“This is a strategy to attack the hearts of humans,” said Meng Chuan coldly. “If some Godfiends lose their will to fight, the human race will lose a portion of their combat strength. Offering a pie in the sky... will make the war much easier. Isn’t that great?”
Liu Qiyue nodded and said, “That’s right. The demons do such things because attacking the human world head-on is very difficult for them.”
“Of course it’s difficult. The stronger demons can’t enter at all,” said Meng Chuan. “Qiyue, I’ll be heading to the chamber to cultivate.”
“Demon Slayer hasn’t finished devouring that Creation-realm alien corpse? It’s been more than a month,” Liu Qiyue whispered.
“It won’t take much longer. It should finish in one or two days,” said Meng Chuan.
In the chamber.
As usual, Meng Chuan took out the 30-foot-long Creation-realm alien corpse. The corpse had already withered quite a bit. However, its black scales and bones were still intact. Nearly half of its muscles and tendons remained.
Demon Slayer had only absorbed a third of it. However, Meng Chuan had said that Demon Slayer would finish absorbing the corpse within a day or two because Demon Slayer’s absorption speed increased over time.
Go. Meng Chuan unsheathed Demon Slayer and casually threw it. Demon Slayer stabbed into the alien corpse. Immediately, Demon Slayer absorbed the blood. The alien’s flesh and blood vanished slowly.
At the side, Meng Chuan practiced the Heart Intent Saber Art empty-handed as Demon Slayer absorbed the alien corpse.
Roughly two hours passed.
An unknown aura emanated. Meng Chuan turned his head in puzzlement. He saw Demon Slayer’s blade transforming as a strange power gathered over it. Gradually, complicated runes appeared on the blade.
Godfiend runes? Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up. The physical body cultivation system, demon monarch cultivation system, Godfiend cultivation system, etc. Runes would appear when one reached a certain level in any cultivation system. For example, Meng Chuan’s Indestructible Divine Armor manifested as runes. They represented a particular law and possessed a unique power.
The runes continued to spread along the blade, and in a few seconds, they were completed. Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Following that, Demon Slayer’s absorption speed of the alien corpse suddenly increased. Large amounts of flesh and bones began to break apart as the golden-red blood surged towards Demon Slayer. Demon Slayer’s absorption speed is so fast. Meng Chuan watched as Demon Slayer devoured the Creation-realm alien corpse at an astonishing speed. Even the black scales were pulverized, transforming into a black mist that fused with Demon Slayer.
In just a few seconds, the corpse was completely devoured, leaving only the right claw’s five razor-sharp hooks.
Only the right claw is left? Furthermore, Demon Slayer can’t absorb it at all. Meng Chuan waved his hand and Demon Slayer flew into his hand. The claw that resembled five knives flew in front of him. Every hook was like a blade, about seven or eight inches. They were long and extremely sharp. It was likely the Creation-realm alien’s sharpest body part. If the claw is reforged, it will be a divine armament. This corpse is extremely tough. Archean Mountain’s predecessors probably didn’t study this corpse carefully. As for the expert who killed this alien, he probably didn’t think much of the corpse.
At such a high physical body cultivation realm, it was probably not difficult for the alien to revive with a single drop of blood. So how did the Archean Mountain senior kill it? The corpse was left mostly intact. Was that Archean Mountain senior already an Imperial Lord?
Several Imperial Lords have existed in human history. Even an expert with an eighth-level Essence Soul has existed. I believe that someone in my generation can do it as well. Meng Chuan put away the claw, prepared to hand it to Archean Mountain for refinement. At the same time, he carefully looked at Demon Slayer.
Its body was dark-red, but the endless baneful aura within the saber was even more intense and shocking than before. The baneful aura began attacking Meng Chuan’s consciousness. However, Meng Chuan had a fourth-level Essence Soul. He could completely withstand the baneful aura.
“Slash!” Meng Chuan infused his Darkstar Quintessential Essence into Demon Slayer. He activated the runes on the saber and slashed downwards. With his Undying Body’s physical strength, the runic patterns on the dark-red saber’s blade became even more dazzling. With a very soft sound, the voice was sliced apart like paper. The rift was about a finger’s length.
Through the void rift, one could see darkness. A chaotic, distorted void energy gathered within the void rift.
I can actually tear open the void? Meng Chuan was alarmed. Although he could previously cause the void to collapse and distortwarping a 1,000-foot-distance to ten feethe was unable to tear open the void.
Among Regis Godfiends, only those with high technique realms could tear open the void. Only when the density of power in one’s attack exceeded the limits of the could they tear open the void. Meng Chuan’s previous strength and speed were insufficient to tear open the void. Now that he had greater strength, due to Demon Slayer transforming, he could split open the void.
I’m afraid it won’t be easy for Senior Brother Archean Mountain Lord to win if he were to spar with me now. Meng Chuan felt more confident about his role in the upcoming battle. Archean Mountain has invested so much into me. Master said that they have also invested a lot in the other Regis Godfiends. I believe all of our combat prowess has improved. We will definitely win this war. I wonder when the demons will start the war.
The demons held the initiative in this war.
The Demon Realm.
Thousands of demon monarchs gathered at the top of a mountain.
“We’ve been here for more than a month. When are we going to start fighting?” Along the mountainside, two demon monarchs were chatting while drinking and eating. They stared at the stable World Entrance just 1,000 feet away. It connected to the human world.
“These are all decisions made by the Imperial Lords. We just need to wait for orders.”
“I really hope that we can win this war the moment we enter the human world and completely destroy the human race. If this drags on, we will have to hide in the human world. I do not like living underground for long periods of time.”
“I was born to fly in the sky; I don’t like staying underground either.”The two demon monarchs chatted while drinking.
Thousands of demon monarchs waited for the three Imperial Lords’ orders. Such scenes could be seen in nearly 200 different areas in the Demon Realm. Over a million demon monarchs were prepared to enter the human world at a moment’s notice.
19th May human world time, the Demon Realm.
A large ship flew through the clouds. A man and a woman stood on the deck of the ship.
The single-horned, black-haired man was Imperial Lord Starquix. The woman-with three white scales between her eyebrowswas Lady Blackmoon. She was also one of the three demon Imperial Lords.
“The fourth Firmament demon monarchs have long gathered. Two months ago, a million demon monarchs arrived at the various World Entrances,” said Lady Blackmoon softly. “Why did we delay until today?”
“Sister Blackmoon, you just woke up and are still unaware of the situation,” said Imperial Lord Starquix with a smile. “Originally, we planned to gather the fourth Firmament demon monarchs and spend several days making simple arrangements before launching a surprise attack on the human world. But who knew that news would leak out the moment they gathered...
In the human world, Archean Mountain and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven have abandoned all prefecture and county cities. They have built large cities. Since news of our surprise attack was leaked, we weren’t able to launch a surprise attack. Therefore, we decided that we might as well prepare fully before attacking.”

chapters.title: Chapter 282 - Large City Pass, Wide Imperial Pass
chapters.content:
Chapter 282 Large City Pass, Wide Imperial Pass
“Have we finished preparing now?” asked Lady Blackmoon.
“We’ve carefully considered how each of the fourth Firmament demon monarchs will be arranged,” said Imperial Lord Starquix, “Nine Abyss recovered his demon sage strength last year, and has completely refined and integrated the Blood Fiend Armor—that I gave him-into his body after half a year. With the Blood Fiend Armor, he is probably much stronger than when he was back in the Demon Realm.”
“What’s the use of being stronger? He’s only a demon sage. There’s a bunch of Creation realm experts over there,” said Lady Blackmoon. “It’s also the humans’ territory. Many of humanity’s treasures can likely be used. The war is in a different world. Many of our treasures are useless in the human world.”
“We can’t do anything else. Our plans have already been exposed,” said Imperial Lord Starquix with a smile. “Since our plans are exposed, we can only crush them with overwhelming power. Cities will completely collapse when 700 fourth Firmament demon monarchs suddenly attack. After multiple sneak attacks, humanity’s infrastructure will definitely collapse. A million demon monarchs will split up and attack... No matter how powerful human Godfiends are, how many demon monarchs can they kill when they can’t split themselves? With a million demon monarchs, we will completely annihilate the human race.”
Lady Blackmoon nodded in approval. “Going against the inevitable trend of the war is what’s most difficult.”
“We’re here,” said Imperial Lord Starquix. The ship slowly descended and landed in front of a huge World Entrance.
“Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s attack on this city pass is only known by the two of us,” said Imperial Lord Starquix with a smile. “Even you didn’t know before I told you, Sister Blackmoon. All fourth Firmament demon monarchs are in the cabin, and the space is sealed. They don’t even know where they are, much less leak the information. Humans’ means of gathering intelligence are too amazing. I have to be careful.”
Lady Blackmoon nodded slightly. “When will Demon Sage Nine Abyss take action?”
“All we have to do is wait. In ten minutes, Nine Abyss will definitely take action and storm this city pass.” Imperial Lord Starquix stood on the ship deck and smiled as he looked at the large World Entrance. On the opposite side of the large World Entrance was the large city pass, Wide Imperial Pass. Two World Island guarded this large city pass.
May 19th, Luofang Island, Wide Imperial Pass.
The Great Yue Dynasty had many forests, mountain ranges, and many islands. The large islands took up most of the Great Yue Dynasty’s territory. Luofang Island was one of the five largest islands. It was nearly half the size of a state. Nearly 20 million people lived on this island, more than half lived in Wide Imperial Pass. Wide Imperial Pass was one of the seven large city passes guarded by
personally guarded this city pass.
In the bustling Wide Imperial Pass, a group of soldiers escorted a carriage forward. Wherever they passed, people would avoid them.
“It’s the Wide Imperial family’s carriage.”
“The Lord of Wide Imperial family is outside.”
Everyone was extremely reverent. Two World Island only had a total of eight Regis Godfiends. However, they had to guard the seven largest city passes in the Great Yue Dynasty. One of them was a super-large city pass. Therefore, Two World Island gave their Regis Godfiends many benefits.
For example, King Wide Imperial was bestowed the entire Luofang Island as his fief. In the fief, King Wide Imperial had the final say. Two World Island could not interfere with his decisions. He was the undisputed supreme ruler of Luofang Island.
In the Great Yue Dynasty, the feoffment system was very common. They even had a slavery system. Black Sand Dynasty and the Great Zhou Dynasty didn’t have such systems.
“Those are the Wide Imperial family’s guards. If one can join the Wide Imperial family, they will bring glory to their ancestors.”
“I heard that only those who have reached the Mortal Shedding realm are qualified to join the Wide Imperial family. It’s just too difficult.”
Many people were engaged in a heated discussion. Many young people were still forward to joining the Wide Imperial family. The Wide Imperial family’s manor was about a kilometer away from the World Entrance. King Wide Imperial could arrive in a second.
Wide Imperial Pass was also one of the Great Yue Dynasty’s 22 major cities. If the demons were to attack, they would probably not spare Wide Imperial Pass. King Wide Imperial stood in a pavilion. He was dressed in a gorgeous white robe with complicated bird patterns embroidered on it. He was tall and had a square face. He had thick facial hair, and his eyes were deep like the sea.
Fourth Firmament demon monarchs are the ones that usually attack Wide Imperial Pass. The threat they pose isn’t too great. On the other hand, letting a million demon monarchs carry out wanton slaughters will probably change how the world works.
Suddenly, King Wide Imperial’s expression changed. This was because he saw a figure appear out of thin air in front of him. It was a sloppy-looking elder. Under the sloppy-looking elder’s disheveled hair was a pair of yellow eyes that stared at King Wide Imperial.
How is this possible? King Wide Imperial couldn’t believe that an enemy had bypassed his Seamless domain and came so close to him without him noticing.
Boom!
His Seamless domain erupted!
A white blast surged out in all directions. It was King Wide Imperial’s attack, the Four Seas Domain. At the same time, King Wide Imperial immediately requested for help through his token and unsheathed his divine sword.
Pfft. The sloppy elder extended his right hand, and a blood-colored armor covered on his thin palm. He appeared to be standing very far away, but he instantly reached towards King Wide Imperial’s chest. King Wide Imperial’s Seamless domain and Quintessential Essence armor were useless in front of the sloppy elder.
The blood-colored claw directly tore King Wide Imperial’s heart out of his chest.
The sloppy elder held a beating heart.
It has the strength of a Creation realm expert. The difference is too great!
King Wide Imperial revealed a look of horror and despair. Before King Wide Imperial could stab out with his divine sword, five bloody beams of light flew out from the blood-colored claw into his body, causing it to expand.
I’m doomed. King Wide Imperial came to a realization as he despaired. At the last moment, he frantically signaled that it was the highest-level threat through his token.
Bam!
His body exploded.
Two World Island’s Regis Godfiends that guard the seven city passes in the Great Yue Dynasty are relatively weak. King Wide Imperial’s strength is ranked at the bottom. He only has the strength of an ordinary Regis Godfiend. The sloppy elder’s eyes were filled with contempt. Just to be safe, he chose to attack Two World Island’s Regis Godfiends. King Wide Imperial was rather easy to deal with.
After infiltrating the human world for many years, he had finally recovered his original cultivation and refined the Blood Fiend Armor.
It wasn’t fun for him to kill an ordinary Regis Godfiend with his peak strength.
Bam!
With a flash, the sloppy elder flashed more than a kilometer away and arrived at the massive World Entrance.
Boom!
A terrifying domain spread out in every direction as the surrounding towering city pass collapsed. The patrolling guards were blasted to pieces. With the sloppy elder at the center, everything within a 2.5-kilometer radius disintegrated. This area was mainly a city pass and a large manor, but tens of thousands of people still died. Furthermore, Demon Sage Nine Abyss had not deliberately targeted them. If he were to waste time killing random passersby, he could turn Wide Imperial Pass into a zone of death.On the other side of the World Entrance.
On the deck of the ship, Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon looked through the huge World Entrance and saw the sloppy old man on the other side. They watched everything around the sloppy old man collapse.
The sloppy-looking old man bowed slightly towards the two Imperial Lords on the other side of the World Entrance.
“Quickly, enter the human world.” Imperial Lord Starquix immediately sent a voice transmission to all the fourth Firmament demon monarchs in the large cabin.
Whoosh...
Many fourth Firmament demon monarchs flew out of the cabin. Under the attention of two Imperial Lords and Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s protection, more than 600 fourth Firmament demon monarchs flew through the World Entrance. In just a few seconds, they arrived at the other end of the World Entrance—the human world.
Archean Mountain.
Qin Wu’s expression changed as he saw an illusory man’s figure appear beside him. The illusory man said anxiously, “Master, I have already entered the human world’s Wide Imperial Pass with many other fourth Firmament demon monarchs. The final battle has begun!”

chapters.title: Chapter 283 - Archean Mountain’s Strength
chapters.content:
Chapter 283 Archean Mountain’s Strength
“It’s finally begun?” Qin Wu stood up with a solemn expression on his face. “Have you seen Demon Sage Nine Abyss?”
“Demon Sage Nine Abyss is instructing us to enter his grotto-heaven treasure,” said the illusory man. “We have already entered the grotto-heaven. Demon Sage Nine Abyss should be leaving Wide Imperial Pass this very moment.”
Qin Wu nodded slightly.
A demon sage could naturally escape with his subordinates extremely quickly.
The illusory man looked at Qin Wu. “What should I do?”
“Stay disguised as a member of the demons,” instructed Qin Wu. “Provide me any updates immediately.”
“Yes,” said the illusory man respectfully before dissipating.
Qin Wu stared off in the distance silently.
Meng Chuan wasn’t the only one who contributed to the human race. Many Godfiends contributed to humans’ survival.
“The final battle has started.” Qin Wu’s eyes glinted sharply. “What great timing.”
Whoosh.
In two small courtyards in Grotto-Heaven Pavilion, an illusory Xu Yingwu—from Two World Island-and an illusory Bai Yaoyuefrom Black Sand Grotto-Heaven-appeared one after another.
Soon, the three of them met.
“Wide Imperial Pass has been breached.” Xu Yingwu’s expression turned ugly as he said, “King Wide Imperial died in the blink of an eye. He requested the highest-level of reinforcements. The one who attacked should be Demon Sage Nine Abyss. It has likely recovered its original cultivation.”
“I’m certain that the fourth Firmament demon monarchs have already sneaked in,” said Bai Yaoyue.
“They infiltrated from Wide Imperial Pass,” said Qin Wu. “Demon Sage Nine Abyss led them into a grotto-heaven treasure and rapidly fled.”
In terms of strength of all three factions, Black Sand Grotto-Heaven was now comparable to Archean Mountain. After all, Imperial Lord Black Sand and Grandsire Yin Yang—who created a transcendent-grade Godfiend Body-originated from Black Sand Grotto-Heaven. Back Sand Grotto-Heaven’s strength was unquestionable.
Archean Mountain had a longer heritage than the other two sects. After all, it had existed since humans still lived in tribes! It had lasted many eras with Imperial Lords! Even if Imperial Lords ruled the world, it was difficult for them to conquer Archean Mountain. Many mighty human legaciesincluding the most mysterious Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven-were all at Archean Mountain.
Xu Yingwu gritted his teeth. “The demons really treat my Two World Island as a pushover.”
“The Regis Godfiends that guard over the Great Yue Dynasty’s large city passes are the weakest. It’s normal for them to choose to attack you,” said Bai Yaoyue indifferently.
This was the truth. Peak Regis Godfiends from Archean Mountain, like King East River and Archean Mountain Lord, didn’t have the qualifications to guard large city passes. The ones responsible were King True Martial, King Calm Sea, King White Elephant, King Swallow Mountain, and etc. They were peak Regis Godfiends at the threshold of the Creation realm.
Demon Sage Nine Abyss just needed to weigh the pros and cons carefully, which is why he chose to attack the pushover. By doing this, he could prevent any accidents.
“Bai Yaoyue.” Xu Yingwu’s face was livid. “Our Two World Island has just lost a Regis Godfiend. Why are you making such sarcastic remarks?”
Bai Yaoyue snorted and did not retort. With her pride, she would’ve continued sniping at him. However, she didn’t continue because she was taking the big picture into account.
“The situation now is very clear. The demons have finally invaded the human world on an even larger scale. We can deal with 700 fourth Firmament demon monarchs since they’re just on the higher end of the strength spectrum,” said Qin Wu. “The million ordinary demon monarchs and countless demons are the most troublesome to deal with! Now, over a million demon monarchs are in front of the various medium-sized World Entrances in the Demon realm as they await their orders to charge into the human world.”
Both Bai Yaoyue and Xu Yingwu wore serious expressions.
“Both of you have kept the matter of the thousand-year-old mystic technique a secret, right?” asked Qin Wu.
“We all know how big the implications would be if the information leaked. There have been no leaks,” Xu Yingwu said.
“Don’t worry,” Bai Yaoyue said coldly.
“Then let’s act according to plan,” said Qin Wu. “We have to catch them off-guard and make them suffer heavy losses! If not, things will be much more troublesome in the future.”
Bai Yaoyue and Xu Yingwu nodded.
“Quickly make preparations. Fourth Firmament demon monarchs will be rushing to various cities from Wide Imperial Pass. They’ll take at least 12 hours to travel alone. We have to be as fast as possible,” said Qin Wu. “Everyone, the survival of humanity will depend on this final battle. If we lose, there will be no future for us.”
A cold light flashed in Xu Yingwu’s eyes. “We have to deal them a severe blow in this battle.”
“They only know how to hide underground.” Bai Yaoyue’s eyes were also filled with killing intent. Following that, she glanced at Qin Wu and Xu Yingwu, and said, “Summon me if you need anything.” Then, the illusory Bai Yaoyue disappeared.
The illusory Xu Yingwu also disappeared.
Inside an Archean Mountain grotto-heaven.
White fog drifted by an empty palace. Qin Wu and an illusory Luo Tang walked side-by-side.
In the enormous plaza in front of the palace, two figures were seated in the lotus position. One was a rather dispirited middle-aged man, while the other was a black-robed, red-haired woman. The two were like statues as they stayed seated in the lotus position, as though they had existed for thousands of years.
Huh? The two figures sitting cross-legged trembled slightly before opening their eyes. “Dao Protectors,” said Oin Wu. “‘The human race is now in a dire situation; the two of you will need to take action.”
“Ever since I possessed the body of a Dao Protector, I have been sitting here all this time.” The middle-aged man stood up and said, “My Essence Soul is at the sixth level. I can maintain this body for 120 years before my Essence Soul dissipates. Every second of lucidity is precious. It’s worth it to kill demon monarchs.”
“You can stay lucid for another 80 years. However, my Essence Soul is at the fifth level. I can only stay lucid for 30 more years,” said the black-robed woman coldly.
The middle-aged man immediately smiled obsequiously. “Junior Sister, as long as the two of us don’t fight, we can remain in a meditative state for more than 1,000 years. Furthermore, a Dao Protector’s body allows us to possess the strength of an ordinary Creation realm expert. Our luck is pretty good.”
“Come in with us.” Qin Wu and the illusory Luo Tang led the way.
“How bad is the situation outside?” asked the two Dao Protectors as they followed along.
“One demon sage and 700 fourth Firmament demon monarchs lurk in the shadows,” said Qin Wu coldly. “There’s also a million demon monarchs and countless demons ready to attack at a moment’s notice. Their goal is to destroy our large cities and slaughter mortals! They want to wipe humanity out. Without mortals, no new Godfiends will be born. It is the simplest solution to getting rid of us humans. In just a few centuries, other than a few Supremacies, all of humanity’s Regis Godfiends would’ve died of old age. In 1,000 years, even Supremacies will die of old age. Besides, without sufficient manpower to stop them, they can secretly expand the World Entrances in our human world.”
As Qin Wu spoke, he walked to the palace.
The towering entrance of the palace was tightly shut, but outside the entrance were nine divine beast sculptures.
“Guardian Divine Beasts, wake up,” said Qin Wu.The nine Guardian Divine Beasts all opened their eyes.
“This time, all of you will also be participating in this battle,” said Qin Wu.
“As you command, Supremacy,” said the nine Guardian Divine Beasts respectfully. They were not normal life-forms, but puppets. As long as they were maintained well, they could exist forever.
Qin Wu and Luo Tang exchanged looks and pushed the palace entrance open together.
Rumble...
The entrance opened.
Figures laid inside the frost-filled palace hall. They were all humans; all were frozen in massive dark-blue ice blocks.
“Awaken, everyone!” Qin Wu said solemnly. All the dark-blue ice blocks in the hall began to melt. The eyelids of the figures inside the hall began to twitch.

chapters.title: Chapter 284 - Awaken, Everyone!
chapters.content:
Chapter 284 Awaken, Everyone!
Within the 26 enormous dark-blue ice blocks were 26 humans.
As the dark-blue ice blocks melted, the human experts within began to awaken. Qin Wu, Luo Tang, and the two Dao Protectors watched with excitement.
“Huh?”
“This is...”
One human expert after another stood up. At first, they were somewhat puzzled, but soon, they were completely awake.
“Senior Brother Qin, how long have I been asleep for?” asked a white-robed man. “Five hundred years? Eight hundred years?” The other human experts also looked at Qin Wu and company.
“Everyone.” Qin Wu said, “It’s the 853rd year since the demons first invaded the human world.”
Many of the men and women-that had just woken up-were enlightened.
“I’ve been asleep for over 500 years.”
“Three hundred years...”
“Time is the greatest enemy. How many people I know are still alive in this world?”
The men and women had mixed feelings.
However, two recently-awakened experts were somewhat puzzled. A plump white-haired elder said in puzzlement, “Junior Brother Qin, you have already become a Supremacy? Also, demons invaded 853 years ago? What race are the demons?”
“Junior Brother Qin, what’s with the demon invasion?” Another goateed elder was puzzled as well.
“Peng Mu, Lunatic Yun,” said a middle-aged scholarly man who had just awoken, “The two of you have been asleep for 982 years. Millennium Instant is one of the core secret arts of our Archean Mountain. In every Regis Godfiend generation, only those with strength comparable to a Creation realm expert will enter Millennium Hall to ‘sleep’ when they are close to the end of their lifespans. This is also to save some combat strength for Archean Mountain. About 100 years after the two of you slumbered, the demons invaded.
“The strength of the Demon Realm is much stronger than that of the human world. Therefore, Archean Mountain decided that all Regis Godfiends will enter a deep slumber 50 years before the end of their lifespans. Two hundred years after the demons first invaded, Archean Mountain sensed that the situation wasn’t turning for the better. Thus, after all the Supremacies and Dao Protectors in Archean Mountain came to an agreement, we shared the Millenium Instant mystic technique with Two World Island and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven.”
“Master.” Immediately, the white-haired elder and the goateed elder respectfully bowed when they saw the middle-aged man.
“Senior Brother Li.” Qin Wu and Luo Tang also bowed slightly.
The middle-aged man was Supremacy Li Guan. He was the strongest and the oldest expert here. He wasn’t too far away from the end of his 2,000-year lifespan. Thus, he was in a deep slumber most of the time.
vas
The Millennium Instant mystic technique allowed them to awaken mid-way, but they could only “steal” a thousand years from the worldly laws.
“Everyone is awake.” Li Guan swept his gaze around. “This means that the situation is so bad that we have to participate.”
The eyes of these awakened Regis Godfiends were filled with fighting spirit. These were Archean Mountain’s many powerful Regis Godfiends that had lived in different periods over the past 1,000 years. For example, Peng Mu and Yun Jianhai were Regis Godfiends that had reigned supreme in the world 1,000 years ago. These Godfiends were almost 400 years old if one didn’t count the time they were in a deep slumber. They were very strong and had profound moves. The outside world believed that they had died of old age! In reality, they had gone into a deep slumber when they only had a few decades of their lifespans left.
Even now, very few Regis Godfiends died in battle. Hundreds of years ago, the situation had been much better. Almost all Regis Godfiends died of old age. In fact, ever since they obtained the Millennium Instant mystic technique, the three major sects’ Regis Godfiends had all entered a deep slumber.
This secret had been kept confidential the entire time. Those who knew the secret were either Supremacies or Regis Godfiends that had slumbered.
“Awaken, Regis Godfiends of Two World Island.”
Xu Yingwu and an illusory Zhang Chun could not help but smile when they saw the Regis Godfiends waking after the dark-blue ice melted.
Unlike the Regis Godfiends of this era that had shallow accumulations, these sleeping ones were all nearing the end of their lifespans. The weakest ones were top Regis Godfiends, some were even peak Regis Godfiends. Two had reached the threshold of the Creation realm.
“Awaken, everyone.” The three Supremacies, Bai Yaoyue, Meng Tiange, and Mi Yu, were staring at the figures sleeping in the dark palace.
The dark-blue ice melted, and figures slowly sat up in confusion.
“Archean Mountain’s Millennium Instant mystic technique has indeed helped us greatly,” said the bearded Meng Tiange.
“Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s inheritance is with them, so it’s normal for them to have more tricks,” said Bai Yaoyue calmly.
Men and women stood up as they woke up completely. They looked at the three Supremacies with eyes filled with fighting spirit.
“Do you need us to join the battle?”
“Has it already reached the point where all the Regis Godfiends have to awaken?” asked the Regis Godfiends.
Meng Tiange said, “Everyone, the entire human race needs your protection. We need you to kill the demon monarchs.”
The three great sects were ready to strike.
Archean Mountain, in a hall.
“Senior Brother Li, this is our temporary arrangement. Is there anything you want to change?” Qin Wu handed a dossier to Li Guan.
Li Guan took it and quickly flipped through it. As a Creation Supremacy, he naturally read it very quickly. “Seven hundred fourth Firmament demon monarchs, a million demon monarchs... The demons really want to destroy the foundation of our human race in one fell swoop.” Li Guan read the dossier calmly. “There are now 61 large cities in the Great Zhou Dynasty. There are 13 Regis Godfiends in this era, 25 Regis Godfiends who were in slumber, nine Guardian Divine Beasts, two Dao Protectors, three Creation Supremacies, and 73 Marquis Godfiends.
“There are a total of ten experts with the combat strength of a Creation realm expert. However, other than the three of us, the rest are at the Creation realm threshold.” Li Guan looked at the dossier and nodded slightly. “This plan is considered safe. I’m supposed to preside over Archean Mountain?”
“Archean Mountain is the last hope of humanity,” said the illusory Luo Tang. “No matter how strong the demons are, we can retreat to Archean Mountain. Archean Mountain cannot be lost.”
Li Guan nodded slightly. “If we are forced into a corner, we shall end the world. We will guard Archean Mountain alone.”
“Too many mortals will die. Unless we truly have no hope will we choose that path,” said Qin Wu immediately.
“Yes.” Li Guan looked at the dossier and said in surprise, ‘This Meng Chuan is also one of the three Godfiends responsible for providing reinforcements? The ones responsible for providing reinforcements are you, my Essence Soul avatar, and him?”
Immediately, the Regis Godfiends—who had just awoken-were astonished. They didn’t know who Meng Chuan was.
“The dossier has a detailed description of his strength,” said Qin Wu calmly.
“Yes.” After Li Guan finished reading the dossier, he smiled and nodded. “Alright. Qin Wu, you are more reliable than me. Just follow the plan.”
“Then, do we implement it immediately?” inquired Qin Wu.
Li Guan nodded. “Right away!”
Soon, Qin Wu, Li Guan, and Luo Tang summoned each Regis Godfiend and Dao Protector.
“Dao Protector Wang Shan, hold this token and quickly head to Jiang State Capital. From today onwards, you will be stationed in Jiang State Capital.” Qin Wu threw the token to Dao Protector Wang Shan. “When you reach Jiang State Capital, you just need to hide in the shadows. Do not let any human discover you. Also, an envoy will accompany you. The envoy will pass orders to Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue.”
“Alright.” Wang Shan received the token and quickly left Archean Mountain with an avian demon monarch envoy. They headed straight for Jiang State Capital. Swish! Swish! Swish!
Regis Godfiends, Dao Protectors, and Guardian Divine Beasts left Archean Mountain after receiving orders and rushed in every direction.
Dao Protector Wang Shan had an extremely high cultivation realm. He also had the strength of a weak Creation realm expert. He traveled extremely quickly with the flying demon monarch envoy. When the sky turned dark, he had arrived in Jiang State Capital.“Jiang State Capital is huge. Back then, Jiang State Capital’s population was only a few million. Now, it’s already more than 20 million?” Wang Shan stood high in the sky and looked at the massive, bustling city with mixed emotions. As for the envoy, he bowed before flying towards Meng Manor alone.
Meng Manor.
Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue were chatting while having dinner. This time of day was their leisure time. Meng Chuan couldn’t hide the fatigue on his face.
Swoosh.
An avian demon monarch descended from the sky.
Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue looked outside in surprise.
“Marquis Eastcalm, Marchioness Calmmoon, these are the transfer orders given by Archean Mountain. Please leave quickly.” The avian demon monarch envoy handed two thick envelopes to Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue.
“Transfer orders?” Meng Chuan and his wife received the thick envelopes in surprise. They opened the envelopes and read the contents.

chapters.title: Chapter 285 - Transfer Orders Everywhere
chapters.content:
Chapter 285 Transfer Orders Everywhere
Meng Chuan looked at the contents. The letter contained the aura of Supremacy Qin Wu. This was also one of the ways Archean Mountain prevented counterfeit letters and to ensure authenticity.
Eastcalm City, Chu An City, and Changfeng City. I only need to provide reinforcements to these three large cities and eight medium-sized World Entrances? Meng Chuan was somewhat surprised. Archean Mountain had assigned Godfiends to guard these eight medium-sized World Entrances, so the possibility of them requiring reinforcements was low.
My speed is the fastest in the world. The only ones that need help are three large cities?
Meng Chuan was very shocked. He had always believed that Archean Mountain might have great use for him since he was the fastest in the world and had the combat strength of a top Regis Godfiend. His master, Qin Wu, had even given him a Creation-realm alien corpse for Demon Slayer to absorb, bringing it to its peak state. However, he only needed to reinforce three of the Great Zhou Dynasty’s large cities out of 61?
Even the three great cities weren’t actually under his watch. Other Godfiends were guarding them. He just needed to wait for them to request reinforcements.
That’s right. In the end, I’m only one person. If I have to cover too many large cities, it’ll be difficult for me to act as a reinforcement effectively. Meng Chuan revealed a smile. Archean Mountain only arranged three large cities for me to rescue. The other cities clearly have proper arrangements.
The more confident the sect was, the more excited Meng Chuan became. The ‘strength’ the sect had was beyond his expectations!
The stronger the sect is, the better.
“Are you done reading your transfer orders?” asked the avian demon monarch envoy.
Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue exchanged looks.
“Ah Chuan, I can’t divulge my transfer orders,” said Liu Qiyue. “However, I have to leave with the envoy now.”
“Oh?” Meng Chuan was surprised.
According to his transfer orders, he could act alone, but his wife needed to leave with the envoy?
“Each person’s transfer orders are confidential,” said the avian demon monarch envoy apologetically. “Although most Godfiends are fighting for humans, it’s inevitable that one or two will collude with the demons. Therefore, after Marchioness Calmmoon receives her transfer orders, I will follow her to another city. This can also ensure that Marchioness Calmmoon doesn’t leak any information during the journey.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly and exhorted his wife. “Be careful.”
Liu Qiyue looked at her husband. “It’s the final battle. You also have to be careful.”
Husband and wife would be separated, each fighting in different areas in the world. They could not afford to lose this final battle. They had to win!
Time to go. Liu Qiyue flew with the avian demon monarch envoy and headed west.
Meng Chuan watched them leave from afar.
“Father, Father-in-law.” Meng Chuan sent a voice transmission to Meng Dajiang and Liu Yebai. “From today onwards, help me take care of Meng You. It’s best if you don’t leave Meng Manor. Even if there’s trouble, remember not to leave Jiang State Capital.”
Jiang State Capital was one of the ten most prosperous cities in the Great Zhou Dynasty, so its safety was definitely above Eastcalm City.
Meng Dajiang and Liu Yebai were chatting casually when Meng Chuan suddenly sent them a voice transmission. “Okay.” They were shocked but didn’t dare to be negligent.
Meng Chuan glanced at his daughter, who was practicing her sword under a distant fruit tree. With a flash, he left Jiang State Capital.
That night...
Marquis Eastcalm and Marchioness Calmmoon left Jiang State Capital. Wang Shan-one of Archean Mountain’s two dao protectors—personally watched over Jiang State Capital.
Whoosh.
Marchioness Calmmoon and the avian demon monarch flew west.
The sect is indeed cautious. With the avian envoy watching, there’s no way for traitors to leak information. Marchioness Calmmoon was quite satisfied. However, Archean Mountain didn’t send any envoys to follow Ah Chuan. It’s clear they trust Ah Chuan greatly.
Meng Chuan was highly trusted. However, Archean Mountain never trusted a single Marquis Godfiend. Meng Chuan was allowed to go alone because he didn’t know much! He only knew that he was responsible for acting as a reinforcement for three large cities and eight medium-sized World Entrances. As for how powerful the guardians of the three large cities and eight medium-sized World Entrances were? He had no idea.
“Duyang City.” Liu Qiyue looked at the huge city in front of her. This was the city she needed to guard.
“Marchioness Calmmoon, follow me.” The avian demon monarch envoy led the way and soon arrived at a manor in Duyang City. Liu Qiyue landed in a relatively quiet, elegant mansion. It didn’t occupy a large area. Only she and the avian demon monarch were there. There weren’t even servants.
“Oh?” Liu Qiyue looked up.
High in the sky, another avian demon monarch envoy led an old woman over.
“Senior Sister Chang.” Liu Qiyue’s eyes lit up as she went to receive the old woman.
“Junior Sister Liu, so you are the one guarding Duyang City with me.” The old woman smiled. “I’m relieved now. Junior Sister Liu, you have a Phoenix Divine Body. Even if ten fourth Firmament demon monarchs were to attack, they would be sending themselves to their deaths.”
“Senior Sister Chang, you are good at reconnaissance. You can prevent demon monarchs from sneak attacking the city,” said Liu Qiyue with a smile. This old woman was Marchioness Plum Snow. She cultivated the Eon Sea Fiend Body, so her domain was extremely useful for reconnaissance. She was also skilled in close combat. With her in charge of reconnaissance, she could naturally protect Liu Qiyue’s safety.
If Liu Qiyue cast Phoenix’s Nirvana, she would be a top sharpshooter at the Regis Godfiend level. She could kill everything. Liu Qiyue’s only weakness was that she was relatively weaker when she didn’t cast Phoenix’s Nirvana. “Your Excellencies, please instruct us if you need anything.” The two avian demon monarchs were rather respectful.
Liu Qiyue and the old lady nodded slightly.
How cautious. They don’t even arrange for mortal servants. Liu Qiyue sighed inwardly. Furthermore, the Marquis Godfiends will monitor each other. Very good. The more cautious we are, the better. Those traitors can forget about leaking any information.
Eastcalm City.
Ever since Eastcalm Prefecture City was expanded to a large city, Meng Chuan had passed by many times, always staying high in the sky. He had never landed to observe the changes in the city closely.
Eastcalm City is now a large city. Meng Chuan looked down from above. Originally, Eastcalm Prefecture City had only an inner city. An outer city had been built and expanded. Each of the four outer city walls was 75 kilometers long.Whoosh.
Meng Chuan landed on a beacon tower on the outer city wall. The four walls totaled 300 kilometers. A soldier was stationed every 50 feet. They carefully observed the situation outside the city. At the same time, many soldiers constantly patrolled the city walls. Meng Chuan’s Darkstar domain isolated his aura and light waves; thus, the soldiers didn’t even notice a person sitting on the beacon tower.
Meng Chuan sat on the beacon tower and drank some wine from a flask.
I wonder how the three major sects have arranged their forces to deal with countless demons, a million ordinary demon monarchs, and 700 fourth Firmament demon monarchs. If they allow the demons to wreak havoc on land, many mortals will die. The closer the final battle got, the more worried he was.
No matter how much I think about it, it’s useless. I just need to concentrate on my mission and protect my assigned targets well. Other people are in charge of the different missions. Meng Chuan’s eyes narrowed as he slowly drank the wine.
I need to reinforce three large cities. Eastcalm City and Chu An City are 555 kilometers apart. Chu An City and Changfeng City are 600 kilometers apart. Eastcalm City and Changfeng City are 750 kilometers apart. Archean Mountain arranged for me to reinforce these three neighboring large cities. It’ll be more convenient for me.
If I want to be faster at helping people, staying put at Chu An City is the wisest decision. Chu An City is close to Eastcalm City and Changfeng City. Since that’s the case... I’ll go to Chu An City. Meng Chuan gently clenched his fist around the alcohol flask in his hand; it silently turned into powder. With a whoosh, he streaked across the night sky and headed straight for Chu An City.
Although Eastcalm City was his hometown, in the face of the final battle, he had to ensure that he could reinforce his assigned protection targets as quickly as possible. If he could reach the cities quickly, it would determine the war’s outcome.

chapters.title: Chapter 286 - Fifth Firmament
chapters.content:
Chapter 286 Fifth Firmament
Calm Sea Pass, Xue Manor.
The training ground in Xue Manor was extremely large. It took up more than half the entire manor, and it was a kilometer long and wide. Servants were forbidden from entering the training ground. Even Godfiends had to ‘report’ outside the training ground. Only one person was at the training grounds currently, King Calm Sea.
Exhale, inhale. King Calm Sea sat cross-legged on the training ground’s grass. Nobody disturbed him here. He had a cold expression and was tall. A strange, magical power revolved around him as he sat cross-legged. The moonlight distorted around him, and the flow of time seemed to change.
Huh? He opened his eyes. It was like the first ray of light in the world, one that had a terrifying aura. King Calm Sea was an extremely reputable Godfiend. Even the demons were extremely afraid of him. Archan Mountain recognized him as the Regis Godfiend that had the highest chance of reaching the Creation realm. Despite knowing that he was a great threat, the demons didn’t dare ambush him. Demon Sage Nine Abyss had never chosen him as an opponent.
Envoys? King Calm Sea looked up at the sky. Two figures had appeared in the sky. One was an avian demon monarch envoy, while the other was a peacock-shaped, dark-red metallic beast.
“King Calm Sea.” The avian demon monarch envoy respectfully handed an envelope over. The envelope flew into King Calm Sea’s hands. “These are transfer orders from Archean Mountain.”
“Transfer orders?” King Calm Sea frowned slightly. He had been presiding over Calm Sea Pass for a long time. Could it be that he was being sent out of Calm Sea Pass?
He opened the envelope and read his transfer orders.
During wartime, the likelihood of Calm Sea Pass being attacked is rather low. A Guardian Divine Beast shall guard it. I’m being transferred to North Night City? King Calm Sea glanced at the Guardian Divine Beast. He could vaguely sense that the Guardian Divine Beast’s body was special. It was likely a Creation-realm divine armament. He could defeat the Guardian Divine Beast, but not truly damage it.
It can guard the city pass alone. King Calm Sea nodded slightly and said, “I’ll head to North Night City.”
Swoosh.
King Calm Sea instantly vanished, reappearing far away in the sky. In another flash, he vanished from Calm Sea Pass completely.
A Guardian Divine Beast will temporarily guard True Martial Pass. I’ll be defending Water Separation City? King True Martial smiled as he read the letter. He was a long-haired elder that treated others very warmly. He was the strongest Regis Godfiend of Archean Mountain’s current generation. In terms of technique realm and Essence Soul, he was in no way inferior to a Creation Supremacy. However, the probability of him breaking through to the Creation realm was extremely slim due to his age. If he attempted to make a breakthrough, his chances of dying were greater than 90 percent.
It’s very unlikely for True Martial Pass will be attacked. It’ll be fine for the Guardian Divine Beast to guard it. King True Martial nodded. His status was special. He was appointed to be the next Dao Protector, so he knew many of the sect’s secrets. For example, he knew that as long as these Guardian Divine Beasts were maintained well, they could exist for all eternity. It was fine if they did not fight, but once they really fought, the cost of maintaining them would increase greatly.
After all, a Guardian Divine Beast was just a special puppet. It was normal for Godfiends to fight. However, a Guardian Divine Beast required an astonishing amount of energy to fight. In a battle, the cost of maintaining it was equivalent to tens of millions of credits. It was best if they didn’t fight at all.
We have to win this decisive battle. Otherwise, it will be troublesome once we use up all our trump cards. When King True Martial saw the Guardian Divine Beast, he guessed the Supremacy’s general plan. Perhaps, most of the sect’s reserve combat strength had been employed.
Swoosh.
King True Martial took a step forward, and dozens of his afterimages appeared in the air as he disappeared into the horizon.
In terms of speed, King Calm Sea and King True Martial far surpassed ordinary Regis Godfiends. They were only slightly inferior to Creation Supremacies.
The battle is coming. The white-haired, white-browed elder looked at the letter and nodded slightly. He took a step forward and streaked across the horizon.
King White Elephant was the oldest among current Regis Godfiends. He wasn’t far from entering Millennium Instant Hall.
That night, the three sects dispatched forces to all over the world. The three sects managed their respective territories; thus, they were very fast. In six hours, all of their forces had arrived at their assigned locations! Meng Chuan, Liu Qiyue, Xue Feng, Yan Chitong, and many others patiently waited for the final battle to begin.
Inside a grotto-heaven.
Demon Sage Nine Abyss sat on his throne and flipped through a dossier.
“Two Marquis Godfiends from Two World Island have leaked information. One Archean Mountain Marquis Godfiend has leaked information. There’s nothing from Black Sand Grotto-Heaven?” Demon Sage Nine Abyss frowned. “Isn’t it said that there are 18 Marquis Godfiends that are in contact with us? Only three leaked information? How can they cower at such a critical moment?”.
“Demon Sage, the three great sects are very careful. It’s very difficult to leak any information,” said a Skydemon respectfully. “It’s already not easy for these three Marquis Godfiends to leak some information.”
“Two World Island’s two Marquis Godfiends are hidden beside medium-sized World Entrances?” Demon Sage Nine Abyss read the intel. “That Archean Mountain Marquis Godfiend, who leaked the news, is also hiding beside a medium-sized World Entrance?”
The Skydemon respectfully said, “They are all hiding by World Entrances alone. It wasn’t easy for them to find a chance to leak information.”
“The humans are now sending Marquis Godfiends to guard medium-sized World Entrances?” Demon Sage Nine Abyss frowned. “From the looks of it, they are extremely wary against our one million demon monarchs. They definitely won’t let so many demon monarchs enter the human world easily.”
“Yes,” said the Skydemon respectfully. “They would rather reduce some of their cities’ defenses to stop a million demon monarchs,” said Demon Sage Nine Abyss. “However, just three pieces of intelligence tell us too little.”
The Skydemon reverently said, “The dossier contains some of our Skydemon Sect’s guesses after searching for information thoroughly.”
“Alright, you are dismissed.” Demon Sage Nine Abyss waved his hand.
“Yes.” The Skydemon retreated.
Demon Sage Nine Abyss pondered the situation.
Moments later, a group of fifth Firmament demon monarchs entered the hall.
The fifth Firmament demon monarchs bowed respectfully. “Demon Sage.”“Hahaha...” Demon Sage Nine Abyss could not help but laugh when he saw them. “It looks like all of you have succeeded in breaking through. Our forces in the human world have become stronger!”
“If it weren’t for the treasures bestowed by the Imperial Lords, perhaps only half of us would have been able to break through normally,” said the leader-a three-headed snake demon monarch—with a laugh. “With those treasures, the 23 of us managed to break through in one go after entering the human world.”
Demon Sage Nine Abyss nodded slightly. “Only the 23 of you were chosen out of everybody else in the Demon Realm. With that, we now have 23 fifth Firmament demon monarchs in the human world. We have a greater chance of winning this war.” “Demon Sage, what should we do now?” All of them looked at Demon Sage Nine Abyss. Demon Sage Nine Abyss smiled and said, “Don’t worry. The Imperial Lords have already made arrangements. The 23 of you are to launch sneak attacks on 23 large cities in Black Sand Dynasty and the Great Zhou Dynasty. A group of fourth Firmament demon monarchs will launch sneak attacks first. They are to attack openly while the 23 of you are to attack surreptitiously! If it’s just Marquis Godfiends guarding a city, the two parties shall cooperate to kill them. If it’s a powerful Regis Godfiend guarding a city, retreat immediately. The safety of the 23 of you is very important.”
The demons trusted the 23 fifth Firmament demon monarchs after much investigation. Each of them was bestowed with valuable treasures! After all, it wasn’t easy to find a fourth Firmament demon monarch who was close to breaking through.
The fifth Firmament demon monarchs nodded. “Understood.”
“These are your respective plans.” Demon Sage Nine Abyss waved his hand, and 23 scrolls appeared in midair. They flew towards the 23 fifth Firmament demon monarchs.
“All of you are to follow your plans. You are not to pass this information to any other demon monarch. Anyone who dares to inquire about them will be a traitor,” instructed Demon Sage Nine Abyss. “Go back and prepare. I will send all of you away very soon.”
The fifth Firmament demon monarchs respectfully said, “Yes.” As Demon Sage Nine Abyss watched them leave, his eyes were filled with anticipation. “Since the Imperial Lords were the ones to create the plan, humanity will definitely fall even if they have some secret reserve strength.”

chapters.title: Chapter 287 - Preparation
chapters.content:
Chapter 287 Preparation
The dark hall was filled with sumptuous food. Six demon monarchs, including Greater Demon Monarch Ravensnake, ate and drank as they chatted.
“The probability of us demons winning this battle is more than half. I just wonder if we will live,” said a white-browed wolf demon monarch as he drank.
“Who dares to disobey the orders of an Imperial Lord?” Greater Demon Monarch Blackcroc grinned and swallowed the roasted meat that was half the size of a human. He scoffed. “However, we are ultimately fourth Firmament demon monarchs. They will not easily send us to our deaths.” “This is an intact world, after all. This world has given birth to many Imperial Lords in the past.” Demon Monarch Red Fox chuckled and said, “From the demons’ point of view, it’s worth sacrificing more than half of the demons to occupy the human world. From the three Imperial Lords’ point of view, if we completely occupy the human world, the treasures left behind by human Imperial Lords will also fall into their hands. I believe the three of them place huge importance on the rich accumulation of history this world has.”
“However, the hard work falls on us,” said a demon monarch with a huge turtle shell in a deep voice. “We need to charge forward and fight humans to the death.”
“Don’t make it sound so nasty. If you were to contribute greatly, the Imperial Lords would definitely reward you greatly.” The rat demon monarch—the smallest demon monarch out of the six here—drank his alcohol happily.
The six demon monarchs were overlords in the Demon Realm. However, they had no choice but to join the fray obediently when the Imperial Lords ordered them to do so. The six of them were assigned to the same team.
“They’re here,” said Ravensnake softly. He looked at the hall entrance.
An envoy walked in. He smiled at the six demon monarchs in front of him, and with a token in hand, said, “Greater demon monarchs, the demon sage has ordered for you to set off immediately.”
Demon Monarch Ravensnake casually tossed the bone in his hand. He stood up with his large body and looked at the envoy with his vertical pupils. He cupped his hands slightly and bowed. “I will proceed with the demon sage’s orders.”
“I will proceed with the demon sage’s orders.” The other five greater demon monarchs stood up and bowed.
“Only Ravensnake knows about the mission details. You are not to divulge the information to other demon monarchs.” The envoy held the token and continued, “Ravensnake only needs to lead his team and set off. Once you arrive at your destination, wait for further orders.”
“Yes,” Ravensnake said in a low voice.
The envoy then left.
Ravensnake’s gaze swept past his five companions. “Everyone, it’s time to fight.”
“Time to go.”
“Let’s go.”
The five demon monarchs stood up, their eyes filled with ferocious killing intent. Although they were unhappy with the Imperial Lords’ coercion, they still carried out their orders. This was because they followed the law of the jungle from the moment they were born. The three Imperial Lords were the strongest in the Demon Realm, so they naturally had to obey their orders.
This group of demon monarchs had been released from a small grotto-heaven by Demon Sage Nine Abyss.
Deep underground, they journeyed to their destination carefully.
“Ravensnake, where are we going this time?”
“Which city are we attacking?”
The six of them traveled underground. An invisible black wind enveloped them as they constantly tunneled through the rock and soil, allowing them to maintain supersonic speeds.
“I can’t tell you anything. This is a rule set by the Imperial Lords.” Ravensnake shook his head and said in a low voice, “I don’t dare violate it. You will naturally know once we reach our destination in a few more hours.”
“We sure are being careful. We’re almost about to take action, but we still aren’t allowed to know our target,” said Red Fox with a chuckle.
“Of course we have to be careful. Humans received news of us gathering the moment the Imperial Lords summoned us. The Imperial Lords are afraid that information will be leaked again,” said the white-browed wolf demon monarch.
“Now that I think about it, it’s odd. The Imperial Lord secretly summoned us and isolated us from the outside world the moment we arrived. Even if there are traitors who wish to snitch on us, they shouldn’t be able to contact the outside world.” Blackcroc sighed. “But in the end, information still spread. Humans truly have mysterious means of gathering intelligence.”
“It’s a world that has given birth to Imperial Lords, after all. Their means are naturally impressive,” said the white-browed wolf demon monarch with a nod. However, his eyes turned colder.
They stealthily made their way to their destination underground. More than six hours later, they finally arrived at their destination after taking a slight detour.
“We’re here.”
It was noon. The sun was high up in the sky and shining brightly.
In a lush forest, the six greater demon monarchs emerged from the ground. The surroundings were void of people; nobody lived here.
“That’s it.” Ravensnake looked ahead. In front of him was a desolate city pass. The city pass was filled with weeds. There were three large words on the city pass gate-Clear Rain Pass.
“Clear Rain Pass?” Red Fox narrowed his eyes as he whispered, “This is one of the abandoned medium-sized city passes in the Great Zhou Dynasty. Weren’t we going to attack a city?”
“Are we going to attack an empty city?”
The other five demon monarchs looked at Ravensnake.
Ravensnake stared at Clear Rain Pass and said, “I believe everyone has guessed that this is Clear Rain Pass. There’s a stable medium-sized World Entrance here. Soon, a large number of ordinary demon monarchs will enter the human world! Human Godfiends are highly likely to appear to block them. Our mission... is to kill the human Godfiends and protect our ordinary demon monarchs as they enter.”
“Kill Godfiends?” The five demon monarchs looked at each other. The white-browed wolf demon monarch sensed a distant area.
In the barren wilderness.
At the peak of a solitary mountain, a long-haired man was seated in the lotus position. Suddenly, an illusory man appeared beside him.
“Zhao Yi.” Qin Wu looked at his beloved disciple with a gentle look in his eyes. He knew very well how much his disciple had sacrificed.
“Master,” said the illusory Zhao Yi reverently. “My fourth Firmament demon monarch team received an order. After traveling for more than six hours, we arrived outside Clear Rain Pass!”
“Arrived at Clear Rain Pass?” Qin Wu frowned. “What is your mission?”
“One million demon monarchs will exit various World Entrances across the world,” said the illusory Zhao Yi. “The demons guessed that humans might send Godfiends to intercept them. Our demon monarch team’s mission... is to kill the Godfiends. It’s very important to attack the large cities, but the demons have also placed great importance on protecting the ordinary demon monarchs as they enter the human world.”
Qin Wu nodded slightly.
“That’s all I know. I shall take my leave first.” The illusory figure bowed before dissipating“World Entrance, intercepting Godfiends?” Qin Wu muttered softly, “Seven hundred fourth Firmament demon monarchs. Six to a team. Less than 120 teams, but there are more than 200 medium-sized World Entrances in the world. Even if they intercept us, it’ll be impossible to kill all the Godfiends at the World Entrances.
“From the demons’ perspective, the fourth Firmament demon monarch’s main goal is to kill as many Marquis Godfiends as possible. Their secondary goal is to protect the ordinary demon monarchs as they enter the human world. The million-strong ordinary demon monarch army poses a greater threat to us. To the demons, that ordinary demon monarch army is disposable. One million demon monarchs will be born in just a few decades. I have to reinforce the forces at the World Entrances slightly.”
Qin Wu pondered the situation carefully. The embodiment he left at Archean Mountain informed Supremacies Li Guan and Luo Tang about the matter. Soon, he made some adjustments to their plan. At this point, there was no time to make any major adjustments. All the arrangements had been made.
Within a tiny, hidden grotto-heaven.
“The 112 teams have arrived at their destinations.” The black-robed figure stood by the side and smiled. “Our 23 fifth Firmament demon monarchs have long arrived. The other arrangements have been made. Everything is ready. Nine Abyss, can we attack now?”
Demon Sage Nine Abyss looked at the huge map that floated in midair. Many dots of light littered the map. Each light dot represented a greater demon monarch.
“Let’s begin!” Demon Sage Nine Abyss smiled. “North Sense, accompany me to watch the battle.”
The black-robed figure nodded slightly. “I hope that this battle will be a decisive victory.”

chapters.title: Chapter 288 - Beginning
chapters.content:
Chapter 288 Beginning
The afterglow of the setting sun shone on North River Pass’s city walls. North River Pass was silent. Many weeds in the city were gently swaying in the breeze.
At North River Pass’s inner city pass, the World Entrance—which was about a kilometer long and a quarter-kilometer wide
-remained calm. Suddenly, without any warning, dozens of demon monarchs rushed out. All of them were extremely vigilant as they tried their best not to make a sound. Most of these demon monarchs were at the second Firmament. Only seven were third Firmament demon monarchs.
A goat demon monarch stood at the exit and looked in all directions. He waved his hand slightly, and demon monarchs immediately surged out from the World Entrance.
The demon monarchs entered the human world en masse.
“We can’t let any more in any longer. If more come in, they will split up and flee. It’ll be difficult for me to intercept them when there’s so many of them.” A mustached man with a weed dangling from the corner of his mouth walked out of the ground without any warning. He stood under the inner city pass. With a wave of his hand, 36 saber beams flew out from his hand. They enveloped his surroundings.
Every saber beam was as fast as a mirage. Horrified, the demon monarchs did not even have time to dodge. All their heads were penetrated.
The saber beams whistled as they stayed within a kilometer of the mustached man. In the blink of an eye, more than 100 demon monarchs—that had charged in—were killed.
“Marquis Thousand Shadows.” The goat demon monarch’s expression changed drastically. He immediately retreated and fled into the World Entrance behind him.
“One hundred and thirty-five demon monarchs. Two escaped into the World Entrance.” Marquis Thousand Shadow’s expression suddenly changed when he saw this scene.
Rumble...
His surroundings suddenly distorted as it transformed into a flaming world. The billowing heatwaves distorted as two blurry figures charged over. They were two greater demon monarchs adept at close combat. Even illusions attacked his Essence Soul.
An ambush. Marquis Thousand Shadow’s expression changed. Instantly, he was attacked from all directions. Since six fourth Firmament demon monarchs had formed a team, it was only natural that they had great teamwork and strengths that complement one another. Even though a Marquis Godfiend’s Darkstar domain was impressive, it was difficult to withstand the attacks of six fourth Firmament demon monarchs.
Black Sand Dynasty, Edge Star City—a city with over ten million people.
The people in the city were still living peaceful lives. They had no idea that a devastating battle was about to begin.
Inside a manor within the city, a silver-haired old woman and a middle-aged man sat opposite each other, drinking tea as they waited.
“The sun is about to set. The demons aren’t here yet.” A silver-haired old woman put down her teacup and said, “According to the sect’s intelligence, the demons won’t delay for long. They should attack very soon.”
“Senior Sister, the ones who should be anxious are the demons,” said the middle-aged man with a smile. “Although a million demon monarchs and countless demons have been mobilized, they are all gathered at the various World Entrances. It’s impossible for them to keep waiting there.”
“Eh?” The middle-aged man’s expression changed as he looked towards the east. “The demon monarchs are here.”
The silver-haired old woman was alarmed as well. “They’re here?”
They immediately flew up and saw the distant eastern city walls tremble. Many buildings collapsed, and many mortals died. Large amounts of blood dyed the area red.
“Hahaha, human Godfiends, die!”
“Where are the human Godfiends?” “Are they afraid?”
Five figures appeared at the eastern city wall. The biggest ones were a 300-foot-tall silver-furred ape and an elephant demon. The elephant demon took human form and held two huge axes. A bird also transformed into lightning as it randomly shot lightning at the buildings. A petite cat demon monarch floated in the air, not hurried to take action. Lastly, a turtle demon monarch walked behind the four.
The aftershocks of their attacks killed the surrounding mortals. They followed the normal way demons usually fought. They only had to kill mortals for the Godfiends to appear! If Godfiends didn’t stop them, they would kill all mortal humans in the city! If Godfiends did appear, they would kill them!
“You are tempting fate.” The silver-haired old woman instantly transformed into a sword beam and charged over. In terms of strength, the old woman was no weaker than a Regis Godfiend. However, she was unable to break through because her body was too old. When she used forbidden spells, her combat strength was comparable to an ordinary Regis Godfiend.
Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish!
Dozens of sword beams appeared as they shot towards the five greater demon monarchs.
“Senior Sister, I’ll help you.” The middle-aged man also streaked through the air. Metal balls appeared around him as they rapidly disintegrated into countless metal threads. These metal threads flew in all directions, covering a radius of 2.5 kilometers. They formed a terrifying battle domain for the old woman. The middle-aged man was a Marquis Godfiend of Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s Halberd Hall. He naturally had impressive techniques and equipment.
“Senior Sister, be careful. On the surface, there are five demon monarchs. There’s another one hidden,” said the middle-aged man with a voice transmission.
“Die!” The silver-haired old woman’s voice echoed in the world. Dozens of sword beams flashed; it seemed like they had teleported to a spot near the five demon monarchs.
Although they were only two Marquis Godfiends, their combined strength was no less than the six fourth Firmament demon monarchs.
They have clashed. On the crown of a tree outside Edge Star City stood a fifth Firmament scorpion demon monarch. He stood there calmly with his aura completely restrained. The light around him distorted. Even a Regis Godfiend would find it difficult to discover him if he deliberately lurked outside their Seamless domain.
The scorpion greater demon monarch watched from afar as his long scorpion tail slowly swayed.
Two Marquis Godfiends? The scorpion greater demon monarch smiled. Since they aren’t Regis Godfiends, I can attack them.
With a whoosh, he vanished and quietly approached the two Marquis Godfiends.
The demons were in the shadows while the humans were out in the open.
Scattered across the world, the demon monarch teams followed Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s orders and launched attacks on cities. Be it Duyang City, Chu An City, or Eastcalm City; demons attacked them simultaneously.
Chu An City.The bell tower in the middle of the city would ring in the morning. Meng Chuan sat on top of the roof of the bell tower as he drank. Since last night, he had been in Chu An City because it was close to both the other cities he was assigned to. The sun is almost setting. Meng Chuan glanced at the sun. He could still see half of the setting sun. The western half of the sky was dyed red. Are the demons waiting for night to fall before they attack, or are they attacking at an even later time?
Huh? Meng Chuan suddenly jolted upright. He looked towards the northern city wall. He could sense demonic powers erupting clearly.
The battle has begun? Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up. He had been waiting for this moment ever since he received his transfer orders. The battle had finally begun! We have to win this battle! Failure is not an option! Meng Chuan’s speed soared to the limit. The moment he sensed the demonic power, he immediately rushed toward the northern city wall.
The area around the northern city wall suddenly exploded. An area spanning 1.5 kilometers was attacked. A large number of buildings collapsed, and there were many casualties. One could hear wails and screams.
Meng Chuan could see the 1.5-kilometer area dyed red with his naked eye. It was the color of blood.
In a flash, Meng Chuan arrived. He instantly used his Essence Soul weapon, Soul-Buster Bell.
Clang! Clang! Clang! The Essence Soul weapon, Soul-Buster Bell, came out of his body and floated beside Meng Chuan. It was invisible to the naked eye. The Soul-Buster Bell sounded as it attacked the fourth Firmament demon monarchs rushing in from every direction.
This battle needs to be concluded quickly. Meng Chuan knew his responsibilities and what needed to be done.

chapters.title: Chapter 289 - Matching the Fifth Firmament
chapters.content:
Chapter 289 Matching the Fifth Firmament
Chu An City.
Greater Demon Monarch Serpentwing stood there in midair, staring coldly at his surroundings.
A nine-headed lion demon monarch let out an excited roar. It caused the void to quake as it spread out in all directions. The surrounding buildings constantly collapsed, and many mortals died from the shock. Only a few managed to survive as they wailed.
“These humans are truly weak.” A black-robed demoness stood still as countless white spider webs tore through the area, slaughtering everything in her path.
Swoosh! Swoosh!
A goat demon monarch wielded two gigantic scimitars. Each 1,000-foot-wide saber beam sliced through buildings, trees, humans, and everything else that blocked its path.
There was also a beautiful woman dressed in purple robes. Her body emitted a floral fragrance as she looked around with a smile.
Apart from the five who appeared, there was an old dragon turtle hidden ten feet deep underground. The old dragon turtle constantly probed a 2.5-kilometer area around him.
With Second Brother around, our team is considered one of the strongest among the many demon monarch teams. The nine-headed lion demon monarch grinned. He was also a descendant of a demon sage and had the combat strength of a peak fourth Firmament demon monarch. However, he still flattered Greater Demon Monarch Serpentwing, who was extremely famous among the demons. Although Serpentwing was only a fourth Firmament demon monarch, his strength was comparable to an ordinary fifth Firmament demon monarch. He just hadn’t broken through yet because of his age. He was the undisputed leader of this team.
Serpentwing coldly watched the others attack the city as he stayed floating above the city. He was very confident of his strength. In one-on-one combat, he could match an ordinary fifth Firmament demon monarch. He also had five strong teammates that cooperated well with him!
The Imperial Lord assigned me a pretty good team. When the other five cooperate with me, we are capable of suppressing newly-advanced Regis Godfiends. Among all the fourth Firmament demon monarch teams, my team is in the top ten.
Just as these demon monarchs were extremely confident...
Swoosh.
A figure suddenly appeared.
“What?” The six demon monarchs were shocked, including the old dragon turtle underground. Without any warning, Meng Chuan appeared in front of them. Clang! Clang! Clang!
The clanging of the Soul-Buster Bell naturally could not be heard by one’s ears. The bell clangs affected the demon monarchs’ Essence Souls.
“Ahhh!” The goat demon monarch, who held two gigantic scimitars, staggered backward. He began to lose basic control over his body and could not stand firmly. He was the only one with a first-level Essence Soul.
The Imperial Lords had assigned strong, skilled teammates to Serpentwing.
“Fix.” Golden light emanated from the purple-robed woman’s glabella as she emitted the fragrance of flowers. It spread across her teammates’ bodies, making the nine-headed lion demon monarch, black-robed demoness, and old dragon turtle more lucid. However, the goat demon monarch remained in excruciating pain.
Greater Demon Monarch Serpentwing only frowned slightly when he was struck by the Soul-Buster Bell’s attack because he had long reached the Dharma Domain realm and a third-level essence Soul. After receiving the help of Demon Monarch Flower’s divine power, he was no longer affected by the Soul-Buster Bell’s attack.
“Marquis Eastcalm-Meng Chuan?” Upon seeing the human youth, Serpentwing’s eyes lit up. “The person stationed in Chu An City is Marquis Eastcalm?” “He’s a Marquis Godfiend. He can be killed.”
“Attack.”
The nine-headed lion demon monarch charged forward in excitement. The black-robed demoness released white spider threads that attacked Meng Chuan. A portion of the old dragon turtle’s body appeared from the ground and mist began to cloud the 2.5-kilometer area around it.
“Marquis Eastcalm, a young junior.” Serpentwing instantly moved. He was filled with confidence. From his point of view, he should be able to wipe out the human Marquis Godfiend with his teammates. Meng Chuan was rather famous, but he didn’t have much time to cultivate.
Just as they were about to attack, they were suddenly stunned,
Pfft.
A dark-red saber penetrated the goat demon monarch’s head. Meng Chuan held the evil dark-red saber and stood in front of him.
Chi! Chi! Chi! The goat demon monarch’s massive body immediately dissipated into dust. In the past, Demon Slayer took some time to devour a person’s lifeblood, but now, the fourth Firmament demon monarch’s body completely disintegrated after his body was penetrated.
The goat demon monarch was dead!
“The goat demon’s Essence Soul is too weak. There’s no need to worry.” Serpentwing sent a voice transmission to his teammates. Just as he sent the voice transmission, his expression changed. Meng Chuan instantly appeared in front of him as the surrounding void distorted.
He was too fast.
Clang! Serpentwing instantly brandished his two stingers, stirring the void and sealing the surroundings. He blocked Meng Chuan’s terrifying saber successfully. After all, he was at the Dharma Domain realm. His technique realm was extremely high. I blocked it. Serpentwing felt a lingering fear. Meng Chuan’s attack was too fast. Even he felt fortunate that he was able to block the attack.
Huh? Serpentwing’s pupils suddenly constricted. As he blocked the saber strike, a dark-cyan fog emanated from Meng Chuan’s saber; it naturally reached him.
The fog flew too quickly, and the distance between them was too close. There was no time for him to dodge before it came into contact with his body.
“This...” An inconceivable chill seeped into his body through his scales. Serpentwing felt as though his consciousness was about to be frozen. Not good!
His Essence Soul instantly cast a divine power, and demonic patterns surfaced on his scales. He tried his best to withstand the frost baneful aura, but his body was still covered in frost eventually.
It managed to block my saber. My baneful aura also failed to freeze it to death instantly. This demon monarch is quite powerful. Such thoughts flashed through Meng Chuan’s mind, but he didn’t stop attacking.
As Serpentwing struggled to resist the baneful aura, he sensed a saber heading towards him. It was still terrifyingly fast. This time, after being frozen, Serpentwing was no longer able to block Meng Chuan’s terrifying saber attack.
Pfft.
Demon Slayer was incomparably sharp. His tough scales and tough skull were unable to block it. Demon Slayer pierced straight through Serpentwing’s head like tofu. Even after his head was penetrated, Serpentwing remained alive and lucid. After cultivating his body to its current state, his head was no longer a vital point. Even if his head was chopped off, he could continue fighting.
But this time...
Chi! Chi! Chi!
Serpentwing’s eyes widened as his dense lifeblood surged into Demon Slayer. Serpentwing’s body instantly turned to dust. Greater Demon Monarch Serpentwing died.
Although it took a long time to describe, Meng Chuan killed the goat demon monarch with one strike the moment he appeared. Then, in two strikes—with his baneful aura aiding him-he killed Serpentwing. Everything took less than three seconds.
Second Brother is dead? The nine-headed lion demon monarch was stunned when he saw this.The old dragon turtle, flower demoness, and spider demoness were also astonished.
Serpentwing, who could match a fifth Firmament, had died the moment he clashed in a one-on-one battle? Wasn’t it said that powerful greater demon monarchs had tenacious vitality? Why was he reduced to dust in one strike?
The old dragon turtle’s Essence Soul sent a voice transmission as he burrowed underground without hesitation. “Run!”
“Flee!” The nine-headed lion, flower demoness, and spider demoness did not hesitate to flee.
Of course they had to escape! The remaining demon monarchs would probably be killed in just a few slashes if they stayed behind. After all, Meng Chuan had just killed a fourth Firmament demon monarch that was comparable to a fifth Firmament demon monarch in a single exchange. Although they didn’t understand how a Marquis Godfiend could be so powerful—there were no such records of a Marquis Godfiend with such strength-they only had one thoughtescape as quickly as possible!
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan arrived beside the black-robed spider demoness in a second. He was so fast that it looked like he had teleported. Before the spider demoness could burrow underground, she saw Meng Chuan appear in front of her.
A saber beam pierced her head. Her heart couldn’t help but turn cold.

chapters.title: Chapter 290 - Heartache
chapters.content:
Chapter 290 Heartache
Although the spider demoness instinctively controlled a large number of spider threads to block the attack, the spider demoness was despairingly reduced to dust as the saber beam penetrated her head.
In seconds, half of the originally-confident demon monarch team was killed.
“Too powerful.”
“How could he be so strong?”
