The nine-headed lion, flower demoness, and old dragon turtle fled underground. With their strength, it would be impressive if a Regis Godfiend killed half of them when they fled in different directions. However, Meng Chuan had killed three of them before they even made it underground! He was much faster than Regis Godfiends!
Escaping? The Divine Eye of Lightning on Meng Chuan’s glabella had long been opened. The electromagnetic domain enveloped his surroundings. Furthermore, he also cast his Indestructible Divine Armor. A blurry light covered his body, and it caused the surrounding void to collapse and distort. With a wave of his hand, two streams of his dark-cyan baneful aura traversed 1000 feet and caught up to the nine-headed lion demon monarch and the flower demoness.
At the same time, Meng Chuan chased after the old dragon turtle, who had fled the furthest.
“Seal!” The old dragon turtle cast his domain with his full might. Endless fog blocked the two streams of Meng Chuan’s dark-cyan baneful aura-an attempt to help his teammates.
“Damn.” The nine-headed lion demon monarch had seen how terrifying this baneful aura was with his own eyes. Even Serpentwing had been frozen to the point he was unable to resist. Without hesitation, the nine-headed lion demon monarch split into nine avatars.
One of his avatars took the initiative to face the baneful aura as the other eight frantically fled in different directions. This was a life-saving divine power that originated from his bloodline—the Doppelganger Technique. Just using the technique once would severely injure him.
Crackle.
When the baneful aura touched one of the nine-headed lion demon monarch’s avatar, the avatar immediately froze and shattered into pieces. The baneful aura split into eight as it pursued the eight remaining avatars.
“No.” The purple-robed flower demoness revealed a look of panic. She was weak and lovable. A faint green fluctuation emanated from her glabella, heading toward the distant Meng Chuan. However, when it reached Meng Chuan—who had a fourth-level Essence Soul – he wasn’t affected by it at all. Meng Chuan continued controlling his baneful aura to freeze the flower demoness.
The flower demoness shattered into pieces.
What? Meng Chuan frowned slightly. The distance between him and his baneful aura increased since he was pursuing the old dragon turtle. There was a limit to how far his baneful aura could travel away from him!
The nine-headed lion demon monarch’s eight remaining avatars were fleeing very quickly. Even if he chased after them personally, he would not be able to chase the eight avatars simultaneously.
These demon monarchs really have a lot of escaping abilities. Meng Chuan was extremely fast, so he easily caught up to the dragon turtle. “Spare me!” The old dragon turtle pleaded.
Pfft.
The dark-red Demon Slayer easily penetrated the old dragon turtle’s shell and stabbed into its body. Following that, the old dragon turtle’s lifeblood was completely drained, causing his entire body to turn to dust. Even the turtle shell turned to dust.
Whoosh. Meng Chuan swept up the items left behind by the old dragon turtle. He stored the remnants of the flower demoness’s corpse in his pocket grotto-heaven with his Darkstar Quintessential Essence before returning to the surface.
Whoosh.
With a thought, the items left behind by Serpentwing, the spider demoness, and the goat demon monarch were stored away.
Although it took time to describe, the entire battle took roughly 15 seconds.
Two Marquis Godfiends were rushing over! It was about 40 kilometers from one city wall to another. With the average speed of a Marquis godfiend, it would take them more than 30 seconds to arrive. While the two Marquis Godfiends were still on their way, Meng Chuan had already killed five greater demon monarchs. Only the nine-headed lion demon monarch had escaped thanks to his divine power.
“It’s Meng Chuan.” Marquis Southcloud and Marchioness Iron Flower flew over at full speed. From afar, they could see the battle at the northern city wall. However, it was very difficult to see the battle clearly because the mist was so thick. They only felt that the erupted demonic power was astonishing.
They were halfway through their journey when Meng Chuan returned to the surface.
The battle had clearly ended. Meng Chuan nodded slightly at them before transforming into a bolt of lightning and disappearing into the horizon.
“So fast.”
Marquis Southcloud and Marquis Iron Flower exchanged looks.
“That powerful demon monarch team was completely defeated by Meng Chuan?” Marchioness Iron Flower was a valiant woman. She exclaimed, “The two of us jointly guard Chu An City, but Meng Chuan suddenly appeared. He’s acting alone, so he’s probably responsible for reinforcing various cities.”
“Yes.” Marquis Southcloud nodded. “It’s just that we haven’t requested for reinforcements. Why is he here?”
“Perhaps he happened to pass by,” said Marchioness Iron Flower. “It wouldn’t be easy for the two of us to defeat those greater demon monarchs, but he was able to kill them instantly.”
Marquis Southcloud nodded slightly. “Back then, I personally watched him participate in Archean Mountain’s entrance examination and enter Archean Mountain. Now, his strength is above mine.”
Marchioness Iron Flower smiled. “This means that humanity has greater hope.”
Meng Chuan held a token. Two spots on the token emitted green light. They were Eastcalm City and Changfeng City. They were the other two cities he needed to reinforce.
Eastcalm City and Changfeng City have requested for help.However, they are requesting for the lowest-level reinforcements. According to their orders, they are only informing me that demon monarchs have been discovered in the two cities. Everything is still under control.
It was just a warning, but Meng Chuan still flew towards Eastcalm City at full speed.
Swoosh.
He streaked across the sky at an astounding speed. Even Supremacy Qin Wu and Supremacy Li Guan were slightly slower than him. After flying for more than 150 kilometers, Meng Chuan suddenly stopped.
Oh? Meng Chuan looked at the token in his hand in shock. A new request for help appeared on the token. It was blood-colored.
Apart from three large cities, he was also responsible for reinforcing eight medium-sized World Entrances. These eight World Entrances were located around Eastcalm City, Changfeng City, and Chu An City.
Apparently, one of the eight-medium sized World Entrances, Silver Lake Pass, was requesting help. Life-and-death request? Meng Chuan turned anxious.
There were three levels of requests for help: green, purple, and blood-red.
A blood-red dot on his token meant that it was a life-and-death request! It was of greatest urgency!
Swoosh.
Without any hesitation, Meng Chuan turned around and rushed toward the southwest.
Archean Mountain believes that it is relatively unlikely for the eight medium-sized World Entrances to request reinforcements. I never expected a life-and-death situation to occur at the beginning of the battle. The final battle has just begun. Even the time I spent killing the demon monarch team wasn’t enough for the Marquis Godfiends to arrive at the city wall.
Silver Lake Pass. Meng Chuan became anxious. Wait for me. You have to hold on.
Within a small grotto-heaven.
Demon Sage Nine Abyss and the black-robed man looked at the huge, floating map and the light dots scattered across it.
Suddenly, light dot after light dot dissipated.
“Oh?” Demon Sage Nine Abyss and the black-robed man’s expressions changed slightly. “There will eventually be casualties in war. After all, many Imperial Lords have been born in human history. It’s naturally not easy to have a flawless victory,” said the black-robed man. “As long as we win, even if we sacrifice half of them, it’s still worth celebrating.”
The light dots dissipated one after another.
“Considering how the battle has just begun, they are dying too quickly.” Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s expression turned ugly. “This is worse than I expected.”
On Archean Mountain.
Li Guan, an illusory Luo Tang, and an illusory Qin Wu, sat by a tea-table as they looked at the floating map of the Great Zhou Dynasty. Illusory figures could be seen on the floating map.
Whoosh.
An illusory figure disappeared. Following that, another two illusory figures dissipated.
Li Guan, Luo Tang, and Qin Wu watched silently. The disappearance of every illusory figure represented the death of a Godfiend.
Luo Tang could not help but say, “Five Marquis Godfiends and eight Great Solar Godfiends have died in battle,” At that moment, another illusory figure dissipated. “Six Marquis Godfiends!”“We have already done our best,” said Li Guan calmly.
“Perhaps it was not worth guarding so many cities.” The illusory Luo Tang looked somewhat regretful as her heart ached. “It will be much easier to guard the cities if there were 20 fewer.”
“Mortals are the foundation of humanity,” said Li Guan. “If Archean Mountain were to abandon so many cities, the population would greatly decrease. The number of geniuses would also decrease. There would be fewer and weaker Godfiends. We have to ensure that there are enough people in the world. This is the foundation of Godfiends, the foundation of humanity!”
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Like a bubble that had burst, seven figures disappeared in succession.
“Another seven Great Solar Godfiends.” Luo Tang’s eyes turned slightly red.
“Everything is already in place. We can’t afford to retreat. We have to fight to the end.” Qin Wu’s illusory eyes turned slightly red. He was extremely familiar with every dissipating figure. Many were his disciples.
At this moment, Luo Tang was guarding Luo Tang Pass. Li Guan’s true body was guarding Archean Mountain. Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar and Qin Wu’s true body were also acting as reinforcements. They were already doing their best.

chapters.title: Chapter 291 - Marquis Eastcalm Meng Chuan, You Have Nowhere to Run!
chapters.content:
Chapter 291 Marquis Eastcalm Meng Chuan, You Have Nowhere to Run!
A bolt of lightning streaked across the sky and headed straight for Silver Lake Pass.
Faster, faster. Meng Chuan looked at the blood-colored dot on the token. He reeled in anxiety. In a few more seconds, he might be able to save one or two Godfiends. Even though he was known for being extremely fast, Meng Chuan still felt like he wasn’t fast enough.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh! The scenery below became blurry. Mountains, rivers, plains, and forests flashed by.
I’m here. Meng Chuan immediately saw the abandoned Silver Lake Pass in the distance. The moment he received the help request, Meng Chuan traveled 350 kilometers at full speed. He arrived at Silver Lake Pass in 30 seconds!
Whoosh. Meng Chuan’s body flashed, and he arrived at the abandoned city pass.
He immediately saw the World Entrance that was about one kilometer long. Many demon monarch corpses and Godfiend corpses piled around the World Entrance. With just a glance, Meng Chuan discovered three Godfiend corpses. The Godfiend corpses had been dismembered. Some heads had been penetrated. He could see a few chests ripped open. He obviously knew the dead Godfiends. There were too many World Entrances, so Archean Mountain couldn’t arrange for Marquis Godfiends to guard every single one of them. Great Solar Godfiend teams guarded some of the World Entrances.
Open! Meng Chuan opened his third eye at his glabella and used his Divine Eye of Lightning to scan the area.
He probed the underground with his electromagnetic domain. Meng Chuan instantly discovered two Godfiend corpses underground. Following that, he discovered demon monarchs pursuing Godfiends.
Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up as he immediately swooped down. There are still Godfiends alive.
The Godfiend, Wei Cheng, was escaping underground with all his might. However, he felt despair. I’m afraid I won’t be able to escape.
Their team had a total of eight Great Solar Godfiends. Most were older and stronger. Three had the strength of a weak Marquis Godfiend. The other five had peak Great Solar Godfiend strength. Such a team was much stronger than Meng Chuan’s trio that had killed Blackwater Palace Lord. They could easily slaughter a group of third Firmament demon monarchs.
Who would have thought that they would encounter a demon monarch team? The six fourth Firmament demon monarchs all had unfathomable strength. Three had the strength of a peak Marquis Godfiend. When the six demon monarchs worked together, they were comparable to an ordinary Regis Godfiend.
The difference in strength was too great.
Although we immediately chose to escape underground when we discovered the fourth Firmament demon monarch team, the difference in strength is too great. Senior Brother Fang and the other two died before they could even burrow into the ground. The rest split up and fled, hoping that one or two would escape. As for me, I definitely won’t be able to escape. As Wei Cheng ran with all his might, he felt a tentacle rapidly approaching him.
Underground reconnaissance was very difficult. Therefore, escaping underground meant a higher chance of survival as long as they could shake off and distance themselves from their enemies. However, Great Solar Godfiends were much weaker than fourth Firmament demon monarchs. Most of the Great Solar Godfiends didn’t have time or weren’t fast enough to open up a gap. It was very difficult for them to escape.
“Demon Monarch, die!” An angry shout that contained Darkstar Quintessential Essence spread underground.
“Huh?”
“Who is it?”
“I can sense the aura of a Marquis Godfiend.”
The six fourth Firmament demon monarchs had split up because they were pursuing multiple Great Solar Godfiends. Of course, they didn’t go too far from each other.
At this moment, everyone was shocked.
Upon sensing the explosive Darkstar Quintessential Essence, the fourth Firmament demon monarchs stopped pursuing the Great Solar Godfiends. Instead, they quickly gathered together. It would take them time to pursue the three remaining Godfiends, so they might as well deal with a Marquis Godfiend! Killing a Marquis Godfiend was more attractive than killing 20 Great Solar Godfiends.
“Die.” The enraged Meng Chuan charged underground as lightning bolts blazed towards the nearest 100-foot-tall ox demon monarch.
The ox demon monarch looked up at Meng Chuan and grinned. His laughter resounded through the ground. “It’s Marquis Eastcalm, Meng Chuan!” He brandished his staff as he laughed.
Clang~~~
Meng Chuan slashed down with his saber. The ox demon monarch swung his staff upward.
The saber and staff collided!
Meng Chuan didn’t use his Darkstar Quintessential Essence to activate Demon Slayer’s runes. He allowed the saber and staff to collide.
After the clash, Meng Chuan was sent flying backward. He had a slight strength disadvantage.
“It’s Marquis Eastcalm, Meng Chuan?” Another ox demon monarch’s eyes lit up.
“Marquis Eastcalm, Meng Chuan. He’s the fastest in the world. He killed many demons when providing reinforcements!” A fox demon was rather excited.
“The credit for killing him is no less than killing a Regis Godfiend.”
“Don’t let him escape.”
“We will surround him underground. It’s difficult to detect people in close proximity when underground. It’ll be difficult for him to discover us.”
The demon monarchs carefully surrounded him from all directions.
“Demon Monarch, you sure are strong. Take a few more strikes from me.” Meng Chuan charged over with killing intent as his figure turned ghost-like.
Swoosh! Swoosh!
The ox demon monarch brandished his staff. His terrifying might caused the void to distort. The surrounding soil and rocks were reduced to dust, but he was still in a sorry state when facing Meng Chuan’s speed. Swallow Stance. Meng Chuan instantly split into more than ten blurry figures. Every time, he struck out with his saber, the ox demon monarch tried his best to block it. Two of his saber strikes landed on his body, leaving only two wounds.
Pfft.
Finally, the next saber attack stabbed through the ox demon monarch’s ear with great difficulty. It seemed like it was very difficult for Demon Slayer to pierce through the ox demon monarch’s ear.
“Scram.” The ox demon monarch sensed the danger of death and quickly slapped Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan took the brunt of the strike and thrust his saber into the depths of the ox demon monarch’s head.
Meng Chuan’s Quintessential Essence completely destroyed the interior of his head. The ox demon monarch’s eyes widened. He had clearly lured Meng Chuan over, but he ended up as the one dying? “Hahaha, cough cough cough.” Meng Chuan was sent flying by the slap. He couldn’t help but cough out blood. However, his face was filled with excitement as though killing a powerful fourth Firmament demon monarch was a great accomplishment. “Brother.”
“Brother.”Boom! Two other ox demon monarchs rushed out from the soil and rocks. Their eyes widened as they looked at their dead brother in disbelief.
Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!
A large number of tentacles extended from the soil and attacked Meng Chuan.
Black fog floated over and enveloped Meng Chuan.
“Marquis Eastcalm Meng Chuan, you have nowhere to run!” The five angry demon monarchs had completely surrounded Meng Chuan. They were furious that they had lost one of their teammates despite clearly holding the absolute advantage. Previously, they were afraid of Meng Chuan’s legendary speed, so they carefully surrounded Meng Chuan to ensure that he wouldn’t escape.
Now that one of their teammates had died, the remaining five were even more furious.
“Revenge for Big Brother!” The remaining two ox demon monarchs roared. The other three demon monarchs attacked Meng Chuan simultaneously.
“What? Five demon monarchs?” Meng Chuan’s expression changed drastically. He frantically tried to escape upward, luring the demon monarchs into trying their best to stop him.

chapters.title: Chapter 292 - Marquis West Sea
chapters.content:
Chapter 292 Marquis West Sea
“Don’t let him escape.”
“Kill him!”
The tentacles attacked Meng Chuan the fastest and most unpredictably. The tentacles completely blocked Meng Chuan’s path. As for the two ox demon monarchs, they charged toward Meng Chuan. Very good. Meng Chuan was satisfied. If he had revealed his overwhelming strength the moment he appeared, these demon monarchs would’ve fled at full speed! Additionally, they were scattered underground when he arrived. If they were to flee separately, it would be a miracle if he could kill half of the demon monarch team.
So he deliberately showed weakness! He revealed the strength of a typical Marquis Godfiend. This made the demon monarchs take the initiative to surround him. They moved closer to Meng Chuan so he couldn’t escape.
This the way for a clean wipeout. Meng Chuan calmly brandished his saber. Demon Slayer’s dark-red blade easily stabbed into one of the tentacles of him. The tentacle’s tough skin couldn’t block the blade at all. The moment Demon Slayer stabbed into the tentacle, Demon Slayer forcefully plundered its lifeblood.
Chi! Chi! Chi! One tentacle after another was pulverized.
The black-robed demoness—who controlled the tentacles that grew on her back-turned to dust as her tentacles were pulverized. Her eyes widened just before she died. Demon Slayer’s lifeblood absorption speed was just too insane. A mere fourth Firmament demon monarch was unable to resist such absorption speed.
What? The two ox demon monarchs—who had both rushed forward-saw the thick, huge tentacles turn to dust. Their hearts could not help but tremble.
Clang! Clang! Clang!
The Soul-Buster Bell rang!
An invisible fluctuation surged towards the remaining four demon monarchs’ Essence Souls. Meng Chuan’s body also began to glow.
Ah! The two ox demon monarchs clutched their heads in pain. Both of them only had first-level Essence Souls. They were in a daze, unable to maintain absolute lucidity.
Pfft.
Demon Slayer flashed and pierced through their heads.
They had come right in front of him and had no ways to resist, so killing them was naturally simple and quick! After piercing through their heads, Demon Slayer immediately absorbed their lifeblood, causing the two ox demon monarchs’ bodies to disintegrate.
What?
“This... This...” The snake demon monarch, who had cast a poisonous fog domain, and the fox demon monarch-whose illusions were of no use—were stunned.
The three ox demon monarch brothers, who had been baited, were killed. Since four of their companions—three of which were extremely skilled in melee combat-were reduced to dust in front of them, the snake and fox demon monarchs felt instinctual fear. Meng Chuan didn’t hide his terrifying aura at all. The surrounding void distorted when a layer of light covered his body.
It’s a trap. The two naturally understood and did not hesitate to flee.
Boom!
Meng Chuan realized that he was a distance away from the remaining two demon monarchs. Without any hesitation, he waved his hand and shot out a bolt of lightning.
Boom!
The blinding lightning bolt blasted out instantly. Soil and rocks were reduced to dust as it flew towards the fox demon monarchwho was trying to escape.
Divine power-Heaven’s Wrath!
Although he had only released ten percent of the lightning contained in his body, it was still a Regis Godfiend-level attack. Releasing 30 percent of the lightning in his body at once was Meng Chuan’s limit. This divine power, Heaven’s Wrath, was Meng Chuan’s fastest move. It had the speed of pure lightning. The moment the fox demon monarch fled, he was struck by the lightning bolt and instantly died. Smoke rose from the charred corpse.
Whoosh. Meng Chuan transformed into a bolt of lightning and chased after the snake demon monarch.
You’re the only one left. Meng Chuan was filled with confidence. He would’ve had a headache if the six demon monarchs had fled separately. However, by deliberately acting weak, he had lured them into attacking him. There was only one snake demon monarch left... In a one-on-one battle, how could this snake demon monarch escape from Meng Chuan’s electromagnetic domain?
Just three seconds later, the snake demon monarch was reduced to dust by Demon Slayer.
The team of fourth Firmament demon monarchs had all died.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan flew toward the surface and stored the other three Godfiend corpses into his Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead.
I’ll find time to send the five of you back to Archean Mountain. The final battle was currently underway, so he could only temporarily place the corpses inside his Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead.
Meng Chuan flipped his hand and looked at the token. Eastcalm City and Changfeng City are still green. The other World Entrances didn’t request for reinforcements. Archean Mountain’s hunch was correct. The probability of those at World Entrances asking for help is extremely low.
Suddenly, the green glow of Eastcalm City transformed into a striking blood-red color.
A life-and-death request for help? Eastcalm City? Meng Chuan was astonished. Just moments ago, everything was still under control at Eastcalm City. Why did it suddenly become a life-and-death situation?
Quick! Without any time to think, Meng Chuan transformed into a bolt of lightning and rushed towards Eastcalm City. Eastcalm City is 525 kilometers away from Eastcalm City. I’ll need about a minute to reach Eastcalm City.
A blood-red glow definitely means they have encountered a huge problem. You have to hold on. Just a minute! Meng Chuan was very anxious. A minute wasn’t a long time, but it wasn’t a short time either. Marquis Godfiends could usually travel 50 kilometers in a minute. In a life-and-death battle, one could be killed dozens of times in a minute if the difference in strength was huge.
...
Before the sun had set, parts of Eastcalm City’s southern region had already been reduced to ruins.
Pfft.
An old man vomited blood and clutched his chest; a gaping hole on his chest could be seen.
An azure-scaled demon monarch stood opposite the old man. He suddenly clenched his left claw—which was holding onto the old man’s heart. He looked at the old man with pity. “Godfiends have very weak bodies. You’re a Marquis Godfiend, but you’ll die since I dig out your heart. I can save you... However, you are already so old. It’s best you die.”
An invisible wave struck the old man’s body, causing him to fall to the ground. His eyes were completely dark and lifeless.
“Senior Brother Yu.” A sword-wielding, middle-aged man’s face was pale as he watched this scene in grief.
“Go. Leave this to me.” The azure-scaled demon monarch waved his hand. The six fourth Firmament demon monarchs looked at each other and bowed respectfully before quickly leaving “Fifth Firmament demon monarch.” The sword-wielding, middle-aged man stared at the azure-scaled demon monarch. He and Marquis Purple Rain jointly guarded Eastcalm City. They fought the six-member demon monarch team when they had attacked the city; they even held a slight advantage. However, the fifth Firmament demon monarch suddenly launched a despicable sneak attack! He heavily injured Marquis Purple Rain. Following that, he joined forces with the six demon monarchs. They easily killed Marquis Purple Rain and severely injured the middle-aged man.
This fifth Firmament demon monarch had a unique treasure. He was much stronger than ordinary Regis Godfiends. The azure-scaled demon monarch looked at Marquis Purple Rain’s corpse and turned to look at the sword-wielding middle-aged man. “Marquis West Sea, you are still very young. You have a bright future ahead of you. I’ll give you a chance to live.” A fiery red pill appeared in the azure-scaled demon monarch’s left claw. “As long as you join us demons and consume this demon core, you will be able to live.”
“My Yan family is a Godfiend family clan. We have one Regis Godfiend and three Marquis Godfiends. Why would we submit to demons?” Marquis West Sea gritted his teeth angrily.
“Time is precious. You only have 30 seconds to decide,” said the azure-scaled demon monarch indifferently. “Once your time is up, you will die if you do not surrender.”

chapters.title: Chapter 293 - Arriving in Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 293 Arriving in Time
Marquis West Sea’s face was pale as he looked at his surroundings. Marquis Purple Rain lay dead on the ground. The area around him was in ruins, and a large number of mortals had died from the shockwaves.
Many Godfiends died in this war. It’s finally my turn today. Marquis West Sea had just exchanged blows with the fifth Firmament demon monarch and knew the difference in strength between them! In a one-on-one battle, he would lose his life in a few moves.
“You have only cultivated for 100 years.” The azure-scaled demon monarch chuckled and said, “In the future, you can become stronger. As long as you consume this demon core, you will still remain as Marquis West Sea to the humans. The humans will have no idea of your betrayal. You will still be able to bask in glory. However, you will have to do something for the demons. When you humans are defeated in the future, you will lead your family clan to pledge allegiance to the demons; thus, enjoying wealth and power.
“In this world, as long as you treat yourself and your family clan well, isn’t that enough?” said the azure-scaled demon monarch as he smiled. “There’s a saying among you humans. Heaven destroys those who don’t look out for themselves!”
The azure-scaled demon monarch tried to persuade Marquis West Sea. A dead Marquis West Sea was worth limited credit. If Marquis West Sea submitted to the demons and became a spy in the human camp, it would be much better for the demons. He would earn many more credits than if he killed Marquis West Sea.
Marquis West Sea looked at the azure-scaled demon monarch. “Do it.”
“I don’t understand. Isn’t it only right to bow your heads to the strong?” The azure-scaled demon monarch was puzzled. “We demons are much stronger than you humans. Why don’t you bow your heads?”
“Bow our heads?” Marquis West Sea looked at the azure-scaled demon monarch, laughed, and said, “It’s too stifling and frustrating to be a dog for the demons! As a Godfiend of this world, I will be upright and steadfast. I will not shame the heavens or the earth. How can I be a lackey for the demons?”
“Just because it’s stifling and frustrating?” said the azure scaled demon monarch in surprise.
“Just thinking about such a fate makes me unhappy,” said Marquis West Sea as he smiled. “It’s already been 30 seconds. Don’t waste your efforts.” Marquis West Sea was already prepared to die. Death was inevitable since time immemorial. It was just a matter of when one would die.
At that moment, Marquis West Sea recalled his life. He was born in a Regis Godfiend family—the Yan family. He had been diligent and talented since he was young. He loved his wife greatly. Although his son, Yan Chitong, was more unruly than his father, his cultivation speed was faster than his father’s.
My dear wife, pardon me for being unable to accompany you any further.
“Thirty seconds are up. What a pity.” The azure-scaled demon monarch shook his head gently as his figure suddenly moved.
Marquis West Sea’s eyelids twitched as madness appeared in his eyes. Although he was prepared to die, it didn’t mean that he wouldn’t resist! Instantly, he cast a forbidden Godfiend spell and used his sword arts to attack the incoming azure-scaled demon monarch.
Clang! Clang! Clang! The azure-scaled demon monarch only used his right claw to block the attacks. Every single nail on his right claw was extremely sharp. He easily parried the sword beam when he gently tapped on it.
He completely crushed Marquis West Sea in all aspects, be it strength, speed, or realm.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Marquis West Sea instantly split into seven.
The azure-scaled demon monarch also moved. He kept staring at Marquis West Sea’s true body, easily fending off his attacks.
I will die, but we humans will definitely win this war. Marquis West Sea turned increasingly deranged. Huh? The azure-scaled demon monarch’s expression changed slightly as he noticed something a distance away in the corner of his eyes. An expert had entered his domain and was charging over.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
The void distorted and collapsed. A saber beam flew out from the distorted void, instantly arriving before the azure-scaled demon monarch.
Fast! It was inconceivably fast!
Meng Chuan specialized in swift saber arts; thus, his saber beams were naturally fast. Coupled with his divine power distorting the void, the saber beam could be said to have teleported in front of the azure-scaled demon monarch. A dark-red saber came closer to him. The azure-scaled demon monarch was a fifth Firmament demon monarch. Since he had reached the Dharma Domain realm, he was extremely sensitive to attacks. The saber caused black cracks to appear in the world, making his heart tighten.
The azure-scaled demon monarch moved his right claw—which had been approaching Marquis West Sea—to meet the stunning saber beam. The azure-scaled demon monarch’s claw was extremely gentle, more gentle than a lover’s caress. His five fingers were soft and boneless as they clashed with the saber beam.
Pfft.
The two parties split up immediately.
The lightning instantly retreated with Marquis West Sea in tow. Only then did Marquis West Sea’s savior reveal his appearance. It was Meng Chuan, who had rushed over at full speed. Meng Chuan’s glowing body caused the surrounding void to collapse and distort constantly.
“Marquis Eastcalm.” Marquis West Sea looked at Meng Chuan in excitement and shock. Marquis West Sea felt repressed by Meng Chuan’s Indestructible Divine Armor.
“If I had come a little later, I wouldn’t have been able to save you, Marquis West Sea,” said Meng Chuan. He was rather glad that he arrived just as the azure-scaled demon monarch used his killer move. Marquis West Sea would’ve died in two or three moves. Thankfully, he managed to arrive in time and saved Marquis West Sea. It could be said that Marquis West Sea was quite lucky.
After all, he had arrived too late to save Marquis Purple Rain—who had died earlier.
Meng Chuan looked at Marquis Purple Rain’s corpse, and his heart ached. Another Marquis Godfiend had died in battle.
“Marquis Eastcalm, be careful of the fifth Firmament demon monarch. Its domain is unpredictable. Invisible threads will appear out of thin air. That’s how he killed Senior Brother Yu,” warned Marquis West Sea via voice transmission.
on m
ona
as
“Got it.” Meng Chuan nodded slightly and looked at the azure-scaled demon monarch solemnly. Fifth Firmament demon monarch... This was the first time he was facing a fifth Firmament demon monarch! Although he had fought with Archean Mountain Lord, it hadn’t been a life-and-death battle.
“What a powerful saber move,” praised the azure-scaled demon monarch. “Marquis Eastcalm Meng Chuan, you really amaze me with your attainments in void manipulation. It looks like staying in Eastcalm City for 30 more seconds was the right decision. I met an expert like yourself.”
Meng Chuan sent a voice transmission to Marquis West Sea. “Leave first.”
“Alright.” Marquis West Sea also understood that staying behind would only affect Meng Chuan. From the saber strike just now, this Marquis Eastcalm—who was about the same age as his son-definitely had the strength of a Regis Godfiend.
Swoosh.
Marquis West Sea instantly left.
The azure-scaled demon monarch couldn’t be bothered with him. Meng Chuan’s value was much higher than Marquis West Sea’s! The demons hated Meng Chuan to the core just after a few years of him acting as a reinforcement to everywhere in the Great Zhou Dynasty. This time, the demons had arranged for him to attack Eastcalm City secretly. They believed that Meng Chuan was likely to be stationed at Eastcalm City because it was his hometown.
“I was quite disappointed when I didn’t see you among the two Marquis Godfiends here. I never expected you to really come.” The azure-scaled demon monarch looked at Meng Chuan with burning greed in his eyes. “It looks like you are destined to fall into my hands.”
Meng Chuan calmly looked at him, but he wasn’t in a hurry to take action. Instead, he sensed Marquis West Sea’s departure. At the same time, he sent out a request for help through his token. It was the lowest level request for help! It indicated that he had encountered a powerful opponent and that everything was under control.
If his master-Supremacy Qin Wu—or any others had the time to rush over, they would be able to take down the fifth Firmament demon monarch easily. Meng Chuan was confident in dealing with this fifth Firmament demon monarch in a one-on-one battle, but he wasn’t confident in killing him.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
The azure-scaled demon monarch didn’t dare delay any further. He secretly started his attack. Threads-hidden in the voidapproached Meng Chuan. Although Meng Chuan possessed a Darkstar domain, an electromagnetic domain, an Essence Soul domain, and many other reconnaissance methods, he didn’t discover the threads approaching him in the void. These threads seemed to be a part of the void.

chapters.title: Chapter 294 - War
chapters.content:
Chapter 294 War
Meng Chuan’s Indestructible Divine Armor caused the surrounding void—within 1,000 feet of Meng Chuan—to distort and collapse. The closer one got to Meng Chuan, the more the void distorted.
The azure-scaled demon monarch’s threads could easily hide in the calm void, but it was much harder to keep hidden in the distorted void. When they were 30 feet away from Meng Chuan, their existence was exposed.
Oh? Meng Chuan discovered the six void threads in the distorted void. With a flash, they appeared before him.
Strangle him! A cold glint flashed in the azure-scaled demon monarch’s eyes. He no longer bothered concealing the six void threads as they attacked Meng Chuan at close range.
Shush.
Meng Chuan instantly phased away, but the six void threads surrounded him from all directions. All of them were terrifyingly fast.
Chi.
Although Meng Chuan tried to block with his saber, a void thread sliced across Meng Chuan’s left arm and easily tore through his Darkstar domain’s defenses. When it came into contact with Meng Chuan’s glowing body, it encountered extremely strong resistance. In the end, it still managed to slice his body, lacerating his tough skin and muscles. After that, Meng Chuan instantly moved out of the way as his injuries instantly healed.
What? Meng Chuan was astonished. It can actually break my Indestructible Divine Armor?
The azure-scaled demon monarch was equally alarmed. The secret treasure bestowed by an Imperial Lord is only capable of injuring him? Why is Marquis Eastcalm Meng Chuan’s body seemingly comparable to a fifth Firmament demon monarch?
Meng Chuan’s wounds instantly healed as his figure vanished in a second. The void threads’ might is still within an acceptable range. Saber beams shot out from the void. Meng Chuan was nowhere to be seen. Only his saber beams could be seen.
The saber beams were silent and were extremely fast.
The azure-scaled demon monarch was forced to dodge and defend with his claws.
Pfft.
The instant he blocked a saber beam, a dark-cyan baneful aura emanated from the saber beam.
So cold. The moment the azure-scaled demon monarch came into contact with the dark-cyan baneful aura, he trembled. Mystical patterns appeared on his azure scales as he resisted the baneful aura. As a fifth Firmament demon monarch, he had three divine powers. He was extremely good at protecting himself.
When Meng Chuan had refined Origins Returning baneful aura, he had absorbed it without proper preparation. It was extremely damaging to his body. In terms of physical bodies, the azure-scaled demon monarch was in no way inferior to Meng Chuan. After using his divine power to resist the baneful aura head-on, it only caused the demon monarch to slow down slightly. His strength had only decreased by a little.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
The azure-scaled demon monarch brandished his claws in a mystical manner. Void threads danced between his claws. Even though he was slower, he managed to block every saber beam.
Trap! The azure-scaled demon monarch stood rooted to the ground as his void threads surrounded Meng Chuan once again.
Rumble!
A dark-cyan baneful aura spread out and enveloped the azure-scaled demon monarch. It affected the void threads, causing them to slow down by 30 percent.
What a potent baneful aura. The azure-scaled demon monarch frowned. My speed was already inferior to Meng Chuan’s. The difference in speed is even greater now. I can’t do a thing to him.
Meng Chuan also realized a problem. This demon monarch’s moves are more profound than mine, and it has a special weapon... I can’t harm it at all.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
Meng Chuan constantly executed his movement techniques as he attacked the azure-scaled demon monarch again and again. He relied on his speed to find an opportunity to win.
The azure-scaled demon monarch was also in a rather sorry state. He had been forced to defend passively. His counterattacks were unable to touch the slippery Meng Chuan.
The shockwaves from their battle were extremely terrifying.
As the void threads sliced through the air, a shockwave traveled 1,000 feet.
Meng Chuan’s baneful aura completely froze the surroundings, causing everything to fall silent.
This caused the distant mortals to flee even more frantically, afraid that they would be affected.
Ten kilometers is safe enough. Marquis West Sea stopped ten kilometers away from the battlefield. That demon monarch will need six seconds to reach me. In six seconds, I can easily burrow into the ground and escape.
Marquis West Sea silently watched Meng Chuan and the fifth Firmament demon monarch fight.
The distant azure-scaled demon monarch stood in the same spot as his terrifying aura emanated. Meng Chuan was similarly releasing a terrifying aura as his body glowed. He appeared everywhere around the demon monarch. It was as if 100 Meng Chuans assailed the demon monarch constantly.
Void threads blocked the constantly-raining saber beams.
The shockwaves from their battle left Marquis West Sea trembling.
Meng Chuan actually has the upper hand in a one-on-one battle? Marquis West Sea was very surprised.
The azure-scaled demon monarch and Meng Chuan were careful. Both of them hid their killer moves and waited for an opportunity to arise.
This Meng Chuan is too skilled in manipulating the void. The azure-scaled demon monarch felt burdened by Meng Chuan’s constant attacks.
The void around Meng Chuan distorted constantly. A thousand feet was just too close. When Meng Chuan used his movement technique, his entire body was like a saber. Meng Chuan could reach the azure-scaled demon monarch in a second! The azure-scaled demon monarch parried Meng Chuan’s attack with great difficulty each time.
Pfft.
Suddenly, when the azure-scaled demon monarch blocked another attack, a strange force drilled into his body.
Meng Chuan had executed Heart Saber Stance!
This is it. Meng Chuan immediately took the opportunity to approach the demon monarch again.
He’s coming! The azure-scaled demon monarch slowed down because of the strange force, allowing Meng Chuan to approach him. The azure-scaled demon monarch smiled at Meng Chuan. The inconspicuous purple horn on his forehead suddenly transformed into a purple stream of light and shot towards Meng Chuan.
They were too close-just over 30 feet away from each other.
The horn shot out at speeds even faster than Meng Chuan’s movement technique. Meng Chuan had no time to react.
Pfft.
The purple stream of light instantly pierced through the Darkstar domain and the Indestructible Divine Armor. It struck Meng Chuan’s forehead. A bloody hole appeared on Meng Chuan’s forehead as the purple stream of light flew out from the back of his head.
Hahaha, he’s been hit. The azure-scaled demon monarch’s eyes lit up as he immediately controlled his six void threads to surround Meng Chuan.
The bloody hole on Meng Chuan’s forehead closed like a gap in water. He wasn’t affected by the attack at all. Meng Chuan raised his brows in surprise. He had an Essence Soul Thought lingering in every single particle of his body. His physical body was comparable to that of a fifth Firmament demon monarch. However, he had a much more tenacious vitality than a fifth Firmament demon monarch. Even if his body had hundreds of such holes, they would instantly heal.
Once he reached the Blood Droplet realm, if a single drop of blood remained, he would instantly recover.
When the azure-scaled demon monarch saw the bloody hole on Meng Chuan’s forehead close instantly, his expression changed. What?
The sea of consciousness was connected to one’s head. If one’s head was destroyed, even a fifth Firmament demon monarch would be affected. It would take a fifth Firmament demon monarch a few seconds to recover completely. Even if a fifth Firmament demon monarch lost their head, they could still fight. Only their combat strength would be affected.
However, Meng Chuan’s head instantly healed and wasn’t affected by the attack at all. This shocked the azure-scaled demon monarch.
Rumble! Meng Chuan—who had charged over —remained unscathed after the demon monarch’s attack. He naturally continued to attack the demon monarch.
He swung Demon Slayer, producing a blinding lightning bolt. It was as though Meng Chuan had torn the world asunder. The terrifying lightning bolt struck the azure-scaled demon monarch. Considering the lightning bolt’s speed and the distance between Meng Chuan and the demon monarch, it was impossible for the demon monarch to block it in time.
Divine power-Heaven’s Wrath!
Meng Chuan directed 30 percent of the lightning in his body into Demon Slayer as he swung it with all his might.
The lightning bolt branched out as it snaked towards the azure-scaled demon monarch, smiting him.

chapters.title: Chapter 295 - Eighteen Segments
chapters.content:
Chapter 295 Eighteen Segments
“Ah.”
Meng Chuan had fused his divine powerHeaven’s Wrath—with his saber strike, becoming his ultimate strike. Thirty percent of the lightning in his body was infused into this single saber move. When Archean Mountain Lord faced this attack, his Archean Combat Body had shattered! The azure-scaled demon monarch withstood the strike and was instantly stunned by the lightning! His body was tough and powerful. His scales protected his body well, and he also had defensive divine powers. However, due to the lightning, his entire body felt numb as blood seeped out from the cracks between his scales.
The azure-scaled demon monarch’s head buzzed. While he was still dazed and stunned, Meng Chuan struck out with Demon Slayer before he could react! In fact, the lightning had come out from Demon Slayer, which meant that Meng Chuan was still swinging his saber down when the lightning struck!
Demon Slayer cleaved down!
The azure-scaled demon monarch, who was dazed and paralyzed, was unable to put up any resistance as the saber ruthlessly struck his body.
Meng Chuan’s most violent strike-Tiger Roar Stance. The dark-red saber split open a void rift. Meng Chuan grabbed his saber with both hands as he put his full strength behind his slash at the azure-scaled demon monarch. Even a void rift had split open, so naturally, the demon monarch’s scales were split apart. However, when his saber reached the azure-scaled demon monarch’s waist, it got stuck. The azure-scaled demon monarch’s body was just too tough! It wasn’t easy to split him in two.
Baneful aura. As Meng Chuan cleaved down, a dark-cyan baneful aura also invaded the demon monarch’s body. Without his scales protecting him, the baneful entered the demon monarch’s body through the gaping wounds. The effects of the frost baneful aura on the demon monarch immediately increased.
Cold! The azure-scaled demon monarch couldn’t help but tremble. When he saw the huge wound at his waist, he panicked. I need to leave. With a thought, the azure-scaled demon monarch retracted the void threads quickly in a bid to protect himself and escape.
Boom!
Another dazzling bolt of lightning.
Meng Chuan unleashed his divine powerHeaven’s Wrath-at maximum power once again. Against the speedy lightning, the azure-scaled demon monarch-who was greatly affected by the frost baneful aurahad no time to defend himself. He was struck by another Heaven’s Wrath. The dazzling lightning instantly zapped through the azure-scale demon monarch’s body. The lightning invaded his body through the wound on his waist, destroying it crazily. This time, the lightning caused even more damage. The demon monarch’s injuries became even more severe. Some of his flesh had been charred black. Even some of his blood evaporated.
Pfft. As he cast Heaven’s Wrath, Meng Chuan slashed again, completely splitting the defenseless azure-scaled demon monarch in two at the waist!
The lower half of the demon monarch’s body was no longer able to resist the baneful aura; it quickly froze and turned into ice.
The azure-scaled demon monarch’s upper body was still resisting the baneful aura’s assault. As his body froze very slowly, he continued to flee in panic.
Slash! Slash! Slash! Meng Chuan frantically attacked, sending coruscating saber beams at the demon monarch.
With only his upper body left and the frost baneful aura invading it, the azure-scaled demon monarch moved much slower. The void threads became much slower at defending him because his demonic power circulation speed had decreased due to the baneful aura. He was unable to block Meng Chuan’s saber attacks any longer.
Meng Chuan no longer wanted to use Heaven’s Wrath. He had already used it twice! That was already a huge expenditure on his body’s lightning reserves.
Pfft.
A saber beam sliced through the azure-scaled demon monarch’s left arm, causing it to be severed.from the body. The moment it was severed, the dark-cyan baneful aura completely frozen the arm.
This baneful aura is too uncomfortable. The azure-scaled demon monarch turned anxious. With this baneful aura attacking me internally and externally, I can’t even use 30% of my maximum strength.
Pfft.
With another slash, another section of his body was chopped off. His resistance towards the baneful aura decreased once again.
I’m unable to escape by turning into water. My water escape divine power is completely useless when faced with this baneful aura. Once I use it, I’ll definitely be frozen. The azure-scaled demon monarch was extremely anxious. He desperately controlled the void threads to protect himself. However, his strength and speed had dropped greatly. This allowed Meng Chuan’s attacks to land on him over and over again. His eyes revealed despair.
After a while, the azure-scaled demon monarch was diced into 18 segments. His entire body was frozen, including his head. He was no longer able to put up any resistance.
The frozen “head” stared at Meng Chuan. “Meng Chuan, is there a way for me to stay alive?”
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan ignored the head’s words and heaved a sigh of relief when he saw the 18 frozen segments of the azure-scaled demon monarch’s body. He took out his token and canceled his request for help. By removing his request for help, Archean Mountain would know that the trouble on his side had been resolved and that there was no need to send reinforcements.
Pfft. Meng Chuan held Demon Slayer and stabbed at the azure-scaled demon monarch’s thigh segment.
The thigh was completely frozen. Due to the baneful aura, its resistance to Demon Slayer had been greatly reduced. However, Demon Slayer still absorbed it relatively slowly. Living beings would resist when they are being absorbed! It was completely unlike the Creation-realm alien corpse that couldn’t resist at all. For example, if the azure-scaled demon monarch were in perfect condition, it would be difficult for Demon Slayer to devour his flesh and blood, even if he was wounded.
The resistance against Demon Slayer’s absorption has weakened significantly. Meng Chuan watched as the demon monarch’s thigh withered. It took nearly 30 seconds for the thigh to be completely devoured.
The frozen azure-scaled demon monarch’s head revealed a look of horror. “Meng Chuan! Meng Chuan, everything is negotiable!”
Meng Chuan continued to let his Demon Slayer devour the demon monarch’s body parts. Demon Slayer absorbed each frozen body segment one by one.
As the azure-scaled demon monarch’s pleaded, the remaining 17 body segments were absorbed in five minutes, leaving only his head intact.
“Don’t worry. I won’t kill you so quickly.” Meng Chuan waved his hand and stored the azure-scaled demon monarch’s head into his Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead. It was only a frozen head, and it was inside his Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead. He constantly monitored it, so there naturally wouldn’t be any accidents.
Whoosh.Following that, he put all of his spoils of war into the pocket grotto-heaven. As for Marquis Purple Rain’s corpse, he had already stored it away before he took action. Meng Chuan looked at his barren surroundings one kilometer around him. All the buildings, trees, and corpses had been reduced to dust during the battle. Everything beyond one kilometer was in ruins.
It’s really not easy to kill a fifth Firmament demon monarch. Following that, he took out his token. On the token, the green dotswhich were low-level reinforcement requests
-had all disappeared. They had clearly withdrawn their requests for help. The danger at the three large cities and eight medium-sized World Entrances should have already passed. The real emergencies had been at Silver Lake Pass and Eastcalm City. Most places can handle the demon monarchs themselves.
Archean Mountain’s arrangements were very appropriate. Only a few places needed emergency reinforcements.
I wonder what the global situation is like.Fifth Firmament demon monarchs have attacked the world. I’m afraid that it’s not just Eastcalm City. I hope that the other regions managed to defend themselves.
There was a limit to what he could do. After all, Meng Chuan was only as strong as a top Regis Godfiend after Demon Slayer devoured the Creation-realm alien corpse. In such a major battle, the help he could provide was ultimately limited.
Swoosh.
Marquis West Sea flew over from afar and looked at Meng Chuan with excitement. He had only come after the demonic aura completely dissipated. “That demon monarch is dead?”

chapters.title: Chapter 296 - Casualties
chapters.content:
Chapter 296 Casualties
“It’s very difficult to kill a fifth Firmament demon monarch,” said Meng Chuan.
Marquis West Sea nodded. “That’s right. After reaching the fifth Firmament, these demon monarchs have extremely strong vitality.”
“I’ve already captured it alive. After the battle, I’ll hand it over to Archean Mountain,” said Meng Chuan.
“Captured alive?” Marquis West Sea was alarmed. According to his knowledge, even if a fifth Firmament demon monarch’s body was diced up, they could still counterattack at any moment. He only dared to come forward when the fifth Firmament demon monarch’s demonic power had completely disappeared. He was afraid of being a burden on Meng Chuan if he was ambushed.
“Oh, right. This is Senior Brother Yu’s corpse.” Meng Chuan waved his hand, and Marquis Purple Rain’s corpse appeared on the ground beside him. The white-haired Marquis Purple Rain had a bloody hole in his chest; his heart had been torn out.
“Senior Brother Yu.” Marquis West Sea looked at the corpse with grief.
“Marquis West Sea, I’ll leave the matters here to you. I still need to take a look at other areas.” Meng Chuan looked at Marquis Purple Rain’s corpse and felt somewhat sad. However, he had seen too many deaths over the years.
“Alright.” Marquis West Sea nodded. He knew that Meng Chuan was in charge of providing reinforcements in this region.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan immediately transformed into a bolt of lightning and vanished from the city.
Although the other cities and medium-sized World Entrances he was in charge of had retracted their requests for help, Meng Chuan still wanted to check on them.
Swoosh.
Supremacy Qin Wu streaked across the sky like a sword. When he arrived outside a large city, he was about 50 kilometers away from the battle between Godfiends and demon monarchs.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
On the battlefield, about 50 kilometers away, sword beams naturally condensed in the void and killed six fourth Firmament demon monarchs swiftly.
Supremacy Qin Wu cultivated the Thirteen Swordbane Fiend Body. At his realm, everything within 50 kilometers of him was his territory. He could condense sword beams and kill enemies with a thought. To him, a fourth Firmament demon monarch... was very weak. He did not need to release his Swordbanes.
Although killing demon monarchs is easy, it takes time to travel to the various locations. Qin Wu stood in midair as he looked at the token in his hand. All cities within 1,000 kilometers have canceled their requests for help. The battle should be over. Our human race suffered heavy losses in this battle. However, I wonder how heavy the losses are for the demons.
He flew to a large mountain more than 50 kilometers away and sat cross-legged on the mountain peak. Qin Wu had to stay prepared to help any area at a moment’s notice. After all, the war had yet to end, and the demons might attack again. Time passed.
As night fell, the world began to calm down.
The next day, at the break of dawn.
Whoosh. An illusory man appeared beside Qin Wu.
“Master.” The illusory man respectfully said, “I’ve returned to Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s pocket grotto-heaven. Almost all demon monarch teams have returned.”
“They have all returned to the grotto-heaven?” Qin Wu frowned slightly. “From the looks of it, they have temporarily stopped attacking? How are the losses on the demons’ side?”
The illusory man sighed in amazement. “Terrible. I heard from many demon monarchs that Regis Godfiends ambushed them when they attacked the cities! They said our humans’ Regis Godfiends are very sinister. They used their Seamless domains to approach them and attack them suddenly once they were close enough. The demon monarch teams suffered quite tragically. It’s considered pretty good if two or three demon monarchs in a team escaped. There are even a few teams that failed to return at all.”
“Okay.” Supremacy Qin Wu nodded slightly. “Do you understand the general losses of the demons?”
“I’m not sure.” The illusory man hesitated and said, “I estimate that the demons have lost about 50% of their forces in the human world. It’s just my guess.”
“Alright, continue keeping tabs. Inform me if anything develops,” instructed Qin Wu.
“I think the demons have lost their morale. I don’t think there will be a second wave of attacks for a while,” said the illusory man.
Qin Wu smiled. “I hope so!”
Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s grotto-heaven.
Many fourth Firmament demon monarchs gathered together. They drank, ate, and chatted.
“We tried to kill the human Godfiends, but King True Martial suddenly appeared!” A white-browed wolf demon monarch couldn’t help but feel afraid as he held a cup of alcohol.
“King True Martial... He’s one of the most powerful human Regis Godfiends. It’s said that he can even fight a demon sage. The six of us were scared silly, and immediately scattered. We burrowed into the ground and fled. It’s only because my Essence Soul had reached the third level that I remained lucid. This allowed me to barely escape and survive,” said a red fox demon monarch.
“It’s not bad for two of you to survive after meeting King True Martial,” said a demon monarch.
The red fox demon monarch said, “That King True Martial was eager to save Godfiends. If he had restrained his aura and carefully approached us, we would’ve had more time. We could’ve killed Marquis Azure Wood. Instead, he showed himself from afar to scare us. We immediately fled, and that allowed Marquis Azure Wood to live.”
“We were in quite a sorry state as well. We encountered a strange peacock beast while attacking a city. When the peacock beast spread its tail, golden beams of light shot out. They were Regis Godfiend-level attacks. We were nearly scared silly by the barrage of hundreds of golden beams. Two of us managed to escape thanks to our powerful bodies,” said a pig demon while chewing on meat.
“A peacock beast? What peacock beast?”
“Could it be a demon?” The other demon monarchs were puzzled.
“No.” The pig demon shook his head. “It’s not a demon, not a human. It felt more like a special weapon that isn’t alive.”“Our team also encountered a strange beast. That strange beast was definitely comparable to a peak fifth Firmament demon monarch. When it opened its mouths, everything turned pitch-black. There was no light at all. We fled underground in fear, and only I survived.”
The demon monarchs shared their experiences. They still felt lingering fear when they thought back on their experiences.
“Nine Abyss.” In the main hall, a black-robed figure flipped through a dossier and said, “From the intelligence provided by the demon monarchs that have returned, most of the human cities are guarded by Regis Godfiend-level forces...”
Demon Sage Nine Abyss listened silently.
“Only a very small number of places were guarded by Marquis Godfiends. They chose extremely powerful Marquis Godfiends to work together and guard these areas. When two such Marquis Godfiends joined forces, they were able to fend off our six-man demon monarch teams. The black-robed figure continued, “Also, other experts reinforced them when they arrived. We can currently confirm that Archean Mountain’s rescue team consists of Supremacy Qin Wu, Supremacy Li Guan, King True Martial, King Clear Jade, and Marquis Eastcalm. The ones responsible for reinforcing Black Sand Dynasty are Supremacy Bai Yaoyue, Supremacy Meng Tiange, King Transcendence, and King Molten.”
“King Clear Jade? King Molten?” Demon Sage Nine Abyss said, “Both of them are Regis Godfiends from 500 to 600 years ago. They should be nearly 1,000 years old if they’re still alive to this day.”
“Yes.” The black-robed figure said, “Most of the humans’ Regis Godfiend-level combat forces were those from hundreds of years ago. There are also some rare treasures and weapons protecting various places. We’ve suffered heavy losses across the entire world.”
“I know,” said Demon Sage Nine Abyss, “I can sense how tragic our losses are through the token. What we need to know now is how bad the humans’ losses are? If the humans’ losses are just as tragic, our losses will be worth it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 297 - Hope
chapters.content:
Chapter 297 Hope
“We’re still investigating the humans’ losses,” said the black-robed figure. “However, their losses aren’t too great.”
Demon Sage Nine Abyss fell silent. The demons had suffered huge losses this time. Their attacks on the cities had hit huge snags! They had even lost a significant number of fifth Firmament demon monarchs.
Demon Sage Nine Abyss finally said, “Investigate it first. Use all means available to investigate the humans’ losses. Also, investigate the human forces’ true strength and report it to the Imperial Lords. What we do next will be decided by the Imperial Lords.”
The black-robed figure nodded.
The situation this time was worse than they had expected. They never expected a large group of ancient Regis Godfiends to appear. Their lifespans were limited by the laws of the world. Even the demons were unable to help existences live beyond their lifespans. However, humans had actually managed to do so.
Evening
High in the sky, Meng Chuan flew by Eastcalm City and saw numerous people entering and exiting Eastcalm City’s four city gates. Under the setting sun’s illumination, the countless people looked as tiny as ants.
Swoosh.
A figure streaked across the sky; it was Qin Wu.
“Master.” Meng Chuan bowed respectfully.
“Every large city is the hope of countless mortals that live in the wilderness.” Qin Wu looked down. “Look. The people who live in the wilderness can transport food to the city and sell it for a high price. They can buy clothes, weapons, cultivation manuals, and send their talented children to a Dao Academy to cultivate.”
Meng Chuan looked down. For many mortals living in the wilderness, entering a large city was a joyous occasion. “As long as large cities exist, we will always have hope in life. If there are large cities, they will completely sink into oblivion, forever living in darkness,” said Qin Wu. “Furthermore, with so many large cities as garrisons, Earth Net can search the world. These large cities must continue to exist, be it for the people’s hope or control over the world. If they didn’t exist, it would be difficult for us to investigate demon attacks.”
“I heard that Two World Island’s situation is very serious,” said Meng Chuan. “Away from a city, one can often encounter demons wreaking havoc.” “Humans and demons are almost coexisting in the Great Yue Dynasty.” Qin Wu sighed. “Unfortunately, our Archean Mountain and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven are finding it difficult to protect even our territories. We can’t help Two World Island.”
Meng Chuan nodded. In this era, humans truly felt powerless. When he was young, the world was still relatively peaceful on the surface, and all city passes were guarded. In the past few decades, he had watched as city passes were abandoned, followed by village forts, prefecture cities, and county cities. Most humans lived like savages in the wilderness; only a minority lived in large cities.
“These years, things have changed too quickly,” said Meng Chuan softly. “Yes, the changes happened quickly,” said Qin Wu. “The demons planned on completely occupying our human world with this battle. However, how can we humans be so easily defeated considering how we have survived to this day? The demons have suffered heavy losses this time. I’m afraid they will be even more prepared when they launch their next attack.”
Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up. “How’s the outcome of this battle?”
Qin Wu smiled at Meng Chuan. “I’m here to tabulate the results of the battle. How’s your demon monarch kill count?”
“I encountered a demon monarch team at Chu An City. I killed five, one escaped,” said Meng Chuan. “I killed six demon monarchs at Silver Lake Pass and a fifth Firmament demon monarch in Eastcalm City. I killed a total of 11 fourth Firmament demon monarchs and one fifth Firmament demon monarch. As for ordinary demon monarchs? The number I killed can be ignored.”
“Fifth Firmament demon monarch?” Qin Wu’s eyes lit up.
“It was captured alive by me.” Meng Chuan waved his hand, and an ice sculpture appeared beside him. The azure-scaled demon monarch’s head was frozen inside. His eyes opened, and he looked at Meng Chuan and Qin Wu.
“Master, I’ll leave it with you,” said Meng Chuan.
“Very good.” Qin Wu waved his hand and put it away. He sighed with mixed emotions. “The most troublesome thing is that a group of fifth Firmament demon monarchs appeared this time. They were extremely cunning. They let the demon monarch teams attack the cities first. If they discover a Regis Godfiend guarding a city, they will retreat. If Marquis Godfiends are the ones guarding a city, they will ambush them. Almost all Marquis Godfiends that died in battle died to the hands of fifth Firmament demon monarchs.”
“There are only three super-large city passes in the world. Fifth Firmament demon monarchs can’t enter, right?” asked Meng Chuan. “They should’ve been fourth Firmament demon monarchs that broke through in the human world.” “Yes.” Qin Wu nodded. “They should be newly-advanced fifth Firmament demon monarchs. However, all of them have received treasures from the demon Imperial Lords. They have valuable treasures with them. They almost have the strength of a peak Regis Godfiend. Of course, they require external items to achieve that strength... They are still somewhat lacking compared to an actual peak Regis Godfiend.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
For example, the azure-scaled demon monarch hadn’t cultivated his physical body for that long a time. If he were a true peak fifth Firmament demon monarch, his body would naturally be stronger. It would’ve been several-fold harder for Meng Chuan to kill him.
Meng Chuan was considered to be as strong as a peak Regis Godfiend. However, he was powerful in many aspects. He had the Undying Body, unparalleled speed, divine powers, and baneful aura. His master had given him a Creation-realm alien corpse, allowing Demon Slayer to transform. If Demon Slayer hadn’t transformed, he wouldn’t have been able to dice the azure-scaled demon monarch’s body.
“From today onwards, you will continue scanning for underground demon lairs,” instructed Qin Wu. “You can also stay in Jiang State Capital.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan revealed a look of delight since he could accompany his daughter now. He then asked, “What about Qiyue?”
“Other Marquis Godfiends have to stay where they are. We also need to make arrangements depending on the demons’ actions,” said Qin Wu. “You were in charge of rescuing the various areas, so you have more freedom.”
Meng Chuan nodded. It looked like he couldn’t reunite with his wife for the time being.
Time passed.
The world’s atmosphere remained tense, but Meng Chuan had returned to his old routine. He spent 12 hours underground every day and returned home at night.Meng Chuan had given tokens to his family so they could sense each other’s location. He knew which city his wife was at, but due to Archean Mountain’s orders, he couldn’t disturb her. The couple could only communicate through letters.
“Ah Chuan, I just received news today that my master, Marquis Heavenstar, was also one of the Marquis Godfiends who died in battle. After I learned of it, I felt muddle-headed. My mind was filled with scenes of my master teaching me archery on the mountain. Even now, I’m still grieving when writing this letter...” Liu Qiyue’s words made Meng Chuan fall silent.
He knew more than his wife. Yesterday, when he dumped his many accumulated demon corpses at Archean Mountain, he learned of many things from Archean Mountain Lord. He knew that 12 Marquis Godfiends had died in the battle. Archean Mountain hadn’t suffered such a huge loss for many years.
“Qiyue.” Meng Chuan also wrote a letter. “I heard that 12 Archean Mountain Marquis Godfiends died in battle. Eleven of them died at the hands of fifth Firmament demon monarchs. Marquis Heavenstar was no different. However, the demons suffered greater losses...”
He filled two pages with writing before stopping. After finishing the letter, he looked at the bright moon through the window. He was a little hesitant.
He and his wife were separated for the time being. They had to carry out their missions separately. Many Marquis Godfiends had died in battle. When would this war end? It was impossible to know.
“Little Gray, send this to Archean Mountain.” Meng Chuan threw the letter out the window.
A gray bird swooped down and transformed into a woman. She respectfully received the letter before soaring into the sky and headed straight for Archean Mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 298 - World Gap (Final C.of Volume)
chapters.content:
Chapter 298 World Gap (Final Chapter of Volume)
A year passed in the blink of an eye.
One million demon monarchs secretly infiltrated through the numerous smaller World Entrances. Although such infiltration was slow, it made it harder for them to be intercepted. Human Godfiends were ultimately too few in number. If a Great Solar Godfiend were to act alone, they would be easily intercepted and killed by demons...
More and more demon monarchs are entering the human world. Meng Chuan stood in Lake Heart Pavilion and looked at his daughterwho was practicing her sword art-as he thought about the global situation. If the demons are willing, most of the mortals in the wilderness will be killed. However, as long as a demon monarch appears and somebody requests for help, I will immediately rush over to kill it.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
Meng You’s sword beam suddenly surged in strength. Meng Chuan was taken aback, but he couldn’t help but smile.
“Dad, I’ve achieved Sword Force! I’ve achieved Sword Force!” Meng You was somewhat excited.
Meng Chuan smiled and nodded. “Yes.”
Meng You had comprehended Sword Force at the age of 15. Although she was two years slower than Meng An, she was still considered excellent. “You’er, write to your mother and tell her the news,” instructed Meng Chuan with a smile. Liu Qiyue was still guarding another city, so she was unable to return to Jiang State Capital. “Alright.” Meng You nodded immediately and couldn’t help but say, “Dad, I achieved Sword Force at 15 years of age. Can I enter Archean Mountain immediately?”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Yes.”
Archean Mountain often invited geniuses into their ranks. There were many kinds of geniuses. Some had awakened a phoenix bloodline or had reached the Realm of Intent at a young age. Although Godfiend Deng Feng was relatively old when he revealed his talent, he was specially invited to join Archean Mountain.
It was rare for someone to comprehend Force at the age of 13. Comprehending Sword Force at the age of 15 was considered a pretty impressive achievement. Geniuses that had comprehended Force at the age of 15 were usually ranked in the top two during Archean Mountain’s annual entrance examination.
Half a month later, Meng Chuan sent his daughter to Archean Mountain.
“Your daughter’s talent also isn’t bad.” Qin Wu stood beside Meng Chuan and smiled. “She also has the potential to become a Marquis Godfiend.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. “By the way, Master, I heard that Archean Mountain is planning to increase the number of recruited disciples a year.”
“Yes.” Qin Wu nodded. “More demon monarchs are entering our human world. The conclusion of the war between humans and demons will happen in a century or two. The awakened Regis Godfiends have limited time, and our advantage in strength will not last long. Therefore, in the next few decades, we have to nurture more disciples. We hope to recruit more disciples and produce more mighty Godfiends.”
“The awakened Regis Godfiends only have a few decades left to live.” Meng Chuan asked, “If the demons don’t attack now, won’t it just be a war of attrition? In a few decades, those awakened Regis Godfiends will die. What will we do then?”
“Don’t worry. We have plans. At the very least, we can ensure that we can protect the large cities for 100 years,” said Qin Wu. “A hundred years?” Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
The Demon Realm.
The three demon Imperial Lords were gathered in Ice Palace that floated high in the sky.
“After a year of investigations, the situation is very clear,” said the black-haired, single-horned Imperial Lord Starquix with a smile. “A large number of human Regis Godfiends suddenly appeared for the battle. Altogether, the three large sects had about 60 Regis Godfiends that appeared suddenly. Some are famous Regis Godfiends from 100 to 200 years ago. Some are even Regis Godfiends that dominated the world 700 to 800 years ago. They are not newly-advanced Regis Godfiends, but Regis Godfiends that are near the end of their lifespans. They have great strength and experience. They never appeared in the past, but they have all appeared now.”
“Death is inevitable at the end of one’s lifespan,” said Lady Blackmoon. “There is a legend in the outer realm that talks about a mystic technique that can hide a person from the laws of Heaven and Earth, preventing them from dying for some time. They do this through a ‘fake death.’ After doing this, they can continue living for a while. However, they have limited time before they will die.
“We demons don’t have any ‘fake death’ mystic techniques. Humans clearly have one,” said a golden-robed, golden-haired man.
Imperial Lord Starquix said, “Observe these Regis Godfiends carefully. They don’t have much of their lifespans left. They’ll die in a few decades.”
“Then let’s just stall for time,” said Lady Blackmoon. “After a few decades, those Regis Godfiends will all die of old age. Without those 60 ancient Regis Godfiends, winning the war will be easy.”
“They might continue using their ‘fake death’ mystic technique and stall for time,” said Emperor Roc.
“Then we’ll attack the human cities occasionally and force them to defend the cities,” said Imperial Lord Starquix. Emperor Roc frowned and said, “With such a group of ancient Regis Godfiends and the heritage of the human world, the humans will probably be able to last another hundred years.”
“Haha.” Lady Blackmoon laughed. “We have to be patient. Now that the World Gap between the Demon Realm and the human world has appeared, it means that the approaching of the two worlds is inevitable in the long River of Spacetime. The delicacy that is the human world is destined to be unable to escape from our grasp.”
“Yes.” Emperor Roc revealed a smile. “I was previously worried that the River of Spacetime would tremble, causing the two worlds to separate. However, since a World Gap is forming between our two worlds, there’s no need to worry anymore. In the future, more World Entrances in our two worlds will appear. It will be easier for us demons to invade the human world then.”
“The human world’s Ancestral Master Archean Eon used to be famous in many worlds across the River of Spacetime. Many worlds’ Imperial Lords feared him back then,” said Imperial Lord Starquix. “Although he died after his lifespan ended, the treasures he left behind... will definitely be a big surprise.”
“It’s not just Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s legacy. Everything that humans have accumulated over numerous generations will be ours.” Lady Blackmoon and Emperor Roc were filled with anticipation. At the Imperial Lord level, one’s horizons would be focused on the outer realm.
They had even greater ambition than most!
The legacy left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon was something the three Imperial Lords had to obtain no matter what. Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s legacy was the greatest treasure trove that the three Imperial Lords might possibly receive in their lives.The human world.
“The Imperial Lords want us to put enough pressure on the humans so that the ancient Regis Godfiends guard the cities with their full strength,” said the black-robed figure. “After a century of attrition, these ancient Regis Godfiends will have died of old age. By then, it will be easier to win the war. Furthermore, the Imperial Lords say that the World Gap has already begun to form. Following that, more World Entrances will appear.” “World Gap?” Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s eyes lit up. “I heard that in the River of Spacetime, the two worlds are close to each other, thus forming a special gap. Apparently, it is very mysterious?”
“The World Gap is the same as a World Entrance. It only allows entry to fifth Firmament demon monarchs and below,” said the black-robed figure.
“Yes, I can’t enter.” Demon Sage Nine Abyss was somewhat regretful. “The Imperial Lords instructed us to spend 100 years battling a war of attrition with the humans. What can we use to fight the humans? Our remaining 300 fourth Firmament demon monarchs and ten-plus fifth Firmament demon monarchs aren’t enough.”
“In addition to the demon monarchs that have infiltrated over the past year, there are over 500,000 demon monarchs in the human world today. In the next three years, there will be one million demon monarchs,” said the black-robed figure. In the future, tens of thousands of demon monarchs will enter the human world every year, replenishing our numbers. Make good use of the one million demon monarchs. Prevent those ancient Regis Godfiends from entering a ‘fake death.”
“Use the million demon monarchs to stall for time?” Demon Sage Nine Abyss understood. “That’s simple. In terms of numbers, there are far fewer human Godfiends”
“These ancient Regis Godfiends might seem difficult to deal with, but they aren’t worth mentioning in the face of time,” said the black-robed figure with a smile. “Furthermore, the human world will no longer be able to escape once the World Gap is formed!”
Final Chapter of Volume-Tumultuous Changes

chapters.title: Chapter 299 - Li Water Dao Academy’s Dean Wen
chapters.content:
Chapter 299 Li Water Dao Academy’s Dean Wen
The Li Water Mountain Range was a mountain range that spanned hundreds of kilometers. Ever since village forts were abandoned, many people had fled to Li Water Mountain Range.
“Demon monarch.”
“There’s a demon monarch.”
An ugly green-skinned demon monarch charged into a valley. This valley was covered in fog perennially, making it a paradise for the people here. Thousands of people lived in this valley. More than 100,000 people were scattered across the entire Li Water Mountain Range.
“You humans really know how to hide.” The ugly, green-skinned demon monarch grinned. With a wave of his claw, sharp demonic powers sliced through the air. Instantly, a lot of blood from mortal humans splattered as they died.
With a furious shout, a youth ran over from a cliff. “Demon monarch!”
The Demon monarch looked up, and his eyes narrowed. He smiled. “Indestructible Godfiend?”
The youth attacked with his spear. His body emitted a blood-colored gas as he stared at the ugly demon monarch.
“Human Godfiend, you should be able to sense the strength difference between us. Not only did you not escape, you even delivered yourself to me?” The green-skinned demon monarch smiled. He was one of the numerous demon monarchs that had been sent into the human world. He was only an ordinary third Firmament demon monarch-average among demons. However, he was still very confident in dealing with an Indestructible Godfiend.
“Isn’t that Dean Wen?”
The mortals that were fleeing in the distance also noticed this scene. All of them were astonished. Dean Wen had built the Li Water Dao Academy in Li Water Mountain Range.
