Many people that lived in the mountain range had no ability to send their children to a large city, so many children were sent to Dean Wen’s Li Water Dao Academy. Everybody that lived on the mountain believed that Dean Wen was only a Impervious realm expert that had comprehended Force.
Who would have thought that he could display the terrifying strength of a Godfiend?
“Dean Wen is a Godfiend?”
“Dean, kill that demon monarch!” shouted a child excitedly.
“Leave quickly!” Dean Wen shouted angrily. He was somewhat anxious. He knew the strength difference between himself and the demon monarch, but if he didn’t step forward, how many people in the Li Water Mountain Range would die?
“Human Godfiend, I truly admire your courage. Therefore, I’ll eat you up piece by piece.” The green-skinned demon monarch let out a savage laugh before transforming into a green blur as he charged forward.
Dean Wen held his spear and took the initiative to clash with the demon monarch.
Underground
Swoosh.
A bolt of lightning flew rapidly underground; it was Meng Chuan, who was busy conducting underground reconnaissance. He kept his Divine Eye of Lightning-situated at his glabella-constantly open.
A large number of demon monarchs constantly sneak in from the various World Entrances. There are too many small and medium-sized World Entrances in the world. A little bit goes a long way. We can’t guard every single one of them. I am finding more and more demon monarchs underground.
A cold glint flashed in Meng Chuan’s eyes. It was like he didn’t know fatigue. During his 12-hour long underground reconnaissance, he wiped out every demon monarch lair he came across. However, he could no longer find any fourth Firmament demon monarchs. According to Archean Mountain’s intelligence, most fourth Firmament demon monarchs were in Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s pocket grotto-heaven. They seldom came out, but when they did... they would attack a large city.
Huh? Meng Chuan—who was flying underground-suddenly sensed a surge of demonic power coming from the surface. The demonic power erupted madly. Meng Chuan could sense it, even when he was dozens of kilometers away.
Demonic aura. Meng Chuan flew up.
Bang! Bang! Bang! After passing through 15 kilometers of soil and rock, he surfaced from the ground. With a glance, he saw a man-covered in blood-on a mountain not far away. The man held a spear in one hand as he fought an ugly demon monarch with green skin. The man had lost an arm, and there were many wounds on his body. There were two bloody holes on his chest. Ordinary Godfiends would have died long ago, but he was still holding on.
“Damn it. Damn it.” The man held a spear in one hand as he roared. His eyes were filled with indignation.
He couldn’t accept dying without killing the demon monarch. What would happen to the 100,000 mortals in Li Water Mountain Range if he died before he killed the demon monarch? What would happen to the youths he carefully taught at his Li Water Dao Academy?
“I’m willing to risk my life as I fight for the people behind me! I will risk my life so that the 100,000 mortals in Li Water Mountain range have a chance to survive! Heavens, show us mercy!” The man was willing to risk everything, but he had heavy injuries.
The green-skinned monarch was cunning; he wasn’t willing to exchange blows with the human Godfiend at the price of being injured. “Oh?” Just as the man stabbed out angrily, he suddenly saw the void collapse and distort. A saber beam flew out from the distorted void and pierced through the green-skinned demon monarch’s head.
The demon monarch’s head flew up, his eyes filled with disbelief.
“The heavens have shown mercy.” A smile appeared on the man’s face before he collapsed to the ground.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan instantly appeared beside the man. He could tell that the Godfiend’s injuries were severe at a glance. Through the two holes on the man’s chest, Meng Chuan could see that the man’s lungs were in pieces. His heart had been reduced to dust! It was only because this man was Body Tempering Godfiend and had vigorous vitality that he was able to hold on for so long.
The youthful Godfiend looked at Meng Chuan and smiled. He said, “Thank you.”
“It’s me who needs to thank you.” Meng Chuan’s Quintessential Essence immediately seeped into the youth’s body and prevented his injuries from worsening. “If you hadn’t fought the demon monarch, forcing him to release enough of his demonic powers, I wouldn’t have sensed it.”
“There’s no need to save me. I’m a Body Tempering Godfiend. I know how severe my injuries are.” The youth shook his head gently. “My heart is shattered, and my organs are severely injured. There’s no hope left.” “There’s hope.” While he prevented the injuries from worsening, Meng Chuan took out a jade bottle from his Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead. He took a pill out of the jade bottle and said, “Eat this.”
Quintessential Essence wrapped around the pill and guided it down the young man’s gullet.
The young man healed at a visible speed the moment he swallowed the pill. Through the bloody holes on his chest, one could see a heart rapidly growing inside the man’s body. The man’s muscle, skin, and organs also rapidly healed. Even his severed arm was rapidly regrowing. The young man watched this happen in astonishment. “No matter how serious your injuries are, as long as you are still breathing, Archean Mountain can save you,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “You wouldn’t have lasted if I didn’t carry some pills with me and had to bring you to Archean Mountain.”
He had contributed to the human race greatly, so he naturally prepared some treasures for himself with his accumulated credit. After all, in such a tumultuous time, he might have to rescue people and Godfiends.
In just a few seconds, most of the man’s wounds had healed completely. The young man immediately stood up and gratefully said, “Greetings Marquis Eastcalm, I’m Wen Fang.” Meng Chuan was now famous throughout the world. It wasn’t strange that he knew Meng Chuan.
“Wen Fang?” Meng Chuan smiled. “You aren’t an Archean Mountain disciple?”
“I’m from the Demon Annihilation Guild. I used the Demon Annihilation Guild’s resources to become a Body Tempering Godfiend,” said Wen Fang with a smile. “I was lucky enough to become a Godfiend. I only reached the Indestructible realm after cultivating to this day.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. His father, Meng Dajiang, had also become a Godfiend with the Demon Annihilation Guild’s resources.
The Demon Annihilation Guild was a very unique organization. It existed to deal with the Skydemon Sect and the demons. With Meng Chuan’s current status, he knew that there were nine human Creation realm experts. Eight were from the three major sects! Demon Annihilation Guild’s Master was the ninth Creation Supremacy. He was a wandering cultivator. In wartime, the three major sects were on good terms with the Demon Annihilation Guild.
“Since you knew that you couldn’t defeat that demon monarch, you should have fled. Keep your useful body alive,” said Meng Chuan. “If not, you would have died in vain. It’s not worth it.”
“I really don’t wish to see the 100,000 mortals in Li Water Mountain Range killed. Therefore, I could only go all-out and risk my life. I originally thought that with the uniqueness of a Body Tempering Godfiend, I might have a chance of killing this demon monarch. But clearly, I overestimated myself.” Wen Fang smiled at Meng Chuan. “Thankfully, you arrived and saved my life, Marquis Eastcalm.”

chapters.title: Chapter 300 - Infiltration
chapters.content:
Chapter 300 Infiltration
From a logical point of view, he should have fled when he was no match for the enemy Keeping a useful Godfiend alive would be better in the long term. However, Meng Chuan still appreciated Wen Fang.
“Dean.”
“Dean Wen.” More than ten bold people ran over from afar.
Meng Chuan said in surprise, “Dean?”
“I built a Dao Academy in Li Water Mountain Range and taught youths how to cultivate,” explained Wen Fang. He also waved at the crowd, but none of them approached. They were happy to see that Dean Wen had completely recovered. In Li Water Mountain Range, Dean Wen had quite the status.
“With your strength, it shouldn’t be difficult for you to build a Dao Academy in a city, right?” asked Meng Chuan.
“There are many experts in the cities. They don’t need me, but this place needs me.” Wen Fang smiled.
“Do you have a family clan or any family?” asked Meng Chuan.
It was rare for a Godfiend to be willing to root himself in the mountains for 100,000 mortals.
Wen Fang laughed. “My wife and children are all in the imperial capital. My clansmen are also in the imperial capital. They are living well and don’t have to worry. The only thing I regret... is my inability to accompany my wife and children properly. They also know that their lives are much better than countless mortals. They also understand what I’m doing.
“In this era, more demon monarchs are entering our human world. Isn’t it said that one million demon monarchs would destroy the human race? I’m a Godfiend, but I’m not of much use in the grand scheme. If I can protect an area, I’ll protect it,” said Wen Fang.
Meng Chuan glanced at the people in the valley and mountains. There were too many people living in this mountain range.
“You have done them a great favor,” said Meng Chuan.
“I only hope to have a clear conscience when doing things,” said Wen Fang with a smile. “I can’t compare to you. You have contributed to the human race much more, Marquis Eastcalm.”
“Haha, I’m also doing all I can. By the way, this item left behind by the demon monarch might be of some use to you and the mortals in Li Water Mountain Range. I’ll leave it with
you.”
With that said, Meng Chuan vanished in a second.
The young man, Wen Fang, raised his head. Then, he collected the demon monarch’s corpse without any qualms.
Night. A rippling sea that ebbed softly.
Above the seawater was a small World Entrance that was about 1,000 feet long. Over the years, more small and medium-sized World Entrances had appeared. This small World Entrance had formed just eight years ago. Humans had never sent Godfiends here to guard it. If a large number of Godfiends were sent to guard various World Entrances, most would’ve died. Back then, humans had no other choice but to stop guarding many World Entrances.
Whoosh.
la
A rather handsome yellow-robed man flew out from the small World Entrance. An invisible fluctuation enveloped him. Even a Regis Godfiend would find it difficult to notice him. He smiled as he looked around and breathed in the world’s air. “Human world? I’ve finally arrived in this human world. I’ll find a place to rise to the fourth Firmament first. Then, I’ll meet Nine Abyss and North Sense.” The yellow-robed man took a step forward and entered the dark, boundless sea.
Four hours later. Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s pocket grotto-heaven.
“Brother Yellow Oscillate!” Demon Sage Nine Abyss and the black-robed man welcomed him. “Nine Abyss, I’m here to seek refuge with you,” said the yellow-robed man with a smile. His aura was much stronger than when he first entered the human world, having reached the fourth Firmament.
Demon Sage Nine Abyss smiled and said, “We are now at a disadvantage in the human world. Our top-level forces are too weak here. You have boosted our confidence since you’ve entered the human world.”
“There’s no need to worry. The World Gap has already appeared and is in the process of forming,” said the yellow-robed man with a smile. “The final outcome has been fixed. The longer this war drags on, the more stable the World Gap will be. The greater the connection between the two worlds, the more World Entrances there will be. Our Demon Realm’s advantage will only grow.
“Many demon sages know how to take advantage of the situation. Before the World Gap appeared, only the two of you entered the human world via possession. Now that the World Gap has appeared, more demon sages will definitely be willing to enter the human world,” said the yellow-robed man. “According to what I know, several demon sages are searching for suitable bodies. I was just slightly faster.”
Nine Abyss Demon Sage and the black-robed figure nodded slightly. They also understood the situation.
“However, it’s very difficult for me to recover to the level of a demon sage,” continued the yellow-robed man. “It will probably take me several years to do so. It’ll be pretty good if I can succeed in returning to my peak strength after spending a century here.”
“Take your time. There’s no hurry,” replied Demon Sage Nine Abyss.
Demon Sage North Sense was famous for his various mystic techniques. He was not very good at fighting head-on. Demon Sage Yellow Oscillate was extremely strong at head-on battles. His technique realm was extremely high. Even with his fourth Firmament demon monarch body, he could unleash the combat strength of a fifth Firmament demon monarch. He would be invincible beneath the Creation realm if he recovered to the fifth Firmament. If he recovered his peak strength, he would be in no way inferior to Demon Sage Nine Abyss.
“After possessing and switching bodies, one has to recover their strength slowly. Although one’s strength decreases greatly, there’s a benefit,” said the yellow-robed man with a smile. His eyes were burning with passion. “We can pay a visit to the World Gap.”
The black-robed figure calmly said, “Only fifth Firmament demon monarchs and below can enter the World Gap. We can indeed enter the World Gap after possessing a new body, but both of us are only at the fourth Firmament right now. If we enter and encounter Regis Godfiends, we will definitely die.”
“I’ll enter after I recover to the fifth Firmament,” said the yellow-robed man.
“The Godfiend cultivation system created by Ancestral Master Archean Eon is stronger than our demon monarch cultivation system,” said the black-robed figure. “Against the top Regis Godfiends, even if you and I recover to the fifth Firmament, we might not be their match.”
“Are you referring to King True Martial, King Clear Jade, King Transcendence, and the others?” asked the yellow-robed man.
King True Martial and King Clear Jade were from Archean Mountain. King Clear Jade was one of the ancient Godfiends that had awoken. The demons still didn’t know that Archean Mountain had two ancient Regis Godfiends that were in no way weaker to King True Martial. One was Peng Mu, and the other was Yun Jianhai. They were the two strongest Regis Godfiends from 1,000 years ago. The black-robed figure nodded and said, “It’s said that these few people have the strength of a newly-advanced Creation realm expert. The Godfiend cultivation system is also stronger than our demon monarch cultivation system. Even if we were to recover to the fifth Firmament, we probably wouldn’t be able to defeat them.”
“We have greater experience than them and high technique realms. It’s not difficult for us to survive. We might even be able to kill them, considering our experience with a World Gap’s environment.” The yellow-robed man smiled.
The black-robed figure nodded slightly. “We can give it a try, but we have to wait until we recover to the fifth Firmament.”
“The two of you can focus on cultivating here at my place.” Demon Sage Nine Abyss smiled.
Huh? Deep underground, Meng Chuan-who was flying at high speeds—suddenly stopped. He took out a token and looked at it with a frown. Archean Mountain is summoning me? Master knows that I’m carrying out underground reconnaissance every day. If there’s nothing important, he won’t summon me.
Swoosh.
He immediately flew to the surface and soared above the clouds before rushing towards Archean Mountain.
After arriving at Archean Mountain, Meng Chuan took a detour to visit his children. His son, Meng An, was practicing his spear art alone in Bright Scenic Peak’s training grounds, but he didn’t see his daughter.
It’s been two years since An’er came to Archean Mountain. It seems like he’s still far from attaining a Samsara Divine Body. Meng Chuan watched his son cultivate from midair. He couldn’t help but smile. He knew the difficulty of cultivating the Samsara Divine Body. It was normal for An’er not to master it in two years.
Whoosh.
Following that, Meng Chuan flew to Grotto-Heaven Pavilion. There, he saw a tall, cold-looking man sitting cross-legged; he was as motionless as a mountain.
King Calm Sea. Meng Chuan immediately recognized him as Yan Jin and Xue Feng’s father. His grandaunt had worked under King Calm Sea for many years.
When Meng Chuan entered, King Calm Sea didn’t even turn his head to look at him. He continued sitting there with his eyes closed, motionless, cold, and proud.
“Marquis Eastcalm, please rest here. Other Regis and Marquis Godfiends will be arriving,” instructed the old steward.
“Thanks.” Meng Chuan sat down on a mat and waited silently.
Moments later, a black-robed youth walked into Grotto-Heaven Pavilion. It was none other than the King Calm Sea’s fifth son, Xue Feng. He wore a warm smile. When he entered and saw his father, King Calm Sea, his expression slightly changed before it turned serious.
Xue Feng is here too. Meng Chuan nodded slightly at Xue Feng. Xue Feng smiled and nodded before sitting down.

chapters.title: Chapter 301 - Candidates
chapters.content:
Chapter 301 Candidates
In Grotto-Heaven Pavilion’s courtyard, Supremacy Li Guan, an illusory Supremacy Qin Wu, and an illusory Supremacy Luo Tang gathered.
“Are we really sending Meng Chuan in this time?” asked Luo Tang. “More and more demon monarchs are entering our human world. Meng Chuan can hunt quite a number of demon monarchs while carrying out his daily underground reconnaissance. If we send him into the World Gap, it will mean a full year of not having someone that can efficiently hunt down demon monarchs. He can kill tens of thousands of demon monarchs within a year.”
“We shouldn’t only be looking at the present, but the future!” said Qin Wu. “Although Meng Chuan can’t carry out underground reconnaissance for a year and we will miss out on killing tens of thousands of demon monarchs, he can become a Regis Godfiend faster if he cultivates in the World Gap! If he can reach the Blood Droplet realm, the range of his underground reconnaissance technique will increase greatly. As a Regis Godfiend, he will be much faster than he is now. He’d probably finish sweeping through the Great Zhou Dynasty’s underground in a year. It’ll only take him a few years to sweep through the entire world. With such strength, he will be able to single-handedly hunt down more demon monarchs than all other Godfiends in the world combined.”
“I agree with Qin Wu’s idea. A beard lathered is half shaved. Once Meng Chuan reaches the Blood Droplet realm, he will be of great help to humanity,” said Li Guan.
“But his talent in saber arts isn’t too high.” Luo Tang shook her head and sighed. “Senior Brother, when you guided him on Archean Mountain a few days ago, he only attained Greater Mastery of Saber Dao. He has been a Marquis Godfiend for 13 years, but he still only has Greater Mastery of Saber Dao. He’s still quite far from reaching the peak of the Realm of Dao. There’s no need to even mention going from the peak of the Realm of Dao to the Dharma Domain realm.
“Based on previous generations of Regis Godfiends’ cultivation speed, it typically takes them 15 years to reach the peak of the Realm of Dao. From the peak of the Realm of Dao to the Dharma Domain realm, it usually takes one about 30 years. This is the average standard. From the looks of it, he’s slower than average,” said Luo Tang.
“We knew long ago that he wasn’t considered a peerless genius when it came to saber arts, but he’s quite lucky. After obtaining the physical body cultivation system, his body will maintain peak vitality until he’s 200 years old. He can still become a Regis Godfiend,” said Qin Wu. “His speed and his talent in underground reconnaissance... We have to pay the price to make him a Regis Godfiend as soon as possible, even if we have to throw resources at him.”
“He has to become a Regis Godfiend in 50 years.” Li Guan nodded. “Although his talent is lacking, it’s not burdensome to throw resources at him until he becomes a Regis Godfiend. As for him becoming a Creation Supremacy? That’s unlikely.”
“Becoming a Regis Godfiend is enough.” Qin Wu smiled and said, “When he becomes a Regis Godfiend, he will be ten times more useful than King White Treasure. He alone can hunt all the demon monarchs in the world, exceeding all other Godfiends. His Essence Soul talent may also bring us a pleasant surprise.” “Alright.” Luo Tang nodded. “Let him take a spot then. I hope he can become a Regis Godfiend within 50 years.”
Five Godfiends, including Meng Chuan, had gathered in Grotto-Heaven Pavillion’s hall. Meng Chuan, Yan Chitong, and Xue Feng were close to each other. They had a good relationship.
“Senior Brother Meng, thank you very much for what happened at Eastcalm City.” Yan Chitong sat by his side, feeling rather grateful. “If you hadn’t arrived, my father would probably have died at the hands of that fifth Firmament demon monarch.”
“Fifth Firmament demon monarch?” Xue Feng said in surprise.
“Oh.” Yan Chitong—who was now a handsome young man-couldn’t help but hesitate when he heard Xue Feng’s questioning tone.
“Back then, Archean Mountain had instructed us to keep this news a secret. Not many people know about it,” said King True Martial with a chuckle. “However, the demons have already noticed Meng Chuan’s strength as a top Regis Godfiend. Therefore, it’s fine for you to know. A year ago, when the demons attacked the cities on a large scale, Eastcalm City was attacked by a fifth Firmament demon monarch. Back then, Marquis Purple Rain and Marquis West Sea were in charge of guarding it. At a critical moment, Meng Chuan rushed over to rescue Marquis West Sea and killed the fifth Firmament demon monarch.”
Xue Feng looked at Meng Chuan in shock. “Killed a fifth Firmament demon monarch?”
Meng Chuan was very famous among Marquis Godfiends. This was because his demon monarch-slaying speed in Chu An City was made public. Godfiends had seen it, and a demon monarch had escaped, so his strength had been exposed.
From then on, everybody knew that Marquis Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, had the strength of a Regis Godfiend! The demons even considered Meng Chuan to have the strength of a top Regis Godfiend.
“Senior Brother Meng.” Yan Chitong looked at Meng Chuan gratefully. “I can’t repay you for your kindness. I can only remember it in my heart.”
“Junior Brother Yan, you wrote a letter to thank me previously. There’s no need for this,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“I really can’t imagine what I’d... If my father died in battle...” Fear still gripped Yan Chitong. He had been extremely talented since he was young, and his personality was very flippant. However, Marquis West Sea was very forgiving towards him. As he grew up, Yan Chitong became even more grateful to his father. Yan Chitong was extremely grateful for Meng Chuan’s help at Eastcalm City.
Xue Feng looked at Meng Chuan with burning eyes. He said, “Senior Brother Meng, do you have time to spar with me?” After all, he only had the strength of a peak Marquis Godfiend. There was a huge gap between him and Meng Chuan.
“Alright, let’s spar when we have time.” Meng Chuan nodded.
As they conversed, King Calm Sea remained sitting there with his eyes closed, not saying a word.
King Calm Sea is way too much of an arrogant loner. I’ve been here for so long, but King Calm Sea only opened his eyes twice. The first time was when he nodded slightly at King True Martial. The second time was when he glanced at his son, Xue Feng. However, he didn’t say a single word. His temper is indeed rather strange. It’s no wonder Yan Jin hates him. He even changed his surname.
Meng Chuan had a good relationship with Yan Jin, so he naturally knew that Yan Jin was estranged from the Xue family. He had even changed his surname.
In the world, some people were separated from their main families, such as Liu Yebai and his daughter, Liu Qiyue. However, very few people changed their surnames! This was because by changing one’s surname, it meant that they didn’t recognize their ancestors. They didn’t believe themselves to be a descendant of their family.
Thus, one had to be very resolute to change their surname. It showed just how estranged Yan Jin was from the Xue Family.
Huh? Meng Chuan, Xue Feng, and Yan Chitong looked ahead. King True Martial smiled, and King Calm Sea also opened his eyes to look.Three figures walked in together; Supremacy Li Guan was in the middle of the trio. An illusory Qin Wu and an illusory Luo Tang stood beside Li Guan.
“Greetings, Master, Supremacies.”
King True Martial, King Calm Sea, Meng Chuan, and the others bowed.
Li Guan smiled and said, “I summoned the five of you here today because I wish to send you all into the World Gap.”
“World Gap?” The five Godfiends present revealed looks of confusion, even King True Martial and King Calm Sea were puzzled. “A World Gap is very unique and rare,” said Li Guan. “In the River of Spacetime, the two worlds are approaching each other slowly. Once they are within a certain proximity of each other, a World Gap will form between the two worlds. This is how two worlds interact when they approach one another. The River of Spacetime is naturally formed; it’s extremely mysterious and shocking. This is the first time in human history that a World Gap has appeared,” said Li Guan. “The two worlds are beginning to overlap in the River of Spacetime?” King True Martial asked, “Master, are you talking about the Demon Realm and the human world?”
“That’s right.” Li Guan nodded. “Although it’s the first time in the history of the human world, human experts have explored the outer realm and have some understanding of World Gaps.”
The three Supremacies did not elaborate on the consequences of a World Gap forming as the two worlds’ connection grew stronger and stronger. More World Entrances would appear, and the situation they faced would become much more serious in the future.
“Although the World Gap has appeared, it is still forming,” said Li Guan.

chapters.title: Chapter 302 - Entering the World Gap
chapters.content:
Chapter 302 Entering the World Gap
“The formation process of a World Gap is very complicated.” Li Guan continued, “The World Gap is warped and folded; its size is extremely vast. According to our observations, it’s likely about 70% the size of the human world.”
“Seventy percent?” Meng Chuan and company were astonished.
“It’s naturally not formed in a day or two. According to human historical records, a World Gap can form in just a few decades; it can even take centuries for it to form completely,” said Li Guan. “As it forms, the River of Spacetime’s power will gradually mold a world. Some ‘magical objects’ will appear. Many of these items can only be found when a world is born.”
Items that only appear when a world is born? King Calm Sea and King True Martial’s hearts stirred. Meng Chuan and the other Marquis Godfiends listened carefully
Qin Wu smiled as well. “The World Gap is a special, distorted region that is forming. The strongest lifeform that can enter is a Regis Godfiend. Creation Supremacies are unable to enter. It is very beneficial to one’s cultivation to witness a world’s birth. Therefore, the demons will definitely send fifth Firmament demon monarchs into the World Gap as well.”
“King True Martial, King Calm Sea, you might encounter demons after you enter. You will need to fend off fifth Firmament demon monarchs,” said the illusory Luo Tang. “You also have to protect the three Marquis Godfiends at the same time. Can you do it?”
“The demon monarch cultivation system is weaker than ours,” said King True Martial with a smile. “If the enemy consists only of fifth Firmament demon monarchs, I have full confidence in protecting two Marquis Godfiends within 25 kilometers of me.”
“I can protect one,” said King Calm Sea.
“King Calm Sea, protect Xue Feng. King True Martial... protect the other two Marquis Godfiends,” said Luo Tang.
King Calm Sea and the King True Martial didn’t refuse. Meng Chuan and company understood that the two Regis Godfiends were responsible for protecting them.
“It is a very rare opportunity to witness the birth of a world,” said Qin Wu. “All of you have to seize the opportunity to cultivate well. If you encounter a rare item that appears during the birth of the world, you should try to snatch it.”
“Yes,” replied the five Godfiends.
“The three Marquis Godfiends can’t be careless,” warned Luo Tang. “It’s likely that the fifth Firmament demon monarchs that enter the World Gap won’t be newly-advanced ones, but those that have cultivated for a long time. The three Marquis Godfiends will enter the World Gap for a year. A year later, King True Martial and King Calm Sea will send the three of you back.”
Meng Chuan and company understood.
Meng Chuan said, “One year, then our missions...” Was his daily underground reconnaissance going to be stopped?
“Your missions have to stop,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “Other Godfiends will take over your missions temporarily. Since we currently have a shortage of Godfiends, only the five of you will be sent in. Otherwise, we would have sent more Godfiends in.”
Qin Wu looked at Meng Chuan. His heart ached for his disciple. This disciple’s saber arts talent was somewhat lacking compared to a peerless genius, but he was extremely diligent and hardworking. He never complained about his long-term daily underground reconnaissance. Furthermore, due to the need to keep it a secret, the outside world did not know of his contributions. Therefore, Qin Wu had pushed for Meng Chuan’s entry into the World Gap. He couldn’t just keep letting him toil without any benefits, right?
“For the next year, all of you will be in the World Gap. If there’s anything you need to prepare, quickly do so. In four hours, I’ll send all of you into the World Gap.” Li Guan waved his hand as five dossiers appeared in front of him. “This is an intelligence dossier regarding the World Gap. You can read it for a better understanding.”
King True Martial, King Calm Sea, Meng Chuan, Xue Feng, and Yan Chitong took the dossiers and began reading.
Meng Chuan wrote letters to his father, wife, and children. After all, his family would be worried if he disappeared for a year without notifying them beforehand.
Four hours later.
The three Supremacies and the five Godfiends stood on one of the nameless mountain peaks of Archean Mountain.
“Although the World Gap is connected to the human world, both regions are obstructed by a world membrane,” said Li Guan. “To enter the World Gap, one has to first break through the human world’s membrane wall, then the World Gap’s membrane wall, creating a temporary passageway. This requires Creation-realm level strength. King True Martial should be able to do it on his own,” said Li Guan with a smile. Following that, he waved his fist and punched the void.
Boom
A burst of gray energy crashed into the barrier in front of them. The space in front of them began to crumble and collapse, revealing a shimmering barrier.
“This is a World Gap’s membrane wall,” said Li Guan with a smile. “It was formed due to the human world and the Demon Realm overlapping. Now, only a portion of the membrane wall has formed; thus, it’s much easier to smash through the membrane wall.”
He waved his hand.
The colorful membrane wall shattered, revealing a 60-foot-wide hole. Through the hole, one could see the world on the other side.
“Enter. The human world’s membrane wall will be restored very soon,” said Li Guan. Qin Wu and Luo Tang watched by the side.
“Let’s go.” King Calm Sea took the lead.
King True Martial released his domain. An invisible fluctuation enveloped Meng Chuan, Xue Feng, and Yan Chitong. They flew into the hole and entered the World Gap.
Demon Realm.
A white-furred lion demon elder stood in a valley and smiled at the three fifth Firmament demon monarchs beside him. “Have you thought it through? You’re likely to encounter human Regis Godfiends in the World Gap. The powers of the Demon Realm can’t help you. You have to deal with problems by yourselves.”
“Demon Sage, we’ve decided. Let us enter.”
“We’ll eat any Regis Godfiends we encounter.”
“Let’s see if Regis Godfiends can fend off my divine powers.”
Greater Demon Monarchs Flood Dragon, Fiery Phoenix, and Ox were very confident. They were fifth Firmament demon monarchs that had cultivated for many years. When the three of them worked together, they even dared to fight a demon sage.
“Alright, I’ll send you in. At least ten greater demon monarchs should’ve entered the World Gap.” The white-furred lion demon elder reached out his hand and grabbed at the shimmering barrier. His fingers transformed into sharp claws that tore through the Demon Realm’s membrane wall. Following that, he tore through the World Gap’s membrane wall, forming a huge hole. Through the hole, one could see the world inside the World Gap.“Thank you, Demon Sage.” The three demon monarchs were overjoyed. They immediately entered the World Gap.
Meng Chuan and company looked at the world in front of them. The 60-foot-wide hole behind them slowly closed.
“This is the World Gap?” Meng Chuan felt his body lighten as an invisible force swept across the world. There was no air. In this environment, mortals’ bodies would probably be destroyed within a few seconds by the invisible force. Meaning Chuan looked around carefully. The distorted sky was dark-red, and one could see many spots of light on the ground.
Oh? Meng Chuan waved his hand, and many beams of light flew towards him. These beams of light were actually gold, silver, gems, ores, etc.
“The birth of a world leaves all kinds of minerals everywhere.” Yan Chitong sighed in amazement. “The description in the dossier is true.”
“These common objects aren’t of much use to us. Let’s go and find a place that’s in the middle of its birth,” said King True Martial with a smile. Gold, silver, and gems were useless to Godfiends. It was only because of their special characteristics that they became currency and used as cash in the mortal world. Godfiends were more concerned about sect credits, heritages, and natural treasures.
Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish!
The five quickly flew through the World Gap.

chapters.title: Chapter 303 - World Rupture
chapters.content:
Chapter 303 World Rupture
Meng Chuan and company flew under the dark-red sky.
“We now have to be careful of the demons.” King True Martial had a mild temper, but the glint in his eyes turned sharper when he mentioned the demons. The demons had brought about too great a calamity to the entire human race. “The three major sects of the human race are busy dealing with the demons’ invasion. Therefore, very few Regis Godfiends are sent into the World Gap,” explained King True Martial. “Archean Mountain only sent our team of five. I reckon that the three great sects only sent three teams in total. However, there will be far more fifth Firmament demon monarchs than us in the World Gap. Although fifth Firmament demon monarchs are unable to enter the human world, they can enter the World Gap.”
Meng Chuan’s heart tightened.
Yes. It was possible for the demons to send more than 100 fifth Firmament demon monarchs into the World Gap. The humans could only afford to send a few Regis Godfiends.
“Once both sides meet, the demons will not show mercy,” said King True Martial. “All you need to do is stay beside King Calm Sea and me. In a life-and-death battle, quantity isn’t always better.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan, Xue Feng, and Yan Chitong nodded.
“Once we fight, just hide under our protection. Don’t charge forward and don’t interfere.” King Calm Sea’s cold voice sounded. “Leave everything to King True Martial and me. You will only be disturbances if you interfere. The fifth Firmament demon monarchs we encounter here are not like the newly-advanced fifth Firmament demon monarchs in the human world.”
“Yes,” replied the three Marquis Godfiends.
Boom!
In the distant sky, a huge rift suddenly appeared. The distorted rift was more than 50 kilometers. Through the huge rift in the sky, Meng Chuan and company could vaguely see a patch of darkness. The darkness made their hearts palpitate.
“The River of Spacetime is beyond the world membrane,” said King True Martial. “If one’s cultivation realm is insufficient, they won’t be able to see the River of Spacetime’s true appearance. Most Regis Godfiends... can only see darkness.”
“The River of Spacetime’s true appearance?” Curious, Yan Chitong asked, “What does it look like?”
Meng Chuan and Xue Feng were also curious.
As King True Martial flew, he smiled and said, “How should I put it? For example, the 500-kilometer area in front of us looks like normal land to you. However, in my eyes, it’s like a thousand-layer cake. Space-time is mysterious. This 500-kilometer area is just a tiny sesame seed on a layer of the thousand-layer cake. We are slowly flying across this sesame seed.” “Thousand-layer cake?” Meng Chuan and company were puzzled.
“King True Martial is indeed extraordinary.” King Calm Sea looked at the King True Martial, his eyes shining. “In my eyes, spacetime is like an endless tidal wave, chaotic and disorderly. The 500-kilometer area is just one wave. In King True Martial’s eyes, spacetime was orderly.”
“Junior Brother Xue, you have only cultivated for such a short period of time, yet you have managed to touch on the Grotto-Heaven profundity. You are really gifted,” said King True Martial with a smile. “You can reach the Creation realm once your Essence Soul breaks through. As for me, I can only cultivate for another 200 years.”
Meng Chuan, Xue Feng, and Yan Chitong were shocked. They were shocked that King Calm Sea only needed his Essence Soul to break through before he could reach the Creation realm. They were also shocked by the duo’s individual descriptions of the River of Spacetime. One said that it resembled endless surging waves, while the other said that it resembled a thousand-layered cake?
“Oh?” Suddenly, King True Martial and King Calm Sea looked into the distant horizon.
Meng Chuan also saw it.
Two streaks of starlight suddenly fell from a distant rift in the sky to the ground.
“It’s a treasure.” King True Martial’s invisible domain enveloped Meng Chuan and company as they rapidly flew towards the spot the two streaks of starlight were falling toward.
King Calm Sea has nearly half my speed. Meng Chuan was being carried along by King True Martial as he pondered King True Martial’s prowess. King True Martial is slower than King Calm Sea when carrying the three of us along. If he acts alone... perhaps he has 60% of my speed?
In terms of speed, he was the best in the world. King Calm Sea and King True Martial were already very fast among Regis Godfiends. In a flash, King Calm Sea could travel about 4 kilometers. Meng Chuan estimated that King True Martial could travel 5 kilometers in a second. Such speeds were near a Creation-realm expert’s.
As a Lightning Devastator Fiend Body Marquis Godfiend, Meng Chuan had a robust foundation. He had reconstructed his body with nine bolts of heavenly lightning. After attaining an Undying Body, he could travel 9 kilometers in a second.
Swoosh.
King Calm Sea waved his hand and caught one of the falling streaks of starlight. King True Martial grabbed the other one.
“Blood Soul Stone?” King Calm Sea looked at the fist-sized, blood-colored stone in his hand.
King True Martial grabbed a slightly larger Blood Soul Stone.
“Two Blood Soul Stones isn’t too bad.” King True Martial smiled at Meng Chuan and company. “You almost never see it in the human world. However, when a world is born, Blood Soul Stones are common. These two Blood Soul Stones can be used as raw materials for the Godfiend Blood Pool. It’s enough for tens of thousands of Godfiends to pass the Life-and-Death juncture.”
“What? Just these two pieces can allow 10,000 Godfiends to pass the Life-and-Death juncture?” Yan Chitong exclaimed.
Meng Chuan and Xue Feng were shocked as well.
“It’s not just the Godfiend Blood Pool that nurtures Godfiends. There are also many other resources,” said King True Martial. “There are tens of thousands of Godfiends in the world now. Only a few thousand have entered the three major sects. To gain powerful Godfiends, one has to nurture geniuses all the way. This consumes way more resources.”
Meng Chuan and company nodded. Meng Chuan thought about what he had consumed. He had consumed pills, spirit fruits, baneful auras, and so on. All of these were much more valuable than what he had used for his breakthrough at the Godfiend Blood Pool.
“However, the Godfiend Blood Pool is also a foundation of the human’s Godfiend cultivation system. Therefore, the value of these two Blood Soul Stones is more than 100 million credits,” said King True Martial with a smile. “This is the first time a World Gap has formed in our human world’s history. What our Archean Mountain wants... isn’t just two Blood Soul Stones.” King Calm Sea nodded slightly. The intelligence they received was much more than the three Marquis Godfiends. They shouldered greater responsibilities and needed to seek out treasures that were even more precious.
Swoosh!
The five continued flying forward. After flying for thousands of kilometers, Meng Chuan and company were somewhat shocked as they took in the scene in front of them.Whoosh! A huge, dark vortex appeared in the distance. The world membrane twisted around the vortex. The further the world membrane was from the vortex, the stabler it became.
The massive dark vortex caused King True Martial to stop and quietly watch. King Calm Sea, Meng Chuan, and company were shocked, but they couldn’t see anything.
King True Martial watched in a daze for a few minutes before coming to his senses. He smiled apologetically and said, “I was distracted. The World Gap is still in its formation phase, and the world membrane here is extending. However, this place is not suitable for your cultivation. Let’s continue.”
The five of them continued flying, far away from the world membrane’s dark vortex.
Another ten minutes passed.
Hua Hua Hua Hua!
The area in the distance was completely fractured! There was no path in front of them, only darkness. In the darkness, one could see purple lightning constantly striking down; it was like a giant tree’s branches but formed out of boundless lightning. It was incomparably astonishing.
When the lightning struck down, black and white streams of energy stirred up dark energy. They transformed into a multi-colored world, which then turned into a colorful world membrane. The world membrane constantly stretched out, and the fractured world was slowly expanding itself. This... Meng Chuan and company were stifled.

chapters.title: Chapter 304 - Cultivation
chapters.content:
Chapter 304 Cultivation
The scene of a world fracturing shocked Meng Chuan. Having not seen it before, Meng Chuan had imagined the birth of a world. However, how laughable was his imagination compared to the scene in front of him? What kind of immense power is this? Meng Chuan watched as the purple lightning struck down from the endless darkness. The purple lightning bared its fangs and brandished its claws. It split the darkness, producing black and white air currents. It also produced the multi-colored energy that formed a world membrane.
This lightning was the power of creation. It could create and destroy worlds.
This strength... Meng Chuan’s heart trembled. He could vaguely sense that the purple lightning in the darkness could probably reduce him to dust. It’s said that lightning is fast, but I never knew it could be so unimaginably powerful. It’s so powerful that it’s soul-shocking. The Heart Intent Saber Art can be considered the best swift saber art in the world. However, it can only be described as swift. In front of this lightning of creation... the Heart Intent Saber Art appears too weak.
Fast and domineering to the extreme. Devastating and fearless. Meng Chuan watched the purple lightning move. He was primarily an artist-an excellent one-and a saber user second. The purple lightning in front of his eye was simply too astonishing and beautiful. Swiftness was just one aspect of its beauty.
The Lightning Devastator Fiend Body only specializes in speed; it gives one very ordinary physical strength. At that moment, Meng Chuan also understood the flaws of the Lightning Devastator Fiend Body and the Heart Intent Saber Art. Only after seeing the sea did he realize how narrow the river he traveled along was.
Only when one’s horizons were broadened would they truly see the path ahead!
At that moment, Meng Chuan was very grateful. He was grateful to his master, Qin Wu, and the other Archean Mountain Supremacies. He was one of the three Archean Mountain Marquis Godfiends—who were escorted by King True Martial and King Calm Sea—that entered the World Gap. If he didn’t have this opportunity, he would’ve never witnessed this scene...
“The birth of a world contains endless mysteries. You can reach the Creation realm if you can just comprehend a little bit,” said King True Martial. “This is a rare opportunity. This is the first time in human history that a World Gap has formed in our human world. You should be the first Marquis Godfiends in human history to see a World Gap.”
Meng Chuan, Xue Feng, and Yan Chitong were all shocked by the scene before them. They could see certain aspects in the World Gap that matched their cultivation path.
They were secretly glad and proud after hearing what King True Martial said. They were indeed the first Marquis Godfiends to see and enter a World Gap in human history.
“Creation Supremacies have to enter the River of Spacetime to search for World Gaps. There, one might not even be able to find a World Gap in the middle of its formation phase,” said King True Martial. “You are seeing something that even Creation Supremacies might not see for their entire lives. Make good use of this opportunity. This place is very suitable for cultivation. We will stay here for a year. You’ll be sent back after a year passes.”
Meng Chuan, Xue Feng, and Yan Chitong nodded.
“Cultivate well. Don’t disturb others,” King Calm Sea said coldly. Following that, he carefully observed the birth of the world.
Eager and infatuated, Meng Chuan and company stared at the shocking scene in front of them.
My saber art isn’t ruthless enough or decisive enough. Therefore... it’s not fast enough! Meng Chuan looked at the dazzling purple lightning in the endless darkness. After the branch-like purple lightning struck down, new bolts of lightning appeared. They continuously tore through the darkness. The lightning’s ruthlessness left Meng Chuan alarmed as it tore through the darkness. This was an extreme resolution, and it caused reckless destruction, but it could give birth to a world! Destruction and creation were just two sides of the same coin.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
One strike after another, Meng Chuan executed Heart Saber Stance over and over again as he pursued the ruthlessness that was contained in the lightning of creation. The Heart Saber Stance was also known as the Saber Drawing Stance. Yin and Yang existed within it. At this moment, he only had one goal—to make his strikes faster, more ruthless, and more resolute! He had to make his strikes be like the purple lightning that split the endless darkness apart.
However...
How can I combine Yin and Yang with such ruthlessness? Meng Chuan wanted to slash out, but he was somewhat unsure about how to proceed. He could see the purple lightning’s appearance, but the true profundities contained within it were things he had to comprehend himself. The purple lightning only guided him in a certain direction, but it never let him see the full path.
Meng Chuan, Yan Chitong, and Xue Feng were engrossed in the various wonders and mysteries of creation. They found their respective directions and cultivated diligently. King True Martial and King Calm Sea were also cultivating.
Although my body has aged, if the Yin-Yang that I cultivate can be improved again, I can greatly increase my vitality with Yin-Yang Reversal. Even with my aging body, I will have a 30% chance of breaking through to the Creation realm. If I cultivate this Yin-Yang to perfection, my youth will return, and I will have a 100% chance of reaching the Creation realm. King True Martial’s eyes were filled with desire.
He knew how difficult this path was. His current technique realm was no less than a Creation Supremacy’s. He did not have much time left to cultivate since he was already 300 years old. Thus, King True Martial originally thought he had no hope of cultivating his Yin-Yang to the point that he could regain his youth. However, now that he was watching the birth of a world, he felt like he had a sliver of hope. This sliver of hope made him go all-out on his cultivation!
The best human techniques are simple and crude. Similarly, the best demon Imperial Lord techniques are also lacking. King Calm Sea narrowed his eyes as he greedily took in the scene of a forming world in front of him. This is what it means to rend the world asunder! This power can rend the world asunder! Only with such strength will my sword be worthy of the name ‘Heavenly Tribulation.’ The two Regis Godfiends and three Marquis Godfiends were immersed in cultivation.
Time passed. In the blink of an eye, more than a month had passed.
Boom!
Explosions sounded from afar, causing spatial fluctuations. This attracted the attention of Meng Chuan and company.
“Oh?” Meng Chuan looked into the distance.
A huge explosion occurred at a world riftthe interface between the endless darkness and the World Gap!
Purple lightning-over 100 times more violent than usual-struck, causing more than ten streaks of starlight to fly out the rift and fall towards the World Gap. The streak of starlight in the lead was the most dazzling. It stirred the Heaven and Earth powers, forming a five-colored belt as it sailed through the sky.
Valuable treasures. King True Martial and King Calm Sea’s eyes lit up. Let’s go!
King True Martial released his domain and carried Meng Chuan and company. King Calm Sea charged forward alone. They had to bring Meng Chuan and company along when they were snatching treasures. Otherwise, once they were separated, Meng Chuan and company might quickly die if they encountered fifth Firmament demon monarchs.
Although Archean Mountain had said that obtaining treasures was very important, Meng Chuan, Xue Feng, and Yan Chitong’s safety took priority. The three of them were the most valued geniuses in recent decades.
Whoosh.
As he flew at high speed, Meng Chuan carefully observed the ten-plus streaks of starlight in the distance, especially the huge streak of starlight in the lead.
“Be careful; there are demons.” King True Martial’s voice suddenly sounded. “They are here because of the treasures.”
Demons? Meng Chuan, Yan Chitong, and Xue Feng’s hearts tightened. This was the first time they were encountering demons since they entered the World Gap over a month ago.

chapters.title: Chapter 305 - I’ll Take You Flying
chapters.content:
Chapter 305 I’ll Take You Flying
Meng Chuan and company carefully looked into the distance. They only saw ten-plus streaks of starlight traveling across the sky at high speed. They didn’t see any demons. “Their concealment techniques are very brilliant,” said King True Martial with a voice transmission. “Even ordinary Regis Godfiends would find it difficult to discover them. However, they won’t be able to escape my detection. If I’m not mistaken, these two demons are Greater Demon Monarch Black Wind and City Lord White Cloud. They are both peak fifth Firmament demon monarchs. They are very famous in the Demon Realm. Be careful later. Don’t take their attacks head-on.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan and company became more cautious.
“King True Martial.” King Calm Sea sent a voice transmission from afar. “The situation isn’t looking good. The demons arrived earlier than us. They are closer to the treasures.”
“In that leading streak of starlight is the legendary Spacetime Floating Ice. It’s extremely useful; we must acquire it,” King True Martial said via voice transmission.
King Calm Sea turned even more solemn as he said, “I understand. Even if the two of them obtain the Spacetime Floating Ice, they can forget about escaping.”
“It’s Spacetime Floating Ice.”
Greater Demon Monarch Black Wind and City Lord White Cloud were hidden in the void as they flew at high speeds. The two of them saw the most dazzling streak of starlight that had caused a five-colored belt to form. They immediately saw a dark, floating ice block, about ten feet in size, inside the streak of light.
“Spacetime Floating Ice is formed only when the River of Spacetime’s powers collide with world creation powers.” City Lord White Cloud was tall and thin. His robes and white hair fluttered. His beautiful face made him look androgynous. “It’s extremely useful to Imperial Lords. As long as we obtain the Spacetime Floating Ice, our trip to the World Gap will be worth it.”
“It’s a pity that we can only use the powers of the Spacetime Floating Ice when we reach the demon sage realm.” Black Wind’s eyes burned with passion. “Even if we bring it back, we would have to hand it over to the Imperial Lords.”
Huh? White Cloud suddenly frowned and looked into the distance.
“What’s wrong?” Black Wind asked with a voice transmission.
“I can sense that there are five more lifeforms in the void with my void divine power. They are also rushing towards the Spacetime Floating Ice,” said White Cloud solemnly via voice transmission. “Furthermore, those five lifeforms are likely humans. Two are Regis Godfiends. The other three are weaker; they are Marquis Godfiends.”
Black Wind knew his good friend’s divine powers very well. “What? Marquis Godfiends dare to enter the World Gap?” Black Wind was surprised.
“It’s obvious that the two Regis Godfiends are very confident,” said White Cloud via voice transmission. “However, we are closer to the Spacetime Floating Ice than them. Let’s take the Spacetime Floating Ice and leave quickly. Those two Regis Godfiends have unfathomable strength. There’s no need for us to take the risk to fight them. Leave the remaining treasures to them.”
Black Wind nodded. “Alright, obtaining the Spacetime Floating Ice would suffice.”
The two of them had reigned supreme in the Demon Realm for centuries and were well-known. However, they were not reckless. They were willing to avoid the human Regis Godfiends after obtaining the Spacetime Floating Ice. After all, they had already seen what was within the remaining ten-plus streaks of starlight. Those treasures in the remaining streaks of starlight were far less valuable than the Spacetime Floating Ice.
Although both parties concealed themselves, they knew of each other’s existence because their reconnaissance methods were impressive.
On the human side, King Calm Sea was the first to fly forward alone. King True Martial flew behind him with the three Marquis Godfiends in a bid to intercept the most dazzling streak of starlight.
“Junior Brother Xue, the two demons are traveling through the void at an extremely fast speed. We are still a lot slower,” said King True Martial via voice transmission.
“Yes.” King Calm Sea’s spatial perception was in no way inferior to City Lord White Cloud’s void divine power. King Calm Sea flew at full speed. How can foolish demons be worthy of Spacetime Floating Ice? King Calm Sea’s eyes were filled with a hint of bloodlust. He wielded a massive sword as he cleaved down furiously.
Bang!!!
The void trembled.
About 50 kilometers away from King Calm Sea, a sword beam suddenly descended. Dozens of sword beams condensed and flew towards an area. Attacking from more than 50 kilometers away? Meng Chuan, who was standing beside King True Martial, was shocked when he saw this scene from afar. At the same time, he could sense the might of the sword beams. It was a move that far exceeded the strength of Archean Mountain Lord’s Archean Combat Body. Even with my Undying Body, King Calm Sea can probably kill me in a few hits.
Whoosh.
Suddenly, a furry, black bear paw appeared in the void. The enormous bear paw was like a small mountain as it swung toward the descending sword beams. Slash! Slash! Slash! Slash! Slash! Slash!
Dozens of sword beams struck the giant bear paw. The paw’s black fur was incomparably tough; every single strand of fur was like a divine armament. The beams struggled to get past the fur. The dozens of sword beams managed to cleave through large amounts of fur and flesh, causing blood to cover the bear paw. A huge wound appeared, but in the blink of an eye, the wound completely healed as the fur grew back.
A towering black bear appeared in the void. The black bear was 1,000 feet tall; it was like a huge mountain in the void. Endless black gases swirled around the bear’s body. The bear’s eyes glowed red as he looked over. “Heavenly Tribulation Sword? So it’s King Calm Sea. I might’ve been afraid of you if you attacked in close-quarters, but are you trying to tickle me by attacking from so far away?”
What a terrifying body. It’s much stronger than my body. Meng Chuan looked at the distant scene and compared himself to his opponent. A peak fifth Firmament demon monarch’s physical body is indeed terrifying.
At the same time, Meng Chuan observed the area carefully. Beside the towering black bear was a handsome white-haired figure with white wings. They were rushing towards the Spacetime Floating Ice rapidly.
These demons. King Calm Sea was furious but helpless. It was already very impressive that he could deliver a strike from 50 kilometers away. However, the attack only had 30 to 40 percent of his maximum strength. It naturally couldn’t do a thing to Black Windwho had an extremely powerful body. Black Wind was rumored to have survived a demon sage’s attack with just his body.
The demons are in that direction. Meng Chuan watched the demon monarchs. Even with King Calm Sea and King True Martial here, we humans are much slower.
The three Marquis Godfiends had to be protected when they were in the World Gap.
Meng Chuan hadn’t thought of attacking, but he could tell that the Spacetime Floating Ice was extraordinary.
“King True Martial, you are too slow. I’ll bring you along with me. Perhaps we can snatch that treasure,” said Meng Chuan via voice transmission.
King True Martial was taken aback as he looked at Meng Chuan. He and King Calm Sea wanted to protect the three Marquis Godfiends in the World Gap. They felt like they had to be careful so that the Marquis Godfiends wouldn’t be implicated when they were fighting peak fifth Firmament demon monarchs. However, King True Martial recalled that his Junior Brother, Meng Chuan, was extremely fast.
King True Martial was stunned for a moment before he immediately sent a voice transmission. “Quick.”
“Let’s go!” Meng Chuan didn’t hesitate at all. He immediately made his Darkstar domain envelop King True Martial, Yan Chitong, and Xue Feng. His speed suddenly increased as he transformed into a bolt of lightning, rushing toward the Spacetime Floating Ice.
Oh? King Calm Sea’s eyes widened. He looked behind him in shock.
A bolt of lightning flew at an unbelievable speed from behind. In just seconds, it surpassed him and flew towards the distant streak of starlight—which formed a colorful belt behind it.
King Calm Sea was a proud person, but the difference in speed couldn’t be denied. At a glance, he could tell that Meng Chuan, King True Martial, Xue Feng, and Yan Chitong were within the bolt of lightning. Despite carrying three other people, Meng Chuan’s speed still exceeded his.
This Meng Chuan’s speed is insane. King Calm Sea felt stifled.

chapters.title: Chapter 306 - Spacetime Scene
chapters.content:
Chapter 306 Spacetime Scene
Not good. On the other side, Greater Demon Monarch Black Wind and City Lord White Cloud flew towards the Spacetime Floating Ice with confidence. But at that moment, they discovered a bolt of lightning rapidly approaching them. Its speed of approach was shocking. “It’s too fast! It’s faster than many demon sages!”
“Good, good.” King True Martial looked delighted. “Junior Brother Meng, good job.”
“Senior Brother, you’re also impressive. My speed isn’t impacted much even though I’m carrying the three of you.” Meng Chuan sighed in amazement. He knew that his speed would greatly decrease when he carried three people. It would be good if he could unleash 50 to 60 percent of his speed—which was still greater than King Calm Sea’s speed by a large margin. However, to Meng Chuan’s surprise, King True Martial’s domain could reduce the impact on his speed due to his high attainments.
Even when carrying the three of them, Meng Chuan didn’t feel much burden. He could unleash up to 80 percent of his normal speed. He could travel 7.5 kilometers in a second.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
With such terrifying speed, Meng Chuan brought King True Martial and company towards the streak of starlight that contained the Spacetime Floating Ice.
“Quick, chase after him!” Black Wind was extremely anxious.
White Cloud shook his head, his eyes filled with helplessness. “We won’t make it in time.”
During critical moments in a battle, one had to rely on teamwork, treasures, and other things. Sometimes, the one with the upper hand might end up suffering, and could even end up losing their lives.
In a race of speed, it was undeniable that the results were unquestionable. Fast meant fast! Slow meant slow!
Like a bolt of lightning, Meng Chuan was just too fast even when carrying three other people! Black Wind and White Cloud immediately understood that the humans would reach the Spacetime Floating Ice first.
They could not catch up!
“The humans have split up. King Calm Sea is behind them. King True Martial is with the three Marquis Godfiends ahead,” White Cloud said via voice transmission. “Let’s rush over and surround King True Martial. Let’s use our divine powers to kill him.
“According to rumors, King True Martial has reached the strength of a weak Creation-realm expert,” said Black Wind via voice transmission.
“Humph.” White Cloud sneered. “They’re just rumors. Has King True Martial ever fought a peak fifth Firmament demon? He defends True Martial Pass and bullies the fourth Firmament demon monarchs that enter. Besides, even if he has the strength of a weak Creation-realm expert, we can still fight him if we join forces. Human bodies are weaker. If we join forces and use our divine powers, we might be able to kill him instantly.”
“Alright.” Black Wind nodded in agreement.
If one’s body was weak, a single mistake in battle could lead to their death. With a strong body, one could afford a few mistakes in battle. Black Wind and White Cloud had impressively strong bodies. They had reigned supreme in the Demon Realm for many years. They had excellent teamwork and rich combat experience.
Meng Chuan approached the streak of starlight with the three other Godfiends in tow.
So beautiful. Meng Chuan stared at the streak of starlight with wide eyes.
Inside the streak of starlight was a ten-foot-wide, dark ice block. Countless scenes surfaced on it. At close proximity, Meng Chuan saw himself appear on the dark ice.
Under the dark sky, a white-haired Meng Chuan sat on a city wall as he drank alone. A man walked over and bowed respectfully. He looked like Meng An, but much more mature.
The white-haired Meng Chuan held Demon Slayer as he stood in the void. He looked coldly at King Calm Sea and said something.
King Calm Sea laughed maniacally.
As soon as Meng Chuan saw the two scenes that featured himself, King True Martial waved his hand, and an invisible power enveloped the Spacetime Floating Ice.
“Retrieve.” King True Martial struggled to store the Spacetime Floating Ice away.
King True Martial looked at Meng Chuan and sent a voice transmission. “Don’t look at the Spacetime Floating Ice. Everyone sees something different from it. I don’t know what you saw, but it’s a different spacetime trajectory. Even a Creation-realm expert can barely use the Spacetime Floating Ice. Such a treasure will only be harmful to you.” Different spacetime trajectory? Meng Chuan pondered the possibilities.
“It’s just a possible future. You don’t have to believe in it.” King True Martial kindly said, “You can pretend that you didn’t see it.”
Meng Chuan pondered. How could he pretend not to see it? It was strange to see himself with white hair. With high attainments in the physical body cultivation system, he could maintain peak lifeforce even when he was at the end of his lifespan, so how could he have white hair? Also, what was going on with him and King Calm Sea?
In that scene, he seemed very powerful. Meng Chuan could vaguely sense that King Calm Sea was stronger than he was now, but in that scene, he appeared to be even stronger?
And An’er. Meng Chuan had seen a mature Meng An. It’s one of the possible spacetime trajectories? It’s just a possibility? Meng Chuan felt a little confused.
When King True Martial saw White Cloud and Black Wind rapidly approaching, he exhorted Meng Chuan, “I can pry into the River of Spacetime. I can tell you that the past can’t be changed, but the future remains unknown.” King True Martial was afraid that Meng Chuan had seen a nightmare-like future and was extremely agitated.
In fact, the scene Meng Chuan saw wasn’t too terrible.
“Senior Brother Meng, what did you see?” Yan Chitong was curious. He and Xue Feng had followed along, but King True Martial had prevented them from seeing the Spacetime Floating Ice. Since Meng Chuan was carrying the three of them to the Spacetime Floating Ice, he naturally couldn’t obstruct Meng Chuan’s vision.
“Nothing.” Meng Chuan temporarily suppressed his emotions when he noticed White Cloud and Black Wind charging over from afar.
“White Cloud Disorder!” White Cloud’s voice sounded out from afar as he spread his white wings.
Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish!
Streaks of white light flew out from White Cloud’s wings; thousands of light streaks came inundating over.
“Interesting.” King True Martial stood there, protecting Meng Chuan, Yan Chitong, and Xue Feng.
An invisible domain enveloped them.
Poof, poof, poof, poof...
The light streaks disintegrated the moment they invaded the domain. Only three feathers managed to escape the fate of disintegration. They flew at high speeds, within the domain, towards King True Martial.
His domain obliterated 9,000 white feathers? White Cloud was alarmed. His White Cloud Disorder used 9,000 white feathers as a cover for the three feathers. It was an attack that mixed the real and the fake, but its might was extraordinary. King True Martial had just destroyed the 9,000 white feathers with just his domain. This greatly decreased the threat of the remaining three feathers—which White Cloud had refined for many years.
Attack.
Die!
Black Wind rushed toward King True Martial with a gust of black wind. White Cloud transformed into a white beam of light as he charged over. After all, they were still demon monarchs; they were best at close combat.
King True Martial watched them calmly.
Swoosh.
King Calm Sea was rapidly rushing over from afar. However, it was obvious that he still needed nine seconds to arrive. He carefully observed King True Martial’s moves.Boom! Boom!
As the two demon monarchs approached, the seemingly gentle-looking King True Martial punched twice.
The first blurry punch struck Black Wind with a gray blur. The second punch similarly struck White Cloud.
He used his fist? Black Wind was a 1,000-foot-tall black bear. He swung his paw, striking the blurry fist. “Ah!” Black Wind roared in pain. A huge hole silently appeared on his paw. His flesh and blood instantly turned to nothingness. After the blurry fist shadow penetrated the bear paw, it reached Black Wind’s head and blasted a hole through it instantly. No blood flowed out. The fist shadow left nothing in its wake.
Black Wind’s powerful body was unable to withstand the punch and was injured severely. The wounds on his head and paw were busy healing.
Meanwhile, White Cloud was about to strike King True Martial with his wings—which were as sharp as divine armaments—when he was struck by the blurry fist. White Cloud’s body was smaller in size, so upon contact with the fist, his entire body—including his wings—was completely pulverized.
Nothing was left behind! He disappeared without a trace! Not even his corpse was left behind! White Cloud, no matter what tricks or divine powers he had, vanished with a single punch!
Is his True Martial Seven Absolutes that powerful? King Calm Sea’s pupils constricted at King True Martial’s display of strength. Although King Calm Sea also had the strength of a weak Creation-realm expert and an inheritance from Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven, King True Martial was publicly recognized to be the strongest Archean Mountain Regis Godfiend. However, it had been a long time since King True Martial had used his full strength. There were simply too few opportunities for him to use his full strength in the human world.

chapters.title: Chapter 307 - Treasure Splitting
chapters.content:
Chapter 307 Treasure Splitting
“Brother White Cloud.” Black Wind was astonished when he saw how the punch had completely pulverized White Cloud. Although White Cloud’s body was not as strong as his, he was still a peak fifth Firmament demon monarch. His feathers could be used as weapons and as a shield. Even a demon sage couldn’t be certain that they could kill him in a single strike.
However, the truth laid before him.
He was vanquished by a human Regis Godfiend in a single punch? Black Wind didn’t know that there were huge strength differences between Regis Godfiends. Some experts could fight those at a higher cultivation realm! Though the founder of the Heart Intent Saber Art, Ancestral Master Guo Ke, was only a Regis Godfiend, he could suppress the Creation Supremacies in his era! Although King True Martial wasn’t at the level of Ancestral Master Guo Ke, he was still extremely terrifying.
Flee! Black Wind no longer had any confidence. Fear filled his heart as he shrank his body without any hesitation. He transformed into a black wind and fled into the distance.
“Do you think you can escape from my domain?” King True Martial smiled.
Whoosh!
A massive Yin-Yang disc—which had a radius of five kilometers—suddenly appeared in front of King True Martial. Previously, Black Wind had closed the gap between him and King True Martial in an attempt to engage in close combat; thus, he was in the range of the Yin-Yang disc. The black-and-white Yin-Yang disc spun, and at the boundary of the disc, blurry gray energy surfaced.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The Yin-Yang disc rotated.
Black Wind felt a terrifying force sweep over him. He tried his best to escape but failed. What power is this? Black Wind struggled with all his might, but he was sucked towards the center of the Yin-Yang disc.
“Wind!” roared Black Wind. The surrounding black winds howled even more maniacally. However, the black winds were torn apart by an invisible force.
“Scram.” Black Wind recovered to his original height—1,000 feet-as blood-colored runes appeared on his body. He resisted the pull of the Yin-Yang disc with his terrifying, mighty body, slowing down his approach to the Yin-Yang disc’s center.
This demon monarch has such a powerful body. King True Martial stood in the same spot and extended his hand. A gigantic gray palm condensed above Black Wind. The huge palm, which had condensed out of thin air, pressed downwards.
“Ah.” Black Wind frantically pushed upwards on the huge palm. However, he cried out in pain when the gigantic palm met his body. He couldn’t withstand the blow and was rapidly sucked into the Yin-Yang disc’s center.
Whoosh.
At the boundary of the Yin-Yang disc, the blurry gray energy engulfed Black Wind completely. Stuck inside it, Black Wind’s body began to crack as the Yin-Yang disc spun. As his body shattered, it recovered at the same time.
“No,” Black Wind tried his best to resist as he punched furiously! His body desperately tried to recover from the damage. However, as the Yin-Yang disc rotated, Black Wind’s body constantly shattered.
The Yin-Yang disc spun seven times. Black Wind’s body had been completely shattered. His flesh pulverized, and his blood evaporated as he died. Some artifacts floated out as a result.
He died just like that? Meng Chuan, Yan Chitong, and Xue Feng were shocked. They could sense how powerful Black Wind’s body was. However, he was forcefully ground to death by the black-and-white Yin-Yang disc. He didn’t have a chance of escaping at all.
Legend has it that King True Martial’s self-created ultimate technique, the True Martial Seven Absolutes, is as strong as a Black Metal Sutra. However, this ultimate technique isn’t perfect enough. King True Martial hasn’t taught it to outsiders. This move should also be from his True Martial Seven Absolutes, right?
Godfiends would typically pen down their ultimate techniques for future generations if they were close to the end of their lifespans, or if they believed their ultimate techniques to have reached sufficient perfection. They usually weren’t in a hurry to impart their ultimate techniques when it was still being improved and worked on.
So powerful. Even King Calm Sea was shocked by King True Martial’s display of power.
He was extremely proud. Why wouldn’t he be proud when he had touched upon the Grotto-Heaven profundity after cultivating for just a century? He originally believed that as a Regis Godfiend with a special heritage, special opportunities, and self-created ultimate techniques, that the gap between him and King True Martial wasn’t huge. However, from the looks of it, he had overestimated himself.
His current realm should have already surpassed King Yanshui. Even if we include the ancient Regis Godfiends that had awoken, I should be one of the best. That was King Calm Sea’s judgment. “Junior Brothers.” King True Martial chuckled as he pointed at the dozen streaks of starlight in the distance. “Whoever snatches those treasures, it will be theirs.”
“Oh?” Meng Chuan, Yan Chitong, and Xue Feng were taken aback, but they quickly chased after the streaks of starlight, leaving behind afterimages of their speeding bodies. King True Martial and King Calm Sea flew to a spot and intercepted the streaks of starlight as well.
After a while, the five of them had all obtained something.
“Just giving each of them one or two would do.” King Calm Sea stood beside King True Martial and calmly said, “Each of them has obtained three treasures, it’s a little too much.”
“They will hand them over to Archean Mountain and exchange them for credits,” said King True Martial with a smile. “Both of us don’t lack credits, but the three of them are still young. Archean Mountain has intentions of nurturing the three of them. It’s only right to give them more credits.”
King Calm Sea nodded slightly.
Meng Chuan and company were somewhat happy as they flew over. They were being protected this time, so they naturally didn’t want to be too greedy. They avoided the most dazzling treasures, and each took three of the remaining treasures.
“Thank you, Senior Brother.” Meng Chuan and company bowed.
King True Martial smiled and said, “If you like something, keep it for yourself. However, you won’t be able to use most of the treasures. You can hand them over to Archean Mountain for credits. In the future, you can exchange for what you need with credits.” Xue Feng and Yan Chitong were more excited. This was because they didn’t contribute much to the human race. Meng Chuan’s contributions to the human race were substantial, so he wasn’t too excited about gaining more credits.
“This time, the Spacetime Floating Ice is the most valuable treasure,” continued King True Martial. “Junior Brother Meng carried me over, so he has rendered great service with his speed. If he hadn’t, the demons would have arrived first... If Junior Brother Xue and I were to chase after them, there might be unexpected variables. Therefore, the credits shall be split equally between Junior Brother Meng, Junior Brother Xue, and me.”
“I only carried you to the treasure,” said Meng Chuan, “You don’t have to give me credit.”King Calm Sea frowned and coldly said, “We succeeded due to your joint efforts. It has nothing to do with me. There’s no need to split the credits with me.”
King True Martial looked at King Calm Sea, smiled, then nodded. “Alright, the credits will be split between Junior Brother Meng and me equally. Junior Brother Meng, there’s no need to say anything more. Credits aren’t of much importance to King Calm Sea and me anymore.”
Meng Chuan didn’t argue further.
“Let’s go there and continue cultivating.” King True Martial pointed at the spot where the purple lightning was most eye-catching.
The five of them rushed over and watched the birth of the world before continuing their cultivation.
“Dad.” Xue Feng came to King Calm Sea’s side. “Feng’er, what’s the matter?” King Calm Sea retracted his gaze from the distant scene of a forming world. He frowned as he looked at his son. With his temperament, he was extremely furious that someone had interrupted his cultivation. However, he had made an exception for his most outstanding son.
“I just obtained three treasures. One of them was something I found special, so I took it.” As Xue Feng spoke, he took out a large box from his storage bag. He opened the box, revealing an ice lotus flower inside. Flames flickered on the ice lotus flower’s pistil. “I can sense that its ice and fire powers come from the same source. They are extremely mysterious. Is it suitable for Seventh Brother’s cultivation?”
“Your seventh brother?” King Calm Sea looked at the ice lotus flower.

chapters.title: Chapter 308 - Xue Feng’s Request
chapters.content:
Chapter 308 Xue Feng’s Request
Xue Feng nervously looked at his father. After Yan Jin ran away from home and changed his surname, he didn’t know how his father would treat his younger brother.
Yes, he did not know. For the past few years, apart from cultivating and guarding Calm Sea Pass, his father had almost zero interest in anything else. He treated all his children equally, almost ignoring them completely! He couldn’t be bothered with his children when they tried to please him. Yan Jin had already run away from home and changed his surname, but King Calm Sea still couldn’t be bothered with him. King Calm Sea favored Xue Feng a little because he was much more outstanding than his other siblings. However, he only favored him a little.
According to what Xue Feng had heard, when the demons invaded Eastcalm City, King Calm Sea’s Heavenly Tribulation Sword appeared and saved Eastcalm City. According to Xue Feng’s judgment, the fact his father had left a sword mark on his younger brother—which ended up saving him-meant that he wasn’t heartless.
“It’s very suitable for your seventh brother,” said King Calm Sea before returning to look at the forming world that stood in the distance.
“Thank you, Dad. I’ll take my leave.” Xue Feng was overjoyed. He bowed respectfully and obediently retreated.
King Calm Sea watched the forming world before immersing himself in his cultivation.
Meng Chuan watched the purple lightning brandish and flail its claws as it tore through the endless darkness. The purple lightning’s stunning beauty attracted him. He also practiced his saber art over and over again.
His Essence Soul realm was very high. He had long obtained a fourth-level Essence Soul. He was in no way inferior to King Calm Sea and the other Regis Godfiends.
