However, he improved slowly in regards to his technique realm. Meng Chuan also knew his shortcomings, so he worked harder in this aspect of cultivation.
I hope that I can reach the Dharma Domain realm when I attain a fifth-level Essence Soul. That way, I’ll be able to cultivate my body to the Blood Droplet realm. My body will be stronger than Greater Demon Monarch Black Wind’s, and my electromagnetic domain will have a larger range. I’ll probably be able to kill more than 1,000 demon monarchs per day when I conduct underground reconnaissance with my improved scouting range. I’ll be able to turn the tides of this war single-handedly.
He alone could affect the war’s outcome. How incredible was it for a single person to kill more demon monarchs than all the other Godfiends in the world combined? However, that was how the world of cultivation was. The strength of an individual surpassed the masses!
A human Imperial Lord could end the war completely by themselves. An expert with an eighth-level Essence Soul could also end the war.
Meng Chuan knew very well that his technique realm improvement speed was very slow. He had a slim chance of reaching the Creation realm in his lifetime. Even if he really broke through, he would probably be around 400 to 500 years old. As for an eight-level Essence Soul? He currently had a fourth-level Essence Soul. He was still very far away from attaining an eighth-level Essence Soul. It was still questionable whether he could achieve these two goals.
Therefore, his most important goal was to reach the Blood Droplet realm.
At the Blood Droplet realm, his body would be stronger than that of Greater Demon Monarch Black Wind. His vitality would be even more terrifying.
For example, King True Martial’s Yin-Yang disc spun seven times before killing Black Wind. If it were a Blood Droplet realm expert, he would be able to recover from the injuries inflicted by the Yin-Yang disc instantly. He might not even suffer any damage. Combined with his speed as a Lightning Devastator Fiend Body Regis Godfiend, Meng Chuan would be a nightmare for the demons in the future.
I have to strengthen myself as quickly as possible. I only have Greater Mastery of Saber Dao. I need to reach the peak of Saber Dao first. Meng Chuan patiently cultivated his saber arts. Suddenly sensing something, Meng Chuan stopped cultivating his saber arts and turned to look.
Xue Feng walked over. “Senior Brother Meng.”
“Junior Brother Xue, what’s the matter?” asked Meng Chuan.
“There’s something I need your help with,” said Xue Feng.
“Pray tell.” Meng Chuan was curious.
Xue Feng took out a wooden box from his storage bag. He opened the wooden box, revealing the mysterious ice lotus flower inside. Flames flickered at the ice lotus flower’s pistil. Xue Feng said, “Senior Brother Meng, I request you to help me hand this ice lotus flower over to my seventh brother, Yan Jin.”
“Hand it to Yan Jin?” Meng Chuan smiled. “You can give it to him directly.”
“My seventh brother hates the Xue family,” Xue Feng explained softly, “Although his attitude towards me is slightly better, he will be unwilling to accept a valuable treasure from me. With his temper, he will never accept treasures from the Xue family.”
“Oh.” Meng Chuan nodded slightly. He knew that Yan Jin was hostile towards the Xue family. Even though Xue Feng tried to please his younger brother time and time again, Yan Jin remained relatively cold towards him.
“When you hand it to him, tell him it was from you. Don’t say that it was from me,” Xue Feng said. “You’re his best friend, having known him from your teenage days. He also recognizes you as his best friend and will accept it if you give it to him. He won’t accept it if it’s from me.”
Meng Chuan looked at the ice lotus flower. This was one of the dozen treasures in the streaks of starlight. It was an item produced during the formation of a world. The ice and fire powers of the ice lotus flower came from the same source. It was indeed extremely profound. From Meng Chuan’s point of view, it was probably worth tens of millions or even 100 million credits.
“Sorry to trouble you, Senior Brother Meng. I will definitely remember your help.” Xue Feng looked at Meng Chuan expectantly.
Meng Chuan had mixed feelings. At the very least, as an elder brother, Xue Feng treated his younger brother very well.
Meng Chuan nodded. “Alright, I’ll help you pass it to him.”
“Please tell him it was from you, Senior Brother Meng,” exhorted Xue Feng again, “Don’t mention my name at all. Otherwise, it will all be for naught.”
“Don’t worry.” Meng Chuan nodded and reached out to take the box. He then smiled and said, “As an elder brother, you’re really worried about Yan Jin.”
“The Xue family owes him too much,” said Xue Feng helplessly. “I won’t disturb your cultivation any longer, Senior Brother Meng.”
Meng Chuan stored the box into his Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead and watched Xue Feng leave.
Xue Feng has the best temper in the Xue family. Yan Jin is cold on the outside but warm on the inside. As for King Calm Sea... Meng Chuan frowned slightly. He couldn’t forget the scenes he saw in the Spacetime Floating Ice. The white-haired Meng Chuan and King Calm Sea were clearly enemies and not friends.
In the future, I might become enemies with King Calm Sea? Archean Mountain Godfiends should be united against the demons. Why would I become enemies with him?
After seeing the scenes, Meng Chuan naturally became wary of King Calm Sea. Following that, he didn’t think too much of it and continued cultivating.
Days passed. In the blink of an eye, more than two months had passed since Meng Chuan and company arrived at the World Gap.
Boom!
Yan Chitong stood in the same spot. The spear in his hand transformed into thousands of spear shadows as he thrust out. Each spear shadow burned with flames. The attack was so sharp that it caused the void to distort. The flames blotted out a few kilometers of the sky. It was terrifying.
“Oh?” Meng Chuan, Xue Feng, King True Martial, and King Calm Sea turned to look.
A breakthrough? Meng Chuan was surprised. He had often watched Yan Chitong cultivate over the past two months, so he was very familiar with Yan Chitong’s spearmanship. He probably had Greater Mastery of Spear Dao. However, the might of the spear attack he had just executed was clearly much greater than before. It was much more exquisite.
Yan Chitong was also delighted.
“You cultivate the Two World Divine Body, but your spear arts are beginning to follow the Extreme Fire lineage?” asked King True Martial.
Yan Chitong immediately said, “Yes. After all these years, I’ve realized that cultivating both fire and water is not very suitable for me. However, I’ve been hesitating all this while. When I came to the World Gap and saw the forming world, I realized that the Extreme Fire lineage would provide me a similarly bright future. I decided to follow the Extreme Fire lineage completely! I immediately felt much more comfortable cultivating. I’ve just broken through to the peak of the Realm of Dao.
“Haha, that’s right. The path created by Grandsire Yin Yang isn’t necessarily the most perfect.” King True Martial laughed. “What’s most important is that it suits you. It seems that you have already found your own path.”

chapters.title: Chapter 309 - The Sect Cornerstone Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 309 The Sect Cornerstone Technique
“Yes.” Yan Chitong nodded excitedly. He had given up on cultivating both fire and water. Instead, he chose to focus on fire. He was also under mental pressure. Now that he had obtained the approval of King True Martial, Yan Chitong was naturally excited. Because in this era, King True Martial was most qualified to comment on Grandsire Yin Yang’s cultivation lineage.
King True Martial similarly cultivated the Two World Divine Body and followed Grandsire Yin Yang’s cultivation path. However, after he broke through, he used Yin-Yang as his foundation and established his own True Martial lineage. His True Martial lineage’s combat strength was even stronger, and people recognized him as the strongest Archean Mountain Regis Godfiend. Even in secret, Archean Mountain’s Supremacies immediately decided that even if King True Martial couldn’t become a Creation Supremacy, he would definitely become a Dao Protector.
Archean Mountain always had two Dao Protectors.
“Cultivate well. You’re 46 years old this year, and you’ve reached the peak of the Realm of Dao. That’s still a rather young age,” said King True Martial with a smile. “However, it will be even harder for you to reach the Dharma Domain realm. It’s best if you can reach the Dharma Domain realm within 30 years. Attain a third-level Essence Soul before you turn 90 and become a Regis Godfiend.” “There’s still 40 years left.” Yan Chitong was filled with battle intent.
“To you, time is still a little tight. You can’t slack off,” instructed King True Martial before looking at Meng Chuan and Xue Feng. “Both of you too. Hurry up and cultivate. The demons haven’t left much time for us humans.”
Meng Chuan, Yan Chitong, and Xue Feng nodded.
Marquis Godfiends had 300-year lifespans. A 90-year-old Marquis Godfiend was equivalent to a 30-year-old mortal! A typical Marquis Godfiend maintained peak lifeforce before the age of 90. After 90 years of age, the probability of a Marquis Godfiend becoming a Regis Godfiend would slowly decrease. The older one was, the faster the likelihood of them becoming a Regis Godfiend would decrease. A 150-year-old Marquis Godfiend would have very low chances of breaking through to the Seamless realm.
A third-level Essence Soul, the Dharma Domain realm, and one’s age were the three thresholds for becoming a Regis Godfiend. However, Meng Chuan’s physical body cultivation system was very special. Even when he neared the end of his lifespan, his body would still maintain peak lifeforce. One had to depend on luck to obtain this physical body legacy from Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven. Furthermore, this physical body cultivation system had strict requirements on one’s Essence Soul.
In the days to come, they continued cultivating. Occasionally, treasures would descend, but they never encountered treasures like the Spacetime Floating Ice again.
One day-half a year after Meng Chuan and company entered the World Gap.
“Golden Wind Fusion as Black Sand. Gold. Extreme Yang. Wind. Takes the form of the shadow.” Xue Feng muttered to himself. He held his sword as he executed his sword techniques. Each strike was originally ordinary, but they gradually caused the surrounding void to tremble. Huh? Meng Chuan, who was cultivating, was alarmed by the trembling void and ground. What’s going on? Meng Chuan looked for the source of the phenomena.
It was Xue Feng, who was practicing his sword art. Xue Feng’s entire body emitted black light. The black light within Xue Feng’s became even denser. Endless black light scattered in all directions. This was a very strange scene. Black light scattered in all directions, enveloping the sky and earth.
The black light enveloped everything within a five-kilometer radius of Xue Feng as the void trembled.
Meng Chuan, Yan Chitong, King True Martial, and King Calm Sea had domains protecting them, preventing the black light from affecting them.
It’s the Fifteen Golden Wind Swords from Black Sand Grotto-Heaven. Meng Chuan quickly recognized the sword art and was even more shocked. Xue Feng actually mastered this secret art? As an Archean Mountain disciple, he had managed to master Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s most difficult ultimate technique?
“Feng’er?” King Calm Sea was also astonished. He was extremely proud. He thought nothing of most Regis Godfiends in the world. Although he slightly favored his most outstanding son, Xue Feng, he didn’t care too much about him. No matter how outstanding he was, he was inferior to himself. However, King Calm Sea now realized that his son’s talent was in no way inferior to his.
“In Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s Black Sand lineage, Fifteen Golden Wind Swords is the most difficult ultimate technique to cultivate,” said King True Martial with a smile as he came to King Calm Sea’s side. “Black Sand Grotto-Heaven is split into three lineages. The Grand Yin lineage and the Halberd lineage are both branch lineages. The sect master’s Black Sand lineage is the main lineage. When a Regis Godfiend masters the core arts-Black Sand Fiend Body and Fifteen Golden Wind Swords—they can become the sect leader and obtain Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s mysterious Imperial Lord heritage. Junior Brother Xue, if your son were in Black Sand Grotto-Heaven, they would definitely be ecstatic.”
“Yes.” King Calm Sea stared at his son, who was practicing his swordplay.
“The three major sects exchange Black Metal Sutras with each other,” said King True Martial wistfully. “However, each sect has a core ultimate technique. Two World Island’s core ultimate technique is the Yin-Yang Art matched with the Two World Divine Body. Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s core ultimate technique is Fifteen Golden Wind Swords matched with the Black Sand Fiend Body. Archean Mountain’s core ultimate technique is the Five Directions Palm matched with the Archean Divine Body.”
There were many Black Metal Sutras in human history, but most of them were at the Creation level. Only a few were at the Imperial Lord level. For example, the Yin-Yang Art-created by Grandsire Yin Yang
—was at the Imperial Lord level. Fifteen Golden Wind Swords was also at the Imperial Lord level. Likewise for the Five Directions Palm.
The Heart Intent Saber Art—which Meng Chuan cultivated-only had one move that reached the Imperial Lord level—the Heart Saber Stance. All the other moves were at the Creation Level. Therefore, the Black Metal Sutra was considered to be at the half-step Imperial Lord level. Humans had very few Imperial Lord-level ultimate techniques. It was very difficult for them to achieve anything significant.
For instance, Archean Mountain Lord cultivated multiple Black Metal Sutras—the Archean Combat Body, Five Directions World, and the Archean Seal Art. However, he had yet to master Five Directions Palm! Therefore, although he was an Archean Mountain Regis Godfiend, he usually handled secular matters and wasn’t famous for his combat strength.
“The human race’s strongest ultimate technique is Samsara Divine Body matched with Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s ultimate technique, Samsara,” said King True Martial. “The second strongest would be the core ultimate techniques of the three major sects. Xue Feng mastered Fifteen Golden Wind Swords the moment he reached the Dharma Domain realm. Your son is truly impressive, Junior Brother Xue.”
King Calm Sea nodded slightly without saying a word.Xue Feng only stopped after practicing for a while. He quickly recovered his lucidity after awakening from his epiphany. “Senior Brother Xue, congratulations,” said Yan Chitong with a smile. Meng Chuan, King True Martial, and King Calm Sea also walked over.
Xue Feng was overjoyed. “I didn’t expect to make a breakthrough just like that.”
“It’s said that Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s Black Sand lineage has many secret heritages that can assist with one’s cultivation,” said Yan Chitong with a smile. “However, no Regis Godfiend in this generation has mastered the Fifteen Golden Wind Swords and the Black Sand Fiend Body. Senior Brother Xue relied on just the Black Metal Sutra’s intent guidance to master it by himself. I’m afraid that Black Sand Grotto-Heaven Godfiends will be extremely envious.”
“If you were in Black Sand Grotto-Heaven, you might have a chance of becoming an Imperial Lord.” King True Martial sighed.
“Imperial Lord is just an ephemeral concept. It’s been many years since the human race has produced an Imperial Lord.” Xue Feng shook his head. “I don’t dare to imagine becoming one.”
King True Martial said, “If you were in Black Sand Grotto-Heaven, you would have a much higher chance of becoming a Creation Supremacy. After news of you mastering the Fifteen Golden Wind Swords spreads, I think that Black Sand Grotto-Heaven will try to recruit you...” “I won’t betray Archean Mountain.” Xue Feng shook his head.
“Not in the past, but it’s possible now that we are facing the demon threat.” King True Martial smiled. “Of course, this is a matter between two sects. First, the sect has to agree, and secondly, it’s your own decision.”
King Calm Sea looked at his son from the side like this was the first time he saw his son.

chapters.title: Chapter 310 - Indulgence
chapters.content:
Chapter 310 Indulgence
Meng Chuan watched from the side. This is the cultivation speed a peerless genius should possess. Junior Brother Yan is five years younger than me, but he reached the peak of the Realm of Dao before I did. Junior Brother Xue Feng is five years older than me, and he has already reached the Dharma Domain realm. As for me, I’m still stuck at Greater Mastery of Saber Dao.
Upon realizing the gap between them, Meng Chuan didn’t wallow in his mediocrity.
There were billions of people in the world. There were gifted talents in every generation. Nobody could surpass everyone in every aspect. It was good to realize one’s strengths and weaknesses. His strength laid in his Essence Soul cultivation talent. His weakness was the slow improvement of his technique realm. However, he was only slightly slower than Xue Feng and Yan Chitong.
It doesn’t matter if I improve my technique realm slowly. As long as I train diligently, I’ll be able to cultivate to the Blood Droplet realm once I attain a fifth-level Essence Soul and reach the Dharma Domain realm. When I reach the Blood Droplet realm, I’ll be able to kill more than ten times as many demon monarchs as I can now. I will single-handedly surpass the efficiency of all the Godfiends in the world. By then, I’ll be the greatest contributor!
When he reached the Blood Droplet realm, it would be his most dazzling moment.
As for being more dazzling? That was very difficult. An expert with a seventh-level Essence Soul could also help the human race with the war. However, they wouldn’t be as useful as an expert with an eighth-level Essence Soul; they could end the war by themself. With his talent, Meng Chuan was confident of attaining a seventh-level Essence Soul. It was relatively unlikely for him to attain an eighth-level Essence Soul. Even if he were to succeed, he would probably take hundreds or even thousands of years. Would the demons let the humans survive for so long?
I can hunt down all the demon monarchs in the human world once I reach the Blood Droplet realm. If I kill enough demon monarchs, I can affect the war outcome. Who knows, we might win. If we win... the world will be at peace. That would be great. I can accompany Qiyue and live a carefree life. Meng Chuan revealed a smile. This was the comfortable life he wanted.
Although he had sworn to kill all the demons in the world since he was young and was willing to risk his life for it, what he truly yearned for the most was world peace.
Continue cultivating. Meng Chuan brandished his saber as he turned his head to look at the dazzling purple lightning that tore through the darkness.
From afar, King True Martial looked at Meng Chuan, who was beginning to cultivate again. He nodded inwardly. He isn’t affected by external events. He diligently cultivates, so it’s no wonder he possesses the strength of a peak Regis Godfiend at such a young age.
King True Martial knew very well how important one’s state of mind was. Some people were innately talented. They were euphoric when they attained success, but they often compared themselves to their peers once they fell behind. When one was young, being competitive was a good thing. However, it wasn’t a good thing for true peerless experts to compare themselves with others. A calm heart was more advantageous for cultivation. A calm heart was like a mountain. No matter whether one was in a positive or negative state, they could advance at the fastest speed possible, surpassing their former selves.
This Meng Chuan’s talent is the worst among the three. King Calm Sea took a glance and ignored him. He even neglected the achievements of his son, Xue Feng, so he naturally didn’t care about Meng Chuan.
In his heart, there was only cultivation. He had cultivated for many years and only believed in one thing-relying on oneself was better than relying on others! He abandoned everything that could affect him and focused all his attention on cultivation. If it weren’t for his resolute attitude, he wouldn’t have touched upon the Grotto-Heaven realm after just a hundred years of cultivation. At the same age, King True Martial was inferior to King Calm Sea.
After nine months in the World Gap, Meng Chuan still diligently practiced his saber art.
The distant purple lightning was like a tree. The scene of countless lightning bolts snaking through the darkness was shockingly beautiful. Even after watching it over and over again, Meng Chuan remained stunned by its beauty.
Immersed in that beauty, he constantly practiced his saber art.
Whoosh.
With a slash of his saber, spatial ripples parted and formed a dazzling bolt of lightning
Oh? This strike attracted the attention of Yan Chitong, Xue Feng, King True Martial, and King Calm Sea. At their level, they were very sensitive to their surroundings. Meng Chuan had been practicing his saber art for a long time. When his saber art underwent a qualitative transformation, he naturally couldn’t hide it from the four of them.
“Congratulations, Senior Brother Meng.” Yan Chitong walked over with a smile. Xue Feng also walked over.
Besides cultivating, they would often spar.
The outcome of the spars...
They were always thrashed by Meng Chuan!
Meng Chuan’s saber art was too fast and too ferocious! Meng Chuan didn’t use his Essence Soul mystic techniques, divine powers, and baneful aura domain. However—with just his Undying Body’s strength and unparalleled speed-Meng Chuan had forced Yan Chitong and Xue Feng to acknowledge that they had lost fair and square. Every time, Meng Chuan’s saber would easily wind up beside Yan Chitong and Xue Feng’s necks.
Meng Chuan was much stronger than Yan Chitong and Xue Feng. After all, he had the strength of a top Regis Godfiend. Even Xue Feng only had the strength of a weak Regis Godfiend.
“Senior Brother Meng’s saber is getting faster and faster. It’s becoming harder to defend against his attacks.” Xue Feng shook his head.
“Senior Brother Xue, when you become a Regis Godfiend and have the Seamless domain, your Quintessential Essence will transform. Perhaps you can block it then,” joked Yan Chitong. Xue Feng smiled and said nothing more.
Marquis Purple Rain was an old Marquis Godfiend who had long reached the Dharma Domain realm. He had deep foundations and had strength comparable to ordinary Regis Godfiends, but he still died to a fifth Firmament demon monarch. Meng Chuan had killed that fifth Firmament demon monarch in question.
Xue Feng knew the difference in strength between them. I was able to master Fifteen Golden Wind Swords because I had a fortuitous encounter. Curious,Xue Feng looked at Meng Chuan. Meng Chuan’s technique realm clearly isn’t high, yet he has the strength of a top Regis Godfiend. He probably also had some special fortuitous encounters.
He could only guess because he didn’t know about Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven’s existence.
In the past eight hundred years, Archean Mountain had only let five disciples enter Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven-King True Martial, King Calm Sea, and Meng Chuan had all entered. King True Martial walked over as well. He knew very well that Meng Chuan was the most important to the sect and the human race! Before entering the World Gap, the three Supremacies had secretly told King True Martial: “If any accidents happen in the World Gap, protect Meng Chuan at all costs.”
“At all costs?” King True Martial was shocked.
“We gave Meng Chuan a life-saving item, but it’s useless in the World Gap. Therefore, you have to look after him. When he becomes a Regis Godfiend, he can hunt down demon monarchs at a speed that surpasses all the Godfiends in the world.” “Oh? Even if I lose my life, I will ensure Junior Brother Meng’s safety.” Since King True Martial had promised to do so, he had always kept Meng Chuan close after entering the World Gap and meeting the demons.
King True Martial walked over to Meng Chuan, Yan Chitong, and Xue Feng. He smiled and said, “Congratulations, Junior Brother Meng. Do you have any ideas on how you will achieve a breakthrough to the Dharma Domain realm?”
“It will be difficult.” Meng Chuan shook his head. “After witnessing the birth of a world, I now have direction. However, I’m even more puzzled. I’m still perplexed on how to walk this path.”
“Take your time. It’s very difficult to go from the peak of the Realm of Dao to the Dharma Domain realm to begin with.” King True Martial consoled him. Then, he looked at Yan Chitong and Xue Feng. “Don’t slack off either. Xue Feng, your Essence Soul cultivation speed is too slow. As for Junior Brother Yan... your Dharma Domain and Essence Soul are both lacking.”
Yan Chitong lowered his head obediently. “Yes, I’ll keep it in mind, Senior Brother.”
As they chatted, King Calm Sea glanced at them before continuing his cultivation. He ignored them once again.
Days passed.
It was already their tenth month in the World Gap. Meng Chuan watched the forming world in confusion. How do I reach the Dharma Domain realm? I don’t understand at all. How do I combine Yin and Yang? Forget it. Even with the World Gap’s opportunities, I still spent more than ten years to reach the peak of Saber Dao. It might take me another 50 years to reach the Dharma Domain realm. Meng Chuan deduced the time he would take to reach the Dharma Domain realm by comparing the cultivation speed of other Godfiends in history. This was a rational judgment. I’ve been cultivating for so long. I’ll indulge myself for the last two to three months. Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up. He couldn’t take it anymore.
He waved his hand.Whoosh.
A boulder appeared beside him. It was taken out from his Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh! His Darkstar domain sliced through the boulder, producing a table and a stone stool.
Meng Chuan sat on the stone stool and looked at the smooth table. He nodded in satisfaction. With a wave of his hand, a paintbrush and scroll appeared on the table. Before he had entered the World Gap, he painted almost every day. No matter how long his daily underground reconnaissance took, he had to paint-even if he needed to sacrifice his sleeping time. Painting was what he enjoyed the most. He hadn’t painted since he entered the World Gap, so he could no longer resist the urge.
Most importantly...
The birth of a world is beautiful. It would be a pity if I didn’t paint this memorable scene. Meng Chuan took a deep breath and began to mix the paint. However, his eyes were filled with excitement as he watched as the world formed.
What is Senior Brother Meng doing? Yan Chitong watched in a daze. Meng Chuan had produced a table and stool out of thin air, as well as brush and paper. He was even mixing paint.
What is he doing? King True Martial and Xue Feng were also stunned. King Calm Sea stole a glance and frowned, also revealing a look of confusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 311 - Drawing “Lightning”
chapters.content:
Chapter 311 Drawing “Lightning”
Although everyone was astonished, looking at Meng Chuan’s stance, drawing table, stool, paper, brush, and palette, it was obvious he was planning on painting.
Cultivation time in the World Gap is precious. Why isn’t Senior Brother Meng seizing the opportunity to cultivate? Why is he painting in the World Gap? Yan Chitong was puzzled.
To let his hair loose so easily, it’s no wonder his skill level is the lowest of the three Marquis Godfiends. King Calm Sea looked down on people who didn’t cherish time the most. He cherished time very much. Apart from diverting his attention to guard the city pass, he spent most of his time cultivating. When he saw Meng Chuan wasting so much time in the World Gap, he naturally felt disdain.
King True Martial was also somewhat astonished. King Calm Sea and I were only ordered to protect the three of them for a year. A year later, King Calm Sea and I will spend more time searching for treasures. In this one year... he’s actually spending time painting? I don’t understand this Junior Brother Meng of mine.
Meng Chuan was good at painting. He could seek answers from his inner self when he was painting. Few people in Archean Mountain knew about this. Though Archean Mountain Lord—who had fought Meng Chuan head-on
-knew that Meng Chuan had a fourth-level Essence Soul, he didn’t know that Meng Chuan had relied on his painting skills to seek answers from his inner self.
They didn’t agree with Meng Chuan’s actions. From the Godfiends’ point of view, the cultivation opportunity of viewing the birth of a world was extremely precious. To paint instead of cultivating? He was too indulgent.
However, nobody lectured Meng Chuan when they saw him painting. After all, they were fellow disciples. Meng Chuan also had the strength of a top Regis Godfiend. He wasn’t a child, so there was no need for them to lecture him.
As Meng Chuan sat on the stool, the World Gap trembled. Meng Chuan had mixed his paint and was about to move his brush when he looked up at the purple lightning hesitantly.
The purple lightning was domineering and dazzling. Electric snakes spread out like branches of a massive tree as they tore through the darkness, bringing with it the beginning of a world.
How should I paint this? Meng Chuan held the brush in his hand and hesitated. The lightning in the River of Time and Space is too vast. It’s thousands of times more shocking than the ordinary lightning in the human world. It’s impossible to paint it out completely with just a brush.
Meng Chuan’s talent in painting was much higher than his talent with saber arts. He had long surpassed the level where one’s paintings had superficialities. When he was young, Meng Chuan had already condensed his Essence Soul by painting People Resonance. With his painting skills, he would naturally direct his efforts on purple lightning’s essence if he wanted to paint it.
The essence of lightning...
I’m a Marquis Godfiend. The River of Spacetime is nothing but darkness in my eyes. The purple lightning I see might only be a part of its true form. Meng Chuan knew his limitations well. Even then, the portion I can see is already extremely vast. I have no choice but to split it up if I want to paint it. Meng Chuan naturally had his solutions to the problem, being the master artist he was. I’ll divide the purple lightning’s essence into several paintings. Each painting will focus on one aspect of the purple lightning.
The first painting shall focus on the lightning’s destructive powers. Meng Chuan raised his head and carefully observed the purple lightning that lit up the endless darkness.
He viewed the lightning very differently from when he previously practiced his saber art. This time, he observed the lightning purely from an artistic angle. He mainly observed the lightning’s destructive powers.
The lightning’s destructive powers have to be drawn from different angles... Meng Chuan shook his head gently. The more he looked at the purple lightning, the more beautiful it appeared. However, it was truly difficult to paint it. Meng Chuan struggled with it.
Meng Chuan finally began painting. The first painting contained purple lightning snakes. Meng Chuan was very careful as he drew them. The purple lightning snakes were connected to each other, merging together as their power constantly accumulated.
ere
as
Meng Chuan was completely immersed in the first painting. He drew 3,000 detailed lightning snakes. The purple lightning snakes formed a huge lightning tree. It took him a day and a half to finish this painting.
The first painting is completed. Meng Chuan wrote the name of the painting on the upper-right corner of the scroll—Endless Form of Destruction.
Despite being awake for a day and a half, Meng Chuan still felt spirited. His Essence Soul emitted a spiritual glow. Painting the lightning snakes had clearly caused his Essence Soul to transform slightly. Meng Chuan didn’t mind it. It was very difficult to attain a fifth-level Essence Soul.
My Endless Form of Destruction has exhausted all my painting skills. Meng Chuan looked up. The purple lightning snakes gathered endlessly, forming a terrifying might that left one alarmed. Meng Chuan had reached his painting skills’ limit.
Meng Chuan put away the first scroll and placed a new scroll on the table. He then began the second painting.
A bolt of lightning began to appear on the scroll. Lightning struck! It pierced through the layers of darkness! This painting was a scene of a bolt of lightning piercing through the endless darkness. However, Meng Chuan’s brush strokes were very thin. The lightning bolt was like a spear that pierced through the layers of darkness. Every time it pierced through a layer, the lightning bolt would dissipate. The lightning’s powers would then gather before smiting the next layer of darkness.
The second painting took Meng Chuan nearly a day to finish. Meng Chuan wrote the name on the upper-left corner-Perfect Harmonization Form of Destruction.
Meng Chuan painted without rest. In fact, King True Martial, Sea King Calm Sea, Xue Feng, and Yan Chitong didn’t sleep or rest either. At their level, eating, drinking, and sleeping wasn’t important. They could sate their thirst by absorbing water from the world.
Days passed.
Meng Chuan completed one painting after another. Each painting was completely different. The emotions in each painting were different. They either made one feel hope, despair, or a sense of fear...
Nirvana Form of Life... Selfless Form of the Void... The Nine Heavenly Forms of the Void... Wave Splitting Forms of Lightning...
Each painting depicted the purple lightning in different ways.
Yes, it should be elegant and unrestrained.
Half a month later, Meng Chuan continued to paint happily. Lightning bolts slithered around the scroll like dragons and snakes. When the last stroke was finished, Meng Chuan felt delighted. This was the last of his 15 paintings. It was also the most complicated painting; it took him six days to complete.
Beautiful. Meng Chuan praised his own painting and wrote the name on the upper-right corner of the scroll-Roving Dragon Form of Lightning!
Fifteen paintings in 23 days. Meng Chuan looked at the last painting in front of him. Thousands of lightning snakes could be seen on it. Each lightning bolt had their own trajectory. They were unrestrained and free, but they also seemed to be one. The Roving Dragon looked beautiful. Compared to the real purple lightning, this painting resembled the swimming and slithering of thousands of dragons and snakes.
However, this was just one aspect of the purple lightning
Human strength is limited at times.
Meng Chuan looked up at the scene of a forming world. I can only draw a maximum of 15 paintings from watching the purple lightning. I’ve painted everything I know about it.
Fifteen paintings—Fifteen Lightning Forms.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan stayed seated on the stool and waved his hand. Fifteen paintings appeared in midair, floating around him.
Following that, he flipped his hand and took out a flask of alcohol. Meng Chuan drank and looked at the 15 paintings in delight. The more he looked at them, the more satisfied he was.

chapters.title: Chapter 312 - What Is Talent?
chapters.content:
Chapter 312 What Is Talent?
I’ve been painting for the past 23 days. My Essence Soul was emitting light constantly. Meng Chuan sensed his Essence Soul and smiled. Those 15 paintings must’ve had a huge impact on me if it could cause changes in my Essence Soul. Although my Essence Soul has accumulated more power, I still haven’t broken through...
One of the requirements to attempt a breakthrough to the Creation realm was a fifth-level Essence Soul. It was extremely difficult to attain. Even most Creation Supremacies only had fifth-level Essence Soul. Among Archean Mountain’s three Supremacies, only Li Guan had a sixth-level Essence Soul.
I’ve been indulging for more than half a month. It’s time to continue cultivating my saber art. After drinking, Meng Chuan waved his hand and put away the drawing table, stool, paintings, brush, and other items.
Meng Chuan instantly wanted to unsheathe his saber and execute the Saber Drawing Stance.
Huh? Meng Chuan stopped while holding the saber handle. He didn’t pull it out of its sheath. He looked at the dark purple lightning in the distance and frowned. My saber art has gone astray?
After completing the Fifteen Lightning Forms, Meng Chuan had gained his own understanding of lightning. In fact, paintings were a depiction of one’s understanding. He tried his best to depict the essence of lightning in the Fifteen Lightning Forms. Meng Chuan was a painting sage. His body contained boundless amounts of lightning, so he could naturally discern a lot when observing the purple lightning. He painted his current understanding of the essence of lightning from 15 different angles. All these paintings combined were the understanding of lightning he had in his heart.
As for the Heart Intent Saber Art, it was also a lightning saber art. It had been comprehended and improved by Guo Ke over centuries, but it only focused on one aspect of lightning
Although Ancestral Master Guo Ke is impressive, only one move of the Heart Intent Saber Art reached the Imperial Lord level. Everybody has their own understanding of lightning. Ancestral Master Guo Ke had his own understanding of lightning. I’m a painter, and I also have my own understanding of lightning. Different people have different takes on the same matter. If I insist on following Ancestral Master Guo Ke, I’ll be led astray and become more unaccustomed to it.
Since ancient times, humans have created Heaven-level techniques and Black Metal Sutra techniques. This is because powerful Godfiends have their own understandings. Junior Brother Yan is starting to follow his own version of the Extreme Fire lineage. King True Martial created his own True Martial lineage. King Calm Sea created his own Heavenly Tribulation Sword.
Since I believe that Ancestral Master Guo Ke’s understanding of lightning is too extreme, causing me to be led astray, I’ll practice saber arts according to my own understanding. I’ll abandon the shackles my predecessors placed on me and practice my sabers arts with the purple lightning as my guide. A strong impulse caused Meng Chuan to immediately make a decision. After completing Fifteen Lightning Forms, Meng Chuan felt like Guo Ke’s version of the Heart Intent Saber was too extreme. He disagreed with it inwardly.
I’ve been exposed to two Black Metal Sutra techniques that follow the lightning lineage
– The Heart Intent Saber and the World Roving Dragon Saber.
The core of the Heart Intent Saber is the Heart Intent Saber Drawing Stance. I’ve practiced the Saber Drawing Stance. For my saber art, my goal is to be fast. With what I’ve seen from the purple lightning, one’s speed can produce an unrivaled might if they achieve extreme speed. Of the Fifteen Lightning Forms I previously painted, Flash Form of Lightning is the embodiment of pure speed. I should use Flash Form of Lightning’s essence as my basis.
Actually, I find that the World Roving Dragon Saber is more suitable for me now. Meng Chuan pondered. I’ve been practicing the saber drawing stance since I was young. After seeing the purple lightning, I’ve realized that the World Roving Dragon Saber is essentially a set of movement techniques. It’s like the snaking trajectory of a lightning bolt. This trajectory is like a brush drawing in the void.
The World Roving Dragon Saber’s essence is similar to my ‘The Nine Heavenly Forms of the Void’ and ‘Twisting Dragon Form of Lightning.’ As someone who enjoyed painting, Meng Chuan felt like the World Roving Dragon Saber resembled two of the paintings in the Fifteen Lightning Forms collection, regardless of it being a saber art or movement technique.
Meng Chuan had the urge to try cultivating the World Roving Dragon Saber.
I’ll give it a try.
Meng Chuan didn’t hesitate to begin cultivating. Of the three Black Metal Sutra swift lightning saber arts-Lightning Devastator Saber, Heart Intent Saber, and World Roving Dragon Saber—Meng Chuan had only read the latter two. Archean Mountain didn’t have the original copy of the Lightning Devastator Saber.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan tried to use his movement technique.
Supremacy Roving Dragon, Ye Hong, created the World Roving Dragon Saber. In terms of strength, it was ranked at the bottom of the three swift lightning saber arts. In terms of movement techniques, it was ranked first among human techniques.
Meng Chuan had the Swallow Stance as his foundation. The World Roving Dragon movement technique that he cultivated was also rather swift, especially after he drew upon the essences of both The Nine Heavenly Forms of the Void’ and ‘Twisting Dragon Form of Lightning.’ He had an accurate grasp of this movement technique’s core. His cultivation of the movement technique progressed at a rapid pace. On the first day, he had already reached a decent stage. He improved daily, and this movement technique turned more and more profound.
Days passed.
Huh? When King True Martial stopped cultivating, he noticed a figure in the distance. It was like a roaming dragon, leaving afterimages in the world. Oh? Junior Brother Meng also cultivates the World Roving Dragon Saber? King True Martial watched his movements. It looks like he’s quite accomplished. He didn’t find it strange. As a Lightning Devastator Fiend Body Godfiend, it was normal for Meng Chuan to cultivate a swift saber art.
But why does his movement technique look so beautiful? King True Martial was astonished. I’ve seen Marquis Sea Return execute the World Roving Dragon Saber; it’s extremely fast and unpredictable. However, when Meng Chuan executes the World Roving Dragon Saber, it’s more elegant and carefree. It has a unique charm to it.
Yes. An indescribable unique charm. King True Martial didn’t know that Marquis Sea Return had followed the same path as his predecessors when he learned the World Roving Dragon Saber. However, Meng Chuan had his own understanding of lightning. After learning this movement technique, he subconsciously infused his understanding of the purple lightning into the movement technique.
His speed is faster than before? King True Martial immediately realized this.
Meng Chuan was indeed faster than before. He had only cultivated the World Roving Dragon Saber for half a month, but he had already reached the peak of the Realm of Dao. If he were to unleash his full strength, he could traverse 12.5 kilometers in a secondthis was the strength of the world’s best movement technique. As for the Heart Intent Saber’s Swallow Stance, it had reached its limit. In a flash, he could only travel 9.5 kilometers.
If word got out that his World Roving Dragon Saber—which he had never cultivated before —could match his proficiency with the Heart Intent Saber in just half a month, Supremacy Qin Wu and company would be dumbfounded.
Such monstrous talent had already surpassed a peerless genius’s talent.
What is talent? After practicing the World Roving Dragon Saber, Meng Chuan was filled with confidence. He also understood one thing. Talent is an understanding of essence.
Peerless geniuses typically had a natural affinity towards something; for example, fire, ice, swords, etc. From the bottom of their hearts, these peerless geniuses would feel a sense of affinity with a certain thing, allowing their cultivation path to be extremely smooth.
They could subconsciously advance in the right and best direction for them. For example, Liu Qiyue had a strong affinity with fire after awakening her phoenix bloodline. Since then, her fire technique realm had risen much faster.
Those without talent were like headless flies. It was difficult for them to cultivate step by step; they might even end up walking in circles.
This was talent! Talent was not immutable. Some geniuses became mediocre because they deviated off the correct path after certain encounters. Some people were late-bloomers. After years of cultivation, one might finally grasp the essence of something, causing their cultivation to advance by leaps and bounds!
Meng Chuan had cultivated the Heart Intent Saber and had interacted with lightning for decades. After seeing the purple lightning in the River of Spacetime, he finally had his own accurate understanding of lightning—which he had gained by completing the masterful collection of paintings that was the Fifteen Lightning Forms.
Most typical peerless geniuses advanced on the correct cultivation path subconsciously. Meng Chuan, however, proceeded on the correct cultivation path thanks to his accurate understanding of things. It could be said that Meng Chuan’s talent in swift lightning saber arts had surpassed his previous genius-level talent.

chapters.title: Chapter 313 - Huge Commotion
chapters.content:
Chapter 313 Huge Commotion
Wind blew in the World Gap as Meng Chuan, King True Martial, and the other Godfiends cultivated.
Swoosh.
A dazzling saber beam flashed, and Demon Slayer was sheathed.
I already have a direction to the Dharma Domain realm. Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up. Although I have a direction, I still have to take one step at a time to reach the Dharma Domain realm. Those that can become Regis Godfiends are mostly peerless geniuses. Typically, it takes 30 years for a peerless genius to advance from the peak of the Realm of Dao to the Dharma Domain realm.
I wonder how long it will take me. I feel like it shouldn’t take me that long. Meng Chuan looked forward to it.
It was because of Meng Chuan’s robust foundation that his World Roving Dragon Saber could reach the peak of the Realm of Dao in a short period of time. It wouldn’t be easy for him to reach the Dharma Domain realm that quickly.
When I return to Archean Mountain, I need to read as many lightning technique manuals as possible.I need to learn more ultimate techniques from my predecessors. Talent only prevents a person from getting lost during their cultivation journey. It allows one to walk towards their target directly, never straying off into the wrong path.
Ultimate techniques were precious knowledge. They were compilations of knowledge and techniques of the lightning lineage. It was too difficult to acquire such knowledge through one’s own efforts. By referencing his predecessors’ ultimate techniques, he could draw on their past wisdom and forge his own path.
I need to draw upon the wisdom of my seniors. I need to abandon what I don’t need and absorb what I need. Only then can I grow faster. Meng Chuan understood this. For example, King True Martial used Grandsire Yin Yang’s lineage as his foundation. He then built upon it to create the True Martial lineage. If he didn’t have the foundation of Grandsire Yin Yang’s ultimate techniques, how could he have created his own lineage out of thin air?
He probably wouldn’t have even created the True Martial lineage by the time he was 500 years old. Progress was only possible because people stood on the shoulders of giants. This was how civilization was. Generation after generation, more knowledge and experience accumulated. It was similar to the barren wilderness turning into a prosperous nation! What was a peerless genius? The definition of one was to know how to absorb what they need and abandon what they didn’t need. By absorbing what one needed, they could ultimately create something that was uniquely theirs!
In the beginning, Meng Chuan’s Heart Intent Saber followed the same path as Ancestral Master Guo Ke’s. He didn’t dare to change anything because modifying an ultimate technique could result in a terrible development! He would only end up in a difficult situation if that happened. However, he now had his own understanding of lightning after painting the Fifteen Lightning Forms. He had gained knowledge on how to modify things. He had a clear goal, and with that, he could succeed!
Even so, becoming a Regis Godfiend and reaching the Creation realm still wasn’t easy. Book knowledge was superficial. You had to comprehend that knowledge in person to gain a profound understanding!
Is my understanding of lightning, obtained after painting the Fifteen Lightning Forms, definitely correct? As Meng Chuan held Demon Slayer, this thought surfaced in his mind. If my understanding is wrong, wouldn’t it mean that I’ve taken the wrong path?
Meng Chuan looked up at the distant purple lightning It was too vast.
Was what he knew definitely correct?
No. Perhaps Supremacy Ye Hong and Ancestral Master Guo Ke were right. The directions they chose were only small portions of lightning’s essence. Even the Fifteen Lightning Forms I painted is only a small portion of lightning’s essence. I’ve been cultivating the lightning lineage for decades. My body contains a boundless amount of lightning. I live with lightning every day. With my painting skills, I won’t make mistakes... At most, I only drew a small portion of lightning’s essence. No matter what happens, I’ll cultivate according to my understanding. Whether I rise to prominence or mediocrity, I’ll accept it. At the very least, my cultivation has been very smooth recently. Meng Chuan was planning on being stubborn. Sometimes, even if one took an unorthodox path, they would still be able to achieve success if they followed it to the end.
The days of cultivation were lonely. Meng Chuan looked at the scene of the distant, forming world. He saw the black and white auras growing there. He saw water, fire, wind, and other elements producing life. Although they contained infinite, mysterious wonders, Meng Chuan couldn’t glean much from them.
He could also attempt to draw the forming world’s water, fire, and so on, but he was destined to draw far less than the Fifteen Lightning Forms. Other than needing a direct reference, one needed decades of insight towards a certain thing. Only by combining the two would one have a greater chance of gaining a more profound understanding of something
Since Meng Chuan had not cultivated these myriad elements, his paintings of them would be shallow and superficial. Without profound insight, it would be impossible to seek answers from his inner self just by painting with the naked eye.
Am I seeing things? King True Martial looked at the distant Meng Chuan. Ever since Meng Chuan finished his paintings, he’s been enjoying himself and even smiling during cultivation. Before he painted, he never smiled so foolishly. Perhaps, it’s because he was too tired and only managed to relax completely after painting?
He was cultivating alone, yet he was enjoying himself? People would think of him as a cultivation lunatic. King Calm Sea was such a lunatic. He abandoned his family ties and completely immersed himself in his cultivation. Only such a madman could believe that there was great joy to be found in cultivation. They wouldn’t find cultivation to be difficult; they would find it to be the greatest joy in the world. Thus, such a madman would naturally be happy to immerse themselves in their cultivation. Only a cultivation lunatic’s cultivation would advance by leaps and bounds.
Considering Meng Chuan’s behavior in the past nine months, he was clearly not a cultivation lunatic.
How could King True Martial know that Meng Chuan’s behavior had changed because of his paintings?
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The earth trembled slightly. What’s wrong? Yan Chitong, Xue Feng, and King Calm Sea stopped their cultivation and were somewhat puzzled.
Meng Chuan sheathed his saber and looked at the ground in puzzlement. The ground trembled as the soil and sand rolled. Meng Chuan looked around, but he couldn’t sense the cause of the commotion. What’s going on? Meng Chuan walked towards the others in puzzlement. Everyone gathered together. Similarly, King Calm Sea couldn’t find the source of the tremors.
However, King True Martial closed his eyes as invisible waves radiated from him. He carefully sensed the surroundings. Suddenly, he opened his eyes. King True Martial stared into the distance and pointed. “In that direction. The tremor source is about 1,650 kilometers away.”
“It’s definitely not a trivial matter if such a commotion occurs during the birth of a world,” said King Calm Sea. “Let’s hurry over,” said King True Martial. “Yes.” Meng Chuan, Yan Chitong, and Xue Feng nodded.
“Meng Chuan, carry us along,” said King True Martial.
“Okay.” Meng Chuan immediately carried everyone. King Calm Sea didn’t object. King True Martial unleashed his domain to assist Meng Chuan, reducing the impact on Meng Chuan’s speed as best he can.
Swoosh.
A bolt of lightning streaked across the sky. It was like a lightning dragon flashing across the world. Meng Chuan traversed 10 kilometers in a second, even when he was carrying four other people along.
He’s this fast? No matter how cold King Calm Sea was, he was still shocked.
“You’re much faster than when we were snatching the Spacetime Floating Ice,” said King True Martial as he looked at Meng Chuan in surprise.
“I had another breakthrough,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“A breakthrough?” King Calm Sea frowned. In other aspects, this Meng Chuan is only average. However, his speed is truly becoming more and more abnormal. Isn’t the common consensus that the faster one is, the harder it is to raise one’s speed? His speed has improved by a large margin again in just a few months?
Furthermore, according to what he knew, a Lightning Devastator Fiend Body Marquis Godfiend typically traversed about five kilometers in a second. It was already not bad if Meng Chuan exceeded that by a bit. Why was Meng Chuan so fast?
“Senior Brother Meng’s speed is truly peerless,” praised Yan Chitong. Ever since Meng Chuan saved Marquis West Sea, Yan Chitong began to admire Meng Chuan. “It’s nothing.” Meng Chuan was very humble. After receiving the intent legacy, Meng Chuan had learned how fast the creator of the World Roving Dragon Saber-Supremacy Ye Hongwas. Compared to Ye Hong, he felt like a baby that had just begun to crawl. He still had a long way to go. The five Godfiends flew at an extremely fast speed and soon arrived at their destination.
Impressive. King True Martial managed to deduce the tremor source to be 1,650 kilometers away. He wasn’t wrong at all. Meng Chuan looked into the distance. A mountain slowly rose from the ground. The mountain emitted a five-colored light, and a faint purple aura surrounded it.
“Is it the birth of an Origins treasure?” King Calm Sea and King True Martial looked at each other.

chapters.title: Chapter 314 - Origins Treasure
chapters.content:
Chapter 314 Origins Treasure
The five of them flew towards the mountain that was slowly rising.
“We can’t go up the mountain,” King True Martial said. His domain tried to penetrate the mountain. “The purple Origins aura protects the mountain. Before the purple Origins aura converges, we can’t approach it.” King True Martial looked at Meng Chuan. “Junior Brother Meng, you should be carrying a small grotto-heaven with you, right?”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded without denying it.
King Calm Sea was alarmed. A small pocket grotto-heaven was extremely rare. To refine such a small grotto-heaven that he could carry with him, he needed valuable treasures and to meet high strength requirements! The price of 500 million credits that was previously mentioned to Meng Chuan was a price for disciples.
Even to King True Martial and King Calm Sea, 500 million credits was a huge amount. They wouldn’t be extravagant enough to exchange for a Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead that wasn’t of any use to their combat prowess. They were purely for storing items. King True Martial used a void bracelet that contained a 500-by-500-kilometer void. It could only store dead objects, but it was cheap. It cost him 30 million credits.
Life could exist within a grotto-heaven; that was why grotto-heaven treasures were valuable. Grotto-heaven treasures contained the power of a world.
“It’s said that the fourth Firmament demon monarchs that have infiltrated the human world are hiding in a small grotto-heaven. Senior Brother Meng also has a small grotto-heaven?” said Yan Chitong excitedly.
“A small grotto-heaven?” Xue Feng looked at Meng Chuan. Meng Chuan was too mysterious. How could he have such a treasure?
Why does Meng Chuan have one when King True Martial and I don’t have one? King Calm Sea pondered. Did he encounter a fortuitous encounter, or did Archean Mountain bestow it to him? If Archean Mountain really gave it to him... there must be a special reason.
The three sects typically owned most of the small grotto-heavens. Even when they were used to move people and transport food during the mass migrations, they were only given to Regis Godfiends for temporary usage As for purchasing it? How many could afford it?
“Junior Brothers.” King True Martial looked at Meng Chuan, Yan Chitong, and Xue Feng. He said, “An Origins treasure is more important than the Spacetime Floating Ice. Archean Mountain is in desperate need of them! The competition for Origins treasures might be a little intense. King Calm Sea and I won’t be able to unleash our full strength if we need to protect the three of you.
Therefore, it’s best for the three of you to hide in a small grotto-heaven. It’ll be much safer this way.”
“Alright.” Meng Chuan, Yan Chitong, and Xue Feng nodded in agreement.
“Junior Brother Meng, it’s better if you stay and help us,” said King Calm Sea. “He’s much faster than the two of us. Speed is very important when it comes to snatching treasures... The moment the Origins treasure appears, we have to obtain it as quickly as possible.”
King True Martial hesitated for a moment, but he had to admit that King Calm Sea’s words made sense. Meng Chuan was much faster than them.
“Junior Brother Meng...” King True Martial looked at Meng Chuan.
“Since Archean Mountain urgently needs this Origins treasure, I’ll naturally do my best,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“Alright, don’t stray too far from me later. As long as you are within 100 feet of me, I’ll ensure your safety,” said King True Martial.
Meng Chuan smiled and said, “Thank you, Senior Brother.” His life-preservation abilities weren’t bad, but with King True Martial around, he was more confident. Meng Chuan looked at Xue Feng and Yan Chitong. “Don’t resist. I’ll pull you into my grotto-heaven.”
“Alright.” Xue Feng and Yan Chitong were still somewhat curious.
Meng Chuan waved his hand. Xue Feng and Yan Chitong were transported inside by the Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead’s world power. “We’ll wait here,” said King True Martial. “Once the purple Origins aura dissipates, we will immediately snatch the treasure.”
“Senior Brothers, how valuable is this Origins treasure?” asked Meng Chuan.
King True Martial smiled and said, “Origins treasures can only form when a world is born. They contain a portion of the World Origins’s powers. We can no longer find such treasures in our human world. Even in the River of Spacetime, it’s very difficult to obtain one.”
It contains the power of World Origins? Meng Chuan fell into deep thought. “Your small grotto-heaven contains the power of the world because it has a Grotto-Heaven Origins,” explained King True Martial. “As for our entire human world, it also has World Origins. It is the true foundation of the world. Everything in the world grows because of it. It has too many uses. When King Calm Sea and I entered the World Gap, our first target was Origins treasures.”
“Such treasures will also help us win the war,” said King Calm Sea in a rare instance. After all, they would be working together later.
“Understood.” Meng Chuan nodded.
“The demons are here.” King True Martial looked into the distance. “Furthermore, they seem very arrogant.” “Arrogant?” Meng Chuan and King Calm Sea didn’t see the demons. After a while, they saw a black line appear on the distant horizon. As the black line drew closer, it turned out to be a black wave.
The black waves surged over. Although he was quite far away, Meng Chuan’s heart palpated when he stared at the black waves.
The black waves spread out for hundreds of kilometers in a dominating manner. Two figures stood above the waves, side by side. One was a black-robed elder, while the other was a goat-horned demon monarch in red scale armor.
“Patriarch Poison Dragon and Blood Shura?” King Calm Sea’s pupils constricted.
“The two of them?” Meng Chuan was shocked as well. There were more fifth Firmament demon monarchs than Regis Godfiends. Among them, five were most dazzling-they had the strength of a demon sage. Patriarch Poison Dragon and Blood Shura were ranked among them.
“Blood Shura doesn’t follow the demon monarch cultivation system, but a Shura cultivation system from the outer realm.” King True Martial was much more solemn. “His body is powerful, and his close combat strength is extremely terrifying. He once fought a demon sage head-on without being disadvantaged.
“As for Patriarch Poison Dragon, he’s even more terrifying. Although he can’t become a demon sage due to his aging body, his technique realm has already reached the level of a demon sage. Furthermore, he has transformed his body into a pool of black, poisonous water by cultivating with an outer realm treasure. This body has no flaws. Every drop of black water is extremely poisonous. He once transformed into the Blackwater Poison Pool to trap a demon sage and erode his body, forcing the demon sage to flee. Among the demons, only two fifth Firmament demon monarchs have managed to defeat demon sages. Patriarch Poison Dragon was one of them,” said King True Martial.
Although Meng Chuan had obtained information on fifth Firmament demon monarchs, he clearly didn’t know as much as King True Martial and King Calm Sea.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
The poisonous, black waves spread out in all directions, enveloping the mountain. They eventually invaded King True Martial’s domain, revealing Meng Chuan, King True Martial, and King Calm Sea.
Huh? Patriarch Poison Dragon and Blood Shura were alarmed when they saw this.
“It’s King True Martial and King Calm Sea,” said Patriarch Poison Dragon. “Both of them have strength comparable to a demon sage.”
“Kill them if you can. If you can’t kill them, hold them back. We’ll leave after we seize the treasures,” said Blood Shura.
Patriarch Poison Dragon nodded. “Yes.”
In the World Gap, they had the confidence to face any human.
Both parties knew that their opponents weren’t to be trifled with when they met.
“Archean Mountain Godfiends.” Patriarch Poison Dragon stood in the black waves that spanned hundreds of kilometers. His voice resounded through the world as he laughed. “Three months ago, we encountered King Molten and King White Treasure from Black Sand Grotto-Heaven. The two of them managed to escape thanks to their exquisite life-preservation means. I want to see if you Archean Mountain Godfiends can escape.”
“What an audacious claim,” said King Calm Sea coldly with a cold glint in his eyes.
“Junior, you have only cultivated for 100 years. You should be more humble,” said Patriarch Poison Dragon with a chuckle. Blood Shura remained expressionless beside him.
Junior? King Calm Sea narrowed his eyes. How proud was he? How dare a demon monarch address him as a junior?

chapters.title: Chapter 315 - Debt for Saving His Life
chapters.content:
Chapter 315 Debt for Saving His Life
Although King Calm Sea’s expression was cold, he remained where he was and didn’t attack.
King True Martial calmly, said “When Patriarch Poison Dragon transforms into a poisonous pool, his black water will span hundreds of kilometers. If we charge over, we will be at a disadvantage. All we need to do is stay on the defensive and let the two of them attack. If they don’t attack, once the treasures appear... Junior Brother Meng will immediately bring us to snatch the treasures. If they attack, they’ll have to attack my True Martial domain.”
Chi! Chi! Chi!
The black water surged, enveloping the mountain. It naturally enveloped Meng Chuan and company. The black water corroded the True Martial domain. A Yin-Yang disc appeared in the invisible domain. The Yin-Yang disc slowly spun, producing an impermeable defense.
“This domain is rather interesting.” Patriarch Poison Dragon watched this scene.
“Attack,” said Blood Shura.
The two instantly moved.
Whoosh.
Patriarch Poison Dragon’s figure instantly fused with the boundless black water—which immediately surged and circled the three Godfiends violently.
“Just stay by my side,” instructed King True Martial.
“Yes, Senior Brother.” Meng Chuan nodded.
Roar! A black, poison water dragon suddenly condensed from the surging waves that spanned hundreds of kilometers. It let out a heaven-shaking roar before charging into the True Martial domain. It had immense strength, an undying body, and lethal toxicity. It opened its gaping mouth in a bid to swallow Meng Chuan, King True Martial, and King Calm Sea.
Whoosh.
A blood-colored figure charged out from the gaping mouth as a blood-colored saber beam lit up.
“I’ll block Blood Shura.” King Calm Sea immediately took the initiative to meet the blood-colored saber beam.
Patriarch Poison Dragon could transform into the Blackwater Poison Pool, a virtually undying body. Even demon sages feared the poison. King Calm Sea’s body was far inferior to that of a demon sage; if he couldn’t kill him, wouldn’t he be at risk of being poisoned to death? He naturally didn’t wish to fight Patriarch Poison Dragon.
Boom!
King True Martial stayed standing in the same spot. With a wave of his palm, a gigantic gray palm condensed in his domain and dealt with the poison dragon.
Blood Shura and King Calm Sea clashed.
The True Martial domain maintained a radius of 2.5-kilometers as it warded off the ordinary, black waves. Only the poison dragon and Blood Shura could enter the domain.
Three greater demon monarchs were hiding in the distant void; it was the fire pheasant trio.
“King True Martial and King calm Sea is on one side, and Patriarch Poison Dragon and Blood Shura is on the other?” The fire pheasant demon monarch was somewhat indignant.
“Back then, didn’t I manage to flee despite Patriarch Poison Dragon’s attempts to corrode my body?” said an ox demon monarch. “The three of us have a chance of grabbing the treasure if we join forces.”
“We need to act smartly. Let them fight each other first. It’s best if one or two die,” said the demon dragon demon monarch with a smile. “Sister Phoenix Feather’s movement techniques are considered impressive among fifth Firmament demon monarchs. She’s faster than many demon sages. With her speed, we might be able to snatch the Origins treasure.”
“I hope their battle ends in an internecine outcome, giving us an opportunity to grab the treasure.” The fire pheasant demon monarch continued staring into the distance. “Origins treasures... are worth our efforts.”
The three of them were peak fifth Firmament demon monarchs. They each had their own strengths. When working together, they were comparable to a demon sage.
What potent poison. It doesn’t have any medium, but it can still seep through. King True Martial was secretly surprised. He used his palm technique to suppress the ferocious Poison Dragon, preventing him from coming within half a kilometer of him.
Whoosh.
King True Martial waved his hand and gathered the poison together. He was afraid it would affect Meng Chuan. I don’t even dare to put this poison in the void bracelet. King True Martial sent the poison flying backward again.
“King True Martial, you’ve been poisoned.” Poison Dragon laughed loudly from afar. “Let’s see how long you can last.”
King True Martial stood where he was with a smile. “Look at me. I’m fine, am I not?” Strands of poison penetrated his Seamless domain and reached the surface of his skin. A gray force flowed across his body, grinding away the poison. The True Martial lineage was terrifying in close combat and also gave one terrifying defense. The True Martial lineage pushed the strengths of the Godfiend cultivation system to the limits, making King True Martial a terrifying force to be reckoned with.
On the other side, King Calm Sea had a bloody wound on his chest. He found it difficult to heal the wound. King Calm Sea was in a sorry state.
King Calm Sea’s situation isn’t good. Meng Chuan watched nervously.
King Calm Sea’s eyes were cold as he struck out once again. His Heavenly Tribulation Sword was very terrifying. Each strike was unpredictable, making it even more terrifying. His sword technique completely suppressed Blood Shura. In just a few strikes, he managed to parry Blood Shura’s saber art, allowing his strike to brush past Blood Shura’s body. It left a three-foot-long wound on his blood-colored scales, but the wound quickly healed.
“Die!” Blood Shura stood in front of King Calm Sea as he constantly struck out with his saber. Saber beams came one after another! He ignored King Calm Sea’s 10 to 20 strikes that landed on his body because he could instantly recover from such trivial injuries. As long as his saber beams brushed past King Calm Sea, King Calm Sea would be severely injured. As long as he landed a solid blow, King Calm Sea would die!
Damn it. King Calm Sea was furious. His sword techniques were clearly more profound and powerful; he was also still in the True Martial domain. However, he already suffered three wounds. The saber beams had only brushed against his body, but he was already severely injured. An evil force seeped through the three wounds, preventing them from healing Blood Shura remained unharmed despite King Calm Sea’s efforts.
“Die.” Blood Shura was extremely calm. He seized the opportunity to unleash his killer move.
In an instant, 20% of his lifeblood was absorbed by the battle saber in his hand. Three blood-colored saber beams instantly erupted from the saber. The three blood-colored saber shadows arced, attacking from different directions. Blood Shura slashed out with his saber continuously, causing a void rift—which was a quarter-kilometer long-to rupture. The strength behind Blood Shura’s attacks had clearly doubled.
When King True Martial saw this, he knew he couldn’t save King Calm Sea in time. “Junior Brother, be careful!”
Oh no, retreat! King Calm Sea knew that he was in a life-and-death situation. His face flushed red as he frantically retreated.
Boom!
From a kilometer away, an extremely thick, dazzling bolt of lightning flew over and suddenly struck the blood-colored saber shadows. It was Meng Chuan that had acted; he was still standing beside King True Martial. Meng Chuan constantly observed the battlefield’s situation. When he realized that something wasn’t right, he naturally had to save his fellow Godfiend. He immediately used his divine power, Heaven’s Wrath. Due to Meng Chuan’s increase in his technique realm, Meng Chuan now had more exquisite control over lightning. He instantly condensed about 50% of the lightning in his body at a single point. The lightning struck quickly. Even Blood Shura didn’t have time to react before the thick lightning bolt struck him.
This lightning bolt was comparable to a peak Regis Godfiend’s strike. This bit of power didn’t even shatter Blood Shura’s terrifying scales. However, the violent lightning left his body slightly numb and reduced his speed.
Whoosh.
Thanks to that slight delay, King Calm Sea fled safely.
What? Blood Shura turned to look at Meng Chuan angrily. A Marquis Godfiend ruined his plans?
It almost killed me. King Calm Sea retreated to King True Martial’s side. He was angry and afraid.
The battle just now was indeed stifling. It was useless even if he had a high technique realm. His sword attacks could injure his opponent, but his opponent recovered from those injuries instantly. However, his opponent’s saber attacks posed a huge threat to him.
“If it weren’t for the domain’s suppression, my saber would have been 30% faster. You wouldn’t have been able to escape,” said Blood Shura coldly. “If it weren’t for that bolt of lightning, you wouldn’t have been able to escape either.”
The Shura cultivation system is this strong? King Calm Sea’s expression turned ugly. He cultivated the Great Strength Fiend Body and was good at attacking. However, he was completely restrained by Blood Shura. This was because the Shura cultivation system suppressed the Godfiend cultivation system.
“Junior Brother Meng, well done.” King True Martial heaved a sigh of relief and praised Meng Chuan.
King Calm Sea looked at Meng Chuan with a complicated look in his eyes. In a low voice, he said, “Thank you for your help, Junior Brother.” If it weren’t for Meng Chuan’s bolt of lightning, he wouldn’t have been able to escape. Meng Chuan had saved his life.

chapters.title: Chapter 316 - Ten Absolutes of World Annihilation
chapters.content:
Chapter 316 Ten Absolutes of World Annihilation
“Be careful of Blood Shura,” said King Calm Sea solemnly. “He has a Lifeblood mystic technique that can affect one’s lifeblood. Our Seamless domain and Quintessential Essence defenses are useless against it. The final three blood-colored saber shadows he produced should be a strong lifeblood mystic technique. If the blood-colored saber shadows had invaded my body, I would have been in greater trouble.”
“Lifeblood mystic technique?” King True Martial nodded slightly. “No wonder you were at such a disadvantage despite your technique realm being higher than his.”
“His body has terrifying defense and recovery speed,” said King Calm Sea.
“Junior Brother Xue, you have to be more careful. After leaving our human world and entering the World Gap, your protective treasure, Scarlet Cloud Heaven, can’t be used,” said King True Martial. King Calm Sea was extremely talented and had an extremely powerful Great Strength Fiend Body. He had the greatest chance of becoming a Creation Supremacy. Archean Mountain also bestowed him a secret treasure, Scarlet Cloud Heaven, to make up for his flaws.
King Calm Sea self-deprecatingly said, “When those demon monarchs enter our human world, they aren’t able to use any of their extremely powerful treasures. Now, I’ve experienced the same thing as them.”
The best treasures required sources of power. When one left their homeworld, they would be separated from their treasures’ sources of power; thus, these treasures naturally couldn’t be used. Demon monarchs were at a disadvantage when they came to the human world. King Calm Sea also had treasures that he couldn’t use when inside the World Gap.
“From now on, you have to spend more effort on defensive measures,” said King True Martial. “We will be entering the World Gap for extended periods frequently.”
“Yes.” King Calm Sea nodded.
Meng Chuan listened from the side.
The cultivation systems in the various major worlds were indeed different. There were the Godfiend, demon monarch, and Skydemon cultivation systems. Black Sand Grotto-Heaven had the Grand Yin cultivation system and the Halberd cultivation systemboth originated from the outer realm. Meng Chuan had high attainments in a mysterious physical body cultivation system. Blood Shura’s Shura cultivation system provided him a strong physical body and lifeblood mystic techniques.
I need to be more careful when fighting experts from other worlds. This is because some unknown technique might appear.
Black water churned.
Blood Shura and Patriarch Poison Dragon gathered together.
“King Calm Sea fled all the way to King True Martial.” Blood Shura looked at the three humans in the distance and said to his companion, “With their strength, it’ll probably be very difficult to break through their defenses if they just focus on defending.”
“This King True Martial is actually able to withstand my poison.” Patriarch Poison Dragon frowned. “He even protected Marquis Eastcalm, Meng Chuan.”
“That Meng Chuan deserves to die. He was the one who unleashed that lightning bolt on me, causing me to fail to kill King Calm Sea.” Killing intent flashed in Blood Shura’s eyes. “Let’s try again. Killing King Calm Sea and King True Martial will be a little difficult, but killing a Marquis Godfiend shouldn’t be difficult. We might find an opportunity to defeat them one by one if they try to save Meng Chuan.”
“Alright. I’ll cast a forbidden spell and give it my all.” Patriarch Poison Dragon nodded.
Blood Shura’s eyes glowed red. “Perhaps we can completely defeat them.”
The two of them were used to fighting head-on-a result of the Shura cultivation system and Patriarch Poison Dragon’s Blackwater Poison Pool body that he cultivated with the help of an outer realm treasure. Patriarch Poison Body had an undying body, so he was naturally stronger than Blood Shura.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The black waves-spread over hundreds of kilometers—suddenly surged towards the Godfiend trio.
“They’re coming.” King True Martial calmly said, “Junior Brother Xue, use your sword art, Spring Autumn Tribulation, to assist me. Leave the rest to me.” King Calm Sea nodded. “Alright.” His Heavenly Tribulation Sword had many killer moves. His Spring Autumn Tribulation had yet to be perfected, but it was the most mysterious and unpredictable move.
Meng Chuan watched carefully. The black water around him had already gathered to form an extremely large sphere-one even larger than ordinary mountains. When the black water sphere reached a diameter of 10 kilometers, the trio was trapped in the middle.
Whoosh.
In the black water sphere, a large, corporeal black dragon appeared. It was about one kilometer long, and its black scales were covered with mysterious patterns. It swam into the shrunken True Martial domain and headed towards Meng Chuan and company.
As for Blood Shura, he charged into the True Martial domain from the other side. Both of them had terrifying vitality, so they charged straight into the domain without any worries.
“Annihilate.” As the black dragon swam over, it suddenly stared at Meng Chuan. An Essence Soul weapon transformed into a blood-colored stream of light. It instantly traversed one kilometer and entered Meng Chuan’s body.
This Meng Chuan is only a Marquis Godfiend. He hasn’t cultivated for long. His Essence Soul is his greatest weakness. If his Essence Soul is only at the first or second level, I might be able to kill him in one strike. Patriarch Poison Dragon’s intelligence was clearly outdated. When Meng Chuan had killed the demon monarchs in Chu An City, the nine-headed lion demon monarch had managed to escape alive. The demons knew that Meng Chuan likely had a fourth-level Essence Soul.
Any fourth or fifth Firmament demon monarch that had entered the human world would receive the latest intelligence. However, Patriarch Poison Dragon and Blood Shura couldn’t enter the human world. They only gathered information about Creation Supremacies and Regis Godfiends, not paying much attention to other Godfiends.
Boom! The blood-colored stream pierced Meng Chuan’s sea of consciousness. The sea of consciousness was the domain of his Essence Soul. When Meng Chuan saw a blood-colored spear flying at his Essence Soul, he immediately expanded the Soul-Buster Bell and enveloped his Essence Soul with a thought.
Clang! The blood-colored spear struck the Soul-Buster Bell, producing a fluctuation. Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul felt somewhat uncomfortable, but he still remained lucid.
