In the end, the strength difference between their Essence Souls wasn’t large. Patriarch Poison Dragon had a fifth-level Essence Soul, and Meng Chuan had a fourth-level Essence Soul. With such a small difference in Essence Soul strength, the blood-colored spear didn’t affect Meng Chuan very much.
What? Patriarch Poison Dragon was somewhat astonished, but he still followed his original plan. He and Blood Shura attacked from two different directions. When they reached Meng Chuan and company, the black dragon roared angrily.
Roar!
The black dragon grew eight new heads. A total of nine poison dragon heads circled Meng Chuan as they attacked the Godfiend trio. Three heads targeted Meng Chuan.
“Die!” Blood Shura burned the blood in his body once again. A sanguine aura rose from his body as he slashed out three blood-colored saber shadows at Meng Chuan.
King True Martial and King Calm Sea attacked almost simultaneously.
Whoosh.
King Calm Sea’s sword technique didn’t contain any killing intent this time. The divine sword instantly transformed into dozens of sword beams that shot out in all directions.
Oh? Meng Chuan revealed a look of surprise. Meng Chuan could clearly sense the changes in his surroundings as he stood beside King Calm Sea and King True Martial. The demon monarchs’ movements remained the same as before, but their speed had clearly decreased by several-fold.
The flow of time has changed. Meng Chuan was shocked. King Calm Sea’s Spring Autumn Tribulation can affect the flow of time?
Boom! Boom! Boom!
King True Martial had long gathered his strength and struck out seven times. Seven blurry gray palms instantly appeared in the world. Under the changed flow of time, the seven palms struck out several times faster than usual, causing the void to collapse and distort. Patriarch Poison Dragon had no way to dodge them.
Boom!
Patriarch Poison Dragon was sent flying backward by King True Martial’s strongest move of his True Martial Seven AbsolutesSky Capsizing Palm. King True Martial was good at fist, palm, claw, and finger attacks. In terms of strength and defense, his palm techniques were the best. In terms of killing enemies, his fist techniques were the best.
After sending Patriarch Poison Dragon flying, King True Martial turned to look at Blood Shura.
“Die!” Although Blood Shura was somewhat alarmed by the seven palm strikes, he was still confident in his attacks. The three blood-colored saber shadows flew over.
Killing intent erupted from King True Martial’s eyes. He instantly cast a forbidden spell and circulated his Quintessential Essence with all his might. He delivered a flurry of punches with both fists.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!
Ten lightning-fast punches. With King Calm Sea’s Spring Autumn Tribulation helping, the ten punches hit even faster. The first nine punches struck one after another. Just as the nine blurry punches were thrown, the tenth punch-which was even more violent-had caught up. It caused the nine punches to condense into one, transforming into a gray column of light. This column of light contained a terrifying destructive power. Not good. Previously confident, Blood Shura’s heart palpitated when he saw the terrifying column of light. He immediately retreated, but it was too late.
The gray column of light instantly enveloped him. His extremely tough scales immediately shattered together with his muscles and bones shattered. Within the gray pillar of light, his body rapidly disintegrated. His head still managed to survive for a while against the gray column of light, but in the end, he let out an indignant roar before his head completely shattered. His body vanished within the gray column of light, obliterated completely.

chapters.title: Chapter 317 - Competition
chapters.content:
Chapter 317 Competition
Blood Shura was dead! Even his storage treasure had been obliterated! Only his battle saber could be seen flying into the distance.
King True Martial watched the outcome with a slightly-pale face. True Martial Seven Absolutes—Annihilation Fist-was a forbidden technique. He had executed the Ten Absolutes of World Annihilation. Annihilation Fist was the strongest move King True Martial had created; it could vanquish enemies with a single punch!
He had even created another forbidden technique–Ten Absolutes of World Annihilation-based on Annihilation Fist. It required him to deliver ten consecutive strikes instantly. This placed a great burden on his body and Quintessential Essence. It was more difficult than delivering 100 normal punches instantly. After executing the Ten Absolutes of World Annihilation, King True Martial suffered significant injuries. His dantian space had suffered damage. Even at his cultivation realm, he still needed to recuperate slowly.
“What?” The black dragon-which had been sent flying—was shocked by the sight.
He and Blood Shura had dominated the Demon Realm for many years. Yet, he had been killed by a Regis Godfiend today? Patriarch Poison Dragon knew very well how powerful Blood Shura’s body was. There weren’t many entities in the Demon Realm that could kill Blood Shura. Only a number of demon sages could accomplish the feat.
Blood Shura died just like that?
Having arrived high up on a mountain, the fire pheasant trio—who were hidden in the void—was also shocked. Blood Shura earned his fame from his kills. The strength of a Shura Body had been proven by generations of experts that followed the Shura cultivation system, yet King True Martial destroyed him in a head-on clash?
“How powerful. We must not clash head-on with King True Martial,” said the demon dragon solemnly as he watched from afar.
“Although my body is strong, I’m inferior to Blood Shura.” The ox demon monarch was extremely afraid.
“All we need to do is wait. When we find an opportunity and seize the Origins treasure, we will flee immediately.” The fire pheasant was confident in her speed.
The demon dragon and ox demon monarch agreed as well. They planned on fleeing upon seizing the treasure. King True Martial was... too terrifying. They didn’t have the confidence to fight him head-on.
Oh? The fire pheasant trio was suddenly alarmed. The mountain below had stopped rising
Whoosh. King True Martial waved his hand and stored away the battle saber left behind by Blood Shura.
“Impressive,” said King Calm Sea sincerely as he looked at King True Martial.
“It’s all thanks to you, Junior Brother Xue.” King True Martial’s face was pale as he said with a smile, “Although I created this forbidden move of mine, it has a fatal flaw. Even if I were to deliver ten consecutive punches, the amount of time it takes to fuse them would be several times longer than trying to fuse normal punches into one. When an enemy notices that something is amiss, they will escape! With your Spring Autumn Tribulation affecting the flow of time, I was able to execute this move several-fold faster than before. That prevented Blood Shura from escaping.” Meng Chuan fell into deep thought.
Yes. The time it took to complete this move was indeed a weakness. King Calm Sea had made up for this weakness, making it even more terrifying
“Your strength is in no way inferior to a true Creation realm expert,” said King Calm Sea. He didn’t say anything else.
A true Creation realm expert? King True Martial felt mixed emotions. He only had such accomplishment due to his many opportunities—a damaged token from Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven, Grandsire Yin Yang’s ultimate technique, and the demon heritage he had obtained from killing demons. Most importantly, he had cultivated for over 300 years! He had once been highly favored by Archean Mountain and was extremely illustrious. However, he had encountered emotional setbacks. He had doubted himself during his cultivation. He had been stuck at a bottleneck and couldn’t advance any further. He had completely fallen to the nadir of his life.
As time passed, he gradually aged. Amidst sighs, he—despite Archean Mountain Supremacies’ disappointment-finally broke through and achieved success. With an Imperial lord level ultimate technique—the Yin-Yang Art-as his foundation, he brashly modified it and created the True Martial lineage. The cultivation difficulty of his lineage was even greater than the Yin-Yang Art. However, once mastered, one’s combat strength would be superior to those of the same level!
But what use was that? By the time he mastered it, he was already old. His aged body prevented him from breaking through to the Creation realm.
As for the theoretical possibility of regaining his youth? That required his True Martial lineage’s foundation, the Yin-Yang Art, to reach perfection. What was perfection. It was the highest level of the Yin-Yang Art-the final level that Grandsire Yin Yang had reached the Imperial Lord level. Grandsire Yin Yang’s technique realm had reached the Imperial Lord level, but he didn’t become an Imperial Lord.
There were many requirements for becoming an Imperial Lord. One’s technique realm was only one of them. However, how difficult was it for one’s technique realm to reach the Imperial Lord level?
It’s just too difficult for one’s technique realm to reach the Imperial Lord level in 500 years.
King True Martial understood this.
Oh? King True Martial suddenly turned to look at the mountain nearby.
This mountain has stopped rising? Meng Chuan and King Calm Sea also discovered it. The purple aura that enveloped the mountain had stopped rising.
“Let’s hurry up and get close. Be ready to snatch the treasure at any time,” said King True Martial. He immediately used his domain to bring Meng Chuan and King Calm Sea closer to the purple aura. They came extremely close to the purple aura before their entry was barred.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Patriarch Poison Dragon transformed into black water; the water spread out. It surrounded the mountain from all directions, blotting out the sky and sealing off the entire mountain. However, the black water was unable to threaten the True Martial domain.
Humph. A black dragon surfaced from the black water, and coldly looked at the human Godfiends. He couldn’t do anything to King True Martial and company; likewise for King True Martial and the others. Patriarch Poison Dragon’s Undying body was indeed powerful. According to the intelligence they had, only the three demon Imperial Lords could kill him.
“Junior Brother Meng, we’ll be counting on you later.” King True Martial looked at Meng Chuan. “King Calm Sea and I will protect you. Carry us towards the treasure as quickly as possible.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded. “I will definitely give it my all.”
Suddenly,
The purple aura that enveloped the entire mountain converged and seeped back into the mountain. A white beam of light suddenly shot up from the mountainside. The white light formed a faint outline of eyes and a nose, but it was like a sharp sword that pierced through the air. It was terrifying fast.
“It’s an Origins treasure.” The black water had enveloped the entire mountain. A black dragon immediately condensed at the spot closest to the treasure. After the black dragon condensed, it rushed towards the white light.
“Seize the treasure.” Meng Chuan felt an inexplicable excitement when he saw the white light. It was as though his life was affected. He instinctively brought King True Martial and King Calm Sea toward the white light.
At the same time, he received a voice transmission from King True Martial’s Essence Soul. “Grab it!”
Whoosh.
Lightning flashed in the sky. Even while carrying King True Martial and King Calm Sea, Meng Chuan’s speed soared to an inconceivable level as he charged towards the white light.
“Grab it!” The fire pheasant trio immediately cast their divine powers.
Swoosh.
The demon dragon’s domain was famous in the Demon Realm. Even Patriarch Poison Dragon and King True Martial didn’t notice them when they hid in the void.
“Divine power—Void Territory.” A vertical eye opened at the demon dragon’s glabella. It allowed him to see chaotic void waves. His divine power could freeze the surrounding void and make it his territory. It was also his strongest domain move.
Whoosh.
The fire pheasant spread her fiery-red wings and transformed into a flaming beam as she swooped down from the sky.
Patriarch Poison Dragon’s black water was also about to reach the white light when the fire pheasant trio instantly charged into the black water.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
The black water was poisonous. However, the demon dragon’s Void Territory shielded the trio from the black water as they charged towards the white light.
Meng Chuan and company flew towards the white light from the side.
“What?” Patriarch Poison Dragon was alarmed as well. He didn’t expect other demon monarchs to be hiding in the vicinity.
“Origins treasure.” The fire pheasant trio went all out. Although Patriarch Poison Dragon was powerful, he was only famous for his Undying Body and poison. They weren’t afraid of him thanks to their number advantage.
Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!
Carrying her companions, the fire pheasant moved about 10 kilometers in a second. She was considered the fastest among fifth Firmament demon monarchs and even surpassed several demon sages.
Meng Chuan moved 11 kilometers in a second even while carrying King True Martial and King Calm Sea. This was the result of his new insights regarding the World Roving Dragon Saber.
They approached the white light—which soared into the sky-at full speed!
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan’s movement technique had a beauty to it. It was like a brushstroke in the void. His esoteric trajectory caused the Godfiend trio to be the first to reach the white light. The moment they intercepted it, King True Martial extended his hand, and a blurry gray aura enveloped the white beam of light.
“Retrieve.” King True Martial could sense the white light struggling, but he still willed it into his void bracelet.
“We have it.” Meng Chuan and King Calm Sea were overjoyed when they saw this.

chapters.title: Chapter 318 - Keeping At Bay
chapters.content:
Chapter 318 Keeping At Bay
“What?” The fire pheasant trio felt their hearts ache and reeled in anxiety when they saw the three human Godfiends obtain the Origins treasure.
That was an Origins treasure! They only appeared when a world was born. Imperial Lords yearned for such treasures. After obtaining one and giving it to an Imperial Lord, the three of them could elevate their strength. The Imperial Lord’s rewards would increase their chances of becoming a demon sage. Even if they couldn’t become a demon sage, their strength would increase by a large margin.
As the rulers of the Demon Realm, the Imperial Lords needed to maintain fairness so that their underlings would continue to risk their lives! When the demons under their command offered an Origins treasure, an Imperial Lord had to give them sufficient rewards. Otherwise, how could they convince the masses?
“We were just a little short. Just a little.”
“How can a human Godfiend be so fast?” The fire pheasant and ox demon monarch’s eyes turned red.
“Marquis Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, is said to be the fastest in the human world,” said the demon dragon via voice transmission. “He’s even faster than I expected.”
“He’s only a Marquis Godfiend. I’m a fifth Firmament demon monarch. I cultivate the Phoenix Flight, but my speed is still inferior to his.” The fire pheasant demon monarch was indignant.
The trio was furious and indignant, but they didn’t rush forward to wrestle the treasure from the humans. This was because they had seen King True Martial’s strength when he attacked Patriarch Poison Dragon and Blood Shura.
As for Patriarch Poison Dragon, he burned with anxiety.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The black water that blotted out the surroundings surged and surrounded the Godfiend trio. The water-closest to the Godfiend trio-condensed into a black dragon, and it stared at them. “Hand over the Origins treasure, and I’ll let you pass. Otherwise, you can forget about escaping!”
Meng Chuan looked up and saw the black waves surging over. The black dragon led the charge as it lunged over. King True Martial could fight Patriarch Poison Dragon one-on-one, but Meng Chuan and King Calm Sea didn’t dare. Patriarch Poison Dragon’s poison was bizarre and unfathomable. Even demon sages might not be able to withstand it. King True Martial was one of the few exceptions.
“Let’s go.” King True Martial sent a voice transmission to Meng Chuan. “Leave Patriarch Poison Dragon to me.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan didn’t hesitate to use his movement technique and flew into the distance with the two Regis Godfiends. However, black water surrounded them everywhere, so they naturally had to plunge into the black water.
The black water they plunged into immediately splashed and condensed into a black dragon. The black dragon could appear anywhere in the black water.
“Don’t even think about escaping.” When the black dragon appeared, it swung its tail and lashed out at the Godfiend trio.
“Scram!” King True Martial struck the black dragon’s body with a huge gray palm, causing the black dragon to stagger backward. The True Martial Seven Absolute’s Sky Capsizing Palm was the strongest non-forbidden move when it came to raw strength. It was especially useful for defense and repelling enemies. Patriarch Poison Dragon could be said to be extremely powerful, but a single palm strike still forced him back.
This caused Patriarch Poison Dragon to realize that something was amiss. King True Martial’s strength is too terrifying. I can’t hold them back alone. Patriarch Poison Dragon once again intercepted the Godfiend trio. At the same time, he sent a voice transmission to the three demon monarchs. “Demon Monarch Phoenix Feather, your trio will keep them at bay together. Don’t let them escape.”
“Keep them at bay together?” The fire phoenix, demon dragon, and ox demon monarch exchanged looks.
“I may be unable to defeat King True Martial and company if I work together with your trio, but it’ll be very easy for me to protect myself. I’ve already sent word out. Other demon monarchs are also rushing over. As long as we stall for time... King True Martial and company won’t be able to escape if all of us join forces,” said Poison Dragon anxiously via Essence Soul voice transmission. “If you watch from the sidelines and allow them to escape, the enraged Imperial Lords will definitely not let the three of you off if they learn of this matter.”
The trio was alarmed.
Origins treasure...
The Imperial Lords deemed such treasures the most important ever since the World Gap appeared. The Imperial Lords encouraged fifth Firmament demon monarchs to enter and adventure, mainly so that they could obtain Origins treasures.
“We will help stall for time, but we will definitely not fight them head-on,” said the demon dragon via voice transmission. Clearly, the three of them had made a unanimous decision.
Swoosh.
The fire pheasant’s wings trembled, and the three of them moved in a beautiful, flaming arc as they rapidly pursued Meng Chuan and company.
The Godfiend trio was obstructed by Patriarch Poison Dragon over and over again. Inside the black water, their speed of escape was affected. The Fire Phoenix trio rapidly approached Meng Chuan and company at an extremely fast pace.
“Suppress!” As they approached, the demon dragon’s vertical eye instantly froze the void. Divine power—Void Territory!
Meng Chuan felt resistance in the void, and it reduced his speed. His speed dropped to about 50% of his normal speed. King True Martial’s True Martial domain could only weaken the suppression somewhat. “This demon monarch’s divine power can actually control the void.” King True Martial’s expression changed slightly. Although he had some insights into spacetime, his control over the void was inferior to the demon dragon’s divine power! The three demon monarchs eyed the Origins treasure covetously from the side.
Patriarch Poison Dragon obstructed the Godfiend trio over and over again, causing Meng Chuan and company’s speed to decrease drastically.
“Senior Brothers, I can’t shake them off at all.” Meng Chuan was also in a difficult situation. Although the World Roving Dragon Saber’s movement technique was exquisite, the void suppression was too unbearable for Meng Chuan. Even though King True Martial’s domain helped him, the demon dragon’s divine power constantly suppressed him. Without King True Martial’s domain, his speed would be further reduced! It was clearly still very difficult for him to face numerous peak fifth Firmament demon monarchs as a Marquis Godfiend. At the very least, the demon dragon’s divine power was very effective against Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan was extremely fast, but he was most afraid of powerful adversaries who were skilled in domains. The stronger the domain, the greater the suppression.
“It’s true that we won’t be able to shake them off.” King True Martial’s expression was solemn as he sent a voice transmission. “The number of Regis Godfiends that have entered the World Gap can be counted on one hand. However, many fifth Firmament demon monarchs have entered the World Gap. It’s possible that there are more than 100 of them. We can’t delay any longer. If we delay any longer, more demon monarchs will attack us.”
“What do we do?” King Calm Sea sent a voice transmission. “Those three demon monarchs constantly stay five kilometers away from us. They are also extremely fast.”
“Junior Brother Xue, your Heavenly Tribulation Sword is good at long-range attacks,” said King True Martial via voice transmission. “Use the Heart Sword Tribulation to attack the fire pheasant. Junior Brother Meng will immediately fly away with all his might. Leave the rest to me... We have to give it a try. If this continues, it will be troublesome.”
“Alright.” King Calm Sea believed in King True Martial.
“Alright,” replied Meng Chuan via Essence Soul voice transmission.
After the three of them came to an agreement, they wore looks of desperation as they escaped. The fire pheasant trio cautiously stayed five kilometers away from the Godfiend trio. If they were any further from the Godfiend trio, the demon dragon’s divine power—Void Territory-would be unable to suppress them.
“Let’s just continue stalling for time.” Patriarch Poison Dragon was filled with confidence. “In a while, another two to three groups of demon monarchs will arrive. In fact, Monarch Peacock might even arrive.”
In the Demon realm, only two fifth Firmament demon monarchs could defeat demon sages. One was Patriarch Poison Dragon. He relied on his undying body and poison. The other was Monarch Peacock. It was said that he had devoured an ancient beast’s corpse successfully with his divine power—Heaven Devouring. After devouring the ancient beast’s corpse, his bloodline mutated, causing Monarch Peacock’s strength to rise by leaps and bounds. He could defeat demon sages in head-on clashes; he had defeated more than one demon sage.
“Attack,” King True Martial ordered via voice transmission.
Whoosh.
King Calm Sea wielded his divine sword and chopped down towards the distance. He struck from afar.
The three demon monarchs were still flying as per usual when a sword beam condensed in front of them. It appeared just slightly more than 100 feet in front of the fire pheasant.
At this extremely close distance, the sword beam slashed at the fire pheasant’s neck.
Heart Sword Tribulation of the Heavenly Tribulation Sword!

chapters.title: Chapter 319 - Return to the Human World
chapters.content:
Chapter 319 Return to the Human World
The Spring Autumn Tribulation was a move King Calm Sea had yet to perfect, but the Heart Sword Tribulation was the move that brought fame to King Calm Sea’s name. He could execute this killer move from 50 kilometers away. This struck fear in many demon monarchs when he defended Calm Sea Pass. Despite the great distance, King Calm Sea was able to send a sword beam to kill them.
The demon monarchs thought of it as a sword of heavenly punishment.
“Be careful!” The demon dragon could sense a terrifying, sharp force descending from the void. He couldn’t block it despite suppressing it as much as possible.
“Not good.” The fire pheasant shuddered. She wasn’t famous for her powerful body. At close proximity to the sword beam, she instinctively dodged.
Swoosh.
On the other side, as King Calm Sea attacked, Meng Chuan turned towards the Fire Phoenix trio.
How fast was he? Although the two sides were five kilometers apart, Meng Chuan quickly closed the distance with King True Martial and King Calm Sea in tow, arriving less than two kilometers away from the Fire Phoenix trio.
Whoosh. The fire pheasant tried her best to dodge. With her mystical movement technique, she managed to dodge the strike. The sword beam slashed past her body. My movement technique is the best. I managed to dodge it. The fire pheasant heaved a sigh of relief. If she had been struck, the consequences would have been dire.
The fire pheasant suddenly realized that the demon dragon beside her had a look of horror and anxiety. “What’s wrong?” Before the fire pheasant could sense anything, a bloody hole appeared between her eyebrows. Blurry gray energy surged out from the bloody hole. Only then did the fire pheasant reveal a look of horror and despair. “No,”
As she despaired, her head and upper body completely disintegrated. Even her two wings were completely obliterated, leaving only her lower torso intact.
Meng Chuan, King Calm Sea, and King True Martial heaved a sigh of relief.
King Calm Sea revealed a rare smile. His attack was a ruse. Meng Chuan’s movement technique brought them within 2.5 kilometers of the Fire Phoenix trio! Within that range, the True Martial domain could exert its greatest strength. That strike was also the only stealthy assassination move of True Martial Seven Absolutes—Yin-Yang Finger.
With a flick of King True Martial’s finger, the beam would meander through the balance of Yin and Yang, silently killing the enemy. However, he could only use this move in his True Martial domain.
Chi! Chi! Chi! The fire pheasant—who only had her lower body remaining-was rapidly regenerating. She wanted to regrow her upper body and wings. Swoosh.
Meng Chuan, King True Martial, and King Calm Sea had arrived.
“Split up and flee.” The demon dragon and ox demon monarch knew that the fire pheasant’s death was certain. They didn’t hesitate to split up and flee. They completely abandoned the fire pheasant. Their speed was far inferior to Meng Chuan’s. If they tried to protect her, they would die together.
Meng Chuan and company wanted to kill the fire pheasant the most. She was simply too fast and could hold them back.
Clang!
Meng Chuan and company arrived beside the fire pheasant in a second. At that moment, the fire pheasant’s body was still regrowing. She hadn’t even regrown her wings, so her flying speed was slow.
When King True Martial arrived beside the fire pheasant, he gently pressed down on her back. Her body dissipated like crumbling gravel, losing sentience. As for her robes, storage treasures, artifacts, and other items, they all remained intact.
After waving his hand and putting away his spoils of war, King True Martial smiled and said, “Let’s go.”
“Let’s go.” Meng Chuan and King Calm Sea felt relaxed.
Swoosh.
They streaked across the sky and rapidly flew into the distance.
Although Patriarch Poison Dragon wanted to stop them, Meng Chuan and company still maintained their speed despite him obstructing them. After charging out of the black water, they accelerated to an even more astonishing speed.
1 more
A bolt of lightning quickly sailed into the horizon like a dragon.
The endless black water converged and formed Patriarch Poison Dragon. He looked at the scene with a gloomy expression. “That fire pheasant sure is stupid. She allowed the humans to kill her with a sneak attack.”
As long as the fire pheasant had stayed alive, they could continue harassing the Godfiends. The demon dragon could also use his Void Territory to suppress the Godfiends and prevent them from escaping.
Without the fire pheasant, the other demon monarchs couldn’t catch up to Meng Chuan and company easily.
“She’s dead?” The demon dragon and ox demon monarch rendezvoused far away. They were furious and helpless.
“King True Martial has an assassination technique?” The demon dragon gritted his teeth. “Why is he so good at so many moves?”
“Let’s go. Patriarch Poison Dragon might vent his anger on us,” said the ox demon monarch.
“Yes.” The two of them instantly hid in the void and fled.
Meng Chuan and company maintained maximum speed as they fled into the distance.
Meng Chuan sighed inwardly. King Calm Sea’s means were somewhat unique, but King True Martial’s combat prowess was very comprehensive. His domain, assassination move, defense, and head-on attacks were all
strong.
Grandsire Yin Yang’s Yin-Yang Art is well-rounded to begin with. The True Martial lineage was built upon this foundation; thus, it is equally well-rounded. In fact, it’s even stronger than the Yin-Yang Art at the same level. Meng Chuan sighed inwardly. It wasn’t a certainty that one’s predecessors were stronger. Those that came after could equally build upon their predecessors’ foundation and innovate. The Heart INtent Saber was a saber art created by a Regis Godfiend. It was the swiftest saber art in the world, surpassing even Creation-realm experts and Imperial Lords.
If one had just reached the Grotto-Heaven realm, then the True Martial Seven Absolutes was stronger than the Yin-Yang Art. Of course, Grandsire Yin Yang’s ultimate technique ultimately was of the Imperial Lord level. King True Martial was still far inferior.
“It’s very dangerous for us to continue staying in the World Gap since we’ve obtained an Origins treasure. Let’s send the Origins treasure back to Archean Mountain,” said King True Martial. “Junior Brother Meng, let’s rush to the spot we came in from.”
“Alright.” Meng Chuan nodded.
An Origins treasure was a hot potato. They would only feel at ease if they delivered it to Archean Mountain.
After a while, Meng Chuan and company arrived back at the spot they had entered from.
Boom!
In just a few seconds, the void in front of them blasted apart. A hole about 50 to 60 feet wide appeared. Through the hole, one could see the world on the other side. It was a splendid world-Archean Mountain!
Meng Chuan and company even saw Supremacies Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang.
“Let’s go.” Meng Chuan and company immediately passed through the entrance and left the World Gap, returning to the human world.
“You’re back.”
Meng Chuan and company landed on the mountain peak. Meng Chuan breathed in the fresh air and smelled the fragrance of flowers and soil. His body was no longer weightless, and he felt protected by the world. This made Meng Chuan feel a sense of warmth. This was his homeworld—the human world.
“Why are you back so quickly?” asked the illusory Qin Wu’s illusory. “Isn’t there still about a month before a year is up?”
“Just the three of you? What about the others?” asked the illusory Luo Tang worriedly.
Only then did Meng Chuan remember about Yan Chitong and Xue Feng. He immediately waved his hand.
Whoosh. Whoosh.
Yan Chitong and Xue Feng appeared by his side. “Cough.” King True Martial coughed, his face pale.
“You are injured? What happened?” asked Li Guan. Qin Wu and Luo Tang also realized that something was amiss.
King True Martial explained with a smile, “We encountered the birth of an Origins treasure, so we got Junior Brother Yan and Xue to hide in a small grotto-heaven. The remaining three of us joined forces to grab the treasure. We were lucky and managed to acquire it.”
“An Origins treasure?” The Supremacies revealed looks of delight.
“This time, apart from the Origins treasure, we also obtained another valuable treasurethe Spacetime Floating Ice,” said King True Martial. “The other treasures are rather ordinary. By the way, there’s still more good news. Junior Brother Xue Feng has broken through and reached the Dharma Domain realm. He has also mastered the Fifteen Golden Wind Swords.”
Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang were pleasantly surprised when they heard that.
“Describe what happened in the World Gap,” said Li Guan with a smile. At the same time, he carefully observed Xue Feng.

chapters.title: Chapter 320 - On the Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 320 On the Mountain
Meng Chuan and the other Marquis Godfiends listened obediently. King Calm Sea didn’t say a word as King True Martial chuckled and said, “Everything went smoothly. We spent the rest of our time cultivating in the World Gap. We had two major battles because of the Spacetime Floating Ice and the Origins treasure. The first time was a month after we entered the World Gap. There were two peak fifth Firmament demon monarchs, Greater Demon Monarch Black Wind and City Lord White Cloud. Thankfully, Junior Brother Meng’s movement technique is outstanding. It was quite easy for us to snatch the treasures before killing a demon monarch.”
“Meng Chuan’s movement technique?” Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang looked at Meng Chuan.
“Junior Brother Meng played a huge role in both battles. If it weren’t for him, the demons would definitely have snatched the Origins treasure. If the fire pheasant greater demon monarch had flown alone, we might not have been able to catch up with it without Junior Brother Meng,” said King True Martial wistfully.
King Calm Sea, who had been silent for a long time, finally said, “The credit first goes to Senior Brother Wang, followed by Junior Brother Meng.”
When Meng Chuan heard that, he immediately said, “All the hard work in dealing with the enemy was thanks to my two senior brothers. I only contributed my speed.”
“If it weren’t for Junior Brother Xue, I wouldn’t have been able to kill Blood Shura. We also mightn’t have been able to obtain the Origins treasure,” said King True Martial.
“Haha, that’s enough. We understand.” Li Guan chuckled. “How’s your cultivation progress?”
“Our progress is slow, but the three juniorswho are still at the Darkstar realm-have gained quite a bit,” said King True Martial. “After two months in the World Gap, Junior Brother Yan reached the peak of the Realm of Dao. After half a year, Junior Brother Xue Feng mastered the Fifteen Golden Wind Swords and reached the Dharma Domain realm. After nine months, Junior Brother Meng reached the peak of the Realm of Dao.”
He knew what the Supremacies were concerned about, so he shared the key points.
“Oh?” The three Supremacies nodded slightly when they heard that. This was within their expectations.
“The Spacetime Floating Ice and Origins treasure has to be handed to the sect. You can’t use them anyway,” said Li Guan. “We will award you credits based on your individual contributions. As for the other treasures? You can keep them. If you can’t use them, you can also hand them to the sect for credits.”
“Let’s exchange them for credit.”
Meng Chuan, Yan Chitong, and Xue Feng began to take out the treasures they obtained. Many of these treasures were unheard of, so it was naturally difficult for them to put to good use. Meng Chuan had acquired many spoils of war in the past few years. For example, he had given almost all of the spoils of war he had obtained from killing fourth and fifth Firmament demon monarchs to the sect. This allowed Meng Chuan to accumulate over 1.1 billion credits! Most of the credits were from killing underground demon monarchs.
He accumulated more than one million credits every day. After two years of hunting, his total was astonishing. In regards to accumulating credits, even King True Martial and King Calm Sea couldn’t compare to Meng Chuan. In the entire human world, only King White Treasure had accumulated an equally astonishing amount of credits.
“Xue Feng’s two treasures are worth 80 million credits altogether. Yan Chitong’s three treasures are worth 90 million credits. Meng Chuan’s three treasures are also worth 90 million credits.” Li Guan quickly made a judgment on the approximate value of the treasures. “The distribution of credits for the Spacetime Floating Ice and the Origins treasure will be given to you after we carefully examine them.”
Meng Chuan and company listened.
“The three of you came out about a month early. Do you plan on entering again?” Li Guan looked at the three Godfiends.
“There’s no need,” said Meng Chuan, Yan Chitong, and Xue Feng.
After watching the birth of a world for so long, an additional month didn’t make much of a difference.
“Alright. King True Martial and King Calm Sea will stay behind. The three of you can return first,” said Li Guan. “If there’s anything you wish to exchange for, you can ask Elder Yi for it.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan and company bowed.
Yan Chitong and Xue Feng’s contributions were decided. There were no other variables that could affect how much credits they earned. Meng Chuan would receive credits for his contribution in obtaining the Spacetime Floating Ice and Origins treasure, but he didn’t care about it.
Meng Chuan and company flew away.
“Senior Brother Meng, I’ll trouble you with the matter regarding my brother, Yan Jin,” said Xue Feng via voice transmission.
“Leave it to me. I’ll meet him later,” replied Meng Chuan via voice transmission.
Xue Feng was relieved. He and Yan Chitong went to Treasure Repository first. After all, they had been “poor” for too long. There were many things they wanted to exchange for. Meng Chuan flew to Bright Scenic Peak to meet his children.
Bright Scenic Peak, Meng Chuan’s cave abode —which was also Meng An’s cave abode now.
When he arrived, his children were rather excited.
“Dad.”
“Dad.”
Meng You and Meng An were very happy to see their father.
“Hey.” Meng Chuan looked at his children and nodded in satisfaction. His son, Meng An, came to the mountain at the age of 13. Back then, he looked like a young teenager. Now, he was 16 years old. Due to his cultivation, he was a handsome youth. His daughter, Meng You, had also grown up. His daughter had changed tremendously.
“How’s life on the mountain?” asked Meng Chuan.
“It’s very lively on the mountain,” said Meng An immediately. “Us fellow disciples often spar and compete with each other.”
“It’s lively?” Meng Chuan was taken aback before coming to a realization. Back when he and Liu Qiyue were cultivating on the mountain, it wasn’t that lively. Most of their fellow disciples cultivated alone. They would only attend gatherings at Dao Exchange Peak occasionally. Now that the demon monarchs lurked everywhere in the world, most Great Solar Godfiends stayed on the mountain. There were many more Godfiends than before, so it was naturally much more lively. Many Godfiends, especially Great Solar Godfiends, had slow improvement. It was no longer suitable for them to cultivate arduously. Gatherings, spars, and competitions naturally increased. “It’s very lively.” Meng You smiled happily. “Many senior brothers are pursuing my sister,” said Meng An immediately. “Oh?” Meng Chuan’s heart tightened. Chasing after my daughter? I have to vet them! Don’t try to cheat my daughter.
“I ignored them all,” said Meng You immediately. “It’s naturally more important to cultivate to become a Godfiend first.”
“That’s right. The two of you are only 16 years old. Work hard to become Godfiends,” said Meng Chuan. “How’s your cultivation?”
Meng You said, “The Azure Lotus Divine Body I chose is rather difficult to cultivate. Uncle Yan often guides me, allowing my cultivation to be much smoother. I’ve already attained Lesser Mastery of the Azure Lotus Divine Body, but Greater Mastery might take another year. As for Perfection, I’m not confident.”
“Don’t be anxious. Just take it one step at a time. It’s fine if you spend a few more years.” Meng Chuan was rather satisfied. She had already attained Lesser Mastery of the Azure Lotus Divine Body? Yan Jin was even helping her?“The Samsara Divine Body I chose is indeed rather difficult. I haven’t mastered it despite spending three years on it,” said Meng An softly.
“Do you want to switch to another Godfiend body formula?” asked Meng Chuan. “There’s no need. I’m confident I can master it.” Meng An’s eyes were filled with confidence. “I’ve already mastered three different Intents. I have some ideas about the remaining two.”
Meng Chuan felt poignant when he heard that. His son’s talent was much higher than his. Meng An had attained three different Intents at the age of 16!
The Samsara Divine Body was created by Ancestral Master Archean Eon. The Samsara spear art was the most profound technique of the human race. Meng Chuan agreed with his son’s chosen path. However, it was too difficult to attain basic mastery. Only by comprehending five different elemental Intents and fusing them into the Samsara Intent could one master the Samsara Divine Body. Meng An was a peerless genius, and he was very compatible with the Samsara spear art. Even so, it remained difficult for him to master the Samsara Divine Body.
After a long chat and dinner with his children, Meng Chuan headed to Fluttering Snow Peak to meet Yan Jin.
Snowflakes flew everywhere. It snowed most of the year here.
“Meng Chuan, you’re here.” Yan Jin took the initiative to come to the entrance of his cave abode to welcome Meng Chuan. He had also been part of a Godfiend team a few years ago. As he fought with other Godfiends in life-and-death battles, his cold bearingwhich kept people at bay—had lightened significantly. However, he still didn’t have many friends. He only had a handful of friends on Archean Mountain.
“How’s life on the mountain?” Meng Chuan smiled as he walked in.

chapters.title: Chapter 321 - Reading Manuals
chapters.content:
Chapter 321 Reading Manuals
“It’s a little boring.” Yan Jin walked by his side and said, “Previously, we were in Godfiend patrol teams and often had the chance to fight demon monarchs. Now that the prefecture and county cities have been abandoned, Great Solar Godfiends like us won’t be of much use.”
Meng Chuan smiled and said, “Some Great Solar Godfiends are still needed down the mountain.”
“They are only allowed to leave the mountain because they are older,” said Yan Jin. “Some of our senior brothers and sisters are in charge of Earth Net’s investigations. Some are in charge of defending large cities.”
“You’re still young, and you cultivate a transcendent-grade Godfiend body. Archean Mountain still has great hopes for you,” said Meng Chuan.
Yan Jin walked to the hall and sat down. “Sit.” He then poured a cup of alcohol for Meng Chuan and said, “One has the highest chance of becoming a Marquis Godfiend before the age of 60. After the age of 60, one’s probability of becoming a Marquis Godfiend will gradually decrease. I’m the same age as you. I only have eight years left before I’m 60. I don’t have any confidence in becoming a Marquis Godfiend in eight years.”
“Despite being stuck at a bottleneck, breakthroughs can happen at any time.” Meng Chuan flipped his hand and took out a treasure box.
“Oh?” Yan Jin said in surprise, “You aren’t using a storage bag?” “Don’t let others know about it,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “It’s a small pocket grotto-heaven that I carry with me. There aren’t many people who know about it.”
Yan Chitong and Xue Feng knew. Meng Chuan’s had greater trust in Yan Jin than in most others.
“A small pocket grotto-heaven?” Yan Jin exclaimed.
“Here.” Meng Chuan handed the treasure box to Yan Jin. “This is a unique treasure I obtained by chance. It’s useful for you, so I’m giving it to you.”
“For me?” Yan Jin smiled. They were good friends that had experienced life-and-death battles together when they were young. They cultivated together in Archean City and entered Archean Mountain together. Since they had a good relationship, it was normal for them to give each other gifts.
Yan Jin opened the wooden box curiously and saw an ice lotus flower inside. Flames flickered on the ice lotus flower’s pistils. Ice and fire… were perfectly combined within this lotus flower.
“This is…” Yan Jin’s heart skipped a beat. He cultivated the Azure Lotus Divine Body and dual-wielded swords. He also cultivated the Black Metal Sutra, Icefire Seven Absolutes. He had a deep understanding of ice and fire. Upon seeing the ice lotus flower that had ice and fire coexisting, he was immediately triggered. Soon, he reacted and looked at Meng Chuan. “This is too precious.” “It’s nothing much,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “For example, my small pocket grotto-heaven is ten times more expensive than this! As for the ice lotus flower… it’s just one of my many treasures. This ice lotus flower isn’t anything to me. Don’t reject me if you call me brother. In the future, kill more demon monarchs when you become a Marquis Godfiend. We humans lack powerful Godfiends in this war.”
Yan Jin looked at Meng Chuan and nodded. “Alright.”
“That’s the way,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “By the way, I still have to thank you for guiding You’er.”
“Meng You is quite talented.” Yan Jin nodded. “At the very least, she’s more talented than I was back then.”
“Yan Jin, you’re the same age as me. My children are already on Archean Mountain and are about to become Godfiends, but you’re still single,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “Does any woman catch your fancy? When do you plan on getting married?” “It’s good to be alone,” said Yan Jin calmly. “I like the feeling of being alone. I don’t like having too many people. It’s too noisy!” The two drank and ate, chatting until midnight before Meng Chuan returned.
Late at night, Yan Jin stood at the entrance of the cave abode and watched Meng Chuan leave amidst the snow.
“He’s gone again.” Yan Jin closed the door to his cave abode and returned to his chamber. He took out the wooden box from his storage bag and looked at the ice lotus flower in the wooden box. As Yan Jin stared at the ice lotus flower, he whispered, “Meng Chuan, thank you.”
When Meng Chuan returned to his cave abode, he saw Xue Feng hiding in the darkness near the entrance.
Xue Feng walked out of the darkness. “He accepted it?” Xue Feng looked at Meng Chuan.
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded.
“That’s good, that’s good.” Xue Feng heaved a sigh of relief. “Remember, keep it a secret. Once he knows that I gave it to you, he will definitely return it to me.”
“It will be kept a secret.” Meng Chuan nodded. “But your estrangement…” “Sigh, it’s mainly because of my father’s temper. The Xue family owes my younger brother a lot.” Xue Feng sighed again before saying, “Thank you for your help. I’ll take my leave first. I have to leave Archean Mountain immediately and return to defend the city.”
Meng Chuan nodded and watched Xue Feng leave.
The next morning, Meng Chuan went to the Treasure Repository to visit Elder Yi.
“Junior Brother Meng.” Elder Yi warmly welcomed Meng Chuan and led him into a tea room. Elder Yi sat cross-legged and brewed some tea for Meng Chuan. “Have some tea.”
“I’m here because I want all Black Metal Sutras and Heaven-level techniques that involve the lightning lineage,” said Meng Chuan. “I want to read them. By the way, I don’t need the Heart Intent Saber and World Roving Dragon Saber.”
“Oh?” Elder Yi hesitated for a moment. “Junior Brother Meng, are you sure you want all of them? Archean Mountain has a long history. We have plenty of Heaven-level lightning lineage techniques.” “All of them,” said Meng Chuan. “Alright.” Elder Yi stood up. “I’ll go look for them. Wait for me here.”
After a while, Elder Yi returned to the tea room after Meng Chuan finished his cup of tea.
“Archean Mountain has a total of eight Black Metal Sutras involving the lightning lineage. You don’t need the Heart Intent Saber or World Roving Dragon Saber. The remaining six techniques are here.” Elder Yi placed six black metal plates on the table. They looked ordinary and didn’t have any illustrations. With a wave of his hand, piles of black books appeared beside him. The number of books was astonishing.
“These are the Heaven-level techniques of the lightning lineage,” said Elder Yi solemnly. “Heaven-level techniques are only at the Dharma Domain level. At most, one or two moves will reach the Grotto-Heaven realm. Therefore, they didn’t have the luxury of using Meteorite Metal for legacy impartation. The number of times that a legacy can impart intent guidance is naturally limited. Each instance of intent guidance will deplete the intent legacy. After about 20 instances of intent guidance, the intent legacy will be depleted.
“Therefore, readers need to be very careful.” Elder Yi looked at Meng Chuan. “If there’s no need, it’s best you don’t read it. Read it only when there’s a need! After reading it, you will be obligated to write a new legacy if you master it.”
Meng Chuan nodded. Legacies were obviously very precious.
“These are the lightning lineage Heaven-level techniques that contain intent legacies. There are 322 books in total. There are also books here that have depleted intent legacies; they only have textual descriptions. There are 619 of them.” Elder Yi waved his hand again, and a large pile of books appeared beside him.
“By the way, why do you suddenly want to read so many manuals?” Elder Yi asked curiously. “These manuals are filled with all kinds of different things. Many of them aren’t the same as yours.”
“I just want to read them,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. After seeing the purple lightning and painting the Fifteen Lightning Forms, he had a good understanding of lightning. Only a portion of the knowledge from the Heart Intent Saber and the World Roving Dragon Saber was usable to him. Now, he wanted to draw upon the wisdom of his seniors and lay the foundation for his future cultivation. Only by standing on the shoulders of his predecessors could he see further.“Alright, you can read them if you want to.” Elder Yi pointed at the six Black Metal Sutras. “These six Black Metal Sutras are spear techniques, hammer techniques, movement techniques, sword techniques, and so on. They aren’t saber techniques. Archean Mountain also doesn’t have the original copy of Lightning Devastator Saber.”
Meng Chuan nodded. It didn’t matter if it was a saber art or not. What he wanted was the profundities contained in the lightning lineage techniques.
“These manuals are important. Archean Mountain only has one copy for many of them,” said Elder Yi. “I’ll arrange a courtyard for you at the library. You can rest in the courtyard and read these manuals. Return them to me after reading them.”
“Don’t worry.” Meng Chuan nodded. This was a collection accumulated thanks to the sect’s long history.
Manuals were the core of a sect. These Heaven-level techniques’ intent legacies would be depleted after they were used more than 20 times. If disciples were allowed to cultivate anything they wanted, dozens of disciples were enough to deplete the intent legacies. Therefore, there were various restrictions when it came to learning. One had to ensure that the people that used the intent legacies could master the technique and produce new legacies. Only by doing things this way could it be passed down for generations.
Whoosh. Meng Chuan waved his hand and put away all the manuals. “Elder Yi, please lead the way,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“Actually, it’s not a good thing to read too many manuals.” Elder Yi walked in front and muttered, “Just follow what you are good at. Reading too much unrelated stuff can sometimes serve to confuse you.”
Meng Chuan didn’t say a word. From his point of view, these manuals were all ‘nutrients’ that allowed him to advance in the lightning lineage.

chapters.title: Chapter 322 - Compensation (Final C.of Volume)
chapters.content:
Chapter 322 Compensation (Final Chapter of Volume)
The Treasure Repository occupied quite a large area. There were 12 treasure vaults that stored common treasures. There were also courtyards beside the treasure vaults. Elder Yi usually lived there.
“Junior Brother Meng, you can stay here. I’ll be next door.” Elder Yi pointed at a courtyard. “If there’s anything, feel free to look for me at any time.”
“Thanks.” Meng Chuan smiled and entered the courtyard. There were seven to eight rooms in the courtyard. Meng Chuan walked into the study and sat by the window, basking in the spring sun. He flipped his hand and took out a Black Metal Sutra. Upon sensing the infinite ferocity contained within, he understood that this Black Metal Sutra was the legendary Heavenly Lightning Pike Art. It was famous for its ferocity.
Meng Chuan’s consciousness entered the Black Metal Sutra, and the legacy’s intent guidance began.
A savage-looking man, dressed in beast hide, emitted a barbaric aura. He held a blood-stained, dark-red pike as he stood on the vast land. He calmly began to execute his pike art.
It’s said that a nameless expert created the Heavenly Lightning Pike Art during the ancient tribal era. Back then, even Archean Mountain hadn’t been formed. The senior that created this pike art was known as Supremacy Heavenly Lightning.
Boom!
Pikes and spears were different. A pike’s shaft was harder, and it didn’t change much when used. It was more savage and direct. The savage man struck out with his pike, producing a thunderous roar. Every strike was extremely ferocious, but it formed a continuously-building momentum. This reminded Meng Chuan of the lightning tree formed by the boundless purple lightning in the World Gap. Every movement of the savage’s pike was likely heavenly lightning.
A large number of lightning bolts shot out one after another, forming a lightning tree.
Boom!
Boom!
Towards the end, the pike’s might became even more powerful. He was clearly executing even more profound moves. The strength behind the pike attacks became more and more terrifying. Every time the pike was thrust out, it naturally produced a deep rumble of thunder.
as
Boom! During the final thrust, endless lightning gathered in the air, causing the void to tremble. The pike gathered thousands of lightning bolts—which smote the ground simultaneously. Following that, it spread out in all directions. The ground exploded, producing a huge crater over 50 kilometers in size. The huge crater connected with the surrounding rivers. As the water flowed in, the water level in the huge crater rose and formed a huge lake that spanned 50 kilometers.
The savage man looked over calmly with his pike in hand. The corners of his mouth curled into a smile, and his eyes were filled with anticipation. This level of attack was something he expected from the juniors that obtained his ultimate technique.
Meng Chuan’s consciousness separated from the Black Metal Sutra. He nodded slightly and exclaimed, “What a powerful pike art. The Heavenly Lightning Pike is like a bolt of heavenly lightning. The entire Heavenly Lightning Pike Art has 49 stances. All of them are offensive in nature. I think that the core of the Heavenly Lightning Pike Art is very similar to the Fifteen Lightning Forms’s Perfect Harmonization Form of Destruction.”
He pondered for a moment. The purple lightning in the World Gap was even more ethereal and illusory. The execution of the Heavenly Lightning Pike Art allowed Meng Chuan to have a deeper understanding of Perfect Harmonization Form of Destruction.
Next Black Metal Sutra. Meng Chuan picked up another Black Metal Sutra and sensed its content. It’s the Lightning Snake Phantom Movement Technique.
The Lightning Snake Phantom Movement Technique was rather famous. After all, it was a Black Metal Sutra ultimate technique. However, it was inferior to the World Roving Dragon Saber!
It’s like a phantom and illusion? After accepting the legacy, Meng Chuan came to a realization. It leans towards the Yin-Yang Form of lightning. Yin-Yang changes in unpredictable ways. The World Roving Dragon Saber is more imposing in comparison. It perfectly combines the two different essences in Roving Dragon Form and Nine Heavenly Forms. This is why the World Roving Dragon Saber is superior to the Lightning Snake Phantom Movement Technique. Even though they were both Creation-level techniques, there were still differences in strength.
However, I can also use this movement technique to gain deeper insights into the Yin-Yang Form of Lightning. Meng Chuan was very satisfied. This was an ultimate technique created by a human senior. He could use it to gain insights into the Yin-Yang Form of Lightning much faster.
Meng Chuan read each manual carefully. Many of the six Black Metal Sutras and nearly 1,000 Heaven-level techniques were related to his Fifteen Lightning Forms. Of course, some also had nothing to do with his Fifteen Lightning Forms. Meng Chuan felt that they didn’t suit his temperament, so he naturally abandoned them.
There’s too many. I have to analyze and sort out every ultimate technique carefully. It will take three years to study all the ultimate techniques even if I study one a day. I have to prioritize them. Yes, I’ll think about it after I return.
Meng Chuan spent nine days to accept all intent legacies and memorize all the ultimate techniques. After all, he had a fourth-level Essence Soul. He never forgot what he had experienced
Knock! Knock! Knock!
Meng Chuan walked out of the courtyard and knocked on Elder Yi’s door.
Elder Yi opened the door and looked at Meng Chuan. He greeted Meng Chuan with a smile. “Junior Brother Meng.”
“I’ve finished reading all the manuals. It’s time to return them,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. Reading the manuals cost Meng Chuan more than 120 million credits. Every Archean Mountain Godfiend had one free chance to read one manual.
The Black Metal Sutras and Heaven-level techniques—which didn’t have an intent legacy-were very cheap. However, Heaven-level techniques that had intent legacies were expensive. The more he read, the greater the cost. Meng Chuan spent over 100 million credits to sweep through the lightning lineage techniques.
To Meng Chuan, this small amount of credits wasn’t much! He had plenty of credit! He couldn’t finish spending it even if he wanted to!
“Master, Supremacies.” Meng Chuan came to Grotto-Heaven Pavilion and greeted Li Guan and company.
The three Supremacies sat there drinking tea.
“Meng Chuan, you have contributed greatly during the snatchings of the Spacetime Floating Ice and Origins treasure.” Li Guan held a teacup and smiled at the young Godfiend. It was a blessing for humans to have such a young, strong Godfiend in this critical period.
“When a world is born, there usually wouldn’t be more than ten Origins treasures being born. Every one of them is a priceless treasure,” continued Li Guan. “However, due to what the sect has, the credits handed out are controlled. Your contributions rank second. The three of us have discussed and have decided to give you 500 million credits.”
“Okay.” Meng Chuan was very calm.
“Meng Chuan accumulates credits the fastest in Archean Mountain. A year of underground reconnaissance is hundreds of millions of credits. Even for him, 500 million credits is quite a lot,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “Do you have anything you want? You have contributed a lot,” asked Li Guan.
VII
“Nothing.” Meng Chuan shook his head. He had long exchanged for the cultivation resources he needed. In fact, the sect hadn’t publicized the existence of a few treasures, so Meng Chuan naturally didn’t know about them. For example, one of the eight cardinal treasures—the Heart Questioning Bead. These treasures were priceless. Archean Mountain needed to employ its limited resources where they were needed most.
“You are still weak,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “Once you become a Regis Godfiend, there will be some treasures you can use. When the time comes, I’ll give you a new book that lists the available items.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
King Calm Sea’s famous defensive treasure, Scarlet Cloud Heaven, required a Regis Godfiend’s Seamless Quintessential Essence to be activated. Darkstar Quintessential Essence was too weak to activate the treasure.
“King True Martial gave some of his spoils of war-which he obtained during your trip to the World Gap-to the sect,” said Qin Wu. “One of them should be of great use to your wife, Liu Qiyue.” Qin Wu handed a book covered in a snow-white beast hide to Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan received the book. He flipped through the book, and every page was filled with paintings. Only when he flipped to the end did he see the detailed description of the ultimate technique.
“Phoenix Flight?” Meng Chuan looked at the name of the ultimate technique. It had been 800 years since the war against the demons began. Human Godfiends had naturally learned the language of the demons. Meng Chuan—who had condensed an Essence Soul —had mastered it after reading it once.
“That’s right. Phoenix Flight,” said Qin Wu. “Amongst the demons’ ultimate movement techniques, it can be ranked in the top five. It doesn’t have an intent legacy, but the book’s paintings are imprinted through ‘rubbing.’ They aren’t inferior to an intent legacy. This is because this comes from the Phoenix Monument Stone. The Phoenix Monument Stone is one of the demons’ core treasures. They are paintings of a true Phoenix’s flight on it. There are a total of 35 paintings. Ordinary materials that come close to the Phoenix Monument Stone will be reduced to dust. Therefore, it’s quite expensive to create a copy of the paintings.”
“According to our intelligence, the avian demon monarchs that cultivate Phoenix Flight can transform into phoenixes naturally,” said Li Guan. “Your wife, Liu Qiyue, has the phoenix bloodline. I believe she’s more suitable for cultivating Phoenix Flight than many demons.”
“An avian demon will transform into a phoenix after cultivating this?” Meng Chuan was somewhat shocked as he said immediately, “It’s best if such an important manual is left at Archean Mountain. I’ll just get Qiyue to come over and learn it.” “One requires to keep such a rubbing by their side. They have to peruse the paintings frequently to speed up their cultivation of the technique,” explained the illusory Qin Wu. “We have already recorded the contents of the manual. There is only one rubbing, so let Liu Qiyue use it first. When she is nearing the end of her lifespan, she can return it to the sect. By the way, we will deduct 50 million credits from you since you’re taking away the Phoenix Flight manual.”
“Alright,” replied Meng Chuan immediately. Fifty million credits were nothing to him.
“Liu Qiyue is now stationed in Changfeng City,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “You should go over as well. Guarding a city is a long-term mission. You can’t always be separated from your wife.”
“Okay.” Meng Chuan revealed a look of delight before saying in surprise, “Qiyue went to Changfeng City?”
“We will occasionally swap our defenses around so that the demons’ investigations aren’t of much use,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “Alright, you may head back if there’s nothing else.” “Yes, I’ll take my leave.” Meng Chuan bowed respectfully and left happily.
The three Supremacies had complicated looks as they watched Meng Chuan leave.
“From the results of their cultivation in the World Gap, Yan Chitong’s cultivation speed is faster than Meng Chuan’s,” said the illusory Luo Tang. “Xue Feng has also reached the Dharma Domain realm. On average, peerless geniuses take 30 years to reach the Dharma Domain realm from the peak of the Realm of Dao. Meng Chuan may need a lot more time.”
“His cultivation speed is relatively slow, but there’s no substitute for him!” said Li Guan. “Meng Chuan needs to become a Regis Godfiend. He also needs to reach the Blood Droplet realm. When that happens, he will be the greatest weapon against the million demon monarchs in our world. Let’s wait patiently. If his technique realm is still increasing slowly by the time he attains a fifth-level Essence Soul, we’ll use the Heart Questioning Bead on him.”
“He conducts a 12-hour long underground reconnaissance every day,” said Qin Wu. “That exhausts him on a daily basis. Just recovering his mental strength takes time, leaving him even less time to cultivate. If it were an ordinary Godfiend, they could cultivate almost the entire day while guarding a city. His cultivation speed will definitely be much faster than it is now if that was his job.”“Wiping out the underground demon monarchs is very important to the entire human race,” said Li Guan. “We can only trouble him.”
“This will go on for years… If the war doesn’t stop, Meng Chuan will need to keep carrying out underground reconnaissance.” Qin Wu sighed. “Compared to most Godfiends, it’s much harder for him. Furthermore, it’s destined to be tough for many years.”
“We have given him credits. If he can’t use it, he can give it to his wife and children,” said Li Guan. “Wasn’t the last phoenix feather and the Phoenix Flight manual given to Meng Chuan’s wife?”
Luo Tang sighed. “We are trying our best to make up for him. Now, we hope that Meng Chuan can become a Regis Godfiend soon.”
Qin Wu hesitated for a moment before saying seriously, “In my opinion, it’s better to use it earlier than later. Let Meng Chuan use it earlier. The sooner he becomes a Regis Godfiend, the more demon monarchs he can kill.”
The Heart Questioning Bead could help Meng Chuan’s cultivation advance significantly.
“We’ll decide depending on the war’s situation,” said Li Guan.
Final Chapter of Volume-World Gap

chapters.title: Chapter 323 - Burning Lifespan
chapters.content:
Chapter 323 Burning Lifespan
Changfeng City. Inside an elegant manor. Liu Qiyue was dressed in a loose cyan robe as she practiced her calligraphy in the study. The petals fluttered outside the window amidst the spring wind. It was a colorful and beautiful sight.
Oh? She sensed something and turned her head. A figure had already appeared in the courtyard. It was Meng Chuan.
“Ah Chuan.” Liu Qiyue revealed a look of surprise. She put down her brush and ran out of the study.
“Qiyue.” Meng Chuan missed his wife very much. The couple looked at each other.
Ever since his wife was assigned to guard a city, Archean Mountain had strictly forbidden the Godfiends stationed in the various cities to leak information to their families, much less reunite with their families. This was also to prevent the demons from finding out who the defenders of each city were! Therefore, the couple hadn’t seen each other for nearly two years. “Ah Chuan.” Liu Qiyue gently hugged Meng Chuan and leaned against him.
Meng Chuan hugged his wife and enjoyed this rare reunion. Liu Qiyue whispered, “I missed you so much.”
“Me too,” said Meng Chuan softly. “We can be together forever in the future.” “Yes, Archean Mountain has already given the order,” said Liu Qiyue. “Guarding a city will be a permanent job. Therefore, the Godfiends stationed here can arrange to have three family members or friends live with them. It just needs to be kept a secret.”
Meng Chuan understood.
The couple sat down in the hall. Liu Qiyue brought out fruit snacks and brewed tea.
“I’ve been out of touch with the outside world for nearly a year.” Meng Chuan ate some snacks and asked, “How’s the world now?”
“The demons aren’t making any big moves.” Liu Qiyue’s eyes were filled with worry. “However, there are still demon monarchs constantly entering the human world from the various small and medium-sized World Entrances. There are too many of these entrances. We Godfiends can’t defend them at all. If this continues, more and more demon monarchs will enter the human world. According to our intelligence, there are at least 600,000 demon monarchs in the human world. I can’t help but feel uneasy when I think of so many demon monarchs hiding in the human world.”
“There are about 200 medium-sized World Entrances. There are even more small World Entrances. Furthermore, they are constantly increasing in number.” Meng Chuan nodded. “There are too few Marquis Godfiends. We will only be sending weak Godfiends to their deaths if we make them defend the World Entrances. There’s no way to put up a defense!”
“Something will happen with a million demon monarchs coming in,” said Liu Qiyue worriedly.
“We’ll deal with whatever comes our way,” said Meng Chuan. “Let’s be prepared. By the way, did anything else happen?”
“Good news.” Liu Qiyue smiled and said, “Two months ago, our Archean Mountain finally gave birth to a Regis Godfiend. It’s King Sword Nine.”
“King Sword Nine?” Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up as he sighed. “It’s been 50 years since Archean Mountain produced a Regis Godfiend. Archean Mountain now has 14 Regis Godfiends.”
It was very difficult to become a Regis Godfiend. Even a peerless genius-who could reach the Dharma Domain realm before the age of 90—found it difficult to guarantee that they would attain a third-level Essence Soul before the age of 90. Regis Godfiends had a 500-year lifespan. However, Archean Mountain only had 14 Regis Godfiends. This showed how difficult it was for a new Regis Godfiend to rise.
Sometimes, two or three geniuses of the same generation could become Regis Godfiends one after the other. Sometimes, it took 70 to 80 years to produce one Regis Godfiend.
“Sword Nine didn’t put much effort into his cultivation when he was young. He was a playboy, and his reputation wasn’t good either,” said Meng Chuan with a sigh. “Later, his elder brother entered the Godfiend Blood Pool and attempted the Life-and-Death juncture, but failed. It agitated him. He only started to cultivate seriously when he was 17 years old. He became a Godfiend at the age of 28. He wasn’t too dazzling among his peers. He became a Marquis Godfiend at the age of 66. He’s 109 this year, and he actually became a Regis Godfiend.
“He cultivates the Thirteen Swordbane Fiend Body,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “In history, those who cultivate the Thirteen Swordbane Fiend Body are famous for killing. However, he likes array formations. He uses the 13 Swordbanes to set up formations. Come, let’s have a drink.” Meng Chuan took out an alcohol flask from his Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead and said excitedly, “I have to drink now that I’ve heard the good news of the new Regis Godfiend.”
Liu Qiyue drank with him. An additional Regis Godfiend meant a gain in combat strength. A Thirteen Swordbane Fiend Body Regis Godfiend was extremely good at fighting.
The couple talked about the past two years and what happened in the World Gap. Even the demons knew about the World Gap, so its existence wasn’t confidential.
“By the way, this is for you.” Meng Chuan handed the book wrapped in a beast hide to his wife.
“What’s this?” Puzzled, Liu Qiyue received it. She found it very soft. This book was made of a mysterious white beast hide. When she flipped open the book, she saw a painting of flying phoenix etched in it. Liu Qiyue’s heart trembled as she immersed herself in it.
She looked at it for over an hour. The sun set and the sky turned dark.
“Phoenix Flight.” Liu Qiyue looked up at her husband. “Where did this come from?”
“It’s from the demons. Master said that this is a movement technique. It should be suitable for your cultivation,” said Meng Chuan.
“Yes, just looking at the painting makes my blood boil.” Liu Qiyue was very excited. “I’ll give it a try.” The moment she finished speaking, she rushed out of the hall and flew into the sky to test the movement technique.
Whoosh.
An extremely beautiful, fiery divine bird appeared in the sky. This divine bird spread its wings and flew. Its tail feathers were long and beautiful. It flew back and forth above the manor, leaving behind a beautiful trajectory.
Meng Chuan sighed in amazement. This divine bird is a phoenix?
The divine bird was a phenomenon formed by flames. Liu Qiyue was inside the divine bird. When Liu Qiyue used the movement technique, she isolated light from the outside world. However, Meng Chuan could still see her clearly with his electromagnetic domain.
Whoosh.
The fiery divine bird landed on the ground. The flames dissipated in midair, leaving an incredulous Liu Qiyue.
“Ah Chuan, this is the best technique for Phoenix Divine Body cultivators.” Liu Qiyue looked at Meng Chuan. “I feel like I’ve really become a divine bird-a phoenix. I even have a direction towards reaching the Dharma Domain realm for fire.”
“You have a direction towards the Dharma Domain realm?” Meng Chuan was happy for his wife.
“Yes, during the battle at the garrison, I cast Phoenix’s Nirvana and shot five fourth Firmament demon monarchs with nine arrows. Only one fourth Firmament demon monarch managed to escape. As I maintained Phoenix’s Nirvana, I reached the peak of the Realm of Dao. However, I didn’t have any idea on how to reach the Dharma Domain realm.” Liu Qiyue was excited. “I saw the direction today.”
Meng Chuan gently hugged his wife. “I read from your letter that you expended 12 years of your lifespan.”
“The stronger one is, the purer one’s phoenix bloodline will be. The more one’s strength increases when undergoing nirvana, the faster one’s lifespan will be drained.” Liu Qiyue nodded. “I used 12 years of my lifespan by shooting nine arrows. The rate of expenditure is indeed much faster than when I was a Great Solar Godfiend.”
When she was a Great Solar Godfiend, she had cast Phoenix’s Nirvana once. That single usage expended 18 years of her lifespan.
“The lifespan you have burned all these years has exceeded 30 years.” Meng Chuan looked at his wife, his heart aching.
“It’s worth it when used to kill demon monarchs.” Liu Qiyue smiled at Meng Chuan.

chapters.title: Chapter 324 - Saber Practice At Night
chapters.content:
Chapter 324 Saber Practice At Night
Meng Chuan’s heart still ached for his wife. After all, she had consumed her lifespan.
“I can also choose not to use Phoenix’s Nirvana,” said Liu Qiyue with a smile. “However, if I had chosen to do that, I wouldn’t have been able to defeat six fourth Firmament demon monarchs with just Marchioness Plum Snow and me. I’d also have been in grave danger of dying. Countless commoners—who we were defending-would have died. As for using Phoenix’s Nirvana, I killed five people easily. Only one managed to escape. When I underwent Nirvana, my insights into fire improved. My Essence Soul improved as well. I believe that in this era, many Godfiends hope to be capable of unleashing such bursts of strength.”
“I understand. You have to be more careful about your lifespan. It’s best if you become a Regis Godfiend as soon as possible,” said Meng Chuan.
His wife had drained over 30 years of her lifespan. In addition to her current age, she was less than ten years away from being 90 years old. Could she become a Regis Godfiend in ten years? Even though his wife had used the phoenix feather to purify her bloodline and had begun cultivating Phoenix Flight, Meng Chuan wasn’t optimistic.
A night passed.
Meng Chuan had a rare good sleep. He hadn’t slept for a single moment in the World Gap.
The sky slowly brightened when he woke up. Meng Chuan and his wife ate breakfast together.
an a
“Marquis Eastcalm?” An old woman arrived. When she saw Meng Chuan and his wife, she couldn’t help but grin.
“Marchioness Plum Snow,” greeted Meng Chuan politely. He respected the Godfiends that were nearing the end of their lifespans. “Thank you for taking care of Qiyue for the past two years.”
“Don’t say that,” said the old woman with a smile. “I was just supporting her. I rely on Junior Sister Liu to kill enemies.”
The old woman very familiarly scooped a bowl of porridge and said with a smile, “I’ve been eating breakfast with Junior Sister Liu for the past two years. It looks like I won’t need to do so in the future. I can spend more time with my great-grandchildren.”
Liu Qiyue smiled brightly.
“It’s been a long time since I saw you smile so happily.” The old woman smiled.
Meng Chuan finished his porridge and stood up. “Marchioness Plum Snow, duty calls. I’ll be taking my leave first.”
The old woman nodded. “Go ahead.”
Meng Chuan nodded at his wife before disappearing into the horizon.
“Unparalleled speed.” The old woman looked up. “He lives up to his reputation.”
Meng Chuan began his daily underground reconnaissance once again. He hadn’t been underground for nearly a year, so he was already somewhat rusty.
Whoosh.
Ever since he cultivated the World Roving Dragon Saber, Meng Chuan’s speed had increased tremendously. His underground reconnaissance speed was naturally much faster than before.
Swish!
Like a swimming lightning dragon, he traversed the deep underground. He kept the Divine Eye of Lightning at his glabella open, and his electromagnetic domain scanned his surroundings. Although he was now faster, he followed the same rules. He spent 12 hours underground
Boom.
Evening, in the western desert.
A figure soared into the sky. It was Meng Chuan. Meng Chuan flew to the northeast and headed straight for Changfeng City. With his Darkstar domain, he distorted the light around him.
I actually killed 193 underground demon monarchs today. My speed is much faster than a year ago. I can sweep through more places, but it shouldn’t have doubled my daily kill count. Yes, there must be an increasing number of demon monarchs hiding underground. King White Treasure is famous, so few demon monarchs hide underground in the Black Sand Dynasty. Most of them are in the Great Zhou Dynasty and the Great Yue Dynasty.
The demon monarchs hiding in the Great Zhou Dynasty’s underground kept increasing. These demon monarchs didn’t hide deep in the sea because that was too far away. Attacking human cities would be troublesome.
Changfeng City. Meng Chuan immediately swooped down when he saw the city below.
After dinner, Meng Chuan spent more than two hours painting. After that, he began to examine the various ultimate techniques of the lightning lineage. “Ah Chuan, aren’t you sleeping?” Liu Qiyue asked.
“I also need to cultivate. I hope to reach the Dharma Domain realm as soon as possible so that I can become a Regis Godfiend,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “I need to carry out underground reconnaissance during the day. I won’t be sleeping at night. I need to spend more time cultivating.”
“Can you take it?” Liu Qiyue asked worriedly.
“I didn’t sleep for almost a year in the World Gap. I managed to take it. My body can constantly maintain the optimum state. As for Essence Soul fatigue? I can recover during my daily painting session,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “Don’t worry. I’ll sleep a little when I’m really tired.”
“Alright.” Liu Qiyue nodded.
In the study, Meng Chuan began to sort out the ultimate techniques that he had memorized. Occasionally, he would write his findings on paper. In order to save time, he simply organized and classified them in different categories.
Speed. It’s an important characteristic of the lightning lineage. Even if they don’t deliberately aim for speed, lightning lineage cultivators will be very fast. They are also fast when attacking. I can draw upon the wisdom of others and fuse it with my ideas to create the moves I need.Although the Heart Intent Saber is known as the swiftest saber art in the world, it’s still not fast enough for me. This is because it values the Yin-Yang Annihilation forces significantly. That ends up affecting its speed. My saber art needs to have my Flash Form of Lightning’s essence be the core. The rest are just auxiliary. I will pursue ultimate speed.
Meng Chuan pondered about his cultivation path. After seeing the purple lightning and painting the Fifteen Lightning Forms, he believed that the Flash Form of Lightning was the pinnacle of pure speed. It was like lightning, like light! Wherever light could reach, the saber could too!
This path wasn’t based on pure speed alone. From the purple lightning, Meng Chuan could tell that when one’s speed reached an unimaginable level, it would contain an annihilative might that could tear through the River of Spacetime. Speed and power didn’t conflict. Many lightning lineage cultivators pursued speed and realized that they weren’t powerful enough. This was because they weren’t fast enough!
