The faster the saber became, the more devastating the saber strike would be. When one’s saber attack approached the speed of light, it was capable of tearing apart the River of Spacetime.
My conjectured saber art shall be named the Infinite Saber.The Infinite Saber’s extreme speed shall surpass all saber arts in history. I like the World Roving Dragon Saber very much. It’s as unrestrained as a painting in the world. However, it’s still not beautiful enough. It lacks color and isn’t gorgeous enough.
Meng Chuan looked at the saber art from an artist’s perspective. He felt that his World Roving Dragon Saber was still lacking. I’ll build upon the foundation of the Nine Heavenly Forms of Lightning and the Roving Dragon Form of Lightning. I’ll also fuse the Yin-Yang Form of Lightning into the saber art. By fusing the Yin-Yang Form of Lightning, there will be more variation to the World Roving Dragon Saber, adding color to it.
This saber art can really become a brush in the world. Meng Chuan was filled with anticipation. Amongst his two conjectured saber arts, the Infinite Saber art was extremely fast, but there were too few variations. In a life-and-death battle, if one’s speed was restrained, there was nothing they could do. The other saber art had an undecided name, but it was an extremely dazzling saber art. It was even more dazzling and beautiful than the World Roving Dragon Saber. There were more variations than the World Roving Dragon Saber!
One saber art had very few variations, while the other had all kinds of variations. When fighting an enemy, using a combination of the two saber arts would be extremely effective. Furthermore, the second saber art was also a movement technique. This unpredictable movement technique was best for close combat.
I have a direction towards the Dharma Domain realm for both saber arts. Time to begin cultivating. Meng Chuan walked out of the study and came to a small courtyard. He pulled out Demon Slayer and began cultivating in the dark.

chapters.title: Chapter 325 - New City
chapters.content:
Chapter 325 New City
In the middle of the night, Meng Chuan’s saber beams spread out like lightning. With his Darkstar domain isolating his attacks, he ensured that he didn’t damage the courtyard at all. No noises reached the outside world due to the isolation.
The cultivation process to reach the Dharma Domain realm was very difficult. Only peerless geniuses vaguely knew the direction they had to take. From the peak of the Realm of Dao to the Dharma Domain realm, it took peerless geniuses an average of 30 years. Others only saw the strength of Regis Godfiends, but they didn’t know how difficult the cultivation process was.
Many ideas needed to be rejected, and new ideas had to be confirmed. When he had the best techniques of the lightning lineage at hand, he could cultivate much faster when he used them as a basis for his cultivation.
Whoosh.
After a night of cultivation, the sky gradually brightened before Meng Chuan took a break. I can’t rush it. A house is built one brick at a time.
Every supreme expert had to endure loneliness before they succeeded. Some people that didn’t have a direction would sink into oblivion forever. A Godfiend’s world was just difficult. Archean Mountain only produced a Regis Godfiend once every few decades.
Days passed.
Meng Chuan’s life was very regular. Every day, he would ensure that he hunted underground for 12 hours. He only talked with his wife during breakfast and dinner. Painting was the only period of the day that he enjoyed. He could wander around his painting world and paint as he wished. This allowed his Essence Soul to relax and recover. After that, he would practice his saber arts the entire night.
Day after day, Meng Chuan repeated this routine. Meng Chuan only slept once every month or two, so he could relax his mind completely.
In the blink of an eye, it was autumn.
Evening.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan landed in the courtyard. Liu Qiyue sat in the courtyard alone, drinking tea in a daze.
“Qiyue.” Meng Chuan smiled as he walked over.
Liu Qiyue turned to look at Meng Chuan with a solemn expression. She handed a letter to Meng Chuan. “Archean Mountain sent this letter to you. Read it.”
“What’s wrong?” Seeing how solemn his wife was, Meng Chuan quickly took the letter.
The letter wasn’t long, but Meng Chuan’s heart sank. Last night, a super-large World Entrance and two large World Entrances appeared? Meng Chuan felt worried.
“The letter says that Black Sand Dynasty’s medium-sized city pass, Leviathan Jade Pass, and the Great Yue Dynasty’s medium-sized city pass, Qingji Pass, have expanded to the size of a large World Entrance,” said Liu Qiyue. “As for our Great Zhou Dynasty, a super-large World Entrance has appeared in An State. We have to build a super-large city pass around it.”
“There were only three super-large city passes in the world. This is the fourth,” said Meng Chuan. “A Creation Supremacy is required to guard it.” “Two World Island and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven also need to build new large city passes. They need Regis Godfiends to guard them,” said Liu Qiyue worriedly. “Although the pressure is great, our Archean Mountain needs a Creation Supremacy to guard the new super-large city pass. We may even need one or two Regis Godfiends to support the Creation Supremacy.” “Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded and frowned. “Although building a new super-large city pass will increase the pressure on us, it’s something we can handle. I’m worried that this isn’t a good sign if three World Entrances appeared overnight-two large and one super-large.”
“Ah Chuan, what do you mean?” Liu Qiyue looked at Meng Chuan.
“I’m worried that this is just the beginning,” said Meng Chuan softly.
This would make war even crueler.
Liu Qiyue nodded and said, “Actually, Godfiends have long discovered that more and more World Entrances are appearing. Twenty years ago, the three major sects completely abandoned all small and medium-sized World Entrances. However, this time, a super-large World Entrance and two large World Entrances appeared overnight. The thought scares me.”
“No matter how adverse our situation is, we can only face it,” said Meng Chuan. “The best way to deal with it is to become stronger.”
“Yes.” Liu Qiyue nodded.
“Let’s work hard to become Regis Godfiends.” Meng Chuan looked at his wife. “Becoming a Regis Godfiend will make us more useful.”
“Phoenix’s Nirvana has helped me greatly increase my technique realm. The Phoenix Flight has also helped me greatly,” said Liu Qiyue. “I might be able to break through and become a Regis Godfiend.”
Phoenix’s Nirvana would accelerate one’s aging and greatly reduce one’s lifespan. However, Marquis Godfiends could still maintain peak vitality until they were 90 years old. Even if they were over 90 years old, their vitality just started to decrease slowly. Therefore it was common for Marquis Godfiends to breakthrough and become a Regis Godfiend when they were slightly over 100 years old. There was still a 90% chance of success. For example, King Sword Nine became a Regis Godfiend at the age of 109.
However, the decline in vitality sped up past that. At 120 years of age, the success rate was only 60%. At 150 years of age, there was only a 10% chance of success. There was no need to mention the rest.
Liu Qiyue’s problem with Phoenix’s Nirvana was that it accelerated her aging speed even though it improved her cultivation. Therefore, Phoenix Divine Body Godfiends could definitely become Marquis Godfiends with their talents. However, there were very few Phoenix Divine Body Regis Godfiends in history. Liu Qiyue had used Archean Mountain’s last phoenix feather to purify her bloodline. She also cultivated Phoenix Flight, giving her a greater chance of becoming a Regis Godfiend.
The Great Zhou Dynasty, An State’s wilderness.
A huge World Entrance, spanning almost 15 kilometers, stood silently in the wilderness. On the other side of the World Entrance, the Demon Realm could be clearly seen. Demon monarchs were looking through the World Entrance.
“Qin Wu.” Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar and Qin Wu stood in the wilderness as they looked at the gigantic World Entrance. “In the future, you will have to preside over this place personally,” said Li Guan. “Your Swordbanes can envelop the entire World Entrance, so you don’t need a Regis Godfiend to assist you,
right?”
“There’s no need,” said Qin Wu.
Supremacy Luo Tang still needed the help of two Regis Godfiends to ensure that nothing unexpected happened to Luo Tang Pass. However, Qin Wu cultivated the Thirteen Swordbane Fiend Body-which was known for having the best long-range attacking prowess. His Swordbanes could completely envelop the World Entrance. Anyone who came through would die!
In terms of strength, Qin Wu was ranked in the top three among all current Creation Supremacies in the world. Previously, he was in charge of guarding the most important place, Archean Mountain. He was confident that he could guard a super-large city pass by himself.
“I’ll leave this to you,” said Li Guan. “A large city-matching the side of Luo Tang Pass and the imperial capital—will be built here. It will have a population of close to 30 million people.”
Since Qin Wu was guarding the city, they naturally built a city to protect more mortals.
“Senior Brother.” Qin Wu’s long hair draped over his shoulders. His eyes were filled with puzzlement as he inquired, “The World Gap is gradually expanding. The two worlds will become closer, and the World Entrances will increase in number. In the end, there might not be enough Creation Supremacies to guard super-large World Entrances. At that point, fifth Firmament demon monarchs can enter the human world freely. I’m worried that an even larger World Entrance—which allows the entry of demon sages-will appear. If that’s the case, will we really have to end the world? Will the only thing we can do is hide in Archean Mountain and pray for hope?”

chapters.title: Chapter 326 - Godfiend’s Identity
chapters.content:
Chapter 326 Godfiend’s Identity
“When that happens, we will have no other choice,” said Li Guan.
“To personally end the world, causing countless deaths...” Qin Wu shook his head. “It’s a nightmare.”
“If demon sages can enter as they please, a large group of demon sages can easily flatten the human world. Countless demons will occupy the human world. Humans will be food to the demons; they’ll be eaten. That would be even more tragic,” said Li Guan. “It’s better to... die instantly without any pain when we end the world.”
Li Guan revealed a smile as he looked at Qin Wu. “The two worlds are like two bubbles in the River of Spacetime. They can be very close to each other and even form a World Gap. However, they will eventually separate from each other.”
“How long will it take for the two worlds to separate?” asked Qin Wu.
“According to the past seniors that explored the River of Spacetime and gathered some information, since the World Gap has been born, it might take 1,000 years for the two worlds to separate,” said Li Guan.
“A thousand years?” Qin Wu fell silent.
“We will definitely win,” said Li Guan with a smile. “Perhaps one day, an Imperial Lord will be born. Perhaps a miracle will happen one day. As long as we persist... there will be hope.”
Qin Wu nodded.
There were two requirements for becoming an Imperial Lord. The first requirement depended on one’s technique realm. The second requirement depended on one’s Essence Soul. There were no age requirements. One’s technique realm had to reach the Imperial Lord level—the Heaven Earth realm. They also needed to attain a seventh-level Essence Soul.
Grandsire Yin Yang, Ancestral Master Guo Ke, and many other famous figures in history had reached the Heaven Earth realm, but their Essence Souls failed to meet the mark. Some had high Essence Soul cultivation talent and attained a seventh-level Essence Soul. However, their technique realm failed to reach the Heaven Earth realm.
Few humans in history had managed both. On average, an Imperial Lord was born once every 100,000 years.
From that day onwards, Black Sand Grotto-Heaven and Two World Island built large city passes-Leviathan Jade Pass and Qingji Pass. As for Archean Mountain, they built a super-large city pass-Sword Sovereign City.
Swoosh.
A stream of light flew through the sky; it was Meng Chuan, who was on his way home after a busy day.
was
What a big city.
While passing by An State, Meng Chuan came to the new city pass. The four city walls of Sword Sovereign City were 100 kilometers long each. Even Jiang State Capital, which had been expanded, was of such a standard. It could accommodate more than 20 million people.
It’s really lively. Meng Chuan watched as the huge city occupied the mountains and wilderness. One-third of the city was embedded in the mountain range. A large portion of the mountain had been dug out. This was very easy for Supremacy Qin Wu. The city walls were built simply and quickly. The countless buildings in the city were much more complicated. Under the guidance of Godfiends, countless mortals were constructing buildings.
Swoosh. A figure flew over.
Meng Chuan immediately welcomed him and bowed respectfully. “Master.”
“It’s been half a month since Sword Sovereign City was built. It’s your first time here.” Qin Wu smiled at his disciple.
“I happened to pass by,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. He was busy every day, hoping he could have twice the amount of time in a day.
“After you returned from the World Gap, your speed has increased greatly,” said Qin Wu. “You are killing underground demon monarchs even faster. In the past few months, the demons must have realized your existence. According to what I know, the demons have been investigating. They want to know which Archean Mountain Regis Godfiend is so skilled at underground reconnaissance. You have to be careful. Make sure to keep your identity a secret.”
“Don’t worry, Master.” Meng Chuan nodded. “Right now, there aren’t any fourth Firmament demon monarchs underground. They are all ordinary demon monarchs. Once I discover them, I kill them from afar. Those ordinary demon monarchs won’t even see me before they lose their lives. Even if they have divine powers like avatars, they won’t discover my identity.”
Qin Wu nodded and said, “You are ultimately a Marquis Godfiend. Although you can fight above your level, you only have the strength of a top Regis Godfiend. Once your identity is exposed, it won’t be difficult for the demons to kill you. For example, Demon Sage Nine Abyss may personally assassinate you. If that happens, you can only use the defensive stone talisman to protect yourself. However, the protective stone talisman will be expended after a single usage.” Meng Chuan nodded. “I understand.”
ldi
“Before becoming a Regis Godfiend, you have to keep your identity a secret. After all, you make the demons’ hearts ache with your demon monarch killing speed,” said Qin Wu.
“It’s good that their heart hurts.” Meng Chuan looked at the huge city below that was in the midst of construction. “I hope their hearts ache even more in the future. The more their hearts ache, the happier I will be.”
Qin Wu laughed and looked down. At this moment, a constant flow of people was entering Sword Sovereign City through the various city gates with their entire families. “It will be very safe here with me presiding over it,” said Qin Wu. “I will try my best to arrange for nearly 30 million people to be brought here from the wilderness.”
“It’s good for mortals.” Meng Chuan nodded. He could see the hope in the people’s eyes.
“Dad, what a big city.” A group of mortals with over 100 people-male and female, young and old-were pulling carts. Many of their clothes, bowls, and pans were placed on them. Children were happily running beside the adults, excitedly looking at the city as snot flowed from their noses.
“That’s right. I heard that this large city could hold more than 20 million people. It’s the largest city in our Great Zhou Dynasty. Kid, once you live in the city, you can train under the sun. There’s no need to hide,” said his father happily as he pulled the cart.
“I never expected our family to be able to enter a large city.” There was an old woman on the cart as well. She chuckled.
The hundreds of people in the team laughed happily.
To mortals, large cities were unbelievable, magical places. Many mortals dreamed of living in large cities for their entire lives.
Sword Sovereign City was newly built. It provided the lowest-level residence for free, but even that was ten times better than what they had in the wilderness.
Deep in the North Sea, inside a small grotto-heaven.
Demon Sage Nine Abyss, the black-robed man, and the yellow-robed man were gathered together.
“North Sense, congratulations on reaching the fifth Firmament,” said the yellow-robed man with a smile.
“We were demon sages. It’s naturally not difficult for us to recover to the fifth Firmament,” said the black-robed man. “I believe Brother Yellow Oscillate will soon reach the fifth Firmament.”
The yellow-robed man nodded. To them, restoring their demon sage strength was the most difficult thing. Even so, they still entered the human world via possession. This was because they could not see any hope in the Demon Realm. They had only the right to negotiate with the demon Imperial Lords when they were in the human world! Only then did they see hope.
“One super-large and two large World Entrances have recently appeared,” said Demon Sage Nine Abyss with a smile. “The situation is becoming more and more advantageous for us demons.”
The black-robed man smiled as well. “I heard that Supremacy Qin Wu is personally guarding the super-large World Entrance. Therefore, it’s named Sword Sovereign City.” Demon Sage Nine Abyss nodded. “Qin Wu is extremely talented. He was extremely dazzling 1,000 years ago. When he was a Regis Godfiend, he struck terror in Two World Island and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven with his kills with the Thirteen Swordbanes. Back then, he was known as the Sword Sovereign, indicating that his strength was above all Regis Godfiends. Later, after he broke through and became a Creation Supremacy, he became increasingly low-key. However, according to what we know, his strength is ranked in the top three among humans.”
“Bai Yaoyue, Qin Wu, and Li Guan should be the three strongest Creation realm humans,” said the black-robed man. “We have to avoid the three of them.”
“There are many demon monarchs in the world now. There’s no need for us to take action,” said Demon Sage Nine Abyss. “It’s been more than two years since the ceasefire. I’m guessing that some ancient Regis Godfiends are about to enter ‘fake deaths’ again. We have to begin our operation. We have to force these Regis Godfiends to stay awake and expend their lifespans.”
“It’s time to mobilize the demon monarchs. There are at least 800,000 demon monarchs in the human world. King White Treasure and a mysterious Archean Mountain Godfiend have been slaughtering underground demons for the past half-year,” said the black-robed man. “Even more demon monarchs have been slaughtered by that mysterious Godfiend.”
With the total number of dead demon monarchs and the location of their deaths, they determined that two human Godfiends were hunting for underground demon monarchs.
“Have you found out who the Archean Mountain Godfiend that is skilled at underground reconnaissance is?” Demon Sage Nine Abyss frowned.
“No.” The black-robed man said, “It’s unlikely to be any of the 14 current Archean Mountain Regis Godfiends. I suspect that it’s one of the 20 or so Regis Godfiends that awakened. However, it’s very difficult for us to come into contact with these ancient Godfiends.”
Demon Sage Nine Abyss nodded slightly. “Continue investigating. I’ll arrange for demon monarchs to take action. It’ll be the day after tomorrow.”

chapters.title: Chapter 327 - Night Attack
chapters.content:
Chapter 327 Night Attack
At night, torches on Changfeng City’s walls burned, illuminating the patrolling soldiers. As a large city with over ten million people, Changfeng City was one of the 62 large cities in the Great Zhou Dynasty (plus Sword Sovereign City). Changfeng City was naturally prosperous, so the security was very tight.
“My lord.”
“My lord.”
The soldiers bowed respectfully to an elderly patrolling guard.
The white-haired elder stopped and stood at the city wall, looking at the dark sky.
Boom! The white-haired elder let out a soft grunt. An invisible Quintessential Essence fluctuation spread out in all directions with him at the center. In the blink of an eye, it covered a distance of ten kilometers.
No demons within ten kilometers. The elder nodded slightly.
Changfeng City had many defensive systems. Godfiend reconnaissance was only one of them. This elder was a Great Solar Godfiend. With a thought, he could probe a radius of ten kilometers! Of course, underground reconnaissance wasn’t his forte. Back then, Fairy Meng was a Godfiend that was skilled at reconnaissance. She could probe a five-kilometer radius with a thought.
Many Godfiends patrolled the city walls.
In Changfeng City, Liu Qiyue and Marchioness Plum Snow were the strongest Godfiends, and a group of ordinary Godfiends supported them. Most of the ordinary Godfiends were outer sect disciples of Archean Mountain. Very few were inner sect disciples.
“We’ve been waiting here for more than two hours. When do we attack?” Three demon monarchs were hiding four kilometers away from the city and half a kilometer underground. “We just have to heed our orders. Once the higher-ups give the order, we’ll attack. If there are no orders, just wait.”
“Just wait. You’ll just be sending yourself to be killed if you charge in alone.”
The three demon monarchs were chatting.
“How many demon monarchs do you think we sent this time? The three of us came from different places and happened to bump into each other here.”
“There will definitely be a lot.”
Huh?
The three demon monarchs felt their tokens burning; they quickly took their tokens out.
“Orders are here.” The three demon monarchs exchanged looks and didn’t hesitate to charge upwards.
At that moment, many demon monarchs flew out of the ground. They were all varying distances away from Changfeng City’s four walls. The demon monarchs didn’t hide their demonic powers as they charged at Changfeng City at full speed.
Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!
Inside a seemingly ordinary residence near one of Changfeng City’s walls was a ten-foot-tall, black-green, pagoda-shaped building. Ten guards were inside this building. The leader of this group was a Godfiend. This building was the mysterious Demon Seeking Pagoda. The Demon Seeking Pagoda was extremely sensitive towards demonic powers. Just a sliver of released demonic power would be sensed from 50 kilometers away. Furthermore, it could sense demonic powers up to 2.5 kilometers underground. However, the Demon Seeking Pagoda wasn’t mobile and wasn’t easily built.
Changfeng City had a total of 12 Demon Seeking Pagodas. Six of them were 2.5 kilometers underground to prevent demon monarchs from carrying out underground sneak attacks.
“Demon monarchs.” The mortal guards’ expressions changed drastically.
“Demon monarchs are attacking from outside the city. There’s plenty of them!” The commanding Godfiend’s expression was ugly. “They aren’t even hiding. I can sense more than 300 demon monarchs outside the eastern city wall.”
At this moment, Godfiends appeared on the four walls. They looked out of the city.
“Demon monarchs.”
“The demon monarchs are here.”
The Godfiends could barely see demon monarchs charging over in the dark. All of them had solemn expressions.
Like wildfire, the Skydemon Sect had deliberately spread the news that one million demon monarchs were entering the human world. Every city was prepared to be attacked by hordes of demon monarchs.
Late at night, Meng Chuan continued practicing his saber arts in the courtyard. His senses were sharp. Even though he was in the middle of the city, he could still sense the dense demonic auras outside the city walls.
Oh? Meng Chuan’s heart tightened. Are the demon monarchs’ attacks on large cities finally here again? Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Three figures soared into the sky. They were Meng Chuan, Liu Qiyue, and Marchioness Plum Snow.
“Same old plan,” said Meng Chuan via voice transmission.
“Alright.” Liu Qiyue nodded. “There are a total of 3,000 demon monarchs coming from all directions. We have to block them,” said Marchioness Plum Snow via voice transmission.
“I’ll leave the southern and western walls to you. Leave the rest to me.” Meng Chuan had already transformed into a bolt of lightning and left.
Liu Qiyue and Marchioness Plum Snow exchanged looks and nodded slightly. They soared into the sky and flew into the distance. Wisps of Darkstar Quintessential Essence spread in all directions.
Swoosh.
As a bolt of lightning, Meng Chuan’s figure snaked through the void. He flashed twice in the void before stopping. He looked at the 800 demon monarchs that were scattered outside the eastern city wall and released Quintessential Essence threads.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
Wisps of Darkstar Quintessential Essence flew in all directions in the darkness. Quintessential Essence threads killed the demon monarchs!
An Indestructible Godfiend could send Quintessential Essence threads in a five-kilometer radius. Fairy Meng could prove a five-kilometer radius thanks to her Quintessential essence. Great Solar Godfiends could typically spread their Quintessential Essence in a ten-kilometer radius. Marquis Godfiends’ Quintessential Essence could spread across a 25-kilometer radius. Regis Godfiends’ Quintessential Essence could spread across a 50-kilometer radius! Of course, this was for average Godfiends.
For example, King True Martial—who had a fifth-level Essence Soul. His Quintessential Essence could fuse with the Power of True Martial, allowing him his Quintessential Essence to spread across a 75-kilometer radius.
A Quintessential essence thread could only detect the area where it passed by. Fairy Meng had purposely cultivated a reconnaissance spell so that she could probe a five-kilometer radius with just a thought.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
More than 1,000 Darkstar Quintessential Essence threads advanced at high speeds in the void. The Quintessential Essence threads were even faster than Meng Chuan! They were prepared to attack a number of demon monarchs. Meng Chuan could only release Quintessential Essence threads in a 30-kilometer radius. The demon monarchs were spread out across 50 kilometers, limiting the number of demon monarchs that Meng Chuan could kill with Quintessential Essence threads.
“Marquis Godfiend’s Quintessential Essence threads.” A rat demon elder—who was charging ahead—could immediately sense the Quintessential Essence threads attacking him with his domain. He immediately crushed the token in his hand.
More than 500 demon monarch tokens-763 demon monarchs were attacking the east wall -turned cold.
“Retreat.”
“Retreat.”
The 500-plus demon monarchs didn’t hesitate to burrow into the ground and flee. However, Meng Chuan’s Quintessential Essence threads were too fast. They pierced through the demon monarchs’ heads one after another, killing over 100 demon monarchs.
Over 300 demon monarchs had successfully fled while over 100 had died. The remaining 200-plus demon monarchs continued charging forward bravely. Quintessential Essence threads attacked them, but the demon monarchs resisted. Some demon monarchs used their bodies to take the brunt of the attack.
Chi! Chi!The Quintessential Essence threads stabbed into an ox demon monarch’s head. It barely managed to tear through the hide, but it was unable to penetrate past it.
“A Marquis Godfiend’s Quintessential Essence is very ordinary when it comes to attacking enemies from afar.”
“Why do I need to fear when they’re a few dozen kilometers away from me?”
The demon monarchs charged forward ferociously.
Meng Chuan’s expression turned ugly. Humans had defensive means, but the demons had ways to deal with them.
Quintessential Essence threads were a long-range attack that almost all Godfiends could use, but they were weak! If they were within his Darkstar domain, Meng Chuan’s Quintessential Essence threads could easily kill third Firmament demon monarchs. However, he could only kill second Firmament demon monarchs and third Firmament demon monarchs that had weaker bodies when they were beyond his domain.
Even an ordinary third Firmament demon monarch could withstand a Marquis Godfiend’s Quintessential Essence threads.
Marquis Godfiend Quintessential Essence threads can kill second Firmaments from afar, but the threat they pose to third Firmament demon monarchs is very low. Changfeng City has me. What about the other large cities? How can a Marquis Godfiend defend a city against 3,000 demon monarchs?

chapters.title: Chapter 328 - The threat of a million demon monarchs
chapters.content:
Chapter 328 The threat of a million demon monarchs
Meng Chuan transformed into a lightning snake and arrived outside the eastern city wall in the blink of an eye. He charged at the third Firmament demon monarchs. Wherever the lightning snake passed, third Firmament demon monarchs collapsed.
“Not good.”
“Run!”
“Quick, flee.” Seeing how fast the lightning snake was, the other third Firmament demon monarchs were alarmed. They immediately burrowed into the ground and fled.
The lightning snake stopped, and Meng Chuan’s figure appeared. Only 51 third Firmament demon monarchs died out of more than 200. The rest fled in fear?
The demon monarchs fled decisively upon sensing the threat of death! It was only thanks to Meng Chuan being the fastest in the world that he had killed 51 third Firmament demon monarchs in such a short time. As for those that fled underground, Meng Chuan could do nothing. After all, he was but a single person.
Swoosh. Meng Chuan transformed into a lightning snake and rushed towards the northern city wall.
Liu Qiyue flew south. She released Quintessential Essence threads; they surged towards the southern city wall.
These demon monarchs are coming from outside the city. They didn’t enter the city from underground. From the looks of it, the demons also know of the existence of Demon Seeking Pagodas.
If demon monarchs charged into the city from underground and slaughtered the population wantonly, it would result in a terrifying destruction. Therefore, Changfeng City had built six Demon Seeking Pagodas aboveground. Another six Demon Seeking Pagodas were built 2.5 kilometers underground and were distributed intricately. When a large group of demon monarchs released their demonic powers, they wouldn’t be able to escape the notice of all the Demon Seeking Pagodas. Traveling underground without the usage of demonic powers was much slower. Furthermore, they would create too big a commotion. The Godfiends responsible for underground defense would sense the intense vibrations.
If they want to enter the city from below, they’ll have to wait for orders five kilometers underground. Only after they travel upwards for five kilometers will they reach the city. It will take them the same amount of time to travel 50 kilometers on the surface. That amount of time is sufficient for Archean Mountain’s reinforcements to arrive.
Ordinary demon monarchs weren’t fast to begin with. They would take about 300 seconds to travel 50 kilometers on land.
An ordinary demon monarch will arrive within 30 seconds if they fly from four kilometers away. Archean Mountain reinforcements won’t be able to arrive in time. Ah Chuan is the fastest in the world. He can travel about 500 kilometers in 30 seconds. Liu Qiyue pondered. She used Phoenix Flight to fly 15 kilometers. She was still 20 kilometers away from the southern city wall. At that moment, her Quintessential Essence threads had already crossed the city wall and attacked the demon monarchs.
Upon sensing a Marquis Godfiend’s Quintessential Essence threads, over 500 demon monarchs at the southern wall immediately fled underground. However, the Quintessential Essence threads were too fast. Liu Qiyue killed over 100 demon monarchs.
Not good. They’re about to enter the city. High in the sky, Liu Qiyue immediately saw over 200 third Firmament demon monarchs arriving at the city wall. The demon monarchs had varying speeds. The faster demon monarchs deliberately slowed down to stay with the main group of demon monarchs.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
The demon monarchs jumped over the city wall and tried to start a massacre. The Quintessential Essence threads were unable to threaten them.
In her anxiety, Liu Qiyue saw a bolt of lightning rush over. Wherever it passed, demon monarchs died.
“Not good.”
“Run!”
Just as the third Firmament demon monarchs leaped over the city wall and began their massacre, they saw a bolt of lightning flash past them. The demon monarchs died one after another. They fled without any hesitation.
Meng Chuan looked into the distance. Many buildings and trees were reduced to ruins. Blood flowed from some of the ruins.
The city was too large. Meng Chuan first went to the eastern city wall before going to the northern city wall. After that, he went to the western city wall. Marchioness Plum Snow was slower than Liu Qiyue, so the western city wall was in a worse state. Finally, he came to the southern city wall.
“Ah Chuan.” Liu Qiyue flew to Meng Chuan’s side.
“Over 600 demon monarchs died. The rest fled,” said Meng Chuan. “Changfeng City has suffered significant losses. Hundreds of people have died on the western city wall. The southern city wall suffered the most casualties, probably tens of thousands.”
He was just one step slower.
More than 200 third Firmament demon monarchs charged into the city. They had fled after being slaughtered, but still, tens of thousands of people had died. This was the destructive power of demon monarchs.
If only he could be faster!
“What about the other large cities? Are there any requests for help?” asked Liu Qiyue.
“Two large cities have requested help. One is over 5,000 kilometers away from us, while the other is 3,000 kilometers away from us. Archean Mountain immediately arranged for reinforcements to be sent. They have withdrawn the requests for backup,” said Meng Chuan.
Marchioness Plum Snow flew over from afar. She had seen more than 200 places in the city’s southern region affected by the demon monarchs. She sighed and said, “Changfeng City is too large. Just circling it is a 300-kilometer journey. It’s really impressive that Marquis Eastcalm rescued the four city walls in 30 seconds. If it were just Junior Sister Liu and me, it would be much worse.”
“If it weren’t for Ah Chuan, I would have to use Phoenix’s Nirvana,” said Liu Qiyue. “I’m not sure if my Quintessential Essence threads can reach 50 kilometers even with Phoenix’s Nirvana.”
Meng Chuan looked at his wife and held her hand.
Another large city.
Three thousand demon monarchs attacked from all directions.
A silver-haired old woman stood in midair as her Quintessential Essence erupted crazily. More than 10,000 Quintessential Essence threads spread out from her body.
The moment her Godfiend Quintessential Essence erupted, the demon monarchs outside the city sensed it. Just like how Godfiends could sense demonic powers, the demon monarchs could also sense a Godfiend’s Quintessential Essence.
“Regis Godfiend?”
“Run!”
Almost all demon monarchs received orders from their tokens. Even before they received the order, the demon monarchs began fleeing upon sensing the terrifying Godfiend Quintessential Essence. Pfft! Pfft! Pfft!
Many Quintessential Essence threads shot down at high speeds. The demon monarchs that were slightly slower were killed, their heads penetrated by Quintessential Essence threads. Over 800 demon monarchs died.
Seven demon monarchs continued charging towards the city valiantly. Although they were third Firmament demon monarchs, they had strength comparable to a weak fourth Firmament demon monarch. Their bodies were extremely powerful. Even a Regis Godfiend’s Quintessential Essence threads were only able to injure the seven demon monarchs.
The seven demon monarchs charged towards the city walls from different directions.
The silver-haired old lady’s expression changed slightly. I’m unable to defend each wall. I can only scare them. She immediately retracted her aura. Her Seamless domain isolated all light and prevented reconnaissance techniques from sensing her as she completely vanished.
The demon monarchs were more afraid when they weren’t able to see her. “The Regis Godfiend’s aura has vanished.”
IS
“Humph. She’s about 50 kilometers away from the city wall. She probably needs 30 seconds to arrive.”
“Retreat within 18 seconds.” The seven demon monarchs were extremely fast. They were about four kilometers away from the city wall. The fastest demon monarchs could arrive in six seconds. The slower ones just needed 15 seconds. After leaping across the city wall, the seven demon monarchs began massacring the population, but they quickly fled.
They all fled? They sure are cautious. The silver-haired old woman appeared in the void and looked at the aftermath. More than 10,000 mortals were killed by these seven demon monarchs. The demons ultimately have the number advantage.
Another city.
When 3,000 demon monarchs attacked, black-carapaced beetles appeared around the four walls.
“Black-carapaced beetles? It’s Marquis Five Poisons?”
“Marquis Five Poisons’s 900 black-carapaced beetles have a collective strength close to a Regis Godfiend. They can easily kill third Firmament demon monarchs in a one-on-one battle even when separated.” When these demon monarchs saw the terrifying black-carapaced beetles, they knew which Godfiend was responsible for defending the city. They immediately retreated.
When it was a battle of who had higher numbers in a battle? The Godfiends that refined poisonous bugs were highly proficient.
“We can only try our best to protect most places. The rest can only wait for the sect to provide reinforcements.”
Three Marquis Godfiends released Quintessential Essence threads. The Quintessential Essence threads that were released were centered around themselves. They spread out in an approximate 25-kilometer radius. Some had slightly greater range; some had a slightly smaller range. When the three Marquis Godfiends worked together, their Quintessential Essence threads spread across more than 80% of the city. This scared the second Firmament demon monarchs into fleeing. However, the third Firmament demon monarchs resisted the Quintessential Essence threads and charged into the city. They began massacring the city’s population.
The next morning, Meng Chuan arrived at Archean Mountain.“Junior Brother Meng.” Archean Mountain Lord frowned as he walked towards Grotto-Heaven Pavilion. He saw Meng Chuan descending from the sky. “Mountain Lord, how many cities were attacked last night? How’s the situation?” asked Meng Chuan.
“Ten of our Archean Mountain’s large cities were attacked,” said Archean Mountain Lord, “The cities guarded by Regis Godfiend suffered very light losses. The most they lost were slightly over 10,000 people. The two cities guarded by Marquis Godfiends that needed reinforcements suffered heavy losses.”
“Heavy losses?” Meng Chuan was alarmed.
Archean Mountain Lord nodded and said solemnly, “This was the first time large groups of demon monarchs attacked the cities. With experience, it will be even harder to deal with the next attack.”
Meng Chuan also felt immense pressure. Compared to the fourth and fifth Firmament demon monarchs, the one million ordinary demon monarchs posed a greater threat!
The flaw of humanity’s defense was starkly exposed-they lacked Godfiends!
“By the way, your son, Meng An, has mastered Samsara Intent. He’s preparing to challenge the Life-and-Death juncture the day after tomorrow and become a Godfiend,” said Archean Mountain Lord. “I originally planned on writing a letter to tell you after meeting the Supremacy.”
An’er is about to become a Godfiend? Meng Chuan was pleasantly surprised, but he suffered mixed emotions. His son was about to begin the life of a Godfiend.

chapters.title: Chapter 329 - Samsara Trial (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 329 Samsara Trial (1)
That night, Meng Chuan told his wife about the matter after returning. His wife was pleasantly surprised. “An’er is going to challenge the Life-and-Death juncture and become a Godfiend?”
Meng Chuan nodded and continued eating his porridge.
Liu Qiyue held her chopsticks and said with mixed emotions, “I still remember the days when we lived at Gu Mountain Prefecture in seclusion. Days when You’er and An’er were just born... In the blink of an eye, over ten years have passed. An’er is about to become a Godfiend now that he’s grown up. In the future, he will follow in our footsteps to fight demons. Truth be told, I really don’t want You’er and An’er to fight. It would be great if the war can end with our generation so that our descendants can live in peace,” said Liu Qiyue.
When the demon monarchs attacked last night, over 23,000 people died in Changfeng City. Over 10,000 people were crippled. It hadn’t been long since the attack had happened, so Liu Qiyue’s emotions were naturally more complicated.
“All of us want to end the war. We don’t want our children and descendants to be embroiled in it. However, this war has been going on for more than 800 years,” said Meng Chuan. “From the looks of it, we won’t be able to win in the next few decades. All we can do is let You’er and An’er adapt to this world.”
“Then our entire family will be participating in the war,” said Liu Qiyue softly.
“You’er and An’er are very outstanding,” said Meng Chuan. “An’er was able to master the Samsara Divine Body at the age of 16 and become a Godfiend. His talent... is better than Yan Chitong, Xue Feng, and mine. Although Xue Feng became a Godfiend at the age of 15, he cultivated the Black Sand Fiend Bodywhich is of relatively lower difficulty. Our son’s Samsara Divine Body is extremely difficult to cultivate.”
Liu Qiyue nodded.
“An’er might develop his strength faster than us,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “You have to have confidence in your children.”
“Of course I have confidence in our son.” Liu Qiyue looked at Meng Chuan. “I have to guard Changfeng City, so I can’t leave. The day after tomorrow, you will be the only one going to Archean Mountain.”
“Don’t worry,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “Archean Mountain’s inner sect disciples are only allowed to challenge the Life-and-Death juncture when they are 100% confident. An’er will succeed easily.”
The cold, autumn wind howled on Life-and-Death Peak. Rain poured, adding to the chill.
Meng Chuan, Archean Mountain Lord, and Elder Yi were chatting on Life-and-Death Peak.
“Oh, he’s here,” said Archean Mountain Lord with a smile as he looked into the distance.
Meng Chuan saw the siblings walking up the winding path rather quickly. When he saw his children, he couldn’t help but smile.
This day had finally arrived. His son was about to become a Godfiend.
“Mountain Lord, Elder.” When Meng An and Meng You arrived, they first bowed to Archean Mountain Lord and Elder Yi before looking at Meng Chuan excitedly. “Dad.”
“Good.” Meng Chuan looked at his son, Meng An, satisfied. He smiled and said, “An’er, you did well. Your mother is very happy to know about this. However, she can’t leave the city, so I’ll be the one to witness your breakthrough.”
“Dad, watch me.” Meng An was in high spirits.
“You’er, wait here,” instructed Meng Chuan as he pointed ahead. “An’er, the Godfiend Blood Pool Cave is up ahead. Go right to the end and you will see the Godfiend Blood Pool. The Supremacy will personally protect you. Go on.”
“Okay.” Meng An bowed respectfully before walking towards the Godfiend Blood Pool Cave.
Meng Chuan and his daughter, Meng You, waited where they were, along with Archean Mountain Lord and Elder Yi.
“I still remember the two of us witnessing your breakthrough as a Godfiend back then,” said Elder Yi with a smile. “In the blink of an eye, over 30 years have passed.”
“Time flies.” Meng Chuan nodded.
“It has really been a storm of events in the past 30 years,” said Archean Mountain Lord. “The world has changed drastically. Village forts, prefecture cities, county cities have all been abandoned. Even small and medium-sized city passes met the same
fate.”
“It has indeed been a storm.” Meng Chuan remembered that he wasn’t disturbed during his cultivation on the mountain. After he left the mountain, he fought one battle after another. He saw many deaths.
Meng You listened silently.
“By the way, do we know how the Black Sand Dynasty and the Great Yue Dynasty fared during the demons’ attack?” asked Meng Chuan. “The Black Sand Dynasty and the Great Yue Dynasty also suffered attacks on ten large cities,” said Archean Mountain Lord.
Meng Chuan was astonished. “The demons attacked all three dynasties and targeted ten cities each?”
The three dynasties had a different number of cities. The Great Yue Dynasty had the least cities.
“The Great Yue Dynasty suffered the lightest losses,” said Archean Mountain Lord. “After all, almost all of their cities are guarded by Regis Godfiends. Two to three cities are guarded by Marquis Godfiends, but with a bunch of them, their cities were impregnable. The Black Sand Dynasty’s losses are comparable to ours,” said Archean Mountain Lord. “Comparable?” Meng Chuan was surprised. “We should have greater combat strength with our Regis Godfiends, right? Yet, the losses are about the same?”
Archean Mountain Lord isolated his voice
Meng You and whispered, “Black Sand Grotto-Heaven and Archean Mountain have a few sleeping Regis Godfiends. Some ancient Regis Godfiends continue to guard the area. Although our Regis Godfiends have more combat strength, their Halberd Hall’s machinery is very powerful. They can control the machinery from afar. It was very advantageous in the defense against the ordinary demon monarchs.”
Meng Chuan understood.
“It’s too difficult for Marquis Godfiends to stop thousands of demon monarchs from attacking a city,” said Archean Mountain Lord. “When dealing with a large group of demon monarchs, only those that cultivate poisonous bugs or refine machinery are good at defending. However, you know that there are too few Marquis Godfiends that cultivate poisonous bugs. There are only five in Archean Mountain.”
“Indeed.” Meng Chuan nodded.
Poison cultivation was a relatively unorthodox system in the world. There was only one suitable high-grade Godfiend body
—the Myriad Poisons Fiend Body. Archean Mountain only had one Regis Godfiend who refined poison-King Luyue. The requirements of this system were low. Almost everyone could attempt to cultivate it, but they needed to focus on researching all sorts of poisons.
“The Supremacies are also discussing how to make up for our shortcomings,” said Archean Mountain Lord.
Meng You looked at her father, Archean Mountain Lord, and Elder Yi —who were busy talking about the war situation. They had cut off all sound as they spoke. Clearly, they didn’t want a junior like her to know too much. Suddenly, Archean Mountain Lord, Elder Yi, and her father—Meng Chuanlooked at the Godfiend Blood Pool Cave.
“Dad?” Meng You couldn’t help but ask, “Is Brother...?”
“He’ll be out soon,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “He’s already succeeded.”
As soon as he finished speaking, Meng An walked out from the Godfiend Blood Pool Cave. His aura was much stronger than before.
“Dad.” Meng An walked to Meng Chuan’s side.
Meng Chuan could sense how powerful his son’s Godfiend body was. Out of all Godfiend bodies, the Samsara Divine Body was the strongest and closest to perfection. This made Meng Chuan admire Ancestral Master Archean Eon. The Godfiend cultivation system focuses on Quintessential Essence, but the Samsara Divine Body still cultivates the body to such a level. It’s even stronger than many demon monarchs at the same level. It’s truly impressive.
The Samsara Divine Body was perfect in all aspects.
“Becoming a Godfiend is just the beginning. Cultivate well,” encouraged Meng Chuan. “We can’t stay on Life-and-Death Peak for too long. You and You’er should hurry down the mountain.”
“Yes.” Meng An bowed. He and Meng You bowed respectfully to the three elders before immediately leaving the mountain. “Mountain Lord, Elder Yi, I’ll take my leave as well.” Meng Chuan cupped his hands.
“Junior Brother Meng, go busy yourself,” said Archean Mountain Lord immediately.
Following that, Meng Chuan transformed into a bolt of lightning and soared into the sky. He still needed to continue his daily underground reconnaissance.
Meng You and Meng An watched the bolt of lightning disappear into the horizon. They knew that their father had left, so they talked softly as they left.

chapters.title: Chapter 330 - Samsara Trial (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 330 Samsara Trial (2)
Half a month later. Snowflakes drifted.
Meng An braved the snowstorm and came to Grotto-Heaven Pavilion. He paid his respects to the Supremacies. “Greetings, Master, Supremacies.” Meng An came to the pavilion and bowed respectfully.
Supremacies Li Guan and Luo Tang were playing chess while Qin Wu watched as he sipped tea.
Luo Tang frowned as she looked at the chessboard. When she turned her head, she saw Meng An bow respectfully. Her eyes lit up as she immediately threw the chess piece in her hand. She stood up and said, “I’m not playing anymore. Let’s get down to business.”
“The outcome will be decided after a few more moves. There’s no hurry,” said Li Guan.
“You have too much free on your hands, but Meng An’s time is very precious,” said the illusory Luo Tang solemnly. “A Godfiend’s cultivation time cannot be wasted.”
Li Guan helplessly said, “Alright, alright.” “Meng An, follow us,” said Luo Tang. “Yes.” Meng An was still somewhat puzzled. Why did the Supremacies summon him?
Soon, the three Supremacies led Meng An through a distorted void passageway. Meng An looked around in amazement. The void passageway was filled with colorful light amidst the warped void.
The void passageway completely solidified. Meng An watched everything in shock and curiosity. Soon, they walked out of the void tunnel and arrived in a grotto-Heaven.
“Meng An, this is an opportunity for you.” Li Guan smiled as he looked at Meng An. He pointed at the closed, 100-foot-tall door in the hall. “Enter when the door opens. There will be a trial. This trial will take from a month to half a year. It can even take half a month. You have to do your best to succeed.”
“Yes,” replied Meng An obediently.
“Go in,” said Li Guan. Luo Tang and Qin Wu watched with anticipation.
Only then did Meng An walk towards the ancient palace. When he arrived at the front door, the door opened with a rumble. Meng An crossed the threshold and entered. The door closed once again.
“The Samsara trial contains Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s legacy. It’s also the strongest legacy in the entire human world.” The illusory Luo Tang showed her worry. “Can Meng An pass the Samsara trial?”
“Every person that has cultivated a perfected Samsara Divine Body has the right to participate in the Samsara trial,” said the illusory Qin Wu. “However, there are very few people who succeeded in the trial. The last person to succeed was from over 6,000 years
ago.”
“Let’s hope he succeeds. At this point in the war, we need a Godfiend who can inherit Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s legacy,” said Luo Tang. “I’ve read the dossiers. From the tribal era of our Archean Mountain, a total of 38 people have passed the Samsara trial! Apart from seven that failed to develop their strength fully, the remaining 31 were rather powerful. Two became Regis Godfiends, 28 became Creation Supremacies, and one became an Imperial Lord. They are famous for being good at combat.”
Li Guan nodded. “Nearly half of those who passed the trial were invincible during their
time.”
“Almost half of them were invincible.” Qin Wu nodded.
“After all, it’s the strongest legacy of humanity,” said Luo Tang. “The opportunities in Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven were obtained by Ancestral Master Archean Eon by chance while roaming the outer realm. As for the Samsara trial... It’s Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s own legacy. It’s a complete system, so it’s much more powerful.”
“I’ll head back first,” said Li Guan. “Are the two of you waiting here?”
“Yes,” said Qin Wu and Luo Tang.
“According to history, only one out of 20 candidates who undertake the trial succeeds,” said Li Guan. “Don’t place too much hope on him.”
“We know.” Luo Tang waved her hand. “Senior Brother, hurry up and tend to your matters.”
Li Guan smiled helplessly as he left.
Time passed. Qin Wu and Luo Tang waited patiently. Two months passed in the blink of an eye. “We know the probability of success is very low, but the two of us just keep watch.” Luo Tang played chess.
Qin Wu was playing chess as well. He smiled and said, “Perhaps we are too eager for humans to have a boost in combat strength. If we can have another Creation Supremacy that can be invincible in this era, it will be very helpful for us during the war.”
As for becoming an Imperial Lord? Only one person who had passed the Samsara trial had become an Imperial Lord. Furthermore, it had taken them more than 1,000 years to become an Imperial Lord. They didn’t dare hope for it They wanted a Creation Supremacy that was invincible in their era. That was more realistic.
“That’s right. We’re too eager to have one join our ranks,” Luo Tang said and moved her chess piece.
Suddenly,
A black fog seeped out from the door of the ancient palace. It condensed into a hundred-foot-tall black giant. “Guardian?” Luo Tang and Qin Wu turned their heads and were alarmed.
“Good news.” The swarthy giant smiled as he revealed his white teeth. “The young Godfiend, Meng An, has already passed the trial. He is receiving Master’s legacy.”
“He succeeded?” Luo Tang and Qin Wu looked at each other, surprised.
The swarthy giant nodded slightly. “He succeeded. He will probably come out in a few days.” With that said, he transformed into a black fog and seeped back into the palace.
“He succeeded. He succeeded.” Luo Tang was ecstatic. “I really didn’t make a mistake with him. Meng An is indeed talented.”
Swoosh.
A figure rushed over from the void passageway. It was none other than Li Guan.
“Why did you summon me in such a hurry?” Li Guan asked with an expectant look. “Is there any news about Meng An’s trial?”
“The Guardian just came out and informed us that Meng An has already passed the trial. He is currently accepting the Samsara legacy,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “He will probably come out in a few days.”
“He really succeeded?” Li Guan revealed a look of delight. “That’s great! The probability of passing the Samsara trial is very low, but Meng An succeeded. It’s really a blessing from the heavens.”“We might be able to change the situation if we have an additional Creation Supremacy that is invincible in this era,” said Luo Tang in anticipation.
“He needs time to grow slowly,” said Qin Wu. “Even if he cultivates quickly, he will take about 100 years to become a Supremacy. Even when he becomes a Creation Supremacy, he will only be an early-stage Supremacy. He will need at least 200 years to become an invincible Creation Supremacy of his era.”
“Every addition to our peak combat forces increases our chances of victory,” said Li Guan with a smile. “At the very least, Meng An passing the Samsara trial is the best news we have had recently. He and his father are very important to us humans. As long as his father, Meng Chuan, reaches the Blood Droplet realm, he will be able to probe the underground and hunt demon monarchs on a larger scale. If Meng An is invincible in the future, he can easily deal with demon sages.”
The Godfiend cultivation system was stronger than the demon cultivation system. If one were an invincible Creation Supremacy, that meant they one could easily kill demon sages. Meng An was expected to fight multiple demon sages alone in the future.
“Meng An still needs time to grow,” said Qin Wu. “What I’m most worried about is that the demons won’t give us 200 years.”
“Therefore, we need to try our best to hold on,” said Li Guan.
“It’s really interesting,” said Luo Tang with a smile. “This Meng family’s three generations are getting more powerful with each generation. Meng Dajiang is a Body Tempering Godfiend, but he’s just an ordinary Godfiend. Meng Chuan’s talent is much higher than his father’s. He can become a Regis Godfiend. As for Meng An, his talent is even higher. He should be one of the top few in the past few centuries. He has a high chance of becoming a Creation Supremacy.” Li Guan smiled and said, “Alright, this matter has to be kept confidential. Only Meng An and the three of us shall know about it! After Meng An comes out, he is strictly forbidden from spreading it. He can’t even tell his parents and sister.”
“Yes.” Luo Tang and Qin Wu nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 331 - Marquis Yan Jin
chapters.content:
Chapter 331 Marquis Yan Jin
9th January
A powerful aura erupted from the almost uninhabited Fluttering Snow Peak. In the cave abode’s chamber, Yan Jin opened his eyes. His eyes were filled with excitement. I’ve finally broken through! I have finally become a Marquis Godfiend! It’s all thanks to the ice lotus flower Meng Chuan gave me. Otherwise, I’ll be stuck at the bottleneck for countless years.
He had been cultivating arduously at Archean Mountain for many years. Previously, he had left the mountain to join a Godfiend team. He had experienced many life-and-death battles, and his insights were very deep. However, he had been stuck at the critical juncture. When he saw the ice lotus flower, he felt inspired. Following that, he broke through to the Realm of Dao in just three months. He finally saw hope that his cultivation would continue to rise.
After reaching the Realm of Dao, he had also cultivated a more profound sword art. Just a few days ago, he had also gained some insights into his sword art. As his emotions surged, he used his sword art to seek answers from his inner self. It allowed his soul to improve greatly and condense an Essence Soul.
In fact, he had been cultivating Archean Mountain’s Essence Soul mystic technique for many years. He used his body’s Quintessential Essence to nurture his soul. After all, he had a transcendent-grade Godfiend body. After many years of nurturing, his soul was only a little short of condensing the Essence Soul. Finally, he sought answers from his inner self with his sword art and formed an Essence Soul.
Yan Jin had finally become a Marquis Godfiend.
The situation off-mountain is dire. Archean Mountain has always been in desperate need of Marquis Godfiends. Yan Jin’s eyes were filled with anticipation. I just need to consolidate my strength, and I’ll be able to leave the mountain in a few months. I can also kill demon monarchs.
As he watched his elder brother, Xue Feng, and his good friend-Meng Chuan-fight the demons off-mountain, he also wanted to join them. However, he never received Archean Mountain’s permission.
13th April.
Liu Qiyue and Marchioness Plum Snow were stationed in Chu An City. As demons attacked cities almost every month, human Godfiends often swapped defense locations! This made the demons unable to figure out which Godfiends were guarding a city. Once the demons learned of the defense arrangements, they could deliver a targeted attack.
Swoosh.
One letter flew down from the sky towards Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue—who were both eating breakfast in the hall. Meng Chuan reached out and received the letter. He glanced at the avian demon monarch outside, which had quickly left.
“It’s You’er’s letter,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. When he opened the letter, his eyes lit
up.
“What does it say?” Liu Qiyue asked immediately.
“You’er attained Greater Mastery of the Azure Lotus Divine Body. She asked Yan Jin and read a lot of books. She felt that it would take at least five to six years to reach the perfected Azure Lotus Divine Body, and she doesn’t have certainty of success.” Meng Chuan handed the letter to Liu Qiyue. “She doesn’t want to waste time as a mortal and asks if she should directly become a Godfiend. What’s your take?”
“Greater Mastery of the Azure Lotus Divine Body?” Liu Qiyue nodded slightly. “You’er spent two years on the mountain to reach Greater Mastery. To reach perfection, it will indeed take a lot of time. In fact, she might not even be able to attain perfection. Instead of spending a lot of time on the Azure Lotus Divine Body, it’s better for her to become a Godfiend as soon as possible. After becoming a Godfiend, her powerful body and Quintessential Essence will strengthen her soul. Her cultivation will also be faster.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded. When he was young, he had condensed an Essence Soul. Due to his weak mortal body and weak Essence Soul, he couldn’t withstand accepting a fragment of the Lightning Devastator Saber legacy.
“Since You’er doesn’t wish to waste time, let her make a breakthrough,” said Meng Chuan. “It’s not good to force her if it’s against her will. She needs to make decisions regarding her cultivation matters according to her preferences.”
“Then, we’ll reply?” asked Liu Qiyue. “Are we in favor of her breaking through?”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded.
A few days later.
Liu Qiyue and Marchioness Plum Snow strolled in the garden.
“Junior Sister Liu, your children have all become Godfiends. They also cultivate transcendent-grade Godfiend bodies. How impressive,” said Marchioness Plum Snow wistfully. “The bloodline of experts is indeed powerful. For example, a Regis Godfiend family clan will produce a group of Godfiends. The number of Godfiends produced by a Creation Supremacy family clan is even greater. There might even be Regis Godfiends among their descendants.”
The Wang family, the Xiao family, and the Yan family all had a bunch of Godfiends amongst their ranks. The imperial familythe Li family-weakened over the generations. Their weakening bloodline made it more difficult for them to produce Godfiends. However, they still had a Regis Godfiend, five Marquis Godfiends, and even more ordinary Godfiends. Two of Li Guan’s children had become Regis Godfiends back then. However, they had died long ago.
King Calm Sea’s newly risen Xue family also had outstanding children. King Calm Sea stood a chance of becoming a Creation Supremacy. Similarly, Xue Feng would soon become a Regis Godfiend.
One’s bloodline benefited their descendants. However, the juniors had to work hard. They even needed to surpass their predecessors.
The Meng family was an ordinary mortal family clan. The first Godfiend, Patriarch Yushan, appeared in the family 500 years ago from mortal roots. After a few hundred years, Fairy Meng appeared. She had also accumulated credits during many life-and-death battles on the battlefield before she became a Godfiend by chance. Meng Dajiang cultivated the Body Tempering Godfiend lineage. His cultivation path was extremely difficult.
At Meng Chuan’s generation, his father, Meng Dajiang, and his mother, Bai Nianyun, had high talent. However, under normal circumstances, it was already good enough for him to become a Marquis Godfiend. However, because he missed his mother, he cultivated crazily every day. Painting was his only form of enjoyment. He had been like this since he was young. In the end, he reached an unimaginable realm in painting. He sought answers from his inner self, and his Essence Soul improved rapidly. Due to his powerful Essence Soul, his cultivation speed was naturally much faster; thus, he easily became a Marquis Godfiend.
The risks he took and the credits he earned allowed him the rare chance to enter the World Gap. With his talent in painting, he managed to draw Fifteen Lightning Forms. He had a clear understanding of the essence of lightning. This metamorphosed his cultivation speed of the lightning lineage.
“Bloodline inheritance just gives an advantage at the starting point,” said Liu Qiyue with a smile. “What happens in the future will depend on the children themselves.”
“Yes. There are many cases with powerful parents, but much weaker children,” said Marchioness Plum Snow. “There are even some hedonistic children.”
Liu Qiyue was somewhat relieved. When the children were young, they had to protect their children due to Meng Chuan’s efficiency at demon-slaying. They disguised themselves as an ordinary family and raised their children with strict discipline. If they had known from a young age that they were children of Marquis Godfiends, Meng An and Meng You would probably have gone astray due to all sorts of flattery.
It’s said that King Calm Sea is very cold and heartless towards his children. They have suffered a lot. Could this have contributed to Xue Feng and Yan Jin’s rise as Marquis Godfiends? Liu Qiyue suddenly thought of this. The couple knew that Yan Jin and King Calm Sea were close to becoming enemies.
Huh? Liu Qiyue and Marchioness Plum Snow’s expressions suddenly changed. The two of them could sense demonic powers erupting in all directions.
1,200 demon monarchs? They are all at the third Firmament? Liu Qiyue and Marchioness Plum Snowfelt felt like something was amiss. After the demons’ first large-scale attack on the cities, they no longer sent second Firmament demon monarchs. Third Firmament demon monarchs were powerful and fast. They could only be killed by a Regis Godfiend’s Quintessential Essence threads. This forced humans to deploy those with the strength of a Regis Godfiend to defend the city.
“Meng Chuan isn’t here. What should we do?” asked Marchioness Plum Snow anxiously.In the past half a year, the demons attacked almost once a month!
Liu Qiyue and Marchioness Plum Snow had encountered two demon attacks on the cities. They were all night attacks! This time, it was a day attack. Meng Chuan was busy hunting for underground demon monarchs.
“Meng Chuan is 1,500 kilometers away. It will take him nearly 120 seconds to arrive. There’s no time.” Liu Qiyue flew up and swept her gaze across the city. A large group of third Firmament demon monarchs charged over from three kilometers away. As third Firmament demon monarchs, they could storm into the city in about 15 seconds.
“Our Quintessential Essence threads can’t kill these third Firmament demon monarchs from afar.” Marchioness Plum Snow flew up and looked around anxiously. “I’ve already requested help.”
“These demons are very shrewd and sly. They will flee after engaging in slaughter for 30 seconds. Requesting help is useless.” Liu Qiyue looked at everything calmly.
If over 1,000 third Firmament demon monarchs were allowed to engage in a wanton slaughter in the city, just how many mortals would be killed?
Boom!
The flames around Liu Qiyue’s body soared into the sky. Flames churned in all directions as a huge, flaming phoenix spread its wings and let out a phoenix shriek.

chapters.title: Chapter 332 - Liu Qiyue’s Appointment
chapters.content:
Chapter 332 Liu Qiyue’s Appointment
Liu Qiyue had cultivated to the peak of the Darkstar realm, so her phoenix bloodline was naturally purer. She unleashed all her might.
Boom!
Her Essence Soul and body transformed continuously. Even her perception and insights towards fire constantly surged as she remained in a state of epiphany. Her Quintessential Essence also underwent a qualitative change. It even burned with flames.
How good would it be if I had such strength all the time? Liu Qiyue’s eyes turned red as she looked at the demon monarchs running outside the city. Quintessential Essence threads flew in all directions, enveloping Chu An City in the blink of an eye.
How beautiful. Marchioness Plum Snow was stunned when she saw this. The phoenix spread its wings in the sky as countless flaming threads flew in all directions, enveloping the entire city. Marchioness Plum Snow felt that she could never forget this
scene.
“Regis Godfiend.” The attacking demon monarchs sensed a terrifying aura erupt. It was an aura that made them tremble. Without any hesitation, most demon monarchs began burrowing underground and fled. However, the flaming threads spread across the city walls at blazing speeds, stabbing into the demon monarchs’ heads.
Some demon monarchs died. Others fled quickly. When they sensed the aura erupting from afar, they immediately burrowed into the ground and managed to escape. Many corpses fell to the ground following the laws of inertia. Some were still twitching.
“So what if she’s a Regis Godfiend? In the city, she won’t be able to kill me from a distance.” Eight third Firmament demon monarchs—which had extremely strong bodies-continued charging forward with confidence. Some of them were comparable to fourth Firmament demon monarchs. Some had extremely high physical talent, while others had very strong life-preservation means. They were confident that they could face a Regis Godfiend’s Quintessential Essence threads.
Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! The eight flame threads drilled into the eight demon monarchs’ bodies.
“No.”
“How is that possible?” “My strength is comparable to a newly-advanced fourth Firmament demon monarch!”
Seven of the eight demon monarchs died on the spot. The remaining demon monarch transformed into three gray shadows and fled underground.
In terms of technique realm, Liu Qiyue hadn’t even reached the Dharma Domain realm. However, she had strength comparable to a peak Regis Godfiend after casting Phoenix’s Nirvana. This was because her Quintessential Essence had completely transformed into flames, making her strength terrifying. Ordinary Regis Godfiends were powerful due to being strong in many aspects. However, Liu Qiyue’s strength came from her flames. Liu Qiyue’s flames erupted with bursts of strength, making her comparable to a peak Regis Godfiend. Even a fourth Firmament demon monarch would suffer from her Quintessential Essence threads.
Whoosh.
Over 1,000 Quintessential Essence threads erupted. Although it felt wonderful to be in a constant state of epiphany, Liu Qiyue immediately stopped maintaining Phoenix’s Nirvana.
She looked around. Liu Qiyue had killed nearly half of the attacking demon monarchs
—591 of 1,200 attacking demon monarchs had died! The demon monarchs had become more cunning and cautious, so it was a very high death ratio for her to kill nearly half of the attacking demon monarchs.
When Meng Chuan discovered Chu An City’s request for help, he immediately flew out from the underground and rushed towards Chu An City at full speed.
Quick, quick, quick. Quick! Meng Chuan was extremely anxious. He knew very well that only his wife and Marchioness Plum Snow guarded Chu An City. If Liu Qiyue didn’t cast Phoenix’s Nirvana, there was no way they could defend Chu An City.
The request for reinforcements has been retracted? After flying for a few seconds, Chu An City’s request for help was withdrawn. After flying for nearly 120 seconds, Meng Chuan arrived at Chu An City. He saw a large number of demon monarch corpses outside the city. Soldiers were busy collecting the corpses. He quickly flew to his and Liu Qiyue’s residence.
“Ah Chuan.” Liu Qiyue and Marchioness Plum Snow were sitting in the courtyard.
“Marquis Eastcalm, it’s all thanks to Junior Sister Liu’s use of the forbidden spell, Phoenix’s Nirvana, that we held back the demons. She killed nearly half of the attacking demon monarchs. The remaining demon monarchs fled.” Marchioness Plum Snow stood up and said, “I won’t disturb the two of you any further.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. After Marchioness Plum Snow left, Meng Chuan sat down beside his wife and looked at her worriedly. “Qiyue, how long did you maintain Phoenix’s Nirvana? How much of your lifespan did you consume?”
“It wasn’t long, I stopped once I released over 1,000 Quintessential Essence threads,” said Liu Qiyue with a smile.
“How much of your lifespan did you consume?” asked Meng Chuan again.
Liu Qiyue smiled and said, “Five years. It’s not much.”
Five years? Meng Chuan was somewhat anxious. His wife was only one year younger than him. She had burned more than 35 years of her lifespan. To have the highest chance of becoming a Regis Godfiend, it would be best if she broke through before she was 90 years old! She didn’t have much time left.
“There’s good news from using Phoenix’s Nirvana this time,” said Liu Qiyue with a smile. “My insights into the Dao of Fire have deepened, and my Essence Soul has become stronger. Furthermore, I’m certain that my Quintessential Essence threads can reach up to 60 kilometers when I cast Phoenix’s Nirvana! They are much stronger than an ordinary Regis Godfiend’s Quintessential Essence threads, be it range or strength.”
Liu Qiyue had stood in the middle of the city during the attack. Since her Quintessential Essence threads could reach up to 60 kilometers, they could easily cover Chu An City. They even crossed the city walls and extended further.
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded and frowned. “However, the demons are attacking too frequently nowadays. On average, they attack once a month. They mainly attack the Great Zhou Dynasty and Black Sand Dynasty’s cities. In the Great Zhou Dynasty, large cities like Luo Tang City, Jiang State Capital, Wu State Capital, and the Imperial Capital are rarely attacked. Many cities with over ten million people are attacked. It’s very easy to attack the city you are stationed at. It’s only been half a year, but you have encountered three attacks.” Meng Chuan was worried. “It’s one too many.”
Liu Qiyue smiled and said, “A large city with a population of over 20 million is naturally more important. Since Regis Godfiends are guarding them, the demons will naturally not attack those cities.”
Make something real appear fake and vice-versa? Archean Mountain didn’t dare use such a strategy. If a city with over 20 million people were to be slaughtered, the losses would be disastrous.
“When you use Phoenix’s Nirvana, although you can release Quintessential Essence threads in a large area, you will consume five years of your lifespan each time.” Meng Chuan shook his head. “This can’t continue.”
Once, twice, thrice... Soon, his wife would quickly lose the chance to become a Regis Godfiend. After becoming a Regis Godfiend, she would become even stronger. She could deal with many situations with her normal strength. Only then could his wife live longer.
The environment for past Godfiends that had awakened the phoenix bloodline was relatively comfortable. Marquis Godfiends usually lived for 200 years out of their 300-year lifespans. If Liu Qiyue continued to fight like this, she would burn her lifespan too quickly.
“Godfiends are constantly dying in battle. It’s just burning a few years of my lifespan,” said Liu Qiyue with a smile.
There’s a perfect solution, Meng Chuan thought.
Archean Mountain.“Meng Chuan’s letter.” Li Guan, Luo Tang, and Qin Wu sat down. Li Guan placed the letter on the table.
“Why didn’t he come to us directly if he had something? Why did he deliberately write a letter?” Luo Tang picked up the letter and frowned. “He’s worried about his wife.”
Qin Wu took the letter and scanned it. He nodded. “The demons are indeed attacking frequently. If Liu Qiyue frequently casts Phoenix’s Nirvana, her lifespan will be consumed quickly. Her chances of becoming a Regis Godfiend will quickly be severed.”
“King Luyue hasn’t refined the 8,000 poisonous bugs yet. The negotiations with Black Sand Grotto-Heaven has yet to come to a conclusion. How can he help Liu Qiyue?” Luo Tang shook her head gently. “There are many problems with the cities guarded by Marquis Godfiends. Are we to awaken a Regis Godfiend just to replace Liu Qiyue?”
“We can’t. We can only last longer if half of the 25 ancient Regis Godfiends are asleep,” said Li Guan.
Qin Wu’s eyes suddenly lit up when he read the letter. “Meng Chuan says in the letter that when Liu Qiyue casts Phoenix’s Nirvana, her Quintessential Essence threads can reach a distance of 60 kilometers. Her strength far exceeds that of ordinary Regis Godfiends. Since that’s the case, transfer her to a large city with more than 20 million people! The demons seldom attack large cities. Occasionally, they attack one or two cities. Perhaps in five years, they might not even attack Liu Qiyue’s city once.”
Li Guan and Luo Tang’s eyes lit up.
Luo Tang smiled. “She has the strength of a peak Regis Godfiend when she casts Phoenix’s Nirvana. She’s more suitable for guarding a major city than ordinary Regis Godfiends.”

chapters.title: Chapter 333 - Collusion
chapters.content:
Chapter 333 Collusion
“Senior Sister Chang.”
“Junior Sister Liu.”
In Chu An City, Liu Qiyue and Marchioness Plum Snow bade farewell. The two of them had been supporting each other for three years and had formed a close relationship.
“It was fate that allowed us to stand shoulder to shoulder for three years.” Marchioness Plum Snow’s snow-white hair fluttered as she said solemnly, “I’ve been fighting my entire life. I have to thank the heavens for letting me live to the end of my lifespan. As for you, you are still very young. You have to be careful with how you use Phoenix’s Nirvana. Even if you become a Regis Godfiend in the future, you have to be extremely careful with your forbidden spell! You might be able to kill powerful enemies once by casting it, but it might not be worth consuming decades of your lifespan. You can do more for humanity if you live a few more decades.
“Even if you occasionally sacrifice some mortals, you can save ten to a hundred times more mortals if you live for a few more decades.” Marchioness Plum Snow looked at Liu Qiyue. “Junior Sister, I hope you will consider it carefully.”
Liu Qiyue was stunned. Live a few more decades? She could save ten times or a hundred times more humans? Liu Qiyue nodded and said, “I understand.”
“Junior Sister Liu, Marquis Eastcalm, farewell!” Marchioness Plum Snow cupped her hands. Meng Chuan and his wife cupped their hands as well. She then turned around and left with a pair of young Godfiends. They followed the messenger-an avian demon monarch-and headed for a new city.
Meng Chuan and his wife watched them leave.
Marchioness Plum Snow was extremely famous. After all, very few people could live to the end of their lifespan during a war. She cultivated the Eon Sea Fiend Body, and she was skilled at domains and close combat! She had strength comparable to a Regis Godfiend. Even if a fifth Firmament demon monarch attacked, she could fight it for a long time with her domain and close combat abilities.
“That pair of young Godfiends is Senior Sister Chang’s great-grandchildren,” said Liu Qiyue. “Senior Sister Chang is old, but she discovered that the descendants of her family are very mediocre. She barely managed to groom these two brothers. Despite being guided by Senior Sister Chang, the two brothers still didn’t qualify for entry into Archean Mountain. However, Senior Sister Chang used her credits to exchange for a chance for the two of them to enter the Godfiend Blood Pool. She exchanged for top-grade Godfiend body manuals and had these two brothers cultivate high-grade Godfiend bodies. Their cultivation resources are slightly better than ordinary Archean Mountain inner sect disciples. Senior Sister Chang used her credits to exchange for all of them. These two brothers likely have a chance of reaching the Great Solar realm. However, they have no hope of becoming Marquis Godfiends.”
“After many years of constant fighting, it’s very normal for one to plan for their family clan when they are nearing the end of their lifespans.” Meng Chuan nodded as he thought of his grandaunt. After his grandaunt was heavily injured, she returned to her hometown to nurture her descendants.
