Marchioness Plum Snow probably shared the same thoughts. “Let’s go,” said Meng Chuan. “Yes.”
The couple set off with the messenger, another avian demon monarch.
Meng Chuan traveled very quickly. After traveling thousands of kilometers, they arrived at a large familiar city. Most of the members of the Meng family lived in this city – Jiang State Capital.
“Jiang State Capital.”
Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue looked down.
“Milords, we have to keep the identity of the guardian Godfiends a secret. We mustn’t reveal it, in case the demons discover it,” said the avian demon monarch envoy respectfully. At the same time, it pointed at an ordinary manor. “The courtyard with peach blossoms is where the two of you will live.”
“I still can’t believe it,” said Liu Qiyue. “Archean Mountain actually wants me to guard Jiang State Capital.”
“It’s written clearly on the transfer orders,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “It’s a large city with over 20 million people,” said Liu Qiyue.
Even though the Great Zhou Dynasty had 62 large cities, there were only over ten cities with a population of 20 million.
“Ordinary large cities are often attacked,” said Meng Chuan. “They encounter attacks once every two to three months, but the top cities are seldom attacked. In the past half-year, only five top cities have been attacked, but they were only attacked once. Jiang State Capital is one of them. I heard that when 1,200 third Firmament demon monarchs attacked, more than 1,100 died. Only a few dozen demon monarchs managed to escape.”
“Yes.” Liu Qiyue nodded.
The city’s defenses were too powerful. A Dao Protector, Wang Shan, had secretly guarded Jiang State Capital! With a Dao Protector’s body, he was in no way weaker than King True Martial.
More than 1,100 of the 1,200 demon monarchs died. The death ratio was crazy! Demon monarchs were also afraid of death! After entering the human world, the demons didn’t have much control over the demon monarchs. They relied on treasures to entice them into attacking cities! The demon monarchs were unwilling to commit suicide.
When attacking a large city, those with better life-preservation means would have a chance of survival if they were careful. Only then were they willing to participate in the attack. However, if the death rate exceeded 95%? The demon monarchs were unwilling to participate in the attack.
“With Jiang State Capital’s combat results, even if the demons guess that there might be changes in our defenses, the possibility of them attacking Jiang State Capital is still very low,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “At the very least, it is much more unlikely for you to cast Phoenix’s Nirvana here.”
Liu Qiyue nodded. She knew that her husband had spent a lot of effort to transfer her to Jiang State Capital.
This transfer... was actually very ingenious. Just a Marquis Godfiend was used to guard a top city. It saved Archean Mountain’s combat strength.
At the bottom of the sea, inside a small grotto-heaven.
Patriarch Yellow Oscillate, the black-robed man, and Demon Sage Nine Abyss gathered together.
“The Great Zhou Dynasty and the Black Sand Dynasty have over 100 large cities. We attack 30 to 40 cities every month, but we only mobilize tens of thousands of demon monarchs,” said Patriarch Yellow Oscillate with a smile. “If we take turns, the numerous demon monarchs will only take action once a year. The demon monarchs aren’t against it.”
“This pressure is enough.” Demon Sage Nine Abyss nodded. “Attacking one or two top cities occasionally will ensure that Regis Godfiends will continue guarding these large cities.”
The black-robed man said coldly, “If a top city doesn’t have a Godfiend comparable to a Regis Godfiend, the attacking demon monarchs will demolish it.”
“It’s time for the second step,” said Demon Sage Nine Abyss. “Too many second Firmament demon monarchs have been idle. Let them hunt freely! Give all demon monarchs a mission. They will earn 100 credits for every mortal they hunt.”“Nine Abyss, these mortals are very careful when hiding,” said the black-robed man. “They are all carefully hiding in the wilderness, the lakes, and the depths of mountains. They are very afraid that demon monarchs will discover them. If one is just a slight distance away, it’s impossible to find them with the naked eye.”
“That’s why killing a mortal will earn them 100 credits,” said Demon Sage Nine Abyss with a smile. “Those demon monarchs will scour the areas one by one. If large groups of human Godfiends come out to kill demon monarchs, we can also kill them. The occasional handful of powerful Godfiends won’t be able to save the entire human world.”
The black-robed man and Patriarch Yellow Oscillate nodded.
Demon Sage Nine Abyss frowned and said, “North Sense, we can suppress humans in all aspects because we have many demon monarchs. However, King White Treasure and Archean Mountain’s mysterious Godfiend have been hunting the underground demon monarchs down. More demon monarchs are coming from the Demon Realm, and more demon monarchs are hiding underground. The number of demon monarchs they kill every year is greater than our losses on land.”
“The Imperial Lords already created plans to deal with King White Treasure.” Demon Sage Nine Abyss looked at the black-robed man. “North Sense, the other mysterious Godfiend underground has always been in the Great Zhou Dynasty. Which Archean Mountain Godfiend is it? You have to investigate their identity carefully. The number of demon monarchs they kill every year is even greater than King White Treasure.”
“I’m still investigating.” The black-robed man felt an incoming headache when talking about the issue.
“Archean Mountain has two Regis Godfiends that are in contact with us. Don’t tell me those two Regis Godfiends don’t know who is responsible for carrying out underground reconnaissance in the Great Zhou Dynasty?” Demon Sage Nine Abyss was furious.
“Both of them say they don’t know,” said the black-robed man. “Can’t they guess? There are only a few Regis Godfiends,” said Demon Sage Nine Abyss angrily. “In my opinion, the two of them just don’t want to talk!”

chapters.title: Chapter 334 - Patrolling the Mountains
chapters.content:
Chapter 334 Patrolling the Mountains
Patriarch Yellow Oscillate drank his alcohol and said with a smile, “It’s just a bet on both sides. They are taking advantage of us, and they are also taking advantage of the humans. They remain free, no matter who wins. We don’t have sufficient evidence of their betrayal. It’s not realistic to make them stand on our side like the Skydemon Sect. In the human world… the combat strength advantage still lies with the humans.”
“We have to figure out that Godfiend’s identity,” said Demon Sage Nine Abyss. “We suffer enough losses in battles aboveground. If underground demon monarchs are continuously slaughtered, our army of a million ordinary demon monarchs won’t last for long.”
“I’ve already tried my best,” said the black-robed man in a low voice. “Actually, there’s a method to trace the Godfiend’s identity. It’s the easiest method, and it will definitely reveal the mysterious Godfiend’s identity.”
Demon Sage Nine Abyss and Patriarch Yellow Oscillate were astonished.
The black-robed man continued, “Blood curse.”
“Blood curse?” Demon Sage Nine Abyss shook his head. “It’s useless. Even if a demon monarch is killed, the blood curse won’t land on the murderer. A Regis Godfiend’s Seamless domain will definitely isolate the blood curse. Even a Marquis Godfiend’s Darkstar domain can detect external powers like the blood curse. They won’t allow it to be attached to their bodies.”
“I’m talking about a blood curse that can trace karma,” said the black-robed man.
“Trace karma?” Demon Sage Nine Abyss and Patriarch Yellow Oscillate were alarmed as they looked at their companion.
“No matter what method is employed during the kill, as long as one is killed, we can trace the karma. It will definitely be attached to the enemy. Unless the enemy has the ability to isolate karma, they won’t be able to remove the blood curse,” said the black-robed man softly. “In the Demon Realm, aside from the three Imperial Lords, Demon Sage Thousand Cricket can also do this.”
Demon Sage Nine Abyss and Patriarch Yellow Oscillate’s hearts stirred.
“Do you mean to have Demon Sage Thousand Cricket enter the human world via possession?” Demon Sage Nine Abyss said, “Demon Sage Thousand Cricket is still young. He might not be willing to come to the human world.”
“Hahaha, North Sense, I know you have a grudge against Thousand Cricket.” Patriarch Yellow Oscillate laughed.
“I’m thinking about the interests of the demons and the Imperial Lords,” said the black-robed man. “Besides, there’s really nothing else we can do to figure out the mysterious Archean Mountain Godfiend’s identity. Nine Abyss, you know that we’ve already tried all other solutions.”
Demon Sage Nine Abyss pondered for a moment before nodding. “Alright, I’ll report it to the Imperial Lords. Since there’s nothing we can do, we’ll let the Imperial Lords think of a solution. Otherwise, we can only let the Godfiend continue to massacre the demon monarchs hiding underground.”
9th May, night.
Swoosh.
An avian demon monarch descended and bowed respectfully. “Marquis Eastcalm, your letter.” A letter flew towards Meng Chuan and his wife.
Meng Chuan was somewhat surprised. If it weren’t an important letter, avian demon monarchs would usually immediately leave after delivering the letter. To hand over the letter at such a close distance implied the importance of the letter.
Meng Chuan opened the envelope and read the contents of the letter. A Supremacy Quintessential Essence mark adorned the letter, proving its authenticity. “What?” Meng Chuan’s expression changed as he read through the letter’s contents.
“What’s wrong?” Liu Qiyue asked.
“The demon army is about to begin hunting mortals.” Meng Chuan handed the letter to Liu Qiyue.
Liu Qiyue’s expression changed slightly when she read through the letter. “A mortal is worth 100 credits? Let the demon monarchs hunt as they please?”
“This order has been passed down to all demon monarchs. Archean Mountain received the news immediately,” said Meng Chuan. “Seventy percent of the world’s population is outside the cities. If we watch these mortals get constantly hunted by a million demon monarchs without doing a thing, almost all of them will be killed. We have to save them!”
“According to the letter, Archean Mountain will deploy 1,500 Great Solar Godfiends and 3,000 demon monarch servants to patrol the world for a long time.” Liu Qiyue read the letter. “If they encounter danger, they will seek help and deploy you.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded. “1,500 Great Solar Godfiends… Archean Mountain doesn’t even have 1,500 Great Solar Godfiend disciples. Outer sect disciples are clearly included in this arrangement. Even demon monarch servants under Archean Mountain’s control are to be mobilized. The sect is already doing its best. The demon monarchs will not be allowed to slaughter the world’s population wantonly.”
“3,000 demon monarch servants. I’m afraid most of them will be deployed, right?” asked Liu Qiyue.
“There aren’t many Godfiends that can control demon monarch servants. Marquis Godfiends that cultivate the Mirage Fiend Body, Regis Godfiends, and Supremacies can control them,” said Meng Chuan. “However, 3,000 demon monarch servants is already the maximum number that Archean Mountain can deploy without affecting existing arrangements.”
For example, King Desire Redemption-who had the strongest illusion technique at Archean Mountain-could control over 1,000 third Firmament demon monarchs alone. This was his limit.
Apart from the avian demon monarchs, these 3,000 demon monarch servants were relatively strong. They were typically strong third Firmament demon monarchs like mountain demons.
10th May, morning.
Archean Mountain, in front of Blood Red Cliff.
A large group of Godfiends gathered here. All of them carried bags on their backs and were ready to leave. Meng You, Meng An, and the other young disciples watched from the side.
Li Guan stood at the front. Archean Mountain Lord and Elder Yi stood beside him.
“All 523 of you Great Solar Godfiends will be deployed today,” said Li Guan solemnly. “More than a million demon monarchs will be conducting wanton slaughter in our home. At this moment, I need you to slay the demon monarchs. Joining you will be other Great Solar Godfiends. They will head out from the various cities in the Great Zhou Dynasty.
“There are a total of 1,509 Great Solar Godfiends heading out to reinforce the various regions! Among them are 601 inner sect disciples and 908 outer sect disciples,” said Li Guan. “Apart from that, 3,000 demon monarch servants will be deployed. We are giving our all, and you only have one goal—if a demon monarch dares show its face, kill it. Kill them until they wouldn’t dare to show their face!”The 523 Great Solar Godfiends present had killing intent in their eyes. Some of them had white hair, while others were still in their prime.
“From now on, all of you will be living out in the open as you patrol the wilderness, hunting down any demon monarch that dares to appear. You will constantly be fighting. You might die in the wilderness; you may not even leave behind a corpse. However, humanity will forever remember every single one of you!” said Li Guan, his eyes red.
Battle intent surged in all the Godfiends present.
There was no way out. It was a war between species! They had nowhere to retreat to.
“Humans will ultimately win this war. All of you are heroes of humanity!” Li Guan said in a deep voice. “Now, set off!”
The 523 Great Solar Godfiends immediately turned around and carried their bags. They brought their weapons and left the mountain.
Meng An, Meng You, many other young disciples, as well as many Godfiends with potential to become Marquis Godfiends, watched silently. All of them wanted to join the fray. However, they needed to become stronger and obtain Archean Mountain’s permission before they could leave the mountain.
Archean Mountain deployed 1,500 Great Solar Godfiends and 3,000 demon monarch servants. Black Sand Grotto-Heaven and Two World Island also sent out their forces! They would patrol the world and protect mortals.

chapters.title: Chapter 335 - Xue Feng’s Request
chapters.content:
Chapter 335 Xue Feng’s Request
Great Zhou Dynasty, Xufang City.
A dark figure descended into a courtyard. It was Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar. At first glance, it looked like a normal person, but it was darker.
“Gucheng,” said Li Guan as he stood in the courtyard.
A figure emerged from an underground tunnel in the rockery. He bowed respectfully. “Master.” This figure was the strongest Godfiend of Archean Mountain’s Poison Refinement lineage-King Luyue.
“Gucheng, you know the global situation. The demon monarchs are attacking cities almost every month,” said Li Guan, “We are in desperate need of the poisonous bugs you refine. How’s the progress of your refinement?”
“It’s not easy to refine 8,000 poisonous bugs, but many of the difficulties have been resolved. It will probably take another two months,” said King Luyue respectfully. He had the experience of refining poisonous bugs for his descendants.
However, Archean Mountain’s request was for him to refine a large number of poisonous bugs that other Godfiends could control. He needed to ensure that every poisonous bug had the strength of a peak Great Solar Godfiend. This was an unprecedented challenge for King Luyue.
Archean Mountain provided him all kinds of precious materials. After trial-and-error with his poison bug refinement, King Luyue finally figured out something.
“Two months?” Li Guan’s eyes lit up.
“However, to control these poisonous bugs, one has to be at least a Great Solar Godfiend that cultivates the Myriad Poisons Fiend Body,” said King Luyue. “Furthermore, the weaker ones might only be able to control dozens of poisonous bugs. The more talented Myriad Poisons Fiend Body Godfiends might be able to control a few hundred. However, I can guarantee that every poisonous bug has the strength of a peak Great Solar Godfiend. They are even more terrifying than before. They are extremely poisonous and are good at destroying bodies. I selected their traits in a targeted manner so that they could deal with demons more effectively.
“Don’t worry. Archean Mountain has 53 Great Solar Godfiends that cultivate the Myriad Poisons Fiend Body. They are all on the mountain waiting for your poisonous bugs.” Li Guan smiled.
“There are only 53 out of 1,000 Great Solar Godfiends. If there are more, we can control more poisonous bugs,” said King Luyue wistfully.
Any disciple could attempt to cultivate the Poison Refinement lineage. Mirage Fiend Body, Myriad Poisons Fiend Body, Sanguine Divine Body... These three high-grade Godfiend bodies had no requirements. Disciples could attempt to cultivate them, but it was very difficult to master them.
As there were no requirements, they had plenty of cultivators. Transcendent-grade Godfiend body Godfiends were what they were lacking. There were only over 100 Great Solar Godfiends that cultivated one of the 12 transcendent-grade Godfiend bodies. However, there were over 1,000 Great Solar Godfiends that cultivated high-grade Godfiend bodies.
Archean Mountain.
“I’ve asked Gucheng. He said that the 8,000 poisonous bugs would be ready in two months,” said Li Guan.
“Black Sand Grotto-Heaven is adamant. They will only deliver us 3,000 iron stone beasts.” The illusory Luo Tang shook her head. “Furthermore, it will take at least half a year. They are also short of iron stone beasts. Halberd Hall is doing its best. Senior Brother, do we still need to continue the negotiations?”
Iron stone beasts were a special weapon refined by Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s Halberd Hall. It wasn’t difficult to control an iron stone beast-which had the strength of a peak Great Solar Godfiend. However, one still needed an Essence Soul to control it! A first-level Essence Soul could only control ten. A second-level Essence Soul could only control 100. Third-level Essence Souls could control a lot more.
“Let’s leave it at that.” Li Guan said, “Although Black Sand Grotto-Heaven values Xue Feng, Xue Feng’s influence hasn’t reached tremendous proportions during the war. Their limit is probably 3,000 iron stone beasts.”
“He’s ultimately a Creation Supremacy sapling. I’m really unwilling to give him to Black Sand Grotto-Heaven.” Qin Wu shook his head and sighed.
“Now that we are working together to fend off the demons, there’s no need to be too calculative. Xue Feng’s growth will be much slower in Archean Mountain. When he goes to Black Sand Grotto-Heaven and obtains the core legacy of the Black Sand lineage, his future will be more promising. If he really becomes a Creation Supremacy in the future, he would be equivalent to an additional force to be reckoned with on our side,” said Li Guan. “By the way, with us telling Xue Feng to join another faction, does he have any new conditions?”
“Xue Feng told me long ago that he will leave it up to us,” said the illusory Qin Wu. “Apart from what he said earlier, he will head to Black Sand Grotto-Heaven after becoming a Regis Godfiend. He mentioned a new condition a few months ago.”
“What’s the condition?” inquired Li Guan.
“When Yan Jin leaves the mountain, arrange for him to guard the city with him as support,” said Qin Wu.
“The brothers haven’t seen each other for a long time. He probably wants a reunion,” said Luo Tang with a smile.
“It’s trivial.” Li Guan nodded as well. “Yan Jin has just broken through. He only has the strength of an ordinary Marquis Godfiend. He can only be responsible for support, no matter which city he is assigned to. Assign him to Xue Feng’s city.”
Boom!
In a desert, Meng Chuan exited from the ground and soared into the sky. The sun had already set, but he could still see a hue of red.
After an entire day of underground reconnaissance, Meng Chuan embarked on his return journey.
The situation is better than I expected. Meng Chuan flew at high altitudes and looked down at the ground. Although the demons have set a bounty and allowed the demon monarchs to hunt freely, the three sects have more than 10,000 Great Solar realm experts in total. They are scattered all over the world. Together with Earth Net’s spies everywhere, demon monarchs are discovered by Earth Net not long after they appear. The Godfiends will then be informed to hunt them down. However, this situation is maintained by many patrolling Godfiends. Meng Chuan had no choice. He was ultimately just a single person.
Swoosh.
He swooped down and silently returned to Jiang State Capital. Although Liu Yebai and Meng Dajiang lived in Meng Manor, Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue didn’t dare to show themselves to them. The identity of the guardian Godfiends had to be kept a secret.
“Ah Chuan, it’s a letter from Yan Jin.” Liu Qiyue sat by the dining table and handed the letter to her husband.
“Oh?” Meng Chuan opened the letter. “He consolidated his strength after becoming a Marquis Godfiend. He’s planning on leaving the mountain in the next few days?”
“We’re in desperate need of Marquis Godfiends now,” said Liu Qiyue wistfully. “With one more Marquis Godfiend, we can protect another area of a few dozen kilometers and save many people.” Meng Chuan nodded. “Yan Jin’s talent is actually quite high. After so many years, he has finally become a Marquis Godfiend.”“Back then, we fought alongside each other in Eastcalm City. Now that we’ve become Marquis Godfiends, we have to thank the heavens,” said Liu Qiyue with a smile.
“In the blink of an eye, over 30 years have passed.” Meng Chuan nodded.
“Marquis Clear Snow, we’ve arrived at Far Spring City.” The avian demon monarch led Yan Jin to his designated mission area. It escorted him the entire way to ensure that Yan Jin didn’t interact with others.
I need to guard a large city like Far Spring City? I wonder which other Godfiends are here. Yan Jin also knew that a newly-advanced Marquis Godfiend didn’t have the strength to protect a large city. He had only come here to provide support. Whoosh.
The avian demon monarch landed in a courtyard with Yan Jin. Two people were already waiting for Yan Jin in the courtyard.
“Junior Brother Yan,” said a handsome man with a fan. “You brothers are really fated.”
“Seventh Brother.” Xue Feng smiled at his younger brother.
After Yan Jin landed, he felt mixed emotions.

chapters.title: Chapter 336 - Myriad Sword Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 336 Myriad Sword Sect
Yan Jin had the urge to request the sect to change his deployment orders. Although his fifth brother, Xue Feng, had treated him the best, he really didn’t want to interact with the Xue Family. However, he knew that the Supremacies arranged how the Godfiends were stationed in the various cities. They only made such arrangements after contemplating and balancing various aspects. Redeploying a Godfiend would affect the entire system. Many Godfiends would then have to be redeployed around the Great Zhou Dynasty.
For example, when Liu Qiyue was deployed to Jiang State Capital, Marchioness Plum Snow had been given a new arrangement! When Wang Shan, a Dao Protector, had been redeployed, many other cities had received new guardian Godfiends.
Redeployment was very troublesome. Meng Chuan had only written a letter to the Supremacies after seeing his wife consume her lifespan every time she cast Phoenix’s Nirvana! The Supremacies made an exception for them because of Meng Chuan’s great contributions. Ordinary Marquis Godfiends were unable to make the Supremacies change their plans without a special reason.
“In the future, we will support each other,” said the fan-wielding man with a smile. “We will guard this city well.”
Yan Jin nodded. “Yes, Senior Brother Lu.”
“We’ve already prepared food,” said the fan-wielding man with a smile. “Let’s not delay any further. We’ll discuss how the three of us are going to work together and deal with demon monarch attacks as we eat.”
Yan Jin nodded.
Xue Feng looked at his younger brother. Marquis Clear Snow, thought Xue Feng. To take the title “Clear Snow,” do you really hate Father that much?
Yan Jin’s mother was a maidservant of King Calm Sea. Clear Snow was also the name she used when she was a maidservant. It wasn’t even her real name. A Marquis Godfiend using a maidservant’s name as a title?
The Godfiends needed to hide their identities, so usually, Yan Jin could only be with Xue Feng and Senior Brother Lu.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
The Darkstar domain spread out.
Xue Feng and Yan Jin transformed into two sword beams as they fought. Although Yan Jin was a man of few words and didn’t pay much attention to Xue Feng, he was still willing to spar. He attacked his elder brother with his full strength. Clang! Clang!
Two swords were sent flying.
“Seventh Brother, you lost again,” said Xue Feng with a smile.
SW
Yan Jin silently picked up the two swords and left.
“Senior Brother Xue, aren’t you being too ruthless by sending his two swords flying? Aren’t you going to show him mercy at all?’ Senior Brother Lu walked over as he fanned himself.
W
Xue Feng shook his head. “You don’t know him. If I had shown him mercy, he probably wouldn’t even have bothered to fight me. He wants me to be ruthless! If I defeat him ruthlessly, he will end up never yielding despite the setbacks.”
“Oh?” Senior Brother Lu was shocked.
They sparred again and again. The days of guardian Godfiends were very lonely. Yan Jin mostly cultivated and sparred. However, Xue Feng thrashed him badly every time.
Time passed.
Yan Jin also understood that his elder brother had sparred with him to help him cultivate. Deep down, he was cold on the outside but warm on the inside. Xue Feng had always treated him very well for many years. He knew that it was only because of the Xue family that he was unwilling to get too close to his fifth brother. However, he remembered this kinship deep down.
Oh, this is? When he returned to his room, Yan Jin saw a small black sword on the table. Yan Jin vaguely felt that the small sword was extraordinary. He held it in his hand in puzzlement and carefully inspected it.
Boom.
His consciousness was directly drawn in. A large number of sword arts surged into his mind. The mysterious legacy didn’t allow him to reject it and entered his Essence Soul.
Oh? It took him a long time to regain his senses. He threw the black sword on the table and looked at it in shock. Myriad Sword Sect? The core legacy of a large sect in history, the Myriad Sword Sect? Why would it appear on my desk? Yan Jin knew what he had just obtained. It was the legacy of a large sect that was famous for its sword arts in human history. The Myriad Sword Sect had once been extremely powerful. At its peak, it was much stronger than present-day Two World Island. Although it had long been destroyed, the core legacy of the Myriad Sword Sect was still a priceless treasure.
This legacy had been lost during the rise and fall of human factions. It had now appeared in Yan Jin’s room.
It’s impossible for it to appear out of thin air. That means someone placed it here. Yan Jin immediately thought of his brother. Fifth Brother? Yan Jin held the black sword and immediately went to Xue Feng’s residence.
Xue Feng was reading in the study.
“Did you leave this with me?” Yan Jin walked in and held the black sword.
“Yes.” Xue Feng held the scroll in his hand and nodded with a smile. “Haven’t you always wanted to defeat me? That black sword is the reason why I mastered the Fifteen Golden Wind Swords. Only by learning the core legacy can you defeat me.” Yan Jin looked at Xue Feng.
Dong. Yan Jin threw the black sword and turned to leave.
Xue Feng smiled as he watched his younger brother leave. He said with a smile, “If you want to thank me, kill more demon monarchs.”
Yan Jin didn’t say anything as he walked away.
This introvert. Xue Feng smiled as he picked up the black sword. Regardless, after receiving the legacy, you can’t forget it even if you want to. Now that Seventh Brother has also learned it, it’s time to hand over the Myriad Sword Sect’s legacy to the sect.
Xue Feng had kept the legacy after he learned it because he hoped that his seventh brother would also learn it one day. However, the requirement for accepting the legacy was very harsh-one needed to condense an Essence Soul to accept the legacy. That was why he had waited until today. As for his brothers and sisters, they were relatively inferior. Furthermore, only his second brother used a sword, but he didn’t have a chance of becoming a Marquis Godfiend. He was only an ordinary Great Solar Godfiend and was currently a Patroller Godfiend.
The core legacy of the Myriad Sword Sect? After receiving the news, Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar rushed over personally. He was rather shocked when he held the small black sword. Archean Mountain had an unfathomable heritage. However, in terms of sword arts, their heritage was inferior to the black sword in his hand.
“Xue Feng, thank you.” Li Guan looked at Xue Feng. “Our sect even made you join another sect, but you still offered such a precious item to our Archean Mountain. Our Archean Mountain owes you a lot. If you have anything you want, feel free to tell us.”
“After I go to Black Sand Grotto-Heaven, I won’t be able to meet my family much,” said Xue Feng. “Please help my brothers and sisters, as well as my father. I don’t need anything else. Let them continue to be patrollers or city guardians. I just hope they won’t be sent to their deaths.”
Li Guan nodded. “They are all contributing to humanity. We will take good care of them anyway. Don’t you have any other requests?”
“No.” Xue Feng shook his head. As a single person, what benefits did he need? After he went to Black Sand Grotto-Heaven, he would have great opportunities. He would naturally rely on himself.
Li Guan looked at Xue Feng and really liked this junior. He sighed and said, “If it weren’t for this tumultuous period, I definitely wouldn’t have let you join them.”
“It’s all the same-slaying demon monarchs,” said Xue Feng.
In the blink of an eye, two years passed.
Meng Chuan had left the World Gap for more than three years. He spent every night cultivating his saber art. Even when extremely exhausted, he would cultivate his saber art for two hours in the morning after waking up. This allowed him to accumulate insights towards his saber art.
Swoosh.
In the sky above Jiang State Capital, a figure executed a movement technique, leaving behind traces of lightning. It was as though dragons and snakes constantly transformed as they played hide and seek amidst the fog.
The lightning bolt vanished. A figure appeared in midair; it was Meng Chuan. With the Darkstar domain enveloping him, no one could see Meng Chuan using his movement technique.
My Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique has already taken shape. I’m only one step away from the Dharma Domain realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 337 - King Calm Sea’s Reply
chapters.content:
Chapter 337 King Calm Sea’s Reply
Ever since he returned from the World Gap, Meng Chuan had drawn upon the knowledge contained in many of the lightning lineage ultimate techniques in history. He had attempted to create two ultimate techniques —the Infinite Saber and the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique. The Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique was in its nascent form.
Of course, the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique could also be used as a saber art. After all, it used the World Roving Dragon Saber as its foundation. He successfully fused the Yin-Yang Form of Lightning’s essence into it and pushed his movement technique to brand new heights by building upon the foundation of his predecessors. However, this movement technique didn’t have any advantage in pure speed. Its speed was only comparable to the World Roving Dragon Saber.
Whoosh.
Under the night sky, Meng Chuan landed in the courtyard. With a flip of his hand, he held Demon Slayer and began to cultivate his other ultimate technique, Infinite Saber.
He unsheathed his saber and transformed into a bolt of lightning. Like lightning, he sliced through the void.
Fast!
If one were to say that the Heart Intent Saber emphasized the profundity of Yin-Yang Fusion, then the Infinite Saber focused on pure strength and speed! Demon Slayer forcefully sliced through the void at speeds so fast that it left one alarmed.
The Infinite Saber is more important to me. I hope I can push it to the Dharma Domain realm first. Meng Chuan spent most of his time and energy cultivating the Infinite Saber, leaving the rest of his time for the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique. This was because Meng Chuan had figured out a flying technique-Lightning Escape Technique—when he was cultivating the Infinite Saber Art!
The Lightning Escape Technique originated from the Infinite Saber. When his body transformed into a saber beam, he tore through the air like lightning… He could travel 15 kilometers in a second. He was actually faster than when he executed the World Roving Dragon Saber Art.
I can kill even more demon monarchs during my underground reconnaissance. The faster I am, the greater the power of my Infinite Saber. Meng Chuan naturally placed greater importance on the Infinite Saber. In fact, there had been many experts in human history that had created ultimate techniques in line with the Flash Form of Lightning’s essence. They were famous for their speed, but they had only reached the Dharma Domain realm. None of them had reached the Grotto-Heaven realm.
After looking at the techniques created in the past—which are similar to the Flash Form of Lightning’s essence—I know that they all focus on increasing one’s speed. However, when one’s speed reaches a certain level, they will be suppressed by the world. Meng Chuan sheathed his saber and pondered.
People from the past believed that one has to break through the shackles of the world to reach the Grotto-Heaven realm. However, no one in history has managed to do so. Can one really deal so much damage to the world when their speed reaches a certain level, causing them to be suppressed by the world? Meng Chuan guessed.
No rush. My speed has yet to be affected by the world’s suppression. I’m clearly not fast enough. Meng Chuan mocked himself before he drew his saber again.
After returning from the World Gap, Meng Chuan had been cultivating with all his might. It was because he had seen too many things. The demon monarchs attacked the cities again and again. In fact, a fourth Firmament demon monarch team lurked in the shadows whenever ordinary demon monarchs attacked the cities. When they discovered that Marquis Godfiends were guarding a city, a fourth Firmament demon monarch team would swoop down from the sky and assassinate the Marquis Godfiends! Even fifth Firmament demon monarchs were ambushing the Godfiends.
Although the humans had means to deal with the demon monarchs, Archean Mountain had already lost five Marquis Godfiends after all these city attacks! Seven of Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s Marquis Godfiends had died. Although the demons had suffered greater losses, the Godfiends that died couldn’t be revived.
“Ah Chuan.” When dawn broke, Liu Qiyue walked out of the room after waking up. She walked over and looked at her husband with a pained expression. “You have to rest well. Don’t work so hard. Perhaps resting more will help your cultivation.”
“Don’t worry. I know my body well.” Meng Chuan looked at his wife. The sweat on his body naturally evaporated. “I have a feeling that I’m advancing every day. I’m getting closer and closer to the Dharma Domain realm. Furthermore, I can’t stop when I think of how patrolling Godfiends could be dying in battle every day. How long has it been? Yet nearly 30% of the patrolling Godfiends have already died in battle.
The three sects tried their best; for example, Earth Net’s reconnaissance. Avian demon monarchs would scan the area ahead of time. The patrolling Godfiends also brought demon monarch servants with them. However, as long as a battle erupted, there would ultimately be accidents. The demons were also very cunning.
Over the past two years, nearly 30% of the patrolling Godfiends had died in battle.
“Yes.” Liu Qiyue nodded gently and didn’t say anything else.
In the courtyard.
Yan Jin and Xue Feng were sparring.
Snow Drift.
Sword beams rained down on Xue Feng like snowflakes in the void. However, Xue Feng held his sword in one hand and blocked every snowflake.
Yan Jin landed on the ground and revealed a look of delight.
“Seventh Brother, you’ve finally mastered Snow Drift,” said Xue Feng with a smile. “Just this move alone gives you the strength of a top Marquis Godfiend.” “Not worth mentioning.” Yan Jin spoke a little more. After all, the human heart remained soft. After spending more than two years together, Yan Jin could sense his brother’s concern for him. The relationship between the two brothers had improved significantly. In fact, Yan Jin was only cold on the outside. In the past, he was resistant towards Xue Feng because of the Xue family. As time passed, changes were natural. I only have the strength of a top Marquis Godfiend even after obtaining the Myriad Sword Sect’s legacy and having my brother’s help? When can I get close to him? Yan Jin’s eyes turned colder when he thought of King Calm Sea and his dead mother.
“I’ll head back first,” said Yan Jin before turning to leave.
Sigh… Xue Feng wanted to say something, but he shut his mouth. This seventh brother of mine has always had a knot in his heart. It’s not his fault. Father does have to bear most of the responsibility. Xue Feng had been admitted to Archean Mountain at the age of 13, so he didn’t know what his brother had experienced. Later, he sent someone to investigate before finding out what his brother had experienced. This made him feel some resentment towards his father.
Father, even if you are focused on guarding the city pass and cultivating, don’t you care about your children at all? Back then, he felt like he was in hell. Despite his despair, you still allowed everything to happen? Seventh Brother only wants justice. So what if you admit your mistake and give his mother the name she rightfully deserves? Xue Feng couldn’t understand his father.
That night.
Xue Feng couldn’t help but write a letter. Since Father left a sword mark on Seventh Brother, he definitely doesn’t have a heart of steel. Xue Feng wrote the letter, his eyes filled with anticipation.
Duyang City. King Calm Sea temporarily guarded this place. He had returned from the World Gap a year ago. His life-preservation means were a little weaker in the World Gap! When he was roaming the World Gap with King True Martial, he had experienced many harrowing instances. King True Martial had to risk his life to protect him. With his pride, he left the World Gap. He was replaced with a stronger Regis Godfiend, Peng Mu, who reigned supreme 1,000 years ago. Including the ancient Godfiends who had awakened, the Archean Mountain Godfiend closest to King True Martial in strength was Peng Mu. In the early days, Archean Mountain had allowed King Calm Sea to explore the World Gap and see the birth of the world for the betterment of his cultivation.
Swoosh.
King Calm Sea sat cross-legged in a courtyard of Duyang City. Suddenly, an avian demon monarch flew over. It threw a letter at King Calm Sea before leaving.
King Calm Sea reached out to receive it.
Feng’er’s letter? King Calm Sea was somewhat astonished. Among his many children, he was most satisfied with Xue Feng. Furthermore, he knew that after Xue Feng became a Regis Godfiend, he would directly join Black Sand Grotto-Heaven and receive the Black Sand lineage’s nurturing.
When King Calm Sea opened the letter, his expression turned gloomy. His eyes turned sharper.
Humph.
King Calm Sea snorted coldly. He clenched the letter in his hand and reduced it to dust.
A day later, while Xue Feng was reading a dossier in his study at night, he saw the letter sent by the avian demon monarch envoy. Father replied? Xue Feng was somewhat nervous and expectant.
I hope Father will stop being so stubborn. It will be our Xue family’s blessing. Xue Feng opened the envelope and unfolded the letter. He nervously looked at the letter’s content, and the color in his face drained.
There was only one sentence on the letter”Defeat me before questioning me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 338 - Fifth Firmament Patriarch Yellow Oscillate
chapters.content:
Chapter 338 Fifth Firmament Patriarch Yellow Oscillate
Father, why are you like this? Xue Feng read the letter; he felt like the words on the letter had stabbed his heart. Although he knew that his father had a heart of stone, Xue Feng believed that his father still had some feelings for his children since he had left a sword mark on each of his children. It made him have extravagant hopes, which resulted in him writing the letter to his father.
There are all kinds of people. Father is that kind of person, I suppose? Xue Feng put down the letter. Quintessential Essence shot out from his fingertip, reducing the letter to dust.
Deep in the sea, inside a small grotto-heaven.
“Congratulations, Brother Yellow Oscillate.”
“Brother Yellow Oscillate, you have now recovered to the fifth Firmament. I believe it won’t be long before you return to the demon sage realm,” said Demon Sage Nine Abyss and the black-robed North Sense with a smile.
Patriarch Yellow Oscillate’s aura was clearly much stronger than before. He remained his handsome self as he smiled and said, “We are demon sages to begin with. You shouldn’t bother congratulating me for reaching the fifth Firmament. As for the demon sage realm? I hope I can return to my original cultivation in 100 years.” “Brother Yellow Oscillate, when are you going to the World Gap? As you are aware, the Imperial Lords are very concerned about this matter,” said Demon Sage Nine Abyss solemnly. “I’ve regained my demon sage realm cultivation, so I can’t go to the World Gap! As for North Sense, he can’t even pierce the World Gap’s membrane. Among the three of us, only you can break through the world membrane and enter the World Gap...”
Yellow Oscillate frowned. “I understand what the Imperial Lords want. They want me to enter the World Gap and lead a bunch of fifth Firmament demon monarchs through the World Gap to infiltrate the human world. However, it’s very difficult to do so! It’s very difficult for a fifth Firmament demon monarch to blast through the world membrane. Although my technique realm has reached the late stages of the Grotto-Heaven realm, our cultivation system is inferior to the Godfiend cultivation system. My strength is slightly lower than King True Martial’s,” said Yellow Oscillate.
“I still need to cultivate a little longer and try my best to push this body to the peak of the fifth Firmament. I want to guarantee that it won’t take me more than 15 seconds to break through the world membrane. All Creation Supremacies will sense somebody attacking the world membrane. They might even rush over at full speed and intercept me. If that happens, I’ll be finished,” said Yellow Oscillate. “I still have to travel the world and observe the River of Spacetime. I need to find the connection point between the world membrane in the human world and the World Gap. I’ll break through the world membrane and enter the World Gap in the future.
“Therefore, the connection point has to be far away from land so that Creation Supremacies can’t arrive in a short period of time. I also have to find a connection point for my return journey. That connection point also has to be far away from land. Otherwise, we will only be sending ourselves to our deaths if Creation Supremacies intercept the group of fifth Firmament demon monarchs.” Yellow Oscillate said, “In case of any accidents, I have to confirm ten different connection points that are 5,000 kilometers away from each other. Only then will I dare to enter the World Gap. I will have the confidence to bring the fifth Firmament demon monarchs back to the human world without being blocked by Creation Supremacies once I’ve finished doing this.”
“The World Gap is between the human world and the Demon Realm. There are countless connection points,” said Demon Sage Nine Abyss with a smile. “It’s not difficult for you, Brother Yellow Oscillate.”
“Once I enter, human Creation Supremacies will immediately realize that something is amiss. They can pry into the secrets of spacetime and sense my identity. They will send Regis Godfiends to enter the World Gap to kill me at all costs.”
“The Imperial Lords will send fifth Firmament demon monarchs to help you,” said North Sense.
“It will be very dangerous. Therefore, I need to continue cultivating. I need to reach the peak of the fifth Firmament first,” said Yellow Oscillate with a smile. “By the way, I plan on traveling around soon. I’ll kill Regis Godfiend along the way.”
“Kill Regis Godfiends?” Nine Abyss and North Sense looked at him.
“Over the past few years, one million demon monarchs have taken turns attacking the city. Fourth Firmament demon monarchs and fifth Firmament demon monarchs occasionally ambush the guardian Godfiends. They only manage to kill Marquis Godfiends,” said Yellow Oscillate with a smile. “I want to make those Regis Godfiends feel fear. I want the humans to know that Regis Godfiends can die at any time if they guard a city.”
The black-robed North Sense nodded. “With Brother Yellow Oscillate’s strength, over 90% of the Regis Godfiends in the world can be killed. However, you have to be careful. Human reinforcements are very fast!”
“Don’t worry. I’ll end the battle within 30 seconds. I’ll leave immediately.” Yellow Oscillate nodded. “I also want to see how much the Death Aura left behind by human experts will help my Stygian Saber Art.”
Patriarch Yellow Oscillate cultivated the Stygian Saber Art. The more experts he killed, the more terrifying his Stygian Saber Art became.
“You just want to kill, right?” asked Demon Sage Nine Abyss with a smile.
Yellow Oscillate’s eyes were filled with killing intent as he said softly, “In the Demon Realm, there are factions. This can’t be killed. That can’t be killed. In the human world... we can kill them all.”
This was one of the reasons why he came to the human world. With his cultivation, it was useless to kill weak experts. Only fifth Firmament demon monarchs were of some nourishment to his saber art. However, how many fifth Firmament demon monarchs were there in the entire Demon Realm? Which one didn’t have a backer? How could they allow him to kill them freely?
Windflow City was a large city in the southwest region of the Great Zhou Dynasty.
Xue Feng, Yan Jin, and Lu Cheng temporarily guarded the city. The guardian Godfiends of each large city would be swapped every few months.
“Junior Brother Xue, your brother is crazy when it comes to cultivation.” Lu Cheng fanned himself as he ate with Xue Feng.
“That’s the way he is.” Xue Feng smiled as he drank. He glanced at Lu Cheng and couldn’t help but say, “It’s winter, yet you’re fanning yourself. How much do you like fans?”
“I’m cultivating this way. Do you understand? You have to learn from me. You have to fuse your cultivation into your daily life, allowing you to cultivate at all times,” said Lu Cheng leisurely.
“You are giving pointers to me, someone who reached the Dharma Domain realm at 50 years old? You reached the Dharma Domain realm at 200 years old.” Xue Feng teased.
Lu Cheng was instantly exasperated. Those that could become Marquis Godfiends all had extraordinary talent. It might be difficult for them to reach the Dharma Domain realm before the age of 90, but a small portion of them could reach the Dharma Domain realm by the time they were 200 years old. These old Marquis Godfiends were the main forces that guarded a city. The younger Marquis Godfiends mainly provided support.
“Oh?” Xue Feng and Lu Cheng’s expressions suddenly changed. They could sense demonic powers erupting in all directions.
“Demon monarchs are attacking the city from all four directions, 1,600 in total.” Xue Feng and Lu Cheng instantly rushed out of the house and soared into the sky. They also saw Yan Jin soar into the sky.
Their gazes swept around the area from above. They saw demon monarchs running in all directions. All of them were third Firmament demon monarchs!
“Same old,” said Lu Cheng.
Xue Feng and Yan Jin nodded.
The three of them quickly flew in different directions. They tried their best to approach the city wall as they released a large number of Quintessential Essence threads. The Quintessential Essence threads that covered the world were beautiful, but the commoners in the city panicked. They knew that the demon monarchs had attacked the city again. In the past few years, the demon monarchs had attacked the city too frequently.
“Demon monarchs are attacking the city!” The soldiers on the city walls immediately lit their beacons.
Boom!
Iron stone beasts crawled out from the moats at the foot of the city walls. At each of the four walls were 50 iron stone beasts. Under Lu Cheng’s remote control, the iron stone beasts rushed towards the demon monarchs. Lu Cheng had a third-level Essence Soul, so it was relatively easy for him to control 200 iron stone beasts. In fact, he could control more iron stone beasts, but Archean Mountain only assigned him 200 of them.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
Poisonous bugs the size of human heads flapped their thin, cicada-like wings and flew out of the city walls.
Every city wall had over 100 poisonous bugs. All of them were controlled by Great Solar Godfiends that cultivated the Myriad Poisons Fiend Body. In Windflow City, there were a total of six Great Solar Godfiends that cultivated the Myriad Poisons Fiend Body. There were a total of 500 poisonous bugs. This was the main force that dealt with demon monarchs.
“Iron stone beasts and poisonous bugs.” The demon monarchs saw them from afar. Although they were afraid, they still charged forward.
After several years of fighting, the demons and humans were familiar with each other’s methods. They also had ways to deal with each other’s tactics. Each attack became more intense than the previous.

chapters.title: Chapter 339 - Man Down
chapters.content:
Chapter 339 Man Down
“Die.” Xue Feng, Lu Cheng, and Yan Jin focused on different directions. They were 25 kilometers away from the city walls they were closest to. Their released Quintessential Essence threads could cross the city walls and attack the demon monarchs.
The iron stone beasts and poisonous bugs had extraordinary bodies. These third Firmament demon monarchs couldn’t destroy them. In a one-on-one battle, the iron stone beasts and poisonous bugs could easily kill third Firmament demon monarchs.
However, the demon monarchs knew how to work together. Some were good at domains, some were good at binding, some were good at close combat, and some were unafraid of poison. When they worked together, they could fight the poisonous bugs and iron stone beasts.
“Charge.”
“It will be a glorious victory if we charge into the city.”
These demon monarchs were filled with fighting spirit. In the city, they fought with poisonous bugs and iron stone beasts, affecting many mortals.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
A large number of Quintessential Essence threads shot out like lightning, making it difficult to dodge.
Bam! A wolf demon monarch—who was fighting an iron stone beast-was struck by two wisps of Quintessential Essence. His movement technique was affected, and his saber strike was torn apart by the Marquis Godfiend Quintessential Essence. The saber’s strength was greatly reduced. The iron stone beast parried the saber and bit at the wolf demon monarch, splitting it into two.
These demons deserve to die. Yan Jin released his Quintessential Essence threads from afar. The Quintessential Essence threads couldn’t kill his enemies directly, but they could injure them! They could affect the demon monarchs’ movement techniques and attacks, making it easier for the poisonous bugs and iron stone beasts to kill the demon monarchs.
These third Firmament demon monarchs have varying degrees of strength. Xue Feng and Lu Cheng wore solemn expressions.
With the help of Marquis Godfiends, the iron stone beasts and poisonous bugs held the advantage. However, they only made most demon monarchs flee. A few third Firmament demon monarchs continued charging towards the city.
In the most intense stage of the attack, a figure hid in the void. It was none other than Patriarch Yellow Oscillate. Patriarch Yellow Oscillate’s domain isolated his aura. He carefully hid himself as he watched the attack from afar.
Marquis Godfiends actually guard this city. Patriarch Yellow Oscillate thought little of them. He wanted to kill a Regis Godfiend during his first attack.
Huh? Marquis Clear Peace, Xue Feng? Patriarch Yellow Oscillate’s gaze swept across Lu Cheng, Yan Jin, and Xue Feng—who were all busy releasing Quintessential Essence threads. Finally, his gaze landed on Xue Feng. A fourth Firmament demon monarch team once fought Xue Feng. It’s said that he has already reached the Dharma Domain realm?
He’s very young and has great potential. Forget it. The next demon monarch attack will happen in a month. I shall let you have the honor of being my first victim in the human world! Marquis Clear Peace Xue Feng! Patriarch Yellow Oscillate approached silently.
Patriarch Yellow Oscillate was very fast in the void. In a flash, he traversed five kilometers. After all, his technique realm was extremely high. His technique realm was even higher than that of King Calm Sea—who was only at the early stages of the Grotto-Heaven realm.
In a few flashes, he had already arrived five kilometers above Xue Feng.
Chi! Chi! Chi! Xue Feng released thousands of Quintessential Essence threads that swept through his surroundings.
These human Marquis Godfiends are becoming more and more cautious after being ambushed by fourth Firmament demon monarch teams. Patriarch Yellow Oscillate carefully approached Xue Feng. Quintessential Essence threads spread out in all directions, including five kilometers above Xue Feng. There are Quintessential Essence threads above them. These Quintessential Essence threads are constantly changing direction, I’m unable to discern any pattern to the threads’ movements.
I’ll be exposed once a Quintessential Essence thread brushes past me. Patriarch Yellow Oscillate carefully approached Xue Feng. Although over 1,000 Quintessential Essence threads swept across Xue Feng’s surroundings, they were ultimately scattered. Five kilometers away, the two Quintessential Essence threads were quite far from each other. Patriarch Yellow Oscillate was confident that he wouldn’t be discovered.
The closer I get to him, the more Quintessential Essence threads there will be. This distance is enough. Patriarch Yellow Oscillate suddenly flashed and charged at Xue Feng
Xue Feng’s Quintessential Essence threads irregularly swept through his surroundings to prevent himself from being ambushed. Some Quintessential Essence threads were used to deal with demon monarchs.
Quintessential Essence threads brushed past Patriarch Yellow Oscillate when he was three kilometers away from Xue Feng, revealing his figure.
What? Xue Feng looked up and saw a handsome yellow-robed man. The yellow-robed man, with fair skin and cold eyes, lunged down. A fifth Firmament demon monarch? Xue Feng shuddered and dove down without any hesitation. At the same time, he swung his sword upwards. Chi! Chi! Chi!
SW
VO
Wisps of wind-like sword shadows swept towards the yellow-robed man. This was the strongest move of the Fifteen Golden Wind Swords that he could execute-Bone-Locking Stance.
With my Black Sand Fiend Body, this Bone-Locking Stance has the strength of an ordinary Regis Godfiend. Even if it can block it, its speed will be affected. Xue Feng pondered the battle situation. Following that, he saw the yellow-robed man fly down at high speeds.
With a bang, the yellow-robed man’s protective domain—which covered hundreds of feet-destroyed the Bone-Locking Stance’s sword shadows. He instantly rushed in front of Xue Feng.
Xue Feng saw everything clearly. The other party didn’t rely on his body! Instead, his protective domain, which spanned hundreds of feet, had destroyed the Bone-Locking Stance. If he were to attack directly, how much strength would be behind his attacks?
Boom!
Xue Feng shuddered as he activated his bracelet without any hesitation. This was a defensive treasure bestowed by Archean Mountain.
A cyan beam enveloped Xue Feng, causing his speed to increase exponentially.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
He and the yellow-robed man burrowed into the ground one after another. Underground reconnaissance was a recognized problem in the world. As long as one was half a kilometer away from each other, an enemy typically couldn’t sense them. As for on the surface? One could see the other party even from 50 kilometers away.
What? Lu Cheng and Yan Jin clearly saw the scene from different spots in Windflow City.
The yellow-robed man swooped down at high speed! Xue Feng’s strike was useless. It didn’t slow the yellow-robed man down. In the end, Xue Feng released a terrifying force and fled underground
It’s too fast. It’s much faster than ordinary Regis Godfiends. Lu Cheng and Yan Jin were alarmed.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
A violent force erupted underground.
He didn’t manage to escape. They are fighting underground. Lu Cheng and Yan Jin looked underground and could clearly sense the terrifying fluctuations emanating.
The ripples of battle rapidly moved. In just a few seconds, they traversed more than ten kilometers underground.
In just fifteen seconds —
Clang! Several kilometers outside the city, a cyan beam of light shot out from the ground. A yellow beam of light followed closely behind as the figure inside the yellow beam slashed out.
The saber beam carried an endless silence as the saber beam transformed into a surging river that swept towards the cyan beam.
Cough! Cough! Cough! The cyan light dissipated. Xue Feng’s face was as white as a sheet. “Archean Mountain really thinks highly of you. They gave you such a protective treasure that could resist seven consecutive strikes from me.” After the yellow-robed man landed, he was about to slash out again when he suddenly frowned and looked into the distance. A Godfiend aura erupted from 50 kilometers away, revealing a lightning-clad figure; it was a young man. “Marquis Eastcalm, Meng Chuan? You deliberately flared your aura to lure me away?” The yellow-robed man didn’t hesitate to slash out with his saber.
Meng Chuan had originally been carrying out underground reconnaissance, but he suddenly sensed a powerful aura. It was because the battle between Patriarch Yellow Oscillate and Xue Feng—who had activated his life-preservation treasure—had caused too great a commotion. It was a clash that reached the threshold of the Creation realm.
He rapidly approached the battlefield. When he arrived 50 kilometers away, he saw Patriarch Yellow Oscillate heavily injure Xue Feng with a single strike. Xue Feng had collapsed to the ground.
What a terrifying strike. It feels even more terrifying than King Calm Sea. I’m not its match. Meng Chuan’s heart burned with anxiety. He had no other choice but to unleash his Godfiend aura to attract the demon’s attention. He hoped to stall for time.
The yellow-robed patriarch indeed glanced at Meng Chuan, but he still swung his saber at Xue Feng. The saber beam surged over like the river of the underworld.
Even though he was 50 kilometers away, Meng Chuan’s heart palpitated from the aura of death.
As for Xue Feng—who had used up all his defensive treasures-he was struck by the aura of death at close range. His body and Essence Soul trembled, unable to resist. So many fellow disciples have died in battle. Now, it’s my turn? This thought surfaced in Xue Feng’s mind.
Under the surging saber beams, Xue Feng’s body was reduced to dust as he dissipated into the churning saber beam river.
Meng Chuan stared blankly at this scene. After watching so many Godfiends die in battle, his heart had become numb to such things. However, as he watched Xue Feng die, he still felt endless grief fill his chest.

chapters.title: Chapter 340 - Always My Brother
chapters.content:
Chapter 340 Always My Brother
Xue Feng was a peerless genius of Archean Mountain. When Meng Chuan first entered Archean Mountain, his name had already spread throughout the world. In the World Gap, Meng Chuan had seen Xue Feng’s talent and love for his younger brother, Yan Jin. This made Meng Chuan find him a very agreeable person.
Such a Godfiend died just like that? Demon monarch. Meng Chuan suddenly moved and approached the yellow-robed man; he moved 7.5 kilometers in a second.
Its strength is probably above King Calm Sea; its strength might even be approaching that of King True Martial. Many thoughts surfaced in Meng Chuan’s mind. An existence at this level can unleash extremely powerful attacks within a five-kilometer radius. King Calm Sea can attack from 50 kilometers away, but the strength of his attacks drastically declines. Furthermore, I’m capable of dodging sword beams that appear out of the void with my speed.
King True Martial’s True Martial domain can unleash his maximum strength within a 2.5-kilometer radius. Beyond 5 kilometers, the strength behind his attacks will be greatly reduced. Any further and the threat should be very low. Its long-distance attacks are clearly inferior to that of King Calm Sea.
When dealing with this demon monarch, the five-kilometer radius around it is a forbidden zone. I have a defensive stone talisman. I can take some risks. I’ll stay 10 kilometers away from it and deliberately bait it into attacking me. If I can stall for enough time, Archean Mountain’s reinforcements might arrive. This was the only way Meng Chuan could immediately seek revenge.
Huh? After the yellow-robed man killed Xue Feng, the corners of his mouth curled up slightly. Following that, he saw Meng Chuan approaching from afar. A mere Marquis Godfiend dares to provoke me with his movement technique? Forget it. Meng Chuan’s value isn’t inferior to that of Xue Feng. I’ll kill him as well. The yellow-robed man stood still and waited for the right opportunity. I can unleash 60% of my strength from five kilometers away. It’s enough to kill him.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan deliberately maintained his speed of 7.5 kilometers per flash. After flying for six seconds, he arrived in midair—10 kilometers away from the yellow-robed man
—and stopped. “Who are you?” Meng Chuan stood in midair and shouted coldly at the yellow-robed man.
He stayed 10 kilometers away from me? The yellow-robed man frowned. His figure phased away. Meng Chuan opened his Divine Eye of Lightning at the center of his brows. His electromagnetic domain spanned a 15-kilometer radius. Electromagnetic waves swept in all directions. They also swept across the yellow-robed man, revealing his location. The yellow-robed man was rapidly approaching Meng Chuan. Oh? Meng Chuan wore a nervous look as he immediately used his movement technique to retreat.
The yellow-robed man frowned. What incredible speed. He struck out with his saber, slashing out a saber beam.
The saber beam transformed into a surging river as the death aura rushed over. Both Meng Chuan’s body and Essence Soul felt uncomfortable even though he was 9 kilometers away. He felt like he had been dragged into a world of death. However, he managed to withstand it.
Meng Chuan executed his movement technique and moved unpredictably.
The saber beam streaked past Meng Chuan’s body. Meng Chuan looked like he was struggling to resist the aura of death as he continued his facade.
Thirty seconds are up. The yellow-robed man remained extremely calm. Time to leave. Without any hesitation, he swooped down and burrowed underground. Only a voice echoed in the world. “Marquis Clear Peace, Xue Feng, is just the beginning.”
It fled? In midair, Meng Chuan scanned the surroundings with his electromagnetic domain. He didn’t dare to go underground.
I have to be within 1.5 kilometers of the demon monarch if I want to tail it underground. With its strength, it can kill me with a single strike if I am within 1.5 kilometers. Meng Chuan had seen the might of the saber strike.
Meng Chuan was already alarmed by the attack’s aura from 9 kilometers away. To go within 1.5 kilometers of that demon monarch? That was a death wish. Archean Mountain only had one such protective stone talisman. Archean Mountain didn’t give it to Regis Godfiends or anyone else. It was given directly to Meng Chuan.
He couldn’t be rash. After standing in midair for a few seconds, Meng Chuan turned his head and saw a dark stream of light flying over. It moved over 10 kilometers in a second.
It’s Supremacy Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar. Meng Chuan recognized it at a glance. An Essence Soul avatar isn’t burdened by a body. It’s said that it can fly even faster than the true body.
For example, Quintessential Essence threads —which were pure energy-were extremely fast, far faster than Meng Chuan. An Essence Soul avatar wasn’t restrained by a body, so it was much faster than the true body. However, its strength was inferior to the actual body.
“The demon monarch has left?” The dark figure flew to Meng Chuan’s side and stopped. It was Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar.
“It fled 15 seconds ago,” said Meng Chuan.
“I’ve already used a treasure and arrived in less than 30 seconds, yet I didn’t arrive in time.” Li Guan sighed softly. Through the token, he knew that Xue Feng had died.
“That demon monarch was very cautious. I tried to bait him into killing me. He only attacked me once before burrowing into the ground.” Meng Chuan pointed into the distance. “Xue Feng died there.”
The two flew to the spot in the wilderness. The only thing that could be seen was a ravine-left behind by the demon monarch’s saber beam. There were no traces of Xue Feng’s corpse. Nothing of it was left.
“Xue Feng had a protective treasure, but it actually failed to keep him alive for such a short period of time.” Li Guan sighed softly. “I’ll try to pry into spacetime now. Don’t disturb me.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded.
Li Guan stood there with his gaze unfocused. Through spacetime, he observed what had happened in that short period of time.
Scenes appeared. He saw what happened to Xue Feng. He saw Xue Feng and the yellow-robed man rushing underground, quickly pursuing Xue Feng. They finally rushed to the surface when Xue Feng’s defensive treasure’s power had been completely depleted. At that moment, Meng Chuan appeared 50 kilometers away and deliberately flared his aura to attract the demon monarch. However, the yellow-robed man continued to deliver that fateful strike at Xue Feng.
Whoosh. Whoosh. Yan Jin and Lu Cheng landed. The two of them had seen the battle from afar. They also saw Xue Feng being killed by the yellow-robed man.
“Junior Brother Xue didn’t want to implicate the mortals in the city or us. Therefore, he fled out of the city with all his might,” said Lu Cheng softly. Yan Jin looked at the ravine left behind by the saber beam in a daze.
“The murderer is Demon Sage Yellow Oscillate,” said Li Guan.
“Demon Sage Yellow Oscillate?” Meng Chuan, Yan Jin, and Lu Cheng memorized the name.
Lu Cheng asked, “Archean Mountain sent dossiers with information on demon sages. Shouldn’t Patriarch Yellow Oscillate have two horns and black scales on his body?”
“Since it has come to the human world, it’ll definitely hide the traces of its demon heritage and disguise itself as a human. The demon monarch’s appearance may have changed, but its moves haven’t,” said Li Guan. “It used the Stygian Saber Art. Only Patriarch Yellow Oscillate can use that saber art to such a level.”
Li Guan stood there and looked at the ravine. There was nothing left of Xue Feng’s body. “We can only make a cenotaph.” Li Guan shook his head gently. “In the past three years, the demon monarchs have attacked cities over and over again. Marquis Clear Peace, Xue Feng, is the sixth Marquis Godfiend who has died in battle. I’ll temporarily guard Windflow City. Archean Mountain will soon make new arrangements for Windflow City. Li Guan glanced at Lu Cheng and Yan Jin before transforming into a stream of light and flying towards Windflow City.
Lu Cheng gently patted Yan Jin’s shoulder and whispered, “Junior Brother Yan, my condolences. Since we were deployed to guard a city, all of us are prepared to die in battle. Junior Brother Xue died in battle while defending the city. He’s a hero.”
After saying that, he flew towards Windflow City. They were no longer children, so there was no need to say too much. Everyone had seen their fair share of tragedies since they involved themselves in the war.
Meng Chuan and Yan Jin stood in front of the ravine and watched as they mourned Xue Feng.
“Yan Jin.” Meng Chuan looked at the ravine in front of him and said, “Now that your brother is dead, there are some things that I should tell you.”
Yan Jin looked at Meng Chuan.
“That ice lotus flower was obtained by your brother. He wanted to give it to you, but because he was afraid you would refuse it, he got me to hand it to you and keep it a secret,” said Meng Chuan. “Now that he has passed away, I think you should know what he has done for you.”
“Mmm.” Yan Jin’s eyes turned slightly red as he whispered, “He’s my brother, always my brother. I’m blessed to be his younger brother.”
“He’s a hero,” said Meng Chuan. “It’s because of heroes like your brother that we can fend off the demons and protect all the humans in this world.”
Yan Jin looked at the ravine and said softly, “I’ll help him finish his unfinished business.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “I’ll be leaving first.” He transformed into lightning and left. Meng Chuan still had to continue his underground reconnaissance and kill demon monarchs.
Only Yan Jin remained outside the city. He stood alone in front of the ravine.

chapters.title: Chapter 341 - Everywhere
chapters.content:
Chapter 341 Everywhere
Black Sand Grotto-Heaven.
At the summit of a mountain, clouds swirled around a building. Bai Yaoyue sat cross-legged on the top platform of the nine-story building. Her eyes were filled with anger as two illusory figures flew over from afar.
“Junior Sister Bai, what’s the matter?” an illusory Meng Tiange and an illusory Mi Yu flew over.
“Xue Feng is dead,” Bai Yaoyue said coldly.
“How is that possible?” Meng Tiange asked anxiously.
“Archean Mountain just informed me that Demon Sage Yellow Oscillate killed him outside Windflow City,” said Bai Yaoyue.
The purple-robed Mi Yu couldn’t help but say, “Archean Mountain is really useless. They already made a deal with our Black Sand Grotto-Heaven. They even accepted our 3,000 iron stone beasts, but they couldn’t even keep Xue Feng alive!”
“According to Archean Mountain’s explanation, they had already given Xue Feng a protective bracelet refined by Imperial Lord Undying. Although Yellow Oscillate is a fifth Firmament demon monarch body after its possession, it can still unleash the strength of a newly-advanced Creation Supremacy. In a few seconds, it struck out repeatedly. The strength contained in the protective bracelet was exhausted, and Xue Feng lost his life.”
Meng Tiange sighed and said, “Xue Feng is ultimately a Marquis Godfiend. Such a treasure will only produce limited strength if only his Darkstar Quintessential Essence is powering it. He can only rely on the bracelet’s strength.”
“It took so many years for our Black Sand lineage to find a genius that can become a Supremacy.” Mi Yu was somewhat angry. “Archean Mountain is nothing but trash. Since we made a deal, they should’ve protected Xue Feng’s life as best they could. For example, let Xue Feng stay on the mountain and not guard cities.”
“They didn’t manage to protect Xue Feng, but they took away 3,000 iron stone beasts,” said Meng Tiange coldly. “It’s not easy for our Halberd Hall to refine 3,000 iron stone beasts. Archean Mountain needs to answer to us.”
“They are now acting thick-skinned and refuse to return the 3,000 iron stone beasts,” said Bai Yaoyue coldly. “However, they have to give us a satisfactory explanation.”
“I’ll never be satisfied now that Xue Feng is dead,” said Mi Yu angrily.
Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s style was completely different from that of Archean Mountain.
Archean Mountain disciples were relatively free to do what they wanted. Disciples with similar strength had relatively equal status. As for Black Sand Grotto-Heaven, its rules were strict and harsh. The internal hierarchy was also strict and unforgiving. Xue Feng would have enjoyed a higher status in Black Sand Grotto-Heaven, giving him many special privileges. It was even possible that he wouldn’t have needed to do anything too dangerous. They would arrange some relatively easier missions for him. They would only let him roam free when they were certain that he had enough strength to protect himself.
“Since we’ve lost him, so be it.” Bai Yaoyue shook her head. “Let’s nurture our disciples ourselves.”
“At the end of the day, it’s all because of the ordinary demon monarchs,” said Meng Tiange with a frown. “With one million ordinary demon monarchs attacking everywhere, Marquis Godfiends have to use their full strength to defend an entire city. Naturally, their locations will be exposed. Some powerful demon monarchs will launch sneak attacks. Over the past two years, seven Marquis Godfiends have died in Black Sand Grotto-Heaven.”
“In order to protect the entire world, we have also lost many Patroller Godfiends.” Mi Yu felt a little pained.
“There are over a million demon monarchs in the world.” Bai Yaoyue’s expression was solemn. “Furthermore, tens of thousands of demon monarchs will enter every year to make up for the dead demon monarchs. The pressure they bring us is immense, be it when they attack cities or hunt mortals. Ancient Regis Godfiends don’t dare to enter deep sleep due to the million demon monarchs. Marquis Godfiends are in danger of dying. Many patrolling Godfiends are risking their lives.”
“We can only place our hopes on King White Treasure now,” said Meng Tiange. “King White Treasure’s self-created ultimate technique, Nine Heavens Ten Earth, is good for underground reconnaissance. If he reaches the Grotto-Heaven realm, his underground reconnaissance range will increase greatly. His speed will also increase greatly. He will be ten times faster at killing demon monarchs.”
“He’s at the peak of the Dharma Domain realm. Furthermore, it’s too difficult for those of the Samsara lineage to reach the Grotto-Heaven realm.” Bai Yaoyue shook her head gently. “Despite staying in the World Gap for some time, he still failed to make a breakthrough.”
Meng Tiange nodded. “In terms of combat strength, the demons are far inferior. They can only hide. However, there are too many ordinary demon monarchs. In a few decades, the Demon Realm will probably produce more demon monarchs. Perhaps another million demon monarchs will be sent to enter our world.”
Bai Yaoyue and Mi Yu remained silent.
This was a huge problem. It frustrated the three sects.
Duyang City.
In the courtyard, King Calm Sea sat cross-legged and pondered his Spring Autumn Tribulation. King Calm Sea spent most of his time cultivating when demon monarchs weren’t attacking the city. Spring Autumn Tribulation. King Calm Sea looked into the void. Time seemed visible in his eyes.
Swoosh.
An avian demon monarch flew over and left after throwing an envelope to him.
King Calm Sea caught the envelope. Archean Mountain’s letter? King Calm Sea opened the envelope and took out the letter.
King Calm Sea’s staid, mountain-like body trembled slightly. Even his right hand that held the letter couldn’t help but tremble, but it quickly stabilized. King Calm Sea’s eyes turned even darker. He stared at the letter for more than 30 seconds. He remained motionless as he stared at it.
“Feng’er, rest in peace.” King Calm Sea’s voice was hoarse. The letter in his hand silently disintegrated. “As your father, I will definitely kill Demon Sage Yellow Oscillate!” King Calm Sea closed his eyes. After a long while, he opened his eyes and continued cultivating the Spring Autumn Tribulation.
Night fell.
After carrying out underground reconnaissance for an entire day, Meng Chuan returned to his home in Jiang State Capital.
“Ah Chuan, why are you back so late today?” Liu Qiyue asked with a smile. “The food is ready.”
Meng Chuan walked to the dining table in the hall. The aroma of food filled the air, but Meng Chuan didn’t have any appetite. “What’s wrong?” Liu Qiyue asked. She realized that something was amiss with her husband. In the past, Meng Chuan would only appear mentally exhausted from maintaining his Divine Eye of Lightning for 12 hours, but he would still be filled with fighting spirit
“Xue Feng is dead,” said Meng Chuan. “It happened at noon today.”
“Senior Brother Xue?” Liu Qiyue couldn’t believe it. “Didn’t Senior Brother Xue already reach the Dharma Domain realm?”
“Demon Sage Yellow Oscillate infiltrated the human world via possession. Although he’s currently a fifth Firmament demon monarch, his strength is extremely terrifying. He’s even stronger than King Calm Sea. Xue Feng couldn’t escape at all,” said Meng Chuan hoarsely. “I’m a little tired. I’ll get some
rest.”
Liu Qiyue nodded. “Alright.” She didn’t have much contact with Xue Feng. Many Godfiends died during wartime. The more familiar she was with a dead Godfiend, the more affected she was. Back when Marquis Heavenstar died in battle, Liu Qiyue was disconsolate for a long time. As for Xue Feng, Liu Qiyue felt sad, but she wasn’t strongly affected by his death like Meng Chuan.
The bedroom.
Meng Chuan lay on the bed and closed his eyes while hugging the blanket. He had emotions too. He wasn’t really numb to such things. Every day, when he hunted underground demon monarchs, he would often receive help requests from patrolling Godfiends. However, most of the time, he would see the patrolling Godfiends’ corpses when he arrived.
He mourned over and over again. This time, he arrived to see Demon Sage Yellow Oscillate kill Xue Feng from afar. There was nothing he could’ve done to stop it.
Meng Chuan was tired. His heart was tired.
Liu Qiyue silently walked into the room and saw that her husband was asleep like a child. Meng Chuan hugged the blanket; tears could be seen at the corner of his eyes.
Ah Chuan is also tired. Liu Qiyue lay beside him and leaned against Meng Chuan as she fell asleep. They trod a difficult path, but at least, the couple could tread this path with each other.
When Meng Chuan opened his eyes, it was already late at night. His exhaustion from using the Divine Eye of Lightning had vanished. His intense emotions had also faded after sleeping.
“You’re up?” Liu Qiyue woke up.
“Yes, I’ll go spend some time in the study.” Meng Chuan smiled and kissed his wife. “I’m good now. I’m still filled with a fighting
spirit.”
Liu Qiyue smiled and nodded.
After waking up, Meng Chuan went to the study and lit the lamp.
Whoosh. He placed a piece of paper on the table and pressed it down. He then mixed the paint and looked at the paper in front of him.
He wanted to use his painting skills to remember some people and matters. These people and matters shouldn’t and couldn’t be forgotten, forever.

chapters.title: Chapter 342 - The Light That Rips Through the Darkness
chapters.content:
Chapter 342 The Light That Rips Through the Darkness
Meng Chuan held the brush in his hand and couldn’t help but stop.
In the past few years, Meng Chuan had experienced too many unforgettable events.
Rustle
