Meng Chuan gently lowered his brush and began painting a handsome man carefully. The man had a flame mark between his eyebrows. He had an extraordinary bearing and a piercing gaze. It was Marquis Heavenstar.
Marquis Heavenstar was a famous sharpshooter. There were very few sharpshooters among powerful Godfiends. Marquis Heavenstar was ranked amongst the top globally. He was Liu Qiyue’s master. Meng Chuan had seen Marquis Heavenstar many times and was impressed by his bearing. However, more than five years ago, Marquis Heavenstar was killed in battle. He was one of the 12 Archean Mountain Marquis Godfiends that had died that year. It was very difficult to express Marquis Heavenstar’s bearing and temperament in a painting. Meng Chuan painted very seriously and took more than four hours to finish.
Meng Chuan continued his daily underground reconnaissance and daily saber art cultivation. He only spent about six hours painting each day.
After painting Marquis Heavenstar, Meng Chuan painted another Marquis GodfiendMarquis Gong Xu.
Marquis Gong Xu was also a Marquis Godfiend that came from Wu State. He was tall and muscular, a very dignified Godfiend. Back then, his father, Meng Dajiang, was accused of colluding with the Skydemon Sect and was imprisoned in Wu State’s dungeons. Marquis Gong Xu had been in charge of guarding Wu State Capital. More than a year ago, when Marquis Gong Xu was defending a region, he released numerous Quintessential Essence threads to deal with a large number of demon monarchs when a fourth Firmament demon monarch team ambushed him. Although Marquis Gong Xu had killed a fourth Firmament demon monarch, he still died in battle.
Meng Chuan hadn’t interacted with Marquis Gong Xu much. He painted the scene of Marquis Gong Xu righteously stopping him from leaving with his father. As he had personally experienced it, he had a deep impression of the scene. The scene he painted was naturally more true to life.
Although the person in the painting was real, he no longer existed in reality. Meng Chuan’s heart ached.
Xue Feng was the third person that Meng Chuan painted.
Xue Feng’s talent was immense. He had already taken one step towards the Seamless realm. His future was limitless. If he had fully developed his strength, he would’ve probably been another King Calm Sea and King True Martial. His achievements and strength might’ve even gone further beyond theirs. However, he was still killed by a demon sage, Yellow Oscillate. Meng Chuan admired Xue Feng’s character and pitied his early demise.
When he was young, Meng Chuan had heard his grandaunt mention how talented King Calm Sea’s fifth son was. He had reached the Unity realm at the age of ten, comprehended Force at the age of 13, and became a Godfiend at the age of 15. When he entered Archean Mountain, Xue Feng was also the most dazzling disciple. Even after leaving the mountain, Meng Chuan’s cultivation speed was inferior to that of Xue Feng. When Xue Feng was in the World Gap, he had reached the Dharma Domain realm while Meng Chuan only reached the peak of the Realm of Dao. Of course, he was five years older than him.
Meng Chuan saw how much he had sacrificed for Yan Jin.
Xue Feng. Meng Chuan painted the last scene he saw of Xue Feng-heavily injured, Xue Feng faced Demon Sage Yellow Oscillate valiantly. He wasn’t afraid; he emanated pure calmness. As a guardian Godfiend, he had long been prepared to die in battle.
Every day, Meng Chuan painted Marquis Godfiends. He was very familiar with some of them, while some were Marquis Godfiends he hadn’t interacted much with. He even painted a few Marquis Godfiends that he had only heard of; he had only seen their figures on Blood Red Cliff.
Those that he hadn’t seen with his own eyes, he could only replicate the scenes on Red Blood Cliff-scenes of them leaving the mountain in high spirits. Meng Chuan painted a total of 18 Marquis Godfiends. He also drew some Patroller Godfiends. Many Patrollers were killed in action in recent years. Meng Chuan had seen some of them with his own eyes. He was even very familiar with some of them. Therefore, he only drew a few simple scenes.
Meng Chuan finished this painting after 21 days.
Late at night, Meng Chuan looked at the painting
The 18 Marquis Godfiends were rather eye-catching. Xue Feng, Marquis Heavenstar, and Marquis Gong Xu were in the middle of the painting. Behind the 18 Marquis Godfiends were 51 Patroller Godfiends. The background Godfiends became more and more blurry as one looked further behind the Marquis Godfiends. In fact, a lot of Godfiends could be seen in the faint shadows.
This painting was of a group of Godfiends. It was as though they remained alive in front of him.
Meng Chuan picked up his brush and wrote a few words on the rightmost side of the painting-Remember Them.
He wrote another passage
“It has been five years and seven months since greater demon monarchs entered the human world from Wide Imperial Pass. Archean Mountain alone has lost 18 Marquis Godfiends and 511 Patroller Godfiends. The war is getting more and more tragic; casualties continue to rise. Painted by Meng Chuan during a December winter.”
Meng Chuan put away his brush and looked at the painting silently. He wanted to vent the intense emotions suppressed in his heart. He also felt that these people should not be forgotten, which was his primary motivation for painting them.
If we win the war, I hope future generations will know of this group of heroes that risked their lives for humanity. They should be remembered forever.
After putting down his brush, Meng Chuan walked out of the study. There was snow on the ground. It was extremely cold mid-winter. Meng Chuan didn’t pay much attention to it. Although he had completed this painting, he knew that people might not remember these heroes thousands of years from the present era, even if they won the war. Perhaps only those who studied history could find the names of many Godfiends by flipping through old papers.
Junior Brother Xue and the others probably don’t care if they are forgotten. They risked their lives solely for the sake of us humans winning this war.
Meng Chuan sensed that his Essence Soul’s spiritual glow was gradually converging. In the past half month, he had sought answers from his inner self, causing his Essence Soul to transform. However, even though it had improved greatly, it remained a fourth-level Essence Soul. One of the requirements to become a Creation Supremacy was a fifth-level Essence Soul. It was extremely difficult to attain.
It’s been seven years since I obtained a fourth-level Essence Soul. These seven years have been especially tragic. My Essence Soul has also improved greatly. Its quality has improved by several-fold, but it still hasn’t achieved a qualitative transformation. As long as I keep improving, I won’t be far from breaking through.
Meng Chuan wasn’t discouraged at all. He kept improving, so he was getting closer and closer to attaining a fifth-level Essence Soul.
Meng Chuan looked up at the night sky as he stood in the courtyard. When can we tear through this long night? Stuck in this war, Meng Chuan couldn’t see any hope of victory. When will victory come?
He knew that they were enduring torment and constantly fighting, but what lay ahead remained pitch-black. More and more World Entrances appeared. More and more demon monarchs entered the human world, becoming stronger and stronger. A large number of demon sages and Imperial Lords were eyeing this world covetously.
Clang.
Meng Chuan unsheathed Demon Slayer and continued practicing his saber art. He slashed out again and again. He cultivated the Infinite Saber; it was the saber art that he invested most of his energy into.
Every strike was focused and pursued extreme speed.
Quick! Faster. Break through all obstructions.
Meng Chuan executed his saber art with all his might as though he wanted to split the thick darkness apart! He hoped to see a sliver of hope after cleaving through the thick darkness!
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan’s saber art suddenly increased in speed, far exceeding the usual speed. It instantly transformed into a beam of light-a beam that tore through the darkness!

chapters.title: Chapter 343 - Dharma Domain Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 343 Dharma Domain Realm
This strike was exquisite.
Meng Chuan had never swung his saber so quickly. The saber transformed into a beam of light. With such speed, the might contained within the saber had reached an unimaginable level. The saber also became very heavy. It was unbelievably fast, but it felt as heavy as a mountain. Even the void distorted in front of the saber. Meng Chuan could clearly sense that the saber could reach any spot within a kilometer through the distorted void.
Pfft.
Meng Chuan’s saber move struck the night sky more than a kilometer away. The saber beam flew askew towards the clouds, traveling over 50 kilometers before it dissipated. The saber didn’t grow longer, but the void distorted and reduced the distance. Something one kilometer away was now within reach of his saber.
I...
After Meng Chuan struck out with his saber, he stood in the courtyard and watched as a rift appeared in the clouds high up in the night sky. He stood there in a daze before lowering his head to look at the saber in his hand.
Dharma Domain realm? I’ve reached the Dharma Domain realm? Meng Chuan was overjoyed. After painting Lightning Fifteen Forms in the World Gap and having gained a direction, he had proceeded with his cultivation in that direction.
He had finally reached the Dharma Domain realm after three years.
Dharma Domain realm. Meng Chuan couldn’t help but strike again.
The saber transformed into a beam of light. If Quintessential Essence threads reached this speed, it wouldn’t cause many changes to the void. However, Demon Slayer was a divine armament. It was rather heavy, so its tremendous speed caused the void to distort greatly. Such a heavy weapon needed to reach tremendous speeds so that it could turn into a beam of light.
Meng Chuan distorted the void to a greater extent than when he used his Indestructible Divine Armor. Due to this distorted void, anything within a kilometer was within his saber’s reach.
Meng Chuan’s saber slashed out in all directions. It struck everywhere within a kilometer. So that he didn’t affect mortals, Meng Chuan swung his saber at the night sky, tearing apart the clouds above. In the dark, perhaps only Godfiends could see the clouds in the sky.
After slashing out dozens of times, he stopped. He was now certain that he had reached the Dharma Domain realm.
I can sense it. At such speeds, the saber becomes very heavy. However, the power behind my attacks has also increased greatly. As Demon Slayer becomes faster, the saber’s might will rapidly increase.
cease.
Meng Chuan couldn’t hold back his joy. When he entered the bedroom, his wife, Liu Qiyue, was sleeping soundly.
“Ah Chuan.” As a Marquis Godfiend, Liu Qiyue could sense Meng Chuan’s entry. She woke up and looked at Meng Chuan curiously because Meng Chuan usually practiced his saber art until dawn. He only slept once every two months.
“Qiyue.” Meng Chuan sat on the bed and stared at his wife. He excitedly said, “I’ve broken through to the Dharma Domain realm.”
“Dharma Domain realm?” Liu Qiyue was stunned for a moment before she revealed an excited expression. “Ah Chuan, your Essence Soul is already at the fourth-level. Does that mean you can become a Regis Godfiend?”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded excitedly. “I’ll take a good rest and ensure I’m in peak form. I plan on breaking through to become a Regis Godfiend tomorrow night.”
“A Regis Godfiend,” exclaimed Liu Qiyue. “Our Wu State finally has a Regis Godfiend.”
It was not easy for Regis Godfiends to be born. They needed talent, resources, and luck! If they were unlucky, they might die mid-growth.
“I’ve been waiting for this day for a long time.” Meng Chuan was also very excited. “I can kill even more demon monarchs this
way.”
Liu Qiyue covered her mouth and laughed. “In the blink of an eye, Young Master Meng from Eastcalm City of yesteryear is now about to become a Regis Godfiend. You didn’t even dare to think about it back then, did you?”
Meng Chuan smiled as well. He had finally come this far after cultivating for decades.
“Most people have goals to become a Marquis Godfiend before the age of 60 and a Regis Godfiend before the age of 90. Ah Chuan, you are becoming a Regis Godfiend before the age of 60. This speed is faster than many peerless geniuses,” said Liu Qiyue in amazement. She had cast Phoenix’s Nirvana several times, expending over 30 years of her lifespan, but she was still far from becoming a Regis Godfiend.
Meng Chuan relied purely on his cultivation.
“It’s all thanks to the World Gap,” said Meng Chuan. Thanks to his observation of the purple lightning in the World Gap, he painted Fifteen Lightning Forms. This allowed him to have a clear understanding of the lightning lineage.
“You’re making the breakthrough tomorrow. You have to tell Archean Mountain in advance, right?” Liu Qiyue suddenly asked.
“Yes, becoming a Regis Godfiend is a big matter. I obviously have to report it in advance. I’ll write a letter now.” As Meng Chuan spoke, Liu Qiyue got up and put on her coat.
They went to the study. Liu Qiyue watched from the side. Meng Chuan put away the painting and wrote seriously.
Following that, the avian demon monarch envoy set off and sent the letter to Archean Mountain overnight.
...
Archean Mountain, Grotto-Heaven Pavilion.
Early in the morning, the old steward respectfully delivered a letter to Li Guan.
“Supremacy, a letter from Marquis Eastcalm,” said the old steward respectfully.
Among Archean Mountain’s many Godfiends, only a few could send letters to Supremacies directly. Meng Chuan was naturally one of them.
“A letter for me?” Li Guan was rather surprised. Meng Chuan was Qin Wu’s disciple. He typically wrote letters to Archean Mountain Lord. He seldom sent letters to Li Guan directly.
Li Guan put down the steaming teacup in his hand and picked up the letter. When he opened the letter and read the contents, he was stunned.
He stared blankly at the letter.
After a while, he blinked his eyes. Li Guan looked up at the sky, then turned his head to look at his surroundings. Snow-covered plum blossoms bloomed, emitting a fragrance.
“I’m not dreaming,” muttered Li Guan as he looked down at the letter. “Is this real?”
After a while, two illusory figures flew over. They were the embodiments of Qin Wu and Luo Tang.
“Senior Brother, why did you summon us?” Luo Tang asked.
“It’s Meng Chuan. Read it.” Li Guan handed the letter to the duo.
Qin Wu took the letter, and they read through it carefully.The duo was stunned by what they read.
“This is definitely Meng Chuan’s letter? It’s not fake?” Luo Tang couldn’t help but ask. “It’s his letter. The Quintessential Essence mark is his,” said Qin Wu as he looked at Li Guan. “Senior Brother, is Meng Chuan about to become a Regis Godfiend?”
“I’m still a little dazed,” muttered Li Guan softly. “Didn’t you say that he spent over ten years to reach the peak of the Realm of Dao even after a year in the World gap? Why is he capable of suddenly becoming a Regis Godfiend? Could he have used a treasure like the Heart Questioning Bead?”
Luo Tang was stunned. “He might not be that fast, even with the Heart Questioning Bead.”
“Peerless geniuses that can become Regis Godfiends before they are 90 years old are already impressive. Many of them only become Regis Godfiends after they are over 100 years old.” Li Guan couldn’t help but say, “This Meng Chuan is becoming a Regis Godfiend at the age of 55. Furthermore, he’s not far from attaining a fifth-level Essence Soul? Didn’t you tell me that his technique realm cultivation speed is way inferior to that of peerless geniuses?” “Previously...” Luo Tang was also in a daze. She looked at Qin Wu. “Qin Wu, as his master, didn’t you say that Meng Chuan’s technique realm cultivation speed was slow? You even wanted to let him use the Heart Questioning Bead to help him become a Regis Godfiend.”
Qin Wu stood rooted to the ground and looked at the letter in his hand. He smiled. “Meng Chuan doesn’t lie. He has indeed reached the Dharma Domain realm. Furthermore, he’s going to become a Regis Godfiend tonight! A 55-year-old Regis Godfiend who is soon going to attain a fifth-level Essence Soul? His talent is even higher than that of King Calm Sea and King True Martial. A Godfiend’s talent isn’t constant. King True Martial was also a late-bloomer! Meng Chuan’s talent has clearly transformed. His talent has become even greater than before.”
“His talent is above that of King Calm Sea and King True Martial?” Luo Tang’s eyes lit up.
“The heavens are blessing us. The heavens are blessing us,” said Li Guan happily. “Meng Chuan is good at underground reconnaissance, and his talent is so high. The threat of a million demon monarchs is something our three sects are vexed about. Now, we see hope of resolving it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 344 - Finally Becoming a Regis Godfiend (Final Chapter of Volume)
chapters.content:
Chapter 344 Finally Becoming a Regis Godfiend (Final Chapter of Volume)
27th December. Snow fluttered everywhere.
Meng Chuan and his wife, Liu Qiyue, were in the hall. They ate snacks and drank tea as they chatted. It was rare for them to have the entire day to relax. Meng Chuan didn’t carry out underground reconnaissance because he was adjusting his body and mind to an optimal state. As for killing demon monarchs? After becoming a Regis Godfiend, he naturally could kill demon monarchs at a much faster speed.
Oh? Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue suddenly sensed something. Through the door, they saw a dark figure descending from the sky. It was Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar.
“It’s Supremacy.” Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue immediately stood up and walked to the corridor outside the hall to welcome him.
Li Guan landed in the yard and stepped on the snow. Following that, he smiled. Two illusory figures appeared beside him. They were Qin Wu and Luo Tang.
“Greetings, Supremacies. Greetings, Master.” Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue bowed in surprise.
The couple could guess the reason for the Supremacies’ arrival. However, all three of them had arrived! It was rare for such a gathering to occur. Although Qin Wu and Luo Tang could form Essence Soul embodiments —which didn’t have any combat strengththey could only maintain nine Essence Soul embodiments at most. They needed to divert their attention for every Essence Soul embodiment so that it can function properly. Furthermore, an Essence Soul embodiment required a medium. Thus, it was very rare for the three Supremacies to come to Jiang State Capital.
“Punk, you actually managed to reach the Dharma Domain realm silently?” Qin Wu chuckled. “Your letter shocked the three of
Us.”
“I broke through after cultivating every day,” said Meng Chuan.
Luo Tang’s eyes lit up as she carefully inspected Meng Chuan. She smiled and nodded. “It’s indeed impressive for you to reach the Dharma Domain realm so quickly even when you spend most of your time carrying out underground reconnaissance.”
Li Guan smiled at Meng Chuan. “When will you enter seclusion and break through?”
“I’ll enter seclusion in a while,” said Meng Chuan.
“I’ll be your guardian,” said Li Guan with a smile. “My Essence Soul avatar only has 30 to 40 percent of my true body’s strength, but it’s enough to protect you.”
As the unspoken strongest person in the world, Li Guan was confident that his Essence Soul avatar could suppress Demon Sage Nine Abyss, much less other demon monarchs.
“Thank you, Supremacy.” Meng Chuan bowed.
“If you can resolve the one million demon monarchs’ threat, we will be the ones thanking you,” said Li Guan. “Alright, you don’t have to accompany us. Just focus on your seclusion and make a breakthrough.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan was already prepared.
“I’ll wait for you outside.” Liu Qiyue was in a hall outside the chamber.
Meng Chuan smiled and nodded before sealing the chamber. Inside the chamber, a candle calmly burned. Meng Chuan sat cross-legged on a mat and took out a cyan jade bottle. He removed the bottle stopper and drank the contents in one gulp. The Clear Divine Water entered his body, and his Essence Soul quickly absorbed it. His Essence Soul became more ethereal, and his control over it increased greatly.
I’ve had a fourth-level Essence Soul for so many years. My Undying body should also be able to withstand the pressure during the breakthrough perfectly. It should be very easy. Meng Chuan was confident, having gleaned generations of Godfiends’ experiences.
Time to begin. The Power of Essence Soul fused with his dantian space, as well as every wisp of Darkstar Quintessential Essence within. A dark-red sphere floated in the middle of the dark dantian space. Dark-red gases swirled around it. Compared to when he had just reached the Darkstar realm, the dark-red sphere was more than ten-fold larger than before.
Due to his Undying Body, Meng Chuan’s dantian space size was the theoretical limit for Marquis Godfiends. Since ancient times, Marquis Godfiends—who had fortuitous encounters-also had dantian spaces as large as his. It was practically the maximum size the dantian space could go at the Darkstar realm! Any larger and the Darkstar would begin its breakthrough. If one’s realm wasn’t high enough when this happened, they would die!
Condense Quintessential Essence. Meng Chuan sent commands with just a thought. He infused the Power of Origins from his Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead into his dantian space and transformed it into Darkstar Quintessential Essence, causing the Darkstar to continue expanding. In such a large dantian space, the Darkstar’s volume was already at its limit. As the new Darkstar Quintessential Essence constantly fused with it, it finally broke through its limits
Boom! Boom!
The dark-red sphere rapidly shrank and collapsed.
Meng Chuan’s Power of Essence Soul fused with every part of the dark-red sphere. When it began to collapse, he used his understanding of the lightning lineage-the Flash Form of Lightning that had reached the Dharma Domain realm—to guide it!
Light! Under Meng Chuan’s lead, the Darkstar’s collapse quickened even more.
Boom!
The dark-red sphere instantly contracted by more than 10,000 times. Even his dantian couldn’t be seen.
The entire dantian space was pitch-black. Apart from the lone Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead, there was nothing else. No, strictly speaking, it wasn’t that there wasn’t anything else, but that tiny point was too small. It was so small that it couldn’t be seen with typical microscopic inner vision. This was also the reason why it was called the Seamless realm.
However, thanks to the Power of Essence Soul, he could vaguely sense its existence. It was tiny. At that moment, it rapidly collapsed before gradually stabilizing under the guidance of the Flash Form of Lightning Dharma Domain. If one’s technique realm wasn’t high enough, this tiny point would explode.
It’s beginning to stabilize. Meng Chuan could sense it.
The Dharma Domain. Only when one had high enough of a cultivation realm could they form a Dharma Domain. The Dharma Domain was also the ‘cosmic law’ responsible for this tiny point’s existence.
It’s done. He could vaguely sense that the tiny point had completely stabilized. It began to absorb external powers and spit out wisps of Quintessential Essence.
Within his dark dantian space, a source of white light suddenly appeared. Thousands of white beams of light illuminated the dantian space from the core. The closer to the core, the denser the light became, forming a light source.
The closer to the core’s periphery, the duller the light became. Only a small amount of light would sweep past this area.
Seamless Quintessential Essence. Meng Chuan was filled with joy. He knew that this beam of light came from his Seamless Quintessential Essence. It looked mild and harmless, but it was actually terrifyingly powerful. Even if one was 50 kilometers away, thousands of third Firmament demon monarchs could be killed instantly.
Every Regis Godfiend had different types of Quintessential Essence. At this stage, their Quintessential Essence was extremely pure. One’s control over their Quintessential Essence reached perfection. Although Regis Godfiends couldn’t perfectly control their bodies, they could perfectly control their Quintessential Essence.
Quintessential Essence was affected by one’s dantian space, Essence Soul, and technique realm. The larger one’s dantian space was, the more Quintessential Essence one could accumulate, causing the Seamless realm point to contract even more! The Quintessential Essence would also become purer due to this process. The stronger one’s Essence Soul was, the greater the restrictions on the point. It also allowed for greater compression of the point. The higher one’s technique realm was, the more brilliant the laws of the point would be.
When Regis Godfiends cultivated, they strived to make the Seamless realm point smaller. When the point’s size had reached the extreme, one could form a Grotto-Heaven! When one formed a Grotto-Heaven, they would be a Creation Supremacy.
However, with different understandings, each Regis Godfiend would have different Dharma Domains. Thus, the laws governing the tiny point were different for each Godfiend. The powers the tiny point produced were also different. For example, some Regis Godfiends had dark, evil Quintessential Essence. Some Regis Godfiends had cold, blue Quintessential Essence. King True Martial had created his own True martial lineage. His Seamless Quintessential Essence was known as the Power of True Martial. It was terrifyingly powerful. Although he was a Regis Godfiend, his Quintessential Essence was in no way inferior to that of a Creation Supremacy.
Is this how strong a Regis Godfiend is? Meng Chuan naturally released his Quintessential Essence. White light shot out from his body, illuminating the chamber. Furthermore, the tiny, invisible point in his dantian constantly emitted circular waves.
The waves spread out in all directions. The waves were like ripples. After flying out of a certain range, they would return to the tiny point. This cycle went on incessantly.
A Regis Godfiend’s Seamless domain was a combination of a void domain and a wave domain.
I’ve just become a Regis Godfiend, but my Seamless domain can already reach a kilometer? Meng Chuan was secretly surprised. King True Martial’s Seamless domain can only reach 2.5 kilometers.
When using his Seamless domain, he could unleash his greatest combat strength.
In the hall.
Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang sat together. As for Liu Qiyue, she was waiting outside the chamber.
“Every Regis Godfiend will walk their own path,” said Li Guan with a smile as he held a teacup. “I wonder what Meng Chuan will be like?”
“Qin Wu, do you wish for your disciple to be like Senior Guo Ke or Senior Ye Hong?” Luo Tang asked with a smile.
These two had extremely high accomplishments in the lightning lineage.
Qin Wu smiled and said, “At the same age, Senior Guo Ke and Senior Ye Hong had inferior achievements than that of my disciple. My disciple’s Essence Soul cultivation talent far exceeds the two seniors. It’s only been three years since he reached the peak of the Realm of Dao, yet he has now reached the Dharma Domain realm... I believe that this disciple of mine might be able to forge an unprecedented path. It’s not impossible for him to follow the lightning lineage’s strongest path.”
“The lightning lineage’s strongest path?” Luo Tang was astonished.
“After I found out that he had broken through, I carefully investigated his experiences over the years,” said Li Guan. “I noticed something. After he came out of the World Gap, he spent over 100 million credits to read all the lightning lineage techniques in Archean Mountain. After reading so many manuals, not only did he not confuse himself, but he ended up breaking through in just three years.” Luo Tang nodded and sighed in amazement. “He didn’t end up lost even after perusing numerous ultimate techniques. He absorbed what he needed and abandoned what he didn’t. He then became a Regis Godfiend in three years. He is indeed outstanding.”
“Therefore, I believe that Meng Chuan should be free to choose any of the Archean Mountain treasures that Regis Godfiends can use,” said Li Guan. “Let him choose whatever he wants.”
“Free to choose? Are we also including what Ancestral Master Archean Eon left behind?” Qin Wu and Luo Tang looked at Li Guan in shock.
“Yes.” Li Guan nodded. “It won’t take long for him to reach the Blood Droplet realm, so we don’t even need to mention his reconnaissance abilities. When he does reach the Blood Droplet realm, his reconnaissance abilities will strengthen greatly. He alone can deal with one million demon monarchs. For this, it’s worth letting him choose any treasure. Furthermore, he’s still so young. Perhaps he can become an invincible Creation Supremacy before we reach the critical moment. Even if a World Entrance that allows demon sages to enter appears, he can deal with a large group of demon sages alone. We’ll have a chance of fending them off. That way, there’ll be no need to end the world. After all, if we end the world, we have to wipe out all living beings outside of Archean Mountain. If I want to make all treasures available to meng Chuan, both of your permissions are needed. Do both of you agree?”
Qin Wu and Luo Tang looked at each other.
“Agreed,” Luo Tang said.
Qin Wu smiled. “Agreed.”
Li Guan nodded. “Alright.”
Meng Chuan became a Regis Godfiend at the age of 55. He had a fourth-level Essence Soul as well, so the three Supremacies saw hope in him.
“Oh?” The three Supremacies sensed fluctuations spreading out.
“It’s the Seamless wave domain.” The three Supremacies looked towards the chamber. They knew that Meng Chuan had broken through
Final Chapter of Volume-King Eastcalm

chapters.title: Chapter 345 - Test
chapters.content:
Chapter 345 Test
After exiting the chamber, Meng Chuan saw his wife.
“Ah Chuan.” Liu Qiyue stood up. She could sense that her husband’s aura was stronger. This delighted her.
Meng Chuan looked at his wife. His senses were unbelievably sharp under his Seamless domain. He could sense the lifeforce contained within his wife’s blood, heart, muscles, bones, and flesh. Her lifeforce was still strong-at its peak. However, it was on the verge of decline.
Qiyue is clearly one year younger than me, but because she has used Phoenix’s Nirvana several times, her physical body is already 90 years old. As a Marquis Godfiend, her lifeforce will begin to decline slowly after she turns 90. With time, the decline in her lifeforce will only quicken. Her chances of breaking through will become even slimmer. Meng Chuan was somewhat worried about his wife.
His wife still had hope of breaking through, but the probability of that happening diminished with time. In fact, if she cast Phoenix’s Nirvana again, she might lose all hope of becoming a Regis Godfiend.
From ages 90 to 110, the rate of decline in one’s lifeforce was very slow. One would still have over 90% chance of succeeding with the breakthrough. At 120 years of age, the success rate rapidly dropped to about 60%. At 150 years old, one’s probability of becoming a Regis Godfiend was only 10%.
His physical body cultivation system was very unique. He could maintain peak lifeforce forever. However, this cultivation system required Cosmos Crystals. One also needed to enter Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven to obtain the legacy. What one received in Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven was not determined by Qin Wu and company because it was left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon.
“Why are you looking at me like this?” Liu Qiyue looked at her husband and smiled understandingly. “It’s said that one can see the true age of others at a glance with the Seamless domain. You realized that my body is already 90 years old? Don’t worry. I can sense that I’m getting closer and closer to the Dharma Domain realm after cultivating Phoenix Flight and my previous use of Phoenix’s Nirvana. I might break through in a few months.”
“Yea.” Meng Chuan nodded.
Besides reaching the Dharma Domain realm, one also needed a third-level Essence Soul before they could become a Regis Godfiend. He hoped for his wife to become a Regis Godfiend. Only then would he be able to fight alongside his wife for a longer period of time. He didn’t want to walk the demon-slaying path alone.
The couple walked out together. The three Supremacies in the distant hall looked over with a smile.
“Supremacies, Master.” Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue bowed.
“Meng Chuan, congratulations,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “After becoming a Regis Godfiend, you have joined the ranks of the strongest humans in the world.”
The illusory Luo Tang also said, “Regis Godfiends all have their own strengths. For example, King Desire Redemption’s illusions and King Luyue’s poison-refining techniques are the strongest in Archean Mountain. King True Martial’s Power of True Martial is also unique. It’s common for Regis Godfiends to be capable of fighting Creation Supremacies In history, there have been eras where Regis Godfiends reigned supreme.”
Meng Chuan nodded. There were very few Regis Godfiends in the world. Archean Mountain only had 14 Regis Godfiends. Meng Chuan was the 15th Regis Godfiend of this era.
“You should have something you are good at.” Li Guan took a step and left the hall. He flew into the sky and said, “Meng Chuan, attack me with all your might. I will only block. Let me see your strength.”
Luo Tang and Qin Wu looked at Meng Chuan expectantly.
“Yes, Supremacy.” Meng Chuan took a step out of the hall and flew into the sky.
“Let’s take a look too.” Qin Wu, Luo Tang, and Liu Qiyue flew into the sky and watched from the side.
In the night sky, Meng Chuan and Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar faced each other from afar.
An Essence Soul avatar can carry Quintessential Essence, but it is expended forever when it is used. Meng Chuan understood this point. However, with Supremacy Li Guan’s realm, his strength far exceeds mine, even if he only uses the Heaven and Earth powers. Just a single Essence Soul mystic technique from him can severely injure me.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul was at the fourth level, while Li Guan’s Essence Soul was at the sixth level.
The difference of two levels...
If Meng Chuan met Li Guan’s Essence Soul mystic techniques, he would barely remain lucid. It would be pretty good if he could unleash 20 to 30 percent of his strength under such circumstances.
However, Li Guan was, unspokenly, the strongest person in the human world. He wouldn’t do that. He had already said that he would only block.
“Supremacy, take this,” said Meng Chuan. Meng Chuan’s Seamless domain had a radius of one kilometer. Within this domain, his strength was augmented substantially. His saber’s might could increase by 30%. The enemy would also be suppressed by various things when within the Seamless domain. It was normal for an enemy’s strength to decrease by 30% when they were within the Seamless domain.
As such, his domain could strengthen himself while suppressing his enemies. In battle, one’s strength would be doubled with such a domain.
Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar only had 30 to 40 percent of his true body’s strength. One important reason for this decrease in strength was because his true body had a Grotto-Heaven Domain. The Grotto-Heaven domain was much more powerful and domineering than the Seamless domain. The Godfiend cultivation system was connected. One started with a Darkstar domain, the Seamless domain would come next, which would then turn into the Grotto-Heaven domain.
Sensing his Seamless domain everywhere, as though he was viewing his territory, Meng Chuan instantly drew his saber!
The saber was unsheathed!
Seamless Quintessential Essence was extremely pure. Wisps of white Quintessential Essence fused with Demon Slayer, causing the saber to transform into a dazzling bolt of lightning instantly. After the saber’s speed rose to a terrifying level, its might was extremely terrifying. It was like a 100,000-foot-tall mountain was compressed within the saber.
With a flash of lightning, the terrifying strike gently sliced through the distorted void. It instantly appeared in front of Li Guan, attempting to cleave him in half.
Pfft.
Li Guan extended his right hand and blocked the blade in front of his throat, causing the blade to come to a halt. Li Guan’s impact with Demon Slayer caused Meng Chuan’s body to tremble. His organs were injured, but his body instantly recovered.
Li Guan looked at Meng Chuan with approval. “What a fast strike. Again.” “Again.” Meng Chuan was somewhat indignant as he continued attacking.
His saber was terrifyingly fast. However, Li Guan was even more terrifying. When the saber beam sliced through the void, it was blocked by an illusory palm.
Supremacy Li Guan simultaneously blocked and retreated until he was 1.25 kilometers away...
After exiting his Seamless domain, Meng Chuan’s saber’s speed decreased, but the strike still managed to reach Li Guan. His saber could reach anywhere within 1.5 kilometers instantly.
After retreating more than 1.5 kilometers, Li Guan nodded slightly. “Alright, we can stop now.”
“I was completely suppressed.” Meng Chuan clearly felt that he was now much stronger. However, he was still completely suppressed.
“Haha, don’t be discouraged,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “Your Uncle-Master Li’s realm should be the highest in the human world. You have just become a Regis Godfiend, so he can easily tease you.”
Li Guan flew over and said with a smile, “You aren’t bad. Your saber art didn’t follow the Heart Intent Saber or the World Roving Dragon Saber. It pursues extreme speed? Your saber art is also very powerful. Just its might alone is barely comparable to a peak Regis Godfiend’s attack.”
Liu Qiyue’s eyes lit up when she heard that. Meng Chuan listened carefully.
“Don’t count your chickens too early,” said Li Guan. “Godfiends all have different strengths. Your saber art is focused on speed and strength. However, you have lost variability It’s very easy to predict your attack trajectory, which is why I easily intercepted them time and time again. Some Regis Godfiends might not be as powerful as you, but they have many attack variations. They are also stronger than you in direct combat.”
“Understood.” Meng Chuan nodded. He cultivated the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique—which was the second saber art that he created. It had many attack variations and was an extremely flexible saber art. However, it hadn’t reached the Dharma Domain realm yet. The combination of the two saber arts would be his future combat style. “All you need to do is continue down this path,” said Qin Wu. “You can also be very powerful by going to the limits of a path. You just need to make your saber faster and faster... When it reaches a certain speed, your Uncle-Master Li will probably not be able to stop it.”
Li Guan smiled. “Use your full strength to show me your speed.”
Qin Wu and Luo Tang also watched carefully.
Meng Chuan’s speed was very important. The faster he could conduct reconnaissance underground, the more efficient he would be at killing demon monarchs.
Meng Chuan nodded. “Yes.” Sensing his surroundings with the Seamless domain, wisps of Seamless Quintessential Essence flowed through his meridians and covered his body. Meng Chuan felt like a bolt of lightning.
Swoosh. Meng Chuan instantly transformed into a beam of light that streaked across the sky.
At this moment, Meng Chuan finally understood what it meant to be shackled by the world! He had encountered a powerful resistance from the world.
Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang stared at the beam of light that streaked across the night sky. Their eyes widened as they looked at each other.

chapters.title: Chapter 346 - Freely Choosing from the Treasure Vault
chapters.content:
Chapter 346 Freely Choosing from the Treasure Vault
Meng Chuan transformed into a beam of light and flew through the air.
With such astonishing speed, time and space began to change. However, the entire world suppressed everything, maintaining the stability of spacetime.
This is the suppression of the world? Meng Chuan flew. Under such speed, invisible restraints wrapped around Meng Chuan like countless threads pulling him. However, he couldn’t sense any strength coming from it. This was the suppression of the laws of the world. In a world, one had to follow its laws.
No human Godfiend that cultivated the lightning lineage Flash Form of Lightning’s essence has broken through the shackles of the world. None of them have reached the Grotto-Heaven realm while taking this path. However, I want to give it a try. Meng Chuan was very calm. Anyway, I also cultivate the Infinite Saber and the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique.
He wasn’t stubborn about sticking to a path. He was more used to multifaceted preparations. Most of his attention was focused on the Infinite Saber because having greater speed could make him more useful during wartime.
From a painter’s point of view, Meng Chuan preferred the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique. This movement technique was like a brush, and it used the world as its canvas.
Whoosh.
He swooped down from the sky and instantly burrowed underground. He advanced at high speeds underground.
Pfft! Pfft! Pfft!
The rocks and soil were easily parted. Meng Chuan flew extremely fast. Compared to the worldly laws’ suppression, the soil and rocks have less influence on my speed. Meng Chuan flew underground for a few seconds and was rather satisfied.
The worldly laws induced the world’s suppression upon Meng Chuan due to his terrifying speed that could affect time and space. Mud and rock were real objects. His Seamless domain could easily part the rocks and soil, so it only affected his speed slightly. He could still maintain 80% of his maximum speed underground.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan broke through the surface and saw the distant Jiang State Capital. He quickly streaked across the sky and returned to where he had sparred Li guan. The three Supremacies and Liu Qiyue were still waiting here.
“You sure are fast.” The illusory Qin Wu sighed in amazement. “You’ve just become a Regis Godfiend, yet you can travel 29 kilometers in a second. Compared to other Lightning Devastator Fiend Body Regis Godfiends in history, you’re much faster. They usually travel about 15 kilometers in a second.”
Luo Tang smiled. “Everybody takes a different path. Some of those Regis Godfiends cultivated the Heart Intent Saber, some cultivated the World Roving Dragon Saber, and some created their own ultimate techniques. Meng Chuan pursues speed to the extreme. This speed... Senior Brother Li, even if you use your Essence Soul to travel, it’s far inferior to Meng Chuan.”
Essence Souls didn’t have physical shackles. They usually traveled faster.
“Any Lightning Devastator Fiend Body Regis Godfiend is faster than me,” said Li Guan with a smile. “We don’t even need to discuss Meng Chuan.”
“I’m still far from it,” said Meng Chuan humbly.
Senior Ye Hong, who created the World Roving Dragon Saber, could instantly split into 81 embodiments within a 50-kilometer radius. Any one of them could become Ye Hong’s true body at any moment. In terms of traveling, they could teleport anywhere within 50 kilometers. In a flash, Senior Ye Hong could probably teleport through the void twice or even thrice—that was roughly 100-150 kilometers.
Senior Ye Hong did not pursue speed, but he far exceeded Meng Chuan. There was no need to mention Senior Guo Ke. His final saber move had reached the Imperial Lord level. One couldn’t even see his saber strike. His speed was much more terrifying than that of Senior Ye Hong.
Meng Chuan was indeed far inferior.
“You tried traveling underground, right?” asked Qin Wu. “How long will it take you to scan all of the Great Zhou Dynasty?”
“I’ve already swept more than half of it in the past few years,” said Meng Chuan. “I’ll be able to finish the sweep within a year. Even if I redo the sweep from the beginning, two years is enough.”
Qin Wu, Luo Tang, and Li Guan were delighted when they heard that. This speed was certainly fast enough. “Liu Qiyue, go back and rest first.” Li Guan turned to look at Liu Qiyue. “Meng Chuan needs to make a trip to Archean Mountain. He will probably take a few months to return.”
An
“A few months?” Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue were puzzled.
“Yes,” replied Liu Qiyue obediently.
Luo Tang and Qin Wu smiled before they dissipated. “Set off now,” instructed Li Guan. “Yes.” Although Meng Chuan was puzzled, he still transformed into a beam of light and headed straight for Archean Mountain. His Seamless domain naturally isolated all forms of reconnaissance. Even at close range, he couldn’t be seen.
...
That night, Meng Chuan arrived at Archean Mountain’s Grotto-Heaven Pavilion.
“Follow us.” Li Guan, an illusory Qin Wu, and an illusory Luo Tang led Meng Chuan into an ordinary room in Grotto-Heaven Pavilion’s backyard.
They pushed open the door. It was a very ordinary room. There was a wall in the middle of the room. A painting of a black-robed man hung on the wall.
Li Guan walked in front while Qin Wu and Luo Tang followed beside Meng Chuan.
Whoosh.
Li Guan flew up as he walked towards the painting. He became smaller and smaller before finally flying into the painting like a speck of dust.
Qin Wu, Luo Tang, and Meng Chuan also grew smaller as they approached the painting
How magical. Meng Chuan felt the changes in the void. He became smaller and smaller—to the point he couldn’t be seen with the naked eye. He entered the painting together with the three Supremacies.
The moment he entered the painting, Meng Chuan looked up.
At this moment, the black-robed man towered above them, affecting this region of spacetime.
“That’s Ancestral Master Archean Eon,” said Qin Wu with a smile.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon? Meng Chuan continued flying into the painting amidst his surprise.
After entering, he landed in a hall. A table and prayer mat could be seen in the hall.
“This is an important place of our Archean Mountain,” explained Qin Wu with a smile.
“Look.” Li Guan pointed upwards.
Meng Chuan looked up and saw eight fist-sized beads on the ceiling of the hall. They emitted different lights—white, black, green, golden...
“Ancestral Master Archean Eon refined nine Heaven Earth treasures. With any one of them, a person can release a Heaven Earth domain,” said Li Guan. “You should know about King Calm Sea’s Scarlet Cloud Heaven.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
King Calm Sea’s Scarlet Cloud Heaven was an extremely powerful domain treasure. It was extremely famous.
“Scarlet Cloud Heaven is one of the nine Heaven Earth treasures,” said Li Guan. “There are still eight left. Since ancient times, our Archean Mountain has been protecting them carefully. Although we occasionally bestow people with the Heaven Earth treasures, we will eventually take them back. We haven’t lost any of them.”
“Even if they’re lost temporarily,” said Qin Wu with a smile, “we can use our tracking means to determine their locations. If we can’t take them back immediately, we’ll take it back when Archean Mountain is invincible during an era.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
“One needs at least Seamless Quintessential Essence to activate these treasures. Once activated, Archean Mountain’s powers will descend and form a Heaven Earth domain to protect you,” said Li Guan. “Its weakness is that once it leaves the human world, it will be useless without our Archean Mountain’s augmentation.”
“Understood.” Meng Chuan nodded. “Supremacy, you said that the Heaven Earth Domain is an Imperial Lord’s domain?”
Marquis Godfiends had Darkstar domains. Regis Godfiends had Seamless domains. Creation Supremacies had Grotto-Heaven domains. Legend had it that Imperial Lords had Heaven Earth domains.
“This is an imitation.” Li Guan nodded. “It’s a treasure that imitates an Imperial Lord’s Heaven Earth domain. It’s impossible to replicate the might of an Imperial Lord’s domain fully. However, Ancestral Master Archean Eon abandoned other aspects and pursued defensive effects, allowing its defensive strength to be sufficiently powerful.”
Qin Wu nodded as well. “Even if Demon Sage Nine Abyss were to attack personally, he would only have 30 to 40 percent of his strength left after being weakened by Scarlet Cloud Heaven. If he were a peak fifth Firmament demon monarch, he wouldn’t be able to break the Scarlet Cloud Heaven’s domain.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
“All the treasures here are comparable to the Scarlet Cloud Heaven,” said Li Guan. “If you want to choose, choose the ones with a lightning affinity. Of course, we have prepared many treasures for you. You can choose any two.”
“I can choose any two?” Meng Chuan’s heart stirred.
“Come.” Li Guan walked to the table and pointed at the five books on it.
The first book had the words ‘Extraordinary Treasures’ on it.
“This book, Extraordinary Treasures, records many rare items.” Li Guan pointed at the second book. “The treasures recorded in this Origins Treasure book are similar to the Scarlet Cloud Heaven. All of them originated from Archean Mountain. They are extremely powerful in the human world, but useless when outside the human world.”
Meng Chuan could tell at a glance.
The third book had the word ‘Creation.’
“This book records weapons and treasures at the Creation level,” said Li Guan.
The fourth book was titled ‘Imperial Lord.’ “This book records Imperial Lord-level weapons and treasures. You are free to choose.”
The fifth book had the words Tribulation Realm’ written on it.
“This last book...” Li Guan looked at the thinnest book, Tribulation Realm. After some hesitation, he said, “It records the weapons and treasures of Tribulation Eminences.”

chapters.title: Chapter 347 - Tribulation Eminence
chapters.content:
Chapter 347 Tribulation Eminence
Tribulation Eminences? Meng Chuan carefully stared at the thinnest book. It was placed at the back. From the order, it was likely the most important. He asked curiously, “What is a Tribulation Eminence? I’ve never heard of it before.”
Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang smiled.
“According to Archean Mountain’s rules, one will only come into contact with such secrets after becoming a Creation Supremacy,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “This is because knowing about it too early wouldn’t be of any use. Instead, it might add to your distracting thoughts.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
“However, now that we are at war, we can make an exception,” said Qin Wu. “Only by becoming a Creation Supremacy can one enter the River of Spacetime. Therefore, Creation Supremacies are the most common and weakest in the River of Spacetime. As for those weaker than a Creation Supremacy? They can’t even see the River of Spacetime, so they don’t have the ability to traverse it.”
“Traverse the River of Spacetime?” Meng Chuan sighed in amazement. As a Regis Godfiend, he couldn’t even see the River of Spacetime. When he moved at maximum speed, he could sense that time and space were slightly affected. That was all.
If one wanted to traverse the River of Spacetime?The minimum requirement was to be a Creation Supremacy.
“You went to the World Gap and saw the birth of a world,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “You should know how helpful it is for cultivation if you witness those mysterious scenes.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded. He had only painted Fifteen Lightning Forms after seeing the purple lightning. This allowed him to advance in his saber art cultivation by leaps and bounds.
“As for the vast River of Spacetime, it’s much larger than the tiny World Gaps. There are plenty of majestic and mysterious scenes,” said Qin Wu. “After traveling the River of Spacetime, one will have more knowledge, boosting one’s cultivation speed. If Creation Supremacies were to just cultivate in their homeworld, they would only see the sun rise and set every day. They would only see the scenery in their world. The likelihood of those Supremacies becoming an Imperial Lord are slim.
“If you head into the River of Spacetime, perhaps you will have an epiphany when you encounter a mysterious phenomenon.” Qin Wu looked at Li Guan. “For example, your Uncle-Master Li should’ve long left the human world and traveled the River of Spacetime to obtain a sliver of hope of becoming an Imperial Lord. However, he remained in our homeworld because of the war.”
“Aren’t the two of you doing the same?” said Li Guan with a smile. “Archean Mountain’s rules. As long as a new Supremacy is born to guard the sect, an old Supremacy is free to roam the River of Spacetime. Now, all three of us are staying in our homeworld.”
Meng Chuan sighed. The Creation Supremacies had made a huge sacrifice.
“Meng Chuan,” said Qin Wu, “in the River of Spacetime, there are as many experts as there is sand on the beach. Creation Supremacies are the weakest, and it’s rare for them to encounter Imperial Lords. As for Tribulation Eminences, they are famous. A Tribulation Eminence is what lies after the Imperial Lord realm.”
“Supremacy, Imperial Lord, Tribulation Eminence?” Meng Chuan muttered.
“You know that the Essence Soul is divided into nine levels, right?” asked Qin Wu. “To become an Imperial Lord, one needs to reach the Heaven Earth realm and have a seventh-level Essence Soul. The eighth level of the Essence Soul is Tribulation Transcendence. The ninth level is Eternal.”
Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up as he nodded immediately.
“In fact, above the Imperial Lord realm, there are two ways to break through. One way is through the Physical Body Tribulation; the other is the Essence Soul Tribulation. Of course, you can also cultivate both,” continued Qin Wu. “The difficulty of cultivating one’s Essence Soul increases as one progresses. It’s very difficult for an Imperial Lord to attain an eighth-level Essence Soul. Eighth-level Essence Souls also vary in strength. The more tribulations one transcends, the more terrifying one’s Essence Soul becomes.”
“A newly-advanced eight-level Essence Soul mystic technique can only suppress a seventh-level Essence Soul. If a Second Tribulation Eminence suppresses others with an Essence Soul mystic technique, I’m afraid even an Imperial Lord will have only 10 to 20 percent of their strength left and can barely maintain consciousness.
“If one reaches the Fourth Tribulation realm, their Essence Soul mystic technique can instantly kill a seventh-level Essence Soul expert. The victim won’t even have the strength to resist,” said Qin Wu. “No matter how high an Imperial Lord’s technique realm is, their Essence Soul will be instantly killed. One must transcend the Physical Body Tribulation if they wish to withstand an Essence Soul attack.
“That’s why a Tribulation Eminence can only fight other Tribulation Eminences after they reach the Fourth Tribulation realm.” Qin Wu said, “A Fourth Tribulation Eminence can kill an Imperial Lord in one strike, but they’re only an average Tribulation Eminence. There are even higher realms... There are nine levels to the Tribulation realm. After passing the ninth tribulation, one will be Eternal.”
“Eternal?” Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up.
“Yes, Eternal,” said Qin Wu. “According to the books written by Ancestral Master Archean Eon, such figures are eternal existences in the River of Spacetime. They are invincible, and are known as Rulers.”
“Rulers?” Meng Chuan memorized the information.
“However, it’s too difficult. No one has become a Ruler in the long span of time we roamed the River of Spacetime. That’s an infinitely distant legend,” said Qin Wu. “The River of Spacetime is boundless. Perhaps a Ruler has been born in a distant place. At the very least, Ancestral Master Archean Eon is very certain that such an existence has been born.
“The cultivation of an Essence Soul is to seek answers from one’s inner self. Therefore, there were another three eighth-level Essence Soul experts in human history,” said Qin Wu. “The strongest became a Third Tribulation Eminence, so it would’ve been very easy for that person to kill an Imperial Lord.”
“As for physical body cultivation, the requirements on one’s cultivation realm and cultivation system are even more complicated. One has to cultivate their body to a sufficiently perfected state before they can reach the Physical Body Tribulation realm. Up to now, only Ancestral Master Archean Eon has reached the Physical Body Tribulation realm.” Qin Wu’s eyes were filled with admiration. “Ancestral Master Archean Eon was a Seven Tribulation Eminence. His might was astounding. Countless worlds around us fear our Ancestral Master Archean Eon.”
Li Guan and Luo Tang were filled with admiration.
“The strength of a Seventh Tribulation Eminence is beyond your imagination. They can destroy the world with a single thought. Our war is nothing more than a triviality to them. In the early tribal days of our human world, the world was desolate and much smaller than it is now. In fact, the world could only accommodate Creation Supremacies,” said Qin Wu. “It was Ancestral Master Archean Eon who nourished the world. Furthermore, he used his unimaginable powers to strengthen our human world, allowing the human world to expand to its current state. It’s also capable of accommodating existences like Imperial Lords.
“Ancestral Master Archean Eon lived for more than 180,000 years. He spent almost his entire life wandering the River of Spacetime,” said Qin Wu. “When he was close to the end of his lifespan, he silently returned to his homeworld and helped improve its world level. He left many arrangements for his descendants before silently passing away.”
“One’s lifespan can also increase? Over 180,000 years?” Meng Chuan felt that everything was very distant. “One lives if they transcend the Tribulations successfully; otherwise, they die. One can have long or short lifespans,” said Qin Wu. “However, an Imperial Lord has a 10,000-year lifespan. Tribulation Eminences break the lifespan limit after transcending a tribulation successfully. Their lifespans will be greatly extended. The longest-living human was Ancestral Master Archean Eon. Next was Imperial Lord An Yang. He was a Third Tribulation Eminence. He lived for 23,000 years.
“These are all secrets. It’s useless even if a Regis Godfiend knows. After all, you can’t go to the River of Spacetime.” Qin Wu looked at Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan nodded.
“The treasures I’m showing you are all things that Regis Godfiends can use.” Qin Wu pointed at the five books in front of him. “Spend time reading them and choose wisely. Choose any two treasures. By the way, you can only choose one Tribulation Eminence treasure. With your current strength, you can only refine them with an Intrinsic Artifact Refining Art. Therefore, you can only choose one. You won’t be able to use the rest even if you have more.”

chapters.title: Chapter 348 - Choice
chapters.content:
Chapter 348 Choice
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in front of the table and began reading.
As he read the books, although some treasures were tempting, he could only choose two.
In terms of strength, the treasures recorded in the Origins Treasure book are the strongest; they originate from Archean Mountain. However, the disadvantage of these treasures is that they use external strength. It’s not flexible enough, and its strength can’t be increased. It’s fine if it’s used to cast a domain, so it doesn’t need to be flexible. However, the inflexibility becomes very obvious when using them to fight directly.
Meng Chuan flipped through it. For example, with the Sword Talisman, a Regis Godfiend could send out a sword beam after activating it. The sword beam was extremely sharp, comparable to an ordinary Creation Supremacy’s full-powered strike. However, the attack was fixed in the Sword Talisman. It was very rigid. It would take a few seconds before the next strike could be delivered.
Origins treasures are more suitable for life-preservation.
When Meng Chuan flipped through the Imperial Lord-level weapons and treasures, he was tempted by them. Imperial Lord-level weapons and treasures were mostly nurtured by Imperial Lords through long periods of cultivation. They had all sorts of magical powers.
Tribulation Eminence. Meng Chuan flipped through the last book. He was most interested in this book. He perused the book carefully.
It had the fewest recorded treasures-only three treasures were listed.
The first item was called the Thousand Lightning Dharma Seal. It had a very high requirement for one’s Essence Soul realm. Only a Regis Godfiend with a fifth-level Essence Soul could attempt to refine it. With the Thousand Lightning Dharma Seal, even the weakest Regis Godfiend that had refined this treasure could form a Lightning Tribulation Cloud within a 50-kilometer radius. Lightning bolts would smite the enemy. The speed of heavenly lightning was obvious. There was no way to dodge it. You could only face the heavenly lightning head-on.
Even if the enemy fled, the Lightning Tribulation Cloud would track them. It was extremely powerful. Once one obtained an eighth-level Essence Soul, they would be able to unleash the full might of the Tribulation treasure. One could release more than 1,000 lightning bolts that had been nurtured for a long period of time. These lightning bolts could be used to defend. They could also tear through space and hunt down enemies. Ordinary Imperial Lords would instantly be pulverized.
“From what I can see, your Essence Soul is already very close to the fifth-level,” said Li Guan. “Therefore, this Thousand Lightning Dharma Seal is included in the list. This is a treasure that Ancestral Master Archean Eon obtained from one of his kills. It’s extremely powerful. However, one takes a few seconds to condense a Lightning Tribulation Cloud before obtaining an eighth-level Essence Soul. This is the disadvantage of using this treasure.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
It was truly powerful. The Thousand Lightning Dharma Seal reached the Creation realm even at its weakest. Furthermore, as his strength increased, he could unleash more of the Thousand Lightning Dharma Seal’s strength. This Dharma seal placed greater importance on the Essence Soul. That was because an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence was the original owner of the treasure.
As for taking a few seconds to condense the Lightning Tribulation Cloud? His speed could buy him those few seconds of time.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan flipped to a new page.
The second Tribulation treasure was a saber. It was known as the Time Saber. After refining this saber, one would obtain a mystic technique legacy, the Water Droplet of Time. It was a time-type mystic technique. Once one cultivated it to a high level, they could trap their enemies for a period of time in constant samsara. They could even stop time. The Time Saber’s original owner was also a great enemy that Ancestral Master Archean Eon encountered. He was eventually killed by Ancestral Master Archean Eon.
“The lightning lineage will affect time when one’s cultivation reaches a high level,” said Li Guan. “This Time Saber is quite suitable for you. You are required to refine this saber if you want to obtain the Water Droplet of Time mystic technique. It’s rather powerful at the beginning, but it becomes even more impressive as you progress.”
Meng Chuan was tempted. As a saber user, the allure of a Tribulation-level saber was obvious.
Although a weapon that he personally nurtured was more suitable, the premise was that the difference in weapons wasn’t too great. Demon Slayer was only a Creation-level divine armament; it was far inferior to the Time Saber. If Meng Chuan could nurture Demon Slayer to the Imperial Lord level, it would be able to approach the might of the Time Saber.
Meng Chuan flipped to the last page.
Another Tribulation treasure-Bloodblade Disc.
The Bloodblade Disc was rather special. It was a treasure that Ancestral Master Archean Eon had chanced upon during his adventures in the River of Spacetime. It was a treasure specially refined for a disciple of a Seventh Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence before he reached the end of his life. However, when this Tribulation Eminence died of old age, although his disciple was already an Imperial Lord and carefully hid, his greatest enemy still managed to kill this disciple with a Essence Soul mystic technique through karma. The disciple died, leaving behind the treasure.
The Bloodblade Disc could protect one’s body, grant flight capabilities, and kill enemies. It was very suitable for the growth of a weak person. Regis Godfiends could use a portion of the Bloodblade Disc’s strength to escape when stepping on the Bloodblade Disc. They could also split the Bloodblade Disc into 18 Bloodblades. The 18 Bloodblades contained an array formation that could protect one’s surroundings. The Bloodblade Disc’s array formation mainly focused on escaping and defense. As for killing enemies? It was because the Bloodblades were made to be extremely sharp.
Godfiends could use their Essence Soul and Quintessential Essence to control the Bloodblades to kill enemies. The strength they could unleash depended on their cultivation realm. If one was a Creation Supremacy, they could split the Bloodblade disc into 24 Bloodblades. The flight and defensive capabilities would increase exponentially. As for killing enemies, it still depended on one’s realm.
If one was an Imperial Lord, they could split the Bloodblade disc into 36 Bloodblades. As for Tribulation Eminences? It would still be 36 Bloodblades. This was already the limit. The Bloodblades were made of special materials and were extremely sharp. It was a pretty good weapon even for a Tribulation Eminence.
This was a protective treasure that the Tribulation Eminence left his beloved disciple. It wasn’t an intrinsic weapon used by the Tribulation Eminence.
“I can use it to protect myself and flight?” Meng Chuan looked at the last item and couldn’t help but ask, “If I refine the Bloodblade Disc and control it, will I be able to fly faster?”
“This is a Tribulation treasure. The higher your realm is, the more of the treasure’s strength you can unleash. You are already that fast by relying on your own speed. By relying on this treasure, you will naturally be faster,” said Qin Wu. “However, let me remind you. The first two treasures are intrinsic artifacts or treasures of a Tribulation Eminence. The last one is a treasure made for a junior to use as protection. It’s more focused on fleeing and defense. It’s weaker when it comes to killing enemies.”
Meng Chuan stared at the page that introduced the last treasure and said, “This Bloodblade Disc is said to be made of special materials. The Bloodblades are extremely sharp. It’s a very good weapon even for Tribulation Eminences, right? This is Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s evaluation.”
“Yes, it’s very sharp. However, the Bloodblade Disc’s runic patterns are used for fleeing and protection. You can only rely on your cultivation realm when it comes to killing an enemy,” reminded Qin Wu. “I’ll choose it then,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“Bloodblade Disc?” Li Guan, Luo Tang, and Qin Wu looked at Meng Chuan.
“I’m certain.” Meng Chuan nodded. “Ancestral Master Archean Eon believes that it’s extremely sharp and that it’s suitable for a Tribulation Eminence. I’m a Regis Godfiend. I believe it’s powerful enough to kill enemies with it.” Meng Chuan smiled. “Besides, my speed is the greatest help I can provide in this war. The faster I am, the more demon monarchs I can kill. Furthermore, I can provide reinforcements faster.”
Li Guan and company also understood that being good at flight was probably the main reason why Meng Chuan had chosen the item.
“Furthermore, this is a treasure for the weak to use,” said Meng Chuan. “Although the other two are powerful, I’m only a Regis Godfiend. This Bloodblade Disc is more suitable for the weak.”

chapters.title: Chapter 349 - Runes
chapters.content:
Chapter 349 Runes
“Apart from this, what’s the second item of your choice?” asked Li Guan.
“Origins treasure, Clear Sky.” Meng Chuan didn’t hesitate to answer.
The advantage of an Origins treasure was certainly huge. It could draw upon Archean Mountain’s powers to form an Imperial Lord-level domain. It was the strongest defensive technique in a head-on clash! Even a peak fifth Firmament demon monarch’s attack couldn’t penetrate the domain. Even Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s strength would be reduced to 30 to 40 percent. This was much more useful than a Tribulation Eminence’s weapon. The only flaw of these Origins treasures was that their powers remained constant. By the time he reached the Grotto-Heaven realm, he would be able to unleash the might of a Tribulation Eminence weapon. It would be far more powerful than an Origins treasure.
At the very least, it can protect me for a few decades. The next few decades are a crucial period. That’s how long I’ll take to wipe out all the demon monarchs in the world.
“Alright, wait here. We’ll help you retrieve them.” Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang turned and left. They pushed open the hall’s door, which led to an empty square. Other buildings surrounded it.
Meng Chuan sat alone in the hall and waited.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon left behind many treasures for us descendants. Meng Chuan flipped through the books. The three Tribulation Eminence treasures that he could choose came from Ancestral Master Archean Eon.
From this, one could tell just how strong the human race was. Although the human world had produced Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences before, the strongest one had only reached the Third Tribulation realm. Therefore, there were few treasures left for humans.
Moments later, Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang walked into the hall. Li Guan held a box as he walked to Meng Chuan. Once he was in front of Meng Chuan, he opened the box.
An ordinary, blood-red, metal disc laid inside the box.
Li Guan gently tapped it with his finger, and a wisp of Quintessential Essence seeped into the Bloodblade Disc. Dense runes immediately appeared on the Bloodblade Disc’s surface. Lightning also flashed around the Bloodblade Disc and emitted a terrifying aura.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul trembled when the aura appeared.
“A divine item usually conceals its strength. You typically wouldn’t be able to see anything impressive about it. It only reacted because I used my Quintessential Essence to probe it,” said Li Guan. “In fact, the Bloodblade Disc is made of extremely precious materials. It’s extremely compatible with the lightning lineage. You are now a Regis Godfiend. You can only refine the Bloodblade disc by using an Intrinsic Artifact Refining Art.”
Li Guan handed a book to Meng Chuan. “This book contains the instructions on how to use the Intrinsic Artifact Refining Art. To use this art, one requires a fourth-level Essence Soul. You meet the requirements.”
Meng Chuan took the book.
“Remember, Godfiends can only have one intrinsic treasure. Unless it’s destroyed or taken away, you can’t refine a second one,” said Li Guan. “However, if it’s destroyed or taken away, it will severely damage your Essence Soul, all the way to its foundation. You will lose your memories, and your perception will be greatly reduced. Therefore, no Godfiend will change their intrinsic treasure unless they are forced to.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. “Understood.”
The Essence Soul was the foundation of life. If his body was destroyed, he could still possess another person’s body. However, if his Essence Soul was destroyed, he would be truly dead. If one’s Essence Soul was too heavily injured, it was possible for one to become a fool. If one’s memories were incomplete and their perception was greatly reduced, one would become stupid. It was very common for one’s Essence Soul to be damaged.
“This is Clear sky.” Li Guan waved his hand, and a faint cyan-colored lightning bead flew towards Meng Chuan. “Clear Sky can be used easily. It’s best if you store it in your dantian space. Don’t let the enemy take it,” instructed Li Guan.
Meng Chuan reached out and clenched his fist. He felt the bead emanating warmth. Immediately, he opened his mouth and sucked the bead in.
Swoosh.
The bead could change size. It obediently flew into his dantian space and approached the Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead.
“You can test its might outside the hall,” said Li Guan with a smile.
Meng Chuan nodded and walked out of the hall. He stood in an empty square. He infused his Quintessential Essence into Clear Sky and activated the runic patterns on it. The runic patterns were simple to use. He first guided Archean Mountain’s powers into descending upon him; he then controlled Archean Mountain’s powers carefully.
Whoosh.
A faint cyan fog silently appeared in a five-kilometer radius around Meng Chuan. The cyan fog was a corporeal lightning bolt. Countless bolts of lightning condensed into clouds, gathering around Meng Chuan.
Three layers of lightning barriers appeared in a ten-foot radius around Meng Chuan, protecting him from any attacks.
“The Clear Sky domain weakens an enemy as they pass through each layer.” The cyan fog also shrouded Li Guan, Luo Tang, and Qin Wu. Li Guan said, “The three layers of protective lightning contain more than half of Clear Sky’s strength, giving it the strongest defense.”
“It’s easy to control it.” Meng Chuan nodded. He only used a small amount of Quintessential Essence to activate it. The domain’s power originated from Archean Mountain, so he didn’t feel burdened by activating it. However, it was extremely powerful.
Qin Wu smiled and said, “Meng Chuan, be it Clear Sky or the Bloodblade Disc, they are Archean Mountain’s treasures that are passed down from generation to generation. If you reach the end of your lifespan, you will have to return the treasures to the sect.”
“I understand.” Meng Chuan nodded and worriedly said, “What if I end up dying due to being weak...”
“In human history, many Creation Supremacies from Archean Mountain have gone to the River of Spacetime. Most of them never return,” said Li Guan helplessly. “What can we do if the treasures are lost? However, according to the sect’s rules, Creation Supremacies are forbidden from carrying a Tribulation Eminence weapon into the River of Spacetime. Only an Imperial Lord has the right to do so. Of course, if there’s a special reason, we can make an exception. For example, we made an exception for you. You were allowed to obtain the Bloodblade Disc despite being a Regis Godfiend.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
“Refine it well. Even after Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s preliminary tempering, it still won’t be easy to refine a Tribulation Eminence weapon,” said Li Guan with a smile.
It really was not easy. Meng Chuan first learned the Intrinsic Artifact Refining Art before attempting to refine it. He felt like a mortal riding an unbridled horse, finding it hard to control it. Meng Chuan could only slowly refine it as time passed.
This Intrinsic Artifact Refining Art has something in common with the Undying realm cultivation method of the physical body cultivation system. Meng Chuan had discovered something when learning the Intrinsic Artifact Refining Art. This refining art required one to have a fourth-level Essence Soul—the Soul Separation stage. This was because one needed to place Essence Soul thoughts into the Bloodblade Disc. This was very similar to how Meng Chuan had placed an Essence Soul thought in each of his particle spaces.
However, the difficulty of placing Essence Soul thoughts into the Bloodblade Disc was even greater. Even though it didn’t resist Meng Chuan strongly—thanks to Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s initial refining of the Bloodblade Disc-he still found it difficult to penetrate it with his Essence Soul.
Days passed in the ancient hall.
Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged as the Bloodblade Disc floated in front of him. It constantly trembled and emitted sounds. Lightning flashed as its terrifying aura emanated. It was an aura that was 1,000 times more terrifying than a Creation Supremacy. Finally, all the lightning snakes on the Bloodblade Disc converged. Their auras were completely restrained as they floated obediently without any movement.
It’s done. Meng Chuan wore a look of delight as he looked at the Bloodblade Disc. It took me over two months to refine it.
Store. With a thought, the Bloodblade Disc rapidly shrank and landed in Meng Chuan’s palm. Following that, it shrank to a size that was barely visible to the naked eye. It easily seeped through his skin and meridians, entering his dantian space. “I’ve finally gained control over it,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. Once I completely refine the Bloodblade Disc with the Intrinsic Artifact Refining Art, part of my Essence Soul will fuse with it. It will become a part of my Essence Soul; it will also be a part of my body. It will be like an extension of my body when I control it.
However, it’s difficult to unleash its strength. It’s a Tribulation Eminence treasure. It’s way too complicated for a Regis Godfiend like me. With a flip of his hand, Meng Chuan took out the Bloodblade Disc. With his Essence Soul, he could clearly see the vast number of runes contained within the Bloodblade Disc.
Meng Chuan had three divine powers and had also cultivated the Lightning Runes. They were also runes that contained the mysteries of the world. However, compared to the runes on the Bloodblade Disc, the number of runes was hundreds of millions of times greater. The complexity of the runes was also incomparable. Meng Chuan could see 128 layers of runes in the Bloodblade Disc. Furthermore, many runes were hidden in spacetime. They would occasionally appear in his perception, but Meng Chuan found it difficult to see the complete runes.
Is this the difference between an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence and me? Meng Chuan sighed inwardly. Thankfully, this is a protective treasure refined by that Tribulation Eminence for his disciple. I’ll just control it at a superficial level for now. The higher his realm was, the more runes he could control. Only then would he be able to unleash the might of the Bloodblade Disc.

chapters.title: Chapter 350 - Liu Qiyue’s Breakthrough
chapters.content:
Chapter 350 Liu Qiyue’s Breakthrough
Meng Chuan stood in the square in front of the hall. The Bloodblade Disc floated in front of him.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
18 Bloodblades flew out from the Bloodblade Disc. Each Bloodblade was curved, and the two edges were extremely sharp.
Guard. Meng Chuan used his Quintessential Essence to activate the circular disc in front of him as well as the runic formation contained within the 18 Bloodblades. He saw the Bloodblades slowly spin in all directions with a strange rhythm.
It has a runic array formation for flying and defense. The more profound my understanding of it, the greater the strength I can unleash with the Bloodblade Disc. That’s why I need to study it carefully. Thankfully, this is a treasure of the lightning lineage. The runes contain the secrets of the lightning lineage. Meng Chuan pondered carefully.
Swoosh.
The Bloodblade Disc became three feet long. Meng Chuan stepped on the Bloodblade Disc as he activated the flying rune array with his Quintessential Essence.
He had reached the Dharma Domain realm with the Flash Form of Lightning. The Bloodblade Disc’s runic array formation was all-encompassing. However, the flying runic array formation contained the Flash Form of Lightning’s essence! With Meng Chuan’s insights in Flash Form of Lightning’s essence, he quickly understood many runes and could unleash greater strength with the runic array formation.
