A bolt of lightning flashed. The suppression of the world became stronger. His body became as heavy as a mountain, but Meng Chuan’s face was filled with delight. It’s so fast. It’s so fast. Meng Chuan was delighted as he flew at high speeds. I can travel 60 kilometers in a second.
The faster I am, the harder it will be for me to increase my speed. With the Bloodblade Disc, my speed has now increased by several-fold. As expected of a Tribulation treasure. Meng Chuan was very excited. The runic formation was clearly much more exquisite than his movement technique. Of course, the materials used in the construction of the Bloodblade Disc was part of the reason. After infusing his Quintessential Essence into the Bloodblade Disc, the Bloodblade Disc carried him away as it transformed into a bolt of lightning.
The Bloodblade Disc increased his affinity with lightning
I can fly faster as long as I comprehend more runes. Meng Chuan’s heart suddenly stirred. Oh? Isn’t this guiding me on how to become faster...? The more profound my understanding of the Bloodblade Disc’s flying runic array, the greater my speed will be. Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up. By the same logic, the more profound my understanding of the defensive array, the better my defense will be.
With the Bloodblade Disc’s insane speed, I can use it to kill enemies. I can control multiple Bloodblades and kill several enemies. These Bloodblades fly much faster than me. When it comes to defense, I can use multiple Bloodblades to control the void. It can also be used to trap and kill my enemies. After all, the Bloodblades can control the void. They are perfectly coordinated when used to seal the void—which prevents enemies from escaping. When it comes to killing enemies, they can attack in any direction.
The more Meng Chuan thought about it, the more excited he became. The runic arrays on this Bloodblade Disc are very clear from the most shallow layer to the deeper layers. I can currently see 128 layers and some runes that I can’t see clearly. When I meditate, I’m also in the process of improving. Furthermore, I’m certain that this path is a promising one. This Bloodblade Disc should be the result of a Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s understanding of the lightning lineage. This is a protective treasure, but it’s also a kind of legacy treasure—just slightly different. However, it’s 1,000 times more precious than any Black Metal Sutra.
Meng Chuan was also very clear-headed and wasn’t conceited. However, I need to absorb what suits me the best. I don’t have to follow the exact same path as that Tribulation Eminence. Instead, I can reference the parts that are suitable for me. For example, I’ve referenced the Flash Form of Lightning, Nine Heavenly Forms of the Void, Yin-Yang Form of Lightning, and Roving Dragon Form of Lightning. That Tribulation Eminence’s accomplishments in the lightning lineage probably far exceed any senior in the human world.
Although Ancestral Master Archean Eon was also a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, Meng Chuan could tell that Ancestral Master Archean Eon hadn’t focused on the lightning lineage from what he had seen of the Samsara Spear Technique.
At the very least, this Bloodblade Disc’s runic array formation allows me to see how I should break through the world’s shackles with the Flash Form of Lightning’s essence. It also guides me with my path towards the Grotto-Heaven realm. Meng Chuan was very glad that he had chosen the Bloodblade Disc. Although the two other Tribulation treasures might be more powerful, they might not have provided the guidance necessary for a disciple to proceed on their cultivation path. The Bloodblade Disc went from simple concepts to more profound ones.
No wonder nobody in the human world has broken free of the world shackles from ancient times to now. It’ll still be extremely difficult to break free of the world shackles with the Flash Form of Lightning, even if I follow this senior’s understanding of the lightning lineage. However, once I master it, I’ll probably be stronger than King True Martial and his Power of True martial. Meng Chuan inspected the vast runic array formation in the Bloodblade Disc. Back then, Grandsire Yin Yang was very powerful when he had just reached the Grotto-Heaven realm. King True Martial had taken Grandsire Yin Yang’s foundation and improved it a step further! By building upon that Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s insights, Meng Chuan’s future path would be even more brilliant!
Obtaining the Bloodblade Disc is as good as obtaining a master. Delighted, Meng Chuan carefully studied the Bloodblade Disc’s mysteries.
Jiang State Capital.
After the new year, spring gradually arrived. The peach blossoms in the courtyard began to bloom as bees came to collect nectar.
Liu Qiyue stood in front of a peach blossom tree and smelled the flowers’ fragrance. She watched a few buzzing bees fly around the peach blossoms.
Ah Chuan hasn’t returned yet. I wonder how many months he will take. Liu Qiyue smiled. If he knew that I reached the Dharma Domain realm, he would definitely be very happy.
Yes. Liu Qiyue had finally broken through to the Dharma Domain realm. In fact, she had reached the peak of the Realm of Dao earlier than Meng Chuan. After she obtained Phoenix Flight from Meng Chuan, she realized the direction she had to head towards so that she could break through! During her cultivation, she also cast Phoenix’s Nirvana once so that she could protect the city. When she underwent nirvana, she had an epiphany. She gained more insights into the Dharma Domain realm. After several years of cultivation, she finally reached the Dharma Domain realm in early spring.
However, one needs a third-level Essence Soul if they wish to become a Regis Godfiend. I’ve been a Marquis Godfiend for many years. I’ve also cast Phoenix’s Nirvana several times. When will I attain a third-level Essence Soul? Liu Qiyue ruminated on her cultivation.
To become a Regis Godfiend, there were requirements on one’s age, technique realm, and Essence Soul.
Liu Qiyue didn’t know when she would obtain a third-level Essence Soul.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in the square in front of the hall. The Bloodblade Disc floated in front of him.
“Go.”With a thought,
Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish!
The Bloodblades instantly transformed into bolts of lightning as they shot forward at high speeds. They were faster than Meng Chuan’s saber, and their might was even more terrifying. In midair, he could only see dazzling lightning. However, Meng Chuan could clearly sense the 18 Bloodblades forming a line. In an instant, they struck a spot in the far distance, tearing it apart. He saw gray chains sealing the outside world. “You actually managed to tear through a Grotto-Heaven membrane wall.” An illusory figure walked out of the hall; it was Qin Wu. He exclaimed, “This strike of yours has the strength of a weak Creation Supremacy.”
“I only managed to unleash such strength thanks to the Bloodblade Disc,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. Meng Chuan had gained quite a bit of insight from studying the flying runic array over the past few days. He had improved greatly in the Flash Form of Lightning “A Tribulation Eminence’s treasure is still a treasure.” The illusory Qin Wu shook his head. “How much of a treasure’s might one can utilize is dependent on the individual. You can unleash such strength because your perception is high.” Meng Chuan smiled and said, “Master, I’ve already gained basic mastery of the Bloodblade Disc. It’s time for me to leave.”
“There’s no need to rush those few months,” said Qin Wu seriously. “You are part of humanity’s hope in dealing with one million demon monarchs. It concerns our hope of winning the war. It’s best you study this treasure more.”
“I know, but I’ve been here for more than three months. If I want to unleash more of the Bloodblade Disc’s might, I’ll need to make a breakthrough in my technique realm,” said Meng Chuan. “It’s likely that it’ll take me three to ten years. Therefore, I’d rather leave sooner than later.”
Qin Wu looked at Meng Chuan and nodded with a smile. “Alright, be careful when you are out.”
With Clear Sky and the protective stone talisman, Archean Mountain was confident in Meng Chuan’s safety. Furthermore, Meng Chuan wasn’t weak.

chapters.title: Chapter 351 - Mask
chapters.content:
Chapter 351 Mask
Archean Mountain, Grotto-Heaven Pavilion’s backyard.
It was still an ordinary-looking room. Two tiny black dots flew out from the painting hanging on the wall. They grew larger and larger; they were Qin Wu and Meng Chuan.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s control over space reached an unimaginable level. Meng Chuan turned his head and looked at the painting in admiration.
If this era had an expert like Ancestral Master Archean Eon, the demons would be simply courting death if they dared to invade. Unfortunately, although the human race had a long history, Ancestral Master Archean Eon was the only one that had truly shocked many worlds.
“Meng Chuan.” Li Guan pushed open the door and walked in.
Meng Chuan bowed. “Supremacy.”
“Your current speed far exceeds your past speed when using the Bloodblade Disc,” said Li Guan. “I’m afraid that you’ll sweep through the underground demon monarchs in our Great Zhou Dynasty in a few months.”
Meng Chuan nodded. In the past few years, he had perused more than half of the lightning lineage manuals. He was bound to be much faster in the near future.
“Although you were fast, you only slaughtered tens of thousands of demon monarchs in a year. Although the demons searched everywhere for your identity, you didn’t pose a serious threat,” said Li Guan. “With your current speed, you can sweep through everywhere under the three dynasties in three to four years. Every year, you will be slaughtering hundreds of thousands of demon monarchs! The demons will definitely go crazy. “The demon world has a much longer history than ours. Although they have never produced an expert like Ancestral Master Archean Eon, there are at least several Imperial Lords in every era. In history, the demons have given birth to ten experts at the Fifth Tribulation or Sixth Tribulation realm. The demon world also has extremely rich heritage. If they aren’t hesitant to pay any price, I believe they will have a way to find out your true identity.” Li Guan looked at Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan’s heart tightened. The more he knew, the more he understood the foundation of a powerful world. The demons couldn’t do much only because they were separated by a world.
“Therefore, after you leave, you have to be more careful about keeping your identity a secret.” Li Guan flipped his hand and took out a gray mask. “This is a rare treasure, Mask of Illusion. It’s used to conceal one’s identity. It can shield you from detection and disguise your aura. Even an Imperial Lord will find it difficult to break through its obstruction and probe your true appearance. Whenever you are carrying out your mission, wear it.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded. He knew very well how powerful mighty figures were. The Seamless domain could probe one’s lifespan and allow them to sense grudges. What if it were a more brilliant technique?
If he revealed himself and used his full strength, the demons might discover his true identity.
“With this mask, you can provide reinforcements everywhere.” Li Guan sighed. “The ordinary demon monarchs attack various cities every month. Fourth Firmament demon monarch teams and fifth Firmament demon monarchs occasionally ambush our Godfiends. Occasionally, Marquis Godfiends will die. Your current speed is even more impressive than before. You are the most suitable person for rescuing them.”
“Understood.” Meng Chuan nodded and received the gray mask. He easily controlled the gray mask with his Quintessential Essence and gently put it on his face.
His aura immediately changed. His expression turned colder. Even Meng Chuan’s hair had turned white.
“Haha, these strands of white hair are quite interesting,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “Godfiends have rather long lifespans. They can typically maintain their youthful looks for years. Only when they reach a certain age will they be unable to control their aging appearance. That’s when their hair begins to turn white. With these strands of white hair, the demons will believe that you are an ancient Regis Godfiend.”
For example, Fairy Meng originally had the appearance of a middle-aged woman. She only appeared aged after being severely injured. For a Godfiend’s hair to turn white? A Godfiend would have to be rather old. Regis Godfiends had to be 400 years old before this happened.
“Very good.” Li Guan nodded in approval.
“Then, I’ll take my leave first.” Meng Chuan bowed to the two Supremacies.
“We have kept the news of you becoming a Regis Godfiend a secret. You also have to keep it a secret,” exhorted Li Guan. “Alright, go.”
Meng Chuan nodded and walked out of the room. He transformed into a beam of light and quickly left Archean Mountain.
At the door, Li Guan and Qin Wu looked into the distance.
“It’s up to Meng Chuan to deal with the million demon monarchs,” said Li Guan.
“With what he has shown from his cultivation, he might bring us more surprises. For example, he may become an invincible Creation Supremacy,” said Qin Wu with anticipation.
“He hasn’t even reached the Creation realm. He’s far from being an invincible Creation Supremacy,” said Li Guan with a smile. “As for you, Junior Brother Qin, if you can progress another two steps, you can be considered invincible in the Creation realm.”
“Difficult.” Qin Wu only said one word.
Invincible at the Creation realm? That was what Grandsire Yin Yang had achieved at his peak. Of course, if an Imperial Lord or an expert with an eighth-level Essence Soul appeared, the war would end completely. However, these two things were even more difficult to achieve.
Meng Chuan returned to Jiang State Capital first.
Swoosh.
When Meng Chuan landed in the small courtyard, his Seamless domain sensed Liu Qiyue—who was cultivating Phoenix Flight. His wife had shielded herself from probing, but he could easily detect her with the Seamless domain.
“Ah Chuan.” Liu Qiyue streaked across the sky and landed in the courtyard, her face filled with delight.
“Your movement technique...” Meng Chuan was somewhat shocked. When his wife flew through the sky, her trajectory carried a stunning beauty. “Qiyue, you broke through?”
In the past, he had often seen his wife cultivate Phoenix Flight, but it was far inferior to her current standard.
Liu Qiyue nodded with a smile. “Yes.” “Dharma Domain realm?” Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up.
“That’s right. It’s all thanks to the Phoenix Flight you gave me. This is definitely the most suitable technique for a Phoenix Divine Body Godfiend,” said Liu Qiyue.
“That’s great. As long as your Essence Soul breaks through, you will become a Regis Godfiend.” Meng Chuan was rather excited. If his wife became a Regis Godfiend, it meant that she could live for 500 years. As a Regis Godfiend, her normal strength would be enough to deal with most problems. It would be unlikely for her to be forced to cast Phoenix’s Nirvana when the demons attacked the city. “I can’t rush an Essence Soul breakthrough. By the way, Ah Chuan, Archean Mountain sent me a letter and asked me to keep your Regis Godfiend status a secret. It won’t be publicly announced,” said Liu Qiyue. “I have to keep a low profile,” said Meng Chuan. “This is because I will kill more underground demon monarchs. The demons will be more anxious, and they’ll use any means to discover my identity.”
Liu Qiyue nodded and smiled. “I’ll prepare some food for you.”
“Alright, I haven’t eaten a single bite in the past three months. I’ve long been craving for some food,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
After a sumptuous meal, the couple chatted for an hour.
“Are you going out today?” asked Liu Qiyue.
“It’s already past noon,” said Meng Chuan. “I’ll head out to hunt for six hours before returning.”
“Be careful,” instructed Liu Qiyue. “Don’t worry.” Meng Chuan smiled and disappeared in a second.
When wearing the Mask of Illusion, Meng Chuan’s hair was white. He rode the Bloodblade Disc underground as he hunted down demon monarchs.
Swoosh.
A beam of light traveled underground.
With the Bloodblade Disc, the soil and rocks had a lower impact on Meng Chuan’s speed. The impact on his speed was almost negligible. In fact, it was the world’s suppression that affected his speed the most. Meng Chuan maintained a speed of 55 kilometers per flash underground. He could travel from the Great Zhou Dynasty’s south to the north in less than 300 seconds; he could do the same from east to west.
After scanning one area over and over again, he conducted a blanket search on 95% of the land at the same depth.
Once Meng Chuan discovered a demon lair within 1.5 kilometers of him, his Quintessential Essence threads easily killed any third Firmament demon monarch within his Seamless domain.
He carried out his underground reconnaissance non-stop. Although the demon monarch lairs were located at different depths underground, there were plenty of demon monarchs to be found. He finished six hours of reconnaissance. I killed 433 demon monarchs. Meng Chuan flew out from the ground and looked down as he flew all the way to Jiang State Capital. Meng Chuan summed up his harvests as he traveled through the dark sky.
If I can kill so many in half of a day’s work, I should be able to kill 800 demon monarchs a day. Meng Chuan nodded inwardly. That should be about 200,000 to 300,000 demon monarchs a year. I’ll kill all the demon monarchs in the three dynasties in three to four years. It’s about what I expected. The Supremacies are right. The demons will definitely become anxious soon.

chapters.title: Chapter 352 - Spacetime Dominion Map
chapters.content:
Chapter 352 Spacetime Dominion Map
In a cave amidst the vast mountains.
A middle-aged sloppy man sat cross-legged. He placed a spear against a wall to his side. He had been cultivating for a long time with his eyes closed. Finally, he opened his eyes and walked to the cave entrance to look around.
His name was Mao Feng. He was a Great Solar Godfiend from Archean Mountain. He was in charge of patrolling the surrounding 150 kilometers. Of course, he also had two demon servants as part of his team.
Everything seems peaceful today. Mao Feng picked up the gourd from his waist and took a sip of alcohol carefully. He unwillingly stuffed the bottle stopper back. “I only have half of a gourd left out of the three gourds of alcohol I brought. I need to conserve it. It will take half a month for Earth Net’s brothers to deliver another supply.”
Huh? Mao Feng suddenly sensed something and took out his token. A spot lit up on the token.
Demon monarch. Mao Feng turned around and picked up his spear. He ignored his living essentials in the cave and jumped out of the mountain cave. He descended from a quarter-kilometer height before rushing through the mountain forest.
Elsewhere, an armored ape demon servant took out its token and quickly rushed towards an unknown location.
Whoosh. A cyan-feathered bird spread its wings and flew towards its target.
A Patroller Godfiend and two demon servants were in charge of this region. They supported each other to reduce casualties.
Moments later, an elephant demon monarch’s corpse laid on the ground. A bloody hole had been pierced through its head. Mao Feng sat on the elephant demon monarch’s massive corpse and took a sip of alcohol happily. He looked at the cyan-clothed female avian demon monarch beside him and said with a smile, “Beauty Qing, you are really afraid of death. You discovered this elephant demon monarch ahead of time, but you didn’t dare to attack.” The cyan-clothed demoness snorted. “This is a third Firmament elephant demon. An elephant demon has immense strength and thick hide. I’m just an ordinary third Firmament bird. If I were to fight it head-on, I’m afraid it would have torn me to pieces long ago. I circled high in the sky and deliberately attracted its attention. I made it kill fewer people. Without me, I’m afraid dozens of people would have died.”
“Sister Qing, you are sharp with your words. It looks like battles still require Trispear Mao and me,” said an ape demon servant with a smile. “Thankfully, we came quickly this time. If we let it continue, it would have stormed into the village that houses hundreds of people ahead. Hundreds would have died. Trispear Mao, your spear arts are getting stronger.”
Mao Feng smiled. He repeatedly engaged in life-and-death battles due to his life as a Patroller. Due to this, his spear art improved quickly.
“Alright, disperse. Continue patrolling,” said Mao Feng.
“Disperse!” The cyan-robed demon servant and ape demon servant nodded.
Only by splitting up could they find demon monarchs faster. Just as they split up and rushed in different directions, ripples appeared in the void. A gray figure suddenly pounced towards Mao Feng.
Not good. Mao Feng instinctively swung his spear, stirring up a huge gust of wind. A large number of wind blades swept through the area. With a loud bang, a powerful, deep force passed through the spear. He felt blood rush into his mouth as his body was sent flying involuntarily. His palm was numb; blood from his ruptured palm dyed the spear shaft red.
The difference in strength is too great. Request for help. Mao Feng knew the difference in strength. It’s suspected to be a weak fourth Firmament demon monarch.
“Trispear Mao.” Upon seeing this scene, the ape demon servant immediately rushed over anxiously. The cyan-feathered bird in the sky immediately spread its wings and returned.
The blurry gray figure instantly closed in and attacked Mao Feng again.
Boom!
A red glow appeared on Mao Feng’s body. He used a forbidden Godfiend spell as he delivered an attack, fending for his life. At the same time, he shouted angrily through a voice transmission, “This demon monarch’s strength is several times greater than mine. You will be sending yourselves to your deaths if you come. Hurry up and leave.”
Bam! The spear was easily blocked.
A claw shadow struck the red glow around Mao Feng’s body. The red light trembled as it resisted the claw attack.
“A protective treasure? How long can it last? Nine seconds, fifteen seconds?” A hoarse voice sounded in Mao Feng’s ears. The gray figure rapidly attacked, and Mao Feng’s spear art was countered time and time again. Although he had the strength of a peak Great Solar Godfiend, he felt despair when he encountered a third Firmament demon monarch that was comparable to a Marquis Godfiend.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Mao Feng tried his best to execute his spear art. Even though his attacks were countered over and over again, he continued to stall for time.
The red glow around his body dulled.
Swoosh.
A beam of light flashed across the distant horizon; it was like sunlight. In a flash, it pierced through the gray figure’s head. The gray figure stopped in its tracks and revealed its appearance. It was a gray-fur leopard demon monarch; it had fur all over its face. Its eyes were filled with ferocity as its body disintegrated with a whoosh. It turned into dust that dispersed.
Mao Feng stared blankly at this scene.
“I’ll leave the demon monarch’s items to you.” A voice sounded in his ears. Mao Feng immediately turned his head and saw a midair figure standing in the distance. He nodded slightly at him before disappearing.
“A reinforcement Godfiend.” Mao Feng was overjoyed. He bowed respectfully and said loudly, “Thank you, Senior.”
“So fast? It’s only been six seconds, and a reinforcement Godfiend arrived?” The avian demon monarch landed, astonished.
“Perhaps he happened to pass by.” Mao Feng smiled. He looked at the ground beside him. The leopard demon monarch didn’t leave behind a corpse, but its treasures remained intact. “The senior showed pity on me. He gave me all the third Firmament demon monarchs’ items.”
Mao Feng immediately checked his spoils of war happily. “A storage bag?” Mao Feng revealed a look of delight. “This is great. I can bring more alcohol with me.”
Cough. In his excitement, Mao Feng couldn’t help but cough out blood.
“You were almost killed just now. I’ll bring you back to the city to recuperate,” said the cyan-feathered bird immediately.
Meng Chuan was indeed fast when it came to reinforcing others. Although he had been nearly 500 kilometers away from Mao Feng when the battle had started, he had arrived 50 kilometers away in just six seconds by using the Bloodblade Disc. To prevent any accidents, he released one Bloodblade from afar, which killed the leopard demon monarch. Meng Chuan hadn’t been confident that he could kill the rather powerful leopard demon monarch with Quintessential Essence threads from 50 kilometers away.
He destroyed the demon monarch’s corpse to wipe out any traces of how it died. The wound made by the Bloodblade would attract the attention of others. Thus, it was naturally better to destroy the corpse.
Patrolling Godfiends live out in the wilderness. Every demon monarch they kill might result in an ambush by cunning demon monarchs. Meng Chuan sighed inwardly. This world required patrolling Godfiends since a large number of demon monarchs hunted mortals all over the world, and he couldn’t be everywhere at once. Humanity could only rely on a large number of patrolling Godfiends to hunt the demons. In fact, one patrolling Godfiend and two demon servants were usually enough to deal with second Firmament demon monarchs and most third Firmament demon monarchs.
Only when the occasional powerful demon monarch appeared would they need help.
Many times, Meng Chuan arrived too late to save them. For example, Mao Feng only had 15 seconds before he was killed. Although Archean Mountain gave every Patroller Godfiend a life-saving treasure, Archean Mountain couldn’t afford to give them the best. After all, there were just too many patrolling Godfiends.
However, Meng Chuan was now extremely fast. Almost every request for help within 2,500 kilometers of Meng Chuan was assigned to him.
Deep in the sea, inside a small grotto-heaven.
Demon Sage Nine Abyss and four other demon sages gathered here. There were two additional figures. They were Demon Sage Deep Profundity and Demon Sage Fire Dragon; they had just infiltrated the human world. Of course, these two were only fourth Firmament demon monarchs now.
“Deep Profundity, Fire Dragon, both of you have joined us,” said Yellow Oscillate with a smile.
“We’ve been here for more than half a year. You’ve been out traveling the entire time, searching for world membrane connection points. You only came back after Nine Abyss summoned you,” said Fire Dragon with a chuckle.
“More and more demon sages have come to the human world,” said Yellow Oscillate with a chuckle. “All of them have confidence that we will win the war.”
“As long as we win the war, we will at least be able to obtain a Spacetime Dominion Map,” said Deep Profundity. “The River of Spacetime is vast and boundless. If we blindly enter, we might end up getting lost or accidentally entering a perilous zone. We might even offend some powerful existences. However, Spacetime Dominion Maps have always been controlled by the Imperial Lords.”
“Yes.” The four demon sages nodded.
They wanted to travel the River of Spacetime, but if they went blindly, it was extremely lightly they would die. With a Spacetime Dominion Map, their journeys in the River of Spacetime would be much safer.

chapters.title: Chapter 353 - Three Terminal Formation
chapters.content:
Chapter 353 Three Terminal Formation
“The three Imperial Lords joined forces to use a carrot and stick approach. What can we do? We can only obey their orders,” said Demon Sage Fire Dragon as he shook his head.
Patriarch Yellow Oscillate smiled and said, “I hope we can defeat the humans as soon as possible.”
“These humans are stupid. The difference in strength is clearly great. A World Gap has formed between the two worlds; they are destined to lose. Why are they still struggling? Isn’t it better to surrender early? The Imperial Lords have long promised to give a small piece of land to the humans. The human race won’t be wiped out. At the very least, the Godfiends will survive,” said Demon Sage Deep Profundity. “However, these humans insist on fighting us. Not only are the Creation Supremacies stubborn, but even the weaker Godfiends are lunatics. One Patroller Godfiend after another dies in battle. I have no idea what’s the point when they are dead.”
“This is humanity,” said Demon Sage Nine Abyss softly. “After staying in the human world for a long time, you will realize that the human world is completely different from our Demon Realm.”
“Completely different?” Fire Dragon and Deep Profundity were puzzled.
“We demons were born to fight each other in the mountains. The strong preyed on the weak. It’s only natural for us to submit to the strong,” commented Demon Sage Nine Abyss “Humans are different. They value their so-called family ties and love. They are willing to sacrifice everything for their loved ones. They do righteous things even during life-and-death situations. For the so-called blind love and illusory righteousness, they are willing to die in battle one after another.”
The black-robed North Sense nodded as well. “Humans are indeed different from us demons.”
“What a foolish species.” Deep Profundity shook his head. Ever since he was born, he had been used to the law of the jungle. He was used to fighting and killing. It was indeed very difficult for him to understand the human race. Demon Sage Nine Abyss and Demon Sage North Sense had infiltrated the human world for over a century before they gradually understood the culture of the human world—a different kind of charm that was unique to the human world.
“Nine Abyss, what’s the important reason for gathering us?” asked Yellow Oscillate.
The other three demon sages looked at Demon Sage Nine Abyss.
Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s expression turned solemn as he flipped his hand and handed a dossier to Patriarch Yellow Oscillate. “Take a look.”
The hall fell silent.
“In a month, 25,000 underground demon monarchs were killed in the Great Zhou Dynasty?” Yellow Oscillate frowned. “If this continues, won’t 300,000 demon monarchs die in a year?”
“It’s still that mysterious Godfiend from Archean Mountain?” Deep Profundity and Fire Dragon had heard of him before. There were two humans extremely skilled at underground reconnaissance. One was King White Treasure from Black Sand Grotto-Heaven, while the other was an Archean Mountain Godfiends-whose identity remained unknown.
“Yes, the situation is very grim. His underground reconnaissance ability is extremely powerful. I estimate that in three to four years, he alone will be able to sweep clean the entire human world of demon monarchs,” said Demon Sage Nine Abyss solemnly. “If demon monarchs hide aboveground, it’ll be extremely easy for powerful Godfiends to locate them when they search a 50-kilometer radius with a thought. Only by hiding at different depths underground can they survive. With the earth suppressing the probing methods, they’ll be able to hide from the humans. However, with our current casualty count... it’s estimated that all underground demon monarchs will be wiped out.”
“Without the threat of a million demon monarchs, we won’t be able to threaten humans,” said Fire Dragon. “It will take us more than a century to return to the demon sage realm.”
“Therefore, we have to deal with this mysterious Godfiend.” Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s voice was cold. “It’s fine that our previous assassination on King White Treasure failed. King White Treasure kills tens of thousands of demon monarchs a year, but that doesn’t affect the overall war situation. However, this mysterious Archean Mountain Godfiend has to be killed! He has to be killed at all costs.”
“Yes.” Everyone present nodded solemnly.
“I estimate that the Great Zhou Dynasty will be swept clean in a few more months. He will likely head to the Great Yue Dynasty and the Black Sand Dynasty,” said Demon Sage Nine Abyss. “More than half of the one million demon monarchs are hiding in the Great Yue Dynasty’s underground.”
“We have to find out who he is,” said Patriarch Yellow Oscillate with a nod.
“I’ve already tried my best, but I can’t find anything,” said the black-robed North Sense. “The best method to find this Godfiend’s identity is for Demon Sage Thousand Cricket to possess someone and enter the human world.”
“We have to convince Demon Sage Thousand Cricket first. Next, he has to find a suitable body for possession. That will take at least a year or two,” said Demon Sage Nine Abyss. “If we let the mysterious Godfiend continue his rampage, in another two years... there won’t be many demon monarchs left in the human world. I estimate that after killing half of them, the remaining demon monarchs will flee back to the Demon Realm in fright.”
Deep Profundity shook his head. “It’s too difficult to figure out his identity immediately. It can only be done if the Imperial Lords use treasures to pry into the heavenly secrets and determine the identity of this mysterious Godfiend. However, the price of doing such a thing across a world is so great that the Imperial Lords wouldn’t be willing to do so, even if a few demon sages die.”
The black-robed North Sense nodded as well. “The more difficult it is to pry into the heavenly secrets, the greater the backlash.”
“Didn’t you say that the Great Zhou Dynasty’s underground will be swept clean in just a few months?” Fire Dragon’s eyes lit up.
“That’s right. In just a few months, only a few underground demon monarchs will be left in the Great Zhou Dynasty,” said Demon Sage Nine Abyss.
“Then wouldn’t it be fine if we directly set up a trap in the Great Zhou Dynasty?” Fire Dragon’s voice echoed in the hall. “Let’s see which demon monarchs are still alive. Let’s set up a trap that spans 10 to 15 kilometers in a rather densely-packed underground area. We’ll camp there and wait for the Godfiend to come. As long as the Godfiend continues their large-scale underground reconnaissance, they will definitely pass by our trap within the next few months. Once they fall into the trap, we can kill the Godfiend in one fell swoop.”
The other four demon sages’ eyes lit up.
That’s right. We should wait for that Godfiend to enter our trap!
Demon Sage Nine Abyss was somewhat excited. “If we are lucky with the 10 to 15-kilometer wide trap, we might encounter that mysterious Godfiend in a month.”
“We can’t wait there for years. It’s easy for accidents to happen if we wait too long. However, we can still give it a try in a month or two.” Patriarch Yellow Oscillate was also looking forward to it. “However, this trap will depend on the Imperial Lords. We failed to deal with King White Treasure last time. This mysterious Godfiend’s defensive treasure must be very powerful. For example, King Calm Sea has Scarlet Cloud Heaven to protect him. This mysterious Godfiend is extremely important to humans, so his defensive treasure will definitely be stronger.”
“Yes.” Demon Sage Nine Abyss nodded. “King White Treasure’s effect on the war situation isn’t great, but the Imperial Lords will definitely pay the price for this mysterious Godfiend. I’ll report it to the Imperial Lords later.”
....
In a dark chamber.
The chamber was carved with dense runes. In the middle of the chamber was a pool.
Boom!
Demon Sage Nine Abyss stood in the chamber as he used his demonic powers to activate the runes. All the runes in the chamber lit up with silver light. A scene gradually appeared in the middle of the pool.“What’s the matter?” The black-haired, single-horned Imperial Lord Starquix appeared in the water.
“Imperial Lord.” Demon Sage Nine Abyss reported the matter in detail.
“Oh?” Imperial Lord Starquix asked, “Are you sure it’s not a Creation Supremacy? For the time being, we can’t kill Creation Supremacies in the human world when they use treasures.”
“It’s impossible for that person to be a Creation Supremacy. This is an Archean Mountain Godfiend. There are three Archean Mountain Supremacies. Luo Tang and Qin Wu are guarding the city passes. Li Guan is also guarding Archean Mountain. Only his Essence Soul avatar is roaming outside. His Essence Soul avatar can only use Essence Soul mystic techniques. It’s impossible for him to be good at underground reconnaissance,” said Demon Sage Nine Abyss confidently. “There are a total of nine Creation Supremacies in the human world. Most of them are guarding various important places. Only two or three can move freely. We have eliminated all other possibilities.”
Demon Sage Nine Abyss continued, “We believe that it’s a Regis Godfiend. In addition, many of the humans’ strongest Regis Godfiends are in the World Gap. This way, we can eliminate several other possibilities. This mysterious Godfiend might not be that strong.”
In the pool, Imperial Lord Starquix nodded gently. After a moment of silence, he said, “I’ve just spoken to Lady Blackmoon and Emperor Roc. This mysterious Godfiend indeed poses a great threat. In that case, we will send the Three Terminal Formation to the human world and tell you the method to set it up. You will use the Three Terminal Formation to kill that mysterious Godfiend. Remember, after killing that Godfiend, dismantle the Three Terminal Formation and send it back.”
The Three Terminal Formation was an important treasure of the demons.
“Yes.” Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s eyes lit up. “I will definitely send it back intact.”

chapters.title: Chapter 354 - Emergency Rescue
chapters.content:
Chapter 354 Emergency Rescue
Jiang State Capital, in a chamber.
Meng Chuan levitated in midair as he sat in a lotus position. Eighteen Bloodblades swirled around him.
The Bloodblade Disc’s runic array formation provides flight and defensive capabilities. In terms of defense, even the superficial runes have the profundity of the Nine Heavenly Forms of the Void, Lightning Domain Form, and Yin-Yang Form of Lightning.
Although he had become a Regis Godfiend, Meng Chuan realized that he was still very weak after learning some secrets. He had yet to reach the requirements needed to travel the River of Spacetime.
In the day, he would carry out underground reconnaissance and hunt demon monarchs. At night, apart from painting, he would focus on his cultivation. Most of his cultivation time was now used to comprehend the Bloodblade Disc’s profundities!
The Bloodblade Disc was his master! It allowed Meng Chuan to understand all sorts of ingenious combination techniques. For example, the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique mainly consisted of the Nine Heavenly Forms of the Void, Roving Dragon Form of Lightning, and Yin-Yang Form of Lightning. After recently comprehending some of the profundities contained within the Bloodblade Disc, Meng Chuan had gained more insights into the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique. It was getting closer and closer to the Dharma Domain realm. He felt like he could break through at any moment.
Whoosh.
With a thought
The 18 Bloodblades flew back to the Bloodblade Disc. The Bloodblade Disc landed in Meng Chuan’s palm as he walked out of the chamber. The sky was already bright.
“Ah Chuan.” Liu Qiyue smiled as she sat at the dining table. “I just bought some meat buns and steamed buns.”
“Oh, it smells good.” Meng Chuan picked up a meat bun and ate half of it in one bite. His mouth was filled with oil. Although he didn’t need to eat or drink, he still ate breakfast and dinner with his wife every day. The couple cherished their time together. Furthermore, Meng Chuan enjoyed the satisfaction brought by the food. Though they could arrange for demon servants to prepare the food, Liu Qiyue would always meticulously prepare it for him.
After eating three meat buns, three large steamed buns, and a bowl of porridge, Meng Chuan stood up.
“It’s time for me to leave.” Meng Chuan stood up. Liu Qiyue also stood up as she sent him off.
Although the days were a little monotonous, the couple cherished these peaceful days very much.
Meng Chuan smiled as he bade his wife farewell. He continued his underground reconnaissance for the entire day.
Swoosh.
A beam of light traveled through the Great Zhou Dynasty’s underground as it searched the area.
After an hour of underground reconnaissance, Meng Chuan’s expression suddenly changed. He felt his token burn his arm. His Seamless domain could clearly see the blood-red spot on the map—which was imprinted on the token’s surface. A fifth Firmament threat in Yushang City? Meng Chuan’s heart tightened.
Marquis Godfiends guarding a city would occasionally be ambushed when dealing with ordinary demon monarch attacks. If a fourth Firmament demon monarch team attacked, the threat would be slightly lower, but Marquis Godfiends would still die. After all, it was a one-against-many battle. If a fifth Firmament demon monarch attacked, it was even more likely for Marquis Godfiends to die.
Swoosh.
Without any hesitation, Meng Chuan stepped on the Bloodblade Disc and transformed into a beam of light. He instantly rushed out of the ground and flew towards the northwest at high speed.
Yushang City was located in the middle of the Great Zhou Dynasty.
Three Marquis Godfiends guarded the city. Of course, there were also iron stone beasts and poison bugs that aided them in the defense.
Roar!
“Die!”
“Kill the humans.”
At that moment, many ordinary demon monarchs were attacking the city. Third Firmament demon monarchs rushed over from all directions.
In the city, the strongest Marquis GodfiendMarchioness Mooncherish-was pale. She had a black-and-white Two World domain around her. She held a sword with one hand as she struggled to deal with a black-armored demon monarch that wielded a black trident.
Although Marchioness Mooncherish was over 200 years old, she still looked beautiful. She cultivated the Two World Divine Body, and her sword art was a Black Metal SutraDuality Sword Art. Every strike carried Yin and Yang. The sword traveled between Yin and Yang, making it seem like the world was isolated. The Duality Sword Art was extremely good at defense; it was especially strong when it came to killing enemies. It was a technique that perfectly matched the Two World Divine Body.
But when the difference in strength between two parties was large enough, it was useless no matter how exquisite the sword art was.
Boom! The two weapons collided. Even though Marchioness Mooncherish tried her best to deflect the force, she was still sent flying backward. Blood rose from her throat, causing her to taste it. Her right arm trembled, but she ultimately managed to block another strike.
The violent shockwaves from the battle spread out in all directions. The nearby buildings and trees had long been reduced to dust. Marchioness Mooncherish did her best to suppress the shockwaves with her Two World Domain, causing the battle’s shockwaves to only affect an area of hundreds of feet. If she hadn’t, the shockwaves would’ve caused much more destruction. Many people in the surrounding residences fled frantically.
“You blocked three strikes in a row?” The black-armored, horned demon monarch shook his head before two golden beams of light suddenly shot out from his eyes. They instantly flew towards Marchioness Mooncherish.
Marchioness Mooncherish immediately sealed her surroundings with her sword in a bid to block the golden light. However, the two golden light beams continued to pierce through her barrier, illuminating Marchioness Mooncherish.
Marchioness Mooncherish’s body turned numb. Not good. Marchioness Mooncherish couldn’t care less about her numb body. She had long used a forbidden spell. She quickly used all her Quintessential Essence to charge underground.
Boom! The black-armored demon monarch chased after her at a much faster speed. His eyes were filled with ferocity. “You won’t be able to escape.”
“Senior Sister.” The other two Marquis Godfiends watched from afar. Their eyes were filled with anger, but they didn’t have time to help her. Furthermore, their strength was inferior to that of Marquis Cherishmoon.
“Yushang City has a fifth Firmament threat. They have requested help many times. The situation is critical.”
In a large hall on Archean Mountain, a huge map of the human world was on the walls. On the map of the Great Zhou Dynasty, 16 cities were currently lit.
Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang sat above the hall as they looked down.
Some people were staring at the map as well. “Supremacy, the situation in Yushang City is critical,” said an elder in charge of monitoring anxiously. “Marchioness Mooncherish has sent out a life-and-death help request. She might lose her life at any moment.”
“Got it,” said Li Guan.
“What can we do?” Luo Tang sent a voice transmission. “We’ve already sent Meng Chuan over. Meng Chuan was about 1,500 kilometers away from Yushang City. I wonder if he’ll make it in time.”
“He will be able to reach the city the fastest,” said Li Guan via voice transmission. “Marchioness Mooncherish’s fate... will depend on the heavens.”
Qin Wu looked down and sent a voice transmission. “When sect disciples encounter life-and-death situations, all we can do is watch. I still remember the scene when that lass Xiyue just came up the mountain. I hope she can survive.”
“She will,” Luo Tang consoled. “Meng Chuan will definitely save her.”
Clang!
The sword in Marchioness Mooncherish’s hand was sent flying by the terrifying impact. It flew like a stream of light, indicating how powerful the impact was. Marchioness Mooncherish’s right hand was covered in blood. She could no longer hold her sword.
She also had a bloody wound on her abdomen. The black-armored demon monarch had used a divine power, and he had nearly split Marchioness Mooncherish into two. It was only thanks to her impressive sword art and powerful Two World domain that she survived the attack. Half of her waist had been sliced through, but she tried her best to close the wound.
I can’t hold on any longer. After her sword was sent flying, despair rose in Marchioness Mooncherish’s heart. Without her sword, she lost most of her strength. She was unable to withstand the fifth Firmament demon monarch’s attacks any longer.
“Die!” The black-armored demon monarch was overjoyed. He waved his black trident and transformed into a black gust of wind, wanting to reduce Marchioness Mooncherish into a meat paste.
The black-armored demon monarch felt that everything was under control up to this point. Killing her took a little more time than expected. Whatever, I’ll leave immediately after killing her. It’s safest to leave within 30 seconds.
According to the intelligence gathered by the demons, demon monarchs would be absolutely safe if they retreated within 30 seconds of starting an attack. This was because a large city was about 500 kilometers away from each other. Even if a Godfiend came from the nearest city, it would take them at least 30 seconds to arrive. In fact, only a few Godfiends in the Great Zhou Dynasty were qualified to carry out rescues. They would typically arrive from thousands of kilometers away. It was usually very safe if they finished an ambush and fled within 60 seconds.
They were already being extremely cautious by escaping within 30 seconds of attacking.
I’m doomed. Facing the terrifying black trident, Marchioness Mooncherish knew that her death was certain, but she still used her palm arts in an attempt to block.
Ever since she left the mountain, she had been fighting. The thoughtless, simple-minded girl on the mountain gradually grew amidst blood and fire and became a Marquis Godfiend. She became stronger, but the war became more and more tragic. She wanted to protect more people because she enjoyed hearing the laughter of others.
I can’t protect all of you anymore, thought Marchioness Mooncherish silently.
Boom!
Suddenly, a powerful, violent aura erupted from afar.
Marchioness Mooncherish looked into the distance with a hint of desire and hope.
It was the aura of a Regis Godfiend. However, it was 50 kilometers away.
It’s too late, thought Marchioness Mooncherish silently.
A blurry figure appeared 50 kilometers away.Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft!
Many demon monarchs that were rushing towards the city collapsed like harvested wheat. Their heads were penetrated by Quintessential Essence threads.
The Godfiend is 50 kilometers away? The black-armored demon monarch didn’t panic at all. You are too late. Just as the black-armored demon monarch had this thought, he sensed a beam of light approaching him.
It moved way too fast, much faster than the black-armored demon monarch’s trident. The beam of light appeared in front of the black-armored demon monarch.
With a bang, the black trident in the demon monarch’s hand was sent flying. It was a blur as it flew into the distance.
“No,” The black-armored demon monarch revealed a look of horror. He sensed that when the first beam of light had sent his weapon flying, the second beam had arrived in front of him. He didn’t even have time to move.
Pfft.
His Essence Soul sensed the attack, but his body failed to react in time. A beam of light had pierced through his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 355 - Thirteen Swordbanes?
chapters.content:
Chapter 355 Thirteen Swordbanes?
Meng Chuan had carried out many rescues over the years. He had been too late many times. Once, he had arrived 50 kilometers away from Xue Feng, only to see him being killed by Patriarch Yellow Oscillate. He also once arrived to see Marquis Purple Rain already dead. However, he had also saved many ordinary Godfiends, like Yan Jin’s Godfiend team. Many times, he would only see Godfiend corpses when he arrived—the demon monarchs having long fled.
Therefore, although he liked the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique more, he placed greater focus on the Infinite Saber because he pursued speed! With speed, he could save more people and kill more demon monarchs. Therefore when he could choose between the three Tribulation treasures, he didn’t hesitate to choose the Bloodblade Disc, despite the fact that Tribulation Eminences had used other two. They were Tribulation Eminences’ powerful offensive means for killing an enemy.
Although the Bloodblade Disc was only a protective treasure-refined by a Tribulation Eminence—for a disciple, it provided one with flight capabilities. It was one of the main reasons why he chose the Bloodblade Disc over the other two Tribulation treasures. It was because he knew that he could save more Godfiends if he was a little faster! By doing this, he would also indirectly save countless mortals.
When Meng Chuan stepped on the Bloodblade Disc, he could move 60 kilometers in a second! Speed was very important during emergency rescues.
Quick, quick, quick. Meng Chuan controlled the Bloodblade Disc with all his might.
Yushang City is up ahead. Meng Chuan rushed over at full speed. When he arrived outside the eastern city wall, he saw hundreds of third Firmament demon monarchs rushing towards the city. Poisonous bugs and Iron Stone Beasts blocked their approach. He also saw the fifth Firmament demon monarch-who had immense demonic power-swing his trident at Marchioness Mooncherish.
With a thought, Bloodblades flew out from the Bloodblade Disc beneath his feet.
Meng Chuan deliberately released his Godfiend aura to distract the fifth Firmament demon monarch as he simultaneously released a large number of Quintessential Essence threads in all directions. Outside the eastern city wall, Meng Chuan was just a few kilometers away from hundreds of demon monarchs.
Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft!
From near Meng Chuan to distant locations, many demon monarchs collapsed like harvested wheat.
The speed of a Bloodblade was comparable to his Quintessential Essence threads. It was virtually indistinguishable from a beam of light. The fifth Firmament demon monarch didn’t even notice it from afar. By the time he realized its proximity, he didn’t have time to react.
Bam!
The Bloodblade was as fast as light, and its might was extremely terrifying. If he were to unleash it wantonly, he could probably reduce an area of tens of kilometers to dust! Most of Meng Chuan’s power was completely concentrated in the tiny Bloodblades.
The first beam of light sent the black trident in the fifth Firmament demon monarch’s hand flying. It left afterimages in its wake.
The second light beam penetrated the fifth Firmament demon monarch’s head. However, a fifth Firmament demon monarch had an extremely strong body. Even if a fifth Firmament demon monarch’s head was destroyed, it wouldn’t die.
When the third beam struck the fifth Firmament demon monarch’s chest, the power contained within the Bloodblade exploded. The fifth Firmament demon monarch’s body completely exploded with a bang, blasting to smithereens. The fifth Firmament demon monarch’s body had shattered to an insane extent. Blood and scattered flesh flew all over the place. As a greater demon monarch that had just broken through to the fifth Firmament realm in recent years, he had lost all hope of survival.
Oh? There’s actually such a divine power? Meng Chuan was somewhat astonished when he saw a part of the fifth Firmament demon monarch’s tail fly towards the ground when its body exploded. The Bloodblade Disc had become Meng Chuan’s intrinsic treasure. It had placed many Essence Soul thoughts into it, and it was now a part of his Essence Soul. Thus, he could sense the surroundings of the Bloodblades.
Furthermore, he could sense that the demon monarch’s Essence Soul had been transferred to the tail.
He can detach and transform his tail into an avatar? With a thought, the fourth Bloodblade —which had transformed into a beam of light -instantly pierced the tail, shattering it completely.
The demon monarch’s Essence Soul, hiding in the tail, howled in despair and was completely annihilated.
Greater Demon Monarch Mo Yi died at Yushang City.
Marchioness Mooncherish watched as the black trident was sent flying. In the blink of an eye, the fifth Firmament demon monarch died instantly. I survived? Marchioness Mooncherish’s body trembled. This was an instinctual reaction. She had thought that she was going to die, but despite her despair, she remained alive? The fifth Firmament demon monarch was the one who died instead?
Marchioness Mooncherish looked into the distance.
From afar, a figure that emitted a cold baneful aura flew over. It moved at about five kilometers per flash. This was considered fast, much faster than King Calm Sea. Of course, Meng Chuan had already put away the Bloodblade Disc. Five kilometers in a second? Meng Chuan was already flying very slowly.
At that moment, the demon monarchs outside the four city walls had already fled. Apart from a portion of demon monarchs that died at the eastern city wall, most third Firmament demon monarchs had fled when they realized that the situation was dire.
Huh? Marchioness Mooncherish saw everything clearly. This reinforcement Godfiend wasn’t any Regis Godfiend she knew. He exuded a cold, oppressive baneful aura. He wore a mask, and his hair was already white. She had never seen him before.
This Regis Godfiend is so fast that he’s almost at the level of a Creation Supremacy. Furthermore, his hair is white, so he’s probably over 400 years old. He’s not a Godfiend that I know. Yes, he must be one of the ancient Godfiends that have awakened.
She naturally knew that in order to fend off the demons, Archean Mountain had awakened a group of ancient Godfiends. The other two sects were the same. The identities of these ancient Godfiends were kept a secret. It was a secret to even their own sect members so that it was difficult for the demons to find out more!
“Thank you for saving my life, Senior Brother.” Marchioness Mooncherish immediately bowed when Meng Chuan flew over.
As long as he was a Regis Godfiend, there was nothing wrong with addressing him as Senior Brother. Even if a Regis Godfiend from Black Sand Grotto-Heaven or Two World Island had saved her life, it was only right for her to address him respectfully as “senior brother.”
“I happened to pass by. That’s why I managed to arrive in time. You were lucky,” said Meng Chuan coldly. He waved his hand and put away the items left behind by the fifth Firmament demon monarch.
“Senior Brother...” Marchioness Mooncherish wanted to say something. She had almost died, so she was very grateful to this ancient Godfiend.
“I’m leaving,” said Meng Chuan calmly as he rapidly soared into the sky. With his Seamless domain’s concealment ability, he completely vanished.
Marchioness Mooncherish watched from afar, her heart trembling. She thought to herself, Those beams of light were terrifyingly fast. They can easily kill a fifth Firmament demon monarch from 50 kilometers away. Could it be the Thirteen Swordbanes?
Only the Thirteen Swordbanes could kill distant enemies extremely quickly. Swordbanes were not corporeal objects; this allowed them to be extremely fast. However, the Thirteen Swordbane Fiend Body was also deemed to be the strongest Godfiend body in one-on-one combat. In terms of killing enemies, it was superior to even Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s Samsara Divine Body.
Since he needed to keep his identity a secret, he naturally had to hide everything about him, even if they were friendlies! With the Mask of Illusion disguising his aura and appearance, Meng Chuan wasn’t worried that anyone would recognize him. He had the intention to disguise his Bloodblade Disc as the Thirteen Swordbanes. In the past, Meng Chuan was rather envious of the Thirteen Swordbane Fiend Body’s means. However, he didn’t think too much of it. Who would’ve thought that he would experience what using the Thirteen Swordbanes were like after obtaining a Tribulation Treasure?
The Bloodblades was as fast as lightning, and he could use them to attack from afar.
“Senior Sister.”
“Senior Sister, who’s that Regis Godfiend? I don’t think I’ve seen him before?” The other two Marquis Godfiends finally flew closer. One of them even delivered Marchioness Mooncherish’s sword to her.
“I haven’t seen him either. He should be an ancient Godfiend of Archean Mountain,” said Marchioness Mooncherish as she took the sword.
In a hall on Archean Mountain. Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang looked at the huge map on the wall of the hall. When the red spot at Yushang City turned into a colorful light, the three of them heaved a sigh of relief.
“They won.”“Great victory, great victory.” The other Godfiends in front of the palace wall were extremely excited. Only if the Godfiend that requested help survived the crisis would it turn into a green spot. A colorful light represented a great victory!
Li Guan and company didn’t lose their composure.
“Meng Chuan managed to reach the city in time,” said Luo Tang with a smile. “His speed is terrifying now. I knew he would definitely arrive in time.”
“Mooncherish survived as well.” Qin Wu revealed a happy smile.
Li Guan smiled and nodded.
Very few fifth Firmament demon monarchs came to the human world. Therefore, Demon Sage Nine Abyss paid lots of attention to any fifth Firmament demon monarch that died in battle.
Deep in the sea, inside a small grotto-heaven.
“The Godfiend that killed Greater Demon Monarch Mo Yi is suspected to be a Regis Godfiend that cultivates the Thirteen Swordbane Fiend Body?” Demon Sage Nine Abyss read through the dossier and before looking up at the black-robed North Sense.

chapters.title: Chapter 356 - Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 356 Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique
“Back then, many third Firmament demon monarchs saw that the reinforcement Godfiend appeared 50 kilometers away from Demon Monarch Mo Yi outside Yushang City,” said the black-robed North Sense. “He attacked from over 50 kilometers away, but Demon Monarch Mo Yi failed to dodge in time. The attacks were clearly swift. This is very similar to the Thirteen Swordbanes.
“According to the Skydemon Sect’s intelligence and the information I obtained from Archean Mountain Godfiends, there’s a 90% chance that he’s a Regis Godfiend with the Thirteen Swordbane Fiend Body. Other possibilities take up the final ten percent. As for who he is? We don’t know. We can only guess that he’s an ancient Godfiend that has awakened,” said the black-robed North Sense.
Demon Sage Nine Abyss nodded gently after reading the dossier. “This Godfiend is extremely powerful. He might be a peak Thirteen Swordbane Fiend Body Regis Godfiend. He might have the strength of a weak Creation realm expert. Put more effort into collecting information about him.”
The black-robed North Sense nodded.
Demons found many Godfiends difficult to deal with. King True Martial, King Transcendence, and other Regis Godfiends already had the strength of a weak Creation realm expert. There were even more if one included the ancient Regis Godfiend that had awakened. In addition, there were nine Creation Supremacies! Bai Yaoyue, Qin Wu, and Li Guan were especially terrifying. Bai Yaoyue cultivated the mysterious Grand Yin cultivation system that came from the outer realm. Qin Wu was a Creation Supremacy that cultivated the Thirteen Swordbane Fiend Body. Furthermore, back when Qin Wu was a Regis Godfiend, he could fight experts that were one cultivation realm above him. Li Guan cultivated Archean Mountain’s core ultimate technique.
The demons were afraid of many human experts. They were long used to it. An additional person was only a passing remark in their dossiers. This was because the difference in strength between the top powers was huge.
Demon Sage Nine Abyss had always been careful! Unless necessary, he never took any risk.
After all, even in the Demon Realm, he was only average among the many demon sages. He couldn’t even enter the top ten. He didn’t have the confidence to deal with the top Creation Supremacies.
“By the way, the Imperial Lords delivered the Three Terminal Formation a few days ago. Any progress on studying it over the past few days? When can you set up the trap?” asked Demon Sage Nine Abyss. He would not participate in the ambush. He was a cornerstone of the demons in the human world! He had to deploy a large number of fourth and fifth Firmament demon monarchs. It was impossible for him to wait for a few months...
If the humans discovered him, and Demon Sage Nine Abyss ended up dead, it would be much more troublesome for the demons to make future arrangements.
“The Three Terminal Formation is too complicated. We still need half a month,” said the black-robed North Sense.
“Lay the ambush in the Great Zhou Dynasty as soon as possible,” said Demon Sage Nine Abyss. “Demon monarchs are being slaughtered every day. Many sharp demon monarchs have moved to the other dynasties.”
“Don’t worry. We’ve already made sufficient preparations. Nine Abyss, you know the details of the plan. As long as we discover that mysterious Godfiend, he’s dead,” said the black-robed North Sense.
Demon Sage Nine Abyss nodded slightly. “Yellow Oscillate has the strength of a newly-advanced Creation realm expert. With you and Longswim working together, it’s almost impossible for a Regis Godfiend to survive the might of the Three Terminal Formation. However, the human race has an extremely rich heritage. After all, it’s Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s homeworld. I’m afraid he might have left the humans some unknown life-preservation means.”
“Therefore, we will also keep our final trump card up our sleeve,” said the black-robed North Sense.
“Let’s hope we don’t have to use it.” Demon Sage Nine Abyss nodded. “If we do use it, the price we pay will be even greater.” “As long as we can kill him, it will be worth it. If we report this plan to the Imperial Lords, the Imperial Lords will agree to it,” said the black-robed North Sense.
After successfully saving Marchioness Mooncherish, Meng Chuan enjoyed a good mood for the next few days.
The crescent moon hung in the sky like a hook. The summer night was rather cool. Under the moonlight, Meng Chuan transformed into an illusory figure. He used his movement technique to his heart’s content. His movement technique was dreamlike. He would occasionally appear right in front of something, and at other times, he would leave behind illusory shadows.
Every night, Meng Chuan would focus on cultivating the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique. This movement technique really made Meng Chuan feel like he was painting. Meng Chuan was intoxicated by the unrestrained and carefree feeling.
Some were reserved, some were unrestrained, some were close, some were far away...
His body was a brush that wandered the void.
Occasionally, Meng Chuan would teleport half a kilometer away. This short-distance teleportation didn’t mean much to Meng Chuan. After all, powerful Godfiends could instantly kill things within a few kilometers of them. His movement technique was even faster than teleportation! It took time to teleport from one spot to another. In a flash, he could teleport three times.
Huh? Meng Chuan, who was cultivating his movement technique, suddenly felt inspired. Nine Meng Chuans appeared in the world at the same time. These nine Meng Chuans seemed real, but they were all fake.
He had long reached the peak of the Realm of Dao with the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique. He had even laid out the foundation of his self-created movement technique. In addition, he had gained more insight into the Nine Heavenly Forms of the Void and Yin-Yang Form of Lightning.
On this summer night, Meng Chuan’s Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique had reached the Dharma Domain realm.
This feeling is amazing. Meng Chuan was somewhat intoxicated as he used his movement technique to travel through a void fluctuation. King True Martial once said that spacetime is like a thousand-layered cake.
I’m currently traveling through one layer of the thousand-layered cake? My true body is moving through this special void fluctuation while nine embodiments are reflected in the normal spacetime? Meng Chuan came to a realization. When I move through this layer, the nine embodiments in the outside world will also move. I can choose to appear at any of my embodiments’ locations.
The embodiments aren’t my true body. However, as long as I’m willing, any embodiment can become the true body. Meng Chuan was filled with joy. He was naturally happy that he had succeeded in his cultivation.
The Infinite Saber pursued extreme speed; its movement technique was simply a beam of light. It was terrifyingly fast.
The Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique was a movement technique and a saber technique. This movement technique was slightly slower than that of the Infinite Saber—he could only move 25 kilometers in a second, but it was more unpredictable and had more variations. He could enter deeper void layers with this movement technique.
According to the introduction of the World Roving Dragon Saber, one would have three embodiments when they reached the Dharma Domain realm. The Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique fused with Yin-Yang Form of Lightning’s essence on top of its original foundation. With many Yin-Yang transformations occurring, I can produce nine embodiments at once.
The Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique makes up for my weakness. It’s much stronger in a head-on battle.Although I was pretty fast previously, my movements didn’t vary much. It’s naturally easy to kill a fifth Firmament demon monarch like Mo Yi.However, if I were to encounter someone that similarly had the strength of a Creation realm expert, my flaws would be exposed if I don’t rely on my treasures or cultivation realm.
With too few variations in his movements, it would be very easy for the other party to see through his moves. But now, his movements had countless variations.
With the myriad variations, I can hide in the depths of the void. Meng Chuan smiled. I have to consolidate my insights as soon as possible and create the corresponding Cloud Dragon Snake Saber Art.
His movement technique and saber art were one, so the creation of his saber art naturally didn’t take long
Meng Chuan practiced happily. By dawn, he had already deduced more than half of the Cloud Dragon Snake Saber Art. He would complete it in a few days.
Oh? Meng Chuan suddenly looked up.
An avian demon monarch flew over from afar.With a thought, Meng Chuan used the Mask of Illusion to change his aura, disguising himself with a Marquis Godfiend’s aura. Normally, he would release his Seamless domain. Nobody in the vicinity could see Meng Chuan and his wife.
Swoosh.
The avian demon monarch had to fly very close before seeing Meng Chuan.
“Marquis Eastcalm, your letter.” The avian demon monarch threw the letter and left.
Meng Chuan sat down on a stone bench and looked at the envelope. He was somewhat surprised. A letter from Dad?
He and Qiyue lived in Jiang State Capital. His father, Meng Dajiang, was also in Jiang State Capital. However, in order to keep their locations a secret, Meng Dajiang didn’t know where the couple was. He wrote letters and had Archean Mountain send them. There was no other choice. This was how it was during wartime.
“Ah Chuan, what’s the letter from Archean Mountain about?” asked Liu Qiyue when she saw Meng Chuan opening the envelope.
“It’s from Dad,” said Meng Chuan as he unfolded the letter.

chapters.title: Chapter 357 - Way of Life
chapters.content:
Chapter 357 Way of Life
Meng Chuan’s expression gradually turned solemn as he read the letter.
“Ah Chuan, what did Dad say in the letter?” asked Liu Qiyue.
Meng Chuan silently handed the letter to his wife. Liu Qiyue received the letter in puzzlement. Her expression couldn’t help but change after reading it. “Dad has broken through to the Great Solar realm, and he wants to become a Patroller Godfiend?”
“He has already reported it to Archean Mountain. Arrangements should be made in the next few days,” said Meng Chuan softly. “I know my father’s temper. Before meeting my mother, he served in the city pass for ten years. When I was young, he even secretly carried out the Demon Annihilation Guild’s missions without me knowing. He experienced life-and-death battles time and time again. My father is bent on doing something once he’s decided.”
“All these years, my father has been an Earth Net Godfiend due to his strength. He borrowed credits from me previously because he wanted to become a Great Solar Godfiend,” said Meng Chuan. “The threshold for a Patroller is to be a Great Solar Godfiend. The moment my father succeeded, he immediately reported it to Archean Mountain.”
Liu Qiyue couldn’t help but say, “There are so many clansmen in the Meng family. Dad needs to preside over them.”
“Such words can’t convince Dad,” said Meng Chuan. “Dad has long resigned from his position as clan leader. The Meng family now has another clan leader and Elders. Even without my father presiding over the clan, it won’t affect the Meng family much.”
“What do you plan on doing?” Liu Qiyue looked at Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan said, “Meet him.”
In the same Jiang State Capital, Meng Manor.
Meng Dajiang and Liu Yebai lived in neighboring courtyards. At that moment, Meng Dajiang sat alone in his courtyard. There was a pile of items on the stone table. He carefully inspected them. These were the weapons he needed to bring when he patrolled the wilderness.
He smiled as he inspected them. He was in a good mood.
Oh? Meng Dajiang looked up and saw a young man land in the yard. It was his son, Meng Chuan. Meng Chuan had concealed his aura, changing it to be of a Marquis Godfiend’s.
“Chuan’er.” Meng Dajiang stood up happily. This was the greatest pride in his life-his son-Meng Chuan!
As he had watched this baby slowly grow up, he dedicated his life to teaching and protecting Meng Chuan. Unknowingly, he had become the most important existence in his life. However, the baby, the youth... had already grown up. He no longer needed him for shelter. He could spread his wings and fly on his own.
“Dad.” Meng Chuan looked at his father. It had been a few years since he last saw his father. He wished that he could split a portion of his time so that he could see his father. His wife’s identity as Jiang State Capital’s guardian Godfiend had to be kept a secret. Due to this, he hadn’t seen his father in a few years.
“I heard that guardian Godfiends are not allowed to leave the city they are guarding. You don’t have to visit me,” said Meng Dajiang immediately as he recalled Archean Mountain’s rules.
“Dad, you know that I’m the fastest in the world. I’m not a guardian Godfiend. I’m in charge of rescuing people. I can run all over the world,” explained Meng Chuan with a smile.
Meng Dajiang understood and nodded. “Then you’re very busy. Why are you here to see
me?”
“Dad, do you plan on becoming a Patroller Godfiend?” asked Meng Chuan.
“Yes, Archean Mountain has agreed. They will provide me with orders in a few days,” said Meng Dajiang. “Over the past few years, many Patrollers have died. Archean Mountain lacks manpower.”
Meng Chuan looked at his father. “Dad, I won’t persuade you, but you have to be careful.”
In this era, who could escape the call of duty? King Calm Sea’s children were also fighting. His father, mother, and wife were all participating in the war. Even his childrenMeng An and Meng You-would participate in the war in the future.
“Hahaha... I was fighting demons before you were even born. Do you need to teach me things about the battlefield?” Meng Dajiang chuckled. “Speaking of which, I taught you your saber techniques.”
“Yes, you laid the foundations for me.” Meng Chuan smiled and nodded.
“That’s right. Back then, I had to raise you all on my lonesome. Later, I had to look after the family clan. I then had to care for You’er and An’er,” said Meng Dajiang. “However, ever since You’er and An’er went up the mountain, I’ve been completely free. After seeing how the war has escalated, I feel anxious. However, I was an Indestructible Godfiend. I wasn’t even eligible to become a Patroller Godfiend.”
“But I’ve finally broken through and reached the Great Solar realm. I can become a Patroller and slay demons,” said Meng Dajiang with a smile. “I feel like I’m alive again. I feel like I’ve returned to my youth. I’m filled with energy!”
Meng Chuan listened. He could sense his father’s fighting spirit boiling.
“I’ll head out for a while. I’ll be back later,” said Meng Chuan.
“Alright.” Meng Dajiang nodded and watched his son disappear.
...
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan stepped on the Bloodblade Disc and changed his appearance with the Mask of Illusion. He flew towards Archean Mountain at high speed.
I can’t stop Father, but I can make preparations for him. I can exchange credits for better weapons and treasures and give them to him.
His journey didn’t take long, but it did take him some time to choose the treasures carefully.
An hour later, Meng Chuan returned to Jiang State Capital. “Dad, this is a storage bag. It has a house-sized space. Many items you carry can be placed inside.” Meng Chuan took out the treasures and introduced them. “This is a very special treasure—Blood Shadow Armor. It can fuse with one’s flesh and blood. The stronger one’s body is, the more useful it will be. With the Blood Shadow Armor, your strength should increase by several times. Your defense will be even better.”
Meng Chuan took out the treasures one by one.
Meng Dajiang couldn’t help but say, “Ah Chuan, we should use all these treasures on the most suitable person.”
“Great Solar Body Tempering Godfiends are very rare. These treasures suit you very well,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “Furthermore, they aren’t that precious. After all, they are treasures for Great Solar Godfiends.” “I’ve seen these treasures in the exchange booklet. They require quite a lot of credits,” said Meng Dajiang.
“It’s really not much,” said Meng Chuan, assuaging his worries.
Archean Mountain didn’t have the ability to arm all the patrolling Godfiends. For example, Archean Mountain only had eight Blood Shadow Armors. They were forged by a Regis Godfiend, who cultivated a Sanguine Divine Body. They paid a huge price, only to later discover that they provided limited help to Marquis Godfiends. But to use them on Great Solar Godfiends? The benefit-cost ratio was too low.
This was because one Blood Shadow Armor cost 30 million credits! As a Great Solar Body Tempering Godfiend, this treasure suited Meng Dajiang very well. A typical Great Solar Godfiend wouldn’t be able to produce the same results with the armor as Meng Dajiang would After spending more than 50 million credits on different treasures, his father now had the strength of a newly-advanced Marquis Godfiend. His life-preservation means had improved greatly. “Dad, these were exchanged using my credits,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “Besides, the stronger you are, the more demon monarchs you can kill and save. Am I right?”
Meng Dajiang hesitated for a moment before nodding with a smile. “Alright, I’ll accept it.”
3rd July.
Outside Jiang State Capital.
Meng Chuan and Liu Yebai sent Meng Dajiang
off.
“I hate myself for not reaching the Great Solar realm. Otherwise, I would’ve gone with you.” Liu Yebai hugged his good friend. After letting go, he sighed and said, “You were clearly on par with me, but you ended up becoming a Great Solar Godfiend? I can’t believe it.”“You won’t be envious.” Meng Dajiang smiled. Two demon servants were beside him. Every Patroller Godfiend would be paired with two demon servants. If a demon servant died in battle, although it would be troublesome to recover from the loss, their losses could be slowly recouped with time. If a Patroller Godfiend died in battle, a new Godfiend was needed.
“Ah Chuan, relax. Smile more.” Meng Dajiang looked at his son. “The fact that your father can become a Patroller Godfiend is something worth celebrating.”
Am I happy? Meng Chuan wondered... Patroller Godfiends... Their job was pretty much permanent. Even if Meng Chuan resolved the threat that the one million demon monarchs posed, there were still countless demon monarchs in the Demon Realm. The Demon Realm wouldn’t waste its advantage in numbers; it would also cause internal struggle in the Demon Realm if too many demon monarchs remained there. Thus, they would definitely keep sending demon monarchs into the human world. The human world was destined to always have demon monarchs. However, the number of demon monarchs in the demon world would decrease in the future. As a Patroller Godfiend, there was no end to their mission.
It continued until the war ended, or if they died in battle.
“Chuan’er.” Meng Dajiang looked at his son and said with a smile, “Death is inevitable. That is the way of life. Some die early, while others die late. Rather than dying on the sickbed in the future, it’s better to patrol the mountains, forests, and lakes to protect all human lives. I’ll hunt the demon monarchs until they die in the wilderness! This is what makes me happy! This is what a real man is! Chuan’er, you should be happy for me.” Meng Dajiang smiled at his son.
Meng Chuan smiled and nodded.
Meng Dajiang laughed and looked at his son before looking at Liu Yebai. He said, “I’m leaving now. Go busy yourselves.”
With that said, he turned around and leaped onto the avian demon servant’s back. The bird spread its wings and disappeared into the horizon.

chapters.title: Chapter 358 - Underground Ambush
chapters.content:
Chapter 358 Underground Ambush
Black Sand Dynasty, Lin Lake City.
Even during summer, the area around Lin Lake City was covered in snow. Many commoners built igloos in the wilderness.
A letter? Bai Nianyun wore a thick robe as she opened the envelope in the study and read the contents. Dajiang has become a Patroller Godfiend?
