After Bai Nianyun read the letter’s contents, she began missing her husband dearly. It was a good thing that Meng Dajiang had become a Great Solar Godfiend. However, the fact that he had become a Patroller Godfiend made Bai Nianyun. The casualty rate of Patroller Godfiends was too high.
Dajiang, I really want to meet you so that our family can reunite. Bai Nianyun couldn’t help but cry as her tears stained the letter. All these years, she had suffered in silence. However, she had no choice.
As a Grand Yin Holy Maiden, she was forbidden from losing her virginity. This was the sect’s rule. However, she had violated the sect’s rules and angered her matriarch, Bai Yaoyue. Back then, she had threatened to end her own life and made all sorts of promises before Bai Yaoyue agreed not to vent her anger on the Meng family. Back then... she had promised to sever ties with the Meng family as well as Meng Dajiang and Meng Chuan.
Although she couldn’t help but secretly take a look when her son, Meng Chuan, got married, she silently left after watching from afar. She didn’t dare contact him for real or exchange a few words with him. She had nothing to say since she was in the wrong when she chose to marry Meng Dajiang.
However, she could not suppress her feelings. When Bai Nianyun read the letter, she had the impulse to ignore everything else. Her family’s reputation? Her reputation? She wanted to throw it to the back of her mind and accompany her husband to roam the wilderness. She was even willing to die in battle with him.
But she knew that doing such a thing would only anger the matriarch.
Bai Yaoyue was now in charge of Black Sand Grotto-Heaven. Her status was extremely high, so Bai Nianyun didn’t dare to anger her. Furthermore, she was only a Marquis Godfiend. She was more useful for guarding cities than patrolling the wilderness.
Dajiang, you shall patrol the mountains and wilderness while I’ll guard the cities. We will fight the demons together. Bai Nianyun activated her Quintessential Essence and reduced the letter in her hand to dust.
9th July, the Great Zhou Dynasty’s underground.
Yellow Oscillate and North Sense brought the demon monarch, Longswim, to a depth of 14 kilometers underground. “I’ve investigated the locations of nearly 500 demon monarch cave abodes in the Great Zhou Dynasty,” said the black-robed North Sense. “Most demon monarchs are within the depths of 9 kilometers to 19 kilometers underground. Most that hide at this depth are still alive. The mysterious Godfiend doesn’t frequently search for demon monarch lairs at this depth. In the coming days, he will definitely sweep this area.”
“Yes.” Yellow Oscillate nodded. “Then let’s set up the formation here.”
“The depth of 9 kilometers to 19 kilometers,” The demon monarch-who was tall and thin -suddenly said, “Two demon sages will help guard the formation. It will take an hour to set up the formation.”
Yellow Oscillate and North Sense waited patiently.
Demon Monarch Longswim was the best at array formations among the newly-advanced fifth Firmament demon monarchs that had infiltrated the human world.
Everyone had their specialty. King Desire Redemption was Archean Mountain’s number one illusionist. King Luyue was Archean Mountain’s number one poison-refining expert. Although Creation Supremacies were powerful, they were only skilled at what they specialized in. Similarly, Demon Monarch Longswim’s skill with runic array formations was more brilliant than the few demon sages currently in the human world. This was because studying runic array formations was very unorthodox.
Be it humans or demons, it was considered an unorthodox field, which made achieving anything in this field difficult.
“The Three Terminal Formation needs to be set up extremely carefully. A single mistake can result in a huge difference.” Demon Monarch Longswim patiently began to set up the formation. Thankfully, the array formation and equipment had long been refined. All Longswim needed to do was set up the formation. As for Patriarch Yellow Oscillate and the black-robed North Sense, they obediently stood ready to heed his instructions.
Demon Monarch Longswim set up the array rather quickly. In less than an hour, everything was done.
Boom!
An invisible fluctuation appeared within the array formation. A black membrane even appeared at the edge of the array formation; it resembled a world membrane. A terrifying aura emanated from the array formation. It was an aura that could destroy everything. However, the fluctuations all disappeared soon after. The membrane vanished as well. Everything returned to normal.
“The array formation is operating normally.” Longswim’s eyes were filled with obsession as he praised, “It’s truly impressive. It blocks out the world, spacetime, and fate. It’s unbelievable that the Imperial Lords are willing to send the Three Terminal Formation over. The three of us are just fifth Firmament demon monarchs. If three demon sages activate the array formation, it will be even more terrifying.”
“That mysterious Godfiend poses too much of a threat. His existence will significantly delay the war. The Imperial Lords are afraid of anomalies appearing due to the delay,” said the black-robed North Sense. “Therefore, we have to get rid of that mysterious Godfiend as soon as possible.”
Patriarch Yellow Oscillate nodded and said, “The human world’s heritage is very rich. Without the Three Terminal Formation, we don’t have the confidence to kill this mysterious Godfiend. He might have extremely powerful defensive items. For example, if he has a treasure that can allow him to travel through spacetime, displacing his position by thousands of kilometers instantly, we will be at a loss. With the world, spacetime, and fate now blocked within the array formation... he will definitely die.”
“If you are lucky, I’m afraid you would be able to kill him with a few strikes, Brother Yellow Oscillate,” said the black-robed North Sense with a smile. “Your strength is comparable to a newly-advanced Creation realm expert. If you catch the Regis Godfiend by surprise, he might die before he can use his life-preservation item.”
“Senior Yellow Oscillate, stay in the middle of the array formation,” said Longswim. “Senior, your saber art can reach anywhere within five kilometers instantly. By making the array formation cover a ten-kilometer radius, it will be the most suitable place for you to use your saber art. Once that mysterious Godfiend is trapped in the array formation, there’s no way for him to dodge. He can only be hit. The first move might be enough to kill him directly.”
Treasures had to be activated. If they weren’t activated, it was possible for them to die.
“I’ll take your advice.” Yellow Oscillate nodded.
“We now need to wait patiently. I will completely stop the array formation’s operations for now. The three of us will restrain our auras so that the humans don’t discover us,” said Longswim.
Days passed.
12th August.
Meng Chuan continued his underground reconnaissance as usual as he hunted down demon monarchs.
Soon. In another two months, I’ll be able to finish sweeping through the entirety of the Great Zhou Dynasty. Meng Chuan wore the Mask of Illusion—which made his hair white
-as he stood on the Bloodblade Disc. He flew underground at high speed. It seems like I’ve been too ruthless in the past few months. I’ve slaughtered a large number of demon monarchs. Quite a number of demon monarchs have probably migrated away. The number of demon monarchs I can find every day is decreasing.
Logically speaking, he was sweeping through the Great Zhou Dynasty at different depths. He didn’t repeat his route. His underground reconnaissance speed wasn’t too different, but his kill count had been declining recently. It was very likely that the demon monarchs had migrated.
Even though the demon monarchs don’t have much contact with each other, too many of them have been killed. News has gradually spread among the demon monarchs, causing them to panic and move to the other dynasties. However, as long as you are in the human world, you won’t be able to escape.
fter sweeping the Great Zhou Dynasty, I’ll go to the Great Yue Dynasty and the Black Sand Dynasty.
There were very few underground demon monarchs in the Black Sand Dynasty due to King White Treasure, but ever since one million demon monarchs entered the human world, more demon monarchs began living underground.Huh? Meng Chuan’s electromagnetic domain instantly discovered a demon monarch lair. There were nine third Firmament demon monarchs, three second Firmament demon monarchs, and over 100 ordinary demons. Ever since the second Firmament demon monarchs stopped attacking the cities and started hunting down mortals, there were fewer second Firmament demon monarchs that followed third firmament demon monarchs.
I’ve discovered another lair. Meng Chuan didn’t hold back at all. He controlled the Bloodblade Disc and closed in, causing the demon monarch lair to be within his Seamless domain. Following that, Quintessential Essence threads shot out.
With the help of the Seamless domain, the Quintessential Essence threads’ strength increased. They pierced through the demon monarchs’ heads and took away their lives. All of them—more than 100 demons-died silently within his Seamless domain.
Whoosh.
After putting away the demon monarchs’ corpses, Meng Chuan continued sweeping through the underground.
“A demon monarch lair is 7.5 kilometers away from the Three Terminal Formation. It’s about the same depth as us.” Underground, the black-robed North Sense suddenly opened his eyes and said, “Those demon monarchs have disappeared from the token’s detection. That mysterious Godfiend... might come to us at any moment.”
“He’s coming?” Patriarch Yellow Oscillate opened his eyes. His eyes were filled with anticipation. “I’ve been waiting so long for this.”
Demon Monarch Longswim’s expression changed slightly. He immediately said, “He has entered the array formation! He’s a Regis Godfiend!”

chapters.title: Chapter 359 - Blocks Out the World, Spacetime, and Fate
chapters.content:
Chapter 359 Blocks Out the World, Spacetime, and Fate
Meng Chuan stepped on the Bloodblade Disc and flew underground at high speeds.
Swoosh.
As he flew into a region, a terrifying fluctuation erupted. At the same time, a black world membrane appeared behind him. A storm of dense, destructive blasts brewed.
Not good. Meng Chuan could vaguely detect impending death. As he activated his protective treasure, Clear Sky, he requested for help through his transmission token! However, Clear Sky didn’t react at all. The transmission token didn’t react at all. He was completely cut off from the outside world.
What? Clear Sky and the transmission token have been blocked out? Meng Chuan knew that something was amiss. However, he remained very calm. Ever since his demon monarch slaughtering speed had increased, he had guessed that the demons would never permit him to continue his massacre.
He still had Archean Mountain’s life-preservation treasure, the one and only protective stone talisman-which Qin Wu had said that he would definitely escape any peril as long as he used the stone talisman within the human world. However, Meng Chuan lost some confidence in it the moment Clear Sky and the transmission token had been blocked out. After all, the protective stone talisman couldn’t be used in other worlds or in the World Gap.
Let’s see how capable you are. Meng Chuan had long prepared himself for all kinds of dangers due to the war.
Unbeknownst to him, Yellow Oscillate, North Sense, Longswim panicked the moment he flew into the Three Terminal Formation on the Bloodblade Disc.
“He’s too fast.” Patriarch Yellow Oscillate originally wanted to catch the mysterious Godfiend by surprise by ambushing him. However, Meng Chuan flew into the Three Terminal Formation on the Bloodblade Disc. He was so fast that the three demon experts were panicking! Thankfully, the Three Terminal Formation could be activated with just a thought. If they had been a little slower, Meng Chuan would’ve probably rushed out of the Three Terminal Formation.
Yellow Oscillate, North Sense, and Longswim activated the array formation with all their might. The three demon monarchs only heaved sighs of relief when the Three Terminal Formation activated-the mysterious Godfiend was trapped.
“It’s no wonder this mysterious Godfiend can slaughter so many demon monarchs so quickly. His flying speed has reached such astonishing extents.” “From the looks of it, his hair is already white. He should be some awakened Regis Godfiend.” Yellow Oscillate and company controlled the Three Terminal Formation, allowing them to sense everything within the array formation clearly. They could also sense Meng Chuan and see his current appearance.
Whoosh.
After activating the array formation, Yellow Oscillate attacked.
Stygian Saber Art.
The saber beam transformed into a turbid river. It carried an infinite aura of death as it instantly struck Meng Chuan. This strike was comparable to an ordinary Creation realm expert’s attack! It was even more terrifying than King Calm Sea’s full-strength strike. After all, Yellow Oscillate’s technique realm was high. He had reached the late-stages of the Grotto-Heaven realm but was limited in strength due to his current body. However, it was strong enough to wipe out most Regis Godfiends!
Die!
North Sense cast an illusion with a thought. He wasn’t good at head-on combat, but he had a high status in the Demon Realm. He was extremely good at creating avatars and embodiments—thousands of the latter. He hid many embodiments everywhere in the human world to contact various parties.
Apart from being good at avatars, he was also good at illusions. As a demon sage, although his illusion skill hadn’t reached the Grotto-heaven realm, he was still at the peak of the Dharma Domain realm. He was even stronger than King Desire Redemption of Archean Mountain.
Illusion Realm. North Sense cast an illusion that wasn’t very offensive in nature. Illusion Realm was mainly used to trap an enemy’s Essence Soul! It caused the enemy to lose their senses of the outside world and their ability to resist temporarily.
As long as I can trap him for one or two seconds, he’ll be dead. North Sense was filled with confidence in his illusions.
“Senior Demon Sages, condense the Great Destruction Rays together.” Longswim guided the array formation with all his might. He was the leader; the two demon sages were his assistants.
This was the true killer move-Great Destruction Rays!
The Three Terminal Formation was used to trap and kill enemies. It blocked off the world, making it impossible for external powers to descend. It blocked off spacetime, preventing one from escaping through spacetime. It blocked off fate, isolating all karmic heavenly secrets. If one had an Imperial Lord backing them, the Imperial Lord could sense that someone close to them was in danger of death through karma and immediately carry out a rescue. However, the Three Terminal Formation prevented one from detecting this by blocking off the karmic heavenly secrets. Outsiders didn’t even know where Meng Chuan was.
In the River of Spacetime, many experts had different means. It was easy to defeat them, but it was very difficult to kill them.
The Three Terminal Formation was specially used for killing enemies. It not only prevented one from escaping; it could also condense the Great Destruction Rays to kill the enemy. The array formation was originally used by demon sages. Once used, anyone below the Imperial Lord realm would definitely die. However, with the three fifth Firmament demon monarchs now powering it with their demonic powers, its strength had been greatly reduced. Though that was the case, the Great Destruction Rays were still strong enough to make Meng Chuan alarmed.
The Great Destruction Rays’ might was even more terrifying than King True Martial’s Ten Absolutes of World Annihilation.
Rumble...
The Stygian saber beam, the Illusion Realm, and finally the Great Destruction Rays were unleashed in close succession.
Typically, killing Regis Godfiends with such attacks was a guaranteed success. In the entire human world, only a handful of Regis Godfiends could survive in such a situation. Even King Calm Sea couldn’t escape!
What a terrifying formation. Meng Chuan evaluated the scene before him as he stepped on the Bloodblade Disc. The moment he discovered that he had been trapped in the array formation, he executed the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique and entered a deep void layer. In the outside world, he produced nine embodiments.
Although he had hidden in a deep void layer, Meng Chuan still released 18 Bloodblades. He activated the Bloodblade Disc’s protective array formation, causing the 18 Bloodblades to revolve around him slowly.
Boom!
The Essence Soul mystic technique, Illusion Realm, swept across the area, but it failed to touch Meng Chuan.
The terrifying attacks struck the void, causing the nine embodiments to dissipate. Finally, the void shattered before Meng Chuan’s true body appeared.
Pfft! Pfft! Pfft!
The aftershocks swept past Meng Chuan. As for the 18 Bloodblades, they formed a world of their own and easily blocked the aftershocks.
In order to shatter the void, more than half of the array formation’s power had been expended. Furthermore, it hadn’t been focused. Less than 10% of its power had been directed at Meng Chuan. It naturally couldn’t pose a threat to the Bloodblade Disc. After all, the Bloodblade Disc specialized in escaping and defense! After Meng Chuan reached the Dharma Domain realm, he had a deeper understanding of the Nine Heavenly Forms of the Void, Roving Dragon Form of Lightning, and Yin-Yang Form of Lightning. With this, the Bloodblade Disc’s array formation had also increased in strength.
With the Bloodblade Disc, Meng Chuan’s attacks were already as strong as a weak Creation realm expert. His defense was even stronger than that.
What? Yellow Oscillate, North Sense, and Longswim were astonished to discover that they had destroyed nine of the mysterious Godfiend’s embodiments. Only when the void had been shattered did the Godfiend’s true body appear. Blood-colored streams of light danced around his body, easily blocking the aftershocks.
Swoosh. The masked Godfiend phased into the void once again and left behind nine embodiments.
When the demons attacked with all their might, they only managed to reduce a kilometer-wide void area to dust. The surrounding void remained intact, and the shattered void was quickly restored.
Yellow Oscillate and company began to panic as they stared at the nine embodiments.
His body can infiltrate into the deep void? Yellow Oscillate and North Sense knew what this meant.

chapters.title: Chapter 360 - Killing
chapters.content:
Chapter 360 Killing
The disappearance of a body meant that most attacks were useless.
The World Roving Dragon Saber was known as the number one movement technique in human history. It was a movement technique that allowed Senior Ye Hong to stay in an extremely deep layer of the void. It was even deeper than where Meng Chuan was at. Ye Hong could produce 81 embodiments in the outside world, making him invincible! As for Meng Chuan, he wasn’t invincible. However, he could weaken over 90% of his enemies’ attacks.
When an enemy attacked with all their might, they had to shatter the void to force him to reveal his true body. However, after shattering the void, the attack’s power would decrease significantly, greatly reducing the threat it posed to Meng Chuan. Thus, hiding in the deeper layers of the void became an expert’s first choice of defense.
s an extremely terrifying method. Many attacks were rendered completely ineffective!
Every skill and profession had its specialties! Meng Chuan’s Infinite Saber movement technique was fast and powerful, but it couldn’t penetrate deep into the void. The Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique offensive power was ordinary, but it had plenty of variations. It was like a fish that could swim in the deep void.
It’s my turn! Meng Chuan stepped on the Bloodblade Disc and sneaked deep into the void. Killing intent flashed in his eyes.
Nine of the eighteen Bloodblades that protected him immediately flew out. These nine Bloodblades executed the Cloud Dragon Snake Saber Art as they silently traversed the void and approached the enemy.
If Meng Chuan could reflect nine embodiments in the void, then as the nine Bloodblades moved at high speeds, one could only see dozens of blurry afterimages approaching Longswim.
I know Patriarch Yellow Oscillate. The black-robed man once tried to entice me. Both of them seem extraordinary. On the contrary, the demon monarch is the most low-key. Meng Chuan vaguely felt that the latter was the key to winning this battle.
In a life-and-death battle, there was no time to think too much.
This is it!
“Be careful.” Yellow Oscillate and North Sense’s expressions changed as they warned Longswim, but the Bloodblades were too fast! A large number of blurry shadows instantly arrived at Longswim’s location. The two of them sensed the attacks, but it was already too late.
Pfft! Pfft! Pfft!
The Bloodblades reached a close distance to Longswim before entering a shallow void layer to attack.
Not good. Longswim’s expression changed drastically. He frantically tried his best to charge up two Great Destruction Rays in a bid to resist. Although the blood-colored beams were formed due to executing the Cloud Dragon Snake Saber Art and weren’t very powerful, they still used a Tribulation treasure as a medium. They were as strong as a peak Regis Godfiend’s attack; they were extremely powerful.
At such a close distance, Longswim was unable to dodge the attacks. Longswim was ultimately a fifth Firmament demon monarch that had only broken through a few years ago. Even with the Great Destruction Rays, he was unable to stop the Bloodblade streams.
Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Bloodblades circled around the Great Destruction Rays and penetrated his body.
Head, chest, abdomen...
In the blink of an eye, Longswim’s body disintegrated as he lost his life.
How weak. Meng Chuan was somewhat surprised. He had prepared nine Bloodblades to attack Longswim, but who knew that the first Bloodblade would pierce through his head? It was extremely easy.
With a thought, the nine Bloodblades entered the deep void again. This time, they rapidly approached North Sense.
“North Sense, he’s after you,” said Yellow Oscillate via voice transmission.
Swoosh.
The Bloodblade stream suddenly appeared at a close distance. However, North Sense flicked his sleeve and sent the Bloodblade flying. He remained calm as he sent a voice transmission. “Brother Yellow Oscillate, I’ll use the Great Destruction Rays to force his true body out. At the same time, I’ll use my Essence Soul mystic technique to affect him. Take this opportunity to kill him at full strength.”
“Alright.” Yellow Oscillate also felt that this was the best solution.
The three demon monarchs could perfectly power the Three Terminal Formation. Even if one of their companions died in battle, the two demon monarchs could barely maintain the formation. The Three Terminal Formation was a demon formation after all. It didn’t collapse that easily. Of course, the power of the array formation would weaken. This black-robed demon monarch is powerful. His technique realm is extremely high. He can easily crack the Cloud Dragon Snake Saber Art at close range. Since it’s useless to rely on tricks, I can only use strength. With a thought, Meng Chuan’s move changed.
After the nine Bloodblades appeared near North Sense, they transformed into dazzling beams of light.
They reached extremely fast speeds.
Infinite Saber!
The might of the Bloodblades was equally potent. Meng Chuan could already unleash the strength of a weak Creation realm expert with the Bloodblade Disc. The Infinite Saber was several times stronger than the Cloud Dragon Snake Saber Art.
North Sense remained extremely calm when facing the terrifying Bloodblades. He controlled 15 Great Destruction Rays to sweep towards Meng Chuan’s location!
Both sides attacked each other!
Boom!
The Great Destruction Rays were faster than the Bloodblades. In an instant, a kilometer-wide void area was shattered, causing Meng Chuan’s true body to appear once again.
An Essence Soul mystic technique attacked Meng Chuan.
Not good. Meng Chuan defended with all his might, but he found it very strange. At that moment, the nine Bloodblades surrounded his body and formed a system. The black-robed demon monarch’s Essence Soul mystic technique passed through the nine Bloodblades’ defensive array formation with great difficulty. The power of the Essence Soul mystic technique had been greatly reduced, leaving only ten to twenty percent of its strength to act on him. Although Meng Chuan was affected by the illusions, he was still able to maintain lucidity. A weapon specially refined by an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence for a junior is truly extraordinary. Even Essence Soul mystic techniques are greatly weakened by the defensive mechanisms of a Tribulation treasure.
“Die!” Yellow Oscillate had already charged over with all his might. The saber beam transformed into a surging, underworld river and flew towards him.
Meng Chuan vanished again and hid in the deep void.
“What?” North Sense couldn’t believe that his illusions were completely useless.
Bam! Bam! Bam!
Bloodblade streams attacked North Sense as Meng Chuan disappeared. When North Sense waved his sleeve to block them, he felt a terrifying impact.
Not good. North Sense’s expression changed. With great difficulty, he barely managed to block three Bloodblades. His movements were somewhat out of place as a fourth Bloodblade brushed past his palm and flew into his chest.
The fifth, sixth, and seventh Bloodblades struck him one after another.
North Sense was ultimately not good at close combat. He didn’t dedicate his time to hone his close-combat skills. The Cloud Dragon Snake Saber Art had countless variations, and its strength was relatively weak, which was why he could block it. However, the Infinite Saber attack was several times stronger. It far exceeded what North Sense could withstand in a head-on clash.
Boom! Boom! Boom!North Sense’s body exploded.
The nine Bloodblades pierced through his body one after another-dozens of times in the blink of an eye. Meng Chuan’s strength constantly erupted as the black-robed North Sense’s body completely exploded, turning into countless fragments.
In this exchange of attacks, Meng Chuan managed to win against the three demon monarchs—the demons’ plan failed.
As for North Sense, he couldn’t withstand the Bloodblades and was reduced to smithereens.
Yellow Oscillate wasn’t worried about his companion. Demon Sage North Sense was good at avatars. The one that had come here was only a powerful avatar.
North Sense, your illusions didn’t affect him at all. My strike didn’t even hit him. You really screwed me. Patriarch Yellow Oscillate could sense that the Three Terminal Formation was beginning to collapse. A single demon monarch could not maintain the array formation for much longer.
What he needed to consider now was not how to kill the mysterious Godfiend, but how he would escape! In fact, he didn’t even have the time to dismantle the Three Terminal Formation.
“Patriarch Yellow Oscillate, don’t even think about escaping!” Meng Chuan’s voice resounded through the underground region. Today, it was time to avenge Xue Feng.

chapters.title: Chapter 361 - Master Is Here
chapters.content:
Chapter 361 Master Is Here
On Archean Mountain.
“Meng Chuan activated Clear Sky, but Archean Mountain’s Heaven and Earth powers were unable to descend.” Li Guan, an illusory Qin Wu, and an illusory Luo Tang appeared. They were filled with anxiety.
Clear Sky, Scarlet Cloud Heaven, and others made up a set of nine treasures. Ancestral Master Archean Eon had personally refined them.
In history, even if the nine Origins treasures were lost, they were eventually retrieved. However, the retrieval of the treasures only occurred because of two things. Firstly, Archean Mountain was strong enough. Secondly, no matter how carefully hidden they were, Archean Mountain could determine the nine Origin Treasures’ locations.
Although the Three Terminal Formation isolated external forces, it was unable to isolate the connection between Clear Sky and Archean Mountain. At the very least, they could determine its location.
“Qin Wu, make a trip personally. My Essence Soul avatar will rush to Sword Sovereign City and help you guard it temporarily,” instructed Li Guan immediately.
“Alright.” Qin Wu nodded. “My true body has already set off! Senior Brother, your Essence Soul avatar has to head over as soon as possible. Sword Sovereign City is currently unguarded.”
“I’ll arrive in 60 seconds. We can only take the risk.” Li Guan’s expression was solemn. “The demons are clearly targeting Meng Chuan if they are able to prevent the power of Clear Sky from descending. My Essence Soul avatar only has 30 to 40 percent of my true body’s strength. I don’t have confidence in saving Meng Chuan.”
Luo Tang was anxious as well. “If we had known earlier, we would have gotten Meng Chuan to choose the other two Tribulation treasures as well. At the very least, they can kill stronger enemies.”
The Thousand Lightning Dharma Seal and the Time Saber had potent offensive abilities. On the other hand, the Bloodblade Disc focused on escaping and defense.
“In the face of a trap, the Bloodblade Disc might be able to save his life,” said Li Guan calmly. “It’s become his intrinsic weapon. Now that he has chosen and refined it, it’s useless to say such things.”
“We can only hope that Meng Chuan can hold on until Qin Wu arrives,” said Luo Tang softly. “If Meng Chuan dies in battle, the situation will become even worse. I’m afraid it will be very difficult to find another Godfiend that can deal with one million demon monarchs.”
Luck played a part in dealing with the threat of a million demon monarchs.
When Meng Chuan entered Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven, he happened to obtain a physical body cultivation system. Since he had a Lightning Devastator Fiend Body, he had awakened a divine power-Divine Eye of Lightning. This made him good at underground reconnaissance.
Without his speed, Meng Chuan wouldn’t have such an impact on the war’s situation. It would be very difficult if they wanted to find another person with Meng Chuan’s demon-slaying efficiency.
After all, they had to find another Regis Godfiend with a perfected Lightning Devastator Fiend Body. They also had to cultivate the physical body cultivation system. Furthermore, their Essence Soul cultivation talent needed to be good! Without good Essence Soul cultivation talent, one wouldn’t be able to progress to a high level in the physical body cultivation system.
Therefore, it was indeed lucky that they had Meng Chuan.
Sky Splitting Sword Flight.
Qin Wu silently left Sword Sovereign City. Without any hesitation, he executed the Sky Splitting Sword Flight that he had yet to perfect.
Archean Mountain’s Creation Supremacies were qualified to choose a Tribulation treasure. However, they also needed to refine it as their intrinsic treasure. Therefore, they could only choose one. Back when Qin Wu chose his Tribulation treasure, he was very young, and the demons hadn’t invaded. He chose the Sky Splitting Sword Array that was most compatible with his Godfiend body—the Thirteen Swordbane Fiend Body.
The Sky Splitting Sword Array consisted of 33 swords—they were meant for killing enemies.
Due to the demon invasion, he needed to reinforce all places! Therefore, after comprehending the Sky Splitting Sword Array, he began to think of a flight technique. He named it Sky Splitting Sword Flight. It was a mystic technique that allowed him to fly and escape with a sword. However, it was originally a weapon that was meant for killing. Hence, it was too difficult to use it for flight. He had never succeeded in creating it completely.
At this moment, he couldn’t be bothered about the imperfections of his technique.
Qin Wu carried a sword on his back. This was only one of the Sky Splitting Sword Array’s swords.
The sword beam soared into the sky!
His body fused with the sword, transforming into a sword that tore through the air.
Chi! Chi! Chi! As a large number of sword beams tore through the air, Qin Wu-who had fused with the sword-was struck by the sword beams.
Human bodies were ultimately not weapons. Weapons could pierce through the air at an extremely fast speed. To tear through the void physically with his weapon? It was a good idea, but it was very difficult to do so. A Seventh Tribulation Eminence had refined Meng Chuan’s Bloodblade Disc; It was made for flight and defense. Supremacy Qin Wu’s Sky Splitting Sword Array was essentially a weapon meant for killing
Pfft. Qin Wu’s body was struck by the sword beams, causing drops of blood to seep out from his skin. His eyes turned blood-red, and even the sword beams from the Tribulation weapon began to attack the grotto-heaven within him. Thankfully, it was his intrinsic weapon, so the damage was minimized.
Qin Wu’s speed increased to 19.5 kilometers per flash after paying such a huge price.
Meng Chuan, you have to wait for me to arrive. Qin Wu was extremely anxious. He absolutely did not want to see this disciple die in battle.
With the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique’s ability to hide in the deep void and with the Bloodblade Disc protecting him, his life-preservation abilities were formidable. This caused the demons’ plans to fall apart completely. Even the weaker Longswim and North Sense’s avatar were killed one after another. Only Yellow Oscillate was left.
I need to leave! With Yellow Oscillate’s years of living, he was cognizant of what the situation was like. Without any hesitation, he soared upwards and rapidly rushed towards the surface.
“Die!” Meng Chuan used his movement technique as he made nine Bloodblades surround Yellow Oscillate.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
As the Bloodblades attacked, Yellow Oscillate’s demonic powers rippled out. Most of the Bloodblades were unable to pierce through the protective demonic powers. Even if a Bloodblade managed to pierce through the layers of protective demonic powers occasionally, it only struck Yellow Oscillate’s robe. His powerful body trembled slightly as he deflected the impact.
This surprised Meng Chuan. Patriarch Yellow Oscillate is a demon sage that has cultivated for many years. Furthermore, he’s good at fighting head-on. His defensive abilities are truly powerful. My strongest attack with the Bloodblades is as strong a weak Creation realm expert, but he actually dares to face them head-on.
If the robe was tough, it was normal that it wasn’t pierced. However, when the robe was soft, the impact was something the body needed to withstand. Yellow Oscillate’s protective demonic powers first reduced the impact before letting his body take on the remnant might. In terms of physical strength... he was probably one of the strongest amongst fifth Firmament demon monarchs. He was much stronger than Longswim. Indeed, demons were physically strong. Even though Yellow Oscillate was only at the fifth Firmament, he had cultivated his body to an extremely terrifying level.
Boom!
Yellow Oscillate rushed out of the ground. He didn’t care about anything else as he fled at maximum speed.
I can see a lot of the connection points between the World Gap and the human world. The closest connection point is 250 kilometers from here. With my speed, I will take 48 seconds.
Swoosh.
He flew towards the nearest world connection point at high speeds.
This Regis Godfiend has been chasing after me and constantly attacking me. I have no way of escaping him. In a short while, a human Creation Supremacy will arrive. Yellow Oscillate was very calm. My greatest chance for survival now is to enter the World Gap through the connection point.Supremacies could not enter the World Gap. In a head-on battle, he didn’t care about the Regis Godfiend behind him. Although he couldn’t kill the Regis Godfiend, the Regis Godfiend’s attacks couldn’t threaten him either.
Demon sages at the late stages of the Grotto-Heaven realm were known to be adept at combat. Even if they were stuck at the fifth Firmament, their combat techniques were perfected. Their strength was close to that of King True Martial.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Bloodblades flew at him at high speeds as they bombarded him.
Oh? When Yellow Oscillate flew at high speeds, he would occasionally take the blows head-on. Sometimes, he would swing his saber to block an attack. He did it in a way that ensured that he maintained maximum fleeing speed.
This Regis Godfiend is currently attacking me with all his might. I can only move at half my speed. To reach the connection point, I will need 90 seconds. In addition, I will take about 30 seconds to break through the world membrane. Patriarch Yellow Oscillate was anxious. The mysterious Godfiend will definitely attack me with all his might when I’m trying to pierce the world membrane.It will take longer to enter the World Gap.
From the moment I flee to the time it takes to enter the World Gap... it will take me 150 seconds? This would be enough time for a human Supremacy to arrive. I have to give up. There’s only one way. I’ll take a gamble. Yellow Oscillate had no way of dealing with the mysterious Godfiend. He couldn’t force the mysterious Godfiend to come out from the deep void. Without any hesitation, he swooped down and burrowed underground.
He would not give up hope of survival until the final moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 362 - Patriarch Yellow Oscillate’s Death
chapters.content:
Chapter 362 Patriarch Yellow Oscillate’s Death
Swoosh.
Patriarch Yellow Oscillate burrowed underground. The nine Bloodblades continued their barrage of attacks. In the blink of an eye, they attacked dozens of times. Although the continuous attacks couldn’t threaten his life, they significantly reduced his speed. It’s useless even if you flee underground. Meng Chuan followed closely behind on the Bloodblade Disc. An Archean Mountain Supremacy should be their way here, right? When the Three Terminal Formation was broken, his transmission token could contact Archean Mountain. Meng Chuan had sent out a request for help immediately. Furthermore, he clearly indicated that he was facing a demon sage threat. It was useless to send a Regis Godfiend to fight an opponent at Patriarch Yellow Oscillate’s level. Even if King True Martial could suppress Patriarch Yellow Oscillate, he couldn’t do anything to him.
It had to be a Supremacy.
Qin Wu, who had used the Sky Splitting Sword Flight, revealed a look of delight.
Meng Chuan sent out a request for help. He didn’t attempt to activate Clear Sky again. He should be in a safer state? Qin Wu heaved a sigh of relief. Since he’s indicating that it’s a demon sage threat, why didn’t he use Clear Sky? He’s probably using his speed to follow the demon sage, preventing him from escaping?
Qin Wu instantly had a guess. Demon sage? Qin Wu was somewhat excited. All these years, humans had not killed a single demon
sage!
Boom!
He continued maintaining Sky Splitting Sword Flight. His worsening injuries—which required time for the Grotto-Heaven in his body to recuperate, preventing him from unleashing his full strength for years— didn’t stop him. Killing a demon sage was worth it.
Any delay could lead to changes. Demon sage-level opponents also had very strong escaping abilities. For example, North Sense appeared to be very weak in a head-on battle. He couldn’t even tear through the world membrane. He was simply a joke among demon sages. However, he was skilled in avatars. His survival ability was ranked in the top three among the many demon sages in the Demon Realm. When he moved outside, it would always be an avatar or embodiment. Even the entity in Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s small grotto-heaven wasn’t his true body.
Nobody, including the Imperial Lords, knew where North Sense’s true body was.
Demon Sage Nine Abyss had already recovered his demon sage powers, yet he remained cautious.
Yellow Oscillate was good at fighting head-on. His cultivation wasn’t focused on escaping abilities, but he had spent a lot of effort in cultivating means for protecting his life.
Meng Chuan followed Yellow Oscillate underground. He kept his Divine Eye of Lightning open, and the nine Bloodblades continued to pester him.
Disperse. Yellow Oscillate burrowed underground and completely retracted his aura. Instantly, his body split into 28 streams of light. Twenty-eight Yellow Oscillates fled in all directions.
“Die!” Meng Chuan, who was constantly on guard, controlled the nine Bloodblades to transform into beams of light. At the same time, he released the nine Bloodblades that protected him!
With Clear Sky protecting him, Meng Chuan had the confidence to do such a thing.
Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft!!
Although Yellow Oscillate’s avatars were extremely fast-each was capable of moving at astonishing speeds—the Bloodblade beams were simply too fast. They pierced through the ‘Yellow Oscillates’ one after another. In the blink of an eye, the 18 blood-blades had killed 27 Yellow Oscillates.
Only one managed to withstand the stream of Bloodblades—the true body.
My Burning Blood Avatar Escape was useless. Patriarch Yellow Oscillate was extremely furious. I can’t care about the consequences anymore.
He swung his saber and struck the void in front of him.
Rumble!
The void shattered.
What is it doing? Meng Chuan was stunned by Yellow Oscillate’s actions.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Yellow Oscillate slashed out with his saber repeatedly, causing the entire region to tremble and distort.
Meng Chuan guessed what Yellow Oscillate was trying to do. It wants to break through the world membrane!
“I’m leaving the human world and entering the outer realm,” said Yellow Oscillate in a deep voice. “You are a Regis Godfiend. Do you have the guts to follow me?” At the same time, he continued cleaving down. Gradually, the gray chaotic world membrane appeared.
“Only demon sages can survive in the harsh environment of the outer realm. You dare to go there?” said Meng Chuan coldly. At the same time, he controlled the 18 Bloodblades to obstruct Yellow Oscillate as much as possible.
“I’m a demon sage to begin with. Even with my fifth Firmament demon monarch body, I have the means to survive the outer realm.” Yellow Oscillate was affected by the Bloodblades, but he still cleaved down with all his might. His destruction speed exceeded the world membrane’s recovery speed. The world membrane distorted and quaked; cracks began to appear.
To enter the World Gap, Yellow Oscillate needed to break through the human world’s membrane before breaking through the World Gap’s membrane. It took him longer than entering the outer realm directly. To enter the outer realm, he only needed to break through the human world’s membrane.
Right now! Under Meng Chuan’s interference, he took 36 seconds to cleave open a ten-foot-long rift.
Boom!
Yellow Oscillate’s body burned as he transformed into a dazzling sanguine beam that entered the rift.
The rift closed.
Meng Chuan stood rooted to the ground. He fled? He escaped? Meng Chuan was somewhat indignant. He could only slow down his opponent’s speed at blasting open the world membrane; he couldn’t stop Yellow Oscillate.
Meng Chuan scanned his surroundings with his electromagnetic domain as he stood where he was. However, the world membrane had long recovered. Yellow Oscillate was gone.
Whoosh.
The surrounding soil and rocks parted.
A figure approached. It was Supremacy Qin Wu, who had rushed over with all his might.
“Master.” Meng Chuan bowed respectfully when he saw Qin Wu. “Where’s the demon sage?” asked Qin Wu immediately.
“Patriarch Yellow Oscillate broke through the world membrane and fled to the outer realm 24 seconds ago,” said Meng Chuan. “Outer realm?” Qin Wu’s expression changed as he immediately asked, “Where is the precise location of the world membrane?”
“Right here.” Meng Chuan waved his hand and pinpointed it with his Quintessential Essence.
Qin Wu suddenly released a terrifying sword beam. Countless sword beams swept across the surrounding soil and rocks, instantly reducing them to dust. The area within a few kilometers of the ground turned into nothingness.
This? Meng Chuan was somewhat shocked as he looked up. The soil and rocks within tens of kilometers were reduced to dust. He could see the sky when he looked up.
“You didn’t leave after it fled, did you?” asked Qin Wu.
“I didn’t leave,” said Meng Chuan as he stood in midair. “That’s good.” Qin Wu’s sword beam carefully swept across the void.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
Just a few hundred feet away from the world membrane, a golden bead appeared.
“As I expected.” Qin Wu extended his hand, and the golden bead flew into his hand.
“Master?” said Meng Chuan as his eyes lit up. “Patriarch Yellow Oscillate is only a fifth Firmament demon monarch. It will definitely die if it enters the outer realm,” said Qin Wu. “Even if it has some means, it can barely live an abject existence for a short period of time. However, it can’t travel the River of Spacetime. It’s destined to a fate far worse than death in the outer realm. It will still die shortly, and its death will be tragic.” Qin Wu looked at the golden bead. “I’m sure it’s still hidden in the human world.”
“Master, what do you mean?” Meng Chuan’s heart raced as he looked at the golden bead.
“Thankfully, you didn’t leave. If you had left, it would have immediately fled,” said Qin Wu. “You remained where you were, so it didn’t dare move at all. I have a small grotto-heaven treasure in my hand.”
Qin Wu looked in front of him and waved his hand. “Come out.”
A yellow-furred leopard demon monarch appeared in front of him. However, he only had a third Firmament demon monarch body. He had a look of despair as he pleaded, “Supremacy Qin Wu, spare me! Spare me!”
“This Yellow Oscillate put up a farce of escaping into the outer realm to deceive you,” explained Qin Wu with a smile. “In fact, the moment it rushed out to the outer realm, it abandoned its original body and sent its Essence Soul into this small grotto-heaven to possess this body. When small grotto-heavens are hidden, it’s difficult for ordinary mystic techniques to detect them. However, it didn’t dare to move. Once you had left, Yellow Oscillate would’ve fled.”
Meng Chuan came to a realization and looked at the yellow-furred leopard demon monarch. Possession?
“Supremacy, how wise of you,” pleaded the yellow-furred leopard demon monarch, “I know many of the demons’ secrets. I’m willing to tell you everything. Please agree to spare my life.”“The demons’ secrets?” Qin Wu looked at Yellow Oscillate.
“Supremacy, you have to promise to spare me first...” said the yellow-furred leopard demon monarch. He was very experienced.
Whoosh.
Sword beams swept over.
In his horror and despair, the yellow-furred leopard demon monarch was reduced to dust.
“It’s impossible for me to spare you.” Qin Wu’s eyes were cold.
Meng Chuan’s emotions surged when he saw this. This was the first demon sage that had died in the human world, and it would definitely not be the last one.
“Oh right, that array formation.” Meng Chuan recalled the array formation that hadn’t been moved. He didn’t want the demons to move it away secretly.

chapters.title: Chapter 363 - Demons’ Trump Card
chapters.content:
Chapter 363 Demons’ Trump Card
“Among the disciples I’ve taught over the years, Xue Feng’s talent and perception are considered top-notch. His future is limitless, but he died in the hands of this demon sage.” Qin Wu stood there, feeling somewhat sad. “Every time I think of it, it hurts my heart.”
Meng Chuan nodded. He was equally in grief and furious. “Master, a large array formation was set up at the spot where the demons ambushed me. It’s still there,” said Meng Chuan immediately.
“Oh?” Qin Wu’s eyes lit up. “Quickly bring me over.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan flew underground with his master, Qin Wu. They instantly arrived at the array formation.
“It’s still here.” Meng Chuan’s electromagnetic domain swept over and discovered a portion of the array formation.
Qin Wu stood in his spot as wisps of sword beams gently swept across the area. The soil and rocks began to crumble silently, gradually revealing a large array formation. The runic patterns on the array formation were extremely profound. Ordinary demon sages would have to spend some time to figure out the array formation before they could set it up and disassemble it.
“Impressive. What a powerful array formation. It blocks off the world and spacetime. It seems that it can even block off one’s ability to pry into karmic heavenly secrets?” commented Qin Wu as he inspected the array formation.
“Master, you’re amazing,” said Meng Chuan. When he probed the array formation with his electromagnetic domain, he felt that many runic patterns were mysterious and that they involved spacetime. He couldn’t understand anything else.
“I cultivate the Thirteen Swordbane Fiend Body, so array formations are crucial,” replied Qin Wu with a smile. “Therefore, I know a little about heavenly secrets and array formations.”
The top Thirteen Swordbane Fiend Body expert was definitely an array formation master. Not only was each Swordbane extremely sharp, but they would also undergo a qualitative change in strength when placed in an array formation.
“If one doesn’t know about array formations, even Creation Supremacies won’t be able to dismantle the array formation. You would only damage it if you forcefully tore it apart,” said Qin Wu as countless sword beams began to dismantle the array carefully. When it came to array formations, Qin Wu was much more brilliant than Longswim. His insights into array formations had already reached the Grotto-Heaven realm. When he used his Swordbanes to set up his Tribulation treasure
—the Sky Splitting Sword Array—he gained unimaginable strength. If Demon Sage Nine Abyss dared showed his face, he would be reduced to dust by the sword array.
In just a few seconds, countless array formation components were dismantled and stored away by Qin Wu. If he wanted to set up an array formation, he could set it up within 30 seconds.
“This array formation is extremely valuable. I only had the chance to kill Patriarch Yellow Oscillate because you held it back.” Qin Wu smiled at Meng Chuan. “I wonder how many credits you deserve.”
“Master, does the sect award you credits for killing enemies?” asked Meng Chuan.
Qin Wu was taken aback because he was one of the people in charge of the sect’s resources.
“You can ignore credits when you become a Creation Supremacy,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “As for now, we still need to keep tabs on credits! The rules are the rules. We must not disregard them.” “Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded. His contributions to the human race were terrifying. He earned nearly ten million credits per day by conducting underground reconnaissance. Of course, he wouldn’t exchange the credits for items recklessly. With his current strength, ordinary treasures were useless.
In fact, the sect had already given him a lot. The Tribulation treasure-Bloodblade DiscClear Sky, protective stone talisman, and so on were directly given to him.
During wartime, Archean Mountain tried their best to protect every sect disciple. Of course, the disciples were also risking their lives as they died in combat, one after another.
“There were at least three demons who ambushed you. How did you survive the array formation’s might?” asked Qin Wu curiously.
“The Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique I created has also reached the Dharma Domain realm,” explained Meng Chuan. “This movement technique is based on the World Roving Dragon Saber. However, it has way more variations. Therefore, after the technique reached the Dharma Domain realm, my true body can enter the deep void. I hid in a deep void layer and had the Bloodblade Disc protecting me. That’s how I managed to block the opponents’ attacks. I killed an ordinary fifth Firmament demon monarch and the black-robed demon monarch, Mo Nan.”
North Sense had once split into thousands of incarnations. He had claimed to be Demon Monarch Mo Nan when he tried to convince every Godfiend to switch sides. He had also met Meng Chuan and his wife.
“A self-created ultimate technique? You improved the World Roving Dragon Saber?” Qin Wu looked at his disciple in surprise.
Successors stood on the shoulders of their predecessors. King True Martial had only created his True Martial Seven Absolutes after basing it on Grandsire Yin Yang’s ultimate technique. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have created it so quickly.
However, being able to build on the foundations of a predecessor and improve on it was a manifestation of one’s ability.
The World Roving Dragon Saber was known as the number one movement technique for humans. Meng Chuan had even improved it? Furthermore, he had created two ultimate techniques at his age, which had both reached the Dharma Domain realm?
My disciple’s talent is truly impressive. Perhaps a miracle will really happen thanks to him. Qin Wu looked at his disciple as many thoughts surfaced in his mind.
“Master, that black-robed demon monarch, Mo Nan, is very strange.” Meng Chuan was puzzled. “It should have the strength of a peak fifth Firmament demon monarch. However, it doesn’t have any life-preservation or escaping means. I quickly killed it with my Bloodblades.”
Logically speaking, a peak fifth Firmament demon monarch would spend all their effort on cultivating life preservation and escape abilities.
“That isn’t its real body.” Qin Wu smiled and said, “Demon Monarch Mo Nan has thousands of embodiments. It has appeared everywhere in the world, and Archean Mountain has long noticed it. We originally suspected that it was a newly-advanced fifth Firmament demon monarch and was good at embodiment arts. Since you said that it has the strength of a peak fifth Firmament demon monarch, it means it isn’t a newly-advanced fifth Firmament demon monarch. Instead, it should be a demon sage. The only one that matches that description is Demon Sage North Sense! It is the best at avatars and embodiments among the demon sages.”
“Demon Sage North Sense?” Meng Chuan had long received intelligence about the demons. He knew about the top demon experts and knew about Demon Sage North Sense.
Demon Sage North Sense was a very mysterious demon sage. His true body could almost never be found.
“Continue your underground reconnaissance. There’s no need to worry about the demons ambushing you,” said Qin Wu. “As I’ve said before, that protective stone talisman will definitely protect your life in the human world.”
“Even against the array formation that the demons set up?” asked Meng Chuan in surprise.
“Yes.” Qin Wu nodded. “It can definitely protect your life, but it’s gone once you use it. That is the last one.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. Definitely?
His master had spoken in absolute terms. Clearly, he was filled with confidence.
“Haha, as you become stronger, it will be more unlikely of you using this protective stone talisman. When you reach the Creation realm, this protective stone talisman can be returned to Archean Mountain,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “You have only become a Regis Godfiend for a short period of time. The demons ambushed you, but you ended up killing them instead. Even Patriarch Yellow Oscillate lost its life.”
Qin Wu was very pleased. The growth of his disciple made him feel less worried about him.
as
Xue Feng’s death was a pity. If Xue Feng had gone to Black Sand Grotto-Heaven for a few years and grew, Yellow Oscillate probably wouldn’t have been able to kill him.
Deep in the sea, inside a small grotto-heaven.
“It failed?”
“Yellow Oscillate is also dead?”
Demon Sages Nine Abyss, Deep Profundity, and North Sense sat there silently for a long time.
Even if Longswim died, he was only a newly-advanced fifth Firmament demon monarch. North Sense had only lost an avatar, which could be recultivated. However, Patriarch Yellow Oscillate was dead. He was the first demon sage to die in the human world. This made the demon sages feel mixed emotions.
“How did this happen?” asked Demon Sage Nine Abyss in a deep voice.
“No one expected that the Godfiend was capable of hiding in the deep void. His defensive means are also very powerful,” said North Sense. “Although his offensive means are crude-weaker than that of King Calm Sea
– his defensive abilities are very strong. He can even withstand my illusions.”
“I never expected that we would not only lose the Three Terminal Formation, but even Yellow Oscillate.” Nine Abyss looked at North Sense. “Then, we’ll have to use our trump card. North Sense, tell me his name. Which Regis Godfiend is he? I’ll report it to the Imperial Lord. The Imperial Lord will spare no expense to kill him by cursing him across worlds!”Killing enemies across worlds. Even if Imperial Lord Starquix was adept at karma mystic techniques, it was very difficult for an Imperial Lord to kill Regis Godfiends across worlds. The price for doing so was also very high.
North Sense shook his head. “I don’t know his name.”
“Those ancient Godfiends are Godfiends that were born in the past 1,000 to 2,000 years. We’ve fought humans for 800 years. Although there’s very little information on these ancient Godfiends, we should be able to recognize most of them, right?” asked Nine Abyss with a frown.
“He was wearing a mask,” said North Sense.
“So what if he was wearing a mask?” said Deep Profundity. “You fought him. Can’t you guess his identity from his moves?”
“No one fits the bill,” said North Sense.
“So we still don’t know who he is after a battle?” Nine Abyss couldn’t help but ask, “Even if the Imperial Lord wants to carry out the curse, he won’t even have a target?”
“I really can’t recognize him.” North Sense shook his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 364 - Actions From All Sides (Final Chapter of Volume)
chapters.content:
Chapter 364
Actions From All Sides (Final Chapter of Volume)
In the Demon Realm, the three Imperial Lords were gathered in Ice Palace—which floated high in the sky.
“The ambush failed. Even the name of that mysterious Godfiend remains unknown.” The black-haired, single-horned Imperial Lord Starquix laughed.
“We have detailed intelligence on every newly-advanced human Godfiend. A dossier about them is kept the moment they enter the sect,” said Emperor Roc angrily. “As for the ancient Godfiends that have awakened, they are all Godfiends from the past 1,000 years. We have intelligence records for most of them. They actually failed to recognize who the Godfiend is after engaging in a life-and-death battle? What a bunch of trash!”
“We lost the Three Terminal Formation, and Yellow Oscillate is dead. They are indeed trash,” said Lady Blackmoon indifferently. Imperial Lord Starquix smiled and said, “Sister Blackmoon, Brother Roc, I previously promised the two of you that if we learned of the Godfiend’s identity, I would be willing to carry out a curse. Now that we haven’t even figured out the Godfiend’s identity, there’s nothing I can do.”
A curse needed a medium. Blood and hair were naturally the best. It was the easiest to curse somebody with these two things. Even if he killed a Regis Godfiend across worlds, only one year of Imperial Lord Starquix’s lifespan would be consumed.
The subsequent choice was to know the target’s exact identity. After confirming the target, without flesh and blood as a guide, one would probably need to expend a few decades of lifespan to curse the target. The stronger the target was, the more one consumed their lifespan. It was also possible for him to consume over 100 years of his lifespan. Even if an Imperial Lord had a 10,000-year lifespan, they would still be very unwilling to consume their lifespan to curse somebody.
Imperial Lord Starquix only agreed after Lady Blackmoon and Emperor Roc gave him a promise. It was also because Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures were too attractive.
“We have to finish off that Godfiend,” said Emperor Roc solemnly. “Otherwise, we demons won’t be able to use our number advantage since our top forces are at a disadvantage in the human world. Without killing him, there’s nothing we can do about the situation. Many Regis Godfiends can fake their deaths and hold on for a long time. We can only hope that more World Entrances appear. It’s possible that we’ll foolishly wait for centuries for such an occurrence to happen. If this drags on for 1,000 years, it’s possible that the human world and the Demon Realm will separate.”
Lady Blackmoon nodded as well. “The human world has an extremely rich heritage. It’s easy for accidents to happen if we delay for too long. Ancestral Master Archean Eon was a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. He didn’t die in the outer realm. Instead, he died of old age in the human world. His entire life’s accumulations remain in the human world. Obtaining his treasures will be the greatest opportunity of our lifetimes.”
“Furthermore, he’s a Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence.” Imperial Lord Starquix’s eyes were filled with desire.
Tribulation Eminences were also divided into two categories: an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence, and a Physical Body Tribulation Eminence. One could also become both.
The demons’ cultivation system was better at cultivating the physical body. The three Imperial Lords were no different. The entire treasure hoard of a Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence drove the three Imperial Lords crazy.
“Carry out the plans from every front. Do not give the humans any chance,” said Lady Blackmoon coldly. “Demon Sage Deep Profundity and Demon Sage Fire Dragon have also arrived in the human world. When they return to the fifth Firmament realm, we will have them enter the World Gap and bring in more fifth Firmament demon monarchs through the World Gap. We will have a group of peak fifth Firmament demon monarchs enter the human world and kill all the Regis Godfiends guarding the cities. There are only nine Creation Supremacies in total. Most of them have to guard super-large city passes and their sects. There’s no way for them to rescue the Regis Godfiends in time.
“On the other hand, kill that mysterious Godfiend and have the one million demon monarchs hunt in the human world. Make it impossible for one to see mortals on the human world’s surface! Without enough mortals and a large number of Godfiends dying, we will have free rein over the human world,” continued Lady Blackmoon. “In fact, we demons can gradually damage the world’s foundation, pushing the human world towards World Degradation. Once it really degrades, the human world will shrink on a large scale. At that point, the world’s strongest existence can only be a Creation realm expert. The three human sects will definitely be afraid then. After all, it’s very difficult for the humans to produce another expert on par with Ancestral Master Archean Eon to elevate the world’s level.”
A low-level world made it very difficult for one to reach the Creation realm. It was more than ten times harder than the difficulty it was now. If they wanted to become an Imperial Lord, they would have to enter the River of Spacetime and risk their lives. It would be very difficult for the human world to get back on its feet again if it did undergo World Degradation. A World Upgrade was the good fortune of an entire world. A World Degradation was a calamity for the world.
“Without a large number of Godfiends obstructing us, we have plenty of ways to force the humans to bow their heads,” said Emperor Roc.
Attacking? Forcefully seizing the legacy left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon? The likelihood of successfully taking a Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s inheritance by force was very low.
It was more effective to use other methods to threaten humans. They wanted the human Creation Supremacies to hand Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s inheritance over voluntarily!
In terms of heritage, the demons had also produced a group of Tribulation Eminences. The three Imperial Lords were confident in forcing the humans to submit.
“Imperial Lord.” A handsome demon sage, Thousand Cricket, bowed respectfully.
Imperial Lord Starquix looked at Demon Sage Thousand Cricket. “Possess someone and enter the human world. Do it within a year.”
Thousand Cricket looked at the Imperial Lord. Previously, he had politely rejected the request. After all, his strength could no longer increase beyond the demon sage realm after he possessed another person’s body.
No...
In the legends of the Demon Realm, there was a possibility of a breakthrough after possession. However, the difficulty was in no way inferior to becoming a Tribulation Eminence. In the history of the Demon Realm, only a handful of people had achieved such a feat. They were much rarer than those that reached the Tribulation realm.
“Go. I’ll impart you with the best Demon Star Scroll of the karma lineage if you do.” Imperial Lord Starquix coldly glared at Thousand Cricket. “If you don’t go, you’ll die.”
“I shall go, my lord.” Thousand Cricket knelt respectfully.
The human world.
Archean Mountain didn’t announce Yellow Oscillate’s death, but they wrote letters to Yan Jin and King Calm Sea.
Patriarch Yellow Oscillate is dead?
King Calm Sea sat cross-legged in a chamber as he carefully read every word on the letter. The description was very simple. Supremacy Qin Wu had personally killed Patriarch Yellow Oscillate.
I wanted to kill you personally, but I never expected you to die so quickly. King Calm Sea’s eyes were cold. Suddenly, he sensed something. He looked up as the letter in his hand turned to dust.
Whoosh.
An illusory figure entered the chamber. It was a black-robed illusory figure.
“King Calm Sea.” The illusory black-robed figure smiled and bowed. “I believe you know that Yellow Oscillate is already dead. I hope that can relieve some of your anger.”“You want me to join the demon side and help you demons,” said King Calm Sea coldly “But you ended up killing my child?”
“Your identity is top secret. We were also afraid of letting Archean Mountain know about it,” said the illusory black-robed figure apologetically. “Only Demon Sage Nine Abyss and I know about your situation in the human world. Yellow Oscillate wasn’t aware, so he killed your child. This is all a misunderstanding.”
King Calm Sea snorted coldly.
“I’ll tell you a piece of good news as well,” said the illusory black-robed figure with a smile. “The demons have approved of giving you the Imperial Lord-level ultimate technique you’ve always wanted—the Time lineage.” “It’s been approved?” King Calm Sea’s pupils constricted.
“Yes.” The black-robed illusory figure smiled and said, “There are very few human Imperial Lord-level techniques. There isn’t even one for the Time lineage. This time, we demons agree to give you three of the Time lineage’s Imperial Lord-level techniques. Of course, you have to pay an equivalent price as per the old rules.”
“You were unwilling to give me the Time lineage’s Imperial Lord-level techniques the entire time. Now, you are giving me three?” King Calm Sea said, “Speak. What’s the matter?”
“Patriarch Yellow Oscillate and the others failed to kill an Archean Mountain Godfiend and ended up being killed by an Archean Mountain Creation Supremacy,” said the illusory black-robed figure with a smile. “What you need to do is figure out the identity of this Archean Mountain Godfiend, who was the target of the attempted assassination. It’s very simple. As long as you get a name, and there’s no mistake about his identity. We will hand over the three Imperial Lord-level ultimate techniques of the Time lineage.”
“I said I don’t know,” said King Calm Sea thoughtfully. “As long as you wish to figure it out, I believe you will be able to find out.” The illusory black-robed figure continued, “Just one name for three Imperial Lord-level techniques of the Time lineage.” With that said, the illusory black-robed figure dissipated. Final Chapter of Volume-Bloodblade Disc

chapters.title: Chapter 365 - Mysterious Godfiend
chapters.content:
Chapter 365 Mysterious Godfiend
Amidst the setting sun on an autumn day, Meng Chuan sat on the mountain peak and looked down at the vast land. He held an alcohol flask and drank happily.
Wonderful.
Meng Chuan threw the alcohol flask towards the sky, and it exploded in the distance. The alcohol splattered as the sunlight reflected off the alcohol, producing a myriad of colors.
After so many years, I’ve finally swept through the Great Zhou Dynasty’s entire underground. Meng Chuan felt a sense of accomplishment. Although he started sweeping through the Great Zhou Dynasty a long time ago, he had to start over again after one million demon monarchs invaded the human world! This was because the demon monarchs—whose numbers were several times more than before—had once again occupied the areas he had previously cleared. After refining the Bloodblade Disc, he had reached an unprecedented demon-slaying speed over the past few months. He had completely scanned and cleared the remaining areas. It’s broad daylight. I’m sitting here leisurely as I drink and enjoy the wind. How long has it been since I’ve been so extravagant? Meng Chuan found the sunlight very intoxicating.
For a long time, he spent most of the day investigating the land’s dark depths.
It’s time to report to the Supremacies. Meng Chuan stood up and disappeared into the horizon in a second.
Soon, the continuous mountain range of Archean Mountain appeared in front of him. Meng Chuan flew in and naturally didn’t encounter any obstruction. He directly went to Grotto-Heaven Pavilion to pay a visit to the Supremacy. “Supremacy.” Meng Chuan bowed. Li Guan sat in a pavilion, drinking tea as he smiled. “Meng Chuan, what’s the matter?”
Li Guan was very pleased that Meng Chuan had risen to prominence among the younger Godfiends. After all, he was close to the end of his lifespan. He had even tried his best to stall for time by entering a deep sleep. He looked forward to the appearance of a new powerful Godfiend. Only when one was born could he rest in peace. “I’ve already swept through the entire Great Zhou Dynasty,” said Meng Chuan. “Of course, it’s impossible for me not to miss out on any spots. However, there are definitely very few demon monarchs left in the Great Zhou Dynasty’s underground. It won’t pose a problem.”
“Good.” Li Guan’s eyes lit up.
“Then, do I help Two World Island and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven next?” asked Meng Chuan. There were still a large number of demon monarchs in other dominions, especially in Two World Island’s Great Yue Dynasty. It was well known for its numerous demon monarchs. He had investigated and slaughtered many demon monarchs in the Great Zhou Dynasty, so many had fled to the territories of the other dynasties.
Li Guan nodded. “We can help, but we have to inform them in advance. There’s no need to do good deeds secretly.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
“The calamity of a million demon monarchs affects our human foundation.” Li Guan looked at Meng Chuan. “What benefits do you want from helping them resolve such a huge calamity?”
“Benefits?” Meng Chuan was stunned.
“Of course,” said Li Guan with a smile. “Before this, when you weren’t good at underground reconnaissance, only King White Treasure was skilled at it. Black Sand Grotto-Heaven used this opportunity to make exorbitant requests of Archean Mountain and Two World Island.”
Meng Chuan fell silent and said, “I can’t think of anything regarding Two World Island, but I want to request something of Black Sand Grotto-Heaven.”
“You’re doing them a huge favor by resolving their troubles,” said Li Guan with a smile. “One million demon monarchs can threaten countless mortal lives and the lives of many Godfiends. They can shake a sect’s foundation. If you help without asking for benefits, what about the other Godfiends in the future? Will they not get any benefits? Even Two World Island and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven aren’t willing to owe you such a huge favor. If you don’t know what you want, Archean Mountain can help you put up the requests.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “I understand. I really don’t know what to get from Two World Island. I’ll leave it to the sect to decide. As for Black Sand Grotto-Heaven... I hope that they will let my mother, Bai Nianyun, come to the Great Zhou Dynasty and reunite with my father. They are to never be in the way of their reunion again.”
Meng Chuan had always yearned for his parents to reunite. He only had memories of his mother from before he was six years old. His mother had a gentle smile on her face as she taught him how to paint. She often appeared in his dreams when he was young.
Because of this, he diligently cultivated since he was young. He also vowed to exact revenge for his mother when he felt intense emotions. However, years after he became a Godfiend, he learned that his mother was still alive. She was a Grand Yin Holy Maiden of Black Sand Grotto-Heaven-Bai Nianyun.
Meng Chuan also knew that his father had always wanted to reunite with his mother, but he couldn’t do it due to his lack of strength. He hoped that Black Sand Grotto-Heaven would allow them to reunite on account of the debt of gratitude earned from slaying one million demon monarchs.
“This request isn’t difficult. I have a way to make them agree obediently,” said Li Guan. “But we can’t do it now. We have to delay it for a while.”
“Delay it?” Meng Chuan was puzzled. “Yes.” Li Guan nodded. “With your underground reconnaissance speed, the demons will definitely discover the matter when you enter the Great Yue Dynasty and slaughter demon monarchs. At that moment, if Bai Nianyun—who is the Holy Maiden of the Grand Yin Hall—suddenly reunites with your father, the demon’s will definitely put things together. The demons are pretty good at gathering intelligence.
“Also, a Grand Yin Holy Maiden has to be a virgin. If she gives up her status as a Holy Maiden and comes to our Great Zhou Dynasty to be with an ordinary Great Solar Godfiend, the demons will be puzzled. After a slight investigation, they will discover your parents secrets. The sect’s rules cannot be easily broken. It has been so many years since an exception was made. Why would Black Sand Grotto-Heaven suddenly make an exception? A Marquis Godfiend was sent to the Great Zhou Dynasty just like that to reunite with your father?”
“Furthermore, you’ll be killing demon monarchs in Two World Island and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven. Thus, it will be very normal for demons to suspect that Bai Nianyun and Meng Dajiang are related to the mysterious Godfiend,” said Li Guan. “For your safety, we have to delay the matter. Your safety involves the matter of one million demon monarchs and the entire war. We can’t take risks.”
“Yes,” said Meng Chuan respectfully. “There’s no need to delay it for too long,” said Li Guan. “Your father and mother aren’t old. With your cultivation speed, your parents will be reunited in ten years. Twenty years at maximum! Now, there are very few demon monarchs in the Great Zhou Dynasty. Although your father is a Patroller, the danger has greatly decreased due to the rarity of demon monarchs. Secondly, your father is strong enough. They can wait for ten to twenty years.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Understood.”
He also understood what the Supremacy meant. He was waiting for him to become stronger until he no longer feared any demon ambush.
Ten years? Twenty years? I should cultivate diligently and become stronger as soon as possible.
Archean Mountain.
Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang sat down and looked at Bai Yaoyue and Xu Yingwu.
“Congratulations,” said Xu Yingwu with a smile. “I heard that the mysterious Godfiend from Archean Mountain slaughtered so many demon monarchs that the demons laid an ambush. In the end, Qin Wu killed Patriarch Yellow Oscillate. This is the first demon sage we humans have killed since the war started.”
“It’s a demon sage whose body is still stuck at the fifth Firmament,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “It’s not worth mentioning.”
“Why did the three of you convene a gathering to meet Xu Yingwu and me?” asked the illusory Bai Yaoyue directly. “Our Archean Mountain Godfiend has already cleared the Great Zhou Dynasty’s underground,” said Li Guan. “Now, we can help your two sects resolve the demon monarchs in your respective territories.”
What?
Xu Yingwu revealed a look of excitement.
Bai Yaoyue had a complicated expression. How proud was she? However, Black Sand Grotto-Heaven had suffered huge losses under the threat of the million demon monarchs. Many patrolling Godfiends and Marquis Godfiends had died. How could she not be anxious? Although King White Treasure was good at underground reconnaissance, he could only kill 20,000 to 30,000 demon monarchs a year. One had to know that tens of thousands of demon monarchs would enter the human world every year.
It wasn’t of any use to the overall situation in the Black Sand Dynasty just by killing those few demon monarchs. The demon monarchs continued attacking their cities.
“If you have any requests, just tell us,” Xu Yingwu said sincerely. “I only hope that you can help Two World Island completely resolve the demon monarch disaster. Two World Island is truly out of solutions. Countless mortals die every day. Our Two World Island’s territory is too large. There are relatively few patrolling Godfiends. After so many deaths, the remaining patrolling Godfiends don’t dare to go too far from the cities. We can only let the demon monarchs hunt wantonly and watch as large numbers of mortals die every day. Many Godfiends are very aggrieved, but they have no choice. We really need help now.”
“Who is this mysterious Godfiend?” Bai Yaoyue asked. “What request does he have? As long as it doesn’t shake our sect’s foundation, my Black Sand Grotto-Heaven will satisfy him.”

chapters.title: Chapter 366 - Dragonize Pool
chapters.content:
Chapter 366 Dragonize Pool
“Yes, what request does he have? Do tell,” said Xu Yingwu.
“Our Archean Mountain Godfiend will make a request to Two World Island in the future,” said Li Guan with a smile. “Don’t worry. If you can’t fulfill this request, it’s enough to give him your treasure, the Yin-Yang Mirror.”
Xu Yingwu frowned slightly. The Yin-Yang Mirror?
Although Two World Island’s heritage wasn’t deep, making it impossible to compare with Archean Mountain and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven, it was ultimately a lineage passed down by Grandsire Yin Yang. He had an extremely high cultivation realm, and he had obtained a lot while traveling through the River of Spacetime. He had also left behind many treasures for his descendants. The Yin-Yang Mirror was a rather famous treasure that suited the Yin-Yang lineage.
“Alright.” Xu Yingwu quickly made a decision. “One request or the Yin-Yang Mirror. Two World Island will abide by it. We will do our best to satisfy this Godfiend’s request.” As long as they fulfilled the requests, there was no need to give the Godfiend the Yin-Yang Mirror. Two World Island naturally knew what to do.
“What about us? What do we need to pay?” Bai Yaoyue asked. She was prepared to take the hit. Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s heritage was much deeper than that of Two World Island. It had produced more than one Imperial Lord, and they had two complete outer realm legacies.
“It’s also a request,” continued Li Guan. “That Godfiend will also make a request to your Black Sand Grotto-Heaven. If you can’t do it, you can give the Godfiend the Dragonize Pool.”
“Dragonize Pool?” Bai Yaoyue’s expression changed slightly. “That’s a treasure that can purify a Dragon Divine Body cultivator’s bloodline. It can be used for generations.”
