The Phoenix Divine Body and Dragon Divine Body valued bloodlines the most. The purer one’s bloodline, the greater one’s potential.
“Although the Dragonize Pool is precious, there are very few human cultivators with a Dragon Divine Body. It only appears once every 1,000 years on average. Furthermore, most of them only reach the Darkstar realm. Very few become Regis Godfiends. It’s rare for the Dragonize Pool to be used. It’s not that important to the sect,” said Li Guan. “To be honest, if we wanted the Black Sand lineage, the Grand Yin lineage, and the Halberd lineage’s true treasures, it won’t be easy for you to agree. As for ordinary treasures, do you think our Archean Mountain will want them?”
Bai Yaoyue was tempted.
Yes.
They weren’t willing to part with Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s three key treasures. However, the Dragonize Pool was quite an oddball. After all, its usage rate was low, and its influence on the sect’s strength was low.
“The Dragonize Pool is one of Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s most precious treasures. It’s also unique in the human world. I will need to discuss with the other two Supremacies...” said Bai Yaoyue. Such a treasure’s fate was not something she could decide on her own.
“Alright.” Li Guan was very patient. He wanted to help Meng Chuan, so he didn’t choose other treasures.
Choosing the Grand Yin lineage treasure? If it wasn’t a core treasure, Bai Yaoyue could decide on her own. Thus, he needed to choose something that required a discussion between the three Supremacies. Furthermore, she wouldn’t be able to convince the other two Supremacies after her dirty linen was taken into account.
Bai Yaoyue fell silent for a moment as her true body discussed with the two other Supremacies in Black Sand Grotto-Heaven.
Although the three Supremacies were reluctant to part with the unique Dragonize Pool—the only one in the world—they knew that it was worth it if they could resolve the threat of a million demons. After all, ordinary treasures wouldn’t do to pay off this debt.
“As long as we can resolve the threat of a million demon monarchs,” said Bai Yaoyue, “we will do our best to fulfill the Godfiend’s request. Even if we can’t fulfill the Godfiend’s request, we will give the Dragonize Pool as a form of thanks.”
“Don’t worry. That Godfiend is very powerful. Perhaps his request isn’t that difficult,” said Li Guan with a smile.
“When will he enter our Black Sand Dynasty and begin hunting underground demon monarchs?” asked Bai Yaoyue.
“We should be first,” said Xu Yingwu.
“It will be done concurrently.” Li Guan said, “He will sweep through both territories repeatedly. This way, the demons will be at a loss. Furthermore, we will begin the underground reconnaissance tomorrow.” “This Godfiend didn’t immediately request for treasures. Instead, he only asks for one request?” Bai Yaoyue felt poignant. “I’m really curious which Godfiend it is. I should know all the Godfiends in the past 1,000 to 2,000 years.”
Xu Yingwu smiled as well. “I’m also curious, but we have to keep it a secret. The fewer people that know his identity, the safer it will be for him. He has already been a victim to an attempted assassination once.”
“Yes, we have to keep it a secret,” said Li Guan with a smile. “When it’s time to announce it, you will know his identity.”
Xu Yingwu smiled and said, “We have to thank him when the time comes. He has contributed greatly to the entire human race.”
“I want to meet him too.” Bai Yaoyue smiled as well.
The next day.
“Are you going to the other two dynasties to hunt down demon monarchs today?” Liu Qiyue looked at her husband as he ate breakfast.
“Yes.” Meng Chuan took two bites of a meat bun. “In three years, I should be able to clear the Great Yue Dynasty and Black Sand Dynasty’s territories.”
“King White Treasure is also carrying out underground reconnaissance in the Black Sand Dynasty. Wasn’t it of any use?” asked Liu Qiyue.
“It’s useful, but it has limited impact on the war’s situation,” said Meng Chuan. “With King White Treasure’s speed, he can only finish sweeping through the entirety of the Black Sand Dynasty in ten years. Also, tens of thousands of demon monarchs enter the human world every year. Every year, about 10,000 to 20,000 demon monarchs enter the Black Sand Dynasty’s territory. In ten years, the areas that King White Treasure has swept through would have an additional 100,000 demon monarchs.
“In the future, the demons will send one million more demon monarchs. King White Treasure’s efficiency is too low. He won’t be able to provide any substantial help. The demon monarchs will continue attacking Black Sand Dynasty’s cities and their mortals.”
Liu Qiyue understood.
“Alright, I’m setting off.” Meng Chuan finished another piece of flatbread and drank a large bowl of porridge before getting up. “Be careful,” instructed Liu Qiyue. Every day, she watched as her husband headed out to slaughter demon monarchs. However, the demons’ previous ambush left her more worried about him.
The more ruthless her husband was when he massacred the demon monarchs, the more the demons viewed Meng Chuan as a thorn in their side. They would think of ways to deal with him.
How terrifying was it to be the target of an entire species? Although a world separated them, it was still enough cause for alarm.
“The demons can’t do anything to me. They are just sending themselves to their deaths,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. Following that, he disappeared into the horizon.
Swoosh.
Soon, he entered the Great Yue Dynasty’s territory.
Meng Chuan wore a mask, and his hair was gray. He stepped on the Bloodblade Disc and transformed into a stream of light as he traversed the underground at high speed. He began hunting According to the size of the territory and the density of demon monarchs, Meng Chuan spent more time in the Great Yue Dynasty every day. He spent less time in the Black Sand Dynasty.
Days passed. In the blink of an eye, more than half a month had passed since he started his underground reconnaissance of the Great Yue Dynasty and the Black Sand Dynasty.Chi! Chi! Chi!
He discovered another underground demon monarch lair.
With Quintessential Essence threads and the Seamless domain, he easily slaughtered every demon monarch in the lair. The resentment and sinful aura-generated from his massacre—also took the initiative to attack Meng Chuan.
He had killed too many people. The baneful aura and resentment aura surrounded him, so it was only natural that it was extremely ferocious. The density of the baneful aura and sinful aura was so immense that it easily affected one’s mind and made one sink into madness. As for Meng Chuan, he wasn’t killing mortals but demon monarchs! He had killed a ludicrous number of demon monarchs -hundreds of thousands of them. If he had to endure it all by himself? He would have long gone mad. Therefore, he needed a way to resolve the resentment and sinful aura.
Meng Chuan’s method was by using Demon Slayer.
The hilt of the saber scabbard was disguised, but Demon Slayer—which was at his waiststill trembled. Inside the saber scabbard, Demon Slayer actively absorbed the resentment aura and sinful aura. Everything was absorbed. To it, this was a delicacy.
Clang! Clang! Clang! Demon Slayer violently trembled as it banged inside the scabbard.
Oh? Meng Chuan’s expression changed slightly. What’s happening to Demon Slayer? Demon Slayer was undergoing a qualitative change after absorbing the resentment aura and sinful aura left behind by hundreds of thousands of demon monarchs.

chapters.title: Chapter 367 - Fleeing to the Sea
chapters.content:
Chapter 367 Fleeing to the Sea
Meng Chuan looked at the scabbard at his waist. With his Seamless domain, he could clearly see that Demon Slayer’s blade was constantly trembling after absorbing the baneful aura. Its interior was undergoing a drastic change. Demon Slayer is originally an evil saber. It’s easy to devour its owner. Ever since it absorbed the Creation realm alien corpse, Demon Slayer has improved to the level of a Creation divine armament. It didn’t have a tough time absorbing the baneful aura. Now, is it finally about to change?
The previous upgrade was due to the absorption of the alien’s flesh and blood. As the alien had died a long time ago, it didn’t have much resentment or sin left. In terms of the impact from the alien’s baneful aura, Demon Slayer had only returned to its historical peak.
Clang! Clang! With the final clang of the scabbard, Demon Slayer regained its calm. However, its dark-red body turned pitch-black as though it wanted to absorb all light and block all perception of it.
For some reason, Meng Chuan was drawn to it. He reached out to grab the hilt of his saber and drew it.
You actually tempted me? Meng Chuan wasn’t afraid. He reached out and grabbed the hilt of the saber. The moment the saber was unsheathed, Meng Chuan’s body froze.
An endless sea of blood enveloped Meng Chuan’s consciousness and dragged him in.
Kill! Kill! Kill!
His entire mind was filled with killing intent. He wanted to be immersed in this slaughter forever.
At that moment, the Bloodblade Disc beneath Meng Chuan’s feet emitted a faint glow. It weakened the mental impact, and Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul protected his consciousness. Although Meng Chuan could sense the impact, he remained conscious.
What a powerful mental attack. Meng Chuan thought to himself. The Bloodblade Disc greatly weakened the impact, but it’s still much stronger than Demon Slayer’s previous surge. If it weren’t for the Bloodblade Disc, I would probably have to use all the strength of my fourth-level Essence Soul.
Ever since North Sense’s illusions had attacked him, Meng Chuan had discovered that the Bloodblade Disc could greatly weaken attacks on his Essence Soul. Therefore, even though he knew that Demon Slayer had transformed, he still had the confidence to draw his saber! Of course, it was also because he had long attained a fourth-level Essence Soul. After all, he could withstand Demon Slayer’s mental attack with a third-level Essence Soul.
If it weren’t for the Bloodblade Disc, I would still need strong willpower to withstand it with a fourth-level Essence Soul. To me, the master, the instinctive backlash is so potent. If I were to take the initiative to use it against my enemy, the strength would be several times greater. It should have an impact on a fifth-level Essence Soul expert.
The current Demon Slayer seems to be even more bizarre? Meng Chuan looked at the pitch-black saber body. The saber body was filled with a strange charm. The actual location of the saber is completely different from the location it appears to be in. Even the Seamless domain can’t detect the saber’s true location. It’s as though this saber is a small illusory world?
He swung his saber.
The black saber beam was blurry.
It was very strange.
The saber was like an embodiment of sin. Meng Chuan, the owner of the saber, could sense its true location through his Quintessential Essence. He couldn’t detect it through any other means, including his Essence Soul domain, electromagnetic domain, and Seamless domain.
I’ll slowly study Demon Slayer after I return. Meng Chuan looked forward to it. If it continues to absorb sin and resentment and continues growing, it might become an extremely powerful weapon. Demon Slayer’s help became limited when he had the Tribulation treasure, the Bloodblade Disc. Now, it was used to absorb resentment and sins.
Meng Chuan looked forward to its future.
Demon Slayer had never slaughtered experts so freely.
A demon monarch was at the same level as a Godfiend.
In the human world, how many Godfiends were there in a single era? Meng Chuan had slaughtered hundreds of thousands of demon monarchs. Demon Slayer had devoured all his sins and grievances. Every demon monarch’s sins and grievances were tens of thousands of times greater than that of a mortal. This naturally pushed Demon Slayer to an unprecedented level. Furthermore, as the war continued, Meng Chuan continued to slaughter demon monarchs. Demon Slayer continued to increase in strength.
Back then, Meng Chuan had chosen Demon Slayer in Archean Mountain’s Divine Armament Cavern. He named it Demon Slayer because he wanted it to drink demon blood, eat demon meat, and devour the demons’ resentment and sins.
However, killing hundreds of thousands of demon monarchs was something Meng Chuan of the past didn’t dare imagine.
“Go! That Godfiend is massacring underground demon monarchs. Let’s quickly flee!”
“Sigh, I was forced to come to the human world. Now, all I can do is flee.”
Demon monarchs fled underground.
“The Imperial Lords and demon sages got us to flee to the ocean, but they forbid us from returning to the Demon Realm.”
“If we dare disobey orders and return to the Demon Realm, we will definitely die. It’s best we live well in this human world.”
“I wonder when I’ll be able to kill all humans and survive above land.”
The ordinary demon monarchs fled the Great Yue Dynasty and the Black Sand Dynasty.
Swoosh.
In the evening, Meng Chuan returned to Jiang State Capital
“Ah Chuan.” Liu Qiyue welcomed him with a smile. “Didn’t you say that the number of underground demon monarchs has decreased recently?”
“That’s right. I’ve only been underground for about three months in the Great Yue Dynasty and the Black Sand Dynasty. The number of demon monarchs I’m discovering every day is decreasing. I’ve only managed to find about 30 demon monarchs today. I was able to find over 1000 demon monarchs a day previously.” Meng Chuan shook his head. “Archean Mountain’s letter.” Liu Qiyue handed it to Meng Chuan and smiled. “You’ll understand after reading it.”
Meng Chuan took the letter and opened it. He nodded and said, “It’s about the same as I guessed. The demons can’t tolerate my unrestrained massacre. They’ve finally allowed the demon monarchs to hide into the ocean. I’ve only been sweeping the Great Yue Dynasty and Black Sand Dynasty for three months. I haven’t even killed many demon monarchs. The demon monarchs don’t have much contact with each other. Even if they flee, it won’t result in most of them fleeing. Thus, it must be an order from the demons’ higher-ups.”
“It won’t be easy for them to send demon monarchs to attack cities after escaping into the ocean,” said Liu Qiyue with a smile. “The number of times they attack cities will probably decrease greatly.” “Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded. “The ocean is tens of thousands of kilometers away from some cities on land. If they were to travel on land, our patrolling Godfiends and flying demon servants would quickly discover them. If they were to travel underground, traveling tens of thousands of kilometers underground would be like traveling hundreds of thousands of kilometers on land. It’s extremely difficult, even for demon monarchs. “The number of attacks and attack frequency will decrease, but it will still continue,” said Meng Chuan. “If they really cared about the lives of these demon monarchs, they should have ordered them to return to the Demon Realm. World Entrances are everywhere in the world. It’s not difficult for them to escape back to the Demon Realm. Why didn’t they flee? Why? They want to attack cities frequently and force the Regis Godfiends to guard the cities.”
“Then what should we do?” asked Liu Qiyue.
“The ocean is several times larger than land.” Meng Chuan shook his head gently. “It will take me more than ten years to scan the depths of the ocean. However, the number of demon monarchs discovered on land will decrease. The threat to humans will be greatly reduced.”
Indeed.
A large number of demon monarchs had fled into the ocean. The number of demon monarchs hunting on the surface of the Great Yue Dynasty and the Black Sand Dynasty would naturally drop. This greatly reduced the pressure on the patrolling Godfiends.
At that moment, the upper echelons of Two World Island and Black Sand Dynasty were already celebrating! They could clearly tell from various intelligence that the instances of mortals being hunted had become rare. The land gradually became ‘peaceful.’
This made them think highly of this mysterious Godfiend because it only took him a few months to affect the war’s situation.
“For so many years, the demons haven’t pulled back a large number of demon monarchs to the ocean. Instead, they have been hiding underground and slaughtering humans everywhere,” said Liu Qiyue with a smile. “Now, they have all pulled back because of you, Ah Chuan.”
“It’s just a temporary relief. To remove the roots, I have to reach the Blood Droplet realm as soon as possible,” said Meng Chuan. “This way, my divine power’s strength will increase greatly. My reconnaissance speed will be faster. I can sweep them clean in the ocean in a short period of time. The demons don’t want a large number of demon monarchs to return to the Demon Realm? I’ll force them back. If they don’t return, I’ll kill them all.”
Demon Realm.
Suddenly, a powerful will descended in the dark cave abode of Demon Sage Thousand Cricket. An illusory figure appeared in the cave abode. It was Imperial Lord Starquix.
“Imperial Lord,” said Thousand Cricket respectfully.
“A year is almost up. Why haven’t you gone to the human world yet?” Imperial Lord Starquix looked coldly at Thousand Cricket. Thousand Cricket had already taken over a body and had become a third Firmament demon monarch with black scales and two red feelers on his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 368 - Thousand Cricket
chapters.content:
Chapter 368 Thousand Cricket
The demons were becoming more and more disadvantaged in the war. If Demon Sage Thousand Cricket hadn’t possessed a demon monarch, Imperial Lord Starquix would’ve crushed him to dust. He could only suppress his anger when he saw that he had already possessed a third Firmament centipede demon monarch.
“Imperial Lord.” Thousand Cricket was extremely respectful. “Apart from being extremely skilled in the karmic lineage, I need at least the demonic powers of a fifth Firmament demon monarch. I’ve just possessed a third Firmament demon monarch, so if I were to enter the human world blindly, I wouldn’t be of any use. Instead, if I exit from a World Entrance, I will be easily exposed. I might be killed by the humans. Therefore, I plan on cultivating to reach the threshold of a fourth Firmament demon monarch before entering the human world. Once I enter the human world, I will immediately recover to the fourth Firmament. With a fourth Firmament demon monarch body and my technique realm, I can also unleash the strength of a Regis Godfiend. This way, it will be safer when I infiltrate the human world.”
Imperial Lord Starquix nodded slightly. Although Demon Sage Thousand Cricket was afraid of death, Imperial Lord Starquix agreed with his explanation.
“When can you go to the human world?” asked Imperial Lord Starquix. “I’ll be able to reach the fourth Firmament in a year. When I’m close to the threshold, I’ll immediately enter the human world. After that, I believe I’ll be able to recover to the fifth Firmament in five years,” said Thousand Cricket.
Imperial Lord Starquix frowned. “Too slow.”
“I’ve only just recently possessed this new body. My Essence Soul needs time to adapt to it,” explained Thousand Cricket in a low voice. More haste less speed. Even if he wanted to reach the fifth Firmament tomorrow, he still needed time.
“I’ll give you this bottle of Essence Spirit Sanguine Aura.” Imperial Lord Starquix flipped his hand and took out a black jade bottle. The jade bottle flew to Thousand Cricket’s side.
Thousand Cricket was overjoyed. Essence Spirit Sanguine Aura? After possession, the recovery of one’s strength was actually a process of fusing one’s Essence Soul and body. By constantly cultivating one’s body, one’s body and Essence Soul would become more compatible. Their strength would constantly increase, allowing them to recover to the demon sage level. Typically, their compatibility would exceed 99%. However, to achieve 100% compatibility, it was more unlikely than becoming a Tribulation Eminence. In the human world’s history, only a handful of Tribulation Eminences were born.
Nobody had ever been able to fuse their Essence Soul and body perfectly after possession.
The Essence Spirit Sanguine Aura was a treasure that could aid one’s cultivation after possessing a new body. It could enhance the compatibility between one’s body and Essence Soul. At the very least, the effects were very obvious before the compatibility reached 95%. It was beneficial because it allowed for one to quickly pass through the weak stages after possession.
“Thank you, Imperial Lord. I will definitely reach the fourth Firmament within half a year. I will definitely reach the fifth Firmament within two years,” said Thousand Cricket.
“Quickly head to the human world and find out who that mysterious Godfiend is,” said Imperial Lord Starquix coldly. “As long as we find out who he is, we can kill him.”
They had long prepared many contingencies.
They had to kill the Godfiend. That mysterious Godfiend was the greatest obstacle for the million demon monarchs in the human world. If he was still alive, he would obstruct the demon monarchs’ havoc wreaking.
“As long as I reach the fifth Firmament, I’ll cast the Karmic Blood Curse on multiple demon monarchs,” said Thousand Cricket confidently. “Unless that mysterious Godfiend doesn’t take action, I’ll be able to find out his identity through the Karmic Blood Curse as long as he continues to kill demon monarchs.” “Alright.” Imperial Lord Starquix nodded. “Apart from the Demon Star Scroll and defensive treasure that we gave you previously, if you can complete the mission successfully, we will reward you greatly. You can choose one of the Imperial Lord-level weapons in our demon treasury.”
“Yes.” Thousand Cricket was overjoyed.
Imperial Lord Starquix’s figure dissipated. The joy on Thousand Cricket’s face vanished as he calmly looked at the jade bottle containing the Essence Spirit Sanguine Aura. He thought to himself, My lifespan was very long. I had cultivated my karmic lineage to the peak of the Grotto-Heaven realm. I had a chance of becoming an Imperial Lord, but I was forced to possess a new body, severing my chances. Humph, I know that you are doing this for the treasures of the humans’ Seventh Tribulation Eminence, Ancestral Master Archean Eon.
No matter how many thoughts ran through his mind, Thousand Cricket had to endure it.
Imperial Lord Starquix and the others also understood that the Thousand Cricket could not escape their control for a long time.
Nearly a year and a half after Meng Chuan was ambushed, Demon Sage Thousand Cricket sneaked into the human world at night.
It was an inconspicuous World Entrance in the vast sea. It was too far away from land! The three human sects only sent an avian demon servant to monitor the entrance secretly. It was difficult for them to arrange enough manpower to intercept them. Unless demon monarchs entered en masse, the humans could only turn a blind eye.
Swoosh.
Thousand Cricket flew out of the World Entrance and stood above the vast sea, breathing in the human world’s air.
In the human world, I’ll deduce the heavenly secrets and divine the future. I might be the final winner. Thousand Cricket instantly entered the vast sea. The moment he entered, his body underwent changes as he rapidly transformed into a fourth Firmament demon monarch.
For ordinary demon monarchs, they had to enter seclusion—they couldn’t be disturbed – when attempting to break through to the fourth Firmament realm.
However, if one’s technique realm was ridiculously high...
For example, when Meng Chuan became a Marquis Godfiend, he had broken through during a life-and-death battle.
Thousand Cricket was a demon sage to begin with. This breakthrough was as easy as breathing for him.
March-a month after Thousand Cricket infiltrated the human world.
At noon, the sun was shining brightly.
Meng Chuan flew high in the sky and ended his underground reconnaissance for the day. Now, he only spent six hours a day carrying out a simple underground reconnaissance of the land beneath the three dynasties and the ocean. The efficiency was just too low. Even if he attacked with all his might, the number of demon monarchs he killed a year couldn’t match the number the demons sent in every year. The demon monarchs would hide far away from land. Other than the demon monarch attacks on cities once every two months, demon monarchs became a rare sight in the human world. Meng Chuan naturally spent more time cultivating.
A beard lathered was half shaved.
Only by reaching the Blood Droplet realm could he completely resolve the threat of the million demon monarchs.
My dad’s days are much more carefree now. Meng Chuan passed his father’s patrol area from high up in the sky.
He could see an inconspicuous wooden hut on a nameless mountain.
Meng Dajiang lived here. He had a tree demon servant as his companion. Now, demon monarchs rarely hunted mortals. They only discovered two to three demon monarchs every month. The demon monarchs were weak, so the avian demon servants could easily dispatch them. Meng Dajiang only took action once every month or two. He was indeed quite relaxed.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan didn’t disturb his father as he flew back to Jiang State Capital.
His wife, Liu Qiyue, was happily preparing lunch. Meng Chuan only carried out underground reconnaissance for six hours a day. After finishing, he rushed back at noon and could spend more time as a couple together.
Oh? Meng Chuan landed in the courtyard and looked at his wife, who was busy cooking in the kitchen. He blinked in disbelief.
Liu Qiyue carried the wooden tray out of the kitchen. On the wooden tray were plates of dishes. She smiled at Meng Chuan and took the initiative to release her Essence Soul fluctuations.
Third-level Essence Soul? Meng Chuan looked at his wife excitedly.

chapters.title: Chapter 369 - Liu Qiyue’s Queen Liu Qiyue’s Queen Conferment
chapters.content:
Chapter 369 Liu Qiyue’s Queen Conferment
Liu Qiyue smiled brightly and nodded. “I broke through this morning when I was practicing my archery.” “That’s great.” Meng Chuan was overjoyed. “I’ll head to Archean Mountain later to exchange for the treasures needed for the breakthrough. You have to be careful when you are breaking through to the Seamless realm. You can’t be careless.”
His wife was one year younger than him. However, because she had cast Phoenix’s Nirvana several times, her vitality had begun to decline from its peak slowly. Of course, this decline had only gone on for about two years. Her vitality remained at an extremely high level, and her chances of becoming a Regis Godfiend were at least 98 percent. Almost every Marquis Godfiend would choose to break through with such chances. “Okay.” Liu Qiyue sensed her husband’s concern and nodded with a smile. “Alright, let’s have lunch first.”
Ultimately, his wife didn’t have a 100% chance of becoming a Regis Godfiend. Meng Chuan naturally had to make sure everything was in place. He arrived at Archean Mountain that afternoon.
“Supremacy, my wife, Liu Qiyue, plans on breaking through to become a Regis Godfiend in three days,” reported Meng Chuan to Li Guan. “Liu Qiyue is about to break through?” Li Guan was overjoyed. “This is a joyous occasion for our Archean Mountain.” A Regis Godfiend with a Phoenix Divine Body was much more powerful than ordinary Regis Godfiends.
“I’ll first exchange for the treasures needed for her breakthrough,” said Meng Chuan.
“Don’t worry. In three days, my Essence Soul avatar will guard Jiang State Capital to prevent the demons from disturbing her.” Li Guan smiled radiantly.
“I’ll take my leave.” Meng Chuan cupped his hands and left to prepare the appropriate treasures. Swoosh! Swoosh! Qin Wu and Luo Tang’s illusory figures soon arrived. “Good news. Liu Qiyue will break through to become a Regis Godfiend in three days,” said Li Guan with a smile.
“Oh?” Luo Tang was pleasantly surprised. “She has a Phoenix Divine Body. After becoming a Regis Godfiend, her strength will soar to the Creation realm when she casts Phoenix’s Nirvana. If she becomes a peak Regis Godfiend in the future, her strength will soar to the peak of the Creation realm once she casts Phoenix’s Nirvana. The arrows of a peak Creation realm expert will be stronger than you, am I right, Qin Wu?” Sharpshooters were the strongest among their peers at the same level. “The higher her realm is, the closer she is to a true Phoenix when casting Phoenix’s Nirvana. However, she will also burn more of her lifespan,” said Qin Wu. “Therefore, it can only be used as a forbidden spell—one not to be used easily and recklessly.” “That’s for sure.” Luo Tang nodded. “But at a critical moment, she will have the strength of a Creation realm expert. You used the last phoenix feather on her. Now, it looks like it has paid off.”
Qin Wu smiled and said, “It’s Meng Chuan. Meng Chuan didn’t use much of his credits on himself. Instead, he spent a lot on Liu Qiyue. He exchanged many treasures that are beneficial to the Phoenix Divine Body, spending more than 600 million credits on Liu Qiyue.” “Meng Chuan’s credits have exceeded six billion,” said Li Guan with a smile. “Yet, he has just used a little. We’ve already given him less than necessary.”
He received relatively fewer credits for the World Gap’s Origins treasure, the Three Terminal Formation, and so on. If he were a Creation Supremacy, credits became meaningless.
Three days later. Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar came to Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue’s residence. He sat there, drinking and chatting with Meng Chuan. Meng Chuan’s focus was on his wife—who was currently in seclusion. “Liu Qiyue’s vitality has only declined from its peak for two to three years. With the treasures you prepared for her breakthrough, it will make up for some flaws in her vitality. She will definitely succeed this time,” consoled Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar. From his point of view, he yearned for a Regis Godfiend with a Phoenix Divine Body. “Yea,” replied Meng Chuan. His gaze often landed on the distant door. From inside the room, one could be led to the hidden chamber.
“Breaking through has something to do with one’s mind and will. If one’s mind is strong, their chances of a successful breakthrough will increase. In our era, Godfiends experience war. Their wills generally exceed the usual standards,” continued Li Guan.
“Yes,” replied Meng Chuan. All he did was occasionally take a sip of his alcohol as he paid attention to the room.
“All you know to do is reply tersely.” Li Guan was helpless. He had kindly consoled Meng Chuan, but Meng Chuan was still distracted. He couldn’t be bothered to say anything else. He just drank! The night sky darkened.
In the middle of the night, a strange fluctuation suddenly spread out in all directions from the chamber. Furthermore, a mysterious domain began to envelop the surrounding void. When it reached Meng Chuan and Li Guan, Li Guan easily prevented the domain from approaching him. Meng Chuan allowed the domain to sweep past him as he revealed a surprised smile. “Seamless domain? Qiyue succeeded.” Meng Chuan was overjoyed. He had been very worried. In war, Marquis Godfiends weren’t strong enough to deal with many dangerous situations. His wife could only cast Phoenix’s Nirvana repeatedly. How long could she live if she kept consuming her lifespan?
Now that she was a Regis Godfiend, she could deal with most problems with her normal strength. She seldom needed to use Phoenix’s Nirvana. Furthermore, she would have a 500-year lifespan.
Creak.
The door opened, and Liu Qiyue walked out. She smiled at her husband before bowing to Li Guan. “Supremacy.” “Very good.” Li Guan smiled and nodded. “In order to deal with the war, our Archean Mountain has decided that beginning with you two, the statuses of newly-advanced Regis Godfiends will not be publicly announced. Firstly, it will make it harder for the demons to determine our strength. Secondly, it’s more advantageous for you when dealing with the demons.”
“I understand,” said Liu Qiyue respectfully. “In the future, it will be publicized when it’s time.” Li Guan flipped his hand and took out a fiery-red divine bow and quiver. The divine bow and quiver flew towards Liu Qiyue. “Every Regis Godfiend will be given a suitable treasure. Liu Qiyue, an outer realm expert with the phoenix bloodline has used this set of Imperial Lord-level divine armaments. Take it.”
“Imperial Lord-level divine armaments?” Liu Qiyue was alarmed. However, under Li Guan’s gaze, she still extended her hand to receive them.
“I won’t be able to hold on for much longer.” Li Guan smiled at Meng Chuan and his wife. “In the future, Archean Mountain will depend on those from the younger generation.”
With that said, he left.
Liu Qiyue looked at the bow that emitted a terrifying aura. The divine bow seemed to have been soaked in blood. Every arrow was filled with an endless aura of destruction. Every newly-advanced Regis Godfiend would obtain treasures! Archean Mountain naturally placed greater importance on Liu Qiyue since she could obtain a Creation Supremacy’s combat strength when she cast Phoenix’s Nirvana.
Ordinary Creation Supremacies could choose a Tribulation treasure that suited them. There was one Tribulation-level divine bow, but one required a fifth-level Essence Soul to refine it with the Intrinsic Artifact Refining Art. Although this was only an Imperial Lord-level divine bow, this bow was used by an outer realm Phoenix bloodline expert—which meant it was very suitable for Liu Qiyue.
“Supremacy said that he couldn’t hold on for much longer. What does he mean by that?” asked Liu Qiyue softly.
“Supremacy is close to the end of his lifespan. He can only use a mystic technique to stall for time,” said Meng Chuan. Li Guan would occasionally disappear for hundreds of years in Archean Mountain’s history. From the time the ancient Godfiends woke up, Li Guan probably went into a deep slumber occasionally. As for deep sleep, there was likely a limit. This was because the ancient Godfiends that had awakened were all Regis Godfiends that were from the past 2,000 years.
The next day. Meng Chuan continued his underground reconnaissance for six hours. Most demon monarchs had fled to the ocean, but there were still a few demon monarchs that thought they could outsmart him. They remained underground in the Great Zhou Dynasty, the Great Yue Dynasty, and the Black Sand Dynasty. In fact, Meng Chuan’s reconnaissance was mainly done on land. This was to ensure the safety of the three dynasties. Only when he reached the Blood Droplet realm did he prepare to probe the sea. “It’s been a long time since we came out for a walk.” On a spring afternoon, Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue walked alongside a river in Jiang State Capital. Peach blossoms filled the city.
Meng Chuan and his wife arrived at a spot with few people and enjoyed the spring view.
“There are so many peach blossoms here.” Liu Qiyue suddenly saw a large patch of peach blossoms in front of her. She ran excitedly. Liu Qiyue felt captivated by the peach blossoms.
The flowers didn’t captivate her, but she surrendered herself to the flowers’ beauty. With her husband accompanying her, the people in the city living in peace, and her becoming a Regis Godfiend, Liu Qiyue was naturally enthralled by the fragrance of flowers. Meng Chuan watched with a smile. His wife’s face and the peach blossoms reflected each other. This scene was like a painting. It was beautiful. I’ll paint this scene when I get back.

chapters.title: Chapter 370 - Fifth-Level Essence Soul
chapters.content:
Chapter 370 Fifth-Level Essence Soul
After coming back from the stroll, Meng Chuan went to the study to paint. On the unfolded piece of canvas, Meng Chuan first drew the peach blossoms. The dark-brown twisted branches and leaves were filled with vibrance. The peach blossoms were beautiful. Some of the peach blossoms had completely bloomed, while some were still flower buds.
The flower pistils seemed to tremble slightly in the breeze. The painting was more lively than what he had seen in reality. Paintings were like this—they originated from reality, but they exceeded reality. Then, he began painting the person. Painting peach blossoms was a display of excellent technique. Painting a human was the soul underlying it! The finishing touch! A beauty stood in front of the peach blossoms as she gently sniffed the peach blossoms’ fragrance. She looked even more beautiful than the flowers.
“What are you painting? Liu Qiyue—who had been practicing her archery for two hours-came to the study. She came to Meng Chuan’s side and took a look. She immediately saw the beautiful woman in the painting. Wasn’t that her? Wasn’t this the peach blossom thicket they had just walked past today?
Liu Qiyue found it sweet as she couldn’t help but look at her husband.
Meng Chuan glanced at his wife. The couple looked at each other and smiled.
“I won’t disturb you. Continue painting. After painting it, let me store it well.” As Liu Qiyue spoke, she walked to another desk and happily began grinding the ink. She was about to practice her calligraphy. She couldn’t help but laugh when she was grinding the ink. Every year, Meng Chuan completed a painting for his wife. Liu Qiyue would put the paintings away carefully and take them out when she was free to take a look at them. She could feel her husband’s feelings for her in the paintings. Sometimes, she was glad... Although the war loomed over them, she felt very grateful that she could be husband and wife with Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan was naturally immersed in his painting. He had interacted with his wife for too long. They had known each other since they were young, and they had supported each other for many years.
Every day, he searched for demon monarchs, exhausting himself. His wife personally prepared breakfast in the morning, and his wife would wait for him at night. This made Meng Chuan even more grateful to his wife for her sacrifices. His wife could have arranged for the servants to prepare the meals, but she insisted on doing it personally. Meng Chuan could sense his wife’s care for him. It was truly a blessing to have a soulmate in this bloody war.
As Meng Chuan painted, his Essence Soul constantly emitted a spiritual glow. Most of the time, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul would transform when he painted his wife. However, the degree of transformation varied. This time, it was clearly more intense.
Boom!
Meng Chuan stopped painting. He felt his Essence Soul begin to undergo a qualitative change. It was about to reach a new level. It’s beginning to break through? A fifth-level Essence Soul? Meng Chuan felt mixed emotions. He obtained a fourth-level Essence Soul when he was 48. Today, he had finally reached the fifth-level of Essence Soul—the Possession stage-at 58. Most demon sages and Creation Supremacies possessed fifth-level Essence Souls. For example, King Calm Sea was temporarily unable to reach the Creation realm because his Essence Soul was stuck at the fourth level.
It only took Meng Chuan ten years to attain a fifth-level Essence Soul.
These ten years were the most tragic ten years of the war between humans and demons. The humans had completely abandoned all prefecture and county cities. The ancient Godfiends woke up and protected the large cities with all their might. As for the vast majority of the commoners, they could only survive in the wilderness with great difficulty.
They were also hunted by demon monarchs. The patrolling Godfiends disregarded their lives and patrolled the forests and wilderness, protecting all of humanity. Dozens of Marquis Godfiends had died in battle all across the world.
The World Gap had appeared, connecting the human world and the Demon Realm, causing the two worlds to become even closer. More and more experts entered the human world. One by one, demon sages that had carried out possession arrived. Xue Feng died at the hands of a demon sage.
I now have a fifth-level Essence Soul. I believe it won’t take long for me to reach the Blood Droplet realm. I hope I can completely resolve the threat of a million demon monarchs. Without a million demon monarchs in the human world, the war will be much easier for us with our top combat strength. After his Essence Soul stabilized, Meng Chuan continued painting. After dinner, he continued painting for four more hours, completing the artwork in one session.
“Qiyue.” Meng Chuan placed the painting in front of his wife. “It’s done.” “You finished it quite quickly this time.” Liu Qiyue smiled as she looked at the painting. It was a half-body portrait. She gently sniffed the fragrance of flowers, exuding extreme beauty. After taking a closer look at the painting, she looked at the painting’s name-Congratulations to my wife’s queen conferment. Liu Qiyue smiled as she glanced at her husband.
“Congratulating me for becoming a queen?” “You have to keep it well. The news of you becoming a Regis Godfiend is still a secret. You can’t let outsiders see it,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “Don’t worry. No one will see it.” Liu Qiyue put it away happily.
That night. Meng Chuan entered the chamber and sat cross-legged.
I can begin cultivating the Blood Droplet realm since my Essence Soul has reached the fifth level. Meng Chuan closed his eyes and focused. He used the Power of Essence Soul to scan the microscopic world.
The further one’s physical body cultivation system progressed, the more profound their physical body cultivation would be. This made one’s body even more terrifying. This was indeed a powerful and inconceivable cultivation system. Even Ancestral Master Archean Eon-who had reached the Seven Tribulation realm—had left this legacy in Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven. However, Ancestral Master Archean Eon had only obtained a few Cosmos Crystals. Due to this, only a few humans could cultivate this system.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan’s Power of Essence Soul swept across his entire body. Every part of his body was magnified countless times in front of his eyes. After attaining a fifth-level Essence Soul, his perception of the microscopic world became even sharper. A drop of blood was as large as a vast world. He could easily see the vast amount of particles in his blood. He could even see the particle spaces within the particles.
Oh? Meng Chuan’s Power of Essence Soul swept across his dantian space. The Source of the Seamless Realm in his dantian space was extremely small. He couldn’t see it with his inner vision. However, the physical body cultivation system’s Essence Soul mystic technique allowed Meng Chuan to see the microcosm. He also saw his Source of the Seamless Realm.It was a sphere much smaller than the particles. When using the microscopic viewing mystic technique with a fifth-level Essence Soul, Meng Chuan felt like a mortal viewing a mountain.
The sphere was purple-brown in color. However, countless blinding white patterns adorned its surface. Wisps of white light shot out from the sphere’s two poles—this was an extremely condensed Seamless Quintessential Essence. Furthermore, the white light that shot out from the two poles formed a special fluctuation when influenced by each other. This fluctuation spread out in all directions before returning to the sphere.
Cultivation in the Seamless realm requires one to think of a way to reduce the size of the Source. Only then will my Quintessential Essence become purer. Now that I have a fifth-level Essence Soul, my control over it has greatly increased. I can make it even smaller.
His Essence Soul thought had long fused with the sphere’s body. As the Essence Soul controlled the Source with all its might, the sphere slowly collapsed. The density of the sphere slowly increased, and the Quintessential Essence became purer. After the sphere’s diameter was reduced by a third, the sphere stopped shrinking and regained its stability.
Time to begin cultivating the Blood Droplet realm. Within each particle, there was a particle space. Each particle space was as vast as the starry sky. A tiny Meng Chuan stood at the core of every particle. After attaining a fifth-level Essence Soul, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul thoughts had undergone a qualitative change.
Every Essence Soul thought became more corporeal—it was as if they were tiny humans. At the same time, it shrank to only one percent of the size of a particle core. Furthermore, they could carry complete memory imprints. This was a requirement for one to reach the Blood Droplet realm. Previously, a mere Essence Soul thought could not possess Meng Chuan’s complete memories. However, it was now possible for a fifth-level Essence Soul to do so.
Rumble!
Meng Chuan followed the Blood Droplet realm cultivation technique. The tiny Meng Chuan sat cross-legged on the particle core and slowly sank into it.

chapters.title: Chapter 371 - Blood Droplet Realm (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 371 Blood Droplet Realm (1)
The tiny Meng Chuan sank to the center of the particle core. At that moment, the Essence Soul thought was like a human soul. The particle core was like a human body, and the massive particle space was like the living world.
Heaven Earth Dharma Domain.
The Dharma Domain he had comprehended had become the laws of this particle world. From a crude particle space, it transformed into a small particle world. Even the particle core had completely transformed. Even the extremely tiny particles required astonishing amounts of energy to function. At this moment, wisps of Seamless Quintessential Essence entered the particle space and were constantly devoured by it. Finally, this tiny particle world completely transformed.
These tiny particle worlds had Meng Chuan’s complete memories and Meng Chuan’s cultivation. Even if Meng Chuan were to be reduced to a particle after being blasted to smithereens, he would be able to recover his body slowly as time passed.
In the Blood Droplet realm, one had to cultivate all the particles in one’s body and transform the particle spaces into a particle world. Every particle became a small world. Once fighting, one would be able to control the power of countless particle worlds. This would naturally make one’s body stronger than any demon monarch’s body.
Even if others were powerful enough to shatter a Blood Droplet realm expert’s body, the countless particles could instantly condense into a complete body, free of injuries. This was the so-called blood reincarnation. One had to know that particles were extremely tiny-invisible to the naked eye. One might not necessarily be able to shatter the particle world even if somebody destroyed the body to the point where one couldn’t see it with the naked eye...
Every particle was extremely tough and formed a Dharma domain.
If there was still a drop of blood left after the explosion? The particles would definitely be intact if the blood remained. This resulted in instant recovery. Killing a Blood Droplet realm expert requires one to destroy all particle worlds in the expert’s body. A Blood Droplet realm expert’s body is powerful, and their divine powers are impressive. How great would the difference in strength need to be if one wants to shatter a particle world? If one couldn’t damage the particle world, the Blood Droplet realm expert would be able to maintain peak strength without any losses. If the particles could be annihilated, it would be very difficult to recover from the damage. The recovery process was just like how Meng Chuan was currently cultivating. It would take him a long time to recultivate each particle world.
Every expert that reaches the late stages of this cultivation system is as powerful as a monster. In terms of head-on combat, it’s fine. At the Blood Droplet realm, one only has the strength of a weak Creation realm expert at best. For the Godfiend cultivation system, some Regis Godfiends have the strength of a Creation realm expert. However, those that follow this physical body cultivation system have much stronger vitality! They can be defeated, but it’s very difficult to kill them. Any Blood Droplet realm expert should have the confidence to fight someone above their level.
The only flaw in this system was the high threshold of cultivation. A fifth-level Essence Soul was required to reach the Creation realm (demon sage). The threshold for a Regis Godfiend (a fifth Firmament demon monarch) was typically a third-level Essence Soul. This was also the most common cultivation system in many other worlds.
Compared to those two cultivation systems, this physical body cultivation system’s difficulty was much greater. The Blood Droplet realm required a fifth-level Essence Soul. However, it was still difficult to conceal how powerful this system was.
To reach the higher Sage Becoming realm, one needs a sixth-level Essence Soul. They also need to reach the Grotto-Heaven realm. These requirements are even more stringent than what is needed to reach the Creation realm. However, in the human world, only Supremacy Li Guan has a sixth-level Essence Soul. However, he isn’t as strong as how Sage Becoming realm experts are described-invincible beneath the Imperial Lord realm. But this cultivation system requires one to consume 1.5 kilograms of Cosmos Crystals before they gain basic mastery. One needs to consume 50 kilograms of Cosmos Crystals to reach the Sage Becoming realm. The top experts of this cultivation system probably use this condition to control this system’s number of cultivators. I suppose this is the case, or is it a natural restriction in the vast River of Spacetime?
The Cosmos Crystals were the most crucial resource of this cultivation system. Basic mastery required Cosmos Crystals. Without this magical item, following this cultivation system was useless. As a Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence, Ancestral Master Archean Eon—who had traveled the River of Spacetime-was amazed by this system. With his status, he could have reached the Mythical realm. However, he had only obtained a small amount of Cosmos Crystals. On one hand, Cosmos Crystals were very magical and rare. On the other hand, they were almost completely plundered by the experts of this cultivation system. Wherever Cosmos Crystals appeared, experts of this cultivation system would appear to vie for it. The physical body cultivation system’s experts had no other choice. This was a necessary item if they wanted to progress on this cultivation system!
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan tried to absorb the Power of Origins from the small grotto-heaven to cultivate. The Power of the Grotto-Heaven Origins is indeed magical. It’s more suitable for body cultivation than Seamless Quintessential Essence. Meng Chuan came to a conclusion after comparison. Even if the small grotto-heaven’s Power of Origins was consumed, it could be replenished via external sources. Its replenishment speed was much faster than Meng Chuan’s recovery of Quintessential Essence as a Regis Godfiend. After cultivating for more than two hours, he stopped when he felt his Essence Soul’s fatigue. According to this speed, I reckon I’ll be able to master it in half a year. Meng Chuan’s eyes were filled with anticipation. The laws of the lightning lineage govern my Blood Droplet realm particle worlds. I wonder what changes my divine powers will undergo, and what new divine powers I will gain?
He had broken through to the Blood Droplet realm from the Undying realm. His original divine powers would undergo a qualitative change, and new divine powers would appear.Days passed. Although most demon monarchs had fled to the vast ocean and had hidden beneath the sea bed, they still attacked cities on a large-scale every two months. More than 30,000 third Firmament demon monarchs rushed to the three dynasties under orders. They didn’t dare to travel on land. All they could do was burrow underground and travel very slowly.
However, attacking cities also caused great damage to the humans. When demon monarchs attacked cities, fourth Firmament demon monarch teams and fifth Firmament demon monarchs would occasionally ambush guardian Godfiends.
“Ah Chuan, another Marquis Godfiend died in Black Sand Grotto-Heaven,” said Liu Qiyue. “It’s Marquis Yue Tong. A fifth Firmament demon monarch ambushed him. Marquis Yue Tong failed to survive.” “Oh?” Meng Chuan frowned slightly. “Although the frequency of attacks on cities is lower after they fled to the ocean, each attack is more ruthless than before,” said Liu Qiyue. “The speed at which Marquis Godfiends die is only slightly slower than before. Ever since you were ambushed two years ago, our Archean Mountain has lost two Marquis Godfiends, and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven has lost three.”
“The demons are attacking the cities to force Regis Godfiends to guard them. They won’t let the ancient Godfiends sleep,” said Meng Chuan. By forcing the demon monarchs to flee, life on land was much more peaceful. The patrolling Godfiends didn’t die as often. The mortals in the wilderness led better lives. They even began forming small villages. However, the pressure on the cities remained! This was also the pressure the demons wanted to give the humans.
Any of the three major sects would feel their hearts ache when one or two Marquis Godfiends died every year. This had happened even when they had arranged for a large number of ancient Godfiends to share the burden. “Don’t worry. One million demon monarchs will soon become history,” said Meng Chuan. “Become history?” Liu Qiyue looked at Meng Chuan. “You’re about to break through?” “In a few days,” said Meng Chuan.
Liu Qiyue’s eyes were filled with excitement. “That’s great.”
Five days later, in a chamber.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged. Suddenly, his body emitted a dazzling rainbow glow. Lightning burst out from his body, causing multi-colored energy to stir. He was like a small world, bringing with him a terrifying pressure.eng Chuan sat cross-legged. Suddenly, his body emitted a dazzling rainbow glow. Lightning burst out from his body, causing multi-colored energy to stir. He was like a small world, bringing with him a terrifying pressure.

chapters.title: Chapter 372 - Blood Droplet Realm (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 372 Blood Droplet Realm (2)
Blood Droplet realm? Meng Chuan opened his eyes.
After the most critical transformation in his mind, his entire body transformed. At that moment, all the particles in the world resonated as a colorful glow emanated from his body. Meng Chuan could sense the astonishing changes he had undergone. With a single movement, he teleported out of the chamber and into the night sky.
Swoosh.
He left Jiang State Capital and arrived high in the night sky outside the city. Meng Chuan stood in midair.
Five divine powers. An invisible force gathered around Meng Chuan’s body and transformed into a cloak. This made Meng Chuan smile. From the looks of it, I can use the Indestructible Divine Armor to condense a robe. Even if it shatters, I can instantly reproduce it. It’s much more suitable than ordinary robes.
The Indestructible Divine Armor could form a transparent membrane on the skin. Its toughness had been greatly enhanced. Typically, he could easily withstand peak Regis Godfiend attacks. It could even transform into robes, armor, and even weapons! However, the effectiveness of the weapons was average. This divine power mainly protected the body.
Electromagnetic domain.
Meng Chuan opened the vertical eye at his glabella.
Boom
This was a domain formed by the electromagnetic waves in the particle world. The electromagnetic waves swept across a radius of 50 kilometers around him. However, it rapidly weakened when it penetrated the ground. Meng Chuan landed on the ground with a whoosh. The electromagnetic waves penetrated five kilometers into the ground before stopping. In the past, my electromagnetic domain’s underground range was 1.5 kilometers around me.
Now, it’s five kilometers? Meng Chuan revealed a look of delight. This way, my reconnaissance efficiency has increased by more than 30 times. In other words, even if the demon monarchs hide in the vast ocean, I can sweep through the entire world in over a year. Meng Chuan was very excited. This was the happiest moment he had ever experienced after reaching the Blood Droplet realm.
There are other changes to my electromagnetic domain. Meng Chuan could sense his electromagnetic domain’s newfound strength. Lightning could be produced at any spot in the electromagnetic domain. Every bolt of lightning was very powerful. Dozens of lightning bolts were enough to kill a Marquis Godfiend. However, this wasn’t the key point. The key was the convergence of countless electromagnetic waves in the particle world. This divine power finally produced another ability. I’ll give it a try. Meng Chuan stood on the ground in the wilderness. With a thought, a Bloodblade appeared in front of him and flew out.
Swoosh!
The Bloodblade transformed into a beam of light, and its speed was extremely fast. However, when it was flying within the electromagnetic domain, the electromagnetic field constantly propelled it. Lightning flowed through the Bloodblade, and the terrifying thrust carried the Bloodblade as it constantly accelerated. Fast, faster, even faster! After circling around Meng Chuan eight times in a 50-kilometer radius, the Bloodblade’s speed reached its limit! With the worldly laws suppressing the Bloodblade, it could no longer accelerate any further. However, at this moment, the Bloodblade was already 60% faster than its previous speed. It also had several-fold greater strength than before.
After I obtained the Bloodblade Disc, I used it to gain insights into runes. Two months ago, I reached Greater Mastery of the Dharma Domain realm with my Infinite Saber. The Bloodblade Disc can kill enemies, and I believe it can match a newly-advanced Creation realm expert. However, when accelerated by the electromagnetic domain, the Bloodblades’ power will increase by several-fold. They’re comparable to a peak Creation realm expert’s attack.
The flaw is that it takes time to accelerate. Furthermore, it has very few variations in its movements.
It had to circle Meng Chuan eight times and fly over 1,500 kilometers before it reached maximum speed. If it was obstructed early on, its strength wouldn’t be able to reach its peak. However, considering the Bloodblades’ speed, it wouldn’t be easy for the enemy to stop them if they flew a little further from the enemy.
Although there were many flaws, Meng Chuan was very satisfied with its strength. The Bloodblade was very compatible with lightning. The electromagnetic domain’s acceleration was excellent as well. He had an additional killer move. Heaven’s Wrath. Meng Chuan no longer needed to cultivate the Lightning Runes because his divine power, Heaven’s Wrath, was more brilliant than the Lightning Runes. After his body was greatly enhanced, the lightning contained within was stronger than before. Boom!
In the darkness, a terrifying bolt of lightning erupted! However, his Seamless domain enveloped the area, preventing all light and auras from escaping. Nobody in Jiang State Capital knew about his actions. It’s quite powerful. Meng Chuan nodded slightly after seeing the effects. I can match a newly-advanced Creation realm expert’s expert by using 20% of the lightning in my body. Unfortunately, I have a Tribulation treasure—the Bloodblade Disc. Its normal strength is already comparable to a newly-advanced Creation realm expert’s attack already. This divine power’s pure strength doesn’t mean much to me.
Ordinary experts at the Blood Droplet realm weren’t that powerful. Meng Chuan had already given up on close combat. It was because he was extremely powerful with the Bloodblade Disc! Otherwise, he would only have strength at the threshold of the Creation realm. However, Heaven’s Wrath also has new changes. When Meng Chuan used Heaven’s Wrath, he could vaguely sense that there was another way of using it.
Boom!
Meng Chuan cast Heaven’s Wrath again. This time, Meng Chuan instantly disintegrated into countless particles. These countless particles flew through the sky at high speeds with the lightning. So fast.
Meng Chuan’s body had transformed into particles and fused with the lightning. His flying speed increased greatly as his Essence Soul concealed his aura by controlling the Heaven and Earth powers. Whoosh. The lightning condensed into a human figure. I can completely disintegrate and transform into lightning? Meng Chuan was astonished. I move even faster than when I use the Bloodblade Disc. I’ll try using the Bloodblade Disc again.
Swoosh.
He transformed into a bolt of lightning, which then enveloped the Bloodblade Disc, allowing him to fly even faster. After flying a circle, he returned to Jiang State Capital. After transforming into particles, my speed is indeed much faster. After attaining Greater Mastery of the Dharma Domain realm, I can move 75 kilometers in a second with the help of the Bloodblade Disc. I can move 250 kilometers in a second by using the divine power’s disintegration function.
Unfortunately, I can’t use many techniques in this state. I can’t use my electromagnetic domain either. He was extremely fast after his body completely disintegrated into particles and fused with lightning. However, he couldn’t use his electromagnetic domain, so he naturally couldn’t use this function when searching for demon monarchs. Since he couldn’t use the Indestructible Divine Armor, his defense was greatly reduced. However, being able to move 250 kilometers in a second made him truly fast. Furthermore, he could still use his Essence Soul and Quintessential Essence. With this, he could control the Bloodblade Disc.
Although my strength is reduced when I use Heaven’s Wrath to escape, my escaping speed is extremely high. Furthermore, I don’t expend much of the lightning in my body. This divine power can be used to escape in dire situations. It can also be used to rescue people. The fourth divine power is a new divine power. Meng Chuan took in the changes that occurred after attaining a Blood Droplet realm body. A Blood Droplet realm body was too powerful.
At the Regis Godfiend-level, it was the strongest known body. This allowed his dantian space to expand greatly, allowing him to carry more Seamless Quintessential Essence. As more Quintessential Essence gathered, the Source of the Seamless realm condensed into an even tinier sphere. This made his Quintessential Essence purer-an additional side effect.
Boom!
With a thought
His countless particle worlds’ Heaven Earth domains erupted as he projected them outwards. A single particle world’s Heaven Earth domain was very weak, but under Meng Chuan’s control, they all gathered and spread outwards together. When it affected the outside world, it formed a terrifying domain. This was a domain that surpassed a Regis Godfiend’s Seamless domain. How magical. Meng Chuan felt as though everything within 50 kilometers was under his control. The powers of the world had completely submitted to him.
Boom!
Meng Chuan punched out, and all the particles in his body erupted. With the Heaven and Earth powers in a 50-kilometer radius augmenting his strength, the void distorted as he punched out. The void distorted even further when he delivered a second punch.
He was like a phantom when he punched out. Every punch’s might was extremely terrifying. The chaotic gray world membrane gradually appeared. The world membrane? Meng Chuan stopped. This divine power can break through the world membrane? When I use this divine power, all my particle worlds will unleash their full strength.
I can control everything within 50 kilometers of me. My strength has increased greatly, but it only lasts for a few seconds. I’ll be exhausted after that. I’m afraid that I can only maintain this divine power for 30 seconds with a Blood Droplet realm body.
Meng Chuan had read the introduction of this divine power in the legacy. This divine power—Heaven Earth Control-was one of the core divine powers of a Blood Droplet realm expert that could fight anywhere. With this divine power, he could control everything around him perfectly.
The fifth divine power seems to be even more special? Meng Chuan began to probe the final divine power. According to the physical body cultivation system, one would attain the maximum number of divine powers at the Blood Droplet realm. The Sage Becoming realm and the Mythical realm would only transform and improve the original divine powers. There would be no more new divine powers. However, Meng Chuan’s fifth divine power wasn’t recorded in the legacy.

chapters.title: Chapter 373 - Divine Power, Flowing Sand
chapters.content:
Chapter 373 Divine Power, Flowing Sand
When Meng Chuan landed on the ground, he could sense the changes in his body after reaching the Blood Droplet realm. He could also sense the fifth divine power because the mystic runes had appeared naturally.
Boom!
With a thought, silver runes began to appear on both sides of Meng Chuan’s forehead.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
Strands of silver lightning flashed around his head. Meng Chuan’s eyes were filled with silver lightning
His surroundings changed. This feeling? Meng Chuan flicked his finger gently, and a wisp of energy caused the withered yellow leaves to fall en masse.
The falling leaves fell very slowly. They swayed leisurely as they descended.
How slow. Meng Chuan’s eyes flashed with silver lightning as he looked around. No, I’m faster. The dust in the void, the flying birds in the sky, and the patrolling soldiers on Jiang State Capital’s city walls in the distance slowed down by ten-fold. The soldiers slowly raised their legs and put them down slowly before taking a step forward.
The flow of time has changed? This divine power changes the flow of time in my body. With a thought, wisps of silver lightning spread out in all directions. The flow of time was the same for Meng Chuan, but everything a distance away remained as slow as ever.
At most, I can extend it to 100 feet. I can also penetrate 100 feet underground. The laws of the earth can’t suppress my influence over time. Meng Chuan understood this point. I can make time faster within 100 feet. A second in the outside world would be ten seconds for me.
Huh? Meng Chuan felt a throbbing pain at his forehead, and his sea of consciousness felt uncomfortable. With a thought, he retracted his domain and converged it within his body. However, the pain on his forehead still slowly intensified.
Phew. Meng Chuan stopped using this divine power. The silver runes on his forehead disappeared, and his sea of consciousness felt extremely relaxed. As he slowly recovered, the pain on his forehead gradually subsided.
I can’t use this divine power for too long. Meng Chuan pondered. I’ve only used this divine power for about 90 seconds. It’s only been 9 seconds in the outside world. A bigger range seems to increase the burden. This divine power is related to one’s head and sea of consciousness.
After reaching the Blood Droplet realm, his dantian and sea of consciousness expanded greatly. After reaching the Blood Droplet realm, one’s body-which was filled with lightning energy —would produce time-based divine powers.
This divine power can only be used for a short period of time. I can’t waste any moment, thought Meng Chuan to himself. This divine power shall be called Flowing Sand. Time flowed like sand. The divine power had to stop once it finished the flow.
In the legacy, some divine powers are commonly seen in the physical body cultivation system. This time-type divine power of mine is rare and isn’t recorded. According to the legacy’s description, every cultivator was unique because they produced special divine powers due to their own experiences. However, the Indestructible Divine Armor and Heaven Earth Control divine powers are very common. Most Blood Droplet realm cultivators possess them. The three divine powers—Divine Eye of Lightning (electromagnetic domain), Heaven’s Wrath, and Flowing Sand—were related to Meng Chuan’s Lightning Devastator Fiend Body cultivation and his physical cultivation. There were no records of them in the legacy.
I have to think about how to combine the five divine powers to unleash my strength better.
Combat was also a test of intelligence. At the same level and with the same divine powers, depending on how one used them, there was a huge difference in strength.
The core of my current strength is the Bloodblade Disc-a Tribulation treasure. I have to make my five divine powers supplement it as much as possible.
The next day, dawn arrived.
“I’m going to meet the Supremacies.” Meng Chuan bade farewell to his wife, Liu Qiyue.
“Yes.” Liu Qiyue was also filled with excitement. “Ah Chuan, your underground reconnaissance range has greatly increased since you reached the Blood Droplet realm. Now that you can completely resolve the threat of a million demon monarchs, the Supremacies will definitely be extremely happy when they learn of it.”
“I’ve been waiting for this day for a long time.” Meng Chuan smiled and turned into a bolt of lightning, disappearing into the horizon.
Liu Qiyue watched from afar, feeling rather proud.
As the storm of war raged, the Godfiends hoped for an invincible expert to be born.
The world of cultivators was a world where individuals ruled over all living beings. The strength of an individual was unimaginable. A Godfiend was much more terrifying than a million mortals. An Imperial Lord could easily sweep through the entire human world. For instance, a Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence like Ancestral Master Archean Eon could dominate the entire world and elevate the entire world’s level by his lonesome.
The danger humanity faced was very easy to resolve-they just needed a peerless expert to be born.
Although Meng Chuan had only reached the Blood Droplet realm, he could at least deal with one million demon monarchs easily.
This is my husband. The more outstanding Meng Chuan was, the prouder Liu Qiyue was.
Archean Mountain.
Meng Chuan arrived at Grotto-Heaven Pavilion. Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang appeared. The three of them looked at Meng Chuan in surprise. Qin Wu couldn’t help but ask, “You broke through?”
Meng Chuan didn’t need to take the initiative to report his status. When Meng Chuan arrived at Archean Mountain, Li Guan sensed him. Meng Chuan’s surging sanguine aura was like a vast sea. His body was even more terrifying than a mountain. Although he restrained everything, he couldn’t hide it from Li Guan.
“I just broke through to the Blood Droplet realm last night,” explained Meng Chuan.
“How’s the underground reconnaissance divine power?” asked Luo Tang.
“It originally had a range of 1.5 kilometers, but it’s five kilometers now,” said Meng Chuan. “I believe that it will take me one and a half years to sweep the entire world clean, both land and sea-everywhere underground.”
“Excellent.” Qin Wu was extremely excited.
“We are finally going to resolve the threat of the one million demon monarchs completely,” said Li Guan with a smile. “Without this massive number of demon monarchs looming over our heads, the threat of the demons will be halved.”
Luo Tang smiled and said, “It’ll be much easier. As long as we carefully deal with the fifth Firmament demon monarch threat, we can at least stall for a few centuries.”
Fifth Firmament demon monarch threat? Meng Chuan also understood that the top-level demons actually held the advantage. However, they couldn’t enter the human world!
If a large group of fifth Firmament demon monarchs arrived, it would be very difficult for humans to deal with them. If a large group of demon sages were to enter, it would spell the end of the world.
As for Imperial Lords? It was impossible for an Imperial Lord to enter the human world.
“A World Gap has formed between the human world and the Demon Realm,” said Li Guan. “The only thing I’m worried about now is the increasing number of World Entrances. In the future, if a World Entrance that can accommodate a demon sage appears, things will be terrible.”
“Perhaps it will never appear,” said Qin Wu.
Meng Chuan couldn’t help but ask, “How can we end the war?”
Since he could resolve the threat of a million demon monarchs, Meng Chuan thought of ending the war completely by himself. If he could do it, he would be very happy to do so, even if he had to give up his life. “One way would be to produce an Imperial Lord,” said Li Guan with a smile. “An Imperial Lord has a seventh-level Essence Soul. They can have up to nine Essence Soul avatars. The nine Essence Soul avatars carry the Quintessential Essence of an Imperial Lord, allowing them to unleash a portion of the strength of an Imperial Lord’s true body. An Imperial Lord has a Heaven Earth domain, allowing them to teleport 500 kilometers instantly. Even if they are 5,000 kilometers away, it just takes them ten teleportations. When a large group of demon sages arrives in the human world, an Imperial Lord can kill them easily, leaving them nowhere to run. Through karma, they can’t hide.
“Another method is for an eighth-level Essence Soul expert to be born. An eighth-level Essence Soul expert will be an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence. With a thought, they can envelop the entire human world and easily kill all demon sages that enter.”
Meng Chuan exclaimed when he heard that. “Is there another way?”“The next best method is to have an invincible Creation Supremacy,” said Qin Wu. “They can defend a World Entrance—which allows for demon sages to pass throughsingle-handedly and sweep through a group of them.”
“What do you mean by an invincible Creation Supremacy?” asked Meng Chuan.
“I’m considered to be at the peak of the Creation realm. With the aid of a Tribulation treasure, I can unleash the strength of a threshold Imperial Lord,” said Qin Wu. “This strength is considered very mighty in the Creation realm. But from what I know, two demon sages have already reached the Heaven Earth realm. However, their Essence Souls haven’t broken through, preventing them from becoming Imperial Lords.”
Meng Chuan’s expression changed slightly.
Since the demons had three Imperial Lords, it was understandable that two demon sages had reached the Heaven Earth realm.
“To defeat so many demon sages,” said Qin Wu, “I have to reach the level of Grandsire Yin Yang and create an Imperial Lord-level technique. My combat strength also has to be comparable to a true Imperial Lord. Only then can I be considered an invincible Creation Supremacy.
“Bai Yaoyue from Black Sand Grotto-Heaven, Senior Brother, and I are people that can unleash the strength of a threshold Imperial Lord through the use of Tribulation treasures,” continued Qin Wu. “It’s impossible for us to wipe out all demon sages that enter the human world.” “King True Martial created a Creation-level ultimate technique—the True Martial Seven Absolutes. He can be said to be an invincible Regis Godfiend,” said Luo Tang. “Grandsire Yin Yang created an Imperial Lord-level technique, making him an invincible Creation Supremacy.” Meng Chuan nodded. How difficult.
It was truly difficult to resolve the war completely.

chapters.title: Chapter 374 - Deep in the North Sea
chapters.content:
Chapter 374 Deep in the North Sea
There were many Black Metal Sutras in the human world, but very few could be considered Imperial Lord-level techniques. Even some of the Imperial Lords that had been born in the human world were unable to create Imperial Lord-level techniques.
Meng Chuan sighed at the difficulty, but he didn’t know...
His son, Meng An, had passed the Samsara trial and obtained Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s legacy. It was also the strongest legacy in the entire human race. At the same level, he was much stronger than Qin Wu and Li Guan. Qin Wu and Li Guan both had a Tribulation treasure that they had chosen for themselves. As for Meng An, he had a series of arrangements laid out by Ancestral Master Archean Eon. At the peak of the Creation realm, Qin Wu and company had the strength of a threshold Imperial Lord. However, Meng An would be able to fight an Imperial Lord, one level higher than him. He would be considered an invincible Creation Supremacy!
However, Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s legacy was a core secret of humanity. The three Supremacies couldn’t tell Meng Chuan.
“There’s no need to be discouraged.” Qin Wu looked at Meng Chuan and smiled. “You’ve already done very well. If we don’t resolve the threat of the million demon monarchs, we will collapse even if we hold on for 100 more years. However, it’s much easier now. It’ll give humanity a chance to relax.”
Luo Tang smiled as well. “In a few centuries, many Godfiends will appear. Perhaps a new Creation Supremacy will appear.”
Typically, one had to break through to the Creation realm before the age of 150. After reaching 200 years of age, the probability of success dropped drastically. Therefore, even if one was only an infant now, they might become a Creation Supremacy in 200 years.
“Meng Chuan, according to what I know, the Blood Droplet realm can allow you to be reborn as long as a drop of blood remains,” said Li Guan. “You need to leave a drop of blood in Archean Mountain to prevent any accidents.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Yes.”
“Follow me,” said Li Guan. He, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang walked towards the room with the portrait of Ancestral Master Archean Eon hanging on a wall.
Inside the room.
Li Guan and company led Meng Chuan towards Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s painting and arrived at the familiar hall.
“Don’t be careless even if you can be reborn from a single drop of blood,” said Li Guan. “In the vast River of Spacetime, there are many cultivation systems in other worlds. Many have avatars. For example, demons have avatar divine powers. Imperial Lords can form a Corporeal Avatar. An Essence Soul avatar can’t be too far from the main body. However, a Corporeal Avatar is different.”
“The Imperial Lords form an Essence Soul avatar and let it enter a Corporeal Avatar. It will then be an individual sentient entity,” said Li Guan. “Even if the main body is killed, the avatar will remain intact. However... in the River of Spacetime, the enemy can kill your avatars through karma-all of them. They can also neutralize all your life-preservation means,” said Li Guan. “For example, the original owner of the Bloodblade Disc was an Imperial Lord. He was remotely killed by the enemy through karma.”
Meng Chuan was shocked.
“Don’t be careless. Typically, when one cultivates to the peak of the Creation realm, they will come into contact with karma,” said Qin Wu. “When an enemy kills your true body, they will destroy your drop of blood through karma. Even if the attack’s power is greatly reduced through karma, a droplet of blood has a defense far inferior to your true body.”
“Don’t be careless just because you have such life-preservation means,” exhorted Li Guan.
“Understood.” Meng Chuan nodded. “In this hall, one can isolate the divination of the heavenly secrets. If an expert below the Tribulation realm kills your true body and tries to destroy the drop of blood through your true body’s connection, it can be transmitted here. The hall can reduce the attack’s power by over 90%,” said Li Guan. He flipped his hand and took out a jade bottle. “Put a drop of blood in here.”
Meng Chuan nodded. A drop of blood flew out from his fingertip and fell into the jade bottle.
Li Guan threw the jade bottle and sent it flying to the side of the hall. The wall devoured the jade bottle like a wave. “This place can weaken karmic attacks drastically, but you only have a drop of blood here.
