Your resistance to karmic attacks is very weak, so you have to be careful,” said Li Guan. “In Archean Mountain’s history, the Imperial Lords that travel the River of Spacetime will have their true bodies stay here in seclusion, while their Corporeal Avatars roam the outer realm. Their true bodies are much more resilient than your drop of blood. Only then can their life-preservation means be powerful enough.” “Their true bodies stay here in seclusion?” asked Meng Chuan. “All the time?”
“It’s always been like this,” said Li Guan. “Usually, you can just send an Essence Soul avatar to deal with the situation outside. The true body mustn’t move. This is because some enemies in the River of Spacetime are good at inferring. They won’t rashly attack if they know that they aren’t able to kill you easily. Once your true body leaves this place... they will attack when they infer that they can kill the person successfully. Therefore, don’t try to count on your luck.”
Meng Chuan was secretly astonished.
“Although the River of Spacetime has great opportunities, it’s too dangerous,” said Li Guan with a smile. “When an Imperial Lord goes out adventuring, their enemies are naturally terrifying. Your enemies haven’t reached that level yet.”
As Meng Chuan’s strength increased, Li Guan and company gradually provided him with more information.
Moments later, Meng Chuan returned to Grotto-Heaven Pavilion.
“Supremacy, Master, I’ll leave now.” Meng Chuan bade them farewell.
“Although you are much stronger, you still have to be careful. After all, you are responsible for completely resolving the threat of a million demon monarchs,” instructed Qin Wu.
“Yes.” Meng Chuan smiled and left.
He arrived in the sky above a vast land. Meng Chuan stepped on the Bloodblade Disc and wore a mask. His hair was white, and he looked at the land. Following that, he instantly dove underground.
Let’s begin!
Swoosh!
At a depth of 30 kilometers underground, he used his Divine Eye of Lightning to probe his surroundings and rapidly flew south at high speeds.
He kept heading south.
After passing through the Great Zhou Dynasty’s territory and the Great Yue Dynasty’s territory, he continued flying south after entering the sea until he reached the end of the world. An invisible void prevented him from going further. The world membrane was just past the void layers. Only then did Meng Chuan turn around and head north. He traveled underground all the way to the north! Most of the ocean was only five kilometers deep. It was rare for it to reach a depth of 15 kilometers. Further down, one would find soil and rocks.
From that day onwards, Meng Chuan began a large-scale reconnaissance. He swept through every corner of the world.
Deep in the North Sea.
No fish could approach a massive underwater mountain range. After swimming for some time, they naturally reached another spot. Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The three aquatic demon monarchs were traveling at the bottom of the sea. They couldn’t see the massive mountain range, nor could they touch it.
“That Godfiend has started sweeping the sea. I heard that many demon monarchs are being slaughtered,” said a fish demon monarch. “Iron Sand Lake’s 800 demon monarchs have connections with each other. They know each other’s situation. According to them, nearly 200 demon monarchs have died in the past half a month. Out of 800, 200 have died. How many demon monarchs—which are hiding in the world—are now dead?” A turtle demon monarch shook his head and sighed.“The Imperial Lords and demon sages have forbidden us from returning to the Demon Realm. If I’m forced into a corner, I’ll join the human race,” said the snake demon monarch angrily.
“I heard that the three great sects of the human race are also allowing for surrenders,” said the fish demon monarch. “I just don’t know the details.”
“The humans will ultimately be defeated in this war. There’s really no need for us to submit to the humans unless we are in dire straits,” said the turtle demon monarch.
“What can we do if the Imperial Lords and demon sages don’t give us a way out?” said the snake demon monarch angrily.
The three aquatic demon monarchs chatted as they traveled. Although they passed by the mysterious underwater mountain range, they naturally passed by it and failed to come into contact with the underwater mountain range.
At a mountain entrance in the massive underwater mountain range.
A black-robed figure stood there and watched the three demon monarchs pass by.
There are more and more demon monarchs in the depths of the North Sea. The black-robed figure shook his head gently. Archean Mountain is truly trash. Back then, the battle with our Eon Sea Sect was intense. Even Ancestral Master Archean could become an Imperial Lord. Now, facing the alien demons, they are weaklings. If our Eon Sea Sect were to rule the world... We would definitely do better than Archean Mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 375 - Fifth Firmament Thousand Cricket
chapters.content:
Chapter 375 Fifth Firmament Thousand Cricket
In the three human dynasties, countless commoners celebrated the new year. The sound of firecrackers and fireworks resounded as they bloomed. The increasing rarity of demon monarchs made the days peaceful for people.
However, in a secret chamber of a small underwater grotto-heaven.
Demon Sage Nine Abyss stood in the chamber. He used his demonic powers to activate the dense runic patterns engraved in the chamber. The runic patterns emitted a silver-white glow. A scene gradually appeared in the pool—which was in the middle of the chamber-revealing Imperial Lord Starquix’s image.
“Imperial Lord, the situation is getting worse,” said Nine Abyss anxiously. “It’s only been three months, but the mysterious Godfiend has been hunting down demon monarchs everywhere in the world. We can’t even figure out his search methodology. In just three months, we have already lost more than 100,000 demon monarchs. Although we tried our best to hide the news, the demon monarchs are panicking. After all, many of them are acquainted with each other, so they are naturally panicking when they realize a huge number of demon monarchs have died in battle.
“We even heard that ordinary demon monarchs are currently filled with resentment. They can’t escape while the human Godfiend is constantly slaughtering them. Since we forbid them from returning to the Demon Realm, a small number of ordinary demon monarchs have already submitted to the human sects. If we continue to force them like this, there will be no way out. Even more demon monarchs will probably submit to the humans,” reported Nine Abyss.
“Submit to the humans?” Starquix frowned.
“Yes, the humans are quite friendly. They even opened their Grotto-Heavens to allow the demon monarchs to live freely,” said Nine Abyss softly. “Should we allow the demon monarchs to return to the Demon Realm through the numerous World Entrances?”
“Now, there are less than 500,000 demon monarchs left in the human world,” said Imperial Lord Starquix calmly. “They can’t return. Once they return, it will be difficult to control the news and narrative. Countless demon monarchs in the Demon Realm will know that Godfiends are slaughtering demon monarchs everywhere in the human world once they return. It will be difficult to mobilize one million more demon monarchs next time.”
The demon monarchs could still accept being sent to the human world to hide and fight the humans. If they knew that sending them over meant suicide, the demon monarchs would naturally resist.
“It’s just a few hundred thousand demon monarchs. Losing them is a trivial matter,” said Starquix calmly. “We just need to kill that mysterious Godfiend.”
“Yes,” replied Nine Abyss obediently. “However, news will gradually spread. More and more demon monarchs will panic and join the human race. What should we do?”
“It’s been nearly a year since Thousand Cricket came to the human world. When will he recover to the fifth Firmament?” asked Starquix.
“Brother Thousand Cricket has been cultivating diligently. I inquired about its situation before reporting to you. It said that it would take another half a year at the soonest,” said Nine Abyss. “According to the speed of that mysterious Godfiend, it will probably take it a year to wipe out all the demon monarchs. However, in this panic, the demon monarchs will probably collapse completely in half a year. When that happens, most demon monarchs will join the human race... It will be very difficult to arrange enough baits to lure the mysterious Godfiend into hunting them.”
“Order Thousand Cricket to reach the fifth Firmament in a month,” said Starquix coldly.
“This will damage the foundation of his body. The possession has already damaged his foundation,” said Nine Abyss hesitantly. “It will be very difficult for it to return to the demon sage realm in the future. It’s even possible that it won’t be able to recover to the demon sage realm. Thousand Cricket will definitely not be willing.” “I will send a Sacred Body Spirit Pill to him.” Starquix paused for a moment and said, “Along with the Sacred Body Heavenly Heart Manual.”
Sacred Body Spirit Pills? Sacred Body Heavenly Heart Manual? Demon Sage Thousand Cricket frowned slightly.
“The treasures will arrive today. The Imperial Lord has given strict orders for you to reach the fifth Firmament in a month,” said Nine Abyss with a sigh. “Brother Thousand Cricket, I know it’s bad for you. If you forcefully raise your cultivation to the fifth Firmament in a short period of time, it will damage your foundation. However, with the Sacred Body Spirit Pill, you can at least switch to the Sacred Body. You can also cultivate the Sacred Body Heavenly Heart Manual, turning your body sacred and your heart heavenly. You might reach the Heaven Earth realm even faster as a result.”
“You put it nicely.” Thousand Cricket turned and left.
“Brother Thousand Cricket...” said Nine Abyss.
“I’ll definitely make a breakthrough within a month. If I anger the Imperial Lord, you will probably kill me, am I right?” said Thousand Cricket.
Nine Abyss’s expression relaxed. The black-robed North Sense appeared beside him.
“I said that it would obediently agree,” said North Sense softly.
Nine Abyss shook his head. “By pushing this matter forward, you sure put it in a tough spot.”
“However, the Imperial Lord is still merciful. He bestowed the Sacred Body Spirit Pill and the Sacred Body Heavenly Heart Manual to it,” said North Sense calmly.
“If we push Thousand Cricket into a corner, it might not work hard,” said Nine Abyss.
A demon sage that carried out possession wouldn’t have trouble reaching the fifth Firmament if they ignored the damage to their body. However, since they carried out possession, they needed to protect this new body in all ways possible by raising the compatibility of the Essence Soul and body. How could they exploit it recklessly?
Thousand Cricket had no choice but to break through to the fifth Firmament on the final day of the month he was given.
Boom!
Thousand Cricket came out of his seclusion chamber. His aura was much stronger.
Nine Abyss, Deep Profundity, Fire Dragon, and North Sense were standing outside the chamber.
“I’ve already broken through to the fifth Firmament. I can use the karmic blood curse mystic technique,” said Thousand Cricket calmly.
“Sorry to trouble you, Brother Thousand Cricket.” Nine Abyss smiled as he handed a token to Demon Sage Thousand Cricket. “Use this token to sense the location of all demon monarchs. Return it to me after you’re done with it.”
“I will cast a karmic blood curse on many demon monarchs,” said Thousand Cricket as he nodded. “Once the mysterious Godfiend kills them en masse, he will also definitely kill the cursed demon monarchs. My blood curse will attach itself to his karma! Unless he reaches an extremely high realm in the Dao of Karma, he won’t be able to detect it. Even if he can sense it... he won’t be able to remove the blood curse.”
“Karma is mysterious. Regis Godfiends have very little understanding of karma,” said Nine Abyss with a smile. “That Godfiend definitely can’t sense it.”
Thousand Cricket nodded. He was very confident.
Typically, one could only gradually gain insights into karma once they reach the peak of the Grotto-Heaven realm.
In the entire Demon Realm, Thousand Cricket was the only demon sage that could cast the Karmic Blood Curse. If his target was only a Regis Godfiend, it was nearly impossible for it to be detected.
“Sorry to trouble you, Brother Thousand Cricket.”
“Brother Thousand Cricket, you have contributed greatly,” said Deep Profundity and Fire Dragon.
North Sense looked at Thousand Cricket and smiled. “Demon Sage Thousand Cricket, I believe the Imperial Lords will remember your sacrifice.”
Thousand Cricket glanced at North Sense but didn’t say a word. He turned and left.
Hence, Thousand Cricket held the token and silently approached demon monarchs in the world. He cast a karmic blood curse on the demon monarchs.
Bind.
Thousand Cricket cast a seal. He used his Essence Soul and lifeblood as the foundation and his demonic powers as the tool to cast the Karmic Blood Curse Seal. It silently seeped into an ordinary demon monarch’s body.
Although there were eight demon monarchs in the demon monarch lair, he only left a karmic blood curse on two of them.
In just a day, Thousand Cricket Demon Sage had left a karmic blood curse on a total of 3,000 demon monarchs. This was also the maximum number of people he could leave the karmic blood curse on.
These 3,000 demon monarchs were scattered across the world, including land and sea.
“Done.” Thousand Cricket returned to the small grotto-heaven. He calmly and confidently faced Nine Abyss. “The bait has been set up. All we need to do is wait for the fish to take the bait.”

chapters.title: Chapter 376 - I’ve Been Waiting for Too Long
chapters.content:
Chapter 376 I’ve Been Waiting for Too Long
Thousand Cricket returned the token to Nine Abyss.
With this token, he could sense the location of every demon monarch in the world. If it landed in the hands of humans, they could use this token to kill all the demon monarchs. It would be much faster than Meng Chuan’s large-scale blanket search. Therefore, Demon Sage Nine Abyss usually held it. This time, Thousand Cricket had used it for a day in order to cast the karmic blood curse on 3,000 demon monarchs.
“What if other Godfiends accidentally kill the bait?” asked Nine Abyss as he put away the token.
“These 3,000 demon monarchs are scattered across the world. Even if they are accidentally killed, one can kill ten of them at most. If one kills over 100 of them? It’s not likely that it’s accidental,” said Thousand Cricket confidently. “The one that slaughters most of the 3,000 demon monarchs must be that mysterious Godfiend. If he continues his killing spree, I suspect that more than 95% of the demon monarchs will die at his hands.”
“Let’s wait and see,” said Nine Abyss with a smile.
“As long as a few hundred demon monarchs die, we will be able to determine the target. There’s no need to wait for all the cursed demon monarchs to die,” said Thousand Cricket when a look of surprise appeared on his face. “One of the baits just died.”
“One died? Who killed it?” asked Nine Abyss immediately. “He might be the target.” Thousand Cricket could sense the deaths of the cursed demon monarchs from afar through the karmic blood curse’s connection.
In the darkness, he vaguely saw a figure-a very young man.
He saw him clearly.
When he saw the young man’s appearance, his disguised aura and appearance was useless under the karmic detection technique. The young man was a famous Marquis Godfiend in the human world.
“Marquis Eastcalm, Meng Chuan?” said Thousand Cricket softly in puzzlement.
“Meng Chuan cultivates the Lightning Devastator Fiend Body. His speed is unparalleled in the world. However, he’s relatively weak. He’s only a Marquis Godfiend. It’s impossible for him to withstand the Three Terminal Formation that Patriarch Yellow Oscillate and the others used,” said Nine Abyss. “North Sense is very certain that the target is a Regis Godfiend. Furthermore, he has the strength of a threshold Creation realm expert. His life-preservation means are especially powerful.”
Thousand Cricket nodded and said, “This Meng Chuan is extremely fast. He’s one of the Archean Mountain Godfiends in charge of reinforcing the Godfiends. He might have killed a demon monarch during a rescue. Let’s wait. The more cursed demon monarchs that die, the more certain we will be of the mysterious Godfiend’s identity.”
Chi! Chi! Chi!
More than 4.5 kilometers away, lightning was naturally produced amidst the electromagnetic domain.
The lightning struck the demon monarchs and over a hundred ordinary demons. All the demon monarchs died. Two of the weaker demon monarchs were charred black, leaving only remnants of their bodies behind. The remaining demon monarch corpses were intact. Ever since he reached the Blood Droplet realm, his divine power-Divine Eye of Lightning (electromagnetic domain) had increased in strength. Even the lightning produced by the domain could kill third Firmament demon monarchs. If he condensed many bolts of lightning together, he could even kill fourth Firmament demon monarchs with it.
Meng Chuan had no idea that one of the demon monarchs he had killed from afar was affected by Demon Sage Thousand Cricket’s karmic blood curse.
The invisible blood curse entangled with his karma.
There’s resentment and sin again? Meng Chuan’s Seamless domain allowed him to sense the resentment aura and sinful aura. Every time he slaughtered demon monarchs, he would be surrounded by resentment and sin. At his waist, Demon Slayer took the initiative to absorb them all.
However, Meng Chuan didn’t have any insights into karma. He couldn’t sense the karmic blood curse at all. The Bloodblade Disc was mainly used for protecting his body! The karmic blood curse had actually left a mark on his karma, allowing the enemy to use it to lock onto him and carry out a karmic attack. Living in this world resulted in all kinds of karma. New karma was formed every day... The Bloodblade Disc couldn’t negate karma completely.
The Three Terminal Formation only concealed karma; it didn’t completely remove karma. Therefore, the enemy could still attack via karma. In fact, the Three Terminal Formation couldn’t even conceal karma when facing a Tribulation Eminence.
The mysterious hall set up by Ancestral Master Archean Eon was much more powerful, but it could only weaken karmic attacks.
Meng Chuan put away the demon monarch corpses and items before continuing his reconnaissance.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan was very cautious when conducting large-scale underground reconnaissance.
From the south to the north, from the east to the west, from the shallow depths to the deep, he frequently switched his route!
In his early days of reconnaissance, he didn’t move like this. Instead, he traveled along a fixed path. Due to these erratic movements, the demons couldn’t figure out Meng Chuan’s reconnaissance pattern.
So this is what the human world is like. Meng Chuan had traveled through the human world many times and knew what the world he lived in was like.
Land stretched from the north end of the sea to the south. The furthest distance was over 50,000 kilometers. From east to west, the furthest distance was over 45,000 kilometers.
It was almost spherical.
The sky was like a dome that covered the ground.
Land? It extended deep underground. Temporarily, Meng Chuan didn’t know what it looked like.
I heard that the human world was very small in the early days compared to the present day. Later, Ancestral Master Archean Eon upgraded the world’s level, causing it to expand greatly. This allowed people in the world to reach the Imperial Lord realm.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan flew at high speeds in the sea. Although the sea was vast, the sea only occupied a small portion of the human world. This was because the sea, on average, was about five kilometers deep! Endless soil, rocks and even metals were below the seabed. As long as Meng Chuan flew close to the bottom of the sea, he could probe the soil and rocks below on a large-scale. However, he would usually take about 8 minutes to fly from the south to the north. He had to go back and forth many times before he could clear the sea.
Oh? There are demon monarchs! Meng Chuan discovered a demon monarch lair more than 10 kilometers away. The sea’s resistance against electromagnetic waves was much weaker than that of the ground. His electromagnetic domain’s range was much greater in the sea.
Currently, in a canyon at the bottom of the sea was a demon monarch lair with eight aquatic demon monarchs and a group of ordinary demons. They were very used to living underwater.
Boom! Boom! Within the electromagnetic domain, lightning appeared with a thought.
Lightning struck the demon monarchs. The ordinary demons were instantly reduced to dust. Seven aquatic demon monarchs died. Only one demon monarch survived the attack and fled in panic.
The other demon monarchs are dead. A human Godfiend is here? The flood dragon demon monarch fled in panic. Suddenly, he saw a white-haired man wearing a mask appear in front of him. His eyes were as deep as the night sky as he stared at him.
“Not bad. This body is nearly comparable to that of a fourth Firmament demon monarch,” muttered the white-haired man to himself.
Following that, the flood dragon demon monarch felt his consciousness sink into oblivion. It constantly sank... as though he had fallen into an endless abyss.
In just a few seconds, the flood dragon demon monarch bowed respectfully. “Master.”Meng Chuan nodded slightly. “Rest in the grotto-heaven.” Meng Chuan waved his hand and stored him in his Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead.
Dozens of demon monarchs were inside his Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead.
In the past three months, I’ve slaughtered more than 100,000 demon monarchs. I’ve controlled over 300 demon monarchs that have the strength of a threshold Marquis Godfiend. Meng Chuan sighed inwardly. Unfortunately, I don’t specialize in illusions. I can only control demon monarchs with my fifth-level Essence Soul. My limit is about 1,000 demon monarchs. Where did Archean Mountain’s demon monarch servants come from?
The main source came from Marquis Godfiends and Regis Godfiends that cultivated the illusion lineage. Li Guan, Luo Tang, and Qin Wu relied on their Essence Soul realm to control demon monarchs as well. Meng Chuan also had a fifth-level Essence Soul, so he was on par with Qin Wu and Luo Tang. He could only control about 1,000 demon monarch servants simultaneously. If he wanted to control more, he had to give up control over a portion of the demon monarchs to control new ones.
Most of the demon monarchs under Master’s control are at the peak of the third Firmament. As for me, I’m carrying out a large-scale selection. I can choose those that are as strong a newly-advanced fourth Firmament demon monarch. Unfortunately, I can’t forcefully control those that have attained Essence Souls. I can only kill them.
Even if the demon monarchs that had Essence Souls were willing to submit, the pressure from controlling one was too great. The strong demon monarchs that hadn’t condensed an Essence Soul were Meng Chuan’s favorite choice. He now had more than 300 demon monarch servants.
Huh? At the entrance of the ancient underwater mountain range, a black-robed figure took form and looked at the distant beam of light flying at high speeds.
I’ve waited for over 50,000 years. Finally, a Regis Godfiend has arrived. The black-robed figure was somewhat excited. I’ve been waiting for too long!

chapters.title: Chapter 377 - Eon Sea Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 377 Eon Sea Sect
Meng Chuan flew across the sea at high speeds on the Bloodblade Disc. He scanned his surroundings and searched for demon monarchs.
Suddenly, the surrounding void changed. Not good! Meng Chuan was alarmed. Another demon ambush?
The three great sects wouldn’t attack him. It was very likely that the demons would attack him again. However, he didn’t know that the demons had only used the karmic blood curse to confirm his identity as the mysterious Godfiend. They hadn’t truly attacked him yet. This time, it was really a human faction that had lured him in.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Bloodblades immediately flew out from the Bloodblade Disc beneath his feet and surrounded him. They isolated him from the outside world and formed a defensive system.
Meng Chuan carefully observed his surroundings. The surroundings returned to normal. At a glance, he saw a massive underwater mountain range. The surroundings were very calm, and he didn’t suffer any attack. He couldn’t help but be puzzled.
Oh? Meng Chuan swept his gaze across the area and saw an ancient mountain entrance in the distance. The stone pillars at the mountain gate were made of green minerals. Although the entrance was ancient, he could still vaguely make out two words— Eon Sea!
Eon Sea? Meng Chuan’s heart churned. Could this be the ruins of the Eon Sea Sect?
Even ordinary Godfiends knew of the peerless expert—Fiend Supremacy Eon Sea. Fiend Supremacy Eon Sea had created one of the 12 transcendent-grade Godfiend bodies—the Eon Sea Fiend Body.
As for Meng Chuan, he knew more due to his clearance.
Humans once had an invincible sect called the Archean Eon Sect. It was created by Ancestral Master Archean Eon. When Ancestral Master Archean Eon was alive, the Archean Eon Sect was the pride of the entire human race. Everyone was proud of joining the Archean Eon Sect, and the sect was extremely united.
Years after Ancestral Master Archean Eon passed away... the Archean Eon Sect fractured.
It split into the Eon Sea Sect and Archean Mountain. According to Meng Chuan’s understanding, Archean Mountain was led by Ancestral Master Archean. The Eon Sea Sect was led by Fiend Supremacy Eon Sea. The two of them had a deep relationship with each other. They were the two most dazzling experts of that era. In human history, the two of them were very famous. Fiend Supremacy Eon Sea was a genius that had reached the Heaven Earth realm. However, he failed to become an Imperial Lord due to his Essence Soul, but he had created an Imperial Lord-level technique. As for Ancestral Master Archean, he had created an Imperial Lord-level technique and the Archean Divine Body formula. He had also become an Imperial Lord, thus suppressing Fiend Supremacy Eon Sea.
Therefore, Archean Mountain had the upper hand between the two sects. They also obtained a large portion of Archean Eon Sect’s resources. The Eon Sea Sect obtained a small portion of Archean Eon Sect’s resources.
The Eon Sea Sect has disappeared for hundreds of thousands of years in history. Meng Chuan looked at the ancient mountain entrancewhich had the words “Eon Sea”—and the vast array formation powers around him. The array formation left behind is still so terrifying? It easily teleported me here?
That’s right. In human history, at its peak, Archean Eon Sect was the strongest sect in history. Archean Mountain is the second strongest sect in history. Eon Sea Sect is ranked third in history. Meng Chuan understood this.
Although Black Sand Grotto-Heaven had obtained two complete outer realm legacies, its heritage was still inferior to that of Archean Mountain.
Whoosh.
Black fog materialized at the entrance, condensing into a black-robed elder.
Oh? Meng Chuan looked at the black-robed elder. With his Seamless domain, Meng Chuan could tell that the black-robed elder likely wasn’t a real living being.
“From how you are using a Tribulation treasure—the Bloodblade Disc-are you an Archean Mountain disciple?” asked the black-robed elder.
Meng Chuan was alarmed. It can recognize the Bloodblade Disc?
One usually couldn’t tell what was special about the Tribulation treasure from its appearance, nor was it possible to identify it. “Don’t be surprised. This is one of the Tribulation treasures left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon. Of course I can recognize it,” said the black-robed elder. “After all, I was also a Guardian of Archean Eon Sect.”
“A Guardian of Archean Eon Sect?” Meng Chuan looked at it.
“After the Archean Eon Sect fractured into two, I became the Eon Sea Sect’s Guardian.” The black-robed elder smiled at Meng Chuan. “Archean Mountain also has a Guardian. Furthermore, there are two of them. Alright, follow me.”
Meng Chuan temporarily put away the Bloodblades, but he made sure that the Bloodblade Disc was ready to be activated at any moment. He carefully followed the Guardian into the mountain and entered a vast grotto-heaven.
Inside the grotto-heaven, he saw three buildings.
“This grotto-heaven that I’ve brought you to is the core of the Eon Sea Sect.” The black-robed elder pointed at the three buildings in front of him. “Back then, the Eon Sea Sect was weak. After negotiations with Archean Mountain during the split, we only obtained these three buildings. Almost all of Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s other treasures are in Archean Mountain’s hands.”
“Oh?” Meng Chuan carefully inspected the buildings.
Of the three buildings, the leftmost building looked ordinary. The middle building was a palace, and the building on the right was a pagoda
“The negotiations between Ancestral Master Eon Sea and Ancestral Master Archean mainly consisted of these three buildings. Of course, there are also other things that were included. For example, Of course... I-a Guardian-was part of the package,” said the black-robed elder with a self-deprecating smile. “Ancestral Master Archean had a good temper and had the absolute advantage, so he didn’t make things unfeasible.”
“As long as you become a Regis Godfiend, you can enter the leftmost building,” said the black-robed elder as he pointed at it. “It’s also the only building that doesn’t require one to pass a test to enter. You can enter it directly.”
“Star Cluster Building?” Meng Chuan looked at the building on the left. The building had a plaque with the words “Star Cluster Building” on it.
“Yes.” The black-robed, long-browed elder nodded and said, “It contains the precious manuals that Ancestral Master Archean Eon collected during his long journey of the River of Spacetime. Almost all of them are manuals at the Tribulation level or Imperial Lord level. Only a small number of Creation-level techniques are included in them. Ancestral Master Archean Eon has seen many manuals in his life. After some selection, he found 98 of them suitable for juniors. All of them are very precious.”
“Tribulation, Imperial Lord, and Creation-level techniques selected by Ancestral Master Archean Eon?” Meng Chuan was tempted. “It’s no wonder Archean Mountain has so few Tribulation and Imperial Lord-level techniques. Back then, Ancestral Master Archean had the advantage. Why did he give up the Star Cluster Building?” “To become a Regis Godfiend, one must find their own path. One won’t lose themselves when reading these manuals,” said the black-robed elder with a smile. “Of course, if one loses themselves, it means that their mental state isn’t strong or stable enough. With such a limited future, it doesn’t matter if they are crippled.”
Meng Chuan was very tempted.
He had read many lightning lineage manuals in Archean Mountain. Although there were few manuals here—98 books in total—all of them were impressive. They were probably above the Heart Intent Saber.They were mostly Tribulation and Imperial Lord-level techniques after all!
Very few were Creation-level techniques. They were all chosen by Ancestral Master Archean Eon personally, so they were probably comparable to the Heart Intent Saber Art.
Reading the various techniques and drawing on the wisdom of the seniors will allow me to walk the path of the lightning lineage faster and more stably. Although Meng Chuan was very tempted, he asked, “Since you’ve lured me here and allowed me to enter the Star Cluster Building to read the manuals, what kind of payment is required?”
“If you wish to gain something, you naturally have to pay the corresponding price.” The Guardian smiled and said, “The price of entering the Star Cluster Building isn’t high. You can choose to join the Eon Sea Sect. As a disciple of the Eon Sea Sect, you will naturally be able to enter the Star Cluster Building. Furthermore, there will be various benefits. If you aren’t willing to become a disciple of the Eon Sea Sect, you have to swear a heart oath. In 100 years, you have to find three genius disciples for the Eon Sea Sect. All of them have to reach the Realm of Force before the age of 16.”
“Reached the Realm of Force by the age of 16?” Meng Chuan looked around and couldn’t help but ask, “The Eon Sea Sect should have a large grotto-heaven, right? Humans can reproduce in the grotto-heaven. Why do I have to find disciples?”
“Grotto-heaven?” The Guardian shook his head. “A grotto-heaven is much inferior to a low-level world. It allows for survival and reproduction, but it’s not suitable for cultivation. Furthermore, even if it’s a large grotto-heaven, only a few millions of people can reproduce there at most. The humans in the grotto-heaven will have a much weaker perception, and cultivation will be even more difficult. It’s very difficult to produce an ordinary Godfiend even after centuries. Therefore, disciples need to be recruited from the outside world.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
It was very difficult to find a peerless genius like Xue Feng, who had become a Godfiend at 15. However, it wasn’t difficult to find a 16-year-old that had reached the Realm of Force. “What about the other two buildings? What price do I have to pay if I want to enter them?” Meng Chuan wasn’t in a hurry to agree.

chapters.title: Chapter 378 - Heart Sea Palace and Battle God Pagoda
chapters.content:
Chapter 378 Heart Sea Palace and Battle God Pagoda
“I’ve already said that there’s no need for a test for the Star Cluster Building,” said the Guardian Deity with a smile. “However, the other two buildings require a test.”
“Test?” Meng Chuan fell into deep thought. The Guardian pointed at the pagoda on the right. “The tower on the right is called the Battle God Pagoda. It was left behind in the sect by Ancestral Master Archean Eon. The opponents in the tower are formed from array formations, so Essence Soul mystic techniques are useless. The Battle God Pagoda tests one’s technique realm and combat intelligence. It has nine levels. If one can pass seven levels, it means that one’s combat skills are invincible in the Creation realm. If one can pass nine levels, their combat skills can be said to be the strongest at the Creation realm in the River of Spacetime. Even if one is stuck at the peak of the Creation realm, they can still kill an Imperial Lord by relying on their techniques.”
“Invincible at the Creation realm after clearing the seventh level?” Meng Chuan was astonished.
The ninth level could be said to be the strongest Creation realm expert in the River of Spacetime? Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s identity made this claim quite believable.
“The Battle God Pagoda has existed in the Archean Eon Sect for 550,000 years, and it has existed since our Eon Sea Sect was founded,” said the Guardian. “The pagoda will determine one’s potential according to the strength and age of every Godfiend that challenges the tower. As long as your potential is ranked in the top five, you will pass the test.”
“Top five?” Meng Chuan was shocked.
“That’s right.” The Guardian smiled at Meng Chuan. “Let me remind you. Ancestral Master Archean has attempted the Battle God Pagoda many times. His potential is ranked third. Ancestral Master Eon Sea is ranked seventh.”
“You want me to enter the top five?” Meng Chuan couldn’t help but ask.
“If you are willing to join the Eon Sea Sect, there’s naturally no need for a test. You can obtain all sorts of benefits,” said the Guardian. “However, you are an outsider, yet you want to take away the benefits of our Eon Sea Sect? The requirements are naturally very high. You only have one chance to challenge the Battle God Pagoda. The higher your potential is, the higher the reward you will receive.”
Meng Chuan didn’t say anything as he pointed at the palace in the middle. “What about this one?”
“This is the Heart Sea Palace,” said the Guardian. “There are many Essence Soul mystic techniques hidden in it. Ancestral Master Archean Eon was a Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Although he wasn’t adept at cultivating the Essence Soul, he had collected quite a number of Essence Soul mystic techniques. They are hidden in the Heart Sea Palace.”
Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up.
He was even more puzzled...
What was Ancestral Master Archean thinking? Back then, he had the advantage. Yet, he had even given up the Heart Sea Palace—which contained various Essence Soul mystic techniques—the Star Cluster Building, which contained many powerful techniques, as well as the Battle God Pagoda that could hone one’s combat prowess.
Of course, according to the words of the Guardian, this was only a small portion left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon. Most of them were still at Archean Mountain. However, these were also very important to Archean Mountain.
“To enter the Heart Sea Palace, your Essence Soul and willpower will be tested,” said the Guardian. “According to your age, Essence Soul, and willpower, you will be ranked. If you enter the top five in the historical records of the Heart Sea Palace, you can read the Essence Soul mystic techniques inside.”
The Guardian smiled at Meng Chuan. “By the way, let me remind you. Ancestral Master Archean is ranked ninth in the history of the Heart Sea Palace. Ancestral Master Eon Sea’s historical ranking is 17th. Two of the top five are Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences! The other three were extremely talented at Essence Soul cultivation.”
“Your requirements are too high.” Meng Chuan couldn’t help but say, “Ancestral Master Archean and Ancestral Master Eon Sea weren’t even capable of meeting the requirements of such a difficult test.”
“Our Eon Sea Sect only needs you to help us find a successor.” The Guardian pointed at the Star Cluster Building. “Any one of the manuals in the Star Cluster Building is enough to drive the world crazy. You can read them as long as you help us find three disciples that has reached the Realm of Force before turning 16. The requirements are considered low.”
At this level, they were not peerless geniuses. However, they usually ranked in the top three of Archean Mountain’s entrance examination. They would be good seedlings. “As for the Battle God Pagoda’s test and the Heart Sea Palace’s test, as long as you pass them, you will be a Dao Protector of our Eon Sea Sect,” said the Guardian with a smile. “There are many benefits to becoming a Dao Protector.”
“If you pass the two tests...” The Guardian looked at Meng Chuan. “Even if you don’t switch allegiance to the Eon Sea Sect, everything in the sect can be handed to you. The only request is that you ensure that the Eon Sea Sect’s lineage doesn’t cease in the future.”
“What I said is the decision of the 119th sect master of the Eon Sea Sect. It was also approved by the seven subsequent sect masters. The 126th sect master of the Eon Sea Sect was the last. He only had the strength of a Marquis Godfiend,” said the Guardian with a sigh. “After that, no disciples managed to hold the position of sect master. The Eon Sea Sect ended its lineage. I’ve waited for more than 500,000 years in this vast sea.”
Hearing this, Meng Chuan fell silent.
The decline of a sect...
Some of Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s legacies left Meng Chuan sighing. “The sea is vast. Back then, in order to avoid the detection of other sects, the Eon Sea Sect hid in an extremely remote area in the sea,” said the Guardian. “In the vast sea, it’s rare for Godfiends to come here. As for Regis Godfiends... you are the only one in the past hundreds of thousands of years.”
“I’m the only one?” Meng Chuan quickly understood that if he hadn’t needed to search for demon monarchs in order to kill them, the Guardian would have to wait even longer.
This place was too remote. Humans liked to live on land. Who liked to live in the sea?
There were very few Regis Godfiends in every generation. Occasionally, they would go overseas for some leisure. To enter deep down into the sea and arrive at such a remote place coincidentally? The probability was too low.“After passing two tests, everything in the Eon Sea Sect will be given to me. I can also pass it to Archean Mountain?” asked Meng Chuan.
The Guardian nodded and said, “I’ve said it very clearly. Everything will be left to you-as long as you ensure that the Eon Sea Sect’s lineage continues in the future.”
The Eon Sea Sect’s Guardian knew the situation very well. As long as one passed any test and entered the historical top five, they would have the potential of becoming an Imperial Lord! No matter how weak they were, they would be at the peak of the Creation realm. The Eon Sea Sect would be happy if such a person became the Dao Protector.
If he passed two tests?
The high potential of one’s technique realm and Essence Soul... When complementing each other, one had a limitless future. The person would have the potential to become a Tribulation Eminence. They would almost definitely become an Imperial Lord. Such a figure—who had obtained benefits from the Eon Sea Sect-would not want to owe the Eon Sea Sect anything, even if it was for their own cultivation. The Eon Sea Sect had declined to such a state, so it was willing to hand over everything to such a figure.
“Top five in the Battle God Pagoda and the Heart Sea Palace’s potential rankings. Is there such a person in human history?” asked Meng Chuan.
“I’m not sure for the past hundreds of thousands of years, but there hasn’t been any in history.” The Guardian shook his head. “The closest one is Imperial Lord An Yang. His Essence Soul potential ranked second, and he is sixth on the Battle God Pagoda’s rankings.”
“If there hasn’t been such a person in history, why are you making such a demand?” Meng Chuan couldn’t help but ask, “Isn’t your Eon Sea Sect’s requirement too high?” “After all, the entirety of the Eon Sea Sect will be handed to you. Everything will be up to you to decide. Therefore, the requirements are naturally very high,” said the Guardian. “Everything the Eon Sea Sect has accumulated is much more precious than that Bloodblade Disc of yours. If it’s not someone with unprecedented talent, they are not qualified to receive the Eon Sea Sect in its entirety.”

chapters.title: Chapter 379 - Traveling the Heart Sea
chapters.content:
Chapter 379 Traveling the Heart Sea
Although Meng Chuan was very confident, he didn’t have the confidence to rank in the top five in both areas of human history. After all, those who had passed the Battle God Pagoda and the Heart Sea Palace were Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences, Imperial Lords, and people that had reached the Heaven Earth realm. Just by looking at Ancestral Master Eon Sea’s ranking, one could tell how difficult it was-7th on Battle God Pagoda’s potential rankings and 17th on the Heart Sea Palace’s rankings.
“I won’t hide it from you,” said Meng Chuan. “Right now, another world—the demon world
– is connected to our human world in the River of Spacetime. Even a World Gap has appeared. There are countless World Entrances. We humans are already on the brink of death.”
“On the brink of death?” The Guardian was astonished.
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded. “The demon world is more powerful than our human world. Their world is vaster, and there are more experts. In the current generation, there are three demon Imperial Lords and nearly 100 demon sages. As for our human world, we don’t have a single Imperial Lord. We only have nine Creation realm experts.”
“Demon sages are comparable to Creation realm experts?” asked the Guardian.
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded. “Furthermore, two demon sages have reached the Heaven Earth realm. With more and more World Entrances appearing, once a World Entrance that can accommodate demon sages appears in the future, many demon sages will enter and wipe out the human world.” Meng Chuan looked at the Guardian. “We humans are on the brink of death. We are in desperate need of the Eon Sea Sect’s power. If the Creation realm experts can study the manuals and Essence Soul mystic techniques in the Eon Sea Sect, perhaps an Imperial Lord or an invincible Creation realm expert will be born. That will save the entire human world.” “It’s very difficult for an invincible Creation realm expert to appear. It’s not something that can be obtained through manuals and mystic techniques.” The Guardian shook his head and said, “In human history, on average, only one invincible Creation realm expert is born every tens of thousands of years. Furthermore, most of them are Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s cross-generation disciples.”
“Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s cross-generation disciples?” Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up. “How do we nurture a cross-generation disciple?”
The Guardian was taken aback as he carefully looked at Meng Chuan. He smiled and said, “You are a Regis Godfiend. You shouldn’t be in charge of Archean Mountain, so you don’t know many secrets about Archean Mountain. In fact, all the major sects in the world know about the secrets of Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s cross-generation disciple. His legacy is in Archean Mountain! Archean Mountain’s cross-generation disciples are naturally selected from Archean Mountain disciples. This is one of the reasons why Archean Mountain is so powerful.”
“Gets selected from Archean Mountain disciples?” Meng Chuan nodded gently.
The sect would naturally think of ways to nurture Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s cross-generation disciples. Only after tens of thousands of years would an invincible Creation realm expert appear. It was equally difficult.
Right... An’er cultivates the Samsara Divine Body. It’s a Godfiend body created by Ancestral Master Archean Eon. I wonder if he’s qualified to become Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s cross-generation disciple. However, An’er is still far from becoming a Marquis Godfiend.
Many thoughts surfaced in Meng Chuan’s mind before he temporarily threw them aside. Meng Chuan looked at the Guardian and said solemnly, “Being at the bottom of the sea, I believe you have seen demon monarchs passing by the area recently.”
The Guardian nodded. “Yes, I’ve seen several waves of demon monarchs.”
“This place is so remote, yet you’ve seen quite a few waves of demon monarchs passing by. I’m sure you can guess how many demon monarchs there are in the world,” said Meng Chuan. “Humans are indeed on the brink of death. As a Guardian, you are also left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon. Considering the circumstances, can’t you make an exception and transfer all of this to Archean Mountain? After all, Archean Mountain is part of Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s lineage.”
“I’m sorry.” The Guardian sighed and said, “The meaning of my existence is to follow orders. I can’t disobey the orders left behind by the Eon Sea Sect’s sect master. They didn’t say that I can hand over the entirety of the Eon Sea Sect to other sects just because the human world is on the brink of destruction.”
Meng Chuan was annoyed and exasperated.
In the long history of their world, no other world had invaded. If the Eon Sea Sect’s sect master were still alive, Meng Chuan believed that he would abandon such estrangement.
“Logically speaking, with the heritage left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon, the human world shouldn’t be destroyed so easily,” said the Guardian in puzzlement.
“What can we do when we encounter a stronger world?” Meng Chuan shook his head. “This war has been going on for more than 800 years. Too many Godfiends have died in battle. Too many mortals have died. The situation is becoming grimmer and grimmer.”
“It’s been going on for this long?” The Guardian shook his head gently. “As a Guardian, I have to follow orders. There’s only one way for you to hand over the Eon Sea Sect’s manuals and mystic techniques to other factions-clear the two tests. I’ll give you everything from Eon Sea Sect. Everything will be up to you, even its fate. I’ll also heed your orders.”
Meng Chuan understood. He decided to rely on himself. Meng Chuan swept his gaze across the three buildings.
Star Cluster Building, Heart Sea Palace, and Battle God Pagoda.
“I’ll try Heart Sea Palace first.” Meng Chuan made a decision. He was the most confident in his Essence Soul talent. He could give it a try. As long as he passed the test and became a Dao Protector, he would have much more authority.
Meng Chuan walked towards the Heart Sea Palace.
“You can enter it directly. Once you enter and sit on a mat, your willpower will be tested,” said the Guardian with a smile. “By the way, what’s your name? You need to record your name in the Heart Sea Palace and the Battle God Pagoda.”
Meng Chuan pondered for a moment before saying, “Call me Humanity’s Demon Slayer.”
“Humanity’s Demon Slayer?” The Guardian was slightly taken aback.
Since he had put on a mask and disguised himself, he wouldn’t reveal his true identity during his entire demon-hunting process. Even if he came to the Eon Sea Sect, he couldn’t reveal his identity. Only by keeping it a secret could his identity stay unknown for a longer time.
The Guardian nodded slightly. “Alright, I’ll record it.”
Meng Chuan walked to the Heart Sea Palace. The door was tightly shut, but Meng Chuan pushed it open.
Rumble!
The huge door slowly opened. A surge of warmth rushed out from within, causing him to relax involuntarily.
It tests my heart and willpower? Meng Chuan took a step in.
After entering the Heart Sea Palace, Meng Chuan found the hall ordinary. There was a prayer mat in the middle. This matched the architectural style of Ancestral Master Archean Eon. Meng Chuan walked to the prayer mat and sat down in the lotus position.
The moment he sat down, his consciousness rumbled as he fell into a vast world.
This is? Meng Chuan looked around.
The sky was bright, and the blue sea was beautiful.He was on a small boat, holding an oar. The boat drifted across the endless sea. The sea was very calm, but no matter how calm it was, there were still waves. The boat constantly bobbed in the waves as Meng Chuan stood firmly on the boat. This is the Heart Sea Palace’s test? Meng Chuan was puzzled. It wants me to cross the sea by boat?
Outside the Heart Sea Palace, the door to the hall had already slammed shut.
The Guardian stood outside the hall and watched with a smile. He sighed. It’s been so many years. Finally, another Godfiend has entered the Heart Sea Palace. Back then, when the Heart Sea Palace was still in Archean Eon Sect, it was extremely lively. Plenty of Godfiends entered it one after another. Unfortunately, the lively days never returned.
Humanity’s Demon Slayer? He gave a fake name to even a Guardian like me? The Guardian looked at the pillar of the Heart Sea Palace. On it were the words: “Humanity’s Demon Slayer, 59 years old.”
He’s 59 years old? The Guardian’s eyes widened. Isn’t he a Regis Godfiend? Isn’t his hair white?
Regis Godfiends typically weren’t young. If a Regis Godfiend had white hair, it was highly likely that they were above 400 years old.
The Heart Sea Palace determined one’s age based on one’s life experiences. It was most accurate.
His name is also fake. This kid has really disguised himself well.

chapters.title: Chapter 380 - Historical Ranking
chapters.content:
Chapter 380 Historical Ranking
Let’s see how his ranking is. With a thought, a dense list of rankings immediately appeared on the pillar. There were a total of 1,000 names. Humanity’s Demon Slayer? The Guardian swept his gaze and immediately found it. His pupils constricted. Ninth: Humanity’s Demon Slayer.
He reached ninth place as soon as he entered the Heart Sea Palace? The Guardian was somewhat astonished. This ranking of potential depends on one’s age, Essence Soul, and willpower. The willpower test will still take a long time. He’s very young. Only by having a fifth-level of Essence Soul can his initial ranking be this high.
Ancestral Master Eon Sea had made several attempts in history. However, he eventually ranked 17th in the Heart Sea Palace. The moment Meng Chuan entered, his initial ranking reached ninth. He had even pushed back Ancestral Master Eon Sea’s ranking by one place—18th place.
Even Ancestral Master Archean had only been ranked ninth in the Heart Sea Palace. He was now tenth because of Meng Chuan. The moment Meng Chuan entered, his initial ranking had pushed back the two ancestral masters back by one place! This Essence Soul talent was truly terrifying. Furthermore, after the willpower test ended, his ranking would continue increasing.
A fifth-level Essence Soul at the age of 59. This Essence Soul cultivation talent is truly abnormal. Among the historical human geniuses I know, that’s in the top five. However, willpower is especially important in the Essence Soul lineage in the later stages. The Essence Soul Tribulation determines one’s life and death at every Tribulation realm. Without a strong willpower, one won’t be able to pass through it.
Now, it’ll all depend on his willpower. As long as he reaches the average standard of these geniuses, he will enter the top five. The Guardian sighed inwardly. It looks like Eon Sea Sect will finally have a Dao Protector.
The vast sea.
Meng Chuan rode the small boat and took in the sea breeze, enjoying the sunlight. He was rather pleased.
As the waves ebbed back and forth, the boat undulated—Meng Chuan dealt with it very easily.
This is called a test? Meng Chuan smiled. It’s more like a carefree vacation.
The waves gradually grew larger and more violent.
Meng Chuan sat in the boat and held the oar. In this illusory world, my Essence Soul can affect my surroundings. One can take advantage of the waves. I can even draw power from them. This should be the correct way. Trying to brute force my way through the waves will have lacking results.
Meng Chuan was, after all, a Regis Godfiend. He knew how to control his strength. His willpower affected the boat and the surrounding seawater, causing the boat to borrow the waves’ strength. Although it constantly rose and fell, it seemed to become part of the sea. Meng Chuan appeared very relaxed as he perfectly controlled the boat amidst the waves.
Oh? Meng Chuan looked up at the sky.
The sky gradually darkened as dark clouds began to gather.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
A gust of wind blew violently!
The waves began to churn, causing Meng Chuan to become serious as well. He held the oar in his hand and used his willpower to support the boat as he rowed. He had immense strength. With the oar, he could part the sea, allowing the boat to borrow more strength from the waves.
Rumble!
The dark clouds in the sky rumbled as the winds howled. The waves surged as they constantly attempted to capsize the boat. However, under Meng Chuan’s control, the boat kept appearing on the crest of the waves.
Interesting. Meng Chuan liked this feeling of conquest. He conquered wave after wave.
Whoosh!
In the billowing dark clouds, a rainstorm suddenly poured down; bean-sized water droplets fell.
The rain was so heavy that the sky was like a huge basin of water unleashing its load. The rain naturally landed on the boat, drenching Meng Chuan. The water in the boat pooled.
Strong winds and torrential rain. The rain is getting heavier and heavier. The heavy rain hindered Meng Chuan’s vision. Although his consciousness could barely prevent the rain from touching his eyes, he couldn’t use his divine powers here. He couldn’t use any domain or other means either. The rain filled the world, blurring everything. He couldn’t see anything with the naked eye.
He could only rely on his Essence Soul to sense his surroundings. He tried his best to steer the boat and conquer the waves—which were already reaching heights of over 100 feet tall.
The world was dark, but Meng Chuan remained calm.
How minuscule this pressure was! Back when he hadn’t left the mountain, Meng Chuan’s willpower was already very outstanding. After leaving the mountain...
After experiencing all the bloody storms, his faith had been tempered and strengthened through repeated trials.
As the saying went, hardship resulted in hardening!
One’s willpower had to be tempered into steel! During peaceful times, it was very difficult to have an environment that can temper one’s willpower. This was why there was the saying that said, ‘heroes appear in troubled times.’ This was because troubled times were truly terrifying. In troubled times, lives were feeble.
The war between humans and demons was a war that involved the survival of the entire race. It was even more tragic than any other war in human history. The demon monarchs slaughtered hundreds of thousands of people. If Godfiends couldn’t hold the fort, cities would be wiped out. The number of deaths in the world neared 100 million every year.
Such a war made Meng Chuan swear an oath to slay all demons at the age of six. In peaceful times, six-year-old children would be happily playing under their parents’ watch.
This war allowed him and Liu Qiyue to support each other and fight on the battlefield together. They risked their lives, killed the demons, and shared life-and-death experiences together. Such a war resulted in Meng Chuan’s father, mother, wife, son, and daughter taking up the call of duty to head out onto the battlefield.
Only in such a war could one establish a terrifying faith that was as tough as steel. This faith had long surpassed life and death.
The Guardian had been idle for too long-more than 500,000 years. Now that a Godfiend was attempting the Heart Sea Palace, he was overjoyed.
He kept staring at the ranking on the pillar. As the test continued, the initial ranking increased as expected.
Eight.
Seventh.The Guardian watched in surprise and delight.
Who were the people that had cleared the Heart Sea Palace? Back when the Archean Eon Sect reigned supreme, there was only one human sect. Back then, all humans—who had great accomplishments-attempted the Heart Sea Palace. After the fracture, many geniuses from the Eon Sea Sect had attempted it. Although they had declined from their peak, there was plenty of competition between the Eon Sea Sect and Archean Mountain over the years.
According to historical achievements, it could be ranked third.
Fifth? The Guardian looked at the ranking and was alarmed. This Humanity’s Demon Slayer has really entered the top five. At the very least, he’s now a Dao Protector of the Eon Sea Sect. His Essence Soul is very powerful for his young age. He should have relatively strong willpower as well. That’s why he’s ranked in the top five.
He has no shortcomings in this aspect. He can go far with his Essence Soul cultivation. His Essence Soul will definitely reach the seventh level. He might even have a chance of attaining an eighth-level Essence Soul. However, whether he can reach the Tribulation realm depends on his future experiences.
There were only a handful of Tribulation Eminences in human history.
As the Guardian pondered, the ranking on the pillar changed again.
The Guardian swallowed a mouthful of saliva as he looked at Meng Chuan’s brand-new ranking. He reached third on the Heart Sea Palace’s potential ranking? Furthermore, he hasn’t come out yet. The test hasn’t ended. Could it be that he can continue to go higher?

chapters.title: Chapter 381 - Essence Soul Legacy
chapters.content:
Chapter 381 Essence Soul Legacy
The ranking on the pillar
1st: Myriad Sword Island Lord
2nd: Imperial Lord An Yang
3rd: Humanity’s Demon Slayer
The Guardian was astonished when he saw this. The two people ranked in front of Meng Chuan were famous. There was no need to elaborate on Imperial Lord An Yang’s achievements. He was the strongest Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence in human history, having reached the Essence Soul Third Tribulation realm. He cultivated the Samsara Divine Body and the Samsara Spear Technique. He had even established an empire that unified the world.
As for the number one-Myriad Sword Island Lord-he was a lone swordsman. He was the most accomplished swordsman in human history. He didn’t care to build an empire, nor was he in the mood to teach disciples. Although he was the strongest expert in his era and many disciples of the Archean Eon Sect idolized the sect’s number one expert, Myriad Sword Island Lord lived on an island out in the sea most of the time. He seldom came into contact with the world. Most of his consciousness was focused on his body. He spent his time traveling the River of Spacetime, his numerous feats making him famous.
He had created the Thirteen Swordbane Fiend Body, the number one killer move. He had also killed a Tribulation Eminence as an Imperial Lord. He focused on his Sword Dao and focused on the Physical Body Tribulation realm.
Although his Thirteen Swordbane Fiend Body was extremely powerful and its power exceeded that of the Samsara Divine Body, it was too extreme. It was even more difficult for his body to reach the Tribulation realm through perfection. He ultimately failed to take the final step and died in regret. In human history, only Ancestral Master Archean Eon had reached the Tribulation realm by perfecting the body.
However, his lineage continued. This was because he had left behind bits and pieces of his sword arts on Myriad Sword Island. A Godfiend descendant had studied it and created a sect—the Myriad Sword Sect—which prospered for a long time.
Now, he’s only behind Myriad Sword Island Lord and Imperial Lord An Yang. This Godfiend might be able to reach the same heights as Myriad Sword Island Lord and Imperial Lord An Yang in the future.
Boom!
The torrential rain caused the world to turn into pure pandemonium. Meng Chuan struggled to control the boat as thunder rumbled in his ears. Lightning bolts blasted down.
Meng Chuan used his Essence Soul to control the boat with all his might. He also paddled with the oar and tried his best to dodge. Lightning bolts struck the water beside the boat. Some of the lightning’s power had diminished by the time they reached the boat. Although Meng Chuan’s consciousness trembled, he quickly recovered. Lightning, however, struck the boat occasionally.
Boom!
The bolt of lightning was too fast for Meng Chuan to dodge. The bolt of lightning struck the boat, drowning both the boat and Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan’s mind instantly went blank.
It was like the apocalypse.
When Meng Chuan regained consciousness, he and the boat had already reached the depths of the sea.
Go up. Meng Chuan waved the oar and used his will to raise the boat. He charged upwards with all his might. Even though the undercurrent surged, he still rushed to the surface of the sea.
Boom!
A thousand-foot-tall wave smashed down like a mountain.
Meng Chuan steered the boat and rapidly approached the tsunami. Only by approaching it would he be safer. As he was far away, it was easy for the 1,000-foot-tall wave to hit him. The closer he was, the safer he would be as he would have an opening to dodge the waves. He calmly searched for opportunities in the harsh environment and struggled to survive. He tried his best to protect the wooden boat from being destroyed. This boat is the embodiment of my Essence Soul and willpower. If my will doesn’t collapse, it won’t dissipate. Meng Chuan understood this. However, as the sea environment worsened, as lightning bolts struck down, the waves became more and more terrifying. Meng Chuan felt his consciousness begin to blur, but his fortitude allowed him to hold on.
Boom!
An 8,000-foot-tall wave-taller than many mountains-formed. When Meng Chuan reached the sea surface with difficulty, he saw the 8,000-foot-tall wave crash down. He had no way to dodge it. He braced himself for impact.
Bam!!!
This heavy wave caused the wooden boat to explode. The limits were bound to be exceeded when the waves were ever-increasing in might.
Oh? Meng Chuan suddenly woke up.
He saw the ancient palace and the prayer mat he was sitting on.
The test is over. Meng Chuan came to a realization. His exhausted mind rapidly recovered, and he felt much more relaxed. I wonder what my ranking in the Heart Sea Palace is. Meng Chuan stood up. At that moment, the door to the Heart Sea Palace opened with a rumble. The black-robed elder standing outside stared at Meng Chuan in a daze.
What’s wrong? Meng Chuan stepped out of the hall.
The black-robed elder carefully looked at Meng Chuan as though he was looking at a monster. He pointed at the pillar beside him.
Meng Chuan turned his head and saw the ranking on the pillar. He glanced at it and was shocked.
1st: Humanity’s Demon Slayer
2nd: Myriad Sword Island Lord
3rd: Imperial Lord An Yang
“I’m ranked first?” Meng Chuan couldn’t believe it. He was very young. He had a fifth-level Essence Soul at the age of 59, and he was ranked in the top five in history. However, when combined with his willpower, he was actually ranked first? There were Tribulation Eminences, Imperial Lords, and human experts who had figured out the Heaven Earth realm on the ranking. Yet, he, a Regis Godfiend, was ranked first?
The black-robed elder finally snapped out of his daze. He couldn’t help but say, “In the history of humanity, there are many people whose Essence Soul realm is higher than yours. There are even people who have an eighth-level Essence Soul. In terms of willpower, an Essence Soul realm expert who has cultivated for over ten thousand years will definitely have a stronger will than you. However, this is a ranking of potential.”
“Your Essence Soul, your willpower... Based on your age of 59, your Essence Soul’s potential is the best in human history,” said the black-robed elder certainly.
Although there was no need for the strongest human expert, Ancestral Master Archean Eon, to challenge the Heart Sea Palace, people knew that Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s Essence Soul talent was a huge weakness. He was stuck with a seventh-level Essence Soul his entire life. He failed to obtain an eighth-level Essence Soul.
As for people before Ancestral Master Archean Eon... the human world was very weak. They peaked at the Creation realm. It was already very difficult for a Supremacy to be born.
“There are also those with high talent that eventually turn mediocre,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “I’m still far from being comparable to Myriad Sword Island Lord, Imperial Lord An Yang, and the other seniors.”Potential was just potential; strength was strength.
Meng Chuan was very clear about how disparate the two were. In fact, he knew that he had extreme Essence Soul cultivation talent!
“With your Essence Soul talent, it’s very suitable for you to walk the Essence Soul path,” persuaded the black-robed elder. “Don’t choose to go down the Physical Body Tribulation path in the future. After all, only Ancestral Master Archean Eon has cultivated his body to perfection and reached the Tribulation realm. Other Godfiends aren’t capable of that. Ancestral Master Archean Eon admits that the reason behind this is because of the Godfiend cultivation system.
“The Godfiend cultivation system focuses on one’s Quintessential Essence. The body is secondary. It’s naturally difficult to cultivate the body to perfection. The Essence Soul is different. The Essence Soul is treated the same across all living beings. It doesn’t care about what cultivation system you follow, but more about one’s heart,” said the black-robed elder.
“Thank you, but I’m still far from becoming an Imperial Lord. I don’t need to consider this for now,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “I’m just reminding you because you have such potential,” said the black-robed elder with a smile. “You’ve already passed the Heart Sea Palace’s test. You can read all the Essence Soul mystic techniques in the Heart Sea Palace.”
Meng Chuan was filled with anticipation.
“The Heart Sea Palace’s evaluation of you has exceeded the threshold of the Tribulation realm,” said the black-robed elder with a smile. “Therefore, one of the legacies stored in the Heart Sea Palace can be passed to you.”
“Oh?” Meng Chuan was surprised. “This is the most mysterious Essence Soul legacy that Ancestral Master Archean Eon obtained after roaming the River of Spacetime. Ancestral Master Archean Eon has determined that it should be the legacy of an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence,” said the black-robed elder. “This legacy is limited by the laws of the River of Spacetime. It will disappear after being imparted nine times. In the past, it has been imparted seven times. Your potential is high enough; thus, you can learn it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 382 - Eminence Fei Yu
chapters.content:
Chapter 382 Eminence Fei Yu
Eighth Tribulation Eminence? Meng Chuan’s heart trembled. If he had taken another step forward, wouldn’t he be at the Ninth Tribulation realm, Eternal?
The black-robed, long-browed elder sighed. “As a Regis Godfiend, you haven’t left the human world. You might not understand what it means to be an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. The further one cultivates, the harder it is to break through. A Sixth Tribulation Eminence is enough to make many worlds tremble in fear. Many Imperial Lords travel the River of Spacetime. The strongest existence they may see in their lives is a Sixth Tribulation Eminence. They might not even be able to see one.”
Meng Chuan was secretly astonished.
An Imperial Lord’s lifespan was long. To not see a Sixth Tribulation Eminence while traveling the River of Spacetime showed how rare they were.
“As for a Seventh Tribulation Eminence? They’re legends! It’s a symbol of invincibility!” said the black-robed elder. “Such invincibility makes worlds revere them no matter where they go. As for Eighth Tribulation Eminences? This is the strongest expert that Ancestral Master Archean Eon has managed to come into contact with,” said the black-robed, long-browed elder. “They have unimaginable powers. They are even restricted by the laws of spacetime. They are only one step away from reaching the Eternal realm. Seventh Tribulation Eminences willingly follow them, hoping to receive some guidance from them.
“Ancestral Master Archean Eon was stuck at a bottleneck. He didn’t manage to break through to the Eighth Tribulation realm even at his death bed,” said the black-robed, long-browed elder. “All his life, Ancestral Master Archean Eon only saw one living Eighth Tribulation Eminence.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Follow me.” The Guardian walked towards the Heart Sea Palace and entered the hall. Meng Chuan followed.
Inside the Heart Sea Palace, Meng Chuan felt the void change as he entered a chamber.
Oh? A palm-sized white sphere floated in the chamber. With Meng Chuan’s eyesight, he could tell that the white sphere’s structure was exquisite. It had billions of tiny, incalculable structural formations.
The moment he saw the white sphere, Meng Chuan was dazed.
He felt like every structural formation he saw with the naked eye was filled with endless charm. The entire white sphere was even larger than the entire human world he knew. At that moment, all he felt moved. When he saw the ‘greatness’ that far exceeded the world, he instinctively felt touched.
Swoosh.
A beam of light shot out from the white sphere and into Meng Chuan’s glabella. Meng Chuan couldn’t resist it, nor could he block it. The stream of light fused with his sea of consciousness.
Meng Chuan’s consciousness entered an illusory world.
In the illusory world, there were grasslands, slick-looking buildings, and a silver-haired, blue-eyed elder.
He had two feelers on his forehead. He smiled at Meng Chuan. “My name is Fei Yu. I’m already at the end of my lifespan. Although I haven’t achieved Eternal, I’m still very satisfied. I’ve traveled the River of Spacetime and explored 37 Universes. I’ve seen too many sights. The only thing I can’t let go of is my hometown, the Fei Yu World. Although I’ve tried my best to raise my homeworld to a higher-level world, there are still powerful Tribulation Eminences eyeing everything I leave behind. They eye my homeworld.
“The legacy I left behind is my magnum opus. If you study it, you will form a karmic tie with me. In the future, once you reach the Eighth Tribulation realm, you must protect my Fei Yu World for 100,000 years. Either that or you will give a World Tree to the Fei Yu World to resolve the karma. If you remain below the Eighth Tribulation realm, you won’t be able to find the Fei Yu World anyway,” said the silver-haired, blue-eyed elder with a smile.
Eighth Tribulation realm?
That was too far away from him.
“My greatest cultivation achievement was limited by the River of Spacetime. It’s difficult to describe it in words. Therefore, I hid the legacy in a painting. There are a total of 29 paintings. They are called the Essence Soul Stars.
“You can see the paintings, but what you figure out depends on yourself,” said the elder with a smile. “When I was alive, I taught 12 disciples. Their insights into the paintings were different. Some were similar to mine, while others were completely different. It’s interesting. Among these 12 disciples, the one with the greatest accomplishments had diametrically opposite insights to mine.”
Following that, the illusory world dissipated as the silver-haired, blue-eyed elder vanished.
Huge paintings merged with Meng Chuan’s memories.
The first painting was a vast, desolate star. It emanated an ancient and profound intent. This was a three-dimensional, vast, desolate star. It was as though a real star was in front of him. The runic patterns in the painting were faintly discernible. It even produced variations. By comprehending the runes, one could understand many mysteries. The second painting was still a star, but it was even more profound.
One painting after another.
Each of the 29 paintings was a star! The further one progressed, the more profound the painting became.
Meng Chuan barely understood the first nine paintings. The ninth painting was divided into nine void layers. The different void layers corresponded to different stars. Combined, it became a complete void star.
As for the rest?
He didn’t understand anything!
For example, the last painting was apparently a star. Meng Chuan felt a boundless intent rush towards him. It was even vaster than the purple lightning that tore through the River of Spacetime. If this star appeared in reality, his Essence Soul would probably be reduced to dust silently with a single glance at it.
“After passing the Heart Sea’s test, you can comprehend the Essence Soul Star. With a fifth-level Essence Soul, you can study the first three paintings. Make sure not to study the fourth painting. With a sixth-level Essence Soul, you can study the first six paintings. With a seventh-level Essence Soul, you can study the first nine paintings. At the Essence Soul Tribulation realm... study as much as you can.”
After seeing the 29 paintings, information surged into his mind. They simply introduced the rules of the cultivation technique.
If one’s Essence Soul realm wasn’t high enough, forcefully studying it would be harmful and useless.
Passing the Heart Sea test? From the looks of it, the Heart Sea Palace’s test was set up by this mighty ancient figure named Fei Yu? It was used by Ancestral Master Archean Eon to test juniors. That’s right. Ancestral Master Archean Eon doesn’t have good Essence Soul cultivation talent. How can he test the potential of his juniors’ Essence Souls?
Meng Chuan first studied the first painting.
Runes constantly appeared on the three-dimensional star painting as they kept changing
As he studied the runic patterns and looked at the star painting, Meng Chuan gradually gained some insights. After all, the basics were relatively simple. There were runic patterns that appeared directly. In the later stages, there were no runic patterns. Therefore, what disciples comprehended depended on themselves. They might even have completely different insights than Eminence Fei Yu.An Essence Soul can be directly cultivated? Meng Chuan was secretly astonished.
After some thought, he came to such a realization. This was also the core of this legacy.
The mystic technique Archean Mountain taught me back then relied on using the physical body and Quintessential Essence to nurture one’s soul and Essence Soul. However, this Essence Soul Star technique is far more exquisite. It uses one’s original Essence Soul as its foundation and slowly improves it.
This is raised based on a ratio. Therefore, the stronger one’s Essence Soul is, the greater the increase. At later stages, the improvement speed becomes more terrifying.
Meng Chuan carefully studied it. Basic mastery is achieved when one can completely change the structure of their Essence Soul. Amazing, truly wonderful. There are still killer moves hidden in this cultivation technique.
Meng Chuan was intoxicated.
Due to the detailed guidance of the runic patterns in the first few paintings, the disciples had similar cultivation results to that of Senior Fei Yu. Only when one reached the middle or late stages would there be bigger differences.
Meng Chuan only spent two hours studying the first painting. He was extremely impressed by Eminence Fei Yu.

chapters.title: Chapter 383 - Cultivation
chapters.content:
Chapter 383 Cultivation
I’ll probably take a few months to understand the second and third paintings. Meng Chuan spent another two hours studying the second and third paintings before stopping temporarily. Time was precious now. He still needed to hunt for demon monarchs. He couldn’t waste too much time.
I’ll try to gain basic mastery first.
With a thought
The Essence Soul in his sea of consciousness suddenly disintegrated into countless Essence Soul thoughts. With countless Essence Soul thoughts as the foundation, he reconstructed his Essence Soul.
It was just like microscopic matter that could form charcoal but also diamond depending on how it was structured. As for the Essence Soul that was naturally formed by living beings, the structure was extremely exquisite. If one were to change the structure without reason or a guide, they would mostly damage the Essence Soul. As for Senior Fei Yu, his understanding of Essence Soul structure had reached an unimaginable level. The perfected Essence Soul structure far exceeded the original structure of the Essence Soul.
Whoosh.
According to the structure he comprehended from the Essence Soul Star’s first painting, countless Essence Soul thoughts in Meng Chuan’s sea of consciousness finally formed a massive star.
The star slowly rotated, emitting an endless charm.
Meng Chuan felt his mind becoming ethereal. His mind was several times faster, and his Essence Soul was extremely stable! It was like a fortress. Furthermore, as his Essence Soul slowly rotated, his Essence Soul absorbed external powers and slowly strengthened itself. This kind of strengthening was very slow, but the advantage was that it never stopped!
According to the simple description of the Essence Soul Star, one’s Essence Soul will take about 500 years to cultivate from the fifth level to the sixth level. It will take about 1,000 years for one’s Essence Soul to reach the seventh level from the sixth. From the seventh level to the eighth level, it will take about 2,000 years. Meng Chuan sighed. What a terrifying cultivation formulation.
Creation Supremacies mostly had fifth-level Essence Souls. With this cultivation formulation, one could attain a sixth-level Essence Soul in 500 years. It was extremely difficult for Imperial Lords to reach the Tribulation realm. This cultivation formulation gave their Essence Souls a chance of reaching the Tribulation realm.
