The first requirement is the paintings. This cultivation formulation is completely hidden within the paintings. It’s relatively easy to gain insights in the early stages, but the further one advances, the more difficult it becomes. In fact, one would comprehend completely different insights than that of Senior Fei Yu. It’s fine if one goes in a completely different direction, but one should be worried about going down a path with a dead end. That would result in being stuck at the sixth or seventh-level of the Essence Soul.
The Essence Soul Star formation he comprehended could be wrong. If he tried to reconstruct his Essence Soul, it would collapse. Not only would he fail to break through, but his foundation would also be damaged. Clearly, not everyone could master such a forbidden cultivation formulation.
The second requirement is the mind’s willpower. If one’s willpower isn’t strong enough, they won’t be able to comprehend the profundities within the paintings. The pressure brought by the star in the paintings is enough to injure the Essence Soul. Furthermore, if one’s willpower isn’t strong enough, they will die once they reach the Tribulation realm! They won’t even be able to pass the first tribulation.
In the Tribulation realm, each tribulation was a life and death experience. Thus, one’s willpower was extremely important.
I can attain a sixth-level Essence Soul in 500 years? It’s not bad if it’s during a time of peace. However, in wartime, it’s still too slow to rely on this cultivation formulation to improve the Essence Soul. This cultivation formulation stabilizes one’s Essence Soul, increasing its defense by more than ten-fold. Meng Chuan could sense how stable the slow-spinning star in his sea of consciousness was.
As for killing enemies? Normally, there’s only one move-Astral Wave.
With a thought, invisible ripples spread out. They could spread out in all directions and also target a single enemy by restraining them. Astral Wave can affect enemies at the same Essence Soul level. When used against somebody with an Essence Soul in the original structure, I can reduce their strength by nearly half.
There’s also a forbidden spell. An Essence Soul Star nurtures Starlight internally. This is the Essence Soul’s foundation. If I were to release a single beam of Starlight, I would be able to injure a sixth-level Essence Soul. However, a single beam of Starlight will damage my Essence Soul’s foundation by 30%. Even if the Essence Soul Star formulation’s recovery speed is astonishing, it will take ten years to recover.
There’s also the move ‘Indiscriminate Destruction.’ It’ll burn the entire Essence Soul Star and deliver a deadly blow at the risk of one’s life. There’s a high chance that one’s Essence Soul will be completely annihilated. If one successfully kills the opponent, a portion of the Essence Soul might still survive. However, one would be left with incomplete memories and a greatly-reduced perception. The damaged Essence Soul will automatically revolve, recovering to its original state. It’ll take more than 1,000 years for it to recover completely.
He definitely couldn’t use the Indiscriminate Destruction mindlessly. If he used it, regardless of whether the enemy died or not, he had a high chance of dying. Even if he was lucky enough to survive, it would take him a long time to recover.
According to the description, if one reaches the Tribulation realm, they will be able to use Starlight as an ordinary move. If one reaches the Sixth Tribulation realm, Indiscriminate Destruction can be used as a normal forbidden spell. Every usage only damages a portion of one’s foundation. It’ll take just a few decades to recover. Meng Chuan understood this point. Clearly, at his current realm, his Essence Soul would still be severely damaged if he burned the entirety of his Essence Soul.
Meng Chuan’s vision blurred as he returned to Heart Sea Palace.
“Are you done cultivating?” The Guardian smiled at Meng Chuan.
“It’s a very powerful cultivation formulation,” said Meng Chuan. Although it prioritized stability in the early stages, it was already impressive that he could reduce the strength of enemies with a similar-level Essence Soul with the main method of attack-Astral Waves.
“Look.” The Guardian pointed to the side of the hall. With a wave of his hand, a bookshelf appeared in the hall. There were over 100 books on the bookshelf.
“Ancestral Master Archean Eon traveled through the River of Spacetime and collected quite a number of Essence Soul mystic techniques. They are all here,” said the Guardian with a smile. “Furthermore, several powerful manuals that humans have obtained from other Tribulation Eminences and Imperial Lords are also placed here.”
Meng Chuan nodded. The most dazzling batch of experts in human history mainly existed during the Archean Eon Sect’s era.
Some were personally guided by Ancestral Master Archean Eon, so their improvement was naturally fast. Some rose after the ancestral master died. At that time, the sect’s heritage was very rich, and they had many treasures. Many experts like Myriad Sword Island Lord and Imperial Lord An Yang appeared.
As time passed, the number of treasures that could aid their cultivation dwindled. It was naturally harder for humans to produce peerless experts.
“You can read the other Essence Soul mystic manuals slowly in the future. You’d better read this first.” The Guardian walked to the bookshelf and handed Meng Chuan a book. “These are some notes left behind by human experts, who have cultivated the Essence Soul Star. Only those that have obtained the legacy are qualified to read it.”Meng Chuan came to a realization as he read the book.
“Remember, don’t let the name ‘Essence Soul Star’ be known. Otherwise, you will incur huge trouble. The Essence Soul Star can improve one’s Essence Soul, and the improvement shouldn’t be revealed. In short, everything regarding the Essence Soul Star has to be kept a secret. Just disguise it as a top-notch Essence Soul mystic technique, which gives one high defense.”
Meng Chuan flipped through the book.
There were records of Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences and Imperial Lords.
The outer realm looks cruel and cold. Even if an alien expert-recognized as a friendmight kill a friend for the sake of his cultivation path. It’s even more common to kill an unfamiliar expert.
The more Meng Chuan read, the more he sighed.
He also realized how cruel the outer realm was! The three demon Imperial Lords were overjoyed when they discovered that a large number of World Entrances had appeared between the Demon Realm and the human world. They had a chance of obtaining the treasures left behind a Seventh Tribulation Eminence just by sending their subordinates to conquer the human world. It was an extremely rare opportunity! As for the large number of demons that died and the countless humans that were slaughtered, they meant nothing to the three Imperial Lords.
The Essence Soul Star formulation is very outstanding in every other aspect. It’s only lacking when it comes to killing enemies. It’s suggested that one cultivates the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell as a supplement.

chapters.title: Chapter 384 - Inside the Pagoda
chapters.content:
Chapter 384 Inside the Pagoda
“It’s suggested that one cultivates the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell.”
“The Magic Awl Forbidden Spell and the Essence Soul Star are the most compatible. They are extremely effective against enemies.”
“With the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell, one can abandon Starlight. It’s suggested to spend more time on the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell.”
Seniors that had cultivated the Essence Soul Star formulation gave advice to their juniors.
Half of the book’s content described the cultivation of one’s Essence Soul Star, while the other half described the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell. Everyone held it in high esteem. They deemed it the strongest mystic technique in the Heart Sea Palace, second only to the Essence Soul Star.
“Oh? They recommend it that much?” Meng Chuan looked at the Guardian. “Where’s the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell?”
“Here.” The Guardian skillfully took out a book and handed it to Meng Chuan.
The River of Spacetime’s laws didn’t restrict the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell.
It’s a forbidden spell that cultivates an Essence Soul weapon. Meng Chuan flipped through the book. There were lots of words and diagrams in the book, and information surged into his mind. The Essence Soul Star gave different results when cultivated by different people. As for the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell, its cultivation method was very clear. All of them followed one particular direction in cultivation. However, the higher one’s cultivation realm was, the stronger the outcome.
This forbidden spell was to cultivate an Essence Soul weapon-Magic Awl! It was called a forbidden spell because one needed to consume some of their Essence Soul foundation to cultivate it. Using ten percent of one’s Essence Soul foundation for cultivation didn’t have much of an impact.
The negative effects showed when more than ten percent of one’s Essence Soul foundation was used. The defensive properties of one’s Essence Soul Star began to decline, and the speed at which one’s Essence Soul improved would constantly decrease.
When more than 30% of one’s Essence Soul foundation was used, it resulted in severe consequences such as the loss of memories and the drop in perceptivity. However, this forbidden spell was extremely powerful! After cultivating the Magic Awl with just ten percent of one’s Essence Soul foundation, it was comparable to a beam of Starlight. A fifth-level Essence Soul could even injure a sixth-level Essence Soul with it, reducing the strength of the sixth-level Essence Soul. Of course, the attack easily backfired. If the Magic Awl failed to pierce through an enemy’s Essence Soul, it would be damaged to the point of destruction. However, it was extremely effective at piercing an enemy’s Essence Soul.
If one used 30% of their Essence Soul foundation to cultivate it, they would have a chance of killing a sixth-level Essence Soul despite having a fifth-level Essence Soul. An enemy with weaker willpower would have their minds go blank upon being attacked. They would be unable to resist at all. Sixth-level Essence Soul experts with stronger willpower would also suffer a huge loss in strength, barely able to unleash 20 to 30 percent of their strength. This was a high-level Essence Soul weapon! All the experts of the human Essence Soul lineage respected it.
Some even wanted to use 30% of their Essence Soul foundation to cultivate it. They combined the Essence Soul mystic technique with their head-on combat techniques; they were virtually invincible.
This all depended on one’s choices. The flaw of this forbidden spell was that cultivating a Magic Awl would place one’s Essence Soul foundation in a damaged state for prolonged periods. For example, using 30% of one’s Essence Soul foundation to cultivate the Magic Awl would force one’s Essence Soul to stay at 70% efficiency for a long period of time. The improvement of one’s Essence Soul would be very slow, and their defense would be much weaker.
It’s really a double-edged sword. It hurts the enemy and oneself. Furthermore, the refinement method of this Essence Soul weapon requires time to study it. At the very least, it’s no less difficult than the Essence Soul Star for anyone below the Tribulation realm.
Meng Chuan simply flipped through the Essence Soul mystic techniques.
Although there were other mystic techniques, he had to consider the time it took, the power it had, and other different angles. It took him a lot of time and effort to cultivate the Essence Soul Star. He just needed to cultivate the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell to make up for the formulation’s lacking lethality. Cultivating a weaker Essence Soul mystic technique was not worth the time. Rumble!
The Heart Sea Palace’s door closed as Meng Chuan and the Guardian walked out.
Battle God Pagoda. Meng Chuan’s gaze landed on the building on the right. It was an ancient nine-story pagoda.
The Guardian also looked at the pagoda. “The Eon Sea Sect only set two tests. You are ranked first in the Heart Sea Palace, so you naturally passed that one. As for the Battle God Pagoda... it has nothing to do with your Essence Soul. It doesn’t even have anything to do with the divine armaments you possess. It tests your true combat strength and your technique realm.
“A judgment of your potential will be made depending on your age, strength, and technique realm,” said the Guardian. “This was personally built by Ancestral Master Archean Eon. With Ancestral Master Archean Eon at the Physical Body Seventh Tribulation realm, the Battle God Pagoda test he set... is extremely accurate when judging one’s potential. Let me remind you that your Bloodblade Disc is useless inside.
“All external powers are useless. You will have to choose your weapon and armor from the Battle God Pagoda upon entry,” said the Guardian. “All Essence Soul mystic techniques are useless because your opponent is formed from an array formation. I can tell that your body is very extraordinary,” said the Guardian. “However, don’t count on your powerful body. In the River of Spacetime, there are all sorts of legacies and rare treasures that can make one’s body very powerful. Therefore, one’s technique realm is key. Your age, the level of your technique realm-all of this can determine your perceptivity potential,” said the Guardian. “Of course, combat strength is also one aspect.” Meng Chuan nodded. “I understand.” “Go all out. It’s not important which level you reach in the nine-storied Battle God Pagoda. What’s important is to showcase yourself,” said the Guardian. “When inside, try your best to showcase your strength. That might boost the Battle God Pagoda’s evaluation of you. This slight boost might be the difference between being ranked fifth or sixth.
“A 59-year-old Regis Godfiend won’t even enter the top 1,000 in human history. You have to do your best.” The Guardian stared at Meng Chuan. “Of course, don’t be discouraged. A 49-year-old Regis Godfiend can be ranked in the top ten. I think you’ve broken through for quite some time.”
Meng Chuan also understood.
An expert with a fifth-level Essence Soul at the age of 59 was ranked in the top five in human history.
A 59-year-old Regis Godfiend? In any thousand-year-long span, there were several such geniuses. He had broken through to the Seamless realm at the age of 55. In comparison, his master, Qin Wu, had become a Regis Godfiend when he was 58-years-old. Bai Yaoyue became a Regis Godfiend when she was 53-years-old.
In fact, becoming a Regis Godfiend when one was in their fifties was monstrous enough. It was very difficult for one to become a Regis Godfiend a year earlier. Just that difference made one surpass many seniors in history.
“Go on in,” said the Guardian with a smile. “Kill the opponents you encounter, and you will enter a higher level.”
Meng Chuan nodded and walked towards the ancient pagoda. He walked to the door of this time-scarred pagoda and pushed it open. After entering the Battle God Pagoda, he entered a separate space.
Boom!
Information entered his mind.
Meng Chuan learned the rules of the Battle God Pagoda. It was similar to what the Guardian had said. Meng Chuan had long stored the Bloodblade Disc in his dantian space. He had also put away Demon Slayer. As for the robe on his body? It was his Indestructible Divine Armor-a part of his own strength.
There are plenty of weapons and armors. Meng Chuan immediately saw a large number of weapons and armors placed beside him. After scanning them with his Seamless domain, he came to a realization. Apart from being tough and sharp, there’s nothing special about these armaments.I’ll use this. Meng Chuan picked up a battle saber that looked like Demon Slayer.
He scanned his surroundings with the Seamless domain and understood the details of every weapon. This battle saber was most suitable for him.
With the saber in hand, Meng Chuan walked forward.
For this war, for the sake of the entire human race, I have to enter the top five in the Battle God Pagoda. Meng Chuan’s fighting spirit rose. This way, he could obtain everything from the Eon Sea Sect. With everything from the Eon Sea Sect, Archean Mountain would be able to restore a portion of the Archean Eon Sect’s former glory. This greatly boosted the chances of humanity winning this war.
Whoosh.
A vortex appeared in the sky. A figure descended from the vortex-an alien expert with scale armor and wings. He swooped down as he attacked.
Meng Chuan knew that this was an opponent formed by the array formation.
Come on. Meng Chuan instantly transformed into a beam of light and charged over.

chapters.title: Chapter 385 - Level After Level
chapters.content:
Chapter 385 Level After Level
Meng Chuan had engaged in close combat since he was young.
After reaching the Blood Droplet realm, he had reached a brand new level in close combat! However, after obtaining a Tribulation treasure —the Bloodblade Disc-he had only used the Bloodblades to fight his opponents. He never fully showcased his expertise afforded to him at the Blood Droplet realm. However, he had returned to his normal close combat techniques in the Battle God Pagoda. This was the most common combat method for experts in the Cosmos Body cultivation system.
Swoosh.
He was so fast that he was almost a beam of light.
Meng Chuan’s movement speed was too fast, and the saber in his hand was also very fast. The scale-armored, winged alien expert didn’t even have time to dodge. He could only swing his sword in a bid to block the attack, but the saber beam dodged the strike with an arc. It easily sliced through his waist, splitting him into two. Following that, the alien expert’s body dissipated into energy particles. This first level is easy. Meng Chuan flew towards the vortex. The opponents on the first level are probably at the level of a peak fifth Firmament demon monarch.
After reaching the Blood Droplet realm, Meng Chuan’s pure strength and speed soared. His body surpassed even peak fifth Firmament demon monarchs. With the Cloud Dragon Snake Saber and the Infinite Saber, he naturally reached the threshold of the Creation realm. In terms of strength in a head-on battle, he was stronger than King Calm Sea without the Bloodblade disc. Reaching the Blood Droplet realm had boosted his body’s strength greatly.
This body was even stronger than Blood Shura -a demon. He could be considered an enhanced version of Blood Shura.
After passing through the vortex, Meng Chuan arrived in the void. Five black-armored aliens stood silently in the void. They were about 30 feet tall, and their faces were ugly. They wore black armor and had sharp, scaled tails. When Meng Chuan appeared, their eyes lit up as they attacked him in a second.
When they flew over, the void distorted, making Meng Chuan feel like there was no way for him to dodge. They can actually set up formations. Furthermore, they are quite fast. Meng Chuan looked at the five black-armored aliens and immediately executed the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique. In an instant, he had already entered the depths of the void. Only nine embodiments remained as he lunged at the five black-armored aliens.
Pfft.
A saber beam appeared from the depths of the void and struck a black-armored alien’s body. After his body split open, the black-armored alien dissipated into nothingness.
Meng Chuan used his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique and closed in on the other black-armored aliens through the deep void. He dealt with them one by one. These black-armored aliens were stronger than the opponent at the first level, but they were still easily dispatched.
After dealing with the five black-armored aliens, Meng Chuan appeared from the deep void. It’s no wonder the World Roving Dragon Saber-created by Supremacy Ye Hong-is called the number one movement technique of humanity. It’s indeed shameless. I can attack my opponent, but my opponent can’t touch
me.
Of course, this move had its flaws. If his opponent shattered the superficial void, Meng Chuan would be revealed. If his opponent could also enter the deep void, then he would be in trouble. Another instance would be the enemy transmitting their might through Meng Chuan’s saber to Meng Chuan’s true body during close combat. However, Meng Chuan’s movement technique was truly terrifying among Regis Godfiends.
Meng Chuan flew into the third level from the sky’s vortex and saw a white-furred tiger demon monarch.
A demon? Demons also appear in the Battle God Pagoda? Meng Chuan shuddered before coming to a realization. That’s right. The Demon Realm and the human world are now connected in the River of Spacetime. I believe they weren’t too far apart in the past. They should be in the same region in the River of Spacetime. The Demon Realm has a longer history than us. Ancestral Master Archean Eon should have known about the Demon Realm long ago.
The white-furred tiger demon monarch had a powerful aura as he stared coldly at Meng Chuan with his yellow vertical pupils.
Buzz.
The surrounding void suddenly froze in an attempt to restrain Meng Chuan.
A demonic divine power? When Meng Chuan sensed the binding force, he immediately dove into the deep void. Following that, he approached the tiger demon monarch and slashed out from the void. The tiger demon monarch frowned slightly as he hurriedly brandished his claws to block the saber beam. However, the saber beam made an unpredictable, abrupt turn. It easily avoided the claw and brushed past the tiger demon monarch’s waist.
Black wind condensed around the tiger demon monarch’s body. The layers of black wind were extremely resistant. After Meng Chuan’s saber sliced through the black wind, he only managed to lacerate the tiger demon monarch’s hide before dissipating.
He quickly retracted his saber.
The tiger demon monarch’s injuries healed in the blink of an eye.
“If you have the guts, come out.” The tiger demon monarch spoke in the human language as he angrily looked at the nine Meng Chuan embodiments around him. Clearly, he knew that his opponent’s true body was hidden deep in the void.
The opponents formed by the Battle God Pagoda’s array formation are the same as real demon monarchs. This demon monarch is considered rather multifaceted among peak fifth Firmament demon monarchs. It has a domain divine power, defensive divine power, and a powerful body. Its recovery speed is astonishing. Its claw arts are also at the peak of the Dharma Domain realm. Perhaps it has other offensive divine powers. However, as long as I hide in the void, it can’t use its powers against me. Meng Chuan understood this point. This is a very well-rounded opponent. Meng Chuan rapidly approached. The tiger demon monarch became even more solemn as his eyes flashed with a golden light. Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!
Saber beams attacked from different directions.
The tiger demon monarch’s surroundings, including the sky and the ground, were filled with saber beams. This made the tiger demon monarch panic.
Meng Chuan pushed the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique to its limits. He executed Infinite Saber, delivering 16 consecutive strikes.
The Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique had bizarre, unpredictable movements. Coupled with the ferocity of the Infinite Saber, it made the tiger demon monarch panic.
Clang! Clang! Clang!
The howling, black wind domain affected the demon monarch’s surroundings. The tiger demon monarch used his claw to block the attacks. Although the Infinite Saber lacked variation, it was much more powerful! It could perfectly unleash Meng Chuan’s physical strength as a Blood Droplet realm expert. The tiger demon monarch struggled to block every attack. Furthermore, the attacks came from all directions.
The seventh strike sliced through the tiger demon monarch’s arm and sent it flying.
The eighth strike and the ninth strike...
When the 16th strike landed, the tiger demon monarch—who had been diced into more than ten pieces-disappeared.I won. Meng Chuan’s true body exited the void. If I only had the Infinite Saber and didn’t have the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique, it would probably take me quite some time to kill it. I can even sense that the tiger demon monarch has an unknown divine power that it couldn’t use on me.
He created two saber arts that followed different paths. Although they weren’t focused, they made up for his flaws and made him more well-rounded. This translated into giving him different ways to deal with different enemies in combat.
Next is the fourth level. The opponents on the fourth level will be even stronger. They should be in the Creation realm. The probability of me clearing it is very low. Meng Chuan understood his strength. No matter what, I have to give it my all!
Meng Chuan followed the vortex and flew to the fourth level.
In order to win the war, he had to do his best.
Outside the Battle God Pagoda.
The Guardian stood there alone as he looked at one of the pillars beside the door. The words on the stone pillar faintly appeared.
He has cleared the third level. The Guardian looked at the Battle God Pagoda’s stone pillar and was somewhat puzzled. It’s already very outstanding for him to be ranked 35th. However, he should have the strength of a threshold Creation realm expert if he can clear the third level. He’s only 59 years old; how can he not enter the top ten with such strength? Could it be that he cleared the third level because of his special cultivation system? Or is it because of a treasure that makes his body stronger? One’s technique realm and age were the key elements of the Battle God Pagoda’s judgment. These made one’s potential more evident. As for strength, combat intelligence, and other aspects, their importance was secondary.

chapters.title: Chapter 386 - Impregnable
chapters.content:
Chapter 386 Impregnable
He’s my opponent for the fourth level? Meng Chuan looked at a middle-aged man with two swords on his back. This is the first human opponent I’ve encountered in the Battle God Pagoda.
Of course, it was just created by the formation. “Your body is rather powerful, but your saber art is a little rough,” said the middle-aged man with a smile. At the same time, he drew the two swords on his back.
“You know what happened during the first three levels?” asked Meng Chuan.
“Of course.” The middle-aged man smiled and said, “I control every opponent in the Battle God Pagoda. Due to this, I know the methods you used in the previous battles. As for who I am? I’m the Battle God Pagoda itself. What you encountered previously were some living beings that had once existed in reality. It simply simulated their strength when they were alive.”
“You sure talk a lot. You didn’t speak much during the first three levels,” said Meng Chuan.
“That’s because I estimate that you will stop at the fourth level,” said the middle-aged man with a smile. “It’s been hundreds of thousands of years. It’s been quite lonely waiting for a human to enter the Battle God Pagoda.”
“I’ll stop at the fourth level?” Meng Chuan drew his saber. “Be careful.”
“I can’t kill you if you hide, but you can’t kill me either,” said the middle-aged man with a smile.
“Really?”
With a flash, nine Meng Chuans charged forward.
The middle-aged man stood in his spot, holding a sword in each hand. He knew very well that they were only embodiments. Furthermore, protective sword beams began to surface on his body. At the same time, the surrounding void began to distort. The closer Meng Chuan got to the depths of the void, the greater the effects of the distorted void. He would be forced to appear when he was 1,000 feet away.
I can kill you with a single strike when I’m 1,000 feetaway from you. Meng Chuan circled the middle-aged man as he constantly attacked.
Clang! Clang! Clang!
Saber beams shot out.
Meng Chuan was either as fast as lightning, or extremely unpredictable. However, the middle-aged man easily parried the attacks with his sword. His defense was flawless. “In my sword domain, your shallow saber techniques are useless.”
Boom!
Meng Chuan revealed his true body and charged into the thousand-foot-wide distorted area. He came close to the middle-aged man.
The opponent was a human Godfiend formed by the array formations. His sword arts were superb, but his body was relatively weak. With his Blood Droplet-realm body, Meng Chuan naturally had to attack his opponent’s weaknesses. He had to engage in close combat!
“That’s right. Your body’s strength is your advantage. You should engage in close combat.” The middle-aged man still swung his sword in a relaxed manner. Every strike forced Meng Chuan to retreat. “Unfortunately, my swords exhibit both Yin and Yang. They are impregnable.” Boom!
Suddenly, a thick bolt of lightning erupted. The lightning was far faster than any weapon or movement technique.
Meng Chuan’s movement technique was as fast as a beam of light. However, without the Bloodblade Disc, he could only travel a few dozen kilometers in a second. A true bolt of lightning... was much faster than Meng Chuan. In the blink of an eye, it could traverse the entire human world.
Therefore, there was no way to dodge real lightning. One was bound to be hit.
Boom!
No matter how powerful or exquisite the middle-aged man’s sword techniques were, he was still struck by the lightning bolt. Although his sword domain weakened the lightning and his body was covered by a Yin-Yang protective sword beam, he suffered the brunt of the lightning strike—which was as strong as a Creation realm expert’s attack. He vomited blood as his body turned numb.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!
Divine Power—Heaven’s Wrath!
Meng Chuan cast Heaven’s Wrath five times consecutively!
Every Heaven’s Wrath was comparable to the strike of a normal Creation realm expert. The powerful lightning bolts made it difficult for the middle-aged man to use his transcendent sword art. He could only use his domain and protective sword beam to withstand the strikes.
The first strike numbed his body as the protective sword beam began to dissipate. The second strike caused even more damage. This was followed by the third, fourth, and fifth lightning bolt! After five consecutive strikes, the middle-aged man’s charred body fell to the ground. His two swords had long been sent flying by the lightning. His charred body dissipated as he vanished from the world.
Impregnable defense? I really want to see how you defend against lightning! Meng Chuan felt empty. To ensure that he could pass the fourth level, he had released all the lightning in his body.
I’ll take a breather first. Meng Chuan sat down cross-legged and used his grotto-heaven’s Origins power to replenish the lightning in his body rapidly. He wanted to attempt the fifth level in his peak state. Therefore, he had to wait for his lightning stores to recover completely. Heaven’s Wrath is indeed excellent. Back then, it was this move that saved King Calm Sea’s life. This move is impossible to dodge thanks to its extreme speed. It can even cause paralysis. It’s very effective against those with weaker bodies.
He passed the fourth level? Outside the Battle God Pagoda, the Guardian was astonished. The opponents on the fourth level typically target the weak points of those who enter the pagoda. They are opponents at the Creation realm. It’s very difficult to kill them.
The opponents a Godfiend encountered varied. The opponents would target the weakness of the Godfiend; therefore, it was hard to advance further.
His ranking has increased. He’s ranked 12th. The Guardian looked at the stone pillar in puzzlement. He’s 59 years old. He killed an opponent at the threshold of the Creation realm. His strength is astonishing. Does the Battle God Pagoda still think that Humanity’s Demon Slayer doesn’t have the right to be in the top ten?
It’s impossible to clear the fifth level. Typically, one needs to be at the peak of the Creation realm before they can do so.
After resting for six hours and using his grotto-heaven’s Origins powers to recover, Meng Chuan went to the fifth level.
CCC
The fifth level.
Oh? Meng Chuan looked in front of him.
A human elder stood there. His Grotto-Heaven domain enveloped 50 kilometers around him. It was extremely powerful. This Grotto-Heaven domain was simulated by the Battle God Pagoda, but its might was in no way inferior.
“I never expected you to have such a powerful divine power as a human Godfiend,” said the human elder. “Every bolt of lightning was astonishing in strength. I lost due to the five consecutive strikes.”
“I’m also doing this to clear the Battle God Pagoda,” said Meng Chuan. “Now that the human world is facing a calamity, I have to be ranked in the top five before I can help the human world.”Meng Chuan had extravagant hopes. He hoped that his words would make the other party be biased towards him.
“Humanity is facing a calamity?” The elder was puzzled.
Meng Chuan explained the situation in the outside world. The human elder listened carefully. After all, he had been isolated for too long. Furthermore, he also stood on the side of the human world.
“I really want to help you, but I’m the Battle God Pagoda. I have to follow the rules set by Ancestral Master Archean Eon,” said the human elder. “Your opponents on the fifth level are all at the Creation realm. There are a total of nine.”
Just as he finished speaking, the power of the array formation began to condense one opponent after another.
Apart from the human elder, there was also a demon sage. The coiled demon dragon was nearly two kilometers long. There was a winged alien expert. His entire body shone with a golden light. There was also a tall, skinny elder with dark skin. There were two soft feelers on his forehead...
There were a total of nine Creation realm existences.
The human elder apologetically said, “This is a rule. There’s nothing I can do about it. I can tell you that each of the nine experts here are equivalent to an ordinary Creation realm expert. They each have their own strengths. They have strong physical bodies, domains, long-range attacks, etc... They will cooperate with each other as they deal with you. You will need to kill all of them before you can clear the fifth level. In history, peak Creation realm experts generally can clear the fifth level.”

chapters.title: Chapter 387 - Meng Chuan Unleashed
chapters.content:
Chapter 387 Meng Chuan Unleashed
Peak Creation realm expert? Meng Chuan’s heart tightened. Even if he tried his best, he was far from reaching the Creation realm’s peak.
His master, Qin Wu, only had the strength of a peak Creation realm expert if he didn’t use a Tribulation treasure. Of course, due to cultivating the Thirteen Swordbane Fiend Body, his master was extremely powerful when it came to offense among peak Creation Supremacies.
In the Godfiend cultivation system, sharpshooters were the strongest, offensive-wise.
Although a sharpshooter could theoretically cultivate any Godfiend body, sharpshooters usually had limited life-preservation means. It was also difficult for them to grow stronger. Humanity didn’t even have a single Creation realm sharpshooter. If Liu Qiyue cast Phoenix’s Nirvana, she could unleash the strength of a Creation realm sharpshooter for an extremely short period of time. However, the stronger she was, the faster she consumed her lifespan when casting Phoenix’s Nirvana. Be it her husband, Meng Chuan, or the sect; they forbade Liu Qiyue from using Phoenix’s Nirvana without good reason.
“Generally, only those at the peak of the Creation realm can clear this level?” asked Meng Chuan. “In other words, there are exceptions?”
“If one’s combat methods are very comprehensive, top Creation realm experts with extremely high combat intelligence stand a chance,” said the human elder. “However, you’ve only reached the Dharma Domain realm. Your techniques are too crude. There’s no hope for you.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
After painting the Fifteen Lightning Forms, he cultivated in a manner that led to the essence of lightning. He also studied the Bloodblade Disc. Now, he had attained Greater Mastery of the Dharma Domain realm with the Infinite Saber Art and the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique.
Of course, Greater Mastery of the Dharma Domain realm was relatively easy to achieve. It was difficult to reach the Dharma Domain realm’s peak. Reaching the Grotto-Heaven realm was ten times harder.
I can’t clear it? Meng Chuan recalled what the Guardian said.
“It’s not important which level you reach in the nine storied-Battle God Pagoda. What’s important is to showcase yourself. When inside, try your best to showcase your strength. That might boost the Battle God Pagoda’s evaluation of you. This slight boost might be the difference between being ranked fifth or sixth.”
The Guardian had made it clear.
It’s not important which level I reach. What’s important is to showcase myself.
“Come on.”
The human elder smiled.
Rumble~
The nine Creation realm experts unleashed their techniques.
The surrounding void began to freeze as layers of fog churned around them. An astonishing repulsive force swept in all directions.
With just a little bit of teamwork, they managed to combine multiple domains perfectly. This is already alarming. Meng Chuan stood in the same spot as he felt the repulsive force sweep past him. He struggled to stand still.
Domains didn’t necessarily improve when stacked upon one another. For example, one domain could freeze the void, while another domain could shatter the void. If they were used at the same time, they would only affect each other negatively, weakening both domains greatly. As for the nine Creation realm experts chosen by the Battle God Pagoda, they naturally had perfect teamwork.
Swoosh.
With a single movement, Meng Chuan entered the deep void. He could no longer sense the repulsive force.
As he approached the nine experts, the void froze. Even Meng Chuan-who was deep in the void—was unable to hide any longer.
I can’t get within 1.5 kilometers of them. Meng Chuan tried to appear.
This was because he was completely suppressed by the multiple domains, even though he was about 1.5 kilometers away.
The void froze like a huge block of ice. He was a fish that had been frozen within. Although he could continue moving, he needed to break through the frozen void. Furthermore, the fog’s full-force binding and the repulsive force were even more astonishing. This made it very difficult for Meng Chuan to approach the nine Creation realm experts.
Under the stacked domains, my strength has declined significantly; I now only have peak Regis strength. I probably won’t be able to get close to them. Meng Chuan understood this. He was confident about fighting an ordinary Creation realm expert one-on-one. However, when nine Creation realm experts combined forces, he felt despair.
I have to rely on my divine powers. I have to showcase myself as much as possible and raise my ranking
With a thought, every particle world in Meng Chuan’s body erupted. This was actually similar to a forbidden spell unleashed by an ordinary Godfiend. However, unleashing each particles’ power when he was in the Blood Droplet realm made it more complete. He unleashed the potential of every particle, causing his body’s strength, speed, toughness, and other aspects to improve significantly. Even the particle world domain was completely released. Although each individual microscopic domain was very weak, a qualitative change in strength would occur when countless of them combined.
They automatically formed a domain and even affected the surrounding 50 kilometers.
Divine power-Heaven Earth Control!
This was a very common divine power for Blood Droplet realm experts, but it was also extremely powerful. It was a divine power that could be used when fighting for his life. This was because this divine power could only last for about 30 seconds. After 30 seconds, his Blood Droplet realm body could no longer maintain it.
This is such a wonderful feeling. Meng Chuan felt his powerful body and domain resisting the surrounding domains. It weakened those domains greatly.
Silver runes appeared on both sides of Meng Chuan’s forehead as silver lightning flashed around his head; silver lightning filled his eyes.
This was another divine power Meng Chuan used in concert with Heaven Earth Control. It was a divine power that was not recorded in the legacy-Flowing Sand!
Meng Chuan only affected the flow of time on his body. This way, the expenditure was the lowest.
At that moment, everything in the outside world slowed down... or rather, he became faster.
Three seconds in the outside world was 30 seconds for Meng Chuan. Thus, Meng Chuan’s every move became ten times faster.
Boom!
Heaven Earth Control domain constantly attacked the stacked domains, reducing the effects of the enemy’s domains. Phasing away, Meng Chuan charged towards the nine experts. His speed was terrifying.
In a flash, he could traverse 190 kilometers.
In reality, Meng Chuan was ten times faster than before. Even with the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique, he could move 250 kilometers in a second. However, due to the multi-layered domain, his speed was reduced to 190 kilometers per flash. This was the result of the Heaven Earth Control domain greatly reducing the stacked domains’ effectiveness.
So fast.
The nine experts were alarmed as they used various methods to stop Meng Chuan.
The demon dragon charged at Meng Chuan. The 300-foot-tall giant held a pike in its hand. A petite winged woman blinked her eyes, and seven colorful beams flew out from her wings, heading towards Meng Chuan.
Among the nine experts, some were skilled at close combat, while others were good at long-range attacks. They all attacked with all their might.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan was too fast. Although he couldn’t hide in the deep void, the nine experts were still somewhat flustered by his speed.
He’s too fast.
We can’t catch up.
Out of the nine attacks, only three managed to catch up to Meng Chuan. They were the human elder’s Thirteen Swordbanes, the winged woman’s seven colorful beams, and the golden beam that shot out from the demon dragon’s forehead. These three attacks could catch up to Meng Chuan—who was moving at a speed of 190 kilometers per flash.
Swish! Swish! Swish!Not only was Meng Chuan fast, but his movements were unpredictable.
In terms of variations, the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique surpassed the World Roving Dragon Saber. When executing this technique, it was difficult to determine Meng Chuan’s flying trajectory. Furthermore, Meng Chuan was in a constant Yin-Yang state. Sometimes an attack pierced through Meng Chuan, only to realize a moment later that it was just an afterimage.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
Most of the attacks from the human elder, the winged woman, and the demon dragon missed. They failed to touch Meng Chuan.
Pfft.
Only two Swordbanes and one colorful light beam struck Meng Chuan. Meng Chuan’s saber blocked one Swordbane and the colorful light beam, while he let his body withstand the last Swordbane.
Although Swordbanes were powerful, with his Heaven Earth Control’s might unleashed, Meng Chuan’s body had improved in every aspect. The Indestructible Divine Armor’s strength had increased greatly. The Swordbane barely pierced through the Indestructible Divine Armor, leaving a small wound on Meng Chuan’s body. His Blood Droplet realm body healed it in the blink of an eye.
Although it took time to describe, in the blink of an eye, Meng Chuan had already torn through the obstruction and arrived in front of the winged woman as an illusory stream of light.

chapters.title: Chapter 388 - Leaving the Battle God Pagoda
chapters.content:
Chapter 388 Leaving the Battle God Pagoda
After the nine experts unleashed their respective techniques, Meng Chuan had a rough understanding of them. From their auras, techniques, and how far they distanced themselves from him, Meng Chuan could conclude that three of the nine experts had weak physical bodies. The amalgamation of factors allowed him to conclude that he had the greatest chance of killing the winged woman, the tall, skinny, swarthy elder with the feelers, and the human elder.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
Dazzling saber beams struck the winged woman.
Affected by Flowing Sand, Meng Chuan had struck out ten times in the time it usually took him to deliver one attack. The winged woman only felt dazzling saber beams cleave down at her.
Although she instantly retracted her wings as a colorful light appeared over her body, the protective light dissipated after being struck ten times. Her wings ruptured, and her face was filled with panic. Following that, a blinding bolt of lightning welcomed her.
Divine power—Heaven’s Wrath!
With her protective light gone and her wings peppered with injuries, she was unable to protect herself perfectly. The lightning struck her, causing her body to turn numb. Rainbow blood flowed out from her mouth and nose.
At that moment, another saber beam cleaved the paralyzed, heavily-injured woman, completely halving her body. Her body suddenly exploded, transforming into a large number of feathers that attempted to fly away.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Saber beams swept across the area-none of the feathers managed to escape. All the feathers were destroyed.
The winged woman died.
Although it took time to describe, Meng Chuan cast Heaven’s Wrath and delivered a dozen strikes in the blink of an eye.
I’ve killed one. Meng Chuan was filled with joy. Since he cultivated Essence Soul Star and had a fifth-level Essence Soul, the speed of his thoughts was no less than that of a Creation realm expert.
When affected by Flowing Sand, his mind was ten times faster.
His mind and body were both fast.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan executed his movement technique and left behind a mysterious mark as he attacked the skinny, swarthy elder with the feelers. Even the Thirteen Swordbanes—which had the strength of a Creation realm expertwere unable to completely lock onto Meng Chuan. Every time, only one or two strikes connected.
He’s a mere Regis Godfiend, yet he killed a Creation realm alien despite being outnumbered nine to one. The human elder watched. That was a true Winged saint, who once existed. Master once said that strength ultimately decides one’s fate. With strength, one will be respected and feared by all. He’s a 59-year-old Regis Godfiend, but he’s really strong. He has a very powerful physical body; it allows him to withstand several Swordbane strikes without any problem. His cultivation system definitely has very strict requirements if he can cultivate his body to such an extent.
The River of Spacetime developed its own limitations in an unspoken manner. The stronger a cultivation system was, the higher the requirements. The more powerful a legacy was, the harder it was for one to cultivate it. To obtain great strength, one had to break through many difficult obstacles. Is he cultivating the Desolate cultivation system? The Cosmos Body cultivation system? Or is it the Combat Body cultivation system? The human elder guessed how Meng Chuan cultivated his body. He had followed Ancestral Master Archean Eon for a long time, so he knew the famous physical body cultivation systems in the River of Spacetime.
Furthermore, he cultivates two saber arts. One saber art is extremely powerful and fast. His ten consecutive strikes easily dispatched the winged saint. The other saber art is unpredictable. Together with his speed, it’s even harder to block. However, it has inferior strength. His movement technique is also bizarre and unpredictable. He can also enter the depths of the void.
The elder looked at Meng Chuan. He’s probably only at the Greater Mastery of the Dharma Domain realm, yet he already has a divine power in the Time lineage.
What were divine powers?
They were manifestations of one’s talent! When specific types of divine powers manifested, it meant that one’s physical body and Essence Soul were talented in this aspect. When one was weaker, that talent would manifest in the form of divine powers. When one was stronger-a Creation realm expert or an Imperial Lord—they would begin to comprehend their divine powers. They would begin to utilize this power at a more profound level.
He’s able to infiltrate the void’s depths. He clearly has talent in space and time. His potential is indeed astonishing since he grasped these two powers so early.
Space and time combined was spacetime. Only the pinnacle existences in the outer realm had the ability to control spacetime. According to normal cultivation, a Regis Godfiend would typically come into contact with the void. Only Grotto-Heaven realm experts would come into contact with time. This was why Grotto-Heaven realm experts could travel the River of Spacetime. However, Meng Chuan could utilize these two powers at a very early stage; he was capable of accelerating time by ten-fold. Even if King True Martial came into contact with time, it would be difficult for him to accelerate it by ten-fold. However, King Calm Sea-who focused on the Time lineage-could influence time by several-fold, but he couldn’t influence it by ten-fold either.
If he reaches the Grotto-Heaven realm, his control over the time and space powers will greatly improve.
Meng Chuan cleaved at the swarthy elder repeatedly. The swarthy elder was like a stream of water as he was sliced apart time and time again. He even split into dozens of thin embodiments. He smiled at Meng Chuan the entire time.
Only then did Meng Chuan understand. I chose the wrong opponent. Meng Chuan thought that the thin, swarthy elder’s physical body wasn’t strong because he used his domain from afar. However, it was only after exchanging blows that he realized that his opponent was extremely difficult to kill.
He had made a wrong judgment about the three experts with weak bodies. His judgment was very accurate when it came to the winged woman, but he was wrong when it came to the skinny, swarthy elder. He couldn’t take his simple conclusions seriously when facing alien experts.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan charged at the human elder.
Thirteen Swordbanes, protect me. With a thought, the human elder moved the Thirteen Swordbanes to block Meng Chuan.
The other close-combat experts came to the human elder’s side and helped block the attacks. They also surrounded Meng Chuan.
Ropes wrapped around Meng Chuan. Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!
Meng Chuan moved 190 kilometers in a second. With the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique, Meng Chuan was unstoppable. However, the human elder only focused on defending. With his companions working with him, Meng Chuan couldn’t do anything to the human elder after six seconds of attempts. He could only switch targets and try one by one.
Meng Chuan tried his best.
He tried three more experts. Unfortunately, one of them had a relatively strong body and was good at close combat. In a one-on-one battle, Meng Chuan would probably have to fight for a long time before he could finish the expert off. Now that there were so many of them, it was impossible to finish him off in a short period of time. The other two were exactly as he guessed—their life-preservation abilities were ridiculously strong.
When Meng Chuan began to feel extremely weak, he was no longer able to maintain his divine power-Heaven Earth Control. The stacked domain suppressed him greatly, and his body became even weaker. His strength decreased drastically. Although he maintained his ten-fold speed with Flowing Sand, his speed was reduced to 50 kilometers per flash.
Pew!
The demon dragon shot out a golden beam.
Meng Chuan swung his saber to block it, but he couldn’t withstand it. His saber was sent flying. The golden beam penetrated Meng Chuan’s body! Both his Indestructible Divine Armor and body were penetrated.
“I admit defeat,” shouted Meng Chuan as he quickly recovered.
Admit defeat?
The eight experts were stunned.
“I admit defeat.” Meng Chuan felt exhausted. Under the suppression of multiple domains, his strength and speed were greatly reduced. There was no way he could continue fighting.
He knew his strength very well.
Typically, his strength was only at the Creation realm’s threshold. If he used the two divine powers-Heaven Earth Control and Flowing Sand-at the same time, he could increase his combat strength to the level of a top Creation realm expert. However, he could only maintain that state for 30 seconds! In the outside world, that was three seconds!
I’ve already shown everything I can.
“I was planning on teaching you a good lesson, but you immediately admitted defeat after delivering a barrage of attacks. Godfiend, you are truly cunning,” said the human elder with a smile. The surrounding alien experts all dissipated. “Alright, you may leave.”
With that said, he waved his hand.
Meng Chuan felt the void change as he arrived outside the pagoda.
Oh? Meng Chuan looked around him. I’ve been teleported outside the pagoda? Beside him, the black-robed elder was looking at the pillar. “How’s my ranking?” asked Meng Chuan nervously.
The black-robed elder looked at Meng Chuan with mixed emotions. “You are ranked fifth in the Battle God Pagoda’s historical rankings.”

chapters.title: Chapter 389 - Eon Sea Sect’s Treasures
chapters.content:
Chapter 389 Eon Sea Sect’s Treasures
The black-robed elder’s emotions were indeed complicated. He never expected to see the mysterious Humanity’s Demon Slayer ranking first in the Heart Sea Palace, and fifth in the Battle God Pagoda. While creating history, everything in the Eon Sea Sect would be handed to him. As a Guardian, he finally could enter the human world after being alone at the bottom of the sea for hundreds of thousands of years.
“Fifth?” Meng Chuan couldn’t help but grin when he saw the ranking on the stone pillar. He laughed. “Ha, hahaha...”
He laughed happily, brimming with joy.
He had actually succeeded!
This was the third-best sect in human history. They had a small portion of the Archean Eon Sect’s legacy. Bringing this legacy back would be a great supplement to Archean Mountain. Furthermore, his master, Qin Wu, and company had a higher chance of advancing further and becoming invincible in the Creation realm. As long as an invincible Creation realm expert was born, they could win the war.
Meng Chuan yearned for that day, even in his dreams.
“Congratulations,” said the black-robed elder. “The requirements for these two tests are extremely high. I never expected you to succeed. From today onwards, the entire Eon Sea Sect will belong to you. You just need to remember not to let the Eon Sea Sect cease to exist in the future.”
“Do you need me to swear an oath?” asked Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan didn’t know much about oaths. He had never heard of it in Archean Mountain. However, the Guardian had previously mentioned that if he didn’t pass the two tests, he could still read the precious books in Star Cluster Building as long as he made an oath to recruit three outstanding disciples.
“There’s no need.” The black-robed elder looked at Meng Chuan. “For someone like you, you will fulfill your promise for the sake of your cultivation path in the future. Otherwise, the entire Eon Sea Sect will impose great karma on you. It will make your cultivation path extremely difficult.”
“A debt of karma will affect my cultivation?” Meng Chuan nodded gently. “It should be a long time from now.”
“After you become an Imperial Lord, you will realize that the greater the karma, the more you need to repay it.” The black-robed elder flipped his hand and handed a book to Meng Chuan. “This book is a list. It roughly records everything the Eon Sea Sect has. As for the detailed records, there are too many. I’ll introduce them one by one later.”
Meng Chuan took the book and flipped through it.
The book recorded the three buildings—Heart Sea Palace, Star Cluster Building, and Battle God Pagoda-as assets. “These three buildings are the most precious treasures in the Eon Sea Sect,” said the Guardian. “As you know, the 98 manuals contained within Star Cluster Building are the most precious techniques in the entire human world. The Essence Soul mystic techniques hidden in the Heart Sea Palace are also the strongest in the human world. The Battle God Pagoda can temper one’s combat strength and allow one to experience the means of experts in neighboring worlds.”
Knowledge was very precious.
The top techniques and powerful Essence Soul mystic techniques were enough to drive the human world crazy. “The other treasures we have accumulated are lacking. We can’t compare to Archean Mountain,” said the Guardian. “We only have five Tribulation treasures. There are only 12 Imperial Lord-level treasures.”
Meng Chuan’s eyelids twitched.
Lacking accumulations?
Black Sand Grotto-Heaven was considered very powerful. It had obtained two complete outer realm legacies, but they only had a handful of Tribulation treasures. This was mentioned by his master, Qin Wu, when they were chatting. In the entire human world, Archean Mountain had the most Tribulation treasures.
Out of those that are suitable for the lightning lineage and can be refined by Regis Godfiends, Archean Mountain gave me three to choose from. Meng Chuan sighed. Not a single one of the Eon Sea Sect’s five Tribulation treasures are related to the lightning lineage. I guess Archean Mountain has ten times more Tribulation treasures than the Eon Sea Sect. They might even have more.
So many treasures.
Meng Chuan looked at the introductions to various treasures and was astonished.
Although Archean Mountain valued Meng Chuan, the sect had its own rules. Many treasures were kept secret. Even the sect master didn’t know about them. Only the three Creation Supremacies and the Dao Protectors knew.
“There’s no way to compare with Archean Mountain.” The Guardian sighed.
“It’s already a lot,” Meng Chuan exclaimed.
“Our Eon Sea Sect has never produced an Imperial Lord, but we did produce three consecutive Creation realm experts,” said the Guardian. “The role of sect master was usually given to the strongest. Hundreds of Creation Supremacies have traveled through the River of Spacetime over the generations, and they have brought many treasures back from the outer realm. Of course, they can’t compare to Ancestral Master Archean Eon. Over time, many treasures have been used up.
“What couldn’t be used remains stockpiled in the treasury. Towards the waning years of the sect, Archean Mountain didn’t do much to us. They didn’t put pressure on us. However, the other sects kept hunting our Eon Sea Sect. They wanted to snatch our sect’s heritage,” said the Guardian. “It became more and more difficult for the Eon Sea Sect to recruit disciples. With the situation worsening and us holding on for more than 10,000 years, our legacy was completely severed.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
“I’ll use a small grotto-heaven that can be carried with you to relocate all the treasures in the Eon Sea Sect,” said the Guardian. “I’ll leave them with you.”
“There’s no rush.” Meng Chuan looked at the catalog and said, “I’ll choose some treasures and put them away separately. There’s a treasure, Phoenix Feather Robe, recorded here. Bring me to it so I can take a look.”
Treasure Vault-Sea 3.
Inside the treasure vault, a colorful feathered robe floated in the air. It was protected by the treasure vault’s powers, allowing it to remain intact despite the passage of time.
The Guardian pointed and said, “This is the Phoenix Feather Robe. It was obtained by seniors in the sect in the outer realm. According to our estimates, this feather robe should be made from feathers from birds that possess the phoenix bloodline. It was then created through carved runes. It’s a rather powerful protective robe. If it’s worn, attacks below the Creation realm will be unable to damage it at all. Furthermore, the robe can release phoenix flames up to 1,000 feet. The flames are extremely potent.
“The only requirement is that one has to be skilled in the fire lineage in order to activate the Phoenix Feather Robe’s runes,” explained the Guardian. “At the very least, one has to be a Regis Godfiend to unleash a portion of its strength.” “I’ll take it first.” Meng Chuan nodded.
Treasure Vault-Extraordinary 5.
Meng Chuan looked at the three red, succulent fruits in the treasure box.
“This is an extraordinary fruit that can strengthen one’s body. One experiences a rebirth after consuming it. However, mortals are too weak to consume it. Anyone below the Seamless realm can consume it. The effects will be very weak when a Regis Godfiend consumes it,” said the Guardian. “It just provides support. It can’t help a Godfiend achieve a true breakthrough.”“I’ll take it,” said Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan searched through the treasure vaults. He took everything that he found suitable for his father, mother, wife, and children.
If his children’s achievements weren’t that high, these treasures would be of help. If their achievements were high, there was no need for him to worry about them. Every Supremacy would nurture them to be Archean Mountain’s best.
Treasure Vault-Imperial 2.
“These are three Imperial Lord-level alien corpses. It was obtained by the seniors of our Eon Sea Sect when they roamed the River of Spacetime. They also brought them back.” The Guardian pointed at the three corpses. “Actually, we also collected dozens of Creation-level alien corpses. They are in another treasury.” “I’ll take them as well,” said Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan spent more than four hours choosing the various treasures in the Eon Sea Sect. They were all suitable for him and his family. However, those didn’t even make up for one percent of the treasures in the Eon Sea Sect. Meng Chuan had planned on handing over all the treasures and three major buildings to Archean Mountain. He had chosen one of the Imperial Lord-level treasures and left the rest for the sect. Only Archean Mountain could truly use these treasures to their fullest potential. He had never planned on setting up a sect. What was the point of having all these? The Heart Sea Palace and the Battle God Pagoda’s tests made Meng Chuan even more confident. He believed that he might become an Imperial Lord or even a Tribulation Eminence in the future.
However, the most important thing now was to win the war first.
If they lost the war, nothing mattered.

chapters.title: Chapter 390 - Ancestral Master Eon Sea (Final Chapter of Volume)
chapters.content:
Chapter 390 Ancestral Master Eon Sea (Final Chapter of Volume)
“This is the Eon Sea Pavilion. It’s where the sect masters of the Eon Sea Sect cultivate.” The Guardian brought Meng Chuan to a seven-story building.
“The first floor is where the sect master teaches disciples. I’m bringing you to the seventh floor. Only sect masters can enter,” said the Guardian. Although the building looked small from the outside, every level’s interior was a hundred times larger than what could be seen on the outside.
Soon, he arrived on the building’s seventh floor.
The seventh floor was very quiet.
Huh? The moment Meng Chuan entered, he saw light gather and form a thin man’s figure.
The thin man stood there with a smile. “Has the Eon Sea Sect switched sect masters?”
Ancestral Master Eon Sea? Meng Chuan had been to many of the treasure vaults before. He had seen a portrait of him, so he naturally recognized Ancestral Master Eon Sea.
“I’ve always found myself extremely smart. I never paid much attention to the seniors in my sect,” said the thin man with a smile. “However, I never expected another disciple that’s not inferior to me to appear in the Archean Eon Sect over time. He’s my senior brother, Archean. He was very low-key and wasn’t competitive, but he unknowingly surpassed many disciples. I was actually happy because I was finally not lonely anymore. I gained a true opponent.”
Meng Chuan listened quietly.
He knew that this was an image left behind by Ancestral Master Eon Sea for every sect master.
“I competed with him my entire life.” The thin man said, “Back then, the two of us were the strongest in the Archean Eon Sect. We were able to defeat Supremacies who were a level above us and reached the invincible Creation realm. However, in the end, he became an Imperial Lord.
“In terms of cultivation, I have to admit that he had already surpassed me at the invi Creation realm,” said the thin man. “Although either of us can dominate all Supremacies in the world, there was a first among equals. I created the Eon Sea Fiend Body that is most suitable for me on my original Godfiend Body’s foundation, but he created the even more outstanding Archean Divine Body.”
In human history, there were 12 transcendent-grade Godfiend bodies. They had each created one.
It had to be known that some Imperial Lords failed to create one.
Meng Chuan also admitted that the two ancestral masters were very talented.
“The Archean Divine Body is indeed stronger. The Five Elements synergize, giving a person another direction to the Samsara Divine Body,” said the thin man. “It’s indeed stronger than mine. I had nothing to say when he took control of the Archean Eon Sect. But I didn’t expect him to be so stupid.
The thin man said, “Back then, our Archean Eon Sect was invincible in the world. There was only one sect in the world—Archean Eon Sect. Archean actually believed that... the various factions in the Archean Eon Sect often had internal conflicts in history. If this continued, there would be more serious consequences. Therefore, he felt that he should loosen the sect’s grip over the world. He even deliberately spread some cultivation methods to mortals and allowed the mortals to form sects.
“He believes that external pressure would make the Archean Eon Sect more united. What a joke. I felt that he wasn’t worthy of managing the Archean Eon Sect,” said the thin man. “He wasted the efforts of our Archean Eon Sect’s predecessors. Many Supremacies in the sect stood on my side.
“I lost that internal war. He actually broke through to become an Imperial Lord. I lost terribly. Archean didn’t wipe us out. Instead, he decided to split the sect into two-Archean Mountain and the Eon Sea Sect. The two would still be part of the Archean Eon Sect lineage,” said the thin man. “He took nine of the twelve cornerstone treasures of Archean Eon Sect and allowed me to choose three to take away. Hahaha, he was really arrogant. I chose the most important cultivation resources.
“I took away the Star Cluster Building, the Heart Sea Palace with the Essence Soul mystic techniques, and the Battle God Pagoda that can temper one’s strength. I really had no idea what he was thinking. He even handed these over.”
The thin man said coldly, “I fought with him my entire life. Our Eon Sea Sect has occupied half of the world now. The new sect masters have to make me proud. We must conquer the world and defeat Archean Mountain completely. We will swallow Archean Mountain and restore our Archean Eon Sect’s former glory.
“Unfortunately, I won’t be able to see it. Although I’m at the end of my lifespan, I believe that only our Eon Sea Sect can exist for a longer period of time. With Archean’s way of managing his sect, Archean Mountain will definitely decline. In the future, if Archean Mountain declines completely, the Eon Sea Sect’s descendants must remember that even after we devour Archean Mountain, we must keep the Archean lineage alive in the Eon Sea Sect. At the very least, my senior brother never wiped my sect out.” The thin man remained silent for a long time.
He had been fighting his senior brother his entire life. However, that was only a battle of philosophy and strength. They had never fought battles that involved life and death against each other. “I have reached the end of my lifespan, but he can still live for another 8,000 years,” said the thin man. “Clearly, cultivation is the foundation. One has to pay attention to their bodies and Essence Souls. Although one reaches the prerequisite technique realm, one cannot become an Imperial Lord if their Essence Soul hasn’t reached the necessary realm. That was my situation.
“What I’m saying next is a huge secret,” said the thin man. “Back then, when I went out to adventure in the outer realm...”
Meng Chuan listened to the secrets that only sect masters could know.
Apart from the conflict between the two ancestral masters, what followed was Ancestral Master Eon Sea’s encounters in the River of Spacetime.
The Eon Sea Sect’s heritage is indeed quite deep. Meng Chuan flipped through some books in the pavilion. These were left behind by past sect masters. They recorded many secrets that were privy to sect masters only. A sect with hundreds of thousands of years of history had hundreds of Creation Supremacies and three invincible Creation realm experts. Such accumulation was naturally astonishing.
Becoming a Creation Supremacy is the minimum requirement to enter the River of Spacetime. These secrets are too distant for me. Furthermore, the Eon Sea Sect has declined for more than 500,000 years. I’m afraid many changes have happened in the outer realm.
Meng Chuan walked out of the Eon Sea Pavilion.
Outside the building, the Guardian looked at Meng Chuan and said, “Now that you know everything about the Eon Sea Sect, do you need me to move all the treasures into a small grotto-heaven for you?”
“There’s no need,” said Meng Chuan. “I’ll hand all of these over to Archean Mountain.”
“Hand all of them over to Archean Mountain?” The Guardian was astonished. “You only took a small portion of them just now. The real treasures haven’t been touched.”
“These are sect treasures. How much can I use alone?” Meng Chuan smiled and shook his head. “I’ll send a message to Archean Mountain and get them to receive everything.”
“It’s up to you. Anyway, everything in the Eon Sea Sect belongs to you. It’s up to you to decide their fates,” said the Guardian.
Meng Chuan flipped his hand and took out his token.
He didn’t wish to relocate the treasures just like that. He was afraid that he would be attacked by the demons midway. If the Eon Sea Sect’s treasures were to fall into the hands of the demons, it would be disastrous. Although he was confident... the demons could attack him at any moment. He couldn’t be careless. “I’ll send you out of this grotto-heaven first. Otherwise, you won’t be able to contact the outside world,” said the Guardian.Meng Chuan suddenly arrived at the underwater mountain range’s entrance.
Meng Chuan held his transmission token and sent out the most ordinary request for help.
Early in the morning, Archean Mountain.
Warm sunlight scattered across the courtyard.
Li Guan and company were discussing something.
“Meng Chuan is requesting help.” Li Guan flipped his hand and took out his token. He said to Qin Wu and Luo Tang, “Don’t panic. It’s the lowest-level help request. There’s no danger. Meng Chuan probably encountered some situation and is asking us to go over to help him.”
“The lowest-level help request?” Qin Wu and Luo Tang relaxed. Li Guan glanced at the token in his hand and said with a smile, “He’s quite a distance away. He’s at the bottom of the distant North Sea. I’ll send my Essence Soul avatar to go and see what happened.”
Final Chapter of Volume-Blood Droplet Realm

chapters.title: Chapter 391 - Sect Proprietor
chapters.content:
Chapter 391 Sect Proprietor
Swoosh.
Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar flew at high speeds through the clouds. After reaching the estimated location, he dove into the sea.
It should be in this area. Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar was in the dark sea. With the transmission token, he rapidly approached the area.
Why don’t I see Meng Chuan? Li Guan was somewhat puzzled.
SuddenlyIn the depths of the sea, the void distorted as an ancient underwater mountain range appeared. Meng Chuan took the initiative to fly over.
“Supremacy.” Meng Chuan’s face was filled with delight.
“Meng Chuan, what happened? Why did you summon me?” Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar smiled.
“Supremacy, look over there.” Meng Chuan pointed into the distance. In one of the massive underwater mountains, there was an ancient mountain entrance.
Li Guan looked carefully and recognized the words on the mountain gate. “Eon Sea?”
His expression changed.
“Eon Sea Sect?” Li Guan naturally knew the relationship between the Eon Sea Sect and Archean Mountain. The two factions were the two branches of the Archean Eon Sect! Of course, Archean Mountain obtained most of the Archean Eon Sect’s legacies, and the Eon Sea Sect obtained a small portion.
“You discovered the Eon Sea Sect?” Li Guan looked at Meng Chuan in pleasant surprise. “Good, but don’t barge in recklessly. Although the Eon Sea Sect hasn’t been quiet for hundreds of thousands of years and there shouldn’t be any successors, it still has a portion of the Archean Eon Sect’s heritage. Its interior is filled with danger. Even a Creation Supremacy might die if they barge in. We need to plan slowly. Without a Supremacy Creation presiding over it, it’s ultimately a dead object. We will spend some time, 100 years, or even 1,000 years. In the end, we will definitely obtain it completely.”
Li Guan was prepared to spend 1,000 years laying siege to it. “I’ve met the Eon Sea Sect’s Guardian. I’m now in control of everything in the Eon Sea Sect,” explained Meng Chuan immediately. “I invited you here because I want to hand all of it over to Archean Mountain.” “You have already obtained everything from the Eon Sea Sect?” Li Guan was stunned. “You want to hand it over to Archean Mountain?”
“I’ll invite the Guardian to meet you, Supremacy,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. He looked behind him. A black fog condensed into a black-robed, long-browed elder. The black-robed elder bowed to Li Guan. “Master said that everything in the Eon Sea Sect would be handed over to Archean Mountain. I only need a moment to move everything in the Eon Sea Sect to a small grotto-heaven.”
“What? Meng Chuan obtained everything from the Eon Sea Sect?” Qin Wu and Luo Tang were shocked.
Qin Wu shook his head. “Even if a sect like the Eon Sea Sect declines, it’s not something Meng Chuan can easily conquer.”
“He has already summoned the Guardian to meet me.” Li Guan sighed in amazement. “He doesn’t dare to bring the entire sect back. He’s afraid that an accident might happen midway. I also don’t dare to have my Essence Soul avatar bring the entire Eon Sea Sect back... If the demons really attack and I make a mistake, I’ll be Archean Mountain’s number one sinner if I lose the Eon Sea Sect’s treasures. My Essence Soul avatar is returning to Sword Sovereign City to replace you.” Li Guan looked at Qin Wu. “Junior Brother Qin, send your true body over to relocate the Eon Sea Sect personally.”
“The entire Eon Sea Sect?” Qin Wu and Luo Tang were somewhat shocked.
“Back then, our Archean Mountain retained nine of the 12 cornerstone treasures that Ancestral Master Archean Eon left behind. The Eon Sea Sect obtained three cornerstone treasures,” Luo Tang couldn’t help but say. “It’s all coming back to us? Meng Chuan has made such a great contribution. How should we treat him?”
Qin Wu nodded gently. “Archean Mountain has its rules. The rewards and punishments are clear. We can’t disappoint any meritorious servant. Meng Chuan has accomplished such an unprecedented feat. Even the three Imperial Lords in Archean Mountain’s history can’t compare to Meng Chuan in terms of contributions.”
Li Guan nodded. “If the three cornerstone treasures return, his contributions will exceed any disciple in history.”
They knew very well that the Archean Eon Sect’s cornerstone treasures were priceless. They were much more precious than Tribulation treasures. They were things Ancestral Master Archean Eon had prepared for his juniors, having spared no expense in creating them. Although his successors included Imperial Lords and Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences, the treasures they brought to the sect were far inferior to Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s 12 cornerstone treasures.
“How should we reward such a meritorious service?” The three Supremacies exchanged looks.
Li Guan shook his head. “He has already obtained the entire Eon Sea Sect. Are we to bestow something more precious than the entire Eon Sea Sect? There’s no reward to be given.”
“No matter how precious an individual treasure is, it’s impossible for it to exceed the entire Eon Sea Sect,” said Qin Wu. “There’s indeed no way to reward him.”
“We have to do something. We can’t just take it for nothing,” Luo Tang said.
“Let him be a Sect Proprietor,” said Li Guan with a smile. “As Sect Proprietor, he can choose any of the sect’s treasures according to the rules. He also has the responsibility of strengthening the sect. However, we’re making an exception to let a Regis Godfiend be a Sect Proprietor. All three of us have to agree to it.”
“I agree.” Qin Wu nodded. “His current strength is comparable to a Creation realm expert. With his talent, he will definitely become one.”
“I agree too. Since he has surpassed every disciple in Archean Mountain’s history, it’s alright for him to become a Sect Proprietor ahead of time,” said Luo Tang. Li Guan nodded. “Alright, our Archean Mountain will have four Sect Proprietors in the future. Everything will be decided by the four of us.”
The Sect Proprietors decided all of Archean Mountain’s important matters. They decided everything about the sect. They didn’t care about credits when it came to contributing to the sect. Of course, they were allowed to take any of the sect’s items as long as it was within the rules. They were responsible for the allocation of the sect’s resources.
Deep in the sea.
Qin Wu’s true body arrived at the underwater mountain range and met Meng Chuan and the Guardian.
“The entire Eon Sea Sect has been relocated to three small grotto-heavens.” The Guardian handed three beads to Meng Chuan. “Master, you can decide everything now.” After Meng Chuan put them away, the Guardian immediately transformed into a black fog and entered one of the beads. “Master.” Meng Chuan handed it over seriously. “Good, good, good.” When Qin Wu took the three grotto-heaven beads, he could not hide his excitement and anxiety. “Is the Heart Sea Palace, the Battle God Pagoda, and Star Cluster Building among them?”
“They’re all inside. They’re intact,” said Meng Chuan.
“Okay.” Qin Wu nodded immediately. Archean Mountain was most concerned about the three cornerstone treasures. He looked at Meng Chuan and sighed. “Back when the Archean Eon Sect split in two, the Star Cluster Building and the other two cornerstone treasures fell into the hands of the Eon Sea Sect. Nearly 800,000 years have passed since then, and these three cornerstone treasures have finally returned to us. Meng Chuan, you have contributed too much this time.”
“When it’s in Archean Mountain, I can still visit the Heart Sea Palace, the Battle God Pagoda, and the Star Cluster Building in the future. I can also read the manuals whenever I want,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “It’s a waste for one to monopolize all of Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s efforts alone.”
Qin Wu smiled at Meng Chuan.
Many of the Star Cluster Building’s secret manuals were original copies and unique! Each original copy of a manual had unimaginable value!
When one reached the Battle God Pagoda’s ninth floor, one would have a chance of killing an Imperial Lord! It could also be used to guard the sect.
The Heart Sea Palace could test Godfiends and attack enemies.
After obtaining the three cornerstone treasures, the Eon Sea Sect had lasted for 200,000 years. Hundreds of Supremacies had been born in the sect’s long history. Even now, other sects had failed to take down the Eon Sea Sect.
Meng Chuan had also completed two difficult tests. Due to this, the Guardian had taken the initiative to hand over everything in the Eon Sea Sect to him.
