If they really wanted to take everything by force? Archean Mountain-a faction that shared the same origins-had already planned on spending 1,000 years to conquer it.
“Let’s go back to Archean Mountain.” Qin Wu didn’t say anything else as he returned with Meng Chuan. The master-disciple duo flew for a long time.
“We’re back.”
Upon seeing the endless Archean Mountain mountain range, Qin Wu and Meng Chuan heaved a sigh of relief. They had successfully brought back the Eon Sea Sect!

chapters.title: Chapter 392 - Secrets
chapters.content:
Chapter 392 Secrets
Li Guan and Luo Tang welcomed them from high above.
“I didn’t disappoint you,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “I’ve already brought the Eon Sea Sect back.” With that said, he opened his palm. There were three grotto-heaven beads in his palm.
The three mysterious beads were three small grotto-heavens. They contained everything the Eon Sea Sect had accumulated. They were priceless.
“Finally, the 12 cornerstone treasures have been reunited again,” said Li Guan wistfully. “Since I, Li Guan, have seen all of this before I die, I can really rest in peace. Meng Chuan, thank you.”
“It was also a fortuitous opportunity for me,” said Meng Chuan. He could sense Li Guan’s deep feelings for Archean Mountain.
After managing a sect for so long, how could they not have deep feelings for it after putting in so much heart and effort into it?
“Meng Chuan, it’s only right for you to encounter the Eon Sea Sect that’s hidden in the world. This might be fate,” said Qin Wu. “Fate destined it to be in your hands, allowing the Eon Sea Sect to return.” “Let’s go. Let’s quickly set up the cornerstone treasures,” said Li Guan.
“This is a catalog.” Meng Chuan immediately flipped his hand and took out a book. “It simply records the treasures the Eon Sea Sect possesses. Apart from the three cornerstone treasures, there are also five Tribulation treasures...” Meng Chuan handed it over.
Li Guan flipped through it briefly and nodded in approval. “The Eon Sea Sect has accumulated quite a lot.”
“I’ve already taken one of the Imperial Lord-level treasures,” said Meng Chuan. “I’ve already made a list of the treasures I have taken at the back.”
“There’s no need to inform us about taking an Imperial Lord-level treasure,” said Li Guan with a smile. “These are originally yours. There’s no need to mention which ones you took.”
After flipping through the book, Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang brought Meng Chuan into Archean Eon Sect’s painting and entered the hall.
After exiting the hall, they found themselves in a square.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The three buildings landed one after another. The Star Cluster Building, the Heart Sea Palace, and the Battle God Pagoda surrounded the central hall.
“They’re back.” Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang watched excitedly.
“It’s said that the Star Cluster Building has 98 ultimate technique manuals.” Luo Tang’s eyes burned as she stared at it. “They are mainly Imperial Lord and Tribulation-level ultimate techniques. Very few of them are Creation-level ultimate techniques. They were all selected by Ancestral Master Archean Eon before he placed them inside.”
“In history, only two seniors have managed to master one of these ultimate techniques completely. Only then did they record them down in a Black Metal Sutra,” said Li Guan. “Therefore, other than two Creation-level ultimate techniques, the rest have been lost. Us humans were greatly lacking in top-level ultimate techniques until now.”
Meng Chuan couldn’t help but say, “According to what I know, when the Archean Eon Sect split up, Ancestral Master Archean had already become an Imperial Lord. He held an absolute advantage. Why did he allow Ancestral Master Eon Sea to choose three of the nine cornerstone treasures? Star Cluster Building has all the manuals, and the Heart Sea Palace also has Essence Soul mystic techniques. They are very important.”
“There are some secrets behind it.” Li Guan said, “Meng Chuan, can you imagine a sect that has ruled the world for hundreds of thousands of years? The world will forever be ruled by this sect. To become a Godfiend, one has to become a disciple of this sect.”
Meng Chuan was slightly stunned.
“The Archean Eon Sect was too powerful,” said Li Guan. “When Ancestral Master Archean Eon was around, he could still control the overall situation so that the sect wouldn’t be too corrupted. After Ancestral Master Archean Eon passed away, the Archean Eon Sect couldn’t be dealt with. Without any external threats, the disciple spots didn’t have to be given to the best. Instead, they were given to the ones the powerful Godfiends favored. Even if you were extremely talented, you wouldn’t become a Godfiend if you didn’t obtain a spot,” said Li Guan.
Qin Wu said, “Absolute power corrupts absolutely. The debauchery brought about was shocking. Although generations of experts wanted to change this, the hearts of people were ultimately immutable. Without external threats, Archean Eon Sect began having internal strife. The internal strife was terrifying. In history, many Supremacies died because of it. Some disciples even betrayed the sect, hoping to exact revenge on the Archean Eon Sect.
“Among the various factions, some believed in meritocracy, hoping to teach the best. Some advocated the nurturing of Godfiend clansmen. Some wanted to plunder the world and make the entire world serve the Godfiends’ whims... The competition between factions and the struggle for power pushed the Archean Eon Sect to the edge of destruction several times. This continued until Ancestral Master Archean’s era.
“Ancestral Master Archean understood that his influence over the sect would only last as long as he was alive. However, once he died, Archean Eon Sect would still face the same predicaments it did in the past,” said Li Guan. “Therefore, Ancestral Master Archean made up his mind and deliberately announced his beliefs, causing objections to arise in the sect. He split off the opposing factions. He was worried that he had done something wrong. Therefore, he offered nine cornerstone treasures for his opposition to choose from. This resulted in the Eon Sea Sect.
“Ancestral Master Archean felt that he was right, but he also believed that no one is omnipotent and omniscient. Therefore, he believed that there should be two lineages. Any of the two sects that thrives will also lead to the Archean Eon Sect thriving.” Li Guan said, “And history has proven that the Ancestral Master’s choice was right.
“Faced with external threats, our Archean Mountain needed to fight with other sects. In history, we fought with the Eon Sea Sect, the Myriad Sword Sect, and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven... This resulted in us being very united,” said Li Guan. “Furthermore, we have nine cornerstone treasures. Even if the other factions have an Imperial Lord, we can hide in Archean Mountain and secretly select disciples from the world to continue the legacy.
“From generation to generation, despite the rise and fall of other sects, Archean Mountain has always been one of the top sects in each era,” said Li Guan. “Actually, we have had many opportunities to unify the world. However, we have always followed the rules set by Ancestral Master Archean. We allowed other sects to rise to prominence.”
Meng Chuan asked, “The battles between sects were very tragic, right?”
“Those below the Creation realm were allowed to kill as they wished,” said Li Guan. “At the Creation realm, all the major sects’ experts became restrained. Most of them chose to explore the outer realm and the River of Spacetime. We are Godfiends from the same world. When we travel the River of Spacetime, we will be companions.”
“Sometimes, because of deep hatred, Supremacies will kill each other,” said Luo Tang. “However, most of them are very rational. They know that they only have a chance of improving after traveling the River of Spacetime. Therefore, in human history, it’s relatively peaceful when one is at the Creation realm. This continues until one faction has the strength to dominate the world. When that happens, our Archean Mountain will be willing to hold back temporarily.” Meng Chuan nodded. “Even if they had to split the several factions, there was no need to hand over the Battle God Pagoda, the Star Cluster Building, and the Heart Sea Palace.”
“The Ancestral Master did it on purpose.” Li Guan said, “Firstly, for the splintered branch to establish a foothold and have a long heritage, they had to have enough cornerstone treasures. Therefore, Ancestral Master took out nine treasures for Senior Eon Sea to choose from.
“Secondly, the most important thing is that Archean Mountain had already taken away the important items. The remaining nine treasures were things that Ancestral Master believed could be handed over to the other party. Losing the Battle God Pagoda, the Star Cluster Building, and the Heart Sea Palace was within his expectations.”
Meng Chuan was puzzled. “It was within expectations? But wouldn’t that mean Archean Mountain would lose the best ultimate techniques and best Essence Soul mystic techniques?”
“The Battle God Pagoda has the strength to kill ordinary Imperial Lords. The Heart Sea Palace can also attack an enemy’s Essence Soul. Only with these two can the Eon Sea Sect gain a stable footing,” said Li Guan. “As for the losses? Ancestral Master once told us that it’s good to have some ultimate technique manuals once we reach the Creation realm. However, those that are truly accomplished will find their own paths and create their own ultimate techniques. “That’s what Ancestral Master saw in the River of Spacetime. Without top-grade ultimate techniques, it will force Archean Mountain Supremacies to create their own ultimate techniques,” said Li Guan. “As for one’s cultivation direction, one can refer to the Tribulation and Imperial Lord-level treasures since they contain runes. They contain the directions one can head in during the Imperial Lord realm and the Tribulation realm.”
“With a direction laid out and treasures to protect ourselves, we are to create ultimate techniques ourselves. This is the path Ancestral Master Archean set for Archean Mountain.”
Meng Chuan jolted. Yes. He had studied the Bloodblade Disc’s runic patterns before improving his Infinite Saber Art and Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique.
Qin Wu added, “It was very painful to lose the Star Cluster Building, the Heart Sea Palace, and the Battle God Pagoda. However, for the Archean Eon Sect of that era, it was probably more advantageous for it to split into two different sects-Archean Mountain and Eon Sea Sect.”

chapters.title: Chapter 393 - Sheltering the Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 393 Sheltering the Sect
“Now that the Eon Sea Sect has returned to us, the hundreds of thousands of years have proven that Archean Mountain’s path is the correct one,” said Li Guan with a smile. He walked towards the Battle God Pagoda. “I never expected that I, Li Guan, would have the chance to challenge the Battle God Pagoda before I die.”
Li Guan walked to the Battle God Pagoda.
Qin Wu, Luo Tang, and Meng Chuan followed.
“I heard that the stone pillar in front of the Battle God Pagoda hides a ranking list,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “As long as one’s Quintessential Essence seeps into it, the ranking list will appear. The people at the top of the ranking list are famous figures in human history.” As he spoke, a wisp of Quintessential Essence seeped in.
Meng Chuan blinked. Looking at the familiar ranking...
“Supremacy Great Strength, Daoist Daybreak, Ancestral Master Archean...” As Qin Wu read the most dazzling names on the ranking, he suddenly frowned and looked at the fifth name. “Humanity’s Demon Slayer?”
“Who is Humanity’s Demon Slayer?” Luo Tang was puzzled as well. “I know everyone else in the top ten. Supremacy Great Strength created the Great Strength Fiend Body by himself. He passed the eighth level of the Battle God Pagoda as a Supremacy, and his potential is the highest in history. Daoist Daybreak is a genius that reached the Creation realm at the age of 62. He died early after entering the River of Spacetime. The two Ancestral Masters, Archean and Eon Sea, as well as Myriad Sword Island Lord, Azure Lotus Swordsman, and Imperial Lord An Yang, are the most dazzling existences in human history.”
These existences either became Imperial Lords or were monstrously talented. They created transcendent-grade Godfiend bodies; some even reached the Tribulation realm.
All of them were admired by generations of Supremacies.
Now, Humanity’s Demon Slayer had appeared in the top ten. “Humanity’s Demon Slayer?” Li Guan was puzzled.
Qin Wu turned to look at Meng Chuan. “Meng Chuan, your saber is called Demon Slayer, right?”
“I can’t hide it from you, Master,” said Meng Chuan. “I only obtained the entire Eon Sea Sect because I challenged the Battle God Pagoda and the Heart Sea Palace, passing the Eon Sea Sect’s test. I’m the fifth-ranked Humanity’s Demon Slayer.”
“It’s you?” Qin Wu, Luo Tang, and Li Guan looked at Meng Chuan in shock. What kind of concept was it to have one’s technique realm and potential to rank fifth amongst all humans?
It was clear from the figures that ranked in the top ten.
“He’s actually ranked fifth,” Luo Tang couldn’t help but whisper. “We were blind back then. We actually failed to realize that Meng Chuan had such talent in terms of technique?”
“There are late-bloomers. Meng Chuan has been reborn, and he’s even more outstanding than before,” said Qin Wu wistfully. He then looked at Meng Chuan. “You said that you passed the Battle God Pagoda and the Heart Sea Palace, which is why you obtained everything the Eon Sea Sect has? The requirement set by the Eon Sea Sect must be very high. That’s how you obtained the Eon Sea Sect, right?” “Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded and said, “I needed to be ranked in the top five in both the Heart Sea Palace and the Battle God Pagoda. Since I’ve accomplished both things, the Eon Sea Sect was given to me. They only requested one thing from me. I can’t let the Eon Sea lineage be severed in the future.” “You need to be in the top five in the Heart Sea Palace as well?” Luo Tang phased away and appeared in front of the Heart Sea Palace. At the same time, she urged, “Qin Wu, hurry up.”
Qin Wu also arrived in front of the Heart Sea Palace. A wisp of Quintessential Essence seeped into the stone pillar.
A ranking appeared on the pillar. 1st: Humanity’s Demon Slayer
2nd: Myriad Sword Island Lord
3rd: Imperial Lord An Yang
“First in the Heart Sea Palace’s rankings?” Luo Tang, Qin Wu, and Li Guan were stunned. The three of them turned to look at Meng Chuan.
“Our Archean Mountain has actually produced such a monstrous disciple,” Luo Tang couldn’t help but whisper. When they discovered that a disciple in this era could be considered the most monstrous genius in human history, Li Guan and the other two Supremacies were excited and overjoyed. They also felt mixed emotions because they knew very well how astonishing such a monster’s growth was from history.
These people could fight Supremacies as a Regis Godfiend. It was normal for them to fight Imperial Lords as a Creation Supremacy!
Many of such geniuses had created powerful ultimate techniques and new transcendent-grade Godfiend bodies.
“We have to protect him and let him grow well,” said Li Guan via voice transmission. “As long as he has enough time, he can end this
war.”
“First in the Heart Sea Palace and fifth in the Battle God Pagoda. This is someone who has surpassed all of the human race’s seniors. He’s probably the closest to Ancestral Master Archean Eon,” said Qin Wu via voice transmission. “We have to protect a genius whose talent is infinitely approaching that of Ancestral Master Archean Eon as much as possible.”
“We’ve already given him all the defensive treasures available,” said Luo Tang via voice transmission. “What else can we do?”
“No, we haven’t done enough. We can still do better,” said Li Guan via voice transmission. The three of them discussed.
Meng Chuan didn’t know what the three Supremacies were discussing secretly.
Meng Chuan’s rankings in the Heart Sea Palace and the Battle God Pagoda were too shocking for the three Supremacies. Many of those that ranked in the top ten of both rankings-people like Myriad Sword Island Lord, Imperial Lord An Yang, and Ancestral Master Archeanbecame Imperial Lords at the very least! Supremacy Great Strength, Daoist Daybreak, and others were all extremely talented when it came to techniques. However, their Essence Soul limited them, causing them to be stuck in the Creation realm.
As for Meng Chuan, he was ranked in the top five in both two buildings. Humanity had never seen someone like him before. The person closest to him was Imperial Lord An Yang. Imperial Lord An Yang also had the closest achievements to that of Ancestral Master Archean Eon. He was an Essence Soul Third Tribulation Eminence.
“Senior Brother Li, you are too thoughtful for Meng Chuan,” said Luo Tang via voice transmission.
Li Guan sent a voice transmission. “A genius comparable to Imperial Lord An Yang, Ancestral Master Archean, and Myriad Sword Island Lord was born in our era. It’s a blessing for our era. We have to protect him. The world of cultivators depends on individual strength. The birth of a transcendent expert... Not only can they end the war, but they can also change the fate of our species forever.”
“Meng Chuan.” Li Guan looked at Meng Chuan and said with a smile, “The Eon Sea lineage will not cease to exist. There’s no need for you to worry. In the future, our Archean Mountain will establish the Eon Sea lineage in our sect. It will focus on Ancestral Master Eon Sea’s legacy. However, before the war ends, the Eon Sea lineage will temporarily be kept secret. We won’t announce it to the public.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Understood.” The sect established this lineage to help him resolve his karma.
“You’ve contributed greatly this time.” Li Guan smiled as he looked at Qin Wu and Luo Tang. “To be honest, after thinking about it, we really have nothing to reward you with. However, according to our Archean Mountain rules, we can’t treat our meritorious members unfairly. Therefore, we’ve discussed and made an exception... to let you be Archean Mountain’s Sect Proprietor.”
“Sect Proprietor?” Meng Chuan was puzzled.
“Right now, Archean Mountain only has Qin Wu, Luo Tang, and me as Sect Proprietors,” said Li Guan. “As long as the three of us discuss something together, we can decide on everything in the sect. Of course, we have to follow the rules left behind by our seniors. We can only make exceptions under special situations.”
“I’ll be a Sect Proprietor? There’s no need for that, right?” Meng Chuan was somewhat hesitant.
“Since it’s your responsibility, take it.” Li Guan looked at Meng Chuan. “You have already resolved the threat of the million demon monarchs. You have even brought back everything from the Eon Sea Sect. Your contributions have already surpassed all Supremacies in Archean Mountain’s history. Your strength is comparable to a Creation realm expert. You are qualified to be a Sect Proprietor. It isn’t just power that is granted to you, but more importantly, responsibility. You need to bear the responsibility. This means that from today onwards, no expert will shelter you from adversity. Instead, you will be the one sheltering the sect!”
I need to shelter the sect from adversity? Meng Chuan felt the additional responsibility weigh down on his shoulders. “With your growth speed, you will become the strongest tree in the sect in a few decades,” said Li Guan with a smile.
Qin Wu and Luo Tang nodded in agreement.
It was very normal for geniuses that matched Imperial Lord Anyang, Ancestral Master Archean, and Myriad Sword Island Lord to take a few decades to achieve accomplishments that matched that of Qin Wu and Li Guan.
If it took over a hundred years? That was called slow cultivation!

chapters.title: Chapter 394 - Twelve Cornerstone Treasures
chapters.content:
Chapter 394 Twelve Cornerstone Treasures
“The ceremony of becoming a Sect Proprietor will be held later,” said Li Guan. “Before that, we have to tell you the truth about Archean Mountain.”
“The truth?” Meng Chuan’s heart stirred.
“Due to the rules set by Ancestral Master Archean. Our Archean Mountain has hidden some key powers from the outside world,” said Li Guan. “The main one is our 12 cornerstone treasures. Previously, our Archean Mountain only had nine cornerstone treasures. The three you brought back have greatly boosted our Archean Mountain’s foundation.
“The first cornerstone treasure is Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s legacy,” said Li Guan. “The complete legacy goes from an ordinary Godfiend to the Creation realm, the Imperial Lord realm, all the way to the Seventh Tribulation realm. The weapons, cultivation methods, special places suitable for cultivation, and precious resources are comprehensively prepared.
“As long as one inherits Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s legacy, they will be able to receive the best nurturing available in the entire human world. They can be said to be blessed by the heavens. In human history, those who became invincible Creation realm experts were mostly recipients of Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s legacy,” said Li Guan. “This is also an important reason why our Archean Mountain can maintain our strength for a long time.”
After the Archean Eon Sect split up, more than half of the invincible Creation realm experts in the world originated from Archean Mountain. How could Archean Mountain not be strong?
“However, it’s very difficult to obtain the legacy through the Samsara trial.” Li Guan smiled at Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan nodded. “Powerful legacies naturally have requirements.” Luo Tang smiled and said, “However, there’s a genius in our era that has passed the Samsara trial and obtained Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s legacy. His surname is also Meng.”
Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up. “His surname is Meng?” His son was extremely talented and had cultivated the Samsara Divine Body.
Could it be that...
“It’s Meng An,” said Li Guan with a smile. “His bloodline is indeed extraordinary. With a father like you, it’s no wonder Meng An can be so outstanding at such a young age. However, the difference between him and you is that he hasn’t experienced the crucible of war, nor has he experienced true tempering.”
Previously, they believed that Meng An had a chance of becoming an invincible Creation realm expert. However, they estimated that it would take at least 200 years. Holding out for another 200 years was very difficult.
But now...
Meng An’s father, Meng Chuan, was even more monstrous. He had extremely high potential in two aspects, even when compared with illustrious historical figures. He would at least become an Imperial Lord. The potential to become an Imperial Lord! Meng Chuan also had a chance of reaching the Tribulation realm! He was the genius closest to Ancestral Master Archean Eon.
“An’er is still young. He will have his experiences in the future.” Meng Chuan was still very happy. Although he had obtained the Essence Soul mystic technique legacy of Eminence Fei Yu, it was only a mystic technique. As for how to cultivate it? What cultivation resources did he have available to him? What powerful weapons did he have? What cultivation grounds were suitable for him? There was none. All he had was the mystic technique.
As for Meng An, he was considered a true legacy disciple! He was groomed in every aspect. “The second cornerstone treasure is that hall.” Li Guan pointed at the tallest hall. It was also the hall that contained many Origins treasures such as Scarlet Cloud Heaven, Clear Sky, and the others. It was also the entrance to this Grotto-Heaven.
“This is the Heaven and Earth Great Hall.” Li Guan said, “It’s also the World Origins of the entire human world.”
“World Origins?” Meng Chuan was taken aback.
Qin Wu sighed as well. “Back then, Ancestral Master Archean Eon revealed the human race’s World Origins. He refined the Heaven and Earth Great Hall to protect the World Origins and also greatly strengthen the World Origins! He raised the entire human world from a low-level world to a middle-level world. With this qualitative change, it made it much easier for humans to cultivate in the world.”
“For example, your Origins treasure, Clear Sky, comes from this Heaven and Earth Great Hall,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “Of course, maintaining a few Origin treasures is only its most inconspicuous function. It has other great uses. The first is to guard Archean Mountain. It mobilizes the Heaven and Earth Great Hall’s powers to guard the entire Archean Mountain.
“As long as a Supremacy activates the array formation or three Regis Godfiends do so simultaneously, they can perfectly defend Archean Mountain. Even if several Imperial Lords jointly attack, they won’t be able to breach Archean Mountain.”
Qin Wu looked at Meng Chuan. “It’s precisely because he had the confidence to defend the sect that Ancestral Master Archean was willing to let other sects grow.”
“This Heaven and Earth Great Hall has another main function,” said Li Guan with a solemn expression. “It can trigger the world’s Origins powers completely. With the World Destruction Array in the Heaven and Earth Great Hall, it can destroy all areas outside Archean Mountain. That would mean World Annihilation.”
“World Annihilation?” Meng Chuan jolted.
“That’s right. Ancestral Master Archean Eon had also considered the possibility of powerful external enemies invading the human world in the future,” said Li Guan. “If we humans can’t withstand the invasion, what should we do? The final solution is to end the world! Us humans shall hide in Archean Mountain and destroy all areas outside Archean Mountain. All living beings will be annihilated.
“The Archean Eon Sect’s former territory is where Archean Mountain stands today,” said Li Guan. “After the destruction of the world, we will allow the mortals holed up in Archean Mountain to leave the mountain and reproduce.
“World Annihilation is the most painful choice for us humans when facing powerful enemies.” Li Guan looked at Meng Chuan. “After all, Archean Mountain can only accommodate a limited number of mortals. Once it’s destroyed, more than 99% of the living beings in this world will die. All cities, vegetation, rivers, and lakes will be destroyed. Everything will have to reproduce.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
“The Heaven and Earth Great Hall still has some other tricks up its sleeves. Once you become a Sect Proprietor, you can slowly learn about them,” said Li Guan. “The third cornerstone treasure is the Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven that you once entered.”
“Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven is a place that stores the opportunities Ancestral Master Archean Eon obtained during his long travels of the River of Spacetime. He found these opportunities very unique. Therefore, he collected them and placed them in Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven. Only extremely monstrous geniuses are qualified to enter Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven, allowing those geniuses to obtain an opportunity that is the most suitable for them. It’s like adding wings to a tiger, allowing them to soar into the sky,” said Li Guan. “In history, Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven’s opportunities are very important. Many seniors like Supremacy Great Strength and Myriad Sword Island Lord have obtained opportunities in Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven, allowing them to rise rapidly. Even you, Meng Chuan, have obtained an opportunity in Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven.
“It’s just that during Archean Eon Sect’s era, Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven was opened too many times. The opportunities in it are decreasing.” Li Guan sighed. “By the time Archean Mountain formed, the number of times we could open it naturally had to be reduced grealy. Otherwise, it would be depleted very quickly. Of the three most important treasures out of the 12 cornerstone treasures, Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven will probably disappear first.”
“That’s right. Archean Eon Grotto-heaven’s remaining opportunities are less than 10% of what it originally had,” said Luo Tang.
“The Archean Eon Sect consumed too many treasures and resources during its time,” said Qin Wu.
“Back then, Ancestral Master Archean reserved these three cornerstone treasures and let Ancestral Master Eon Sea to choose from the other nine,” said Li Guan. “The remaining nine cornerstone treasures are equally extraordinary. The fourth one is an arm.”
“An arm?” Meng Chuan was stunned.
“We don’t know its secrets either,” said Li Guan. “Ancestral Master Archean Eon set up an array formation around it. One has to reach the Imperial Lord level before they can know the secrets to this arm. According to our predecessors, who became Imperial Lords, they rank it as the fourth most important cornerstone treasure.
“The fifth cornerstone treasure, follow me...” said Li Guan.
Meng Chuan couldn’t help but click his tongue when he learned about the sect’s 12 cornerstone treasures. He finally realized just how deep a sect’s—one created by a Seventh Tribulation Eminence-foundation was.
The demons have a longer history than us. They have given birth to more Tribulation realm experts. More than one has reached the Physical Body Sixth Tribulation realm. Meng Chuan immediately became alert. I have to be more careful.
After learning about the cornerstone treasures, Meng Chuan returned to the Heaven and Earth Great Hall.
Inside the Heaven and Earth Great Hall.
The black-robed, long-browed elder and the two other Guardians had also arrived. They were the three Guardians from Archean Eon Sect’s earliest days.
“Once you become a Sect Proprietor, you will protect the sect and the human race. This is not to change until you die. Meng Chuan, do you understand?” The three Guardians stood in front of Meng Chuan, while Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang watched from the side.
“I, Meng Chuan, will guard the sect and guard the human race. I will never stop until I die,” Meng Chuan swore an oath in the Heaven and Earth Great Hall.
The leader, a Guardian giant, handed a golden token to Meng Chuan. “King Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, you will be Archean Mountain’s fourth Sect Proprietor from today onwards.” “I accept the order.” Meng Chuan received the token solemnly.

chapters.title: Chapter 395 - Reading the Ultimate Techniques
chapters.content:
Chapter 395 Reading the Ultimate Techniques
After becoming a Sect Proprietor, Meng Chuan went to the Star Cluster Building.
Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang also came to the Star Cluster Building and began reading the manuals. “You haven’t read the Star Cluster Building’s ultimate techniques either?” Qin Wu smiled.
“When I obtained the Eon Sea Sect, all I wanted to do was send it back to Archean Mountain as soon as possible,” said Meng Chuan. “Also, carefully reading the ultimate techniques isn’t something that can happen overnight, so I wasn’t in a hurry.”
“I plan to gradually open up Star Cluster Building, Battle God Pagoda, and Heart Sea Palace to Archean Mountain’s Regis Godfiends.” Li Guan read the manuals by the side and said, “Of course, I have to get the Guardian to hide your name on the Battle God Pagoda and Heart Sea Palace rankings. It won’t be too late to announce it after you become a Creation Supremacy and have no fear of the demons.”
Qin Wu, Luo Tang, and Meng Chuan nodded in agreement
“Since you don’t have any objections, let’s do it.” Li Guan nodded. “As for Star Cluster Building’s ultimate techniques and the Essence Soul mystic techniques in Heart Sea Palace, we will follow the rules of the Archean Eon Sect. We will limit them to those that have strength and credits.”
“Yes.” These were all old rules. They were very lenient towards Godfiends from their own sect.
“Alright, that’s settled. I know that all of you are focused on these ultimate techniques.” Li Guan smiled as he began to read the manual in his hand attentively.
The four Sect Proprietors first flipped through the manuals casually before finding the ones that suited them the best.
There are a total of six lightning lineage ultimate techniques. Meng Chuan sat in a corner of the Star Cluster Building and held the six original manuals in front of him. Five of the ultimate techniques were in the form of books. The last one was a palm-sized crystal jade. The human world’s predecessors had created Black Metal Sutras because it was easier to obtain materials like Meteorite Metal in the human world. As for the ultimate techniques obtained from the River of Spacetime, most of them were text-based books. A small portion of them was crafted with strange materials.
One Creation-level ultimate technique, three Imperial Lord-level ultimate techniques, and two Tribulation-level ultimate techniques. Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up.
There were very few Creation-level techniques among the 98 ultimate techniques selected by Ancestral Master Archean Eon.
This Creation-level technique was called Golden Lotus Descent.
It’s clearly a Creation-level ultimate technique. According to the description, the intent and profundities contained within it are only at the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm. However, the exquisitely fine usage method allows one to possess terrifying might when executing the Golden Lotus Descent. It’s an ultimate technique that has a chance of killing an Imperial Lord. Meng Chuan flipped through the ultimate technique and immersed his consciousness into it. The legacy was slowly imparted to him.
Golden Lotus Descent;it was a golden lotus flower condensed from lightning.
The golden lotus flower was the most dazzling object in the intent world. It contained a resplendent might as it emanated a destructive force. It slowly spun, and the might contained within one petal gathered in the next petal, constantly increasing in strength. The more it spun, the more terrifying its might became.
Furthermore, the golden lotus flower had two layers of petals. The two layers slowly swirled, containing endless Yin-Yang mysteries. Chi! Chi! Chi!
The spinning golden lotus fell downwards. It looked slow, but when it spun and fell, it tore through everything. Nothing could stop it. Even the entire world would be penetrated by
it!
Meng Chuan couldn’t help but think of the purple lightning that tore through the River of Spacetime. The lightning tree—that constantly spread out—was a power that could repeatedly tear through spacetime. If the purple lightning was a natural force formed by the River of Spacetime, then the spinning golden lotus was more like a lotus flower formed by the lightning tree. Its strength completely fused as it constantly shattered, ground, and penetrated the world.
Its power kept increasing.
The lotus flower’s rotation was the convergence of strength. Its strength increased without limit.
What a terrifying ultimate technique. If the user is able to charge up this technique without any interference, the might of this move will constantly increase until it exceeds the user’s control. Even if the enemy wants to suppress it, it’ll be very difficult. After all, it’s still an ultimate technique that can surpass the Imperial Lord level. It even has a chance of killing an Imperial Lord. This is much stronger than Senior Guo Ke’s Heart Intent Saber. It’s no wonder Ancestral Master Archean Eon selected it. However, cultivating it is very difficult. It’s much harder than ordinary Creation-level techniques. I have painted the Fifteen Lightning Forms. According to the description of this ultimate technique, I need to perfectly combine the Flash Form of Lightning, the Yin-Yang Form of Lightning, the Endless Form of Destruction, the Perfect Harmonization Form of Destruction, and the Void Form of Destruction. Only then will I be able to cultivate this move to perfection. The primary aspect of the lightning lineage’s destruction is this.
Meng Chuan flipped through the three Imperial Lord-level techniques.
Imperial Lord-level techniques—Lightning Walk, Lightning Fire Body Tempering Art, and Dark Lightning. These are rather unorthodox techniques. Meng Chuan also learned these three ultimate techniques. “Lightning Walk is a movement technique. Once mastered, I can completely transform into lightning. I will have speed comparable to true lightning. Meng Chuan knew how terrifying his speed would be once this was mastered. Even if the human world was vast, true lightning could instantly sweep across the entire world. Imperial Lords typically could teleport thousands of kilometers, but that was nothing in the face of true lightning.
This was why Lightning Walk was highly valued by Ancestral Master Archean Eon and placed inside the Star Cluster Building.
The Lightning Fire Body Tempering Art is actually used to cultivate one’s body? It transforms one’s body to the same sturdiness as an Imperial Lord-level weapon? Even if one doesn’t reach the Tribulation realm, one’s strength and defense are comparable to a Physical Body Fifth Tribulation Eminence. An Imperial Lord can fight a Fifth Tribulation Eminence? I never expected one could cultivate such a powerful body with the lightning lineage.
However, according to the legacy’s description, one also has to cultivate the fire lineage. Furthermore, every time the body is tempered, the burden on one’s body would be huge. It’s extremely difficult to reach perfection.
Once Dark Lightning is perfected, one can seem to disappear from spacetime. Ordinary Tribulation Eminences won’t be able to find them.
After learning the three techniques, Meng Chuan felt that they were all techniques that reached the pinnacle in a certain aspect.
Perhaps ordinary Imperial Lord-level techniques could no longer attract Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s attention.
Tribulation-level ultimate techniques. After learning them, Meng Chuan felt relieved. This is what I consider a normal ultimate technique.
There were two Tribulation-level ultimate techniques.
One was called Lightning Realm. It could control the void. When cultivated to the extreme, one could transform a 50,000-kilometer area around them into a Lightning Realm with just a thought! One’s body was the master of the Lightning Realm.
The three Imperial Lord-level ultimate techniques—Dark Lightning, Lightning Walk, and the Lightning Fire Body Tempering Artwere nothing more than ants when compared to Lightning Realm, even when one cultivated them to perfection. Within the Lightning Realm’s 50,000-kilometer area, they would be easily crushed to death without any resistance.
This ultimate technique was created by a Physical Body Sixth Tribulation Eminence. With it, he reigned supreme across the River of Spacetime. His strength was close to the Seventh Tribulation realm.
According to Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s evaluation, this was an ultimate technique that had perfected insights into the void. The other technique was called Three World Saber. It was a technique that relied on lightning to control time. Although the creator died before he could perfect his saber art, it was still a technique that could threaten Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
Any system-fire, lightning, water... Everything would lead to spacetime towards the end. This was because everything originated from the River of Spacetime. This was the most fundamental power.
The void was more realistic and easier to come into contact with. It was even easier to grasp it. Typically, Regis Godfiends would begin to comprehend it gradually. Of course, they were extremely far away from reaching it even after perfecting Lightning Realm. Time was more ethereal and difficult to control. Most of the Tribulation-level ultimate techniques were related to time and space. However, they all had different approaches when it came to basic mastery. Meng Chuan’s two Tribulation-level ultimate techniques controlled time and space via lightning.
Lightning Realm and Three World Saber are both orthodox ultimate techniques. They are the final direction for cultivation. I need to spend more time on these two Tribulation-level ultimate techniques.

chapters.title: Chapter 396 - Report
chapters.content:
Chapter 396 Report
After obtaining all the ultimate technique legacies of the lightning lineage, Meng Chuan still didn’t agree with Ancestral Master Archean’s choice.
These precious ultimate techniques systematically guide one’s cultivation path. They are complete cultivation methods. Although one can gain insights into the appropriate cultivation path using Imperial Lord and Tribulation-level treasures after losing the Star Cluster Building, the efficiency is still much lower. Even though true experts in the River of Spacetime create their own ultimate techniques, it’s beneficial for one to draw upon the insights contained within other ultimate techniques and absorb the wisdom of others.
Of course, Ancestral Master Archean stood at a different height from me. He was an Imperial Lord. Back then, he was the strongest expert in the human world. He might have had more profound reasons.
Ancestral Master Archean was invincible back then. He stood at the pinnacle of the human world. Not only did he have to consider the situation he was facing, but he also needed to take the distant future into account. If he only cared about his happiness, Ancestral Master Archean could have taken Archean Eon Sect’s entire heritage and left it at Archean Mountain, focusing on Archean Mountain’s development.
In fact, he carefully trod on thin ice, believing that he could be wrong.
For the sake of humanity, he couldn’t place all his eggs in one basket.
He placed bets on both sides.
Therefore, he gave the three extremely precious cornerstone treasures to the Eon Sea Sect, allowing for Ancestral Master Eon Sea and a group of experts to build the Eon Sea Sect.
Archean Mountain and the Eon Sea Sect had invincible foundations. No matter which sect succeeded, humans would still have a strong foundation. They could continue to thrive.
Jiang State Capital, afternoon.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan landed in the courtyard. Liu Qiyue
—who was flipping through books in the courtyard—had stood up and walked over. She couldn’t help but ask, “Ah Chuan, why didn’t you come back last night?”
“I was delayed,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. Back then, he was undergoing a test in the Eon Sea Sect’s grotto-heaven. “Didn’t I inform you that I was safe through the transmission token?”
Meng Chuan had prepared a transmission token for each of his family members. All of them had coded signals that could inform whether one was safe, requesting help, etc.
“But I couldn’t contact you after you sent the message,” said Liu Qiyue. “If you hadn’t informed me beforehand, I would have already sought help from Archean Mountain.”
“Don’t worry, my wife.” Meng Chuan could sense his wife’s concern. He smiled and said, “Your husband’s strength is unfathomable. I’ve even reached the Blood Droplet realm and left my blood with Archean Mountain! My life-preservation means are very strong. With the demons’ means in the human world, they can’t do anything to me.”
“Alright, alright. I know you’re impressive,” said Liu Qiyue with a smile.
“By the way, I prepared a gift for you.” Meng Chuan flipped his hand and handed a colorful feathered robe to his wife. “Try it on.”
Liu Qiyue was instantly attracted by it. The power emanating from the feathered robe was extremely attractive to her. She reached out to take it and put it on. She felt the phoenix bloodline in her body resonate with the feathered robe.
“It’s called Phoenix Feather Robe. I think it suits you very well,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“The power of my bloodline can control it,” exclaimed Liu Qiyue. A phoenix phantom vaguely appeared over the Phoenix Feather Robe. This phoenix phantom also contained energy that protected Liu Qiyue. “It can protect me, and it can also release extremely powerful flames, turning my surroundings into a flame domain. Ah Chuan, I like this feather robe very much.”
Liu Qiyue happily familiarized herself with the feather robe. “Where did this come from?” Liu Qiyue snapped out of her daze and asked.
“Come, let’s talk inside,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. The Star Cluster Building would gradually be opened to Archean Mountain Regis Godfiends. There was no need to hide the matter of the Eon Sea Sect from his wife.
The next day, Meng Chuan began hunting underground demon monarchs again.
Swoosh.
Swoosh.
Deep underground, a beam of light flew at high speeds. Meng Chuan’s electromagnetic domain probed his surroundings repeatedly, and he killed all the demon monarchs he discovered. Only a few demon monarchs would be subdued by Meng Chuan and became his demon servants.
Inside a chamber of a small grotto-heaven.
“I never expected that the Godfiend that is hunting underground demon monarchs on a large scale would actually be Meng Chuan.” Through the karmic blood curse, Demon Sage Thousand Cricket could sense the young Godfiend.
Karma was most mysterious. Even a Tribulation Eminence could not completely isolate karma from themselves. They could only try their best to conceal or blur the lines.
Meng Chuan had no idea that his identity had been exposed because of karma. However, he knew that with the demons’ heritage, he had to be careful all the time.
Boom!
Thousand Thicket pushed open the door to the chamber and walked out.
Thousand Cricket came to a quiet hall and shouted, “Nine Abyss!”
Soon, Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s figure appeared on the throne in the hall. He smiled and said, “Yes?”
“I’m 90% confident of the Godfiend’s identity,” said Thousand Cricket.
“Ninety percent?” Nine Abyss frowned slightly.
“In the past, I traveled and sought out 3,000 demon monarchs across the world before casting a karmic blood curse on them,” said Thousand Cricket. “These 3,000 demon monarchs are randomly scattered around the world. Now, 205 of them have been killed. The same Godfiend killed 202 of them,” said Thousand Cricket. “I think his identity is quite certain.”
“About 200 of the 3,000 baits have died?” Nine Abyss shook his head. “This has huge repercussions. At this point in time, these few days don’t matter. Our demons will target that Godfiend with an even more powerful attack. If we get the wrong target, the consequences will be dire.”
Thousand Cricket pondered. “Actually, I’m pretty certain now. If you have any doubts, wait for another half-month.”
“Another half-month would only spell the deaths of tens of thousands of demon monarchs,” said Nine Abyss indifferently. “By the way, who was it?”
Thousand Cricket looked at him and smiled. “Marquis Eastcalm, Meng Chuan!”
Another half-month passed.
Nine Abyss and Thousand Cricket walked side by side.
“Up to this day, 533 baits have died,” said Thousand Cricket. “Meng Chuan killed 526 of them. As you know, these demon monarchsbait-are scattered across the world. There hasn’t been any large-scale attack recently. Almost all the demon monarchs are underground. To kill over 500 cursed demon monarchs in a short month? It can’t be a coincidence!”
Nine Abyss agreed. “From the looks of it, Meng Chuan has long become a Regis Godfiend. However, he’s been hiding his status.”
“Therefore, none of you managed to find out who it was despite your investigations,” said Thousand Cricket.
The two demon sages came to a dark chamber.
In the center of the dark chamber was a pool of water.
“I’ll contact the Imperial Lord now,” said Nine Abyss.
Thousand Cricket nodded.
Boom!
The countless runes carved in the chamber glowed with silver light. A scene gradually appeared in the middle of the pool. It was Imperial Lord Starquix. Nine Abyss and Thousand Cricket bowed slightly, showing their utmost respect. “Imperial Lord, we’ve identified that Godfiend,” reported Nine Abyss respectfully.

chapters.title: Chapter 397 - Nine-Day Prayer
chapters.content:
Chapter 397 Nine-Day Prayer
“You have figured out his identity?” Imperial Lord Starquix’s eyes narrowed as the pressure he exuded intensified.
“Yes,” said Nine Abyss respectfully.
“I’m confident,” said Thousand Cricket.
“Who is it?” Imperial Lord Starquix asked coldly.
Thousand Cricket continued, “Archean Mountain disciple, Marquis Eastcalm, Meng Chuan. Nine Abyss and I believe that Meng Chuan’s talent far exceeds what’s publicly known. He secretly became a Regis Godfiend long ago. However, because he’s good at underground reconnaissance, humans have tried to conceal this and keep it under wraps.”
“Marquis Eastcalm, Meng Chuan?” asked Imperial Lord Starquix. “Are you 100% confident? What I want is... 100% confidence.”
This was because he had to pay a huge price to attack the target. Last time, they had set up the Three Terminal Formation. Patriarch Yellow Oscillate and Demon Monarch Longswim had lost their lives and failed. He naturally had to pay a greater price to kill the Godfiend this time.
If he killed the wrong person?
Thousand Cricket’s life wasn’t enough to make up his losses.
“Imperial Lord,” said Thousand Cricket respectfully, “I sought 3,000 demon monarchs and left karmic blood curses on them. They are scattered all over the human world. It was completely random. Now, 533 demon monarchs have died. Marquis Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, killed 527 of them.”
Nine Abyss added, “Without a token, it’s like searching for a needle in a haystack. I probably won’t be able to find 50 of those cursed demon monarchs in a month. Yet, Meng Chuan killed so many of them. He must be that Godfiend that is extremely skilled at underground reconnaissance.” “Meng Chuan?” Imperial Lord Starquix fell silent before asking, “Does his daily lifestyle fit his underground reconnaissance schedule?”
“After confirming that it was him, I’ve often confirmed his location through the karmic blood curse,” said Demon Sage Thousand Cricket. “During the day, he is virtually all over the world. He’s at the bottom of the four seas, under the land—basically everywhere underground. As for our demon monarchs, they are mainly slaughtered during the day. It completely matches. At night, he returns to the Great Zhou Dynasty’s Jiang State Capital.”
“Underground-all over the world-during the day? Returns to Jiang State Capital at night?” Starquix nodded slightly, a smile appearing on his face. “Thousand Cricket, you did well.” “It’s my honor to serve the Imperial Lords.” Thousand Cricket bowed slightly.
Starquix smiled and looked at the two demon sages with satisfaction. Then, his figure in the pool disappeared.
...
Demon Realm.
The three Imperial Lords were gathered in Ice Palace, which floated in the sky.
“The intelligence on the human Godfiend, Meng Chuan, is all here,” said Emperor Roc. “From the intelligence, Meng Chuan entered Archean Mountain by taking first place during their entrance examination. When he was a Great Solar Godfiend, he joined forces with his companions to kill Blackwater Palace Lord of the Skydemon Sect not long after he left the mountain. This was because he was extremely fast and was good at rescuing people. The peak fourth Firmament demon monarch-Demon Monarch Blackrock-attacked Meng Chuan, but Blackrock failed in the end. Meng Chuan and his wife were immediately announced to have become Marquis Godfiends.
“More than ten years later, our demons attacked human cities on a large scale. From his actions, we can confirm that he has the strength of a top Regis Godfiend at the very least. I’m guessing that he was already a Regis Godfiend by then,” said Emperor Roc. “In that case, it’s very likely that he has been a Regis Godfiend for more than ten years.
“If his talent is as monstrous as speculated, he might reach the peak of the Seamless realm in ten years. With some special opportunities and powerful treasures, he can easily fight against the three-Yellow Oscillate and companyalone. Furthermore, he cultivates the lightning lineage. When Yellow Oscillate and North Sense attacked the mysterious Godfiend, they also confirmed that the Godfiend was skilled with lightning,” said Emperor Roc. “Indeed, Meng Chuan does match with all the information we have.”
Lady Blackmoon said softly, “Have you forgotten one thing? He’s extremely fast. For him to be able to probe the underground so well, other than using a mystic technique, his speed will greatly increase his reconnaissance efficiency.”
“Since it’s confirmed, I’ll prepare.” Imperial Lord Starquix looked at his two companions.
Emperor Roc and Lady Blackmoon looked at him. “Make the preparations.”
Imperial Lord Starquix nodded. He waved his hand and placed a huge black disc on the ground. The black disc had specks of light.
“Archean Eon Realm, Great Zhou Dynasty, Marquis Eastcalm, Meng Chuan!” Imperial Lord Starquix wrote words on the disc with his right hand. Every word was condensed with blood before fusing into the black disc.
In the River of Spacetime, the human world was also known as the Archean Eon Realm.
Many worlds were named after the strongest person in the history of their world. After all, Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s fame had spread far and wide across many worlds. When experts from other worlds thought of Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s hometown, they naturally called it the Archean Eon Realm.
Boom!
As Starquix wrote words on the black disc, he began to form a weak karmic connection with the human world’s Meng Chuan.
Through the illusory, ethereal karma, Starquix vaguely saw the figure of a young man.
“It’s a pity that we don’t have his blood or hair as a medium.” Imperial Lord Starquix shook his head gently. “Furthermore, he’s a world away from me. The human world is too great of an obstacle to me. It’s quite a struggle locking onto Meng Chuan.”
“This Meng Chuan can fight three enemies single-handedly, and the Three Terminal Formation failed to do anything to him. It’s impossible for us to obtain his hair or blood secretly,” said Emperor Roc. “It’s impossible to obtain hair or blood from even ordinary Regis Godfiends thanks to their Seamless domain. If we can secretly take his blood or hair, we can also take his head.”“Yes, I know.” Starquix nodded. “I need to pray to him for nine days and write a complete incantation for him. When I curse him on the ninth day, the power of the curse will reach its maximum.”
“We’ve waited so many years. Of course, we have the patience to wait another nine days,” said Emperor Roc with a smile.
“Starquix will pray to him for nine days. Once the curse descends upon him on the ninth day, we will definitely know if he’s dead or alive. It’s fine if he’s dead,” said Blackmoon. “If he really survives and discovers that his identity has been exposed, the humans will definitely strengthen their protection against him. It will be much harder for us to carry out an attack on him next time. Therefore, the plan this time needs to be more detailed and flawless.”
“What do you mean?” Emperor Roc and Imperial Lord Starquix looked at Lady Blackmoon.
“Since we are doing it, make sure his death is certain. We’ll also secretly prepare our final plan,” said Lady Blackmoon. “Prepare everything we can to deal with Meng Chuan. We must get rid of him. If he remains alive, most of our plans will fail.”
Emperor Roc and Imperial Lord Starquix nodded. “Yes.”
Emperor Roc began making other preparations while Lady Blackmoon guarded Imperial Lord Starquix.
Imperial Lord Starquix knelt in front of the black disc, completely motionless. Every two hours, he would write a ‘curse incantation’ on the black disc with blood. In his perception, the blurry young man’s figure gradually became clearer.

chapters.title: Chapter 398 - Curse
chapters.content:
Chapter 398 Curse
Elsewhere, in a small grotto-heaven in the human world.
A golden-armored envoy stood there, while Nine Abyss and the North Sense took the initiative to welcome him. They bowed respectfully. “Envoy.”
“Nine Abyss, you know what the Imperial Lords have instructed you to do, right?” asked the golden-armored envoy.
“I understand,” said Nine Abyss respectfully.
“Yes.”
The golden-armored envoy flipped his hand and took out a long, crystalline box. He handed it to Nine Abyss. “This is yours. Don’t disappoint the Imperial Lord.”
Nine Abyss’s eyes burned as he looked at the box. He received it excitedly and said, “The Imperial Lords can rest assured. I will definitely do my best.”
He had been looking forward to it for too long. Even though he had infiltrated the human world and had restored his strength to that of a demon sage, he was the only true demon sage in the human world. The Blood Fiend Armor had been the most precious item the Imperial Lord had given him.
Inside the box... was a treasure that he had been longing for. It was a legendary treasure amongst demons.
I never expected that I would obtain this treasure ahead of time because of Meng Chuan. Nine Abyss thought to himself, Regardless of whether the Imperial Lords’ plan succeeds or fails, I have at least obtained what I wanted. I hope everything goes smoothly. Meng Chuan should just die without a fuss.
“North Sense.” The golden-armored envoy instructed, “From now on, you will temporarily take over this small grotto-heaven. You will temporarily command all the demons in the human world.”
“Yes,” North Sense replied respectfully.
Nine Abyss and North Sense did a handover as the golden-armored envoy left.
“I’ll leave these mortal matters to you, Brother North Sense.” Demon Sage Nine Abyss left with a smile on his face. North Sense was secretly puzzled. What plan was it executing? Why would Nine Abyss be mobilized?
Emperor Roc had secretly deployed him as a backup plan for killing Meng Chuan. To the three demon Imperial Lords, they had to kill Meng Chuan at all costs. They were putting in their best effort this time.
The Demon Realm.
Emperor Roc came to Lady Blackmoon’s side as they watched Imperial Lord Starquix write the incantations.
“Are you ready?” asked Lady Blackmoon.
“According to our plans, everything is ready,” said Emperor Roc. “We have done everything we can to deal with Meng Chuan across worlds. If we fail this time, we really won’t be able to do anything to Meng Chuan.” Lady Blackmoon shook her head. “It’s impossible for us to fail! Our preparations have been very meticulous. In fact, it’s very likely that we will succeed considering how Imperial Lord Starquix is using 100 years of his lifespan to carry out the curse. Our other preparations might be unnecessary.” “A hundred years of lifespan? Shouldn’t we have Starquix consume more of his lifespan? For example, 200 years or 300 years?” said Emperor Roc.
“We need to pay several times the price, or even ten times the price before he agrees.” Lady Blackmoon shook her head and said, “Besides, to be honest, the effects of consuming 100 years of lifespan and 200 years of lifespan aren’t too different. The potency of the curse can only increase by 20 to 30 percent at most. If we want the curse’s power to undergo a qualitative change, Starquix will have to consume 1,000 years of his lifespan. This is something Starquix would never agree to.”
To an Imperial Lord with a 10,000-year lifespan-100 years was like a year to a mortal. Even for mortals, how many of them would easily give up a year of their lifespan?
If an Imperial Lord lived for 100 more years, they might break through to the Tribulation realm in the final century! Their lifespans would increase greatly as a result.
Therefore, not only did the lifespans of Imperial Lords indicate their lives, but they also represented a chance of breaking through. If they really encountered a huge threat, the three Imperial Lords’ plans might be foiled because of Meng Chuan. Therefore, Imperial Lord Starquix was willing to spend 100 years of his lifespan to carry out a curse. Otherwise, he would definitely not be willing to consume his lifespan if he could make the demon monarchs risk their lives instead.
Even if ten demon sages died, how could they compare to him consuming 100 years of lifespan? “Alright.” Emperor Roc nodded. “It was already very difficult to make Starquix carry out the attack. I hope everything goes smoothly.”
“It will be successful. That human, Meng Chuan, will definitely die without any resistance. He’ll die instantly,” said Lady Blackmoon. Her eyes were filled with anticipation.
Days passed.
Daily, Imperial Lord Starquix wrote incantations on the black disc every two hours. The incantations were condensed with blood. In fact, they were infused with Imperial Lord Starquix’s lifespan. After paying a huge price, the incantations were powerful enough to kill Meng Chuan across worlds.
Finally, it was the ninth day.
Emperor Roc and Lady Blackmoon, who were watching silently from the side, were somewhat nervous. The time of the attack was here. If they succeeded, it would be ten times easier to conquer the human world. If they failed, it would be very difficult to conquer the human world.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Imperial Lord Starquix calmly finished writing the last incantation.
At that moment, he could sense the distant young man’s appearance 1,000 times clearer than before. The karmic connection between the two rapidly strengthened.
“Die!” Imperial Lord Starquix softly read the incantation on the black disc. It was also the first time he was speaking since he started writing the incantation for nine days. At the same time, he tapped his finger on the black disc.
Bang!!!
A terrifying attack pierced through the mysterious and profound karma and instantly flew out of the demon world. It passed through the human world’s obstruction and flew into the Great Zhou Dynasty’s Jiang State Capital – where Meng Chuan was.
The world’s obstruction was extremely strong!
Normally, Imperial Lords’ attacks wouldn’t be able to penetrate another world, but it was a different story when one attacked through karma. In the vast River of Spacetime, countless cultivators were bound by karma. Tribulation Eminences often killed their enemies through karma-it was a common move for them. No matter how far one hid, no matter how special the place they were hiding in was, one would only be able to weaken the karma slightly, unable to truly isolate it. Even Ancestral Master Archean Eon and Eminence Fei Yu were unable to isolate karma from themselves.
Karma was inevitable in life.
Of course, as a middle-level world, the human world greatly suppressed any attacks through karmic connections.
If it wasn’t weakened? An Imperial Lord could kill a Regis Godfiend without expending his lifespan.
Boom!
After nine days of praying, Starquix cast a curse that descended upon Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan was studying Lightning Realm and Three World Saber in his chamber. At night, he would spend quite a bit of time studying the two ultimate techniques he had obtained. His daytime was dedicated to hunting demon monarchs. He had gained a lot from these two ultimate techniques.
He didn’t notice Imperial Lord Starquix’s daily “prayer.”
Only when the entire incantation was completed did the karmic connection between them strengthen. Meng Chuan vaguely felt fear and panic.
What happened? This thought surfaced in Meng Chuan’s mind.
Boom!
Just as he had this thought, the curse descended.
The curse was too bizarre; it was invisible and formless. Meng Chuan didn’t even know how to block it.
Hng.
Blood flowed from Meng Chuan’s nostrils. He couldn’t help but open his eyes. His eyes were filled with shock.
Pfft! Pfft! Pfft!
Hideous wounds appeared on Meng Chuan’s body. Blood instantly dyed his robe red. His organs began to rupture. Following that, Meng Chuan’s consciousness rumbled. He felt his vision blur.

chapters.title: Chapter 399 - Karmic Attack
chapters.content:
Chapter 399 Karmic Attack
In Meng Chuan’s sea of consciousness, his Essence Soul was a massive star.
After obtaining the Eon Sea Sect for nearly a month, he focused on comprehending and cultivating the Essence Soul Star. This was the strongest legacy he had obtained. Senior Fei Yu was an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence. This legacy was limited by the River of Spacetime’s laws. Although Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s legacy was known as the number one legacy of humanity and very well-rounded, it wasn’t restricted by the laws of spacetime. Furthermore, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul cultivation potential was ranked first in the Heart Sea Palace. He naturally put in a lot of effort into this aspect. He had now cultivated the second painting of the Essence Soul Star, making the massive star larger and heavier.
This legacy wasn’t very powerful when it came to killing enemies. In the early stages, it wasn’t even comparable to Essence Soul mystic techniques at the Fifth or Sixth Tribulation realm. Meng Chuan also cultivated the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell.
The Essence Soul Star was strong in two aspects. Firstly, the Essence Soul could cultivate on its own. The further one progressed, the greater the improvement. In the early stages, it didn’t help Meng Chuan much.
Secondly, it provided one’s Essence Soul a stable defense. After cultivating the Essence Soul Star, one’s Essence Soul would be extremely stable. Its defense would increase by more than ten-fold.
Just these two points alone were enough to make one supreme in the endless River of Spacetime.
Boom!
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul was struck by a mysterious attack. It seemed to disintegrate his Essence Soul from within, destroying his Essence Soul.
This destructive force caused Meng Chuan’s consciousness to rumble, but his Essence Soul continued to spin slowly. It began attacking the destructive power within him.
Oh? Meng Chuan instantly regained consciousness. His Essence Soul remained intact. My body... Meng Chuan sensed the mysterious destructive force that was crazily destroying his body from within.
Meng Chuan’s body was ridiculously powerful! He could be said to be comparable to a Regis Godfiend with just his Blood Droplet realm body alone. His body was one of the strongest in the River of Spacetime. It was stronger than a Creation realm human’s body. Although the mysterious destructive power was terrifying, it only caused his organs and bones to rupture. Although the internal bleeding was bad, his body remained intact.
Even if it really crumbled, Meng Chuan would die because his Blood Droplet realm body could regenerate as long as not all of the particle worlds weren’t destroyed. Combine! Meng Chuan commanded with a thought.
He accelerated his body’s recovery speed as he resisted the internal attack.
This destructive force was like water without a source. As it spent its force, Meng Chuan’s body rapidly recovered.
Bam!
The door to the chamber shattered. Liu Qiyue —who was holding a bow and arrow— rushed in. She was filled with worry. “Ah Chuan.”
His consciousness had blurred from the attack, so Meng Chuan naturally couldn’t restrain his aura completely.
Liu Qiyue was worried when she felt his aura leak out due to the clash between his body’s defensive forces and the curse.
“It should be a karmic attack,” said Meng Chuan as the blood on his body vanished. His clothes turned clean.
In such a situation...
A karmic attack was the only possibility he could think of. His Seamless domain, electromagnetic domain, and various means had failed to detect it. Furthermore, the attack was strange; he couldn’t even find the caster. It was as though the attack had descended from the void. With Meng Chuan’s knowledge, he could only think of a karmic attack.
The Demon Realm.
Imperial Lord Starquix knelt in front of the black disc and prayed for nine days. He wrote the complete incantation and unleashed a terrifying curse. All of this required him to consume 100 years of his lifespan.
“Did it succeed?” Lady Blackmoon and Emperor Roc watched nervously from the side. Everything would be great if they succeeded.
Huh? Imperial Lord Starquix’s face flushed red.
A terrifying force surged into his body through the karmic connection.
Pfft.
A mouthful of blood spewed from his mouth as the terrifying force wreaked havoc in his body.
The curse was a double-edged sword. It was naturally best if he succeeded in killing the enemy. If he failed, he would suffer a terrifying backlash.
Impossible. Imperial Lord Starquix felt the backlash damaging his body and Essence Soul, but he remained calm. No matter how serious his injuries were, he was still in his lair back at the Demon Realm. He could slowly recover.
However, the curse had failed?
How can my curse fail when I targeted both his Essence Soul and body?” Even if one has a fifth-level Essence Soul, they need to have very strong willpower to withstand it. Even if they can withstand it, their Essence Soul will be severely injured, and their strength will be greatly reduced.
Human Godfiends generally have weak bodies, far weaker than us demons. Those Regis Godfiends definitely can’t withstand the curse with their bodies. Only a Creation Supremacy can withstand it with their body.
If one’s Essence Soul can’t withstand the curse, death is definite. Even if the Essence Soul withstands it, one’s Essence Soul will lose its roots when their body is destroyed. Due to this, the Essence Soul will be much weaker and will definitely be annihilated by the curse. So how did my curse fail when I targeted both his body and Essence Soul?
Logically speaking, all cultivation had its shortcomings.
It was very difficult to have no shortcomings in one’s technique and Essence Soul. Imperial Lord Starquix’s curse—sent into another world -cost him 100 years of his lifespan. Few human Regis Godfiends could withstand such a curse. However, Meng Chuan happened to have no shortcomings!
Meng Chuan was extremely talented when it came to cultivating his Essence Soul. He had obtained an Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s legacy, Essence Soul Star. It made his Essence Soul terrifyingly stable. His consciousness only blurred when the curse struck him. His Essence Soul remained undamaged.
Furthermore, he followed the Cosmos Body cultivation system. His Blood Droplet realm body was much stronger than that of fifth Firmament demon monarchs. His body and Essence Soul were both powerful!
“How did it go?” asked Lady Blackmoon and Emperor Roc immediately.
“I failed.” Imperial Lord Starquix shook his head and said, “His body and Essence Soul are very strong. I even suspect that this Meng Chuan is the reincarnation of some Creation Supremacy or has been possessed by one. How else can he be flawless at such a young age?”
“You failed?” Lady Blackmoon and Emperor Roc exchanged looks.
“Execute the assassination plan,” said Lady Blackmoon directly.
Emperor Roc nodded slightly before disappearing into thin air. Starquix’s face was pale as he weakly fell to the ground. He sighed and said, “I failed to kill a Regis Godfiend with the curse. The assassination has to succeed. Otherwise, it will be troublesome.”
“We will definitely succeed.” Blackmoon’s expression turned cold.
Inside the chamber
The chamber’s door had long been shattered. Liu Qiyue immediately said, “Ah Chuan, you suffered a karmic attack. You have to report this to Archean Mountain immediately.”
“I’ve already requested for help,” said Meng Chuan calmly. “I’ve learned about the demon sages’ intelligence and limits. A karmic attack is extremely difficult for demon sages. Among the many demon sages in the Demon Realm, only one demon sage, Demon Sage Thousand Cricket, has extremely high attainments in the aspect of karma. The other demon sages are very ordinary. Could it be that a demon sage has arrived in the human world and has recovered its strength as a demon sage?”
The curse was potent.
If Thousand Cricket only had the strength of a fifth Firmament demon monarch, the curse would’ve tickled Meng Chuan. It would pose no threat to him at all.
“It takes a long time for a demon sage to recover their strength after possession,” said Liu Qiyue. “Furthermore, I haven’t heard of Demon Sage Thousand Cricket coming to the human world.”
“Apart from Demon Sage Thousand Cricket, there are only the three demon Imperial Lords left,” said Meng Chuan.
Once one reached the Imperial Lord realm, one would typically know how to employ karmic attacks.
“A demon Imperial Lord attacked me across worlds?” muttered Meng Chuan softly. “They are the most likely culprits. It looks like the demons are anxious to get rid of me.”
“The fact that they attacked you means that your identity has been exposed,” said Liu Qiyue worriedly. “The demons might also know your location. Shouldn’t you hide?”
“Let’s discuss that when an Archean Mountain Supremacy arrives,” said Meng Chuan. “I can’t leave now. If I escape and the demons attack... How will you and Jiang State Capital’s 20 million people resist the demons?”
Liu Qiyue looked at her husband.
“Don’t worry. No demon monarch in the human world, including Demon Sage Nine Abyss, can scare me in a head-on battle,” said Meng Chuan.
Huh? Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue sensed a terrifying aura appear above Jiang State Capital.

chapters.title: Chapter 400 - Arrival
chapters.content:
Chapter 400 Arrival
Night.
Demon Sage Nine Abyss silently stood in the clouds above Jiang State Capital. He was, currently, the only true demon sage in the human world! He was the only one with extraordinary combat strength!
If he were to die, it would probably take the demons nearly 100 years before a second true demon sage appeared in the human world. The demon Imperial Lords never allowed him to take risks easily. Even if he was in charge of bringing in a portion of the demon monarchs into the human world, he did so in a way that ensured his safety. The demon Imperial Lords didn’t care about the casualties of other demon monarchs. They only needed to ensure that Demon Sage Nine Abyss remained safe.
However, Meng Chuan was too great a threat to the demons! Imperial Lord Starquix had failed to kill Meng Chuan despite consuming 100 years of lifespan to curse him. They had no other choice. They only had one method left—let Demon Sage Nine Abyss take action.
From this, it could be seen that the three Imperial Lords valued Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s safety more compared to 100 years worth of Imperial Lord Starquix’s lifespan. This showed how important he was.
Nine Abyss’s attacks were extremely terrifying. A fifth Firmament demon monarch-activated demon treasure was much weaker than when they were activated by a demon sage. When a demon sage activated a demon treasure, it had incomparable might.
Oh? Nine Abyss sensed something. I ultimately have to take action?
He looked down; his eyes immediately locked onto an ordinary manor in Jiang State Capital. The demons had located Meng Chuan’s residence in advance. Furthermore, when Meng Chuan was hit by the curse, Meng Chuan’s aura and the curse’s power had leaked out. Nine Abyss had sensed the fluctuations.
He’s right there.
This is the first time I’m using my full strength since I came to the human world. Furthermore, for this battle, the Imperial Lords have bestowed me the Tribulation treasure I wanted the most, allowing me to achieve unprecedented strength. A dark-red eye suddenly opened at Nine Abyss’s glabella. It seemed to contain a dark-red world. The moment it opened, the surrounding world began to distort and gradually turn dark-red. The dark-red color even spread in all directions.
You should be proud that I’m using my full strength on you.
Nine Abyss swooped down and struck the manor below.
The terrifying fluctuations alarmed Meng Chuan and his wife. It also alarmed their neighbors. Within the many houses around Meng Chuan and his wife, there was one family that created stone sculptures. At that moment, one of the ordinary-looking sculptures suddenly opened its eyes and looked at the dark-red sky.
“There really is someone who’s attempting to assassinate Meng Chuan.” The stone sculpture suddenly soared into the sky and transformed into an ox-like, stone beast. It stepped through the void and took the initiative to meet Nine Abyss’s terrifying palm strike.
Huh? Nine Abyss frowned slightly. He could tell at a glance that the stone ox beast wasn’t a living being, but a guardian puppet. Ignoring the strength of these guardian puppets, most of their bodies could be said to be indestructible.
Boom! The gigantic palm collided with the stone ox beast.
The stone ox beast had immense strength, but its moves were too crude. Even so, it had the combat strength of a top Creation realm expert. In terms of being a bodyguard, it was much better than a top Creation realm expert. Few Creation realm experts dared to risk their lives to hold back the enemy.
There was a loud bang.
The world ruptured!
There was indeed a rupture. The world membrane had shattered, and one could see the outer realm-a despair-filled, heart-shaking darkness.
“Humph.” Although the stone ox beast was extremely powerful, it was sent flying by Nine Abyss—who had stronger and more mysterious moves. After obtaining the Tribulation treasure that was most suitable for him, Nine Abyss had far exceeded his previous strength.
Archean Mountain actually has a Creation realm guardian beast. They even sent it to guard the manor secretly. They really do cherish Meng Chuan. Nine Abyss’s palm changed direction slightly before continuing to strike at the manor.
Meng Chuan and his wife had long flown out of the chamber.
They saw the dark-red world descend! They also saw the stone ox beast soar into the sky before being sent flying by the palm.
As a Sect Proprietor, Meng Chuan knew that Archean Mountain had nine Seamless-level guardian beasts and a Creation-level guardian beast. According to Archean Mountain’s rules, more than half of the Sect Proprietors were needed to open Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven. It was the same for the Creation-level guardian beast. More than half of the Sect Proprietors had to approve of the guardian beast’s mobilization before it could be used.
Master and the others actually sent a guardian beast to protect us secretly. Meng Chuan was inwardly grateful, but he became nervous as the surrounding world began turning dark-red.
Although Nine Abyss’s palm wasn’t too fast, it felt like a descending world. It was unavoidable.
“Go.” With a thought, the Bloodblade Disc appeared beneath Meng Chuan’s feet as Bloodblades flew out, transforming into dazzling beams of light that streaked across the sky.
m
Boom!
Liu Qiyue didn’t hesitate to cast Phoenix’s Nirvana. She held her ancient divine bow and immediately shot arrows at the palm. “Qiyue.” Meng Chuan turned anxious when he saw his wife cast Phoenix’s Nirvana.
However, after seeing the stone ox beast collide with the palm, he knew how terrifying the palm was.
After reaching the Blood Droplet realm, Meng Chuan’s dantian space expanded; his technique realm had also improved. This caused his Seamless Quintessential Essence to become purer! He could now instantly unleash the strength of an ordinary Creation realm expert when he controlled the Bloodblades. If he were to accelerate himself with the electromagnetic domain and push his speed to the limits, he could unleash the strength of a top Creation realm expert.
Clear Sky. Meng Chuan instantly activated the Origins treasure. Blue clouds appeared around him. Three layers of lightning barriers appeared around him, protecting Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
The Bloodblades—which Meng Chuan released —constantly accelerated within the electromagnetic domain. Liu Qiyue’s arrows struck the giant palm first. Boom! Boom!
Every arrow was terrifying.
Due to the fact that Liu Qiyue had an Imperial Lord-level bow and arrows that suited heralong with the fact that a sharpshooter’s arrows were extremely terrifying-each arrow was comparable to a full-powered strike from a top Creation realm expert. Although the arrows’ strength wasn’t comparable to the stone ox beast’s clash, they had greater penetrative power. The destructive properties of the burning flames were also extremely punishing. The arrows opened up blood-colored holes in the giant palm as flames burned in the blood-colored holes.
