Swish! Swish! Swish! The Bloodblades flew at terrifying speeds. In the blink of an eye, they accelerated to their maximum speed within the electromagnetic domain.
Twelve Bloodblades struck the giant palm one after another. Each strike was a top Creation realm attack. They were slightly inferior to Liu Qiyue’s arrows, but they had 70 to 80 percent of her might. Furthermore, they were superior in number.
Huh? When the palm struck down, it was hit by arrows and Bloodblades continuously. Before it reached Meng Chuan and his wife, its momentum had been drained.
Why is Demon Sage Nine Abyss so powerful? Meng Chuan and his wife couldn’t believe their eyes. According to the intelligence, although Nine Abyss had cultivated for a long time, he was only at the late stages of the Grotto-Heaven realm. According to the human world’s strength, he could only be considered a top Creation realm expert. He was still quite far from reaching the Creation realm’s peak.
Therefore, it was said that Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar could fend off Demon Sage Nine Abyss.
But now?
With a single palm strike, he defeated the stone ox beast and suppressed the couple’s desperate attacks. This was definitely not the strength of a top Creation realm expert! It was the strength of a peak Creation realm expert.
From the looks of it, I won’t be able to kill them with a World Power-charged palm strike. Nine Abyss leisurely retracted his palm. However, the World Power has spread out enough. Dark-Red Prison, descend!
The surroundings had long turned dark-red.
At that moment, the dark-red world completely condensed, forming a tiny world. Even a world membrane was formed. Nine Abyss had obtained a Tribulation treasure
– Eye of the Dark Realm. It was what he had yearned for all this time.

chapters.title: Chapter 401 - Attention from Everywhere
chapters.content:
Chapter 401 Attention from Everywhere
Boom!
Qin Wu carried his sword on his back as he fused with his sword, rushing towards Jiang State Capital at high speed. Qin Wu had already recovered from the heavy injuries he had suffered from his previous high-speed travel. Qin Wu had now perfected his Sky Splitting Sword Flight perfected, reducing the damage to his body by half.
Meng Chuan, hold on. Qin Wu was very worried about his disciple.
Archean Mountain.
Li Guan, an illusory Qin Wu, and an illusory Luo Tang watched Jiang State Capital from afar. They had sensed the attack when Demon Sage Nine Abyss sent the stone ox beast flying with a single palm strike and collapsed the world membrane.
“Back when Meng Chuan requested help, my true body had already begun rushing over at full speed,” said Qin Wu. “Sparing no expense, it’ll take me 90 seconds to get there.”
“The Guardian Divine Beast is also requesting help. It actually failed to withstand the attack,” said Luo Tang in surprise. “What kind of danger did Meng Chuan encounter?”
Li Guanyi flicked his sleeve. In front of him, ripples appeared in the void, allowing them to vaguely see the scene of the world membrane shattering
In terms of insights into the void, Li Guanwho had cultivated the Archean Divine Bodycould be said to be the best in the present era. Without any treasures, he could see things in distant places. However, he could only see a single spot at any given moment! Only after confirming that the world membrane had shattered did Li Guan lock onto the battle location.
A battle scene appeared in the ripples of the void.
The dark-red world expanded. Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue attacked Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s palm strike.
Following that, the dark-red world condensed into a tiny world.
“Dark-Red Prison?” “It’s the demons’ Dark-Red Prison.” Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang were alarmed.
The demons and the human world were in the same region in the River of Spacetime. Over time, they gained a deep understanding of each other. Of course, this information was only known by Supremacies.
Among the demons’ many Tribulation treasures, the Dark-Red Prison was rather famous. Every Tribulation treasure had a different use. The Dark-Red Prison was a very special Tribulation treasure. It was very suitable for capturing enemies.
“After Demon Sage Nine Abyss improved on its divine powers, it produced its ultimate technique-Nine Abyss Land. This Dark-Red Prison is very suitable for it. It can increase Nine Abyss’s strength by several-fold,” said Li Guan. “However, Meng Chuan and his wife are quite strong. They managed to block this strike head-on. With Meng Chuan’s strength, the defensive stone talisman, and other treasures, we shouldn’t need to worry about his life.”
“Meng Chuan and his wife may want to protect the 20 million people in Jiang State Capital. They won’t be willing to escape,” said Luo Tang worriedly. “If they lose their lives, things will be terrible.”
She also cared about the 20 million people. However, she would rather sacrifice Jiang State Capital if Meng Chuan and his wife had a chance of dying. After all, Meng Chuan was now critical to the entire war. If he died, the war would be much more tragic for humans. Many more humans would die-much more than Jiang State Capital’s population.
“The couple has experienced so much. They will choose wisely at critical moments,” said Qin Wu as he watched silently.
Huh? Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s three Supremacies-Bai Yaoyue, Meng Tiange, and Mi Yu-looked at the mirror in front of them. This was an Imperial Lord-level treasure, the Heaven-Peeking Mirror. As long as it didn’t encounter a powerful obstruction, it could show the scene of any spot in the human world.
This is? Bai Yaoyue and the others watched in surprise. They had sensed that the world membrane had shattered, so they immediately probed the area.
The mirror was now showing a battle sceneDemon Sage Nine Abyss attacked with all his might, forcing the stone ox beast to retreat. Meng Chuan and his wife jointly blocked Nine Abyss’s attack.
“It’s Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue. Aren’t they both Marquis Godfiends? How can they withstand this strike? This is definitely a peak Creation realm expert’s strike,” said Mi Yu in surprise. “From the looks of their moves, they should have become Regis Godfiends long ago,” said Meng Tiange. “It’s not strange that Liu Qiyue has such strength after casting Phoenix’s Nirvana. Meng Chuan is the oddball. He doesn’t have a move like Phoenix’s Nirvana. Could it be that Archean Mountain has given him a Tribulation treasure? He managed to unleash such strength with a Tribulation treasure?”
“They bestowed a Tribulation treasure to a Regis Godfiend? Even King True Martial and King Calm Sea aren’t qualified.” Mi Yu watched. The scene before her was too shocking. It contained too much information.
“Since they silently broke through to the Seamless realm, perhaps their talent far exceeds what we imagine,” said Meng Tiange. “Furthermore, it’s even stranger that Demon Sage Nine Abyss is willing to risk everything to attack them. Back when they ambushed the mysterious Godfiend, they only sent Patriarch Yellow Oscillate and some other demon monarchs. This time, they sent Demon Sage Nine Abyss to deal with Meng Chuan and his wife personally.”
Bai Yaoyue’s eyes narrowed as she watched the battle play out.
Meng Chuan? He was Bai Nianyun and Meng Dajiang’s son! Bai Yaoyue hadn’t paid much attention to them, but now that Meng Chuan had unleashed the strength of a top Creation realm expert, she felt shocked and conflicted.
He’s already attained such strength at such a young age?
“Think about it. The demons weren’t this crazy, even when they ambushed the mysterious Godfiend that is skilled at underground reconnaissance. Why are they attacking Meng Chuan and his wife so crazily now?” asked Meng Tiange.
“It’s impossible that they are specifically targeting Liu Qiyue. She only has such strength because of Phoenix’s Nirvana. Her lifespan will be depleted after a few bursts. She won’t affect the demons much,” said Mi Yu. “The key lies with Meng Chuan.”
“Do you see the weapon he’s using? The streaks of light,” said Meng Tiange. “Back then, a mysterious Godfiend rescued Yushang City. Beams of light flew out and killed the fifth Firmament demon monarch, saving Marchioness Mooncherish.” Mi Yu was shocked. “Meng Chuan is that mysterious Godfiend?”
“There’s a high chance that Meng Chuan is the reconnaissance Godfiend, especially when you consider how the demons are trying to kill him at all costs,” said Meng Tiange. “I’m even more certain after seeing his techniques and combat strength. Clearly, after the last failure, the demons can only use crazier means.”
Mi Yu was extremely worried.
No matter what, Meng Chuan could not die. His life determined whether they could get rid of the million demon monarchs in the human world, and the war’s outcome.
“I also wish to help him, but we are tens of thousands of kilometers away. We won’t arrive in time,” said Meng Tiange.
Bai Yaoyue watched as she inwardly said, Meng Chuan, although I don’t like you and your father, I still hope you can live! For the sake of the entire human race, you have to survive!
“Demon Sage Nine Abyss spared no expense to deal with Meng Chuan and his wife? Meng Chuan and his wife actually have such strength?”
Two World Island naturally had treasures that could reflect any spot in the world.
At this moment, Xu Yingwu and the others were also watching the battle. Based on the intelligence that Two World Island had gathered-together with the information that Meng Chuan was the Godfiend that had taken action in Yushang City
-Two World Island also had their own guesses as to why Demon Sage Nine Abyss had attacked Meng Chuan.
“Archean Mountain actually produced a peerless genius like Meng Chuan? However, for the sake of the entire human race, you have to survive. You can’t die.” Xu Yingwu and company also wished for Meng Chuan’s survival.
Jiang State Capital.
Meng Chuan and his wife blocked the strike, but they had been sealed within the dark-red world. The Dark-Red Prison had formed a tiny world about five kilometers in diameter.
What is this? Meng Chuan controlled a Bloodblade to attack the dark-red world membrane. The Bloodblade was too fast; Demon Sage Nine Abyss didn’t have time to block it. The Bloodblade stabbed into the dark-red world membrane. Chi! Chi! Chi!
The Bloodblade penetrated the dark-red membrane, causing Meng Chuan to discover that there was a tendon membrane hidden behind the dark-red membrane. The tendon membrane seemed alive as they twisted and writhed. They were extremely tough.The Bloodblade was unable to pierce through the Tribulation treasure-Dark-Red Prison.
Demon Sage Nine Abyss scoffed inwardly. He extended his hands and boundless dark-red energy gathered on his body, forming a gorgeous dark-red robe. Demon Sage Nine Abyss sensed the World Power gather around him, and his every move became stronger. “I’m the master of this world here. Meng Chuan, you have nowhere to run this time!”
Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s voice echoed in the Dark-Red Prison. At the same time, he transformed into a dark-red blur as he charged towards Meng Chuan and his wife. Boom! The stone ox beast roared as it charged forward again.
Go, Magic Awl! A sharp glint flashed in Meng Chuan’s eyes.
Twelve Bloodblades accelerated to maximum speed as they flew towards Demon Sage Nine Abyss alongside the stone ox beast. At the same time, Meng Chuan-who had long cultivated the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell-also made his move. The Magic Awl Forbidden Spell was the strongest offensive mystic technique in the Heart Sea Palace. Meng Chuan had used ten percent of his Essence Soul’s Origins to cultivate the Magic Awl.
The Magic Awl was pitch-black. It contained many mystic runes. Just looking at it made one’s heart palpitate.
Swoosh!
Although the stone ox beast, 12 Bloodblades, and Liu Qiyue’s arrows shot out one after another, the Magic Awl-an Essence Soul weapon—was the first to reach Demon Sage Nine Abyss. It burrowed into his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 402 - Prison Shrinking
chapters.content:
Chapter 402 Prison Shrinking
Demon Sage Nine Abyss felt the World Power of the entire Dark-Red Prison gather upon his body. The unprecedented strength intoxicated him.
Kill Meng Chuan?He had full confidence in doing that.
“Die.” Nine Abyss transformed into a dark-red blur as he charged over. As for the stone ox beast, 12 Bloodblades, and Liu Qiyue’s arrows, he completely ignored them. Huh? Nine Abyss’s expression changed.
An invisible Essence Soul weapon instantly attacked him. His Essence Soul domain saw it
—a strange, pitch-black awl. Nine Abyss could not help but panic when he saw it. It was too fast. Before Nine Abyss could react, the magic awl entered his body and arrived at his sea of consciousness.
In his sea of consciousness, a powerful Essence Soul-which had been cultivating for many years—was surrounded by a dark-red shadow. He was also alarmed when facing the Magic Awl.
As a world-type Tribulation treasure, the Dark-Red Prison was beneficial to one’s Essence Soul. Of course, the benefits were limited. It couldn’t be compared to a protective treasure like the Bloodblade Disc. The Bloodblade Disc was specially refined by an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence for his disciple. Its defense was ranked first. As for the Dark-Red Prison, it was ultimately meant to set up a world. Pfft. The black Magic Awl instantly pierced through the dark-red shadow and Nine Abyss’s Essence Soul. Although his Essence Soul was tough and solid, it was still forcefully penetrated!
A huge hole appeared.
At the same time, the sharp grooves at the edge of the Magic Awl—which was known for its offensive power-damaged his Essence Soul to the greatest extent.
“Roar!” Demon Sage Nine Abyss—who was originally confident-suddenly let out an extremely painful howl. The dark-red robe on his body began to collapse uncontrollably.
Painful, it hurts! The intense pain made Nine Abyss hold his head and wail.
Pfft! Pfft! Pfft...
With the dark-red robe crumbling and Nine Abyss leaving himself nearly defenseless, Nine Abyss’s Blood Fiend Armor was the only thing protecting him. However, the Bloodblades avoided the armor and pierced through Nine Abyss’s head, abdomen, throat, and other exposed spots.
Boom!
The stone ox beast ruthlessly slammed into Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s body. Although its moves were crude, its strength alone was comparable to a peak Creation realm expert. This collision caused Nine Abyss’s tough body to split into two, snapping at the waist. As for Nine Abyss’ upper body, he still clutched his head in pain. He couldn’t care less about the attacks.
Pfft! Pfft! Pfft!
Three arrows landed on Nine Abyss’s body one after another, devastating his body even more. “It really hurts,” Nine Abyss growled. His damaged, split body instantly merged and became flawlessly whole. Once that was done, Nine Abyss’s eyes flew open and stared coldly at the distant Meng Chuan. However, his Essence Soul’s pain made his face twitch.
What a powerful body. Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue were alarmed.
“Demons have powerful bodies.” Meng Chuan sent a voice transmission to his wife. “My body can only be considered superior to fifth Firmament demon monarchs. Compared to demon sages, at the very least, Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s body is stronger than mine. Its vitality and recovery speed are probably close to mine. I believe it can be reborn from a single drop of blood as well.” It was very difficult to kill fifth Firmament demon monarchs even if one diced them up.
Killing a demon sage? A demon sage’s vitality was even more abnormal. Nine Abyss was a demon sage that had cultivated for many years. He was nothing like a newly-advanced demon sage.
“What a powerful Essence Soul attack.” Nine Abyss roared softly as he charged towards Meng Chuan. Magic Awl. Meng Chuan directed the Magic Awl with a thought.
The Magic Awl entered Nine Abyss’s sea of consciousness once and forcefully penetrated his Essence Soul again. At the same time, the sharp grooves on the Magic Awl naturally shattered the Essence Soul. Nine Abyss’s Essence Soul resiliently resisted the attack. After the Magic Awl pierced through the Essence Soul, cracks appeared in the Essence Soul weapon.
The Magic Awl is damaged? Meng Chuan was secretly alarmed. Although it’s very powerful, it’s too easily damaged.
The forbidden spell, Magic Awl, pursued extreme might, but there were many flaws. Firstly, one had to direct lots of their Essence Soul Origins to maintain the Essence Soul weapon. Secondly, it was too brittle due to its extreme sharpness. If the enemy’s Essence Soul blocked it with all its might, the Magic Awl would be damaged. If it couldn’t penetrate through, it would shatter directly.
Even if the Magic Awl successfully penetrated the Essence Soul after a few attempts, it would still shatter.
However, the Magic Awl had excellent effects after penetrating an enemy’s Essence Soul once. The enemy’s Essence Soul would be unable to fight back due to the pain.
“Roar!” Nine Abyss clutched his head in pain and stopped once more. Even with the aid of the Dark-Red Prison, he could barely maintain his external senses.
I nearly lost control of the outside world after suffering the Essence Soul attack. I can only barely maintain my lucidity. My Essence Soul doesn’t follow any patterns when it comes to convergence and divergence. It can split into billions of thoughts. However, this strange Essence Soul attack only took two strikes to make me lose ten percent of my Essence Soul’s Origins. I’ll lose a portion of my memories if I suffer another two or three strikes.
I’ve damaged my Origins, and my Essence Soul is in extreme pain. Nine Abyss sensed the intense pain coming from his Essence Soul. I can’t use any intricate moves now. I can only use brute force.I must use a forbidden spell and kill the enemy with one strike! I can’t afford to delay any further!
Boom!
The dark-red robe condensed on his body once again. Nine Abyss looked at Meng Chuan from afar. The Dark-Red Prison began to shrink; its five-kilometer diameter rapidly shrunk.
Oh? The couple and the stone ox beast realized that the Dark-Red Prison was shrinking.
“Ah Chuan, why aren’t you using your Essence Soul mystic technique?” Liu Qiyue sent a voice transmission.
“If I use it again, my Essence Soul weapon will shatter,” said Meng Chuan via voice transmission. “That’s why I can’t use it easily.”
He felt a little regretful. If he had used 20% of his Essence Soul’s Origins to form the Magic Awl, its might would definitely be much greater. He could probably kill Demon Sage Nine Abyss with just the Essence Soul mystic technique alone. However, there was no room for regret! Meng Chuan had chosen to use only 10% of his Essence Soul’s Origins because it would influence him significantly if he used any more.
It was clearly stated that one would only lose memories and suffer a drop in perceptivity when one used more than 30% of the Essence Soul’s Origins. However, Meng Chuan could sense that the side effects of using just 10% of his Essence Soul’s Origins already had insignificant impacts on him.
For example, his Essence Soul’s thought process had slowed down by one percent, and its stability had decreased by one to two percent. Clearly, the more Essence Soul Origins he used, the greater the impact it had on him. In fact, it might even affect his spirituality and perceptivity. It was just that the initial impact was tiny.
This mystic technique was ultimately a forbidden technique.
Meng Chuan wanted to reach the Creation realm as soon as possible. He wanted to become an invincible Creation expert or even an Imperial Lord. He wanted to end this war completely.
There’s no need to regret my choice, thought Meng Chuan. If I used 20 to 30 percent of my Essence Soul Origins, it might take me an extra decade or two to reach the Creation realm. It might have an impact on my chances of becoming an Imperial Lord.
Nine Abyss constantly shrank the Dark-Red Prison until it was just 1.5 kilometers wide. The Dark-Red Prison could expand and shrink. It could shrink until it was 1.5 kilometers wide.It’s too close. Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue were somewhat uneasy.
The Dark-Red Prison’s shrinking made them even closer to Nine Abyss. To engage in close combat with a demon sage that had a powerful body? It was suicidal.
Boom!
Nine Abyss punched out without any warning.
His punch instantly reached Meng Chuan and his wife. They were just too close to one another! Thankfully, the Origins treasure, Clear Sky, formed three lightning barrier layers. Boom!
The punch-fueled by World Power-shattered the three lightning barrier layers.
This punch wasn’t aimed at Meng Chuan, but Liu Qiyue!
This was because Meng Chuan was too slippery with his movement technique! This information was what they had obtained after Patriarch Yellow Oscillate and company ambushed Meng Chuan last time.

chapters.title: Chapter 403 - Nothing Can Be Done
chapters.content:
Chapter 403 Nothing Can Be Done
Archean Mountain.
Li Guan, an illusory Qin Wu, and an illusory Luo Tang nervously watched the scene that appeared in the void ripples. Demon Sage Nine Abyss, who had a monstrous aura, clutched his head and wailed. The constant attacks made them heave sighs of relief. However, Nine Abyss recovered completely without any injuries (Essence Soul injuries were not physically visible).
The Dark-Red Prison shrank as Nine Abyss cast a forbidden spell and punched out with all his might. The power behind this punch was too terrifying “How sinister.”
“If it were to attack Meng Chuan directly, Meng Chuan would dodge! But since it is attacking Liu Qiyue, Meng Chuan will take the initiative to block it.” Li Guan and company could discern the situation at a glance.
They knew what Demon Sage Nine Abyss was trying to do, but they could do nothing to stop
him.
“Don’t block it.” Bai Yaoyue clenched her fists as she nervously stared at the Heaven-Peeking Mirror.
“This punch carries the strength of the entire Dark-Red Prison. It shouldn’t be blocked.” Meng Tiange was anxious as well. “With Demon Sage Nine Abyss casting a forbidden spell, this punch’s might should be close to the strength of a threshold Imperial Lord.”
“You must not block it. Doing so will only mean death.” Xu Yingwu and company watched nervously.
At the Creation realm, one could vaguely deduce the strength of the punch.
After infusing all of the Dark-Red Prison’s strength into the punch, Demon Sage Nine Abyss was close to a threshold Imperial Lord when he went all out. Could a Regis Godfiend withstand such a punch?
Nine Abyss’s sinister fist flew towards Liu Qiyue. This punch was too fast, causing the void to shatter. Meng Chuan had no way of putting Liu Qiyue into his Grotto-Heaven Treasure Bead.
“Qiyue.” Meng Chuan was alarmed. When the three lightning barrier layers collapsed one after another, the 18 Bloodblades’s defensive formation-which was protecting himinstantly expanded in range to include Liu Qiyue.
“Ah Chuan.” Liu Qiyue had cast Phoenix’s Nirvana. She triggered her pure Phoenix bloodline’s power, causing her Essence Soul and body to transform. Insights into fire even surged into her mind constantly. However, this state of epiphany was at the cost of her lifespan. Although Liu Qiyue felt that she was pretty strong, she was still unable to match Nine Abyss’s punch. Meng Chuan put himself between the attack and Liu Qiyue.
Clang!
After the huge dark-red fist shattered Clear Sky’s three lightning barrier layers, it immediately smashed into the 18 Bloodblades’ defensive formation.
Clear Sky’s obstruction wasn’t worth mentioning; the 18 Bloodblades’ defensive formation was much stronger. This was a Tribulation treasure that was meant for protection. Its defensive capabilities were much stronger. With Meng Chuan’s current cultivation and technique realm, he could withstand a top Creation realm expert’s attack without the defensive formation breaking down. However, Nine Abyss’s punch was too powerful. It was close to the threshold of an Imperial Lord.
The moment the fist struck the 18 Bloodblades, the pitch-black Magic Awl pierced Nine Abyss’s sea of consciousness.
The Magic Awl—which already had cracks on it — forcefully penetrated Nine Abyss’s Essence Soul at this critical moment!
“Ah!” Nine Abyss felt unbearable pain. Due to his extraordinary willpower, he barely managed to stay lucid as he struck out with his fist. The 18 Bloodblades scattered due to the blow, but they drastically reduced the fist’s might.
The giant dark-red fist—which had been greatly weakened-still smashed towards Liu Qiyue.
Meng Chuan held Demon Slayer with both hands and took the initiative to meet it.
Boom!
Divine power—Heaven Earth Control!
Divine power-Flowing Sand!
Meng Chuan unleashed his two divine powers simultaneously. Even though the fist’s strength had been greatly reduced, Meng Chuan gave his all when facing the chaotic punch.
“You can’t block it.” Bai Yaoyue, Li Guan, Xu Yingwu, and the others were gripped with anxiety. “Ah Chuan!” Liu Qiyue was even more anxious. She hated herself for not being strong enough. She dug deep into her bloodline for more strength.
To Meng Chuan, everything beyond him slowed down.
Meng Chuan had ten times as much time as he had in the outside world. When he used the same Cloud Dragon Snake Saber Art, it seemed much more exquisite to observers. Under his Heaven Earth Control, he could unleash even greater strength and speed. His Indestructible Divine Armor also became stronger.
The saber art he used could divert strength away.
He tried his best to reduce the force behind the punch! He diverted most of the strength to the side.
Boom!
The moment the saber and fist collided, Meng Chuan’s body trembled as blood burst from his body like a fog. Many bones and organs began to crack, but Meng Chuan still held Demon Slayer firmly in his hands. His bones, muscles, and organs instantly recovered.
Oh? After Nine Abyss’s fist headed towards Liu Qiyue, Meng Chuan finally stood in front of her. This delighted Nine Abyss.
Even though I suffered Essence Soul attacks and had to blast through layers of obstructions, the punch still has 30% of its power left. It’s enough to kill him.
However, half of the force behind the punch was diverted away. After Meng Chuan’s Indestructible Divine Armor blocked the punch, only a spray of blood burst out of Meng Chuan’s body before he completely recovered from his injuries.
He blocked it? Nine Abyss found it unbelievable. His Essence Soul was in excruciating pain. He found it difficult to control the Dark-Red Prison.
I blocked it. Meng Chuan was very glad because the punch was just too powerful for him to block it directly.
Even though it only had 30% of its strength remaining-even if he had executed the Cloud Dragon Snake Saber Art most exquisitely—the fist was definitely not something he could block directly. If the attack were to hit his body, it was highly likely that he would be killed!
Without the Magic Awl, Demon Sage Nine Abyss would’ve been able to unleash his strength perfectly. In that case, he would’ve been swept away-not able to resist at allwhen he put himself in the attack’s trajectory.
If he wanted to save Liu Qiyue and himself, he would have made her hide in his Grotto-Heaven Treasure early on before relying on the protective stone talisman to escape. However, if he did such a thing, Nine Abyss’s ambush would’ve failed. He would then vent his anger on Jiang State Capital. Twenty million people would die if they fled cowardly.
My strength increased by leaps and bounds after I obtained a Tribulation treasure. Demon Sage Nine Abyss is indeed terrifying after it obtained a powerful treasure. Meng Chuan was secretly alarmed. Fortunately, I cultivated the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell, causing its strength to decrease greatly.
Whoosh.
The pitch-black Magic Awl was now covered in cracks; it looked as if it could shatter at any moment. Luckily, it didn’t.
Meng Chuan immediately put the Magic Awl into his sea of consciousness and carefully nourished it.
If he was willing...
He could force his Magic Awl—which was about to shatter at any moment—to carry out a life-and-death strike. Of course, that would result in him losing 10% of his Essence Soul’s Origins. Even with the Essence Soul Star mystic technique, it would take time to recover slowly. Without doing this, Meng Chuan’s Magic Awl
—which was covered in cracks—could recover in half a month as long as it stayed in his sea of consciousness.
It failed? With his injuries, Nine Abyss could barely control the Dark-Red Prison. It was difficult for him to replicate such a powerful attack again. No, no. I have to succeed. I’ll deliver another fatal strike. Nine Abyss endured his injuries and attacked again.
Boom!
Behind Meng Chuan, Liu Qiyue’s aura suddenly intensified. The terrifying aura made Meng Chuan turn his head.
As a Regis Godfiend, Liu Qiyue became closer to a real phoenix when she cast Phoenix’s Nirvana to draw upon her bloodline’s power! Due to this, she naturally consumed her lifespan even faster than before. From the moment the battle began, Liu Qiyue had already maintained Phoenix’s Nirvana for 21 seconds. This was a very long time for Liu Qiyue.
Her insights into fire had reached a whole new realm.
Boom!
Liu Qiyue looked at Demon Sage Nine Abyss. She pulled her bow taut as a flaming arrow pierced through the air. The arrow’s might was much more terrifying than before.Not good. Nine Abyss sensed the threat of death the moment Liu Qiyue shot the arrow.
Rumble...
Invisible astral ripples spread out. This was Meng Chuan’s main method of attack with his Essence Soul Star-Astral Wave. The Astral Wave fluctuation struck Nine Abyss’s Essence Soul. This aggravated his heavily-injured Essence Soul, so he was in even more pain than before. He was unable to block the arrow.
Pfft.
The arrow struck his chest, piercing through his dark-red robe and Blood Fiend Armor. It penetrated right through his body. Golden flames constantly burned at his wounds.
Not good. Nine Abyss panicked. If I don’t leave now, I might not have a chance of surviving. If he were in perfect condition, even if Liu Qiyue made another breakthrough, Nine Abyss was confident of killing them easily. However, his Essence Soul was severely injured. Astral Waves also constantly struck him! He could only unleash 30 to 40 percent of his strength. He began to panic when facing Liu Qiyue’s arrows.
Nothing can be done. Time to go!
The Dark-Red Prison dissipated, and Nine Abyss quickly fled into the distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 404 - Liu Qiyue’s Lifespan
chapters.content:
Chapter 404 Liu Qiyue’s Lifespan
Nine Abyss’s lack of hesitation when fleeing stunned Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue.
That arrogant and threatening demon sage had fled just like that?
Its injuries are too severe. It doesn’t dare to stay here any longer. Meng Chuan quickly understood that the three stabs from his Magic Awl were extremely damaging to the demon sage’s Essence Soul.
“Qiyue, I’ll follow it so that it can’t escape,” said Meng Chuan via voice transmission.
“Go. This is the best chance to deal with Demon Sage Nine Abyss. Be careful.” Liu Qiyue stopped maintaining Phoenix’s Nirvana and quickly retracted her flames. “Don’t worry.” Meng Chuan could clearly sense his wife’s lifespan being consumed with his Seamless domain. His heart ached.
Liu Qiyue didn’t maintain Phoenix’s Nirvana for more than 24 seconds. Due to Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s powerful body, she had stopped shooting arrows midway... Even then, she consumed 89 years of her lifespan? Meng Chuan felt pained. When she was under Phoenix’s Nirvana, Liu Qiyue had used all her strength to shoot multiple arrows. Doing this resulted in more lifespan being consumed than not shooting arrows at all. However, she consumed an average of 11 years of lifespan for every three seconds she maintained Phoenix’s Nirvana. This was much faster than when she was a Marquis Godfiend.
Liu Qiyue had consumed 89 years of lifespan. How long could a Regis Godfiend live to begin with? In the future, he had to prevent his wife from using Phoenix’s Nirvana again.
We have to take this opportunity to kill Demon Sage Nine Abyss. If it escapes, there will be endless troubles in the future. Meng Chuan quickly caught up with Nine Abyss on the Bloodblade Disc. At the same time, he released Bloodblades to attack Nine Abyss. Meng Chuan was fast, and the Bloodblades were even faster!
The Bloodblades circled Nine Abyss like lightning
Archean Mountain. Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang watched the scenes that appeared in the void ripples. As Liu Qiyue’s aura intensified, the arrows’ might increased greatly. Demon Sage Nine Abyss finally fled in panic.
“It fled.”
“Good.”
Li Guan and company were overjoyed.
Luo Tang happily said, “As a Regis Godfiend, Liu Qiyue’s lifespan drains quickly when maintaining Phoenix’s Nirvana, but her strength also increases greatly. She is already a top Regis Godfiend. Under Phoenix’s Nirvana, she’s a sharpshooter comparable to a top Creation realm expert. She has a good bow and arrows. Her arrows are as strong as a peak Creation realm expert’s attacks.”
A sharpshooter’s arrows were powerful to begin with. A top Creation realm sharpshooter could match a peak Creation realm expert. A peak Creation realm sharpshooter’s attack was comparable to a threshold Imperial Lord. If the sharpshooter had a suitable Tribulation treasure, the threat they posed would increase by several-fold!
“It’s also because Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul mystic technique heavily injured Demon Sage Nine Abyss that it was unable to withstand Liu Qiyue’s arrows,” said Li Guan with a smile. “If Demon Sage Nine Abyss were in perfect condition, he would naturally be able to block the arrows and kill a sharpshooter at close range.”
“Haha, that’s why the couple forced Demon Sage Nine Abyss into a retreat.” Luo Tang was happy.
“The Magic Awl Forbidden Spell is indeed powerful.” Li Guan nodded. “Back then, it was a forbidden spell that awed the River of Spacetime. Ever since the Eon Sea Sect declined, this mystic technique was lost. Now, it’s finally back.”
Back during the Archean Eon Sect’s era, the human world was rather famous in its local region of the River of Spacetime.
First, Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s fame spread far and wide. Later on, there were generations of Imperial Lords and invincible Creation realm experts.
With powerful treasures and powerful forbidden spells, who in the vicinity wouldn’t fear the experts of the Archean Eon Realm?
The Essence Soul weapon, Magic Awl, was a signature technique of the human world! However, this mystic technique had been lost for the past 500,000 years. In those years, fewer experts had been produced in the human world. In fact, the human race gradually declined.
In the near future, the resources within Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven would be completely depleted by successive generations. In the past 500,000 years, the number of experts in the human world became scarce.
The Archean Eon Realm’s influence had declined in its local region of the River of Spacetime. It was far less famous than the Demon Realm.
“Qin Wu, hurry over. Make use of this opportunity to finish off Demon Sage Nine Abyss,” said Li Guan.
Qin Wu nodded. “Yes.”
“It fled.” Meng Tiange and Mi Yu were overjoyed.
Bai Yaoyue also smiled. Meng Chuan, a Regis Godfiend, was now critical to the war. From the perspective of the entire human race, he couldn’t die! Nine Abyss attacked ferociously, but he fled in panic. The outcome delighted them.
“Demon Sage Nine Abyss covered its head several times and wailed in pain. It doesn’t seem to be injured on the surface. It should’ve been struck by an Essence Soul mystic technique, right?” Meng Tiange exclaimed. “Demon Sage Nine Abyss has a fifth-level Essence Soul at the very least. However, its Essence Soul was severely injured. Who executed the Essence Soul mystic technique? Meng Chuan? Liu Qiyue?”
“Both of them are very young. No matter who it was, it’s very impressive for them to injure Demon Sage Nine Abyss heavily with an Essence Soul mystic technique,” praise Mi Yu. “However, I believe that Meng Chuan was the one who cast the Essence Soul mystic technique. Firstly, those beams of light-which he controls—are extremely powerful. It’s very likely that they’re a Tribulation treasure. Tribulation treasures usually have very strict requirements on one’s Essence Soul.
“Secondly, as a reconnaissance Godfiend, the demons will have plenty of ways to deal with him if his Essence Soul is too weak. Furthermore, I’ve read the reports on Meng Chuan.... When Meng Chuan entered Archean Mountain, his Spirit Perception far exceeded others during the entrance examination. This means that his Essence Soul talent is extremely high.”
Bai Yaoyue watched silently.
“Junior Sister Bai, your Essence Soul talent is quite high too. It’s probably thanks to you that Meng Chuan has such talent,” said Meng Tiange with a teasing smile; he was in a good mood.
Bai Yaoyue snorted coldly.
“Hahaha...” Meng Tiange’s laughter grew louder.
Although Black Sand Grotto-Heaven kept the matter between Bai Nianyun and Meng Dajiang a secret, even Grand Yin Hall Elders could tell that Bai Nianyun was not a virgin. They quickly found out that it was related to Meng Dajiang. The Supremacies, Meng Tiange and Mi Yu, naturally knew about it.
They also knew the relationship between Meng Chuan and the Bai family.
Thinking about it... Meng Chuan also had a portion of the Bai family’s bloodline.
As for Bai Yaoyue, she was extremely talented. She became a Regis Godfiend at the age of 53! Although her Essence Soul talent was far inferior to Meng Chuan’s, she had a third-level Essence Soul in her forties. She was considered very talented in the aspect of Essence Souls.
Nianyun is the most similar to me among the juniors of the Bai family. Her talent is high, but she doesn’t have enough self-control. She got together with a mortal like Meng Dajiang and even lost her virginity to him, yet she still became a Marquis Godfiend. If she had restrained herself, she could’ve probably gained control of Grand Yin Hall and become a Creation Supremacy in the future. The Meng family would have lucked out.
There was no doubt that talent involved blood inheritance. Parents passed on their bloodline to their children; the more outstanding the parent, the higher the starting point their children enjoyed.
Of course, hard work was more important! Among the children of powerful experts, there were also profligate sons and daughters. Children born of mortals could also shock the world. After all, even the weak human world could give birth to a Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence like Ancestral Master Archean Eon.
There were thousands—if not tens of thousands-of Godfiends in the human world that were stronger than Meng Dajiang and Bai Nianyun. However, their son, Meng Chuan, was ranked first in the combined potential rankings of the Heart Sea Palace and the Battle God Pagoda! This talent could no longer be attributed to bloodline inheritance. It was more to do with Meng Chuan’s repeated transformations over the years.
A true expert would repeatedly surpass their former selves in the aspects of the Essence Soul, willpower, perception, and etc.
Not far away from Jiang State Capital, the golden-armored envoy watched the battle that had taken place.
It represented one of the three demon Imperial Lords, Emperor Roc. Emperor Roc could see everything the golden-armored envoy saw. That was why Demon Sages Nine Abyss and North Sense were so respectful towards this envoy.
Nine Abyss fled? The golden-armored envoy watched from afar; he felt disbelief. We lost?

chapters.title: Chapter 405 - Turning Point
chapters.content:
Chapter 405 Turning Point
Boom!
Demon Sage Nine Abyss fled at full speed, but Meng Chuan remained behind him. Bloodblades constantly attacked him.
I can only escape Meng Chuan if I go underground. Nine Abyss suddenly swooped down and burrowed into the ground. Swish! Swish! Swish!
The Bloodblades burrowed into the ground and circled Nine Abyss. After that, Meng Chuan quickly followed behind him.
Boom!
As soon as he entered the ground, Nine Abyss
—who was fleeing—turned around and delivered a punch!
The punch tore through the void and shot towards Meng Chuan.
Still on the Bloodblade Disc, Meng Chuan ducked slightly, allowing the punch to brush past him. The punch flew hundreds of feet away from Meng Chuan. “Nine Abyss, it’s currently impossible for your punches to touch me,” said Meng Chuan via voice transmission. With the help of his electromagnetic domain, he easily followed his target.
He’s too slippery. Nine Abyss was secretly vexed by the situation. His Essence Soul was too severely injured. He had lost 10% of his Essence Soul Origins—which translated into heavy injuries. His Essence Soul constantly twitched, making it impossible for him to execute any exquisite moves. As for his crude fist arts, how could they touch Meng Chuan? Even if Meng Chuan was forced into a corner, Meng Chuan could still affect the flow of time with his divine power—Flowing Sand. This made him even more slippery. Nine Abyss flew deep underground at high speeds. When he reached a depth of about 50 kilometers, his body suddenly split into ninewhich all fled in different directions. However, they were quickly intercepted by several Bloodblades! If I had a sixth-level Essence Soul, my Essence Soul avatars would be able to hold him back. My main body would be able to escape easily. Nine Abyss felt that Meng Chuan was too clingy. No matter how hard he tried, he couldn’t escape from Meng Chuan.
No, if I had a sixth-level Essence Soul, I could have withstood his Essence Soul mystic technique and killed him head-on.
Nine Abyss began to panic. He had already used seven different escape techniques, but the ten-plus Bloodblades shattered his hopes of escaping It won’t be long before an Archean Mountain Creation Supremacy arrives. If I can’t shake Meng Chuan off, I will definitely be caught by the Creation Supremacy. We lost. We lost terribly. Nine Abyss shook his head. The Imperial Lords will definitely be disappointed.
At that moment, he understood that he had lost. He was actually waiting for a Creation Supremacy to arrive.
Boom!
Nine Abyss burrowed 100 kilometers deep into the mantle. The Bloodblades continued to surround him.
Oh? Nine Abyss’s eyes lit up as he stopped and turned to look into the distance.
Nine Abyss stood there as the power of the Tribulation treasure-Eye of the Dark Realmerupted. A terrifying power swept across his surroundings. Nine Abyss pulverized the world membrane from where he stood. The aftershocks even spread out for several kilometers, reducing the molten rock and metal, within a few kilometers, to dust.
From afar, Meng Chuan appeared. The aftershocks swept past him, but it didn’t injure him at all. He remained deep in the void. With the Bloodblade Disc protecting him, his Blood Droplet realm body, and a slippery movement technique, even Nine Abyss was helpless against him.
“Supremacy Qin Wu.” Demon Sage Nine Abyss stared into the distance. Qin Wu had finally arrived. “Demon Sage Nine Abyss.” Qin Wu looked at Demon Sage Nine Abyss and the shattered world membrane next to him.
“I never expected that I wouldn’t be able to kill a Regis Godfiend, even with my full strength. This Meng Chuan has such a powerful Essence Soul mystic technique.” Nine Abyss sighed. The world membrane around him constantly shattered, maintaining the huge hole—which was dozens of feet wide. “However, in the end, you humans will definitely lose. I will watch from the Demon Realm.”
With that said, Nine Abyss turned around and crossed through the opening in the world membrane.
Humph. The sword on Qin Wu’s back suddenly slashed out. A terrifying sword beam cleaved the world membrane, tearing the hole wider by hundreds of feet as it pursued Nine Abyss.
The terrifying sword beam instantly appeared behind Nine Abyss, but the sword beam was immediately obliterated by the darkness. It completely dissipated as Nine Abyss remained unharmed.
“Demon Imperial Lord.” Through the world membrane opening, Qin Wu stared at the figure standing in the outer realm’s void.
Previously, this figure was hidden.
Since he had made a move, there was no need to hide. He revealed himself-a golden-robed, golden-haired figure that emitted a terrifying aura. The figure coldly glared at Qin Wu through the world membrane opening before his gaze swept past Meng Chuan.
A demon Imperial Lord. Meng Chuan felt his heart palpitate when the gaze swept past him. He knew that if they were in the same world, the demon Imperial Lord would probably be able to kill him with a single strike. “So it’s Emperor Roc,” said Qin Wu with a smile.
Meng Chuan also saw it.
Demon Sage Nine Abyss did it on purpose. Meng Chuan came to a realization at that moment. However, it’s also quite afraid of Master. It tore open the world membrane, meaning it could escape at any time. If it escaped and Master actually chased after him, he would be killed by Emperor Roc—who was hiding in the outer realm.
No matter how weak a demon Imperial Lord was, they had reached the Heaven Earth realm and had a seventh-level Essence Soul at the very least.
It was a complete suppression. If a Creation realm expert wanted to fight an Imperial Lord that was above their level? Well, human Creation Supremacies were presently far from being capable of such a thing.
“You human Godfiends don’t even dare to enter the outer realm,” said Emperor Roc coldly as he stood in the dark void. “Continue hiding. Let’s see how long you can hide.”
Following that, he left with Nine Abyss.
The world membrane regenerated and sealed the opening
“Trying to lure me out and ambush me?” Qin Wu shook his head. “Do you really think I’m stupid?”
“One of the three demon Imperial LordsEmperor Roc.” Meng Chuan stood by the side. This was the first time he had seen an Imperial Lord. He instinctively felt fear when he saw Emperor Roc.
“What’s there to be afraid of when we are separated by a world?” said Qin Wu with a smile. “Even a Tribulation Eminence can’t break through a world’s obstruction and enter another world, much less an Imperial Lord. This is a rule in the entire River of Spacetime. It serves as protection for a world’s weak living beings.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
Many worlds were still very weak. For example, in the earliest periods of the human world, one could only reach the Creation realm at the very most.
The weakest experts traveling through the River of Spacetime were at the Creation realm. If they were allowed to enter and leave worlds freely, these weaker worlds would’ve long been destroyed. Due to the River of Spacetime’s laws and the World Origins’ protection, countless civilizations were born in the River of Spacetime.
“However, it’s right.” Qin Wu sighed. “Ever since the war with the demons began, human Creation Supremacies no longer dare to enter the outer realm. Unless we have an avatar technique, we would be courting death if we roam the outer realm with our true bodies. If our true bodies are discovered by the demons...
“The Demon Realm has great influence over this region in the River of Spacetime. They have three Imperial Lords and a group of demon sages. They are ranked among the top five worlds in this region. Many weak worlds are willing to suck up to the Demon Realm. Our human world’s status is much worse.
“I’ve talked too much.” Qin Wu smiled at Meng Chuan. “What outer realm? The most important thing for us humans now is to win this war. Today, we won a great victory. Although we failed to kill Demon Sage Nine Abyss, it was forced to flee to the outer realm. It won’t be able to enter the human world again unless it possesses another weak demon.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Without Nine Abyss, the demons’ strongest expert in the human world is gone.”
“It will probably take 100 more years for another true demon sage to appear in the human world,” said Qin Wu happily. “This is a turning point! It’s a turning point for the entire war. From now on, the million-strong demon army will no longer be of any use. They also no longer have a true demon sage in the human world! Hahaha... life will be much better in the future.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan was also excited.
The strongest demon expert and the million-strong demon army was gone. That drastically reduced the demons’ threat towards humans.
“Let’s go.”
The master-disciple duo soared toward the sky, passing through layers of soil and rocks. Soon, they flew out of the ground and headed towards Jiang State Capital.

chapters.title: Chapter 406 - Hope
chapters.content:
Chapter 406 Hope
Demon Realm.
Ice Palace floated high in the sky. Emperor Roc brought Demon Sage Nine Abyss here. Lady Blackmoon and Imperial Lord Starquix stood side by side as they coldly glared at Nine Abyss In particular, Starquix’s aura was weak; his unstable aura spread out in all directions, affecting Nine Abyss.
“I’m useless. I failed to kill Meng Chuan,” said Nine Abyss as he knelt in horror.
His rationality told him that the three Imperial Lords would not kill him to prevent so that the other demon sages wouldn’t be disheartened. However, he was afraid of what would happen when things didn’t go as expected! He knew how important this matter was to the Imperial Lords.
“You are a demon sage that has cultivated for many years. Furthermore, you have a Tribulation treasure. However, you couldn’t even kill a Regis Godfiend?” said Lady Blackmoon with a sneer. “His strength is not inferior to that of a Creation Supremacy. He also has a Tribulation treasure,” explained Nine Abyss immediately. “Furthermore, his Essence Soul mystic technique is extremely powerful. It can transform into a black awl that easily pierced my Essence Soul. I lost 10% of my Essence Soul Origins as a result. I’m afraid it will take me 100 years to recover completely. With my Essence Soul heavily injured, my strength suffered greatly. That’s why I couldn’t do anything to him.”
It was very difficult to recover one’s Essence Soul Origins. For example, Meng Chuan had the Essence Soul Star legacy. It allowed the Essence Soul to self-cultivate; it also granted the Essence Soul an astonishing recovery speed. Meng Chuan only needed two years to recover from the Essence Soul damage that Nine Abyss had suffered.
In those two years, his strength would be in a “damaged” state. This was very dangerous.
For those that didn’t have the Essence Soul Star legacy, one would take decades to recover from the shattering of their Magic Awl. The Magic Awl deserved its name as a forbidden technique. If Meng Chuan had used 30% of his Essence Soul Origins to cultivate the Magic Awl, he would pay ten times the price for shattering it.
“Black awl?” Blackmoon, Starquix, and Roc exchanged looks.
“Magic Awl.” Blackmoon said softly, “It’s been a long time since I’ve heard of the Magic Awl mystic technique. Another Godfiend from the Archean Eon Realm has mastered this mystic technique.”
The Magic Awl mystic technique was once the most famous killer move of Archean Eon Realm’s Godfiends that traveled the River of Spacetime. Unlike the Essence Soul Star legacy —which suffered restrictions from the River of Spacetime’s laws-quite a few cultivators practised the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell. The Essence Soul Star legacy had an extremely high threshold. The Magic Awl Forbidden Spell didn’t suffer those restrictions. Most of the human world’s Godfiends-who traveled the River of Spacetime-cultivate this Essence Soul mystic technique.
Unfortunately, no one could cultivate it to perfection. Thus, nobody could make a copy of the technique manual. There was only one copy of the technique manual in the entire human world. The original copy was left in the Heart Sea Palace. It was something Ancestral Master Archean Eon had obtained by chance.
This terrifying forbidden technique was perfected by Essence Tribulation Eminences.
For juniors like Meng Chuan, although they knew how to use it, they didn’t understand the profundities behind it. They only knew how to construct the Essence Soul weapon and carve the runic patterns according to the manual’s description. As for why these runic patterns were constructed in such a manner? They didn’t know. Only when they truly comprehended it could their attainments in this mystic technique match that of the creator. Only then could they make a copy of the technique manual.
However, this forbidden spell had been obtained by Ancestral Master Eon Sea by chance. Excluding the Essence Soul Star legacy, it was the strongest mystic technique. It was suspected to be created by an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence. At the very least, it was created by an Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence. Thus, it was very difficult for human descendants to cultivate it to perfection.
“Even without the Essence Soul mystic technique, his strength is comparable to a top Creation realm expert,” said Nine Abyss. “Furthermore, his body is extremely powerful. He received one direct attack from me, but his body managed to withstand it. Also, his wife, Liu Qiyue... Her arrows were extremely dangerous when she cast Phoenix’s Nirvana...” Emperor Roc waved his hand. “Alright, you may leave.”
Nine Abyss was delighted.
“It will be as previously said,” said Lady Blackmoon. “The Eye of the Dark Realm will be yours to use until you reach the end of your lifespan. If you wish to leave the Demon Realm and enter the outer realm... you will have to return the Eye of the Dark Realm first.”
“I understand,” said Nine Abyss excitedly.
“Take your leave,” said Blackmoon.
“I’ll take my leave.” Nine Abyss immediately flew away. Although the Tribulation treasure was the least he could receive because he failed the assassination, Nine Abyss was rather satisfied with his gains.
“What a good-for-nothing.” Imperial Lord Starquix watched Nine Abyss leave and couldn’t help but shake his head.
“In order to make the demon sages willing to work for us, we have to bear with it,” said Emperor Roc. “This Meng Chuan’s body and Essence Soul are extremely powerful. His strength is comparable to a top Creation realm expert. Apart from his crude techniques, he has no weaknesses. He even knows the Magic Awl mystic technique!”
“There’s nothing we can do to him across a world,” said Lady Blackmoon. “With him around, us demons won’t be able to use our numbers advantage. Now, we can only rely on the World Gap and the World Entrances. As long as we can send large groups of fifth Firmament demon monarchs into the human world through the World Gap, we will regain our advantage. We might even be able to force the humans to admit defeat.”
“Yes, there are a total of nine Creation realm humans. Most of them are guarding super-large city passes and their sects. They won’t dare to move easily. Our fifth Firmament demon monarchs are enough to take down the cities and kill Regis Godfiends,” said Imperial Lord Starquix with a nod. Although the demon cultivation system was weaker than the Godfiend cultivation system, the demons were numerous. Therefore, the best among them were especially powerful. For example, some fifth Firmament demon monarchs couldn’t even do a thing to King True Martial. These fifth Firmament demon monarchs yearned to enter the human world so that they could obtain lots of credits and be bestowed treasures by the Imperial Lords.
“As long as we send them in, we will have the advantage,” said Emperor Roc. “However, it’s very difficult to send them in. First, we need to find a connection point with the human world. We need to find multiple connection points as backups. This requires one to have the ability to see the River of Spacetime. “Second, break through the human’s world membrane in a short period of time and quickly enter the World Gap. We must not be intercepted by human experts. After that, we’ll head to the World Gap and find the corresponding connection points.” They needed to determine the connection points between the human world and the World Gap. Only then could the two places be connected.
Emperor Roc said, “We still have to be careful of the humans laying an ambush. If we aren’t careful, the fifth Firmament demon monarchs will be wiped out the moment they enter the human world.”
If dozens of fifth Firmament demon monarchs were to enter the human world and ended up facing Supremacy Qin Wu, it would be a nightmare.
“It’s very difficult. Just a single mistake during the entire process will result in complete failure,” said Emperor Roc. “Once we reach the World Gap, we will have the advantage in strength,” said Lady Blackmoon. “I think there’s a 50% chance of this plan succeeding. If we fail again, we will have to place our bets on the World Entrances.”
As time passed, more World Entrances would appear. Maybe a World Entrance that could accommodate demon sages would appear. “Perhaps a World Entrance that allows demon sages to enter will never appear,” said Emperor Roc. “We can’t place our hopes on luck. Our greatest hope is still the World Gap.” “Prepare well,” said Imperial Lord Starquix. “If we fail again, we will probably have to wait centuries. We might never have a chance of succeeding ever again.” Emperor Roc and Lady Blackmoon nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 407 - Requests
chapters.content:
Chapter 407 Requests
Qin Wu and Meng Chuan came above Jiang State Capital. Under the night sky, Jiang State Capital was very lively. A dark-red world that looked like a ball of meat had appeared above Jiang State Capital. The terrifying waves had awoken many people. About three-tenths of the city’s population had seen the dark-red world floating in the sky with their own eyes! Some had woken up too late. After all, the battle had only lasted for about 24 seconds.
“What a huge meatball.”
“The dark-red ball of meat had many flesh tendons wrapped around it. It was really terrifying.” “From afar, I felt my legs go limp. Even a demon attack on the city wasn’t as terrifying.”
The entire city was filled with discussions. “Thankfully, the guardian beast intercepted the blow first. Qiyue and I fought Demon Sage Nine Abyss in midair. The Dark-Red Prison didn’t affect Jiang State Capital. It’s really fortunate,” said Meng Chuan while high in the sky.
“Demon Sage Nine Abyss only had one goalto kill you. Why would he care about the mortals?” said Qin Wu.
The master-disciple duo landed in the courtyard. Liu Qiyue and the stone ox beast were there.
“Thank you, Guardian.” Meng Chuan looked at the stone ox beast and cupped his hands.
“It’s my job,” said the stone ox beast.
“Demon Sage Nine Abyss has already fled from the human world. Guardian, you may return,” said Qin Wu.
“With the couple’s strength, they really do not need my protection.” The stone ox beast nodded slightly before flying off into the distance.
Meng Chuan looked at his wife. He could clearly sense his wife’s lifespan with his Seamless domain. His heart couldn’t help but ache. She had lost 89 years of her lifespan!
“It was worth it considering how we chased Demon Sage Nine Abyss away,” said Liu Qiyue with a smile.
“You saved the entire city,” said Qin Wu. “If Meng Chuan relied on himself, he would only be able to dodge. He wouldn’t have been able to threaten Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s life. It was your arrows that made Demon Sage Nine Abyss feel the threat of death. That’s why he didn’t dare continue fighting and immediately fled.”
Within Meng Chuan’s electromagnetic domain, Demon Sage Nine Abyss was unable to use the Heaven and Earth powers to carry out a large-scale massacre. However, the Eye of the Dark Realm could slaughter all living beings within five kilometers of Jiang State Capital instantly. It wasn’t difficult for Demon Sage Nine Abyss to kill millions of people within a few seconds. Luckily, Liu Qiyue’s arrows made him unwilling to stay any longer. If he stayed any longer, he would probably be killed after ten more arrows.
“It’s all because Ah Chuan blocked it,” said Liu Qiyue immediately.
“Haha, you lovebirds don’t have to be humble,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “However, the demons now know that you are guarding Jiang State Capital and might attack Jiang State Capital in the future. They will think of a way to force you to cast Phoenix’s Nirvana.”
Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue’s expressions were solemn.
Liu Qiyue’s normal strength matched that of a peak Regis Godfiend, but her defensive capabilities were inferior.
“We will immediately discuss it. Your arrangements will be decided in a few days. We will help you swap cities,” said Qin Wu. “Thank you, Master,” said Meng Chuan.
“Haha, this battle has caused too much commotion. It even tore through the world membrane. It must have alarmed Black Sand Grotto-Heaven and Two World Island,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “Besides, the demons also know of your strength. There’s no need to hide it any longer. We will quickly announce your status to the world. The Imperial Court will arrange for your official title conferments. A married couple being conferred the titles of king and queen... This is definitely a good story.”
Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue exchanged looks.
Very few couples in human history were both conferred the titles of king and queen.
“Archean Mountain won’t hide your contributions anymore,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “According to Archean Mountain’s rules, Godfiends’ contributions are to be publicly announced. We can’t let our meritorious members remain unknown. It was only kept secret because of the circumstances.”
Things could be kept secret for a while due to special reasons. However, it would be made public once they no longer had to hide it.
“Publicly announce our contributions?” Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue were alarmed. “You deserve to be praised by the world for annihilating one million demon monarchs single-handedly.” Qin Wu looked at Meng Chuan. “Also, it’s time to request what you want from Black Sand Grotto-Heaven. Black Sand Grotto-Heaven must have guessed that you are the mysterious Godfiend that has been carrying reconnaissance across the entire world.”
Meng Chuan fell silent.
The gentle figure in his memories had appeared in his dreams many times when he was young. Even now, although he rarely slept, that figure would appear in his occasional dreams.
“If you have no objections, Archean Mountain will directly inform Black Sand Grotto-Heaven of your request,” said Qin Wu.
Meng Chuan only said one word. “Alright.”
Qin Wu nodded and patted his disciple on the shoulder before leaving.
Liu Qiyue held her husband’s hand and looked at him. “Ah Chuan.”
“It’s been more than 50 years,” said Meng Chuan softly. “It’s been too long. I’ve been hunting demon monarchs all over the world. I really want to meet my mother. However, the identity of a Marquis Godfiend that guards a city is a secret. Marquis Godfiends have to hide their identities carefully. Once they are exposed, they will quickly be swapped to another city. I could only put up with it.
“After reaching the Blood Droplet realm, I knew I had a chance of helping Mom return. However, I still had to endure because I needed to keep my identity a secret so that the demons wouldn’t ambush me,” said Meng Chuan. “Thankfully, I have a Tribulation treasure. Thankfully, I learned an Essence Soul mystic technique from the Eon Sea Sect’s treasure trove. We survived the demons’ attack, and there’s no need to keep it a secret anymore.”
“Everything’s good now.” Liu Qiyue looked at her husband. “Everything’s getting better.”
Meng Chuan smiled. “Yes, everything is improving. The human world is improving, and my mom can return.” “Qiyue.” Meng Chuan looked at his wife and said in pity, “Phoenix’s Nirvana is a forbidden spell. You can’t cast it so readily anymore.”
“I can still live for over 300 years. That’s longer than the lifespans of many Marquis Godfiends,” said Liu Qiyue with a smile. “I’m very satisfied with what I have.”
Meng Chuan looked at his wife and nodded. “I hope we end the war as soon as possible. Let’s enjoy the time that belongs to us.”
The couple had once said that they were willing to die on the battlefield together. At that time, they felt that their chances of victory were slim. They only hoped that they could spend their lives fighting together. Now, the couple saw hope of the war ending in their favor!
Black Sand Grotto-Heaven.
Bai Yaoyue, Meng Tiange, and Mi Yu gathered together.
“There’s news from Archean Mountain.” Bai Yaoyue sat cross-legged and said calmly, “They acknowledged that Meng Chuan is the Godfiend that carried out world-wide reconnaissance. He resolved the threat of a million demon monarchs. Back then, he helped the Black Sand Dynasty clear out the demon monarchs. Our Black Sand Grotto-Heaven promised that we would try our best to fulfill the Godfiend’s request. Even if we can’t fulfill his request, we will still give him the Dragonize Pool as a gift of appreciation.”
“Yes, satisfy one of his requests or give him the Dragonize Pool.” Meng Tiange nodded. “We made the promise. He’s making the request now?”
“What’s the request?” asked Mi Yu.
Bai Yaoyue said expressionlessly, “We are not to stop Bai Nianyun anymore. Furthermore, we are to allow Bai Yaoyue to head to the Great Zhou Dynasty and live with Meng Dajiang forever.”
“That’s all?” Mi Yu and Meng Tiange looked at each other and smiled.

chapters.title: Chapter 408 - Husband and Wife Conferred Kingship and Queenship
chapters.content:
Chapter 408 Husband and Wife Conferred Kingship and Queenship
“What do you think?” Bai Yaoyue looked at the duo.
“Junior Sister Bai, Bai Nianyun is your clansmen. This matter will naturally be decided by you,” said Meng Tiange with a smile.
“Yes, Junior Sister Bai, you decide,” said Mi Yu.
Bai Yaoyue’s status in Black Sand Grotto-Heaven was indeed very high. She had only cultivated for a short period of time, but she quickly surpassed her fellow disciples and became the strongest expert in the sect. She was ranked in the top three in the entire human world.
Creation Supremacies could live up to 2,000 years.
It was possible for Bai Yaoyue to reach the Heaven Earth realm before the end of her life. Her Essence Soul talent wasn’t bad either. She even had a very low chance of becoming an Imperial Lord!
With such talent, Meng Tiange and Mi Yu deferred to her at times. After all, for the next 2,000 years, Bai Yaoyue would be Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s pillar!
“If I were to hand over the Dragonize Pool, would you be willing?” Bai Yaoyue looked at the duo.
Mi Yu and Meng Tiange were stunned. “Hand over the Dragonize Pool?”
“Junior Sister Bai, this Dragonize Pool is unique. It’s exclusive to our Black Sand Grotto-Heaven.” Meng Tiange couldn’t help but say, “With this Dragonize Pool, most Dragon Divine Body cultivators have been willing to join our Black Sand Grotto-Heaven all these years.”
Mi Yu looked at Bai Yaoyue. “The Dragonize Pool is extremely precious. In terms of value, it’s comparable to a Tribulation treasure. Are we going to hand it over just like that?” Bai Yaoyue nodded. “It looks like the two of you aren’t willing to hand over the Dragonize Pool.”
“That’s not the case. Although this treasure is precious, it’s only for Dragon Divine Body cultivators. On average, a Dragon Divine Body cultivator only appears once every 1,000 years. Very few can become Regis Godfiends. The Dragonize Pool is considered a rather non-mainstream treasure. It has limited influence on Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s overall strength,” said Meng Tiange. “If Junior Sister Bai insists on handing it over, I agree.”
“Regardless, we will stand on your side, Junior Sister Bai,” said Mi Yu. She couldn’t help but say, “To be honest, Meng Chuan has contributed greatly to the entire human race. He changed the direction of the war. We shouldn’t cross him.”
The corners of the expressionless Bai Yaoyue’s lips curled up into a smile. “He also has the Bai family’s blood flowing in him. He’s naturally outstanding. Don’t worry. I’m not such a foolish person.”
Meng Tiange looked at Bai Yaoyue in surprise. “Junior Sister, what you mean is...”
“Let’s agree to Meng Chuan’s request,” said Bai Yaoyue with a smile.
“Junior Sister, well thought out.” Meng Tiange and Mi Yu smiled and began to flatter her.
“Do the two of you really think I’m such a selfish person?” Bai Yaoyue shook her head. “It’d be a huge loss to our Black Sand Grotto-Heaven if I give the Dragonize Pool to Archean Mountain. Doing such a thing will also offend Archean Mountain and Meng Chuan. It’s not beneficial to anyone. As for agreeing to his request... everyone will be happy.”
Bai Yaoyue said, “Nianyun and that Meng Dajiang are both mediocre, but Meng Chuan is different! He has contributed greatly to the human race and is worthy of our respect. However, more importantly, he’s still very young! From the fight, we can tell that he has long become a Regis Godfiend. Also, he has a fifth-level Essence Soul at the very least since he can injure Demon Sage Nine Abyss with an Essence Soul mystic technique.
“A fifth-level Essence Soul in his fifties, coupled with his technique realm?” Bai Yaoyue sighed softly. “Although I’m proud, I know that my talent is much inferior to Meng Chuan’s. In my life, I have a chance of becoming an invincible Creation Supremacy. However, I barely have a 10% chance of becoming an Imperial Lord.
“Compared to me, Meng Chuan has a 100% chance of becoming an invincible Creation Supremacy. Most likely, he will become an Imperial Lord.” Bai Yaoyue said, “Even if you don’t consider my feelings, you have to consider the sect. We naturally can’t cross him.
“Also, the most important thing is that this Godfiend’s mother is from my Bai family. My Bai family’s bloodline also flows in his veins,” said Bai Yaoyue with a smile. “With this relationship, he will not do anything too bad to the Black Sand Grotto-Heaven when he becomes an Imperial Lord.”
Mi Yu and Meng Tiange nodded.
“Junior Sister, you considered the future really thoroughly,” said Meng Tiange. However, they didn’t know about Meng Chuan’s actual potential! According to the Heart Sea Palace and the Battle God Pagoda’s potential rankings, Meng Chuan had the best overall potential! He had even greater potential than Myriad Sword Island Lord, Imperial Lord An Yang, and company.
...
On the third day after Jiang State Capital experienced the dark-red world’s descent, the envoys sent by the Imperial Court arrived. They arrived at Jiang State Capital on a bird.
The envoy team arrived at Meng Manor. Most of the Meng family members were in Jiang State Capital; only a few—3,000 peopleremained in Eastcalm City.
The current Meng family clan leader led the Elders to welcome them.
The Imperial Court’s envoy announced the imperial decree. His voice was loud as the Heaven and Earth powers within a few dozen kilometers rumbled. It could be heard anywhere in Jiang State Capital.
“Conferment?”
“The couple have both been conferred kingship and queenship?”
Everyone in Jiang State Capital was astonished. They stopped what they were doing and listened carefully. King Eastcalm, Meng Chuan! Queen Calmmoon, Liu Qiyue!
In human history, it was rare for a couple to be conferred the titles of king and queen simultaneously.
“I’ve never heard of a couple becoming Regis Godfiends.”
“Did you hear? According to the decree, King Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, contributed greatly to humanity. He killed over one million demon monarchs alone. Is that true? Did I hear wrongly?” “You didn’t hear anything wrong. The decree said: ‘slew one million demon monarchs.’ In the past, a single demon monarch was enough to slaughter county cities. King Eastcalm actually killed so many demon monarchs. How terrifying.” “Amazing.” “Didn’t they say that after one million demon monarchs entered the world, they would slaughter everyone? Now, King Eastcalm has killed over one million demon monarchs alone. Haha, I believe the demons will soon be defeated.”
Jiang State Capital was filled with discussions.
News of the couple being conferred kingship and queenship quickly spread across the world. News spread among the Godfiends extremely quickly! Before the Great Zhou Dynasty publicly announced their Regis Godfiend titles, news had already spread among the Godfiends.
A white-robed woman rushed to meet Bai Nianyun. “Sister Nianyun.”
“Senior Sister Liu,” said Bai Nianyun politely.
“Did you hear? A joyous matter has happened. We aren’t far from victory in this war,” said the white-robed woman excitedly.
Bai Nianyun revealed a look of delight as she asked excitedly, “We aren’t far from victory? What happened?”
The white-robed woman said, “The demons spared no expense in ambushing Marquis Eastcalm, Meng Chuan. They sent a demon sage to assassinate him. However, Marquis Eastcalm-Meng Chuan—and his wife have long become Regis Godfiends! Furthermore, they have the strength to fight someone a level above them. The two of them joined forces to fend off the demon sage. To their Godfiends, Archean Mountain has already acknowledged that Meng Chuan and his wife have long become Regis Godfiends. Meng Chuan has killed over one million demon monarchs! He’s also about to kill all the demon monarchs in the world. This was why the demon monarchs were desperate to kill him.”Bai Nianyun listened in a daze.
Her son, Meng Chuan? He killed over a million demon monarchs? They weren’t far from winning this war?
“I’m quite well-informed. I reckon all the Godfiends in the world will know in a day,” said the white-robed woman excitedly. “It’s a joyous occasion. How long have we waited for this day?” Bai Nianyun nodded gently. “We’ve waited a long time indeed.” The white-robed woman’s eyes were filled with tears. “All these years, so many fellow disciples have died in battle. Now, we’ve finally seen hope.”
At this moment, an avian demon envoy descended. “Holy Maiden, a letter from the sect.” The avian envoy respectfully handed a letter over.
Bai Nianyun waved her hand, and the letter fell into her hand. She opened it and read it. The letter explained the entire situation in detail. Bai Nianyun looked at the letter in disbelief. She read it over and over again, reading each word carefully... afraid that she had misunderstood.
As Bai Nianyun read, her tears flowed uncontrollably.
“Junior Sister, don’t cry. Now that we see hope of winning the war, you should be happier,” said the white-robed woman.
Bai Nianyun folded the letter and put it away. She revealed a charming smile. “I’m very happy. I’ve never been happier.”

chapters.title: Chapter 409 - Chunyu Family’s Revenge
chapters.content:
Chapter 409 Chunyu Family’s Revenge
Bai Nianyun thought about the contents of the letter. This letter that was personally written by Bai Yaoyue explained everything clearly. Black Sand Grotto-Heaven decided to agree to Meng Chuan’s request.
It’s really rare for Matriarch to bow her head.
Bai Nianyun knew Bai Yaoyue’s temper very well. Cold, emotionless, protective of her own... Although she was protective of her own but that only applied to the Bai family as a whole.
As for individual clansmen?
She only cared about those with strength and potential. She appreciated those with potential and groomed them well. As for those without potentialIn the eyes of the matriarch, they were mere ants!
The Matriarch’s temperament probably has something to do with the Grand Yin lineage’s heritage. One will become colder and more heartless as they progress further in the Grand Yin cultivation system. Only those with no future in cultivation will get married, thought Bai Nianyun to herself. Back then, her cultivation was still inadequate, so it was easy for her to be tempted. After she married Meng Dajiang and had a child, it affected her cultivation in the Grand Yin cultivation system. Although she had high talent, she improved extremely slowly after becoming a Marquis Godfiend.
CIIU.
However, Bai Nianyun didn’t regret it.
Back then, I risked my life to get the Matriarch to spare the Meng family, but she has never liked the Meng family. Now, for her to bow her head...
It’s really the Matriarch’s way of doing things. She values strength more. Meng Chuan’s strength has changed the Matriarch’s mind. Although she didn’t know about her son’s Essence Soul cultivation talent, she could discern his talent from the information she had received. He had become a Regis Godfiend in his fifties. He managed to fight a demon sage! Bai Nianyun knew what this meant.
His achievement of killing one million demon monarchs alone was even more dazzling.
We’re about to meet. As long as the defense swap happens, I can leave, thought Bai Nianyun in anticipation.
In a large city manor in a desert oasis.
Marquis Martial Yang read the letter in his hand. His expression was deep, but his heart trembled slightly.
How could this be? Meng Chuan is a Regis Godfiend. Furthermore, he secretly became a Regis Godfiend long ago? He can fight a demon sage? He killed over a million demon monarchs alone?
Marquis Martial Yang glanced at the letter. News of Meng Chuan’s achievements caused all the other Godfiends in the world to cheer, but Marquis Martial Yang panicked. This was because he had once plotted against Meng Chuan’s father.
The goddess he had pursued for decades had been obtained by an ordinary person. Back then, he had been filled with anger. In order to vent his anger, he had secretly taken action. However, because he was afraid of Archean Mountain, he didn’t dare to be too ruthless. Instead, he framed Meng Dajiang for a crime, hoping to use Archean Mountain to get rid of Meng Dajiang.
Back then, Meng Chuan was only a Great Solar Godfiend. Although I knew that he was talented and could become a Marquis Godfiend, I am also a Marquis Godfiend. Furthermore, he’s from another sect. I didn’t treat him as a threat at all.
Who knew that he would become a Regis Godfiend? Even a Regis Godfiend wouldn’t pose much of a threat to me since we are from different sects. However, he’s a Regis Godfiend in his fifties! He’s a Regis Godfiend that can fight a demon sage! He even killed one million demon monarchs alone. Black Sand Grotto-Heaven and Two World Island are greatly indebted to him. He has contributed greatly to the entire human race. Marquis Martial Yang panicked. There are many ways for him to deal with me.
Marquis Martial Yang regretted his decision. Why did he do that back then?
As a Marquis Godfiend, he had immense power. He didn’t pay much attention to the occasional ants he squashed to death. However, after plotting against Meng Dajiang, it backfired on him 20 years later!
Back then, I did everything cleanly. Very few people knew about my actions behind the scenes. The one who did the deed was Chunyu Mu. He was a Mirage Fiend that had reached the Realm of Dao. Furthermore, he has long been dead. Supremacy Yaoyue knows about this, but there’s no need to inform Archean Mountain.
The information can be leaked from two possible avenues. One: the upper echelons of Black Sand Grotto-Heaven-Supremacy Yaoyue and the others. If more higher-ranking people know about my actions, there’s a higher chance of a leak. Two: Chunyu Mu! Could Chunyu Mu have leaked the news to more people? Marquis Martial Yang thought anxiously. As long as he did something, he would always leave behind flaws. It would be difficult to cover them up now.
The imperial capital of Black Sand Dynasty.
Meng Chuan killed a million demon monarchs alone? He has long become a Regis Godfiend. He fought a demon sage, who’s above his level? A middle-aged man read the letter. His eyes were cold. Marquis Martial Yang, you probably didn’t expect this day to come.
My father’s illusions had reached the Realm of Dao. He did a lot of dirty work for you when he was alive.
