Just because he didn’t do a clean job with Meng Dajiang, Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s upper echelons learned about it and punished you harshly. You ended up venting your anger on my Chunyu family. Thankfully, my father had already expected this. As a Mirage Fiend, my father made contingency plans for the family clan. That’s how our family clan survived.
A Mirage Fiend at the Realm of Dao could change the memories of ordinary Godfiends and easily control mortals.
Therefore, the contingencies he left for the family clan couldn’t be easily detected.
My father has done dirty work for you several times. He also has some evidence against you. However, they aren’t concrete evidence. Furthermore, it can’t bring you down. Back then, you were harshly punished when the job failed. Not only did you fail to give the benefits you promised to the Chunyu family, you even took your anger out on my Chunyu family and suppressed us. You forced my Chunyu family to divide into two factions. Even the direct descendants have completely changed. My Chunyu family has endured for over 20 years. I originally thought I’d have to endure it forever. I never expected Meng Chuan to shock everyone with a single feat. He can fight a demon sage and kill a million demon monarchs alone. He’s really the most dazzling Regis Godfiend in the present generation. The middle-aged man’s eyes were filled with hatred. He immediately sat in front of his desk, picked up a brush, and began writing. He wrote to Meng Chuan.Before my father died, he left behind a personally-written letter. The middle-aged man placed the letter he wrote with his father’s personal letter. The two letters will be sent over together. Only then will King Eastcalm truly believe it.
However, he didn’t know that Meng Chuan had long known that Chunyu Mu was the one who had done the deed. However, he couldn’t do much since it crossed sect jurisdictions.
That day, the middle-aged man sent this letter through the Demon Annihilation Guild branch in the imperial capital. To prevent any leaks from happening, he didn’t use Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s channels.
The Demon Annihilation Guild was different. The Demon Annihilation Guild’s influence spread throughout the world. They had a good relationship with the three sects. The letter would be sent to Archean Mountain via the Demon Annihilation Guild before it was handed to Meng Chuan.
It costs 5,000 taels of silver to send a letter to King Eastcalm. The middle-aged man shook his head secretly. He was an ordinary Godfiend and was also skilled with illusions. With his father’s inheritance, 5,000 taels of silver wasn’t worth mentioning to the Chunyu family. However, the Chunyu family was already past its prime. Even the direct descendants of the Chunyu family had changed. One had to know that Chunyu Mu was a Mirage Fiend at the Realm of Dao. Furthermore, he had cultivated an Essence Soul. Although he had remained a Great Solar Godfiend due to his age, the Chunyu family was still prosperous for a period of time.
The Chunyu family’s previous dazzling status only served as a contrast to how sorry its present state was.
The middle-aged man became even more furious with Marquis Martial Yang. He wanted to pull him down ruthlessly.
This letter took two days to travel from the Demon Annihilation Guild to Archean Mountain. After another day, it was sent to Meng Chuan in Jiang State Capital.

chapters.title: Chapter 410 - Dealing with Marquis Martial Yang
chapters.content:
Chapter 410 Dealing with Marquis Martial Yang
At night, Meng Chuan and his wife ate dinner. “Ah Chuan, there are two letters.” Liu Qiyue placed the letters on the table. “They are for you.”
The two letters were not opened. In fact, for an avian envoy to give Liu Qiyue the letters directly meant that it wasn’t that important. If it was a top-secret letter, Meng Chuan would definitely have to receive it personally.
“Two letters?” Meng Chuan looked at them in surprise. “One is a letter sent from Black Sand Grotto-Heaven, and the other is a letter sent through the Demon Annihilation Guild? I wonder who sent the letter through the Demon Annihilation Guild.”
As the fourth strongest faction in the human world, the Demon Annihilation Guild wouldn’t easily send letters to Meng Chuan. One had to be a member of the Demon Annihilation Guild before they had the qualifications to do so. If they were mortal Demon Annihilation Guild members, they would need to pay 50,000 taels of silver to have them send a letter to Meng Chuan.
If they were Demon Annihilation Guild Godfiends, they would need to pay 5,000 taels of silver to have them send a letter to Meng Chuan. This was because the Demon Annihilation Guild needed to hand the letter to Archean Mountain; it would then be delivered to Meng Chuan. Archean Mountain didn’t want to disturb Meng Chuan randomly. Thus, they had set high requirements on which letters could be sent to Meng Chuan. Therefore, Meng Chuan was very surprised to receive a letter from the Demon Annihilation Guild.
“Black Sand Grotto-Heaven.” Meng Chuan flipped open the envelope he was most concerned about. He read the letter and revealed a look of excitement.
“Has Black Sand Grotto-Heaven answered?” asked Liu Qiyue.
“Yes, they’ve agreed.” Meng Chuan nodded excitedly. “However, they need to do a defense swap if my mom is to leave. Therefore, it has been decided that I’ll head to Black Sand Grotto-Heaven in half a month to bring her back.”
Liu Qiyue was also happy for her husband. “Ah Chuan, the wish you’ve had for years is finally coming true.”
I’ve been waiting for this day for more than 50 years. It’s been too long. The storm of blood had passed. When he parted with his mother, he was still a six-year-old child. Although he was a famous Regis Godfiend, Meng Chuan’s emotions surged. He couldn’t hide his excitement. I believe that Dad will be very happy when he learns of this news.
“Dad is still a Patroller Godfiend,” said Liu Qiyue. “He can’t leave his designated mission area.”
Meng Chuan shook his head and explained, “Right now, the three major sects are planning to reduce the number of patrolling Godfiends. They want the patrolling Godfiends to return home gradually. In half a year, there will be no need for Godfiends to patrol the world.”
“There’s no need for them anymore?” Liu Qiyue was surprised. “Even if you wipe out all the demon monarchs in the world, with so many stable and unstable World Entrances, demons will still occasionally infiltrate the human world. We will still have a need for some forces to patrol the world.”
“The demon monarchs that occasionally enter the human world pose a much lesser threat. Earth Net will also monitor them everywhere they go. Furthermore, I captured some threshold fourth Firmament demon monarchs as demon servants when I was busy conducting underground reconnaissance,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “These demon servants have been sent to Archean Mountain. Archean Mountain’s demon servant numbers have been greatly boosted. They just need to arrange for a number of demon servants to patrol the world.” These were demon servants that he personally selected from one million demon monarchs. “The large group of powerful demon servants will be of great help to Earth Net,” said Meng Chuan. “Archean Mountain plans to reduce the number of patrolling Godfiends by 500. My father is one of them.”
Meng Chuan opened the second letter. It was the letter that was sent through the Demon Annihilation Guild.
Oh? Meng Chuan looked at the two letters in the envelope in surprise. One was written with blood. It should have been written more than ten years ago. The other letter was recently written.
Chunyu Mu? Meng Chuan read the contents of the letter.
“What’s written in the letter that was sent through the Demon Annihilation Guild?” asked Liu Qiyue.
“Back then, my father was framed for colluding with the Skydemon Sect. Later, Master personally pried into heavenly secrets and traced the karma. Only then did he discover that Chunyu Mu from Black Sand Grotto-Heaven had carried out the deed,” said Meng Chuan.
Liu Qiyue nodded. “You’ve told me about this before. Since we were in different sects, punishing Black Sand Grotto-Heaven disciples isn’t under Archean Mountain’s jurisdiction. Furthermore, the three sects are working together to deal with the demons. It’s not good to execute them directly.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded. “Now, Chunyu Mu’s son has written a letter to me; there’s also a letter that Chunyu Mu left behind before his death. The two letters confirm one thing... Marquis Martial Yang from Black Sand Grotto-Heaven instigated Chunyu Mu into framing my father.” “Marquis Martial Yang?” Liu Qiyue asked curiously. “He’s a Marquis Godfiend from Black Sand Grotto-Heaven. Since we are Archean Mountain Godfiends, it’s not convenient for us to attack him directly.”
“Back then, when he failed to frame my dad, Black Sand Grotto-Heaven actually found out the truth and punished Marquis Martial Yang. Marquis Martial Yang also vented his anger on the Chunyu family. The Chunyu family has been in a tragic state in recent years. Now that they know that I’ve become a Regis Godfiend, they are immediately telling me about it,” said Meng Chuan. “However, back then, Black Sand Grotto-Heaven didn’t punish Marquis Martial Yang harshly. They clearly weren’t willing to kill one of their Marquis Godfiends because of my dad.
Meng Chuan’s eyes were filled with killing intent. “However, since he attacked my father, I can’t spare him.”
Liu Qiyue thought about it and whispered, “Kill him secretly?”
“My mother is about to return. There’s no need to fall out with them now.” Meng Chuan thought about it and came up with a plan.
“What do you plan on doing?” asked Liu Qiyue.
“You’ll know in a while,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. Meng Chuan naturally had the intention of killing a despicable Godfiend that had tried to harm his father.
The next day.
Bai Yaoyue handed a letter to Meng Tiange and Mi Yu. “Take a look; it’s Meng Chuan’s personal letter.”
“Meng Chuan sent it?”
Meng Tiange and Mi Yu read through the letter once and couldn’t help but look at each other.
“Meng Chuan made it very clear. He found out that Marquis Martial Yang was the person who attempted to frame his father. Marquis Martial Yang was the one who instigated Chunyu Mu,” said Bai Yaoyue.“How should we deal with the matter now that he has found out the truth?” asked Mi Yu. “Logically speaking, one should be sentenced to death if they attacked a Godfiend of the same race during the war. Even if we don’t execute him, we can’t let him off easily. However, Marquis Martial Yang is a Marquis Godfiend of our Black Sand Grotto-Heaven...”
“Meng Chuan’s intentions are very clear,” said Meng Tiange. “He doesn’t want to offend our Black Sand Grotto-Heaven, so he’s allowing us to deal with this matter. However, if we take things lightly and let Marquis Martial Yang off, Meng Chuan will definitely have a knot in his heart even if he doesn’t speak out now. This Meng Chuan has killed over a million demon monarchs, and he has such a strong killing intent. He’s definitely not an indecisive person. When he becomes invincible in the world in the future, I’m afraid he’ll settle scores with us.”
Bai Yaoyue nodded and smiled. “If he was indecisive, he wouldn’t have written this letter. What a cunning punk. He posed a difficult question to us. He wants us to decide if we execute or absolve Marquis Martial Yang of his crimes.”
“Then how should we deal with Marquis Martial Yang?” Mi Yu asked.
“He only has himself to blame for harming a fellow Godfiend,” said Bai Yaoyue coldly. “Summon him back to Black Sand Grotto-Heaven and use illusions to control him. Check if he has colluded with the demons. If he has colluded with the demons, charge him for colluding with the demons and execute him. If he hasn’t colluded with the demons, he will be punished to refine divine armaments at Fire Melting Grotto-Heaven until the day he dies since he harmed a fellow Godfiend.”
Mi Yu and Meng Tiange nodded. The memories of Godfiends that had condensed Essence Souls could not be changed. If news of them forcefully controlling Marquis Martial Yang for interrogation spread, many powerful Godfiends would be disgruntled.
If one had a third-level Essence Soul, it was impossible to interrogate them using illusions. At the very least, the current Godfiends couldn’t do so.
Black Sand Grotto-Heaven underwent a defense swap. Bai Nianyun and Marquis Martial Yang’s arrangements had changed, so they returned to Black Sand Grotto-Heaven the same day.

chapters.title: Chapter 411 - Meng An Out of Seclusion
chapters.content:
Chapter 411 Meng An Out of Seclusion
Black Sand Grotto-Heaven had beautiful scenery.
Marquis Martial Yang flew to Bai Yaoyue’s pavilion with a heavy heart. Suddenly, a cyan-clothed woman appeared. It was Bai Nianyun.
“Junior Sister Bai,” greeted Marquis Martial Yang politely.
Bai Nianyun glanced at Marquis Martial Yang and nodded slightly before leaving without a word.
She has become more arrogant after her son became a Regis Godfiend. Marquis Martial Yang snorted inwardly before entering the building.
After a while, Marquis Martial Yang saw Bai Yaoyue, as well as the illusory figures of Meng Tiange and Mi Yu.
Under normal circumstances, only Bai Yaoyue’s true body protected Black Sand Grotto-Heaven. Meng Tiange and Mi Yu had their Essence Soul avatars present, but it was very rare for the three Supremacies to appear at the same time. “Greetings, Master, Supremacies.” Marquis Martial Yang bowed respectfully.
“Marquis Martial Yang...” said Bai Yaoyue. Her voice was ethereal; it was like she had descended from the heavens. As Marquis Martial Yang listened to her voice, his eyes glazed over.
Bai Yaoyue was the most monstrous Creation Supremacy in the past 1,000 years. Her Essence Soul talent was rather high. She had already attained a sixth-level Essence Soul. Although she didn’t spend much effort on illusions, they were enough to control a Godfiend with a second-level Essence Soul for a short period of time.
“Let me ask you. Have you colluded with the Skydemon Sect and the demons?” asked Bai Yaoyue directly.
“The demons are powerful. There’s no hope of victory. I naturally have to leave myself a way out,” said Marquis Martial Yang numbly.
Meng Tiange’s expression changed when he heard that. He couldn’t help but ask, “Now that the situation has changed, do you plan on severing ties with the demons?”
“You want to help your disciple?” Mi Yu sent a voice transmission.
Marquis Martial Yang was a Halberd Hall disciple. Most of Halberd Hall’s powerful Godfiends were Meng Tiange’s disciples.
Marquis Martial Yang said numbly, “Although the one million-strong demon monarch army has been slain and there’s hope of victory, the number of World Entrances is still increasing slowly. The demons might still win. It’s safer to have an additional path of survival. Since the demons don’t have any evidence to oust me and the sect doesn’t dare to incur public wrath, Black Sand Grotto-Heaven can only interrogate me through illusions when they have no evidence.”
“Humph.” Bai Yaoyue’s expression turned cold.
Mi Yu sneered. “Shameless.”
Meng Tiange shook his head gently.
“What have you done during your collusion with the demons?” Bai Yaoyue continued to ask questions.
“I only revealed some information. Three pieces of information were of value. The demons were quite generous, and I received the rewards,” said Marquis Martial Yang numbly. However, every sentence came from the bottom of his heart.
“Execute him,” said Meng Tiange directly.
Bai Yaoyue and Mi Yu nodded.
No powerful Godfiend was willing to be controlled by illusions and have their secrets dug out. This resulted in public wrath! After all, most Godfiends were unwilling to reveal secrets to others. They only wished to hide them in their hearts forever.
This time, they had only interrogated Marquis Martial Yang because of Meng Chuan. Furthermore, Marquis Martial Yang had indeed plotted against a fellow Godfiend. Therefore, they forcefully interrogated him through illusions. This interrogation was witnessed by three Creation Supremacies.
Previously, the demons had the absolute advantage, and there was no hope of victory. Countless powerful demon monarchs-enough to blot out the sky-had constantly entered the human world. In the face of death and temptation, the human race’s upper echelons understood that it was impossible for all Godfiends to be absolutely loyal. There would definitely be a few of them colluding with the demons secretly!
With regards to this, the human race’s upper echelons were unable to carry out a large-scale purge.
This was because they didn’t know how many Godfiends had colluded with the demons. One-fifth? One-third? Without knowing the exact number, they didn’t dare purge their sects. Furthermore, they were afraid that their internal strife would result in countless casualties before the demons even did anything. This was probably something the demons were looking forward to.
Furthermore, as long as these Godfiends-who had colluded with the demons-were used well, they would still be part of their combat forces!
As long as humans carefully kept important information secret, Godfiends had to carry out their missions without openly showing their betrayal. They had to kill demon monarchs and protect humanity without making a fuss.
No matter what these Godfiends-who colluded with the demons—thought, if they were put to good use, they would still be serving humanity.
Marquis Martial Yang was secretly executed.
Although they didn’t announce his death publicly, the powerful Godfiends of Black Sand Grotto-Heaven knew about it. They knew that Marquis Martial Yang had colluded with the demons, and the evidence was conclusive. The three Creation Supremacies decided to execute him together.
Traitor. The loyal Godfiends were furious and disdainful.
I have to be even more careful. Those that colluded with the demons became even more cautious and had various thoughts.
Jiang State Capital.
Executed for colluding with the demons? When Meng Chuan read the letter, he could sense Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s sincerity.
Archean Mountain.
A spatial vortex appeared in a cave on a nameless mountain. A handsome youth walked out. He resembled Meng Chuan, but he was slightly more elegant. He was a combination of his parents’ physical traits. “Meng An,” shouted a white-robed woman immediately as she waited outside. Meng An looked at his sister and couldn’t help but smile. “Sis.”
“You’ve been in seclusion for too long. It’s been three months,” said Meng You.
“Didn’t I say that I’ll come back once three months are up?” said Meng An.
Meng You smiled and said, “I know. There are many things you can’t tell me.”
The siblings cultivated on the mountain together. Over time, Meng You realized how special her brother was.
Her younger brother was very powerful. She never knew the limits of her younger brother’s strength. Meng An, who was 23 years old, was already a Great Solar Godfiend. Furthermore, he had defeated other Great Solar Godfiend disciples easily on Dao Exchange Peak. A senior brother—who had the strength of a threshold Marquis Godfiend-had once sparred with her younger brother when he visited. He had also been defeated by her younger brother.
Furthermore, her younger brother had to enter seclusion every year. No one was allowed to disturb him during his seclusion, and nobody could find him when he did enter seclusion.
“Something major happened while you were in seclusion,” said Meng You as she looked at Meng An.
“What happened?” Meng An asked in surprise.
“Dad and Mom have become Regis Godfiends,” said Meng You with a smile as she looked at her brother.
What? Meng An was alarmed. Dad and Mom have both become Regis Godfiends? Since when did becoming a Regis Godfiend become so easy?
“Furthermore, Dad and Mom should have been Regis Godfiends for many years,” said Meng You. “Dad has been secretly hunting demon monarchs in the world, causing the demons to panic. The demons even sent a demon sage to assassinate him. Dad and Mom managed to fight the demon sage—who surpassed them in technique and cultivation realm. In that battle, the defeated demon sage fled from the human world. This news has spread throughout the world. Archean Mountain has also publicly announced that Dad has killed over a million demon monarchs alone.”
“He killed over a million demon monarchs?” Meng An was alarmed. “Dad did it alone?”
“Yes, this is public information. Furthermore, the imperial government’s conferment decree clearly stated his achievements. It’s absolutely true,” said Meng You, still amazed by her father’s achievements. “The entire Archean Mountain is in an uproar. Fellow disciples are often visiting us. You sure are good. You have been in seclusion the entire time. I’ve been pestered so much that I don’t even dare participate in the Dao Exchanges.”
Meng An nodded when he heard that. However, he thought to himself, Humans are faced with the threat of demons. Due to this calamity, an exception was made for me to become Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s prime disciple.
This was another great secret of humanity. Usually, those that passed the Samsara trial and became Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s cross-generation disciples were only normal disciples.
If one’s talent was ridiculously monstrous, they would have a chance of becoming Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s prime disciple. Meng An’s talent wasn’t that high, but as humanity was facing a calamity, they put more effort into grooming him. He would directly become Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s prime disciple. He would also be nurtured with greater effort. The trials that helped hone his strength were also more difficult.
If he could withstand the arrangements, he would rise to prominence. If he failed, he would lose his prime disciple status; his cultivation path would also be severed.He entered seclusion for three months every year. He would undergo the mysterious Samsara Tempering of the Heart. He would need to undergo it a total of nine times. This was also the so-called Nine Lifetime Samsara Tempering of the Heart. As long as he failed once, his mind would be greatly affected. He would suffer great obstruction as he continued his cultivation journey; his cultivation could even be severed.
Every three years, he would undergo the Myriad Spear Devastator Tribulation. He needed to undergo it three times. This also took nine years.
These nine years... were used to build his foundation.
Once he passed through these trials, he would have the strongest foundation in human history. He would surpass Ancestral Master Archean Eon and all his other seniors, becoming the strongest Great Solar Godfiend in history.
However, this was just the foundation building period. Meng An still had a series of arrangements awaiting for him after this. There were also matters that a prime disciple of Ancestral Master Archean Eon had to do. Meng An had to bear the responsibility. This path was destined to be difficult.
If he survived it all, he would be a dazzling expert in the River of Spacetime.
If he couldn’t endure it?
He would be left to rot.

chapters.title: Chapter 412 - Reunion
chapters.content:
Chapter 412 Reunion
Spring
Peach blossoms bloomed outside the city. The fragrance of flowers spread.
A sloppy-looking, middle-aged man with a saber by his waist walked in the wilderness. He chuckled as he looked at the majestic Jiang State Capital
I’m back. Meng Dajiang had stubble on his face. He had lived in the wilderness for three years and was used to looking sloppy.
Swoosh.
A figure flashed across the sky and landed in front of Meng Dajiang. It was Meng Chuan, who greeted him happily, “Dad.” “Chuan’er.” Meng Dajiang looked at his son proudly and smiled. “You’re not hunting for demon monarchs today?”
“Dad, as your son, I naturally have to receive you since you’re back today. As for the demon monarchs? Now that we’re finishing up, there’s no need to rush anymore,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
Meng Dajiang walked alongside his son in the wilderness road and asked, “Chuan’er, according to your letter, the first batch will only reduce the number of patrolling Godfiends by 500. There are only 800 patrolling Godfiends in the Great Zhou Dynasty, right?”
“There are 805.” Meng Chuan nodded as he said with mixed emotions, “In the past seven years, the Great Zhou Dynasty has sent 1,579 patrolling Godfiends. A total of 763 patrolling Godfiends died, and 11 were heavily injured, forced to return to their hometown.”
“Almost half of them died in battle,” said Meng Dajiang with a sigh. “During my Patroller days, I discovered that things were getting easier. It’s almost impossible to encounter a demon monarch now. Only when Archean Mountain announced that you were the one that killed a million demon monarchs did I understand.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded. “I broke through with my strength half a year ago. It boosted my ability to hunt demon monarchs by ten-fold. That was how I managed to clear out all the demon monarchs in the world. I’ll probably be done in a few more months.” “As your father, I’ve leeched some benefits off from you,” said Meng Dajiang with a smile. “If it weren’t for you, I’m afraid that the Patroller Godfiends wouldn’t have been able to retreat for decades.”
“The losses are too severe,” said Meng Chuan. “The Great Yue Dynasty and Black Sand Dynasty have suffered more losses than us. Over half of the patrolling Godfiends in the world have died in just seven years. If this continues for another ten years, they will mostly be dead. I even think that if I had broken through earlier, not so many patrolling Godfiends would’ve died.”
Meng Dajiang patted his son’s shoulder and said with a smile, “Things don’t go as we wish in this world. You are already very outstanding. Since the Patrollers made their choice, they were prepared. Although many died, they saved billions of lives.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Yea.”
If it weren’t for Godfiends and demon monarch servants patrolling the world, the million demon monarchs would have slaughtered most of the mortals in the world. Since they allowed the demon monarchs to hunt down humans, although Meng Chuan’s reconnaissance was effective, he couldn’t split himself up. The number of deaths would have been unimaginable.
Only with the deterrence of the Patroller Godfiends could they minimize the losses.
“By the way, you said that you would fetch your mother on 8th April?” Meng Dajiang looked at his son. “Has Black Sand Grotto-Heaven really agreed to your request?”
“They’ve agreed,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “Don’t worry. The three Supremacies from Black Sand Grotto-Heaven have agreed and sent a letter. It’s impossible for them to go back on their word.”
Meng Dajiang nodded.
“Before we go, Dad, you have to tidy up yourself.” Meng Chuan couldn’t help but say, “You’re too sloppy.” “This...” Meng Dajiang looked at himself and laughed. “I really don’t think too much about my appearance when I’m alone in the wilderness. I do need to trim myself.”
8th April Meng Dajiang had lost a lot of weight. He was more muscular and looked much younger. Furthermore, as a Great Solar Body Tempering Godfiend, Meng Dajiang looked like he was in his thirties.
Swoosh!
Meng Dajiang and Meng Chuan flew at high speed through the clouds, heading straight for Black Sand Grotto-Heaven.
“Dad, you look much younger now,” said Meng Chuan with a smile as he turned to look at his father.
“It’s not much different from back then, right?” asked Meng Dajiang.
“Almost identical,” evaluated Meng Chuan.
His figure and appearance were very similar. His temperament was calm and restrained. The lonely Patroller days were also a form of training for his father.
“That’s good.” Meng Dajiang nodded. He was clearly nervous. The thing he yearned for the most in his life was to meet his wife, Bai Nianyun. He originally thought it would be an eternal regret, but now that it was about to be realized, he was extremely excited.
“Right ahead.” Meng Chuan immediately saw two figures standing at the foot of one of the mountains in the distance.
Whoosh.
The father and son landed.
Meng Dajiang’s gaze landed on the cyan-clothed woman in the distance.
The cyan-clothed woman looked at Meng Dajiang with tears in her eyes.
Meng Dajiang wasn’t fat anymore. He looked quite similar to the time he separated from his wife back then.
Bai Nianyun was stronger, but due to her 300-hundred-year lifespan as a Marquis Godfiend, her appearance hadn’t changed much. Only her aura was colder than before.
As they looked at each other, an influx of old memories surged into their minds.
Back then, they had met, interacted with each other, fallen in love, married, and had a son... They would never forget their lovey-dovey days. Due to the demon massacre at the time, Bai Nianyun had no choice but to expose her identity to fend them off, causing them to be separated.
Bai Nianyun looked at her husband. “Dajiang.”
“Nianyun.” Meng Dajiang ran over excitedly.
It had been over 50 years.
The couple stared at each other.
“Humph.” The illusory figure by the side snorted coldly.
Bai Nianyun recovered from her intense emotions. She immediately pulled Meng Dajiang and said respectfully, “Dajiang, this is our Bai family’s matriarch. Hurry up and greet her.”
Meng Dajiang bowed respectfully. “Greetings, Matriarch.”
The illusory Bai Yaoyue looked younger than Bai Nianyun, but her cold aura made the heart of Meng Dajiang-a Great Solar Godfiendtremble.
“You are Meng Chuan?” Bai Yaoyue couldn’t be bothered to look at the couple. Instead, she looked at Meng Chuan.
“Greetings, Supremacy Yaoyue.” Meng Chuan bowed.
“You have contributed greatly to humanity by killing one million demon monarchs.” Bai Yaoyue nodded in satisfaction. “It’s been a long time since I’ve seen such an outstanding junior Godfiend. Cultivate well and enter the Creation realm as soon as possible. The demons won’t stop so easily.”
“Yes,” replied Meng Chuan politely.
The other party was an expert that matched his master and Supremacy Li Guan. As his mother’s matriarch, he had to be polite. Of course, it was also because of her that his parents could reunite.
If Bai Yaoyue didn’t allow his parents to reunite, Meng Chuan wouldn’t have been that nice. In the future, he would’ve forcefully brought his mother back when he got stronger.
Since Black Sand Grotto-Heaven was now sincere, and on his good side, it wasn’t good to be rude.“As for the two of you?” Bai Yaoyue coldly stared at Bai Nianyun and Meng Dajiang.
“Matriarch.” Bai Nianyun was extremely respectful. Meng Dajiang lowered his head to listen to her lecture.
“One is weak, while the other is stupid. You value your so-called love and don’t care about cultivation at all. You wasted a lot of the Grand Yin lineage’s resources,” said Bai Yaoyue with a sneer. “It’s only because Meng Chuan has contributed greatly to humanity that our Black Sand Grotto-Heaven made an exception. Otherwise, with my temper, the two of you can forget about being together for the rest of your lives.”
Bai Nianyun and Meng Dajiang listened to the lecture and didn’t retort.
“It’s frustrating to see the two of you.” Bai Yaoyue waved her sleeve and turned to leave. Her illusory figure disappeared into the vast mountain range. “Let’s go,” said Meng Dajiang with a smile.
Bai Nianyun looked at her husband. “Are you not angry by what the Matriarch said?”
“We’re already together. It’s nothing to let her say a few words.” Meng Dajiang smiled happily. He was indeed extremely happy today.
Meng Chuan watched from the side. After seeing how intimate his parents were, he felt like he had become an outsider.

chapters.title: Chapter 413 - Sweeping Clean the World (Final Chapter of Volume)
chapters.content:
Chapter 413 Sweeping Clean the World (Final Chapter of Volume)
Bai Nianyun finally turned to look at Meng Chuan. She nervously cried out, “Chuan’er?”
When they parted, Meng Chuan was only six years old. He was now a famous Regis Godfiend. Furthermore, he had contributed outstandingly to the human race. Even Creation Supremacies treated him with utmost politeness.
How should she interact with her son? What if her son was distant? What was she to do? After all, she had left when her child was six. It had been over 50 years since they last met face-to-face.
“Mom,” shouted Meng Chuan with a smile. This cry of “mom” completely dispelled Bai Nianyun’s dilemma. She couldn’t help but walk over and hug her son tightly. All these years, she had missed her son so much. When her son got married, she couldn’t help but head over, hoping to catch a glimpse of him from afar.
Meng Chuan was similarly agitated. His mother’s appearance was almost identical to his memories. The way she looked at him... was still as gentle as before. It was the way a mother treated her son.
No matter when, his mother would always be his mother.
Meng Dajiang grinned as he watched his wife and son hug. He had no regrets in this life!
In the following days, Meng Chuan naturally hunted demon monarchs as usual. He wanted to sweep clean all the demon monarchs in the world.
Swoosh.
He rode the Bloodblade Disc deep underground and transformed into a beam of light, flying at high speeds.
When he discovered a demon monarch lair, his electromagnetic domain naturally formed lightning. The lightning bolts reduced the demons to dust, and almost all the demon monarchs died. Only one bear demon monarch, heavily injured, escaped. It has the strength of a threshold fourth Firmament demon monarchy if it can withstand the lightning bolts. Meng Chuan took a step and crossed the void. He teleported in front of the bear demon monarch-who looked at the human that had suddenly appeared in front of him in shock. The moment their eyes met, the bear demon monarch’s eyes gradually glazed over.
A few seconds later, the bear demon monarch’s eyes regained their sentience. He was extremely respectful as he said, “Master.”
“Yes, take a rest.” Meng Chuan waved his hand and stored him into his Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead.
He had another demon servant.
It was very difficult to find threshold fourth Firmament demon monarchs. However, one such demon servant was comparable to ten or so ordinary demon servants.
It won’t be easy for me to find new threshold fourth Firmament demon monarchs after I kill all the demon monarchs in the world. I have to seize this opportunity.
In the dark underground.
“Demon Monarch Yu Cong.” An illusory North Sense glanced at the demon monarch in front of him.
Demon Monarch Yu Cong was a snake demon with pitch-black scales and green eyes. He was extremely respectful towards North Sense.
“Now that the situation is dire, we won’t be able to save all the demon monarchs. You are extremely talented and young. You have a chance of reaching the fourth Firmament. Therefore, you are specially permitted to hide in the grotto-heaven,” said the black-robed North Sense. “Follow me.”
“Yes.” Demon Monarch Yu Cong was overjoyed.
Everywhere in the world, North Sense secretly contacted demon monarchs. They were all demon monarchs that the demons’ upper echelons thought had potential. They were then brought to a small grotto-heaven.
A few days later.
Within a small grotto-heaven.
“There are more than 300,000 demon monarchs left alive in the world. We only chose 95 demon monarchs to enter the grotto-heaven,” said Demon Sage Fire Dragon after sighing. “We can only watch as the other demon monarchs are slaughtered.”
“There’s nothing we can do about it,” said North Sense calmly. “We have to be careful. This small grotto-heaven is our most important garrison. We can’t expose it. Therefore, we can only bring in a small number of third Firmament demon monarchs. All 95 demon monarchs that we chose are young and talented. They are the ones with the greatest potential of reaching the fourth Firmament amongst the 300,000 remaining demon monarchs.”
“Forget it.” Fire Dragon shook his head. “We lost too badly. We have no choice but to watch the demon monarchs die.”
“Do the Imperial Lords really not care about the 300,000 demon monarchs?” asked Demon Sage Deep Profundity.
“They absolutely cannot return,” said North Sense. “Once they return, they will leak information about the human world’s situation. Countless bottom-feeder demon monarchs in the Demon Realm will then know how dangerous the human world is. The casualties will be immense if they enter the human world. It will be very difficult for us to mobilize an army next time. Therefore, even if 300,000 demon monarchs are going to die, they have to die in the human world.”
Deep Profundity and Fire Dragon nodded slightly.
The bottom-feeder demon monarchs were nothing but ants. Although the number of demon monarchs lost made their hearts ache slightly, they understood the Imperial Lords’ decision.
“We can only hide now,” said North Sense in a low voice. “We don’t have the strength to fight the humans! We can slowly find an opportunity to bring a group of fifth Firmament demon monarchs from the World Gap. If we can successfully bring them in... We will be able to turn the tables. If we can’t bring the fifth Firmament demon monarchs in, we can only hide forever.”
“We will keep hiding until there are enough World Entrances. Once they are big enough, perhaps a sliver of hope will appear,” said North Sense. “We can’t place our hopes on luck,” said Deep Profundity in a deep voice. “We have to bring a group of fifth Firmament demon monarchs in.”
They had already infiltrated the human world through possession. There had no way out. They had to take a gamble.
“Where’s Thousand Cricket?” asked Fire Dragon.
“Thousand Cricket is cultivating in seclusion,” said North Sense. “It’s good at cursing and killing. It’s also good at karmic divination. Only the two of you have a chance of tearing the world membrane open to bring in the fifth Firmament demon monarchs.”
Fire Dragon and Deep Profundity exchanged looks.
Although the Imperial Lords supported them and rewarded them heavily, it was extremely dangerous to bring demons from the World Gap into this world. The humans would definitely do their best to stop them.
“Let’s wait. We’ll take action when we reach the peak of the fifth Firmament,” said Fire Dragon. If they were stronger, they might be able to tear through the world membrane up to 15 seconds faster. He and Deep Profundity had to make ample preparations before taking action.
Meng Chuan continued hunting demon monarchs all across the world.
Many demon monarchs died. Although they didn’t have much contact with each other, the demon monarchs knew more and more.
“We are constantly being slaughtered in the human world. They aren’t letting us return to the Demon Realm. They aren’t giving us a way
out.”
“The upper echelons of the Demon Realm don’t care about our lives at all.”
“Humph. At most, I’ll submit to the humans.”
“The three major human sects have agreed to let us live.”
“You are really stupid. Humans and demons have deep enmity. It’s probably a trap if they’re offering us a way out. If we are to fall into the trap, we would probably suffer a fate worse than death.”
Due to the large-scale hunting, the demon monarch alliance began to fracture.
Some surrendered. They surrendered to Archean Mountain, Black Sand Grotto-Heaven, and Two World Island.
The human Godfiends were very polite as they received the demon monarchs that surrendered and sent them into grotto-heavens. They were a free labor force! Those that were strong enough would serve the humans as demon servants. How good was that?
Some stubborn demons didn’t believe in the humans’ good intentions. They refused to surrender and tried their best to hide. However, 99% of them were slaughtered or taken in as demon servants by Meng Chuan in the following days. Only a pathetic number slipped through the cracks. They lived in constant fear, afraid of being discovered by humans.
When winter came, Meng Chuan finished sweeping the world clean of demon monarchs.
Demon monarchs became nearly extinct. The world’s peace gradually returned. People finally began living their dreams of a peaceful life. Final Chapter of Volume – Famous Across the World

chapters.title: Chapter 414 - You Have to Thank Meng Chuan
chapters.content:
Chapter 414 You Have to Thank Meng Chuan
One of the Great Zhou Dynasty’s eight major city passes-Snow Wind Pass.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Snowflakes fluttered in the sky. The people in Snow Wind Pass lived as usual. The streets were very lively.
As for the snow?
The residents of Snow Wind Pass were already used to it. As the coldest city pass in the Great Zhou Dynasty, the traditions here were very different from the rest of the world. Snow and ice had long become a part of the people’s lives.
“We’ve been in Snow Wind Pass for more than a month. It snows almost half the time,” said Liu Qiyue as she ate hot pot in the pavilion. It was bone-chilling outside, but it was rather warm inside the pavilion.
“It won’t take long for you to be sick of it,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “The snow here never melts.”
“At the very least, I think it’s very beautiful now.” Liu Qiyue took in the vista. “It’s still the same houses, trees, and soil. However, with snow, it looks completely different. It’s still summer in Jiang State Capital, but it’s snowing heavily here.”
SU
Meng Chuan smiled.
As long as his wife liked it.
His wife had been transferred to Snow Wind Pass. Among the eight major city passes of the Great Zhou Dynasty, only Luo Tang Pass and Sword Sovereign Pass were guarded by Creation Supremacies. As for the other six city passes, six of the strongest Regis Godfiends of the current generation-King True Martial, King Calm Sea, King White Elephant, King Swallow Mountain, King Snow Wind, and King Yamafire-originally guarded them. Among these six Godfiends, only King True Martial, King Calm Sea, and King White Elephant had reached the Grotto-Heaven realm. King Swallow Mountain, King Snow Wind, and King Yamafire were all peak Regis Godfiends.
As for the other Regis Godfiends, such as King East River, Archean Mountain Lord, Elder Yi, Patriarch Chu, King Luyue, and company, they were relatively weaker.
Of course, disregarding Luo Tang Pass and Sword Sovereign Pass, the other six major city passes were still important!
Each of these six major city passes could allow fourth Firmament demon monarchs to enter the human world. Currently, hundreds of fourth Firmament demon monarchs hid in the human world. Even if 2,000 fourth Firmament demon monarchs were to enter, they wouldn’t be able to put a dent in the human cities.
However, the demons had to consider their heritage! Considering the nurturing period for generations of experts, it was impossible for them to send all their fourth Firmament demon monarchs into the human world. That would result in a generational gap in their cultivation world.
The guardians of these six major city passes often changed. Guardian Divine Beasts, awakened ancient Godfiends, and Regis Godfiends of the current era took turns. However, most of them were still guarded by Regis Godfiends. Therefore, demons seldom attacked the city passes. Even with her normal strength, Liu Qiyue could easily guard a large city.
Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue looked up.
A beam of light descended and transformed into a dark figure. It was Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar.
Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue stood up. “Supremacy.” “Eating hot pot when it’s snowing? Not bad, not bad.” Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar walked over with a smile. “Get me a set of cutlery.”
Liu Qiyue prepared a set with a flip of her hand.
Li Guan sat down and handed a detailed map to Meng Chuan. “Meng Chuan, take a look.” With that said, he picked up the chopsticks and began eating
Meng Chuan looked at the map. This was a map of the entire human world. Many of the places were marked out in detail. Very few areas had depths deliberately marked out. Some areas were deep underground, while others were at extreme altitudes.
“These are the connection points between the World Gap and the human world,” said Li Guan. “I spent one to two months traveling all over the world. I marked out the connection points.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “They’re spread across the world, including the ocean. All the connection points are connected... They are like two rings that surround the human world.”
“The demons are at their wits’ end now. Their only solution is to send a batch of fifth Firmament demon monarchs into the World Gap. From there, they’ll infiltrate into our human world,” said Li Guan as he ate. “To send them in, one has to first determine the connection points in the human world. They also have to determine the connection points in the World Gap. Only by matching two connection points can they form a passageway.
“Currently, with what we have, our first step is to determine the connection points the demons will most likely target,” said Li Guan. “Then, we will lay in wait! Meng Chuan, your speed is even more astonishing now. As long as you hide in the shadows, once the enemy attempts to attack the world membrane, you can rush over as quickly as possible. You are fast enough to hold them back as they try to tear open a rift between the human world and the World Gap,” said Li Guan with a smile. “Once they are stalled by you, Meng Chuan, they will be finished.”
“Understood.” Meng Chuan nodded and carefully looked at the map.
“How far can you travel in 30 seconds?” asked Li Guan.
“2,500 kilometers,” said Meng Chuan.
“That fast?” Li Guan’s eyes lit up. He looked at the map and pointed to a spot. “I need you to be here often. From this central spot, there are the most connection points in a 2,500-kilometer radius. Furthermore, it’s also in the sea... It’s very likely that the demons will choose the sea as their infiltration point.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Alright.”
“Liu Qiyue, I’m sorry. You two are always separated,” said Li Guan apologetically.
“It’s more important to deal with the demons,” said Liu Qiyue with a smile. “If the fifth Firmament demon monarchs are unable to enter the World Gap, then humanity will have a long period of peace.”
By doing this, the demons could only place their hopes on the World Entrances, hoping that they gradually expanded over time.
Before their army surpassed the limits of humanity, the human world would be peaceful.
In fact, before the World Entrances exceeded the limits of humanity, they might begin to shrink and disappear. The two worlds would begin to separate from each other... and the demons would never have any hope of invading the human world successfully again. The state of World Entrances depended on luck. To the three demon Imperial Lords, they naturally didn’t wish to place their bets on luck.
“Meng Chuan, cultivate well and reach the Creation realm as soon as possible,” said Li Guan with a smile. “Once you do, you can refine an entrusted object and condense an embodiment, sending it everywhere it needs to
be.”
Creation Supremacies could condense Essence Soul embodiments.
Although Essence Soul embodiments didn’t have much combat strength, they could still communicate information urgently. It was much more convenient than using a transmission token.
As for entrusted objects, one could only personally refine them after becoming a Creation Supremacy. Therefore, many experts with fifth-level Essence Souls-like King True Martial, Meng Chuan, and Patriarch Yellow Oscillatecouldn’t refine anything to maintain their Essence Soul embodiments before they broke through to the Creation realm.
“I’ve only been a Regis Godfiend for a few years. It’s still early,” said Meng Chuan.
“That’s true. With your talent, you might attain a sixth-level Essence Soul first,” said Li Guan with a smile. “That way, you can directly condense an Essence Soul avatar.”
Swoosh! Swoosh!
King Calm Sea arrived at Archean Mountain.
“Greetings, Master, Supremacies.” King Calm Sea bowed respectfully to Qin Wu, Li Guan, and Luo Tang in Grotto-Heaven Pavilion’s garden. King Sword Nine stood beside him.
“The two of you, follow us.” Li Guan and company walked ahead. King Calm Sea and King Sword Nine followed behind in puzzlement.
They came to an ordinary room and walked towards the painting that hung on the wall. The five figures became smaller as they walked into the painting. Finally, they were as tiny as specks of dust as they entered further into the painting. King Sword Nine looked at the incomparably huge painting in shock. King Calm Sea was still relatively calm because he had entered the painting before.
From the painting, they walked into a hall before arriving at a square.
Why are there three new buildings? King Calm Sea looked at the newly-appeared Star Cluster Building, Battle God Pagoda, and Heart Sea Palace in puzzlement.
“That’s Star Cluster Building,” said Li Guan as he pointed at it. “Ancestral Master Archean Eon personally selected the precious manuals —which he obtained as he roamed the River of Spacetime—that were placed in there. They’re stored here because he thinks that these ultimate techniques are suitable for his juniors. There are a total of 98 manuals inside. All of them are extremely precious.”
Manuals left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon? King Sword Nine was excited, but King Calm Sea was puzzled.
Why haven’t I heard about this after all these years?
“Among these 98 manuals, most are Tribulation and Imperial Lord-level ultimate techniques. There are very few Creation-level manuals,” continued Li Guan. “These few Creation-level manuals are all extraordinary. Some Creation Supremacies might even have a chance of slaying an Imperial Lord if they reach perfection in them.”
Slaying an Imperial Lord despite being at a lower realm? King Sword Nine and King Calm Sea found it unbelievable.
“Archean Mountain disciples, who have reached the Dharma Domain realm, can choose to read any three manuals below the Tribulation-level,” said Li Guan. “Once you reach the Grotto-Heaven realm, you can read any manuals you want.”
“Yes.” King Sword Nine was overjoyed.
King Calm Sea listened in a daze.
I can read any manual inside? In the past few years, I’ve only obtained three Creation-level temporal arts from the demons with great difficulty. I wanted to obtain an Imperial Lord level ultimate technique, but could hardly get one. Now, I can read the Imperial Lord-level and Tribulation-level manuals freely?
King Calm Sea couldn’t help but ask, “Why are you only telling us about this now?”
“That’s because Archean Mountain didn’t have such things in the past,” said Li Guan with a smile. “You have to thank Meng Chuan. Meng Chuan obtained the Star Cluster Building with great difficulty and gave it to Archean Mountain. That’s why you have a chance of perusing these manuals.”

chapters.title: Chapter 415 - Ultimate Technique’s First Volume
chapters.content:
Chapter 415 Ultimate Technique’s First Volume
Meng Chuan obtained the Star Cluster Building and offered it to Archean Mountain? King Calm Sea fell silent.
The sect had already nurtured him with all its might. They had even bestowed him with Origins treasures.
If he had the manuals earlier; if they had given it to him earlier...
However, they didn’t have it previously...
“Senior Brother Meng is truly impressive. He doesn’t monopolize such a valuable Star Cluster Building. He’s willing to offer it to the sect so that we can study them and cultivate,” said King Sword Nine in amazement. “Such magnanimousness is truly admirable.” “It’s indeed impressive,” said King Calm Sea. His heart was still in turmoil.
If he had known earlier...
Why did he have to play the hypocrite with the demons?
Although the information he had revealed to the demons had only been released after careful consideration and didn’t affect the human race’s overall situation at all, it still caused the human race to suffer losses. Some Godfiends even died in battle.
King Calm Sea had tried to convince himself: The loss of a small number of ordinary Godfiends is trivial in this war’s overall outcome. As long as I become stronger, I’ll contribute ten-fold, even a hundred-fold more than them. As he suffered inner turmoil, he swore an oath: My fellow disciples, I, Xue Ting, will repay you what I owe in my next life. In order to win this war, I have to do this.
But now, he realized that his actions had become a joke.
Forget it. At the very least, the demons’ ultimate techniques allowed me to reach the Grotto-Heaven realm earlier. Furthermore, I figured out my killer move, Spring Autumn Tribulation. As for the future, there’s no need to give the demons any more benefits. Instead, I can give them false information.
“Go in and read through the introductions of every ultimate technique carefully. Choose what you need,” instructed Li Guan. “Once you finish learning the legacies, come out immediately.”
King Calm Sea and King Sword Nine immediately responded and entered. “Yes.”
Ancestral Master Archean Eon had personally selected the ultimate techniques in Star Cluster Building techniques. Every single one of them made King Calm Sea and King Sword Nine amazed.
Impressive. Too impressive. It’s much more brilliant than the demons’ ultimate techniques. King Calm Sea was extremely excited.
He didn’t know that although a Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence might appear to be only one step higher than a Sixth Tribulation Eminence, the difference was actually huge.
A Seventh Tribulation Eminence represented a legend! They represented invincibility!
This was because it was very difficult to find someone stronger than a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. For example, Ancestral Master Archean Eon had a long lifespan. He went to many places and had only encountered an Eighth Tribulation Eminence once. It was very unlikely for other lifeforms to encounter an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. Even if they did, they wouldn’t be able to “see” one. Therefore, under normal circumstances, a Seventh Tribulation Eminence was virtually invincible in the vast River of Spacetime. Invincible existences were able to obtain many more precious techniques.
This was also why the three demon Imperial Lords coveted Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures.
Two hours later.
After King Sword Nine and King Calm Sea learned the ultimate techniques, they were sent out by the Supremacies.
“I hope King Calm Sea can cultivate faster with Star Cluster Building’s ultimate techniques,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “Although King Calm Sea’s perceptivity is inferior to Meng Chuan and Meng An, he’s very close to becoming a Creation Creation.” Luo Tang nodded as well. “According to our estimates, he’s very close to attaining a fifth-level Essence Soul. He can break through at any time. Once he breaks through, he will become a Creation realm expert. It’s been a long time since our Archean Mountain has had a new Creation realm expert.” “We can’t rush it,” said Li Guan. “Let’s quickly get all Regis Godfiends to come to Star Cluster Building and learn from the manuals. Only five Regis Godfiends have learned from the manuals. It’s too slow.”
“We have to do it in batches,” said Luo Tang. “After all, when Regis Godfiends leave their assigned cities, we need to arrange for Guardian Divine Beasts to replace them temporarily. We have limited numbers of Guardian Divine Beasts... We can only send them in batches one by one.”
“In half a month, all Regis Godfiends at Archean Mountain will have finished studying the manuals,” said Qin Wu.
“Yes.” Li Guan nodded. Suddenly, he sensed something and turned to look.
“They are back.” Qin Wu revealed a look of delight. “King True Martial, Peng Mu, and Lunatic Yun have returned from the World Gap.”
Swoosh.
Soon, three figures flew over from afar and arrived at Grotto-Heaven Pavilion. They greeted the three Supremacies.
“Master, Supremacies.” King True Martial bowed slightly. Peng Mu and Lunatic Yun also bowed slightly. These two were Regis Godfiends that were famous 1,000 years ago. Their strength was close to King True Martial’s.
“When we were summoned, a treasure appeared, so it took us until now for us to return,” said King True Martial.
Li Guan smiled and nodded. “Haha, follow us.”
The three Supremacies brought King True Martial, Peng Mu, and Lunatic Yun to Star Cluster Building, allowing them to peruse the ultimate technique manuals.
Every batch of Regis Godfiends that perused the ultimate technique manuals was shocked by Star Cluster Building. They were puzzled as to why they had never heard of it before. Li Guan and company didn’t hide the fact that Meng Chuan had obtained the Star Cluster Building and offered it to Archean Mountain. This made Archean Mountain Regis Godfiends impressed by Meng Chuan’s selflessness. They were grateful for Meng Chuan for giving them the opportunity to learn these ultimate techniques.
King Calm Sea returned to the city in excitement.
I’ve learned three Tribulation-level techniques, five Imperial Lord-level techniques, and one Creation-level technique. They are all suitable for me. King Calm Sea couldn’t hide his excitement. Compared to these ultimate techniques, the demons’ technique is cruder and worse. In history, such powerful techniques were actually lost! Thankfully, Meng Chuan found them again. Meng Chuan has contributed to this era, but he has given several benefits to successive generations. King Calm Sea admitted Meng Chuan’s contributions.
These ultimate techniques would have profound effects on humanity’s overall strength over time.
King Calm Sea closed his eyes and began to meditate on the techniques carefully.
Night fell as time passed.
King Calm Sea frowned slightly, a hint of displeasure in his eyes. He was immersed in his meditation of an ultimate technique, so he naturally didn’t like to be disturbed.
Whoosh.
The black fog seeped through the door and window, condensing into a black-robed illusory figure.
“What’s the matter?” King Calm Sea looked at it coldly.
“King Calm Sea, you don’t seem to welcome me,” said the black-robed illusory figure with a smile.
“Humph, you haven’t been willing to give me an Imperial Lord-level technique of the Time lineage to this day. What’s the point of helping the demons when you’re so insincere?” King Calm Sea sneered.
“What’s the use of helping us?” The black-robed illusory figure laughed. “From the looks of it, all of you believe that there’s no hope for the demons in this war. Are you trying to cut ties with us?”
King Calm Sea frowned. “Speak. What’s the matter?”
“In order to express our sincerity, we demons are willing to give you half of an Imperial Lord-level technique of the Time lineage,” said the black-robed illusory figure.
“Half?” King Calm Sea looked at him.
“Half. It is an Imperial Lord-level technique of the Time lineage,” said the black-robed illusory figure. “As long as you contribute enough in the future, we can naturally give the other half to you.”
He waved his hand. A dark-red book appeared in front of him. “Learn it first. I’ll take it away after you finish,” said the black-robed illusory figure.
“Oh?” King Calm Sea took the book and flipped through it. At the same time, his consciousness seeped into the legacy.
“How is it?” The black-robed illusory figure looked at King Calm Sea.
“Interesting.” King Calm Sea’s eyes lit up. “The second half...”
“I’ve already said it. Once you contribute enough, I’ll give you the second half.” The black-robed illusory figure waved his hand and put the dark-red book away. He smiled and said, “Besides, it’s still early in this war. The World Entrances are still expanding. We demons still have a chance of winning.”
With that said, the black-robed illusory figure vanished.
Humph.
King Calm Sea’s expression turned cold.
What an ordinary Imperial Lord-level technique. Ignoring the fact that it’s only just half of it, even if it’s complete, it’s still far inferior to the ultimate techniques within Star Cluster Building. King Calm Sea snorted coldly. The Imperial Lord-level techniques in Star Cluster Building had been screened strictly before being placed there. When one cultivated them to perfection, most would be able to fight across levels! As for the Imperial Lord-level techniques given by the demons, they were just ordinary Imperial Lord-level techniques.
If you had come a few days earlier, I’m afraid I would have been excited and would focus on cultivating it. Now? Comprehending it will just be wasting my time.
King Calm Sea closed his eyes.
Within a small grotto-heaven.
These Godfiends aren’t as attentive to us demons anymore. The black-robed North Sense looked at the dark-red book in his hand. Although King Calm Sea didn’t contribute, we have to give him the first half of the manual first.
If we don’t provide him the other half of the ultimate technique, the flaws will gradually erupt. We haven’t shown our hand with King Calm Sea. We’ll use him once he reaches the Creation realm!

chapters.title: Chapter 416 - Taking the Initiative to Attack
chapters.content:
Chapter 416 Taking the Initiative to Attack
On an island in the south.
Splash! Splash! Splash! The seawater gently impacted the beach.
Meng Chuan walked barefoot on the white beach. From afar, a seabird flapped its wings and flew high.
This was where Meng Chuan lived in seclusion. There were many connection points within 2,500 kilometers of him. Furthermore, this place was far from civilization. In this area, it was extremely likely that the demon monarchs would try to enter the human world from the World Gap.
This southern island doesn’t snow all year. The Snow Wind Pass, which Qiyue guards, often snows. Meng Chuan smiled. He returned to Snow Wind Pass every month to accompany his wife. Although they were tens of thousands of kilometers apart, it took him just moments before he arrived there.
Huh? Meng Chuan sensed the transmission token signalling him to convene. Archean Mountain? Meng Chuan was somewhat puzzled. Following that, he transformed into a bolt of lightning that streaked across the sky and headed straight for Archean Mountain.
After five minutes of normal flight, Meng Chuan arrived at Archean Mountain and landed in Grotto-Heaven Pavilion. As one of Archean Mountain’s Sect Proprietors, he could enter many places directly.
“Meng Chuan is here.” Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang were already waiting. Li Guan pointed at a stool beside him. “Sit.”
“Master, Supremacies.” Meng Chuan sat down and smiled. “What’s the matter?”
“We plan on bestowing King True Martial a Tribulation treasure,” said Li Guan. “This matter is of great importance, so we naturally need your approval.”
A Tribulation treasure? Meng Chuan’s heart stirred as he listened carefully.
The Supremacies definitely had their reasons for making such a suggestion. Qin Wu explained, “King True Martial has been fighting in the World Gap for eight years. He has also studied the ultimate techniques in the Star Cluster Building for half a year. He has now broken through and reached the late stages of the Grotto-Heaven realm. His True Martial lineage already enables one to fight experts one level above them to begin with. Even though he’s a Regis Godfiend, his strength is comparable to Demon Sage Nine Abyss. He’s not a Creation Supremacy, but he’s much stronger than an ordinary Creation Supremacy. If he were to be equipped with a Tribulation treasure... his combat strength would increase greatly. He would be comparable to Demon Sage Nine Abyss when augmented by the Dark-Red Prison.”
Demon Sage Nine Abyss when augmented by the Dark-Red Prison? Meng Chuan was secretly alarmed.
If it weren’t for the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell, his wife and he wouldn’t have been able to defeat Demon Sage Nine Abyss—who had been augmented by the Dark-Red Prison.
King True Martial has attained such strength? However, on second thought, it isn’t that surprising
The Grotto-Heaven realm was divided into the early, middle, late, and perfected stages. The Grotto-Heaven realm was when one made a complete grotto-heaven. However, the strength of different ultimate techniques varied.
For example, the Star Cluster Building’s ‘Golden Lotus Descent’ was a Creation-level ultimate technique. However, after it reached the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm, it could slay an Imperial Lord! It was a heaven-defying combat technique.
The True Martial lineage was naturally not as heaven-defying as Golden Lotus Descent. However, it was also very powerful. After reaching the late stages of the Grotto-Heaven realm, the True Martial lineage allowed one to match a perfected Grotto-Heaven realm expert of a normal cultivation system. Even as a Regis Godfiend, King True Martial could fight Demon Sage Nine Abyss evenly. Meng Chuan nodded. “I agree. No objections.” It was a good thing for their side to have one more powerful fighter.
“Alright.” Li Guan nodded.
Meng Chuan was also a Sect Proprietor, so he had to agree if they wanted to bestow a Tribulation treasure to King True Martial.
“In the past half-year, the demons have not tried to destroy the world membrane. They are clearly preparing,” said Li Guan. “We can’t just watch them prepare to invade the human world.”
“What can we do when they have been hiding?” asked Meng Chuan.
His electromagnetic domain wasn’t omnipotent.
Small grotto-heavens could be very concealed. Therefore, Meng Chuan still couldn’t find the demon headquarters or the Skydemon Sect headquarters.
“We’ve thought about it,” said Qin Wu. “The demons are relying on a large number of fifth Firmament demon monarchs entering the human world. Once they infiltrate the human world, they will be in the shadows while we are out in the open. These fifth Firmament demon monarchs can attack anywhere! Some extremely powerful fifth Firmament demon monarchs can easily kill ordinary Regis Godfiends. They’ll definitely slaughter Marquis Godfiends.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
There were powerful human Regis Godfiends and many weaker ones. Ordinary Regis Godfiends couldn’t protect cities, much less Marquis Godfiends. In that event, the human world would face a great calamity.
“Since the demons aren’t in a hurry to enter the World Gap with their army, let’s enter first,” said Qin Wu. “Send the strongest Regis Godfiends to pursue all demon monarchs within the World Gap.”
Luo Tang added, “If more than half of those powerful fifth Firmament demon monarchs are killed, even if they enter the human world in the future, the threat they pose would be much lesser.”
“Kill them first. Kill as many as we can,” said Li Guan. “With the Star Cluster Building and the Heart Sea Palace’s secret techniques, we have enough strength to do so.”
“King True Martial will wield a Tribulation treasure. Furthermore, he has cultivated the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell,” said Li Guan. “He alone can dominate the World Gap.”
Meng Chuan nodded in agreement.
After cultivating the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell, King True Martial’s comprehensive combat prowess was extremely terrifying. “You can enter as well,” said Li Guan. “You have the ability to protect yourself, but you are still weak when it comes to killing enemies. Demon monarchs have different divine powers. The demon Imperial Lords will nurture the core experts to the best of their ability. Therefore, we have decided to have a Dao Protector, Wang Shan, accompany you.”
Dao Protector? Meng Chuan’s heart stirred.
Archean Mountain had two Dao Protectors. The Dao Protector, Wang Shan, wasn’t very strong in direct combat. “He has a sixth-level Essence Soul. Over the past few days, he has also cultivated several Essence Soul mystic techniques. He has also cultivated the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell,” said Li Guan. “When he works with you, he will first execute an Essence Soul mystic technique if you encounter powerful enemies. The two of you will be able to dominate the World Gap if both of you cooperate.” “Yes.” Meng Chuan immediately felt confident.With his strength and the Dao Protector’s Essence Soul mystic techniques, they would indeed be invincible.
“Peng Mu and Yun Jianhai will form another team,” said Li Guan. “Our Archean Mountain plans to send three teams into the World Gap. King True Martial will act alone. Your team and Peng Mu’s team will be enough to dominate the World Gap. Even if you encounter a special situation and are unable to defeat them, you should be able to keep yourselves alive. I’ve contacted Two World Island and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven. Their heritage isn’t as rich as ours, but they will also send five Regis Godfiends! These five Regis Godfiends... After they swear an oath, I’ll let them learn the secret techniques in Star Cluster Building and the Heart Sea Palace. Meng Chuan, do you have any objections?”
“It’s fine if they swear an oath.” Meng Chuan nodded. “I agree.”
After obtaining powerful techniques, the Regis Godfiend teams-one from Two World island, three from Archean Mountain, and one from Black Sand Grotto-Heaven-would have a huge increase in strength.
“I’ve also discussed with your master and the others that apart from the Godfiends participating in the World Gap mission, we will also open the Heart Sea Palace and Star Cluster Building to Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s Bai Yaoyue. She will also be allowed to peruse the secret techniques,” said Li Guan. “Of course, we will make her swear an oath in the Heart Sea Palace to prevent her from threatening our Archean Mountain. We are only doing this because we’re relying on her to deal with the demons in the future. After all, in terms of cultivation potential, she’s the best among current Creation Supremacies.” Qin Wu nodded and said, “For this war, we can help her with her cultivation. However, we will definitely make her swear an oath.”
“Supremacies, you have considered everything very well. I naturally have no objections.” Meng Chuan nodded.
“Alright.” Li Guan nodded. “Meng Chuan, go back and rest for a few days. You will probably set off for the World Gap within a month. The World Gap will probably exist for a long time.”
“Understood.” Meng Chuan’s eyes were filled with anticipation.

chapters.title: Chapter 417 - Going to the World Gap
chapters.content:
Chapter 417 Going to the World Gap
In the following days, Meng Chuan went to meet his parents, children, and wife. This was because the mission in the World Gap could take a long time to finish.
His parents were now very loving. Furthermore, the pressure in regards to defending humanity had greatly reduced. Meng Dajiang and Bai Nianyun weren’t assigned any missions, so the couple traveled the world together! Meng Chuan felt a little redundant after meeting them once.
His daughter, Meng You, was also rather outstanding. She wasn’t far from the Great Solar realm. However, his son, Meng An, shocked him. His son’s personality was especially steady, and his strength was astonishing
“Qiyue, you didn’t see him. An’er sparred with me and used seven sets of spear arts in a row,” said Meng Chuan. “None of the spear art sets have reached the Realm of Dao, but in terms of strength, they’re at the peak of the Darkstar realm.”
“Every spear art is at the peak of the Darkstar realm?” Liu Qiyue asked in surprise. She had not seen her son in a long time because she was guarding the cities and couldn’t leave her post.
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded. “It’s fine if one set of spear arts is heaven-defying. However, all seven spear art sets allow him to fight above his cultivation level. He can even kill ordinary Marquis Godfiends... He’s much more powerfu. than I was back then.”
Although he knew that his son had obtained Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s legacy, such a monstrous genius still shocked Meng Chuan. Furthermore, his son was very composed. He wasn’t proud of his monstrous talent at all.
“I’ll be in the World Gap for a few years, maybe even decades,” said Meng Chuan. “I’m not worried about the rest, but you have to take care of You’er and An’er.”
“Okay.” Liu Qiyue nodded. “I’ll write to them often.”
“An’er’s opportunities are extraordinary, but these opportunities are accompanied by trials
—which will temper him. Some trials can be very cruel,” said Meng Chuan. “If you find something amiss, write to Archean Mountain and summon me back. It won’t affect me much if I occasionally return from the World Gap.”
As a Sect Proprietor, he had a deep understanding of Archean Mountain’s heritage. However, he didn’t know what tests and treasures were contained in the best cornerstone treasure-Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s legacy. It was the most mysterious treasure hidden in the world. He only knew that there were many opportunities contained within. Even Tribulation-level opportunities existed. However, Meng Chuan also knew that these opportunities were accompanied by tests.
For example, he only knew about a portion of the opportunities available in the third treasure —Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven. As for what secrets the fourth treasure, the arm, contained, Qin Wu and Li Guan didn’t know either. This was a secret only an Imperial Lord knew.
Archean Mountain had many unknown secrets.
His son had the number one legacy.
“Alright. If anything goes wrong, I’ll immediately write to Archean Mountain and summon you back.” Liu Qiyue nodded.
Meng Chuan looked at his wife and gently hugged her. “It’s about time. I should set off.”
Liu Qiyue leaned her head against Meng Chuan’s chest and said softly, “We will be apart for years, maybe even decades. We’ve never been apart for so long.”
In the past, although he was busy hunting underground, he still came back at night. Even when he guarded the island, he would return to visit her every month.
The longest time he had been away from her in recent times was during the trip to the World Gap. Even then, he had only been gone for less than a year. However, this time they might even be separated for decades.
Liu Qiyue had mixed emotions.
“If we resolve the threat of the fifth Firmament demon monarchs,” said Meng Chuan softly, “preventing the demons from sending a large number of fifth Firmament demon monarchs through the World Gap, the human race will have a long period of peace. This mission has huge implications for the war.”
“I know,” replied Liu Qiyue.
She knew how important her husband’s participation in this mission was, but they still had to separate.
Moments later,
“I’m leaving,” said Meng Chuan. “Be careful.” Liu Qiyue looked at her husband. “Don’t think you’re invincible just because you’re in the World Gap. The demons have the numbers advantage; they also have robust foundations. They definitely won’t be easy to deal with. It’s never too much to overestimate your enemy.”
“Got it.” Meng Chuan nodded. “I’ll be careful.”
Swoosh.
He transformed into a bolt of lightning and flew south.
Liu Qiyue looked up. The snow still fluttered down onto the ground. She didn’t know when her husband would return.
Archean Mountain, Grotto-Heaven Pavilion.
By the time Meng Chuan arrived, King True Martial, Peng Mu, Yun Jianhai, and the Dao Protector—Wang Shan—were already waiting.
“I’m late,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“Haha, we came early.” The fat white-haired elder, Peng Mu, smiled and said, “The four of us have been staying in Archean Mountain for the past few days. We naturally got here earlier. Junior Brother Meng, you have given the three treasures-Star Cluster Building, Battle God Pagoda, and Heart Sea Palace-to the sect. It’s truly admirable. Generations of Archean Mountain disciples will benefit from it.”
“It’s great for humanity and for the sect,” said King True Martial with a smile. “Even we have benefited from it and learned the mystic techniques.”
“Amazing.”
The goateed elder-Yun Jianhai—and the Dao Protector, Wang Shan, smiled at Meng Chuan.
They were the four strongest Regis Godfiends in the past 1,000 plus years. King True Martial was the strongest. Peng Mu and Yun Jianhai also had peak Creation realm combat strength. Dao Protector Wang Shan had a sixth-level Essence Soul.
Although Meng Chuan was the youngest, the four of them were rather impressed by him! The services Meng Chuan had rendered were dazzling. At the same time, many disciples benefited from him.
“Junior Brother Meng, according to the plan, I’ll be with you,” said Wang Shan. He was dressed in black and appeared dispirited, but he had the strongest Essence Soul amongst those present.
“I’ll have to trouble Senior Brother Wang to take care of me when the time comes,” said Meng Chuan.
“Everyone has received intelligence on the fifth Firmament demon monarchs,” said King True Martial. “However, the intelligence also has its flaws. Over the past few years, many fifth Firmament demon monarchs have gathered in the World Gap. After a few exchanges, they have formed powerful teams. Some demon monarchs have made breakthroughs while watching the World Gap’s world-birthing scenes.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
He, King True Martial, Yan Chitong, and the deceased Xue Feng had experienced breakthroughs during their time in the World Gap. “There are hundreds of fifth Firmament demon monarchs among the demons. Of them, 190 have reached the peak of the fifth Firmament,” said King True Martial. “Over the years, in the World Gap, a very small number of peak fifth Firmament demon monarchs have taken the final, critical step. They have the strength to match a demon sage. Some can even become demon sages at any time. However, the World Gap can’t contain demon sages, so they can only temporarily hold back their breakthroughs.”
“It’s impossible for us to probe all of the demon monarchs’ improved combat prowess,” said King True Martial. “We can only probe a small portion of them. Therefore, there are flaws in our intelligence. We can use it as a reference, but we can’t trust it completely.”
Meng Chuan and company nodded.
King True Martial had been roaming the World Gap for many years, and he was the strongest. His words were naturally more convincing. “The World Gap is a great opportunity for us Regis Godfiends,” said King True Martial with a sigh. “Most fifth Firmament demon monarchs have entered the World Gap. In the past few years, many have had a breakthrough in strength. As for us humans... Most of the Regis Godfiends have to guard cities. Only a small portion of us can enter. The overall benefits we obtain are incomparable to the demons.”
“We have very few people. It’s too dangerous for weak Regis Godfiends to enter,” said Peng Mu. “On the contrary, we will only send those that are strong enough to protect themselves, even if they can’t kill the fifth Firmament demon monarchs.”
“Yes, before we enter, I need to remind all of you again to be careful of Monarch Peacock,” said King True Martial. “Brother Wang Shan can try using his Magic Awl against it. There’s no need to try other methods. If the Magic Awl can’t kill it, immediately flee when you discover that it’s in the vicinity.”
Meng Chuan and company nodded.
According to the intelligence gathered, Monarch Peacock was indeed terrifying. King True Martial had once fought with him, but he was completely suppressed. Thankfully, the True Martial lineage was extremely powerful, allowing him to survive.
Of course, now that King True Martial had broken through and obtained a Tribulation treasure, he had the confidence to deal with Monarch Peacock.
Among the human Regis Godfiends, only King True Martial had the confidence to deal with Monarch Peacock.“Are all of you here?” Li Guan, an illusory Qin Wu, and an illusory Luo Tang walked over.
“Master, Supremacies.” King True Martial, Meng Chuan, and company bowed.
“Set off now. Black Sand Grotto-Heaven and Two World Island will send their teams in today,” said Li Guan.
After a while, everyone arrived at the nameless mountain peak. With a wave of his hand, Li Guan shattered the world membrane with a rumble. He also tore through the World Gap’s membrane.
“You have to be careful.” Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang watched.
“Yes.” The five nodded.
Following that, they flew into the opening and headed for the World Gap.
