“These are the strongest Regis Godfiend teams that Archean Mountain can send,” said Li Guan. “I hope they can return safely.” Qin Wu and Luo Tang nodded slightly. They looked at the closing world membrane and could only pray for their safety.

chapters.title: Chapter 418 - First Meeting with Demon Monarchs
chapters.content:
Chapter 418 First Meeting with Demon Monarchs
Under the dark-red sky, five figures leaped out from an opening and landed on the ground.
I’m here again. Meng Chuan looked at the gold, silver, and all sorts of colorful gems on the ground. Back then, he had been a Marquis Godfiend. Although nine years had passed since his first entry, the World Gap was still slowly expanding. This formation process would take decades, even centuries. It was still in its nascent stages.
“Let’s split up here,” said King True Martial. “Everyone, be careful.”
“Yes.” Peng Mu, Yun Jianhai, Meng Chuan, and Wang Shan nodded solemnly.
Everyone was armed to the teeth. It was one thing for them to cultivate mystic techniques, but King True Martial had obtained a Tribulation treasure. Peng Mu and Yun Jianhai had also been given Imperial Lord-level weapons. There was no need to mention Meng Chuan and Wang Shan.
Their goal here was to kill as many demon monarchs as they could.
Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish!
The five of them split into three teams and moved quickly.
“Junior Brother Meng, my body is rather special,” said Wang Shan. “The body of a Dao Protector is used by generations of Dao Protectors through possession. It can resist the world’s limitations on lifespan, greatly extending the lifespan of us Regis Godfiends. However, it has a huge flaw. This body is too burdensome to one’s Essence Soul. The pressure on my Essence Soul is too great. I can only stay lucid for a period of time.
“My Essence Soul is at the sixth-level. I can possess a Dao Protector’s body. At most, I can stay awake for 120 years. Other times, I have to meditate or be in deep sleep. I’ve been awake for a few decades since I became a Dao Protector. I can still stay awake for over 70
years.”
Wang Shan looked at Meng Chuan. “You have a small grotto-heaven, right? If you let me stay in a small grotto-heaven normally, I’ll meditate in there. When you travel through the World Gap, only awaken me when you encounter enemies.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Understood.”
A Dao Protector’s time was very precious!
Their mission in the World Gap would last decades. If the Dao Protector stayed awake the entire time, the expenditure on his remaining time would be too great.
“Senior Brother Wang, don’t resist. I’ll put you into a small grotto-heaven first,” said Meng Chuan.
Wang Shan nodded.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan waved his hand and stored Wang Shan into his small grotto-heaven.
Inside the small Grotto-Heaven, Wang Shan sat cross-legged on the ground. He smiled and closed his eyes. The body of a Dao Protector is indeed extraordinary. It can greatly extend a Regis Godfiend’s lifespan when they near the end of it. Meng Chuan sighed. However, it is a greatly flawed method. At the very least, one needs to have a fifth-level Essence Soul before they can possess the body. Furthermore, they can only stay lucid for a short period of time. However, it’s impressive that they can break through the world’s limits on one’s lifespan.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan flew alone in the World Gap. He wore a mask and used his Seamless domain to isolate light. He carefully hid from sight.
The demons can also isolate light in the World Gap. They can’t be seen with the naked eye alone. Should I use a domain to probe? No, when the domain detects an enemy, the enemy will also discover me.
All fifth Firmament demon monarchs had acute senses. They also had domains that aided them in scanning their surroundings. I’ll take my time searching for them. Meng Chuan flew around the World Gap as he searched for fifth Firmament demon monarchs.
Most fifth Firmament demon monarchs in the Demon Realm had come to the World Gap. It was a rare cultivation opportunity. However, there were only a few hundred of them. After forming teams, they had split into dozens of teams.
The vast World Gap made it impossible for one to see everything with the naked eye. To search for dozens of teams?
It was quite difficult.
Fortunately, he had reconnaissance techniques. Fifth Firmament demon monarchs mostly come to the World Gap to cultivate. Very few of them are here to snatch treasures. Those weaker fifth Firmament demon monarchs have the self-awareness to not involve themselves in the treasure snatching.
As for those that are cultivating, they’re definitely watching the birth of the world. I just need to search for the phenomena produced by the birthing world. By doing this, I’ll have a chance of finding demon monarchs. Meng Chuan flew around the World Gap as he thought up a plan. However, I have to be careful. These phenomena are typically close to the outer realm. If I’m careless and I end up charging out of the World Gap, I’ll probably lose my life once I fall into the outer realm.
He flew around as he searched for demon monarchs.
He finally arrived at the spot where the world had shattered. There was no way forward.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
One side was the normal World Gap, while endless darkness was on the other.
At the intersection, purple lightning struck. Boundless purple lightning converged into a huge tree. Meng Chuan was still shocked by this scene. The huge, purple lightning tree split apart the black-white air currents, stirring up dark energy. The world membrane slowly expanded as the splitting of the heavens and earth continued.
The last time he came here, he was still a Marquis Godfiend. Now that Meng Chuan had reached the Dharma Domain realm, and had also studied the Bloodblade Disc and Star Cluster Building’s ultimate techniques, he gained new insights after seeing the purple lightning once again.
When I’m free, I’ll definitely paint the purple lightning again. After thinking that, he flew dozens of kilometers away from the fractured world.
He flew for an hour.
He saw a colorful bubble appear where the world had shattered. Purple lightning struck down furiously.
The colorful bubble spanned about five kilometers as it encompassed the horizons.
According to the intelligence provided by King True Martial and company, this colorful bubble is extremely dangerous. Once it explodes, everything within 50 kilometers will be destroyed. Even the world in this area will be destroyed. Godfiends and demon monarchs will definitely die. Meng Chuan looked at the bubble and felt a sense of danger. He immediately stayed 100 kilometers away from the colorful bubble. There were two sources of danger in the World Gap—the demon monarchs and the World Gap itself.
Many dangers appeared during the birth of a World Gap. This was also the reason why Meng Chuan and company had decided to cultivate in a certain place. They couldn’t go anywhere randomly! If they accidentally entered a dangerous place, they might lose their lives.
Since they were careful and cautious, they would rather hide far away when facing an unknown danger.
Half a day after Meng Chuan arrived in the World Gap He carefully scanned the area with his electromagnetic domain.
Huh? Meng Chuan looked at a distant area.
In the region, a demon monarch’s head appeared. It stared at the masked Meng Chuan with a threatening and warning look in its eyes.
Humans and demons were mortal enemies! However, in the World Gap, the goal of both parties was to cultivate and seize treasures. Therefore, they would only engage in battle when treasures were born or sighted. Typically, very few battles would occur. Otherwise, it would be very difficult for both parties to cultivate in peace if a battle ensued whenever they met.
This was a form of tacit understanding.
If one accidentally encountered the other party, if one didn’t wish to fight, they would immediately retreat and stay sufficiently far away from the other party. However, it was different this time. Humanity’s goal was no longer to cultivate or seize treasures. Instead, their goal was to kill demon monarchs-all fifth Firmament demon monarchs!
There’s a demon monarch team ahead. They’re studying the birth of the world there. Meng Chuan was delighted by the discovery.
The black demon head stared at Meng Chuan as an invisible domain swept across Meng Chuan. He was clearly waiting for Meng Chuan to retreat. At the same time, he sent a voice transmission to his two companions. “I’ve discovered a Godfiend. There might be other Godfiends hiding in the shadows.”“Do you know who the human Godfiend is?”
“He’s wearing a mask. I don’t know him,” said the black demon head via voice transmission. “There’s no need to awaken the other demon monarchs for now. It won’t be too late to awaken them if he doesn’t retreat.”
The three of them had to be on guard while cultivating. The other demon monarchs focused on their cultivation.
That’s not right. The black demon head’s eyes began to blur. His Essence Soul suffered a blow, causing it to be dazed. He found it difficult to stay lucid.
Essence Soul Star-Astral Wave.
The Astral Wave had a huge impact on a fifth-level Essence Soul. The fifth Firmament demon monarch-who only had a fourth-level Essence Soul-instantly fell into a daze. His mind became slow, finding it difficult to process information. His slow mind finally reacted. Essence Soul mystic technique?
Pfft.
A Bloodblade pierced through his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 419 - In a Daze
chapters.content:
Chapter 419 In a Daze
When Meng Chuan released the Bloodblades, the Bloodblade tore out like lightning. The rip through the sky naturally alarmed the surrounding fifth Firmament demon monarchs.
They jolted awake from their cultivation and turned their heads.
The Bloodblade instantly reduced their companion’s—who had been struck by the Astral Wave-head to dust upon penetration. With a whoosh, four more Bloodblades pierced through the demon monarch’s body, completely shattering his body. A powerful fifth Firmament demon monarch died on the spot.
“Human Godfiend.”
“It’s a human.”
“Be careful.”
There were a total of nine fifth Firmament demon monarchs. After one of them was killed by Meng Chuan, the remaining eight demon monarchs quickly gathered and were on high alert. According to their experience in the World Gap, humans who dared to roam the World Gap weren’t to be trifled with. Even if they had the confidence to deal with them, they couldn’t afford to be careless.
“He’s here. It seems like he’s alone,” said a three-eyed toad demon monarch in a deep voice. An invisible wave spread out as he discovered Meng Chuan flying over at high speeds.
There are eight of them left! In reality, Meng Chuan’s current flying speed wasn’t fast. In a flash, he traversed six kilometers. He drew close to the demon monarchs because he wanted to use his electromagnetic domain to probe their strength. There’s no threat. There’s no need to summon Senior Brother Wang Shan for now.
“Let’s wait for him to approach before attacking,” said a black-furred lion demon monarch in a low voice.
“He’s tempting fate by charging over alone..”
“There aren’t many human Godfiends that can take on eight of us alone,” said a silver-haired demoness softly. She looked at the approaching figure in the distance, her eyes filled with cold killing intent.
Humans and demons were mortal enemies.
If they stayed away from each other in the World Gap, everything would be fine.
However, once the gap between the two parties narrowed, neither side would hold back. There was only one thing to do-kill!
“Attack.” The silver-haired demoness suddenly let out a silent screech. A gray rune appeared at her glabella. The Power of Essence Soul and demonic powers complemented each other, forming a strange sound wave that blasted towards Meng Chuan.
Divine power-Sound of Death. This was a sound that only an Essence Soul could hear. It was said that hearing the sound represented the arrival of death. It was a terrifying divine power that targeted the Essence Soul.
Regardless of how strong one’s technique realm was, one would die if they failed to withstand the divine power.
An ugly demon monarch-wrapped in a black robe-smiled hideously. His body suddenly withered. At the same time, a blood-red figure flew out of his body. The blood-red figure was extremely fast. In a flash, it traveled about 25 kilometers as it pounced towards Meng Chuan.
Divine power-Blood Clone. This divine power could control the enemy with his blood, turning them into an avatar. During this process, the enemy would naturally die.
Whoosh.
The black lion demon monarch opened his mouth, causing a black wind to blow towards Meng Chuan. The black wind was like countless sharp blades that sliced through the void. Wherever it passed, the void would distort.
The eight fifth Firmament demon monarchs had carefully selected the members of this team before it formed. Their abilities complemented each other.
Apart from their dead companion, among the eight remaining fifth Firmament demon monarchs, three were at the peak of the fifth Firmament. Even the weaker fifth Firmament demon monarchs had powerful divine powers that made them stand out.
In the demon monarch cultivation system, the fifth Firmament realm was the final stage of divine power awakening. These divine powers represented their talent; they were also their ultimate moves.
At that moment, the attacks that surrounded Meng Chuan targeted his Essence Soul and blood. Some were poisonous; some were strong winds, while the other attacks were domains and stingers.
If the eight fifth Firmament demon monarchs attacked simultaneously, even if one had reached the Creation realm, one might not be able to withstand it.
Swoosh.
Still flying, Meng Chuan was the first to hear the Sound of Death.
Sharp fluctuations surged into Meng Chuan’s sea of consciousness. The Essence Soul in his sea of consciousness slowly spun, emitting an ancient and eternal charm.
Bam!
The sharp fluctuations were extremely powerful, but Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul Star slowly spun and negated all the impact.
Meng Chuan frowned slightly. He used his movement technique to enter the deep void, causing the attacks that followed-Blood Clone, Tail Stinger, Poison, etc-to miss. Nine embodiments formed in the outside world as they charged towards the eight fifth Firmament demon monarchs.
“He entered the deep void?”
“Then many of our moves are useless against him.”
These fifth Firmament demon monarchs still failed to recognize Meng Chuan. This was because they had been in the World Gap for several years. Meng Chuan’s strength had been exposed only a year ago. Since they focused on cultivating and snatching treasures, they didn’t obtain any of the latest intelligence on Meng Chuan. Furthermore, it wasn’t easy for them to contact the Demon Realm. Thus, most fifth Firmament demon monarchs in the World Gap didn’t have the latest intelligence on Meng Chuan.
“Let’s go.”
“He’s hiding in the deep void and can attack us at will. Our methods, on the other hand, are useless. Don’t waste time with him. Hurry up and leave.” The eight fifth Firmament demon monarchs immediately made up their minds to leave. At the same time, they used various means to protect them as they retreated, creating an impregnable defense. Whoosh.
From the deep void, Meng Chuan suddenly arrived at the outermost layer of the void. He arrived in the middle of the eight fifth Firmament demon monarchs.
“Kill him!” When the eight fifth Firmament demon monarchs saw Meng Chuan suddenly appear among them, they couldn’t help but be enraged. All of them wanted to attack him.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The moment Meng Chuan appeared, he immediately unleashed Astral Waves.
Waves of energy surged in all directions. Essence Soul attacks were extremely fast. Before the fifth Firmament demon monarchs could attack, their Essence Souls had been struck by the Astral Waves. Instantly, three fifth Firmament demon monarchs lost consciousness due to the attack. Three other fifth Firmament demon monarchs felt dazed, causing their thoughts to slow down. Only the silver-haired demoness and the black-furred lion demon monarch remained conscious. The silver-haired demoness and the black-furred lion demon monarch were alarmed by Meng Chuan’s attack. It’s an Essence Soul mystic technique!
“It’s an Essence Soul mystic technique that targets a wide area! Hurry up and escape,” said the silver-haired demoness anxiously.
The Astral Wave was different from a Magic Awl. The attack originated from the Essence Soul Star—the only mysterious legacy that was restricted by the River of Spacetime. Unleashing Astral Waves had no side-effects. It was much weaker than the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell. Against enemies with a same-level Essence Soul, Astral Waves only affected their strength. However, Astral Waves could be used to attack all enemies in the vicinity. It was an area-of-effect attack, while the Magic Awl targeted a singular enemy at a time.
Therefore, after Meng Chuan entered the depths of the void and reached the eight fifth Firmament demon monarchs, he unleashed an Astral Wave...
Struck by the Astral Wave, six fifth Firmament demon monarchs lost the ability to resist.
Only two fifth Firmament monarchs remained. Although the silver-haired demoness only had a fourth-level Essence Soul, she had an Essence Soul divine power. She had extremely high attainments in Essence Soul mystic techniques and had extremely strong resistance against them. The other demon monarch had a fifth-level Essence Soul.
Pfft! Pfft! Pfft!
Bloodblades attacked the silver-haired demoness and the black-furred lion demon monarch, who were still conscious.
“No.” The silver-haired demoness wanted to burrow underground, but she was quickly penetrated by the sanguine light beam. Her body was reduced to dust. “Scram!” The black-furred lion roared angrily. Black wind surrounded him as he charged underground.
Pfft! Pfft! Pfft!
A total of 13 Bloodblades surrounded the black-furred lion demon monarch. The black wind around his body was extremely resilient. The layers of black wind weakened the Bloodblades’ strength by 30%. His fur, muscles, and bones were extremely strong. The Bloodblades barely pierced through the black-furred lion’s body, only leaving tiny holes. The lion demon monarch’s wounds instantly healed.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
With every cycle, three Bloodblades accelerated within Meng Chuan’s electromagnetic domain. The three Bloodblades traveled 50 kilometers around Meng Chuan eight times! Their speeds became even more terrifying.
I have to leave quickly. The black-furred lion demon monarch frantically wrapped the black wind around him and fled through the underground at high speeds.“Go.” The three Bloodblades—which had accelerated to the extreme-descended.
After the electromagnetic domain accelerated the three Bloodblades to maximum speed, the Bloodblades’ speed increased by 60%; their strength increased by several-fold. Not good. The black-furred lion’s heart chilled. A Bloodblade pierced through his chest, causing it to explode. His body split in two due to the explosion.
Bam! Bam!
His remaining body parts exploded one after another. Due to the demon monarch’s reduced resistance, the two halves of his body were reduced to dust by the two other Bloodblades. His vitality was wiped out.
If you were any more powerful, I would’ve used Magic Awl. Meng Chuan looked at the remaining six demon monarchs. Three of them collapsed to the ground and rolled around subconsciously. The other three were still in a daze. Their eyes were filled with shock and anger. It’s an Essence Soul mystic technique! Although they had come to their senses, they found it difficult to control their bodies. They staggered and lost their footing.
In a head-on clash, Meng Chuan was comparable to a Creation realm expert. Against a group of fifth Firmament demon monarchs, they could only be defeated by him.
As for Meng Chuan, he first unleashed an Astral Wave in the area, immediately decreasing the enemy’s strength by 80-90%. It naturally made the fight much easier for him.
“You are the first group,” said Meng Chuan softly as Bloodblades danced around him.

chapters.title: Chapter 420 - Holy Lady Strings
chapters.content:
Chapter 420 Holy Lady Strings
The three demon monarchs—who had unconsciously collapsed to the ground, rolling
– didn’t feel any pain at all. The sanguine light beams killed them. As for the other three demon monarchs, they were horrified and in despair. However, they found it difficult to control their bodies. All they could do was watch the sanguine light beams repeatedly attack them.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Explosions rang out again and again.
The bodies of these fifth Firmament demon monarchs are tenacious. Meng Chuan stood there watching the demon monarchs as ten-plus Bloodblades danced around him for 15 seconds before finally stopping.
They’re all dead. Meng Chuan scanned his surroundings. After all, they hadn’t even left a speck of dust behind after being killed. After scanning his surroundings, he was sure that they had actually died.
Meng Chuan walked over and swept up the items left behind by the demon monarchs with an invisible domain. Meng Chuan looked at the items and nodded slightly. Not bad. There’s also a transmission token? I reckon some demon monarchs sent out a cry for help before they died.
Whoosh.
He walked around the area and stored all the items left behind by the demon monarchs into his Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead.
The small grotto-heaven was completely isolated from the outside world. There was no way for the transmission token to make any connection with anything in the outside world unless his pocket grotto-heaven was like Black Sand Grotto-Heaven. Black Sand Grotto-Heaven maintained several permanent entrances so that they could stay in contact with the outside world.
Therefore, with his small grotto-heaven storing his spoils of war, he wasn’t afraid that the enemy could track him down, even if they did have a tracking treasure.
The first group of fifth Firmament demon monarchs yielded me nine kills. Meng Chuan was rather satisfied. His victims had cultivated for many years, unlike the newly-advanced fifth Firmament demon monarchs in the human world! They were much stronger.
He had to get rid of them as soon as possible.
There were naturally few fifth Firmament demon monarchs that could be sent to the human world directly.
From the looks of their strength, it’s a relatively weak demon monarch team in the World Gap. According to the intelligence provided by King True Martial and company, the demon monarchs in the World Gap have formed teams. These teams are split into two groups.
The first type has weak overall strength. They came to the World Gap to cultivate. They don’t have the strength to snatch treasures.
no
The other type is extremely powerful. They normally cultivate, but they also search for treasures in the World Gap! After several clashes with human Godfiends, these demon teams that have the confidence to snatch treasures are extremely powerful.
Meng Chuan understood this.
I encountered a relatively weak team this time. However, if it weren’t for my Astral Wave, it would’ve been difficult to deal with them. If it were a powerful team... it would’ve been even more troublesome. Meng Chuan had been very careful during that fight. Suddenly, his eyes flashed. I killed nine demon monarchs. Several of them should have requested help. Could a demon monarch team be rushing over?
I’ll wait secretly. If a reinforcement team arrives, I’ll fight them if I can. If I can’t, I’ll flee. Although he and Dao Protector Wang Shan weren’t invincible, they could protect themselves.
On the other side of the World Gap, a black-and-white pool appeared amidst the ruptured boundary of sky and land.
The black-and-white pool was clearly separated into two, like Yin and Yang.
Five demon monarchs were cultivating around the pool. A devilish woman dressed in a black veil opened her eyes. Not far away, a man as tall as a mountain opened his eyes.
The two exchanged glances. “That old lion from Black Lion Mountain has requested help from me.” The muscular man’s voice was deep and powerful. “Holy Lady, has it requested help from you?”
The surrounding demon monarchs stopped cultivating the moment he said that and looked at the devilish woman.
The devilish woman nodded slightly. “Yes.”
“Holy Lady, do we help them? That old lion is still very loyal to you,” said a white-furred rat demon with a beard.
The devilish woman stood up. With a whoosh, a black-skinned youth, covered in scales, appeared beside her. She looked into the distance, and calmly said, “Save them.”
A hunchbacked demon monarch stood up with a chuckle. “Then let’s set off.”
Huh? The devilish woman and the muscular man suddenly frowned.
“Dead?” the devilish woman whispered.
“The old lion died so quickly,” said the stocky man in surprise. “With its strength, it can hold out for a long time even if it encounters a newly-advanced demon sage.”
“It should be a rather powerful human Godfiend team,” said the devilish woman calmly. “Since there was a battle, it’s very likely that a treasure has appeared.”
According to past experiences, this was indeed the case.
Very few battles occurred in the World Gap. Otherwise, nobody could focus on their cultivation if they fought each other to death every time they met an enemy.
Battles usually occurred because of treasures.
“However, we have to be careful. To be able to kill the old lion so quickly, the human Godfiend team definitely won’t be weak,” said the devilish woman.
“Human Godfiend teams aren’t worth mentioning to us,” said the hunchbacked demon monarch with an eccentric laugh. The devilish woman took a glance and said indifferently, “Blood Shura died in the hands of humans.”
“According to Patriarch Poison Dragon’s intelligence, Blood Shura was killed by King True Martial and King Calm Sea after they joined forces. King Calm Sea can affect time, allowing King True Martial to unleash several-fold his strength instantly,” said the hunchbacked demon monarch with a strange laugh. “Blood Shura relied only on the powerful body of its Shura cultivation system. In terms of cultivation realm, it’s inferior to me, much less you.”
“Back when Blood Shura first came to the World Gap, it didn’t make any breakthroughs in strength. In terms of one’s physical body, I’m not inferior to Blood Shura.” The stocky man smiled humbly.
He was a mountain demon. He cultivated in the World Gap and broke through from the peak of the Dharma Domain to the Grotto-Heaven realm in one fell swoop. A mountain demon at the Grotto-Heaven realm had a more perfect body. He was much stronger than Blood Shura in a head-on battle. This was why the devilish woman had invited him to the team.
“Amongst all fifth Firmament demon monarchs, Holy Lady is the best in terms of technique realm,” praised the white-furred rat demon. “Patriarch Poison Dragon only relies on a treasure to transform into a poisonous black liquid, giving him an undying body. Its combat strength is inferior to that of Holy Lady. Even that peacock transformed after consuming a mutated beast’s corpse, making its body become stronger than many demon sages. In terms of technique realm, moves, and divine powers, they are inferior to you, Holy Lady. As long as you advance one step further, you can reverse your old age and become a demon sage. Peacock and Patriarch Poison Dragon have no hope of becoming demon sages. How can they compare to you?”
“Peacock is very strong.” The devilish woman calmly said, “Back when I dominated the Demon Realm, only it defeated me. Even though I’ve gained insights from watching the birthing world’s phenomena and my strength has increased, I still don’t have the confidence to deal with it. If I were to attain a seventh-level Essence Soul and combine it with my Essence Soul mystic technique, I might be able to defeat it.” She had sparred with Monarch Peacock many times, so she knew how powerful Monarch Peacock was.
Monarch Peacock and Patriarch Poison Dragon’s strength were a result of special opportunities.
As for this woman, she relied solely on her technique realm to possess such strength. Back then, she was inferior to only Monarch Peacock. As her technique and cultivation realm increased, she gained insights into her divine powers and created a demon sage-level ultimate technique.
This woman was the demons’ Holy Lady Strings.
The World Gap was a dream come true for her, considering her extremely high perception.
Whoosh.
The five of them rushed over.Ripples appeared in the void, affecting Holy Lady String and the others in a 50-kilometer radius.
After a short while, they traveled over 1,500 kilometers.
“In front of us is the area where the old lion died. No matter what opponent we face, we have to be careful,” said the devilish woman indifferently.
“Yes.” Her four companions were extremely obedient. With their pride, the only fifth Firmament demon monarchs that could make them humble were Monarch Peacock and Holy Lady Strings.
Huh? Ripples appeared in the void as they swept across a corner, colliding with Meng Chuan’s electromagnetic domain.
Meng Chuan had waited in hiding. He wanted to see how strong the reinforcement demon monarchs were. If he couldn’t afford to offend them, he would flee. If he could attack, he would try.
Lightning? The devilish woman turned her head. The void ripples immediately spread out in Meng Chuan’s direction, revealing the hidden Meng Chuan.
Holy Lady Strings? Meng Chuan’s pupils constricted when he saw the devilish woman. According to the intelligence, the fifth Firmament demon monarchs ranked in terms of threat were 1st: Monarch Peacock, 2nd: Holy Lady Strings.

chapters.title: Chapter 421 - One Against Five
chapters.content:
Chapter 421 One Against Five
Holy Lady Strings? Although Meng Chuan’s heart tightened, his fighting spirit stirred. According to King True Martial’s intelligence, with the strength of Dao Protector and I, we only should try using Magic Awl when encountering Monarch Peacock. If we fail, we have to flee immediately. We can’t continue the battle. As for the other demon monarchs, including Holy Lady Strings, they don’t have the strength to force us to escape without a fight.
In the intelligence records, it was noted that Holy Lady Strings reached an extremely high realm for her techniques and very combat prowess.
Her melee, long-range attacks, domains, and Essence Soul mystic techniques were all rather powerful, but the threat she posed was much lower than that of Monarch Peacock.
“Human Godfiend.” The five demon monarchs also saw Meng Chuan.
“Don’t let him escape,” said Holy Lady Strings softly. The five demon monarchs quickly chased after Meng Chuan. Threads appeared in the void, surrounding Meng Chuan from 100 kilometers away. The void threads interweaved, forming a three-dimensional spiderweb. Holy Lady Strings controlled the spiderweb to trap Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan looked at her. As expected of a spider demoness.
Holy Lady Strings was a spider demon monarch. She studied her divine power, strengthening her domain greatly. Her void spiderweb could envelop a 150-kilometer area around her. Once one was trapped by her, it would be difficult to escape.
Swoosh.
Beside Holy Lady Strings, the black-skinned youth-who had scales on his body-suddenly turned into a black beam of light and shot towards Meng Chuan at a speed of 10 kilometers per flash. This speed was definitely impressive among fifth Firmament demon monarchs.
Unbeknownst to them, Meng Chuan could easily shake off the demon monarch team by hiding in the deep void with his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique.
They are afraid that I’ll escape. Meng Chuan calmly watched the spiderweb envelop him, as well as the five demon monarchs rushing forward—the black beam acted as the vanguard. He suddenly moved.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan instantly hid deep in the void. The nine embodiments that appeared in the outside world charged towards the five demon monarchs.
What? The five demon monarchs were alarmed.
Not only did the human Godfiend not flee, but he even took the initiative to rush towards us?
He can enter the deep void. He’s on a disc-shaped weapon, wears a mask, and has a lightning domain? Holy Lady Strings’s eyes lit up as she sent a voice transmission. “He’s Meng Chuan! King Eastcalm, Meng Chuan!”
“Meng Chuan?”
The other four demon monarchs now recognized him. Although most of the demon monarchs in the World Gap hadn’t received the latest intelligence on Meng Chuan, Holy Lady Strings’s team was an exception.
The three Imperial Lords now placed great importance on the fifth Firmament demon monarchs. After all, they had to rely on these fifth Firmament demon monarchs to turn the tide in the war. The three Imperial lords highly valued 15 fifth Firmament demon monarchs. They were currently nurturing them with everything they had, allowing them to grow. The latest intelligence on human Godfiends would also be provided to these 15 demon monarchs immediately.
After Holy Lady Strings learned of Meng Chuan’s detailed information, this team also learned of it.
“Meng Chuan killed one million demon monarchs alone. The Imperial Lords hate him to the core! If we kill him, we will have endless credits.”
“The three Imperial Lords will agree to us entering the Demon Ancestral Cave.”
“King Eastcalm, Meng Chuan.”
The demon monarchs felt their hearts burn. Even the usually calm Holy Lady Strings felt her heart burn. Their gazes towards Meng Chuan were filled with endless killing intent.
Meng Chuan was ranked first on the demons’ latest bounty list. Killing Meng Chuan would earn them 50 billion credits!
Qin Wu and Bai Yaoyue were ranked second. They each had a bounty of 10 billion credits.
Li Guan ranked fourth; he had a bounty of 8 billion credits.
Ranked fifth, Jing Fei had a bounty of 7 billion credits.
Ranked sixth, Xu Yingwu had a bounty of 6.5 billion credits.
In terms of treasures, the demons could exchange a billion credits for an Imperial Lord-level weapon. Five billion credits could be exchanged for a Tribulation treasure. One entry into the legendary Demon Ancestral Cave required ten billion credits.
Killing Meng Chuan was 50 billion credits!
Who wouldn’t eye this?
In the human world, the demons had tried their best to kill Meng Chuan but failed. However, the fifth Firmament demon monarchs still had hopes of killing him since they were in the World Gap.
Regarding Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s failure, Holy Lady Strings wasn’t impressed. In terms of Essence Soul, hers was even stronger than Nine Abyss’s. After cultivating in the World Gap, she wasn’t inferior to Demon Sage Nine Abyss in terms of technique realm. Furthermore, she was skilled in many techniques.
“Kill him at all costs,” said Holy Lady Strings via voice transmission.
“Demon Sage Nine Abyss failed to kill him despite having a Tribulation treasure,” said the white-furred rat via voice transmission. “With our means, we might not be able to kill him.”
The stocky man sent a voice transmission. “Among the Regis Godfiends, his life-preservation means are probably the strongest.”
“As long as you hold him back slightly, I’ll imprison him,” said Holy Lady Strings via voice transmission.
The hunchbacked demon monarch’s eyes lit up. “It’s easy to defeat him. We’ll have to rely on the Holy Lady to imprison him.” They were totally confident that they could defeat the young Regis Godfiend. After all, according to the intelligence, Meng Chuan had been completely suppressed by Demon Sage Nine Abyss. He had only escaped the calamity because of his wife and Essence Soul mystic techniques. After knowing Meng Chuan’s identity, they also knew how fast he was. These demon monarchs patiently waited for him.
Whoosh.
The other party knew about Meng Chuan’s capabilities. Meng Chuan also had intelligence on the demon monarchs, but he wasn’t afraid!
“Let him get closer. The closer he gets, the better.” Holy Lady Strings watched Meng Chuan. “The closer he gets to me, the more unlikely it will be for him to escape my spider web.”
The five demon monarchs closed in together.
Meng Chuan rushed forward at high speed.
The distance between the two parties was getting shorter and shorter!
Holding back their attacks? The demon monarch cultivation system is better at close combat. They want to come close to me and unleash stronger attacks? Meng Chuan narrowed his eyes. As you wish.
Swoosh.
The distance between the two parties rapidly shortened to a few kilometers. Meng Chuan suddenly went from the deep void to the shallow void layers. The moment he was exposed, he released Astral Waves.
They blasted out in all directions with him at the center.
Astral Waves swept out in all directions inside of Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul perception domain.
The white-furred rat demon’s Essence Soul transformed into a huge black lotus flower. At the same time, he stirred the Power of Essence Soul of his four companions, causing their Power of Essence Soul to condense into smaller black lotus flowers.
With one big black lotus and four small black lotuses, they formed a formation. The white-furred rat demon in Holy Lady Strings’s team was named Cave Lord White Azure. He was an expert in illusions and had reached the peak of the Dharma Domain realm. His control over the Power of Essence Soul was much more brilliant than Meng Chuan, Wang Shan, and Holy Lady Strings. As the saying went, everyone had their specialties. Even in Archean Mountain, the one with the highest attainments in illusions was King Desire Redemption. He was even better than Li Guan -who had a sixth-level Essence Soul.
Meng Chuan and company cultivated the Magic Awl. It was also a form of using the Power of Essence Soul. It was a technique that followed the void lineage. Almost all experts came into contact with the void’s mysteries at the Seamless realm. When they reached the Creation realm, they would come into contact with the mysteries of time.
Therefore, most experts with fifth-level Essence Souls could cultivate the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell. However, in reality, the Mirage lineage was the best when it came to utilizing the Power of Essence Soul. In the later stages, one would gain better control over the Essence Soul and could transform it into a world with a mere thought. This was the definition of an illusion expert.
Although the silver-haired demoness had a fourth-level Essence Soul, she was rather skilled in illusions. Her Essence Soul was also able to resist the Astral Waves. This showed that the rat demon had a fifth-level Essence Soul and had reached a higher realm in illusions.
Now’s the moment. A sharp glint flashed in Meng Chuan’s eyes. Bloodblades flew towards the white-furred rat demon monarch-who was more than 1.5 kilometers away. The Bloodblades arrived in a second.
He had information on these demon monarchs. Thus, he deliberately used an Essence Soul mystic technique to distract the white-furred rat demon. He wanted to catch him by surprise with the Bloodblades. The rat demon monarch had the weakest body among the five.
Pfft! Pfft! Pfft!
Wisps of void threads blocked the Bloodblades exquisitely. The white-furred rat grinned at Meng Chuan. He clearly believed in Holy Lady Strings’s protective methods.
All of them were blocked? Meng Chuan’s expression changed slightly. How fast were the Bloodblades? She actually managed to block them all!Swoosh.
Meng Chuan swiftly entered the deep void.
“Since you’re here, don’t leave.” Holy Lady Strings’s cold voice rang out in the void. Ripples appeared in the surrounding space, affecting the deep void. Fifty kilometers around her, the deep void and the shallow void mixed together, forcing Meng Chuan out.
Meng Chuan’s expression changed slightly as he looked at Holy Lady Strings. Has Holy Lady Strings made a breakthrough in technique realm?
According to the intelligence he had, although Holy Lady Strings’s spatial spider web domain was very powerful, it couldn’t affect the deep void within 50 kilometers of her.
She had clearly made huge improvements in regards to her technique realm.
“I’ve been studying my divine power in the World Gap for years. I’ve created my own ultimate technique. King Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, please experience it.” Holy Lady Strings smiled at Meng Chuan. Void threads surrounded Meng Chuan from all directions.
Meng Chuan couldn’t hide in the deep void, so he could only face them head-on. The black-skinned youth, the hunchbacked demon monarch, and the stocky demon monarch charged towards Meng Chuan simultaneously.

chapters.title: Chapter 422 - Counterattack
chapters.content:
Chapter 422 Counterattack
Chi! Chi! Chi!
The void threads were extremely sharp; they were also bizarre and unpredictable. They attacked from all directions.
Although Meng Chuan’s Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique had many variations, it was only at Greater Mastery of the Dharma Domain realm.
Holy Lady Strings was extremely talented and also had high Essence Soul talent. However, her efforts were mostly focused on refining her control over the void threads. Her self-created ultimate technique was also known as the Strings Technique. Her technique realm was much higher than Meng Chuan’s, so her influence on the void was much more brilliant.
verse
The thing she yearned for the most in her life was to reach the highest theoretical realm of the Strings Technique so that she could reverse her age. In history, humans and demons that were unable to reach the Creation (Demon Sage) realm due to their age yearned for age reversal, recovering their bodies’ peak vitality and allowing them to break through to the Creation (Demon Sage) realm.
However, it was too difficult to reverse one’s
age!
First, one had to reach the Heaven Earth realm. This was an insurmountable roadblock to countless Regis Godfiends (Fifth Firmament demon monarchs).
Secondly, it depended on the direction of one’s cultivation. For example, although Ancestral Master Guo Ke had reached the Heaven Earth realm when he cultivated the Heart Intent Saber, this saber art didn’t have the effect of reversing one’s age. This was also the reason why Holy Lady Strings had focused all her attention on studying the Strings Technique. According to her plans, if she cultivated the Strings Technique—which fused Yin and Yang-to the Heaven Earth realm, she would be able to reverse her age. However, reaching the Heaven Earth realm was too difficult.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
The void threads were sharper than blades! They were also extremely soft and mild.
Yin and Yang—hardness and softness-were one.
“Die.” The black-skinned youth, the hunchbacked demon monarch, and the stocky demon monarch rushed in front of Meng Chuan. They were willing to do anything for the sake of the numerous credits they would earn.
After killing Meng Chuan, they would skyrocket into prominence.
Mystify! The white-furred rat demon looked at Meng Chuan. He executed an invisible Essence Soul mystic technique, targeted at Meng Chuan.
Instantly, the five demon monarchs attacked simultaneously!
The Essence Soul mystic technique was the fastest. It invaded Meng Chuan’s sea of consciousness and enveloped his Essence Soul. However, his Essence Soul Star—which slowly spun—naturally resisted the illusions. His Essence Soul Star wasn’t eye-catching in other aspects, but its stability and defense were ridiculous! It was unbelievably stable.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul only saw a few illusory images. He remained lucid; likewise, his strength remained unaffected.
“Capture him while his Essence Soul is affected.” The void threads controlled by Holy Lady Strings were equally fast. After the Essence Soul mystic technique struck Meng Chuan, the void threads quickly attacked him.
The Bloodblades flew to block them, but they were unable to intercept the unpredictable void threads.
Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft!
The void threads approached Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan stood on the Bloodblade Disc as six Bloodblades circled him to protect him. He activated the defensive array formation’s runes on the Tribulation treasure. Six Bloodblades formed an array formation, which blocked all the void threads’ attacks.
Holy Lady Strings’s expression changed slightly. He wasn’t affected by the Essence Soul mystic technique?
Whoosh.
The black-skinned youth charged forward as well. A Bloodblade shot out, but it only left a hole in his body. The youth continued to pounce towards Meng Chuan.
Bloop! Bloop! Bloop!
The black-skinned youth transformed into a thousand-foot-wide, black mud pool that enveloped Meng Chuan.
The fifth Firmament demon monarch, Demon Monarch Quicksand, was a rare blackmarsh earth dragon. His divine power could turn his body into black mud. In terms of offensive strength, he was very mediocre. However, he had a virtually undying body. Among the fifth Firmament demon monarchs, only Patriarch Poison Dragon had a perfect undying body. He had used an outer realm treasure to transform his body into a Blackwater Poison Pool completely. His life essence had changed. The Blackwater Poison Pool was his true body. The dragon form was just something it was used to manifesting into.
Demon Monarch Quicksand relied heavily on his innate divine power. After transforming into black mud, he would pounce on the enemy and hold them back. Weaker opponents would die immediately. The stronger ones would be greatly affected by his attacks. If Holy Lady Strings took the opportunity to attack again, the probability of the attack succeeding would increase greatly. If she encountered a powerful enemy, she would have Demon Monarch Quicksand hold them back.
Demon Monarch Quicksand followed Holy Lady Strings when he first became a demon monarch. They had a deep relationship.
Oh? Meng Chuan looked at the large amount of black mud around him. Although the Bloodblades danced around him and formed a system which isolated the void outside—the black mud constantly obstructed the Bloodblades. It was rather difficult for him to activate the defensive array formation.
How thorny. With a thought, the 12 Bloodblades far away swiftly flew back. Meng Chuan relied on the 12 Bloodblades to hold on firmly.
Boom! The hunchbacked demon monarch arrived in front of Meng Chuan as well. He extended six arms out, each with a saber in hand. He cleaved down, causing cracks to appear in the void.
With the massive amount of black mud holding him back and the void threads constantly attacking, the hunchbacked demon monarch’s six consecutive strikes held horrifying might. His full-powered strikes were even stronger than Holy Lady Strings when she controlled the void threads.
He struck the Bloodblades one after another, causing openings to appear in the 12 Bloodblades’ defenses. Immediately, void threads seeped through the cracks and stabbed at Meng Chuan’s head.
The stocky mountain demon at the back had already revealed his true form. He transformed into a 10,000-foot-tall giant and raised his stone arm high and smashed down with all its might.
The combined attacks of the five demon monarchs were very terrifying.
Divine power—Flowing Sand.
Silver runes surfaced on Meng Chuan’s forehead. Strands of silver lightning flashed around his head as silver lightning appeared in his eyes.
At that moment, everything beyond him slowed down.
The originally speedy threads were reduced to a tenth of their original speed!
Meng Chuan shook his head slightly as the void threads streaked past his face.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan’s speed increased exponentially as he stepped on the Bloodblade Disc. At the same time, the 12 Bloodblades flew at high speeds. They were faster than the void threads!
What’s going on? The five demon monarchs only saw Meng Chuan’s figure turn into a blur as he escaped their attacks. He was so fast that they were left dumbfounded. What did traveling hundreds of kilometers in a second imply? It meant that many of the demon monarchs’ attacks moved slower than Meng Chuan.
Just as he escaped the encirclement, Meng Chuan looked at the distant white-furred rat demon monarch. Void threads surrounded him. Holy Lady Strings sensed that the situation was beyond her control. She wanted to protect the white-furred rat demon monarch-the weakest of their group.
Kill. A thought arose in Meng Chuan.
Boom!
The five demon monarchs only saw a dazzling lightning bolt appear on Meng Chuan’s body. Then, the thick lightning bolt instantly traversed several kilometers, smiting the white-furred rat demon. It was so fast that none of the demon monarchs present had time to react. The white-furred rat demon was reduced to dust by the lightning bolt.
Divine power—Heaven’s Wrath.
This was one of Meng Chuan’s five divine powers. Among Meng Chuan’s many moves, this attack wasn’t very powerful. It was only as strong as an ordinary Creation realm expert’s attack. However, it was superior in speed. It literally moved at the speed of lightning! It was so fast that no demon monarch could react to it. All they could do was take it head-on. Furthermore, it caused paralysis upon being struck.
Against those with strong bodies, it would be akin to a tickle. As such, Meng Chuan didn’t use it against Demon Sage Nine Abyss.
When Meng Chuan was a Marquis Godfiend, he had once used this move on Blood Shura, causing him to be slightly slower. This gave an opening for King Calm Sea to escape; it didn’t injure Blood Shura at all. Thus, the demons didn’t realize how powerful the attack was.
Now that he had reached the Blood Droplet realm, the divine power had increased in strength greatly. It had reached the level of an ordinary Creation realm expert’s attack. With a single strike, fifth Firmament demon monarchs—which had extremely strong bodies
—could only be heavily injured. However, Cave Lord White Azure was skilled in illusions. His body was mediocre among fifth Firmament demon monarchs. With a single strike, he was reduced to dust and died on the spot.
I thought it would take two or three strikes. Meng Chuan couldn’t help but raise his eyebrows in surprise when he saw the white-furred rat demon monarch get pulverized.
A look of surprise appeared in Holy Lady Strings’s eyes. How is that possible?White Azure is dead. The mountain demon and the hunchbacked demon monarch found it unbelievable.
They believed that they would have the absolute advantage after they joined forces, Who would have thought that Meng Chuan could escape despite this! Furthermore, they couldn’t even help Cave Lord White Azure before he died.
They had long known that 50 billion credits weren’t easy to obtain. However, Meng Chuan’s strength far exceeded their expectations.
“The intelligence on Meng Chuan isn’t complete,” said the hunchbacked demon monarch via voice transmission. “That lightning bolt released by King Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, is already as strong as a demon sage’s attack.”
“His speed far exceeds what is reported in the dossiers. The speed at which my demonic powers spread can’t match his speed. It’s impossible for me to attach myself to him.” The black mud also condensed into a black-skinned youth—who wore a solemn expression.
Holy Lady Strings was extremely solemn. She didn’t really care about the lightning bolt. No, she cared about his speed.
Being capable of traveling hundreds of kilometers in a second was terrifying. They actually forced me to use Flowing Sand. Meng Chuan had no choice. Without using this divine power, he wouldn’t be able to escape the void threads surrounding him. He didn’t even have the confidence that he could defend himself with the 12 Bloodblades. Perhaps he would’ve required all 18 Bloodblades to protect himself. However, doing that prevented him from counterattacking. I can only maintain Flowing Sand for a short period of time. I have to end this battle quickly. Under this divine power, Meng Chuan’s speed was terrifying. His blurry figure instantly appeared in front of the hunchbacked demon monarch. Next up is you.
It was very difficult to kill Holy Lady Strings. One had to clip her wings in order to have a chance of killing her.

chapters.title: Chapter 423 - Hunter and Prey
chapters.content:
Chapter 423 Hunter and Prey
Among the four demon monarchs in front of him, Holy Lady Strings was the most well-rounded. In a one-on-one battle, Meng Chuan would be at a disadvantage against her.
The mountain demon’s body was in no way inferior to Blood Shura’s. Back then, King True Martial was assisted by King Calm Sea’s influence on the flow of time, allowing him to unleash the Ten Absolutes of World Annihilation—which killed Blood Shurainstantly. Although Meng Chuan had unleashed his full strength, he only had slightly greater strength than King True Martial’s normal strength. His attacks were still somewhat inferior to the Ten Absolutes of World Annihilation.
As for Demon Monarch Quicksand—who could turn into black mud, giving him a virtually undying body-it was equally difficult to kill him.
Meng Chuan believed that he had the highest chance of killing Demon Monarch Mountain Splitter.
“Be careful.” After the white-furred rat demon died, the black lotus flower formed by Holy Lady Strings’s Power of Essence Soul suddenly expanded, becoming the core of the black lotus formation.
One big black lotus and three small black lotuses.
Although they didn’t study the Mirage lineage, the five demon monarchs in Holy Lady Strings’s team had cultivated the Black Lotus mystic technique. The white-furred rat had the highest accomplishments. Holy Lady Strings ranked second. The two of them could be the core of the array formation. The other three demon monarchs had only scratched the surface of the technique. They could form small black lotuses with their companions’ help.
From the looks of it, my Essence Soul mystic technique has been exposed. From the beginning of the battle until now, they’ve been on the constant lookout for my Magic Awl. He had been trying to use his Magic Awl to sneak an attack on the weak Essence Souls, but he never had the chance.
He wasn’t confident that he could crack the Black Lotus mystic technique maintained by Cave Lord White Azure. Likewise, he didn’t have the confidence of cracking the Black Lotus mystic technique cast by Holy Lady Stringswho had a sixth-level Essence Soul. The Magic Awl Forbidden Spell was a double-edged sword. Once it failed to break through one’s Essence Soul defenses, it would shatter, severely injuring his Essence Soul.
Demon Monarch Mountain Splitter. Meng Chuan wasn’t fazed. With Meng Chuan’s terrifying speed, he instantly arrived beside Demon Monarch Mountain Splitter. The other demon monarchs didn’t have time to rescue him.
Although he was being encircled, Meng Chuan could easily deal with his enemies with his terrifying speed. It was impossible for the enemies to form a true encirclement.
“He’s too fast.” The demon monarchs were helpless against Meng Chuan’s speed.
Whoosh.
A saber beam lit up as it slashed towards the hunchbacked demon monarch. The hunchbacked demon monarch had six arms. His saber art had reached the Grotto-Heaven realm.
However, Meng Chuan’s saber art was fast to begin with. With the augmentation of his divine power-Flowing Sand-it was ten times faster. This speed had already exceeded the speed at which demonic power could emanate. When an object’s speed reached a certain level, there was no way to intercept it.
Reaching the limits of an aspect gave one truly terrifying combat prowess. For example, although the Golden Lotus Descent technique in Star Cluster Building was a Creation-level technique, it could kill an Imperial Lord when it reached the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm! This was the heaven-defying strength one gained once they reached the limits of a certain aspect.
Humph. The hunchbacked demon monarch could only let out a low grunt. A golden light appeared on his skin. He could only rely on his defensive powers to withstand the attack.
Pfft.
When one reached a certain speed, they would be suppressed by the laws of Heaven and Earth. The faster they were, the greater the suppression. Therefore, speed corresponded to strength. The Bloodblades were already extremely fast. After being accelerated by Meng Chuan’s electromagnetic domain, their speed increased by 60%, increasing their strength by several-fold.
Meng Chuan’s saber seemed to be ten times faster than before, but in reality, the saber was still moving at its normal speed. In terms of strength alone, his saber art didn’t experience any improvements. However, he could deliver ten consecutive strikes in the same amount of time it would usually take him to deliver one attack.
At that moment, the saber beam struck the golden light that surrounded the hunchbacked demon monarch’s body. He barely withstood the attack after combining his demonic power with the Grotto-Heaven realm’s profundities.
Meng Chuan’s saber strike didn’t increase in strength, but his Blood Droplet realm body gave him strength and speed that was greater than that of Blood Shura and the mountain demon. The saber strike still caused the hunchbacked demon monarch’s protective golden light to coruscate.
Following that, the second strike landed at the same spot. It shattered the protective golden light and left a wound on the mountain demon. When the third strike arrived, the hunchbacked demon monarch’s protective golden light had recovered.
Your attacks are too weak. The hunchbacked demon monarch heaved a sigh of relief. At the same time, he struck out with his six sabers.
Meng Chuan’s figure blurred as he easily dodged the saber beams.
Boom!
Suddenly, dazzling lightning erupted from Meng Chuan’s body.
Divine power—Heaven’s Wrath!
“Be careful.” The four demon monarchs’ hearts tightened. Cave Lord White Azure had died to a bolt of lightning. Demon Monarch Mountain Splitter-who was closest to Meng Chuan-was even more nervous.
The dazzling lightning bolt instantly struck the distant Holy Lady Strings.
Considering the speed of lightning and the fact that the four demon monarchs were within 15 kilometers of Meng Chuan, the lightning bolt struck all of them simultaneously, giving them no time to react. They could only rely on their own means to block the attack.
Boom!
When the lightning bolt struck Holy Lady Strings, a huge cocoon-formed from countless void threads-appeared around her. The huge void silk cocoon was about 30 feet tall. It protected Holy Lady Strings from the lightning’s constant attacks. It was one of Holy Lady String’s important defensive techniques. The lightning was invisible. Bolts of lightning passed through the tiny cracks in the silk threads and struck Holy Lady Strings.
Holy Lady Strings’s skin was covered in a protective white light. Though it seemed that it could withstand the lightning perfectly, in reality, her body turned numb.
auses
n
It causes my body to turn numb. My control over my body and my demonic powers have slowed down? Holy Lady Strings was secretly alarmed. At her level, it was very dangerous for her control to slow down.
Huh? Holy Lady Strings suddenly saw something.
From afar, six Bloodblades—which had already accelerated to their maximum speedsattacked!
From the beginning of the battle, the Bloodblades—which Meng Chuan had released —constantly accelerated within his electromagnetic domain. They circled him again and again. As the distance of eight full circles around Meng Chuan was considerable, even though the Bloodblades were fast, it was only until now that the six Bloodblades reached their maximum speed. Every one of them was as strong as a top Creation realm expert’s attack.
As he executed Heaven’s Wrath, the six Bloodblades followed suit. At this moment, Holy Lady Strings’s control over her body and demonic power had slowed down.
Experts seized critical moments when they fought.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!
Meng Chuan maintained Flowing Sand. Although this divine power couldn’t affect the speed of his Bloodblades, Meng Chuan’s mind moved ten times faster than before. Due to Meng Chuan’s faster mind, he could control the Bloodblades more precisely as they flew around the void threads, dodging them with ease. This was also a reason why the void threads’ interception speed had slowed down.
Six consecutive strikes.
When the Bloodblades struck the gigantic void silk cocoon around Holy Lady Strings, the Bloodblades’ might weakened due to the dense amount of void threads that formed the void silk cocoons. After slicing through a large number of threads, the Bloodblade’s might had been drained. The six Bloodblades blasted a huge hole in the void silk cocoon. However, many void threads flowed over to defend the void silk cocoon.
Even Peacock can’t kill me. You think you can do so with your six sabers? The numbness affecting Holy Lady Strings instantly disappeared. Holy Lady Strings controlled her void silkworm cocoon, easily blocking the attacks.
Boom!Another dazzling bolt of lightning struck the hunchbacked demon monarch at close range. Blood appeared on the corner of the hunchbacked demon monarch’s mouth as his body turned numb.
He didn’t have time to react as a saber beamwhich made his heart palpitate—appeared in front of him.
It was fast and furious!
Pfft.
The hunchbacked demon monarch’s head flew up!
He pushed Heaven Earth Control and Flowing Sand to maximum strength! These two divine powers combined with Heaven’s Wrath to deliver this fatal sneak attack!
He had to succeed in one strike!
As for why he attacked Holy Lady Strings, it was because he wanted to figure out the other party’s strength before focusing his attacks on her. It was also because he wanted her to focus on protecting herself, stopping her from protecting the hunchbacked demon monarch. That way, the moment he revealed his fangs, his probability of success would be much greater! The second one is down. There are still three left. Meng Chuan was like a hunter as he patiently searched for his prey’s weaknesses.

chapters.title: Chapter 424 - Dao Protector Strikes
chapters.content:
Chapter 424 Dao Protector Strikes
After beheading the hunchbacked demon monarch with one strike, saber beams fell one after another. Meng Chuan struck out quickly under the effects of Flowing Sand. After six consecutive strikes, the hunchbacked demon monarch was reduced to dust. The weapons he left behind were also stored into Meng Chuan’s Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead in passing.
“Mountain Splitter is dead?”
“Another one died?”
The three of them saw Meng Chuan deal with the hunchbacked demon monarch, but they didn’t have time to rescue him.
Meng Chuan’s terrifying speed allowed him to take them down one by one. When this Meng Chuan discovered the five of us, he took the initiative to meet us head-on! In the face of our encirclement, he first struck White Azure with a bolt of lightning. Then, he appeared to attack me, but in reality, he killed Demon Monarch Mountain Splitter in close combat. Holy Lady Strings vaguely sensed that something was amiss. The intelligence on Meng Chuan is wrong. Meng Chuan repeatedly killed the demon monarchs in my team. We are being led by the nose. The mountain demon and Quicksand were shocked and furious.
If they had encountered such a terrifying opponent in the past, they might have chosen to retreat temporarily. However, their opponent was Meng Chuan! He had a bounty worth 50 billion credits! The combined credits awarded for killing the nine human Supremacies were only worth a few billion credits.
The huge bounty made the three of them unwilling to give up. Furthermore, they had confidence in killing him.
They had the Black Lotus mystic technique to protect their Essence Souls. They also had extremely powerful defensive techniques, so they were confident that they could withstand Meng Chuan’s attacks. “Convene here. As long as he attacks, he will have to face all three of us at the same time,” said Holy Lady Strings via voice transmission.
“Yes.” Quicksand and the mountain demon immediately moved towards Holy Lady Strings.
You want to convene? Meng Chuan grinned and lunged at Holy Lady Strings. In terms of speed, he moved faster than the speed demonic powers could spread through the void. Just as the duo moved, Meng Chuan charged towards Holy Lady Strings.
“Senior Brother Wang, attack!” Meng Chuan sent a voice transmission.
Within a small grotto-heaven.
Dao Protector Wang Shan had already woken up and was ready to attack at any moment. “Senior Brother Wang, your Essence Soul mystic technique is too terrifying. Once you attack, you will give them a terrible fright. They will immediately flee in panic.” Meng Chuan had long warned him via voice transmission. “Let me take action first. Holy Lady Strings doesn’t feel threatened by my strength. I’ll first kill the weaker Cave Lord White Azure and Demon Monarch Mountain Splitter. I won’t be able to deal with the remaining three by myself.” With the Black Lotus mystic technique protecting them, the remaining trio dared to face Meng Chuan’s attacks head-on.
Quicksand’s undying body, the mountain demon’s body, and Holy Lady Strings’s protective means were enough to make Meng Chuan despair.
“You can summon me anytime,” said Wang Shan with a smile.
“Senior Brother Wang, once I summon you, use Magic Awl to deal with Holy Lady Strings,” said Meng Chuan via voice transmission. “Your Essence Soul mystic technique will definitely be able to break the Black Lotus mystic technique, striking fear in the trio. The other two don’t pose much of a threat to us humans, but Holy Lady Strings’s threat is much greater.”
Holy Lady Strings was a greater threat than the other four demon monarchs combined.
This fifth Firmament demon monarch had the highest technique realm among the rest. Once she obtained a Tribulation treasure, her strength would increase substantially. However, Monarch Peacock was different. Monarch Peacock had an extremely powerful body that allowed him to be invincible. His body was the foundation of his invincible strength and his best weapon. A Tribulation treasure wouldn’t be of much help to him.
Those with high technique realms—like Holy Lady Strings and King True Martial —could unleash astonishing might if they had a Tribulation treasure.
“Don’t worry. The moment I appear, I’ll use Magic Awl to deal with Holy Lady Strings,” said Wang Shan confidently.
Suddenly, an invisible force wrapped around Wang Shan.
A sharp glint flashed in Wang Shan’s eyes. It’s time for me to come out?
Swoosh.
He was teleported out as he appeared beside Meng Chuan. An Essence Soul voice transmission sounded. “Senior Brother Wang, attack.”
“Alright.” Wang Shan looked at Holy Lady Strings as the surrounding void threads swiftly surrounded him. As Holy Lady Strings used her void spiderweb domain to deal with Meng Chuan, she looked at the dispirited black-robed man in shock.
Holy Lady Strings didn’t recognize this dispirited-looking man at all.
Who is he? Holy Lady Strings was puzzled and cautious. The demons had no information regarding Dao Protector Wang Shan. However, Holy Lady Strings knew that Meng Chuan alone had dealt with the five of them. Now that he suddenly summoned a human Godfiend, one that the demons didn’t have intelligence on, it meant that this human Godfiend was definitely very special.
Holy Lady Strings’s Essence Soul domain sensed something. Not good.
A pitch-black, strange awl instantly flew out from Dao Protector Wang Shan’s position.
Holy Lady Strings vaguely sensed a great threat to her life.
Holy Lady Strings immediately guessed, Magic Awl.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul mystic technique had severely injured Demon Sage Nine Abyss. To deal with Holy Lady Strings, it wasn’t Meng Chuan that used his Magic Awl this time, but the mysterious Godfiend!
The Magic Awl was too fast! Pfft.
The awl pierced the huge black lotus formed from the Power of Essence Soul Holy Lady Strings’s Essence Soul had also become a corporeal black lotus. At this moment, it was being attacked by the black Magic Awl.
“Ahhh!!!” Holy Lady Strings had very high Essence Soul talent, but because she wanted to become a demon sage, she mainly focused on her technique realm. In regards to Essence Soul mystic techniques, she mainly focused on cultivating the Black Lotus mystic technique. She also received pointers from Cave Lord White Azure, but her cultivation of her Essence Soul wasn’t too brilliant.
The Magic Awl forcefully pierced through layers of the corporeal black lotus’s petals.
When the Magic Awl pierced through, it also destroyed Holy Lady String’s Essence Soul’s Origins.
A sixth-level Essence Soul was even more magical. One could form an Essence Soul avatar, and it could be condensed and dispersed at will. Logically speaking, even if one’s Essence Soul was blasted apart, it could instantly fuse back together. However, the Magic Awl was extremely destructive, destroying the Essence Soul’s Origins directly. This caused Holy Lady Strings to let out a painful howl. However, as a fifth Firmament demon monarch with the highest technique realm, her mind and willpower were extraordinary. She could still maintain a basic level of clarity, but she was incapable of using any profound, exquisite moves.
She saw Meng Chuan charging over and immediately shouted angrily, “Run!”
Just as she spoke
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!
Bloodblades struck the void silk cocoon crazily. The intense pain in her Essence Soul prevented her from perfectly controlling the void spider silk cocoon. Due to this, she couldn’t divert the Bloodblades’ strength. All she could do was rely on the void silk cocoon to resist.
With a boom, the void cocoon shattered.
Pfft! Pfft!
The Bloodblades struck her body repeatedly.
Holy Lady Strings was in human form; her robes were rather gorgeous. At that moment, the robes naturally extended, protecting every vital point. Despite the Bloodblades striking her, her robes remained intact.
A spider demon monarch could naturally spin spider silk. The void spiderweb domain was formed by Holy Lady Strings’s demonic powers combined with the Strings Technique—which was in the late stages of the Grotto-Heaven realm. Therefore, it could cover a radius of hundreds of kilometers. The robe on Holy Lady Strings’s body was a robe made of spider silk! This robe was her strongest defensive technique.
In terms of defense, the spider silk robe was several times stronger than the void silk cocoon.
She could also control the spider silk robe to kill people. It had much greater offensive strength than her void threads. However, the length and the quantity of the spider silk were limited. The spider silk’s most suitable range for combat was half a kilometer around Holy Lady Strings.
This was the true reason why she could survive Monarch Peacock.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The Bloodblades struck Holy Lady Strings’s robe. Meng Chuan’s Demon Slayer slashed repeatedly, but he couldn’t tear the robe apart. Her robe extended from her neck, protecting her head. He couldn’t injure her at all.
What? Meng Chuan originally thought that Holy Lady Strings’s strength would be greatly reduced after being struck by Wang Shan’s Essence Soul mystic technique. Believing that she had limited means, he thought he had a chance of killing her at close range.
Who would have thought that he still couldn’t kill her?
Pfft.
The Magic Awl pierced through Holy Lady Strings’s Essence Soul again, causing her to wail in pain. Quicksand and the mountain demon had already begun fleeing separately.
Even Holy Lady Strings was wailing in pain despite having a sixth-level Essence Soul. How could they withstand that?
Meng Chuan’s Heaven Earth Control and Flowing Sand, as well as the Bloodblades failed to do anything to Holy Lady Strings. This chilled Meng Chuan’s heart. He knew that his technique realm was ultimately lacking. Even with his body-which was stronger than that of the mountain demon and Blood Shura-he couldn’t do anything to Holy Lady Strings despite using the Tribulation treasure, Bloodblade Disc.
“A crack has appeared on the Magic Awl,” said Wang Shan via voice transmission.
The Magic Awl was extremely powerful, but it was too brittle. Every time it pierced through Holy Lady Strings’s Essence Soul, it would damage her body while incurring damage on itself.
“Kill the other two demon monarchs,” said Meng Chuan immediately.
“Alright.” Dao Protector Wang Shan also understood the situation. He instantly sent out the Magic Awl.
Quicksand had already transformed into black mud and fled underground. The Magic Awl instantly caught up to him and passed through him! The black mud immediately stopped flowing and transformed into a black-skinned youth, who was covered in scales. He quietly lay underground and no longer made a sound.
Quicksand died.
Pfft! Pfft! Pfft!
The black Magic Awl attacked the mountain demon next.
However, the towering mountain demon had already disintegrated into tens of thousands of tiny stone golems. Some flew in the sky, while others ran on the ground. Some also burrowed underground.

chapters.title: Chapter 425 - After the Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 425 After the Battle
The Magic Awl pierced through the tiny stone golems one after another, causing them to dissipate into metal and rock fragments. However, the single Magic Awl managed to pierce through over 100 tiny stone golems, causing the other stone golems to flee frantically. Many of them had already burrowed underground.
Boom!
Meng Chuan’s gaze swept over, and his electromagnetic domain erupted!
Bolts of lightning appeared within the electromagnetic domain, wantonly attacking a large number of tiny stone golems. Nearly half of the tiny stone golems were struck! The stone golems’ outer layers shattered, revealing the tiny metal humanoids that were much smaller. The tiny metal humanoids were clearly much tougher; they didn’t suffer any damage from the electromagnetic domain’s bolts of lightning. They continued running away from the battlefield.
When a mountain demon is at the Great Solar realm, it can shatter its body and attack its enemies. This mountain demon-who has reached the Grotto-heaven realm-can actually flee by transforming into tens of thousands of avatars?
Mountain demons were very special among demons.
They weren’t living creatures that had gained sentience. For example, lion demons, ox demons, spider demons, flood dragons, and others could raise their cultivation realm through cultivation. However, they were originally living creatures.
A mountain demon was originally a mountain! They were dead objects.
Thanks to the good fortune of the heavens and earth, one would gain spirituality through a fortuitous encounter before embarking on the path of cultivation. They were very special. Just by relying on their special bodies, they stood at the peak amongst their peers at the same level.
How difficult was it for Meng Chuan to cultivate a Blood Droplet realm Body? Though he put in so much effort, it was only slightly stronger than a fifth Firmament demon monarch’s body. Although this mountain demon—who had reached the Grotto-Heaven realm—was still at the fifth Firmament, it had already undergone a transformation. Its life-preservation abilities had greatly strengthened.
“Why did the two of you stop?” A cold voice rang out. Standing in midair, Holy Lady Strings lowered her hands that had been clutching her head. Her robe’s collar still reached high up so that her head would be constantly protected.
She coldly glared at Meng Chuan and Wang Shan.
Meng Chuan stepped on the disc, and 12 Bloodblades surrounded his body. The six Bloodblades that had attacked Holy Lady Strings continued to fly around him.
“Where’s your Magic Awl? Why aren’t you continuing?” Holy Lady Strings looked at Dao Protector Wang Shan. “You stopped when a crack appeared?”
“Holy Lady Strings, you do have brilliant means,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “I’m impressed!”
With that said, he flew away with Wang Shan.
As he flew away, he passed by Demon Monarch Quicksand’s corpse in a bid to store it. Chi! Chi! Chi!
However, the void spider silk had already wrapped around Demon Monarch Quicksand’s corpse and dragged it back rapidly.
The void spiderweb domain is indeed powerful. When Meng Chuan saw this, he thought to himself. After putting the Dao Protector into his Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead, he phased hundreds of kilometers away in a second and fled from the void spiderweb domain.
The void spiderweb domain barely had the might of a top Creation realm expert. What was important was its wide range. It could reach at least 150 kilometers.
If Holy Lady Strings used her real spider silk, her strength would further increase as long as it was within half a kilometer of her!
This strength was enough to defeat many ordinary demon sages. Of course, it was also because she had a breakthrough in the World Gap. Before coming to the World Gap, she was much weaker.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
The spider silk cocoon wrapped around Quicksand as the void threads dissipated, revealing the black-skinned youth’s corpse.
“Quicksand.” Holy Lady Strings looked at the floating corpse with a hint of pain in her eyes. She reached out and caressed the black-skinned youth’s face as she whispered, “You have followed me for many years, but you have now died in the hands of the humans. I was too arrogant. I didn’t take human Regis Godfiends seriously after my breakthrough in the World Gap. Who would have thought that I would encounter King Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, and make you lose your life? I’ll avenge you. I’ll make sure more human Godfiends will join you in death,” said Holy Lady Strings gently.
...
When he was far away, Meng Chuan stopped flying. His Seamless domain naturally shielded him from detection.
I can’t fight for too long after casting Flowing Sand. Without this divine power, I probably wouldn’t have escaped the void spiderweb domain.
With this divine power, he could move hundreds of kilometers in a second. His flying speed was faster than the void spider silk. Furthermore, his thought processes were ten times faster; He was also much more agile while flying, allowing him to escape easily.
Without his divine powers, things would’ve been troublesome. Although he could rely on Heaven’s Wrath-allowing his body to transform into lightning-to escape, he couldn’t use many divine powers under those circumstances. His mind wasn’t ten times faster, but he could still travel hundreds of kilometers in a second. That reduced the variation in his flight path, so he didn’t have the confidence of dodging the void spiderweb domain’s interception in advance.
I can use Flowing Sand for a maximum of 15 seconds. In the future, I’ll try my best to maintain it for 9 seconds at maximum. I’ll leave 6 seconds for contingencies.
The earlier battle took a long time to describe; however, in reality, battles were as fast as lightning when experts fought.
Before killing Demon Monarch Mountain Splitter, Meng Chuan struck out with Heaven’s Wrath and killed Cave Lord White Azure. He then summoned Dao Protector Wang Shan to attack Holy Lady Strings. All of that took about nine seconds.
Therefore, Meng Chuan quickly fled without daring to stay any longer.
“Senior Brother Wang.” Meng Chuan summoned Wang Shan and immediately asked, “Are you alright now?”
“The Magic Awl only has cracks; it didn’t shatter. It won’t be a problem,” said Wang Shan. “If it completely shatters, I’ll lose ten percent of my Essence Soul’s Origins. My lifespan and time of lucidity will be greatly reduced.”
Meng Chuan heaved a sigh of relief.
Dao Protectors were different from ordinary Regis Godfiends. Regis Godfiends could nurture their Essence Souls with their bodies, improving their Essence Souls.
However, a Dao Protector’s body was very special. It could allow one to go past the lifespan restriction, but the pressure on one’s Essence Soul was extremely great.
