Senior Brother Wang Shan had a sixth-level Essence Soul, and he could only stay lucid for another 70-plus years. For over 1,000 years, he had meditated so that the pressure-exerted by the body he was currently possessing-on his Essence Soul lessened. Therefore, Dao Protector Wang Shan hadn’t formed an Essence Soul avatar over the years. He wanted to maintain his Essence Soul’s totality so that he could withstand the pressure exerted by the body.
If his Magic Awl shattered and he lost ten percent of his Essence Soul’s Origins, he would be unable to recover due to the pressure exerted by the body. It would be a permanent loss. His time of lucidity and lifespan would be greatly reduced.He had only used ten percent of his Essence Soul’s Origins to cultivate the Magic Awl. It didn’t affect his Essence Soul much, so it was fine. If he were to use 20% or 30% of his Essence Soul’s Origins to cultivate the Magic Awl, it would have a huge impact on his Essence Soul. His time of lucidity and lifespan would be greatly reduced. Once it shattered, a huge gap in Wang Shan’s Essence Soul would appear after losing 20 to 30 percent of his Essence Soul Origins. In just a few days, his Essence Soul would completely dissipate due to the pressure exerted by his body, spelling his death.
“Senior Brother Wang, how long will it take for you to heal your Magic Awl?” asked Meng Chuan.
“There are just a small number of cracks,” said Wang Shan with a smile. “I believe it will recover in half a month. I can fight during that half-month as long as I don’t attack sixth-level Essence Souls.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Understood.”
Elsewhere in the World Gap.
With the transmission token, Holy Lady Strings and the mountain demon gathered again.
“Holy Lady,” greeted the stocky mountain demon respectfully. “In that battle, only you and I survived,” said Holy Lady Strings.
The stocky mountain demon nodded silently.

chapters.title: Chapter 426 - Gathering
chapters.content:
Chapter 426 Gathering
They suffered a tragic defeat in this battle. Three of the five demon monarchs died, leaving only the two of them alive.
Holy Lady Strings pondered for a moment before saying, “The first reason why we lost so tragically this time is because of the mysterious Godfiend’s Magic Awl. Quicksand died under his hands. I also suffered heavy injuries as a result. Secondly, it’s because of Meng Chuan himself. Meng Chuan’s speed was the main reason why our attack failed; it far exceeded our expectations. My void spiderweb domain was completely useless, so we were unable to form an effective encirclement.”
“Yes.” The stocky mountain demon couldn’t help but say, “His speed is terrifying. He’s faster than many demon sages. How can a Regis Godfiend be so fast?”
Holy Lady Strings nodded and said, “The Heaven Earth laws suppress speed. He shouldn’t be this fast.”
“Could he have broken free of the world’s shackles?” asked the stocky mountain demon curiously.
“Impossible.” Holy Lady Strings shook her head. “To rely on speed to break free of the world’s shackles... that saber art’s might should far exceed your imagination. Even you and I can’t withstand a single strike from such a saber art! Although Monarch Peacock’s body is special, it will probably die from a few chops.”
The mountain demon listened in alarm.
Holy Lady Strings didn’t elaborate further. To break free of the world’s shackles with speed alone... Although Holy Lady Strings hadn’t seen it before, it was recorded in the demons’ secret records. Holy Lady Strings was highly valued by the Imperial Lords, so she once had a chance of reading the secret records.
“How can he be so fast if he hasn’t broken free of the world’s shackles?” asked the stocky mountain demon.
Holy Lady Strings pondered and said, “When I used the void spiderweb domain to surround him, I could vaguely sense that the flow of time around him was a little special. I’m guessing that... he changed the flow of time, making him appear extremely fast in our eyes.”
As a fifth Firmament demon monarch with the highest technique realm in the present eraher technique realm was much realm higher than most demon sages—she had already begun coming into contact with the profundities of time.
“Time lineage?” The mountain demon was astonished.
“There’s no trace of it when used. It’s more like a divine power. From his age, it should be a divine power,” said Holy Lady Strings.
As they reflected on this battle and conducted an after-action review, they suddenly sensed something
“Oh?” Holy Lady Strings and the stocky mountain demon flipped their hands and took out their tokens.
“The Imperial Lords have summoned us back?” Holy Lady Strings and the stocky mountain demon exchanged looks. They were somewhat puzzled.
The duo didn’t dare delay any further as they immediately rushed towards the connection point that linked the World Gap and the Demon Realm.
Holy Lady Strings led the stocky mountain demon to the nearest connection point. They directly tore through the two world membranes and returned to the Demon Realm. They then rushed to the Imperial Lord’s palace. This time, they were summoned by Lady Blackmoon, so they naturally headed for the palace where she was at.
“Holy Lady.” As she flew, she encountered a fifth Firmament demon monarch. The lion demon monarch chuckled and said, “Holy Lady, are you going to the Imperial Lord’s
place?”
Holy Lady Strings nodded slightly and looked at him. “Are you acting alone? Didn’t you go to the World Gap?”
“No,” said the lion demon monarch with a smile. “I’ve been contacting my old friends recently. I’m preparing to form a team to enter the World Gap.”
“Those who didn’t go to the World Gap have been summoned by the Imperial Lord?” Holy Lady Strings frowned slightly.
Why did the Imperial Lord summon them?
Were they going to attack the human world?
Soon, Holy Lady Strings, the stocky mountain demon, and the lion demon monarch arrived at Ice Palace.
The square in front of the ice palace was already filled with over 100 fifth Firmament demon monarchs. More fifth Firmament demon monarchs would occasionally rush over.
“Despite us traveling at full speed, there are already over 100 demon monarchs here?” When the stocky mountain demon saw this scene, he sent a voice transmission. “It looks like all the fifth Firmament demon monarchs in the Demon Realm are gathering.”
Holy Lady Strings nodded. “Yes.”
“Holy Lady.” A goat demon monarch and two other demon monarchs rapidly approached. They had close ties with Holy Lady Strings.
“Horn Mountain, only three of you are left in your team?” Holy Lady Strings saw the three demon monarchs.
“Yes.” The goat demon monarch was in a rather sorry state. He whispered, “Two hours ago, our team of nine demon monarchs were in the World Gap studying the scene of a world’s birth. Who knew that we would encounter human Godfiends, Peng Mu and Yun Jianhai? The moment they discovered us, they attacked. They also had an Essence Soul mystic technique. It was a black awl that could penetrate and destroy one’s Essence Soul. The two of them were extremely powerful. Our team collapsed the moment we clashed. We fled in all directions. As you can tell, only three of us escaped. The other six demon monarchs died.”
“Six died?” Holy Lady Strings frowned and said, “The old lion’s team was wiped out. My team also lost three demon monarchs. Horn Mountain, your team lost six... Furthermore, it all happened in half a day’s time.”
“Black Lion’s team was wiped out?” The goat demon monarch and company were alarmed.
Holy Lady Strings nodded slightly.
They knew that something was amiss. It wasn’t strange for a battle to happen in the World Gap. Human Godfiends and demon monarchs would fight over to see who would obtain possession of a treasure. However, it was abnormal for so many demons to engage in fights and end up defeated in such a short period of time.
“Sister Strings.” A black-robed elder with a dragon head walked over.
Holy Lady Strings looked at him. “Poison Dragon.”
Among the fifth Firmament demon monarchs, they stood at the top.
“I’ve heard that human Godfiends have attacked more than one team.” Patriarch Poison Dragon looked at Holy Lady Strings. “Was your team also attacked?”
Holy Lady Strings nodded.
“The humans come with ill intentions,” said Patriarch Poison Dragon. He was rather excited. He had an undying body, and his essence in life had changed. The more lively the war was, the happier he felt.
Another hour passed. All the fifth Firmament demon monarchs arrived!
nas
A green-robed, snake-tailed woman walked over from afar. All the demon monarchs fell silent. They recognized the green-robed, snake-tailed woman. She was Lady Blackmoon’s personal maidservant; she was also one of Lady Blackmoon’s envoys. “By the Imperial Lord’s orders,” said the green-robed, snake-tailed woman. “All those who fought human Godfiends in the World Gap are to produce a detailed report and hand it to the Imperial Lord.”
“Yes,” replied all the demon monarchs respectfully.
...
“In just half a day, 43 fifth Firmament demon monarchs died in the World Gap,” said Imperial Lord Starquix. “The World Gap has been in existence for more than nine years. In the past nine years, only 31 fifth Firmament demon monarchs have died. It’s normal for us to suffer losses during battles for treasures. However, in just half a day, we lost 43 demon monarchs... It’s more than we’ve lost in the past nine years. Even someone blind can tell that something is amiss.”
“Humans know that we will try our best to send fifth Firmament demon monarchs to the human world through the World Gap,” said Lady Blackmoon. “They aren’t willing to sit still as we prepare, so they attacked first and killed our fifth Firmament demon monarchs in the World Gap.”
“Why was the result so one-sided? Why did so many die in just half a day?” Emperor Roc couldn’t help but ask, “Could it be that humans have given several Tribulation treasures to the Regis Godfiends?”
“We’ll know when we get the demon monarchs’ intelligence reports,” said Imperial Lord Starquix.
Sending fifth Firmament demon monarchs to the human world through the World Gap had long been part of the three Imperial Lords’ plans.
The three Imperial Lords valued the lives of every fifth Firmament demon monarch.
After cultivating in the World Gap for a long period of time, these fifth Firmament demon monarchs were slowly improving.
King True Martial’s True Martial lineage was powerful. The further one advanced, the harder it was for them to improve. However, he still managed to break through to the late stages of the Grotto-Heaven realm by cultivating in the World Gap.
It was more common for ordinary fifth Firmament demon monarchs to improve.
The Imperial Lords were happy to see the demon monarchs slowly improve. As for the small losses during the treasure-snatching bouts? The three Imperial Lords could tolerate
it.
However, the 43 casualties—incurred in a short period of time-shocked the Imperial Lords. They immediately summoned the rest of the fifth Firmament demon monarchs back.
Oh? Why can’t I find any demon monarchs? Dao Protector Wang Shan continued to meditate in Meng Chuan’s Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead as Meng Chuan flew around the World Gap, probing his surroundings with his electromagnetic domain.
After the battle with Holy Lady Strings, he conducted a blanket search of the World Gap. Even after searching for more than two days, he still couldn’t find a single demon monarch team. This was clearly abnormal.
King True Martial has summoned me? Meng Chuan flipped his hand and took out his token. Since they were in the World Gap, requesting help from each other was relatively simple. King True Martial’s position was also revealed on the token.

chapters.title: Chapter 427 - The Three Most Threatening Godfiends
chapters.content:
Chapter 427 The Three Most Threatening Godfiends
Although he was puzzled, Meng Chuan quickly flew towards King True Martial.
Moments later.
Meng Chuan saw King True Martial standing alone on a hill. King True Martial sensed him and looked up.
“Junior Brother Meng,” said King True Martial with a smile.
“Senior Brother.” Meng Chuan landed.
“Summon the Dao Protector out as well,” said King True Martial.
Meng Chuan was somewhat surprised. Few outsiders knew about the secret Dao Protectors. However, King True Martial had an extremely high status in Archean Mountain. His knowledge of secrets wasn’t far from that of a Sect Proprietor. Furthermore, he was designated to be the next Dao Protector. He naturally knew that Dao Protectors usually meditated if they wanted to stay lucid for the short period of time that they had. Each period of lucidity was very precious.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan first awakened the Dao Protector before moving him out of the Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead.
“Dao Protector,” said King True Martial politely.
“King True Martial, why did you wake me up?” asked Wang Shan. “I’ll tell all of you when Senior Brother Peng and Senior Brother Yun arrive,” explained King True Martial. As they chatted, two figures flew over from afar. They were the fat elder—Peng Mu—and the goateed elder, Yun Jianhai. They landed on the hill.
“Everyone is here.” King True Martial looked at everyone and said, “Everyone hasn’t encountered a demon monarch in the past two days, right?”
Meng Chuan, Dao Protector, Peng Mu, and Yun Jianhai shook their heads.
Nobody has encountered a single one? Meng Chuan immediately guessed. Are the demons frightened to the point that they fled? “Two days ago, the demon monarchs left the World Gap,” explained King True Martial.
Peng Mu nodded and said, “I sensed that many areas in the World Gap were destroyed repeatedly two days ago. Back then, I suspected that some demon monarchs had left the World Gap. I also wondered if a powerful demon monarch was sent in.”
“I also sensed it. Furthermore, the areas that were destroyed were connected to the Demon Realm,” said King True Martial.
The Demon Realm and the human world were two separate locations. The World Gap was connected to the two, but the connection points for each world naturally differed. From the areas where the world membranes had been destroyed, one could determine if they were heading to the human world or the Demon Realm.
The world membrane was destroyed in several spots? Meng Chuan muttered to himself.
He hadn’t sensed it at all. Typically, one had to reach the Grotto-Heaven realm before they could pry into the River of Spacetime’s secrets and sense the distant world membrane that had been shattered.
“Most importantly, Archean Mountain sent a Godfiend in with a message,” said King True Martial. “It has been confirmed that all fifth Firmament demon monarchs in the Demon Realm were summoned by the Imperial Lords two days ago. This news was obtained from Black Sand Grotto-Heaven. They then informed Archean Mountain and Two World Island.”
“All fifth Firmament demon monarchs in the Demon Realm were summoned?” Meng Chuan, Dao Protector, Peng Mu, and Yun Jianhai were enlightened.
“I’ve gathered Black Sand Grotto-Heaven and Two World Island. The three sects’ teams will gather and decide our next steps,” said King True Martial.
Another hour passed.
The three Godfiends from Black Sand Grotto-Heaven and two Godfiends from Two World Island came as well.
“All the Godfiends are here,” said King True Martial with a smile. There were a total of ten Godfiends present. They were the full force responsible for battling fifth Firmament demon monarchs in the World Gap. Each of them had received the greatest nurturing from their respective sects.
“Hahaha, this is the first time I’ve seen so many Godfiends here,” said a red-haired elder with a laugh. He was the leader of Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s team, King Molten. Beside him was a black-robed, middle-aged man in silver armor, King Northcleanse.
King Molten smiled and said, “All fifth Firmament demon monarchs have been gathered. They are currently in Lady Blackmoon’s-one of the Demon Realm’s Imperial Lords-palace. This news was obtained by Black Sand Grotto-Heaven. Even if we search the entirety of the World Gap, it will be impossible to find a demon monarch.”
Everyone present listened.
“That’s because we attacked the demon monarchs previously. The demon monarchs that survived also learned about us,” said King Molten. “The Demon Realm’s Imperial Lords made all the demon monarchs write down whatever they know about us. I’m afraid they know almost everything about us.”
“That will be troublesome,” said King True Martial solemnly. “Only by knowing yourself and your enemy will our probability of victory be higher. Previously, our miraculous results, from the battles we initiated—was thanks to the demons’ lack of understanding of our strength. Now that they know our strength, they definitely won’t let us succeed easily.”
“Yes.” King Molten nodded. “Let me tell you first. From what we know from the Demon Realm, the demon monarchs have communicated and determined the three most threatening Godfiends.”
“The first is naturally you, King True Martial.” King Molten’s eyes lit up as he looked at King True Martial. “Your domain is extremely terrifying. As long as your domain envelops them, the demon monarchs will die without a doubt. As for close combat? Nobody can withstand a single strike from you. They are certain that your current strength is on par with Monarch Peacock. You are superior to all the other Regis Godfiends and fifth Firmament demon monarchs. Monarch Peacock and you are each side’s strongest entity in the World Gap.”
“I failed to kill all of them in a one-against many fight. Some managed to slip through the cracks.” King True Martial shook his head gently. If not for those who slipped through the cracks, the demons wouldn’t have new intelligence on him.
“The second is King Thousand Wood from Two World Island.” King Molten looked at the tall, ancient-looking Godfiend. “With King Thousand Wood’s Essence Soul mystic technique, once his black awl connects, any demon monarch that gets hit will definitely die. They are certain that you have a sixth-level Essence Soul.”
King Thousand Wood was an ancient Godfiend that had slept for centuries. Before he slumbered, he only had a fifth-level Essence Soul. After waking up, he was filled with grief and indignation when faced with the war. After that, he created his own moves. While doing so, he sought answers from his inner self and attained a sixth-level Essence Soul after breaking through.
There were dozens of Regis Godfiendsincluding the Dao Protectors and those still slumbering-in total. But even so, only two of them had sixth-level Essence Souls. Dao Protector Wang Shan had attained a sixth-level Essence Soul when he was 300 years old. King Thousand Wood attained a sixth-level Essence Soul when he was 450 years old.
After breaking through, Two World Island placed great importance on him, allowing King Thousand Wood to slumber once again. In order to complete the mission in the World Gap, they awakened him again.
After King Thousand Wood learned the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell, he didn’t hesitate to use 30% of his Essence Soul’s Origins to cultivate the Magic Awl because he only had a normal body and was close to the end of his lifespan. He used ordinary Essence Soul mystic techniques when dealing with ordinary demon monarchs. When dealing with powerful demon monarchs, he would wipe out their Essence Soul with the Magic Awl.
“The third is King Eastcalm.” King Molten looked at Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan was surprised.
He was ranked third among the most threatening Godfiends? None of the Godfiends present were easy to deal with.
“King Eastcalm’s speed is inconceivable. In a flash, he can traverse 250 kilometers. King Molten looked at Meng Chuan. “In a one-on-one battle, most demon monarchs will find it difficult to escape your pursuit.”
When faced with other Godfiends, all the demon monarchs needed to do was widen the distance between them before fleeing underground.
However, when they faced against Meng Chuan? Apart from a few people, none could shake off Meng Chuan.
Back then, Demon Sage Nine Abyss was forced to flee to the outer realm because he couldn’t escape Meng Chuan. “He can travel 250 kilometers in a second?” Many Godfiends were astonished by King Molten’s words; they quickly glanced at Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan’s speed was simply insane. Nobody could catch up to him if he wanted to flee! When he pursued enemies, 99% could not escape from him.
“The demons have also gathered information regarding other Godfiends to a certain extent. They are guessing that humanity has definitely used and given us many treasures,” said King Molten.

chapters.title: Chapter 428 - Start Cultivating
chapters.content:
Chapter 428 Start Cultivating
“After all, from the clashes, the demons have determined that our strength has increased significantly,” said King Molten.
Combat in the World Gap was the most critical step in the war.
If the fifth Firmament demon monarchs were unable to enter the World Gap, humanity would have a long period of peace. It might even result in permanent peace! The three sects naturally nurtured the Godfiend teams with all their might.
For the Archean Mountain party, Meng Chuan and King True Martial both had Tribulation treasures. Peng Mu and Yun Jianhai had also obtained Imperial Lord-level weapons. In fact, for Regis Godfiends, the difference between an Imperial Lord-level treasure and a Tribulation treasure wasn’t that great. This was because they were unable to unleash the full might of their treasures.
Peng Mu and Yun Jianhai originally had ordinary Creation realm combat strength. Although they had improved after cultivating in the World Gap for many years, their improvement wasn’t too significant. Considering their strength, the sect had given them Imperial Lord-level treasures that suited them best. They immediately obtained top Creation realm combat strength.
Although Two World Island and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s support was inferior to Archean Mountain’s due to the gap in heritage, they had also put in a lot of effort to nurture their Godfiends.
Two World Island placed great importance on King Thousand Wood. Therefore, they bestowed him with two Imperial Lord-level treasures. Together with his sixth-level Essence Soul, he was virtually invincible.
Two World Island even used a rare treasure to transform the body of King Thousand Wood’s companion, King Gu Eyes. As a Regis Godfiend that only had a remaining lifespan of over 40 years, King Gu Eyes had cooperatively reconstructed his body. There were many flaws with a reconstructed body. From then on, he was no longer human. His body would no longer be able to improve. During the body reconstruction process, failure was possiblehis body would collapse and die. However, once the process succeeded, his strength would increase greatly.
The demons’ Patriarch Poison Dragon had an undying body thanks to a rare treasure that had helped him reconstruct his body.
Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s heritage was much richer than Two World Island’s. The Black Sand lineage, the Grand Yin lineage, and the Halberd lineage were all very unique. After all of Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s efforts in grooming, King Molten, King Transcendence, and King Northcleanse each had their own specialties. When they joined forces, they were not inferior to Two World Island’s team.
“Thanks to our sects’ grooming, our strength has improved greatly,” said King Molten. “The demons were previously cultivating in the World Gap with peace of mind. Now that they are being hunted by us, the demons will definitely nurture those demon monarchs with all their might. The average strength of demon monarchs isn’t comparable to us Godfiends, but there are too many of them. In addition, they have been cultivating in the World Gap for many years. The number of demons that have Creation realm strength exceeds ours. Once the Imperial Lords groom the fifth Firmament demon monarchs, all of them will improve greatly.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Yea.”
Holy Lady Strings’s strength would increase greatly just by having an Imperial Lord-level weapon that suited her, let alone a Tribulation treasure. If that were the case, he would only be able to flee when facing her—thanks to his astonishing speed. He wouldn’t dare to fight her head-on.
“The demons’ heritage is much richer than ours,” said King Molten. “They also have many treasures.”
Everyone present felt immense pressure.
Meng Chuan knew that Archean Mountain had the richest heritage, but the treasures left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon had been depleted by generations of Godfiends. Currently, only their ultimate techniques and Essence Soul mystic techniques were superior to the demons! They were at a disadvantage in many other aspects, especially when it came to treasures suitable for Regis Godfiends and Creation realm experts. They were very rare in the human world.
This was also the reason why humans had become weaker in the past hundreds of thousands of years. However, the demons had powerful experts for long periods! There were a few Imperial Lords each period. In history, they had quite the number of Tribulation Eminences. Over the years, the Demon Realm’s dominion was nearly ten times larger than the human world. It was considered the pinnacle of middle-level worlds.
“Therefore, we have to be even more careful now,” said King Molten. “The demons know about our abilities. It’s very likely that they will first focus on nurturing the demon monarchs. They will then send them to the World Gap to attack us. For example, they can have Monarch Peacock and several demon monarchs form a team and take the initiative to find us.”
“Yes.” Everyone present nodded.
“According to the plans set by the three sects,” said King True Martial, “we will patiently cultivate in the World Gap after our initial ambushes. The World Gap is a land of opportunity for us when it comes to cultivation. However, according to our original plans, Two World Island and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven will temporarily meet up. Your teams complement each other. Our Archean Mountain team will also meet up.”
King Molten nodded. “Alright.”
“With King Molten and company cooperating with each other, we can deal with all kinds of dangers.” King Thousand Wood nodded. He and his companion were best at using Essence Soul mystic techniques and Gu-worm arts. As for Black Sand Grotto-Heaven, their team was better at head-on combat. With both teams joining forces, their collective strength increased greatly.
With the Archean Mountain team helping them as well, their collective strength increased once again.
King True Martial, Meng Chuan, Wang Shan, Peng Mu, Yun Jianhai... They each had their own strengths. When they worked together, they had the confidence to fight any powerful team the demons sent.
“We will patiently cultivate for 20 years,” said King Molten. “After 20 years, all of us will enter a deep slumber.”
King Thousand Wood nodded. “That’s right. Our lifespans are limited. We can’t keep wasting it away.”
“The demons shouldn’t be able to delay for more than 20 years. The longer they delay, the more afraid they will be of unexpected developments,” said King True Martial with a smile. He glanced at Meng Chuan.
His Junior Brother Meng was a monstrous genius. With another 20 years of cultivation? His strength would probably improve further.
“If the demons really do delay for more than 20 years, you can sleep. It won’t be too late to wake up when the demons attack,” said King True Martial with a smile.
King Molten and King Thousand Wood nodded. They were all over 400 years old. Among them, King Molten was the oldest-he was only 31 years away from the end of his lifespan. King Thousand Wood only had 39 years left of his lifespan. Time was tight.
“I’ll take my leave then.” “Farewell.”
The two sides quickly separated.
The five Godfiends from Two World Island and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven left together. Although they had grudges between them, in the face of war, the two sects still worked together to fight the common enemy-the demons.
Dao Protector Wang Shan entered a small grotto-heaven to meditate. His Magic Awl slowly recovered from the damage it had suffered. If it were Meng Chuan, his Magic Awl could recover from the damage in two hours. However, Dao Protector Wang Shan needed nearly half a month.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan and company flew to a fractured area between the land and sky.
Boom!An extremely thick purple bolt of lightning tore through the River of Spacetime. The purple bolt of lightning was shockingly massive; one couldn’t even see its end with the naked eye. It was ferocious and terrifying, making King True Martial, Meng Chuan, and company feel threatened. “The lightning here is the strongest in the World Gap,” said King True Martial. “Let’s cultivate here.”
“Yes.” Peng Mu, Yun Jianhai, and Meng Chuan watched the purple lightning in shock. The black-and-white gases produced by the purple lightning formed a large black-and-white lake. Half of the lake was in the World Gap, while the other half was in the endless darkness.
The lake spanned 250 kilometers. The lake was composed of the black-and-white gas. The gas streams pursued each other, shattering the darkness. Colorful energy surged like waves.
“Don’t get any closer,” said King True Martial. “Once we are affected, we might die.”
“This is true power; it can destroy a world,” exclaimed Peng Mu. “Likewise, it can create a world.”
Meng Chuan observed the purple lightning carefully.
This purple lightning was different from what he had seen in the past. The feelings he had from observing the purple lightning was much more intense than before. Perhaps it was because it was so large-Meng Chuan couldn’t see the end of the purple lightning bolt with the naked eye. The sense of destruction made Meng Chuan’s heart palpitate.
He knew the purple lightning could destroy everything. If he approached it, he would definitely be reduced to dust instantly. Meng Chuan’s eyes were filled with desire as he comprehended this terrifying power.

chapters.title: Chapter 429 - Second Drawing of Lightning
chapters.content:
Chapter 429 Second Drawing of Lightning
King True Martial released his domain to affect his surroundings, so he was naturally on guard.
Meng Chuan and company also released their Seamless Domains. When experts cultivated, they hated being disturbed the most. This was especially so when they were immersed in their meditation. The interference of others would probably affect them during the critical moment of a breakthrough. Therefore, everyone released their Seamless domains and kept to themselves.
“This lake is indescribably marvelous.” King True Martial smiled as he watched. His True Martial domain appeared around him as he began comprehending the profundities of the Yin-Yang Lake.
In the Yin-Yang Lake, countless black-and-white gas streams pursued each other. The power within these gas streams was extremely terrifying. It shattered the darkness, causing the world to be born.
If one fell into the lake, they would be instantly pulverized.
“Life is limited, but the Great Dao is limitless.” Peng Mu muttered to himself as he looked at the phenomenon stemming from a world’s birth. The closer he was to the end of his lifespan, the tinier he felt.
Peng Mu glanced at his old friend, Yun Jianhai.
Yun Jianhai had already unsheathed his sword and began practicing his swordplay. Sword beams swirled around him like waves.
Huh? Peng Mu looked at the distant Meng Chuan in surprise.
Meng Chuan produced a table, chair, color palette, brush, and other items from his Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead. He sat there and began to mix the paint.
What is he doing? Peng Mu was secretly puzzled.
Meng Chuan sat in front of the table. The entire World Gap was his study room. The scene of purple lightning tearing through the darkness was his painting target.
I can finally paint it a second time. Meng Chuan was overjoyed. My technique realm was relatively low when I painted it the last time. I was still a Marquis Godfiend. Now that I’ve attained Greater Mastery of the Dharma Domain realm, the differences are obvious after seeing it again.
In the different stages of cultivation, one would naturally obtain different benefits from observing the purple lightning.
I’ll paint the Fifteen Lightning Forms again. This was something Meng Chuan had long yearned for. He laid out the paper, pressed it down with a ruler, and painted after some thought. With his previous painting experience and his two self-created ultimate techniques, Meng Chuan had his own ideas regarding the order of his paintings. First, he drew the lightning’s void aspect.
The Nine Heavenly Forms of the Void was something Meng Chuan had a deep understanding of. The Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique—which he had created
-contained many mysteries from this aspect of lightning. Meng Chuan was completely immersed in painting the Nine Heavenly Forms of the Void.
Wonderful, wonderful. As he painted the Nine Heavenly Forms of the Void, he fused his new insights with his old, gaining a deeper understanding of the void aspect of lightning Meng Chuan couldn’t help but be extremely excited.
Comprehending the Dao in the morning leaves one content even if one dies in the evening.
This was exactly the point of comprehending the Dao!
When Meng Chuan painted, he felt the light forms deepen. It was as though he saw the Dao and the truth. He was so excited that his blood boiled. Tears welled up in his eyes as his Essence Soul emitted a spiritual glow.
This was common for powerful Godfiends. When they had a breakthrough, they would feel joy from their souls. As this happened, they sought answers from their inner self, causing their Essence Souls to transform.
Meng Chuan first began painting the void aspect—the Nine Heavenly Forms, Lightning Domain Form, Reality Form, and Selfless Form.
As he immersed himself in painting, he forgot about the time. After becoming a Regis Godfiend, he remained extremely energetic even if he didn’t eat, drink, or sleep for a month.
Meng Chuan divided the purple lightning into four aspects-void, lightning, destruction, and life—and finished a total of 15 paintings.
All would find the scene of the forming world in the World Gap staggering and boundless, be it Godfiend or demon monarch. They didn’t have any extravagant hopes of fusing all the profundities of the world with their own knowledge. This was because each aspect was simply too vast. They could only choose a part of them. They chose what was most suitable for them, comprehending and fusing them so as to improve themselves.
If Meng Chuan were cultivating his saber arts, it would be the same. However, he was painting! A painting depicted the purple lightning’s charm. The purple lightning’s charm in various aspects could be found in each painting. When one saw any of the paintings, it was like seeing the actual purple lightning. It was perfect. However, due to his painting ability, Meng Chuan could only divide it into 15 pieces. The painting process deepened Meng Chuan’s understanding of the purple lightning.
Others would only focus on a small portion of the purple lightning’s profundities when cultivating. Compared to them, Meng Chuan took in the purple lightning in its entirety. Furthermore, with the eyes of a peerless artist, he grasped its essence. This also affected Meng Chuan’s cultivation path.
Demon Realm, Ice Palace.
In the hall.
The three Imperial Lords sat on their thrones as the illusory scene in front of them dissipated.
“The selection is over,” said Lady Blackmoon. “I believe we have a clear understanding of all the fifth Firmament demon monarchs’ strength.”
The test—which lasted for more than ten days — targeted every fifth Firmament demon monarch.
“Yes.” Imperial Lord Starquix nodded gently. “From their performance, Demon Monarch Strings ranks second or third among all fifth Firmament demon monarchs. However, its technique realm is the highest. It is most qualified to obtain a Tribulation treasure.” “Yes.”
“I agree.” Emperor Roc and Lady Blackmoon nodded.
In history, the demons had many Tribulation Eminences. Thus, they had many Tribulation treasures. However, there were very stringent conditions that had to be fulfilled before a demon could be bestowed a Tribulation treasure. No matter how rich one’s heritage was, it would ultimately be exhausted as time passed. Usually, they would never bestow a fifth Firmament demon monarch with a Tribulation treasure.
However, this time, they made an exception because they needed to defeat the humans.
Emperor Roc said, “There are three Tribulation treasures that suit Demon Monarch Strings best. Let it choose.”
Lady Blackmoon nodded.
After a while, Holy Lady Strings entered the hall and looked at the three Imperial Lords seated high in the hall. She immediately bowed respectfully. “Greetings, Imperial Lords.” No matter how proud Holy Lady Strings was, she was extremely respectful towards Imperial Lords.
“Take a look.” With a wave of Lady Blackmoon’s hand, a book flew over to Holy Lady Strings. It recorded three Tribulation treasures. “You can choose any one of them.”
When Holy Lady Strings received it, her eyes lit up.
The description of each Tribulation treasure was alluring. After flipping through it, she hesitated.
“Imperial Lords,” said Holy Lady Strings respectfully, “the human’s Essence Soul mystic technique-Magic Awl-is extremely powerful. Do we demons have an Essence Soul mystic technique that can protect our Essence Soul and resist the Magic Awl? Or do we have an offensive technique similar to the Magic Awl?”
She had tasted the power of Dao Protector Wang Shan’s Magic Awl.
Although she barely managed to remain lucid amidst the pain, she lost a tremendous amount of strength. However, Meng Chuan didn’t have enough destructive power to tear through her robe. If her robe had been destroyed, she would be dead.
Meng Chuan couldn’t destroy it, but King Martial and company could do so. Thus, Holy Lady Strings was in desperate need of means to protect her Essence Soul. “We have none,” said Emperor Roc coldly. “Ordinary Essence Soul mystic techniques are similar to the Black Lotus mystic technique that you cultivate. If one wishes to possess a powerful Essence Soul mystic technique, one has to cultivate an illusion technique and have extremely high attainments in it.”
“However, the humans’ Magic Awl likely doesn’t have such a requirement,” said Holy Lady Strings. “King Eastcalm, King Thousand Wood, and many other Godfiends can use it.”
“That’s a mystic technique unique to humans. Even in the outer realm, powerful Essence Soul mystic techniques can only be used by those from the illusion lineage. If one isn’t an illusionist, how powerful can it be? Such Essence Soul mystic techniques are few and far between. The Demon Realm doesn’t have any.”
Past generations of human experts highly recommended the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell. It was almost a necessary Essence Soul technique for humans. It was also a trump card that represented the Archean Eon Realm. The Magic Awl Forbidden Spell was originally placed in the Heart Sea Palace, so even if outsiders eyed it covetously, they couldn’t obtain it.
“Then, I’ll choose the Tribulation treasure, Nine Lives Cocoon.” Holy Lady Strings made her choice.
“Nine Lives Cocoon is an intrinsic treasure of an Essence Soul Fifth Tribulation Eminence. At critical moments, a cocoon can surround your body. In seconds, it can nurture a complete body and Essence Soul. It’s almost equivalent to gaining another life.” Blackmoon’s voice was cold. “However, one requires that Tribulation Eminence’s bloodline if they wish to master the technique of undergoing rebirth after breaking free of the cocoon. Although we demons have obtained the Nine Lives Cocoon, it’s impossible for us to master the technique of undergoing rebirth after breaking free of the cocoon.”
“I understand. What I care about is the toughness and sharpness of the Nine Lives Cocoon’s threads. Furthermore, they are good for protecting one’s body and Essence Soul.”
Most Tribulation treasures were effective in blocking Essence Soul attacks. The effects obviously varied. Some Tribulation treasures were mainly used for killing enemies. They were weaker when it came to protecting the Essence Soul. Some Tribulation treasures were mainly used for protection. For example, the Bloodblade Disc was very strong when it came to protecting one’s Essence Soul. The Nine Lives Cocoon protected one’s Essence Soul with great efficiency. “The Nine Lives Cocoon is quite suitable for your String Technique.” With a wave of Lady Blackmoon’s hand, a palm-sized egg-which emitted a crystalline white glow-flew towards Holy Lady Strings. “You need to refine it with the Intrinsic Artifact Refining Art. Store it properly and go to the Ninth Sob chamber to cultivate.”
“Yes, I’ll take my leave.” Holy Lady Strings held back her excitement as she received the legg’ and left the palace.
“The humans’ Essence Soul mystic technique is indeed troublesome,” said Imperial Lord Starquix. “Our fifth Firmament demon monarchs are at a disadvantage in this aspect.”
“Ancestral Master Archean Eon was a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. We can’t envy him for finding the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell’s heritage,” said Emperor Roc indifferently. After all, in history, the strongest demon was only a Sixth Tribulation Eminence. Although the demons had given birth to more than one Sixth Tribulation Eminence, the strength difference between a Sixth Tribulation Eminence and a Seventh Tribulation Eminence was just too great.
A Sixth Tribulation Eminence would find it very difficult to venture into the places Ancestral Master Archean Eon could go.
Although the demons had more treasures and the numbers advantage, the humans had a higher quality.
The Essence Soul heritage-Essence Soul Star and Magic Awl-were ranked first and second in the humans’ Heart Sea Palace. These two techniques made the demons drool. The demons clearly did not have such Essence Soul legacies. Of course, the demons also had their own unique legacies.
“How should we nurture Peacock?” asked Blackmoon. “That peacock has awakened the River of Spacetime’s Dark Peacock bloodline. It’s our trump card against the humans.”

chapters.title: Chapter 430 - Three Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 430 Three Years
The World Gap.
Meng Chuan put away the table and chair and looked up at the purple lightning that tore through the darkness.
“It took me 53 days to finish 15 paintings. It took much longer than it previously did,” said Meng Chuan softly. As he painted, his Essence Soul constantly emitted a spiritual glow. Clearly, the insights he gained from painting had stirred his heart and affected him greatly.
Back then, he took 23 days to finish painting Fifteen Lightning Forms for the first time. This was because his cultivation and technique realm was low, thus he saw ‘less.’ Due to seeing less, his paintings of the purple lightning were blurry! Back then, he only cared about depicting the purple lightning’s charm in his paintings vaguely.
This time, he saw a lot more. The paintings were more complicated and exquisite. The Fifteen Lightning Forms’ charm was much more similar to the actual purple lightning.
These 15 paintings represent the purple lightning’s different aspects. However, all these paintings still depict the same purple lightning Meng Chuan understood this concept. If I can fuse the 15 forms into my saber arts one day, my saber arts will be like the purple lightning. When I strike, I will be able to tear through the River of Spacetime and shatter the darkness. My achievements then will probably be comparable to Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s.
Perhaps the purple lightning was weaker than Ancestral Master Archean Eon? Or was it slightly stronger than him?
Meng Chuan couldn’t judge the differences between the two with his current level of insight. However, he definitely knew that the purple lightning was slightly stronger when compared to the Star Cluster Building’s two tribulation-level ultimate techniques of the lightning lineage-Lightning Realm and Three World Saber.
Since Ancestral Master Archean Eon and the alien experts can reach such a level, I, Meng Chuan, also have the chance of doing so. Meng Chuan instantly drew Demon Slayer and faced the forming world. He stood on the vast land and slashed out.
A beard lathered was half shaved. To Meng Chuan, his second attempt at painting Fifteen Lightning Forms was the lathering of the beard. It deepened his understanding of the purple lightning. He had a clearer understanding of which aspects he could still improve on.
Days passed.
Archean Mountain’s team, as well as the Two World Island and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven team, cultivated peacefully.
This cultivation lasted for three years!
In these three years, the demons didn’t send any demon monarchs into the World Gap. This made Meng Chuan and company even more cautious. The demons were clearly making secret preparations. The longer they bided their time, the more terrifying their attacks would be.
With regards to this, the humans were temporarily unable to do anything. Meng Chuan and company focused on their cultivation. Their chances of dealing with danger successfully increased as they got stronger.
Boom!
King True Martial sat cross-legged. He formed a black-and-white domain that spanned five kilometers around him. The black-and-white gas streams chased after the gray, blurry energy that had fused and gathered at the core of the domain.
Peng Mu, Yun Jianhai, and Meng Chuan occasionally sighed in amazement when they saw the True Martial domain’s might.
The True Martial lineage doesn’t follow one path to the extreme. It’s very powerful in all aspects. Meng Chuan sighed inwardly.
The True Martial Lineage granted one an extremely powerful domain, offense, and defense. This was an extremely comprehensive ultimate technique. Of course, due to its comprehensiveness, it had limited strength. Compared to King True Martial’s self-created ultimate technique, the most terrifying ultimate techniques in the River of Spacetime allowed Creation Supremacies to kill Imperial Lords. These ultimate techniques focused on one aspect to the extreme.
For example, the Golden Lotus Descent was even more profound than the True Martial lineage. Furthermore, it had only one goal-to unleash its full power! Only by doing so could one kill an Imperial Lord with the technique!
The True Martial lineage was too comprehensive. It could only be considered dazzling in the human world. Compared to the most heaven-defying ultimate techniques in the River of Spacetime, it was still inferior.
Impressive.
Meng Chuan, Peng Mu, and Yun Jianhai were all very impressed with King True Martial. After all, King True Martial could leave his name in human history. In this era, even the strongest-Qin Wu, Li Guan, and Bai Yaoyuelearned their predecessors’ techniques.
Suddenly
Standing on the vast land, Meng Chuan drew his saber and slashed out.
Boom!
The saber beam could not be seen with the naked eye. The world rumbled as the world membrane distorted.
Without using his divine powers, Meng Chuan had made the world membrane tremble and distort, a testament of his might. “Peak of the Dharma Domain realm,” muttered Meng Chuan softly. “I’ve finally reached this stage?”
Just as I expected, the suppression of the worldly laws is even more terrifying now. Meng Chuan pondered. After three years in the World Gap, Meng Chuan’s Infinite Saber had broken through to the peak of the Dharma Domain realm.
If he had remained in the human world, hadn’t painted the purple lightning again, and hadn’t constantly contemplated the mysteries of a forming world, he might have needed another five to six years to accomplish this feat.
I became a Regis Godfiend at the age of 55. I’m now 63 years old. It took me about eight years to reach the peak of the Dharma Domain realm. Logically speaking, it’s even harder to reach the Grotto-Heaven realm from the peak of the Dharma Domain realm. Considering my current cultivation speed, I will reach the Grotto-Heaven realm after about ten years. However, that is only if I follow an ordinary cultivation path. If I follow the Infinite Saber’s extreme path, it will be difficult for me to reach the Grotto-Heaven realm.
The Infinite Saber Art pursued the limits of speed.
In human history, nobody had ever broken free of the world’s shackles. Nobody had ever reached the Grotto-Heaven realm by following the path of pure speed in the human world.
To break free of the world’s shackles with extreme speed?
The difficulty of doing such a thing was very high.
Some experts in the River of Spacetime could do it. Even some powerful Tribulation Eminences could do it.
Therefore, the three ultimate techniques that he had infused with his insights of the Bloodblade Disc’s runes—Lightning Realm, Three World Saber, and Lightning Walk-could definitely break free of the world’s shackles.
Whether it’s the Bloodblade Disc or the three ultimate techniques, there’s only one way to break through the limits of pure speed.With the Flash Form of Lightning as the core, I will fuse the Wave Splitting Forms of Lightning and the Yin-Yang Form of Lightning with it. Only by fusing the three forms together can I break the world’s shackles with pure speed alone.
One had to fuse more forms together as they traveled further down their cultivation path.
Meng Chuan estimated that he would learn Golden Lotus Descent by fusing five formsEndless Form of Destruction, Perfect Harmonization Form of Destruction, Void Form of Destruction, Flash Form of Lightning, and Yin-Yang Form of Lightning-together.
The higher one’s attainments, the more forms they had to fuse.
Meng Chuan felt that he had to combine all 15 forms together if he wanted to learn Lightning Realm and Three World Saber. The 15 forms only represented elements contained within the purple lightning. Different chefs made different things with the same ingredients.The same Fifteen Lightning Forms would ultimately form different techniques when using different fusion methods.
I’ve already reached the peak of the Dharma Domain realm for Flash Form of Lightning. My Yin-Yang Form of Lightning and Wave Splitting Forms of Lightning need to reach the peak of the Dharma Domain realm independently. Only by fusing the three perfectly will I be able to break free of the world’s shackles. Infinite Saber will also reach the Grotto-Heaven realm. The most difficult thing is the fusion of the three forms.
On the contrary, my Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique doesn’t have to break free of the world’s shackles. It might reach the Grotto-Heaven realm earlier than the Infinite Saber Art.
Three years and six months after he entered the World Gap, his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique also reached the peak of the Dharma Domain realm.
For this ultimate technique, Meng Chuan did not go to the extremes of a singular aspect. Thus, he didn’t need to break free of the world’s shackles for this particular technique. Meng Chuan estimated that the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique would reach the Grotto-Heaven realm in another decade or so. However, he couldn’t tell how long the Infinite Saber Art would take. It was very likely that he wouldn’t be able to break through the bottleneck.
Three years and 11 months after Meng Chuan came to the World Gap.
Huh?
King True Martial and Peng Mu, who were cultivating, suddenly sensed something. They turned their heads and looked in a direction. Soon, Yun Jianhai also sensed something and turned his head to look. Only Meng Chuan didn’t sense anything. He was in a ghostly state as he cultivated the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 431 - Repeated Attempts
chapters.content:
Chapter 431 Repeated Attempts
Eighteen Meng Chuans appeared in the outside world. They looked real, but it was difficult to tell the fake from the real.
As for Meng Chuan’s true body, it hid in the deep void. Due to the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique reaching the peak of the Dharma Domain realm, he could enter deeper into the void. Meng Chuan also formed more embodiments in the outside world because of the breakthrough.
“Junior Brother Meng,” shouted Peng Mu.
Huh? The many figures dissipated. Meng Chuan stopped executing the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique, leaving the deep void. He saw King True Martial, Peng Mu, and Yun Jianhai gather.
“What happened?” Meng Chuan phased over nervously. “Has the world membrane been penetrated? Have the demon monarchs arrived in the World Gap?”
“No,” said Peng Mu with a chuckle. “We sensed a very special fluctuation. It’s likely that a treasure has appeared in the World Gap. It’s very likely an Origins treasure.” The birth of a valuable treasure? Meng Chuan was delighted. He had been cultivating in the World Gap for more than three years. Ordinary treasures occasionally appeared, but they weren’t at the level of Spacetime Floating Ice or intrinsic treasures.
The World Gap would take decades, even centuries, to take form completely.
Typically, not more than ten Origins treasures could be found in a World Gap! To encounter one in a few years was considered lucky.
“It’s about 4,000 kilometers from here,” said King True Martial. “Let’s hurry over and take a look.”
“Let’s go.” Nobody hesitated. Meng Chuan released his Seamless domain and brought everyone along with him. He was extremely fast. On their way, they picked up 12 ordinary treasures. They were likely treasures that had landed in the past three years. Since no demon monarchs entered the World Gap and the Godfiends had been cultivating, the treasures remained on the ground the entire time. Meng Chuan and company picked them up in passing
“We can take a good look around the World Gap in a while. Perhaps we might discover some treasures,” said King True Martial with a smile. “Ordinary treasures are useful. Every bit counts.”
“Blood Soul Stones are relatively common. If we gather more, they can be used as raw materials for the Godfiend Blood Pool,” said Peng Mu.
When one took the three large sects and their outer sect disciples into account, hundreds of mortals would challenge the Life-and-Death juncture every year. The Godfiend Blood Pool was drained every year, so it was naturally alarming how much was used over time. Even Supremacies worried about it; they tried their best to gather the raw materials that fueled the Godfiend Blood Pool.
Huh? The four Godfiends flew for ten minutes before arriving at the source of the fluctuation. At that moment, they summoned Dao Protector Wang Shan. The five of them looked into the distance.
Boom!
azur
An azure wind howled, destroying the world. The ground shattered as the void distorted.
With their eyesight, they could barely see the core of the strong winds. In the eye of the storm, they could see an azure egg vaguely.
These winds... Meng Chuan discovered that the howling winds had an azure glow to them. This azure glow was almost identical to the colorful energies that Meng Chuan had seen cause intense destruction before. “Is it the Power of Origins?”
Meng Chuan knew that the colorful energy was the Power of Origins after causing immense worldly destruction. It was world-creating energy; it left one shuddering in fear.
There was only one possibility for the Power of Origins to gather here.
It’s an Origins treasure. Furthermore, it’s a wind-type Origins treasure.
“This place actually produced the Origins of Wind treasure,” said King True Martial in amazement. “Origins treasures only appear when a world is born. They are extremely precious. As for the Origins of Wind treasure, it’s even more unique. They typically have intelligence. Once they are completely formed, they will tear out of their eggshell and fly away with inconceivable speed. They like freedom; they typically fly away from the world they are born in, and fly freely in the outer realm.”
“Even Imperial Lords in the River of Spacetime find it very difficult to capture them,” said King True Martial. “As for us? We have to capture them before they form completely. Once they tear out of the eggshell, it will be impossible for us to capture them.”
Meng Chuan and company nodded.
“This wind contains the Power of Origins within the World Gap,” said King True Martial. “Let me give it a try.”
He extended his hand. Blurry, gray energy gathered into a ball and spun into the wind.
“I formed that sphere with my Tribulation treasure’s power. It has an extremely tough defense,” said King True Martial. Chi! Chi! Chi!
The wind howled as it raged across the land. It also blew past the blurry, gray sphere. Many cracks appeared on its surface, but it resisted the wind tenaciously and healed rapidly. It continued flying towards the Origins of Wind treasure.
However, the wind was strong. Sometimes it was strong; sometimes it was weak. The deeper one went, the stronger the wind was.
After flying for more than 100 kilometers, the strong winds shattered the blurry, gray sphere shattered, causing it to dissipate completely.
“I can’t defend against it.” King True Martial shook his head when he saw this scene. “I won’t be able to resist the Origins of Wind.”
After obtaining a Tribulation treasure and breaking through, King True Martial had strength close to Meng Tiange and Xu Yingwu. Only Qin Wu, Bai Yaoyue, and Li Guan were confident of defeating King True Martial in a few moves. However, even with his strength, he couldn’t withstand the Origins of Wind with his defensive means.
The other Regis Godfiends... had no hope of making it through the wind.
It can’t be withstood head-on. Meng Chuan also sensed the might of the wind. The destructive wind warped the void, preventing him from entering the deep void. If he resisted the wind head-on with his body, he would just die.
Peng Mu smiled. “I’ll try.”
With a wave of his hand, an azure-colored vine flew out from his hand and into the wind. “This is an Imperial Lord-level treasure. I’ll forget about cracking this Origins of Wind, but it won’t be difficult for it to travel 500 kilometers into the wind.”
The azure-colored vines grew longer and longer. When they extended more than 15 kilometers into the gale, the violent winds became even more turbulent. The azure vines swayed from the wind, unable to travel any further.
The wind is too powerful. Furthermore, it rejects all external objects. It’s impossible for the vines to go further. Peng Mu’s face flushed red as he commanded the azure vines to shrink rapidly. “I won’t try. My sword art is good for killing enemies head-on. Obtaining treasures? It simply won’t do,” said Yun Jianhai calmly
Wang Shan shook his head. “There’s nothing I can do either.”
King True Martial looked at Meng Chuan. “Junior Brother Meng, do you have any ideas?”
“I’ll observe the wind first.” Meng Chuan had a bold idea in mind. He carefully observed the gale, inspecting it with his electromagnetic domain and Seamless domain.
At that moment, five figures flew over from afar. They were the alliance team from Two World Island and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven. King Thousand Wood, King Molten, and company flew down together.
“It’s a Origins of Wind treasure.”
“The gale spans a very large area-500 kilometers?”
King Thousand Wood and King Molten watched in amazement.
“You’re one step faster than us,” said King Molten with a smile. “It looks like you didn’t manage to take away this Origins treasure.” “You can give it a try,” said King True Martial with a smile.
The three major sects were still very tightly knit. No matter which sect obtained it, it would be a boon to humanity.
“I’ll go first,” said King Transcendence coldly. A black figure suddenly flew out from his body. It entered the gale and, although the wind was devastating, it couldn’t touch the black figure at all. However, as it approached, the black figure began to distort when it had traveled more than 50 kilometers into the gale. The black figure quickly retreated and returned to King Transcendence’s body. King Transcendence’s face was pale, and his eyes were dim.
King Molten and King Northcleanse frowned when they saw this. They both felt that their companion, King Transcendence, had a high chance of success. They never expected this to happen.
“I’ll give it a try as well,” said King Gu Eyes. With a wave of his hand, more than 10,000 Gu worms flew out. These Gu worms were extremely fast, and there was still some distance between the gales. However, the Origins of Wind was too fast, making it difficult for them to burrow through the cracks.
Even so, these Gu worms agilely flew through the gaps in the wind. They continued to venture deeper into the wind. However, the deeper they went, the denser the winds became. Once the Origins of Wind swept past them, the Gu worms were reduced to dust.
“It doesn’t work.” King Gu Eyes also realized that something was amiss. The Gu worms traveled 50 kilometers into the wind before retreating. King Gu Eyes retrieved his Gu Worms; there were over 3,000 Gu worms left.
Those with means of traversing the wind tried, but everyone failed.
“The winds are too strong,” said King Molten helplessly as he shook his head. Although a World Gap produced Origins treasures, it was difficult to obtain them, even if they were placed in front of them.
Meng Chuan carefully observed the winds as he calculated his probability of succeeding.
I have a 20 to 30 percent chance of succeeding. I can give it a try.

chapters.title: Chapter 432 - Movement Technique Limits
chapters.content:
Chapter 432 Movement Technique Limits
“The Origins of Wind revolves around the 500-kilometer area.” King Thousand Wood watched from afar. “It’s extremely powerful. The closer we get to the Origins of Wind’s core, the denser and stronger the wind becomes. We Regis Godfiends are unable to approach it.”
“The wind will form a vortex that repels all external objects. Our weapons won’t be able to approach it,” said Peng Mu. Powerful weapons could withstand the Origins of Wind. If the wind vortex didn’t repel their weapons, they could control them to approach the core and obtain the treasure.
King True Martial, King Molten, and company watched from afar as they pondered on ways to obtain the treasure. After all, it was an Origins treasure. There were too many uses for it. The World Origins nurtured Origins treasures. Origins treasures could be used as the Godfiend Blood Pool’s source of power.
It could also be fused with the World Origins of their world, strengthening it. If the world were to face the danger of being downgraded in the future, the Origins treasures would be able to extend the world’s life and maintain its middle-level world identity.
It could also be used to refine treasures and for cultivation.
Origins treasures had many uses, but they were few in number. It was very difficult to find them, even for Tribulation Eminences. This was because an Origins treasure would only appear when a world was still forming.
“Let me try.” A voice rang out.
Everyone turned to look. Meng Chuan was the person who spoke. Meng Chuan carefully observed the giant wind vortex and walked towards it.
Yun Jianhai could not help but say, “Junior Brother, be careful.”
Meng Chuan extended his right hand and touched the wind at the periphery. This puzzled the other Godfiends. He touched the Origins of Wind with his finger?
Pfft.
A wisp of azure wind sliced through Meng Chuan’s fingertip. It barely managed to slice through his Indestructible Divine Armor’s membrane, leaving a tiny wound on Meng Chuan’s fingertip.
Meng Chuan retracted his finger and thought to himself, It’s similar to what I expected. Just a wisp of Origins of Wind is already this powerful. If I were to be buffeted by the wind, I should be able to escape—though I would have severe injuries—as long as I stay in the periphery. Once I reach the vortex’s depths, my body will probably be ground to pieces instantly. I won’t be able to escape.
However, the Origins of Wind only has powerful destructive properties. It doesn’t have any consciousness, and it doesn’t know how to kill enemies through karma. I just need to leave a drop of blood behind so that I can come back to life if the wind destroys my body. I can take the gamble.
Meng Chuan had left a drop of blood on Archean Mountain. Meng Chuan had now left some of his blood in his Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead.
“Senior Brother Wang, I’ll leave this Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead in your care for the moment.” Meng Chuan flipped his hand and handed the Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead to Wang Shan. Puzzled, the Dao Protector received it.
The Origins of Wind was too powerful. Meng Chuan wasn’t confident that the Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead could withstand the wind. However, he was certain that a Tribulation treasure could withstand it.
Meng Chuan smiled at King True Martial and said, “Senior Brother, if I fail, I hope you can help me retrieve this Bloodblade Disc.”
If his body was destroyed, he wouldn’t be able to control the Bloodblade Disc.
“You are entering with your real body?” King True Martial guessed. He couldn’t help but be shocked. The other Godfiends also looked at Meng Chuan in shock.
“King Eastcalm, your life concerns the entire war. Don’t be rash,” said King Molten immediately.
“King Eastcalm, don’t take the risk,” said King Thousand Wood worriedly.
Meng Chuan killed one million demon monarchs alone.
Without Meng Chuan, the demons could send demon monarchs in over a span of several years. When one million demon monarchs infiltrated the human world, the human world would once again enter a nightmare.
“I have absolute confidence in staying alive,” said Meng Chuan. “Everyone, don’t worry.”
“Oh?” Everyone present heard the confidence in his voice. He has absolute confidence in staying alive?
“Since King Eastcalm is confident, we won’t stop you. However, King Eastcalm, you must remember that your life is of paramount importance,” reminded King Molten.
Meng Chuan smiled and nodded. Following that, he floated up and stepped on the Bloodblade Disc.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan transformed into a blur and flew into the vortex.
“He’s using his movement technique to charge in just like that?” King Gu Eyes couldn’t help but speak when he saw this. “His speed is unparalleled in the world. He is definitely much more agile than my Gu Worms with his movement technique. However, the Origins of Wind’s movements is irregular. The further one goes into the area, the denser the wind becomes. The tiny Gu worms... only managed to travel 50 kilometers in.”
“Watch,” said King True Martial.
Most of the Godfiends present were nervous.
Meng Chuan stepped on the Bloodblade Disc and flew agilely. The Origins of Wind was terrifying; it caused the void to distort wherever it blew.
Perhaps, after replicating Supremacy Ye Hong’s accomplishments and becoming capable of entering the deep void, the Origins of Wind wouldn’t pose a threat. However, there was still a huge gap between Meng Chuan and Supremacy Ye Hong. Swish! Swish! Swish!
With the help of the Bloodblade Disc and his movement technique-which was at the peak of the Dharma Domain realm-Meng Chuan moved unpredictably. He passed through the gaps in the wind and constantly ventured deeper into the area.
The wind became denser as he went further into the massive vortex.
“What speed!”
“King Eastcalm’s movement technique is indeed amazing. It’s unpredictable and extremely fast.” The Regis Godfiends watching by the side sighed in amazement. With the Bloodblade Disc, Meng Chuan could traverse more than 50 kilometers in a second! Of course, the violent wind vortex’s environment didn’t allow him to barge in forcefully. Thus, the variations in his movement technique were even more important than pure speed. In the blink of an eye, Meng Chuan had executed 100 variations of his movement technique as he passed through the gaps of the violent wind.
The wind is getting denser. When Meng Chuan traversed 75 kilometers into the vortex, he felt immense pressure acting on him. With a thought, silver runes surfaced on Meng Chuan’s forehead. Strands of silver lightning flashed around his head, and silver lightning filled his eyes. At that moment, everything Meng Chuan saw in the world slowed down to about 10% of its original speed.
Divine power—Flowing Sand.
Now that the Origins of Wind had only 10% of its normal speed, Meng Chuan immediately felt much more relaxed. He stepped on the Bloodblade Disc and rapidly traveled further into the vortex.
100 kilometers, 150 kilometers, 200 kilometers...
He rapidly approached the center of the vortex. “This...”
“This movement technique?”
The Regis Godfiends—who were watching by the side-stared at Meng Chuan in shock. Even King True Martial found the scene unbelievable.
Originally, Meng Chuan’s movement technique was still within their scope of understanding. However, after using his divine power, Meng Chuan’s movement technique had become unimaginably ghostly. They only saw countless afterimages of Meng Chuan as he passed through the seemingly dense wind.
“He has to be moving at a speed of almost 40 kilometers per second,” said King Northclease softly as he watched. “What’s most terrifying is that he can control himself so exquisitely even when he’s moving at such speeds. Even while he’s moving at such a terrifying speed, he has executed at least 100 different variations of his movement technique in the blink of an eye. As for how many times he has changed direction, I can’t tell.”
“I can’t tell either,” said King Gu Eyes. “In the face of such a movement technique, my attacks can’t touch him at all. However, he can attack me at will.”
King Molten nodded. “With such speed, he can change direction at least hundreds of times in the blink of an eye. How can his Essence Soul react in time?”
Even these Regis Godfiends felt like this exceeded their Essence Souls’ reaction time.
Meng Chuan traveled a distance of over 50 kilometers while on the Bloodblade Disc. With his divine power-Flowing Sand-his maximum speed in the wind was over 500 kilometers per second! If he executed the Infinite Saber movement technique endlessly, he could travel 800 kilometers per second. With the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique and the Bloodblade Disc, he could travel 600 kilometers in a second.
However, one might not be able to control themselves if they moved too fast.
When facing Holy Lady String’s void spiderweb domain, countless void threads would block them for several hundreds of kilometers as long as they were within her domain. If he were to charge through Holy Lady String’s domain at maximum speed, he would likely collide with many void threads. It was like how a mortal easily lost control and bumped into obstacles when they ran too quickly. Meng Chuan encountered similar problems when moving at speeds beyond his control.
He was too fast on the Bloodblade Disc. It was naturally fine for him to be moving at such speeds while carrying out underground reconnaissance. However, when fighting powerful opponents like Holy Lady Strings, he needed to control his movements perfectly.
Before this, when he used Flowing Sand, he could perfectly control his movements when he moved 250 kilometers per second. With this speed, he could dodge the dense void spiderweb domain easily.
Now that his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique had broken through and reached the peak of the Dharma Domain realm, he could perfectly control his movements while moving at a speed of 450 kilometers per second. If he moved any faster, he would lose control. If he lost control, he would only be sending himself to his death.

chapters.title: Chapter 433 - Returning to Archean Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 433 Returning to Archean Mountain
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
With the help of the Bloodblade Disc, Meng Chuan became faster and more unpredictable with the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique.
His divine power—Flowing Sand-allowed Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul to have enough time to execute the inconceivable movement technique.
He left behind countless afterimages as he went deeper into the vortex. The Regis Godfiends watching from the side couldn’t see him executing his movement technique at all.
There’s still 15 kilometers left—10 kilometers. Meng Chuan could already see the huge azure egg at the core of the Origins of Wind vortex. However, the final stretch had even denser winds. There were almost no gaps that he could exploit.
The wind is too dense. Even with Flowing Sand, Meng Chuan’s perception of the outside world only slowed down to a quarter of its original speed. The eye of the storm still alarmed Meng Chuan. In the azure egg’s vicinity, there were no gaps in the wind.
As long as the wind blows, there will be dense and sparse areas. I’ll risk it. Meng Chuan hesitated for a moment when he was about five kilometers from the azure egg. Thousands of afterimages appeared around him. The Origins of Wind’s density here couldn’t threaten him.
Charge! With a thought, Meng Chuan unleashed his divine power-Heaven Earth Control! At the same time, 18 Bloodblades surrounded his body.
When Flowing Sand only affected his body, it consumed the least amount of energy. It lasted 15 seconds, but it felt like 150 seconds to Meng Chuan.
Flowing Sand could affect other things besides himself. He could affect the flow of time in an entire area. The larger the area, the greater the expenditure. Therefore, Meng Chuan only released his Bloodblades at the final moment. The invisible power of Flowing Sand also touched the 18 Bloodblades.
Boom!
Instantly, he executed 127 movements. In the final stretch, there wasn’t a single gap in the wind at all. Meng Chuan chose the sparsest spot and charged forward. Meng Chuan reached his maximum speed during this final charge.
Pfft.
Even the sparsest spot here had more terrifying winds than at the periphery!
The moment Meng Chuan charged forward, the 18 Bloodblades’ protection trembled slightly before collapsing. However, in the blink of an eye, Meng Chuan arrived in front of the azure egg
Retrieve. Meng Chuan’s palm touched the azure egg and forcefully stored it into a void treasure.
The moment the azure egg entered the void treasure, the surrounding Origins of Wind seemed to lose its source. It rapidly weakened and dissipated.
Meng Chuan’s legs had been ground to dust. Red blood spread out in all directions. The Origins of Wind had pulverized his legs.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The blood and flesh on the ground rapidly flew back to Meng Chuan’s body. His legs rapidly regenerated to its previous state as the Bloodblade Disc flew back.
After reaching the Blood Droplet realm, he wouldn’t die as long as the particle worlds remained intact. Meng Chuan would only die when all the particle worlds were destroyed. The Origins of Wind sweeping past felt like countless blades slicing through Meng Chuan’s legs. Although it reduced Meng Chuan’s legs to a bloody mist, the other particle worlds in his body remained intact.
With a thought, all the dispersed particles returned to his body. He recovered in a few seconds.
I succeeded. Meng Chuan looked at the void bracelet and sensed the azure egg inside. The Origins of Wind treasure had yet to be born, so it was very obedient. Huh? From afar, the other Regis GodfiendsKing Molten, King Gu Eyes, King True Martial, etc-saw Meng Chuan’s legs burst into a bloody mist. However, in the blink of an eye, he completely recovered.
King Molten and the others were shocked by the sight. His recovery speed is truly astonishing
During the treasure obtaining process, Meng Chuan’s showcased movement technique and vitality left them somewhat shocked. Meng Chuan didn’t care about revealing his strength because the demons already knew nearly everything about him. There was no need to hide anything from his human comrades.
Be it from him resisting Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s punch or fighting Holy Lady Strings, the demons could deduce that Meng Chuan’s body was very strong. Furthermore, they guessed that he probably had more than one divine power.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan flew back to the Godfiends.
“King Eastcalm, your movement technique has really broadened our horizons,” said King Northcleanse in amazement.
“With King Eastcalm’s strength, the demons won’t be able to threaten him.” King Thousand Wood smiled as well. With this movement technique, the demons were also unable to enter the World Gap from the human world since he could catch up to them easily.
Meng Chuan’s strength made these Regis Godfiends feel at ease. After all, Meng Chuan’s influence on the war was too great. “Congratulations to Archean Mountain for obtaining the Origins treasure. We’ll take our leave first,” said King Molten.
“Farewell,” said King Gu Eyes and company.
Soon, the Black Sand Grotto-Heaven and Two World Island team left. Dao Protector Wang Shan returned to the Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead. Following that, Meng Chuan and company began to fly around the World Gap.
After traveling for five days in the World Gap, Meng Chuan and company picked up several ordinary treasures. Following that, they blasted open a rift in both world membranes and returned to Archean Mountain.
The Origins of Wind treasure was too precious. They naturally had to send it back to the sect as soon as possible.
Boom!
After King True Martial blasted open a passageway, the four Godfiends flew into the opening and returned to the human world.
The moment they returned, Meng Chuan and company landed on Archean Mountain’s nameless mountain. It was late at night in the human world, and the moon hung high in the sky. It was bleak.
“Why are all of you back?” Li Guan brought an illusory Qin Wu and an illusory Luo Tang over; they looked at Meng Chuan’s team in surprise.
“We encountered an Origins of Wind treasure in the World Gap,” said King True Martial with a smile. “All the Regis Godfiends—including those from Black Sand Grotto-Heaven and Two World Island-tried to obtain the treasure. However, none of us managed to snatch the treasure. In the end, Junior Brother Meng took action and obtained the Origins treasure in one fell swoop.” “Origins of Wind treasure?” Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang revealed looks of delight.
“Before this Origins treasure is born, it’s protected by the Origins of Wind. Once it’s born, the Origins of Wind treasure would be extremely intelligent. Even an Imperial Lord would find it difficult to capture the treasure. You actually obtained it?” Li Guan was rather excited.
Qin Wu smiled at Meng Chuan. “Well done.”
“After learning that it was an Origins of Wind treasure, I went all out. My luck wasn’t too bad,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. As a Sect Proprietor, Meng Chuan knew very well that Archean Mountain’s cornerstone treasure—the Heaven and Earth Great Hall—was in desperate need of an Origins of Wind treasure.
Back then, with Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s status, many alien experts had offered their homeworld’s Origins treasures in exchange for benefits. However, Origins of Wind treasures would always slip away after they were born, making it much more difficult to find them. Ancestral Master Archean Eon had only found six in his life. Some of them had been used to upgrade the world. Over the years, not a single one had been found.
“The Origins of Wind treasure and other ordinary treasures—found in the World Gapare in this void treasure.” Meng Chuan handed the void bracelet to Li Guan.
Li Guan took it. “Good.”
“Then we’ll head back,” said King True Martial. They had to continue staying in the World Gap for a long time. “The three of you go back first. Meng Chuan, stay behind,” said Li Guan. Meng Chuan was somewhat puzzled by the order.
King True Martial and company nodded. They tore through the world membranes and returned to the World Gap.
