“What’s the matter?” Meng Chuan looked at the three Supremacies curiously. His mission in the World Gap was of utmost importance now. If there was nothing important, the Supremacies wouldn’t stop him from returning to the World Gap.
Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang exchanged looks.
“There’s a troublesome matter.” Li Guan looked at Meng Chuan. “This matter is a little strange.”
“Strange?” Meng Chuan listened carefully.

chapters.title: Chapter 434 - Anomaly
chapters.content:
Chapter 434 Anomaly
Li Guan said solemnly, “In the past few months, two cities in our Great Zhou Dynasty have suffered mysterious attacks. A million people died each time.”
“What? A million people?” Meng Chuan’s expression changed. Ever since he resolved the threat of a million demon monarchs, the entire human race felt that peace had arrived. The remaining demon monarchs—who were hiding in small grotto-heavens—could not stir up much trouble. Meng Chuan, King True Martial, King Thousand Wood, and the other powerful Regis Godfiends-were now thinking of dealing with the World Gap’s threat. Once accomplished, the human race would likely obtain final victory over the demons.
However, to their surprise, while Meng Chuan and company were in the World Gap, the Great Zhou Dynasty was attacked twice, and a million people ended up dying each time.
“Although the demons attacked the cities in the past, every city was guarded by Godfiends. It’s rare to have so many casualties in a single city,” said Meng Chuan. “Who’s the murderer? A demon sage?”
“The reason why it’s so strange is because of the bizarre means involved. Furthermore, we still don’t know who the murderer is,” said Li Guan. “The Godfiends guarding the city discovered a terrifying force in the city. It devoured all mortal living beings within a radius of dozens of kilometers. The flesh and blood of countless living beings turned into lifeblood and were devoured. Their sins were also devoured before it completely vanished.”
“Devouring lifeblood and sin? It’s very similar to my Demon Slayer. However, Demon Slayer only devours the lives it killed. Furthermore, it needs to be in close proximity.” Meng Chuan frowned. “It devoured all lives within dozens of kilometers? Did the Godfiends guarding the city manage to figure out the murderer’s identity?
“No.” Li Guan shook his head. “The first attack happened three months ago. A Guardian Divine Beast was guarding the city that was attacked. That Guardian Divine Beast has the strength of a Regis Godfiend. It pursued the mysterious murderer with all its might. However, the mysterious murderer vanished without it catching up.
“The second attack was on a city that three Marquis Godfiends guarded. The fastest among them saw a blurry figure densely shrouded in lifeblood and sin. There was no way to tell if it was a demon or human. The mysterious murderer also disappeared. The Marquis Godfiends couldn’t track it at all.
“Both attacks happened suddenly, and the culprit vanished in an equally sudden manner.” Li Guan frowned. “Furthermore, the culprit attacked only the cities in our Great Zhou Dynasty. Two World Island and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven were not attacked.”
Meng Chuan’s expression turned solemn. “It sounds like some evil cultivation formula,” said Meng Chuan with a frown.
In human history, there were some very evil cultivation formulas. When humans didn’t face external enemies, the internal strife was very intense. Some Godfiends treated mortals as nothing but poultry. Some even used evil cultivation methods. Similarly, Demon Slayer was an evil weapon. However, it became a powerful weapon in Meng Chuan’s hands.
After the demon invasion, the three major sects abandoned their past grudges and joined forces to fight the enemy. They clearly forbade internal strife!
Any fratricide and fatal harming of Godfiends was considered a serious crime once there was conclusive evidence on their misdeeds. Many ancient and evil formulas from the past had been sealed and were forbidden to be imparted. For example, cultivating the Sanguine Divine Body was too painful. Thus, people later created methods that enabled them easy progress, but it was evil. They used the lives of millions of people to build their foundation. The Godfiend bodies they cultivated were known as the Sanguine Fiend Body. There were many such evil formulas, but they were no longer in existence.
After 800 years...
The three large sects had been united for a long time as they defended against their common enemy. The human Godfiends supported each other, and there was no way to learn evil formulas. In the past 800 years, the Godfiends were the Godfiends with the best reputations in history. Generations of Godfiends fought for the human race.
Because of this fight for humanity and the sacrifices they made, this spirit was passed down generation after generation. It had already merged with every newly-born Godfiend’s bones.
“Humanity’s evil cultivation techniques are all sealed. It’s almost impossible for the outside world to have them,” said Li Guan.
“Even if there’s a small number of the techniques circulating, it’s impossible for one to absorb the lives of one million people at once. Even a Guardian Divine Beast couldn’t catch up to the culprit,” said Qin Wu.
“What do you need me to do?” asked Meng Chuan.
“Your speed is unparalleled in the world.” Li Guan looked at Meng Chuan. “As long as you can discover the murderer, you can track him and prevent him from escaping perfectly.” Meng Chuan nodded. With his capabilities, no expert in the world—including Creation Supremacies—could escape his pursuit.
“You can travel about 250 kilometers in three seconds.” Li Guan looked at Meng Chuan. “If you use that special temporal divine power, your speed will be ten times faster.”
Although Meng Chuan kept the secrets of Flowing Sand a secret, he still told the three Supremacies about it. “I can only maintain Flowing Sand for about 15 seconds. If I use it to the limit, it will burden my Essence Soul greatly,” said Meng Chuan.
“That mysterious murderer takes about nine seconds to devour one million people’s lives. After committing that large-scale massacre, that culprit quickly flees,” said Li Guan. “Therefore, you have to arrive within nine seconds. In the entire human world, only you – Meng Chuan-have a chance of doing so.”
“We need you to capture the murderer,” said Qin Wu.
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
If he spared no expense and used the Bloodblade Disc, he could travel about 800 kilometers in a second while under Flowing Sand. This was thanks to his Infinite Saber Ar reaching the peak of the Dharma Domain realm. In just three seconds, he could travel about 2,500 kilometers.
“The mysterious murderer only attacked twice so far. There was about a month’s gap between each attack,” said Qin Wu. “We believe that if he cultivates a special technique, he will take action soon.”
“Meng Chuan, all you need to do is stay in a large city that is in the Great Zhou Dynasty’s center for the time being. Once he attacks any city in the Great Zhou Dynasty, with your speed, you can arrive there in nine seconds,” said Luo Tang. “Alright.” Meng Chuan nodded. “I’ll temporarily stay in Southwater City.”
Great Zhou Dynasty, Southwater City.
The city furthest away from Southwater City was Qiyu City-which was in the northwest of the Great Zhou Dynasty. Most cities in the Great Zhou Dynasty were within 6,000 kilometers of Southwater City.
Who is it? Meng Chuan looked at the dossier in his hand and frowned slightly. Is it a demon or a human Godfiend?
His time was precious. However, Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang still requested Meng Chuan to stay in the human world temporarily so that he could resolve the threat.
Each attack caused over a million people to die. It was enough to make humanity panic. The Supremacies were extremely anxious.
I’ll just wait. Meng Chuan was also anxious. However, he knew that he would only be able to capture the culprit when the other party attacked.
on
Once the enemy attacked, it also meant that one million people would die. This made Meng Chuan’s killing intent intensify.
Days passed.
In the blink of an eye, Meng Chuan had returned to the human world for more than half a month.
At night, high in the sky of the Great Zhou Dynasty’s hinterland, Rain Peace City.
Whoosh.
The void distorted slightly as a figureshrouded in dark-red fog-appeared in the sky. He looked down at the massive city.
“There are more than ten million fresh lives here,” muttered the dark-red fog figure softly before descending. Although Godfiends guarded the prosperous Rain Peace City, nobody sensed the arrival of this terrifying existence.

chapters.title: Chapter 435 - Mysterious Murderer
chapters.content:
Chapter 435 Mysterious Murderer
The dark-red figure landed on a lake in the city. His blood-red eyes looked around. “Delicacies everywhere.”
SuddenlyWith him at the center, a dark-red fog silently descended within a 15-kilometer radius. Most of the people in the area were fast asleep. Of course, some people were losing themselves in revelry in the brothels. Soldiers were also patrolling the streets as Dao Academy disciples diligently cultivated. However, all of them were suddenly horrified. Their skin, flesh, and blood began to disintegrate into lifeblood, causing the dark-red color in the domain to intensify.
Those who were awake could see their bodies – in horror-disintegrate. As for the ones sleeping soundly, their entire body was filled with pain and anguish. Following that, they lost all sensation forever.
The murderer chose the southeastern corner of Rain Peace City. The periphery was filled with the most ordinary commoners, but it had a dense population. Over one million people’s bodies disintegrated into lifeblood. The anger and resentment they felt when they died also produced sinful grievances—which were also devoured by the dark-red figure.
Blood, sin, and resentment transformed into endless dark-red waves that gathered at the center of the domain.
Huh? The sudden appearance of the lifeblood domain alarmed the Godfiends guarding Rain Peace City.
“That mysterious murderer came to my Rain Peace City?” In an ordinary courtyard, King Luyue’s expression changed.
Due to the change in the war situation, the threat of the demons was greatly lessened. Therefore, many ancient Regis Godfiends had returned to their slumbers. There were fewer Regis Godfiends guarding cities in the Great Zhou Dynasty, but King Luyue was the one guarding this city. After the two mysterious attacks, Archean Mountain naturally sent dossiers regarding the attacks to the Godfiends guarding the various cities. The Godfiends guarding the cities were on high alert.
King Luyue immediately requested help through the token.
I want to see who this mysterious murderer is. I can sense that the lifeblood domain is 25 kilometers away from me. With just my speed alone, I won’t be able to rush there in nine seconds. However, my poisonous bugs will. King Luyue instantly transformed into a beam of light and rushed over. He was an ordinary Regis Godfiend; he was much slower than King True Martial and company. With a wave of his sleeve, a black shadow flew out.
This black shadow was formed from over 70 poisonous bugs. These poisonous bugs were much faster than him. The fastest among them traveled nearly 10 kilometers in a second as they flew towards the lifeblood domain.
In Southwater City, the night was still. Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in the courtyard. Bloodblades flew around him as he practiced his moves. With his Seamless domain distorting lightconcealing him—the surrounding people didn’t discover anything out of the ordinary
Huh? Meng Chuan suddenly opened his eyes. With a flip of his hand, he took out a token. A red blip-over Rain Peace City’s location-had lit up; the sanguine light was blinding.
Rain Peace City? Meng Chuan’s eyes flashed coldly.
After half a month, the murderer had finally appeared!
Boom!
The Bloodblades rapidly flew back into the Bloodblade Disc as Meng Chuan tore through the air.
He stepped on the Bloodblade Disc and used his Infinite movement technique. Meng Chuan flew at his maximum speed, causing silver patterns to surface on his forehead. Bolts of silver lightning flashed around his head as his eyes flickered with silver lightning. The flow of time beyond Meng Chuan’s body was still normal, but Meng Chuan’s flow of time had changed.
Flowing Sand!
Boom!
The surrounding scenery was a complete blur. Even weak Godfiends would feel fear at such speed because they couldn’t see their surroundings clearly. In a second, he traversed 800 kilometers. This was an inconceivable speed. Under normal circumstances, only Imperial Lords could surpass this speed easily. Imperial Lords could teleport 500 kilometers in a single instant. They could teleport two or three times in a second, which meant that they could travel 1000 to 1500 kilometers. This was the slowest speed among Imperial Lords. If one included an Imperial Lord’s control over time and the powerful treasures they possessed, their speed would be much faster.
However, Meng Chuan’s speed allowed him to leave many Creation Supremacies in the dust.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
The surroundings blurred as Meng Chuan advanced at high speeds. The distance between Southwater City and Rain Peace City was over 3,000 kilometers. In slightly more than three seconds, Meng Chuan arrived.
I’m here.
When Meng Chuan arrived in the sky above Rain Peace City, he immediately saw the disaster that had struck Rain Peace City’s eastern region. The rich lifeblood that spanned dozens of kilometers was churning, and it was filled with immense amounts of resentment. Poisonous bugs attacked the lifeblood domain repeatedly. These poisonous bugs were rather powerful as they advanced in the lifeblood domain. However, with the lifeblood domain blocking them, the poisonous bugs’ flying speed slowed down.
It’s King Luyue. Meng Chuan also saw King Luyue. King Luyue was only an ordinary Regis Godfiend. He could travel about five kilometers in three seconds. He had yet to reach the lifeblood domain.
The moment Meng Chuan arrived, the vertical eye at his glabella opened, causing his electromagnetic domain to envelop the area below.
Electromagnetic waves swept across the area and locked onto the figure in the middle of the domain. The figure had a protective barrier, making it difficult to ‘identify’ him.
Huh? The figure enveloped by the dark-red fog was alarmed. Not good.
I’ve found you. Meng Chuan stared into the distance. Bloodblades flew out from the Bloodblade Disc beneath his feet and encircled the figure.
It’s King Eastcalm. King Luyue—who was rushing over-also noticed Meng Chuan. He couldn’t help but reveal a look of delight. King Eastcalm is extremely fast. With him around, the murderer won’t be able to escape.
Bloodblades attacked the figure. Meng Chuan was filled with killing intent. However, Archean Mountain had instructed him to do his best to capture the perpetrator alive! Therefore, he controlled the Bloodblades to sever the culprit’s limbs and seal their strength.
Boom!
The surging lifeblood put up a defense, but it was unable to block the Bloodblades.
Although they hadn’t been accelerated via Meng Chuan’s electromagnetic domain, the Tribulation treasure could unleash terrifying strength since he had reached the peak of the Dharma Domain realm.
With a boom, the lifeblood domain was easily torn apart. The mysterious murderer also tried his best to block the attack as a dazzling blood-colored sword beam lit up.
Boom!
The sword beam was profound, and the lifeblood fled in a sorry state.
What? Meng Chuan’s expression changed.
Although the opponent’s means were very evil, Meng Chuan was very familiar with the sword technique! He had once gone on an expedition in the World Gap with the other party. He had even personally seen the other party fight Blood Shura with all his might. Although his sword technique was much more brilliant than before, Meng Chuan could still tell that the mysterious sword technique—which had blocked the Bloodblade—was Spring Autumn Tribulation.
Strictly speaking, this sword beam was closer to perfection than the Spring Autumn Tribulation he had seen before. However, it was obvious that they shared the same origins. Meng Chuan didn’t believe that another expert in the world could use this move.
“King Eastcalm, don’t let him escape.” King Luyue chased after him anxiously.
The blood-colored figure flashed through the fluctuating void and was now several kilometers away. It rapidly fled with several flashes.
“He won’t be able to escape.” Meng Chuan’s voice echoed in King Luyue’s ears. With a flash, his figure approached the mysterious blood-colored figure.
Meng Chuan stared at the blood-colored figure in front of him. Bloodblades floated around him.
“King Calm Sea, is that you?” asked Meng Chuan in a low voice.
“Hehehehe... As expected of the fastest person in the world.” The blood-colored figure chuckled strangely.

chapters.title: Chapter 436 - The Truth
chapters.content:
Chapter 436 The Truth
The blood-colored figure floated in midair, not in a hurry to escape. This was because he knew very well that it was impossible to escape the fastest person in the world—Meng Chuan.
“Meng Chuan, you need at least a few moves to capture me,” said the blood-colored figure with a strange smile. “As long as I’m willing, I can instantly kill many mortals below. Thus, you only have two choices.
“One, let me go, I will immediately flee. I won’t harm a mortal again. Two, you fight me, but I’ll have these mortals die with me.” The blood-colored figure looked at Meng Chuan. “Choose carefully. I know that the famous Meng Chuan isn’t a heartless person.”
Meng Chuan looked at the blood-colored figure smiling strangely. He was secretly puzzled. I’m 90% confident that this mysterious murderer is King Calm Sea. But since when did King Calm Sea become so garrulous? Furthermore, when was he ever so
stupid?
Buzz.
The Astral Wave swept forward, instantly affecting the blood-colored figure. Meng Chuan knew that King Calm Sea was an extraordinary Regis Godfiend. His willpower was probably just as extraordinary as his technique realm. Even if he had a fourth-level Essence Soul, it was likely that he could barely remain lucid when affected by an Astral Wave. Oh? The blood-colored figure couldn’t help but tremble when the Astral Wave struck it. Following that, it plummeted downwards.
What? He has lost consciousness? Meng Chuan was still prepared to use his Bloodblades to defeat his opponent. Seeing his opponent fall weakly, he was somewhat puzzled. His Quintessential Essence quickly flew out and seeped into his opponent’s body. His opponent didn’t resist at all, allowing Meng Chuan to seal all his strength.
During the sealing process, Meng Chuan also discovered the Quintessential Essence in the mysterious person’s body. He also discovered the Essence Soul that had lost consciousness.
From the Quintessential Essence aura and Essence Soul aura, he was undoubtedly King Calm Sea.
Meng Chuan looked at the mysterious murderer suspended in front of him. This mysterious murderer was taller than King Calm Sea, and his face was covered with dark-red runes. He looked ugly and evil.
His appearance has completely changed, but his Quintessential Essence aura and Essence Soul aura are King Calm Sea’s. Furthermore, his willpower is rather lacking. I’ll bring him back to Archean Mountain and inform Master and the others of the situation. We’ll discuss how to deal with him.
King Calm Sea was extremely famous in the human world. He was an Archean Mountain Regis Godfiend that would very likely become a Creation Supremacy. He had presided over Calm Sea Pass for many years, killing many demons and protecting humanity.
Many Godfiends admired King Calm Sea. Many demons feared him.
If this matter was made public, the impact on morale would be terrible! More importantly, Meng Chuan had many questions on his mind. He had a nagging feeling that the blood-colored figure wasn’t actually King Calm Sea. After all, the blood-colored figure’s manner of speaking was completely different from King Calm Sea’s. King Luyue flew over from afar and sent a voice transmission. “King Eastcalm.”
“I’ve already captured this murderer alive,” said Meng Chuan. “King Luyue, please handle the aftermath. I’ll immediately send this murderer to Archean Mountain.”
“Alright, we definitely can’t spare the murderer easily,” said King Luyue immediately. His eyes were filled with anger. The mysterious murderer had killed more than a million people in Rain Peace City. How could he not be angry? “Don’t worry,” said Meng Chuan.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan quickly rushed to Archean Mountain with the mysterious murderer in tow.
Archean Mountain.
Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang were already waiting.
“Meng Chuan sent a signal through the token, indicating that he has successfully resolved the threat,” said Luo Tang worriedly. “I wonder if he captured the murderer alive or killed the murderer.”
“I hope he captured him alive.” Qin Wu frowned. “I really want to see who the murderer is. Is he a human or a demon?”
Li Guan looked up. “He’s here.”
Meng Chuan landed in Grotto-Heaven Pavilion with the mysterious murderer and threw the person in his grasp at the ground. The tall, ugly man-with dark-red runes on his facelooked around uneasily.
“He’s the murderer?” Qin Wu was puzzled.
“Oh?” Li Guan’s expression changed. “I checked its Quintessential Essence aura and Essence Soul aura. It’s King Calm Sea?”
Meng Chuan nodded and said, “He attacked with a sword technique just now. It was Spring Autumn Tribulation. Back when King Calm Sea and I were in the World Gap, I saw King Calm Sea use this move. This mysterious killer’s use of the move is even more perfect than what I had seen before.”
“King Calm Sea?” Luo Tang was surprised. “Xue Ting?” Qin Wu found it unbelievable. “Xue Ting is the murderer. This is impossible.” King Calm Sea was also Qin Wu’s disciple. He was also one of his most outstanding disciples.
“My Essence Soul avatar is rushing to King Calm Sea’s city. I want to see if there’s another King Calm Sea there,” said Li Guan.
“Where’s the Origins treasure, Scarlet Cloud Heaven? What about his token?” Luo Tang asked. “We can confirm their location.”
“It’s still in the city that he’s supposed to be guarding. It hasn’t moved,” said Li Guan coldly. “I’ve already summoned him to Archean Mountain. However, his identity token and Scarlet Cloud Heaven remain in place.”
Qin Wu and Luo Tang’s expressions changed slightly.
If he didn’t come under orders, then the person in front of them was probably King Calm Sea.
Everything became clearer. “This murderer’s gaze isn’t right. He doesn’t look like King Calm Sea.” Li Guan looked at the ugly man and suddenly used an Essence Soul mystic technique to target the ugly man. “Ahhh!” The ugly man clutched his head in pain as he wailed for a long time. His Essence Soul was greatly agitated, and he finally regained consciousness.
His body trembled as he slowly raised his head. Although he was still in pain, he endured it and looked around.
Meng Chuan, Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang were alarmed.
At that moment, they found the ugly man’s eyes very familiar. This cold, proud gaze belonged to King Calm Sea.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
His bones, muscles, and facial expressions changed. Although his Quintessential Essence had been sealed, as a Regis Godfiend, he still had very refined control over his body. Soon, the blood-red figure transformed into King Calm Sea’s true appearance. “Supremacies, Master.” King Calm Sea stood up and bowed respectfully despite the pain.
Qin Wu looked at him with mixed emotions. “It’s really you.”
“That mysterious murderer?” King Calm Sea frowned slightly. “It’s me?”
Li Guan, Qin Wu, Meng Chuan, and Luo Tang looked at him.
“I guessed it too.” King Calm Sea nodded calmly. “Previously, I lost consciousness twice during my late-night cultivation. Even when I woke up later, I lacked memories of that period. As for those two times... they matched the time when the mysterious murderer attacked the cities.”
Qin Wu couldn’t help but angrily say, “Then why didn’t you report it?”
“I lost my memories twice, and two cities – which were thousands of kilometers away, were attacked. Would it definitely be me?” King Calm Sea said calmly. “If I were to report it, what should I say? That I once colluded with the demons and have connections with the demons?”
Qin Wu looked at his disciple painfully.
King Calm Sea was once the disciple he was most proud of. He had placed his hopes on King Calm Sea becoming Archean Mountain’s next Supremacy. It was unexpected that he would collude with the demons.
“Another evil consciousness hides within your Essence Soul,” said Li Guan. “It’s very rare to see such a thing happen. Typically, one’s consciousness will only split apart when one cultivates a forbidden mystic technique, causing them to turn crazy and evil. We humans have long sealed such evil, forbidden mystic techniques.”
“I’ve cultivated the demons’ formulas before,” King Calm Sea pondered and said, “Perhaps it’s related to their formulas.”
King Calm Sea waved his hand. Four manuals appeared in front of him.
“These are all the manuals the demons have given me over the years,” said King Calm Sea calmly. There was no need for him to hide it any further.

chapters.title: Chapter 437 - King Calm Sea’s Memory
chapters.content:
Chapter 437 King Calm Sea’s Memory
Meng Chuan and company watched from the side. Li Guan carefully read through the manuals.
“Three Creation-level techniques. The last one is half an Imperial Lord-level technique.” After Li Guan finished reading, he picked out two books. “This Creation-level technique, the Four Absolutes Sword, is related to the Imperial Lord-level technique-Time Saber. Furthermore, it contains a so-called Meditation Technique. The Four Absolutes Sword has a foundational section on the meditation technique. The Time Saber also has the follow-up of the meditation technique... I suspect that your split consciousness should be related to this meditation technique.”
Li Guan was, after all, at the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm. His eyes were much sharper.
“I didn’t cultivate the second half of the technique,” said King Calm Sea, “because I obtained an even stronger legacy in Star Cluster Building. The demons sent over this half of the Imperial Lord-level technique afterward.”
Li Guan nodded slightly. As he had expected... King Calm Sea wouldn’t have been exposed so early if he had cultivated the subsequent meditation technique within the Imperial Lord-level manual.
Qin Wu looked at King Calm Sea, his heart aching. “Xue Ting, Archean Mountain has long told every Godfiend about the demons’ ill intentions. You can’t believe their promises, ever. The treasures they give might be poison. The ultimate techniques they give might contain huge flaws.” “Yes, that’s been said before, but how many Godfiends in the world believe you?” King Calm Sea said calmly. “Everyone thinks that it’s an empty threat. Furthermore, many Godfiends believe that if the treasures are poison and the ultimate techniques they give are flawed, that would imply they lacked basic credibility. If that happened, how would Godfiends be willing to continue colluding with the demons? The demons will definitely not be so short-sighted.”
“The demons won’t be so short-sighted, but you have a chance of becoming a Creation Supremacy. It’s very likely that the demons will target you.” Qin Wu frowned. “Besides, I don’t understand why you colluded with the demons.”
“Learn their ultimate techniques and make myself stronger.” King Calm Sea looked at the four people in front of him. “Then, I’ll use that strength to slay the demons. Isn’t that good? The demons are very despicable, but we can still learn their ultimate techniques.”
“If a demon’s ultimate technique contains the profundity of laws, one can gain some insights. However, some special mystic techniques can’t be cultivated if one doesn’t understand the fundamentals of the mystic technique,” said Li Guan. “Once one cultivates an unknown mystic technique, one’s path will be unknown. All the demon techniques that we have collected have been inspected by us Supremacies. What we can confirm and understand will be taught to Godfiends.”
King Calm Sea said in puzzlement, “The demons made me go crazy and slaughter humans? Although the deaths of millions of humans are tragic, it doesn’t damage humanity’s foundation in the entire war.”
“That’s because you didn’t continue cultivating the mystic technique. If you continued cultivating it, you wouldn’t have been exposed so early.” Li Guan pointed at the Imperial Lord-level ultimate technique. “I’m guessing that the demons had great plans for you. Considering how you didn’t even know about the birth of the new consciousness within your Essence Soul... it’s very likely that this special technique will eventually allow the new consciousness to devour your main consciousness and completely replace you. Furthermore, the demons should have means of controlling that consciousness.”
“If you become a Creation Supremacy and are absolutely loyal to the demons, you will pose a great threat to us humans,” said Li Guan. King Calm Sea fell silent.
Meng Chuan and company looked at King Calm Sea.
For many years, King Calm Sea had indeed contributed greatly to the human race. All his children had fought for the human race. Who knew that King Calm Sea would collude with the demons?
“You shouldn’t have colluded with the demons. Do you think it’s so easy to gain benefits from the demons?” Qin Wu looked at his disciple.
“I’ve never thought of betraying humanity.” King Calm Sea looked at the person in front of him. “I know that I, Xue Ting, have committed an unpardonable crime and deserve to be executed. However, dying like this only benefits the demons. I hope that my death will be more valuable. Allow me to atone for my sins as much as possible. All these years, in order to collude with the demons, I leaked some intelligence and caused some Godfiends to die in battle. I owe too much.”
“We don’t dare believe what you said,” said Li Guan coldly.
“We need you to make a trip to the Heart Sea Palace. We can decide how we should deal with you after that,” said Qin Wu.
King Calm Sea nodded. “Alright.”
...
With the help of the Heart Sea Palace, one could swear an inviolable oath.
The Heart Sea Palace could also be used to verify the words said by powerful Godfiends.
Hum.
King Calm Sea sat cross-legged in Heart Sea Palace as he immersed himself in its illusion control.
Meng Chuan, Qin Wu, Luo Tang, and Li Guan stood by the side. The Guardian—the black-robed elder-appeared beside them. The black-robed elder said, “Now, I’ll project his memories. All of you can take a closer look.”
“Everyone, check his memories carefully. We will decide on how we shall deal with King Calm Sea afterward,” said Li Guan. Meng Chuan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang nodded.
Scenes and sounds began to appear above Heart Sea Palace. They were all King Calm Sea’s memories.
When King Calm Sea was a child, his hometown had been invaded by demons. His parents died instantly; he—as a child-and countless people fled in panic. A large number of demons chased after him. When the demons left, only about 30 percent of the fleeing humans had survived. As for King Calm Sea, he became a wandering beggar.
An orphaned beggar? Meng Chuan watched this scene.
Many humans had encountered demon invasions in the human world. He had encountered them before too, but his parents had protected him.
King Calm Sea had become an orphaned beggar.
Memories kept appearing in midair.
When King Calm Sea was a child, he suffered plenty of hardship as a young beggar. He experienced the darkest side of humanity.
The weather got colder. In the cold December winter, just as the young beggar was about to freeze to death, he finally became a servant of a large family clan. His life as a servant was rather difficult, but at the very least, he didn’t starve to death. He had only truly come into contact with cultivation in this large family clan...
As a lowly servant, without a good master’s guidance, all he could do was secretly cultivate and be ruthless to himself.
“He doesn’t care about mortals,” said Li Guan softly as he watched. “In his heart, mortals can’t resist the demons at all. They only know how to bully the weak. However, he still thinks highly of Godfiends. Every Godfiend’s death is heart-wrenching for him. He believes that every death is a loss of strength in the war against the demons.”
Meng Chuan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang nodded slightly. As they watched King Calm Sea’s growth period, all his thoughts and beliefs were revealed.
“He trusts himself the most. He’s focused on dealing with the demons,” said Qin Wu.
“He really hates the demons the most,” said Luo Tang softly. “As children of powerful Godfiends are typically very powerful, he had many wives and concubines to give him a bunch of children. His children suffered much when they were young, but he had guided them secretly. He believes that hardship and setbacks can temper their willpower.”
Meng Chuan frowned.
Yan Jin’s tragic childhood was actually planned by King Calm Sea secretly? He left a sword mark on his son but tortured Yan Jin in various ways. As for Yan Jin’s mother, she was just a tool in King Calm Sea’s eyes. She was a tool for giving birth and tempering Yan Jin. King Calm Sea didn’t care about his other family members. He only cared about his children. He was actually using this method to nurture his children. His children clearly didn’t like this method of nurturing. Even the most outstanding and most monstrous genius, Xue Feng, couldn’t understand his father.
The memories dissipated.
Meng Chuan and company looked at the controlled King Calm Sea, who was sitting cross-legged. “We are done,” said Li Guan. “Everyone, share your thoughts on how we should deal with him.”

chapters.title: Chapter 438 - Life Modification
chapters.content:
Chapter 438 Life Modification
With a cold expression, Qin Wu said, “This war has lasted for more than 800 years. Every year, more unstable World Entrances appear. Billions of people have suffered because of the demons. Many Godfiends have experienced hardship. Would all of them collude with the demons just as he did? We have strictly forbidden them from colluding with the demons repeatedly. After all, they’re betraying humanity by doing so. However, he still insisted on colluding with them.”
“He has caused the deaths of millions of mortals as well as many Godfiends.” Qin Wu sneered. “He only believes in himself. He doesn’t believe in what the sect says. He doesn’t believe in mortals or ordinary Godfiends. From his point of view, the weak can be sacrificed.
“With such a personality, he has already lost himself. If it’s during normal times, he should be executed,” said Qin Wu coldly. “Even now, we can’t let him escape punishment just because he can atone for his sins.”
“We need to punish him severely.” Luo Tang nodded. “The problem is how we will make him atone for his sins towards the human race. His Essence Soul is now flawed; there’s another consciousness within it.” The guardian chipped in. “Through the Heart Sea Palace, one can wipe out the newly-born evil consciousness. However, due to the flaws that come from cultivating that special Essence Soul mystic technique, another evil consciousness will still be born as time passes. The evil consciousness will then continue to grow stronger.”
Li Guan pondered for a moment and said, “First, kill the evil consciousness within before modifying his life. Wipe out his Essence Soul completely! Without an Essence Soul, the mystic technique will be useless.”
“Life modification?” Meng Chuan finally spoke. “How?”
“We can make him into a puppet like the Guardian Divine Beasts,” explained Li Guan. “Even without an Essence Soul, one can become such a puppet. However, his consciousness and memories will completely merge with the puppet. He can still maintain his current technique realm through this method. The current Guardian Divine Beasts were all left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon.”
a
en
“There are many types of life modification. With the resources our Archean Mountain has accumulated, we can do more than ten types of modifications, ” said Qin Wu. “There are only two types of modifications that wipes away an Essence Soul. One modification is the Ice Guard. The other is Streaming Fire Life. Out of the two, Streaming Fire Life has a higher mortality rate during the modification. The Ice Guard has a lower mortality rate.”
Although Meng Chuan had the authority to know about such secrets, he didn’t have time to study it in-depth.
Qin Wu, Li Guan, and company had clearly studied Archean Mountain’s secrets more than he did.
“Let him be an Ice Guard. There’s a 70% chance of success,” said Li Guan. “Streaming Fire Life is too incompatible with us humans. The probability of success is too low.”
“Meng Chuan.” Qin Wu looked at Meng Chuan and explained, “Ice Guards are lifeforms that are fundamentally different from us. They aren’t made of flesh and blood. They are a special ice lifeform produced in the River of Spacetime. They have an ice body. During the modification process, one’s Essence Soul will completely melt, becoming nutrients for their ice body. This makes their ice body extremely powerful! An Ice Guard’s ice body is very powerful, but they will die once it shatters.” “Furthermore, after the modification process, the ice body can no longer be improved. One’s Essence Soul is also gone forever. One can only continue to improve their technique realm. Once one’s lifespan is up, they will naturally die.
“However, Ice Guards are still very powerful modified lifeforms,” said Qin Wu wistfully. “In the River of Spacetime, many people—who have no hope of breaking through-have studied life modification techniques. They hope to increase their lifespan or increase their strength through such means.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
Life modification techniques were double-edged swords. It severed one’s cultivation path and expended precious resources. Failure during the modification meant death...
However, there were all sorts of benefits. One’s lifespan might increase; their strength might increase, etc.
“Becoming a Dao Protector also changes one’s life essence,” said Luo Tang. “As long as one has a fifth-level Essence Soul, one can possess a Dao Protector’s body. Although one needs to meditate most of the time—they can only be lucid for a period of time—they will gain over 1,000 years in lifespan! A Dao Protector’s body is indestructible. It’s a great opportunity for Regis Godfiends that have reached the end of their lifespans.”
Meng Chuan and company quickly made their decision. “Although he is now loyal to the human race and hates the demons, who knows what will happen in the future? Our punishment might result in him resenting us. Maybe that resentment will develop, causing him to betray humanity even more,” said Li Guan. “Therefore, before we begin the life modification process, he must swear an oath in Heart Sea Palace.”
Meng Chuan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang nodded.
“After transforming into an Ice Guard, we will banish him to the World Gap. He is forbidden from returning to the human world for 300 years,” said Li Guan. “He will perpetually guard the World Gap and hunt down the demons that enter. He will only be allowed to return when 300 years are up.”
“Alright.”
“Agreed.”
“This can be considered as a way for him to atone his sins.” Qin Wu, Luo Tang, and Meng Chuan agreed to the plan.
If this were a peaceful era, he would have long been executed. However, an expert with the strength of a Creation Supremacy was too precious. It was too wasteful to execute him directly.
After King Calm Sea patrolled the World Gap for 300 years, his remaining lifespan would be very short. Only then would he be allowed to return to the human world to take a look.
“Xue Ting, you are aware of your punishment.” Li Guan looked at him. “Do you have any objections?”
“It’s my wish to hunt down the demons. I’m naturally willing.” King Calm Sea revealed a rare smile. “If I die during the life modification process, I have no complaints.”
Meng Chuan watched from the side.
“Before that, I want to write a letter.” King Calm Sea looked at Meng Chuan. “I hope King Eastcalm can pass it to Yan Jin.”
“If there’s nothing wrong with the letter, I can pass it to him for you,” said Meng Chuan.
If King Calm Sea had any tricks up his sleeves to deal with Yan Jin, he wouldn’t help him pass the letter to his son.
“It’s a very simple letter.” King Calm Sea smiled and looked around. “Do you have a brush and paper?”.
Meng Chuan waved his hand and prepared a table, brush, and paper. As someone who often painted, he naturally had these things on him.
omeon
King Calm Sea placed the paper on the table and began writing carefully.
“I’ll be fighting in the World Gap. If you want to meet me, get the right to enter the World Gap first.” King Calm Sea finished writing the sentences before handing the letter to Meng Chuan. He smiled and said, “He will definitely seek me in the future. I might as well tell him in advance.”
“Even ordinary Regis Godfiends are currently forbidden from entering the World Gap,” said Qin Wu with a frown.
“Very good.” King Calm Sea smiled. “If he wants to see me, he has to become stronger.”
Meng Chuan frowned. “Is that how you should treat your son?” “I have my ways of educating my children,” said King Calm Sea with a smile. “Even if you don’t give him this letter, he will still crazily seek me out in the future.”
Meng Chuan said indifferently, “I’ll give it to him at the appropriate time.” Meng Chuan also understood Yan Jin’s obsession.
“It’s up to you.” King Calm Sea looked at Meng Chuan carefully. “I’ve been cultivating for over 100 years, but I haven’t been able to see any hope of victory. I felt like I was blindly searching in the darkness. However, I never expected that you, Meng Chuan, to change the war’s trajectory single-handedly. You have truly allowed me to see the light.
“I’m very happy to see Meng Chuan appear. I always believed that I couldn’t pin my hopes on others; that I could only trust myself.” King Calm Sea looked at Meng Chuan. “From the looks of it, I can trust others.”
Following that, King Calm Sea swore an oath and underwent life modification.
Humph.
King Calm Sea sat cross-legged in a huge pool. His body gradually turned transparent as endless frost gathered in his body. He couldn’t help but grunt softly. Clearly, he was in immense pain.
Meng Chuan and company watched from the side.
I once saw two scenes in the Spacetime Floating Ice. As Meng Chuan thought about it, the scene of his white-haired self holding Demon Slayer and angrily roaring at King Calm Sea-who laughed maniacally-appeared in his mind.
In that scene, I was stronger than I was now. King Calm Sea was also stronger. In that scene, he had already become a Creation Supremacy. Now, regardless of whether the life modification process succeeds or fails, he can no longer become a Creation Supremacy. That scene will never come to fruition.
The Spacetime Floating Ice only revealed the possibilities of the various timelines.
If King Calm Sea had continued cultivating the meditation technique, he mightn’t have been exposed so early. He could’ve become a Creation Supremacy before his misdeeds were discovered.
Since spacetime can be changed, I wonder if I will still have white hair in the future? Meng Chuan pondered.

chapters.title: Chapter 439 - Eight Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 439 Eight Years
In the pool, King Calm Sea-who was sitting cross-legged-became increasingly transparent. Endless frost energy gathered within him. King Calm Sea’s expression was warped; his eyes were filled with madness.
Li Guan, Qin Wu, Luo Tang, and Meng Chuan watched nervously. “The first day of the life modification process is the most dangerous. On the first day, his life essence will be completely transformed. The remaining two days are for him to give birth to an ice lifeform,” said Li Guan nervously. “As long as he survives the first day, it will be considered a success.”
“Although King Calm Sea has lost his way, his willpower is extremely astonishing,” said Luo Tang. “He should be able to survive.”
The life modification process was extremely painful.
Even one’s Essence Soul would completely melt into the ice body. If King Calm Sea’s consciousness collapsed during this process, he would die completely.
Time slowly passed.
Meng Chuan and company waited by the side for a full day. They still hoped for another combat force to appear in the human world.
Finally, the terrifying frost energies in the pool completely fused with King Calm Sea’s body. A huge ice block appeared, and a human figure could be vaguely seen sitting cross-legged inside. The look in the human figure’s eyes gradually calmed down.
“He survived. Next, he’ll give birth to an ice body.” Li Guan heaved a sigh of relief.
“Xue Ting can live for a few more centuries. I hope he can redeem himself in the World Gap in the future,” said Qin Wu. Qin Wu was somewhat angry and disappointed about this disciple of his.
“Everyone, I don’t think it’s appropriate to announce Xue Ting’s matter to the public.” Li Guan looked at the three people around him.
Luo Tang nodded and said, “I also agree about not announcing it. This matter has terrible implications if word gets out. However, Xue Ting is about to head to the World Gap. Should the few Regis Godfiends in the World Gap be informed?”
“In the future, they might have to cooperate with King Calm Sea. It’s best to inform them. It’s fine if King True Martial, Dao Protector, and the others know,” said Li Guan.
“They should be informed,” said Qin Wu.
“I’ll tell them,” said Meng Chuan.
Li Guan nodded slightly before looking at the pool and saying, “He still needs two more days before the life modification process is completed. Let’s leave first. The guardian is guarding this place. There’s no need to worry about anything.” Soon, Meng Chuan and company left and returned to their residences to cultivate.
Two days later.
Li Guan, Qin Wu, Luo Tang, and Meng Chuan arrived again. They watched as the huge ice block in the pool began to melt.
Whoosh.
The ice around King Calm Sea’s body completely melted as he absorbed it into his body.
At that moment, King Calm Sea’s body seemed to have been carved into a dark-cyan ice sculpture. He stood up and closed his eyes as he assessed the completely different power in his body. Finally, he slowly opened his eyes, filled with excitement.
He now had overwhelming power!
“Thank you, Supremacies. Thank you, Master. Thank you, King Eastcalm.” King Calm Sea walked out of the pool and bowed. “You gave me a chance to continue slaying demons.”
“Humph.” Qin Wu grunted angrily. “If it weren’t for the war, you would have long been executed. Redeem yourself well in the future.”
“Yes,” replied King Calm Sea obediently without feeling vexed.
“I can sense that my body’s strength and speed far exceeds the past,” said King Calm Sea. “Supremacies, Master, please give me some pointers. How can I unleash the full strength of this body?”
“There are pros and cons to a modified lifeform. Although you can’t reach the Creation realm, you have an ice body,” said Li Guan. “You don’t have an Essence Soul, but that makes you invulnerable to any Essence Soul mystic technique. Essence Soul mystic techniques are completely useless against you.”
Meng Chuan listened from the side. He knew a lot of secrets, so he also understood that there were many strange lifeforms in the outer realm.
Some lifeforms were completely unafraid of Essence Soul mystic techniques. Some strange, special lifeforms were completely different. They were most afraid of Essence Soul mystic techniques, but any world-annihilative attacks would completely fail to work on them.
Everything had its vanquisher. To be invincible, one had to cultivate to an unimaginable realm. For example, a Sixth Tribulation Eminence or a Seventh Tribulation Eminence could be described as being capable of easily killing countless strange lifeforms.
“Although your ice body is powerful and can be restored after suffering some damage, you will die once it’s shattered,” said Li Guan. “Don’t rely on your powerful body to resist an enemy’s attacks. As for how you should fight? There are only two things an ice lifeform is good at. First, their bodies have relatively high strength and speed. Secondly, they’re good at using the power of ice. You can slowly figure it out when you reach the World Gap.”
“Yes.” King Calm Sea’s eyes were filled with excitement. He could sense his body’s complete transformation.
The Origins Treasure-Scarlet Cloud Heavenand other items were taken back by Archean Mountain, but some of them were returned to King Calm Sea. After all, he needed to patrol the World Gap for 300 years.
That day, Meng Chuan brought King Calm Sea to the World Gap.
“I’ll be fighting here for the next three centuries.” King Calm Sea landed on the World Gap’s ground as his battle intent surged. Endless frost energy was released, causing the surroundings to freeze.
King Calm Sea instantly brandished his sword and slashed at his palm. The palm-formed from the dark-cyan ice—was extremely hard. The terrifying strike only produced a white mark, but the frost energy quickly gathered and healed the wound.
King Calm Sea’s attacks have greatly increased in strength and speed. Previously, he only had the strength of an ordinary Creation realm expert. He now has the strength of a top Creation realm expert, yet his strike only caused a crack to appear on his palm. An ice lifeform’s body is indeed powerful.
King Calm Sea’s ice body was both his greatest advantage, and his only fatal weakness.
“Very good.” King Calm Sea felt the might of the strike and looked at his palm. He was even more satisfied with his new body.
He colluded with the demons because he wanted to learn powerful formulas to increase his strength. After undergoing the life modification process, his strength had increased, making him more confident in killing the demons. “I’m to patrol and fight in the World Gap for 300 years. During this period, I’m not allowed to return to the human world.” King Calm Sea looked at Meng Chuan beside him. “It’s a punishment for others, but it’s a reward for me.”
“Then enjoy it.” Meng Chuan brought King Calm Sea to meet King True Martial and company.
King Calm Sea looked forward to slaying demons. Meng Chuan, King True Martial, and company were also prepared to deal with demons. However, no fifth Firmament demon monarchs entered the World Gap.
In the blink of an eye, eight years had passed since Meng Chuan and company began their mission in the World Gap. Apart from killing some fifth Firmament demon monarchs on the first day, the rest of the days were very peaceful. They spent almost all their time cultivating. Huh? Meng Chuan took out his token and looked around. King True Martial, Peng Mu, Yun Jianhai, and King Calm Sea were all immersed in their cultivation.Whoosh.
He summoned Dao Protector Wang Shan from his Grotto-Heaven treasure.
“Senior Brother Wang,” said Meng Chuan. “Archean Mountain has summoned me. I’ll head back first.”
“Oh?” The Dao Protector was astonished. He looked around and smiled. “It looks like you were the only one summoned. Go. If King True Martial asks, I’ll tell them.”
Meng Chuan nodded and silently returned to the human world without disturbing his companions.
After tearing through the world membrane, Meng Chuan returned to Archean Mountain. Only an illusory Qin Wu was waiting at the top of the nameless mountain.
“Master, why did you suddenly summon me? Is there something important?” asked Meng Chuan.
Qin Wu smiled and said, “Your son, Meng An, has broken through to the Darkstar realm, becoming a Marquis Godfiend.”

chapters.title: Chapter 440 - Father and Son Fight
chapters.content:
Chapter 440 Father and Son Fight
“An’er broke through?” Meng Chuan was overjoyed.
When his son was 13, he came to Archean Mountain to cultivate. Over the years, Meng Chuan had fought waves of demons. Although things had settled down after he dealt with the one million demon monarchs, he had been inside the World Gap most of the time. He hadn’t met his son much.
His son was 32 years old this year.
“He became a Marquis Godfiend at the age of 32,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “He’s much stronger and talented than me.”
“You are different from him. You left the mountain early to fight demons. Furthermore, you only obtained the special body cultivation system when you were about to leave the mountain,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “Your son obtained a series of opportunities left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon. His opportunities are 1,000 times better than yours.”
Meng Chuan smiled.
The more outstanding his son was, the happier he was. Which father didn’t hope for the best for his child?
“In the past eight years, other than King Calm Sea’s matter, the world has been peaceful,” said the illusory Qin Wu. “Therefore, the pressure on the various cities has been greatly reduced. After Meng An became a Marquis Godfiend, we also summoned your wife, Liu Qiyue, to Archean Mountain. Your family can have a reunion.”
“Alright, thank you, Master.” Meng Chuan also missed his wife and children.
“What are you thanking me for? You are the one who has been giving your all,” said Qin Wu with a sigh.
Meng Chuan sighed and said, “Our generation of Godfiends can at least see the turning point in the war. In the past 800 years, more than 100,000 Godfiends have died in battle. Even Regis Godfiends that had entered deep slumbers had to awaken to continue fighting. Many generations of Godfiends fought the demons for their entire lives, but they failed to see any hope. Compared to them, we are considered very blessed.”
Qin Wu nodded slightly and smiled. “Go on. Your wife and family are at Bright Scenic Peak.”
“Alright.” Meng Chuan nodded and left in a flash.
Bright Scenic Peak.
Meng Chuan headed to his and Liu Qiyue’s original cave abode from when they were still cultivating on the mountain. Now, their children lived here.
Whoosh.
From high in the sky, Meng Chuan saw Liu Qiyue, Meng An, and Meng You sitting in the cave abode’s courtyard. They were drinking tea, chatting, and eating snacks. Liu Qiyue looked up when she sensed something. She couldn’t help but reveal a look of delight when she saw Meng Chuan flying over. Liu Qiyue stood up. “Ah Chuan.” Meng Chuan landed.
Meng An and Meng You also stood up and looked at Meng Chuan excitedly. “Dad.” “Ah Chuan, you’re back too.” Liu Qiyue walked over and said happily, “I thought you wouldn’t be free to return.” “The World Gap is still rather peaceful. The demons haven’t waged war against us Regis Godfiends. Over there, we mainly cultivate and pick up treasures,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. At the same time, he looked at his children. His son, Meng An, had a sharp aurawhich was much stronger than before. As for his daughter, Meng You, she was more reserved and carefree. She was stuck in the Great Solar realm.
“Not bad, both of you,” praised Meng Chuan in satisfaction.
“Dad, don’t praise me. Meng An is much better than me,” said Meng You with a smile.
Meng An humbly said, “I only happened to be lucky.”
“Hahaha, An’er, have you thought of your Marquis title?” Meng Chuan smiled as he sat down. His daughter, Meng You, immediately poured a cup of tea for her father. Meng Chuan smiled at his daughter.
“I’ve already told Archean Mountain that I’ll be named Marquis Feather Dragon,” said Meng An.
“Marquis Feather Dragon?” Meng Chuan was surprised. “Why this name?”
Meng An hesitated for a moment before shaking his head gently. “I just want this
title.”
Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue exchanged looks.
The couple believed that their son had some secrets. However, their son had already become a marquis Godfiend when he was only 32 years old. As his parents, they didn’t have to care too much about his matters.
The family of four drank tea and ate snacks as they chatted. “In the past eight years, the world has become much more peaceful. Many mortals in the wilderness have migrated to places outside the cities and live nearby,” said Liu Qiyue. “Therefore, many gathering grounds have appeared around each city. Without demons threatening the human world, people’s lives are much better.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. “What I did was just a short-term solution. To obtain complete peace, we need to resolve the biggest threats.”
Threats such as the World Gap—which he was currently dealing with. After dealing with this threat, only the World Entrances would be left. World Entrances gradually expanded over time. In the future, the pressure on the humans would be greater as more large and super-large World Entrances appeared.
However, as long as a World Entrance that allowed passage to demon sages didn’t appear, humanity had the confidence of defending the world! By guarding the World Entrances, the human world would be able to maintain its current peace. When the two worlds began separating from each other, the pressure on them would constantly decrease. Nobody knew if a World Entrance that allowed passage to demon sages would appear in the future. It all depended on luck.
The demons were unwilling to leave anything to luck, which is why they didn’t spare any effort or expenses in regards to their preparations for the World Gap.
“Ah Chuan,” said Liu Qiyue with a smile, “An’er finds it difficult to find an opponent now. Demons? There are no demons to be seen in the world. Find a Regis Godfiend? The city that a Regis Godfiend guards is secret. Also, I can’t face him in close combat with my archery skills. I’m just not suitable for guiding him.”
“Oh?” Meng Chuan looked at Meng An.
Meng An stared at his father with anticipation in his eyes. He stood up and cupped his hands. “Father, please give me some pointers.”
“Although An’er has just become a Marquis Godfiend, he has the strength to fight a Regis Godfiend,” said Liu Qiyue. “Ah Chuan, be careful.”
“No wonder it’s difficult for you to find suitable opponents.” Meng Chuan stood up. “Let’s go to the training grounds.” “Yes.” Meng An was very excited.
After a while, Liu Qiyue and Meng You stood by the side of the cave abode’s training grounds and watched.
“Dad, be careful.” Meng An held a silver spear in his hand, effusing a sharp aura.
“Come.” Meng Chuan stood opposite him leisurely.
Boom!
Meng An’s figure moved, and his entire body seemed to become one with the spear. A dazzling spear beam distorted the void and thrust at Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan stood there and nodded slightly. “You have the strength of a Regis Godfiend just after becoming a Marquis Godfiend. Impressive indeed. Back then, I just barely had the combat strength of a Regis Godfiend after cultivating an Undying body. I only had sufficiently strong means of fighting a Regis Godfiend after cultivation my frost baneful aura further.”
The terrifying spear beam stabbed at Meng Chuan, but the closer it got to Meng Chuan, the greater the repulsive force that acted on it.
Meng Chuan’s surroundings were somewhat dark.
The closer Meng An got to Meng Chuan, the greater the repulsive force that acted on him.
When his spear was just three feet away from Meng Chuan, it stopped moving completely, unable to approach Meng Chuan any further. “Oh?” Meng An was taken aback.
“This is the Seamless domain,” said Meng Chuan. “It’s a technique every Regis Godfiend has. Of course, Seamless domains have varying strengths when it comes to different Regis Godfiends.”
Meng Chuan’s Blood Droplet realm body allowed his dantian space to reach its limits. He also had a fifth-level Essence Soul and was at the peak of the Dharma Domain realm, making his Quintessential Essence extremely pure.
In terms of the Seamless domain, Meng Chuan’s was twice as strong as a peak Regis Godfiend’s. With just his Seamless domain defending him alone, only peak Regis Godfiend attacks had a chance of touching Meng Chuan! However, the attacks’ strength greatly decreased by the time it made it to him.
Of course, when fighting opponents at the level of Demon Sage Nine Abyss and Holy Lady Strings, the Seamless domain’s defensive capabilities were nothing worth mentioning.
Meng An was alarmed. “The Seamless domain is so powerful.”
“That strike of yours only has the strength of an ordinary Regis Godfiend. An ordinary peak Regis Godfiend can withstand it with just the Seamless domain,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “Alright, I’ll dispel the Seamless domain’s defense. Attack with all your might. Let me see the strength you have achieved after years of cultivation.”
“Yes.” Meng An understood the strength difference between them, but he felt that he could still give his father some surprises despite having cultivated 30 years fewer than his father.

chapters.title: Chapter 441 - Nine Samsara Tempering of the Heart
chapters.content:
Chapter 441 Nine Samsara Tempering of the Heart
A spear very suddenly arrived in front of Meng Chuan without any warning.
Pfft.
Meng Chuan stood rooted to the ground as he extended his fingertip and tapped the tip of the spear. The strange force on the spear tip was completely neutralized.
Meng An didn’t hesitate to retract his spear and strike again. Instantly, spear shadows filled the sky as Meng An attacked frantically, his spear techniques unpredictable and fast.
Some spear shadows seemed to come from the wind! They were fast and ethereal. Some spear shadows seemed to come from the fire! They were violent and ferocious. Some spear shadows seemed to come from the water! They were mild and bizarre...
These spear techniques complemented each other. Each attack chained with the next relentlessly, perfectly utilizing the techniques’ speed and variations to its fullest. Although each strike was at the level of an ordinary Regis Godfiend, ordinary Regis Godfiendswho had weaker defensive means-might very well suffer. However, Meng Chuan easily blocked each attack with his finger. In terms of variability, Meng Chuan far surpassed Meng An. How could Meng Anwho had just reached the Realm of Daocompare with the Cloud Dragon Snake Saber Art, which was at the peak of the Dharma Domain realm?
In terms of speed, how could he compete with the fastest person in the world, Meng Chuan?
Therefore, Meng Chuan easily tapped the spear tip with his finger every single time.
Blocking my spear art with just a finger? Meng An felt the huge gap between them. The spear art he was proud of was too weak in front of his father.
Boom!
Meng An was very proud. He wanted his father to acknowledge his strength, so he instantly executed his ultimate technique.
The spear’s might and speed increased exponentially.
Again, Meng Chuan easily blocked it with his finger, but he was somewhat surprised by the attack. “This move has the strength of a top Regis Godfiend. Not bad!”
Back then, only after he became a Marquis Godfiend for a few years, cultivated an Undying Body, had his frost baneful aura domain and Heaven’s Wrath—his divine power — did his overall strength barely reach the standards of a top Regis Godfiend.
For his son to unleash such strength shortly after becoming a Marquis Godfiend, his son was indeed much stronger than he was back then.
Swoosh.
Meng An retracted his spear and looked at his father. He said, “Dad, you easily cracked my ultimate technique. There’s no need for me to continue attacking. Dad, my spear arts are quite good at defense. Dad, please attack. I’ll defend.”
As he spoke, the void around Meng An distorted. A five-colored light filled the area. Meng An held his spear and looked at his father.
“Alright, I’ll attack. You defend.” Meng Chuan smiled and gently stretched out his finger.
A beam of light shot out from his fingertip; it had a terrifying might.
The five-colored domain distorted as it blocked the light beam. The light beam gradually weakened as it flew closer towards Meng An.
Meng An also executed his spear art. His spear spun as it swept through the beam like a tidal wave, completely blocking it. With a boom, the beam collided with Meng An, causing him to stagger three steps back. However, he remained unharmed.
“It’s not bad that you can block a top Regis Godfiend’s attack head-on,” praised Meng Chuan. “The next move will have the strength of a peak Regis Godfiend.”
Another light beam shot out from Meng Chuan’s fingertip.
The light beam’s aura was terrifying.
In an instant, it pierced through the five-colored domain.
How fast. Meng An used his spear in an attempt to block the light beam, but the beam of light was so fast that it moved in a bizarre way. It actually brushed past Meng An’s spear shaft and headed straight for his head.
What? Meng An panicked.
As the beam approached Meng An, it grazed past his ear, leaving a bloody mark.
Meng An heaved a sigh of relief.
“It isn’t just strength that separates a top Regis Godfiend and a peak Regis Godfiend. The difference in combat prowess is also to do with one’s technique realm,” said Meng Chuan. “A peak Regis Godfiend’s techniques are even more profound than that of an ordinary Regis Godfiend. With your current spear skills, it’s naturally more than enough for you to fight an ordinary Regis Godfiend. You might even gain the upper hand against them. However, if you encounter a top Regis Godfiend, you will be at a disadvantage. If you encounter a peak Regis Godfiend, you won’t be able to fight back at
all.”
“I understand,” said Meng An respectfully before looking at Meng Chuan expectantly. “What if I encounter a Creation realm expert?”
“A Creation realm expert?” Meng Chuan smiled.
Whoosh.
From a distance, Meng Chuan suddenly appeared in front of Meng An. He tapped Meng An’s glabella with his fingertip.
“Ah.” Meng An was shocked.
“You have just encountered a Creation realm expert,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “You won’t even know how you died.”
Meng Chuan only had the strength of an ordinary Creation realm expert if he didn’t use a Tribulation treasure or his divine powerslike flowing Sand and Heaven Earth Control.
Meng An found it unbelievable. “Dad, I clearly didn’t even see you move with my Samsara Domain and Darkstar Domain, but you were already in front of me. You’re too fast.” “To a Creation realm expert, this bit of speed can only give them a slight advantage,” said Meng Chuan. In front of his son, he only showcased a speed of 30 kilometers per second. This speed was only slightly superior to a Creation realm expert. Of course, his true speed was 500 kilometers per second. It was also his greatest strength when he fought in the World Gap.
There was no need to show his son his true speed.
“In the past few years on the mountain, I fought Archean Mountain Lord and Elder Yi once.” Meng An looked at his father excitedly. “But, I was only slightly disadvantaged.” “Mountain Lord and Elder Yi aren’t peak Regis Godfiends,” explained Meng Chuan. “Also, they are busy. Don’t disturb them unnecessarily.”
“I understand.” Meng An nodded.
Liu Qiyue and Meng You walked over.
Liu Qiyue smiled and said, “An’er, do you understand what you’re lacking now?” “Yes.” Meng An nodded. “I was proud of my spear arts. I originally thought my defense was powerful, but now, I’ve discovered too many flaws.”
“Your father is the strongest Regis Godfiend in the world when it comes to defense,” said Liu Qiyue with a smile.
“Dad, how should I perfect my defensive means?” asked Meng An.
Meng Chuan smiled as he looked at his son. “There are two main things you should focus on. Firstly, you should improve your spear art technique realm. The higher your technique realm is, the stronger your defense will be. Secondly, learn some special defensive means such as domains, movement techniques, or even special mystic techniques.
“Take me for example,” continued Meng Chuan, “I’m the fastest person in the world. If I want to escape, Creation Supremacies and demon sages won’t be able to catch up. This is just one of my life-preservation means. I can also stand still and allow the enemy to attack me, but they will have to shatter the void to touch me. I also have defensive divine powers and a powerful body. Apart from these two things, your Essence Soul is also very important. In a life-and-death battle, the enemy will focus on attacking your flaws. If your Essence Soul is weak, the enemy will directly kill you with an Essence Soul mystic technique. No matter how high your technique realm is, it’ll be useless against Essence Soul mystic techniques.”
“Essence Soul?” Meng An nodded slightly. “Sparring is one thing, but a life-and-death battle is another matter,” said Meng Chuan. “Either you don’t have any shortcomings, or you have to be careful and keep them a secret. Once they are exposed, and your weaknesses are targeted, you will die.” Meng Chuan smiled at his son. “You have just been conferred the title of Marquis. The human world is now considered peaceful. Cultivate well and make up for your shortcomings. Make yourself stronger.”
Meng An nodded. “I will.” His initial pride had been completely crushed by his father. He could sense the huge strength difference between them. His father had only cultivated about 30 years longer than him, but the gap between them was already this huge.
“Cultivate diligently.” Meng Chuan looked at his son. “Even I am considered very weak on this path of cultivation. I haven’t even reached the minimum threshold to enter the River of Spacetime. Work hard. More World Entrances will appear in the future. All of you will have to guard them together.” Even if he could resolve the threat of the World Gap, as more and more World Entrances appeared, humanity needed enough Godfiends to guard the World Entrances.
“I will guard a city like Dad and Mom,” said Meng An.
“Remember, you have to pay attention to your Essence Soul,” reminded Meng Chuan.
Meng An nodded. “Understood.”
No wonder... It was no wonder Ancestral Master Archean Eon had such high expectations on one’s Essence Soul. It’s no wonder Ancestral Master Archean Eon made me experience the Nine Samsara Tempering of the Heart. Are the Nine Samsaras really just an illusion? Meng An thought to himself. But everything is so real. I remember those people and matters clearly.

chapters.title: Chapter 442 - Demon Teams
chapters.content:
Chapter 442 Demon Teams
Meng Chuan enjoyed the happy family reunion at Archean Mountain. However, three days later, he returned to the World Gap.
Time passed
Years passed.
After Meng Chuan resolved the threat of a million demon monarchs, the human world experienced rare peace. It reached the point where many of the younger generation had never seen demons before.
In the blink of an eye, 15 years had passed since Meng Chuan and company had begun their mission in the World Gap.
In a dark chamber.
The chamber was engraved with dense runes. Demon Sage Fire Dragon and Demon Sage Deep Profundity stood in the chamber as they looked at the pool in front of them.
The runes emitted silver-white light. On the surface of the pool, Imperial Lord Starquix appeared.
“One more year.” Deep Profundity said respectfully, “In a year, the two of us will become the strongest below the demon sage realm.”
“Alright,” said Imperial Lord Starquix coldly. “The Demon Realm will wait another year. A year later, we will launch an all-out attack. We won’t forget your contributions if you succeed.”
“Thank you, Imperial Lord,” replied the two demon sages obediently. According to the plan, the two of them would go to two separate spots in the human world that were tens of thousands of kilometers apart. They would simultaneously blast through the world membrane and head to the World Gap.
As long as one successfully entered the World Gap, they would map the corresponding connection points between the human world and the World Gap.
With a complete map, the demons could easily send fifth Firmament demon monarchs into the human world through the World Gap.
The Demon Realm, Lady Blackmoon’s Ice Palace.
The three Imperial Lords sat in the hall.
“The all-out attack will happen in a year.” Imperial Lord Starquix looked at his two companions. “Before the all-out attack, we should first sweep the World Gap clean.”
“Yes.” Emperor Roc nodded slightly. “Over the years, our avatars have worked hard to exchange for treasures in the outer realm so that we can nurture the fifth Firmament demon monarchs at all costs. It’s time for them to repay us.” Lady Blackmoon smiled and said, “The human world’s Creation Supremacies don’t dare go to the outer realm. Even if they want to nurture Regis Godfiends, they can only use what they have accumulated in the past. They are definitely far inferior to our Demon Realm. By the way, which demon monarchs are we sending to the World Gap to hunt the Godfiends?”
Emperor Roc looked at Imperial Lord Starquix.
“I’ve already given it some thought.” Imperial Lord Starquix waved his hand, and two illusory figures appeared in midair. One was a black-robed, dragon-headed elder and a silver-robed woman with feelers on her forehead.
“Poison Dragon has a black water body. Its Essence Soul has been scattered and fused with every drop of black water,” said Imperial Lord Starquix. “Even if it suffers an attack from a Magic Awl, it can only destroy a tiny portion of the black water’s Essence Soul. The damage a Magic Awl can deal to Poison Dragon’s Essence Soul is not worth mentioning. It’s impossible for Regis Godfiends to kill Poison Dragon.”
Lady Blackmoon and Emperor Roc agreed.
“Now that Poison Dragon has refined five poisonous objects and a Tribulation treasureWater Essence Bead-its poisonous, black water is several times more potent. Its combat strength has also greatly increased,” said Imperial Lord Starquix with a smile. “Even if the Creation Supremacies-Qin Wu and Li Guan—in the human world were to attack, they would probably only be able to trap Poison Dragon’s black water body and seal it. It would be very difficult to kill Poison Dragon.”
The black water body was truly perfect. With his black water body, Patriarch Poison Dragon reigned supreme in the Demon Realm. “Demon Monarch Coldmonon is the other person we’re sending in.” Imperial Lord Starquix pointed at the silver-robed woman. “There are three fifth Firmament demon monarchs that have a sixth-level Essence Soul. Demon Monarch Coldmoon is one of them. Furthermore, she has successfully transformed into a phantom lifeform and can travel through the shadow world. With a Tribulation treasure, she has the ability to act alone.”
When Lady Blackmoon heard that, she couldn’t help but say, “Although the two of them have quite powerful life-preservation means, their offensive means are rather weak.” “At the very least, they can deal with weaker Regis Godfiends,” said Imperial Lord Starquix with a smile. “Among Regis Godfiends, King Thousand Wood, King Gu Eyes, and the others aren’t that strong in a head-on battle. Patriarch Poison Dragon and the others can also create miracles if they are used well. In terms of offensive means, we have three other trump cards—Peacock, Strings, and the Eighteen Black River Guard.”
“The Eighteen Black River Guard was obtained by Brother Roc when he went to Black River Realm for negotiations. We then selected 18 demon monarchs to refine the Black River Life Caskets so as to form the Eighteen Black River Guard,” said Imperial Lord Starquix. “These 18 demon monarchs can form a 400-kilometer-wide Black River Array. Godfiends will probably be corroded and reduced to dust instantly if they enter. These 18 demon monarchs will be located at the Black River Array’s core... If the human Godfiends want to attack with an Essence Soul mystic technique, they will be too far away. They won’t be able to reach them.”
Essence Soul mystic techniques had limited range. For example, the Magic Awl could only be used within the caster’s Essence Soul domain. A sixth-level Essence Soul’s domain only had a range of 25 kilometers.
“I’ve long heard of the Eighteen Black River Guard’s fame. I naturally thought of a way to exchange for them,” said Emperor Roc with a smile. “Although the two Imperial Lords of Black River Realm are arrogant, they still kept my reputation in consideration.”
In the surrounding region, the three Imperial Lords of the Demon Realm were rather famous. Emperor Roc was even more famous than the other two.
“Eighteen Black River Guard, along with Strings and Peacock,” said Imperial Lord Starquix with a smile. “Demon Monarch Strings has improved in every aspect after obtaining the Nine Lives Cocoon. It can protect its Essence Soul. It’s the most well-rounded fifth Firmament demon monarch. It can roam freely in the World Gap.”
“As for Peacock... We’ve spent the most on Peacock all these years,” said Imperial Lord Starquix. “We’re about to see the results now.”
“Alright, we’ll use them,” said Lady Blackmoon with a smile.
Emperor Roc nodded as well. “With such strength, it’s enough to wipe the World Gap clean.”
“I’ll summon them,” said Imperial Lord Starquix.
Moments later
Figures rushed into the hall.
They were the black-veiled Holy Lady Strings, the black-robed, dragon-headed Patriarch Poison Dragon, Demon Monarch Coldmoonwho stood alone in the corner-and the Eighteen Black River Guard, whose bodies were covered in flowing runes.
After they arrived, Monarch Peacock slowly took his time to enter the hall.
Monarch Peacock’s long black hair flowed down to his waist. He was tall and muscular; his purple eyes were filled with a domineering aura. When he walked into the hall, he casually cupped his hands. “Greetings, Imperial Lords.”
Emperor Roc and company exchanged looks and felt helpless.
There was nothing they could say or do...
Monarch Peacock did not have more than 100 years to live. He wanted to break through to become a demon sage, but his age made it impossible. He wanted to extend his lifespan, but there were only two ways to do so in the Demon Realm. However, these two methods were unable to affect his Dark Peacock bloodline. Instead, the Dark Peacock bloodline devoured external powers.
As for independently figuring out the Yin-Yang Transformation’s profundities, thus, reversing his age? In terms of technique realm, he was inferior to Holy Lady Strings. Furthermore, he cultivated the Darkness lineage. Even if he reached the Heaven Earth realm, he wouldn’t be able to regain his youth. After all, this lineage didn’t allow one to reverse their age.
Thus, Monarch Peacock had no hope of extending his lifespan.
Because of this, Monarch Peacock lived each day like it was his last. It was natural for him to live without desires. He lived carefreely. Even the three Imperial Lords were rather tolerant of him. As long as Monarch Peacock obeyed their orders, the three Imperial Lords tolerated his actions.
“All of you are much stronger than before.” Imperial Lord Starquix smiled as he looked down and said, “You are now needed to fight. Go to the World Gap and kill all Godfiends you encounter.”
“Yes.” Monarch Peacock and company bowed.

chapters.title: Chapter 443 - Bottleneck
chapters.content:
Chapter 443 Bottleneck
“You will be split into two teams.” Imperial Lord Starquix sat high in the hall, his voice echoing. “Demon Monarch Peacock and the Eighteen Black River Guard will form one team. Demon Monarch Strings, Demon Monarch Coldmoon, and Demon Monarch Poison Dragon will form another team. This way, each person can cooperate with each other and increase the team’s overall strength. You will also have greater confidence in killing Godfiends.”
“Yes,” said Monarch Peacock and company respectfully.
