Although they didn’t know their companions’ current strength, they trusted the Imperial Lords very much. The Imperial Lords had better judgment than them.
Moments later,
The three Imperial Lords led Monarch Peacock and the other demon monarchs to an area more than 500 kilometers away from Ice Palace.
Boom!
With a single punch, Emperor Roc tore through the Demon Realm and World Gap’s world membranes. He blasted open a thousand-foot-wide hole. Through the hole, one could see the vast World Gap.
“You should understand the importance of this mission,” said Emperor Roc coldly. “If you do well, we won’t be stingy with our rewards. Us three Imperial Lords will do what we promised you. However, if anyone deliberately doesn’t put in the effort... don’t blame us for being heartless.”
“Don’t worry, Imperial Lord.”
“We will do our best.”
Monarch Peacock and Patriarch Poison Dragon held their breaths as they immediately replied.
Although they were the strongest fifth Firmament demon monarchs and all of them had improved, the Imperial Lords could still kill them with just a thought.
Even Patriarch Poison Dragon-who was known for his Undying body-could easily be sealed in a void by the Imperial Lords. Once he was trapped in this void, they could completely shatter the void and all its contents. Patriarch Poison Dragon would also be destroyed. This would happen in the blink of an eye.
With the absolute difference in strength, even the arrogant Monarch Peacock had to obey their orders.
“GO,” instructed Lady Blackmoon.
After Monarch Peacock and the other demon monarchs bowed, they immediately entered the huge hole and flew into the World Gap.
In the World Gap.
Monarch Peacock and company landed on the ground and looked at each other.
“The Imperial Lords are willing to pay any price to conquer the human world,” said Holy Lady Strings. “Therefore, we can’t afford to be negligent. If we anger the Imperial Lords, the consequences would be disastrous.” “For the Imperial Lords’ rewards, we have to do our best,” said a demon monarch in the Eighteen Black River Guard with a smile.
“Split up,” said Monarch Peacock coldly before flying into the distance.
“Brother Peacock.” The Eighteen Black River Guard hurriedly followed. They were in the same team as Monarch Peacock.
“Let’s go as well.” Holy Lady Strings glanced at her two companions. “The two of you will have to brief me about your current strength in detail. Only then will we have better teamwork.”
“It’s only right.” “We need to understand each other if we want to work together.”
As they chatted, the team left quietly.
In the World Gap, at the fracture between the land and sky.
Meng Chuan, King True Martial, King Calm Sea, Peng Mu, and Yun Jianhai were cultivating. They didn’t disturb each other.
King Calm Sea, who now had a deep-cyan ice body, looked at the darkness beyond the fractured area. Every time, he would accumulate strength for a long time before slashing at the darkness. King Calm Sea—who had now been a modified lifeform for 11 years
-had improved after staying in the World Gap for so long. His sword techniques moved closer and closer to perfection.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
Densely-packed figures disappeared one after another, leaving only Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in confusion. He looked up at the purple lightning that illuminated the endless darkness. It’s been 15 years since I came to the World Gap. I believe that I have accumulated enough insights in the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique. However, I’m still stuck at the final bottleneck.
Based on his understanding of lightning and the two Tribulation-level ultimate techniques
– Lightning Realm and Three World Saber... His cumulative insights in the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique was enough for it to reach the Grotto-Heaven realm.
The Infinite Saber pursues extreme speed. It has to break free of the worldly laws’ suppression. I can understand why it is so difficult for me to make a breakthrough in it. However, the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique doesn’t need to break free the worldly laws’ suppression. It shouldn’t be that difficult to break through.
It’s no wonder that so many Regis Godfiends are unable to reach the Grotto-Heaven realm. This step is indeed difficult to take. It’s already so difficult to make the breakthrough with the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique. Making the breakthrough with Infinite Saber will be even harder than I imagined.
Meng Chuan had been somewhat vexed recently.
When stuck at a bottleneck, one couldn’t advance any further. One didn’t even know how to improve themselves, so one would naturally be worried.
If he didn’t figure it out, he would be stuck at this step forever!
I’ve been stuck at the bottleneck for over a year. What do I lack? How can I make the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique reach the Grotto-Heaven realm? Meng Chuan pondered for a long time but couldn’t come up with a solution.
Forget it. I’ll do the same old. Since the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique is stuck at a bottleneck, I’ll cultivate Infinite Saber first. I might end up getting a streak of inspiration. After all, they are both from the lightning lineage.
Meng Chuan drew his Demon Slayer and attempted to cultivate the Infinite Saber. However, he suddenly sensed something stirring in the distant void. Although he had yet to reach the Grotto-Heaven realm, his perception of the void was indeed sharper than most.
That direction. King True Martial, King Calm Sea, Peng Mu, and Yun Jianhai turned their heads at the same time. They felt an even stronger sensation as they felt the world membrane crack.
Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish!
The five immediately gathered.
King True Martial said solemnly, “The world membrane has been destroyed. Furthermore, it’s connected to the Demon Realm. The demons have likely sent demon monarchs in.”
The demons are finally taking action? Peng Mu, Yun Jianhai, and King Calm Sea were filled with fighting spirit.
“Meng Chuan, bring us there at full speed,” said King True Martial.
“Alright.” Meng Chuan nodded.
His Seamless domain enveloped everyone as they transformed into a bolt of lightning. They quickly rushed towards the source of the commotion.
“The demons have come to the World Gap.”
“The battle is finally about to begin.”
The five Regis Godfiends from Black Sand Grotto-Heaven and Two World Island also sensed the commotion.
“Let’s go.” King Molten’s fighting spirit soared. “I’ll bring everyone there.”
“Sorry for troubling you, King Molten,” said King Thousand Wood with a smile.
Invisible waves enveloped everyone present as they quickly rushed towards the rift in the world membrane.
Meng Chuan’s team was even faster, but the demons had already split into two teams and taken action. They arrived to see nothing.
On the contrary, King Molten’s slower team only flew for more than two hours before they encountered Holy Lady Strings’s team.
Huh?
The void rippled as a black-robed woman, a black-robed, dragon-headed elder, and a silver-robed woman appeared.
“Demons.” King Molten, King Transcendence, King Northcleanse, King Gu Eyes, and King Thousand Wood also appeared. They probed each other with their domains and discovered one another.
“Human Godfiends? Don’t even think about escaping.” Holy Lady Strings’s killing intent was biting cold. She had suffered at Meng Chuan’s hands previously. Void threads appeared within a 150-kilometer radius around her.
Previously, her domain only had a radius of 50 kilometers. Now she could expand to a 150-kilometer radius, allowing her to envelop the five Godfiends.
Patriarch Poison Dragon and Demon Monarch Coldmoon similarly had immense killing intent.
“Kill them.” King Molten’s body was covered in a layer of armor. At the same time, golden flames erupted from his body and spread out. The power of the golden flames was terrifying, and it rapidly burned Holy Lady Strings’s void threads into nothingness. In an instant, a five-kilometer area around him turned into a sea of fire.
King Molten had refined a Tribulation treasure
—the Fire Refinement Star Cauldron—which was given to him by Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s Halberd Hall. With his accomplishments in the fire lineage, the Fire Refinement Star Cauldron had terrifying might.
At that moment, the Fire Refinement Star Cauldron in his body constantly spewed out golden flames that burned in all directions.
His fire domain protected his companions as they charged towards Holy Lady Strings and company at high speeds. King Transcendence, King Northcleanse, King Thousand Wood, and King Gu Eyes were filled with killing intent.
“Good timing.” Holy Lady Strings was very patient. The Nine Lives Cocoon in her body began to release threads. The Nine Lives Cocoon’s threads mixed with her void silk and spread out in all directions.

chapters.title: Chapter 444 - Fire Refinement Star Cauldron
chapters.content:
Chapter 444 Fire Refinement Star Cauldron
The gap between the two parties closed-75 kilometers, 70 kilometers, 65 kilometers...
The demon team and the human team rapidly approached each other. To Holy Lady Strings, she felt like the number of threads released by the Nine Lives Cocoon was limited. Furthermore, the further they were from her, the harder it would be to control them. She determined that a distance of 50 kilometers was optimal.
“Let them get close,” said Holy Lady Strings via voice transmission. “However, King Thousand Wood’s Magic Awl is extremely terrifying. We can’t let them come within 25 kilometers. Therefore... attack when we are 35 kilometers away.”
“Alright,” replied Demon Monarch Coldmoon calmly.
“Haha, even if human Regis Godfiends reach the Grotto-Heaven realm, they can only unleash their full strength when they are within a range of five kilometers. If they try to attack from 35 kilometers? They pose almost zero threat to us,” said Patriarch Poison Dragon via voice transmission as he laughed. “I have an undying body. Sister Coldmoon is also an illusory lifeform. Strings, you are especially good at long-range attacks. With the three of us working together, we can attack our enemies with our strengths. We can easily crush them before they reach us.”
Boom
The raging fire domain protected the five Godfiends as they rapidly approached.
The moment the distance between them shrank to 35 kilometers
“Attack,” said Holy Lady Strings via voice transmission.
Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish!
A large number of void spider threads were unable to penetrate the flame domain, but at that moment, the faint runes on the threads’ surface glowed, allowing them to penetrate the flame domain instantly.
These threads were extremely tough. The flames were unable to burn through them.
The golden flames burned fiercely as they surged in all directions. They also attacked the Nine Lives Cocoon threads. The Nine Lives Cocoon threads continued attacking the Godfiends despite the impact forcing it back.
Not good. King Molten’s expression changed. Demon Monarch Strings is so powerful.
Clang! Clang! Clang! King Northcleanse—who was standing beside King Molten-was clad in silver armor. He stretched out his palm, and 13 tiny divine swords flew out from his palm. After they flew out, the divine swords naturally grew larger. The 13 divine swords scattered to form a sword formation—which protected the area around them. The five Godfiends tried their best to block the Nine Lives Cocoon threads. Under the obstruction of the array formation, more than half of them were blocked.
However, there were too many Nine Lives Cocoon threads. All of them were extraordinary in strength, so some of them still managed to penetrate the obstruction.
The fire domain and the 13 sword formation were unable to block the threads completely.
“Forest World.” King Thousand Wood waved his hand, and wooden columns appeared around him-which naturally formed an array formation. Countless branches grew out from each wooden pillar as they intertwined with each other. They constantly lashed out at each of the Nine Lives Cocoon threads that passed by.
King Thousand Wood had a sixth-level Essence Soul, and Two World Island highly valued him. Although Two World Island couldn’t give him a Tribulation treasure, they still gave him an Imperial Lord-level array formation treasure. With King Thousand Wood’s cultivation and technique realm, his strength was extraordinary.
Huh? Holy Lady Strings frowned slightly. The attack failed?
She originally believed that once she attacked with the tribulation treasure—Nine Lives Cocoon-it would have a chance of killing a Godfiend.
However, the fire domain weakened nearly half of the Nine Lives Cocoon threads. The sword formation blocked more than half of the remaining threads. In fact, the remaining threads’ strength was already attenuated. Due to this reduction in strength, the threads were unable to break through the Forest World array formation. “I thought we had to hide in the Fire Refinement Star Cauldron.” King Molten smiled when he saw this. He couldn’t move or do anything to the cauldron if Godfiends were hiding in it. Likewise, the Godfiends within the cauldron could only hide.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The poisonous, churning black water attacked.
“Be careful.” King Transcendence’s expression changed slightly.
A shadow suddenly descended and appeared beside King Thousand Wood in the fire domain, stabbing right at his head. Although the wooden column attempted to block the blow, the distance between the two was just too short.
“Roar!” King Gu Eyes beside King Thousand Wood opened his mouth and struck the sword with his tongue.
The tongue was as fast as lightning.
Bam!
The sword was sent flying.
The tongue wrapped around the shadow, only for it to dissipate.
“Brother Gu Eyes, thank you,” said King Thousand Wood.
“The sect ordered me to protect you well.” At that moment, King Gu Eyes’s head had become ugly and huge. Countless protruding toad heads appeared, but in the blink of an eye, he returned to his normal human appearance.
His body had long been modified. He was a powerful Worm King.
Before the demons invaded Two World Island, Two World Island had been suppressed by Black Sand Grotto-Heaven for a long time. This caused many Godfiends in Two World Island to have distorted mental states. In order to become stronger, they had gathered many evil formulas. The Worm King transformation was very evil and cruel, but after succeeding, one’s combat strength would soar tremendously. In contrast to their past behavior, the Godfiends from Two World Island had calmed down over the past 800 years.
“Humph.” King Transcendence’s figure had already entered the shadow world. Everyone present had a keen perception of the void. They could vaguely sense two living beings in the shadow world.
One was King Transcendence, and the other was Demon Monarch Coldmoon.
“Humans can also modify themselves into a phantom lifeform.” Coldmoon looked at King Kong in surprise.
“Let’s see who’s more powerful?” King Transcendence sneered as he looked at his opponent and instantly charged at her. The two fought in the shadow world. Occasionally, they would split out shadows to sneak an attack. The terrifying aspect of phantom lifeforms was that they could travel through the shadow world and use their shadow clones to attack their enemy. Even if the shadow clone was destroyed, it didn’t result in any damage to the main body at all. However, as one’s cultivation level increased, experts could gradually enter the shadow world as well.
The poisonous black water blotted out the sky as it attempted to drown the human Godfiends. However, it was burned by the fire domain, causing a colorful, poisonous gas to rise from the periphery of the fire domain constantly. The golden flames were the poison’s bane.
“My poison is being restrained. I can’t penetrate the fire domain at all,” said Patriarch Poison Dragon via voice transmission. “I’ll send my black water clone to charge in.”
Boom!
In the churning black water, black dragons took form. Each black dragon had terrifying might as they charged into the fire domain.
Although the fire domain burned them, the condensed black dragons could withstand it completely, not evaporating at all.
“With the Water Essence Bead, I’m much stronger in direct combat.” Patriarch Poison Dragon was rather confident of his strength. Previously, he had purely relied on his undying body and poison to deal with his enemies. His offensive means weren’t strong, but after being nurtured by the three Imperial Lords and being bestowed a Tribulation treasure that was extremely suitable for him—Water Essence Bead-his combat prowess had transformed.
Break!
The 13 sword formation moved.
The sword beams tore through the black dragons with terrifying might!
“The Thirteen Swordbanes are too powerful.” Patriarch Poison Dragon’s expression changed slightly. He could maintain the strength of nine black dragons, but there were Thirteen Swordbanes—these Swordbanes truly restrained the black water dragons.
“Well done.” A sharp glint flashed through Holy Lady Strings’s eyes.
Without the sword array’s obstruction, Holy Lady Strings could make her move.
The Forest World array formation still obstructed the Nine Lives Cocoon threads, but at that moment, the threads rapidly gathered and formed a white snake.
Boom!
After the numerous threads gathered, the giant white snake revealed tremendous might. It easily thrashed through the Forest World array formation and shot straight at King Thousand Wood. The demon monarchs had to kill King Thousand Wood—who had a sixth-level Essence Soul. The demons were most afraid of King True Martial and King Thousand Wood.
“Get lost.” A huge cauldron suddenly appeared in King Molten’s hand, one that was several times larger than himself. Golden flames constantly surged out from the cauldron.
Boom!
King Molten held the cauldron in his hand as his strike pierced through the void several kilometers away, striking the white snake.
The white snake was the amalgamation of more than half of the Tribulation treasure’sNine Lives Cocoon-threads. Holy Lady Strings put all her strength into that attack.
It was said that the Fire Refinement Star Cauldron was refined from an outer realm planet. It was most suitable for ‘smashing’ opponents in head-on battles. However, King Molten had limited strength. He could only unleash a portion of the Tribulation treasure’s power. Even so, the strike was still extremely terrifying
Boom!
Due to the smash, the white snake exploded. The numerous threads scattered in all directions as they were blasted out of the fire domain by the violent flames.
“You only have one cauldron. Let’s see how many spots you can block.” Holy Lady Strings’s charming face contorted slightly. Numerous Nine Lives Cocoon threads gathered once again. This time, they formed three smaller white snakes.

chapters.title: Chapter 445 - Archean Mountain Godfiends Are Here!
chapters.content:
Chapter 445 Archean Mountain Godfiends Are Here!
“King Northcleanse, help King Molten. Leave these black dragon clones to me,” said King Thousand Wood via voice transmission.
“Alright.” King Northcleanse immediately directed the 13 divine swords to attack one of the white snakes with a single thought. Boom! Boom! Boom!
The formation consisting of the 13 swords completely blocked the white snake’s charge.
As for King Molten, he held an enormous cauldron in his hand. With a single strike, he tore through kilometers of the void and destroyed a white snake. With another strike, he defeated another white snake. The golden flames that kept spewing out of the cauldron sent the white snake flying into the distance. King Molten could still fend off two white snakes at the same time.
The black dragons roared. However, under the golden fire domain’s suppression, the nine black dragon clones’ strength was greatly reduced. They were unable to break through the dense Forest World array formation’s obstruction.
“Damn it.” Seeing this, Holy Lady Strings frowned slightly.
The Nine Lives Cocoon that she chose was stronger when it came to preserving her life, but it had weaker offensive strength. She only had two reasons for choosing this Tribulation treasure. Firstly, she was being cautious. Secondly, although the Tribulation treasure’s offensive power was weaker, it was still a boon for her overall strength.
With the Nine Lives Cocoon, her combat prowess was boosted to the peak of the Creation realm. With such strength, she believed that it was enough to deal with the human Godfiends in the World Gap.
However, who would have thought that she would encounter King Molten? King Molten was the strongest Black Sand Grotto Lord Regis Godfiend in the past 1,000 years. After cultivating in the World Gap for many years, he had improved from the middle stages of the Grotto-Heaven realm to the late stages of the Grotto-Heaven realm. Although he didn’t create his own ultimate technique like Holy Lady Strings, he was capable of dealing with more than half of Holy Lady Strings’s strength alone after obtaining the Fire Refinement Star Cauldron. Now that he was cooperating with his companions, he could put up a complete defence against her attacks.
Swish! Swish!
Demon Monarch Coldmoon and King Transcendence fought in the shadow world.
Demon Monarch Coldmoon had a slightly lower technique realm than King Transcendence. However, she had a Tribulation treasure. As for King Transcendence, his technique realm was higher and more profound than hers. Thus, the battle between the two was naturally intense. He delivered attacks to his opponent again and again. However, both parties alternated between their true bodies and shadow clones! After piercing his sword into his opponent’s body each time, he realized that the true body had already become a shadow.
“Go.” As Demon Monarch Coldmoon killed the shadow clones, she used an Essence Soul mystic technique to attack King Transcendence. She had a sixth-level Essence Soul. Even if she cultivated ordinary Essence Soul mystic techniques, they were certainly strong enough. Her Essence Soul fluctuations surged towards King Transcendence like waves.
“Magic Awl.” King Transcendence’s Essence Soul domain sensed the terrifying waves rushing towards him. With a thought, his Magic Awl-which was refined from 30% of his Essence Soul’s Origins-flew towards the fluctuations. The sharp Magic Awl moved against the waves, greatly dispersing its might.
He didn’t dare use his Magic Awl to attack a sixth-level Essence Soul. However, the Magic Awl could be used to crack an enemy’s Essence Soul mystic technique.
Whoosh.
King Transcendence returned to the outside world and came to King Molten’s side. He didn’t look too good. “That Demon Monarch Coldmoon has a Tribulation treasure. I can’t kill it.”
“Holy Lady Strings is also very powerful. We’re completely trapped inside her domain—which is formed from her countless spider threads.” King Molten held the cauldron and had an extremely solemn expression on his face.
The golden fire domain only spanned five kilometers wide. Only with the golden fire domain resisting the attacks, weakening them, could King Molten and King Northclean resist the Nine Lives Cocoon threads.
“We won’t be able to escape them with the threads in the way,” said King Gu Eyes. He didn’t attempt to release his poisonous worms because he knew that his poisonous worms couldn’t withstand the threads’ attacks.
Just Holy Lady Strings alone was enough to make them feel tremendous pressure. “It’s very cautious. It doesn’t dare let me come within 25 kilometers,” said King Thousand Wood via voice transmission. “If I am within 25 kilometers of it, I can attack it with my Magic Awl.”
“Let’s wait,” said King Molten calmly. “We won’t be able to escape, but they also won’t be able to do anything to us. When Archean Mountain Godfiends arrive, we will be able to counterattack.”
Meng Chuan-on the Bloodblade Disc-was indeed rushing over with King True Martial, King Calm Sea, Peng Mu, and Yun Jianhai in tow. Although he was carrying four Regis Godfiends, he could move 50 kilometers in a second.
“King Molten has the Fire Refinement Star Cauldron. Even if they are in a dire situation, they can still stay alive if they hide inside it,” said King True Martial. The two teams had powerful life-preservation means. The Black Sand Grotto-Heaven and Two World Island team was strong enough to deal with all kinds of dangerous situations as long as King Molten and King Thousand Wood cooperated. As for the Archean Mountain team... when Meng Chuan and King True Martial worked together, they could also deal with all kinds of dangerous situations.
“It’s just ahead,” said Meng Chuan.
Just as he finished speaking, they saw the raging battle.
In the distance, one could see a dazzling region filled with golden flames. Countless threadswhich covered a 50-kilometer areasurrounded the flame domain. Black poison dragons frantically attacked the golden flames.
In the region of fire, King Molten and the other Godfiends could be seen resisting with all their might.
“The Archean Mountain Godfiends are here!” Upon seeing this, King Molten and company couldn’t help but be overjoyed.
“They’re all here?” When Holy Lady Strings saw the Archean Mountain Godfiends from afar, her expression changed slightly.
“Be careful. I’ll try my best to stall them until Peacock and the others arrive,” said Holy Lady Strings via voice transmission. “When that happens, we’ll have a chance of killing them if we join forces with Peacock and the others.”
“Alright.” Patriarch Poison Dragon was very confident. Demon Monarch Coldmoon nodded as well.
Boom!
In the distance, Meng Chuan led King True Martial and company over. A huge Yin-Yang disc—covering a five-kilometer radius around King True Martial—formed around their team. At the center of the Yin-Yang disc, blurry, gray energy gathered. At the edge of the Yin-Yang disc, a layer of the gray energy condensed. This gray energy broke through the Nine Lives Cocoon threads’ obstruction.
“What a powerful domain. My Nine Lives Cocoon threads are unable to penetrate it.” Holy Lady Strings’s expression changed slightly. After tearing through the Nine Lives Cocoon threads, the Archean Mountain Godfiend team finally rendezvoused with King Molten and the rest.
“Hahaha. Everybody from Archean Mountain, thank you!” King Molten, King Gu Eyes, and the others laughed loudly.
“Let’s join forces and kill them,” said King True Martial. “Junior Brother Meng, catch up to Holy Lady Strings.” “Bring me within 25 kilometers of it,” said King Thousand Wood. “Leave it to me.” Meng Chuan stepped on the Bloodblade Disc and brought the nine Godfiends with him as they traveled at full speed. The True Martial domain-the Yin-Yang disc-protected them as they forcefully tore through the void spiderweb domain.
Bang!!!
The numerous Nine Lives Cocoon threads were unable to stop the group from advancing towards the demon monarchs. Holy Lady Strings could only force the threads to form three white snakes that charged into the True Martial domain.
Boom!
King Molten swung the cauldron in his hand. With a single strike, he tore through a few kilometers and shattered a white snake.
Boom!
King Northcleanse’s 13 sword formation gathered and blasted apart a white snake. Under the suppression of the True Martial domain, the white snakes’ strength had been greatly reduced compared to earlier on.
Boom!
King Calm Sea suddenly slashed out with his ice-cold sword. His strike affected the flow of time, causing the void to distort. The terrifyingly fast strike caused the last white snake to dissipate.
King Calm Sea’s eyes were filled with excitement. After becoming an ice lifeform, he had cultivated in the World Gap for more than ten years. He had long yearned for battle.
King True Martial, Peng Mu, Meng Chuan, and company didn’t even get the opportunity to attack.This scene caused Holy Lady Strings’s expression to change slightly. She sent a voice transmission, “There are too many Godfiends. Meng Chuan is too fast. Even if we want to escape, we won’t be able to. The best way we can survive is to keep our distance. Don’t let them come within 25 kilometers of us, but don’t let them escape either. Keep them here until Peacock arrives.”
“How are we going to hold them here?” Patriarch Poison Dragon was somewhat anxious. He watched as the Godfiends-who were protected by the Yin-Yang disc-quickly closed in. All he could do was constantly send black dragon clones to block them. “No matter how much we try to hold them back, they are still too fast.”
“It is true that they’re too fast.” Holy Lady Strings became even more solemn. “However, we must try our best to stall for time.”
Nine Lives Cocoon threads and Patriarch Poison Dragon constantly obstructed them, causing King Molten and company to have to fight back frequently. This also interfered with Meng Chuan’s flight. However, Meng Chuan’s speed was too astonishing. Even under such a situation, the team’s average speed of approach was still 15 to 20 kilometers per second.
The distance between them rapidly shortened.
30 kilometers, 25 kilometers, 20 kilometers...
“Don’t be in a hurry to attack. Wait until we are within five kilometers of them,” said King True Martial via voice transmission.
King Molten and King Thousand Wood held back and waited.

chapters.title: Chapter 446 - Killing
chapters.content:
Chapter 446 Killing
The human Godfiends were too fast, so the demons couldn’t escape at all. They could only watch as the distance between them shortened.
15 kilometers, 10 kilometers, 5 kilometers...
“Attack.” King True Martial suddenly sent a voice transmission.
Boom!
All the Godfiends instantly attacked at the same time, unleashing pandemonium upon the battlefield. The fastest attack was none other than King Thousand Wood’s Magic Awl.
King Thousand Wood’s Essence Soul was at the sixth-level. He had used 30 percent of his Essence Soul’s Origins to refine his Magic Awl. It was a trump card for the human Godfiends.
There were many demon monarchs, but they had only sent a few demon monarchs because they were afraid of a sixth-level Essence Soul’s Magic Awl. After all, those with weaker Essence Souls would be sending themselves to their deaths if they were to come within 25 kilometers of King Thousand Wood.
Swoosh!
The black Magic Awl was invisible to the naked eye; it could only be clearly seen with one’s Essence Soul domain. The Magic Awl was extremely fast, and in an instant, it had already arrived in front of Holy Lady Strings. Although she had long prepared herself for this, she still felt a little flustered when facing this terrifying Magic Awl.
Boom!
Holy Lady Strings’s expression turned ferocious. She opened her mouth as though she was crying out in pain, but no sound came out of it. She clutched her head in pain. The midair Nine Lives Cocoon threads became sluggish as Holy Lady Strings slowly lost control over them.
Out of the Tribulation treasures that the three Imperial Lords had allowed her to choose from, she had chosen the Nine Lives Cocoon-which protected her Essence Soul the most. It could drastically weaken a Magic Awl’s strength. However, Holy Lady Strings still found the Nine Lives Cocoon’s protection insufficient. This was because her Essence Soul was still torn apart by the Magic Awl. It was too painful, and she felt despair.
She even felt like she was about to die.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
A terrifying attack descended. The massive Fire Refinement Star Cauldron smashed down, and King True Martial’s gray fist projection-which could crush everything-appeared. However, all the attacks landed on a white cocoon. A white cocoon had completely enveloped Holy Lady Strings. This was the Nine Lives Cocoon itself! In its cocoon form, it completely protected one’s body. It was said to be virtually indestructible. Furthermore, it provided one with a very strong Essence Soul defense. Out of the three Tribulation treasures that she could’ve chosen from, the Nine Lives Cocoon was the strongest when it came to protecting one’s body and Essence Soul.
The Nine Lives Cocoon had played its role!
The human Godfiends failed to blast the white cocoon open with their attacks.
“Holy Lady Strings’s Essence Soul has a very strong defense. It should be a Tribulation treasure,” said King Thousand Wood via voice transmission. To participate in this battle in the World Gap, they naturally knew lots about their enemies! King Thousand Wood’s Magic Awl was his trump card. Unless the demons had an illusion expert, they would have to rely on Tribulation treasures to resist his Magic Awl’s attacks. This was also the reason why King Transcendence didn’t use his Magic Awl when he fought Demon Monarch Coldmoon.
Attacking a sixth-level Essence Soul with a fifth-level Essence Soul Magic Awl—which was refined 30% of one’s Essence Soul’s Origins? Under normal circumstances, they could heavily injure the opponent! There was even a chance of killing them.
However, since the other party had Tribulation treasures, King Transcendence didn’t dare attack. This was because there was a high chance that his Magic Awl would shatter while attacking the other party! Although the Magic Awl was extremely sharp, it was brittle. Once it was shattered, he would lose 30% of his Essence Soul Origins. He would be severely injured, and his strength would be greatly reduced
The other party would only be slightly injured and would still have more than half of their combat strength left. If he did lose 30% of his Essence Soul’s Origins, he would be defenseless as he experienced intense pain. It would just result in his death.
It was better for him to let King Thousand Wood deal with the experts with sixth-level Essence Souls!
Patriarch Poison Dragon naturally didn’t fear the attacks of the Godfiends. He transformed into nine black dragons and charged forward. However, he was unable to charge into the True Martial domain’s Yin-Yang Disc. As for Holy Lady Strings, she was enveloped within the white cocoon as she experienced immense pain.
Demon Monarch Coldmoon naturally hid in the shadow world.
Boom!
King True Martial’s punch failed to penetrate the white cocoon. He turned around and punched at the void again.
The void shattered as the mysterious shadow world was destroyed.
The fist projection tore through the shadow world and struck the fleeing Demon Monarch Coldmoon.
Bam!
Coldmoon’s body transformed into shadow fragments as she fled in panic.
Pfft.
At the same time the shadow world was destroyed, a black Magic Awl rushed towards Demon Monarch Coldmoon. When Demon Monarch Coldmoon used her shadow to take King True Martial’s strike in her stead, the black Magic Awl took the opportunity to burrow into her true body and strike her Essence Soul.
The Magic Awl forcefully tore apart Demon Monarch Coldmono’s Essence Soul.
Demon Monarch Coldmoon clutched her head in pain. Although her Tribulation treasure, Shadow Sword, could protect her Essence Soul, it had a much weaker defense than the Nine Lives Cocoon. She instantly lost consciousness from the pain.
Clang!
The blurry fist shadow struck her body.
After the fist shadow struck Coldmoon’s body, she completely disintegrated and died on the spot. Though she was pulverized, a few treasures remained intact. The dark short sword was the most eye-catching treasure.
Whoosh.
King True Martial waved his hand and grabbed all the treasures left behind by Coldmoon.
A Tribulation treasure. King True Martial was delighted as he looked at the dark short sword in his hand.
Meng Chuan, King Molten, and company were overjoyed by their gains. After all, Tribulation treasures were very precious.
In human history, only Ancestral Master Archean Eon had left behind plenty of Tribulation treasures. Therefore, Archean Mountain had the greatest quantity in this aspect. For example, Black Sand Grotto-Heaven and Eon Sea Sect only had a few Tribulation treasures. Black Sand Grotto-Heaven had only given one Tribulation treasure to their Godfiends—the Fire Refinement Star Cauldron! Two World Island didn’t even give a Tribulation treasure to their Godfiends because it was truly poor. Although Archean Mountain had a rich heritage, they only gave Meng Chuan and King True Martial a Tribulation treasure each. As for King Calm Sea, Peng Mu, and Yun Jianhai, they were given Imperial Lord-level treasures.
The demons were the most wealthy.
Of course, Tribulation treasures had differences. There were a few Tribulation treasures that were left behind by Seventh Tribulation Eminences inside of Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s collection. Fifth and Sixth Tribultaion Eminences left behind most of the remaining Tribulation treasures in Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s collection.
The demons were different. Third and Fourth Tribulation Eminences left behind most of the Tribulation treasures they had.
Although the Nine Lives Cocoon was a Tribulation treasure left by a Fifth Tribulation Eminence, the demons lacked the key rebirth technique—which was required if one wanted a new life after breaking free of the cocoon. That was why it had been one of the Tribulation treasures that Holy Lady Strings could choose from.
COon.
Of course,
Meng Chuan and company were only Regis Godfiends. Tribulation treasures forged by Sixth and Seventh Tribulation Eminences didn’t differ much from those refined by Third Tribulation Eminences because of their lacking cultivation realm and technique realm. The strength they could unleash with the Tribulation treasures wasn’t too great. Only when they reached a sufficiently high realm could a huge difference in strength manifest.
Tribulation treasure. The Godfiends were excited because they had killed a powerful demon monarch and obtained a Tribulation treasure.
Dead? Demon Monarch Coldmoon is dead? Patriarch Poison Dragon was somewhat shocked. With his Undying body, he wasn’t worried about his safety. He could tell at a glance who the key force was. He stared at the distant King True Martial. King True Martial can actually shatter the shadow world with a single punch? When it comes to the void, his technique realm is just too high.
King True Martial did, indeed, reach a very high realm.
Grandsire Yin Yang’s Yin-Yang Art was an Imperial Lord-level ultimate technique. However, King True Martial had created his own ultimate technique-True Martial Seven Absolutes—by basing it on the Yin-Yang Art’s foundation and improving it.
Although he was only at the late stages of the Grotto-Heaven realm, he had similar strength to an expert that had reached the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm with the Yin-Yang Art. Furthermore, his cultivation path was adept in aspects of the void. After Archean Mountain bestowed him a Tribulation treasure to strengthen him, it wasn’t difficult for him to shatter the shadow world with a single punch.
King True Martial was one of the core members of this mission.
The Magic Awl is even more terrifying than I imagined. Holy Lady Strings—who was inside the Nine Lives Cocoon-still felt her Essence Soul thrashing in pain. If I were to take a few more similar blows, my Essence Soul might completely shatter and die. However, it’s said that the Magic Awl is brittle. It shouldn’twon’t attack me continuously.
“Holy Lady Strings and Demon Monarch Coldmoon both have sixth-level Essence Souls. They are protected by Tribulation treasures. Holy Lady Strings has an even stronger Essence Soul defense,” said King Thousand Wood. “When attacking the two of them, a few cracks appeared on my Magic Awl. I’m not confident that I can kill Holy Lady Strings with just the Magic Awl.”
“There’s no need,” said King True Martial. “Your Magic Awl is our trump card. There aren’t many demon monarchs with sixth-level Essence Souls. In the future, you will be able to slaughter those with fifth-level Essence Souls easily. It’s better to use the Magic Awl at critical moments only.”
“As long as your Magic Awl doesn’t shatter, it will be a powerful deterrence,” said King Molten.King Thousand Wood nodded. He was also one of the core members of this mission.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
Holy Lady Strings continued hiding within the white cocoon. Suddenly, she began to release countless threads that spread around her.
“More demons are coming.” King True Martial suddenly looked into the distance.
Soon, Meng Chuan sensed it as well.
A terrifying aura erupted from afar. A tall, black-haired man stood in midair. His long hair reached his waist. His purple eyes looked into the distance.
From afar, Meng Chuan and the other Godfiends felt the area surrounding the black-haired man collapse. Behind the black-haired man were 18 guards.
“Monarch Peacock is here.” King True Martial, King Molten, and Meng Chuan’s fighting spirit rose. This was a battle between the humans’ and the demons’ strongest combat forces in the World Gap.

chapters.title: Chapter 447 - Battle of Peak Forces
chapters.content:
Chapter 447 Battle of Peak Forces
The white cocoon rapidly shrank and retracted into Holy Lady Strings’s body. Holy Lady Strings and Patriarch Poison Dragon flew over and met up with Monarch Peacock.
“The strongest batch of human Regis Godfiends are here.” Monarch Peacock stared at the human Godfiends in the True Martial domain with his purple eyes as his fighting spirit rose. “Peacock, be careful of King True Martial,” said Holy Lady Strings as she flew closer.
“He destroyed the shadow world with a single punch. With King Thousand Wood’s help, he instantly killed Demon Monarch Coldmoon,” said Patriarch Poison Dragon as he flew over.
“Oh?” Monarch Peacock remained extremely calm. “In a while, all you need to do is cooperate with me.”
“Alright,” replied Holy Lady Strings and Patriarch Poison Dragon.
“Monarch Peacock is here.” King Molten’s eyes were filled with excitement. “The strongest fifth Firmament demon monarchs are here.”
“Junior Brother Meng, please cooperate with me later.” King True Martial looked into the distance and sent a voice transmission. “I need you to use your temporal divine power.” As a Godfiend that cultivated the Cosmos Body cultivation system, Meng Chuan’s temporal divine power-Flowing Sand-was indeed very powerful. To kill the powerful demon monarchs, the Godfiends needed exquisite teamwork. As a core force in this mission, King True Martial was naturally informed of Flowing Sand.
“Alright, Senior Brother, you need to be within 30 feet of me,” said Meng Chuan via voice transmission.
“King Thousand Wood and King Molten, cooperate with me later. Let’s try to kill Monarch Peacock together,” said King True Martial via voice transmission.
King Thousand Wood’s face was simple and unadorned. King Molten’s fighting spirit boiled as he sent a voice transmission. “Don’t worry.”
“The demons have been preparing for more than ten years. Their strength must have improved greatly. Everyone, be careful.” King True Martial sent a voice transmission to all the Godfiends.
All the Godfiends present were solemn. Meng Chuan had already released Dao Protector Wang Shan from his pocket Grotto-Heaven.
Whoosh.
The True Martial domain protected the Godfiends as they rapidly flew towards Monarch Peacock. They were extremely fast. With Meng Chuan carrying the Godfiends, their speed naturally far exceeded the demon monarchs’.
Monarch Peacock said coldly, “Leave it to me.”
The other demon monarchs stopped in midair. Monarch Peacock charged forward with a dark purple spear in his hand. An enormous, black peacock phantom appeared behind him. It spread its wings and soared. Monarch Peacock’s flying speed was extremely astonishing. He actually reached a terrifying speed of more than 15 kilometers per second as he charged over.
One demon monarch against a group of Godfiends.
As they charged at each other, the 50-kilometer gap between the two parties instantly shortened to five kilometers. The battle instantly erupted.
“How arrogant.” King Molten held the Fire Refinement Star Cauldron that was several times larger than himself and smashed it down.
“Die!” With a thought from King Thousand Wood, his Magic Awl flew out and appeared in front of Monarch Peacock.
Divine power—Flowing Sand! Meng Chuan also used his divine power. Silver runes appeared on both sides of his head as strands of silver lightning flashed around his head. Silver lightning filled Meng Chuan’s eyes as he looked around. Wisps of silver lightning appeared in a 30-foot radius of him, enveloping King True Martial.
King True Martial had already gathered his strength.
The flow of time for the two changed. In the eyes of others, they had sped up.
King True Martial could sense the adjusted flow of time since he had been studying the time lineage. However, his attainments were still very low. This was because the True Martial lineage mainly focused on the void lineage.
Meng Chuan’s Flowing Sand has sped up the flow of time by ten-fold; it’s a greater boost than King Calm Sea’s sword art. King True Martial was very satisfied.
Although the Ten Absolutes of World Annihilation had been created due to a stroke of inspiration, it didn’t actually do much in actual combat. After all, an opponent-who had similar strength-wouldn’t just stay idle and watch him deliver ten punches. Thus, he could only unleash this technique instantly with King Calm Sea or Meng Chuan’s help.
When King True Martial punched out, the dark Magic Awl had already drilled into Monarch Peacock’s body.
Huh? King Thousand Wood’s expression changed slightly. He had a sixth-level Essence Soul, and he had used 30 percent of his Essence Soul’s Origins to refine the Magic Awl. One could imagine how powerful his Magic Awl was. Even Holy Lady Strings and Demon Monarch Coldmoonwho both had sixth-level Essence Souls and Tribulation treasures-were affected by the attack greatly. One ended up severely injured while barely remaining somewhat lucid. The other fell unconscious and was unable to put up a defense. As for Monarch Peacock, he only had a fifth-level Essence Soul. However, the three Imperial Lords had never been worried because a true Dark Peacock could ignore Essence Soul mystic techniques. Dark Peacocks were extremely strong when it came to head-on battles. In the River of Spacetime, Dark Peacocks were considered an extremely powerful lifeform. They were comparable to phoenixes, true dragons, and etc.
Of course, Monarch Peacock wasn’t a true Dark Peacock. However, the awakened bloodline in his body had pushed him infinitely close to becoming a true Dark Peacock. He could probably transform into a Dark Peacock completely if he awakened his bloodline one more time.
Crackle...
When the Magic Awl entered Monarch Peacock’s body, it was as though it had entered a dark vortex. The black vortex constantly pulled the Magic Awl, causing many cracks to appear on it.
After passing through the dark vortex with great difficulty, the Magic Awl emerged from Monarch Peacock’s body with many more cracks than before.
I can’t find its Essence Soul at all. Has its Essence Soul fused with the black vortex? King Thousand Wood was secretly alarmed. “Humph.” Monarch Peacock let out a painful grunt.
Boom!
The gigantic Fire Refinement Star Cauldron smashed through the void and arrived in front of Monarch Peacock. Monarch Peacock was affected by the Magic Awl after it had pierced through the black vortex in his body. Thus, he only had time to block the Tribulation treasure with his left hand.
However, this strike was King Molten’s strongest attack!
He used a forbidden spell so that he could release his Quintessential Essence maximally. He pushed the Fire Refinement Star Cauldron’s strength to the limits of what he could withstand. Although blood flowed out from King Molten’s mouth and nose, the power behind this strike was terrifying.
Although Monarch Peacock’s left hand had immense strength, he was still suppressed by the Fire Refinement Star Cauldron. The huge flaming cauldron crushed Monarch Peacock’s arm and smashed into his head.
Bam!
The Fire Refinement Star Cauldron struck Monarch Peacock’s head.
Monarch Peacock’s extremely powerful body staggered backward as blood flowed from his forehead.
“Oh?” Monarch Peacock looked up and saw a terrifying gray pillar of light. With Flowing Sand affecting the flow of time, King True Martial’s ten punches moved extremely quickly. Infusing the Tribulation treasure’s Yin-Yang energy and the Power of the True Martial into his arm, King True Martial punched out ten times consecutively. The gray pillar of light-formed by the ten punches-instantly tore through the void. Even Monarch Peacock didn’t have time to dodge it. The scene of the gray pillar of light tearing through the void caused all the Godfiends and demon monarchs to fall silent.
This was an extremely terrifying move.Even with a Tribulation treasure’s help, at the cost of suffering heavy injuries, King True Martial could only use this move once in a short period of time. Furthermore, thanks to Meng Chuan’s divine power-Flowing Sandhe had struck out ten times nearly instantly.
This strike was comparable to Qin Wu’s sword formation!
Boom!
Monarch Peacock had no time to dodge the gray pillar of it. He could only hold his spear horizontally in front of him as he braced for impact.
The gray pillar of light instantly enveloped him.
“Ahhh!” Monarch Peacock let out an angry roar. Within the gray pillar of light, his body began to shatter.
In the blink of an eye, Monarch Peacock’s body completely shattered and disappeared.
Where Monarch Peacock once stood, only a spear, a dark purple robe, and a few other items floated in midair.

chapters.title: Chapter 448 - Tragic
chapters.content:
Chapter 448 Tragic
He’s dead? King Transcendence, King Molten, and King Gu Eyes revealed looks of excitement.
The distant Holy Lady Strings, Patriarch Poison Dragon, and the Eighteen Black River Guard found it unbelievable.
King True Martial’s expression was solemn, without a hint of delight.
Whoosh.
The gray pillar of light had pulverized Monarch Peacock’s body.
Suddenly, immense power gathered and fused, forming the black-haired man’s body in the blink of an eye. The dark purple robe draped over him once again as the spear landed in his hand.
Blood Rebirth? Meng Chuan’s expression changed slightly. He knew the specifics of such life-preservation means. His Blood Droplet realm body could instantly reform, even when his body was reduced to invisible particles.
Monarch Peacock clearly had life-preservation means similar to Blood Rebirth. After all, he had instantly recovered with no injuries to be seen on his body.
“You’re injured,” said King True Martial in a deep voice.
“You should be able to kill me if you use that same move 20 more times.” Monarch Peacock looked at King True Martial excitedly. “I’ll stand here. Continue!” King True Martial’s pupils constricted. Though he was already heavily injured after using it once, he could still maintain his normal strength. However, if he executed the attack again, he would become extremely weak for the entire battle.
“That’s all you got?” Monarch Peacock’s eyes were filled with madness. “Then it’s my turn. Attack,” ordered Monarch Peacock.
Boom!
Instantly, the world collapsed. A River of Darkness instantly engulfed the surrounding area. Meng Chuan and company could only see black water everywhere around them. The black water could even corrode the True Martial domain’s Yin-Yang disc instantly.
“Seal.” King True Martial’s expression changed slightly. He stretched out his hands slightly, and copious amounts of Yin-Yang energy spread out from his body. The energy revolved around the Godfiends as it blocked every attack from every direction.
However, the True Martial domain’s range was reduced. It only extended to 1,000 feet of him.
Meng Chuan and the other Godfiends were confined to that 1,000-foot-wide area.
What’s this? Meng Chuan couldn’t believe his eyes when he saw the black water. It was different from Patriarch Poison Dragon’s poisonous black water. The churning black water was even darker, denser, and thicker. Its might was even more terrifying! He had the feeling that his body would be reduced to dust if he charged into the black water without his Bloodblade Disc defending him.
Boom!
King Molten swung the Fire Refinement Star Cauldron down with all his might, stirring up waves as it smashed into the black water.
“What array formation is this?” King True Martial’s expression turned solemn. He had created his own True Martial lineage and was best at defense.
With the help of his Tribulation treasure’s Yin-Yang energy, his True Martial domain’s power was elevated to extreme heights. It could crush Holy Lady Strings’s domain head-on. When it came to domain techniques, King True Martial believed that no one could match him, be it Regis Godfiends or fifth Firmament demon monarchs. However, this time, he was completely suppressed.
This was the Black River Array Formation. This array formation had only been obtained by one of the Demon realm’s Imperial LordsEmperor Roc-because he had a high status within this region of the River of Spacetime. Using his reputation, he had gone to the Black River Realm to negotiate, eventually obtaining the Eighteen Black River Life Caskets.
Afterward, he selected 18 suitable fifth Firmament demon monarchs to refine the Black River Life Caskets and form the Eighteen Black River Guard. The Eighteen Black River Guard had worked together to set up the Black River Array Formation, forming this 400-kilometer-long Black River! Emperor Roc had only expended a lot of effort to create the Eighteen Black River Guard because he knew that the array formation was extremely powerful. The Black River Array Formation was also the three Imperial Lords’ trump card.
Whoosh.
Monarch Peacock suddenly opened his mouth and sucked.
The void began to distort.
A special force instantly descended on the Godfiends. They could sense space compressing them. Divine power—Heaven Devouring! This was Monarch Peacock’s strongest divine power.
Monarch Peacock flew over alone because he wanted to be closer to the human Godfiends. He wanted to use Heaven Devouring when he was within range!
Thankfully, with the True Martial domain’s resistance, Meng Chuan and company didn’t suffer too much pressure. Otherwise, the force that acted on them would be several times stronger.
Not good. Meng Chuan and company felt terrible. They struggled to resist the spatial compression.
King True Martial used his True Martial domain to resist the Black River Array Formation as he also did his best to weaken Heaven Devouring’s influence on the void.
“Be careful.” King True Martial’s expression changed.
Black spears suddenly flew out from the black water in all directions. Previously, these spears had taken form while hidden in the array formation. Due to this, the human Godfiends didn’t notice them. By the time they discovered the black spears, they had already reached the edge of the True Martial domain.
In the blink of an eye, the flying, black spears shot into the True Martial domain and headed towards every Godfiend!
Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish!
Every flying spear had terrifying might and speed.
Meng Chuan and company were still affected by Monarch Peacock’s divine power-Heaven Devouring
“Be careful.” King Molten didn’t have time to react. He threw the Fire Refinement Star Cauldron-which was several times larger than him-up and covered himself and King Northcleanse. The flying, black spears then struck the Fire Refinement Star Cauldron.
Silver runes appeared on both sides of Meng Chuan’s face as silver lightning flashed around his head. He stepped on the Bloodblade Disc and transformed into a phantom. He was the least afraid of the flying, black spears. The flying, black spears moved at a speed of about 150 kilometers per second. Although Meng Chuan was affected by Heaven Devouring, under Flowing Sand, he could still move faster than the flying spears.
He easily dodged the black spears with just his movement techniques. Furthermore, he was able to hide in the deep void in a split second. The flying spears were unable to touch him.
King Thousand Wood. With a thought, Meng Chuan sent 12 Bloodblades to protect King Thousand Wood.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Countless flying spears pummeled King Thousand Wood.
The demons clearly knew that Meng Chuan was too slippery, while King True Martial was too strong. Therefore, they attacked King Thousand Wood with more than 100 flying spears. The surrounding Forest World array formation obstructed them, but the black water spears easily penetrated past it.
Bam! Bam! Bam!
The spears struck the Bloodblades one after another. Meng Chuan tried his best to control the Bloodblades to block all the flying, black spears.
Although the Bloodblade Disc was good at defense, the flying spears were too powerful. Meng Chuan struggled to block all of them.
At that moment, he hated the fact that his cultivation realm wasn’t high enough. Due to his low cultivation realm, he wasn’t able to utilize the Bloodblade Disc’s defensive powers fully.
Roar!
Countless Nine Lives Cocoon threads converged to form a massive white snakewhich then charged into the True Martial domain. The white snake lunged at King Thousand Wood, attempting to kill him.
“Break! Break! Break!” King True Martial punched at the distant Monarch Peacock with all his might.
A blurry fist projection tore through the sky, forcing Monarch Peacock to stop using his divine power and block the punch with his full strength.
King True Martial then diverted his attention and struck out with his palm. The blurry, gray palm phantom struck the white snake, making it fly out of the True Martial domain and into the churning black river.
“Die.” After Monarch Peacock stopped his divine power, he thrust his spear at King True Martial. The world trembled as it stabbed at King True Martial.
“Hide in here. Come in and hide!” roared King Molten from within the Fire Refinement Star Cauldron. Under the protection of the 12 Bloodblades, King Thousand Wood hurriedly entered the cauldron.
Only then did Meng Chuan cast his gaze at the others.
King Transcendence was naturally fine because he hid in the shadow world.
Peng Mu’s expression was ferocious as vines danced around him, isolating him from most of the flying, black spears. He blocked a small number of them with his palm arts. Even when he was struck occasionally, his Indestructible Divine Body helped him quickly heal his injuries.
Dao Protector Wang Shan sat cross-legged. No matter how intense the attacks were, his body
—which was like a powerful divine armament -remained completely unharmed.
King Calm Sea defended his surroundings with a single sword. His sword art affected spacetime, causing his slashing speed to be very astonishing. At the same time, he withstood dozens of flying, black spears with his body. Although his ice body was tough, a few fist-sized holes riddled it.
Affected by Monarch Peacock’s Heaven Devouring, King Calm Sea’s movement technique revealed flaws, causing him to be hit by the flying spears. Thankfully, King Calm Sea’s ice body was extremely tough. The flying spears weren’t able to destroy his ice body completely.
Senior Brother Yun and King Gu Eyes died. Meng Chuan felt a hint of grief.
Meng Chuan could clearly sense what happened through his domain.
Affected by Monarch Peacock’s divine powerHeaven Devouring-Yun Jianhai’s sword formation was affected greatly. Due to this, he was struck by the flying, black spears. Yun Jianhai’s body wasn’t very strong. After two spears struck his body consecutively, his body was completely annihilated. King Gu Eyes was originally very agile, but he was unable to dodge the spears due to being affected by Heaven Devouring. Although his body was tough, he was completely reduced to dust after being penetrated by dozens of flying, black spears.
In that single exchange, Monarch Peacock’s Heaven Devouring and the Black River Array Formation caused two Godfiends to die.
Boom!King True Martial’s fist tore through the air and clashed with the spear. He flew backward after the collision; his True Martial domain followed him.
All the flying, black water spears scattered as well.
“We only killed two.” Monarch Peacock stood in the vast black river with his spear in his hand. He looked at the remaining Godfiends in the True Martial domain and grinned. “However, the remaining Godfiends are all turtles in a jar. None of them can escape.”
Inside the True Martial domain.
King True Martial, Meng Chuan, and the other Godfiends—including the Godfiends hiding in the Fire Refinement Star Cauldron-were extremely furious.
The death of their companions saddened them. Their killing intent intensified as they grieved for their fallen comrades.
Lunatic Yun, rest in peace. I’ll kill more demon monarchs before coming to accompany you. Peng Mu’s eyes were filled with tears. He and Lunatic Yun had reigned supreme in the same era. After waking up from their slumbers that lasted nearly 1,000 years, the two of them had been guarding cities. This time, they had come to the World Gap to fight. However, Lunatic Yun had passed away before him.
King Gu Eyes. King Thousand Wood—who was in the Fire Refinement Star Cauldron-looked at the numerous Gu worm corpses in the distance. That strange-tempered little fellowwhose Gu worms accompanied him his entire life—had died just like that?

chapters.title: Chapter 449 - Predicament
chapters.content:
Chapter 449 Predicament
Monarch Peacock stood in the vast black river and stared at the True Martial domain in the distance.
Monarch Peacock thought to himself, King True Martial is much stronger than before; he’s even harder to deal with now.
The True Martial domain in front of him was like a huge turtle shell. It could resist the Black River Array Formation and greatly weaken his divine power—Heaven Devouring.
Without cracking the True Martial domain, it would be very difficult for them to kill the Godfiends.
“Black River Guard, use your full strength to attack King True Martial’s domain,” said Monarch Peacock. “Strings, you and I will deal with King True Martial together.”
“Alright,” replied the distant Holy Lady Strings. Instead of getting close to the Godfiends, she hid about 35 kilometers away. She was clearly afraid of King Thousand Wood’s Magic Awl.
“Rise.” The Eighteen Black River Guard simultaneously activated the Black River Array Formation with another method.
Black chains formed in the black river. In the blink of an eye, hundreds of black chains surrounded the True Martial domain.
More than half of the black river’s power is gathered in the chains. It’ll definitely crush this True Martial domain. The Eighteen Black River Guard’s eyes were filled with ferocious killing intent.
Not good! Meng Chuan saw the black chains wrap around the True Martial domain. They wrapped around it and shrunk rapidly.
The expressions of the Godfiends changed.
King True Martial, Meng Chuan, and King Transcendence were still standing in the domain. King Molten, King Thousand Wood, King Calm Sea, and Dao Protector Wang Shan had already hidden in the Fire Refinement Star Cauldron. The cauldron’s walls had become translucent, and the Regis Godfiends-who were protected inside—could clearly see what was happening outside.
“Trying to crack my domain?” King True Martial snorted coldly. The black-and-white Yin-Yang disc spun as it constantly diverted the pressure exerted by the chains. The True Martial domain gradually shrank under the pressure. 900 feet, 800 feet... However, it quickly expanded. 850 feet, 900 feet...
This situation see-sawed between both parties as they alternated between leading forces. The True Martial domain would occasionally shrink before it would exert its own pressure and expand, allowing it to divert the force exerted by the chains.
Boom!
A spear tore through the black river and pierced towards the Godfiends; it was Monarch Peacock’s terrifying spear.
He clearly wanted to take advantage of King True Martial being distracted by the chains and attack him head-on.
King True Martial executed a palm art. His True Martial Seven Absolutes contained palm techniques, finger techniques, claw techniques, fist techniques, and so on. In terms of killing enemies, his fist techniques were the most domineering. His palm techniques were the best when it came to defense. At that moment, his palm projection traversed a few kilometers. The palm project was covered with a blurry, gray light as it tore through the black river water and blocked the terrifying spear.
Boom!
The long spear brought with it a destructive might, shattering everything in its way.
King True Martial’s palm technique seemed to be extremely mild, but it actually fused both Yin and Yang, allowing it to divert the infinitely powerful force emanating from the spear.
Whoosh.
Even after all his efforts, King True Martial was still sent flying back several kilometer True Martial domain naturally followed. However, he didn’t suffer any damage since most of the spear’s force had been diverted.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!
Monarch Peacock was extremely violent. His spear enlarged—becoming several kilometers long-as he attacked repeatedly. His moves were much cruder than King True Martial’s; they could only be described with one word – violent!
The spear served as the conduit for Monarch Peacock’s terrifying strength as he sent waves of attacks at King True Martial-each strike stronger than the last.
Every strike sent King True Martial flying backward.
At the same time, he found it very difficult to divert his attention to resist the Black River Array Formation’s chains and Monarch Peacock’s relentless attacks.
This is the moment. Holy Lady Strings had been secretly watching this entire time. She seized the opportunity to attack. Countless Nine Lives Cocoons threads suddenly merged to form a white snake—which then charged out from the black river and into the True Martial domain.
The black chains naturally opened a gap in the True Martial domain and allowed the white snake to burrow in. This sneak attack was as fast as lightning, and it had been timed just as King True Martial barely blocked Monarch Peacock’s seventh strike.
Clang! Clang! Clang!
The Bloodblades formed a sphere that was dozens of feet wide. They spun and blocked the white snake’s terrifying attack. Meng Chuan had controlled his Bloodblades to help King True Martial block the attack.
“King Eastcalm, Meng Chuan?” Holy Lady Strings was extremely furious.
“Thank you, Junior Brother Meng,” said King True Martial via voice transmission as he recovered from Monarch Peacock’s blow. Even without Meng Chuan’s help, he would’ve still been able to block the attack forcefully, but his injuries would worsen.
“I can only help a little in the defense.” Meng Chuan struggled to block the white snake’s attacks.
The white snake-which Holy Lady Strings had condensed with all her might with the Nine Lives Cocoon threads-was definitely as strong as a peak Creation realm expert. However, the True Martial domain was too powerful. Even the Black River Array Formation was unable to penetrate it completely. The white snake was suppressed, distorted, and worn down by the True Martial domain, leaving only about 50% of its strength left.
The Bloodblade Disc was best at defense, so it was able to block the attack, but it was still a struggle for Meng Chuan to do so. Every time they clashed, the Bloodblades, as though they were about to be destroyed.
The 18 Bloodblades swam like fish, forming an array formation. The Bloodblades formed a small world as they did their best to withstand the impact.
Even with the True Martial domain reducing its might, it’s still very difficult for me to withstand its attacks. My realm is still too low.
With a low cultivation realm, he could only control the layers of runic formations contained within the Bloodblade Disc on a superficial level.
The demons were also vexed by the situation.
Although Monarch Peacock was extremely ferocious and suppressed his opponent, King True Martial was completely able to withstand his attacks. The Black River Array Formation was also unable to invade the True Martial domain successfully.
“Everyone, do any of you have a way to deal with these Godfiends?” Monarch Peacock frowned and sent a voice transmission.
“King True Martial is currently controlling his domain with all his might. The Black River Array Formation can’t even crack it. My black dragon clones can’t enter either,” said Patriarch Poison Dragon via voice transmission. “There’s nothing I can do.”
Holy Lady Strings sent a voice transmission. “He’s using his True Martial domain with all his might. Ordinary demon sages will probably be pulverized if they enter. My Nine Lives Cocoon threads have formed a white snake. Its strength gets halved by the domain’s suppression, allowing even Meng Chuan to block it.”
Monarch Peacock frowned.
“Then there’s only one solution,” said Monarch Peacock via voice transmission. “Black River Guard, I’ll have to trouble you to isolate the world and prevent them from absorbing the Heaven and Earth powers.” “Alright,” replied the Eighteen Black River Guard.
The Black River Array Formation had many functions. However, most of these functions couldn’t be utilized since the Godfiends were hiding inside the True Martial Domain.
As the surging river water enveloped the True Martial domain, countless runes appeared on the Eighteen Black River Guard’s bodies.
“What happened?”
King True Martial, Meng Chuan, and King Transcendence’s expressions changed slightly.
As Godfiends, their bodies naturally absorbed the Heaven and Earth powers. It was akin to a mortal breathing. However, after the Heaven and Earth powers inside the True Martial domain were absorbed by their bodies, they didn’t absorb any more.
The Heaven and Earth powers have been cut off? King True Martial’s expression changed slightly.
“King True Martial, I’m impressed by your strength.” Monarch Peacock held his spear and looked at the True Martial domain from afar. He said indifferently, “As long as you resist, you will constantly use Quintessential Essence. I want to see how long you can last when you’re consuming your Quintessential Essence at such an insane rate without the Heaven and Earth powers replenishing your reserves.”
The demons used the Black River Array Formation’s chains to suppress the True Martial domain, isolating the Heaven and Earth powers from the Godfiends. They then continued this battle of attrition.
Meng Chuan and King True Martial could sense the seriousness of the situation.
“Everyone, do you have a solution?” asked King True Martial.
“Hide in the cauldron. We’ll rely on the cauldron to hold them off. It will give us some time,” said King Molten with a frown.
However, King Northcleanse beside him said, “You also consume quite a lot of energy when you use the Fire Refinement Star Cauldron.”
“King Transcendence can enter the shadow world and escape this array formation,” said Wang Shan as he thought of solutions.
“It’s useless.” King True Martial said, “Yes, King Transcendence can escape, but we consume Quintessential Essence too quickly. No matter how many pills we have brought, we won’t be able to last long. Even if we have a small grotto-heaven, the small grotto-heaven’s Heaven and Earth powers will only last us a month. I believe the demons won’t let King Transcendence freely enter and exit the human world and the World Gap.”
“The most troublesome thing is...” Meng Chuan looked outside and said solemnly, “Even if we can withstand them and continue doing so, we won’t be able to leave. While we’re defending, we can only watch the demons draw a map of the World Gap’s connection points. They can then send fifth Firmament demon monarchs into our human world.”
King True Martial nodded. “That’s right. Being trapped here implies that we have failed our mission.”

chapters.title: Chapter 450 - Grotto-Heaven Realm (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 450 Grotto-Heaven Realm (1)
The 400-kilometer-long black river surged as the chains wrapped around the True Martial domain multiple times, binding it and exerting pressure on it.
In the True Martial domain, the Godfiends were thinking of solutions.
“We can’t stay trapped here,” King Thousand Wood said solemnly. “We have to think of a way to crack this formation.” “How do we crack it?” asked King Molten.
King True Martial waved his hand slightly, and an illusory figure appeared. It reflected the Eighteen Black River Guard that were nearly 50 kilometers away. King True Martial said, “These 18 demon monarchs are controlling the array formation. The array formation spans 400 kilometers; the 18 of them are at the center of the array formation. Judging by the runic patterns on their bodies... they are crucial for the array formation to function. As long as one is killed, the array formation will probably collapse! Even if it can be maintained, its might will be greatly reduced.”
“How do we kill one?” asked Peng Mu. “They are hiding nearly 50 kilometers away from us. Even our Magic Awls can’t touch them.” “If my body enters the black water, I’ll probably be reduced to dust instantly,” said King Transcendence. “Only King True Martial can withstand the array formation with his domain. None of us can do it. Even if we can barely withstand the array formation, we will be captured alive.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
His Bloodblade Disc was his main protection means. Even if he was lucky enough to withstand the Black River Array Formation, it would be very difficult for him to fly due to the Black River Array Formation’s suppression. With Monarch Peacock and Holy Lady Strings cooperating, they could easily capture him alive.
A Dao Protector’s body was powerful and could be said to be indestructible. However, Dao Protector Wang Shan was relatively weak and could be easily captured alive. “If you have a small portable grotto-heaven, lend it to me. Everyone can hide in the small grotto-heaven,” said King Transcendence hesitantly. “I can try to escape by carrying the small grotto-heaven into the shadow world.”
“This method won’t work.” Meng Chuan frowned and shook his head. “The Godfiends can’t resist if they are to be stored in a small grotto-heaven! King True Martial is currently using his domain to block the demons’ array formation. Yes, we can hide in the small grotto-heavens, but what about King True Martial?
“If King True Martial isn’t releasing his strength because he’s not resisting, the array formation will sweep through the void, leaving devastation in its wake. Holy Lady Strings and Monarch Peacock’s killer blows will then descend. King Transcendence, King True Martial can’t enter a small grotto-heaven without any interference. Are you going to escape with us and have King True Martial stay where he is?”
“This method won’t work.” King Molten rejected the suggestion. “We will be unable to resist if we hide in a small grotto-heaven! If the demons have a way to break through the shadow world, we will be easily wiped out all at once.”
King True Martial nodded as well. “This method is very dangerous. I can destroy the shadow world myself. The demons have a rich heritage. We haven’t figured out what functions this mysterious array formation has. We can’t take such risks.”
Although there was a high chance that the demons could not pose a threat to them when they were in the shadow world, they couldn’t risk the lives of the Regis Godfiend group! In a small grotto-heaven, they couldn’t even attack or block. It would be terrible if they were wiped out in one fell swoop.
“Everyone, don’t panic. Junior Brother Meng and I can work together. We’ll try charging out,” said King True Martial. “I will use my domain to block the array formation. Junior Brother Meng will use his movement technique to carry me. Although we will be much slower under the array formation’s suppression, it’s still possible for us to travel up to 10 kilometers a second. We will charge straight for the 18 demon monarchs. As long as we are within 25 kilometers of them, King Thousand Wood can attack the 18 demon monarchs with his Magic Awl.”
“This is a solution. We can give it a try.” Everyone’s eyes lit up. Even if they failed, they could still hide in the True Martial domain.
“I used a killer move just now and was injured. I still need a day to recover completely,” said King True Martial. “Let’s try to counterattack in a day.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Alright.”
How fast could he fly while being suppressed by the demons’ array formation? Meng Chuan wasn’t confident. His speed now depended on how the strength of King True Martial’s True Martial domain. King True Martial clearly needed to recuperate and reach optimal condition before giving it a try.
However, the demons didn’t want King True Martial to recover slowly. They wanted to accelerate the Godfiends’ energy consumption.
Boom!
A long spear stirred the black waves as it pierced towards King True Martial once again.
Boom!
Numerous Nine Lives Cocoon threads gathered and formed a white snake—which then charged into the True Martial domain.
However, the True Martial domain was too powerful. If Holy Lady Strings’s Nine Lives Cocoon threads were split into three white snakes, they would be suppressed by the True Martial domain. The threat they posed to King True Martial was negligible. King True Martial frowned slightly. “The demons aren’t willing to let me recuperate.” He immediately struck out with his palm, smashing through the void to block the spear.
Meng Chuan also released the 18 Bloodblades. They transformed into a sphere-it was like they had formed their own world—to block the white snake. Clang! Clang! Clang! Every time the white snake clashed with the 18 Bloodblades, some Bloodblades would fly backward. Other Bloodblades would immediately take their place.
These Bloodblades continued to fly as they interweaved each other. They naturally formed a sphere and blocked the White Snake’s attacks with extreme resilience. Although Meng Chuan could only block the attacks due to the True Martial domain’s suppression, Holy Lady Strings had ultimately reached the Grotto-Heaven realm’s late stage. The white snake’s attacks were indeed exquisite. Thankfully, I’m barely able to block the attacks by activating the Bloodblade Disc’s runic formations. If I had relied on my normal techniques, I would’ve been defeated long ago. The Bloodblade Disc’s defensive array formation is truly impressive.
The 18 Bloodblades take turns to form a world. The Bloodblades are like roving dragons, but the 18 roving dragons can still form a world... Meng Chuan sighed in amazement at the Bloodblade Disc’s runic formation. His current realm only allowed him superficial control over the Bloodblade Disc. After all, this was a Tribulation treasure refined by an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
As Meng Chuan marveled at the array formation’s profundities, he suddenly froze.
Eighteen roving dragons form a world? Roving dragons form a heaven and earth?
That’s right. I pursue endless variability with the Cloud Draogn Snake Movement Technique. I originally felt like I should follow the same path as Supremacy Roving Dragon-Senior Ye Hong-and use the Roving Dragon Form of Lightning as the core. However, I think I should change my train of thought. I think I should... use the Nine Heavenly Forms of the Void’s essence as the core?
The Bloodblade Disc’s runic formation inspired Meng Chuan.
As he used the Bloodblade Disc to resist the white snake’s attacks, thoughts about how he should proceed with his cultivation surfaced in his mind.
The Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique was an ultimate technique created by Meng Chuan. It used the World Roving Dragon Saber’s foundation and took on a new path. This ultimate technique of Meng Chuan’s pursued endless variability.
