Senior Ye Hong was known as Supremacy Roving Dragon. Her movement technique focused on the Roving Dragon Form of Lightning’s essence. When mastered, one could travel through the world with unpredictable movements.
Originally, Meng Chuan also thought that this path was correct. However, he added the Yin-Yang Transformation’s profundities on top of Senior Ye Hong’s foundation. After cultivating in the World Gap for many years, he had been stuck at a bottleneck. He was unable to fuse his years of insights into one and reach the Grotto-Heaven realm.
At that moment, Meng Chuan was inspired by the Bloodblade Disc’s runic formation.
No matter how mystical a roving dragon’s roving was, it was still within the world.
What if he used the Nine Heavenly Forms of the Void’s essence as the core of his movement technique?
Boom!
As a large number of ideas surfaced in his mind, Meng Chuan’s years of accumulated insights into the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique naturally began to fuse. He tried to use the Nine Heavenly Forms of the Void as the core, and the Roving Dragon Form of Lightning and Yin-Yang Form of Lightning as complements. For a moment, he seemed to gain the help of a god.
The ultimate technique gradually approached the Grotto-Heaven realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 451 - Grotto-Heaven Realm (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 451 Grotto-Heaven Realm (2)
This made him unable to contain his joy.
This was what cultivation was like.
He solved the conundrum that puzzled him for years after being inspired by something! This sudden epiphany made everything become clear!
Of course, it was also possible that one’s insights would accumulate until it resulted in a qualitative change. When Meng Chuan activated the Bloodblade Disc’s runic array formation with his full strength, he naturally studied it. He tried his best to unleash more of the Tribulation treasure’s strength. This benefited his insights into the Nine Heavenly Forms of the Void, Roving Dragon Form of Lightning, and Yin-Yang Form of Lightning.
Meng Chuan was finally inspired by the bountiful harvest of his hard work.
That’s it. This is what I want. Meng Chuan’s control over the Bloodblade Disc became more exquisite and refined. His strength increased as he easily blocked the white snake.
The ultimate technique in his heart edged closer and closer to perfection. The moment he discovered a problem, he quickly resolved it.
He was getting close...
Oh? Meng Chuan frowned slightly as he looked into the distance. Monarch Peacock and Holy Lady Strings had stopped attacking. They clearly needed to recover their strength after sending a barrage of attacks for an entire hour.
The black river surged.
“Let’s rest for an hour before attacking again.” Monarch Peacock looked at the Godfiends in the distance and said confidently, “We can constantly absorb the Heaven and Earth powers, but their strength will decrease as they consume more energy. When their pills and the energy within the small grotto-heavens are completely depleted, it will be time to reap the harvest.”
“Black River Guard, you are the only weakness in the Black River Array Formation,” said Holy Lady Strings via voice transmission. “The human Godfiends will definitely think of a way to deal with you.”
“Holy Lady Strings, don’t worry. These Godfiends can’t approach us.”
“Their frontal attacks will be obstructed by the Black River Array Formation. They can’t touch us at all.”
“Only their Essence Soul mystic techniques pose a threat to us. Our Life Caskets can’t block King Thousand Wood’s Magic Awl, so we can’t let him come within 25 kilometers of us,” said the Black River Guard from afar.
They knew their limits. If King True Martial punched at them once, they would definitely be killed. The Fire Refinement Star Cauldron could also kill them with a single smash. However, King True Martial and King Molten couldn’t approach them. King Thousand Wood was the only person that could threaten them at such distances. All they needed to do was stay on guard.
Inside the True Martial domain.
After the demons stopped attacking, King True Martial sat down in a somewhat exhausted manner and recovered his energy. “Everyone, if these demons continue attacking, I will need three days to recover completely. Junior Brother Meng, we can only attempt our plan in three days and see if we can approach the 18 guards.”
“Alright,” replied Meng Chuan. He sat cross-legged as the 18 Bloodblades flew in front of him. They traced out the shape of a sphere.
In the semi-translucent cauldron, King Thousand Wood said, “King True Martial, you are unable to absorb the Heaven and Earth powers in the outside world. In the next three days of fighting, will you be able to recover your consumed Quintessential Essence? I can lend you a small grotto-heaven.”
“There’s no need. Back when I first entered the World Gap, I killed many fifth Firmament demon monarchs and obtained many war spoils. Among them was a small Grotto-Heaven.” King True Martial looked at the large number of black chains that wrapped around his True Martial domain. He frowned and said, “Everyone, if you have time, study this mysterious array formation carefully. We know too little about this array formation. Junior Brother Meng and I will try to charge out in three days. The more we know about this array formation, the greater our chances of success.”
“This formation...”
The Godfiends studied the array formation carefully.
King Northcleanse said, “The 18 demon monarchs have numerous runes on their bodies. It seems like their bodies have been modified. Their life-preservation methods are very strong.”
Peng Mu nodded as well. “Previously, from afar, we could see that the 18 demon monarchs’ auras all came from the same source. This might be some kind of joint attack. They are the casters of this array formation, and they are also the array formation’s only weakness. The array formation’s creator has definitely thought of ways to protect them.”
“They haven’t reached the level of a demon sage,” said King Calm Sea coldly. “Therefore, no matter how strong their life-preservation abilities are, it will be of limited use against us.”
“From the looks of it, they don’t dare to come within 25 kilometers of us. They should be afraid of King Thousand Wood’s Magic Awl,” said King Molten. “They are mainly responsible for maintaining the formation. They shouldn’t be too strong in a head-on clash.”
The Godfiends discussed their speculations.
Suddenly, they realized that only one of the Godfiends present hadn’t uttered a single word during their discussion.
Meng Chuan closed his eyes and sat cross-legged. The 18 Bloodblades circled him as they flew.
Hum.
The 18 Bloodblades—which had been flying around Meng Chuan-suddenly darted forward and disappeared into the void. “This is?” King True Martial’s expression changed as he looked at Meng Chuan in shock. Meng Chuan opened his eyes and excitedly sensed the 18 Bloodblades in the void.
I’ve succeeded. I’ve succeeded. Meng Chuan revealed an excited expression. After his ultimate technique reached the Grotto-Heaven realm, he verified his newfound prowess with the Bloodblades.
“Junior Brother Meng?” King True Martial looked at Meng Chuan, his eyes glowing in excitement. “Your weapon has entered the extremely deep void. Although I can sense it, I can’t go that deep myself. Have you broken through?”
“What?” King Transcendence and the Regis Godfiends hiding in the Fire Refinement Star Cauldron looked at Meng Chuan in shock.
What heights had King True Martial reached in the void lineage?
Meng Chuan’s weapon had infiltrated a void layer that even King True Martial couldn’t reach? “I’ve finally made a breakthrough after all these years in the World Gap,” said Meng Chuan without hiding anything. He was filled with delight. “I’ve finally reached the Grotto-Heaven realm for the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique I created.”
“You created your own lightning lineage ultimate technique, and it has reached the Grotto-Heaven realm?” The other Godfiends exchanged looks.
All lightning lineage ultimate techniques shared one characteristic-speed.
For example, the World Roving Dragon Saber was known as the number one movement technique of humanity. It was famous for its unpredictable life-preservation techniques, and it granted one terrifying speed. From the looks of it, King Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, was even more terrifying when it came to speed and movement techniques!
“Ignoring everything else, my Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique is quite adept at void travel,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
The Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique was superior to the World Roving Dragon Saber.
Strictly speaking... Meng Chuan had created the best movement technique for humanity today!
He had created the strongest movement technique in human history at the age of 75. Even with the World Gap’s cultivation opportunities, his talent was still dazzling.
“Void travel?” King True Martial looked at Meng Chuan as his eyes lit up. “Junior Brother Meng, are you confident in cracking the array formation?”
“Cracking the array formation?” The other Godfiends were stunned.
Why did he suddenly mention that? “I need to consolidate my foundation first. I’ll crack the array formation in ten minutes,” said Meng Chuan.
“King Eastcalm, do you really have the confidence to crack the array formation?” King Molten, King Transcendence, King Thousand Wood, and the others all revealed looks of disbelief. Could he crack the Black River Array Formation that gave them headaches?
“I’m not familiar with array formations,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “I’ll try to crack it alone later. I probably have an 80% chance of success. If I fail, I’ll cooperate with King True Martial and King Thousand Wood. That way, we will certainly crack the array formation successfully.” “Certainly crack the array formation?” Everyone was excited by his words.
“King Eastcalm, consolidate your strength first.”
“Don’t disturb King Eastcalm.” The Godfiends were extremely excited.
With a thought, Meng Chuan began to increase his strength.
In his body’s dantian space, the Seamless realm’s Origins-a sphere-was extremely small. Countless white patterns could be seen on the surface of the sphere. Wisps of white light shot out from the sphere’s ‘two poles’ and formed a special fluctuation. It spread out in all directions before returning to the sphere. At this moment, the sphere circulated its laws and began merging with the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Techniques’ Grotto-Heaven profundities.
The more brilliant and profound the Origins’ laws were, the more stable the sphere was. With this stability, the sphere could absorb more energy. A large amount of his small grotto-heaven’s power was absorbed and converted into Quintessential Essence. The sphere’s total energy increased, causing it to collapse.
The collapse caused the sphere to become smaller and denser. The Quintessential Essence within the sphere was naturally purer than before!
Demon array formation. Meng Chuan looked at the black chains surrounding the True Martial domain. Although the array formation was powerful, it couldn’t affect the strongest movement technique in humanity’s history. After all, Meng Chuan could infiltrate a deeper void layer than even Supremacy Roving Dragon -Senior Ye Hong

chapters.title: Chapter 452 - Cracking the Formation
chapters.content:
Chapter 452 Cracking the Formation
Through a gap in the black chains, Meng Chuan could see the endless black river outside. He could sense the array formation’s terrifying might.
Attacking the array formation head-on would be the most foolish decision.
Now that I’ve reached the Grotto-heaven realm, I should be able to control the Bloodblade Disc’s runic array formation better. The Bloodblade Disc floated in front of Meng Chuan. His Essence Soul thought had already seeped into the Bloodblade Disc. The billions of runes on the Bloodblade Disc were mysterious and complicated. Ignoring the barely discernible runes, he could see complete runes up to the 128th layer.
With the increase in Meng Chuan’s cultivation realm and him reaching the Grotto-Heaven realm, his prowess with the lightning lineage underwent a qualitative change. After looking at these runes with increased insight and knowledge, Meng Chuan understood a lot more of them, especially the superficial ones! Although he didn’t fully comprehend each individual rune, he could understand the relationships between the different runic patterns. It gave him knowledge on how to activate them.
The Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique has improved on the World Roving Dragon Saber’s foundation. My movement technique has improved, and my strength has also improved.
If ultimate techniques were divided into levels, the World Roving Dragon Saber would be considered a high-grade Creation-level technique. The Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique can be considered a transcendent-grade Creation-level technique. However, I based my movement technique on Senior Ye Hong’s foundation, so she deserves half the credit.
In terms of foundation, the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique was on par with the True Martial Seven Absolutes. The True Martial Seven Absolutes built on the Yin-Yang Art’s foundation. Similarly, the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique was built on the World Roving Dragon Saber’s foundation.
These two techniques were peak Creation-level ultimate techniques that were created by human Godfiends. The True Martial Seven Absolutes granted one a more comprehensive combat prowess. The Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique focused more on variations in movements and speed.
Since Meng Chuan focused on movement techniques, although he was only in the early stage of the Grotto-Heaven realm, his attainments in this aspect had already reached an unimaginable level.
Of course, in the vast River of Spacetime, there were Creation-level ultimate techniques that surpassed the True Martial Seven Absolutes and the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique.
For example, the Golden Lotus Descent was a paramount Creation-level technique. It was far superior to the True Martial Seven Absolutes and the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique. However, it was also much more difficult to create such a strong technique. Such miraculous techniques made it possible for a Creation Supremacy to kill an Imperial Lord.
Oh? King True Martial, King Molten, and company saw the Bloodblades fly back to Meng Chuan from the deep void.
Meng Chuan looked at the Regis Godfiends around him.
“Junior Brother Meng?” King True Martial looked at Meng Chuan expectantly.
“Senior Brother, please use your domain to prevent the demon monarchs outside from prying,” said Meng Chuan. “Once I crack the array formation, you must immediately hold Monarch Peacock back.”
King True Martial nodded. “Don’t worry. Leave it to me.”
“King Eastcalm, you must remember that your safety comes first,” reminded King Thousand Wood.
King Molten, Peng Mu, and King Calm Sea looked at Meng Chuan. “King Eastcalm, you have to be careful of the demons’ methods.”
Meng Chuan had too many responsibilities. They couldn’t allow any accidents to happen to him.
Meng Chuan smiled. “Everyone, please wait for the good news.”
Whoosh.
He disappeared. In reality, he had entered the deep void immediately.
“I can’t see him at all?”
“I heard that Senior Ye Hong could produce 81 embodiments when executing the World Roving Dragon Saber Art. However, Meng Chuan has completely vanished?” The Regis Godfiends present were astonished.
King Transcendence also sighed in amazement. “I could only enter the shadow world after becoming a phantom lifeform. However, King Eastcalm’s skill in the void lineage allows him to enter the void’s depths completely. We can’t even see him.”
King True Martial was famous for having comprehensive combat prowess. However, he had reached the Grotto-heaven realm’s late stage. He could clearly sense Meng Chuan.
Deep in the void.
Meng Chuan stood in the same spot, but in a completely different space.
The deep void? While he stood in the deep void, Meng Chuan could see the outside world. The Black River Array Formation, Godfiends, and demon monarchs outside were slightly distorted and blurry.
King True Martial once said that the River of Spacetime is like a thousand-layered cake to him. Meng Chuan smiled. It’s about the same as what I perceive now. It’s really like a huge thousand-layered cake. The vast void is split into several layers. Ordinary mortals, ordinary Godfiends, and ordinary demon monarchs are usually in the outermost layer. As for me, I’m hidden in a very deep void layer. The void was like the sea.
Some living beings could only survive above the sea. Some could dive deep into the sea.
As for Meng Chuan, he had entered a deep void layer. His attainments in the void lineage easily allowed him to stay in this void layer and not be expelled.
The shallow void layers can still intersect with the outside world. However, it’s very difficult to come into contact with the outside world once I’m in a deep void layer, thought Meng Chuan.
A pure, powerful force could shatter the shallow void layers and connect with the outside world. As for the deep void? It was just too difficult for one to connect with the outside world from here.
Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!
Meng Chuan released his invisible electromagnetic domain.
Ka! Ka! Ka!
Bloodblades flew out from the Bloodblade Disc -a total of 24.
With Meng Chuan’s current cultivation, he had enough control over the Bloodblade Disc’s runic formation to handle 24 Bloodblades at the same time.
With this, his defensive means had greatly improved.
An Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence had made careful considerations when refining this defensive treasure for his disciple.
The different technique realms correspond to the Bloodblade Disc’s different levels. With only six Bloodblades protecting his body, the remaining 18 Bloodblades circled Meng Chuan and accelerated within the electromagnetic domain.
Meng Chuan executed the Cloud Dragon Snake Saber Art with the 18 Bloodblades. Each of them instantly had the strength of a top Creation realm expert.
The electromagnetic domain accelerated the Bloodblades each time they circled it once.
In a few seconds, the 18 Bloodblades accelerated to their maximum speed.
The electromagnetic domain increases the Bloodblades’ speed by 30 to 40 percent. They barely have the strength of a peak Creation realm expert. Clearly, as the Bloodblades’ strength increases, the effectiveness of the speed boost-granted by the electromagnetic domain-decreases.
Apart from Flowing Sand, his other divine powers had decreasing benefits to his strength. It was an inevitable situation. Although the strength increase had decreased, Meng Chuan’s divine power still increased the Bloodblades’ power slightly.
Go. Standing in the deep void, Meng Chuan commanded the Bloodblades with a thought.
The 18 Bloodblades—which had reached their maximum speed-left the deep void and attacked the demon monarchs outside.
The True Martial domain disrupted all prying means, preventing the demons from knowing what was happening inside.
However, when Meng Chuan entered the deep void, Holy Lady Strings felt something. Huh? Among the Godfiends and demon monarchs present, her attainments in the void lineage were second only to King True Martial’s. Although she couldn’t see Meng Chuan, she could vaguely sense a living being in the deep void.
“Everyone, be careful,” said Holy Lady Strings via voice transmission. “It’s likely that a Godfiend has sneaked into the deep void.”
“Sneaked into the deep void? Who?” Monarch Peacock frowned.
Holy Lady Strings shook her head. “I don’t know.” At the same time, Nine Lives Cocoon threads spread around the Eighteen Black River Guard, carefully protecting all of them. “How can a Godfiend enter the deep void?” The Eighteen Black River Guard was somewhat nervous. An invisible enemy was very terrifying
“Strings, protect the Eighteen Black River Guard,” said Monarch Peacock.
“There are 18 of them. I can only do my best, but I can’t assure their absolute safety.” Holy Lady Strings was very uneasy. The Nine Lives Cocoon was the strongest Tribulation treasure she could’ve chosen from when it came to life-preservation means. It could protect her entire body completely. However, its defense was much weaker when used to protect her companions. Protect the Eighteen Black River Guard perfectly when the numerous threads were spread out over several kilometers? She didn’t have the confidence.
Monarch Peacock nodded and said, “Everyone, don’t panic. Every Godfiend has their own specialties. If this Godfiend can enter the deep void, his offensive means might be weak.”
As soon as he finished speaking
“Not good.” Holy Lady Strings’s expression changed drastically. She could sense a terrifying force coming from the deep void.
The Eighteen Black River Guard controlled the array formation and suppressed the void. Finally, they sensed the terrifying force. However, it was too late for them!
Swish! Swish! Swish!
Beams of light arrived from the deep void. The moment they appeared in the outside world, they were only a few feet away from a goat demon Black River Guard. The light beams instantly struck him. The goat demon’s eyes widened, unable to react in time. In the blink of an eye, the Black River Guard member exploded!

chapters.title: Chapter 453 - Giving Up
chapters.content:
Chapter 453 Giving Up
The attack happened nearly instantly.
In fact, Holy Lady Strings had already tried her best to protect the Black River Guard. The goat demon had been wrapped with threads, and it had done its best to resist the attacks. However, the first Bloodblade pierced the Nine Lives Cocoon threads and struck the Black River Guard’s body, causing his chest to cave in. The second Bloodblade entered the Black River Guard’s body completely. The third Bloodblade shattered his body, struck the Life Casket, and destroyed the life core.
The Life Casket was extremely tough, and it served as protection for the life core.
However, when the Bloodblades struck the Life Casket’s surface, a terrifying force was transmitted, shattering everything inside it.
Just like that, the goat demon Black River Guard died!
When the first Black River Guard was killed, the originally vast 400-kilometer-long black river immediately calmed down. The black chains—which had been suppressing the True Martial domain-dissipated.
Boom!
King True Martial traveled five kilometers in a second. His True Martial domain’s range expanded to five kilometers around him, instantly enveloping Monarch Peacock-who had been laying siege more than five kilometers away.
“Demon Monarch Peacock.” King True Martial smiled as he charged forward, wanting to engage in close combat. “Damn it.” Monarch Peacock’s purple eyes were filled with anger as he glanced at the distant Black River Guard. Bloodblades struck the five terrified Black River Guard members at the same time. Their bodies exploded as the vast black river began to dissipate. The Bloodblades continued to pursue the other members of the Black River Guard.
The Eighteen Black River Guard is finished. Monarch Peacock understood this point. He stared at King True Martial—who was charging towards him—and sneered coldly. He held his spear and charged towards King True Martial.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Monarch Peacock and King True Martial clashed.
On the other side, Holy Lady Strings’s expression was gloomy. Patriarch Poison Dragon shook his head slightly. “The Eighteen Black River Guard is finished.”
“It was King Eastcalm,” said Holy Lady Strings coldly. She was able to guess the murderer’s identity when the Bloodblades appeared.
Patriarch Poison Dragon frowned. “King Eastcalm, Meng Chuan? Again?”
King Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, had obstructed the demons too many times in this war.
“Holy Lady Strings, save me.”
“Help!”
“Save me!”
The members of the Black River Guard were filled with despair. They were originally fifth Firmament demon monarchs that reigned supreme in a particular region. Under the Imperial Lord’s orders, they willingly transformed into the Black River Guard. They didn’t have hope of becoming demon sages. After becoming part of the Black River Guard, their strength increased greatly. In the future, their status in the Demon Realm would also increase greatly. It wasn’t a bad option.
However, although they had accomplished something in their first battle, who would have thought that they would immediately encounter a life-and-death crisis?
This terrifying Godfiend hid in the deep void, preventing the Black River Array Formation from affecting him. Eighteen Bloodblades appeared in front of them, making it impossible for them to dodge! Every Bloodblade was terrifyingly powerful. Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft!
Meng Chuan watched as his Bloodblades pursued the Black River Guards.
The attacks were split into two waves.
In the first wave, he killed one Black River Guard. This greatly reduced the Black River Array Formation’s strength, making it unable to pose a threat to the Godfiends any longer.
In the second wave, three Bloodblades attacked another Black River Guard and pursued them. The Bloodblades’ movements were unpredictable and terrifying. The Nine Lives Cocoon threads couldn’t intercept them even at close range.
Black River Guards exploded one after another! They were horrified and in despair. The Bloodblades were too fast; they couldn’t escape at all.
“Everyone, gather towards me,” said Holy Lady Strings via voice transmission. Numerous Nine Lives Cocoon threads gathered to protect the five Black River Guards that were closest to her.
“Alright.” The remaining Black River Guards struggled to gather. Swoosh.
Bloodblades came from the deep void and appeared inside the Nine Lives Cocoon threads’ protective range. They attacked the five Black River Guards inside the protective barrier.
Pfft! Pfft! Pfft!
This scene made Holy Lady Strings shake her head slightly.
“Cang Jue, I can only save you,” said Holy Lady Strings via voice transmission. A large number of Nine Lives Cocoon threads wrapped around Demon Monarch Cang Jue’s body, forming a robe. The robe protected his head, and Demon Monarch Cang Jue immediately flew towards Holy Lady Strings at full speed. Another boom sounded, and an ox demon Black River Guard was killed. There was only one remaining Black River Guard-Demon Monarch Cang Jue.
The Bloodblades spun as they struck him. Demon Monarch Cane Jue was sent flying from the impact, but the robe protecting him was extremely tough. The robe was the perfect manifestation of Holy Lady Strings’s technique realm.
The 18 Bloodblades struck Cang Jue one after another. Although each Bloodblade was extremely strong, the robe withstood all the attacks.
The dark-cyan-robed Meng Chuan finally appeared.
Meng Chuan looked at Demon Monarch Cang Jue—who was protected by the Nine Lives Cocoon threads. There’s still one left. He then looked at Holy Lady Strings. “Do you think you can protect it?”
“Don’t even think of injuring it!” Holy Lady Strings flew over at high speed.
Hum.
An invisible Astral Wave swept over, affecting Demon Monarch Cang Jue’s Essence Soul.
“I-I...” Demon Monarch Cang Jue staggered as his consciousness began to blur.
The Eighteen Black River Guard consisted of ordinary fifth Firmament demon monarchs. Their Essence Souls were generally weak. Demon Monarch Cang Jue only had a fourth-level Essence Soul! Even with a Life Casket protecting him, his consciousness turned groggy under the Astral Wave. “It’s a pity that your Essence Soul is too weak,” said Meng Chuan coldly. A Magic Awl flew out and drilled into Demon Monarch Cang Jue’s body.
Cang Jue’s body trembled before he fell silent.
All members of the Eighteen Black River Guard died.
Holy Lady Strings stopped moving and stared at the distant Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan glanced at her and took a step forward. He arrived beside King Molten, King Thousand Wood, and the other Godfiendswho were dozens of kilometers away. “The Eighteen Black River Guard has been wiped out. When they join forces, they become one. Due to this, their Essence Soul defenses will be greatly enhanced.” Patriarch Poison Dragon appeared by Holy Lady Strings’s side and shook his head. “If there’s only one Black River Guard left, even if it’s a special lifeform, a fourth-level Essence Soul can’t withstand King Eastcalm’s Magic Awl.”
“It’s King Eastcalm again.” Holy Lady Strings looked at the distant Godfiends. She felt very angry because she failed to protect the Eighteen Black River Guard.
Most importantly,
King Eastcalm Meng Chuan was responsible for the kills again! Her bosom friend, Demon Monarch Quicksand, and many other demon monarchs had died at Meng Chuan’s hands.
“You stayed idle on the side and watched them die?” Holy Lady Strings looked at Patriarch Poison Dragon.Patriarch Poison Dragon chuckled. “Apart from watching, what else can I do? I can’t withstand those Bloodblades at all. I wanted to pull the Black River Guards into a small Grotto-Heaven, but the Bloodblades tore through the void. The void was so unstable that there was no way for me to pull them in. With my strength, I could only watch everything happen. As for you, Strings... didn’t you fail to save a single one after all the work you put in?”
Given his undying body, Patriarch Poison Dragon calmly taunted Holy Lady Strings. “We lost terribly this time,” said Holy Lady Strings coldly. “Although we killed two Regis Godfiends, we lost the Eighteen Black River Guard and Demon Monarch Coldmoon. Our losses are even greater in this battle.” “The three of us won’t be able to win. King True Martial’s domain is powerful. Meng Chuan can appear anywhere now. His attacks are also extremely powerful,” said Patriarch Poison Dragon. “Let’s return and report to the Imperial Lords. Let them decide what will happen next.”
Patriarch Poison Dragon looked into the distance. “That lunatic Peacock is still fighting.”
Bang!!!
With a boom, a beam of light flew towards Patriarch Poison Dragon and Holy Lady Strings.
“Peacock,” greeted Patriarch Poison Dragon with a smile.
“I clearly suppress him, but I can’t defeat him.” Monarch Peacock was extremely furious. “Let’s go back to the Demon Realm.” With Monarch Peacock leading the way, Patriarch Poison Dragon followed. Holy Lady Strings remained silent, but she also flew away with them.
The human Godfiends watched from afar and didn’t stop them from retreating.

chapters.title: Chapter 454 - Report
chapters.content:
Chapter 454 Report
“It’s a great victory to have that array formation destroyed.” King Molten watched the demons leave and said, “The demons made 18 fifth Firmament demon monarchs undergo a life modification process and ultimately set up this array formation. They clearly spared no expense when nurturing them. Fortunately, King Eastcalm was able to crack this array formation.”
“It’s a pity that Junior Brother Yun and King Gu Eyes lost their lives,” said Peng Mu softly.
“How can there be no casualties in war?” King Molten said. “As long as we win, it’s worth it.”
Huh? Meng Chuan looked into the distance. After reaching the Grotto-Heaven realm, his perception of the world was acute. At that moment, he could clearly sense part of the World Gap being destroyed in the distance.
Boom!
The world membrane was being attacked.
King True Martial waved his hand, and an image appeared in the void—one of a distant area.
Monarch Peacock, Holy Lady Strings, and Patriarch Poison Dragon were attacking the world membrane. Soon, they blasted a rift open in the World Gap and the Demon Realm’s world membranes.
The three of them flew into the Demon Realm. Soon, the world membranes quickly recovered to their normal states.
“They have returned to the Demon Realm,” said King True Martial with a frown. “We may have had the upper hand in this battle, but the demons had only sent their vanguard. After knowing our battle capabilities, the three demon Imperial Lords will definitely think of ways to nurture those fifth Firmament demon monarchs. They will also think of ways to deal with us. We still need to be careful.”
“The demons’ goal isn’t to defeat us,” said King Thousand Wood solemnly. “Their true goal is to send large groups of fifth Firmament demon monarchs into the human world.”
“Once they enter the human world, the fifth Firmament demon monarchs will split up and take action. Once they take action, they will probably wipe out most of our human cities,” said King Calm Sea with a nod.
Everyone present fell silent.
This was the bitter truth.
Currently, there were very few demon monarchs—which were lurking in the human world—that had reached the fifth Firmament. At most, they were all newly-advanced fifth Firmament demon monarchs. None of them dared to attack cities guarded by Regis Godfiends.
However, if a group of heavily-nurtured fifth Firmament demon monarchs—who had cultivated for many years—entered the human world, they wouldn’t be afraid of Regis Godfiends. They would attack all the large cities that weren’t guarded by Creation Supremacies. Regis Godfiends might be able to fight them one-on-one, but the demon monarchs’ goal was to destroy the cities. It was difficult for human Regis Godfiends to stop them.
Causing destruction was much easier than protecting something. A large-scale domain attack-spanning over 50 kilometers—could instantly wipe out all living beings within an area. It would be easy for these demon monarchs to slaughter the mortals residing in the cities.
Just one operation undertaken by a large number of fifth Firmament demon monarchs would result in the destruction of over 90% of the human cities. No matter how powerful Meng Chuan was, he was only one person. He could only save one city at a time.
“That’s why we have to stop them,” said Meng Chuan. “We have to report the results of this battle to the three sects.”
“Junior Brother Meng, go back on my behalf,” said King True Martial.
Meng Chuan nodded. “Alright.”
King True Martial had to stay behind to maintain the group’s safety when the demons attacked again. Meng Chuan was the only Regis Godfiend in this group who could guarantee his own safety while working alone. “King Eastcalm, I’ll go back with you,” said King Northcleanse.
“King Eastcalm, please pass the news to Two World Island on my behalf as well,” said King Thousand Wood. “Let’s distribute the war spoils and let King Eastcalm bring them back.”
Boom!
Meng Chuan used his Bloodblade to tear a huge hole open in the World Gap and the human world’s world membranes. Meng Chuan flew through the huge hole and returned to Archean Mountain.
He first flew towards Grotto-Heaven Pavilion.
Archean Mountain is still peaceful. Meng Chuan looked around as he flew. Although the battle in the World Gap was crazy and harrowing, the human world—including the three major sects-remained relatively peaceful. It was a rare period of peace in the past 800 years.
One had to know that...
In the past 800 years, even in the early stages of the invasion, many small and medium-sized World Entrances had to be guarded to ensure the entire human world’s safety. It was only until later that they could no longer defend all of the World Entrances.
Humanity gave up on the small and medium-sized World Entrances, causing more and more demon monarchs to enter the human world. When one million demon monarchs appeared in the human world to wreak havoc, village forts, prefecture cities, and county cities were abandoned one after another. Countless people died. Only when Meng Chuan rose to prominence did he completely resolve the threat of a million demon monarchs.
Meng Chuan also understood that this was a temporary peace.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan landed in Grotto-Heaven Pavilion.
“Supremacies, Master.” Meng Chuan bowed and greeted the three Supremacies.
Li Guan, an illusory Qin Wu, and an illusory Luo Tang were gathered together, waiting for Meng Chuan.
Li Guan drank tea as he sat at a table. After taking a sip of tea, he smiled. “Sit.”
Meng Chuan sat down and drank a mouthful of tea.
“You came back alone?” asked the illusory Luo Tang in surprise. “They can’t leave willy-nilly,” said Meng Chuan. “Also, there’s a reason why I came back to report.”
“What happened?” asked Li Guan.
Meng Chuan said, “Today, the demons finally sent a team into the World Gap to deal with us. Senior Brother Yun Jianhai and King Gu Eyes from Two World Island have died in battle.”
“What?” Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang were alarmed. “Tell me what happened in detail,” said Li Guan immediately.
Meng Chuan nodded and said, “I brought a letter from King Thousand Wood with me. It’s to be delivered to Two World Island. The letter describes the battle. Supremacies, you can read this letter as well. King Thousand Wood wrote this letter to prevent our Archean Mountain from fabricating stories.” With that said, he took out the letter and handed it to Li Guan.
Li Guan received the letter; Qin Wu and Luo Tang read it from the side.
The letter wasn’t long, but the key points were mentioned.
“It’s no wonder he wants to send this letter.” Li Guan nodded. “King True Martial and he worked together to kill Demon Monarch Coldmoon and obtained a Tribulation treasure. Speaking of which, Two World Island doesn’t have any Tribulation treasures, right?”
“Two World Island’s heritage is a little shallow. They haven’t given birth to an Imperial Lord. They probably don’t have any Tribulation treasures,” said Qin Wu. “I never expected them to obtain a Tribulation treasure in the World Gap.”
“It’s written here that King True Martial and King Thousand Wood contributed the most to Demon Monarch Coldmoon’s death. King True Martial has 70% of the credit, while King Thousand Wood takes the remaining 30%,” said Li Guan. “We will discuss how we should split the war spoils with Two World Island.”
With a flip of his hand, a dark short sword appeared in Meng Chuan’s hand.
“The Tribulation treasure is this sword,” said Meng Chuan.
Li Guan received it and put it away after a brief inspection. “We will discuss this with Two World Island later.”
“According to the letter, 18 demon monarchs set up a massive array formation that spanned 400 kilometers in length?” asked Li Guan. “Each of these 18 demon monarchs underwent a life modification process?”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded. “The array formation was extremely powerful. King Gu Eyes and Senior Brother Yun mainly died because of this array formation.” “You were the one who destroyed this array formation?” Qin Wu asked curiously. “According to the letter, this array formation suppressed King True Martial’s domain and completely trapped many of you Godfiends. Later, you entered the deep void and killed the 18 demon monarchs one by one, thus destroying the array formation?”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Yes.”
“Such a powerful array formation will definitely suppress the void. How did you get close?” asked Qin Wu.
“To be honest, Master, I’ve finally made a breakthrough after cultivating in the World Gap for so many years,” said Meng Chuan. “My Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique has reached the Grotto-Heaven realm. That’s how I could enter a very deep void layer and kill the 18 demon monarchs with my Bloodblades.”
“You’ve reached the Grotto-Heaven realm?” Luo Tang was pleasantly surprised. “Yes, you reaching the Grotto-Heaven realm at the age of 75 is also within our expectations. How many embodiments do you project in the outside world when you enter the deep void? 81? 108”
Meng Chuan shook his head. “No embodiments are projected in the outside world.”

chapters.title: Chapter 455 - Creating a Grotto-Heaven?
chapters.content:
Chapter 455 Creating a Grotto-Heaven?
“No embodiments?” Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang were stunned.
“You can infiltrate the extremely deep void?” asked Li Guan.
Meng Chuan nodded. “Yes.”
The illusory Qin Wu asked, “Meng Chuan, from you, I heard that the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique-which you created is an improvement on the World Roving Dragon Saber. Even though it’s an improved version of it, how can you not produce any embodiments at all?”
Even Supremacy Roving Dragon, Senior Ye Hong-who had reached the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm-projected embodiments in the outside world when she traveled the void.
Although Meng Chuan had improved Supremacy Roving Dragon’s technique further, he had only reached the Grotto-Heaven realm’s early stage.
Meng Chuan explained, “Master, my Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique is indeed based on the World Roving Dragon Saber. However, as I cultivate, the difference between the two techniques becomes greater. After breaking through to the Grotto-Heaven realm, the two techniques have completely different cultivation directions. Senior Ye Hong’s World Roving Dragon Saber... places greater importance on variability! As for my Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique, it places greater importance on infiltrating the void.”
Senior Ye Hong’s technique primarily followed the Roving Dragon Form of Lightning’s essence. Meng Chuan’s technique followed the Nine Heavenly Forms of the Void’s essence. The two techniques’ cores were different from each other.
Due to this, Meng Chuan’s Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique was better at infiltrating the void.
“They follow different aspects?” Qin Wu understood what Meng Chuan was getting at. “Show it to me.” “Alright.” Meng Chuan nodded and vanished.
Qin Wu and Luo Tang looked at Li Guan. This was because Li Guan’s real body could detect Meng Chuan’s location.
“Impressive.” Li Guan sensed Meng Chuan’s location and sighed in amazement. “In terms of void concealment, he has already reached an astonishing level. Even I still need to use a Tribulation treasure to blast through that void layer completely.” “Oh?” Qin Wu and Luo Tang were somewhat shocked by Li Guan’s words.
In this world, the strongest Creation Supremacies were Bai Yaoyue, Li Guan, and Qin Wu.
Bai Yaoyue was adept at the Grand Yin lineage.
Li Guan cultivated the Archean Divine Body and was skilled in the five elements. His control over the void was even more exquisite than that of King True Martial.
Qin Wu’s Sky Splitting Sword Formation mainly focused on sealing the void. Thus, he had extremely profound attainments in the void lineage.
Qin Wu and Li Guan were both skilled in the void lineage.
“That’s right.” Qin Wu smiled as he looked at Meng Chuan. “Among all the Creation Supremacies in the world, only Senior Brother Li Guan and I can threaten you. If you go deeper into the void... I’m afraid no one in the world can threaten you.” “It’s just hiding to protect myself,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “When killing enemies, one has to use an offensive technique. By the way, when I was killing the 18 demon monarchs in the array formation, I noticed that their core lifeforce was a black casket. I obtained 16 black caskets; I failed to obtain the remaining two.”
With that said, Meng Chuan waved his hand, and 16 Life Caskets piled up on the ground. “Life Caskets?” said Li Guan in surprise.
“The interior of this casket is already damaged,” said Meng Chuan. “There are a lot of runes in the Life Caskets. I can’t understand them. Master, can you tell what array formation the 18 demon monarchs could form?”
“I can recognize these things as Life Caskets. In the outer realm, it’s quite common for special lifeforms to use a Life Casket as their core lifeforce,” said Li Guan with a frown. “However, I don’t understand or know what array formation these Life Caskets can form.”
“I can’t tell either.” Qin Wu shook his head. “Creation Supremacies travel too slowly in the River of Spacetime. The area they can explore is limited. Imperial Lords can explore a much wider area in the River of Spacetime.... It’s getting harder for an Imperial Lord to be born in our homeworld. Due to this, we are exploring the outer realm less and less. We know more about the surrounding areas in this River of Spacetime region. However, our information on more distant areas is outdated.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
Qin Wu, Luo Tang, and Li Guan exchanged looks. Qin Wu said, “Meng Chuan, there’s something I need to remind you of.”
“Please speak, Master.” Meng Chuan listened carefully.
“You have already reached the Grotto-Heaven realm, and have a fifth-level Essence Soul. Logically speaking, you can become a Creation Supremacy at any time,” said Qin Wu. “However, the mission in the World Gap is the most pressing matter now. If you become a Creation Supremacy, you won’t be able to enter the World Gap. Therefore, for this war, you can’t break through temporarily.”
“I understand.” Meng Chuan smiled. “Ordinary Regis Godfiends aim to break through before they are 150 years old. I cultivate a physical body cultivation system, so my vitality is always at its peak. I can break through whenever I want to. I’m not in a hurry.”
Qin Wu added, “Meng Chuan, I know you created the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique and Infinite Saber Art. These are two separate paths. However, you have to choose a single path if you want to create a Grotto-Heaven. This is also the path you have to take and focus on in the future.”
Meng Chuan listened to his master’s wisdom.
“When breaking through to the Grotto-Heaven realm, you will need to control the process with your powerful Essence Soul. With the Grotto-Heaven realm laws of one technique, you will be able to create a grotto-heaven,” said Qin Wu. “The grotto-heaven that you create in your dantian space will also be the source of your future strength.
“The grotto-heaven that’s created is like a sapling. As you cultivate, the grotto-heaven will inch closer to perfection. This is also the slow growth of the sapling. After that, the grotto-heaven will transform into Heaven Earth. It is also the moment the tree sapling grows into a towering tree.” Qin Wu looked at Meng Chuan. “You have to follow one path and never stray from it. When you decide on your sapling’s identity, you are also determining the future of the towering tree.”
“I understand,” replied Meng Chuan. He also understood this.
“Now that you have reached the required realm, you can choose your path at any time. As your master, I have to remind you that you currently have two paths to choose from,” said Qin Wu solemnly. “The path your Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique follows is relatively easy. Now that you are at the Grotto-Heaven realm at such a young age, you have a chance of reaching the Heaven Earth realm in the future. As far as I know, your Infinite Saber pursues the limits of speed. Once you can break the worldly law’s suppressions with pure speed alone, it will become a legendary paramount technique.”
Meng Chuan fell silent. He was in a dilemma over this matter.
“Paramount techniques are very powerful,” continued Qin Wu. “With the Grotto-Heaven realm laws of a paramount technique, the created grotto-heaven will definitely be 1,000 times more superior to an ordinary grotto-heaven. The grotto-heaven will transform into Heaven and Earth. Once formed, the Heaven and Earth in one’s body will definitely be 1,000 times larger than the average.
“One’s foundation will be extremely robust, but the cultivation difficulty is much higher. At the very least, in our homeworld, no paramount technique has been created to date. Even if you can create a Creation-level paramount technique, it will be very difficult to create an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique.
“You have to consider which of the two paths you will follow carefully. Once you make the choice, there’s no way to reverse it,” said Qin Wu. “I have to remind you that no person that follows the Godfiend cultivation system has ever created a grotto-heaven with a paramount technique.”
Meng Chuan’s heart skipped a beat. His master’s last sentence had jolted him awake.
Up to now, generations of human predecessors had perfected and refined the Godfiend cultivation system. However, no one had managed to create a grotto-heaven with a paramount technique’s laws. Although everyone believed that the resultant grotto-heaven would be 1,000 times larger than ordinary grotto-heavens, it was unprecedented. Accidents could happen.
“Yes, you have enough time to think about it slowly,” said Li Guan with a smile. “After knowing that you have attempted to create a paramount technique, your master has been reading countless manuals and books from Archean Mountain and the Eon Sea Sect over the past few years. He has helped you gather a lot of information regarding paramount techniques.”
With that said, he waved his hand, and a pile of books appeared beside him. There were hundreds of them.
Meng Chuan looked at his master gratefully. Archean Mountain and the Eon Sea Sect had a ton of books. No one had ever created a paramount technique, so who would care about such scattered records? Qin Wu had conducted this research for his disciple. He wanted to make Meng Chuan’s future cultivation path very smooth. Thus, he did his best to read through these books carefully.
“My embodiment usually has nothing to do,” said Qin Wu with a smile.
“Thank you, Master,” said Meng Chuan gratefully.
Meanwhile, in the Demon Realm.
“The Black River Array Formation was destroyed?” Imperial Lord Starquix, Lady Blackmoon, and Emperor Roc sat high in the hall. They looked down at the three demon monarchs that had returned in disbelief.
To create the Black River Array Formation, Emperor Roc had expended a lot of effort. The three Imperial Lords had high hopes for the Black River Array Formation. Who would have thought that it would fail on their first try?
“Give me the details,” instructed Imperial Lord Starquix.
“This was what happened,” reported Patriarch Poison Dragon immediately.

chapters.title: Chapter 456 - Brush Strokes Infused
chapters.content:
Chapter 456 Brush Strokes Infused
After hearing Patriarch Poison Dragon’s explanation, the three Imperial Lords exchanged looks.
“It’s that Meng Chuan again,” said Blackmoon coldly. “His threat level is increasing. To reach such a level after only a few decades of cultivation, it means he can become a Creation Supremacy at any time.”
“The tenth Creation Supremacy of the human race,” said Imperial Lord Starquix. “King True Martial, King Molten, and the others relied on their years of accumulation to have their current strength. They are too old, so it’s impossible for them to breakthrough. However, Meng Chuan is still very young. He is deliberately holding back his breakthrough because he wants to fight in the World Gap. In practice, he’s the tenth Creation Supremacy of the human race.”
Emperor Roc looked down and said, “Can you sense Meng Chuan after he enters the deep void?”
“Only I can sense him,” said Holy Lady Strings respectfully. “I can vaguely sense his location.”
“To have such attainments at such a young age...” Emperor Roc nodded and said, “Considering his age, he will definitely become an invincible Creation realm expert in the future. He might even become an Imperial Lord.”
“It’s not that easy to become an Imperial Lord.” Imperial Lord Starquix shook his head and said, “Human Creation Supremacies are trapped in their homeworld. They don’t dare to enter the outer realm. They’re afraid of being pursued by us. Without the outer realm’s various opportunities, it’s too difficult to become an Imperial Lord.”
However, Lady Blackmoon coldly said, “There’s no need to think too much. The pressing issue now is how we’re going to map the World Gap’s connection points. We need that map of connection points if we want to send fifth Firmament demon monarchs into the human world.”
“My greatest fear is that these Regis Godfiends will be in the way when we’re trying to map the World Gap’s connection points,” said Imperial Lord Starquix. “How are we to stop Meng Chuan if he can enter the deep void?”
“Many defensive arrays can prevent him from entering the void,” said Blackmoon. “Some powerful defensive arrays can greatly reduce the strength of karmic attacks, much less suppressing the void. However, these are immobile defensive arrays. To map the World Gap’s connection points, one will have to travel through the entire World Gap. They can’t hide in a fixed spot.”
Imperial Lord Starquix pondered and said, “The only way is to have the demon monarchs form an array formation and seal the void. Us demons have the Nine Dragon Realm-Sealing Array-which is quite suitable. Normally, nine demon sages are needed to set it up. However, I can modify it slightly and have 99 fifth Firmament demon monarchs set up the array.”
“Let’s do that.” Emperor Roc nodded. “I’ll leave it to you.”
In terms of strength, Emperor Roc was the strongest out of the three Imperial Lords.
When it came to array formations and curses, Imperial Lord Starquix was most adept.
“As long as we suppress the void, Meng Chuan’s threat level will greatly decrease,” said Imperial Lord Starquix. “When we’re trying to map the World Gap’s connection points, King Thousand Wood will be the greatest threat when both sides enter combat. As long as he’s within 25 kilometers of a demon monarch, he is free to attack with his Magic Awl. There are too few demon monarchs that can withstand his Magic Awl.” “Imperial Lord, I had my Essence Soul pierced by the Magic Awl once,” said Holy Lady Strings respectfully. “Back then, I was in extreme pain. I could only use the Nine Lives Cocoon to protect my body completely. I had no way of resisting it. I think that if I had been attacked by the Magic Awl a few more times, my Essence Soul would have collapsed.”
“The Nine Lives Cocoon’s Essence Soul defense failed?”
Imperial Lord Starquix, Emperor Roc, and Lady Blackmoon felt the pressure.
The Magic Awl Forbidden Spell was the signature move of the human world—the Archean Eon Realm. In the River of Spacetime, alien experts feared Archean Eon Realm’s experts. It was partly because of Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s fame and the signature move, Magic Awl Forbidden Spell.
“The three of you can leave first.” Imperial Lord Starquix waved his hand, and the trio of demon monarchs retreated.
“We have to be careful when dealing with King Thousand Wood. There’s no need to keep him 25 kilometers away from our forces,” said Emperor Roc.
“We still need to prepare for the final operation carefully,” said Imperial Lord Starquix. “We can’t fail this mission.”
“Yes.” Lady Blackmoon and Emperor Roc nodded.
The three of them had been Imperial Lords for many years. Emperor Roc’s strength and fame spread far and wide in this River of Spacetime region, but none of them had reached the Tribulation realm. They naturally wanted to grasp the opportunity of obtaining Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasure trove. This was also the greatest opportunity in their lives.
Archean Eon Realm.
Meng Chuan left Archean Mountain and arrived at one of the Great Zhou Dynasty’s nine city passes—Snow Wind Pass. Liu Qiyue guarded Snow Wind Pass.
It was night, and the snow drifted outside the window.
The couple sat on the bed and chatted.
“Ah Chuan, do you know that the Great Zhou Dynasty already has nine large city passes?” said Liu Qiyue as she leaned on Meng Chuan.
“Nine large city passes?” Meng Chuan was astonished.
“A medium-sized World Entrance in the East Sea has become a large World Entrance,” said Liu Qiyue. “In short, although the world has been peaceful for the past decade, World Entrances have been expanding slowly and increasing in number. Originally, World Entrances mainly formed on land. However, there are increasingly more in the ocean now.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Land is the core of the human world. The four seas are the periphery of the world. Since large World Entrances are gradually appearing in the ocean, it clearly means that the two worlds are getting closer and closer.”
Liu Qiyue nodded slightly. “But don’t worry.” Meng Chuan smiled and said, “We don’t arrange for Godfiends to guard small and medium-sized World Entrances nowadays. We can just arrange for demon servants to keep an eye on them secretly. Only large-scale city passes and super-large city passes need to be guarded. As long as there’s enough manpower, the human world will stay peaceful. The human world and the Demon Realm will get closer and closer. After a certain point, they will gradually separate from each other. Once that happens, the pressure on us will ease.” “I wonder when the two worlds will begin to separate,” said Liu Qiyue.
“We will definitely see it happen while we’re alive,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
According to records, two worlds would usually separate after a few centuries.
Regis Godfiends had long lifespans. Furthermore, they could sleep for 1,000 years. They could still witness the day of victory. “By the way, Ah Chuan, how long are you staying this time?” asked Liu Qiyue.
“Three days,” said Meng Chuan. “In three days, King Northcleanse will meet me at Archean Mountain. We will then head to the World Gap together.”
“It’s been hard on you,” said Liu Qiyue softly. “As long as we obtain victory and completely resolve the World Gap’s threat,” said Meng Chuan with a smile, “we will be at peace. We just have to guard the World Entrances in the future once the World Gap’s threat is resolved.”
Liu Qiyue nodded.
“Sleep early,” said Meng Chuan as he lay down.
“Okay.” Liu Qiyue nodded. The couple had finally reunited after so many years, so they naturally had many things they wanted to say. They only rested in the latter half of the night.
The next day, the snow stopped.
The sunlight shone on the snow; the reflected light was somewhat blinding. Meng Chuan was already in the study. He mixed the paint and prepared to paint.
Liu Qiyue sat cross-legged in a pavilion outside the window. An invisible heatwave spread in all directions, melting a large amount of snow. In front of her, a wisp of fire transformed into a small phoenix. After forming, it flew around her.
I promised to paint a painting for Qiyue every year. In the past few years, I’ve been painting in the World Gap. I’ll use Qiyue as my model this year. Meng Chuan smiled. He looked up at Liu Qiyue—who was cultivating outside-and lowered his head to paint.
Painting was relaxing for him. To him, this pastime was a form of enjoyment and a way to relax his mental state. Every stroke of Meng Chuan’s brush was like a dragon. The essence of his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique was naturally infused into the brush. This caused Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul to stir as his Essence Soul slowly glowed. The higher one’s technique realm was, the greater the influence on their Essence Soul when cultivating
After reaching the Grotto-Heaven realm, one’s Essence Soul would naturally transform whenever they cultivated normally. Most experts that reached the Grotto-Heaven realm would naturally attain a fifth-level Essence Soul. King True Martial, Peng Mu, and company were the same.
King Calm Sea hadn’t cultivated for very long, so he had yet to obtain a fifth-level Essence Soul. Given more time, his Essence Soul would naturally reach the fifth level.
Once Meng Chuan reached the Grotto-Heaven realm, he could fuse his techniques’ essence into his brush technique. The brush technique contained his technique’s law profundities. He naturally found it easier for his feelings to be evoked, which affected his Essence Soul.

chapters.title: Chapter 457 - Sixth-Level Essence Soul
chapters.content:
Chapter 457 Sixth-Level Essence Soul
From the moment his artistic realm ‘stepped into the Dao,’ his Essence Soul gradually transformed every time he painted. After reaching the Grotto-Heaven realm, one just required sufficient time for their Essence Soul to become a fifth-level Essence Soul. After becoming a fifth-level Essence Soul, the benefits of passive growth would be much lesser than before.
After reaching the Heaven Earth realm, a cultivator’s Essence Soul would definitely become a sixth-level Essence Soul given enough time.
As for obtaining a seventh-level Essence Soul? One needed to undergo emotional upheavals! They needed to create their own cultivation techniques to trigger the Essence Soul’s transformation! Either that or they could obtain special opportunities like Essence Soul cultivation techniques. In short, to countless living beings in the River of Spacetime, obtaining a seventh-level Essence Soul was their limit.
Even Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s Essence Soul stayed at the seventh-level for his entire life.
Obtaining an eighth-level Essence Soul? This meant one was an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence! One required talent and opportunities to reach this step. Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Meng Chuan’s brush moved like a dragon. He painted to his heart’s content.
Not every technique could be fused with brushstrokes. If it was an ultimate technique that had a strong baneful aura? What if it were a paramount technique? If the technique didn’t match the mood, then it wouldn’t be suitable to use it whilst painting a beautiful woman.
The Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique was like a brush that used the world as a canvas. Thus, it was very suitable for painting. Meng Chuan found his brushstrokes very beautiful as he painted. Every stroke stirred the natural law’s profundities and the Heaven and Earth powers. At the same time, the brushstrokes touched his heart. The painting seemed to transform into a grotto-heaven gradually. Usually, a grotto-heaven was unable to be depicted within an ordinary painting. However, this painting gradually formed an illusory grotto-heaven.
The ancients did not lie. A picture can really speak a thousand words. This painting is a world in itself. Meng Chuan sighed inwardly. When one reaches the Grotto-Heaven realm, their paintings can form an illusory grotto-heaven if their painting techniques are sufficiently brilliant.
Halfway through his painting, Meng Chuan sensed the changes in his Essence Soul.
My Essence Soul has broken through? Meng Chuan was overjoyed. In his sea of consciousness, the slowly rotating Essence Soul Star and the revolving black Magic Awl originally emitted spiritual glows. However, they were now beginning to transform.
IS.
This was a transformation of the Essence Soul’s Origins-a qualitative change. His fifth-level Essence Soul had broken through the barrier and became a sixth-level Essence Soul. His Essence Soul perception domain now had a range of 25 kilometers.
It’s been 17 years since I attained a fifth-level Essence Soul Meng Chuan was secretly delighted by his Essence Soul’s transformation. I’ve finally attained a sixth-level Essence Soul.
Meng Chuan quickly calmed down before commanding his Essence Soul with a thought. Fuse.
The black Magic Awl fused with his Essence Soul Star completely.
Separate, commanded Meng Chuan with another thought.
The rotating Essence Soul Star split into two; the binary Essence Soul Stars slowly revolved around the barycenter.
Swoosh.
One of the Essence Soul Stars flew out of his body and transformed into a slightly darker Meng Chuan. It was his Essence Soul avatar.
I can form an Essence Soul avatar? The two Meng Chuans exchanged looks. He found Essence Soul avatars rather intriguing.
Ultimately, an Essence Soul avatar only had a part of his Essence Soul. It wasn’t a complete lifeform. Although it could act independently, it still relied on his true body. Once it was destroyed, the dissipated Essence Soul would quickly return to his true body. Once his true body died, his Essence Soul avatar would die as well. The Essence Soul avatar could only stay in the same world as the true body. It couldn’t go to other worlds if Meng Chuan’s true body wasn’t there.
A Corporeal Avatar was the only exception to this rule. An Imperial Lord could create a Corporeal Avatar. Once an Essence Soul avatar merged with the Corporeal Avatar, it would become a complete lifeform.
When that happened, the avatar was no different from the true body.
If the true body died, the avatar could still live on. Furthermore, the avatar could reform the true body through cultivation. When the avatar died, the original body would remain unaffected. The Corporeal Avatar could also be re-cultivated. Due to this strange relationship, the two were as important as each other.
Although Emperor Roc, Lady Blackmoon, and Imperial Lord Starquix appeared to be in the Demon Realm, they actually had avatars roaming the outer realm.
Unfortunately, this body cultivation system is limited to the Blood Droplet realm in the human world. I can’t reach the Sage Becoming realm here. According to the legacy’s description, as long as I reach the Sage Becoming Realm, I can form a Corporeal Avatar. This physical body cultivation system granted one a physical body that was extremely powerful. A Sage Becoming realm expert’s body was in no way inferior to an Imperial Lord’s.
With a thought, the Essence Soul avatar swiftly returned to his sea of consciousness.
Meng Chuan continued painting. He hadn’t finished painting.
Liu Qiyue came into the study at noon and realized that her husband was still seriously painting. She stood by his side and watched.
In the painting, Liu Qiyue sat cross-legged as a flaming phoenix circled her, melting the surrounding snow.
How beautiful. When Liu Qiyue saw the painting, her consciousness was drawn into the illusory grotto-heaven.
The illusory grotto-heaven was blurry and inchoate.
Within the illusory grotto-heaven, she could see a woman sitting cross-legged as a phoenix flew around her. The melted snow dripped onto the ground.
With just a thought, Liu Qiyue’s consciousness left the illusion. After all, Liu Qiyue was a Regis Godfiend. Such a thing couldn’t trap her unless she wanted it to.
There’s a world inside the painting? Liu Qiyue was astonished. This is still an incomplete painting. If it’s completed, this painting will have a strong influence on one’s consciousness. Ah Chuan’s previous paintings never had such strong effects on one’s consciousness. Have his painting skills improved?
She didn’t dare disturb him and allowed him to paint carefully.
This painting took him from morning to night to complete.
At night, Meng Chuan finally stopped painting after the candle had melted halfway.
A courtyard was depicted in the painting. In the courtyard, a woman sat cross-legged. She was surrounded by a flying phoenix, thick snow, and a part of a building. The colors were vivid, and everything seemed real.
“Ah Chuan.” Liu Qiyue stared at the painting in amazement. “Why is your painting like a Black Metal Sutra? It can draw one’s consciousness into it!”
“Each brushstroke contains the Grotto-Heaven realm’s profundities. Due to this, this painting has naturally formed an illusory grotto-heaven,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “I didn’t expect such a thing to occur before painting. From the looks of it, if my brushstrokes contain the Heaven Earth realm’s profundities, my paintings will become even more magical.” If he reached the Heaven Earth realm in the future, Meng Chuan’s paintings would reach a whole new level! When his brushstrokes contained the Heaven Earth realm’s profundities, just how magical would his paintings become? “Qiyue, keep it well,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“This is mine.” Liu Qiyue stared at the painting happily. The paintings that Meng Chuan painted for her every year were treasures to her.
“I’m going into seclusion tonight. You should rest early,” said Meng Chuan.
“Seclusion?” Liu Qiyue was puzzled. “Ah Chuan, you are only back for three days, yet you are still going into seclusion? Is your cultivation time so precious?” Meng Chuan smiled. “My Essence Soul became a sixth-level Essence Soul today. Therefore, I need to enter seclusion to cultivate my Essence Soul mystic techniques.”
“Became a sixth-level Essence Soul?” Liu Qiyue was shocked. She knew that only a handful in the human world’s Godfiends could attain a sixth-level Essence Soul. Although she knew that her husband was already an artistic sage when he was young, she was still rather shocked that he had attained a sixth-level Essence Soul so quickly. “I didn’t expect it either,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “It’s a joyous occasion for my Essence Soul to break through before the final battle in the World Gap. When the time comes, I can give the demons a surprise.”
“Ah Chuan, quickly go into seclusion. Your cultivation is more important,” said Liu Qiyue immediately.
Meng Chuan nodded and left the study. He walked to a chamber beside him and pondered his next moves as he walked. How much of my Essence Soul Origins should I use to cultivate my Magic Awl this time? The final battle in the World Gap has far-reaching implications on the war. Humanity has to win the battle.
Therefore, I’ll use 30% of my Essence Soul Origins.
He didn’t dare to use more. If he used more than 30% of his Essence Soul Origins, he would begin losing memories. His perceptivity would also decrease. He might even go crazy.

chapters.title: Chapter 458 - Preparation Before the Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 458 Preparation Before the Battle
Inside the chamber
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged and began cultivating the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell.
Whoosh.
Billions of Essence Soul thoughts gathered in his heart. Although separating an Essence Soul avatar was a trivial matter to him, he was refining an Essence Soul weapon-Magic Awl
—with 30% of his Essence Soul Origins, which had a long-term impact on his Essence Soul. Under normal circumstances, people only used 30% of their Essence Soul Origins to cultivate a Magic Awl if they didn’t see any hope for future breakthroughs. People who were as talented as Meng Chuan wouldn’t do such a thing.
When my mission in the World Gap ends, I’ll destroy my Magic Awl and fuse it with my Essence Soul.
Although it would delay his cultivation for a period of time, there were pros and cons. After all, it would be too late for him to cultivate the Magic Awl when the demons actually took action.
Boom!
The slowly-rotating Essence Soul Star sent out a large number of Essence Soul thoughts. They gathered into the shape of a black Magic Awl. Runic patterns were engraved on the Magic Awl, causing it to take shape gradually. When refining a Magic Awl, one had to refine the runes on it layer by layer. These runes mainly contained the void lineage’s profundities. As Meng Chuan refined more runes, the dark Magic Awl’s aura became more terrifying
With my technique realm improving, I can refine a total of 12 runic layers for the Magic Awl. It will probably take me half a month to finish refining it. I hope that no battles in the World Gap happen during that half-month. With his improved Essence Soul, his strength had already surpassed what he had before. Meng Chuan’s Astral Waves could now pose a great threat to those with fifth-level Essence Souls. Meng Chuan’s Magic Awl—which only had a few layers of runes currently-could unleash a portion of its full strength.
Three days passed in the blink of an eye. Meng Chuan bade his wife farewell and arrived at Archean Mountain. “What? You have attained a sixth-level Essence Soul?” Li Guan, the illusory Qin Wu, and the illusory Luo Tang stared at Meng Chuan in shock.
What a monster.
The Supremacy trio were the strongest Archean Mountain experts in this era. However, after seeing a monster rise up, they felt mixed emotions.
But when they thought about it carefully, Meng Chuan’s achievements made sense. Meng Chuan was ranked number one in terms of Essence Soul talent in the Heart Sea Palace! He had the greatest Essence Soul talent in humanity’s history. No matter how monstrous and outrageous his achievements were, it was normal and expected for Meng Chuan.
“Luo Tang and I have cultivated for many years, but we are still stuck with fifth-level Essence Souls.” Qin Wu shook his head and smiled. “Punk, you already have a sixth-level Essence Soul.”
“Ranked first amongst humans in the Heart Sea Palace. Heart Sea Palace’s evaluation of Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul cultivation talent is really accurate,” exclaimed Luo Tang.
Li Guan shot a gratified smile at Meng Chuan and said, “I am increasingly convinced that we will win this war. As long as we stall for timea century or two-Meng Chuan will definitely become an invincible Creation realm expert.”
“Supremacy, I’m not confident about my chances of becoming an invincible Creation realm expert at all,” said Meng Chuan immediately.
If he couldn’t create a Grotto-Heaven realm paramount technique, he could only travel his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique’s path.
This path wouldn’t grant Meng Chuan insane combat strength. Due to this, it was impossible for him to become an invincible Creation Supremacy with just the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique. It was more pragmatic to become an Imperial Lord.
Qin Wu smiled at his disciple. “Don’t underestimate yourself.”
“Your Essence Soul talent is very high. It’s even higher than your talent for cultivating saber techniques,” said Li Guan. “As long as you attain a seventh-level Essence Soul, your Magic Awl will become a trump card. As long as you are within 50 kilometers of anybody, your Magic Awl can attack them. How many demon sages will be able to withstand your Magic Awl? If you attain an eighth-level Essence Soul, you will be an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence! You will be able to suppress the three demon Imperial Lords. I believe that I will see us winning this war before I close my eyes for eternity.”
The three Archean Mountain Supremacies were excited that Meng Chuan had attained a sixth-level Essence Soul.
Considering Meng Chuan’s breakthrough speed, he would be able to reach the seventh-level Essence Soul in about 50 years. It wouldn’t take him longer than 50 years because it wouldn’t match Meng Chuan’s improvement speed!
Attaining an eighth-level Essence Soul depended on luck.
In human history, calligraphy and painting sages-who could seek answers from their inner self-typically attained seventh-level Essence Souls realm with relative ease.
As for attaining an eighth-level Essence Soul? It was just too difficult. One required talent and opportunities, neither could be missing. In human history, only three people had attained eighth-level Essence Souls. Thus, nobody dared to make claims on how long it would take Meng Chuan to obtain an eighth-level Essence Soul.
“I will definitely do my best. However, it’s extremely difficult to become an Imperial Lord. Same as attaining an eighth-level Essence Soul. I’m not confident of my chances at all,” said Meng Chuan immediately.
“Hahaha.” Qin Wu laughed. “By the way, you have to keep the matter of your sixth-level Essence Soul a secret. Tell only King True Martial when you enter the World Gap.”
Meng Chuan was slightly taken aback as he nodded. “I understand.”
“It’s not because we don’t trust them,” said Qin Wu. “Instead, it’s because I can’t let the other Godfiends place all their hopes on you, causing the demons to be alarmed. Your Magic Awl is a killer move. King Thousand Wood will be in the open while you lurk in the shadows. One is in the open while the other is in the dark. This will catch them by surprise.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Understood.” “King Northcleanse is here,” said Li Guan. “I’ll send the two of you off.”
Moments later
On the nameless mountain.
Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang blasted open a rift in the world membranes. Meng Chuan and King Northcleanse flew into the opening and entered the World Gap.
“It’s been more than ten years since Meng Chuan killed the million demon monarchs in the human world,” said Luo Tang. “After such a long time, the demons’ all-out attack is definitely getting closer and closer.”
“You’re right. The demons used the array formation and those 18 demon monarchs to probe our strength. Once they launch an all-out attack, it will definitely be much more intense,” said Qin Wu. “After all, this is very likely the three Imperial Lords’ final chance.”
“It will definitely be more intense,” said Li Guan indifferently. “However, we have also prepared.”
“It depends on whose means are stronger,” said Qin Wu softly.
On one side was the Demon Realm that had prospered for many years. They had Imperial Lords every generation. A Tribulation Eminence would occasionally appear in the Demon Realm.
On the other side was Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s homeworld.
Who would win and who would lose?
The outcome would soon be known.
In the blink of an eye, nearly a year had passed since Meng Chuan and King Northcleanse returned to the World Gap.
The Demon Realm.
A mighty lineup of fifth Firmament demon monarchs gathered in the square outside Ice Palace and looked at the three Imperial Lords respectfully.
“This will be a decisive battle.” Emperor Roc’s
—the leader of the Imperial Lord Trio-voice echoed in every demon monarch’s ears. “The only outcome permitted for this battle is victory.”
“Out of the Demon Realm’s numerous fifth Firmament demon monarchs, the 192 of you were selected. Do not disappoint us.”
“Yes,” replied the 192 gathered demon monarchs respectfully, their voices echoing. “If we win, all of you will be handsomely rewarded. If anyone shows any form of negligence during the battle, they will be sent to the Demon Ancestral Cave as sacrifices. They will feed the flames until their deaths,” said Emperor Roc coldly.
The demon monarchs below trembled. Going to the Demon Ancestral Cave as a sacrifice was the worst punishment. One would be constantly tortured by the fire, unable to seek death. Only by reaching the end of their lifespan would they die completely.
Even the proud Monarch Peacock didn’t dare make a sound when facing the cold Emperor Roc. The three Imperial Lords spent more than ten years nurturing them. Who would dare to hold back during such a critical battle? Nobody here could withstand the three Imperial Lords’ wrath.
“Set off,” instructed Emperor Roc. Boom!
The demon army moved at the same time and flew out of the square.
Emperor Roc, Imperial Lord Starquix, and Lady Blackmoon watched from afar.
“We’ve waited for so many years. Everything will be decided in this battle,” said Lady Blackmoon.
“We have to win.” Imperial Lord Starquix’s eyes were filled with madness.
The famous Emperor Roc had a little hope of independently breaking through to the Tribulation realm. However, Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon had no hope of reaching the Tribulation realm unless they had special opportunities.
“We will win.” Emperor Roc was equally eager.
Not only did he want to become a Tribulation Eminence, but he also wanted to go far down the Tribulation realm path. He could not afford to miss such a great opportunity.
...
Boom!
King True Martial, King Molten, King Thousand Wood, Meng Chuan, and the other Regis Godfiends—who were cultivating in the World Gap-were suddenly alarmed.
One by one, they could sense the distant world membrane shattering.
“The demon monarchs have entered.” “They are finally here.” King True Martial waved his hand, and an image appeared in the void. It was the scene of the distant world membrane being blasted open. A large number of fifth Firmament demon monarchs flew out of the opening and entered the World Gap. Monarch Peacock, Holy Lady Strings, and others were leading the group.
Meng Chuan and company’s expressions turned solemn.
“They are here. The demon sages that are hiding in the human world after entering through possession are probably about to take action,” said King Calm Sea coldly. “It’s been more than 17 years since Demon Sage Nine Abyss’s attempted assassination on King Eastcalm. It’s not strange that the demons are prepared for this battle,” said King Northcleanse.
“I’ve been waiting for so long. If they didn’t come now, I would have needed to enter a slumber first,” said King Molten coldly, his fighting spirit soaring.
Meng Chuan looked at the scene in the void.
Holy Lady Strings sensed something and raised her head to take a look. She then sneered. Instantly, the demon monarchs disappeared from King True Martial’s prying means. They could no longer spy on them.
