chapters.title: Chapter 459 - Boom! Boom!
chapters.content:
Chapter 459 Boom! Boom!
“The demon teams have hidden their auras and are secretly on the move,” said King True Martial. “It’s very difficult for us to find them if they are bent on hiding.”
“Nearly 200 demon monarchs have entered the World Gap,” said King Calm Sea coldly. “There are so many demon monarchs. Just their collective might is terrifying enough when they attack together. Furthermore, they are definitely complemented by an array formation. If we fight them head-on, they will likely be able to suppress us. However, they are hiding... They are clearly trying to find the demon sage possessors that are in the human world.”
Meng Chuan and company nodded. Yes. Most of the 192 demon monarchs were peak fifth Firmament demon monarchs. Some had even undergone a life modification process so that they could attain Creation realm strength. Monarch Peacock and Holy Lady Strings had the strength of a peak Creation realm expert. With so many demon monarchs working together with array formation, their strength was unimaginable.
“Our only goal is to kill the demon sage possessors,” said King True Martial. “It also won’t be easy for the demon monarchs to find the demon sages that can destroy two world membranes in a short time.”
“We’ve been waiting for this battle for so many years.” King Molten’s eyes were burning with passion. “Even if we sacrifice our lives, we have to stop the demons,” said King Thousand Wood.
Many of them had been in deep slumbers for many years. They weren’t far from the end of their lifespans. To them, as long as they successfully stopped the demons, they could die in peace.
“Junior Brother Meng is the fastest in the world,” said King True Martial. “Act according to plan. We will hide in a grotto-heaven treasure and be carried around by him. Once we discover a demon sage attacking the world membrane... Junior Brother Meng will rush there at full speed.”
“It’s best if we can stop the demons as soon as possible. We can only guarantee our timelines by having King Eastcalm travel alone.”
“King Eastcalm, we’re counting on you.”
Everyone smiled at Meng Chuan. Even King Calm Sea looked at Meng Chuan trustingly.
“I, Meng Chuan, will definitely not disappoint any of you,” said Meng Chuan solemnly. The other Regis Godfiends hid in his Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead and had Meng Chuan carry it. This showed just how much they trusted Meng Chuan! If Meng Chuan were a traitor and handed the Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead to the demons, the Regis Godfiends hiding inside would be wiped out all at once.
By voluntarily entering the small grotto-heaven, it showed that they believed in Meng Chuan!
If Meng Chuan were a traitor, one million demon monarchs would have long wreaked havoc in the human world. The human world would have been in a thousand-fold more tragic situation.
Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!
The Regis Godfiends were teleported into the Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead.
King True Martial looked at Meng Chuan. “Junior Brother Meng, act according to plan.”
“Don’t worry.” Meng Chuan nodded before putting King True Martial into his Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead.
As Archean Mountain’s Sect Proprietor, Meng Chuan naturally knew about humanity’s final plan. After all, Meng Chuan had to agree to the usage of Archean Mountain treasures.
I’ll head to the region where the most connection points between the human world and the World Gap are located and wait there. Meng Chuan stepped on the Bloodblade Disc and entered the deep void in a split second. He quickly rushed to his destination and waited there.
The demon army had arrived. The demon sages in the human world could take action at any moment. He had to be prepared.
Two days later.
The human world, inside a small grotto-heaven.
“Let’s drink.” Demon Sage Fire Dragon and Demon Sage Deep Profundity drank large mouthfuls of alcohol.
“We will take action after finishing this last jar of wine.” Demon Sage Fire Dragon put down his cup and looked at his good friend, Demon Sage Deep Profundity. “It’s time to take action. We’ve been stalling for so many years. We’ve cultivated to the limits of the fifth Firmament,” said Demon Sage Deep Profundity. “We’ve even obtained a Tribulation treasure. If we don’t take action soon, the Imperial Lords will be furious.”
Demon Sage Fire Dragon nodded slightly. He looked at his good friend and said solemnly, “It’s hard to tell whether we will live or die in this operation. Deep Profundity, I hope that both of us will survive.”
“I wonder if it’s a blessing or a disaster. Either way, there’s no room for retreat,” said Demon Sage Deep Profundity.
“Just fight it out.” Fire Dragon’s eyes burned with flames.
Demon Sage Deep Profundity grinned as well. “Let’s fight it out.”
As demons, they were used to the law of the jungle-survival of the fittest. Ever since they were born, they had been risking their lives.
“Ten hours later, let’s contact each other via the transmission token,” said Demon Sage Fire Dragon. Demon Sage Deep Profundity nodded slightly before silently leaving for their respective destinations.
Ten hours later.
Demon Sage Fire Dragon and Demon Sage Deep Profundity were already tens of thousands of kilometers apart. One was in the East Sea, while the other was in the North Sea. They were more than 10,000 kilometers away from land.
“Whether we live or die depends on this moment.” Demon Sage Fire Dragon stood above the sea as he sent a transmission with his token.
“It’s about to begin.” Demon Sage Deep Profundity stood on a reef in the sea and held a token.
They were in contact with each other. Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!
After three signals, Demon Sages Deep Profundity and Fire Dragon attacked simultaneously, their eyes filled with madness.
“Break!” Demon Sage Fire Dragon punched out. His fist was extremely heavy, like a meteor. With a single punch, the world membrane distorted.
“Open!” Demon Sage Deep Profundity wielded his black saber and cleaved down with all his might. The world seemed to split into two.
Rip!
The world membrane distorted and trembled.
Boom! Boom!
The simultaneous attacks on the East Sea and North Sea’s world membranes instantly alarmed all the Creation Supremacies in the world.
“There is a demon sage possessor in the East Sea and one in the North Sea!”
Bai Yaoyue, an illusory Meng Tiange, and an illusory Mi Yu stared at the Imperial Lord-level treasure—Heaven-Peeking Mirror. Two scenes appeared at the same time. The first scene showed Demon Sage Fire Dragon-who was covered in flames-attacking the world membrane. The second scene showed Demon Sage Deep Profundity—who was wielding a saber-cleaving the world membrane with all his might.
Xu Yingwu and an illusory Zhang Chun-Two World Island’s Creation Supremacies-looked at their spying treasure with drastically changing expressions. “From the looks of it, they can break through the two world membranes in just a few strikes. It won’t take them more than four seconds. However, they are tens of thousands of kilometers away from us. We won’t be able to arrive in time.”
In the North Sea, on an island with tens of thousands of residents, the Demon Annihilation Guild Master— Jing Fei—was sitting cross-legged on the beach. He sensed the locations of the demon sage possessors from afar, and his expression changed drastically. Although I’m in the North Sea, I’m 4,000 kilometers away from this demon sage possessor. I won’t be able to arrive in time.
The nine Creation Supremacies in the world were unable to stop the two demon sage possessors in time.
Archean Mountain.
Li Guan, an illusory Qin Wu, and an illusory Luo Tang looked up at the sky. The void reflected the scenes happening in the North Sea and the East Sea. They could clearly see Demon Sage Deep Profundity and Demon Sage Fire Dragon attacking the world membranes simultaneously.
“There are two demon sages-Demon Sage Deep Profundity and Demon Sage Fire Dragon.” Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang’s expressions changed.“We can only intercept one of them.”
“Time to go.” Li Guan held a dark stone talisman in his hand and instantly activated it. A large number of runes contained within the stone talisman lit up as void fluctuations enveloped him.
This dark stone talisman was the Void Transference Talisman. Archean Mountain only had one left. It could only be used if all the Sect Proprietors agreed to its usage. Meng Chuan, Qin Wu, Luo Tang, and Li Guan didn’t hesitate to use Archean Mountain’s treasures to stop the demons.
During Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s era, humanity had accumulated many treasures. However, over the course of time, the successive generations had used too many treasures.
Although later generations put stricter requirements on the treasures, many treasures were still used. For some treasures, they only had one of them left! Take Meng Chuan’s protective stone talisman for example. There was only one protective stone talisman left! The same could be said for the Void Transference Talisman that Li Guan had just used. Of course, in terms of importance, the Void Transference Talisman was above that of the protective stone talisman.
Swoosh.
After activating the Void Transference Talisman, the void fluctuations enveloped Li Guan before he disappeared with a whoosh.
Following that, not far from Demon Sage Fire Dragon in the East-Li Guan had been more than 15,000 kilometers away from him originally-Li Guan appeared out of thin air.

chapters.title: Chapter 460 - Inside the World Gap
chapters.content:
Chapter 460 Inside the World Gap
Demon Sage Fire Dragon punched out a second time. The world membrane distorted as large cracks appeared. It’s about the same as I expected. Three punches are enough to break through the first world membrane. Demon Sage Fire Dragon hovered above the sea. Flames filled his body as he attempted to deliver a third punch. At that moment, he saw a middle-aged man appear out of thin air.
“Li Guan?” Demon Sage Fire Dragon’s heart instantly turned cold.
Li Guan—who had cultivated for a long timewas the unspoken strongest human expert in the world.
At that moment, Fire Dragon was somewhat dazed by Li Guan’s sudden arrival.
Boom!
After Li Guan appeared, he reached out and grabbed at Demon Sage Fire Dragon.
Demon Sage Fire Dragon sensed a gigantic palm grabbing the surrounding world. He
the fingers.
Heaven and Earth-in an area of dozens of kilometers—had completely transformed into the gigantic palm’s toy. The gigantic palm clenched, causing the tiny world in the hand to collapse rapidly.
Demon Sage Fire Dragon punched out in despair, hoping to shatter the tiny sealed world.
Boom!
Demon Sage Fire Dragon struck out with his strongest punch madly, but it failed to affect the gigantic palm at all. The gigantic palm clenched fully.
“No!!!” Demon Sage Fire Dragon’s eyes were filled with despair and indignation. He looked up at the gigantic palm as it closed tightly. Under the terrifying void force, his body, along with his Essence Soul, was pulverized.
Pfft!
The small world was completely crushed.
As for Demon Sage Fire Dragon, he was like an insect in a piece of amber. He shattered along with the tiny world.
Before his death, Demon Sage Fire Dragon still couldn’t understand why Li Guan—a human Creation Supremacy-could suddenly appear near him.
Only he had knowledge of this connection point that he had chosen to blast open. He had even scanned the surrounding 150 kilometers in advance. Only after confirming that there were no Godfiends did he attack.
Why did Li Guan suddenly appear?
“Nicely done.” “Beautiful.”
The Creation Supremacies—who were remotely watching from Black Sand Grotto-Heaven and Two World Island’s headquarters—were rather excited. They had killed one demon sage possessor.
“He actually appeared out of thin air. I wonder if he had been waiting or if he had some means to traverse the void,” said Meng Tiange.
“Even if it’s some method to traverse the void, it likely can’t be used a second time. This is because Archean Mountain didn’t intercept the other demon sage.” Bai Yaoyue looked at the Heaven-Peeking Mirror solemnly. “The other demon sage, Demon Sage Deep Profundity, has already blasted open a rift in the human world’s world membrane. It’s about to enter the World Gap.”
Demon Sage Deep Profundity attacked with all his might. He slashed out with his saber frenziedly when he sensed Demon Sage Fire Dragon’s death through the token. Fire Dragon is dead? Quick, break!
He struck the World Gap’s colorful world membrane with all his might. He tore open the World Gap’s world membrane—which was slightly weaker than the human world’s world membrane—with just two strikes. He saw the scenery on the other side of the rift.
Go. The moment Demon Sage Deep Profundity cleaved open a passageway, he immediately entered the World Gap through the rift. He was afraid that he would be killed by the humans if he delayed any further.
Li Guan—who possessed one of the sect’s cornerstone treasures—could easily send a threshold Imperial Lord-level attack casually. He used his full strength at that critical moment to kill Demon Sage Fire Dragon with a single strike. Qin Wu and Luo Tang were not surprised at all. The two of them looked at the other scene in midair-Demon Sage Deep Profundity had struck both world membranes, creating a passageway between the human world and the World Gap. With a whoosh, he flew through the rift, entering the World Gap.
“Demon Sage Deep Profundity has entered the World Gap.” Qin Wu and Luo Tang were somewhat anxious.
“Unfortunately, we only have one Void Transference Talisman,” said Qin Wu. “If we had two, Demon Sage Deep Profundity wouldn’t have been able to escape.” “Everything is up to Meng Chuan and company now,” said Luo Tang solemnly.
They couldn’t afford to lose this battle. Although they could use World Annihilation, doing so meant the deaths of billions of people in the world. This would be a humiliation for every living Godfiend on Archean Mountain! It would be an eternal humiliation!
Meng Chuan, King True Martial, and King Thousand Wood tried their best to intercept the demons, hoping that they never needed to use World Annihilation.
The World Gap.
We can’t lose this battle. Meng Chuan sat cross-legged as he held an ancient black mirror in his hand. Can Master, Supremacies, and the others successfully intercept them? Huh? Meng Chuan’s expression changed slightly.
From afar, he could sense the world membrane fluctuating due to being struck.
Through the mirror in his hand, he immediately sensed the area that the fluctuations originated from.
Boom!
He saw the void distort. The world membrane had clearly been struck from the other side.
That’s it. Meng Chuan didn’t hesitate to move towards the area.
Swoosh.
He instantly stepped on the Bloodblade Disc. Silver runes appeared on both sides of his forehead. Wisps of silver lightning flashed around his head as silver lightning filled his eyes.
Meng Chuan’s divine power-Flowing Sandinstantly erupted, and his speed soared to the limit.
He went all out!
After the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique reached the Grotto-Heaven realm, Meng Chuan could normally travel 140 kilometers per second due to the technique being a lightning lineage ultimate technique. However, the worldly law’s had greatly suppressed his speed. Only with Grotto-Heaven laws could he resist the worldly laws to a certain extent. If he reached the Heaven Earth realm, his Heaven Earth laws would be able to block the worldly law’s suppression completely. Without the worldly law’s suppression, Meng Chuan’s speed would reach an unimaginable level.
As for now? He would normally only be able to travel 140 kilometers in a second. After stepping on the Bloodblade Disc, his speed increased slightly. He could travel 160 kilometers a second when using the Bloodblade Disc. The higher his speed, the stronger the worldly law’s suppression became.
Boom!
Under the effects of Flowing Sand, Meng Chuan moved 1,600 kilometers per second. He streaked across the sky terrifyingly, heading straight toward the area where the world membrane had been attacked.
While flying at high speeds, Meng Chuan diverted some of his attention to stare at the scene projecting from the black mirror in his hand.
In the mirror, he could see a black saber tearing through the distorted world membrane, producing a huge rift. Following that, a figure entered the World gap.
Meng Chuan instantly recognized the figure.
It’s Demon Sage Deep Profundity. I still need three seconds before I can arrive there. Meng Chuan rushed towards Demon Sage Deep Profundity at full speed. It won’t be able to go far in three seconds.
For this battle, Archean Mountain prepared several treasures. Meng Chuan and King True Martial carried most of them because Archean Mountain trusted their strength the most.
Demon Sage Deep Profundity tore through the world membrane rift and arrived in the World Gap.
I succeeded. When Demon Sage Deep Profundity arrived in the World Gap, he couldn’t help but reveal a look of delight.
It was too dangerous in the human world.
Upon reaching the World Gap, the danger level immediately decreased.
Hum.
Just as Demon Sage Deep Profundity landed on the ground, the surrounding void distorted. A black-robed, dragon-headed elder appeared out of thin air. It was Patriarch Poison Dragon.
“Demon Sage Deep Profundity.” Patriarch Poison Dragon grinned and waved his hand.
Whoosh
Nearly 200 fifth Firmament demon monarchs —including Monarch Peacock and Holy Lady Strings-instantly appeared around them.
Rumble!These 192 fifth Firmament demon monarchs skillfully followed the plan and set up the array formations. Instantly, three powerful array formations protected Demon Sage Deep Profundity heavily.
“There are only five Void Transference Talismans in the Demon Ancestral Cave. The three of us spent lots of credits before we managed to obtain one Void Transference Talisman,” said Emperor Roc indifferently. “As long as Demon Sage Deep Profundity or Demon Sage Fire Dragon enters the World Gap, the demon monarch team will rendezvous with them immediately by using the Void Transference Talisman. Once they’ve met up, they’ll be able to protect each other.”
“I’ve never used a Void Transference Talisman before,” said Imperial Lord Starquix with a smile. “Now, a fifth Firmament demon monarch gets to use one first.”
“As long as we obtain Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures, it’s worth it,” said Emperor Roc.
A Void Transference Talisman had an extremely wide range. Formation suppression? Void lockdown? The worldly law’s suppression? The Void Transference Talisman could ignore all such suppressions. It also had a very wide range. However, it was a single-use treasure. Its value was equivalent to a Tribulation treasure used refined by a Sixth Tribulation Eminence. It was a very rare treasure. Even with the Demon Realm’s rich heritage, they only had five Void Transference Talismans.
The Demon Ancestral Cave placed restrictions on every generation of demon Imperial Lords. Thus, it was impossible for these Imperial Lords to squander the demon ancestors’ wealth completely. Only by doing so could they pass down their legacy.
“Oh?” Lady Blackmoon sensed something as she smiled excitedly. “Demon Sage Deep Profundity has entered the World Gap. He has already rendezvoused with the demon team.”
“I see it too.” Emperor Roc nodded slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 461 - Fighting Alongside Each Other
chapters.content:
Chapter 461 Fighting Alongside Each Other
Demon Sage Deep Profundity looked at Monarch Peacock, Holy Lady Strings, Patriarch Poison Dragon. He then glanced at the group of more than ten experts and the numerous fifth Firmament demon monarchs—who had set up the array formations. He couldn’t help but feel relieved.
Even Demon Sage Deep Profundity found it challenging to see through the surrounding array formations.
The Imperial Lords have put in a lot of effort. If I were to attempt to charge through the three array formations, even I would definitely die.
The 39 demon monarchs at the periphery of the array formations were all dressed in golden armor. Faint golden light swirled around them. These 39 demon monarchs spread out in a 50-kilometer wide area as they faintly resonated with each other.
At that moment, one of the demon monarchs leading the group cupped his hands and said, “Monarch Peacock, an approaching Godfiend is 250 kilometers from us.”
“A Godfiend?” The demon monarchs’ hearts tightened.
“He’s hiding in the deep void. Although our array formation can sense him, we can’t stop him,” reported the avian demon monarch.
“There’s no need to worry.” Holy Lady Strings smiled.
While Meng Chuan was rushing towards Demon Sage Deep Profundity at full speed, he discovered that the demon team had arrived first. Therefore, Meng Chuan instantly entered the deep void and attempted to approach Demon Sage Deep Profundity stealthily.
As long as I’m within 25 kilometers of it, I can use the Magic Awl to deal with Demon Sage Deep Profundity. If there’s nothing wrong with the intelligence, Demon Sage Deep Profundity should only have a fifth-level Essence Soul. It will definitely die when struck by Magic Awl.
He had a sixth-level Essence Soul, and he had used 30% of his Essence Soul’s Origins to refine the Magic Awl, giving it terrifying power. Demon Sage Deep Profundity hadn’t undergone a life modification process. He was just a normal demon. Even with a Tribulation treasure protecting his Essence Soul, it was impossible for him to withstand Meng Chuan’s Magic Awl.
Swoosh!
Meng Chuan rapidly approached the group as he traveled through the deep void.
Oh? Meng Chuan looked ahead. The deep void in front of him was completely frozen. With Demon Sage Deep Profundity at the center, the void within 100 kilometers of him was frozen. In this area, the entire void had been frozen. As long as he entered the area, he would be forced to appear.
I can’t even get within 100 kilometers of him? Meng Chuan was secretly alarmed. He could only retreat temporarily. After retreating nearly 150 kilometers, Meng Chuan waved his hand and released the Godfiends in his small grotto-heaven.
“How’s the situation?” The Regis Godfiends weren’t sure about the situation. Meng Chuan had immediately rushed over when he discovered the world membrane being attacked. He didn’t even have time to brief them about what was happening.
“Look ahead.” Meng Chuan pointed ahead and said. “Demon Sage Deep Profundity has successfully arrived in the World Gap. Furthermore, the demon team instantly rendezvoused with him and set up large array formations. I can barely determine that they have set up three array formations together. The array formations cover an area about 100 kilometers around Demon Sage Deep Profundity. The array formations are very powerful, so I didn’t dare to barge in.”
“The demons don’t know the corresponding connection points between the human world and the World Gap,” said King Thousand Wood in puzzlement. “Even it shouldn’t know where it would appear in the World Gap upon entry. How did the demons rendezvous with it instantly?”
“They rendezvoused with it instantly,” said Meng Chuan. “The moment Demon Sage Deep Profundity passed through the rift in the world membrane and landed, the demon team arrived.”
“Strange.”
“How did they rendezvous so quickly?” “This is troublesome.”
The situation vexed all the Regis Godfiends present.
In their previous fights with the demons, they knew very well that it would be very difficult to breach the demons’ defenses if they only focused on defense, acting like turtles.
“The demons are willing to pay any price for this battle.” King True Martial was very calm as he looked into the distance. “Even if the demons have some special means, there’s nothing strange about it.” “How can we kill a Demon Sage Deep Profundity then?” asked King Northcleanse.
“We have to get close,” said King Thousand Wood.
“We’ll have to resist the array formation if we are to approach,” said King True Martial after some thought. “I have a plan.”
Everyone looked at him.
“The demons have set up three major array formations. Every array formation is extremely powerful,” said King True Martial. “It’ll definitely be impossible for us to charge through the array formations head-on. The most suitable method... I’ll first execute Ten Absolutes of World Annihilation, blasting open a passageway through the demons’ array formations. We can then head strength into the depths of the array formations. Afterward...”
Everyone present listened carefully.
After hearing the entire plan, King Molten couldn’t help but say, “King True Martial, I’m naturally willing to follow your plan and risk it with King Thousand Wood. However, are you confident in Archean Mountain’s killer move?”
“Our Archean Mountain has a rich heritage. We naturally have powerful treasures,” said King True Martial. “Don’t worry. I’ll definitely do what I say.”
“King Molten, I’ll accompany you. Don’t worry,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
King Thousand Wood nodded. “Since King Eastcalm and King True Martial have decided to do so, we naturally agree.” King True Martial nodded slightly. At the same time, he sent a voice transmission to Meng Chuan. “Junior Brother Meng, your Essence Soul avatar will be going all out later.”
In the World Gap, only King True Martial knew about Meng Chuan’s sixth-level Essence Soul.
“Don’t worry. Even if my Essence Soul avatar and the Magic Awl are destroyed, I can still withstand the damage,” said Meng Chuan via voice transmission. The destruction of his Essence Soul avatar wouldn’t have much of an impact on his strength. On the other hand, losing 30% of his Essence Soul’s Origins would be huge. If his Magic Awl was destroyed would require time to recover slowly.
King True Martial looked into the distance. “If we attack, we must go all out. I hope we can settle everything in one fell swoop. Everyone, what questions do you have regarding the plan?” King True Martial turned to look at the other Regis Godfiends.
On the demons’ side.
Monarch Peacock sneered. “The human Godfiends are far away. They don’t dare to move.”
“Demon Sage Deep Profundity,” said Holy Lady Strings. “The Imperial Lords didn’t give us the important mission of killing the Godfiends. Instead, they asked us to protect you well. We will protect you along the way so that you can draw a complete map of the World Gap’s connection points. Once the map is finished, the human will be defeated.”
“Yes.” Demon Sage Deep Profundity nodded with a smile. “As long as we have a map of the connection points, victory will be ours. Please wait a while. I’ll map the surrounding areas’ connection points first.”
Demon Sage Deep Profundity looked around. He could sense spacetime fluctuations, helping him locate the connection points between the World Gap and the Human World.
The map of the human world’s connection points had already been drawn. The corresponding locations of the world membrane had been confirmed. The world membrane was mysterious; it couldn’t be recorded as an image. Only when one’s cultivation realm was high enough could they sense the spacetime fluctuations. Once they could sense the spacetime fluctuations, they remember the world membrane’s locations.
“All I need to do now is draw a map of the World Gap’s connection points. From there, I’ll match the locations of the world membrane in the World Gap with those in the human world. This way, I will be able to draw a complete map of the connection points between the human world and the World Gap.”
Once he succeeded, it would be clear where the World Gap and the human world connected with each other. With this, they could determine where they ended up after passing through the world membranes.
Drawing a map of the connection points was very troublesome. Demon Sage Deep Profundity only had the ability to draw the map when he was at the Grotto-Heaven realm’s late stage.
Meng Chuan was only at the Grotto-Heaven realm’s early stage. When standing in the World Gap, he could clearly sense the World Gap’s world membrane. As for the human world’s world membrane, it was very blurry to him. He was unable to draw it.
“This place is confirmed.” He recorded the surrounding scenery and confirmed the location in the void. “Let’s set off. Next spot,” said Demon Sage Deep Profundity with a smile.
“Let’s go,” said Holy Lady Strings.
The entire demon army began to move; they maintained the array formations as they flew.
“The demons are moving.” King True Martial’s gaze swept across the Regis Godfiends. “If you don’t have any questions, we’ll take action.”
Meng Chuan, King Calm Sea, King Thousand Wood, and King Molten all nodded.They had no way out.
Since the human world couldn’t stop Demon Sage Deep Profundity from entering the World Gap, they were the final interceptors! They had to succeed! Otherwise, the human world might be lost completely. It would spell endless darkness.
“It’s my honor to fight with all of you,” said King True Martial with a smile.
“Among us are Regis Godfiends from the past 1,000 years and peerless geniuses of the present generation. It’s truly wonderful to live and die alongside all of you.” King Molten laughed loudly.
Meng Chuan and company smiled as well. King Calm Sea’s icy eyes burned.
“GO,” said King True Martial.
King True Martial’s Yin-Yang Disc enveloped the Regis Godfiends within a five-kilometer radius as they charged towards the demon monarchs.
“The human Godfiends are coming!” The demon monarchs—who were preparing to move to the next location-were immediately alarmed.

chapters.title: Chapter 462 - Human Attack
chapters.content:
Chapter 462 Human Attack
Monarch Peacock sneered. “These human Godfiends actually dared to charge over.”
“With nearly 200 fifth Firmament demon monarchs joining forces, we can crush them easily.” Patriarch Poison Dragon was filled with confidence.
Holy Lady Strings was in charge of coordinating the demon monarchs in the array formations. She immediately sent a voice transmission. “Alert! Since the human Godfiends have taken the initiative to charge into the array formations, we’ll take the opportunity to kill them.”
“Yes.”
The hundred-plus demon monarchs that maintained the array formations stared at the approaching human Godfiends.
Boom!
With the Yin-Yang disc protecting Meng Chuan, he released a total of 24 Bloodblades that circled 1,000 feet around him. The Fire Refinement Star Cauldron also shielded him as King Calm Sea, King Transcendence, Dao Protector Wang Shan, Peng Mu, and King Northcleanse temporarily hid within it.
Only four Godfiends stood outside the Fire Refinement Star Cauldron-Meng Chuan, King True Martial, King Thousand Wood, and King Molten.
“Be careful. We’re about to enter the array formations,” said King True Martial. “Yes.” Meng Chuan, King Thousand Wood, and company stared at the array formations warily.
Bam!
After the Yin-Yang disc flew into the array formations, short golden spears naturally formed and shot towards the Godfiends. These short golden spears streaked across the sky and stabbed into the True Martial domain.
“This array formation is a little powerful,” said King True Martial via voice transmission. The Yin-Yang disc—which originally spanned five kilometers—had shrunk to a radius of 1.5 kilometers, greatly boosting the Yin-Yang disc’s resistance against the attacks. The short golden spears weakened as they passed through each layer of the True Martial domain.
When they finally struck the defensive array formation-formed by Meng Chuan’s 24 Bloodblades—they only had 20 to 30 percent of their initial might left. After striking the defensive array formation, the golden spears dissipated.
Meng Chuan’s Bloodblade Disc was a defensive treasure to begin with. Thus, the runic array formations within the Bloodblade Disc were used for defense and escaping! When the defensive array formation expanded to a radius of 1,000 feet around him, the strength of the array formation would decrease. However, even though it had suffered a decrease in defensive might, it still remained extraordinary.
Although Meng Chuan couldn’t solely rely on his Bloodblade Bisc to block the demons’ array formations, the True Martial domain weakened the golden spears by 70 to 80 percent. Due to this, the defensive array formation consisting of 24 Bloodblades—was now able to protect the Godfiends with ease.
Boom!
Under the dense bombardment of the golden short spears, the Yin-Yang disc and the 24 Bloodblades protected the Godfiends as they advanced
“They actually managed to withstand the Golden Light Killing Formation.” Patriarch Poison Dragon watched from afar in surprise.
“The outermost array formation takes care of both defense and offense. As for the two inner array formations, they are mainly for defense,” said Holy Lady Strings with a calm smile. “There’s no need to worry about Demon Sage Deep Profundity. These human Godfiends are unable to come within 50 kilometers of him.”
The Yin-Yang disc and 24 Bloodblades protected the Godfiends as they advanced through the array formations. Soon, they were only 75 kilometers away from the demons in the distance.
OT
With a single glance, Meng Chuan and company could see the demon monarchs in the distance. They saw Monarch Peacock, Holy Lady Strings, Patriarch Poison Dragon, and Demon Sage Deep Profundity in the center of the array formations. However, they could do nothing to harm them from this distance.
Boom!
When they were 75 kilometers away from the demons, a dense saber array formation appeared in the void. Countless saber beams circled the demons, forming layer upon layer of defenses, completely protecting the demons.
The Yin-Yang disc had crushed the short golden spears, but they were forced to a halt when they met with the massive saber array formation. The humans were unable to approach the demons any further.
“This saber array formation mainly focuses on defense. Against the many defensive layers, we can’t charge in with just my domain,” said King True Martial.
“There’s no other way. Let’s follow the plan,” said Meng Chuan.
“Yes.” King True Martial and Meng Chuan exchanged looks.
Without any hesitation, they began carrying out the plan. Silver runes appeared on both sides of Meng Chuan’s face. Wisps of silver lightning appeared around his head. Using Flowing Sand, he changed the flow of time around him.
King True Martial cast a forbidden spell. Ignoring the damage to his body, he unleashed his Quintessential Essence as he punched out with both fists.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!
As his cultivation realm slowly increased, King True Martial had executed the Ten Absolutes of World Annihilation several times, causing the move to become more perfect. With the help of his Tribulation treasure, the might of the move became even more terrifying.
The first nine blurry fist shadows gathered and fused with the tenth fist projection the moment it formed. The nine punches’ might merged with the tenth fist projection, condensing into a gray pillar of light.
It’s that move again. Monarch Peacock’s pupils constricted. He had been completely blasted apart by this move once. Thus, he knew just how terrifying it was.
The gray pillar of light tore through the sky at lightning speed. Wherever it passed, everything seemed to vanish.
The gray pillar of light destroyed the dense saber array formation.
The pillar of light crossed 25 kilometers.
Just as it was 50 kilometers away from Demon Sage Deep Profundity, another array formation appeared within the saber beam array formation. It was endless darkness. Dragon shadows swam through the darkness. The world within the darkness seemed to be completely isolated from the outside world.
Boom!
After blasting through the 25-kilometer long saber array formation, the gray pillar of light’s strength had weakened significantly. When it struck the dark array formation, the gray pillar of light completely dissipated. It had only gone 1,000 feet into the dark array formation before dissipating
Swoosh.
After executing the Ten Absolutes of World Annihilation, King True Martial didn’t stop. Instead, he blasted another light beam at the demons. Although this light beam wasn’t as fast as the gray pillar of light, it still moved extremely swiftly. Just as the gray pillar of light’s remnant strength struck the dark array formation and dissipated, the light beam struck the dark array formation.
“Explode.” King True Martial watched from afar and forced the light beam to explode with his will.
With anticipation in his eyes, Meng Chuan looked into the distance. Within the light beam that King True Martial had blasted out was a bottle. Inside the bottle were two Lightning Explosive Beads. The Lightning Explosive Beads were just one of the many treasures that Meng Chuan and company had prepared for this battle.
In terms of strength alone, one Lightning Explosive Bead was comparable to the strike of a threshold Imperial Lord. It was comparable to the Ten Absolutes of World Annihilation, but much easier to trigger. After all, Meng Chuan and company were a group of Regis Godfiends. Any treasures that had sufficient power and were usable by them were extremely rare.
Although a Lightning Explosive Bead was powerful, it had cons as well. Once a Lightning Explosive Bead erupted, its might would surge in all directions.
Boom!
Meng Chuan, King True Martial, King Thousand Wood, King Molten, and the Regis Godfiends inside the Fire Refinement Star Cauldron saw a huge explosion.
The explosion caused by the two Lightning Explosive Beads instantly destroyed the dark array formation.
The Lightning Explosive Beads’ terrifying might spread out in all directions.
The explosion tore into the dark array formation by more than 10 kilometers before it reached its limit. At the same time, the blast surged towards Meng Chuan and company. Although the shockwaves had traveled 25 kilometers, it still inundated them.
After traveling 25 kilometers, the shockwaves had been greatly weakened. Thus, the True Martial domain withstood the attack explosion completely.
When King True Martial saw this scene, he took out a pill and swallowed it.
The pill he just swallowed was an Indestructible Divine Pill. Just a single Indestructible Divine Pill could restore King True Martial to peak condition. For this crucial battle, Archean Mountain gave King True Martial three Indestructible Divine Pills.
At this moment, Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up just as they withstood the impact. He immediately carried King True Martial, King Thousand Wood, and King Molten forward on the Bloodblade Disc.
Meng Chuan’s divine power-Flowing Sandenveloped his companions who were just about ten feet from him.
He charged towards the demons at full speed. Since the array formations in front of him had been temporarily blasted apart by the Lightning Explosive Beads, Meng Chuan faced zero obstruction as he advanced towards the demons.
Even while carrying others, Meng Chuan could traverse more than 1,000 kilometers in a second on the Bloodblade Disc. A distance of about 50 kilometers was traversed almost instantaneously by Meng Chuan. They arrived at the forefront of the Lightning Explosive Beads’ explosion. They were only 35 kilometers away from Demon Sage Deep Profundity.
Boom!
As Meng Chuan carried the rest and arrived 35 kilometers away from Demon Sage Deep Profundity, a stream of light flew out from his body. It was his Essence Soul avatar.
Although his Essence Soul avatar didn’t have any divine powers, it still moved faster than his physical body when he used the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique. It traveled at a speed of 150 kilometers a second and quickly reached the leftmost area of the explosion.
The explosion was fan-shaped.
At this moment...
Meng Chuan’s true body led King True Martial, King Thousand Wood, and company to the front. His Essence Soul avatar approached the demons from their left flank.
“Kill!” “Kill!”
King Thousand Wood didn’t hesitate to use his Magic Awl. Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar contained his Magic Awl.
Two Magic Awls-each refined with 30% of a sixth-level Essence Soul’s Origins-attacked the demon monarchs within 25 kilometers.
Not good. Patriarch Poison Dragon was originally filled with confidence, but when the Lightning Explosive Beads struck the dark array formation and exploded, his expression changed. The explosion had traveled more than 10 kilometers into the dark array formation, so he immediately waved his hand at Demon Sage Deep Profundity.Demon Sage Deep Profundity was already prepared for such a thing to happen. He didn’t resist Patriarch Poison Dragon’s Quintessential Essence at all and was directly stored into a small portable grotto-heaven.
“It’s been stored in a small grotto-heaven?”
Although Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar and King Thousand Wood had used their Magic Awls to attack simultaneously, their hearts turned cold when they saw Demon Sage Deep Profundity disappear into thin air.
King True Martial, King Molten, and the others felt their hearts turn cold when they saw this scene.
During their planning, they had feared the demons would do such a thing the most!
After Patriarch Poison Dragon-who had an undying body-stored Demon Sage Deep Profundity into a small grotto-heaven, they wouldn’t be able to touch him at all.
“What are we going to do next?” asked King Molten anxiously.
“The plan has changed.” King True Martial’s expression turned ugly.

chapters.title: Chapter 463 - The Final Attack (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 463 The Final Attack (1)
It hid in a small grotto-heaven. Meng Chuan was somewhat anxious.
They had long guessed the possibility of this happening. However, they still didn’t want to see this scene.
Meng Chuan and company had prepared many plans. They mainly focused on two scenarios.
The first scenario: Since Demon Sage Deep Profundity had to draw a map of the connection points, he would stay in the outside world. Following the Regis Godfiends’ plan, they reduced the distance between them and Demon Sage Deep Profundity until they were within 25 kilometers of him. Once they were close enough, they would kill their target with a Magic Awl. The second scenario: The demons were very cautious. Demon Sage Deep Profundity constantly hid in a small grotto-heaven. As they slowly dragged out the battle with the Godfiends, the difficulty of killing him would immediately soar.
Things were now following the scenario that the humans were unwilling to see.
“Kill!” Holding back his rage, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar controlled the Magic Awl as killing intent surged within it.
an
The black Magic Awl instantly streaked across the sky. After the Magic Awl pierced a fifth Firmament demon monarch’s Essence Soul, the demon monarch’s eyes widened as he collapsed silently.
Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft!
The black Magic Awl passed through several demon monarchs’ bodies. Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar was more than 35 kilometers away from Patriarch Poison Dragon. There were eight demon monarchs within 25 kilometers of his Essence Soul avatar. Although these eight demon monarchs panicked and tried to retreat, the Magic Awl caught up to them extremely quickly. In the blink of an eye, the Magic Awl passed through all eight demon monarchs’ bodies.
Among the eight fifth Firmament demon monarchs, three had third-level Essence Souls, four had fourth-level Essence Souls, and one had a fifth-level Essence Soul.
Due to their weak Essence Souls, they couldn’t resist Meng Chuan’s Magic Awl at all. The Magic Awl easily penetrated their Essence Souls and destroyed them, causing them to collapse to the ground in horror and despair.
On the other side, King Thousand Wood-who was accompanied by Meng Chuan’s true body, King True Martial, and King Molten-also released his Magic Awl and attacked the seven fifth Firmament demon monarchs that were within his range.
The seven fifth Firmament demon monarchs also fell silently. None of them had the strength to resist his Magic Awl. In fact, even if a demon monarch had a sixth-level Essence Soul, they wouldn’t be able to withstand Meng Chuan and King Thousand Wood’s Magic Awls unless they had a special treasure that protected their Essence Souls.
Swoosh.
After his Essence Soul avatar controlled the Magic Awl to kill the eight demon monarchs, it immediately retreated. The Magic Awl also rapidly flew back to his true body.
However, as his Essence Soul avatar and Magic Awl flew back to his true body, Meng Chuan felt the surrounding world freeze.
A terrifying force pressed down.
Meng Chuan’s retreating Essence Soul avatar could see black dragon phantoms rushing towards it from all directions. The terrifying strength caused the Essence Soul avatar to collapse instantly.
Swish!
The Magic Awl was extremely fast, instantly flying back into Meng Chuan’s body. Due to being an Essence Soul weapon, the Magic Awl ignored such obstructions.
My Essence Soul avatar was destroyed. Meng Chuan felt his Essence Soul ache. His Essence Soul had suffered some damage.
The destruction of his Essence Soul avatar didn’t affect him much compared to others. Take Li Guan for example. If Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar was destroyed, it would take him several years to recover completely. Meng Chuan, however, had the Essence Soul Star legacy. With the Essence Soul Star, his Essence Soul could recover completely. He could completely recover from the destruction of his Essence Soul avatar within a month.
“Retreat.” Meng Chuan quickly retreated with King True Martial and company.
One black dragon phantom after another lunged over as the dense saber array formation attacked the Godfiends.
Bam! Bam! Bam!
The two sides clashed.
The humans quickly retreated from the dark array formation.
The demons’ array formations were rather powerful. However, apart from the golden spear array formation at the periphery, the other two array formations were mainly for defense.
The True Martial domain’s range shrank to 1,000 feet. The True Martial domain’s interior was protected by a defensive array formation formed by Meng Chuan’s 24 Bloodblades. Although the Godfiends were suppressed by the black dragon phantoms and the dense saber array formation, Meng Chuan and company had an impregnable defense as they retreated from the dark array formation.
“What should we do?” King Molten asked anxiously. “Demon Sage Deep Profundity has already hidden itself. Furthermore, it should be hiding in Patriarch Poison Dragon’s small grotto-heaven. We have no solution.”
“It’s our worst fear.” King Thousand Wood frowned. “Demon Sage Deep Profundity is hiding in a small grotto-heaven. We can’t touch it at all.”
“King True Martial, King Eastcalm, your Archean Mountain is in charge this time. What should we do next?” asked King Molten.
They were unafraid of death.
In the original plan, they were going to rush at the demons until they were 35 kilometers away from the target. King True Martial would have used the Ten Absolutes of World Annihilation to attack the array formations’ core immediately after.
With the Fire Refinement Star Cauldron’s protection, King Molten and King Thousand Wood would then be thrown to the center of the array formations and take the final gamble. If Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar didn’t die, he would’ve followed along.
Who would have thought that the demons would immediately store Demon Sage Deep Profundity into a small grotto-heaven after they saw the Lightning Explosive Beads detonating? Due to this, King Molten and the others naturally had no reason to risk their lives.
“Follow Junior Brother Meng’s instructions,” said King True Martial as he stared at Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan stared at King True Martial.
Their gazes met.
They knew Archean Mountain’s detailed plan and which treasures they were carrying on them.
This was also the core of their execution plan.
King True Martial looked at Meng Chuan. “Junior Brother Meng, we don’t have a choice.”
Meng Chuan’s eyes reddened as he nodded slightly. “Alright.”
Over a hundred fifth Firmament demon monarchs set up three large array formations. The two large defensive array formations worked together to protect Patriarch Poison Dragon, Monarch Peacock, and company.
“The Golden Light Formation at the periphery has been destroyed. We lost 15 of the 36 demon monarchs that maintain the formation,” said Holy Lady Strings calmly. “Thankfully, the two defensive formations inside are fine.”
“What a close shave. When I saw that terrifying explosion, I knew something was amiss,” said Patriarch Poison Dragon. “At critical moments, humans might take out some powerful treasures. I didn’t dare take the risk.”
Monarch Peacock nodded and said, “Protecting Demon Sage Deep Profundity is of utmost importance.”
Huh?
“The humans have retreated?”
The demons discovered that the humans had retreated to a spot 75 kilometers away from them. After retreating beyond the two defensive array formations, they hid their auras and disappeared from the demons’ sight.
Hum.
An invisible fluctuation spread out from the demons’ array formations as it probed the surrounding 250 kilometers.“The humans are roughly 80 kilometers away from us. They are carefully hiding and have been following us,” said a silver-armored demon monarch respectfully. “I can also sense that they’ve been following us through my domain.” Holy Lady Strings smiled coldly. “They already have no way out. They’re risking their lives to stop Demon Sage Deep Profundity from completely the map of connection points. They can’t really leave.”
“Be careful.” Patriarch Poison Dragon said, “They are secretly tailing us. With Demon Sage Deep Profundity hiding in a small grotto-heaven, they aren’t in a hurry to attack. However, once it’s released, they will discover an opportunity and might suddenly attack.”
“Demon Sage Deep Profundity is to stay inside the grotto-heaven?” Monarch Peacock frowned slightly. “If it hides and doesn’t come out, how can it draw the map of connection points?”
“It’s very important to draw the map of connection points, but Demon Sage Deep Profundity’s life is also important. If it comes out and is killed, we might be implicated by the Imperial Lords’ rage,” said Patriarch Poison Dragon. “I think we should report this to the Imperial Lords first and let them decide on what we shall do next.”
Holy Lady Strings and Monarch Peacock nodded.
This battle had too many implications on the war.
Completing the map of connection points would mean a bountiful harvest for the three Imperial Lords—who had put in a lot of effort and paid a huge price to achieve victory in the war.
To the humans, it was a nightmare.

chapters.title: Chapter 464 - The Final Attack (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 464 The Final Attack (2)
Meng Chuan, King Molten, King Thousand Wood, King Calm Sea, Peng Mu, and the other Godfiends silently followed the demon team.
“It’s out?” Meng Chuan held the black mirror, which clearly revealed what was happening at the center of the demons’ array formation. Patriarch Poison Dragon, Demon Sage Peacock, and Holy Lady Strings escorted a figureDemon Sage Deep Profundity. “If Demon Sage Deep Profundity wants to complete the map, it will definitely have to come out. It looks like the demons aren’t willing to drag this out,” said King Molten excitedly. “It has appeared. We can risk it again.” King Thousand Wood stared into the distance.
“It’s fake.” A voice sounded.
Meng Chuan, King Molten, King Calm Sea, King Thousand Wood, Peng Mu, and company all turned to look.
King True Martial sat cross-legged. Black-and-white gas streams spread out in all directions, forming a blob of gas that enveloped King True Martial. Meng Chuan and company couldn’t see him at all.
“There’s no need to doubt it. It’s fake.” King True Martial’s voice continued to ring out from the black-and-white gas. “They’re trying to bait us into attacking and expend our treasures.”
“That’s right. This war has lasted for more than 800 years. Now that it’s the critical moment, how can the demons not have patience?” said Peng Mu.
In the demon team. “Could it be that they have seen through it?” Monarch Peacock asked curiously. “Its demonic aura and Essence Soul aura are perfectly disguised. Furthermore, it’s more than 50 kilometers away from them. How did they see through its disguise?” said Patriarch Poison Dragon via voice transmission.
Holy Lady Strings watched the Godfiends from afar with her domain. “These experts in front of us are the strongest Regis Godfiends in the human world. Many of them are very old. Most of them will be at the end of their lifespans if we waste 20 to 30 years of their time. They will die of old age. In the World Gap, humans are weaker than us. Furthermore, they have been tailing us all this time. They don’t dare to relax at all... King Eastcalm won’t have time to cultivate either. If we drag this battle on for another 20 to 30 years, the situation will be advantageous for us.”
King Molten only had ten years left to live. King Thousand Wood, Peng Mu, and company would all die of old age in 30 years. Many of the ancient Regis Godfiends had survived to this day due to humanity’s slumber mystic technique. However, these ancient Regis Godfiends were too old. They had spent quite some time guarding the cities; they had also spent 16 years in the World Gap. They were nearing the end of their lifespans.
“If they are tricked into taking the initiative to attack, it’ll be good if we can waste a few of their treasures. We might even be able to kill a few Godfiends,” said Patriarch Poison Dragon via voice transmission. “If we are to stall for time, we shall follow the Imperial Lord’s instructions and wait 20 to 30 years. This war has gone on for more than 800 years. Waiting 20 to 30 years is nothing.” “Hahaha, if humans were to risk their lives and discover that this Demon Sage Deep Profundity is just a clone of Patriarch Poison Dragon, that would be wonderful.”
They secretly sent voice transmissions as they discussed the situation.
However, time passed quickly. Although the human Godfiends followed the demons, they didn’t attack.
The demon team flew towards different areas in the World Gap at high speeds.
Everywhere the demons went, the humans followed.
Both sides were very cautious, not daring to relax.
One day, two days, three days passed.
“We have pretended to draw the map of connection points, but the human Godfiends still haven’t taken action,” said Patriarch Poison Dragon via voice transmission. “We can travel across the World Gap and complete the map in ten days. Three days is enough for us to draw a small portion of the map, yet they are just watching us?”
“They definitely won’t allow Demon Sage Deep Profundity to draw the map freely. Since they haven’t taken action in three days, they are certain that this Demon Sage Deep Profundity is fake,” said Monarch Peacock via voice transmission.
“How did they tell that it’s a fake?” Patriarch Poison Dragon was puzzled. “I used a treasure
– bestowed by the Imperial Lords—to disguise my clone. The disguise is pretty good.”
“Don’t underestimate the humans,” said Monarch Peacock via voice transmission.
The human team.
It’s been three days. Meng Chuan glanced at the black-and-white blob. Senior Brother, it should be about time.
The black-and-white fog enveloped King True Martial. It had been like this for the past three days.
Only Meng Chuan and King True Martial knew the detailed battle plan for the World Gap.
Inside the black-and-white blob.
King True Martial sat cross-legged. A strange strawman floated in front of him. Every blade of straw that was weaved into the strawman had many runes carved into it. The strawman emitted a strange aura that made one’s heart palpitate.
Buzz!
King True Martial tapped the strawman with his finger, and a bloody dot immediately appeared at the spot he hit. I’ve been praying for three days. Time is up. Through the strawman, King True Martial could sense a hiding lifeform-Demon Sage Deep Profundity-inside a small grotto-heaven.
Why was he able to identify that the Demon Sage Deep Profundity outside was fake?
It was because the strawman and Demon Sage Deep Profundity’s fates had begun to connect gradually. Through the strawman, he could determine where the real Demon Sage Deep Profundity was.
This is our final gamble, thought King True Martial.
Sixteen years ago.
Before they left for the World Gap
“If you can’t attack the demon sage possessors because they are hiding, you will only have one option left.” Li Guan flipped his hand, and a strawman appeared in his hand. He said, “This is a Fate Strawman. One needs to have insights into the karma lineage before they can use it. With this, one can kill a demon sage possessor from afar.
“I don’t have much knowledge of the karma lineage,” said King True Martial hesitantly.
“In terms of technique realm, you are the best among the Regis Godfiends. You are comparable to Qin Wu and me,” said Li Guan with a smile. “Considering your technique realm, you should be able to sense karma clearly. As long as you study the karma lineage a little, you can use this Fate Strawman.”
King True Martial was indeed able to sense karma. His True Martial lineage had reached the Grotto-Heaven realm’s late stage. It was comparable to an average Creation Supremacy’s perfected Grotto-Heaven realm technique.
The moment one stepped into the Grotto-Heaven realm, one would gradually gain the ability to sense karma. The higher one’s technique realm was, the clearer the karma was. King True Martial could sense karma extremely clearly. After some meditation, it wasn’t difficult for him to use the treasure.
“The detailed method of using the Fate Strawman is in this book.” Li Guan handed King True Martial a book. “During the mission in the World Gap, you are the strongest. Your life-preservation means are also the strongest. Thus, I’ll hand the Lightning Explosive Beads, the Fate Strawman, the Soul Nurturing Kettle, and many other treasures to you.”
An illusory Qin Wu, an illusory Luo Tang, and Meng Chuan stood beside Li Guan. The four Sect Proprietors had clearly agreed to these treasures being used. “Okay.” King True Martial received the treasures.
“We will try our best to stop them in the human world. If we can’t stop them, we can only rely on you two.” Li Guan looked at King True Martial before looking at Meng Chuan.
“Supremacy, don’t worry,” said Meng Chuan.
“Don’t worry, Master,” said King True Martial.
King True Martial looked at the strawman in front of him and immediately pointed at the strawman’s head. He said solemnly, “Demon Sage Deep Profundity, you shall die today!”
He had pointed at the strawman without any hesitation.
A terrifying force passed through the tip of his finger and entered the strawman’s head.
Within a small grotto-heaven.
The Imperial Lords want me to wait patiently. Since that’s the case, I shall just wait patiently then. Demon Sage Deep Profundity sat cross-legged on the grass. He was the only living being in the small grotto-heaven.
Suddenly, a mysterious force descended.
The force attacked him unpredictably as it descended upon his Essence Soul.
This is— Demon Sage Deep Profundity only felt his consciousness rumble. In the face of this mysterious and terrifying attack, his Essence Soul disintegrated, causing him to die on the spot.
His body continued to sit cross-legged, but it no longer emanated any auras.
Meng Chuan and company saw the black-white gas dissipate.
vm
The strawman in front of King True Martial exploded and turned into dust completely.
King True Martial smiled. It’s done.
After the black-white gas dissipated, Meng Chuan and company immediately saw King True Martial sitting cross-legged. His long black hair had turned white, and his face had turned wizened. He even emitted an aura of death.
He smiled at Meng Chuan and company.
“King True Martial.” King Molten and Peng Mu were in disbelief; they had no idea what had happened.
“Senior Brother.” Meng Chuan immediately rushed towards King True Martial.
“Demon Sage Deep Profundity is dead,” said King True Martial happily. “Junior Brother Meng, in order to kill him, I burned my Essence Soul.”
Meng Chuan’s eyes turned red. “You didn’t have to do this.”
To kill Deep Profundity, King True Martial just needed to expend 100 years of his lifespan. Just by doing this, he would have a high chance of killing Deep Profundity with the Fate Strawman. After that, he could live his remaining lifespan in a Dao Protector’s body. By doing this, he could live for over 1,000 years.
However, King True Martial was afraid that it wouldn’t be powerful enough. He was afraid that the attack would fail. Due to his doubts, he completely expended his remaining lifespan and burned his Essence Soul. This attack came at the cost of King True Martial’s life.
“I’ve done everything I can.” King True Martial’s Essence Soul dissipated as he continued smiling. “I’ll leave the rest to you.”
King True Martial’s consciousness dissipated as his body collapsed.
The moment his consciousness dissipated, he saw his entire life.He was once a dazzling expert in his generation, even more dazzling than Xue Feng and Meng Chuan when they were young. He was even more dazzling than two of the strongest Supremacies-Qin Wu and Bai Yaoyue-when they were young.
His talent made Li Guan excited and delighted. Due to his outstanding talent, Archean Mountain had opened Archean Eon Grotto-heaven for him. They believed that he was the peerless genius that would save humanity...
However, he had encountered emotional setbacks. He doubted his cultivation path and life, causing him to fall to his lowest point in life. As time passed heartlessly, he rebuilt himself from the beginning. He arrogantly took the foundations of an Imperial Lord-level ultimate technique-Yin-Yang Art-and created the True Martial Seven Absolutes.
The moment he showcased his True Martial Seven Absolutes’s strength, he was immediately recognized as the number one Regis Godfiend in the world. Even as a Regis Godfiend, he could match a Creation Supremacy. However, he had regrets in his life. He was never able to let go of these regrets. These regrets caused him to stay single his entire life.
I haven’t let my regrets go my entire life. As he sighed, his consciousness completely dissipated.
Meng Chuan, King Calm Sea, Peng Mu, King Molten, and King Thousand Wood looked at King True Martial’s lifeless corpse. All of them were filled with grief.
Another companion had died. Furthermore, he was the strongest Regis Godfiend of the present generation. He died in battle for the sake of humanity.
“Senior Brother Wang, rest in peace!” said King Calm Sea softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 465
chapters.content:
Chapter 465
The demon team protected the fake Demon Sage Deep Profundity as they continued heading to various places in the World Gap, pretending to draw a map of the connection points.
“Not good.” In the middle of the demon team, Patriarch Poison Dragon’s expression suddenly changed drastically. His consciousness seeped into the small grotto-heaven. He discovered that although the only living being in the small Grotto-Heaven remained seated, it was no longer breathing. His face drained of color immediately.
“What’s wrong?” asked Holy Lady Strings and Monarch Peacock.
“The talisman-which I used to help us rendezvous with Demon Sage Deep Profundity —suddenly couldn’t sense its life,” said Patriarch Poison Dragon hoarsely. “I immediately checked the small grotto-heaven afterward. Demon Sage Deep Profundity is already dead.”
“How is that possible?” Holy Lady Strings and Monarch Peacock’s expressions changed drastically.
“It’s already dead.” Patriarch Poison Dragon waved his hand, and Demon Sage Deep Profundity’s corpse appeared beside him. A domain prevented spying means, isolating the three demon monarchs from the outside world.
“How did it die when it was in your small grotto-heaven?” Monarch Peacock was somewhat angry. They had sacrificed so much, hoping to obtain the Imperial Lords’ rewards. Now, it was all for naught. “It isn’t Poison Dragon’s fault.” Holy Lady Strings looked at the corpse in front of her. “Demon Sage Deep Profundity’s body isn’t damaged at all. Only its Essence Soul has been completely destroyed. Its Essence Soul likely suffered a direct attack. Ordinary Essence Soul mystic techniques can’t penetrate a grotto-heaven. Only legendary karmic mystic techniques are capable of doing so. What could we do in such a situation? The Imperial Lords can’t blame us.”
“Let’s go back.” Monarch Peacock shook his head. “All our years of hard work has been for nothing.” “The human team is leaving swiftly,” said Holy Lady Strings. “My domain can sense that they are leaving extremely quickly. It’s impossible for us to chase after them. Oh... I can’t sense them anymore. They are too far away.”
Monarch Peacock shook his head. “How are we to chase after King Eastcalm? He’s too fast. Let’s go back.”
The human world, Archean Mountain.
The nameless mountain’s peak.
Li Guan, and the illusory figures of Qin Wu, Luo Tang, Bai Yaoyue, Meng Tiange, Mi Yu, Xu Yingwu, Zhang Chun, and Jing Fei— leader of the Demon Annilation Guild-were gathered here.
Ever since the two demon sage possessors attempted to tear through the world membranes and enter the World Gap three days ago, the Creation Supremacies in the world had been extremely nervous.
Although Demon Sage Fire Dragon had been killed, Demon Sage Deep Profundity had successfully fled into the World Gap and rendezvoused with the demon team. This caused everyone to wait for the battle’s outcome nervously.
“It’s been more than 800 years,” said Jing Fei
– leader of the Demon Annihilation Guild. “We have been fighting the demons for more than 800 years. If we fail to stop the demons this time, humanity’s darkest times will arrive.”
“We have to stop them,” said Bai Yaoyue.
“However, there’s nothing we can do now,” said Xu Yingwu. “We can only hope for the Regis Godfiends to stop the demons.”
They fell silent again.
Only the wind howled. The nine Creation Supremacies were anxious. After all, humanity’s fate would be decided by this battle.
Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang’s expressions changed suddenly. “Not good.”
“What’s wrong?” The other six Creation Supremacies could not help but panic. “What happened? Whether it’s good news or bad news, speak quickly,” Bai Yaoyue urged anxiously.
Li Guan’s eyes turned slightly red as he said in a deep voice, “King True Martial just died.”
“King True Martial is dead?” Bai Yaoyue, Xu Yingwu, Jing Fei, and the other Creation Supremacies were even more flustered than before.
“His technique is so strong that he’s comparable to a perfected Grotto-Heaven realm expert. Doesn’t the True Martial Seven Absolutes make him extremely well-rounded? His defensive means should be even more impressive,” said Jing Fei, the Demon Annihilation Guild Master, anxiously, “He even has a Tribulation treasure. How can he die?”
“King True Martial is the strongest member of the Regis Godfiend team. He’s also the most important. Now he’s dead? That means the situation has turned for the worse.” Xu Yingwu was extremely worried.
“Let’s wait for the results,” said Li Guan.
The Creation Supremacies fell silent.
They had no choice but to wait!
In just 30 seconds
Boom!
The world membrane distorted.
Li Guan, Qin Wu, and the other Creation Supremacies looked up. They saw the distorted world membrane being penetrated by a Bloodblade repeatedly. A hole-dozens of feet wide—was torn open.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
Meng Chuan, Peng Mu, Dao Protector Wang Shan, King Molten, King Transcendence, King Northcleanse, and King Thousand Wood flew out of the hole and landed on the nameless mountain.
Xu Yingwu couldn’t help but ask, “How did it go?”
The other Creation Supremacies also looked at them nervously.
Meng Chuan and company exchanged looks. Although killing Demon Sage Deep Profundity was a joyous occasion, the death of King True Martial weighed on the hearts of Meng Chuan and company.
“We succeeded,” said Meng Chuan. “Succeeded?” The Creation Supremacies revealed looks of excitement.
“Good, good, good.” Meng Tiange was so excited that his eyes were filled with tears. Extremely excited, he said, “You did well. You did well.”
“We succeeded.” Jing Fei was extremely excited. “We finally stopped the demons.”
“Well done.” Li Guan looked at the seven Godfiends in front of him and nodded. “You’ve done well. All we need to do now is guard the city passes and enjoy a long period of peace.”
“Peaceful days are here, hahaha.” Jing Fei laughed. Meng Chuan and the other Regis Godfiends didn’t smile.
King Molten said, “King True Martial ended the battle. He sacrificed his life and used a mystic technique to kill Demon Sage Deep Profundity.”
“We didn’t do anything. King True Martial did it all by himself,” said King Thousand Wood.
Meng Chuan added, “Senior Brother originally had over 100 years to live. With his attainments in the Yin-Yang lineage, it would be possible for him to become a Creation Supremacy by reversing his age. However, to ensure that Demon Sage Deep Profundity would die, he completely expended his remaining lifespan and burned his Essence Soul.”
“He’s a hero,” said Jing Fei. “He’s a hero of the entire human race.”
Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang had mixed emotions.
They had watched King True Martial enter Archean Mountain as a youth. They had watched him grow step by step to this day. Although he had once despaired and fallen to a low point in his life, King True Martial’s technique realm was comparable to Qin Wu and Li Guan’s.
Now, he was dead.
On Archean Mountain, King True Martial’s cave abode.
King True Martial’s corpse laid on the bed as wisps of flames burned it, gradually turning the body to ashes.
Li Guan, an illusory Qin Wu, an illusory Luo Tang, and Meng Chuan watched from the side.
The strongest Regis Godfiend of the present era-also the strongest Regis Godfiend in the past millennium-had been turned to ashes. “I will bury his ashes on this cave abode’s back mountain,” said Li Guan.
“Senior Brother doesn’t have any family?” asked Meng Chuan.
“In his entire life, he never married. He didn’t have children and has always been alone,” said Li Guan. “He once had a mortal sister. He had a deep relationship with her. After her death, he no longer remained in contact with her descendants.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
“This was left behind by Senior Brother.” Meng Chuan pointed at the void bracelet beside him. “The Tribulation treasure is also inside.”
Li Guan nodded. He put away the void bracelet and went forward to place the ashes into an urn.
Meng Chuan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang watched silently.
“Although King True Martial sacrificed himself, a new era has begun,” said Qin Wu. “Humans will have much better days.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Yea.”
Yes, a new era had begun.
The Demon Realm.
“Demon Sage Deep Profundity is dead. Our plan failed.” Imperial Lord Starquix shook his head gently. “The human’s heritage is deeper than we expected. A karma technique killed Demon Sage Deep Profundity while it hid in a small grotto-heaven.”
“What do we do next?” asked Lady Blackmoon. “Should we think of a way to send demon sage possessors into the human world?”
Imperial Lord Starquix shook his head. “It’s difficult. The demon sages aren’t our puppets. We can occasionally force one or two demon sages, but we can’t force all of them. If we force them into a corner... the demon sages will leave the Demon Realm and roam the outer realm.
“Back then,when the World Gap formed and a million demon monarchs infiltrated the human world-only Deep Profundity, Yellow Oscillate, Fire Dragon took the initiative to head to the human world. They all felt that there was a chance of victory,” continued Imperial Lord Starquix. “The situation has completely reversed now. The demon sages that entered the human world—Yellow Oscillate, Deep Profundity, and Fire Dragonhave died. Even Demon Sage Nine Abyss was forced to flee to the outer realm to survive.
“In such a situation, it will be very difficult to make the demon sages enter the human world willingly via possession,” said Imperial Lord Starquix.
The greater their chances of victory, the more willing the demon sages were to participate in the three demon Imperial Lords’ plans. However, the higher the death rate in the human world, the more reluctant the demon sages were.
“Besides, we don’t need ordinary demon sages. We need demon sages that can break through the two world membranes quickly,” said Imperial Lord Starquix. “The only demon sages left in the human world-Demon Sage North Sense and Demon Sage Thousand Cricketdon’t have good offensive strength.”
“It’ll be very difficult to find a suitable demon sage that’s willing,” said Emperor Roc. “Even if we find one, it will take it about 30 years to cultivate to the peak of the fifth Firmament after possession. Thirty years... If we do attack then, we might still fail.” Emperor Roc shook his head. “The humans have produced a monstrous genius, King Eastcalm, Meng Chuan. In 30 years, he will be even more terrifying than he is now.”
“Although the situation is dire, we still have to try,” said Imperial Lord Starquix.
The three Imperial Lords knew the war had become extremely difficult for them.
The World Gap.
King Calm Sea, formed from dark-blue ice, stood guard alone.
Senior Brother. King Calm Sea looked at the world that was slowly forming. He thought to himself, I’m actually very envious of you! Destroying the demons’ plans is a huge meritorious deed! You’ve helped the entire human world! Your name will be recorded in humanity’s history.
As for me, I’m just a joke. I was teased and used by demons. I could only recover completely because Master helped me become an ice lifeform. Otherwise, I would’ve become a lunatic that harmed humanity.
King Calm Sea continued advancing alone. He needed-wanted to redeem himself.
Due to Archean Mountain’s punishment, he had to patrol the World Gap for 300 years.
Final Chapter of Volume-Sixth-Level Essence Soul

chapters.title: Chapter 466 - Twenty-Two Years Later
chapters.content:
Chapter 466 Twenty-Two Years Later
Time passed.
In the blink of an eye, 22 years had passed since the battle in the World Gap.
The Great Zhou Dynasty’s Jiang State.
A merchant caravan with hundreds of people was advancing on a main road. A group of children sat on the two mule carts in the caravan. There were over ten children in total.
“It wasn’t easy for us to join the caravan as they made their way to Jiang State. Kids like you shouldn’t cause any trouble. If you anger the caravan owners, they will chase us away,” said a linen-clothed man who was driving the mule cart. “When the time comes, we won’t be able to bring you to Jiang State Capital that’s hundreds of kilometers away.”
“Yes, yes.”
“We will be very obedient.”
The children nodded immediately. “Uncle Liu, Uncle Zhang, we’re going to Jiang State Capital’s Green Elm Dao Academy. It’s said that King Feather Dragon, a Godfiend, cultivated in Green Elm Dao Academy when he was young. Is that true?” asked a boy. Immediately, the children on the two mule carts pricked up their ears and looked at the adults in anticipation.
“Haha.” A youth with a saber walked beside the mule cart. He laughed and said, “It’s true. King Feather Dragon attended Green Elm Dao Academy when he was young. He is the son of King Eastcalm and Queen Calmmoon. He cultivated at Green Elm Dao Academy. This Green Elm Dao Academy is definitely one of the best Dao Academies in the world. It’s most suitable for children like you to study there. The entire fort selected the 16 of you to go there. You have to cultivate well when you are at Green Elm Dao Academy.”
“I know, I know.”
“King Eastcalm’s family is truly impressive. They have three Regis Godfiends.”
“King Eastcalm is the most powerful Godfiend in the world. He alone wiped out a million demon monarchs in the world.” The group of children discussed. Nearly 40 years had passed since Meng Chuan resolved the threat of the million demon monarchs. King Eastcalm’s reputation had risen as time passed. He was extremely famous now.
“Uncle, I heard that Jiang State Capital is 100 kilometers wide, right?” “Yes. From the eastern city gates to the western city gates, you won’t be able to cover it even if you walk from morning until night,” said the saber-wielding youth with a smile. “Furthermore, I heard that a powerful Godfiend built Jiang State Capital’s city walls in half a month.”
“Half a month?” The children were dumbfounded.
As the elders chatted with the children, suddenly
“Quick, quick.”
From afar, a figure ran over and shouted, “Demons! Run ahead! Run ahead!”
The figure that flew over was also a Mortal Shedding realm expert. His shouts were loud, and almost the entire caravan heard it.
At first, the merchants were taken aback. They turned their heads and saw a black ‘line’ rapidly coming towards them.
“It’s the demons. Hurry up and leave.” The two Impervious realm experts in the caravan had excellent eyesight. Their expressions changed drastically once they saw this. They immediately shouted at the top of their voices.
Quick!
Quick!
The entire caravan went crazy. Many goods were abandoned as people fled in panic.
The black line in the distance quickly spread out. It was a dense horde of demons. The ones running in front were mainly greater demons and demon lieutenant commanders. Their speed was in no way inferior to those at the Impervious realm. They moved much faster than the entire caravan. The merchants were fleeing with all their might, but the demons behind them still closed in on them.
The demons were extremely ferocious as they ran with dismembered human corpses in hand.
“We’re too slow. We can’t escape.” The caravan was in a state of panic. Four of the adults on the two mule carts carried the children.
“Brother Liu, what should we do?”
“The Godfiends will quickly arrive once they are notified. Hold on, hold on,” shouted Uncle Liu anxiously. It was already difficult for them to escape themselves. The 16 children from the fort only slowed them down even more.
The mule ran desperately as it pulled the cart, but it was much slower than the demons.
“We won’t be able to protect them. Every man for himself!” A skinny, hunchbacked man suddenly jumped out of the mule cart and fled into the distance.
“Liu Laoqi.” The other three adults were extremely furious. Immediately, one of their companions took over the reins of the mule and continued driving it forward.
“When will the Godfiends come?”
“If the Godfiends come in time, we’ll live. If not, we’ll die,” said Uncle Liu through gritted teeth. Everyone looked at the dense horde of demons behind them. Some of the bear demons and ox demons were as large as a hill. The humans didn’t have any extravagant thoughts of resisting.
The children on the two mule carts were even more horrified. They had no idea how to deal with the situation. The children had never encountered such danger before.
Just as the obstreperous demons were about 100 feet away from the caravan, all the demons suddenly froze.
The dense horde of demons—which was spread out over a kilometer-froze. They were completely motionless.
Following that, the wind reduced the demons to dust with a whoosh. Tens of thousands of demons were annihilated instantly.
Meng Chuan stood high in the sky and looked down at the scene.
An invisible void fluctuation spread out a hundred kilometers. No demon within 100 kilometers could escape his detection.
Oh? Meng Chuan turned his head to look into the distance. An avian demon monarch was traveling at full speed.
Meng Chuan’s figure blurred before arriving in front of the avian demon monarch.
The avian demon monarch was taken aback. When he saw Meng Chuan in front of him, he bowed his head respectfully. “Greetings, King Eastcalm. I received Earth Net’s help request. I came here to provide reinforcements.”
