“I’ve killed all the demons. There are five second Firmament demon monarchs’ corpses 6.5 kilometers to the northeast. You are in charge of handling them,” said Meng Chuan. “Also, the unstable World Entrance is about 9 kilometers to the northeast. Keep an eye on it.”
“Yes,” said the avian demon monarch respectfully. Meng Chuan nodded and looked at the distant caravan. He sighed inwardly before disappearing
Whoosh.
As he flew, Meng Chuan wasn’t in a good mood.
Over the past few years, the number of unstable World Entrances has been increasing as the human world and the Demon Realm gradually grow closer to each other. Several of them appear in the Great Zhou Dynasty every day. Occasionally, more than ten unstable World Entrances appear a day. Ever since their plans for the World Gap failed, the demons have become even crazier. Every time an unstable World Entrance appears, they will send demons into the human world to engage in slaughter.
There are many Earth Net personnel now. A large number of Godfiends and demon servants are stationed everywhere. However, unstable World Entrances appear without any warning. There are often casualties. Meng Chuan shook his head slightly. Even he couldn’t do anything about it.
It had been nearly 40 years since he resolved the threat of a million demon monarchs. For mortals, 40 years was a very long time. Many youths had never experienced what life had been like when one million demon monarchs roamed the world, wreaking havoc. They had never experienced the days of hiding underground, in lakes, and deep in the mountains.
After 40 years, the human population had also multiplied to a large extent.
For every ten unstable World Entrances, there’s almost always one tragic outcome. All these years, the world has been peaceful. The large city passes are guarded quite well. Demon servants secretly watch the small and medium-sized World Entrances. The only time when a large number of casualties occur is when unstable World Entrances appear randomly. Meng Chuan had no solution to this problem.
A large city is guarded by Godfiends. As for the fort villages, it’s very easy for them to encounter disasters. Fortunately, Earth Net is everywhere. Godfiends and demon servants patrol the world all the time. The demons only dare to attack fort villages at most. Last year, 175 forts in the Great Zhou Dynasty were attacked. Over a million people died.
More than a million people died, and over 100 village forts were attacked. Placed against the backdrop of the entire Great Zhou Dynasty, it was a mere statistic. After all, this amount of casualties... was much less than before.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan flew towards the south.
I’m here. A towering city appeared in his vision.
Dragoncloud State, Warped Cloud City. This was a bustling city with over ten million people.
Upon seeing the large city, Meng Chuan smiled. He had come to congratulate his good friend. His good friend, Yan Chitong, had just become a Regis Godfiend!

chapters.title: Chapter 467 - Meng Chuan and Yan Chitong
chapters.content:
Chapter 467 Meng Chuan and Yan Chitong
Yan Chitong lived in an inconspicuous manor in Warped Cloud City.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan arrived above the manor and slowly descended. A bearded, heroic-looking man walked out from a house. He smiled and looked up at Meng Chuan. “Senior Brother Meng.”
“Junior Brother Yan.” Meng Chuan landed in the courtyard and smiled. “Congratulations. You have finally become a Regis Godfiend after cultivating for so many years.”
“It really has been many years.” Yan Chitong felt somewhat wistful before he smiled and said, “Among all our fellow disciples, you are the first to visit and congratulate me.”
“The guardian Godfiends have to keep their identities a secret. The other fellow disciples can’t find you, so I’m naturally the first to visit,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. Although the world was relatively peaceful, hundreds of fourth Firmament demon monarchs and a small number of fifth Firmament demon monarchs remained in hiding. These demon monarchs had been hiding because the situation wasn’t looking good. However, the humans didn’t dare to be careless.
If the identity of a guardian Godfiend was revealed, the demons could attack them in a targeted manner. Yan Chitong turned his head and shouted, “Dear.”
Soon, a woman walked out.
“This is Senior Brother Meng,” said Yan Chitong with a smile. “Senior Brother Meng came to congratulate me after knowing that I’ve broken through.”
“Greetings, King Eastcalm.” The woman was humble and polite.
Meng Chuan smiled and nodded. “This is the first time I’m meeting Marchioness Qingyi.”
“I’ve long heard of King Eastcalm’s name. Back at Archean Mountain, Junior Sister Meng You often told me about you,” said the woman with a smile.
The woman was the rather famous Marchioness Qingyi, Su Qingyi. She was also one of Archean Mountain’s younger generation geniuses.
Over the years, the younger Godfiends patrolled the world and hunted down the demons. Some of them had broken through to become Marquis Godfiends.
Su Qingyi and Meng You were two of the newly-advanced female Marquis Godfiends.
“Dear, I know you have something on. Go tend to it,” said Yan Chitong with a smile. “I’ll find a place to drink with Senior Brother Meng. I’ll be back tonight.”
“Go on then.” Su Qingyi smiled and nodded.
“Let’s go.” Yan Chitong left with Meng Chuan.
Warped Cloud City was extremely prosperous. There were many entertainment outlets in the city. Rainbow Cloud Restaurant was one of the best.
In one of Rainbow Cloud Restaurant’s private rooms.
Meng Chuan and Yan Chitong sat opposite each other.
“I didn’t bring anything else with me to congratulate you this time. I only brought a jar of good wine.” Meng Chuan smiled as he flipped his hand. He held the black jar in his hand-which was stuffed tightly. Meng Chuan placed it by the table.
“This is Fire Fruit Wine?” Yan Chitong’s eyes lit up when he caught a whiff of it. He immediately said, “As expected of Senior Brother Meng. How generous! This Fire Fruit Wine is rare. There are only dozens of jars left in this world. I’m going to have a treat today.” He took the initiative to pull out the wine jar’s stopper. With the naked eye, he could see the faint red alcoholic gases diffusing. Yan Chitong’s mind jolted, and he took the initiative to pour two bowls of wine. “Cheers.” Yan Chitong immediately picked up a large bowl and clinked it with Meng Chuan’s. He drank a few mouthfuls before putting it down on the table.
“What a fabulous wine. Unfortunately, it’s too expensive. A jar costs a million credits. I can’t bear to be so extravagant,” said Yan Chitong. “Senior Brother, you’re the best.” “This wine is meant for enjoyment. If others can enjoy it, we can naturally enjoy it as well.” Meng Chuan put down his wine bowl and sighed. “Time passes so quickly. The days when we entered Archean Mountain together remain vivid in my mind. Back then, you were the youngest. You wore a red robe, walked barefoot, and carried a spear. Several Godfiends cheered you on. You were very smug.” “I was only 13 years old back then,” Yan Chitong said as he reminisced about the past. “Back then, I felt that no matter how vast the world was, I, Yan Chitong, had the best talent in the world. Later, I learned that there is always someone better than you.”
“We’ve been cultivating for so many years. You’ve also become a Regis Godfiend now,” said Meng Chuan with a sigh. “Among our batch’s many disciples, only the two of us have become Regis Godfiends.”
Yan Chitong nodded and smiled. “I’ve worked hard for many years. Now, I’ve finally become a Regis Godfiend. Senior Brother Meng, you’re much better than me.”
“It was all because of fortuitous encounters,” said Meng Chuan. “Back then, when we went to the World Gap and observed the forming world, I had an epiphany. Otherwise, my cultivation would have been much slower.”
“Didn’t I go as well? Why am I so much slower than you?” Yan Chitong poured himself another bowl of alcohol and shook his head. “It still depends on one’s perceptivity! So many Godfiends and demon monarchs have been to the World Gap, but who can compare to you, Senior Brother Meng? Speaking of which, Senior Brother Xue Feng went to the World Gap with us. Furthermore, he reached the Dharma Domain realm in the World Gap! If he were alive, his future would definitely be limitless.”
Meng Chuan sighed. “If he were alive, he would have a chance of becoming a Creation Supremacy after being nurtured by Black Sand Grotto-Heaven.”
In their generation, they were the three most talented people. However, Patriarch Yellow Oscillate had killed Xue Feng before his talent could bloom fully.
The two of them drank and ate, chatting casually.
Oh? Meng Chuan sensed something and turned to look at another building outside the window.
“To think that something that fouls the mood has happened.” Yan Chitong frowned. “I’ll throw them out.”
+ techniquears ago inferior
“There’s no hurry. This matter will be more exciting than you expected. If you were to take action, wouldn’t that spoil the fun?” said Meng Chuan as he watched what was happening outside. His current technique realm was much higher than it had been 22 years ago. His perception of karma was in no way inferior to Qin Wu and Li Guan. Although he had never deliberately studied it, he knew a little about the karma lineage.
“It’s more exciting than I imagine?” Yan Chitong looked at the other building outside the window in puzzlement. “I’ll spoil the fun? Whose fun?”
In another building.
The building was much more luxurious. A bearded man sat high up at the seat of honor. Behind him stood five guards, and guests sat on both sides of him.
“Come, Madame Xiao. Come sit with me. Drink with me.” The bearded man’s large fan-like hand grabbed a slim woman carrying a lute and pulled her into his embrace. The slim woman wore a veil and tried her best to stand up straight. “Lord Ge, I’m only a musician at Rainbow Cloud Restaurant. I don’t accompany guests.”
“I told you to drink with me. Be good and listen to me.” The bearded man forcefully pulled the woman into his embrace and removed her veil, revealing her face. She was pretty, and her eyes were very clear and alluring. The bearded man smiled at the woman and raised his cup. “Come.”
The slim woman couldn’t fend him off and could only take a sip. “Lord Ge, I really don’t know how to drink.”
“Very good. You take a sip while I’ll take a sip.” The bearded man finished the rest.
“Madame Xiao, Lord Ge has taken a fancy for you. You have to seize the opportunity,” said the customer beside her with a smile.
Inside the building, Lord Ge coaxed the slim woman to drink. The guests around him also curried favor. None of the other musicians at Rainbow Cloud Restaurant dared to stop him.
Not long after
“I-I...” Lord Ge—who reeked of alcohol, suddenly felt his body go weak. He instinctively felt that something was amiss. He released his Quintessential Essence—which surged in all directions.
The surrounding tables and objects were sent flying. The slim woman in Lord Ge’s arms was sent flying by the impact. Only after the commotion ended did the surrounding guards see a dagger stab into Lord Ge’s chest.
“Bitch.” Lord Ge’s eyes turned red as he immediately took out a pill and ate it.
“How dare you.” The five guards transformed into phantoms. In a single exchange, they heavily injured the slim woman-who had reached the Impervious realm-and immediately captured her alive. “Hahaha, Ge.” The thin woman’s eyes were filled with madness. “I’ve been hiding in the Rainbow Cloud Restaurant for half a year. I was waiting for you to take the bait! Don’t you feel very indignant to die in the hands of a trivial figure like me?”
“Die?” Lord Ge sat there panting. His hand reached for the dagger in his chest and pulled it out. The wound on his chest rapidly healed at a visible speed. He sneered at the thin woman. “You think you have what it takes?”
The thin woman looked at this scene in disbelief. A mortal could live even after having their heart pierced?
“So it was an assassination attempt. Furthermore, it was deliberately planned by this female musician,” said Yan Chitong as he watched the commotion. “No wonder Senior Brother told me not to do anything. However, from the looks of it, her assassination failed.”
“Senior Brother Meng?” Yan Chitong looked at Meng Chuan in puzzlement.
Meng Chuan watched from afar.
In his vision, Lord Ge’s powerful aura enveloped his surroundings. The aura emitted by the five guards behind him enveloped every inch of the building. Anyone who dared to harm Lord Ge would suffer a crazy counterattack! However, this woman had been close to him. She silently poisoned him and stabbed him ruthlessly. She knew she couldn’t escape the five guards’ counterattack, but she still decisively attacked.
That Lord Ge seems to be in control of the entire situation. He is very safe in the building, but the female assassin still delivered the fatal blow.
Over the years, I’ve cultivated the electromagnetic domain. I spent a lot of time and effort on the electromagnetic domain. However, the domain is ultimately formed by Force. Killing an enemy ultimately depends on a fatal blow. Meng Chuan was inspired. The lightning lineage’s profundities naturally fused in his mind as he began to deduce another cultivation direction.

chapters.title: Chapter 469 - Meng Chuan’s Actions
chapters.content:
Chapter 469 Meng Chuan’s Actions
Ge Congbin stood there blankly, his heart cold. He was a mortal at the Core Condensation realm. He only had such great authority in Warped Cloud City because the Godfiend family clans descendants had insatiable greed, but were afraid of the laws. This was why he, Ge Congbin, had to do the dirty work, trying to satisfy the Godfiend descendants’ desires. He had done very well over the years, so he had become good friends with many Godfiend family clan descendants, creating a massive network of factions.
He needed his Godfiend family descendant friends to shield him from trouble and create the network of factions. The Godfiend family clan descendants also needed him because he was very good at cleaning up after them.
I’m doomed. I’m finished. Ge Congbin knew very well that many high-ranking members of Warped Cloud City’s government office and Earth Net headquarters came from Godfiend family clans. The Godfiend family clans’ influence in every aspect could be said to be one of the most powerful.
However, he encountered King Eastcalm himself today.
“This young lady will help you investigate this case, so remember to protect this young lady well,” instructed Meng Chuan. “Yes,” replied Tang Fengqi respectfully. King Eastcalm? The female musician looked at Meng Chuan and felt her head spin. She had just met King Eastcalm? According to legends, he killed a million demon monarchs and saved the entire human race? That King Eastcalm?
“Young lady, don’t worry. I’ll definitely investigate this matter thoroughly.” Meng Chuan looked at her and waved his hand. A wooden block—which had shattered from the battle—flew over. When it flew over, it naturally transformed into a small saber. Meng Chuan held the wooden saber and handed it to the female musician assassin. “Take it with you. If anyone harms you, just crush it. It will protect you.”
The female musician received the wooden saber and placed it in her arms. She nodded immediately. “I’ll remember this.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly and said to Yan Chitong, “Let’s go.” Whoosh. Whoosh.
The two fellow disciples had instantly disappeared.
It was already dark as Meng Chuan and Yan Chitong walked beside the river.
“Senior Brother, don’t be angry,” Yan Chitong comforted him.
“I’m not angry.” Meng Chuan looked into the distance. “I’m sad.”
“I know it’s been peaceful for many years. Many large cities are very prosperous and extravagant. I’ve always been vexed. The unstable World Entrances have caused many inhabitants of forts and villages to live arduous lives. More than a million people die every year. Compared to those that live in forts and villages—who live abject lives—these Godfiend family clan descendants that live in large cities are extravagant.
“However, from the looks of it, not only are they extravagant, but they also have twisted desires. When fewer people are killed by the demons, they take on the role. They treat people like livestock, killing them when they don’t obey. Didn’t you hear? That young lady could identify at least 1,000 corpses. How many people have they killed?”
“Senior Brother, there are all kinds of people in this world,” Yan Chitong comforted him.
“Over the past few years, generations of Godfiends have been fighting with all their might. Senior Brother Xue Feng, King True Martial, and many others have died in battle,” said Meng Chuan. “For what? For the sake of victory and peace. However, the peace that Godfiends exchanged for with their lives has ended up being wasted by them!” Meng Chuan looked at Yan Chitong. “I can’t tolerate their behavior.”
“What do you plan on doing?” asked Yan Chitong Meng Chuan looked at the bustling city. “Currently, the Godfiend family clan descendants can do whatever they want. Ordinary people are extremely afraid of them. I think that these Godfiend family clan descendants need to fear something.”
Archean City, Great Zhou Imperial Capital, Jiang State Capital, Wu State Capital, Eastcalm City, Changfeng City, Luo Tang City, Snow Wind City...
In the Great Zhou Dynasty, each large city’s Earth Net headquarters now had an additional ‘Ministry of Supervision.’
The various Ministries of Supervision investigated all the Godfiend family clans in the world. If they committed minor crimes, they could turn a blind eye. However, they didn’t spare any people that committed major crimes.
“Go in.”
“Go in.”
In the Great Zhou Dynasty, the various cities and Earth Net headquarters’ cells were almost full.
“Dad, you have to save me. You have to save me.” A young prisoner knelt and hugged his father’s thigh.
“You idiot. The family clan has given strict orders time and time again. However, you fools remain bold and rash,” said the old father angrily. “Can’t you ask me for money? Why did you have to break the law?”
“It’s not just me. There are others,” shouted the young prisoner immediately.
“Everyone will pay for their crimes. No one can escape.” The old father’s back hunched slightly as he sighed. “No one can save you this time. King Eastcalm is standing behind the Ministries of Supervision. No one can stop him.”
“The law can’t punish the masses. There are so many people,” shouted the young prisoner immediately. “It’s all my fault.” The old father looked at his son with tears in his eyes. “It’s my fault for being useless. I didn’t discipline you well when you were young. When you grew up, I knew that you wouldn’t become a Godfiend, but I indulged you too much. I wanted to give you a happy life, but who would’ve thought that I ended up hurting you?” “Dad, Dad,” the young prisoner begged. “Dad can’t help you anymore.” The old father turned and left.
“Dad—”The young prisoner was filled with despair. Only now did he know fear. “I was wrong. I know my faults!”
The young prisoner lived in an ordinary cell. At the bottom level’s prison cells, the security was much tighter.
In one of the heavily-guarded prison cells.
A man sat cross-legged. “Young Master,” said an old servant respectfully outside the cell. “What did my grandfather say?” asked the man indifferently.
“Patriarch said that King Eastcalm is behind the Ministries of Supervision. The various cities’ dossiers are handed to King Eastcalm himself. Nobody can stop this,” said the old servant.
“He has plenty of ways to save me if he wants to.” The man was furious. “Can’t he find a scapegoat?”
“Patriarch has also said that he would remove you from the family tree.” After saying that, the old servant left.
The man’s body trembled as he sat there silently.
After a long while, a noble scion brought his servants and came outside the cell.
“Xu Ming, are you looking for me?” asked the noble scion indifferently.
“Brother Yang Yuan, please save me.” The man knelt and begged. “On account of our past relationship, save me.”
“I can’t save you when my grandfather is personally behind this,” said the noble scion. “Furthermore, I didn’t expect you to do so many evil deeds. It’s really difficult to tell the human heart. The ancients are right.”
The man looked up and said in a deep voice, “Young Master Yang Yuan, we are very close. If I were to dig out the skeletons in your closet, you wouldn’t be able to clear your name.”
“The skeletons in my closet?” The noble scion was astonished.
“As long as you save me and give me a way out, I won’t slander you.” The man stared at the noble scion. “If I’m cornered, don’t blame me for running my mouth.”
“Hahaha, digging out the skeletons in my closet and framing me?” The noble scion laughed. “Xu Ming, your attitude before your death has really disappointed me.”
The noble scion turned around and left.
“Don’t regret it after you leave,” said the man through gritted teeth.
“What’s there to be afraid of when your conscience is clear?” The noble scion turned his head and smiled. “Besides, as you know, my grandfather is King Eastcalm.”
Meng Chuan’s children were Meng An and Meng You.
Meng An remained single. This left Meng Chuan and his wife vexed and helpless.
Meng You got married 20 years ago. Her husband was an Archean Mountain discipleYang Cheng-who shared life-and-death experiences with her. Yang Cheng was also rather outstanding. He was a rather dazzling genius in the past 30 years. He became a Marquis Godfiend before Meng You. The couple only had one son-Yang Yuan.“King Eastcalm?” The man became somewhat crazy. “Old man, you really have nothing better to do. You could have investigated Warped Cloud City only, but you ended up investigating all the cities in the Great Zhou Dynasty. You didn’t even give me a way out. I can’t accept it!”
In an ordinary manor in Snow Wind City.
Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue were drinking tea together as they watched the snow outside.
“I just wrote two letters. I’m prepared to send them to Two World Island and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven. Help me see if they’re appropriate.” Meng Chuan drank his tea and handed two letters to his wife.
“You want Two World Island and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven to set up Ministries of Supervision as well?” Liu Qiyue was surprised.
“They can decide what should be done. I only gave them some advice,” said Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan’s reputation was very high now.
In the eyes of the three major sects’ top Godfiends, they believed that Meng Chuan would soon become the strongest in the world! With his prestige in the war, his letters’ contents were something the two other major sects had to consider seriously.

chapters.title: Chapter 468 - Meng Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 468 Meng Family
Cultivation progress slowed down towards the end of each realm. Meng Tiange and Luo Tang had been stuck at the Grotto-Heaven realm’s late stage for hundreds of years. Qin Wu, Li Guan, and Bai Yaoyue had also cultivated for a long time, yet they were still stuck at the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm. It was very difficult for them to reach the Heaven Earth realm.
Although Meng Chuan had the best overall potential in the history of the human race, he encountered bottlenecks when it came to cultivating his Grotto-Heaven realm techniques. Although he went to the World Gap every year, Meng Chuan had only reached the Grotto Heaven realm’s late stage after 22 years. After breaking through, he met a conundrum.
What should be his next step? How was he to go from the Grotto-Heaven realm’s late stage to the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm?
What must I do with my Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique if I want to reach the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm? Meng Chuan pondered on his next steps. My Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique currently has the Nine Heavenly Forms of the Void’s essence as its core. It has also fused the Roving Dragon Form of Lightning, Yin-Yang Form of Lightning, and Lightning Domain Form’s essences. From the looks of it, I have placed too much importance on domains. After all, it’s a movement technique. It can also become a saber art. I should be more focused on cultivating the lethality of the technique.
The process of gradually fusing the 15 different aspects of lightning is how one cultivates the lightning lineage. I can try to fuse the Wave Splitting Forms of Lightning into the technique.
I’ve accumulated a lot of insight into the Wave Splitting Forms of Lightning’s essence. Furthermore, after I combine the Roving Dragon Form of Lightning with the Wave Splitting Forms of Lightning, my movement technique will be faster and more unpredictable. My saber technique will also be stronger. Meng Chuan began deducing the outcomes in his mind.
After attempting to combine all sorts of profundities, he felt that the Wave Splitting Forms of Lightning was very compatible with the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique.
An extremely bright spiritual glow appeared. Nine Heavenly Lightning Domain, Roving Dragon Wave Splitting, Yin-Yang Transformation.
It’s feasible. This direction is very suitable for me. Meng Chuan was delighted by his new ideas. I’ll enter seclusion after I return.
Only after snapping out of his daze did Meng Chuan notice Yan Chitong sitting by the table and drinking the Fire Fruit Wine happily. At the same time, he said, “Senior Brother, you suddenly fell into a daze, so I drank alone. By the way, I’m watching that musician assassin.”
“Just drink.” Meng Chuan smiled as he turned to look at the building outside the window.
He had just been inspired a moment ago. He now had an idea of how he should improve his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique.
The general direction of cultivation was to pursue the purple lightning’s essence.
However, cultivation wasn’t that simple. For Meng Chuan, every step he took was a step forward. Compared to him, most experts ended up stuck at a particular stage of cultivation, unable to improve themselves any further. Lady Blackmoon, one of the demon Imperial Lords, was one such person. She had been stuck at the Heaven Earth realm’s middle stage for millennia. Every breakthrough attempt ended up in failure.
This time, I have a feeling that this direction is correct. Meng Chuan was delighted. This young lady inspired me. I’m somewhat fated with her.
“Junior Brother Yan, I’ll go take a look,” said Meng Chuan.
“Let’s go together. But this wine is mine.” Yan Chitong put away the gourd of wine and immediately followed Meng Chuan.
...
Inside the luxurious room.
“I’m asking you one last time, who instigated you,” said Lord Ge ferociously with a pale face.
The delicate-looking woman snorted coldly. “Humph.”
“Very good. Very soon, I’ll let you know how it feels to not die, even when you beg for death.” Lord Ge gritted his teeth and said, “Let’s go. Bring her back.” The delicate-looking woman’s lips began to turn white as she sneered. “Of course I know what Lord Ge is capable of. Therefore, I consumed poison the moment I attacked. If I couldn’t escape, I would’ve died quickly. I estimate that the poison will take effect in another 30 seconds.” “Poison?” Lord Ge was furious. “What a suicidal woman.”
“Young lady, you want to commit suicide just because of this?” A gentle voice sounded as two figures appeared in the room. They were Meng Chuan and Yan Chitong. With a wave of his hand, the delicate-looking woman-who was being escorted-suddenly appeared beside Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan had been inspired by the female musician’s assassination attempted. He realized that a karma bond had formed between him and her.
According to Archean Mountain’s records, karma would become more and more important to cultivators as they became stronger. This was especially true for Tribulation Eminences. They were very concerned about karma. When Meng Chuan obtained the Essence Soul Star formula, he formed a karmic connection with Tribulation Eminence Fei Yu. In the future, when he became an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, he would have to resolve the karma. Of course, the Eighth Tribulation realm was extremely distant for Meng Chuan.
According to the books left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon, the explanation for karma was simple: Rather help others than owe anyone anything!
The more he owed, the greater his karma.
Being kind and helping many people led to good karma-a good thing. Rather help others than owe anyone anything. Meng Chuan clearly remembered this piece of advice that Ancestral Master Archean Eon had given to his juniors. Since he had a karmic connection with the girl, he naturally helped her to resolve it.
Oh? The delicate-looking woman looked at Meng Chuan and Yan Chitong dazedly. However, she realized that the poison in her body had disappeared quickly. Her body had recovered completely.
“Greetings, Godfiends.” Lord Ge immediately bowed. The five guards also bowed.
The guests and musicians beside them immediately bowed in fear.
“Young lady, tell me, why did you try to assassinate him?” asked Meng Chuan. He could tell at a glance that the woman was only 23 years old. It wasn’t wrong to address her as a young lady. The delicate woman’s eyes lit up as she looked at the two Godfiends in front of her. She immediately knelt on the ground.
“Just stand up and say it,” said Meng Chuan.
“This Ge Congbin secretly sent many subordinates into the mountains. They looked like a merchant caravan on the surface, but in reality, they went there to abduct people wantonly. Many villages in the mountains have been destroyed by them.” The delicate-looking woman gritted her teeth.
“You are framing me.” Lord Ge was extremely furious. He immediately shouted, “Lord Godfiends, don’t listen-“.
The delicate-looking woman’s eyes turned red as she continued speaking with tears streaming down her face. “Many men and elders were sent to the mines, never to be seen again. They will die in the mines. Many women and children were sold in batches like goods. Those that were disobedient were slaughtered like livestock.” The delicate-looking woman’s body trembled.
“Earth Net investigates the entire world. What did they do to escape Earth Net’s investigations?” asked Meng Chuan.
“Earth Net?” The delicate woman sneered and pointed angrily at Lord Ge. “He, Ge Congbin, is one of Warped Cloud City’s four Patrollers – South Patroller.”
“It’s all slander. This woman has a grudge against me,” said Lord Ge angrily.
Boom.
The door opened, and a figure walked into the room with an afterimage. It was a black-robed elder.
The black-robed elder looked at Lord Ge. “Brother Ge, what’s wrong?” “Brother Tian, this woman tried to assassinate me and accused me in front of those two Godfiends,” said Lord Ge immediately.
Only after Ge Congbin pointed out the two Godfiends did the black-robed elder turn his head and look at Meng Chuan and Yan Chitong. Yan Chitong had naturally changed his appearance to hide his identity, but Meng Chuan didn’t bother disguising himself. However, information regarding Regis Godfiends was secret. This black-robed elder was only an outer sect disciple of Archean Mountain, so he naturally couldn’t recognize Meng Chuan.
Although he couldn’t recognize them, he could sense how powerful these two Godfiends were. “I’m Warped Cloud City’s Earth Net Godfiend, Tian Qun.” The black-robed elder cupped his hands. “This woman tried to assassinate an Earth Net patroller. I need to bring her back to Earth Net headquarters.”
“Senior Godfiends, I have plenty of evidence,” said the slim woman. “There are at least nine deep burial pits in Fog Dragon Mountain. There are at least thousands of corpses buried there. They are the bodies of all the disobedient women and children. I can identify them! As for the people in the mines, as long as we interrogate them, we will know that they were originally commoners in the mountain villages.”
Lord Ge’s expression changed.
The black-robed elder angrily said, “How dare you slander our Earth Net’s South Patroller? Please don’t stop our Warped Cloud City’s Earth Net from handling this matter.”
“Lord Godfiends,” said Lord Ge with a fawning smile. “I’m a mortal. Although I have reached the Core Condensation realm, it’s rare for someone like me to take on the role of South Patroller. I only have this job because I have a group of good friends. They are all from Godfiend family clans. For example, the Wang family, the Lu family, and... the Meng family!”
The final words ‘Meng family’ was slowly said by Lord Ge.
The Meng family’s influence was gradually approaching that of the number one Godfiend family clan in the Great Zhou Dynasty. This was because Li Guan neared the end of his lifespan. He could only hold on for another few decades. Once he died, according to Archean Mountain’s rules, the imperial family would be replaced.
Typically, the ascension of a new imperial family was based on credits.
As an expert equivalent to a Creation Supremacy, Meng Chuan had killed one million demon monarchs. He had even brought back the Eon Sea Sect’s treasure. Due to this, Meng Chuan had gained a lot of credits. The ancient Godfiend family clans secretly guessed that the Meng family would be the Great Zhou Dynasty’s next imperial family. This family already had three Regis Godfiends. The Meng family would clearly grow stronger as time passed. Soon, they would become the strongest Godfiend family clan in the world.
When the Meng family handled matters, everyone would give them face.
“The Meng family?” said Meng Chuan softly as he frowned.“That’s right, the Meng family,” said Lord Ge with a smile. “I believe no one dares to spout nonsense about the Meng family. I received the support of many good friends. Their recommendations and belief in my abilities led to me becoming an Earth Net Patroller.”
Meng Chuan’s expression turned ugly.
Seeing this, Lord Ge felt pressured by the mysterious Godfiend.
“A bunch of bastards!” Meng Chuan’s expression turned ugly. He extended his hand and grabbed Warped Cloud City Lord, who was dozens of kilometers away. Dozens of kilometers, Warped Cloud City Lord had been eating dinner when Meng Chuan suddenly dragged him away. In the blink of an eye, Warped Cloud City Lord found himself in a house. He held his chopsticks and looked around dazedly. From the scenery outside the window, he knew one thing. This is the Rainbow Cloud Restaurant. It’s more than 25 kilometers away from my residence! He couldn’t help but tremble. He had never heard of anyone capable of pulling someone from 25 kilometers away. “Tang Fengqi!” shouted a furious voice.
Warped Cloud City Lord, Tang Fengqi, turned his head and saw two figures. Yan Chitong naturally hid his identity, but Meng Chuan didn’t hide it at all.
“King Eastcalm.” Tang Fengqi immediately bowed in fear. He was an Archean Mountain inner sect disciple. As a Great Solar Godfiend, he naturally knew Meng Chuan. “King Eastcalm?” Lord Ge and the black-robed elder were stunned.
“I want you to do the investigations.” Meng Chuan pointed at Lord Ge. “Investigate everything about Ge Congbin. Investigate everybody he knows and everything he has done. Even if it involves the Meng family, investigate it. I want a clear answer to everything!” “Yes, yes, yes.” Tang Fengqi was extremely alarmed. King Eastcalm’s status in Archean Mountain was special. He was equivalent to the Supremacies. With a single command, his legs went limp.
“No matter who it involves, don’t let them go.” Meng Chuan glared at Tang Fengqi ferociously.

chapters.title: Chapter 470 - Deterrence
chapters.content:
Chapter 470 Deterrence
“I’m afraid many people will find you a busybody,” said Liu Qiyue with a smile as she read through the letters.
Meng Chuan took a sip of tea. “They can think of me however they want.”
After reading the two letters, Liu Qiyue nodded and said, “I think there’s no problem with the two letters. It’s reasonable. Furthermore, in the past 40 years, the world has been peaceful. The population has doubled, and the way the world is governed needs some changing. Furthermore, you wrote these letters personally. Black Sand Grotto-Heaven and Two World Island require your help, so even if they go through the motions, they will still do something.”
“It’s fine as long as you think there’s no problem.” Meng Chuan nodded and looked outside.
Swoosh.
An avian demon servant instantly appeared and greeted respectfully, “Master.”
“Send these two letters to Archean Mountain.” Meng Chuan casually threw the two letters at the avian demon servant. The avian demon servant took them and bowed slightly before disappearing into the sky.
“By the way, Ah Chuan,” said Liu Qiyue. “What’s wrong with An’er? Archean Mountain has many female Godfiends that admire him, but he doesn’t care about any of them.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan held his teacup and nodded in thought. “An’er was very normal when he was young. He didn’t experience any major setbacks when he was growing up. It’s most likely that a special cultivation technique has affected his temperament. It could also be a result of Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s legacy.”
“Then, can we do anything about it?” Liu Qiyue asked worriedly.
“Didn’t you already try many times?” asked Meng Chuan with a smile.
“All my attempts failed,” said Liu Qiyue worriedly. Her son had been alone for many years. Now that he was guarding a city alone, how could she not worry?
“We’ve done everything we can. Furthermore, An’er is a Regis Godfiend. There’s no need for us to worry about him too much,” said Meng Chuan.
Liu Qiyue shook her head. “What can I say about you?” Huh? Meng Chuan held his teacup in one hand as a token suddenly appeared in his other hand. A spot on the token’s map emitted a blood-red glow.
“A life-and-death request.” Meng Chuan’s expression changed.
Liu Qiyue saw the token map as well. “Is it in the Great Yue Dynasty?”.
“I’m going out for a while.” While his voice was still echoing, Meng Chuan had already vanished.
Liu Qiyue looked out of the house, but she didn’t see the bolt of lightning disappearing into the southern horizon.
The Great Zhou Dynasty and the Black Sand Dynasty had nearly 70 large cities each. Countless forts and villages surrounded these large cities. Although the Great Yue Dynasty had a vast territory, it only had 23 large cities. In the past 40 peaceful years, the Great Yue Dynasty’s population had increased rapidly. People needed commerce, trade, and better living environments. Therefore, they began repairing and rebuilding the cities that they had abandoned in the past. Over 200 medium-sized cities were rebuilt.
The Great Yue Dynasty’s Sunset River City was one such city.
More than one kilometer away from Sunset River City, a huge void hole suddenly appeared in the afternoon. It was more than three kilometers wide. One could clearly see the Demon Realm on the other side of the World Entrance.
“What?”
“That’s—”
The guards on Sunset River City’s city walls were shocked when they saw the huge World Entrance that had suddenly appeared. Some guards lit beacons frantically, while others crushed their tokens to request help.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
In Sunset River City, one Great Solar Godfiend and two Indestructible Godfiends flew to the top of a tree and looked towards the eastern city wall. Due to the distance, the city walls prevented them from seeing the World Entrance.
“What happened?”
“Could it be an unstable World Entrance?”
“There are still demon monarchs invading?” The three Godfiends were somewhat puzzled. They stepped on tree crowns and roofs as they rushed to the eastern city wall as light beams.
At that moment, a massive bear demon monarch—who was nearly 200 feet tallpassed through the World Entrance and arrived in the human world. He stood at the World Entrance’s exit and didn’t continue advancing.
“Human city? How lucky.” The bear demon monarch grinned hideously. He suddenly roared and cast his divine power.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
A black wind blotted out the sky, blanketing the world as it swept across everything.
Flowers, plants, and trees were completely destroyed. Sunset River City’s eastern city wall instantly crumbled under the black wind. The black wind swept up the horrified, fleeing guards as they cried out in pain before being reduced to blood. All the buildings and trees in the city were pulverized. Before many people could react, the black wind wiped them out completely. The black wind was extremely fast. In the blink of an eye, it traveled more than a kilometer away.
The three Godfiends-who were rushing towards the eastern city wall—were shocked when they saw the terrifying black wind tear everything apart. The Indestructible Godfiend nearest to the city wall turned around and fled in fright. However, in just an instant, the black wind covered an area over a kilometer wide and inundated him as it howled.
Swoosh! Swoosh!
Wherever the black wind passed, everything was destroyed. Mortals died. Even Indestructible Godfiends died instantly.
“Request reinforcements.” “Quick, send the life-and-death request.” The other two Godfiends watched the destructive black wind from afar. Horrified, they requested for reinforcements as they fled.
The black wind billowed as it swept over five kilometers.
King Eastcalm can travel 5,000 kilometers in three seconds. I have to retreat quickly. The stocky fourth Firmament bear demon monarch was very cautious. He immediately retreated back into the World Entrance after casting his divine power once.
Over the years, the demons had suffered terribly at King Eastcalm’s hands!
Therefore, they learned their lesson. Although Sunset River City was akin to a nice piece of fatty meat-one that he could easily devour within 30 seconds—the bear demon still chose to give up and retreat.
Another three seconds later.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan appeared above Sunset River City.
The silver mystic patterns on both sides of his face faded as the silver lightning around him disappeared. He continued to scan the city as he stood on his Bloodblade Disc.
Having cast his divine power—Flowing Sandto travel at full speed, Meng Chuan could travel about 1,900 kilometers in a second. In just three seconds, he could travel over 5,000 kilometers. With such terrifying speed, Meng Chuan could travel anywhere in the world within nine seconds. In the past few years, only Meng Chuan could arrive at the attacked places in a short time. He was also the only one that could handle any other emergencies.
This was also why Two World Island and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven needed Meng Chuan’s help.
A new large World Entrance? Meng Chuan looked down and saw the new World Entrance. It was more than three kilometers wide. He also saw the bear demon monarch and other demon monarchs on the other side of the World Entrance. They nervously glanced at the human world, but they didn’t dare enter. These demons are becoming more and more crafty. They know that I’m fast, so they immediately flee after surprise attacking a city. They aren’t greedy at all. Meng Chuan glanced down at Sunset River City.
Sunset River City spanned about 30 kilometers wide. Part of the city’s eastern region had been reduced to ruins. Pools of blood dyed the ruins red. It should be a large-scale attack that swept through the city in a short period of time. It probably killed tens of thousands of people.
Meng Chuan’s expression was cold, but his invisible domain hid him from sight. The demons couldn’t see him at all.
He waited silently.
However, the demons did not enter.
“Don’t be anxious. King Eastcalm has likely arrived. This is a stable World Entrance. We will have time to attack slowly in the future.” The demon monarchs on the World Entrance’s other side were very patient. “Your Majesty, you earned lots of credits by slaughtering tens of thousands of humans this time.” Some demon monarchs curried favor. They received credits for every human they killed. He gained lots of credits for killing tens of thousands of humans.“Hahaha.” The bear demon monarch laughed as he stared at the other side of the World Entrance.
Meng Chuan waited for ten minutes.
Only after ten minutes did a black-robed, saber-wielding man fly over to Meng Chuan.
“Greetings, King Eastcalm,” said the black-robed, saber-wielding man politely. “King Mushui.” Meng Chuan nodded in greeting. “When I came, this area in Sunset River City was destroyed. Tens of thousands of people died. The demons are very cunning. They didn’t enter the city directly.”
The black-robed, saber-wielding man frowned slightly as he looked at the three-kilometer-wide World Entrance. He gratefully said, “Thank you, King Eastcalm. If it weren’t for your deterrence, the demons would have long wiped out Sunset River City. After a large number of demons enter, they would quickly spread out and attack various areas. With you around, the demons have to be cautious. Because of you, they didn’t slaughter millions of people.” His words were filled with flattery.
King Eastcalm looked at the ruins. The blood that dyed the area red weighed on his heart.
“I’ll leave this to you. I’ll head back first,” said Meng Chuan.
“Don’t worry, King Eastcalm. Two World Island will deal with this place properly,” said King Mushui immediately.

chapters.title: Chapter 471 - Entering Autumn
chapters.content:
Chapter 471 Entering Autumn
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan streaked across the sky and flew towards Snow Wind City.
He took about six seconds to reach Sunset River City with his divine power, Flowing Sand. It didn’t burden him at all.
This divine power placed a huge burden on his Essence Soul. In the past, Meng Chuan could only use it for 15 seconds. After gaining a sixth-level Essence Soul, he could maintain Flowing Sand for 90 seconds. Due to this, he could use this move often. “Ah Chuan.” Liu Qiyue stood in the corridor and waited for him.
Meng Chuan landed. “How’s the situation?” asked Liu Qiyue.
“Another large World Entrance has appeared.” Meng Chuan frowned. “More and more World Entrances are appearing. The pressure on the three sects is also increasing.”
“There’s no other way,” said Liu Qiyue. “Ah Chuan, follow me.” As she spoke, she flew north.
“Oh?” Meng Chuan followed her curiously.
The couple flew to Snow Wind City’s inner city pass and stood on the inner city wall. They could see a four-kilometer-wide large World Entrance. The World Entrance was about a quarter kilometer deep. Through the World Entrance, they could clearly see the Demon Realm. As they stood on the other side of the Demon Realm, they could see a vast mountain range. They could vaguely see many demons and demon monarchs looking at the human world’s scenery. “The World Entrance has expanded again?” Meng Chuan immediately noticed the changes.
“That’s right. When you rushed to the Great Yue Dynasty, Snow Wind City’s large World Entrance experienced some changes,” said Liu Qiyue. “Previously, it was more than 3.5 kilometers wide. Now, it has widened by another quarter-kilometer. It’s nearly 4 kilometers wide now.”
“Yes,” said Meng Chuan solemnly. “The human world and the Demon Realm are gradually approaching each other, causing many changes to occur. A large World Entrance directly appeared in the Great Yue Dynasty. Many other World Entrances have expanded.”
Liu Qiyue said, “During the years I’ve been guarding Snow Wind City, this World Entrance has expanded slightly. In the past 40 years, its width has increased from 3 kilometers to 4 kilometers.”
“All the World Entrances in the world are the same.” Meng Chuan nodded. “Small World Entrances, medium-sized World Entrances, large World Entrances, and even super-large World Entrances are slowly expanding. This is the trend!”
According to predictions, the two worlds would gradually approach each other for many years. When they had reached a certain distance from each other, they would slowly separate. When that happened, many stable World Entrances would gradually shrink or even disappear.
“Ah Chuan.” Liu Qiyue worriedly said, “There are now five super-large World Entrances in the world. That means five Creation Supremacies are needed to guard them. The situation will only worsen in the future.”
“Don’t worry,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “We’ve survived more difficult times. It’ll get better and better as time passes.”
“Yes.” Liu Qiyue looked at her husband and calmed down.
As his wife, she knew how astonishing Meng Chuan’s cultivation speed was.
Meng Chuan’s self-created Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique was an ultimate technique superior to the World Roving Dragon Saber. As an expert that had reached the Grotto-Heaven realm’s late stage, he was comparable to Qin Wu, Li Guan, and Bai Yaoyue—who were all at the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm.
Furthermore, those who created their own ultimate techniques were generally stronger than those who followed their predecessors’ steps. They were stronger because they had a clearer understanding of how to utilize their techniques. Their self-created techniques were also extremely suitable for themselves.
Black Sand Grotto-Heaven.
“What’s your take on Meng Chuan’s letter?” asked Bai Yaoyue as she looked at Meng Tiange and Mi Yu.
“Over the past few years, King Eastcalm has rushed over to reinforce us when an emergency occurs,” said Meng Tiange. “In the past 22 years, tens of millions of Black Sand Dynasty’s mortals have survived because of him. Let’s not even mention the dozens of Godfiends that were saved by him. He destroyed many of the demons’ plans alone. We can’t turn a blind eye when he’s asking for such a huge favor.”
Bai Yaoyue and Mi Yu nodded. “Yes.”
Meng Chuan was now the number one Patroller in the world. Everyone needed his help during dire situations.
“Furthermore, it’s time for some changes,” said Meng Tiange with a smile. “Previously, we abandoned the prefecture cities and county cities, causing our control over the commoners to decrease. Additionally, the world’s population has doubled in the past 40 years. Due to this, our control over the population further decreased.
“On the contrary, the Godfiend family clans have tens of thousands of clansmen. Some even have as many as 100,000 clansmen. With their influence, their assertion of power is even more thorough than before. In many places outside the cities, these Godfiend family clans are basically uncrowned emperors. “The pressure of guarding so many large cities is quite great. The demons can counterattack at any moment. It’s temporarily not suitable to build more prefecture cities or county cities,” continued Meng Tiange. “At this time, we need to restrain these Godfiend family clans by using the law.”
“I agree,” said Mi Yu. “King Eastcalm’s letter is a good opportunity for us to implement this
plan.”
Two World Island.
“What’s your take on King Eastcalm’s letter?” Xu Yingwu looked at the illusory Zhang Chun -his good friend.
“We definitely have to give King Eastcalm face.” Zhang Chun nodded. “However, our Great Yue Dynasty’s situation is special. Many places are occupied by Regis Godfiends. Even slavery exists. It’s not easy for our Two World Island to interfere with the internal matters of the Regis Godfiends’ territories.” Xu Yingwu said, “Firstly, the world’s population is now much greater than before. Regis Godfiends control much greater populations than before. Secondly, the three major sects have constantly been expanding in the past 50 years.
“Every year, we recruit 50 disciples, just like Archean Mountain and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven. We’ve spent a large amount of our resources, causing us to have the most number of Marquis Godfiends in our sect’s history. Although we aren’t comparable to the other two sects, we still have 75 Marquis Godfiends. There isn’t even enough territory for these Marquis Godfiends.” The next 200 years were extremely crucial years.
Humans had obtained many resources from the World Gap. The three sects were also increasing their recruitment quota. They nurtured disciples with all their might, causing many more Marquis Godfiends to rise than before.
“That’s right. There’s not enough territory for our Marquis Godfiends. However, the territories of our Regis Godfiends have much greater populations than before.” Zhang Chun nodded. “Although the Regis Godfiends have contributed greatly, we have to be fair. We have to give some territory to the Marquis Godfiends.”
“King Eastcalm’s letter is a good opportunity. With the excuse of protecting the commoners and compressing the territory, more Marquis Godfiends will have territories. At the same time, the Imperial Court will have direct control over more places,” said Xu Yingwu. “To deal with the war, the influence of Two World Island’s Regis Godfiends has increased so much that it’s encroaching that of Two World Island.”
Other than the Great Zhou Dynasty, Two World Island and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven also pushed for Ministries of Supervision.
The Black Sand Dynasty was similar to the Great Zhou Dynasty.
Compared to Archean Mountain and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven, Two World Island’s internal affairs were much more chaotic. Most of the time, they were dealing with the redistribution of power. In this struggle for power, Two World Island had to use King Eastcalm’s name to enact executive orders. They still needed to go through the motions.
By doing this, it greatly increased the commoners’ statues. In the past, they were the feudal lords’ property. Their lives and deaths were controlled at their mercy. Now, their lives were at least protected by the law. The Ministries of Supervision protected them. Their status in the Great Yue Dynasty had greatly improved.
The two sects had given Meng Chuan face. Apart from owing him a favor and Meng Chuan’s significant contribution to humanity, they mainly did this because everyone expected Meng Chuan to be the strongest expert in the world soon. Furthermore, he might be invincible for thousands of years, maybe even longer.
“It’s over. It’s over. My years of hard work have gone down the drain.”
“King Eastcalm has too wide an influence. A Regis Godfiend from the Great Zhou Dynasty is interfering with our Black Sand Dynasty’s governance? However, Black Sand Grotto-Heaven actually listened to him obediently?”
“The family clan gave me the land 50 kilometers around Icewater Mountain. Now, they want to take it away?” “Don’t blame the family clan. The entire island was originally our Fenghai family’s territory. However, our territory has been reduced. We only have control over Fenghai City and 250 kilometers around it. The other areas have been taken away. Since Icewater Mountain no longer belongs to the family clan, it’s obviously not yours.”
“King Eastcalm, you destroyed me!” Countless people cursed Meng Chuan behind his back.
Many people ruled over their territories like uncrowned emperors, but all of this collapsed in the face of the tumultuous situation. They were angry at King Eastcalm, but they could only grumble to themselves secretly. They didn’t dare spout their grievances publicly.
Meng Chuan naturally didn’t care. When he read the intelligence dossiers that recorded the world’s changes, his mood lifted.Days passed.
Meng Chuan and his wife, Liu Qiyue, lived in an ordinary courtyard in Snow Wind City. They lived a peaceful life, and in the blink of an eye, autumn arrived.
Late autumn.
The World Gap’s scenery remained unchanged throughout the four seasons.
A seemingly calm region suddenly distorted.
Boom!
A passageway between two world membranes was blasted open. A figure leisurely flew through the passageway and entered the World Gap. It was none other than Monarch Peacock. Monarch Peacock scanned his surroundings.
Since I’ve come to the World Gap, it won’t be long before King Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, arrives. Monarch Peacock was very familiar with how things played out. In the past 22 years, he had fought Meng Chuan plenty of times. Both parties often came to the World Gap to cultivate.

chapters.title: Chapter 472 - Meng Chuan vs. Monarch Peacock
chapters.content:
Chapter 472 Meng Chuan vs. Monarch Peacock
Snow Wind Pass, morning.
Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue drank hot porridge and ate pancakes. Outside the house, the heavy snow resembled down feathers.
“Qiyue, your cooking skills are getting better.” Meng Chuan picked up a piece of flatbread and ate happily. Although they had servants to serve them, Liu Qiyue often cooked for him back on Archean Mountain. This was one of her hobbies.
“Just eat,” said Liu Qiyue with a smile as she drank her porridge.
“By the way, what do you plan on doing after breakfast?” asked Meng Chuan.
“Go to the ice river outside the city and practice my archery,” said Liu Qiyue with a smile. “Do you want to accompany me?” “I’m absolutely willing to be your sparring partner,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “Besides, your archery skills are unparalleled in the world. It helps me hone my Cloud Dragon Snake Saber Art.”
Being Liu Qiyue’s so-called sparring partner meant that he would be a target dummy!
He brandished Demon Slayer to block the number one sharpshooter’s arrows! Liu Qiyue wasn’t afraid of making mistakes. After all, even if Meng Chuan used his body to block the arrows, Meng Chuan could still withstand them completely. Ever since he improved the laws within his body from the Dharma Domain realm to the Grotto-Heaven realm’s late stage, Meng Chuan’s physical body had improved greatly. Although he didn’t have enough Cosmos Crystals to reach the Sage Becoming realm, he was nearly twice as strong as before. Just by using his body alone, he was as strong as an ordinary Creation Supremacy. His divine power -Indestructible Divine Armor—was also slightly stronger. I currently have a sixth-level Essence Soul. My technique realm is sufficient for the breakthrough. If I had enough Cosmos Crystals, I would’ve long reached the Sage Becoming realm. If I was a Sage Becoming realm expert, I would be able to suppress Monarch Peacock with my body alone. However, my body is currently only as strong as an ordinary Creation realm expert. The difference is still too great. With such a weak body, I don’t dare to engage Monarch Peacock in close combat.
Meng Chuan’s heart suddenly stirred. He flipped his hand and took out a black token.
The black token was carved with complicated patterns. At this moment, the token glowed red.
“It’s King Calm Sea?” Liu Qiyue—who was drinking porridge—could tell what the red glow meant at a glance.
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded. “King Calm Sea summoned me. I’m guessing a demon monarch has entered the World Gap. Dear, I’m sorry. It looks like I won’t be able to train with you today.” “Dealing with demons is more important,” said Liu Qiyue with a smile.
“There’s no rush. Let me finish the flatbread first,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “If it’s an emergency, King Calm Sea will summon me three times in a row. It should be a normal situation since he only summoned me once.”
It was very difficult to communicate across worlds. Even with Archean Mountain’s means, Meng Chuan and King Calm Sea’s tokens could barely sense each other.
If King Calm Sea summoned him once, then it was likely a normal problem. If King Calm Sea summoned him three times frantically, then it was likely that it was an urgent situation. Once this happened, Meng Chuan had to rush over to the World Gap immediately.
“Yes, I’m full.” Meng Chuan finished the flatbread and the porridge before standing up. “I’ll leave first. I’ll probably be back in two to three months.”
“Go ahead,” said Liu Qiyue with a smile.
Meng Chuan smiled at his wife before disappearing into the horizon.
Liu Qiyue watched Meng Chuan disappear from afar. She was used to his frequent disappearances.
For the past 22 years, he stayed in the World Gap for at least two to three months every year! Even without King Calm Sea’s summons, Meng Chuan would usually leave during winter and return before the new year.
Boom!
Meng Chuan flew into the world membrane passageway he blasted open and arrived in the World Gap. I’m back at the World Gap. Meng Chuan looked at the familiar scenery.
Meng Chuan placed great importance on his cultivation. He wanted to increase his strength as quickly as possible. The stronger he was, the more useful he would be in the war.
The World Gap was a perfect place for cultivation, so Meng Chuan naturally had to come.
However, he also realized that staying in the World Gap for long periods didn’t give the best results. It was like how painting the purple lightning occasionally was better than cultivating arduously every day. Going between the World Gap and the human World wasn’t any worse than staying in the World Gap constantly
In fact, he could feel the differences between the complete human world and the incomplete World Gap when he compared them with each other. Meng Chuan cared about his family a lot. Therefore, he spent most of his time in the human world. He only spent two to three months in the World Gap every year before returning
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan flew at high speeds while carefully scanning his surroundings.
If I’m not wrong, King Calm Sea summoned me. It should mean Monarch Peacock has entered the World Gap. This year, my Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique has finally reached the Grotto-Heaven realm’s late stage. I’ve also perfected my electromagnetic domain. My strength has increased significantly. If I’m lucky, I should have a chance of killing Monarch Peacock.
Monarch Peacock held his spear as he watched the incomplete world slowly expand.
I have a powerful body and strong divine powers. Back then, I couldn’t do anything to King True Martial, even though I clearly suppressed him. I’m now facing the same situation with King Eastcalm, thought Monarch Peacock.
King Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, created his own ultimate technique. It has reached the Grotto-Heaven realm’s middle stage. I’ve learned my predecessors’ ultimate techniques. I also have the Dark Peacock bloodline and the treasures that the three Imperial Lords bestowed me. I’ve cultivated hundreds of years longer than Meng Chuan, but I’m still stuck at the Grotto-Heaven realm’s middle stage.
Monarch Peacock was rather disgruntled. However, the breakthrough will happen soon. I sense that I’m almost at the Grotto-Heaven realm’s late stage. Perhaps I can break through after fighting King East Calm, Meng Chuan.As long as I break through, my strength will increase greatly. If I catch him off guard, I will have a chance of killing Meng Chuan. When that happens, the Imperial Lords will have to abide by their promise and bestow me immense credit.
Meng Chuan had the highest bounty in the Demon Realm. His bounty far exceeded that of the other Creation Supremacies. Monarch Peacock was still looking forward to the Demon Ancestral Cave’s treasures. Suddenly, an invisible void fluctuation swept across Monarch Peacock, causing him to be alarmed. He turned his head and looked into the distance.
From afar, a human figure appeared. It was Meng Chuan.
“King Eastcalm.” Monarch Peacock grinned. “It’s been so many years, but you are still so timid. You always stay far away or hide in the deep void. When will you dare fight me head-on?”
“Monarch Peacock, I’ll do as you wish today,” said Meng Chuan as he rushed towards Monarch Peacock.
Monarch Peacock was alarmed by Meng Chuan’s actions.
All these years, Meng Chuan had always been cautious when facing Monarch Peacock. Meng Chuan had never gotten close to him.
Does this Meng Chuan have something he can rely on? Monarch Peacock watched Meng Chuan approach him warily.
Meng Chuan got closer and closer to him without showing any signs of abnormality.25 kilometers, 15 kilometers, 5 kilometers...
Meng Chuan was just 5 kilometers away from Monarch Peacock. Monarch Peacock was extremely confident about attacking at this distance. It’s now. Monarch Peacock attacked very decisively. He didn’t bother with pointless words. Instead, he thrust his spear at Meng Chuan with his full strength. This spear brought darkness along with it as it tore through the sky. The moment it struck, it pierced Meng Chuan’s chest—who was several kilometers away.
Boom!
The terrifying might penetrated Meng Chuan’s body, causing the aftershocks to spread for more than 50 kilometers. However, Meng Chuan’s body only trembled slightly as he continued smiling at Monarch Peacock.
It’s a fake? Monarch Peacock found it unbelievable. He had thrust his spear at Meng Chuan with his full strength, but he couldn’t see any flaws appear on the fake Meng Chuan.
The fake Meng Chuan continued smiling. “It’s
my turn.”
This fake Meng Chuan was a skill he had recently obtained after reaching the Grotto-Heaven realm’s late stage. Monarch Peacock naturally didn’t know about it.

chapters.title: Chapter 473 - Monarch Peacock’s Decision
chapters.content:
Chapter 473 Monarch Peacock’s Decision
Deep in the void.
Meng Chuan stood there and looked at what was happening outside. However, the scene of the outside world was distorted and blurry.
I have to take advantage of this opportunity to kill it in one fell swoop. If I miss this opportunity, it won’t give me another chance after my strength is exposed. Meng Chuan’s killing intent surged.
“Die!” Bloodblades immediately flew out from the Bloodblade Disc beneath his feet. A total of 24 Bloodblades flew out of the void. At the same time, countless lightning bolts erupted from the deep void to the outside world.
“Oh?” Monarch Peacock frowned. He looked at the lightning bolts that covered an area of more than 50 kilometers around him. The lightning bolts were extremely terrifying. Just a portion of the lightning bolts was enough to kill an ordinary demon sage. Monarch Peacock as he watched this scene. Has Meng Chuan obtained a domain-type treasure? Unfortunately for him, it doesn’t pose a threat to me at all.
This domain was Meng Chuan’s newly-created Electromagnetic Domain.
After he fused the Lightning Domain Form with the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique, Meng Chuan had created a domain technique.
Just like how the True Martial Seven Absolutes had a domain, Holy Lady Strings’s Strings Technique also had a domain. A complete ultimate technique typically formed its own system.
After reaching the Grotto-Heaven realm’s late stage, Meng Chuan’s Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique now had a domain. This domain used Meng Chuan’s original divine power-Divine Eye of Lightning’s electromagnetic domain as a model. He had also accumulated enough insights into the lightning lineage. After drawing upon the profundities of a Tribulation-level ultimate technique-Lightning Realm-he finally created the Electromagnetic Domain.
Forming lightning was one of the Electromagnetic Domain’s secondary functions. Its most important function was its electromagnetic force. Not good. Monarch Peacock jolted. Following his senses, he stabbed out with his spear. It happened to block a Bloodblade that appeared out of thin air.
The second, third, fourth strike...
Even more Bloodblades attacked Monarch Peacock. Sometimes, several Bloodblades would attack him simultaneously.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
Monarch Peacock stood in midair as the surrounding void distorted and collapsed.
An invisible force affected the Bloodblades whenever they came close to Monarch Peacock. Monarch Peacock wielded his spear extremely exquisitely. His spear drew out circles and sent the Bloodblades flying multiple times. However, each clash between his spear and the Bloodblades caused Monarch Peacock to be alarmed.
This Bloodblades are stronger than before, thought Monarch Peacock to himself. However, they still can’t threaten me.
Monarch Peacock put up an impregnable defense with his spear, but he still felt the pressure from being attacked by 24 Bloodblades. Although he felt pressured, his battle intent increased. If I fight this Meng Chuan a few more times, I might be able to reach the Grotto-Heaven realm’s late stage.
Suddenly Monarch Peacock’s expression changed. Oh? What happened? He could clearly sense that the Bloodblades flew towards him with increased speed and strength. Monarch Peacock couldn’t believe his eyes. How did they become faster?
Boom!
Monarch Peacock blocked two Bloodblades with his spear, but the terrifying impact caused him to stagger backward.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
A total of 24 Bloodblades accelerated within Meng Chuan’s Electromagnetic Domain. This new domain technique was very good at accelerating the Bloodblades. As long as a few Bloodblades worked together, they would suppress Monarch Peacock.
How is this possible? I’ve been suppressed? Monarch Peacock found the situation unbelievable. Every time he blocked the Bloodblades, he suffered a terrifying impact. Due to this, he had no choice but to use techniques that diverted force away.
However, it was useless! Not only had the Bloodblades increase in strength, but they moved much faster than before! Monarch Peacock was unable to defend against 24 Bloodblades with his spear alone.
Under the barrage of Bloodblade beams, Monarch Peacock barely managed to block a portion of the attacks before the other Bloodblades struck his body.
Bam!
A bloody hole appeared in his chest. Next, a large wound appeared on his arm. However, his body rapidly recovered from the injuries. The bigger wounds closed in the blink of an eye. In another blink of an eye, not a single scar was left.
It’s now! A cold glint flashed in Meng Chuan’s eyes. Silver runes appeared on both sides of his face. Silver bolts of lightning flashed around his body as the flow of time changed. To the outside world, Meng Chuan’s mind moved ten-fold faster than before.
Due to this, his control over the Bloodblades became even more exquisite and agile.
The agile Bloodblades stunned Monarch Peacock.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Monarch Peacock couldn’t hold on any longer. A large number of Bloodblades struck him simultaneously. Most of his body was pulverized, but his flesh and blood instantly fused back together.
The 24 Bloodblades arced through the air and attacked Monarch Peacock again. They blasted apart another portion of his body—which fused together again.
Not good. Monarch Peacock’s expression changed. He can affect my body’s vitality. He can probably annihilate my body completely after doing this 100 more times. While Monarch Peacock suffered under the Bloodblades, Meng Chuan gave his all. I have to seize the opportunity to kill this Monarch Peacock.
Although they didn’t have as much explosive strength as King True Martial’s Ten Absolutes of World Annihilation, the 24 Bloodbladesaffected by his Electromagnetic Domain and Flowing Sand—could unleash strength that far exceeded King True Martial’s normal. His Bloodblades’ strength also exceeded Monarch Peacock’s normal.
The Bloodblades could destroy most of Monarch Peacock’s body with a single strike. Meng Chuan has strength comparable to Qin Wu and Li Guan. Qin Wu’s only had two advantages over Meng Chuan-his Grotto-Heaven Quintessential Essence and Grotto-Heaven domain.
Once Meng Chuan possessed Grotto-Heaven Quintessential Essence and a Grotto-Heaven domain, as the creator of the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique, his combat strength would be greater than that of Qin Wu, Li Guan, and Bai Yaoyue.
An ultimate technique created for oneself was generally much stronger. Boom! Boom! Boom!
Many Bloodblades simultaneously attacked Monarch Peacock repeatedly.
This made Monarch Peacock panic.
This place is at the edge of the fractured world. It’s very far from a connection point.Monarch Peacock won’t be able to return to the Demon Realm in a short period of time. It can only suffer my attacks. This time, it’s going to die.
Meng Chuan maintained his divine power as he fully concentrated on controlling the Bloodblades to the best of his ability.
frenziedly. Due to their agile movements, Monarch Peacock could only take the beating as his injuries worsened. This place is more than 2,500 kilometers away from the connection point to the Demon Realm. There’s no time to escape. Monarch Peacock was completely suppressed. The large number of Bloodblades constantly aggravated his injuries, allowing him to sense his approaching death. This made Monarch Peacock panic even more.
All these years, Meng Chuan was the only expert at the fifth Firmament (Seamless realm) who could make him sense the threat of death.
“Die.” Meng Chuan didn’t hold back. He struck his opponent’s body with his full strength, hoping to reduce Monarch Peacock to dust.
Boom!
Monarch Peacock gritted his teeth and charged towards the right.
“What?” Meng Chuan was astonished by Monarch Peacock’s actions.
The edge of the world was on their right. This was where the fractured world continued to extend very slowly. The outer realm was on the other side of the World Gap!
This place was pure darkness. Sometimes purple lightning tore through the darkness in certain areas, promoting the growth of the World Gap.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
They were too close to the edge of the world. Although the 24 Bloodblades struck Monarch Peacock’s body three more times, Monarch Peacock still managed to charge into the endless darkness.
It went into the outer realm? Meng Chuan surfaced from the deep void and looked at the endless darkness.
“Ah.” After charging into the endless darkness and entering the outer realm, Monarch Peacock let out a shrill cry as his body convulsed.
Legend has it that if one isn’t a Creation Supremacy or a demon sage, they will definitely die if they enter the outer realm. Upon seeing Monarch Peacock entering the outer realm, Meng Chuan thought to himself, Only if special situations occur can one survive in the outer realm as a fifth Firmament demon monarch (Regis Godfiend).The outer realm’s environment was very vile. Ordinary Regis Godfiends and fifth Firmament demon monarchs would die very quickly upon entry. Meng Chuan stared at Monarch Peacock-who was in the endless darkness.
“Hahaha, hahaha...” The convulsing Monarch Peacock suddenly laughed. He gradually regained control of his body. He then grinned and looked at Meng Chuan. “Meng Chuan, you are ruthless enough to force me into the outer realm! Haha... Thankfully, I have a strong body and the Dark Peacock bloodline. I can survive in the outer realm’s environment.”
Monarch Peacock turned his head and looked at the endless darkness. His eyes burned with ambition. “If you hadn’t forced me, I wouldn’t have dared to enter the outer realm. My body contains the Dark Peacock bloodline. A Dark Peacock is a creature that roams the River of Spacetime. I should have been roaming the outer realm.
“I still have over 50 more years to live.” Monarch Peacock looked at the endless darkness before glancing at Meng Chuan. “In the last few decades of my life, I’m going to travel the outer realm. I still have to thank you. If it weren’t for you, I wouldn’t have dared to enter the outer realm.” Monarch Peacock laughed happily.
Swoosh.
He transformed into a beam of light and rapidly flew into the endless darkness’s depths. Soon, he disappeared from Meng Chuan’s vision.
Meng Chuan stared blankly at this scene.
It left? The other party has gone into the outer realm?

chapters.title: Chapter 474 - Rift
chapters.content:
Chapter 474 Rift
Monarch Peacock had completely vanished into the endless darkness. However, Meng Chuan continued staring at the endless darkness. Thoughts surfaced in his mind. Outer realm? When will I be able to enter the outer realm?
Ancestral Master Archean Eon entered the outer realm when he was a Creation Supremacy. After countless encounters, he cultivated until he became a Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence and completely changed the human world.
There are too many things in the outer realm. There are countless cultivation opportunities similar to the ones in the World Gap. Records show that it’s almost impossible to become an Imperial Lord if one doesn’t enter the outer realm to hone themselves.
Meng Chuan understood what the records were trying to say. Although cultivation talent was important, fortuitous encounters were just as important. If Meng Chuan hadn’t come to the World Gap to observe the purple lightning, his growth would’ve been much slower.
After one went to the outer realm, they would see things thousands of times more inconceivable than the purple lightning. After experiencing different sorts of cultivation opportunities, one would be able to go even further on their cultivation path. The human world’s Creation Supremacies also know that they can go further if they adventure in the outer realm. However, in the past 800 years, Master and company have been staying in our homeworld silently to protect it. Meng Chuan sighed. On the one hand, the Creation Supremacies guarded their homeworld quietly. On the other hand, they would be pursued by demons if they went to the outer realm.
Meng Chuan had to admit that he had a slight impulse when he saw Monarch Peacock leave the World Gap to roam the outer realm.
He wanted to roam the outer realm and broaden his horizons. However, humanity currently faced a dire situation, so he couldn’t just abandon his duties here.
I’m not even a Creation Supremacy. I’m overthinking things. Meng Chuan let out a self-deprecating laugh before flying away.
The Demon Realm, Ice Palace. “Congratulations, Brother Roc. You have finally reached the perfected Heaven Earth realm after cultivating for 7,000 years.” Imperial Lord Starquix raised his cup with a smile.
“There’s finally a chance of a demon Tribulation Eminence being born in our generation,” said Lady Blackmoon with a smile. “When the time comes, you will have to take care of Starquix and me.”
Emperor Roc sat at the seat of honor with a rare smile on his face. He was already famous to begin with. He was the most famous of the Demon Realm’s three Imperial lords. Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon were still at the Heaven Earth realm’s middle stage. Originally, Emperor Roc was just one step faster than them—Heaven Earth realm’s late stage. There hadn’t been an exaggerated difference between them.
No, his fame was mainly a result of his special bloodline. It made Emperor Roc’s combat prowess extremely terrifying.
“Hahaha, we are all from the Demon Realm, so we naturally have to support each other,” said Emperor Roc with a laugh. Following that, he sighed. “It’s been 7,000 years. My other avatar has encountered all sorts of opportunities while roaming the outer realm. He has also experienced many battles. He has finally reached the perfected Heaven Earth realm. There’s a chance for him to cultivate his body to perfection.”
“If you perfect your body, you can enter the Tribulation realm,” said Imperial Lord Starquix immediately.
“Even at the perfected Heaven Earth realm, it’s not easy to perfect the body,” said Emperor Roc. “In Archean Eon Realm, many have reached the perfected Heaven Earth realm. However, only Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s body reached perfection, allowing him to become a Physical Body Tribulation Eminence. Nobody else managed the feat.”
“That’s because there are flaws in Archean Eon Realm’s cultivation system,” said Lady Blackmoon with disdain. “Although the Godfiend cultivation system gives one strong Quintessential Essence, it’s not very good at refining one’s body. Only a Samsara Divine Body expert has a chance of perfecting their body. Us demons are different. We value our bodies more. Over the generations, many people have reached the Tribulation realm using our cultivation system.”
Imperial Lord Starquix nodded and said immediately, “Brother Roc, you will definitely reach the Tribulation realm.”
Lady Blackmoon and Imperial Lord Starquix were trying to curry favor.
Emperor Roc was currently at the perfected Heaven Earth realm. With his bloodline, his explosive combat strength was comparable to that of a First or Second Tribulation Eminence. His status in the surrounding outer realm regions would increase greatly as well.
