Emperor Roc would only help them if they maintained a good relationship with him. If they were to offend Emperor Roc, there was a chance of him killing them. After all, there had been demon Imperial Lords that killed each other in history.
“There’s still hope for the two of you to reach the Tribulation realm,” said Emperor Roc with a smile. “Your hopes lie in Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasure trove.”
Imperial Lord Starquix’s and Blackmoon’s eyes lit up as they nodded. “If I want to go further down the Tribulation realm path, I also need his inheritance. Therefore, we have to obtain it,” said Emperor Roc.
“We will definitely do our best,” said Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon.
Huh? Imperial Lord Starquix suddenly sensed something and looked into the distance. “That peacock left the World Gap and entered the outer realm. Furthermore, it’s quickly leaving the Demon Realm’s vicinity.”
“It went to the outer realm?” Blackmoon couldn’t help but say, “It brought the Tribulation treasure that we bestowed it into the outer realm to adventure? Starquix, you are the most accurate at sensing karma. Hurry up and capture it. That peacock is still very useful in the war with the humans.”
“I don’t think it’s suitable to capture it,” said Imperial Lord Starquix with a frown.
“There’s no need to capture it.” Emperor Roc added, “That peacock only has 50-plus years left to live. It’s fearless. If it wants to roam the outer realm, let it do as it pleases. Once we need this peacock for the war... it won’t be too late to bring it back. By then, the peacock will have to accept our gratitude.”
Lady Blackmoon nodded. “That’s true. If we capture it now, it will probably be filled with hatred. It could spoil our plans at a critical moment.”
“Furthermore, that tiny peacock hasn’t become a demon sage. It probably won’t be able to travel through the River of Spacetime,” said Emperor Roc with a smile. “Even if it can travel through the River of Spacetime with its special bloodline, its speed will be ridiculously slow... How far can it run? Furthermore, it has lacking speed. It won’t be able to escape the Three Bay River System, even if it traveled for 10,000 years. I only need half a month to cross the entire Three Bay River System,” said Emperor Roc confidently.
“Brother Roc’s speed is indeed impressive. Even if I traveled at full speed, it would take me ten years to cross the Three Bay River System in the River of Spacetime,” said Imperial Lord Starquix. The Three Bay River System was the name of this particular region in the River of Spacetime. Archean Eon Realm and the Demon Realm were inside the Three Bay River System.
It covered an extremely vast area.
In the World Gap.
A table and chair stood upon the vast dark-red ground. Meng Chuan sat on the chair and glanced at the purple lightning as he painted.
He was painting the purple lightning for the fifth time.
When he was at the Grotto-Heaven realm’s early stage, Meng Chuan had painted the purple lightning for the third time when he had free time. It had taken him 73 days of careful painting to finish the third set of paintings. After reaching the Grotto-Heaven realm, he had a deeper understanding of the purple lightning.
When he was at the Grotto-Heaven realm’s middle stage, Meng Chuan had completed the fourth set of paintings in just 33 days. Since his technique realm didn’t improve much, he didn’t gain many insights from studying the purple lightning the fourth time. Therefore, he finished the fourth set of paintings much faster.
He was now painting the purple lightning for the fifth time.
This time, he finished painting after 28 days. Alright. Meng Chuan waved his hand and put away the paintings. He also put away the table, chair, brush, and ink.
I’ll try cultivating the Infinite Saber again. The five sets of paintings—which all depicted the purple lightning’s different aspects-made Meng Chuan even more expectant about the Infinite Saber’s future direction.
He immediately swung his saber.
Whoosh. Whoosh. Whoosh.
He swung the unsheathed Demon Slayer and slashed out multiple dazzling saber beams, his eyes analyzing them one by one. Although the saber beams didn’t seem fast, they caused the void to distort slightly. These saber beams affected the flow of time slightly, producing afterimages as they traveled.
He kept sheathing and drawing his saber for ten consecutive days.
It still isn’t working. Meng Chuan was somewhat vexed. I can clearly sense that this is the correct direction. Flash Form of Lightning is Infinite Saber’s core. I will further improve Infinite Saber by having the Yin-Yang Form of Lightning and Wave Splitting Forms of Lightning complement it. Once all three aspects merge, Infinite Saber will undergo a qualitative transformation.
The Bloodblade Disc and Three World Saber prove that this direction is correct. So why can’t I create this move?
He had already accumulated enough insights into the lightning lineage. After all, his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique had already reached the Grotto-Heaven realm’s late stage. After spending many years studying the purple lightning, his insights towards the lightning lineage grew more profound each time.
However, he was still unable to figure out how he should combine the three different aspects of lightning. Fusing ordinary aspects together were meaningless. He had to break free of the worldly law’s suppression if he wanted to improve his Infinite Saber.
How can I make my Infinite Saber break through? Meng Chuan was very vexed by this conundrum. It was like there was a wall in front of him. He could touch the wall, but he couldn’t break it.
This wall blocked all the experts in human history! Nobody in the Archean Eon Realm had ever created their own paramount techniques.
Even in the endless River of Spacetime, one would be the strongest amongst peers of the same level if they had a paramount technique. The birth of a new paramount technique was extremely rare, even in the vast River of Spacetime.
It’s really not easy to create a paramount technique. Meng Chuan shook his head slightly. Perhaps I’ll have to follow my Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique’s path in the future.
Meng Chuan began cultivating the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique again.
Great Zhou Dynasty, Snow Wind Pass.
Although Snow Wind Pass was very cold, it was still a bustling city. After all, over ten million people lived here.
Afternoon at the inner city pass, 5th October.
The massive World Entrance—that was four kilometers wide—was still there. Through the huge World Entrance, one could clearly see the vast Demon Realm’s scenery.
At this moment, the human world and the Demon Realm approached each other slowly, causing some changes to occur in Snow Wind Pass.
The huge World Entrance—which was four kilometers wide— trembled slightly and distorted.
Rip!
A World Entrance—more than ten kilometers wide-ripped apart the previous World Entrance.
The guards standing at the inner city wall were completely stunned when they saw this. Although they stood on top of the inner city walls, they couldn’t see both ends of the World Entrance. All of the soldiers’ legs instinctively went weak as their hearts trembled with fear.

chapters.title: Chapter 475 - Rescue
chapters.content:
Chapter 475 Rescue
Apart from the mortal soldiers, five Godfiends usually guarded the inner city pass.
“What?” The five Godfiends standing on the city wall saw the World Entrance widen from 4 kilometers to 10 kilometers. They couldn’t help but be dumbfounded.
“It’s about 13 kilometers wide; it’s a super-large World Entrance!”
“Super-large World Entrance!”
“This is bad!” The expressions of the five Godfiends changed drastically. They simultaneously sent out life-and-death help requests—the most urgent-through their tokens.
The demons placed as much importance on large World Entrances as humans did. Currently, dozens of fourth Firmament demon monarchs and several fifth Firmament demon monarchs were stationed at every large World Entrance.
The demons guarded these large World Entrances perpetually. Although these large World Entrances only allowed entry to fourth Firmament demon monarchs and below, several fifth Firmament demon monarchs guarded each one.
According to past experiences, they knew that a large World Entrance could expand, becoming a super-large World Entrance. Once it expanded, launching an attack immediately would give rise to the best results.
This had happened to the city pass that King Yanshui guarded-Yanshui Pass. Many fifth Firmament demon monarchs had attacked the city pass due to the World Entrance’s sudden expansion. Although King Yanshui killed nine fifth Firmament demon monarchs and dozens of fourth Firmament demon monarchs one after another, he still lost his life.
Back then, Yanshui Pass had been reduced to ruins. The battle had connected Yanshui Lake to the East Sea. The terrain 500 kilometers around Yanshui Pass had also changed dramatically due to the battle. After this battle, humanity rebuilt the city pass, making it even bigger than before. It was then named Luo Tang Pass.
“A super-large city pass has appeared?” The Demon Realm’s inhabitants were in an uproar. Many demons and demon monarchs appeared and stared at the entrance with burning eyes.
Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish!
The fifth Firmament demon monarchs-who were in charge of guarding the area-appeared and stared at the massive World Entrance that was over ten kilometers wide. Five fifth Firmament demon monarchs exchanged looks.
“Our luck is really not bad. Great luck has befallen us. We’re going to earn a lot of credits.”
“There are more than ten million humans in Snow Wind Pass. Every dead human is 100 credits.”
“One billion credits are right in front of us.”
The fifth Firmament demon monarchs exchanged looks. As they requested for reinforcements, they immediately charged into the World Entrance. Now that the World Entrance had expanded, it was unable to stop them from entering. “All of you wait here,” instructed the fifth Firmament demon monarchs as they charged in. They didn’t want the other demons to interfere.
Snow Wind Pass’s guardian Godfiend was none other than Liu Qiyue.
Liu Qiyue’s residence was just slightly more than 1.5 kilometers away from the inner city pass.
The World Entrance’s expansion was a tiny split in the world membrane, so the commotion was very small. It was a much smaller commotion than when one attacked the world membrane with their full strength. Even Creation Supremacies wouldn’t be able to sense the expansion of a World Entrance if they were slightly further away.
Luckily, Liu Qiyue lived close enough to sense the commotion. She could sense the changes in the void a few kilometers away.
Swoosh.
Liu Qiyue—who had been writing in a courtyard study—had a drastic change in expression. She used Phoenix Flight and arrived at the inner city wall in a second.
She immediately saw a huge World Entrance that was over 10 kilometers wide.
A super-large World Entrance? Liu Qiyue’s heart tightened. According to what she knew, the other five super-large World Entrances in the world were over 10 kilometers wide. The largest super-large World Entrance was in the Black Sand Dynasty; it had a width of 18.5 kilometers.
Request for reinforcements! With a thought, Liu Qiyue sent out a life-and-death help request-showing that the situation was urgent—through the token.
The moment Liu Qiyue sent out the help request, she saw five figures instantly fly out from the massive World Entrance. The five figures were either skinny, massive, or sinister. They were all fifth Firmament demon monarchs! The skinny figure in the lead emitted an extremely terrifying fiery aura. It was much more terrifying than Liu Qiyue’s aura.
“Kill!” The moment the five evil figures charged out, they attacked!
Boom!
Soaring crimson flames burst out from the skinny figure in the lead. The raging flames instantly covered half the sky as it swept towards the inner city pass. The flames even enveloped the entire Snow Wind Pass.
In the past, dozens of fifth Firmament demon monarchs underwent life modifications for the battle in the World Gap! The skinny figure was one such case.
“Suppress!” Liu Qiyue stood still as a phoenix phenomenon condensed behind her. She tried to control the flames that blotted out the sky.
Liu Qiyue was a rather powerful Godfiend. She had guarded Snow Wind Pass for nearly 40 years, gaining insights into the fire lineage during her free time. Due to these insights, she broke through from the top Regis Godfiend realm to the peak Regis Godfiend realm. However, the moment she tried, she understood that she was unable to suppress the terrifying flames.
She realized that these flames were not just some sort of mutated flames.
The Demon Realm had arranged for these five fifth Firmament demon monarchs to form a team. They had cultivated together for a long time, learning how to create a formation. The five demon monarchs worked together to use the formation, casting various attacks.
Roar
A terrifying sound wave tore out from a stocky tiger demon’s mouth, forming a fan-shaped shockwave that spread towards Snow Wind
Pass.
Rip!
Tentacle after tentacle burrowed into the ground and rapidly tore towards Snow Wind Pass.
All sorts of techniques erupted.
I have no other choice. Liu Qiyue’s eyes were cold as she resolutely made up her mind.
Bang!!! Towering flames erupted from Liu Qiyue’s body. Using her Phoenix Feather Robe, she transformed into a 10,000-foot-tall flaming phoenix. The flaming phoenix let out a high-pitched cry that resounded throughout the nine heavens.
As a peak Regis Godfiend, Liu Qiyue’s strength rapidly soared to an unimaginable level once she cast Phoenix’s Nirvana.
In the World Gap.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged at the edge of the fractured world. His Bloodblades flew around him as he experimented with his moves.
King Calm Sea—who emitted an endless cold aura-sat beside him. He observed the forming world and cultivated diligently.
Huh? In the blink of an eye, Meng Chuan’s token received three summons. Meng Chuan’s eyes immediately flew open. Not good. Silver runes surfaced on his face as wisps of silver lightning appeared around him.
Three summons meant that somebody was in a life-and-death situation.
He had to rush over as quickly as possible.
Swoosh.
He stepped on the Bloodblade Disc and instantly vanished.
It looks like something major has happened. King Calm Sea turned his head and glanced at the spot Meng Chuan had vanished from before continuing his cultivation. He only had one mission-patrolling the World Gap.
Bang!!!
Meng Chuan stepped on the Bloodblade Disc and used his divine power, Flowing Sand. He was terrifyingly fast. In just two seconds, he arrived at the connection point more than 2,500 kilometers away from the fractured world!
Boom!
Six Bloodblades shot out ahead of time. They struck the connection point simultaneously.
The six Bloodblades pierced through the World Gap and the human world’s world membranes simultaneously, creating a large passageway. Meng Chuan instantly rushed in and returned to the human world.Although it took some time to describe, he had only taken three seconds to return to the human world after he received the help request.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan appeared on a mountain next to a city-Peace Nest City-in the middle of the Great Zhou Dynasty’s territory.
Since it was in the middle of the Great Zhou Dynasty, it wasn’t too far from any place within the Great Zhou Dynasty.
Trying to communicate between the World Gap and the human world was extremely difficult. Meng Chuan’s token could barely receive help requests across worlds. Because of this, he couldn’t determine the exact location the help request had originated from.
The moment Meng Chuan returned to the human world, the token notified him of the help request’s origins. What? Snow Wind Pass is in danger? Meng Chuan’s expression immediately changed.
Boom!
A lightning bolt rushed towards Snow Wind Pass-which was in the Great Zhou Dynasty’s northernmost region-at maximum speed.

chapters.title: Chapter 476 - Patriarch Poison Dragon’s Attack
chapters.content:
Chapter 476 Patriarch Poison Dragon’s Attack
The Demon Realm, in Ice Palace high in the sky.
The three Imperial Lords were discussing cultivation matters.
“Brother Roc, are you saying that I should spend more effort on the void lineage?” asked Imperial Lord Starquix.
“That’s right.” Emperor Roc nodded. “The perfected Heaven Earth realm. What does it mean by perfected? It’s a perfect fusion of many profundities, leaving no flaws. The void lineage’s profundities are relatively easy to combine. The difficulty of combining the time lineage and the space lineage’s profundities is much higher. “Starquix, the biggest reason for your stagnation is due to your lack of focus. You are also studying array formations and the karma lineage. What’s the point of learning so many different things? Could it be that you can combine all the different profundities perfectly?”
Imperial Lord Starquix fell deep in thought.
“That’s just my suggestion,” said Emperor Roc with a smile. “You decide what you should choose.”
“Emperor Roc, what about me? I’ve focused all my cultivation efforts on the void lineage. What should I change in my cultivation routine to improve?” asked Lady Blackmoon.
“Your case is a little complicated. I think you should try to create a large grotto-heaven now. Furthermore, this grotto-heaven...” Emperor Roc suddenly stopped and looked into the distance.
Huh? Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon also looked in the same direction.
After reaching the Heaven Earth realm, one became extremely sensitive to changes within the world.
The large World Entrance’s expansion had created a small commotion. Although it was difficult for Creation Supremacies to sense it from afar, the three demon Imperial Lords immediately sensed the expansion of Snow Wind Pass’s World Entrance. Imperial Lord Starquix’s eyes lit up in delight. “The sixth super-large World Entrance has appeared.”
“The human world only has nine Creation Supremacies.” Blackmoon was somewhat excited.
“Let’s go.” As Emperor Roc spoke, he waved his hand and grabbed Patriarch Poison Dragon from afar. Patriarch Poison Dragon-who had been cultivating in one of Ice Palace’s roomswas brought to Emperor Roc.
“Imperial Lord.” Patriarch Poison Dragon was somewhat stunned by the sudden change in scenery.
“Let’s go,” repeated Emperor Roc. He transformed into a golden light beam and carried the few figures out of Ice Palace instantly.
Boom!
The golden beam of light was unbelievably fast. Before one reached the Heaven Earth realm, the worldly laws restricted all living beings. Most Creation Supremacies would only be able to travel more than five kilometers in a second.
Once one reached the Heaven Earth realm, one would be able to withstand the worldly laws, no longer suppressed by them. Heaven Earth realm experts were able to unleash their maximum speed due to the lack of suppression. Therefore, Imperial Lords could typically travel thousands of kilometers in a second.
Emperor Roc—whose fame spread across many worlds-could travel 15,000 kilometers in a second after reaching the perfected Heaven Earth realm. Even when he carried Lady Blackmoon, Imperial Lord Starquix, and Patriarch Poison Dragon, he could still travel 10,000 kilometers in a second.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Imperial Lord Starquix affected the flow of time in the surrounding area. Since three Imperial Lords were currently within the affected region, it was extremely difficult for him to affect the flow of time drastically. Imperial Lord Starquix only made time flow eight times faster than the outside world.
Therefore, outsiders would see Emperor Roc and the others—who were within the golden light beam-traveling over 50,000 kilometers per second.
Although the Demon Realm was much larger than the human world, it was only slightly more than 65,000 kilometers from Ice Palace to Snow Wind Pass’s World Entrance. Therefore, they virtually arrived at the entrance instantaneously. “We’re here.” Emperor Roc, Lady Blackmoon, and Imperial Lord Starquix looked at the World Entrance that was over 10 kilometers wide.
Patriarch Poison Dragon was somewhat dumbfounded as he stood beside them. We were in Ice Palace just a moment ago. How did we arrive at Rotten Cypress Mountain in the blink of an eye? This speed is truly terrifying! It’s no wonder the demon sages are obedient, not daring to disobey the three Imperial Lords.
At this moment
Boom!
Four figures flew out of the World Entrance, returning to the Demon Realm. They were all fifth Firmament demon monarchs. These four demon monarchs were in sorry states; they even seemed somewhat horrified. “I never thought Liu Qiyue would be so strong after casting Phoenix’s Nirvana. Despite undergoing a life modification process, I still can’t resist her strength at all.” The skinny firefox demon monarch was somewhat alarmed.
“She’s too strong. If we were any slower, we would have been burned to death.”
“Her strength is probably comparable to Holy Lady Strings or Monarch Peacock.”
The four demon monarchs—who had fled from the human world—were somewhat terrified of Liu Qiyue’s strength.
Without hesitating, the five Firmament demon monarchs had attacked Snow Wind Pass together. However, who would’ve thought that Liu Qiyue would instantly wreck their teamwork after casting Phoenix’s Nirvana?
The firefox demon monarch—who had undergone a life modification process—could withstand about ten moves from a top Creation realm expert. However, he had immediately fled once he discovered Liu Qiyue’s terrifying flames. He didn’t even care about his companions. “We were just standing in front of the entrance. We fled immediately, but one of us still died.”
“Too powerful.”
The four of them had quickly escaped through the World Entrance and returned to the Demon Realm. Only then did they discover the three Imperial Lords and Patriarch Poison Dragon.
“Go, destroy Snow Wind Pass,” ordered Emperor Roc.
“Yes.”
As the four demon monarchs returned to the Demon Realm, Patriarch Poison Dragon charged into the World Entrance.
He was truly fearless. Even if Qin Wu and Li Guan attacked him while he was in the human world, they couldn’t kill him directly. They had to think of a way to trap him first before thinking of ways to kill him.
With the World Entrance behind me, even Qin Wu and Li Guan can’t trap me in the human world. Patriarch Poison Dragon was naturally confident.
After noticing the three Imperial Lords, the four fifth Firmament demon monarchs—who had fled from the human world—bowed respectfully. “Imperial Lords.”
Imperial Lord Starquix waved his hand, and the four demon monarchs retreated to the side in sorry states.
Through the super-large World Entrancewhich was over ten kilometers wide—the three Imperial Lords stared at Snow Wind Pass.
Snow Wind Pass.
Liu Qiyue stood in midair as her dazzling flames soared into the sky. She had used her full strength to kill a fifth Firmament demon monarch instantly. The other four fifth demon monarchs had managed to flee.
“Oh?” Before she could relax, Liu Qiyue instantly discovered a figure rushing through the World Entrance. It was a black-robed, dragon-headed elder.
It’s—! Liu Qiyue’s heart jolted. It’s Patriarch Poison Dragon? The black-robed, dragon-headed elder grinned at Liu Qiyue.
Whoosh.
His body instantly transformed into boundless black water. The black water constantly filled the World Entrance and spread to the sky. In an instant, the black water covered a 50-kilometer radius.
The black water spread in all directions extremely quickly. It was about to envelop the entire Snow Wind Pass. At the same time, poison emanated from the black water. Not good. Liu Qiyue realized that if she didn’t stop him, over ten million people in Snow Wind Pass would die in seconds. After being nurtured by the three Imperial Lords, Patriarch Poison Dragon’s poison was enough to kill weaker demon sages, much less mortals.
Boom!
Liu Qiyue instantly unleashed her flames without restraint.
The flames spread in all directions; they spread at speeds no slower than the black water.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
The phoenix flames constantly clashed with the black water, causing the black water to evaporate and turn into a black gas. However, the black gases quickly condensed back into black water. The black water didn’t lose any strength even when it changed between two physical states.
Although the black water didn’t lose any strength, the phoenix flames held the advantage when the two clashed.
Liu Qiyue’s phoenix flames protected the inner city pass as it quickly enveloped the entire Snow Wind Pass. Even underground, a wall of phoenix flames blocked the black water from invading Snow Wind Pass any further.
From city wall to city wall, Snow Wind Pass spanned 75 kilometers. Over ten million people inhabited this large city.
It was very difficult for Liu Qiyue to unleash so much phoenix flames at once. Patriarch Poison Dragon’s black water could extend for hundreds of kilometers. She knew that she had to protect the city completely. Otherwise, the black water would flood Snow Wind Pass, killing all weak living beings that it touched.

chapters.title: Chapter 477 - Choice
chapters.content:
Chapter 477 Choice
The three Imperial Lords watched what was happening in Snow Wind Pass from the other side of the World Entrance.
“Liu Qiyue cast Phoenix’s Nirvana, and has unleashed her phoenix flames without restraint?” When Lady Blackmoon saw this scene, she sent a voice transmission. “Her phoenix flames are protecting Snow Wind Pass, which spans 75 kilometers. She is using an extremely astonishing amount of phoenix flames.”
“That’s right.” Imperial Lord Starquix nodded and sent a voice transmission. “With such a crazy eruption of strength, she will burn her lifespan several times faster than normal.”
During Phoenix’s Nirvana, if one didn’t do anything, the energy expenditure would be minimal. There would be minimal burden on one’s body. It consumed one’s lifespan at a low rate.
If one were to use a massive amount of phoenix flames to protect a massive city-like what Liu Qiyue was currently doing-one’s lifespan would be consumed several times faster than normal.
“She’s going all out just to save over ten million mortals?” Emperor Roc was surprised by her actions, causing him to laugh. “I’m somewhat impressed by this girl.”
“She’s still Meng Chuan’s wife,” said Lady Blackmoon. “Meng Chuan has ruined many of our plans.”
“I’ve read the intelligence on them. Meng Chuan and his wife, Liu Qiyue, were childhood sweethearts. They cultivated together on Archean Mountain and left the mountain together. The relationship between this husband-wife duo is very deep,” said Imperial Lord Starquix via voice transmission. “I’m wondering if Meng Chuan’s personality will change drastically after Liu Qiyue dies to save these mortals. Will his cultivation come to a halt?”
“Back then, King True Martial sank to a nadir because of love.” Emperor Roc smiled and nodded. “However, Meng Chuan rose to prominence much faster than King True Martial. He probably won’t sink into oblivion easily.”
“If he does sink into oblivion, it will be an unexpected gain,” said Lady Blackmoon laughingly via voice transmission.
As Liu Qiyue used her phoenix flames to protect the entire Snow Wind Pass, she drew her bow and shot arrows at the black water.
Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!
She could increase her offensive power by using the arrows.
Her arrows tore through the churning black water, arcing within it. The arrows parted the black water completely. However, the vast black water didn’t suffer any damage.
After casting Phoenix’s Nirvana, Liu Qiyue’s peak Regis Godfiend strength rose to the peak Creation realm. Her arrows had the strength of a threshold Imperial Lord. Every arrow was slightly stronger than Monarch Peacock’s full strength. However, they couldn’t injure Patriarch Poison Dragon at all.
Ah Chuan told me that Patriarch Poison Dragon’s strength increased greatly after the three Imperial Lords nurtured it. It’s undying body practically makes it an unkillable fifth Firmament demon monarch. I can’t do anything to its body. Liu Qiyue understood this when she saw Patriarch Poison Dragon appear. I’m consuming my lifespan too quickly because my phoenix flames are spread across a 100-kilometer radius.
I have to suppress Patriarch Poison Dragon. With a thought, Liu Qiyue immediately attempted to suppress the black water with a large amount of phoenix flames.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The vast Blackwater Body suddenly separated into nine black dragons. Every black dragon was 15 to 20 kilometers long. The black dragons could be seen in Snow Wind Pass’s northern, southern, eastern, and western regions. Some flew in the sky, while some were underground.
A portion of the black water clung to the World Entrance tightly, while another portion coiled around it.
The nine black dragons roared.
No matter how the phoenix flames suppressed them, the nine black dragons remained completely unharmed.
“What’s wrong?”
“What’s happening in the sky?”.
Snow Wind Pass’s countless residents saw golden flames filling the sky. The flames covered everything in the city. Through the flames, one could barely see the churning black water beyond. Soon, the black water transformed into massive black dragons!
Several massive black dragons swam in the sky.
The residents watched everything in horror. “Are ten million mortals really worth you consuming so much of your lifespan? Patriarch Poison Dragon’s voice resounded across the city as he watched Liu Qiyu leisurely.
By massacring Snow Wind Pass’s populationwhich was over ten million-he would gain over a billion credits. Liu Qiyue’s life was of equal worth. Since Liu Qiyue was Meng Chuan’s wife and a Regis Godfiend with a phoenix bloodline, the demons had placed a massive bounty on her-her life was worth one billion credits.
“Is it worth it?” Liu Qiyue didn’t hesitate to protect Snow Wind Pass. When she had first left the mountain with her husband, they had risked their lives at North River Pass. Back then, Godfiends had died in battle.
When she and her husband lived incognito at Gu Mountain Prefecture, they had worked together to kill demon monarchs. They had protected many county cities and prefecture cities during their stay at Gu Mountain Prefecture. During that time, she had also seen many Godfiends die in battle.
Later, when she was in charge of guarding a city, she saw Marquis Godfiends—who were guarding the city-also dying in battle.
The couple had lived to this day, but many of their companions had fallen.
Her fallen companions had sacrificed their lives to fend off the demons and protect the mortals. How could Liu Qiyue retreat?
Boom!
Due to the fact that her phoenix flames had spread across nearly 100 kilometers, Liu Qiyue burned her lifespan at an insane rate. Due to Phoenix’s Nirvana, Liu Qiyue’s body, Essence Soul, and technique realm improved very quickly. Insights into the fire lineage constantly surged into her mind. Liu Qiyue was already a peak Regis Godfiend. With the numerous insights she was gaining, she finally stepped into the Grotto-Heaven realm completely. When under Phoenix’s Nirvana, one experienced no bottleneck during a breakthrough. This was because insights constantly surged into one’s mind when under Phoenix’s Nirvana.
Due to this, Liu Qiyue stepped straight into the Grotto-Heaven realm with the fire lineage. The moment she reached the Grotto-Heaven realm, she naturally gained better control over the phoenix bloodline in her body. As Liu Qiyue controlled her phoenix bloodline’s power more exquisitely, her body transformed rapidly. Her bones turned crystalline, becoming much tougher than before. At the same time, a faint red glow appeared around her body as fiery-red runes appeared between her eyebrows.
Snow Wind Pass is in danger. On the Bloodblade Disc, Meng Chuan maintained his divine power-Flowing Sandas he rushed towards Snow Wind Pass at full speed.
I take nine seconds to reach Snow Wind Pass from the World Gap. Meng Chuan was very anxious. The only thing he could currently do was comfort himself as he rushed to Liu Qiyue. Qiyue is a peak Regis Godfiend. Once she casts Phoenix’s Nirvana, she should be able to deal with all dangers. Nothing serious can happen to her in nine seconds.
Quick, quick, quick. I must get there faster. Meng Chuan kept trying to calm himself, but he remained worried about his wife because he didn’t know what had happened at Snow Wind Pass. He only knew that Snow Wind Pass had sent a life-and-death help request.
Boom.
Snow Wind Pass appeared in front of him.
Meng Chuan immediately saw everything
Massive black dragons-15 to 20 kilometers long-coiled around Snow Wind Pass. The boundless phoenix flames spread in every direction, protecting Snow Wind Pass heavily. Liu Qiyue—the source of the phoenix flamesstood in midair as she blocked the black water.
Whoosh.
All the phoenix flames dissipated as their energy returned to the world.
Huh? Patriarch Poison Dragon was astonished to see all the phoenix flames dissipate. She isn’t protecting the mortals any longer? He looked at Liu Qiyue.
Liu Qiyue was bathed in flames.She was like a fire god as she drew her bow and shot an arrow.
Swoosh.
Golden flames—which seemed sentientinstantly shot towards one of the black dragons. The black dragon didn’t even have time to dodge before it was hit by the arrow.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
The arrow pierced the black dragon, and all nine black dragons erupted in golden flames simultaneously.
“Ah-” All nine black dragons let out painful wails at the same time. Their wails echoed throughout the world, and the black water naturally dissipated.
The remaining black water rushed into the World Entrance and fled back to the Demon Realm. At the same time, a roar could be heard from the stream of black water. “Imperial Lords, save me! Please save me, Imperial Lords!”
“What?” The three Imperial Lords on the other side of the World Entrance were somewhat shocked when they saw what happened.
Emperor Roc was alarmed by the golden flames. “Undying Phoenix’s divine fire?”
“Undying Divine Fire?”
Legend had it that it was nearly impossible to extinguish a phoenix’s flame once touched by
“Save me-” The black water stream completely vanished when it was midway through the World Entrance.
The black water was burned to nothingness.
Patriarch Poison Dragon died.
Whoosh.
A weapon and treasures fell to the ground. A dark-cyan bead landed in the World Entrance.
Whoosh.
Liu Qiyue waved her hand, and the treasures flew towards her.
“Qiyue.” Meng Chuan flew in front of Liu Qiyue.
Liu Qiyue made the flames on her body converge as she smiled at Meng Chuan.

chapters.title: Chapter 478 - Growing Old Together
chapters.content:
Chapter 478 Growing Old Together
The three Imperial Lords watched this scene through the World Entrance angrily.
How could they not be angry when they lost a key general, Patriarch Poison Dragon, and a Tribulation treasure—the Water Essence Pearl?
“There’s nothing that can be done when facing the Undying Divine Fire,” said Imperial Lord Starquix.
Lady Blackmoon sneered. “That Liu Qiyue is also stupid. She consumed so much of her lifespan just to save the mortals.”
“World Entrances are increasing in number. The day when the humans can’t defend all of them is the day we win,” said Emperor Roc calmly. “Let’s go.”
The three Imperial Lords transformed into streaks of light and left.
The human world.
Meng Chuan flew to his wife and looked at her concernedly.
“Ah Chuan.” Liu Qiyue smiled at Meng Chuan. The flames converged, revealing her current appearance. Her long hair was snow-white, and there were some wrinkles on her face. Meng Chuan looked at his wife, his heart aching.
“There’s nothing else I could’ve done,” said Liu Qiyue helplessly. “Maintaining Phoenix’s Nirvana for nine seconds should have only consumed about 60 years of my lifespan. However, Patriarch Poison Dragon’s Blackwater Body can reach over hundreds of kilometers. I had to protect Snow Wind Pass. After all, over ten million people live here. Therefore, I utilized a large amount of phoenix flames to protect a 100-kilometer-wide area. Due to this, I burned my lifespan several times faster than normal.”
Liu Qiyue looked at her husband and smiled. “However, I don’t regret it because I saved over ten million people. I only had to consume a portion of my lifespan to protect them.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “I understand.” They had been together for many years, so he naturally understood his wife.
When faced with such a situation, he knew that his wife wouldn’t hesitate to consume a portion of her lifespan to save over ten million people. It was the same for the many Godfiends that had died in battle. They, too, had not hesitated to sacrifice themselves.
“I managed to protect Snow Wind Pass and even killed Patriarch Poison Dragon,” said Liu Qiyue with a smile. “A living Patriarch Poison Dragon is a scourge to humanity. Furthermore, I obtained a Tribulation treasure.” With a flip of her palm, a mysterious dark-cyan bead-the Water Essence Pearl-appeared in her hand.
“Apart from you, Qiyue, nobody in the human world can kill Patriarch Poison Dragon head-on,” said Meng Chuan as he looked at his wife.
Liu Qiyue smiled as she glanced at her husband worriedly. “Will you think less of me now that I’ve grown old?”
In the past, Liu Qiyue maintained a very youthful appearance. She looked like she was 20 years old. Meng Chuan had maintained his youthful appearance as well. However, Liu Qiyue’s long hair was now snow-white, and her face had some wrinkles. She looked like she was in her thirties or forties.
“I can still live for 53 years. I can barely control my appearance. As I near the end of my lifespan, I’ll look older and older,” said Liu Qiyue softly. She looked up at Meng Chuan. “You—”
Liu Qiyue stared at her husband dazedly.
Her husband’s long hair was also white, and a few wrinkles appeared on his face. He looked like he was in his thirties or forties. Liu Qiyue only had such an appearance because of her waning lifespan, but Meng Chuan had taken the initiative to look this way by controlling his body.
Meng Chuan smiled at his wife. “I’ll grow old together with you.”
Liu Qiyue hugged Meng Chuan tightly.
Above the inner city pass, invisible ripples spread out. The surrounding guards and Godfiends couldn’t see them.
Inside Meng Chuan and his wife’s residence.
The couple sat on a bench in the corridor. Liu Qiyue leaned on her husband and smiled. “Ah Chuan, do you think we’ll grow old together?”
“Yes, of course.” Meng Chuan nodded. “We grew up together. It’s been almost 100 years, and our hair has turned white together. We have definitely grown old together.”
“The heavens have really treated me well.” Liu Qiyue hugged her husband’s arm and watched the fluttering snowflakes in the sky. “I have a pair of outstanding children, a good husband, and we’ve been together for nearly a century. Many mortals don’t even live 100 years... This year, you’re 98 years old. I’m 97 years old.”
Meng Chuan smiled and nodded. “Yes, we’re nearly 100 years old.”
“It’s really nice to live a long life and grow old together,” said Liu Qiyue. “During this war, so many people have died. So many Godfiends died in battle. Our situation is already really
good.”
Meng Chuan listened to his wife, staying silent.
“Ah Chuan, do you still remember what we promised each other?” Liu Qiyue smiled and said, “Back when we were at Archean Mountain, we agreed to walk to the ends of our lives together. It was either we kill all the demons in the world, returning peace to our world, or we die in battle.
“I have always been prepared to die in battle. We’ve now lived for almost 100 years.” Liu Qiyue looked at Meng Chuan. “At the time we made that pact, we felt like our goal of vanquishing all demons in the world was too distant. We were prepared to dedicate our entire lives to achieving this goal. Back then, we would’ve never imagined that you, Ah Chuan, would be the one to wipe out one million demon monarchs. The world has been peaceful for decades because of your actions.”
“Ha.” Meng Chuan laughed. “That’s right. Back then, I only wanted to kill demons and risk my life for peace. I never expected that this day would come.”
“The task is not done until it’s done.” Liu Qiyue looked at her husband. “We’re getting closer and closer to achieving victory in the war, but that’s why we can’t be careless.”
Meng Chuan looked at his wife beside him.
“But I want to see the world with you, Ah Chuan,” said Liu Qiyue with a smile. “I want to be extravagant for a year. After a carefree year, I’ll do what needs to be done.”
That night.
Swoosh. Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar left Snow Wind Pass and came to the wilderness outside the city. When he saw Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar, the illusory figures of Qin Wu and Luo Tang appeared beside him.
“Meng Chuan,” said Qin Wu. “We watched the battle at Snow Wind Pass during the day. Liu Qiyue saved more than ten million people at Snow Wind Pass; she also killed the scourge that is Patriarch Poison Dragon.” Meng Chuan nodded. “Yea.”
an n
Li Guan looked at Meng Chuan. “However, we know that Liu Qiyue has consumed a lot of her lifespan to protect all of Snow Wind Pass.” “Yes, she consumed more than 220 years of her lifespan.” Meng Chuan nodded. “Qiyue can only live for 53 more years.” Liu Qiyue didn’t mind. Mortals were considered to have long lives if they lived for 100 years. Thus, she was satisfied that she could live this long. However, Meng Chuan’s heart ached for his wife.
“She can live for 53 more years...,” said Qin Wu. “As you know, according to Archean Mountain’s rules, a Regis Godfiend with about only 50 years left to live will need to enter the Millennium Instant slumber. This is to prepare for when the war enters its most crucial period in the future. They’ll be awakened once they are needed during that crucial period. After casting Phoenix’s Nirvana, Liu Qiyue has even greater strength than Senior Brother Li and me. She will be of great use in future battles.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. “Qiyue was actually prepared for this. I just hope that Qiyue and I will have a year to ourselves. She will enter the Millenium Instant slumber a year later.”
“This is just a precaution. Meng Chuan, Liu Qiyue doesn’t have to die,” said Qin Wu. “We are also saving her by having her enter the Millenium Instant slumber.”
“Saving her?” Meng Chuan was stunned.
“Yes.” Qin Wu nodded. “By entering the Millennium Instant slumber, she can live for more than 1,000 years. With your talent and perception, you have a high chance of becoming a Tribulation Eminence within 1,000 years.”
Li Guan added, “You have the greatest potential in the human world. You rank number one in Heart Sea Palace and Battle God Pagoda’s combined ranking. It’s very likely that you can become a Tribulation Eminence within 1,000 years. When you are strong enough, you will have all sorts of ways to save Liu Qiyue. You might obtain a treasure that can extend her lifespan, and restore her body’s vitality to its peak. Liu Qiyue can then continue to cultivate. She might even become a Creation Supremacy.
“However, longevity extension treasures are very rare. You can also find treasures similar to the Dao Protectors’ bodies. After undergoing a life modification process, she can also live for a long time as a special lifeform. As long as you grow fast enough, Liu Qiyue won’t need to cast Phoenix’s Nirvana in the future,” said Li Guan. “The Millennium Instant mystic technique can save her.”“Longevity extension treasures? Restore her body’s vitality to its peak?” Meng Chuan was tempted.
The illusory Qin Wu said, “A long time ago, during Archean Eon Sect’s era, humans had these longevity extension treasures. However, too many Godfiends yearned for them, so they have long been used up. You have to search for them yourself now. There’s hope of finding them if you become a Tribulation Eminence.”
“Even if you can’t find a longevity extension treasure, you can spend Liu Qiyue’s remaining 50 years with her. Of course, this will only happen if we win the war within 1,000 years,” said Luo Tang.
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
“Regardless, the people at Snow Wind Pass will have eternal gratitude towards Qiyue,” said Qin Wu. “She saved more than ten million people. She also indirectly saved tens of millions of people by killing Patriarch Poison Dragon.” Meng Chuan smiled. “Qiyue was willing to do so.”
She had no regrets.
Snow Wind Pass became a major city pass. Due to Archean Mountain having a shortage of Creation Supremacies, Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s Mi Yu temporarily guarded it. Once Archean Mountain gave birth to a new Creation Supremacy in the future, they would take over Mi Yu’s role. “The world is peaceful. It’s much more prosperous than before.” Liu Qiyue and Meng Chuan flew high in the sky. She smiled and said, “All these years, I have been guarding cities. I haven’t seen the world properly. For the next year, Ah Chuan, you have to keep me company.” “Don’t worry. I’ll keep you company,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
The couple began to admire the vistas the land had to offer, traveling the world that they protected with their lives.

chapters.title: Chapter 479 - One Year
chapters.content:
Chapter 479 One Year
Winter went as spring came.
Jiang State Capital’s four outer city walls were 100 kilometers long each. Although the city had many soldiers, they were scattered across the four city walls.
Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue sat on one of the city walls. They looked at the vast land and ate some naan. The soldiers couldn’t see them.
“This naan smells so good,” said Liu Qiyue as she ate it. “If I hadn’t gone to Black Sand Dynasty’s western region, I wouldn’t have known that such food existed in this world.”
“I’ll buy as much as you want. It only takes me a few seconds to travel 15,000 kilometers and buy it,” said Meng Chuan as he ate.
Liu Qiyue smiled at her husband. “I still remember how I personally built Jiang State Capital’s outer city walls,” said Liu Qiyue as she ate. “I dug up the 400-kilometer moat below. It took me half a month.”
“Back then, the entire city was stunned by your accomplishment,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“It’s like everything happened yesterday. It’s been nearly 50 years since then,” said Liu Qiyue. Meng Chuan nodded. “Back then, An’er just entered Archean Mountain. Even An’er has been a Regis Godfiend for many years now.”
“Time flies by so quickly. For so many years, I’ve always been thinking about cultivation and guarding the cities. Time has flown by without me realizing it.” After Liu Qiyue finished eating the naan, she looked at Meng Chuan. “Ah Chuan, are there any watermelons?” “Yes, of course.” With a flip of his hand, a watermelon appeared in his hand. His Quintessential Essence sliced the watermelon into six pieces. He handed a piece of watermelon to his wife.
Some places in the southern region had watermelons all year round. Meng Chuan had naturally placed some fruits, alcohol, and other items in his void bracelet. His void bracelet was very suitable for storing food.
Meng An was Jiang State Capital’s guardian Godfiend.
Meng An arrived on the city wall and looked at the white-haired couple sitting on the city wall. At that moment, Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue had finished eating the watermelon. They were still chatting about their beautiful memories in Jiang State Capital. The couple had spent a long time in Jiang State Capital.
“An’er is here.” Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue flew away from the city wall and headed towards Meng An.
“Dad, Mom.” Meng An looked at his white-haired father and mother, feeling terrible and sad.
After last year’s battle at Snow Wind Pass, Meng An, Meng You, and others quickly learned of the couple’s situation. Meng An and Meng You wanted to meet their parents, but their parents were busy traveling the world. They had no idea where they went. Thus, they agreed to meet at Jiang State Capital when 8th March arrived.
“Let’s go to the manor.” Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue smiled at their son.
Meng An was very outstanding. He wasn’t like Liu Qiyue—who relied on her phoenix bloodline. Nor was he similar to Meng Chuanwho created his own non-mainstream ultimate technique. Meng An cultivated the Samsara Divine Body and Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s spear arts. It was a very orthodox path. It was also very comprehensive, causing his growth to be rapid.
Jiang State Capital, Meng Manor.
Due to the increasing number of Meng family clansmen over the past few years, only a portion of the core clansmen lived in Meng Manor. The entire inner court was reserved for Meng Chuan, his wife, and his children. Other clansmen were not allowed to enter.
“Be careful and respectful when you see your grandparents later. Don’t anger them,” Yang Cheng reminded his son via voice transmission.
“Yes, Dad,” Yang Yuan replied obediently.
Meng You waited anxiously by the side.
Half a year ago, Mother lost lots of her lifespan during the battle at Snow Wind Pass, but I haven’t gotten to see them yet. Meng You had always been anxious about her parents’ wellbeing. I wonder how Dad and Mom are now?
Huh? Meng You and her husband, Yang Cheng, sensed something and immediately stood up.
“Yuan’er, follow us.” Meng You and Yang Cheng walked in front, while their son, Yang Yuan, followed behind.
The family of three walked out, and soon they saw them.
A white-haired man and white-haired woman walked side by side as they chatted with the white-haired Liu Yebai. King Feather Dragon, Meng An, followed behind them.
Liu Qiyue’s eyes were slightly red as she looked at her father, Liu Yebai. “Dad, Ah Chuan and I will visit you. There’s no need for you to specially come over.”
“It’s fine. I live in Jiang State Capital. My house is very close to Meng Manor.” Liu Yebai was still as thin as always. He looked at his daughter longingly. “How long are you planning to stay in Jiang State Capital?” Liu Qiyue smiled and said, “Ah Chuan and I plan on staying in Jiang State Capital for a month. I’ll accompany you well.” Liu Yebai could only live for another 50-plus years. After his daughter entered the Millennium Instant slumber, Liu Yebai would probably be dead by the time she woke up. Thus, this reunion was also their final reunion.
“Dad, Mom, Grandpa.” Meng You stepped forward and bowed. Yang Cheng and Yang Yuan followed.
Although her parents looked like they were in their thirties to forties, Meng You’s heart ached when she saw their snow-white hair.
“You’er.” Liu Qiyue waved.
Meng You immediately ran over and hugged her mother’s arm.
“Little Yuan Yuan has grown up.” Meng You smiled as she looked at Yang Yuan. “The last time I saw him, he was only this tall. In the blink of an eye, he has become an adult.”
“Grandma, Grandpa,” greeted Yang Yuan obediently.
“Yang Yuan should be 18 this year,” said Meng Chuan.
“Yes, Dad (Father-in-law),” said Meng You and Yang Cheng.
Meng Chuan smiled at Yang Yuan.
When Meng An and Meng You were young, they didn’t know that their family was special. They considered themselves as ordinary people.
As for Yang Yuan, he had grown up with a silver spoon. Thankfully, his upbringing was strict, so he didn’t go astray. “When do you plan on participating in Archean Mountain’s entrance examination?” asked Meng Chuan.
“I’ll participate at the end of this year,” said Yang Yuan respectfully.
“Yuan’er comprehended Force last year,” explained Meng You. “His father and I have nurtured him for more than a year. We hope that he can obtain first place in the entrance examination. If he can’t obtain first place, he has to be in the top three. At the very least, he can’t embarrass our Meng family.”
Liu Qiyue smiled and said, “Ah Chuan and I will stay in Jiang State Capital for a month. This month, we’ll teach Little Yuan Yuan well.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Yea.”
“Thank you, Grandma. Thank you, Grandpa,” said Yang Yuan immediately.
For the next month, Meng Chuan and his wife lived in Jiang State Capital and enjoyed their family reunion.
His son, Meng An, happened to be stationed here. As for Yang Cheng and Meng You, they were young Marquis Godfiends. They were relatively weak; they didn’t have the ability to guard a large city alone. Thus, it was a trivial matter for them to be temporarily transferred to Jiang State Capital to assist Meng An. They lived this past month in a very fulfilling manner. Liu Qiyue saw her father, Liu Yebai, every day. The family ate together. Liu Qiyue and Meng Chuan also guided Yang Yuan.
Meng Chuan didn’t have Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s legacy to guide him step-by-step. He relied on his own efforts to reach his present realm. He had even created his own ultimate technique, so he had his own understanding of cultivation.
In his youth, Meng Chuan summarized the Godfiend biographies to understand how he should improve himself.
After repeated transformations, Meng Chuan’s eyes were naturally sharp. Yang Yuan was enlightened every time he was given pointers.
Grandpa is really impressive. A month of his guidance is even better than three years of guidance from my parents. It might really be possible for me to obtain first place in Archean Mountain’s entrance examination. After this month of training, Yang Yuan was even more confident.
...
A month later.
Meng Chuan and his wife followed their plan and left Jiang State Capital. They continued to travel the world.As they traveled the world, they learned the customs of the world’s various areas and ate various delicacies.
Meng Chuan accompanied Liu Qiyue every day.
After traveling all over the inhabited areas, the couple went to places that were uninhabited.
They traveled to the tallest mountain peak, the largest desert, and the ends of the ocean. They even traveled to the deepest underground spot with the Bloodblade Disc’s help.
Horizon of the Heavens, Corner of the Sea.
Meng Chuan and his wife headed to the end of the world.
Meng Chuan had torn through the two world membranes and entered the World Gap with his wife. In the World Gap, he brought his wife to see all kinds of gorgeous scenes. They also saw the incomplete world and the outer realm’s endless darkness.
Before they knew it, their scheduled year had passed, and it was late autumn again.

chapters.title: Chapter 480 - Thousand Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 480 Thousand Years
Jiang State Capital, Meng Manor’s inner courtyard, Lake Heart Pavilion.
“It’s really well painted,” said Liu Qiyue as she watched from the side.
Meng Chuan sat in front of the painting table and painted. He smiled at his wife and continued painting. Liu Qiyue carefully studied the painting, which depicted a white-haired Meng Chuan and a white-haired Liu Qiyue sitting together. They took in the fractured world’s view and the purple lightning tearing through endless the darkness—the scene of a forming world...
Regardless of a forming or dying world, it was as though the two of them would forever be together.
“Alright.” Meng Chuan stopped painting and moved aside.
Liu Qiyue stood in front of the table and carefully admired the painting. She stared at the scene of a shattered world and the purple lightning tearing through the darkness. The depicted forming world induced a sense of awe and fear within her. Although Meng Chuan didn’t paint it with deep purpose, the grand scene still pressured her. However, grand as the scenes were, the white-haired man and the white-haired woman remained the painting’s core.
The white-haired duo leaned against each other; it was as if they would continue doing so for an eternity. One could clearly sense the intent of eternity.
Tears welled up in Liu Qiyue’s eyes. “Good, very good.”
Meng Chuan hugged his wife and glanced at the painting in front of him.
“Ah Chuan, ever since we got married, you have painted a painting for me every year. Including the three paintings you painted for me before we got married,” said Liu Qiyue softly, “there are a total of 72 paintings. In the past, when I was free, I often took a look at those paintings. I was very happy whenever I saw them.”
Meng Chuan hugged his wife tightly.
“After I enter the slumber, 1,000 years will pass in an instant.” Liu Qiyue looked at her husband. “To me, 1,000 years will pass in the blink of an eye. I won’t feel any pain or suffering. However, you will have to endure the torment of time alone.”
“Time will fly by,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“I’ll leave these 72 paintings with you for now. Give them back to me when I wake up.” Liu Qiyue smiled at her husband. “Whenever you miss me, you can take a look at these paintings.” Meng Chuan nodded and smiled. “Alright.”
In the last few days, she bade farewell to Meng Dajiang and his wife, as well as Liu Yebai.
After all, Meng Dajiang, Liu Yebai, and others couldn’t enter Archean Mountain’s Millennium Hall.
Archean Mountain, in a grotto-heaven.
White fog filled the area, causing the grotto-heaven to look bleak and desolate. Through the white fog, one could see a palace in the distance.
е
Meng Chuan, Liu Qiyue, Li Guan, an illusory Qin Wu, an illusory Luo Tang, Meng An, and Meng You arrived together.
Two figures sat cross-legged in front of the cold, lonely palace. One figure was a black-robed man; the other was a black-robed, red-haired woman. They were Archean Mountain’s two Dao Protectors.
Since the pressure on the cities had lessened over the past few years, the two of them temporarily rested here.
“Oh?” The two Dao Protectors opened their eyes at the same time. When they saw that it was Li Guan, Meng Chuan, and company, they naturally didn’t stop them from advancing. Meng Chuan and company continued forward.
Boom!
Meng Chuan, Li Guan, the illusory Qin Wu, and the illusory Luo Tang simultaneously stretched out their hands and pushed the palace doors.
The door immediately opened with a rumble. A freezing-cold wind swept out.
Through the palace doors, one could see many figures lying inside the palace. All of them were frozen within dark-blue ice.
“Wait here,” instructed Meng Chuan.
“Yes, Dad,” replied Meng An and Meng You.
Meng You—the weakest of the group-was only a Marquis. She was only permitted to come to this important area because she was Liu Qiyue’s daughter.
“Meng Chuan, we won’t be entering,” said Qin Wu.
“Alright.” Meng Chuan nodded and led his wife, Liu Qiyue, into the Millennium Hall.
Currently, 17 figures were sleeping within Millennium Hall. After the pressure on the cities had reduced, many ancient Regis Godfiend returned to Millennium Hall to slumber.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan walked to an empty spot and waved his hand. He placed a jade bed—which he had prepared in advance-down.
Liu Qiyue smiled and sat on it before slowly lying down.
“Mom.” Meng An and Meng You watched outside the hall, unwilling to separate from her.
Her slumber could last for 1,000 years. If Meng You couldn’t become a Regis Godfiend, this could be their final meeting.
Liu Qiyue lay down and looked at her children outside the hall before looking at her husband.
“Ah Chuan,” said Liu Qiyue.
Meng Chuan stared at his wife. “The happiest thing I did in my life”— Liu Qiyue looked at Meng Chuan and smiled – “was marrying you and becoming your wife.”
Meng Chuan’s eyes were filled with tears. “I’m very lucky to marry you and have you as my wife.”
“Cast Millennium Instant,” said Liu Qiyue with a smile. “When I open my eyes again, I’ll definitely see you.”
“Definitely.” Meng Chuan infused his Quintessential Essence into the mystic runes on the Millennium Hall’s surface. The mystic runes required for the Millennium Instant mystic techniques were already carved into the hall. He just needed to activate them.
Buzz.
As he activated the runes with his Quintessential Essence, an intense, boundless cold wind gathered around Liu Qiyue. The cold wind formed a dark-blue layer of ice around her body. In just several seconds, a huge, dark-blue ice block formed around Liu Qiyue’s body.
With this, Liu Qiyue had been completely frozen. Her lifeforce was frozen and maintained at its current state.
As Meng Chuan stared at Liu Qiyue through the ice, his heart felt empty.
Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang didn’t rush him. They just waited outside the hall silently.
Moments later
Meng Chuan finally turned around and left Millennium Hall silently.
Rumble!
Millennium Hall’s doors began to close. One last time, Meng Chuan turned his head and looked at his wife—who was sleeping in the hall—amongst all the other slumbering Regis Godfiends. Finally, Millennium Hall’s doors shut completely.
The group left the grotto-heaven and arrived in front of Grotto-Heaven Pavilion.
“Dad,” said Meng An. “Come with us to Jiang State Capital. Sis, Grandpa, and Grandma, and I are there.”
“Dad, you can also give Yuan’er pointers on cultivation. Yuan’er will be participating in Archean Mountain’s entrance examination at the end of the year. He says that you are the best teacher.”
Meng Chuan looked at his children and nodded slightly. “Go back to Jiang State Capital without me. I still have something to do.”
With a whoosh, he transformed into a stream of light and disappeared into the horizon. Meng An and Meng You exchanged looks. They could do nothing to change their father’s mind.
Meng Chuan returned to his wife’s residence at Snow Wind Pass. This was the place he and his wife had lived in for the longest. This had been their residence for the past few decades.
Swoosh.
After returning to the ordinary manor, Meng Chuan sat in a pavilion blankly. His heart felt empty. This was something he had never experienced in so many years. Unknowingly, the sky turned dark.
Meng Chuan returned to his familiar room and lay down on the bed. He looked to his side. This time, he was the only one sleeping here.
Sleep. He closed his eyes and gradually fell asleep.
When he opened his eyes again, it was already dawn.
After waking up, Meng Chuan became more spirited. He stood up and walked to the dining table.
Meng Chuan’s body trembled as he stared at a seat blankly.
In the past, his wife, Liu Qiyue, liked to cook porridge and make flatbread. He also liked to eat everything she cooked in big mouthfuls. Every day, he ate breakfast at home.
At this moment, the dining hall was silent.
Meng Chuan sat alone at the dining table. There was no porridge or flatbread today. The familiar fragrance was missing.
“Qiyue...” Meng Chuan murmured.They had known each other since they were children. They grew up together as childhood sweethearts. They cultivated together on Archean Mountain.
After leaving the mountain, they went to North River Pass. They guarded the city pass and participated in many bloody battles.
After leaving North River Pass, they lived secluded lives in Gu Mountain Prefecture. They guarded the prefecture and killed demons to reinforce the world’s safety.
They brought up their children in Jiang State Capital together. His wife guarded cities while he patrolled the world to kill demon monarchs...
Even after so many years, the longest they had ever been separated from each other was when he was fighting in the World Gap. Due to his mission, they didn’t meet for over ten years. Besides this exception, he spent most of his time with her.
“We agreed to walk alongside each other for the rest of our lives. We were to fight on the battlefield together, risking our lives to slay all demons,” muttered Meng Chuan. “However, I’m now walking forward alone without you.”
At that moment, a strong sense of loneliness erupted, completely drowning Meng Chuan’s heart.
For the next 1,000 years, he would be alone.

chapters.title: Chapter 481 - Painting
chapters.content:
Chapter 481 Painting
In a restaurant at Snow Wind Pass.
“Make way, make way.” A waiter carried a wooden tray. A large bowl of porridge, a steamer full of buns, and a plate of flatbread laid on top of the wooden tray. He carried it and walked towards the customers on the second floor.
Suddenly, the bowl of porridge, the steamer full of buns, and the plate of flatbread vanished from his wooden tray. At the same time, a piece of silver appeared on the wooden tray.
“Oh?” The waiter’s eyes widened in shock. “Where’s the porridge? Where are the buns? Where did the flatbread go?” The waiter was somewhat dazed. He carefully picked up the silver piece and rushed to the first floor. “Uncle, Uncle, look.”
Meng Chuan remained seated at the table. A bowl of porridge, a steamer full of buns, and a plate of flatbread appeared in front of him.
“Breakfast is ready.” Meng Chuan turned his head to the side. The dining table was empty save for him; he was the only one there.
“I have to get used to being alone.” Meng Chuan lowered his head and ate as he did in the past. He ate the porridge, buns, and flatbread in large mouthfuls.
Soon, he finished everything.
Still sitting by the table after his meal, Meng Chuan finally understood what he had to do now. I have to continue cultivating. The human world and the Demon realm are gradually nearing each other, causing more World Entrances to appear. We still haven’t won the war completely. I have to become stronger. Only by becoming stronger and facing danger will we not need to awaken Qiyue. If she doesn’t awaken, she’ll never have to cast Phoenix’s Nirvana, which would risk her life.
If we lose this war, it will be a calamity for humanity. Countless Godfiends’ efforts will be in vain. We’ve already sacrificed too much. We have to win. I have to cultivate. Meng Chuan walked into the courtyard with Demon Slayer hanging by his waist.
He unsheathed his saber.
Meng Chuan frowned before swinging his saber.
He repeatedly swung his saber for ten minutes, attempting to cultivate. However, he had to stop when he realized his mental state wasn’t in the right place.
My heart is affected. I can’t focus on cultivation at all. Meng Chuan frowned as he stood in the courtyard. If I don’t focus on my cultivation, I won’t be able to improve.
Whether he was trying to reach the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm with the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique—which was currently in the Grotto-Heaven’s late stageor if he was trying to make Infinite Saber a paramount technique, the most basic requirement was to be fully focused whenever he cultivated.
If his mind was bombarded by stray thoughts, making him constantly distracted, there was simply no way he could make any progress.
I can’t control my thoughts. What should I do? Meng Chuan pondered how to solve this problem.
Ordinary emotions could be thrown to the back of one’s mind. They would be forgotten very quickly once one stopped thinking about them. However, emotions that truly affected one’s life could never be forgotten, even if one was a peerless genius. Back then, King True Martial had been unable to recover from his emotional setback. He was stuck at this nadir for a long time. Did he want to sink into oblivion? No! King True Martial also wanted to cultivate and become stronger. However, the emotional setback had caused him to doubt his entire cultivation path. Due to these doubts, he couldn’t continue traveling that path.
In the end, King True Martial didn’t forget everything that happened before his emotional setback. He just created a new path and followed it until he died.
What should I do? Meng Chuan pondered. His intense loneliness and longing for his wife couldn’t be suppressed.
It’s better to let everything loose than blocking the flood. I’ll vent all my intense emotions. Furthermore, I’ll vent them completely. After I vent all my emotions, it might be much easier. Meng Chuan made his decision. The best way for me to vent my emotions is to fuse them into my paintings. Starting from Snow Wind Pass, I’ll travel to all the places Qiyue and I once lived. I’ll fuse every memory and intense emotion into my paintings.
After making his decision, Meng Chuan began painting Meng Chuan spent two days and two nights painting this ordinary courtyard at Snow Wind Pass. This was the place where Meng Chuan and his wife had lived the longest.
He then went to Jiang State Capital, which he had many fond memories of. He had once lived an incognito life in an ordinary residence and taught his children as they grew up. He had also guarded Jiang State Capital…
He even went to Chu An City, Changfeng City, Duyang City, and other places. As a guardian Godfiend, Liu Qiyue frequently swapped defenses. Meng Chuan also moved to those different residences with her. To the couple, no matter where they lived, they would always be at home as long as they stayed together.
He went to Gu Mountain Prefecture.
Gu Mountain Prefecture City is completely abandoned. Meng Chuan arrived at the manor that the couple had once lived in. Half a year ago, the couple had come here and cleaned the
place.
Back then, Qiyue and I lived incognito at Gu Mountain Prefecture. We hunted demons and reinforced the various cities in the region. Meng Chuan looked at the manor. This is also where Qiyue got pregnant and gave birth to An’er and You’er.
The couple stayed in Gu Mountain Prefecture for six years. At that time, they were young and outstanding. The couple worked together to crush any foes.
Meng Chuan sat on a stone bench and painted the days when his wife was pregnant. He also painted scenes of An’er and You’er in their swaddling clothes. The couple coaxed their children. He also painted scenes of him and his wife working together to kill the demons and reinforce the cities.
North River Pass.
Meng Chuan arrived at the abandoned North River Pass.
He went to the manor that the couple had once resided in.
After the couple left Archean Mountain, they were deployed to North River Pass. They fought here for a while. This was also where they got married and became husband and wife.
Meng Chuan stood in the familiar abandoned mansion and vaguely saw the day of their marriage.
Zhang Yunhu, Fan Cheng, Shi Xiu, Yu Chiyan, Yang Xingwu, Mu Qing, Dean Ge Yu, and many other friends witnessed Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue bowing to the world and officially becoming husband and wife.
Most of those friends and family members had died. Some had died on their sickbeds, while others had died when battling the demons.
Archean Mountain.
After painting at North River Pass for two days, Meng Chuan arrived at Archean Mountain. He didn’t visit the Supremacies; he returned to his cave abode.
“King Eastcalm.” The steward of the cave abode had changed. It was a female steward with the surname He. The former Steward Liu had long passed away from old age. “I’ll stay here for a few days,” said Meng Chuan.
“Yes.” The female steward immediately arranged for the servants to clean the place.
Meng Chuan looked around the cave abode and recalled the days when he and his wife cultivated on the mountain. This was where he and his wife had promised to spend the rest of their lives together. They promised that they would fight on the battlefield together. They also promised that they would fight the demons until they died. They would be together forever in life and in death.
They created 11 years of beautiful memories here.
As Meng Chuan painted the various scenes, he occasionally smiled. His feelings for his wife transferred into his brush as he painted the various scenes.
After painting for two days and one night, Meng Chuan left the cave abode at midnight and arrived at Blood Red Cliff.
Hum.
Countless Godfiend images appeared on Blood Red Cliff.
As Meng Chuan stared at the countless images of Godfiends—which had left behind before they left the mountain-he immediately saw himself and Liu Qiyue.
Back then, he was dressed in a dark-cyan robe, a pair of battle boots, and had Demon Slayer hanging by his waist. His robes fluttered in the wind. Liu Qiyue was dressed in a cyan-red robe. The color of her robe was even brighter than his. She carried a divine bow and quiver on her back. The two looked at each other and smiled brightly. “Why did Blood Red Cliff’s projections
appear?”
Blood Red Cliff was on the main mountain peak. Godfiend disciples often came to the main peak, so they naturally noticed the countless Godfiend projections appearing. Immediately, a Godfiend disciple rushed over curiously.
From afar, he saw a white-haired man standing on Blood Red Cliff and looking at the countless floating Godfiend images.
What happened?
Only Elders can activate Blood Red Cliff’s projections. Who triggered it? Many Godfiend disciples rushed over, but the projections had long disappeared by the time they arrived. Meng Chuan had also left.
Meng Chuan returned to Eastcalm City. He arrived at Mirror Lake Manor—the place they had first met.
Although a few servants maintained Mirror Lake Meng Manor, nobody dared to move in. After all, this was King Eastcalm and Queen Calmmoon’s old house.
Meng Chuan walked through the familiar residence; the layout was the same as before. When he was eight years oldBack then, Meng Chuan, who thought that his mother was dead, cultivated crazily. His father’s good friend, Liu Yebai, led a timid little girl to Mirror Lake Meng Manor. It was then that he became acquainted with the little girl. Afterward, they cultivated together as they grew up. Meng Chuan sat in the residence’s training grounds. Under a huge tree-where he had cultivated his saber drawing stance in the past – he painted his childhood memories.
He painted at Mirror Lake Meng Manor for three days.
As he traveled, Meng Chuan first painted his recent life before painting his childhood memories. He first painted his memories at Snow Wind Pass. From there, he painted the memories he made at Jiang State Capital, Chu An City, Changfeng City, Duyang City, Gu Mountain Prefecture City, North River Pass, Archean Mountain cave abode, Mirror Lake Meng Manor at Eastcalm City-in that particular order. All of these painted memories were part of a super-long long painting. These memories made a very long painting; it was 153 feet long. It was the longest painting Meng Chuan had painted to date.
The painting depicted the memories he had of Liu Qiyue. From the right, it was the first time the two met each other; the years that they grew up together; the battle in Idle Stone Garden; the demon invasion which caused Liu Qiyue’s bloodline to awaken and Meng Chuan rushing over to rescue her… The painting depicted scenes of their lives until the couple both had snow-white hair.
The white-haired Meng Chuan painted while the white-haired Liu Qiyue watched from the side with a smile. This memory depicted the scene of Meng Chuan painting for his wife before she entered the slumber in Archean Mountain’s Millennium Hall.
Boom!
The extremely long painting was partially rolled up and partially floating.
Meng Chuan sat under a tree at the training grounds. He looked at the completed painting and felt a little dazed.
He picked up his brush and wrote a few words on the right—’I hold your hands; we will grow old together.’

chapters.title: Chapter 482 - Dance of the Saber Under the Moon
chapters.content:
Chapter 482 Dance of the Saber Under the Moon
The painting’s every brushstroke contained Meng Chuan’s emotions and memories. As he stared at the painting, he felt as though he could see the beautiful things he had experienced with his wife.
When Meng Chuan was completing this painting, he naturally sought answers from his inner self. It had affected his Essence Soul greatly. As he painted, his Essence Soul had constantly emitted a spiritual glow. However, it remained a sixth-level Essence Soul, even after he finished the painting.
I’ve finished painting. I’ve calmed down. Meng Chuan sat under the tree and waved his hand to put away the painting. I think I can continue cultivating calmly now.
Meng Chuan was unlike King True Martialwho had doubted his cultivation path. Meng Chuan didn’t doubt his cultivation path at all.
I’ll let myself get drunk. After waking up, I will cultivate diligently. Meng Chuan flipped his hand and took out a jar of Fire Fruit Wine. He sat under the tree and drank.
When the Fire Fruit Wine entered his throat, it was as though flames were burning his chest. His head heated up due to the wine. Meng Chuan deliberately controlled his body so that the alcohol wouldn’t be expelled. He liked the feeling of being slightly tipsy.
With his body, even Archean Mountain’s best alcohol couldn’t make him drunk if he wasn’t willing
“Qiyue.” Meng Chuan sat under the tree and drank from the wine jar he was hugging. He muttered to himself, “In the past, I could chat with you whenever I encountered setbacks. I could share happy matters with you. Whenever I had a breakthrough in my cultivation, I would flaunt it in front of you. When I was sad, you would accompany me... But what about now? Who will I share my feelings with for the next 1,000 years?” Meng Chuan tipped his head back and drank.
Gulp! Gulp! Gulp!
The Fire Fruit Wine burned his chest like a raging fire. He was tipsy, but his mind became more active. Scenes of his beautiful memories surfaced in his mind.
“When you were still here, we enjoyed our happy days together. We fought together, taught our children together..” Meng Chuan laughed self-deprecatingly. “Those times only exist in memories now... Can I only recall my past memories? How laughable.”
Meng Chuan continued drinking as he muttered to himself.
The sky gradually darkened. After finishing one jar of wine, he took out another jar of wine.
Meng Chuan’s drunkenness intensified.
“It’s said that if both sides love each other for aye, they don’t need to stay together day and night!” Meng Chuan said softly. “However, I want us to be together night and day!
“I’m spouting nonsense again. It’s impossible.” Meng Chuan threw away the empty wine jar in his hand and pulled out Demon Slayer-which had been hanging from his waist. “Impossible!”
He casually executed his saber art to vent his anger and indignation.
In the end, not everything in the world could go as per one’s will.
Some people gave up on themselves, while others sank into oblivion. The strong would accept it and try their best to change the future. However, there were times when powerful experts needed to vent their frustrations.
...
The crescent moon hung high in the sky. The cold moonlight scattered across Mirror Lake Meng Manor’s training grounds.
On the training grounds, a figure could be seen carelessly executing a saber art.
“From South to North together they flew, how many seasons have they been together?” Meng Chuan executed his saber art as he chanted poems loudly, his voice echoing through the night.
In the past, he and Qiyue were like flying birds. They roamed the world together, no matter how long it took them.
“Happy together, devastated when separated. Their devotion to each other surpasses even the most infatuated couples.”
Too many memories.
Days of joy, the pain of parting.
Infatuation?
“He must have realized only he is left to fly over those lonely thousands of miles of clouds and snowy mountains alone?” Meng Chuan continued reciting the poems; his saber art became even more poignant and beautiful as he vented his emotions. The saber art was like a lone bird flying in the snow.
“Alone!”
When he swung his saber
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan felt that the night sky was as beautiful as a painting. Under the moonlight, he could see wisps of light penetrate the void and scatter everywhere. Everything slowed down.
The rays of moonlight flew slower, and the wind seemed to turn still.
Everything slowed down.
The world’s slow motion was close to stillness, causing the world’s scenery to become like a painting. Only the rays of moonlight shone down at a relatively faster speed. Meng Chuan could still clearly see the rays of moonlight with his naked eye. The phenomenon was absolutely beautiful.
After swinging Demon Slayer, the saber vanished from his field of vision. It had entered the gap between spacetime.
