This move was similar to the Heart Intent Saber’s strongest attack-which Ancestral Master Guo Ke had created back then; they were both invisible moves. An enemy would be struck by one’s saber before they could even sense it. This saber move of Meng Chuan’s hadn’t reached the Heaven Earth realm. This saber move was only his future paramount technique
– Infinite Saber’s first successful move. This saber strike moved between the gaps of spacetime. It was difficult to notice or block it. Even when one was killed, they still wouldn’t be able to sense the saber strike.
This saber move affected time itself. It made time slow down-coming to a standstill—until the enemy was hit. It was only with such a strike that one at the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm would have a chance of slaying an Imperial Lord.
“So this is the true Infinite Saber,” muttered Meng Chuan to himself.
Fueled by his intense feelings and his unbearable longing for his wife, he swung Demon Slayer.
His endless feelings resulted in this saber move being created.
Under such a state of mind, Meng Chuan’s insights into the lightning lineage began to fuse. The Flash Form of Lightning, the Yin-Yang Form of Lightning, and the Wave Splitting Forms of Lightning merged, allowing Meng Chuan to execute a beautiful strike that could break free of the worldly law’s suppression. Legend had it that one could affect time once they broke free of the worldly law’s suppression with pure speed alone...
Meng Chuan continued executing his saber art under the moonlight. His longing for his wife kept infusing into his saber art as he struck out repeatedly. When he was done, Meng Chuan stopped swinging his saber and fell asleep.
Archean Mountain, Grotto-Heaven Pavilion.
“According to the intelligence, Meng Chuan first went to Snow Wind Pass, then to Jiang State Capital, and other places. He also returned to Archean Mountain. He’s currently in Eastcalm City,” said Li Guan with a frown. “We’ve realized that every place that he has visited is where he and Liu Qiyue once lived. They are childhood sweethearts. They’ve had a deep relationship with each other for almost 100 years. I’m worried that Liu Qiyue’s matter will affect Meng Chuan’s cultivation.”
“Although this emotional impact will influence his cultivation somewhat, it won’t sever his cultivation path,” said Luo Tang. “Some Archean Mountain Godfiends are affected for a short period of time after their loved ones pass away, but they usually recover. Yes, King True Martial once doubted his cultivation path, but Liu Qiyue is only slumbering... There’s no reason for Meng Chuan to doubt his cultivation path.”
“Give him some time,” said Qin Wu. “He needs time to adapt. I think he will be fine after a few months.”
“Yes.” Li Guan nodded solemnly. “The city passes are under a lot of pressure. There are currently six super-large city passes. There are only nine Creation Supremacies in the human world. A Supremacy also has to guard Archean Mountain at all times. It’ll be very difficult for humanity to guard another two or three super-large city passes. As for me, I only have a few decades left to live. Therefore, I need Meng Chuan to grow as fast as possible and take this burden from me.”
“All humans will experience a moment of weakness,” said Qin Wu. “I believe that my disciple will recover quickly.”
Li Guan and Luo Tang nodded slightly. “Yes.”
Archean Mountain’s Creation Supremacies were worried about Meng Chuan, but they didn’t dare disturb him.
In Eastcalm City, on Mirror Lake Meng Manor’s training grounds, Meng Chuan was still sleeping under a tree. The morning sun rose.
Meng Chuan slowly opened his eyes as the sun shone on him. He looked at the burning sun. It’s daybreak?

chapters.title: Chapter 483 - Seventh-Level Essence Soul
chapters.content:
Chapter 483 Seventh-Level Essence Soul
Meng Chuan sat up and looked at the alcohol jars around him.
After spending half a month painting and a round of getting drunk, Meng Chuan’s heart became calmer; it was like an endless ocean. His feelings for his wife were hidden deep in his heart.
I have to reach the Tribulation Realm as soon as possible and find a treasure that can extend Qiyue’s lifespan. This way, Qiyue can wake up earlier. I need to work hard. Meng Chuan stood up. Oh right, I created a paramount technique last night. Meng Chuan clearly remembered the scene of him executing the beautiful saber art last night.
He had wanted to create the paramount technique, Infinite Saber, for many years, but he had been stuck at a bottleneck. It was only last night, when he was half-drunk and half-lucid, that he executed that beautiful slash.
I need to consolidate my paramount technique. Meng Chuan focused on executing his saber art to familiarize himself with the move. He also wanted to deduce the corresponding movement technique based on the saber art’s foundation.
Huh? When he was just about to focus on executing his saber art, Meng Chuan was suddenly stunned. My Essence Soul...? The revolving Essence Soul Star in his sea of consciouness had become much bigger, reaching a whole new level.
Seventh-level Essence Soul? Meng Chuan was taken aback by his Essence Soul’s changes. My Essence Soul has already reached the seventh level? My Essence Soul was clearly still at the sixth level when I used my saber art last night...
Without a doubt, the massive Essence Soul Star in his sea of consciousness had indeed reached the seventh level. In fact, his Essence Soul had improved greatly over the past few years. The extremely long painting he painted during the past half-month had also benefited his Essence Soul greatly. However, he never expected his Essence Soul to change qualitatively.
His Essence Soul had reached the seventh level when he had executed that beautiful saber move that broke through the worldly law’s suppression. That move truly touched Meng Chuan’s heart, causing his Essence Soul to transform.
Comprehending a paramount technique greatly benefited his Essence Soul. When Meng Chuan was asleep, his Essence Soul naturally transformed into a seventh-level Essence Soul. Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul perception domain and Seamless domain naturally enveloped his surroundings when he was asleep. They would wake up if there were any danger. Even his Tribulation treasure, Bloodblade Disc, would alert him when it sensed danger. However, an Essence Soul breakthrough was completely natural. It was like a mortal slowly growing taller while asleep. It was a natural transformation. Thus, Meng Chuan didn’t receive any warnings.
It was only after he awakened that he realized that he had a seventh-level Essence Soul.
I actually attained a seventh-level Essence Soul unknowingly. Meng Chuan sighed inwardly.
Before he obtained the Eon Sea Sect’s treasures, his combat prowess didn’t improve much even though he had a slightly stronger Essence Soul than his opponents. A sixth-level Essence Soul could typically withstand a seventh-level Essence Soul mystic technique. An expert with a fifth-level Essence Soul might suffer a reduction in strength when struck by an Essence Soul mystic technique below the seventh level, but they wouldn’t die to them. This was normal in the vast outer realm.
However, after Meng Chuan retrieved the Eon Sea Sect’s treasures, he had given humanity an extremely terrifying Essence Soul mystic technique-Magic Awl Forbidden Spell. This was once Archean Eon Realm’s signature move. It sent quakes through the countless worlds in the outer realm whenever it appeared. Although the Demon Realm had a rather rich heritage—they had several Sixth Tribulation Eminences in history-none of their techniques were comparable to the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell. It was a testament to how rare such a technique was.
Meng Chuan even obtained the even more precious Essence Soul Star legacy.
Of course, these techniques were the heritage left behind by the Seventh Tribulation Eminence, Ancestral Master Archean Eon.
Since I have a seventh-level Essence Soul, my Magic Awl Forbidden Spell will be... Meng Chuan sighed inwardly. At the very least, he was invincible in the human world.
Meng Chuan was even more confident in dealing with any threats during the war.
Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!
Meng Chuan stood on the training grounds’ grass. Dark Meng Chuans flew out from his body-nine in total.
I can form nine Essence Soul avatars. Meng Chuan looked at the Essence Soul avatars and couldn’t help but nod slightly. However, one can only have a single Magic Awl. Therefore, my Essence Soul avatars’ most powerful Essence Soul mystic technique is Astral Wave. These Essence Soul avatars can also carry Quintessential Essence. When equipped with weapons, they can use my paramount technique, Infinite Saber.
Each of these nine Essence Soul avatars has terrifying combat strength. I’ll consolidate my understanding of Infinite Saber first before deducing the corresponding movement technique.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan flew out of Eastcalm City. He flew into the wilderness. Meng Chuan stood in the wilderness and tried to strike out.
Swoosh.
Everything around him slowed down greatly. In the distance, the people’s feet didn’t land on the ground after taking a step for a long time. The wind blew the fallen leaves extremely slowly. The morning dew fell from the leaves very slowly. It took them a long time to land on the ground.
The beautiful saber vanished from his vision and entered the spacetime gap before returning to its scabbard. The flow of time around him returned to normal. The people in the distance began walking normally, and the leaves floated normally. The dew fell to the ground.
To those in the outside world, they would think that Meng Chuan’s saber had never moved from his waist at all. This was because he had drawn and sheathed his saber in the blink of an eye. Furthermore, due to the changed time flow, he had drawn the saber 50 times faster than usual. Even Creation Supremacies typically wouldn’t have noticed him drawing and sheathing his saber.
The flow of time around me is over 50 times faster than in the outside world. Meng Chuan was secretly alarmed. This strike is already unbelievably fast after tearing through the worldly law’s restrictions. With the changed time flow, it’s even faster.
Below the Heaven Earth realm, this strike is invincible. Meng Chuan understood the limits of his paramount technique. However, Heaven Earth realm experts can withstand the worldly laws with just their Heaven Earth domains. Their speed is also unimaginably high. When an Imperial Lord flies at normal speed, they would be able to travel thousands of kilometers in a second. With my current strength, I can’t deal with two Heaven Earth realm demon sages at the same time with just Infinite Saber. Infinite Saber is currently at the Grotto-Heaven realm’s early stage.
A paramount technique was very terrifying. Although Infinite Saber was only at the Grotto-Heaven realm’s early stage, it was invincible beneath the Heaven Earth. It was infinitely close to having the strength of a Heaven Earth realm technique. However, if he wanted to defeat a Heaven Earth realm expert, he needed to continue improving the paramount technique.
As long as Infinite Saber reaches the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm, I will be able to kill an Imperial Lord. Humanity will definitely win this war. Meng Chuan’s eyes flashed.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan instantly tore through the air.
High in the sky, Meng Chuan tested his new movement technique repeatedly. Since Meng Chuan had already comprehended the Infinite Saber Art, he only needed two hours to deduce the corresponding movement technique.
Boom!
Everything slowed down.
Meng Chuan flew across the world at high speeds. He felt like he had forcefully torn through the worldly law’s suppression, causing his speed to rise to an astonishing level.
An Imperial Lord used their Heaven Earth domain to block the worldly laws, allowing them an easy flight. Meng Chuan’s paramount technique forcefully tore through the worldly laws’ restrictions that suppressed his speed. It was much more difficult to achieve.
If I don’t use the Bloodblade Disc, I can fly 600 kilometers in a second with just my body. If I factor in the changed time flow, I can travel 50 times faster. In other words, I can travel over 30,000 kilometers in a second! With this speed, I can reach one end of Archean Eon Realm in a second from anywhere within the Great Zhou Dynasty.
Meng Chuan sighed inwardly.
Although Infinite Saber had just reached the Grotto-Heaven realm’s early stage, this paramount technique of his had gradually revealed his terrifying strength. It granted him astonishing speed, further complemented by the changed time!
I’ll make a trip to Archean Mountain and tell Master and the others about this, thought Meng Chuan. They are currently frustrated over how to guard the super-large city passes. Each of my nine Essence Soul avatars can guard a super-large city pass.
A super-large city pass faced the threat of fifth Firmament demon monarchs. One of Meng Chuan’s seventh-level Essence Soul avatars was enough to guard a super-large city pass.
Whoosh.
With a flash, the scenery in front of him blurred. He had already traversed over 5,000 kilometers and arrived at Archean Mountain.
I’m here. Meng Chuan stood in front of Archean Mountain’s Grotto-Heaven Pavilion.

chapters.title: Chapter 484 - The Rising Hope of Dawn for the Human World
chapters.content:
Chapter 484 The Rising Hope of Dawn for the Human World
Archean Mountain, Grotto-Heaven Pavilion.
“Meng Chuan is here.” Li Guan stood in the courtyard as Qin Wu and Luo Tang’s illusory figures appeared beside him.
“In the past half-month, he didn’t reunite with his children. Instead, he visited every place he and Liu Qiyue lived in before,” said Luo Tang in surprise. “But now, he’s suddenly looking for us. Did he make a decision?”
The illusory Qin Wu frowned slightly. He was somewhat worried. His concern for Meng Chuan made him worried. Qin Wu was very concerned about this genius disciple of his that had been focused on slaying demons for many years. He was afraid that this genius disciple’s personality would change drastically, affecting his cultivation path.
“He’s here.” Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang looked over. Meng Chuan had already arrived in the courtyard.
“Greetings, Supremacies, Master,” said Meng Chuan humbly. “He looks fine. Very calm,” said Luo Tang via voice transmission.
“He looks normal.” Li Guan and Qin Wu felt relieved.
Li Guan smiled. “Meng Chuan, why are you here?”
“My Essence Soul has just broken through to the seventh level,” said Meng Chuan directly. “Seventh-level Essence Soul?” Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang were stunned by Meng Chuan’s words.
Although the Essence Soul of Meng Chuan’s first six levels rose quite quickly, the further he progressed, the harder it became. It had only been 20 years since Meng Chuan attained a sixth-level Essence Soul, but now it had already reached the seventh level?
Qin Wu couldn’t help but ask, “Meng Chuan, did you really break through?”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. At the same time, nine dark Essence Soul avatars flew out of his body and landed beside him. Meng Chuan’s nine Essence Soul avatars stood in the courtyard.
Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang’s eyes lit up. “Meng Chuan, do you know who attained a seventh-level Essence Soul the fastest in human history before you came along?” asked Luo Tang.
“I know. It was Myriad Sword Island Lord,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “When he was 153 years old, he attained a seventh-level Essence Soul. However, he failed to attain an eighth-level Essence Soul his entire life.”
an
Li Guan said, “The further one’s Essence Soul advances, the harder it becomes to break through. Senior Myriad Sword Island Lord attained a sixth-level Essence Soul at the age of 96. He attained a seventh-level Essence Soul at the age of 153. As for you, you’re only 99 years old this year, right? However, you have already attained a seventh-level Essence Soul. You attained a seventh-level Essence Soul 50 years faster than Senior Myriad Sword Island Lord.”
Meng Chuan also understood that there had been many factors that contributed to his breakthrough. The key factor was the creation of his paramount technique. If he hadn’t created the paramount technique-which boosted his Essence Soul’s growth greatly-it would’ve probably taken him several more years.
“This is great,” said Luo Tang excitedly. “The pressure on the super-large city passes has been increasing recently. Meng Chuan now has nine Essence Soul avatars. Every Essence Soul avatar can carry Quintessential Essence. With the Cloud Dragon Snake Saber Art, his Essence Soul avatars are able to guard a super-large city pass. Even if his Essence Soul avatar’s Quintessential Essence reserves are exhausted, Meng Chuan can immediately send another Essence Soul avatar to swap defenses.”
Li Guan and Qin Wu nodded slightly. “Yes.”
“Meng Chuan, if you become a Creation Supremacy, your Quintessential Essence will undergo a qualitative change. Once you become a Creation Supremacy, you will be able to activate a super-large city pass’s array formation,” said Li guan. “With the array formation aiding your Essence Soul avatars, it will be even easier for them to guard a super-large city pass.”
Every super-large city pass contained an array formation. These fixed array formations could unleash extremely terrifying might. However, one needed Creation Quintessential Essence to activate them! Activating the array formation with Seamless Quintessential Essence would cause the array formation to weaken greatly.
“I will become a Creation Supremacy in the near future,” said Meng Chuan. “You plan on breaking through?” The illusory Qin Wu was surprised, but he quickly nodded. “That’s right. Paramount techniques are too difficult to create. Even in the outer realm’s countless worlds, it’s extremely rare for one to create a paramount technique. Nobody in humanity’s history has ever created a paramount technique!
“Your Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique is already an impressive ultimate technique. You’ve already reached the Grotto-Heaven realm’s late stage with the technique. It shows that you have great potential for the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique’s path. With it as your foundation, you will have a limitless future as a Creation Supremacy.” “Master, I’ve already created a paramount technique,” said Meng Chuan. “I plan on consolidating my foundation and making a trip to the World Gap. I want to see if I can find Holy Lady Strings. Once I kill her, I’ll immediately break through to become a Creation Supremacy.”
Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang listened to his words dazedly.
Killing Holy Lady Strings? The three of them didn’t care about that. They only cared about...
“You created a paramount technique?” Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang looked at Meng Chuan as though they were looking at a monster.
“An important figure is about to appear in our human world.” Li Guan stared at Meng Chuan and said, “Ever since Ancestral Master Archean Eon, our human world’s descendants have been relatively mediocre. They are worlds apart from Ancestral Master Archean Eon. Now, there’s finally a genius that can approach Ancestral Master Archean Eon!”
“You actually managed to create a paramount technique yourself?” Qin Wu and Luo Tang were shocked as well.
They had only read about such peerless geniuses in Archean Mountain’s dossiers. They were legendary figures in the outer realm. Anyone who created a paramount technique was a legend.
Now, such a legend was in front of them; he was also an Archean Mountain Godfiend!
At this moment, Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang seemed to see a peerless expert that was close to Ancestral Master Archean Eon gradually rising. The human world welcomed a dazzling era once again.
Meng Chuan looked at the three people in front of him. “Supremacies, Master?”
“Meng Chuan,” said Qin Wu immediately. “You have to keep your self-created paramount technique a secret. Don’t tell anybody about it.”
“Yes. There will be trouble if the demons learn of it,” said Li Guan. “Of course, no one can threaten you in the human world. However, with your talent, you will have to go to the outer realm in the future. There are all kinds of experts in the outer realm. Even in the outer realm, your self-created paramount technique has to be kept a secret. It will also reduce a lot of your future troubles.”
Meng Chuan nodded. This was the same advice he had once received from Fairy Meng long ago. It was always good to hide his trump cards.
“I remember. It’s recorded in the books left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon,” said Meng Chuan. “If one wants to be certain that it’s a paramount technique, one has to be Fifth Tribulation Eminence at the very least before they can see through the moves’ profundities with a single glance. Therefore, as long as I’m careful, no one will be able to recognize it for what it is when I use it.”
“That’s a matter for when you’re adventuring in the outer realm. Let’s talk about it later,” said Li Guan with a smile. “Are you planning on consolidating your strength and making a trip to the World Gap?”.
Meng Chuan nodded. “Once I become a Creation Supremacy, I won’t be able to go to the World Gap again. Therefore, I’ll take this opportunity to get rid of Holy Lady Strings. However, it’s difficult to estimate how long it will be before she enters. I might have to wait for a year or two.”
Among the fifth Firmament demon monarchs, Monarch Peacock, Holy Lady Strings, and Patriarch Poison Dragon posed the greatest threat. Now that Monarch Peacock had left for the outer realm and Patriarch Poison Dragon was dead, Meng Chuan decided to kill Holy Lady Strings before he broke through.
“It’s up to you,” said Qin Wu with a smile.
“By the way, Meng Chuan, what has your paramount technique focused on?” asked Luo Tang. Li Guan and Qin Wu also looked at Meng Chuan curiously. “It’s very similar to Senior Guo Ke’s Heaven Earth realm move from Heart Intent Saber,” said Meng Chuan. “It has about 70 to 80 percent of the Heart Intent Saber move’s might.”
“It’s very similar to the Heart Intent Saber move—which is at the Heaven Earth realm?” Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang were secretly alarmed.
With this single move, Senior Guo Ke had been invincible in his era as a Regis Godfiend.
Creation Supremacies could not see his strike or defend against it. They would only realize that their opponent had moved once they were struck.
“By using my paramount technique, I’m much faster than before,” said Meng Chuan. “In a second, I can reach anywhere in the human world. Future reinforcements will be much faster than before.”
“Alright.”
“Got it.” Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang nodded in agreement.
After a while, Meng Chuan left Archean Mountain.
Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang were silent for a long time.
“I’m relieved.” Li Guan finally spoke. “Although I’m only a few decades away from the end of my life and probably won’t see the end of this war, I’m relieved. With Meng Chuan around, even if we are momentarily disadvantaged in this war, we will ultimately
win.”
“It’s been so many years since a monstrous expert has appeared. It looks like our human world is about to produce another Tribulation Eminence,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “This feeling of my disciple becoming a Tribulation Eminence is really...”
“Look at how smug you are,” Luo Tang said with a smile. “Regardless, I feel much more relaxed now.”
“I can still live for a long time. With the Millennium Instant mystic technique’s help, I can live even longer,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “I want to see how far my disciple, Meng Chuan, can take our human world.”
“I’m younger than you,” said Luo Tang with a smile.
Li Guan smiled and nodded. “I’m reminding the two of you to keep an eye on Meng Chuan. Since it’s a time like this, we need Meng Chuan to be more careful. He mustn’t take any unnecessary risks. Us humans have waited for such a person to appear for many years. We can’t have him die midway.”
Qin Wu nodded immediately. “Don’t worry. I’ll keep an eye on him.”

chapters.title: Chapter 485 - Sudden Change in Cultivation
chapters.content:
Chapter 485 Sudden Change in Cultivation
Snow fluttered everywhere as an ordinary-looking carriage advanced. The carriage driver was a muscular man.
In fact, this carriage driver was a demon servant with strength close to a fourth Firmament demon monarch. When Meng Chuan had been wiping out the demons in the world, he had captured a large number of powerful demon servants.
“Giddy-up!” The carriage traveled through the snow.
Yang Yuan sat within the carriage. He looked out through the window, but he had other thoughts on his mind.
I’ll be participating in Archean Mountain’s entrance examination in a month. Yang Yuan pondered. Which Godfiend body formulation should I choose? He wasn’t worried about not passing the assessment.
Ever since the demons’ large-scale invasion decades ago, many Godfiends were sent out to patrol various regions in the vast world. Archean Mountain had also greatly increased their recruitment quota-recruiting 50 disciples every year instead of the original 20. They increased their recruitment quota because the next 100 to 200 years were the war’s most critical period. With the treasures and rare items obtained from the World Gap, the three major sects were able to sustain the expenditures of these new disciples for 100 to 200 years. With 50 available spots, Yang Yuan was naturally confident of being admitted into Archean Mountain. He even had hopes of achieving first place in the entrance examination.
Achieving first place is just so I don’t disappoint my family. It’s not that important. My main concern is which transcendent-grade Godfiend body I should choose. Yang Yuan carefully pondered his choice. What has aided me most in my cultivation? It’s grandfather’s guidance! Grandfather is unspokenly the strongest Godfiend in the world after cultivating for only 100 years. His future achievements will be even greater. Therefore, my best choice is to choose the same cultivation path as my grandfather—the lightning lineage. It’ll be easier for Grandpa to guide me if I cultivate the lightning lineage. If I choose another path, Grandpa’s insights towards it might not be deep or profound enough. There are only two transcendent-grade Godfiend bodies of the lightning lineage. One is the Lightning Devastator Fiend Body, and the other is the Eon Sea Fiend Body.
I naturally want to aim for a perfected Godfiend Body. The Lightning Devastator Fiend Body... its requirements for one’s willpower are terrifying. I don’t think I can achieve the perfected Nine Refinements, even if I’m given a few centuries. Although Yang Yuan was hard on himself, he was still used to enjoying a comfortable life. Therefore, the Eon Sea Fiend Body-which has a lower cultivation difficulty-suits me better.
Eon Sea Fiend Body, lightning lineage sword art. It’s settled then. Yang Yuan decided on his future path. Although he could cozy up to other famous figures, he realized that he had benefited greatly from his grandfather’s guidance. Yang Yuan often felt enlightened whenever Meng Chuan gave him some guidance.
What he didn’t know was that his uncle—King Feather Dragon, Meng An-was much inferior when it came to guiding disciples compared to Meng Chuan. After all, Meng An’s cultivation path was arranged by Ancestral Master Archean Eon.
The carriage entered Meng Manor. Soon, Yang Yuan headed to Lake Heart Pavilion alone.
At a glance, he saw the white-haired Meng Chuan sitting cross-legged in the open space in front of Lake Heart Pavilion. His surroundings seemed slightly distorted
Swoosh.
When Yang Yuan walke Pavilion, he noticed the changed time flow.
What’s going on? He was astonished when he discovered a bizarre phenomenon. As he walked past different places, he could see the snowflakes in the distance falling at different speeds. At some places, the snowflakes would fall at normal speed. In other places, the snowflakes would fall much slower than usual; some even stopped falling completely. All the snowflakes and rippling water seemed to have come to a standstill.
Yang Yuan was shocked.
Time had been distorted. Different regions had different time dilations.
Suddenly,
Everything-including the distorted spacetime — returned to normal. Countless snowflakes floated in the air. The white-haired Meng Chuan opened his eyes and stood up. The Bloodblades flew into his palm and vanished.
“Grandpa.” Yang Yuan walked to Lake Heart Pavilion and bowed respectfully. “Yang Yuan, I’ll give you two hours of guidance today.” Meng Chuan looked at his grandson and said, “I’ll give you pointers again in half a month. After that, go to Archean Mountain and cultivate well.”
“Yes, Grandpa.” Yang Yuan was extremely respectful.
“Show me your swordplay,” instructed Meng Chuan.
Yang Yuan immediately began demonstrating his swordplay.
Meng Chuan had recently taught him his sword technique–Three Sword Art. Three Sword Art consisted of three moves—Wave Splitting Sword, Yin-Yang Sword, and Flowing Light Sword. These were Infinite Saber’s three basic lightning lineage forms.
Yang Yuan had to execute each of these three moves 5,000 times a day! This was Meng Chuan’s request for Yang Yuan.
“Flowing Light Sword.” Yang Yuan instantly struck out with his sword. Like a bolt of lightning, it streaked across the sky.
“Yin-Yang Sword.” His body followed the sword beam, instantly leaving multiple afterimages as he moved. “Wave Splitting Sword.” A sword shadow flashed.
Meng Chuan watched from the side.
Yang Yuan stopped and looked at Meng Chuan. “Continue practicing. Practice the same way you always do at home,” instructed Meng Chuan. “Don’t stop unless I tell you to.”
“Yes.” Yang Yuan continued demonstrating his sword art. As he demonstrated the sword art, he followed the same move order: Flowing Light Sword, Yin-Yang Sword, and Wave Splitting Sword.
“Stop.” After executing the three moves 100 times, Meng Chuan shouted for Yang Yuan to stop.
“I taught you Three Sword Art half a month ago. Tell me, what do you think about the sword art?” asked Meng Chuan.
Yang Yuan hesitated for a moment before saying, “Grandfather, do the three sword moves have to be demonstrated in the exact order of Flowing Light Sword, Yin-Yang Sword, and Wave Splitting Sword? Furthermore, the more I cultivate, the more I can draw upon the moves’ intents. Flowing Light Sword can be used in many other ways. Wave Splitting Sword can also be executed as a sword drawing technique.”
Meng Chuan smiled. “Yes, you’re right.”
Yang Yuan’s eyes lit up. He felt good about himself after being praised by his grandfather.
“However, before you have comprehended Sword Dao, follow the three sword moves I’ve given you,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “You are not allowed to modify them. Practice each move 5,000 times a day. You have to persevere.”
“I’m not allowed to change them before comprehending Sword Dao?” Yang Yuan was overjoyed.
He could tell that cultivating just this seemingly basic Three Sword Art was enough for him to reach the Realm of Dao.
Unbeknownst to him, Meng Chuan had combined these three forms-Flash Form of Lightning, Yin-Yang Form of Lightning, and Wave Splitting Forms of Lightning—to create his paramount technique, Infinite Saber.
The way he had fused these three forms could be said to be the most ingenious in human history! He had specially created the three sword moves for Yang Yuan. At Meng Chuan’s level, there wasn’t much difference between saber techniques and sword techniques. An intent could be infused into a saber art. The very same intent could also be infused into a movement technique. It could also be infused into the Bloodblade Disc.
In fact, Meng Chuan even planned on simplifying his Infinite Saber so that his juniors could learn it. After simplifying it, it would just be a weaker Black Metal Sutra ultimate technique.
...
“I’ve taught you enough today.” Meng Chuan looked at Yang Yuan, who was in a sorry state. He smiled and said, “I’ll demonstrate Three Sword Art again. Each sword move will be executed very slowly. Sense the intent carefully.”
“Yes.” Yang Yuan stared at Meng Chuan intently.
Meng Chuan extended his right hand and condensed a Quintessential Essence sword.
“Flowing Light Sword.” Meng Chuan’s seemingly slow strike was actually very slow, but it caused the void to distort. Ripples appeared as the strike pierced through many void layers.
“Yin-Yang Sword.” Meng Chuan followed the sword beam as it swam through the void like a fish. He moved through the void, changing directions multiple times. Many afterimages appeared around him before he returned to his original spot.
“Wave Splitting Sword.” Meng Chuan’s sword parted the void in the same way water parted. The sword beam sliced through the void and struck Starmoon Lake’s surface, which was more than half a kilometer away. The sword’s tip touched the surface, but in the next second, it had already retracted.
“Think over the three sword moves carefully. Go back and continue practicing,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
He had also demonstrated these three moves previously. Back then, he placed greater importance on the three moves’ accuracy. After half a month of cultivation, Yang Yuan’s moves were considered accurate enough.
This time, Meng Chuan placed greater importance on intent during the demonstration.
“Yes, Grandpa.” Yang Yuan was extremely excited. He bowed respectfully before leaving. His mind was filled with scenes of his grandfather demonstrating the three moves to him. The intent within the three saber moves completely shocked him.
Meng Chuan was still very willing to teach his grandson. His son, Meng An, was already walking the path that Ancestral Master Archean Eon had arranged for him. Thus, he had nothing to teach him. His daughter, Meng You, was already a Marquis Godfiend. Her cultivation path was different from his, so he could only give her limited guidance. As for his grandson, Yang Yuan, he appeared to like the lightning lineage.
Meng Chuan’s days in Jiang State Capital were very peaceful. He only gave Yang Yuan pointers once every half-month. He spent the rest of his time cultivating and consolidating his paramount technique, Infinite Saber.
In the blink of an eye, it was 19th December.
In a chamber in Lake Heart Pavilion.
I’ve already recultivated my Magic Awl. Once I purify my Quintessential Essence, I’ll head to the World Gap. Meng Chuan sat cross-legged and immersed his consciousness into his dantian space.
In the dantian space.
The Source of the Seamless Realm was a purple-brown sphere that was smaller than normal particles. Blazing-white patterns covered its surface. Wisps of white light shot out from the sphere’s two poles, forming a Seamless Wave domain.
Cultivation in the Seamless realm was to make the Source of the Seamless Realm smaller. The smaller it was, the purer and stronger one’s Quintessential Essence became. When the Source of the Seamless Realm contained a large amount of energy, it would cause the sphere to shrink. The smaller the sphere was, the more robust one’s foundation would be.
With a more robust foundation, one’s future grotto-heaven would be larger than the average.
My dantian space has long expanded to its limits. Now that I have a seventh-level Essence Soul and created a paramount technique, Infinite Saber, I’ll definitely be able to forge a more robust foundation. With these two things aiding me, I’ll be able to cultivate my Source of the Seamless Realm to an unprecedented level for human Godfiends. As Meng Chuan thought this, his Essence Soul seeped into his Source of the Seamless Realm.
A seventh-level Essence Soul was extremely powerful. It granted him much better control over the sphere. As Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul controlled the purple-brown sphere, it slowly shrank due to the suppression. The sphere constantly absorbed external energy as it shrank, causing its density to increase. His Quintessential Essence became purer. At the same time, Infinite Saber’s laws began to replace the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique’s. Infinite Saber’s laws now governed the purple-brown sphere. After the sphere’s governing laws changed
Boom!
The purple-brown sphere now rotated according to the new laws. As it rotated, the sphere suddenly collapsed and turned into a black hole.

chapters.title: Chapter 486 - Breakthrough to become a Supremacy?
chapters.content:
Chapter 486 Breakthrough to become a Supremacy?
After the purple-brown sphere collapsed and transformed into a black hole, the black hole rapidly expanded and filled the entire dantian space. A monstrous suction force spread out in the outside world.
The Bloodblade Disc and Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead were expelled from his dantian space and were hidden in Meng Chuan’s pocket for the time being
Boom!
This suction force is too terrifying. Meng Chuan didn’t dare to absorb the Heaven and Earth powers from the outside world. Instead, he absorbed the Grotto-Heaven Origins energy from his Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead. In just a few seconds, he devoured half of his tiny Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead’s Origins energy like a whale. What is this absorption speed? I can completely absorb a small grotto-heaven’s energy in just six seconds? Meng Chuan was secretly alarmed. With a single movement, he disappeared from the chamber in Lake Heart Pavilion. He arrived at a desolate lake Three Mountain Lake—that was hundreds of kilometers away.
Lake Heart Island was only 300 feet wide. There were only weeds and rocks.
Meng Chuan appeared out of thin air and sat cross-legged on the island.
Three Mountain Lake was a large lake. It was over a hundred kilometers long and over 50 kilometers wide.
“What happened?”
“What’s wrong?”
“Not good! Help!”
Some of the fishermen on Three Mountain Lake had just cast their nets while others were rowing their boats. They became extremely alarmed when the scenery in front of them changed suddenly. When they came back to their senses, they realized that they, along with their boats, had been transported to a large river. “This is the Ancient Mang River. It’s tens of kilometers away from Three Mountain Lake. Why am I here?” “I was just at Three Mountain Lake.”
“I didn’t lose anything. My half-bowl of food is still here, but I was clearly at Three Mountain Lake just now.”
The fishermen were dumbfounded.
With a thought, Meng Chuan had teleported all the fishermen away from Three Mountain Lake.
а
Following that, he no longer suppressed himself. He allowed the black hole in his dantian space to devour the outside world’s powers. Immediately, the Heaven and Earth powers seemed to be devoured by a whale.
Boom!
A large amount of Heaven and Earth powers were sucked into his dantian space amidst thunderous booms. The gathered Heaven and Earth powers began to liquefy as they were absorbed into Meng Chuan’s dantian space, transforming into Quintessential Essence.
With Meng Chuan at the center, as if they were sucked into a huge vortex, the rich Heaven and Earth powers within half a kilometer surged towards him.
Within 50 kilometers of Meng Chuan, the world had turned dark. The boundless Heaven and Earth powers in the distance constantly gathered here, forming a massive dark vortex. Dark clouds gathered about the chaotic vortex as lightning crackled. Thunder boomed as inconspicuous bolts of heavenly lightning struck the massive dark vortex.
Why is my dantian absorbing so much energy from the outside world? Meng Chuan was shocked by the situation. He could clearly sense everything happening around him. A dark vortex-50 kilometers wide—had formed around him. The areas further away from the dark vortex remained relatively calm thanks to the worldly laws. The entire Archean Eon Realm breathed at this moment. Normally, the world just absorbed energy from outside and converted it into the gentle Heaven and Earth powers—which nurtured all living beings within the world. However, at this moment, Archean Eon Realm’s absorption amount had increased greatly. It absorbed more and more energy from the outside each time.
Large amounts of Heaven and Earth powers gathered around Three Mountain Lake and surged towards Meng Chuan.
As a middle-level world, Archean Eon Realm could supply sufficient energy to its inhabitants, even if several Imperial Lords broke through at the same time.
Although Meng Chuan was absorbing an astonishing amount of energy, it was relatively easy for a large, middle-level world to cope with.
“What happened?”
“Such a huge commotion?”
“Why is there such a huge commotion in Jiang State Capital?”
The human world’s Creation Supremacies could sense the large commotion coming from Jiang State Capital. The commotion was much more eye-catching than when the world membranes were being blasted open.
Even Regis Godfiends that were 500 kilometers away from Meng Chuan could sense the commotion.
Whoosh.
Li Guan waved his hand as Qin Wu and Luo Tang’s illusory figures appeared beside him. It was still daytime, but the area around Three Mountain Lake was very dark. The surging Heaven and Earth powers were sucked into a massive vortex. Dark clouds covered the area as bolts of lightning struck the dark vortex.
“I can’t see anything.” On Two World Island, Xu Yingwu and the illusory Zhang Chun could only see darkness through their prying treasure. “The Heaven and Earth powers have gathered. Such might... Something major must have happened. However, I can’t see what is happening in the dark vortex’s depths.”
“Something special must have happened at the Great Zhou Dynasty’s Three Mountain Lake.” Bai Yaoyue, the illusory Meng Tiange, and the illusory Mi Yu observed the situation through their prying treasure as well. Even the Demon Annihilation Guild Master, Jing Fei, and the black-robed demon sage, North Sense, noticed the commotion at Three Mountain Lake.
“It’s beside Jiang State Capital. Have Meng Chuan take a look,” said Qin Wu.
“Alright.” Li Guan nodded before frowning slightly. “Meng Chuan is right there. I’ll get my Essence Soul avatar to take a look.”
What’s going on? Meng An flew out from Jiang State Capital and into the sky. He looked towards Three Mountain Lake.
It was currently daytime, but the region around the Three Mountain Lake was dark. Dark clouds covered the area, and lightning flashed from time to time. Furthermore, the Heaven and Earth powers in Jiang State Capital were somewhat affected by the phenomenon. The Heaven and Earth powers were being sucked towards Three Mountain Lake.
Jiang State Capital is hundreds of kilometers away from Three Mountain Lake. However, the Heaven and Earth powers here are still affected? What is happening at Three Mountain Lake. Meng An was secretly alarmed. He was Jiang State Capital’s guardian Godfiend, so he didn’t dare leave the city.
Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar wasn’t anxious. From his point of view, Meng Chuan would arrive first, and he was enough to control the situation.
Whoosh.
Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar tore through the air and arrived at Three Mountain Lake’s periphery. He could see the dark scenery before him.
A large amount of Heaven and Earth powers are gathered here? It even caused a phenomenon. Li Guan was alarmed when he saw this. He continued flying forward. The black clouds, lightning, and chaotic Heaven and Earth powers were unable to threaten Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar. He quickly flew to the center of the dark vortex.
The Heaven and Earth powers—which had completely liquefied-surged towards the figure in the middle of the dark vortex.
Li Guan could clearly sense the figure in the dark vortex’s center with his Essence Soul perception domain.
Meng Chuan? He could clearly sense the white-haired man sitting cross-legged in the middle of the vortex as the liquefied Heaven and Earth powers gravitated towards the man.
The commotion caused by absorbing the Heaven and Earth powers is too great. Li Guan was secretly alarmed. Has Meng Chuan broken through and become a Creation Supremacy? With his insights, he will definitely create an unprecedented grotto-heaven. With a seventh-level Essence Soul and a paramount technique, he will definitely be able to absorb an unimaginable amount of Heaven and Earth powers. His created grotto-heaven will be far more powerful than all the other historical Creation Supremacies’.
His mad absorption of the Heaven and Earth powers has caused a commotion ten times greater than an ordinary Creation Supremacy’s breakthrough. However, Meng Chuan said that he would head to the World Gap to look for Holy Lady Strings after he consolidated his strength. He said he would rather wait a year or two in the World Gap to kill it. Why is he breaking through in advance? Li Guan was somewhat puzzled.
Furthermore, breaking through to the Creation realm is an extremely important matter. Why didn’t he break through at Archean Mountain? Why is he breaking through at the empty Three Mountain Lake? Li Guan was puzzled.
“Supremacy, please help me set up an array formation to envelop the entire Three Mountain Lake.” A voice sounded in Li Guan’s ears. “I need to cultivate here for a period of time. I don’t wish to be disturbed. The array formation just needs to be able to prevent others from spying on me.”
Li Guan nodded. “Alright.”
It wasn’t difficult for him to set up an array formation. Every super-large city pass had a large-scale array formation set up. Meng Chuan’s requirements for this array formation were much lower. All this array formation had to do was guard against prying eyes and disturbances.
“I’ll quickly arrange the array formation. When the time comes, I’ll get King Feather Dragon to protect you,” said Li Guan. “Meng Chuan, are you breaking through to become a Creation Supremacy?”
Meng Chuan was silent for a moment before he said, “I’m not sure either.”

chapters.title: Chapter 487 - One Year and Two Months
chapters.content:
Chapter 487 One Year and Two Months
“You’re not sure?” Li Guan was somewhat dazed. He isn’t even sure if he’s breaking through? Is this something one should be unsure about?
“While I was cultivating, a situation that has never occurred in the Godfiend cultivation system happened.” Meng Chuan’s voice rang out. “I’ll explain it in detail after I finish cultivating.”
“Alright, focus on your cultivation.” Li Guan was alarmed as well. An accident happened during his cultivation? This wasn’t something that they could afford to be careless about. “I’ll set up the array formation immediately.”
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged on Lake Heart Island. His dantian space constantly absorbed the rich liquefied Heaven and Earth powers.
What’s happening? Meng Chuan looked inwardly at his dantian. The black hole was like a bottomless pit as it devoured the Heaven and Earth powers.
Archean Eon Realm’s predecessors created the Godfiend cultivation system. Meng Chuan thought about the cultivation system. Core Cloud realm, Indestructible realm, Great Solar realm, Darkstar realm, and Seamless realm. These are the five major Godfiend realms. They all follow one core concept. By refining the Heaven and Earth powers and condensing them in one’s dantian, one’s Quintessential Essence will become purer as the density increases.
His predecessors created the cultivation system in a straightforward manner, but the creation process had been very difficult. Many early Godfiends had failed and died during the creation of the cultivation system. Only after generations of experimentation did they complete the Godfiend cultivation system and produce many types of Godfiend body formulations.
The Seamless realm is the limit of Quintessential Essence compression. If Quintessential Essence is to be improved further, then the path of compression is no longer usable. It isn’t feasible to achieve a qualitative change in Quintessential Essence once it reaches the limit. Therefore, our predecessors used another method to improve their Quintessential Essence. With their Source of the Seamless Realm as the foundation, they created their own grotto-heavens and reached the Creation realm!
After that, their grotto-heavens will transform into inner heaven and earth, turning them into an Imperial Lord. As for me... With my seventh-level Essence Soul and my paramount technique’s laws controlling the Source of the Seamless realm, it collapsed and formed a black hole. In the past, the Source of the Seamless realm represented the limit of Quintessential Essence compression. However, I seem to have induced some special changes.
Meng Chuan was very cautious about this unexpected event. While it was a good thing to achieve unprecedented changes, it also represented stepping into the unknown. In humanity’s history, many of Meng Chuan’s predecessors had died to create the Godfiend cultivation system. Although Meng Chuan had tenacious vitality and a high technique realm, he was still extremely cautious. He didn’t even bother letting his Essence Soul avatars outside of his body. If anything happened to his main body, his Essence Soul avatars would die!
“Meng An, from today onwards, guard the array formation here,” instructed Li Guan. “Guard your father well.”
“My father?” Meng An was alarmed.
“You can go closer and take a look,” said Li Guan.
Meng An immediately flew towards the middle of the lake. As he approached the dark vortex’s center, he saw the gathered Heaven and Earth powers surging towards the dark vortex. With his Essence Soul perception domain, he saw the white-haired man sitting cross-legged in the middle of the vortex.
“Dad,” said Meng An.
“An’er, you just have to stop outsiders from approaching,” said Meng Chuan via voice transmission.
“Alright, I’ll definitely guard you well.” After Meng Chuan learned that his father was the one who had caused the huge commotion, he was naturally concerned and anxious. However, he still did his best to protect him.
Time passed.
Meng An sat cross-legged on Three Mountain Lake’s shore. He controlled the entire array formation to protect his father.
“Dad...” Meng An looked at Lake Heart Island. A terrifying, dark aura erupted from it.
m
What is Dad cultivating? Why is his aura much more terrifying than that of a Creation Supremacy? Meng An stared at Lake Heart Island from afar. The black aura erupted from the island as lightning flashed within the dark vortex. I think I’ll die if I approach it.
Due to his high realm, his perception was very accurate.
Boom!
Occasionally, lightning would shoot out in all directions, transforming the surroundings into a lightning dominion.
After half a month, the lightning was confined to the endless darkness. The darkness made Meng An’s heart palpitate.
Dad must have restrained his strength. When cultivating, his energy is kept within a five-kilometer radius, thought Meng An to himself. However, is Dad already this strong?
Meng An had many fortuitous encounters. He was one of the human world’s strongest Regis Godfiend. His father, Meng Chuan, was also a Regis Godfiend. So why was the strength difference between the two so great?
Just his father’s leaking energy was enough to kill him?
Three Mountain Lake had been dark for a long time. The black clouds and lightning naturally attracted the attention of many people. All were extremely puzzled by the phenomenon, be they mortal or Godfiend. Although the array formation enveloped Meng Chuan’s surrounding 50 kilometers, Meng Chuan’s absorption range was just too great. The Heaven and Earth Powers from Jiang State Capital—which was a few hundred kilometers away-collectively surged towards Three Mountain Lake.
I wonder what happened. Archean Mountain has forbidden all parties from investigating. Bai Yaoyue’s Essence Soul avatar flew high in the sky. When it passed by, she glanced at Three Mountain Lake before leaving. The three sects were now working together to fight a common enemy.
Archean Mountain had forbidden all parties from investigating matters that happened in the Great Zhou Dynasty. Thus, it wasn’t appropriate for the other sects’ Creation Supremacies to barge in. “Nothing is turning up from our investigations.” The black-robed North Sense stared at Three Mountain Lake from afar. The demons had limited strength in the human world. They were unable to break through the obstructions that were King Feather Dragon, Meng An, and the array formation. They would only be sending themselves to their deaths if they tried to charge in.
Whoosh.
The black-robed North Sense embodiment dissipated.
There must be a huge secret in Three Mountain Lake. A merchant caravan was advancing. In a luxurious carriage, a middle-aged man lifted the curtain and looked at Three Mountain Lake from afar. The corners of his mouth curled into a smile. However, I don’t have the right to see this big secret. If I see it, I’ll die.
The middle-aged man’s gaze swept across the merchant caravan, and his smile became even more radiant. The human world is really interesting. The more things I experience here, the more interesting I find it compared to the Demon Realm. Seven emotions and six desires? I still have to thank Imperial Lord Starquix for forcing me to come to the human world. In the human world, I might be able to cultivate the karma lineage to the Heaven Earth realm.
I can still live for a long time. No rush, no rush. The middle-aged man smiled. The three Imperial Lords have arranged for two old fellows that are about to die to enter the human world via possession. They still haven’t given up on their plans. Humph. After all, they know that I’m not good at close combat. I’m only skilled in using karmic mystic techniques. The middle-aged man was rather pleased. His smooth cultivation made him look forward to the future.
In the blink of an eye, one year and two months passed.
Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar had been stationed at Three Mountain Lake for a long time because he was nervous. Meng Chuan had been absorbing the Heaven and Earth powers for too long.
Back when I became a Creation Supremacy and formed my grotto-heaven, I only absorbed the Heaven and Earth powers for three days. Li Guan remained secretly alarmed. Meng Chuan has been absorbing the Heaven and Earth powers for one year and two months. The commotion he has caused is much greater too. He has absorbed at least 1,000 times more Heaven and Earth powers than I did when I was creating my grotto-heaven. What will happen when such a large amount of Heaven and Earth powers are gathered in his body?
Suddenly,
The rich Heaven and Earth powers that enveloped Three Mountain Lake rapidly gathered at the dark vortex’s core. The world began to calm down. The dark clouds dissipated. The sky turned clear, and Three Mountain Lake was extremely calm.
A white-haired man sat cross-legged on Lake Heart Island—which was now only 30 feet wide. The island had turned dark-cyan and crystalline.
“Dad.” Meng An revealed a look of delight.
“Let’s go over,” said Li Guan.
Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar and Meng An quickly streaked across the sky and flew towards Meng Chuan. They landed on the lake and stared at Meng Chuan. Li Guan and Meng An felt their hearts skip a beat when they looked at Meng Chuan from a close distance.
The white-haired Meng Chuan opened his eyes.
“Meng Chuan, how is it?” asked Li Guan.
“There are some changes,” said Meng Chuan.
After Meng Chuan discovered that his transformation was complete, he first checked his lifespan.
Regis Godfiends had 500-year lifespans. Their lifespans could be reduced when affected by physical injuries and other factors. If they maintained their body well, they might live a little longer. However, a Regis Godfiend’s lifespan usually spanned 500 years.
Creation realm experts had 2,000-year lifespans.
Meng Chuan was somewhat puzzled. How did my lifespan extend to 5,000 years?

chapters.title: Chapter 488 - Supremacy Level
chapters.content:
Chapter 488 Supremacy Level
One’s lifespan wasn’t determined by the individual world’s laws, but the vast River of Spacetime’s laws.
There were many different cultivation systems. Some cultivation systems-like the Shura cultivation system, the Cosmos Body cultivation system, and many other special cultivation systems-granted one a 2,000-year lifespan once they reached the Creation realm! At the Imperial Lord realm, one would have a 10,000-year lifespan. The world was just like how one would gradually age. Although the past was over, the future held infinite possibilities. These were the River of Spacetime’s most basic operation rules.
Breaking the River of Spacetime’s basic operation rules was an unbelievable achievement. Just how powerful was a Sage Becoming realm expert—who followed the Cosmos Body cultivation system? Yet, they only had a 2,000-year lifespan. My lifespan is longer than that of a Creation Supremacy, but slightly shorter than an Imperial Lord’s. Meng Chuan’s heart suddenly stirred with excitement. After becoming Archean Mountain’s Sect Proprietor, he had read many of Archean Mountain’s secret documents. Due to his wife, he had also read about phoenixes. The information in that dossier has recorded a situation somewhat similar to mine.
As he thought that, Meng Chuan carefully inspected his body’s changes.
His dantian space had completely transformed into a black hole. Rings of pure lightning Quintessential Essence surrounded the black hole. The Bloodblade Disc and Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead had returned to his dantian space, However, they could only reside at the black hole’s periphery-where the lightning Quintessential Essence was released.
My body... Meng Chuan sensed every particle space with his Essence Soul thoughts.
Every particle space had turned into a black hole. Lightning Quintessential Essence revolved around each black hole. Every particle possessed strength even more terrifying than before. Meng Chuan’s body had gained terrifying strength.
I feel like I can easily tear open the world membrane just by extending my hand. Meng Chuan could sense the world membrane’s fragility with his domain.
Although an ordinary Regis Godfiend’s body becomes stronger after breaking through to the Creation realm, it won’t be as astonishingly strong as mine. Is this newfound strength related to my original Blood Droplet realm body, or is it related to my paramount technique and seventh-level Essence Soul? Meng Chuan had too many questions. This was a realm that no Godfiend in Archean Eon Realm had ever reached. After reaching this realm, Meng Chuan had far too many questions. However, he could only answer them by himself as he explored his new capabilities. Li Guan’s Essence Soul avatar asked, “Meng Chuan, what has changed?”
“Let’s go back to Archean Mountain before I slowly figure my body’s changes out,” said Meng Chuan.
He had yet to comprehend his current strength. He was even more puzzled about his future path. How was he to advance in the future?
Li Guan nodded. “Alright, let’s talk when we return to Archean Mountain.”
“An’er.” Meng Chuan looked at his son and was very pleased. He smiled and said, “It’s been hard on you for the past year.”
Meng An shook his head immediately. “Not at all.” He was very happy that he could do something for his father. After all, his father had guided him since he was young.
“Go back to Jiang State Capital and rest well,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “I’ll make a trip to Archean Mountain first.”
“Okay, Dad,” replied Meng An immediately.
Li Guan waved his hand, causing many disk arrays and other components to fly over from all directions. Li Guan waved his hand again, storing them away. “My Essence Soul avatar will continue patrolling the area. Meng Chuan, go directly to Archean Mountain,” said Li Guan with a smile. He and Meng An flew away.
Meng Chuan only moved when he saw them leave.
In the blink of an eye, he arrived in Archean Mountain’s Grotto-Heaven Pavilion.
What’s happened to my movement technique? Meng Chuan frowned slightly as he puzzled over the peculiarities in his movement technique.
“Meng Chuan.” Li Guan, the illusory Qin Wu, and the illusory Luo Tang were waiting for him.
“You are now...” Qin Wu and Luo Tang also noticed Meng Chuan’s changes. When they saw Meng Chuan, they felt fear and pressure.
“I might have broken through to the Creation realm,” said Meng Chuan. Following that, he shook his head in confusion. “However, I still have many questions. I’m very confused.”
“Confused?”
“What confusion can there be after a breakthrough?”
“The various problems that occur in the Godfiend cultivation system should be recorded in the books.” Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang looked at Meng Chuan strangely. Meng Chuan shook his head slightly. “Let me confirm if I have really broken through to the Creation realm.”
Meng Chuan, Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang arrived at Archean Mountain’s nameless mountain peak.
Boom!
With a wave of his hand, a lightning bolt shot out and tore through two world membranes. It tore open a passageway that was hundreds of wide. Through it, one could see the scenery on the other side.
“I’ll see if I can enter the World Gap.” Meng Chuan flew towards the opening, hoping that he could enter the World Gap.
His right hand extended towards the opening, but an invisible barrier strongly repelled it. Huh?
“The World Gap is repelling you. You are no longer a Regis Godfiend,” said Qin Wu. He then curiously asked, “Can’t you determine if you have reached the Creation realm by checking your lifespan or your created grotto-heaven?”
“I was cultivating normally,” said Meng Chuan. “Who would’ve known that my Source of the Seamless Realm would suddenly collapse completely when I was compressing it? After collapsing, it turned into a black hole.” Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang were shocked by his words. “A black hole?”
“You didn’t create a grotto-heaven?” asked Qin Wu anxiously.
Meng Chuan frowned. “No.”
Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang looked at each other and realized the problem.
“This will be troublesome,” said Qin Wu in a low voice. “Logically speaking, such accidents only happen in imperfect cultivation systems! Generations of predecessors have verified the Godfiend cultivation system’s completion. It should already be perfect, especially after Ancestral Master Archean Eon perfected it. However, you didn’t create a grotto-heaven after breaking through the Seamless realm. Instead, your Source of the Seamless Realm turned into a black hole, allowing you to become a Creation Supremacy?”
“Such a situation has never happened in history.” Qin Wu and Luo Tang were extremely solemn.
They had no experience with this anomalous change. This meant that Meng Chuan had to figure out everything by himself.
“How do you feel?” asked Qin Wu.
“A Grotto-Heaven domain typically has a 50-kilometer range,” said Meng Chuan. “However, I feel like my Seamless domain has gone one step further, but it only has a five-kilometer range.”
“A five-kilometer range? It’s even smaller than a Grotto-Heaven domain? Could it be that your breakthrough was very flawed?” Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang were somewhat worried.
“Let me try projecting my domain.” With a thought, Meng Chuan’s surrounding five kilometers descended into darkness. The domain had made everything within it turn completely dark.
The darkness devoured everything.
Surrounded by the darkness, Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang didn’t feel any harm, but they were inexplicably afraid.
“I can no longer sense the worldly laws,” said Li Guan solemnly.
“Yes, I can’t sense Archean Eon Realm’s laws.” Qin Wu and Luo Tang found it unbelievable. However, Meng Chuan felt something. His Darkness domain was an upgraded version of the Seamless domain; it had increased the repulsive force acting on the outside world. Even the worldly laws were forcefully repelled by the domain! “An Imperial Lord’s Heaven Earth domain can isolate the worldly laws.” Luo Tang looked at Meng Chuan in disbelief. “Your domain can actually isolate the worldly laws?”
“I also feel that your domain’s strength weakens the further I am from you. As I get closer to you, your domain gets stronger?” Li Guan carefully sensed the force acting on him. “That’s why I said that it’s an upgrade of the Seamless domain. The closer you are to me, the stronger the repulsion.” Meng Chuan nodded. “It also has a stronger suppression now. However, it’s not just my domain that has changed. My body has also changed tremendously.” Meng Chuan carefully probed his body’s changes. “It feels like every basic particle has undergone a qualitative change. It seems like
Hu! Hu! Hu!
Numerous particles flew out from Meng Chuan’s body and came to his side. They then condensed into another Meng Chuan. At the same time, an Essence Soul avatar occupied the other Meng Chuan’s sea of consciousness.
“A Corporeal Avatar?” Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang found it unbelievable.
This was a common technique for Imperial Lords. A cultivator of the Cosmos Body cultivation system would also have this ability when they reached the Sage Becoming realm.
“Yes, a Corporeal Avatar.” Meng Chuan nodded. “My body has greatly improved after reaching this new realm. It’s much stronger than when I was at the Blood Droplet realm. I can naturally condense a Corporeal Avatar now.”
“A Corporeal Avatar with an Essence Soul avatar is a complete lifeform.” Li Guan looked at Meng Chuan excitedly. “An Imperial Lord is most confident in roaming the outer realm when they have a Corporeal Avatar. With your own Corporeal Avatar, you can try roaming the outer realm now.”
“Roam the outer realm?” Meng Chuan was slightly taken aback. The most important thing he needed to do now was to figure out his situation. He hadn’t really set his sights on roaming the outer realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 489 - Decision
chapters.content:
Chapter 489 Decision
Qin Wu looked at Meng Chuan and said solemnly, “Every Creation Supremacy and Imperial Lord has the goal of cultivating in the outer realm. The outer realm is the cultivation ground for Supremacies and Imperial Lords.”
“Meng Chuan,” said Luo Tang. “I believe you can sense that although Archean Eon Realm’s worldly laws, they are only at the Imperial Lord-level. Your current domain... can withstand the worldly laws now.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
In the River of Spacetime, Archean Eon Realm was just a drop in the ocean.
“In Archean Eon Realm, no matter how much you study, you will only be able to comprehend Imperial Lord-level worldly laws. How far can your cultivation go in such a place?” said Luo Tang. “In the outer realm, even if it’s a barren land, you will be able to perceive vaster and more profound spatial-temporal laws.”
Li Guan added, “In the past few decades, you’ve improved greatly. The World Gap is one factor in your speedy improvement. Now we have to answer one question. Why is the World Gap a sacred land for cultivation? It’s because you can observe a forming world there. The purple lightning that tears through the outer realm’s darkness contains laws that go far beyond the Imperial Lord-level. The laws within the purple lightning point towards the vast River of Spacetime’s most profound mysteries. Thus, you will naturally gain a lot from observing the purple lightning.”
Meng Chuan agreed. His Fifteen Lightning Forms far exceeded the Imperial Lord-level. Even Meng Chuan could vaguely sense that Three World Saber and Lightning Realm-two Tribulation-level ultimate techniques-were far inferior to the purple lightning. Deducing a lightning lineage cultivation path after observing the purple lightning was one of the reasons why he could create his paramount technique.
“As the saying goes, reading thousands of books is not as useful as traveling a thousand miles. To Creation Supremacies and Imperial Lords, roaming the outer realm is equivalent to traveling 1,000 miles,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “You will forever see the same scenery
– Imperial-level worldly laws—if you say in your homeworld. In the outer realm, you will see all sorts of beautiful scenes. They are ten times, if not 100 times more beautiful than purple lightning. You can see them all.”
Qin Wu smiled and continued, “To be honest, as your master, I’m very envious of you. With a Corporeal Avatar, you can roam the outer realm freely.”
From the side, Li Guan said, “Meng Chuan, you can grow faster and stronger in the outer realm.”
Meng Chuan also understood this. One’s external environment was very important for cultivation. The World Gap had contributed greatly to his current growth. The outer realm was much vaster than the World Gap. Countless experts roamed the outer realm. Although Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s name had awed countless worlds, there were still Tribulation Eminences that surpassed him. One such person was Eminence Fei Yu.
“Before the war with the demons, generations of Godfiends would often head to the outer realm after reaching the Creation realm,” said Li Guan with a sigh. “They also become more and more powerful in the outer realm.”
“Generations of Godfiend seniors...” Qin Wu shook his head gently. “In this era, once we enter the outer realm, we will be easily caught by the three demon Imperial Lords. The three demon Imperial Lords will definitely not allow human Godfiends to become stronger by cultivating in the outer realm. However, you are different. You have a Corporeal Avatar.”
“My Corporeal Avatar will also be pursued, right?” Meng Chuan asked curiously. “According to the intelligence, the three demon Imperial Lords, especially Emperor Roc, are considered very powerful among the outer realm’s Imperial Lords.”
“Haha, Archean Mountain has some secrets that can only be known after reaching the Creation realm. Some secrets are only for Imperial Lords’ ears,” said Li Guan. “Our Archean Mountain has a treasure-Exile Prison
—that can only be used only in the outer realm. Once this treasure is used, it can trap a target. After that, the treasure can tear through spacetime and send the target to a certain faraway spot in the distant spacetime.”
“Send to a certain faraway spot in distant spacetime?” Meng Chuan was puzzled. “How far?”
“Very, very far away,” said Qin Wu. “Once the treasure is used, the target will be exiled to an infinitely far place. Even an Imperial Lord has no chance of returning from such a distant spacetime his entire life.”
Li Guan smiled and said, “Once your Corporeal Avatar enters the outer realm, you can immediately use the Exile Prison on yourself! Your Corporeal Avatar will be sent to a faraway land. This way, the three demon Imperial Lords will not be able to pursue you. Although it will be very difficult for your Corporeal Avatar to return before it reaches the Tribulation realm, your Corporeal Avatar’s cultivation realm will increase as much as your original body in your homeworld.”
“Your true body will be left behind in Archean Eon realm. It will cultivate in Heaven and Earth Great Hall as per the rules,” said Luo Tang. “Even if an enemy kills your Corporeal Avatar and tries to kill your true body through a karmic mystic technique, the attack’s might will be greatly reduced after traveling across the distant spacetime. Our homeworld’s obstruction will also reduce the attack’s strength once again. After that, the Heaven and Earth Great Hall’s obstruction will reduce the attack’s strength once more... After being weakened repeatedly, I’m afraid only 1-2% of the attack’s strength will be left.”
“If an enemy isn’t skilled at the karma lineage, the attack won’t even have 1-2% of its power left,” said Li Guan with a smile. “Of course, ordinary worlds do not have treasures like the Heaven and Earth Great Hall. Ancestral Master Archean Eon painstakingly refined the Heaven and Earth Great Hall. It was one of Archean Eon Sect’s top treasures.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. He had learned from many dossiers that it would be extremely difficult for outer realm experts to kill him if his true body remained in his homeworld.
Generally speaking, true death would only occur when there was a huge disparity in strength between the two parties. For example, if an Imperial Lord angered an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, the latter could kill all of the former’s avatars remotely, even if they were across worlds. “Meng Chuan, you have created a paramount technique. Your Essence Soul is also strong enough to roam the outer realm. You will also be protected by the Heaven and Earth Great Hall created by Ancestral Master Archean Eon,” said Qin Wu, “You are very suitable for adventuring the outer realm! In the past, our Archean Eon Realm’s Godfiend ancestors went out to roam the outer realm. It was only when they roamed the outer realm that our world gave birth to powerful Imperial Lords and Tribulation Eminences.”
“I understand.” Meng Chuan nodded. “I planned on roaming the outer realm in the future, but I never expected to have a Corporeal Avatar. In that case... I’ll set off soon.”
Be it for the war or his wife-Liu Qiyue-Meng Chuan was forced to become stronger as soon as possible. Going to the outer realm was the best way to raise his strength quickly.
“Alright.” Qin Wu, Li Guan, and Luo Tang were filled with anticipation. “You have reached the Creation realm, so you can read the secrets that only our sect’s Supremacies can come into contact with,” said Li Guan. “You must also read all intelligence dossiers regarding the outer realm.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. “Understood. I’ll prepare myself before setting off.” He also had to understand his current situation fully. He still had too many questions about this unknown realm he had reached.
Meng Chuan began to familiarize himself with the secrets that only Supremacies could come into contact with.
“This is?” Meng Chuan stood in a chamber. Inside the chamber was a massive phantom river.
“This river is the Spacetime Dominion Map.” Qin Wu pointed at the surging river’s phantom. “It was made by Ancestral Master Archean Eon after paying a huge price. It can be said to be a massive Spacetime Dominion Map. Even Ancestral Master Archean Eon can’t travel every inch of the River of Spacetime.”
“These are?” Meng Chuan looked at the dossiers in front of him.
“Information on the many civilizations and worlds. They are useless in our homeworld,” said Qin Wu. “This information will be of great use in the outer realm at critical moments.”
Boom!
A treasure vault opened.
Meng Chuan stared at the treasure vault curiously. He knew about the treasure vault, but he had never entered it.
“Every Supremacy that heads to the outer realm has the right to come here and choose treasures,” said Qin Wu as he pointed at the vault’s contents. “One naturally needs some defensive treasures when roaming the dangerous outer realm. Although many treasures have been lost over time, we still have about ten to twenty percent of the treasures left. Furthermore, the other Sect Proprietors have agreed that you can choose any ten.”
For the next few months, Meng Chuan prepared himself for his journey in the outer realm. He also gradually familiarized himself with the abilities he gained after reaching his new realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 490 - Set Off, Outer Realm! (Final Chapter of Volume)
chapters.content:
Chapter 490 Set Off, Outer Realm! (Final Chapter of Volume)
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in the square outside of the Heaven and Earth Great Hall. After several months, Meng Chuan had gained a deep understanding of his strength.
My current realm is the sixth realm that comes after the Godfiend cultivation system’s first five realms—Core Cloud realm, Indestructible realm, Great Solar realm, Darkstar realm, and Seamless realm. According to the various characteristics of this realm, I should call it the Chaos Hole realm.
For ordinary Godfiends, the Creation realm was after the Seamless realm. However, Meng Chuan had stepped into the Chaos Hole realm —which was above the Seamless realminstead of the Creation realm.
I have a 5,000-year lifespan at the Chaos Hole realm. My physical body isn’t inferior to a Sage Becoming realm expert of the Cosmos Body cultivation system. The Quintessential Essence condensed by the chaos hole is stronger than my physical body. The bad thing about reaching the Chaos Hole realm is that I have no experience to draw from. None of the seniors have ever reached this realm. I need to figure everything out by myself. However, at my current realm, my Corporeal Avatar can instantly merge with my true body, even if I fail to figure it out.
The higher one’s cultivation realm was, the stronger their lifeforce would be. When creating a new cultivation system or exploring an unknown cultivation realm, there was a higher chance of error. Even if he made a mistake during his experimentation, causing his dantian and body to explode and shatter, he could instantly regenerate with just a thought.
This was why the human world’s experts could create various Godfiend bodies. Transcendent-grade Godfiend bodies, high-grade Godfiend bodies... All sorts of Godfiend bodies had been created. This had something to do with the top experts’ fault-tolerance rates.
In humanity’s history, only a limited few had reached the Heaven Earth realm. Many of humanity’s experts created new Godfiend bodies based on whatever Godfiends bodies existed at the time. Godfiend bodies that were perfect and could be used universally were transcendent-grade. Those that were suitable for the creators but couldn’t be universally used would be reduced to high-grade or middle-grade Godfiend bodies.
For example, Ancestral Master Archean Eon cultivated other Godfiend bodies when he was still weak. He created the Samsara Divine Body when he had reached a high cultivation realm! He had also converted his original Godfiend body into the Samsara Divine Body.
There was a limit to Godfiend body conversion.
For example, Meng Chuan cultivated the Lightning Devastator Fiend Body. His main cultivation path was the lightning lineage! Even when he converted his Godfiend body in the future, he would use the lightning lineage as his core.
My current body is quite different from the Lightning Devastator Fiend Body and the Cosmos Body cultivation system’s Sage Becoming realm, thought Meng Chuan to himself. His body now had a black hole as its core. Every particle space was a miniature black hole. This made his body extremely powerful and magical. Even without using Cosmos Crystals, his body was in no way inferior to a Sage Becoming realm body.
In the future, I will need to create a Godfiend body that is most suitable for me if I want to progress further in the physical body lineage.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan stood up. It’s time to return. Meng Chuan entered Heaven and Earth Great Hall and left the grotto-heaven.
He exited from the grotto-heaven and landed in Archean Mountain’s Grotto-Heaven Pavilion.
Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang appeared. “Meng Chuan.”
“Has your seclusion ended?” asked Qin Wu.
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded and smiled. “I’ll make a trip back first. I’ll set off for the outer realm in three days.”
Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang were shocked.
Finally...
After 800 years, humanity finally had a Godfiend setting off for the outer realm.
“Are you sure you’ve prepared everything?” asked Qin Wu. “Besides, are you really only bringing one treasure to the outer realm?”
“The Bloodblade Disc will suffice,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
According to Archean Mountain (Archean Eon Sect)’s rules, Creation Supremacies were forbidden from carrying Tribulation treasures into the outer realm under normal circumstances. Only an Imperial Lord was allowed to carry Tribulation treasures into the outer realm.
Of course, exceptions could be made for special situations. For example, suppose a Creation Supremacy obtained a Tribulation treasure from the outer realm by themselves. In that case, they could give it to the sect and exchange it for another Tribulation treasure that was suitable for them.
