After that, they would be allowed to bring that specific Tribulation treasure into the outer realm.
Another example would be when all the Sect Proprietors agreed to let a Creation Supremacy bring a Tribulation treasure to the outer realm with them.
As for Meng Chuan?
Meng Chuan had obtained the Eon Sea Sect’s treasures and gave them to Archean Mountain. Other than the three cornerstone treasures, he had also brought back five Tribulation treasures and many other treasures. After killing many demons, Meng Chuan and his wife had also given a large amount of war spoils to the sect, including a Tribulation treasure. Meng Chuan had also created a paramount technique by himself. With his talent, during any era, the sect would’ve allowed him to bring a Tribulation treasure into the outer realm. Furthermore, Meng Chuan’s role in the war was of utmost importance. Regardless what reason was provided, Meng Chuan could bring one Tribulation treasure into the outer realm with him! Li Guan and Qin Wu even hoped that Meng Chuan would bring one or two more.
“Alright, you know yourself best,” said Li Guan.
Meng Chuan nodded and vanished.
Above Jiang State Capital.
Meng Chuan appeared.
After reaching the Chaos Hole realm, I gained the Chaos Hole domain. My Chaos Hole domain can isolate the worldly laws. There’s no need to break free of the worldly laws’ suppression when I fly. Meng Chuan’s domain could isolate the worldly laws from him, allowing him to fly as he wished. Without using the Bloodblade Disc, I can now travel 2,500 kilometers per second. Previously, I could only travel 600 kilometers per second.
However, the Infinite Movement Technique can only make my time flow faster by twenty-fold. Meng Chuan also realized another thing. When I was a Regis Godfiend, the same movement technique could change my time flow by fifty-fold. However, now that I have reached the Chaos Hole realm, it can only change my time flow by twenty-fold.
The flow of time’s impact on matter... was like the wind blowing across the land. If it blew sand, the sand would fly extremely quickly. The wind would barely affect rocks; they would just roll slightly. A mountain? The wind wouldn’t even budge the mountain the slightest bit. If one tried to speed up the time flow of a Tribulation Eminence? It would be 100 times harder to affect the Tribulation Eminence’s time flow than to do it for a Regis Godfiend!
The Chaos Hole domain isolated the worldly laws from Meng Chuan, allowing him to travel 50,000 kilometers in a second! It was much faster than his original speed of 30,000 kilometers per second.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan flew towards a manor in Jiang State Capital
In the courtyard, Meng Dajiang was reading while Bai Nianyun was painting. The couple was very relaxed. Whoosh.
Meng Chuan landed in the courtyard.
Meng Dajiang and Bai Nianyun saw their son. “Chuan’er.” They put down their books and brushes and stood up. Meng Chuan smiled at his parents. “Dad, Mom.” His parents had been separated for more than 50 years. After they reunited, they were extremely affectionate to each other.
Meng Dajiang’s wrinkles had become more obvious over the years; his hair was also more grizzled. His mother, Bai Nianyun, was a Marquis Godfiend. She could live for one century longer than Meng Dajiang, making her appear much younger than Meng Dajiang.
Dad will reach the end of his lifespan in a few decades. Time sure is heartless. No one can withstand the passage of time. “What brings you here today?” asked Meng Dajiang with a smile.
“Just because,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“Punk, I saw you grow up. I can tell at a glance that you have something on your mind,” said Meng Dajiang. Meng Dajiang’s heart ached as he stared at his son. His son had shouldered too many responsibilities... However, they couldn’t help him much. Meng Chuan nodded and smiled. “It’s like this. In the future, my true body needs to guard a region, so I can’t leave without permission. In the future, I can only send an Essence Soul avatar to visit you. If there’s anything, you can look for me anytime. One of my Essence Soul avatars will be stationed in Jiang State Capital permanently.”
“One of your Essence Soul avatars?” said Bai Nianyun in surprise, “You have more than one Essence Soul avatar? Chuan’er, have you attained a seventh-level Essence Soul?”
Meng Dajiang also looked at his son in shock.
Meng Chuan smiled and nodded. “Yes.” He hadn’t publicly announced the existence of his seventh-level Essence Soul.
In the future, his true body would stay in Heaven and Earth Great Hall for a long time! He would also be responsible for guarding Archean Mountain while his Corporeal Avatar roamed the outer realm.
His Essence Soul avatars would be the ones moving about and acting as reinforcements in Archean Eon Realm.
“Impressive. As expected of my son.” Meng Dajiang was overjoyed. “You attained a seventh-level Essence Soul so quickly?” Bai Nianyun was pleasantly surprised. “Even the dossier hasn’t recorded an expert attaining a seventh-level Essence Soul that fast. Chuan’er, you have to have dinner with us tonight and chat with us more.”
“Alright, I also wish to eat Mom’s food.” Meng Chuan smiled and nodded. Although his Essence Soul avatar could eat and drink, it was inferior to experiencing it with his actual body. In the future, it would be rare for him to taste his mother’s cooking.
He chatted with his parents and talked about many things.
Meng Dajiang and Bai Nianyun were especially happy.
The next day, Meng Chuan went to meet his son and daughter. He informed them of his journey to the outer realm. After all, his departure couldn’t be hidden from the demons. Thus, it was fine to tell his children the news.
In the afternoon.
The sky was gloomy as the autumn wind blew across Jiang State Capital.
On one of Jiang State Capital’s city walls, the white-haired Meng Chuan sat there and drank alone.
“Qiyue, we agreed that we would kill demons together in this life. We promised to risk our lives to kill all the demons in the world. You guarded various cities for so many years and killed a large number of demons. In order to protect Snow Wind Pass, you sacrificed so much, but you saved ten million people. Now, like the ancient Godfiends, you have chosen to enter the Millennium Instant slumber so that you can continue to fight for humanity during future dire situations.
“As your husband, I won’t disappoint you. I will enter the outer realm tomorrow. I will do my best to grow stronger as soon as possible. I will definitely kill all the demons and win this war.”
As Meng Chuan spoke, he drank. It was as though his wife was beside him. He remembered the time when he and his wife ate naan and watermelon on this same city wall.
“Fight to the death, rest only when the demons are slain. This is our shared promise,” muttered Meng Chuan softly. When Meng An arrived at the city wall and saw the white-haired Meng Chuan drinking alone, his heart ached for him. He knew that his father and mother, Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue, had a very good relationship. They were childhood sweethearts, and they were proponents of till death do us part.
Meng An went forward and bowed respectfully. “Dad.”
“Oh, An’er.” Meng Chuan turned to look at his son.
“Grandfather and Grandmother will be coming over tonight. The family will have dinner together,” said Meng An. “Should we return together?”
Meng Chuan smiled and nodded. “Don’t worry. I’ll return after I finish this flask of alcohol.”
“Yes,” replied Meng An respectfully. He immediately left without disturbing him any further.
After staying in Jiang State Capital for three days, Meng Chuan returned to Archean Mountain.
The Heaven and Earth Great Hall had several chambers.
Meng Chuan carried two Tribulation treasures and other protective items into a chamber and cultivated. From now on, his true body would be in charge of controlling Heaven and Earth Great Hall. It would also be guarding Archean Mountain on behalf of Li Guan.
The other Meng Chuan left the grotto-heaven.
“Once you enter the outer realm, you are to use Exile Prison immediately,” said the illusory Qin Wu solemnly.
Meng Chuan smiled and nodded. “Don’t worry.”
Li Guan and Luo Tang were also very solemn.
Upon entering the outer realm, he had to use Exile Prison before the demons intercepted him.
“It’s been more than 800 years... You are the first human Godfiend to enter the outer realm in over 800 years.” Li Guan looked at Meng Chuan. “Us humans have had Supremacies and Imperial Lords enter the outer realm for many generations. However, this stopped for the past 800 years. You are the first to enter the outer realm in over 800 years.”
Qin Wu looked at Meng Chuan solemnly. “In the outer realm, you can only rely on yourself. Be careful.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan smiled and nodded. “Then, I’ll set off.”
Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang nodded and watched carefully.
Meng Chuan waved his hand.
Rip!
He tore open a huge rift in the world membrane beside him. Through the world membrane, one could see the endless darkness outside.
“I’m leaving.” Meng Chuan instantly charged into the huge rift and into the endless darkness.
Final Chapter of Volume-Supremacy

chapters.title: Chapter 491 - Spacetime Disorder
chapters.content:
Chapter 491 Spacetime Disorder
For the past 800 years, the vast outer realm had been a forbidden zone for human Supremacies!
But today, Meng Chuan didn’t hesitate to charge through the world membrane rift.
Boom!
Meng Chuan rushed out of the world membrane rift. When he entered the outer realm, he felt a strange sensation. He felt like he was swimming in water. The water resisted him in all directions. However, his abrupt arrival at the shore made him feel empty and relaxed. He could no longer feel any resistance.
This is the outer realm? In front of the outer realm’s void, Meng Chuan was as tiny as an ant.
The outer realm was dark and boundless. Very few obstacles littered the void. With just the naked eye, one could see an astonishingly far distance; Meng Chuan’s perception of the void had become many times sharper. The moment Meng Chuan rushed out of the world membrane rift, he noticed a massive burning star in the distance. This burning star spewed out billions of flame wisps, wantonly burning the surrounding darkness. Behind the burning star was a dark, cold star.
Meng Chuan had read many dossiers and knew that this was the most common Yin-Yang Binary Stars in the outer realm. The outer realm was fraught with countless encounters and many dangers.
A Grand Yin Star and a Grand Yang Star were the most common dangers. In terms of size, they spanned over 100 million kilometers. A Grand Yang Star’s surface flames weren’t anything worth mentioning. Imperial Lords could bathe on the star’s surface. However, the deeper one traveled into the star, the more terrifying the flames were. The Grand Yang Divine Fire’s core could instantly reduce Imperial Lords to ashes. Even many Tribulation Eminences could withstand the flames and would be reduced to ashes.
A Grand Yin Star was just as terrifying; its danger level was comparable to a Grand Yang Star.
Boom!
A resplendent light belt flew at high speeds.
The resplendent light belt contained countless asteroids of different colors. They flew extremely quickly, reaching a terrifying speed of 190,000 kilometers a second. Even Imperial Lords would instantly shatter when struck. These asteroids flew at high speeds, producing terrifying spatial fluctuations that spread out in all directions. This resplendent light belt was another danger in the area around Archean Eon Realm.
The outer realm was filled with opportunities and hidden dangers. Even its environment was terrible. The outer realm’s void also contained all kinds of invisible forces that could easily destroy a Regis Godfiend’s body, killing them in seconds.
The outer realm was also very cold. It was much colder than the baneful aura that Meng Chuan had cultivated in the past. Even ordinary peak Regis Godfiends wouldn’t be able to withstand the cold for long before freezing to death.
The outer realm contained many harsh environments. With a Grotto-Heaven domain, one could screen the threat level the different environments posed to them.
At the same time...
His homeworld had mild Heaven and Earth powers; cultivators could absorb the mild Heaven and Earth powers and cultivate. However, in the outer realm, only the most primitive outer realm essence energy existed. It was very damaging to one’s body. Typically, only Supremacies could absorb the outer realm essence energy and convert it into their own strength. If they were unable to convert it, they would “starve to death” over time due to the lack of energy. This happened even though they could barely survive in the outer realm.
There were other reasons as well.
The minimum requirement for traveling the River of Spacetime was to be a Supremacy. Monarch Peacock had only barged into the outer realm due to being forced into a dire situation. Thankfully for him, he had reached the Grotto-Heaven realm long ago. His body also contained the bloodline of an outer realm special lifeform, the Dark Peacock. It was only because of these two factors that he was qualified to roam the outer realm before becoming a Supremacy.
This is the outer realm. The moment Meng Chuan rushed out of the world membrane rift, he greedily looked at his surroundings. Archean Mountain’s information on his homeworld’s surroundings was the most detailed, but he ultimately had to leave this region.
As he rushed out of the world membrane rift, Meng Chuan turned to look behind him. With this glance, he saw Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang standing on the other side of the closing world membrane rift. They held their heads high in anticipation. He saw his homeworld from the outside.
This is Archean Eon Realm. It’s my homeworld; it’s where I was born. Meng Chuan saw the massive sphere-shaped Archean Eon Realm. It was about 50,000 kilometers in diameter. It emitted a mysterious aura, and the world membrane protected it very well.
When Meng Chuan saw Archean Eon Realm from the outer realm, he felt emotional. He couldn’t help but tear up. Archean Eon Realm, my homeworld, I will definitely protect you. Even at the cost of my life, I will protect you well.
After staring at Archean Eon Realm, Meng Chuan immediately saw another large world beside it. The large world emanated a demonic aura! Furthermore, the demon was over 150,000 kilometers in diameter.
The two worlds of different sizes circled each other as a World Gap formed between the two.
I need to leave now. Without any hesitation, a black talisman appeared in Meng Chuan’s hand. Strands of Quintessential Essencewhich circulated with lightning- seeped into the black talisman. The black talisman was instantly activated. A black wind appeared out of the thin void, and it enveloped Meng Chuan.
Boom!
A crack suddenly appeared in the distant demon world’s world membrane. A golden light beam rushed out at very fast speeds. It constantly accelerated in the outer realm, becoming faster and faster. Within the golden stream of light was Emperor Roc. His eyes were filled with killing intent as he stared at Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan remained very calm. Considering the distance between Archean Eon Realm and the Demon Realm, nothing would happen to him unless the demons set up an ambush in advance! Therefore, even though Emperor Roc was constantly accelerating in the outer realm, it would take him several seconds at least to traverse tens of thousands of kilometers.
As for Exile Prison, it could be activated instantly. The demons had no way of stopping him.
Archean Eon Realm, my homeworld. Meng Chuan glanced at Archean Eon Realm again.
Viewing Archean Eon realm from the outer realm was really mesmerizing. Meng Chuan engraved this scene deep in his memories.
Whoosh.
The black wind enveloped Meng Chuan, instantly tearing through the void and making him disappear into a spatial rift.
“Meng Chuan exiled himself and left this area of the void.”
Through the slowly closing world membrane rift, Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang saw the black wind wrap around Meng Chuan before disappearing into the void.
Although it took a long time to describe, it had taken Meng Chuan a very short amount of time to rush into the outer realm, glance at the outer realm, and look back at his homeworld before exiling himself!
“Meng Chuan can only rely on himself in the outer realm,” said Qin Wu.
“We have to trust him,” said Li Guan with a smile.
Luo Tang nodded slightly.
The three of them were filled with anticipation.
Emperor Roc’s Essence Soul avatar flew faster and faster in the outer realm, constantly accelerating. Several seconds later, he arrived at the spot where Meng Chuan had vanished.
His expression was icy as he coldly scanned his surroundings.
Soon, Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon’s Essence Soul avatars arrived. Their true bodies—which guarded their homeworld—would never venture into the outer realm.
“You failed to catch up?” asked Lady Blackmoon with a frown.
“When I rushed to the outer realm, the wind of spacetime had already engulfed Meng Chuan.” Emperor Roc shook his head. “I wouldn’t have been able to stop him even with a Void Transference Talisman. Furthermore... We don’t have a Void Transference Talisman.”
Only four Void Transference talismans remained in Demon Ancestral Cave. The three Imperial Lords had previously taken one out. Unless they had contributed greatly to the Demon Realm, there was no way they could obtain a second one. “Starquix, where did Meng Chuan escape to? Use karma to deduce his current location,” said Emperor Roc.
“He has fled very far away. I don’t know how far away from Three Bay River System he is. Even if we spend our entire life flying towards him, I’m afraid we won’t be able to reach him.” Imperial Lord Starquix shook his head and said solemnly, “Due to the distance between us, it will still be very difficult to calculate his exact location even if I am ten times more accomplished in the karma lineage. There’s still one more thing I have to tell the two of you... Through karma, I can confirm that Meng Chuan still has a true body within Archean Eon Realm.”
The expressions of the two Imperial Lords changed. “What?”
“He has two true bodies?” Blackmoon couldn’t believe it. “He’s a Supremacy at most.”
Corporeal Avatars were something only Imperial Lords and stronger had.
“Karma won’t lie to me. Archean Eon Realm is so close. I’m extremely sure that one of Meng Chuan’s true bodies is still in Archean Eon Realm,” said Imperial Lord Starquix. “The true body that fled just now... is already extremely far away.”
Emperor Roc and Lady Blackmoon fell silent.
“Perhaps this Meng Chuan will offend a powerful Tribulation Eminence the moment he enters the outer realm. A Tribulation Eminence can use karma to kill all his avatars,” said Blackmoon faintly.
“We can’t place our hopes on luck. Furthermore, Meng Chuan isn’t stupid.” Emperor Roc’s eyes were cold. “We have to deal with the human world faster. The longer we delay, the stronger Meng Chuan will become. We can’t afford to delay.”
“Yes, we have to do it as soon as possible.” Imperial Lord Starquix nodded and said, “Even if we aren’t confident, we have to give it a try.”
“The two demon sage possessors are still very weak. We can’t rush them,” said Blackmoon with a frown.
“Ten years. We have to take action within ten years,” said Emperor Roc coldly.
Whoosh.
The black wind enveloped Meng Chuan and swept him into spacetime turbulence. As he watched the scenes of distorted spacetime disappear, Meng Chuan was swept into it. He was somewhat nervous. According to the records, I’ll simply be exiled very far away. The probability of entering a forbidden zone is very low. My luck shouldn’t be that bad, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 492 - New Arrival
chapters.content:
Chapter 492 New Arrival
Scenes of the surrounding spacetime constantly flashed and disappeared. Meng Chuan remained cautious while the chaotic spacetime turbulence enveloped him.
Just like how water flowed down, spacetime turbulence followed certain laws; it would flow towards the place of least resistance. For example, a Grand Yang Star or a cave abode set up by a Tribulation Eminence would have very powerful repulsive forces. It was unlikely for him to end up in such places.
Of course, spacetime turbulence was... turbulent.
This resulted in occasional accidents. For example, spacetime turbulence could sometimes be too violent, forcefully leading its load to unimaginable places. It would bring them to places like a Grand Yang Star’s core! If Meng Chuan arrived at a Grand Yang Star’s core, he would probably be instantly reduced to ashes and die.
I’m going out! As he was on high alert, Meng Chuan saw a void rift appear in front of him. Meng Chuan was carried out of the rift by the spatial turbulence.
In the dark and silent void, a spatial rift appeared. Meng Chuan rushed out and quickly steadied himself.
This is? Meng Chuan looked around. He could see many stars in the distance; he could also vaguely see worlds between the stars. My luck isn’t bad. I didn’t appear in a perilous zone, nor did I appear in a completely barren region. Meng Chuan secretly rejoiced in his luck. I can see several worlds with life at a glance. There must be many cultivators here.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan used his movement technique to fly over silently.
The outer realm’s resistance was negligible, so he could constantly accelerate. Even ordinary Supremacies could move hundreds of kilometers in a second when they weren’t affected by worldly laws or resistance! They could even accelerate to the point they could move thousands of kilometers per second.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
Meng Chuan transformed into a golden beam of light as he accelerated. Soon, he reached a speed of 150,000 kilometers a second.
In the outer realm, any Supremacy would accelerate themselves until they moved at extremely high speeds. At the same time, Meng Chuan changed the flow of time. Of course, it was only three times faster than the outside world.
I’m a new arrival, so I should keep a low profile. I’ll maintain this three-fold time dilation so that I’m not too eye-catching. Considering my original speed of 150,000 kilometers a second... my traveling speed is now boosted to an effective 450,000 kilometers per second.
Moving 150,000 kilometers per second usually required a long acceleration period. This didn’t represent his strength.
It would be truly terrifying if he could unleash such astonishing speed instantly.
Meng Chuan flew towards the distant stars. His domain hid his aura.
On a piece of stellar debris—which was more than 500 kilometers in diameter—was a massive cave abode. The cave abode spanned more than 50 kilometers; from it, terrifying sword beams emanated in all directions.
Five figures landed on the stellar debris’s surface and stared at the ancient cave abode.
“Ah.” A cyan-scaled expert covered his head with one claw and said in a deep voice, “My Essence Soul avatar was killed. It was killed by the sword beams the moment it entered the cave abode’s entrance.” “Brother Qing Gu failed as well?”
“Both attempts failed.”
The five Supremacies stared at the cave abode in front of them. Three of them had sixth-level Essence Souls. Of them, two had met with failure after sending their Essence Soul avatars in.
It would take several years for their Essence Soul to recover even when the Essence Soul avatars were killed during reconnaissance. “An Essence Soul avatar is ultimately much weaker. It doesn’t have any powerful treasures,” said the purple-robed leader indifferently. “Same old rules. Whoever takes the risk and successfully investigates the cave abode will gain 10% more treasures.”
The other four Supremacies didn’t say a word.
From their previous reconnaissance attempts, they knew that this cave abode was too dangerous! “Cang Qu, your life-preservation means are strong. Go in,” instructed the purple-robed man.
“Brother Fang,” said a muscular yellow-furred man immediately, “I’m the only Supremacy of my homeworld. If I die...”
“Go in!” said the purple-robed man indifferently. The other three Supremacies also glanced at him.
The cyan-scaled Supremacy smiled and said, “To only have one Supremacy in a world. There are plenty of such low-grade worlds. If Brother Fang wants you to enter, just obediently enter. If you successfully probe the cave abode, you can receive 10% more treasures.”
The yellow-furred man gritted his teeth and carefully entered.
After a while —
Oh? A wisp of light dissipated from the purple-robed man’s token. The purple-robed man frowned slightly.
“Cang Qu is dead.”
The other three Supremacies had ugly expressions.
The outer realm was a place where the strong preyed on the weak. When they followed the purple-robed man, they could reap some of the leftover benefits he enjoyed! Furthermore, it was much safer than venturing alone. However, when cannon fodder was needed, they had to play the role obediently.
“Brother Fang, Cang Qu’s life-preservation means are much stronger than ours. He’s already dead. It’s useless for us to enter.”
“Brother Fang.”
“This cave abode is too dangerous. We will be sending ourselves to our deaths if we enter.” The three Supremacies were somewhat flustered.
The purple-robed man frowned as he stared at the cave abode. He thought to himself, This cave abode has flown around for countless years. I discovered it first when it came to our void. I have to obtain the treasures within. From the looks of it, I can’t rely on them. I’ll send my Essence Soul avatar to give it a try.
He only had a sixth-level Essence Soul. Thus, he only had one Essence Soul avatar. Once his Essence Soul avatar died, it would take several years for him to recover. He would rather make his subordinates risk their lives than allow his combat prowess to decrease. However, it was useless even if his subordinates risked their lives. He could only do it himself.
“Oh?” The purple-robed man suddenly sensed something and turned to look into the distance.
“There is a cultivator flying at high speeds.” A white-robed woman stared into the distance.
Although Meng Chuan hid his figure as he flew at terrifying speeds, he couldn’t hide his tracks! Meng Chuan flew at a terrifying speed of 150,000 kilometers per second. After speeding up the time flow by three-fold, wherever he passed, a long ripple appeared in the void.
The black-armored man’s eyes emitted a purple glow as he stared at Meng Chuan from afar. He said solemnly, “He’s a Supremacy. He has sped up the time flow around him by three-fold.”
“Brother Fang, you can let this lone Supremacy probe the cave abode’s situation,” said the white-robed woman immediately.
“That’s right. With one more probing attempt, we can also discover this cave abode’s dangers,” said the cyan-scaled expert immediately.
The purple-robed man nodded slightly. “Let’s go investigate him and find out his origins. If he has no special background, capture him.” In the entire Heaven Peak River System, some factions were very powerful. Of course, most cultivators came from small worlds. They were ordinary Supremacies with no background!
This was because there were only over 600 middle-level worlds out of the 100,000 worlds with life in Heaven Peak River System! The rest were all low-grade worlds. In low-grade worlds, one could only reach the Supremacy realm after thousands of years or even tens of thousands of years. They were all alone when they came to the outer realm. They didn’t have any backing
The muscular yellow-furred man, Cang Qu, was a Supremacy of a lower-grade world. He didn’t have any backing.
Cang Qu chose to submit to the purple-robed man. Over the years, he had benefited greatly. He had also reached the perfected Supremacy realm. He had brought back many treasures and cultivation manuals to his homeworld. However, he failed to survive this particular expedition because of the purple-robed man.
This was what life in the outer realm was like. They didn’t come from the same world. The only thing binding them together was interests. It was a cruel situation.
Meng Chuan left his homeworld and roamed the outer realm alone.
As a middle-level world that had given birth to a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, Archean Eon Realm had a rich heritage. Meng Chuan had brought many treasures with him, including the Mask of Illusion.
With the Mask of Illusion, Meng Chuan could perfectly disguise his aura to that of a Supremacy. His Chaos Hole realm aura... If he were to release his aura, it would be extremely domineering-close to that of an Imperial Lord. However, if he converged his aura, nothing would leak out. Even ordinary Imperial Lords would find it difficult to converge their auras so perfectly. This was a special technique one had after reaching the Chaos Hole realm. It was best to disguise as the most commonly seen cultivators-Supremacies—while roaming the outer realm. Otherwise, he would appear too special! Be it releasing his domineering aura or converging his aura until it didn’t leak out, any Imperial Lord that passed by would find Meng Chuan special!
The Mask of Illusion was a rare treasure! Even Tribulation Eminences had to be very close to Meng Chuan to detect his true strength.
Oh? Meng Chuan, who was flying at high speeds, sensed four streaks of light intercepting him from afar. The four streaks of light also accelerated until they moved 150,000 kilometers per second. They altered the time flow by tenfold.
“Friend, stop.” As the four light streams approached, a voice echoed in the surrounding void—which seemed to freeze.
The powerful resistance acting on Meng Chuan caused him to slow down. Meng Chuan stopped and looked at the four figures flying over.

chapters.title: Chapter 493 - Spare Your Life
chapters.content:
Chapter 493 Spare Your Life
Outer realm cultivators spoke a universal language. As a middle-level world, Archean Eon Realm naturally had records of it. Even if one didn’t know the language, it was a trivial matter. When Supremacies conversed with each other, they could understand each other through their mental fluctuations. With their strong Essence Souls, they would probably be able to learn a language in a few seconds.
The other party had shouted ‘stop’ and even made the void freeze, suppressing him. He had clearly come with ill intentions.
It’s my first time coming into contact with outer realm cultivators, but their attitude isn’t very friendly. Meng Chuan was very cautious. From the sect’s dossiers, he knew how dangerous the outer realm was. Countless civilizations existed in the outer realm, and all of them had different cultivation systems. Therefore, alien Supremacies had all sorts of strange abilities available to them. Even if he was at a higher cultivation realm, he might suffer losses against someone who happened to have an ability that countered him. Therefore, unless there were a huge gap in strength, it wouldn’t be wrong to be cautious in the outer realm.
The four figures stopped. They were about 150 kilometers away as they looked at Meng Chuan. To Supremacies, this distance was akin to a few hundred feet for a mortal. They could cover this distance with a single charge.
“Friend.” Among the four figures, the purple-robed leader wore a smile on his face.
“I’m Fang Chang from Blood Yang Realm. I love making friends. Might I know where you hail from?” Meng Chuan’s heart tightened. Blood Yang Realm? Where is that?
In the vast River of Spacetime, countless worlds hosted life. The name of these worlds would often change. For example, the human world had changed its name to Archean Eon Realm after Ancestral Master Archean Eon rose to prominence. It was the same for many inhabited worlds. When a powerful Tribulation Eminence appeared, outsiders would refer to the world by the Tribulation Eminence’s name.
Therefore, even Ancestral Master Archean Eon didn’t bother to record down the names of all the inhabited worlds on the Spacetime Dominion Map. Of course, they had detailed records of the inhabited worlds within the Three Bay River System. “I’m Eastcalm of Great Zhou World,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“Brother Fang, I’ve never heard of this name before.” The white-robed woman sent a voice transmission. “Among the famous Supremacies in our Heaven Peak River System, no one is named Eastcalm.” “I’ve never heard of the Great Zhou World amongst Heaven Peak River System’s 100,000 worlds either. A new, powerful Supremacy might appear occasionally, but it’s definitely impossible for a new inhabited world to appear suddenly,” said the black-armored man via voice transmission. The purple-robed man looked at Meng Chuan and said indifferently, “I’ve never heard of the Great Zhou World. Could it be that Brother Eastcalm is just making things up and lying to me?” “The Great Zhou World is a middle-level world in my Mirror Lake River System. It currently has a Tribulation Eminence and seven Imperial Lords. It’s famous across several river systems,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“When I was roaming outside, I accidentally got swept up in the spacetime turbulence and ended up here. Sigh... Even I don’t know when my Great Zhou World’s patriarch will arrive to bring me back.” Having arrived at an unfamiliar place, he couldn’t pretend to be a cultivator from his actual river system. After all, he would easily expose himself once the other party asked a few simple questions. Thus, Meng Chuan fabricated his background. He could scare the other party by saying that his world had a Tribulation Eminence and seven Imperial Lords. “A Tribulation Eminence and Imperial Lords? Brother Eastcalm must have learned something extraordinary,” said the purple-robed man with a smile. “I love to befriend people the most. Come, let’s go to my cave abode. We should do an exchange of knowledge.”
“Let’s go.”
“Supremacy Eastcalm, since our Lord has invited you, please follow us.”
The three Supremacies also spoke in a way that exerted an unspoken pressure. Meng Chuan looked at him. “Brother Fang Chang, are you forcing me to go to your cave abode?” “Are you not willing?” The purple-robed man looked at Meng Chuan. Meng Chuan nodded.
“I’m not willing.” “Capture him alive.” The purple-robed man couldn’t be bothered to say anything else. After a simple conversation, they confirmed that he wasn’t a Supremacy from one of Heaven Peak River System’s large factions. As for coming from another river system? There was a high chance that he was a Supremacy from a low-grade world. After all, 99% of the worlds in a river system were low-grade worlds! Even if he had a Tribulation Eminence backing him, it wouldn’t be easy for them to investigate since they were so far away. In the vast outer realm, they were more than confident that they could take action. After all, cultivators were always hovering over the fine line of life and death.
Boom!
The purple-robed man stood still, but the three Supremacies beside him attacked simultaneously.
The void around Meng Chuan froze as it pressed down on him.
Growl
The thin, black-armored man hunched his back as mystical runes covered his body.
At the same time, a huge illusory beast phantom appeared in the outer realm. The illusory beast was over 100 kilometers tall. It had an extremely huge head, and its mouth was over 50 kilometers wide. It could swallow Meng Chuan in one gulp. At a glance, Meng Chuan could tell that this was an extremely powerful spatial divine power. Ordinary perfected Supremacies probably couldn’t withstand
The cyan-scaled expert secretly used a treasure.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Nine black chains appeared from the void and surrounded Meng Chuan from all directions in a bid to capture him. “Go.” The white-robed woman’s expression turned cold as a light beam flew out from her glabella-a divine sword. Words could be seen on the sword. Although Meng Chuan couldn’t recognize the words, he could tell the meaning of the words after taking a glance at the sword’s cold intent. The words meant Cold Moon.
The moment the sword flew out, it instantly pierced through the void and attacked Meng Chuan. The three alien Supremacies attacked simultaneously. The weakest had the combat strength of a perfected Creation realm expert. The thin black-armored man’s divine power roughly had the strength of a threshold Imperial Lord. Although he was attacked, Meng Chuan stood still. Meng Chuan sighed softly. “Why must you do this?” The sigh strangely sounded in the ears of the purple-robed man, the white-robed woman, the cyan-scaled expert, and the black-armored man. Not good. The trio of attackers was alarmed.
With Meng Chuan at the center, the surrounding 500 kilometers transformed into endless lightning. Although his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique’s Electromagnetic Domain wasn’t powerful originally, Meng Chuan had used his Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence to power it. As a Godfiend, Meng Chuan’s Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence was stronger than his physical body.
Meng Chuan’s Quintessential Essence domain instantly enveloped the surrounding 500 kilometers. It was extremely terrifying. The electromagnetic domain’s powerful repulsive force affected the white-robed woman’s divine sword. The closer it got to Meng Chuan, the stronger the repulsive force became. Once it was just a kilometer away from Meng Chuan, it could no longer move any further. To hide his Chaos Hole domain’s uniqueness, Meng Chuan had only made it envelop his surrounding half-kilometer. Beyond that, he relied on his Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence to power his electromagnetic domain.
Clang! Clang! Clang! The nine black chains also trembled. Meng Chuan’s electromagnetic domain repelled them. They, too, came to a halt once they were a kilometer away from Meng Chuan.
Roar!
As this happened, the illusory beast opened its mouth and tried to swallow Meng Chuan whole despite being obstructed by the electromagnetic domain. Other than using his electromagnetic domain, Meng Chuan also released Bloodblades one after another. The Bloodblades executed the Cloud Dragon Snake Saber Art. In terms of technique realm, the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique-which had only reached the Grotto-Heaven realm’s late stagehad no advantage over the three aliens at the perfected Supremacy realm. However, the Bloodblades were a Tribulation treasure! Furthermore, they were driven by Meng Chuan’s Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence! Their might immediately became much greater than before. Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Eighteen Bloodblades instantly tore through space. This strange, mysterious move was extremely domineering when executed with Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence! The Bloodblades forcefully shattered the void beast phantom and instantly attacked the three Supremacies. The three alien experts knew that they had met a thorny opponent the moment Meng Chuan cast his electromagnetic domain.
Could he be a Supremacy that has reached the Heaven Earth realm?
Even a Supremacy at the Heaven Earth realm shouldn’t be able to bully us so easily with just this tiny show of might.
He did it on purpose. He wanted us to attack.
The three alien experts felt grief in their hearts.
The moment Meng Chuan’s electromagnetic domain descended, the purple-robed man appeared 1,500 kilometers away from the battlefield. He calmly watched the battle play out.
He made his subordinates capture this unfamiliar Supremacy because, given his status, he couldn’t always be doing all the dirty work. He also wanted his subordinates to investigate the other party’s strength. If he had really provoked a tough opponent who deliberately hid his strength, he would be prepared.
“Let’s go.” Light covered the white-robed woman’s body. It was a silver armor. She tanked the electromagnetic domain’s lightning and forcefully fled into the distance. However, Bloodblades came one after another. “Brother Fang,” shouted the white-robed woman anxiously. At the same time, she used her palm technique to block a Bloodblade. Boom! Boom! Boom! The extremely domineering Bloodblade penetrated her palm and armor, instantly destroying her body. Although she was quite strong in close combat and long-range attacks-only slightly inferior to Qin Wu and company in terms of strength-she was naturally very weak in front of Meng Chuan. Horrified, the black-armored man sent a voice transmission.
“Spare me! I’m willing to submit!”
Boom!
A Bloodblade struck. The thin, black-armored man vanished into thin air. He entered the deep void, but the Bloodblade also pursued him in Using different methods, the thin, black-armored man constantly phased about in the deep void. He could constantly teleport, but due to the electromagnetic domain’s suppression, he could only teleport up to five kilometers each time. Boom! Boom! Boom! A total of nine Bloodblades surrounded him and pursued the thin, black-armored man as he fled through different void layers. Although the black-armored man relied on his constant teleportation, it took time for him to teleport each time. The Bloodblades were simply too fast. Under the nine Bloodblades’ relentless attacks, it only took nine seconds before the black-armored man faltered.
Pfft.
A single Bloodblade penetrated the black-armored man’s body; his body began to dissipate. His eyes were filled with indignation and despair. As the strongest expert in his homeworld, he had become a Supremacy in 300 years. He had cultivated to the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm in 1,000 years and raised his divine power’s strength to an unimaginable level. Without any treasures, he could unleash the strength of a threshold Imperial Lord. However, he had succumbed this time. Huh? Meng Chuan’s gaze landed on the cyan-scaled expert.
The cyan-scaled alien expert’s nine chains weren’t his strongest attack. Instead, his body was the strongest. Meng Chuan’s Bloodblades pierced through his body, riddling him in holes. However, water quickly flowed into the holes, and his body recovered.
The cyan-scaled alien expert’s entire body was like a strange body of water. Even with Meng Chuan’s Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence driving the Bloodblades, he was unable to destroy the cyan-scaled alien expert’s body with the Cloud Dragon Snake Saber Art. Unless there was a special situation, Meng Chuan was unwilling to use his paramount technique. What a powerful body, thought Meng Chuan.
I’ve provoked a great enemy. The cyan-scaled alien expert was alarmed. His other two companions had died instantly. Only he could barely withstand the attacks with his body. He believed that such a powerful Supremacy had many tricks up his sleeves. This expert could take him down if he exerted a bit more effort.
“Brother Fang, save me! Save me!” The cyan-scaled alien expert flew into the distance, but he flew very slowly under the electromagnetic domain’s suppression. The purple-robed man couldn’t be bothered to look at the cyan-scaled alien expert. Instead, he scrutinized Meng Chuan. “Interesting,” said the purple-robed man. “Hand the Tribulation treasure to me and follow me. I can spare your life.”

chapters.title: Chapter 494 - Attack With All His Might
chapters.content:
Chapter 494 Attack With All His Might
The purple-robed man took in these Supremacies as his followers, gave them pointers, and provided them with benefits. However, they were put to use at critical moments. For example, he would get them to explore perilous areas or figure out experts’ backgrounds.
Now that two of his subordinates had died, the purple-robed man was rather satisfied with Meng Chuan’s strength.
This self-proclaimed Eastcalm has demonstrated domains and moves that are still at the Grotto-Heaven realm, thought the purple-robed man. It’s very likely that he has a powerful cultivation system if he can unleash such strength. Furthermore, he has a Tribulation treasure. Using the lives of two trash to exchange for a powerful follower and an additional Tribulation treasure is really worth it. The purple-robed man continued observing Meng Chuan happily.
He observed Meng Chuan’s every move and minute change in expression. After doing so, he deduced Meng Chuan’s strength. Meng Chuan looked at the purple-robed man in puzzlement. “Follower?”
“Agree, and you’ll live. Otherwise, you’ll die,” said the purple-robed man. “I’ll give you 30 seconds to consider.”
At that moment, the cyan-scaled alien carefully flew towards the purple-robed man in the Electromagnetic Domain. At the same time, he thought with anxiety, I’m so weak. Just ignore me.
Within the electromagnetic domain—which covered a 500-kilometer radius—the Bloodblades flew at high speeds, constantly accelerating. As they gradually neared their maximum speed, the Bloodblades’ might became even more terrifying.
“Kill!” Meng Chuan couldn’t be bothered to waste any more time. The Bloodblades instantly vanished as they entered the deep void and approached the purple-robed man. After reaching the Chaos Hole realm, Meng Chuan’s Quintessential Essence had become extremely pure. In his homeworld, Meng Chuan’s Bloodblades could maintain peak strength as long as they were within 500 kilometers of him! However, without the worldly laws suppressing him in the outer realm, very few normal obstacles could affect Meng Chuan.
In the outer realm, his Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence flew even faster. Not only did his perception range increase greatly, but he could also maintain his Bloodblades’ peak strength as long as they were within 5,000 kilometers of him! Any further and the Bloodblades’ strength would rapidly decrease.
“Very good.” The purple-robed man remained very calm when he sensed the Bloodblades in the deep void approaching him.
The void within 5,000 kilometers of him instantly froze.
Whether it was the cyan-scaled alien expert, Meng Chuan, the electromagnetic domain, or the Bloodblades that flew through the deep void, they were all frozen!
The cyan-scaled alien expert couldn’t move at all. His eyes darted around.
The electromagnetic domain dissipated, unable to be maintained.
Boom!
Meng Chuan stood rooted to the ground. His surroundings were surrounded by a black domain that forcefully resisted the frozen void. Chi! Chi! Chi!
After the void froze, the rapidly-moving Bloodblades slowed down. They had less than 10% of their original speed. Although they were still flying, their strength was too low.
The purple-robed man instantly controlled the situation with a single move. At the same time, he said another word, “Collapse!”
Pa! Pa! Pa!
The frozen void around him shattered like a mirror. The void first froze, then shattered into countless spatial shards. The space shattering avoided the cyan-scaled alien expert. The deep void layer where the Bloodblades were located began to crack. The Bloodblades ended up in different spatial shards.
Hum.
Meng Chuan stood in his original spot, and the void layer he was in began to crack. However, his Chaos Hole domain maintained the stability of his surroundings! With him at the center, the surrounding five kilometers remained pitch-black and extremely stable. The spatial cracks in the outside world couldn’t affect Meng Chuan.
Although the Chaos Hole domain only had a five-kilometer range, it could forcefully repel worldly laws! An Imperial Lord’s Heaven Earth domain was good at suppressing and binding. Meng Chuan’s Chaos Hole domain was best at repelling! It repelled all external forces. If he was willing, Meng Chuan could also devour all external forces.
I need to kill him as soon as possible. With a thought, a dazzling bolt of lightning suddenly erupted from Meng Chuan’s body. The terrifying bolt of lightning pierced through the void and struck the purple-robed man.
Divine power-Heaven’s Wrath!
After reaching the Chaos Hole realm, Meng Chuan’s body became even stronger; his divine powers naturally improved greatly. A lightning bolt had instantly erupted from Meng Chuan’s. It was too fast.
Although the purple-robed man could sense the terrifying lightning bolt, he was struck by it before he could even move! The might of Heaven’s Wrath was comparable to Qin Wu’s Sky Splitting Sword Array; it was also faster. Whoosh!
A layer of light appeared on the purple-robed man’s body. The dazzling lightning bolt struck him, but the light barrier around him blocked it. The lightning snaked around the light barrier, but the purple-robed man remained unharmed.
The purple-robed man thought nothing of the lightning. Instead, he looked solemnly at the Chaos Hole domain around Meng Chuan. He thought to himself, What a powerful domain. Apart from that lightning domain, he also has an even stronger defensive domain. It seems to be a domain that devours and suppresses?
Entrap. The purple-robed man attacked with all his might. The void layer Meng Chuan was in was rapidly compressed into a pipe-shaped space. Even his Chaos Hole domain was trapped in this void pipe.
After reaching the Heaven Earth realm, his understanding of everything had reached the stage of self-creating worldly laws. His moves were even closer to perfection. Fang Chang’s control over the void was much more perfect than Meng Chuan’s.
Swish!
On the surface, he controlled the void as he secretly attacked Meng Chuan with a short spear.
This short spear was a Tribulation treasure.
This sneak attack was also one of the purple-robed men’s strongest killer moves.
Boom!
Meng Chuan’s perception of the void was similarly sharp. Although he couldn’t see it, he could still vaguely sense a terrifying threat rapidly approaching. “Kill.” Meng Chuan stepped on the Bloodblade Disc and instantly moved. The flow of time changed. Everything around him slowed down rapidly. The time flow was sped up by twenty-fold! Originally, Meng Chuan had wanted his divine power – Heaven’s Wrath-to strike and paralyze his opponent for an instant.
His Bloodblades would then follow up and kill his opponent instantly. However, since he had failed, he was forced to use his paramount technique! From their short exchange of attacks, Meng Chuan realized that the other party was clearly very skilled in the void lineage. His opponent had completely suppressed his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique! Even with his Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence and Tribulation treasure, he was still at a disadvantage.
Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish!
The time flow around the 18 Bloodblades changed as they flew, allowing them to move twenty-fold faster than before. The Bloodblades were much faster than Meng Chuan’s true body. The Bloodblades instantaneously reached a speed of 250,000 kilometers per second once the flow of time around them had been sped up! The Bloodblades weren’t too far from the speed of light. Oh? The purple-robed man’s expression changed drastically.
Before he could move, the Bloodblades struck him. Too fast. Boom! Boom! Boom! The 18 Bloodblade struck the purple-robed man. The might of each Bloodblade was much greater than when Meng Chuan first used the Cloud Dragon Snake Saber Art. Every strike left the cyan-scaled alien expert speechless. If they strike me, my body would be destroyed. The purple-robed man’s body was covered in a blurry layer of light. He used his full strength to defend against the Bloodblades. The seemingly thin layer of light blocked the 18 Bloodblades. Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!
Every time his body flashed, he would flee 1,500 kilometers. However, the Bloodblades were too fast. Every time the purple-robed man moved, the 18 Bloodblades would phase towards him and attack him.
Meng Chuan—who stood on the Bloodblade Disc in the deep void—was charging towards the moving purple-robed man. Suddenly,
A short gray spear appeared and rapidly approached Meng Chuan. Chi! Chi! Chi!
While on the Bloodblade Disc, Meng Chuan’s Chaos Hole domain naturally blocked the attack. The short gray spear only stopped when it was 30 feet away from Meng Chuan. With his Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence and Chaos Hole domain, Meng Chuan’s defense and repulsive forces were extremely terrifying. When the short gray spear was just 30 feet away from him, it was unable to advance any further.
He’s pretending to be an ordinary Supremacy even though he has reached the Heaven Earth realm. The purple-robed man gritted his teeth as he continued defending against the 18 Bloodblades. With his horizons and knowledge, he still couldn’t recognize a paramount technique when he saw one. He only believed that Meng Chuan had reached the Heaven Earth realm.
Boom!
The moment Meng Chuan blocked the gray spear, he flashed again. Meng Chuan was too fast with the Infinite Movement Technique. While the purple-robed man blocked the 18 Bloodblades, Meng Chuan had already arrived 50 kilometers away from him in the blink of an eye.
Swoosh.
A black Magic Awl flew out from Meng Chuan’s sea of consciousness. It instantly traversed 50 kilometers and stabbed into the purple-robed man’s head.

chapters.title: Chapter 495 - Blood Yang Realm’s Fang Chang
chapters.content:
Chapter 495 Blood Yang Realm’s Fang Chang
Pfft.
The black Magic Awl pierced through the purple-robed man’s Essence Soul forcefully. So that it couldn’t affect his cultivation, Meng Chuan had only used ten percent of his Essence Soul’s Origins to refine the Magic Awl. However, this seventh-level Essence Soul’s Magic Awl could still crush a sixth-level Essence Soul easily.
Chi!
The mysterious talisman in the purple-robed man’s arms silently disintegrated. The purple-robed man’s shattered Essence Soul instantly recovered. Even his expended strength was restored. However, he was alarmed. This was because the talisman was a life-preservation item-the Life Substitute Talisman. It would only be activated when one died. It would instantly recover one to optimal state.
Heavens Walk. The purple-robed man didn’t hesitate to activate another life-preservation item. Instantly, the purple-robed man split into 28 purple-robed men.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Every purple-robed man was extremely fast. Their figures moved unpredictably as they scattered and fled.
Although it took a long time to describe, it happened in an instant.
Meng Chuan’s Magic Awl had just shattered the purple-robed man’s Essence Soul, but the purple-robed man remained unharmed. He split into 28 purple-robed men and fled frantically.
Every purple-robed man’s aura was real. They fled extremely quickly, and no flaws could be seen.
You won’t be able to escape! Meng Chuan had read a large number of dossiers before entering the outer realm. He was already mentally prepared, so he didn’t panic at all.
Boom!
Meng Chuan instantly split into six.
One true body and five Essence Soul avatars executed the Infinite Movement Technique! They instantly chased the purple-robed men fleeing in different directions.
The 24 Bloodblade streams were faster than the six Meng Chuans.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
The 24 Bloodblade streams instantly erupted with speed comparable to the speed of light.
Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft!
In an instant, 23 purple-robed men were struck by the Bloodblades. All of them exploded. One of the purple-robed men was struck by a Bloodblade, but a blurry light barrier blocked it.
That’s the real body. The eyes of the six Meng Chuans lit up as they immediately surrounded that particular purple-robed man.
At the same time, the Bloodblade streams shattered the other four fake purple-robed men.
Flee! The purple-robed man, Fang Chang, frantically fled. The time flow around him sped up by fifteen-fold.
In terms of attainments in the void lineage, the purple-robed Fang Chang might be stronger, but in terms of speed? He couldn’t compare to Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan’s Infinite Saber focused on extreme speed. With it, Meng Chuan could still move faster than Fang Chang—who had used all his means-after changing the time flow.
Besides, six Meng Chuans were surrounding him.
Hum.
Every single Meng Chuan released an Astral Wave. When an Essence Soul avatar was within 50 kilometers of the purple-robed man, an Astral Wave struck him, immediately affecting his movements.
Shush!
Meng Chuan’s true body was within 50 kilometers of Fang Chang. Pfft.
The black Magic Awl pierced through the void, stabbing into the purple-robed man’s sea of consciousness once again.
The purple-robed man’s eyes instantly turned blank.
Master, I’ve disappointed you. The purple-robed man’s eyes turned completely dark. He floated in the void, completely suppressed by Meng Chuan’s domain.
Before he died, the purple-robed man didn’t beg for mercy. Fang Chang had reigned supreme throughout his life. He had once knelt and begged, but after that... he swore that he would never beg for mercy again!
He actually forced me to use the forbidden Essence Soul mystic technique, Magic Awl, to kill him. Meng Chuan stood in front of the corpse and sighed inwardly.
Ever since he reached the Chaos Hole realm, Meng Chuan had become invincible in Archean Eon Realm. He was already invincible when he revealed a sliver of his strength in Archean Eon Realm. Who would have thought that he would be forced to use all his strength just after coming to the outer realm?
Compared to the Grotto-Heaven realm, the Heaven Earth realm does indeed change one’s strength qualitatively. Meng Chuan waved his hand and stored the purple-robed man’s corpse into his Grotto-Heaven treasure. Following that, he looked into the distance. Meng Chuan’s dark Essence Soul avatar had already arrived in front of the cyan-scaled alien expert.
ce.
“Spare me! Spare me!” The cyan-scaled alien expert was terrified.
Heaven Earth realm strength?
Seventh-level Essence Soul?
How could he afford to offend such a terrifying existence?
I need to leave. The Essence Soul avatar instantly streaked across the void with the cyan-scaled alien expert in tow and arrived beside Meng Chuan’s true body.
The Essence Soul avatars fused with Meng Chuan’s true body.
Meng Chuan looked at the cyan-scaled alien and said coldly, “I’m going to question you now. You have to answer me honestly. I’ll carefully read your memories later. If I discover any lies, you are dead.”
“Senior, don’t worry. I’ll definitely answer honestly,” said the cyan-scaled alien obsequiously.
“Let me ask you,” asked Meng Chuan directly, “Was the purple-robed Fang Chang’s homeworld really Blood Yang Realm? Is there a Tribulation Eminence in Blood Yang Realm?”.
“Senior,” said the cyan-scaled alien expert reverently, “that Fang Chang really does come from the middle-sized world-Blood Yang Realm. There are two Imperial Lords in Blood Yang Realm. One is his third senior brother, Imperial Lord Dark Yang. The other is his master, Imperial Lord Crimson Yang. I heard that Imperial Lord Dark Yang is a middle-stage Imperial Lord, while Imperial Lord Crimson Yang is already a perfected Imperial Lord. His fame is widespread.”
“Are there any Tribulation Eminences who are on good terms with him?” asked Meng Chuan.
“No,” said the cyan-scaled alien.
Meng Chuan heaved a sigh of relief.
A Supremacy’s memories were too vast and complicated. It would take at least two hours to flip through them. If he wanted to escape, he couldn’t afford to waste two hours. Interrogations were much faster.
From the looks of it, Fang Chang only had two Imperial Lords backing him!
He had left Archean Eon Realm with many protective treasures that could muddy the heavenly secrets. Furthermore, the Heaven and Earth Great Hall had the ability to conceal him from the heavenly secrets. Only a Tribulation Eminence who was skilled in karma could deduce Meng Chuan’s location. If Fang Chang really had a Tribulation Eminence backing him, Meng Chuan would have immediately escaped the river system.
“Let me ask you. Which river system does this void belong to?” asked Meng Chuan.
“Heaven Peak River System,” said the cyan-scaled alien expert immediately.
Meng Chuan frowned slightly. “Heaven Peak River System?”
There were many river systems in the vast River of Spacetime, and many shared the same name. Many of them had special reasons for their name; thus, even if they shared the same name, they wouldn’t be willing to change it.
According to Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s records, there were a total of six Heaven Peak River Systems in the Spacetime Dominion Map.
“Which river zone is the Heaven Peak River System in?” asked Meng Chuan.
“River zone? What river zone?” asked the cyan-scaled expert curiously. As a Supremacy from a low-level world, he had limited knowledge. He didn’t know many secrets.
Meng Chuan was slightly taken aback as he looked at the alien Supremacy. He asked, “You should at least know which river system neighbors the Heaven Peak River System, right?”
“I don’t know much about them.” The cyan-scaled alien expert smiled awkwardly. “I’ve only heard of Cave Mountain River System, Dark Tide River System, and Three Ring River System. I don’t know anything else.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
Heaven Peak River System, Cave Mountain River System, Dark Tide River System, and Three Ring System neighbored one another? It corresponded to a specific area in the Spacetime Dominion Map.
Meng Chuan immediately understood where he was.
I ended up in Ancient Magus River Zone’s Heaven Peak River System. Meng Chuan felt staider.

chapters.title: Chapter 496 - Azurewater Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 496 Azurewater Realm
The cyan-scaled alien expert hurriedly said, “Senior, there’s something I need to report to you immediately.”
Meng Chuan looked at him. “Speak.”
“Blood Yang Realm’s Fang Chang wanted to capture you because he wanted to explore the cave abode of a Tribulation Eminence,” reported the cyan-scaled alien. “Fang Chang left a mark beside the cave abode, but I didn’t leave one. I can still find the cave abode if I bring you there now. If too much time passes, I might not be able to find it again.” Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up. “Where’s the cave abode?” “Let me take you there,” said the cyan-scaled alien expert immediately. “It’s not too far away.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Let’s go.” He couldn’t afford to miss the opportunity that came knocking on his door.
The cyan-scaled alien led Meng Chuan in a very obsequious manner. He was very afraid. He was afraid that the senior would find him useless after reading his memories and kill him in passing. Therefore, he had to make use of the time to please him, hoping that this senior Eastcalm would spare his life.
“If my estimates of its moving speed are correct, the cave abode should be in the surrounding area.” The cyan-scaled alien expert brought Meng Chuan to an area in the void and circled the area. However, he was somewhat puzzled. “Senior, I’ll take a closer look.”
“Is that cave abode over 500 kilometers in size?” asked Meng Chuan.
The cyan-scaled alien expert nodded immediately. “The cave abode is on a piece of stellar debris. The stellar debris is indeed more than 500 kilometers long.”
“Follow me.” After reaching the Chaos Hole realm, Meng Chuan was extremely sensitive to the world around him. He immediately flew with the cyan-scaled alien expert in tow. He could clearly sense the void ripples caused by the stellar debris’s high-speed flight as he approached his target.
“Right there.” The cyan-scaled alien revealed a look of delight. “Senior, you are indeed amazing.” Through the void ripples, Meng Chuan could determine its size.
Swoosh! Swoosh!
Two figures descended.
Only when he was 50 kilometers away did the stellar debris appear in his vision. After all, this Tribulation Eminence’s cave abode contained an array formation that isolated all light around the stellar debris. From afar, one couldn’t see the cave abode with the naked eye.
As for the void ripples, one had to be close enough to detect them. Otherwise, they wouldn’t be able to sense them from afar. Even the cyan-scaled alien expert, Qing Gu, couldn’t find it after shortly leaving it. Even the purple-robed Fang Chang had deliberately left behind a mark.
What a powerful cave abode. Meng Chuan also saw the cave abode in front of him.
The cave abode spanned over 50 kilometers and was located in the middle of the stellar debris’s surface. The array formation enveloped the area.
“We’ve tried exploring it a few times,” said the cyan-scaled alien expert. “We already tried to enter the cave abode. I had my Essence Soul avatar enter, but the cave abode’s sword beams killed it. However, from the looks of it... there shouldn’t be any cultivators inside this cave abode.”
“If the owner of this Tribulation Eminence’s cave abode was present, the lot of you wouldn’t have been able to land on the stellar debris.” Meng Chuan carefully examined the cave abode, his heart filled with anticipation.
The array formation was intact, and the entire cave abode was intact. This meant that the cave abode was not occupied. The cave abode was a treasure. If an outsider were to occupy the cave abode, they would have long stored it away.
It was possible that the Tribulation Eminence failed to survive the tribulation and died. Therefore, the cave abode he left behind might have all his treasures and corpse left behind. For instance, it was rare for someone like Ancestral Master Archean Eon—who reached the Seventh Tribulation realm—to die in his hometown peacefully.
Most Tribulation Eminences ended up dying during their tribulations!
Tribulations were the greatest obstacle for every Tribulation Eminence.
“Senior, Fang Chang had previously bound this stellar debris and made it fly towards Blood Yang Realm,” said the cyan-scaled alien immediately.
Towards Blood Yang World? Meng Chuan was alarmed.
With a thought, lightning appeared in his surrounding 500 kilometers, forming a lightning domain.
The lightning domain began to restrain the stellar debris.
Due to the negligible resistance in the outer realm, the stellar debris could fly at high speeds for a long time. However, under Meng Chuan’s control, the stellar debris began to slow down. In just a few seconds, it completely stopped.
“It stopped without any void ripples,” said the cyan-scaled alien obsequiously. “Unless one is within 5,000 kilometers of it and tries to locate the stellar debris with their own domain, it’s impossible to find it. There’s nothing within a trillion kilometers in the outer realm. It’s impossible for someone to come within 5,000 kilometers of this stellar debris.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
It was much harder to find stellar debris that had isolated light from the outside world than finding a needle in a haystack.
Meng Chuan looked at the cyan-scaled alien expert. “I’ll take a quick look through your memories to confirm that you didn’t lie. As long as you didn’t lie, I’ll spare your life. If you dare lie to me... Humph.”
“I wouldn’t dare. I wouldn’t dare at all,” said the cyan-scaled alien expert obsequiously. “I only want to live. Senior, please check my Essence Soul memories.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
After all, the cyan-scaled expert had a sixth-level Essence Soul. Meng Chuan could only check his memories if he didn’t resist.
The cyan-scaled expert was extremely obedient as he allowed Meng Chuan to read his memories.
The cyan-scaled alien expert came from the low-level world, Azurewater Realm. He was also the strongest expert of Azurewater Realm!
Azurewater Realm had a history of hundreds of millions of years. It was considered a relatively young world with life.
In Azurewater Realm’s history, only one Imperial Lord had been born! On average, a Supremacy was born every 100,000 years. In Azurewater Realm, a Supremacy would reign supreme once they were born. It meant that they were invincible in the world.
There’s only one Tribulation treasure in the entire Azurewater Realm. Unless one reaches the Imperial Lord realm, one is forbidden from bringing it out of their homeworld? Meng Chuan sighed inwardly. This was what a low-level world is like. A Tribulation treasure is extremely important. It’s the most important treasure in the entire Azurewater Realm. All of Azurewater Realm’s Supremacies study the Tribulation treasure’s runic patterns and figure out a cultivation direction.
The strongest manual in Azurewater Realm is an Imperial Lord-level ultimate technique. It’s also of the Windfire lineage. It’s not suitable for most Supremacies.
Meng Chuan sighed inwardly. One’s cultivation required a direction and their predecessors’ experiences. It was just like how it was extremely difficult for mortals to become Godfiends without manuals! Archean Eon Realm had only created the Godfiend cultivation system after experiencing a long period of savageness. To go from nothing to something was harder than mortals becoming a Supremacy. It was almost impossible for a Supremacy to reach the Fifth Tribulation realm or Sixth Tribulation realm without manuals. After all, they were cultivating blindly.
From shallow to deep mysteries, a manual with detailed guidance could guide one to a profound realm.
It was obvious how important such manuals were.
A Tribulation treasure had similar uses. By comprehending a Tribulation treasure’s runic patterns, they could receive guidance in a particular direction.
This Supremacy Qing Gu’s homeworld’s Tribulation treasure isn’t suitable for him. Meng Chuan flipped through his memories and understood everything about him. During his cultivation, he received an Imperial Lord-level legacy from Fang Chang. He also gained insights after studying the runic patterns on an Imperial Lord-level weapon, Nine Dragon Chain.
Pitiful.
Qing Gu had only obtained an ordinary Imperial Lord-level legacy because Fang Chang had given it to him. The Nine Dragon Chain was obtained by Qing Gu by chance when he followed Fang Chang.
wa
An ordinary Imperial Lord-level technique doesn’t even have the right to be placed in Star Cluster Building. Meng Chuan thought of his homeworld. Every manual in Star Cluster Building is a top technique.
For example, the lightning lineage Imperial Lord-level techniques-Lightning Walk, Lightning Fire Body Tempering Art, and Dark Lightning-could be considered incomplete Imperial Lord-level paramount techniques. To a certain extent, these three techniques had the might of an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique, but they had flaws. For example, the Lightning Fire Body Tempering Art allowed one’s body to match a Fifth Tribulation Eminence. It was indeed comparable to an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique. However, it had one flaw-one’s body would no longer be able to improve once they cultivated their body into a weapon.
Although these three techniques had flaws, they allowed an Imperial Lord to fight those at higher realms. Since Ancestral Master Archean Eon was willing to leave them in the Star Cluster Building, it showed how special they were.
Three World Saber and Lightning Realm were even more impressive techniques. A Sixth Tribulation ultimate technique could threaten Seventh Tribulation Eminences. Ancestral Master Archean Eon could find many Sixth Tribulation ultimate techniques, but he ultimately kept only two from the lightning lineage. To tempt King Calm Sea, the demons had offered a rather good ultimate technique to him. With the demons’ heritage, it was considered a good ultimate technique in the outer realm. However, after King Calm Sea obtained the Star Cluster Building’s ultimate techniques, he couldn’t be bothered to read them anymore.
So this is how tragic a low-level world is. Meng Chuan sighed. It’s already this difficult to find an Imperial Lord-level ultimate technique that suits one perfectly. It’s no wonder these Supremacies are willing to follow experts.
They had no choice. The things that slipped through the cracks of an expert’s fingers could delight Supremacies from low-level worlds greatly.
This Supremacy Qing Gu’s greatest wish is to perfect his homeworld’s cultivation system. Meng Chuan sighed inwardly.
Their cultivation system was incomplete.
In contrast, Archean Eon Realm’s Godfiend cultivation system was only flawed when one reached the perfected Imperial Lord realm to the Tribulation realm. Only the Samsara Divine Body was considered perfect.
The cultivation system from Supremacy Qing Gu’s homeworld-Azurewater Realm-had flaws at the Supremacy realm. Despite reaching the required Essence Soul realm and the Grotto-Heaven realm, they just couldn’t break through no matter how young they were! It was purely because of a flaw in the cultivation system.
This was also the reason why Azurewater Realm only produced a Supremacy every 100,000 years. If the cultivation system was perfected, a Supremacy might appear every few millennia.
Meng Chuan sighed. A suitable cultivation system... The aquatic creatures in Azurewater Realm had sharp claws and scales. They were very different from humans. Their physical characteristics were different.
The cultivation system of each world wasn’t universal unless one had a similar body type. For example, Ancestral Master Archean Eon had collected many legacies suitable for humans, such as the Cosmos Body cultivation system. Ancestral Master Archean Eon wouldn’t harm his descendants by leaving the legacies that were not suitable for them.
Archean Eon Realm has obtained many legacies from elsewhere, but the most suitable cultivation system for the world’s inhabitants is our self-created Godfiend system. If Azurewater Realm can give birth to a Tribulation Eminence, perhaps their cultivation system will be perfected up to the Supremacy realm. However, it would be very difficult.
Every world and civilization had their own hardships.
“Senior.” Supremacy Qing Gu sensed that Meng Chuan had stopped reading his memories. He raised his head and looked at Meng Chuan in horror.
Meng Chuan sighed.
After reading through his memories, he gained a deeper understanding of him. All Supremacy Qing Gu wanted was to learn more ultimate techniques from the outer realm. He wanted to learn more and help his homeworld.
Compared to the countless worlds in the outer realm, Qing Gu’s homeworld was too backward! It was too weak! This ‘weakness’ made Supremacy Qing Gu grit his teeth. He took risks just to make his homeworld stronger.
“In the future, just call me Eastcalm,” said Meng Chuan. “There’s no need to address me as Senior.”
“Yes, yes,” said Supremacy Qing Gu immediately.
“As long as you are obedient, I won’t treat you poorly,” said Meng Chuan. “Don’t worry, Brother Eastcalm. I’ll do whatever you ask me to do. I definitely won’t do something you forbid me from doing.” Supremacy Qing Gu immediately guaranteed. He knew very well what a follower needed to do if they wanted to live a long life.
Meng Chuan nodded slightly before looking at the mysterious cave abode.

chapters.title: Chapter 497 - Exploring the Cave Abode
chapters.content:
Chapter 497 Exploring the Cave Abode
“How much do you know about this cave abode?” Meng Chuan observed the cave abode. The cave abode’s array formation continued operating, enveloping the surroundings. Time was heartless.
If no one maintained the cave abode’s array formation, it would gradually be damaged over time.
The fact that the cave abode’s array formation was still operating meant that it hadn’t been long since it was established. At the very least, it wasn’t a cave abode from a million years ago.
“I don’t know much. I only know that when my Essence Soul avatar explores the cave abode, the area outside is very calm. Upon entry, the calm cave abode will suddenly release sword beams. I couldn’t dodge them at all,” said Supremacy Qing Gu. “As for what the other Supremacies have explored, I’m not sure. Only Fang Chang placed a mark on each Supremacy, allowing him to pry into everything they saw.” Meng Chuan nodded slightly. With a fourth-level Essence Soul, one could consume a tiny amount of their Essence Soul to form a mark on others. This mark could be activated at critical moments. When one attained a sixth-level Essence Soul, one’s Essence Soul thought could attach itself to a person, allowing them to observe the target’s surroundings.
“Okay.” Meng Chuan nodded gently. “It looks like your exploration range was very small. It’s no wonder you wanted to capture other Supremacies and continue probing.”
“That’s right. This cave abode is very terrifying.” Supremacy Qing Gu nodded. “Fang Chang wasn’t confident either. Although he had reached the Heaven Earth realm, he only had a sixth-level Essence Soul. He only had one Essence Soul avatar. If his Essence Soul avatar died while exploring, it would have taken him several years to recover.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Investigate the surroundings carefully. Guard the area well. Leave the exploration of the cave abode to
me.”
Supremacy Qing Gu secretly heaved a sigh of relief. “Yes.” Thankfully, the expert he followed still had a sense of pity. If Meng Chuan had forced his true body to enter, he would most likely have died in the cave abode.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged on a short mountain peak. He could see the cave abode below him, but an array formation protected it. It was difficult to see through the array formation.
Blood Yang Realm’s Fang Chang is quite wealthy. Meng Chuan had previously stored Fang Chang’s corpse into a Grotto-Heaven treasure. After such a long period of time, he had already sent his Essence Soul avatar to investigate the corpse carefully.
He had two Tribulation treasures. One is a short gray spear, and the other is the purple robe on his body. Unfortunately, they are all of the water lineage. If I want to make use of them, I have to exchange them for a lightning lineage Tribulation treasure.
Blood Yang Realm was a middle-level world. Since Fang Chang had reached the Heaven and Earth realm, Blood Yang Realm should have bestowed him with a Tribulation treasure. This was something many middle-level worlds did.
One Tribulation treasure had been bestowed to him by Blood Yang Realm’s experts. The other Tribulation treasure was something he obtained after all these years of traveling the outer realm.
There are also three Imperial Lord-level treasures. There are also two single-use treasures. He should’ve used the Life Substitute Talisman when I shattered his Essence Soul the first time. What a pity. It’s equivalent to a weaker Tribulation treasure.
According to the intelligence recorded in Archean Eon Realm, the outer realm life-preservation item-Life Substitute Talisman-was relatively common. It was equivalent to a Third Tribulation treasure. It was far inferior to the Void Transference Talisman. This was because the Life Substitute Talisman could only allow one to recover to their peak state instantly. During a dire situation, an enemy could kill them a second time!
A Void Transference Talisman was different. Even if one was within a world with life, they would be instantly teleported to any spot in the world despite the worldly laws’ suppression. In the outer realm, there was no suppression from the worldly laws. Because of this, a Void Transference Talisman could teleport someone extremely far away instantly. It could even allow a person to escape far away from a Tribulation Eminence, allowing the user to shake off their enemies completely.
In terms of value, a single Void Transference Talisman was equivalent to a Sixth Tribulation treasure. It was hard to find.
Even with Archean Eon Realm’s rich heritage, there had been only one remaining Void Transference Talisman in the current era. Furthermore, it had been used up. Even with the Demon Realm’s heritage, the three Imperial Lords needed to work together to exchange for a single Void Transference Talisman from the Demon Ancestral Cave.
What weapon should I give my Essence Soul avatar when it explores the cave abode? I can only exert more strength when I have a weapon. This shall be it. Meng Chuan made his decision.
A dark Meng Chuan suddenly flew out of his seated body and into the distant cave abode.
