A seventh-level Essence Soul avatar. Supremacy Qing Gu—who was in charge of guarding the area—couldn’t help but sigh in amazement when he saw Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar. Supremacy Eastcalm has reached the Heaven Earth realm; he has also attained a seventh-level Essence Soul. Why isn’t he an Imperial Lord yet? Does he want to cultivate a special technique and use it to reach the Imperial Lord realm?
He could only guess silently, not daring to mutter his speculations out loud.
Swoosh. Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar arrived at the cave abode’s entrance.
The cave abode’s array formation was vast and profound, but its might was restrained. There was no danger superficially, but the main entrance had already closed.
Boom!
The dark Meng Chuan casually threw Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence—which shimmered with lightning-and a silver metal piece. He used the Infinite Saber Art and transformed into a terrifying light beam, striking the entrance of the cave abode. After the door was blasted open, the silver metal piece flew back into Meng Chuan’s hand.
It’s a White Star Ore after all.
Yes. Meng Chuan had sent his Essence Soul avatar to probe the cave abode with the White Star Ore as its weapon. Since he was prepared to lose his Essence Soul avatar, he naturally couldn’t bear to let it carry a good weapon. He couldn’t even bear to let it use an Imperial Lord-level weapon! He was afraid that he would lose it and not be able to retrieve it.
As for weaker weapons? They were inferior to the White Star Ore!
Meng Chuan’s Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence carried the White Star Ore. Its strength was quite good. The White Star Ore was famous for its hardness. It was a material used to refine Tribulation treasures. However, a five-kilometer-wide White Star Ore was equivalent to a Third Tribulation treasure. If it was just one piece? Meng Chuan had obtained a thousand-foot-tall White Star Ore hill from Fang Chang’s corpse.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
A total of 99 White Star Ores were enveloped in Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence as they circled the dark Meng Chuan.
The dark Meng Chuan arrived at the main entrance.
After entering, fog filled the area. It was impossible to see through it with the naked eye. Even with a domain, it was also difficult to see through it. Even Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul perception domain was unable to see through it.
Buzz!
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar stood at the edge of the main door. He released an Astral Wave, letting it spread out in all directions. It barely affected the surrounding hundred feet before being suppressed.
It can suppress the Power of Essence Soul? Meng Chuan was secretly alarmed. It’s indeed a cave abode of a Tribulation Eminence.
Swoosh.
With a thought, Meng Chuan immediately enveloped one of the floating White Star Ores with his Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence. It transformed into a stream of light and shot it into the distance. However, when it touched the white fog, the high-speed White Star Ore produced sizzling sounds. The Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence on its surface eroded away in the blink of an eye, but the White Star Ore flew fast enough and struck something.
At the end of the day, I still have to enter the cave abode. Meng Chuan continued standing at the edge as lightning flashed around him. The flow of time around him also changed, speeding up by twenty-fold. After creating his paramount technique, Meng Chuan’s understanding of the spacetime lineage had surpassed what his divine power, Flowing Sand, could do. Meng Chuan could change time with his saber art. He could do the same with lightning.
Swoosh.
At the same time, Meng Chuan executed the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique. His Essence Soul avatar was faster and more agile than his true body. However, its defense was much weaker. Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The moment Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar rushed into the cave abode, the silent cave abode seemed to awaken. A large number of sword beams erupted and rushed towards Meng Chuan.
What a powerful array formation. I can’t enter the deep void. Fortunately, my movement technique has lots of variations. With the changed time flow, it’s not too difficult to dodge them. As Meng Chuan thought this, he advanced at high speeds.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
Nobody controlled these sword beams; thus, they had somewhat stiff movements. Due to the changed time flow, Meng Chuan’s agility was comparable to an Imperial Lord. He dodged the numerous sword beams.
It’s strange. My speed is very astonishing. However, why haven’t I seen any buildings after flying for so long? Meng Chuan was puzzled. This cave abode is only 50 kilometers wide.
Meng Chuan immediately guessed. A void array formation. The void here has been changed. No matter how I fly, I probably won’t be able to leave this small, confined area. Thus I must-tear apart! With a thought, 30 White Star Ores—which had been floating around him-executed the Infinite Saber Art, transforming into terrifying streams of light that struck the surroundings.
After the White Star Ores flew out, the area remained silent, just like the boundless void.
I’m trapped here? Meng Chuan flew back the way he came. The white fog enveloped him, making him unable to find the cave abode’s entrance.
The sword beams stopped for a moment.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar was trapped in the white fog. He tried his best, but he failed to touch anything. He was unable to escape the area.
My Quintessential Essence is exhausted. Forget it. With a thought, Meng Chuan could only dissipate the Essence Soul avatar.
On a short mountain peak far away from the cave abode, Meng Chuan sat cross-legged.
The main entrance is the easiest to enter, but it’s a trap. After entering, one will be trapped in the void cage forever. As for the weaker ones, they will be killed by the sword beams. I can’t even discover anything unique about the void cage.
It will take me three days to recover from my Essence Soul avatar’s death. I have plenty of time.
For an expert with a sixth-level Essence Soul, it would take their Essence Soul several years to recover from their Essence Soul avatar’s death.
An expert with a seventh-level Essence Soul could have up to nine Essence Soul avatars simultaneously. However, to create up to nine of them, each Essence Soul avatar contained a lesser amount of Essence Soul Origins. Thus, when one of these Essence Soul avatars died, one would only need a few months to recover.
Meng Chuan had also obtained the Essence Soul Star legacy. His Essence Soul had astonishing recovery speed; thus, he could recover from the loss in three days!
I’ll try the front entrance, back entrance, courtyard wall, and the top of the cave abode... In a year, I can send over 100 Essence Soul avatars. I don’t believe that an ownerless cave abode can stop me.

chapters.title: Chapter 498 - Owner of the Cave Abode
chapters.content:
Chapter 498 Owner of the Cave Abode
In the blink of an eye, three months had passed.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged on the desolate mountain hill. Behind him was an endless void.
It’s been three months. I’ve investigated the cave abode 30 times. Meng Chuan looked at the ancient cave abode. From the looks of it, no matter how I attempt to enter the cave abode
—be it from the main entrance, courtyard walls, ceiling, underground, etc.— I will be trapped in the void cage once I enter it. With my current realm, I can’t crack the void cage.
If I attack from the main entrance or from outside the cave abode, the White Star Ore will collide with an unknown object after it enters the cave abode. When I was trapped in the void cage, I attacked in every direction, but I received no response from the White Star Ores after they flew out.
After experiencing so many situations, I can determine that the void cage array formation doesn’t activate when a weapon flies into the cave abode. It allows a weapon to attack. If a living being enters, the void cage array formation will immediately activate and imprison the living being. Meng Chuan revealed a smile. I know how to crack the array formation.
With a thought
Swoosh! Swoosh!
Two dark Essence Soul avatars flew out simultaneously. This was the first time Meng Chuan had used two Essence Soul avatars.
Whoosh.
The two Essence Soul avatars arrived above the cave abode.
Swoosh.
SI
One of the Essence Soul avatars instantly swooped down and flew into the cave abode below. White fog filled the area; the Essence Soul avatar that flew in was trapped within the void cage. It was killed by a large number of sword beams. Due to the changed time flow and the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar dodged the void cage for a moment before the sword beams stopped.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar ended up trapped in the void cage.
The void cage below has been activated. Meng Chuan’s other Essence Soul avatar looked down from the sky. If I attack now, I won’t be attacking an unknown object, but the void cage.
He waved his hand.
His Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence carried a White Star Ore and transformed into a stream of light. It rushed towards the void cage that had formed.
The greatest flaw of an ownerless array formation is its source of strength. The outer realm’s powers are even more violent than the Heaven and Earth powers in an inhabited world. Even Regis Godfiends are unable to refine the outer realm’s powers.
Even if they hide in a safe place, they will ‘starve to death.’ Therefore, when I’m attacking from afar, this array formation would rather resist them. This is because this stable spatial resistance is less draining. As long as the void cage array formation is activated, energy will be consumed. The void cage’s defense against is much greater than normal spatial resistance. It’s normal for it to consume ten times more energy. Thus, all I need to do is deliver a powerful blow. It has to be so powerful that it consumes all the energy in this cave abode’s array formation. Without energy, the array formation will just be a joke. Meng Chuan was filled with confidence. Come on.
The levitating Meng Chuan immediately controlled the White Star Ore and began accelerating it!
In a second, it traveled 5,000 kilometers, 10,000 kilometers, 15,000 kilometers...
The White Star Ore accelerated in the 500-kilometer-wide region around him. The resistance from the outer realm’s void was negligible. The White Star Ore’s speed increased.
Meng Chuan didn’t accelerate the White Star Ore by changing the flow of time. This was because the White Sar Ore would only hit its target at its actual speed when it struck. It’s actual speed represented the impact’s power. Without altering the flow of time, he could save his Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence.
When the White Star Ore’s speed increased to a terrifying 175,000 kilometers per second, Meng Chuan could barely make the White Star Ore fly around him in circles, even with his Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence controlling it. He couldn’t control it any more precisely.
“Go.” The White Star Ore—which had reached a terrifying speed-suddenly flew towards the cave abode like a burning meteor.
If such a terrifying might struck Meng Chuan, even his body would have exploded into pieces! However, one had to accelerate for a long time before they could reach such speeds in the outer realm. At such high speeds, control also became increasingly difficult. In a life-and-death situation, nobody would give their opponent time to accelerate their attacks. Furthermore, they could dodge these attacks easily.
Rumble!
The meteor-like White Star Ore flew into the cave abode’s void cage. The void cage tried its best to weaken the blow, but it still produced a rumbling sound. The other Essence Soul avatar trapped in the cage could clearly hear it. He could sense the entire void trembling.
Very good. Just as I expected, the relatively weak void cage will consume even more energy when resisting a sufficiently powerful attack’s impact.
Continue.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar shot one White Star Ore after another. After shooting out 122 pieces of White Star Ores, the Essence Soul avatar flew back to Meng Chuan’s true body and replenished its Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence.
The consumption of Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence is too great. Meng Chuan sat cross-legged as he absorbed the outer realm’s violent powers with all his might. The Chaos Hole in his dantian constantly absorbed the external powers and turned it into Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence.
Back in my homeworld, I wantonly absorbed the Heaven and Earth powers when I broke through to the Chaos Hole realm. It took me one year and two months to finish the breakthrough. If I were in the outside world, I would have probably needed to absorb these violent external powers for ten years. In the future, when I break through from the Chaos Hole realm’s early stage to the middle stage, I would have to absorb the violent external powers for ten years to consolidate my strength.
From the looks of it, cultivation in the Chaos Hole realm requires Outer Realm Essence Stones.
In the outer realm, a Supremacy would be able to continue cultivating normally and engage in battle by absorbing the outer realm’s powers.
Imperial Lords were different. An Imperial Lord at the early stage would require immense energy to break through to the middle stage! If an early-stage Imperial Lord only absorbed the outer realm’s powers slowly, it would take them about 100 years to complete the breakthrough
If a Third Tribulation Eminence only absorbed the outer realm’s powers during a breakthrough, it would take them over 1,000 years to step into the Fourth Tribulation realm!
Therefore, the outer realm’s powers were too thin for Imperial Lords and Tribulation Eminences. Breaking through took way too long when absorbing the outer realm’s powers only. It was impossible for them to waste so much time to absorb the outer realm’s powers slowly. Therefore, they required Outer Realm Essence Stones.
Outer Realm Essence Stones were solidified outer realm essence energy. Of course, most of them had impurities, but the energy contained within them was very rich. Outer Realm Essence Stones were used by Supremacies when they had completely drained their energies during combat. Outer Realm Essence Stones could replenish their strength rapidly.
Outer Realm Essence Stones were more important for Imperial Lords and Tribulation Eminences.
Therefore, Outer Realm Essence Stones were the outer realm’s common currency! However, it was rare for a Supremacy to use Outer Realm Essence Stones for daily cultivation due to their low expenditure of energy.
Boom!
Meng Chuan’s true body sat cross-legged. A black vortex—that spanned over five kilometers-appeared in the sky. Large amounts of dark outer realm powers constantly surged into Meng Chuan’s body. The Chaos Hole in his body absorbed the outer realm’s powers slightly slower than an Imperial Lord.
As he absorbed the outer realm’s powers and turned it into Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence, his Essence Soul avatar constantly replenished its Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence before continuing to attack the void cage.
Although he had obtained more than 800 Outer Realm Essence Stones after killing Fang Chang, he wasn’t willing to use them. He temporarily absorbed the energy at maximum speed to maintain a balance between absorption and expenditure.
Although array formation techniques are more brilliant, a dead array formation can’t absorb the outer realm’s powers like me. I’ll slowly exhaust the array formation’s energy. If I really have no choice, I’ll use the Outer Realm Essence Stones.
Meteor-like White Star Ore pieces smashed into the void cage, causing the void cage to tremble every time.
He smashed the void cage with White Star ores 3,000 times a day.
Three months later.
Boom!
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar cultivated while it was stuck inside the void cage. As long as it remained inside, the void cage had to be maintained!
As another White Star Ore smashed into the void cage, the void cage trembled and turned into nothingness.
The fog dissipated.
A clear cave abode was revealed. The buildings in the cave abode were clearly visible. Not far away from the cave abode’s entrance was a stocky yellow-furred man’s incomplete corpse. He was Supremacy Qing Gu’s former teammate.
Swish! Swish!
After the void cage dissipated, Meng Chuan’s White Star Ores—which he had used to smash the void cage for three months-appeared. There were hundreds of thousands of them.
Whoosh.
The Essence Soul avatar waved its hand and put away the White Star Ores.
The other Essence Soul avatar flew down and looked at the cave abode that had revealed its true appearance. An ownerless cave abode’s array formation can only operate normally until its energy reserves are exhausted. The entire cave abode’s array formation has probably expended most of its energy now. It should be very easy to occupy the cave abode completely.
The two Essence Soul avatars released their Essence Soul perception domains. This time, the Essence Soul perception domains didn’t encounter any obstructions. They easily enveloped the cave abode below.
In that instant
Buzz
The entire cave abode rippled like a reflection in water. The ripples spread out in all directions. In an instant, they spread around the cave abode for thousands of kilometers.
Meng Chuan’s true body, which sat on the hill in the distance, and Supremacy Qing Gu—who was guarding the stellar debris’s peripherywere enveloped by the ripples.
This is? Meng Chuan was alarmed. Instantly, 24 Bloodblades surrounded him. His Chaos Hole domain protected him as he carefully observed his surroundings.
The scenery around them changed drastically. They arrived in another world, surrounded by towering mountains and raging rivers.
A bearded man with a gourd by his waist sat cross-legged on a towering mountain peak. At that moment, he opened his eyes and looked at Meng Chuan.
Creating a world with a single thought? An Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence? Meng Chuan was cautious.

chapters.title: Chapter 499 - Choice
chapters.content:
Chapter 499 Choice
Where is this? On the other side of the towering mountain, Supremacy Qing Gu looked around the mountainside dazedly. Who am I? Why did I appear here? Supremacy Qing Gu forgot his cultivation and climbed the mountain dazedly.
Elsewhere.
Meng Chuan had a seventh-level Essence Soul after all. Furthermore, he cultivated the Essence Soul Star formulation; thus, he could maintain his lucidity.
This is an illusory world. Only an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence can create an illusory world. Experts with eighth-level Essence Souls were known for creating ‘a world with a single thought.’ It was the most basic technique.
This bearded man should be the owner of the cave abode. However, the owner of the cave abode... is probably already dead. This is just an illusory world he left behind before he died.
For example, Archean Mountain’s Heart Sea Palace contained an illusory world. Furthermore, it can exist for a long period of time. If the owner of the cave abode was still alive, he could have done anything to him. Meng Chuan had no way of resisting. “You should be able to guess.” The bearded man sat cross-legged on the mountain peak. He looked at Meng Chuan from afar and smiled. “I’m already dead. Only a sliver of my will is left in this illusory world.”
Meng Chuan bowed respectfully. “Greetings Senior, I’m Eastcalm.” The accomplished came first in the path of cultivation.
An Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence was worthy of him bowing! Furthermore, it was the most basic thing one had to learn if they wanted to live a long life in the outer realm. They had to stay ‘respectful’ when facing experts in the outer realm.
“Eastcalm?” The bearded man smiled and nodded. “I’ve waited for over 30,000 years. My luck isn’t bad enough to have a human come.”
Meng Chuan listened obediently.
“My name is Pang Ming. My hometown is a low-level world, Pang Ming Realm,” said the bearded man.
Pang Ming Realm? His homeworld is named after him?
“You didn’t guess wrongly. I had the highest cultivation realm in the Pang Ming Realm’s history.” The bearded man nodded slightly. “It has been more than 600 million years since my homeworld was born. It’s considered a relatively young world that supports life... Eighty million years ago, my homeworld barely managed to create a path to the Imperial Lord realm. As for me, I’m the second Tribulation Eminence in my homeworld’s history. I cultivate both the Essence Soul and the physical body,” said the bearded man.
Meng Chuan was secretly astonished when he heard that.
Double cultivation?
“I ultimately stopped at the Fifth Tribulation realm. I failed to withstand the sixth Essence Soul Tribulation.” The bearded man shook his head gently. “I originally wanted to reach the Sixth Tribulation realm in this life. I wanted to spend more time upgrading my homeworld to a middle-level world. Unfortunately, I was just one step short. Of course, this step is as difficult as ascending to the heavens! Perhaps my years of cultivation had been wrong from the beginning. The Fifth Tribulation realm was my limit.”
Meng Chuan listened obediently. He understood what the other party meant. He had read Archean Mountain’s intelligence dossiers before. He knew that after reaching the Sixth Tribulation realm, one could raise a low-level world to a middle-level world if they paid a sufficient price.
Many low-level worlds had long histories—the younger worlds had over 100 million years of history. Some had billions of years of history. Although they had long histories, it was extremely difficult to upgrade a low-level world to a middle-level world.
In Heaven Peak River System, there were only over 600 middle-level worlds out of the 100,000 worlds that supported life.
“The Supremacy realm is the gradual perfection of the Grotto-Heaven realm,” said the bearded man softly. “The Imperial Lord realm is the gradual perfection of the worldly laws. One can raise their cultivation with the knowledge gleaned from clearly feeling the worldly laws... But at the Tribulation realm, it’s just groping about in the darkness. “What realm has one reached? Even the person in question isn’t sure. Has one cultivated rightly or wrongly? That’s unclear too.” The bearded man looked at Meng Chuan. “Perhaps, there’s no right or wrong for a Tribulation Eminence’s cultivation. Maybe there’s only the difference between the strong and the weak. The stronger ones can survive the Heavenly Tribulations, while the weaker ones will die if they fail to transcend them.”
Meng Chuan listened to the bearded man silently. Meng Chuan recalled that Eminence Fei Yu—the creator of the Essence Soul Star legacy that he discovered in his homeworld. Eminence Fei Yu had mentioned that he taught 12 disciples when he was alive. All of them learned the Essence Soul Star formulation, but all 12 went down different paths. Some had similar insights to Eminence Fei Yu, while others had completely different insights. The disciple with the highest accomplishments went down a completely opposite path to that of Eminence Fei Yu.
The bearded man said that Tribulation Eminences simply groped about in the darkness. There was no right or wrong during cultivation. There was only the difference in strength that separated them. It was indeed a reasonable statement. “The Sixth Essence Soul Tribulation arrived without any warning as usual,” said the bearded man. “I was still chatting with my good friend when this Heavenly Tribulation directly descended upon my body and struck my Essence Soul.
“After I failed my tribulation, I didn’t have time to escape back to my distant homeworld. All I could do was rush into the River of Spacetime and the nearest outer realm desert,” said the bearded man. “I only had time to make simple arrangements.”
The bearded man stood up.
Meng Chuan turned solemn.
Whoosh.
The bearded man instantly appeared in front of Meng Chuan. Meng Chuan continued standing there, listening humbly.
Gulp! Gulp! Gulp!
The bearded man grabbed the calabash hanging from his waist and drank a few mouthfuls of alcohol. He smiled and said, “The taste of alcohol is truly wonderful. Unfortunately, I won’t be able to maintain this illusory world after activating it once. I won’t be able to continue drinking either.”
Meng Chuan looked at him.
It was very difficult to maintain an illusory world for extended periods. For example, the Heart Sea Palace was a treasure that Ancestral Master Archean Eon had found.
“I have sent back many treasures I accumulated in my life to my homeworld.” The bearded man looked at Meng Chuan. “However, I kept quite a number of treasures with me when I was out adventuring. I possessed three treasures that were most suitable for me. One is a Seventh Tribulation treasure, while another is a Sixth Tribulation treasure. I have over 3,000 cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals, a fully-grown Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake’s corpse, as well as a piece of flesh from a Seventh Tribulation Dark Peacock. There are also many other items that are much less valuable.”
Meng Chuan was alarmed when he heard that. He knew that Ancestral Master Archean Eon had left behind many things for his descendants. However, considering how humanity continued developing in Archean Eon realm, there were very few treasures that could be taken out by Supremacies, Imperial Lords, and even Tribulation Eminences.
If Ancestral Master Archean Eon allowed any junior to take the treasures out as they pleased, his future descendants would have none remaining in no time.
Therefore, when Meng Chuan left the Archean Eon Realm, the most precious treasure he had on him was a Tribulation treasure-Bloodblade Disc. He was poorer than Fang Chang, who had been roaming the outer realm for many years. Of course, Meng Chuan had more life-preservation items than Fang Chang. The treasures carried by a Fifth Tribulation Eminence during his adventures in the outer realm. Meng Chuan was secretly excited. All of them are now in my hands?
“Since you breached my cave abode, I can’t give it to anyone else.” The bearded man smiled at Meng Chuan. “But we don’t know each other, so I can’t give it to you for free.”
“I understand. Senior, please state your conditions,” said Meng Chuan humbly.
The bearded man nodded slightly. “The conditions are very simple. Since you received my treasures, it means you owe me karma. This karma can only be resolved if you accept a Supremacy from my homeworld, Pang Ming Realm, as your disciple. Furthermore, you have to guide him until he becomes an Imperial Lord. You can’t have any intentions of harming him in this life. You have to treat him like how you treat a normal disciple.”
“I have to recruit a Supremacy from Pang Ming Realm as my disciple?” Meng Chuan frowned. “Pang Ming Realm is a low-level world. How long does it take for a Supremacy to be born in the world?”
“My homeworld has quite a rich heritage. I estimate that it will take 1,000 years for a Supremacy to appear,” said the bearded man with a smile. “Therefore, it’s not difficult for you to find a Supremacy from Pang Ming Realm after you reach the Tribulation realm.
“By the way, Pang Ming Realm is in Ancient Magus River Zone’s Myriad Horn River System,” continued the bearded man. “The karma you owe doesn’t have much of an effect on you in the early stages. After you reach the Tribulation Realm, the greater your realm, the greater the influence karma will have on you. Therefore, you can take in the disciple after you reach the Tribulation Realm.”
Meng Chuan listened carefully.
“If you don’t agree to my conditions, the treasures I hid in the space will instantly be obliterated. Some of the items inside will be shattered and destroyed. Some will be swept into chaotic spacetime turbulences and sent to various places in the River of Spacetime. You won’t be able to obtain anything,” said the bearded man.
“Furthermore, my illusory world will deliver its strongest attack before it’s destroyed. Your Essence Soul is at the seventh level. Furthermore, your Essence Soul seems to have cultivated a special formulation. Although I’ve been dead for 30,000, I have a 50% chance of destroying your Essence Soul by using a rare treasure.”
Destroying all the treasures? He would even attack his Essence Soul?
Meng Chuan didn’t find the bearded man’s words strange. After all, he had breached the cave abode forcefully! Apart from giving him the treasures, this Tribulation Eminence could only have the two go their separate ways.
“Don’t be in a hurry to agree.” The bearded man tipped his head and drank a few more mouthfuls of alcohol before leisurely saying, “Back then, I, Pang Ming, did some things to become stronger. I captured a Sixth Tribulation Eminence’s son and forced them to teach me powerful techniques. Two Sixth Tribulation Eminences are my mortal enemies. Therefore, even if you do obtain my treasures and weapons, you have to sell them secretly. Don’t get implicated because of me.”
“Besides, it’s only been over 30,000 years since I died. I’m guessing that the two of them are still alive. One of them is called Chang Jue. My other mortal enemy is called Immortal Lan Ming,” said the bearded man with a smile. “Alright, I’ve told you everything that needs to be said. It’s your turn to choose.
“Do you choose to accept my treasures or not?” The bearded man looked at Meng Chuan. “You have 30 seconds to consider. After 30 seconds, my strongest strike will descend before this illusory world collapses.”

chapters.title: Chapter 500 - That Piece of Flesh
chapters.content:
Chapter 500 That Piece of Flesh
The bearded man’s conditions were rather harsh for a cultivator who had the ambition to become a Tribulation Eminence.
He had to accept a Supremacy from Pang Ming Realm as his disciple?
On average, a Supremacy would appear in Pang Ming Realm every 1,000 years. If Meng Chuan were to become a Tribulation Eminence, what would happen if no Supremacy was available in Pang Ming Realm? Would he have to wait 1,000 years? What if the future Supremacy reached the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm in Pang Ming Realm? That Supremacy might choose to enter the outer realm after they had no remaining regrets in their homeworld. What should Meng Chuan do if the Supremacy died the moment they entered the outer realm? Before Meng Chuan could find the Supremacy? Did he have to wait for the next Supremacy to be born?
Furthermore, it takes an average of 1,000 years for a Supremacy to rise? What if it took thousands of years before a Supremacy from Pang Ming realm entered the outer realm? This karma would affect him for thousands of years.
The development of things was ultimately unpredictable. Meng Chuan had read the sect’s books and knew that he would really be blindly groping in the darkness after becoming a Tribulation Eminence!
Supremacies and Imperial Lords had a clear cultivation path. Imperial Lords only needed to make their Heaven Earths more perfected. Therefore, karma had limited effects on Imperial Lords. However, Tribulation Eminences groped about in the darkness. They didn’t even know if they had cultivated wrongly, so the effects of karma interference were very great. “Think carefully,” said the bearded man indifferently. He raised his head and drank. “Think carefully. Don’t regret it.” “I choose to accept it,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
They didn’t know each other to begin with, so how could this Tribulation Eminence give him treasures for free? In the cultivation world, love didn’t come for no reason. The law of the jungle was the most common.
For many years, be it Qiyue, my parents, the Godfiends of Archean Eon Realm, or me, our greatest wish has been to win the war against the Demon Realm. Even if I owe karma, I have to grow stronger as soon as possible! The stronger I am, the greater the probability of ending this war in our favor.
His number one goal was to win the war. Compared to reaching the Tribulation realm, it was 100, or even 1,000 times more important! Just some karma was nothing.
“Very good.” The bearded man smiled when he saw this. “Everything I left behind will now be yours.”
Swoosh.
A stream of light flew into Meng Chuan’s consciousness. It contained everything left behind by Pang Ming. Following that, a loud whoosh reverberated!
The entire illusory world began to collapse. “I traveled the outer realm alone for 28,000 years, only to stop at the Fifth Tribulation realm in the end,” muttered Pang Ming as he held a calabash in his hand. His figure disintegrated along with the illusory world. Meng Chuan silently watched this scene. All Tribulation Eminences aided their homeworlds not because they were ‘grateful,’ but because of karma!
A huge debt of gratitude would arise when a world produced an expert. This karma between the expert and their homeworld was extremely important! Therefore, weaker Tribulation Eminences would place many treasures in their homeworld. Although their true bodies in their homeworld carried these treasures, as long as the treasures were in their homeworld, it would be considered part of their homeworld. This was also a form of compensation to their homeworld. After reaching the Sixth Tribulation realm, all Tribulation Eminences would try their best to upgrade their low-level world to a middle-level world. If they were from middle-level worlds, they had to work hard on expanding the middle-level world and strengthening the world’s Origins. Upon reaching the Eighth Tribulation realmwhich Eminence Fei Yu had done-one could upgrade homeworld to a high-level world.
This Tribulation Eminence, Pang Ming, failed his tribulation. Before he died, he only asked me to help Pang Ming Realm’s cultivators. He really has true feelings for his homeworld, thought Meng Chuan. It’s very rare for a low-level world to produce a Fifth Tribulation Eminence who cultivates both the Essence Soul and the physical body. He’s the only one in hundreds of millions of years.
My homeworld, Archean Eon Realm, has only existed for a few hundred million years. It’s considered a very young world. Meng Chuan thought of his homeworld. It was also extremely difficult for cultivators of the Godfiend cultivation system to rise to prominence during the world’s early barbaric times. This continued for more than a million years until Ancestral Master Archean Eon rose to prominence. As a Supremacy, he roamed the outer realm alone... He cultivated step by step and became a legendary figure in the River of Spacetime. Meng Chuan sighed. He also gave Archean Eon Realm an extremely robust foundation. The Godfiend cultivation system is very perfected up to the perfected Imperial Lord realm. Meng Chuan was very impressed with Ancestral Master Archean Eon. The first three tribulations were relatively easy. From the Fourth Tribulation realm and onwards, the tribulations would become more difficult to overcome as one advanced on their cultivation path.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon had left a tremendous legacy for his homeworld.
Although the demons had invaded, Archean Mountain still had the option of annihilating the world. As time passed, humanity’s heritage would deepen. However, Meng Chuan, Liu Qiyue, King True Martial, and the other Godfiends-who had participated in the war that has lasted for over 800 years—wanted to win the war.
If they really did choose to go for World Annihilation, it would be very humiliating for Meng Chuan and his generation of Godfiends! They would never be able to remove this thorn in their hearts for the rest of their lives.
They wanted victory, even at the cost of their lives. Meng Chuan was unwilling for the World Annihilation plan to happen. No matter how much karma he was tainted with, he would do his best to become stronger as soon as possible.
The illusory world collapsed. Supremacy Qing Gu regained his consciousness.
What happened to me just now? What happened? Supremacy Qing Gu stood rooted to the ground dazedly. His memories of the illusory world had turned blank. He had lost a portion of his memories. Another memory loss? Supremacy Qing Gu was helpless.
Previously, to gain Meng Chuan’s trust, Supremacy Qing Gu completely wiped his memories of Fang Chang from his Essence Soul! There was no longer a person named Fang Chang in his memories. This was why he couldn’t even tell others that Meng Chuan had murdered Fang Chang. He believed that this was the only way to make Meng Chuan feel at total ease, allowing him to stay alive.
He had already lost two portions of his memories. He had voluntarily removed and wiped away the first portion of memories. However, the second portion of memories had been removed through unknown means.
Swoosh.
Supremacy Qing Gu quickly flew to Meng Chuan’s side and said respectfully, “Brother Eastcalm.”
“This cave abode has been breached,” said Meng Chuan. “Continue guarding the outside.”
“Yes,” said Supremacy Qing Gu. Meng Chuan immediately flew into the cave abode. The cave abode was once again filled with fogs. At that moment, Meng Chuan took the initiative to control the cave abode’s array formation. His Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence activated the array formation.
In a courtyard in the cave abode, Meng Chuan sat cross-legged on the crystalline jade ground and began checking his gains.
When I first came to the outer realm, the Bloodblade Disc was the most valuable item I had. However, the Bloodblade Disc is my intrinsic treasure. I definitely won’t sell it. Meng Chuan was somewhat wistful. He had gained quite a bit from Fang Chang—who had adventured the outer realm for years. After all, Blood Yang Realm was a middle-level world. It had a rich heritage.
I’ve really made a killing now. What was the owed karma in comparison? At the very least, he could grow stronger much faster than before! This is a Spatial Pagoda? Meng Chuan looked at the miniature golden pagoda in his palm. It was a Tribulation treasure-Spatial Pagoda.
It could not store living beings-only items or dead objects. However, it was extremely stable!
This Spatial Pagoda’s value was comparable to a Fifth Tribulation treasure. Just the characteristic of ‘stability’ was very important. This was because many treasures in the outer realm were too mystical. Ordinary void bracelets couldn’t store them. Even Meng Chuan’s void bracelet would collapse.
Swoosh.
With a thought, the golden pagoda entered Meng Chuan’s dantian space.
I gained one Seventh Tribulation treasure and two Sixth Tribulation treasures. Meng Chuan waved his hand and released the treasures Senior Pang Ming often used from the pagoda.
They were a calabash, a robe, and a sledgehammer. The calabash was a Seventh Tribulation treasure.
Although my Bloodblade Disc was refined by a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, it was only refined for his disciple near the end of his life. It’s mainly used for escaping. It can only be considered a Sixth Tribulation treasure. However, Meng Chuan knew that the Bloodblade Disc wasn’t ordinary. The Bloodblade Disc was suitable to be used at different cultivation realms. Furthermore, it contained many profound mysteries of the Seventh Tribulation realm. It was considered to be a relatively top-grade Sixth Tribulation treasure.
To the weak, the Bloodblade Disc was a stronger treasure.
This calabash is comparable to several Bloodblade Discs. Meng Chuan sighed inwardly. These three treasures are considered a part of Senior Pang Ming’s treasure trove. Unfortunately, Senior Pang Ming is skilled in the Mountain River lineage. It’s not compatible with the lightning lineage. I can only sell these treasures in the future and exchange them for something that suits me. However, I’m currently too weak. It’s not wise to take out such treasures in public. I’m afraid it’ll bring me trouble.
Nobody could distinguish the grades of his owned Tribulation treasures whilst fighting. However, when trading? He naturally had to let others take a closer look at the Tribulation treasures and confirm their specific strengths.
With his current strength, it wasn’t suitable for him to take out a Seventh Tribulation treasure for trading
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan waved his hand and put away the three precious Tribulation treasures. With a flip of his hand, a fist-sized cubic crystal jade appeared in his palm. Chaotic mist flowed within the crystal jade. This is an Outer Realm Essence Crystal. Meng Chuan sighed in amazement. Just this piece of Outer Realm Essence Crystal is enough to exchange for an Imperial Lord-level treasure. Senior Pang Ming has 3,000-plus Outer Realm Essence Crystals in the Spatial Pagoda. In terms of value, the Outer Ream Essence Crystals have the same value as the three Tribulation treasures.
Outer Realm Essence Crystals were the outer realm’s currency. Tribulation Eminences consumed a terrifying amount of energy when battling. Absorbing the outer world’s powers would be too slow for them. Even Senior Pang Ming-who had reached the Fifth Tribulation realm-found using Outer Ream Essence Stones too slow. Thus, he mainly used Outer Realm Essence Crystals. After reaching the Tribulation Transcendence realm, one needed even more Outer Realm Essence Crystals. Senior Pang Ming had prepared for his cultivation in the Sixth Tribulation realm, so he had kept a sufficient amount of Outer Realm Essence Crystals. However, he failed to survive the sixth Essence Soul Tribulation.
Senior Pang Ming’s treasures make up 30% of his wealth. The Outer Realm Essence Crystals make up another 30% of his wealth. Meng Chuan looked at the massive corpse in the pagoda-it was a 5,000-kilometer-long body. It was an Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake’s corpse!
An adult Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake’s complete corpse. Meng Chuan looked at it. It’s a powerful Tribulation Eminence. With this corpse, one can absorb its complete bloodline. This absorbed bloodline can be passed on for generations.
The Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake was ranked high among the alien beasts. However, Meng Chuan didn’t think much of it. I can sell it in the future. I don’t have the strength to refine this corpse. Furthermore, Archean Eon Realm doesn’t need it. Archean Eon Realm has the phoenix bloodline and the dragon bloodline.
There were countless aberrant existences in the outer realm. Many of them were very mediocre. Some of the life modification processes undergone by Regis Godfiends and fifth Firmament demon monarchs used ordinary materials coming from these special lifeforms.
The Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake and the Dark Peacock were considered powerful special lifeforms. However, there were two special lifeforms that were considered the strongest-the dragon and the phoenix! Of course, that was referring to pure-blooded dragons and pure-blooded phoenixes. Ancestral Master Archean Eon had once obtained an adult pure-blooded dragon and an adult pure-blooded phoenix. He refined the two complete bloodlines, allowing humans to have the phoenix bloodline and the dragon bloodline. It was only because humanity didn’t have these two bloodlines for very long. If a Supremacy-level or an Imperial Lord-level Phoenix Divine Body (Dragone Divine Body) expert appeared, one would know how terrifying these two bloodlines were.
I can sell the Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake’s corpse after I become an Imperial Lord. It’s not too eye-catching either. Meng Chuan didn’t think too much of it because it wasn’t a very precious item in Senior Pang Ming’s treasure trove.
Senior Pang Ming’s most precious treasure is even more valuable than the Seventh Tribulation treasure...
Meng Chuan looked for the item inside the pagoda. However, his mind went blank when his consciousness went too close to it. He couldn’t sense anything.
I can’t see it at all. It looks like I have to take it out. Meng Chuan was somewhat nervous.
Meng Chuan first cast his Chaos Hole domain and infused his Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence into his domain to protect his surroundings. He also made his Bloodblades surround his body. Following that, Meng Chuan took the item out from the pagoda. Come out. Although he couldn’t see it, he could sense the treasure’s location after he gained control of the pagoda.
Boom!
It appeared 100 feet in front of Meng Chuan.
The moment it appeared, the void trembled and distorted.
Meng Chuan stared at it. He tried to probe the item with his Essence Soul perception domain and Chaos Hole domain, but they were useless. His perception still remained blank when he tried investigating the item. He could only see its surface with his naked eye. At Meng Chuan’s realm, he could see many layers of ordinary matter with his naked eye. However, he could only see the item’s surface.
A piece of flesh from a Seventh Tribulation Dark Peacock? In terms of value, it’s much more expensive than the calabash. Meng Chuan carefully examined it.
A Dark Peacock was a very powerful special lifeform. However, although a Dark Peacock went through hardships and excavated its potential to reach maturity, it would only reach the perfected Imperial Lord realm. It could fight Third Tribulation Eminences. However, if a Dark Phoenix wanted to become stronger? A Dark Phoenix would have to cultivate like other species and rely on their own cultivation to reach the Tribulation realm. Physical Body Tribulation Eminences had very special bodies. A piece of flesh extracted from a Physical Body Tribulation Eminence would instantly turn to dust and disappear. Their bodies would be restored to their original state. When they were alive, it was impossible to take a single drop of blood or a strand of hair from them.
Only after a Physical Body Tribulation Eminence died could one dissect their corpses.
Such corpses... were the most precious treasures for a Physical Body Tribulation Eminence.
It shouldn’t have died from a failed tribulation. The stronger one is, the more unwilling they are to let their bodies be dissected and violated. According to Archean Mountain’s dossiers, a Tribulation Eminence will usually destroy their bodies—not leaving a single trace behindafter they fail to transcend a tribulation. The true bodies left in their homeworld can be left to their descendants. However, they will also set up things that prevent their descendants from violating their corpses.
Therefore, it’s very likely that he was killed. After all, the corpse has been preserved. Every piece of flesh and drop of blood within a Physical Body Tribulation Eminence’s body contains their cultivation path of the Tribulation realm. A Seventh Tribulation Dark Peacock? Meng Chuan sighed in amazement. The Dark Peacock species had extremely high talent.
However, due to their high talent, it was extremely difficult for them to reach the Tribulation realm. It was extremely difficult for a Dark Phoenix to become a Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
Seventh Tribulation treasures contained a portion of the profundities of a Tribulation Eminence’s cultivation path. The flesh and blood of a Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence? It contained all the accomplishments of that Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence.Cultivation? Although one could deduce a cultivation path, it didn’t mean that they could verbalize it or express it. The profundities that were written within manuals and refined into treasures were all things that could be expressed. Some profundities were extremely difficult to express. However, they were perfectly reflected in a Physical Body Tribulation Eminence’s body.
Pang Ming had paid a huge price to obtain this piece of flesh. He often perceived the profundities contained within this Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s body. Chi! Chi! Chi!
The piece of flesh floated in the air, exerting tremendous pressure on the Chaos Hole domain.
Go. Meng Chuan carefully controlled a Bloodblade. When the Bloodblade was just one foot away from the piece of flesh, an invisible barrier prevented it from approaching any further.
It’s true. I can’t even touch it, much less cut it. Meng Chuan carefully looked at the black jade-like flesh. This piece of flesh was larger than an ordinary person’s head. One side was skin; flesh could be seen on the other side. He could also see dark-purple blood. The other parts couldn’t be seen clearly.
The black jade-like piece of flesh’s skin was similarly crystalline. A faint black membrane covered its surface.
Meng Chuan glanced at the skin membrane. Meng Chuan—who had reached the Chaos Hole realm-magnified it with his naked eye by millions of times. To him, the skin was currently as vast as a tiny star. Meng Chuan could see countless runes flowing on the black membrane. A Physical Body Tribulation Eminence’s corpse was a manifestation of the law profundities they had perceived.
Oh? Meng Chuan looked at the countless runic patterns on the skin. He suddenly discovered something similar to his paramount technique, Infinite Saber. However, it was many times more complicated.

chapters.title: Chapter 501 - Dormancy (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 501 Dormancy (1)
The black jade-like flesh-the black membrane on its skin surface—was magnified millions of times with Meng Chuan’s naked eye. The runes contained within were vast and uncountable. They were much more massive than the runes contained within the Bloodblade Disc. The parts that were similar to Infinite Saber were the core.
Meng Chuan looked at them excitedly. Ignoring those that he couldn’t understand, he stared at the parts similar to Infinite Saber and studied them.
Infinite Saber pursues paramount speed. Meng Chuan observed. I can vaguely understand a portion of these runes. If I’m not wrong, they should be the laws of paramount speed. The paramount speed law and another law perfectly form the core.
Meng Chuan could tell that these two laws were clearly separated! One was Yin, and the other was Yang. One was like the heavens, and the other was like the earth. Although the differences were obvious, they complemented each other and formed a core.
Countless runes appeared under the core laws’ dynamics. These countless runes were actually the mysterious black membrane on the black jade-like skin. If Meng Chuan could fully comprehend these runes, a membrane would also form on the surface of his skin.
My Infinite Saber is only at the Grotto-Heaven realm’s early stage. This paramount speed law is many times more profound than what I have comprehended. Meng Chuan remained very clear-headed even though he was slightly excited.
According to the records left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon, once a Supremacy-level paramount technique has reached the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm and broken through to the Heaven Earth realm, it would typically be stronger than a normal Imperial Lord-level ultimate technique. One would also have a small chance of creating Imperial Lord-level paramount techniques like Lightning Walk, Dark Lightning, and Lightning Fire Body Tempering. However, such techniques would still have flaws.
There’s only an extremely small chance of creating a true Imperial Lord-level paramount technique.
One could occasionally see Supremacy-level paramount techniques. However, Imperial Lord-level paramount techniques were legends! Even if one comprehended or created one, they would keep it a secret.
An Imperial Lord-level paramount technique reaches its limits at the perfected Heaven Earth realm. Meng Chuan understood these secrets. If one pursues speed only, one can eventually reach paramount speed completely.
What was paramount speed? It was to transform into true light!
When cultivating, one would discover that the closer one was to light speed, the harder it was to improve. Even time would begin to distort as one’s speed increased. When one reached light speed, a completely different world would come into view!
In fact, Tribulation Eminences usually cultivate in some prescribed order. They spend a long period of time accumulating insights. Once a person reaches the Sixth or Seventh Tribulation realm, they will have a sufficiently deep understanding of spacetime. Only then will one be able to reach paramount speed. Meng Chuan understood this. The higher one’s cultivation realm was, the more terrifying the means a Tribulation Eminence had available to them.
This Senior Dark Peacock reached the Seventh Tribulation realm. He also naturally grasped the paramount speed law and another set of corresponding laws at the Seventh Tribulation realm. Furthermore, he has the ‘laws’ that help combine the two other laws perfectly... The three laws are so powerful when working in concert.
Meng Chuan marveled as he examined the runes. It was just like how mortals knew that mountains were made of soil and rocks when they looked at them.
Meng Chuan barely knew that the membrane runes contained three different laws within. However, if he wanted to comprehend them? That was much harder than a mortal building a mountain.
Look at its muscles and blood. Meng Chuan carefully examined the piece of flesh. It was magnified by millions of times as Meng Chuan stared at it with his naked eye.
The dark-purple blood was magnified by millions of times in his vision. It now looked like a dark-purple jade that connected with each other. He couldn’t see any microstructures, nor could he see any burrs. All the magnified details of the dark-purple blood looked completely like smooth dark-purple jade.
What? Meng Chuan stared at the piece of flesh blankly.
Even Supremacies and Imperial Lords could see the microscopic structures in blood after magnifying it by millions of times. They even had a chance of seeing tiny sand-like particles. Now, not even mentioning particles, he could only see the dark-purple blood was perfectly whole. There were no runic patterns to be seen.
That’s strange. Meng Chuan was secretly puzzled. From the looks of it, I can only see more when my Essence Soul’s powers are infused into it.
With his current Essence Soul, he could use a microscopic vision mystic technique. With it, ordinary particles were as large as a Grand Yang Star. Furthermore, his Essence Soul thoughts were capable of entering an object’s interior and probe it. Meng Chuan even believed that he would be able to glean some secrets from a Dark Peacock that was a Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
Unfortunately, despite all his reconnaissance techniques, this piece of flesh remained blank in his vision. He could only see the profundities contained within the piece of flesh with his naked eye.
After my strength increases, I’ll take a look at his muscles and blood, thought Meng Chuan to himself. The muscles currently also appeared like a perfect whole. He couldn’t see any microscopic structures after magnifying it by millions of times.
He could only see runes on the skin membrane.
This membrane is very similar to my Indestructible Divine Armor. It’s a naturally-formed membrane that covers the skin surface. It’s similar to a divine power, which is why I can see the runes with my naked eye.
“Brother Eastcalm.” Supremacy Qing Gu respectfully stood in front of Meng Chuan.
“Qing Gu, stay in the eastern courtyard first,” said Meng Chuan. “I plan on cultivating here for some time.”
“We’ll stay here forever?” asked Supremacy Qing Gu. He couldn’t help but look outside. Outside the cave abode was the endless outer realm.
Meng Chuan smiled and said, “In a few years, we’ll head to Black Dragon Planet.”
Supremacy Qing Gu’s eyes lit up in excitement as he nodded immediately. “I understand. I’ll take my leave then.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly as he watched Supremacy Qing Gu leave.
Black Dragon Planet. Meng Chuan glanced at the endless void. I obtained Senior Pang Ming’s treasures. If I want to grow faster, I need to sell the treasures that are useless to me. Black Dragon Planet is Heaven Peak River System’s most important trading planet.
Heaven Peak River System’s strongest Tribulation Eminence cultivated in Black Dragon Planet. It was said that he moved 64 grand Yang Stars and 64 Grand Yin Stars to set up a defensive array formation around Black Dragon Planet! On Black Dragon Planet, killing was forbidden. It was the safest trading ground.
Black Dragon Planet is a trading planet. The Eternal Tower exists among the many buildings on the planet. Eternal Tower’s forces have already infiltrated Black Dragon Planet.
Meng Chuan knew of many secrets after reading his sect’s records.
Eternal Tower... was one of the top factions in the outer realm’s infinite spacetime! Back when Ancestral Master Archean Eon reached the Fifth Tribulation realm, he had been invited to join as a member. When he was at the Seventh Tribulation realm, Ancestral Master Archean Eon was a high-ranking member of Eternal Tower.
Of course, after Ancestral Master Archean Eon died, he naturally lost his position as one of Eternal Tower’s upper echelon members. This was how Eternal Tower’s members were replaced over the generations.
Although I don’t plan on trading the most precious items, I have to choose a safe place even when I’m only taking out a small portion of them. Black Dragon Planet’s Eternal Tower is the key to my transactions. Although Eternal Tower had a good reputation, he didn’t dare take out the Seventh Tribulation treasure for trading because it was never absolutely safe.
As long as the temptation was high enough, anything could happen. Since he was weak, he had to keep a low profile.
Meng Chuan came to the outer realm to cultivate. Now that he had gained some insights from the Seventh Tribulation Dark Peacock’s flesh and blood, he naturally immersed himself in his cultivation, unwilling to be disturbed.
Thus, many days passed.
The paramount laws produce the Origins of Paramount. The Origins of Paramount also repels all external entities? Meng Chuan was somewhat confused as he studied his new knowledge. Although he was still confused, he vaguely understood why his original dantian power source-Source of the Seamless Realm —had collapsed and turned into a chaos hole.
From the looks of it, one has to comprehend a paramount technique if they want to reach the Godfiend cultivation system’s Chaos Hole realm. The Chaos Hole realm clearly isn’t universal for those in Archean Eon Realm. In fact, it’s very normal that nobody else in Archean Eon Realm has reached the Chaos Hole realm. After all, the threshold for reaching the Chaos Hole realm is naturally very high since one gains a 5,000-year lifespan at the Supremacy realm. One’s domain is also nearly comparable to an Imperial Lord’s Heaven Earth domain.
It’s no wonder the Chaos Hole domain repels all external powers. In terms of defense, my divine power, Indestructible Divine Armor, is no longer as strong as the Chaos Hole domain. Because of this, I can give up on this divine power. I’ll use my Infinite Saber’s laws as the core of my new technique. This new defensive technique will be similar to the Seventh Tribulation Dark Peacock’s skin membrane.
“I failed,” muttered Meng Chuan with a frown as the robe over his body dissipated.
Clang!
Meng Chuan’s right hand shattered into nothingness before rapidly regenerating. From the looks of it, it isn’t suitable to use the Cosmos Body cultivation system’s methods without Cosmos Crystals. Even without using my physical strength, it is already much easier to control it after fusing my Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence and Chaos Hole domain.
Meng Chuan’s 15th version of the Body-Protecting Peacock Robe.
The Bloodblade moved at a speed of 75,000 kilometers a second and struck the Body-Protecting Peacock Robe. Meng Chuan glanced at the Bloodblade—which had transformed into a light beam as it flew at high speeds—and the Blood Peacock Robe, which had spread out hundreds of feet around him. The robe spread out in all directions as the Bloodblade struck it.
Boom!
A huge hole appeared in his Body-Protecting Peacock Robe.
Meng Chuan shook his head and continued pondering
Years passed. In the blink of an eye, five years had passed since Meng Chuan became the cave abode’s owner.

chapters.title: Chapter 502 - Dormancy (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 502 Dormancy (2)
In the dark outer realm, on an invisible stellar debris.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in the cave abode’s courtyard. Above the courtyard was the vast void.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
A fist-sized gray stone hovered in front of Meng Chuan. The gray stone glowed with a faint crystalline luster. The liquefied outer realm essence flew out from the gray stone and fused with Meng Chuan’s body as he constantly absorbed it.
This was an Outer Realm Essence Stone.
Outer Realm Essence Stones were objects condensed from outer realm essence energy. However, too many impurities defiled these stones. Compared to the impure stones, Outer Realm Essence Crystals didn’t contain any impurities at all. An Outer Realm Essence Crystal was thousands of times purer than an Outer Realm Essence Stone of the same size. Of course, Outer Realm Essence Crystals had differences in their purities.
Fang Chang was only a Supremacy after all. He doesn’t have any urgent need for Outer Realm Essence Stones. His 800-plus Outer Realm Essence Stones combined are far less valuable than a single Outer Realm Essence Crystal. As Meng Chuan thought about it, the chaos hole in his dantian constantly devoured the outer realm essence energy. His absorption rate was extremely astonishing.
It’s really easy to break through with Outer Realm Essence Stones. I can freely absorb Outer Realm Essence Stones, but my dantian absorbs the energy too slowly.
The gray stone in front of Meng Chuan became dimmer and dimmer. Finally, it completely shattered. With a thought, another Outer Realm Essence Stone appeared in front of Meng Chuan.
It took him six days to absorb over 1,000 Outer Realm Essence Stones. It was equivalent to half the outer realm essence energy contained within an Outer Realm Essence Crystal.
Just breaking through from the Chaos Hole realm’s early stage to the middle stage consumes an astonishing amount of energy. If I were to absorb the thin outer realm essence energy outside only, it would take me at least ten years to finish my breakthrough. However, it has only been six days. Meng Chuan realized how important Outer Realm Essence Stones were. It’s no wonder Tribulation Eminences have to accumulate Outer Realm Essence Crystals.
As one’s lifeforce grew stronger and more profound, their need for energy increased. For instance, Seventh Tribulation Eminences and Eighth Tribulation Eminences had unimaginable means. They could crush a Grand Yang Star with their hands and walk across time... With such unimaginable power, they naturally required a massive amount of essence energy to make a breakthrough. If they were to absorb the outer realm’s thin essence energy slowly? A Seventh or Eighth Tribulation Eminence wouldn’t even live long enough to finish the breakthrough!
Thus, Outer Realm Essence Stones and Outer Realm Essence Crystals became determining factors for breakthroughs. If one wanted to reach the Tribulation realm, many obstacles would naturally bar their way. One such obstacle was the lack of energy.
Back when I was in my homeworld, my Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique already reached the Grotto-Heaven’s late stage, thought Meng Chuan to himself. My insights into Flash Form of Lightning, Yin-Yang Form of Lightning, and Wave Splitting Forms of Lightning have long been very profound. Just five years after coming to the outer realm, my Infinite Saber has already reached the Grotto-Heaven realm’s middle stage.
After reaching the Chaos Hole realm’s middle stage, my Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence and Chaos Hole domain have become stronger. Meng Chuan was astonished by his newfound strength. Despite just reaching the Chaos Hole realm, he was only slightly inferior to newly-advanced Imperial Lords in every aspect.
After breaking through, Meng Chuan could sense the improvement in his strength. His strength had doubled! When he reached the perfected Chaos Hole realm in the future, he would probably be slightly weaker than a perfected Imperial Lord. He would be able to suppress a late-stage Imperial Lord. I can’t celebrate too early. The demon world is a middle-level world with a much longer history than Archean Eon Realm. It has plenty of experts. In each era, they usually have several Imperial Lords and several Supremacies that have reached the Heaven Earth Realm. If our Archean Eon Realm can produce geniuses, then the demons can also produce geniuses.
Thus, I must get stronger and stronger! I have to cultivate my paramount technique to the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm before I have the confidence to win the war. It was never wrong to overestimate the enemy.
Meng Chuan stood up. When he sensed his newfound strength after breaking through, a smile appeared on his face.
“Qing Gu,” said Meng Chuan.
A figure quickly arrived at the courtyard’s entrance, and respectfully said, “Brother Eastcalm, are you looking for me?” “I’ve been cultivating here for quite some time. It’s time to go to Black Dragon Planet,” said Meng Chuan.
Supremacy Qing Gu’s eyes lit up. He also liked Black Dragon Planet. After all, it was where many cultivators gathered.
Swoosh! Swoosh!
Meng Chuan and Supremacy Qing Gu flew into the sky.
Meng Chuan waved his hand, and the stellar debris immediately shrunk. Originally spanning 500 kilometers, it shrank until it was just a quarter-kilometer in diameter. Following that, Meng Chuan stored it in the spatial pagoda.
“Qing Gu, you travel the River of Spacetime too slow. Stay in my grotto-heaven for now,” said Meng Chuan.
“I’m naturally willing to do so. It will take me 50 years to reach the Black Dragon Planet through the River of Spacetime. It’s too slow,” said Supremacy Qing Gu humbly.
Meng Chuan nodded and stored the other party into his Grotto-Heaven Magic Bead.
Standing in the dark outer realm, Meng Chuan was rather curious. This is my first time traveling the River of Spacetime.
Cultivators took a long time to travel the outer realm, even if they altered the time flowwhich allowed them to travel faster than light speed.
Light took hundreds of thousands of years to traverse Heaven Peak River System. This was only a small river system. Therefore, Meng Chuan had to enter the River of Spacetime so that he could travel to another spacetime zone faster.
Boom!
Meng Chuan rapidly accelerated.
In the dark void, Meng Chuan’s speed increased.
He went from 5,000 km/s, 10,000 km/s, 15,000 km/s... until he could move at 50,000 km/s.
He didn’t alter the time flow at all. This was his actual speed.
After he reached the speed of 50,000 km/s, Meng Chuan transformed into a light beam. Although the outer realm’s resistance was negligible, it still burdened his body slightly. However, any Supremacy could withstand such a burden.
Hum.
While traveling at 50,000 km/s, a strange fluctuation appeared in the originally stable spacetime.
Meng Chuan maintained his steady speed. He gradually fused with the spatial fluctuations and maintained his speed for more than 30 seconds.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan entered the spatial fluctuation and vanished completely.
Whoosh.
The River of Spacetime? Meng Chuan saw an unimaginable river.
This river was boundless—there was no end to it. The reason why it was called a river was common knowledge! Cultivators knew that the River of Spacetime’s true shape was of a mysterious river!
A weak person, like Meng Chuan, was just a tiny shrimp in the river. Meng Chuan could only see what was dozens of feet around him. Due to this, he naturally couldn’t see the river’s true appearance.
The water droplets in this river are like countless stars.Here, one can see countless worlds that hold life. Meng Chuan saw countless stars and worlds in the vast River of Spacetime.
The Grand Yang Star closest to Meng Chuan was the size of a fist from his perspective. The closest inhabited world was the size of a finger.
Further away, it looked like countless points of light had gathered to form a vast river...
According to Archean Mountain’s dossiers, the higher one’s realm is, the deeper one can enter the River of Spacetime. For example, Ancestral Master Archean Eon can go to extremely deep depths in the River of Spacetime. To him, a river system is just like a small river, one he can cross it in a few steps. As for me...
Whoosh.
bulu
Meng Chuan slowly flew through the River of Spacetime like a small fish. He flew very slowly as he glanced at the stars and the inhabited worlds. This was because the River of Spacetime exerted very strong pressure on him.
Considering when I entered the River of Spacetime and my flight speed, it will probably take me about three years to travel across Heaven Peak River System. Ancestral Master Archean Eon can traverse the distance I travel in three years with a few steps. Meng Chuan sighed.
He was still very weak.
I estimate that it will take me half a year to reach Black Dragon Planet.
He was considered to be very fast at traveling the River of Spacetime. As someone who pursued extreme speed, he was considered to be quite fast at traveling the River of Spacetime, even when compared to Imperial Lords.
Days passed.
Meng Chuan flew patiently as he sensed the River of Spacetime’s time and space mysteries.
In the blink of an eye, more than a month had passed since he entered the River of Spacetime. Oh? Meng Chuan looked at the distant River of Spacetime in shock. An extremely massive figure appeared in the distance. He was tall and muscular. His hair was disheveled, and he wore a loose robe. He walked barefoot in the River of Spacetime.
Although they were very far away from one another, his body still seemed unimaginably tall to Meng Chuan. The countless stars and inhabited worlds in the distance were so tiny that he couldn’t even see them.
This massive figure strode across a distance spanning billions of stars with each step. In just ten steps, he vanished from Meng Chuan’s sight.
Meng Chuan stared blankly.
The other party didn’t notice him because he could see hundreds, even thousands, of cultivators in the River of Spacetime with a single glance. Meng Chuan was too tiny in comparison.

chapters.title: Chapter 503 - Entering Black Dragon Planet
chapters.content:
Chapter 503 Entering Black Dragon Planet
The stronger one is, the larger one’s body will appear in the River of Spacetime. Meng Chuan also knew this common knowledge. That was why Ancestral Master Archean Eon could cross a river system in just a few steps. After all, since the Ancestral Master was extremely large, a river system was just a small river to him.
Ancestral Master would be massive in the River of Spacetime. With my current strength, I wouldn’t even be able to see his entire body. I could probably see his foot at most. The Tribulation Eminence I saw just now is probably a Sixth Tribulation Eminence, or maybe he was a Fifth Tribulation Eminence.
Meng Chuan had too little experience when he first came to the outer realm. Although he knew a lot of information, he could only vaguely determine that the Tribulation Eminence he just saw had at least reached the Fifth Tribulation realm!
Anyway, I’m still far from that realm. After recovering from his shock, Meng Chuan continued flying.
The River of Spacetime was vast, but cultivators often roamed it. Even Supremacy Qing Gu knew Heaven Peak River System very well.
Meng Chuan naturally wouldn’t be lost since he had the Spacetime Dominion Map.
Half a year after entering the River of Spacetime.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan—who had been resisting the River of Spacetime’s suppression for a long time-suddenly stopped resisting. Immediately, Meng Chuan was expelled out of the River of Spacetime.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan returned to the outer realm’s ordinary void.
At a glance, he saw many burning Grand Yang Stars in front of him. The 64 Grand Yang Stars were scattered everywhere, protecting the black planet in the middle. The 64 Grand Yang Stars moved very slowly. No matter how they moved, they were like one entity.
I heard that there are still 64 Grand Yin Stars apart from the 64 Grand Yang Stars. However, the Grand Yin Stars are hidden in the dark... I can’t sense them at all. Meng Chuan was astonished by that. He was so astonished that such huge stars—which were part of the array formation-were completely hidden from sight.
Meng Chuan waved his hand and released Supremacy Qing Gu.
“Brother Eastcalm, you are really impressive. You arrived at Black Dragon Planet so quickly.” Supremacy Qing Gu couldn’t help but sigh in amazement when he saw where they were. He truly admired Meng Chuan. Meng Chuan’s traveling speed of the River of Spacetime was comparable to some Imperial Lords.
“Let’s go,” said Meng Chuan.
The two quickly flew towards Black Dragon Planet.
Surrounded by Grand Yang Stars, Black Dragon Planet appeared very small, but in reality, it was a massive planet that was half a million kilometers in diameter.
Meng Chuan and Supremacy Qing Gu transformed into dazzling streams of light. Their true speed was 100,000 kilometers per second. After altering the time flow, they moved no slower than light. They flew for an hour before arriving at Black Dragon Planet.
“Patriarch Black Dragon is Heaven Peak River System’s strongest Tribulation Eminence. He is also the owner of Black Dragon Planet.” Supremacy Qing Gu looked at Black Dragon Planet and sent a voice transmission. “Although it’s very safe on Black Dragon Planet and fighting is forbidden, we can’t show any disrespect to Patriarch Black Dragon. Offending Patriarch Black Dragon means death.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “I understand.” “As long as we don’t offend Patriarch Black Dragon, it’s absolutely safe,” said Supremacy Qing Gu with a smile.
“The safest method is to not mention Patriarch Black Dragon’s name at all after entering Black Dragon Planet,” said Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan was still very respectful towards a
Tribulation Eminence that could forcefully move Grand Yang Stars and Grand Yin Stars to set up an array formation. Not to mention the fact that this Tribulation Eminence was also the river system’s strongest expert.
“Don’t worry.” Supremacy Qing Gu nodded. “I won’t even mention his name.” Swoosh! Swoosh!
Following that, they swooped down.
As they passed through Black Dragon Planet’s outermost array formation, Meng Chuan and Supremacy Qing Gu felt the void change. They arrived at the entrance of an ancient city. Black Dragon City. Meng Chuan stared at the city in front of him.
On Black Dragon Planet, Black Dragon City was the most important transaction ground for Heaven Peak River System’s cultivators.
As for what was outside the city? There were layers upon layers of array formations outside the city, as well as Patriarch Black Dragon’s cultivation grounds. All were forbidden from trespassing
“That’s...” Meng Chuan looked into the distance.
At the end of the black mountain range in the distance, a gigantic head could be seen. Its nostrils flared as its breath swept across 500 kilometers.
“A dragon?” Meng Chuan recognized the lifeform.
The coiled black dragon laid on the ground, appearing like a black mountain range. The so-called mountain range was just a portion of its revealed back.
“This is Patriarch Black Dragon’s dragon follower?” Meng Chuan was somewhat astonished.
“It’s said to be an adult dragon,” said Supremacy Qing Gu in envy. “A perfected Imperial Lord dragon has strength comparable to a Tribulation Eminence.”
However, Meng Chuan knew more than Qing Gu. He thought to himself, Look at how thick and heavy his body is. Look at the spikes on his back. He is a Magma Black Dragon. He isn’t a pure-blood dragon. A Magma Black Dragons’ strength is slightly inferior to an Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake and a Dark Peacock’s. A Magma Black Dragon should be comparable to a Second Tribulation Eminence upon reaching adulthood.
Powerful Tribulation Eminences easily attracted special lifeforms into following them.
Meng Chuan and Supremacy Qing Gu took another glance at the black dragon before walking into the city.
The city gates opened without any obstruction.
The moment they entered, they saw buildings lining both sides of the main street. Some of the buildings were closed, while others were open. The small buildings that were open had puppet servants to receive guests and customers.
“These small buildings can be rented from Black Dragon City for a short period of time,” said Supremacy Qing Gu. “After renting them, you can do business and trade goods... However, those who can rent small buildings are either good at refining artifacts or have special goods. Supremacies typically rent them for short periods of time and personally receive their guests. Those who rent small buildings for extended periods are typically Imperial Lords.”
Meng Chuan took in the sight.
Many buildings—thousands of them-could be seen on the street. There were also all kinds of strange items being sold.
“One has to depend on their acumen if they want to buy goods from these small buildings,” explained Supremacy Qing Gu. “As fighting is forbidden here, one can’t blame others for losing out. However, whenever I come here, I like to shop at these small buildings. Due to the low prices, I might be able to find something suitable for myself.”
Supremacy Qin Gu then pointed at the large buildings in front of them—which clearly occupied a much larger area. They were all huge buildings. “It’s different up ahead. Most of the majestic buildings are backed by Tribulation Eminences. For example, Star Pavilion sells treasures and weapons. They can even custom-make Tribulation treasures. Essence Water Manor mainly sells 39 types of essence water. Black Dragon Palace... I believe you can guess who it belongs to from the name, Brother Eastcalm. A large-scale treasure auction is hosted every year...”
Supremacy Qing Gu happily explained Black Dragon Planet’s many buildings.
Meng Chuan was amazed as he listened. As Heaven Peak River System’s most important trading area, 20-30% of the river system’s cultivators would usually gather here. During special events, many more cultivators would gather here. This planet naturally bustled with life.
“Oh, and the most important thing. Look at that tall building.” Supremacy Qing Gu pointed at a tall building that was faintly discernible through the clouds. “Eternal Tower is said to be the only nine-storied building! It’s 90,000 feet tall! It’s said that there’s nothing you can’t find inside. As long as you can afford it, you can buy anything. Black Dragon Palace is only 10,000 feet tall, but Eternal Tower is 90,000 feet tall.”
Meng Chuan laughed.
As one of the strongest factions in the River of Spacetime, Eternal Tower was definitely confident in its ability to provide anything for sale given the right price.
This Black Dragon Planet is the most suitable place for me now. After obtaining Senior Pang Ming’s treasures, I have to convert the treasures into strength!
“Let’s rent a cave abode,” said Meng Chuan.
“Rent a cave abode?” Supremacy Qing Gu looked at Meng Chuan in surprise. “That’s very expensive.”
As it was absolutely safe in Black Dragon City, the rental prices were very high.
Meng Chuan brought Supremacy Qing Gu to one of Black Dragon City’s top three buildings – Black Dragon Manor.
“Gentlemen, what would you like to buy at Black Dragon Manor?” A female attendant smiled at them. In reality, the female attendant was only a puppet servant. She only had the strength of the weakest Core Cloud Godfiend. However, in Black Dragon City, the puppet servants only had to serve the guests well! After all, cultivators weren’t suitable for serving guests.
“I’m renting a cave abode,” said Meng Chuan. The female attendant nodded slightly and led Meng Chuan to a hall.
Inside the hall, a miniature three-dimensional image of Black Dragon City floated in the air.
