“Only Supremacies are allowed to live in Supremacy-level cave abodes,” said an elder with a smile. “One Supremacy-level cave abode can only hold two followers. Followers are not allowed to exceed the Supremacy-level. Living beings within grotto-heavens are also considered followers.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
As Black Dragon Planet was absolutely safe, this was used as a form of protection. There was naturally a huge difference between protecting a Supremacy and protecting an Imperial Lord or even a Tribulation Eminence. The prices for renting different level cave abodes were naturally different.
“Please take a look.” The elder pointed at the projection of Black Dragon City floating in front of him. “There are still over 500 empty Supremacy-level cave abodes. You can choose any one.”
“What’s the rental price?” asked Meng Chuan.
“The cost of renting a Supremacy-level cave abode is half an Outer Realm Essence Crystal for ten years,” said the elder with a smile. “The minimum rental period is ten years.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “I’ll rent it for ten years then.”

chapters.title: Chapter 504 - Ashen Pagoda
chapters.content:
Chapter 504 Ashen Pagoda
Black Dragon City occupied a vast area. Apart from the transaction grounds, most of the places were cave abodes.
The Supremacy-level cave abode only spanned half a kilometer. To cultivators, it was considered very small. They had to hold back when cultivating in the cave abode. However, it was absolutely safe. This was Patriarch Black Dragon’s guarantee.
“After refining the cave abode talisman token, you will be the owner of this cave abode. The cave abode will be absolutely safe. Furthermore, the array formation is stable. Attacks below the Tribulation realm will not damage the cave abode at all,” said the female attendant with a smile.
Meng Chuan held the talisman token and looked at the cave abode in front of him. This was because the refinement talisman token allowed him to control the cave abode easily.
“Leave,” instructed Meng Chuan as he nodded once.
“Yes.” The female attendant bowed and left the cave abode before closing the door carefully.
Apart from being stable, there’s nothing special about it. They haven’t opened up the space inside. This Black Dragon Planet owner sure is thrifty.
The cave abode was only half a kilometer wide. If he wanted to practice his techniques, he had to be careful not to cross the boundary.
“This is the first time I’m living in a cave abode on Black Dragon Planet.” Supremacy Qing Gu looked around the cave abode excitedly.
“Choose any room in the front yard,” instructed Meng Chuan as he headed towards the inner courtyard.
Suddenly
Knock! Knock! Knock!
Someone knocked on the door. “Oh?” Meng Chuan was surprised.
Supremacy Qing Gu was puzzled. “We just moved in. Why is someone visiting us?”
“Qing Gu, open the door,” instructed Meng Chuan.
“Yes.” Supremacy Qing Gu immediately stepped forward and opened the door.
A handsome young man stood outside the cave abode. Meng Chuan could tell at a glance that he was just a puppet attendant. The puppet attendant’s clothes had the Black Dragon Palace’s symbol, indicating that he represented Black Dragon Palace.
Supremacy Qing Gu was very casual when facing a puppet attendant. “We just came from Black Dragon Palace. Why are you here?” “Supremacies,” said the man with a respectful smile, “Black Dragon Palace has many branches. I’m from Black Dragon Palace’s Treasure Auction branch. According to Black Dragon Palace’s rules, they will send a Treasure Catalog to all Black Dragon City cave abodes owners at the beginning of the year. It’s already the middle of the year. Having learned that you just settled down, we immediately sent over this year’s Treasure Catalog. The Treasure Auction will be held at the end of this year. All treasures recorded in the Treasure Catalog will be publicly auctioned. This will be Black Dragon Planet’s liveliest time of the year. Many cultivators will come from all over.”
Supremacy Qing Gu extended his hand and took the Treasure Catalog.
“I’ll take my leave.” The man smiled and left.
“Brother Eastcalm, Black Dragon Palace takes the initiative to give Black Dragon City cave abode owners a copy of the Treasure Catalog. Ordinary cultivators like me will have to spend Outer Realm Essence Stones just to read it,” said Supremacy Qing Gu as he handed it to Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan reached out to receive it.
Those who could rent cave abodes were not ordinary cultivators. This was because even Heaven Earth realm cultivators had to grit their teeth before they were willing to pay the ten-year rent. They wouldn’t dare to rent the cave abodes for extended periods.
Being a cave abode owner represented one’s wealth.
Treasure Catalog. Meng Chuan flipped through the pages and walked towards the inner courtyard. There was a backyard in the inner courtyard. It was rather elegant.
Meng Chuan sat by the pool and flipped through the Treasure Catalog.
Only Black Dragon Palace has the right to hold the Treasure Auction in Heaven Peak River System. Other factions are forbidden from holding it. Even Eternal Tower will give in. Meng Chuan understood that Patriarch Black Dragon was Heaven Peak River System’s strongest expert. Black Dragon Planet was his. He was the local honcho. Eternal Tower naturally had to give in to him.
Every year, over 100 treasures are sold at the Treasure Auction. They are all good treasures. The starting prices are quite high. Meng Chuan read the introductions to each of the items listed in the Treasure Catalog. The items that could be listed within were all extraordinary. Every single item was expensive and rare. A Life Substitute Talisman didn’t even have the right to be sold at the Treasure Auction.
Altogether, 38 Tribulation treasures, 19 single-used talismans and amulets, 22 precious materials, nine rare flowers and fruits, and 23 rare treasures were being sold this time. Meng Chuan looked at the items’ prices. The lowest starting price was ten cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals. Ordinary Fourth Tribulation treasures were worth this price. Furthermore, this was only the starting price of these treasures.
Meng Chuan flipped through the Treasure Catalog and was astonished.
Undying Talisman: After using it, one will gain an undying body until the talisman’s strength is exhausted (it can be maintained for about two hours). A Seventh Tribulation Eminence can crack this talisman. It cannot be used to transcend Essence Soul Tribulations or Physical Body Tribulations. The starting price is ten cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals.
Meng Chuan shook his head slightly after reading the introduction. It’s useless.One may gain an Undying body for two hours, but the enemy can trap them for that duration. Once the talisman’s strength is exhausted, the enemy will be able to kill the user. It’s much less useful than a Void Transference Talisman. However, it can be used when probing perilous zones. It can also be used for special purposes.
The Undying Talisman was an evolved version of the Life Substitute Talisman. In those two hours, no matter how the enemy attacked, one would be instantly restored to their peak state even if they were reduced to dust instantly. This was a high-level application of the time lineage. It looked useless, but it had surprising effects when used in suitable situations.
Lightning Five-Colored Flower: After consumption, one-who has reached the Heaven Earth Realm with the lightning lineage
—will turn into the lightning beast, Xiao. Their lives will be completely changed. As a Heaven Earth realm cultivator, one’s lightning beast body will mature slowly. As time passes, one’s lightning beast body will eventually have the strength of a perfected Imperial Lord. Starting price: 300 cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals.
The price of this treasure was much higher. This was meant for cultivators who had reached high technique realms, but their Essence Souls were stuck at the sixth level, preventing them from becoming Imperial Lords. After consuming the flower, although they would become a lightning beast, they would become an Imperial Lord-level special lifeform. Their lifespans and strength would increase greatly. However, it cost 300 cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals. This price was enough to make many Imperial Lords’ hearts tremble. Some Imperial Lords couldn’t even afford it.
If Meng Chuan hadn’t obtained the treasures left behind by Senior Pang Ming, he wouldn’t have been able to afford it.
Meng Chuan looked at the treasures that he coveted.
When he flipped to another page, Meng Chuan’s pupils constricted.
Ashen Pagoda: A cultivation cave abode. Time can be accelerated within the cave abode. When ordinary Supremacies cultivate in it, the Ashen Pagoda’s time flow will be sped up by thirty-fold. This can be maintained for long periods of time. When ordinary Imperial Lords cultivate within it, the Ashen Pagoda can maintain a ten-fold acceleration of time.
A Tribulation Eminence can also cultivate in it. The higher one’s Tribulation realm, the lower the Ashen Pagoda’s time acceleration. The Ashen Pagoda can normally maintain a two-fold speed-up on time when Fourth Tribulation Eminences cultivate within it. It’s useless on Fifth Tribulation Eminences. If too many cultivators or powerful special lifeforms are in the Ashen Pagoda, the temporal acceleration’s effects will decrease.
The Ashen Pagoda will be affected by the worldly laws when one is in an inhabited world. This will prevent the Ashen Pagoda’s effects from taking place.
Sixth Tribulation treasure. Starting price: 300 Outer Realm Essence Crystals.
Meng Chuan stared at the page solemnly.
Worldly laws suppressed worlds that supported life. Due to this, the environment was milder and more suitable for weaker organisms to live in.
Many rare treasures could not grow in worlds that support life. Some treasures were unable to be used in them as well. Tribulation Eminences could only break through while cultivating in the outer realm. One could also only cultivate to the Supremacy realm or the Imperial Lord realm in low-level worlds and middle-level worlds respectively. This was the worldly laws’ suppression.
One would not be suppressed by the worldly laws in the outer realm. This allowed one to go far on the cultivation road. All sorts of miracles could be witnessed in the outer realm.
Ashen Pagoda. Meng Chuan’s eyes burned. Meng Chuan knew that top Tribulation Eminences had very refined control over time. The Undying Talisman and Life Substitute Talismans were results of a high-level application of the time lineage. It wasn’t very difficult for top Tribulation Eminences to refine a cave abode that could constantly maintain an accelerated time flow.
Time is very important to me, and especially for Supremacies. I have to grow as soon as possible. Meng Chuan looked at the treasure’s introduction. I have to obtain Ashen Pagoda if possible.
On Black Dragon Planet, a Sixth Tribulation treasure transaction happened in places like Eternal Tower and Black Dragon Palace’s Treasure Auction. After all, it was very common for a Sixth Tribulation treasure transaction to occur in these two places. It was also very safe because they cared about their reputations.
However, Seventh Tribulation treasures were another beast...
Not even a single Seventh Tribulation treasure was listed in the Treasure Catalog!
With Meng Chuan’s current strength, he didn’t dare take out his Seventh Tribulation Treasure on Black Dragon Planet.
The Ashen Pagoda is too expensive. Perhaps I can look again and see if I can find a cheaper temporal cave abode. The Treasure Auction is at the end of the year. There are still five months left. There’s plenty of time.

chapters.title: Chapter 505 - Spending Money
chapters.content:
Chapter 505 Spending Money
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged and flipped through the treasures recorded in the Treasure Catalogue. “Brother Eastcalm, Brother Eastcalm.” A voice came from outside the courtyard. Supremacy Qing Gu stood there, holding some books.
Meng Chuan turned his head and couldn’t help but smile. “Were they sent by Black Dragon City’s various shops. Do they list the treasures available?”
“Every shop will take the initiative to deliver these books to cultivators who rent cave abodes in Black Dragon City,” said Supremacy Qing Gu obsequiously. “They are hoping that you will buy something.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Indeed, I do need to take a look.”
He came to Black Dragon City to buy treasures!
As the most prosperous trading place in the river system, 20-30% of the river system’s cultivators gathered here. Therefore, there were many treasures.
Meng Chuan spent five days window shopping around Black Dragon City, including Eternal Tower!
On the sixth day, he began making large-scale purchases!
Essence Water Manor.
“Every time you consume a drop of Heartcleansing Essence Water, your mind will be cleansed completely. It greatly aids one’s cultivation,” said the attendant with a turtle shell on his back warmly. “Ten bottles only cost one Outer Realm Essence Crystal. Ten bottles of Heartcleansing Essence Water will last you for three years if you consume one drop a day.” “How long do the effects of one drop last?” asked Meng Chuan. “About four hours,” said the turtle-shelled attendant obsequiously.
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. After some hesitation, he rather unwillingly said, “Then I’ll buy... five bottles.”
“Our Essence Water Pavilion has a total of 39 types of Essence Water. They all have their amazing...” The attendant continued.
“There’s no need. I’ll just buy Heartcleansing Essence Water.” Meng Chuan looked like he was frugal.
After a while, Meng Chuan left Essence Water Manor with five bottles of Heartcleansing Essence Water.
To speed up one’s cultivation, one had to enter a special state. For example, a state of epiphany would occur when one’s Essence Soul entered a special state. These special states could be induced by using external objects. Some natural treasures could induce one’s Essence Soul into entering a state of epiphany after consuming it. However, the price of such treasures was astonishing. Heartcleansing Essence Water was one such commonly used treasure. It had a relatively good benefit-cost ratio. It was one of Essence Water Manor’s 39 signature Essence Waters.
Meng Chuan exchanged an Imperial Lord-level treasure for three types of alcohol-nine jars each—that could supplement one’s cultivation from Thousand Drunks Manor. After Fang Chang and his followers died, Meng Chuan obtained some war spoils. Among the treasures left behind by Senior Pang Ming, many materials, treasures, and Imperial Lord-level treasures were nothing worth mentioning. He also had a pile of Outer Realm Essence Stones.
Meng Chuan was currently exchanging the less valuable items for things he needed.
Meng Chuan used Heartcleansing Essence Water, Thousand Drunks Manor’s alcohol, and over 100 Two World Void Fruits to supplement his cultivation. He often consumed them. He had only bought enough to last him for ten years of cultivation.
Next is Eternal Tower. Meng Chuan looked up at the towering Eternal Tower and immediately entered.
He had no choice but to do so. Although the other shops had all sorts of treasures, Eternal Tower was 1,000 times better than all the other shops in Black Dragon City combined when it came to Fifth Tribulation treasures and stronger! This was because Eternal Tower could transfer goods from their branches in other river systems and river zones.
This was the third time Meng Chuan had come to Eternal Tower. He didn’t buy anything the first two times he visited. But this time, he went to Eternal Tower’s fifth floor with great familiarity.
“Greetings, Imperial Lord.” In a hall on Eternal Tower’s fifth floor, a puppet attendant welcomed him warmly.
Meng Chuan no longer disguised his aura with the Mask of Illusion. Instead, he masked his aura with a treasure that Senior Pang Ming had carried with him-Sea Serpent Token. For his cultivation, Senior Pang Ming had provoked strong enemies. Thus, he usually had to hide his identity. Due to the need for anonymity, he tried his best to obtain a Sea Serpent Token. A Sea Serpent Token could only be refined by those of the Sea Serpent race.
With the Sea Serpent Token, Senior Pang Ming could perfectly disguise himself! Even mighty figures below the Seventh Tribulation realm were unable to discern his true identity.
Meng Chuan had now disguised himself as an Imperial Lord. With his technique realm and strength, his Quintessential Essence was close to that of an Imperial Lord. He also had a seventh-level Essence Soul. Furthermore, he had seen dozens of Imperial Lords in Black Dragon City. It was relatively easy for him to disguise himself as an Imperial Lord with the Sea Serpent Token.
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded indifferently. “I want to see all Fifth and Sixth Tribulation treasures of the lightning lineage.”
The puppet attendant smiled and waved his hand. “Please take a look, Imperial Lord.”
Phantoms of weapons and treasures appeared in the hall, floating lazily. When one’s consciousness probed these phantoms, one would obtain the introductions of every weapon and treasure.
“There are a total of over 8,000 Fifth Tribulation treasures and over 1,000 Sixth Tribulation treasures here. They are all of the Lightning lineage. Imperial Lord, feel free to take a look,” said the puppet attendant. “However, these treasures are scattered across the river zone. Imperial Lord, if you wish to buy them, you will need to wait for a while. It will take some time for these treasures to be delivered from other river systems.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
Since Eternal Tower had too many Fifth and Sixth Tribulation treasures, the other factions in Black Dragon City didn’t sell these high-level Tribulation treasures. They only sold cheap items at the Third or Fourth Tribulation realm.
This was why Black Dragon City’s other merchants didn’t sell Sixth Tribulation treasures of the lightning lineage.
“Let me choose.” Meng Chuan looked through the selection of treasures carefully. Eternal Tower indeed had an extraordinary way of doing business. Regardless of the customer’s background, they could view all Sixth Tribulation treasures and weapons. However, Seventh Tribulation treasures weren’t up for display. One had to prove that they could afford it by showing a treasure that was worth 1,000 cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals.
Temporal Cave Abode. Meng Chuan carefully looked for what he wanted. There were over 10,000 Fifth and Sixth Tribulation treasures of the lightning lineage. Of them, there were two cave abodes that could accelerate the time flow.
They were, Myriad Flower Realm: Sixth Tribulation treasure. Many different kinds of rare outer realm flowers are planted within. Many of these rare flowers have miraculous uses. Myriad Flower Realm can also accelerate its time flow, allowing the flowers to bloom faster. It’s also suitable for cultivation. For ordinary Supremacies, it can maintain a twenty-fold faster time flow. For ordinary Imperial Lords, it can maintain an eight-fold faster time flow. For Third Tribulation Eminences, it can maintain a two-fold faster time flow. It’s useless for Fourth Tribulation Eminences. Price: 500 Outer Realm Essence Crystals.
Blackrock Palace: Fifth Tribulation treasure. Suitable for cultivators to cultivate in. For ordinary Supremacies, it can maintain a ten-fold faster time flow. It can maintain a three-fold faster time flow for ordinary Imperial Lords. This treasure is useless for Tribulation Eminences. Price: 80 Outer Realm Essence Crystals.
Eternal Tower only has these two temporal cave abodes available for public sale. Cave abodes that can accelerate the time flow are really rare.
There was a reason why there were so few temporal cave abodes. After all, one had to attain extremely high accomplishments in the time lineage if they wanted to accelerate the time flow. Seventh Tribulation Eminences usually refined temporal cave abodes. In history, even Eighth Tribulation Eminences had refined some of them. Tribulation Eminences typically didn’t accelerate the time flow because they would consume their lifespans faster. Doing such a thing wasn’t beneficial to their cultivation. Furthermore, it was extremely difficult for stronger Tribulation Eminences to affect the time flow in a region that they occupied.
Temporal cave abodes were difficult to refine! They also couldn’t be sold for much! This resulted in very few people willing to refine a temporal cave abode. Typically, only top Eminences would refine one for practice.
For example, the Myriad Flower Realm had clearly been used by a top Tribulation Eminence for growing flowers.
In terms of time flow acceleration, Myriad Flower Realm is inferior to Ashen Pagoda. Furthermore, it’s more expensive than Ashen Pagoda! Ashen Pagoda’s starting price in the Treasure Auction is 300 cubes of Outer Ream Essence Crystals. During the auction, this treasure’s price won’t increase by too much. As for Blackrock Palace, it’s much cheaper than both Ashen Pagoda and Myriad Flower Realm. However, it doesn’t accelerate the time flow very much. It clearly states that there’s only a ten-fold acceleration of the time flow when used by ordinary Supremacies. Am I an ordinary Supremacy? Meng Chuan was mentally prepared for this.
In terms of domain and Quintessential Essence, he was nearly an Imperial Lord. He could already live for 5,000 years! He was also stronger than many special lifeforms. The stronger a special lifeform was, the lesser the effects of temporal acceleration.
Blackrock Palace accelerates the time flow by tenfold for ordinary Supremacies. For me? Its effects might be much lower.
Compared to Eternal Tower’s two temporal cave abodes, Ashen Pagoda was more suitable for him.
“I want this treasure.” Meng Chuan pointed at a floating star phantom.
The puppet attendant who was serving him was alarmed when he heard that. Supremacies and Imperial Lords often came to browse through the treasures, but they seldom bought them.
“Please wait a moment, Imperial Lord,” said the puppet attendant immediately as he left.
Meng Chuan stared at the star projection.
Lightning Dwarf Star: A Fifth Tribulation treasure. It contains the complete laws of paramount speed. When one unleashes its peak strength, it can strike at light speed! It was originally one of the beads of a Sixth Tribulation treasure—the Lightning Star Beads. Price: 90 Outer Realm Essence Crystals.
Meng Chuan’s consciousness permeated the treasure’s phantom and read its more detailed introduction.
The Lightning Dwarf Star was refined from a 4,150-kilometer-long planet and many materials. Since it had been a part of an array formation treasure, it had very few uses by itself. One typically used it for smashing opponents. Thanks to its weight and speed, it was very good to use it to smash others! Also, due to the rarity of the complete laws of paramount speed, this treasure was relatively expensive compared to other Fifth Tribulation treasures. It cost 90 cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals!
Eternal Tower is truly filled with all kinds of wonders. I can actually find a Tribulation treasure that possesses the complete laws of paramount speed. This is the most suitable treasure for me. The profundities contained within it are suitable for improving Infinite Saber. This treasure is also suitable for combat.
The Bloodblade Disc only had runes for defense and escaping. When it came to killing enemies? Meng Chuan relied solely on his insights and the Bloodblades’ sharpness.
As for the Lightning Dwarf Star? He could unleash greater explosive strength when he combined it with his paramount technique, Infinite Saber. Most importantly, he could comprehend the laws of paramount speed by studying it.
“There’s another one.” Meng Chuan’s gaze landed on another chained prison phantom. “Fiend Prison.”
When he first came to Black Dragon Planet, Meng Chuan only wanted to buy two itemsLightning Dwarf Star and Fiend Prison.

chapters.title: Chapter 506 - Patriarch Black Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 506 Patriarch Black Dragon
Lightning Dwarf Star and Fiend Prison were the two treasures that Meng Chuan wanted the most after reading Eternal Tower’s list of Fifth Tribulation treasures.
Fiend Prison. Meng Chuan probed the prison phantom with his consciousness.
Fiend Prison: Fifth Tribulation treasure. The prison itself contains void array formations. Furthermore, the prison is split into nine layers. The lower the layer, the stabler it is. In addition, the prison has many punishment methods. It’s difficult for ordinary Sixth Tribulation Eminences to escape once they are imprisoned. One flaw is that the Fiend Prison can’t attack the outside world. Price: 60 Outer Realm Essence Crystals.
This was a prison! It was used to imprison and torture prisoners. It couldn’t attack the outside world, nor could it protect its owner. Thankfully, its void array formation could completely seal the prison! The price of these array formations was quite high. That was the only reason why the Fiend Prison had reached the price of a normal Fifth Tribulation treasure.
The Lightning Dwarf Star can be used as a weapon. Most importantly, I can use it to comprehend the paramount speed laws.
Creating a paramount technique was very difficult. He could reach the perfected realm if he followed a Supremacy-level paramount technique’s prescribed order. However, what about an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique? It was much more difficult to create an Imperial-Lord paramount technique than a Supremacy-level one. Therefore, the Seventh Tribulation Dark Peacock’s flesh, Lightning Dwarf Star, and Tribulation-level ultimate technique-Three World Saber-were all supplementary to his cultivation.
Even with these supplements, it would still be extremely difficult for him to create an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique.
Even with Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s status, he didn’t manage to collect an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique of the lightning lineage. The few lightning lineage techniques he had collected were slightly inferior to paramount techniques. They were flawed. This showed how rare they were.
Fiend Prison’s array formation is the most perfected one of the Fifth Tribulation treasures. Once a Sixth Tribulation Eminence is trapped, it will be difficult for them to escape. Meng Chuan was very astonished because Sixth Tribulation Eminences were truly terrifying. Fiend Prison’s ninth layer could trap a Sixth Tribulation Eminence. This meant the spatial array formation was extremely close to perfection.
By studying the entire Fiend Prison, I can comprehend the spatial laws better.
The Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique followed the spatial lineage. His two self-created techniques were extremely profound. One was a paramount technique that pursued extreme speed. This technique also contained the time lineage’s profundities. This was because the faster one was, the easier it became for them to control the flow of time. Thus, paramount speed was one of the time lineage’s basics.
The Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique completely focused on the void. When executing this technique, his body would act like a brush, while the void would become his canvas. His body would paint a picture in the void...
Combining time and space was the ultimate goal of Tribulation Eminences.
“Imperial Lord.” The door to the hall opened, and a black-robed, silver-haired man walked in. His skin was fair, and on his glabella was a vertical eye pattern with silver runes. He smiled radiantly. “You wish to buy Lightning Dwarf Star-a Fifth Tribulation treasure?”
“Lightning Dwarf Star and Fiend Prison,” said Meng Chuan.
“You want to buy Fiend Prison too?” The black-robed, silver-haired man was somewhat surprised. Meng Chuan nodded. “Yes.”
The black-robed, silver-haired man glanced at Meng Chuan in surprise. The white-haired man in front of him was only an Imperial Lord. He was actually buying two Fifth Tribulation treasures at once?
Many places like Eternal Tower respected their guests. They wouldn’t offend guests by forcefully probing their guests’ strength! Meng Chuan had masked his aura as an Imperial Lord’s with the Sea Serpent Token, so the black-robed, silver-haired man believed him.
“What a coincidence. The Fiend Prison is here,” said the black-robed, silver-haired man. “However, the Lightning Dwarf Star is currently located very far away from Black Dragon Planet. If you want to obtain it today, you need to pay an additional 100 Outer Realm Essence Crystals. Otherwise, you will need to wait three months. A Tribulation Eminence that happens to be on the way will deliver it to you.”
Meng Chuan was astonished. “An additional 100 Outer Realm Essence Crystals?”
The Lightning Dwarf Star only cost 90 Outer Realm Essence Crystals.
An additional 100 cubes just for it to be delivered by today?
“No, there’s no need. I’ll wait three months,” said Meng Chuan.
The black-robed, silver-haired man smiled and said, “You can take Fiend Prison away immediately once you pay for it now. For the Lightning Dwarf Star... you need to pay ten cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals as a deposit. This way, our Eternal Tower can hire Tribulation Eminences to deliver it when they pass by.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Alright.”
One had to pay a price if they wanted a Tribulation Eminence to deliver items as they passed by.
Without a deposit, what happened if the customer disappeared before the item was delivered? They could die because of an accident. Wouldn’t Eternal Tower suffer a loss then? Thus, a deposit was necessary! No matter what happened in the future, Eternal Tower would definitely not lose out.
Meng Chuan knew Eternal Tower’s credibility very well, so he naturally paid the deposit without hesitation.
“Fiend Prison costs 60 Outer Realm Essence Crystals. In addition to the deposit for Lightning Dwarf Star, that will be a total of 70 cubes,” said the black-robed, silver-haired man with a smile.
“I don’t have that many Outer Realm Essence Crystals,” said Meng Chuan in shame. “Can I use treasures in place of Outer Realm Essence Crystals?”
“Yes.” The black-robed, silver-haired man smiled and said, “Tribulation treasures, precious materials, and so on can be used as long as they are of sufficient value. Our Eternal Tower will give you a fair price for them.”
Meng Chuan flipped his hand, and a folded purple robe appeared in front of him.
“Take a look at this set of robes,” said Meng Chuan. This was Fang Chang’s most precious protective Tribulation treasure! No matter how Meng Chuan had attacked, he couldn’t injure Fang Chang at all. He had to rely on his seventh-level Essence Soul’s Magic Awl to kill Fang Chang. “Alright.” The black-robed, silver-haired man received the purple robe. A blurry light descended from the hall’s ceiling and enveloped the purple robe. A huge eye appeared in the blurry light.
The huge eye stared at the purple robe for a few seconds before a voice echoed in the hall. “Fifth Tribulation realm, Water lineage, defensive treasure. It can be considered 80 Outer Realm Essence Crystals.”
Meng Chuan was secretly delighted when he heard that.
This price offered by Eternal Tower was different from their actual sale price. If they offered 80 Outer Realm Essence Crystals, that meant they could sell it for 90 cubes or even 100 cubes!
A protective treasure is indeed worth more. Protective Tribulation treasures are typically twice as expensive as offensive ones! “It is worth 80 Outer Realm Essence Crystals.” The black-robed, silver-haired man looked at Meng Chuan and smiled. “Are you willing to sell it to our Eternal Tower?”
“Sure.” Meng Chuan didn’t hesitate at all. It was safest to get rid of it here. Blood Yang Realm’s two Imperial Lords didn’t have any right to investigate Eternal Tower.
Moments later
“This is Fiend Prison. This is Lightning Dwarf Star’s deposit proof.” The black-robed, silver-haired man held a palm-sized black prison in his hand, as well as a token that glowed with starlight.
Meng Chuan reached out to receive both items.
“Here are 10 Outer Realm Essence Crystals.” The black-robed, silver-haired man waved his hand, and 10 Outer Realm Essence Crystals appeared in midair. “Please keep that token safe. Once the Lightning Dwarf Star arrives on Black Dragon Planet, the token in your hand will sense it. You can come to Eternal Tower and pay the rest of what you owe. After that, you’ll be allowed to take away the Lightning Dwarf Star. If you don’t collect it in half a year, it will be equivalent to you giving up on the Lightning Dwarf Star. If this happens, we won’t return your deposit of 10 Outer Realm Essence Crystals.”
“Understood.” Meng Chuan smiled and nodded before leaving happily.
The black-robed, silver-haired man politely sent Meng Chuan off.
In Eternal Tower, it was very common for Fifth Tribulation treasures to be sold! This was because the weakest Tribulation treasures sold here were at the Third or Fourth Tribulation realm!
Imperial Lords at the perfected Heaven Earth realm could reach the Tribulation realm once their bodies were perfected. Therefore, First and Second Tribulation Eminences typically remained at the perfected Heaven Earth realm. Apart from the change in lifeforce, a First or Second Tribulation Eminence’s technique realm was not much superior to a perfected Imperial Lord.
Over time, many middle-level worlds accumulated a rich heritage. They would use many treasures to protect Supremacies that had reached the Heaven Earth realm and Imperial Lords, making Fifth Tribulation treasures disposable assets.
Sixth Tribulation treasures? They were rarer.
Archean Eon Realm was a rather special middle-level world. Although it was a very young world, it had given birth to a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Therefore, Meng Chuan had managed to obtain a Sixth Tribulation treasure, Bloodblade Disc.
At Eternal Tower, a Fifth Tribulation treasure transaction isn’t a problem. Even buying or selling one to two Sixth Tribulation Treasures isn’t a big deal. However, a Seventh Tribulation treasure can’t be casually taken out on Black Dragon Planet. Perhaps Patriarch Black Dragon will be greedy once he learns of it.
Meng Chuan knew very well that the outer realm was a place where the strong preyed on the weak.
Why was Black Dragon Planet a place of prosperous trade? It was only because Patriarch Black Dragon had set rules and maintained them.
Black Dragon Planet, at a 1500-kilometer-tall mountain peak outside Black Dragon City.
There were many luxurious buildings on the mountain peak. Within the mountain peak, an array formation absorbed and refined outer realm essence energy, transforming it into the mild, gentle Heaven and Earth powers. This was why a group of weaker cultivators lived within the mountain.
“Patriarch’s methods are truly impressive. This array formation refines outer realm essence energy and transforms it into Heaven and Earth powers. The Heaven and Earth Powers then nurtures mortals,” said a lanky man with a smile.
“The converted Heaven and Earth powers ultimately have flaws. Only qualified cultivators can survive here. A true mortal can’t survive. I also like the rowdiness, so I got these juniors to accompany me,” said a black-haired elder with a chuckle.
The lanky man’s head was covered in black scales; he also had a curved horn on his forehead. He smiled and said, “Patriarch, I won’t beat around the bush. I came here for one reason. I fancy Black Dragon Planet and Heaven Peak River System.”
“You wish to occupy my Heaven Peak River System and my Black Dragon Planet?” The black-haired elder looked at him.
“Hahaha... Patriarch, you have cultivated for 50,000 years. You are nearing the end of your lifespan,” said the lanky man with a smile. “Why don’t you retire early? I naturally won’t let you suffer any losses.”
Patriarch Black Dragon continued staring at the lanky man. “Nearing the end of my lifespan? Perhaps I have been deliberately stalling for time, waiting until I’m close to the end of my lifespan before choosing to transform my body... by undergoing the sixth Physical Tribulation.”
The lanky man’s expression changed slightly.
aco
Although Tribulation Eminences couldn’t accurately control when their Heavenly Tribulations descended, they still had ways of delaying them.
For example, if a Physical Tribulation Eminence’s body didn’t improve at all, the next Heavenly Tribulation would never descend! This was how Ancestral Master Archean Eon, a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, died of old age. His body hadn’t reached the stage where the eighth Physical Tribulation would be forced to descend upon him.
The lanky man sneered. “It’s normal to stall a tribulation for 10,000 years, but to wait until you are close to the end of your life?”
“Scram.” Patriarch Black Dragon’s expression turned cold. “Unless I die or leave of my own accord, you can forget about interfering with Heaven Peak River System.”
“Hmph.” The lanky man sneered. “Very well. Let’s see how much longer you can live.”
Boom!
Patriarch Black Dragon’s head suddenly transformed into a gigantic beast’s head. He opened his mouth, and the surrounding 5,000 kilometers turned pitch-black. Upon closing his mouth, everything returned to normal. Patriarch Black Dragon had already devoured the lanky man.
“I’ll eat your avatar first. If you have the guts, come to me with your true body.” Patriarch Black Dragon’s eyes were cold.

chapters.title: Chapter 507 - Master of the Fiend Prison
chapters.content:
Chapter 507 Master of the Fiend Prison
Black Dragon Planet. I’ve finally obtained a treasure that suits me better. In the front yard, Supremacy Qing Gu leisurely held a long, cyan staff and happily studied the Imperial Lord-level treasure. It’s good that I can live on Black Dragon Planet. I can check out the available treasures every day.
Black Dragon City would expel cultivators every month. Other than those who had accommodation in Black Dragon City, all other cultivators had to leave Black Dragon Planet!
This was to prevent cultivators from living in inconspicuous places like Black Dragon City’s streets and alleys. After all, it was a trivial matter for cultivators to live without sleep or rest. It was very easy for them to sit in the lotus position for a few years.
If they didn’t pay any price and wanted to continue being protected in Black Dragon City, Patriarch Black Dragon wouldn’t agree! Therefore, cultivators were expelled from the planet once a month. Furthermore, Patriarch Black Dragon had to expel them from Black Dragon Planet’s array formation.
Very few Supremacies like Supremacy Qing Gu could live on Black Dragon Planet long-term.
It’s been almost five months since I came to Black Dragon Planet. I managed to earn some Essence Stones with my acumen. Supremacy Qing Gu was rather happy. He wouldn’t lose much if he bought items at a low price. He could occasionally make some profit. With time, my acumen will become more and more accurate. Supremacy Qing Gu enjoyed his carefree days of picking treasures.
In one of the inner courtyard’s chambers.
Nobody was in the chamber. Only a 30-foot-tall prison stood in the middle of the chamber. Chains sealed the chamber from outsiders. Countless runes covered the chains. It was clear that this prison contained a powerful array formation. This was the Fiend Prison.
Inside the prison.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in the dark space at the prison’s bottom.
Third array formation, suppress. With a thought, a large number of runes appeared on the dark spatial membrane. Through the spatial membrane, one could vaguely see the huge chains’ illusory figures.
Meng Chuan observed the operating array formation.
The prison’s array formation was too complicated. To imprison a Sixth Tribulation Eminence, it came with a spatial array formation. Meng Chuan’s realm was too low, so he couldn’t unleash the Fiend Prison’s full strength. All he could do was activate the array formation and try to comprehend it.
The strength of a treasure depended on who used it! If a Fifth Tribulation Eminence—who was skilled in spatial laws—had this prison, he would be able to suppress a Sixth Tribulation Eminence!
Of course, the premise was that the Sixth Tribulation Eminence had to enter the prison’s bottommost layer first. If they weren’t defeated and imprisoned within, a Sixth Tribulation Eminence would easily be able to realize what the Fiend Prison did. Thus, they wouldn’t foolishly enter. Therefore, this was only a prison, making it seem useless.
The ninth array formation. Illusion.
Fog immediately filled the dark space, making it very difficult for Meng Chuan to see anything clearly. Meng Chuan could sense the void beginning to descend into chaos. No matter how he flew, he would never reach the end of the prison!
Meng Chuan was the master of the prison’s space when he was inside it!.
Slashing through space?
Crack!
Lightning Whips—which could slice through space-would strike down with terrifying might. These were used to whip prisoners. Teleporting through the void? One would instantly be teleported to the prison’s various layers. This teleportation was several times more exquisite than Fang Chan’s teleportation
—which could only go up to 1,500 kilometers each time. Through the prison, Meng Chuan had now experienced this level of void transference.
Lost in the void? Prisoners inside the prison would forever remain lost, no matter how they ran. This even happened to weaker Tribulation Eminences!
Selfless! Meng Chuan instantly arrived at Fiend Prison’s bottommost layer. However, at that moment, Meng Chuan felt like he was at every spot between the first and ninth layers concurrently.
I’m the master of this space. I’m everywhere. Everything here is under my watch, but the prisoners won’t be able to discover me at all. Meng Chuan enjoyed this wonderful feeling. This was something only he could experience as the Fiend Prison’s master. He only had such means when he was inside the Fiend Prison.
He was everywhere! Those imprisoned here could not see or sense him.
Buying Fiend Prison was worth it. Meng Chuan was very satisfied with his purchase. The Fiend Prison didn’t contain a complete spatial law; instead, the array formations focused on different aspects. Due to this, they ended up being suitable for Meng Chuan to study.
These array formations were different from paramount speed laws. The complete spatial laws were too vast! It was better for him to dissect the spatial laws into several portions and ponder on them.
Buzz.
Meng Chuan felt his Essence Soul’s thinking speed slow down. It was as though dust had fogged up his mind.
The wine’s effects have faded. Meng Chuan realized what had happened. Before he cultivated, he usually drank a flash of Thousand Drunks Manor’s wine. The wine greatly benefited his cultivation-it was like divine help. Depending on the brew type, each flask of Thousand Drunk Manor’s wine had an effective period of six to ten hours.
Nearly five months after arriving at Black Dragon Planet.
With Fiend Prison and Thousand Drunks Manor’s wine aiding him, Meng Chuan finally pushed his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique to the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm.
In fact, his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique had long reached the Grotto Heaven realm’s late stage before he had created his paramount technique! After years of cultivation, along with Black Dragon Planet’s cultivation environment, he had finally reached the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm.
The Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique has reached the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm. How should I push it to the Heaven Earth realm? Meng Chuan pondered on his next steps.
From the Grotto-Heaven realm’s early stage to the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm, he had to go through the grind of accumulating insight. However, breaking through to the Heaven Earth realm was even more difficult than going from the early stage to perfection. This was one of the main reasons why there were so many Supremacies and so few Imperial Lords.
There were two thresholds for becoming an Imperial Lord. One required a seventh-level Essence Soul; they also had to reach the Heaven Earth realm!
Of course, for Supremacies from low-level worlds, their cultivation systems’ flaws were a huge obstacle.
Time to cultivate Infinite Saber. Meng Chuan flipped his hand and took out a black bottle of Heartcleansing Essence Water. He pulled off the bottle stopper and immediately sucked a drop of Heartcleansing Essence Water into his mouth.
After several months of experimentation, he realized that Thousand Drunks Manor’s wine was better suited for his cultivation of the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique! This was because Thousand Drunks Manor’s wine stimulated Meng Chuan’s emotions! It was a great boon to his movement technique.
Heartcleansing Essence Water was more suitable for consumption when cultivating his Infinite Saber Art. After consuming a drop of Heartcleansing Essence Water, Meng Chuan’s heart became as still as water.
Meng Chuan continued cultivating in the Fiend Prison. The space here was large enough, which meant he could attack freely! With the Fiend Prison’s toughness, he couldn’t damage it at all.
Lightning Dwarf Star. Meng Chuan flipped his hand and took out the Lightning Dwarf Star.
The Lightning Dwarf Star was like a glass bead. In fact, it was refined from a star. Utilizing the Lightning Dwarf Star’s full strength could enable it to travel at light speed, making its power unimaginable. Even Imperial Lords would be instantly pulverized when struck by it. It had originally been a part of a Sixth Tribulation treasure! When used alone, it was considered a top-grade Fifth Tribulation Treasure!
Of course, Meng Chuan’s Infinite Saber was only at the Grotto-Heaven realm’s middle stage. In his hands, he could only unleash a small portion of the treasure’s might. However, it had become Meng Chuan’s strongest attack at present.
Paramount speed laws. Meng Chuan felt the Lightning Dwarf Star in his hand and casually threw it.
Boom!
The Lightning Dwarf Star expanded to ten feet in size. Lightning bolts circled its body, and its speed instantly soared. The time flow around it distorted as it tore through the void and flew into the distance like a dazzling meteor.
Bam!
It finally smashed into the Fiend Prison’s walls. However, the Fiend Prison didn’t budge at all. This tiny bit of power wasn’t worth mentioning.
Meng Chuan immersed himself in his cultivation as his strength slowly increased.“Brother Eastcalm, there are still eight more days before the Treasure Auction begins. Black Dragon City is becoming livelier.” Meng Chuan led Supremacy Qing Gu as they walked through Black Dragon City. Supremacy Qing Gu said excitedly, “Many cultivators have rushed to Black Dragon City. Many cultivators are also renting small buildings on the streets.” Meng Chuan nodded slightly. Half a month before the Treasure Auction began, Black Dragon City reached its most bustling state. This lasted until the auction had ended for half a month. During this time, more cultivators would gather in Black Dragon City than usual.
Not just Heaven Peak River System’s cultivators are here. Meng Chuan looked around and thought to himself, Perhaps other river systems’ cultivators have rushed over. After all, not every river system has a bustling trading ground.
Meng Chuan knew very well that a river system’s style was decided by the river system’s strongest Tribulation Eminence.
Patriarch Black Dragon was Heaven Peak River System’s strongest expert. He was also a member of Eternal Tower. Therefore, he placed greater importance on fair trades. This made trading with weak cultivators relatively fair.
This was also why Ancestral Master Archean Eon had joined the Eternal Tower.
“Brother Eastcalm, with so many cultivators rushing over, we have to take a look. We might even scoop up some treasures,” said Supremacy Qing Gu excitedly.
“It depends on luck.” Meng Chuan had been arduously cultivating for the past five months. He was prepared to relax and search for treasures before the Treasure Auction began.
Meng Chuan was unlike Supremacy Qing Gu. Supremacy Qing Gu would only select from cheap goods. However, Meng Chuan had enough wealth to consider any treasure that caught his fancy.

chapters.title: Chapter 508 - Talisman Amulet
chapters.content:
Chapter 508 Talisman Amulet
Meng Chuan and Supremacy Qing Gu moved separately. After all, their goals were different. Talisman Amulet Gate. Meng Chuan first headed to Black Dragon City’s top ten merchants. These merchants had Tribulation Eminences backing them! Some of them were even backed by other river systems’ Tribulation Eminences.
Meng Chuan first went to Talisman Amulet Gate. Black Dragon City’s Talisman Amulet Gate specialized in selling talismans. They sold many single-use talismans.
“Welcome, Imperial Lord.” The female attendant welcomed him warmly.
Meng Chuan continued to use the Sea Serpent Token to disguise his aura as an Imperial Lord’s. He could save himself plenty of trouble by doing so.
“Imperial Lord, the Treasure Auction is approaching. Our Talisman Amulet Gate has also pushed out some more precious talismans. You can take a look,” said the female attendant.
“Oh, which talismans do you have?” asked Meng Chuan.
“Void Shattering Talisman, Life Substitute Talisman, Avatar Talisman, Void Escape Talisman...” the female attendant listed 15 different talismans in a row before she whispered, “Furthermore, we also have Lesser Void Transference Talismans. However, we only have ten of them. We’ve already sold six of them.”
Meng Chuan’s pupils constricted. “Lesser Void Transference Talismans?”
Many things couldn’t be bought on Black Dragon Planet, even in Eternal Tower. For example, he couldn’t find a single Cosmos Crystal. It was as though all the Cosmos Crystals in the outer realm had been completely plundered clean. Not a single one was available for sale.
He also couldn’t buy Void Transference Talismans from Eternal Tower! At the very least, Meng Chuan couldn’t buy them with his Imperial Lord status. Although a single-use Void Transference Talisman had a similar price to a Sixth Tribulation Treasure, Tribulation Eminences only needed a few Tribulation treasures! Therefore, it was very difficult to find a suitable owner for the Tribulation treasures left behind in history.
Void Transference Talismans were different! Everyone could use them. No matter how strict the worldly laws were in worlds that supported life, the outer realm, or forbidden zones, they could still be forcefully used.
Be it the weak, Fifth Tribulation Eminences, or even Sixth Tribulation Eminences, they could survive by using a Void Transference Talisman.
Most importantly, it was a single-use item! Once a Void Transference Talisman was used up, it would be gone. Furthermore, it was difficult to create one. Due to this, the outer realm’s supply of Void Transference Talismans simply couldn’t keep up with the demand.
Worlds like Archean Eon Realm and the Demon Realm had very few Void Transference Talismans, even though they had rather deep heritages. The human world had quite a few in the past, but they had been used over the generations. The last one had been used not long ago. Emperor Roc and the other two Imperial Lords had combined their contributions to exchange for one Void Transference Talisman from the Demon Ancestral Cave. It had been their trump card. They hoped that their fifth Firmament demon monarch army could successfully enter the human world, allowing them to obtain Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures! Even if they only obtained a tiny portion of Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures, they would still make a killing. Back then, they were very close to success! The fifth Firmament demon monarchs had used the Void Transference Talisman to rendezvous with Demon Sage Deep Profundity immediately.
Meng Chuan and company had found it difficult to kill Demon Sage Deep Profundity. They watched as Demon Sage Deep Profundity drew the map of connection points. They watched as the demons’ chances of successfully leading an army into the human world rose.
If this had happened, the human world would have faced a calamity. If this had happened, humans either had to lower their heads obediently and hand over many benefits, or they would risk their lives to annihilate the world.
Thankfully, King True Martial had cursed Demon Sage Deep Profundity to death by using the Fate Strawman and consuming his lifespan completely, thereby destroying the demons’ plan. Later on, it became impossible for the fifth Firmament demon monarch army to threaten humanity after Meng Chuan created his paramount technique.
Although a Lesser Void Transference Talisman is much weaker than a Void Transference Talisman, I’ll be able to flee once I use it, unless a Tribulation Eminence prevents me from escaping... Even Supremacies and Imperial Lords can survive a dangerous situation if they use a Lesser Void Transference Talisman.
The laws of a world that supported life were strict. The worldly laws’ suppression was extremely terrifying. It prevented one from using a Lesser Void Transference Talisman.
The Ashen Palace could suppress the Lesser Void Transference Talisman’s effects. It could greatly change time and space, preventing one from successfully using the talisman. In the outer realm—where there was no suppression
—these talismans would be of great use. “What’s the price?” asked Meng Chuan. “It can’t be higher than Eternal Tower’s price, right?”
Eternal Tower always had Lesser Void Transference Talismans on sale.
“A Lesser Void Transfer Talisman costs 39 Outer Realm Essence Crystals,” said the female attendant via voice transmission.
“Thirty-nine cubes?” Meng Chuan hesitated. “Let me think about it.”
The demand for Void Transference Talismans outstripped the supply. Lesser Void Transference Talismans were also in high demand! Some of the more wealthy Imperial Lords could afford by gritting their teeth.
Moments later
In one of Talisman Amulet Gate’s halls.
“I want one Lesser Void Transference Talisman, two Life Substitute Talismans, and two Void Escape Talismans,” said Meng Chuan.
The gray-robed Supremacy in charge of receiving him let out a radiant smile immediately. “Imperial Lord, you acted early. I’m afraid the Lesser Void Transference Talismans would’ve been sold out in a few days. Other than these three talismans, do you need anything else?” “That’s all,” said Meng Chuan.
“The Lesser Void Transference Talisman costs 39 cubes. The two Life Substitute Talismans cost six cubes in total. The two Void Escape Talismans also cost six cubes in total. A total of 51 Outer Realm Essence Crystals,” said the gray-robed Supremacy.
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. With a wave of his hand, 51 identical Outer Realm Essence Crystals floated to the side.
In preparation for the Treasure Auction, Meng Chuan had sold some materials and treasures to Eternal Tower ahead of time. After selling some of the treasures left behind by Senior Pang Ming, he had obtained 135 Outer Realm Essence Crystals.
Meng Chuan was also very cautious when selling these treasures. He was afraid that someone would discover that the treasures had something to do with Senior Pang Ming’s cave abode if he sold them elsewhere.
Selling them to Eternal Tower was much safer. Furthermore, it was easier for him to keep his identity a secret with the Sea Serpent Token.
I’ve spent so much on just three types of talismans. It’s almost as much as a cheap Fifth Tribulation treasure. Meng Chuan quickly obtained the three types of talismans he wanted.
He had bought two Life Substitute Talismans, two Void Escape Talismans, and one Lesser Void Transference Talisman.
The Void Escape Talisman was used for escaping. Most of the time, one could use it to escape. There was no need to use the Lesser Void Transference Talisman unless it was a truly dire situation.
I can study the Void Escape Talismans and the Lesser Void Transference Talisman. By doing this, I can also comprehend the void lineage’s profundities contained within. I can also comprehend some of the time lineage’s profundities by studying the Life Substitute Talismans.
Although the Life Substitute Talisman had some flaws, it was worth buying it. After all, by using it, one would instantly recover to peak state after receiving a fatal attack.
Meng Chuan visited the largest merchants first. When many experts gathered in Black Dragon City, he took the opportunity to buy a large number of treasures. He spent a total of 123 Outer Realm Essence Crystals. He bought bits and bobs from various shops. His biggest expenditure had been at Talisman Amulet Gate. It was normal.
After visiting the large merchants, Meng Chuan went shopping at the small streetside buildings.
Most of these small streetside buildings were rented by Imperial Lords. Some Supremacies jointly rented them for a short period of time, taking the opportunity to sell their spoils.
“This is what we obtained from an expedition into an ancient cave abode. They are all good treasures.” In a small streetside building, five Supremacies personally received guests. None of them hired puppet attendants. Meng Chuan walked in.
From the side, he looked at the treasures placed inside the array formation. Some of them were even damaged. The damaged items felt like they had been passed down over a long period of time. Without good maintenance, the treasures had gradually been damaged. They really were like spoils discovered in an ancient cave abode. However, Meng Chuan knew very well that no matter how nice it sounded, they were not to be taken seriously!
“Imperial Lord.” A red-robed Supremacy immediately welcomed Meng Chuan warmly when he saw him. Among the eight guests in the building, only Meng Chuan was an Imperial Lord, though it was just a disguise
“You have cultivation manuals here?” Meng Chuan glanced at the manuals. They were in the form of jade and blood cauldrons. In short, they were all legacy manuals.
“These are all Imperial Lord-level manuals,” said the red-robed Supremacy warmly. “It’s a harvest that my friends and I have collected over the years. Some of them were from our homeworld! There are a total of 19 manuals. One only requires one Essence Crystal to learn all of them.”
Meng Chuan laughed when he heard that.
Learning?
An Imperial Lord-level legacy was like the human’s Black Metal Sutra legacies. As long as one maintained them well, one could keep learning from them. Even if others learned from the manuals, they would still belong to the Supremacies ultimately. The Supremacies would only be profiting from such an endeavor.
“Imperial Lord-level manuals, but I don’t know what aspects they cover,” said Meng Chuan casually. “It’s already good enough to have one or two that are suitable for me. One Essence Crystal?”
“We have detailed introductions for each of these manuals. Imperial Lord, you can take a look first before deciding if you want to learn them or not. Perhaps it will be of great help to your cultivation,” said the red-robed Supremacy warmly. They were very willing to do such a business. After all, they didn’t have to give up the manuals.
Meng Chuan came from Archean Eon Realm, which had a deep heritage. He had originally planned on rejecting the offer. However, when his gaze swept across the 19 manuals, he saw one that looked like a painting catalogue. His heart couldn’t help but stir as he casually said, “Bring them over for me to take a look. What manuals are there?”.

chapters.title: Chapter 509 - Selfless Formless Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 509 Selfless Formless Sword
“Imperial Lord, please take a look.” The red-robed Supremacy flipped his hand and produced a book. He handed it to Meng Chuan respectfully.
Meng Chuan flipped open the book.
The book described the 19 Imperial Lord-level techniques in detail. Meng Chuan glanced at them briefly before focusing on the painting catalogue manual’s description.
The Selfless Formless Sword’s creator, Huang Yong, was an Essence Soul Third Tribulation Eminence. He was a mortal master artist who eventually became a cultivator. He used his sword as a brush and created a perfected Imperial Lord-level technique-Selfless Formless Sword.
This sword art was famous for its many variations. It had a total of 33,000 moves. Once it was used, he could be seen everywhere within 15,000 kilometers. It was as though he was in every spot within 15,000 kilometers simultaneously. Simultaneously, he could use the 33,000 sword moves to create a painting. The technique’s might was unimaginable. However, it was extremely difficult to learn it because there were many sword moves-each of them was extremely profound.
Though this was the case, one could ignore all the manual’s sword moves and directly study the five paintings in the manual. If one could comprehend the five paintings, they could also cultivate the sword art to perfection, allowing them to reach the perfected Heaven Earth realm.
Meng Chuan glanced at the sword art’s moves. Meng Chuan was looking forward to seeing what a perfected sword technique had to offer. “That sword art technique is actually a painting?” Meng Chuan pointed at the old book.
The red-robed Supremacy smiled and said, “Imperial Lord, to be honest, instead of calling this Selfless Formless Sword a sword art, it’s actually more like a brush technique! The brush technique is unpredictable, and it’s extremely difficult to master it. However, if one can directly comprehend its essence from the paintings, one’s cultivation will advance by leaps and bounds.”
“It’s well painted.” Meng Chuan stared at the old painting catalogue. The surface depicted the first painting. The array formation stopped one from probing it with the consciousness, but he could see it with his naked eye.
Meng Chuan examined the first painting...
Meng Chuan could see through the bones, intent, and soul of the painting at a glance. Each brushstroke looked like they were two different strokes, but in reality, the painter had just varied their brush speed-fast and slow.
The brushstrokes’ speed, heaviness, fluidity, realism, and variability... With a single glance, Meng Chuan split the first painting into thousands of brushstrokes in his heart.
Meng Chuan seemed to see Senior Huang Yong personally painting it live. The first painting was only at the Dharma Domain realm, so Meng Chuan completely comprehended the first painting with just a glance. This Selfless Formless Sword is not from the lightning lineage, but it’s not from the water or fire lineage either. Instead, it’s a brush technique that only uses void laws. Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
Huang Yong had used his brush technique to enter the Dao before focusing on the void lineage. Meng Chuan looked relaxed.
“The painting is pretty good. I’ll buy this manual.” Meng Chuan looked at the red-robed Supremacy. “Name your price.”
“Buy?” The red-robed Supremacy was taken aback.
One just needed to learn a legacy once, yet he wanted to buy it?
“Sister Li, this Imperial Lord wants to buy Selfless Formless Sword’s original copy. He wants to make a bid. This is yours. Hurry up and make a decision.” The red-robed Supremacy secretly sent a voice transmission. The other four Supremacies beside him also noticed this.
“Just learning the legacy once would do. Why does he want to buy the original copy? Wouldn’t that cost more Essence Crystals?”
“It’s a good thing to earn more Essence Crystals. Sister Li, your homeworld should have more than one copy of the Selfless Formless Sword manual, right?”
“That is the only copy,” said the female Supremacy via voice transmission. “Senior Huang Yong isn’t a cultivator from my homeworld. This was originally bought in the outer realm and taken back to my homeworld. It’s said that one can comprehend the technique’s essence by studying the paintings. However, nobody in my homeworld has mastered Selfless Formless Sword, even after millions of years. Therefore, I brought it here.”
“Hurry up and give me a price, but don’t scare this Imperial Lord. After all, he’s an Imperial Lord. Imperial Lord-level techniques are useful to them.”
“I won’t sell it for too low a price. After all, it’s the original copy.”
As the five Supremacies conversed, the cyan-clothed female Supremacy walked over and bowed respectfully. “Greetings, Imperial Lord. This Selfless Formless Sword manual belongs to my homeworld. I had no choice but to take it here to sell it. If you want it, you can have it for eight Outer Realm Essence Crystals.”
“Eight Outer Realm Essence Crystals?” Meng Chuan shook his head and smiled. “I can buy two to three Third Tribulation treasures with that price.”
An Outer Realm Essence Crystal could be exchanged for one ordinary Imperial Lord-level treasure.
He had to exchange eight Imperial Lord-level treasures for an Imperial Lord-level technique’s original copy? “After all, it was written by a Tribulation Eminence,” said the female cyan-robed Supremacy.
“Regardless of whose work it is, it’s ultimately an Imperial Lord-level ultimate technique,” said Meng Chuan with a frown. “I can accept the price of five Outer Realm Essence Crystals. It’s fine if you don’t agree.”
He could negotiate the price with the Supremacies as an ‘Imperial Lord.’ He didn’t want to be too long-winded.
The female cyan-clothed Supremacy pondered for a moment. Although one only requires a single Outer Realm Essence Crystal to learn all 19 Imperial Lord-level techniques, only a handful of people are willing to pay the price to learn them during the Treasure Auction. The price this Imperial Lord gave is the typical price for a perfected Imperial Lord-level ultimate technique’s original copy! “Alright, I’ll sell it to you, Imperial Lord,” said the cyan-clothed Supremacy with a smile.
After buying the manual, Meng Chuan returned to his cave abode. He couldn’t help but begin perusing the manual. Meng Chuan became even more excited when he started studying it.
He had picked up a treasure!
Cultivators usually had to be compatible with the ultimate technique if they wanted to learn it! Even if Meng Chuan was given many ultimate techniques, he would feel a headache trying to learn them! If they weren’t compatible with him, he would take a long time to learn them!
In the past, Meng Chuan practiced swift saber techniques. When his cultivation realm had later become high enough, the World Roving Dragon Saber was quite suitable for him. However, Meng Chuan still felt that it wasn’t good enough. He modified it and created the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique, which was more suitable for him.
Beautiful. Meng Chuan had already learned the legacy, but he continued flipping through the book, engrossed with its contents.
His Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique used the world as a canvas, but its core was the lightning lineage’s profundities. The Selfless Formless Sword was a brush technique that also used the world as a canvas. Furthermore, it was purer than Meng Chuan’s self-created technique!
Meng Chuan was rather talented in the lightning lineage. He created the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique with his understanding of the lightning lineage’s profundities.
Huang Yong’s talent in other aspects wasn’t high. He also didn’t follow a specific cultivation system. Instead, he only incorporated the void lineage’s profundities into his brush techniques, making it even purer.
Amazing. The way Huang Yong uses the brush has reached a godly level. The third painting looks like it’s composed of 3,6000 strokes, but the entire painting is actually just a single brushstroke. He utilizes realism. I’m very inferior to him. Meng Chuan stared at the paintings in admiration. After all, as a perfected Imperial Lord-level technique, the Selfless Formless Sword uses realism as one of its cores. Meng Chuan had extremely high attainments in painting. He wasn’t inferior to Huang Yong at all. However, Huang Yong had extremely high attainments in the void lineage. He had fused the void lineage’s profundities into his brush, making it even more magical. Though this was the case, Meng Chuan’s learning process was very smooth. Meng Chuan easily combined the so-called 33,00 sword moves and managed to form paintings. At the very least, Meng Chuan had fully understood the first three paintings.
The fourth painting is at the Heaven Earth realm. Meng Chuan flipped open the page containing the fourth painting and carefully studied it.
Realism and domain?
Meng Chuan continued staring at the fourth painting. He dissected the brushstrokes and comprehended their uniqueness.
It took time to dissect a painting, which was why he bought the painting manual. Just accepting the legacy would provide him fewer benefits than constantly deciphering the profoundness behind every brushstroke in the painting catalogue.
So it wasn’t actually two cores. The Selfless Formless Sword uses domain as its core. Realism and the selfless concept is to realize the domain...
Meng Chuan continued studying the painting and gradually understood the painting’s essence. However, it wasn’t easy to master it completely. The concepts of realism and selfless were both the void lineage’s profundities. These concepts had to be infused into one’s brushstrokes before they could form a domain naturally.
Meng Chuan’s Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique was considered a top-notch Supremacy-level ultimate technique. After it reached the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm, Meng Chuan was very vexed about how he should break through to the Heaven Earth realm.
However, after learning Selfless Formless Sword, Meng Chuan was no longer vexed. He pushed the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique aside and temporarily focused on learning the sword art. His insights into the void lineage rapidly fused with the Selfless Formless Sword, making his attainments in the sword art soar to the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm. He even headed straight for the Heaven Earth realm.
While he was cultivating, the Treasure Auction started.

chapters.title: Chapter 510 - Treasure Auction
chapters.content:
Chapter 510 Treasure Auction
Meng Chuan arrived in front of Black Dragon Palace. So many cultivators are here.
Black Dragon Palace occupied an incredibly vast area, but he could still see a large number of cultivators entering Black Dragon Palaceeither alone or in groups.
Meng Chuan couldn’t help but sigh in amazement. “At least 20-30% of Heaven Peak River System’s cultivators will participate in the Treasure Auction.”
The Treasure Auction was a grand event. Even if one couldn’t afford the treasures, they could broaden their horizons by looking at them.
Meng Chuan was currently dressed in a luxurious black robe. He had a sword by his waist, and his white hair draped over his shoulders. He also had a unique temperament, one that he attained after cultivating Selfless Formless Sword.
Perhaps it was because Selfless Formless Sword was extremely suitable for Meng Chuan; it could also be because his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique-which was at the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm-was much stronger than ordinary perfected Supremacy-level ultimate techniques, but Meng Chuan had already deduced how he should reach the Heaven Earth realm after cultivating Selfless Formless Sword. He was confident that he could upgrade his Selfless Formless Sword to the Heaven Earth realm within ten years.
His fake Imperial Lord aura-courtesy of the Sea Serpent Token—was now inclined towards the Selfless Formless Sword. His disguise was perfect.
“Imperial Lord, welcome.” Black Dragon Palace had a large number of attendants. These attendants-all with different appearanceswarmly welcomed every cultivator and brought them to the large hall where the auction was being held.
Meng Chuan also arrived at the hall.
“Imperial Lord, please rest here. The auction will be held in about two hours.” The attendant led Meng Chuan to a seat. When Meng Chuan sat down, he was astonished to discover that, although he could see figures covered by fog with his naked eye, he couldn’t see them clearly; he also couldn’t approach them! Every cultivator’s seating area was a separate space. Unless a group of fellow companions was willing to stay together, nobody could approach them or spy on them. Black Dragon Palace wanted to give every cultivator the courage to bid during the Treasure Auction! Thus, they had to conceal every cultivator’s identity so that they wouldn’t be hunted down by experts.
On Black Dragon Planet, Black Dragon Palace and Eternal Tower had the best reputations.
Meng Chuan only dared to buy Sixth Tribulation treasures in these two places.
Meng Chuan sat down and consumed the free alcohol and snacks provided by Black Dragon Palace. He waited patiently, and two hours soon passed. The number of blurry figures in the hall had already exceeded 10,000. Tribulation Eminences were definitely among them.
“Everyone.” In the middle of the hall, a silver-haired woman appeared. Her face was covered in dragon scales, and she emitted a faint dragon aura. Her voice spread throughout the hall, causing the entire hall to fall silent.
It’s her? Patriarch Black Dragon’s follower, Cang Yu. Meng Chuan immediately recognized her.
Cang Yu was a Third Tribulation Eminence. She was one of Patriarch Black Dragon’s followers.
“I will be hosting today’s Treasure Auction,” said the silver-haired dragon woman with a smile. With a flip of her hand, a talisman token floated in front of her. “The first treasure is an Undying Talisman.”
None of the cultivators could see the talisman with their Quintessential Essence or consciousness, but they could clearly see the runes on the talisman token.
“Everyone, take a closer look,” said the silver-haired dragon woman. She began describing the talisman’s properties. “The Undying Talisman grants one an Undying body for about two hours. Most importantly, it contains extremely profound time lineage laws. One can study this talisman.” Thirty seconds passed in silence.
She then said, “The starting price is ten Outer Realm Essence Crystals. As per the normal rules, if there are no new bids after three counts, it will be considered sold.”
“Ten cubes.” A powerful voice immediately rang out.
“Fifteen cubes.”
The price immediately went up.
Even if one had an Undying Talisman, one would probably be captured alive if they were to encounter a powerful enemy! Although one would have an Undying body for two hours, they would still die after being captured alive. After all, the talisman didn’t increase one’s strength at all.
The Undying Talisman was only useful during certain situations. Thus, the Undying Talisman was more useful for comprehending the time lineage’s profundities. If one could fully comprehend the profundities within, they could gain a permanent Undying body forever! Even among Tribulation Eminences, a permanent Undying body was a rare and powerful technique. Of course, Seventh Tribulation Eminences and stronger could easily counter this.
“Sixteen cubes.”
A hoarse voice rang out. “Eighteen cubes.”
The hall fell silent.
Three counts later.
“Undying Talisman, sold for 18 Outer Realm Essence Crystals.” The silver-haired dragon woman put away the Undying Talisman and immediately said, “Next treasure, an incomplete stone tablet...”
She took out treasures one by one, placing them before the cultivators as they vied for them.
The starting prices set by Black Dragon Palace were considered very low. Even if one didn’t use it, one could still buy it for the starting price. They could then sell it to Eternal Tower and earn a profit! Therefore, even Supremacies dared to bid in the beginning! However, after the prices rose, only those who truly wanted an item would continue bidding.
“Lightning Five-Colored Flower. Sold for 373 Outer Realm Essence Crystals,” continued the silver-haired dragon woman. “Next, Grand Yang Divine Fire Cauldron, a Fifth Tribulation treasure...”
The Treasure Auction progressed relatively quickly, but only half of the treasures had been shown after six hours.
“Drunken Dream Flower, sold for 37 Outer Realm Essence Crystals,” said the silver-haired dragon woman. “Next, Ashen Pagoda, a Sixth Tribulation treasure.”
The silver-haired woman flipped her hand and took out an ancient pagoda.
The pagoda flew out from her palm and floated in midair. With her Tribulation realm powers, many runes appeared on the pagoda’s surface.
“The Ashen Pagoda can accelerate time...” The silver-haired dragon woman began describing the treasure’s functions. At the same time, she allowed the cultivators to scrutinize the Sixth Tribulation treasure carefully.
It was rare for one to see a temporal cave abode. It was much harder to refine a temporal cave abode than it was to refine an Undying Talisman. However, temporal cave abodes had limited usefulness.
One could grow flowers, grass, and fruits in them. They could also be used to help one increase their strength quickly in a short time when they were faced with a difficult situation. One could also study the time lineage profundities contained within the temporal cave abode.
“The Ashen Pagoda’s starting price is 300 Outer Realm Essence Crystals,” said the silver-haired woman.
Meng Chuan stared at the Ashen Pagoda carefully.
He had not bid on a single item all this while.
“320 cubes,” said a calm voice from the left.
“330 cubes,” said Meng Chuan. Outer Realm Essence Crystals were very precious. People typically didn’t bid for treasures that far exceeded their market value.
Suddenly, a terrifying voice rang out. “350 cubes.”
Meng Chuan’s expression changed. The price increased by so much in a single bid?
The other party’s intentions were clear-he had to obtain it!
While Meng Chuan and company were fighting over treasures, Patriarch Black Dragon was chatting with a red-haired man over drinks in one of Black Dragon Palace’s secret halls.
“Old fellow, you really can’t hold on any longer?” The red-haired man looked at his good friend with mixed emotions.
Patriarch Black Dragon nodded slightly. “Yes.” He had to keep his situation a secret from outsiders, but he had no need to do so for close friends.
“On this path of cultivation, my old friends are passing away one after another.” The red-haired man sighed softly. “Back then, the seven of us joined forces to kill that old fiend. After we succeeded, our fame spread throughout the outer realm. Now, even you are about to reach the end of your life. I will be the only one left among the original seven.” “You are still young,” said Patriarch Black Dragon with a smile. “As a pure-blood dragon, you have a long lifespan. You will go further than us.”
A pure-blood dragon at the Imperial Lord realm could live for 100,000 years. After reaching the Tribulation realm, a pure-blood dragon’s lifespan would increase again. Although he was over 30,000 years old, the red-haired man was considered a very young pure-blood dragon.
“I’m still stuck at the Fifth Tribulation realm. It’s difficult for me to take that next step,” said the red-haired man. “Without a qualitative breakthrough, I don’t dare to improve my body. After all, I’ll trigger the sixth Heavenly Tribulation if my body improves further.”
“Considering your lifespan, you’re still very young. What are you worried about?” said Patriarch Black Dragon. “When you can fight a Sixth Tribulation Eminence, it means your realm is high enough. You can then improve your body and trigger the sixth Heavenly Tribulation. Your chances of transcending the tribulation will be very high.”
The red-haired man smiled. “It’s too difficult.”
As a pure-blood dragon, as long as he broke through to the Tribulation realm, he could reach the Fifth Tribulation realm in a short period.
