“Chi Feng,” said Patriarch Black Dragon, “I’ll hand this Black Dragon Planet to you. How’s that? In the future, Heaven Peak River System will be yours. You will be in charge.”
“Me?” The red-haired man shook his head. “As you know, I’m not the type that can stay in one place for thousands of years. I still want to travel the vast outer realm and adventure.”
Patriarch Black Dragon sighed slightly. “I worked hard to build Black Dragon Planet and set up the array formation. The three friends I wanted to entrust it to were also unwilling.”
Gaining control over a river system wasn’t very tempting for a Fifth Tribulation Eminence. This was because, during this era, there was only one fifth Tribulation Eminence in two to three river systems on average. “Why do you even care? Heaven Peak River System’s other cultivators will bear the responsibility,” said the red-haired man.
“You don’t understand.” Patriarch Black Dragon shook his head. “That bunch of lunatics from Black Fiend Hall have already targeted Heaven Peak River System.”
The red-haired man was slightly taken aback.
“Forget it. Without paying an appropriate price, who would be willing to protect Heaven Peak River System?” Patriarch Black Dragon shook his head. If he expended all his treasures, he would naturally be able to hire a Tribulation Eminence to guard the area. However, he had left his treasures for his homeworld!
“You’ve protected Heaven Peak River System for tens of thousands of years. You’ve already done enough for it. As for the rest? It depends on the juniors’ fates,” said the red-haired man casually. “A crueler environment might be more suitable for cultivators.”
“Ordinary cultivators have to be careful. Their cultivation paths are much more difficult than yours. You are a pure-blood dragon, so you won’t be able to understand the struggle,” said Patriarch Black Dragon.
Dragons and phoenixes were domineering forces in the River of Spacetime. Even Sixth Tribulation Eminences were afraid of them. They were afraid of provoking the older ones after dealing with the younger ones! Of course, Seventh Tribulation Eminences didn’t care. Killing them and refining their bloodlines was a normal thing.
Under normal circumstances, Seventh Tribulation Eminences were invincible in the endless River of Spacetime. They were legends.
Eighth Tribulation Eminences? Ancestral Master Archean Eon had only encountered one in his entire life.
“430 cubes.” Meng Chuan bid again. “Oh?” Patriarch Black Dragon looked over in surprise. “Ashen Pagoda’s price has reached 430 cubes?”
“Why have they bid such a high amount for a temporal cave abode?” The red-haired man was shocked as well.
Ashen Pagoda’s starting price was 300 cubes. Typically, it would be considered a high price at 360 cubes. 430 cubes? That was too much.
“450 cubes.” An evil, ear-piercing sound rang out.
Silence.
The entire hall fell silent.
Meng Chuan frowned.
Why is the price so high? Meng Chuan didn’t expect the Ashen Pagoda to reach such a price. This price was too high. Furthermore, it wasn’t worth it.
Although he had obtained Eminence Pang Ming’s treasures, he still needed to be thrifty. Although the Ashen Pagoda was important to his cultivation, it wasn’t without substitutes.
Three counts passed quickly.
Humph.
In a corner of the hall, an ugly elder had a look of anger.
The Ashen Pagoda is the best temporal cave abode for me. I traveled across more than ten river zones to arrive here... To think that someone had a bidding war with me. If it weren’t for the fact that I need to nurture my worms quickly so that I can explore the ancient cave abode, I wouldn’t have spent so many Essence Crystals. The elder’s heart ached slightly. Of course, it was just a tiny ache.
“Ashen Pagoda, sold for 450 Outer Realm Essence Crystals.” The silver-haired woman smiled as she announced the final price for the treasure. “Next, the Primordial Stone.”
The moment she said that, more than ten experts snapped to attention among the countless figures in the hall. They had come here for the Primordial Stone.
“A Primordial Stone is a piece of rock that can only be found on the most mysterious Primordial Star in the outer realm. Only legendary Eighth Tribulation Eminences can discover a Primordial Star and enter it. Therefore, all Primordial Stones... have been collected by an Eighth Tribulation Eminence at the very least,” said the silver-haired woman. To the legendary Eighth Tribulation Eminences, obtaining Primordial Stones was as simple as picking up some rocks.
However, a Primordial Stone was extremely precious.
As the silver-haired woman spoke, she waved her hand, causing a round stone—the size of a baby’s fist-to appear. The moment it appearedOh? Meng Chuan immediately felt the Chaos Hole in his dantian trembling. It yearned for the Primordial Stone greedily. It was extremely eager to obtain the object that was just in front of it.
My dantian’s Chaos Hole? Meng Chuan’s expression changed.
The Chaos Hole realm was a very special realm in the Godfiend cultivation system. Only Meng Chuan had reached the Chaos Hole realm. Although he was a Supremacy, he had a 5,000-year lifespan. As the first pioneer of this special realm, Meng Chuan had to figure out everything about it himself. How was he to cultivate his body? How was he to perfect his dantian? Did he need external objects? Everything was unknown.
Meng Chuan had seen many treasures on Black Dragon Planet, but this was the first time his dantian’s Chaos Hole had reacted. It was yearning to devour the Primordial Stone.
My dantian’s Chaos Hole doesn’t only absorb the Heaven and Earth powers and the outer realm essence energy. It can also absorb Primordial Stones? Meng Chuan felt his entire body tremble. The desire in his dantian made his Essence Soul tremble.
This was his body’s innate instinct. A Chaos realm lifeform yearned for Primordial Stones. Luckily, I didn’t buy the Ashen Pagoda. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have dared to bid for the Primordial Stone. Meng Chuan understood that he would alarm Patriarch Black Dragon if he bought both treasures. After all, they both cost a pretty penny. Buying both treasures would cause a lot of trouble for him.
However, he would be fine since he was only buying a single treasure now.
At that moment, Meng Chuan felt that fate was magical. He had clearly lost a treasure he wanted, but a more important treasure had now appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 511 - Everything Bought
chapters.content:
Chapter 511 Everything Bought
“The Primordial Stone is the toughest weapon refinement material in the outer realm. Even a full-powered strike from a Seventh Tribulation Eminence can’t damage it at all,” continued the silver-haired woman. “In the face of time, many Tribulation treasures will gradually be damaged without a Master maintaining them. As for the Primordial Stone, it has an Eternal characteristic. Even after billions of years, it remains flawless.”
“Eternal characteristic?”.
“A full-powered strike from a Seventh Tribulation Eminence can’t damage it?”
Many cultivators with little experience were dumbfounded when they heard this. They carefully looked at the round, smooth stone that was the size of a baby’s fist. They could only see such treasures doing the Treasure Auctions; otherwise, they had no way of seeing such valuable items during their everyday lives.
This was also why many Supremacies came to the Treasure Auction despite not being able to afford any of the items being sold.
The Primordial Stone is actually so attractive to the Chaos Hole. It’s as though it’s an instinctive attraction? Meng Chuan had carefully read his sect’s dossiers before leaving Archean Eon Realm. Thus, he naturally knew about the famous Primordial Star. In the outer realm, there were countless types of stars. The most common examples were Grand Yang Star, Grand Yin Star, the mysterious Darkstar, and the Seamless Star. The Godfiend cultivation system’s Great Solar realm, Darkstar realm, and Seamless realm’s names had all originated from the stars in the outer realm.
To ordinary cultivators, a Chaos Hole was the most terrifying celestial body. This was the reason why Meng Chuan named the new unknown realm he had reached the Chaos Hole realm.
However, legend had it that the most mysterious star was the Primordial Star. Only Eighth Tribulation Eminences could discover and enter a Primordial Star. Eighth Tribulation Eminences could easily mine a pile of Primordial Stones. However, the stones that were available to the vast majority of the public were tiny in comparison. They were also extremely expensive! After all, only an Eighth Tribulation Eminence could mine them.
Primordial Stones were mostly commonly refined into Tribulation treasures. Ancestral Master Archean Eon had recorded a refining method for Primordial Stones—Myriad Star Refinement Art. This refinement method required one to gather 10,000 Grand Yin Stars and 10,000 Grand Yang Stars. These stars would then be used to set up an altar. Only by using a sacrificial method could a Primordial Stone automatically disintegrate. After that, one could refine the Primordial Stone into a Tribulation treasure. It was typically used to refine Seventh Tribulation treasures.
As for Eighth Tribulation treasures? Every Eighth Tribulation treasure’s creation process was extremely difficult. One needed to chance upon a fortuitous encounter to refine one.
“The raw refinement material, Primordial Stone, has a starting price of 360 Outer Realm Essence Crystals,” said the silver-haired woman with a smile.
A voice immediately rang out. “370 cubes.” An old, white-haired perfected Imperial Lord stared at the Primordial Stone.
“380 cubes.” “385 cubes.”
There were consecutive bids.
Meng Chuan continued to stare at it, not in a hurry to bid.
He didn’t panic! He knew that although Primordial Stones were rare and precioushaving a price comparable to a Sixth Tribulation treasure despite its small size-one could still purchase them from various places. This was because every Eighth Tribulation Eminence that had existed in the River of Spacetime’s long history would typically excavate a massive number of Primordial Stones to leave in their homeworldshigh-level worlds. Although it took quite some time for these Primordial Stones to be available for sale, one could still purchase some if they were diligent in searching for them.
Eternal Tower had Primordial Stones for sale.
Meng Chuan remembered that he had seen two raw Primordial Stones for sale when he was scanning through Eternal Tower’s treasures. One Primordial Stone was slightly larger than the other, and its price was 760 Outer Realm Essence Crystals. The other was much smaller, and its price was only 200 Outer Realm Essence Crystals.
“405 cubes.”
“410 cubes.” One cultivator after another bid on the Primordial Stone. These cultivators weren’t in desperate need of the stone because not everyone could use it as material for artifact refinement. Many of them participated in the Treasure Auction because they wanted to buy low and sell high.
Meng Chuan finally said, “430 cubes.”
He increased the price by 20 cubes in one go, causing many cultivators to hesitate.
The hall fell silent.
One count, two counts...
Meng Chuan waited silently.
Three counts were up! As the other cultivators in the hall hesitated, time passed.
“Primordial Stone, sold for 430 cubes.” The silver-haired woman smiled radiantly. “The next treasure, Fire Raven Plume.”
I bought it. Meng Chuan heaved a sigh of relief.
Following that, Meng Chuan scrutinized the showcased treasures in an appreciative manner. He stared at the exotic flowers, precious materials, powerful treasures, special treasures... These were rather common.
Cosmos Crystals, Void Transference Talismans, and precious treasures like Archean Eon Sect’s Heart Questioning Bead were not for sale anywhere.
Seventh Tribulation Eminences swept up all the vast outer realm’s most precious items first! Sixth Tribulation Eminences also competed for these precious treasures.
Meng Chuan had also heard that although Eighth Tribulation Eminences might no longer exist in their high-leveled homeworlds, the cultivators from those worlds would sell some Primordial Stones once in a while.
This made a high-level world very wealthy. They were also willing to sell Primordial Stones because they were just one of the legacies a high-level world had.
If it was said that cultivators in middle-level worlds had a sense of superiority when facing lower-level world cultivators, then cultivators in high-level worlds were richer than many Tribulation Eminences. It was difficult to pry into their homeworld’s secrets. High-level worlds had powerful cultivation systems and powerful defensive treasures... It was as though every high-level world expert would face their peers as if they were an emperor to a peasant.
The difference in heritage was too great. Only when one reached the Fifth Tribulation realm would a high-level world’s experts take them seriously. Such disdain was inevitable. After all, their worlds had produced an Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
The Treasure Auction finally ended after 12 hours.
In one of Black Dragon Palace’s halls.
“This is the Primordial Stone.” The silver-haired woman personally came to close the trade with Meng Chuan. She was in charge of all the treasures that were worth more than 100 cubes. She let an imperial Lord close the trades of the cheaper treasures. This was because most of the treasures sold in the Treasure Auction were from other cultivators. Thus, no mistakes could be made.
“430 Outer Realm Essence Crystals.” With a flip of his hand, Meng Chuan produced 430 floating Essence Crystals.
The silver-haired woman smiled. She took the Outer Realm Essence Crystals, and Meng Chuan took the Primordial Stone.
“Ordinary storage treasures can’t store Primordial Stones. One has to have a sufficiently stable spatial treasure to store it,” reminded the silver-haired woman before leaving
Meng Chuan obviously knew that. Whether it was his Spatial Pagoda or Fiend Prison, they could store the Primordial Stone. Primordial Stone. Although Meng Chuan’s dantian was filled with longing, he still controlled himself.
After leaving Black Dragon Palace, Meng Chuan headed for Eternal Tower.
In one of Eternal Tower’s fifth-floor halls.
A large number of Sixth Tribulation treasure phantoms appeared in the sky above the hall.
“I want to buy this treasure.” Meng Chuan pointed at a star-shaped world. It was the Myriad Flower Realm, a Sixth Tribulation treasure. “Please wait a moment, Imperial Lord.” The attendant was somewhat surprised as he immediately invited a female Imperial Lord over.
The female Imperial Lord smiled at Meng Chuan. “Imperial Lord, you wish to buy Myriad Flower Realm?”
“Yes, but I don’t need all of Myriad Flower Realm’s flowers. I’ll sell the ones I don’t need to Eternal Tower,” said Meng Chuan.
“You just want Myriad Flower Realm itself, and not the flowers?” The female Imperial Lord was somewhat surprised. “Wait a moment. Our Eternal Tower needs to do an audit for a while.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
Many rare flowers were extremely valuable. For example, the Lightning Five-Colored Flower had sold for over 300 cubes during the Treasure Auction. The flowers in Myriad Flower Realm were naturally not as precious as the Lightning Five-Colored Flower. However, there were many of them! The total price he could sell them for wouldn’t be too low once added together.
“Our Eternal Tower has done an audit. Our Eternal Building is willing to purchase all of Myriad Flower Realm’s flowers for 180 Outer Realm Essence Crystals,” said the female Imperial Lord. “Myriad Flower Realm by itself costs 320 cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals.”
“Alright.” Meng Chuan didn’t say anything else.
Eternal Tower had its own pricing system. There was no way to bargain for treasures below the Seventh Tribulation realm.
In terms of time flow acceleration, the Myriad Flower Realm was much inferior to the Ashen Palace, but it wasn’t bad. It still met Meng Chuan’s requirements. “Myriad Flower Realm’s original owner happens to be in Heaven Peak River System. Imperial Lord, you only need to wait for two hours before the Myriad Flower Realm arrives,” said the female Imperial Lord with a smile.
Meng Chuan revealed a look of surprise. He thought he would have needed to wait for months!
The Treasure Auction usually attracted many Tribulation Eminences. Some Tribulation Eminences had treasures they needed others to sell on their behalf, while others had gatherings. From the looks of it, Myriad Flower Realm’s original owner had also arrived. “How much can this Sixth Tribulation treasure robe pay towards it?” With a flip of his hand, Meng Chuan took out one of the three precious treasures left behind by Eminence Pang Ming. Meng Chuan naturally didn’t dare take out the most precious Seventh Tribulation calabash. The remaining two items... The sledgehammer was too distinctive. It was Eminence Pang Ming’s trademark weapon. On the other hand, the robe didn’t have any specific characteristics that could link Meng Chuan to Eminence Pang Ming.
Due to the robe being a protective treasure, it was quite expensive. Eternal Tower bought it for 500 Outer Realm Essence Crystals.
After handing over the robe, he left with Myriad Flower Realm and 180 Outer Realm Essence Crystals. Meng Chuan left Eternal Tower delighted. I’ve bought everything!
It was safest to dispose of goods at Eternal Tower.
After all, two Sixth Tribulation Eminences were Eminence Pang Ming’s mortal enemies! A Sixth Tribulation Eminence didn’t have the right to make Eternal Tower expose their customers’ information. Furthermore, Eternal Tower wouldn’t investigate every customer’s true identity. This was to maintain Eternal Tower’s credibility in the outer realm, allowing them to continue doing business.
After returning to his cave abode, Meng Chuan quickly entered a chamber.
With a wave of his hand, he released a light-emitting star into the chamber. This tiny star was extremely beautiful. It was crystalline, but in reality, it contained Myriad Flower Realm.
Swoosh.
The dazzling star remained suspended in the middle of the chamber. Meng Chuan had already entered Myriad Flower Realm.
Myriad Flower Realm. Meng Chuan looked around the grotto-heaven. The grotto-heaven was filled with flowers and plants. They were very beautiful. Of course, the remaining flowers and plants were all ordinary. All the precious flowers had been plucked and removed.
He landed on the grass and sat cross-legged. With a flip of his hand, he took out the Primordial Stone.
Meng Chuan looked at the round Primordial Stone in his palm. Primordial Stone... The moment he took it out, the Chaos Hole in his dantian once again let out a greedy yearning for it. His Chaos Hole wanted to devour it.

chapters.title: Chapter 512 - Primordial Stone Transformation
chapters.content:
Chapter 512 Primordial Stone Transformation
Meng Chuan carefully examined the Primordial Stone.
He couldn’t find any runes on the small piece of rock despite employing every mean at his disposal.
When Meng Chuan attained a seventh-level Essence Soul, he gained microscopic vision. Even a tiny particle could appear bigger than a Grand Yang Star. However, when Meng Chuan looked at the Primordial Stone, its surface didn’t change at all despite it being magnified by a billion-fold! Looking at it had him making the same conclusion as feeling the Primordial Stone in his palm-it was smooth!
There were no blemishes on the surface, nor any runes. It was also unbelievably tough. A Seventh Tribulation Eminence could use a Grand Yang Star-which spanned over 50 million kilometers—as a toy. However, even after attacking at full strength, they still wouldn’t be able to damage the Primordial Stone.
Primordial Stones even had the Eternal characteristic. This meant that even time couldn’t wear it down.
My dantian’s Chaos Hole is extremely eager to devour it. Meng Chuan held the Primordial Stone and attempted to absorb its strength. However, he was unable to absorb any energy from it, even when he used his Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence and Power of Essence Soul.
Is my dantian’s chaos hole to devour it directly?
His body could instantly fuse back together after disintegrating, so Meng Chuan wasn’t worried about the danger. However, the Primordial Stone was extremely precious. He was also afraid that bad changes would occur to his Chaos Hole if it did devour the stone directly. After all, the Chaos Hole was his Chaos Hole realm’s core...
Meng Chuan used all his means to examine the Primordial Stone for seven consecutive days.
“Eternal characteristic,” muttered Meng Chuan softly. “I’ve tried everything. I’ve placed it in an accelerated time flow and a normal time flow. I’ve struck it at near light speed. I’ve even made it fly at speeds close to light speed. However, this Primordial Stone forever remains the same every time! No matter what I do, it doesn’t experience any changes.”
As wind blew, ripples would appear on a water surface.
When an object flew at high speeds, changes would also occur to its body. For example, the temperature caused by friction or the pressure caused by moving at high speeds would change the object’s structure slightly.
Time was even more mysterious. Even powerful Tribulation treasures would change in the face of time, albeit slowly. They would eventually decay and become damaged.
Everything experienced change. This was supposed to be a universal law. However, the Primordial Stone remained unchanged.
It was... eternal.
So this is the Eternal characteristic? The Primordial remains the same eternally? Meng Chuan stared at the Primordial Stone’s surface, which had a faint luster. Meng Chuan noticed that light reflected by the Primordial Stone was unique. After all, no object had a surface as perfect as the Primordial Stone’s. Therefore, the Primordial Stone’s reflected light made Meng Chuan infatuated.
Even after examining the stone for seven days, he was still attracted by this luster.
Forget it. Apart from devouring it, I have no other option. Meng Chuan no longer hesitated as a dark Chaos Hole domain appeared in his palm.
The dark Chaos Hole in his palm devoured the Primordial Stone.
It had been seven days since he obtained the Primordial Stone.
For the past seven days, his dantian’s Chaos Hole had constantly yearned for it. His instincts kept telling him to devour it. However, Meng Chuan had forcefully suppressed himself for seven days. At this moment, Meng Chuan finally stopped suppressing his urges and absorbed the Primordial Stone into his body by following his instincts.
Most cultivators’ instincts usually dictated the best path one should take.
Swoosh.
The Primordial Stone was instantly sucked into his dantian.
A Chaos Hole appeared in his dantian. Out of caution, he temporarily removed the Spatial Pagoda, Bloodblade Disc, Fiend Prison, and other items from his dantian space and placed them beside him.
Whoosh.
The tiny Primordial Stone flew into his dantian space and entered the chaos hole silently.
Changes soon began to occur.
Huh? Meng Chuan vaguely felt an invisible force spread out from his dantian and into every part of his body. Every particle in his body underwent a magical transformation.
Furthermore, the Chaos Hole in his dantian began to absorb the outside world’s energy.
I’m suddenly absorbing energy? Meng Chuan was taken aback. He was experiencing the same thing when he broke through from the Seamless realm to the Chaos Hole realm, and from the Chaos Hole realm’s early stage to the middle stage—his body was taking the initiative to absorb the outside world’s energy.
At that moment, his body was taking the initiative to absorb energy. His dantian was extremely hungry.
I have plenty of Outer Realm Essence Crystals. Let’s see how many you can absorb. Meng Chuan waved his hand and took out an Outer Realm Essence Crystal. He had more than 3,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals. They were enough to produce an ordinary Sixth Tribulation Eminence, so he was naturally extremely calm. Chi! Chi! Chi!
Meng Chuan projected his Chaos Hole domain outwards and had it envelop the Outer Realm Essence Crystal in his hand. The Outer Realm Essence Crystal slowly turned to dust at a visible speed. His body constantly sucked the surging energy. In just a few seconds, one Outer Realm Essence Crystal had been completely devoured.
This is an Outer Realm Essence Crystal! A normal Imperial Lord only needs ten Outer Realm Essence Crystals for a breakthrough. Meng Chuan was shocked, but he hurriedly took out another Outer Realm Essence Crystal from the Spatial Pagoda beside him.
Previously, his Chaos Hole seemed to be underdeveloped.
After absorbing the Primordial Stone, it now began changing qualitatively. Even the total amount of energy it had absorbed was extremely astonishing! His dantian’s Chaos Hole only stopped absorbing external energies after devouring 18 Outer Realm Essence Crystals and a half-cube of Outer Realm Essence Crystal.
During the absorption process, Meng Chuan’s body constantly changed. The mysterious energy changed every particle of his body; it had completely changed his body. At this moment, the transformation process had also completely stopped. The Primordial Stone in my dantian hasn’t been completely devoured. There’s still some left. With a thought, the Primordial Stonewhich had shrunk greatly in the depths of his dantian- flew out. It quickly reached Meng Chuan’s palm. His dantian’s Chaos Hole was no longer hungry. Only a finger-sized Primordial Stone remained.
It was still round and smooth. However, it was 80% smaller than before! Nothing else had changed.
Other than the Myriad Star Refinement Art recorded by Ancestral Master Archean Eon, a Godfiend can also absorb Primordial Stones once they reach the Chaos Hole realm. Meng Chuan was somewhat astonished by this fact. It was very difficult to make a Primordial Stone disintegrate because of its Eternal characteristic. However, a Godfiend who reached the Chaos Hole realm could absorb the stone like it was only nourishment.
To reach the Sage Becoming realm and the Mythical realm, one needs many Cosmos Crystals. My Chaos Hole also requires Primordial Stones to grow. It’s just that I prepared a little more than needed. Just 80% of this Primordial Stone was enough.
I wonder if I’ll still need Primordial Stones once I reach the Imperial Lord realm? Meng Chuan pondered this question.
One didn’t require a large number of Cosmos Crystals to reach the Cosmos Body cultivation system’s Sage Becoming realm. However, one needed an astonishing number of Cosmos Crystals to reach the Mythical realm.
If he had to follow the same ratio, how many Primordial Stones did he need to become an Imperial Lord? At that moment, Meng Chuan felt like the treasures left behind by Eminence Pang Ming might not be enough for his expenses.
If I hadn’t seen the Primordial Stone during this Treasure Auction, I wouldn’t have known its uses. Meng Chuan sighed. As the first pioneer of an unknown cultivation realm, he had to figure out everything about it himself.
Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence. With a thought, Meng Chuan’s fingertip produced lightning-like Quintessential Essence.
Meng Chuan frowned slightly. The purity of my Quintessential Essence hasn’t changed. He could clearly sense that special changes had occurred in his dantian and body after absorbing the mysterious energy. However, his Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence remained the same.
Hum.
With a thought
The Chaos Hole domain spread out. Meng Chuan-who was sitting cross-legged-was surrounded by darkness.
My Chaos Hole domain has become much stronger. Meng Chuan could sense that his domain had changed qualitatively. The pressure and repulsive force exerted by his domain had increased significantly.
Meng Chuan experimented for six hours.
After absorbing 80% of the Primordial Stone and many Outer Realm Essence Crystals, he realized that his body had changed greatly. His Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence’s purity was the only thing that hadn’t changed. On the other hand, he had about ten times more Quintessential Essence in his body. His Chaos Hole domain’s strength had also increased significantly. It was roughly three times stronger than before.
Meng Chuan’s body was also extremely tough now. It was like a weapon. Although his speed hadn’t changed much, his physical strength had increased by dozens of times. Meng Chuan estimated that he could match a late-stage Imperial Lord with just brute strength alone.
In other words, my long-range attacks haven’t improved at all. However, my close combat prowess has become very strong. My body is comparable to a magical treasure. Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft!
His Bloodblades began to execute the Infinite Saber Art—which had reached the Grotto-Heaven realm’s middle stage. They rapidly accelerated and struck Meng Chuan’s body furiously. Meng Chuan didn’t use his Chaos Hole domain or his Body-Protecting Peacock Robe to block the Bloodblades. He just withstood them with his body alone. The Bloodblades—now streams of light-shot towards Meng Chuan.
Sparks flew off Meng Chuan’s skin, but he remained unharmed.
This toughness reminded Meng Chuan of the Primordial Stone.
My dantian’s Chaos Hole is a huge burden on my body. When I had broken through to the Chaos Hole realm, I had to transform every particle space in my body into a miniature Chaos Hole. I had to strengthen my body greatly before I could complete the breakthrough successfully and withstand the Chaos Hole in my dantian.
As for the Primordial Stone, it has transformed my body greatly. My Chaos Hole has become much stronger. I also have ten times more Quintessential Essence now.
Meng Chuan had a vague feeling that a powerful body was the Chaos Hole realm’s foundation. Only by having a solid foundation could he advance further.

chapters.title: Chapter 513 - Let the Demons Make More Preparations
chapters.content:
Chapter 513 Let the Demons Make More Preparations
With a paramount technique as his foundation, Meng Chuan’s body had become astonishingly powerful after absorbing most of the Primordial Stone.
I should have the strongest body among my peers in the Supremacy realm. It should be comparable to pure-blooded dragons and phoenixes at the same realm, right?
The strongest special lifeforms were dragons and phoenixes. They were much stronger than the Dark Peacock. Pure-blooded dragons and phoenixes could fight peak Imperial Lords when they were young (Supremacy realm). When they were adults (perfected Imperial Lord realm), they could fight Fifth Tribulation Eminences. This was the extreme talent of a special lifeform.
Although Dark Lightning, Lightning Walk, and Lightning Fire Body Tempering Art could grant one the strength of a Fifth Tribulation Eminence in certain aspects, they were greatly flawed techniques. Only if one had mastered a perfected Imperial Lord-level paramount technique and had a body comparable to an adult pure-blooded dragon or phoenix, could they match a Fifth Tribulation Eminence.
How difficult was it to create a perfected Imperial Lord-level paramount technique?
In comparison, it was easier to see pure-blooded dragons and phoenixes...
Pure-blood dragons and phoenixes had immense talent. With their talent, they could unleash the combat strength of a Fifth Tribulation Eminence when they were adults. They could dominate the outer realm. However, it was very difficult for them to understand every aspect of their strength! This made it extremely difficult for them to reach the Tribulation realm! After all, they had to understand natural laws. But the natural laws they grasped were at the Fifth Tribulation realm! Due to this, they would become a Fifth Tribulation Eminence once they understood their full strength.
Therefore, these two special lifeforms were typically Fifth Tribulation Eminences after breaking through to the Tribulation Realm. It was more than 100 times more difficult for them to reach the Sixth Tribulation realm.
Seventh Tribulation realm? In the same era, across the entire River of Spacetime, the two species didn’t necessarily have a Seventh Tribulation expert.
However, both races have strong divine powers. Although my body is comparable to theirs, I haven’t produced any strong divine powers. Meng Chuan’s previous divine were too weak. If I were to name a divine power I have, I’d say it’d be my body. Its toughness is comparable to a magical treasure or weapon.
The Primordial Stone was very tough, so Meng Chuan had gained similar characteristics after absorbing it.
Although his body wasn’t as ludicrously tough as a Primordial Stone, it was still exaggeratedly strong.
If I were to encounter a powerful enemy, they might not be able to destroy my body, but they can capture me alive. Meng Chuan understood this. In the outer realm, there were plenty of ways to deal with those with tough bodies. For example, one could first capture their opponent before throwing them into a Grand Yang Star’s core. In front of the star’s divine fire, one’s body would probably be reduced to ashes instantly.
Although I’ve improved greatly this time, the body back at home can’t make a breakthrough without a Primordial Stone.
Meng Chuan thought about it and felt like it was alright.
He had two bodies. One had absorbed a Primordial Stone, while the other hadn’t. He could use one body as a control, allowing him to understand the Primordial Stone’s uses better.
Meng Chuan had bought all the treasures he wanted to buy.
In the following days, he began his long-term cultivation on Black Dragon Planet.
Everything was as Meng Chuan had expected. He was indeed different from ordinary Supremacies. When he cultivated in Myriad Flower Realm alone, it could only accelerate the time flow by ten-fold! In contrast, the Myriad Flower Realm could maintain an eight-fold faster time flow for Imperial Lords —who had 10,000-year lifespans.
The Fiend Prison was permanently placed in Myriad Flower Realm. Myriad Flower Realm became Meng Chuan’s long-term cultivation ground.
His paramount technique, Infinite Saber, gradually broke through from the Grotto-Heaven realm’s middle stage to the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm. It was a change that happened due to Meng Chuan accumulating more insights as time passed.
Since he could study the Lightning Dwarf Star’s complete paramount speed laws, the Seventh Tribulation Dark Peacock’s flesh and blood, and the Three World Saber-a Tribulation-level ultimate technique-he had plenty of guidance. He also consumed wine and fruits—which aided his cultivation-daily. Due to all these different factors, his cultivation speed naturally increased by leaps and bounds.
His cultivation of the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique was even smoother.
After arriving on Black Dragon Planet, the most precious manual Meng Chuan had obtained was the painting catalogue, Selfless Formless Sword. This was an ultimate technique that suited his intentions the best.
Through the paintings, he understood Senior Huang Yong’s intentions. It was like they were communicating across space and time.
Cultivating this sword art was like painting. After three years of cultivating the sword art, Meng Chuan’s Selfless Formless Sword reached the Heaven Earth realm! After 12 years, his Selfless Formless Sword reached the Heaven Earth realm’s middle stage. At this moment, Meng Chuan had already fully understood the painting catalogue’s fourth painting. After fusing his insights into his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique for eight years, he had accumulated enough insights to upgrade his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique to the Heaven Earth realm!
The moment the movement technique reached the Heaven Earth realm, it was in no way inferior to Selfless Formless Sword’s four paintings. Furthermore, it suited Meng Chuan better.
Although cultivating the Selfless Formless Sword was like talking to Senior Huang Yong and understood his intentions, Meng Chuan was still different from Senior Huang Yong.
Senior Huang Yong used the world as a canvas. He was more poetic and romantic, and he followed the flow.
Meng Chuan was someone whose temperament had been tempered by the war happening in Archean Eon Realm. He soared into the sky, hoping to break through all shackles. Therefore, he created the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique and Infinite Saber Art.
Archean Eon Realm.
The white-haired Meng Chuan sat on Jiang State Capital’s city wall and drank. The surrounding soldiers couldn’t see him at all.
One of Meng Chuan’s true bodies remained secluded in the Heaven and Earth Great Hall, while the other cultivated in the outer realm. His Essence Soul avatars were much more relaxed than his true bodies.
Such a leisurely life was inevitable.
Stuck in his homeworld, his true body could only sense the worldly laws! No matter how much he cultivated, he would still be cultivating the worldly laws. How could it compare to the vast outer realm? There was no suppression in the outer realm. One could clearly sense the vast laws of spacetime. Only such a vast world could give birth to all sorts of special lifeforms and Tribulation Eminences. His homeworld was more friendly to mortals, but it increasingly impeded one the stronger they became.
Gulp! Gulp! Gulp!
Meng Chuan raised his head and drank.
The cold autumn wind blew.
It’s been ten years since my body started roaming the outer realm. I still haven’t found any longevity extension treasures. However, I’m more confident about protecting my homeworld now. There’s no need for Qiyue to awaken and risk her life.
Longevity extension treasures were treasures that broke the laws of spacetime. Once they appeared, they would be taken away by powerful Tribulation Eminences.
He probably had to become a Tribulation Eminence before he had a chance of collecting them.
Oh? Meng Chuan sensed something and looked into the distance.
After obtaining Myriad Flower Realm, he had cultivated in Myriad Flower Realm for 37 years. His strength naturally improved greatly.
The profundities contained within his self-created Imperial Lord-level ultimate technique-Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique—had already surpassed Archean Eon Realm’s void lineage laws. With a thought, he stared at two specific areas in the South Sea and the North Sea.
Above an island in the South Sea, more than 10,000 kilometers away from land, a demon monarch—who was covered in yellow furangrily cleaved through the void with an axe in hand. The void distorted and trembled as the two axe strikes split open the World Gap’s membrane. The demon monarch struck out with his axe as he tried to break through the two world membranes as quickly as possible. “Quick, quick. We have to enter the World Gap before the humans can stop us.” At the same moment, a demon monarch with a scaled tail—whose right claw was emitting black gases-stood above the North Sea’s edge. He tore through the human world’s membrane with three consecutive swipes. He then tore through the World Gap’s membrane.
The scaled demon monarch was equally anxious. “I have to enter as soon as possible! If the humans intercept me, I’m dead. However, Brother Hanlie and I are taking action simultaneously in the North and South Sea. In just a few seconds, the humans won’t be able to stop us.”
Are the demons trying to draw the map of connection points again? Or are they sending a fifth Firmament demon monarch army in from the World Gap? Meng Chuan sat at the city wall and drank a mouthful of alcohol. He was very calm.
Swoosh.
A figure flashed and appeared at the city wall. It was Meng An.
“Dad,” said Meng An anxiously. “The demons are attacking the world membranes. They are about to enter the World Gap; we have to stop them.”
“Don’t be anxious. Let the demons make more preparations,” said Meng Chuan indifferently as he glanced at his son.

chapters.title: Chapter 514 - Guarding Everywhere
chapters.content:
Chapter 514 Guarding Everywhere
“Let the demons be more prepared?” Meng An was taken aback. How could they let the enemy be more prepared?
Meng Chuan smiled and looked at his son. “The demons won’t completely give up if we only kill two demon sage possessors. Even if the two demon sage possessors die, the demons might send another one or two into the human world. The best solution is to let the demons send a large batch of fifth Firmament demon monarchs into the human world.”
“Let them send in?” Meng An looked at his father.
Meng Chuan nodded. “Then, kill them all.”
Meng An was alarmed as he somewhat understood his father’s thoughts.
“We have to kill so many fifth Firmament demon monarchs that they no longer dare to enter. We need to kill them until the demons completely give up,” said Meng Chuan indifferently. The fifth Firmament demon monarchs who didn’t participate in the battle would definitely resist when they saw how all who entered the human world were wiped out. They would rather live in the World Gap forever than die.
“Dad, are you confident?” Meng An asked worriedly. “If we can’t kill them all, it will be troublesome. Just a small number of survivors will cause a lot of trouble for us.”
“How can I joke about such matters?” Meng Chuan tipped his head and drank. He smiled and instructed, “Alright, go busy yourself. There’s no need to worry about this.” “Yes, I’ll take my leave.” Meng An respectfully retreated. He still trusted his father.
Ever since he obtained Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s core legacy, he had received the best nurturing from his early days as a Godfiend. Every step he took was very well-grounded. In terms of foundation, he was even stronger than Meng Chuan and King True Martial back in their time.
Now, he had already cultivated all six ultimate techniques to the Grotto-Heaven realm. However, the six Samsara ultimate techniques were only his foundation. According to Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s plan, he had to use this foundation and create a stronger ultimate technique that belonged to him. Only then would he have the right to create a Grotto-heaven in his dantian and become a Supremacy. Meng Chuan was currently stuck at this stage. He was having trouble creating an ultimate technique that belonged to him. Even so, he was considered the strongest Regis Godfiend in the world. His strength was very close to that of King True Martial and Meng Chuan back when they were Regis Godfiends.
However, the father-son duo had sparred many times. His father’s Essence Soul avatar had easily defeated him every time. Meng Chuan didn’t use any exquisite moves. He could easily defeat Meng An by using law profundities alone. This made Meng An realize the gap between them.
Meng An was improving quickly. However, his father’s strength remained unreachable!
This made Meng An even more reverent and trusting of his father. Since his father was confident that he could definitely resolve the demon threat, then he would leave it be.
Archean Mountain.
“Demon Sage Hanlie and Demon Sage Black Bone are attacking the world membrane.” Bai Yaoyue and Xu Yingwu’s illusory figures appeared at Archean Mountain immediately. They were somewhat anxious.
“Back then, didn’t we agree that the matter of demons wanting to send demon monarchs into the World Gap should be left to Archean Mountain?” asked Li Guan with a smile. Beside him were Qin Wu and Luo Tang’s illusory figures.
“You did say so.” The illusory Bai Yaoyue solemnly said, “However, once a fifth Firmament demon monarch army infiltrates the human world and scatters, they can attack all the large cities simultaneously! This matter involves too much. Archean Mountain mustn’t make any mistakes. Our entire human race can’t afford to pay such a price.”
Xu Yingwu stared at Li Guan and company solemnly.
“Since our Archean Mountain has promised to deal with this matter, we will be capable of handling it.” Li Guan nodded. “You can just watch without worry.”
Bai Yaoyue and Xu Yingwu exchanged looks. Even now, Archean Mountain remained confident, so this matter shouldn’t be a problem.
“Sure.”
“We’ll leave it to Archean Mountain then.” The two illusory figures dissipated. Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang exchanged looks and smiled.
“When Meng Chuan makes his move this time, everybody-including those of the Demon Realm and the human world’s major sectswill understand his strength,” said Li Guan with a smile. “We’ve kept his strength secret for ten years, all to deal a terrible strike to the demons.”
Meng Chuan’s self-created paramount technique and his reaching the Chaos Hole realm was top secret.
Archean Mountain had never divulged anything.
Luo Tang’s eyes were filled with anticipation. “Let the demons enter before letting them despair.”
“Yes, let them despair.” Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars walked out from a distant room.
“Are all your Essence Soul avatars taking action?” Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang looked at the six Essence Soul avatars in front of them. One had to know that only two Essence Soul avatars were left in the outside world.
“All eight Essence Soul avatars are acting. They will guard every corner of the world,” said Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars. “This matter has huge implications. We cannot afford any accidents.” “Yes.” Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang were rather excited.
“I’m leaving.” The numerous Meng Chuan Essence Soul avatars instantly vanished in all directions.
These eight Essence Soul avatars guarded eight different areas in Archean Eon Realm.
Cities, mountains, snowlands, deserts, or forests... Meng Chuan’s eight Essence Soul avatars in Archean Eon Realm were already prepared to welcome the fifth Firmament demon monarch team.
After attaining a seventh-level Essence Soul, Meng Chuan could form up to nine Essence Soul avatars. Since one avatar was cultivating in the outer realm’s Black Dragon Planet, he couldn’t split the last Essence Soul avatar. Therefore, there were only eight Essence Soul avatars in Archean Eon realm.
The Demon Realm.
Imperial Lord Starquix, Lady Blackmoon, and Emperor Roc sat in the hall, watching the projected scenes in midair solemnly.
One scene depicted a yellow-furred demon monarch charging into the World Gap with an axe. The other scene depicted a demon monarch with a scaled tail tearing a hole open and entering the World Gap.
“Demon Sage Hanlie and Demon Sage Black Bone have successfully entered the World Gap.” Lady Blackmoon revealed a look of delight.
“It’s also within our expectations,” said Imperial Lord Starquix with a smile. “Last time, we also sent two demon sages to act simultaneously. The humans only managed to intercept one. They likely used a Void Transference Talisman. This time... the humans no longer have any Void Transference Talismans. Since they are tens of thousands of kilometers, they can only watch as these two demon sage possessors attack the world membranes and enter the World Gap.”
Emperor Roc nodded slightly. “We can’t celebrate too early. We have to be careful of humans intercepting us in the World Gap.”
“Don’t worry. Two demon sage possessors have entered the World Gap. Even if one dies, there’s still another,” said Imperial Lord Starquix with a smile. “This time, our chances of victory are very high.”
“Didn’t that King Eastcalm enter the outer realm?” said Lady Blackmoon. “He should have reached the Supremacy realm. It’ll be very difficult for the humans to send powerful Regis Godfiends into the World Gap to intercept our demon monarch team.”
“King True Martial is dead. King Eastcalm has become a Supremacy. The humans can’t stop us in the World Gap anymore.” Imperial Lord Starquix was confident.
Emperor Roc nodded slightly as he watched the scenes in midair.
For the past ten years, he had been cultivating his body. After reaching the perfected Heaven Earth realm, one could trigger a Heavenly Tribulation and undergo a Physical Body Tribulation once their body reached perfection. If one transcended the tribulation, they would become a Physical Body Tribulation Eminence.
The Demon Realm had a long history. Archean Eon Realm was much younger.
As one of Three Bay River System’s top ten inhabited worlds, the Demon Realm had produced more than ten Fifth and Sixth Tribulation Eminences altogether. At any point in time, there would usually be several Imperial Lords. Every few generations of Imperial Lords, a Tribulation Eminence would rise in the Demon Realm. In the Demon Realm’s long history, many Tribulation Eminences were naturally born. However, they had all died as time passed heartlessly.
Although this was the case, generations of demon ancestors had perfected the demon monarch cultivation system. This was especially true when a demon Imperial Lord reached the Tribulation realm with a perfected body.
I estimate that it will take me several years, at most a few decades, before I can reach the Tribulation realm. Emperor Roc’s confidence grew. Once I reach the Tribulation realm, I will need Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures even more.
Although he would have access to more of the Demon Ancestral Cave’s treasures after becoming a Tribulation Eminence and would be bestowed with gifts from his demon ancestors, they were ultimately inferior to Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures.
All the demon ancestors combined couldn’t compare to Ancestral Master Archean Eon! Emperor Roc and company knew very well that Archean Eon Realm had a short history. If the humans were allowed to develop for hundreds of millions of years and utilize the treasures and ultimate techniques left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon, they would definitely be much stronger than they were now.
We have to rob Archean Eon Realm of Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures while the humans are still weak. Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures will benefit our Demon Realm greatly. Emperor Roc looked forward to it.
Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon continued staring at the scenes in midair.
The three of them watched solemnly.
Once they succeeded...
Even if Emperor Roc took the largest share, they would still be satisfied by their smaller shares.
“The humans aren’t intercepting?”
“No human teams were discovered?”
The three Imperial Lords continued watching carefully.
One day, two days, three days...
In the blink of an eye, five days passed.
Demon Sage Hanlie and Demon Sage Black Bone led the demon monarch team. Although they were anxious, they continued drawing the map of connection points.
“We completed the map?”
The two demon sage possessors rendezvoused with the other demon monarchs. They were shocked and delighted. The first half of the plan had been too easy.

chapters.title: Chapter 515 - Wipeout
chapters.content:
Chapter 515 Wipeout
“The connection point map was successfully drawn?” The three demon Imperial Lords in the hall felt that everything was going too smoothly.
No humans stopped the demon monarchs as they wandered the World Gap.
“Could there be a special reason?” Imperial Lord Starquix couldn’t help but say, “It went too smoothly.”
Lady Blackmoon pondered for a moment before saying, “The humans might be out of options. Just as we said before, King True Martial is dead. King Eastcalm has become a Supremacy. Humanity can’t defeat us in the World Gap. Instead of sending Regis Godfiends to their deaths, they might as well give up! There are ultimately fewer human experts than demon experts. They have to treasure every single one of them.”
Emperor Roc nodded as well. “We have reached a critical juncture. We have to attack the human world!”
Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon nodded.
At this moment, the demons couldn’t stop! They had paid too much for this day.
“Just like what Blackmoon said, it’s much harder for humans to produce experts than us demons,” said Emperor Roc. “The humans made a wise choice by giving up this time. However, they are definitely prepared for the battle in the human world!”
“Yes, they have to guard the human world,” said Imperial Lord Starquix. “The riskier the situation is, the more we can’t be careless.”
Emperor Roc nodded. “According to our original plan, the fifth Firmament demon monarch team will be split into five! They will attack five of Archean Eon Realm’s connection points. They are all at the periphery of Archean Eon Realm. Each connection point is tens of thousands of kilometers from land! Even if the humans have guessed that we will charge in from the seas, there are too many connection points. There’s no way for them to guard all of the connection points.”
Imperial Lord Starquix nodded as well. “Even if they manage to intercept one team, we will definitely emerge victorious as long as the other four teams hide after entering the human world.”
“There’s no pattern. It’s impossible for the demon monarchs to expose which connection points they are going through at the last minute.” Lady Blackmoon nodded as well. “If they are intercepted like this, it means that humanity has the strength to protect all the connection points in the human world... However, that’s impossible.”
The three Imperial Lords watched with anticipation as they waited.
In the World Gap.
“Everyone, good luck.”
“As long as we succeed in forcing humanity to submit, we will rise to prominence.”
“If the humans don’t submit, we will kill them. We will kill as many humans as we can until they bow their heads in fear.”
The demon monarchs were nervous and excited. This was their plan’s most critical juncture. As long as they succeeded, they would obtain 100 times more treasures they would usually receive. This was a promise made by the three Imperial Lords. After obtaining Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures, the three Imperial Lords would be able to make all the demon monarchs extremely wealthy.
The fifth Firmament demon monarchs were split into five teams.
“This is the connection point map. Your team will enter from the southeast sea. As for which connection point you should go through, it’s up to you. You’ll have to decide on the spot.” Demon Sage Hanlie handed the connection point map to a mountain demon. “Alright.” The mountain demon took the map and quickly left with his team.
Every team chose a connection point at the last minute.
This lowered the possibility of snitching.
Cities, mountains, snowlands, deserts, forests...
Meng Chuan’s eight Essence Soul avatars waited in different areas around the world.
They had completely abandoned the plan of intercepting the demons in the World Gap. This was because humanity’s Regis Godfiends were much weaker than before! Although his son, Meng An, had risen to prominence, he still wasn’t as strong as Meng Chuan and King True Martial back then. Meng An might not even be able to defeat Holy Lady Strings. Holy Lady Strings might have also improved after all these years.
Furthermore, the demons had sent hundreds of fifth Firmament demon monarchs into the World Gap. Over the past few years, many powerful demon monarchs had risen. Their combined combat strength was astonishing when they moved in a formation.
However, would the demons really just give up on entering the human world if the humans didn’t stop them in the World Gap? Were the demons willing to give up when the situation no longer allowed them to? Even if the Demon Realm was greatly weakened, the three Imperial Lords still wouldn’t give up. Meng Chuan knew this very well.
His eight Essence Soul avatars waited silently, ready to attack at any moment.
In the World Gap.
King Calm Sea hid far away as he watched a demon monarch team fly into the distance. His expression turned solemn.
Back when Archean Mountain punished him, he was ordered to patrol the World Gap for 300 years.
What’s going on with Archean Mountain? They completely gave up on intercepting the demons and allowed the demons to roam the World Gap freely. King Calm Sea’s expression was gloomy. Forget it. I’ve already told them everything that needs to be said. Archean Mountain will make the final decision.
The five demon monarch team leaders each chose a different connection point on the map.
Holy Lady Strings was leading a demon monarch team.
Among the fifth Firmament demon monarchs, Holy Lady Strings was the strongest! As for Monarch Peacock? He had already disappeared for a long time.
“Our team is entering from the North Sea.” Holy Lady Strings’s expression was cold as she looked at the 37 demon monarchs around her. She said, “In a while, work together with the four other teams. After I blast open a passageway in the world membranes, you will all immediately enter the human world.”
“Understood.”
“Holy Lady Strings, don’t worry. We understand.”
“Once we enter, we will immediately split up and hide.”
These demon monarchs knew how to hide from human Supremacies.
Holy Lady Strings nodded slightly.
Hum.
Holy Lady Strings looked at the token in her hand, and her eyes lit up slightly.
Boom! With a wave of her hand, numerous threads condensed into a white beam that sliced through a connection point in the void. This was one of the labeled connection points on the map.
Boom!
In just one strike, the world membrane shattered.
After another strike, the two world membranes were completely penetrated, revealing a huge hole. One could see the dark sky and the vast sea with the naked eye. “Go in.”
“Go!”
The demon monarchs howled as they quickly charged through the huge hole and entered the human world.
Holy Lady Strings silently watched this scene. She didn’t enter because she wouldn’t make much of a difference in threatening the hundred-plus human cities. In the human world, she wasn’t invincible either. Qin Wu, Li Guan, and Bai Yaoyue could easily kill her. Meng Chuan-who had become a Supremacycould likely kill her easily as well.
Her most important cultivation goal was to regain her youth. After Monarch Peacock had disappeared, the three Imperial Lords needed Holy Lady Strings to maintain control over the World Gap.
“Go in.”
“Go in.”
The demon monarchs charged into the world membrane opening.
The demons moved at the same time, blasting the five connection points from the World Gap. The five connection points were located at the periphery of the Four Seas. They were all over 15,000 kilometers apart from each other. They were also more than 10,000 kilometers away from land.
They had chosen to enter the human world in a remote place. After completing the connection point map, the demons could choose to enter the connection points that were most difficult to defend.
How many human Supremacies were there?
Currently, there were a total of six super-large city passes in the human world. Also, just how many Supremacies could ambush and intercept the demon monarch teams? They were so far away, so how could the humans arrive in time? Even if Meng Chuan—who was extremely fast
-attempted to intercept them, he would still take about 18 seconds to reach the remote areas in the Four Seas. Although he could reach any spot on land within nine seconds, the demons would have long fled and hidden by the time he arrived.
Huh? Meng Chuan’s eight Essence Soul avatars —which were all at different areas in Archean Eon Realm-raised their heads simultaneously. At his realm, he could clearly see the world membrane passageways. They’ve split into five teams, which will then act together? Meng Chuan’s eight Essence Soul avatars smiled. It’s only five teams.
Five Essence Soul avatars moved and instantly vanished.
The demons had only split into five teams because they had to break through two world membranes in a short time. To do this, one had to be extremely strong. If they were too scattered, they would break through the world membranes very slowly, which would give the humans more time to prepare.
m
“Human world.”
“We’re here.”
“Hahaha.”
A large group of fifth Firmament demon monarchs charged out of the five world membrane passageways—which were all located in different areas around Archean Eon Realm.
When they rushed in, one of Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars was already waiting at each location. However, his Essence Soul avatars were hiding in the deep void. After creating the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique and improving it, Meng Chuan’s attainments in the void lineage were too high. Not to mention these demon monarchs, even Holy Lady Strings and Monarch Peacock wouldn’t have been able to sense Meng Chuan when they arrived.
Meng Chuan looked at the group of fifth Firmament demon monarchs.
“Go!”
“Split up.” “Let’s hide first.” The fifth Firmament demon monarchs were very decisive. They separated after entering the human world.
“You won’t be able to escape,” said Meng Chuan softly as he watched them from the deep void.
Buzz
His Essence Soul Star’s Astral Wave spread in all directions.
With Meng Chuan at the center, the Astral Wave swept across his surrounding 50 kilometers.
Even Peacock and Strings have never experienced a seventh-level Essence Soul’s Astral Wave. Meng Chuan remained extremely calm as he watched the 38 demon monarchs around him lose consciousness; they weren’t able to resist the Astral Wave at all. All of them collapsed to the ground.
Such a powerful mystic technique could even affect Imperial Lords, much less fifth Firmament demon monarchs.
Whoosh.
When these demon monarchs lost consciousness, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar appeared. These demon monarchs didn’t even know who had attacked them when they lost consciousness.
The same thing happened outside all of the other world membrane passageways in the world.
Five of Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars stood outside the openings. A large number of unconscious fifth Firmament demon monarchs floated around each Essence Soul avatar. Demon Sage Hanlie and Demon Sage Black Bone—who were demon sage possessors-had been leading two teams. They had also lost consciousness.
I’ve captured a total of 193 demon monarchs. Meng Chuan’s five Essence Soul avatars looked at the surrounding demon monarchs. All of them are captured alive!

chapters.title: Chapter 516 - Time (Final Chapter of Volume)
chapters.content:
Chapter 516 Time (Final Chapter of Volume)
On a lone island in the North Sea, Demon Sage North Sense and a golden-armored envoy stood side by side. They stared at the black mirror floating in front of them, which reflected what was happening in the five regions.
They saw events play out similarly in all five regions.
Outside the world membrane passageway, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar stood in midair. A group of unconscious demon monarchs floated around him.
“What?” The golden-armored envoy’s heart turned cold.
“How did this happen?” No matter how calm North Sense usually was, he was still somewhat dazed.
The demons had planned this for years. So far, they had executed the plan perfectly. A total of 193 fifth Firmament demon monarchs entered the human world through five different connection points-each was at the periphery of the human world’s Four Seas!
Logically speaking, it was rather unlikely for humans to intercept the demon monarch teams successfully. However, in reality, all the demon monarch teams had been simultaneously wiped out by a single human Godfiend.
Meng Chuan. North Sense looked at the dark figures in the five projections. “He has at least five avatars?”
Suddenly, the five Essence Soul avatars turned to look at the black mirror.
Not good. North Sense and the golden-armored envoy’s expressions changed slightly.
Whoosh.
Following that, they looked up and saw a dark Essence Soul avatar arrive at the lone island. It was standing in front of them.
He’s already here. North Sense and the golden-armored envoy knew that things had gone south.
“Demon Sage North Sense is good at avatars and embodiments.” Meng Chuan swept his gaze across the area. “There’s also a puppet that has an Imperial Lord’s thoughts attached to it. I really made a wasted trip.” As soon as he finished speaking
North Sense’s avatar and the golden-armored envoy were instantly reduced to dust.
I only obtained an Imperial Lord-level treasure. Meng Chuan reached out and grabbed the black mirror. With a step, he vanished.
With Meng Chuan’s current cultivation realm and Heaven Earth realm ultimate techniqueCloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique-be they human or demon, Meng Chuan could sense everything and everybody that was spying on him through the void!
He could even locate the person spying on him by tracing their tracks in the void. The other people that were spying on him were all from human factions. He had only discovered the people on North Sense and the golden-armored envoy on this lone island because they were spying on him.
Of course, the humans spying on Meng Chuan were also dumbfounded by what they saw.
Black Sand Grotto-Heaven and Two World Island’s Supremacies, as well as the Demon Annihilation Guild Master— Jing Fei—were shocked. They were shocked at how Meng Chuan’s five Essence Soul avatars had easily captured all the invading demon monarchs.
It’s no wonder Archean Mountain had such confidence.
Five Essence Soul avatars. Meng Chuan has a seventh-level Essence Soul at the very least.
Furthermore, I suspect that he has already become an Imperial Lord.
The Supremacies were completely stunned by Meng Chuan’s show of might.
...
The Demon Realm.
In the hall, Imperial Lord Starquix, Lady Blackmoon, and Emperor Roc were silent.
The three Imperial Lords didn’t say a word. They remained silent for ten minutes.
In this deathly silence, many thoughts surfaced in their minds, causing their hearts to turn cold.
Their plans had gone up in smoke. This meant that they would never be able to fulfill their wild dreams! This loss affected their mental states.
They had planned for 900 years! They saw success at hand, but they only ended up failing!
“How did this happen?” asked Lady Blackmoon softly.
Emperor Roc was the most mentally stable. He said indifferently, “The day I saw Meng Chuan charge into the outer realm and escape through the spacetime turbulence, I knew that something was amiss. Back then, I made up my mind to attack Archean Eon Realm again within ten years. I never expected Meng Chuan’s growth to be faster than I expected.”
“It’s been 900 years.” Imperial Lord Starquix said in a low voice, “We’ve been attacking the human world for 900 years. We were almost at the finishing line, but this Meng Chuan suddenly appeared and destroyed our efforts!” “After all, it’s a Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s homeworld,” said Emperor Roc indifferently. “How can a Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s treasure be obtained so easily? Even if Meng Chuan didn’t exist, other things might obstruct us. Therefore, I’ve always wanted to force the humans into submission.”
“Then what should we do now?” asked Imperial Lord Starquix. “Meng Chuan has revealed at least six Essence Soul avatars. He clearly has a seventh-level Essence Soul! Furthermore, his attainments in the void lineage might have reached the Heaven Earth realm.”
“He should have reached the Heaven Earth realm,” said Emperor Roc. “He has definitely reached the Heaven Earth realm if he can silently appear anywhere in Archean Eon Realm within an instant. After all, we already knew he was good at controlling the time flow. To achieve this feat, he’s just pairing that ability with his attainments in the void lineage now.”
“Heaven Earth realm, seventh-level Essence Soul. Has he become an Imperial Lord?” asked Lady Blackmoon.
“Even if we do consider him as one, he’s only a newly-advanced Imperial Lord. He’s just an early-stage Imperial Lord,” said Emperor Roc coldly. “A newly-advanced Imperial Lord can forget about making me give up completely.” Lady Blackmoon and Imperial Lord Starquix looked at Emperor Roc.
“We have to wait,” continued Emperor Roc indifferently. “We have to wait until I reach the Tribulation realm. I’ll be able to obtain more treasures from Demon Ancestral Cave then. We also have to wait until a demon sage passageway appears.”
“You plan on doing it?” Imperial Lord Blackmoon and Imperial Lord Starquix immediately guessed Emperor Roc’s intentions.
“I heard that Ancestral Master Archean Eon has extremely high standards. He doesn’t think much of the various special lifeforms’ bloodlines. He only refined the dragon and phoenix bloodlines and passed them down to the human race.” Emperor Roc sneered. “As for us demons, we have never produced a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. However, we have given birth to many Fifth and Sixth Tribulation Eminences. We demons have all sorts of special bloodlines.
“I’d like to see if the human Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s means are more powerful or if our many demon ancestors’ means are stronger.” Emperor Roc’s eyes were filled with madness. He naturally wouldn’t stop trying to obtain Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures.
After all, they had the right to covet the human world’s riches. Archean Eon Realm and the Demon Realm were in close proximity to each other. They wouldn’t give up such an opportunity as long as there was a sliver of hope.
Emperor Roc stood up. “I’ll enter seclusion.”
“What about the demon monarchs lurking in the human world?” asked Imperial Lord Starquix. “You can deal with them as you wish,” echoed Emperor Roc’s indifferent voice as he vanished.
Archean Mountain, Grotto-Heaven.
The demon monarchs had been piled up into a small mountain in a square. After they regained consciousness, they discovered that they had been piled up.
What happened?
What happened to us? The demon monarchs wanted to struggle, but they realized that their Essence Souls, demonic powers, and bodies had been sealed. They couldn’t move their bodies; they could only allow themselves to be piled up like a mountain. Their eyes were extraordinary. They could see what was happening in front of them with their naked eyes. It was rather strange. Although some demon monarchs were buried deep within the pile, they could still see four figures,Meng Chuan, Li Guan, an illusory Qin Wu, and an illusory Luo Tang-standing in front of them.
“Demon monarchs,” said Meng Chuan, “only by submitting to us humans will all 193 of you have a chance of survival.”
“Demon Sage Hanlie is the only one with a sixth-level Essence Soul among you. It’s too troublesome to control its Essence Soul, so it doesn’t have the right to submit.” Meng Chuan waved his hand, and Demon Sage Hanlie flew out from the demon monarch pile. His eyes were filled with shock and anger. At that moment, a Guardian flew out and grabbed Demon Sage Hanlie.
“Imprison Demon Sage Hanlie. A demon sage possessor still has many uses,” said Meng Chuan. His voice made the demon monarchs’ hearts palpitate.
What could they be used for if they didn’t submit? At that moment, the demon monarchs thought of many terrifying scenes. Some of these scenes were things that they had witnessed or heard about in the Demon Realm.
“As for the rest of you...” Meng Chuan said indifferently, “Although I have a seventh-level Essence Soul, I can only control 30 fifth-level Essence Souls. Among you, there are 35 fifth-level Essence Souls, 96 fourth-level Essence Souls, and 61 third-level Essence Souls. Therefore, I can only control a portion of you. Only a portion of you can submit. There’s nothing else I can do for the rest. If a demon monarch’s Essence Soul isn’t controlled, we humans will not allow that fifth Firmament demon monarch to roam the human world freely.
“If you aren’t willing to submit, us humans will also put you to use. However, you will suffer fates more painful than death,” said Meng Chuan. “Those who are willing to submit can speak now. I’ll give the order priority consideration.”
The sealed demon monarchs suddenly realized that their mouths could move.
The 192 demon monarchs—who had piled up into a small mountain- fell silent.
Suddenly, a hoarse voice rang out. “I’m willing to submit.”
The expressions of many demon monarchs changed.
“I’m willing to submit.”
“I’m willing.”
The law of the jungle made the demons more accustomed to submitting. As the first demon monarch willingly submitted, nearly half of the demon monarchs took the initiative to speak.
Meng Chuan, Li Guan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang watched this scene happily. After so many years, they felt like they had gained the upper hand in the war.
The war between the humans and demons had entered a new stage.
The demons had no way of threatening humanity. However, the World Entrances in the human world slowly expanded as time passed. World Entrances also increased in number. The number of super-large city passes also increased. From six to seven, and even eight...
However, Meng Chuan—who was suspected to be an Imperial Lord-had a seventh-level Essence Soul. The demons could only carefully probe and wait.
They waited for the day a demon sage passageway appeared.
As for Meng Chuan’s true body in the outer realm, it was still cultivating on Black Dragon Planet.
In the blink of an eye, 28 years had passed since his Essence Soul avatars captured the 193 fifth Firmament demon monarchs.
Final Chapter of Volume-Outer Realm Rookie

chapters.title: Chapter 517 - Shadow
chapters.content:
Chapter 517 Shadow
Black Dragon Planet.
The black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan walked through the city and looked at the buildings with familiarity. Black Dragon City was still as prosperous as before. Many cultivators from Heaven Peak River System gathered here, closing a large number of transactions every day.
It’s been 32 years since I came to Black Dragon Planet. Although 32 years seemed short, he spent most of his time cultivating in Myriad Flower Realm. He had actually been cultivating for much longer than 32 years due to the time dilation.
Because of Myriad Flower Realm, I’ve actually been on Black Dragon Planet for more than 310 years. Meng Chuan sighed. He had cultivated in his homeworld for over a century and had been cultivating on Black Dragon Planet since he came to the outer realm. If he hadn’t obtained Senior Pang Ming’s treasures, he wouldn’t have been able to cultivate on Black Dragon Planet so freely.
On Black Dragon Planet, he had the best cultivation conditions. In the past few years, he had participated in many Treasure Auctions and visited many merchants. He also bought treasures once again. Firstly, he wanted to increase his strength. Secondly, it was for his cultivation.
In terms of strength and treasures, he was in a better state than when he first came to Black Dragon Planet. Even his mental state had changed greatly. After cultivating alone for more than 300 years, Meng Chuan experienced the magical power of time. As time passed, he became more patient. He wasn’t arrogant or rash. Creating an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique is really difficult. Meng Chuan frowned slightly. He had cultivated for more than 310 years on Black Dragon Planet. In fact, during the 39th year of cultivation, his paramount technique, Infinite Saber, had reached the Grotto-Heaven realm’s late stage. During the 83rd year of cultivation, Infinite Saber had reached the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm. It had reached the limits of a Supremacy-level paramount technique. In terms of profundity and strength, it was only slightly inferior to ordinary techniques at the perfected Heaven Earth realm.
With just Infinite Saber, Meng Chuan could unleash the strength of a late-stage Imperial Lord. With the special characteristics his body had gained after devouring the Primordial Stone, he could fight a perfected Imperial Lord. It was naturally easy for him to kill ordinary Imperial
Lords.
This was also the combat strength of the vast outer realm’s strongest Supremacies.
However, his Infinite Saber had encountered a bottleneck.
During the 205th year of cultivation, Meng Chuan had created one Imperial Lord-level move for his Infinite Saber. After executing it, he realized that this move was only several times stronger than his perfected Grotto-Heaven realm Infinite Saber Art.
He quickly realized that this saber move didn’t have the strength of an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique. He knew that it would only be an ultimate technique as strong as Lightning Fire Body Tempering Art and Dark Lightning. It was different from a true Imperial Lord-level paramount technique.
Thus, Meng Chuan gave up on cultivating that direction.
Up until now...
Meng Chuan had deduced three different directions his Infinite Saber Art could improve in. These three different directions resulted in three saber moves. The strongest saber move was only 80% stronger than his Infinite Saber, which was at the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm.
A Supremacy-level paramount technique has to change qualitatively if it is to become an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique. If one is to say that a Supremacy-level paramount technique is slightly inferior to an ordinary perfected Heaven Earth realm ultimate technique, then an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique should grant one strength far greater than a perfected Imperial Lord. Upon creation, it should enable one to fight a Tribulation Eminence.
Meng Chuan knew this very well. Once one reaches the perfected Imperial Lord realm, they will have the strength of a Fifth Tribulation Eminence. They would be comparable to an adult pure-blooded dragon or phoenix.
Thus far, his saber moves had far inferior strength to what an actual Imperial Lord-level paramount technique should have.
Meng Chuan found creating an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique very difficult.
It’s just too difficult. Every single future path I’ve deduced for Infinite Saber is very outstanding and perfect in my opinion, but the saber moves are only 80% stronger. That means that these paths are clearly not the right one.
Meng Chuan couldn’t accurately determine if his saber moves were paramount techniques or not with his present knowledge, but their strength couldn’t be faked! His created saber moves simply weren’t enough to match a Tribulation Eminence, so they definitely weren’t Imperial Lord-level paramount techniques.
The creators of Imperial Lord-level paramount techniques were much rarer than pure-blooded dragons and phoenixes. Meng Chuan knew that this path would be very difficult. However, he had patience.
Even if a demon sage World Entrance between the Demon Realm and Archean Eon Realm forms, I still have confidence in guarding it. With my Infinite Saber and Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique, I have the confidence to deal with all the demon sages combined.
His Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique had improved greatly over the years.
After obtaining Selfless Formless Sword’s manual, his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique had reached the Heaven Earth realm in the 23rd year of cultivation.
In the 96th year, his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique reached the Heaven Earth realm’s middle stage.
In the 205th year, his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique reached the Heaven Earth realm’s late stage. Among Imperial Lords, this improvement speed was considered at the genius level. A normal Imperial Lord’s cultivation speed would be similar to that of Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon. Meng Chuan had already finished comprehending Selfless Formless Sword’s five paintings. Although he had fully comprehended them, Selfless Formless Sword was still an ultimate technique created by Senior Huang Yong. Although he fully comprehended all the paintings, he still fell slightly short of a perfected Heaven Earth realm expert. Only the ultimate technique’s creator could unleash its full strength. Furthermore, he had high aspirations for his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique. Thus, it was even harder for it to reach the perfected Heaven Earth realm than his Selfless Formless Sword.
Although there were many Imperial Lords in the outer realm, very few reached the perfected Heaven Earth realm. The improvement speed of his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique had slowed down.
