A thousand years. I’ll set a time limit of 1,000 years for myself! If I can’t create an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique after cultivating for 1,000 years, I’ll give up.
Cultivation also required self-awareness. If he couldn’t create an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique for a long time, it would be foolish of him to continue slamming his head into the wall.
One thousand years was long enough! If he couldn’t create an Imperial Lord-level technique after such a long time, then it would mean that he was highly unlikely to create one, even if he was given several-fold more time. Either way, didn’t experts like Ancestral Master Archean Eon—who hadn’t even created Supremacy-level paramount techniques-still become Seventh Tribulation Eminences all the same?
Of course, if Meng Chuan did create an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique, he would immediately rise to prominence.
I’ve studied the Lightning Dwarf Star and the Seventh Tribulation Dark Peacock’s secrets. I’ve also studied Three World Saber for a long time. I’ve vaguely deduced my future path, but how should I improve Infinite Saber? How should I combine the lightning lineage’s profundities and reach the Imperial Lord realm? Meng Chuan pondered as he walked.
A paramount technique represented supremacy and perfection. A paramount technique’s strength was worlds apart from that of an ultimate technique because of a slight difference.
What is that difference?
At that same moment, on the peak of a 1,500-kilometer-tall mountain outside Black Dragon City.
Patriarch Black Dragon looked down at the bustling Black Dragon City in the distance with a complicated look in his eyes. After a long while, he stared out into the outer realm, through the stellar array formation. He could sense evil and terrifying forces lingering at the array formation’s periphery.
A silver-haired woman and five other figures stood behind him respectfully. They were Patriarch Black Dragon’s followers.
“That bunch of lunatics from Black Fiend Hall have already arrived. There are three Fifth Tribulation Eminences,” said Patriarch Black Dragon slowly. “They are targeting Black Dragon Planet.”
“Patriarch, what should we do?” asked the silver-haired woman, Cang Yu. “They must have deduced that I’m rapidly approaching death. That’s why they came to create the blockade,” said Patriarch Black Dragon indifferently. “Don’t worry. Those bunch of lunatics from Black Fiend Hall are targeting the cultivators on Black Dragon Planet. About 20-30% of Heaven Peak River System’s cultivators are gathered here. There’s an astonishing number of treasures here. They want to sweep this place clean, but they won’t be willing to risk their lives fighting me. I can protect the few of you.”
The followers exchanged looks.
A man asked, “Patriarch, why didn’t you tell some factions on Black Dragon Planet about Black Fiend Hall in advance and have them leave early?”
“Once the news spreads, it will spread like wildfire,” said Patriarch Black Dragon indifferently. “Black Fiend Hall has long been secretly monitoring Black Dragon Planet’s surroundings. Once a top faction flees, Black Fiend Hall will immediately launch an attack ahead of schedule. When that happens, the remaining cultivators will find it even harder to escape. “Right now, I only hope that as many cultivators can survive as possible.” Patriarch Black Dragon looked at his followers. “When I see them, I see my younger self—who had carefully cultivated just to survive.”
“Patriarch, Black Fiend Hall has already targeted them. How can they let them live?” asked the silver-haired woman.
“According to my plan, no matter how strong or weak these cultivators are, 80% of them should survive,” said Patriarch Black Dragon calmly. “I can’t care about anything else. Everything depends on fate. What I can do is ultimately limited.”
“Black Fiend Hall wants to sweep this place clean, but 80% of the cultivators here can escape? They will probably be furious,” said an ugly servant.
“I gave them free rein to eat, who can they blame if they fail to eat them all?” Patriarch Black Dragon sneered. “If they want to fight? Well, I’m a dying old man. Why would I be afraid of them?”
Meng Chuan walked around the city and returned to his cave abode. A puppet attendant came to visit him.
“Supremacy.” The puppet attendant stepped forward and said rather politely, “Black Dragon Planet will be completely shut down today. We would like to thank all cultivators for their patronage. Supremacy, you will have to leave Black Dragon Planet by today. Since we require you to leave in advance, we will refund half an Outer Realm Essence Crystal.” Looking at the halved Outer Realm Essence Crystal, Meng Chuan and Supremacy Qing Gu’s expressions changed slightly. Black Dragon Planet is closing? I have to leave the planet by today? Meng Chuan immediately realized that something was amiss.

chapters.title: Chapter 518 - Black Fiend Hall
chapters.content:
Chapter 518 Black Fiend Hall
“All cultivators have to leave by today?” asked Meng Chuan as he received the halved Outer Realm Essence Crystal. “Yes.” The puppet attendant nodded. “All cultivators on Black Dragon Planet have to leave. When night falls, Black Dragon Planet will expel all the cultivators who haven’t left.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly and watched the puppet attendant leave. “Pack up. Let’s quickly leave,” instructed Meng Chuan.
“Yes,” said Supremacy Qing Gu with a nod.
Meng Chuan and Supremacy Qing Gu came to the streets and saw many cultivators walking towards the city gates. Most of them looked uneasy.
“What is the patriarch doing by expelling all the cultivators?” “Black Dragon Planet wants to destroy its own foundation?”
“Patriarch’s reputation is still very good since he’s returned the Essence Crystal fees for the rental. There must be a special reason this time.”
The cultivators were panicking and discussing silently. Most of them didn’t know the reason why Patriarch Black Dragon was asking everybody to leave. Meng Chuan and Supremacy Qing Gu followed the crowd of cultivators and walked out together.
“Patriarch.” At the foot of the towering mountain outside the city, three figures stood respectfully. The leader was a golden-haired man with a carapace on his back. He said loudly, “Please save
us.”
The towering mountain was silent. The three figures exchanged looks, becoming even more anxious. The golden-haired man said loudly, “Patriarch, our Essence Water Manor has been on Black Dragon Planet for over 10,000 years. We have been doing business here for so many years. Please, on account of our friendship over the years and our Manor Lord, save us.”
After a long while, the towering mountain still didn’t react.
“Black Dragon.” A blurry figure appeared. It was a handsome and elegant man.
“Brother Essence Water.” Patriarch Black Dragon’s blurry figure appeared as well. With his status as a Fifth Tribulation Eminence, he couldn’t be bothered with the Imperial Lords’ pleas. However, he still had to meet Manor Lord Essence Water personally.
“You sure hid the news well,” said the handsome man with a chuckle. “We only learned of it today.”
“I’m sorry,” said Patriarch Black Dragon casually. An old man who was about to die was more carefree in his actions.
Manor Lord Essence Water said, “Black Dragon Planet has many Imperial Lords and Supremacies. Black Fiend Hall has probably done the investigations. I know you can’t protect too much.”
Patriarch Black Dragon nodded. “Brother Essence Water, it’s good that you understand my difficulties.”
“Can you help me protect Imperial Lord Lin Xu?” asked Essence Water. “After this matter is over, I’ll personally receive Lin Xu. Just protecting an Imperial Lord shouldn’t have much of an impact on you. Of course, Lin Xu will also offer you 100 Outer Realm Essence Crystals.”
Patriarch Black Dragon smiled. “Aren’t you afraid that I will kill Lin Xu and snatch all his treasures?”
“I trust you,” said Essence Water.
“I don’t care about karma now,” said Patriarch Black Dragon with a chuckle. “If you are fine with it, just let Imperial Lord Lin Xu come up the mountain. Three years later, come to Black Dragon Planet and receive Lin Xu. I’ll stay on Black Dragon Planet for a few more years.”
Essence Water nodded. “Alright.”
Soon, the three Imperial Lords split the items they had. Imperial Lord Lin Xu brought treasures worth a total of 1,300 Outer Realm Essence Crystals and went up the mountain to seek refuge with Patriarch Black Dragon.
The other two Imperial Lords brought 1,200 cubes worth of treasures, hoping to try their luck and escape. Manor Lord Essence Water clearly didn’t trust Patriarch Black Dragon completely. He split Essence Water Manor’s treasureswhich were on Black Dragon Planetinto two portions and moved them away.
The Imperial Lords’ lives weren’t too important because they had another true body in their homeworld! No, they didn’t want to die because they wanted to protect the treasures on them. Apart from their own treasures, Essence Water Manor’s three Imperial Lords also carried Essence Water Manor’s treasures. They belonged to Manor Lord Essence Water.
“Patriarch.”
“Patriarch, save us.” Many Imperial Lords and even two Tribulation Eminences came to beg Patriarch Black Dragon. However, Patriarch Black Dragon didn’t care about them. If he protected too many... Black Fiend Hall would wage a full-out war with him. Although Black Fiend Hall didn’t wish to risk their lives to fight a dying old fellow, they were willing to do so if the temptation was large enough.
Meng Chuan left Black Dragon City with the crowd and flew away from Black Dragon Planet.
He flew into the vast void.
The 64 Grand Yang Stars and the 64 Grand Yin Stars—which had been hidden in the shadows—were all emitting light. The Grand Yin Stars was revealed as a result. Extremely cold light and extremely hot light enveloped Black Dragon Planet. Meng Chuan and the other cultivators—who had flown into the void—were also enveloped by the light.
“He wants us to leave, but still uses the Yin-Yang Stellar Array to restrain us. What is he doing?”
“What is the patriarch trying to do by trapping us here?”
Although the cultivators were puzzled, they waited obediently.
Meng Chuan hid in an inconspicuous corner of the void. Supremacy Qing Gu hid in Meng Chuan’s grotto-heaven treasure.
What happened? Meng Chuan speculated about the situation. Due to reading the dossiers left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon, Meng Chuan knew about the different types of danger that lurked in the outer realm.
It was very common for a seemingly prosperous organization to collapse in one fell swoop.
Black Dragon Planet must have encountered some danger. Therefore, Patriarch Black Dragon ordered all the cultivators to leave. Meng Chuan pondered. He even took the initiative to return half an Essence Crystal. Clearly, Patriarch Black Dragon is extremely proud and unwilling to take advantage of others. His decision must have been done with good intentions.
What kind of danger is he facing? Meng Chuan carefully pondered.
In the outer realm, many dangers could cause such a disastrous outcome.
Plundering of life, evil Tribulation Eminences, forces from high-level worlds, and so on could force Patriarch Black Dragon to make such a choice. There were some forbidden existences that even Ancestral Master Archean Eon feared. Of course, it was highly unlikely that such forbidden existences would appear.
Meng Chuan and the other cultivators waited in the void for more than two hours. The number of waiting cultivators had reached over 10,000. Almost all of them were Supremacies; only a small number were Imperial Lords. Meng Chuan couldn’t tell if Tribulation Eminences were hiding in the void.
“Truth be told.” A cold voice sounded in the void as a silver-haired woman appeared. She looked at the cultivators in front of her and said, “Outside the Yin-Yang Stellar Array, Black Fiend Hall is waiting in ambush. Their strength far exceeds yours. They want to occupy Black Dragon Planet and plunder all your treasures.”
Many cultivators were shocked. Most began to panic.
Black Fiend Hall? Meng Chuan was alarmed. That is one of the River of Spacetime’s top forces! It’s comparable to Eternal Tower.
Eternal Tower was a more peaceful organization. Eternal Tower’s Tribulation Eminences were extremely proud beings. They disdained bullying the weak.
Black Fiend Hall was different. Their Tribulation Eminences believed in the law of the jungle. To them, they felt like it was right to enslave or slaughter large numbers of Imperial Lords and Supremacies and snatch all the treasures in their hands.
“They wanted to occupy Black Dragon Planet, but were rejected by the Patriarch,” said the silver-haired woman.
Meng Chuan was shocked. If Patriarch Black Dragon hadn’t refused, they wouldn’t have been able to escape. They would have been wiped out. “The Patriarch’s lifespan is nearing its end,” said the silver-haired woman. “He can protect you for a moment, but he can’t protect you forever. We have only thought of a single solution. The Patriarch will use the Yin-Yang Stellar Array to prevent Black Fiend Hall from entering. Black Fiend Hall will also be unable to spy on what is happening in the array formation’s interior. As for all of you, you have to spread to every corner of the array formation. “Once the Patriarch dispels the array formation, you must flee as quickly as possible. The Yin-Yang Stellar Array is set up by 64 Grand Yin Stars and 64 Grand Yang Stars. It envelops a large area. Even if one travels at light speed, it will take one more than an hour to traverse the area. With such a large area to cover, Black Fiend Hall won’t be able to seal off the area completely within a short period of time. “It’s a large area, and many cultivators will be fleeing frantically. It will be an achievement for Black Fiend Hall if they can intercept 20% of the fleeing cultivators,” said the silver-haired woman. “This method sounds a little silly, but the difference in strength between Black Fiend Hall and you is too great. This is the best way for all of you to survive.
“Everyone, please head to the array formation’s corners. In six hours, the array formation will be dispelled. You have to flee as quickly as possible. By the way, don’t enter the River of Spacetime. A Tribulation Eminence is definitely guarding this particular region in the River of Spacetime. They will capture anyone who enters.”
The silver-haired woman disappeared instantly.
Many cultivators were engaged in heated discussions. This was the first time many of them had heard of Black Fiend Hall.
I have to be careful. Meng Chuan was also very solemn. He still had many of Senior Pang Ming’s treasures. He was unwilling to be captured and have the treasures taken away. Meng Chuan looked around. About 20-30% of Heaven Peak River System’s cultivators were gathered here. Considering the vast area the Yin-Yang Stellar Array covered, nearby cultivators would be at least 50 million kilometers away from each other when they fled. If Black Fiend Hall could catch 20% of them, it would already be a testimony of their strength.
I’m just a Supremacy. It’s very normal for me to hide among these people. The probability of me successfully escaping is very high. Meng Chuan had no intention of fighting Black Fiend Hall head-on. Although Black Fiend Hall’s recruitment requirements were lower than that of Eternal Tower—an official member had to be a Fourth Tribulation Eminence at the very least—the forces they had sent here were definitely very strong. Otherwise, Patriarch Black Dragon wouldn’t be so afraid.

chapters.title: Chapter 519 - The Escape of More Than Ten Thousand Cultivators
chapters.content:
Chapter 519 The Escape of More Than Ten Thousand Cultivators
The Yin-Yang Stellar Array was incredibly vast. Beyond the array, a powerful force hid in the dark void.
In one spot was a massive black ship. The ship was about 15,000 kilometers long, comparable to an ordinary planet. The ship was made of special black materials that emitted a cold aura, causing frost to condense in the surrounding void. Ordinary Imperial Lords would instantly freeze if they approached it. At the black boat’s bow, a black-robed, black-haired man stood with his hands behind his back as he silently stared at the Yin-Yang Stellar Array.
Swoosh.
A bolt of lightning tore through the void and condensed into a short, stocky elder. The elder had a lightning mark between his eyebrows. Lightning swirled around his body-it was terrifying enough to horrify Imperial Lords. The short, stocky elder looked at the black-haired man and said respectfully, “Senior Dong Jing.” “Brother Jiao Zuo, if you were any later, you wouldn’t have made it in time,” said the black-haired man calmly. “How many subordinates did you bring?” “I brought three Tribulation Eminences and 15 Imperial Lords,” said the short, stocky elder respectfully.
Jiao Zuo was also one of Black Fiend Hall’s official members. He was a Fourth Tribulation Eminence that was skilled at the lightning lineage. He was one of the river system’s strongest, but his status was much lower than that of the black-haired man, Dong Jing.
Dong Jing was one of the three Fifth Tribulation Eminences that presided over the hunt.
“Three Tribulation Eminences and 15 Imperial Lords?” The black-haired man pondered for a moment. With a wave of his hand, the frost in the void condensed into a map of the void. He pointed at one of the areas. “You and your subordinates will guard this empty region.”
The short, stocky elder looked at the void map and replied respectfully, “Senior Dong Jing, don’t worry.”
The black-haired man continued, “Patriarch Black Dragon is very stubborn. He is forcefully using the Yin-Yang Stellar Array to protect all the cultivators, allowing all of them to flee to the array formation’s periphery. This array formation is set up by 64 Grand Yang Stars and 64 Grand Yin Stars. It covers too vast an area, so we can’t blockade it completely.”
The short, stocky elder nodded slightly.
Back then, Patriarch Black Dragon had paid a huge price to set up the defensive array formation. He had requested a Tribulation Eminence from Eternal Tower to help him set up this array formation together.
Patriarch Black Dragon would find it difficult to move so many Grand Yang Stars and Grand Yin Stars alone.
“Many will definitely slip through the net. Therefore, we have to capture the big fish,” said the black-haired man. “All you need to do is guard this empty region. Tribulation Eminences will intercept Imperial Lords while Imperial Lords will kill Supremacies. Do you have the confidence to do so?”
“Of course I’m confident.” The short, stocky elder smiled. “I reckon there won’t be many Imperial Lords fleeing towards the region I’m defending. However, there will be many Supremacies. I’m afraid we won’t be able to intercept all of them completely.”
“Just kill as many as Supremacies you can,” said the black-haired man indifferently. “Let fate decide.”
The short, stocky elder nodded. “Yes.”
The black-haired man waved his hand slightly.
Swoosh.
Jiao Zuo transformed into a bolt of lightning and instantly vanished.
Eternal Tower’s Tribulation Eminences are all fools. The black-haired man coldly stared at the Yin-Yang Stellar Array. They can clearly kill a bunch of Imperial Lords with a single breath, but they still have pity in their hearts. They set rules for themselves so that they have to conduct ‘fair trade.’ What a joke. The law of the jungle is the law of survival of all living beings.
He didn’t agree with Eternal Tower from the bottom of his heart.
The juniors in his homeworld trembled when they saw him. He still had intentions of repaying the karma he owed his homeworld, so his attitude towards his juniors was much better. However, he didn’t care about other outer realm cultivators. He slaughtered them without even flinching.
Inside the Yin-Yang Stellar Array, a faint glow could be seen, but it affected one’s visibility.
With Meng Chuan’s eyes, he could only see tens of thousands of kilometers around him.
Whoosh.
He had already flown to the Yin-Yang Stellar Array’s periphery. The array formation formed a barrier, preventing him from leaving.
The Yin-Yang Stellar Array covers a very vast area. More than 100 stars occupy the inner region already. More than 10,000 cultivators will scatter and flee. We’ll all be quite far away from each other. Meng Chuan looked around, but he couldn’t see any other cultivators.
Even if Black Fiend Hall’s spies were hiding inside the array formation, they couldn’t report every cultivator’s exact location. It was also very difficult for Black Fiend Hall to blockade the area completely.
However, I can see the outside world clearly. Through the array formation’s barrier, Meng Chuan could see the void outside.
The outside world was dark. In the distance, he could see stars and worlds with life. However, he failed to discover a single Black Fiend Hall expert. Black Fiend Hall’s experts had clearly hidden, making themselves undiscoverable.
Suddenly
Oh? Meng Chuan saw something.
A nine-story building flew out from the array formation barrier.
It’s Eternal Tower. When Meng Chuan and the other cultivators saw this, they immediately recognized the building as Eternal Tower.
The Eternal Tower flew out of the Yin-Yang Stellar Array. However, it was suddenly restrained by an invisible shackle.
An old man carrying a turtle shell walked out of Eternal Tower and said, “We are under the command of Lord Bloodblessings. This Eternal Tower is filled with cultivators under his command. We didn’t bring any cultivators from Heaven Peak River System with us. Please allow us passage.” Lord Bloodblessings?
I can sense it. He’s not lying.
Forget it. There’s no need to fight Lord Bloodblessings for an Eternal Tower branch in a mere river system. The three commanders of the hunt communicated and made a decision.
If the temptation was high enough, the lunatics from Black Fiend Hall would boldly attack Eternal Tower.
Soon, the Eternal Tower flew away.
Meng Chuan didn’t find it strange at all as he watched this scene from within the array formation. This was only a hunt for weak cultivators. It wasn’t a battle between two top factions–Eternal Tower and Black Fiend Hall.
Even a war between these two top factions’ branches was highly unlikely. In a war between these two top factions’ branches, Sixth Tribulation Eminences would be involved. If a large-scale war between the two factions were to erupt, Seventh Tribulation Eminences like Ancestral Master Archean Eon would get involved. Such a war would shock the entire River of Spacetime.
Supremacies and Imperial Lords were just ordinary people in the outer realm. Tribulation Eminences decide the ownership of all resources and the rules.
Another two hours passed.
Suddenly,
“In 30 seconds, all of you are to flee as fast as you can! Remember, the further you escape, the better. Don’t enter the River of Spacetime.” The familiar female dragon’s voice resounded in the array formation.
Meng Chuan’s heart tightened. Is it time to flee?
The moment 30 seconds had passed, the array formation barrier disappeared without any warning
Go! Meng Chuan instantly transformed into a lightning bolt. The time flow around him changed, and his speed instantly soared as he flew into the distance.
At that moment, over 10,000 cultivators used all sorts of methods as they escaped the array formation frantically.
Although Black Fiend Hall was powerful, it had a limited number of experts. Although they had brought along six official Fourth Tribulation members, they still had lacking manpower.
Escape! Escape! Escape!
Flee!
Among the fleeing cultivators—which numbered more than 10,000—were five Tribulation Eminences and over 200 Imperial Lords. Some of them had quite the backgrounds. However, unless they were backed by a sufficiently powerful existence in the River of Spacetime, it was useless to use their names to beg for mercy from Black Fiend Hall.
Tere
At that moment, they were frantically fleeing for their lives. Although Tribulation Eminences and Imperial Lords had true bodies in their homeworlds, their true bodies in the outer realm also had Tribulation treasures and weapons. Typically, more than half of their wealth was on the true bodies that roamed the outer realm. Thus, they would not give up until the final moment of despair.
Meng Chuan was the same. If he died in battle and lost his Exile Prison, it wouldn’t be easy for him to escape the demons’ pursuit again.
Furthermore, Meng Chuan was unwilling to lose his large number of treasures.
Charge.
Flee!
All of them fled frantically.
Black Fiend Hall had set up hundreds of array formations outside the Yin-Yang Stellar Array, but they could only block less than half of the
area.
At that moment, some cultivators charged out of the Yin-Yang array formation and entered the array formations set up by Black Fiend Hall.
Some didn’t encounter any obstacles.
Almost instantly, battles erupted in many areas outside the Yin-Yang Stellar Array...
Boom!
The moment Meng Chuan rushed out of the Yin-Yang Stellar Array, he discovered dense water droplets appearing in the originally dark void. The water droplets were only a foot away from each other as they surged towards him. The moment Meng Chuan rushed into the array formation, his Chaos Hole domain struck many water droplets. He felt like mountains were pressing down on him.
Not good. I crashed into an array formation. Meng Chuan’s heart tightened. Furthermore, this array formation has greatly suppressed the void. I can’t use the Lesser Void Transference Talisman.
Inside the Yin-Yang Stellar Array, Meng Chuan naturally couldn’t use a Lesser Void Transference Talisman.
However, he never expected to fall into one of Black Fiend Hall’s array formations the moment he rushed out.
Black Fiend Hall’s array formations were set up by Tribulation Eminences. They were anti-escape array formations. Most people wouldn’t be able to escape from such array formations after encountering one.
This array formation was only one of the hundreds of array formations set up by Black Fiend Hall. Although it wasn’t as vast as the Yin-Yang Stellar Array, it was still presided over by one Third Tribulation Eminence and five Imperial Lords. The array formation spanned 65 million kilometers.
“One Imperial Lord and 65 Supremacies were intercepted by the array formation,” said a long-browed elder in charge of the array formation indifferently. “I’ll kill that Imperial Lord. Kill those Supremacies quickly.” “Yes,” replied the five Imperial Lords, who were also presiding over the array formation, immediately.
They needed to kill this group of prey before they continued chasing after other prey. The more they killed, the greater the credit.

chapters.title: Chapter 520 - Escape
chapters.content:
Chapter 520 Escape
Although he was trapped in one of Black Fiend Hall’s array formations, Meng Chuan didn’t panic. This had been within his expectations.
Unlike the near-zero probability of entering a forbidden zone like a Grand Yang Star’s core because of spacetime turbulence, it was highly likely for cultivators to be intercepted by Black Fiend Hall. After all, more than 10,000 cultivators were fleeing, and Black Fiend Hall had prepared for this battle. It was difficult for cultivators to be lucky forever in the outer realm.
Even with my Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique reaching the Heaven Earth realm’s late stage, I can only sense a small portion of this array formation. This array formation is ridiculously large. Meng Chuan analyzed his situation calmly.
In order to intercept as many cultivators as possible, Black Fiend Hall set up many array formations. They tried to cover as wide a range as possible. They would rather sacrifice some strength to capture more cultivators.
This array formation’s offensive power is very weak. It has only two uses-to seal the void and to increase resistance. Meng Chuan glanced at the countless water droplets in the array formation. These water droplets guide the void’s strength, making them extremely heavy.
The seal on the void is very powerful. I can’t even escape with a Lesser Void Transference Talisman. Meng Chuan’s current realm was very high. His Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique—which he created-was considered a very brilliant Imperial Lord-level ultimate technique. Although it was only at the Heaven Earth realm’s late stage, it was only slightly inferior to a normal perfected Heaven Earth realm ultimate technique. At this realm, he could already understand the Lesser Void Transference Talisman’s limits.
I can vaguely sense that array formation’s range is over 50 million kilometers. Meng Chuan pondered. I’ve only discovered the array formation’s periphery on my left. I haven’t explored the other areas yet.
Meng Chuan’s domains had all greatly improved. When he first entered the outer realm, his electromagnetic domain had a 500-kilometer range around him. Now, it could cover 30,000 kilometers around him! If he purely focused on sensing void fluctuations, he would be able to sense fluctuations that were 50 million kilometers away. A perfected Imperial Lord — who focused on the void lineage-would haven’t a perception much stronger than Meng Chuan’s.
Escape to the left. Meng Chuan naturally ran in the direction that brought him closer to the array formation’s periphery. I have to keep a low profile. I can sense many cultivators charging into the array formation. I can’t move too fast. If my speed is too ridiculous, I might attract a Tribulation Eminence’s attention.
Meng Chuan only displayed 10% of his speed as he fled towards the left.
As a cultivator who pursued extreme speedhis Infinite Saber had reached the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm—10% of his normal speed was a normal supremacy’s maximum speed.
The array formation’s range was too large. It had completely abandoned offensive power; instead, it only focused on sealing and increasing resistance. It allowed the ones presiding over the array to fly over and kill the trapped cultivators.
“These Supremacies are slow when trapped in the array formation. They can’t escape even if they want to.” The five Imperial Lords in charge of the array formation were extremely relaxed. They were not met with any obstructions as they traveled through the array formation. They had constantly accelerated until they neared the speed of light. Furthermore, those that were skilled in the time lineage would accelerate the time flow, allowing them to travel even faster.
As for those trapped in the array formation, although they weren’t suppressed by the worldly laws, the array formation’s resistance was too great. They couldn’t continue accelerating past a certain speed.
Most Supremacies were fleeing at a speed of about 50,000 kilometers per second. However, when trapped in the vast array formation, they could only choose to flee in a random direction blindly. After all, their cultivation realm was too low; thus, they couldn’t detect anything.
Swoosh.
A black-armored Imperial Lord maintained a six-fold faster time flow. He traveled 1.5 million kilometers per second as he chased after a Supremacy. The Supremacy was still foolishly flying, unaware of the approaching danger.
Pfft.
A blood-colored crescent flew past the Supremacy. In his horror, the Supremacy’s flesh and blood were completely devoured. The Supremacy’s body vanished without a trace, leaving only his weapons and treasures behind.
The black-armored Imperial Lord flew over. With a wave of his hand, he put away the treasures and chased after the next Supremacy.
With an Imperial Lord’s strength, killing Supremacies was too easy.
The strongest person presiding over the array formation was a Third Tribulation Eminence.
This Tribulation Eminence naturally targeted the only Imperial Lord that had rushed into the array formation.
Swoosh.
The blue-robed man cast his domain. Ripples of water spread out in all directions, separating the water droplets at an extremely fast speed.
Suddenly, his expression changed.
A long-browed elder appeared in front of him. The long-browed elder’s eyebrows fluttered as he smiled at him. “Black Fiend Hall gives Imperial Lords two paths. The first path is to hand over 200 Outer Realm Essence Crystals and their loyalty for 1,000 years. They can regain their freedom after 1,000 years. The second path is death.”
“200 Outer Realm Essence Crystals?” The blue-robed man’s expression turned ugly. “Can it be lower?”
“I can’t change the rules set by the higher-ups,” said the long-browed elder. “Make a choice in nine seconds. Otherwise, I’ll kill you.”
The blue-robed man gritted his teeth. “200 Outer Realm Essence Crystals? Your Black Fiend Hall is truly crazy. Count it as me throwing treasures down the drain.”
Just as he finished his sentence
Boom!
The blue-robed man exploded as terrifying shockwaves swept the surroundings.
Self-destructed? The long-browed elder watched calmly. A self-destruction can’t destroy Tribulation treasures. It looks like he’s poor. The long-browed elder waved his hand and scanned the treasures left behind by the blue-robed man. He scoffed. It’s just as I guessed. Two Fifth Tribulation treasures and some other miscellaneous items. They barely add up to 200 Outer Realm Essence Crystals.
Many wealthy Imperial Lords were willing to hand over 200 Outer Realm Essence Crystals and their loyalty for 1,000 years so that they could hold onto their remaining treasures. However, they had deliberately set the price at 200 Outer Realm Essence Crystals. Only those who were relatively rich, had a huge harvest, or a powerful Tribulation Eminence in their homeworld, would have that many Outer Realm Essence Crystals. Otherwise, most Imperial Lords would rather destroy one of their true bodies when faced with Black Fiend Hall’s conditions.
After all, they could just cultivate a new Corporeal Avatar with their true body in their homeworlds. However, once the treasures were lost, they would be lost forever.
The cultivators trapped in the array formation were intercepted.
In fact, Meng Chuan was the strongest cultivator in the array formation! However, he had perfectly disguised himself as an ordinary Supremacy with the Sea Serpent Token.
Due to his powerful void perception, Meng Chuan could sense Black Fiend Hall’s Imperial Lords from afar as they carried out their pursuits. He deliberately maintained some distance from them and secretly guided the Imperial Lords to pursue the closer Supremacies.
That Supremacy is quite fast. Furthermore, he’s skilled in the time lineage. He can maintain a ten-fold faster time flow. He’s only 15 million kilometers away from the array formation’s periphery. He will fly out very soon. An Imperial Lord with cyan wings stared at Meng Chuan. He spread his wings and chased after Meng Chuan at a terrifying speed of 1 million kilometers per second-courtesy of an accelerated time flow.
Meng Chuan could clearly sense the approaching Imperial Lord.
What should I do? I’m already moving at a very high speed. Any faster, and I won’t look like a Supremacy. Meng Chuan vaguely knew that things were going south for him.
The cyan-winged Imperial Lord quickly chased after him.
When the distance between the two shrank to just a few hundred thousand kilometers, Meng Chuan saw the other party about to arrive and launch an attack.
Huh? Meng Chuan pretended like he had just discovered something. He looked at the winged Imperial Lord in panic and instantly crushed a jade token in his hand.
In reality, it was an ordinary jade token. However, the time flow around Meng Chuan accelerated once again. The time flow around Meng Chuan became fifty-fold faster than the outside world.
A single-use talisman amulet that accelerates the time flow? The winged Imperial Lord’s expression changed when he saw this. He’s quite a wealthy Supremacy.
After his Infinite Saber reached the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm, Meng Chuan could maintain a fifty-fold faster time flow.
Under the pressure, Meng Chuan had been acting like he could only travel 50,000 kilometers per second. With the time flow around him suddenly accelerated by fifty-fold, his speed suddenly increased significantly. His speed completely exceeded the winged Imperial Lord’s.
“Stop him.” The winged Imperial Lord turned anxious. He was actually slower than a Supremacy. He didn’t have any talisman amulets that could accelerate the time flow. “I’ll do it.”
The five Imperial Lords had already been at the array formation’s periphery so that they could intercept the fleeing cultivators better. At that moment, a red-haired Imperial Lord—who was tens of millions of kilometers awayrushed over to intercept Meng Chuan. If I continue flying in the same direction, I’ll be intercepted by the red-haired Imperial Lord. Meng Chuan could sense the red-haired Imperial Lord from afar thanks to the void fluctuations produced by the red-haired Imperial Lord as he rushed over at maximum speed. The red-haired Imperial Lord happened to be blocking his path. If I change directions, will Black Fiend Hall suspect that I discovered an Imperial Lord tens of millions of kilometers away? Will they believe that I’m actually an Imperial Lord in disguise and end up sending a Tribulation Eminence?
Thoughts flashed through Meng Chuan’s mind. After some thought, he decided to be more straightforward.
He would continue moving forward in the same direction at the same speed.
He quickly shook off the winged Imperial Lord, but he was getting closer and closer to the red-haired Imperial Lord. Come to papa. Through the array formation, the red-haired Imperial Lord was very certain that the Supremacy was blindly fleeing. He leisurely stopped and waved his hand, producing six flaming mountains. Meng Chuan blindly charged forward. He was getting closer and closer to the array formation’s periphery. Five million kilometers, four million kilometers, three million kilometers...
When Meng Chuan was 2.5 million kilometers away from the array formation’s periphery, he finally encountered the red-haired Imperial Lord.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!
Six flaming mountains flew towards Meng Chuan without any warning. The red-haired Imperial Lord thought nothing of Meng Chuan. He only wanted to crush this Supremacy to death before quickly killing the other Supremacies. “Hahaha.” The distant winged Imperial Lord, who had been left in the dust, was more than five million kilometers away from Meng Chuan. He stopped and laughed at this scene.
Meng Chuan’s eyes turned cold as he looked at the six flaming mountains.
Boom!
The surrounding void pressure suddenly increased as an invisible force restrained the six flaming mountains. The six flaming mountains stopped in midair, unable to move. As for the red-haired Imperial Lord, his expression changed drastically. Not good.
This was because he realized that terrifying pressure was coming from all directions. This pressure came from the void. He couldn’t escape it, nor could he move at all. However, it didn’t just stop there. The void pressure acted on his body and his internal powers.
This was a complete void seal!
Swoosh.
Lightning Dwarf Star, which contained the paramount speed laws, transformed into a dazzling meteor that instantly crushed the red-haired Imperial Lord.
No- The Imperial Lord was alarmed and furious, but he was unable to move at all. He helplessly watched as the lightning starwhich spanned hundreds of feet wideslammed into him.
Bam!
The red-haired Imperial Lord instantly turned to dust.
Meng Chuan flew past him and waved his hand to put away the treasures that were left behind. “What?” The winged Imperial Lord watched the scene in shock.
The other three Imperial Lords and the long-browed elder-a Third Tribulation Eminence-looked at Meng Chuan’s direction from afar. Their expressions changed. There was a hidden Imperial Lord. I actually failed to notice him! The long-browed elder was furious as he frantically chased after Meng Chuan.

chapters.title: Chapter 521 - The Hunt Ends
chapters.content:
Chapter 521 The Hunt Ends
After killing an Imperial Lord, Meng Chuan remained calm as he charged out of the array formation at full speed.
After staying on Black Dragon Planet for so many years, he bought other Tribulation treasures that were suitable for him as his strength increased.
For example, the Lightning Domain Seal-a Fifth Tribulation treasure-combined with his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique and formed a domain! Due to his cultivation of Selfless Formless Sword, Meng Chuan had accumulated a lot of insights into domains. This resulted in his self-created Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique being extremely good at void lineage domains.
Meng Chuan decisively decided to combine his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique’s main void domain with a suitable Tribulation treasure. This made it so that even perfected Imperial Lords might not necessarily be stronger than Meng Chuan when it came to the void lineage.
As for killing enemies?
He matched his Infinite Saber-a paramount technique—with the Lightning Dwarf Star for killing!
The two combinations worked in conjunction —the domain suppressed his enemies while the Lightning Dwarf Star attacked them! With the two combined, Meng Chuan believed he could fight a perfected Imperial Lord.
However, I’m still no match for a Tribulation Eminence. Meng Chuan knew this very well. His and those pure-blooded dragon and phoenix youths’ strength represented the peak of the Supremacy realm! Although they represented the peak of the Supremacy realm, it was impossible for them to fight a Tribulation Eminence. This was the knowledge left behind by generations of cultivators.
Swoosh!
It took a long time to describe, but after Meng Chuan revealed his strength, he no longer concealed his speed. He rapidly accelerated. With a fifty-fold faster time flow around him, he rushed out of the array formation as a bolt of lightning
Whoosh.
As he rushed out of the array formation, Meng Chuan waved his hand and threw out some items.
With his present realm, Meng Chuan could instantly sweep up the war spoils when he killed the Imperial Lord.
Tribulation treasures, Outer Realm Essence Crystals, Outer Realm Essence Stones, exotic plants, life-preservation items, and so on... These common items could be kept. Meng Chuan didn’t hesitate to throw away anything related to Black Fiend Hall, talismans, and other items that he couldn’t identify! He didn’t want to keep any items that may have had tracking methods embedded into them.
The moment he rushed out of the array formation, Meng Chuan looked back.
The void was still pitch-black. One array formation after another blocked off all prying eyes! However, Meng Chuan could sense the killing intent. The cultivators trapped in the array formation were clearly struggling.
Time to go! Meng Chuan looked back and activated a Lesser Void Transference Talisman without any hesitation.
As he was skilled in the void lineage, Meng Chuan could teleport 400,000 kilometers in an instant. However, his teleportation was far inferior to a Lesser Void Transference Talisman.
Buzz
Meng Chuan instantly realized he could see things from another angle. The entire spacetime was distorted and warped. After using a Lesser Void Transference Talisman, Meng Chuan could see the surrounding stars collapse in the distorted spacetime. The spacetime he could sense seemed to have become a box.
This is true spacetime. Meng Chuan knew what he was seeing. As his cultivation realm increased, his insights into spacetime became deeper. Ordinary Supremacies perceived spacetime to be a thousand-layered cake. Those at higher realms understood that spacetime consisted of countless boxes. Perhaps a Seventh Tribulation Eminence or an Eighth Tribulation Eminence could discover a different appearance to spacetime. Perhaps it was different when viewed from the eyes of a Ninth Tribulation existence, Eternal.
At different realms, one saw the same view, but they saw different realities.
At this moment, he was just an ant in the box. With the help of a Lesser Void Transference Talisman, the ant jumped from one side of the box to the other side.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan felt the scenery before him change.
He had already arrived in another outer realm void. When he turned around, he couldn’t see Black Dragon Planet or the Yin-Yang Stellar Array. He had teleported billions of kilometers away.
The distance I’ve traversed is really far. Meng Chuan sighed in amazement. My Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique is focused on the void lineage. I have to reach the Fifth Tribulation realm before I can do such a thing normally.
In contrast, a Void Transference Talisman was extremely expensive and nearly unpurchasable.
It was usually easier for Imperial Lords to buy Lesser Void Transference Talismans. They could afford the cost of 40 cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals if they steeled their hearts a little.
There’s a reason why it’s expensive. I escaped really far away, thought Meng Chuan. Even if there are Fifth Tribulation Eminences amongst those lunatics of Black Fiend Hall, they might not be able to execute Lesser Void Transference. Even if there are, they won’t waste time hunting me when there are so many other cultivators, right?
If they really came to pursue him? Meng Chuan couldn’t escape a Fifth Tribulation Eminence even if he used all his treasures. After all, the difference in strength was too great.
In fact, Fifth Tribulation Eminences thought nothing of him.
Black Fiend Hall was busy hunting over 10,000 fleeing cultivators. How could a Fifth Tribulation Eminence leave this important hunting ground just because an Imperial Lord managed to escape?
Without the array formations obstructing the cultivators, it would be extremely difficult to intercept and kill an Imperial Lord who escaped using a Lesser Void Transference Talisman. Furthermore, Black Fiend Hall’s three Fifth Tribulation Eminences couldn’t leave alone while they were hunting. They had to be prepared to work together to prevent any accidents from happening. This was a rule set by Black Fiend Hall.
A Lesser Void Transference Talisman? The long-browed elder stopped when he saw Meng Chuan disappear. He was rather indignant.
I lost one of the five Imperial Lords under my command for such a simple mission. The long-browed elder was vexed. The red-haired Imperial Lord had been forced to serve Black Fiend Hall, but he would no longer be enslaved by Black Fiend Hall since this true body had died in battle. The red-haired Imperial Lord’s true body in his homeworld would definitely cultivate a new true body since he had already lost his treasures.
From Black Fiend Hall’s point of view, they had lost a portion of their strength. The long-browed elder had to bear some responsibility. Kill! The long-browed elder’s eyes were filled with anger as he flew out of the array formation to kill the other fleeing cultivators.
The battle continued outside the Yin-Yang Stellar Array
Patriarch Black Dragon stood in the void, with the silver-haired woman by his side. The two of them stared into the distance.
Hum.
Waves of invisible fluctuations scanned the surroundings.
With Patriarch Black Dragon’s strength, he naturally could clearly see what was happening outside after Black Fiend Hall’s array formations were completely exposed. Hundreds of array formations were scattered around the Yin-Yang Stellar Array, intercepting about 30% of the fleeing cultivators. The other 70% continued to flee frantically.
Amongst the fleeing cultivators, some Supremacies were allowed to escape, but Imperial Lords would definitely be pursued. Unless they had a Lesser Void Transference Talisman that allowed them to teleport to a faraway place, these Imperial Lords wouldn’t be able to escape.
“Many Imperial Lords were unwilling to buy Lesser Void Transference Talismans. Now, they will suffer a tragedy,” said the silver-haired woman.
“You are a dragon, so you don’t understand.” Patriarch Black Dragon calmly watched the battles in the outside world. “Those Imperial Lords vary in strength. The stronger ones might be willing to buy a Lesser Void Transference Talisman, but the weaker ones’ total wealth might only be 80 to 90 Outer Realm Essence Crystals. They need to purchase Tribulation treasures, cultivation techniques, and so on. How many will be willing to spend half their wealth to buy a Lesser Void Transference Talisman that they might not necessarily need to use?”
The silver-haired woman was taken aback, but she nodded slightly.
The Imperial Lords who roamed the outer realm had about 200 Outer Realm Essence Crystals worth of treasures on average. However, this was the average for early-stage, middle-stage, late-stage, and perfected Imperial Lords. Early and middle-stage Imperial Lords that came from low-level worlds were typically poor! They would rather use their Outer Realm Essence Crystals to buy some cultivation techniques to keep in their homeworld or a frequently-used Tribulation treasure that could aid in their cultivation.
To spend half one’s wealth to buy a Lesser Void Transference Talisman?
It was impractical.
“That’s how I was like back then.” Patriarch Black Dragon pointed at the battles happening in the outside world. Cultivators were hunted and slaughtered. Many cultivators panicked and were glad that they had escaped such a calamity. “I lived carefully. All sorts of dangers kept me on my toes constantly. I only had the right to set the rules after becoming a Tribulation Eminence.”
This was indeed the case in the outer realm. Even Meng Chuan—who had fled to Heaven Peak River System in a sorry state with Exile Prison-was intercepted the moment he arrived.
He had to rely on his seventh-level Essence Soul and the Essence Soul Star legacy’s recovery speed before he could crack the cave abode. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have obtained the treasures Pang Ming had left behind. The commotion Yin-Yang Stellar Array gradually came to a halt. Black Fiend Hall’s hunt was about to end.
“Slightly more than 70% of the 10,000 cultivators managed to escape. I expected this.” Patriarch Black Dragon calmly watched everything happen. “Over half of the Imperial Lords were intercepted, enslaved, or killed. Only one of the five Tribulation Eminences managed to escape.”
“Patriarch, you have already done your best,” whispered the silver-haired woman.
“It can’t be considered as doing my best.” Patriarch Black Dragon remained very calm. “I’m just helping them out of self-preservation. In fact, those Imperial Lords and Tribulation Eminences are much better. At most, they will lose some treasures and a true body. Those Supremacies are truly pitiful... Them dying here means a true death. In the outer realm, only by being powerful can one change their fate.”
Following that, he turned his head and took a step forward, disappearing from view as he returned to Black Dragon Planet.
The silver-haired woman glanced at the outside world one more time before turning to leave.
After Meng Chuan entered the River of Spacetime, he fled for another five days. He fled much further than the distance he had been teleported. Meng Chuan slowly flew through the River of Spacetime. He glanced at the countless stars and inhabited worlds in the distance and understood where he was in Heaven Peak River System.
Huh? Suddenly, Meng Chuan stared at a certain spot.
From afar, it looked like a human-faced darkness. In the River of Spacetime, it appeared only that ‘large.’ But in the void, it was extremely massive. That’s a Chaos Hole? Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up. The Chaos Hole I cultivate is quite similar to a real Chaos Hole. I’ve always wanted to find a Chaos Hole and study it at close range. This is my chance. Meng Chuan stared at it with fervent eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 522 - Cultivation in the Chaos Hole (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 522 Cultivation in the Chaos Hole (1)
In terms of size, the Chaos Hole in front of him was considered one of the biggest in the entire Heaven Peak River System. Meng Chuan no longer resisted the River of Spacetime’s repulsive force. He was expelled and returned to the ordinary outer realm void.
Meng Chuan stood in the dark void.
Chaos Hole. Meng Chuan stared at the mysterious celestial body in the distance in amazement.
If Primordial Stars—which only those at the Eighth Tribulation realm could discover-were the most mysterious celestial bodies in the River of Spacetime, then Chaos Holes were second to Primordial Stars.
Chaos Holes were the most mysterious and terrifying celestial bodies that ordinary cultivators could discover.
A Grand Yang Star’s divine fire core could reduce Tribulation Eminences to ashes. As for a Chaos Hole... only a Seventh Tribulation Eminence and stronger could reach its core.
It’s really massive. Meng Chuan stared at it from afar.
At the Chaos Hole’s periphery, a huge golden ring that resembled a disc surrounded it. It was also known as the Chaos Hole accretion disc.
The golden accretion disc allowed one to see the Chaos Hole’s darkness. It was what allowed cultivators to recognize it as a Chaos Hole.
If not for the Chaos Hole accretion disc, it would be very difficult to distinguish the pitch-black Chaos Hole in the outer realm.
The Chaos Hole accretion disc is astonishingly large. It’s much larger than the array formation formed by 64 Grand Yin Stars and 64 Grand Yang Stars. Meng Chuan flew towards it.
After flying for four hours, he gradually approached the Chaos Hole accretion disc.
The dazzling Chaos Hole accretion disc was extremely large. It had a very strong attractive force, but it didn’t pose any threat to Meng Chuan.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan waved his hand, and Supremacy Qing Gu appeared beside him.
“Brother Eastcalm.” Just as Supremacy Qing Gu was about to bow, he was affected by the attractive force. He flew a hundred feet towards the Chaos Hole before suddenly stopping
“A Chaos Hole?” Supremacy Qing Gu stared at the dazzling Chaos Hole accretion disc in shock before looking at the Chaos Hole in the middle.
“I’ll be cultivating around the Chaos Hole for some time,” said Meng Chuan with a smile as he looked at Supremacy Qing Gu. “You can find a place to cultivate, or you may leave.”
Back then, he had brought Qing Gu with him because he wanted to integrate with other outer realm cultivators better. He could also get Qing Gu to do everything for him. Now that he had bought everything he needed, Qing Gu’s usefulness had greatly decreased.
“I’m willing to follow you wholeheartedly. Don’t worry, Brother Eastcalm. I’ll silently cultivate outside the Chaos Hole accretion disc. I’ll be at your beck and call,” said Supremacy Qing Gu immediately.
“Alright, it’s up to you.” Meng Chuan smiled and nodded.
Supremacy Qing Gu bowed and left.
He quickly left the Chaos Hole accretion disc and flew to an area with relatively lower gravitational force. He then controlled a meteor that was flying towards the Chaos Hole. He simply built an ordinary cave abode on the meteor and stayed there temporarily.
How difficult is it for an ordinary Supremacy like me to cultivate alone? Only by following an expert will I have more hope in my cultivation. Supremacy Qing Gu looked at the Chaos Hole accretion disc from afar. He definitely had to cozy up with Meng Chuan. It was precisely because he came from a low-level world that Supremacy Qing Gu understood how difficult it was to find a backer.
For example, Black Fiend Hall only accepted enslaved Imperial Lords.
What a beautiful Chaos Hole accretion disc. Meng Chuan took in the sight before him. The Chaos Hole accretion disc spanned an immense distance. He felt like he had arrived in a resplendent golden world.
Meng Chuan continued flying. After another two hours, he entered complete darkness.
It’s pitch-black. Meng Chuan turned his head and looked behind him. He could still see the Chaos Hole accretion disc. He continued flying towards the Chaos Hole.
He flew deeper into the darkness. Occasionally, a ball of hot energy would shoot towards Meng Chuan. Meng Chuan’s domain would swiftly deal with it before it got close to him.
The gravitational force is getting greater and greater. Meng Chuan constantly flew towards the Chaos Hole as its suction force constantly increased in strength.
In terms of strength, Meng Chuan was comparable to a perfected Imperial Lord. He had a Chaos Hole in his dantian. Of course, compared to the Chaos Hole in the outside World, his dantian’s Chaos Hole was considered microscopic. Even so, Meng Chuan was still very capable of resisting the gravitational force.
The closer one is to the Chaos Hole’s core, the more dangerous it will be.
After flying closer towards the Chaos Hole, Meng Chuan finally realized that the time flow around him had changed.
Two-fold faster time flow, three-fold faster time flow, five-fold faster time flow...
The closer Meng Chuan got to the Chaos Hole’s core, the greater the time flow acceleration became.
Using his homeworld’s true body as reference, he could clearly determine how much the time flow had accelerated.
The time flow is already twenty-fold faster than the norm. Meng Chuan continued flying into the Chaos Hole’s depths. His Chaos Hole domain was especially good at resisting the gravitational force. However, he had to direct most of his strength to resist it.
After flying for a few more moments, Meng Chuan suddenly stopped. He continued floating in midair, resisting the terrifying gravitational force.
The time flow is 35 times faster than the norm. I can’t go any deeper. Meng Chuan felt the terrifying gravitational force weaken his Chaos Hole domain, causing his body to tremble. If I get any closer, I’ll be sucked in. I won’t be able to resist the gravitational force. I’ll stay around this area. I’ll carefully experience the Chaos Hole’s powers and cultivate well.
Chaos Holes were very magical.
After Meng Chuan was a certain distance from the Chaos Hole, the terrifying gravitational force affected the Myriad Flower Realm, Fiend Prison, and any grotto-heaven objects. Therefore, he couldn’t hide in a treasure and reach the Chaos Hole’s core by hiding in it.
The deeper one went into the Chaos Hole, the harder it was for an object to isolate the gravitational force.
I heard that only a day passes in the outside world after cultivating for 1,000 years at a Chaos Hole’s extreme depths? Meng Chuan was somewhat astonished. According to the information left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon, the time flow at this celestial body’s core could also be slower than the norm. One day in the Chaos Hole’s core could be 1,000 years in the outside world. Different Chaos Holes had various differences.
Outside the Chaos Hole’s core, the time flow was faster than the norm. The closer one was to the Chaos Hole, the greater the time flow acceleration became. However, the time flow at the Chaos Hole’s core slowed down by more than 10,000 times.
There are too many unknowns. Meng Chuan felt like he had too many things he needed to investigate. However, he thought of it as a very good thing. This was what cultivation was like-one had to explore the unknown.
Huh? Meng Chuan was suddenly alarmed. What happened to my body?
All life could adapt. Under the effects of gravity, mortals’ bones and muscles would gradually change over time.
In a dark world, one’s eyes could adapt, giving them night vision. It was the same for cultivators. Changes would occur to a cultivator after they spent a long time in a certain cultivation environment. However, Meng Chuan had reached the Chaos Hole realm and had absorbed a Primordial Stone. His body was extremely powerful, which was why his body was extremely difficult to change.
The smallest particles in my body are actually slowly shrinking because of the gravitational force? Meng Chuan stayed at the maximum depth he could. With his Essence Soul’s microscopic vision, he could clearly see that his body’s particles were shrinking extremely slowly. Although they weren’t big changes, it couldn’t escape Meng Chuan’s senses.
Meng Chuan watched it happen silently. He didn’t interfere with the natural changes in his body; instead, he allowed his body to change in the environment.
One day, two days, three days...
On the surface, Meng Chuan’s body seemed to become slightly thinner. The billions of particles in his body were about 30% smaller than before. At the same time, he had about 30% more particles in his body. The Chaos Hole’s environment caused Meng Chuan’s body to gain 30% more particles. His body also became more compact. The surface of his skin was even glowing like the Seventh Tribulation Dark Peacock’s skin membrane. This is how I should cultivate my body at the Chaos Hole realm. All these years, I’ve been thinking of how I should cultivate my body. I’ve finally found the most suitable path for me. I now have a way to cultivate my Chaos Hole Divine Body... Meng Chuan was rather excited.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon had created the Samsara Divine Body.
Generations of human Godfiends-some at the Tribulation realm, some at the Imperial Lord realm, and some at the Supremacy realm-had created various Godfiend bodies.
Meng Chuan had created his own paramount technique. However, he still found it extremely difficult to create his own Godfiend body. He only found a cultivation direction after he came to the Chaos Hole’s depths.

chapters.title: Chapter 523 - Cultivation in the Chaos Hole (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 523 Cultivation in the Chaos Hole (2)
In Archean Eon Realm’s history, many of the Godfiend cultivation system’s predecessors had tried to create Godfiend bodies. Some Godfiend bodies were only suitable for their individual bodies and weren’t universal. Although Meng Chuan had created the Chaos Hole Divine Body, it clearly had a very high requirement. It didn’t seem like it would be a universal Godfiend body. However, he knew that once he reached a high enough cultivation realm-such as the Fifth or Sixth Tribulation realm-his deep foundation would allow him to create a more universalized Chaos Hole Divine Body formulation.
He would be able to create a cultivation method for the Core Cloud realm, Indestructible realm, Great Solar realm, Darkstar realm, and Seamless realm. First, I have to create my Chaos Hole Divine Body’s nascent form. Meng Chuan was filled with anticipation. In the past, he had tried many times, but he had failed. It was only because of his powerful vitality that his body could instantly fuse back together after it shattered. Therefore, he could constantly experiment.
In a natural environment, one’s body would change gradually. The natural changes that occurred in one’s body meant that their bodies had cultivation potential in a certain direction.
Meng Chuan began to focus and meditate.
The closer one was to the massive Chaos Hole, the greater the burden on one’s body. Such an environment wasn’t suitable for calm cultivation or body cultivation. Thus, Meng Chuan usually cultivated in the Chaos Hole’s outer area, where the time flow was ten-fold faster. Meng Chuan could withstand the Chaos Hole’s gravitational force with his Chaos Hole domain alone. With his Chaos Hole domain protecting him, he could cultivate in peace.
Of course, Godfiend bodies were just ways to utilize laws.
Meng Chuan spent most of his time on paramount speed laws and void laws. He also wanted to create an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique and push his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique to the perfected Heaven Earth realm.
In the blink of an eye, four years in the outside world passed. Meng Chuan had been cultivating around the Chaos Hole for nearly 50 years.
Deep in the Chaos Hole.
The time flow here was 47 times faster than normal. It was also darker and quieter here. Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in the dark, silent void and stared at the Chaos Hole’s depths.
Chaos Hole. Meng Chuan observed it silently. Although Meng Chuan couldn’t reach the core, he could imagine its true appearance because of the intelligence he had gathered in the outside world and the information left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon.
The Chaos Hole’s core is spherical. A small Chaos Hole’s core is only 100 feet wide. Even this super-large Chaos Hole’s core is probably only 10,000 feet wide. However, this tiny core can easily devour hundreds of Grand Yang Stars. If a Tribulation Eminence below the Seventh Tribulation realm goes too close to the core, they’ll be unable to resist the gravitational force.
It’s said that a Chaos Hole’s devouring powers are very terrifying. However, the ancient books left behind by Eighth Tribulation Eminences and the fragmentary words left behind by an Eternal existence confirms that everything in the world comes from spacetime.
The gravitational force is essentially a spacetime law. There are records that mention that a Chaos Hole contains the profound mysteries of time and space. Even a Seventh Tribulation Eminence will find it difficult to comprehend these mysteries fully.
As for my Chaos Hole, it’s formed from Infinite Saber’s laws. These laws are of the time lineage only. Maybe such a Chaos Hole isn’t perfect. A perfect Chaos Hole should have a combination of laws from the time lineage and the spatial lineage.
All these years, I’ve been creating my Chaos Hole Divine Body according to this conjecture.
Although only four years had passed in the outside world, he had actually cultivated around the Chaos Hole for a few decades.
With a clear direction, Meng Chuan had results. To Meng Chuan, every particle space was a miniature Chaos Hole. The particle space’s core was the miniature Chaos Hole’s core.
His Essence Soul thoughts lingered in the cores and fused with them. They had contained his Infinite Saber’s laws—which were of the time lineage. The void in his particle spaces contained his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique’s laws—which were of the spatial lineage.
After many attempts, Meng Chuan had succeeded after suffering from repeated particle collapses. Time and space were naturally suitable for fusion. There were all sorts of combinations.
The particles in Meng Chuan’s body were currently about a third of their original size. The particles’ cores shrank to only one percent of its original size. Although the cores were smaller, each particle could contain much more power than before.
His entire body transformed. His muscles, bones, tendons, and blood had changed qualitatively. Even the most basic particles had undergone fundamental changes. The changes in his muscles and bones were even more obvious. They were manifestations of the laws Meng Chuan had comprehended.
The number of particles in his body had increased by three-fold, but his physical strength had increased by twenty-fold. With such physical strength, Meng Chuan was confident that he could suppress pure-blooded dragons and phoenixes at the same realm.
The dragons’ familial branch, Baxia, has immense strength. My strength should be in no way inferior to a Baxia clan member. Meng Chuan guessed.
The pure-blooded dragons had many familial branches. These familial branches were created because pure-blooded dragons evolved in different directions. However, all of these evolved pure-blooded dragons were still extraordinary. For example, Sea Serpents had divine powers that were related to illusions. As for Baxia clan members, it was rare for them not to have any divine powers. However, Baxia clan members had insane physical strength. Their bodies were like treasures. When they were at the Supremacy realm, they could fight a perfected Imperial Lord with their bodies alone.
The more Meng Chuan cultivated, the more he understood which direction he needed to direct his Chaos Hole Divine Body towards.
I can fight a perfected Imperial Lord with my body alone. I created my Chaos Hole Divine Body after combining my paramount technique and Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique. Meng Chuan was somewhat worried. I originally wanted to use my paramount technique as my Chaos Hole Divine Body’s core. Now that I’ve fused the void lineage’s laws with it, I wonder if doing this is right or wrong.
He only decided to take this path after seeing a real Chaos Hole. He felt like it was the right path. However, this path required him to fuse two different lineages’ laws together.
Tribulation Eminences ultimately aim for spacetime. Thus, my general direction is correct. Meng Chuan stopped doubting his path. Regardless of whether it was the correct path or not, this Chaos Hole Divine Body was the strongest one he had developed over the years.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged. A membrane covered his skin. Countless runes appeared on the membrane. The runes contained the profundities of Infinite Saber and Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique. His skin membrane was somewhat similar to the Seventh Tribulation Dark Peacock’s flesh membrane.
I’ve successfully created my Chaos Hole Divine Body. However, I can’t freely modify my dantian’s Chaos Hole. The energy contained within my dantian is too terrifying. If I modify my dantian and it explodes, I’ll probably be completely annihilated. Even my body’s particles will be completely obliterated. If this true body dies, all the treasures it carries will be gone.
I’ll try modifying my dantian when I return to my homeworld.Even if this true body dies because of an explosion, I can still cultivate another true body.
His dantian’s Chaos Hole had absorbed dozens of Outer Realm Essence Crystals. It contained too much Quintessential Essence! If it exploded, the explosion would probably be comparable to a perfected Imperial Lord self-destructing!
However, I have yet to create an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique to date. Meng Chuan was very frustrated by this. His Chaos Hole Divine Body was only an application of laws.
Comprehending the laws was more important.
What am I doing wrong? Meng Chuan pondered on what he was missing.
If Meng Chuan’s Chaos Hole Divine Body was strong enough, even if it was newly-created, he could continue perfecting it in the future. However, an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique had to be perfect! If his created technique lacked just a little, it wouldn’t be a paramount technique. This was the conundrum Meng Chuan had encountered.
Three Bay River System, Demon Realm.
In a chamber, Emperor Roc floated in the air as golden light radiated from his body. The wings on his back were even more dazzling. Every golden feather was as sharp as a divine armament.
Sometimes, taking a step back is more important than taking another step forward. Emperor Roc opened his eyes, unable to hide the excitement in them.
It’s been so many years. I’ve finally cultivated my body to perfection. I’m about to step into the Tribulation realm. Emperor Roc was filled with joy. A year from now, the first physical body tribulation will descend
Although Heavenly Tribulations came without any warning, there were patterns. For example, the first three tribulations were separated by at least one year each time. In the future, each tribulation would happen at least a century apart! However, if one’s body didn’t improve at all, the subsequent physical body tribulations would never descend. They would naturally die of old age.
It was the same for Essence Soul Tribulations. If one’s Essence Soul didn’t improve at all, the subsequent Essence Soul tribulations would never descend... However, the improvement of one’s Essence Soul was uncontrollable. One’s Essence Soul would transform as long as one’s stage of mind, insights into laws, and their willpower changed. Therefore, Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences found it even harder to predict when their Heavenly Tribulations would descend.
After becoming a Tribulation Eminence, I will be able to cross river zones, thought Emperor Roc. I have to kill Meng Chuan as soon as possible. It’s best if I can use karma to kill all his avatars. Even if an early-stage Imperial Lord hides in their homeworld, there’s still hope of killing them through karma.
Emperor Roc pondered his next steps.

chapters.title: Chapter 524 - The Strongest Experts in the Two Worlds
chapters.content:
Chapter 524 The Strongest Experts in the Two Worlds
A snowy day in winter.
On Archean Mountain, Li Guan, Qin Wu, Luo Tang, and Meng Chuan arrived at a bleak and empty grotto-heaven. “In the blink of an eye, I’ve reached the end of my life,” said Li Guan with a smile as he stared at the Millennium Hall in front of him.
Meng Chuan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang looked at Li Guan.
At that moment, Li Guan looked extremely old. His hair was snow-white, and his face was covered in wrinkles. He was nearing the end of his lifespan, and his age was apparent.
“Senior Brother, you have sacrificed plenty for Archean Mountain and humanity all these years,” said Qin Wu solemnly.
“I was born during humanity’s prosperous times,” said Li Guan with a sigh. “Godfiend sects fought each other, killing one another. I once killed an enemy Godfiend that shocked all parties. After becoming a Supremacy, I wanted to roam the outer realm once I reached the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm. Who knew that the Demon Realm and Archean Eon Realm would get closer and closer to each other? World Entrances even appeared. Therefore, I spent the rest of my life fighting the demons.”
Meng Chuan listened.
“Many Godfiends have risked their lives to guard the World Entrances.” Li Guan had mixed emotions. “In the past 900 years, too many Godfiends have died. Too many names have been left on Blood Red Cliff.”
mes
Meng Chuan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang fell silent.
It was true that many Godfiends had died because of the war. Many were fellow disciples they were familiar with.
“The situation got worse. I was even prepared to use the Heaven and Earth Great Hall and unleash World Annihilation. Although that will stop the demons, our generation of Godfiends will become the sinners of humanity. Even if we save the world, we won’t be able to wash away our sins.” Li Guan looked at Meng Chuan. “Thankfully, a miracle appeared after 900 years.”
Luo Tang nodded and looked over. “Thankfully, Meng Chuan appeared.”
“Therefore, I think it was a very wise decision for me to let him enter the Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven,” said Qin Wu with a smile.
“Hahaha...” Li Guan, Luo Tang, and Meng Chuan laughed.
If he hadn’t entered Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven and obtained the Cosmos Body cultivation system legacy, Meng Chuan wouldn’t have been able to wipe out one million demon monarchs alone. Even if he gained enough strength to reverse the situation later, many more humans would have died. The situation would’ve been much worse.
“I don’t have any regrets in my life.” Li Guan’s old face was very calm. “Now that I’m nearing the end of my lifespan, I only have one final dream. I want to see us humans finally winning this war. I haven’t slept for 1,000 years, so I can still continue sleeping... When we emerge victorious in the war, wake me up. I’ll have no regrets after seeing our victory and celebrating,” said Li Guan with a smile.
“Senior Brother, you will definitely see it,” said Qin Wu.
“We will definitely win,” said Meng Chuan.
Li Guan nodded slightly and walked towards Millennium Hall...
Grotto-Heaven Pavilion.
Meng Chuan, Qin Wu, and Luo Tang sat down.
“Meng An is also a Supremacy. He should have been here to send Senior Brother Li off,” said Qin Wu.
“That kid became even busier after becoming a Supremacy.” Meng Chuan shook his head. “It should be Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s legacy. He obtained the core legacy. Ancestral Master Archean Eon made arrangements for every stage of Meng An’s cultivation. He went into seclusion again, and who knows how long he will be in seclusion.”
Luo Tang and Qin Wu nodded. “Yes.”
Back then, the demons had sent a large number of fifth Firmament demon monarchs into the World Gap. They then infiltrated the human world, but Meng Chuan had wiped out all of them. That battle had completely established Meng Chuan’s status as the strongest person in the world.
About 20 years after that battle, Meng An became a Supremacy. Doing the math... It had only been slightly more than ten years since he became a Supremacy.
After becoming a Supremacy, Meng An became even more mysterious. He would occasionally disappear for a few years.
“Meng Chuan,” said Qin Wu seriously, “are you sure your family doesn’t want to take over the Great Zhou Dynasty’s throne? According to the rules, the Li family should be abdicating and passing it to your Meng family.”
Luo Tang looked at Meng Chuan. “Senior Brother Li is only one year away from his death. The Li family will soon abdicate. The entire family clan will migrate out of the imperial capital.”
“There’s no need.” Meng Chuan shook his head and said, “I think it’ll be good if the Great Zhou Dynasty doesn’t have an imperial family. The Imperial Court’s cabinet can manage the secular world, while the sect supervises the rest. There’s no need for an additional imperial family.”
Most importantly, Meng Chuan didn’t see anyone suitable to be an emperor in the Meng family. Meng An and himself were focused on cultivation.
Meng An had always been single. Even with Yan Jin’s cold personality, he married and had children after he was 100 years old. His son, Meng An, remained single the entire time. This vexed Meng Chuan.
His daughter, Meng You, and Yang Cheng had generations of descendants... However, they were considered part of the Yang family. They weren’t surnamed Meng, so they naturally couldn’t be counted. The Meng family’s original members? They had a distant relationship with Meng Chuan. Furthermore, if one wanted to be an emperor, one had to condense an Essence Soul and reach the Darkstar realm at the very least. Meng Chuan also hoped that his descendants would be more simple and humble. Therefore, he decided that the Great Zhou Dynasty would not have an imperial family. Meng Chuan felt that it wasn’t a bad choice.
“Alright, Archean Mountain is under your control now. According to the rules, this throne belongs to your Meng family. Since you have given up on it, it’s up to you,” said Qin Wu with a smile.
Archean Mountain’s leader, the strongest person in the world, and an Imperial Lord...
This was Meng Chuan’s current status.
Although Meng Chuan only had Essence Soul avatars outside and never admitted that he had become an Imperial Lord, he was able to reach Archean Eon Realm’s Four Seas instantly. He had also captured many fifth Firmament demon monarchs all those years ago. He could travel tens of thousands of kilometers in an instant. Unless one comprehended a paramount technique and broke free of the worldly law’s suppression, only Heaven Earth realm experts could travel so quickly. In addition, Meng Chuan had a seventh-level Essence Soul.
As an expert that had reached the Heaven Earth realm and had a seventh-level Essence Soul, he naturally had the strength of an Imperial Lord.
Regardless of whether Meng Chuan had broken through, his Imperial Lord-level strength was unquestionable.
Meng Chuan’s strength, status, and his ability to fend off demons made all the Godfiends in the world accept him wholeheartedly. He was the strongest Godfiend in the world, the supreme leader of Godfiends.
“You’ve been roaming the outer realm for over 40 years,” said Luo Tang worriedly. “There are now a total of nine super-large city passes. The World Entrances are still slowly expanding. I wonder if a demon sage-level passageway will appear.” “Even if nobody guards the super-large city passes, would the demons dare enter?” Qin Wu smiled. “The demons have long been scared out of their wits.”
Meng Chuan could instantly arrive anywhere in Archean Eon Realm.
This caused the demons to stop invading completely. Not many demons entered the unstable World Entrances either.
