No fifth Firmament demon monarch was willing to attack a super-large city pass! This was because Meng Chuan would kill or capture them alive if they dared to appear.
Luo Tang couldn’t help but ask, “Meng Chuan, are you confident in guarding the world if a demon sage-level passageway appears?”
“Don’t worry. Leave it to me,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
Meng Chuan didn’t say much. After broadening his horizons in the outer realm, he also understood that if the demons nurtured a Heaven Earth Supremacy at all costs, it would bring him some trouble. After all, the Demon Realm’s heritage was rather rich.
Of course, it would just be a little troublesome. Meng Chuan believed that he could blaze through all Supremacies. The only problem was that his Essence Soul avatars in Archean Eon Realm were much weaker than his true body in the outer realm.
Eight Essence Soul avatars will attack together. If I’m forced into a corner, my true body that is in Heaven and Earth Great Hall will also enter the battlefield.
This war had to be won.
While Li Guan was slumbering, Emperor Roc’s two true bodies-one in the outer realm and the other in his homeworld—welcomed the second Physical Body Tribulation.
The Tribulation realm’s Heavenly Tribulations were unavoidable. No matter where one hid, they couldn’t escape from it. Although the worlds that supported life specially protected the weak, Heavenly Tribulations would still descend upon a Tribulation Eminence even if they hid in their homeworld.
Humph.
In the cave abode’s chamber, a Golden-Winged Roc lowered its wings. Its sharp claws grabbed the ground, and the golden light on its wings was dazzling. However, the dazzling golden light entangled many black threads. Countless black threads constantly seeped into the golden-winged Roc’s body, causing it to tremble in pain. Its wings instinctively wrapped around it.
Emperor Roc had the Golden-Winged Roc bloodline, and his body was extremely powerful. He had the strength to match a Third Tribulation Eminence when he just reached the Tribulation realm. However, due to his powerful body, the first three tribulations came very quickly.
According to the demons’ experience, after those with the Golden-Winged Roc bloodline reached the Tribulation realm, they would experience three tribulations within 100 years! However, because they weren’t real Golden-Winged Rocs, they might fail to transcend the tribulations.
Suddenly
The Golden-Winged Roc let out a deep roar as it spread its wings. Countless black threads were forcefully expelled from its body. After being expelled, the black threads turned into nothingness and vanished from the world.
The Golden-Winged Roc transformed into Emperor Roc.
It’s a success. Emperor Roc was somewhat exhausted. He felt his body slowly transform as the demonic power in his body also transformed. I’ve already undergone two tribulations in just two years. However, I estimate that the third tribulation will come in a few decades. This estimation was based on the experiences of other demons with the Golden-Winged Roc bloodline.
It’s about time. I have to make every second count and kill Meng Chuan as soon as possible.
Meanwhile, Emperor Roc’s true body in the outer realm silently transcended the second tribulation on one of Three Bay River System’s barren planets.
Swoosh.
A golden beam of light shot up from the barren planet.
As he reached a higher realm, he naturally grasped many more means, like karma. Meng Chuan could already sense the obvious karma. As for Tribulation Eminences, they could clearly sense the karma threads that entangled them.
Emperor Roc and Meng Chuan.
One was the Demon Realm’s strongest expert, while the other was Archean Eon Realm’s strongest expert.
The war between the two worlds had been raging for many years, so the karma between Meng Chuan and Emperor Roc grew thicker. Although he found it difficult to determine Meng Chuan’s exact location, he could follow the karmic threads and chase after him. The closer he was, the clearer Meng Chuan’s location would be.
Meng Chuan, I’m coming. Emperor Roc’s true body in the outer realm had already entered the River of Spacetime and headed straight for the Ancient Magus River Zone.

chapters.title: Chapter 525 - Astray
chapters.content:
Chapter 525 Astray
One month, two months, three months... Half a year... One year...
I’ve already crossed three river zones. Why haven’t I sensed Meng Chuan’s exact location yet? Emperor Roc, who had spent a year traveling in the River of Spacetime, found it unbelievable.
As they were too far away from each other, he couldn’t determine Meng Chuan’s exact location. He could only sense Meng Chuan’s general direction.
To his surprise, even as a Second Tribulation Eminence with the Golden-Winged Roc bloodline, he was still unable to determine Meng Chuan’s exact location despite traveling for a year. How far did Meng Chuan flee? How much longer do I have to fly? Emperor Roc felt somewhat sad.
Back when Imperial Lord Starquix couldn’t determine his location, he wrote it off as Imperial Lord Starquix’s realm being too low. Now that it was his turn to make the trip, he felt the hardship.
As he flew, he could sense through karma that Meng Chuan seemed to be in front of him forever! This feeling of never seeing the end was indeed tormenting. However, Emperor Roc no longer thought about it.
At his level, he had great willpower and determination. He also knew that success didn’t come easy for many things. He would definitely experience many setbacks during the process. He had to clear them one by one before he could finally enjoy success.
If one year isn’t enough, then I’ll search for three years! If that’s still not enough, then I’ll search for ten years! I can still meditate and cultivate while traveling through the River of Spacetime. I want to see where Meng Chuan has fled to. Emperor Roc calmed down and prepared himself for the long haul.
Just like that, he transformed into a blurry golden beam of light and patiently flew through the River of Spacetime.
Ancient Magus River Zone, Heaven Peak River System.
In a massive Chaos Hole’s depths, a region where time flowed 47 times faster than the norm. Even newly-advanced Tribulation Eminences would find it difficult to resist this region’s gravitational force, much less a perfected Imperial Lord.
Chaos Hole. Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in the darkness and observed it silently.
His Chaos Hole Divine Body resembled a treasure or weapon. His Chaos Hole domain made Meng Chuan especially good at resisting the gravitational force. However, he couldn’t travel beyond this region; this was his limit.
He often stared into the Chaos Hole’s depths. The Chaos Hole’s seemed pitch-black, but upon closer inspection, Meng Chuan could sense spacetime distortions. The closer he got to the Chaos Hole’s core, the more beautiful the spacetime distortions became. The time flow also accelerated even more.
Beautiful. Meng Chuan appreciated this sight.
Although only eight years have passed in the outside world, I’ve been cultivating in the Chaos Hole for over 100 years. Meng Chuan discovered a problem. I spent 100 years cultivating alone. The Chaos Hole was my only companion. My state of mind has changed over time because I’ve been meditating. He had a seventh-level Essence Soul and obtained the Essence Soul Star legacy. He had also honed his mind since he was young... However, his personality still gradually changed as he cultivated in the Chaos Hole’s depths alone. This Chaos Hole affects spacetime and all things. It also affects one’s Essence Soul. It’s as if it wants everything to return to darkness and become still eternally.
Meng Chuan had another true body in his homeworld. He also had an Essence Soul avatar guarding Archean Mountain. He had Essence Soul avatars in Jiang State Capital, Snow Wind Pass, and other places. He often interacted with others. No matter how lonely his true body in the outer realm was, his personality shouldn’t have changed.
However, his personality still suffered changes.
What realm was Meng Chuan at? He didn’t notice it at first, but he realized his mental state’s minute changes over time. These changes were subtle, which was why they had gone unnoticed at first.
I’m getting affected by the Chaos Hole. It’s changing me gradually. My mental state has become even calmer. There are no fluctuations at all. It’s deathly still. It’s as though everything is about to die. Meng Chuan didn’t think that there was anything wrong with his state of mind. It remained extremely calm, as though he had transcended all things. He calmly watched the birth and the destruction of all things. However, he still made a decision. It’s been over 100 years. I’ll leave this place after cultivating for 20 more years.
Although such a mental state isn’t an obstruction to my cultivation-making me even calmer and more capable of comprehending the law profundities clearlythis is a change that happened because of the Chaos Hole. This is not a voluntary transformation of mine.
The Chaos Hole was indeed beneficial to his cultivation. Therefore, Meng Chuan decided to persist for 20 more years.
Infinite Saber. Meng Chuan drew Demon Slayer. Meng Chuan’s Quintessential Essence had nurtured Demon Slayer for a long time. As Meng Chuan’s realm improved, Demon Slayer slowly transformed. Now, it was an Imperial Lord-level weapon.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan swung his saber and tried to create an Imperial Lord-level saber move for Infinite Saber.
He spent most of his time cultivating in a region where the time flow was ten times faster than the norm. He would also occasionally cultivate in the region where he was at his limits.
Fifteen Lightning Forms. In the past few years, Meng Chuan had studied the 15 forms intensively. He had attempted to fuse many of them with Infinite Saber, running through all the different combinations.
Annihilate. Meng Chuan slashed out.
When he slashed out, his heart didn’t stir at all.
Whoosh!
The saber produced a weak sound, but a black saber beam flew out of it! Strictly speaking, the saber beam’s center was pitch-black, and its periphery was filled with lightning, outlining the black saber beam. The black saber beam was violent and unrestrained, but the interior was completely silent. The two completely opposite intents fused with the saber beam.
Rip!
The saber easily tore through the void.
Meng Chuan was at the Chaos Hole’s depth, where time flowed 47 times faster than usual. No matter how he tried, Meng Chuan couldn’t stir the void in the past.
Now, his saber could rip it apart.
This strike...? After swinging the saber, Meng Chuan was pleasantly surprised.
Swoosh.
He immediately turned his head and flew out of the region he was in. After flying for a long time, he arrived at the Chaos Hole accretion
disc.
Even ordinary Supremacies could resist the gravitational force around a Chaos Hole accretion disc. Meng Chuan’s cultivation was not affected here.
Annihilate. Meng Chuan swung his saber again.
Another black saber beam! The saber beam’s edges were lightning snakes. The interior was pitch-black and indestructible. Wherever it passed, the void would be annihilated. I succeeded? I’ve created an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique? Meng Chuan was overjoyed. Without a doubt, the might of this strike far exceeded his perfected Grotto-Heaven realm Infinite Saber. It had undergone a qualitative change! This was a move that could suppress ordinary perfected Imperial Lords. It definitely had the strength of a Tribulation Eminence.
After so many years, I’ve finally created it! I’ve created so many different Imperial Lord-level saber moves for my Infinite Saber, but they weren’t strong enough. However, this move’s might is about ten times stronger than my perfected Grotto Heaven realm Infinite Saber. Meng Chuan was delighted. This move definitely has the strength of a Tribulation Eminence.
Flash Form, Yin-Yang Form, Wave Splitting Forms, Infinite Forms, Perfect Harmonization Form... These five forms combined make the perfected Grotto-Heaven.
I’ve now fused the Nirvana Form into my Infinite Saber.
Light returns to Nirvana...
The saber move’s strength has also undergone a qualitative change. This should be an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique? Meng Chuan was overjoyed.
Meng Chuan began to study this move carefully.
It also has a huge influence on time. With this move, I can speed up the time flow by eighty-fold. Meng Chuan sighed in amazement. It has indeed greatly improved.
I’ll test out my speed next. Meng Chuan executed his movement technique in the Chaos Hole accretion disc.
Swoosh.
After his first try, Meng Chuan frowned slightly. Something’s not right. Meng Chuan continued. He executed his movement technique repeatedly.
Two hours, four hours, six hours...
Meng Chuan stood there silently.
My cultivation has gone astray? Meng Chuan had mixed emotions. Not only did my speed not increase, but it has actually decreased?
Ignoring the changed time flow, his perfected Grotto-Heaven realm Infinite Saber could increase his speed to 15,000 kilometers per second instantly when he was in the outer realm void—there was no resistance here. Ordinary Supremacies would slowly accelerate as they flew in the outer realm. An instant burst of speed could prove their strength. It was also useful in life-and-death battles.
Although he could accelerate the time flow even more, his actual speed had dropped! He could only travel 14,000 kilometers per second now!
What I’m pursuing is paramount speed. So how can one’s speed decrease when they break through from the Supremacy realm to the Imperial Lord realm? Something’s wrong. This move is still not it. This move is probably similar to Dark Lightning, Lightning Walk, and Lightning Fire Body Tempering Art. Although its strength seems to match an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique, it has obvious flaws.
This saber move shall be called Saber of Nirvana. It’s worth keeping it. However, there’s no need for me to cultivate it in depth. Meng Chuan understood this point. His Infinite Saber pursued pure speed in the Grotto-Heaven realm. Thus, something was obviously wrong when his speed decreased when using this Imperial Lord-level move. However, although it wasn’t a paramount technique, it didn’t mean it was weak. It still had the strength of an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique.
However, this saber move had flaws!
There was only one path without any flaws, and that was to create an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique! This was the only perfect, flawless path. Everything else was wrong With his Infinite Saber as the foundation, he had definitely made a mistake when he was creating an Imperial Lord-level saber move, which resulted in his speed decreasing.
This flaw was similar to the outer Imperial Lord-level ultimate techniques of the lightning lineage that Ancestral Master Archean Eon had left in Star Cluster Building. The more one cultivated the Lightning Fire Body Tempering Art, the greater the side-effects on one’s body. One would cultivate their body into a weapon in the end. One would have high combat strength, but they would never reach the Tribulation realm with it.
Dark Lightning and Lightning Walk had huge flaws as well...
If he continued cultivating Saber of Nirvana, there would be even greater side-effects, especially if he used it to cultivate his body and his dantian’s Chaos Hole. Towards the end, when a huge flaw appeared, it would be too late for regret.
Although this saber move is flawed, if it is improved to the perfected Heaven Earth realm, even Seventh Tribulation Eminences would keep this move in their collections. Meng Chuan laughed self-deprecatingly. However, what’s wrong is ultimately wrong.
Meng Chuan stood in the Chaos Hole accretion disc and silently stared into the Chaos Hole’s depths. How can I create an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique?

chapters.title: Chapter 526 - Grotto-Heaven Pavilion’s Lecture
chapters.content:
Chapter 526 Grotto-Heaven Pavilion’s Lecture
Although Saber of Nirvana wasn’t an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique, it was still a Tribulation-level ultimate technique.
By fusing Saber of Nirvana’s intent into his Body-Protecting Peacock Robe during combat, he could increase his strength in every aspect.
As long as I don’t use it to cultivate my body, dantian, and Essence Soul, it won’t bring me any harm. After all, I’m just using it as a combat technique. Meng Chuan knew this very well. This was because Ancestral Master Archean Eon had left behind records regarding techniques like Dark Lightning. It was fine if one used such techniques for reference, but if one used such a technique to cultivate their Godfiend body or Essence Soul, huge flaws would crop up.
Archean Eon Realm and the Demon Realm are getting closer. It’s very likely that a demon sage passageway will appear. The demons will do anything to obtain a Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s treasures. The more powerful I am, the more confident I will be.
Next, Meng Chuan dedicated 20-30% of his time to studying Saber of Nirvana. He consolidated it and fused it with his combat style. Although he wouldn’t use this move to become an Imperial Lord, the move’s profundity allowed his strength to increase significantly
Archean Eon Realm, Archean Mountain. 25th March, morning. The sun was shining brightly as many disciples rushed towards Grotto-Heaven Pavilion.
Grotto-Heaven Pavilion had three lectures every month. This was a rule that appeared and consolidated itself over time.
“Hurry up.”
“You can arrive early on lecture day, but you can’t be late.”
Many disciples rushed to Grotto-Heaven Pavilion. Grotto-Heaven Pavilion had many prayer mats. The disciples sat down on them obediently.
“The seating arrangement has changed again. I heard that a genius disciple has been recruited this time.”
“It’s King Clear Snow’s daughter, Yan Lihua. She’s only 13 years old this year and has already comprehended Force.”
“As expected of a Regis Godfiend’s daughter. I heard that Yan Lihua’s grandfather is King Calm Sea! King Calm Sea’s strength is extraordinary, but he’s keeping a low profile now.”
These disciples discussed silently.
Yan Lihua was a girl who still appeared young. She was currently sitting cross-legged on a mat in Grotto-Heaven Pavillion’s second row. She didn’t speak to any of her fellow disciples, appearing rather lonesome. However, she raised her head slightly, her eyes sharp.
Gradually, Grotto-Heaven Pavilion was filled with disciples; the disciples discussed softly. Suddenly, it fell silent.
Oh? Yan Lihua also sensed something.
The surrounding world changed as though it had been isolated from the outside world. Even spacetime changed.
A white-haired man walked in. He was the center of the spacetime distortions—the center of the world. His eyes were gentle as he smiled at the disciples.
“Greetings, Master.” All the disciples stood up and bowed respectfully. They even appeared extremely pious.
Although there were only three lectures every month, they would be thrilled to see Imperial Lord Eastcalm—the strongest Godfiend in the world, who had changed the war situation single-handedly-every time they faced him.
Ignoring ordinary disciples like them, even Marquis Godfiends and Regis Godfiends yearned to listen to Imperial Lord Eastcalm’s lectures! Although Meng Chuan never claimed to be an Imperial Lord, the entire world’s Godfiends addressed him as Imperial Lord Eastcalm privately. As Archean Mountain’s leader, Meng Chuan held one lecture every year, which all of the world’s Marquis Godfiends, Regis Godfiends, and Supremacies could attend. When they attended his lectures, they would become more respectful towards the admirable Imperial Lord Eastcalm every time they asked Meng Chuan questions. Every time he answered their questions, they could sense the difference in strength between them.
It was only because of this chasm in strength that Meng Chuan could easily guide Marquis Godfiends, Regis Godfiends, and even Supremacies.
Due to his high realm, everyone respectfully addressed him as Imperial Lord Eastcalm from the bottom of their hearts.
In fact, his self-created Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique had already reached the Heaven Earth realm’s late stage! He had also mastered Selfless Formless Swords’ five paintings. In regards to the void lineage, his attainments were very close to the perfected Heaven Earth realm.
His paramount technique, Infinite Saber, was at the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm. In regards to the time lineage, it was very close to a perfected Imperial Lord that specialized in the time lineage.
He was proficient in both the time lineage and spatial lineage. Because of this, Meng Chuan could understand many Marquis, Regis, and Supremacy-level techniques. He gave suitable pointers each time he answered.
Meng Chuan was willing to hold lectures for all of the world’s Godfiends because his horizons had been broadened as he roamed the outer realm. Out in the outer realm, he had seen too many cultivators who were the strongest experts in their homeworlds.
Meng Chuan naturally treated each inhabited world as a whole. Two World Island, Black Sand Grotto-Heaven, and others were all part of the human race. As Archean Eon Realm’s strongest expert, Meng Chuan felt that it was only right for him to guide the entire human race for the long, foreseeable future.
This selfless sharing of knowledge was also the reason why the world’s Godfiends respected him more.
Due to his lectures, the number of newly-advanced Regis Godfiends in the past few decades had increased significantly.
This was what cultivation was like. With a mighty figure guiding them, the entire era would receive an uplift. Many talents would be born during such an era.
Even with his current strength, Meng Chuan was ranked in humanity’s top ten historical experts.
“Have a seat,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
All the disciples sat down.
Meng Chuan’s gaze swept across Yan Lihua.
This little fellow has already grown up, thought Meng Chuan to himself. He had a good relationship with Yan Jin. The last time he met Yan Jin, Yan Lihua was still in her swaddling clothes. She was chubby and had quite a big appetite.
Meng Chuan answered questions and lectured as usual.
Back then, Qin Wu presided over Archean Mountain. Li Guan had that role before him. Now, it was Meng Chuan’s turn.
As this era’s strongest Godfiend, Meng Chuan’s status as Archean Mountain’s leader would last for years—even hundreds or thousands of years... Archean Mountain would recruit generations of Godfiends and their descendants. With Meng Chuan being in charge of Archean Mountain for the foreseeable future, he was every future Godfiend generation’s master.
“Let’s end the lecture today. You are dismissed.” Meng Chuan’s gaze landed on Yan Lihua. “Lihua, stay behind.”
The other disciples stood up and bowed respectfully before leaving. Yan Lihua stood there nervously. Although she wasn’t afraid of anything before she came to Archean Mountain, she was still very nervous when facing the legendary Imperial Lord Eastcalm.
“The last time I saw you, you were still a baby,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “You’ve grown up in the blink of an eye. Is your father doing okay?”
“Master,” said Yan Lihua respectfully, “my father accompanies mother every day. He’s living quite happily.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Okay.”
Yan Lihua’s mother was truly an extraordinary woman.
After accompanying Yan Jin for so many years, she finally became Yan Jin’s wife. She completely changed Yan Jin; she thawed the cold Yan Jin, making him gentle and friendly. Of course, Yan Jin’s change might have something to do with King Calm Sea. Meng Chuan had long told him everything about King Calm Sea.
Meng Chuan looked at Yan Li Hua.
Generation after generation.
The children had all grown up.
As for the elders?
Dad is getting older. When Meng Chuan thought of this, he felt somewhat uncomfortable.
Although Meng Chuan tried his best to improve his father’s body and make up for his father’s damaged body caused by his forced cultivation, Great Solar Godfiends only had 200-year lifespans. Even if his father was healed from all the damage, he probably wouldn’t be able to last ten more years. I’m afraid Dad won’t be able to hold on for more than ten years. Father-in-law is slightly better, but he can only hold on for a few more years.
The River of Spacetime.
Emperor Roc flew for more than a year before finally arriving at the Ancient Magus River Zone.
Oh? The moment he flew into the Ancient Magus River Zone, Emperor Roc could vaguely sense Meng Chuan’s location through karma.
Found him. I’ve finally found him. He’s in Ancient Magus River Zone. Emperor Roc was somewhat excited.
Across river zones, too many obstacles blocked one’s perception of karma.
With Emperor Roc’s current cultivation, he found it difficult to determine Meng Chuan’s exact location when he was in a different river zone. Now, he was finally certain of Meng Chuan’s exact location.
He’s in a river system in the Ancient Magus River Zone’s center. I’ll probably arrive there in a month. Emperor Roc was filled with anticipation.

chapters.title: Chapter 527 - Emperor Roc and Meng Chuan
chapters.content:
Chapter 527 Emperor Roc and Meng Chuan
More than a month later.
Emperor Roc arrived at Heaven Peak River System. Following the clearer karmic connection, he arrived at the Chaos Hole.
No matter how good he is at fleeing, that punk from Archean Eon Realm will not be able to escape me. Emperor Roc flew through the River of Spacetime for over a year before finally finding Meng Chuan, who had fled to the Ancient Magus River Zone. He was rather excited.
He actually ran into a Chaos Hole? Emperor Roc became even more cautious. He blocked all possible spying means and carefully flew into the Chaos Hole.
After becoming a Tribulation Eminence, although I can easily use karma to kill enemies, I still don’t have a deep understanding of karma. As Emperor Roc flew, he thought to himself, The most appropriate way to deal with Meng Chuan is to capture him alive and seal all his strength, preventing him from committing suicide. After that, I’ll return to Three Bay River System and find a Fourth Tribulation Eminence that’s good at karma. I’ll hire him to kill Meng Chuan’s other true body using the one that I have captive.
If one relied on karma to kill enemies, the attack would be much stronger with a medium. Such mediums could be the other party’s blood and hair.
Of course, the best medium was the other party’s complete true body! A true body’s connection with the other true body... had the strongest karmic connection. I’ll capture his true body alive. He’ll definitely die once I hire a Fourth Tribulation Eminence to do the deed.
Fourth Tribulation Eminences who are skilled in karma can typically kill a perfected Imperial Lord when they have the other party’s complete true body. It will naturally be easy to kill Meng Chuan. I’m ultimately much weaker than a Fourth Tribulation Eminence. I’m not good at karma either. Even with the other party’s true body, I can barely kill an early-stage Imperial Lord. I might not be able to kill all of Meng Chuan’s avatars.
He only had one chance to attack Meng Chuan. Since it concerned Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures, Emperor Roc naturally wanted to choose the best and safest solution.
Emperor Roc hid in the void and silently flew towards the Chaos Hole accretion disc.
He’s gone that deep into the Chaos Hole? Emperor Roc frowned slightly. Through karma, he could clearly confirm that Meng Chuan had gone quite deep into the Chaos Hole.
Chaos Holes are so dangerous. How deep did he go? Emperor Roc was secretly puzzled.
As he flew further into the Chaos Hole, the time flow around him also changed.
In the Chaos Hole’s depths, at a region where the time flow was 35 times faster.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in the silent darkness, projecting his Chaos Hole domain outwards. Only by combining his Chaos Hole domain and Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence could the Chaos Hole domain’s strength reach its maximum. With Saber of Still Quiescene’s profundities as the foundation, Meng Chuan’s Quintessential Essence circulation through the Chaos Hole domain became even more exquisite. With just his domain, Meng Chuan was able to withstand the gravitational pull. Before this, his Chaos Hole domain could only withstand the gravitational pull at a region with ten-fold faster time flow. This showed just how astonishingly strong his Chaos Hole domain became after improving his perfected Grotto-Heaven realm paramount technique to the Heaven Earth realm.
Although Saber of Nirvana had flaws, its strength was comparable to an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique. Time passed as he cultivated.
It was extremely silent. It was as though he and the Chaos Hole’s core were the only things in the void.
The Chaos Hole’s core distorted spacetime freely as Meng Chuan resisted the spacetime distortions.
Oh? Meng Chuan frowned slightly.
Other than himself and the Chaos Hole’s core, another existence had appeared in his perception range. The existence secretly approached him. However, with Lightning Domain Seal-a Fifth Tribulation treasure—aiding him, Meng Chuan could sense the void extremely clearly, despite the treasure not being very useful when affected by the Chaos Hole’s gravitational pull.
An outsider is approaching me furtively. Meng Chuan’s heart palpitated.
In the outer realm...
It was very common for complete strangers to attack suddenly.
Who is it? Why is he secretly approaching me? Could it be that he’s better at reconnaissance and discovered me from afar? Meng Chuan became even more cautious as he prepared all sorts of treasures.
Even now, Meng Chuan didn’t realize that the person was Emperor Roc.
The weaker one was, the blurrier their karma perception. Ordinary Godfiends couldn’t sense karma at all. After reaching the Chaos Hole realm, Meng Chuan could sense karma. However, he couldn’t clearly identify the person approaching him through karma due to various reasons.
Meng Chuan could clearly sense the karmic connection between Emperor Roc and himself, but the karmic threads’ trajectory was blurry and hard to see. Typically, it would be the heavenly secrets that blocked him from prying into it.
For example, the stronger one was, the harder it was to spy on them.
Meng Chuan was a Chaos Hole realm expert. In essence, he was slightly inferior to an Imperial Lord. So it was naturally impossible for him to spy on a Tribulation Eminence.
On the other hand, a Tribulation Eminence could sense Imperial Lords and Supremacies extremely clearly through karma.
I can’t wait here foolishly. Meng Chuan stopped cultivating and pretended to be calm as he continued flying deeper into the Chaos Hole.
The closer one was to a Chaos Hole’s core, the more distorted spacetime became.
The time flow acceleration increased from 35-fold to 36-fold; it then increased to 37-fold and so... The time flow around Meng Chuan rapidly accelerated.
Oh? Why did he continue flying in? He’s a newly-advanced Imperial Lord. How can he withstand the Chaos Hole’s gravitational pull? Emperor Roc was already very shocked. He found it somewhat difficult to resist the gravitational pull. Furthermore, why did he suddenly fly in? Did he discover me?
Emperor Roc immediately accelerated.
The moment he acceleratedOh? Meng Chuan’s expression changed slightly. He didn’t want this person to get close to him, so he had accelerated as well.
He accelerated as well? He really has discovered me. A sharp glint flashed in Emperor Roc’s eyes. However, I can capture him from such a distance.
Meng Chuan had already flown to a region where time flowed 45 times faster. He suddenly sensed something and turned his head.
Boom!
A huge golden palm appeared.
The moment it appeared, it covered the surrounding void. Countless runes could be seen on the golden palm. The void froze as the golden palm descended.
At the other end of the golden palm, Meng Chuan used his Lightning Domain Seal to sense Emperor Roc. However, Emperor Roc’s aura was even more terrifying than an Imperial Lord’s. With Meng Chuan’s experience of dealing with many cultivators on Black Dragon Planet, he instantly determined: It’s Emperor Roc. Furthermore, it has already reached the Tribulation realm!
Meng Chuan shuddered.
Boom!
The void distorted as the golden palm grabbed at everything in the vast void.
Meng Chuan understood something after seeing the palm. Emperor Roc’s accomplishments in the void lineage are much higher than mine.
He wasn’t surprised.
Just like how having the phoenix bloodline made one talented at the fire lineage, having the Golden-Winged Roc bloodline meant that one would be talented at the void lineage.
Back when World Entrances hadn’t appeared in Archean Eon Realm and the Demon Realm, human Supremacies often went to the outer realm. Back then, the demons’ Emperor Roc was already rather famous! It wasn’t a secret that Emperor Roc had the Golden-Winged Roc bloodline.
It has the Golden-Winged Roc bloodline. Once it reaches the Tribulation realm, it will be comparable to a Third Tribulation Eminence.
In terms of profundities, my Saber of Nirvana might be comparable to a Third Tribulation Eminence. However, my body and Quintessential Essence are far inferior to a Tribulation Eminence’s. Meng Chuan knew this very well. I’m not its match.
In terms of technique realm, a perfected Imperial Lord was the same as a Physical Body Tribulation Eminence. Both were perfected Heaven Earth realm experts. However, the qualitative changes in one’s body and powers that occur after reaching the Tribulation realm magnified the strength difference between them.
In terms of technique realm, Meng Chuan was close to Emperor Roc with Saber of Nirvana. However, his opponent had a Tribulation realm body and Tribulation realm demonic power. Emperor Roc’s strength far exceeded his.
If he had used Saber of Nirvana to become an Imperial Lord, his body and Quintessential Essence would have greatly improved, giving him the confidence to fight Emperor Roc. However, he knew that Saber of Nirvana was flawed. It was impossible for Meng Chuan to use it as his foundation to break through to the Imperial Lord realm.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan stepped on the Bloodblade Disc and increased his speed to the maximum. At the same time, he accelerated and flew faster.
The time flow acceleration sped up to 47-fold, 48-fold, 49-fold, 50-fold...
Meng Chuan flew into the Chaos Hole’s depths without any regard for anything else. The time flow acceleration naturally became more ludicrous as he flew into the Chaos Hole’s depths. What? The gigantic golden palm grabbed at Meng Chuan.
Although the sealed void made teleportation difficult, Meng Chuan still managed to fly out of the golden palm’s range with his speed.
Whoosh.
The golden palm extended forward and reached further into the Chaos Hole for Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan continued flying in!
Finally, the golden palm didn’t extend any further.
In the outside world, Emperor Roc’s palm could envelop a much larger area, but it could only envelop a smaller area when affected by the spacetime distortions in the Chaos Hole’s depths. The closer he got to the Chaos Hole’s core, the smaller the area his attacks could cover. Naturally, he failed to capture Meng Chuan.
I can’t grab him anymore. Forget it. If I can’t capture him alive and have a Fourth Tribulation Eminence kill him through karma, I’ll do so myself. I’ll kill him.
A golden beam flew out and instantly pierced through the void, striking Meng Chuan.

chapters.title: Chapter 528 - Trapped
chapters.content:
Chapter 528 Trapped
The demons had sacrificed too much for the Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s treasures. After realizing that it was difficult to capture him alive, Emperor Roc didn’t hesitate to use his strongest killing blow. He wanted to kill Meng Chuan’s true body and use karma to kill all his avatars. He wanted to kill the human, Meng Chuan, completely!
“Die!” Emperor Roc’s eyes were filled with anticipation. He looked forward to Meng Chuan’s death. He wanted to make their greatest obstacle in Archean Eon Realm vanish!
Huh? Meng Chuan—who was fleeing on his Bloodblade Disc—was able to sense his surroundings with his Lightning Domain Seal aiding him. He clearly discovered a golden spear piercing through the void and appearing in the void five kilometers away from him.
Thankfully, after comprehending Saber of Nirvana, his Chaos Hole domain’s profundity had improved greatly. Likewise, its strength increased greatly; otherwise, the spear would’ve already appeared in front of Meng Chuan.
The golden spear’s body was covered in silver runes.
This was the strongest treasure Emperor Roc used when roaming the outer realm. It was a Sixth Tribulation treasure—Void Impalement Spear. It was especially compatible with the Golden-Winged Roc bloodline. Typically, only demon Imperial Lords with the Golden-Winged Roc bloodline were qualified to take this Sixth Tribulation treasure away from Demon Ancestral Cave.
Not good. Meng Chuan—who was fleeing at high speed on the Bloodblade Disc-was alarmed when he saw the golden spear appear outside his Chaos Hole domain. The surrounding Bloodblades quickly protected
him.
Rip!
The spear was five kilometers away from Meng Chuan, and he was fleeing at high speed. The golden spear instantly freed itself from the Lightning Domain Seal’s suppression. With the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique, Meng Chuan could suppress ordinary Imperial Lords with the Lightning Domain Seal. It could even affect perfected Imperial Lords. However, the golden spear didn’t suffer any damage at all. It also broke through the Lightning Domain Seal’s suppression.
An Imperial Lord’s full-powered strike wouldn’t even be able to come close to Meng Chuan because of the repulsive force of his Chaos Hole domain—which had his Saber of Nirvana’s profundities fused within. However, the golden spear instantly penetrated his Chaos Hole domain.
Boom!
The golden spear blasted through the 36 Bloodblades that were most well-known for their defensive capabilities.
Clang!
Meng Chuan’s Body-Protecting Peacock Robe was also instantly penetrated.
The golden spear stabbed into Meng Chuan’s chest. After the Body-Protecting Peacock Robe was torn apart, Meng Chuan’s pale-white clothes were revealed. This was a Fifth Tribulation treasure-Nightcloud Robe—which Meng Chuan had bought. It didn’t have any other uses. It was purely a defensive treasure. He wore the Nightcloud Robe all the time! However, such a defensive treasure was actually quite expensive.
Boom!
After being weakened by the Nightcloud Robe, the terrifying impact struck Meng Chuan.
Like a meteor, Meng Chuan rushed into the Chaos Hole’s depths at greater speeds.
Huh? Emperor Roc, who was chasing Meng Chuan, looked at this scene in shock. How is this possible?
With a wave of his hand, the Void Impalement Spear flew back into Emperor Roc’s palm.
I used my full strength. How did it not even blast apart his body? Emperor Roc found it unbelievable.
Even if Meng Chuan had a defensive Tribulation treasure, the remnant force would still affect his entire body. Even with 10-20% of its strength remaining, the spear attack was still enough to kill a perfected Imperial Lord. However, Meng Chuan’s body remained intact.
Did he have an Indestructible Talisman or other similar talismans? Emperor Roc guessed.
Once an Indestructible Talisman was used, one could withstand all external attacks.
Typically, one’s attack had to have the strength of a Fifth Tribulation Eminence to break an Indestructible Talisman. A Third Tribulation Eminence would probably take dozens of strikes to exhaust an Indestructible Talisman’s strength.
An Indestructible Talisman is worth 15 Outer Realm Essence Crystals. He actually bought one willingly? Humph, it’s useless. As long as I capture him alive, he’ll still die even if he has treasures protecting him. Emperor Roc gritted his teeth and rushed into the Chaos Hole’s depths, continuing his pursuit.
Single-use treasures ranged from extremely precious Void Transference Talismans to Life Substitute Talismans, which were much cheaper-all of them contained powers that could be used directly.
However, these talismans had one flaw—they couldn’t store too much energy because of the materials they were made of. Therefore, these talismans contained extremely profound and mysterious laws, but they didn’t have much strength.
What a powerful strike. Meng Chuan recovered from the blow.
It broke through my Lightning Domain, Chaos Hole domain, 36 Bloodblades, and Body-Protecting Peacock Robe in a row. Meng Chuan was secretly alarmed. The Nightcloud Robe blocked the Tribulation treasure’s remnant strength, but it still made me uncomfortable.
Meng Chuan’s body was very special. After cultivating the Chaos Hole Divine Body, he could fight a perfected Imperial Lord with his body alone. After absorbing a Primordial Stone, Meng Chuan’s body became like a Dharma treasure. It was extremely tough. This was why he survived this time. After being struck by Emperor Roc’s weakened full-strength strike, Meng Chuan’s body remained intact.
If I didn’t have the domains or treasures, my body probably wouldn’t have been able to withstand it.
A Third Tribulation Eminence was considered rather powerful among Tribulation Eminences. They could kill newly-advanced Tribulation Eminences with a flip of a hand. As for dealing with a perfected Imperial Lord? Just like an Imperial Lord could easily kill a newly-advanced Supremacy, a Third Tribulation Eminence could easily slaughter a perfected Imperial Lord.
It was only because Meng Chuan had comprehended Saber of Nirvana, raising his technique realm and strength greatly, that he could escape Emperor Roc’s palm strike. Otherwise, with his former strength that was comparable to a perfected Imperial Lord, Meng Chuan could only sacrifice his true body. The treasures on him would benefit Emperor Roc.
As for now? Meng Chuan—who had 20-30% of Emperor Roc’s strength-was especially good at staying alive. At the very least, he could stall for time if he maintained some distance between them.
Even if my body can’t withstand it, I still have a Life Substitute Talisman. Meng Chuan didn’t panic. As long as I hide far away and don’t let him capture me alive, he won’t be able to do anything to me.
Meng Chuan constantly flew deeper into the Chaos Hole.
The time flow acceleration went from 55-fold to 56-fold to 57-fold...
He’s still flying deeper? Emperor Roc, who was chasing from behind, gradually found it difficult to believe his eyes. How can a newly-advanced Imperial Lord withstand such a powerful Chaos Hole’s gravitational pull?
Emperor Roc stopped at a region where time flowed 58 times faster.
He had a powerful Tribulation realm body that was comparable to a Third Tribulation Eminence’s. However, he had already reached his limits, so he didn’t dare venture any further.
If he went any deeper, a slight moment of inattention would result in him being unable to resist the gravitational pull. If that happened, he wouldn’t be able to escape the Chaos Hole. This true body of his would die.
I’m already almost at my limits here.However, he’s still flying in? Emperor Roc floated in midair. The Chaos Hole was too terrifying. He had to leave some buffer for himself, so he didn’t dare go deeper.
Meng Chuan stopped when he reached a region where time flowed 60-fold faster. The region where time flows 62-fold faster is my limit. Meng Chuan knew this very well.
Both sides were equal in regards to technique realm, but Meng Chuan’s cultivation was extremely similar to a Chaos Hole. His Chaos Hole domain was also especially good at blocking the Chaos Hole’s gravitational force. Because of this, he could reach the region where time flowed 62-fold faster.
However, I’m still 15 million kilometers away from it. Even if I head into the region where time flows 62-fold faster, I’ll only be an extra 10 million kilometers away from it. I won’t be able to escape its prying eyes. Meng Chuan understood this. The deeper he went into the Chaos Hole, the faster time flowed.
Tens of millions of kilometers? At that distance, even Meng Chuan could sense people through the void, much less Emperor Roc, who was even more skilled in the void lineage.
However, it looks like it doesn’t dare go any further. The corners of Meng Chuan’s mouth curled into a smile. He sat cross-legged in the darkness.
I can’t reach that area. Emperor Roc sensed Meng Chuan from afar. He could clearly see Meng Chuan through the void, but he couldn’t approach him.
Even if he tried his best to approach Meng Chuan, he would only be able to travel another five million kilometers into the Chaos Hole’s depths. This was his limit. Any further and an accident could befall upon him.
He’s a newly-advanced Imperial Lord. He must have a rare treasure that’s good at resisting a Chaos Hole’s gravitational pull if he can go so deep into the Chaos Hole, guessed Emperor Roc.
Emperor Roc was vexed as well. He wanted to find a Tribulation Eminence that could enter the Chaos Hole’s depths and deal with Meng Chuan. However, he was a newly-advanced Tribulation Eminence. He didn’t have many connections in the Tribulation Eminences’ circle. He also wasn’t very familiar with Ancient Magus River Zone’s Heaven Peak River System. Either way, this true body of his has to monitor Meng Chuan all the time. There was no way he could get his avatar to hire an Eminence.
Furthermore, a Tribulation Eminence wouldn’t be willing to risk going into a Chaos Hole’s depths. After all, a Chaos Hole was ultimately a very dangerous celestial body.
I’ll think of a solution first. If there’s really nothing I can do, I’ll invite a Fourth Tribulation Eminence from Three Bay River System, thought Emperor Roc. However, the connection between the Demon Realm and Archean Eon Realm isn’t a secret in Three Bay River System. Once I invite a Fourth Tribulation Eminence... that Fourth Tribulation Eminence will definitely take the opportunity to fleece me. Emperor Roc frowned slightly. Unless necessary, he was unwilling to invite a Fourth Tribulation Eminence from Three Bay River System. His best choice was to use Outer Realm Essence Crystals to hire the help of an unfamiliar Fourth Tribulation from another river zone.
I’ll wait and see first. Staying in the Chaos Hole’s depths for a long time will affect his body and Essence Soul. After some time, he might not be able to withstand it. Emperor Roc knew the dangers of Chaos Holes.
Meng Chuan was very patient. If I can’t escape, I’d rather die than benefit Emperor Roc.Furthermore, I should be able to fight him as long as I make a major breakthrough. He had two choices. One, he let himself fall into the Chaos Hole’s depths, letting his treasures get sucked towards the Chaos Hole’s core. Two, head out and battle Emperor Roc once his strength increased greatly. As for the strength difference between them now? He could only bear with it for the time being.
Up to now, I’ve only fled and withstood that strike. It probably believes that I don’t have enough strength to fight it head-on. It is probably thinking that I’m relying on talismans and other items. That’s good. The less it knows about my strength, the greater my chances of succeeding.
Just like that, Meng Chuan patiently hid in the Chaos Hole’s depths. He immersed himself in his cultivation while Emperor Roc silently monitored him.
Affected by the Chaos Hole’s gravitational pull, Emperor Roc carefully checked his body. Withstanding the terrifying gravitational force was also testing his body. Emperor Roc carefully and slowly perfected his body.
Only a year had passed in the outside world. However, nearly 60 years had passed in the Chaos Hole’s depths where Meng Chuan and Emperor Roc were.
As for Emperor Roc’s third Physical Body Tribulation, it had descended.

chapters.title: Chapter 529 - Tribulation Transcendence and Passageway
chapters.content:
Chapter 529 Tribulation Transcendence and Passageway
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in the Chaos Hole’s depths. With the Lightning Domain Seal aiding him, he carefully sensed his pitch-black surroundings. Emperor Roc had long vanished. Emperor Roc is hiding in the distance and hasn’t left. Meng Chuan frowned slightly. He had tried escaping before, but when he arrived at the Chaos Hole’s periphery, Emperor Roc suddenly appeared and intercepted him. Meng Chuan barely managed to escape back into the Chaos Hole’s depths.
With karma, it can lock onto my location at any time. Once I escape, it will be able to sense everything. Once I fall into the array formation trap it has set up, it will be over. It’s fine if this true body dies, but I can’t let the treasures on me fall into its hands.
Forget it. Unless my strength increases to the point that I can fight it head-on, I’ll hide in the Chaos Hole’s depths.
The difference in life order between the two parties was huge. The other party could easily lock onto him through karma, but he couldn’t sense Emperor Roc. It was best for him to hide patiently.
At that moment, Emperor Roc hid in the void outside the Chaos Hole accretion disc. He set up an array formation in the vicinity. The array formation isolated any external prying. Emperor Roc was currently experiencing his third Physical Body Tribulation. Blood-colored fog—which came from the void -constantly seeped into Emperor Roc’s body. Emperor Roc transformed into a Golden-Winged Roc as the blood fog enveloped him, seeping into every feather and changing his body.
“Roar!” Emperor Roc’s eyes suffused a sanguine glow as his breathing turned heavy.
His golden wings gradually transformed into blood-red wings. Chi! Chi! Chi!
On his back, a second pair of wings slowly emerged as it grew, spreading to its heart’s content. Following that, a third pair of wings slowly grew. As for Emperor Roc, the bloody glow in his eyes turned brighter.
Expel! Emperor Roc gritted his teeth and roared.
Golden light bloomed from his body; the golden light tore through the blood fog.
The blood-red wings shattered, and the blood on the surface of his body gradually disintegrated. However, the blood-red wings continued growing as they shattered repeatedly.
Shatter, growth, shatter, growth...
After struggling for 14 hours, the sanguine glow in Emperor Roc’s eyes gradually receded as the golden light gained the upper hand.
Finally, the golden glow enveloped his entire body, and he returned to his Golden-Winged Roc form.
I’ve succeeded. Emperor Roc seemed to have lost half his lifeforce. He was extremely exhausted, and his eyes were filled with lingering fear. I never expected that I would nearly fail the third tribulation. What if it’s the much more terrifying fourth tribulation?
Tribulation Transcendence...
The first two tribulations were relatively easy to transcend. As long as one accumulated enough strength, they could typically survive the first two tribulations.
However, from the third tribulation and onwards, every tribulation’s strength changed qualitatively! Furthermore, the further one progressed, the more exaggerated the increase in strength became. The difficulty of transcending tribulations became even more exaggerated! Unless my strength improves greatly and I’m completely confident, I definitely can’t transcend the next tribulation. Emperor Roc was truly afraid. The past 14 hours had been a more difficult time for him than the past 7,000 years. Every moment had been a life-and-death struggle. After struggling for more than 14 hours, he finally transcended his third tribulation.
Outer realm cultivators only saw Tribulation Eminences’ might, but they didn’t know how torturous each Heavenly Tribulation was.
For example, Archean Eon Realm.
Due to their short history, apart from Ancestral Master Archean Eon, only three Essence Soul Tribulation realm experts were born. None of them had reached the Fourth Tribulation realm. Most of the time, a river system’s strongest expert was a Fourth Tribulation Eminence.
Therefore, when Patriarch Black Dragon was nearing the end of his lifespan, he couldn’t find a suitable Fifth Tribulation Eminence to hand over Heaven Peak River System to. To a Fifth Tribulation Eminence, a river system was no longer attractive. Black Fiend Hall’s Fifth Tribulation realm experts were only interested in ‘harvesting.’ After reaping the harvest, they would search for other river systems to target.
Emperor Roc survived his third Physical Body Tribulation with great difficulty, but that remained unknown to Meng Chuan, who remained hiding in the Chaos Hole’s depths.
Time passed. Meng Chuan had been hiding in the Chaos Hole’s depths for more than three years. However, his actual cultivation time was even longer. In the World Gap between Archean Eon Realm and the Demon Realm, King Calm Sea-who looked like he had been carved from dark-cyan ice-stood at the edge of the World Gap. He looked ahead solemnly.
The world membrane has closed.
King Calm Sea looked ahead.
The world membrane in front of him and the world membrane in other areas had completely fused together. The World Gap had completed its formation process. As the world membrane completely closed and isolated itself from the outer realm, the World Gap was extremely complete. The World Gap no longer had any scenes of a forming world. The World Gap has formed completely. It’s perfect; there are no flaws. According to Master and company, once the World Gap has completely formed, it means that the connection between Archean Eon Realm and the Demon Realm is at its strongest. It’s also when the two worlds are closest to one another. King Calm Sea was extremely solemn. This is the human world’s most dangerous period. I have to report to Archean Mountain immediately.
Archean Mountain, Grotto-Heaven Pavilion.
Meng Chuan, Qin Wu, Luo Tang, and Meng An were gathered together.
“Xue Ting sent news of the World Gap completely forming.” Qin Wu was extremely solemn. “The world will probably undergo huge changes soon.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. “I can see that many World Entrances have expanded greatly.”
At his realm, he could clearly sense any World Entrances in the world.
“Dad, a demon sage passageway might appear in the near future, right?” asked Meng An.
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded. “A demon sage passageway might appear in the next few days. If a demon sage passageway doesn’t appear in the next few days, it will probably never appear.”
“I hope one never appears,” said Luo Tang. “If one never appears, the demons that exit the super-large World Entrances will just be sending themselves to their deaths. They would have no hope of winning this war at all.”
“We have to be prepared for the worst,” said Qin Wu solemnly.
All of humanity’s upper echelons were on high alert because the next few days were most critical.
After the World Gap had completely formed, Archean Eon Realm changed drastically.
The number of small-sized, medium-sized, large, and super-large World Entrances increased. The human Godfiends were extremely cautious. However, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars were guarding the various areas. He was also controlling a large number of demon servants. Even a large group of fifth Firmament demon monarchs were his servants. The demons didn’t enter the human world because it was suicidal.
The third morning after the World Gap finished forming.
Luo Tang Pass.
The Grand Zhou Dynasty’s earliest super-large city pass was already very noisy in the morning. People were already rushing about with their daily lives.
As for the inner city pass, it was completely silent. Ordinary people were forbidden from approaching. The Godfiends and demon servants on the city wall were responsible for guarding it. An array formation was set up at the inner city pass. As long as Supremacy Luo Tang controlled this fixed array formation, even Monarch Peacock and Holy Lady Strings wouldn’t be able to touch it.
The World Entrance has become a little larger again. The Godfiends and demon servants observed the massive World Entrance.
Luo Tang Pass’s World Entrance was 19.5 kilometers wide. Such a length was equivalent to the width of a city!
Through the World Entrance, the Godfiends and demon servants could clearly see the vast Demon Realm.
The Demon Realm and Archean Eon Realm seemed to be one in front of such a massive World Entrance.
Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!
The World Entrance slowly trembled and grew. Ten feet, twenty feet, thirty feet... It slowly expanded.
The Godfiends and demon servants carefully observed the World Entrance’s borders. They inspected the World Entrance from their respective positions and accurately determined how much the World Entrance was expanding.
Suddenly,
Boom!
It was like thunder. An extremely deep rumble sounded, causing the hearts of every Godfiend and demon servant to palpitate. The World Entrance—which was 19.5 kilometers wide-suddenly expanded as the two worlds collided and warped.
The World Entrance expanded greatly.
The Godfiends and demon servants—who were in charge of monitoring the World Entrancecould not see the edges of the massive World Entrance with their naked eyes’ field of view. The World Entrance expanded greatly, tearing apart an extremely vast plantation.
“This, this...” The Godfiends and demon servants were shocked.
Swoosh.
Luo Tang appeared in midair and stared at the massive World Entrance solemnly.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar appeared in midair as it carefully examined the World Entrance. “Meng Chuan, is this a demon sage passageway?” asked Luo Tang.

chapters.title: Chapter 530 - Demon Sage Passageway
chapters.content:
Chapter 530 Demon Sage Passageway
“I don’t know.” Meng Chuan shook his head gently. Although he had a lot of knowledge after roaming the outer realm, Supremacy-level (Demon Sage-level) passageways were still legends. “This passageway at Luo Tang Pass is already 69.5 kilometers wide. From its size, it might be a demon sage-level passageway.” “Then we can only try,” said Luo Tang.
Meng Chuan flew to Luo Tang’s side and carefully protected her. The two of them arrived near the World Entrance.
The surrounding Godfiends and demon servants couldn’t see Meng Chuan and Luo Tang. The duo didn’t want to cause too great a commotion.
“If I can enter, then a demon sage can enter and exit as well.” Luo Tang extended her right hand and reached into the World Entrance.
Huh? Luo Tang’s heart tightened when she saw her right hand reach into the tunnel. Meng Chuan became even more solemn.
Following that, Luo Tang took a step forward and entered the tunnel.
Luo Tang looked at Meng Chuan. “It’s a demon sage passageway.”
This scene proved everything. Human Creation Supremacies could easily pass; likewise, demon sages could easily pass through it as well.
“It has ultimately appeared. A demon sage passageway.” Meng Chuan was very calm. He had seized every opportunity in the outer realm to cultivate just so that he was prepared for this final battle.
At that moment, many figures appeared in the Demon Realm. However, both sides had hidden themselves, preventing the other party from seeing them.
Swoosh.
Luo Tang retreated.
“How are the restrictions on this demon sage passageway?” asked Meng Chuan.
“It’s easy to pass through it. The restrictions are also negligible. If I pass through this passageway alone, I can maintain maximum speed,” said Luo Tang solemnly. “It can probably allow a group of demon sages to enter simultaneously. If a group of demon sages work together, they will definitely set up an array formation. We have to think of a way to set up an array formation first.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Let’s wait and see if there are any changes.”
Luo Tang looked at Meng Chuan confusedly. “What do you mean?”
“Will a second demon sage passageway appear? Or will a larger World Entrance appear?” commented Meng Chuan calmly.
“An even larger World Entrance?” Luo Tang couldn’t help but say, “According to the dossiers, if two inhabited worlds are close to each other, they will produce one Supremacy-level passageway at most.”
“Let’s wait and see,” said Meng Chuan.
Since Luo Tang Pass would probably become the main battlefield for the demon invasion, Meng Chuan and company naturally decided to relocate all of Luo Tang Pass’s residents. If they didn’t, there would be a disastrous number of casualties if the battle’s aftershocks spread for hundreds of kilometers.
Days passed.
No second demon sage passageway appeared in the human world! There was also no larger World Entrance.
Luo Tang Pass was the only demon sage entrance.
This also made sense. After all, Archean Eon Realm and the demon world were both middle-level worlds. If two middle-level worlds were close to each other in the River of Spacetime, it was indeed possible for a demon sage passageway to appear. However, it was already very rare for one to appear. Two? That was even more unlikely.
Luo Tang Pass.
One Supremacy after another arrived at Luo Tang Pass.
Ordinary Godfiends and demon servants had left, leaving not a single mortal around. This would be the final battlefield of the warwhich had lasted for more than nine centuries.
“This is the final battlefield.” Xu Yingwu stood on the city wall and looked at the massive World Entrance that was more than 50 kilometers wide. “This nine-century war ultimately needs to end! If we win, the demons’ plans will completely fail. If we lose, it will be a calamity for our Archean Eon Realm.”
“Imperial Lord Eastcalm has the strength of an Imperial Lord. Together with the treasures left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon, we will definitely win this battle,” said the Demon Annihilation Guild Master, Jing Fei. “I trust Meng Chuan too,” said Bai Yaoyue.
Luo Tang Pass had now become a place where Supremacies gathered. They gathered and conversed in groups.
Boom!
Not far from the world entrance, an array flag stabbed into the ground.
Meng Chuan and Qin Wu floated side by side.
Qin Wu looked at the World Entrance. “It’s been over 900 years. It’s finally time for the final battle.”
“Master, don’t worry. We humans will only be victorious. We definitely won’t lose,” said Meng Chuan.
“We can’t help you. We can only rely on you.” Qin Wu looked at Meng Chuan. “Choose Archean Mountain’s treasures carefully. Bring the ones that can help you.”
“Understood.” Meng Chuan nodded slightly and turned to look at the World Entrance. His eyes were filled with fighting spirit.
Because of Emperor Roc’s pursuit, he had been hiding in the Chaos Hole and not counterattacking. One of the reasons was to hide his strength. His quick escape could be explained away as using a single-use talisman. However, if he were to engage in a head-on battle, he would completely expose his strength.
Therefore, Meng Chuan had been hiding his strength, letting the demons underestimate his strength. In this critical final battle, he was going to deal the demons a ruthless blow.
“Meng Chuan, in the past few meetings, I keep having the feeling that something is wrong with you,” blurted Qin Wu suddenly. “In the past, I felt like you had a lively and natural aura. You were carefree and uninhibited, and you liked painting. But now, I feel like you’re a deep pool without any waves. Let me ask you, do you still paint?” Meng Chuan was slightly stunned. Yes, it had been a long time since he painted. He couldn’t even lift a brush.
Qin Wu looked at Meng Chuan seriously. “How long has it been since you smiled?”
“I know my problem.” Meng Chuan nodded slightly and said solemnly, “Master, don’t worry.”
“It’s good that you know.” Qin Wu didn’t say anything else. Meng Chuan pondered. A hundred years into his cultivation inside the Chaos Hole, he discovered the effects the Chaos Hole had on his Essence Soul and mind. His entire mind gradually became dead silent. It was because of this mental state that Meng Chuan had created Saber of Nirvana.
Back then, he had decided to cultivate for another 20 years before leaving the Chaos Hole.
To his surprise, he was hunted down by Emperor Roc, forcing him to hide in the Chaos Hole’s depths. He had spent over 200 years cultivating inside.
After such a long period of time, the Chaos Hole’s influence on his Essence Soul and mind had become greater and greater. His mind had become deathly still. Without feeling touched, how could he be motivated to paint? He didn’t know what to paint. Meng Chuan also knew that this wasn’t right. He only persisted with his cultivation in the Chaos Hole because he needed to increase his strength as much as possible so that he could deal with the war.
I have to leave the Chaos Hole after the final battle ends. Even if I sacrifice all my treasures and give up that true body, I have to escape the Chaos Hole’s influence.
His deathly still mind allowed him to create Saber of Nirvana easily. However, as he cultivated this path further, Meng Chuan became even more certain that it was a stray path. Thus, he didn’t use his Saber of Nirvana to cultivate his dantian’s Chaos Hole, nor did he use it to cultivate his body. However, his mental state was already greatly affected.
After the war, I must not study Saber of Nirvana anymore. Although Meng Chuan’s mental state had changed, he knew very well what was right and what was wrong.
The Demon Realm.
Imperial Lord Starquix, Lady Blackmoon, and Emperor Roc sat in front of a mountain. They drank and looked at the massive World Entrance that was more than 50 kilometers wide.
The demons had also confirmed that this was a demon sage passageway.
“A demon sage passageway.” Imperial Lord Starquix was rather excited. “A demon sage passageway has finally appeared. Even if Meng Chuan is an Imperial Lord, how long will he take to cultivate? How strong can he be? He can’t stop us.”
Although Lady Blackmoon was delighted, she still said, “The human race has definitely been extremely cautious ever since the demon sage passageway appeared. I believe they will permit Meng Chuan to use many of Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures! Meng Chuan will definitely set up a large array at Luo Tang Pass. With the array formation and many other treasures, he will be able to unleash strength far beyond his normal.” “External objects are ultimately external objects. How much can his strength increase?”. asked Imperial Lord Starquix confidently.
“Although we have hope of winning in a head-on attack, the best solution is to get rid of Meng Chuan first.” Emperor Roc held a cup of wine and said softly, “Let’s get rid of Meng Chuan first before we send our forces into the demon sage passageway. That’s the safest way.”
“How do we kill him?” asked Lady Blackmoon. “Didn’t you say that Meng Chuan’s outer realm body is hiding in the Chaos Hole’s depths thanks to a special treasure?”
“Since the demon sage passageway has appeared, it’s worth paying a greater price,” said Emperor Roc. “I’m already at the Third Tribulation realm. I’ll think of a way to hire one of Ancient Magus River Zone’s Fourth Tribulation Eminences. When a Fourth Tribulation Eminence has a target’s true body, they can easily kill all the target’s avatars through karma. Even perfected Imperial Lords will die. Meng Chuan’s life level is lower than a perfected Imperial Lord’s.”
“Are you confident of hiring a Fourth Tribulation Eminence?” asked Imperial Lord Starquix.
“They can be hired with the appropriate price,” said Emperor Roc indifferently. Of course, it depended on who hired them. As a Third Tribulation Eminence, Emperor Roc could still hire a Fourth Tribulation Eminence.

chapters.title: Chapter 531 - Inviting a Tribulation Eminence
chapters.content:
Chapter 531 Inviting a Tribulation Eminence
In the Demon Realm, fog lingered on a steep mountain. A cave abode was located at the peak of the mountain.
Sigh. A man in a white feathered robe stood by a pool in the cave abode. He sighed as he watched the fish swimming in the pool.
“The opening of the demon sage passageway can be both a boon and bane for me,” muttered the white-robed man softly. “I’ve cultivated for 500 years and reached the Heaven Earth realm. My Essence Soul is my forte. I believe I can become an Imperial Lord within 1,000 years, but I’m now forced to head into Archean Eon Realm for a battle to the death. If we succeed, we will reap great benefits. If we fail, everything will be for naught.
“The probability of the other two Heaven Earth realm demon sages becoming Imperial Lords is slim, so they are willing to risk their lives... However, it really isn’t worth it for me.” The white-robed man wasn’t willing to participate in the battle. However, the battle between Archean Eon Realm and the Demon Realm had lasted for more than 900 years. Emperor Roc, Imperial Lord Starquix, and Lady Blackmoon spared no expense. He didn’t dare disobey Emperor Roc’s will.
Swoosh.
The white-robed man soared into the sky and rushed towards the strongest demon’s palace — Roc Imperial Palace.
He flew rather quickly. In about 30 seconds, he arrived at Roc Imperial Palace, where two figures were already waiting in front of it.
“Brother Bai Fu,” shouted the two demon sages with a smile.
“Brother Ying Feng, Brother Si Feng,” said the white-robed man humbly. It had been a long time since Demon Sage Ying Feng and Demon Sage Si Feng reached the Heaven Earth realm. They didn’t have confidence in raising their Essence Souls to the seventh level before they reached the end of their lifespans. Therefore, they were looking forward to participating in the battle so that they could share the benefits of victory.
“Brother Bai Fu stepped into the Heaven Earth realm before the demon sage passageway was born. From the looks of it, we demons are destined to obtain the human world’s treasures.” Demon Sage Si Feng had a tiger’s head, which was filled with wrinkles. He smiled and said, “Brother Bai Fu, you are best at array formations. With your help, our overall strength will increase greatly.” “If the three of us work together, we will definitely be able to sweep through the entire human world.” Demon Sage Ying Feng was also quite confident. He was the strongest among the three Heaven Earth realm demon sages. “When the time comes, everything else will depend on the two of you. I’m only good at array formations,” said the white-robed man humbly. He was only 500 years old-a rather young demon sage. After a while,
Boom!
The main entrance to Roc Imperial Palace opened. “Demon sages, His Majesty invites the three of you in,” said an attendant.
The three demon sages didn’t dare say anything else as they immediately headed over.
Roc Imperial Palace, main hall.
Emperor Roc, a Third Tribulation Eminence, sat at the highest seat in the middle. Below him, Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon sat at his sides. Their statuses were clearly much lower. The two of them didn’t think much of it either... After all, they were relying on Emperor Roc’s help to reach the Tribulation realm. With his help, they still had a sliver of hope of reaching the Tribulation realm. If Emperor Roc was selfish, the two of them probably wouldn’t have any hope. Therefore, they naturally fawned on him even more.
“Greetings, Your Majesty.” After the three demon sages entered the hall, they bowed respectfully.
Although they might have different thoughts on the matter, they didn’t dare to say anything regarding the war against the human world! Emperor Roc had free rein to kill them if they angered him whatsoever. In history, there was no shortage of instances where demons killed each other.
“It’s been hard on all of you to rush back from the outer realm.” Emperor Roc looked at the three demons below him. “A demon sage passageway has opened. We will be relying on the three of you in this war against the human world. If you succeed, Starquix and Blackmoon will not treat you poorly. The rewards you will receive will be more than 1,000 cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals at least.”
If they succeeded, they would obtain Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures.
Just obtaining a small portion was enough... What were 1,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals in comparison?
“A thousand Outer Realm Essence Crystals?” The three Heaven Earth realm demon sages felt their hearts burn. Even the white-robed man couldn’t help but be tempted.
“Before that, the three of you need to improve your strength greatly,” said Emperor Roc.
Attacking Meng Chuan was only part of the plan.
Attacking the human world through the demon sage passageway was also very important. These three Heaven Earth realm demon sages were the most important forces that Emperor Roc could deploy.
Based on history, only one Imperial Lord would rise out of several Heaven Earth realm demon sages! Even if they sacrificed these three Heaven Earth realm demon sages, it was nothing to the entire Demon Realm. Emperor Roc naturally had to do his best to make the three Heaven Earth realm demon sages stronger.
From spring to autumn.
“Half a year.”
Withered yellow leaves fell at Luo Tang Pass. The Supremacies gathered together to drink tea and chat.
“The demon sage passageway has already appeared for half a year. The demons haven’t taken action yet,” said Meng Tiange. “I don’t know how long this wait will last.”
“Since the passageway has appeared, the demons naturally have to prepare carefully now,” said Luo Tang with a smile as she drank some flower tea. “After all, victory or defeat in this battle will determine the war’s outcome. If the demons are defeated in the upcoming battle and the three Heaven Earth realm demon sages die in battle, they won’t have a second chance.”
To have a few more Heaven Earth realm demon sages rise up? That would probably take 1,000 years. By then, the demon sage passageway would have long collapsed. Jing Fei nodded. “The demons will do their best to prepare for this battle.”
“Meng Chuan has long become an Imperial Lord. Furthermore, we are the defenders,” said Bai Yaoyue confidently. “We will have the terrain advantage by setting up a large array formation in advance. We only have to deal with three Heaven Earth realm demon sages with the strength of an Imperial Lord? We will definitely win this battle.”
“Although we have a high chance of winning this battle,” said Xu Yingwu as he shook his head, “we can’t be careless at all. Imperial Lord Eastcalm said that the demons’ Emperor Roc has already become a Tribulation Eminence. It has more means at its disposal.”
The Supremacies present understood this, but all their hopes were placed on Meng Chuan.
With the disparate strength difference, the other Supremacies couldn’t participate in the battle. They would only burden Meng Chuan by forcefully interfering.
Heaven Peak River System.
On a desolate planet, there was a giant alien beast carrying a turtle shell. It lay there as its mountain-like head stared at a huge basin in front of it.
Boom!
In the basin—which was thousands of kilometers wide-two black-and-white beads clashed. They only stopped after several collisions.
“Brother Xuan Fang, how’s the divination?” asked Emperor Roc’s Essence Soul avatar beside the beast.
“From my divination, it’s not easy to kill that Meng Chuan,” said the beast in a low voice.
“Brother Xuan Fang, you are the strongest in all of Heavenly Peak River System when it comes to karma,” said Emperor Roc. “You even have a chance of killing a newly-advanced Tribulation Eminence. Why would it be difficult to kill Meng Chuan?”
The alien beast shook its head slightly. “My divination won’t be wrong.”
Emperor Roc frowned slightly. “Then, Brother Xuan Fang, will you be going?”
“It’s very difficult to kill him.” The beast stared at Emperor Roc with its huge eyes. “I have to raise the price.”
Emperor Roc blinked. “Apart from what we previously agreed upon, the treasures left behind by Meng Chuan after his death will all be yours,” said Emperor Roc.
The alien beast shook its head slightly, no longer bothering to say anything else. “How much more do you want?” Emperor Roc was secretly furious. This greedy old fellow.
Xuan Fang wasn’t content with 300 Outer Realm Essence Crystals. “Five hundred cubes,” said the beast in a low voice. “Not one less.”
Emperor Roc was even more vexed.
This Fourth Tribulation Eminence, Xuan Fang, was the most suitable helper. He was strong enough; he was also adept at the karmic lineage.
“Alright, but I can’t produce so many Outer Realm Essence Crystals. The difference can only be made up with Tribulation treasures,” said Emperor Roc.
The alien beast nodded slightly. “It’s fine. I’ll take action once I obtain treasures worth 500 Outer Realm Essence Crystals.”
“Let’s go to that Chaos Hole. My true body will hand over the treasures to you,” said Emperor Roc.
“Let’s go.” The gigantic alien beast’s body flashed, transforming into a barefoot old man carrying a turtle shell. With a chuckle, he flew out of the planet with Emperor Roc.

chapters.title: Chapter 532 - The Price for Becoming Stronger
chapters.content:
Chapter 532 The Price for Becoming Stronger
In the silent void outside the Chaos Hole.
The turtle-shelled elder, Xuan Fang, smiled at Emperor Roc as he took the treasures one by one.
“It’s still slightly short,” muttered Xuan Fang as he chuckled.
“This should definitely total up to 500 Outer Realm Essence Crystals.” After Emperor Roc took out another piece of refinement material, he refused to take out another piece.
Xuan Fang said in disdain, “I have to specially sell these treasures for Outer Realm Essence Crystals. Now that Heaven Peak River System doesn’t have Black Dragon Planet, I have to travel all the way to other river systems to sell them. Forget it. I can barely count it as 500 cubes.” With that said, he waved his hand and put away all the treasures.
Emperor Roc’s heart ached. However, he knew that Xuan Fang had a much greater chance of killing Meng Chuan than him doing the deed personally. Not only was Xuan Fang much stronger, but he was also especially adept at the karmic lineage.
“Alright, I’ll naturally do the job after taking your treasures. I care about karma the most,” said Xuan Fang with a smile.
Emperor Roc was relieved.
Ordinary Tribulation Eminences placed great importance on karma. When it came to entities who studied karma, they placed even greater importance on it. Xuan Fang wouldn’t want to owe a huge karmic debt to anyone, even if he had to give up all his treasures to resolve the karma.
asu
“Lead the way,” said Xuan Fang.
Emperor Roc nodded. “Follow me.” The two Tribulation Eminences immediately flew towards the Chaos Hole.
They first flew past the accretion disc before flying into the Chaos Hole’s depths.
“A newly-advanced Imperial Lord can enter a Chaos Hole’s depths? I wonder what kind of rare treasure he has. I’ve only heard of such rare treasures in legends,” muttered the turtle-shelled old man, Xuan Fang. “From the looks of it, this Meng Chuan has quite the background. Are you sure there are no other powerful experts in his homeworld?”
“I don’t wish to owe you any karma either. I naturally won’t lie about such matters,” replied Emperor Roc. “Besides, Brother Xuan Fang, you are good at divination. You should know that I’m right.”
“He’s the strongest expert in a middle-sized world.” The turtle-shelled elder nodded slightly. “After killing him, all his treasures will be mine.”
Emperor Roc nodded as his heart ached. “They’re naturally yours.”
Meng Chuan definitely carried many treasures as he journeyed around the outer realm. Because Meng Chuan could enter the Chaos Hole’s depths, it gave the illusion that the treasures he had on him were rather powerful.
With Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures, Meng Chuan can enter the Chaos Hole’s depths. Perhaps these treasures are worth thousands of Outer Realm Essence Crystals. Emperor Roc guessed.
