However, if he wanted a Fourth Tribulation Eminence to do the deed, the Fourth Tribulation Eminence would definitely obtain the war spoils. As a Third Tribulation Eminence, he would be tempting fate by trying to snatch the war spoils.
CIT
In the Chaos Hole’s depths, where time flowed 60-fold faster.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in the darkness. He had cultivated in the Chaos Hole for over 300 years, so he had gotten used to the darkness. Meng Chuan was over 700 years old. He had spent 300 years cultivating in Myriad Flower Realm on Black Dragon Planet. He then spent over 300 years cultivating in the Chaos Hole. His life in Archean Eon Realm was rather interesting. After stepping into the outer realm, he did his best to cultivate. The lonely cultivation affected Meng Chuan’s personality. His personality and mental state were further affected because he spent 300-plus years in the Chaos Hole.
Meng Chuan also realized this problem. Therefore, he always insisted on hosting lectures at Grotto-Heaven Pavilion. He taught generations of Archean Mountain disciples. He often stayed in contact with his disciples, allowing him to slow down his mental state’s sedation.
Oh? Meng Chuan suddenly sensed something. Someone’s here? One is Emperor Roc, while the other seems even stronger than it?
After cultivating in the Chaos Hole for more than 300 years, his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique finally broke through and reached the perfected Heaven Earth realm.
This ultimate technique was much more brilliant than Selfless Formless Sword. Upon reaching the perfected Heaven Earth realm, its technique realm was comparable to a Third Tribulation Eminence.
In regards to technique realm, newly-advanced First Tribulation Eminences were typically at the perfected Heaven Earth realm. Second Tribulation Eminences’ technique realm might be slightly higher, but their improvement was limited.
A qualitative change only happened once one reached the Third Tribulation realm.
His Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique —which was at the perfected Heaven Earth realm-had already changed qualitatively. It was much stronger compared to ordinary perfected Heaven Earth realm techniques.
It hired a helper. Without any hesitation, Meng Chuan flew deeper into the Chaos Hole. “What?” Xuan Fang and Emperor Roc were alarmed as they silently approached.
Xuan Fang could already sense Meng Chuan. Emperor Roc had long confirmed it through karma.
“He actually discovered us so early?” Xuan Fang was somewhat surprised as he looked at Emperor Roc beside him. “He must have a treasure protecting him,” said Emperor Roc.
However, Emperor Roc had no idea that Meng Chuan was in no way inferior to him when it came to technique realm! In fact, Meng Chuan’s Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique was more inclined towards domains. Emperor Roc was more inclined towards direct combat. “I’m not good at resisting the gravitational pull. I can’t get any closer.” Emperor Roc quickly stopped. “I’ll be counting on you, Brother Xuan Fang.”
“Leave it to me.” Xuan Fang continued flying in with a solemn expression. He could sense Meng Chuan’s position.
As Meng Chuan flew deeper into the Chaos Hole, his speed decreased. The number of spacetime distortions in the Chaos Hole’s depths was clearly increasing.
The time flow accelerated by 60-fold, 61-fold, 62-fold...
Xuan Fang continued to fly into the Chaos Hole’s depths. He was a special lifeform that had cultivated to the Tribulation realm. His body was extremely strong to begin with. Furthermore, he had reached the Fourth Tribulation realm, allowing him to fly quite deep into the Chaos Hole.
I see him. Xuan Fang clearly locked onto Meng Chuan’s location as the distance between them shortened.
Meng Chuan turned his head to glance and continued flying 65-fold, 66-fold...
When he reached a region where time flowed 68-fold faster, Xuan Fang stopped. He frowned deeply. He’s 10 million kilometers away from me. The area he’s in... time flows 72-fold faster than normal there. Xuan Fang understood something. I can only go a few million kilometers deeper into the Chaos Hole. I have no way of approaching him.
Xuan Fang waited silently.
Meng Chuan stared at Xuan Fang when he was 10 million kilometers away from him. Both sides stared at each other.
This deadlock dragged on.
A month later.
Swoosh.
Xuan Fang turned around and left.
Emperor Roc had been patiently waiting in the Chaos Hole’s depths, but after waiting for a full month, he could sense that Meng Chuan was still alive through karma.
Huh? Emperor Roc saw the turtle-shelled elder, Xuan Fang, fly out from the Chaos Hole’s depths.
“Brother Xuan Fang, what happened?” asked Emperor Roc immediately. “Why is Meng Chuan still alive?”
“You hired the wrong person.” Xuan Fang shook his head. “This Meng Chuan can go much deeper than me.”
“He can go deeper than you?” Emperor Roc found it unbelievable.
“I’m afraid a Fourth Tribulation Eminence won’t be able to capture him in the Chaos Hole. You can try finding a Fifth Tribulation Eminence.” After speaking, Xuan Fang continued flying out.
Emperor Roc couldn’t help but ask, “Brother Xuan Fang, are you giving up just like that?” “I can’t kill him. I’ve already done my best. I’ve also spent a month here. I didn’t break my promise.” Xuan Fang’s voice echoed in Emperor Roc’s ears as he left.
Emperor Roc could only helplessly watch Xuan Fang leave.
He had given Xuan Fang 500 Outer Realm Essence Crystals in advance. The other party had only promised to do his best in hunting down Meng Chuan for a month with no guarantee of success. No one could guarantee that they would succeed as the future had too many possibilities.
He hid so deep? Even a Fourth Tribulation Eminence can’t touch him? Emperor Roc was extremely aggrieved. He had no intention of hiring a Fifth Tribulation Eminence.
Fifth Tribulation Eminences had much higher statuses.
The treasures he had on him were far from enough to hire one. Fifth Tribulation Eminences would also typically join the outer realm’s top factions. They could easily discover Emperor Roc’s identity and investigate the conflict between the Demon Realm and Archean Eon Realm.
Meng Chuan carefully waited in the domain produced by his Lightning Domain Seal.
From its appearance, it should be Xuan Fang, one of Heaven Peak River System’s famous Tribulation Eminences. I can’t defeat it in other places, but it can’t do anything to me in the Chaos Hole’s depths.
Meng Chuan was very calm.
After being trapped in the Chaos Hole for more than 200 years, his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique had reached the perfected Heaven Earth realm. His Saber of Nirvana had also improved, reaching the Heaven Earth realm’s middle stage. Although it was an ultimate technique with huge flaws, it’s strength was still comparable to an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique.
After the technique reached the Heaven Earth realm’s middle stage, it was comparable to an ordinary Fourth Tribulation-level technique. If it reached the perfected Heaven Earth realm, it would be equivalent to a Fifth Tribulation-level technique.
This technique-comparable to a Fourth Tribulation-level technique-happened to focus on Meng Chuan’s Chaos Hole domain’s core aspects, allowing him to go very deep into the Chaos Hole.
If you had trapped me for a few more days, my Saber of Nirvana might’ve reached the Heaven Earth realm’s late stage.
Chaos Holes affected one’s mental state greatly. However, Meng Chuan still improved Saber of Nirvana very smoothly. Meng Chuan knew that his mental state would be greatly affected, but he needed to increase his strength. He needed to have absolute confidence in winning the war! Even if he had to pay a price for it, he didn’t care.
This was because over the past 900 years...
Too many Godfiends had paid the ultimate price—their lives.

chapters.title: Chapter 533 - Finally Here
chapters.content:
Chapter 533 Finally Here
Meng Chuan returned to the region where time flowed 60-fold faster. This way, the Chaos Hole’s influence on him would be lessened.
Meng Chuan. Emperor Roc could clearly see Meng Chuan sitting cross-legged in the darkness. He was rather furious. Meng Chuan was the greatest obstacle in their plans of conquering Archean Eon Realm! He was Archean Eon Realm’s strongest expert in the past 900 years. He destroyed their plan of using one million demon monarchs to hunt humans. He destroyed their plan of attacking from the World Gap. He was also the greatest obstacle in their plan of conquering Archean Eon Realm through the demon sage passageway.
Since I can’t kill him completely, we’ll storm our way into Archean Eon Realm. Emperor Roc made a decision and glared at Meng Chuan from afar. His heart burned with anger. With the help of a rare treasure, you have been hiding in the Chaos Hole’s depths in that sorry state. When we’re storming into Archean Eon Realm, continue hiding if you have the ability to do so.
In the distance, Meng Chuan was still cultivating in the darkness.
Demon Realm, Roc Imperial Palace. In a hidden hall, there was a cyan pool. Inside the pool was a huge white egg.
Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon silently guarded the pool.
Creak.
The hall’s doors opened, and Emperor Roc walked in.
“Emperor Roc.”
“Brother Roc.”
Lady Blackmoon and Imperial Lord Starquix immediately stood up to welcome him.
“How is it?” Emperor Roc carefully stared at the huge white egg in the pool.
“Everything is normal,” said Imperial Lord Starquix. “With Demon Sage Ying Feng’s strength at the Heaven Earth realm’s middle stage, I believe that it will definitely be able to transform successfully.” Emperor Roc stared at the white egg and fell silent for a moment before saying, “The plan of hiring a Fourth Tribulation Eminence to kill Meng Chuan has failed. With the help of a rare treasure, Meng Chuan can enter the Chaos Hole’s extreme depths. Even a Fourth Tribulation Eminence can’t reach him.”
“Even a Fourth Tribulation Eminence can’t kill him?” Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon found it unbelievable.
“Who knows what treasure he obtained from Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasure trove,” said Emperor Roc. “That treasure might be especially good for infiltrating Chaos Holes. After all, it’s from a Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s treasure trove.”
Starquix and Blackmoon also understood this. Accidents could happen as they plotted for a Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s treasures. However, treasures relied on their masters. Emperor Roc and company were confident that the demons were much stronger than humans.
“Therefore, we can only attack from the demon sage passageway.” Emperor Roc looked at the white egg in the pool. “If its transformation fails, the probability of our forced attack succeeding will be slim.”
“Demon Sage Ying Feng has the Feng Cang-a special lifeform-bloodline. Furthermore, it has reached the Heaven Earth realm’s middle stage. It will definitely transform successfully,” said Lady Blackmoon.
“Yes, it will definitely succeed,” said Imperial Lord Starquix.
This time, Demon Sage Ying Feng was the main attacking force among the three Heaven Earth realm demon sages. The other demon sages would be assisting Demon Sage Ying Feng
“As long as it’s a life transformation, there’s a possibility of failure,” said Emperor Roc calmly. “Of course, with its realm, there’s a 99% chance that its original bloodline will be successfully converted.”
They nurtured Demon Sage Ying Feng because he had a high chance of transforming successfully and had the highest cultivation realm.
Days passed.
Two months after their failure to kill Meng Chuan.
Ka! Ka! Ka! Ka!
In the hall, the liquid in the pool had turned transparent. Cracks appeared on the white egg’s surface, causing Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon to watch nervously.
Bam!
The door opened, and Emperor Roc appeared. He stared at the white egg that was beginning to crack Eggshell pieces fell in all directions, and a huge, white, red-eyed bird appeared. The white feathers on the giant bird’s body were soft. It looked around, and its body transformed into Demon Sage Ying Feng’s appearance.
“Greetings, Your Majesty. Greetings, Imperial Lords,” said Demon Sage Ying Feng humbly.
Emperor Roc’s eyes were filled with excitement. “How is it?”
“I’ve completely become a special lifeform. I’m now a Feng Cang, a divine bird.” Demon Sage Ying Feng was also excited. It was now a fairly powerful special lifeform.
After transforming into a special lifeform from a demon, he now followed the special lifeform’s cultivation path.
Once he reached the required realm, his body would mature, allowing him to reach the Imperial Lord realm because of his bloodline.
“I’ve long reached the Heaven Earth realm’s middle stage,” said Demon Sage Ying Feng. “As long as I have enough Outer Realm Essence Crystals, I can grow rapidly and reach maturity.” “Follow the plan,” said Emperor Roc with a nod. “When you reach the limits of your immature body, don’t be in a hurry to break through. Stay as a Supremacy-level lifeform... After you go through the demon sage passageway and enter the human world, you can break through and obtain an adult body.”
“Even if I reach my limits and break through in the human world,” said Demon Sage Ying Feng, “I will need ten minutes to transform into an adult completely, given that I have sufficient Outer Realm Essence Crystals.”
“Don’t worry. Everything has been planned. After you enter Archean Eon Realm, defenses will be set up. You will be defended until you obtain an adult body. Then, you will officially begin the attack,” said Emperor Roc.
Demon Sage Ying Feng nodded slightly. “Ying Feng, it’s up to you now,” said Imperial Lord Starquix with a smile.
In
“The other two demon sages will also do their best to help you.” Lady Blackmoon’s eyes were filled with anticipation.
Although they had tried their best to nurture the other two Heaven Earth realm demon sages, Emperor Roc was ultimately a Third Tribulation Eminence. He could only obtain a limited amount of treasures from the Demon Ancestral Cave. Therefore, given the resources that Emperor Roc could use, his plan to nurture the three Heaven Earth realm demon sages was already the best one.
esources
The demon sage passageway appeared in spring, but it was already winter.
Luo Tang Pass.
The demon sage passageway was completely enveloped by an array formation. This was an array formation controlled by Meng Chuan alone.
He guarded the passageway alone!
All the other human Godfiends trusted Meng Chuan greatly. Only Meng Chuan could guard a demon sage passageway!
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The array flags which were embedded around the demon sage passageway flapped.
As the storm raged, there was heavy snow.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged on the snow and stared at the huge World Entrance in the distance. His Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence even seeped into the World Entrance and spread to the Demon Realm. However, it was blocked by an array formation! It was clear that the Demon Realm had set up an array formation on the other side of the tunnel.
Meng Chuan-who was at the Chaos Hole realm-was still considered a Supremacy in terms of life’s natural order. Therefore, his Quintessential Essence was unable to penetrate past the array formation.
The snow is getting heavier. It resembles Snow Wind Pass. Meng Chuan looked at the pure white world and thought of Snow Wind Pass.
Snow Wind Pass snowed most of the year. He and his wife spent a long time there.
Qiyue, a demon sage passageway has appeared. It’s almost time for the final battle. When Meng Chuan thought of his wife, his still heart stirred slightly.
His mental state clearly hadn’t gone completely still.
This battle is also the most important battle in my life. Meng Chuan waited for a moment before closing his eyes and continued to familiarize himself with the treasures as 13 transparent beads floated around him.
These 13 beads were a Seventh Tribulation treasure from Archean Mountain’s treasure vault-Thirteen Universe Beads.
Many years ago, Meng Chuan had obtained the treasures left behind by Senior Pang Ming. The strongest one was a Seventh Tribulation treasure. Compared to the treasures left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon, they were far inferior. However, Meng Chuan didn’t have the right to use many treasures. According to Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s rules, the higher Meng Chuan’s realm was, the more powerful treasures he could obtain from the treasure vault. The Bloodblade Disc was only one of the less amazing treasures. To prepare for the upcoming battle, Meng Chuan was allowed to choose ten treasures of the lightning lineage. He was only allowed to choose this many treasures because he wasn’t bringing them out of Archean Eon Realm, and all the Sect Proprietors and the three Guardians had approved of Meng Chuan using them.
Treasures of the lightning lineage...
Ancestral Master Archean Eon had left behind quite a few treasures of the lightning lineage. He even had one Eighth Tribulation treasure of the lightning lineage. Meng Chuan didn’t take it because he knew he could utilize much of its power with his lacking realm.
This time, Meng Chuan chose three Seventh Tribulation treasures, five Sixth Tribulation treasures, and two array formations. He chose to take two array formations because he had a group of Essence Soul avatars that could perfectly control the array formations.
Huh? Meng Chuan suddenly sensed something. His Chaos Hole Quintessential Essence—which had seeped into the World Entrance—was triggered. He stared at the World Entrance. The other five Essence Soul avatars hiding in the surrounding array formations also stared at the World Entrance. Is it finally beginning?

chapters.title: Chapter 534 - Final Chapter of War (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 534 Final Chapter of War (1)
“Everyone, leave Luo Tang Pass and stay outside the array formation.” Meng Chuan’s voice suddenly sounded in the ears of every Supremacy. “The demons are about to attack.”
Only Meng Chuan and the other Supremacies were present at Luo Tang Pass. The Supremacies either had their true bodies, Essence Soul avatars, or embodiments watching. They were all here to watch the most critical battle, which would decide the outcome of the war that had gone on for more than 900 years.
“It’s finally beginning?”
“They’re coming?”
Although the Supremacies lived at Luo Tang Pass, they were still at the array formation’s periphery. Since all of them now knew the situation’s severity, they quickly flew out of the array formation. The array formation was set up by Meng Chuan! It spanned 150 kilometers and completely enveloped the entire demon sage-level World Entrance. It was the battlefield Meng Chuan had set up.
“Are the demons coming?” Qin Wu, Xu Yingwu, Bai Yaoyue, Meng Tiange, Jing Fei, Meng An, and the other Supremacies were outside the array formation. They stood high in the sky and looked in the direction of the World Entrance.
Although Meng Chuan had set up the array formation, he didn’t prevent people in the outside world from spying into it. However, no mortal could be found within 250 kilometers of Luo Tang Pass. They had long sealed off this area.
“There’s no movement at the World Entrance,” said Bai Yaoyue nervously as she watched.
“Meng Chuan is calm. He remains sitting cross-legged, guarding the World Entrance alone,” said Xu Yingwu.
Meng An watched carefully.
Suddenly, he sensed something. His gaze passed through the massive World Entrancewhich spanned more than 50 kilometers-and looked at the Demon Realm on the other side. He immediately said, “There’s energy seeping in from the Demon Realm.”
“I see it.”
“What’s that?”
There were Supremacies here who were close to the end of their lifespans. Two Supremacies of the younger generation-Meng An and the Xiang Fu-watched nervously.
In the beginning, the energy was inconspicuous, but it gradually became more eye-catching. A massive blood-colored wave surged from the other end of the World Entrance and headed towards Archean Eon Realm.
Meng Chuan, who was sitting cross-legged on the snow, was on the other side of the blood
wave.
Meng Chuan saw everything clearly.
When the blood wave appeared, he vaguely saw three figures within it. They were the three demon sages they knew about—Demon Sage Bai Fu, Demon Sage Si Feng, and Demon Sage Ying Feng.
At that moment, the three demon sages bowed respectfully in one direction. There were three faint figures standing in that direction. Roc, Starquix, and Blackmoon. Meng Chuan recognized them.
Following that, the three demon sages arrived.
In the surging blood waves, resplendent stars rose and fell, concealing the three demon sages.
This blood wave seems capable of injuring one’s Essence Soul? Meng Chuan felt his Power of Essence Soul instinctively abhor the blood wave. Ordinary Imperial Lords typically had seventh-level Essence Souls. There were all sorts of ways to restrain a seventh-level Essence Soul’s Power of Essence Soul. For example, some means could corrupt one’s Essence Soul. If his Magic Awl pierced the blood wave, it would become corrupt. Its might would be greatly reduced, and it could even collapse.
This is to restrain my Magic Awl? Meng Chuan didn’t take it to heart.
The other party was a Third Tribulation Eminence, and he could utilize a lot of the demon world’s heritage. Meng Chuan had never thought that he could easily deal with the enemy with his seventh-level Essence Soul’s Magic Awl.
Whoosh!
The blood wave traveled through the demon sage passageway and entered the human world in the blink of an eye. It quickly spread out, and bright stars appeared in the human world. Under the stars’ protection, three demon sages appeared. They had already arrived in the human world.
“They’re here.”
“The demon sages are here.”
“Demon Sage Bai Fu, Demon Sage Si Feng, and Demon Sage Ying Feng. Three Heaven Earth realm demon sages.” The human Supremacies watching from outside the array formation became nervous. They also felt the strength difference between both sides. The Demon Realm was much larger and had more lifeforms. Their cultivation system was also closer to perfection. The fifth Firmament demon monarchs, demon sages, and Imperial Lords surpassed the human equivalents in number.
With greater numbers, they could naturally select more elites. The Demon Realm had three Heaven Earth realm demon sages.
As for the humans, not a single Heaven Earth Supremacy had risen to prominence in the past 1,000 years before Meng Chuan appeared. Even Meng An didn’t have the confidence to deal with well-prepared demon sages at the Heaven Earth realm with his current strength.
Chi!
Demon Sage Ying Feng waved his hand and threw out a green seed.
The seed emitted a sparkling glow as it flew out and sprouted in midair. It rapidly grew. In a second or so, it had grown completely. There were three huge leaves on the main stem. A huge pale-pink flower grew on the top of the green stem.
“Quick.” Demon Sage Ying Feng, Demon Sage Si Feng, and Demon Sage Bai Fu flew into the flower simultaneously.
“Don’t worry. This array formation can withstand a late-stage Imperial Lord’s blows for a while. Furthermore, we have many defensive treasures. Even newly-advanced Tribulation Eminences won’t be able to threaten us for a short period of time,” said Demon Sage Bai Fu via voice transmission.
As he spoke, he activated the treasures.
Single-use talisman, ancient tokens...
They used them one by one! Layers of protections formed around the flower.
“His Majesty has said that,” said Demon Sage Si Feng, “inhabited worlds’ laws protect the weak. These laws suppress spacetime very strongly. Many life-preservation items are greatly weakened. The treasures that are too heaven-defying can’t even be used.”
Demon Sage Bai Fu looked at Demon Sage Ying Feng. “Therefore, we just need to hold on until Brother Ying Feng becomes an Imperial Lord.”
Demon Sage Ying Feng had already transformed into a giant, white, red-eyed bird.
Roar!
The giant, white, red-eyed bird let out a deep roar.
The roar caused Demon Sage Bai Fu and Demon Sage Si Feng to reveal looks of pain. Following this roar, the white, red-eyed birdwhich was extremely close to adulthoodinstantly transformed! Its feathers began to turn long and sharp. Its skin became tougher as its eyes transformed... “I’ve accumulated enough insights and have enough Outer Realm Essence Crystals. I’ll be able to stabilize my Imperial Lord-level strength in ten minutes,” said Demon Sage Ying Feng via voice transmission to his two companions. “The two of you just need to hold on for ten minutes.”
“Leave it to us.”
“Don’t worry.”
Demon Sage Bai Fu and Demon Sage Si Feng were very confident.
Emperor Roc and the others had really spared no expense to give them a large number of protective treasures. This was because they wanted to ensure that Demon Sage Ying Feng could reach the adult stage. Once he reached the adult stage, even if he was at the Heaven Earth realm’s middle stage, he would be able to unleash extremely high combat strength with just his body alone.
“What flower is that?”
“The demons are hiding in the flower.”
“Demon Sage Ying Feng has broken through and become an Imperial Lord.” The human Supremacies watching from the outside reeled in panic and felt the pressure when they saw Demon Sage Ying Feng’s body mature. This pressure was a suppression caused by life’s natural order. It was because of this pressure that they knew that he had become an Imperial Lord.
A demon sage had broken through to the Imperial Lord realm upon entry? Then why didn’t Demon Sage Ying Feng not become an Imperial Lord after so many years?
Although the human Supremacies were puzzled, they knew that they could only rely on Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan observed everything.
Life-preservation items? Meng Chuan looked at the life-preservation items that had been activated one by one. He wasn’t in a hurry to take action.
He knew very well that many life-preservation items were very magical when used in the outer realm—where there was no suppression. For example, a Life Substitute Talisman. However, in an inhabited world, the nomological suppression was even greater.
Once a Life Substitute Talisman was used, one could instantly recover to their previous state. Thus, even if they were killed instantly, a Life Substitute Talisman would be able to restore the user’s body to a past snapshot.
Therefore, once one had sufficiently high attainments in the time lineage, one would be able to recover instantly even if their opponent -only skilled in the void lineage-delivered lethal strikes.
But in an inhabited world, a Life Substitute Talisman’s powers were suppressed. The time laws were greatly suppressed. It was impossible to use the talisman with its limited energy reserves.
Many talismans were the same. Even if the Void Transference Talisman was a life-preservation treasure for Tribulation Eminences, they could only teleport within the confines of an inhabited world. They couldn’t enter the outer realm using it!
Many talismans couldn’t be used in an inhabited world! Some of them could be used, but their strength would be greatly reduced!
So many life-preservation items. Meng Chuan glanced at them. Even if their strength has been greatly reduced, I still need to spend some effort to break through them.
Rise. The surroundings instantly turned dark.
Strictly speaking, the 150-kilometer area enveloped by the array formation had turned to night. The array flags fluttered as countless runes were activated.
In regards to technique realm, Meng Chuan was comparable to a Fourth Tribulation Eminence. This set of array formations that Meng Chuan had selected from Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasure vault suited him best. Its brilliance brightened the area as wisps of light gradually condensed into a crescent in the middle of the array formation.
The crescent hung high in the night sky like a hook. However, the crescent constantly charged up its power. One’s heart would palpitate just by looking at it with their naked eye.
“The array formation that Meng Chuan is using...” Qin Wu and Luo Tang watched in shock. They knew that Meng Chuan’s strength was unfathomable, but they weren’t certain how strong he was.
“This array formation?” Demon Sage Bai Fu, Demon Sage Si Feng, and Imperial Lord Ying Feng, who were hiding in the Green Fire Lotus, were somewhat flustered.
Just seeing the crescent made them panic.
“We have many life-preservation items. All we need is ten minutes.”
“The Six Cycles Earth Talisman I used just now can only be cracked by a Fifth Tribulation Eminence in the outer realm. Although its strength is greatly weakened in an inhabited world, even a newly-advanced Tribulation Eminence will probably take ten minutes to crack it. Furthermore, we have used several other life-preservation items that aren’t inferior to the Six Cycles Earth Talisman.” Demon Sage Bai Fu and Demon Sage Si Feng were now on guard.
Meng Chuan watched as the demons formed an impregnable defense.
Moonfall Strike. Meng Chuan glanced at the crescent in the sky.
Boom
The crescent slashed down like a saber as it executed Meng Chuan’s strongest moveSaber of Nirvana.
Wherever the saber beam passed, everything returned to darkness and stillness.
“It can be blocked.” Demon Sage Bai Fu, Demon Sage Si Feng, and Imperial Lord Ying Feng stared at the attack. Imperial Lord Ying Feng was still desperately absorbing the Outer Realm Essence Crystals’ energy so that his body could completely transform.
Boom!
The demons only felt darkness descend upon them.
Everything tore apart; nothing could put up a resistance against it. In an instant, a total of three layers of protection were destroyed. Even the Six Cycles Earth Talisman’s energy was instantly consumed.
I only destroyed three layers? Meng Chuan didn’t care about Demon Sage Bai Fu and company’s horror and disbelief. With a thought, another crescent condensed in the darkness.
Annihilate.
The second Moonfall Strike descended.
Moonfall Strike carried the Saber of Nirvana’s extremely terrifying destructive force as it struck the demons’ defenses. Another few layers of protection collapsed.
Third strike!
Fourth strike!
Every attack seemed to strike Demon Sage Bai Fu, Demon Sage Si Feng, and Imperial Lord Ying Feng’s hearts. They were completely dazed.
“How is this possible?” On the other side of the demon sage passageway, Emperor Roc, Lady Blackmoon, and Imperial Lord Starquix clearly saw this scene through the massive World Entrance.
They had been fully confident of their defensive means, which only ended up being destroyed by Meng Chuan. It had taken him just four strikes!
Apart from the Green Fire Lotus, all other defensive means had been destroyed. Even the array formation controlled by Demon Sage Bai Fu was instantly sent flying by the Thirteen Universe Beads.
Meng Chuan channeled his energy into the fifth strike from afar. A new crescent formed in the darkness.
What realm is he at? Emperor Roc could no longer maintain his calm. His face distorted as he stared at the scenery on the other end of the World Entrance. At that moment, he understood that his dreams had been shattered!

chapters.title: Chapter 535 - Final Chapter of War (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 535 Final Chapter of War (2)
Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures were like the dog and his reflection. Their plans were ultimately for naught. Their efforts over the past 900 years had all been in vain. Emperor Roc, Lady Blackmoon, and Imperial Lord Starquix found this unacceptable.
“What realm is he at?” Lady Blackmoon and Imperial Lord Starquix were equally puzzled.
Through the 50-kilometer-wide demon sage passageway, they could clearly see the battle in the human world.
The crescent descended repeatedly. As if it had the might of a heavenly body, the crescent struck the Green Fire Lotus.
The three demons hiding in the Green Fire Lotus trembled.
“He’s steamrolling them completely.” Emperor Roc felt mixed emotions. “They have no way to resist.”
It was like a mortal brandishing a hammer and smashing a bean.
Bam! Bam! Bam!
The bean had no way of resisting. Its only end was pulverization.
We’re doomed. In the Green Fire Lotus, Demon Sage Bai Fu, Demon Sage Si Feng, and Imperial Lord Ying Feng knew their fates very well.
They watched as the cold, white-haired man repeatedly pummeled them with the condensed crescents.
“More than 70 years ago, this Meng Chuan participated in the World Gap battle. Back then, he was only a Regis Godfiend. How long has it been? How can he be so powerful?” muttered Demon Sage Si Feng to himself. He was about to go crazy. “Previously, it was said that he could become an Imperial Lord with his outstanding talent. However, he should only be a newly-advanced Imperial Lord. Why did so many life-preservation items get destroyed so easily?” “Even a Tribulation Eminence can’t tear through all of the layers of protection easily, but Meng Chuan managed to do so in a few strikes.” Demon Sage Bai Fu looked up and watched the fifth crescent descend. “Meng Chuan is even stronger than a newly-advanced Tribulation Eminence. If I had known this would happen, why would I be sending myself to my death?”
“That’s right. We are sending ourselves to our deaths.” Demon Sage Si Feng nodded. “It’s indeed suicidal for the three of us to fight a Tribulation Eminence.”
Boom!
The fifth crescent descended, causing the Green Fire Lotus to tremble and show signs of damage.
The sixth crescent condensed.
“As long as we leave the Green Fire Lotus, we will probably be reduced to dust when a mere ripple sweeps past us.” Demon Sage Bai Fu sighed softly. “However, this Green Fire Lotus probably won’t last much longer. I wasn’t willing to participate in this battle, but I couldn’t disobey Emperor Roc and the rest. Who knew that I would really die? Furthermore, I’ll be dying in such an aggrieved manner.”
At that moment, the Green Fire Lotus suffered a heavy blow once again. The lotus flower showed signs of damage in many spots.
“It’s likely that it won’t be able to withstand the seventh strike. Bai Fu, I feel very sorry for you. You could have become an Imperial Lord and lived a carefree life for a long time, but you still had to accompany us.” Demon Sage Si Feng’s wrinkled face was very calm. After all, he was very old and wasn’t too far from the end of his life. He could accept this situation rather easily.
However, Imperial Lord Ying Feng didn’t say a word. He was frantically absorbing Outer Realm Essence Crystals to perfect his body. His body had just matured, and he had a long lifespan-his future was filled with infinite possibilities. How could he be willing to die?
Boom!
Meng Chuan coldly condensed the seventh crescent. The crescent descended. Executing Saber of Nirvana, it descended upon the Green Fire Lotus that was about to collapse at any moment. The moment it struck, the Green Fire Lotus completely exploded and dissipated.
“Go.” The moment the Green Fire Lotus was struck, Demon Sage Si Feng instantly transformed into a gust of wind and rushed towards the demon sage passageway.
Demon Sage Bai Fu knew very well that he couldn’t survive because there wasn’t an array formation, and he had a weak body. He calmly looked up at the crescent and didn’t escape.
“Die!” Imperial Lord Ying Feng roared.
After becoming an Imperial Lord, he was unable to return to the Demon Realm through the demon sage passageway! Meng Chuan had also completely trapped him in the array formation, so he couldn’t tear through the world membrane and escape to the outer realm! His only path of survival was to attack Meng Chuan.
Boom
Just as the crescent destroyed the Green Fire Lotus, the darkness also affected the windwhich was the transformed Demon Sage Si Feng-Demon Sage Bai Fu, who was silently standing, and Imperial Lord Ying Feng, who was crazily attacking Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar.
Whoosh!
Everything fell silent and still under the swath of darkness.
The wind dissipated and Bai Fu was annihilated. Imperial Lord Ying Feng’s body was completely reduced to nothingness as he roared. Only his indignant roar remained echoing within the 150-kilometer-wide array formation.
This demon team was completely wiped out.
The human Supremacies watching the entire battle outside the array formation first fell silent before they burst into an uproar.
“He won?”
“We won?”
The Supremacies stared at Meng Chuan in excitement. The three powerful demon sages sent by the demons had been completely annihilated. Those three demon sages were the strongest experts that the demons could send through the demon sage passageway. After the three were wiped out, the demons would not be able to send such strong forces for a long time.
“It’s been over 900 years. We’ve finally won.” Qin Wu cried tears of joy.
Xu Yingwu’s face flushed red in excitement. “We humans have ultimately won this war.”
Bai Yaoyue smiled happily. “I’ve been waiting for this day for so long, and it’s finally come.”
“The many generations of Godfiends didn’t sacrifice themselves for nothing,” said Jing Fei softly.
Nine hundred years ago, before Meng Chuan rose to prominence, humanity had always been at a disadvantage during the war. Generations of Godfiends rushed to every battlefield frontier. Even mortals had to serve in the military and guard the city passes with great difficulty.
Countless mortals either died or were crippled. More than 100,000 Godfiends had died in battle. More than 10,000 Godfiends from the three sects had died. Even more outer sect disciples had perished during the war.
Considering the speed at which newly-advanced Godfiends arose, the ratio of casualties was extremely high. In the past 900 years, almost every Human Godfiend had participated in the war. Most of them were killed in action.
These Supremacies watched everything happen with their own eyes. They did their best, but they could only watch as the mortals and young Godfiends fought against the demons. If these brave souls hadn’t been defending the human world, the war situation for the humans would’ve been much worse. However, seeing so many Godfiends and mortals die tormented equally.
“We’ve finally won.” Luo Tang smiled as tears welled up in her eyes. “Even if we die, we can face the Godfiends that died in battle with our heads up.”
“I never expected Meng Chuan to attain such strength in just a few decades,” exclaimed Bai Yaoyue.
Qin Wu looked at Meng Chuan-who remained calm as he stood in the array formation-and said, “No strength comes by chance. We don’t know what Meng Chuan sacrificed to attain his present strength.”
We won. After destroying the three demon sages, Meng Chuan felt relieved.
His greatest wish—which he had since he was young-had finally been fulfilled.
For this specific goal, many people had sacrificed their lives. Many Godfiends like Xue Feng and King True Martial had sacrificed their lives. Even his wife, Qiyue, had burned her bloodline until she nearly exhausted almost all her lifespan. She was currently sleeping in Millennium Hall like the other ancient Godfiends, waiting to be awoken to answer the call of duty.
Everyone, we won. Muttered Meng Chuan inwardly. He should have been excited. He should have shouted or cried. However, his heart remained calm. He had been in the Chaos Hole for too long, and he had spent too much time and effort comprehending Saber of Nirvana.
Demons. Meng Chuan looked through the demon sage passageway and saw Emperor Roc, Lady Blackmoon, and Imperial Lord Starquix.
Go. Meng Chuan’s heart suddenly stirred. A crescent condensed in the night sky; it carried Meng Chuan’s will and executed Saber of Nirvana. It passed through the demon sage passageway and slashed at Emperor Roc and company.
Meng Chuan was still stuck at the Chaos Hole realm-placing him at the Supremacy level. The crescent-which contained his Quintessential Essence and willpower-was not repelled by the demon sage passageway. Instead, it successfully traveled through it and instantly shot towards Emperor Roc and company. What? Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon’s instinctively trembled when they saw the incoming crescent. Their instincts told them that they would die if the crescent struck them.
“Humph.” Emperor Roc grunted softly. He stretched out his hand, and a gigantic palm blocked the crescent.
Whoosh.
The crescent silently returned to the still darkness.
The gigantic palm was pierced through, catching Emperor Roc somewhat off-guard. His right hand formed a golden claw as he took the initiative to block it.
Bam!
Emperor Roc protected Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon as they were sent flying dozens of kilometers away. A huge crater, spanning tens of kilometers, appeared. Emperor Roc’s right claw was still bleeding, but it quickly healed.
What? He actually suppressed Emperor Roc? Imperial Lord Blackmoon and Imperial Lord Starquix found this unbelievable. After all, Emperor Roc was a Third Tribulation Eminence.
Nas
On the other side of the demon sage passageway, Meng Chuan calmly observed everything. Although Emperor Roc was suppressed and was sent flying dozens of kilometers away, Meng Chuan remained expressionless. Following that, Meng Chuan turned his head and left, disappearing from Emperor Roc’s sight.
Even I’ve been suppressed by him. Doesn’t he want to enter the Demon Realm to seek revenge? Could it be that he knows that I’m pretending?
Meng Chuan only sent one strike into the Demon Realm. He didn’t plan on entering.
With the Golden-Winged Roc bloodline, the moment it reaches the Tribulation realm, it would be comparable to a Third Tribulation Eminence. Meng Chuan walked through the array formation and remained very clear-headed. It has trapped me in the Chaos Hole for so long. It’s probably at the Second Tribulation realm, or even the Third Tribulation realm. In terms of strength... it’s considered strong among those at the Third Tribulation realm.
As for me? My technique realm is comparable to that of a Fourth Tribulation Eminence, but my body and Quintessential Essence are still very weak. I’m slightly inferior to Imperial Lords.
His homeworld’s body was much weaker due to it not devouring a single Primordial Stone.
There was a huge difference in both body and Quintessential Essence! Even though he had an advantage in his technique realm, Meng Chuan knew that his current strength was still slightly inferior to a Third Tribulation Eminence, much less Emperor Roc.
Most importantly... The Demon Realm was Emperor Roc’s homeworld.
For example, Archean Eon Realm was Meng Chuan’s homeworld. Meng Chuan had set up two array formations around the demon sage passageway. One was a killing array formation, and the other was a trapping array formation.
With fixed array formations set up, Meng Chuan would hold the advantage, even if the enemy was several times stronger.
By the same logic, Emperor Roc set up a massive fixed array formation in his homeworld, which allowed him to unleash extraordinary strength! If Meng Chuan entered the Demon Realm alone, it was very likely that he would be sending himself to his death. Once he died, he would only have his true body that was far away in the Ancient Magus River Zone. Archean Eon Realm would be defenseless. The demons would probably start another invasion in that instance.
As long as I don’t take risks and use the array formations to guard the demon sage passageway, we will remain victorious in this war. The demons won’t have a chance at all. As for revenge? There will be plenty of opportunities in the future. You were sent flying dozens of kilometers by a single strike of mine? Emperor Roc, your show of weakness was too exaggerated.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar flew out of the array formation.
Outside the array formation, the human Supremacies gathered.
“Meng Chuan!”
“Imperial Lord Eastcalm.”
“Dad.”
Everyone looked at Meng Chuan excitedly.
Meng Chuan nodded slightly and said, “After killing these three Heaven Earth realm demon sages, it’s impossible for the demons to send out any threatening experts. We’ve won this war.” “We won.” Upon hearing Meng Chuan say this personally, the Supremacies became even more excited.
“I’ll arrange for my Essence Soul avatars to continue guarding Luo Tang Pass. I’ll use the array formation to seal off the demon sage passageway,” said Meng Chuan. “This demon sage passageway will collapse in a few decades; it won’t take more than two centuries. I’ll guard it until it collapses completely. Everyone, don’t worry. Even a perfected Imperial Lord would be sending itself to its death, much less a Heaven Earth realm demon sage.”
At this moment, Meng Chuan no longer needed to keep a low profile.
The strike that traveled into the Demon Realm was to make the demons give up!

chapters.title: Chapter 536 - Victory!
chapters.content:
Chapter 536 Victory!
“We won!”
“We won.”
“We won the war against the demons.”
In the world, loud cheers could be heard in cities, mountains, and canyons. The world celebrated!
After the three sects confirmed their victory, they spread the news to the world, bringing delight to the world. Celebrations were held everywhere.
Archean Mountain, Blood Red Cliff.
Godfiend disciples gathered here. Even the extremely aged Li Guan was awakened.
“I don’t have much sleeping time left. I thought I wouldn’t be able to see the day of victory.” The white-haired and wrinkled Li Guan arrived at Blood Red Cliff with Qin Wu, Luo Tang, and Meng An accompanying him. They stood at the edge.
“The final battle happened very suddenly. When I saw the three Heaven Earth realm demon sages enter, with one immediately becoming an Imperial Lord. I was a little flustered,” said Luo Tang with a smile. “Who would’ve thought that even a newly-advanced demon Imperial Lord would be so weak in front of Meng Chuan? It was instantly reduced to dust.”
Qin Wu smiled as well. “Meng Chuan did say that the demons would just be sending themselves to their deaths, even if a perfected Imperial Lord entered.” “What realm is Meng Chuan currently at?” asked Li Guan secretly.
“I asked him,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “He said that he’s stronger than newly-advanced Tribulation Eminences.”
Li Guan’s eyes widened as he stared at Qin Wu. Following that, the duo laughed.
Luo Tang and Meng An smiled as they listened.
“Meng Chuan is here,” said Luo Tang.
Meng Chuan walked over from afar. It was still his Essence Soul avatar. His white hair draped over his shoulders as he walked over alone.
Li Guan’s old eyes looked at Meng Chuan, but he could sense a deathly aura coming from Meng Chuan. As someone who didn’t have long to live, Li Guan could sense this very clearly. Meng Chuan walked closer and nodded at the Supremacies. “Dad.” Meng An walked to Meng Chuan’s side. “Meng Chuan,” said Li Guan with an old voice as he carefully stared at Meng Chuan. “before I went into my slumber, you weren’t like this. Why are you now...”
“It’s nothing. It’s just a form of cultivation,” said Meng Chuan.
In the Ancient Magus River Zone, Emperor Roc had already left the Chaos Hole. Emperor Roc could clearly sense that Meng Chuan was in no way inferior to him in terms of technique realm. With the time both sides had to cultivate, he probably wouldn’t be able to leave, even if he wanted to continue stalling for time.
Meng Chuan left the Chaos Hole and was no longer affected by it. However, it was very difficult to change one’s mental state.
Li Guan nodded slightly. “Yes, it’s all cultivation. Living is also cultivation.”
Archean Mountain’s Supremacies turned their heads to look into the distance because the celebration ceremony had begun.
The current Archean Mountain Lord was King Sword Nine. As for many of the older Regis Godfiends, they had already entered slumbers.
The purple-robed King Sword Nine’s prestige had increased. He solemnly said to the surrounding Godfiends, “I’m the fifth Archean Mountain Lord since the war between the demons and the humans began. I stand here before you, very proud to announce to everyone that we humans have won this war!”
“We won!”
“We won! We won!”
The Blood Red Cliff was filled with excited cheers. Many white-haired old Godfiends teared as they cried out in excitement.
Whoosh.
Countless Godfiend phantoms suddenly appeared beside Blood Red Cliff. The area fell silent. The Godfiends present stared, searching for figures they were familiar with.
The incumbent Archean Mountain Lord continued, “There are 17,101 Godfiends here. All of them fought the demons to protect humanity. Out of them, 13,208 Godfiends were killed in action. Only 3,000 Godfiends managed to live to the end of their lifespans, but they also fought the demons their entire lives.
“All Godfiends that sacrificed for this war will live in our memories forever. Our Archean Mountain will forever remember them.”
Meng Chuan watched everything silently. On Blood Red Cliff, he saw many familiar figures—King True Martial, Senior Brother Xue Feng, and his wife, Liu Qiyue...
According to Archean Mountain’s past rules, once a Regis Godfiend entered a slumber, they were publicly pronounced dead. This allowed the Godfiends’ upper echelons to know that these ancient Godfiends haven’t actually died. However, Archean Mountain still followed the preexisting rules because every slumbering Godfiend wasn’t far from the end of their lifespans.
In the images, Meng Chuan, Yan Chitong, Yan Jin, and company couldn’t be seen. However, one could see Liu Qiyue.
Qiyue. Meng Chuan saw his wife— Liu Qiyuestill in her prime amidst the numerous Godfiend images. She was dressed in a cyan-red robe, making her look dazzling. She even had a divine bow and quiver on her back as she smiled brightly.
Meng Chuan knew that his wife had been smiling at him back then.
Qiyue, we won this war. Meng Chuan thought to himself, The oath we made back then has been fulfilled.
That night, the still young man and woman had made a life-long promise. Back then, even the two of them felt that their goal was a stretch. They were prepared to die in battle. But now, he continued advancing towards his goal, risking his life to advance, and he had succeeded.
Brother. Yan Jin stood among the Godfiends and stared at a young man amidst the Godfiend projections. It was Xue Feng. Brother, everything’s fine. Everything in the world is fine. Yan Jin stared at the figure, who had taken care of him since he was young.
He managed to walk out of his former state partly because of his wife and everything that Meng Chuan had said about King Calm Sea, but it was mainly because of his elder brother!
The World Gap.
King Calm Sea, whose entire body was like ice, sat there silently. Ever since he received news that they had won the war, he had been sitting here. Now, he didn’t look like a human at all. His body was like a sculpture made of deep cyan ice.
We won. King Calm Sea finally grinned. We finally won.
He slowly stood up. As a sinner, I’ll continue patrolling the World Gap. My 300-year sentence isn’t up. King Calm Sea walked through the lonely World Gap. Now that the World Gap was completely stable, all the treasures produced had long been taken away. He couldn’t observe a forming world while meditating, so even demons seldom came here.
King Calm Sea was the only living being in the World Gap.
Other than the Godfiends from the sect, many ordinary Godfiends-who could only be considered outer sect disciples—had fought the demons. Many died in battle. “Senior Brother Zhang, Senior Brother Wang, Senior Sister Li... Also, Junior Sister, I’m here to visit everyone.” A white-haired elder was sitting in a cemetery. He muttered, “In the past two months, my eyes have become worse. As a Godfiend who can’t even see clearly, I’m probably going to join you guys underground.
“However, I came with good news today. We won the war against the demons. We won. The world will be completely peaceful in the future. Junior Sister, I said that I’ll marry you after we swapped defenses. However, I didn’t manage to see you again. I owe this to you.
“I didn’t marry again. I’ve been fighting the demons my entire life. Now that the war has been won, I don’t need to fight anymore. I’m relieved,” muttered the white-haired elder as he drank his alcohol.
Unknowingly, he fell asleep leaning on the tombstone.
An eternal slumber.
Too many people in the world were thrilled about this day’s arrival. This was because many people had sacrificed too much for this war.

chapters.title: Chapter 537 - Tremble
chapters.content:
Chapter 537 Tremble
Jiang State Capital.
Meng Chuan was alone in the city, watching the celebrating Jiang State Capital.
After coming victorious in the war, the world celebrated for a month. It wasn’t just Jiang State Capital celebrating. Every large city in the world and many villages were celebrating as well.
“Nice.”
“Beautiful.”
“Another one.”
People chuckled as they watched the acrobatic performances. To ordinary people, the feeling of victory wasn’t a strong one! This was because in the past few decades, even the demons had abandoned the unstable World Entrances. It had been a long time since ordinary people had encountered any demon threats. Instead, many of the celebrations in the world made them happier.
The white-haired Meng Chuan walked alone in the crowd. Mortals couldn’t see him, nor could they sense the human world’s strongest expert walking past him.
We’ve won the war. However, my mental state has been greatly affected by the Chaos Hole after all these years. It’s very difficult for me to feel happy. However, my current mental state is different from Nirvana of the past.
I... Meng Chuan was somewhat puzzled.
His Essence Soul avatar walked through the city until it went out of the city.
He looked at villages. They were also celebrating, but at the same time, villagers were doing some farm work.
He looked at the rivers and lakes. Fishermen were still fishing and celebrating January. It was impossible for ordinary people to enjoy themselves for a month. They still had to work and support their families.
He saw many merchant caravans still rushing towards the cities and transporting the large amounts of materials needed for the celebrations.
My current mental state isn’t Nirvana. It’s not happiness or excitement either. What is it? At his current realm, Meng Chuan couldn’t even tell.
He felt relaxed, slightly tipsy, but his Essence Soul was trembling. It resembled trembles of excitement. This feeling filled Meng Chuan’s heart. He couldn’t help but walk around the world as he carefully observed it.
Archean Mountain, in a large hall in a Grotto-Heaven.
Three Godfiend disciples were placing massive numbers of dossiers on shelves. At this point, Meng Chuan walked in. “Master.” The three Godfiend disciples bowed respectfully.
“Are all the dossiers here?” asked Meng Chuan.
“The dossiers from Two World Island and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven have been sent over,” said a Godfiend disciple respectfully. “Among them, there are more than 230,000 Godfiend dossiers. There are even more mortal dossiers. Since the war began, billions of mortals have participated in the war. Therefore, most of them are just dossiers with their names. Only those who contributed greatly would have a special dossier.”
“Meng Chuan nodded slightly. Okay, continue your work.”
This was the decision of the three sects under his leadership.
He gathered all the dossiers of the Godfiends and mortals that had participated in the war. Each of the three sects had copies of them. No matter what, they had to let future descendants know about their valiance and sacrifices.
Meng Chuan casually picked up a dossier.
“Master, there are Godfiend dossiers here. The shelves behind contain the mortal dossiers,” reminded the Godfiend disciple softly.
Meng Chuan nodded slightly and read.
This dossier was about a powerful Godfiend from 900 years ago. Marquis East MartyrZhang Xing. When the Demon Realm and the human world gradually neared one another, unstable World Entrances just started appearing in Archean Eon Realm. Back then, Marquis East MartyrZhang Xing-was only a Great Solar Godfiend. He saw a city that had been massacred. No one survived in that county city. The scene was like a living hell...
Ever since then, Marquis East Martyr, Zhang Xing, busily hunted down demons. However, the unstable World Entrances’ sudden appearances still caused massacres to happen in cities and villages constantly. It was a nightmare for the humans of that time.
After stable World Entrances appeared, Marquis East Martyr Zhang Xing began guarding a city pass.
Later, he became a Marquis Godfiend.
He fought demons his entire life. He saw more and more city passes appear, and more unstable World Entrances. As a Marquis Godfiend, he was very safe during the war’s early stages, but many mortals had died during that time.
Marquis East Martyr died in his hometown, but he had contributed greatly after spending his entire life fighting the demons.
After reading the dossier about Marquis East Martyr, Zhang Xing, Meng Chuan walked forward and picked up another dossier.
This was a dossier about an outer sect disciple.
Outer sect disciples like Fairy Meng had never cultivated on Archean Mountain for long.
This outer sect disciple was called An Tong. He was born 800 years ago. An Tong was at the Impervious realm and the Core Condensation stage when he was 19. He was considered one of the strongest mortals. Back then, military conscription hadn’t been implemented because the pressure on the humans guarding the city passes wasn’t too great. It was on a voluntary basis.
An Tong bade farewell to his parents when he was 19. He headed to a city pass in high spirits. He became a soldier and fought the demons.
After fighting the demons for six years, he made immense contributions several times. During this period of time, the city pass had been breached once. More than half of the city pass’s soldiers died. Only after the Godfiend reinforcement arrived did the remaining soldiers survive. An Tong had luckily survived. This was his greatest life-and-death experience before he became a Godfiend.
When he was 25, he had earned enough credits to challenge the Life-and-Death juncture and successfully become a Godfiend. He then stayed home for three years under the orders of his parents. He got married and had children.
Three years later, he returned to the military. At that time, it wasn’t compulsory for every outer sect Godfiend to participate in the war, but An Tong continued fighting.
This way... An Tong guarded a city pass for 65 years until the demons planned an all-out attack. In order to stop the demons, An Tong ultimately died at the city pass.
Antong, muttered Meng Chuan silently.
He was an outer sect disciple who ultimately became an Indestructible Godfiend. Outer sect disciples never cultivated on Archean Mountain for long, but in reality, they were many in number.
Humanity couldn’t give them enough resources. They even needed to exchange credits for the resources required to challenge the Life-and-Death juncture themselves! After that, they were left to fend for themselves. However, these outer sect disciples had contributed greatly in the war against the demons. Far more outer sect disciples had died than the Godfiends from the three sects. They were extremely important.
Earth Net required a large number of ordinary Godfiends.
Many city passes needed the help of ordinary Godfiends that weren’t from the three sects.
Meng Chuan read the dossiers one by one and continued walking towards the back.
He finally reached the end.
Meng Chuan picked up a dossier.
“Wang Fu, Wang Changyu, Wang Ergou, Wang Sanmao...”
Meng Chuan’s heart trembled as he read the dense list of names.
All of them were names. Names filled one page after another.
After flipping through the dossier, Meng Chuan spotted a few words.
“On 9th April during the 19th year of Tian An’s reign of the Great Zhou Dynasty, Quyang Pass was breached, all 19,302 mortal soldiers in the city were wiped out.”
Meng Chuan’s hand trembled slightly. He closed the dossier and picked up another dossier.
This one was filled with names as well...
One dossier after another.
One pile after another.
They numbered in the billions.
Almost all of them contained names only. Meng Chuan looked at the countless names and felt countless gazes on him. Countless people were looking at him. When Meng Chuan reached the end, there were no more names, but relics left behind on many battlefields.
“Dad, Mom, I’ve reached Qinyang Pass.
“Don’t worry. My saber art is very powerful. Those demons can’t threaten me at all. I promise you that I will definitely return...” This was a letter. Only half of the letter remained. It was probably a letter that a soldier had yet to send back.
Many items were placed on the shelves, and words were carved on the shelves. “Third year of Chunping’s reign of the Great Zhou Dynasty. Qinyang Pass was breached. Items left behind.” It was unknown who the owners of these many relics were, so they couldn’t be sent back. Earth Net collected them and stored them in Archean Mountain’s classified sections.
Meng Chuan silently stared at the countless relics. He turned his head to look at the countless dossiers. It was as though he had traveled through spacetime and saw billions of people. They smiled at Meng Chuan or nodded with a smile. All of them were smiling.
At that moment, Meng Chuan finally understood why he was trembling after winning the war.
He sat cross-legged.
It was as though billions of people were watching him. Meng Chuan waved his hand, and a long painting floated in front of him. He picked up a brush, one that had been dabbed in ink. He began to move the brush. At that moment, the intense feelings—which made his Essence Soul tremble—made him want to depict the truth. Even his mental state that was trying to return to Nirvana couldn’t suppress it.

chapters.title: Chapter 538 - Eighth-Level Essence Soul
chapters.content:
Chapter 538 Eighth-Level Essence Soul
The powerful feelings—which made his body tremble-broke through all suppressions and surged out.
Meng Chuan held the brush in his hand and began painting.
First, it was a dark and oppressive scene. A Godfiend stood high in the sky and looked down at a ruined city. The ruined city was painted with dark hues. Countless corpses littered the city. This was a city the size of a prefecture city. There were too many corpses, so Meng Chuan painted them simply. However, behind the simple brushstrokes were a deathly aura.
Meng Chuan had personally seen too many cities that had suffered massacres. When the demons wreaked havoc in the world, he had rescued many cities and had seen many humans in cities and forts being slaughtered.
He had seen it with his own eyes. Thus, this painting’s emotions were soul-stirring and went bone-deep.
The slaughtered cities, the slaughtered villages, the large number of ferocious demons that entered from the unstable World Entrances, and the fleeing ordinary people covered the entire canvas. This scene showed the beginning of the war between Archean Eon Realm and the Demon Realm.
Following that, humans began to build majestic city passes around the stable World Entrances. Godfiends and mortal soldiers guarded them.
People dismantled ordinary villages and began building forts that were covered in traps. Thousands of mortals gathered together.
The entire world had changed because of the demons.
Meng Chuan painted scenes of mortals joining the military.
A mortal teenager carried his luggage and bade farewell to his parents; a valiant woman bowed to an elderly man; a one-armed man hugged his wife, but he still left without any hesitation; a middle-aged man stroked his children’s heads and entrusted them to his wife...
Every one of them was inspired in one way or another. Meng Chuan had read many dossiers about mortal soldiers.
In the earliest days of the war, city pass soldiers were recruited publicly. It was all voluntary. They could apply to be a soldier after reaching the Marrow Cleansing realm. Many youths joined the army without any hesitation to fight the demons.
As he painted the military recruitment scene, Meng Chuan recalled the countless names on the dossiers. Many people only had their names left to be remembered.
When Meng Chuan flipped through the dossiers, he completely understood why his Essence Soul kept trembling. His Essence Soul began to glow.
As he moved his brush, his Essence Soul constantly emitted light, constantly transforming
Half a day of painting later, Meng Chuan finished the scene of mortals joining the military.
Boom!
His Essence Soul—which had been transforming for more than half a day-had completely undergone a qualitative change.
Every Essence Soul thought emitted a rainbow glow, as though they were worldly treasures. The Essence Soul formed by countless Essence Soul thoughts was vast and mysterious. Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul was draped in a colorful robe. It emitted rainbow colors.
Eighth-level Essence Soul!
Many Imperial Lords spent their entire lives with seventh-level Essence Souls. Even those with extremely high Essence Soul cultivation talent would find it difficult to take that step and attain an eighth-level Essence Soul.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s Essence Soul cultivation talent wasn’t high. He was extremely talented at physical body cultivation, but his Essence Soul remained at the seventh level, even though he was a Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
Meng Chuan...
He had a heart that observed the world since he was young. He also had talent in painting. However, he had cultivated for more than 700 years. His mental state had turned still. After experiencing the entire war, he attained an eighth-level Essence Soul realm while painting. The higher one’s cultivation realm was, the harder it was for them to improve their mind and Essence Soul. This was because they had seen too many things. Even if the world collapsed, they could calmly face it. Thus, it became extremely difficult for them to improve their Essence Souls!
An Eighth-level Essence Soul! In the vast River of Spacetime, it meant one had reached the Essence Soul Tribulation realm!
At the Essence Soul Tribulation realm, one also needed to undergo Tribulation Transcendence. Every Essence Soul Tribulation tested one’s Essence Soul.
Of course, Meng Chuan’s first Essence Soul Tribulation would take at least a year before it descended.
An eighth-level Essence Soul? Meng Chuan sensed his changes, but he didn’t care.
In front of this painting, his Essence Soul’s transformation could be put aside. This painting reflected his heart! In the past, Meng Chuan’s mental state had returned to Nirvana, making it difficult for him to feel any emotional upheavals. This was because Meng Chuan believed that the final destination of everything was Nirvana. The entire world seemed to be gray. However, his mental state had changed after reading the dossiers. He had completely torn apart his Nirvana mental state.
He now had a different mental state.
Meng Chuan could only paint because he had ripped apart his Nirvana mental state.
Meng Chuan was completely immersed in painting.
After painting the scenes of mortals joining the military, Meng Chuan painted a majestic city pass.
There were Godfiends, mortals, and a World Entrance at this city pass. The few mortals-a teenager, a woman, a one-armed man, and a middle-aged man-were all part of the mortal army.
The Godfiends led the mortals to resist the demons.
Some soldiers beat the drums with all their might. Accompanied by the drumming, the other mortal soldiers worked together to fight the demons, while the Godfiends fought the demon monarchs.
In the battle, many soldiers fell as the remaining soldiers fought crazily.
The battle was won. However, many soldiers died. Some of their companions mourned, while others stood atop the city walls and stared at the World Entrance.
Scenes after scenes of victory were drawn. The teenager, the woman, the one-armed man, and the middle-aged man remained alive at the city pass, but many of their companions died.
Finally, another scene appeared. A demon monarch’s roar echoed in the sky as the demons wreaked havoc. All the humans died.
The teenager, the woman, the one-armed man, and the middle-aged man’s corpses were among them. On the other side
The teenager’s parents, the woman’s master, the one-armed man’s wife, and the middle-aged man’s wife and children were still looking into the distance.
This scene of mortals participating in battles, fighting and sacrificing their lives, and how their families waited for them took Meng Chuan nine days to paint. It seemed like he was only painting a few important soldiers, but in reality, it represented the countless soldiers that died in battle. These countless soldiers each had families. They had their own dreams. If it were a peaceful era, they might be more willing to accompany their family. They would also be more willing to accompany their wives to bring up their children.
However, all of them went to participate in the
war.
In the early days, participation was voluntary. However, during the war’s middle and late stages, the number of city passes increased. Humanity had no choice but to begin conscripting people into the military. They provided many benefits to the soldiers, but the number of casualties remained tragic.
Meng Chuan paused after finishing this segment of history. In his mind, he recalled the stories he read in the dossiers. Among the countless items left behind, many were letters. He felt like he was watching a living person’s life as he read them.
Many of them missed their families and felt like they owed them. However, the city passes had to be guarded! If they didn’t defend them, the demons would wreak havoc, causing more deaths.
If they didn’t resist, humanity would be wiped out by the demons.
Only a few Supremacies knew of the World Annihilation plan. Many Regis Godfiends and Two World Island and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven’s Supremacies believed that humanity would be exterminated if they couldn’t hold the demons back. To prevent that, generations of Godfiends had risked their lives.
It was the same for Meng Chuan back then. He also went all out to protect humanity.
Meng Chuan continued painting.
He painted the war’s beginning, the city passes, and the forts. He painted mortals joining the war, the Godfiend guarding the city passes, and the Skydemon Sect wreaking havoc...
He painted a history that spanned over 900 years. He was also painting heroes. When painting each hero, Meng Chuan thought of all these historical events.
It was also a will-humanity’s will to protect Archean Eon Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 539 - Skydemon Sect’s Plea
chapters.content:
Chapter 539 Skydemon Sect’s Plea
On the sixth day of the new year at Archean Mountain, the mountain still had the new year’s festive vibes.
Inside Grotto-Heaven Pavilion, Qin Wu stood with his hands behind his back. He frowned slightly, appearing somewhat frustrated.
Meng Chuan, you are Archean Mountain’s current leader. You went into seclusion immediately and threw all your responsibilities at me. You clearly have so many Essence Soul avatars, so can’t you have an Essence Soul avatar presiding over the sect’s matters? Qin Wu was rather helpless. He glanced at a nearby room. The room led to a grotto-heaven. I wonder when he will exit seclusion.
Amidst his frustrations, a figure descended from the sky. It was Meng An. “Meng An.” Qin Wu smiled when he saw Meng An. Although Meng An’s talent couldn’t compare to a monstrous genius like Meng Chuan, he was still very outstanding. His current strength was probably slightly higher than Qin Wu’s.
“Master,” said Meng An humbly.
When Meng An entered Archean Mountain, Qin Wu was still the one managing Archean Mountain. He was also the one that gave lectures at Grotto-Heaven Pavilion.
Qin Wu helmed Grotto-Heaven Pavilion for 300 years. Many had attended Qin Wu’s lectures. From grandfather, father, to children, all of them addressed him as Master.
In the past 300 years, Qin Wu had too many disciples. These disciples had various relationships between themselves—father and son, husband and wife, etc. “Meng An, what’s the matter?” asked Qin Wu. “I need to discuss something with my father, but I can’t contact him,” said Meng An. “I heard that Master is in charge of Grotto-Heaven Pavilion now, so I wanted to ask, what’s up with my father now? He ignores me even when I’m looking for him.” “Your father is in seclusion,” explained Qin Wu. “He ignores everything in the outside world unless something extremely important happens.”
“Seclusion?” Meng An couldn’t help but ask, “How long will it take?”
“Your father only told me that he should be out of seclusion within a year. I’m not sure about the exact time,” said Qin Wu.
“In a year?” Meng An heaved a sigh of relief. “There’s still time.”
At that moment, a disciple carefully came over and bowed respectfully. “Greetings, Supremacies. Skydemon Sect’s sect master has come to the mountain and wishes to seek an audience with Imperial Lord Eastcalm.”
“Oh?” Qin Wu was somewhat surprised. “Let’s go. Lead the way.”
“Yes,” said the disciple respectfully.
Meng An did not follow. It was good enough for one Supremacy to meet the Skydemon Sect’s sect master. How could a few Supremacies meet him?
In a large hall on Archean Mountain. Qin Wu entered the hall.
“Master.” The current Archean Mountain Lord, King Sword Nine, immediately stood up. Qin Wu sat in the main seat of honor, while King Sword Nine obediently sat by the side.
Qin Wu looked at the elegant middle-aged man in front of him. “Skydemon Sect’s sect master?”
The middle-aged man had some white hair. His entire body was somewhat dark. It was an Essence Soul avatar.
“Greetings, Supremacy Qin Wu.” Skydemon Sect Master smiled and bowed. His smile naturally carried an evil charm.
“I never expected the Skydemon Sect’s sect master to have a sixth-level Essence Soul,” said Qin Wu in surprise. He had high talent in Sword Dao, but he was relatively inferior when it came to cultivating his Essence Soul. He had only attained a sixth-level Essence Soul after having his wish of winning the war fulfilled.
As for this mysterious Skydemon Sect Master, he had a sixth-level Essence Soul.
Skydemon Sect Master had cultivated the incomplete Skydemon system to the fifth Firmament Skydemon realm. His Essence Soul cultivation talent was even higher, allowing him to hold the position of sect master firmly.
“My body was flawed. I couldn’t condense a core using the Godfiend system,” said Skydemon Sect Master with a smile. “Instead, the Skydemon system is especially suitable for me. However, I’m only a fifth Firmament Skydemon. I only have less than a century left to live.”
Qin Wu looked at him. “Why are you here?”
“Where’s Imperial Lord Eastcalm?” asked Skydemon Sect Master. “This matter concerns the fate of the Skydemon Sect’s many Skydemons. I hope to meet him and hear him promise.”
King Sword Nine frowned and shouted angrily, “Speak!”
The three human sects had always been hostile towards the Skydemon Sect. After all, this was a faction that had betrayed humanity!
Over the years, it had caused too much harm to humanity. This was because many Godfiends and mortals had died as a result of Skydemon Sect’s machinations. Some young mortal geniuses had died at the hands of the Skydemon Sect. Now, he came acting arrogantly, disregarding Supremacy Qin Wu and asked for Imperial Lord Eastcalm?
“I’ll speak.” Skydemon Sect Master didn’t insist further. He smiled and said, “I represent many Skydemons to beg for survival.”
“Survival?” Qin Wu looked at him. “Yes, surrender. I can guarantee your survival.”
“If we surrender, we will probably be imprisoned immediately. We will suffer daily torment. We don’t wish to live like this,” said Skydemon Sect Master with a smile. “All of us Skydemons want to live. We hope that the human Godfiends can let bygones be bygones. I hope that my Skydemon Sect’s cultivators can openly live under the sun safely. The three sects will treat us and ordinary Godfiends as equals. If we are to commit any more heinous crimes, the three sects can punish us severely. However, if we don’t commit any crimes, the past should not be pursued any further.”
Qin Wu frowned when he heard that. He waved his hand. “You have to pay the price for your sins. You can scram if you want your punishments to be waived. Let’s see if you can escape our Archean Mountain’s pursuit.”
Skydemon Sect Master indifferently said, “Our Skydemon Sect is entrenched amongst humanity. Even after all these years, Godfiends have still failed to find us. Likewise, they won’t be able to find us in the future. If we are not spared, the Skydemons will have no room for retreat. We can only continue to be enemies with the Godfiends. If this happens, many people will die.”
“Oh?” Qin Wu looked at him. “Continue.”
“Actually, I only have a few decades left to live. If I don’t surrender, I can still continue living a carefree life,” said Skydemon Sect Master. “I’m just passing a message on behalf of the many Skydemons. Many Skydemons wish to live. If the Godfiends don’t give them a way out, the Skydemons can only counterattack crazily. Therefore, I advise Supremacy Qin Wu to think it over.”
Qin Wu glared at him. “Dream on.”
“The Skydemon Sect now has more than 1,000 Skydemons. Three of them have reached the fifth Firmament realm,” said Skydemon Sect Master. “As for the ordinary disciples that have yet to become Skydemons, there are countless of them. They are all mortals and are everywhere in the cities. Are the three sects sure they won’t let us live? I think we should ask Imperial Lord Eastcalm about this and let him decide.”
Qin Wu looked at him and said coldly, “Meng Chuan will be informed of this matter. The three sects will also need to discuss it. Due to the huge implications, we will give the Skydemon Sect an answer a year later.”
“Alright, we’ll wait for the Godfiends’ reply.” Skydemon Sect Master smiled slightly before turning to leave.
Qin Wu watched as the other party flew away.
“Master?” King Sword Nine looked at Qin Wu. “The Skydemon Sect is different from the demons.” Qin Wu frowned and said worriedly, “The Skydemon Sect has entrenched itself by infiltrating every corner of the world. Skydemon Sect members might be hiding in large cities and even ordinary villages. If they attack, the destruction they can cause will indeed be very great. I have to think about how I can reduce the losses and get rid of these traitors.”
King Sword Nine nodded.
Another month passed.
Demon monarchs came to the mountain.
The demon monarchs in the human world, especially the fourth and fifth Firmament demon monarchs that were hiding in small grotto-heavens, could only return to the Demon Realm via large and super-large city passes. Those city passes were securely defended, making it impossible for them to return.
Now that they had lost the war, they could only hide in the human world forever. Such days were simply a nightmare.
Therefore, they could only negotiate.
Spring passed and summer came. Meng Chuan had painted for five months and nine days.
Meng Chuan was still in the hall. He was still sitting cross-legged and painting seriously.
Whoosh.
As he raised his brush, Meng Chuan stared at the painting in front of him. It was an extremely long painting. The canvas prepared by Meng Chuan was only 300 feet long. This was something Meng Chuan had deliberately prepared. However, he connected three pieces of canvas together, forming a super-long painting.
At the end of the painting, one could see the scene of a bustling, peaceful world as it experienced prosperous days. “Everyone. We didn’t let your sacrifices go to waste.
