We won this war,” said Meng Chuan. This was said to the Godfiends and billions of warriors who had died in battle. Following that, he wrote one word on the right side of the painting-Backbone.

chapters.title: Chapter 540 - The World Projected
chapters.content:
Chapter 540 The World Projected
One generation plants the trees, another gets the shade.
The sacrifices made by generations of Godfiends and mortal warriors allowed the war to drag on until Meng Chuan grew stronger.
If Godfiends had been afraid of death, with none of them willing to risk their lives, the few Supremacies wouldn’t have been able to defend the numerous World Entrances. The human world would probably have long collapsed after the human Supremacies chose to execute the World Annihilation plan. Countless lives would have been wiped out.
Meng Chuan, Liu Qiyue, and the others might not have even been born if the World Annihilation plan had happened. Only a small number of humans in the grotto-heavens would survive.
Billions of heroes used their lives to earn hope for the entire human race. They are the backbone of humanity.
Meng Chuan looked at the floating painting in front of him.
This painting depicted the countless sacrifices humanity had made. He drew the backbone of Archean Eon Realm’s human race.
Outside the Heaven and Earth Great Hall. Meng Chuan walked out of the hall and stood alone in the square. The square was filled with fog.
He stared into the distance silently, but his heart was filled with joy.
After his body trembled, he had an epiphany, which allowed him to gain basic insights. It was only after painting ‘Backbone’ that he experienced catharsis. His understanding deepened
Nirvana? Nirvana is the ultimate home for all things. It’s the ultimate version of eternity.
Life is most dazzling and exciting. The vastness of spacetime becomes interesting because of life. Life is the soul of spacetime. Without life, the River of Spacetime would be gray. With life, the River of Spacetime is colorful, said Meng Chuan to himself. Life has already surpassed eternity.
The transformation of one’s heart and mind had a significant impact on cultivators. This had an even greater impact on Essence Souls.
Meng Chuan’s aura was no longer dead and still. Instead, it was warm and bright. This was because Meng Chuan felt that every part of the world was beautiful! Every part was filled with brimming vitality!
I never expected that I would attain an eighth-level Essence Soul after my spiritual transformation. Meng Chuan sighed in amazement.
He had pondered over his paramount technique for many years. His body was still at the Chaos Hole realm (Supremacy). Who knew that his Essence Soul would reach the Tribulation realm first?
I’ll try out my moves. Meng Chuan pulled out the Tribulation treasure at his waist-Time Saber. After pulling it out, he casually threw it out and made it levitate in midair.
Meng Chuan had already infused the Power of Essence Soul into Time Saber as he controlled
With a thought
A saber beam traveled through the world like a swimming dragon. It sliced through the world, revealing the gray chains that were hidden beyond the world.
After reaching the Tribulation realm, one’s Power of Essence Soul will change qualitatively. I will now be able to utilize such weapons and treasures perfectly. Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
With a weak Essence Soul, one’s Power of Essence Soul was mainly used to cast Essence Soul mystic techniques.
After reaching the Essence Soul Tribulation realm, one’s Power of Essence Soul would change qualitatively. In fact, the Power of Essence Soul became even more suitable for utilizing Tribulation treasures than Tribulation realm demonic power or Tribulation Quintessential Essence. Controlling Tribulation treasures with the Power of Essence Soul was easier and one could unleash greater might.
This was decided by the cultivation system. After reaching the Physical Body Tribulation realm, one’s main goal was to cultivate their body! Every Physical Body Tribulation Eminence’s body was as powerful as a Dharma treasure.
Merely by opening their mouths, they could swallow celestial bodies. They could tear spacetime with a stretch of the hand. Sitting cross-legged and allowing enemies to attack them would be fine because their bodies would remain unharmed. This was something only Physical Body Tribulation Eminences could do. Their bodies were their strongest weapons, so close combat was what they were best at.
Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences were different. An Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence’s body was relatively weak, while their Essence Soul was especially powerful. They could create a world with just a mere thought! Each of an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence’s nine Essence Soul avatars could fight in different places. It was common for a single Essence Soul avatar to cross many river zones to hunt down enemies.
Essence Soul mystic techniques also became even more bizarre and ruthless! Controlling a Tribulation treasure with the Power of Essence Soul made it even easier to deal with enemies from afar.
World treasures were unique to Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences.
At the Physical Body Tribulation realm, one’s Essence Soul is hidden in the body. One’s body is like the world, perfectly protecting the Essence Soul. It’s very difficult to injure a Physical Body Tribulation Eminence’s Essence Soul. After Ancestral Master Archean Eon reached the Physical Body Seventh Tribulation realm, even an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence wouldn’t be able to break through the obstruction that’s Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s body with Essence Soul mystic techniques only.
Most Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences relied on Essence Soul Worlds, Tribulation treasures, and World treasures to deal with Physical Body Tribulation Eminences.
A Physical Tribulation Eminence could just charge forward brashly.
My Essence Soul World.
With a thought
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan stood in the square in front of Heaven and Earth Great Hall. He had Time Saber by his waist as a huge painting suddenly appeared behind him.
The painting was vast, spanning over 50 kilometers. In the vast painting, mountain ranges could be vaguely seen. There were also rivers flowing, and countless people living in it. As the painting was only about 50 kilometers long, the people in the painting were extremely tiny. So my Essence Soul World looks like a painting? Meng Chuan nodded slightly. This was the first time he was seeing his Essence Soul World.
If it’s not suppressed by worldly laws, my Essence Soul World can expand to 1.5 million kilometers. Meng Chuan carefully studied it.
His Essence Soul World was quite big. However, the size of an Essence Soul World didn’t have any correlation with its strength. Every Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence had their own unique Essence Soul World because each person’s mental state differed. Although some had very small Essence Soul Worldssome Essence Soul Worlds were only 100 feet wide—they could condense them into beads and smash their enemies with them. These small Essence Soul Worlds had equally terrifying strength. Some Essence Soul Worlds might be tens of millions of kilometers wide, but they might have very low strength. On the first day of painting, my Essence Soul reached the eighth level. My Essence Soul has been transforming constantly during the five months of painting. It feels like it has improved greatly. My Essence Soul World shouldn’t be weak, guessed Meng Chuan.
After reaching the Tribulation realm, it was very difficult to determine one’s exact strength. One had to use many methods as reference. Of course, one could determine their exact strength after passing multiple Heavenly Tribulations. However, for someone like Meng Chuan—who had yet to transcend a Heavenly Tribulation-he needed to determine his strength by using many different methods.
Whoosh.
With a thought, the Essence Soul world around him instantly disappeared.
At that moment, black fog surged out from Heaven and Earth Great Hall and condensed into Guardians.
The three Guardians bowed and said, “Greetings, Eminence Eastcalm.”
“Guardians, there’s no need to stand on ceremony,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“There’s finally another Tribulation Eminence in Archean Eon Realm,” said the black-robed, long-browed Guardian excitedly. “We only had Tribulation Eminences rising during Archean Eon Sect’s era. After that era, no Tribulation Eminences were born in the world.”
“It’s a blessing for Archean Eon Realm to have a Tribulation Eminence rising.” Another Guardian looked at Meng Chuan and said immediately, “Eminence Eastcalm, after becoming a Tribulation Eminence, you can obtain more treasures left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon-much more than before.”
Meng Chuan smiled.
Yes. Previously, he wasn’t even an Imperial Lord. Now that he had reached the Tribulation realm, he could naturally obtain many more things from Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasure trove.
“There are many treasures that ordinary Supremacies and Imperial Lords are not qualified to take. Eminence Eastcalm, you can now choose from them.” The Guardians were very enthusiastic. How long had they been protecting Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures? Due to the rules set by Ancestral Master Archean Eon, the weaker human juniors naturally couldn’t take very much. This was because Supremacies couldn’t utilize much of these powerful treasures’ might.
These treasures would instead bring them disaster in the outer realm. Another Tribulation Eminence had now finally appeared in Archean Eon Realm.
“There’s no rush. I’ll investigate the treasure vault later,” said Meng Chuan. “I still need some time to cultivate.”
The three Guardians exchanged looks and bowed respectfully before retreating. Meng Chuan continued to stand in front of Heaven and Earth Great Hall, deep in thought.
Saber of Nirvana. The soul of this saber move is Nirvana.
But I have a new move now. The soul of this new saber move is life. Meng Chuan grabbed Time Saber—which hung from his waist-and slashed out. He didn’t use the Power of Essence Soul, nor did he use much strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 541 - Imperial Lord Paramount Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 541 Imperial Lord Paramount Technique
The world changed as he slashed out.
The entire world seemed to come to a standstill. Even the floating clouds were completely still. This feeling? The corners of Meng Chuan’s mouth curled into a smile. The saber in his hand seemed to cleave at a small yellow flower in the southernmost part of the grotto-heaven casually. He carried a jade stone from the western mountain range, picked up a black fish in the north, and cut a purple fruit in the east.
The world returned to normal.
Meng Chuan’s saber was already sheathed. The yellow flower, pebble-like jade, lively black fish, and purple fruit were in front of Meng Chuan.
Paramount speed. Time and speed are under my control. My saber art has completely condensed into a line, exclaimed Meng Chuan inwardly. This is the paramount technique I’ve been pursuing. I’ve finally created the Imperial Lord-level paramount technique, Infinite Saber.
Meng Chuan smiled.
In the past, he had only created a Supremacy-level paramount technique. Only now did he create one at the Imperial Lord level.
This strike can accelerate the time flow by thirty-fold. This is mainly because my Essence Soul is currently at the eighth level. It’s even harder to change the time flow of the area I’m in. Meng Chuan understood this. The difficulties of changing a Supremacy-level lifeform’s time flow and a Tribulation Eminence lifeform’s time flow were two separate matters. If Meng Chuan relied only on his Grotto-Heaven realm Infinite Saber, he would only be able to accelerate the time flow around his body by three-fold. However, with his Imperial Lord-level paramount technique, he could accelerate the time flow around him by thirty-fold. It was clear that his Supremacy-level paramount technique had very limited effects on Tribulation Eminences.
Furthermore, the saber move’s pure speed is several times faster than before. Meng Chuan sighed in amazement. The speed of a Supremacy-level paramount technique was already fast enough. Now his Imperial Lord-level paramount technique was several times faster than its original speed; it was also much stronger.
His Infinite Saber had gone straight to the Third Tribulation realm from the near-perfected Imperial Lord realm. Of course, Meng Chuan’s Saber of Nirvana had reached the Heaven Earth realm’s middle stage, and it was already comparable to a Fourth Tribulation Eminence’s technique realm. All in all, his technique realm was comparable to that of a Fourth Tribulation Eminence. However, his Saber of Nirvana couldn’t be used as his cultivation foundation.
His Infinite Saber could be used as the foundation of his body cultivation and Essence Soul cultivation. Once my Infinite Saber reaches the Heaven Earth realm’s early stage, everything will be smooth. I can cultivate all the way to the perfected Heaven Earth realm. Meng Chuan was filled with joy. I, Meng Chuan, have actually created an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique. An Imperial Lord-level paramount technique creator was extremely rare. They were in no way rarer than Seventh Tribulation Eminences. In the past few centuries of cultivation, even I doubted whether I was capable of creating an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique. Meng Chuan sighed.
He knew very well. Previously, he had failed time and time again. Even Saber of Nirvana—which he created—was of the wrong path. However, because he had failed repeatedly, he had accumulated more and more experience. Only after painting ‘Backbone’ did he create the Imperial Lord-level Infinite Saber.
In fact, just the fact that he could create Saber of Nirvana meant that he had plenty of insight. After creating Saber of Nirvana, he was just one step away from success. This step was also the hardest one. In the River of Spacetime, many peerless cultivators met. Meng Chuan had been trapped in the Chaos Hole for more than 300 years. After winning the war, his mind had transformed, which finally allowed him to take that final step.
Huh? Meng Chuan examined his Essence Soul.
After creating the Imperial Lord-level Infinite Saber, his Essence Soul transformed and improved significantly. However, compared to the improvement in the five months he had spent painting, the improvement this time was only about 10%.
It’s no wonder the Essence Soul Tribulation realm values spiritual cultivation. Cultivation in the Essence Soul Tribulation realm mainly involved two aspects. One was spiritual cultivation, and the other was to gain insights into the laws. Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences had a common saying—the size of the world is determined by how big one’s heart is. Only when one’s mind and spirit have been cultivated to a sufficiently profound level could their Essence Soul World bear the burden of many laws and mysteries, allowing the Essence Soul World to grow. If one’s spiritual cultivation didn’t work, no matter how profound the comprehended laws were, they wouldn’t be able to improve. They wouldn’t even be able to trigger an Essence Soul Tribulation.
The Physical Body Tribulation realm was similar. Cultivation also involved two aspects. One was to study the laws, and the other was to cultivate the body. One had to comprehend a sufficiently profound law first before using the comprehended laws to improve the body! No matter how high one’s technique realm was, one couldn’t reach a higher level if their body wasn’t improved. Improving one’s body was 1,000 times more complicated than using a weapon to deliver certain moves. For example, due to Ancestral Master Archean Eon cultivating Samsara Divine Body himself, he had paved a path to the Tribulation realm. Samsara Divine Body cultivators had a clear path to the Tribulation realm because of this. As for the other Godfiend bodies, Ancestral Master Archean Eon was unable to perfect them because he didn’t cultivate them personally. Up until now, Ancestral Master Archean Eon was Archean Eon Realm’s only Physical Body Tribulation Eminence.
From this, one could see just how difficult it was to improve one’s body to perfection. However, the difference between the two systems was very obvious. The Essence Soul Tribulation realm gave priority to one’s mind; one had to cultivate their mind to a high level before their Essence Soul World would have a strong foundation. The Physical Body Tribulation realm prioritized the cultivation of laws. One had to comprehend the laws before they could improve their body.
Luo Tang Pass.
Inside the array formation, Meng Chuan’s three Essence Soul avatars guarded the demon sage passageway. Before the demon sage passageway completely collapsed, Meng Chuan had to guard it constantly.
After attaining an eighth-level Essence Soul, every single of my Essence Souls avatar can travel very far away from the main body. Meng Chuan understood this point. It’s very easy to control them, even if they are separated by inhabited worlds and several river zones.
With a seventh-level Essence Soul, one’s Essence Soul avatars couldn’t be too far away from their true body. In the outer realm, one’s Essence Soul avatars and true body had to be in the same river zone.
In a world that supported life, one’s Essence Soul avatars and true body had to be in the same world. With an eighth-level Essence Soul, one’s Essence Soul avatars could roam freely. Furthermore, their Essence Soul avatars would also have an Essence Soul World.
An Essence Soul World can already affect the real world. It can absorb the outer realm essence energy and transform it into its own strength. His Essence Soul avatars could roam the outer realm freely and absorb energy whenever it needed to.
Therefore, Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences would typically have several Essence Soul avatars carrying out missions. When each Essence Soul avatar was equipped with a Tribulation treasure, their combat strength was on par with their true bodies. This was because most of an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence’s strength came from their Essence Soul.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar arrived in front of the demon sage passageway and tried to take a step forward, but was unable to enter.
I really can’t enter. Meng Chuan felt resistance. Although I haven’t experienced the first Essence Soul Tribulation, my life order has upgraded to a different level.
Forget it. Since I’ve created the Imperial Lord-level Infinite Saber, I won’t be far from becoming a Fifth Tribulation Eminence. I’m even confident about becoming a Sixth Tribulation Eminence in the future. I’ll deal with the demons slowly. Although he wanted to make the demons pay the price, with so many demons coming to Archean Eon Realm to slaughter them, the ones he wanted to deal with the most were the three leaders.
Emperor Roc, Imperial Lord Starquix, and Lady Blackmoon orchestrated the entire war.
Dealing with Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon was very simple. As long as he became a Fifth Tribulation Eminence, he could kill them through karma, even if they were in different worlds. As for Emperor Roc, it will take some time. I’ll take it slow. Meng Chuan was patient. According to Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s records, the creator of an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique was extremely rare in the River of Spacetime. Creators of Imperial Lord-level paramount techniques had terrifyingly-high talent. Once their Imperial Lord-level paramount technique reached perfection, they would be a Fifth Tribulation Eminence! They could then combine the profundities of other laws with it, allowing them to reach the Sixth Tribulation realm.
With these creators’ talent... it wouldn’t be difficult for them to combine other laws’ profundities with their paramount technique’s foundation.
Meng Chuan believed that his Infinite Saber was purely a time lineage technique. Once it reached perfection, he could combine it with his accumulated insights into the void lineage. With time and space combined, it would be quite easy for him to reach the Sixth Tribulation realm.
But it will be difficult to reach the Seventh Tribulation realm. Meng Chuan understood this point.
Even an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique’s creator would find it extremely difficult to reach the Seventh Tribulation realm. The Eighth Tribulation realm was an even more distant goal.
Ancient Magus River Zone, Heaven Peak River System.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar sat cross-legged in the void beside the Chaos Hole. In his arms was Fiend Prison.
Inside the prison.
Meng Chuan’s true body was here.
I’m the first to reach the Chaos Hole realm. I wish to reach the Imperial Lord realm with this foundation. However, I might fail. Meng Chuan knew this very well. Once I fail, my body might even be destroyed. My homeworld is more important, so I’ll try to break through in the outer realm first.
Although this true body would be destroyed if he failed, his Essence Soul avatar would remain intact.
With an eighth-level Essence Soul... no matter how far away he was from his true body in his homeworld, he still had something to rely on. His Essence Soul avatars wouldn’t collapse. Fiend Prison and the many Tribulation treasures he had on him would still be his; they wouldn’t be lost if his true body in the outer realm died.
Meng Chuan still placed great importance on these treasures. Although he could obtain treasures from Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s vault after reaching the Tribulation realm, he knew that Ancestral Master Archean Eon had made long-term considerations. Thinking about how Archean Eon Realm would produce Tribulation Eminences over the years, Meng Chuan still had limits to what he could obtain from the vault.
Time to begin. Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in the Fiend Prison as he focused on sensing the Chaos Hole in his body. He began his breakthrough.

chapters.title: Chapter 542 - Imperial Lord (Final Chapter of Volume)
chapters.content:
Chapter 542 Imperial Lord (Final Chapter of Volume)
Nineteen days later.
Meng Chuan was still cultivating at Fiend Prison’s bottommost layer. The Outer Realm Essence Crystals in front of him were slowly shrinking as the surging outer realm essence energy constantly flooded Meng Chuan’s body. His absorption speed was extremely fast.
Finally, Meng Chuan stopped cultivating. The incomplete Outer Realm Essence Crystals also stopped shrinking. I succeeded. Meng Chuan was in a very good mood.
Meng Chuan sighed in amazement as he sensed the immense and unimaginable power in his body. A pure-blooded dragon has such a shocking body after reaching the adult stage? With a single fist clench
Boom!
The void in Meng Chuan’s palm dissipated as the fluctuations spread in all directions.
Break! Meng Chuan extended his arm, and it expanded by more than five kilometers. His fist—which was now several kilometers wide
-suddenly smashed into the prison’s outermost wall, causing it to tremble.
As long as Meng Chuan was willing, his entire body could grow to 500 kilometers tall or shrink to the size of an ant.
I heard that Physical Body Tribulation Eminences have bodies comparable to Tribulation treasures. They are extremely strong in close combat. Even Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences aren’t willing to let Physical Body Tribulation Eminences come close to them. Now that I’ve broken through to the Imperial Lord realm with an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique, my body is probably comparable to a Fourth Tribulation Eminence.
The improvement in one’s body was the most exaggerated when one’s order in life was elevated.
A pure-blooded dragon’s body would mature from the early-stage Imperial Lord realm to the perfected Imperial Lord realm. Their bodies were several times stronger than the average cultivator’s. At the peak, they would be Fifth Tribulation Eminences.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
Boom!
Bloodblades scattered everywhere in Fiend Prison’s lowest level as they attacked Meng Chuan crazily. At the same time, the meteor-like Lightning Dwarf Star smashed towards Meng Chuan.
The prison’s bottommost layer constantly rumbled. Meng Chuan used his Power of Essence Soul to control the Tribulation treasures to attack him at full force. He had put away all his protective treasures and took the brunt of the attacks with just his body.
My Power of Essence Soul is better at controlling Tribulation treasures than Quintessential Essence. When I execute Saber of Nirvana and Infinite Saber, I estimate myself to be at the Fourth Tribulation realm. Meng Chuan lowered his head and looked at his skin. His skin had easily withstood all the different attacks. Even if the attacks’ terrifying impact was weakened by his skin. After that, the remaining force would spread to his entire body; his powerful body could easily withstand the remaining force.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged and didn’t move.
I feel like I’m an adult Baxia clan memberwhich is one of the pure-blooded dragon branch families, thought Meng Chuan to himself. The Bloodblades sliced through Meng Chuan’s hair, but not a single strand of hair could be cut off. His hair was tough and remained undamaged.
Meng Chuan inspected his body inwardly, staring at his dantian.
There was a tiny gray star in his dantian.
Gray gases flowed on the gray star’s surface. This gray star was 80-90% similar to a Primordial Stone.
If one were to observe the gray star through the airflow carefully, they would discover the gray star’s composition was 99% similar to a Primordial Stone. Therefore, Meng Chuan named this realm the Primordial realm.
So far, the Godfiend cultivation system had seven known realms. In ascending order: Core Cloud realm, Indestructible realm, Great Solar realm, Darkstar realm, Seamless realm, Chaos Hole realm (Supremacy realm), and Primordial realm (Imperial Lord realm).
I wonder which cultivation direction I can go far with for both the Physical Body Tribulation realm and the Essence Soul Tribulation realm. Meng Chuan was rather expectant.
Archean Eon Realm, in the square in front of Heaven and Earth Great Hall.
In his homeworld, Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in confusion.
My outer realm body has reached the Primordial realm, but the true body in my homeworld hasn’t broken through? Meng Chuan was somewhat puzzled. He had attempted to have his dantian break through with Infinite Saber—which was the Heaven Earth realm’s early stage-as the core.
He had only allowed his Chaos Hole to absorb more Outer Realm Essence Crystals when he realized that the miniature Chaos Hole in this true body had only become stronger. His overall strength had increased. However, this true body was still stuck in the Chaos Hole realm.
The only difference between my true body in the outer realm and the one in my homeworld is the fact that one has devoured a Primordial Stone. Could it be that I require a Primordial Stone to reach the Primordial realm? Is it similar to the Cosmos Body cultivation system’s Sage Becoming realm and Mythical realm, where one requires Cosmos Crystals?
I don’t require Primordial Stones to reach the Chaos Hole realm, but my true bodies need to devour a Primordial Stone each to reach the Primordial realm? Meng Chuan was somewhat puzzled about the cultivation realms he had independently created for the Godfiend cultivation system.
He needed to figure out many things. Furthermore, the Chaos Hole realm and the Primordial realm’s requirements were too high. One had to use a paramount technique as their foundation.
Firstly, Meng Chuan had to figure out the cultivation system himself. Secondly, he might need to simplify the Chaos Hole Divine Body in the future. If the threshold was lower, more Godfiends could cultivate it. Otherwise, the requirement of creating one’s own paramount technique was ridiculously high. Of course, once he simplified it, its strength would definitely decrease greatly. However, even if its strength decreased greatly, it would still be powerful enough for a Supremacy or an Imperial Lord.
I still have too many questions regarding my Godfiend body. I’ll slowly study it in the future. As for my true body in my homeworld, it won’t be too late for it to reach the Primordial realm after I obtain another Primordial Stone. I wonder if Ancestral Master Archean Eon has a Primordial Stone among his treasures.
He hadn’t seen the treasure vault himself. In fact, due to his lacking strength, he didn’t have the right to see many of Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures. Even now, he could only come into contact with a small portion of the treasures.
Archean Mountain, Grotto-Heaven Pavilion.
After disappearing for nearly half a year, Meng Chuan returned to Grotto-Heaven Pavilion.
“Meng Chuan, you’re finally back. I thought I’d have to pull you out forcefully in a few months,” said Qin Wu with a smile.
Luo Tang also said, “Senior Brother Li Guan has returned to his family clan. I’m afraid his time will be up in two to three months.”
“Senior Brother Li Guan?” Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
Senior Brother Li Guan had sacrificed too much for the war. He naturally had to send him off on the day of his death.
“Dad.” Meng An rushed over.
“An’er.” Meng Chuan couldn’t help but smile when he saw his son.
“Everyone’s here,” said Qin Wu. “Let’s get down to business first. Meng Chuan, you’ve been in seclusion for half a year. During this time, two major matters have come up.”
Meng Chuan looked at him.
“One is related to the demons, and the other is related to the Skydemon Sect,” said Qin Wu. “Since we have completely won the war, the powerful demon monarchs in the human world... don’t see any hope of returning to the Demon Realm, so they are negotiating with us. Likewise for the Skydemon Sect. They have also come to negotiate with us.”
“What are the conditions?” asked Meng Chuan with a smile.
He understood the demons and Skydemon Sect’s predicament in Archean Eon Realm.
Since they couldn’t see any hope, they naturally had to struggle for a way of survival.
“Those fourth and fifth Firmament demon monarchs aren’t willing to be controlled and become servants. They hope that we humans will let them leave the human world and return to the Demon Realm,” said Qin Wu.
Luo Tang added, “The demons also said that they were just carrying out orders. All the plans were decided by the demons’ Imperial Lords. If we humans trap them in the human world forcefully, preventing them from seeing hope, they don’t mind having an internecine outcome.”
Qin Wu nodded and said, “It’s the same for the Skydemon Sect. The Skydemon Sect has infiltrated humanity even deeper. Ignoring the 1,000-plus Skydemons, there are also a large number of Skydemon Sect mortal disciples hiding in the cities. It’s very difficult to discover them. Once they cause destruction, we will suffer great losses.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. “The Skydemon Sect is more troublesome than those demons. What are the Skydemon Sect’s conditions?”
“They are to be pardoned for all past transgressions. We shall let bygones be bygones. In the future, we will treat them the same as we treat Godfiends,” said Qin Wu.
Meng Chuan said coldly, “All these years, how many Godfiends have died at the hands of the Skydemon Sect? How many cities were slaughtered, and how many city passes were breached? How can we let bygones be bygones? They sure have beautiful dreams.” “They have infiltrated too deep,” said Qin Wu worriedly.
“Wait a moment. I’ll capture them now,” said Meng Chuan.
“What?” Qin Wu, Luo Tang, and Meng An were stunned when they heard that.
Meng Chuan stood there, and a faint painting world appeared around him. The massive painting world expanded and fused with the void instantly, enveloping the entire human world.
At that moment, the entire human world was enveloped by Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World.
Every spot is blanketed by my Essence Soul World. Meng Chuan was infatuated with this feeling. This was the first time he saw Archean Eon Realm from this angle. Be it the Four Seas’ ends, the highest altitude in the sky, or the underground depths, no matter where or what it was, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World enveloped them as long as they were in Archean Eon Realm.
At this moment, Meng Chuan observed everything in Archean Eon Realm!
Only a few spots on Archean Mountain blocked Meng Chuan’s prying eyes! Meng Chuan even felt fear. He knew that they were array formations set up by Ancestral Master Archean Eon. However, Meng Chuan could sense other places—be it Two World Island, Black Sand Grotto-Heaven, or the long-disappeared Godfiend sects’ ruins.
He could also sense the items left behind by ancient Godfiends in the seas, the desert, deep underground, and the mountains. Some had been left behind when they died, while other treasures had been hidden by Godfiend sects.
Everything was within Meng Chuan’s observation range.
Every Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence could thoroughly scan through their homeworld. However, after Archean Eon Sect fractured, no Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence rose amongst the humans.
Meng Chuan found many of the missing treasures and stashes that had vanished in the past million years.
And them. Besides finding the numerous treasures in the world, he also found two small, hidden grotto-heavens.
One was deep in the North Sea.
“We can only hide in a small grotto-heaven. When will such days end?”
“At least I’m free in this Grotto-Heaven. If I submit to Archean Mountain, I’ll be enslaved.” Several fourth Firmament demon monarchs drank and chatted. Almost all the powerful demon monarchs that lurked in the human world hid here.
Another small grotto-heaven was deep in the Great Yue Dynasty’s mountain forest. Two entrances led to the small grotto-heaven.
“The demons lost just like that. We are now in trouble.”
“Don’t worry. The three Godfiend sects will compromise.” Two Skydemons walked side by side in the palace complex. They were relatively relaxed. They were used to wreaking havoc while hiding in the darkness. If they continued fighting the three sects, they could be equally patient. They believed that the three sects would not be able to withstand the attacks eventually.
Swoosh! Swoosh!
With a thought, a water-blue bead and a fist-sized boulder were teleported to Archean Mountain Grotto-Heaven Pavilion’s backyard.
“This is?” Qin Wu, Luo Tang, and Meng An were taken aback when they saw the two items appear.
“One is a grotto-heaven where powerful demons hide, while the other is the Skydemon Sect’s garrison grotto-heaven.” Meng Chuan pointed at the two small grotto-heavens. “They are all here.”
Final Chapter of Volume-Demon Sage Passageway

chapters.title: Chapter 543 - Teleport
chapters.content:
Chapter 543 Teleport
“You’re saying that one of them is the demons’ grotto-heaven, and the other is the Skydemon Sect’s grotto-heaven?” Qin Wu found it unbelievable. The Skydemon Sect had wreaked havoc on humanity for so many years, but Archean Mountain couldn’t find its headquarters no matter how hard they tried. Archean Mountain even sent Godfiends to infiltrate the demons’ grotto-heaven, but they still couldn’t find its location.
Now, Meng Chuan had brought back both of the grotto-heavens?
Luo Tang and Meng An stared at the water-blue bead and the fist-sized rock.
“I couldn’t find them previously,” explained Meng Chuan. “Recently, after winning the war, my Essence Soul broke through and became an eighth-level Essence Soul.”
“Eighth-level Essence Soul?”
“Tribulation realm?”
Qin Wu, Luo Tang, and Meng An were stunned before they stared at Meng Chuan with burning eyes.
Meng An was somewhat shocked. “Father, you have become a Tribulation Eminence?”
Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s training was set in a way to ensure that his personal disciple would have a strong foundation. In the future, they could become a Tribulation Eminence with a perfected body.
Now, his father-Meng Chuan—was already at the Tribulation realm?
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded when he saw the three heated gazes. “A Tribulation Eminence has finally appeared in our human world.” Qin Wu was extremely excited. “After such a long time, we have finally welcomed a prosperous era.”
A powerful cultivator would elevate the entire world to greater heights.
Of course, if it was just a weaker Tribulation Eminence, they would have a weaker impact on the world. Third Tribulation Eminences were considered common in the outer realm. Only Fourth Tribulation Eminences had no fear in a river system. Fifth Tribulation Eminences were considered true overlords in the outer realm. Fifth Tribulation Eminences would be of great help to their homeworlds.
If one was a Sixth Tribulation Eminence, they could upgrade their homeworld from a low-level world to a middle-level world. If their homeworld was a middle-level world, they could expand their homeworld once again.
For example, although the demon world was a middle-level world like Archean Eon Realm, it was much larger.
“A Tribulation Eminence.” Luo Tang’s eyes lit up as well. “Was the illusory painting that instantly fused into the void your Essence Soul World?”
“That’s right.” Meng Chuan nodded. “With a thought, a world will descend. My Essence Soul World has enveloped the entire Archean Eon Realm, so I can naturally scan it clearly.”
He was the lord of the Essence Soul World.
For example, void domain techniques could only sense the void. If the other party had special methods, they could avoid detection. However, his Essence Soul World... made it impossible for the enemy to hide from him. They would definitely be exposed.
“Then, can you track down the Skydemon Sect’s subordinates, which are all over the world?” asked Qin Wu.
“Don’t worry.” Meng Chuan nodded. “Apart from the Skydemon Sect’s grotto-heaven headquarters, there are 35 branches scattered across the world. Skydemons are also guarding them. I will wipe out all 35 branches. However, I’ve already obtained intelligence about the Skydemon Sect’s information network that has infiltrated various regions. This requires the local Earth Net forces to capture them.” “That’s great.”
“We can finally resolve the Skydemon Sect threat.” Qin Wu and Luo Tang were excited.
The Skydemon Sect factions that infiltrated the various regions were all mortal members. Most of them had yet to cultivate the Skydemon formulations. It was impossible to distinguish them on the surface. This was the greatest headache for human Godfiends.
Now, with the help of his Essence Soul world, Meng Chuan could envelop the world with a single thought. He could easily read every piece of intelligence.
Meng Chuan could easily investigate every city’s member list.
As Meng Chuan and company chatted...
Swoosh.
A figure appeared beside them. It was a middle-aged man with white hair. When the middle-aged man appeared, he saw Meng Chuan and company. His expression changed slightly. He sighed and said, “I never expected to be captured in the blink of an eye.”
Meng Chuan and company looked at the Skydemon Sect Master.
“Greetings, Imperial Lord Eastcalm. Greetings, Supremacies.” Skydemon Sect Master bowed first before saying, “I want to know how you found our Skydemon Sect’s grotto-heaven?”
Swoosh.
A stocky bear demon monarch appeared beside him. When the bear demon monarch saw Meng Chuan and company, his expression changed drastically. He also saw Skydemon Sect Master. All he could do was bow. “Greetings, human Godfiends.”
“Where’s Demon Sage Thousand Cricket? Where’s Demon Sage North Sense?” asked Qin
Wu.
“The two of them have long vanished,” said the bear demon monarch. “After Imperial Lord Eastcalm captured a large group of fifth Firmament demon monarchs, the two demon sages disappeared.”
“They are no longer in Archean Eon Realm,” said Meng Chuan.
“It looks like they fled decades ago. They fled really quickly,” said Luo Tang.
In Archean Eon Realm, the demons and Skydemon Sect faced a true apocalypse.
The demons were the easiest to discover. Under the Essence Soul World’s envelopment, none could escape. Meng Chuan even captured the ordinary demons hiding in the deep mountains and forests.
After the Skydemon Sect’s grotto-heaven and 35 branches were wiped out in one fell swoop, Earth Net’s forces—which were all over the world-began to capture the Skydemon Sect’s low-level members. This caused a commotion and a small number of casualties. However, Earth Net was led by Godfiends. The Skydemon Sect members they dealt with were all mortals, so the losses were minimal.
Meng Chuan had no choice. Although he could gather a name list, it was very difficult for him to find everyone on it.
Furthermore, the Skydemon Sect simply had too many mortal members—ten million of them. After all, they were a faction that had been led by over 1,000 Skydemons for centuries. They were unscrupulous and used all sorts of temptations to recruit members. Many mortal members didn’t cultivate the Skydemon system. They only coveted the benefits the Skydemon Sect gave them.
Archean Mountain, Grotto-Heaven Pavilion. Meng Chuan sat in the pavilion and looked at the black-and-white bracelet in his hand.
“Bright Light Sect.” Meng Chuan looked at the black-and-white bracelet and whispered, “There hasn’t been a single Imperial Lord in the Bright Light Sect’s history. However, three Heaven Earth realm Supremacies were born. Among the sect treasures left behind by Bright Light Sect, there’s actually a Sixth Tribulation treasure.”
Meng Chuan was very surprised.
In terms of historical heritage, Bright Light Sect was only inferior to Black White Grotto-Heaven and Myriad Sword Sect. However, they had once thrived for 300,000 years.
It had a history longer than Two World Island!
There were three Tribulation treasures.
Ever since he attained an eighth-level Essence Soul, Meng Chuan had gained an Essence Soul World, which could envelop the entire Archean Eon Realm. He had taken away all the treasures scattered across Archean Eon Realm. Even if he hadn’t obtained Eon Sea Sect’s treasures, he could still take them back now that he had an eighth-level Essence Soul.
Back then, Archean Eon Sect had completely unified the human race and was the only Godfiend sect. They didn’t have any external enemies.
Without external enemies, it was naturally easy for internal strife and corruption to occur. Meng Chuan agreed with Ancestral Master Archean’s decision.
The Archean Eon Sect of the past was already rotten.
Meng Chuan now had the strength to unify the world, but he didn’t think it was necessary.
Archean Mountain had plenty of cornerstone treasures that Ancestral Master Archean Eon had left behind. They had the deepest and most unshakeable foundation. It was good for an unshakeable sect to have some external threats.
“Dad.” Meng An walked over from afar.
“An’er.” Meng Chuan casually wore the black-and-white bracelet on his wrist and smiled at his son.
Meng An’s expression was solemn as he walked to Meng Chuan and sat down.
“If there’s anything, just say it. Don’t hesitate,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“Actually, I’ve become Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s personal disciple,” said Meng An. “All the so-called disciples who obtained Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s legacy are just in-name disciples. Without heaven-defying talent, they won’t be able to become personal disciples. An exception was made for me before I became Ancestral Master’s personal disciple because of the war.”
“Oh?” Meng Chuan looked at his son.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon had broad horizons. He definitely had ridiculously high requirements for him to accept a personal disciple.
“Actually, I should have left Archean Eon Realm long ago,” said Meng An. “It’s only because of the war that I can stay here. Now that we have won the war... According to the Ancestral Master’s rules, I have to leave Archean Eon Realm within three years. I can’t afford to waste too much time when it comes to cultivation.”
“An’er, are you leaving Archean Eon Realm?”. Meng Chuan was somewhat worried. He knew how dangerous the outer realm was. An’er was only at the Supremacy realm. “Where are you going in the outer realm?”.
Meng An said, “I will be directly teleported to a distant river zone-inside a mystic realm.”
“A distant river zone? Teleport?” Meng Chuan immediately felt powerless.
He knew that the outer realm had teleportation techniques.
For example, if he paid a huge price when buying treasures at Eternal Tower, he could have his purchased treasures quickly delivered across many river zones. It was done through a teleportation spell.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s legacy clearly had a teleportation treasure. However, Meng Chuan and Qin Wu couldn’t come into contact with it previously. “A mystic realm in a distant river zone?” asked Meng Chuan. “Which river zone?”
“I don’t know.” Meng An shook his head. “I only know that it’s very far.” Meng Chuan looked at his son.
His son, Meng An, was only at the Supremacy realm. He only had one true body. It was too dangerous for him to venture outside.
“Must you go? Is there no other way?” asked Meng Chuan. “I’ve withstood all the hardships during my grooming as a personal disciple,” said Meng An. “If I fail, I will be sent back. If I succeed... I don’t know when I will return.”
Meng Chuan also understood this.
From a cultivation standpoint, Ancestral Master Archean Eon was a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. He stood at the vast River of Spacetime’s top. He had come into contact with many secrets and obtained many opportunities. The Essence Soul Star legacy he had casually placed in Heart Sea Palace was an Eight Tribulation Eminence’s legacy. Furthermore, it was clearly not Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s most important legacy.
“Go if you want to.” Meng Chuan nodded. “However, wait a few days for me.”
Meng An looked at his father. “How many days?” “Come find me in three days.” Meng Chuan stood up and left. It’s time to see what’s available amongst Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures.
He hoped that he could help An’er with his status.

chapters.title: Chapter 544 - Meng Chuan’s Strength
chapters.content:
Chapter 544 Meng Chuan’s Strength
Archean Mountain, Heaven and Earth Great Hall.
Meng Chuan stood in the ancient hall. This Heaven and Earth Great Hall was ranked second among the 12 cornerstone treasures.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon has indeed put in a lot of effort for the entire human race.
As Archean Mountain’s strongest expert and the leader of Heaven and Earth Great Hall, Meng Chuan could sense more secrets from Heaven and Earth Great Hall after attaining an eighth-level Essence Soul.
Back then, Ancestral Master Archean Eon was close to the end of his life. He had spent a lot of effort into building the Heaven and Earth Great Hall for his homeworld.
This Heaven and Earth Great Hall contains this inhabited world’s Origins. This is also a form of protection. It makes it extremely difficult for one to harm this inhabited world’s Origins from the outside. Meng Chuan understood this point. Just by looking at the arrangements he set up in Heaven and Earth Great Hall, I can tell that Ancestral Master Archean Eon has done too much for humanity to thrive.
An inhabited world wasn’t an eternal existence. It would also die. Natural death, death caused by external forces... However, with the Heaven and Earth Great Hall’s protection, Archean Eon Realm was extremely unlikely to die.
Whoosh.
At the end of the hall, a passageway suddenly opened up.
Meng Chuan walked straight in.
After a few turns, he arrived at a hall.
Inside the hall laid a cyan arm that was about 190 feet long and 50 feet thick. The severed arm was still stained with drops of purple blood at the stump. The arm didn’t have a palm, but a sharp claw. The curved claws were thin and sharp.
The moment Meng Chuan stepped into the hall, he felt pressure on him. The temperature in the hall was extremely low, and frost condensed on the surrounding walls. Arm. Meng Chuan looked at the arm.
This hall was one of Archean Mountain’s important areas. Only those who had reached the Imperial Lord realm could enter! Meng Chuan was currently in the Tribulation realm, so he naturally could enter.
Fourth of the 12 cornerstone treasures. Meng Chuan looked at the huge arm. He could see the patterns on the cyan arm changing as he looked at it, causing spacetime to change. Illusory microcosms appeared on the arm’s surface, constantly producing life and death. Every time they were born, these countless microcosms showed various scenes. Following that, they would die. Meng Chuan couldn’t help but hold his breath when he saw this.
This is an Eight Tribulation Eminence’s arm. Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s array formation is suppressing it. Otherwise, even ordinary Tribulation Eminences would be affected by it. They might even be controlled by it.
The Eighth Tribulation realm was a legend.
Many Seventh Tribulation Eminences might not even see a single Eighth Tribulation Eminence their entire lives.
For circumstances like dying when transcending a tribulation or from age, Eighth Tribulation Eminences would make plans for their corpses. They wouldn’t allow their corpses to be incomplete and scattered. Therefore, the fact that Ancestral Master Archean Eon an Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s arm meant that the Eminence had not died a natural death.
Even a piece of flesh of a Physical Body Eighth Tribulation Eminence was a priceless treasure, much less a relatively intact arm. Thus, it was ranked among the top of Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s 12 cornerstone treasures.
The flesh of an Eighth Tribulation Eminence exerts very strong pressure on people, burdening them greatly. Ordinary inhabited worlds wouldn’t be able to withstand it. They might even be sent out of the world. Meng Chuan understood this point. Ancestral Master Archean Eon should have brought it back with a special treasure.
Ignoring an Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s flesh and blood, even storing a Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s flesh and blood was a huge problem.
It was even more difficult to take them back into an inhabited world. This was also one of the reasons why Senior Pang Ming had kept the Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s piece of flesh beside his body in the outer realm.
Meng Chuan continued advancing. He walked through Heaven and Earth Great Hall’s hidden halls. Only Tribulation Eminences could enter these areas. This is it. Meng Chuan arrived at an ancient hall.
White fog emerged from the hall’s walls. The white fog condensed into a white-robed elder, who nodded slightly at Meng Chuan. “Master’s homeworld has finally produced another Tribulation Eminence after all these years. Are you here to retrieve the treasures?”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Yes.”
“Let’s determine your strength first.” The white-robed elder pointed at a cyan pillar. “In three seconds, attack this pillar with all your might. I’ll determine your strength based on the force exerted. The greater your strength is, the more treasures you can obtain. Even the most important treasures left behind by the old master can be given to you.”
The most important treasures that Ancestral Master Archean Eon had accumulated in his life were within his legacy. However, legacies didn’t necessarily have to be given to his disciples.
If an extremely powerful Tribulation Eminence appeared, Ancestral Master Archean Eon would be willing to give it to them as well.
“Alright.” Meng Chuan looked at the cyan pillar.
“You only have three seconds. It starts from the moment you gather strength,” said the white-robed elder. “Don’t gather your strength for too long.” Meng Chuan nodded. “Understood.” Whoosh. The painting world appeared behind Meng Chuan and descended into the hall.
The painting world was vast and majestic. The world was covered in fog as countless figures engaged in battle. There were also people drinking and chatting. Youths were practicing their swordplay together. Countless corpses could be seen on the battlefield... All sorts of scenes surfaced, causing the world to be extremely solemn and heavy. The Essence Soul World’s powers suppressed the cyan pillar, causing the runes on it to light up.
Meng Chuan stood in the middle of the world as he calmly looked at the pillar. “Oh?” The white-robed elder looked at Meng Chuan in surprise. “This Eastcalm junior actually has the strongest Essence Soul World in human history.”
Although Meng Chuan had just attained an eighth-level Essence Soul, his Essence Soul World was formed by the combination of his strong mental state and technique realm! His Essence Soul World was the strongest in human history! It far surpasses the other three Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences from Archean Eon Realm.
Crack!
Lightning flashed around Meng Chuan as time accelerated. “Attack!”
With a thought, Meng Chuan’s Power of Essence Soul fused with Time Saber—which was at his waist-as he unsheathed it! He executed Saber of Nirvana! Currently, Saber of Nirvana’s might was still greater than that of Infinite Saber—which remained at the Heaven Earth Realm’s early stage.
Under the influence of accelerated time, Saber of Nirvana’s might was even more terrifying.
Rip!
Dark saber beams landed on the cyan pillar. The runes on the cyan pillar cracked, but new runes soon formed.
He delivered nine consecutive strikes.
Following that, the saber beams and the Essence Soul World vanished. Everything returned to normal.
Time Saber remained in Meng Chuan’s sheath.
Meng Chuan looked at the white-robed elder.”How is it?”
The white-robed elder looked at Meng Chuan, nodded slightly, and smiled. “The strength of an Essence Soul Fourth Tribulation Eminence.”
Meng Chuan was secretly delighted when he heard that.
In regards to technique realm, Meng Chuan was indeed at the Fourth Tribulation realm. However, his Essence Soul ultimately hadn’t transcended a tribulation. Since he was determined to have the strength of an Essence Soul Fourth Tribulation Eminence, his strength would definitely increase by quite a bit once he transcended four Tribulations. Perhaps he would be as strong as a peak Fourth Tribulation Eminence? His strength might even be near the threshold of the Fifth Tribulation realm!
It is clear that my Essence Soul has improved greatly after painting ‘Backbone’ and creating an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique. My spiritual cultivation level is high enough.
The white-robed elder looked at Meng Chuan and smiled. “You have the strength of an Essence Soul Fourth Tribulation Eminence. You can choose any treasure in the old master’s treasure vault. You can choose treasures that are worth less than 50,000 cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals.” “Treasures worth 50,000 cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals?” Meng Chuan was pleasantly surprised.
Senior Pang Ming had many treasures. However, Senior Pang Ming had left most of his treasures in his homeworld. The treasures he had on him were the items he often used when roaming the outer realm. It was probably just a small portion of his total wealth. Even then, the treasures left behind by Senior Pang Ming to Meng Chuan had a total value of around 10,000 cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals. This was enough to make Fourth Tribulation Eminences go crazy with envy.
I can take out treasures worth five times more than Senior Pang Ming’s treasures. Meng Chuan sighed.
Before the war, humanity had already been at a disadvantage. It wasn’t that Ancestral Master Archean Eon wasn’t powerful. No, in the past one million years, humanity’s descendants were generally too weak. Thus, they could only obtain treasures that were suitable for the weak.
Humanity had yet to fully mature before they encountered a calamity-the demon invasion.
If humanity was forced into using World Annihilation, Archean Eon Realm’s prosperous days would probably be delayed further.
“Do you have any Primordial Stones in the treasure vault?” asked Meng Chuan. This true body in his homeworld needed to devour a Primordial Stone before it could reach the Primordial realm.
Furthermore, after absorbing a Primordial Stone and increasing his strength, he could continue to ‘confirm’ his strength.
When he attained greater strength, he would be allowed to take even more from Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasure vault.
“Primordial Stones?” The white-robed elder nodded. “The old master once collected a few Primordial Stones. There are a total of 203 inside the treasure vault. Altogether, they are worth about 93,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals. For the sake of future human juniors, you can only take 10% of them.”

chapters.title: Chapter 545 - Lifespan
chapters.content:
Chapter 545 Lifespan
That many Primordial Stones? Meng Chuan heaved a sigh of relief.
Following that, Meng Chuan recalled his main goal. He came to the treasure vault to prepare gifts for his son, who was about to enter the outer realm.
As a father, this was all he could do.
“Are there Void Transference Talismans in the treasure vault?” asked Meng Chuan.
“There are 55 of them. You can take three at most,” said the white-robed elder.
Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up.
To Qin Wu, Luo Tang, and company, it was normal for Archean Mountain to not have any Void Transference Talismans remaining.
Before Ancestral Master Archean Eon died, he had considered the entire race’s long-term development. Although he had left behind many treasures and cultivation manuals... they still needed people to cultivate them. He needed humanity’s future generations to work hard. Only with enough time and plenty of geniuses could a powerful Tribulation Eminence rise to prominence. According to the probability of a Tribulation Eminence rising, Ancestral Master Archean Eon believed that the resources he left behind could provide humanity with resources for at least 100 million years. Only then could he ensure Archean Eon Realm’s prosperity and growth.
Over 100 million years, every generation of Supremacies, Imperial Lords, and Tribulation Eminences could only receive limited resources.
Even the sect’s public resources were limited.
He couldn’t allow the Godfiends of one era to ‘waste’ it all away. He had to consider the countless Godfiends that would appear over the next 100 million-plus years.
The sect’s public resources were resources that Supremacies and Imperial Lords could use. The resources left behind by the seniors were mostly expended. Meng Chuan understood this point. Even I can only take three Void Transference Talismans.
If Meng Chuan didn’t need them, he could give them to the sect, and it would become the sect’s public resource. However, Meng Chuan needed them!
He still wanted to give one to his son, Meng An. Meng An was relatively weak, and he only had one true body. It was too dangerous for him to venture into the outer realm. If anything happened, he would be dead. As a father, Meng Chuan was very worried about his son.
“Do you have any more powerful life-preservation items?” asked Meng Chuan.
“Yes, there’s a Spacetime Teleportation Talisman in the treasury, which is stronger than Void Transference Talismans,” said the white-robed elder with a smile. “You can take one at most.”
“Spacetime Teleportation Talisman?” Meng Chuan was somewhat puzzled.
He knew that there were treasures that allowed one to teleport items across river zones. However, he didn’t know how special it was.
“A Spacetime Teleportation Talisman can teleport one to the other end of the River of Spacetime in a short period of time,” said the white-robed elder with a smile. “It’s a life-preservation treasure for Sixth Tribulation Eminences. Most Seventh Tribulation Eminences will find it difficult to stop a Spacetime Teleportation Talisman.”
“From one end of the River of Spacetime to the other?” Meng Chuan was somewhat shocked as he asked, “In what aspect is a Void Transference Talisman weaker than it?”
“Void Transference Talismans are one level weaker,” explained the white-robed elder. “Void Transference Talismans only allows one to cross many river systems within the same river zone in an instant. Furthermore, Void Transference Talismans are useless in front of Seventh Tribulation Eminences. Of course, most Sixth Tribulation Eminences can’t stop them. Only a small number can. In the outer realm, Void Transference Talismans are the most famous life-preservation items.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
Ordinary Tribulation Eminences rarely saw Sixth Tribulation Eminences. Thus, it was difficult to provoke them. Even if one did provoke a Sixth Tribulation Eminence, a single Void Transference Talisman was enough to save one’s life. “By the way, a Void Transference Talisman is counted as 300 Outer Realm Essence Crystals. A Spacetime Teleportation Talisman counts as 3,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals. These are very difficult to buy in the outside world, especially Spacetime Teleportation Talismans,” said the white-robed elder with a smile.
“Yes.” Meng Chuan was somewhat excited. “Are there any treasures in the treasure vault that can extend one’s lifespan?”
“Yes, there are 19 of them. You can only take one at most,” said the white-robed elder. “The stronger one is, the weaker the effects of longevity extension treasures.”
Meng Chuan frowned slightly.
I can only take one at most? “Come, follow me. There are many treasures in the treasure vault. Take a look at them one by one.” The white-robed elder was extremely enthusiastic. The walls behind him cracked open, and Meng Chuan immediately entered with the white-robed elder.
Although he still didn’t have the right to see some of the treasures in the treasure vault, what Meng Chuan saw still shocked him. It broadened his horizons, allowing him to understand how unfathomable the outer realm was. He realized just how many treasures and rare items had been monopolized by experts. These treasures... Meng Chuan was tempted by the treasures. Unfortunately, there were a limited number of treasures available to him. Furthermore, the total value of all the treasures he could take couldn’t exceed 50,000 cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals.
Three days later, in a pavilion at Grotto-Heaven Pavilion’s backyard. Meng Chuan was drinking tea.
“Dad.” Meng An rushed over when his father summoned him.
“An’er.” Meng Chuan put down his teacup and smiled at his son. “You previously said that you have to leave Archean Eon Realm within three years after winning the war?”.
Meng An nodded. “Yes, this is a rule set by Ancestral Master Archean Eon.”
“Then, stay in our homeworld until the three-year deadline is almost up. Leave when it’s time,” instructed Meng Chuan.
Meng An hesitated for a moment before saying, “Dad, I want to leave in the near future.”
“Leave in the near future?” Meng Chuan was alarmed as he looked at his son. “An’er, your grandfather is getting older. He doesn’t have much time left. If you leave now, he will be worried about you.” Meng An looked at Meng Chuan. “I have a reason for wanting to leave as soon as possible.”
“What reason?” Meng Chuan stared at his son.
“The reason why I’m cultivating so desperately is not only to deal with the war but also for something else.” Meng An looked at his father. “I have to become stronger as soon as possible. I have to head to the mystic realm as soon as possible.”
Meng Chuan looked at his son.
Meng An looked at his father.
The father-son duo stared at each other for a moment...
Meng Chuan could tell that the reason was very important to his son, even though he didn’t elaborate on it.
Meng Chuan nodded slightly, somewhat exhausted, and said, “Alright then, when do you want to set off?”
Meng An was somewhat ashamed. “As soon as possible.”
“Then, let’s wait another 20 days,” said Meng Chuan.
Meng An obediently agreed.
Meng Chuan looked at his son, who was only at the Supremacy realm. Meng An didn’t have another true body. How could he head to another river zone just like that? Meng Chuan was naturally worried.
In one of Heaven and Earth Great Hall’s chambers.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged. An Outer Realm Essence Crystal in front of him transformed into surging outer realm essence energy that constantly flooded his body.
Meng Chuan seized the opportunity to break through.
After obtaining a Primordial Stone from the treasure vault, his dantian’s Chaos Hole devoured it. Once the Primordial Stone had been absorbed, his body transformed, and this true body finally broke through to the Primordial realm.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasure vault naturally had Outer realm Essence crystals. However, Meng Chuan didn’t have the right to know how many were inside. In short, his quota of 50,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals was nothing to Ancestral Master Archean Eon.
The true body in my homeworld has also reached the Imperial Lord realm. Meng Chuan felt like his body had completely transformed. It was already comparable to his true body in the outer realm.
Reaching the Primordial realm makes me an Imperial Lord, mutteredMeng Chuan to himself.
With Infinite Saber-an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique-as his foundation, his lifespan had increased to 100,000 years after reaching the Primordial realm (Imperial Lord realm).
Even among special lifeforms, only the strongest special lifeforms—the pure-blooded dragons and phoenixes-could have 100,000-year lifespans. Meng Chuan had now reached the same level.
Such a long lifespan was enough to make many Tribulation Eminences envious. I wonder if I should refine more Primordial Stones after becoming an Imperial Lord.
With a flip of his hand, a fist-sized Primordial Stone appeared in his palm. When he held the Primordial Stone, his dantian had the urge to devour it. The impulse was much weaker than when he was at the Chaos Hole realm.
In the treasure vault, the Primordial Stones were 30% cheaper than the Eternal Tower’s. After all, Eternal Tower was doing business with the goal of earning Outer Realm Essence Crystals. As for Ancestral Master Archean Eon, he was only considering humanity’s future generations, so he naturally provided it at cost price.
With a thought, a dark Chaos Hole appeared in his palm as he devoured the Primordial Stone.
The Primordial Stone was sucked into his dantian. When it approached the tiny gray star in his dantian, the Primordial Stone silently disintegrated. The disintegration power couldn’t be seen with the naked eye, but Meng Chuan could vaguely sense that most of the Primordial Stone’s had been devoured by the tiny gray star. A portion of it scattered and fused with his body. The gray star also expanded in size as his body slowly transformed.
I absorbed it just like that? Meng Chuan was stunned. He flipped his hand and took out another Primordial Stone.
One stone after another...
Meng Chuan consumed five Primordial Stones, and only a small portion of the sixth stone was consumed.
After becoming an Imperial Lord, Meng Chuan’s body and dantian absorbed about 1,500 cubes Essence Crystals worth of Primordial Stones before he was satiated.
Including the Primordial Stone that I needed to absorb when I was at the Chaos Hole realm, one true body requires 1,800 Essence Crystals worth of Primordial Stones. The total for both bodies is 3,600 cubes.
My Essence Soul is as strong as a Fourth Tribulation Eminence’s. I wonder if I can reach the Fifth Tribulation realm’s threshold if I include my physical body’s strength. If I have strength at the Fifth Tribulation realm’s threshold, I can prepare better gifts for An’er.
Meng Chuan was very worried about his son. He had no idea when he could meet his son again after he headed to the outer realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 546 - Farewell
chapters.content:
Chapter 546 Farewell
After cultivating his body to the early-stage Primordial realm (Imperial Lord realm), he had devoured about 1,500 cubes worth of Primordial Stones. Apart from the fact that his body was as tough as a Dharma treasure, the true body in his homeworld wasn’t much stronger in close combat than his true body in the outer realm.
Meng Chuan confirmed his strength once again in Heaven and Earth Great Hall. Even with his Essence Soul strength-which was at the eighth level-and physical strength combined, he was still as strong as a Fourth Tribulation Eminence.
In the Tribulation realm, the difference between the First Tribulation Realm and the Second Tribulation realm was relatively small. Once one reached the Third Tribulation realm, one’s strength would change qualitatively. The further one advanced, the greater the increase in strength. It was clearly not easy for Meng Chuan to be as strong as a Fifth Tribulation Eminence.
Although it was autumn in Jiang State Capital, it was still extremely hot.
Meng Manor. “Father-in-law.” Meng Chuan was accompanying Liu Yebai.
Liu Yebai sat on a chair. His hair was thin, but his face remained rather ruddy. Many age spots could be seen on his face. His wrinkles were deep like ravines. At that moment, he smiled at his grandson and granddaughter.
“Meng Chuan, I still clearly remember the day these two children were born,” said Liu Yebai with a chuckle. “They were born in Gu Mountain Prefecture. After they were born, the two of you were very busy dealing with the demons. Dajiang also had to manage the Meng family and Earth Net in Eastcalm Prefecture... I was the one who looked after them. The two of them were very clingy to me.”
“It was hard on you back then, Father-in-law,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. He also remembered that period. Back then, he had yet to become a Marquis Godfiend.
“Grandpa.” Meng An and Meng You accompanied Liu Yebai.
“It doesn’t feel like much time has passed. Time really flies.” Liu Yebai shook his head. “In the blink of an eye, I’m almost dying of old age. People always reminisce about their past and their youth.”
At that moment, two figures walked over from afar. One was a white-haired elder, while the other was a middle-aged woman.
“Dad, Mom.” Meng Chuan immediately stood up.
Meng An and Meng You also quickly stood up and greeted them. “Grandfather, Grandmother.”
The white-haired elder looked extremely old, but his mind remained extremely clear because he was a Great Solar Godfiend. There was no need for anyone to help him. He was still stocky, tall, and slightly plump. He chuckled all year round and looked amiable.
“Today is a rare occasion. My son, grandson, and granddaughter are here.” Meng Dajiang chuckled.
“You’er is becoming more and more beautiful.” Bai Nianyun smiled as she looked at her granddaughter. Several years ago, under Meng Chuan’s full guidance, Meng You finally became a Regis Godfiend. However, her cultivation was clearly much inferior to Meng An’s. She became a Regis Godfiend because she had a father who pushed his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique to the perfected Heaven Earth realm. With her father’s full guidance, Meng You barely became a Regis Godfiend.
“Oh my, Dajiang, look at how old you have become?” Liu Yebai smiled. He looked much better in comparison.
“At least my hair isn’t missing at all.” Meng Dajiang sat by the side and looked at his old friend. “Look at your hair. If I must say something, why don’t you just go bald?”
“Here, have some watermelon.” Meng Chuan waved his hand, and a large watermelon appeared on the table. It quickly split into several pieces. The melon pulp was very red. Meng An and Meng You immediately picked up the watermelon pieces and served them to their paternal grandfather, paternal grandmother, and maternal grandfather.
As they ate, they chatted. Meng Chuan smiled as he watched this scene. His mother still could live for a long time, but his father only had three years left. His father-in-law, Liu Yebai, had eight years left.
Their lifespans shortened by one day as every day passed.
Back when Meng Chuan was young, they had shouldered everything. Now, they were all dying of old age.
After chatting for more than an hour, Meng Dajiang smiled and said, “Chuan’er, what’s the occasion today? You summoned the whole family together. You usually come alone to spend time with us. Meng An and Meng You should be very busy, right?”
“Yes, Dad, what’s the matter today?” asked Meng You. “Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded slightly and looked at Meng An.
Meng An said, “It’s about me. I’m leaving the human world and heading to the outer realm.”
“Heading to the outer realm?” Meng Dajiang, Bai Nianyun, and Liu Yebai exchanged looks. They fell silent. Although their cultivation realms weren’t high, they were still Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue’s seniors. They also knew some basic information about the outer realm.
“A good man goes wherever his ambition takes him,” said Meng Dajiang with a chuckle. “Since you want to go, go ahead. Back then, I didn’t hesitate to join the army. I went to a city pass and fought the demons. Your father and mother also fought the demons shortly after they left Archean Mountain. When your mother was pregnant with the two of you, your parents often fought outside. They even killed many demon monarchs.”
“Go ahead if you want to, but be careful,” instructed Liu Yebai.
“Be careful,” said Bai Nianyun. “Your father has been roaming the outer realm for some time. You should seek guidance from him.”
The three of them had seen too much blood and fire, so they accepted this matter calmly.
Outside Jiang State Capital, Meng Chuan and Meng An walked side by side under the night sky. “You’re leaving tonight?” asked Meng Chuan. Meng An nodded. “I’ve bid farewell to Grandfather and company. It’s time to leave.”
Meng Chuan nodded. With a flip of his hand, he took out a golden talisman and a purple talisman. “This is a Void Transference Talisman, and this is a Spacetime Teleportation Talisman. Take them.”
“Void Transference Talisman?” Meng An looked at the two talismans in front of him in shock.
He knew that Archean Mountain no longer had any Void Transference Talismans. At the very least, they couldn’t find one in the treasure vaults that were open to Supremacies.
They were only available in Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s higher-level treasure vaults.
“The Void Transference Talisman can be activated with a thought. It can allow one to cross several river systems instantly,” said Meng Chuan. “Under normal circumstances, it can save one’s life. As for the Spacetime Teleportation Talisman, it’s even stronger. No matter where you are, under normal circumstances, it can help you escape once it’s activated. All you need to do is follow your senses and return to Three Bay River System.”
“Flee back to our homeworld?” Meng An found his father’s words unbelievable. “Flee from a distant river zone to our homeworld?”
“You can return, no matter how far away you are.” Meng Chuan flipped his hand and took out two black talismans. “These two are Undying Talismans. Normally, this gives you an undying body for two hours. If you encounter a fatal attack, it will automatically activate. After activating them, you can use the Void Transference Talisman or the Spacetime Teleportation Talisman to escape.”
Meng Chuan looked at his son. “One Void Transference Talisman and one Spacetime Teleportation Talisman. It means that you have two chances of escaping. If you use both of them, you have to return quickly. It’s temporarily not suitable for you to roam the outer realm without life-preservation means,” said Meng Chuan. “Dad...” Meng An looked at his father. He knew how precious a Void Transference Talisman was. Before heading to the outer realm, he had naturally read many dossiers and knew of the Spacetime Dominion Map. However, he had never heard of Spacetime Teleportation Talismans. From just Meng Chuan’s description of it, its powers far exceeded a Void Transference Talisman’s.
Meng Chuan looked at his son. “You only have two chances of escape.”
“I’ll take my leave.” Meng An didn’t say anything else.
“Remember, this is your homeworld,” said Meng Chuan softly. “If you can come back, come back often. Visit your family. Don’t stay outside for too long. If you stay too long, you won’t be able to see many people.” Meng An nodded heavily. “Yes.” He couldn’t bear to part with his homeworld. However, he had to head out and create his own future.
Rip!
The world membrane tore apart; Meng An flew through the rift and entered the outer realm.
Meng Chuan silently watched this scene. His son was only a Supremacy, but he had to head to a mystic realm in a distant river zone. Even if he did become an Imperial Lord and had another true body, unless he used the Spacetime Teleportation Talisman, he would probably only be able to cross river zones and return to his homeworld after reaching the Tribulation realm.
How long would that take?
Hundreds of years? Thousands of years?
Meng Chuan felt mixed emotions.
Meng An rushed out of the world membrane rift and arrived in the outer realm. When he saw the outer realm void, the Grand Yang Star, and the Grand Yin Star, he was somewhat shocked. He turned his head to look at his homeworld and his father before nodding slightly.
Buzz!
Following that, purple light enveloped Meng An, and he instantly disappeared.
Meng Chuan’s karma with his son was very deep. The bloodline connection between them made Meng Chuan’s perception of Meng An even clearer.
He could sense that his son had instantly arrived at a distant river zone. It was much further away than the Ancient Magus River Zone. There was even a mysterious force that blocked Meng Chuan’s perception.
It’s time to cultivate. Meng Chuan turned and left. He had to prepare for his first Essence Soul Tribulation.

chapters.title: Chapter 547 - Tribulation of the Essence Soul
chapters.content:
Chapter 547 Tribulation of the Essence Soul
Whoosh
Emperor Roc was traveling through the vast River of Spacetime at full speed. He wanted to return to his homeworld, which was in Three Bay River System.
I’m about to reach Three Bay River System. Emperor Roc’s strength had improved greatly after reaching the Third Tribulation realm and cultivating in the Chaos Hole’s depths for more than a century. He was much faster during his return trip from Ancient Magus River Zone. He would reach Three Bay River System in a year.
This trip was all for nothing. Emperor Roc was rather indignant. His many years of planning had been in vain. Damn you, Meng Chuan! He’s indeed sinister. I thought he was a newly-advanced Imperial Lord at most, but I never expected him to remain at the Supremacy realm. When Meng Chuan’s strike reached the Demon Realm through the demon sage passageway, he knew that Meng Chuan had remained at the Supremacy realm, not breaking through. Although Meng Chuan had remained at the Supremacy realm, he could unleash the strength of a Tribulation Eminence! His technique realm clearly is extremely high. In regards to technique realm, he’s probably slightly stronger than me.
Once the war was won, Meng Chuan no longer needed to hide his strength.
A month after their victory, my karmic perception of him blurred significantly. I can only vaguely sense his direction. He should be at the Tribulation realm. Emperor Roc had some guesses about Meng Chuan’s strength. He understood that a month in the outside world could mean dozens-fold longer in the Chaos Hole’s depths. This was because of how the time flow accelerated in the Chaos Hole.
With sufficient Outer Realm Essence Crystals, Meng Chuan could advance to the Tribulation realm smoothly. After winning the war for more than half a year, I can’t even sense him through karma. I can only confirm that he’s alive. I can’t sense anything else. Even if he has a treasure that isolates karma, his lifeforce should be in no way inferior to mine. Has he reached the Third Tribulation realm?
Emperor Roc speculated. The more he thought about it, the more he found it perverse.
It was even harder to pry into the karma of high-level lifeforms. For example, Third Tribulation Eminences couldn’t sense the karma of Fifth Tribulation Eminences. As for Fifth Tribulation Eminences... they couldn’t clearly sense the karma of Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
