Of course, some rare treasures had supplementary effects. However, the higher one’s cultivation realm was, the less effective these treasures were.
However, Emperor Roc didn’t know that a month after winning the war, Meng Chuan had attained an eighth-level Essence Soul. That was why his perception of Meng Chuan’s karma became very blurry.
Half a year after winning the war, Meng Chuan became a Primordial Imperial Lord! His strength was equivalent to that of an adult pure-blooded dragon or phoenix. He now had a 100,000-year lifespan. In regards to life’s natural order, he was equivalent to a Fifth Tribulation Eminence. This was also why Emperor Roc couldn’t sense him clearly.
There’s no way to suppress an Essence Soul breakthrough. Since he could immediately break through in a short time, it means that he’s reached the Physical Body Tribulation realm. Considering his technique realm, he might be able to become a Fourth Tribulation Eminence after spending some time. Emperor Roc was quite stressed.
They were all Tribulation Eminences from Three Bay River System. A river system only had a few dozen Tribulation Eminences! They would definitely interact in the future.
With the enmity between the two parties, Meng Chuan definitely wouldn’t let him off.
How did he improve so quickly? Emperor Roc muttered to himself. Did he create a very powerful ultimate technique?
One could rapidly improve their strength by creating powerful techniques.
Emperor Roc relied on his bloodline to reach the Third Tribulation realm quickly.
After Meng Chuan’s self-created Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique reached the perfected Heaven Earth realm, his technique realm was comparable to a Third Tribulation Eminence’s. As long as his body was perfected, he could reach the Third Tribulation realm with the ultimate technique in a short period of time.
Ordinary Imperial Lord-level ultimate techniques typically allowed one to rise straight to the Third Tribulation realm.
Further up and it would be Imperial Lord-level paramount techniques. They were techniques that allowed one to reach the Fifth Tribulation realm smoothly. Creators of such techniques were legendary existences. In the River of Spacetime, such peerless geniuses were much rarer than Sixth Tribulation Eminences.
I’ve returned to Three Bay River System. Emperor Roc was filled with anticipation. It’s time to meet the Palace Lord.
Three Bay River System was a river system with a rather deep heritage. The river system also had a Fifth Tribulation Eminence-Palace Lord Snowjade.
Palace Lord Snowjade was rather arrogant. Therefore, ordinary cultivators didn’t dare enter his cultivation grounds.
Swoosh.
Emperor Roc flew over to a towering snow mountain, which floated in the outer realm.
The snow mountain was over 50,000 kilometers tall. Next to the snow mountain was a Grand Yin Star that emitted a cold glow. This snow mountain was a Sixth Tribulation treasure. Even a Fifth Tribulation Eminence wouldn’t be willing to enter the snow mountain and fight Palace Lord Snowjade.
A palace complex—which appeared to be carved from jade-stood atop the snow mountain’s summit. It was Three Bay River System’s Holy Land-Snowjade Palace.
Whoosh.
Emperor Roc landed on the square in front of Snowjade Palace. In the square, a green toad was coiled like a sculpture. At that moment, the green toad opened its eyes and looked at Emperor Roc. It said in surprise, “Golden Roc, you have reached the Tribulation realm?”
Emperor Roc nodded. “Yes.”
“Which Tribulation realm?” asked the green toad.
“Third Tribulation realm.” Emperor Roc didn’t hide anything. “That’s true. With your bloodline, you can quickly reach the Third Tribulation realm,” said the green toad with a smile. “The Palace Lord will be leaving Three Bay River System to do something big. Since you have reached the Third Tribulation realm... you can follow him.”
Emperor Roc was astonished. “Something big?” “Golden Roc, come in.” A cold voice came from the palace’s depths.
“Yes.” Emperor Roc was extremely respectful. When he reached the perfected Imperial Lord realm, he was admitted to Snowjade Palace due to his bloodline.
It was more suitable for weak Tribulation Eminences to follow powerful Tribulation Eminences. Some weaker Tribulation Eminences were even unqualified to follow them.
After Emperor Roc reached the perfected Imperial Lord realm, he was destined to be a Third Tribulation Eminence. Due to his bloodline, he was considered extremely powerful in the Third Tribulation realm. He was strong enough for Fifth Tribulation Eminences to take him in as a follower. This was because Fourth Tribulation Eminences could have free rein over large areas alone. There was no need for Fifth Tribulation Eminences to shelter them.
Emperor Roc was willing to be a follower because he knew himself very well. After quickly reaching the Third Tribulation realm, it would be extremely difficult for him to improve further. He needed Palace Lord Snowjade as his guide.
Archean Eon Realm, Grotto-Heaven Pavilion.
Meng Chuan was reading a book when he suddenly looked into the distance.
Emperor Roc has returned to Three Bay River System. Furthermore, I can sense its location... It should be in Snowjade Palace. Meng Chuan frowned slightly. Due to them being in the same river system, his perception of Emperor Roc’s karma became clearer.
Emperor Roc couldn’t sense his karma, but Meng Chuan could clearly sense Emperor Roc’s.
Back on Black Dragon Planet, Meng Chuan had purchased detailed intelligence on Three Bay River System through Eternal Tower. Information on every Tribulation Eminence and Imperial Lord was available.
One of them noted that Emperor Roc was one of Palace Lord Snowjade’s followers.
Palace Lord Snowjade, the only Fifth Tribulation Eminence in the entire Three Bay River System? When I kill Emperor Roc in the future, as long as Palace Lord Snowjade isn’t stupid, he won’t fight me for a follower. Fifth Tribulation Eminences did not need to fight life-and-death battles unless for special reasons. After all, they all had true bodies in their homeworlds. Even if a Fifth Tribulation Eminence killed one of their opponent’s true bodies, the other party could just cultivate another one.
However, this will only happen if my strength is close to Palace Lord Snowjade’s. I’m still not at the Fifth Tribulation realm yet. Meng Chuan had patience.
He was growing at a rapid pace.
Meng Chuan flipped through the book in his hand leisurely.
Suddenly
Meng Chuan’s hand trembled slightly as he sat there and stared at the page for about ten minutes.
I transcended the first Essence Soul tribulation. Meng Chuan heaved a sigh of relief before flipping to the second page.
Essence Soul Tribulations came and went without a trace. They descended upon one’s Essence Soul directly. Thus, there wasn’t much of a commotion on the surface.
After Meng Chuan transcended his first Essence Soul Tribulation, his Essence Soul transformed as his Power of Essence Soul became purer. If he couldn’t withstand the Essence Soul Tribulations, no matter how powerful his Essence Soul was, he could barely get things in order before his soul completely dissipated. However, Meng Chuan was very confident. From his Essence Soul’s purity, Meng Chuan knew that his spiritual cultivation level should be extremely high.
Meng Chuan’s Infinite Saber and Saber of Nirvana fused with his Essence Soul World, changing it greatly. His infinite Saber was a perfect paramount technique. With it, he naturally transcended his first Essence Soul Tribulation easily.

chapters.title: Chapter 548 - Cultivation Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 548 Cultivation Years
In the blink of an eye, three years had passed.
Ever since his son, Meng An, headed to the outer realm, Meng Chuan’s true body in the outer realm’s Ancient Magus River Zone had been cultivating in the Chaos Hole’s depths for a long time. He cultivated in a region where time flowed 70-fold faster. Although he could stay in a region where time flowed 80-fold faster with his greatly enhanced body and Essence Soul, the region where time flowed 70-fold faster placed a smaller burden on him. It was much more suitable for long-term cultivation.
In fact, cultivating in a Chaos Hole’s depths would affect one’s Essence Soul and mental state. Weak Tribulation Eminences didn’t dare to cultivate in a Chaos Hole’s depths for too long. However, Ancestral Master Archean Eon had never mentioned this in his dossiers. This was because Ancestral Master Archean Eon knew very well that the Chaos Hole’s influence was an external one.
A harsh environment could temper one’s mind. If one’s mind could withstand a Chaos Hole’s influence, it would only improve further. If one couldn’t even withstand a Chaos Hole’s influence, their achievements would be limited.
Meng Chuan had originally been affected for over 300 years before breaking free of the Chaos Hole’s influence. After painting ‘Backbone,’ his Essence Soul had improved greatly. The Chaos Hole’s influence on my mental state is a form of tempering to the present me. My mind will only become stronger. Due to the fact his mind could be strengthened, Meng Chuan liked to cultivate in the Chaos Hole.
Powerful swords needed to be tempered and sharpened. Suitable tempering only boosted one’s cultivation.
In reality, Meng Chuan had been cultivating in the Chaos Hole for over 200 years despite only three years passing outside.
His fourth Essence Soul Tribulation had finally descended.
The first three Essence Soul Tribulations were separated by a year at least. Therefore, Meng Chuan reached the Essence Soul Third Tribulation realm at the fastest speed possible.
After the third tribulation...
Every tribulation was separated by 100 years at least.
As for Meng Chuan, 200 years passed since he transcended the third tribulation before the fourth Essence Soul Tribulation finally descended upon him.
My fourth Essence Soul Tribulation didn’t arrive in the shortest time possible.
This means that my Essence Soul is probably at the Fourth Tribulation realm. It still hasn’t reached the Fifth Tribulation realm yet. Meng Chuan understood this point. If one’s mind, Essence Soul World, and various aspects had reached the Fifth Tribulation realm, the fourth tribulation would arrive in the shortest time possible. Of course, he also understood the general level of his Essence Soul because of his experiments at Heaven and Earth Great Hall.
Only when the fourth Essence Soul Tribulation descended upon Meng Chuan did he truly understand why Tribulation Eminences were afraid of Heavenly Tribulations.
He transcended the first three tribulations very easily. However, the fourth tribulation made him suffer quite a bit.
Boom!
His sea of consciousness had long transformed into an Essence Soul World.
In the Essence Soul World, there were grasslands, deserts, flowers, birds, and beasts. There were also battles between beasts, as well as living beings surviving inside...
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul transformed into a person sitting cross-legged in the middle of the world.
On this day, fire descended from the sky.
The flames descended upon the Essence Soul World in his sea of consciousness, burning a 50-kilometer radius around his Essence Soul.
Boom!
There was no way for Meng Chuan to escape the tribulation. The flames burned every inch of his Essence Soul, preventing any Essence Soul thoughts from escaping.
He could only sit cross-legged and silently resist.
Boundless pain filled his consciousness. This was the highest level of pain Meng Chuan had ever experienced. The flames burned every Essence Soul thought, causing them to collapse in terrifying pain. New Essence Soul thoughts were born after every collapse.
Fire of the heart. Burning my Essence Soul is also a way to temper my heart. Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul sat cross-legged in his sea of consciousness’s Essence Soul World. Despite the pain spreading, his heart remained as cold as ice.
He had experienced too much since he was young. His willpower and mind were already extremely strong.
The flames burned for three days; however, Meng Chuan felt like the flames had burned him for an eternity.
Whoosh.
The flames receded.
The Tribulation Fire burned his Essence Soul for three entire days. It was painful torture, but it also tempered his Essence Soul. As a result, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul had become much stronger. He absorbed Outer Realm Essence Crystals to replenish his strength; he realized that his Essence Soul’s strength had reached a new peak.
“This is only the fourth Essence Soul Tribulation. How terrifying is the fifth Essence Soul Tribulation, which is supposed to be more than ten times harder?” Meng Chuan muttered. “Cultivation in the Tribulation realm is indeed difficult.”
Only by creating an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique could one rapidly advance to the Fifth Tribulation realm. Even so, Meng Chuan felt that it was becoming harder and harder for him to advance.
After creating an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique, he was considered the most monstrous genius in the River of Spacetime. However, even he began finding cultivation difficult as he approached the Fifth Tribulation realm.
It was obvious how difficult it was for ordinary Tribulation Eminences—who were groping in the dark—to reach the Fifth Tribulation realm. Even the proud Emperor Roc had long become a Fifth Tribulation Eminence’s follower. He hoped that his cultivation path would be smoother with an expert’s guidance.
In the same era, two to three river systems gave birth to a Fifth Tribulation Eminence on average. This ratio also proved the difficulty of cultivation.
After winning the war, Meng Chuan had cultivated in the Chaos Hole’s depths for over 200 years. After spending more than 30 years, Meng Chuan raised his Infinite Saber to the Heaven Earth realm’s middle stage. As he had previously been stuck at a bottleneck, he had created quite a few saber moves. His accumulated insights were sufficiently profound, which was why Infinite Saber could reach the Heaven Earth realm’s middle stage so quickly.
After spending more than 180 years, he finally raised his Infinite Saber to the Heaven Earth realm’s late stage. Strictly speaking, not long after transcending the fourth Essence Soul Tribulation, Meng Chuan’s Infinite Saber reached the Heaven Earth realm’s late stage.
“You want to confirm your strength again?” The white-robed elder looked at Meng Chuan, who was inside Heaven and Earth Great Hall.
Meng Chuan nodded. “Yes.”
“Make your move.” The white-robed elder pointed at the cyan pillar. “You know the rules.”
Meng Chuan held his breath and waited.
Ever since his Infinite Saber reached the Heaven Earth realm’s late stage, he had gained more confidence. His body had also become stronger thanks to using Infinite Saber as his foundation. He wasn’t far from becoming a perfected Primordial Imperial Lord.
Father only has less than half a year left. It’s time to make a decision. Meng Chuan placed his right hand on his saber’s hilt.
Nothing seemed to have changed.
Whoosh
A saber mark appeared on the cyan pillar. Meng Chuan’s drawing of the saber couldn’t be seen. Neither could its trajectory be seen, but the saber mark sliced through layers of runes on the pillar.
Meng Chuan’s pure speed had reached 60% of light speed. This speed was very terrifying for Tribulation Eminences. When he accelerated the time flow around him, the speed of his saber was unimaginable. Even a planet that was tens of thousands of kilometers in diameter could be completely destroyed with a single strike. However, he had condensed all his might into the seemingly ordinary saber mark
“Instantly penetrating seven layers of runes?” The white-robed elder looked at Meng Chuan in surprise.
Meng Chuan stared at the white-robed elder. “How is it?” Although it seemed easy, Meng Chuan had already used all his physical strength.
The white-robed elder looked at Meng Chuan in surprise. He smiled and said, “This strike of yours has reached the Fifth Physical Body Tribulation realm.”
Fifth Physical Body Tribulation? Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up.
There was a difference between Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences and Physical Body Tribulation Eminences. Physical Body Tribulation Eminences were more skilled at close combat. They were also more skilled at direct attacks. Their bursts of strength were even greater than that of Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences.
“You can only be considered to have reached the Fifth Tribulation realm’s threshold,” reminded the white-robed elder. “One is considered to be at the Fifth Tribulation realm if they can penetrate seven to nine layers of runes. You can only be considered to reach the Fifth Tribulation realm’s threshold.”

chapters.title: Chapter 549 - Extended Longevity
chapters.content:
Chapter 549 Extended Longevity
Meng Chuan was rather pleasantly surprised.
I never expected that my close-combat strength would reach the Fifth Tribulation realm’s threshold after cultivating Infinite Saber to the Heaven Earth realm’s late stage. However, Meng Chuan understood why he achieved this feat after some thought.
On the one hand, Infinite Saber at the Heaven Earth realm’s middle stage was already considered to be as strong as a Fourth Tribulation-level technique. Once it reached the late stage, it was not far from a Fifth Tribulation-level technique. On the other hand, his body was especially powerful after he devoured Primordial Stones. Only by using his powerful body and saber art together could he reach the Fifth Tribulation realm’s threshold.
“In the past, you could only choose treasures that cost less than 50,000 cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals in total,” said the white-robed elder with a smile. “Now, your upper limit is 300,000 cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. “Okay.” Even when faced with 300,000 cubes worth of treasures, he could now face the situation calmly. Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s gift had indeed saved Meng Chuan the trouble of gathering treasures.
However, his quota of 300,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals was the limit after attaining Fifth Tribulation realm strength. Furthermore, he had already chosen treasures like the Spacetime Teleportation Talisman for his son. He had also taken a few Primordial Stones and cultivated a World Treasure. He had spent quite a bit of his quota.
I can reach the Fifth Tribulation realm in a short period of time, but it will take me a lot of effort and time to reach the Sixth Tribulation realm. Meng Chuan understood this.
In the River of Spacetime’s history, the monstrous geniuses that could create Imperial Lord-level paramount techniques had reached the Fifth Tribulation in a short period of time. However, they had to put in plenty of effort to reach the Sixth Tribulation Realm. The Sixth Tribulation realm was usually the limit for these monstrous geniuses. Meng Chuan’s cultivation resources were the treasures he could obtain with his 300,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals quota. He had to use his resources carefully so that he could advance to the Sixth Tribulation realm in the future.
After all, it was almost impossible for Meng Chuan to obtain such immense wealth without Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s gifts for his juniors.
Treasure ruins? Even if a Seventh Tribulation Eminence failed a tribulation, they would be able to return to their homeworld instantly and make arrangements before they died.
Only a Fifth Tribulation Eminence like Senior Pang Ming, who traveled a little slower, couldn’t rush back in time before they died! That was why his cave abode drifted through the outer realm.
Therefore, the better the lost treasure, the lower the chances of obtaining it. It was too difficult to soar in a single step.
Even Tribulation Eminences that came from high-level worlds had limited wealth. This was because the treasures left behind by Eighth Tribulation Eminences in high-level worlds were similarly limited. They could only obtain a set amount. The rules for obtaining these treasures were even stricter than Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s. This was because there were many more cultivators in high-level worlds than in middle-level worlds. Thus, these treasures had to be conserved.
Meng Chuan’s quota of 300,000 cubes was a huge sum... With this amount of Outer Realm Essence Crystals, one could just buy anything they needed for the body cultivation and World Treasures without any regard for the price. They could also buy many life-preservation items and cultivation supplements.
But 300,000 wasn’t that much either. For example, the lowest price of an Eighth Tribulation treasure was 150,000 cubes. Furthermore, they couldn’t be bought. Many Sixth Tribulation Eminences couldn’t find a single one their entire lives.
There were also other very expensive treasures. Small Universe was priced at 500,000 cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals. It was one of the top five treasures in Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasure vault. It made even Seventh Tribulation Eminences envious. Meng Chuan could see it, but he couldn’t afford it either.
Following that, Meng Chuan tried attacking the pillar again, but with his Essence Soul realm strength this time. The white-robed elder determined that his Essence Soul’s strength was still at the Fourth Tribulation realm.
It was clear that reaching the Fifth Tribulation realm’s threshold in close combat had something to do with his powerful body.
In a place like Jiang State Capital, it was very difficult to encounter a snowstorm. The number of snow days a year typically didn’t last more than half a month.
Today, it was snowing heavily.
Snowflakes fluttered across the world like down feathers.
Meng Manor.
In a corridor, Meng Dajiang and Liu Yebai were lying on a reclining chair. They were covered in a blanket. Beside them was a stove that warmed the alcohol flask.
The two old men drank and chatted leisurely.
Bai Nianyun was leisurely reading on Meng Dajiang’s other side. “Jiang State Capital’s population is increasing,” said Liu Yebai. “The food supply has become a little tight. The streets and carriages are becoming more and more crowded. In the early days, Jiang State Capital never thought of accommodating 30 million people. The Imperial Court has to manage this.”
“It’s indeed very crowded. I’d rather fly when I’m out,” said Meng Dajiang. “I can’t even be bothered to walk with the crowds.”
“Do you think everyone has an avian demon servant like you?” said Liu Yebai. “When Earth Net Godfiends go out to do business, they use their movement techniques to walk across the roofs and treetops.”
Meng Dajiang nodded. “There are too many people. More and more people are using carriages.”
“Jiang State Capital is so big. Without using a carriage, it will take an entire day to go from the eastern city gate to the western city gate on foot,” said Bai Nianyun casually. “Of course a carriage is needed. Sitting in a carriage is much more comfortable and much faster.”
Meng Chuan walked over from afar. He smiled when he heard his parents and father-in-law chatting.
Jiang State Capital had many people, and there were even more people in the countryside outside the city! The war had ended for many years, and the population boomed! The cities were beginning to reach the food supply limit. Many prefecture cities and county cities were being rebuilt.
“Meng Chuan is here.” Liu Yebai’s eyes were pretty good as he noticed Meng Chuan at a glance.
“Father-in-law.” Meng Chuan walked over with a smile. “Dad, Mom.”
“Did you hear what Uncle Liu said?” asked Meng Dajiang
“It’s mainly because large cities are more suitable for children to attend the Dao Academies and cultivate. It’s also more suitable for doing business, so there are many more people,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “Prefecture and county cities in the world are now being rebuilt. Living in large cities is not easy. Quite a bit of the world’s population will naturally migrate to the prefecture and county cities.”
With a Tribulation Eminence like Meng Chuan presiding over the entire Archean Eon Realm, civil wars wouldn’t happen. In history, when there were no external enemies, the war between sects and dynasties would continue. However, the world was peaceful now. With Meng Chuan alive, how could anyone from Two World Island and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven dare to cause trouble?
Archean Eon Realm was destined to welcome another era of prosperity.
The world’s population would reach a peak, and the number of Godfiends would be the highest. However, Meng Chuan alone could easily supply the resources needed to nurture Godfiends.
“That’s right. There are countless county cities and prefecture cities,” said Meng Dajiang with a smile. “The entire human world will slowly recover to how it had been when I was young.” “It will be much better than when you were young,” said Liu Yebai. “Now, there’s no need to hide in a fort. The villages are all over the world. There will be a lot more people.” “Yes, countless villages.” Meng Dajiang nodded. “There are countless villages everywhere in the world. Originally, I could only see such a description in history books, but now we can see it. We really are living in an era of great change.”
Liu Yebai nodded slightly. “Yes, we’ve seen enough big changes in our lives.”
As the two old friends chatted, Meng Chuan listened from the side. Bai Nianyun read a book and accompanied them. Gulp! Gulp! Gulp! Gulp! The smell of alcohol wafted out of the alcohol flask and diffused through the air. Snowflakes fluttered in the outside world. Some drifted into the corridor and onto their bodies.
Meng Chuan accompanied them until they finished drinking. The snow stopped.
“Dad, Father-in-law,” said Meng Chuan, “All of you know about the Millennium Instant mystic technique, right?”
Meng Dajiang, Liu Yebai, and Bai Nianyun turned to look at him. As his elders, they naturally knew that Liu Qiyue had entered a slumber.
Liu Yebai nodded. “Qiyue is currently slumbering.”
“I hope that Dad and Father-in-law can enter a deep slumber as well,” said Meng Chuan.
“Us?” said Liu Yeba in surprise. “I remember you saying that one has to be a Regis Godfiend to enter the slumber at the very least. Otherwise, one won’t have the right to enter Millennium Hall.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. “That’s true. In fact, Archean Mountain taught the Millennium Instant mystic technique to Two World Island and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven. I have also learned this mystic technique. This mystic technique is an array formation. It’s not difficult to set it up.”
Even Two World Island and Black Sand Grotto-Heaven could set it up. With Meng Chuan’s skill in the void lineage, it was naturally very easy for him to set up the array formation needed for the Millennium Instant mystic technique.
“I will personally set up the Millennium Instant mystic technique’s array formation in my mobile grotto-heaven and build a sleeping palace,” said Meng Chuan. “I’ll let Dad and Father-in-law enter a slumber first.”
“I don’t have any regrets in my life. What’s the point of sleeping for 1,000 years?” Meng Dajiang chuckled.
Meng Chuan looked at the two elders and said solemnly, “I’m confident that I can obtain a longevity extension treasure. Father, Father-in-law, it’s not difficult for me to extend your lifespan by 1,000 years.” “Extending our lifespan by 1,000 years?” Meng Dajiang and Liu Yebai sat up straight.

chapters.title: Chapter 550 - Perfected Imperial Lord Paramount Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 550: Perfected Imperial Lord Paramount Technique
Translator: CKtalon
Meng Dajiang and Liu Yebai had experienced too many things. They had long gotten around the concept of death and could face death calmly. However, if they could live for a few more centuries or 1,000 more years? They naturally wanted to live longer.
“Chuan’er, can you really do it?” Bai Nianyun was somewhat excited and nervous.
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded. “I’m confident.”
He was confident. Although longevity extension treasures were rare, the weaker one was, the easier it was to extend one’s lifespan. It was especially easy to extend one’s lifespan by 2,000 years.
It was much more difficult to extend a Supremacy’s lifespan or an Imperial Lord’s lifespan. It was even harder to extend a Tribulation Eminence’s lifespan.
All the treasures in Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasure vault were extraordinary. Some could extend a Supremacy’s lifespan. Some even worked on Imperial Lords and Tribulation Eminences. However, Meng Chuan could only choose one!
However, as long as he chose a valuable treasure, Meng Chuan would be qualified to exchange for five to six ordinary longevity extension treasures when he became a Fifth Tribulation Eminence.
Meng Chuan planned to extend his wife, father, mother, and father-in-law’s lifespans.
The price for extending his wife’s lifespan was the greatest. She was a Regis Godfiend. She could condense Phoenix Divine Fire when she burned her Phoenix bloodline. Because of this, it cost much more to extend her lifespan than to extend an ordinary Supremacy’s lifespan. On the contrary, the three elders combined would cost less than Liu Qiyue.
“Extend by 1,000 years?” Meng Dajiang and Liu Yebai exchanged looks.
“Is it very difficult?” Meng Dajiang was somewhat worried about his son.
Meng Chuan smiled at his father and father-in-law. “It’s not difficult.”
Why did he cultivate? It was for his homeworld and his family. Only when his family lived a better life did Meng Chuan feel that his cultivation was of value. What was the point of being invincible if he was alone forever?
“It’s not difficult?” Meng Dajiang, Liu Yebai, and Bai Nianyun looked at Meng Chuan in disbelief.
“It’s not difficult for me,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “Father-in-law, Dad, Mom, I’ll be honest with you. It won’t take me long before I reach the Fifth Tribulation realm. It’s still possible for a Fifth Tribulation Eminence to extend the lifespan of weaker cultivators.”
“Fifth Tribulation realm?”
Meng Dajiang, Bai Nianyun, and Liu Yebai knew some information regarding the outer realm. They also roughly understood the strength difference between Tribulation realm experts.
They knew that in human history, four Tribulation Eminences had been born before Meng Chuan. The strongest one was Ancestral Master Archean Eon. Imperial Lord An Yang—who ranked second in Heart Sea Palace and Battle God Pagoda’s combined rankings—only reached the Essence Soul Third Tribulation realm.
Now, their son—Meng Chuan—said that he would reach the Fifth Tribulation realm soon?
“Alright, I’ll listen to you.” Meng Dajiang smiled at his son and looked at Liu Yebai. “Yebai, when do you plan on sleeping?”
“In a month. This is too sudden. I have to make arrangements,” said Liu Yebai.
Meng Dajiang nodded. “Then we shall do it in a month.”
...
A month later.
In a beautiful palace complex inside a grotto-heaven, the Millennium Instant mystic technique’s array formation had been set up in one of the palaces.
Meng Dajiang and Liu Yebai entered a slumber as they were completely frozen by the dark-blue ice.
...
After Meng Dajiang fell asleep, Bai Nianyun became even lonelier.
In just a year, Bai Nianyun came to Meng Chuan and requested to enter the slumber as well.
“Let me sleep too. This way, I’ll be able to see Dajiang when I wake up. Otherwise, it’ll be too difficult for me to live alone for 100 years.”
Meng Chuan couldn’t refuse his mother’s request. He actually understood his mother’s feelings. After Liu Qiyue fell asleep, he had been suffering alone. He also hoped to just have a good night’s sleep and see his wife awake when he opened his eyes. That would be a beautiful day. However, he was the only one who didn’t have the right to sleep. He had too many responsibilities.
“Alright.” Meng Chuan promised his mother.
His mother also entered a slumber in the palace.
...
Meng Chuan became even lonelier. His parents were slumbering. His son, Meng An, had left for the outer realm. His daughter, Meng You, also had her own family and children. However, he calmly faced all of this. With his high spiritual cultivation level, he could withstand his loneliness completely.
He focused all his attention on cultivation; his true body in the outer realm continued cultivating in the Chaos Hole’s depths.
...
In the blink of an eye, eight years had passed since his father, Meng Dajiang, and his father-in-law, Liu Yebai, began slumbering. Meng Chuan had been cultivating in the Chaos Hole’s depths for another 500-plus years.
Ancient Magus River Zone, Heaven Peak River System, deep in the Chaos Hole.
Swoosh.
Lightning flashed and transformed into a white-haired man. This white-haired man had already appeared in the Chaos Hole accretion disc. It was Meng Chuan.
The distance between the Chaos Hole’s depths and the accretion disc was counted in billions of kilometers, but Meng Chuan traversed that distance instantly.
This feeling? Is this the feeling of perfected paramount speed laws? Meng Chuan’s eyes were filled with infatuation.
Today, he had finally elevated his Infinite Saber to the perfected Heaven Earth realm. He had finally raised his Imperial Lord-level paramount technique to the perfected Heaven Earth realm. With this, Meng Chuan had also grasped the paramount speed laws.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan used his movement technique again and immediately felt a powerful resistance acting against his body. He flew against the powerful resistance.
Everything around him turned still.
Complete stillness.
Even the light rays had stopped; the extremely tiny matter in the outer realm had also fallen silent.
“Time Stillness,” muttered Meng Chuan as he looked around.
The Chaos Hole accretion disc, the Grand Yang Star, and the Grand Yin Star’s light rays came to a halt.
Everything came to a standstill.
Only he was moving!
As a powerful lifeform, he would jump out of the time flow’s restraints when he reached light speed. At a certain speed, Meng Chuan could completely jump out of the temporal dimension and be able to travel very far at this instant in time.
Everything beyond him was still.
Therefore, Meng Chuan could easily travel hundreds of millions of kilometers or even further in an instant.
Whoosh.
After flying in a circle for billions of kilometers, Meng Chuan stopped in exhaustion. He had to resist the time flow’s restrictions constantly when he stopped time. He had to resist spacetime’s restrictions, so it greatly exhausted him. Meng Chuan couldn’t pause time for very long.
“Is this the strength of a Fifth Tribulation Eminence?” Meng Chuan whispered softly. “It’s no wonder the strength difference between Tribulation Eminences becomes greater with every realm. If I were to attempt to kill the Fourth Tribulation realm me, my former self wouldn’t even be able to see my current self before my former self was taken down.”
Although his strength had reached the Fifth Tribulation realm’s threshold in the past, it wasn’t the true Fifth Tribulation realm.
At the true Fifth Tribulation realm, one’s technique realm had to reach the Fifth Tribulation realm first. If one was a Physical Body Tribulation Eminence, one needed to fuse their insights into their body and raise their body to the corresponding level. Only when one reached a sufficiently high level in both aspects would they be able to trigger the fifth Physical tribulation.
After Meng Chuan’s Infinite Saber reached the perfected Imperial Lord realm, his technique realm could only be considered at the Fifth Tribulation realm. Only when his body reached this stage could he truly be the match of a Fifth Tribulation Eminence.
As a Fifth Tribulation realm expert, I can easily kill a Fourth Tribulation Eminence with just the Time Stillness technique. Although Patriarch Black Dragon and the other Fifth Tribulation Eminences might have taken different paths from me, they might still have terrifying void lineage or time lineage techniques.
At the Fifth Tribulation realm, all of their techniques were on par with each other.
Legend had it that there were also Fifth Tribulation Eminences that had reached the Sixth Tribulation realm in terms of technique. However, due to a lack of confidence in cultivating their bodies, they deliberately stopped at the Fifth Tribulation realm. This would also mean that they were invincible among their peers. Meng Chuan would be killed if he encountered one.
Of course, such existences were famous. Meng Chuan wouldn’t deliberately provoke them.
After reaching the Fifth Tribulation realm, I’m finally qualified to roam the outer realm freely.
As long as a Fifth Tribulation Eminence kept one of their true bodies in their homeworld, only an Eighth Tribulation Eminence could kill their true bodies across inhabited worlds. In fact, it was virtually impossible to find an Eighth Tribulation Eminence in the vast River of Spacetime. An existence like Ancestral Master Archean Eon had only encountered one in his life.
Therefore, from a life-preservation perspective, as long as a Fifth Tribulation Eminence had one body in their homeworld, they were virtually ‘unkillable.’ Therefore, even the strongest factions would treat a Fifth Tribulation Eminence seriously.
There was no need for him to become mortal enemies with a Fifth Tribulation Eminence for no reason.

chapters.title: Chapter 551 - Meng Chuan’s Rushes Over
chapters.content:
Chapter 551: Meng Chuan’s Rushes Over
Translator: CKtalon
Chaos Hole accretion disc.
The white-haired Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in the void. Pieces of Outer Realm Essence Crystals floated in front of him. The Outer Realm Essence Crystals slowly disintegrated, transforming into an extremely turbulent wave of outer realm essence energy, which surged into Meng Chuan’s body. After a long while, the nine Outer Realm Essence Crystals in front of him were completely devoured.
I spent 150 cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals. It’s about time. Meng Chuan opened his eyes.
After raising Infinite Saber to the perfected Heaven Earth realm, he had completely elevated his dantian, Quintessential Essence, and body to the perfected Imperial Lord realm.
Strictly speaking, he was just short of perfecting his body.
Meng Chuan looked at his left arm. One last tiny skin layer hadn’t been refined to the pinnacle. All I need is one more Outer Realm Essence Crystal to make up for the last flaw. I have a feeling that my body will be perfected once long as I resolve that flaw.
Although my true body in the outer realm devoured fewer Primordial Stones than my true body in my homeworld, it can still be perfected.
It was very difficult to attain a perfected body. Many Imperial Lords reached the perfected Heaven Earth realm, but they couldn’t reach the Tribulation realm because they couldn’t perfect their bodies.
However, it was very easy for an expert who had created an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique. This was because their self-created paramount techniques were perfect. With a paramount technique as one’s foundation for cultivating their body, one would definitely be able to reach the Tribulation realm.
If I miss the Imperial Lord realm, I’ll miss it forever. It’s best if I return to my homeworld once I reach the Primordial realm’s early stage. I’ll refine enough Primordial Stones before entering the Physical Body Tribulation Realm.
It was very easy for one to stall their progress in the Physical Body lineage deliberately. One just needed to stop improving their bodies.
Before returning home... The white-haired Meng Chuan looked into the distance. As a lifeform that was comparable to a Fifth Tribulation Eminence, he was extremely sensitive to karma. He could sense karmic threads affecting him.
Many of the karmic threads led back to Three Bay River System. However, two karmic threads led to his left.
I can sense the location. Based on the Spacetime Dominion Map, it’s within Ancient Magus River Zone’s Myriad Horn River System. Meng Chuan frowned slightly. Is Myriad Horn River System where Senior Pang Ming’s homeworld is?
Back when he obtained Senior Pang Ming’s treasures, a karmic connection between the two of them had formed.
After reaching the Tribulation realm, he had to recruit a Supremacy from Pang Ming Realm as his disciple and guide them to become an Imperial Lord.
This karma’s influence on me will only increase. Meng Chuan also realized this. He had cultivated for 1,500 years to date. His Infinite Saber had reached the perfected Heaven Earth realm.
Meng Chuan was no longer afraid of Saber of Nirvana’s influence on his mental state, so he continued cultivating it. However, he didn’t use it as a foundation for his body cultivation and Essence Soul cultivation. Saber of Nirvana had long reached the Heaven Earth realm’s late stage; it wasn’t far from the perfected Heaven Earth realm.
The karma didn’t significantly affect the two techniques for the time being because the path to attaining the perfected Heaven Earth realm was very clear.
However, Meng Chuan’s Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique had long reached the perfected Heaven Earth realm. He didn’t have a clear cultivation direction beyond that. All he could do was grope in the dark. The karmic interference also made his already unclear cultivation path even more uncertain. Nearly 1,000 years had passed since his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique had reached the perfected Heaven Earth realm.
Although he had attempted many directions to progress his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique, he didn’t manage to improve the technique qualitatively. In terms of profundity, the technique remained at the Third Tribulation realm.
Karma affects Tribulation Eminences greatly.
Infinite Saber and Saber of Nirvana have yet to reach the perfected Heaven Earth realm. However, their future paths after the perfected Heaven Earth realm also have to be deduced by groping in the darkness. In the future, they will also be at the mercy of karma. Meng Chuan understood this point and looked in the direction of Myriad Horn River System. I agreed to establish the karmic connection back then. As long as a Supremacy is born in Pang Ming Realm, they will naturally be connected to me by karma.
The two karmic threads were relatively weak. However, Meng Chuan’s order in life was high, which was why he could sense them clearly.
...
In the void beside the Chaos Hole, there was an ordinary cave abode on an asteroid. Supremacy Qing Gu was cultivating there.
Ever since Meng Chuan said he was going to the Chaos Hole to cultivate, Supremacy Qing Gu had been patiently waiting. While waiting over the years, he had observed the vast void, the Grand Yin Star, the Grand Yang Star, and the Chaos Hole. He also focused on his cultivation. He hoped to reach the Heaven Earth realm.
Whoosh.
As he sat cross-legged on the asteroid, Supremacy Qing Gu slowly exhaled. Green scales on his body flickered with a faint purple luster.
Oh? Supremacy Qing Gu suddenly glared and saw a white-haired man—Meng Chuan—appear in front of him. Supremacy Qing Gu could tell that the person in front of him was none other than Supremacy Eastcalm, whom he followed.
However...
Supremacy Qing Gu’s heart couldn’t help but tremble when he saw Supremacy Eastcalm; his legs also went limp. He felt an inexplicable fear. It was the same feeling he got when he saw a Tribulation Eminence on Black Dragon Planet. Furthermore, the invisible pressure and fear he felt was far stronger than when he saw any Tribulation Eminence on Black Dragon Planet.
After all, back on Black Dragon Planet, only Patriarch Black Dragon could match Meng Chuan. Supremacy Qing Gu had never seen Patriarch Black Dragon before.
“S-Senior,” stammered Supremacy Qing Gu. He no longer dared to address Meng Chuan as Brother Eastcalm.
Meng Chuan was slightly taken aback when he saw Supremacy Qing Gu.
Yes. He had cultivated in the Chaos Hole for more than 1,000 years, so he was used to not hiding his aura. Now that he saw Supremacy Qing Gu, he subconsciously didn’t think of hiding his true identity. However, he had frightened Supremacy Qing Gu.
A Primordial realm expert at the perfected Imperial Lord realm was comparable to a Fifth Tribulation realm expert. Due to this, the difference between Supremacy Qing Gu and Meng Chuan in life’s natural order was just too great—just looking at Meng Chuan’s 100,000-year lifespan alone was enough to see the difference. This caused fear to erupt in Supremacy Qing Gu.
The difference in level was too great.
Supremacy Qing Gu was instinctively horrified.
“Qing Gu,” said Meng Chuan, “I’ve already reached the Tribulation realm. I’m preparing to leave Heaven Peak River System. I’m also leaving Ancient Magus River Zone. Are you willing to follow me?”
“You’ve reached the Tribulation realm?” Supremacy Qing Gu was stunned. He had stayed in the void outside the Chaos Hole for more than 20 years, and the former Supremacy Eastcalm had already reached the Tribulation realm?
However, he didn’t know that those 20-plus years in the outside world had been over 1,000 years for Meng Chuan. Furthermore, he had experienced Emperor Roc and Eminence Xuan Fang’s—a Fourth Tribulation Eminence—attacks. When Emperor Roc and Eminence Xuan Fang came to the Chaos Hole, they didn’t pay any attention to the ordinary, ant-like Supremacy.
“Are you willing?” asked Meng Chuan again.
“Yes, of course. I’m willing to follow you, Senior” said Supremacy Qing Gu immediately. This was a rare opportunity, so he naturally had to seize it.
“Alright.” Meng Chuan nodded slightly and waved his hand to put Qing Gu into his grotto-heaven. Since they were fated, he was willing to bring Qing Gu along.
Since he was returning to Three Bay River System, he needed several subordinates to deal with some trivial matters.
Swoosh.
With a single step, Meng Chuan’s flying speed caused spatial fluctuations to appear. He maintained the spatial fluctuations for more than 30 seconds before completely entering them.
...
The River of Spacetime? Meng Chuan looked at the vast river in front of him.
To Meng Chuan, the River of Spacetime had completely changed. The stars and the inhabited worlds in the River of Spacetime had become extremely tiny. Every star and inhabited world were like particle cores. The surrounding void resembled a particle space. The particles revolved around the stars in the void like water droplets in the River of Spacetime.
Countless particles and countless droplets formed a vast river. It was a real river!
Meng Chuan could clearly see over ten wide water streams. As the water surged, many obstacles obstructed the river flow.
On my left, I can see the end. Meng Chuan looked into the distance. On his left, he could see seven streams. Further away, it was pitch-black. On his right, he could vaguely see eight streams. There were even more distributaries even further away, but he could not see them clearly.
According to the Spacetime Dominion Map left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon, I should see a total of 26 spacetime distributaries. Meng Chuan was very clear on this. Every distributary is a river system.
The 26 river systems were relatively close.
As long as one flew further, they would be able to see other river systems.
Countless river systems were scattered everywhere.
Boom!
At Meng Chuan’s current realm, he was already at an extremely profound level in the River of Spacetime. The countless water droplets in the River of Spacetime were extremely dense. The resistance was extremely great, and he couldn’t fly. He could only walk step by step as he traversed the river.
He walked step by step.
After he grasped the paramount speed laws, his speed far exceeded other Fifth Tribulation Eminences. With each step, his body phased away, allowing him to travel a great distance.
...
“That is?”
Many cultivators flew through the River of Spacetime. They saw a towering figure; it was a white-haired man. His eyes were thousands of times larger than Grand Yang Stars and Grand Yin Stars.
The countless stars at his feet were so tiny that he couldn’t see them clearly. With a single step, he traveled an extremely far distance. Furthermore, his figure was blurry. Every time he phased into being again, he would already be at the limits of the ordinary cultivators’ vision. With another step, he completely vanished.
“Who is that?”
“Which Tribulation Eminence is it?”
Meng Chuan only took a few steps before passing by over 100 cultivators.
The higher one’s order in life was, the larger their body would be in the River of Spacetime. Meng Chuan was a lifeform at the Fifth Tribulation realm.
...
He traversed the River of Spacetime step by step. Every step he took blurred his body. In about two hours, Meng Chuan crossed 11 river systems and arrived at his destination—Senior Pang Ming’s homeworld, Myriad Horn River System.

chapters.title: Chapter 552 - Disciple Recruitment
chapters.content:
Chapter 552: Disciple Recruitment
After arriving at Myriad Horn River System, Meng Chuan’s perception of the two karmic threads became clearer.
There are two sources of karma; one is closer to me, while the other is in Pang Ming Realm. Meng Chuan had completely locked onto the two cultivators who had karmic ties with him.
Pang Ming Realm was also an inhabited world. He couldn’t enter it.
Meng Chuan walked step by step in the River of Spacetime. He didn’t hesitate to head towards the one closest to him. After five minutes, Meng Chuan arrived at his destination. He no longer resisted the River of Spacetime’s repulsive force and returned to the normal void.
Huh? In the dark outer realm void, Meng Chuan saw a relatively weak Grand Yang Star in the distance. The Grand Yin Star’s light was completely concealed. There were other stars around him.
It’s right there. Meng Chuan’s speed soared, easily reaching near-light speed. Furthermore, the time flow around him accelerated by 100-fold.
It was very easy to travel in this state. To reach light speed and escape time’s shackles while maintaining the stillness of time was too burdensome for him.
Whoosh.
Even while going at terrifying speeds, he traveled with ease. He traversed tens of millions of kilometers in a second.
In a few minutes, he arrived at the Grand Yin Star.
A Grand Yin Star. Meng Chuan looked at the massive Grand Yin Star in front of him and smiled. A cultivator who had karmic ties with him was on the Grand Yin Star.
...
Unlike blazing Grand Yang Stars, Grand Yin Stars were much more restrained and mild. Although a Grand Yin Star’s deepest depths were no less terrifying than a Grand Yang Star’s, Grand Yin Stars didn’t seem dangerous on the surface. Thus, it was very suitable for cultivators to build cave abodes on Grand Yin Stars.
Cultivators knew that there were many cave abode ruins on Grand Yin Stars. However, there were billions of Grand Yin Stars in a river system! Trying to find an ancient cave abode on Grand Yin Stars was like finding a needle in a haystack.
“Be careful.”
“Duck!”
“Duck!”
A group of cultivators was exploring a cave abode—which was enveloped by an array formation—on the Grand Yin Star. They were frantically dodging attacks.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
One saber beam after another swept across the area. A gray-robed female Supremacy was one step slower and was reduced to dust by the saber beam. The other seven Supremacies used various methods to dodge the saber beams desperately.
“Granny Kui.” A red-haired elder couldn’t help but feel extremely pained when he saw the gray-robed woman turn to dust.
The other cultivators continued to probe the area carefully. After the saber beams swept past them, the surroundings returned to normal. Only then did they heave a sigh of relief.
“Brother Zhang, since we are here to explore this cave abode, we were prepared to die. My condolences,” said the muscular leader with two curved horns. At the same time, he waved his hand and swept the treasures left behind by the female gray-robed Supremacy to the red-haired elder’s side. The red-haired elder and the gray-robed Supremacy were husband and wife. Their other companions wouldn’t go so far as to snatch the items left behind by Granny Kui.
The red-haired elder’s eyes turned red as he nodded slightly. “I understand. This cave abode is like what is recorded in the treasure map. It’s already our luck that it’s true. We found the cave abode, but we didn’t have the ability to obtain the treasures inside. We can only blame our lack of strength if we die in the cave abode.”
The other companions had mixed emotions.
“We came as a group of 12, but only seven of us are left.” The horned man—who was the leader of the group—swept his gaze around. “We are getting closer and closer to the cave abode’s core. Everyone, be careful. Either we make it big, or we die here. We have to seize this opportunity.”
The cultivators were determined.
Supremacies were the weakest cultivators in the vast outer realm. They did not have any spare true bodies in their homeworld. They roamed the outer realm with their only true bodies. If they died, that was it.
They were weak. Most of them came from low-level worlds. They were the only Supremacies in their homeworld.
Follow experts? Experts didn’t think highly of them.
Find cave abode ruins? The outer realm was vast. Where could they find one?
This expedition team was already very lucky to have found a cave abode. However, although they had found the ancient cave abode, many Supremacies died inside. Those who could obtain the treasures within a cave abode were either strong or lucky.
Among the seven cultivators, a tall, muscular man walked carefully with his spear in hand. I, Gao Fang, was invincible in my world. I united the world and established a dynasty. I even mastered Ancestral Master Pang Ming’s ultimate techniques. However, when I came to the outer realm, I ended up lining the outer realm’s bottom with all the other Supremacies. My homeworld is also a low-level world.
As a Supremacy, I can only obtain one of Senior Pang Ming’s treasures, a Third Tribulation treasure. Gao Fang only realized how vast the world was when he came to the outer realm.
Senior Pang Ming was a Fifth Tribulation Eminence. He had indeed left behind treasures for his homeworld. However, every Supremacy in his homeworld could only obtain up to 20 Outer Realm Essence Crystals worth of treasures. After all, Senior Pang Ming didn’t leave much for his homeworld—a total of 20,000 cubes. Some were prepared for Imperial Lords and Tribulation Eminences, so not much was left for Supremacies.
Twenty Outer Realm Essence Crystals? Although such an amount seemed quite significant for a Supremacy, they remained poor. Gao Fang’s spear was one of the treasures Senior Pang Ming had left for his homeworld. It was a Third Tribulation spear that was most suitable for his cultivation.
With this spear and the ultimate technique he cultivated, Gao Fang had the strength of a threshold Imperial Lord even though he was considered a bottom-feeder Supremacy in the outer realm. At the very least, he was ranked in this team’s top three.
I came to the outer realm with great ambitions, but after struggling for 300 years in the outer realm, my greatest resource is still the treasure Senior Pang Ming bestowed me. As for the treasures in this cave abode... it’s my opportunity. I definitely have to seize this opportunity. Gao Fang had struggled for too long. He had to grasp onto this sliver of hope, even if he had to risk his life.
The exploration team continued forward.
Although they encountered danger two more times—which were extremely harrowing experiences—none of them had died.
“We have already arrived at the cave abode’s core region. The surrounding array formations are clearly much denser,” said a cyan-haired woman. She carefully observed the array formation. She was the best at array formations in the team.
“What do we do next?” asked the curved-horned man. His companions, including Gao Fang, looked at the cyan-haired woman.
The cyan-haired woman carefully inspected the array formation. After a while, she tapped her finger slightly. Wisps of threads seeped into the array formation. Just as she was carefully probing the array formation, she touched a hidden node in the array formation. After all, it was very difficult for Supremacies to probe a Tribulation Eminence’s cave abode’s array formation. Back then, Meng Chuan had relied on his seventh-level Essence Soul and his Essence Soul Star’s recovery speed to crack Eminence Pang Ming’s cave abode’s array formation.
“Not good.” The cyan-haired woman’s expression changed drastically.
Boom!
The array formation erupted as a huge palm appeared in the sky, enveloping the entire region. The seven cultivators in the team looked up at the gigantic palm in horror.
“Not good. The surrounding void has been sealed.”
“We can’t escape.”
“We will be reduced to meat paste.”
The team couldn’t be bothered to blame the cyan-haired woman as they frantically rushed out of the region. Gao Fang brandished his spear and stabbed forward with all his might.
However, the void prison was like a cage that completely trapped the intruders. The Supremacies were unable to escape the void prison as they watched the gigantic palm descend.
“We won’t be able to turn into meat paste. We will probably be reduced to dust. There won’t be any traces of our bodies left.”
“We’re doomed.”
“Forget it.” Gao Fang lowered his spear and faced his fate—death in this cave abode ruins—calmly.
At this moment—
Rumble...
A vast painting world descended and enveloped the cave abode. This ancient cave abode ruin seemed to be just a tiny portion of the massive painting world. As for the gigantic palm formed by the array formation’s power, it instantly shattered.
In the middle of the painting world, a white-haired man appeared. He stood in midair and looked down.
He arrived ten minutes ago and had observed Gao Fang for a while. After all, he wanted to see his disciple’s temperament. He only took action when the other party was in a dire situation.
Huh? Gao Fang and the other six cultivators watched this scene in shock.
As they watched the vast world descend and the white-haired man appear in the sky, the invisible pressure caused the cultivators to feel fear instinctively. This was the most terrifying expert they had encountered in their lives.
Boom!
The cave abode ruins were uprooted and rapidly shrank before landing in the white-haired man’s palm.
It should be a cave abode of a Third or Fourth Tribulation Eminence, guessed Meng Chuan before putting it away.
“Thank you, Senior.”
“Thank you for saving my life, Senior.”
The seven cultivators knelt respectfully. They even had hints of desire in their eyes. As long as they could follow such a Tribulation Eminence, it would be a great opportunity to be his subordinate.
Meng Chuan’s gaze landed on Gao Fang.
Gao Fang could also sense the senior’s gaze. He couldn’t help but feel nervous and excited.
Whoosh—
Gao Fang felt the scenery in front of him change; he found himself standing on a vast grassland. In front of him was a white-haired man.
Only Meng Chuan and Gao Fang existed in this world.
Gao Fang looked around in shock. Where is this place?
“What’s your name?” asked Meng Chuan with a smile.
“I’m Gao Fang.” Gao Fang hurriedly bowed respectfully.
“You’re from Pang Ming Realm, right?” asked Meng Chuan.
Gao Fang was shocked. He had received strict orders that Supremacies from Pang Ming Realm had to hide their identities for 200,000 years after Ancestral Master Pang Ming died.
“Senior, do you have a grudge with our Ancestral Master?” Gao Fang’s heart palpitated. Ancestral Master Pang Ming had powerful enemies, so he needed to hide his identity.
Now that Gao Fang had been captured, the other party was definitely confident about Gao Fang’s background since he mentioned Pang Ming Realm directly.
“No.” Meng Chuan shook his head. “I owe your Ancestral Master a favor, so I specially came to recruit you as my disciple.”
“Recruit me as a disciple?” Gao Fang felt his head buzzing. He had struggled in the outer realm for 300 years.
I, Gao Fang, am finally going to soar?

chapters.title: Chapter 553 - Zhao Hongxiu
chapters.content:
Chapter 553: Zhao Hongxiu
Clang!
Gao Fang immediately knelt and smashed his head on the ground. He shouted loudly, “Greetings, Master.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. “Very good.”
Following that, the illusory world collapsed.
Gao Fang was in a daze. He was still kneeling on the Grand Yin Star with his six companions.
“Gao Fang, follow me.” Meng Chuan waved his hand; Gao Fang didn’t resist at all. He was sent into a grotto-heaven.
Swoosh.
Following that, Meng Chuan took a step and vanished.
The six remaining cultivators exchanged looks.
“That Eminence actually took Brother Gao Fang away.”
“Unfortunately, he didn’t fancy us.”
The six Supremacies were filled with mixed emotions. It was already a great blessing for an Eminence to save them from the dire situation. They didn’t dare hope for the mighty figure to take them away. However, with one taken away, the remaining six naturally felt discomfort.
Envy and jealousy surged in their hearts.
“That Eminence might have taken away the cave abode, but he may have also left something behind. Let’s search carefully,” said the horned man.
“Search carefully again.”
The six Supremacies continued their search on the Grand Yin Star. In the next month, they did indeed find something. After all, the cave abode owner had lived here in seclusion for a long time. The Grand Yin Star was very vast. Many places had been the Eminence’s experimentation grounds for his techniques. Many other residences were also scattered around the star.
...
Meng Chuan entered the River of Spacetime again and arrived at Pang Ming Realm.
Whoosh.
Returning to the ordinary outer realm void, Meng Chuan looked at the inhabited world in front of him. Pang Ming Realm was about 15,000 kilometers in diameter. With the spacetime laws’ restrictions, Meng Chuan couldn’t enter it.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan waved his hand, and Gao Fang appeared beside him.
“Master.” Gao Fang was somewhat puzzled. After being stored in the grotto-heaven for a moment, he had been talking with Supremacy Qing Gu. He was halfway through his conversation with Supremacy Qing Gu when he suddenly was thrown out.
“This is Pang Ming Realm, right?” Meng Chuan pointed at the inhabited world in front of him.
“That is Pang Ming Realm, my homeworld,” replied Gao Fang respectfully. He glanced at Pang Ming Realm and was secretly astonished.
His master was too fast. He knew that it would take him over 30 years to return to his homeworld from the Grand Yin Star through the River of Spacetime.
As for his master? He arrived in the time it took to exchange a few words.
“There should be another Supremacy in your Pang Ming Realm,” said Meng Chuan.
Gao Fang looked at Meng Chuan in shock and nodded. “Master is wise. There is indeed another Supremacy in Pang Ming Realm.”
“Tell me about that Supremacy,” instructed Meng Chuan.
“Yes.” Gao Fang felt mixed emotions.
There were two Supremacies in Pang Ming Realm. He had had some conflict with that person. They weren’t enemies, but they weren’t friends either.
“She’s a female Supremacy,” said Gao Fang respectfully. “Her name is Zhao Hongxiu. She’s the strongest assassin in Pang Ming Realm. She’s good at archery.”
“Archery?” Meng Chuan raised his eyebrows. He couldn’t help but feel an affinity towards her.
His wife, Liu Qiyue, was also skilled in archery. Very few outer realm cultivators used bows and arrows.
“Zhao Hongxiu’s personality is rather special.” Gao Fang hesitated for a moment and said, “In the early days, she was a member of an assassin organization. Later, she betrayed the assassin organization, which then pursued her... In the end, the entire assassin organization was destroyed because of this. She did everything according to her wishes. She hated corrupt officials the most. She even infiltrated the capital and killed the ministers under me.
“I’ve been cultivating for longer than her—800 years,” explained Gao Fang. “After I became a Supremacy, I unified the world and established the Great Xuan Dynasty. The Great Xuan Dynasty has been in existence for more than 600 years. Zhao Hongxiu has only cultivated for 300 years. When she grew in strength, the Great Xuan Dynasty was also helmed by my descendant as emperor. She ignored the Imperial Court and did whatever she wanted, causing me to fight her.
“She grew in strength extremely quickly. With the Zhao family’s archery technique as her foundation, she improved an ordinary archery technique to the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm. I fought her three times. In the beginning, I didn’t want her talent to go to waste. Furthermore, she and I were the only two Supremacies in the world. Therefore, I let her off for the first time and never pursued her.
“The second time, she managed to escape from me. The third time, I returned from the outer realm. When I saw her again, her strength was in no way inferior to mine,” said Gao Fang.
Meng Chuan was somewhat surprised.
He could tell at a glance that this disciple of his, Gao Fang, had an extremely powerful body. From his performance in the cave abode, he had at least cultivated three spear arts to the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm. He was considered extremely powerful among the outer realm Supremacies.
Zhao Hongxiu, who was just a sharpshooter, wasn’t inferior to him? Sharpshooters were extremely powerful when it came to offense, but they were typically weaker in other aspects. Meng Chuan was rather happy about Zhao Hongxiu’s talent—which allowed her to match Gao Fang despite cultivating for over 300 years only.
The higher one’s talent was, the higher their chances of becoming an Imperial Lord.
Meng Chuan smiled and nodded. “Gao Fang, make a trip to Pang Ming Realm and bring her out.”
“Master, you wish to accept her as your disciple?” asked Gao Fang.
Meng Chuan nodded.
“Zhao Hongxiu’s personality is different from mine,” said Gao Fang carefully. “After she reached the perfected Supremacy realm, she once went to the outer realm for decades. Later, she was disappointed with the outer realm. She returned to our homeworld and lived in seclusion for a long time. She is willing to live a peaceful life. I am not confident in successfully persuading her.”
“Go and give it a try,” instructed Meng Chuan. “Just do your best.”
“Yes.” Gao Fang’s heart trembled.
His master was clearly warning him not to play any tricks when he told him to ‘do his best.’
For example, he could enter Pang Ming Realm and not meet Zhao Hongxiu before coming back out to tell him that Zhao Hongxiu was disagreeable.
Master is willing to accept me as his disciple. I should be more careful, Gao Fang thought to himself. I shouldn’t anger Master. He can kill me with a flip of his hand; offending him won’t be worth it. Forget it. We are ultimately cultivators from Pang Ming Realm. I’ll give Zhao Hongxiu this great opportunity.
...
Gao Fang entered Pang Ming Realm, his homeworld.
Swoosh.
He flew at a high altitude before arriving above a mansion in a bustling city—Zhao Manor.
This mansion spanned more than five kilometers. It could be said to be a city in a city. The Zhao family had once been a large family clan in Pang Ming Realm, but it gradually declined. Zhao Hongxiu had found herself entering an assassin organization when she was young. However, she mainly cultivated the Zhao family’s archery technique after she rose to prominence. Furthermore, she improved the archery technique to an astonishingly high level.
Zhao Hongxiu reconstructed Zhao Manor and restored it to its golden era in history. In fact, during the most prosperous period in history, the Zhao family was still a step away from reaching the Supremacy realm. Now, the Zhao family was enjoying its most glorious period.
However, the Zhao family had very few direct descendants. In particular, there were very few people in this ancestral mansion. The clansmen of the branch families lived elsewhere.
“Oh?” Zhao Hongxiu sat cross-legged under a plum blossom tree. Snowflakes fluttered, and the fragrance of the plum blossoms filled the air. Zhao Hongxiu enjoyed peace and quiet. There were only about ten direct descendants in this manor, which spanned more than five kilometers. There were only about 100 servants. There was no one else within half a kilometer of Zhao Hongxiu. There were only some cats and dogs.
Zhao Hongxiu looked up.
A tall and muscular Gao Fang appeared in the sky. In a flash, he appeared on the snow. He looked at Zhao Hongxiu.
Zhao Hongxiu was still sitting cross-legged. She was dressed in a white outer robe and a red inner robe. Her eyes were long and narrow as she looked at Gao Fang. “How rare of you to drop by. You actually came back from the outer realm?”
They were two extremes.
Gao Fang was very well-rounded. Including the ultimate techniques that aided his physical cultivation, he had cultivated five ultimate techniques to the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm. He wanted to accumulate more insights so that he could reach the Heaven Earth realm.
Zhao Hongxiu’s focus was on archery. Strictly speaking, the Zhao family’s archery technique was something she had created. Ignoring the most important Supremacy-level portions, she had also modified the basic parts from before. She had created a perfected Grotto-Heaven realm archery technique. She naturally had extremely high combat strength.
“Zhao Hongxiu.” Gao Fang stood there and said coldly, “I met a Tribulation Eminence in the outer realm. This Tribulation Eminence has ties with Ancestral Master Pang Ming, so he’s willing to accept me as his disciple. He also knows that Pang Ming Realm has another Supremacy... and he’s willing to accept you as his disciple as well.”
“A Tribulation Eminence is willing to accept me as his disciple?” Zhao Hongxiu revealed a look of surprise.
“Yes.” Gao Fang said indifferently, “You can reject it; no one will force you. By the way, once you become an Eminence’s disciple, you will have to follow the mighty figure to a distant river zone. I’m afraid you won’t be able to return for a long time. Zhao Hongxiu, do you agree or not?”
Zhao Hongxiu smiled brightly. Her smile was even more beautiful than the winter’s plum blossoms beside her. “Of course I’m willing. Such an opportunity is most welcome!”
...
In the outer realm, Meng Chuan looked at Pang Ming Realm, which was in front of him.
After I recruit my disciples, I should return to Three Bay River System. Meng Chuan’s mind was already on his distant homeworld. That was the place he wanted to set up his base.

chapters.title: Chapter 554 - Returning Home
chapters.content:
Chapter 554: Returning Home
Zhao Hongxiu didn’t hesitate to choose to become an Eminence’s disciple. When Gao Fang saw this, he could only frown and say, “I’ll give you ten minutes. Hurry up and make your arrangements. Then, leave with me to meet Master.”
After Zhao Hongxiu stood up, she sent a voice transmission to a subordinate.
“It’s done. Let’s go.” Zhao Hongxiu was straightforward.
Gao Fang immediately soared into the sky, and Zhao Hongxiu followed.
Pang Ming Reaml’s two most dazzling Supremacies silently left Pang Ming Realm and headed to the outer realm to follow Meng Chuan, a Tribulation Eminence.
...
“Master, Zhao Hongxiu is here.” Gao Fang flew to Meng Chuan and bowed respectfully.
Zhao Hongxiu instinctively felt fear when she saw the white-haired man standing in the void. This shocked Zhao Hongxiu. She had seen more than one Tribulation Eminence when she went to the outer realm’s trading grounds. However, none of them could exert this mysterious master’s terrifying pressure.
“Greetings Master, I’m Zhao Hongxiu.” Zhao Hongxiu knelt in the void and was extremely respectful.
It was already a huge blessing for a Supremacy to become a Tribulation Eminence’s disciple.
Meng Chuan looked at her and nodded slightly. “My name is Eastcalm. From today onwards, Gao Fang is your senior brother. You will be his junior sister.”
“Yes,” said Zhao Hongxiu respectfully.
“I’ll bring the two of you to my homeworld’s Three Bay River System, which is in the Goddess River Zone. It’s very far away from here,” said Meng Chuan indifferently. “I can send you back if you want to return in the future, but I can only send you back once.”
“Okay.”
“Okay.” Gao Fang and Zhao Hongxiu replied obediently.
The two of them had already done everything they could in the secular world. They didn’t have much attachment to it. Now, they wanted to have great accomplishments in cultivation.
How could they miss out on such a great opportunity of having an Eminence as their master? It was a dream come true.
For example, Emperor Roc was a mighty Third Tribulation Eminence, yet he became one of Palace Lord Snowjade’s followers. Firstly, it was to be protected by him. Secondly, he hoped that Palace Lord Snowjade would occasionally give him some pointers. To become his disciple? Palace Lord Snowjade thought little of him. The higher one’s status was, the more cautious they would be when recruiting disciples.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan waved his hand and stored the two of them into his grotto-heaven treasure. Soon, he entered the River of Spacetime and headed for his homeworld.
...
A towering white-haired man walked through the River of Spacetime.
As a Fifth Tribulation Eminence who had grasped paramount speed laws, he could be said to be the fastest among Fifth Tribulation Eminences. At the very least, he was comparable to a Sixth Tribulation Eminence when it came to traveling through the River of Spacetime.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan stepped through the endless darkness and arrived at a river zone.
If river systems were distributaries, then river zones were vast drainage basins. There were many obstacles between the different zones. Only Tribulation Eminences could break through these obstacles and reach another river zone.
On the third day after leaving Heaven Peak River System, Meng Chuan arrived at the Goddess River Zone.
Goddess River Zone.
Meng Chuan crossed the endless darkness and looked at the massive river zone formed by countless distributaries.
This basin was the Goddess River Zone, his homeworld’s river zone.
Goddess River Zone...
This basin was given this name because a female Eminence had descended to Goddess River Zone and lectured here billions of years ago. This female Eminence was an Eighth Tribulation Eminence! Therefore, the cultivators in the River of Spacetime called this zone ‘Goddess River Zone.’
Ancestral Master Archean Eon had investigated the matter, but he failed to find out who the female Eminence was. He only knew that she was an Eighth Tribulation Eminence from the marks left behind by her during the lectures.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Meng Chuan walked through the River of Spacetime. After another hour, he finally arrived at Three Bay River System.
I’m home.
Meng Chuan had already arrived at Archean Eon Realm.
There were two inhabited worlds in this area. One was about 50,000 kilometers in diameter, while the other was about 150,000 kilometers in diameter. They looked like binary planets.
Meng Chuan glanced at the Demon Realm.
He immediately split out an Essence Soul avatar.
Swoosh! Swoosh!
The Essence Soul avatar left quickly with some treasures, including the grotto-heaven treasure that Gao Fang, Zhao Hongxiu, and Supremacy Qing Gu was inside. After becoming an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars could roam the universe freely. They could also absorb energy from the outside world to survive.
His true body flew into Archean Eon Realm.
...
I’m finally back.
His outer realm true body silently arrived at Archean Mountain and came to Heaven and Earth Great Hall to meet his true body that resided in his homeworld.
I need to choose suitable treasures if I want to establish myself as a strong force in Three Bay River System.
Suitable Tribulation treasures would allow him to unleash greater strength.
With his strength at the Fifth Tribulation realm, he could take up to 300,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals worth of treasures from Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasure vault. That was indeed a lot. As long as he wasn’t greedy, he would have enough resources to break through to the Sixth Tribulation realm. It would be even easier if he only used his quota to strengthen himself.
I’ll absorb Primordial Stones first.
Meng Chuan didn’t think further. He entered a chamber and began absorbing Primordial Stones. He raised his Primordial realm (Imperial Lord realm) body to a higher level.
...
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar carried many treasures and rushed to a mysterious place in Three Bay River System.
This is it.
The black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan stood there. Although he was only an Essence Soul avatar, his Essence Soul avatar’s combat strength was in no way inferior to his true bodies’.
This was an advantage unique to Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences.
This is the Thousand Mountain Star recorded in Ancestral Master’s dossiers in the treasure vault?
Meng Chuan used the distant stars as references and nodded slightly.
The location is correct. Even after more than a million years, there won’t be many changes to a Grand Yang Star and Grand Yin Star’s positions.
Thousand Mountain Star was an outer realm encampment built by one of Three Bay River System’s Sixth Tribulation Eminences in history.
Although Sixth Tribulation Eminences were extremely rare, Three Bay River System had a long history. It had even given birth to one Seventh Tribulation Eminence; therefore, it was only natural that hundreds of Sixth Tribulation Eminences rose to prominence here. Of course, they passed away over time.
Almost all these Tribulation Eminences had established an outer realm cultivation base.
Some carried their bases with them. For example, Palace Lord Snowjade’s Snow Mountain was a Tribulation treasure. It could be shrunk and brought along. The owner could go anywhere with the cave abode on his body. Even if he was close to the end of his lifespan, he could send it back to his homeworld first.
As for Black Dragon Planet, it wasn’t a Tribulation treasure. It couldn’t be brought into an inhabited world; it could only stay in the outer realm.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon discovered more than ten well-hidden bases in Three Bay River System. This Thousand Mountain Star is one of them. The array formation set up is mainly based on the time lineage laws. It’s quite suitable for me.
The black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan stood in the void. His accomplishments in the time lineage far exceeded his accomplishments in the void lineage.
Whoosh!
With a thought, the painting world appeared and enveloped the surrounding 1.5 million-kilometer void.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World had the best reconnaissance ability. Within the Essence Soul World, Meng Chuan was lord of the world. Nothing could escape his detection.
Found it.
The black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan smiled.
A hidden star appeared in the void. This was a star with a diameter of 1.95 million kilometers. There were many mountains on the star. Every mountain was part of an array formation. At the same time, he could see a majestic city that was ten times larger than Black Dragon Planet’s Black Dragon City. The buildings were all extraordinary.
At a glance, the entire star seemed to twist and distort, as though it was illusory and unreal.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan’s Power of Essence Soul rapidly seeped into the star.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon had recorded the method of cracking these bases’ array formations in a dossier. Once one was at a particular realm, one would be able to crack these array formations after some time. Having chosen this base, Meng Chuan naturally had the confidence to crack it.
It took him two days.
Rumble!
The entire Thousand Mountain Star trembled as the mountains and cities emitted light.
It’s finally been cracked. That array formation is really complicated.
