Meng Chuan heaved a sigh of relief and smiled. He immediately transformed into a stream of light and flew into Thousand Mountain Star.
Although he had control over Thousand Mountain Star’s array formation, he still needed to make some changes so that it matched his preferences. He needed time to refine and control all the array formations completely.
His true body that usually resided in his homeworld was very safe. On the contrary, it was easy for his base in the outer realm to be attacked. It required more effort and thought.
...
Half a year after Meng Chuan returned to Three Bay River System.
Three Bay River System, Snowjade Palace.
“Palace Lord.” A green toad, Emperor Roc, a snake-tailed woman, a golden-haired man, and others—a total of nine Tribulation Eminences—bowed respectfully.
Standing in front of the palace was a light-blue-robed man. His skin was crystalline, like jade, and his face was covered in light-blue mystic runes. There was a soft feeler on both sides of his forehead. He was Palace Lord Snowjade, Three Bay River System’s strongest expert! He was a rather famous expert in the entire Goddess River Zone.
Palace Lord Snowjade looked into the distance and said softly, “It’s time. Follow me.”
“Yes,” responded the nine Tribulation Eminences in unison.
They knew that their lord was plotting something important. They had long been waiting for orders in Snowjade Palace.
Swoosh.
Snowjade extended his hand, and the towering snow mountain rapidly shrank before flying into his palm. The nine subordinates didn’t resist at all as they were stored in his cave abode.
Following that, he left Three Bay River System through the River of Spacetime.
...
Oh?
Meng Chuan had three Essence Soul avatars spread across Thousand Mountain Star. They were busy refining and modifying the array formations.
The refinement and modification process was also a form of cultivation.
At that moment, the three Essence Soul avatars looked at Snowjade Palace from afar. Through karma, Meng Chuan could sense that Emperor Roc was rapidly moving.
Emperor Roc left Snowjade Palace?
Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up, but he was puzzled.
However, it shouldn’t be capable of traveling so quickly.

chapters.title: Chapter 555 - The Fifth Essence Soul Tribulation
chapters.content:
Chapter 555: The Fifth Essence Soul Tribulation
The demon invasion had brought too much harm to humanity.
Meng Chuan naturally wanted to kill Emperor Roc, Imperial Lord Starquix, and Lady Blackmoon. Among the trio, Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon were very easy to kill. On the contrary, Emperor Roc was the most difficult to deal with. Meng Chuan had decided on how he planned on targeting Emperor Roc.
Emperor Roc left Heaven Peak River System and returned to Three Bay River System. That took it about a year. It mainly relied on its Golden-Winged Roc bloodline. It’s very difficult to break through the limits of one’s talent. Even if it breaks through to the Fourth Tribulation realm, its speed will be at most five times faster. However, it’s now ten times faster. It’s likely that Palace Lord Snowjade is traveling with it in tow.
Meng Chuan made a judgment.
I’ll continue cultivating. I’ll take action when I reach the Essence Soul Fifth Tribulation realm.
Meng Chuan continued refining and modifying Thousand Mountain Star’s array formations.
His spiritual cultivation and technique realm were already adequate, but the fifth Essence Soul Tribulation never descended.
He was afraid that the Essence Soul Tribulation would descend when he was dealing with Emperor Roc or when he was in a dire situation. That would be bad.
Therefore, he had to wait!
...
Time passed. In the blink of an eye, a year and a half had passed since he returned to his homeworld, which was in Three Bay River System.
There were also Chaos Holes in Three Bay River System. Meng Chuan chose a super-large Chaos Hole as his long-term training ground. He wholly viewed the Chaos Hole’s influence on his mind as a form of cultivation.
Huh?
Meng Chuan, who was sitting cross-legged in the Chaos Hole’s depths, suddenly sensed that a Heavenly Tribulation was about to descend in three seconds.
He immediately took a step.
Time stopped.
Meng Chuan flew rapidly at this moment. The Heavenly Tribulation paused temporarily as he quickly arrived outside the Chaos Hole.
He threw out Fiend Prison and hid inside. As for Fiend Prison, it vanished from the outside world.
Come on.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged inside Fiend Prison as time began flowing again.
After returning to his homeworld for more than a year, he cultivated in Archean Eon Realm and the Chaos Hole. Over 80 years had passed overall. During these 80-plus years, Meng Chuan had passed the first three Physical Body Tribulations! Each Tribulation descended one year apart—which was the shortest amount of time possible. The fourth Physical Body tribulation would happen 20 years later at the earliest.
In fact, transcending the first three Physical Body Tribulations didn’t boost Meng Chuan’s strength much.
When he was at the perfected Primordial realm (Imperial Lord realm), he was already comparable to a Fifth Tribulation Eminence. Transcending the first three tribulations in a row didn’t increase his body’s strength by much. His overall strength had increased by less than 10%.
Boom!
The fifth Essence Soul Tribulation descended.
The body in his homeworld, the Essence Soul avatars guarding the demon sage passageway, the body in the outer realm, and the Essence Soul avatars on Thousand Mountain Star all suffered the Essence Soul Tribulation.
Meng Chuan was still confident if it were the fifth Physical Body Tribulation. This was because Physical Body Tribulations only tested one’s body! With an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique as his foundation, he could definitely withstand the fifth Physical Body Tribulation. However, Meng Chuan wasn’t confident transcending the fifth Essence Soul Tribulation.
This was because Essence Soul Tribulations tested one’s mind and spirit!
It was hard to tell whether one could pass tests of one’s mind. Even if he believed that his mind and spiritual cultivation level was sufficiently high, it didn’t mean that he could withstand the Essence Soul Tribulation.
Among Tribulation Eminences, quite a number of Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences were at the First and Second Tribulation realm. However, the further one progressed, the lower the number of Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences became. For example, about eight in ten Sixth Tribulation Eminences were Physical Body Tribulation Eminences.
The fifth Essence Soul Tribulation is descending.
Meng Chuan waited. He had made ample preparations for this tribulation. He spared no expense in refining a World Treasure. World Treasures were unique to Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences.
This was because one’s Essence Soul World descended from an illusion. World Treasures could make one’s Essence Soul World more ‘real.’ With a World Treasure, one’s Essence Soul World’s might would increase by several-fold. One’s overall strength would naturally increase in all aspects.
Whoosh.
In Meng Chuan’s sea of consciousness, a painting canvas floated in the air. Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul sat cross-legged on the canvas.
This painting canvas was a World Treasure.
Boom!
The Essence Soul Tribulation descended upon Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul directly.
The painting canvas was one with Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul. It also blocked the Essence Soul Tribulation, reducing its might.
...
Archean Mountain, Grotto-Heaven Pavilion.
“Meng Chuan, Meng Chuan.” Qin Wu came to the backyard in delight, but he didn’t see Meng Chuan. This puzzled Qin Wu.
Where is he?
Creak.
A door in the distance opened, and Meng Chuan walked out.
“Meng Chuan.” Qin Wu smiled as he walked over, but his smile gradually disappeared. He looked at Meng Chuan solemnly.
At that moment, Meng Chuan’s eyes were filled with fatigue. He forced a smile onto his face. “I just transcended the fifth Essence Soul Tribulation.”
“The fifth Essence Soul Tribulation?” Qin Wu was astonished. “You have reached the Essence Soul Fifth Tribulation realm?”
“I originally thought that I was sufficiently prepared. My spiritual cultivation wasn’t bad, but I still suffered greatly,” said Meng Chuan self-deprecatingly.
“What did you encounter during your Essence Soul Tribulation?” asked Qin Wu.
According to the sect’s records, every person’s Essence Soul Tribulations were different. The Heavenly Tribulations targeted the cultivator’s mental weaknesses. The further one progressed, the more terrifying the tribulations became. Not to mention the fact that an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence’s Heavenly Tribulation couldn’t be delayed. This caused the number of strong Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences to be fewer than Physical Body Tribulation Eminences.
“What did I encounter?” said Meng Chuan softly. “Nothing.”
“Nothing?” Qin Wu was puzzled.
“My consciousness entered emptiness,” said Meng Chuan. “There was nothing. I couldn’t see or hear anything. Nor could I sense any profound laws. I only know that a long, long time passed. Was it a million years? A hundred million years? It could’ve been even longer. I don’t know how long it was.”
Meng Chuan’s eyes were filled with fatigue.
He had experienced many hardships since he was a child; his heart had been tempered to the point that it was as sharp as a blade. It could slice through all obstacles, to the point that he could shrug off the Chaos Hole’s influence on his mental state.
However, time was a different beast...
Everything gradually turned to emptiness in the face of time.
In his infinitely-long solitude, Meng Chuan could only constantly recall the moving scenes he saw during his life. He thought of his father, mother, and wife waiting for him, but he was still exhausted.
He was really too tired.
“I survived.” Meng Chuan laughed self-deprecatingly. “In the past, I always felt that life could surpass time. However, after experiencing time... I realized that my cultivation isn’t enough. If this Essence Soul Tribulation had lasted two-fold, or even ten-fold, longer, my consciousness would probably completely blur and collapse.”
Only after experiencing it would one truly realize how terrifying time was.
“From your description, it’s really a temporal prison.” Qin Wu was somewhat shocked. “You can’t see or hear anything. There’s nothing. Furthermore, there’s almost no end to time. I believe I won’t be able to withstand it.”
“Thankfully, the sixth Essence Soul Tribulation is still very far away,” said Meng Chuan.
His cultivation realm was still far from the Sixth Tribulation realm. He still had a long time to accumulate his strength slowly, constantly temper himself, and improve himself.
I have a 110,000-year lifespan. I have plenty of time to cultivate my mind.
Meng Chuan also decided to spend more effort on mental cultivation.
If one’s mind was lacking, even if they could barely have the strength of a Sixth Tribulation Eminence, they might not be able to withstand the sixth Essence Soul Tribulation.
He had a very long lifespan. As a Primordial realm expert (Imperial Lord), he had transcended the first three Physical Body Tribulations and the fifth Essence Soul Tribulation; his lifespan had slightly increased from 100,000 years to 110,000 years.
...
Thousand Mountain Star.
In a cave abode deep within a mountain range.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in a chamber. Translucent beads circled around him. These were the Thirteen Universe Beads—a Seventh Tribulation treasure. It was the most suitable treasure for Meng Chuan in Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s vault.
The Thirteen Universe Beads was a Seventh Tribulation treasure—which fused time lineage laws and spatial lineage laws—allowing Meng Chuan to unleash his full potential.
This treasure was worth 3,200 cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals in Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasure vault—this was counted in Meng Chuan’s 300,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals quota. It was twice as valuable as Senior Pang Ming’s Seventh Tribulation calabash. Such a treasure would be difficult to buy elsewhere, even if he had the money for it.
It’s about time.
Meng Chuan flipped his palm, and Fiend Prison appeared in the outside world.
Inside Fiend Prison was an Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake’s corpse. Demon Slayer was currently stabbed into the corpse.
Meng Chuan had carried Demon Slayer with him during his thousand-plus years of cultivation. Demon Slayer had also grown with Meng Chuan. It could be said to be the most compatible divine armament for Meng Chuan. It was even better than the Bloodblade Disc—which he had refined as his intrinsic treasure. After all, it was a divine armament he had nurtured since he was weak. Meng Chuan had used Infinite Saber’s laws as Demon Slayer’s core, allowing it to grow greatly.
Demon Slayer had also reached the level of a Tribulation weapon. However, it required many external forces to increase its strength. This Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake’s corpse had enough flesh and blood for Demon Slayer to devour.
Demon Slayer has also reached the Fifth Tribulation realm.
Meng Chuan could sense that nearly half of the Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake’s flesh had been devoured. Demon Slayer was completely satiated.
Although it was a Fifth Tribulation treasure, it was much more powerful than ordinary Sixth Tribulation treasures in Meng Chuan’s hands.
He had long prepared all sorts of treasures for melee-range and long-range attacks.
It’s time to set off and find Emperor Roc.
Meng Chuan stood up and grabbed Demon Slayer. He sheathed his saber, placing it by his waist. He immediately walked out of the chamber.

chapters.title: Chapter 556 - Tracking Emperor Roc
chapters.content:
Chapter 556: Tracking Emperor Roc
In a cave abode’s hall.
Gao Fang, Zhao Hongxiu, and Supremacy Qing Gu were reverent.
“I’ll be going out for a while,” said Meng Chuan indifferently. “I’ll leave my Essence Soul avatar to preside over Thousand Mountain Star. However, from today onwards, the three of you are not to leave it.”
“Yes,” Gao Fang, Zhao Hongxiu, and Supremacy Qing Gu obediently replied, not daring to disobey.
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
His Essence Soul avatar had the absolute advantage with Thousand Mountain Star’s array formation. Even if several Fifth Tribulation Eminences joined forces, they wouldn’t be able to break through Thousand Mountain Star’s defenses.
However, his Essence Soul avatar would be weaker away from Thousand Mountain Star. This was because up to now, Meng Chuan had only refined one World Treasure. It was carried by his outer realm body. The cost of refining a World Treasure was too great. It cost more than 3,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals alone.
Physical Body Tribulation Eminences spent most of their Outer Realm Essence Crystals on their bodies! The price of cultivating their bodies to match powerful treasures was more than ten times higher than refining treasures.
Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences would spend most of their wealth on World Treasures.
In the Physical Body Fifth Tribulation realm, one could cultivate an extremely powerful body. At the very least, it cost 2,000-3,000 cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals with no definite upper limit.
Meng Chuan used an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique as his foundations. He could also directly devour Primordial Stones to improve his body. Together, his true bodies in his homeworld and the outer realm spent more than 5,000 cubes. On average, each of his true bodies used over 2,000 cubes. It was considered a small price.
For example, Patriarch Black Dragon and company had to pay a huge price to cultivate their powerful bodies because they took many detours.
Although a Fifth Tribulation Eminence can be said to be virtually impossible to kill, the price of losing an avatar is immense.
His true body in the outer realm consisted of his body, Essence Soul treasures, Thirteen Universe Beads—a Seventh Tribulation treasure—Bloodblade Disc, several other Sixth Tribulation treasures, a piece of flesh from a Seventh Tribulation Dark Peacock, thousands of Outer Realm Essence Crystals, and Void Transference Talismans. If he died in battle, he would lose about 20,000 cubes.
However, it was difficult for an enemy to kill him.
As an expert that reached both the Physical Body Tribulation realm and Essence Soul Tribulation realm and had Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures, Meng Chuan was definitely one of the strongest Fifth Tribulation Eminences when it came to life-preservation means.
Time to go!
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan left Thousand Mountain Star. He quickly entered the River of Spacetime and headed straight for Snowjade Palace.
Moments later—
Meng Chuan arrived in the void where Snowjade Palace was. He looked at the empty void in front of him. Snowjade Palace is no longer here. Has Palace Lord Snowjade left with his cave abode?
From the looks of it, it’s indeed as I’ve guessed. Palace Lord Snowjade left Three Bay River System with his subordinates, including Imperial Lord Roc. Meng Chuan followed the karmic connection and locked onto Emperor Roc’s location. They have arrived at Yufang River System?
His figure moved. He immediately walked through the River of Spacetime and headed for Yufang River System.
...
Palace Lord Snowjade had reached Yufang River System more than half a year before Meng Chuan became an Essence Soul Fifth Tribulation Eminence. Yufang River System was within Goddess River Zone.
Two figures stood side by side in the silent void.
Palace Lord Snowjade was dressed in a light-blue robe. His face was ice-cold, and he naturally emanated a cold aura around him. Beside him was a grinning hunchbacked elder with gray eyes; a formless black fog surrounded him.
Most Supremacies and Imperial Lords had their own domains! As Fifth Tribulation Eminences, Snowjade and the hunchbacked elder naturally had their own domains.
For example, when Meng Chuan reached the Primordial realm, his Chaos Hole domain had also transformed into the stronger Primordial domain.
This was the case for those that followed the physical body lineage. Their bodies were akin to the core of a world. They naturally projected a domain that influenced their surroundings. An Imperial Lord’s domain typically spanned 500 kilometers. A Physical Body Tribulation Eminence’s domain could span thousands of kilometers to tens of thousands of kilometers. Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s domain only had a 30,000-kilometer range; it was relatively small.
An Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence’s Essence Soul World could cover a much larger area.
“Brother Snowjade, did you divine the location of the cave abode wrongly? We’ve been waiting here for half a month, but there has been nothing.” The hunchbacked elder frowned slightly. He held an incomplete token and carefully inspected the surrounding void.
“I’ve divined it at least ten times. There’s no mistake,” said Snowjade indifferently. He was filled with confidence.
“Then why can’t we find the cave abode?” asked the hunchbacked elder.
“This cave abode is located in a different spacetime dimension. It will only appear here at specific moments,” said Snowjade indifferently. “The cave abode will appear soon. Furthermore, it will stay here for a year. Just wait patiently.”
The hunchbacked elder couldn’t help but smile when he heard that. “Brother Snowjade, you are the best.”
Snowjade couldn’t be bothered to speak any further. If the other party didn’t have half the token, he wouldn’t have allowed the other party to enter.
As the two sides waited patiently, a figure suddenly appeared in the void and flew over.
“Oh?” The hunchbacked elder and Snowjade’s expressions changed slightly.
“You leaked the information?” Snowjade frowned as he stared at the hunchbacked elder.
“No, we have already made an agreement. How can I violate our promise?” said the hunchbacked elder immediately.
Snowjade’s brows furrowed tightly.
At their cultivation realm, they cared more about karma. Once they made a promise, they would not easily violate it.
“He won’t be able to find us if we hide in this void,” said the hunchbacked elder.
As soon as he finished speaking—
Rip!
The mysterious person broke through the obstruction and flew towards the hunchbacked elder and Snowjade.
The mysterious person flying over was somewhat thin.
“Why are the two of you here?” The mysterious man was somewhat puzzled. When he saw the incomplete token in the hunchbacked elder’s hand, he suddenly asked, “The two of you together form a complete token?”
“Who are you?” Snowjade and the hunchbacked elder stared at the mysterious man.
The mysterious man smiled slightly. Behind him, an enormous, blood-colored beast phantom appeared.
“Shura Realm?” Snowjade and the hunchbacked elder were secretly alarmed.
Shura Realm was a high-level world. Even in the River of Spacetime, high-level worlds were extremely rare. This was because every high-level world had produced an Eighth Tribulation Eminence in history.
Shura Realm’s cultivation system was known as the Shura cultivation system. In the River of Spacetime, it was one of the top physical body cultivation systems. The advantage of the Shura cultivation system was the same as the Cosmos Body cultivation system—they were universal; anyone could master these cultivation systems. Furthermore, these two cultivation systems had detailed guidance on how to reach the Tribulation from the very lowest realm.
Although Meng Chuan’s Chaos Hole realm and Primordial Realm might be stronger, they required one to have a paramount technique as their foundation. They weren’t universal.
“The two of you can be considered fated to find this place,” said the thin man indifferently. “After entering the cave abode, how much you can obtain will depend on your means and strength.”
The hunchbacked elder and Snowjade exchanged looks and nodded slightly.
Since they didn’t have the confidence to kill a Fifth Tribulation Eminence from Shura Realm, they could only hold back for now.
When it came to one’s background, the hunchbacked elder and Palace Lord Snowjade didn’t care too much. With their strength, they had long joined the River of Spacetime’s top factions. A Tribulation Eminence from a high-level world didn’t pose any threat to them.
“This is Palace Lord Snowjade. I’m known as Old Fiend Black Wind. I wonder how I should address you?” The hunchbacked elder grinned at the mysterious man.
“Me? Just call me Ta Gu,” said the mysterious skinny man casually. “After I leave the cave abode, I will leave Goddess River Zone. We might not meet again in the future.”
Palace Lord Snowjade was very cold. The mysterious man, Ta Gu, couldn’t be bothered to say anything else either. No matter how enthusiastic the hunchbacked elder was, he could only shut his mouth.
This wait lasted for more than a half-month.
Whoosh.
The void was somewhat distorted. If one’s realm was high enough, one could see a cyan door through the distorted void.
Snowjade and the hunchbacked elder’s eyes lit up. “It’s here.”
The mysterious man, Ta Gu, was very calm. He had already determined when the cave abode would appear.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
After a simple probe, Palace Lord Snowjade, the hunchbacked elder, and the mysterious man charged out of the distorted void and flew towards the cyan door.
...
Half a year after the three of them entered.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan arrived in this area of the void by tracing the karmic connection between him and Emperor Roc.
The outer realm was boundless. It was even harder to find a small distorted void than searching for a needle in a haystack. However, Meng Chuan tracked Emperor Roc’s karma all the way before arriving here.
Oh? Meng Chuan flew over and was somewhat puzzled. I can clearly sense Emperor Roc’s karma in this area. Why can’t I find it? Is there a space hidden around here?
With a thought—
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World spread out in all directions; the vast painting world enveloped the distorted void.
What’s that? Meng Chuan’s figure flashed as he turned to look at the distorted void. He could even sense a cyan door hidden within his Essence Soul World.

chapters.title: Chapter 557 - First Probe of the Cave Abode
chapters.content:
Chapter 557: First Probe of the Cave Abode
With Meng Chuan’s control over time, he could sense that the hidden cyan door had existed for a very long time.
This door has existed for a long time. It has existed for ten million years at least. Then, its creator should have died long ago. Palace Lord Snowjade brought Emperor Roc and his other subordinates over because of this mysterious cave abode?
guessed Meng Chuan.
With a thought, he split out an Essence Soul avatar and had it fly towards the cyan door. The door opened with a push.
Oh?
Through his Essence Soul avatar, Meng Chuan probed the situation behind the door. His eyes lit up.
Swoosh.
His true body flew in.
The cyan door—which contained many runic patterns—opened with a push. After Meng Chuan flew in, he turned around and saw the door close again.
What a cave abode.
After dispelling his Essence Soul avatar, Meng Chuan looked at the scene in front of him.
Behind the door was an extremely large dark-red lair! This lair was about 500,000 kilometers wide. At the lair’s entrance was a stone monument, which had a few simple words engraved on it: “Those who reach the end will be the final victor.” The words circled around like tadpoles. Meng Chuan had never seen them before, but he could sense the intent contained in the words and understood the meaning behind them.
It’s only a few words, but the pressure they give me is already so strong. From the looks of it, it’s likely that this cave abode’s owner is an existence comparable to Ancestral Master Archean Eon.
He had seen many of Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s capabilities from the many things he had left behind in Archean Eon Realm.
Just the cyan door, stone monument, and lair made Meng Chuan feel that the creator was on the same level as Ancestral Master Archean Eon. At the very least, the words left behind by a Sixth Tribulation Eminence wouldn’t make him feel such immense pressure.
Is this cave abode related to a Seventh Tribulation Eminence? Or is it related to an even stronger existence?
Meng Chuan was tempted.
Let’s go.
Meng Chuan walked towards the lair’s entrance. At the same time, his Essence Soul World’s phantom appeared around him. When it came to reconnaissance, his Essence Soul World was still better than his Primordial domain.
...
There was only one entrance to the lair, but the deeper one went, the more forks there were.
According to the Palace Lord, we just need to advance. The deeper we can probe, the greater the benefits.
Emperor Roc carefully advanced as ripples spread out in all directions.
If I can obtain what the Palace Lord needs, it will be a great contribution.
Emperor Roc was filled with anticipation.
Palace Lord Snowjade had a basic understanding of this cave abode. That was why he had brought his subordinates here. As long as they entered the cave abode and reached a certain depth, they would obtain opportunities and benefits. After they left the cave abode, these subordinates naturally had to hand over everything obediently! Although his subordinates were weaker than him, they had the number advantage. Perhaps Palace Lord Snowjade’s subordinates could amass more than him.
Palace Lord Snowjade wouldn’t be stingy if they amassed plenty of valuable treasures.
These subordinates were prepared to die in battle. Thus, they didn’t bring any valuable items with them.
Oh?
As Emperor Roc walked through the lair’s tunnel, he suddenly saw a huge hole in front of him. The hole was rather large. Boundless black fog billowed beneath it. A blood-colored chain was connected to one end of the hole to another, with the other end being right in front of the tunnel.
Emperor Roc was slightly taken aback before he came to a realization.
I probably have to step on the chain and walk to the other end. This cave abode is filled with danger. It’s very difficult to venture deep. If I were the owner and deliberately set up a chain here, it will definitely contain dangers.
With a thought, Emperor Roc immediately split out an Essence Soul avatar. He had a seventh-level Essence Soul. Apart from his true body in his homeworld and his true body in the outer realm, he could still use eight Essence Soul avatars.
However, his Essence Soul avatars were much weaker than his true bodies.
Swoosh.
Emperor Roc tried to use his Essence Soul avatar to fly forward, but the moment it flew out, the churning black fog instantly captured the Essence Soul avatar. The Essence Soul avatar froze as it plummeted, disappearing into the black fog.
It really does contain dangers.
Emperor Roc didn’t mind it. He could recover quite fast from losing an Essence Soul avatar. He immediately sent out another Essence Soul avatar and let it step onto the chain.
After stepping on the chain, the black fog didn’t attack it, but the chain’s invisible force affected his Essence Soul avatar.
It didn’t destroy my Essence Soul avatar. This chain is indeed the most suitable path.
Emperor Roc no longer hesitated as he stepped forward with his true body.
I have to make every second count. According to Palace Lord’s instructions, this cave abode only allows us entry for a year. The lair is too complicated. I’ve been in here for more than half a year. I even killed two Tribulation Eminences during this time.
Yes, Emperor Roc had encountered enemies in the past half-year. One of them was only at the Second Tribulation realm, while the other was at the Third Tribulation realm. They were likely subordinates of Old Fiend Black Wind or Ta Gu.
As long as one encountered unfamiliar strangers in the cave abode, they would attack each other; only one of them could continue advancing. The other either died or gave up on advancing.
Boom!
Emperor Roc stepped on the blood-colored chain. At first, he felt relaxed, but the force exerted by the chains became more and more terrifying as he advanced. Emperor Roc also began to sway. He had to spread his golden wings out to withstand the force.
This... the lair’s obstruction is already this strong? Could it be that I’m almost at my limit?
Emperor Roc was somewhat anxious.
I haven’t obtained any treasures yet.
He resisted the force with all his might. As though he was affected by terrifying void turbulence, Emperor Roc spread his wings and tried his best to stabilize himself. His foot claws grabbed the chains. This was the only method he could use to stabilize himself. Once he fell, he would definitely be devoured by the black fog.
Emperor Roc was indeed talented in the void lineage. Although it was difficult, he still reached the other end.
I did it.
Emperor Roc finally walked to the other end, feeling relieved.
At that moment, a black lotus seed flew out from the black fog and headed towards Emperor Roc.
After wandering for more than half a year, I finally obtained treasure in the cave abode.
Emperor Roc was somewhat excited. After receiving the black lotus seed, he realized that the lotus seed’s surface was covered in numerous golden runes. The runic patterns appeared inconspicuous because they were too tiny.
...
Palace Lord Snowjade was also roaming the lair, but he wanted to venture deeper.
Rumble!
Over a churning magma lake.
Snowjade stepped on the magma lake’s surface as he advanced.
“Palace Lord, I obtained a black lotus seed.”
His subordinates hid an Essence Soul avatar each inside the grotto-heaven that Palace Lord Snowjade carried with him. His subordinates would report everything they had experienced in the cave abode. These subordinates were all at the Tribulation realm, so it was very easy for them to split out Essence Soul avatars.
“What’s the black lotus seed like?”
asked Snowjade via voice transmission.
“It’s difficult for me to replicate the runic patterns on the lotus seed’s surface. I can only replicate its general appearance.”
Emperor Roc’s Essence Soul avatar immediately replicated the black lotus seed’s appearance, allowing Snowjade to view it.
When Snowjade saw the lotus seed’s appearance, he became delighted.
“Very good. Your current priority is to stay alive. If you encounter other Tribulation Eminences, you should admit defeat; don’t lose that lotus seed.”
“Yes,
” responded Emperor Roc’s delighted Essence Soul avatar immediately.
It was enough for Emperor Roc to obtain the lotus seed.
Snowjade was in a good mood.
Although four of his nine subordinates had failed, the other five were still forging forward. Three of them had obtained treasures.
Golden Roc’s luck isn’t bad to have obtained a Tribulation Luck Lotus Seed.
Snowjade stepped on the magma lake’s surface and continued advancing cautiously.
...
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan quickly advanced. The dangers in the lair’s earlier tunnels posed no threat to him. He could easily break through the tunnels’ obstructions with his Essence Soul World, allowing him to advance with ease.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
A gray wind blew through the gaps in the tunnel, but it was blocked by the Essence Soul World’s many layers of obstruction. It failed to touch Meng Chuan at all.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan phased into a blur as he advanced at high speeds.
Meng Chuan suddenly stopped and looked at an altar in front of him. Sitting on the altar was a bored alien Tribulation Eminence. This alien expert had a pair of snow-white wings and looked somewhat dejected. However, he couldn’t help but jump in fright when he saw Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World enveloped his surroundings; thus, this alien expert couldn’t see Meng Chuan’s appearance, but he could sense the huge difference in their order in life. This alien expert knew that the other party could crush him with a single finger.
“I’ve already taken the initiative to give up,” said the alien expert with a fawning smile. “To explore this cave abode, I didn’t bring any treasures with me. Senior, don’t worry about me. Just advance.”

chapters.title: Chapter 558 - Emperor Rocs Harvest
chapters.content:
Chapter 558: Emperor Roc’s Harvest
Meng Chuan walked over. His Essence Soul World enveloped his surroundings, making his figure blurry. However, the pressure—caused by the difference in Meng Chuan and the alien expert’s order in life—made the alien expert tremble uncontrollably.
“Do you want to live or die?” asked Meng Chuan.
“I naturally want to live.” The alien expert was very respectful.
Meng Chuan nodded. “I can spare you if you tell me everything you know about this cave abode and the cultivators who are exploring the cave abode.”
“As long as Senior spares me and doesn’t take any of my treasures, I will definitely tell you everything,” said the alien expert immediately. The promise spoken by a Tribulation Eminence would form karma. Weak people could spout nonsense and violate their promises. However, Tribulation Eminences wouldn’t violate their promises unless they had a good reason. Otherwise, it would affect their cultivation greatly.
A powerful Tribulation Eminence breaking their promise was akin to destroying their cultivation path. Therefore, powerful Tribulation Eminences did everything they could to fulfill promises.
“As long as you say everything, I won’t touch you,” said Meng Chuan indifferently. This alien expert was only at the Second Tribulation realm. He was weaker than Emperor Roc, so how many treasures could he have? Meng Chuan wanted to know more about this cave abode.
“I’m under Fiend Lord Black Wind, who is from Yufang River System,” said the alien expert immediately. “I don’t know much about this cave abode.”
Meng Chuan continued looking at the alien expert.
“My lord said that he wanted to do something important, so he stored us in his grotto-heaven and came to this cave abode,” said the alien expert. “Before we came, I didn’t know anything about this ancient cave abode. Even now... I still don’t know this cave abode’s origins and location. My lord only released us after entering this cave abode.”
Meng Chuan frowned. “Tell me whatever you know.”
“Yes, yes.” The alien expert nodded immediately. “I know that apart from my lord’s faction, there are two other factions. One faction is Palace Lord Snowjade’s—who is from Three Bay River System. The other is a mysterious Fifth Tribulation Eminence, Ta Gu. I’m not too sure about that person’s origins. My lord didn’t elaborate on him. In short, three factions have entered the cave abode.
“According to my lord, you only need to advance down the cave abode’s tunnels. If you go deep enough, you will have a chance of obtaining treasures,” said the alien expert immediately. “However, once you encounter other cultivators, only one can advance! The other will either have to admit defeat or be killed.”
The alien expert continued, “Although there are many forks, all the forks eventually converge. Therefore, only one person has a chance of reaching the cave abode’s end.”
Meng Chuan listened.
“One has to be fast while traveling through the cave abode because some of the treasures in the cave abode will be taken by the cultivators ahead. Slower cultivators will not receive any treasures,” explained the alien expert. “One can obtain anything by killing the cultivators ahead.
“Also, we can stay in this cave abode for a year at most,” said the alien expert. “Once one year is up, we will be expelled from this cave abode.”
“That’s all?” asked Meng Chuan.
The alien expert nodded immediately. “That’s all. We are mainly competing with Palace Lord Snowjade and Ta Gu.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
A one-year deadline? When two cultivators met, only one could continue advancing?
“When did this one-year deadline begin?” asked Meng Chuan.
“It’s been seven months since the cave abode appeared,” explained the alien expert.
Meng Chuan nodded and immediately continued forward.
Whoosh.
Only after Meng Chuan left did the alien expert heave a sigh of relief.
...
The hunchbacked elder, Old Fiend Black Wind, frowned as he looked at the surrounding columns. Around him were 323 pillars. He had been stuck here for half a month.
“Milord, milord, I encountered a mysterious expert. He’s suspected to be a Fifth Tribulation Eminence.”
When Black Wind heard the voice, he looked at the silver bracelet on his wrist. The silver bracelet was a grotto-heaven with many Essence Soul avatars inside.
The weakest second Tribulation Eminence was reporting to him.
“Suspected to be at the Fifth Tribulation realm?”
In the grotto-heaven’s sky, Old Fiend Black Wind’s gigantic face appeared. He looked down at the alien expert.
“You are relatively weak. You shouldn’t have gone too far. A Fifth Tribulation Eminence has only arrived at your location?”
“I might be mistaken,”
said the alien expert respectfully.
“However, this mysterious expert does indeed exert terrifying pressure on me because of the difference in our order in life. It’s the same feeling I get whenever I face you, milord. I can vaguely tell that he’s at the Fifth Tribulation realm. Furthermore, he asked me about the cave abode. In order to survive, I told him.”
“Okay.”
Old Fiend Black Wind didn’t mind.
What his subordinates knew was the most basic information on the cave abode. One could obtain this information after staying in the cave abode for a long time.
What was truly important, such as the cave abode’s location, origins, and so on, was something none of his subordinates knew.
Could it be that another Fifth Tribulation Eminence has entered?
Black Wind became even more cautious.
More and more experts were entering the cave abode.
He originally thought that he only needed to fight Palace Lord Snowjade, but a Fifth Tribulation Eminence from Shura Realm had arrived. Now, another Fifth Tribulation Eminence had also entered the cave abode?
...
Boom! Boom!
A golden light beam and a gray light beam clashed in a tunnel that was only 100 feet wide.
The golden light was formed by Emperor Roc. Emperor Roc spread his wings; he also wore a pair of treasure gloves on his hands.
The gray light beam was a transformed skinny, skeletal six-armed alien. The alien’s six arms were strange and bizarre. Each of them held a weapon as it attacked Emperor Roc with all its might.
Both were at the Physical Body Third Tribulation realm.
Although they were fighting in a narrow tunnel that was only 100 feet wide, they fought in unpredictable ways. Their moves were capable of tearing the world asunder. The two were considered the best among the Physical Body Third Tribulation realm.
The six-armed alien had been in the Third Tribulation realm for nearly 10,000 years. It had accumulated quite a bit of insight.
When Emperor Roc first reached the Tribulation realm, he could already match a Third Tribulation Eminence. Once he reached the Third Tribulation realm, he was considered to be one of the strongest in the Third Tribulation realm.
Pfft.
Emperor Roc’s palm was peerlessly powerful. His palm was in the shape of a claw. After fighting for a long time, one of the six-armed alien’s arms was severed. After the arm shattered, it immediately transformed into countless particles, which then flew towards the stump in a bid to regrow the arm.
However, the void froze, freezing the countless particles.
Rip!
Rip!
Emperor Roc’s moves were cruel, but they contained the void lineage’s profundities. The six-armed alien’s injuries worsened. After losing three of its arms consecutively, it could only sigh and self-destruct. It didn’t want to be humiliated any further.
Boom!
As it self-destructed, Emperor Roc flew backward and slammed into the tunnel wall. His body was stained with blood and feathers, but the wounds healed in the blink of an eye. A smile appeared on his face.
Thankfully, I brought a Sixth Tribulation treasure—Void Splitter. With it, I can suppress him with my strength. This idiot, Marquis Ice, brought weak treasures. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have the confidence to kill him.
Marquis Ice—who was at the Third Tribulation realm—was from a low-level world. It was much poorer than Emperor Roc. When he came to this cave abode on this expedition, he knew that he was in danger of dying. He couldn’t bear to bring any precious treasures with him. His six arms held one Fifth Tribulation treasure and five Fourth Tribulation treasures. His strength was naturally inferior.
After all, Marquis Ice had only accumulated two Sixth Tribulation treasures and many Fifth Tribulation treasures over the years. If he had brought all his treasures with him, it was unknown who would emerge victorious.
As for Emperor Roc, he came from a middle-level world. Furthermore, it was a world with quite a rich heritage. Even though he knew that he might die, he still brought a Sixth Tribulation treasure and other ordinary treasures with him on this expedition. This was because he could afford to lose them!
Of course, Emperor Roc was far inferior to Meng Chuan in terms of wealth.
Even Senior Pang Ming—who had cultivated both his Essence Soul and Physical Body—only brought about 10,000 cubes worth of treasures with him when roaming the outer realm. He also carried less than Meng Chuan’s true body that roamed the outer realm.
This Marquis Ice had some gains.
Emperor Roc inspected his war spoils and was rather satisfied.
Counting all of them, there are nearly 600 cubes worth of treasures. I’ve made a killing. I really did reap a big harvest on this cave abode trip.
...
Meng Chuan walked through the lair’s tunnels. His Essence Soul World spread out around him, allowing him to travel without any obstruction.
During the earlier portions of the lair, there were no obstacles. However, he didn’t discover any treasures.
It’s likely that the cultivators ahead have taken all the treasures.
Meng Chuan also understood this point. He leisurely walked through the lair, but his speed was terrifying. Soon, he arrived at a fork.
The forks headed into two different directions, each leading to an extremely distant place.
Emperor Roc is in this direction.
Meng Chuan chose one side after sensing Emperor Roc’s location through karma.
Although there were many forks in the lair, they ultimately converged. Many forks were connected, so cultivators would occasionally encounter each other.
As for Meng Chuan, he probed the karmic connection between him and Emperor Roc when choosing forks. He was getting closer and closer to Emperor Roc.
Soon.
Meng Chuan leisurely walked through the cave abode. To him, capturing Emperor Roc was the most important matter. As for the cave abode’s opportunities? They were secondary to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 559 - Emperor Roc and Meng Chuan Meeting Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 559: Emperor Roc and Meng Chuan Meeting Again
Meng Chuan walked step by step, his figure becoming blurry and illusory. He moved through the tunnel extremely quickly, but he was also extremely cautious.
After all, it was suicidal to be careless in a cave abode that was suspected to be built by a Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
Oh?
Meng Chuan vaguely sensed a threat in front of him. He couldn’t help but be even more careful. He carefully probed the area in front of him with his Essence Soul, and he soon discovered the source of the threat.
What’s that?
Meng Chuan quickly saw something.
On the tunnel wall in front of him were ghastly, sharp, white teeth. The ends of these teeth were embedded in the tunnel’s depths. The sharp teeth were pointing outwards. There were 38 sharp teeth. Some were like spikes; some were like scimitars; they were all of varying lengths. They were embedded into both sides of the tunnel, leaving only a 30-foot-wide passageway.
This should be the teeth of a living being.
Meng Chuan looked at them. There were layers of runes on the surface of the teeth. The evil energy contained within the white teeth corroded the surrounding void.
This lifeform has died long ago. There are only a few teeth here, but they make me feel threatened. These teeth contain a strange power. It’s indeed terrifying.
With a thought, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World suppressed these teeth with all its might. After cultivating his World Treasure, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World was strong enough to suppress a Fourth Tribulation Eminence! This suppression was naturally extremely powerful.
Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!
When the teeth were suppressed, the runic patterns on the teeth’s surface became even more eye-catching. They trembled slightly, but because they were embedded into the tunnel walls, they didn’t shake too much.
Is the evil power contained in these teeth this area’s test?
As Meng Chuan examined the teeth, he passed through the 30-foot-wide gap between the teeth. As he walked through the gap, he was also affected by the teeth’s evil power. He estimated that only a Third Tribulation Eminence and stronger could resist the evil power’s influence. Of course, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World could completely isolate him from its influence.
The owner of the teeth should be a Fifth or Sixth Tribulation realm lifeform.
Meng Chuan had some guesses, but he felt that something was amiss.
A cave abode was built, but the teeth of other lifeforms are embedded in this cave abode’s walls? This kind of action is somewhat special.
Meng Chuan continued to advance rapidly as he pondered the cave abode’s layout that the owner had purposely planned.
An hour later.
Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up as he looked at the tunnel ahead.
Emperor Roc is right ahead. I’m finally going to capture you.
Meng Chuan was filled with anticipation.
He had waited too long for this day.
...
In one of the lair’s caves, a dark wind howled.
Emperor Roc struggled to move forward because of the strong wind. Just as he took a step forward, the wind carried him and sent him flying for more than ten steps before he found his footing.
This wind is too powerful. I haven’t even walked through half of this. I can’t pass through this cave at all.
Emperor Roc was in a sorry state as he glanced at the cave’s raging wind. The further he went, the stronger the wind became.
Emperor Roc tried a few more times. However, every time he struggled to advance, he would be sent flying backward by the wind.
After several attempts, he finally chose to give up.
I’m afraid only Fourth Tribulation Eminences and stronger can clear this. This is my limit.
Emperor Roc also knew that even if a true expert reached this ancient cave abode’s end, it would still be a battle between Palace Lord Snowjade and the other Fifth Tribulation Eminences. It was already not bad if a Third Tribulation Eminence like him could obtain some treasures.
Emperor Roc turned his head and walked to the edge of the cave where the wind was weak. He chose a large rock and sat on it, leisurely waiting.
The wind here was very weak. Emperor Roc felt rather comfortable when the wind blew across his golden fur.
This is the end of my expedition in this cave abode. I’ll be leaving the cave abode once the one-year deadline is up.
Emperor Roc was in a good mood.
I deliberately slowed down while roaming this lair. The ones behind me should be weaker than me. It’s unlikely that I will encounter a Fourth Tribulation Eminence.
Snowjade and Black Wind each had one Fourth Tribulation realm subordinate.
Few people at the Fourth Tribulation realm were willing to follow a Fifth Tribulation Eminence.
Time passed.
Rumble!
Emperor Roc, who was sitting on a boulder, was leisurely drinking a flask of alcohol. The alcohol was very strong, but it suited his tastes very well.
Suddenly—
An Essence Soul World phantom invaded the void. The howling dark wind was suppressed into silence.
Oh?
When Emperor Roc saw the Essence Soul World phantom, he jolted.
An Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence?
The complete suppression of the cave’s wind made Emperor Roc panic greatly. He immediately shouted, “Senior, I’ve already given up...”
Before he could finish speaking, Emperor Roc lost consciousness.
Emperor Roc.
At this moment, time stopped.
Meng Chuan took action at that moment. Everything around him was still. Even the dark wind stopped.
Meng Chuan instantly appeared beside Emperor Roc.
Emperor Roc still had a terrified look on his face; he seemed to be speaking anxiously. However, he remained motionless like a statue.
I’ve finally caught you.
Meng Chuan looked at Emperor Roc. He was one of the three main instigators behind the human world’s demon invasion—which lasted for more than 900 years. He was also the leader of the demons.
Meng Chuan waved his hand and stored Emperor Roc into Fiend Prison.
...
Inside Fiend Prison.
Wh-where am I?
Emperor Roc regained consciousness and looked around. He was in a dark space. Following that, he discovered that he was chained up. His hands and feet were shackled, and even his spine was bound by chains. His body was completely sealed, preventing him from using any demonic powers. His body became weak.
My treasures are all gone.
Emperor Roc realized that all his treasures were missing. Even his robes were gone. Thankfully, his fur covered his body.
My body and Essence Soul have been sealed?
Emperor Roc was somewhat uneasy. He couldn’t commit suicide in such a state.
At this moment, he was completely at the mercy of another person. However, he had cultivated for many years, allowing him to face the dire situation calmly.
I haven’t reached the Third Tribulation realm for long. I haven’t offended any powerful Tribulation Eminences
, thought Emperor Roc to himself.
There must be a special reason why I was imprisoned.
Following that, he looked up.
An Essence Soul World phantom enveloped him as a figure walked over from afar.
“Senior, Senior,” said Emperor Roc immediately. “I’m willing to offer all my treasures to you. I’ll definitely do my best to help you.”
When it was time to bow his head, he would obediently bow his head. Emperor Roc knew his limits.
“The Demon Realm’s strongest expert,” said the approaching figure. “It really wasn’t easy to capture you.”
“You?” Emperor Roc found the voice familiar.
The Essence Soul World phantom dissipated, revealing a white-haired man.
The white-haired man looked at him with mixed emotions.
“Do you recognize me?” Meng Chuan glanced at Emperor Roc.
Meng Chuan?
Emperor Roc felt his vision turn dark. Fear, disbelief, and indignation—he was unable to think because of all his chaotic emotions.
Emperor Roc gradually regained clarity of his mind. He regained his rationality, but he felt like everything before him was a joke.
The human world’s Meng Chuan could actually capture him alive without him putting up any resistance?
One was the Demon Realm’s strongest expert, while the other was Archean Eon Realm’s strongest expert.
Was the strength difference between the two already so great?
“What are you doing?” Emperor Roc stared at Meng Chuan. “If you want to kill me, just kill me.”
Meng Chuan found it amusing.
Kill?
After killing Emperor Roc’s outer realm body, Emperor Roc could just cultivate another one quickly.
No, what Meng Chuan wanted to do was capture Emperor Roc alive and prevent him from committing suicide! This outer realm body could be used as a medium for a karmic attack. Once Meng Chuan was completely confident, he could kill this outer realm body. With the karmic connection between this body and Emperor Roc’s other avatars, Meng Chuan could kill all of Emperor Roc’s avatars in one fell swoop. Without a medium, a karmic attack’s might would greatly decrease.
Blood and flesh were good mediums. Emperor Roc’s true body was a complete body and had a complete Essence Soul. It was the best medium for karmic attacks.
“The three of you are the main instigators behind the demon invasion. We humans haven’t forgotten about this grudge for even one day.” Meng Chuan looked at the imprisoned Emperor Roc and said, “All of you have to pay back what you owe us humans. Today, I’ll kill Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon and let them head to the underworld first. As for you? It’ll be your turn soon.”
With Meng Chuan’s Fifth Tribulation Eminence strength, he could easily kill the two ordinary Imperial Lords through karma. However, he held back from attacking the enemy before capturing Emperor Roc alive. He didn’t want to alert his enemies too early.
Now, it was time for him to attack the Demon Realm’s three strongest experts.
Starquix, Blackmoon.
Emperor Roc was anxious, but he couldn’t do anything. He couldn’t save the two demon Imperial Lords.

chapters.title: Chapter 560 - Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoons Ending
chapters.content:
Chapter 560: Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon’s Ending
Three Bay River System.
A cave abode had been built on a barren planet. With an array formation concealing it, Lady Blackmoon’s outer realm body cultivated in seclusion.
Whoosh.
Sitting on the mountain, Lady Blackmoon sucked in a cold breath. She felt extremely comfortable. She chose this barren planet because it was very suitable for her cultivation.
In the outer realm, one’s perception of the different laws became much clearer. It was unlike her homeworld, where she could only comprehend the worldly laws.
Meng Chuan?
At the moment Emperor Roc discovered Meng Chuan’s identity after being captured alive—
Lady Blackmoon also saw a white-haired man appear in front of her.
Oh?
Lady Blackmoon was slightly taken aback. Her eyes widened because she recognized the white-haired man as Meng Chuan!
The white-haired Meng Chuan calmly looked at her.
Lady Blackmoon had already lost consciousness.
...
At the same time, Imperial Lord Starquix—who was leading his subordinates to explore ruins—also discovered a white-haired man.
“Imperial Lord, these ruins have been discovered by others more than once. It has been wiped clean. There’s nothing left,” said his subordinates.
Imperial Lord Starquix stood rooted to the ground, unable to move. His mind even stopped thinking.
A white-haired man walked in front of him. Without looking at the other Supremacies around him, the white-haired man waved his hand and stored Imperial Lord Starquix into his grotto-heaven treasure.
...
The Demon Realm.
Not good.
We’re doomed.
Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon rushed to Roc Imperial Palace as quickly as possible.
“Emperor Roc.”
“Emperor Roc.” The two of them were horrified and in despair.
Soon, they saw Emperor Roc sitting alone on the throne in the hall. He had been waiting for them.
“Emperor Roc, save us.”
“Meng Chuan appeared and captured our true bodies in the outer realm,” pleaded Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon anxiously.
Emperor Roc looked down from atop his throne. After a moment of silence, he slowly said, “My outer realm true body has been captured as well.”
Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon were stunned.
Emperor Roc’s true body was also captured alive?
The two of them were ultimately ordinary Imperial Lords. It was still reasonable and believable if they were captured alive, but even Emperor Roc was captured alive?
“What’s his strength?” asked Imperial Lord Starquix anxiously. “Isn’t it said that one’s cultivation speed would be very slow after reaching the Tribulation realm? Even if one creates a very powerful technique and has a very powerful bloodline, they will typically only reach the Third Tribulation realm in a short period of time.”
Emperor Roc nodded slightly. “I originally guessed that he was at the Third Tribulation realm, but I realized that I was ridiculously wrong this time. I couldn’t resist him at all... The strength difference between us is too great. I can still fight a Fourth Tribulation Eminence, but Meng Chuan should have already reached the Fifth Tribulation realm.”
“How long has he been cultivating for?” Lady Blackmoon couldn’t believe it.
The path of cultivation was long.
There wasn’t much of a difference between the First and Second Tribulation realms. Although it was difficult to reach the Third Tribulation realm, one could reach the Third Tribulation realm if they created a powerful ultimate technique—like Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique—and elevated it to the perfected Heaven Earth realm.
If one had the Golden-Winged Roc, Dark Peacock, Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake, or even non-pure-blooded dragons and phoenix, one could typically reach the Third Tribulation realm in a short period of time.
Many could reach the Third Tribulation realm quickly. It was common among Tribulation Eminences.
However, the Fifth Tribulation realm? Reaching the Fifth Tribulation Realm was more than 100 times harder than reaching the Third Tribulation realm! In one entire river system, there might not even be a Fifth Tribulation Eminence during an era.
“When I saw him, I couldn’t put up any resistance and was captured alive,” said Emperor Roc softly. “His strength should be at the Fifth Tribulation realm.”
“How is that possible?” Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon murmured in horror and despair.
“Perhaps Meng Chuan had a special encounter or an opportunity left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon that allowed him to enter some mysterious mystic realm,” said Emperor Roc. “Mystic realms can have accelerated time flows. Although it appears that he has been cultivating for a short period of time, Meng Chuan could have actually been cultivating over 10,000 years. Regardless of our speculations, his strength is something we can no longer resist. As for the two of you... nobody can save you.”
Two ordinary Imperial Lords hiding in their homeworld were unable to withstand a Fifth Tribulation Eminence’s karmic attack.
Perhaps only Seventh Tribulation Eminences and Eighth Tribulation Eminences could protect the two of them from a Fifth Tribulation Eminence’s karmic attack. However, the Demon Realm’s three strongest experts could only meet Seventh Tribulation Eminences in their dreams.
“Nobody can save us?” muttered Lady Blackmoon to herself and looked up at Emperor Roc. “What is he trying to do by capturing Starquix’s outer realm true body and my outer realm body? It doesn’t seem like he is planning on killing us. Does he have other motives?”
“He told me what he’s going to do,” said Emperor Roc, “He will kill the two of you today.”
Starquix and Blackmoon’s expressions changed drastically.
Emperor Roc sighed. Meng Chuan directly said that he would kill Starquix and Blackmoon today so that it would strike deeper fear into them.
“He captured us alive because he didn’t want us to die too easily?” Starquix and Blackmoon looked at each other with nasty expressions.
...
Archean Eon Realm, demon sage passageway.
“How can I let you die so easily?” The white-haired Meng Chuan stood under a willow tree and looked at the Demon Realm on the other side of the demon sage passageway.
“Feel fear. Feel the helplessness before death,” muttered Meng Chuan softly.
If they were killed through karma, Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon wouldn’t die in pain. It would be letting them off too easily. It would be better for them to be reduced to ashes.
The war—which lasted for 900-plus years—had caused too much harm to humanity. Just the number of soldiers dying while guarding the cities were in the billions. Countless commoners had died. Darkness, despair, madness, and hysteria... Too many things had happened.
Meng Chuan had experienced a demon attack when he was young. At the very least, his father protected him when he was young. The Meng family, a large family clan, supported him. Meng Chuan lived a carefree life, but there were many more who led more miserable lives than Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan had seen too many things with his own eyes. He had long sworn that he would make the culprits pay the price.
Meng Chuan believed that it was impossible for Starquix and Blackmoon to produce a miracle.
Wanting a Seventh Tribulation Eminence to protect them? In this era, there were no Seventh Tribulation Eminences in Goddess River Zone or Ancient Magus River Zone! If Emperor Roc and company could cozy up to Seventh Tribulation Eminences? That would be a rare miracle in the River of Spacetime.
“Senior Eastcalm.”
“Senior Eastcalm.”
Two voices traveled through the demon sage passageway.
The 50-kilometer-long demon sage passageway allowed Meng Chuan to see the vast demon world easily. He also saw Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon kneeling reverently on the ground.
“We know that we brought too many disasters to Archean Eon Realm,” said Imperial Lord Starquix as he knelt. “Right now, Blackmoon and I are only begging for survival. I wonder what we can do to survive? Senior Eastcalm, just state your conditions.”
“Senior Eastcalm, please state your conditions,” said Lady Blackmoon as she knelt.
At this moment, the two of them were extremely humble as they begged for their lives.
Meng Chuan stood on the other side of the demon sage passageway and said indifferently, “Do you feel despair? When the demons invaded, they didn’t care about humanity’s despair. Let me tell you now, the two of you will die today. There’s still two hours before your deaths. Two hours later, I’ll kill the two of you through karma.”
Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon looked up at Meng Chuan.
Their eyes met.
It looks like he won’t give us a way out.
Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon both went crazy.
Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon suddenly collapsed to the ground silently.
On the other side of the demon sage passageway, Meng Chuan watched from afar. “Do you think the two hours I’m giving you is for you to arrange your funerals? Wrong. In these two hours, I’ll let you have a good taste of the suffering that Archean Eon Realm’s people have experienced.”
As an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence, he was very skilled at illusions. Essence Soul Worlds were the most terrifying illusions. It made it very easy for Meng Chuan to alter one’s consciousness and create memories.
After capturing Starquix and Blackmoon’s outer realm bodies, Meng Chuan cast an illusion on the two. Furthermore, the illusions descended upon all of Starquix and Blackmoon’s avatars through karma.
The strength difference between both parties was too great! Even through karma, Meng Chuan’s illusions caused Starquix and Blackmoon’s avatars to fall into an illusion.
Two hours passed outside, but in the illusion... it had been a very long time.
Everything the humans had suffered was piled onto the two of them.
Two hours later, Starquix and Blackmoon regained their clarity, but their eyes were somewhat dazed.
“No, no...”
“No...”
Although they had never experienced many terrifying things after becoming Imperial Lords, they had completely lost their minds. This was how terrifying an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence was.
Boom!
Following that, saber beams descended.
The saber beams killed the two outer realm bodies. Through karma, saber beams descended upon each avatar. Although the saber beams’ strength decreased significantly, they instantly annihilated all the avatars.
Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon completely turned to dust and vanished.
This was the day of their execution; thus, they would be executed today!
They’re dead.
Emperor Roc sat on his throne in Roc Imperial Palace. Through the void, he saw Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon—who were in front of the demon sage passageway—turn to dust. Emperor Roc remained expressionless.
I have to become stronger
, thought Emperor Roc.
The stronger I become, the less threatening a descending karmic attack will be to me.
...
Inside Fiend Prison.
Emperor Roc, who was chained up, stared at Meng Chuan.
“The two of them are dead. You’re the only one left,” said Meng Chuan calmly. “Don’t be anxious. Your judgment day will soon arrive.”
Emperor Roc stared at Meng Chuan. “Is that so? If you have the ability, kill me through karma.”
Meng Chuan looked around. “Do you know where this is?”
Emperor Roc was puzzled.
“This place is called Fiend Prison,” said Meng Chuan casually. “As a prison, it’s very good at torturing prisoners. I’ll let you have a taste of Fiend Prison’s tormenting tortures.”
Lightning seeped into Emperor Roc’s body through the chains, causing him to convulse.
...
It won’t be easy to kill Emperor Roc.
Meng Chuan knew this very well.
A Fifth Tribulation Eminence typically had the confidence to kill a newly-advanced Tribulation Eminence through karma.
Sixth Tribulation Eminences had a relatively high chance of killing a Third Tribulation Eminence through karma, but they didn’t have 100% confidence.
Seventh Tribulation Eminences had full confidence in killing a Fourth Tribulation Eminence.
Eighth Tribulation Eminences? Their means were unfathomable. They could easily kill Fifth Tribulation Eminences. They could even threaten Sixth Tribulation Eminences through karma. However, even Seventh Tribulation Eminences might not ever meet a single Eighth Tribulation Eminence their entire lives. Even in the same era, there might not be an Eighth Tribulation Eminence in the entire River of Spacetime.
I killed two and captured one alive.
Meng Chuan found it cathartic.
It’s now time to explore this cave abode properly.
Meng Chuan looked ahead.
I captured Emperor Roc alive. Its backer, Palace Lord Snowjade, should know of my existence.
Following that, he took a step forward. Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World easily suppressed the wind, allowing him to continue advancing through the lair with ease.

chapters.title: Chapter 561 - End of the Lair
chapters.content:
Chapter 561: End of the Lair
Deep in the lair’s tunnel, Snowjade’s eyes were cold as he slowed down.
Buzz—
An invisible aura surged from the tunnel’s depths, pressurizing Snowjade.
Just the aura alone is terrifying enough to kill a Fourth Tribulation Eminence.
Snowjade was somewhat puzzled.
What’s the source of the aura?
Even the aura emitted by a legendary Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s corpse could only control Tribulation realm experts, changing their bloodline. The emitted aura wouldn’t kill a Fourth Tribulation Eminence directly.
Is it some treasure in the River of Spacetime or a living being?
Palace Lord Snowjade’s body glowed with an ice-jade luster as he advanced without slowing down.
“Palace Lord, Palace Lord.”
A voice cried for help.
Huh?
Snowjade frowned slightly.
Inside his grotto-heaven, Palace Lord Snowjade’s figure condensed. He looked at Emperor Roc’s Essence Soul avatar, who was bowing respectfully.
“Palace Lord.” Emperor Roc’s Essence Soul avatar said anxiously, “I encountered an enemy, Meng Chuan. My true body was captured, and my treasures were taken away.”
“Your treasures have been taken? He imprisoned your outer realm true body?” Snowjade frowned slightly. The treasures his subordinates obtained in the cave abode were his to begin with. Meng Chuan robbing Emperor Roc’s treasures was equivalent to robbing him of his treasures, so he naturally wasn’t pleased. He then asked, “What’s his background?”
Emperor Roc immediately said, “Palace Lord, this Meng Chuan comes from Archean Eon Realm!”
“Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s Archean Eon Realm?” Snowjade was somewhat astonished.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon was the only Seventh Tribulation Eminence that had been born in Three Bay River System over the years. Palace Lord Snowjade naturally knew about him.
“Yes.” Emperor Roc continued, “As you know, Archean Eon Realm neighbors my homeworld, and we have formed a huge grudge with each other. This Meng Chuan quickly rose to prominence. In Archean Eon Realm, he is also known as Imperial Lord Eastcalm. His strength was considered normal. After cultivating for about 100 years, his strength was only at the perfected Supremacy realm.”
In the World Gap, Meng Chuan revealed his full strength very clearly. At his strongest, he was only comparable to Monarch Peacock.
“Later, he entered the outer realm. In just a few decades, his strength reached the Tribulation realm,” explained Emperor Roc. “Furthermore, he’s suspected to be at the Fifth Tribulation realm now.”
“He’s suspected to be at the Fifth Tribulation realm after a few decades in the outer realm?” No matter how calm Snowjade was, he found it unbelievable.
“Therefore, I suspect that it might be an opportunity left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon, which allowed him to enter a special mystic realm,” said Emperor Roc. “It might seem like he only spent a few decades in the outer realm, but maybe more than 10,000 years have passed in the mystic realm. This time, he tracked me through our karmic connection and came to this cave abode. He first captured me alive, then used karma to kill two Imperial Lords in my homeworld. He has a huge grudge with my homeworld. He imprisoned me because he wants to have full confidence in killing all my avatars,” said Emperor Roc.
Snowjade nodded slightly. “I understand. If he really has reached the Fifth Tribulation realm, nobody will be able to kill him cleanly. Since he wants to kill you... you can only rely on yourself if you want to live.”
“I understand,” replied Emperor Roc with a bow of his head. He naturally understood this logic. Only an Eighth Tribulation Eminence could kill a Fifth Tribulation Eminence with an inhabited world in the way! The probability of such a thing happening was negligible.
Therefore, after confirming that Meng Chuan had reached the Fifth Tribulation realm, Emperor Roc felt despair. All he could do now was work hard to become stronger, making it difficult for Meng Chuan to kill him completely. If Emperor Roc reached the Fifth Tribulation realm one day, he would naturally be able to roam the River of Spacetime fearlessly.
...
With those thoughts in mind, Snowjade continued advancing through the deep passageway.
Imperial Lord Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, is suspected to be at the Fifth Tribulation realm? It’s getting more and more interesting.
Snowjade endured the pressure and continued advancing. Finally, Snowjade reached the end of the deep tunnel and arrived in a huge cave.
The massive cave spanned about 5,000 kilometers.
Snowjade walked out of the passageway and entered the cave. At a glance, he saw a massive head at the end of the cave.
The head was about 500 kilometers tall. It had two black curved horns, and its skin was black. It only had a single blood-colored, vertical eye! Its mouth was gaping, spanning about 250 kilometers long; within its mouth were mountain peak-like teeth.
Chains were embedded in the head and rooted in its skull, face, ears, and mouth. Large amounts of energy passed through the chains to everywhere in the lair.
Oh?
Snowjade’s expression changed drastically.
Although the chains trapped the gigantic head and its huge mouth, making it unable to move, its blood-colored vertical eye was glowing as it stared at Snowjade.
With the blood-colored eye staring at him, Snowjade felt stifled and horrified. His body instantly froze, unable to move.
Break! Break! Break!
Snowjade took a few seconds to resist the blood-colored vertical eye’s influence completely and regain control of himself.
This made him look at the gigantic head in horror.
A forbidden creature at the Sixth Tribulation realm?
Snowjade was shocked. He had seen a forbidden creature once, but the one he had encountered was only at the Fifth Tribulation realm. However, the feeling was similar.
The head in front of him was even more terrifying than the one he had once encountered. If it hadn’t been completely imprisoned, the blood-colored eye could have killed him with a single stare. It could devour him with a single gulp.
He was out of options.
The strength difference between Tribulation Eminences increased the further one progressed. A Fifth Tribulation Eminence could easily crush a Fourth Tribulation Eminence, but a Sixth Tribulation Eminence’s suppression of a Fifth Tribulation Eminence was even more terrifying.
For example, a monstrous genius who created an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique could reach the Fifth Tribulation realm in a short period of time. However, that monstrous genius might spend their entire life trying to reach the Sixth Tribulation realm.
Sixth Tribulation realm.
Palace Lord Snowjade stood in the cave and stared at the imprisoned Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature. The forbidden creature’s blood-colored vertical eye kept staring at him. Even though he could resist the vertical eye’s influence, he still felt immense pressure.
Whoosh.
Fog flew out from the gaping mouth that was hundreds of kilometers long. It condensed into a man with a human body and a snake tail.
“This sinful creature’s mouth is the core of the cave abode.” After the snake-tailed man flew out, he smiled at Snowjade and said, “Only one of you can reach the end of the cave abode.”
“Can I enter now?” Snowjade looked at the snake-tailed man. He could tell at a glance that he was a Guardian and not a true lifeform.
“No.” The snake-tailed man shook his head. “After the one-year deadline, all lifeforms that arrive here will engage in one final battle. Only the final victor will be able to enter.”
Palace Lord Snowjade didn’t say another word. He could sense layers of array formations on the gigantic head. They were something that could even imprison a Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature. If he wasn’t allowed to enter, he would be tempting fate if he dared to barge in.
...
Half a month later.
“Oh?” The hunchbacked Old Fiend Black Wind also arrived. When he saw the huge chained head, his face turned pale. The blood-colored vertical eye turned to look at Black Wind.
Black Wind was horrified. It took him almost ten seconds to withstand the suppression.
A forbidden creature at the Sixth Tribulation realm?
Black Wind was alarmed as well. Soon, he discovered the chains’ uses.
What a powerful sealing method. It completely imprisons the Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature. Furthermore, it seems to draw upon this forbidden creature’s strength to supply energy to the entire cave abode.
Black Wind immediately turned to look at Snowjade.
Snowjade stood by the side with his eyes closed as he waited silently.
“Snowjade, you came really quickly,” said Black Wind with a smile.
Snowjade opened his eyes and glanced at Black Wind before closing them again.
...
Another half a month passed.
The skinny Ta Gu arrived. When he saw the huge head, his body trembled for a few seconds before he resisted the forbidden creature’s aura. This was because he had known about this cave abode’s layout long ago. He also knew that there was a terrifying forbidden creature imprisoned here.
Since his mind was prepared, he naturally escaped the aura’s influence faster.
They came earlier than me?
Ta Gu was somewhat surprised when he saw Snowjade and Black Wind. Following that, he turned to look at the Guardian—who had a human body and snake tail. He said loudly, “The other lifeforms in this cave abode should have given up on the exploration. Only the three of us are at the Fifth Tribulation realm. Let’s quickly engage in the final battle.”
“No rush.” The snake-tailed man smiled and said, “There’s one more person still advancing.”
“It’s been ten months. There are still people advancing through the cave abode?” Ta Gu was puzzled.
Black Wind and Snowjade remained calm. Both of them knew that an unknown fifth Tribulation Eminence had entered the cave abode.
Imperial Lord Eastcalm, Meng Chuan?
Snowjade thought to himself. He knew the most about the unfamiliar expert among the three.
...
“Senior, spare me! Spare me!” A lanky gray-robed man was extremely respectful, but he felt bitter in his heart.
He was at the Fourth Tribulation realm. He had deliberately slowed down. With the number of tunnels in the lair, he thought he had made a killing.
Who knew that another Fifth Tribulation Eminence was slower than him! Furthermore, he happened to share the same passageway as him.
Isn’t this Fifth Tribulation Eminence afraid that he will be too slow and have all the best treasures taken by the other Fifth Tribulation Eminences?
The lanky gray-robed man felt aggrieved.
“Spare your life?” The white-haired Meng Chuan looked at him. “You should understand the rules. Hand over all the treasures, and your life will be spared.”
“Yes.” No matter how depressed the gray-robed man was, he obediently handed over the treasures. This was because he had discovered the huge difference in strength between them. Just the illusory Essence Soul World’s suppression made him unable to resist.
If this white-haired man was willing, he could easily kill him and take away all the treasures. He spent 600 Outer Realm Essence Crystals cultivating this outer realm body. It was already not bad if he could retain this body.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan waved his hand and put away the treasures before continuing forward.
He had arrived rather late, so Palace Lord Snowjade, Ta Gu, and Old Fiend Black Wind had all benefited. On the other hand, Meng Chuan’s main gains were obtained from the Fourth Tribulation Eminence and Emperor Roc.
Of course, certain regions in the lair had a lowered threat after the core treasures were removed. Thus, Meng Chuan was able to proceed much faster.
This aura’s pressure...
Meng Chuan also felt a terrifying aura affecting him. He was puzzled by it as he walked through the tunnel.
Why is the aura so strong? Is it a treasure or a living thing?
Soon, Meng Chuan walked out of the deep tunnel and arrived at a huge cave.
The cave was 5,000 kilometers wide. At the end of the cave was a huge imprisoned head. The blood-colored vertical eye on the head stared at Meng Chuan.
As for Snowjade, Black Wind, and Ta Gu, they turned to look at Meng Chuan.
“The last one has arrived.” The snake-tailed man smiled.

chapters.title: Chapter 562 - Forbidden Creature
chapters.content:
Chapter 562: Forbidden Creature
When he was stared at by the giant head’s blood-colored eye, Meng Chuan could sense his will being suppressed.
Huh?
This force was crazy and cold. It carried extreme malice as it attempted to destroy Meng Chuan’s consciousness. However, as an Essence Soul Fifth Tribulation Eminence, Meng Chuan was extremely powerful when it came to spiritual cultivation.
