His willpower far exceeded that of a Physical Body Fifth Tribulation Eminence.
The moment he was affected by the aura, Meng Chuan instinctively resisted it.
That’s...
Meng Chuan was alarmed. He carefully looked at the massive head that was 500 kilometers tall with a black curved horn. He looked at the chains that were embedded in its head, completely sealing its strength.
A forbidden creature?
This was the first time Meng Chuan had seen a forbidden creature.
One of the dossiers left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon focused on forbidden lifeforms. Forbidden existences represented disaster, destruction, and great sin.
In the vast outer realm, there were many special lifeforms. However, one of them was the most special. It was even more special than pure-blooded dragons and phoenixes. It was even specially singled out by Tribulation Eminences out of all the special lifeforms. It was called a forbidden creature!
The birth of a forbidden creature was a mystery. One could be born anywhere in the outer realm, but their numbers were extremely low.
The strengthening of a forbidden creature was different from all cultivators. As long as it devoured other lifeforms, it would become stronger. Even a forbidden creature that had reached the Sixth Tribulation realm could slowly devour low-level worlds. A forbidden creature at the Seventh Tribulation realm could devour middle-level worlds. A legendary Eighth Tribulation forbidden creature could even devour large-sized words.
However, an Eighth Tribulation forbidden creature was even rarer than an ordinary Eighth Tribulation Eminence. They could be treated as myths.
Apart from becoming stronger by consuming life, it also had a special trait—its lifespan was extremely long. To a certain extent, it could exist forever! Of course, only its body existed permanently.
Without any end to its lifespan, its body could live forever. However... its consciousness would eventually decay and collapse after a long period of time. A new consciousness would be born in its body. From life’s perspective, this was already a new life.
If a forbidden creature wanted to become powerful, it had to devour cultivators. It could even devour entire inhabited worlds in the future. Other lifeforms naturally regarded forbidden creatures as sins, so they were known as sinful creates.
Forbidden creatures were the common enemy of all life.
A forbidden creature at the Sixth Tribulation realm was actually captured alive.
Meng Chuan was secretly astonished.
A forbidden creature at this level already has an undying body.
Killing a forbidden creature below the Sixth Tribulation realm wasn’t too difficult. But once a forbidden creature reached the Sixth Tribulation realm, they could hide their Life Core. Even if their bodies were destroyed time and time again, they could quickly recover. They had undying bodies. Only by finding the Life Core could they kill or capture a Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature alive. Therefore, it was very difficult to kill or capture one alive.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan calmed his mind and looked at the other Tribulation Eminences.
The three Fifth Tribulation Eminences—the proud, cold Palace Lord Snowjade, the smiling Old Fiend Black Wind, and the slightly curious Ta Gu—were also alarmed.
This stranger isn’t affected by the blood-colored vertical eye’s stare?
Palace Lord Snowjade and Old Fiend Black Wind spent several seconds to withstand the impact. Ta Gu, who was already prepared for this, took about three seconds to resist it successfully.
What about Meng Chuan? He completely resisted it.
His spiritual cultivation is very strong. He might be at the Essence Soul Fifth Tribulation realm,
guessed Ta Gu, and his eyes lit up.
It’s worth befriending him.
Essence Soul Fifth Tribulation realm?
Black Wind’s smile became even warmer.
The higher the Tribulation realm, the fewer Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences there were. They also became more useful.
“I’m Ta Gu from Shura Realm,” said Ta Gu.
Black Wind chuckled. “My name is Black Wind. I’m from the Yufang River System.”
While the two of them showed their friendliness to the white-haired man, Snowjade remained silent with a cold expression.
Meng Chuan smiled. “Greetings everyone, I’m Eastcalm.”
It was very difficult for a Fifth Tribulation Eminence to be killed. Therefore, there was no need for them to form a deep grudge unless absolutely necessary.
“The other living beings in the cave abode have already given up on advancing,” said the man with the snake tail. His voice resounded throughout the cave. “Now, the final victor will emerge from the four of you. Only the final victor can enter the cave abode and obtain the most important treasure in this cave abode’s opening.”
Ta Gu’s eyes lit up. He knew how valuable this cave abode’s treasures were.
Meng Chuan, Snowjade, and Black Wind were also filled with anticipation.
Meng Chuan and company knew that the owner of the cave abode wouldn’t be stingy, especially when one took into account the captured Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature, which was kept alive so that its energy could power the cave abode.
“We have four people here. How do we compete? A battle royale?” asked Black Wind.
“Master has long set the rules,” said the snake-tailed man smilingly. “I’ll preside over the cave abode’s final battle. I will expel whoever doesn’t follow the cave abode’s rules. If the rules are followed, you will receive a reward, even if you ultimately fail,” said the man with the snake tail.
Meng Chuan, Palace Lord Snowjade, Old Fiend Black Wind, and Ta Gu obediently followed the rules, no matter how high their talent was, how arrogant they were, or how powerful their background was. It was better to follow the rules in a cave abode created by an unknown Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
The snake-tailed man flipped his hand, and four stones appeared in his palm. Two were dark-red, and two were pale-white.
“I’ll randomly throw these four stones out, which will fly towards you separately. Those who obtain the same color will be in the same group,” said the man with the snake tail calmly. “The people in each group will fight one another until one side admits defeat or is killed. Only then will the winner be decided. The winner of those battles will engage in another battle... to decide the final victor.”
With that said, four stones floated high in the air.
Bam!
Invisible waves struck the four rocks. The four rocks rolled and collided, but they flew towards Meng Chuan and company strangely and precisely.
A pale-white stone flew towards Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan looked at the pale-white stone in front of him and noticed a pale white stone in front of Black Wind. Black Wind smiled at Meng Chuan. “Brother Eastcalm, it looks like I’ll fight you first.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. Of the three people in front of him, he only knew a little more about Palace Lord Snowjade.
Meng Chuan had bought information about Three Bay River System’s experts at Eternal Tower, but he didn’t know about Black Wind and Ta Gu.
“You and me?” Ta Gu looked at Snowjade. There were dark-red stones in front of them. They clearly had to fight each other.
“According to the order of arrival,” said the man with the snake tail as he pointed at Snowjade and Ta Gu, “the two of you will fight first. As for the other two, watch from the side. You are not to interfere.”
...
Meng Chuan and Old Fiend Black Wind arrived beside the gigantic head. They stood in a corner with the snake-tailed man. At the same time, an array formation rose and enveloped 90% of the cave. It also enveloped Snowjade and Ta Gu.
The spectators were naturally outside the array formation, unable to interfere with the battle.
“Before the outcome is decided, the two of you are unable to leave the array formation zone,” said the snake-tailed man. “You may begin.”
Snowjade stood there like an unmovable iceberg. At the same time, an invisible chill spread out, filling the entire array formation.
Ta Gu completely retracted his aura and allowed the frosty aura to attack him.
Neither party was in a hurry to attack.
Meng Chuan, who was outside the formation, looked up when he approached the giant head. He saw the sinful creature’s mountain-like teeth. The aura emitted by this sinful creature was much stronger than before.
This sinful creature’s aura and intent are somewhat similar to Saber of Nirvana.
Saber of Nirvana was Meng Chuan’s first technique to reach the Heaven Earth realm. However, he realized that the technique had flaws. Due to it being flawed, he couldn’t use it to cultivate his body and Essence Soul. Therefore, he deliberately slowed down.
If I use Saber of Nirvana as the core to my body cultivation and Essence Soul cultivation, my life force might be close to that of a forbidden creature.
Only after Infinite Saber reached the perfected Heaven Earth realm did he dare to cultivate Saber of Nirvana with full effort.
After all, Tribulation realm cultivation focused on controlling spacetime and all laws beneath it. However, before one’s foundation was strong enough, some laws couldn’t be studied deeply. There would be many terrifying consequences if one studied certain laws too deeply with a weak foundation.
Meng Chuan’s current foundation was sufficient. However, Saber of Nirvana remained at the Heaven Earth Realm’s late stage. It was only one step away from reaching the perfected Heaven Earth realm.
Saber of Nirvana, perfected Heaven Earth realm?
Meng Chuan sensed the forbidden creature’s aura that resembled Nirvana. Ideas came to his mind. He naturally began to refine Saber of Nirvana and pushed it towards perfection.

chapters.title: Chapter 563 - Saber of Nirvana
chapters.content:
Chapter 563: Saber of Nirvana
At the same time, in Three Bay River System.
Deep in a Chaos Hole.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar came here. As a Fifth Tribulation Eminence, his Essence Soul avatars were powerful enough to enter deep into a Chaos Hole.
Nirvana?
Meng Chuan was inspired by the forbidden creature. He felt that his Saber of Nirvana could reach the perfected Heaven Earth realm at any moment. At this moment, he carefully studied the Chaos Hole’s operations. This was because Saber of Nirvana originated from a Chaos Hole.
Meng Chuan looked up and saw rays of light being absorbed by the Chaos Hole. The light couldn’t escape the black hole. At the same time, some matter in the outer realm was sucked into the Chaos Hole. As they went deeper, the matter completely disintegrated.
The Chaos Hole seemed to have infinite destructive power. It devoured and destroyed everything, making everything a part of the darkness!
Only Seventh Tribulation Eminences and stronger can reach the Chaos Hole’s core. Those weaker will completely disintegrate before they can reach the Chaos Hole’s core. They will be reduced to nothingness.
Meng Chuan looked at the matter that was constantly being sucked into the Chaos Hole’s core. His outer realm true body looked at the forbidden creature’s huge head in the cave abode as the ideas created sparks in his mind.
It was relatively easy for one to improve a technique to the Heaven Earth realm, allowing one to push straight for perfection.
Saber of Nirvana had already reached the Heaven Earth realm’s late stage for a long time. He had accumulated plenty of insights. Now that he had gained inspiration, he continued to perfect the technique after processing his ideas. In just an hour, he was done.
With the various combined powers, it will be Nirvana.
Meng Chuan suddenly brightened up.
Standing in the dark Chaos Hole’s depths, Meng Chuan waved his hand. Lightning Dwarf Star—a Tribulation treasure—appeared and flew out.
The moment it flew out, it transformed into a dark star.
This dark star turned into a black light beam. Wherever it passed, it would leave tears in the fabric of spacetime. It left a wake of annihilation as it flew.
It silently swept past and annihilated everything, causing everything to return to nothingness. This was a portion of a Chaos Hole’s Nirvana’s might.
Others might only think of it as a black light beam, but Meng Chuan saw it as the Lightning Dwarf Star transformed into a light beam. It was also a wave. Its power stacked and completely fused together, forming a terrifying annihilation force. The incomparably terrifying annihilation force’s might further condensed and turned into a beam of light. This was the ultimate goal of Nirvana.
This black beam represented the most terrifying destructive force. It had surpassed the annihilation powers of the most terrifying Grand Yang Divine Fire—which came from Grand Yang Stars.
What a terrifying move. One’s body and Essence Soul represent life. However, this move’s intent is completely different from life. It’s indeed not suitable to be one’s cultivation core.
Meng Chuan was delighted about creating such a powerful move.
Infinite Saber pursued extreme speed. It was much more inferior when it came to pure destructive power.
Grand Yang Divine Fire and Wind of Annihilation were famous for their destructive powers. They far surpassed Infinite Saber’s paramount speed laws. As for Saber of Nirvana, it made up for Meng Chuan’s weakness. In terms of destructive power, it was one of the best Fifth Tribulation techniques.
Unfortunately, the combined might of these two ultimate techniques is still far from the Sixth Tribulation realm.
Meng Chuan shook his head slightly.
According to historical experience, one would typically have a high chance of creating a Sixth Tribulation technique by fusing three Fifth Tribulation realm laws.
If one was lucky, one law would be of the time lineage, and another would be of the void lineage. If the compatibility of these laws were extremely high, one could fuse these two Fifth Tribulation realm laws and create a Sixth Tribulation technique.
However, it clearly wasn’t easy...
Meng Chuan’s Infinite Saber’s laws were purely of the time lineage, but Saber of Nirvana contained both time laws and spatial laws. In fact, it was quite common for techniques to consist of both spatial laws and time laws. After all, everything existed in spacetime. These two techniques had quite a good compatibility, but they were still far from reaching the Sixth Tribulation realm after fusing.
I’m much more confident in clearing the mysterious cave abode after creating two Fifth Tribulation techniques.
Although he cultivated both his body and Essence Soul, he was still a newly-advanced Fifth Tribulation Eminence. He only had the confidence to stay alive when facing Palace Lord Snowjade, Ta Gu, and Black Wind. He didn’t have the confidence to defeat them.
Now, he was much more confident.
...
Inside the mysterious cave abode, which was located in Yufang River System.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar cultivated in the Chaos Hole for an hour before breaking through completely. However, only a few seconds had passed in this mysterious cave abode.
Huh?
Meng Chuan looked up at the gigantic head, and his eyes lit up slightly.
He had finally figured it out. His Saber of Nirvana had now reached the perfected Heaven Earth realm.
He had two Fifth Tribulation ultimate techniques. However, it would be difficult for him to improve them further. For example, his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique had failed to reach the Fourth Tribulation realm, even after so many years.
“Brother Eastcalm, who do you think will win?” asked Black Wind with a chuckle.
“Ta Gu probably,” said Meng Chuan casually. “After all, he’s from the Shura Realm, a high-level world.”
Black Wind nodded. “I’m also optimistic about Ta Gu’s chances.”
The two watched the battle intently.
Inside the array formation.
Palace Lord Snowjade stood there as the frosty aura invaded Ta Gu’s body.
“Since you aren’t attacking, I’ll attack first.” Ta Gu smiled slightly. His figure instantly blurred as he appeared in front of Snowjade. A black saber slashed at him.
Only then did Snowjade extend his palm. He wore a golden glove, and there was a crystalline layer of ice on the glove’s surface. His palm pressed down on the black saber’s blade. With a thrust, his palm stabbed towards Ta Gu’s chest, only to see Ta Gu’s chest robe tremble slightly. The attack failed to pierce through.
Chi!
A blood-colored saber beam struck Snowjade.
Two sabers; one black saber in the light and one blood-colored saber in the dark. The blood-colored saber stabbed towards Snowjade’s abdomen, but it failed to pierce through the ice layer on the surface. This caused Ta Gu’s expression to change slightly.
Pfft.
Clang!
Palace Lord Snowjade stood rooted to the ground and only waved his palms. As for Ta Gu, his figure blurred as he constantly attacked.
Both parties allowed each other to attack their bodies at times. They were clearly very confident in their bodies.
In just a few seconds, they had already exchanged hundreds of blows.
As Physical Body Tribulation Eminences, they were best at close combat. Each move was extremely restrained, but their strength was extremely terrifying.
“Those who come from the Shura Realm have rather strong bodies,” praised Snowjade.
How is that possible?
Ta Gu already felt that something was amiss. He actually didn’t have an advantage in a head-on clash?
According to Eternal Tower’s intelligence, Palace Lord Snowjade cultivates the ice lineage. Although his defense is very strong, how can he withstand Ta Gu’s attacks without taking any damage?
Meng Chuan was somewhat shocked.
“Snowjade’s strength?” Black Wind’s expression changed slightly.
“Since you have no other moves, there’s no need to delay this any further,” said Snowjade indifferently.
Pfft—
His palm instantly thrust through Ta Gu’s chest.
Ta Gu looked down at the white arm in shock.
Snowjade’s palm had completely pierced through his chest.
Pfft! Pfft! Pfft!
Almost instantly, the illusory palm tore through Ta Gu’s body.
Ta Gu’s body instantly collapsed into a pool of blood.
With a flash, the blood condensed and reformed Ta Gu’s body at the array formation’s periphery, which was thousands of kilometers away.
Palace Lord Snowjade’s expression remained cold. He appeared at the edge of the array formation almost simultaneously and shattered Ta Gu’s newly-condensed body.
Blood constantly flowed!
The pool of blood instantly traversed from one corner of the array formation to another corner. It constantly changed positions, but Snowjade followed like a shadow, destroying his newly-condensed body time and time again.
If this continues, he will only need an hour to destroy my body completely.
Ta Gu, who was in the form of blood, understood his current situation.
If he was outside, he would be able to escape far away because the array formation’s restrictions wouldn’t be affecting him. However, this time, they had to fight within the array formation until a victor emerged.
Furthermore, I probably won’t be able to escape his pursuit in the outside world if I don’t use my life-preservation items.
Ta Gu could tell.
Apart from being skilled at the ice lineage, he also has a Fifth Tribulation technique of the void lineage.
Apart from the ice’s sharpness, Snowjade’s palm contained more profound void lineage laws. This was why it could penetrate his body.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The blood that had been fleeing all this time spoke suddenly. “I admit defeat.”
Only after Ta Gu admitted defeat did Snowjade stop.
The array formation temporarily retracted its might. The snake-tailed man nodded and said, “We’ve decided on a winner. The two of you will be next.” As he spoke, he looked at Meng Chuan and Black Wind.
Meng Chuan and Black Wind nodded slightly before flying towards the array formation.
“Snowjade, you sure hid your strength well,” said Black Wind with a laugh. “You actually comprehended a second Fifth Tribulation technique. Even with our relationship, you have been hiding it from me all this time.”
“Why should I tell you?” said Snowjade coldly.
Black Wind was taken aback, but he quickly chuckled. “That’s really in character.”
Snowjade and Ta Gu flew to a corner to watch the battle between Black Wind and Meng Chuan.
“Impressive,” said Ta Gu as he smiled.
“Your Shura Realm’s body is rather powerful. I can shatter your body, but it’s difficult for me to exhaust your Shura blood,” said Snowjade.
However, Ta Gu wasn’t smug. Although he had comprehended Fifth Tribulation laws’ profundities, his technique usage was still inferior to Snowjade! Those who came from Shura Realm were famous for their life-preservation abilities.
However, their ancestors’ help was limited. When there was a huge difference in realm, Ta Gu had nothing to say about his loss.
For example, pure-blooded dragons and phoenixes had extremely high talent because of their ancestors. However, when they encountered a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, they had to bow their heads obediently. Even if a Seventh Tribulation Eminence captured a pure-blooded dragon or phoenix to refine their bloodlines, the two species didn’t dare say anything.
This was the outer realm. One had to rely on strength to have any say!
...
The array formation rose once again.
Inside the array formation, Meng Chuan and Black Wind faced each other.
As long as I defeat the victor of this battle, I’ll be able to obtain this cave abode’s treasures.
Snowjade’s eyes burned with anticipation.
Soon... I’m about to succeed.
He thought nothing of Black Wind.
Meng Chuan? To Snowjade, he was only a newly-advanced Fifth Tribulation Eminence. He didn’t pose much of a threat.

chapters.title: Chapter 564 - Old Fiend Black Wind
chapters.content:
Chapter 564: Old Fiend Black Wind
Old Fiend Black Wind looked at Meng Chuan carefully. No matter who he faced, he wasn’t careless. He would still be careful even if he were dealing with a Fourth Tribulation Eminence, much less someone at the Fifth Tribulation realm.
A long, long time ago...
When he was still at the Fourth Tribulation realm, he could be said to be invincible among his peers. Furthermore, with his ferocious personality, he thought nothing about opponents at the same level. However, this led to him suffering a terrible defeat.
The price he paid was immense, but it taught him a lesson he would never forget.
Although he still addressed himself as Old Fiend Black Wind, he was on good terms with everyone. He didn’t easily offend cultivators of the same level. He focused more on his cultivation.
I believe I’ve accumulated enough insights after cultivating for more than 30,000 years.
Black Wind felt mixed emotions.
However, Snowjade, who is much younger than me, is now one step ahead of me. He has already grasped two Fifth Tribulation laws. Compared to Snowjade and company, my talent is still lacking. I need to focus on my cultivation even more.
Black Wind stared at Meng Chuan.
Now, I should fight Eastcalm with all my strength and defeat him.
...
Meng Chuan stood in the array formation. There was a string of beads on his left wrist. It was a Seventh Tribulation treasure from Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasure vault that suited him best—Thirteen Universe Beads.
Boom!
A painting unfolded behind Meng Chuan. In the blink of an eye, it enveloped the entire array formation. This painting was a World Treasure. The Essence Soul World’s powers were even more terrifying with the World Treasure as its medium.
In fact, Meng Chuan would be at a disadvantage if the cave was only 5,000 kilometers wide. As an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence, his Essence Soul World could cover millions of kilometers. As for Physical Body Tribulation Eminences, they hoped to close the distance when fighting Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences.
Huh?
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World suppressed his opponent’s various aspects.
Black Wind felt the powerful suppression and determined Meng Chuan’s realm.
Essence Soul Fifth Tribulation realm.
Black Wind was very certain of this. He didn’t hesitate to move.
He transformed into a blur and attacked Meng Chuan.
Crackle!
Lightning flashed around Meng Chuan. He was about to jump out of the confines of time to achieve Time Stillness’s effects.
A fish would leave ripples as it swam across the water. The larger the fish was, the greater the disturbance in the water.
Tribulation realm experts were fish, and spacetime was the water.
The stronger a Tribulation Eminence was, the more terrifying the effects on spacetime would be. It was 1,000 times more difficult for Meng Chuan to jump out of time’s confines around an expert. Even accelerating the time flow became very difficult.
A Sixth Tribulation Eminence could simply look over, and it would be pretty good if Meng Chuan could still accelerate the time flow to gain an advantage.
If it were a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, one glance from such an expert would collapse the spacetime around Meng Chuan. His body would be annihilated.
I’m unable to jump out of time’s confines due to a nearby Fifth Tribulation Eminence’s influence.
Meng Chuan realized this.
I can only maintain a 50-fold faster time flow.
The flow of time was relative.
Three seconds for Old Fiend Black Wind was 150 seconds for Meng Chuan. Due to this, he naturally had a huge advantage in battle.
What?
Old Fiend Black Wind instantly lunged at Meng Chuan, but he discovered that Meng Chuan had easily fled thousands of kilometers away. This made Old Demon Black Wind immediately sense the accelerated time flow around Meng Chuan.
The time flow around is 50-fold faster? I won’t be able to catch up to him then!
“That fast?”
“This time flow acceleration...”
Even Ta Gu and Snowjade, who were watching from afar, were slightly shocked.
It was already very good if a Fifth Tribulation Eminence could gain a temporal acceleration advantage. However, Meng Chuan had a 50-fold temporal acceleration advantage. This meant that he was extremely powerful in this aspect.
From the looks of it, the formulation he cultivates focuses on the time lineage. Although he will gain a huge advantage in a certain aspect when focusing on it, he will be weaker in other aspects.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The surging black wind swept across the entire array formation.
My Black Wind Body can vary in size. It can easily fill the entire array formation. Let’s see where you can hide.
The chaotic black wind rapidly spread out. It spread across a 500-kilometer area before covering a 1,500-kilometer area rapidly.
Meng Chuan waved his hand. “Go.”
Bloodblades flew out.
Every Bloodblade rapidly accelerated to light speed. Combined with the temporal acceleration, their speed was even more terrifying.
All of them were extremely dazzling. The Bloodblades—which were moving at light speed—were extremely terrifying.
Infinite Saber!
“Die!” The surging black wind condensed into arms.
Every black wind arm held a weapon. There were spikes, sabers, swords, spears, whips... All sorts of weapons attacked Meng Chuan at the same time. Black Wind didn’t bother blocking the Bloodblades at all.
Rip!
Bloodblades tore through the black wind and struck the void. The wind dissipated, but the Bloodblades failed to injure Black Wind a single bit.
Instead, Black Wind’s weapons constantly attacked Meng Chuan, while the black wind surrounded Meng Chuan and attacked him as well.
I lack strength when I’m only using paramount speed laws. If I encounter a Fifth Tribulation Eminence with strong life-preservation means, I won’t be able to injure him at all.
Meng Chuan made a judgment.
However, my 50-fold temporal acceleration advantage is already very great.
Old Fiend Black Wind is very experienced. He has grasped a Fifth Tribulation law and is also using several Fourth Tribulation laws in conjunction.
Meng Chuan only relied on his Essence Soul World’s suppression and temporal acceleration to dodge the weapons’ attacks.
“Trying to flee?” Black Wind was originally good at speed, but he immediately roared when he encountered the even more slippery Meng Chuan.
Invisible waves came with the roar. These invisible waves spread throughout the array formation and attacked Meng Chuan.
Let’s end this.
Meng Chuan realized that he couldn’t defeat Old Fiend Black Wind with Infinite Saber alone. He wasn’t confident in killing his opponent with Infinite Saber alone unless he used the Thirteen Universe Beads—a Seventh Tribulation treasure. However, the Bloodblade Disc was a Sixth Tribulation treasure. Furthermore, it was Meng Chuan’s intrinsic treasure. Just the Bloodblade Disc alone was enough to deal with enemies. Only if it were a special situation would he use the Thirteen Universe Beads.
After experimenting with Infinite Saber during his first battle with a Fifth Tribulation Eminence, Meng Chuan brought out the big guns.
Boom!
The Bloodblades surrounding Meng Chuan suddenly changed.
He maintained the 50-fold faster time flow as the Bloodblades instantly gathered terrifying might. The infinite might fused together, forming a destructive force. This destructive force—Power of Annihilation—then condensed into black light beams.
Several black light beams appeared!
This is...
Snowjade, who was watching from the side, originally felt that everything was within expectations. However, Snowjade instinctively felt fear when the Bloodblades transformed into the black light beams...
The black light beams’ annihilative properties were terrifying. It contained greater power than when the Bloodblades were moving at light speed.
This Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence named Eastcalm has grasped two Fifth Tribulation laws?
Ta Gu was alarmed as well.
Snowjade is stronger than me; Eastcalm is also stronger than me. However, I can obtain a treasure simply by coming to this cave. My goal has been achieved.
...
Oh?
Black Wind also sensed that something was amiss. He instinctively used his weapons to block the black light beams.
Clang!
A saber and a spear were flung far away.
When they exchanged blows, Black Wind couldn’t even hold his weapons firmly. From this, one could tell how terrifying the black light beams were.
Apart from the saber and spear, none of the other weapons were able to block the black light beams. In fact, the black light beams’ had average speed and average agility. However, the black light beams became much faster when influenced by the 50-fold faster time flow. They became difficult to block or dodge.
Chi!
The Bloodblades flew through the black wind in the form of black light beams, covering the entire array formation.
Every spot the black light beams swept across erased the black wind.
Not good.
The black winds instantly gathered and converged into Old Demon Black Wind’s original appearance. However, he now had eight arms and a weapon in each hand. After his body shrank, his defense became even more perfect.
The black light beams were simply too fast when affected by the 50-fold faster time flow.
Bam! Bam! Bam!
Black Wind’s weapons were sent flying one after another. Black Wind revealed a look of disbelief.
I can’t even defend against this?
Following that, multiple black light beams penetrated his body.
“I admit defeat,” said Black Wind loudly.
He was out of options. The already powerful Saber of Nirvana naturally changed qualitatively once affected by a 50-fold faster time flow. Meng Chuan completely crushed Old Fiend Black Wind. All Black Wind could do was take a beating.
I have the confidence to stay alive when facing Snowjade and Ta Gu. But my movement speed—which is what I’m best at—is restrained by Eastcalm. I’m afraid that my Black Wind Body will be destroyed in a moment. He really restrains me the most.
Black Wind realized this. Logically speaking, he had cultivated for more than 30,000 years and had many means available to him. However, this mysterious, white-haired Eastcalm was his greatest nemesis.
I won. There’s only one opponent left.
Meng Chuan looked at Snowjade.

chapters.title: Chapter 565 - Meng Chuan and Palace Lord Snowjade
chapters.content:
Chapter 565: Meng Chuan and Palace Lord Snowjade
Soon, Meng Chuan and Snowjade stood in the array formation.
Only the victor of this round could reach the end of this expedition.
Palace Lord Snowjade was dressed in a light-blue robe. There were faint blue patterns on his face, and his eyes were like dark-blue jade as he stared at Meng Chuan. His gaze was extremely oppressive. However, Meng Chuan’s eyes were very calm. He knew the least about this cave abode. His main goal for coming here was capturing Emperor Roc. Now that he had achieved his goal, the cave abode treasures were just an additional surprise.
Ta Gu and Old Fiend Black Wind were observing Meng Chuan from a distant corner.
Although Goddess River Zone was vast, almost all Fifth Tribulation Eminences were famous. As for the white-haired man, Eastcalm, he was unheard of. They had never heard of him before.
“I’ve never heard of an Essence Soul Fifth Tribulation Eminence grasping two Fifth Tribulation laws,” Ta Gu whispered.
“He must have stepped into the Fifth Tribulation realm for a long time if he has grasped two Fifth Tribulation laws,” said Black Wind. “I’ve never heard of him before. He probably comes from a distant river zone.”
...
Whoosh!
A painting appeared behind Meng Chuan. The painting unfurled and instantly enveloped the entire array formation.
Palace Lord Snowjade’s ice domain resisted the Essence Soul World, but the Essence Soul World’s remnant might still pressed down on his body. The terrifying pressure could even crush a star. As for Palace Lord Snowjade, the layer of ice over his body easily withstood the pressure.
“I never expected our Three Bay River System to produce another Fifth Tribulation Eminence. Furthermore, you have cultivated to such a realm,” said Snowjade indifferently. “I heard from Emperor Roc that you are only a newly-advanced Fifth Tribulation Eminence. To my surprise, you have grasped two Fifth Tribulation laws. Have you obtained Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s opportunities and entered a mystic realm? Have you been cultivating for a long time?”
Meng Chuan smiled. “That golden roc told you quite a lot.”
Snowjade’s eyes narrowed slightly.
He had cultivated from a low-level world to this day. For the sake of a fortuitous encounter, he had to risk his life and suffer countless hardships to attain his present achievements. As for Meng Chuan and Ta Gu—who had obtained the benefits left behind by their ancestors—they could easily obtain a large number of treasures and opportunities from the treasures left behind by their ancestors once they reached the Fifth Tribulation realm! Snowjade naturally found it unfair. He felt that Meng Chuan and Ta Gu’s accomplishments would be far inferior to his given the same conditions.
However, he had forgotten that the predecessors of medium-sized and high-level worlds had to go through a lot to obtain such a rich heritage.
For example, it was extremely difficult for Ancestral Master Archean Eon to cultivate to become a Seventh Tribulation Eminence from a low-level world. Only with all his achievements in life could he provide some help to his juniors. However, his juniors still needed to rely on themselves to achieve great accomplishments in the end. After more than one million years, not a single Fourth Tribulation Eminence had been born in Archean Eon Realm before Meng Chuan.
Under the threat of the demons, Meng Chuan had reached the Fifth Tribulation realm in a short period of time. He was already stunning. If he was weaker, he would probably have died before he grew in strength.
Boom!
Snowjade suddenly moved.
Crackle!
Lightning appeared around Meng Chuan. His speed instantly changed as he maintained a 30-fold faster time flow around him. It was clear that Snowjade had a greater influence on spacetime.
Meng Chuan’s movement technique was naturally astonishing when affected by the 30-fold faster time flow.
One of them wanted to close in, while the other dodged.
As he dodged, Meng Chuan was surprised to discover that Snowjade had been chasing after him.
He had the advantage of time. If he didn’t have the advantage of time, his opponent would have easily gotten close to him.
Even while suppressed by my Essence Soul World, he can instantly appear anywhere within the array formation. What a powerful void technique.
Go.
Bloodblades circled Meng Chuan before transforming into black beams. There were 36 of them.
Snowjade’s pupils constricted. In a flash, he was thousands of kilometers away. However, a black light beam still appeared near him.
Bam!
Snowjade gently flicked his glove-wearing palm. The black light beam and palm collided and produced a bassy sound. Snowjade frowned slightly, but he deliberately didn’t block the second black light beam, allowing it to strike him.
Chi—
The ice layer on Snowjade’s body contained miniature voids. The protective ice layer contained hundreds of millions of miniature voids. When the black light beam struck the ice layer, it cleaved open a tiny void... After splitting the ice layer completely, the black light beam struck the light-blue robe.
Snowjade’s robe caved in slightly as the terrifying might seeped into his body. His body could fully withstand the impact.
What?
Meng Chuan discovered that his saber—Saber of Nirvana—beam had failed to cause any real damage to Snowjade.
Snowjade’s defensive means—resulting from the combination of two Fifth Tribulation laws—were clearly powerful enough.
“Impressive. Do you dare to withstand 36 strikes?” Meng Chuan smiled as 36 black light beams attacked Snowjade.
“Humph.” Snowjade snorted coldly. Did he think he was that stupid? He only wanted to test the strength of Meng Chuan’s strike.
The 36 black light beams struck Snowjade’s body simultaneously. With the combined might, even he would be severely injured.
Palace Lord Snowjade’s figure was like a ghost as he constantly flickered in and out of the array formation’s range. With his movement technique, only a maximum of five of the 36 Bloodblades could strike him simultaneously, even when affected by the 30-fold faster time flow. With his defensive means, the Bloodblade Disc posed little threat to him.
It was also because Meng Chuan had just broken through. His fusion of the two Fifth Tribulation laws was still too crude.
Palace Lord Snowjade was slightly stronger. He had combined his two Fifth Tribulation laws more ingeniously. Be it in defense or offense, it was better than Meng Chuan’s.
Suppress!
Snowjade used his trump card.
Absolute Cold combined with Void Territory!
Frost appeared in the 5,000-kilometer-wide array formation. Everything froze completely.
Meng Chuan felt a terrifying coldness affecting his body.
Everything froze, turning everything still.
This move was extremely powerful. Even if an ordinary Fifth Tribulation Eminence could move, their speed would be greatly reduced. However, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World—which was aided by a World Treasure—blocked most of the killer move’s might. The remaining strength was much lesser.
Even with his Essence Soul World weakening my attack, his weak body will probably slow down greatly.
Palace Lord Snowjade flashed and approached Meng Chuan. He wanted to impale Meng Chuan’s head with his saber. “It’s over!”
Meng Chuan looked at him and didn’t dodge.
Boom!
A black Magic Awl flew out from Meng Chuan’s side and instantly struck Snowjade.
Magic Awl Forbidden Spell!
The Magic Awl—which was condensed with 30% of his Essence Soul Origins—was terrifyingly fast. There was no way to dodge it as it stabbed into Snowjade’s body.
Snowjade’s body trembled as his eyes widened!
Mortals, even Supremacies and Imperial Lords, could not block Essence Soul attacks with their bodies.
However, Physical Body Tribulation Eminences had long cultivated their bodies to perfection. One characteristic of a perfected body was that they could block Essence Soul attacks! The stronger one’s body was, the stronger their resistance to Essence Soul attacks would be. For example, even an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s mystic technique could not crack Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s physical defense.
However, Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences focused more on one specific aspect—will impact!
The forbidden creature’s blood-colored vertical eye—which could make Snowjade and Black Wind freeze for a few seconds with a single glance—was a pure attack on one’s will.
“Ah.” Snowjade felt a boom inside his body. The terrifying impact on his will caused his consciousness to turn chaotic. He could only divert a small portion of his attention to deal with the battle outside.
Whoosh!
The black Magic Awl dissipated into countless points of light. Under the Essence Soul Star’s guidance, almost all the points of light returned to Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul.
With a thought, Meng Chuan condensed another Magic Awl.
After reaching the Essence Soul Fifth Tribulation realm, the indestructible characteristic of an Essence Soul became even more obvious. After cultivating the Essence Soul Star, moves like Starlight were considered normal moves. He could instantly recover from losing 30% of his Essence Soul Origins. In comparison, Starlight was inferior to the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!
The Magic Awl struck Snowjade’s body repeatedly. Even with his body blocking the attacks, they still struck his will and consciousness.
It was like a sledgehammer smashing down.
The Magic Awl repeatedly shattered before condensing again and again as it struck out continuously!
With the Essence Soul Star’s recovery speed coupled with the Magic Awl’s might, Meng Chuan’s attack on Snowjade’s consciousness was extremely powerful.
What’s going on?
Palace Lord Snowjade felt his head buzzing. He could only use a small portion of his mental strength to deal with the battle in the outside world. He could only unleash 30% of his full strength.
“This is...” Ta Gu and Old Fiend Black Wind were astonished when they saw this scene from afar. They could see the Essence Soul weapon, Magic Awl, fly out from Meng Chuan’s body and attack Snowjade repeatedly.
In the blink of an eye, Meng Chuan’s Magic Awl attacked more than ten times.
Snowjade’s movement speed slowed down.
It’s an Essence Soul attack at the Essence Soul Tribulation realm.
Ta Gu’s pupils constricted.
Palace Lord Snowjade’s will is within his body, giving him an advantage. His body has the ability to block it. As for Eastcalm’s will impact, it relies on an Essence Soul weapon. How can it reduce Snowjade’s strength greatly?
Even with his body blocking it, he can’t withstand the will impact caused by Eastcalm’s Essence Soul weapon?
Black Wind was also alarmed. It was very rare to see such a scene when peers at the same level fought.

chapters.title: Chapter 566 - Meng Chuan’s Age
chapters.content:
Chapter 566: Meng Chuan’s Age
It was indeed rare.
Since Snowjade could reach the Fifth Tribulation realm, it meant that his willpower had definitely reached a certain threshold. The fact that he was suppressed by Meng Chuan’s will impact meant that Meng Chuan was too powerful in this aspect!
In fact, Meng Chuan was considered one of the best at the Fifth Tribulation realm when it came to willpower. However, his will impact’s strength was mostly due to an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s legacy—Essence Soul Star—and the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell. If Meng Chuan only had the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell, he would require ten minutes to recover completely after his Magic Awl shattered.
If he only had the Essence Soul Star formulation, his Essence Soul attacks would have lacked power.
With the synergy between the two, he could have his Magic Awl repeatedly shatter and condense, resulting in a seamless attack!
I-I... Snowjade’s head buzzed from the explosion. He was furious and flustered. Is my willpower actually this weak?
His will was suppressed.
When it came to this aspect, his opponent was stronger, while he was weaker at it.
If his willpower was strong enough, it wouldn’t be a problem for him to maintain his lucidity.
This Meng Chuan wasn’t famous in the past. Snowjade knew Meng Chuan’s origins very well. So how can he crush me when it comes to willpower?
Is my will actually this weak? If it’s this weak, what hope do I have of reaching the Sixth Tribulation realm?
At that moment, Snowjade realized the huge strength difference.
One’s mind and willpower had far-reaching effects on their cultivation path.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Magic Awls struck him one after another.
Palace Lord Snowjade’s eyes were filled with madness as he stared at Meng Chuan. He thought to himself, I have to thank you for letting me discover that my willpower is still very weak. Therefore, try receiving my final move.
Snowjade didn’t wish to delay any further. His willpower had been suppressed too badly.
...
Meng Chuan constantly attacked his opponent with his Essence Soul weapon, Magic Awl. At the same time, he controlled the 36 Bloodblades to transform into black light beams—which then surrounded his opponent.
Palace Lord Snowjade could only use his movement technique to dodge. His figure appeared in different spots within the array formation. In the blink of an eye, he flashed more than ten times.
Suddenly, Snowjade’s eyes narrowed.
Swoosh.
He attacked Meng Chuan with his movement technique.
With his Essence Soul World suppressing everything within the array formation, Meng Chuan could clearly sense his opponent’s movements. Meng Chuan maintained the 30-fold faster time flow, allowing him to dodge his opponent’s close-range attacks easily.
I still can’t get close to him. Palace Lord Snowjade had long guessed what would happen. He resisted the impact on his will and swung his left hand. Eight frost beads flew out from his palm.
Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish!
This Ice Frost Beads set was a Seventh Tribulation treasure. It contained the profundities of time, space, and ice. Palace Lord Snowjade had paid a huge price to obtain it.
The surrounding void froze. The degree of freezing far exceeded before. It even affected spacetime.
Not good. Meng Chuan sensed spacetime freezing. It became very difficult for him to affect the time flow. He could only maintain an eight-fold faster time flow now.
At the same time, his body was also frozen, causing his movement speed to decrease greatly.
Every frost bead attacked at the same time.
Bam! Bam! Bam!
Meng Chuan tried his best to maintain his eight-fold faster time flow advantage. At the same time, he used his movement technique to dodge while he controlled the black light beams—Bloodblades—to block the frost beads.
There were a total of 36 Bloodblades, but only 18 of them were used to intercept the beads. The remaining ones continued attacking Snowjade. Meng Chuan was clearly very confident in his defense.
Almost all of Snowjade’s remaining efforts were used to control the Ice Frost Beads—a Seventh Tribulation treasure. He completely gave up on resisting the Bloodblades.
Along with the terrifying impact, the eight Ice Frost Beads traversed the void in unpredictable trajectories. The 18 Bloodblades instantly blocked six Ice Frost Beads, and the remaining two Ice Frost Beads smashed into Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan used his body to withstand the attack. He didn’t even use the bracelet on his wrist or Demon Slayer—which was by his waist.
Humph.
The robe on his body was a Sixth Tribulation protective treasure. Meng Chuan’s body completely withstood the remnant impact that went through the robe.
Huh? Palace Lord Snowjade—who had placed his hopes on this strike—watched in astonishment as the two Ice Frost Beads slammed into Meng Chuan’s body.
Meng Chuan’s robes fluttered as he stood rooted to the ground, completely withstanding the impact. Although his back slightly arched, he stood up straight quickly without vomiting any blood.
Physical Body Fifth Tribulation realm? Palace Lord Snowjade found it unbelievable. Furthermore, he’s a Physical Body Fifth Tribulation Eminence with extremely strong defense?
Physical Body and Essence Soul dual cultivation? When Ta Gu and Black Wind saw Meng Chuan withstand the Seventh Tribulation treasure’s attack, they were stunned.
Physical Body Tribulation Eminences and Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences had their advantages and disadvantages.
A Physical Body Tribulation Eminence’s greatest advantage laid in their physical body’s explosive strength! Their life-preservation means were also extremely strong. As a peak Fifth Tribulation Eminence, Palace Lord Snowjade used a Seventh Tribulation treasure to deliver a full-powered strike. The attack’s might was obvious.
Even among Fifth Tribulation Eminences, one had to specialize in defense before they even had a chance of withstanding the attack.
Old Fiend Black Wind placed greater importance on gathering and scattering his body at will. Ta Gu focused on cultivating his blood. Due to both of their specializations, neither could withstand such a strike without suffering any damage.
Meng Chuan did it.
As an expert who had reached both the Essence Soul Fifth Tribulation realm and the Physical Body Fifth Tribulation realm, the threat he posed rose rapidly.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
When Snowjade saw Meng Chuan withstand the strike, multiple black light beams struck his body, many of which tore through his body.
Many wounds appeared on his body. Almost half of his flesh had disappeared.
“I admit defeat,” shouted Snowjade.
The black light beams stopped and transformed into Bloodblades.
Snowjade’s incomplete body rapidly regenerated. In the blink of an eye, he recovered completely.
Just seven blades are enough to injure my body. Snowjade carefully stared at Meng Chuan’s waist, where Demon Slayer was. Furthermore, he hasn’t engaged in close combat yet.
When he saw the saber on Meng Chuan’s waist, he thought it was a weapon controlled by the Power of Essence Soul.
To his surprise, Meng Chuan was at the Physical Body Tribulation realm!
He only used long-range attacks without engaging in close-range combat. Ta Gu and Black Wind were secretly astonished. If he were to draw his saber and engage in close combat, I’m afraid Palace Lord Snowjade would lose even faster.
There were quite a few Tribulation Eminences that cultivated both their Physical Body and Essence Soul. However, it was very rare for a Tribulation Eminence to reach the Fifth Tribulation realm in both aspects. Typically, Tribulation Eminences had one aspect better than the other.
Unbeknownst to them...
Meng Chuan’s body was actually only at the Fourth Tribulation realm. However, when he became a perfected Imperial Lord, his body already had Fifth Tribulation realm combat strength.
His close-range attacks were indeed stronger than his long-range attacks.
...
He admitted defeat? Meng Chuan relaxed. His Bloodblades flew back rapidly. I thought we would have to engage in close combat before deciding a victor.
Meng Chuan was already prepared. If the other party had stronger means, he would engage Snowjade in close combat! He would even use the Thirteen Universe Beads! However, he clearly wasn’t forced into such a situation.
Whoosh.
The array formation slowly converged.
The Guardian with a snake tail smiled and said, “Since one side has admitted defeat, the final victor will be Eastcalm!”
The final victor of the cave abode expedition was Meng Chuan!
“Brother Eastcalm, congratulations,” said Ta Gu with a smile. “Senior Cang Xing’s cave abode is a huge opportunity.”
Meng Chuan’s heart stirred. Senior Cang Xing? At the same time, he nodded and smiled at Ta Gu. He could sense his kindness.
“Impressive.” Black Wind praised, “I never expected Brother Eastcalm to hide so much strength when fighting me. I never expected Brother Eastcalm to be a Physical Body Tribulation Eminence as well.”
“Follow me,” urged the human-bodied, snake-tailed Guardian. “As for the three of you, wait here. I’ll bestow each of you something later.”
“Everyone, I’ll enter first,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. He then walked towards the forbidden creature’s giant head with the human-bodied, snake-tailed Guardian.
The forbidden creature’s blood-colored vertical eye looked down. Its eye turned colder, but it couldn’t stop them. It was imprisoned here, forever to be the entire cave abode’s power source.
“Follow me.” The human-bodied, snake-tailed Guardian flew into the gaping mouth.
Meng Chuan flew into the gaping mouth as well.
Every tooth in the gaping mouth was like a huge mountain peak. They flew through the gap.
“In the end, the one who succeeded was actually Brother Eastcalm, who arrived last.” Ta Gu shook his head and smiled. “It’s really difficult to predict how things will develop.”
“Even if Brother Eastcalm didn’t come, I wouldn’t have come out victorious.” Black Wind had a good attitude.
Snowjade stood by the side silently.
He was still thinking about how his will was suppressed. My willpower has a huge flaw. I have to temper my mind and will. I have to thank Meng Chuan for letting me discover this flaw in advance. He looked up and saw the human-bodied, snake-tailed Guardian and Meng Chuan fly into the giant head’s gaping mouth.
...
A chamber was hidden deep within the gaping mouth.
The chamber was only 1,000 feet wide. It was embedded in the flesh of the forbidden creature’s mouth. Meng Chuan carefully examined the ancient chamber.
Rumble~
The chamber’s door opened automatically.
“Follow me.” The Guardian walked in, and Meng Chuan followed.
Huh? The moment Meng Chuan entered, he realized that the chamber was very empty. There wasn’t much inside. All he saw was a black mirror hanging on a wall, reflecting his appearance.
A blurry light enveloped him as ancient words appeared in the mirror.
The snake-tailed man smiled at the ancient text before his smile froze. He turned to look at Meng Chuan in disbelief. “You’ve only cultivated for 1,587 years? How is that possible? How can a Fifth Tribulation Eminence be so young?”

chapters.title: Chapter 567 - Void Catalog
chapters.content:
Chapter 567: Void Catalog
How can a Fifth Tribulation Eminence be so young?
Meng Chuan was slightly stunned before looking at the ancient mirror curiously.
This mirror could accurately determine his age.
This type of treasure could only be refined by experts with extremely high attainments in the time lineage. The mirror could probe the time he had experienced simply by reflecting his appearance. The mirror showed that Meng Chuan had experienced 1,587 years since he was born.
“How did you reach the Fifth Tribulation realm in just 1,000-plus years?” asked the snake-tailed man. “Furthermore, you cultivate both your body and Essence Soul. You have even grasped two Fifth Tribulation laws. How did you cultivate so quickly?”
At that moment, the Guardian had many guesses.
Reincarnator? Universe Wonder? A monstrous genius that has created an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique, or is he related to an... Eternal existence?
Being any one of these would make Meng Chuan a legend in the River of Spacetime!
Even a Sixth Tribulation Eminence can’t see through my age at a glance. It’s also impossible for them to use a treasure mirror to pry into other people’s ages randomly.
Meng Chuan looked at the mirror.
However, the owner of the cave abode has specially left behind a mirror here.
Meng Chuan knew that his cultivation time was very short.
Under normal circumstances, those who became Imperial Lords after cultivating for 300 years and newly-advanced Tribulation Eminences after cultivating for 2,000 years would reach the Fifth Tribulation realm after cultivating for more than 10,000 years. This was considered a relatively fast cultivation speed among Fifth Tribulation Eminences. If one spent 30,000 years to reach the Fifth Tribulation realm, it would be considered extremely slow. This was because Fourth Tribulation Eminences typically had 30,000-year lifespans.
As for Meng Chuan?
He had reached the Fifth Tribulation realm in just a tenth of the average time. Furthermore, he cultivated both his Essence Soul and his physical body. He had also grasped two Fifth Tribulation laws! This was simply too heaven-defying.
In fact, Meng Chuan’s Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique had reached the Heaven Earth realm over 100 years ago. If he had used the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique as his core, he would have long become an Imperial Lord. However, he delayed his breakthrough to the Imperial Lord realm because he placed most of his attention on his paramount technique.
“My perceptivity is a little higher,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. He didn’t say anything else.
“No matter what the reason is,” the snake-tailed man looked at Meng Chuan and said, “the treasure bestowed by Master will be upgraded to second-class since you have reached such a level in 1,000-plus years.:
“Second-class?” Meng Chuan knew very well that no benefits came without reason. He asked, “I should have to pay a certain price for the so-called second-class treasure, right?”
The cave abode’s owner had set up this cave abode for a reason. It was relatively unlikely that Meng Chuan would be given benefits for nothing.
“My master’s name is Cang Xing,” said the snake-tailed man. “His homeworld was a low-level world. Back when Master roamed the outer realm and was at the Fourth Tribulation realm, a forbidden creature appeared in our homeworld. It devoured Master’s homeworld. All living beings in the world were wiped out. None survived.
“After many years of cultivation, Master reached the Seventh Tribulation realm. Before his end, he set up many cave abodes and placed all the treasures he had accumulated during his life in the many cave abodes. He left them for future generations. He only has one request... to kill forbidden creatures.
“Your talent is outstanding. According to Master’s rules, you have the right to obtain a second-class treasure. The condition is that you have to kill three Sixth Tribulation forbidden creatures when you are at the Sixth Tribulation realm. When you are at the Seventh Tribulation realm, you have to kill one Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature.” The man with the snake tail said, “As long as you agree, you can choose any second-class treasure.”
Meng Chuan frowned slightly.
Killing three Sixth Tribulation forbidden creatures when he was at the Sixth Tribulation realm? He would be violating his promise if he didn’t kill the quota and attempted to transcend the Heavenly Tribulation to reach the Seventh Tribulation realm! The karma affecting him would immediately increase; it would even affect his tribulation.
Although forbidden creatures were the common enemies of all life, there were extremely few of them! Many Tribulation Eminences had never seen forbidden creatures before. There were even fewer who deliberately pursued them.
For example, if a Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature appeared in other river zones, why would Tribulation Eminences in Goddess River Zone care? They were too far away! The river zone’s respective Eminences could deal with them.
“I have to kill them at the Sixth Tribulation realm. Likewise for the Seventh Tribulation realm,” said Meng Chuan softly. “There are restrictions on both realms.”
“Of course, the second condition only concerns you if you reach the Seventh Tribulation realm in the future,” said the man with the snake tail with a smile. “Even if you don’t kill a Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature, you will only break your promise when you die of age. By then, karma will no longer affect you.”
Meng Chuan smiled.
Talking about killing a Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature when one was at the Seventh Tribulation realm was targeted at those who had a chance of breaking through to the Eighth Tribulation realm. Since they were about to reach the Eighth Tribulation realm, they had to kill a Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature before they transcended the tribulation so they could end the karma.
“Although there are very few Sixth Tribulation forbidden creatures, they can still be found,” said Meng Chuan. “However, Seventh Tribulation forbidden creatures are virtually legends.”
Meng Chuan was confident in himself, so he naturally didn’t want to be easily bound by duty.
“Master’s first-class treasures can be counted on one hand. They are targeted at Seventh Tribulation Eminences and some Sixth Tribulation Eminences.
“The second-class treasures are already extremely precious,” said the snake-tailed man. “You can hear what I have to say before deciding if you agree to it. Even if you refuse, you can obtain an ordinary treasure like the other three Fifth Tribulation Eminences and leave the cave abode.”
“Oh?” Meng Chuan asked, “What treasures can you give me?”
“What do you want the most?” asked the snake-tailed man.
“A treasure that’s useful for cultivating the void lineage,” said Meng Chuan. “Tell me what you can provide.”
Meng Chuan also had Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures as his resources. If the treasures weren’t attractive enough, he wouldn’t easily accept a set of binding karma.
“Something that’s useful for cultivating the void lineage?” The snake-tailed man pondered for a moment and said, “The most precious void manual in the River of Spacetime is called the Void Catalog. There are three volumes of the Void Catalog. Master can give you a basic-level Eternal Token. With this, you can go to any Eternal Tower headquarters in a river zone and choose one volume to read.”
Void Catalog?
Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up.
Cultivation manuals were used to teach future generations.
For example, Meng Chuan had learned Lightning Realm. It was a manual left behind by a Sixth Tribulation Eminence after comprehending a complete spatial law. However, it was extremely difficult to comprehend it with just the manual.
Many manuals were the same.
The creators comprehended something and wrote the manuals. However, people of the future couldn’t understand it. It was like reading a heavenly book! Therefore, manuals that were suitable for one were very important. The Selfless Formless Sword painting catalog, which Meng Chuan encountered, was very compatible with him. The effects it had on his cultivation were very good.
As for the Void Catalog, it was an ultimate technique that was compatible with all Tribulation Eminences!
Legend had it that an Eternal existence wrote it.
Of course, this was only a legend. It was a mystery as to who created the Void Catalog! However, its interpretation of the void made even historical Eighth Tribulation Eminences sigh in amazement when they read it. They believed that it was the best manual in the void lineage.
“The Void Catalog is split into three volumes. If you want to read each volume, even a Sixth Tribulation Eminence from Eternal Tower will have to pay 300,000 cubes. Outsiders have no right to read them unless they have a special reason.” The snake-tailed man looked at Meng Chuan. “As long as you agree to Master’s request, I’ll give you the basic-level Eternal Token.”
“What if Eternal Tower doesn’t want to exchange for it when I head over with a basic-level Eternal Token?” asked Meng Chuan.
According to what he knew, the Void Catalog’s three volumes naturally turned to dust after reading each volume.
One had to be an expert who had once read the Void Catalog and comprehended a complete spatial Great Dao before they could write down the Void Catalog’s contents on a piece of precious material. According to legends, there were still some Void Catalogs at Eternal Tower. Even if they were reduced to ashes, they would be replenished with time.
However...
Will a basic-level Eternal Token be devalued? After all, Senior Cang Xing died a long time ago. Is it possible that the Void Catalogs in Eternal Tower are too rare in this era? If one wants to read it, would the price one has to pay greatly increase?
Is it possible that a basic-level Eternal Token isn’t sufficient for the exchange?
“If you can’t exchange for a copy of the Void Catalog in Eternal Tower, your promise naturally won’t count,” said the snake-tailed man with a smile. “In that instance, the basic-level Eternal Token will be a gift for you.”
He was clearly prepared for such a situation.
After all, Senior Cang Xing knew that everything and anything could happen in the face of time. For example, Eternal Tower could be destroyed a long time later. That would naturally make basic-level Eternal Tokens useless.
Meng Chuan nodded slightly as he pondered.
The Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique had become increasingly difficult to cultivate to this day. Lightning Realm was difficult to understand, and his improvement was minimal.
“Alright, I agree,” said Meng Chuan calmly as he looked at the snake-tailed man.
The path of cultivation was destined to be filled with many obstacles. In the future, Meng Chuan felt that it was worth it to kill forbidden creatures in exchange for a copy of the Void Catalog!

chapters.title: Chapter 568 - Cang Alliance?
chapters.content:
Chapter 568: Cang Alliance?
“You agree?” The snake-tailed man was delighted.
As a Guardian, the meaning behind his existence was to carry out his master’s orders.
Meng Chuan was the youngest among all the Fifth Tribulation Eminences he had encountered in this cave abode! Furthermore, he was ludicrously young! Since Meng Chuan agreed, he was naturally excited and happy.
“Here.” The snake-tailed man waved his hand, and a palm-sized gray sword appeared in his palm. “This is the basic-level Eternal Token.”
With that said, he waved his hand again.
The gray sword flew towards Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan reached out and grabbed it. He examined it in surprise.
This basic-level Eternal Token was made of Primordial Stones. There were no traces of special refinement methods. It was as though it was a small sword carved out of a Primordial Stone. However, it contained a very unique aura that seemed extremely vast. Meng Chuan felt like a mortal looking up at the starry sky. It was extremely distant and boundless...
He could vaguely tell that the aura’s owner was a great existence.
With just a glance from the aura’s owner, he would be reduced to dust.
“The basic-level Eternal Token is very special. Nobody in the River of Spacetime can forge it,” said the snake-tailed man.
Meng Chuan nodded in agreement. “Yes.”
The snake-tailed man continued, “Eastcalm, if you join Eternal Tower in the future, you will know this basic-level Eternal Token’s value. With it, you can exchange for many treasures in Eternal Tower. It doesn’t necessarily have to be exchanged for one of the Void Catalog’s volumes.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Understood.”
This basic-level Eternal Token would be of great help to him at the Fifth Tribulation realm!
After reaching the Fifth Tribulation realm, Ancestral Master Archean Eon permitted him to choose treasures—from the treasure vault—that didn’t exceed 300,000 cubes in total. As for this basic-level Eternal Token, it was worth more than 300,000 cubes.
Of course, Ancestral Master’s bestowments didn’t have binding karma. Furthermore, Meng Chuan could obtain even more benefits after reaching the Sixth Tribulation realm.
His transaction with Senior Cang Xing was a one-time transaction! He was bound by karma.
Furthermore, it was because Meng Chuan’s potential was too heaven-defying that he was bestowed such a valuable item. If it were Palace Lord Snowjade and the other Fifth Tribulation Eminences, even if they were the final victors, the treasures they would be bestowed would be significantly inferior.
Although I’m bound by karma, this is indeed of great help to me. Meng Chuan was very confident that he could reach the Sixth Tribulation realm with his talent. However, his chances of reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm would be slim if he wasted too much time.
His lifespan was limited.
He had to reach the Sixth Tribulation realm as soon as possible before he stood a chance of reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm.
Even as a peerless genius who had created an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique, he had to seize every opportunity if he wanted to have a chance of reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm. If he were careless, the Sixth Tribulation realm would be the furthest he could go.
“Let’s go out.” The snake-tailed man led Meng Chuan out of the chamber and flew out of the forbidden creature’s gaping mouth.
In the cave.
Ta Gu, Black Wind, and Snowjade waited.
“They’re out.” The three of them saw Meng Chuan and the snake-tailed man fly out.
“Eastcalm definitely obtained great benefits this time.” Black Wind and Snowjade couldn’t help but feel envious. They also valued opportunities greatly.
With a few more opportunities, they might have a chance of reaching the Sixth Tribulation realm.
If they lacked just a little, the Fifth Tribulation realm might be the furthest they could go.
Ta Gu couldn’t help but ask, “It’s time to hand out the Cang Alliance tokens, right?”
Black Wind and Snowjade looked at the snake-tailed man.
“Cang Alliance token?” Meng Chuan was somewhat puzzled.
“You are lucky.” The snake-tailed man smiled and said, “The Cang Alliance’s member limit hasn’t been reached yet. Therefore, the four of you can each get one Cang Alliance token, which will allow you to become members of the Cang Alliance.”
With that said, he waved his hand, and four golden tokens flew out.
“Cang Alliance tokens are only useful when refined for the first time. It’s useless to give it to someone else after refining it,” informed the snake-tailed man.
“Understood.” Ta Gu received the golden token excitedly.
Black Wind and Snowjade received the tokens excitedly as well.
“I’ve finally obtained it.” Black Wind looked at the golden token in his hand.
“Cang Alliance token?” Meng Chuan also received the token. The token was golden in color, and there was a layer of mysterious runes on its surface. The token had a single word—Cang.
“After refining the identity token, you will naturally become a member of the Cang Alliance,” said the snake-tailed man. “As for the benefits of becoming a Cang Alliance member, you can slowly figure it out. Alright, according to the rules, you have to refine it in front of me.”
Ta Gu, Palace Lord Snowjade, and Old Fiend Black Wind didn’t hesitate to refine their tokens.
Meng Chuan hesitated slightly. As a newly-advanced Fifth Tribulation Eminence, he didn’t know much about the Cang Alliance! There were no records of this ‘Cang Alliance’ in the books left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon.
Did he dare join an unknown River of Spacetime organization so haphazardly?
“Just refine it directly.” Ta Gu smiled at Meng Chuan and explained, “The Cang Alliance is a very loose alliance. It doesn’t have any restrictions. Instead, it has great benefits.”
“Haha, we came to this cave abode because of this Cang Alliance token,” said Black Wind with a smile. “Refine the token and become a member of the Cang Alliance. That way, you can instantly contact the other members of the Cang Alliance.”
“Instantly contact?” Meng Chuan was slightly shocked.
“That’s right. Cang Alliance’s members are scattered across the River of Spacetime. No matter how far away they are, you can communicate with them instantly,” said Ta Gu. “Isn’t it amazing?”
Meng Chuan was somewhat shocked.
No matter how far away they were? Communication at any time?
The River of Spacetime was too vast.
It would take a long time to travel from one river zone to another.
It was very difficult to establish long-range communications!
For example, Meng An was too far away. Meng Chuan couldn’t contact him at all.
According to Ancestral Master’s dossier, Eternal Tower has similar means, but only Sixth Tribulation Eminences and stronger have the right to access such means.
“Senior Cang Xing once obtained a Universe Wonder,” explained Ta Gu. “After refining the token, we can leave an Essence Soul mark on this Universe Wonder! Those that leave a mark on this Universe Wonder can communicate at any time. That Universe Wonder can only accommodate 1,000 Essence Soul marks in total.”
Black Wind added, “Senior Cang Xing left this technique behind so that we can better contact each other and hunt down forbidden creatures.”
“The more powerful the hunted forbidden creature is, the greater the benefits.” Ta Gu was somewhat excited.
Hum.
With a thought, Meng Chuan refined the golden token in his hand.
The moment his Power of Essence Soul refined it—
Boom!
His Essence Soul touched a special place.
This Universe Wonder existed in a very special place! His Essence Soul left a mark on it, allowing him to sense it at any time.
I see. Meng Chuan understood.
This special place was known as the Cang Alliance Space. After leaving behind an Essence Soul mark, the Cang Alliance token was useless.
I can exchange for all sorts of treasures by killing forbidden creatures? Meng Chuan understood. The Cang Alliance didn’t have any restrictions. As long as one killed enough powerful forbidden creatures, they could naturally exchange for treasures.
Of course, a Fifth Tribulation forbidden creature was the minimum. Weaker forbidden creatures wouldn’t be counted.
795 marks. Meng Chuan couldn’t help but be shocked when he sensed the numerous marks.
The marks were divided into different grades according to one’s strength.
The lowest-ranked—Fifth Tribulation Eminences—marks numbered 786.
There were eight Sixth Tribulation Eminences in the middle.
There was one Seventh Tribulation Eminence at the highest point!
There’s actually a Seventh Tribulation Eminence in the Cang Alliance? Meng Chuan was shocked.
There were only a handful of Sixth Tribulation Eminences in a vast river zone.
As for Seventh Tribulation Eminences, they were virtually legends!
“Since all of you have refined it, you may leave.” The snake-tailed Guardian waved his hand and teleported Meng Chuan and company, as well as a large group of weaker Tribulation Eminences, out. The ancient cave abode instantly vanished into the River of Spacetime.

chapters.title: Chapter 569 - Invitation (Final Chapter of Volume)
chapters.content:
Chapter 569: Invitation (Final Chapter of Volume)
Meng Chuan, Old Fiend Black Win+d, Ta Gu, Palace Lord Snowjade, and the group of subordinates were teleported to the void where the original entrance was.
We’re out.
Meng Chuan and company also saw the group of subordinates.
Old Fiend Black Wind, Palace Lord Snowjade, and Ta Gu each stored their subordinates into their respective grotto-heavens. Only Meng Chuan didn’t bring any subordinates with him. He had originally come here to capture Emperor Roc. Becoming a member of the Cang Alliance was an unexpected gain.
“Everyone, don’t be in a hurry to leave,” said Ta Gu with a smile. “Now that we’ve joined the Cang Alliance, the most important thing is to get to know the other members.”
“We have to get to know the other members slowly, right?” Black Wind looked at Ta Gu. “Could it be that Brother Ta Gu has some fast method?”
“Everyone, please enter the Cang Alliance Space first,” said Ta Gu with a smile.
...
The Cang Alliance Space was an extremely special existence.
One could sense it anywhere in the River of Spacetime. Any member could condense an embodiment here. This was an illusory embodiment condensed from an Essence Soul mark. It didn’t have any strength.
In the illusory space, fog drifted.
There were over 1,000 stone stools.
Embodiments of Ta Gu, Meng Chuan, Snowjade, and Black Wind descended from the sky.
“We can communicate with any member of the Cang Alliance at any time. We can also condense an embodiment to meet them.” Ta Gu sighed. “There aren’t any restrictions, so many Fifth Tribulation Eminences wish to become a member of the Cang Alliance.”
How magical.
Meng Chuan looked around and sighed in amazement.
Snowjade looked at Ta Gu. “How do we get to know the other members?”
“Don’t be in a hurry. Someone’s here.” Ta Gu turned his head to the side. An embodiment descended from the fog not far away. It was a purple-robed woman. Her ears were pointed, and she had long, jade-green hair. Her every frown and smile was extremely moving. This amazed Meng Chuan. This was only an embodiment. If the purple-robed woman’s true body were here, her charm would probably be much greater.
“This is my good friend, Zi Yao,” Ta Gu introduced.
“Everyone, just address me as Zi Yao,” said the purple-robed woman with a smile. “I’m also a member of the Cang Alliance. I love making friends the most. I’ve also gathered information on all Cang Alliance members. Of course, this information... If it’s for outsiders, it will naturally be sold at a high price. However, it’s free for those of the Cang Alliance.”
The purple-robed woman waved her hand as she spoke.
A large amount of information appeared in the void beside her, revealing the details of every member.
Meng Chuan and company carefully read through the information. With the speed of their minds, they naturally memorized everything in seconds.
Although the information seemed detailed, it wasn’t too important. Therefore, it was an unspoken rule for Cang Alliance members to share such information with each other.
“Thank you,” said Meng Chuan.
“Thank you, Sis Zi Yao,” said Black Wind gratefully. It was easier to interact with other members after obtaining such intelligence.
“There’s no need to thank me. Every new recruit to the Cang Alliance will need to give me an intelligence report on themselves. Describe yourself simply so that I can inform the other members. The other members will also know you,” said the purple-robed woman with a smile.
“Of course.” Black Wind nodded. He immediately waved his hand, and a simple piece of information regarding him appeared in the void.
Meng Chuan nodded and sent her his intelligence as well.
Snowjade didn’t say a word, but he also sent the intelligence.
According to the intelligence of the other hundreds of members, a short description of themselves would do.
For example, Meng Chuan described himself as City Lord Eastcalm. His homeworld was in Three Bay River System. He cultivated both his Physical Body and Essence Soul. He was at the Fifth Tribulation realm. He was good at...
In the outer realm, few people revealed their true names. For instance, City Lord Eastcalm, Palace Lord Snowjade, and Old Fiend Black Wind weren’t their true names. Even the name, Ta Gu—which seemed real—was also his alias in Shura Realm.
Meng Chuan named himself City Lord Eastcalm because he had future plans.
“Alright.” The purple-robed woman collected the three new intelligence reports. She knew Ta Gu’s information a long time ago. “What I gave you just now was the most basic intelligence about each member,” said the purple-robed woman with a smile. “There are also some tidbits of special intelligence. I can share some with you.”
Meng Chuan and company listened carefully.
“Zi Yao knows more than me since she has many friends in the Cang Alliance,” said Ta Gu.
The purple-robed woman smiled and said, “I’m just privy to more information. I’ll first talk about the eight Sixth Tribulation Eminences in the Cang Alliance. Most of them can’t be bothered to deal with Fifth Tribulation Eminences. If you wish to request their help? It’s only easy to get help from two of them. One of them is Lady of Icesoul; the other is Patriarch Fire Dragon. However, they are somewhat greedy. You have to pay a sufficient price for their help.”
Greedy?
Meng Chuan and company listened carefully.
It was a good thing that a Sixth Tribulation Eminence was even willing to help.
Although the price could be very high, their help was very worth it.
“The Lady of Icesoul is the master of Icesoul Realm. She has a cold and arrogant personality. If you need her help, you have to talk business immediately,” said the purple-robed woman. “As for Patriarch Fire Dragon, he’s one of the Elders of the dragons’ 12 Ancestral Lands in the River of Spacetime.”
Ta Gu said, “In the River of Spacetime, the dragons’ strongest experts are the 12 Ancestral Land Elders. In this era, the dragons don’t have any Seventh Tribulation Eminences.”
“Oh?” Meng Chuan, Snowjade, and Black Wind listened carefully.
The dragons were still very powerful to them. However, the dragons had no Seventh Tribulation Eminences in this era.
