“However, the dragons have ultimately produced an Eighth Tribulation Eminence in history. They naturally have the strength to ensure the longevity of their race,” said Ta Gu. “Unless you have the strength of a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, don’t provoke the dragons.”
...
The few of them chatted; Meng Chuan and company learned all sorts of intelligence.
Meng Chuan now knew that the strongest Sixth Tribulation Eminence in the Cang Alliance was known as Saber Swordsman. Only the best alcohol—rare top-notch wine in the River of Spacetime—could attract his attention. He was already infinitely close to the Seventh Tribulation realm, but his body had yet to reach the Seventh Tribulation realm. Otherwise, he would have long transcended the tribulation. Such an existence already had the partial strength of a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Even the dragons had to respect him.
“Oh.”
Meng Chuan and company were briefed on the various big shots. When they heard about the only Seventh Tribulation Eminence in the Cang Alliance, their blood pumped in excitement.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon is a Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
The more Meng Chuan understood, the more impressed he became.
Back then, Ancestral Master Archean Eon entered the outer realm as a cultivator from a low-level world. It was truly impressive for him to reach the Seventh Tribulation realm.
“After chatting for so long, it’s about time,” said the purple-robed woman with a smile. “I’ll also give your intelligence to all the other members.”
Meng Chuan and company naturally didn’t object. It was easier to befriend the other members if they were familiar with them.
How many opportunities could a Fifth Tribulation Eminence find by cultivating alone?
The entire Cang Alliance was scattered across the River of Spacetime. If everyone knew each other, the number of opportunities they obtained would probably be more than ten times greater.
...
Yufang River System.
Snowjade took the lead to leave.
“I’m leaving too.” Meng Chuan bade his two companions farewell.
“No rush,” said Ta Gu immediately.
Black Wind immediately said, “Don’t be anxious. Brother Eastcalm. You haven’t truly joined a faction, right? A loose alliance like the Cang Alliance doesn’t count. I’m talking about peak factions in the River of Spacetime.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Indeed, I haven’t.”
“I’m currently in Shadow Lands. One can join this faction once they reach the Fifth Tribulation realm.” Black Wind invited him warmly. “I can recommend you. Shadow Lands is ranked in the top ten in the entire River of Spacetime. The members are very united. After joining...”
“Brother Black Wind, there’s no need to say anything else,” rejected Meng Chuan politely.
With the dossiers left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon, he knew more about the top factions in the River of Spacetime than Black Wind.
These top factions had special means to maintain their existence. It was difficult for them to disappear even after hundreds of millions of years.
“I also wish to invite Brother Eastcalm to a faction,” said Ta Gu with a smile. “I’m from Eternal Tower. Eternal Tower has a long history. It’s able to rank in the top three out of the River of Spacetime’s numerous factions.”
“Although Eternal Tower is strong, it’s more loose. The members aren’t tight,” said Black Wind. “Our Shadow Lands is much more united.”
“Eternal Tower has low requirements for its members because we are strong enough. Furthermore, we mainly do business. What’s important is the willingness of both parties,” said Ta Gu with a smile. “Our Eternal Tower does business in the River of Spacetime. Some...”
Meng Chuan nodded immediately. “I’m willing to join.”
Ta Gu, who was prepared to share a long introduction, was slightly stunned.
“Which are you willing to join?” Black Wind was filled with anticipation.
“Eternal Tower,” said Meng Chuan.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon had been a member of Eternal Tower. The River of Spacetime had many factions. Which faction would he join? Meng Chuan had long decided.
Eternal Tower, you are the one!
Final Chapter of Volume—Tribulation Realm

chapters.title: Chapter 570 - Starlord Scarlet Snake
chapters.content:
Chapter 570: Starlord Scarlet Snake
“Join Eternal Tower?” Black Wind couldn’t help but persuade him. “Brother Eastcalm, think about it carefully. Don’t make rash decisions.”
“I think Brother Eastcalm has made a wise decision,” said Ta Gu with a smile.
“Although Eternal Tower is powerful, everything has a clear price,” said Black Wind. “Shadow Lands is different. It will give plenty of help to new members. Furthermore, our Shadow Lands is stronger than Eternal Tower in Goddess River Zone.”
Meng Chuan shook his head and smiled. “Thank you, Brother Black Wind. There’s no need to persuade me further.”
Black Wind could only stop.
Shadow Lands was more active in recruiting new members. The more strength and potential the recruited members had, the greater the contributions the referrer would receive.
“Do we need to go to Eternal Tower’s headquarters in Goddess River Zone to join Eternal Tower?” asked Meng Chuan.
“Yes.” Ta Gu nodded. “I’ll accompany you.”
“Brother Black Wind, we’ll take our leave first.”
“Black Wind, we’ll take our leave.”
Meng Chuan and Ta Gu were in a good mood. After bidding Old Fiend Black Wind farewell, they quickly rushed to the Goddess River Zone’s Eternal Tower headquarters through the River of Spacetime.
Old Fiend Black Wind warmly sent the two away before he paused and pondered for a moment. Finally, he left.
...
I never expected to encounter Meng Chuan.
Palace Lord Snowjade—who was traveling through the River of Spacetime—thought,
When I fought him, I discovered the flaws in my mind and will. This can be considered a reward. I have to improve my willpower when I return. It will be my number one priority!
Snowjade’s eyes were filled with fighting spirit.
He was considered quite talented amongst his peers at the Fifth Tribulation realm. He had only cultivated for 20,000 years, yet had grasped two Fifth Tribulation laws. He had a low chance of reaching the Sixth Tribulation realm.
...
Black Wind was from Yufang River System, so he was the first to return to his lair.
Black wind blew over the dark planet.
After throwing his subordinates out of the Grotto-Heaven with a flip of his sleeve, Black Wind returned to his palace alone.
Snowjade and Eastcalm are stronger than me.
Black Wind sat on his throne as he recalled the events that happened during his expedition into the cave abode.
With my cultivation speed, I have to rely on external objects to reach the Sixth Tribulation realm. I’ll sell intelligence on them first.
Black Wind thought to himself,
I can also exchange it for some contribution points.
With a flip of his hand, a black jade token appeared in his hand. Silver light swirled on the jade token. Through the jade token, he could contact the Shadow Lands headquarters in Goddess River Zone.
Shadow Lands already has ordinary intelligence on the other Cang Alliance members?
They already have intelligence on Ta Gu?
Palace Lord Snowjade’s strength has increased. The intelligence on him can be sold for 30 contribution points. Intelligence on Eastcalm can be sold for 200 contribution points? Not bad.
Black Wind was rather satisfied.
Since he had been cultivating as a weakling to this day, he was used to seizing every opportunity to accumulate resources.
Selling intelligence?
To him, it was just a small matter. It was not like they forbade him from spreading the information!
The members of Cang Alliance communicated with each other internally. Typically, they wouldn’t spread the information to others. This was only an unspoken rule with no clear agreement. After all, they were just simple pieces of information. He couldn’t sell the information at a high price. Furthermore, only the first person to sell it could earn something. Once the various major organizations knew the intelligence, nobody else could profit from it unless they had new intelligence.
Meng Chuan’s physical body and Essence Soul were both at the Fifth Tribulation realm. Furthermore, he had grasped two Fifth Tribulation laws (the two laws had simple introductions). He earned 200 contribution points only because it was the first sale! Of course, if he had information on how Meng Chuan had only cultivated for more than 1,000 years, the value of the intelligence would have increased ten-fold! However, at Meng Chuan’s realm, it was difficult for other experts to see how many years he had experienced.
...
Meng Chuan and Ta Gu traveled through the River of Spacetime.
Although they were both Fifth Tribulation Eminences and could enter a similar depth in the River of Spacetime, the difference in their speeds was about ten-fold.
“Brother Eastcalm, you sure are fast. I’m afraid you are close to the Sixth Tribulation realm,” said Ta Gu in amazement.
“Haha, that’s all there is to it. When it comes to traveling, it’s very rare to find a Fifth Tribulation Eminence faster than me,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. His domain carried Ta Gu as they traveled. Letting Ta Gu travel the River of Spacetime alone was too slow. Carrying him in tow was much faster.
“With your help, we should be able to reach Scarlet Snake Planet in a few hours,” said Ta Gu.
Scarlet Snake Planet was Eternal Tower’s headquarters (river zone-level headquarters) in Goddess River Zone.
Many river systems had Eternal Tower branches.
There would be one river zone-level headquarters in each river zone.
Eternal Tower also had a headquarters in the River of Spacetime. However, it was too distant and mysterious. Ordinary members (Fifth Tribulation Eminences) didn’t have the right to head there.
“The person presiding over Scarlet Snake Planet is Starlord Scarlet Snake,” said Ta Gu seriously. “Although there are many river systems in the entire Goddess River Zone, there are only a total of eight Sixth Tribulation Eminences, including those who cultivate in seclusion. Among them, only Starlord Scarlet Snake joined Eternal Tower. However, in terms of strength, Starlord Scarlet Snake should be one of the best in the entire Goddess River Zone.”
“Oh? One of the best in Goddess River Zone?” As a newly-advanced Fifth Tribulation Eminence, Meng Chuan had no idea how powerful the current experts of Goddess River Zone were. After joining Eternal Tower, he had to make up for his lack of knowledge and gather such intelligence slowly.
“That’s right.” Ta Gu nodded. “It’s been over 90,000 years since Starlord Scarlet Snake began cultivating! Apart from being a manager of Eternal Tower, it’s also the current clan leader of a special lifeform, the scarlet snakes. In the River of Spacetime, all the scarlet snakes deem it supreme.”
Meng Chuan was somewhat surprised.
Scarlet snakes were rather powerful special lifeforms. Adult scarlet snakes were comparable to Third Tribulation Eminences. It was a race that was comparable to Dark Peacocks and other races.
The supreme leader of the entire race?
However, it was normal. The dragons were considered one of the most prosperous species amongst the special lifeforms. Even then, they only had 12 Sixth Tribulation Eminences in this era. The scarlet snakes were way inferior to the dragons. It was already not bad for them to have a Sixth Tribulation Eminence presiding over them.
...
The two chatted as they traveled. Half a day later, they arrived at Scarlet Snake Planet.
“What a huge planet.” Meng Chuan stared at the massive star and couldn’t help but sigh in amazement.
This planet was five million kilometers in diameter. Apart from Grand Yang Stars and Grand Yin Stars, it was rather rare for a planet to be five million kilometers wide.
At a glance, the entire planet was a dark-red. Dust plumes rose indiscernibly. In the dust fog, one could vaguely see fiery-red serpents. Large serpents swam all over the planet.
In the outside world, it was very difficult to find scarlet snakes. However, there were many of them here! This was the scarlet snakes’ largest lair in the River of Spacetime. Starlord Scarlet Snake personally guarded it.
“Scarlet snakes are born in the outer realm. They don’t have a homeworld.”
Ta Gu sent a voice transmission.
“Therefore, Starlord Scarlet Snake places greater importance on safety in this lair. This is to protect his true body and the entire species. Thus, Starlord Scarlet Snake spared no expense to forge the entire Scarlet Serpent Planet into an impregnable fortress!”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
He still had one true body hiding in his homeworld, but a special lifeform didn’t have such benefits. One could imagine how important the safety of one’s lair was.
A river zone-level Eternal Tower headquarters already places great importance on safety. Furthermore, it’s the main lair of the scarlet snakes.
Meng Chuan looked at the planet and sighed in amazement.
I’m afraid that those below the Seventh Tribulation realm won’t be able to threaten Scarlet Snake Planet.
“Let’s enter,”
said Ta Gu.
“When entering Scarlet Snake Planet, head straight to the main city. Don’t stay outside.”
The two swooped down together.
Scarlet Snake Planet was enveloped by layers of array formations. Normally, Meng Chuan and Ta Gu could only enter the city. It was very difficult for them to head anywhere outside the city.
Swoosh.
Just as Meng Chuan and Ta Gu arrived in the sky above Scarlet Snake Planet, a red-robed figure welcomed them.
“Brother Ta Gu?” A tall, handsome, red-robed, bald man flew over. He smiled at Meng Chuan.n “This must be Eastcalm.”
“This is Chi Jiuxin.” Ta Gu introduced Meng Chuan to the bald man. “He’s usually in charge of many matters in Goddess River Zone’s Eternal Tower headquarters. Only the most important matters will be handled by the Starlord personally.”
“Greetings, Brother Chi Jiuxin,” said Meng Chuan politely.
“Ta Gu has long informed headquarters about your matter. I’ve also sent the news to the Eternal Tower headquarters in the River of Spacetime,” said Chi Jiuxin with a smile. “The headquarters in the River of Spacetime has already sent a reply; they’ve agreed to let you join Eternal Tower. Therefore, we’ll go through the procedures later.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
“Should we pay a visit to Starlord?” asked Ta Gu.
“There’s no need,” said Chi Jiuxin with a smile. “Patriarch has been in seclusion for a long time. He wants to break through to the Seventh Tribulation realm before his demise. Let’s not disturb him.”
Meng Chuan and Ta Gu nodded.
A Sixth Tribulation Eminence only had an average lifespan of 80-90,000 years.
Due to being a special lifeform and his chosen cultivation path, Starlord Scarlet Snake had a relatively longer lifespan. However, time was still very tight. All the scarlet snakes hoped that their patriarch could reach the Seventh Tribulation realm. Meng Chuan’s arrival wasn’t worth distracting Starlord Scarlet Snake.
“Let’s go to Eternal Tower.” Chi Jiuxin led Meng Chuan and Ta Gu towards the tallest nine-story building in the city.

chapters.title: Chapter 571 - Eye of Eternal
chapters.content:
Chapter 571: Eye of Eternal
This city occupied an area of about 5,000 kilometers, and Eternal Tower was the most majestic building. It was even the tallest building on Scarlet Snake Planet, surpassing all mountains.
As one of Eternal Tower’s river zone headquarters, it was 900,000 feet tall!
What an amazing Eternal Tower.
When Meng Chuan followed Chi Jiuxin and flew towards Eternal Tower, he could sense the pressure emanating from it. This was the suppressive feeling brought by the Eternal Tower’s array formation. If it were a weak cultivator, they might not have noticed it. The higher one’s cultivation realm was, the clearer they could sense the terrifying fluctuations coming from the array formation.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s records regarding the top-notch factions in the River of Spacetime were very detailed, including Eternal Tower. Eternal Tower’s every river zone headquarters could be said to be a fortress. This was because they were too important. They were the command centers of numerous river system branches in the River of Spacetime. It had to maintain contact with the Eternal Tower headquarters in the River of Spacetime, allowing them to carry out stable spacetime teleportations.
They could teleport experts and items instantly.
It’s very difficult for ordinary Eternal Tower members to receive immediate reinforcements in the River of Spacetime. However, Sixth Tribulation Eminences typically preside over river zone headquarters. They can receive reinforcements as long as they ask. Starlord Scarlet Snake likely had this as one of his considerations when joining Eternal Tower.
Special lifeform Tribulation Eminences placed greater importance on safety. They didn’t have the protection of an inhabited world, so it was a huge boon to have Eternal Tower’s headquarters in the River of Spacetime as reinforcements.
Whoosh.
Chi Jiuxin, Meng Chuan, and Ta Gu flew towards the huge entrance of Eternal Tower.
The entrance to Eternal Tower was extremely wide. It was 30,000 feet wide. The array formation was constantly maintained, causing Eternal Tower’s interior to be filled with layers of space. It was difficult to probe it.
Oh?
The moment Meng Chuan flew through the entrance, he could vaguely sense powerful auras. He could even sense another Fifth Tribulation Eminence’s aura.
“This is Scarlet Snake Planet. There are more Fifth Tribulation Eminences here,”
said Ta Gu via voice transmission to Meng Chuan. “
The scarlet snakes are also a powerful special lifeform species in the River of Spacetime. There’s only one Sixth Tribulation Eminence in the entire species, but there should be over 80 Fifth Tribulation Eminences! There are 33 of them on Scarlet Snake Planet. The other Fifth Tribulation Eminences are scattered across the various river zones.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
With a Sixth Tribulation patriarch and 33 Fifth Tribulation Eminences, this place lived up to its reputation as the scarlet snakes’ lair.
Whoosh.
Eternal Tower’s array formations were profound since they could divide the building into several layers of space.
Chi Jiuxin led Meng Chuan and Ta Gu through Eternal Tower. “We have to carry out the ritual for Brother Eastcalm to join Eternal Tower. Therefore, we will head to the eighth level of Eternal Tower.”
The eighth level of Eternal Tower was a very important place. Guests were forbidden entry.
In a hall on the eighth floor.
The hall was octagonal. It was about 300 feet wide and 3,000 feet tall. Countless runes were carved on the ceiling and walls.
“Once you join Eternal Tower, you have to abide by Eternal Tower’s rules.” Chi Jiuxin handed a golden book to Meng Chuan. “Brother Eastcalm, read through the rules inside.”
“Okay.” Meng Chuan took it and began reading.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon was a high-ranking member of Eternal Tower. Meng Chuan was naturally familiar with this set of rules. The so-called rules were mainly to ensure that Eternal Tower could do business fairly. As Eternal Tower members, they couldn’t rely on their status to affect Eternal Tower’s operations.
The other restrictions on members weren’t too great. Eternal Tower was more particular about fair transactions. It was the same for their members.
“No problem.” Meng Chuan nodded and closed the golden book.
“The rules of Eternal Tower are considered very lax compared to the other top factions,” said Ta Gu with a smile. “The core mission of Eternal Tower is to do business.”
“I heard that Eternal Tower covers almost every river zone?” asked Meng Chuan.
“There are still 19 river zones that we can’t penetrate,” said Ta Gu. “The other river zones have river zone headquarters.”
Since he came from the Shura Realm, Ta Gu knew more than Meng Chuan.
“Brother Eastcalm, since you have no objections, let’s begin the ritual,” said Chi Jiuxin. “In a while, you will personally promise to abide by the 99 Eternal Tower rules with the Eye of Eternal as a witness and become a member of Eternal Tower.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Alright.”
“Then, let’s begin.” Only then did Chi Jiuxin activate the runic array formation on the hall’s walls. Following that, he and Ta Gu immediately left the hall.
The door closed, leaving Meng Chuan alone in the hall.
Meng Chuan looked up and saw a vortex appear at the top of the hall. A huge eye appeared in the vortex.
Eye of Eternal.
Meng Chuan’s heart jolted.
The huge eye had a golden iris as it looked down.
Facing it, Meng Chuan felt tiny.
According to Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s records, even Seventh Tribulation Eminences had limited lifespans. Therefore, the Eye of Eternal was the one actually in charge of Eternal Tower’s operations. Eternal Tower had existed for hundreds of millions of years. The Eye of Eternal remained in constant existence through the connection between the River of Spacetime headquarters and the river zone headquarters. It was capable of observing each river zone headquarters simultaneously.
It had all sorts of unimaginable abilities. Ancestral Master Archean Eon treated it as a Seventh Tribulation Eminence with an eternal lifespan.
“Archean Eon Realm, City Lord Eastcalm, Meng Chuan. Are you willing to abide by Eternal Tower’s 99 rules?” The Eye of Eternal filled the sky above the hall as it looked down at Meng Chuan.
Words appeared in front of Meng Chuan. They were the rules he had seen in the book.
“I’m willing to abide by Eternal Tower’s 99 rules and become a member of Eternal Tower,” said Meng Chuan solemnly.
“With you being at the Fifth Tribulation realm at such a young age, I’m looking forward to seeing Archean Eon Realm produce another Seventh Tribulation Eminence,” said the Eye of Eternal from above.
Meng Chuan’s heart skipped a beat.
Young Fifth Tribulation Eminence? Young?
Did the Eye of Eternal discern my age at a glance? That’s right. Ancestral Master Archean Eon treated it as a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. It isn’t strange for it to have all sorts of unimaginable abilities. Seeing through my age is nothing surprising.
Hum.
Golden threads gathered in the hall and condensed into a golden token. On it was the word ‘Eastcalm,’ which landed in Meng Chuan’s hand.
Meng Chuan knew that this was his Eternal Tower identity token. The moment he held it, he felt that he could control it perfectly. This was because it was condensed using Meng Chuan’s aura.
With the token, he could contact the river zone headquarters.
Whoosh.
Following that, the mysterious power rapidly receded. The Eye of Eternal glanced at Meng Chuan once more before completely disappearing.
The Eye of Eternal had seen generations of Seventh Tribulation Eminences. Thus, it didn’t care much about geniuses unless they were at the Seventh Tribulation realm. It was only because Meng Chuan came from Archean Eon Realm and was a young Fifth Tribulation Eminence that it paid any notice to him.
I’ve become a member of Eternal Tower.
Meng Chuan looked at the token in his hand. He could sense that the token could contact the river zone headquarters and gather more information whenever he needed to.
Ordinary member: City Lord Eastcalm, Meng Chuan.
Homeworld: Goddess River Zone, Three Bay River System, Archean Eon Realm.
Strength: Fifth Tribulation realm
Contribution: Zero
I can find many manuals and treasures at a river zone headquarters.
Meng Chuan tested out his token and was shocked.
Eternal Tower was the largest transaction ground in the River of Spacetime. In terms of heritage and treasures, it was one of the best in the River of Spacetime.
Many special treasures were very rare. They were not sold to outsiders. Only Eternal Tower members could purchase them.
Eternal Tower members were also divided into different levels.
There were different categories of treasures that could be bought at the Fifth Tribulation realm. One could buy them with Outer Realm Essence Crystals.
More treasures could be bought at the Sixth Tribulation realm, including the Void Catalog. One only needed to pay Outer Realm Essence Crystals to buy them.
The purchasing breadth of a Seventh Tribulation realm continued to increase.
Apart from one’s strength and status being considered, the other factor was their contribution.
One could purchase any treasure with their Eternal Tower contribution points.
Basic-level Eternal Token: Exchanged using 300,000 contribution points. One could buy many treasures with a basic-level Eternal Token.
In fact, a basic-level Eternal Token could be sold to outsiders. This was also a way for outsiders to buy top-notch treasures. The expenditure was deducted from the members’ contributions.
An intermediate-level Eternal Token could be exchanged for one million contribution points.
Advanced-level Eternal Tokens could be exchanged for three million contribution points. This was also the most valuable item in Eternal Tower.
Eternal Tower members could use their contribution points to exchange for various treasures. They could also exchange for basic-level Eternal Tokens to sell to non-members.
My current contribution points are zero.
Meng Chuan mocked himself.
If I relied on myself, I really don’t know how many years it would take me to accumulate 300,000 contribution points.
According to Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s records, if a Sixth Tribulation Eminence worked hard in Eternal Tower’s service, they would have a chance of earning 300,000 contribution points. In fact, most Sixth Tribulation Eminences failed to accrue 300,000 contribution points after working for Eternal Tower their entire lives.
It was very difficult for a Fifth Tribulation Eminence like Meng Chuan to earn tens of thousands of contribution points.
Therefore, the only way to buy a Void Catalog volume in the short term is to obtain a basic-level Eternal Token.
Meng Chuan scanned through the information about all the different treasures. There was lots of information regarding the Void Catalog. As the number one ultimate void lineage manual in the River of Spacetime, one suspected to be created by an Eternal existence, it was naturally extremely expensive.
Each of the Void Catalog’s three volumes contained different aspects of the void.
A single volume required 300,000 contribution points. One could exchange for a single volume using a basic-level Eternal Token. For members at the Sixth Tribulation or above, 300,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals could be exchanged for one volume. After exchanging for it, one had to read it immediately; they weren’t allowed to take it out of the Eternal Tower headquarters.
Meng Chuan didn’t hesitate. With a flip of his hand, he took out the basic-level Eternal Token. A wisp of Power of Essence Soul seeped into the basic-level Eternal Token. The aura of the basic-level Eternal Token immediately intensified, causing the entire Eternal Tower to tremble.
Buzz—
Waves enveloped Meng Chuan.
“I wish to buy the third volume of the Void Catalog,” said Meng Chuan.

chapters.title: Chapter 572 - Sweeping Clean the Three Bay River System
chapters.content:
Chapter 572: Sweeping Clean the Three Bay River System
A blurry light descended from the hall and enveloped Meng Chuan’s basic-level Eternal Token. An eye appeared from deep within the blurry light. This eye’s pressure was much weaker than the Eye of Eternal’s. Furthermore, it didn’t project any emotions.
Meng Chuan knew very well that this eye was the river zone Eternal Tower headquarters’ artifact spirit. It was the arbiter of absolute fairness, and it also prevented members from mismanaging anything.
“Basic-level Eternal Token.” A voice echoed in the hall. “You can buy the third volume of the Void Catalog. Please wait for a few seconds.”
Meng Chuan stood there and waited.
He couldn’t tell Ta Gu and Chi Jiuxin about his use of the basic-level Eternal Token.
It was very common for people to betray their good friends for treasures. News of people breaking their promises and getting tainted with great karma often happened in the outer realm.
Not everyone was afraid of karma! Many Tribulation Eminences found it difficult to improve their cultivation. They had no hope of improving themselves further. Thus, they didn’t mind if they were tainted by karma. If they obtained treasures, they could still increase their combat strength with them! Furthermore, they could extend their lifespans and gain other benefits.
The outer realm was very cruel.
In order to become stronger, it was very common for Tribulation Eminences to kill and plunder. It would take ages for a Sixth Tribulation Eminence to accumulate treasures by only treasure hunting. If one wantonly plundered treasures and killed 10-20 Fifth Tribulation Eminences, they would typically gain over 100,000 cubes worth of treasures! Nothing was faster than plundering.
Therefore, weaker Tribulation Eminences were willing to follow experts and seek their protection.
As for Fifth Tribulation Eminences, they formed factions! For example, Meng Chuan joining Eternal Tower was equivalent to having a backer. Even so, plundering in the outer realm happened often.
A basic-level Eternal Token was enough to tempt a Sixth Tribulation Eminence! A Fifth Tribulation Eminence would go crazy for it! Given enough benefits, one could even betray Eternal Tower.
The best method was to conceal the matter. Exchanging for treasures using a basic-level Eternal Token could only be done through the artifact spirit. However, the artifact spirit wouldn’t be greedy. It was absolutely fair.
Huh? Meng Chuan looked up.
A very thick black book appeared out of thin air. This treasure had just been teleported from the Eternal Tower’s River of Spacetime headquarters.
The black book was about half the size of a person. It was about a foot thick and emitted a faint black fog. The void distorted in the black fog.
Meng Chuan reached out and received it. The book cover was pitch-black. He flipped to the first page, revealing the golden words on the black page.
When Meng Chuan read them, the words flew out and entered his eyes. He constantly flipped through the pages. There were a total of 209 pages. The words and drawings constantly flew into his eyes. After Meng Chuan flipped to the last page, the remaining golden words flew into his eyes.
When all the golden words and drawings vanished, the black book silently turned to dust and vanished.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged. His mind was filled with the contents of the Void Catalog’s third volume. He carefully read and pondered over every sentence. After cultivating for so many years, he had never realized that one sentence could contain so much profundity.
A single sentence triggered many thoughts in him.
Every sentence had to be carefully read and reflected on.
Great wisdom!
The creator of the Void Catalog dissected space from different angles. Furthermore, the ideas contained within the Void Catalog naturally extended to lightning, earth, wind, fire, and other laws. Of course, the core of the manual was still space.
This wasn’t a cultivation ultimate technique or a move.
It was purely a catalog that described the void. It mainly consisted of words and some drawings.
For just the first eight sentences, Meng Chuan sat cross-legged and meditated for more than six hours. He felt as though those eight sentences had illuminated the many areas in which he groped about in the dark.
Boom!
Many ideas surfaced in Meng Chuan’s mind. Suddenly, his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique transformed.
Meng Chuan’s Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique had long reached the perfected Heaven Earth realm. Its strength was comparable to a Third Tribulation technique. He had been cultivating for a long time and had accumulated experience in many areas. However, he still couldn’t elevate it to the Fourth Tribulation realm.
At that moment, many of his accumulated insights had been stirred. They transformed and reached a higher level.
Huh? Meng Chuan opened his eyes and looked at the void.
In the past, the mysterious void had countless fluctuations. Now that he had found a pattern in the countless fluctuations, they could naturally be sorted into different categories. Everything had its own rules.
After mastering a portion of the laws, his control over the surrounding void increased greatly. His range was wider and more powerful. The Void Catalog’s third volume focused on domains. Meng Chuan could clearly sense that his void domain had improved significantly.
As expected of the number one void lineage manual in the River of Spacetime. Meng Chuan was extremely excited. Every sentence is filled with infinite wisdom. My Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique broke through just by reading the first eight sentences on the first page.
Of course, this was related to his long-term accumulation.
Furthermore, I only gained some basic insights. Just these eight sentences are enough for me to keep ruminating for a long time. They extend in different directions.
A single sentence contained many viable paths. Just those eight sentences could help him improve in many aspects.
I’ll slowly study it after returning to Three Bay River System. Meng Chuan stood up and opened the hall door.
…
“Brother Eastcalm has been in there for so long. I wonder what he’s doing,” said Chi Jiuxin as he drank.
By his side, Ta Gu was leisurely eating snacks and drinking as he chatted. “There’s no rush. Eastcalm just joined Eternal Tower after all. He must have been stunned by Eternal Tower’s treasure vault. He probably has to buy some necessary treasures first.”
Chi Jiuxin nodded. “Eternal Tower’s treasure vault is indeed comprehensive.”
Eternal Tower naturally had countless treasures for all cultivators considering its business front.
Whoosh.
A path appeared in the void ahead. Meng Chuan walked over.
“Are you done?” Ta Gu’s eyes lit up as he stood up with a smile. Chi Jiuxin also stood up.
“I’m sorry for making the two of you wait until now,” said Meng Chuan apologetically.
Even the proud Chi Jiuxin was rather polite when he looked at the white-haired man in front of him. He had read Meng Chuan’s self-introduction in his application to join Eternal Tower. He knew that Eastcalm was a Fifth Tribulation Eminence who cultivated both his body and Essence Soul. Furthermore, he had grasped at least two Fifth Tribulation laws. Meng Chuan was considered extremely strong among Fifth Tribulation Eminences. Jiuxin wasn’t confident that he could defeat him, so he was naturally willing to befriend him.
“It took me quite some time to peruse through Eternal Tower’s entire treasure vault during my first time. I was shocked back then.”
“It’s indeed tempting, but everything is very expensive,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
Many things moved him when he first perused Eternal Tower’s treasure vault. However, when compared to the Void Catalog, very few things could tempt him. Most of the treasures were around 10,000 cubes. He couldn’t afford them with the treasures he had on him.
“Haha. The better the treasures, the more expensive they are. What do you plan on doing next, Brother Eastcalm?” asked Ta Gu with a smile. “I’m preparing to leave Goddess River Zone and head to Fuxiu River Zone. Brother Eastcalm, do you want to join me?”
“Probably not.” Meng Chuan shook his head. “I want to return to Three Bay River System. Next, I plan on building an Eternal Tower branch in Three Bay River System.”
“An Eternal Tower Branch?” Ta Gu and Chi Jiuxin exchanged looks.
“The cultivators in Three Bay River System will probably be grateful to you, Brother Eastcalm,” said Chi Jiuxin wistfully.
“That’s right. Those weak cultivators wish to have a safe trading ground,” said Ta Gu. “As for the weaker cultivators, they would probably find it difficult to leave a river system. To have an Eternal Tower branch in their river system is a great opportunity for them.”
“However, it’s not that easy to establish an Eternal Tower branch,” reminded Chi Jiuxin. “Brother Eastcalm, before you establish it, you have to sweep the factions that plunder on a large-scale in Three Bay River System clean. Make sure that Three Bay River System is within Eternal Tower’s territory.”
Ta Gu added, “It’s too easy to plunder for treasures. Many river systems have hidden experts that like to plunder. If there are a few large-scale plundering factions hiding, the Eternal Tower branch wouldn’t be able to do business properly.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
For example, Black Fiend Hall was created purely for plundering. It was considered a top faction in the River of Spacetime.
Although top factions like Shadow Lands and Ancestral Magus Realm weren’t created for plundering, they didn’t forbid their members from plundering.
As for the weaker Tribulation Eminences, there were even more who liked plundering.
“If you are only cultivating in seclusion in Three Bay River System, it naturally won’t be a big deal. However, if you want to build an Eternal Tower branch there, you have to clear out the river system,” said Ta Gu. “Let those experts, who are happy to plunder, know your name. They won’t dare to cause damage afterward.”
“Brother Eastcalm,” said Chi Jiuxin, “if you really want to build an Eternal Tower branch, you have to submit an application. Eternal Tower’s river zone headquarters will carefully investigate Three Bay River System. They will investigate and list down the various plundering factions for you. You have to clean them up. After you do so… Eternal Tower will send a branch to the place you want to set up as a base.”
“Then I’ll sweep Three Bay River System clean.” Meng Chuan nodded. He was still confident about this.

chapters.title: Chapter 573 - Cultivation
chapters.content:
Chapter 573: Cultivation
Meng Chuan, Chi Jiuxin, and Ta Gu sat down and chatted. They also settled the application to establish an Eternal Tower branch in Three Bay River System.
“There’s no problem with this request.” Chi Jiuxin looked at Meng Chuan’s application and nodded slightly. Following that, he said in surprise, “Three Bay River System, Thousand Mountain Star, Eastcalm City? Is this Thousand Mountain Star the one spoken of in history?”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Yes.”
“That’s a Sixth Tribulation Eminence’s cultivation cave abode,” said Chi Jiuxin with a smile. “I’m impressed.”
When Ta Gu heard this, he said, “A cultivation cave abode that was once a Sixth Tribulation Eminence’s? Then, Thousand Mountain Star is safe enough. It can also attract many Tribulation Eminences to set up a garrison at your place.”
They had vast knowledge.
Although a Fifth Tribulation Eminence who helmed a cultivation base left behind by a Sixth Tribulation Eminence was considered lucky, it was still quite common.
As for Sixth Tribulation Eminences, all of them stood at the pinnacle of river zones. They were famous existences in the River of Spacetime. They pursued cultivation grounds known as mystic realms.
Mystic realms were created by Eighth Tribulation Eminences.
Compared to a mystic realm, Meng Chuan’s Thousand Mountain Star was nothing worth mentioning.
“After the application is submitted, Eternal Tower will send you a list after it finishes its investigation on Three Bay River System,” said Chi Jiuxin. “You just need to clear out the factions on the list.”
“How long will it take?” asked Meng Chuan.
“About a year,” said Chi Jiuxin. “A river system is rather vast. Even Eternal Tower will take a year to finish investigating everything. Even then, they can only identify the relatively famous plundering factions.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
It took light tens of thousands of years to fly from one end of a river system to the other.
River systems were vast. Each one had countless stars! Nobody knew how many cultivators were hiding in a river system.
If a plundering faction was very careful and low-key, such as only killing Supremacies without leaving any survivors, it would be very difficult to identify them.
Even with Eternal Tower’s unimaginable means, they could only identify the famous ones.
...
That day, Meng Chuan and Ta Gu left Scarlet Snake Planet and embarked on their separate journeys.
Ta Gu headed for Fuxiu River Zone, while Meng Chuan returned to Three Bay River System.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan traveled through the River of Spacetime very quickly. On the same day, he returned to Thousand Mountain Star.
A red-robed Zhao Hongxiu stood at the peak of a mountain. She pulled her bow and aimed her arrow into the distance. After a few seconds, she released her grip. The arrow instantly pierced through a void interlayer and struck a distant target.
Suddenly, a white-robed Meng Chuan appeared. With a tap of his finger, the arrow appeared in the void, and it stopped moving.
“Master.” When Zhao Hongxiu saw this, she immediately took a step forward and bowed respectfully.
Meng Chuan looked at his disciple and said with a smile, “Hiding an arrow in a void interlayer is for better stealth. However, void interlayers are ultimately very niche when it comes to space. For cultivation, one should take the widest path from the beginning.”
Zhao Hongxiu’s heart stirred. She immediately bowed excitedly and said, “Master, please guide me.”
“The void is all-encompassing. Just follow your heart and choose a Great Dao that suits you the best. As for what you choose, that’s up to you,” said Meng Chuan with a smile before disappearing.
“Thank you, Master.” Zhao Hongxiu bowed immediately as many thoughts surfaced in her mind.
She had been cultivating for many years. Being left to her own devices, she hadn’t realized the path she was treading. After all, she was once an assassin. Her archery skills had unknowingly developed towards assassination. Her path was narrow.
A wide path and a narrow path naturally had different levels of difficulty, but both led to progress.
Only those with extremely high attainments in the void lineage could tell Zhao Hongxiu’s problem at a glance.
This was also the reason why many cultivators, even Tribulation Eminences, were willing to follow experts. A single pointer from an expert could lead them out from their dead ends. A single sentence could change their lives.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan landed on the top floor of a building and poured himself a cup of fruit wine.
The fruit wine could invigorate his Essence Soul, increasing his perceptive efficiency.
The third volume of the Void Catalog.
Meng Chuan took a sip of wine and began to study every word and drawing carefully.
Without anyone disturbing him, he could fully focus on comprehending the void lineage.
He even temporarily slowed down his studies into Infinite Saber and Nirvana Saber. Figuring out the void lineage’s Fifth Tribulation law was now of paramount importance. After comprehending it, he could fuse three Fifth Tribulation laws together, boosting his chances of forming higher-level laws.
As a Tribulation Eminence, the ultimate path of cultivation was to pursue spacetime laws.
Spacetime was also the source of all laws. The powers of wind, fire, and lightning, including Chaos Holes and Primordial Stars, were derived from spacetime.
Amazing.
As Meng Chuan meditated, ideas constantly surfaced in his mind.
Meng Chuan was extremely addicted to the feeling of reaping benefits constantly.
I wonder if I, Meng Chuan, will be able to produce such a technique in my life.
As Meng Chuan meditated, he felt admiration for the creator of the Void Catalog.
It was too impressive.
The Essence Soul legacy—Essence Soul Star—was also an Eighth Tribulation legacy, yet he didn’t gain as much from it compared to studying the Void Catalog. As he studied it, Meng Chuan’s understanding of lightning improved.
A single Dao produced myriad Daos.
Meng Chuan could vaguely sense that the creator of the Void Catalog had completely grasped other paths. It was only because of this that he could easily extract the best out of all the lineages and create the Void Catalog.
One had to know that a complete Dao of Space was only at the Sixth Tribulation realm. It was naturally the strongest path at the Sixth Tribulation realm. With it, one could barely fight a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Under normal circumstances, only Seventh Tribulation Eminences could grasp a complete Dao of Space.
However, the Dao of Space was divided into three Void Catalog volumes. Just one volume made Meng Chuan feel that it was much better than the Essence Soul Star, an Eighth Tribulation legacy. This was the difference between the creators. It was inevitable that many Tribulation Eminences believed that an Eternal existence created the Void Catalog.
Days passed.
Meng Chuan immersed himself in his comprehension of the Void Catalog. Occasionally, he would send his Essence Soul avatars to a Chaos Hole to test out his moves. Chaos Holes had a huge influence on spacetime. Thus, he had a completely different experience practicing his moves in a Chaos Hole than in normal areas.
His wife, parents, and company could sleep for 1,000 years at most. Meng Chuan had to make every second count. A Chaos Hole was clearly suitable for him to save time.
He had to reach the Sixth Tribulation realm before they finished their 1,000-year slumber!
This way, he could obtain more from Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasure vault. His status in the River of Spacetime would also be much higher. It would also help his wife, parents, and company greatly.
...
In the Cang Alliance Space.
Only the members of the Cang Alliance could condense an embodiment here.
“Eastcalm, Eastcalm, over here.”
Meng Chuan saw a few figures sitting in the distance. Among them, Old Fiend Black Wind waved his hand with a smile. Meng Chuan walked over.
“This is Brother Eastcalm?” A short fatty stood up with a smile. He was as fat as a ball, and his skin was very fair. “I’ve long heard about you. It’s our first time meeting today.”
“Brother Fu Sui?” Meng Chuan smiled as well. Although he was meeting him for the first time, he knew all of the Cang Alliance members because of the basic intelligence given to him. He naturally recognized Fu Sui at once. He looked at the other three people around him. They were Old Fiend Black Wind, Zi Yao, and Mountain Lord Boneserve.
In the Cang Alliance, there were people who liked to make friends.
The more friends they had, the larger their social network. It made it easier for them to obtain opportunities.
For example, Zi Yao and Mountain Lord Boneserve had many old friends. Although Old Fiend Black Wind had just joined the alliance, he was also eager to befriend others. They spent half a month here every month with their embodiments to befriend the various members of the Cang Alliance.
As a newbie, Meng Chuan was happy to befriend others.

chapters.title: Chapter 574 - Plundering Factions
chapters.content:
Chapter 574: Plundering Factions
“We were talking about you just now.” Mountain Lord Boneserve was a skeleton draped in a robe. His homeworld was a middle-level world. His cultivation focused on the Skeleton Body, which ultimately transformed him into a skeleton lifeform.
“Even if Cang Alliance members are scattered across the River of Spacetime, there are only about ten people who have cultivated their body and Essence Soul to the Fifth Tribulation realm. If we include the fact that you’ve grasped two Fifth Tribulation laws, there will only be two.” Fu Sui—who was as chubby as a ball—smiled with an infectious smile. “Brother Eastcalm is the third. We naturally have to befriend such a person.”
Meng Chuan smiled and said, “I’ve heard of Brother Fu Sui’s name many times.”
“Is it because I like to explore ruins and court death?” Fu Sui smiled.
The members of the Cang Alliance came from all over the universe. They had their individualistic style.
Fu Sui enjoyed adventures and exploration! Since he explored ruins often, he had brushes with death many times.
“Fu Sui, how many times have your outer realm true bodies died during your ruin expeditions?” asked Zi Yao with a smile. “I remember it was 35 when you told me last time.”
“Thirty-seven times,” Fu Sui said helplessly. “Although I gain from exploring ruins, losing my outer realm true body time and time again makes me rather poor, despite the fact I can cultivate a new one.”
Once one’s outer realm true body died, all the treasures it carried would be gone! An outer realm true body also required numerous treasures for cultivation.
Therefore, Fu Sui didn’t want to spend too much when it came to cultivating his body. Although he had grasped two Fifth Tribulation laws, his physical body was relatively weak. His overall strength was considered average among Fifth Tribulation Eminences. However, in the Cang Alliance, he was publicly acknowledged to have the most experience in exploring ruins. Everyone was willing to befriend him and invite him to explore ruins together.
...
Meng Chuan chatted with Fu Sui, Mountain Lord Boneserve, Old Fiend Black Wind, and Zi Yao for a long time before departing.
The Cang Alliance’s gatherings were also a way to befriend others.
After all, those who could join the Cang Alliance were Fifth Tribulation Eminences at least. All of them were overlords of a river system.
In the past half year, Meng Chuan met more than 100 members in the Cang Alliance Space. Old Fiend Black Wind—who liked to befriend people—had acquainted himself with more people than Meng Chuan did in the past half-year.
“They have all left. Let’s talk business,” said Fu Sui with a smile as he looked at Black Wind.
“What’s the matter?” asked Black Wind.
“I plan on exploring an ancient ruin.” Fu Sui nodded and said, “I want to ask if you are interested in joining us?”
“You plan on exploring another ruin again?” Black Wind knew that Fu Sui was very crazy in this aspect. “Can’t you just do it alone? Why are you roping me in?”
Fu Sui shook his head gently. “It’s different this time. This ruin is a little special. Furthermore, I’ve already died twice during my preliminary explorations. I need companions. As for your cultivation methods, they should be quite suitable for the expedition. Therefore, I’m here to invite you.”
“Where’s the ruin?” asked Black Wind.
“It’s in Six Desires River Zone,” Fu Sui said.
“It’s very far from my Goddess River Zone. It’ll take me more than a year to travel there,” said Black Wind.
“It’s only a year. Are you coming?” asked Fu Sui. “The rewards obtained from the ruin exploration will depend on each person’s ability.”
Black Wind pondered for a moment and looked at Fu Sui.
Although most Fifth Tribulation Eminences had another true body hiding in their homeworld, making them virtually immortal, losing their treasures and the body when exploring a ruin would result in a loss of thousands of cubes, maybe even more. They naturally had to be careful. Very few people were as crazy as Fu Sui in exploring ruins.
This Fu Sui’s physical body is weak. The Tribulation treasures he carries with him are weak as well. However, he has also grasped two Fifth Tribulation laws. In terms of strength, he’s not inferior to me, thought Black Wind to himself. He has quite a good reputation in the Cang Alliance because of his numerous ruin expeditions. He has already made two preliminary expeditions to this ruin. This ruin must be very special and attractive to him. I can give it a try. However, I shouldn’t bring too many treasures with me. I just need to unleash 70 to 80 percent of my strength.
Fu Sui waited by the side for Black Wind’s answer.
“Alright, I’ll set off immediately. We’ll meet in Six Desires River Zone.” Black Wind nodded. “Only the two of us will explore the ruin together.”
Fu Sui nodded. “Just you and me.”
...
After making some arrangements that day, Black Wind immediately set off for the distant Six Desires River Zone to rendezvous with Fu Sui.
As for Meng Chuan, he was still focused on cultivating in Three Bay River System. He was busy comprehending the River of Spacetime’s best void manual—Void Catalog’s third volume.
...
Three Bay River System, in an outer realm void.
Two Imperial Lords looked around in despair. Black ripples emanated from the surrounding void for tens of millions of kilometers. They were like bugs that had fallen into a spiderweb. They were unable to escape.
“Senior, Senior, we are willing to offer our treasures. Please spare our lives,” pleaded the two Imperial Lords.
A black-robed elder appeared amidst the black ripples. His eyes were filled with black runes as he sized up the two Imperial Lords. It was as though he was looking at two ants waiting to be slaughtered. He said coldly, “I’ll spare your lives if you hand over all the treasures on you, including the items in the grotto-heaven.”
“Everything?” The two Imperial Lords exchanged looks.
In front of a Tribulation Eminence, there was no way they could hide anything.
“Count ourselves unlucky to encounter Old Bandit Bolan. Don’t hold any hopes. Let’s just hope that he will spare the juniors’ lives.”
“I hope Old Bandit Bolan doesn’t force us too much.” The duo communicated via voice transmissions.
One of the Imperial Lords immediately said respectfully, “We are willing to hand over all the treasures on us. However, we have Supremacies in our grotto-heaven. Please spare them. These Supremacies will naturally hand over all their treasures as well.”
“Supremacies? It’s better for such weaklings to die.” The black-robed elder’s eyes suffused a ferocious glow.
He liked killing Supremacies.
Why would he spare an Imperial Lord? This was because an Imperial Lord had another true body in their homeworlds. Even if he killed them, an Imperial Lord could cultivate another true body.
As for Supremacies, killing them meant killing them completely! The thought of completely killing a cultivator excited the black-robed elder.
“Senior, killing them won’t do you any good.”
“Senior, please give those Supremacies a chance of survival.” The two Imperial Lords were somewhat anxious. Some of the Supremacies they brought were their followers, while others were Supremacies from their homeworld. It was fine if the treasures were gone, but they still had to protect the Supremacies’ lives.
The black-robed elder chuckled as his black eyes became even more ferocious. “I’ll give the two of you a choice. Hand over the treasures and all the Supremacies and scram. The other choice is death for the two of you.”
“Senior.” One of the Imperial Lords suppressed his anger and maintained a respectful attitude. “If you give the Supremacies a way out, we will offer all our treasures. If you don’t give them a way out, we will definitely not hand over all our treasures. We will destroy as many treasures as we can.”
“Senior, why would you want to lose so many treasures just to vent your anger?” asked another Imperial Lord.
“Are you threatening me?” The black-robed elder chuckled strangely.
“Senior, you are a Tribulation Eminence. Why bother being petty with juniors? Please show some generosity. We will definitely thank you for sparing our lives.” The two Imperial Lords tried to persuade him.
Clang!
Without any warning, the black ripples in the void domain erupted with all its might, attacking the two Imperial Lords.
“Scum!” The two Imperial Lords’ eyes turned red. In their rage and despair, they only had time to self-destruct. They tried their best to destroy the treasures they carried with them. However, many Tribulation treasures could not be destroyed.
Soon, only a portion of the treasures remained! The two Imperial Lords and the 23 Supremacies hiding in the grotto-heaven died. The Imperial Lords still had true bodies in their homeworld, but the Supremacies had truly died.
“Hahaha... I like to see that look of despair.” The black-robed elder extended his long tongue—his tongue was split into three parts—and licked his lips. He enjoyed the pleasure gained from killing others. He enjoyed the despair of the weak. He then put away the treasures and left.
An hour later, in a hidden cave abode on a Grand Yin Star.
The black-robed elder returned to the cave abode. The Imperial Lords were extremely respectful when they saw him.
“Bolan, you’re back.” A red-robed man—who was sitting there, eating large mouthfuls of meat—looked up and asked, “How’s your harvest this time?”
“After wandering around for half a year, I only encountered three batches of cultivators. I killed seven Imperial Lords and over 50 Supremacies.” The black-robed elder shook his head and said, “Those Supremacies were completely wiped out. Unfortunately, Imperial Lords have true bodies in inhabited worlds. There’s no way to kill them completely. I’m really envious of these ants. Us special lifeforms have no world to hide in.”
“They can hide in their homeworlds, but they are still very weak,” said the red-robed man as he ate the meat. “By the way, we have to restrain ourselves from today onwards.”
“Restrain? Why?” asked the black-robed elder in puzzlement.
“Our Three Bay River System has an additional Fifth Tribulation Eminence,” said the red-robed man. “According to the news from Black Fiend Hall, Three Bay River System’s newly-appeared Fifth Tribulation Eminence is City Lord Eastcalm.”

chapters.title: Chapter 575 - City Lord Eastcalms List
chapters.content:
Chapter 575: City Lord Eastcalm’s List
“City Lord Eastcalm?” The black-robed elder was puzzled. “I’ve been in Three Bay River System for so many years, but I’ve never heard of anyone named City Lord Eastcalm.”
“It’s said that he’s a Tribulation Eminence of our Three Bay River System. He might have been traveling far away in the past.” The red-robed man ate his meat and glanced at the black-robed man. “Bolan, let me remind you. This City Lord Eastcalm has already joined Eternal Tower. If he plans on building an Eternal Tower branch in Three Bay River System, he will definitely sweep the plundering factions here clean.”
The black-robed elder’s heart palpitated.
Although he had dominated Three Bay River System for a long time, he knew how terrifying a Fifth Tribulation Eminence was. At the very least, they wouldn’t be able to withstand him.
His companion, Cave Lord Redmynah, was the strongest expert of the species. He was a member of Black Fiend Hall, but he was only at the Fourth Tribulation realm. City Lord Eastcalm could kill him with a flip of his hand.
“I’m only telling you to be careful,” said the red-robed man casually. “City Lord Eastcalm will probably be like Palace Lord Snowjade. He will focus on cultivation and not care about the outside world. That way, we will still be carefree.”
The black-robed elder nodded immediately. “I hope so.”
Fifth Tribulation Eminences were supreme existences. It was best if they didn’t bring them trouble.
“If he wants to establish an Eternal Tower branch and a transaction ground, it requires Palace Lord Snowjade’s agreement,” said the red-robed man. “Palace Lord Snowjade is a Fifth Tribulation Eminence in Three Bay River System. He’s very proud and aloof. Since there are two Fifth Tribulation Eminences in one river system, one will definitely be stronger than the other.”
“With Palace Lord Snowjade’s character, how can he allow another to control Three Bay River System’s commerce?” The black-robed elder’s eyes lit up. They had cultivated in Three Bay River System for many years. They knew Palace Lord Snowjade’s temperament very well. If one didn’t provoke him, he wouldn’t be bothered with other Tribulation Eminences. However, if one transgressed his authority, he would definitely take action.
The red-robed man nodded and said, “In short, we have to monitor the situation. We have to flee as soon as possible once things go south.”
“Alright.” The black-robed elder nodded. “However, we were born in Three Bay River System. We have been cultivating here for so many years. I really don’t want to leave.”
He was too familiar with Three Bay River System.
“Our species is in Three Bay River System. I’m also unwilling to leave, but if the situation forces us, we have to make a choice,” said the red-robed man solemnly. “By the way, City Lord Eastcalm lives on Thousand Mountain Star. Don’t go anywhere close.”
“Thousand Mountain Star?” The black-robed elder understood. “In Three Bay River System’s history, there were only hundreds of Sixth Tribulation Eminences. I know the approximate location.”
Thousand Mountain Star was very famous in history.
However, with its master dead and the array formation activated, Thousand Mountain Star hid itself. However, Three Bay River System’s Tribulation Eminences knew its approximate location.
The news of Meng Chuan’s residing on Thousand Mountain Star had been spread by the Cang Alliance. They had also reported it to Eternal Tower. Many people knew of this matter, so Black Fiend Hall naturally obtained this information.
In the future, if Cang Alliance members came to Three Bay River System, they could head to Thousand Mountain Star to look for Meng Chuan.
Furthermore, Thousand Mountain Star had to be made public if an Eternal Tower Branch were to be established!
...
A new Fifth Tribulation Eminence has appeared in our Three Bay River System. Furthermore, he has cultivated both his body and Essence Soul. I’m afraid some tough times will be ahead.
A stocky elder with silver fur sat cross-legged on a barren planet. His aura was one with the entire planet. It even affected the surrounding void for tens of millions of kilometers.
However, I’m secluded here. It won’t affect me. I wonder when I can break through the bottleneck and grasp a Fifth Tribulation law.
The stocky elder sighed. His emotions had been in upheaval when he received the news from Yellow-Robed Academy. Following that, he restrained his emotions and continued cultivating.
The Yellow-Robed Academy was also one of the top factions in the River of Spacetime. The minimum requirement to be a member was to be at the Fourth Tribulation realm. However, one had to undergo strict tests to join it. Therefore, there were fewer Yellow-Robed Academy members than Black Fiend Hall, but many experts were inside.
...
Meng Chuan had only joined Eternal Tower for more than half a year. Few people in Three Bay River System knew about this.
The transmission of information in the outer realm was slow to begin with. Cave Lord Redmynah was a member of Black Fiend Hall. The stocky elder was a member of Yellow-Robed Academy, so he was able to learn of the news quickly. As for those below the Fourth Tribulation realm like Cave Lord Bolan, they didn’t have the right to join top factions. The top factions in the River of Spacetime generally had a minimum requirement of the Fifth Tribulation realm. No matter how low the threshold was, it would still be at the Fourth Tribulation realm.
...
On the same day. On Thousand Mountain Star, the top floor of a building.
Meng Chuan sat there with his white hair draped over his shoulders. He drank and immersed himself in the profundities of the Void Catalog’s third volume. His fingers gently moved the void.
Thousand Mountain Star’s void changed as well.
At times, it would distort and layer.
Thousand Mountain Star—which was about 1.95 million kilometers in diameter—was 30 times larger because of the void layer! Meng Chuan became even more unfathomable when it came to the void domain since he could change the void on such a large scale.
Oh?
Meng Chuan stopped cultivating and received a message.
This message was information transmitted through Eternal Tower’s identity token. Only the river zone’s Eternal Tower headquarters could instantly send information.
The name list of Three Bay River System’s plundering factions has finally arrived.
Meng Chuan checked the list he had received.
I’ve waited for a full 11 months.
The information on the list was very detailed.
A total of 18 plundering factions were recorded!
Among them, seven factions had Tribulation Eminences. Tribulation Eminences could wreak more havoc!
Based on Eternal Tower’s means, the least number of cultivators that had been killed by the seven factions with Tribulation Eminences in the past 10,000 years numbered more than 300. The most killed by a faction numbered more than 5,000! This alarmed Meng Chuan.
Cultivators who typically roamed the outer realm were, at the very least, Supremacies.
Although Three Bay River System has more than 100,000 inhabited worlds and many cultivators, these Tribulation Eminences have been plundering for a long time. They pose a threat to too many cultivators,
Meng Chuan thought to himself.
Tribulation Eminences that plundered occupied 20 to 30 percent of Three Bay River System’s total Tribulation Eminences. In 10,000 years, they had killed many cultivators. Compared to adventuring and ruin expeditions, plundering treasures was much easier. It made some Tribulation Eminences take this sunken road.
In the past, only Palace Lord Snowjade had the strength to clear Three Bay River System. However, he didn’t want to manage it. He coldly watched from above as the weak cultivators struggled.
With Meng Chuan’s current strength, it was very easy for him to clear Three Bay River System. He was naturally willing to do it.
With just a slight effort, he could save many cultivators’ lives, numbering in the tens of thousands.
Seven Tribulation Eminence factions and 11 Imperial Lord factions.
Meng Chuan carefully pondered over the information. There were many Imperial Lords in Three Bay River System. There were naturally other Imperial Lords that specialized in plundering. Only these 11 Imperial Lords were infamous.
Many of them have some background. They are related to top factions or are special lifeforms.
Meng Chuan pondered for a moment.
Let’s do this.
...
As he made his decision—
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Six black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuans left Thousand Mountain Star. Each of them carried a Sixth Tribulation treasure.
With Meng Chuan’s wealth, he had long bought six Sixth Tribulation treasures. Every Essence Soul avatar could carry one. They were very suitable for Meng Chuan. They were equipped with good offensive and defensive measures. In terms of offensive strength, they were stronger than the Bloodblade Disc. After all, the Bloodblade Disc focused on defense and escaping. It lacked offensive runes.
These new Sixth Tribulation treasures were all specially chosen by Meng Chuan when he contacted the river zone’s Eternal Tower headquarters. He checked Eternal Tower’s treasure vault and picked them out. They cost about 2,300 cubes in total.
Eternal Tower’s treasure vault was much better stocked than Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasure vault. Thus, it was very easy to find six items that were suitable for Meng Chuan. Furthermore, the prices were all very reasonable.
The six Essence Soul avatars moved at the same time.
Swoosh.
One of the Essence Soul avatars walked through the River of Spacetime and headed straight for Cave Lord Redmynah’s cave abode.
Cave Lord Redmynah.
The black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan confirmed his mission target.
Eternal Tower had used karma to lock onto these targets’ locations. Therefore, Meng Chuan immediately took action once he received the information! If he delayed any further, those Tribulation Eminences might have fled elsewhere. Although Meng Chuan wanted to kill those Tribulation Eminences, they had never met each other. The karmic ties between them were very faint, so he had to rely on Eternal Tower’s intelligence to locate them.
As expected of a Black Fiend Hall member, Cave Lord Redmynah’s faction has killed many cultivators and is ranked third.
Meng Chuan’s killing intent was very strong.
It was common to fight in the outer realm. However, killing Imperial Lords and Supremacies as Tribulation Eminences and plundering them for long periods of time was already beyond the normal confines of ‘battling.’
Cave Lord Redmynah has a fellow Tribulation Eminence, Cave Lord Bolan. The remaining subordinates are all Imperial Lords.
I’ve arrived.
Traveling in a river system was too easy for Meng Chuan. In a moment, he arrived at the cave abode hidden by Cave Lord Redmynah and Cave Lord Bolan.

chapters.title: Chapter 576 - Cave Lord Redmynah
chapters.content:
Chapter 576: Cave Lord Redmynah
It’s on this Grand Yin Star.
Meng Chuan stepped through the void and looked at the Grand Yin Star. His gaze landed on one of the cave abodes hidden by an array formation.
With his perception of the void, he could sense a massive cave abode hidden within.
Hum.
Meng Chuan took a step and arrived near the cave abode. At the same time, a vast painting world instantly enveloped his surroundings.
His Essence Soul World descended!
Oh? Not good.
Cave Lord Redmynah, who was in the cave abode, suddenly opened his eyes. As he controlled the cave abode’s array formation, he realized that the illusory Essence Soul World had forcefully invaded his cave abode and swept across the entire cave abode. At that moment, Cave Lord Redmynah didn’t hesitate to activate the protective item he carried with him.
An invisible fluctuation enveloped him, making him feel like he was isolated from the world.
The illusory Essence Soul World enveloped the entire cave abode.
One Imperial Lord after another fell silently, unable to put up any resistance.
The moment the black-robed elder, Cave Lord Bolan, was attacked by the Essence Soul World, he couldn’t control himself. He couldn’t speak. All he could do was raise his head with a pleading look. Without seeing the intruder clearly, he lost consciousness and collapsed to the ground.
In the entire cave abode were two Tribulation Eminences and a group of Imperial Lords, but only the Fourth Tribulation Eminence, Cave Lord Redmynah, remained lucid. He also relied on his protective treasures to resist the mental invasion.
Cave Lord Redmynah didn’t know that Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World also released Astral Waves. Astral Wave was a mystic technique that originated from an Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s legacy—Essence Soul Star. A Fourth Tribulation Eminence would be considered lucky if they could remain lucid when facing Meng Chuan’s Astral Wave. Even then, it was very difficult for them to maintain 20% of their strength.
“Who is it?” Cave Lord Redmynah’s expression turned ugly as he looked up into the sky.
In the sky, the black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan stood there and calmly looked down.
Cave Lord Redmynah recognized him. “City Lord Eastcalm.”
White-haired human?
In the intelligence provided by Black Fiend Hall, there was an image of City Lord Eastcalm.
City Lord Eastcalm sure attacked quickly. I didn’t even hear any news about his attacks. If I had known this would happen, I would have abandoned my species and fled to another river system with Bolan.
Cave Lord Redmynah was somewhat vexed, but he didn’t panic.
“Greetings, City Lord Eastcalm. I’m Redmynah from Black Fiend Hall,” Cave Lord Redmynah bowed and said, “City Lord Eastcalm, if you wish to clear Three Bay River System, all you need to do is give the order. I will definitely leave with my subordinates obediently. Why must City Lord Eastcalm personally take action?”
Clearing out didn’t mean killing.
Tribulation Eminences had avatars, so they had very strong life-preservation means. Tribulation Eminences from inhabited worlds were difficult to kill since their true bodies remained in their homeworld.
Therefore, the meaning of ‘cleaning out’ generally meant killing all the outer realm true bodies of the plunder factions’ members or expelling them from Three Bay River System!
“It’s fine if it’s just ordinary fighting,” said the black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan indifferently as he looked down at Cave Lord Redmynah. “However, I hate people like you who specialize in plundering and slaughtering weak cultivators. Therefore, I specially came to send you off.”
With that said, Meng Chuan flicked his sleeve.
Whoosh!
The Imperial Lords below were reduced to dust. The dust scattered across the world as he killed their other bodies through karma.
Upon seeing this, Cave Lord Redmynah’s expression changed drastically. The killed Imperial Lords were his descendants. He could clearly confirm that all of their bodies had been destroyed.
“City Lord Eastcalm, aren’t you going too far!?” Cave Lord Redmynah—who had been restraining himself—had an ugly expression as he stared at Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan looked down. His gaze landed on the unconscious, motionless black-robed elder—Cave Lord Bolan.
“City Lord Eastcalm.” Upon seeing this, Cave Lord Redmynah turned anxious. He immediately said, “I’m willing to submit to City Lord Eastcalm.”
Meng Chuan glanced at him in surprise.
In the outer realm, it was very common for ordinary Tribulation Eminences to follow Fifth Tribulation Eminences. However, very few Fourth Tribulation Eminences followed Fifth Tribulation Eminences. A Fifth Tribulation Eminence typically only had one or two Fourth Tribulation Eminences under them. Such arrangements only happened if a Fourth Tribulation Eminence was especially willing.
This was because Fourth Tribulation Eminences could join some of the River of Spacetime’s top factions that had lower requirements. In terms of strength, they weren’t too afraid of Fifth Tribulation Eminences. Fifth Tribulation Eminences could kill one of their true bodies, but they couldn’t kill their other true body through karma.
“Yes, I’m willing to submit to City Lord Eastcalm,” said Cave Lord Redmynah immediately. “I only hope that City Lord Eastcalm will spare Bolan.”
Their species only had two Tribulation Eminences.
Cave Lord Redmynah still cared about Bolan’s life. Furthermore, his true body in Three Bay River System carried many treasures because this river system was where he was born.
His other true body was participating in Black Fiend Hall’s missions. It was often out and experienced more dangers. Most of the treasures he gained were transferred to this river system.
To be able to protect this body and the treasures I have accumulated over the years, as well as Bolan’s life... I can tolerate submitting to this Eastcalm City Lord.
This was indeed what Cave Lord Redmynah thought.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan flicked his sleeve, and a black stream of light flew down.
As it flew out, it instantly landed on Cave Lord Bolan.
With a bang, the black-robed elder’s body trembled as he was reduced to dust. A terrifying force passed through the karmic connection between the two bodies and transmitted into Cave Lord Bolan’s other true body. Even though the attack’s power was reduced to a tenth, it represented Nirvana Saber’s Fifth Tribulation laws. Even though it only had ten percent of its strength left, the attack still destroyed Cave Lord Bolan’s other true body.
“No!” On a distant planet, Cave Lord Bolan was completely annihilated as he despaired.
In Three Bay River System, Old Bandit Bolan—who had reigned supreme for over 20,000 years—had died completely.
“Eastcalm!” Cave Lord Redmynah’s expression changed drastically.
He was already willing to submit to him, yet the other party still chose to kill Bolan.
“You can join him.” Meng Chuan flicked his sleeve, and another black beam of light flew towards Cave Lord Redmynah. It instantly landed on him, and ripples spread across his body. Even so, his body remained intact.
Cave Lord Redmynah glared at Meng Chuan. He instantly activated the Void Transference Talisman and vanished.
As a Fourth Tribulation Eminence, he had already obtained a Void Transference Talisman after joining Black Fiend Hall because he didn’t have an inhabited world to protect his other true body. He had this true body in Three Bay River System carry the talisman because it had many treasures. With his status and strength, he had only obtained one Void Transference Talisman.
He escaped?
Meng Chuan locked onto a location in the distance.
Cave Lord Redmynah was only one target on the list. Previously, he hadn’t seen him before, so the karmic connection between them both was very faint.
Now that he had seen Cave Lord Redmynah with his own eyes and grasped his aura, he could accurately lock onto his target. Furthermore, he had killed a group of Imperial Lords from the same species as Cave Lord Redmynah. After killing Cave Lord Bolan, their karmic connection had strengthened greatly. Their karmic connection was much stronger.
He instantly fled to Beiyou River System. A Void Transference Talisman is indeed very powerful. As expected of a Tribulation Eminence’s life-preservation treasure.
A Spacetime Teleportation Talisman was stronger than a Void Transference Talisman. Meng Chuan had given one to his son, Meng An.
...
Whoosh.
The void distorted.
After the void returned to normal, Cave Lord Redmynah discovered that he had already arrived in a pitch-black void. He could sense the location of his other true body. He used its location and compared it with the Spacetime Dominion Map. At the very least, he could confirm the river system he was in.
“This is... Beiyou River System?” Cave Lord Redmynah heaved a sigh of relief. He had controlled the Void Transference Talisman to transport him to the furthest location. Although Void Transference Talismans were said to be only effective within river zones, the energy contained within each one was fixed. Therefore, the stronger a Tribulation Eminence was, the greater the burden on a Void Transference Talisman. A stronger Tribulation Eminence traveled a relatively shorter distance when using Void Transference Talismans.
If a Fifth Tribulation Eminence were to use one, they would only be able to travel a few river systems’ distance. Cave Lord Redmynah had been transported considerably far after using his Void Transference Talisman.
This place is very far from Three Bay River System. City Lord Eastcalm is only at the Fifth Tribulation realm. It’s impossible for him to rush here quickly considering his attainments in the void lineage unless he’s willing to use a Void Transference Talisman
, thought Cave Lord Redmynah.
Even though he’s at the Fifth Tribulation realm, he can buy very few Void Transference Talismans/ He probably won’t be willing to use them to kill one of my bodies.
Beiyou River System is Eternal Tower’s territory. I’ll head to another neighboring river system and go to Patriarch Anfang.
Cave Lord Redmynah made a decision.
I’ll probably take three days.
It was normal for a Fourth Tribulation Eminence to take three days to travel across a river system.
Patriarch Anfang was a Fifth Tribulation Eminence of Beiyou River System; he was also a member of Black Fiend Hall.
Cave Lord Redmynah and Patriarch Anfang had some ties with each other. Thus, it was still possible for him to hide in Patriarch Anfang’s cave abode for temporary protection.
Whoosh.
Cave Lord Redmynah traveled through the River of Spacetime. After traveling for a moment, he completely relaxed. “As I expected, City Lord Eastcalm couldn’t bear to part with the Void Transference Talisman and didn’t chase after me.”
More than two hours later.
As he walked through the River of Spacetime, Cave Lord Redmynah saw a towering figure walking over. The shocked Cave Lord Redmynah was only about the height of the other party’s foot.
The black-robed, white-haired man arrived in front of him in a single step. With a stretch of his hand, a gigantic palm reached out for Cave Lord Redmynah.
How did he chase up to me?
Cave Lord Redmynah was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 577 - Wiping Clean
chapters.content:
Chapter 577: Wiping Clean
Meng Chuan could only exchange for a limited number of Void Transference Talismans from Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasure vault. He naturally couldn’t bear to use a Void Transference Talisman just to capture one of Cave Lord Redmynah’s bodies.
However, Meng Chuan was fast enough. He had grasped the paramount speed laws, making him close to a Sixth Tribulation Eminence when it came to traveling. He could travel across a river zone in half a day! He could travel from Three Bay River System to Beiyou River System in just two hours.
Swoosh.
Cave Lord Redmynah instinctively followed the River of Spacetime’s rejection and instantly returned to the normal void. Meng Chuan followed.
