“City Lord Eastcalm, please—” Cave Lord Redmynah begged for mercy. Without any more Void Transference Talismans, the other defensive treasures he had could only stall for time. He wanted to beg for his life.
His true body—which was carrying out a Black Fiend Hall mission—was bound to experience many dangers; therefore, it had few treasures on it. It was fine if that true body died in battle.
This true body in his home river system contained more than half of the treasures he had accumulated over the years. If he died in battle, the losses would be immense!
However, before he could finish his sentence...
Everything around Meng Chuan, who had lightning flashing around him, stopped. Cave Lord Redmynah remained humble and obsequious. He opened his mouth, about to say something, but everything froze.
Time Stillness!
Following that, a black beam of light landed on Cave Lord Redmynah. Without a sound, he was reduced to dust.
...
In a scorching palace’s inconspicuous side hall in a distant river zone.
My other true body was killed? Cave Lord Redmynah sat there in a daze. At that moment, his heart felt empty. Having joined Black Fiend Hall, Cave Lord Redmynah was naturally very greedy and placed great importance on those treasures.
After so many years of plundering and killing, was it easy to accumulate those treasures? Most of them were now gone!
“My treasures! My treasures!” Cave Lord Redmynah was beyond tears.
His heart ached!
This true body that had been carrying out missions for a long period of time only had some Tribulation treasures that amounted to about 1,000 cubes. They were mainly necessities in battle. His true body in his home river system had all his years of accumulation. There, he didn’t have it do any dangerous missions, nor did he provoke any powerful factions. However, he never expected to be pursued by City Lord Eastcalm.
City Lord Eastcalm is a lunatic. Even when I fled to Beiyou River System, he used a Void Transference Talisman to continue chasing me. Cave Lord Redmynah gritted his teeth in indignation.
Even until now, he still believed that Meng Chuan had used a Void Transference Talisman.
At such a great distance, one couldn’t accurately teleport using a Void Transference Talisman! One could only teleport to a general area. He imagined that Meng Chuan had teleported to Beiyou River System, but due to the huge inaccuracy, it took him more than two hours to catch up.
City Lord Eastcalm, I’ll remember you. Cave Lord Redmynah hated Meng Chuan to the core.
...
Meng Chuan waved his hand and stored away the war spoils left behind by Cave Lord Redmynah. It took him more than two hours to destroy a Fourth Tribulation Eminence’s true body.
He had no choice. Previously, his opponent had been hiding in his lair. The cave abode had an array formation protecting it. With the array formation’s defense barely reaching the Fifth Tribulation realm in strength, Meng Chuan had to break through the cave abode’s array formation forcefully with his World Treasure.
Such a collision also affected time.
Meng Chuan’s Time Stillness still had many flaws. For example, a Fifth Tribulation Eminence’s domain was enough to affect time. A Fifth Tribulation Eminence’s order in life could also affect time. When experts fought, the energy they produced also interfered with time.
Of course, even if he suffered from interference, Meng Chuan could maintain a high level of time acceleration.
He’s really rich. He has so many treasures? Meng Chuan checked the war spoils he obtained from Cave Lord Redmynah and was rather surprised. It’s worth more than 6,000 cubes?
A Fourth Tribulation Eminence has so many treasures?
Although Meng Chuan was very wealthy, he was still shocked by his gains.
Back then, Senior Pang Ming, who was at the Fifth Tribulation realm, only left behind about 10,000 cubes worth of treasures! Yet, he received so much in one instant. Of course, most of what Senior Pang Ming had accumulated was in his homeworld. As for Cave Lord Redmynah, most of his wealth was in front of Meng Chuan. Furthermore, Cave Lord Redmynah was a member of Black Fiend Hall. Although Black Fiend Hall members had infamous reputations, they were considered relatively wealthy among their peers.
After taking so many treasures from him, Cave Lord Redmynah probably hates me to the core. The black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan was in a good mood. Even with one more enemy, I’ll head over and kill him as long as I sense that he’s close to Three Bay River System through karma. Or I’ll directly kill him through karma when I reach the Sixth Tribulation realm...
Without an inhabited world’s protection, it was very easy for a Sixth Tribulation Eminence to kill a Fourth Tribulation Eminence through karma. Of course, the premise was that they had a strong karmic connection with each other! Meng Chuan and Cave Lord Redmynah had formed a strong karmic connection this time.
I’ll head back and deal with the next target. The black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan immediately entered the River of Spacetime and rushed back to Three Bay River System.
...
Meng Chuan sent six Essence Soul avatars to deal with six Tribulation Eminences.
Whoosh.
Another Essence Soul avatar appeared above a barren planet. It looked down and suppressed the area beneath with an Essence Soul World.
The two Third Tribulation Eminences knelt down. “Senior, spare me. Spare me.”
Just the pressure from the Essence Soul World’s projection made the two of them feel an invincible might. The difference in strength between them was too great... The mysterious black-robed, white-haired man was probably a Fifth Tribulation Eminence.
“Senior, feel free to instruct us if you need anything. We will definitely do our best.” The two Tribulation Eminences were extremely humble.
The black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan looked down and said, “Never appear in Three Bay River System again. Once I discover the two of you, I’ll kill you again.”
The voice sounded from afar.
Kill us again? The two Third Tribulation Eminences were taken aback before they realized something amiss.
Boom! Boom!
The Power of Essence Soul blasted into their Essence Souls and immediately killed them. Only their bodies remained.
At the same time, an Essence Soul attack traveled through karma to the two inhabited worlds and attacked their other true bodies.
Humph.
One of the Third Tribulation Eminences—who lived in a low-level world that was mostly filled with water—grunted softly as he resisted the karmic attacks.
I don’t even know this black-robed, white-haired man. I was quite respectful, yet he actually destroyed my outer realm body. The Third Tribulation Eminence was rather furious. I want to know who this black-robed, white-haired man is.
With such hatred, he had to figure out the other party’s background.
...
These two Third Tribulation Eminences are protected by inhabited worlds. They can’t be killed. Meng Chuan shook his head slightly. He knew that these two Third Tribulation Eminences came from inhabited worlds, so he knew that it was impossible for them to kill them completely. It was why he said those few words.
In the future, when they cultivated a new outer realm body, they would probably have to stay away from Three Bay River System obediently. They wouldn’t dare to continue causing trouble in Three Bay River System.
Every time he killed one true body, his opponent would suffer huge losses.
...
Another of Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars chased someone to another river system.
In the void, an alien Tribulation Eminence with a scaled tail and two sharp horns said in disbelief, “City Lord Eastcalm? I’ve already fled to Mountain Yang River System. Why are you still chasing after me?”
It was a Fourth Tribulation special lifeform. It had been wreaking havoc in Three Bay River System for a long time. When it learned that Eternal Tower’s City Lord Eastcalm was from Three Bay River System, it immediately hid in a neighboring river system—Mountain Yang River System. It planned to monitor the situation.
From the standpoint of sweeping a river system clean, he didn’t need to pursue anyone who had already left Three Bay River System.
However, Meng Chuan clearly didn’t think that way.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
The black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan was surrounded by bolts of lightning.
Time Stillness.
In order to avoid any unexpected twists and turns, he killed the other party with Time Stillness.
This Fourth Tribulation Eminence had fled to Mountain Yang River System. Without being inside his cave abode, it was even harder for him to resist Meng Chuan’s killer move. He lost his life on the spot.
These Fourth Tribulation special lifeforms will send their true bodies to a distant river zone. It won’t be easy to kill them completely. Meng Chuan shook his head and embarked on his return journey.
...
Six Essence Soul avatars took action at the same time.
According to the list provided by Eternal Tower, there were plundering factions consisting of seven Tribulation Eminences and 11 Imperial Lords.
When clearing a river system, some Eternal Tower members might be gentler and expel them from the river system.
Meng Chuan’s methods were clearly much more ruthless. Growing in Archean Eon Realm made Meng Chuan kill cultivators who specialized in plundering and slaughtering.
Those that he could completely wipe out were naturally killed through karma. Not a single one was spared. If he could only kill one true body, he would do so.
Meng Chuan continued his pursuit, even if they escaped to other river systems!
In short, he was going all out!
It was somewhat troublesome to deal with Tribulation Eminences. With an inhabited world’s protection, it was even harder to kill them completely. Dealing with Imperial Lords was much easier. Even with a true body in their homeworlds, as a Fifth Tribulation Eminence, Meng Chuan could still kill all of an Imperial Lord’s bodies through the karmic connection between the true bodies.
In just six hours, the six Essence Soul avatars finished their missions. All of them returned to Thousand Mountain Star.

chapters.title: Chapter 578 - Three Bay River Systems Shock
chapters.content:
Chapter 578: Three Bay River System’s Shock
When Meng Chuan’s six Essence Soul avatars pursued the plundering factions, it alarmed many Tribulation Eminences in Three Bay River System.
On a seemingly ordinary star in Three Bay River System.
There was an ancient, dilapidated cave abode that had been renovated simply. Many halls were inhabited by cultivators.
“Many Imperial Lords in Three Bay River System have been killed.”
“Of the ones I know, more than 50 Imperial Lords have died.”
“It’s not just Imperial Lords. Six Tribulation Eminences have been completely killed. Some Tribulation Eminences have also had their outer realm bodies wiped out.”
In the ruined square, more than 20 Tribulation Eminences’ Essence Soul avatars discussed this matter. Many of them could sense the deaths of some Tribulation Eminences and Imperial Lords through karma.
“From the information I received, the murderer is a black-robed, white-haired man,” said a short, fat elder in a deep voice. “Even my outer realm body was killed.”
The short and fat elder was at the Essence Soul Third Tribulation realm. He could travel the River of Spacetime with only his Essence Soul avatar.
“Who is that black-robed, white-haired man? Why is he hunting down the Tribulation Eminences in our Three Bay River System?” Some Tribulation Eminences were puzzled.
“The ones he killed are from plundering factions,” said a white-haired, white-browed elder indifferently with a smile. “None of the other Tribulation Eminences who simply cultivate were pursued.”
“He might be killing plundering factions now, but he might target the rest of you in the future,” said another gray-robed masked man coldly.
“Everyone.” A white-robed, bald woman said, “We formed the Tranquilstar Alliance for transactions and to exchange information. There’s no need for us to quarrel. Let’s talk about this black-robed, white-haired senior. This senior has been hunting down plundering factions in our Three Bay River System. Even Imperial Lord plundering factions have mostly been wiped out... Do you know the black-robed, white-haired senior’s identity?”
Although Three Bay River System didn’t have a safe transaction ground since it lacked an established Eternal Tower branch, trading and exchanges were necessary for cultivators. It was very important to communicate with each other.
Therefore, secret alliances were formed for transactions.
For example, the Tranquilstar Alliance had about 30% of Three Bay River System’s Tribulation Eminences as its members. There were a total of 28 Tribulation Eminences. Every member stationed an Essence Soul avatar on this barren planet so that they could communicate with each other at any time.
With the 28 Tribulation Eminences as the core, it also included many Imperial Lords and Supremacies.
Although the efficiency wasn’t as high as public transaction grounds and there was unfairness, the numerous Supremacies in Three Bay River System were unable to head to other river systems. Therefore, they were willing to trade in these secret organizations.
The ten-plus organizations, such as the Tranquilstar Alliance, were established all for the sake of trading.
Many Tribulation Eminences joined several organizations simultaneously.
Transactions in Three Bay River System were naturally exploited by Tribulation Eminences greatly. This was because the entire trading network was controlled by them.
“I just asked Palace Lord.” Suddenly, a small mountainous figure said in a deep voice, “Palace Lord said that the black-robed, white-haired man’s name is City Lord Eastcalm. He’s a Fifth Tribulation Eminence. He’s a member of Eternal Tower. He lives on Thousand Mountain Star. He likely dealt with the plundering forces because he wants to establish an Eternal Tower branch in Three Bay River System.”
“City Lord Eastcalm?”
“A Fifth Tribulation Eminence?”
“Set up an Eternal Tower branch?”
Immediately, everyone was shocked.
To these Tribulation Eminences, they didn’t wish for Three Bay River System to have open and safe trading grounds.
If there was one, how could they exploit others?
They could head to the other river systems’ Eternal Tower branches to trade. Therefore, it wasn’t beneficial for them to have an Eternal Tower branch established in Three Bay River System. Instead, there were many disadvantages.
“In the future, we won’t be able to take advantage of others.” The white-haired, white-browed elder shook his head. “With a Fifth Tribulation Eminence stepping forward and offering a safe transaction ground, along with the guarantee of Eternal Tower’s reputation, those Imperial Lords and Supremacies will no longer come looking for us.”
Although Supremacies were weak, they were the greatest in number. They were scattered across the river system to search for ruins. Occasionally, they would discover treasures.
These Tribulation Eminences who grasped the trading network had indeed benefited greatly over the years.
“City Lord Eastcalm is a Fifth Tribulation Eminence. Isn’t it better to just focus on cultivation? Why does he need to build an Eternal Tower branch and worry about such trivial matters?”
“City Lord Eastcalm probably doesn’t like plundering factions, which is why he hunted them down. It’s not guaranteed he will build an Eternal Tower branch, right? Who is willing to go to Thousand Mountain Star to figure out Lord Eastcalm’s intentions?”
“With City Lord Eastcalm’s temper, I’m afraid he will slap us to death if we appear in front of him.”
These Tribulation Eminences had mixed emotions.
Apart from one who had reached the Fourth Tribulation realm, the others were much weaker. It was quite important for them to control the trading network and reap its benefits.
“What did Palace Lord say?” asked the white-robed, bald woman. “Is Palace Lord not going to do a thing about City Lord Eastcalm establishing an Eternal Tower branch?”
The other Tribulation Eminences looked over.
Palace Lord Snowjade was formerly the strongest expert in Three Bay River System. As the only Fifth Tribulation Eminence, other Tribulation Eminences usually hid far away, not daring to provoke him.
Now, they hoped that Palace Lord Snowjade would step forward!
The mountain-like figure shook his head slightly. “Palace Lord said that he wouldn’t interfere with matters regarding City Lord Eastcalm in Three Bay River System.”
“He won’t interfere?”
“So many Tribulation Eminences were hunted down. Six of them died completely. Many Imperial Lords were killed, yet he’s not interfering?”
“Doesn’t Palace Lord Snowjade want to vie for control of Three Bay River System?”
The Tribulation Eminences were astonished.
How could Palace Lord Snowjade tolerate City Lord Eastcalm given his personality?
“Everyone don’t be anxious. If City Lord Eastcalm really wants to establish an Eternal Tower branch, he will have to sweep the river system’s plundering factions clean. As for our Three Bay River System... the strongest plundering faction is Snake Fiend Star,” said the white-robed, bald woman softly. “I didn’t sense Snake Fiend Star incurring any losses.”
“Snake Fiend Star.”
The surroundings fell silent.
In the past, there were two strongest factions in Three Bay River System.
Palace Lord Snowjade’s faction was one of them! As the only Fifth Tribulation Eminence, he had an extraordinary status. The other was Snake Fiend Star. Snake Fiend Star plundered the entire river system. It was the most ferocious overlord with a powerful background.
“Snake Fiend Star has a powerful background. City Lord Eastcalm might not dare to attack directly.”
“It’s very likely that negotiations will occur, allowing Snake Fiend Star’s species to migrate out of Three Bay River System.
“Against a Fifth Tribulation Eminence, Snake Fiend Star will likely compromise.”
The Tribulation Eminences discussed for a long time before finally dispersing.
Whether an Eternal Tower branch was established in Three Bay River System or not, all they could do was watch from the sidelines. They didn’t dare interfere.
...
Tranquilstar Alliance, North Wind Pavilion, Hundred Sword Tower... All the secret organizations in Three Bay River System discovered the deaths of many Imperial Lords and the destruction of many Tribulation Eminences’ true bodies. They discussed the matter urgently.
In fact, before Meng Chuan took action, several Fourth Tribulation Eminences already knew that Three Bay River System had produced a Fifth Tribulation Eminence named City Lord Eastcalm. However, these secret organizations existed for the sake of trading. The more precious the information was, the higher the price was. They naturally wouldn’t spread it cheaply. On the other hand, unless they had a good relationship, why would Tribulation Eminences care about the lives of other cultivators?
Of course, some of the plundering factions pursued by Meng Chuan knew about City Lord Eastcalm. Some Tribulation Eminences hid in other river systems, but Meng Chuan still hunted them down.
Some Imperial Lords had fled back to their homeworlds. Having not seen them with his own eyes or grasping their auras, the karmic connections between Meng Chuan and them were too weak. Meng Chuan wasn’t able to kill the Imperial Lords hiding in their homeworlds because of this.
...
At the top of a snow mountain, Snowjade Palace.
Currently, Three Bay River System is in a state of panic.
Palace Lord Snowjade stood outside the palace and looked into the endless void. Through karma, he knew that six Tribulation Eminences had died completely. Many Tribulation Eminences had also lost their true bodies.
To be able to dispatch them so quickly, Meng Chuan should have sent multiple Essence Soul avatars to attack at the same time,
Snowjade concluded.
Now, only Snake Fiend Star is left. Snake Fiend Star will likely give in to Meng Chuan during the negotiations.
Snowjade knew the strength of both parties.
Snake Fiend Star had a powerful background, but Meng Chuan was also very powerful!
The information that the outside world had gathered was the simplest: City Lord Eastcalm had the strength of a Fifth Tribulation Eminence and lived on Thousand Mountain Star.
As for more important intelligence, such as having a dual Physical Body and Essence Soul Fifth Tribulation realm cultivation, had grasped two Fifth Tribulation laws, was a member of the Cang Alliance, and so on... This kind of important intelligence couldn’t be obtained without paying a certain price.
...
On Thousand Mountain Star, the six Essence Soul avatars returned after completing their missions.
Meng Chuan’s true body was on a tall building. He looked at the continuous mountain range as he pondered over his mission of clearing out the plundering factions.
Eternal Tower listed 18 plundering factions for me to wipe out. The other 17 factions have been resolved.
Meng Chuan frowned slightly.
Only the strongest plundering faction, Snake Fiend Star, is left.
I have to send my true body.
Meng Chuan knew very well that the other party wasn’t to be trifled with. Previously, the main reason why Palace Lord Snowjade couldn’t fully control Three Bay River System was because of Snake Fiend Star.

chapters.title: Chapter 579 - Extraordinary Treasure
chapters.content:
Chapter 579 Extraordinary Treasure
Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes lived on Snake Fiend Star. The leader was at the Fourth Tribulation realm.
I once obtained an adult Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake corpse from Senior Pang Ming. Meng Chuan found it rather magical. Now, I’m facing a branch of the Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake species. The ten-plus Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes that live on Snake Fiend Star are nothing to me. However, there’s a spacetime hole on Snake Fiend Star that connects to Warped Cloud River System.
There were various special phenomena in the outer realm. Spacetime holes were one of them. Through them, one could reach a distant place.
The two regions connected to each other by spacetime holes were usually in the same river zone. Very few connected to places in different river zones.
I can instantly destroy Snake Fiend Star. However, on the other end of Snake Fiend Star’s spacetime hole is Warped Cloud River System, which is the true lair of Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes. Meng Chuan knew this very well.
More than 30,000 years ago, Three Bay River System did not have Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes. Later, Warped Cloud River System’s Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes discovered a spacetime hole that led to Three Bay River System. When they arrived at Three Bay River System, they realized that there were no Fifth Tribulation Eminences here. Therefore, they moved a massive star to the entrance of the spacetime hole. The star’s layout was modified, becoming Snake Fiend Star. It was governed by an Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake at the Tribulation realm with eight other adult Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes. They wantonly plundered Three Bay River System.
Warped Cloud River System’s strongest expert is an Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake at the Fifth Tribulation realm. Its name is Cave Lord Scenic Cloud; its a Physical Body Fifth Tribulation Eminence. It has cultivated for more than 50,000 years and has grasped three Fifth Tribulation laws. Unfortunately, the compatibility between its three grasped laws are too low. It failed to fuse them into a Sixth Tribulation law. Even so, it’s extremely powerful at the Fifth Tribulation realm. It’s much stronger than Palace Lord Snowjade. Meng Chuan knew this very well. Under normal circumstances, one would have a high chance of fusing three Fifth Tribulation laws into a Sixth Tribulation law. However, failure happened when there was low compatibility between the laws. This was the case for Cave Lord Scenic Cloud.
Palace Lord Snowjade was also at the Physical Body Fifth Tribulation realm. He had also grasped two Fifth Tribulation laws. Furthermore, he had only recently broken through, so he naturally wasn’t willing to offend Cave Lord Scenic Cloud.
Fortunately...
Thankfully, the Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake species in the entire River of Spacetime hasn’t produced a Sixth Tribulation Eminence in this era. According to the intelligence, there are over 30 Fifth Tribulation Eminences in the species, and they are scattered across the River of Spacetime.
In terms of life’s natural order, the Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes were in no way inferior to Scarlet Snakes.
However, the Scarlet Snake species had produced Starlord Scarlet Snake. He was considered one of the top Sixth Tribulation Eminences. Therefore, the environment the Scarlet Snakes lived in was much better. They even had a large lair in the River of Spacetime
-Scarlet Snake Star! The number of Fifth Tribulation realm Scarlet Snakes on Scarlet Snake Planet accounted for half of those in the River of Spacetime.
For example, the Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake species hadn’t produced a Sixth Tribulation Eminence, so they were relatively weak. Their species was bullied everywhere... With no Sixth Tribulation Eminence protecting them, their living conditions were much worse than the Scarlet Snakes.
Under such circumstances, the Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes were naturally extremely scattered! Since they were scattered, they wouldn’t be affected when they encountered a formidable enemy. They could reproduce and survive.
Special lifeforms are very united because they don’t have an inhabited world’s protection. There are 30 known Fifth Tribulation Eminences for the species, and there’s one who has grasped a Sixth Tribulation law, but it hasn’t fully stepped into the Sixth Tribulation realm.
That Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake, who has grasped the Sixth Tribulation law, is very far away. It will take it at least half a year to reach here.
I won’t be able to kill Cave Lord Scenic Cloud. I’m only capable of killing one true body of each of the eight Fourth Tribulation Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes. If the strongest Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake wants to deal with such a trivial matter, it will have to travel across the River of Spacetime all day.
Meng Chuan knew very well that the only person he needed to deal with was Cave Lord Scenic Cloud.
Physical Body Fifth Tribulation realm, and has grasped three Fifth Tribulation laws. Meng Chuan felt pressured. I have to make sufficient preparations.
According to Eternal Tower’s investigations, Snake Fiend Star has slaughtered more than 5,000 cultivators in Three Bay River System in the past 10,000 years. Many had their true bodies destroyed, but that can’t be confirmed by Eternal Tower’s investigations. There are probably many more victims.
The intelligence provided by Eternal Tower consisted of confirmed cases. Eternal Tower wasn’t omnipotent. Its investigations couldn’t pinpoint those who carried out more covert operations or if the deceased didn’t have much connection to Eternal Tower.
Many low-level worlds only had one Supremacy.
When killed, their true bodies and avatars were destroyed! They couldn’t recount this to anyone else-it was a very common situation.
In 10,000 years, there have been more than 5,000 confirmed cases. In fact, 20,000 to 30,000 people have likely been slaughtered. The Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake species has been in Three Bay River System for over 30,000 years. Nearly 100,000 cultivators have likely been slaughtered. Meng Chuan estimated the number of deaths with a ferocious glint in his eyes. They really treat Three Bay River System as a hunting ground for Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes.
To have no intention of paying the price after slaughtering so many people? As for Cave Lord Scenic Cloud and the entire Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake species? Meng Chuan made a decision.
To have reached the Fifth Tribulation realm with an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique in a short period of time, reaching the Sixth Tribulation realm wasn’t a distant possibility for Meng Chuan.
Now, he had grasped two Fifth Tribulation laws. He was also studying the Void Catalog’s third volume. He was confident that his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique would reach the Fifth Tribulation realm in the near future. When that happened, he would have grasped three Fifth Tribulation realm laws. Furthermore, Infinite Saber was a pure time lineage technique. Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique was a pure spatial lineage technique. Nirvana Saber fused both the time lineage and the spatial lineage. The three were extremely compatible. Therefore, Meng Chuan had the confidence to deal with the entire Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes species.
Meng Chuan had to admit that Cave Lord Scenic Cloud was not to be trifled with. Therefore, he chose array formations and other items from Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasure vault in advance and prepared to send his true body.
Before setting off, I should check my war spoils. Meng Chuan was in a good mood. I wiped out the 17 other plundering factions. Of the 19 Tribulation Eminences on the list... I killed 13 Tribulation Eminences’ true bodies. Six of them were completely killed.
I only found 127 of the 139 Imperial Lords on the list. All of them have been killed.
Not long after he joined Eternal Tower, a handful of Fourth Tribulation Eminences in Three Bay River System learned of Eastcalm City Lord’s existence.
Some Imperial Lords among the plundering factions were related to them. They had fled back to their homeworlds early. Meng Chuan failed to see them with his own eyes, so his karmic connection with these Imperial Lords was very weak. He naturally couldn’t kill the Imperial Lords hiding in inhabited worlds.
All the six Tribulation Eminences I completely killed off were special lifeforms. It wasn’t by Meng Chuan’s choice. A Tribulation Eminence from a plundering faction was at least at the Second Tribulation realm. With a homeworld in the way, Meng Chuan had no way of killing their true bodies. Cave Lord Redmynah left behind the most treasures. They are worth over 6,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals. Yes, this one is not bad either. It is worth over 2,000 cubes.
ices
Meng Chuan carefully inspected his war spoils. It’s no wonder many Tribulation Eminences crazily plunder others. They do gain plenty from such acts.
He had obtained quite a lot from killing these plundering factions.
He only destroyed one of the three Fourth Tribulation Eminences’ true bodies, earning him over 9,000 cubes; Cave Lord Redmynah contributed the most of it.
There were 11 Third Tribulation Eminences. He obtained more than 5,000 cubes from them. There were five Second Tribulation Eminences. He obtained nearly 1,000 cubes from them.
There were also many Imperial Lords’ treasures...
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
He directly teleported the Imperial Lords’ treasures out of their mobile grotto-heavens and storage spaces. Soon, piles of items appeared in front of Meng Chuan. Meng Chuan could probe the items with his Essence Soul domain with a thought. With his experience, he could tell the value of 99% of the items.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan took out a spatial bracelet and forcefully infused his Power of Essence Soul into it. He teleported all the items inside out. Another pile of items surrounded him.
As Meng Chuan calculated the value of the treasures, he suddenly lowered his head and looked at his waist.
Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!
Meng Chuan’s Demon Slayer trembled as it attempted to leave the scabbard.
Demon Slayer was a weapon Meng Chuan had chosen when he finished cultivating at Archean Mountain. He had been nurturing it for many years. He even carried it with him all the time, nurturing it for a long time. Its compatibility with Meng Chuan was higher than his intrinsic treasure, Bloodblade Disc.
What’s going on? Meng Chuan was somewhat surprised. He could sense that Demon Slayer had been greatly attracted by something and wanted to leave the scabbard.
Go. With a thought, Meng Chuan controlled Demon Slayer and allowed it to fly to the source of attraction.
Swoosh.
Demon Slayer immediately flew out and charged into the latest pile of items with a boom. The invisible force sent many miscellaneous items flying. Demon Slayer’s power only enveloped one of the items, causing it to float in front of Demon Slayer.
It was a fragment of a wine cup-only the size of a finger.

chapters.title: Chapter 580 - I’m Willing to Serve You, City Lord
chapters.content:
Chapter 580 I’m Willing to Serve You, City Lord
A wine cup shard. Could this wine cup be some powerful treasure? Meng Chuan was puzzled. He could sense Demon Slayer’s desire. Like its desire to absorb flesh and blood, it wanted to devour the fragment. However, Meng Chuan didn’t let it do so immediately. Instead, he waved his hand, and the shard flew in front of him.
It was the size of a finger, resembling an ordinary wine glass’s fragment without any runes.
It’s just a shard. It’s not a treasure fragment. Even its materials are very common. There’s nothing special on the surface, but it’s very heavy. Meng Chuan was somewhat puzzled. Despite being the size of a finger, it’s as heavy as a mountain.
I’ve never heard of such a heavy cup before. Meng Chuan was puzzled.
Some outer realm’s materials were indeed very heavy. Despite being the size of a fist, they were as heavy as a star, but nobody used such heavy materials to make wine cups.
Perhaps some large-sized lifeforms would use super-large wine cups, but the fragment in front of him was very small. It was probably only a normal wine cup that humans used, yet it was so heavy. What kind of lifeform would use it?
Special material? It looks very ordinary. I’ll slice off a bit first. I can appraise it properly in the future. With a thought, Meng Chuan controlled the wine cup fragment with his Primordial Domain and forcefully pried it apart. The force was enough to crush a Fourth Tribulation Eminence to death. He then peeled off a sliver of the fragment and put it away. As for the remaining fragment, he stopped restraining Demon Slayer and allowed it to absorb the fragment according to its instinctive desire.
Demon Slayer’s tip touched the fragment and began absorbing it instinctively.
The fragment appeared ordinary. No matter how Meng Chuan looked at it, there was nothing special about it other than its weight. Demon Slayer’s absorption was like a catalyst, drawing out the true strength hidden within it.
Boom!
in
Meng Chuan only saw blood-colored waves suddenly surge out from the fragment. Instantly, it filled the entire cultivation chamber. The terrifying blood-colored waves made Meng Chuan’s heart tighten. His Primordial domain and illusory Essence Soul World were useless. However, Meng Chuan’s Primordial Body was able to block 99% of the blood-colored waves.
However, a minute amount still entered Meng Chuan’s body and attacked his Essence Soul.
Baneful aura? Meng Chuan felt the impact on his Essence Soul.
I’m at the Physical Body Tribulation Realm and the Essence Soul Tribulation realm. If it were an ordinary Physical Body Fifth Tribulation Eminence, their body would be able to withstand most of the impact. However, their Essence Souls would probably be severely injured. Those with weaker mental cultivation might even have their consciousness destroyed. Meng Chuan was secretly alarmed.
Even though one’s Essence Soul and willpower were very strong at the Essence Soul Fifth Tribulation realm, it would be pretty impressive if they could maintain 20-30% of their full strength when trying to resist the full impact without a perfected body.
At the Physical Body Fifth Tribulation realm, one’s body was in the way, but their Essence Souls were weak. It would be very difficult for them to withstand the attack as well.
Among Fifth Tribulation Eminences, only Meng Chuan—who was very strong in both aspects—could withstand the attacks easily.
If he was at the Physical Body Sixth Tribulation realm... the blood-colored waves would have been unable to break through his body’s obstruction. If his Essence Soul was at the Sixth Tribulation realm, his Essence Soul’s extreme strength would make the blood-colored waves feel like a gentle breeze, allowing him to face them easily.
The blood-colored waves are very similar to the baneful aura in my homeworld, but it’s many times stronger. It can threaten a Fifth Tribulation Eminence, and this is only a fragment of the wine cup. If it’s the full cup... it might even pose a threat to a Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
What is its background?
As Meng Chuan pondered, Demon Slayer frantically devoured the fragment.
It was an evil saber in Archean Eon Realm’s history. It liked to devour flesh, blood, and baneful aura; it would even attack its owner. If its owner’s Essence Soul wasn’t strong enough, they would easily sink into madness. Back on Archean Mountain, Meng Chuan chose it and named it Demon Slayer. After Meng Chuan rose to prominence-during his slaughtering of demons when he killed millions of demon monarchs in the worldDemon Slayer devoured a countless amount of flesh, blood, and baneful aura. Meng Chuan even used his comprehended insights to form Demon Slayer’s Dao.
Demon Slayer also devoured an alien lifeform’s flesh and blood, as well as the corpse of an Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake, but it didn’t absorb much baneful aura in the outer realm.
At that moment, it trembled and crazily absorbed the blood-colored wave. Having reached the level of a Fifth Tribulation weapon, it could devour this energy. As time passed, Demon Slayer’s color gradually turned red, making it look even more demonic.
Meng Chuan’s perception of Demon Slayer was very sharp. He could sense that Demon Slayer was transforming. It was a qualitative transformation of the weapon’s core, making it become stronger. Since it was a development towards more strength and Demon Slayer yearned for it, Meng Chuan naturally didn’t stop it.
Meng Chuan didn’t fear the blood-colored baneful aura.
After Demon Slayer sucked all the energy, Demon Slayer was controlled by its master. The backlash was naturally weaker than when it first erupted. Therefore, he was even less afraid.
It’s been six hours, but it has only absorbed only this much. It’ll probably take half a month to finish absorbing it. I’ll delay my battle with Snake Fiend Star for half a month.
He felt that Demon Slayer would greatly increase his melee combat strength after it completely absorbed the blood-colored wave.
He naturally had to deal with Snake Fiend Star in optimal state.
Two figures arrived in the void where Thousand Mountain Star was.
Thousand Mountain Star.
Two figures appeared side by side-a man and a woman-as they looked at Thousand Mountain Star from afar.
The man was tall and had a vertical eye. He exuded a powerful aura, but he appeared somewhat simple.
The woman was petite in comparison. She was dressed in a light-white robe.
“We’ve been in Three Bay River System for so many years, but we’ve never seen Thousand Mountain Star. Although it’s recorded in history that Thousand Mountain Star is in the surrounding area, we weren’t able to find it,” exclaimed the man. “It has appeared now.’ “The surrounding void has a range of billions of kilometers, but Thousand Mountain Star is hidden in a very tiny area,” said the petite woman with a smile. “Without high attainments in the void lineage, it’s impossible to find it.”
Indeed. If it wasn’t for Ancestral Master Archean Eon, Meng Chuan would’ve needed a long time to search the region that spanned billions of kilometers with his Essence Soul World. Even if I he found it, cracking Thousand Mountain Star’s array formation would have been very difficult.
With Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s detailed explanation on how to crack the array formation, it was much more convenient. Of course, only those at the Fifth Tribulation realm could do such a thing.
“I wonder what kind of personality City Lord Eastcalm has,” said the tall, vertical-eyed man hesitantly.
“Regardless, he needs sufficient manpower if he wants to build an Eternal Tower branch here. If we join him now, he will most likely be willing to accept us.”
“Should we wait for him to finish off Snake Fiend Star before coming over?” asked the man worriedly. “I’m always worried that he might fall out with Snake Fiend Star and anger Cave Lord Scenic Cloud. When that happens, he will be forced to escape Three Bay River System. Then, won’t we have to leave Three Bay River System as well? I don’t wish to leave. I still have to take care of my homeworld’s Supremacies and Imperial Lords.”
“Pang Feng, if you are too cautious about everything, you won’t be able to grasp opportunities.” The petite woman shook her head. “Once he resolves Snake Fiend Star and publicly establishes an Eternal Tower branch, there will be even more Tribulation Eminences who will follow him. If we only come when that happens, it will be very difficult for us to be valued. But if we come now... We will have a much higher status amongst his subordinates in the future.”
The man nodded slightly. He was a cautious person, but he also felt that the woman’s words made sense. He decided to take a risk. “If City Lord Eastcalm is forced to flee from Three Bay River System because of Cave Lord Scenic Cloud, we would have no choice but to flee as well.” The man shook his head slightly. They had never thought of betraying Eastcalm City Lord. Betraying a Fifth Tribulation Eminence was courting death!
“Once the opportunity comes, we have to seize it.” The petite woman didn’t hesitate at all.
Swoosh! Swoosh!
The two quickly flew towards Thousand Mountain Star.
Thousand Mountain Star’s array formation was vast. As they approached Thousand Mountain Star, they felt an endless pressure.
“Why are the two of you here on Thousand Mountain Star?” A figure appeared. It was none other than Supremacy Qing Gu.
A Supremacy? The two Tribulation Eminences muttered to themselves. However, they knew that he was City Lord Eastcalm’s subordinate, so they didn’t dare belittle him. The petite woman said amiably, “We heard of City Lord Eastcalm’s name and specially came to pay our respects.”
Supremacy Qing Gu was alarmed when facing the two Tribulation Eminences. However, he still remained calm on the surface and said, “Wait here. I’ll pass the message.”
After a while —
The two Tribulation Eminences were allowed to enter Thousand Mountain Star and came to the peak of a mountain. The black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan sat cross-legged. He was meditating on the Void Catalog’s third volume with his eyes closed. He only opened his eyes when he sensed the guests.
The tall, vertical-eyed man and the petite woman were alarmed by this glance. They immediately bowed respectfully. “Greetings, City Lord Eastcalm.”
“Pan Feng, Zhong Yu,” said Meng Chuan indifferently. “Why have you come to see me?”
There were fewer than 100 Tribulation Eminences in Three Bay River System. Meng Chuan knew each of their details.
The two people in front of him were at the Third Tribulation realm. They were considered ordinary Tribulation Eminences.
“We heard that City Lord Eastcalm swept through Three Bay River System’s plundering factions in just a few hours. We are extremely impressed,” said the petite woman, Zhong Yu. “Furthermore, our cultivation has become more difficult after we reached the Tribulation realm. We’ve always yearned for guidance. Having learned that City Lord Eastcalm has arrived at Three Bay River System, we became extremely excited. Therefore, we immediately rushed over and wished to come under you. We are willing to serve you.”
“It’s the same for me, Pang Feng. I wish to come under you and serve you, City Lord Eastcalm,” said the tall, vertical-eyed man hurriedly.
They had only seen a handful of Fifth Tribulation Eminences in their lives. He felt immense pressure every time.
The look in City Lord Eastcalm’s eyes brought about a terrifying mental pressure. He was likely at the Essence Soul Fifth Tribulation realm! It was said that the Essence Soul Fifth Tribulation Eminence was much harder to deal with than a Physical Body Fifth Tribulation Eminence. He had chosen a powerful person to cozy with.
“Come under me?” Meng Chuan raised his eyebrows. Now that he wanted to build Eastcalm City and an Eternal Tower branch, he had many miscellaneous matters to attend to. Supremacy Qing Gu and his two disciples were too weak to hold the fort. He really needed Tribulation Eminences to be his subordinates.
He originally imagined that Tribulation Eminence would only follow him after he resolved Snake Fiend Star and publicly established an Eternal Tower branch.
The two in front of him were fast! At the very least, they were the first to come to him. Furthermore, his intelligence about them showed that they were considered decent.
Meng Chuan nodded. “Alright, you two can work for me in the future.”

chapters.title: Chapter 581 - Descent on Snake Fiend Star
chapters.content:
Chapter 581 Descent on Snake Fiend Star
“Yes.” Pang Feng and Zhong Yu revealed looks of delight as they bowed respectfully.
They wanted to follow him, but Meng Chuan could also refuse their request.
They were very happy to receive his permission.
This was because a Third Tribulation Eminence couldn’t help a Fifth Tribulation Eminence when powerful enemies were encountered. Therefore, a Fifth Tribulation Eminence only needed a small number of Tribulation Eminences to deal with trivial matters. There were no benefits if there were too many of them. Instead, he needed to provide them protection. This would result in greater karmic implications. “There are cities on Thousand Mountain Star to begin with,” instructed Meng Chuan, “I’ve already designed the new city layout. It will be the layout of the future Eastcalm City. Find Qing Gu and rebuild the cities according to the new layout.”
“Yes, City Lord.” Pang Feng and Zhong Yu were extremely respectful. They immediately left and helped build Eastcalm City.
Meng Chuan nodded.
At that moment, Meng Chuan thought of his wife, Qiyue. Back then, his wife had personally built an outer city in Jiang State Capital.
Qiyue. Meng Chuan missed her very much. He wanted to wake her up. There’s no hurry. Qiyue can still sleep for a very long time. To her, it’s only an instant. Meng Chuan was very patient after cultivating to such a level. Furthermore, the first use of a longevity extension treasure has the best effects. I have to prepare the best longevity extension treasures for Qiyue, Father, Mother, and Father-in-law.
The level between treasures at the Fifth and Sixth Tribulation realm had a quantitative difference, be it in the outer realm or Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasure vault.
At the Sixth Tribulation realm, he could awaken Qiyue and his parents. As for the Seventh Tribulation realm?
Meng Chuan could be said to be close to the Sixth Tribulation realm; he could reach it within the time afforded to him by his wife and company’s slumber. However, the Seventh Tribulation realm was too far away.
In the blink of an eye, 19 days passed.
Thousand Mountain Star, in Meng Chuan’s cultivation chamber.
His true body had been here for the past 19 days, studying the Void Catalog’s third volume.
Whoosh.
The thin blood-colored aura in the chamber rapidly surged into Demon Slayer. Finally, no more of the blood-colored aura remained. The wine cup fragment silently disintegrated and dissipated into the void.
This wine cup shard is just a vessel for this special baneful aura. Once the baneful aura is gone, it will be destroyed. Meng Chuan understood. Thankfully, I peeled a little fragment from it. I have to investigate its origins.
Meng Chuan looked at Demon Slayer.
Demon Slayer was now a dark-red color. At first glance, it looked very restrained and ordinary. However, if one took a closer look, an evil and fiendish aura would inundate them from the dark-red saber. Even Meng Chuan was alarmed when he saw it.
What dense baneful aura. Meng Chuan reached out and grabbed Demon Slayer.
The baneful aura from a mere slash of this saber will be plenty to deal with a Fifth Tribulation Eminence! Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up. Previously, Demon Slayer was only at the Fifth Tribulation realm. Due to the fact that it was extremely compatible with him, its power even multiplied. Now, Demon Slayer had become his trump card. It was completely different from his Seventh Tribulation treasure – Thirteen Universe Beads.
I’ll familiarize myself with it for two days. I’ll head to Snake Fiend Star after that. Meng Chuan’s eyes were cold. It was time to deal with Snake Fiend Star.
Snake Fiend Star.
This was a massive star that spanned five million kilometers. Every adult Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake was large. Therefore, they had deliberately found a sufficiently large star to move here to create a branch lair.
Typically, Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes could be seen sleeping on Snake Fiend Star’s surface. But now, there was no life to be seen.
In a chamber in a towering palace on Snake Fiend Star.
Two thin figures, a man and a woman, sat cross-legged. “It’s been more than half a month since City Lord Eastcalm slaughtered Three Bay River System’s plundering factions.” The woman’s eyes were dark-gold. They were cold and heartless. “He didn’t come to our Snake Fiend Star. If he wants to build an Eternal Tower branch, according to Eternal Tower’s rules... he has to wipe out all the plundering factions. We are the largest plundering force in Three Bay River System. He can’t avoid us.”
“Regardless of whether it’s a fight or a negotiation, he has to come,” said the lanky man. “Unless he isn’t building an Eternal Tower branch, but wouldn’t slaughtering the other plundering factions be a waste of his effort then?”
“Could he have gone to negotiate with Cave Lord?” guessed the woman.
“If he negotiates with Cave Lord, Cave Lord will inform us,” said the lanky man indifferently. “Just wait patiently!”
For special lifeforms, the higher one’s cultivation realm was, the more they cherished their lives. This was because they didn’t have an inhabited world’s protection! Their life-preservation means were much weaker.
Snake Fiend Star was already privy to City Lord Eastcalm’s intelligence. They believed that he wouldn’t do anything rash. However, when they learned that he had slaughtered all the other plundering factions, they were shocked! The Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes fled back to Warped Cloud River System through the spacetime hole on Snake Fiend Star. They only made two Fourth Tribulation Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes leave their Essence Soul avatars behind to negotiate with City Lord Eastcalm!
Even if they were killed, they would only lose two Essence Soul avatars. Furthermore, the Essence Soul avatars of the two Fourth Tribulation Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes didn’t even carry any treasures with them. They wouldn’t lose anything even if they died.
To their surprise, City Lord Eastcalm hadn’t visited despite half a month passing.
“We’ll wait for another month. If he still doesn’t come, we’ll pay a visit to City Lord Eastcalm on Thousand Mountain Star,” said the woman.
“A visit to Thousand Mountain Star? Alright.” The man agreed after some thought. They didn’t carry any treasures with them after all.
Huh? The man and woman sensed something at the same time. They looked up slightly and saw a figure appear above the star. “He’s here!” The two jolted to attention. After all, they had waited for this moment for quite some time.
The cyan-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan stood above Snake Fiend Star and looked down at it. Just as I expected, they were so frightened from learning about my massacre that only two Fourth Tribulation Eminences remained.
At that moment, two figures flew out from below. They were a lanky man and a woman. Although they had human appearances, they had Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake patterns on their faces. Their eyes resembled that of a snake’s.
“We are under Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s orders to wait for City Lord Eastcalm,” said the lanky man. His posture showed respect. This was the respect a Fourth Tribulation Eminence had for a Fifth Tribulation Eminence.
Meng Chuan listened. These two were originally Snake Fiend Star’s supreme leaders, but they had only left their Essence Soul avatars to pass a message. “Cave Lord Scenic Cloud has said that he’s willing to show you due respect since City Lord Eastcalm is a Fifth Tribulation Eminence who cultivates both his body and Essence Soul,” said the lanky man. “The entirety of our Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake branch in Three Bay River System will migrate back to Warped Cloud River System. We won’t affect your control over the entire Three Bay River System. However, we have lived in Three Bay River System for tens of thousands of years. If we give up this branch, City Lord Eastcalm will have to compensate us.” “Compensation?” Meng Chuan raised his eyebrows. “Ten thousand cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals or the equivalent in treasures,” said the lanky woman. “These are Cave Lord’s demands.”
Meng Chuan wasn’t surprised by the other party’s demanding request.
As a special lifeform-an Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake—Cave Lord Scenic Cloud had cultivated to the Fifth Tribulation realm and grasped three Fifth Tribulation laws. His strength was indeed terrifying.
“After plundering Three Bay River System for tens of thousands of years, you still want me to compensate you?” said Meng Chuan indifferently. “Scenic Cloud thinks too highly of himself! Send a message to Scenic Cloud and hand over all the Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes that have been plundering Three Bay River System for the past tens of thousands of years. Furthermore, none of you are allowed to enter Three Bay River System again from now on. Only then will this matter be settled.”
“We have to hand over all our fellow species that have plundered in Three Bay River System?” The lanky man scoffed as he looked at the white-robed man. “City Lord Eastcalm, you are overstepping your boundaries. In the entire River of Spacetime, countless Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes have plundered. Do you want to act as a judge to all of them? Ignoring our Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes, there are countless cultivators in the River of Spacetime that enjoy plundering. Even peak factions like Black Fiend Hall are established to plunder and slaughter. Do you want to wipe them out? Unfortunately, even if an Eighth Tribulation Eminence is born in the River of Spacetime, they can’t wipe out Black Fiend Hall.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “I know my limits, so I’ve already said that I will only focus on the Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes that plundered Three Bay River System.”
“City Lord Eastcalm, stop dreaming.” The lanky woman couldn’t help but berate angrily. “Cave Lord’s conditions are exactly as stated. If you don’t agree, hmph! Don’t even think about building an Eternal Tower branch here.”
“When the time comes, our Cave Lord will personally come to Three Bay River System and wipe out your Three Bay River System. We’ll see how you stop him then,” said the man. “Therefore, bow your head obediently and hand over 10,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals as compensation. That way, we will migrate; it’s a good end for both parties.” “Good end for both parties?” Meng Chuan muttered softly. He shook his head slightly and flicked his sleeve.
The man and woman dissipated in shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 582 - Meng Chuan vs Cave Lord Scenic Cloud!
chapters.content:
Chapter 582 Meng Chuan vs Cave Lord Scenic Cloud!
Meng Chuan turned even more solemn after destroying the two Essence Soul avatars.
Destroying them meant that they had fallen out with each other. Although he was very confident, Cave Lord Scenic Cloud was definitely the strongest opponent he would encounter in the outer realm to date.
Let’s begin. Bolts of lightning appeared around Meng Chuan as he walked towards Snake Fiend Star.
At this moment, light came to a halt; the tiny particles in the outer realm’s void stopped moving
Apart from Meng Chuan, everything was still.
Time Stillness!
Meng Chuan leaped out of time. He could move for a long time at this frozen moment in time. Of course, even if no experts came to interfere with him, it would be a huge burden on Meng Chuan if he maintained this state of leaping out of time.
I have to set up a formation quickly. Meng Chuan waved his hand and threw out several artifacts. He placed them on Snake Fiend Star and began building a fixed array formation.
The array formation was a tool to communicate with spacetime. The array formation itself contained all sorts of mysteries. The user only needed 10% of their strength to unleash 100% of the array formation’s effects. However, there was one disadvantage. The greater an array formation’s power, the more complicated it was. In fact, it couldn’t be moved at all after being deployed. Once it moved, problems would occur during the array formation’s operations.
Cave Lord Scenic Cloud has mastered three Fifth Tribulation laws. I have to be sufficiently prepared. Meng Chuan knew this very well. Just like how Palace Lord Snowjade—who had mastered two Fifth Tribulation laws—could easily crush Ta Gu, Cave Lord Scenic Cloud could easily Palace Lord Snowjade by the same logic.
In fact, there weren’t many ways to combine two Fifth Tribulation laws. There were many ways to combine three Fifth Tribulation laws. Any two could be combined together, and one could also combine all three. In terms of strength, it was much stronger than combining two Fifth Tribulation laws. There was even a high chance of the three combined Fifth Tribulation laws reaching the nomological Sixth Tribulation realm.
Although Cave Lord Scenic Cloud hadn’t successfully ascended, he was nearly invincible below the Sixth Tribulation realm. That was why he was so domineering.
Even though Meng Chuan was a Fifth Tribulation Eminence who cultivated both his body and Essence Soul, he still requested for compensation. If not, wouldn’t it be too embarrassing for him to leave without making any requests?
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul was powerful, so he set up the array formation very quickly. However, since a fixed array formation was very complicated, he had to be careful when setting up the array formation. Furthermore, he had to attempt to activate it once to ensure that there were no problems with each of the array formation components’ operations.
Thus, Meng Chuan spent nearly four hours to complete the formation.
The moment the array formation was set up, Meng Chuan’s face turned pale. He quickly returned to the normal timeline and stopped maintaining Time Stillness. Tiring. It’s really tiring. Meng Chuan’s face was pale. His Essence Soul was extremely exhausted. Whenever he leaped out of time, he would be exhausted after two hours of free movement. The longer he persevered, the greater his fatigue.
This time, he lasted for nearly four hours. This was the longest Meng Chuan had lasted after comprehending the paramount speed laws.
Meng Chuan immediately consumed a Green Leaf Creation Fruit worth 80 cubes. He drank some fruit wine that nourished his Essence Soul and recovered to optimal physical state. In the outer realm, there were treasures that could instantly restore one to peak state, even if they were at the brink of death. The premise was that one had enough treasures. For example, treasures that were useful to Supremacies and Imperial Lords, such as an Undying Talisman, could allow an Imperial Lord to maintain an undying body for two hours. However, they couldn’t stand in for a lifeform like Meng Chuan.
The stronger a living being was, the greater the price needed for a death stand-in.
I’ll be waiting for Cave Lord Scenic Cloud now. Meng Chuan sat cross-legged on a mountain. His illusory Essence Soul World enveloped him, as well as the array formation he had secretly set up. The array formation seemed to be a part of his Essence Soul World.
Meng Chuan silently stared at the spacetime hole in front of him.
A spacetime hole was like a bottomless pit in the void. One couldn’t sense what was at the other end of the hole. However, much was known about this spacetime hole. It was connected to Warped Cloud River System.
About 30 seconds after Meng Chuan sat cross-legged, a figure flew out of the spacetime hole.
So fast? Meng Chuan carefully observed the figure.
It was a tall and muscular man. Even though the figure had a human appearance, he was as tall as a small mountain. His skin was like black metal; every spot on his skin seemed to contain a world.
After flying out of the spacetime hole, he emitted a monstrous pressure, causing the space around Snake Fiend Star to distort, even though he was floating in mid-air.
en
What a powerful body. The pressure he exerts on the void is so strong. Meng Chuan was secretly shocked.
“City Lord Eastcalm,” Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s eyes were cold as he said coldly, “I offered you respect, but you showed none to me?”
Meng Chuan looked at him. “After plundering and killing for tens of thousands of years in my homeworld’s river system, you still want me to compensate you? This is called giving me respect?”
Cave Lord Scenic Cloud looked at the figure in front of him. The cyan-clothed, white-haired man with a saber by his waist stood there with a restrained aura.
“From the looks of it, you have cultivated both your body and Essence Soul. Do you think you have the confidence to deal with me?” Cave Lord Scenic Cloud swept his gaze across his surroundings. The surrounding world was vast.
Smoke curled up. Children ran around. There were youths practicing their saber arts. Cultivators flew across the world. The world was extremely real. Meng Chuan had used a World Treasure as his Essence Soul World’s vessel, boosting his strength greatly. “Your Essence Soul World looks very weak. It doesn’t pressure me at all.”
This was the bitter truth.
Where Cave Lord Scenic Cloud stood resulted in spacetime distortion as if the void submitted to him. When the Essence Soul World came into contact with Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s surroundings, it was obstructed by an invisible force.
“I believe you know my request as well,” said Meng Chuan calmly. “All the Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes that have plundered Three Bay River System for tens of thousands of years will be handed over as long as they are alive. That way, this matter will be settled.” Cave Lord Scenic Cloud was taken aback when he heard that. Following that, he laughed loudly. “Hahaha...”
The laughter was robust and bombastic as it stirred a void storm in all directions.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World suppressed the void storm with all its might. Meng Chuan frowned slightly when he saw how powerful the laughter was. He had already expected the other party to be very strong, but he still found it a little difficult to withstand him.
“I never expected a Fifth Tribulation Eminence to dare bully me.” Cave Lord Scenic Cloud looked at Meng Chuan with cold eyes. “You can forget about having this body leave alive.”
As soon as he finished speaking
Cave Lord Scenic Cloud opened his mouth.
Boom!
Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s mouth seemed to become a dark black hole. An invisible suction force landed on Meng Chuan through the void.
An Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake’s talent was Star Swallowing. As for Cave Lord Scenic Cloud, he had fused three Fifth Tribulation laws together, raising his Star Swallowing to an unimaginable level.
Just by opening his mouth, Meng Chuan felt like he was isolated from his surroundings. He couldn’t help but fly toward his opponent’s mouth.
Go. Meng Chuan waved his left hand, and the 13 beads on his wrist immediately flew out. The Seventh Tribulation treasure—Thirteen Universe Beads!
Under the control of his Power of Essence Soul, the Thirteen Universe Beads flew out. Their might seemed to fuse together as though they were a world in itself, isolating any external forces.
His Essence Soul World also had a World Treasure as a vessel. It also cooperated with the Thirteen Universe Beads.
Meng Chuan exerted all his strength with his Thirteen Universe Beads and Essence Soul World. Only then did Meng Chuan feel the suction force weaken. Only then could he stabilize himself.
This left Cave Lord Scenic Cloud somewhat surprised. Many a time, the moment he opened his mouth, he would force his opponent to use a life-preservation treasure to escape. This City Lord Eastcalm could actually block him head-on.
Go. As he maintained Star Swallowing, he secretly used his second killer move.
An illusory shadow of a huge tail came from the void’s depths. It instantly appeared in front of Meng Chuan. Wherever it passed, his Essence Soul World would be torn apart.
The tail was over 50,000 kilometers long. Its might was terrifying. Meng Chuan’s expression changed. He instantly drew the dark-red Demon Slayer from his waist and maintained an eight-fold faster time flow. He used his movement technique to dodge the tail phantom.
His Essence Soul only represented a portion of his strength. His physical body was another portion.
This was also why those who cultivated both the body and Essence Soul were powerful. When Meng Chuan attacked, it was like an Essence Soul Fifth Tribulation Eminence and a Physical Body Fifth Tribulation Eminence attacking together. Furthermore, they had perfect teamwork.

chapters.title: Chapter 583 - The Fight on Snake Fiend Star
chapters.content:
Chapter 583 The Fight on Snake Fiend Star
Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s second killer moveTail Phantom-appeared from deep within the void. It was over 50,000 kilometers long. It was especially large and terrifyingly fast. It instantly appeared in front of Meng Chuan.
I can’t avoid it. Although Meng Chuan had the time advantage and speed advantage, Tail Phantom was too large! As it swept over with a whoosh, even the firmament seemed to collapse. Meng Chuan immediately swung his saber. “Break!” Meng Chuan’s physical strength completely erupted. His entire body transformed into a black saber beam as he forcefully sliced through the Tail Phantom.
The tail seemed corporeal and extremely tough, making Meng Chuan feel immense resistance. The tail seemed to contain billions of void obstruction layers. However, after his body devoured Primordial Stones, his body was similar to that of the dragons of the Baxia clan —who were famous for their immense strength and bodies akin to treasures. He naturally dared to clash with the tail head-on.
This saber move also fused Infinite Saber’s and Nirvana Saber’s profundities. Back when he was exploring the mysterious cave abode, he had just comprehended Nirvana Saber... Therefore, the two Fifth Tribulation laws had yet to fuse. After returning to Three Bay River System for nearly a year, he had actually cultivated for decades after counting the time he spent cultivating in a Chaos Hole. These two laws had also fused together during that period.
With an extremely powerful body, he executed this strike with Demon Slayer.
Rip!
The black saber beam-spanning over 5,000 kilometers-forcefully sliced through the tail.
What? Cave Lord Scenic Cloud was somewhat astonished. He actually managed to block my move head-on?
His killer moves were formed from fusing three different laws. They were extraordinary in might. Tail Phantom was executed by projecting his body’s Dharmic powers. Although it was slightly weaker in toughness, it was fast. This was because it descended from the void, making it even more unpredictable and difficult to dodge.
“Kill!” After slicing the tail phantom apart, Meng Chuan didn’t slow down at all. He used the Thirteen Universe Beads to defend himself against the Star Swallowing Technique. At the same time, he charged at Cave Lord Scenic Cloud with Demon Slayer. When Cave Lord Scenic Cloud saw this, he immediately roared angrily.
Star Swallowing had previously been sucking, but it was now a terrifying roar that was the complete opposite.
Roar!
The roar’s sound waves spread out in a fan-shape in front of him. Wherever they passed, space would shatter.
Meng Chuan—who was surrounded by the Thirteen Universe Beads—was sent flying by the sound waves despite his attempts to block them. The roar’s sound waves struck Meng Chuan’s body. This... Meng Chuan felt very uncomfortable. The sound waves struck his body, causing every particle in his body to tremble. His body was close to shattering, but Meng Chuan’s body remained intact after the sound waves passed him.
Oh? He didn’t die? He was surprised that his roar didn’t kill Meng Chuan. The fact that Meng Chuan’s body remained completely uninjured shocked him.
Under normal circumstances...
The first three of the seven killer moves he had comprehended could be used in his ordinary form. They were Star Swallowing, Tail Phantom, and Void Roar. These three moves were enough to kill most Fifth Tribulation Eminences.
The four other stronger killer moves could only be used when he was in his true form.
“It’s been a long time since a Fifth Tribulation Eminence has made me use my true form,” said Cave Lord Scenic Cloud. At the same time, his body had already transformed into a massive body that appeared like a mountain range.
This was an Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake’s true form.
He was much larger than an adult Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake. He had broken through the limits of his talent and reached the Fifth Tribulation realm. Furthermore, he grasped three Fifth Tribulation laws, making his body extremely terrifying.
His massive body was over 15,000 kilometers long. The surface was covered with huge snake scales. Every scale surface had a large number of spatial flows. His eight necks were very long, like giant snakes.
The eight heads stared at Meng Chuan at the same time. Beneath his muscular torso, his thick legs stood on Snake Fiend Star. At the same time, eight long black tails slowly swayed. Every tail made Meng Chuan’s heart palpitate. According to the intelligence, Cave Lord Scenic Cloud has cultivated his eight tails, making them akin to treasures. His tails are even more terrifying than his heads. Meng Chuan became more cautious when he saw Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s true form. “Die!” Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s eight heads coldly glared at Meng Chuan as his eight black tails moved simultaneously.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Black afterimages tore through the void and attacked Meng Chuan from all directions.
Although Meng Chuan had grasped the paramount speed laws and could dodge quickly, the eight tails appeared in front of him as if they were teleporting. Furthermore, they collectively attacked him, encircling him within. Each tail was massive, so Meng Chuan couldn’t dodge them. He could only choose to fend off one of the black tails.
Bam!
Meng Chuan used all his strength to attack. He wanted to test his opponent’s body.
This collision made Meng Chuan’s body tremble.
Boom!
He couldn’t help but fly backward. He attempted to dodge the other black tails’ attacks in the void, but he still collided with two black tails. He staggered before escaping from the eight tails’ attack range.
I actually failed to slice off the tail? Meng Chuan noticed that his full-powered strike had only split apart the tail’s snake scales and muscles. His attack had struck the tailbone, but it had lost its momentum.
The Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake instantly recovered from its injuries.
If I can’t heavily injure him in close combat, it will be even harder to injure him with the Thirteen Universe Beads. Meng Chuan’s strongest attacks were when he unleashed his full strength at close range. However, his opponent’s body was just too strong!
Cave Lord Scenic Cloud hadn’t comprehended a Sixth Tribulation law because the three Fifth Tribulation laws he had grasped were mainly from the spatial lineage. Furthermore, he hadn’t managed to fuse them into a complete spatial law. After all, spatial laws were ultimately the strongest Sixth Tribulation laws. Typically, only Seventh Tribulation Eminences grasped a completely spatial law.
Cave Lord Scenic Cloud mainly focused on the spatial lineage. Although he was stuck in the Fifth Tribulation realm, his combat strength was still terrifying. His body was also extremely tough.
Meng Chuan’s melee attack was definitely at the peak of the Fifth Tribulation realm; yet, his opponent only sustained minor injuries, which instantly healed thereafter.
However...
“This is—” Cave Lord Scenic Cloud was in pain. His eight heads couldn’t help but sway as he let out a painful roar.
The saber strike had only split half of a tail. His sustained injuries weren’t worth mentioning, but the strange baneful aura contained in the saber strike affected Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s consciousness greatly.
Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s eight heads stared at Meng Chuan in shock. Due to the baneful aura lacking further supply after a single strike, it naturally weakened. “This baneful aura?” Cave Lord Scenic Cloud was puzzled. He couldn’t help but look at the dark-red saber in Meng Chuan’s hand. “Is it from the saber in your hand? Is your saber an extraordinary treasure?” Cave Lord Scenic Cloud could sense the dark-red saber’s evilness.
“An extraordinary treasure?” Meng Chuan looked at his Demon Slayer and smiled. Typically, strange and special treasures were considered extraordinary treasures. “From the looks of it, the baneful aura poses a threat to you.” Meng Chuan smiled slightly.
“However, don’t even think about touching me with your saber again.” Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s eight heads simultaneously attempted to execute another killer move to deal with Meng Chuan from afar.
At that moment, a black Magic Awl flew out of Meng Chuan’s body. It instantly flew into Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s body.
Essence Soul forbidden spell—Magic Awl! Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s eight heads trembled slightly as they came to a halt. Meng Chuan instantly closed in on him with Demon Slayer in hand. His saber struck one of his heads.
Blood flowed out of the shattered snake scales as a strange baneful aura surged into Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s body.

chapters.title: Chapter 584 - How Did You Have the Time to Set up the Array? Boom!
chapters.content:
Chapter 584 How Did You Have the Time to Set up the Array?
Boom!
On Snake Fiend Star, Cave Lord Scenic Cloud and Meng Chuan’s battle became even more intense.
Although Meng Chuan’s Magic Awl shattered every time, the Essence Soul Star legacy allowed Meng Chuan to recover and condense another Magic Awl instantly. Therefore, Magic Awl after Magic Awl flew out and struck Cave Lord Scenic Cloud.
Meng Chuan’s true body held Demon Slayer as he cleaved at Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s massive body.
“Damn it.”
Growl
Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s eight heads howled as his body distorted. His eight long tails transformed into afterimages as they swept in all directions. His eight heads attempted to devour Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan’s every strike contained a strange baneful aura as a Magic Awl followed up. This made it impossible for Cave Lord Scenic Cloud to use any special moves. All he could do was rely on his powerful body to counterattack. His moves were too simple, making it much easier for Meng Chuan to deal with them.
Meng Chuan attacked with ferocious close-range strikes. At the same time, the Thirteen Universe Beads frantically attacked his opponent. Boom! Boom! Boom!
The Thirteen Universe Beads struck Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s eyes and necks. The ferocious black saber beams cleaved down repeatedly, causing Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s skin to split open. Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s eight heads frantically counterattacked in a bid to bite Meng Chuan and devour him. His eight tails struck out repeatedly, causing the void to shatter. However, his superficial attacks failed to touch Meng Chuan. This Essence Soul mystic technique and strange baneful aura... I can’t use any killer moves at all. Cave Lord Scenic Cloud was in great pain, but deep down, he was very calm. However, this is an extremely rare opportunity to temper my mind and will! At my realm, it’s getting harder to temper both aspects. As for Eastcalm City Lord’s attacks, they only deal me superficial wounds. I’ll recover from them instantly. Cave Lord Scenic Cloud didn’t panic at all.
His body-which was cultivated from three Fifth Tribulation laws-was too powerful. His skin and injuries healed instantly, so he didn’t consume much energy.
Even if I lie here and let him slash me for 10,000 years, he can’t do anything to me. What I need to do is resist the baneful aura and Essence Soul mystic technique while diverting more attention to the fight. If I can use a complete killer move, it means that my mind and will has improved greatly. Cave Lord Scenic Cloud was very patient. Although he appeared to be engaged in battle, he treated it as a form of cultivation.
Meng Chuan used all his strength.
Demon Slayer’s strange baneful aura and the Magic Awls attacked simultaneously. His opponent’s mental cultivation was clearly stronger than Palace Lord Snowjade’s. Although Cave Lord Scenic Cloud was greatly affected, it wasn’t to the point that his consciousness completely collapsed. He could still continue controlling his body and counterattack.
The profundity of his current moves are shallow. He can’t touch me at all. I can use all my strength to deal with him, but the injuries I inflict on him aren’t worth mentioning at all. When Meng Chuan saw the flesh and blood wounds that had been inflicted instantly heal, he could sense the difference between them.
Meng Chuan focused on the laws of paramount speed. He had only recently comprehended Nirvana Saber. Thus, it was difficult for him to fuse its profundities into his body and change his body, given that so little time had passed. Furthermore, Meng Chuan mainly cultivated the Void Catalog’s third volume. He hoped that he could quickly comprehend a Fifth Tribulation spatial lineage law so that he could master a Sixth Tribulation law in one fell swoop. In the future, his body would focus solely on the Sixth Tribulation law. He didn’t want to waste his time comprehending Nirvana Saber’s law, which could already fuse with his body.
However, Cave Lord Scenic Cloud cultivated his body with three Fifth Tribulation laws. His body was just too powerful.
It’s not bad that I managed to tie with Cave Lord Scenic Cloud. Meng Chuan had long expected this outcome. He had even been prepared to be defeated.
Arise! Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World had long communicated with the array formation he set up on Snake Fiend Star. His vast Power of Essence Soul instantly split his mind into 10,000 thoughts as he controlled the massive array formation.
When it came to operating array formations, why was an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence much stronger than a Physical Body Tribulation Eminence? The Essence Soul was one reason! The stronger one’s Essence Soul, the more complicated the arrays one could control.
Essence Soul Worlds were the second reason!. When an Essence Soul world fused with an array formation, one could perfectly control the array formation’s every ounce of strength. Every Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence was an array formation master.
This is— Although Cave Lord Scenic Cloud looked crazed, he was actually immersed in the tempering of his mind and will. The sudden development alarmed him.
Snake Fiend Star completely vanished, along with the distant void.
Only black and white gases remained.
Black fog filled the bottom, while white fog occupied the top. Cave Lord Scenic Cloud and Meng Chuan were in the middle of the black-and-white fog.
The black-and-white fog simultaneously wrapped around Cave Lord Scenic Cloud. They wrapped around his eight tails, eight necks, thick legs, and torso.
