I need to leave. When Cave Lord Scenic Cloud saw the black-and-white fog, he felt an immense threat. He immediately activated the Void Transference Talisman he carried with him without any hesitation.
Buzz!
The Void Transference Talisman was activated.
What? After Cave Lord Scenic Cloud activated it, he was astonished to discover that the area he could sense through the Void Transference Talisman was still within the black-and-white fog! He couldn’t teleport out.
I can’t even leave with a Void Transference Talisman? Cave Lord Scenic Cloud was somewhat alarmed.
Some Sixth Tribulation Eminences could stop a Void Transference Talisman with their own means.
If one relied on a fixed array formation, a Fifth Tribulation Eminence could stop a Void Transference Talisman.
Meng Chuan had exchanged for a Seventh Tribulation array-Yin-Yang Grand World Array—from Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s vault. This array formation wasn’t far inferior to Thousand Mountain Star’s array formation. Thousand Mountain Star only had the number advantage! With the superimposition of might, the Yin-Yang Grand World Array’s level was extremely high. Just the materials needed to set up the array formation cost a total of 5,900 cubes.
The reason why he exchanged for it was partially to deal with Cave Lord Scenic Cloud. The other reason was that the array formation was most suitable for Meng Chuan. Meng Chuan could comprehend the array formation and cultivate it.
“Break!” Cave Lord Scenic Cloud lashed out with his eight tails. His eight heads swayed as layers of void fluctuations surged around him. He needed to dissipate the black-and-white
fog.
The black-and-white fog was originally formless, but it still clung to Cave Lord Scenic Cloud. Almost instantly, black-and-white chains appeared around his body, making it harder for him to escape.
“Stop struggling. Unless a Sixth Tribulation Eminence takes action, they won’t be able to break my array formation.” Meng Chuan stood there and looked at Cave Lord Scenic Cloud, who was completely restrained by the black-and-white chains.
Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s eight heads looked at Meng Chuan in disbelief. “When did you set up the array formation? Snake Fiend Star has always been my Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes’ territory. You killed two of my clansman’s Essence Soul avatars. I immediately rushed here after that happened. How did you set up the array formation in time?”
He had never thought of charging into Thousand Mountain Star. This was because Thousand Mountain Star—the base of a former Sixth Tribulation Eminence—had powerful array formations. Without being at the Sixth Tribulation realm, there was nothing he could do to the array formations.
As for Snake Fiend Star? This was the Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes’ territory!
This type of fixed stacked array formation was famous for being complicated. It’s complicated composition was the only reason why it could break down into tens of thousands of low-level array formations. With many low-level array formations perfectly combined, this high-level array formation could unleash extremely terrifying might.
Setting up such an array formation took a long time. However, Cave Lord Scenic Cloud didn’t know that Meng Chuan could stop time.
Back when Meng Chuan explored the mysterious cave abode, he had only accelerated time when he fought Old Fiend Black Wind and Palace Lord Snowjade! He didn’t use the Time Stillness technique in front of them. He only used the Time Stillness technique when he killed some weaker Tribulation Eminences. However, those Tribulation Eminences didn’t know what move he had used.
Time acceleration was very common. Stopping time was very rare.
At the Fifth Tribulation realm, only one in 10,000 people could stop time. One could do it when they reached the extremes of the time lineage’s paramount speed laws.
As for paramount speed laws, they were the laws of a perfected world! It was impossible to have any additional profundities, or have even a sliver lacking. Any mistake-no matter how tiny-was forbidden. Therefore, it was extremely difficult to create an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique. There were far fewer of such existences than Sixth Tribulation Eminences!
Ordinary Fifth Tribulation Eminences would usually comprehend a Heaven Earth ultimate technique when they were Imperial Lords. They would then grope in the dark and accumulated insights until they comprehended a Fifth Tribulation law. They wouldn’t be able to comprehend paramount speed laws. Typically, only Sixth Tribulation Eminences or Seventh Tribulation Eminences would be able to grasp paramount speed laws due to their higher vantage point. “You don’t have to worry about when I set up the array formation. This body of yours is now dead.” Just as Meng Chuan finished speaking, the black and white gases condensed into a huge saber beam.
Array formations could trap enemies; they could naturally also kill enemies.
I’m dead. Cave Lord Scenic Cloud looked at the saber beam-it was much stronger than Meng Chuan’s normal saber beams. Its strength was close to that of a Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
Even though he knew he had failed, Cave Lord Scenic Cloud still didn’t understand how his opponent managed to set up the array formation in time.

chapters.title: Chapter 585 - Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s Decision
chapters.content:
Chapter 585 Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s Decision
The huge saber beam condensed from the black-and-white fog descended from the sky and silently struck Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s body. It sliced right through, splitting him into two. However, the wound on Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s massive body liquefied like flowing water. Soon, it connected back as one.
This strike managed to truly injure him. When Meng Chuan split his opponent into two, he could sense it very clearly. However, it only consumed a portion of his strength. I’m afraid it will take hundreds of strikes to kill him. If he has a treasure that can recover his strength and his body... it will take much longer.
Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s body was too strong. He had the most terrifying body Meng Chuan had ever seen at the Fifth Tribulation realm. With a body cultivated by three Fifth Tribulation spatial lineage laws, even a true Sixth Tribulation Eminence would take more than ten moves to destroy it. The saber beam condensed by Meng Chuan’s Yin-Yang Grand World Array was still much weaker than a true Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
Whoosh.
A new saber beam condensed in the sky. The array formation couldn’t condense a saber beam as fast as Meng Chuan, but it could deliver about one strike every second. Saber beams destroyed Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s massive body repeatedly.
Even if I have many defensive treasures and can instantly recover to my peak state, I will still use up all my treasures in a few hours. Cave Lord Scenic Cloud understood this point. His massive body was bound by black-and-white chains. He couldn’t struggle or dodge. He felt like he was being tortured by the saber beams that came cleaving down. He was furious and helpless.
When roaming the outer realm, one would encounter unexpected events. For example, a terrifying, mighty figure could suddenly appear when dealing with a trivial figure. For example, one might suddenly encounter a forbidden existence when plundering cultivators.
With Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s strength, it was very easy for him to deal with City Lord Eastcalm-a Fifth Tribulation Eminence. Who knew that his opponent had already secretly set up a powerful array formation on Snake Fiend Star, a place where he thought was safe.
I lost. I, Scenic Cloud, will lose half of the treasures I have accumulated over 50,000 years. Cave Lord Scenic Cloud felt his heart ache. His two true bodies were located in different river zones. The treasures they each held were comparable.
With his strength, it was typically very difficult for him to die if he didn’t provoke a Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
It will take several hours to kill his true body completely. Meng Chuan just needed to use the array formation to send several saber beams down before he understood this point. Immediately, a stream of light flew out from his body. The stream of light transformed into a black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan-an Essence Soul avatar.
My Essence Soul avatar will first head to Warped Cloud River System and observe Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s lair. Meng Chuan made a decision. Immediately, the Essence Soul avatar flew towards the spacetime hole.
It was difficult to see the interior of a spacetime hole from the outside. He could only feel that spacetime here was extremely distorted.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar flew in.
This is the first time I’m entering a spacetime hole. Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar flew into the spacetime hole and saw the scene inside. It was as though the vast spacetime had been compressed and stacked together. It appeared ridiculous and strange.
In less than three seconds, he passed through the spacetime hole and arrived in the ordinary outer realm void.
When he flew out, Meng Chuan saw a massive planet that spanned five million kilometers.
Scenic Cloud Planet. Meng Chuan looked at the planet. This was the lair of Warped Cloud River System’s Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake branch. It was also Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s cultivation ground.
“Leave!”
“Leave quickly!” “Evacuate Scenic Cloud Planet.”
“Quick, quick, quick.”
At this moment, Scenic Cloud Star was in a state of panic. Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes were flying out. Some crushed Lesser Void Transference Talismans and instantly left. The ignorant Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake infants were somewhat puzzled as they slowly flew. With their flying speed, it would take them a long time to fly out of Scenic Cloud Planet.
Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s Essence Soul avatar stood on a mountain and watched everything coldly.
Boom!
The illusory Essence Soul World descended and corroded Scenic Cloud Planet’s array formation.
He’s here? Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s Essence Soul avatar looked up but didn’t resist.
This was only a seventh-level Essence Soul avatar. It was weak and could only exist within the same river zone as his true body. A seventh-level Essence Soul’s Power of Essence Soul was unable to activate Scenic Cloud Planet’s array formation. As for the other Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes, their cultivation realms were too low. They couldn’t use the array formation. He could only allow Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World to attack them.
In the blink of an eye, Scenic Cloud Planet’s array formation was breached!
The illusory world spread out for 1.5 million kilometers as void fluctuations enveloped tens of millions of kilometers! They grabbed the Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes.
“No!” Many Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes revealed looks of despair.
“What happened?”
“What’s going on?” Many Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake infants were alarmed and puzzled. Some of them had yet to escape far from Scenic Cloud Planet. At most, they were still flying in its vicinity.
The black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan stood in midair above Scenic Cloud Planet. He sensed the area. I was too slow. There are only five Tribulation-level Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes left. The rest are Imperial Lords and Supremacies.
Most Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes were selfish. After receiving Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s orders, they immediately used various means to escape in the shortest time possible.
Scenic Cloud Planet was huge. It spanned five million kilometers! If they wanted to bring along some young Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes with them, it would take them a lot of time. They might lose the chance to escape if they were delayed by mere seconds.
For example, the five Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes—who were at the Tribulation realm-wanted to bring more of their clansmen with them. In the end, they failed to escape. Meng Chuan’s illusory world had descended.
“Eastcalm, aren’t you going overboard?” Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s Essence Soul avatar flew over and stared at Meng Chuan. “Are you trying to implicate these weak clansmen in our battle? Some of them were just born not long ago.”
“Five Tribulation Eminences, 32 Imperial Lords, and 263 Supremacies.” Meng Chuan nodded slightly. “Some are indeed newly born.”
Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes were born in the outer realm at the Supremacy realm.
Considering it was a lair guarded by Cave Lord Scenic Cloud, many Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes gathered here. Many Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes rushed over because of its fame. With Cave Lord Scenic Cloud protecting them, it was naturally very safe.
Scenic Cloud Planet was the largest Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake lair in the entire Goddess River Zone.
For example, Scarlet Snake Planet had dozens of Fifth Tribulation Eminences under its command! It became the Scarlet Snake species’ largest lair in the entire River of Spacetime.
The more powerful a species’ expert, the more of its kind gathered in one place. This time...
Many of the Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes’ Tribulation Eminences and Imperial Lords had fled, but Meng Chuan had also captured many. Most of them were weaker Supremacies.
“Release them.” Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s Essence Soul avatar looked at Meng Chuan. “I’ll give you all my true body’s treasures. I’ll also guarantee that I won’t cross you again.”
“You won’t cross me any longer?” Meng Chuan looked at him.
“If you kill my clansmen, I, Scenic Cloud, swear that I will fight you for the rest of my life. The entire Three Bay River System will not have peace.” Cave Lord Scenic Cloud stared at Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan looked at him and smiled slightly. “Are you threatening me? Cave Lord Scenic Cloud, think about it carefully. It was your Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake species that extended its claws into the Three Bay River System. After plundering Three Bay River System for tens of thousands of years, I’m only demanding payment for Three Bay River System’s blood debt. Are you the only one allowed to slaughter and plunder? Are cultivators not allowed to take revenge?”
Cave Lord Scenic Cloud said solemnly, “Only a small number of people have plundered. Many weak Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes here have never plundered, especially those at the Supremacy realm. These weak Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes are innocent, right?”
“I’ll take all of them away,” said Meng Chuan. “I’ll decide whether they are killed or kept alive... As for you spending the rest of your life fighting me, give me your best shot!”
Fight with him? The present him was no longer afraid of the other party.
He had gained a lot from studying the Void Catalog’s third volume. Once his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique reached the Fifth Tribulation realm, he believed that he could grasp a law at the Sixth Tribulation.
When that happened, killing Cave Lord Scenic Cloud would be easy.
Snake Fiend Star.
Cave Lord Scenic Cloud, who was bound by the black-and-white chains, endured the descending saber beams. His eight heads stared at Meng Chuan as he said, “City Lord Eastcalm, I plan on making a deal with you.” His voice echoed throughout Snake Fiend Star.
“Deal?” Meng Chuan temporarily stopped his saber beams.
“I’ll follow and serve you for 10,000 years,” said Cave Lord Scenic Cloud. “With this as a price, spare my fellow clansmen and my true body.”
“If I kill you, I’ll probably reap great benefits,” said Meng Chuan. “With your strength, this true body should have at least tens of thousands of cubes worth of treasures. As for followers? I’m not in urgent need of one.”
“I’ll offer another 30,000 cubes of treasures.” Cave Lord Scenic Cloud stared at Meng Chuan. As a special lifeform, Cave Lord Scenic Cloud had a relatively long lifespan. After reaching the Fifth Tribulation realm, he had a lifespan of more than 70,000 years. He still had 20,000 years left to live.
He was already making a huge sacrifice by saying that he would follow Meng Chuan for 10,000 years. As for treasures? He was considered extremely powerful at the Fifth Tribulation realm and had lived for a long time. He had accumulated several times more treasures than Pang Ming. Just the treasures he carried on his true body were worth nearly 50,000 cubes.
“Give me 30,000 cubes?” Meng Chuan looked at the massive Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake. A follower that was powerful enough could be of much use. There was no need for him to handle many trivial matters personally. He could focus more on his cultivation. He immediately said, “I don’t care about anything else. Hand over all the Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes that plundered Three Bay River System to me.”
“They fled back to Warped Cloud River System. You’ve already captured a portion of them,” said Cave Lord Scenic Cloud coldly. “A portion of them fled. I’ll capture them as well. However... the two strongest Fourth Tribulation Eminences are scattered in different distant river zones. I can’t capture them.”
“In other words, other than the two strongest Fourth Tribulation Eminences, you’ll leave the rest to me?” Meng Chuan looked at him.Cave Lord Scenic Cloud nodded. He could tolerate handing over more than ten Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes.
As for the 300 Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes that Meng Chuan had captured, they represented the vast majority in his lair! It was difficult for Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes to reproduce. Cave Lord Scenic Cloud couldn’t just watch as all of them were handed over to Meng Chuan. On the other hand, he also wanted to protect a special treasure that his true body carried. He could give the other treasures-worth 30,000 cubes when converted—to Meng Chuan. The special treasure was very important for his cultivation. He didn’t want to give it up.
For many reasons, he had made this choice. This was the greatest price he could bear. Meng Chuan pondered for a moment. He had never thought of slaughtering all Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes. Just like there were all sorts of ordinary cultivators, there were also many kinds of Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes. Only a small portion of them liked plundering. Some focused on cultivating on the planet and ignored the outside world while others liked taking risks. Otherwise, there wouldn’t have been just over ten Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes plundering Three Bay River System.
Meng Chuan looked at Cave Lord Scenic Cloud. “I agree to your conditions.”
Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s eight heads were slightly taken aback. His expression was complicated as he bowed his head. “Greetings, City Lord.”

chapters.title: Chapter 586 - Famous Across Goddess River Zone
chapters.content:
Chapter 586 Famous Across Goddess River Zone
Some Tribulation Eminences would break their promises easily because they knew that they had no hope of increasing their strength any further. Thus, they didn’t care about karma. However, promises made by people like Cave Lord Scenic Cloud—who had a chance of reaching the Sixth Tribulation realm—could be trusted.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan removed the array formation. At the same time, his Essence Soul World enveloped the area as he began to dismantle every part of the Yin-Yang Grand World Array. It was difficult to set up the array formation since every detail mattered. However, the dismantling process was very fast! A large number of array formation components flew up and were casually put away by Meng Chuan. “City Lord.” Cave Lord Scenic Cloud returned to his human form, becoming the same height as Meng Chuan, but he was still brawny. He cupped his hands slightly and said, “For the next 10,000 years, I will follow you. I won’t be able to preside over Warped Cloud River System. Therefore, many Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes in Warped Cloud River System will find it difficult to find a suitable place to reside. I wonder if my fellow clansmen can live on Thousand Mountain Star?”
It was one thing for him to preside over the planet in the past, but if he wasn’t present, a few hundred Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes would attract many experts to plunder them. This was because an adult Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake was worth hundreds of cubes.
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded and made a decision. “I’ll demarcate half of Thousand Mountain Star. I’ll use an array formation to put restrictions. Your clansmen can live there, but you know my temper. If your clansmen plunder again, I’ll also kill them.” “Thank you, City Lord.” Cave Lord Scenic Cloud was overjoyed. He immediately said, “City Lord, don’t worry. As long as anyone dares to violate your rules, I will kill them without you needing to do the deed.” Although Thousand Mountain Star was slightly smaller than Snake Fiend Star and Scenic Cloud Planet, it had a diameter of 1.95 million kilometers. Just half of it was enough for the Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes to live in.
“I’ll go capture the few fish that escaped,” said Cave Lord Scenic Cloud immediately.
Meng Chuan had captured more than half of the ten-plus Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes that had plundered Three Bay River System. There were still a few left. Cave Lord Scenic Cloud didn’t show any mercy.
The rules within the race were strict. For the sake of hundreds of his clansmen, Cave Lord Scenic Cloud was naturally decisive in sacrificing the few.
Long periods of plundering might accidentally result in provoking a powerful cultivator to seek revenge! Therefore, every plunderer knew how dangerous it was. However, they still plundered. Some of them just had it in them. Most of them became obsessed with the massive gains they obtained from plundering. As the leader of a branch of the species, Cave Lord Scenic Cloud had his clansmen choose their own paths. However, if a strong enemy came as a result of their plundering, the plunderer would have to bear the consequences. He couldn’t let the entire species die because of them.
That day, Cave Lord Scenic Cloud packed up everything. He even brought a total of 355 Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes to Thousand Mountain Star. A small number of Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes were unwilling to come to Thousand Mountain Star, so they wandered off by themselves. “Thousand Mountain Star.” “This is where we will live in the future?”
“According to Cave Lord, an Eternal Tower branch will be built here. It will be very lively.”
The hundreds of Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes-who had taken human forms—were secretly discussing with each other. Many of them were still young, so they were rather curious and expectant about their future lives.
“Bring them over and settle them down,” instructed Cave Lord Scenic Cloud.
“Yes, Cave Lord,” the five Fourth Tribulation Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes respectfully replied. They immediately led their clansmen and swooped down. Thousand Mountain Star had long prepared a residential area for them.
Soon, many young adults revealed their true bodies. They swam in the water and rolled on the ground in satisfaction.
Meng Chuan smiled as he watched the scene from afar. With this additional group of Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes, Thousand Mountain Star became much more lively.
Cave Lord Scenic Cloud felt much calmer when he saw this.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
The two Third Tribulation Eminences, Zhong Yu and Pang Feng, flew over.
“City Lord.” Zhong Yu and Pang Feng were extremely respectful. At the same time, they couldn’t help but look at Cave Lord Scenic Cloud and the Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes in the distance.
“Scenic Cloud.” Meng Chuan pointed at the two. “These two are Zhong Yu and Pang Feng. They are also my followers. Many of Eastcalm City’s trivial matters will mainly be handled by the two of them. Scenic Cloud, you don’t need to deal with matters usually. If they encounter any trouble... I’ll require you to help them.”
“Alright.” Cave Lord Scenic Cloud felt relieved. He was one of the top Fifth Tribulation Eminences, so he naturally didn’t want to worry about anything.
“Greetings, Cave Lord Scenic Cloud.” Zhong Yu and Pang Feng couldn’t hide their excitement as they bowed respectfully. They had long received Meng Chuan’s voice transmission and learned of the future arrangements in detail. This made them sigh in amazement. The outside world was worried that the City Lord would deal with Snake Fiend Star and anger Cave Lord Scenic Cloud. Who knew that Cave Lord Scenic Cloud would end up following their City Lord? If this news spread, the entire Goddess River Zone would probably be alarmed.
Goddess River Zone, Scarlet Snake Planet was Goddess River Zone’s Eternal Tower headquarters.
“Patriarch, Three Bay River System’s Eastcalm has already cleaned up the river system’s plundering factions. The next step is to build his Eternal Tower branch.” Chi Jiuxin respectfully handed a golden book over. Starlord Scarlet Snake was very thin. His body was shriveled, and his face was covered in wrinkles. However, his eyes were cold. His invisible aura made Chi Jiuxin’s heart tremble.
This Scarlet Snake patriarch was famous throughout the River of Spacetime. He was extremely powerful.
Most of the Scarlet Snakes’ reputation was thanks to Starlord Scarlet Snake. Without him, the Scarlet Snakes’ living environment would immediately turn nasty. Their population would shrink greatly.
With him around, the various factions would have to weigh the consequences carefully before dealing with the Scarlet Snakes. “Oh? Scenic Cloud has also followed him?” Starlord Scarlet Snake read the golden book in surprise.
“Yes. Eastcalm has already reported that the plundering factions are cleared. Eternal Tower will investigate and confirm that there’s no mistake. Furthermore, Cave Lord Scenic Cloud is very respectful towards Eastcalm on Thousand Mountain Star. He has even moved over 300 Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes there,” said Chi Jiuxin.
Starlord Scarlet Snake nodded slightly. “For Scenic Cloud to follow him, that kid from Archean Eon Realm does have some means. Pay more attention to him.”
“Yes,” replied Chi Jiuxin respectfully.
Starlord Scarlet Snake nodded. “Alright, I have no objections. Permit him to establish an Eternal Tower branch.”
“Yes,” replied Chi Jiuxin respectfully. Chi Jiuxin handled the day-to-day affairs, but he still had to report to the patriarch regarding the establishment of an Eternal Tower branch.
The patriarch was nominally in charge of the Eternal Tower branches in Goddess River Zone.
Three Bay River System’s Thousand Mountain Star is about to establish an Eternal Tower branch? It has even invited us to build a branch there? A purple-haired, purple-browed elder received news from Chi Jiuxin.
Eastcalm City’s core was the Eternal Tower branch, but there would also be other trading places.
The official members of Eternal Tower started many businesses to earn Outer Realm Essence Crystals or contribution points.
Cave Lord Scenic Cloud has migrated his entire clan to Thousand Mountain Star to follow this City Lord Eastcalm? The purple-haired, purple-browed elder found the news from Chi Jiuxin unbelievable. Why would Cave Lord Scenic Cloud do this?
What? Cave Lord Scenic Cloud is following a Fifth Tribulation Eminence? This Fifth Tribulation Eminence is called City Lord Eastcalm? A new face? An alien Fifth Tribulation Eminence—who was covered in fur and only had a pair of black eyes exposedwidened his eyes. Following that, he nodded slightly. From the looks of it, I have to go to Three Bay River System and build a branch. I can also pay a visit to City Lord Eastcalm.
How is that possible?
Who is this City Lord Eastcalm?
Although Goddess River Zone was vast, there were only about 1,000 Fifth Tribulation Eminences. The circle was only that large.
News spread like wildfire across Goddess River Zone!
Cave Lord Scenic Cloud is extremely famous among the Fifth Tribulation Eminences in Goddess River Zone, but he ended up following a new Fifth Tribulation Eminence?
City Lord Eastcalm.
The Fifth Tribulation Eminences in Goddess River Zone firmly memorized the name.
Previously, when news of Meng Chuan joining Eternal Tower spread, Goddess River Zone only knew of the Fifth Tribulation Eminence—who cultivated both his body and Essence Soul.
Meng Chuan had now become an influential figure! After all, the fact that Cave Lord Scenic Cloud followed him was too shocking.

chapters.title: Chapter 587 - A Long Eight Centuries
chapters.content:
Chapter 587 A Long Eight Centuries
Time passed. Nearly a century had passed since Meng Chuan built Eastcalm City on Three Bay River System’s Thousand Mountain Star.
“This is Eastcalm City? There are so many cultivators here.”
“There are so many shops. They have Imperial Lord-level manuals and Tribulation-level manuals.”
Three Supremacies walked through Eastcalm City excitedly. Eastcalm City was the trading ground for the entire Three Bay River System. Thirty to forty percent of the river system’s cultivators had gathered here over time. In the past, they had been suppressed badly. Now that there was a fair trading ground, it excited many Supremacies. They took out their homeworld’s treasures and came here to exchange for what they needed in their homeworld.
They could sell what they couldn’t use in exchange for what they needed.
Everyone was happy!
The Supremacy leading the group proudly introduced Eastcalm City. “The shops by the roadside are all ordinary shops. The buildings that occupy more than 50 kilometers of land have Fifth Tribulation Eminences backing them. The tallest one is Eternal Tower! All the other shops in Eastcalm City combined aren’t even comparable to Eternal Tower. However, good deals can be found in ordinary shops.”
“According to the rules, we’ll split up and do whatever needs doing. We’ll gather here after ten hours. This is because we have to leave Thousand Mountain Star before nightfall.”
“Alright.”
“Let’s split up.”
The three Supremacies weren’t worried about safety.
In the past, it was one thing for weak Supremacies to be oppressed in secret trading grounds. But if the treasures they had were too attractive, they would easily be robbed!
As for Eastcalm City? Even Tribulation Eminences didn’t dare violate the rules.
Outside Eastcalm City was a small building on a tall mountain.
Qin Wu sat cross-legged on a flat rock in front of the building. He sensed the profundities of the outer realm’s various laws. He looked down at the huge Eastcalm City in the distance. The city was extremely lively. “Meng Chuan really blessed the entire Three Bay River System by building Eastcalm City,” muttered Qin Wu softly.
Due to the increasing prosperity that Archean Eon Realm enjoyed, there were more and more Godfiends.
Meng Chuan had greatly reduced the threshold for entering the Godfiend Blood Pool. Furthermore, he had used 100 Outer Realm Essence Crystals to exchange for all sorts of treasures to nurture his juniors. This was enough to increase the number of Godfiends in Archean Eon Realm significantly. Although the expenditure of resources had increased ten-fold, Meng Chuan could buy resources from the outer realm without expending much of Archean Eon Realm’s resources. This was the benefit of producing a powerful Tribulation Eminence! Large amounts of resources were transported back to his homeworld. A hundred cubes were spent in a century. In 10,000 years, that would be 10,000 cubes—a rather huge investment.
Furthermore, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar often held public lectures. As a Fifth Tribulation Eminence, he had a deep understanding of time and space. Under his guidance, the Godfiends improved even faster. There were now 17 Supremacies, excluding Meng An, who had left for the outer realm.
My Essence Soul talent is a little lacking. It’s probably difficult for me to attain a seventh-level Essence Soul for the rest of my life. However, I still have a chance of creating a Sword Dao technique at the Heaven Earth realm before I reach the end of my lifespan. Qin Wu was also ambitious.
Back then, he was a peerless genius. He became a Supremacy early on and cultivated to the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm in his homeworld.
Because Meng Chuan brought back Star Cluster Building’s various techniques, Meng Chuan and his master, Qin Wu, discussed cultivation with each other. Not long ago, Qin Wu finally saw hope of reaching the Heaven Earth realm. Therefore, he informed Meng Chuan before coming to the outer realm to cultivate in Eastcalm City.
Here, many alien races could spar with each other. They could sense the vast laws and profundities. He still had hundreds of years to live. He was confident that he could reach the Heaven Earth realm before his end. However, his Essence Soul... had only reached the sixth-level recently. According to this progress, he had no hope of attaining a seventh-level Essence Soul before he passed away.
Meng Chuan once said that as long as a Supremacy in Archean Eon Realm reaches the Heaven Earth realm in terms of technique, he can find treasures to transform them into an Imperial Lord-level special lifeform if they haven’t attained a seventh-level Essence Soul by the end of their lives. Qin Wu felt that this path was rather suitable for him.
To Meng Chuan, it was very difficult to produce a Heaven Earth realm Supremacy in his homeworld. It was already impressive if there were a handful of them! However, it was very easy for Meng Chuan to transform them into an Imperial Lord-level special lifeform.
Qin Wu didn’t know that Meng Chuan was prepared to extend his master’s lifespan. This was because life modifications would stop his cultivation at the Imperial Lord realm. He would then have no hope of reaching the Tribulation realm.
A normal longevity extension method didn’t affect one’s cultivation path. However, the price of extending one’s lifespan was much greater.
Qin Wu didn’t dare hope for it. He even felt that it was already a great opportunity for a Heaven Earth realm Supremacy to be transformed into an Imperial Lord-level special lifeform. Meng Chuan would have to pay a huge price.
Whoosh.
Qin Wu took a step and descended the mountain. He flew towards Eastcalm City. He often went to Eastcalm City. There were all sorts of stores in Eastcalm City, and he enjoyed shopping
Inside Meng Chuan’s cave abode.
He was drinking tea as he carefully studied the Void Catalog’s third volume. “It’s true that the Great Dao is all about simplicity. As described in the catalog, although the entire Dao of Space is vast, it also has three main paths. I’ve been studying the Void Catalog for 800 years. I’ve finally finished reading it carefully from beginning to end,” muttered Meng Chuan.
Although nearly a century had passed in the outside world, he spent most of his time deep inside a Chaos Hole to verify his insights. The degree of spacetime distortion was different at different depths, making it very suitable for comprehending spacetime.
One basic-level Eternal Token for the Void Catalog’s third volume is really worth it. The Fifth Tribulation Eminences in Eternal Tower have to use contribution points for the exchange. Sixth Tribulation Eminences need 300,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals to buy a volume.
After he finished reading it, Meng Chuan felt that the price wasn’t high at all. If the Void Catalog only described one path, it naturally would not be worth this much. What’s most precious about the Void Catalog’s third volume is that it draws inferences. It provides examples of the various Dao. Meng Chuan was very certain of this. The creator’s realm was too high. To explain and dissect a sentence clearly, the creator drew inferences and even used other laws as examples.
With a large number of examples, the reader would then gain a clear understanding of the various Daos in the River of Spacetime, forming their own nomological path. It was just like how countless bricks were eventually built into a tall building. When the countless laws and profundities fused, they formed the River of Spacetime’s spacetime laws.
After studying the catalog, his horizons were broadened. He could even vaguely sense that he stood at the height of an Eternal, looking down at the many laws.
Of course, this was just an illusion! The Void Catalog was only suspected to be created by an Eternal existence. However, it allowed Meng Chuan to create a clearer plan for his cultivation.
I really want to read the other two volumes. Meng Chuan was filled with anticipation.
The Void Catalog had three volumes. He had only read the third volume to date. Unfortunately, the price to read one volume was too high. It was already a great opportunity for him to obtain a chance to read one volume at the Fifth Tribulation realm. If he wanted to read the other two volumes, he could only think of a solution when he reached the Sixth Tribulation realm.
Huh? Meng Chuan suddenly turned his head and looked in a certain direction. He was somewhat astonished.
In an extremely distant location, he sensed his son, Meng An. Due to the haziness, Meng Chuan found it difficult to lock onto his son’s location.
The connection between a father and son should have allowed them to sense each other clearly through their bloodlines since their karmic ties were deeper. However, for a moment, Meng Chuan sensed another existence other than his son, Meng An! It was of the same bloodline.
It’s just as far away. It’s in the same direction as An’er. It also has an extremely strong bloodline connection with me? Meng Chuan was shocked.
His daughter, grandson, and company had a bloodline connection with him, but they were in Archean Eon Realm.
That incomparably distant land...
Apart from Meng An, who else could have a strong blood connection with him? His perception of this unknown through the bloodline was clearly inferior to what he could sense of Meng An and Meng You. A blood relative within three generations. Could it be An’er’s child? Meng Chuan could only guess. Of his family, only Meng An had been to such a distant region.
An’er has a child? Dazed, Meng Chuan blinked his eyes. After so many years in his homeworld, didn’t An’er not marry? How did he suddenly have a child? What has An’er experienced all these years in the outer realm?

chapters.title: Chapter 588 - Meng An in a Mystic Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 588 Meng An in a Mystic Realm
Meng Chuan calmed himself down and thought carefully. He guessed that it was likely Meng An’s child. He couldn’t think of any other possibilities.
Nice. An’er finally has a child. Meng Chuan was delighted. According to the Meng family’s traditions, and basically every family’s traditions, only the family’s first generation of women would be written into the family genealogy. After the woman married, the children she gave birth to would come under the other family’s genealogy
For example, Meng You’s son, Yang Yuan, belonged to the Yang family. Although the Meng family had many people, for Meng Chuan’s bloodline, Meng You had married into another family. Meng An never married or had children. Therefore, his line had come to an end for his family genealogy. It didn’t continue.
Now, Meng Chuan’s line was continued.
Although Meng Chuan no longer cared about such matters as a Tribulation Eminence, the child was still his grandson or granddaughter.
I wonder what’s so special about the cultivation ground Ancestral Master Archean Eon prepared for An’er. An’er didn’t get married for so many years in Archean Eon Realm. After going to that cultivation ground... he now has a child. Meng Chuan smiled. According to An’er, that cultivation ground is a special mystic realm. I should go take a look. Since the child has been born, I should meet the child as their grandfather.
Meng Chuan couldn’t hold back any longer. With a thought, an Essence Soul avatar flew out of his body.
The Essence Soul avatar immediately left Thousand Mountain Star and entered the River of Spacetime. Following the karmic connection, it flew towards Meng An and the newly-appeared bloodline connection.
Although his senses of the two were blurry, he could still determine the direction.
Meng Chuan’s black-robed, white-haired Essence Soul avatar traveled through the River of Spacetime. In order to meet his son and grandchild, he carried some treasures with him.
Two months later.
Boom!
Meng Chuan stepped out of the endless darkness and finally arrived at a new river zone.
Oh? Meng Chuan stood in the vast River of Spacetime. Countless starlight dots surrounded him. He frowned slightly as he sensed the area. I traveled in the direction I sensed Meng An in and arrived at Taigu River Zone. I can confirm that An’er and the other bloodline-connected person are in Taigu River Zone. However, my perception of both is being blocked, making it very blurry. I can’t determine the direction now.
It looks like An’er and that person are still in that mystic realm.
Meng Chuan understood his limits.
A mystic realm was created by an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. It had all sorts of unimaginable things. A large number of mortal living beings could survive in mystic realms. They could even cultivate to the Tribulation realm. A mystic realm could accommodate living beings. It was more suitable for cultivation than a middle-level world. Of course, it was far inferior to a high-level world. Every high-level world had given birth to an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. Eighth Tribulation Eminences could gradually raise their worlds’ foundation to a higher level.
A mystic realm was created from nothingness by an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. It was naturally inferior to a high-level world of life, but it was still very magical. This was because the rules in a mystic realm were set by an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. They had many special traits. If a Sixth Tribulation Eminence controlled a mystic realm, anyone below the Seventh Tribulation realm would be courting death if they dared to charge in.
I wonder which mystic realm An’er is in. I wonder if there’s a mystic realm master or not. Meng Chuan was puzzled. At the very least, according to the intelligence I’ve gathered, there aren’t any mystic realms in Taigu River Zone.
There were some mystic realms hidden in the River of Spacetime. If a Sixth Tribulation Eminence obtained one and became the master of the mystic realm, some would choose to announce it. However, some would still keep it a secret.
Some mystic realms also had no owners. They remained unknown to the general public. The mystic realm An’er is residing in is an undisclosed mystic realm. Meng Chuan frowned slightly. I can’t enter it if it’s not publicized.
Taigu River Zone was two to three times larger than Goddess River Zone. There was indeed an ancient mystic realm hidden in the vast river zone.
Inside the mystic realm.
In a mountain valley filled with flora and fauna, Meng An was fishing by a pool. Beside him was a feline beast.
“Meng An.” A white-robed woman walked over from afar. In a few steps, she reached Meng An’s side. The feline beast opened its eyes and took a glance before closing its eyes comfortably to sleep. “Are you unaccustomed to living in this remote mortal world when you are a great expert that ascended to the Heaven realm?” The white-robed woman sat by his side and chuckled softly.
“No way.” Meng An shook his head. “Cultivation in the Heaven realm is important, but the child in your stomach is more important. The wars in the Heaven realm are too intense. It’s even possible that our enemies will target your child. Therefore, we should leave for now and stay in this mortal world. After the child grows up safely and I’ve arranged everything for him, we can return to the Heaven realm to cultivate.”
The white-robed woman nodded slightly.
Of the Heaven, Earth, and Man realms, the Heaven realm was naturally the most suitable for cultivation. However, for the sake of their children, the couple had sneaked back to the mortal realm.
“It will probably take over 100 years before the child grows up and gains a firm foothold in the mortal world,” said the white-robed woman. “We’ll stay in the mortal realm for a century then.” Meng An thought nothing of it. “Furthermore, I’ve already reached the perfected Heaven Earth realm. However, the perfecting of my body is still lacking. It’s suitable for me to study my body carefully in the mortal world.”
“Are you confident of attaining a perfected body in 100 years?” asked the white-robed woman worriedly. She knew very well that her husband’s cultivation technique had flaws when it came to cultivating a perfected body.
Although Ancestral Master Archean Eon had succeeded and had also arranged a path for his disciples, Meng An’s path was ultimately different from Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s. Therefore, there were differences in their methods of achieving a perfected body.
“I’ve read many books. I’ve also experienced 500 years of cultivation in the Heaven realm. I’m still confident about perfecting my body,” said Meng An. “It won’t even take 100 years. It should be perfected in 30 years.” The white-robed woman nodded slightly. She leaned against her husband and gently stroked her stomach with one hand.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar explored Taigu River Zone for more than a month. In the end, he returned empty-handed. It was too difficult to find a mystic realm.
In a chamber on Thousand Mountain Star.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged and meditated on the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique.
In the past 800 years of cultivation, he had mainly focused on comprehending the Void Catalog’s third volume. He carefully studied every single sentence. Now that he had finished comprehending it, he attempted to fuse his numerous insights into the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique. This technique was originally a movement technique, but it’s becoming more and more unrecognizable now. Meng Chuan laughed self-deprecatingly.
Back when he drew on the wisdom of the Selfless Formless Sword, he had an inclination towards domain.
Now, having read the Void Catalog’s third volume, which followed the Void Dao’s domain lineage, Meng Chuan’s accumulated insights were mostly in this aspect. He naturally wanted his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique to push its domain to the limits.
After 800 years of accumulating insights, Meng Chuan constantly perfected the Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique.
Three years after returning from the Taigu River Zone.
It’s done.
As he drank fruit wine, Meng Chuan felt a flash of inspiration amidst his tipsiness.
Meng Chuan’s many scattered insights into the domain lineage transformed into one. Finally, his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique reached a new stage.
Meng Chuan couldn’t suppress the joy in his heart. Although he hadn’t verified it, he was 80 to 90% confident.
It should have reached the Fifth Tribulation realm. Meng Chuan put down his cup and looked around. His gaze penetrated the chamber’s wall and enveloped Thousand Mountain Star. It even spread across Thousand Mountain Star. His perception of the void reached nearly half a billion kilometers.
If he completely grasped the Dao of Space, it would be normal for him to be capable of sensing another river system with a single thought. With a single step, he could carry out Void Transference and cross dozens of river systems without any surprises.
Of course, Meng Chuan only grasped the domain lineage so far.

chapters.title: Chapter 589 - Fu Sui and Old Fiend Black Wind
chapters.content:
Chapter 589 Fu Sui and Old Fiend Black Wind
In the chamber, Meng Chuan stood up and took a step, immediately appearing hundreds of millions of kilometers away from Thousand Mountain Star.
Teleportation!
This is the domain of space. Meng Chuan sensed that the void was as vast as the deep ocean. Different voids had different depths, just like the ocean. The deeper one went, the darker it became. Of course, the void was many times more complicated than the ocean. All sorts of ripples, fluctuations, and undercurrents surged in the void’s different layers, causing the different void levels to be connected for a short period of time. If one followed the connection, they could reach a distant spot.
The void was usually distorted. Matter and energy could distort it. Even the thoughts and gazes of Tribulation Eminences could distort it. However, even Tribulation Eminences found it difficult to understand the void.
As for Meng Chuan, he completely understood spatial domains after his Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique reached the Fifth Tribulation realm, and mastered its spatial domain. He no longer had any doubts.
The void was connected at different levels. Countless ripples appeared chaotic, but they contained a hidden pattern.
Once one grasped this pattern, one could stir the laws of a Tribulation realm Essence Soul and unleash terrifying strength. With me at the center, everything within 480 million kilometers is within my control. If I don’t suffer any interference, my teleportation range can reach 480 million kilometers. Meng Chuan also knew that this was the best result when undisturbed. If he fought experts or was suppressed by array formations, even he would be affected.
Enemies could even completely suppress the void, preventing him from teleporting at all. If he wanted to maintain peak strength, his domain would rapidly shrink.
Spatial domains, I’m best at domains. Meng Chuan knew that hiding in the void’s depths and teleporting were all supplementary techniques. They weren’t too impressive. Void Imprisonment and Void Suppression are the strongest. Meng Chuan could sense that as long as he stirred the Power of Essence Soul, he could control the power within the void’s infinite layers to suppress his opponent.
Meng Chuan’s heart stirred.
Boom!
Lightning that traveled at lightspeed flew out from his body and danced around him. Under Meng Chuan’s control, the lightning stirred the spatial domain’s laws and formed a terrifying electromagnetic field.
The electromagnetic field rumbled. Even a Fourth Tribulation Eminence would be instantly reduced to dust upon entry. Ordinary Fifth Tribulation Eminences would only have 10% to 20% of their strength left from the suppression. A simple combination of paramount speed laws and spatial laws can form such a terrifying electromagnetic field domain? Countless lightning bolts enveloped Meng Chuan’s surroundings as he stood in the middle like a lightning god.
This was a qualitative change due to the laws of time and space.
“Nirvana Saber, Infinite Saber, and Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique will increase in strength once the three laws are combined,” muttered Meng Chuan softly. Lightning crackled in the surrounding electromagnetic field. It was as though it was destructive. The lightning increased in strength, greatly increasing the power of the electromagnetic field.
With such might, he had a chance of killing an ordinary Fifth Tribulation Eminence.
Infinite Saber is a pure time-based law. Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique is a pure spatial law. Nirvana Saber is a combination of two. The three laws are too easy to combine.
All sorts of ideas surfaced in Meng Chuan’s mind.
The three laws made Meng Chuan’s strength transform. Although his body’s defense was still inferior to Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s, he had the advantage in domains and array formations. Just his means as an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence made him in no way inferior to Cave Lord Scenic Cloud. This isn’t what I want. What I want now is a Sixth Tribulation law. Meng Chuan’s heart burned with passion. According to many cultivators’ experiences, these three laws combined are sufficient to form a Sixth Tribulation law. However, I have to be careful when fusing them together. Meng Chuan was equally cautious.
In the future, the laws would fuse with his Essence Soul World, as well as his body. The laws would affect both his body and Essence Soul.
A path that was too heretical would affect his Essence Soul and mind. He might even go crazy. As an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence, he placed great importance on mental cultivation. Therefore, it was best to take the orthodox and peaceful path.
It takes time to combine them. My three laws are very suitable for combination. It might take as short as a few decades, but it’s hard to say how high the upper limit will be. Meng Chuan knew this very well. Cultivation was unpredictable to begin with. He didn’t need to think too much about it. He just needed to cultivate patiently and diligently.
Three Bay River System was calm and peaceful. Many cultivators gathered in Eastcalm City for transactions. With City Lord Eastcalm and Cave Lord Scenic Cloud presiding over it, no other factions dared to cause trouble at Three Bay River System.
In the blink of an eye, more than ten years passed.
In the Cang Alliance Space.
This was a place where many members of the Cang Alliance gathered. Meng Chuan would occasionally come here. Having made Cave Lord Scenic Cloud follow him, Meng Chuan became much more famous in the Cang Alliance. Many members took the initiative to befriend him.
“He’s here.” The short and fat Fu Sui sat there. He was as fat as a ball, but his eyes were very bright as he stared at Old Fiend Black Wind.
“Hey.” Black Wind nodded and sat down. Fu Sui and Black Wind sat opposite each other, silent for a moment.
“What do we do next?” asked Black Wind softly.
“Although we both lost a true body and many treasures, it’s nothing compared to our gains.” Fu Sui chuckled. “What I told you before we entered wasn’t a lie, right?”
Black Wind nodded slightly without saying a word. After exploring the ruins, he had finally broken through and grasped two Fifth Tribulation laws.
Black Wind was very regretful that he died after exploring only a portion of the ruin.
“You died once in this ruin, but I’ve already died three times.” Fu Sui gritted his teeth and said, “This is the most special ruin I’ve encountered in the past tens of thousands of years. I will definitely enter again. What about you?”
“Of course. Don’t try to shake me off.” Black Wind stared at Fu Sui.
“Don’t worry.” Fu Sui shook his head. “In order to keep it a secret, I won’t shake you off. However, I think... even if our strength increases, we are still far from being able to explore this ruin completely.”
Black Wind was slightly taken aback. Although he was unwilling to admit it, it was the truth. “Yes, our strength is indeed insufficient.” Black Wind nodded.
Fu Sui’s eyes lit up. “Previously, with the two of us working together, we gained much more. I want to invite two more helpers. If four Tribulation Eminences head in together, the gains will definitely be greater.” “Who do we invite?” asked Black Wind.
“Definitely members of the Cang Alliance. Cang Alliance members have a tacit understanding with each other. Nobody dares to break the rules. If they break the rules, their reputation in the Cang Alliance will be tarnished.” Fu Sui pondered and said, “At the same time, they have to keep their promise. Those Tribulation Eminences who have no hope of further cultivation improvements can do anything. They don’t care about karma at all. They can’t be selected either.”
“Yes.” Black Wind nodded. “Who’s on your mind?”
“I’ll choose two more. The first one will have to cultivate both their Essence Soul and body, so their life-preservation means will naturally be stronger. It’ll also be suitable to have them keep sending Essence Soul avatars to scout the danger ahead,” said Fu Sui. “The second one has to have sufficient combat strength and an even stronger body. Many a time, we will need him to tank the attacks.
“The first person I have in mind is Eastcalm. He’s a newly-advanced Fifth Tribulation Eminence. He also cultivates both his body and Essence Soul. There’s still endless promise to his cultivation path. It’s impossible for him to break his promise,” said Fu Sui.
Black Wind nodded slightly. He had interacted with Meng Chuan before, so he felt that it was alright.
“As for the second person, I plan on inviting that tiger king from Heavenly Dream Realm,” Fu Sui said.
Heavenly Dream Realm was one of the higher-level worlds in the River of Spacetime.
“Tiger King is much stronger than us. He has a violent personality, but he upholds his reputation in a way like it’s more important than his life.” Black Wind agreed. “I have no objections to these two choices.”
He also knew that Fu Sui held the means to enter the ruin. He ultimately decided the candidates.
“Alright, we’ll invite the two of them,” said Fu Sui.

chapters.title: Chapter 590 - Nearing (Final Chapter of Volume)
chapters.content:
Chapter 590 Nearing (Final Chapter of Volume)
Thousand Mountain Star.
“Master, congratulations.” Meng Chuan raised his cup and smiled.
“After cultivating for more than 1,000 years, I’ve finally created a Heaven Earth realm ultimate technique.” Qin Wu held a cup of wine and looked at Meng Chuan. He sighed and said, “Meng Chuan, as your master, I have to thank you. It’s because of you that I can learn so many ultimate techniques from Star Cluster Building. You’re also the reason why the war ended. Your actions have also dispelled my obsession. It’s also because of your guidance that I can break through. Otherwise, it would’ve probably taken me hundreds of years.”
Meng Chuan shook his head. “Master, it’s because you sacrificed too much for our homeworld! Back then, you became a Supremacy early on. You were unable to roam the outer realm because of the war. You were delayed for nearly 1,000 years.” “We are all a part of our homeworld. Many have sacrificed a great deal,” said Qin Wu indifferently. “So many Godfiends have sacrificed their lives. I’ve only been unable to roam the outer realm for 1,000 years.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded. “That’s right. Too many Godfiends have sacrificed their lives. By the way, I recently sensed that the demon sage passageway is beginning to become unstable.” “Unstable?” Qin Wu was astonished.
“It will probably collapse in a few decades. Archean Eon Realm and the Demon Realm will gradually distance themselves from each other,” said Meng Chuan with a nod.
“They are going to distance themselves?” Qin Wu had mixed feelings. This was something humans had always hoped for the most. But in this day and age, the demon sage passageway no longer posed any threat to humans.
With Meng Chuan around, the demons didn’t dare invade. Instead, they were worried that they would be attacked by the humans! However, other than Meng Chuan, there were far fewer ordinary human Godfiends than the demons. It was difficult for them to invade.
After all, the Demon Realm was ten-fold larger than Archean Eon Realm when it came to world size. The demons’ cultivation system was also more complete, so there were naturally more demon monarchs.
“There’s no way for us humans to seek revenge for the thousand-year blood feud.” Qin Wu was still somewhat unwilling to give up. Over the past 1,000 years, especially during the 800 years before Meng Chuan rose to prominence, humanity had sacrificed too much. Be it Godfiends or ordinary mortals, they were slaughtered like livestock.
“There will eventually be a chance for revenge,” said Meng Chuan softly. He had only killed the three leaders. How could that repay the blood debt of countless humans that numbered in the billions? Furthermore, he had yet to kill Emperor Roc.
“There’s not much I can do now,” said Meng Chuan to his master. “I can only prevent the demons from entering the outer realm. I’ll kill every demon that appears.”
Meng Chuan was in charge of Three Bay River System.
One of Meng Chuan’s true bodies was in his homeworld, making him very close to the Demon Realm physically. If the Demon Realm’s world membrane were to be torn open, Meng Chuan would immediately sense the demons coming out and intercept them.
Just like back then... human Supremacies didn’t dare leave their world for fear of being intercepted. Back then, Meng Chuan had immediately exiled himself the moment he left the world! Emperor Roc and company had also pursued him, but they were a step slower.
“Master.” A voice sounded from afar.
Meng Chuan turned to look.
In the distance, a woman in red appeared in midair. It was Zhao Hongxiu. Zhao Hongxiu was hovering in midair outside the hill, not daring to barge in.
Meng Chuan nodded. “Hongxiu, come in.”
Zhao Hongxiu flew into the mountain and bowed respectfully.
Meng Chuan glanced at her. “What’s the matter?”
“I’ve comprehended something today during my cultivation.” Zhao Hongxiu looked at Meng Chuan. She couldn’t hide her excitement. “I’ve finally reached the Heaven Earth realm.”
Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up when he heard that. “Heaven Earth realm?”
Due to his karma with Senior Pang Ming, he had accepted Gao Fang and Zhao Hongxiu as his disciples. The younger Zhao Hongxiu had reached the Heaven Earth realm in terms of technique. She also had a sixth-level Essence Soul. Furthermore, she still had much of her lifespan remaining... She had a chance of attaining a seventh-level Essence Soul before her death and becoming an Imperial Lord.
“Heaven Earth realm?” Qin Wu laughed when he heard that. Zhao Hongxiu had also broken through not long after he broke through. “What a coincidence,” said Qin Wu with a smile.
“It is.” Meng Chuan nodded. He was in a good mood. His master and disciple had reached the Heaven Earth realm one after another.
Meng Chuan’s cultivation had been rather smooth.
The three Fifth Tribulation laws—Infinite Saber, Nirvana Saber, and Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique-were very suitable for combining. Meng Chuan had figured out many ways to combine them, and his strength had increased by leaps and bounds.
I can sense that I’m getting closer and closer to fusing them into a Sixth Tribulation law. Meng Chuan stood on the tallest mountain building on Thousand Mountain Star and looked down at the vast and bustling city. He felt a sense of urgency. It’s fine if my spiritual cultivation isn’t high enough when I comprehend a Sixth Tribulation law. However, if my mental cultivation can keep up, it won’t take long for the sixth tribulation to descend.
This was the con of becoming an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence. They couldn’t stall for time. Under normal circumstances, if one comprehended a Sixth Tribulation law and had a sufficiently high mental cultivation, it would take a century to a few centuries before the sixth Heavenly Tribulation descended.
The short 100 years was a chance of survival given by the River of Spacetime’s laws. It allowed Tribulation Eminences to have enough time to refine a Sixth Tribulation treasure to prepare for their tribulation.
As for Physical Body Tribulation Eminences, they could continue delaying their tribulation for more than 10,000 years as long as their body didn’t reach a specific level.
Can I transcend the sixth Heavenly Tribulation? Meng Chuan wasn’t confident.
There were many criteria for one’s body to transcend a tribulation-strength, speed, vitality, toughness, and so on. Therefore, historically, those who had comprehended an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique had the confidence to create a sufficiently perfected Sixth Tribulation physical body formulation. However, when it came to an Essence Soul transcending a tribulation? Nobody was confident
If my mental cultivation is high enough, I’ll need to gather longevity extension treasures for Qiyue and my parents once I grasp a Sixth Tribulation law.
If he failed his tribulation, that would mean death. If he died, many things had to be arranged in advance.
At this moment...
On the contrary, Meng Chuan had some hope. His mental cultivation was lacking, so he could still cultivate his body first and reach the Sixth Tribulation realm with his body. Furthermore, he could improve his technique. If he grasped more laws, it would be easier for him to transcend the tribulation since his Essence Soul World would be powerful enough. However, no one could control the improvement of their mental cultivation. Sometimes, one would be stuck without making a breakthrough for a long time. Sometimes, one’s mind would suddenly transform.
Oh? Meng Chuan suddenly sensed something. Cang Alliance Space? Fu Sui invited me over?
With a thought, an embodiment immediately took form in the Cang Alliance Space using the Essence Soul mark he left there.
In the Cang Alliance Space.
Meng Chuan appeared and saw two figures sitting in the distance. One was Old Fiend Black Wind, who had explored a cave abode with him. The other was Fu Sui.
“Brother Eastcalm,” greeted Black Wind with a smile.
Meng Chuan walked over.
“Have a seat.” Fu Sui—who was as fat as a ball
-sat there and pointed to the side. “Tiger King will be here in a while.”
“Tiger King? The tiger king from Heavenly Dream Realm?” asked Meng Chuan as he sat down.
The Cang Alliance’s members were scattered across the River of Spacetime. There were a total of 801 members. Six new members, including Meng Chuan himself, had joined the alliance when he first joined.
In the Cang Alliance, there was only one person known as Tiger King. “Yes, Tiger King will likely not snub us.” Fu Sui turned his head.
Meng Chuan also sensed a figure condense in the distance.
It was a very thin figure. In terms of height, he was slightly taller than the short, fat Fu Sui, but he was much shorter than Meng Chuan and Old Fiend Black Wind. Furthermore, he was relatively thin. Among the four of them, he was the thinnest. The thin figure was dressed in a gray robe. The corners of his eyes were filled with bloodlust.
In the outer realm... one couldn’t judge a cultivator by their looks. This thin figure’s true strength was very terrifying because Heavenly Dream Realm’s special heritage was even stronger than Cave Lord Scenic Cloud’s. “Greetings, Brother Meng Hu,” said Meng Chuan and Black Wind politely because it was their first time meeting Tiger King.
“You can just address me as Tiger King.” The thin Meng Hu was very gallant. He sat on a chair that looked oversized for him. He sat cross-legged on the chair as he looked at Fu Sui and asked, “Lunatic Fu, why did you suddenly invite me over? You even said that you invited Old Fiend Black Wind and City Lord Eastcalm to discuss something important? Is there some ruin you want to explore?”
Fu Sui liked taking risks the most. He was famous in the Cang Alliance because of this, but he had never gained much from his ruin explorations. He had some small gains, but he had always been relatively poor because he had died too many times.
“Yes, a ruin.” Fu Sui’s eyes lit up as he swept his gaze across Tiger King, Meng Chuan, and Black Wind.
“I have the least interest in your little adventure.” Meng Hu curled his lips. “It would be a huge loss if I accidentally lose a true body.”
“If you take the risk and feel that you have suffered a loss, I’ll compensate you,” said Fu Sui.
Meng Chuan and Meng Hu were shocked when they heard that.
Compensation? Every true body that died meant a loss of thousands of cubes. Yet, Fu Sui dared to boldly declare that he would compensate them for their losses?
“I’ve already entered three times and died three times,” said Fu Sui solemnly. “Brother Black Wind has gone in with me once. He died once too.”
Meng Chuan became even more intrigued when he heard that. He entered three times in a row? Despite dying three times, he still wants to enter? He even promised to make up for any feeling of loss. He has clearly benefited from this ruin greatly. “I’ll also be entering this time,” said Black Wind as he looked at Meng Chuan and Tiger King. “You have piqued my interest.” Meng Hu narrowed his eyes.
As long as one wasn’t a fool, they could tell from Fu Sui and Black Wind’s actions that this ruin had great benefits in store.
“Brother Eastcalm, my promise to you is the same,” said Fu Sui. “If you enter and feel that it’s a loss, I’ll make it up to you. Of course, don’t bring more than 5,000 cubes of treasures with you. I can’t afford to pay any more than that.”
Meng Chuan looked at him. “You will compensate us? Is there such a good thing?”
“Of course. However, you have to promise me that the items left behind by Black Wind and me after our deaths will still belong to us,” said Fu Sui.
“Don’t worry.”
Meng Chuan and Meng Hu nodded. The two of them wouldn’t bother snatching the treasures that they would leave behind.
Meng Chuan was about to grasp a Sixth Tribulation law. He had an intrinsic sense of pride in him.
Fu Sui and Black Wind exchanged looks and nodded slightly. The treasures left behind after their deaths belonged to them. This was a very important clause. This was because... Old Fiend Black Wind had obtained quite a lot previously. He had lost it all in the ruins. Fu Sui had probed the ruins thrice, and the treasures he had collected were also there. Furthermore, they were confident that the duo wouldn’t feel like they had made a bad decision in joining the ruin exploration as long as the duo entered.
“This matter can’t be spread to anyone else. Only the four of us can know about it,” continued Fu Sui. “After you enter, we are not to harm each other. As for the gains, it will depend on our own abilities. Can the two of you agree to these conditions?” Meng Hu and Meng Chuan glanced at each other and nodded slightly.
Both parties felt that they could participate in this matter.
“Alright,” said Meng Hu.
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded as well. He was somewhat looking forward to this mysterious ruin.
Final Chapter of Volume-Eastcalm City

chapters.title: Chapter 591 - Heading to the Ruins
chapters.content:
Chapter 591 Heading to the Ruins
Thousand Mountain Star, ninth floor of Eternal Tower.
Meng Chuan stood there as a large number of treasures floated in front of him.
Having built an Eternal Tower branch on Thousand Mountain Star, it’s rather convenient for me to buy treasures. Meng Chuan smiled. He was the manager of the Eternal Tower branch, so he naturally wouldn’t leak the sales information. It was easy for him to launder any goods. Meng Chuan wasn’t confident that he could survive this trip to the mysterious ruin. After all, Fu Sui had died three times, and Black Wind had died once. Although he was much stronger than them, he could similarly die there.
Therefore, he couldn’t bear to bring any of the following: Demon Slayer-which he had nurtured for many years; Bloodblade Disc, which he had refined as an intrinsic artifact; his Essence Soul World’s World Treasure, and the Thirteen Universe Beads—which was very compatible and very precious to him. He didn’t want to lose any of them.
“Seventh Tribulation treasure, Chaos Hole types,” said Meng Chuan.
Whoosh.
The phantom images in front of him changed once, but there were still an uncountable number of them. As a Fifth Tribulation Eminence and Eternal Tower member, Meng Chuan could see nearly all the Seventh Tribulation treasure vaults in the River of Spacetime’s Eternal Towers. Over time, generations of cultivators left behind many treasures, naturally amounting to an enormous number of treasures.
For instance, even though there were only two to three Chaos Holes per river zone, the total number found across the River of Spacetime was still astonishing.
Most of Eternal Tower’s truly valuable items were sold on behalf of other factions. The other factions also had a demand for them. Eternal Tower was the largest trading network in the River of Spacetime.
Meng Chuan swept his gaze across the hundred cheapest items.
This is it. Meng Chuan locked onto one of the items. “Chaos Hole Bead.”
This Chaos Hole Bead was the size of a grape. Even the treasure phantom appeared dark and unfathomable.
A Seventh Tribulation treasure—Chaos Hole Bead-contains a complete Chaos Hole law. Meng Chuan nodded slightly. It costs 1,800 cubes.
A complete Chaos Hole law was one of the most terrifying laws in the River of Spacetime. It was a Seventh Tribulation law.
Legend had it that Chaos Hole laws were formed by combining the complete spatial laws and a portion of temporal laws. With this as a foundation, one could reach the Seventh Tribulation realm!
The Seventh Tribulation realm was a legend. Even among the strongest factions like Eternal Tower, the strongest experts were at the Seventh Tribulation realm. The Seventh Tribulation realm was considered at the top of the hierarchy. Even large clans-like the dragon clan-in the River of Spacetime didn’t have any Seventh Tribulation Eminences in the current era.
My Infinite Saber, Nirvana Saber, and Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique can be considered small branches of Chaos Hole laws. Meng Chuan understood this point.
All of the spatial laws were a subset of Chaos Hole laws. The Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique could be considered as one of them. Of course, these three small branches were still far from Chaos Hole laws. Meng Chuan’s current goal was only the Sixth Tribulation realm.
With my current insights, I can only unleash a portion of the Chaos Hole Bead’s strength when using it. However, it far exceeds a Sixth Tribulation treasure. It’s considered the greatest investment I’ve made for this trip to the ruin. Meng Chuan had bought the cheapest Seventh Tribulation treasure. Why did Seventh Tribulation treasures have such huge discrepancies in price?
Most of the more expensive ones were easier to understand. They were easier to control, allowing one to unleash greater strength. For example, the Thirteen Universe Beads sold for 5,000 cubes in Eternal Tower. The cheaper ones such as the Chaos Hole Bead were too esoteric. It was extremely difficult to comprehend them. They had higher requirements for one to control them. The strength they could unleash was also relatively lower. However, the advantage was that they were cheap!
The laws that Meng Chuan cultivated and comprehended made him very compatible with the Chaos Hole Bead. However, he could only utilize about 60% of the Thirteen Universe Beads’ power with the Chaos Hole Bead.
Sixth Tribulation array formation treasure, Myriad Dragon Array, and this Purple Thunder Saber. Meng Chuan quickly selected the items. He had read through Eternal Tower’s treasure catalog many times, so he remembered many treasures clearly.
He just needed to choose cheap and suitable ones. After all, he was prepared to suffer losses.
After staying in Eternal Tower for more than two hours, he purchased one Seventh Tribulation treasure, Chaos Hole Bead, and two Sixth Tribulation treasures—Myriad Dragon Array and Purple Thunder Saber.
If he bought a Seventh Tribulation treasure, he could have it teleported to him on the same day. It came with free teleportation services. If he only bought a Sixth Tribulation treasure, he needed to add an additional 100 cubes for same-day delivery. Meng Chuan estimated that the cost of only teleporting items was definitely low for Eternal Tower. It definitely cost less than 100 cubes.
After leaving three Essence Soul avatars to guard Thousand Mountain Star, Meng Chuan left Three Bay River System. He first met up with Black Wind before heading to the distant Six Desires River Zone.
Half a month later.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan and Old Fiend Black Wind flew to a barren planet. As they landed, the scenery changed. An elegant cave abode appeared in front of them.
Fu Sui—who was as fat as a ball—had already flown over to welcome them. He laughed loudly and said, “Black Wind, you spent more than a year traveling last time. This time, you’ve arrived here within a month. It looks like Brother Eastcalm helped.”
“Brother Eastcalm is astonishingly fast when traveling in the River of Spacetime.” Black Wind chuckled. “That’s why I got a free ride by having him bring me along.”
“You came quickly. Tiger King hasn’t arrived yet after setting off from Heavenly Dream Realm,” said Fu Sui. “Let’s wait a little longer.”
“No rush.” Meng Chuan and Black Wind nodded.
They had to travel a greater distance by coming from Goddess River Zone, yet they arrived first.
“This is one of my vacation residences for meditation. Sometimes, I will abandon all my subordinates and come here to meditate when I’m frustrated,” said Fu Sui with a smile. “Come, come. Although I’m a little poor, I’ve collected many rare items over my years of adventuring. Let me show them to you.” “I’ve seen them last time. There are many rare items.” Black Wind nodded. Meng Chuan was rather curious as he followed along to admire them.
There were only three Fifth Tribulation Eminences on this barren planet. When the fourth Fifth Tribulation Eminence, Meng Hu, arrived, all their companions were gathered for this expedition.
“Since everyone is here, let’s set off,” said Fu Sui. He led Meng Chuan, Black Wind, and Meng Hu out of the barren planet. They entered the River of Spacetime and flew for ten minutes before returning to the normal void.
Huh? Meng Chuan and Meng Hu stared in surprise. Their surroundings were pitch-black. They could only see some light in extremely distant places. It was the light of a distant river system.
“This is the land of darkness between river systems,” said Fu Sui with a smile. “One of the entrances to the ancient ruin is here. Can you sense the entrance?”
Meng Chuan tried to spread his illusory Essence Soul World. With his control over the Void Domain, he carefully sensed everything.
The tiger king also used his means to investigate carefully.
“This is the land of darkness. There’s nothing here.” The thin, gray-robed Meng Hu shook his head and said, “At least, I can’t discover it.”
“Neither can I.” Meng Chuan shook his head as well.
“Quickly open the entrance. Stop pretending to be all mysterious,” urged Black Wind. He had tried to probe the area previously when he came, but he couldn’t find it either.
Fu Sui laughed and began casting a mystic technique.
This was a mystic technique that opened the entrance.
Buzz
The surrounding dark void began to ripple. Meng Chuan felt the entire space tremble.
The distorted darkness affected up to a hundred million kilometers out. The distorted darkness instantly devoured Meng Chuan, Fu Sui, Black Wind, and Meng Hu.
Oh? Meng Chuan didn’t even have time to react before he felt himself sink into another spacetime zone.

chapters.title: Chapter 592 - Forbidden Creature
chapters.content:
Chapter 592 Forbidden Creature
After spacetime stabilized, Meng Chuan landed on the ground and looked around. With his eyesight, he could see that the land was half a million kilometers wide. It was pitch-black beyond the land’s edge. Meng Chuan was currently at the very edge.
That mountain. Meng Chuan looked into the distance. In the middle of the vast land stood a towering mountain. The mountain was more than 50,000 kilometers tall, and the mountainside was clustered by clouds.
The mountain was completely black.
As he stared from afar, Meng Chuan felt his heart palpitate and panic. It was as though he was a mortal who had raised his head to look at a 10,000-foot-tall monster. It was an instinctual fear.
This mountain is very strange. This ruin world isn’t ordinary either. Meng Chuan discovered this the moment he entered. This land originally had cave abode buildings, but they were now in ruins. Most of them had been reduced to gravel, leaving behind only a portion of their remains.
At the same time, the suppression of the world was terrifying. Even a Fifth Tribulation Eminence had to resist it with all their might.
Even a Fourth Tribulation Eminence will be crushed to death by such suppression. It looks like the threshold to enter this ruin world is the Fifth Tribulation realm. Only a Fifth Tribulation Eminence and stronger can survive here. Who created this ruin world and left behind such a powerful suppression?
For such a world to maintain such a strong suppression for a long time, the energy consumed is astonishing. The creator of this ruin world is a Seventh Tribulation Eminence at least.
“Brother Eastcalm,” said Fu Sui via voice transmission.
