Meng Chuan immediately rushed over. Due to the suppression, Meng Chuan’s speed was much lower.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
Meng Chuan, Meng Hu, and Black Wind gathered beside Fu Sui.
“I believe everyone has discovered how extraordinary this ruin is,” said Fu Sui with a smile. “I’ve already died three times here. I’ll give you a brief introduction. When I first came to this ruin world, I realized that this ruin was rather extraordinary. I also sensed that the mountain in the middle of the land was very strange. Therefore, I carefully explored the land and didn’t dare to barge into the black mountain,” explained Fu Sui. “I gained something during my exploration of the land, but I also encountered a forbidden creature.”
“A forbidden creature?” Meng Chuan and Meng Hu were alarmed.
They were all members of the Cang Alliance. They could exchange for some benefits by killing forbidden creatures, but they had yet to kill one. This was because there were too few forbidden creatures.
“There are many forbidden creatures in this ruin,” said Fu Sui solemnly.
“Many?” Meng Chuan asked in surprise, “How is that possible? It’s very difficult for forbidden creatures to be born. Is this a forbidden creature lair?”
“No.” Black Wind shook his head. “It doesn’t look like a lair. It’s more like a cage for forbidden creatures.”
Fu Sui also explained, “Although there are many forbidden creatures in this ruin world, the forbidden creatures here have gone crazy. They are no longer lucid. As for why they’ve gone insane, we aren’t too sure.”
“Not lucid?” Meng Chuan and Meng Hu fell into deep thought.
Ordinary forbidden creatures were comparable to Tribulation Eminences. They naturally had lucid thoughts and were very cunning. Yet, all the forbidden creatures here went crazy? “Furthermore, the closer one is to the black mountain in the middle, the more forbidden creatures there are. Therefore, I only managed to arrive at the black mountain when I joined forces with Black Wind.” Fu Sui pointed at the black mountain. “I’ve explored this land for hundreds of years, but I didn’t gain much. However, when I first climbed the mountain, I discovered... that the true treasure trove in this ruin world is that black mountain.”
“It’s that mountain.” Black Wind’s eyes burned fervently. “The two of us only explored the foot of the mountain in half a month, and we felt that we had gained a lot.”
“What’s so precious about it?” asked Meng Hu with a frown.
“You’ll know when we get there.” Fu Sui smiled slightly. “If we go, all of you will definitely be grateful to me. This time, we won’t waste anymore time on exploring this land. We will head straight for the mountain. Brother Eastcalm, you need to send an Essence Soul avatar to scout the surroundings. Brother Meng Hu, if a forbidden creature attacks, you have to destroy it as soon as possible. This is because the longer we delay, the chaos from the battle will attract even more crazy forbidden creatures.”
“How strong are the forbidden creatures?” asked Meng Hu.
“In the centuries I’ve been exploring the land, all the forbidden creatures I’ve seen are at the Fifth Tribulation realm. Any weaker, and they wouldn’t be able to survive in this ruin,” said Fu Sui with a smile. “As for the black mountain, I’m not sure. At the very least, the ones Black Wind and I encountered were at the Fifth Tribulation realm during the half-month we explored the foot of the mountain.”
Meng Chuan and Meng Hu nodded.
It was very difficult to produce a Sixth Tribulation Eminence among Tribulation Eminences. It was the same for forbidden creatures!
“Even if these forbidden creatures are at the Fifth Tribulation realm, they differ in strength. We can’t be careless,” said Fu Sui. “Furthermore, you know how powerful these forbidden creatures are. They are very unpredictable.”
Meng Chuan and Meng Hu nodded.
Unlike Tribulation Eminences—who relied on cultivation-forbidden creatures were born under special circumstances. They relied on eating to become stronger. They were born with all sorts of powers. Some were incomprehensible.
“Let’s set off,” said Fu Sui immediately. He and Black Wind yearned to step onto the mountain as soon as possible.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Meng Chuan released three Essence Soul avatars and split them up to scout the area ahead. The team quickly rushed towards the black mountain.
Whoosh.
With Meng Chuan leading the other three, the group traveled very quickly.
Meng Hu couldn’t help but sigh in amazement. “Brother Eastcalm sure is fast.”
“At this speed, we will probably reach the mountain in a month,” said Fu Sui. Although they weren’t too far away, the ruin world’s suppression was very strong. Meng Chuan could only travel 5,000 kilometers a day with them.
Half a month quickly passed as they traveled.
“That’s strange. We’ve been traveling for half a month and have covered more than 50,000 kilometers, but we haven’t encountered a single forbidden creature?” Fu Sui was surprised.
“I encountered a few, but they were all resolved by my Essence Soul avatars,” said Meng Chuan. “Resolved?”
“We didn’t sense any battles.” Fu Sui, Black Wind, and Meng Hu looked at Meng Chuan in shock.
“They were relatively weak, so they were killed very quickly.” Meng Chuan smiled slightly. “In order not to attract other forbidden creatures, I tried my best to control the void and suppress all commotion.”
“That’s because you are strong enough,” said Black Wind with a smile. “If one has difficulty killing a forbidden creature, one naturally won’t be able to suppress the commotion.”
Fu Sui nodded and said, “There are strong and weak forbidden creatures. The stronger ones are at the peak of the Fifth Tribulation realm. They will be very difficult to deal with.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “I haven’t encountered them yet. I’ll have to rely on Brother Meng Hu and everyone else if I encounter them.”
A strange beast, with nine tails and a human face, had bloodshot eyes. It was filled with madness and killing intent. Without any reason, it charged towards the black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan.
This beast had split into nine monsters. All of them had physical bodies and were at the Fifth Tribulation realm.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
Meng Chuan stood rooted to the ground as divine swords flew out. They instantly vanished the moment they flew out.
When they appeared again, they had already stabbed into the monsters’ bodies. In the blink of an eye, the nine monsters that had split up were impaled. A white stone bead inside one of the monsters’ bodies shattered.
Bam!
When the white bone bead shattered, the eight monsters immediately dissipated. Only the shattered monster’s true body was left in shock and horror. Following that, it slumped to the ground motionless, no longer breathing.
It’s relatively easy to deal with forbidden creatures below the Sixth Tribulation realm because their cores are in their bodies. Meng Chuan nodded slightly as the divine swords flew in front of him. With a wave of his hand, Meng Chuan stored the forbidden creature’s corpse away. Once a forbidden creature reached the Sixth Tribulation realm, its core would leave its body and hide somewhere else.
Even if its body was destroyed thousands of times, it could instantly recover as long as its core remained intact. Therefore, even a Sixth Tribulation Eminence would have a headache when facing a Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature.
As for Fifth Tribulation forbidden creatures? As long as one had overpowering strength, killing one was much easier.
The nine-tailed forbidden creature was considered powerful, but Meng Chuan was just too strong
Although I’m only using an ordinary weapon, it’s still very easy to kill these forbidden creatures. Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars used a Fifth Tribulation treasure. Before Meng Chuan came, he had specially bought a sword array. There were 18 swords in the array. Every Essence Soul avatar could carry a few of them when they were sent out. Meng Chuan didn’t care about how profound the sword array was. He only cared about how sharp these divine swords were.
As for profundity? Meng Chuan could use all the moves he had comprehended. In this state, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar had the most ordinary strength. Yet, they were much stronger than Meng Chuan’s true body back when he had only grasped two Fifth Tribulation laws.
If he used the Seventh Tribulation treasureChaos Hole Bead-he could increase his strength by several-fold.
After traveling for more than half a month, they were getting closer and closer to the mountain.
Fu Sui, Black Wind, and Meng Hu were astonished to discover that they hadn’t encountered any forbidden creatures on their way. Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars had clearly intercepted them.
“This trip is way too easy.” Fu Sui and Black Wind secretly conversed.
Black Wind sent a voice transmission. “Are we lucky, or is Brother Eastcalm just that strong?”
“Perhaps we are lucky. Brother Eastcalm only sent out Essence Soul avatars. The treasures carried by his Essence Soul avatars must be very ordinary. How much strength can he unleash?” Fu Sui sent a voice transmission.
Suddenly, Meng Chuan’s expression changed slightly as he solemnly said, “There’s a forbidden creature. My Essence Soul avatar can’t block it. Everyone, be careful.”
“Is one finally here?”Meng Hu’s eyes lit up. He had come to this ruin as the team’s main combat strength, but he had been idle up to now. “Brother Eastcalm, the days have been rough on you. Leave this forbidden creature to me,” said Meng Hu with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 593 - Void
chapters.content:
Chapter 593 Void
“My Essence Soul avatar can’t defeat it, but I’m quite good at escaping.” To his three companions, Meng Chuan suggested, “As long as everyone hides in my grotto-heaven treasure, I can escape the forbidden creature if I escape with all my might.”
His Essence Soul avatar was forced to flee.
“Haha, there’s no need for that.” Meng Hu was filled with fighting spirit. He smiled and said, “I haven’t fought any forbidden creatures since I came to this ruin world.”
Fu Sui was rather confident. “Brother Eastcalm, let’s see what we can do.”
Black Wind said, “Brother Eastcalm, tell me what means are available to that forbidden creature.”
“Its body is very strange. None of my moves can injure it,” said Meng Chuan with a frown. “It’s as though it’s an illusion-a phantom that you can only see. Any attack will pass through it without posing any threat to it.” “Oh?”
“It can’t be injured?”
Fu Sui guessed, “Is it hiding in the depths of the void? Or is it hiding in the spatial layer gaps that are beyond the true void? Maybe the one in front of you wasn’t its true body?”
To Fifth Tribulation Eminences, there were many methods to have illusory bodies.
“I couldn’t figure it out.” Meng Chuan shook his head gently. As he was getting closer and closer to grasping a Sixth Tribulation law, Meng Chuan was very confident of himself. However, the forbidden creature puzzled Meng Chuan.
“Many forbidden creatures are very strange. They represent a strange phenomenon in the River of Spacetime,” said Meng Hu with a smile. “However, they rely on their innate techniques. Us cultivators are the ones who truly grasp the essence of strength. At the same level, they aren’t our match.”
As they spoke, a blurry figure flew over from afar.
“It’s here.” Meng Chuan looked into the distance.
Meng Hu and company also looked over.
It was a humanoid creature with purple skin and gray-green robes. Its eyes were cold.
The ruin world’s suppression was very strong. Although this forbidden creature traveled quickly, it was slower than Meng Chuan.
“Let’s see what you’re made of.” Meng Hu was rather confident. Following that, he let out a low grunt as two invisible waves spewed out from his nostrils. The moment the two waves appeared, they arrived in front of the forbidden creature.
The green-robed, purple-skinned figure didn’t sense anything as it continued flying and collided with the two waves.
Meng Hu was astonished. “It really does seem illusory. I can’t touch its body at all.” “Let me try,” said Black Wind as he punched out.
Boom!
A black fist shadow distorted the void and struck the forbidden creature.
Back when Black Wind explored this ruin, he had lost a true body. However, his realm had greatly improved. He now had the confidence to suppress Palace Lord Snowjade. However, the ferocious black fist projection didn’t injure the forbidden creature at all. All it did was pass through it.
“I didn’t touch it at all. It’s as though I hit the air.” Black Wind was somewhat astonished.
“Leave it to me.” Meng Hu turned solemn. A diamond-shaped crystal appeared at his glabella. Countless mystic runes surfaced on the crystal, causing his strength to increase greatly.
Black Wind and Fu Sui watched this scene with anticipation.
Meng Chuan watched curiously. Is this Heavenly Dream Divine General’s strength?
Every high-level world had a very rich heritage. Cultivation systems, special legacies, rare treasures, reincarnations... In many aspects, they stood high and mighty above most cultivators.
The Heavenly Dream Realm also had special legacies. Heavenly Dream Divine General was one of them.
It was said that Meng Hu had grasped two Fifth Tribulation laws. Due to his talent and cultivation path, he had luckily passed the Heavenly Dream Divine General test and became one. Although his cultivation realm was still low and could only unleash a portion of Heavenly Dream Divine General’s strength, his strength was enough to stand at the peak of the Fifth Tribulation realm.
Even Meng Chuan was barely on par with Meng Hu. Break! The thin Meng Hu stood rooted to the ground. He gathered his strength with his left hand and punched out with his right.
Boom!
The void in the ruin world trembled. The forbidden creature charged over without even bothering to dodge. However, when the punch landed on its body
“Oh?” The green-robed, purple-skinned forbidden creature revealed a look of pain. Its body distorted in the void and froze for a moment. However, it quickly recovered. The ferocity in its eyes intensified as it pounced towards Meng Hu, who posed the greatest threat.
It didn’t die? Meng Hu was surprised that his punch didn’t kill his opponent.
Meng Chuan was somewhat enlightened as he watched from the side. The primary focus of Meng Hu’s punch is the void lineage, but its strength is unimaginable. The super-powerful force affected this forbidden creature’s body structure. It can be said to have broken the laws with raw strength.
Energy could affect spacetime. When one’s strength reached a certain level, they would break the laws with raw strength.
However, the forbidden creature’s injuries aren’t serious enough. It will quickly recover. Meng Chuan knew that things were going south.
Boom! Boom!
Meng Hu and the forbidden creature had their eyes on each other. Meng Hu took the initiative to meet it in midair as they engaged in battle.
Rip!
The green-robed, purple-skinned forbidden creature arrived in front of Meng Hu. With a swipe of its claws, a wound appeared on Meng Hu’s chest. Just as blood flowed out, the wound rapidly healed.
“Die.” Meng Hu went mad as well. The crystal at his glabella swirled with a terrifying might. He pummeled the forbidden creature, causing it to distort in pain, but it quickly recovered. Meng Hu looked somewhat miserable. Although the wounds on his body healed rapidly, he had dozens of wounds on his body in the blink of an eye.
“Let’s attack together,” Fu Sui said solemnly. Since Meng Hu couldn’t kill the forbidden creature with his full strength, the only thing they could do was attack together.
Black Wind’s moves were violent and unpredictable.
Fu Sui also used his saber art. His saber art couldn’t be seen with the naked eye. Saber beams landed on the forbidden creature. “Go.” Meng Chuan cast the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell, and a Magic Awl instantly struck the forbidden creature’s body.
Although it shattered, it still made the forbidden creature cry painfully. “Ah!”
Although Meng Hu’s head-on attack could injure the forbidden creature with brute force, the injuries could only be considered superficial wounds.
Meng Chuan’s Magic Awl caused 100 times more pain to the forbidden creature as it drilled deep into its mind.
After the Magic Awl shattered, Meng Chuan condensed another Magic Awl. One after another, they blasted into the forbidden creature’s body. “Ah!” The forbidden creature screamed shrilly. It abandoned Meng Hu and attempted to kill Meng Chuan.
“Don’t think of leaving.” Meng Hu was indeed powerful in close combat. He attacked the forbidden creature with his moves, trying to slow it down.
Meng Chuan also used his movement technique to pull Fu Sui and Black Wind away from the forbidden creature.
“Ah!” In the ruin world, a crazy forbidden creature would only act according to its instincts and devour other lifeforms! Meng Chuan’s Magic Awl had caused it immense pain, yet it couldn’t kill Meng Chuan and company, so it immediately fled into the distance as it cried out in pain.
Meng Hu didn’t continue pestering it and allowed it to escape.
Phew. Meng Hu heaved a sigh of relief and dispelled the crystal between his eyebrows. “I only managed to injure this forbidden creature when using all my strength. It’s impossible to kill it.”
“At the very least, you could injure it. We couldn’t even touch it,” said Fu Sui with a smile. “Brother Eastcalm’s Essence Soul weapon is quite powerful. The forbidden creature couldn’t take it and fled.”
“It only suffered some pain.” Meng Chuan sighed. “If it was clear-headed and rational, it would’ve been much harder to deal with. It wouldn’t have left so easily either.”
Meng Hu and company agreed.
With rationality and lucidity, the forbidden creature would pose a much greater threat.
“Let’s continue our journey. Don’t stay here for too long. The battle might have attracted other forbidden creatures,” said Fu Sui.
“Let’s go.”
The subsequent journey was smooth. Before arriving at the black mountain, they didn’t encounter any new forbidden creatures. This was because Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars intercepted them.
“We’re here.” The four of them arrived at the foot of the black mountain.
“The two of you can try stepping on this mountain.” Fu Sui pointed at his feet. They were still standing on land. A few dozen feet away was a black rock. It was within the range of the black mountain and the land-a very clear boundary. Meng Chuan and Meng Hu exchanged looks. They took a few steps forward and stepped onto the black rock.
The moment they stepped on it, Meng Chuan heard the sound of mountains and rivers in the mountain. He heard the howling wind in the mountain forest and the sound of leaves falling. There were various floral fragrances, aromas, and sounds.
Meng Chuan felt extremely comfortable. His Essence Soul became ethereal. At that moment, his train of thought became much faster.
This... This? Meng Chuan found it unbelievable. My Essence Soul is even more ethereal now. My mind has become faster. I can sense the laws around me. My inspiration is surging. It’s like I ate a rare spirit fruit that can assist my cultivation.
For some rare treasures, eating one was nearly equivalent to experiencing an epiphany.
Although it wasn’t exactly an epiphany, it was very potent.
I’ll probably be able to comprehend a Sixth Tribulation law in a month or two simply by standing here. Meng Chuan understood this point. He was already very close to mastering a Sixth Tribulation law. If he were in the outside world, he would be able to grasp the law in a few decades or even a century. However, he realized how beneficial just stepping into the black mountain was to his cultivation. The time he needed to comprehend a Sixth Tribulation law had naturally been shortened drastically.

chapters.title: Chapter 594 - Ascending the Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 594 Ascending the Mountain
“This is a cultivation Holy Land.” Meng Hu, who had stepped onto the black rock, was somewhat shocked.
“Yes.” Fu Sui and Black Wind had also stepped past the mountains’ boundary.
Fu Sui smiled and said, “This mountain is a cultivation Holy Land. Furthermore, the deeper we go, the greater the benefits to our cultivation.” Meng Chuan was shocked. “The benefits can be even greater?”
“Fu Sui and I have been here once. It’s naturally true,” said Black Wind with a smile. This mountain is really special. Meng Chuan sighed even more. There are all kinds of wonders in the outer realm. Ancestral Master Archean Eon said that there are no benefits without reason. This mountain definitely has a reason for its uniqueness. Meng Chuan felt fear when he looked at the distant black mountain. He was naturally wary of it.
This mountain is somewhat strange. Meng Hu sensed his current state as his inspiration surged. He then looked at Fu Sui, Black Wind, and Meng Chuan. He thought to himself, Everything in the River of Spacetime follows a natural cycle. Only by consuming spirit fruits and treasures can one gain the effects of an epiphany for a few hours. In this black mountain, a Fifth Tribulation Eminence is in a constant state of near-epiphany. Perhaps, we have already paid the price unknowingly? Or perhaps, this mountain is baiting us?
Meng Hu was very cautious. His homeworld was the Heavenly Dream Realm, a high-leveled world. The ancestor produced by his homeworld was an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. Having passed the test and become a Heavenly Dream Divine General. His status in the Heavenly Dream Realm was considered very high. He had read many secret records.
Some places in the outer realm were even more magical than the ruin they were in.
To easily induce a constant state of near-epiphany for a large number of Fifth Tribulation Eminences without paying any price? It was impossible!
There had to be a price! Either the price came from themselves, or the mountain’s creator had paid the price.
If the creator of the mountain had paid the price, they would definitely have a motive.
“The optimal situation is that the creator of this mountain created this cultivation Holy Land for juniors. After the creator died, the mountain was still barely maintained. We got lucky by coming here.” Meng Hu quickly rejected this hypothesis. “However, the possibility is too low. Furthermore, I can sense how strange this black mountain is from afar. There are many forbidden creatures in the ruin world. The forbidden creatures are also all crazy...”
Forbidden creatures could devour all life. They were the common enemy of all life. However, such evil and sinful creatures had all gone crazy?
“This definitely isn’t a safe cultivation Holy Land. There must be a reason for the strange black mountain.” Meng Hu was extremely cautious.
Meng Hu was the most cautious of the four people present. Meng Chuan was equally cautious. On the contrary, Fu Sui and Old Fiend Black Wind, who had both stepped onto the black mountain for the second time, became even more zealous because of the benefits they obtained.
“Everyone, it’s best you be careful,” said Meng Hu. “This black mountain has given us great benefits. Perhaps there will be a huge calamity.”
“Haha, opportunity and risk come in pairs,” said Fu Sui with a smile. “Adventuring in ruins requires one to experience all sorts of dangers and grasp the opportunities within. This black mountain is the greatest opportunity I’ve encountered in all these years. At most, this true body will die in battle. I can’t give up on this opportunity.” “Sometimes, the price one has to pay isn’t just one true body,” said Meng Hu faintly.
Fu Sui and Black Wind’s hearts stirred.
“Brother Meng Hu, did you manage to detect something?” asked Black Wind.
“I don’t know.” Meng Hu shook his head gently. “I only know that the greater the benefits that come knocking, the more careful you should be.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “We have to be careful.”
“Yes, we also understand. Should we head to the place where Black Wind and I died in battle next?” said Fu Sui.
“Alright.” Meng Chuan and Meng Hu nodded. After all, Fu Sui and Black Wind had to retrieve their lost treasures first. Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The four of them quickly moved. Meng Chuan sent three Essence Soul avatars to continue scouting the area. “Be careful. There are more forbidden creatures on this black mountain,” reminded Fu Sui. “Black Wind and I died at the hands of a forbidden creature.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan and Meng Hu nodded. After experiencing the attacks of forbidden creatures on land, they didn’t dare underestimate them.
As they traveled
“Why didn’t we encounter any forbidden creatures?” Fu Sui looked at Meng Chuan. “Did Brother Eastcalm’s Essence Soul avatars intercept them ahead of time?”
Meng Chuan shook his head. “No. My three Essence Soul avatars haven’t discovered any forbidden creatures.”
Fu Sui frowned slightly and became more cautious. “It’s strange. There are many more forbidden creatures on the black mountain. We should have encountered five or six forbidden creatures having traveled so far.”
The journey was very strange.
After entering the black mountain range, Meng Chuan and company didn’t encounter any forbidden creatures, even when they reached Fu Sui and Black Wind’s remains.
“How strange.”
“Not a single forbidden creature.”
“My Essence Soul avatars didn’t bump into anything either.” Fu Sui and Black Wind picked up the treasures they left behind, but they remained puzzled.
It wasn’t strange that they could retrieve their treasures. The forbidden creatures in the ruin world had gone mad. They only knew how to kill, so they didn’t deliberately horde cultivators’ treasures. Fu Sui had died three times in this ruin before, and he always collected his treasures afterward.
After finding the treasures, Meng Chuan and company carefully ventured deeper into the mountain.
Huh? Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar saw some weapons and items scattered in the mountain forest. Immediately, his Essence Soul World enveloped the area, and the weapons and treasures flew up.
These should have been left behind by other cultivators after they died. Meng Chuan put away the items and carefully inspected them. He flipped his hand and took out a void bracelet. This void bracelet’s mysterious patterns are incomplete. The void inside it has completely shattered. The void bracelet must be very, very old.
The damage to the void bracelet was due to natural wear and tear caused by extended periods of time going by.
In the outer realm, very few things could exist for eternity. For example, Primordial Stones were eternal existences.
As for the vast majority of items, they would slowly be damaged over time. For example, spirit fruits, wine, and so on had shorter expiry dates. If a Tribulation treasure was preserved well, it could be preserved for a longer period of time. However, without cultivators nurturing it, even a Seventh Tribulation treasure would eventually decay. Some of the items have decayed and become damaged. Some are still intact. Meng Chuan inspected them. They are worth about 8,000 cubes. They should be left behind by a Fifth Tribulation Eminence.
This black mountain has a long history. Many cultivators have come here before. However, I haven’t found any historical records of this place in the outside world. Meng Chuan was puzzled. Huh? Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar suddenly felt its heart tighten. This was because a three-headed humanoid creature had flown past from afar. The three-headed humanoid creature had also discovered Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar. It only gave Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar a glance before flying into the distance.
What? It didn’t attack me despite seeing me? Meng Chuan was shocked.
“What did you say? Your Essence Soul avatar and a forbidden creature discovered each other, but that forbidden creature didn’t attack you. It left instead?” Fu Sui and Black Wind found it unbelievable.
Meng Chuan nodded. “Yes.”
“Impossible. I’ve investigated this ruin world three times. All the forbidden creatures have gone crazy. They have no rationality.” Fu Sui shook his head. “Once they discover us, they will immediately attack.” “Back when we entered the black mountain, we were pursued by many forbidden creatures. This time, no forbidden creatures came to pursue us,” said Black Wind. “Could it be that something has changed in this black mountain?”
Although Meng Chuan, Fu Sui, Black Wind, and Meng Hu were puzzled, they could only be careful. They wouldn’t give up easily. The deeper they went, the greater the benefits to their cultivation. They could not stop.
The four of them advanced.
Along the way, an enormous head flew past them. It could clearly see Meng Chuan and company, but it continued flying into the distance.
“The forbidden creature my Essence Soul avatar discovered and that forbidden creature are heading in the same direction,” said Meng Chuan.
Fu Sui’s eyes lit up. “Let’s chase after it and take a look.”
Immediately, the four of them silently tailed the giant head.
The head was about 1,000 feet wide. It was completely carved out of gray rock. The head constantly flew in a certain direction. Meng Chuan and company followed silently as they headed deeper into the mountain.
The mountains were vast.
Along the way, Meng Chuan and company discovered over ten forbidden creatures. Some were fast, while others were slow. However, they all flew in the same direction.
“They are all heading in the same direction.”
“There must be a reason why so many forbidden creatures have appeared in this ruin world.” Meng Chuan and company became even more cautious and expectant. The greater the secret, the greater the possibility of reaping great benefits.
On the third day after entering the black mountain, they arrived at the depths of the mountain.
At that moment, Meng Chuan had already picked up seven treasures using his three scouting Essence Soul avatars. They had a total value of about 30,000 cubes. They were probably left behind by Fifth Tribulation Eminences.
Huh?
Meng Chuan and company followed the head-like forbidden creature and finally arrived at the tallest mountain peak on the black mountain. The black mountain was over 50,000 kilometers tall. It spanned more than 50,000 kilometers. There were many mountain peaks on the mountain, but the most eye-catching one was the tallest peak in the middle.
Three roads paved with crystal jade appeared at the tallest mountain peak’s entrance. They extended deep into the mountain.
“Three paths?” Meng Chuan and company stopped.
The head-like forbidden creature didn’t fly towards the three paths. Instead, it flew towards the highest mountain peak that was closest to it in a daze.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Meng Chuan and company stared into the distance. The highest peak was extremely majestic. They could see forbidden creatures flying up in a daze, but none of them took the three paths. “What should we do next?” asked Fu Sui. “Should we follow the three paths, or should we go up the mountain like the forbidden creatures without touching the three paths?”

chapters.title: Chapter 595 - Decision
chapters.content:
Chapter 595 Decision
Meng Chuan approached the mountain and watched the forbidden creatures fly up in a daze. He instinctively felt that it would be very dangerous to barge up the mountain. Thus, he said, “Since the creator of Black Mountain created three paths, he must have a motive. The paths are built for cultivators to walk. If we violate the creator’s intentions, we might suffer a disastrous fate when we forcefully ascend the mountain.”
Old Fiend Black Wind observed and nodded. “I agree with Brother Eastcalm. If we don’t ascend the mountain along the built paths and choose to fly up the mountain by force, it will anger the creator of the black mountain. All those sinful creatures have gone mad. Perhaps, madness will be our result if we forcefully fly up the mountain.”
Fu Sui looked at Meng Chuan. “Brother Eastcalm, why don’t you try using your Essence Soul avatar?”.
Meng Chuan frowned and looked at Fu Sui. “Fu Sui, I might end up as a lunatic if I forcefully ascend the mountain. These forbidden creatures are in no way inferior to Tribulation Eminences, but all of them have gone mad. If I forcefully fly up, all my avatars might go crazy. It’s not wise for me to give it a try, right?”
Although he was in charge of reconnaissance and vigilance, it didn’t mean that he would send himself to his death.
If all his bodies went crazy, it would be equivalent to death. After all, he wouldn’t even have a conscious mind. Meng Chuan instinctively realized the danger of forcefully ascending the mountain, so he naturally wouldn’t do it.
It would just be stupid to do such a thing despite knowing that it was very dangerous.
“All your avatars will go crazy? That’s unlikely. You have your true body in your homeworld. It definitely won’t affect your true body in your homeworld,” said Fu Sui with a smile. “Without an Eighth Tribulation Eminence appearing, they won’t be able to threaten your homeworld’s true body.”
“It’s a huge loss for me if it were to affect this true body of mine.” Meng Chuan shook his head. His evaluation of Fu Sui had worsened greatly. He continued, “Besides, it’s still unknown who the creator of this black mountain is. He might be an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, or even an Eternal existence!”
“It’s fine if you aren’t willing. You are too cautious,” said Fu Sui with a smile. “If it weren’t because my Essence Soul avatar is unable to withstand the pressure from this ruin world, I would have long attempted it.”
Meng Chuan didn’t argue further.
Perhaps Fu Sui felt that he could give it a try, but Meng Chuan didn’t want to. He just needed to stay safe because it wouldn’t take long before he had a chance of reaching the Sixth Tribulation realm!
When he reached the Sixth Tribulation realm, even an Eighth Tribulation Eminence wouldn’t be able to pose a threat to him in the River of Spacetime. It was one thing for him to be bold during expeditions, but now? He had to be careful! These forbidden creatures were all at the Fifth Tribulation realm, and didn’t they all become crazy? “It’s up to Brother Eastcalm,” said Black Wind. “Since Brother Eastcalm isn’t willing to send an Essence Soul avatar up the mountain and our Essence Soul avatars are too weak... It looks like we can only give the three paths a try.”
Meng Hu nodded. “These three paths shouldn’t reach a dead end.”
“We can give it a try,” said Fu Sui as he walked toward the leftmost path.
After stepping onto the leftmost path, Fu Sui stopped moving. He stood there and carefully sensed his surroundings. His face was filled with obsession. He took a few seconds to regain himself before he took a step back and left the path.
“It’s unbelievable.” Fu Sui pointed to the leftmost path. “Just stepping on this path will result in a constant state of epiphany. It’s much better for cultivation than when we just entered the mountain.”
“Epiphany?” Meng Chuan, Meng Hu, and Black Wind were alarmed.
When they entered the mountain, it greatly benefited their cultivation. Back then, Meng Chuan believed that he would probably be able to comprehend a Sixth Tribulation law within a month or two. Now, the leftmost path was even more helpful to one’s cultivation?
“I’ll give it a try.” Meng Hu immediately took a step forward. He also immersed himself in the feeling. He even took a few steps forward before retreating after a while. He nodded and said, “It is indeed the case. One will be in a constant state of epiphany once they step onto the path, but it only lasts for a few seconds. One has to continue advancing along the path. As long as one advances slowly, they will be able to maintain the state of epiphany. I believe that, on the leftmost path... I have a chance of mastering a third Fifth Tribulation law. I even have a chance of fusing three laws and comprehending a Sixth Tribulation law.”
Black Wind also walked up and retreated after experiencing the situation.
Meng Chuan wasn’t in a hurry. After all, he was close to grasping a Sixth Tribulation law. He was the last to step forward.
The smooth path was paved with crystal jade. As he walked on it, he felt a warmth spread from his feet to his entire body. His body felt very warm and comfortable. His Essence Soul entered a state of epiphany as large amounts of inspiration constantly surged through his mind. The various insights in Meng Chuan’s mind were constantly integrated. A vast and complete embryonic set of laws were constantly perfected in his mind.
In just a few seconds, the warmth beneath his feet receded, and his Essence Soul returned to normal. Meng Chuan took another step forward, and his Essence Soul entered a state of epiphany again.
After taking two steps, Meng Chuan retreated. Meng Chuan was also shocked. I’ll probably be able to comprehend a Sixth Tribulation law if I spent two hours on this path.
It might take a century elsewhere and one to two months on the mountain, but this path would allow him to comprehend a Sixth Tribulation Law in about two hours.
Constant state of epiphany?
Although Meng Chuan and company were excited, they were very cautious. “The greater the benefits, the greater the price,” said Meng Hu. “Since the opportunity is here, we should take the risk,” said Fu Sui.
“Let’s try the second path,” said Black Wind with a smile.
The second path was also the middle path.
Meng Chuan quickly stepped onto it. The moment he did so, his consciousness rumbled.
What happened? Meng Chuan was astonished.
He transformed into a towering flaming giant, about five million kilometers tall. It was currently sleeping on a Grand Yang Star.
Although Meng Chuan became a fire giant, he couldn’t control the body at all. When the giant woke up and stretched, it stirred the Grand Yang Star’s endless flames.
Oh? Meng Chuan couldn’t control the body at all. However, he could clearly sense every part of the giant’s body. The giant stretched its back, and it even subconsciously controlled the flames. Meng Chuan could sense the profundity of the flames. This giant was a Sixth Tribulation Eminence. The giant’s every action was devastating. Meng Chuan could see some of the fire laws on the giant’s body.
In just a few seconds, Meng Chuan’s consciousness returned to his normal body. He stood on the second path and took another step.
When he took the second step, his consciousness rumbled again and possessed another living being. This time it was a silver-armored, golden-horned alien. It was fighting another mighty figure in the void.
Boom!
The void collapsed.
The silver-armored, golden-horned alien walked through the shattered void, using the void as a weapon as it attacked its opponent.
It’s another Sixth Tribulation Eminence. Its attainments in the void are much higher than mine. Meng Chuan gained something from this scene. In just a few seconds, his consciousness returned to his body.
“With every step on the second path, one’s consciousness seems to possess an Eminence’s body,” exclaimed Meng Hu. “I took nine steps on it. I possessed a Sixth Tribulation Eminence with every step I took. I possessed one Sixth Tribulation Eminence twice. This second path spans about 50,000 kilometers. If I were to reach the mountain peak, how many mighty figures would I have possessed?”
“It’s fascinating.”
Meng Chuan, Fu Sui, and Black Wind were astonished. They could constantly possess Sixth Tribulation Eminences.
The third path... Meng Chuan and company also began to try out the rightmost path.
Huh? The moment Meng Chuan stepped on it, he heard a cacophony. He couldn’t hear the complete sentence, nor could he understand what it meant. However, he felt an invisible pressure suppress his Essence Soul and mind when he heard the voice.
“This third path?” Meng Chuan stood there for a moment as he heard intermittent sounds. The sound seemed to come from the top of the mountain as it constantly suppressed his mind.
Meng Chuan took another step forward, and the intermittent sounds seemed to become clearer. The pressure on his mind and consciousness also increased.
Meng Chuan took nine steps. The voice was still intermittent, but each of the nine steps he took increased the mental pressure.
“We’ve finished probing all of them.” Fu Sui looked at his three companions. “There are three paths. The left path induces a state of constant epiphany. The path in the middle allows one to possess an Eminence that is at the Sixth Tribulation realm at least. The right path allows one to listen to sounds that exert immense pressure on one’s mind and consciousness. From the looks of it, we have to make our own choices.”
Black Wind, Meng Hu, and Meng Chuan nodded. “Yes.”
“It looks like we’ll be separated from each other here,” said Meng Hu.
“The first path induces a constant state of epiphany. This is my greatest hope of reaching the Sixth Tribulation realm. I’ll definitely choose the first path if I’m seeking opportunities amidst risk.” Fu Sui made a decisive decision.
It was very good to possess Eminences, but one could only experience it since it was cast by other Eminences.
As for epiphanies? Whatever he comprehended was his own. In terms of help, the first path was much better than the second.
“The benefits of constant epiphany are too great. However, the price may be great. I don’t dare to choose it,” said Meng Hu. “I’ll choose the second path.”
“I’ll choose the second path as well.” Black Wind nodded. Although he was ambitious, he felt that taking the same path as Meng Hu, who came from a high-level world, wouldn’t be a bad choice. Black Wind knew very well. “Tiger King, who’s a Heavenly Dream Divine General, is over 100 times more knowledgeable than me. His choice might be the best.”
“Brother Eastcalm, which path do you plan on choosing?” asked Black Wind with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 596 - EaChapter Taking Their Own Path
chapters.content:
Chapter 596 Each Taking Their Own Path
Meng Chuan declared his decision. “The third
path.”
“Third?” Fu Sui, Meng Hu, and Black Wind were somewhat astonished.
Fu Sui couldn’t help but persuade him. “Brother Eastcalm, the third path has a huge impact on one’s mind and consciousness. You won’t be able to cultivate in peace once you set foot on that path. I think it’s better if you don’t choose it. You can cultivate on the mountain. This cultivation environment is quite beneficial to our cultivation.”
“Staying in the mountain is also dangerous,” said Meng Hu. “It’s impossible for you to gain benefits for long. Therefore, you still have to choose a path.”
Fu Sui shook his head. “That doesn’t mean he should choose the third path.”
Black Wind nodded and said, “Brother Eastcalm, the first two paths have all sorts of benefits. Perhaps we may have to pay a corresponding price, but at the very least... We will benefit. As for the third path, it suppresses one’s mind and consciousness. The further you go, the stronger the suppression. It looks like a test. Passing the test may bring great benefits. However, we are ultimately only at the Fifth Tribulation realm. It’s very likely that we won’t pass the test and end up not obtaining any benefits.”
“Brother Black Wind, what you said makes sense.” Meng Chuan nodded. “This path has a huge impact on one’s mind and consciousness. It’s indeed possible that I won’t pass the test and fail to walk to the end, but I still wish to take the third path.”
Test? Benefits?
Meng Chuan didn’t mind. The third path’s influence on the mind was a rare occasion for Meng Chuan to cultivate his mind and willpower.
At his realm, it was too difficult to stir his mind and will. He was excited simply by discovering the uniqueness of the third path.
This was because he wasn’t far from comprehending a Sixth Tribulation law. Even if he cultivated in an ordinary cultivation environment in the outer realm, he would definitely be able to grasp one within 100 years. What he worried about the most were his mind and willpower. Could his Essence Soul World withstand the Sixth Tribulation law? Could it transcend the sixth Heavenly Tribulation?
The stronger one’s willpower was, the better it would be for him when it came to the Essence Soul Tribulation realm!
“Since you’ve made a decision, we won’t try to persuade you otherwise.” Fu Sui nodded. “We chose the paths ourselves, so the results have to be borne by yourself.”
“Brother Eastcalm.” Meng Hu looked at Meng Chuan. “The path you chose is bound to be filled with suffering. Perhaps it will have the best benefits if you reach the end. However, there’s a high chance that you won’t.” As he spoke, Meng Hu was the first to walk towards the second path. “Brother Eastcalm, good luck.” Black Wind walked towards the second path as well.
“Haha... Perhaps the one who gains the most in the end is Brother Eastcalm.” Fu Sui laughed loudly as he walked towards the first path.
“Good luck, everyone.” Meng Chuan smiled and walked towards the third path.
The four Fifth Tribulation Eminences that came to the ruin world made their choices.
This path. Meng Chuan stepped onto the third path. Crystal jade paved his feet as he listened to the sounds.
The sounds couldn’t be blocked. Although they were intermittent, they still transmitted into his Essence Soul and echoed in his Essence Soul World.
He couldn’t hear a single word clearly. It was vague, but it caused Meng Chuan’s mind and consciousness to suffer immense pressure. Continue walking.
After all, Meng Chuan was at the Essence Soul Fifth Tribulation realm. He didn’t know how high his mental cultivation was. At the very least, he could easily withstand the pressure in the third path’s early parts.
After standing there for 30 seconds, Meng Chuan took another step.
Although he could easily withstand the pressure, Meng Chuan had to stop for 30 seconds after taking every step. He carefully sensed the differences between the different sounds and the effects on his mind and consciousness.
One step every 30 seconds was extremely slow, but Meng Chuan was very patient. He even had some occasional gains. As a result, he would stay at the same spot for longer. “Hum... ha... Yu...” Although the voice was vague, Meng Chuan discovered some patterns. Each syllable of these sounds had different effects on his mind and consciousness. The cacophony of sounds was like countless sledgehammers slamming into his Essence Soul from different angles. Even the sledgehammers could be combined into one. However, Meng Chuan was still at the beginning of the path. Thus, he couldn’t hear much.
On the first day, Meng Chuan walked half a kilometer on the path. He piously continued, cherishing this place that honed his mind and willpower.
Meng Hu and Black Wind had traveled the second path for a day.
They repeatedly possessed different Sixth Tribulation Eminences. They could sense the various mysteries these Sixth Tribulation Eminences exhibited through their battles, cultivation, or strolls.
I’ve gained a lot, but... Meng Hu frowned slightly. My consciousness has been possessing bodies over and over again. I’ve tried to figure out the different Sixth Tribulation Eminences’ means. I’ve gained too much insight that it is confusing me.
He possessed many Sixth Tribulation Eminences. All of them grasped laws that were above Meng Hu.
In the beginning, Meng Hu was very excited and agitated. He felt as though a door had opened in front of him. He could clearly sense how a Sixth Tribulation Eminence executed their moves. Even though he had experienced only a portion of the moves, he could see the path ahead. However, he had seen too many possible paths!
On the first day, he had already seen the paths of hundreds of Sixth Tribulation Eminences despite taking the occasional break.
Some paths were completely different!
Many paths are at odds with others, causing me to hesitate. What is right? What is wrong? Which path should I take? Having traveled far on this path, I know the danger of it. If I don’t have enough determination, I’ll be completely lost. Meng Hu understood this point. He stood in the same spot and pondered for a moment. His eyes became determined.
How could he stop when the opportunity was right in front of him?
I’ll follow the Heavenly Dream Divine General’s path. I’ll study the paths that are suitable for me. If they aren’t suitable, I’ll directly delete that portion of memories from my head. Meng Hu gritted his teeth and continued walking.
About 100 feet behind Meng Hu, Black Wind had also discovered the problem with this path.
What should I do? If I study every Sixth Tribulation Eminence, I’ll definitely be lost in less than a month. Black Wind looked at Meng Hu. I can’t compare to Meng Hu. Meng Hu’s other true body is in Heavenly Dream Realm. He has a way to reduce the negative effects. I can only rely on myself. I have to be more cautious.
For Black Wind to come this far from a low-level world, he had suffered immensely. From then on, he became extremely cautious. When he decided to attack, he would bite his target like a poisonous snake. He usually restrained his sharp claws and fangs so as to wait for an opportunity.
I have to slow down my walking speed. The number of Sixth Tribulation Eminences that I possess is overlapping at an increasing pace. The overlaps will be greater as I go further. Black Wind pondered. I should focus on comprehending a few paths and abandon the rest. Furthermore... I have to slow down and comprehend them carefully.
Therefore, Black Wind advanced even slower on the second path.
The first path.
Fu Sui walked step by step on the first path, maintaining his state of epiphany. The feeling of constant epiphanies was just too wonderful.
All sorts of insights surged into his mind. In the past, he could be stuck with a bottleneck for over 100 years. Now, he could easily break through them in an instant.
On the first day he embarked on the first path, he walked five kilometers. He walked the fastest.
In just half a year, Fu Sui had traveled nearly 1,000 kilometers. He had also comprehended a third Fifth Tribulation law. With his perception, he should have been unable to comprehend a third Fifth Tribulation law his entire life under normal circumstances. However, he had managed to do it in half a year.
I may need to pay a price, but risks sometimes need to be taken. Now, I have a chance of fusing these three laws of mine to reach the Sixth Tribulation realm. Fu Sui held back his excitement and continued walking on the crystalline path.

chapters.title: Chapter 597 - Ten Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 597 Ten Years
The sixth year after Meng Chuan and company stepped onto their respective paths.
How should I cultivate? What’s right? What’s wrong? Meng Hu stood on the second path and looked up. He could see the crystal path leading into the endless fog. He couldn’t see its end at all. At that moment, Meng Hu’s eyes were filled with confusion.
In the past five years, I’ve possessed nearly 10,000 Sixth Tribulation Eminences.
I reflect on myself every day. I leave behind all the paths that suit the Heavenly Dream Divine General and abandon the rest of my memories. In fact, the further I go, the more I have to wipe away my memories. In the past five years, I’ve wiped away my memories thousands of times. However, I remain lost.
I-I... don’t know how I should cultivate next. Meng Hu stood on the path, his mind filled with hesitation. He had many insights, but they clashed with each other.
Meng Hu had indeed gained a lot when he first began walking down this path. He had even successfully comprehended a third Fifth Tribulation law. However, when he wanted to form a Sixth Tribulation law with the three Fifth Tribulation laws, the numerous insights he obtained from his possessions began conflicting with each other. This was despite him wiping away the memories that he felt weren’t right repeatedly... Memory changes one’s understanding. Every time I gain insights through possession, what I know will change. Even if I wipe my memories, choosing to wipe my memories is a choice I made after my understanding changed. Time and time again, my understanding of things is changed before I wipe away my memories.
It gets more and more chaotic.
Meng Hu looked around. He could see Old Fiend Black Wind-who was much slower than him-and Meng Chuan, who was even further away. Meng Chuan walked even slower on the third path.
I knew the danger of losing myself. I believed that I could obtain benefits and ward off danger, but I still ended up lost. Meng Hu knew his situation very well. He could draw on a blank piece of paper very clearly. However, when countless strokes of different styles landed, his ‘understanding’ as an artist would already be in a mess, even if they were eliminated repeatedly. His ‘understanding’ was no longer clear. “Is this the furthest my cultivation realm can go?” Meng Hu muttered. He was a Heavenly Dream Divine General of Heavenly Dream Realm. He had the potential to reach the Sixth Tribulation realm. How could he swallow the fact that he was lost?
It’s time to return. Meng Hu looked up at the black mountain that extended deep into the clouds. Following that, his body and Essence Soul completely disintegrated without a sound.
His true body had died.
At the same time, in a mysterious and vast inhabited world-Heavenly Dream Realm.
It’s really like a dream. Meng Hu walked out of his cave abode. His cave abode was built on a five-kilometer-wide leaf. The clouds around him were clear. The leaf where his cave abode was located was a leaf of a towering tree.
I’ll go look for Master, thought Meng Hu. I can only seek Master’s help to resolve my present problems.
As a high-level world, Heavenly Dream Realm had an extremely rich heritage. It was much better than that of Archean Eon Realm. The difference between Archean Eon Realm and Heavenly Dream Realm was the difference between the Seventh Tribulation realm and the Eighth Tribulation realm.
Every Eighth Tribulation Eminence had unimaginable abilities. The laws in the River of Spacetime would severely limit the traces they left behind. Any item they refined was enough to make a Sixth Tribulation Eminence go crazy. They could easily obtain Primordial Stones from Primordial Stars, and the prices for them were extremely high. If an Eighth Tribulation Eminence was born in a particular era, the entire River of Spacetime would tremble. Even Seventh Tribulation Eminences wanted to follow them.
The heritage in an Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s homeworld was unimaginable.
Meng Hu could only hope that his homeworld
– Heavenly Dream Realm-could help him. Otherwise, he would be stuck with his present achievements forever.
Meng Hu destroyed his true body? Black Wind, who was also on the second path, couldn’t help but be taken aback when he saw Meng Hu completely turn to dust. It also chilled his heart.
He chose the same path as me. Why did he destroy his true body? Did he discover the hidden dangers of this path? Black Wind felt somewhat uneasy. The way he traveled the second path was different from Meng Hu.
From the very beginning, he realized that the Eminences he possessed would constantly overlap with each other. He was extremely cautious as he chose to study six of them. He chose to abandon everything else. Even if he possessed them, he wouldn’t choose to gain any insights.
He only studied six of the Sixth Tribulation Eminences! Furthermore, these six were mainly of the Wind attribute.
In the past five years, the number of times Old Fiend Black Wind possessed his six selected Eminences went from as little as 200 to more than 1,000 times. There were clearly only about 10,000 Sixth Tribulation Eminences available for possession on the second path. They would overlap repeatedly. Each possession was of a different period in the Eminences’ lifetimes. There were differences in their insights.
After five years, Black Wind felt that the second path was pretty good. Although I didn’t study many Sixth Tribulation Eminences, they suit me very well. I think I’m close to mastering a third law. Although it feels good, I still have to be careful. After all, Meng Hu has already destroyed his true body.
Black Wind was greedy for the opportunities here, but he also became even more cautious. He was afraid that Meng Hu had discovered some unknown danger. However, Black Wind was unwilling to leave before discovering the danger.
It would be difficult for him to obtain such an opportunity again if he missed it.
It’s been eight years. Fu Sui walked the fastest; he was also the one with the smoothest cultivation. He constantly maintained a state of epiphany.
In eight years, he had already traveled more than 15,000 kilometers.
Although I’ve traveled 15,000 kilometers, this path is really long. I still can’t see the end. Fu Sui was already in the clouds. He could barely see what was 50 kilometers above him with his naked eye. This path constantly extended upwards.
I can sense that I’m getting closer and closer to the Sixth Tribulation realm. In a few years, I will definitely master a Sixth Tribulation law. Fu Sui’s heart was filled with zeal as he advanced step by step.
Meng Chuan walked the slowest. As the mental pressure increased, it affected his other avatars’ cultivation elsewhere. Meng Chuan naturally slowed down. He still had to make sure he still had 30% of his mental strength for his other avatars.
“New... rising...”
This was the tenth year of Meng Chuan’s journey on the third path. He had only walked over 1,500 kilometers.
He could now hear a majestic voice coming from the top of the mountain. However, after traveling a long distance, the sound was affected by all sorts of invisible interference. What he heard remained intermittent. However, he could clearly hear single words. Every word was like a hammer striking Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul and mind. Meng Chuan was already used to it.
He could clearly sense the impact each word had on his Essence Soul and mind. Having resisted it for long periods, he gradually figured out the best way to resist it. In this confrontation, Meng Chuan could sense that his willpower had become stronger.
This strengthening process was very slow. Typically, one wouldn’t obtain anything in a year or so. Furthermore, the pressure would become stronger as they advanced on the path. It was like a nightmare. However, after repeated trial and error for about five years in this nightmare, one’s mind and willpower would undergo a qualitative change. They would then find it much easier to resist the pressure.
After nearly ten years on this path, my willpower has clearly improved three times. Meng Chuan was very happy. The first improvement was in the second year after he stepped onto the path. The second improvement was in the fifth year. The third improvement just happened the tenth year.
Cultivation was the process of perfecting oneself over and over again after setbacks, allowing one to attain perfection. It was the same for one’s mental cultivation. When one withstood mental attacks, they could discover their mental flaws. The more perfect their mental tempering, the stronger their mind would become.
Only with a strong mind could one withstand an even larger Essence Soul World in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 598 - Price
chapters.content:
Chapter 598 Price
Twelve years after Meng Chuan and company stepped onto their respective paths –
Boom!
Fu Sui dazedly stood on the first path for a long time.
“I’ve grasped a Sixth Tribulation law?” Fu Sui muttered to himself. The endless joy filled his mind, making him somewhat dazed. Only a handful of Sixth Tribulation Eminences existed in a vast river zone. With such strength, he had a chance of helming a mystic realm! He would be a core member of any peak faction in the River of Spacetime. This was a level Fu Sui had to look up to in the past.
He had sacrificed too much for this goal. He couldn’t even see hope of accomplishing it before.
I never expected that I, Fu Sui, will be able to master a Sixth Tribulation law in my life. Fu Sui’s heart was pounding.
Why did he risk his life so crazily? Did he really like taking risks? Of course not. His true pursuit was strength! He pursued strength that would allow him to change the level of his homeworld and allow him to kill the enemies he had buried deep in his heart for many years.
I’ve finally grasped this strength. Fu Sui extended his right hand and clenched it slightly. Black cracks appeared on his palm. Although he had grasped a Sixth Tribulation law, he had yet to recultivate his body with the law as the foundation. He had yet to transcend the sixth Physical Body Tribulation, but his explosive strength had already reached the threshold of the Sixth Tribulation realm.
There was a qualitative difference between him and a Fifth Tribulation Eminence. Many Fifth Tribulation Eminences—including Cave Lord Scenic Cloud and Meng Hu—could not resist Fu Sui at all.
It was easy for a Fifth Tribulation Eminence to kill a Fourth Tribulation Eminence. Killing a Fifth Tribulation Eminence was even easier for a Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
It’s been 12 years. I’ve grasped such strength after stepping onto this path. Fu Sui was very excited. He looked up at the path, filled with endless anticipation.
Fu Sui knew very well that he was only above average amongst Fifth Tribulation Eminences when it came to talent and potential. Compared to a Heavenly Dream Divine General like Meng Hu, he was far inferior.
If Meng Hu were in his shoes, he would probably have grasped a Sixth Tribulation law in a year or two.
Compared to Meng Chuan, who created an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique, he was far inferior.
With such a great opportunity, I can still go very far. I have to figure out a way to cultivate my body as soon as possible so that I can survive the Physical Body Tribulation. Fu Sui suppressed his excitement and continued advancing, entering a state of epiphany again.
In the blink of an eye, three years passed. Fu Sui had traveled more than 25,000 kilometers in the 15 years since he came to the ruin world.
Huh? Fu Sui looked in front of him in shock. Through the fog, he could vaguely see the path ahead curve around the mountain’s silhouette. It had actually overlapped with another curved
path.
Fu Sui could tell at a glance that the other curved path was the third path. The first and third paths fuse after more than 25,000 kilometers? Fu Sui stared blankly. He originally only thought that the three paths would lead to the peak. Who would have thought that the first and third paths would merge after 25,000 kilometers?
What should I do?
There will definitely be some changes when I step into the overlapped path. Fu Sui was somewhat uneasy. After some thought, he gritted his teeth. The formulation I cultivate my body with is almost perfected. With my epiphanies, I will probably be able to perfect it very soon. If I were in the outside world, it would be difficult to predict how long I would take.
Besides, I’m feeling great now. There’s nothing wrong with me. Fu Sui believed that opportunities and risks came in pairs. He had to risk his life at critical moments.
He took one step after another. Half a month later, Fu Sui arrived at the intersection of the two paths.
I’ll try and see what will happen when the two paths merge. Fu Sui looked at the ground and didn’t hesitate to take that step.
With a single step, he stepped onto the new path.
In an instant
“Nine... too... much...” A mighty voice sounded from the mountain peak. Suddenly, it resounded in his Essence Soul. Every syllable dealt a heavy impact on his Essence Soul.
Upon hearing the first syllable, countless cracks appeared on Fu Sui’s Essence Soul. His Essence Soul shattered completely after it heard a few more syllables.
Not good. Fu Sui didn’t have the time to react. His Essence Soul had already been destroyed. His body collapsed at the entrance of the merged path and it was no longer breathing.
Fu Sui’s homeworld.
What happened? Fu Sui, who was sitting cross-legged in a chamber, opened his eyes and revealed a look of shock. My outer realm true body died in the ruin world?
I’ve tried the third path before. Although it has a huge impact on one’s mind and consciousness, I could still withstand it. However, the sounds on the merged path were much clearer. The impact on my Essence Soul was also much greater. Just the sound of a few syllables was enough to shatter my Essence Soul. Fu Sui was somewhat indignant. He was unable to continue advancing.
Forget it. Although I’ve left the ruin world, I’ve at least grasped a Sixth Tribulation law. I’ve almost perfected my physical body cultivation formulation. Fu Sui quickly calmed down. Furthermore, he was in a good mood. I reckon I can reach the Sixth Tribulation realm in a few centuries.
Even now, I can barely be considered to have Sixth Tribulation realm strength. Fu Sui couldn’t suppress his smile. The opportunities in the ruin world had greatly helped him. If he enhanced his body, he wouldn’t be much different from a true Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
Tribulation Transcendence was just a test. It didn’t affect one’s strength much.
While Fu Sui was happily thinking about his future plans, his expression suddenly changed. M-my Essence Soul... Fu Sui clutched his head in pain.
He felt an intense pain in his Essence Soul. The pain made Fu Sui fall to the ground uncontrollably as he convulsed and rolled on the ground.
Something bad is happening to my Essence Soul. My 15-year-long epiphany seems to have injured my Essence Soul foundation. Fu Sui felt his entire Essence Soul tremble with pain everywhere. This injury had affected his foundation deeply.
With a thought, he took out treasures that were beneficial to his Essence Soul from his storage treasure.
Gulp! Gulp! Gulp! He first drank a flask of alcohol. The alcohol had an invisible force nourishing his Essence Soul, but his Essence Soul still remained in excruciating pain. It wasn’t very helpful. Pills, blood crystals, spirit fruits...
Fu Sui consumed 11 types of treasures that were beneficial to the Essence Soul. Only when the 11th Scarlet Leaf Fruit managed to affect his Essence Soul completely from the ground up did the pain subside.
The Scarlet Leaf Fruit is a treasure that can help one recover from Essence Soul injuries. One fruit is worth 300 cubes. Fu Sui was somewhat worried. I wonder if my Essence Soul’s injuries have been completely healed.
However, his Essence Soul began to ache slightly that night. Fu Sui tried not to consume any treasures, but the pain intensified as time passed.
A Scarlet Leaf Fruit can’t even last a day? What should I do? On that very day, Fu Sui split out a true body that headed to the outer realm. He immediately thought of ways to treat his Essence Soul.
Inside the ruin world.
Only Black Wind and I are left in this ruin world? Through karma, Meng Chuan could sense his companions’ locations. Meng Hu had long left the ruin world. Today, Fu Sui had also left the ruin world.
Fu Sui took the first path. He has been in an epiphany for 15 years? Meng Chuan was surprised and even somewhat envious. After all, it was difficult to enter a state of epiphany. Fifteen years of epiphanies? Perhaps he could even reach the Seventh Tribulation realm with that.
However, Meng Chuan knew that 15 years of constant epiphanies had a price. The black mountain’s creator wouldn’t give them benefits for nothing.
I wonder what price Fu Sui paid, Meng Chuan thought as he looked at the path beneath his feet.
Although his Essence Soul had been constantly suppressed by the sounds, Meng Chuan was very satisfied. This was because his other bodies were cultivating normally in the outside world. After so many years, he had almost grasped a Sixth Tribulation law. He was so frightened that he stopped cultivating.
I can sense that I can reach the Sixth Tribulation realm if I continue cultivating in the outside world. Meng Chuan also vaguely understood that the acceleration in his cultivation was more likely related to the transformation of his willpower.
I’ll temporarily stop cultivating. I’ll focus on mental cultivation until I can’t advance any further on this path.
An Essence Soul Tribulation couldn’t be delayed. If he transcended it, he would live. If he failed, he would die!
His mental cultivation might be enough, but it could also be a little lacking. Before actually transcending the tribulation, Meng Chuan had no confidence.
Therefore, Meng Chuan decided to stop cultivating for the time being. Almost all his time and effort was focused on tempering his mind and willpower.

chapters.title: Chapter 599 - This Is a Demonic Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 599 This Is a Demonic Mountain
The 30th year after Meng Chuan and company entered the ruin world.
Old Fiend Black Wind stood there and looked up at the path that extended deep into the clouds.
Who am I? Mo Yang? Qin Cai... Yes, I’m Black Wind. Black Wind gradually regained clarity in his mind. He looked around in horror. I’ve always been very careful. I’ve always followed my rule of possessing only those six Tribulation Eminences. I didn’t comprehend anything else.
But who would have thought that the Dao of these six Tribulation Eminences are distorted? They are all wrong! Black Wind’s eyes turned crazy. Everything is wrong!
Many Sixth Tribulation Eminences’ Dao were not suitable for his cultivation’s foundation.
For example, Nirvana Saber wasn’t suitable to be one’s cultivation foundation at the Fifth Tribulation Realm. Using it as a foundation would gradually lead one to nirvanic destruction and self-destruction.
One had to first grasp a suitable Dao, such as Infinite Saber’s paramount speed laws. Only by establishing such a foundation would one be able to tread evil paths at the same level. Only by having a strong foundation could one take the paths that led to backlash.
Similarly, many distorted paths at the Sixth Tribulation realm were not suitable as one’s cultivation foundation!
When creating a technique, cultivators would gradually sense that it was wrong to continue walking down a particular path. They would then find another suitable direction. However, when one was possessing another’s body, one couldn’t discover this wrongness due to their limited horizons. By the time they realized it, it was already too late.
I originally thought that the Sixth Tribulation Eminences I possessed were all on correct paths. Who would’ve thought that everything was wrong? Everything is distorted.
I’m only one step away from grasping a Sixth Tribulation law, but my consciousness is already in a mess. If I take the final step and grasp a Sixth Tribulation law, I’ll probably go crazy. Black Wind understood this point.
In the 30 years he spent traversing the second path, he had long grasped three Fifth Tribulation laws. He was only one step away from grasping a Sixth Tribulation law. However, he would struggle for a long time to regain his consciousness every time he possessed a body. His clarity of thought was already decreasing.
The six Tribulation Eminences I chose were all on wrong paths. If that’s the case, could it be that all 10,000 Sixth Tribulation Eminences on the second path are on wrong paths? Black Wind shuddered.
He originally thought that this was a huge opportunity. Who knew that all of them led him to embark on a wrong path? If a Sixth Tribulation Eminence were to come here, they would be able to accommodate these wrong paths. As for a Fifth Tribulation Eminence? Perhaps 999 out of 1,000 of them would end up taking the wrong path.
This is a demonic mountain. It’s a demonic mountain, muttered Black Wind inwardly. I have to leave this place.
Black Wind raised his head and looked around. His Essence Soul and body were silently reduced to dust as the mountain wind scattered him across the world, leaving only his weapons and treasures on the crystal path.
At the same moment, Meng Chuan, who was the slowest on the third path, looked up in the direction where Black Wind had vanished.
Over the past few years, he had traveled alone. Through karma, he could sense that Black Wind had always been on the second path, but he was gone now.
Old Fiend Black Wind has left as well? Meng Chuan didn’t know what his three companions had encountered, but they had all given up.
Old Fiend Black Wind lasted for 30 years-a very long period. I feel that it’s getting more and more difficult for me. Meng Chuan sensed the syllables blasting into his Essence Soul. The voices were vast and mighty. Just the pressure from the sounds alone was terrifying. In the past 30 years, my willpower has transformed five times. I feel like I’m reaching my limits.
His willpower had transformed five timesduring the second year, the fifth year, the tenth year, the eighteenth year, and the twenty-ninth year.
Although his willpower had just transformed last year—a significant improvement-Meng Chuan realized that all he heard was the same voice. The sounds were becoming less effective for tempering his willpower, even though the voice was becoming clearer, and exerted more pressure the higher he went. From the time gaps between his transformations, he could tell that each transformation took more time. He guessed that it might take him 20 years for the next transformation to occur.
Could he continue walking for 20 years without his mind and willpower transforming at all? Meng Chuan estimated that a few years was probably the limit he could withstand. Meng Chuan didn’t have any confidence in breaking through in a few years.
I’ll just continue. Although he could vaguely sense that he would reach the end of the third path in a few years, he still had to take one step at a time. Perhaps there might be a turning point?
Meng Chuan walked alone in the ruin world. One particular day after Old Fiend Black Wind chose to leaveFu Sui is looking for us? Meng Chuan sensed something.
Fu Sui contacted Meng Chuan, Meng Hu, and Black Wind through the Cang Alliance Space and invited them to gather.
Meng Chuan sighed. The current Fu Sui is really thriving. Fu Sui was no longer the same as before. In the past, he was an ordinary Fifth Tribulation Eminence. Although he had grasped two Fifth Tribulation laws in the past, the physical body he had in the outside world was very weak. The weapons and treasures he carried were also very weak. He appeared very poor. The only special thing was that he liked to take risks and adventure in various places.
However, Fu Sui was already considered half a Sixth Tribulation Eminence now. Although his body had yet to improve, Fu Sui had already surpassed the Fifth Tribulation realm. He had become an influential figure in the Cang Alliance.
After Fu Sui left the ruin world, his style of doing things changed drastically. He became domineering and intimidating. He even killed 15 Fifth Tribulation Eminences that he had some grudges with.
Meng Chuan sighed inwardly. Only two of the 15 people had huge grudges with Fu Sui. The other 13 were killed because of small conflicts. Under normal circumstances, one wouldn’t kill a Fifth Tribulation Eminence over a small conflict.
This was because a Fifth Tribulation Eminence was virtually immortal if they had a true body in their homeworld. Therefore, there was no need to form huge grudges.
However, Fu Sui still acted so. He was domineering and intimidating, killing as he wished! After killing 15 people in a row, the Cang Alliance was naturally alarmed.
I wonder why he’s looking for us. Although Meng Chuan was puzzled, he still sent an embodiment through the Essence Soul mark in the Cang Alliance Space. Meng Chuan felt that he still owed Fu Sui a favor.
No matter what, his mind and will had already transformed five times in the ruin world. Even if he was forced to leave, he had gained a lot. He had to thank Fu Sui for this opportunity.
In the Cang Alliance Space.
“Brother Fu Sui, congratulations.”
“Brother Fu Sui, you have grasped a Sixth Tribulation law. I’m afraid you aren’t far from reaching the Sixth Tribulation realm.” The three members of the Cang Alliance congratulated Fu Sui from afar.
Fu Sui smiled and nodded before sitting in another corner.
“In the past, Fu Sui was very friendly to everyone. Now that the three of us are congratulating him, he can’t even be bothered to say a word.”
“After all, he has one foot into the Sixth Tribulation realm. He can destroy us with a flip of his hand. Why would he bother with us?” The three members conversed via voice transmissions. They weren’t angry. This was how the cultivation world was. Strength determined one’s status.
Fu Sui sat there alone. People only know that my strength has increased greatly, and my status is different. However, they don’t know how much I’ve suffered. Fu Sui felt aggrieved.
After leaving the ruin world and discovering his Essence Soul injuries, he thought of ways to seek treatment. Grasping a Sixth Tribulation law had elevated his status greatly. He had visited eight Sixth Tribulation Eminences; he even had the honor of meeting a Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
Unfortunately, nobody could treat his injuries. Therefore, he spared no expense to search for treasures that could treat his Essence Soul.
I’ve used up all the treasures I have accumulated over the years. I’ve also used up all the treasures I obtained from killing the 15 Fifth Tribulation Eminences. I’ve also borrowed more than 50,000 cubes... I’ve finally found a treasure that’s relatively cheap. It’s a treasure that can alleviate my Essence Soul’s injuries. Fu Sui had mixed emotions. The item that could alleviate his injuries while being the cheapest was a supplementary cultivation pill that Eternal Tower sold—Heart Intoxicating Pill.
I need 120 cubes a year to consume the Heart Intoxicating Pill. I need to consume it for a long time.
One hundred and twenty cubes a year was considered cheap. However, in order to find the Heart Intoxicating Pill, he had experimented with too many treasures. He had expended all his savings, and he still owed a lot of debt.
One hundred and twenty cubes a year. In 1,000 years, that’s over 100,000 cubes... How do I save that amount? Fu Sui felt that the consumption of Heart Intoxicating Pills was a death sentence. Furthermore, Fu Sui was worried that the Heart Intoxicating Pill’s effects would decrease over time. Sigh. Fu Sui felt aggrieved. People believed that he was thriving, but only he knew how much trouble he was in.
He didn’t even dare to transcend the sixth Physical Body Tribulation because of his Essence Soul’s injuries. He could only stall for time, not daring to improve his body. Therefore, he was forever stuck at the half-step Sixth Tribulation realm.
Oh? Fu Sui looked up. One figure after another appeared. They were Meng Hu, Black Wind, and Meng Chuan. The three of them walked towards Fu Sui.
Fu Sui sat there with a smile as he welcomed his three companions. However, he didn’t stand up to welcome them! After all, his strength was already at the Sixth Tribulation realm, if barely. His status was much higher than his three companions.

chapters.title: Chapter 600 - Fu Sui’s Intentions
chapters.content:
Chapter 600 Fu Sui’s Intentions
Meng Chuan, Meng Hu, and Black Wind greeted each other. After all, they had become much closer after exploring the ruin world together.
“Black Wind, you are much more powerful than me.” Meng Hu sighed as he looked at Black Wind. “I walked that path for more than five years before I chose to give up. You persisted on the same path for 30 years. Impressive, impressive!”
Meng Hu knew very well that the longer one walked on the path, the greater the probability of losing themselves.
“But I still failed to persist.” Black Wind shook his head and didn’t elaborate. He looked at the approaching Meng Chuan. “Brother Eastcalm is still the best. He’s still persisting in the ruin world.”
