“I didn’t take the same path as all of you. Furthermore, I’m much slower than all of you,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“Indeed. I’m considered slow, but you are even slower,” admitted Black Wind as he nodded. When he chose to give up, he could sense Meng Chuan’s location through karma. The distance that Meng Chuan covered was much less than him.
The three of them chatted for a while before walking to a corner of the Cang Alliance Space, where Fu Sui was sitting alone.
“Look at Fu Sui. Now that he has grasped the strength of a Sixth Tribulation Eminence, his attitude is completely different from before,” said Black Wind via voice transmission. “It’s indeed different.” Meng Hu narrowed his eyes slightly.
Meng Chuan also realized this, but he could understand why. Sixth Tribulation Eminences were much stronger than them. Since Fu Sui had one foot in the Sixth Tribulation realm, his attitude was naturally more supercilious.
“Everyone, take a seat,” said Fu Sui with a smile.
“Brother Fu Sui, you are now completely different from us,” said Black Wind respectfully. “The people you make friends with are all Sixth Tribulation Eminences.”
“Yeah.” Fu Sui nodded slightly. “I do know some Sixth Tribulation friends. I was even lucky enough to pay a visit to Yellow-Robed Academy Lord.”
“Yellow-Robed Academy Lord?” Meng Chuan, Meng Hu, and Black Wind were alarmed.
Among the top factions in the River of Spacetime, Yellow-Robed Academy was one of them. It was said that two Seventh Tribulation Eminences were in Yellow-Robed Academy presently. They were the incumbent Academy Lord and Vice Academy Lord.
Yellow-Robed Academy Lord was definitely one of the most terrifying existences in the River of Spacetime.
“Seventh Tribulation realm?”
Meng Chuan, Meng Hu, and Black Wind sighed inwardly. Very few Seventh Tribulation Eminences were born in the entire River of Spacetime. Seventh Tribulation Eminences also had their own pursuits. They had very little free time, so it was very difficult to meet them.
In the entire River of Spacetime, there were countless Fifth Tribulation Eminences. It was very difficult for them to meet Seventh Tribulation Eminences alone. However, Fu Sui had a chance to meet a Seventh Tribulation after barely gaining the combat strength of a Sixth Tribulation Eminence. After all, a peak faction in the River of Spacetime had the most combat strength at the Sixth Tribulation realm.
“I was lucky that I could pay a visit to the Yellow-Robed Academy Lord,” said Fu Sui with a faint smile. “By the way, I can sense that Black Wind has left the ruin world. Is Eastcalm the only one left in the ruin world?”
Black Wind nodded. “Yes, only Eastcalm is left.”
“I’m slow,” said Meng Chuan.
Fu Sui swept his gaze across the three people present and said with a smile, “We made our choices for the three paths on the black mountain’s main peak. Let’s have a simple exchange of information. The first path I took was indeed a path of constant epiphanies. I maintained a state of epiphany for 12 years and grasped a Sixth Tribulation law in one fell swoop. I nearly figured out a physical body cultivation formulation. The path’s only flaw was that it damaged my Essence Soul, but the damage is still bearable.” “Brother Fu Sui has indeed improved rapidly, from having mastered two Fifth Tribulation laws to mastering a complete Sixth Tribulation law. Perhaps I should’ve taken the risk and chosen the first path back then,” said Black Wind with a vexed expression. “I took the second path and possessed many Eminences. Although my strength improved greatly, I was in danger of losing myself. In the end, I was forced to give up.”
“You had a breakthrough in strength, right?” asked Fu Sui with a smile.
Black Wind nodded. “I’ve grasped three Fifth Tribulation laws.” After leaving the ruin world completely, he could stay lucid. What Old Fiend Black Wind needed now was to abandon the paths of the six Eminences he possessed. With the three laws he had comprehended as his foundation, he could forge his own path. This way, he could reach the Sixth Tribulation realm.
“Although it’s a little troublesome, I still gained a lot. I have to thank you, Brother Fu Sui,” said Black Wind with a smile. “It’s all thanks to Brother Fu Sui that I, Black Wind, can be where I am today.”
“Haha...” Fu Sui laughed. He was somewhat indignant. It seemed like the price paid by those who took the second path was much lower.
“I’m not as good as Brother Black Wind. I only lasted for a short period of time before becoming somewhat lost,” said Meng Hu as he shook his head. “I haven’t resolved the problem of losing myself.” Meng Hu only spoke half-truths as well.
In fact, after a discussion among Heavenly Dream Realm’s upper echelons, they had already decided to help Meng Hu activate Hundred Lives Dream Realm. He would use 100 lifetimes to temper his heart. If he succeeded, the loss of self due to the possessions would not be worth mentioning. However, he would stay completely lost in Hundred Lives Dream Realm if he failed.
The negative effects of getting lost in Hundred Lives Dream Realm were much greater than the possessions’ negative effects.
Meng Hu was very nervous about his future. “Lost?” asked Fu Sui. “Then, did you gain anything?”
“My cultivation has improved.” Meng Hu nodded. “I’ve now grasped three laws.” “There are gains and losses,” said Fu Sui with a smile. “I believe that Heavenly Dream Realm’s means can definitely resolve the danger of losing yourself.”
Black Wind was secretly astonished when he heard that. It sounded like Meng Hu lost himself in a way much more serious than him. “Eastcalm, what about you?” Fu Sui looked at Meng Chuan.
“All of you know that the sounds you hear will affect your mind and consciousness when you enter the third path,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “The higher you go, the greater the impact.”
“Has your strength broken through?” asked Fu Sui.
“My strength hasn’t changed much.” Meng Chuan shook his head. “I don’t have the mood to cultivate while on the third path. I can only focus on resisting the sounds’ impact on my Essence Soul. However, my willpower has improved after 30 years of tempering.”
“Only your willpower has improved?”
Fu Sui, Black Wind, and Meng Hu felt that the third path was somewhat lacking. After all, there were many ways to improve one’s willpower slowly. In comparison, one’s technique realm had a more direct influence on one’s strength.
“No other benefits?” asked Black Wind.
Meng Chuan shook his head. “None.”
“From the looks of it, you might really have to reach the end before it’s considered as passing the test. Only then will you obtain great benefits,” said Meng Hu. Fu Sui nodded and said, “It’s just as we expected. The three paths on the black mountain’s peak are filled with blessings and disasters. By the way, I invited the three of you here to seek your help.” “You want our help?” Meng Chuan, Meng Hu, and Black Wind exchanged looks.
“I have the mystic technique needed to enter the ruin world,” said Fu Sui. “I plan on inviting more Fifth Tribulation Eminences in. Of course, I won’t bring them in for free. Every one of them needs to pay Outer Realm Essence Crystals.”
Meng Chuan, Black Wind, and Meng Hu understood that Fu Sui wanted to obtain a huge amount of benefits through this. It was easy to guess that Fu Sui could earn a lot. However, only Fu Sui knew the mystic technique used to enter. It was useless for them to be envious.
“Why don’t you invite a Sixth Tribulation Eminence in?” asked Meng Hu. “The black mountain’s peak should be useful for Sixth Tribulation Eminences.”
“To be honest, my mystic technique can only bring Fifth Tribulation Eminences in. There are also other restrictions,” said Fu Sui. He had always kept the method of entering the ruin world a secret.
Fu Sui looked at the three of them. “I’ll inform the members of the Cang Alliance. I need the three of you to pass a message to all the Fifth Tribulation Eminences in the Cang Alliance. For example, Brother Black Wind, you should say that you entered the ruin world twice. From grasping one law, you improved to the point of grasping three laws. You took the second path on the black mountain’s peak and experienced the danger of losing yourself. However, it didn’t affect your strength.”
“Alright.” Black Wind smiled in agreement. Since he would be speaking the truth, Black Wind was willing to help. After all, Fu Sui could barely be considered a Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
Fu Sui looked at Meng Hu and said, “Brother Meng Hu, you should say that you improved from grasping two Fifth Tribulation laws to three Fifth Tribulation laws. You took the second path on the black mountain’s peak. You were in danger of losing yourself, but you remained lucid to this day.”
Meng Hu pondered for a moment. “I’ll remind them of the danger of losing themselves.” “Sure.” Fu Sui nodded. “I don’t need you to lie. Brother Eastcalm, you can tell the others the truth.”
To attract cultivators, one had to rely on the first two paths. It was fine if the third path was less attractive. This was especially true since the first path allowed one to maintain a state of epiphany
Fu Sui had successfully grasped a Sixth Tribulation law with this.
“Alright.” Meng Chuan nodded. Fu Sui had brought him into the ruin world. No matter what, he had to acknowledge this favor. He would help if he could. If he didn’t have to lie, he could just say what he needed to say.
“In a day, pass the message to all Fifth Tribulation Eminences in the Cang Alliance,” said Fu Sui. “Of course, send me the messages’ content in advance. I will remember your kindness.”
Moments later
Meng Hu and Black Wind left.
Meng Chuan looked at Fu Sui. “Brother Fu Sui, why did you ask me to stay behind?”
“Eastcalm, when do you plan on leaving the ruin world?” Fu Sui asked with a smile.
“I don’t know.” Meng Chuan shook his head. “I’ll just last as long as I can.”
Fu Sui frowned slightly when he heard this answer. He still said, “To be honest, there can only be ten cultivators in the ruin world at the same time. I want to send the other Fifth Tribulation Eminences in. If you continue to stay inside, you will keep occupying a spot. The third path won’t be of much help to you. If you don’t mind, leave the ruin world as soon as possible.”

chapters.title: Chapter 601 - Constantly On the Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 601 Constantly On the Mountain
Meng Chuan looked at Fu Sui and frowned slightly. “Fu Sui, you should know that I cultivate both my body and Essence Soul. The third path is very important for the tempering of my mind and will.”
“There are many ways to cultivate one’s mind. It doesn’t have to be done on this black mountain ruin,” said Fu Sui with a smile. “How about this? If you leave in three years, I’ll compensate you with 3,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals. Just treat it as helping me.”
Meng Chuan shook his head. “I can’t help you.”
Fu Sui’s expression sank slightly. His strength was now at the Sixth Tribulation realm. His status was much higher than that of an ordinary Fifth Tribulation Eminence. He had already tried to persuade Meng Chuan, but Meng Chuan wasn’t having any of it. “Eastcalm,” said Fu Sui with a frown, “I was the one who brought you into the ruin world and gave you the chance to obtain opportunities and benefits. You should be grateful for this favor. Can’t you help me on account of that?”
“Exploring the ruin together is about mutual weal and woe,” said Meng Chuan. “Before exploring the ruin, no one knows how great the benefits and the disasters are. Even now, I don’t know how much trouble this ruin will bring. It’s still early to talk about favors now, right?”
Meng Chuan had only explored a portion of the ruin. He was worried that the third path would lead to deep trouble.
Fu Sui stared at Meng Chuan. “You’ve been inside for 30 years. That’s enough, right!?”
Meng Chuan’s expression turned cold as well. Since the other party had brought him in, he owed him a favor. However, mutual weal and woe were unavoidable when it came to exploring ruins. It would be a joke for the other party to use this debt of gratitude to request recompense.
As for using force?
“I’ll stay as long as I want.” Meng Chuan glanced at Fu Sui before standing up in preparation to disperse the embodiment.
Fu Sui’s pupils constricted when he heard that. Rage surged in his heart. However, when he thought of Meng Chuan’s two true bodiesone in his homeworld and the other in the ruin
—both of which he couldn’t deal with, he could only suppress his anger.
“Wait,” said Fu Sui.
Meng Chuan turned to look at him.
Fu Sui’s previous attitude greatly reduced Meng Chuan’s impression of him. If the other party wanted to pursue him because of this small conflict, Meng Chuan was already prepared.
“Forget it.” Fu Sui squeezed out a smile. “Since you want to stay in the ruin world, I won’t force you. I’ll just send fewer cultivators in! By the way, remember to pass a message to every Fifth Tribulation member of the Cang Alliance.”
Meng Chuan was shocked. Fu Sui had previously threatened him, but he now forced a smile to ease the situation... Fu Sui could barely be considered a Sixth Tribulation Eminence, so why was he stooping so low?
From the looks of it, there is a special reason that forced Fu Sui to abandon his pride. Meng Chuan had some guesses.
“Don’t worry. I’ll do as I say,” said Meng Chuan. “Of course, I won’t lie either.” With that said, Meng Chuan dissipated his embodiment.
Fu Sui sat there alone for a long time before leaving.
Three Bay River System, Snowjade Palace.
Black Mountain ruin? Palace Lord Snowjade frowned slightly. He was also a member of the Cang Alliance. Today, he received four messages. They were from Fu Sui, Black Wind, Meng Chuan, and Meng Hu. Is the Black Mountain ruin that magical?
Old Fiend Black Wind went there twice. He went from grasping one Fifth Tribulation law to grasping three Fifth Tribulation laws?
Fu Sui went from grasping two Fifth Tribulation laws to grasping a Sixth Tribulation law?
Meng Hu has also improved from grasping two Fifth Tribulation laws to three Fifth Tribulation laws?
Eastcalm is still exploring the Black Mountain ruin’s path? Snowjade’s heart burned as he read the intelligence. It might have been a coincidence if only one explorer had improved greatly. However, Fu Sui, Meng Hu, and Black Wind had improved greatly. This meant that the ruin was very special. The first path can induce a constant state of epiphany? However, the longer one is in an epiphany, the greater the damage to their Essence Soul? Fu Sui relied on this path to grasp a Sixth Tribulation law in one fell swoop. Now, Fu Sui’s fame has spread far and wide, yet he hasn’t gone crazy. Snowjade’s heart burned with passion. The second path can also lead to great improvements, but there’s the danger of losing oneself. As for the third path, one’s Essence Soul and mind will suffer pressure? There are no other benefits? Snowjade was indeed tempted. The first two paths aren’t bad. However, if I want to enter, I need to pay 10,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals? Ten thousand cubes!
The financial pressure on a Fifth Tribulation Eminence was immense.
For example, the treasures left behind by Senior Pang Ming’s outer realm true body only added up to 10,000 cubes.
Many of the poorer Fifth Tribulation Eminences might only have over 10,000 cubes worth of treasures. Of course, the wealthy ones like Cave Lord Scenic Cloud, Ta Gu, Meng Hu, and Meng Chuan could easily afford to take out 10,000 cubes.
Fu Sui set the price at 10,000 cubes after much consideration.
“There are no benefits in the outer realm void for no reason. The benefits usually have a price hidden behind them. If a ruin can induce a constant state of epiphany, the price one has to pay will definitely be astonishing. To spend 10,000 cubes for a spot, anyone willing to pay for it can go?”
“Ten thousand cubes is too much. I can’t even raise 10,000 cubes.”
“It’s too much.”
In the Cang Alliance Space, the members chatted.
Many members were indeed unable to produce 10,000 cubes. This was because some treasures were very important to them—they weren’t for sale! It was very common for people to be unable to raise 10,000 cubes with what was readily sellable.
“I think we should get Brother Fu Sui to lower the price. Three thousand cubes would be sweet.”
The Cang Alliance Space was stirred by this matter, but many Fifth Tribulation Eminences were in the Cang Alliance. In the end, 53 Fifth Tribulation Eminences prepared to enter the Black Mountain ruin world. All of them rushed to Six Desires River Zone.
I’ve been cultivating for more than 70,000 years. I only have a few thousand years left to live. It’s my final gamble, so I’ll accept the price! A black turtle as large as a mountain moved through the River of Spacetime.
There’s actually a treasure land that allows one to be in a constant state of epiphany? Only with such a treasure land will I have a chance of improving my strength greatly. Only then will I have a chance of revenge. A silver-robed, thin, and tall man rushed through the River of Spacetime. Four members have confirmed the matter. Fu Sui has grasped a Sixth Tribulation law. Meng Hu is a Heavenly Dream Divine General of Heavenly Dream Realm. City Lord Eastcalm managed to get Cave Lord Scenic Cloud to follow him. They definitely care about karma. What they say is trustworthy.
There might be one who would lie because of special reasons, unfazed by the problem of karma, but the fact that four members had vouched for it made it trustworthy.
In fact, Meng Chuan, Black Wind, and Meng Hu weren’t lying.
Only attracting 53 Cang Alliance members was slightly lower than Fu Sui’s expectations. After all, he hadn’t even attracted 10% of the Cang Alliance members.
Fu Sui was rather excited that he could obtain 530,000 cubes. This was because it was very difficult for even a Sixth Tribulation Eminence to obtain such wealth. Fu Sui was banking on selling the opportunity of entering the Black Mountain ruin world to make a killing. With his current strength and the cave abode’s array formation, even a Sixth Tribulation Eminence would find it difficult to breach the array formation. This guaranteed his profits.
In the ruin world.
Whoosh.
Fu Sui and the eight Fifth Tribulation Eminences arrived. Among the eight new members was Palace Lord Snowjade.
I can sense that Eastcalm is here. Snowjade looked around and noticed the towering black mountain in the distance. The world’s pressure is very strong. That black mountain looks terrifying. It must have an extraordinary background. This is the ruin world?
That’s the black mountain?
The other Fifth Tribulation Eminences were somewhat excited as they looked around. “The 53 Cang Alliance members will be split into several batches. You are the first batch to enter,” said Fu Sui with a smile. “Follow me.” “Alright.” The eight other members followed Fu Sui as he confidently led them forward.
Fu Sui encountered several forbidden creatures along the way. Although Fu Sui’s body was relatively weak and he didn’t carry any powerful treasures with him, he was much stronger than Meng Hu and Meng Chuan after grasping a Sixth Tribulation law. He easily killed the forbidden creatures and traveled at his maximum speed. He arrived at Black Mountain very smoothly.
Just entering the black mountain is like eating a rare treasure.
One day of cultivation here is equivalent to a month in the outside world.
The eight Fifth Tribulation Eminences were somewhat excited. Snowjade’s heart burned with fervor.
Fu Sui led the eight of them forward. They flew past mountain peaks and finally arrived at Black Mountain Peak.
“These are the three paths.” Fu Sui pointed at the three crystalline paths in front of him. “The left path allows one to be in a constant state of epiphany. The middle path allows one to possess Sixth Tribulation Eminences. The right path will result in mental suppression. I’ll say it again now. The black mountain paths contain both good and bad. The further one goes, the greater the price one has to pay. Act according to your abilities.”
The eight Fifth Tribulation Eminences stepped forward to give the paths a try. Soon, they came to a decision. In fact, they had already made up their minds before coming here.
The second path allowed one to possess Eminences. Snowjade was still rather cautious. He had cultivated for a long time, so he felt that the first path’s price would probably be rather high. He was satisfied as long as he could grasp three Fifth Tribulation laws.
ec
In the end, four people stepped onto the path of epiphany, three stepped onto the second, and one took the third path. Fu Sui smiled as he watched this scene. Following that, he raised his head and looked in a direction. His eyes turned colder. Through karma, he could determine Meng Chuan’s location. Eastcalm has always been on the mountain. His occupying of a spot makes my suffering worse.
There was only one way to leave the ruin world each time: destroy a true body.
Destroying a true body required him to recultivate it again. Fu Sui didn’t care much about spending more than 1,000 cubes to recultivate a true body. However, after losing a portion of his Essence Soul, recultivation would result in tremendous pain due to his Essence Soul injuries!
Since Meng Chuan occupied one spot, Fu Sui had to die one or two more times. He was naturally very unhappy with Meng Chuan.
Forget it; it’s time to return. Although Fu Sui knew that losing a portion of his Essence Soul was painful, this was the only way to leave.
Whoosh. His body and Essence Soul completely dissipated.

chapters.title: Chapter 602 - Fiend Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 602 Fiend Mountain
A massive ship—40,000 kilometers longfloated through the outer realm. This ship was Fu Sui’s present cave abode.
These Fifth Tribulation Eminences are really cautious. Fu Sui stood at the top of the massive ancient ship and watched the Fifth Tribulation Eminences gathered on the distant deck. I have to wait for the first batch to come out before the second batch of Fifth Tribulation Eminences are willing to hand over 10,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals.
Although these Fifth Tribulation Eminences were filled with anticipation for the ruin world, they had inculcated great caution from roaming the outer realm.
The 53 Fifth Tribulation Eminences entered in batches.
Each batch was only willing to pay the 10,000 cubes when the batch before them left the ruin world. If they discovered something amiss, they would give up on entering.
I have to be careful. It costs 10,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals. I mustn’t be fooled by Fu Sui. These Fifth Tribulation Eminences came from various river zones. However, most of the members of the Cang Alliance were very familiar with each other. They chatted on the deck.
Huh? The Fifth Tribulation Eminences on the deck looked up. Fu Sui, who was on the highest level of the ancient ship, also looked into the distance.
Black fog condensed, forming a dark-purple-robed man, who looked down coldly.
Huh? The Fifth Tribulation Eminences trembled as they instinctively felt fear.
Boom! An array formation appeared on the ancient boat, isolating the pressure from the outside world.
“Lord Ghostink.”
The Fifth Tribulation Eminences were somewhat stirred. Some Fifth Tribulation Eminences even took the initiative to bow. “Greetings, Lord Ghostink.”
There were a total of eight Sixth Tribulation Eminences in the Cang Alliance. Lord Ghostink was one of them.
Apart from Patriarch Fire Dragon and Lady of Icesoul, who were relatively easy to come into contact with, the other six couldn’t be bothered with Fifth Tribulation Eminences. Lord Ghostink usually couldn’t be bothered to look at these Fifth Tribulation Eminences. Furthermore, in terms of reputation... Lord Ghostink had the worst reputation among the eight Sixth Tribulation Eminences. This was because he was ruthless and unscrupulous. It was said that the higher one’s status was, the more they cared about their reputation. However, Lord Ghostink was one of the rare few who didn’t care about their reputation. “Lord Ghostink.” Fu Sui also appeared. He flew to the edge of the ancient ship’s array formation. With the array formation, he had the confidence to deal with Lord Ghostink.
“Fu Sui?” The purple-robed Lord Ghostink looked at Fu Sui. He could sense that Fu Sui had yet to raise his natural order in life. Fu Sui’s body was clearly still at the Fifth Tribulation realm. It posed zero threat to Lord Ghostink.
Even if their cultivation realms were equal, Lord Ghostink’s body was much stronger than that of Fu Sui. Fu Sui would definitely lose in a head-on battle.
If Fu Sui created a physical body cultivation formulation and raised his body to the Sixth Tribulation realm, Lord Ghostink’s attitude would have changed.
“Fu Sui,” said Lord Ghostink coldly, “is what you’ve been publicly spreading in the Cang Alliance true?”
“I naturally wouldn’t dare lie to the entire Cang Alliance,” said Fu Sui with a smile.
He had also mentioned that one’s Essence Soul would be injured when taking the path of epiphany, and that one’s injuries would be more severe, the further one went. He hadn’t lied, but he hadn’t gone into detail of the path’s danger.
“Sixth Tribulation Eminences can’t enter?” Lord Ghostink looked at Fu Sui.
“When I open the ruin world, I can only bring Fifth Tribulation Eminences in,” said Fu Sui with a humble smile. “If you don’t believe me, Lord Ghostink, I can try bringing you along next time. You will sense the rejection from the ruin.”
Lord Ghostink frowned slightly before saying, “Alright, bring me in next time.”
Fu Sui was stunned. Lord Ghostink really wants to enter? Fu Sui couldn’t help but ask, “Lord Ghostink, you don’t believe me?”
“Give it a try,” said Lord Ghostink indifferently. Fu Sui felt somewhat aggrieved.
An attempt meant he would bring one fewer Fifth Tribulation Eminence during that expedition.
“The next entry time might be 30 years later,” said Fu Sui with a smile. “Lord Ghostink, if you are willing, I’ll bring you in when the time comes. You will know that I’m not lying.”
“Alright.” Lord Ghostink waved his hand and released a black palace. He then entered the palace to wait.
Fu Sui glanced at the distant palace before turning to look at the group of Fifth Tribulation Eminences. He said coldly, “As you have heard, Lord Ghostink wants to give it a try. Therefore, I can only bring seven people in with me during the next batch.” With that said, Fu Sui flew away.
The Black Mountain ruin world attracted more and more attention from the outside world. Even so, Meng Chuan continued to advance through the ruin world slowly.
In the blink of an eye, three years passed.
New cultivators. Meng Chuan could clearly see cultivators moving along the first path far away. They had reached the height where Meng Chuan was.
City Lord Eastcalm?
He has been here for 33 years, right? That’s how high he has climbed?
The third path is indeed difficult.
Four Cang Alliance cultivators were on the first path. They were very close to each other, and they also noticed Meng Chuan on the third
path.
They had been walking for three years while Meng Chuan had been on his path for 33 years. Yet, they had reached the same altitude.
This path of epiphany is indeed magical. The four cultivators could sense their huge gains after three years of epiphanies.
However, one of the five Tribulation Eminences—who had six arms and one eyestopped in his tracks. He jolted awake and looked in Meng Chuan’s direction with lingering fear. I’ve been here for three years. I originally decided to leave immediately after mastering three Fifth Tribulation laws, but the feeling of being in a state of epiphany was too wonderful. I unknowingly walked another year. Thankfully, I saw Eastcalm today.
It was indeed wonderful to be immersed in a state of epiphany. He didn’t want to stop.
Upon seeing Meng Chuan, he thought of Fu Sui, Meng Hu, and Black Wind. Only then did the six-armed, one-eyed cultivator completely calm down. It’s time to leave. My goal was to grasp three Fifth Tribulation laws. I should have returned a year ago. The six-armed, one-eyed cultivator had already grasped two Fifth Tribulation laws before entering the ruin world. He wanted to leave after taking a step forward. This would mitigate any potential disaster.
However, his mind was filled with excitement and zeal after being immersed in a constant state of epiphany, greatly reducing his cautiousness.
This path is a little sinister. The six-armed, one-eyed cultivator looked at the path beneath his feet and immediately stopped thinking. He destroyed his body and Essence Soul.
He gave up after three years?
Fu Sui took this path for 15 years.
The other cultivators continued walking.
Meng Chuan saw everything clearly from the third path. He saw the six-armed, one-eyed cultivator self-destruct and leave.
“His name is Wu Ao, right?” Meng Chuan had information on the Cang Alliance members. “He gave up after walking about 5,000 kilometers on the first path?”
Meng Chuan stopped thinking about it and continued advancing slowly. However, the pressure gradually became stronger and stronger. The further he walked, the clearer he could hear the sounds. However, his willpower had yet to transform.
Meng Chuan knew very well that the first five transformations happened in the second, fifth, tenth, eighteenth, and twenty-ninth year, respectively. The next transformation might happen decades later... The next transformation might take decades, but I’m about to reach my limit. Every step Meng Chuan took was very difficult. I can sense that I can only walk for a few more months.
Every word that echoed in his mind caused his Essence Soul to tremble. Meng Chuan tried his best to perfect his will. This was what cultivation was like.
Even if he found the correct method, he would have to suffer the torment of time. He needed time to accumulate strength slowly and become stronger. This torturous process was actually very difficult. This was because sometimes one’s path might be wrong, meaning that enduring the period of torture was in vain.
The first five transformations made Meng Chuan realize that this path was the correct one for him. He naturally seized the opportunity to persevere.
One step... One more step... As he walked slowly, Meng Chuan’s pace became slower and slower. It became harder and harder for him to resist the aural syllables.
Boom!
When Meng Chuan took another step, a voice echoed in his mind
“Having walked the path of the mind for 5,000 kilometers, you may become an ordinary member of my Fiend Mountain.”
At the same time, information on a mystic technique entered his mind.
With this mystic technique, one could freely enter and exit the Fiend Mountain ruin world.
There are nine entrances and exits to the Fiend Mountain ruin world? They are separately located in nine river zones? Meng Chuan was very shocked. One ruin is connected to nine river zones. The creator of this ruin world clearly had inconceivable accomplishments in spacetime. At the very least, Ancestral Master Archean Eon was far from capable of such a feat. It looks like the creator of Fiend Mountain is an Eighth Tribulation Eminence at least. The creator might even be stronger?
Meng Chuan had guessed that there would be great benefits if he could reach the end of the third path. From the looks of it, traveling 5,000 kilometers on the third path resulted in a benefit. He could now freely enter and exit the ruin.
If I travel further on this third path, I might gain some more benefits. However, the creator of this ruin world named it Fiend Mountain? Meng Chuan was somewhat puzzled.
God was a relatively positive word. Fiend was considered negative.
It’s fine if the outside world called it Fiend Mountain, but the creator themself called it Fiend Mountain? This gave Meng Chuan many ideas.
Let’s continue. After some thought, Meng Chuan continued walking. As expected, Meng Chuan felt his Essence Soul rumble in his sea of consciousness after walking for three more months. It was very difficult for him to remain lucid due to the aural attack, much less advance.
Whoosh. After retreating three steps, the pressure rapidly decreased. I’ve reached my limit. It’s time for me to give up for now. Meng Chuan looked at the mountain path that continued high into the clouds. I’ll give it another try when my mental cultivation has clearly improved. Thankfully, I can enter and exit the ruin world freely now.
Meng Chuan was very glad.
Before I leave... Meng Chuan turned to look at the vast Fiend Mountain range. I have to explore this mountain range and obtain some benefits.
Swoosh!
Meng Chuan followed the third path and quickly flew down the mountain. In contrast to the difficulty of climbing the mountain, going down was quick. He took 33 years to cover 5,000 kilometers, but he descended the mountain in the blink of an eye.

chapters.title: Chapter 603 - Breakthrough, Sixth Tribulation law!
chapters.content:
Chapter 603 Breakthrough, Sixth Tribulation law!
When he reached the foot of the mountain, Meng Chuan turned to look at the three paths.
He knew that Fu Sui, Black Wind, and Meng Hu had left treasures on the first and second paths.
Although I’ve become an ordinary member of Fiend Mountain, I still know very little about its entirety. I can only guess that the creator of Fiend Mountain is an Eighth Tribulation Eminence at least. When facing such an existence, I mustn’t try my luck.
Meng Chuan knew that if the other party was an Eternal existence, they would leave behind some means that could kill him, even with an inhabitable world in the way.
The third path allowed him to become an ordinary member after walking 5,000 kilometers. Thus, continuing to take that path was the best choice.
Fu Sui walked the path of epiphany. He suffered Essence Soul juries.
The average cultivation speed in the entire Fiend Mountain range is dozens of times faster than in the outside world. It will probably cause an Essence Soul injury. Meng Chuan became even more cautious when he sensed his current state. I can’t stay in the ordinary region for too long. I’ll stay for three days. I have to leave in three days.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan instantly split out five Essence Soul avatars. His true body and the five Essence Soul avatars flew in different directions to search the entire Fiend Mountain range.
Fiend Mountain range was rather vast. Apart from the main peak, the other mountain peaks occupied a large section of the mountain range. Due to the ruin world’s suppression, Meng Chuan only explored a small portion of the mountain range during the three days. He discovered seven treasures.
Time to leave. Once the three days were up, Meng Chuan didn’t hesitate to leave.
He cast the mystic technique he obtained from Fiend Mountain. This mystic technique contained the profundities of a spacetime technique. Even ordinary Fifth Tribulation Eminences could grasp it, much less Meng Chuan.
Buzz. He stirred spacetime.
Meng Chuan could sense nine spots in the distance. They were the nine exits connected to the Fiend Mountain ruin world.
Bright River Zone. Meng Chuan chose the exit closest to Goddess River Zone. Bright River Zone was one of the five river zones that neighbored Goddess River Zone.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan felt spacetime distort as it wrapped around him. He constantly sank as he fell towards the exit in Bright River Zone.
When the surrounding spacetime returned to normal, Meng Chuan found himself in the void.
I’m already in Bright River Zone. Meng Chuan sensed his surroundings and was somewhat shocked.
He entered the ruin world via Six Desires River Zone and landed in Bright River Zone upon exiting it. Furthermore, the Fiend Mountain ruin world was actually connected to nine different river zones. Meng Chuan was extremely impressed by this spacetime technique.
Humph.
The moment he came out, Meng Chuan felt his Essence Soul turn dizzy. The dizziness lasted for about 30 seconds before dissipating. His body returned to normal.
It’s about the same as I guessed. Cultivation in the periphery of Fiend Mountain will help, but it will also affect one’s Essence Soul slightly. I’ve only been there for a few days. If I were to cultivate in the mountain range’s periphery for ten or twenty years, my injuries would probably be much more obvious. Fu Sui traveled on the path of epiphany for 15 years. I wonder how severe his Essence Soul injuries are.
Essence Soul injuries also depended on the strength of one’s Essence Soul. If one were an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence or an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence, it would be very difficult for their Essence Souls to suffer even light injuries.
Fu Sui’s Essence Soul was inferior to Meng Chuan’s. Meng Chuan guessed that Fu Sui’s injuries were probably not light.
Time to return. Meng Chuan was in a good mood as he rushed towards Goddess River Zone.
Bright River Zone was very near. He could return to Three Bay River System in 16 hours.
On the ancient ship.
Fu Sui looked in the direction of Goddess River Zone and smiled. Eastcalm has finally destroyed his body and left the ruin world.
Since they were both at the Fifth Tribulation realm, he could only vaguely sense Meng Chuan’s location. Through karma, he could sense that Meng Chuan’s many avatars were in Goddess River Zone.
Bright River Zone was also close to Goddess River Zone. From Fu Sui’s location, it was indeed in the same direction.
He didn’t agree when I offered him 3,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals previously. It’s only been a few years, but didn’t he end up leaving on his own? Fu Sui shook his head slightly. Did he really think he could last for a century or two?
Fu Sui’s eyes were filled with anger.
In the past, Fu Sui had befriended many people and had many friends. However, after walking the path of epiphany for 15 years and comprehending a Sixth Tribulation law—which resulted in Essence Soul injuries—he became a lot more callous.
Fu Sui also realized that he had become more callous and ruthless. For example, he had killed 15 Fifth Tribulation Eminences in a row. He didn’t have any major grudges with most of them. He only had small conflicts with them. If it were the past Fu Sui, he wouldn’t have had the intention to kill. Fu Sui only treated this change as a natural change in his mental state after he became stronger and was forced by the circumstances of having his Essence Soul injured.
He felt that this was a very normal change.
In fact, Fu Sui didn’t realize that his mental state had already changed even though he felt ‘normal.’
Not far from the ancient ship, in the palace.
Dressed in a dark purple robe, Lord Ghostink stared at the ancient ship in the distance and pondered. Could that black mountain ruin be the Fiend Mountain I heard of?
If it’s really Fiend Mountain, the so-called path of epiphany will really be filled with endless disasters. Lord Ghostink narrowed his eyes. He had the worst reputation among the Cang Alliance’s Sixth Tribulation Eminences. He did things unscrupulously, but it was undeniable that Lord Ghostink placed great importance on any possible opportunities. He also investigated all opportunities. In terms of strength, he was only ordinary amongst Sixth Tribulation Eminences. However, in terms of being privy to intelligence, Lord Ghostink was one of the best connected Sixth Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime.
However, according to legend, the second and third paths of Fiend Mountain can be traversed. To me, the second path is the most suitable. However, it’s too difficult for me to enter at the Sixth Tribulation realm.
Perhaps I’m wrong. This black mountain ruin might just be a replica of the legendary Fiend Mountain.
Very few people in the River of Spacetime knew of Fiend Mountain’s legend.
Lord Ghostink was only lucky enough to have an inkling about it. After hearing the news from Fu Sui and company, he immediately came to confirm if it was Fiend Mountain and see if he could enter.
Three Bay River System, Thousand Mountain Star, Eastcalm City.
Meng Chuan cultivated in peace.
Now that it was becoming harder and harder to improve his mental cultivation, Meng Chuan no longer hesitated. He began to comprehend a Sixth Tribulation law.
Boom! Meng Chuan sat cross-legged on the building’s top floor. Lightning began to rumble above him.
Black clouds and lightning filled the sky above Eastcalm City.
“What’s going on in Eastcalm City today?”
“Why is there so much lightning?”
Many cultivators in Eastcalm City looked up in puzzlement. Countless bolts of lightning spread everywhere. It wasn’t just Eastcalm City, but even the vast area visible to the naked eye was filled with dark clouds and lightning.
On the building.
Meng Chuan’s Dao became clearer as he sat cross-legged.
Lightning!
The Dao affected one’s heart. If one used evil laws as their foundation, they would eventually become evil and crazy. Some would even self-destruct. Therefore, one had to figure out the Dao they chose over and over again when cultivating. They had to repeatedly adjust it slightly before finally finding the most suitable Dao.
In fact, most Sixth Tribulation Eminences had the correct path.
On the contrary, mistakes were very rare. Even Old Fiend Black Wind was able to confirm that the six Eminences he had possessed all followed wrong paths. Thus, making a mistake seemed unbelievable. If even he could discover the mistakes, why didn’t the six Eminences realize that they had taken the wrong path? Or were the Eminences he possessed on the second path all fake Eminences?
Lightning law. Not long after Meng Chuan’s Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique reached the Fifth Tribulation realm, he confirmed his target.
Lightning was one of the orthodox paths.
He was very familiar with lightning. Infinite Saber’s speed could reach lightning speed. Nirvana Saber could attain the destructive might of lightning. Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique could transform into a lightning domain.
The three fused with a portion of his insights, undergoing a qualitative change. It was very easy for them to condense a complete lightning law. Meng Chuan was so frightened that he stopped cultivating in the Fiend Mountain ruin world because he felt that he was within reach of the Sixth Tribulation law.
Now, he was immersed in his insights. Today was only a particular day in the second year since he returned to Three Bay River System.
Boom!
Meng Chuan opened his eyes. Not only was endless lightning above Thousand Mountain Star, but his eyes were also filled with lightning

chapters.title: Chapter 604 - Essence Soul World
chapters.content:
Chapter 604 Essence Soul World
Lightning law. The moment Meng Chuan completely understood it, he felt his body transform.
Be it in an inhabited world or the outer realm, lightning was one of the most fundamental forces.
Lightning existed everywhere in the normal void.
In the past, he could control very little of it. Now that he had completely grasped the lightning law, he could control the power of lightning by a hundred-fold more than what he was previously capable of. Every move he made had the power to destroy the world. He could easily shatter a Grand Yang Star with a flip of his hand.
Through lightning, I can sense a much wider area than before. Meng Chuan looked into the distance.
Swoosh!
Meng Chuan transformed into a bolt of lightning. The lightning formed by the particle streams shuttled through the spacetime rift. In a flash, he arrived in the void billions of kilometers away.
He didn’t deliberately stop time. He just flew normally.
I can travel billions of kilometers in a second? Meng Chuan was somewhat astonished. Sixth Tribulation Eminences truly have unfathomable means. Those who can control lightning are famous for their speed. I’m indeed getting faster and faster.
Lightning contained the mysteries of time and space. A bolt of lightning that tore through spacetime was fast and unpredictable.
He could change directions however he wanted. One moment, he was charging forward at full speed, and in the next moment, the lightning would reach maximum speed in the opposite direction. Even among Sixth Tribulation laws, the lightning law was the best when it came to speed and changes. Of course, different Sixth Tribulation laws had their own strengths.
Crackle!
Meng Chuan—who was in the form of a particle-constantly traversed the spacetime rift.
My current state is very special. Meng Chuan sensed his body and completely disintegrated, becoming a true bolt of lightning.
Lightning was invisible.
As the poem goes, drawing a saber to cut through water would only make water flow even faster! If he used his saber to slice through lightning, it would be difficult for him to affect the lightning at all. Although Meng Chuan’s lightning form couldn’t be considered an undying body, his life-preservation means had improved greatly. After grasping the lightning law, my body can transform into lightning. It will be difficult for an enemy to injure me. Meng Chuan sighed in amazement. He stopped and returned to his human form.
Standing in the outer realm void, Meng Chuan restrained himself from afar. “Heavenly lightning, descend!” Instantly, lightning within a 50 billion-kilometer radius gathered. In a completely scattered state, lightning was difficult to see with the naked eye. However, after all the lightning within a 50 billion-kilometer radius gathered, it became a corporeal bolt of lightning that was tens of thousands of kilometers long.
Boom!
The bolt of lightning tore through the outer realm, forming a pitch-black spatial rift. Following that, the black rift slowly recovered.
Without using a Tribulation treasure, this is the strongest move I can unleash. Even Cave Lord Scenic Cloud will probably be reduced to dust instantly. Meng Chuan could sense its might, but he wasn’t surprised. A lightning law was one of the strongest offensive laws among Sixth Tribulation laws.
And my Essence Soul World... Meng Chuan’s expression was somewhat complicated. With a thought
Whoosh! A vast illusory world spread out, enveloping a four-million-kilometer area.
My Essence Soul World has expanded. Meng Chuan inspected his Essence Soul World. In the past, his Essence Soul World had three different complementary laws-Infinite Saber, Nirvana Saber, and Cloud Dragon Snake Movement Technique. Now, his Essence Soul World only had one law left-a lightning law.
In the vast world, lightning flashed in the clouds high in the sky. Tall mountains were also constantly struck by lightning. Countless lightning bolts gathered in many areas, forming a sea of lightning-a lake of lightning. This was an Essence Soul World with a lightning law as its foundation. Many illusory creatures had lightning characteristics. My Essence Soul World. Meng Chuan could sense how powerful his Essence Soul World was.
With his illusory world enveloping the area, his control over electromagnetic forces had reached an unimaginable level. Ordinary Fifth Tribulation Eminences would be torn apart and disintegrated when they entered his Essence Soul World.
With his strength increasing so much, Meng Chuan felt immense pressure.
My mental cultivation can indeed withstand the lightning law.
When one’s Essence Soul World transformed, the sixth Essence Soul Heavenly Tribulation would descend in about 100 years. The pressure on Meng Chuan was quite great.
He didn’t know if his mental cultivation could withstand the lightning law before entering the ruin world. However, after his mind and willpower transformed five times on Fiend Mountain’s third path, he could now withstand the lightning law.
I hope my mental cultivation level is higher than the Sixth Tribulation realm’s threshold. Meng Chuan silently looked forward to it. The higher his mental cultivation level, the greater his chances of transcending the sixth Heavenly Tribulation. I wonder what I will encounter during the sixth Essence Soul Tribulation.
Essence Soul Tribulations were even more ethereal than Physical Body Tribulations.
Physical Body Tribulations’ tests were much clearer in comparison. Meng Chuan had already transcended five Heavenly Tribulations with his body. He transcended them easily every time. This was because his body was perfect among Physical Body Fifth Tribulation Eminences. There were no surprises.
This was the case for Physical Body Tribulation Eminences. As long as one’s body reached the standard in all aspects or if one’s cultivation was stronger than the standard, one would have a high chance of transcending the tribulation.
Before transcending an Essence Soul Tribulation, one wouldn’t have the confidence.
Boom!
After practicing in the outer realm for an hour and familiarizing himself with his current means, Meng Chuan returned to Thousand Mountain Star.
The cultivators on Thousand Mountain Star didn’t know that a new Sixth Tribulation Eminence had been born in Three Bay River System.
Unlike Fu Sui—who was at the half-step Sixth Tribulation realm and had the least strength, Meng Chuan could be considered a true Sixth Tribulation Eminence. He only had one final trial left-Tribulation Transcendence.
Archean Eon Realm was as peaceful as ever.
With Meng Chuan present in this era—the second strongest existence in Archean Eon Realm’s history-Archean Eon Realm didn’t need to worry about any external threats. It was also supplied with large amounts of resources and could expand greatly.
Tribulation Transcendence. Meng Chuan sat in Archean Mountain’s Grotto-Heaven Pavilion, drinking as he pondered.
There’s not much I can do when facing the Heavenly Tribulation. Meng Chuan pondered. The first thing is that I have to strengthen my World Treasure. The second thing is to continue improving my mental cultivation.
If he could grasp stronger laws and make his Essence Soul World stronger, it would naturally help him transcend the tribulation easier.
However, no matter how monstrous Meng Chuan was, it was difficult for him to undergo a qualitative transformation within 100 years.
Therefore, he could only focus on two other aspects. A World Treasure can stabilize one’s Essence Soul World. It also increases one’s chances of resisting the Heavenly Tribulation. It is the best solution that shows effects the fastest. Meng Chuan put down his cup and stood up to head to Heaven and Earth Great Hall’s grotto-heaven.
Heaven and Earth Great Hall. Meng Chuan entered the hall and walked past many ancient halls. Soon, he arrived at a familiar hall.
White fog flew out from the hall’s walls and condensed into a white-robed elder. He smiled at Meng Chuan. “Meng Chuan, are you here to obtain treasures or to confirm your strength?”
“Confirm my strength,” said Meng Chuan. “You are very familiar with the rules. Attack that pillar with all your might.” The white-robed elder smiled as he pointed at the cyan pillar.
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. He extended his right hand, and a Lightning Seal appeared in his palm. It was the Thousand Lightning Dharma Seal. Although the Thousand Lightning Dharma Seal wasn’t too precious, it was very suitable for an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence like Meng Chuan-who had grasped a law of lightning.
Go.
Boom!
The Thousand Lightning Dharma Seal suddenly transformed into a terrifying bolt of lightning. The bolt of lightning was only ten feet long, but it wouldn’t suffer any damage even if it pierced through a Grand Yang Star. At that moment, it struck the cyan pillar with all its might. Layers of runes appeared on the cyan pillar. Instantly, countless runes shattered until ten layers were destroyed in a row. Soon, new runes condensed and regenerated.
“You shattered ten layers?” The white-robed elder was stunned. “Sixth Tribulation realm?”
He had been watching Meng Chuan’s growth all this while. Meng Chuan hadn’t cultivated for long, yet he was already at the Sixth Tribulation realm?
“I haven’t transcended the tribulation yet,” said Meng Chuan.

chapters.title: Chapter 605 - World Treasure
chapters.content:
Chapter 605 World Treasure
The white-robed elder looked at Meng Chuan and sighed. “After all these years, Master’s homeworld is finally about to produce a Sixth Tribulation Eminence. Archean Eon Realm can finally grow again.”
“I can only help Archean Eon Realm after I transcend the tribulation,” said Meng Chuan.
A small tree needed soil, water, sunlight, and time to grow. The growth of an inhabited world was even more complicated. It required much more time. It also required a Sixth Tribulation Eminence to preside over it.
“Meng Chuan, I believe you will definitely succeed in transcending the tribulation,” said the white-robed elder with a smile. “However, I have some bad news for you.”
“Oh?” Meng Chuan looked at the white-robed elder.
“If you fail to transcend the tribulation, you can only obtain treasures that don’t exceed 1,000,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals from Archean Eon’s treasure vault,” said the white-robed elder. “Taking into account the 300,000 cubes from before, the total cannot exceed 1.3 million cubes. This is the quota set by Master.”
Though this was the case, Meng Chuan was very satisfied. With a total of 1.3 million cubes worth of treasures, Ancestral Master Archean Eon had given enough to his descendants! Meng Chuan was very grateful.
According to what he knew, very few Sixth Tribulation Eminences could accumulate more than a million cubes by themselves.
“Master also did this because he took Archean Eon Realm’s future into account,” said the white-robed elder. “After you transcend the tribulation, according to your age, you will obtain many more treasures than what you have now.”
“Many more?” Meng Chuan was surprised.
“When Master became a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, he left all his years of savings in his homeworld. If you have great potential, I can give you a maximum of half the treasures,” said the white-robed elder with a smile. “If you are very old after transcending the tribulation and have very low potential, the treasures you obtain will decrease accordingly.”Our 1 file is being uploaded to: up “Half?” Meng Chuan was alarmed.
According to what he knew, Ancestral Master Archean Eon had lived for more than 100,000 years at the Seventh Tribulation realm. Furthermore, he died of old age. Over the years, he had accumulated a terrifying amount of resources.
If a junior was a Sixth Tribulation Eminence with extremely high potential, they could obtain a maximum of half his treasures? Just how much was a half? Meng Chuan was alarmed by the mere thought of it.
One had to know that Eighth Tribulation treasures and rare treasures like Small Universe were treasures that Sixth Tribulation Eminences couldn’t obtain, despite how much they yearned for one. However, Ancestral Master Archean Eon had a pile of such treasures. Elsewhere, these treasures couldn’t be bought even if one had the necessary Outer Realm Essence Crystals. This was because the more precious the treasures were, the less there were. For example, there were very few copies of the Void Catalog. As for the treasures even more precious than the Void Catalog, they were probably unique in the outer realm or only numbered a handful.
As they were too rare, they typically had to be obtained through barters!
Only Seventh Tribulation Eminences—who stood at the pinnacle of the River of Spacetime —could control such resources.
Meng Chuan knew about these resources.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon had also forbidden him from delving deeper into some treasures. They were clearly more special.
It’s no wonder those high-level worlds are still so powerful even though their Eighth Tribulation Eminences are no longer around. Meng Chuan sighed inwardly.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures were shocking enough. What level were the treasures left behind by an Eighth Tribulation Eminence?
He only knew that most Seventh Tribulation Eminences’ homeworlds declined, but most high-level worlds remained constantly prosperous.
Even if an Eighth Tribulation Eminence was a special lifeform, they would be able to produce a powerful species like the dragons and phoenixes if they focused on perfecting their race’s bloodline. Their bloodline could then pass down for generations.
If I can reach the Eighth Tribulation realm in my life, my homeworld-Archean Eon Realm
— will be dazzling for countless years. Meng Chuan had that thought at that very moment. However, he knew that it was too far away from him.
A total of 1.3 million cubes was a gift from Ancestral Master Archean Eon to a Sixth Tribulation junior who was about to transcend the tribulation. Meng Chuan completely understood Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s rationale. After all, failure meant that everything would be for naught. Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s investment could be described as significant.
I’ve spent a lot. Thankfully, I’ve earned quite a bit as well. Over the years, Meng Chuan had spent a lot on his cultivation, treasures, and array formations. The Void Catalog’s third volume was his greatest investment.
Thankfully, he had earned a lot. Considering the basic-level Eternal Token, the wiping out of Three Bay River System’s plundering factions, and the spoils gained from Fiend Mountain, he still had over 50,000 cubes remaining
That makes it 1,350,000 cubes. Meng Chuan sat in Grotto-Heaven Pavilion’s backyard and pondered. I mainly need to do three things. First, I need to prepare for Tribulation Transcendence. Second, I need to prepare some longevity extension treasures. Third, I need to make preparations for my homeworld. Before transcending the tribulation, he had to awaken his parents, father-in-law, and Qiyue to extend their lifespans.
If he failed to transcend the tribulation, no one could extend their lifespans.
Secondly, what would happen to his homeworld if he failed to transcend the tribulation? He naturally had to consider his homeworld. Emperor Roc’s outer realm true body was still imprisoned by him, so he had to resolve this problem before transcending the tribulation.
A total of 1.35 million cubes. Meng Chuan pondered. Longevity extension treasures will use up a huge portion of it.
If they were ordinary longevity extension treasures, even a Fifth Tribulation Eminence could afford them. They only cost a few thousand cubes! However, the stronger the cultivator and the more special their bloodline was, the greater the price of extending their lifespans. For example, Great Solar Godfiends and Marquis Godfiends were all below the Supremacy realm. A few thousand cubes worth of longevity extension treasures could extend their lifespans by centuries. To extend their lifespans to the threshold of 2,000 years, 10,000 cubes were enough. Spending 30,000 cubes for the three elders was definitely sufficient. It was relatively easy for Meng Chuan.
However, it was different for his wife. His wife had a phoenix bloodline, and she had already awakened Phoenix Divine Fire. It was harder to extend her lifespan than ordinary Supremacies. But his wife was still relatively weak. The difficulty of extending her lifespan should be lower than that of an Imperial Lord.
I’ll probably need 50,000 cubes to extend Qiyue’s lifespan by 2,000 years. As for extending her lifespan further, the price will be even higher.
There were three major thresholds for lifespans.
The first threshold was 2,000 years. Mortals could obtain rare treasures in an inhabited world to live for centuries. It was even easier to find treasures in the outer realm that could extend one’s lifespan to 2,000 years.
The second threshold was 5,000 years. Living beings below the Imperial Lord realm had a maximum lifespan of 5,000 years! This was the River of Spacetime’s law. It couldn’t be broken. If Meng Chuan wanted his wife to live for more than 2,000 years, the price would be greater. The third threshold was 100,000 years. This was the limit of an Imperial Lord’s lifespan. Imperial Lords usually had a 10,000-year lifespan. It was very difficult for them to extend their lifespans. The price of extending their lifespans by 10,000 years was very terrifying. However, if they were lucky and obtained some legendary treasures, they could theoretically have a 100,000-year lifespan. Of course, it was very difficult for them to chance upon such great luck in any era in the River of Spacetime. It was much harder than producing a Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
As for extending the lifespans for Tribulation Eminences? Most of them didn’t bother spending any effort.
This was because an additional two to three centuries was meaningless when they already had long lifespans. It didn’t match the effort they needed to put in. As for extending their lifespans by more than 10,000 years? The price was enough to leave them in despair. In this era, apart from me, Archean Eon Realm doesn’t have a single Imperial Lord. If I fail to transcend the tribulation, Archean Eon Realm will rapidly decline. Meng Chuan frowned slightly. I can only pin my hopes on Master, who has already comprehended a Heaven Earth realm law.
Qin Wu had comprehended a Heaven Earth realm law, but his Essence Soul realm was lacking.
Meng Chuan could only provide better conditions and guidance on cultivation. Cultivation ultimately depended on oneself. Even Ancestral Master Archean Eon could only hope that Archean Eon Realm’s descendants could produce geniuses over a long period of time. At the very least, when Ancestral Master Archean Eon was alive, he could nurture a few Imperial Lords. He had already done plenty by nurturing an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence.
I have to extend Master’s lifespan. Master is a Supremacy. He doesn’t have a special bloodline. The difficulty of extending his lifespan is lower than Qiyue’s. However, Master already has a 2,000-year lifespan. The price to break the threshold for him isn’t small either.
Quite a bit is needed for longevity extension. I’ll just refine one World Treasure.
Just one World Treasure was enough to transcend the tribulation.
World Treasures were the greatest expenditure for Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences. World Treasures could make an illusory Essence Soul World more corporeal. Their strength would increase greatly, and their Essence Soul would become more stable. Be it when facing enemies, protecting oneself, or transcending tribulations, World Treasures were most helpful.
World Treasures at the Essence Soul Fifth Tribulation realm typically cost thousands of cubes! Most Sixth Tribulation World Treasures cost more than 100,000 cubes.
I can save on other things, but I can’t save on the World Treasure. Meng Chuan pondered. I’ll use the best materials to refine it. I have grasped a lightning law. The most suitable refinement material is Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand. I have to buy one grain.
Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand had a very special background. Legend had it that a Physical Body Eighth Tribulation Eminence faced their ninth Heavenly Tribulation on a Primordial Star.
The ninth Physical Body Heavenly Tribulation was the Tribulation of Lightning Punishment. The Primordial Star struck by it completely shattered, forming special materials under the Lightning Punishment. It was known as Nine Tribulation Lightning Sand.
It was an unsolved mystery whether the Eighth Tribulation Eminence who had transcended the tribulation succeeded or failed. However, Nine Tribulation Lightning Sand was indeed the best lightning lineage material in the River of Spacetime. At the very least, based on Meng Chuan’s knowledge, it was ranked first.
It was traded by the grain, and every grain of Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand was extremely precious and difficult to buy.
A World Treasure that uses Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand as its core is the most suitable for me. My Essence Soul will be more stable, and my chances of transcending the tribulation will be much higher.
The additional stability of an Essence Soul might mean the difference between a successful or failed Tribulation Transcendence.
Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand was not only useful to lightning law cultivators.
Unfortunately, Ancestral Master Archean Eon doesn’t cultivate the lightning lineage. Therefore, he didn’t deliberately gather Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand despite having collected a lot of treasures. Meng Chuan pondered. There were many treasures in the outer realm void. Even an Eighth Tribulation Eminence didn’t have that much time and energy to collect them all.
I have to find it through Eternal Tower’s channels, and I have to do it as soon as possible. If I can’t find it, I have to change to another material, Meng Chuan thought to himself. He would be transcending the tribulation in about 100 years. He only had a short time to gather the materials. If he couldn’t find the materials, he could only give up on the Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand.

chapters.title: Chapter 606 - Eighth Tribulation Treasure
chapters.content:
Chapter 606 Eighth Tribulation Treasure
Thousand Mountain Star, Eternal Tower’s ninth floor.
Meng Chuan stood there and looked at the massive number of illusory treasures floating around him.
Eternal Tower doesn’t have any Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand in its vaults. Meng Chuan checked them over and over again. He also understood that an ultimate technique like the Void Catalog could be rewritten by an Eminence who had comprehended the Dao of Space. Therefore, it could be sold publicly.
Likewise, rare treasures were occasionally produced in the outer realm. However, Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand was only produced when that particular Eighth Tribulation Eminence transcended the tribulation. It had to be produced in a special environment with the special method that the Eighth Tribulation Eminence used to resist the lightning tribulation. All these factors combined resulted in the Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand’s birth.
It was difficult for it to be produced again. Every grain used was one less grain. Even Eighth Tribulation Eminences placed great importance on it. This was because every grain of Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand contained the power of the ninth Heavenly Tribulation.
There’s no other way to find it in a short period of time. Meng Chuan looked up. As the administrator of this Eternal Tower branch, he activated Eternal Tower’s array formation, causing a huge eye to appear above him. This eye had some characteristics of the Eye of Eternal.
“I’m willing to offer an Eighth Tribulation treasure, the Heart of Immeasurable, as a bounty for one grain of Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand,” said Meng Chuan. With a wave of his hand, the Heart of Immeasurable appeared beside him.
The Heart of Immeasurable was fist-sized. It constantly expanded and contracted, and countless runes appeared on its surface.
Meng Chuan only recorded the appearance of what he had seen before.
“Confirm the bounty commission?” asked the giant eye.
“Yes,” said Meng Chuan. He felt mixed emotions. The first Eighth Tribulation treasure he exchanged from Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasure vault was used for selling.
If he succeeded in transcending the tribulation, he would definitely repay Archean Eon Realm. This was the only way to repay Ancestral Master Archean Eon.
In just a few seconds, the giant eye above said, “The bounty has been issued.”
Meng Chuan left the Eternal Tower branch and landed on a mountain peak on Thousand Mountain Star. He looked at the large number of cultivators in Eastcalm City from afar.
If I fail to transcend the tribulation, Eastcalm City will be gone, and Three Bay River System will return to its former chaos. Meng Chuan suddenly sighed. This was how the outer realm was. An Eminence decided the order! Once the Eminence passed away, the order would collapse.
The weak could abide by the order that existed.
The weak suffered the most when there was no order. In the best-case scenario, they would be squeezed dry. Their precious items could only be sold at low prices. In the worst-case scenario, they would be hunted and slaughtered.
I’m selling the Heart of Immeasurable this time. Meng Chuan still felt some pressure. After all, it was an Eighth Tribulation treasure. The Heart of Immeasurable is the cheapest Eighth Tribulation treasure in Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasure vault. Ancestral Master Archean Eon set the price of this treasure as 180,000 cubes for his descendants. It’s not a loss to exchange it for a grain of Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand.
An Eighth Tribulation treasure could only be refined by an Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
There were very few Eighth Tribulation Eminences in the history of the outer realm. Eternal existences were even more ethereal legends. Therefore, the number of Eighth Tribulation treasures was limited. At the very least, most Sixth Tribulation Eminences yearned for them but couldn’t obtain them. Typically, they had a starting price of 150,000 cubes. It was normal for the prices of good treasures to increase by several-fold.
Most importantly, very few of such transactions would occur in the outside world.
The Heart of Immeasurable that Meng Chuan had taken out this time was an introductory step to the Immeasurable lineage. It contained complete spatial laws and temporal laws!
Every Eighth Tribulation treasure came equipped with complete spatial laws and temporal laws. This was also one of the reasons why Eighth Tribulation treasures were so valuable. It was also why Seventh Tribulation Eminences desperately sought them. To Seventh Tribulation Eminences, different Eighth Tribulation treasures allowed them to study time and space from different angles. Since Seventh Tribulation Eminences desperately searched for such treasures, demand outstripped supply. Thus, Eighth Tribulation treasures were naturally expensive. Although Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand was more special and rare, it was ultimately just a raw material. According to his understanding of the outer realm, Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand was slightly less attractive than an Eighth Tribulation treasure.
When the bounty was announced, all the Eminences in the River of Spacetime learned about it.
In a mystic realm, a sleeping scarlet dragon opened its eyes amidst the endless flames. An Eighth Tribulation treasure, the Heart of Immeasurable?
As a Sixth Tribulation Eminence, he had long been monitoring the available Eighth Tribulation treasures through his Eternal Tower token. He was the first to know anything about Eighth Tribulation treasures.
He was willing to use all his treasures to exchange for an Eighth Tribulation treasure suitable for him.
A bounty for a grain of Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand? The scarlet dragon frowned slightly, feeling somewhat indignant. It’s another barter!
The more precious and rare an item was, the more likely it would be bartered.
He couldn’t buy an Eighth Tribulation treasure. He didn’t have a grain of Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand either.
It’s said that all Eighth Tribulation Eminences in history have sought Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand. Most of Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand grains have landed in various high-level worlds. The scarlet dragon sighed. I knew it wouldn’t be easy to obtain an Eighth Tribulation treasure.
He closed his eyes and continued sleeping. He knew that an Eighth Tribulation treasure was nothing but a pipe dream for him.
An Eighth Tribulation treasure as a bounty reward issued through Eternal Tower? I wonder who the owner of the Heart of Immeasurable is. In a mysterious place in the Chaos Void, endless gray fog spread out. A gray-robed man took form. His robe had blood-colored patterns on it. His three eyes were gray. If I know who the owner is, I can snatch it directly.
The benefit of transactions through Eternal Tower was its confidentiality. The administrator of the Eternal Tower branch was Meng Chuan himself, so he didn’t need to worry about the news being leaked.
“I’m willing to pay 250,000 cubes to buy the Heart of Immeasurable.” In an Eternal Tower river zone branch, the administrator was a short, fat elder. His hair was disheveled, and his eyes were bloodshot. He said anxiously, “Eye of Eternal, send a message to the bounty issuer. I’ll buy the Heart of Immeasurable for 250,000 cubes.”
In the Eternal Tower trading network, the Eighth Tribulation treasure attracted the attention of many Eminences. Even several Seventh Tribulation Eminences paid attention to this matter. However, the bolt of Ninth Heavenly Tribulation Lightning contained in Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand was equally important to Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
The Heart of Immeasurable was only at the bottom of Eighth Tribulation treasures. They typically had several Eighth Tribulation treasures in their possession, so there was no need for them to use a grain of Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand to exchange for it.
As for Sixth Tribulation Eminences? They wanted the Heart of Immeasurable fervently, but most of them didn’t have a grain of Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand. After all, they were treasures of the same level.
A high-level world—Cosmos Realm.
The Cosmos Body cultivation system was one of the best in the outer realm.
“Everyone, the bounty Eternal Tower has just announced is for a grain of Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand. The reward will be an Eighth Tribulation treasure, the Heart of Immeasurable,” said a silver-haired man sitting in the second seat of a grand hall. “The Immeasurable law is the core of our Cosmos Body cultivation system! I think we have to obtain this Eighth Tribulation treasure that will guide us in our Immeasurable lineage.”
“Haha, our Cosmos Realm has more than one Eighth Tribulation treasure that provides guidance for the Immeasurable lineage,” said an elder with a laugh.
“Different Eminences have different refining methods. This Heart of Immeasurable might give us different insights,” said the silver-haired man.
“Our Cosmos Realm only has 15 grains. I think we should weigh the pros and cons carefully.”
“Be careful.”
“Teng Jiuyu, you already have an Eighth Tribulation treasure. There’s no need for you to obtain the Heart of Immeasurable anymore.” Most of the experts in the hall objected.
The silver-haired man sat there and coldly said, “Seniors, you have already escaped Samsara. You are undying and indestructible. I’m the only Sixth Tribulation Eminence in Cosmos Realm presently. I still hope to advance further... I hope to grasp the Immeasurable law completely and reach the Seventh Tribulation realm. I can sense that this Heart of Immeasurable is completely different from the Immeasurable Divine Spear that I have. I must obtain this Heart of Immeasurable.”
The surrounding Eminences hesitated.
Teng Jiuyu was the strongest expert in Cosmos Realm presently, so he was naturally special.
“I shall use the 120,000 credits I have accumulated, together with a 30,000 credit debt to my homeworld. Can I use this as a price to exchange for a grain of Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand?” Teng Jiuyu’s gaze swept across the various Eminences.
“Debt? You wish to owe credits?” asked the elder.
“Alright.” The only tall man sitting in the hall looked down and smiled. “I’ll add 30,000 credits to Jiuyu’s account. As such, he shall exchange 150,000 credits for a grain of Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand. I doubt anyone has any objections, right?”
“We naturally have no objections to His Majesty’s request.” Everyone present bowed respectfully. “Thank you, Your Majesty.” The silver-haired man was extremely respectful.
The tall man sitting in the hall smiled as he looked down. He nodded and said, “It’s been a long time since our Cosmos Realm has produced a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Jiuyu, it’s up to you.”
“I’ll naturally do my best,” replied the silver-haired man respectfully.
Ten hours after Meng Chuan issued the bounty.
The bounty has been answered? On the ninth floor of Eternal Tower, Meng Chuan was filled with delight. Using an Eighth Tribulation treasure as a bounty reward is very efficient!

chapters.title: Chapter 607 - Lord Ghostink
chapters.content:
Chapter 607 Lord Ghostink
With a flip of his hand, Meng Chuan took out the Eighth Tribulation treasure—Heart of Immeasurable.
The black-brown heart floated in the hall on the ninth floor of Eternal Tower. It expanded and contracted rhythmically.
Badump! Badump! Badump!
The sound of a beating heart echoed in the hall. Meng Chuan felt uncomfortable when he heard the sound. This was without a master controlling the treasure.
Teleport. Meng Chuan activated the item teleportation function through Eternal Tower.
Any Eternal Tower branch could teleport items.
Meng Chuan didn’t need to pay any price for the bounty. However, he needed to pay 100 cubes to teleport the item to a distant river zone.
However, be it Meng Chuan or Teng Jiuyu from Cosmos Realm, they would close the deal through Eternal Tower’s teleportation function. Firstly, it was safe. They didn’t need to worry about information leaks. Secondly, the items would be appraised by Eternal Tower. They didn’t need to worry about receiving fakes.
Of course, this was only the cost of teleporting items. The price of teleporting cultivators was much greater.
The other party accepted the bounty. According to the rules, they have to hand over the treasure within two hours. Meng Chuan sat cross-legged and waited. No one dared to accept a bounty and not hand over the treasures. If they broke the transaction rules, they would be severely punished by Eternal Tower.
Time slowly passed.
After nearly an hour, Meng Chuan felt the void distort as an item appeared out of thin air.
It’s here. Meng Chuan suppressed his excitement and stared at the item excitedly. The grain of Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand was a stone the size of a finger.
At a glance, he could see many distorted patterns on the surface. The patterns looked like ripples on the surface of a lake. When he looked at them with the naked eye, he could even vaguely sense the ripples moving. These ripples aren’t moving. It’s a distortion of spacetime. Meng Chuan quickly confirmed.
The stone remained suspended in midair. Spacetime around it changed, making it seem like it was moving. Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand? It looks very ordinary. Meng Chuan examined it. However, it has many similarities with Primordial Stones.
Primordial Stones were extremely round.
When the Power of Essence Soul viewed it with microscopic vision, a tiny particle could appear bigger than a Grand Yang Star. However, when one looked at a Primordial Stone’s surface, it remained smooth at every magnification.
This grain of Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand is similar to Primordial Stones. It also has the Eternal characteristic. However, there are ripples on its surface. In fact, the more magnified it is, the more complicated the patterns are. Meng Chuan didn’t sense the Ninth Heavenly Tribulation Lightning Punishment contained within the Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand. However, the more he looked at the patterns, the more he liked them.
Just like how some mortals liked flowers and grass, while others liked cats and dogs.
As a Tribulation Eminence that grasped a lightning law, Meng Chuan instinctively liked these ripples. He felt that they were more beautiful than any other painting in the world.
Zoom in. Meng Chuan used his microscopic vision to examine the Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand. Thankfully, there aren’t many patterns on it. When I magnify it to the size of a 5,000-kilometer-wide planet, the smallest pattern is akin to a strand of hair.
At first glance, there were many patterns. However, an Eminence like Meng Chuan could memorize all of them with one look.
If I continue zooming in, the surface of the Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand grain will appear very smooth, as smooth as a Primordial Stone.
