Therefore, it only has more ripples than a Primordial Stone on the surface. Its color will also change. Meng Chuan was somewhat puzzled. With his ability, he could only discover such tiny differences.
I’ll send it back to my homeworld. Meng Chuan didn’t think too much about it. He immediately left Thousand Mountain Star and returned to Archean Eon Realm via the River of Spacetime.
After sending the grain of Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand to Archean Eon Realm, Meng Chuan wasn’t in a hurry to refine it. Instead, he began painting.
In the grotto-heaven where the Heaven and Earth Great Hall was located, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World enveloped the entire grotto-heaven.
Whoosh.
A huge piece of paper condensed from the void. With Meng Chuan’s current realm, his Essence Soul World could condense ordinary illusory objects into reality.
A piece of paper floated in the air as countless patterns were drawn on it. It was completed in a moment.
It’s easily drawn. Ordinary paper can depict it. Meng Chuan was somewhat puzzled. He waved his hand and put away the huge piece of paper in midair. He vaguely felt that his realm was still a little low. The Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand was special. There were too many things he couldn’t figure out.
I’ll begin refining the World Treasure. Meng Chuan sat cross-legged on the grass. He took out a flask of fruit wine and drank two mouthfuls. After feeling his Essence Soul become much more ethereal, he released his Essence Soul World.
A huge painting enveloped the entire grotto-heaven. The painting was his Essence Soul World. However, the current painting wasn’t very compatible with his Essence Soul World.
A painting at the Fifth Tribulation realm wasn’t very compatible with an Essence Soul World that had a lightning law as its foundation.
Go. Meng Chuan threw out the Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand.
Boom.
The Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand flew into the painting and landed in the middle of the painting world. It stirred up a commotion in the lightning world. Thunder rumbled as the Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand transformed into a mountain.
It was a Lightning Mountain!
As expected of Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand. Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up. Refining a World Treasure was completely different from refining other treasures. It used an illusory Essence Soul World as its foundation during its pursuit of perfection.
To others, a domain-type Sixth Tribulation treasure was worth hundreds of cubes.
To an Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence, a World Treasure was no less important than an Eighth Tribulation treasure.
An Eighth Tribulation treasure was extremely powerful. With one, one could roam the River of Spacetime freely. They could also comprehend its profundities and probe the mysteries of spacetime. World Treasures weren’t as useful as Eighth Tribulation treasures in battle. However, they could perfectly fuse with one’s Essence Soul World, stabilizing their Essence Soul. The chances of successfully transcending a tribulation would also greatly increase. This alone was enough for Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences to put in maximum effort to refine them. This was the only useful item for an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence when it came to Tribulation Transcendence.
Every Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence would spend the effort to refine one.
Heart of Immeasurable.
In Teng Jiuyu’s cave abode in the Cosmos Realm, he looked at the expanding and contracting heart in his hand. After staring at it for a long time, he grabbed the heart and pressed it against his chest.
The black-brown heart fused with his skin and replaced Teng Jiuyu’s original heart. His original heart dissipated as energy, and his body began fusing with the black-brown heart.
Buzz!
Teng Jiuyu’s body turned illusory.
With my cultivation realm, I can barely maintain my Body of Immeasurable with the Heart of Immeasurable? Teng Jiuyu’s eyes burned. This was a good purchase! This is indeed a different application of the Immeasurable lineage. My chances of reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm have increased. Presently, he was the strongest expert in the higher-level world-Cosmos Realm. In terms of talent, he was ranked in the top ten in Cosmos Realm’s long history. He reached the Tribulation realm after cultivating for 800 years. He reached the Fifth Tribulation realm in 5,000 years. He reached the Sixth Tribulation realm in 20,000 years. Even Cosmos Realm’s ruler thought highly of him and looked forward to him reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm.
With his remaining lifespan, Teng Jiuyu had a chance of reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm.
The 26th year after Meng Chuan obtained the Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand grain, in Heaven and Earth Great Hall’s grotto-heaven.
I succeeded. Meng Chuan sat cross-legged on a towering mountain. Countless lightning bolts struck the mountain with terrifying might.
This mountain wasn’t the original mountain in Heaven and Earth Great Hall’s grotto-heaven. Instead, it was the Lightning Mountain that appeared in his Essence Soul World.
The Lightning Mountain’s entire surface is actually corporeal? Meng Chuan sighed in amazement. Furthermore, it’s more powerful than I expected. It looks like it’s related to the Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand.
According to the intelligence, Meng Chuan estimated that he could use a World Treasure to manifest lightning!
For example, Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminences that cultivated fire laws could release flames from their Essence Soul World. The flames burned in all directions, and they were extremely powerful, making it one of their trump cards. Meng Chuan originally thought that he could release lightning to smite everywhere, but a Lightning Mountain appeared to his surprise. This was clearly related to the Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand.
My Essence Soul is indeed much more stable than before. Meng Chuan sensed that his Essence Soul World had become much more stable after gaining an extremely compatible vessel. In the future, his endurance would be much greater when the Heavenly Tribulation struck him; his chances of transcending the tribulation would also be greater.
Although it was possible that he could successfully transcend the sixth Heavenly Tribulation without using a World Treasure, no one knew for sure before transcending the tribulation.
Therefore, the more prepared he was, the better.
Now that I’ve refined the World Treasure, I have to think of a way to improve my mental cultivation. Meng Chuan knew that time was tight. He couldn’t afford to waste it.
In the second year after Meng Chuan refined his World Treasure, Fu Sui sent cultivators into Fiend Mountain again. “Lord Ghostink, I’ll bring you in now,” said Fu Sui politely. Lord Ghostink stood by the side and maintained some distance from Fu Sui and the other five Tribulation Eminences. When he heard that, he only responded tersely.
Hum.
Fu Sui used a mystic technique to open the entrance.
The surrounding spacetime trembled as the surrounding darkness distorted. The distorted darkness quickly devoured Fu Sui, the eight Fifth Tribulation Eminences, and Lord Ghostink.
At the moment of devouring
Pfft!
An invisible force pushed out Lord Ghostink while Fu Sui and the eight Fifth Tribulation Eminences were sucked in.
Oh? Lord Ghostink looked around. Fu Sui and company had all disappeared.
I was pushed out. It seems like spacetime rejected me... Lord Ghostink frowned slightly. This method of controlling spacetime is too brilliant. The owner of the ruin probably disdains people replicating Fiend Mountain. Then, it’s very likely that it’s actually Fiend Mountain.
It’s really Fiend Mountain?
At that moment, Lord Ghostink’s emotions were complicated, and he felt uncomfortable. He knew that the legendary place was right before him, yet he couldn’t enter!

chapters.title: Chapter 608 - Palace Lord Snowjade’s Ending
chapters.content:
Chapter 608 Palace Lord Snowjade’s Ending
Years passed. Meng Chuan tempered his willpower in preparation for his tribulation.
In the Cang Alliance Space.
Meng Chuan sat in a corner and leisurely chatted with his old friend, Mountain Lord Boneserve. Suddenly, he heard cursing from afar.
“That Fu Sui is too shameless. He didn’t tell us how dangerous the first path in the ruin is. My Essence Soul has also reached the Third Tribulation realm. I only traveled the path for six years. Yet, I had to return to the dragon ancestral land to borrow a lot of treasures to heal my Essence Soul. He traveled that path for 15 years, and his Essence Soul is weaker than mine. I don’t believe that he doesn’t know how terrifying the Essence Soul injuries are,” said a dragon-headed elder angrily.
“Brother Long Zheng, you have also grasped three Fifth Tribulation laws after experiencing six years of epiphanies. You have made a breakthrough, so there are both pros and cons.”
“Haha, there have been quite a number of people cursing Fu Sui in recent years. But aren’t they still entering one by one?” The two Tribulation Eminences laughed as they spoke.
The dragon-headed elder was furious. “I was very careful when I went to the ruin. I knew that I would injure my Essence Soul. I’m at the Essence Soul Third Tribulation realm after all. I only took the path for six years, yet I suffered such a huge loss? City Lord Eastcalm, Old Fiend Black Wind, and Heavenly Dream Realm’s tiger king aren’t any better either. They deliberately helped Fu Sui deceive us.”
His companion reminded him, “Brother Long Zheng, City Lord Eastcalm is there.” The dragon-headed elder glanced at Meng Chuan and Mountain Lord Boneserve from afar and scoffed. “Did I say something wrong? Fu Sui is the main culprit. City Lord Eastcalm, Old Fiend Black Wind, and that tiger king from Heavenly Dream Realm are accomplices!”
Just as Meng Chuan was about to speak, Mountain Lord Boneserve-who was beside him-sat there and shouted indifferently, “You old dragon, are you someone who can only take advantage of others and not suffer losses? Exploring ruins is always a combination of good and bad. Fu Sui was indeed vague when he sent the message to the Cang Alliance. However, Brother Eastcalm’s message wasn’t just for you. We also received it. Brother Eastcalm repeatedly warned us of the danger, but you still took the initiative to take the first path. Who can you blame for having your Essence Soul injured?”.
Indeed, Meng Chuan had made it sound rather serious when he delivered the message.
As Fu Sui had threatened Meng Chuan during the negotiations, their relationship had become somewhat strained. Since he had to inform all the Fifth Tribulation Eminences in the Cang Alliance, Meng Chuan didn’t want to harm the other members. He explained the dangers clearly and repeatedly reminded them of the danger. Even a large number of forbidden creatures inside had gone crazy, so there was definitely something strange about it.
“Reminded us of the danger? He helped pass the message so that more powerful Eminences would enter.” The dragon-headed elder scoffed.
“Long Zheng.” Meng Chuan said, “After you came out, you told all the members of the Cang Alliance that Fu Sui was despicable and shameless. You talked about how severe your Essence Soul injuries were. However, none of those who decided to go to the ruin world gave up. Even more people ended up going to the ruin world.”
The dragon-headed elder was stunned.
Yes.
As the members left the ruin world one after another, news spread in the Cang Alliance Space. This further confirmed the usefulness of the three paths. Not only did people not give up the opportunity, but more members searched for Fu Sui, hoping to head to the ruin. Fu Sui earned more because of this.
Meng Chuan looked at him. “Even if you were given a choice to choose again now, you will probably still enter!”
The dragon-headed elder frowned slightly. He couldn’t lie to himself. Previously, he had only grasped two Fifth Tribulation laws. Improvement of his cultivation became more strenuous, and he couldn’t see any hope. Therefore, after confirming that the Black Mountain ruin world could bring him hope of breaking through, he decided to take the risk.
Now, he was only somewhat sour. It would be great if he could pay a lower price.
“By helping Fu Sui so much, I’m afraid you have earned quite a bit too, am I right?” The dragon-headed elder scoffed.
“He didn’t give me any of the Outer Realm Essence Crystals he earned,” said Meng Chuan.
The dragon-headed elder stood up and scoffed. “I’ve already recovered from the injuries to my Essence Soul. There are a few people in the Cang Alliance who are heavily injured. They have no hope of being treated, and they hate Fu Sui to the core. Fu Sui will ultimately pay the price for earning such Outer Realm Essence Crystals.”
With that said, he left the Cang Alliance Space. His two companions left as well.
Mountain Lord Boneserve chuckled softly and said, “Fortune and disaster are different sides of the same coin when exploring ruins. One has to pay the corresponding price for choosing the first path. Who can be blamed now that they are suffering?”
“However, Fu Sui’s words were indeed very vague,” said Mountain Lord Boneserve with a sigh. “From the intelligence I’ve gathered, the price for someone with a weak Essence Soul like him to be in a state of epiphany for 15 years would definitely have terrifying consequences. There’s no way to treat his Essence Soul’s injuries.”
“That’s right.” Meng Chuan nodded. Now that people were coming out of Fiend Mountain one after another, more people knew about the path of epiphany’s danger thanks to the increasing amount of information they had.
Many also guessed that Fu Sui’s Essence Soul had to be severely injured.
“His Essence Soul is heavily injured. He can’t heal it properly, so he can only stall for time,” said Meng Chuan softly. “Therefore, he’s even more unscrupulous.”
“Yes, he’s currently trying his best to earn Outer Realm Essence Crystals so that he can live longer.” Mountain Lord Boneserve nodded. “It’s strange. The more everyone knows about the three paths in the ruin, the greater the number of Eminences heading to the ruin.”
“That place is dangerous, but it’s a place of hope for many cultivators,” said Meng Chuan.
Mountain Lord Boneserve nodded slightly before asking, “By the way, I heard that Palace Lord Snowjade is from the same river system as you. You are both from Three Bay River System?”
“Yeah.” Meng Chuan nodded. “He entered the Cang Alliance with me. I’ve heard about his situation. He goes back and forth between lucidity and craziness.”
“Quite a few people have come out of the second path. He’s the only one who went crazy.” Mountain Lord Boneserve sighed.
“Sigh.” Meng Chuan shook his head gently.
Black Wind had also traveled the second path, and his strength had increased greatly. Although Meng Hu’s situation was not too good, he didn’t go crazy. Although the subsequent Eminences had some troubles, none of them went crazy, but Snowjade had gone mad!
Palace Lord Snowjade—who had a relatively weak willpower-would occasionally be lucid while crazy at other times. When he was lucid, he would search for a way to heal himself. He had also requested to meet more than one Sixth Tribulation Eminence, but they were unable to treat him. When he went crazy, he would wander the outer realm. Now, he had long left Three Bay River System, to the point of leaving Goddess River Zone.
Palace Lord Snowjade’s outcome made Meng Chuan sigh.
It’s really not easy to become a Sixth Tribulation Eminence. Meng Chuan sighed. Even if one grasped a Sixth Tribulation law on the path of epiphany, their Essence Souls would be severely injured. Even if they don’t die immediately, they will suffer endless torture. It is impossible for them to transcend the tribulation and become a true Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
Outside Archean Eon Realm, in the dark and silent outer realm void.
A purple halo enveloped a figure and appeared outside Archean Eon Realm. Inside the halo was Meng An.
I’m back. Meng An charged forward. A rift appeared in Archean Eon Realm’s membrane, and he immediately entered it.
As a living being of Archean Eon Realm, he could enter easily without any obstacles.
An’er? Inside Archean Mountain’s Heaven Pavilion, Meng Chuan was extremely surprised. When his son appeared outside Archean Eon Realm, he had sensed it through karma! His son’s appearance hadn’t changed much. He was much staider and stronger.
An’er is back. Meng Chuan was very excited and happy.
He immediately took a step and traversed tens of thousands of kilometers.
Dad? Meng An—who had just rushed into Archean Eon Realm-saw the white-haired Meng Chuan cross the void and appear in front of him, smiling at him. “Dad, quickly bring me into the Heaven and Earth Great Hall,” said Meng An immediately, ignoring everything else.
Heaven and Earth Great Hall? Meng Chuan’s expression changed slightly when he heard that. The Heaven and Earth Great Hall had the ability to weaken karmic attacks. It was a cornerstone treasure refined by Ancestral Master Archean Eon.
“Let’s go!” Meng Chuan held his son’s hand, took a step forward, crossed the grotto-heaven’s obstruction, and entered Heaven and Earth Great Hall.
To enter Heaven and Earth Great Hall’s grotto-heaven while inside Archean Eon Realm took only a single step. Meng An was somewhat shocked by his father’s strength. He only relaxed when he entered the Heaven and Earth Great Hall.

chapters.title: Chapter 609 - Meng An’s Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 609 Meng An’s Years
Meng Chuan looked at his son and asked, “What happened?”.
If he doesn’t feel safe despite returning to his homeworld, to the point of wanting to hide in Heaven and Earth Great Hall... Did An’er provoke a powerful enemy?
“Dad.” Meng An looked at his father, his eyes filled with fatigue. He wanted to say something, but he couldn’t bring himself to say it.
“Sit down and talk slowly.” Meng Chuan sat down. Heaven and Earth Great Hall occupied an extremely large area. There were many halls and chambers. Meng Chuan and his son were in the outermost hall. Through the window, they could see the outside world.
Meng An sat down and looked at the scenery outside the window. His mind went adrift.
“An’er?” Meng Chuan asked again.
Meng An snapped out of his daze. “Dad, as you know, I left my homeworld according to Master’s arrangements and headed to a mystic realm.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Yes.”
“That mystic realm is called Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. This mystic realm is very beneficial to one’s cultivation. After Master discovered it, he was intrigued. He used every available means to leave this mystic realm to Archean Eon Realm’s descendants,” said Meng An. “After I arrived at Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, I had the best cultivation conditions due to Master’s arrangements. My cultivation advanced by leaps and bounds. Furthermore, I found my wife—who I had been separated from for many years.”
“A wife who you had been separated from for many years? When did you get married?” Meng Chuan was puzzled.
Meng An explained, “Dad, the Nine Lifetime Samsara Heart Tempering I experienced when I was young is one of the greatest opportunities in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. With Master’s rare treasure, I can enter the Nine Lifetime Samsara Heart Tempering anywhere in the River of Spacetime.”
Meng Chuan’s heart stirred when he heard that. This reminded him of the Cang Alliance Space. He could enter the Cang Alliance Space with a thought no matter where he was. “My wife also experienced the Nine Lifetime Samsara Heart Tempering back then. We made a life-and-death promise,” said Meng An with a smile. “After I learned the Nine Lifetime Samsara Heart Tempering’s secret, I kept thinking about going to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. I am also grateful to the heavens for managing to find her.
“The two of us cultivated together. She has very high perception and potential. Although the opportunities set up by Ancestral Master Archean Eon can’t be shared with her, she still managed to reach the mid-stage Imperial Lord realm after all these years,” said Meng An.
When Meng Chuan heard that, he praised, “It’s indeed not bad.”
It was very difficult for Archean Eon Realm to produce an Imperial Lord.
The cultivation environment in the Earth Cloud Mystic Realm might be much better, but becoming an Imperial Lord still wasn’t easy.
“I only managed to break through to the Tribulation realm thanks to Master’s nurturing at the perfected Imperial Lord realm,” said Meng An. “I transcended the first three tribulations in a short period of time. However, I’ve been stuck at the Third Tribulation realm for centuries. My improvement has become increasingly difficult.”
“An’er,” consoled Meng Chuan, “cultivating at the Tribulation realm is like groping in the dark. It will become harder and harder. During this process, we will encounter many setbacks. We will discover how many wrong paths we have taken and realize that we have ended up at a dead-end. However, every mistake will benefit us. We need to have great willpower and determination to go further in the Tribulation realm.”
Meng An nodded. He knew the difference between him and his father. His cultivation path had always been arranged by a predecessor. His father had figured his path out all by himself.
After reaching the Tribulation realm, it was very difficult for Ancestral Master Archean Eon to help Meng An any further. He could only rely on himself. This made Meng An find cultivation even harder.
“What happened after that?” asked Meng Chuan.
“My wife got pregnant,” said Meng An. “My wife and I have roamed Earth Cloud Mystic Realm for many years. We also have some enemies. To protect our child, we secretly went to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s mortal world. After our child was born, we hid our identities and nurtured him well. We taught him for nearly a century before returning to the Heaven realm to continue cultivating.
“We didn’t tell anyone about our child. In fact... Meng Yu doesn’t even know that his mother is an Imperial Lord while I’m a Tribulation Eminence.” A rare smile appeared on Meng An’s face as he recalled his family of three’s beautiful days.
“The child’s name is Meng Yu?” asked Meng Chuan. “Also, what’s your wife’s name?”
“My wife and I named the child,” said Meng An. “As for my wife, her name is Long Han.”
Upon hearing this name, Meng Chuan immediately sensed a distant place. Apart from his grandson-Meng Yu-who he had a bloodline connection with, there was another karmic connection.
Meng Chuan had never seen Long Han before. He didn’t have a bloodline connection with her, and he didn’t even know her name; thus, he naturally didn’t have a karmic connection with her. Things had changed completely after gaining knowledge of her name.
Names were very special when it came to karma. One could even kill a person through curses with just their name.
Meng An said, “Today, one of my true bodies was cultivating in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s Realm Manor. Unexpectedly, a Sixth Tribulation Eminence appeared in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. He actually relied on his own strength to come to Realm Manor in an attempt to refine it. The moment he arrived, I discovered him. Likewise, he also discovered me.
as
“Separated by Realm Manor’s layered array formations, I immediately destroyed that true body,” said Meng An. “My other true body was with my wife at the time. I also told my wife about this matter. My wife is a middle-stage Imperial Lord. Her homeworld is Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. She can’t escape to any other inhabited world. Therefore, once the other party wants to kill her, the Sixth Tribulation Eminence can kill her with a thought simply by knowing her name. “Unable to escape, my wife severed a portion of her memories. She severed all her memories regarding our child, Meng Yu. I carried this portion of her memories with me, and I fled back to Archean Eon Realm.”
Meng An said, “I’m at the Third Tribulation realm. Now that I’m back in my homeworld and inside Heaven and Earth Great Hall, the Sixth Tribulation Eminence might not be able to kill me, even if he has one of my true bodies as a medium. Furthermore, he hasn’t captured any of my avatars. He also doesn’t have any of my flesh, blood, or hair as a medium.
“If he can’t find me or kill me, my wife’s chances of survival will increase greatly. The other party will likely take my wife hostage. My wife can also negotiate with him. If the negotiation bears fruit... the other party will probably send news to Archean Eon Realm,” said Meng An softly.
Meng Chuan asked, “Who’s that Sixth Tribulation Eminence? Since Ancestral Master Archean Eon was the one who set up the array formation, outsiders shouldn’t be able to enter.”
“Yes, he can’t.” Meng An said, “In Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, one can only leave the mystic realm after reaching the Tribulation realm. However, the avatars that leave are unable to find a way to return to the mystic realm. Once they leave, they won’t be able to return.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
He had once gone to search for the mystic realm. He had clearly followed his bloodline karmic connection to Meng An, but he couldn’t find the mystic realm.
“That Sixth Tribulation Eminence is naturally native to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm,” said Meng An. “Ever since Ancestral Master Archean Eon left behind his defenses, although Earth Cloud Mystic Realm has had several Fifth Tribulation Eminences every generation, no Sixth Tribulation Eminences have been born in the past.”
Meng Chuan could understand why that was the case. A mystic realm wasn’t a normal created world. It was a world created by an Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
Eighth Tribulation Eminences created mystic realms according to their will. They even set the laws themselves. Therefore, some mystic realms were especially suitable for cultivation. However, cultivation was just like that. If one progressed too smoothly in the beginning, they would only encounter greater resistance during the later stages. This was because these cultivators didn’t experience enough hardships. They relied on the various opportunities in the mystic realm to cultivate smoothly. When the mystic realm couldn’t provide them much help, their breakthroughs became extremely difficult.
The difficulty of reaching the Tribulation realm in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm was lower than the outside world, but the further one went, the harder it was to reach the next Tribulation realm.
“This Sixth Tribulation Eminence is called Grandsire Three Stones,” said Meng An. “He was the strongest Fifth Tribulation Eminence in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm and also the most mysterious one. I never expected him to become a Sixth Tribulation Eminence secretly.”
“Realm Manor is related to the ownership of a mystic realm,” said Meng Chuan. “When he found you there, he definitely thought of ways to capture you.”
“Yes.” Meng An nodded and somewhat exhaustedly said, “Dad, I abandoned my wife and child and fled alone. I feel like I’m a deserter back when I was guarding the city passes.”
“An’er, you should understand that you have the greatest chance of survival by doing this,” said Meng Chuan. “If you are captured, all of you will be doomed. By escaping, the other party won’t kill your wife easily. As for Meng Yu’s current identity, it’s still a secret for
now.”
Meng An nodded.
He had guarded city passes for many years and knew how to make the right choices. He wouldn’t be soft-hearted. However, he still felt tormented even though he knew he was doing the right thing.
Meng Chuan looked at his son. “You came back using a Spacetime Teleportation Talisman?”
“Yes.” Meng An nodded. “Otherwise, it’s impossible for me to escape from Grandsire Three Stones’s pursuit.”
“In other words, it hasn’t even been an hour since he arrived in the Realm Manor.” Meng Chuan pondered. “It will normally take one about ten years to refine a mystic realm. With the defenses left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon, it will probably take even longer.”
Meng An nodded.
“Since he doesn’t control Earth Cloud Mystic Realm...” said Meng Chuan. “I can attempt to pay a visit.”

chapters.title: Chapter 610 - Set Off, Earth Cloud Mystic Realm (Final Chapter of Volume)
chapters.content:
Chapter 610 Set Off, Earth Cloud Mystic Realm (Final Chapter of Volume)
Apart from not experiencing the Tribulation Transcendence trial, Meng Chuan was effectively at the Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation realm. He naturally wasn’t afraid of Grandsire Three Stones.
If the other party refined and controlled Earth Cloud Mystic Realm as its owner, Meng Chuan would have no chance of fighting him! In a mystic realm, the strength of that mystic realm’s owner was terrifying. Sixth Tribulation Eminences would only be sending themselves to their deaths if they went.
It’s still too early for him to control the mystic realm since he just headed to Realm Manor. Meng Chuan was rather confident.
“Dad, are you going to challenge him?” Meng An found it unbelievable. Meng An was willing to risk his life to save his wife and child. However, he knew how powerful a Sixth Tribulation Eminence was. He didn’t have any intention of barging in. He only wanted to rely on negotiations to save his family.
“Of course, I have to go. I naturally have to save members of my Meng family.” A sharp glint flashed in Meng Chuan’s eyes. “Furthermore, although you tried your best to keep my grandson-Meng Yu-a secret, a Sixth Tribulation Eminence might still be able to find Meng Yu if they spend some effort and time... Thus, I have to carry out the rescue operation as soon as possible.” “Dad, Grandsire Three Stones is a Sixth Tribulation Eminence,” said Meng An anxiously. Meng An had roamed Earth Cloud Mystic Realm for many years; he had also been stuck at the Third Tribulation realm for many years. Meng An knew very well what a Sixth Tribulation Eminence meant. In the entire River of Spacetime, Seventh Tribulation Eminences were among the strongest experts. It was rare to encounter one. All of them had extremely high statuses. As for Sixth Tribulation Eminences, they were already overlords that reigned supreme in the River of Spacetime! “It’s true that a Sixth Tribulation Eminence isn’t to be trifled with.” Meng Chuan nodded. He knew this very well. “I can only kill one of his true bodies at best. It’s almost impossible to kill him completely.”
Meng An was slightly taken aback and looked at his father with shock. “Dad?”
“It’s also thanks to the Heavens’ blessing. I have just broken through to the Sixth Tribulation realm,” said Meng Chuan. “Otherwise, I really can’t do anything..”
“Dad, you’re at the Sixth Tribulation realm?” Meng An was pleasantly surprised.
How long had his father been cultivating?
He was born when his father was 36 years old. When he went to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, the time flow there was ten times faster than in the outside world. Yet, he was still stuck at the Third Tribulation realm. In contrast, his father was already at the Sixth Tribulation realm?
“Don’t waste time. Follow me.” Meng Chuan led his son deeper into Heaven and Earth Great Hall.
Moments later,
Whoosh.
Mist seeped out from the walls of the ancient hall, transforming into a white-robed elder.
“The two of you are here? What a nice father-son duo.” The white-robed elder smiled. Archean Eon Realm finally had an expert in this generation-Meng Chuan. Even Meng Chuan’s son had reached the Third Tribulation realm. It was barely considered
good.
“Are you here to confirm your strength or retrieve treasures?” asked the white-robed elder.
“When my son went to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm for cultivation, he was directly teleported to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm,” said Meng Chuan. “According to what I know, Ancestral Master Archean Eon set up many defenses in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. Normally, outsiders can’t enter.”
“Yes.” The white-robed elder nodded. “After Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s native cultivators reach the Tribulation realm, they won’t be able to return once their avatars leave the mystic realm. They won’t be able to return, even with the help of a Spacetime Teleportation Talisman.
“This will prevent Sixth Tribulation Eminences from controlling this mystic realm. Master thought highly of Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. It’s a mystic realm that’s very suitable for cultivation. Master wanted to leave it for juniors from Archean Eon Realm.”
“I want to head to the mystical realm,” said Meng Chuan. “How can I do so?” “A normal Spacetime Teleportation Talisman will do,” said the white-robed elder. “However, you have to learn a mystic technique first. Once you activate the mystic technique mark and use the Spacetime Teleportation Talisman, you won’t be obstructed. If you aren’t in a hurry, you can head to Taidong River Zone first. Earth Cloud Mystic Realm is there. You can find the mystic realm by following the map. Ancestral Master Archean Eon left behind a method to open the mystic realm.”
“Give me both methods,” said Meng Chuan.
Accidents might happen if he slowly took his time to travel and wasted time.
The white-robed elder looked at Meng An. “Meng An, Earth Cloud Mystic Realm is your fortuitous encounter. However, your father has already reached the Sixth Tribulation realm. He can choose almost all the treasures left behind by Master. Therefore, he is entitled to all the intelligence regarding Earth Cloud Mystic Realm.”
“I have no objections,” said Meng An anxiously. “Please brief my father quickly.” “Alright.” The white-robed elder nodded. He took out a thin booklet with a flip of his hand and handed it to Meng Chuan. “This contains all the information regarding Earth Cloud Mystic Realm and the mystic technique for entering and exiting the mystic realm.” Meng Chuan reached out to receive the booklet.
Thousand Mountain Star, Eternal Tower’s ninth floor.
“Deliver the Seventh Tribulation treasure, Lightning Pool Chart, immediately.” Meng Chuan immediately chose a treasure.
Eternal Tower sold a large number of treasures. Some belonged to Eternal Tower, while others were sold on behalf of other factions. Many of the treasures that were put up for sale were still in the original owner’s hands. If he wanted to buy them, he would need the original owner to head to an Eternal Tower branch first before teleporting it over. This would take a longer time.
Therefore, Meng Chuan chose a treasure that could be swiftly delivered to him.
The Seventh Tribulation treasure-Lightning Pool Chart, worth 3,800 cubes-was delivered in less than ten minutes.
“It’s done.”
Two Seventh Tribulation treasures, many Sixth Tribulation treasures, and some other items. With these, I can make a trip to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. Meng Chuan was very decisive.
The outcome of his trip to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm was unpredictable. His opponent was ultimately a Sixth Tribulation Eminence. Therefore, he had to be cautious. He had to consider defeat before considering victory!
Meng Chuan wouldn’t bring his World Treasure with him. The World Treasure refined with Ninth Tribulation Lightning Sand as its core was what he would rely on most when transcending the sixth Heavenly Tribulation. He couldn’t afford any accidents to happen to
it.
Meng Chuan also didn’t bring an Eighth Tribulation treasure of the lightning lineage from Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasure vault with him.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon had only collected 11 Eighth Tribulation treasures in his entire life.
It was difficult for Sixth Tribulation Eminences to find one their entire lives. It was more than ten times harder for him to find one that matched his lightning lineage. Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s lightning lineage Eighth Tribulation treasure was very rare. The Heart of Immeasurable he sold back then was the lousiest among the 11 Eighth Tribulation treasures that Ancestral Master Archean Eon had collected.
As for the treasure of the lightning lineage, it was much stronger. If he wanted to use it, he had to choose a critical moment.
Physical Body Sixth Tribulation? I want him to know how powerful an Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence is. Meng Chuan’s eyes were cold.
“It’s here.” Meng Chuan looked up
One of his Essence Soul embodiments had already rushed to Thousand Mountain Star from Archean Eon Realm while carrying a Spacetime Teleportation Talisman. He naturally had to attack with his true body this time. His true body could split out many Essence Soul avatars.
It’s time to set off. Meng Chuan knew that he had little time.
“Dad, are you confident?” Meng An looked at his father uneasily in Heaven and Earth Great Hall.
Meng Chuan said, “My perception of Meng Yu is the clearest. I will teleport to his side and save him immediately. It hasn’t even been an hour since you returned to Archean Eon Realm. If we act fast enough, I’m confident that I can save Meng Yu. After all, Meng Yu’s existence has always been a secret. It will take the Sixth Tribulation Eminence some time to discover his existence.”
Meng An nodded slightly and couldn’t help but ask, “What about my wife?”
“As for your wife, Long Han... She should be imprisoned by now. Rescuing her will require more effort on my part,” said Meng Chuan. “Don’t worry. They don’t know of my existence. I can act incognito. I have a chance of secretly saving your wife.”
Meng An looked at his father and softly said, “Sorry for troubling you, Dad.” “Kid,” said Meng Chuan with a smile as he looked at his son. Following that, he looked at the outside world. Through the grotto-heaven, he saw the endless void. “The outer realm void is filled with danger. I’m your father, so I naturally have to help you. However, you have to learn from this experience. You have to be more cautious in the future.” Meng An nodded.
Thousand Mountain Star. Only an Essence Soul embodiment was left to guard Thousand Mountain Star.
Meng Chuan looked in the direction of Taidong River Zone.
I want to see how capable this Grandsire Three Stones from Earth Cloud Mystic Realm is. Meng Chuan immediately activated the Spacetime Teleportation Talisman.
A purple light enveloped Meng Chuan. With a whoosh, Meng Chuan felt spacetime distort. Following that, he arrived at his destination.
This was how spacetime transference worked. No matter how far he was, he could arrive at the designated location in an instant.
Earth Cloud Mystic Realm? Meng Chuan looked at the scene in front of him. He could see a colorful valley with cultivators inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 611 - Grandfather and Grandson
chapters.content:
Chapter 611 Grandfather and Grandson
In a valley inside Thousand Fang Mountain Range, Earth Cloud Mystic Realm.
Meng Chuan-who was surrounded by purple light-appeared out of thin air and slowly landed on the ground. The eight cultivatorswho were only hundreds of feet away-didn’t sense him at all. Ignoring the fact that they were merely Supremacy-level juniors, even the Tribulation Eminences in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s Heaven realm couldn’t sense Meng Chuan due to his control over the void.
Meng Yu? Meng Chuan smiled and looked at the black-robed youth among the eight cultivators.
Due to the bloodline connection within three generations and the source of the karmic connection, everything confirmed that the black-robed youth was Meng An’s child in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm.
My grandson. Meng Chuan felt relieved when he saw Meng Yu with his own eyes. Meng Yu is safe. The next step is to save his mother.
With a thought, Meng Chuan’s two Essence Soul avatars left silently. They headed to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s Heaven realm to rescue Long Han.
As Meng An and Long Han had tried their best to protect their son, Long Han had even severed her memories of their son, preventing the enemy from finding him through investigations. Therefore, Meng Chuan could easily protect his grandson.
If I’m not wrong, Long Han’s location should be near the Heaven realm’s Realm Manor. Meng Chuan frowned slightly. Before Meng Chuan came, he had learned about the entire Earth Cloud Mystic Realm.
Even though Seventh Tribulation Eminences might not put too much emphasis on one, every mystic realm in the River of Spacetime was very precious. Ancestral Master Archean Eon was one example. He simply set up some defenses for his descendants when he found Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. He didn’t need it for himself.
In the outer realm, Sixth Tribulation Eminences mainly wanted to control a mystic realm and become its owner.
The number of experts nurtured in a mystic realm was typically comparable to ten river systems!
When Earth Cloud Mystic Realm was created, its spatial structure was rather special. It was split into three realms-Heaven, Earth, and Man.
The Man realm was the mortal world. It was a place for mortals to live and reproduce. This world’s Essence Energy was thin, making cultivation extremely difficult. Reaching the Supremacy realm was typically the limit. Supremacies could then ascend to the Earth realm.
The Earth realm was where sects, family clans, and other cultivation factions resided. It was also the world with the most Supremacies and Imperial Lords.
In this world, Supremacies made up the foundation when it came to combat strength. Imperial Lords were the backbone of a sect. Tribulation Eminences were the patriarchs of a sect. Only Tribulation Eminences had the right to establish a sect. As long as one cultivated to the Imperial Lord realm, they could ascend to the Heaven realm. Therefore, Imperial Lords would send one of their true bodies to the Heaven realm while typically leaving their other true body in the sect.
The Heaven realm was where all the experts in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm gathered. Imperial Lords and Tribulation Eminences lived here. After reaching the Tribulation realm, they could head to the outer realm!
This was because Ancestral Master Archean Eon had set up a mechanism that prevented them from returning after leaving! Even Tribulation Eminences were unable to bring outsiders into Earth Cloud Mystic Realm.
Realm Manor was the Heaven realm’s core. To enter Realm Manor, one needed to be at the Sixth Tribulation realm.
As expected of a mystic realm. The number of Supremacies here is comparable to ten river systems. Meng Chuan sighed in amazement. The eight people in front of him—including Meng Yu-were all Supremacies. They were common across the Earth realm.
Eight cultivators were gathered in the distance. “Brother Meng Yu, it’s all thanks to you,” said a young man in a purple-gold robe with a smile. “Otherwise, I’m afraid two or three of us would have died in battle.”
“I was training in Thousand Fang Mountain Range,” said Meng Yu with a smile. The black robe he was wearing was very baggy. His hands were hidden in the robe, and his hair was tied up simply. “When I saw Brother Shen and the others fighting a Valiant Fiend, how could I watch and do nothing when you are in trouble? I naturally drew my sword and attacked!”
“Well said. Drawing your sword and attacking!” Young Master Shen sighed. “Sometimes, many so-called ‘good friends’ won’t save people at critical moments. They will even give one a nudge from behind, sending them to their deaths.” Meng Yu nodded immediately.
“Brother Meng Yu, I owe you a favor,” said Young Master Shen solemnly.
“There’s no need for that. Giving me the Valiant Fiend has benefited me enough,” said Meng Yu immediately.
“A single Valiant Fiend’s corpse can’t compare to the lives of the several of us,” said Young Master Shen.
The six companions beside him nodded in agreement.
Young Master Shen continued, “Brother Meng Yu, when we met at Star Sword Sect last time, I discovered that Star Sword Sect was almost controlled by a family line. Those like you, who have ascended from the mortal world, have very few opportunities.”
“What can I do?” Meng Yu curled his lips. “The masters above me can’t resolve it, so what can a junior like me do?”
Star Sword Sect’s patriarchs were still alive.
How could a junior like him question the distribution of resources?
“Neither the opportunity to ascend the Stairway to Heaven nor the opportunity to visit Sword Cave will come by us. We can only carry out sect missions.” Young Master Shen shook his head. “We can’t continue like this. You saved us, so how about this? I’ll invite you to join my Shen family as a guest elder. You should have heard that there are many benefits to being a guest elder.”
“Shen family’s guest elder?” Meng Yu looked tempted, but he was also somewhat hesitant.
“Guest elder? With Brother Meng Yu’s strength, he can indeed be a guest elder,” said Young Master Shen’s other companions.
Meng Yu hesitated for a moment before saying, “Brother Shen, you know how strict the sect is. I have to think about this. I have to inform Master and obtain his permission.”
“Don’t worry. Star Sword Sect’s higher-ups won’t pay attention to such trivial matters,” persuaded Young Master Shen.
“I still have to ask Master about this. I’ll seek you out again if Master agrees, Young Master Shen... When the time comes, Young Master Shen, are you willing to let me be a guest elder?” Meng Yu looked at Young Master Shen.
When Young Master Shen heard this, he smiled and said, “Alright, ask your master for permission. My invitation to you to be a guest elder of the Shen family will always hold. With my status, getting you the position of guest elder is trivial.”
“Thank you, Brother Shen,” said Meng Yu. “Then, I’ll return to the sect to report.”
“Alright.” Young Master Shen watched Meng Yu leave.
“This Meng Yu doesn’t know how to appreciate favors.”
“Young Master personally invited him, but he’s still hesitating,” said his companions. “Shut up.” Young Master Shen frowned. His six companions didn’t dare say a word. These companions were Young Master Shen’s guards. They were here to protect Young Master Shen on his training expedition.
These six trash can’t even fend off that Valiant Fiend. Meng Yu alone could hold back a Valiant Fiend. He alone is stronger than the other six. I didn’t manage to see Meng Yu’s true strength back at Star Sword Sect. If I hire him as a guest elder, I can get him to protect me. If there’s danger, I can get him to be my shield, Young Master Shen thought to himself. It was very easy for the family clan to arrange for a Supremacy-level guest elder to be a guard. As long as Meng Yu chose to be a guest elder and received benefits from the Shen family, he would have to take responsibility.
I’m in desperate need of a powerful guard, Young Master Shen thought to himself.
The competition between the Shen family’s younger generation was intensifying. With Young Master Shen’s status, he couldn’t hire an Imperial Lord to be his guard! He could only hire Supremacies. As for Meng Yu, his strength was definitely at the level of an extremely powerful Supremacy.
The Shen family is one of Mental Demon Sect’s 13 family clans. They deliberately allow their descendants to engage in internecine conflict to determine the strongest. I don’t want to get involved. As Meng Yu flew, he pondered the situation. Furthermore, he made it sound nice. Back when the Valiant Fiend pursued them, they must have sensed that I was around and lured it over. Otherwise, there wouldn’t be such a coincidental meeting. Dad, Mom, the two of you sure are carefree. You hide in the mortal world to enjoy yourselves while I’m forced to ascend and cultivate. However, I don’t have anyone backing me. I also don’t have any opportunities. It’s really difficult to cultivate.
Meng Yu picked up the black gourd by his waist and drank two mouthfuls of alcohol before leisurely flying towards Star Sword Sect.
Meng Chuan—who was secretly observing his grandson-couldn’t help but laugh. This grandson of his didn’t resemble Meng An or himself. He and An’er had grown up during wartime. Meng Yu’s growth was somewhat different, and his personality was also different.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan waved his hand.
“Hey-” As Meng Yu leisurely flew, he suddenly saw the scene in front of him change. The space in front of him changed.
The bright sunlight was no longer visible. Only a faint light enveloped the world around him. A grotto-heaven? Meng Yu stood on the grass, looked around, and jolted.
Pa!
Meng Yu knelt down and said loudly, “Greetings, Senior, I’m Meng Yu.” With that said, he immediately bowed his head respectfully. “Kowtowing before seeing anyone?” Laughter rang out.
Meng Yu carefully looked up and saw a white-haired, white-robed, middle-aged man standing in front of him and smiling at him.
Upon seeing the other party’s smile, Meng Yu calmed down. It’s fine. I’m not in danger.

chapters.title: Chapter 612 - That’s All I Can Help You With
chapters.content:
Chapter 612 That’s All I Can Help You With
“Alright, quickly get up,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“Yes, Senior.” Meng Yu stood up obediently and carefully asked, “Senior, may I know what instructions you have for me since you’ve summoned me here?”
“Meng Yu. Ascended to the Earth realm 430 years ago and joined Star Sword Sect. Currently at the perfected Supremacy realm,” said Meng Chuan directly. “Independently created a Sword Dao technique, Seven Stars Sword Control. Your true strength is ranked in the top ten among Star Sword Sect’s Supremacies, am I right?”
Meng Yu was alarmed when he heard this. Although intelligence on him wasn’t a secret, it wasn’t easy to investigate him so clearly. Less than ten people knew about his self-created Seven Stars Sword Control. The mysterious white-haired man in front of him has a cultivation realm that far exceeds mine. He definitely has a motive for investigating me so thoroughly!
“Senior, you are absolutely right,” said Meng Yu humbly. “I’m just a nobody. I don’t know how you spotted me.” “Because-“Meng Chuan smiled at him. “you are my grandson. I’m your grandfather!” Meng Yu’s expression froze as he stared at Meng Chuan dazedly. Grandfather? Grandson? “Senior, don’t tease me,” said Meng Yu immediately. Even though he had experienced all sorts of situations and had interacted with sinister, cunning, and ferocious demons, he still felt dazed when facing an unfamiliar expert who claimed to be his grandfather and that he was his grandson.
Is this a trap? A deliberate lie? Using me as a tool? Or does he have a more sinister motive? Many thoughts instantly surfaced in Meng Yu’s mind. He wasn’t one to believe a stranger’s words easily.
“Your father’s name is Meng An,” said Meng Chuan, “and your mother’s name is Han Yue.”
Meng Yu’s expression turned solemn. His parents were his most important loved ones. His father’s name was Meng An, and his mother’s name was Han Yue! These were his parents’ names when adventuring.
“Are you really my grandfather?” Meng Yu looked at the mysterious white-haired man. “My father said that he left his family long ago. He only told me about the Meng family briefly. He said that my grandfather is an outstanding hero.”
“Your father said that you would believe me if I take out this token.” Meng Chuan flipped his hand and took out a purple-red wooden token.
When Meng Yu saw the crude pattern on the token, his heart couldn’t help but tremble. It was a picture he had painted when he was six. Before his parents left, they had said, “You are our child. This has to be kept a secret. Nobody else’s words can be trusted unless they come with this token.”
The time he spent with his parents were the loveliest days in Meng Yu’s heart. Now that he saw his childhood token, Meng Yu’s emotions surged.
“Greetings, Grandfather.” Meng Yu’s eyes turned red. He immediately knelt down solemnly and kowtowed three times.
It had been so many years.
He had finally met his family! After ascending to the Earth realm, he had suffered a lot in the past 400 years. He lived as if he was treading on thin ice. He didn’t even dare to show his full strength in the sect because he had ascended without any background. One wrong step and he would be consigned to eternal damnation. Even when the Shen family’s scion previously invited him to be a guest elder, he didn’t dare reject him directly. Instead, he tactfully found a reason to delay giving an answer.
After cultivating in the Earth realm for over 400 years, he had always felt lonely. He cultivated alone and carefully guarded against all dangers. Now, he finally met a family member.
“Good, good.” Meng Chuan personally helped him up. This grandson of his had cultivated for more than 500 years, and this was the first time Meng Chuan was meeting him as his grandfather.
Of course, he was still considered young in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s Earth realm.
“Grandfather, how are my parents?” Meng Yu asked worriedly. “I haven’t seen them since I ascended to the Earth realm.”
Meng Chuan frowned slightly and shook his head. “Not particularly good.”
Meng Yu was alarmed as he immediately asked, “Dad and Mom said that they have to hide in the mortal world to avoid their enemies’ detection. Could it be...” “Yes, their enemy has found them,” said Meng Chuan with a nod. “Your father was lucky enough to escape. Your mother has been captured.” “My mother?” Meng Yu panicked.
“Your mother is an Imperial Lord, your father is a Tribulation Eminence, and your grandfather is also a Tribulation Eminence.” Meng Chuan exaggeratedly said, “However, their enemy is also a very powerful Tribulation Eminence. Therefore, they have to hide your existence to prevent the enemy from finding out about you. Even as your grandfather, I can’t publicly acknowledge you as my grandson. Doing so will only implicate you.”
Meng Chuan had learned about his grandson’s growth before he came. With his previous observations, he had a plan to nurture his grandson.
After dealing with the threat that was Grandsire Three Stones, his grandson-Meng Yu-would be able to do whatever he wanted in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. This wasn’t suitable for his grandson’s growth.
Therefore, he couldn’t let his grandson have something to rely on.
A treasured sword’s sharpness required sufficient tempering to forge a powerful will.
Meng Yu nodded. “I understand. All of you did this to protect me.” “It’s good that you understand.” Meng Chuan nodded and sighed. “I can’t help you much. I can only stay here with you and teach you for a month. After a month, I have to leave! If I stay by your side for too long, my nemesis will discover me. You will also be implicated.” Meng Yu said, “Grandfather, please think of a way to save my mother.” “I’m only accompanying you with an Essence Soul avatar,” said Meng Chuan. “My true body has already headed to the Heaven realm to think of a way to save your mother. However, I’m not completely confident.”
Meng Yu fell into deep thought.
“This is a flask of Lunar Aspect Wine I obtained by chance. You only need to take a sip every time. It’s extremely beneficial to your cultivation.” Meng Chuan flipped his hand and took out a silver alcohol flask. “I couldn’t bear to drink a single mouthful, but here it is for you. You have to treasure it! Don’t finish it too quickly. It will be gone once you finish it.”
“Yes.” Meng Yu accepted it gratefully.
This flask of Lunar Aspect Wine was worth 120 cubes! It was indeed a valuable treasure to a newly-advanced Tribulation Eminence. However, it was nothing to Meng Chuan. He had earned a lot from picking up treasures at the Fiend Mountain ruin world, but this was the only treasure Meng Chuan would leave for his grandson to aid Meng Yu in his cultivation.
“I heard that you are skilled with swords. Our Meng family happens to have a very mighty Tribulation-level manual. Learn it quickly. After mastering it, I’ll have to bring it back to my family clan.” Meng Chuan flipped his hand again and took out a foot-long black crystal jade. It had countless golden light dots peppered over it.
This ultimate technique was called Immeasurable Sword Heart. It was a manual from Star Cluster Building. Taking out was originally forbidden, but Meng Chuan had used 3,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals as collateral.
If he didn’t bring it back, those 3,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals would be stored in Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasure vault.
Immeasurable Sword Heart was created by a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. In terms of value, it was superior to Star Cluster Building’s two strongest lightning lineage ultimate techniques—Lightning Realm and Three World Saber. However, it was inferior to the Essence Soul Star formulation Meng Chuan previously learned. It was even less comparable to the Void Catalog
He took the manual out with 3,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals as collateral!
After he brought it back, the 3,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals would be returned to Meng Chuan.
After a moment, Meng Yu received Immeasurable Sword Heart’s legacy. He was shocked. This sword art was too vast, and it was the most powerful technique he had ever obtained.
“Thank you, Grandfather.” Meng Yu was grateful. “This ultimate technique needs to be brought back to the family clan as soon as possible. Nothing must happen to it.”
“Indeed, nothing must happen to it.” Meng Chuan took it back and immediately put it away. He said seriously, “Your father and I still need to deal with powerful enemies. This is all I can help you with.”
“Grandfather, you’ve already helped me a lot.” Meng Yu was rather touched.
In the Earth realm, he was used to seeing people scheme against each other. Only his parents and grandfather were selfless enough to demand nothing in return.
Meng Yu made up his mind to cultivate harder so that he could become a Tribulation Eminence. He had to help his father and grandfather share the burden and deal with the enemy. “Alright.” Meng Chuan looked at his grandson in satisfaction.

chapters.title: Chapter 613 - Grandsire Three Stones’s Order
chapters.content:
Chapter 613 Grandsire Three Stones’s Order
“Here are three Undying Talismans. Carry them with you and leave your mark on them.” Meng Chuan took out three Undying Talismans and handed them to his grandson solemnly. “Although your parents have done their best to protect you, our enemy’s means are unfathomable. They might be able to discover your existence and kill you with a thought. With an Undying Talisman, you can survive for longer. Every Undying Talisman can delay your death for two hours. This will give me enough time to save you.”
Meng Yu’s heart palpitated when he heard that.
The enemy that even his grandfather and parents feared was an expert among Tribulation Eminences. As long as their enemy knew of his existence and name, he could kill him with a thought through karma. “I’ll definitely carry them with me.” Meng Yu carefully put away the three Undying Talismans and left his Essence Soul mark on them. He decided to carry them forever. They were the most important life-preservation items.
Only then did Meng Chuan heave a sigh of relief.
He wasn’t lying. If Grandsire Three Stones obtained information on Meng Yu, he could kill Meng Yu with just a thought.
Even if he protected Meng Yu by keeping him close, Meng Chuan didn’t have the confidence to protect Meng Yu thoroughly. This was because it was very difficult to block a karmic attack.
There were two ways to block a karmic attack. The first was to weaken the karmic attack as much as possible! For example, an inhabited world could greatly weaken a karmic attack. The Heaven and Earth Great Hall created by Ancestral Master Archean Eon could also weaken karmic attacks. As an Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World could repel all external forces, producing a weakening effect. However, even with his Essence Soul World enveloping his grandson, he could only weaken a karmic attack by 80-90%. Meng Yu still couldn’t withstand the karmic attack’s remaining strength.
The other method was to be at an extremely high cultivation realm. One could then sense all karmic attacks within their domain. They could also easily intercept and even sever karmic threads! This was something only Seventh Tribulation Eminences and stronger could do. Therefore, people were very safe when they were beside Seventh Tribulation Eminences. It was impossible for others to ambush a mortal protected by a Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
One of Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars accompanied his grandson and taught him. His true body and three other Essence Soul avatars moved separately, thinking of ways to save Long Han.
Heaven realm.
I can sense that the lass, Long Han, is in the palace ahead. The black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan stared off into the distance. That palace is close to Realm Palace. With Grandsire Three Stones there, there is no way to rescue her forcefully.
Since the other party had captured Long Han, the Sixth Tribulation Eminence could kill Long Han instantly, even if Meng Chuan launched an all-out attack.
I have to find an opportunity. He definitely has his reasons for not killing Long Han directly. Meng Chuan was very patient.
Earth realm.
One of Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars came to a large island in the Ice Sea. This island was 1,500 kilometers in diameter. It was considered a large island in the Earth realm.
Dragon Island. Meng Chuan solemnly looked at the vast island. A 50-kilometer-deep crater had appeared in the middle of the island. However, countless buildings remained intact beyond this crater. Not a single soul left. Meng Chuan frowned as he looked down.
Dragon Island was an island where the divine dragons had resided for generations. Over a million of them lived on the island. The divine dragons had dragon bloodlines. After generations of proliferation, many experts emerged within their race when their bloodlines awakened.
According to An’er, the divine dragons’ strongest member is a Fourth Tribulation Eminence. There’s also a Second Tribulation Eminence and over ten Imperial Lords. There are over a million clansmen. Meng Chuan looked down. Yet, there’s not a single one left?
Long Han came from Dragon Island. Due to Dragon Island’s nurturing, she had the chance to undergo the Nine Lifetime Samsara Heart Tempering when she was young. Long Han places great importance on the divine dragons. She’s even willing to sacrifice her life for the divine dragons. Meng Chuan pondered. It’s such a highly-populated race. Previously, An’er and his wife sensed that they were fine. Now that I’m here less than two hours later, they have all disappeared?
Whoosh.
His Essence Soul World silently enveloped Dragon Island as he carefully inspected it.
Huh? Meng Chuan’s heart stirred as he landed in an ancient hall on Dragon Island.
Hundreds of jade talismans were enshrined in the hall.
“Guardian, come out,” shouted Meng Chuan as he stood in the hall.
Whoosh.
Black fog immediately rose from the ground and condensed into the form of a dragon-headed elder. He immediately bowed respectfully. “Greetings, Senior. I’m the Guardian of Dragon Island.” Although Dragon Island’s array formation had been destroyed, the Guardians could barely maintain a portion of the array formation. Without the strength of a Tribulation Eminence, it was impossible for one to enter Dragon Island.
With Meng Chuan’s cultivation realm, he immediately learned everything about Dragon Island after his Essence Soul World probed it. He also knew that five Guardians were on the divine dragons’ island. This hall was permanently guarded by one Guardian.
“What happened to the million divine dragons?” asked Meng Chuan. “Senior, truth be told,” replied the dragon-headed elder bitterly, “Fiend Ancestor Skygrief led five Tribulation Eminences and destroyed our array formation with a single palm strike one hour ago. They abducted all the clansmen on Dragon Island. Back then, they didn’t injure a single clansman... However, they must have begun a massacre after the mass-abduction.”
“Massacre?” Meng Chuan frowned as he looked at him. “How do you know?”
“Dragon Island has a way to sense every clansman’s life and death,” said the dragon-headed elder. “After they were abducted, 100,000 ordinary clansmen died. At the same time, three clansmen at and above the Supremacy realm died.”
Meng Chuan looked at the jade talismans and asked, “Three of the jade talismans here have shattered. Does that mean that three Supremacies and stronger have died?”
“That’s right.” The dragon-headed elder nodded. “In the divine dragon race, when one reaches the Supremacy realm, their Life Talismans will be enshrined here. This is because Supremacies often roam the world. By doing this, the clan can also learn of their fate at any time.”
“What relationship do these three people have with Long Han?” asked Meng Chuan.
The dragon-headed elder was stunned by Meng Chuan’s question.
Long Han was one of the divine dragons’ Imperial Lords. She was naturally valued by Dragon Island.
“Indeed. The three deceased were very close to Long Han,” said the dragon-headed elder. “Long Han’s parents died when she was still young. Therefore, she lived in her master’s house. The three who died are Long Han’s master, senior brother, and junior sister.”
Damn it. Meng Chuan’s expression sank. He wanted to save Long Han and protect the divine dragons. Only then would things be considered well-settled. Now that the three clansmen Long Han was close to had died, Meng Chuan was rather furious. I have to think of a way to save as many people as possible. Since the situation has already reached this point, Long Han will probably suffer a fate worse than death if over a million divine dragon clansmen are killed. An’er will then blame himself for the rest of his life.
Although a small number of divine dragon clansmen roamed the outside world, the million-plus clansmen on Dragon Island were the divine dragons’ most important members. They were also the clansmen Long Han was most familiar with. The more he saved, the better.
Heaven realm.
In a palace beside the World Realm.
“Palace Lord.” The three Fifth Tribulation Eminences were extremely respectful as they faced the thin, cold elder.
Grandsire Three Stones had long grasped a Sixth Tribulation law. He was the strongest expert in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. His body had recently broken through, giving him the impetus to refine the Realm Palace. He clearly wasn’t far from becoming the mystic realm’s lord, so these Fifth Tribulation Eminences naturally became more respectful.
“Have you finished investigating?” asked Three Stones coldly.
“We used the divine dragon clansmen’s lives to threaten her. We used her closest acquaintances-her master, senior brother, and junior sister—to threaten her ten times in a row. We killed 10,000 clansmen each time. We also killed her master, senior brother, and junior sister,” said a black-haired, green-eyed man. “I even controlled her Essence Soul and flipped through her memories. Everything that can be interrogated has been determined.”
A slightly plump, noble-looking woman beside him said, “However, what we obtained wasn’t of much use. All we know is that Island Lord Feather Dragon came from outside the mystic realm. He came to our Earth Cloud Mystic Realm 2,100 years ago. Back then, he was only at the perfected Supremacy realm. After that, he advanced by leaps and bounds and reached the Third Tribulation realm.”
“That’s all?” Three Stones frowned. The one here was only an embodiment. One of his two true bodies was in the outer realm, while the other was refining the Realm Palace.
“There’s no other useful intelligence,” said the black-haired, green-eyed man. “When I flipped through her memories, I discovered that some of her memories—which should’ve existed-have been removed. Those memories are key, but there’s no way to dig into them.”
“Then control her,” instructed Three Stones. “Control her with your Essence Soul and make her loyal to me. She will be on our side and will help us think of a way to deal with that Island Lord Feather Dragon.” “Yes,” replied the three Fifth Tribulation Eminences respectfully.
Moments later,
A white-robed woman’s eyes burned as she looked at Grandsire Three Stones. She was extremely respectful. “Greetings, Palace Lord.”
“What else do you know about your husband?” asked Three Stones.
“I’ve told you everything I know.” The white-robed woman immediately knelt down and guiltily said, “However, my memories have been completely severed. I can’t retrieve them.”
“Tell me, how should we make Island Lord Feather Dragon return without a fuss?” asked Three Stones with a smile.
The white-robed woman tried her best to think, but she shook her head slightly in pain. “He only said that he wanted Senior to send someone to Goddess River Zone and seek him out through karma. I don’t have any other solution... No... perhaps there’s another solution.”
“Oh?” Three Stones and the three Fifth Tribulation Eminences beside him looked at Long Han. “I can sense that a lifeform with a very strong karmic connection with me is in the Earth realm,” said the white-robed woman curiously. “I don’t know this lifeform, but the karmic connection between us is much stronger than the one I had with Master, Senior Brother, and Senior Sister. It’s even stronger than the karma between Feather Dragon and me.”
“Oh?” Three Stones’s eyes lit up. Island Lord Feather Dragon and Long Han are husband and wife. Who is that lifeform with a stronger karmic connection?
“I didn’t manage to find this person when I flipped through her memories,” said the black-haired, green-eyed man immediately. “She must have erased her memories to hide everything about this person.”
“Where is he?” asked the noble woman.
“I’m only an Imperial Lord, so I can’t determine that lifeform’s location when we’re separated by a world,” said Long Han respectfully. “However, the closer I am, the more accurate my senses will be.”
Three Stones nodded. “Very good. One of your true bodies shall stay here. Your other true body will follow Fiend Ancestor Skygrief to Earth realm and find the lifeform with extremely strong karmic ties with you.”
“Yes.” Long Han was extremely respectful. Her two true bodies were imprisoned here.
“I’ll bring her to Earth realm now.” The black-haired, green-eyed man was very excited.

chapters.title: Chapter 614 - Saving Long Han
chapters.content:
Chapter 614 Saving Long Han
“To go as far as hiding her memories by removing them... They definitely don’t want me to discover this person,” said Three Stones solemnly. “This person might be the key to breaking the stalemate. Brother Skygrief, you have to capture this person alive.”
“Palace Lord, don’t worry,” replied Fiend Ancestor Skygrief with a nod.
In the entire Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, Fiend Ancestor Skygrief only listened to Grandsire Three Stones’s orders. As for the other Fifth Tribulation Eminences? They were, at most, on par with him. None of them could threaten him. Thus, Fiend Ancestor Skygrief acted even more brazenly in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. “Let’s go.” Fiend Ancestor Skygrief left the hall with Long Han.
As he watched them leave, Grandsire Three Stones’s eyes were filled with anticipation. He only had an embodiment here, so he could only leave the trivial matters to his subordinates. Fiend Ancestor Skygrief was strong, ruthless, and meticulous. Three Stones was very satisfied with having him as his subordinate.
Swoosh! Swoosh!
Fiend Ancestor Skygrief flew with Long Han.
The Heaven realm was vast, but there were very few living beings. This was because the Essence Energy here was much denser and more violent than in the outer realm. Supremacies would be injured if they stayed in such an environment. Therefore, only Imperial Lords and Tribulation Eminences stayed here for prolonged periods. Naturally, few living beings could be seen here. Whoosh.
A luxurious airship flew through the clouds. On it were three Tribulation Eminences and a group of Imperial Lords. They were drinking and chatting
“It’s Fiend Ancestor Skygrief.” The leading Fourth Tribulation Eminence immediately stood up when he saw the traveling duo from afar. The other Tribulation Eminences and Imperial Lords jumped in fright and hurriedly stood up.
The Fourth Tribulation Eminence bowed. “Greetings, Fiend Ancestor. I’m Fang Rui.”
“Greetings, Fiend Ancestor.” The other Tribulation Eminences and Imperial Lords bowed extremely respectfully. They didn’t even dare to raise their heads. A Fourth Tribulation Eminence might have the confidence to deal with Fiend Ancestor Skygrief, but Third Tribulation Eminences and those weaker would be extremely afraid. This was because Fiend Ancestor Skygrief could wipe them out easily.
Fiend Ancestor Skygrief glanced at Fang Rui and tersely replied before continuing on his journey with Long Han.
“He’s gone.” The cultivators heaved sighs of relief.
“I never expected to encounter Fiend Ancestor Skygrief on this trip.”
“Fiend Ancestor Skygrief is temperamental. We will be dead if we anger him.” “Thankfully, Fiend Ancestor Skygrief couldn’t be bothered with us.”
The Tribulation Eminences and Imperial Lords were glad.
Only the Fifth Tribulation Eminences could do whatever they wanted in the Heaven realm. Grandsire Three Stones was too mysterious, and he seldom showed himself. Among the Fifth Tribulation Eminences, Fiend Ancestor Skygrief was famous for being temperamental. He was a great demon. This naturally made the cultivators in the Heaven realm fear him.
Fiend Ancestor Skygrief led Long Han to the Earth realm.
“My perception of that person is much clearer now.” Long Han’s eyes lit up as she pointed into the distance. “The person is in that direction. We should arrive in about 30 seconds if we continue at our current flying speed.” “The person is that close?” Fiend Ancestor Skygrief was delighted. Even at this moment, Fiend Ancestor Skygrief didn’t raise his guard because he was used to it. In his eyes, nothing posed a danger to him in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm.
“Let’s go.” Fiend Ancestor Skygrief led Long Han on their way.
At this moment
A bolt of lightning emerged from a spacetime rift. The moment it appeared, it arrived in front of Fiend Ancestor Skygrief.
Fiend Ancestor Skygrief was furious.
The lightning bolt was too fast! A complete lightning law was even faster than paramount speed laws. It affected the flow of time by an even higher degree. The bolt of lightning traversed the spacetime rift, appearing and striking Fiend Ancestor Skygrief the moment it appeared.
Fiend Ancestor Skygrief only had enough time to be alarmed. Before he could react, he was already struck.
Boom!
Only the rumbling of thunder remained in Fiend Ancestor Skygrief’s consciousness. His powerful fiend body was instantly obliterated by the lightning.
It was completely destroyed!
Fourth Tribulation Eminences were unable to resist a Fifth Tribulation Eminence’s attacks at all. The difference between a Fifth Tribulation Eminence and a Sixth Tribulation Eminence was even greater. Meng Chuan didn’t even use a Tribulation treasure. Just a single lightning bolt was enough to annihilate Fiend Ancestor Skygrief completely.
Long Han couldn’t help but be stunned when Fiend Ancestor Skygrief was killed. Before she could react, time and all fluctuations stopped.
Time Stillness. The white-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan appeared. Meng Chuan was very happy when he sensed Long Han leaving Grandsire Three Stones’s palace! If Long Han had been by Grandsire Three Stones’s side, he really wouldn’t have been able to save her.
Three Stones was too confident because he had always been Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s strongest expert.
Meng Chuan was cautious. He waited for Skygrief and Long Han to arrive before taking action! Due to the fact that they were separated by a world, Three Stones couldn’t perceive the events taking place here, even when he used all his means.
Long Han. Meng Chuan looked at the motionless, white-robed woman. He knew that she was An’er’s wife.
He had been unable to use Time Stillness when he was dealing with Fiend Ancestor Skygrief! However, when facing Long Han—who was
uch weaker than him-Meng Chuan could make time stop completely. He could leap out of the timeline and have full freedom at that point in time.
Undying Talismans. Meng Chuan took out three Undying Talismans. They flew into Long Han’s sleeve. At the same time, three drops of blood flew out from Long Han’s finger and fused with the Undying Talismans.
In fact, she just needed to place her Essence Soul mark on the talismans. However, an Imperial Lord’s blood also had their Essence Soul mark. Thus, it was sufficient to have her blood fuse with the Undying Talismans.
Three Undying Talismans can give her at least six hours of immortality. Meng Chuan’s heart relaxed as he examined Long Han with the Power of Essence Soul.
Her Essence Soul has been controlled. The one controlling her Essence Soul has relatively weak cultivation. It’s still very easy to restore her individuality. As an Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence, Meng Chuan only took ten seconds to restore Long Han’s Essence Soul completely.
Another drop of blood flew out from Long Han’s fingertip. Meng Chuan reached out and caught it.
Long Han’s blood was faintly golden. Long Han also had a dragon bloodline. She was an Imperial Lord with a dragon bloodline, so her blood was naturally extraordinary.
Annihilate. With this drop of blood, Meng Chuan instantly locked onto Long Han’s other true body in the Heaven realm.
With her blood as a medium, he could kill all her true bodies and avatars. Of course, Meng Chuan had a choice now. He avoided Long Han’s true body—which was beside him—and locked onto her other true body in the Heaven realm.
With a thought
The lightning bolt on his fingertip annihilated the drop of blood. It then followed the karmic connection and attacked Long Han’s true body situated in the Heaven realm.
In the outer realm, a vast black riverspanning 500,000 kilometers-swirled around an area.
A cave abode was situated above the river, and Fiend Ancestor Skygrief lived there.
Th-this... Inside his chamber, Fiend Ancestor Skygrief was somewhat dazed. My true body in my homeworld, Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, has been killed? Fiend Ancestor Skygrief was stunned. I died just like that?
He was instantly killed. He didn’t even know who had attacked him.
I wasn’t able to put up any resistance, and one of my true bodies was instantly killed. Fiend Ancestor Skygrief was somewhat alarmed. It must be a Sixth Tribulation Eminence! Apart from Grandsire Three Stones, there’s another Sixth Tribulation Eminence in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm!
This truth left him alarmed.
Sixth Tribulation Eminences were overlords that reigned supreme in the River of Spacetime. Now, there were two Sixth Tribulation Eminences in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm? Wasn’t he courting death by getting involved? I’ve never thought of making an enemy out of a Sixth Tribulation Eminence. This is an unfamiliar Sixth Tribulation Eminence. I’ll naturally obey your orders if you just say so. Why must you destroy my homeworld’s true body?
How am I to return if my homeworld’s true body is destroyed? Fiend Ancestor Skygrief felt aggrieved. Earth Cloud Mystic Realm was a cultivation holy land after all. It had all sorts of opportunities. Although the outer realm was vast and filled with more possibilities, it was much harder to obtain opportunities in the outer realm. Therefore, Earth Cloud Mystic Realm was extremely important to him. However, he couldn’t return now.
Grandsire Three Stones’s embodiment was inside a palace beside Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s Realm Palace.
Huh? Three Stones was suddenly alarmed. He sensed that Fiend Ancestor Skygrief’s true body in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm had vanished!
Not good. Three Stones turned his head and saw Long Han—who lived in one of the palace buildings—through the various obstacles.
Whoosh. Long Han’s body silently disintegrated.

chapters.title: Chapter 615 - Meng Chuan and Grandsire Three Stones
chapters.content:
Chapter 615 Meng Chuan and Grandsire Three Stones
Grandsire Three Stones’s pupils constricted.
Three Stones thought nothing of a junior like Long Han. What he cared about was Long Han’s husband!
