This was because an array formation had been set up in the entire Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s Realm Palace. The array formation was so brilliant that he could tell it was set up by a Seventh Tribulation Eminence at least. However, Long Han’s husband could easily enter it. He clearly controlled the array formation.
Furthermore, Long Han’s husband was an outsider!
One could leave Earth Cloud Mystic Realm but not return.
However, if Long Han’s husband is capable of entering... Three Stones thought of many possibilities. He definitely couldn’t tolerate other Sixth Tribulation Eminences having control of Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. He had long treated the mystic realm like meat in his bowl.
To kill Fiend Ancestor Skygrief instantly and save Long Han... Could it be that a Sixth Tribulation Eminence has arrived? Three Stones’s mind raced. He didn’t even dare teleport to the spot where Fiend Ancestor Skygrief had died. He was afraid that the unfamiliar Sixth Tribulation Eminence would set up an array formation trap ahead of time. If he were to teleport over, he would fall into the trap.
Not good. I have to return quickly. Three Stones immediately had this thought.
Whoosh.
A stream of light descended from the sky and fused with Grandsire Three Stones’s embodiment. His aura became clearly thicker.
Three Stones’s true body stopped refining the Realm Palace and returned.
Realm Palace was core to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. It was also a rather elegant and quiet cave abode.
The cave abode was 500 kilometers wide and had a large lake surrounding it. Beyond the lake were thick clouds.
The thick clouds completely protected the Realm Palace. The clouds were extremely difficult to pass through, and they exerted immense pressure on lifeforms. Only Sixth Tribulation Eminences could tear through the obstruction to enter the Realm Palace.
Back when Ancestral Master Archean Eon came here, he had set up an array formation and built a passageway. Even the weak could pass through the array formation and enter the cave abode. Meng An had done so previously. However, Meng An was too weak. With Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s array formation, he could enter the Realm Palace and use its cultivation environment. However, he couldn’t refine the Realm Palace for himself to control the mystic realm.
Although a mystic realm was inferior to a high-level world, it was much stronger than a middle-level world. It nurtured a large number of living beings. If one wanted to control such a mystic realm, the burden would be immense. Only a Sixth Tribulation Eminence could withstand it.
Swoosh.
A person appeared out of thin air in the elegant cave abode—the white-haired, white-robed Meng Chuan. Oh? Grandsire Three Stones is really decisive. He actually reacted instantly and fled with his true body? With a thought, Meng Chuan sensed the situation in the Realm Palace. Three Stones had clearly fled in advance.
It wasn’t the proper strategy to expose my existence and attack without saving Long Han. However, I was still a step too late by the time I saved Long Han and teleported over.
The Realm Palace had an array formation set up by Ancestral Master Archean Eon. Even if Meng An activated the array formation, he was far from being Grandsire Three Stones’s match. However, as his father, Meng Chuan held the terrain advantage if he controlled the Realm Palace’s array formation! He had a 90% chance of winning against Grandsire Three Stones.
The Realm Palace is truly extraordinary. The Essence Energy here was docile and rich. A special aura emanated from the Realm Palace, allowing his Essence Soul to think faster.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s Heaven and Earth Great Hall is an imitation of the Realm Palace. However, the Realm Palace is much more brilliant when it comes to protection. Meng Chuan sighed in amazement. After all, an Eighth Tribulation Eminence had spent a lot of effort to create the mystic realm. To an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, the process of creating a world was another form of cultivation. As the core of a mystic realm, the Realm Palace was even more mysterious and unfathomable.
In terms of karmic obstruction, Realm Palaces were even more magical. They could confuse the heavenly secrets, turning karma blurry to prevent detection.
In fact, one’s detection of living beings in the mystic realm was also affected when one was outside the mystic realm. Previously, Meng Chuan only knew that his son was in Taidong River Zone. As for his exact location? He couldn’t lock onto it.
Eighth Tribulation Eminences are even more brilliant when it comes to karma. The more Meng Chuan cultivated, the more reverent he became. Seventh Tribulation Eminences’ strength was already inconceivable. Eighth Tribulation Eminences far exceeded Seventh Tribulation Eminences. The weapons, mystic realms, and legacies they left behind would even be restricted by the River of Spacetime’s laws.
In a floating palace outside the Realm Palace.
Three Stones led his subordinates and flew out of the palace. They levitated in midair and looked at Realm Palace from afar.
“Palace Lord, Fiend Ancestor Skygrief’s true body has been killed?” asked the slightly plump, noble-looking woman beside him softly.
The other cyan-robed elder was somewhat uneasy. Both of them were Fifth Tribulation Eminences. None of the Fifth Tribulation Eminences in the entire Earth Cloud Mystic Realm dared to disobey Grandsire Three Stones. Fiend Ancestor Skygrief was at his beck and call and was very trusted by Three Stones.
It was impossible for Grandsire Three Stones to kill Fiend Ancestor Skygrief. Thus, only leaving one possibility-another Sixth Tribulation Eminence was around. Upon thinking of another Sixth Tribulation Eminence’s existence, these Fifth Tribulation Eminences were naturally flustered. They were afraid of being implicated.
“Don’t be anxious. We’ll know in a while.” Three Stones calmly looked ahead before chuckling. “He’s here.”
Oh? The slightly plump woman, the cyan-robed elder, and the other Tribulation Eminences looked carefully. From afar, a figure flew out from the thick clouds. He was dressed in white, and his white hair draped over his shoulders. The pressure he exuded wasn’t strong either.
When Three Stones’s body reached the Sixth Tribulation realm, the pressure he exuded was extremely terrifying. Just a little of his aura made Fifth Tribulation Eminences panic. However, the white-robed, white-haired man in front of them didn’t exude much pressure.
“Grandsire Three Stones, you fled rather quickly,” said Meng Chuan. “It’s really as I expected.” The skinny Three Stones looked at Meng Chuan. “You are in cahoots with Island Lord Feather Dragon. You really can control the array formation in the Realm Palace. If I were any slower, I would have died.”
He immediately left back then. This was because he had yet to refine the Realm Palace. He would hold no terrain advantage by staying there, but the other party could control the Realm Palace’s array formation.
As a Sixth Tribulation Eminence, his chances of winning were too low if the other party had the terrain advantage.
“I’m somewhat puzzled.” Three Stones narrowed his eyes as he looked at Meng Chuan. “I’ve never seen you before. You can sneak into the Realm Palace and use the Realm Palace’s array formation to deal with me. Once you destroy my true body, you will be able to control the entire Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. Instead of doing so, you hid in the shadows. You saved Long Han before entering the Realm Palace, giving me a chance to leave the Realm Palace... In your eyes, a mystic realm doesn’t even compare to Long Han’s life?”
Meng Chuan continued looking at him.
Yes.
Meng Chuan didn’t pay much attention to the mystic realm. After cultivating for 2,600 years, he had reached the Sixth Tribulation realm. All that was left was the Tribulation Transcendence trial.
With such cultivation speed, Meng Chuan naturally set his sights on the higher Seventh Tribulation realm. A mystic realm? He would occupy one if he came across one, but it didn’t matter if he didn’t. For example, how many Seventh Tribulation Eminences would become the owner of a mystic realm themselves? They typically reserved it for future generations.
“Since you care about Long Han’s life, you should also care about the lives of all the divine dragons.” Three Stones stared at Meng Chuan, and his eyes turned colder. He flipped his palm, revealing a small black pagoda. “More than a million divine dragon clansmen are inside this pagoda. Their lives depend on you.
“Give me this Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, and they shall live. Otherwise, they die.” Three Stones looked at Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan scoffed in disdain. “I only saved Feather Dragon’s wife because he begged me. I can’t be bothered with his wife’s clansmen. You want me to give up a mystic realm for some race I know nothing about? Dream on.”
Three Stones’s expression changed slightly.
“One of my Essence Soul avatars has already begun refining the Realm Palace,” said Meng Chuan. “The array formation left behind by my Ancestral Master can greatly accelerate my refinement speed. I believe I will be able to control the mystic realm in a few years. Do you have the guts to stop me inside the Realm Palace? Therefore, I’ve already won! This Earth Cloud Mystic Realm is destined to be mine.”
He has already won? Three Stones was somewhat anxious, but he knew that the other party was right. The other party was refining the array formation, but he didn’t dare to enter! The Realm Palace had an array formation set up by the man’s Ancestral Master. He would only be tempting fate if he entered.
Damn it. He’s relying on the array formation left behind by his predecessor. Three Stones was rather indignant. He lost simply because the other party had the help of a predecessor’s array formation.
However, as a Sixth Tribulation Eminence, he couldn’t let the other party have an easy time snatching Earth Cloud Mystic Realm away from him.
“Once I completely refine the Realm Palace,” Meng Chuan stared at Three Stones and said, “I can easily crush your true body. However, I can give you a chance. Release all the divine dragons. Don’t implicate the juniors, and I will fight you fair and square to determine the better person. The winner will obtain Earth Cloud Mystic Realm.”
“From the looks of it, you still care about the divine dragons’ lives.” Three Stones chuckled as he stared at Meng Chuan.
“You can kill them.” Meng Chuan looked at him. “Be more straightforward. To be honest, the ownership of the mystic realm isn’t that important to me. The divine dragons aren’t that important either.” Meng Chuan looked at Three Stones. “I want both, but losing them isn’t a big deal. Therefore, I want to fight you. If I win, it’s all mine. If I lose, Earth Cloud Mystic Realm will be yours.
“You can choose to agree or refuse. It’s up to you,” said Meng Chuan indifferently. Three Stones looked at Meng Chuan. He could sense the other party’s will. A Sixth Tribulation Eminence wouldn’t change their mind easily.
“Alright.” Three Stones nodded. “The divine dragons have you to thank for saving them. I also promise not to implicate the juniors in the future... However, a fair battle naturally has to be sufficiently fair. I think we should choose to hold our fight in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s Heaven realm.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Alright, let’s have it in the Heaven realm.”
“Pass down the order,” instructed Three Stones. “In an hour, all Tribulation Eminences and Imperial Lords in the Heaven realm will descend to the lower realms.”
“Yes.” The plump, noble-looking woman, the cyan-robed elder, and the other Tribulation Eminences respectfully acknowledged the order.
The entire Heaven realm was about to become a battlefield for the two Sixth Tribulation Eminences. The other cultivators couldn’t stay any longer.
“Wait an hour,” said Three Stones. “I have quite a number of disciples. By the way, I’ll give you the divine dragons.” With that said, he threw out the small black pagoda. “Good.” Meng Chuan extended his hand and received the black pagoda. After a brief probe, he discovered that a large number of terrified and uneasy divine dragons were inside the pagoda. More than a million clansmen were in horror, afraid that they would be exterminated.
Swoosh.
The Essence Soul avatar took a step and left with the black pagoda. Before the battle, he had to settle in the divine dragons, Long Han, and Meng Yu.
An’er, I’ve saved everyone that can be saved, thought Meng Chuan. I’ve already done my best.
Time slowly passed.
A white-robed, white-haired man and a thin, cold elder stood in midair silently, waiting for the great relocation of the entire Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s Heaven realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 616 - Battle of Sixth Tribulation Eminences (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 616 Battle of Sixth Tribulation Eminences (1)
“The battle between Grandsire Three Stones and an unknown Sixth Tribulation Eminence will determine the ownership of Earth Cloud Mystic Realm? The entire Heaven realm is set to be their battlefield?” As the news spread, the entire Heaven realm fell into chaos.
The factions that could take root in the Heaven realm were knowledgeable. They knew what a Sixth Tribulation Eminence meant. Even in the outer realm, Sixth Tribulation Eminences were invincible as long as Seventh Tribulation Eminences didn’t appear. All of them were extremely terrifying.
“Quick, quick, quick.”
“Hurry up and move if you can. Hurry up and go to the lower realms. If we get implicated, we will all die.”
The many Tribulation Eminences and Imperial Lords in the Heaven realm were extremely alarmed. Most of the Tribulation Eminences only had one true body in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. If they died, they wouldn’t be able to return to the mystic realm! The Imperial Lords’ true bodies in the Heaven realm carried many treasures with them. If they died, the treasures would be gone.
“This is the sect headquarters that we built after years of hard work. Sigh! The next time I return to the Heaven realm, this place will probably be in ruins.”
“Move everything you can.” “In ten minutes, we have to go to the lower realms.”
Although Grandsire Three Stones had instructed them to move in an hour, some time had passed before the news reached the various factions in the Heaven realm. Therefore, everyone had to relocate quickly.
Thankfully, only eight Fifth Tribulation Eminences lived in the Heaven realm other than Ancestral Fiend Skygrief. The other Tribulation Eminences numbered less than 1,000, and the number of Imperial Lords had just exceeded 10,000. At this level, news spread very quickly. “The Heaven realm has been reduced to a battlefield. I wonder who will be in control of our Earth Cloud Mystic Realm after this battle between Grandsire Three Stones and the other mysterious Sixth Tribulation Eminence.”
“This isn’t something an Imperial Lord like you needs to worry about. No matter who controls Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, we just need to be obedient.”
Realm Palace, in a grotto-heaven that Meng Chuan carried with him.
Meng Yu’s eyes turned red when he saw the white-robed Long Han. “Mom.” “Yu’er.” Tears welled up in Long Han’s eyes. After being saved by Meng Chuan and regaining her sense of self, she learned of what had happened. She had been captured, and a large number of her clansmen had died. Her master, senior brother, and junior sister had also died...
Long Han was filled with horror. She was afraid that more people would die—the clansmen who had raised her. The entire divine dragon race had even been captured. If her entire race was destroyed because of this, even a hundred deaths couldn’t make up for her sins.
There was also her child. After her Essence Soul was controlled, she was loyal to Grandsire Three Stones. She had actually led her enemies to find her child.
“Grandfather saved you?” Meng Yu was very excited. He knew that his mother had been captured by the enemy.
“Yes, he saved me.” Long Han nodded. “It’s all thanks to your grandfather. He saved you and
me.”
“It’s been more than 400 years. I’ve finally met you again, Mom.” Meng Yu’s emotions surged. He had been cultivating alone in the Earth realm for many years. He yearned to meet his family.
Long Han looked at her son as her mind went adrift.
“Mom, what’s wrong?” asked Meng Yu.
“Nothing.” Long Han didn’t say much. She was worried about her race.
She was proud of her status as a divine dragon. The divine dragons had experienced many calamities over the years. They had even been in danger of being wiped out twice. However, many divine dragons were scattered across the universe. Some even concealed their identities... When they became stronger, they would eventually rebuild Dragon Island.
Dad promised me that he would try his best to save the divine dragons. However, the divine dragons are in the hands of Grandsire Three Stones, so even he doesn’t have full confidence. Long Han could only pray silently.
Grandsire Three Stones was a Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
All the factions in the entire Earth Cloud Mystic Realm looked up to him. Long Han was already very excited that Meng Chuan dared to make the claim of rescuing them. At the very least, she saw hope.
“Long Han.” A voice suddenly sounded in Long Han’s mind. “Grandsire Three Stones has already agreed to fight me. He has also released all the divine dragons. There’s no need for you to worry.” They’ve been saved? Long Han found it unbelievable because all the divine dragons had been rescued not long after he saved her.
“Dad, are you going to battle Grandsire Three Stones?” asked Long Han via voice transmission. She was worried.
“Don’t worry.” Meng Chuan was very calm.
Heaven realm.
In the entire Heaven realm, there were only two living beings outside the Realm Palace.
One was Meng Chuan, and the other was Grandsire Three Stones.
“Everyone has gone to the lower realms.” Three Stones smiled and looked at Meng Chuan. “By the way, how should I address you?”
“Eastcalm,” said Meng Chuan without hiding anything.
Three Stones nodded slightly. He was somewhat puzzled. He had long gathered intelligence on the River of Spacetime’s Sixth Tribulation Eminences. Although the River of Spacetime was vast, there weren’t many Sixth Tribulation Eminences. He knew 99% of the Sixth Tribulation Eminences at least. It was possible that he didn’t know a few newly-advanced and reclusive Sixth Tribulation Eminences, but he should know most of the normal ones. However, he had never heard of the name Eastcalm.
He didn’t know that the outside world thought Meng Chuan to be at the Fifth Tribulation realm!
Although only one Fifth Tribulation Eminence existed in two river systems on average, there were too many Fifth Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime. Fifth Tribulation Eminences were appearing all the time, while others died. The ones paying attention to City Lord Eastcalm were mainly the Cang Alliance members and those living around Goddess River Zone.
“To be honest, I never expected you to be willing to give up Earth Cloud Mystic Realm just for the divine dragons,” said Three Stones.
“I didn’t give up. I just gave you a chance,” said Meng Chuan.
“Haha, anything will do,” said Three Stones. “Before we start, I need you to confirm... that this battle will decide the ownership of Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. No matter who wins or loses, we are not to implicate the juniors.”
The juniors Meng Chuan was most concerned about were from Archean Eon Realm.
Grandsire Three Stones had grown up in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. He had many clansmen and juniors here. He was also worried that Meng Chuan would slaughter them after losing
“Don’t worry. I won’t implicate the juniors,” said Meng Chuan. Three Stones nodded. “Alright.”
At their level, promises had karmic implications.
“After I grasped a Sixth Tribulation law, I cultivated for nearly 10,000 years before my body broke through,” said Three Stones. “Brother Eastcalm, try this move of mine.”
As soon as he finished speaking
Boom
Three Stones punched out!
When he punched out, a terrifying fluctuation instantly penetrated Meng Chuan’s body. It even reached the end of the entire Heaven realm. The Heaven Realm was 4.5 million kilometers in diameter, and the world was very stable. Now, as the punch pierced Meng Chuan’s body, it destroyed all the mountains and sect buildings along the way. It only stopped when it struck the end of the Heaven realm.
Meng Chuan’s afterimages dissipated as he appeared on the other side. His expression turned solemn.
Every Sixth Tribulation Eminence was terrifying. The moment the punch was delivered, fluctuations tore through the entire Heaven realm. Following that, the punch pierced through Meng Chuan’s afterimages.
“What speed.” Three Stones looked at Meng Chuan in surprise.
The Earth lineage? Meng Chuan looked at the other party. Meng Chuan had gathered intelligence on Sixth Tribulation Eminences in the outer realm, but there was no one named Grandsire Three Stones. Three Stones had clearly changed his name in the outer realm. “You will learn of my means later.” Three Stones’s aura began to intensify.
Meng Chuan nodded. “Alright.”
Whoosh.
At the same time, Meng Chuan’s avatars appeared in various spots in the Heaven realm. They happened to circle Three Stones, putting him at the center.
Eight avatars? Three Stones’s expression changed slightly. The most difficult thing to deal with when fighting Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences was their numerous avatars. After all the effort one spent to kill their opponent, they could only kill one avatar at the end of the day. Even if one true body was destroyed, the other avatars wouldn’t be affected.
“Grandsire Three Stones, please have a taste of my lightning array formation.” Meng Chuan’s voice echoed throughout the entire Heaven realm.
Rumble!
The entire Heaven Realm was only 4.5 million kilometers in diameter. As for Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World, it spanned four million kilometers. He also activated the Seventh Tribulation treasure, Lightning Pool Chart, and fused it with his Essence Soul World. Combined with his Essence Soul World, the array formation’s strength reached a terrifying level.

chapters.title: Chapter 617 - Battle of Sixth Tribulation Eminences (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 617 Battle of Sixth Tribulation Eminences (2)
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World enveloped more than half of the Heaven realm as lightning sizzled out of existence like water.
The lightning was like water. Countless bolts of lightning gathered like a vast lake.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
Grandsire Three Stones solemnly looked at his surroundings. Even the void around him had been torn apart. The nearby mountains and rivers naturally had disintegrated into nothingness.
The terrifying electromagnetic force seeped into Three Stones’s body, attempting to tear apart his body. At the same time, a terrifying compression force was acting on him from outside his body! Compression, stretching, repulsion, suppression, shearing... All sorts of opposing forces perfectly worked together like soldiers. They acted on an area around Three Stones as they ground through his body crazily.
Ordinary Fifth Tribulation Eminences would instantly disintegrate if they dared to step into a zone of such terrifying forces.
As a Physical Body Sixth Tribulation Eminence, Three Stones had many layers of defenses on his skin surface. Every particle in his body was extremely heavy. Although he could completely withstand such attacks, his strength was slightly affected. It’s said that every Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence is an array formation master. It looks rather interesting. The corners of Grandsire Three Stones’s mouth curled up slightly. No matter how the lightning pool domain constantly produced lightning, he still had the confidence to face all dangers. A Physical Body Tribulation Eminence relied on their physical body to kill enemies in close combat to begin with.
However, it’s useless against me. Three Stones’s expression turned ferocious as he exerted all his strength. Every particle in his body erupted like a star. With all his might, countless particles condensed into one. They erupted from Three Stones’s fists as he punched out in all directions.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!
Instantly, hundreds of terrifying fluctuations surged out from Three Stones. They passed through Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars, penetrated the entire array formation, and struck the ends of the world.
Eight Meng Chuans appeared beside Three Stones. They weren’t hit at all.
Oh? The eight Meng Chuans’ expressions suddenly changed.
When the fluctuations reached the end of the world, they bounced back and continued chasing after Meng Chuan’s avatars.
Every fluctuation reached maximum speedthe speed of light! Furthermore, they affected the flow of time. They instantly arrived at the end of the world. They constantly bombarded, rebounded, merged, and split the Heaven realm as they crazily attacked Meng Chuan’s avatars.
If it weren’t for the Lightning Grand Array’s suppression, these fluctuations wouldn’t have weakened at all. Meng Chuan was secretly surprised. This law was extremely strange. It caused fluctuations to spread in a certain area constantly. However, Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminences were the best when it came to domains. Meng Chuan’s Lightning Pool Chart-combined with his Essence Soul World-constantly weakened the fluctuations. After just a few rebounds, the fluctuations were weakened to the point of disappearing.
The lightning lineage? Three Stones frowned slightly. My moves are fast, but Eastcalm is even faster.
Each of the eight Meng Chuans could move at the speed of light. Furthermore, their influence on the time flow and space distortions were even more exaggerated. Every fluctuation seemed to pierce through Meng Chuan, but they actually happened too far away.
Meng Chuan moved faster than Three Stones’s attacks.
They were both Sixth Tribulation Eminences!
Meng Chuan, who had grasped a lightning law, had an absolute advantage in speed. “Brother Eastcalm, with your speed, it would be very difficult for me to threaten you in the outside world. However, this is Earth Cloud Mystic Realm! The available area you can dodge in is too small!” Three Stones’s voice resounded throughout the Heaven realm.
Boom!
Three Stones’s body rapidly expanded. He was originally thinner and smaller than an ordinary person, but he rapidly grew taller than a mountain. In the blink of an eye, he expanded to an unimaginable height.
He stepped on the ground, his head almost touching the firmaments.
About 600,000 kilometers tall? Meng Chuan looked at the massive creature. This is only because the entire Heaven realm can only accommodate such heights. The Heaven realm spanned 4.5 million kilometers. The dome was only 600,000 kilometers from the ground.
Grandsire Three Stones—who was at the Physical Body Sixth Tribulation realm-had become such a giant. With one foot, he crushed three lakes and many mountains. With the other foot, he destroyed a large sect’s territory.
Boom!
At that moment, Three Stones grew arms-a total of 100 arms. Every arm seemed to stretch across the world. The arms’ muscles bulged and sank like mountains.
In the outer realm, some Physical Body Sixth Tribulation Eminences could still maintain their peak strength, even if they expanded to over 50 million kilometers, due to the different laws they grasped. They could use Grand Yang Stars and Grand Yin Stars as playthings.
“Die!” shouted Three Stones-whose head nearly touched the firmament dome. His hundred arms could strike almost every corner of the Heaven realm with their flailing.
To him, the Heaven realm was too small.
Any distance was equivalent to engaging in close combat for him! He was right. If Meng Chuan, who grasped a lightning law, was in the outer realm, he could easily hide far away since he had a vast range. However, both parties were fighting in the Heaven realm. Even if the entire Heaven realm was the battlefield, it was still too small.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
The lightning pool fused with Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World, causing the four-million-kilometer wide Lightning Grand Array to produce lightning constantly.
More and more aqueous lightning bolts appeared, and the lightning pool grew even more turbulent.
The hundred-armed giant easily withstood the lightning pool’s might as he punched out in all directions.
They were too close to each other. With 100 arms attacking at full strength, it was somewhat difficult for the eight Meng Chuans to dodge. After all, more than ten arms attacked a single avatar on average. Sometimes, more than 20 arms attacked an Essence Soul avatar from every direction.
Clang!
Finally, a nearly 500,000-kilometer-long arm brushed past Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar. The Essence Soul avatar shattered with a bang
An Essence Soul avatar was ultimately much weaker.
Oh? It’s just an ordinary Essence Soul avatar. Three Stones didn’t show any signs of joy because he knew that Meng Chuan’s true body definitely carried a protective item. It couldn’t be destroyed so easily.
Whoosh.
The seven Meng Chuans split out another Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan’s true body could instantly recover, even if 40% of his Essence Soul Origins was destroyed. Although an ordinary Essence Soul avatar’s recovery speed was much lower, it could instantly split out a new Essence Soul avatar.
Bam! Bam! Bam!
In the Heaven realm, Meng Chuan dodged time and time again. His Essence Soul avatars were destroyed one after another, but Meng Chuan continued to control the Lightning Pool Chart patiently. He accumulated more and more lightning.
This Eastcalm can easily escape with his true body. He’s just using his Essence Soul avatars to preside over the array formation. Three Stones felt his heart tighten. However, his true body hasn’t left. Apart from being confident, he definitely has other plans. Furthermore, this array formation... is constantly accumulating lightning, but it hasn’t unleashed its load.
Yes.
The lightning was like water. More and more lightning gathered, and the lightning pool grew larger and larger. The number of lightning bolts alarmed Three Stones.
es.
It’s about time. Meng Chuan had gathered lightning in the Lightning Pool Chart’s array formation for 45 seconds. After accumulating an extremely massive amount of lightning, he waved his hand, and the 13 beads on his wrist flew out.
Thirteen Universe Beads!
Boom!
The Thirteen Universe Beads floated in all directions. Every one of them frantically absorbed the lightning pool’s ‘water,’ and countless lightning bolts surged into the Thirteen Universe Beads. Every bead became massive. As they absorbed a large amount of the lightning pool’s ‘water,’ their explosive might increased rapidly. Every single one of them floated everywhere like a small universe.
The Thirteen Universe Beads was peerlessly mysterious. It was the most powerful Seventh Tribulation treasure of the lightning lineage Ancestral Master Archean Eon had collected. Meng Chuan had always placed great importance on it. It wasn’t easy to find such a treasure.
In the past, Meng Chuan was weak. With the Thirteen Universe Beads in hand, the might he could unleash was too weak.
Now that he had reached the Sixth Tribulation realm and grasped a lightning law, he could unleash some of its true might by activating the Thirteen Universe Beads. However, each of them was massive. He needed enough lightning to activate them.
Therefore, he chose to buy the Lightning Pool Chart because he wanted to couple it with the Thirteen Universe Beads. The Lightning Pool Chart could accumulate enough lightning to make the Thirteen Universe Beads stronger.
“Die!” Meng Chuan looked at the towering hundred-armed giant. The Thirteen Universe Beads were like small universes as they rumbled and smashed! Instantly, they reached the speed of light. As spacetime distorted, they instantly struck the hundred-armed giant, which could not feasibly dodge due to his huge size. Every blow connected.
Swish!
At the same time, a black Magic Awl flew out of Meng Chuan’s true body. It was a Magic Awl condensed from 40% of his Essence Soul’s Origins. It instantly struck the hundred-armed giant.

chapters.title: Chapter 618 - Battle of Sixth Tribulation Eminences (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 618 Battle of Sixth Tribulation Eminences (3)
So this move is the reason why he has accumulated so much lightning. Upon seeing the Thirteen Universe Beads, Grandsire Three Stones knew that he couldn’t dodge them.
Every Sixth Tribulation Eminence had their own strengths. There was only one way to deal with an Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence-fight head-on.
Humph.
Three Stones tucked in his arms in a bid to block the attack. His terrifying body also contained layers of energy as they passed through his body. They stacked like waves as he prepared himself for the attack. Chi!
The Magic Awl struck Three Stones first.
The Magic Awl Forbidden Spell was an Essence Soul mystic technique that Ancestral Master Archean Eon had found. Its explosive power was the best among all the mystic techniques. The only flaw was that it would shatter if it failed to pierce through the opponent’s Essence Soul. This caused great damage to the user’s body.
After reaching the Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation realm and having the Essence Soul Star formulation, Meng Chuan could instantly recover after losing 40% of his Essence Soul Origins. If he lost more, it would take him a long time to recover. For example, the Essence Soul Star’s forbidden spell—Indiscriminate Destruction-was probably twice as powerful as the Magic Awl. However, he would take decades to recover after using it once. Meng Chuan wouldn’t use such a move in light of the upcoming Heavenly Tribulation. This is? Three Stones felt a sharp pain in his Essence Soul. The Magic Awl shattered the moment it struck him. Three Stones’s Sixth Tribulation body was too perfect and powerful, but the will contained within the Magic Awl impacted his consciousness.
His consciousness quaked as his Essence Soul rumbled. The hundred arms that he wanted to use to defend himself slowed down slightly. The fluctuations in his body became chaotic.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The moment he was struck by the Magic Awl and had his consciousness quake, the Thirteen Universe Beads struck him.
With Three Stones’s body, he could reduce the impact by 70-80% if he was well-prepared. Now that his consciousness had been affected, his defense was a mess. He only managed to reduce 20-30 percent of the Thirteen Universe Beads’ impact and took the brunt of the remaining impact. Three Stones—whose feet were on the ground and had the firmament dome right above his head-had one of his arms distort and fracture.
His severed arm was sent flying, and a huge bloody hole appeared in his chest. His skin and muscles were destroyed by the Universe Beads that resembled a small universe. His flesh and blood were exposed. His head was also blasted open. A dark yellow skull could be seen as shards of his skull flew everywhere... Three Stones looked somewhat tragic. He staggered a few steps back before stabilizing himself.
Essence Soul mystic technique. Three Stones’s pupils constricted. If it weren’t for the Essence Soul mystic technique, his injuries would’ve been negligible. However, his injuries were rather severe. A portion of his body structure had been destroyed completely.
What a powerful body. If the Magic Awl was weaker, his injuries would probably be lighter. Meng Chuan was alarmed. The Magic Awl’s strength depended on one’s cultivation realm and willpower. Lightning Pool World, Thirteen Universe Formations! Meng Chuan’s heart stirred, and another Magic Awl blasted out. At the same time, the Three Universe Beads moved. Meng Chuan completely treated Three Stones as an experimental subject as he used the Thirteen Universe Beads’ various techniques to their fullest.
The Thirteen Universe Beads also contained a set of array formations—Thirteen Universe Formations. When the array formations were activated simultaneously, the enemy would feel as though they had entered 13 different spaces. The Universe Beads were the core of each space. They had different offensive methods.
For example, with the other 12 Universe Beads as support, the might gathered within the final Universe Bead could be unleashed at full might. Another example would be nine Universe Beads as supplements to three Universe Beads—which were the core. The 13 spaces would then combine to form a Chaos Hole...
Crap.
A Magic Awl shattered, and a new Magic Awl condensed.
Magic Awls continuously struck Three Stones’s massive body. Under the impact, Three Stones’s consciousness could only use a portion of its mental strength to deal with the Thirteen Universe Beads’ attacks.
I’m completely trapped. Three Stones discovered the changes in the surrounding space. The Heaven realm was clearly only 9 million kilometers wide, but no matter how he ran or fought in the Thirteen Universe Formations, he was still within the array formation’s range. He couldn’t reach the Heaven realm’s edge.
The lightning pool array accumulated lightning, which constantly surged into the Universe Beads.
The Thirteen Universe Beads formed a large array formation and attacked Three Stones.
Bam! Bam! Bam!
Three Stones tried to shrink in size, but the Thirteen Universe Beads became even smaller. Their might didn’t decrease at all as they kept attacking him, constantly injuring his body.
This Eastcalm is really quite difficult to deal with. Three Stones had to admit that this unfamiliar Sixth Tribulation Eminence, Eastcalm, was indeed superior to him.
Sixth Tribulation Eminences were skilled in their own law, but the various laws had differences in strength.
It was publicly acknowledged that the strongest was a spatial law. Meng Chuan’s lightning law was considered one of the stronger ones. He was rather good at attacking and killing enemies. The Universe Beads destroyed a portion of Three Stones’s body every time. Together with Meng Chuan’s speed advantage thanks to the lightning law, it was difficult for enemies to dodge his attacks. When Meng Chuan fled, it would be difficult for his enemies to pursue him. It was indeed a rather powerful Sixth Tribulation law.
Furthermore, Meng Chuan was an Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence. With the array formation suppressing Three Stones, he couldn’t touch Meng Chuan’s true body. The outer realm also publicly acknowledged that the higher one’s cultivation level was, the more terrifying an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence was compared to a Physical Body Tribulation Eminence.
An Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence that has grasped a lightning law. His Essence Soul mystic technique is also amazing. Even if I have many treasures, I can only last for an hour at best. Three Stones knew this very well. All sorts of treasures had very weak effects on powerful Tribulation Eminences. For example, an Undying Talisman’s energy could keep Imperial Lords alive for two hours. However, the effects were rather weak on Tribulation Eminences.
It could take the place of a Fifth Tribulation Eminence, preventing them from dying once, but it was useless for Sixth Tribulation Eminences!
At the end of the day, Three Stones’s true body had never been to the outer realm! All the treasures he had were gathered in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, so his life-preservation means were relatively limited.
However, I have to win this battle. Earth Cloud Mystic Realm is mine! Three Stones withstood the Magic Awls’ and the Universe Beads’ attacks. With a flip of his hand, he took out a red crystal pillar. Since he had concealed it with his powers, Meng Chuan didn’t discover it.
“Die!” Three Stones’s expression was ferocious. A large amount of sanguine aura surged into the red crystal pillar in his hand, and his body became much weaker. When he was struck by a Universe Bead, he fell to the ground. The moment he fell, he suddenly threw out the red crystal pillar in his hand.
Boom!
A scarlet stream of light instantly tore through the array formation and sent a Universe Bead flying. It even penetrated one of Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars.
Meng Chuan’s avatars moved extremely quickly, causing spacetime to distort. However, they were inferior to the scarlet stream of light.
Not good. Meng Chuan’s true body and many of his avatars transformed into lightning particles as lightning bolts surged everywhere.
Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft...
Scarlet streams of light crazily tore through the surroundings, constantly destroying Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars. “Eastcalm!” Three Stones’s expression changed as he gritted his teeth and roared, “You are really shameless!”
“Haha, shameless? I’m at the Essence Soul Tribulation realm. My true body should be hidden in a safe place to begin with. It’s enough for me to use my Essence Soul avatar to fight you.” Meng Chuan’s voice resounded throughout the Heaven realm. The moment he sensed something amiss, Meng Chuan’s true body had already fled into the Realm Palace.
The Realm Palace was in the center of the Heaven realm. It was also within Meng Chuan’s array formation. He could enter it instantly.
It was naturally much safer to hide in the Realm Palace that came equipped with layers of protection. “If you have the ability, kill all my Essence Soul avatars. Then you will win.” Meng Chuan’s voice was mighty.
One Essence Soul avatar after another transformed into lightning and roamed the Heaven realm. Even though the scarlet streams of light destroyed them, the other Essence Soul avatars quickly split out new Essence Soul avatars.
With the recovery speed of Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars, it was very easy for him to create new Essence Soul avatars. Furthermore, Essence Soul avatars flew out of the Realm Palace.
His Essence Soul avatars constantly perished and revived as he controlled the lightning pool array and the Thirteen Universe Beads to continue attacking Three Stones.
I’ve snatched your Tribulation treasure. Let’s see how you fight me. Three Stones controlled the scarlet streams of light from afar and consecutively struck five Universe Beads, causing the Thirteen Universe Formations to be destroyed. Three Stones took the opportunity to extend his hand. His palm stretched out like it could cover the sky as he grabbed the weakest Universe Bead after the collision.
The Five-Colored Pillar is that powerful? Meng Chuan was alarmed. Meng Chuan instantly guessed what the scarlet stream of light was.
There was a legend in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm that there was a treasure known as the Five-Colored Pillar. It contained mysterious and unfathomable power. In history, only one or two crystal pillars had appeared. Only Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s owner could control all the Five-Colored Pillars.
The Five-Colored Pillar was closely related to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. It was impossible to bring it out of the mystic realm.
When Meng Chuan saw the scarlet crystal pillar, he guessed that it was the Scarlet Blood Divine Pillar.
Buzz
The Universe Bead—which had been grabbed by Three Stones-constantly trembled as it resisted with all its might. The other 12 Universe Beads set up a formation again and triggered the captured Universe Bead, greatly strengthening its resistance. Furthermore, the 12 Universe Beads continued to attack.
“Die!” At that moment, the lightning pool array condensed terrifying lightning bolts that struck at Three Stones.
As a Seventh Tribulation treasure, the Lightning Pool Chart’s ability to produce lightning was only one of its uses. It could also be used for killing enemies.
Killing enemies with lightning! The Lightning Pool Chart’s lightning was much stronger than the lightning that Meng Chuan condensed out of nothing
Bolts of lightning struck Three Stones.
“Hahaha, you’re still struggling.” Three Stones laughed loudly. “City Lord Eastcalm, you didn’t lose because you weren’t strong enough. It was because you didn’t have enough opportunities. I have the Scarlet Blood Divine Pillar, so this Earth Cloud Mystic Realm is destined to be mine.”
If he could snatch an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence’s treasure, what threat could an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence pose?
Whoosh.
At that moment, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar traveled from the distant Archean Eon Realm and arrived at the Realm Palace.
The Essence Soul avatar quickly flew out of the Realm Palace and joined the battlefield.
Huh? The confident Three Stones’s expression changed as he looked up.
A huge eye appeared in the sky.
The Heavenly Eye looked down below.
This is? Three Stones felt an inexplicable fear.
Go. With a thought, he controlled the Scarlet Blood Divine Pillar to attack the huge eye above him.
Boom!
Lightning struck down from the huge eye! Lightning constantly rumbled as the Scarlet Blood Divine Pillar was drowned by the lightning! It tried its best to withstand the lightning as it charged upwards, but it became slower and slower. Advancing became more and more difficult.
Three Stones—who was controlling the pillar
— turned increasingly pale. He felt that controlling the Scarlet Blood Divine Pillar consumed more and more of his lifeblood.
Bam!
More and more lightning descended from the huge eye as the might became even more terrifying. Finally, it completely destroyed the Scarlet Blood Divine Pillar. It plummeted, and the terrifying lightning instantly drowned Three Stones.
Three Stones’s eyes widened as his body rapidly disintegrated amidst his despair and indignation. He sure hid his strength well. He actually has such a powerful move. Three Stones turned his head and looked in the direction of the Realm Palace.
Meng Chuan’s true body had already left the Realm Palace as he looked at Three Stones.
Both parties exchanged looks.
The outcome of this match was finally decided. Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s owner had also been determined.
Under the rumbling lightning, Three Stones disintegrated completely.
When Meng Chuan saw this scene, he thought to himself, You can die without any regrets since you died under an Eighth Tribulation treasure’s might.

chapters.title: Chapter 619 - Control of the Mystic Realm (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 619 Control of the Mystic Realm (1)
Meng Chuan extended his hand, and the illusory scroll landed in his hand. The scroll was about three feet long, and there was an eye on it.
With Meng Chuan’s current realm, he could sense that the eye was a Dark Chaos Hole. Lightning gathered in the depths of the eye, undergoing a qualitative change
Lightning is the catalyst. The Dark Chaos Hole is only a supplement to gather strength. It can guide the flow of time and space, condensing it into a point... It can send down heavenly punishment. As expected of an Eighth Tribulation treasure. Meng Chuan was shocked as he looked at the Eighth Tribulation treasure
– Heavenly Punishment Chart. The Eighth Tribulation treasures that Ancestral Master Archean Eon had gathered were of different grades. The Heavenly Punishment Chart was one of the best. The Heart of Immeasurable that he had previously sold was ranked at the bottom.
The Heavenly Punishment Chart was of the lightning lineage. It suited Meng Chuan best for studying and fighting. The moment he used it, he killed Grandsire Three Stones.
This trip to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm was smoother than I expected. Meng Chuan was in a good mood. He had made many preparations before entering Earth Cloud Mystic Realm.
As he didn’t know Three Stones’s strength, he didn’t even dare to bring an Eighth Tribulation treasure with him in the beginning! He was afraid that Three Stones was too powerful. For example, he might have grasped an extremely powerful Sixth Tribulation law and had an Eighth Tribulation treasure.
Meng Chuan didn’t dare to bet on the Heavenly Punishment Chart. He could only fight Three Stones head-on and figure out his opponent’s strength. Only then did he teleport an Essence Soul avatar from Archean Eon Realm to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm while bringing the Heavenly Tribulation Chart with him to kill Three Stones’s true body. Heavenly Punishment Chart. Meng Chuan looked at the painting.
As the Physical Body Tribulation realm’s ninth Heavenly Tribulation was Lightning Heavenly Punishment, cultivators in the outer realm acknowledged that the best way to use the lightning lineage was to replicate heavenly punishment. For example, more than half of the lightning lineage Eighth Tribulation treasures replicated the effects of heavenly punishment. Many of the lightning lineage Seventh Tribulation treasures also replicated heavenly punishment.
I’ve expended another Spacetime Teleportation Talisman, but it’s worth it. Meng Chuan waved his hand, and the war spoils left behind by Three Stones were teleported in front of him. Most of the treasures Three Stones collected in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm are probably here.
I lost.
In the outer realm, a towering mountain floated. There were palaces on the mountain peak. Grandsire Three Stones stood in front of a hall and looked into the endless void with a complicated expression.
I lost Earth Cloud Mystic Realm in this battle. All the treasures I’ve collected over the years are gone as well. Three Stones had just become a Sixth Tribulation Eminence, which elevated his status greatly. He had felt confident and smug and was planning to refine Earth Cloud Mystic Realm for himself when he suffered a huge setback.
Forget it. It’s fine if I lose. It’s just a mystic realm. It’s not like I can’t afford to lose. Three Stones calmed his emotions. After all, most Sixth Tribulation Eminences didn’t own a mystic realm. Gaining control of a mystic realm only allowed one to obtain more benefits. It didn’t bring about any qualitative changes.
Three Stones looked in the direction of Goddess River Zone. Eastcalm? I want to see who you are. Despite suffering a huge loss, Three Stones still wanted to figure out the other party’s true origins.
In a grotto-heaven in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s Realm Palace.
“Meng An.” When Long Han and Meng Yu saw the recently-arrived Meng An, they were extremely excited.
When Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar teleported to the Realm Palace with the Eighth Tribulation treasure, he had also brought his son, Meng An. One of Meng An’s true bodies remained in Archean Eon Realm, while the other was in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. After all, his wife and son were here.
Meng An was equally excited. Previously, he could only flee to Archean Eon Realm alone. He was naturally extremely worried about his wife and son. This was because his wife and son were born in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. They couldn’t enter Archean Eon Realm! Therefore, he couldn’t save them, even if he wanted to. Thankfully, his father, Meng Chuan, had taken action.
“It’s good that you are fine. It’s good that you are fine,” said Meng An.
“All’s well that ends well. Dad saved the divine dragons as well,” said Long Han with mixed emotions. “However, my master and many other clansmen died before Dad came. However, the clan leader and Elders are very grateful to Dad...”
Meng An gently hugged Long Han. “It’s all my fault.”
“In the past ten million years, Earth Cloud Mystic Realm has never produced a Sixth Tribulation Eminence. Who would have guessed that a Sixth Tribulation Eminence would appear now? You can’t be blamed for this.” Long Han also understood this point. Earth Cloud Mystic Realm had all sorts of cultivation opportunities. Therefore, many experts were born. However, it was precisely because people were used to obtaining all sorts of opportunities that it became extremely difficult for a Fifth Tribulation Eminence to reach the Sixth Tribulation realm. The ratio of breakthroughs was much lower than in the outer realm.
In Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s history, even if one had comprehended a Sixth Tribulation law, they might not be able to cultivate a physical body cultivation formulation.
Who knew that Meng An would bump into a Sixth Tribulation Realm?
“Dad, can the enemy that Grandpa is currently dealing with be killed?” asked Meng Yu.
Meng An and his wife exchanged looks.
“It’s very difficult,” said Meng An solemnly. “The enemy is very strong. Your mother and I have been very careful all these years.”
“The enemy is very powerful,” said Long Han. “However, your grandfather has reached the Essence Soul Tribulation realm. He has many Essence Soul avatars, so he can still protect himself,” said Meng An to his son. “Your grandfather is willing to accompany you for a month. He will teach you well. You have to seize the opportunity. Remember... don’t expose your relationship with your grandfather. Don’t let the enemy find you.”
“Okay.” Meng Yu nodded. “Dad, Mom, don’t worry. I’ve been roaming the Earth realm alone for more than 400 years. Didn’t I deal with all the problems easily?”
Meng An and Long Han nodded slightly.
“Your grandfather has summoned me. Your mother and I will head out first.” Meng An and Long Han immediately left the grotto-heaven and arrived at the Realm Palace.
In a hall in the Realm Palace, a white-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan stood there.
“Dad.” Meng An and Long Han stepped forward and bowed respectfully.
“This battle is over.” Meng Chuan nodded and looked at his son and daughter-in-law. “I’ve already killed one of Grandsire Three Stones’s true bodies. He won’t be able to return to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm in the future.”
“You’ve won?” Meng An and Long Han were pleasantly surprised.
Three Stones was a Sixth Tribulation Eminence. How could his true body—which was at the Physical Body Sixth Tribulation realm-be destroyed just like that?
Meng An and Long Han also felt the dark clouds weighing down on their hearts completely dissipate. They no longer had any threats in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm.
“I’ll refine and control Earth Cloud Mystic Realm in a few years and become the owner of the mystic realm,” said Meng Chuan. “The Fifth Tribulation Eminences in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm will be obedient and loyal to me. However, I’ll leave the matters of managing Earth Cloud Mystic Realm to you. I still need to focus on preparing for my upcoming Heavenly Tribulation.”
“Okay.” Meng An’s heart trembled. He couldn’t help but say, “Dad, this Heavenly Tribulation...”
“Before transcending the tribulation, I’ll settle everything,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “By the way, continue hiding the truth from that grandson of mine. If he learns that I control Earth Cloud Mystic Realm and you manage it, his mental state will change. This won’t be good for his cultivation.”
Meng An nodded. “I understand.”
If his grandfather was the master of a mystic realm, and his father was in charge of managing it, wouldn’t he be able to do whatever he wanted?
How could such an attitude temper one’s willpower? “Dad,” Long Han couldn’t help but say, “when they interrogated me, Fiend Ancestor Skygrief and Sect Lord Chou Xi killed 100,000 of my clansmen.”
“I’ve destroyed their true bodies,” said Meng Chuan. “They are both at the Fifth Tribulation realm. I can only destroy their true bodies in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. It’s difficult for me to destroy their true bodies in the outside world.”
After all, 100,000 of Long Han’s clansmen had died. Meng Chuan understood how Long Han felt. If he could, he would naturally be willing to annihilate all of Fiend Ancestor Skygrief’s and Sect Master Chou Xi’s avatars completely. However, Fiend Ancestor Skygrief and Sect Master Chou Xi had ultimately reached the Fifth Tribulation realm. They had quickly split into two true bodies, and their second true bodies were rushing to other river zones.
The two true bodies were located in different river zones and had joined various factions. It was very difficult to kill them completely. “Thank you, Dad,” said Long Han.
That day, Meng Chuan summoned seven Fifth Tribulation Eminences in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm.
These seven Fifth Tribulation Eminences were very concerned about the cultivation environment in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. On the other hand, they were born here, so they had many things to worry about. They naturally couldn’t abandon this place. All of them chose to be loyal to Meng Chuan.
Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. Meng Chuan’s true body was in the Realm Palace as his Power of Essence Soul permeated it. This is a world created by an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. If I become the owner of a mystic realm, it will be beneficial to my cultivation.
Meng Chuan began refining the Realm Palace.
Before transcending the tribulation, he had to think of ways to improve himself. The greater his chances of transcending the tribulation, the better.

chapters.title: Chapter 620 - Control of the Mystic Realm (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 620 Control of the Mystic Realm (2)
Earth realm, Thousand Fang Mountain Range.
Meng Yu and his family landed.
“Dad, Mom, don’t worry about me. The enemy doesn’t know of my existence. Furthermore, I will always carry the Undying Talismans that Grandfather gave me,” said Meng Yu to his parents. “Yes, keep them with you at all times,” instructed Long Han.
“In the future, you will have to rely on yourself. Your mother and I can’t help you much,” said Meng An.
“Yes.” Meng Yu was still very satisfied. He had spent a month with his parents, and his grandfather would occasionally give him pointers. This was his happiest month after ascending to the Earth realm.
Soon, Meng An and Long Han left. Dad and Mom have left. Meng Yu stood in a secluded mountain forest with mixed emotions. There were too few blissful days. He could only walk this cultivation path alone.
I’m already much more relaxed. Dad and Mom are in much greater danger. Mom had more than 100,000 clansmen slaughtered. They shielded me from the danger, so I have to make the best use of my time to cultivate so that I can become a Tribulation Eminence. That way, I can help Dad and Grandpa. Meng Yu flew through the vast mountain range and chose an uninhabited valley to live in seclusion temporarily.
He wasn’t in a hurry to return to the sect. Instead, he focused on his cultivation.
Although the Seven Stars Sword Control I created is a perfected Grotto-Heaven realm ultimate technique, it’s enough for me to fight an early-stage Imperial Lord. In this month, I obtained the Immeasurable Sword Heart legacy and had my grandfather’s guidance. I’ve gained a lot. If I’m willing, my Seven Stars Sword Control can be improved to the Heaven Earth realm at any time.
However, that’s not what I want. I want a stronger ultimate technique. Meng Yu was ambitious as well. There were too many cultivators in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. A lot of information was common knowledge. For example, almost everyone knew that Grotto-Heaven realm techniques were divided into different levels. The strongest was a paramount technique! Meng Yu’s original Seven Stars Sword Control was already stronger than an ordinary perfected Grotto-Heaven realm technique. Meng Yu tried to pursue perfection at the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm to build a more robust foundation. Only with a strong foundation would one have a greater chance of reaching the Tribulation realm.
Meng Yu cultivated in the valley and studied the Immeasurable Sword Heart legacy. He carefully recalled every sentence of his grandfather’s advice and often gained insights.
After cultivating here for more than half a year, he returned to the Star Sword Sect.
He was still an ordinary Star Sword Sect disciple. He struggled to survive between the cracks of the Star Sword Sect’s various opposing factions. Even though he was cunning and careful, he was still embroiled in some disputes. He relied on his hidden strength to survive the dangers.
In the fifth year after Meng Chuan came to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, he finally refined the Realm Palace.
This kid’s ability to read people is much better than that of An’er and me. In the Realm Palace, Meng Chuan used his perception to scan Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s three realms. He was rather satisfied with his grandson’s situation.
After refining the Realm Palace, the entire Earth Cloud Mystic Realm was under his control. He could sense many hidden places with a thought. He currently saw his grandson fighting in a dangerous Nine-Ringed Devil Cave in the Earth realm.
This grandson of mine is very diligent with his cultivation. In the future, he might reach the Tribulation realm. Meng Chuan actually didn’t agree with Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s nurturing method.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon had a very clear cultivation plan for Meng An. Every stage had extremely high requirements. At the same time, he gave Meng An extremely good opportunities. As such, Meng An had always been on a tight schedule when it came to his cultivation.
He was constantly whipped in a figurative manner, and he didn’t dare stop. Thankfully, Meng An was talented enough. The Imperial Lord-level techniques he had comprehended in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm were powerful enough, allowing him to reach the Third Tribulation realm in one go. An overly detailed plan has actually weakened An’er’s ability to figure things out. An’er is now at a loss after losing the good cultivation conditions he’s accustomed to. My grandson can’t be like this. I gave him the Immeasurable Sword Heart legacy so that he has a path to follow. I’ll let him struggle and figure out the rest.
One has to rely on themselves when weak. After reaching the Tribulation realm, they can only rely on themselves to go far. Meng Chuan’s cultivation method was completely different from Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s cultivation plan for Meng An.
Meng An and Long Han also agreed with his thoughts. They knew very well that their father had only cultivated for a short period of time, but he had already reached the Sixth Tribulation realm. His cultivation speed was extremely monstrous. It was possible for him to stand at the top of the River of Spacetime when he reached the Seventh Tribulation realm. His ideas were naturally very convincing.
Meng Chuan stood in front of the Realm Palace’s lake. With a stretch of his hand, a vortex appeared in the lake.
From the lake’s depths, a huge crystal that had been nurtured for tens of millions of years flew out. The pale-yellow crystal was about ten feet in size. One could see a pale yellow liquid slowly flowing within it.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon has swept away the treasures in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm once. In the past ten million years, many of the treasures that had been produced have decayed and suffered damage. Meng Chuan looked at the huge crystal floating in front of him. This Yellow Jade Nest has been kept in storage for over ten million years. It’s worth at least 30,000 cubes.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan waved his hand again.
In the gap between Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s Heaven realm and Earth realm, a white beadwhich had been nurtured for more than ten million years—flew towards Meng Chuan.
In the Heaven realm’s Tribulation Wind Fiend Cave-which was suitable for Tribulation Eminences-over 10,000 grains of black sand traveled through the void and flew towards Meng Chuan.
Deep underground in the Man realm, the Nine Leaf Grass-which had grown to its limitstraversed the void and arrived in front of Meng Chuan.
Instantly, more than 100 rare treasures flew from all over Earth Cloud Mystic Realm towards Meng Chuan.
I really made a killing. Meng Chuan was delighted. Sixth Tribulation Eminences wanted to become the master of a mystic realm because, on the one hand, it was beneficial to their cultivation. On the other hand, earning many benefits was key.
Mystic realms were created by Eighth Tribulation Eminences. When they were created, they would nurture rare treasures according to the different regions’ environment.
Over time, some rare treasures would appear in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s three realms. Some would decay and be damaged, while others would become stronger as time passed.
There are so many treasures. They are worth about 390,000 cubes. Meng Chuan was rather satisfied after counting them. I obtained 170,000 cubes from killing Grandsire Three Stones, Fiend Ancestor Skygrief, and Sect Master Chou Xi.
The war spoils mainly came from Three Stones’s true body. Three Stones was invincible in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. Therefore, many of the treasures left behind in its history were in his hands. Some were brought to the outer realm, while others he carried with him.
There’s still the Five-Colored Pillar. Meng Chuan looked in front of him. Five crystal pillars floated in front of him. The Five-Colored Pillars are actually the manifestation of Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s Origins. Comprehending the Five-Colored Pillars’ mysteries will allow me to sense the mystic realm’s operations in greater detail.
Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s operations didn’t follow the River of Spacetime’s laws. Instead, it followed the rules set by the Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
For example, a time flow ten-fold faster than that of the outside world could be maintained. Time and space could be combined, the three realms could be split apart, and various lands of fortuitous encounters could be created... Meng Chuan’s horizons were broadened by the application of various laws.
After refining the Realm Palace, I can use the entire mystic realm’s Origins powers to nourish my body. With my Essence Soul nourished, my cultivation speed will be faster. Meng Chuan was rather satisfied. Although refining a mystic realm didn’t improve his strength qualitatively, it had many long-term benefits.
Fifteen of the treasures this time have life-prolonging effects. Meng Chuan was very happy. The treasures that could extend one’s lifespan in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm weren’t too precious.
There was no way for mystic realms to produce them if they were too precious. Only special environments in the outer realm could give birth to them.
It’s been 90 years since I grasped a Sixth Tribulation law. It’s time for Father, Mother, Father-in-law, and Qiyue to awaken.

chapters.title: Chapter 621 - Longevity Extension Treasure
chapters.content:
Chapter 621 Longevity Extension Treasure
Time to return.
Standing in front of the lake, Meng Chuan split out a stream of light and left Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. He rushed towards Goddess River Zone, leaving only an Essence Soul avatar behind.
This Realm Palace is indeed a cultivation treasure land. Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar stayed behind. Firstly, it was to control Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. Secondly, it had the best cultivation environment.
Be it Archean Eon Realm or Thousand Mountain Star, they were inferior to the Realm Palace.
Apart from controlling Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s core, the Realm Palace was also a cultivation cave abode. Apart from quickly nourishing one’s body and Essence Soul, it could also do other things.
There are two special chambers in the Realm Palace. One has the same cultivation speed as the outside world. The other has a cultivation chamber that has a time flow ten times slower than the outside world. Meng Chuan was astonished. The normal time flow in the entire Earth Cloud Mystic Realm was ten times faster than the outside world. However, the Eighth Tribulation Eminence had built two special chambers, which had time flowing at different speeds.
When cultivating in different chambers, one can comprehend the changes in the time flow.
Meng Chuan placed great importance on these two chambers. The higher one’s cultivation realm was, the more effort one had to put into the time lineage. This was because a pure spatial law was the strongest among Sixth Tribulation laws. To reach the Seventh or Eighth Tribulation realm, one had to have extremely high accomplishments in the time lineage.
Although he felt pressured by the impending Heavenly Tribulation, he had only cultivated for 2,600 years before reaching his current realm. Meng Chuan naturally had great ambitions for his future cultivation. He wanted to reach the Seventh Tribulation realm. He even thought about the possibility of reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm...
He wanted to make his homeworld-Archean Eon Realm-a high-level world that would forever be dazzling and powerful.
If his chances of reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm were relatively low, his chances of reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm were slim. This was because it was very normal for an Eight Tribulation Eminence not to appear in the River of Spacetime in an era.
However, pursuits were something not to be discouraged.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan’s outer realm true body traveled through the River of Spacetime. It took him nearly half a month to return to Archean Eon Realm in Goddess River Zone.
After mastering the lightning law, Meng Chuan traveled several times faster than before. In terms of speed, he was one of the fastest Sixth Tribulation Eminences. Of course, the fastest Sixth Tribulation Eminences had grasped a complete spatial law, far surpassing the current Meng Chuan.
I’m back. Meng Chuan’s outer realm true body passed through Archean Eon Realm’s world membrane as he looked at the beautiful mountains and rivers. He couldn’t help but smile at the familiar scenery of his homeworld.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan took a step and returned to Archean Mountain.
I went to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm and obtained about 560,000 cubes worth of treasures. Meng Chuan was in a good mood. My purse strings no longer need to be tightened anymore. Before transcending the tribulation, he had to make preparations for his family and the entire Archean Eon Realm.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon had left many treasures in the sect for the sect to use. However, over the past million years, the juniors had almost used up all the treasures. As for the more precious treasures, one had to meet many requirements before they could take them out.
As a Sixth Tribulation Eminence who had yet to transcend the tribulation, Meng Chuan had received a lot from the Ancestral Master. He naturally left many things for his homeworld and the sect. However, he had to think about his cultivation and extend his parents and wife’s lifespans. He naturally tightened his purse strings back then, but he could now be much more relaxed.
Many rare herbs can be left in Archean Mountain. Those that suit Tribulation Eminences can be exchanged for 100,000 basic treasures at Eternal Tower. I can leave them for Archean Mountain. Meng Chuan nodded. At the very least, I can let Archean Eon Realm spend lavishly for another million years. If... he failed to transcend the tribulation, he hoped that Archean Eon Realm could produce a Sixth Tribulation Eminence in the next million years and expand Archean Eon Realm. It took a long time for a sapling to grow into a tree. The growth of an inhabited world was even slower.
Heaven and Earth Great Hall, treasure vault.
“Meng Chuan.” The white-robed elder greeted him with a smile. “You brought back the Heavenly Punishment Chart?”
Meng Chuan nodded. “I brought it back.”
To bring the Heavenly Punishment Chart out of the vault and take it into Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, he needed to deposit 650,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals. This was the price Ancestral Master Archean Eon had set for his juniors.
In reality, it cost twice as much.
This was because such treasures were mostly in the hands of Seventh Tribulation Eminences or high-level worlds. Outer Realm Essence Crystals alone couldn’t interest the owners at all, making them impossible to purchase.
“The 650,000-cube deposit can be returned to you,” said the white-robed elder with a smile.
“I want to exchange for a longevity extension treasure,” said Meng Chuan. “You know about the 19 longevity extension treasures that the Master collected.” The white-robed elder nodded. “Which one do you want to choose?”
Meng Chuan became solemn.
The 19 longevity extension treasures had costs ranging from 27,000 cubes to 500,000 cubes. The more expensive they were, the rarer they were.
“I want a drop of Fire Origins Liquid.” Meng Chuan didn’t hesitate.
“You sure are willing to spend,” said the white-robed elder with a smile.
“It’s very worth it.” Meng Chuan nodded.
According to Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s simple records, the Fire Origins Liquid originated from a rare treasure in another universe. One drop costs 200,000 cubes.
The essence of extending one’s lifespan was to perfect one’s life. The more perfect a lifeform was, the longer their lifespan would be. The most perfect lifeforms at the Supremacy realm were pure-blooded dragons and phoenixes, or Supremacies that used paramount techniques as their foundation. They had a 5,000-year lifespan. Meng Chuan was one such example back then.
If one relied on rare treasures to perfect their lifespans to match a young pure-blooded dragon, they would naturally have a 5,000-year lifespan. However, it was almost impossible to reach the limits! This drop of Fire Origins Liquid is most suitable for Qiyue. Meng Chuan knew this very well. Qiyue has a phoenix bloodline. The Fire Origins Liquid is best for her. It can probably extend her lifespan by 3,000 to 4,000 years. Although Liu Qiyue had a phoenix bloodline, there was still a gap between her and a pure-blooded phoenix. However, with the Fire Origins Liquid’s help, she would come close to a pure-blood. She would only be lacking a sliver.
When the time comes, Qiyue’s life will become closer to perfection. Her life level will greatly increase, and she will be close to a pure-blooded phoenix. Her cultivation will also become smoother. Meng Chuan looked forward to it.
Thousand Mountain Star, Eternal Tower’s ninth floor.
I still need to prepare one for Master. Meng Chuan checked the longevity extension items sold by Eternal Tower. His master, Qin Wu, was only an ordinary Supremacy. He didn’t have a special bloodline. It was much easier to extend his lifespan than Liu Qiyue’s.
In fact, since his master had created a Heaven Earth realm ultimate technique, he could directly transform it into an Imperial Lord-level special lifeform with the help of a treasure. The threshold for transforming into an Imperial Lord-level special lifeform was relatively high. One had to comprehend a Heaven Earth realm ultimate technique and have a suitable treasure.
Furthermore, transforming a lifeform into a special lifeform had the possibility of failure and death. Even if it succeeded, one would cap out at the Imperial Lord level and have no hope of reaching the Tribulation realm.
Despite all sorts of reasons, his master, Qin Wu, still felt that it wasn’t a bad idea transforming into an Imperial Lord-level lifeform. He didn’t dare dream of extending his lifespan.
By extending his lifespan, he had a chance of becoming an Imperial Lord as a human. It would be very safe for him to break through. Furthermore, he had a chance of reaching the Tribulation realm. The most suitable thing for Master is this World Tree fruit. Meng Chuan shook his head slightly. Back then, I obtained Senior Fei Yu’s legacy and formed a karmic connection. If I become an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, I need to fulfill my karmic obligation. I need to protect Fei Yu Realm for 100,000 years or give a World Tree to Fei Yu Realm. Only now do I know the value of a World Tree.
A World Tree was a legendary item. Just a single branch or fruit was extremely valuable. The World Tree fruit that Meng Chuan wanted to buy for his master, Qin Wu, cost 80,000 cubes.
A complete World Tree could produce 36 fruits every cycle. The fruits were only a portion of the World Tree’s value. One could imagine how precious a World Tree was.
An Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s 100,000-year-long protection of Fei Yu Realm is equivalent to the cost of a World Tree? Meng Chuan also understood how precious time was for an Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
“I need one World Tree fruit,” said Meng Chuan.
“80,000 cubes.” A mighty voice sounded from above.

chapters.title: Chapter 622 - The Deranged Emperor
chapters.content:
Chapter 622 The Deranged Emperor
Moments later, a black wooden box appeared in a hall on Eternal Tower’s ninth floor. It slowly landed in front of Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan stretched out his hand and grabbed it. Inside the box was a thin-skinned fruit. The flesh inside was crystalline, and it emitted a refreshing fragrance. It made Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul tremble as it gave him the urge to eat it.
A World Tree fruit. Meng Chuan nodded slightly. The fruit had many uses. It could bring a Supremacy-level lifeform closer to perfection. Extending one’s lifespan was just one of its uses. To some Eminences, using a World Tree fruit to extend a Supremacy-level lifeform’s lifespan was too wasteful. However, it was worth it for Meng Chuan.
He had obtained more than 500,000 cubes from his trip to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. What was a little sacrifice when he could increase the Archean Eon Realm’s number of experts in this era? Meng Chuan wanted to nurture those with potential.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan waved his hand. He took out the war spoils he had obtained in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm and began selling them through Eternal Tower. After all, most of these war spoils were useless to Archean Eon Realm. It was better to exchange them for treasures suitable for weak Godfiends, Supremacies, and Imperial Lords.
Soon, a large number of war spoils were exchanged for many treasures that were suitable for Archean Eon Realm’s growth. He even bought ten Void Transference Talismans! This was the maximum amount Meng Chuan could buy as an ordinary member.
Archean Eon Realm, Heaven and Earth Great Hall.
“Meng Chuan.” The white-robed elder appeared and smiled. “Why did you summon me?”
“It won’t be long before I transcend the tribulation,” said Meng Chuan.
The white-robed elder nodded.
“These are treasures I prepared for Archean Eon Realm. They’re worth a total of 350,000 cubes.” Meng Chuan handed a silver bracelet to the white-robed elder. With a flip of his hand, he took out a book. “The book records all the treasures in detail. Furthermore, I’ve decided to exchange for 700,000 cubes worth of items from Ancestral Master’s treasure vault. The detailed requirements for the exchange are listed on it.
“A total of 1.5 million cubes. Everything will be left to Archean Eon Realm.” Meng Chuan looked at the white-robed elder. “I’ll leave the management of everything to you. Split them according to the rules I set.”
The white-robed elder was alarmed. “You have reached the Sixth Tribulation realm and are about to transcend the tribulation. Master gave you a total of 1.3 million cubes... Are you leaving most of it to Archean Eon Realm?”
“I naturally have my own selfish motives. I’ve also made preparations for my tribulation transcendence and family’s cultivation,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “Thankfully, I earned a lot from this trip to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have left so much for Archean Eon Realm.”
The white-robed elder sighed and said, “I’ve seen many cultivators when following Master. When faced with an impending Heavenly Tribulation, those Tribulation Eminences will use every resource they have to increase their chances of transcending the tribulation. At most, they will fail the tribulation and leave their treasures to their race. However, you left over a million cubes. Over a million cubes... that is enough to increase your chances of transcending the tribulation by several-fold.”
Meng Chuan also understood this. There were all sorts of miraculous objects in the vast outer realm. They were even more mysterious than a World Tree fruit. One could buy many objects with a million cubes, increasing one’s chances of transcending the tribulation.
“A World Treasure is the greatest help. The others provide limited help. It’s not worth it,” said Meng Chuan.
The white-robed elder’s gaze landed on the book, and he instantly read it. He then sighed and said, “Archean Eon Grotto-Heaven was almost emptied. It has now been replenished with many opportunities.
