There are too many treasures suitable for ordinary Godfiends.” “Ancestral Master was farsighted. Treasures need to be prepared for the weak and even Tribulation Eminences,” said Meng Chuan. “Therefore, I made preparations mainly for those below the Tribulation realm.”
“Don’t worry. I’ll distribute the treasures according to your rules,” guaranteed the white-robed elder.
Meng Chuan trusted him. The Guardians left behind by the Ancestral Master could live forever, and all of them were absolutely loyal. Nobody in Archean Eon Realm was suited to control such a huge amount of wealth besides them. The Guardians were the most trustworthy.
Thousand Mountain Star.
Emperor Roc’s outer realm true body was imprisoned inside Fiend Prison. He suffered torment every day.
Oh? Emperor Roc sensed something and looked up.
A white-robed, white-haired man appeared.
“Meng Chuan.” Emperor Roc stared at Meng Chuan and sneered. “As a Fifth Tribulation Eminence, your time is precious. Why do you have the time to meet me? Are you planning on killing me?”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Yes.”
Emperor Roc was taken aback. He looked at Meng Chuan and smiled. “You want to kill a Third Tribulation Eminence with an inhabited world in the way? Aren’t you reaching beyond your means?”
Indeed, it was a fool’s dream for a Fifth Tribulation Eminence to kill a Third Tribulation Eminence with an inhabited world in the way.
Even a Sixth Tribulation Eminence only had a low chance of killing a Third Tribulation Eminence hiding in an inhabited world through the karmic connection between avatars.
An inhabited world’s obstruction was just too strong.
This was even when one had an avatar as a medium. If Meng Chuan didn’t have any blood or hair as a medium, he wouldn’t even be capable of killing Imperial Lords across worlds! For example, when he swept through Three Bay River System’s plundering factions, Meng Chuan was unable to kill the Imperial Lords, who had returned to their inhabited worlds to hide, with just their names.
“I advise you to hire a Sixth Tribulation Eminence,” said Emperor Roc with a smile. “Perhaps only by hiring a Seventh Tribulation Eminence will you have complete confidence.”
Meng Chuan walked forward and stretched out his hand.
A wound appeared on Emperor Roc’s arm, and blood flew out.
“Are you really going to attack?” Emperor Roc’s heart tightened as he looked at Meng Chuan solemnly. He naturally had intelligence on Meng Chuan. He knew that Meng Chuan wasn’t a foolhardy person. He only took action when he was prepared.
I’m currently at the Sixth Tribulation realm. I only have a sliver of hope of killing it. Meng Chuan understood this point. Therefore, he didn’t directly kill Emperor Roc’s outer realm true body. Instead, he used his blood as a medium.
With a true body’s blood as a medium, the effects were already excellent. It was just slightly inferior compared to using a true body as a medium. With blood, he could make multiple attempts without much of a problem. Meng Chuan left with Emperor Roc’s blood.
He wants to bring my blood to a Sixth Tribulation Eminence? He wants to kill me through karma? Emperor Roc was somewhat flustered.
Demon Realm, Demon Ancestral Cave.
Emperor Roc’s true body had been hiding in the Demon Ancestral Cave all these years.
The Demon Realm was a middle-level world with an extremely rich heritage. It had historically produced many Fifth Tribulation Eminences and Sixth Tribulation Eminences. They raised the Demon Realm to the limits of a middle-level world. Their cultivation system was also very perfected. The Demon Ancestral Cave was also the most important treasure land in the Demon Realm. It also had the ability to weaken karmic attacks, but it was far inferior to the Heaven and Earth Great Hall.
He’s going to attack? Emperor Roc sat cross-legged in one of the caves in Demon Ancestral Cave. He was extremely anxious. A Sixth Tribulation Eminence can’t be bothered with a Fifth Tribulation Eminence. A huge price has to be paid before a Sixth Tribulation Eminence is willing to take action. Meng Chuan is so anxious that he has finally hired a Sixth Tribulation Eminence?
Damn it. I’ve been risking my life with the Fiendish Demon Cultivation all these years. I’ve already comprehended a Fourth Tribulation law, but I haven’t perfected my Fourth Tribulation physical body formulation. When it comes to resisting karma, I’m still only at the Third Tribulation realm.
Emperor Roc panicked. One relied on their bodies and Essence Souls to resist karma. He was still at the Third Tribulation realm.
After Meng Chuan captured his outer realm true body, Meng Chuan first killed Starquix and Blackmoon, causing Emperor Roc to panic. He was worried that Meng Chuan would immediately seek the help of a Sixth Tribulation Eminence and kill him through karma. Therefore, Emperor Roc chose the craziest path-the path of a Fiendish Demon.
The path of a Fiendish Demon was the most deranged path for demons at the Tribulation realm. Furthermore, it wasn’t perfected. When cultivating, one would enter a deranged state, greatly increasing their cultivation efficiency. However, it was possible for one to go completely insane in such a state.
Emperor Roc stayed in this deranged state for more than 80 years before actually comprehending a Fourth Tribulation law. He then realized that Meng Chuan had never attempted to kill him through karma. Therefore, he temporarily stopped treading this deranged path and slowly pondered over the Fourth Tribulation physical body formulation.
Even if I were to embark on the path of derangement now, I won’t be able to perfect my physical body cultivation technique that quickly. Furthermore, if I continue cultivating the path of a Fiendish Demon, I might really go crazy. No matter how much Emperor Roc wanted to live, he didn’t want to go completely crazy. Therefore, he limited his cultivation of the Fiendish Demon path to 100 years.
Who knew that Meng Chuan would finally attack him?
It’s too late. It’s too late to cultivate. I can only rely on fate. Emperor Roc gritted his teeth and waited. Meng Chuan, as long as I survive, I definitely won’t give up.
Archean Eon Realm, inside a Seventh Tribulation World Treasure.
Rumble...
There was a huge eye in the sky. It was formed by the Eighth Tribulation treasure, Heavenly Punishment Chart. Meng Chuan looked at Emperor Roc’s blood that floated in front of him.
Annihilate.
Meng Chuan immediately controlled the Heavenly Punishment Chart’s power. A condensed golden bolt of lightning—as thick as a finger-instantly struck down. Its speed made it difficult to see with the naked eye. The golden bolt of lightning struck Emperor Roc’s blood. As it destroyed the blob of blood, it immediately reached inside an inhabited world through the karmic connection, reaching Emperor Roc, who was hiding in the Demon Realm’s Demon Ancestral Cave.
Amidst Emperor Roc’s horror, his body instantly split into numerous particles. Lightning zapped through the remaining particles, but the remaining particles condensed and materialized into Emperor Roc.
I survived! I survived! Emperor Roc was delighted and surprised.

chapters.title: Chapter 623 - Liu Qiyue Awakens
chapters.content:
Chapter 623 Liu Qiyue Awakens
Emperor Roc felt lingering fear and relief, having toed the precipice of death.
This Meng Chuan hired a Sixth Tribulation Eminence to kill me, but he still failed to kill me. Emperor Roc looked around. “Thank you, demon ancestors. You spared no expense to build the Demon Ancestral Cave, and it has allowed me to survive this calamity.”
Demon Ancestral Cave had the ability to weaken karma. If it weren’t for the Demon Ancestral Cave, Emperor Roc would have died if he simply relied on the obstruction of an inhabited world.
Meng Chuan, the price for hiring a Sixth Tribulation Eminence can’t be low, right? Emperor Roc sneered. Are you willing to hire a second or even third Sixth Tribulation Eminence after failing once?
From Emperor Roc’s point of view, Meng Chuan was only a Fifth Tribulation Eminence. He could dominate a river system, but his status was far inferior to that of a Sixth Tribulation Eminence, who reigned supreme across the River of Spacetime.
If you can hire a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, you will have full confidence in killing me. Unfortunately, you don’t even have the right to meet a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Emperor Roc was very confident.
A Sixth Tribulation Eminence only had a sliver of hope of killing a Third Tribulation Eminence through an inhabited world.
In contrast, Seventh Tribulation Eminences had full confidence in killing Fourth Tribulation Eminences across worlds. This was because a Tribulation Eminence’s strength increased as they advanced through the Tribulation realms.
This Meng Chuan has a strong desire to kill me. I should think of a way to perfect my body formulation and improve my body as soon as possible, thought Emperor Roc.
Thousand Mountain Star.
I failed? Meng Chuan stood on the mountain peak and looked down at the vast land. His karmic connection with Emperor Roc was strong enough to begin with. Despite this, Meng Chuan had failed to kill him using Emperor Roc’s blood as a medium. The strength he could unleash with the Eighth Tribulation treasure, Heavenly Punishment Chart, was considered top-notch among Sixth Tribulation Eminences. Even if he hired other Sixth Tribulation Eminences, he didn’t have confidence in succeeding.
However, failure was within expectations.
If I succeed in transcending the tribulation, I can befriend a Seventh Tribulation Eminence and seek their help.
He was absolutely confident of a Seventh Tribulation Eminence succeeding if they did the job.
Meng Chuan didn’t know Emperor Roc’s true strength, but he was very certain that Emperor Roc had only reached the Third Tribulation realm after cultivating for more than 7,000 years. Unless he had a huge opportunity, it was impossible for Emperor Roc to reach the Fifth Tribulation realm in his entire life with such talent and perception.
Emperor Roc was also forced to stay in the Demon Realm, unable to enter the outer realm. It was impossible for him to obtain any huge opportunities. Without any huge opportunities, Emperor Roc was destined to have zero hope of reaching the Fifth Tribulation realm by living a peaceful life in the Demon Realm.
With Emperor Roc’s potential, it wouldn’t be easy for him to reach the Fourth Tribulation realm, even if he took some unorthodox path and ignored all future repercussions. In the future, Meng Chuan would definitely successfully kill him by hiring a Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
What if I were to fail at transcending the tribulation? Meng Chuan frowned slightly. Archean Eon Realm will have to endure for tens of thousands of years.
Swoosh.
From afar, a figure—which looked like it was forged from black metal—flew over. It landed on the mountain peak very gently, but it still felt like a world was pressing down on it. It was the Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake
— Cave Lord Scenic Cloud-who had grasped three Fifth Tribulation laws.
“City Lord, you were looking for me?” asked Cave Lord Scenic Cloud.
“Scenic Cloud.” Meng Chuan nodded. “I’m about to transcend the tribulation.”
“Tribulation Transcendence?” Cave Lord Scenic Cloud was taken aback. “Sixth Heavenly Tribulation?”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Yes.”
Cave Lord Scenic Cloud stared at Meng Chuan dazedly. He had grasped three Fifth Tribulation laws for so many years, but he had failed to merge them into a Sixth Tribulation law. Even if he managed to comprehend a Sixth Tribulation law in the future, he still needed to create a physical body formulation and raise his body to the Sixth Tribulation realm before he could trigger the sixth Heavenly Tribulation. Back then, he had been forced to bow his head because Meng Chuan had set up an array formation to suppress him.
He had only bowed his head because of the treasures he had amassed for years and his species.
“It’s been less than 200 years since I came to Thousand Mountain Star, yet you are already about to transcend your sixth Heavenly Tribulation,” muttered Cave Lord Scenic Cloud. “None of us Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes can reach the Sixth Tribulation realm in the entire River of Spacetime.”
“It’s hard to predict success or failure when it comes to Tribulation Transcendence.” Meng Chuan looked at him. “If I succeed in transcending the tribulation, everything will be as it was in the past. If I fail to transcend the tribulation... I’ll leave Thousand Mountain Star to you. You can do whatever you want with it. However, I hope that you can protect the cultivators in Archean Eon Realm and treat them as your fellow clansmen.
“Also, kill any cultivator that dares to come out of Three Bay River System’s Demon Realm. These are the two requirements I have for you. As for the restrictions I placed on you in the past, they can be abolished.”
“Alright, I agree.” Cave Lord Scenic Cloud agreed decisively. Meng Chuan’s requirements weren’t high. He only treated the two inhabited worlds differently. Furthermore, Cave Lord Scenic Cloud didn’t dare refuse Meng Chuan, who had the strength of a Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
“Good.” Meng Chuan looked at Cave Lord Scenic Cloud and nodded slightly.
If he transcended the tribulation successfully, Archean Eon Realm would naturally obtain all sorts of benefits. If he failed to transcend the tribulation, Archean Eon Realm would continue to develop silently. Only when the next powerful Tribulation Eminence rose would it become prosperous again.
Archean Eon Realm, in Archean Mountain’s grotto-heaven.
Boom!
Millennium Hall’s door opened.
Meng Chuan looked at the figures lying in the hall. All of them were frozen in dark-blue ice. Those that could lie here were at least Regis Godfiends. They made up the entirety of Archean Mountain’s hidden combat force. They either woke up naturally after sleeping for 1,000 years or were awakened under special circumstances. With Meng Chuan’s current status, he could personally make the decisions for Archean Mountain. “Qiyue.” Meng Chuan stood beside his wife and looked at her sleeping figure. He couldn’t help but smile.
He was 99 years old when his wife entered her slumber.
Today, he was 2,605 years old. He may have spent a long time cultivating alone in the Chaos Hole’s depths, but it had been too long... “Qiyue, wake up.” Meng Chuan looked at his wife. The dark-blue layer of ice gradually melted.
The white-haired woman’s eyelids trembled slightly as she gradually opened her eyes. When she saw the white-haired man beside her, Meng Chuan, she couldn’t help but smile. “Ah Chuan, I said that I wanted to see you the moment I woke up.” Liu Qiyue looked at her husband and smiled. “You really didn’t break your promise.”
“I’ll definitely do what I promised you.” Meng Chuan looked at his wife.
Liu Qiyue stood up and carefully looked at her husband. His hair was still white, and the tiny amount of wrinkles on his face were the same as before.
“Let’s go out.” Meng Chuan held his wife’s hand as the couple walked out of the hall.
“How long did I sleep this time?” asked Liu Qiyue.
“264 years,” said Meng Chuan.
“It’s been more than 200 years?” Liu Qiyue was somewhat surprised. “Has the war ended? Did we win?”
“About 50 years after you entered your slumber, a demon sage passageway appeared,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “However, with me around, I naturally killed the invading demons easily. The demon sage passageway has long collapsed. The other World Entrances are also shrinking. Even the World Gap—which has a short lifespan-is gradually collapsing. “Of the three demon Imperial Lords from back then, I have killed Imperial Lord Starquix and Imperial Lord Blackmoon across an inhabited world. However, Emperor Roc has already reached the Third Tribulation realm. He can’t be killed across worlds for the time being.”
Liu Qiyue was dazed when she heard that. She asked in surprise, “You killed them across worlds? Ah Chuan, what realm have you reached?”
“I can barely be considered to be at the Sixth Tribulation realm,” said Meng Chuan. “Isn’t that only one step away from Ancestral Master Archean Eon?” Liu Qiyue found it unbelievable. “And I’ve only been asleep for over 200 years?”.
Meng Chuan said, “However, I’ve already cultivated for more than 2,000 years. Furthermore, I haven’t transcended the tribulation. Only after I transcend the tribulation can I be considered a Sixth Tribulation Eminence.”
“You’ve cultivated for more than 2,000 years?” Liu Qiyue stared at her husband dazedly.
The couple grew up together as childhood sweethearts. They fought alongside each other until they were almost 100 years old. When she woke up from her slumber, she realized that her husband had been cultivating alone for more than 2,000 years.
“Was it very lonely?” Liu Qiyue looked at her husband.
“It was.” Meng Chuan smiled. “Even in my dreams, I dreamed of the days we spent together.”
Although the world was vast, his days of cultivation were indeed lonely. Only when his wife woke up and stood beside him again did Meng Chuan feel that he wasn’t lonely anymore. His life was complete again. Liu Qiyue smiled at her husband and immediately asked, “By the way, you said that you would only be at the Sixth Tribulation realm if you successfully transcended the tribulation. When will you transcend the tribulation? Are you confident about it?”
Back when she entered her slumber, although she had obtained some information about the Tribulation realm, she didn’t know much about it. She didn’t know much about the status of a Sixth Tribulation Eminence in the outer realm. She also didn’t know how difficult it was to reach the Sixth Tribulation realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 624 - Perfection (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 624 Perfection (1)
“The sixth Heavenly Tribulation will descend on me from as short as several years to past a century,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “As for the certainty of transcending the tribulation, haha. Don’t you understand me? I’m naturally confident in my abilities.”
Liu Qiyue looked at her husband and said solemnly, “Be careful.” Meng Chuan nodded. “Let’s go home. It’s also time to wake Dad, Mom, and Father-in-law up.”
The sun shone brightly in the idyllic Jiang State Capital
Meng Manor.
Meng An and Meng You had long been waiting. Finally, they saw a white-haired couple flying over from afar.
“Mom.” The siblings were extremely excited.
“An’er, You’er.” Liu Qiyue and Meng Chuan landed together. Liu Qiyue was filled with joy as she looked at her children. “After so many years, you have improved greatly.”
Meng An and Meng You were much more mature. Meng An had reached the Third Tribulation realm. Although Meng You’s cultivation was weaker, the cultivation conditions in Archean Eon Realm were much better than before. Meng You had also reached the Regis Godfiend realm.
The number of ordinary Godfiends in Archean Eon Realm had greatly increased. It was ten times more than when Meng Chuan was young.
Due to Meng Chuan’s guidance, the number of Supremacies in Archean Eon had risen to 35. There were 282 Regis Godfiends. Most of them had broken through in the past century or two, so most of them were very young.
Creak.
Liu Qiyue chatted with her children to learn about what had happened over the years.
Not far away, a door creaked open, and Meng Chuan came out with the three elders.
“Grandfather, Grandmother. Grandfather.” Meng You stood up in surprise. Meng An and Liu Qiyue also stood up to welcome them.
“To think I can still see my son, daughter-in-law, and grandchildren after waking up. Hahaha... I, Meng Dajiang, am very lucky.” Meng Dajiang chuckled.
Liu Yebai grinned and said, “They are also my grandchildren.”
Meng Dajiang shot him a glance.”No one is going to snatch the title from you.”
“The moment you wake up, you quarrel.” Bai Nianyun couldn’t help but shake her head.
“When I closed my eyes, this old fellow was beside me. When I woke up, it’s him again,” said Meng Dajiang. “Dear, you might have waited for quite some time. It was only a nap for us.”
“Dad, Mom, Father-in-law.” Meng Chuan smiled when he saw the three elders bickering. “Let’s get down to business as soon as possible.” His father and father-in-law were already very old. It was best for them to consume the longevity extension treasures as soon as possible.
“Longevity extension?” Meng Dajiang stared at his son with widened eyes.
Meng Chuan nodded. “Yes.”
“We really are having our lifespans extended. How long will our lifespans be after extension?” asked Meng Dajiang.
“It will be the same for everyone, 2,000 years,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“Our lifespans will be extended to 2,000 years? We can live until we’re 2,000 years old?” Liu Yebai muttered.
Meng Dajiang and Bai Nianyun looked at each other in shock. Although they had received their son, Meng Chuan’s promise before they entered the slumber, Meng Chuan had been vague about it back then. Now that they were about to extend their lifespans, the three of them still found it unbelievable. Such a thing was rare in human history. “Won’t the price be too great?” Meng Dajiang looked at his son. “If it’s too great, there’s no need to use it on us old fellows. Cultivation of the younger ones like you is more important.”
“It’s not great.” Meng Chuan shook his head.
The elders were weak. To Meng Chuan, extending their lifespans to 2,000 years was nothing
The treasures he randomly picked up inside Fiend Mountain were enough.
“Dad, Mom, Father-in-law, have a seat first.” Meng Chuan arranged for the three elders to sit down. Following that, he flipped his hand and took out a small jade bottle. He said, “Inside this jade bottle is a liquid that will taste like honey. It’s sweet and has a fragrance. Just drink it all. Dad, you can go first.” “Alright, I’ll go first.” Meng Dajiang reached out to receive it, but he looked at the jade bottle nervously. He looked up at his son, and the wrinkles on his face became more obvious. “Like honey?”
“Dad, hurry up and drink it,” said Meng Chuan with a helpless smile.
The others watched carefully. Apart from Meng Chuan, only Meng An knew how precious longevity extension treasures were. In the outer realm, only Fifth Tribulation Eminences had the ability to obtain longevity extension treasures.
Meng Dajiang removed the bottle stopper and sniffed it. Following that, he raised his head slightly and drank the liquid in the jade bottle.
“Oh, it does taste a little like honey.” Just as Meng Dajiang finished speaking, his body trembled slightly. He felt his entire body itch. It was an itch that came from the deepest and tiniest parts of his body.
It wasn’t too intense, but a very slight itch. It even felt very comfortable.
The change was very gentle, but it was a qualitative change to his life essence. Meng Dajiang’s eyes became more limpid and were no longer turbid. Instead, the contrast between the blacks and whites became clearer. His skin no longer had wrinkles, making him look much younger. A powerful aura even spread out naturally, causing Meng You to feel pressure.
After five minutes, the transformation ended.
“I-I... feel?” Meng Dajiang looked at his young hands. With the immense strength he had now, he could probably shatter a mountain easily.
“Dad, you have already become a Supremacy-level lifeform,” explained Meng Chuan with a smile. “Many special lifeforms are Supremacies when they are born. Dad, it’s the same for you. Your level in life has increased.” “I reached the Supremacy realm without cultivating?” Meng Dajiang found it unbelievable.
“There are many instances of creatures in the outer realm reaching the Creation realm at birth,” said Meng Chuan. “To become an Imperial Lord, one has to rely on themselves and cultivate.”
No matter how powerful a longevity extension treasure was, mortals could only extend their lifespans to the limits of the Supremacy realm –5,000 years. This was the limit for pure-blooded dragons when they were young. It was also Meng Chuan’s lifespan when he was at the Supremacy realm.
The dragons, phoenixes, and so on also needed to grasp Heaven Earth laws before they could transform from youths to adults.
“He became a Supremacy?” Bai Nianyun and Liu Yebai were shocked as well. To them, Supremacies were already extremely powerful. However, in reality, Supremacies were the weakest in the outer realm.
By relying on external items, even a Sixth Tribulation Eminence or a Seventh Tribulation Eminence could make a person reach the Supremacy realm at best.
A longevity extension treasure was worth more than 10,000 cubes! It was enough to make a Fifth Tribulation Eminence’s heart ache.
“Mom.” Meng Chuan took out a jade bottle and placed it beside his mother. He then took out a bottle and gave it to his father-in-law, Liu Yebai. Finally, he took out a third bottle and handed it to his daughter, Meng You.
“Me?” Meng You was taken aback.
“Why? Do you think you can cultivate to the Supremacy realm?” Meng Chuan looked at his daughter.
His daughter had cultivated for more than 300 years, and her body was gradually aging. She had no hope of becoming a Supremacy.
Meng You looked at her father. She had many thoughts in her mind, but in the end, she nodded. “Thank you, Dad.”
Soon, Meng You, Bai Nianyun, and Liu Yebai’s level in life was elevated.
“Qiyue, it’s your turn.” Meng Chuan waved his hand, and a drop of flames appeared.
The flames appeared in the form of a water droplet. It had ten colors because it contained different flames.
“This is—”
Everyone present felt as though they were mortals looking up at the sun. Although it didn’t bring too much pressure, they felt like they were looking up an unreachable height.
Meng Chuan knew very well that this was Fire Origins Liquid. It was a rare treasure from another universe. It was present in Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s collection and required 200,000 cubes to exchange for a drop from Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s vault. Strictly speaking, it was slightly more valuable than the Eighth Tribulation treasure—Heart of Immeasurable.
When Liu Qiyue saw the flame, she felt her blood boil. She yearned for the drop of Fire Origins Liquid.
Whoosh.
Under Meng Chuan’s control, the Fire Origins Liquid slowly flew towards Liu Qiyue. It passed through Liu Qiyue’s robe and naturally seeped into her body.
Boom!
Liu Qiyue’s bloodline erupted after obtaining the Fire Origins Liquid. Terrifying flames erupted.
Meng Chuan stood calmly by the side. He naturally had a lightning domain around him. With a thought, he placed his wife in another space.
Flames erupted from his wife’s body, spreading across Meng Manor and even the entire Jiang State Capital. However, no one could see the flames. The flames couldn’t harm a single blade of grass in the normal space.
“Where’s Mom?” Meng You was puzzled. Meng Dajiang and his wife, as well as Liu Yebai were equally puzzled.
“Mom’s elevation in life’s natural order is rather special. She’s in another space.” As a Third Tribulation Eminence, Meng An could sense her despite not being able to see her.
Meng Chuan watched his wife transform. Her phoenix bloodline—which was originally very thin-was rapidly transforming after obtaining the Fire Origins Liquid. It became purer...

chapters.title: Chapter 625 - Perfection (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 625 Perfection (2)
Flames erupted wantonly as Liu Qiyue’s life transformed. First, she reached the level of an ordinary Supremacy. Following that, she continued evolving. She was comparable to some of the descendants from the phoenix lineage’s branches...
The Fire Origins Liquid lives up to its reputation. It’s better than I expected. Meng Chuan’s current realm was extremely high. He could determine his wife’s evolution at a glance.
An hour passed.
Liu Qiyue—who was bathed in flames-was like a fire deity. The flames she emitted were enough to injure an Imperial Lord severely.
She opened her eyes and retracted her flames with a thought. Her wrinkles had reduced greatly, but she still had long, snow-white hair.
With a thought, Meng Chuan teleported his wife back to the normal void.
“Qiyue, why are you still white-haired?” Liu Yebai, who now had long, black hair, looked at his daughter in surprise.
Liu Qiyue smiled at Meng Chuan and didn’t say anything else.
“Mom.” Meng An and Meng You looked at their mother in delight. They could sense the changes in their mother’s aura.
“Ah Chuan, what did you feed me?” Liu Qiyue asked softly.
“It’s a special longevity extension treasure. Its effects are better than I expected.” Meng Chuan nodded. “How do you feel?”
“My phoenix bloodline has improved greatly. It’s much purer now. Even the flames I naturally emit are much stronger than before,” said Liu Qiyue.
Meng Chuan could tell at a glance that his wife had a 4,300-year lifespan.
For special lifeforms with powerful bloodlines, they typically only had a 3,000-year lifespan at the Supremacy realm. In contrast, Meng Chuan only had a 5,000-year lifespan back then. Generally speaking, living beings whose bloodlines passed down from generation to generation had a round number for their lifespans. Those with non-round number lifespans, like having a 2,800-year lifespan or a 3,200-year lifespan, mostly relied on longevity extension treasures.
Liu Qiyue had a 4,300-year lifespan now. This meant that her life essence was only slightly inferior to a pure-blooded phoenix or dragon. However, this was a huge difference! Even the Fire Origins Liquid—which was comparable to an Eighth Tribulation treasure-couldn’t elevate Liu Qiyue’s bloodline to that of a pure-blooded phoenix. In fact, it was very difficult for phoenixes and dragons to produce pureblood offspring across the entire River of Spacetime. Meng Chuan had roamed the outer realm for so many years, but he had never encountered a pure-blooded dragon or phoenix.
That night, at Lake Heart Pavilion in Jiang State Capital’s Meng Manor.
Meng Dajiang, Bai Nianyun, Liu Yebai, Meng Chuan, Liu Qiyue, Meng An, and Meng You ate and chatted in the garden in front of Lake Heart Pavilion. The elders were asking questions, while the juniors answered.
“Meng An, you have a son too?” Meng Dajiang held his cup, pleasantly surprised by the news. “I have a great-grandson? Where is he?”
PWS.
“You will have to leave Archean Eon Realm first and travel a great distance in the outer realm to reach his location. That place is called Earth Cloud Mystic Realm,” explained Meng An. “My wife and son are both in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm.”
“What? Outside Archean Eon Realm?” Meng Dajiang, Bai Nianyun, and Liu Yebai were shocked.
“Why did you go all the way outside the human world to get married and have a child?” Bai Nianyun was somewhat shocked.
“This is fate.” Meng An smiled and didn’t explain further.
“Earth Cloud Mystic Realm is very suitable for cultivation,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “That mystic realm has countless cultivators. It has over 10,000 Imperial Lords and nearly 1,000 Tribulation Eminences.”
“What?” Everyone was stunned.
“In terms of how many cultivators there are, Earth Cloud Mystic Realm is comparable to ten river systems,” said Meng Chuan. “I’ve already gained control of that mystic realm. If there’s a chance, I’ll send many cultivators from Archean Eon Realm to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm to cultivate. Dad, all of you can go there together in the future.”
Archean Eon Realm ultimately couldn’t compare to a mystic realm. Therefore, arranging for Archean Eon Realm cultivators to train there was also part of the plan. The prerequisite was that he transcended the tribulation successfully.
“You control that mystic realm?” Meng Dajiang was somewhat dazed. “Chuan’er, you now control a mystic realm that has over 10,000 Imperial Lords and nearly 1,000 Tribulation Eminences?”
“I was lucky,” said Meng Chuan. The family chatted about everything under the sky.
They chatted about Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, the war with the Demon Realm, the three Demon Realm’s Imperial Lords, Three Bay River System’s Palace Lord Snowjade, and Eastcalm City...
The peach blossom tree beside them had bloomed beautifully. The fragrance of the blossoms wafted amongst them as Meng Chuan took in the fragrance and looked up. The stars in the night sky were bright. Although this scenery was beautiful, he had experienced it many times over the years. However, he was especially happy today. This was because his family was beside him.
“Dad, drink slowly with Father-in-law.” Meng Chuan stood up alone and came to a nearby library. He looked at his family outside through the window. With a wave of his hand, a painting unfolded on the table. He had already prepared a brush and ink.
It had been a long time since Meng Chuan had the urge to paint.
The last time he painted with passion was when he won the war. He painted ‘Backbone.’
Meng Chuan similarly wanted to record this scene.
It’s been more than 2,000 years, Meng Chuan thought to himself. Meng Chuan looked up and smiled before lowering his head to paint. The stars in the night sky were resplendent with the vast galaxy streaking across it.
Under the night sky, a family had a reunion meal.
A hundred-year-old peach blossom tree bloomed just in time, scattering its petals on the ground as a family surrounded a table by the side.
His mother, Bai Nianyun, Liu Qiyue, and Meng You chatted in low voices. All three of them had smiles on their faces.
His father, Meng Dajiang, and his father-in-law, Liu Yebai, raised their cups and also chatted. Meng Chuan sat by the side and smiled without saying a word. As for Meng An, he was busy pouring wine.
Meng Chuan painted very seriously.
He finished painting in an hour.
“Cultivation focuses on one’s heart. It slices through the obstacles in an unstoppable manner,” muttered Meng Chuan softly. “However, one’s heart needs a place to return to. Only when one has a place to return to can it be perfected.”
Meng Chuan looked up at his family outside the window. These family members were his heart’s home. No matter how lonely he was, he was truly ever-triumphant with them around.
Without them, no matter how strong I am, I will be lonely and incomplete. Only with them am I perfected. Meng Chuan knew what he valued the most. Even if he could become invincible and live forever, what was the point if he did it alone-having no family or fellow men?
What he wanted was for his species to thrive and prosper. He wanted everything in front of him to exist for a long time. Perhaps there was life and death, but what was an Eminence? An Eminence could do things that mortals couldn’t! They could protect what they cared about for a long time.
Meng Chuan looked at his family and thought to himself, In order to enjoy more of these days, I will definitely transcend the tribulation successfully.
He could sense it.
After his wife woke up, his mind and will slowly changed as he painted. With his family by his side, his mind became stronger. Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul-which had transformed into an Essence Soul Star-slowly revolved in his sea of consciousness. It also became closer to perfection and more powerful. Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul path wasn’t completely the same as Senior Fei Yu’s, but it was at least 80% similar. Similarly, he cared the most about a perfected mind. Although his Essence Soul was lacking when it came to the offensive, he had great defense and stability.
Two days later, Meng You temporarily left Meng Manor and returned to meet her husband, Yang Cheng.
“Dear.” Yang Cheng looked at his wife, who had landed outside the study. He couldn’t help but be shocked. He put down the scroll and immediately walked out. He stared at his wife with widened eyes. “Dear, you... you have become a Supremacy?”
His wife had cultivated for over 300 years. Logically speaking, it was impossible for her to become a Supremacy.
“Dad made me consume a longevity extension treasure, raising my lifespan to that of a Creation realm expert.” Meng You looked somewhat distracted.
“Father-in-law did it?” Yang Cheng felt pleasantly surprised. “That’s great. Absolutely
great.”
Yang Cheng was a genius of Archean Mountain.
After Meng Chuan, Xue Feng, Yan Chitong, and the others, he was the most dazzling genius in the subsequent generations. Back then, he had become a Marquis Godfiend long ago. He had also married Meng You and become a Regis Godfiend. As Archean Mountain’s cultivation resources increased greatly, Meng Chuan personally guided Yang Cheng. When Yang Cheng was 153 years old, he also reached the Supremacy realm. However, Meng You was slower. “Why are you so troubled over such a joyous occasion?” Yang Cheng was puzzled.
“Yuan’er has always been on my mind,” said Meng You softly. “Although Yuan’er has been nurtured by the two of us and is considered diligent in his cultivation, he has not progressed past the Marquis Godfiend realm. He has been cultivating for more than 280 years, and he’s not far from the end of his life. I’m wondering if I should make a request and beg Dad to...”
When she saw her father, Meng Chuan, take out longevity extension treasures, Meng You thought of her son.
Yang Yuan was her child. As a mother, she naturally cared about him.
“No,” said Yang Cheng solemnly. “How precious are longevity extension treasures? In human history, lifespan extension only happened during Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s era. Now that Father-in-law is willing to extend your lifespan for you, it’s a huge favor. You can’t force a request.” “I know. I didn’t say anything. I just feel terrible,” said Meng You.
“Longevity extension treasures are extremely precious. Even Tribulation Eminences have to go through great pains to obtain them,” said Yang Cheng solemnly. “A longevity extension treasure is enough to nurture many Godfiends. Our son has led a carefree life and hasn’t contributed much to Archean Eon Realm. What right does he have to obtain a longevity extension treasure? If we really want to help our son, we will have to rely on ourselves.
“If Yuan’er reaches the end of his life, I can also set up the Millennium Instant for him since I’ve already figured it out. Yuan’er can enter a slumber before his death. In the future, if the two of us become Imperial Lords through cultivation, according to the sect’s rules, we can receive some of Ancestral Master’s treasures. We can then extend our son’s lifespan. That will be the correct path.”
Meng You nodded slightly. “Yes.”
“Father-in-law saved our Archean Eon Realm when it was on the brink of destruction. He sacrificed a lot for our race, and he is trying his best to nurture the young now.” Yang Cheng looked at his wife. “As his daughter, you must not make things difficult for him.”
“I understand. I’ll listen to you,” replied Meng You.

chapters.title: Chapter 626 - Entering Fiend Mountain Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 626 Entering Fiend Mountain Again
In a study in Jiang State Capital’s Meng Manor.
The spring sunlight shone through the window, causing the paper on the table to become a little blinding from the reflection. Meng Chuan was smiling as he painted. He had a hobby of painting. Back when he hunted down demon monarchs underground, he insisted on painting every day. However, ever since his wife entered a slumber, Meng Chuan very rarely painted.
1on
O
Today, Liu Qiyue was writing while Meng Chuan leisurely painted. He felt especially relaxed.
“Ah Chuan.” Liu Qiyue suddenly stopped writing and turned to look at her husband. “You can tell what’s on You’er’s mind, right?”
“You’er?” Meng Chuan paused and nodded. “I can guess. That kid, Yang Yuan, has only reached the Marquis Godfiend realm. He’s already close to the end of his 300-year lifespan. As a mother, she naturally can’t bear to watch her son die, especially when she knows that I have longevity extension treasures.”
“What are your plans?” asked Liu Qiyue.
“Plans?” Meng Chuan looked out the window. His gaze crossed the void, and he looked down at Archean Eon Realm’s people. “For this peaceful day, over 2,300,000 Godfiends died in the war that lasted over 900 years. Billions of mortal soldiers died in battle, and even more innocent commoners were slaughtered. Countless heroes died in battle. For example, Senior Brother King True Martial, Senior Brother Xue, and the others were all talented, but they died in battle for their fellow men.”
“That little fellow, Yang Yuan, was born in the lap of luxury. He lived carefreely for nearly 300 years. What else does he want?” said Meng Chuan indifferently. “I, Meng Chuan, am also human. I also have selfish thoughts, but everything has its limits.”
“Father, mother, son, and daughter. With my cultivation to date, it’s fine if I help my family extend their lifespans. As for the third generation? If they have the talent, they can be given a small number of cultivation resources. They can just be nurtured as the sect’s core. If they don’t have the ability, there’s no need to waste resources. If You’er and her husband, Yang Cheng, want to save him, they will have to rely on their own abilities.”
Meng Chuan looked at his wife. “Qiyue, although most of the treasures I’ve accumulated since I started cultivating have been left to the race, I’ve also left behind a treasure for you. If I fail to transcend the tribulation and die, you will be in charge of this resource. I hope you won’t pamper our descendants.”
“Don’t even mention dying from the tribulation,” said Liu Qiyue immediately. “We’ve seen so many life-and-death situations. There’s nothing taboo that can’t be talked about.” Meng Chuan glanced at his wife. “You said you were confident.” Liu Qiyue stared at her husband.
Meng Chuan nodded and smiled. “Of course, I’m confident! I’ve already cultivated an Essence Soul World Treasure. I woke you up two days ago to extend your lifespan. My painting of Perfection has improved my insights into the Essence Soul Star formulation. My mind has also improved. I’m very confident that I can transcend the tribulation successfully. However, I don’t know what I’ll encounter before actually transcending the tribulation.”
“You don’t have to accompany me every day. It’s more important to prepare for the tribulation.” Liu Qiyue stared at her husband solemnly.
“Don’t worry. My other true body left Archean Eon Realm yesterday and headed for the Fiend Mountain ruin,” said Meng Chuan. “In the days before the tribulation, my other true body will stay on Fiend Mountain to temper my Essence Soul.”
Fiend Mountain ruin.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan flew across the vast land and headed toward the black Fiend Mountain. This was his second time coming to the Fiend Mountain ruin.
Fu Sui brought the three of us in last time. At the very least, it was useful to me, Meng Chuan thought. This was also the reason why he still tolerated Fu Sui despite his drastic change in personality. He had to admit that it was all thanks to Fu Sui that he obtained this opportunity. With this opportunity, his willpower had indeed become much stronger.
The four people who entered that time had different fates.
Meng Chuan had a strong foundation to begin with. He was only one step away from the true Sixth Tribulation realm. All he needed was to transcend the tribulation. He was the strongest one.
Fu Sui had grasped the method to enter. He had taken the path of epiphany and instantly comprehended a Sixth Tribulation law. However, it resulted in endless trouble.
Meng Hu, who came from a high-level world, had gained some benefits. He was plagued by calamities and now relied on his homeworld, Heavenly Dream Realm, to save him.
Old Fiend Black Wind was originally the weakest of the four. He had only grasped one Fifth Tribulation law, but he relied on the Fiend Mountain ruin to approach the Sixth Tribulation realm. He didn’t bring much trouble to himself.
Meng Chuan’s willpower was strong enough, so he had traveled far on the third path and became an ordinary Fiend Mountain member. His gains were greater than that of Old Fiend Black Wind.
For example, Fu Sui had later sent quite a number of Fifth Tribulation Eminences in. Some had taken the third path, but they failed to go far. They were still far from reaching 5,000 kilometers.
Clearly, the threshold for becoming an ordinary member of Fiend Mountain was extremely high! The ancient existence that created Fiend Mountain had set this threshold because one could only be of value by reaching this threshold.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan flew to Fiend Mountain and circled the mountain range for half a day. He found two spots to harvest-each was worth more than 10,000 cubes-before stepping onto the third path while in a good mood.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
Although a voice sounded in his mind, and every word in the voice seemed to strike his Essence Soul, giving him immense pressure, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul and willpower was strong enough. He naturally forcefully resisted the voice and advanced rapidly. He walked 5,000 kilometers until he reached the spot where he had previously given up.
Last time, I gave up here because I couldn’t advance any further. However, it’s much easier this time. Meng Chuan could sense that his willpower had become stronger. His insights into the Essence Soul Star formulation had also deepened. His Essence Soul had become even more stable, allowing him to withstand the brunt of the impact easily.
Let’s begin. Meng Chuan followed his original routine. With every step he took, he stopped and carefully sensed the voice that seemed to come from the peak of Fiend Mountain. After comprehending it, he took another step. He advanced at an extremely slow speed.
In Fiend Mountain ruin’s first path.
A shrunken stone giant-Starlord Ancient Desert-was walking. At the same time, he was immersed in his epiphany. Although everyone knew that the path of epiphany required one to pay a huge price due to the endless calamities, that didn’t stop Fifth Tribulation Eminences from taking this path. These Fifth Tribulation Eminences had their own thoughts. Some were putting up a final struggle before the end of their lifespans. Some felt that they could curb their greed and be satisfied after two to three years. Some urgently needed to become stronger and were willing to pay the price... As expected of the path of epiphany. I’ve already comprehended a second Fifth Tribulation law. The stone giant, Starlord Ancient Desert, stopped and grinned. His heart surged when he comprehended a complete Fifth Tribulation technique. He temporarily escaped from his epiphany state.
I’ll give up after another two years, thought the stone giant to himself. In reality, when cultivators embarked on the path of epiphany, they would think it wouldn’t matter even if they continued for an additional year and that it wouldn’t be a huge problem for them to continue for two more years.
The more arduous their cultivation previously was, the more unwilling they were to give up when they were in a state of epiphany. After all, a year here might be much better than a lifetime in the outside world. It was too difficult to give up. The stone giant stopped and looked up. His gaze naturally swept across Fiend Mountain. Suddenly, his eyes widened. What? There’s a cultivator at the 5,000-kilometer mark on the third path? The stone giant stared at the tiny figure in shock.
According to his current experience, the third path placed immense pressure on the Essence Soul. Most people would stop before reaching 500 kilometers.
Over 5,000 kilometers?
Eh? That’s... The stone giant looked at the tiny figure from afar. After all, they were all members of the Cang Alliance. They had met in the Cang Alliance Space before. Therefore, he immediately recognized the figure. It’s Eastcalm? Why is he here again?
Meng Chuan couldn’t help turning his head when he sensed another living being watching him.
Hundreds of kilometers away, a Fifth Tribulation Eminence’s and a Sixth Tribulation Eminence’s gazes met. Due to him constantly resisting Fiend Mountain’s voice, Meng Chuan’s mind and willpower were extremely focused. He resisted with all his might. At that moment, he instinctively turned his head to take a glance. The powerful willpower contained in his gaze made the stone giant’s mind rumble before it instantly went blank.
The stone giant stood there in a daze. Only when Meng Chuan stopped looking at him and continued advancing slowly did the stone giant wake up.
The Essence Soul pressure is so strong? He has reached the Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation realm? The stone giant was somewhat shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 627 - News
chapters.content:
Chapter 627 News
The Cang Alliance Space’s periphery was covered in mist.
In a corner, Snowjade sat alone. He was still dressed in a light-blue robe. He no longer had the cold arrogance he had in the past. All he had was loneliness.
Having gotten myself into this situation, the other Tribulation Eminences can’t even be bothered with me. Palace Lord Snowjade’s gaze swept across, and he saw Tribulation Eminences chatting in small groups. None of the Tribulation Eminences chose to cozy up with him in their gatherings.
Everyone knew that Snowjade had gone mad. Furthermore, his madness was worsening.
The longer one stayed crazy, the shorter their period of lucidity would be. Everyone naturally drew a clear line with Snowjade. Otherwise, it would be troublesome if they were entangled with a crazy Fifth Tribulation Eminence. My Essence Soul calamity is worsening. The time I remain lucid is getting shorter and shorter. Perhaps, I will go crazy forever one day. Snowjade cherished his periods of lucidity. He was willing to come to the Cang Alliance Space and see the other Fifth Tribulation Eminences.
At the very least, everyone here was only an embodiment. The Fifth Tribulation Eminences weren’t too afraid of him.
In the outside world? Tribulation Eminences had long distanced themselves from him.
I clearly knew that my willpower is relatively weak. I knew that the third path in the Black Mountain ruin has the effect of tempering the mind. Why didn’t I choose the third path? Just because I saw Old Fiend Black Wind—who was weaker than me-improve greatly and grasp three Fifth Tribulation laws, I became envious and jealous. I couldn’t help but take the second path. I felt that the danger would be lesser... Snowjade was very regretful.
However, no amount of regret mattered. If one took the wrong path, they had to bear the consequences.
“What? City Lord Eastcalm appeared in the black mountain ruin again?”
“Impossible. Fu Sui is currently on the ship. The next batch will only be sent when the time is up. Only Fu Sui knows the method to enter the black mountain ruin. It’s impossible for City Lord Eastcalm to enter.”
“I saw it with my own eyes. Furthermore, I feel that City Lord Eastcalm has already reached the Sixth Tribulation realm.”
In a corner of the Cang Alliance Space, five Tribulation Eminences discussed something. The person who spoke was the stone giant, Starlord Ancient Desert. He was extremely confident. “If you don’t believe me, you can ask Brother Qushui. He is also in the black mountain ruin. He can see City Lord Eastcalm from his location.”
Huh? While sitting alone in a corner, the spurned Palace Lord Snowjade was slightly taken aback after hearing a familiar name. Meng Chuan has appeared in the black mountain ruin again? He seems to have reached the Sixth Tribulation realm?
How is it possible for him to be at the Sixth Tribulation realm? Palace Lord Snowjade wasn’t sure what he was feeling. He instinctively denied it. How can it be so easy for him to reach the Sixth Tribulation realm? There are so many Tribulation Eminences in the black mountain ruin world, but none of them have truly reached the Sixth Tribulation realm.
“Ah, no wonder! In the past, I could barely sense Brother Eastcalm’s general direction through karma. Just a few years ago, his karma became much blurrier. I couldn’t determine his location at all. I thought he had cultivated a karmic lineage Dharmic formulation and deliberately obscured his karma or that perhaps he had obtained a treasure that could blur karma... From the looks of it, he has reached the Sixth Tribulation realm?”
“That’s right. City Lord Eastcalm’s karma is much more blurry. From this point, it’s really possible that he has reached the Sixth Tribulation realm.”
The people discussing in the distance became more and more certain of the conclusion.
Every Tribulation Eminence knew many other cultivators. If a cultivator’s karma suddenly became blurry, they wouldn’t care too much about it.
This was because breaking through to the Sixth Tribulation realm couldn’t be hidden! As long as one interacted with the outside world, they would eventually be exposed.
Meng Chuan’s karma has become even more blurry. Snowjade sat there silently. I didn’t even notice his changes.
We are both from Three Bay River System, and we were in the same batch that came to the Cang Alliance Space. We later went to the black mountain ruin one after another, but the result is me being crazy most of the time. I might even go crazy forever in the future. However, Meng Chuan has reached the Sixth Tribulation realm. Snowjade sighed gently as his figure dissipated and disappeared from the Cang Alliance Space.
His arrival and departure didn’t attract much attention in the Cang Alliance Space.
A group of Fifth Tribulation Eminences was in Fiend Mountain. They had their own means. As long as they deliberately observed, they could see Meng Chuan.
The news constantly spread in the Cang Alliance Space and was confirmed by various parties.
“Ahhh!” Fu Sui was in his chamber on the massive ship, holding his head in pain. He endured the excruciating pain in his Essence Soul as the pain slowly intensified. However, he couldn’t help but let out a painful cry as his body curled up and twitched. It’s too painful. I’m dying! Fu Sui finally flipped his hand and took out a Heart Intoxicating Pill. He immediately swallowed it. After consuming the Heart Intoxicating Pill, his Essence Soul felt comfortable and intoxicated. This intoxication greatly relieved the pain. Fu Sui could sit up again, and his expression returned to normal.
I have to consume Heart Intoxicating Pills. The Outer Realm Essence Crystals I earn will eventually be used up, Fu Sui thought to himself. Furthermore, I can sense that the Heart Intoxicating Pill’s effects are worsening at an extremely slow speed. Compared to the first time I consumed it, it only has 80-90% effectiveness now.
As long as I’m alive, I might be able to find a treasure more useful than the Heart Intoxicating Pill. I’ll have a chance if I’m alive. Fu Sui’s eyes were determined as he pondered over how to treat his Essence Soul injuries.
Suddenly
Fu Sui realized that a Fifth Tribulation Eminence had left him a message through the Cang Alliance Space.
“Brother Fu Sui, we discovered City Lord Eastcalm in the black mountain ruin again. How did he enter? Did you send him in?”
“You discovered Eastcalm?” Fu Sui was very surprised. Through the Cang Alliance’s space connection, he asked, “Where did you hear that? Eastcalm had already left the black mountain ruin previously. It’s impossible for him to appear inside again.” “Several Fifth Tribulation Eminences have discovered City Lord Eastcalm in the black mountain ruin. Furthermore, they believe that City Lord Eastcalm has already broken through to the Sixth Tribulation realm.”
“Broken through to the Sixth Tribulation realm?” Fu Sui found it unbelievable. How could the Sixth Tribulation realm be reached that easily?
Fu Sui even condensed an embodiment in the Cang Alliance Space to investigate the matter carefully. The more he investigated, the more he realized how true it was. After some hesitation, Fu Sui personally contacted Meng Chuan. As a Cang Alliance member, he could instantly contact Meng Chuan even if they were separated across the River of Spacetime.
“Eastcalm, are you in the black mountain ruin?” asked Fu Sui.
“Yes,” replied Meng Chuan quickly.
Fu Sui was somewhat shocked by Meng Chuan’s reply because he knew very well that he hadn’t sent Meng Chuan in a second time.
“How did you enter? You also obtained a mystic technique to enter? Can you bring other cultivators in?” Fu Sui asked. This was very important. If Meng Chuan could bring other cultivators in, this business couldn’t be monopolized by Fu Sui.
Sending cultivators into the black mountain ruin was Fu Sui’s best method of earning Outer Realm Essence Crystals. This business had earned him a lot. As the news spread, he could continue to earn more.
“Fu Sui, don’t worry. I can only enter alone. I can’t bring anyone else with me,” replied Meng Chuan. After becoming an ordinary member of Fiend Mountain, he could freely enter and exit Fiend Mountain, but it was limited to himself.
Fu Sui heaved a sigh of relief when he received Meng Chuan’s answer. “You’ve reached the Sixth Tribulation realm?” Fu Sui asked curiously. He didn’t believe the rumors.
“Before entering the ruin, I was close to breaking through. After coming out of the ruin, I had some free time. After cultivating for a few days, I broke through,” replied Meng Chuan. He still owed the other party a favor. If it were other Cang Alliance members, he wouldn’t have said so much. Of course, he wouldn’t tell others when he would transcend the tribulation.
Fu Sui was stunned. He really has broken through to the Sixth Tribulation realm!
Fu Sui had paid such a huge price, but he was forever stuck at the half-step Sixth Tribulation realm. The injuries to his Essence Soul also constantly tormented him. Meng Chuan has completely reached the Sixth Tribulation realm. However, when Fu Sui thought of how Meng Chuan was close to breaking through before entering the ruin, he felt slightly comforted.
Fu Sui finally said, “Congratulations, Brother Eastcalm.”
The news constantly spread, and it also reached the ears of the Cang Alliance’s Sixth and Seventh Tribulation Eminences. It also attracted the attention of some folks.

chapters.title: Chapter 628 - Fishing
chapters.content:
Chapter 628 Fishing
A figure appeared in the dark outer realm. He was dressed in a dark purple robe as he looked coldly at Thousand Mountain Star.
“Thousand Mountain Star,” muttered Lord Ghostink.
He yearned to enter the legendary Fiend Mountain even in his dreams. Therefore, he immediately rushed to Thousand Mountain Star when he heard the news.
Is it really as the rumors say? Eastcalm entered the Fiend Mountain despite being a Sixth Tribulation Eminence? Lord Ghostink couldn’t help but feel tempted. If he can enter, I should be able to enter as well!
After cultivating to his current realm, he felt like the gap between the Sixth and Seventh Tribulation realm was like a chasm! The further he cultivated, the greater the difference in strength. However, the difficulty of breaking through also increased.
There were only a few Sixth Tribulation Eminences in a vast river zone. However, Seventh Tribulation Eminences were legends!
Lord Ghostink had his own goals. He also wanted to reach the Seventh Tribulation realm.
Whoosh.
Lord Ghostink flew towards Thousand Mountain Star but suddenly stopped.
Lightning gathered in the surrounding void and condensed into a white-haired, white-robed man. He smiled at Lord Ghostink and said, “Ah, Lord Ghostink. My Three Bay River System is a remote river system. Why are you here, Lord Ghostink?”
Meng Chuan’s lightning law domain was sufficiently vast. He could sense any other living beings that invaded his range of influence.
It was fine if it were ordinary cultivators in the past, but Lord Ghostink was a Sixth Tribulation Eminence. Meng Chuan was naturally alarmed by his visit. He immediately sent an Essence Soul embodiment.
“City Lord Eastcalm.” Lord Ghostink looked at Meng Chuan. His cold eyes lit up as he revealed a look of delight. “You really have reached the Sixth Tribulation realm.”
Meng Chuan looked at him.
Lord Ghostink didn’t have a good reputation. He was ruthless and unscrupulous. He had the worst reputation among the Sixth Tribulation Eminences in the Cang Alliance. Meng Chuan naturally had his guard up.
“City Lord Eastcalm, you have reached the Sixth Tribulation realm. How did you enter the black mountain ruin again?” asked Lord Ghostink.
Meng Chuan nodded. “Yes.”
He really is here because of Fiend Mountain.
“How did you enter? I asked Fu Sui, but he said it had nothing to do with him. He said that you entered the black mountain ruin through your own means.” Lord Ghostink’s voice had a hint of anxiousness.
“I can enter, but I can’t help others,” said Meng Chuan directly, having guessed the other party’s intentions.
Lord Ghostink frowned and asked, “City Lord Eastcalm, I just want to ask you. How did you enter? Do you have a mystic technique, a token, or something else?”
“Why should I tell you such a secret?” Meng Chuan looked at him.
Information was valuable. Meng Chuan hadn’t even discovered the existence of Fiend Mountain from Eternal Tower’s intelligence.
The intelligence of how to become an ordinary member of Fiend Mountain was even more precious. How could he easily leak it? Lord Ghostink persuaded, “Tell me, and I will owe you a favor. We are both members of the Cang Alliance. Can’t you help me on this?” “I can’t,” said Meng Chuan indifferently.
Lord Ghostink looked at Meng Chuan and nodded. “It wasn’t right of me. Let’s negotiate like it’s a transaction. How about 30,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals if you tell me how you entered the black mountain ruin?”
“No deal,” rejected Meng Chuan. Meng Chuan had yet to figure out Fiend Mountain’s origins.
The crazy forbidden creatures, the various aftereffects of stepping onto Fiend Mountain, and the mysterious voice that came from the mountaintop... Even the name of the placeFiend Mountain-made Meng Chuan very cautious. Logically speaking, such a place shouldn’t be unknown! However, even if he couldn’t find any information on it, Meng Chuan naturally didn’t want to spread further information about it.
“Even a transaction won’t do?” Lord Ghostink’s eyes were cold.
Meng Chuan looked at him and said, “If you really want to buy the information, I’ll naturally be the one offering a price. 200,000 cubes, and I’ll tell you the details.”
“Hmph! Hmph! Hmph!” Lord Ghostink laughed angrily.
200,000 cubes?
After cultivating for so many years, he had only accumulated over 500,000 cubes. Many of them were treasures that were useful to him. Was he crazy to exchange nearly half of that for a piece of information?
“You should have just reached the Sixth Tribulation realm, so you aren’t aware.” Lord Ghostink looked at him. “I’m currently following a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, Qilin Ancestor. I’ll give you another chance. Thirty thousand cubes to purchase your information.”
“Lord Ghostink, forgive me for not entertaining you. Also, I do not allow any Sixth Tribulation Eminences to come within 15 million kilometers of my Thousand Mountain Star array formation without my permission.” With that said, Meng Chuan’s figure dissipated. He couldn’t be bothered with him.
Lord Ghostink had even threatened him.
Meng Chuan came from Archean Eon Realm. Ancestral Master Archean Eon had recorded some of the unspoken rules regarding the top factions in the River of Spacetime. Meng Chuan knew them pretty well.
It was true that many Sixth Tribulation Eminences had Seventh Tribulation backing them. Although there were relatively more Sixth Tribulation Eminences than Seventh Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime, there were very few of the latter. There were only 20 to 30 of them! Therefore, every Seventh Tribulation Eminence was considered a faction.
Most Sixth Tribulation Eminences relied on a faction. With a Seventh Tribulation Eminence backing them, it was as though an entire faction was taking care of them. Thus, they could do things in a much smoother way. They could also obtain various benefits for their cultivation.
To a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, a Sixth Tribulation Eminence subordinate was a very important helper.
From Lord Ghostink’s point of view, City Lord Eastcalm-a newly-advanced Sixth Tribulation Eminence—shouldn’t have fully followed a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Without a powerful backer, he shouldn’t be confident enough, so it was easy to scare him into submission.
According to Ancestral Master Archean Eon, although Eternal Tower is a loose and free organization, there are still very few Sixth Tribulation Eminences. Eternal Tower still cares about the safety of every Sixth Tribulation Eminence. Meng Chuan understood this point.
Once he transcended the tribulation, he would naturally report it to Eternal Tower. His status in Eternal Tower would rise, and he would become part of Eternal Tower’s backbone. Eternal Tower had to confirm that he had successfully transcended the tribulation before promoting him.
He’s gone? Lord Ghostink was alarmed. City Lord Eastcalm has just vanished and left me here? He was a Sixth Tribulation Eminence. Good, very good. Lord Ghostink stared at Thousand Mountain Star in the distance.
No matter how rash he was, he wouldn’t charge into the enemy’s lair to attack him. The enemy’s lair had an array formation augmenting him. He would be sending himself to his death if he acted rashly.
I’ll remember you for this. Lord Ghostink was furious, but there was nothing he could do. With a wave of his sleeve, he immediately stepped into the River of Spacetime and left Three Bay River System.
Knowing Lord Ghostink’s style, one had to fall out with him immediately. If one spoke nicely to him, only more trouble would ensue.
In front of a lake in a bamboo forest.
A white-haired elder sat there fishing.
The lake beneath the hook vaguely revealed different spacetime. Images of cultivators appeared in the lake, but none of them were worth fishing
Whoosh.
A cyan-clothed woman flew over from afar. After landing, she walked over and stopped dozens of feet away. She greeted respectfully, “Realm Ancestor.”
Realm Ancestors were terrifying existences that were famous across the River of Spacetime.
“Ah, Yu Xi.” The white-haired elder smiled at the cyan-clothed woman.
The cyan-clothed woman sighed.
Realm Ancestor treated her like a father and master. In her eyes, he was the greatest existence. However, he was close to the end of his lifespan.
There were only three Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime. Realm Ancestor was one of them, but even he couldn’t withstand the ravages of time. He could only accept the fact that his lifespan was coming to an end.
“Realm Ancestor, everything you instructed me to do has been done,” said the cyan-clothed woman respectfully. “However, Third Young Master still refuses to listen to advice. Therefore, I can only forcefully capture him back.”
“I’ve protected him for tens of thousands of years, but I can’t protect him forever.” The white-haired elder nodded. “Once I die, all sorts of backlashes will happen.”
“Realm Ancestor, you will definitely break through to the Eighth Tribulation realm,” said the cyan-clothed woman immediately.
“Eighth Tribulation realm?” The white-haired elder smiled as he looked at the cyan-clothed woman. The masses had rumors that Realm Ancestor was close to the Eighth Tribulation realm, but he knew that he was still far from it! He casually waved his hand. “Alright, you may take your leave.”
“Yes.” The cyan-clothed woman obediently retreated.
The white-haired elder sat there, still leisurely fishing. Countless spacetime figures were in the lake.
“According to the latest intelligence from the Cang Alliance, a Sixth Tribulation Eminence has entered Fiend Mountain?” The white-haired elder was somewhat surprised. He had entered the Cang Alliance when he was young and was the only Seventh Tribulation Eminence in the Cang Alliance now.
The Cang Alliance was an extremely loose organization. However, it had a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Therefore, it was rather famous in the River of Spacetime.
Realm Ancestor was very powerful. He had control over a portion of the Cang Alliance Space. The Cang Alliance Space would take the initiative to record everything that happened in the Cang Alliance Space and pass it on to Realm Ancestor.
City Lord Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, has become a member of Fiend Mountain? The white-haired elder guessed. The fishing rod in his hand connected to an area of spacetime.
In the lake, Thousand Mountain Star’s Meng Chuan, Archean Eon Realm’s Meng Chuan, and Fiend Mountain’s Meng Chuan appeared.
He’s also a member of the Cang Alliance like me. The white-haired elder gently lifted the fishing pole.
Whoosh.
A white-haired, white-robed man flew out of the lake and landed on the ground.
Meng Chuan looked around in a daze and saw a white-haired elder holding a fishing pole. The white-haired elder looked ordinary, like a mortal elder, as he smiled at him.

chapters.title: Chapter 629 - Realm Ancestor Explains Fiend Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 629 Realm Ancestor Explains Fiend Mountain
Meng Chuan was somewhat dazed.
His Essence Soul avatar had just coldly rejected Lord Ghostink and returned to Thousand Mountain Star’s chamber to meditate when it was teleported to a distant spacetime.
That’s Thousand Mountain Star. Despite the protection of my array formations, my Sixth Tribulation Essence Soul avatar was captured? Through his perception of Archean Eon Realm, Meng Chuan understood how infinitely far he was. It was the furthest he had ever been. The other party’s strength far exceeds mine. Although Meng Chuan was shocked, he instantly determined the situation. He knew that he had encountered an unstoppable existence. He looked around and saw the white-haired elder.
The white-haired elder was very amiable as he wore a smile.
It’s him? Meng Chuan’s heart jolted.
A Seventh Tribulation Eminence held a reverent status in the River of Spacetime. There was only one criteria to be a top faction in the River of Spacetime-possess a Seventh Tribulation Eminence in that era!
A faction would be considered a top one when they had a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Otherwise, they wouldn’t be considered a top faction in the River of Spacetime.
Every Seventh Tribulation Eminence was a legend! According to Meng Chuan’s understanding, Realm Ancestor should be the oldest Seventh Tribulation Eminence presently alive. Furthermore, he was an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence! In terms of strength and status, Realm Ancestor was definitely not inferior to Ancestral Master Archean Eon.
“Greetings, Realm Ancestor. I’m Eastcalm.” Meng Chuan bowed respectfully. In the outer realm, he only addressed himself as Eastcalm.
“The longer I live, the more I feel like there are geniuses in every generation.” Realm Ancestor smiled at Meng Chuan. “On a whim, I discovered an Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence who has only cultivated for about 2,000 years. In terms of talent, you are even superior to Saber Swordsman.”
“How can I compare to Senior Saber Swordsman?” said Meng Chuan immediately.
Saber Swordsman was the most special Sixth Tribulation Eminence in the Cang Alliance Space. This was because he had grasped a Seventh Tribulation law and had the partial strength of a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Ordinary Sixth Tribulation Eminences couldn’t withstand a single strike from Saber Swordsman. They were completely steamrolled.
“Saber Swordsman comprehended a paramount technique and directly reached the Fifth Tribulation realm. However, he only reached the Sixth Tribulation realm after cultivating for 3,600 years.” Realm Ancestor looked at Meng Chuan. “You are much faster than him. Furthermore, you are at the Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation realm.”
“I haven’t transcended the tribulation yet, so I can’t be considered a true Sixth Tribulation Eminence,” said Meng Chuan. “As a Sixth Tribulation Eminence, your reentry into Fiend Mountain implies that you are at least an ordinary member of Fiend Mountain.” Realm Ancestor looked at Meng Chuan. “Just this alone gives you a 90% chance of transcending the tribulation.” Meng Chuan was shocked. Ordinary member of Fiend Mountain?
“Fiend Mountain isn’t a secret to Seventh Tribulation Eminences,” said Realm Ancestor with a smile. “Putting it in another way, it should be said that all Seventh Tribulation Eminences know about Fiend Mountain.”
“All of them know about it?” Meng Chuan was secretly alarmed. Despite it being a place that every Seventh Tribulation Eminence knew about, he couldn’t find any information on it. Clearly, they had deliberately kept it a secret. Ancestral Master Archean Eon didn’t make any records of it, so he clearly didn’t want his descendants to know.
“I never expected that you juniors would find it again after we hid the news about it,” said Realm Ancestor with a smile.
“Are we not supposed to enter?” asked Meng Chuan.
“It’s fine if you enter. We won’t stop the members of Fiend Mountain either. However, we will strictly forbid Fu Sui from continuing to bring cultivators in,” said Realm Ancestor. “Senior, is Fiend Mountain very dangerous?” asked Meng Chuan.
Realm Ancestor smiled. “The first of Fiend Mountain’s three cultivation paths is the path of epiphany. According to my understanding, there are countless Fifth Tribulation Eminences that have stepped onto the path. Over 10,000 have reached the Sixth Tribulation realm thanks to it, but without any exception, these Sixth Tribulation Eminences have either gone crazy or become spellbound. None of them had a good ending.”
Meng Chuan was shocked.
Up to now, nobody had reached the Sixth Tribulation realm after embarking on the path of epiphany. Typically, only those who had accumulated enough insights would have a chance of reaching the Sixth Tribulation realm after a year or two.
Over 10,000 people have reached the Sixth Tribulation realm thanks to it? How many Fifth Tribulation Eminences have traversed the first path? Also, none of them ended up well? They either went crazy or became spellbound? Meng Chuan shuddered.
“The second path is the path of possession. One can possess different Sixth Tribulation Eminences and experience Sixth Tribulation Eminences’ cultivation,” said Realm Ancestor. “However, in fact, the many Sixth Tribulation Eminences that can be possessed all became Sixth Tribulation Eminences by taking the path of epiphany. The path of possession... may appear to be brilliant in every way, but in fact, it’s not orthodox.”
Meng Chuan was astonished. He knew that one could possess different eminences, but he didn’t know that the ones being possessed eventually ended up going crazy or becoming spellbound.
Se
“On the path of possession, even if one can maintain their original intent, they will be drawing upon thousands of erroneous paths. In the end, most of them will still take a wrong step, thus going crazy or becoming spellbound,” said Realm Ancestor. “Of course, there are also those who have experienced thousands of paths, comprehended their essence, and attained great accomplishments. There are three people in history who have attained greatness through the path of possession. They have all comprehended a Seventh Tribulation law.”
Meng Chuan was shocked.
The path of possession was also very bizarre. Either one didn’t have a good ending, or one comprehended the essence after studying thousands of paths to grasp a Seventh Tribulation law.
“Countless Fifth Tribulation Eminences have taken that path, but only three have comprehended a Seventh Tribulation law,” said Realm Ancestor. “This kind of screening method is too cruel. Among Fifth Tribulation Eminences and Sixth Tribulation Eminences, some have lived. Countless Fifth Tribulation Eminences have died, gone crazy, or become bespelled. Only three grasped a Seventh Tribulation law.”
“The third path is the path of the mind. It doesn’t have any aftereffects, but it’s the most difficult path. After traversing 5,000 kilometers and becoming an ordinary member, one’s willpower reaches the threshold needed for the Physical Body Seventh Tribulation realm,” said Realm Ancestor. “Most cultivators will be wasting their efforts on the path of the mind.”
“Reaching 5,000 kilometers on the path of the mind means one’s willpower has reached the requirement of the Physical Body Seventh Tribulation realm?” Meng Chuan was shocked.
“In terms of willpower, the requirements for the Physical Body Tribulation realm and Essence Soul Tribulation realm are different,” said Realm Ancestor. “The Physical Body Tribulation realm uses the body as the foundation. The requirements for one’s willpower are much lower than those of the Essence Soul Tribulation realm.” Meng Chuan cultivated both his body and Essence Soul, so he knew this very well.
Physical Body Tribulation Eminences controlled their bodies. An Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence needed to control an Essence Soul World.
“At 5,000 kilometers on the path of the mind, one’s willpower needs to be at the normal level of the Physical Body Seventh Tribulation realm, which is the peak of the Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation realm.” Realm Ancestor continued to reveal secrets without holding back. “At 25,000 kilometers on the path of the mind, one’s willpower would have reached the peak of the Physical Body Seventh Tribulation realm and the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm’s threshold.”
“When one reaches the peak of the mountain on the path of the mind, one’s willpower has reached the Physical Body Eighth Tribulation realm’s threshold. Therefore, Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminences often go to Fiend Mountain to take a stroll. They walk the path of the mind and see if they can reach the peak. This is the easiest way to verify if one’s willpower has reached the Physical Body Eighth Tribulation realm.
“However, to an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence, the willpower they need to reach the peak is still fundamentally different from the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm.” Realm Ancestor shook his head. “Physical Body Tribulation Eminences only need to cultivate their bodies. It’s something tangible. As for us Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences... We need to improve our willpower constantly. The willpower needed to reach the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm is just too difficult to attain, way too difficult.”
Realm Ancestor looked at Meng Chuan. “You are now young. You had one epiphany in the early stages of cultivation. Once your mind is stirred, your Essence Soul might improve greatly. However, by the time you reach my level, you will no longer be puzzled. Even the mechanics of the River of Spacetime and the Universe is something you can understand at its essence. If you want to trigger another epiphany and cause a sublimation of the mind? It’s even harder than comprehending another Origins ultimate technique.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. Thankfully, he still had a long way to go before reaching Realm Ancestor’s realm.
Two of the three paths on Fiend Mountain led to endless disasters. The last path was extremely difficult.
“Senior Realm Ancestor, who’s the original owner of Fiend Mountain?” asked Meng Chuan. He was very curious about the creator’s identity.
“Fiend Mountain’s owner?” Realm Ancestor’s eyes were filled with amazement. “It belongs to an Eighth Tribulation Eminence.”
“Eighth Tribulation Eminence?” Meng Chuan came to a realization.
Realm Ancestor looked at Meng Chuan and couldn’t help but shake his head gently. “Any Eighth Tribulation Eminence is a mighty existence. The greatest existence in our River of Spacetime since its birth is only an Eighth Tribulation Eminence.”
“Eighth Tribulation Eminences control time and space. They can jump out of the River of Time, return to the past, and head to the future,” said Realm Ancestor wistfully. “Although they aren’t truly eternal, they live in different eras.
