For example, they can live for thousands of years in the present era. They can then cross time and live for thousands of years ten billion years from now. They can cross another ten billion years after that to meet the Eternal existence that broke through after ten billion years. All of these are possible.”
“It’s not just time. They can also leave the space we are in and enter another universe,” said Realm Ancestor. “They can roam other universes.”
Meng Chuan was stunned when he heard that.
“You may think that the Eighth Tribulation Eminences are dead, but they might appear ten billion years later. Or they might be in another universe.”
“You may think that they are still alive? However, they have also crossed ten billion years, skipping you over, making living beings in those ten billion years believe that they are dead,” said Realm Ancestor. “They also have to follow the flow of time. After jumping for a period of time, they won’t be able to exist in the time they skipped. At the very least, there are no Eighth Tribulation Eminences in our present era.”
Realm Ancestor’s eyes were filled with regret.
He wanted to meet an Eighth Tribulation Eminence and ask them questions. However, in this era, he was already standing at the peak! There were no Eighth Tribulation Eminences that he could question.
He couldn’t leave this universe, so he could only wait for his end.

chapters.title: Chapter 630 - Opportunity and Orders
chapters.content:
Chapter 630 Opportunity and Orders
“Jump out of the River of Time to return to the past or head to the future?” Meng Chuan muttered to himself. He still didn’t have the right to probe the treasures and dossiers left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon.
There were very few records regarding Eighth Tribulation Eminences.
From Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s point of view, understanding the Eighth Tribulation realm was clearly meaningless for someone who hadn’t even reached the Sixth Tribulation realm.
“The past has already happened, so it naturally can’t be changed,” said Realm Ancestor. “The so-called returning to the past is simply being a bystander. For example, one can watch the birth of the Universe and the history of some dead Eighth Tribulation Eminences.”
“Dead Eighth Tribulation Eminences?” Meng Chuan was puzzled.
“A living Eighth Tribulation Eminence controls their past and future. They will completely jump out of the River of Spacetime, so others will not be able to see his past,” said Realm Ancestor. “Once they die, there will be no future. They will also completely land in the River of Spacetime. We can naturally pry into their past then. Of course, us Seventh Tribulation Eminences can’t return to the
past.”
“Compared to the past that can’t be changed, the future has infinite possibilities. Therefore, Eighth Tribulation Eminences mostly head to the future or other universes,” said Realm Ancestor with a sigh. “Compared to them, us Seventh Tribulation Eminences are just fish in the River of Spacetime. We are still swimming in the river, but Eighth Tribulation Eminences are already on the shore. They can choose to enter the river in the future or head to other rivers directly.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. The strength difference between Tribulation Eminences was indeed greater at higher realms. He had no way of resisting a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. As for Seventh Tribulation Eminences and Eighth Tribulation Eminences, they were even more different fundamentally.
“I think very highly of you.” Realm Ancestor smiled at Meng Chuan. “Your talent is even higher than Saber Swordsman’s. You have a chance of reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm in your lifetime. In the future, you might be like me. You will also attempt to reach the Eighth Tribulation realm.”
“I’m still far from reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm,” said Meng Chuan. In the entire River of Spacetime, a single Eighth Tribulation Eminence might not even appear in a particular epoch. In fact, one might not even appear in ten epochs. According to the scattered information he had, it was very difficult for an Eighth Tribulation Eminence to appear.
Meng Chuan only wanted to take things one step at a time and do his best. The most important thing for him was to transcend the sixth Heavenly Tribulation first.
“It is very difficult.” Realm Ancestor said softly, “I’m not confident, even if I’m given ten times my lifespan.” With a flip of his hand, a golden leaf appeared in Realm Ancestor’s hand. With a wave of his hand, the golden leaf flew towards Meng Chuan.
“This is for you. This is an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation legacy. It’s called Eternal Road,” said Realm Ancestor. “It’s limited by the River of Spacetime’s laws. If you learn it, this leaf will shatter.”
“An Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation legacy?” Meng Chuan was alarmed. “T-this is too precious.”
“It’s precious to you, but it’s nothing to me,” said Realm Ancestor indifferently. “I once deliberately searched for Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation legacies, so I naturally collected many. It’s just a small matter to give you one. In the future, help my two juniors-Yu Xi and Feng Xiao—and help my homeworld, Eternal Mountain Realm, if you have the chance.”
Realm Ancestor’s request was very vague. By asking Meng Chuan to help if he had the chance and not stating the extent of the help, it was clearly up to Meng Chuan. Such a request was considered very small. “Thank you, Senior.” Meng Chuan still accepted the legacy. He naturally remembered this favor. He would definitely find an opportunity to repay Realm Ancestor in the future.
This legacy was very important to him. After all, Ancestral Master Archean Eon was a Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence. He knew very little about the Essence Soul cultivation system. He had even obtained the Essence Soul Star formulation by chance. With this new legacy, he had two Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation legacies. He would be able to obtain more guidance.
“I’ll give you some advice as well.” Realm Ancestor smiled at Meng Chuan. “You can learn an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s legacy, but you can’t follow it completely. Every Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence creates their own Eighth Tribulation path.”
“I can learn it, but I can’t follow it completely?” Meng Chuan somewhat understood.
“I wonder how far you will go in the future. I can’t see it,” said Realm Ancestor with a smile. “Forget it. That is all we have between us.” With that said, he flicked his sleeve.
Meng Chuan couldn’t help but fall into the lake.
Plop. Spacetime changed.
Inside the same chamber on Thousand Mountain Star.
Spacetime distorted as Meng Chuan appeared out of thin air.
I’m back? Meng Chuan looked at his surroundings. The meditation mat, lamp, incense... Nothing had changed. It was as though he had just experienced a dream.
Meng Chuan looked down at the golden leaf in his hand. This is a legacy bestowed by Realm Ancestor. It clearly wasn’t a dream.
I never expected that I would obtain an opportunity while cultivating in a chamber. Meng Chuan felt somewhat wistful. Sometimes, opportunities were as such. Even if one searched hard, they might not necessarily obtain one. An opportunity could descend from the heavens while one was cultivating diligently.
Meng Chuan’s opportunity had to do with his shared membership of the Cang Alliance with Realm Ancestor. Most importantly, his potential had been recognized by Realm Ancestor. Realm Ancestor—who was nearing the end of his lifespan-was willing to form a good relationship with him.
From what Realm Ancestor said, he wants me to help take care of his two juniors and his homeworld if I have a chance.Also, Realm Ancestor is close to the end of his lifespan? Meng Chuan nodded slightly. According to public information, Realm Ancestor has already lived for more than 180,000 years. He’s the oldest Seventh Tribulation Eminence in this era. He’s indeed not far from the end of his lifespan.
This legacy. Meng Chuan looked at the golden leaf and immediately sat down cross-legged. He solemnly took out a jade bottle and consumed a pill.
His eyes lit up. Following that, an Essence Soul thought immediately seeped into the golden leaf.
Boom! Immediately, a large amount of information surged into Meng Chuan’s mind.
An inheritance—which was completely different from the Essence Soul Starappeared in front of Meng Chuan.
While Meng Chuan received the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation legacy-Eternal Road-Fu Sui was waiting in a hall on his ship.
The Black Mountain ruins are becoming more and more famous. News has spread outside the Cang Alliance, attracting even more cultivators. Fu Sui was rather excited. When the news first spread, only those cultivators from the Cang Alliance entered the ruin world. However, when the news reached the outside world, cultivators from outside the faction came over because of its fame.
No one can kill me completely with my body in my homeworld. I’ll definitely earn a huge fortune. Fu Sui was very cautious. Every time he earned Outer Realm Essence Crystals, he would send them to his homeworld. His true body in the outer realm carried a pitiful amount of treasures.
If he earned anything, he would send it back! Unless an Eighth Tribulation Eminence took action, his homeworld’s true body could not be threatened by anything else.
Whoosh.
Spacetime distorted in the ship.
Fu Sui’s expression changed as he looked ahead in panic. A figure forcefully tore through spacetime and passed through the ship’s layers of array formations, arriving in the hall where Fu Sui was.
It was a tall, thin man with six arms. His eyes were cold.
When he arrived, he imperceptibly affected the entire ship. He even affected the surrounding one trillion kilometers. This huge area became much darker.
His gaze landed on Fu Sui, who felt an inexplicable sense of horror and fear.
“Thearch Xu.” Fu Sui was extremely respectful.
Thearch Xu-one of the six Celestial Thearchs from Six Directions Heaven-a top faction in the River of Spacetime.
There were a total of six Celestial Thearchs in Six Directions Heaven. Celestial Thearch Xu was ranked last. He grasped a Seventh Tribulation law and didn’t cultivate a Seventh Tribulation body. However, he was still one of the top 100 terrifying existences in the River of Spacetime.
Fu Sui wasn’t even at the Sixth Tribulation realm. Furthermore, his Essence Soul was heavily injured. Thearch Xu could probably kill Fu Sui with a glance.
Even Lord Ghostink would probably be reduced to dust with a flick of his sleeve.
“Fu Sui.” Thearch Xu looked at Fu Sui and coldly said, “The Black Mountain ruin you discovered is filled with endless troubles. According to the agreement signed by the Star Pavilion Association, I’m here to deliver an order. From today onwards, you are not to send any cultivators into the Black Mountain ruin.”
“I’m not to send any cultivators in?” Fu Sui was somewhat dazed.
Many cultivators were still on his ship. Only by sending a batch of cultivators in would he receive a batch of Outer Realm Essence Crystals. Many Outer Realm Essence Crystals had yet to be collected.
Although he was afraid of Thearch Xu, these Outer Realm Essence Crystals were his means of survival.
“This is an opportunity I discovered. Why can’t I send them in?” Fu Sui whispered. In order to survive, he still retorted to Thearch Xu’s words.
“I’m here to pass the order. I’m clearly not the one who gave the order.” Thearch Xu looked at Fu Sui. “It’s the eminences who signed the agreement with Star Pavilion Association.” “What is the Star Pavilion Association?” Fu Sui felt indignant.
“More than half of the Seventh Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime have signed the agreement together,” said Thearch Xu indifferently. “You can disobey the order, but you can forget about having any of your true bodies and avatars appearing outside your inhabited world from the moment you refuse. The moment they appear... they will be annihilated.”
Fu Sui was somewhat dazed. More than half of the River of Spacetime’s Seventh Tribulation Eminences? How can I resist such an order? In the future, I will die if I leave my inhabited world after disobeying?
“I-I...” Fu Sui felt very indignant.
Thearch Xu looked at him. “Give me your answer.”

chapters.title: Chapter 631 - Sea of Spacetime
chapters.content:
Chapter 631 Sea of Spacetime
“I’ll naturally follow the order.” Fu Sui lowered his head. “However, how can I reject those cultivators? Dozens of them are waiting in my cave abode.”
“That’s simple.” With a thought, Thearch Xu locked onto the other Fifth Tribulation Eminences temporarily residing in the ship.
“From today onwards, the Black Mountain ruin will be mine.” A mighty voice echoed in every Fifth Tribulation Eminence’s mind. These Fifth Tribulation Eminences felt an inexplicable sense of fear. Before they could react, they felt as though they had been forcefully ‘thrown’ out.
The surrounding spacetime changed. When they saw their surroundings clearly, they realized that they were either in a dark, desolate land, a nameless planet, or an unfamiliar void...
In the blink of an eye, a group of Fifth Tribulation Eminences was thrown into several different river systems.
“All you need to do is spread the word that I have forbidden you from sending any more cultivators in,” said Thearch Xu indifferently. “I’ll take all the blame.”
“Yes,” Fu Sui replied respectfully.
Thearch Xu turned and vanished. If Thearch Xu didn’t have to come and deliver the order, he wouldn’t have bothered meeting Fu Sui.
As one of the top 100 existences in the River of Spacetime, Fifth Tribulation Eminences didn’t dare question his claim of occupying the Black Mountain ruins.
“Thearch Xu.” Fu Sui watched him disappear with yearning in his eyes. He yearned to have Thearch Xu’s strength, but the difference between them was too great.
At the very least, I sent in four batches in a row and earned 300,000 cubes. Fu Sui pondered. I’ve earned quite a bit. I have to think of a way to make use of it.
Thousand Mountain Star.
Boom!
Vast amounts of information surged into Meng Chuan’s mind as he saw many scenes.
The scenes were similar. They were of a vast sea. Seawater constantly amassed, causing the sea to become wider and deeper. The seawater’s circulation contained all sorts of profundities. The more complicated the scene, the darker the sea was.
This is the Sea of Spacetime. Meng Chuan had grasped a lightning law, so he could understand the first part of the legacy. This legacy’s profundities appeared in the form of a swirling sea. In reality, the sea was spacetime itself.
Spacetime had a huge sinkhole. All spacetime revolved around this point.
This Eternal Path has a higher learning threshold than the Essence Soul Star formulation. Meng Chuan also came to realize this.
The learning threshold for the Essence Soul Star formulation was very low. Even someone with a fifth-level Essence Soul could gain basic mastery of it, making it evident that the criteria on one’s willpower was not too ridiculous.
Eternal Road had a much higher learning threshold than that of Essence Soul Star. It didn’t have any requirements for one’s Essence Soul realm, but it had extremely high requirements for one’s technique realm, mind, and willpower.
One also had to have insights into time and space before they could comprehend the formulation. Those who specialized in only the void lineage or the time lineage couldn’t understand the formulation. This was very normal. Every powerful Tribulation Eminence had extremely high attainments in time and space. Another aspect required one’s mind and willpower needed to reach the Essence Soul Fifth Tribulation realm before they could cultivate it.
I’ll give it a try.
The Essence Soul Star in his Essence Soul avatar’s body slowly revolved. Although the Essence Soul contained in the avatar was only a tiny portion, it was still maintained by the Essence Soul Star’s structure. This made it much more stable and stronger.
At that moment, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul Star began to scatter with a thought, forming the most fundamental Essence Soul thoughts.
Sea of Spacetime, Eternal Road. As Meng Chuan attempted the technique, countless Essence Soul thoughts fused together. This time, it wasn’t a star, but a sea of spacetime.
In the vast sea, his countless Essence Soul thoughts were water droplets, which gathered with the profundities of spacetime.
Since Meng Chuan had comprehended a Sixth Tribulation lightning law, lightning vaguely appeared in the Sea of Spacetime, making it vaguely appear like a lightning pool.
Boom!
In the Sea of Spacetime, seawater constantly gathered, producing extremely strong pressure that acted on the core.
In the Sea of Spacetime’s middle, countless thoughts gathered. These thoughts suffered immense pressure. Furthermore, this pressure was naturally produced by the formulation.
This— Meng Chuan felt immense pressure the moment he tried it. His Essence Soul thoughts at the core began to collapse.
At my realm, the pressure created by circulating the Eternal Road’s formulation is too great. I need a powerful Essence Soul to withstand it. My Essence Soul avatar is ultimately too weak. Meng Chuan understood this point. He didn’t hesitate to summon his true body in the outer realm’s Fiend Mountain. His outer realm true body was listening to the voice on Fiend Mountain as his Essence Soul was constantly tempered. Simultaneously experiencing the dual pressure from Fiend Mountain’s sounds and the Eternal Road formulation only interfered with each other. The effects of cultivation weren’t good.
His outer realm true body soon returned to Thousand Mountain Star. His outer realm true body had more than half of his Essence Soul Origins foundation, making his Essence Soul much stronger. He began to devote himself to the new Eternal Road formulation.
Only by having a much stronger Essence Soul could one withstand the pressure of this technique. Otherwise, one wouldn’t be able to cultivate this technique for a long time.
In terms of stability and defense, this technique is extremely strong. It’s in no way inferior to the Essence Soul Star. The Essence Soul Star’s strength lies in the fact that one’s Essence Soul can slowly strengthen. It’s also beneficial to one’s willpower.
One’s Essence Soul won’t strengthen with Eternal Road. Instead, it forms a Sea of Spacetime that constantly puts pressure on my Essence Soul. I have to use my willpower to resist this pressure at all times. For a day or two, I’ll continue resisting the pressure to force my mind and will to transform. Meng Chuan was rather impressed. Compared to the Essence Soul Star’s slow improvement of his Essence Soul, Eternal Road was even crueler.
If one couldn’t withstand it, their Sea of Spacetime would collapse. They wouldn’t be able to cultivate the formulation for long. If Meng Chuan wanted to cultivate Eternal Road for a long time, he had to strengthen his willpower.
The voice of Fiend Mountain is an external sound that tempers one’s Essence Soul while Eternal Road allows for self-cultivation. It’s internal pressure. According to the manual, the Sea of Spacetime is torture. It constantly tortures one’s mind and will.
ultimately be exhausted and tired. I won’t be able to cultivate the Eternal Road formulation well. I have to enjoy this pressure. Under this pressure, I have to find the flaws in my willpower and perfect it, allowing it to transform. The transformation of one’s willpower is what makes cultivators infatuated with this formulation. Meng Chuan understood the creator’s choice.
There was no need for external pressure since the Essence Soul formulation allowed for internal refinement.
With the Sea of Spacetime, he would forge an Eternal Road.
I can give it a try. At the very least, this formulation was an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s smooth path. However, just as Realm Ancestor had said, one had to walk their own path if they wanted to reach the Eighth Tribulation realm. Therefore, be it learning from the Essence Soul Star or Eternal Road, he had to break through their limitations eventually.
However, it was still too early to talk about breaking through. He had to focus on cultivation.
More than half a year passed.
The World Gap between Archean Eon Realm and the Demon Realm slowly collapsed. As the two inhabited worlds gradually distanced from each other, the World Gap—which had formed temporarily when the two worlds approached each other-began to collapse.
This collapse was very slow. It would probably continue for centuries.
Occasionally, light would fall from the damaged sky.
King Calm Sea-who looked like he was carved out of dark-cyan ice-looked up silently. His appearance hadn’t changed at all. However, his skin was much dimmer, and his vitality was much weaker. Even though he had transformed into an ice lifeform, he was still nearing the end of his lifespan.
It’s been 300 years. King Calm Sea looked at the World Gap. In the beginning, there were still clashes between humans and demons in the World Gap.
After that, the Demon Realm completely turtled up and no longer dared to enter the World Gap. King Calm Sea patrolled the World Gap alone. The occasional entry by human Godfiends would leave him somewhat delighted. However, after the human Godfiends returned to Archean Eon Realm, he was the only one left in the World Gap.
Today was the day his 300-year sentence ended.
Sea’s heart trembled slightly. It had been 300 years—too long. He had repeatedly dreamed of that land.
King Calm Sea flew up and arrived at a node after traveling 1,500 kilometers. This node was connected to Archean Mountain.
Boom!
King Calm Sea struck the node and punched out eight times with his bare hands. He tore through the world membrane and saw what stood at the other end. The sunlight was bright and beautiful. The sunlight was so bright that King Calm Sea narrowed his eyes.
He took a step forward and passed through the world membrane, arriving at Archean Mountain.
King Calm Sea stood on the nameless mountain and looked around alone. Two figures soon flew over from afar. One was Qin Wu, and the other was Yan Jin. They coldly looked at King Calm Sea.

chapters.title: Chapter 632 - King Calm Sea’s End
chapters.content:
Chapter 632 King Calm Sea’s End
“Master.” King Calm Sea bowed respectfully. Qin Wu looked at his disciple. This disciple had once been his pride. He had a chance of becoming Archean Mountain’s fourth Supremacy after Li Guan, Luo Tang, and Qin Wu, but he had taken the wrong path. He believed that he could obtain the demons’ benefits for himself without letting them take advantage of him. However, the demons ultimately schemed against him.. If not for Meng Chuan’s actions, King Calm Sea would have caused even greater harm.
“The 300-year deadline is up,” said Qin Wu coldly. “Archean Mountain allows you to take a look around the world. In three days, you have to return to Archean Mountain. Without the sect’s permission, you are not allowed to leave the mountain again.”
“Yes, I understand.” King Calm Sea bowed slightly and accepted the sect’s decision. Qin Wu looked at him and turned to leave.
With Meng Chuan present in Archean Eon Realm, an invisible domain naturally covered the entirety of Archean Eon Realm. It was fine if he didn’t pay attention to it. Nothing could escape Meng Chuan’s notice as long as he paid a sliver of attention. Thus, Qin Wu wasn’t worried about any negative consequences for letting King Calm Sea roam the human world for three days.
“My seventh son.” King Calm Sea looked at Yan Jin.
Yan Jin coldly glared at King Calm Sea. “Xue Ting, I came today to ask you if you have learned your mistake. Do you regret it?” Even now, Yan Jin didn’t recognize his father.
“Hahaha.” King Calm Sea looked at his son and laughed. “What mistakes should I have learned? What regrets should I have?”
“Your children.” Yan Jin couldn’t hide his anger. “My mother and all the other innocent, pitiful people—you deliberately arranged for them to end up in such a tragic state. Many of the hardships we experienced were caused by you. These are your sins.”
King Calm Sea looked at Yan Jin and indifferently said, “If you had enjoyed riches and honor since you were young and didn’t suffer any hardships, would you have become a Regis Godfiend? Would your fifth brother have attained such accomplishments back then? You have to thank your childhood for your accomplishments.”
“Gratitude?” Yan Jin laughed in anger. “I never expected you to be so crazy even after 300 years. You still don’t care about pitiful people like my mother?”
King Calm Sea calmly said, “To nurture a Regis Godfiend like you, your mother and the other mortals sacrificed themselves. They have contributed greatly to humanity. Their contributions are much greater than many mediocre mortals.”
“You truly are unrepentant!” Yan Jin’s eyes were filled with anger. “Xue Ting, I’ve been cultivating arduously for more than 300 years. I’ve created a sword technique. Have a taste of it and see how powerful my sword is!”
With that said, Yan Jin attacked.
The sword beam was dazzling as it streaked across the sky and appeared at King Calm Sea’s chest.
“Hahaha.” King Calm Sea laughed loudly as he struck out with his bare hands.
Yan Jin was rather talented. Although he couldn’t reach the Supremacy realm at the peak of his body’s vitality, he had cultivated for more than 300 years. Archean Mountain’s resources had also greatly increased, and Meng Chuan often gave lectures. Although Yan Jin’s current strength was inferior to that of King True Martial, his technique realm had reached the mid-stage Grotto-Heaven realm. His sword art had drawn upon the Myriad Sword Sect’s experience, and he had learned the Star Cluster Building’s legacies. It was extremely powerful.
However, after a short exchange
Clang!
Yan Jin was slammed into the mountainside, causing the mountain to tremble. Only with the sect’s array formation protecting it did the mountain not collapse. However, he produced a huge crater. Yan Jin lay there with a pale face. There was a trickle of blood at the corner of his mouth.
I lost? Yan Jin found it unacceptable.
King Calm Sea, Xue Ting, had cultivated 100 years longer than him. However, Archean Mountain’s cultivation resources were much better than before. Meng Chuan-a Tribulation Eminence-often gave lectures. Under such circumstances, Yan Jin believed that he could surpass King Calm Sea. “A self-created sword art at the mid-stage Grotto-Heaven realm? It’s already impressive that you can exchange dozens of blows with me,” said King Calm Sea indifferently as he calmly looked at the heavily injured Yan Jin. “However, I’ve cultivated in the World Gap for 300 years. I’ve already reached the Grotto-Heaven realm’s late stage. You are still not my match. If your fifth brother had cultivated for 300 years, he probably would have surpassed me. You are still lacking.”
“Xue Ting, you are talented. Back then, Archean Mountain nurtured you with all their might, but what did you do?” Yan Jin sneered. “You saved some people while guarding the city passes, but you killed them later. You even killed many Godfiends. If it weren’t for Meng Chuan, you would have killed even more Godfiends and mortals.”
King Calm Sea’s expression changed slightly. This was something he had never been able to forgive himself for. He originally thought that he could obtain the demons’ benefits for himself before striking back at them, but he ended up falling for the demons’ tricks.
“You used unscrupulous means to increase your strength,” said Yan Jin angrily. “You even used unscrupulous means to nurture your children. However, in fact, you can’t be unscrupulous when it comes to teaching your children and juniors. An orthodox path needs to be taken. If you take the wrong path, you will go astray and naturally deviate thousands of kilometers. I never expected you to remain so stubborn after 300 years.”
My path was crooked? A deviation of thousands of kilometers? King Calm Sea looked at his hands. His entire body seemed to be formed from ice. He was no longer a normal human. Did I go astray? King Calm Sea asked himself this question silently before leaving.
When Yan Jin saw this, he gritted his teeth in indignation. He was indignant for his family, his siblings. So many of his family members had been harmed because of this lunatic.
Three days later.
King Calm Sea, who traveled the world, returned to Archean Mountain.
“Master.” King Calm Sea arrived in front of Qin Wu.
“From today onwards, you are not allowed to leave the mountain without the sect’s permission.” Qin Wu looked at him coldly. King Calm Sea should’ve had a bright future, but he ended up in such a state.
“I’ve been walking the human world for three days. Indeed, this world is much more prosperous and exciting than before.” King Calm Sea smiled at Qin Wu. “This is the world I wanted to see even in my dreams. Now that I’ve seen it, Master, help me tell Meng Chuan that I’m very grateful to him. I’m grateful that he completed the dream I wanted to complete the most.
“Master, please tell Yan Jin that I have indeed gone astray on my path,” said King Calm Sea. “I’ve even implicated him, Feng’er, and many others. Perhaps if I taught them well, they would’ve grown like Meng Chuan and become equally strong. I’ve reached the end of my life. Master, I’ve let you down.”
King Calm Sea bowed respectfully. Following that, he looked up. When he straightened his body, his body had already begun to dissipate, turning into dust.
Qin Wu silently looked at his disciple. The disciple—who had long transformed into an Ice Guard-dissipated in front of him.
Meng Chuan appeared out of thin air beside the courtyard. Meng Chuan could naturally sense King Calm Sea’s death.
“King Calm Sea is dead,” said Qin Wu. “He snapped to his senses before he died.”
“He had a miserable childhood. He also saw the darkest side of the human world. All of that warped his personality,” said Meng Chuan. “His warped personality affected his wives and children. He also harmed a large number of mortals and Godfiends. He caused great harm, but he guarded Calm Sea Pass for many years and saved many people. He also contributed by patrolling the World Gap for 300 years.”
“He has made contributions, but he also committed a grave mistake!” said Qin Wu. “He failed to live up to Archean Mountain’s nurturing.”
“Yeah.” Meng Chuan looked at Qin Wu. “Master, I’ll be entering seclusion soon. You can look for me if there’s anything important. Otherwise, don’t disturb me.”
“Alright.” Qin Wu nodded.
“Quickly consume the longevity extension treasure I prepared for you,” reminded Meng Chuan.
“There’s no rush,” said Qin Wu with a smile. “I’m still hundreds of years away from the end of my lifespan. If I don’t break through in the next three years, it won’t be too late to consume it.”
With Qin Wu’s current status, although he didn’t know the exact value of the longevity extension treasures Meng Chuan had prepared, he knew that anything that could extend a Supremacy’s lifespan was extremely precious. Therefore, he didn’t want to use it easily.
“Alright then.” Meng Chuan didn’t force Qin Wu when faced with his master’s stubbornness. He had prepared many gifts for his fellow men and the sect. He had even prepared gifts for his best friends, Yan Jin, Yan Chitong, and company. He had also prepared gifts for his grandchildren. Although they didn’t cost more than 10,000 cubes, they were still of great use.
Of course, these objects only provided external help. Whether it was the race or an individual, cultivation still depended on themselves.
Meng Chuan turned and left. He began to focus on his cultivation in seclusion.
He had a feeling that the sixth Heavenly Tribulation wasn’t far away.

chapters.title: Chapter 633 - Sixth Heavenly Tribulation
chapters.content:
Chapter 633 Sixth Heavenly Tribulation
Meng Chuan delegated all his responsibilities to others. He also temporarily bade farewell to his parents and wife. He entered seclusion and focused on his cultivation. Meng Chuan was so invested because he was already somewhat infatuated with the legacy Realm Ancestor gave him-Eternal Road.
As expected of an Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s legacy. Meng Chuan was filled with admiration. To transform one’s Essence Soul into a Sea of Spacetime to torture oneself... This allows one to have a higher chance of finding the flaws in their willpower due to the internal pressure.
As he cultivated this technique, Meng Chuan discovered some flaws in his mind. Stronger willpower doesn’t mean better resistance against the internal pressure. Something excessively hard becomes brittle. Sometimes, it’s much easier to resist when something is slightly rounder.
His mind and will controlled his entire Essence Soul. When resisting the pressure, being milder and gentler helped in being malleable.
It was easiest to discover all sorts of weaknesses when one cultivated Eternal Road for the first time. As the various weaknesses were resolved, this legacy would gradually push one towards a bottleneck. This was because it became harder to overcome the remaining weakness as one progressed.
Of course, when Meng Chuan just began cultivating Eternal Road and was in the midst of improving, he was naturally fervent. He could clearly sense his body transforming. Cultivating in a Chaos Hole’s depths is indeed different from the outside world. Meng Chuan often went to a Chaos Hole’s depths to cultivate Eternal Road. The Dark Chaos Hole affected spacetime and his Essence Soul. In the Chaos Hole’s depths, his Essence Soul—which had transformed into a Sea of Spacetime—was affected by the Chaos Hole. It became even more distorted and unstable. The pressure on his Essence Soul was greater, making it easier for him to discover his weaknesses.
He resolved his weaknesses and made himself stronger. Meng Chuan indulged in this feeling of improvement.
In the blink of an eye, 15 years had passed since he had obtained Eternal Road. Meng Chuan had also reached a bottleneck. This was because he had resolved all the easily resolved weaknesses. The remaining weaknesses came from his character as a person. Thus, improvement became difficult.
Cultivators are ultimately not puppets. They can’t control themselves perfectly. Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in the Dark Chaos Hole’s depths and sighed silently. It was already very difficult for him to improve. All that was left was pressure—one that continued without stopping. Meng Chuan couldn’t help but feel exhausted.
Oh? Meng Chuan’s expression suddenly changed. He vaguely sensed that a Heavenly Tribulation was about to descend.
The sixth Heavenly Tribulation is coming? Meng Chuan was alarmed. He immediately took a step forward and flashed three times before arriving in Archean Eon Realm.
The Chaos Hole he was in was the closest to Archean Eon Realm. Meng Chuan’s true body could naturally return in the shortest time possible.
The Heavenly Tribulation is coming?
Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, in a chamber in the Realm Palace cave abode.
The white-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan sat cross-legged. The time flow in this chamber was identical to the outer realm’s void. It was also where Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar stayed. Otherwise, staying in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm would drain away his lifespan much faster. Meng Chuan sat in the chamber and looked out the window, staring at the vast lake. His expression was somewhat complicated.
His gaze landed on his grandson, Meng Yuwho was in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. He also saw his son-Meng An-and Long Han.
I wonder if I can return to this mystic realm. At the same time, the Essence Soul avatar silently dissipated.
Meng Yu-who was cultivating in the sectdidn’t know that his grandfather was about to transcend the sixth Heavenly Tribulation. If Meng Chuan failed, Meng Yu would never see his grandfather again.
Thousand Mountain Star.
Meng Chuan glanced at his disciples-Gao Fang and Zhao Hongxiu—who were cultivating. He also looked at Cave Lord Scenic Cloud, the Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snakes, and the large number of cultivators in Eastcalm City.
If he failed to transcend the tribulation, Thousand Mountain Star’s future would follow his arrangements.
Meng Chuan silently dispersed his Essence Soul avatar.
Archean Eon Realm.
Meng Chuan dispersed all his Essence Soul avatars in the outside world. He even retracted his outer realm true body’s Essence Soul thoughts.
He only used his true body to deal with the Heavenly Tribulation.
Sixth Heavenly Tribulation.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged inside the tallest building in Heaven and Earth Great Hall. He looked up at the sky and sensed a terrifying force forcefully descending through the endless spacetime. Nothing could stop a Heavenly Tribulation.
It’s here. Only about 30 seconds had passed since Meng Chuan sensed it. At that moment, none of Meng Chuan’s friends and family knew that his sixth Heavenly Tribulation had already descended.
Essence Soul Tribulations were ethereal. Even if one’s willpower and cultivation level were high enough, they wouldn’t dare say that they were completely confident of transcending the tribulation. This was because Essence Soul Tribulations targeted one’s Essence Soul and mental weaknesses.
If one’s technique realm was high enough, such as grasping a Seventh Tribulation law, their Essence Soul would be as strong as a Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s. It would naturally be much easier for them to transcend the sixth Heavenly Tribulation. It was as though a gale couldn’t shake a towering mountain, but it could sweep up rocks! A Seventh Tribulation Essence Soul was a mountain, and a Sixth Tribulation Essence Soul was a rock. The sixth Heavenly Tribulation was a gale.
The gale descended, sweeping up the rock. Tribulation Transcendence. Meng Chuan sensed the terrifying force pass through the Heaven and Earth Great Hall’s obstruction and drilled into his sea of consciousness.
In his sea of consciousness was an Essence Soul that resembled a star. As the Essence Soul Star that had been cultivated for the longest time, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul naturally responded in this form. This form was also what he was most confident in.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Numerous illusory flames descended and smashed into Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul like meteors. The impact was rather terrifying.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul circulated his Essence Soul Star formulation. It also used his powerful willpower and the World Treasure guarding him. He could be said to be stable enough to withstand all the attacks. Chi! Chi! Chi! These illusory flames were colorless. Even with his Power of Essence Soul, Meng Chuan could only sense flames everywhere.
Its existence caused spacetime to distort into the shape of flames. Meng Chuan called them Void Flames.
During an Essence Soul Tribulation... any bizarre thing could happen. The only way to transcend the tribulation was to deal with whatever came! What is this Void Flame for? Meng Chuan was very cautious.
The illusory flame first smashed down like a meteor. After his Essence Soul resisted the flame, it attached to his Essence Soul and burned it. Wisps of flames seeped into his Essence Soul and affected his Essence Soul World.
As the Void Flames fused and adhered to his Essence Soul, more and more flames seeped into his Essence Soul World.
Boom!
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World was a world of lightning. His World Treasure’s defense made his Essence Soul World much more stable and powerful. It repelled the external flames and wanted to destroy them. Under Meng Chuan’s control, the lightning mountain in the middle of his Essence Soul World flew up and smashed into the Void Flames.
Boom!
His Essence Soul World trembled. The Void Flames remained undamaged as they continued entangling his Essence Soul World.
His will was like a sword as he mobilized the Power of Essence Soul to attack with all his might. He wanted to expel the flames, but the flames kept seeping into his Essence Soul World. They couldn’t be readily destroyed.
Two hours, four hours... As time passed, more and more Void Flames became attached to his Essence Soul. More and more flames seeped into his Essence Soul World. Meng Chuan felt his control over his Essence Soul World weaken.
I can’t extinguish these flames. They will only strengthen as time passes. What should I do? Meng Chuan realized how terrifying the flames were. It didn’t have any other characteristicsit only attached, infiltrated, burned, and remained indestructible!
It constantly seeped into his Essence Soul from every spot.
Meng Chuan understood that if he allowed the flames to continue, his Essence Soul would probably be engulfed by the fiery Void Flames and be completely annihilated.

chapters.title: Chapter 634 - Nascent Formulation
chapters.content:
Chapter 634 Nascent Formulation
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Balls of Void Flames descended from afar and struck Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul, causing the flames attached to his Essence Soul to increase gradually. The Void Flames in his Essence Soul World also increased.
Nothing I’ve done has stopped it, much less expelled it. Meng Chuan carefully thought of a solution. After cultivating for so many years, he had experienced situations that were far worse than this. He was naturally very calm.
My Essence Soul Dharmic formulation, willpower, and World Treasure only slow down its corrosion speed. Meng Chuan understood that the corrosion would’ve been much faster if his willpower had been weak or if he lacked a World Treasure.
I’ll change the Essence Soul’s structure. Meng Chuan immediately made a decision. In the past, he didn’t have a second powerful Essence Soul structure, but he now had one after obtaining the new legacy-Eternal Road.
Sea of Spacetime. With a thought, the countless Essence Soul thoughts that were in the form of stars immediately changed. They formed a brand new structure, creating a sea of spacetime.
The Sea of Spacetime slowly spun and condensed, producing an internal pressure. A portion of his Essence Soul thoughts had previously been tainted by the Void Flames. Though Void Flames were still burning the Sea of Spacetime’s surface after the Essence Soul’s structure had changed, the corrosion speed had indeed changed.
Some places are being corroded at a slower speed? Meng Chuan was astonished and carefully sensed the changes. His Essence Soul Star was round and indestructible. The speed at which it corroded was uniform.
The Sea of Spacetime constantly fluctuated and condensed. This constant variability resulted in different corrosion speed.
Overall, the corrosion is faster than the Essence Soul Star’s corrosion? Meng Chuan carefully sensed every spot. Some places in the Sea of Spacetime corrode very slowly, but why is it slow? Some places corrode quickly, but is that so?
As Meng Chuan pondered, he gradually gained insights. These insights fused with some of the insights he had gained from his many years of cultivation. They clashed and formed sparks of inspiration, giving Meng Chuan ideas.
Some changes might lead to better results. Meng Chuan thought of something. Of the two legacies, Meng Chuan had cultivated the Essence Soul Star the longest. This was a cultivation formulation he had started cultivating when he was a Regis Godfiend.
However, he realized that he was ultimately different from Senior Fei Yu as he cultivated, even though the Essence Soul Star formulation was quite suitable for him. In the early stages, he could follow the other party’s path. However, the further he progressed, the greater the differences between them.
Meng Chuan had long used the formulation as his foundation to change and create an Essence Soul cultivation formulation that was most suitable for him. However, creating a new Essence Soul formulation wasn’t easy. Meng Chuan didn’t spend much effort on this aspect, so he never succeeded.
This time, he had gained more insights after studying Eternal Road. Now that he had encountered the Void Flames during his tribulation transcendence, he gained further insights. When all these ideas collided, a nascent formulation took shape in his mind.
Change.
Meng Chuan changed his Essence Soul’s structure according to his will.
Boom.
His Essence Soul’s structure changed again. This time, it changed according to the nascent formulation Meng Chuan came up with.
Seventy percent of his Essence Soul thoughts condensed into an Essence Soul Star, while the other 30% of his Essence Soul thoughts formed a stream of water that covered the Essence Soul Star’s surface.
Senior Fei Yu’s Essence Soul Star pursues eternal indestructibility. His Essence Soul is also stable and indestructible. However, I think that the combination of Yin and Yang, a soft surface with a hard interior is more stable. It can withstand all sorts of impacts and pressure.
The Sea of Spacetime didn’t match his personality because it constantly tortured him. His Essence Soul Star wasn’t completely compatible with him because it was too hard.
Meng Chuan’s style of doing things was to act according to the situation-enduring and attacking as the situation called for it. Such an Essence Soul structure was most suitable for him.
Internally, it’s eternally indestructible. Externally, it is destroyed according to the circumstances.
The interior was still the Essence Soul star.
The exterior water surface was based on the knowledge he had gleaned from the Sea of Spacetime. Thanks to the experience from the Eighth Tribulation legacy-Eternal RoadMeng Chuan could form a prototype in a short period of time. Otherwise, it would take him much longer to create something out of nothing.
This formulation was still very crude. It was a combination of two Eighth Tribulation Eminences’ legacies. It could only be considered a nascent formulation, but it suited Meng Chuan the best.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
When he formed the new Essence Soul structure, Meng Chuan deliberately moved his Essence Soul thoughts that were tainted by the Void Flames to the outermost water layer.
The inner star remained untainted.
Annihilate. With a thought, the Essence Soul thoughts in the surrounding water layer were completely destroyed. Thirty percent of his Essence Soul Origins was destroyed, causing the Void Flames to lose their medium.
Furthermore, with his Essence Soul’s recovery speed, he quickly recovered 30% of his Essence Soul’s Origins. The new 30% Essence Soul’s Origins—which didn’t have any Void Flamescovered the surface of the star.
Whoosh!
The Void Flames—which he had detached from him-entangled him again.
This method won’t work. Meng Chuan frowned slightly. The flames won’t extinguish. They will only continue to infiltrate my body. I’ll try another method.
He began to experiment with the water layer, coming up with various methods to deal with the situation.
Previously, the Sea of Spacetime had differences in corrosion speed when dealing with the Void Flames. Meng Chuan had comprehended some techniques for those that had slow corrosion speed. These techniques couldn’t be used with his Essence Soul Star, but he could employ them with the water layer.
Boom!
The water surged and changed as the Void Flames began to weaken. They occasionally became stronger, but the overall corrosion power gradually decreased.
In the variability of spacetime, spacetime empties, strengthens, and intersects when needed... Meng Chuan felt like he was fighting a war. His opponent was the increasing number of Void Flames while his army consisted of the countless Essence Soul thoughts, lightning law, the usage of two Eighth Tribulation Eminences’ legacies, and a powerful mind and will.
In this Tribulation Transcendence war, Meng Chuan’s goal was to make his Essence Soul have a greater resistance to corrosion. The internal Essence Soul Star was his foundation. Even if losses happened in the surface water layer, they could quickly be recouped. One time, he made a mistake while experimenting with the water layer. The Void Flames seeped into his Essence Soul Star. Even with his Essence Soul Star’s stability and strength, the Void Flames infiltrated slowly. However, Meng Chuan could immediately transfer his Essence Soul thoughts tainted by Void Flames to the water layer, allowing his Essence Soul Star to recover naturally.
The combination of the two Essence Soul structures had the inner core as the foundation. It was like an army barracks that kept producing soldiers. The periphery was the battlefield, allowing one to fight as much as they wanted.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The Void Flames constantly descended. More and more flames became attached to Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul. More flames also seeped into his Essence Soul World. However, through Meng Chuan’s repeated experiments, the water layer’s resistance to corrosion became more and more efficient. The Void Flames’ corrosion speed was only ten to twenty percent of its original speed.
Meng Chuan immersed himself in the tribulation. Under the threat of death, he tried his best to resist the tribulation.
Suddenly, no new Void Flames descended. The mysterious and vast laws receded as well. The constantly burning Void Flames seemed to lose their source of power and dissipated.
Oh? Meng Chuan was somewhat astonished. Why are the flames gone?
The Void Flames had all disappeared.
He was still improving his new formulation constantly.
It’s over? The sixth Heavenly Tribulation has ended? Meng Chuan looked up. The Heavenly Tribulation had vanished. His Essence Soul had endured the Void Flames’ tempering, undergoing some changes.
So, I would’ve completed the Heavenly Tribulation as long as I could resist the Void Flames for a certain length of time?
With his original willpower and World Treasure, he could have lasted until now without creating a new Essence Soul formulation.
Unfortunately, the tribulation was too short. If this Heavenly Tribulation had lasted two to three times longer, my formulation would be more complete. Meng Chuan stood up and walked to the window, looking at the sky.
Meng Chuan was in a good mood after successfully transcending the tribulation and reaching the Sixth Tribulation realm.
Time to tell Qiyue. Meng Chuan immediately left Heaven and Earth Great Hall and headed for Jiang State Capital.

chapters.title: Chapter 635 - Half of the Master’s Treasures (Final Chapter of Volume)
chapters.content:
Chapter 635 Half of the Master’s Treasures (Final Chapter of Volume)
Outside Jiang State Capital, on a nameless mountain.
Liu Qiyue sat cross-legged on the mountain peak with her eyes closed. She took in the evolution of the world and focused on her cultivation. Ever since her husband-Meng Chuan-entered seclusion, Liu Qiyue had been under a lot of pressure. This was because she knew that it was possible for him to fail the Tribulation Transcendence. Furthermore, Meng Chuan’s series of arrangements meant that he wasn’t completely confident.
Thus, she was worried about her husband. To prevent herself from overthinking things, all she could do was spend almost all of her time cultivating. This was because she had consumed another rare treasure-Fire Origins Liquid. It improved her bloodline until it was close to that of a pure-blooded phoenix. Her cultivation was very smooth now.
Insights into the fire lineage surged into her mind in a natural manner. Her cultivation efficiency was more than ten times faster than before. In fact, true pure-blooded phoenixes cultivated even more smoothly. Even if they didn’t cultivate diligently, they would grow naturally over time. In the end, they could easily reach the perfected Imperial Lord realm and have strength comparable to a Fifth Tribulation Eminence.
Liu Qiyue was slightly inferior, but she improved rapidly. Furthermore, she was much more diligent and serious than a pure-blooded phoenix.
Swoosh.
A figure traversed the void and appeared on the nameless mountain.
Liu Qiyue sensed something. She opened her eyes and saw Meng Chuan smiling at her.
“Ah Chuan, you’ve come out of seclusion?” Liu Qiyue stood up in pleasant surprise. “Didn’t you say that this seclusion is very important? You said you probably wouldn’t come out until the Tribulation Transcendence is over? You are now...”
Liu Qiyue was somewhat nervous.
“That’s right. I’ve already transcended the sixth Essence Soul Heavenly Tribulation,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“You succeeded?” Liu Qiyue was thrilled when she heard that. “That’s great! That’s great!”
“That’s right.” Meng Chuan nodded and smiled. “I should be spending a long time at the Sixth Tribulation realm. I can accompany you during this period of time and help Archean Eon Realm.”
Although he had the strength of a Sixth Tribulation Eminence previously, he was faced with an impending Heavenly Tribulation. There were many things that needed his attention.
Meng Chuan was even a little harsh on his descendants. This was because he felt that he had to save up more of his resources since he might’ve died during the Tribulation Transcendence.
“Now that you have transcended the tribulation, you will be of great help to Archean Eon Realm.” Liu Qiyue was rather expectant. “By the way, towards Yuan’er and the others...”
“I can slightly relax the rules now.” Meng Chuan nodded. “It’s not only them. There are also Regis Godfiends with potential. Even if they are 300 to 400 years old and their bodies are beginning to age, they can be given treasures to restore their bodies to peak vitality.”
The price of recovering one’s body to its peak was relatively low. A hundred cubes’ worth of treasures was enough. However, Archean Mountain had used these relatively cheap treasures early on. After all, Ancestral Master Archean Eon didn’t have too many of them in his reserves. Luckily, Meng Chuan could purchase them through Eternal Tower.
“What a pity for Senior Brother Wang.” Meng Chuan always felt that it was a pity that Senior Brother Wang-King True Martial—had died. Back then, Archean Eon Realm was sealed off due to the war, preventing them from heading to the outer realm. Otherwise, Archean Mountain would’ve been willing to buy a treasure that could restore King True Martial’s body to peak vitality. “Yes.” Liu Qiyue nodded. “Many Regis Godfiends have sacrificed a lot for the people. They deserve some help. If they can become Supremacies, their lifespans will be much longer. They might have a chance of becoming an Imperial Lord in this lifetime.”
“It’s difficult to become a Supremacy, and the chances of becoming an Imperial Lord are even lower.” Meng Chuan shook his head gently. “However, if I send them to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, there’s a chance of them improving significantly.”
Earth Cloud Mystic Realm was an important place for Meng Chuan to nurture Archean Eon Realm’s Supremacies.
Meng Chuan accompanied his wife as he sent his other true body to Heaven and Earth Great Hall to meet the white-robed Guardian.
White fog seeped out from the walls of the hall, forming a white-robed elder.
The white-robed elder looked at Meng Chuan excitedly. “Meng Chuan, did you successfully transcend the tribulation?”
“Senior, you are wise,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“How am I wise? I was just making a wild guess.” The white-robed elder flipped his hand and took out a bronze mirror. There were ancient mystic patterns on the bronze mirror. When he shone it at Meng Chuan, the white-robed elder immediately understood. “Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation realm. Age 2,622. As I guessed, you’re still young. Master was much older than you when he reached the Sixth Tribulation realm back then.”
Meng Chuan also knew that he was relatively faster because he had created an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique and raised it to the Fifth Tribulation realm. However, being fast for a moment didn’t mean that he would always be fast.
How many Seventh Tribulation Eminences were there in the entire River of Spacetime? From this, one could tell that most creators of Imperial Lord-level paramount techniques couldn’t reach the Seventh Tribulation realm.
“You are very young and have extraordinary potential,” said the white-robed elder with a sigh. “According to Master’s speculations, the probability of another Seventh Tribulation Eminence appearing in a middle-level world like Archean Eon Realm is negligible. Therefore, one can obtain half of his treasures as long as a sufficiently young Sixth Tribulation Eminence is born.”
“Half of his treasures?” asked Meng Chuan. “What age range is Ancestral Master Archean Eon referring to when he said sufficiently young?” “Becoming a Sixth Tribulation Eminence within 10,000 years is considered sufficiently young,” said the white-robed elder with a smile. “You are much stronger than the standards set by Master.”Similarly, you can also know all of Master’s secrets. These secrets can only be known by you. You can’t tell outsiders, including the people closest to you,” said the white-robed elder solemnly. “According to Master’s arrangements, even if a Sixth Tribulation Eminence appears in Archean Eon Realm, many secrets can’t be touched upon. Only those who reach the Sixth Tribulation realm within 10,000 years can learn of everything.” “Oh?” Meng Chuan was curious.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon was already dead. It wasn’t easy for a Sixth Tribulation Eminence to appear in his homeworld, yet he still hid such information.
Only someone like me who has enough potential can learn about this information?
“Some Seventh Tribulation Eminences might not see what you will see today.” The white-robed elder turned his head and said, “Follow me.”
Boom!
A path opened up ahead. Meng Chuan followed the white-robed elder in.
“Since you have reached the Sixth Tribulation realm, you should understand that the entire River of Spacetime is typically controlled by Seventh Tribulation Eminences,” said the white-robed elder as he walked.
“According to my understanding, there aren’t any Eighth Tribulation Eminences in this era. There are about 20 to 30 Seventh Tribulation Eminences,” said Meng Chuan.
“Even if there are Eighth Tribulation Eminences, they can’t be bothered to participate in the River of Spacetime’s internal affairs. Their sights are much further,” said the white-robed elder. “As you said, there are only 20 to 30 Seventh Tribulation Eminences in this era. These 20 to 30 are the ones who control nearly all the top resources in the River of Spacetime. They are also divided into factions. Some form a single faction, while others form a faction as a pair or trio. “In the River of Spacetime, only Seventh Tribulation Eminences can form a faction,” said the white-robed elder. “One has to join a faction to enjoy the top resources. Otherwise, they won’t even have the right to touch most of the resources.”
“Oh?” Meng Chuan fell into deep thought.
After seeing Realm Ancestor’s strength, he had an inkling. It was possible for 20 to 30 Seventh Tribulation Eminences to control most of the resources. For example, Ancestral Master Archean Eon had set up an array formation when he discovered Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, preventing outsiders from entering. Only by joining a faction could one enjoy the resources. Otherwise, they could forget about touching them.
“Becoming a Sixth Tribulation Eminence makes you one of the backbones of any top faction in the River of Spacetime,” said the white-robed elder. “If a Fifth Tribulation Eminence is not worth mentioning because there are countless of them, then Sixth Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime are few in number. Seventh Tribulation Eminences still place great importance on Sixth Tribulation Eminences. After all, they can’t split themselves infinitely. Many important places are managed by their subordinates.
“After the news of you becoming a Sixth Tribulation Eminence is announced, you will also be faced with the choice of joining a faction,” said the white-robed elder. “Eternal Tower itself can’t be considered a faction. It’s a very loose trading organization. There are many Seventh Tribulation Eminences inside, and all of these Seventh Tribulation Eminences have their own motives.
“Of course, Eternal Tower has a very special existence-Eye of Eternal. It’s as powerful as a Seventh Tribulation Eminence and is eternal. Even if a Sixth Tribulation Eminence of Eternal Tower doesn’t join any faction, they will be protected by it.
Meng Chuan knew this.
The Eye of Eternal wasn’t a cultivator. It was more like a special existence. It didn’t belong to any factions and was loyal to Eternal Tower. It naturally protected its core members.
“Don’t be in a hurry to choose a faction. Let’s first understand the division of factions in this era,” said the white-robed elder with a smile. “There are only 20 to 30 Seventh Tribulation Eminences. There are probably only a handful of truly powerful factions.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded. He still didn’t know much about these factions. After all, he wasn’t privy to such information.
As a Fifth Tribulation Eminence previously, meeting a Seventh Tribulation Eminence was as difficult as ascending to the heavens since there were countless Fifth Tribulation Eminences across the River of Spacetime. Even Realm Ancestor’s summoning was due to Meng Chuan’s young age and Sixth Tribulation realm strength.
“We’ve arrived.” The white-robed elder solemnly stared at the dark land in front of him. “Master’s greatest secret—which you absolutely can’t tell a second person is that he was lucky enough to obtain an Eternal treasure.”
“Eternal treasure?” Meng Chuan was stunned. “As the name implies.” The white-robed elder looked at Meng Chuan. “It’s a treasure refined by an Eternal existence. This is the greatest opportunity in Master’s life. Back then, he immediately hid in Archean Eon Realm after he was lucky enough to obtain it. He never dared to announce it! He was afraid of causing endless trouble. Thankfully, an Eternal treasure is beyond time. Even an Eighth Tribulation Eminence can’t find an Eternal treasure when they search the past and future. “Come in. Come with me to see this Eternal treasure. This is because you will be the one in charge of it in the future.” The white-robed elder walked towards the dark land.
Meng Chuan held his breath and walked in.
Final Chapter of Volume—Sixth Tribulation Realm

chapters.title: Chapter 636 - Seal
chapters.content:
Chapter 636 Seal
The dark land was a space deep in Archean Eon Realm’s Heaven and Earth Great Hall. It was only 1,000 feet wide.
The white-robed elder led Meng Chuan into the space.
The entire space was dark, and one had no way to get their bearings. A huge, gray seal floated in the air. Its existence caused the surrounding void to be destroyed constantly. Under the suppression of the dark land’s array formation, its annihilative might was suppressed to a 100-foot radius. Apart from the seal, there was a lake of blood. A large amount of dark-red blood gathered there.
However, in terms of aura, the gray seal clearly far exceeded the blood in the lake that spanned hundreds of feet.
This blood is clearly the blood of an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. Meng Chuan was very certain of this. He had seen Seventh Tribulation-level flesh and blood before. He had also seen an Eighth Tribulation creature’s arm. Therefore, when he saw the dark-red blood that pooled into a lake, he instantly determined that it was at the Eighth Tribulation realm.
A lake consisting of an Eighth Tribulation being’s blood was completely suppressed by the large seal.
“This is an Eternal treasure. I can’t approach it any further,” said the white-robed elder. “Even though it was Master who set up the array formation, the emissions from the seal’s power can still destroy everything within 100 feet.”
“It’s this powerful, even without an owner controlling it?” Meng Chuan carefully observed it.
“That is just the might of its natural emission,” said the white-robed elder. “When Master wielded it, he felt confident that he could match a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence.”
“Half-step Eighth Tribulation realm?” Meng Chuan was puzzled. “One that has made a breakthrough in laws, but has yet to undergo a physical breakthrough?
The white-robed elder nodded.
For Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences, it might be very difficult for them to comprehend the laws of time and space. However, it was equally difficult for their willpower to reach the Eighth Tribulation realm’s threshold.
It was the same for Physical Body Tribulation Eminences. Some may have comprehended the laws, but they couldn’t raise their bodies to the corresponding level. Such a situation placed them as half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences.
A half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence was extremely powerful. After all, they had a portion of an Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s strength. They could easily crush Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
“Ancestral Master Archean Eon could match a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence with this Eternal treasure?” Meng Chuan was secretly alarmed.
“You can give it a try,” said the white-robed elder with a smile. “The might of the treasure’s natural emissions isn’t something to be afraid of. I’m only a Guardian, so I can’t restrain it.”
“Okay.” Meng Chuan’s mind stirred.
The painting-like Essence Soul World appeared and enveloped the dark area—which was only 1,000 feet wide. It suppressed the large seal, forcing it to restrain its might. After all, it had no owner or energy source. Meng Chuan ultimately managed to suppress it, albeit barely.
A wisp of Power of Essence Soul seeped into the ancient gray seal.
The moment it infiltrated the Eternal treasure
–
Boom!
Meng Chuan could vaguely see a towering, blurry, and bald figure holding a gray seal. The gray seal revealed an unimaginable might. The area in front of him was immeasurably vast. It far exceeded the size of 100 river zones. Everything in the vast area was reduced to nothingness.
Meng Chuan vaguely understood that this was likely the mark left behind by the seal’s creator.
The bald, towering figure suddenly turned his head slightly and looked at Meng Chuan.
He saw me. Meng Chuan panicked. Meng Chuan found it impossible to gaze into the other party’s eyes directly, but he could clearly sense that the other party was looking at him.
Following that, the illusory figure completely dissipated.
The creator of an Eternal treasure is also an Eternal existence. That Eternal existence should still be alive. Therefore, I must have attracted his attention, even if I have only seen a sliver of his mark?
However, Meng Chuan then realized that the other party had only been looking at him casually. To a lofty Eternal existence, even an Eighth Tribulation Eminence was nothing, much less a Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
This situation was just like how a grain of rice —which had fallen to the ground-would be carried away by an ant in excitement. An Eternal existence was the existence that ate while Meng Chuan was just an ant carrying away the grain of rice.
Perhaps Eternal treasures are just casually refined by Eternal existences. To a true invincible existence with an Eternal lifespan, what is spending some time to refine a weapon?
When the creator wielded the seal, the destruction range was immensely vast... The area I could see at that moment should be from the Eternal existence’s perspective. The area it covered is probably more than half the River of Spacetime. Meng Chuan deduced that his estimate wouldn’t be that far off, even if there was a mistake.
The other party can probably destroy this universe’s entire River of Spacetime with a flip of his hand. So this is an Eternal existence?
Meng Chuan felt mixed emotions. In the past, he had thought that Eighth Tribulation Eminences were ridiculously powerful and unimaginably powerful. They could jump out of time and travel to the future or even other universes.
Seventh Tribulation Eminences were fish in the river. Eighth Tribulation Eminences were already pedestrians on the shore.
However, Meng Chuan now realized that an Eternal existence was a god above the shore. They could destroy rivers and perhaps create them. They were Eternal.
As for me, I’m currently only a small fish in the river. I was lucky enough to obtain a weapon that a god dropped into the river. This weapon was picked up by a big fish like Ancestral Master Archean Eon.
This seal... Meng Chuan’s Power of Essence Soul seeped into it.
The gray seal had run dry for a long time. It didn’t have a source of energy. Therefore, Meng Chuan’s Power of Essence Soul was rapidly absorbed the moment it seeped into the seal. Through this, Meng Chuan could see the gray seal’s true appearance. This is too... Meng Chuan was stunned.
Boundless laws.
He found the lightning law within them, but the lightning law was only one of the fine threads. The laws here were as vast as the sea. It was like a beautiful building had been built.
Meng Chuan sensed that it was a strange building with ten corners. The building was formed by countless laws, and it was filled with a destructive force.
I’ve finally seen an existence that can match the River of Spacetime’s laws. Meng Chuan was shocked.
The way the River of Spacetime operated was supreme. Heavenly Tribulations descended because of it.
The lifespans of various creatures, the size of inhabited worlds, the coldness and heat in the outer realm... All sorts of laws originated from it.
However, this gray seal was another structure composed of countless laws! It was different from the laws of spacetime. However, the two were on the same level. At the very least, they were equally vast and unbelievable from Meng Chuan’s vantage point.
The laws of spacetime were more balanced, while the gray seal was purely for destruction.
It’s too complicated. Just comprehending the lightning law is impossible to activate it at all. Meng Chuan was somewhat dazed.
It was as though he was a child reading a heavenly book. He was only lucky enough to recognize one of the words! He didn’t understand it at all once the words were strung together.
“Master said before,” the white-robed elder finally said, “that an Eternal treasure is paramount. To activate it... one has to grasp an Origins law at the very least. Only by using an Origins law can one barely drive it, allowing one to unleash some of its might. That might is enough to dominate all Seventh Tribulation Eminences and allow one to be comparable to a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
“Master instructed me that Archean Eon Realm juniors are forbidden from bringing this Eternal Treasure out of Archean Eon Realm before they reach the Eighth Tribulation realm. He also forbids them from telling anyone else.” The white-robed elder looked at Meng Chuan. “Only by accepting this condition can you receive the gift from Ancestral Master.”
“I accept,” said Meng Chuan without hesitation.
“Okay.” The white-robed elder nodded. “It’s good that you can understand. Master also said that not only will the experts discover the Eternal treasure once it is exposed, but even Eighth Tribulation Eminences will probably be able to discover its existence and come to this spacetime to vie for the Eternal treasure. Don’t think that hiding it in an inhabited world will be useful. An inhabited world can also be destroyed.”
“I understand.” Meng Chuan had seen the remnant imprints in the gray seal. He knew very well that the entire universe was probably not mentioning in front of an Eternal existence.
A middle-level world? Meng Chuan knew that a Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature could feed on middle-level worlds.
Therefore, if Eighth Tribulation Eminences were to discover any traces of an Eternal treasure, they would travel across spacetime and arrive at this era. Archean Eon Realm wouldn’t be able to stop them at all. One could only protect the secret by doing what Ancestral Master Archean Eon did not telling anyone else. He went as far as hiding in the inhabited world and refrained from taking it out. Since an Eternal treasure was beyond time, it could remain safe.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon had only left this secret to his descendants before he died. Furthermore, one had to reach the Sixth Tribulation realm and have enough potential before they had the right to come into contact with the Eternal treasure. “Master said that ordinary Tribulation Eminences could comprehend the operation of spacetime,” said the white-robed elder. “After obtaining an Eternal treasure, apart from comprehending the operation of spacetime, one can also comprehend the countless laws within the seal. Comparing the two structures will be very beneficial to one’s cultivation.”
Meng Chuan nodded and acknowledged this point. Of course, the seal was like a heavenly book to him-incomprehensible.
“There’s also the lake of blood.” The white-robed elder pointed at the lake of blood. “When Master obtained the seal by chance, the seal was enveloped by this blood. The will within the blood has completely dissipated. The original owner of the blood has clearly died. This is the blood of an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. Since it involves an Eternal treasure, you can’t bring it out of Archean Eon Realm either. You can only study this blood’s mysteries in Archean Eon Realm.”

chapters.title: Chapter 637 - Total Treasure Value
chapters.content:
Chapter 637 Total Treasure Value
This seal was originally wrapped in all this blood? Many thoughts surfaced in Meng Chuan’s mind. The blood’s owner was an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, but they have actually died?
Was it because of this Eternal treasure? Or was it because the Eternal treasure was the Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s weapon? Did they ultimately die in battle after fighting against their enemies?
An Eighth Tribulation Eminence who can jump out of the timeline and live in different periods of time can even head to other universes. To think they died just like that. Furthermore, they clearly didn’t die of old age.
Meng Chuan sighed. Of course, this was a very distant matter for him. He carefully examined the dark-red blood that resembled a small lake.
The Eighth Tribulation Eminence arm that Ancestral Master Archean Eon had openly left made one feel like it was the end of everything
—the end of spacetime, and the end to all kinds of energy. It also made the coldness reach an extreme. At the same time, it was the beginning of everything—the birth of a world. However, it ended the moment it was born. This blood is completely different from that arm. Meng Chuan realized this immediately. The blood was clearly in front of him. However, Meng Chuan could instantly magnify a drop of blood by hundreds of millions of times with his naked eye. When the drops of blood were magnified to the size of a mountain, one would discover that every drop of blood seemed to both exist and not exist at the same time upon closer inspection. It was as though it possessed two statesexistence and non-existence.
It was like a painting. From one angle, it might look like something. However, it looked completely different from another angle.
At Meng Chuan’s realm, he could examine the blood on several different levels with his naked eye. When he magnified the blood to a certain extent, he realized that the blood had two states.
Such a situation prevents the blood from being destroyed because it doesn’t exist. However, it can kill enemies because it exists.
e
Meng Chuan’s heart palpitated.
An incomprehensible situation had occurred. It could only be said that it far exceeded what Meng Chuan could comprehend at his current realm. From this blood, he could tell how terrifying an Eighth Tribulation Eminence was. The difference is ultimately too great before I reach the Eighth Tribulation realm. There’s still the Seventh Tribulation realm separating me from it.
The only Seventh Tribulation Eminence Meng Chuan had come into close contact with was Realm Ancestor. In front of Realm Ancestor, Meng Chuan couldn’t fight back at all. Back when he was cultivating in a chamber on Thousand Mountain Star, Realm Ancestor had easily ‘fished’ out Meng Chuan across distant spacetime.
Unfortunately, be it that arm or this blood, they’re useless to me right now. Meng Chuan shook his head slightly. This is because I haven’t comprehended the Chaos Hole law. The Chaos Hole law was one of the Origins laws. One could rely on it to reach the Seventh Tribulation realm.
Meng Chuan had cultivated in Chaos Holes for many years. Many of his insights were a part of the Chaos Hole law. Furthermore, he was the most familiar with Chaos Holes. He analyzed it from his best vantage point. Therefore, his goal was the Chaos Hole law since he wanted to reach the Seventh Tribulation realm.
The Eighth Tribulation arm and the blood lake in front of me contain more than one Origins law. If I can reach the Seventh Tribulation realm, these two items will be of help to me. As for now? I don’t need to spend too much effort on them. Meng Chuan understood this point.
“Meng Chuan, let’s go and see Master’s other treasures,” said the white-robed elder with a smile. “The Eternal treasure and this blood must be kept a secret. However, other treasures can be brought out.”
“Can I leave my Essence Soul avatar here?” asked Meng Chuan. “Of course.” The white-robed elder nodded and said, “From today onwards, Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures will be under your control. Apart from these two treasures, you can choose half of the other treasures.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
Whoosh!
An Essence Soul avatar flew out from his body and landed at the side. The Essence Soul avatar immediately walked to a corner and sat cross-legged, carefully studying the large seal.
The seal was esoteric and profound. However, the Great Seal was an existence on the same level as the laws of spacetime. Comprehending the Great Seal was like comprehending another spacetime law.
Compared to other Tribulation Eminences, the advantage of having an Eternal treasure was that one could comprehend two spacetime laws at the same time. Furthermore, their inherent qualities were different.
The white-robed elder continued to show Meng Chuan’s true body around the vaults, causing Meng Chuan to sigh in amazement.
Ancestral Master is truly impressive. He walked out of a low-level world as a weak Supremacy and relied on himself to reach the Seventh Tribulation realm. His wealth has also benefited the entire Archean Eon Realm.
Meng Chuan was extremely impressed because these treasures were all-encompassing.
Eighth Tribulation treasures were only a small portion of them. Ancestral Master Archean Eon also had many rare treasures and rare herbs that were difficult to find in the outside world. They were carefully stored by Ancestral Master Archean Eon. The treasures he chose could be stored for a long time.
“These are all of Master’s treasures.” The white-robed elder looked at Meng Chuan. “You’ve seen them all. Apart from the Eternal treasure and the blood lake, all the other treasures are worth about 60 million to 90 million cubes altogether. In fact, many of the treasures here are very rare. They can only be exchanged as part of barters. Therefore, there’s no way to determine their exact value. If you sell them now, one treasure might be able to fetch up to 500,000 cubes. However, one treasure could also be sold for 800,000 cubes another time.”
Meng Chuan also understood this. If he encountered something he desperately needed, he would rather spend more to buy it. Therefore, it was normal for the total value of the treasures to be set at 60 million cubes to 90 million cubes.
“Master has set low prices for all the treasures that are to be given to his descendants,” said the white-robed elder. “At the lowest prices, the treasures are worth 60 million cubes altogether. You can choose any of the treasures as long as you don’t exceed the 30-million-cube quota. This is also Ancestral Master’s final gift to you...
