In the future, the remaining treasures belong to other juniors, no matter how far you go or how powerful you become.”
re
Giving half of his treasures to a particular junior was Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s limit.
“Ancestral Master has already given me too much,” said Meng Chuan with a sigh. He was very impressed with Ancestral Master Archean Eon. Although the Ancestral Master had given Meng Chuan half his treasures, Meng Chuan decided to limit how much he would take. Furthermore, Meng Chuan would make up for it in the future! He might even add even more to the treasure vault, allowing Archean Eon Realm to accumulate even more valuable things.
“Master has also asked me to remind you about one thing: confirm your strength in your respective faction as soon as possible after reaching the Sixth Tribulation realm,” said the white-robed elder.
Meng Chuan nodded.
This was common knowledge. Once one transcended the tribulation, they would confirm it as soon as possible. When Meng Chuan’s status in Eternal Tower was greatly elevated, he would learn the many secrets that Sixth Tribulation Eminences knew.
The secrets of every era were different. The intelligence left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon was outdated since more than a million years had passed.
The black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan left Archean Eon Realm and went to Thousand Mountain Star. This was only an Essence Soul avatar. Meng Chuan felt that an Essence Soul avatar was enough to guard Thousand Mountain Star.
“Thousand Mountain Star.” Meng Chuan appeared high above Thousand Mountain Star and looked down at Eastcalm City. After transcending the tribulation, he felt different when he looked at Eastcalm City again.
“City Lord.” Cave Lord Scenic Cloud flew over from afar.
“Scenic Cloud.” Meng Chuan looked at him and smiled as he instructed, “Forget about the matter requiring you to watch the Demon Realm.”
Cave Lord Scenic Cloud was taken aback before he understood. He asked with some guesses, “City Lord, you.. you have successfully transcended the tribulation?”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Yes.”
Cave Lord Scenic Cloud was shocked and felt mixed emotions. He couldn’t help but sigh. “My Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake race is scattered across the River of Spacetime. However, no Sixth Tribulation Eminence has been born in this era. Us special lifeforms rely on our talent and strength. However, once we get used to our talent, it becomes very difficult for us to break through the limits of our talent.”
Meng Chuan could understand. As long as special lifeforms matured, all sorts of insights would naturally enter their minds even when they were sleeping. These powerful special lifeforms grew in strength very easily. With just a little effort, they would have combat strength comparable to a Third Tribulation Eminence when they reached maturity. After they used all their bloodline’s benefits, these special lifeforms had to rely on themselves to gain insights. It was also more difficult for them to cultivate than the Tribulation Eminences who had cultivated step by step.
For example, pure-blooded dragons had terrifying talent. Yet, there wasn’t a single Seventh Tribulation Eminence in this era.
“City Lord, may I ask how you comprehended the Sixth Tribulation law?” Cave Lord Scenic Cloud looked at Meng Chuan. “Can you give me some pointers? I’ve been stuck at this step for a very long time.”
“There’s no way to teach you that.” Meng Chuan smiled at him. “Otherwise, there wouldn’t be so few Sixth Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime. I can only say that... you should ponder, think, and comprehend more.” With that said, Meng Chuan flew towards Eternal Tower.
Cave Lord Scenic Cloud stood rooted to the ground and muttered to himself, “Ponder more? Think? Comprehend?”
On the ninth floor of Thousand Mountain Star’s Eternal Tower.
Meng Chuan appeared in the hall. He immediately sent a message through the branch. With the Eternal Tower headquarters in Goddess River Zone as the transmission point, his message reached Eternal Tower’s headquarters in the River of Spacetime.
“Three Bay River System’s Eastcalm has already transcended the tribulation and become an Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence.” After Meng Chuan reported the news, he only needed to wait for Eternal Tower’s headquarters to confirm it.

chapters.title: Chapter 638 - Starlord Scarlet Snake and Meng Chuan
chapters.content:
Chapter 638 Starlord Scarlet Snake and Meng Chuan
After reporting the news, Meng Chuan checked Eternal Tower’s treasure vault to see if there was anything suitable for him.
Meng Chuan was slightly taken aback. “Eternal Tower responded so quickly?”
It took just 30 seconds.
“City Lord Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, please teleport to the nearby Eternal Tower River Zone headquarters.” The response was very simple. As a Sixth Tribulation Eminence, Meng Chuan was considered a core force in the River of Spacetime. He had the right to head to Eternal Tower’s headquarters in the River of Spacetime.
I haven’t been to Eternal Tower’s River of Spacetime headquarters before. Meng Chuan was rather curious. After all, Fifth Tribulation Eminences weren’t qualified to go there. He heard that Seventh Tribulation Eminences had been presiding over it for a long time. He also heard that Eternal Tower’s infinite number of treasures were hidden there.
That day, Meng Chuan’s outer realm true body rushed to Scarlet Snake Planet through the River of Spacetime.
Scarlet Snake Planet was Eternal Tower’s headquarters in Goddess River Zone.
The massive Scarlet Snake Planet was as prosperous as ever. Similarly, there were layers of array formations protecting it. Ordinary cultivators wouldn’t cause any commotion when they entered or exited the planet. However, the array formation immediately sensed Meng Chuan when he arrived.
Immediately, an acquaintance came forward.
“What a rare occasion to have Brother Eastcalm come to my Scarlet Snake Planet personally,” said Chi Jiuxin with a chuckle as he flew over.
It was indeed very rare. This was because transactions could be done through Eastcalm City’s Eternal Tower branch. Chi Jiuxin originally thought that probably more than 10,000 years would pass before he could meet Meng Chuan again. Who knew that they would meet again so quickly?
“I came because I have something important to do,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“Something important?” Chi Jiuxin was puzzled. “Brother Eastcalm, feel free to ask if there’s anything I can help you with.”
“I want to use the Eternal Tower on Scarlet Snake Planet to head to Eternal Tower’s headquarters in the River of Spacetime,” said Meng Chuan directly. This was because he had obtained the River Zone-level commander’s approval.
“Head to the headquarters in the River of Spacetime?” Chi Jiuxin was slightly stunned. “Y-you...”
“Jiuxin, why are you still in a daze?” A thin elder appeared. His body was thin, and his face was wrinkled. He looked old, and his eyes were cold. At that moment, he looked at Meng Chuan with a rare smile.
“Patriarch.” Chi Jiuxin immediately bowed respectfully.
This person was Starlord Scarlet Snake, the only Sixth Tribulation Eminence in the River of Spacetime’s Scarlet Snake race.
The thin elder smiled as he observed Meng Chuan. “It’s no wonder Jiuxin couldn’t tell that Brother Eastcalm has reached the Sixth Tribulation realm.”
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul was hidden in his sea of consciousness. As long as he restrained his aura, it was indeed difficult for others to sense his changes.
At the Physical Body Sixth Tribulation realm, one’s body was exposed to the outside world. They could easily sense the difference in one’s natural order in life.
“Starlord, you are wise,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“Including you, there are nine Sixth Tribulation Eminences in our Goddess River Zone,” said the thin elder with a smile. “Among them, there are three Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminences. They take up a third of the total. It’s considered a high ratio.”
Meng Chuan understood what Starlord Scarlet Snake meant. Of all the Sixth Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime, 20% were Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences, while nearly 80% were Physical Body Tribulation Eminences.
“It’s a joyous occasion to have a newly-advanced Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence in my homeworld’s river zone. Come, come. Be my guest. I know you are going to the headquarters in the River of Spacetime to test your strength, but half a day isn’t much of a delay.” Starlord Scarlet Snake was rather enthusiastic.
“As you say, Starlord,” replied Meng Chuan with a smile. He was very calm.
Chi Jiuxin followed by the side, still somewhat dazed. Brother Eastcalm has reached the Sixth Tribulation realm? He’s that fast?
He had no idea about it. Although there was news of Meng Chuan breaking through to the Sixth Tribulation realm in the Cang Alliance space, it hadn’t been completely confirmed. Secondly, the Cang Alliance space was a very small and private circle.
Meng Chuan and Starlord Scarlet Snake sat cross-legged in front of a spread containing delicacies and fine wine. They chatted as they drank and ate.
“Having cultivated our entire lives, the only thing we can’t let up on is eating and drinking.” Starlord Scarlet Snake happily took a sip of the emerald-like wine and said, “Eating top-notch delicacies and drinking rare fine wine can make us feel joy from the bottom of our hearts. Since I’m approaching the end of my lifespan, I feel like I should enjoy good food and wine before I die.”
Meng Chuan nodded in agreement. He could understand what the other party was getting at.
“I’ve worried about my race my entire life. Since my chances of reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm are getting slimmer, I should treat myself better.” Starlord Scarlet Snake smiled at Meng Chuan. “It’s rare to see a new Sixth Tribulation Eminence in my homeworld’s river zone. If you don’t mind me being nosy, I’ll say a few words.”
“Starlord, please speak.” Meng Chuan poured wine for the other party, as well as for himself.
Starlord Scarlet Snake looked at Meng Chuan with the cup of wine in hand. “After reaching the Sixth Tribulation realm, the first major thing one has to do is join a certain faction.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. He didn’t know much about the current top factions in the River of Spacetime.
“Any Seventh Tribulation Eminence can form their own faction,” said Starlord Scarlet Snake. “They have no need to bow their heads to other experts. However, there are ultimately differences between Seventh Tribulation Eminences. For example, in this era, the two most dazzling existences in the entire River of Spacetime are the two strongest and most impressive existences.”
“Which two?” asked Meng Chuan. Although he had collected information on Seventh Tribulation Eminences, he had still been at the Fifth Tribulation realm back then. The information he could gather was too crude.
Starlord Scarlet Snake was slightly taken aback as he smiled. “That’s true. You just broke through, so you aren’t too sure. The most dazzling figures in this era are naturally Celestial Thearch Myriad Star and Hall Lord White Avian. They have grasped the laws of time and space. They are existences that have one foot into the Eighth Tribulation realm.”
Meng Chuan understood.
These two were at the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm! Their nomological insights were sufficient, but their bodies and Essence Souls had yet to break through to the Eighth Tribulation realm.
“The two of them are the most impressive figures in this era. With each of them as a core, they form the two strongest factions in the present era,” said Starlord Scarlet Snake with a smile. “I’m not saying this to persuade you to join these two factions. These two factions have as many experts as the clouds. They have several Seventh Tribulation Eminences and several half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences. As an ordinary Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence, you won’t turn heads, even if you join them.”
Meng Chuan nodded. There weren’t many Sixth Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime. However, according to his understanding, there should be tens of thousands of them. He was only one among tens of thousands, and he had just broken through. Although there were very few Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime, there were probably nearly 10,000 of them.
“You are nothing amazing among the two factions,” said Starlord Scarlet Snake. “However, it’s different for the other Seventh Tribulation Eminences. They have few experts under them. You will be valued more if you join them. You will also gain more benefits. We are fated to be together, so I won’t harm you. The faction I recommend you to join is Centaurea Manor.”
“Manor Lord Centaurea?” Meng Chuan knew that the leader of this faction was also at the Seventh Tribulation realm. However, he didn’t know much about him.
“I’m a subordinate of Manor Lord Centaurea. He is very kind to his subordinates. I followed him when I was still at the Fifth Tribulation realm. Back then, he was still at the Sixth Tribulation realm,” said Starlord Scarlet Snake as he reminisced.
“Manor Lord Centaurea is extremely talented and impressive. Now that he’s a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, he likes to befriend everyone. When Celestial Thearch Myriad Star and Hall Lord White Avian were still insignificant, Manor Lord Centaurea had greatly helped the two of them. Actually, it’s not just the two of them. Nearly ten of the current Seventh Tribulation Eminences have received Manor Lord Centaurea’s help.”
Meng Chuan was shocked.
Greatly helped them? Such words couldn’t be spoken without evidence. After all, it involved the two most powerful existences in this era.
A great favor meant karma. The two of them had to consider Centaurea Manor Lord’s stance in any matter.
If one didn’t repay a favor and even resorted to underhanded means, it would result in great karma. To two existences who had the ambition of reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm, they definitely wouldn’t do such a thing. Therefore, Centaurea Manor was indeed a very safe faction.
“Manor Lord is very impressive,” said Starlord Scarlet Snake. “If you join his faction, your future will be very smooth. If you join another faction, I’m afraid you’ll be embroiled in plenty of trouble since they have many enemy factions.”
“Understood.” Meng Chuan smiled and nodded. “Thank you for your guidance, Starlord. I’ll carefully digest this information before making a decision.”
Joining a faction had far-reaching implications. Hence, Meng Chuan had to be cautious.
“You do have to consider it carefully,” said Starlord Scarlet Snake solemnly. “However, I’ll say a few more words. Don’t join Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s faction.”
“Why?” Meng Chuan looked at him.
“It can’t be said. You can take your time to understand why.” Starlord Scarlet Snake shook his head slightly, not daring to say too much.
He chatted with Meng Chuan for half a day.
Half a day later, on the ninth floor of Scarlet Snake Planet’s Eternal Tower.
“Starlord, I’ll take my leave first.” Meng Chuan stood at the teleportation array disc.
“The headquarters in the River of Spacetime is quite interesting. You should stay there for a few more days,” said Starlord Scarlet Snake with a smile.
Meng Chuan nodded. Through the spacetime fluctuations, he felt spacetime rapidly change.
Whoosh.
After everything stabilized, Meng Chuan found himself standing in the cosmos. In front of him were stars.
Tens of thousands of massive stars surrounded the towering nine-story Eternal Tower in the middle. The Eternal Tower emitted colorful light that illuminated the surroundings. I’m here. Meng Chuan could sense several auras in front of him, each one of them causing his heart to palpitate.

chapters.title: Chapter 639 - Eternal Tower’s River of Spacetime Headquarters
chapters.content:
Chapter 639 Eternal Tower’s River of Spacetime Headquarters
The towering Eternal Tower stood in the void, releasing colorful light that illuminated all the layers of spacetime. The area it illuminated formed a world that was isolated from the outside world. Without Eternal Tower’s permission, even a Seventh Tribulation Eminence wouldn’t be able to find Eternal Tower’s headquarters in the River of Spacetime.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan saw colorful light spread out in the void. An illusory, huge eye then appeared out of thin air. Its golden iris stared at Meng Chuan.
“Greetings, Eye of Eternal,” said Meng Chuan with a bow.
In Eternal Tower, the Eye of Eternal held the highest authority. The eye was calm, not showing any hint of emotion. It had experienced too many things over the years, so it was very difficult for anything to shock it.
The Eye of Eternal could determine Meng Chuan’s strength by observing him from a close distance.
“Archean Eon Realm’s City Lord Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, cultivated for 2,622 years. It’s considered rare for someone to reach the Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation realm at such a young age. I’m looking forward to your Archean Eon Realm producing another Seventh Tribulation Eminence,” said the Eye of Eternal as it stared at Meng Chuan.
“I’m also looking forward to that day.” Meng Chuan didn’t hold back. After becoming a Sixth Tribulation Eminence, his next goal was to reach the Seventh Tribulation realm!
“Take out your identity token,” said the Eye of Eternal.
With a flip of his hand, a golden token appeared in Meng Chuan’s palm. The Eye of Eternal’s gaze landed on the token, and the golden token naturally changed. More golden lines fused with the token, causing it to turn darker. The token had already been upgraded.
“With this token, you can contact the headquarters in the River of Spacetime at any time,” said the Eye of Eternal. “You can also contact other Sixth and Seventh Tribulation Eminences.”
Meng Chuan nodded. Now that his status had been elevated, he could be considered one of Eternal Tower’s backbones—a core member. Of course, he was still far from reaching the upper echelons. Only a Seventh Tribulation Eminence could become a high-ranking member of Eternal Tower. In front of the Eye of Eternal, a tokensaturated by starlight-appeared out of thin air and flew towards Meng Chuan.
“This is a Nebula Token. With a Nebula Token, one can send a wisp of their will into the Nebula Palace,” continued the Eye of Eternal. “Almost all Sixth Tribulation Eminences have a Nebula Token.”
Meng Chuan revealed an expectant look as he received the Nebula Token. He had long learned of Nebula Palace’s existence from the dossiers left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon.
When it came to organizations, Nebula Palace was ranked first in the River of Spacetime! Almost all Sixth and Seventh Tribulation Eminences were members of Nebula Palace. The reason why they could accommodate all factions was that Nebula Palace existed to allow powerful Tribulation Eminences to communicate better.
In Nebula Palace, one could condense a body with a thought. The body would be completely identical to the real body. Therefore, one could unleash all their strength in Nebula Palace.
Powerful Tribulation Eminences gathered, preached, and competed in Nebula Palace. Some factions even held negotiations in Nebula Palace.
Nebula Palace and Eternal Tower exist to allow powerful Tribulation Eminences to interact and to allow them to engage in fair transactions, respectively. Meng Chuan felt somewhat wistful. Some factions still opposed Eternal Tower’s fair transactions. For example, the factions like Black Fiend Hall believed in the law of the jungle and liked to plunder the weak.
How difficult was it to hunt for treasures? How fast was it to kill and plunder? Therefore, Black Fiend Hall was at odds with Eternal Tower.
However, no organization would oppose Nebula Palace. Hence, Nebula Palace was indeed the largest faction. It included almost all Sixth and Seventh Tribulation Eminences. Of course, there were those who were so reclusive that they didn’t even want to join Nebula Palace.
According to Ancestral Master’s records, these two organizations should have been created by an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. After Meng Chuan successfully transcended the tribulation, he could read all the dossiers left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon. Therefore, he knew very well that this River of Spacetime had never produced an Eternal existence. Eternal Tower, Nebula Palace, and Fiend Mountain’s founder were all Eighth Tribulation Eminences.
Eighth Tribulation Eminences were all mysterious and unfathomable. For example, the owner of Fiend Mountain had once caused a huge calamity. Large batches of cultivators flooded Fiend Mountain only to have tragic outcomes.
Whoosh.
After Meng Chuan obtained the Nebula Token, he was teleported to a small planet at the periphery.
A dense array of stars surrounded the towering Eternal Tower. The closer one was to the edge, the smaller the stars became. Meng Chuan’s planet only spanned thousands of kilometers.
“This is your cave abode. As long as you are alive, it will belong to you. You can stay here forever. If you want to leave, you can teleport away at any time.” The Eye of Eternal’s voice echoed in Meng Chuan’s ears.
Meng Chuan had already landed on the small planet. There were no flowers or trees on the small, bare planet. There were only dark-brown rocks.
There was only one building on the stone planet-a cave abode that spanned about five kilometers.
This is my cave abode at Eternal Tower’s headquarters in the River of Spacetime? Meng Chuan looked up and saw many planets in the distance. The auras of a few stars were very terrifying. Some of the planets were close to the Eternal Tower, while others were at the periphery. A Seventh Tribulation Eminence lives in there?
Through his identity token, Meng Chuan could investigate the owners of every planet.
Meng Chuan visited his cave abode first.
The cave abode occupied an area of about five square kilometers. The scenery in the cave abode wasn’t bad. It had all the necessities. There was a small two-kilometer-wide lake within the cave abode’s courtyard, and special creatures dwelled in the lake. I’ll take a look at the intelligence on the various factions first. Meng Chuan leisurely sat in front of the lake and flipped his hand to take out a fruit. He ate it as he read.
With his elevated status, Meng Chuan now had access to much more intelligence through Eternal Tower. Information about the various factions was provided for free.
If he required very detailed information, he naturally had to pay Outer Realm Essence Crystals for it.
Tsk, tsk, tsk. They are all terrifying existences. Meng Chuan read the introductions of the various factions.
Although they were from various factions, the information mainly talked about the leaders of the factions. These leaders were all Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
“Palace Lady Blood Phoenix.” Meng Chuan read the introduction of a female Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
Palace Lady Blood Phoenix was a cultivator who came from a middle-level world. She had a partial phoenix bloodline, and the entire phoenix race tried their best to befriend her. However, Palace Lady Blood Phoenix was rather reclusive and didn’t like to be involved in trouble.
Her Blood Phoenix Palace was built on an Outer Realm Essence Crystal Planet.
This planet was composed of Outer Realm Essence Crystals. It could be said to be the most precious Outer Realm Essence Crystal mine in the entire River of Spacetime. According to legend, this planet was one of the nodes in the River of Spacetime’s operation system. An expert had speculated that it contained about 3% of the Outer Realm Essence Crystals in the River of Spacetime.
The planet was too special. It was affected by the River of Spacetime’s operations, preventing it from being relocated. Furthermore, there were restrictions on mining. One could only mine the Essence Crystals on the surface. However, this planet constantly gathered outer realm essence energy from the River of Spacetime and constantly condensed Outer Realm Essence Crystals. Therefore, it provided an endless supply of ores.
With this mine, Palace Lady Blood Phoenix’s wealth alone could be ranked in the River of Spacetime’s top ten, even though she didn’t participate in any faction battles.
Of course, many people coveted this planet. However, Palace Lady Blood Phoenix was ranked among the strongest Seventh Tribulation Eminences. She had set up layers of array formations. It was said that she had set up 13 Eighth Tribulation array formations. Even if a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence personally took action, it would be difficult to gain an advantage in her lair.
Impressive. Meng Chuan sighed in amazement. The current Seventh Tribulation Eminences are all extraordinary, but they are also very prideful. After all, none of them can kill the other party completely, so they naturally had fewer concerns.
They had no qualms about competing with each other. To compete for resources, many Seventh Tribulation Eminences have completely fallen out with each other, such as Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
Every one of them is impressive. The most dazzling ones are these two. Meng Chuan carefully read their intelligence reports.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had cultivated for 11,000 years before becoming a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. He had reached the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm at the 53,000-year mark. Now that his technique realm had reached the corresponding level, he only needed to forge an Eighth Tribulation body. Hall Lord White Avian reached the Seventh Tribulation realm after cultivating for 6,000 years. He reached the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm in about 30,000 years. Similarly, he only needed to forge an Eighth Tribulation body, which was his last obstacle.
These two were astonishingly talented and dazzling.
Their talent is terrifying. Meng Chuan was somewhat shocked when he read the intelligence on the two.
“Brother Eastcalm.” A voice sounded from outside the cave abode. A lanky man appeared in the void.
A guest? Meng Chuan looked up from the lake.

chapters.title: Chapter 640 - Valley of Spacetime
chapters.content:
Chapter 640 Valley of Spacetime
The lanky man smiled as he landed in front of Meng Chuan’s cave abode.
The cave abode’s entrance silently opened. The white-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan took the initiative to welcome him.
“Brother Eastcalm, do you know me?” asked the lanky man with a smile.
“I’ve long heard of your famous name, Xiao Jiuqu. Brother Xiao, please come in.” Meng Chuan smiled as he turned to the side. He had long gathered intelligence on Sixth Tribulation Eminences.
After breaking through, Eternal Tower had provided Meng Chuan with basic intelligence on all Sixth Tribulation Eminences. Meng Chuan knew about Xiao Jiuqu very early because he was a good friend of Starlord Scarlet Snake. Any intelligence that involved Starlord Scarlet Snake would mention Xiao Jiuqu. Likewise, any intelligence on Xiao Jiuqu would definitely mention Starlord Scarlet Snake.
Meng Chuan and Xiao Jiuqu walked into the cave abode together. In front of the cave abode’s lake were a table, chairs, fine wine, and some fruits. Meng Chuan had clearly prepared them beforehand to welcome the guest.
“Oh.” Xiao Jiuqu’s nose twitched. “Good wine.”
“Try it.” Meng Chuan sat down and poured some wine for the man. Xiao Jiuqu sat down and looked at the wine in front of him. He then said, “You can probably guess why I’m here. I’m here to invite you on behalf of Centaurea Manor. You know how crazy the conflicts in the River of Spacetime are. If one doesn’t join a faction, a Sixth Tribulation Eminence alone won’t have the right to vie for the top treasures. Centaurea Manor is a faction that has the least troubles. If you don’t want to be involved in trouble, joining Centaurea Manor will be a good choice.”
“I only learned about it today.” Meng Chuan nodded as he recalled the large amount of intelligence he had read. “The conflicts are indeed crazy.”
After reaching the Sixth Tribulation realm, any Eminence that came from an inhabited world could be said to be immortal.
Perhaps they would be afraid of Seventh Tribulation Eminences-afraid that they would anger one and end up being pursued. Once they appeared in the outer realm, they would be attacked. Therefore, they acted more respectful towards Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
However, if two people were both at the Sixth Tribulation realm, what was there to be afraid of? They naturally would use any means necessary to obtain the much-needed cultivation resources.
“Choosing Centaurea Manor will result in the least trouble, but plenty of resources will be open to you.” Xiao Jiuqu drank his wine. “Brother Eastcalm, think about it.”
“If I choose Centaurea Manor, will I be able to go to the Valley of Spacetime?” asked Meng Chuan.
“Valley of Spacetime?” Xiao Jiuqu looked at Meng Chuan in surprise before saying, “You should know how special the Valley of Spacetime is. I can’t give you a certain answer. A request needs to be made to the higher-ups.”
“Alright.” Meng Chuan smiled and nodded.
Xiao Jiuqu stayed for a moment before leaving.
Whoosh.
After flying off the planet, Xiao Jiuqu shot a glance at the cave abode on the tiny, bare planet. He frowned inwardly. Why doesn’t this Meng Chuan know how to appreciate favors? A newly-advanced Sixth Tribulation Eminence actually dares to request to enter the Valley of Spacetime? However, since he’s recommended by Scarlet Snake, I can’t reject him too directly. I’ll delay it for a few days before rejecting his request.
He had never thought of putting up a request to his higher-ups.
Meng Chuan had only said it casually. He didn’t believe that Centaurea Manor would agree.
Meng Chuan had a strong desire to go to the Valley of Spacetime.
To reach the Seventh Tribulation realm, his most promising goal was the Chaos Hole lawone of the Origins laws. As for comprehending the Chaos Hole law, one had to comprehend a complete spatial law first.
Although he could buy the Void Catalog’s other two volumes from Eternal Tower, it was still very difficult for him to comprehend a complete spatial law through it. After all, spatial laws represented the strongest Sixth Tribulation laws. They were stronger than two or three other types of Sixth Tribulation laws combined. Spatial laws also represented a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence’s strength.
Although Meng Chuan was confident, he knew the difficulty of comprehending spatial laws. He naturally wanted external aid. The number one treasure that aided one’s cultivation in the void lineage was the Void Trileaf Flower. Only the Valley of Spacetime produced Void Trileaf Flowers. The flowers appeared irregularly, and they would completely wither after a day had passed since they were born. Therefore, Void Trileaf Flowers had to be consumed within a day. After consuming a Void Trileaf Flower, one would become space’s most favored. One could even control space instinctively. This state would last for several years. During these few years, one’s efficiency in comprehending spatial laws would be astonishingly high. The Void Trileaf Flower was much more beneficial to one’s comprehension of spatial laws than the second-best treasure. Therefore, it caused many parties to fight over it.
The Void Trileaf Flower is a specialty of the Valley of Spacetime. If I want to obtain the Void Trileaf Flower, I have to enter the Valley of Spacetime first.
“City Lord Eastcalm, our Blood Phoenix Palace wishes to extend an invitation to you.”
“Brother Eastcalm, are you interested in joining our Yellow-Robed Academy?”
Following that, several Sixth Tribulation Eminences contacted Meng Chuan through Eternal Tower. After all, many factions were lacking in manpower. Having greater numbers gave a faction an advantage. In the competition for resources in the River of Spacetime, the various factions hoped to have more experts on their side.
Meng Chuan was also an Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence. He had many Essence Soul avatars, making him much more useful than a Physical Body Sixth Tribulation Eminence. Therefore, even the relatively arrogant Blood Phoenix Palace and other factions took the initiative to invite him.
Meng Chuan also asked what he was expected to do and what he could obtain after joining the factions.
All parties had to compete. In fact, the fact that Meng Chuan had reached the Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation realm in 2,600 years had not been exposed. If this information was known to all, Meng Chuan would probably see a sharp increase in the number of warm invitations. The benefits they offered him would also increase significantly. However, Meng Chuan didn’t wish to expose this.
The ones who knew how long he had cultivated included the Eye of Eternal. It was the most impartial Eternal Tower administrator and wouldn’t be biased towards any faction. The other was Realm Ancestor-one of the oldest Seventh Tribulation Eminence in the universe. Hence, he naturally wouldn’t divulge anything.
As it was very difficult to kill them, the top experts in the River of Spacetime did not dare to do anything
Many Seventh Tribulation Eminences had completely fallen out with the two half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences—Celestial Thearch Myriad Star and Hall Lord White Avian. From this, it could be seen how terrible the conflicts were.
If Meng Chuan’s talent was exposed, he would encounter all sorts of trouble more often, even though the invitations from factions would greatly increase in number. Even top Eminences would be jealous of his talent. It would be very normal for them to destroy Meng Chuan’s opportunities deliberately. For example, it would be normal for them to join forces and beat Meng Chuan to the punch when vying for the Void Trileaf Flowers in the Valley of Spacetime.
Wind damaged the flourishing trees in the forest; people found fault with the capable.
After all, Meng Chuan had just advanced to the Sixth Tribulation realm. He had only grasped one lightning law. His strength was considered ordinary among Sixth Tribulation Eminences. Hence, it was best to keep a low profile.
If he grasped a complete spatial law one day, he would have a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence’s strength. He would even be able to fight a half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence. At that time, it wouldn’t matter if he showed off his prowess.
If he wanted to show off his prowess, he had to have the ability to do so. Currently, it was better for him to keep a low profile.
“Brother Eastcalm, in terms of strength, our Ancestral Magus Realm is second only to White Avian Hall and Six Directions Heaven,” said a purple-robed man warmly. He had gray scales on his head and two small snakes wrapped around his ears. “In terms of physical body cultivation, our Ancestral Magus Realm is ranked first. We have also collected quite a number of Essence Soul cultivation techniques.”
“Brother Zuo, I naturally know about the Ancestral Magus Realm’s fame.” Meng Chuan nodded.
Six Directions Heaven was the faction established by Celestial Thearch Myriad Star. White Avian Hall was naturally established by Hall Lord White Avian.
These era’s two most dazzling existences were considered relatively young among the current Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
Before they rose to prominence...
The strongest Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminences were led by Ancestral Magus King, an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
Ancestral Magus King had obtained an Eternal legacy, the Magus lineage, and established Ancestral Magus Realm. His physical body was the strongest among Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminences. However, after Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star rose to prominence, he was overshadowed. After all, the two of them were half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences.
“I’m very interested in the Valley of Spacetime.” Meng Chuan looked at the other party. “I wonder if there’s any hope of entering? I heard that Ancestral Magus Realm occupies quite a large territory.”
After all, the Ancestral Magus Realm was the strongest faction in the past. They had a first-move advantage, allowing them to occupy a large territory.
Six Directions Heaven and White Avian Hall each occupied about 30% of the Valley of Spacetime’s land. Ancestral Magus Realm occupied 20% of the Valley of Spacetime, while the other factions occupied a small percentage.
“Valley of Spacetime?” The purple-robed man frowned and looked at Meng Chuan. “It’s not impossible, but you should know that time and space are core to cultivation. Too many people want to comprehend spatial laws, and all of them want to go to the Valley of Spacetime. You have to join Ancestral Magus Realm and accumulate credit first. With enough credit, you will naturally have your turn.”
“Alright, I’ll think about it,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“Alright, consider it carefully. In terms of heritage, our Ancestral Magus Realm isn’t much inferior to White Avian Hall and Six Directions Heaven.” The purple-robed man stood up. “If you go to White Avian Hall or Six Directions Heaven, you will most likely be one of their most ordinary members. You won’t be valued at all.”
Meng Chuan didn’t say anything else and sent him off.
Swoosh.
The purple-robed man flew away, still rather dissatisfied. He originally believed that Ancestral Magus Realm was attractive enough to succeed in inviting Meng Chuan.
Requesting for entry into the Valley of Spacetime immediately? Do you think you are worthy when you’re just a newly-advanced Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence? The purple-robed man was rather disdainful. If it weren’t for the fact that he would receive credit for successfully inviting Meng Chuan, he wouldn’t have bothered coming.

chapters.title: Chapter 641 - Hall Lord White Avian
chapters.content:
Chapter 641 Hall Lord White Avian
Standing at the cave abode’s entrance, Meng Chuan watched the purple-robed man leave. It’s just as I expected. It’s too difficult for a newly-advanced Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence to enter the Valley of Spacetime. Meng Chuan also understood that there were tacit rules regarding the distribution of resources within the various factions. There were only a few ways to receive precious resources-one silently contributed and accumulated enough credit over time for a chance, one had dazzling talent that attracted the faction’s nurturing, or one had a powerful backer...
Meng Chuan was only a newly-advanced Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence on the surface. He naturally had no place in line to enter the Valley of Spacetime.
Meng Chuan shook his head slightly. Fifteen factions have already invited me. They’ve also already given me their conditions. The largest factions-Six Directions Heaven, White Avian Hall, and Ancestral Magus Realm-have given average conditions regarding the Valley of Spacetime. Forget it. Since I can’t enter the Valley of Spacetime, I’m not in a hurry to join a faction.
What was the point of joining a faction? For the sake of obtaining precious resources!
However, joining a faction would result in Meng Chuan being embroiled in all sorts of troubles.
The Void Trileaf Flower was not purchasable anywhere. Furthermore, it would have to be consumed within a day after it was born. Therefore, Meng Chuan was willing to join a faction for the sake of the Void Trileaf Flower.
Apart from the Void Trileaf Flower, I can still buy most of the other resources I need for cultivation. I happen to be able to afford them.
Meng Chuan—who had obtained half of Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasureswas comparable to a Seventh Tribulation Eminence in terms of wealth. Of course, Meng Chuan had long decided that he would only use a small portion of Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures. In the future, he would return what he took several-fold.
Since he had just reached the Sixth Tribulation realm, he could use some of the treasures while lying dormant.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan returned to his cave abode’s chamber and waved his hand. A pile of treasures appeared in front of him.
I have to sell all of these. Meng Chuan contacted Eternal Tower through his identity token.
Hum.
A colorful light descended and enveloped the treasures.
“Eternal Tower can directly purchase these treasures for 650,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals. If they’re consigned to Eternal Tower, they can be sold for 700,000 cubes. A sale typically happens within 1,000 years,” said a boundless voice.
“Consignments,” said Meng Chuan directly. “I can use these treasures as collateral to exchange for the Void Catalog’s first and second volumes, am I right?”
“You can use them as collateral,” replied the boundless voice.
Consigned treasures didn’t have a clear sale date.
However, Meng Chuan could only receive 80% of the consigned items’ value in advance-in Outer realm Essence Crystals—at maximum. For example, Meng Chuan could take away 560,000 cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals first. He could only obtain the rest after the items were sold.
If he used the consigned items as collateral to buy treasures in Eternal Tower, he could buy treasures worth 630,000 cubes in Eternal Tower—90% of his consigned items’ face value. He would only obtain the remaining Outer Realm Essence Crystals after the items were sold as well.
Eternal Tower could earn money from transactions.
“I’ll exchange for the Void Catalog’s first and second volumes,” said Meng Chuan.
Whoosh.
In just three seconds, two thick, black books appeared in the chamber.
Eternal Tower’s headquarters in the River of Spacetime was like their river zone Eternal Tower headquarters’ ninth floor. One could teleport things through spacetime.
It was very safe in Eternal Tower’s River of Spacetime headquarters.
The Sixth and Seventh Tribulation Eminences that were special lifeforms were very willing to leave their true bodies in the headquarters. This was because even Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star couldn’t engage in a massacre in Eternal Tower’s River of Spacetime headquarters.
I didn’t use a basic-level Eternal Token and directly bought these two volumes. Meng Chuan excitedly received the two black books.
Buying a volume of the Void Catalog for 300,000 cubes was a privilege that only Eternal Tower’s Sixth Tribulation Eminences and stronger had.
Basic-level Eternal Tokens could be used by external members. Therefore, a basic-level Eternal Token was worth more than 300,000 cubes.
There was a basic-level Eternal Token, an intermediate-level Eternal Token, and even an advanced-level Eternal Token in Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasure vault. However, Meng Chuan wouldn’t use them easily.
The Void Catalog really is a good book. With a flip of his hand, Meng Chuan took out a calabash and drank a mouthful of fruit wine. His Essence Soul became much more ethereal. With the help of rare treasures, he began to read the two Void Catalog volumes seriously.
Meng Chuan planned to study the laws of spacetime. He would focus on the Void Catalog’s three volumes and use supplementary treasures like the Void Trileaf Flower.
I’m not in a hurry.
I’ll carefully study these two volumes in my normal cultivation state first. After studying them, I’ll consume the Void Trileaf Flower in the future before studying them again. This is the most suitable method. Meng Chuan had already planned his cultivation out. He hadn’t even finished comprehending the Void Catalog’s three volumes.
Using a Void Trileaf Flower before one finished comprehending the Void Catalog was the worst method.
Days passed.
Meng Chuan was immersed in studying the Void Catalog
Spatial laws were the strongest Sixth Tribulation laws. Although they were typically grasped by Seventh Tribulation Eminences, Sixth Tribulation Eminences occasionally comprehended them as well. Therefore, it was very common for books to record spatial laws. For example, the Lightning Realm—which Meng Chuan had learned-contained complete spatial laws.
However, Meng Chuan still used a basic-level Eternal Token and 600,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals to buy the Void Catalog’s three complete volumes. This was because this manual wasn’t just limited to spatial laws.
The Void Catalog’s creator viewed things from a strategically advantageous position. The creator could easily write down the spatial laws’ outline and even link them to other laws.
Only in this manual could one clearly sense that all the laws originated from spacetime. Meng Chuan had to thank the Void Catalog’s third volume for allowing him to comprehend the lightning law so quickly.
Amazing. The creator of this manual should be an Eternal existence. The more Meng Chuan studied it, the more he admired the existence that had written this manual.
Every sentence in the manual seemed to make utmost sense. They could be used in the reproduction of all things—the circulation of water, the burning of flames, and the roar of lightning... They were all compatible! With the manual’s guidance, Meng Chuan made many connections and comprehended many profundities. Even when different laws were connected, Meng Chuan’s understanding of spacetime improved. It’s too worth it. Meng Chuan was intoxicated by the feeling of constantly gaining insights.
Expert teachers produce outstanding disciples. Though the Void Catalog’s three volumes might not be comparable to an Eternal existence’s personal explanation, it was still better than an Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s lecture. The words within the manual contained endless wisdom. In the face of such wisdom, Meng Chuan felt like he was constantly growing.
One’s cultivation realm is one of the two fundamental aspects of cultivation.
To an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence, one’s technique realm and willpower were two important aspects. Low technique realm meant low overall strength. Only when one’s technique realm was high could they be truly powerful. At the same time, one had to have high willpower. Otherwise, they wouldn’t be able to withstand such laws. It was just like how a child swinging a saber would only end up injuring themselves. The Void Catalog’s three volumes guided one’s cultivation realm.
Different cultivators gained different insights. Only by gaining a sufficiently deep understanding could one grasp spatial laws. Those who obtained the Void Catalog’s three volumes but failed to grasp spatial laws only meant one thing—their insights were still too shallow.
In front of a bamboo forest lake.
The white-haired Realm Ancestor was fishing.
“Realm Ancestor.” A voice rang out as a figure walked out from the bamboo forest. He was thin and wore a gray robe. His eyes were as serene as the deep sea as he walked over.
“Hall Lord, why are you here?” Realm Ancestor couldn’t help but smile when he saw the person.
Hall Lord White Avian was one of the two peak existences in the River of Spacetime. He had completely comprehended the laws of spacetime, making him, the leader of White Avian Hall, a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
“I wish to seek your advice, Realm Ancestor.” Hall Lord White Avian was very thin. He spoke gently as he sat by the side. “Speak your mind,” said Realm Ancestor with a smile. “I’ll definitely help if I can. However, I might not be able to help when even someone like you is perplexed.” “My Essence Soul is injured,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “I wonder if there’s a solution?”
“Injured? Who can injure you?” Realm Ancestor was alarmed.
Hall Lord White Avian nodded and said, “An Eighth Tribulation Eminence—who has traveled to our River of Spacetime-has a good relationship with me. He took one of my true bodies and left this universe to roam other places... We fought an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence, and my Essence Soul was injured. Even my homeworld’s true body suffered injuries.”
“Your true body outside the Universe was injured, yet your other body suffered an Essence Soul injury across an inhabited world?” Realm Ancestor was shocked as he immediately asked, “Can you show me your injuries?”

chapters.title: Chapter 642 - Realm Ancestor and Hall Lord White Avian
chapters.content:
Chapter 642 Realm Ancestor and Hall Lord White Avian
Hall Lord White Avian nodded slightly. He calmly remained seated, but an illusory white bird appeared behind him. It was a projection of his Essence Soul.
This huge white bird had a majestic aura, but upon careful inspection, it appeared somewhat dispirited. Its feathers were stained with many black spots. The black spots wriggled like tadpoles, trying to spread out, but they were forcefully suppressed.
“It doesn’t affect my close-combat strength much,” said Hall Lord White Avian calmly. “I can still unleash strength that’s close to my peak. However, the constant torture and pain will slowly spread over time. Even if I try my best to suppress it, I can only last another 50,000 to 60,000 years at best.”
Realm Ancestor nodded.
ds
Fifty to sixty thousand years? Hall Lord White Avian was very young. He had only cultivated for 50,000 years. Considering his cultivation realm, he had naturally cultivated his body to perfection. He would typically have a 180,000-year lifespan. However, his lifespan was now greatly reduced due to his Essence Soul injury?
Realm Ancestor carefully examined the tadpole-like black dots on the white bird Essence Soul as light swirled in his eyes.
After a long while, he said, “Hall Lord, I’ve seen similar powers before, but I’m helpless against them. I’m afraid that you have to reach the Eighth Tribulation realm with your body. By nurturing your Essence Soul with your body, you can help your Essence Soul expel this power. Another solution is to have your Essence Soul reach the Eighth Tribulation realm so that it can expel this external force.”
“There’s nothing you can do?” White Avian sighed softly. “In the entire River of Spacetime, you are the strongest Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence. If even you can’t do anything, I’m afraid there’s no solution in the River of Spacetime.”
“The eighth Heavenly Tribulation only tests your body,” said Realm Ancestor. “Even if your Essence Soul is injured, you should be able to transcend the tribulation.”
“Yes.” Hall Lord White Avian nodded. “I can suppress my injuries for 30,000 years, and I almost have peak strength. I do have a chance of transcending the tribulation and reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm. However, my injuries will spread even further in the next 30,000 years. My strength will decrease, and it will begin to affect my body. I have no hope of transcending the tribulation once that happens. I will only be struggling at death’s door. However, it’s really difficult to reach the Eighth Tribulation realm within 30,000 years.”
Realm Ancestor nodded slightly.
Yes, it was too difficult.
Even with his normal lifespan, White Avian had a low chance of reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm, much less break through in 30,000 years. “Perhaps finding an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence might help you,” said Realm Ancestor.
White Avian shook his head. “Eighth Tribulation Eminences are too rare. My other true body has traveled all over the multiverse, yet I’ve only encountered a few. The only Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence I’ve encountered is an enemy. He is the reason for my current injuries.”
At that moment, Hall Lord White Avian felt mixed emotions. It was a good thing that he had the opportunity to leave the River of Spacetime and be brought to other universes or even other special places…
These experiences had indeed been an eye-opener for him. He had broadened his horizons and accumulated more knowledge. However, he had encountered even more terrifying enemies and suffered an Essence Soul injury.
“Hall Lord, what did your Eighth Tribulation Eminence friend say? He should have more solutions,” asked Realm Ancestor.
“He said the same thing. Expel this force by relying on myself to become an Eighth Tribulation Eminence,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “If I am to use external force to expel the foreign power, it has to be an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence or an Eternal existence.”
“Eternal existence?” Realm Ancestor’s mind jolted when he heard that.
“Eternal existences are only a legend, even to Eighth Tribulation Eminences,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “In other universes and places, there are legends left behind by Eternal existences. Eighth Tribulation Eminences travel across time to search for Eternal existences. However, if Eternal existences are unwilling to meet them, they will never have a chance to meet them.”
“Never have a chance?” Realm Ancestor muttered.
“There are only a few Eternal existences in the multiverse and all of spacetime,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “Many Eighth Tribulation Eminences in the Universe have been searching for one. It’s considered lucky for them to meet one in their lives.”
Realm Ancestor nodded gently. “I’ve only learned that there are only a few Eternal existences in all the universes and different spacetimes today. It has resolved some of my doubts.”
“By the way, are there any legacies left behind by Eternal existences in our River of Spacetime?” asked Realm Ancestor.
“I only know that the Immeasurable Universe and the Void Catalog are suspected to be legacies of Eternal existences,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “After all, many Eighth Tribulation Eminences in our River of Spacetime and other universes have seen these two legacies. They believe that only Eternal existences can write them. As for whether this is actually true or not? Only Eternal existences can confirm it.”
“Only these two legacies?” Realm Ancestor smiled and nodded. “From the looks of it, I have to leave a few more copies of the Void Catalog in my homeworld. However, there are only three copies of the Immeasurable Universe in the entire River of Spacetime. There’s no way to buy them.”
The Void Catalog mainly described spatial laws. It had limited elaboration on other aspects. Therefore, a Seventh Tribulation Eminence could write a new copy after reading it. Therefore, there were quite a few copies around.
The Immeasurable Universe was different. It used the Immeasurable lineage as its core. It described all the laws in the universe in a way that was hundreds, even thousands of times more detailed than the Void Catalog. Its actual value was unimaginable.
Apart from the first copy that came from beyond the universe, the other two copies had been written over a long period of time. Only one Eighth Tribulation Eminence—who had been born in the River of Spacetime—had successfully created one copy, at great cost, after comprehending it. Although the other Eighth Tribulation Eminences had also read the Immeasurable Universe, they couldn’t make a copy.
“Realm Ancestor, if there’s anything you need my help with, feel free to tell me,” said Hall Lord White Avian.
He had two reasons for visiting. Firstly, to treat his injuries. Secondly, to visit this senior.
“There’s nothing. When there’s a need in the future, just help my homeworld and my two juniors,” said Realm Ancestor with a smile.
Hall Lord White Avian nodded.
“By the way,” said Realm Ancestor solemnly, “I have to remind you to be careful of Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.”
Hall Lord White Avian nodded. “Realm Ancestor, don’t worry. I understand. Besides, he can’t threaten me.”
“Thankfully, you are present. Otherwise, I don’t know what this era would’ve been like.” Realm Ancestor thought of something. “By the way, I recently discovered a very talented young man. In the future, he might become a valued member of your White Avian Hall.”
“Oh? He must be impressive to receive such praise from you,” said Hall Lord White Avian with a smile. “Who is he?”
Realm Ancestor flicked his sleeve.
Many scenes immediately appeared in the lake beside him. Images of Meng Chuan in Archean Eon Realm, Thousand Mountain Star, and Earth Cloud Mystic Realm appeared.
“He still has a true body in Eternal Tower’s River of Spacetime headquarters. I can’t pry into it,” said Realm Ancestor. “He’s a newly-advanced Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence. He has only cultivated for 2,600 years.”
“He reached the Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation realm in 2,600 years?” White Avian was also astounded. “It took me 2,900 years to reach the Sixth Tribulation realm. I only reached the Seventh Tribulation realm early because of a huge opportunity and an epiphany.”
“That’s right. He has a very high chance of reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm,” said Realm Ancestor with a smile. “I’ve recommended a Seventh Tribulation seedling to you. I hope it can help you.”
White Avian nodded. “Thank you.”
“He hasn’t joined any faction yet. He has made a request to all the factions—to enter the Valley of Spacetime. None of them have agreed to his request. The knowledge of his cultivation duration is still a secret. None of them know his true potential,” said Realm Ancestor with a smile. “Furthermore, this kid came from Archean Eon Realm. Senior Archean Eon has definitely given Meng Chuan some of his treasures. He doesn’t lack treasures. Therefore, he isn’t in a hurry to join any faction unless there are enough benefits.”
Hall Lord White Avian nodded. “I see. With such talent, potential, and Senior Archean Eon’s treasures, he will definitely soar. I’ll make arrangements today and invite him to join my White Avian Hall.”
Meng Chuan’s outer realm true body cultivated in the Eternal Tower’s River of Spacetime headquarters. He wasn’t in a hurry to return because his location was more suitable for receiving invitations from various factions.
Huh?
As the owner of this planetary cave abode, Meng Chuan sensed a dark-red-skinned, tall man descending to the planet. This tall man had one eye with a vertical pupil. His dark-red skin was as rough as rock. He wore a loose robe, and his supercilious gaze seemed to see through all mysteries. White Avian Hall’s deputy hall lord, Blazing Sun? Meng Chuan was shocked. The true person managing White Avian Hall was Blazing Sun.
Hall Lord White Avian was the faction’s supreme leader. He seldom managed matters and focused on his cultivation, leaving Blazing Sun to manage all the faction’s matters with great difficulty. Although he was only a half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence, he could match a true Seventh Tribulation Eminence with the help of treasures. Considering his actual authority… he was one of the top ten Eminences in the River of Spacetime.
Such an Eminence has come to visit me? Meng Chuan was somewhat shocked. He immediately left the chamber and went outside the cave abode.
Blazing Sun stood there and observed Meng Chuan.
“Greetings, Hall Lord Blazing Sun.” Meng Chuan bowed.

chapters.title: Chapter 643 - Ranked Eighth
chapters.content:
Chapter 643 Ranked Eighth
Blazing Sun observed Meng Chuan with his vertical eye, and a smile finally appeared on his face. “Despite being a newly-advanced Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence, you have only cultivated for 2,600 years. Truly impressive.” “Hall Lord, you have a sharp eye,” said Meng Chuan humbly. He wasn’t surprised that the other party could see through his age, considering Blazing Sun’s attainments in the time lineage.
“No, I can’t determine your age,” said Blazing Sun with a smile. “Hall Lord White Avian was the one who informed me about it.”
To see through a Sixth Tribulation Eminence’s age at a glance, one had to be able to clearly sense the length of time a Sixth Tribulation Eminence had experienced. A Sixth Tribulation domain could conceal everything. Therefore, it was very difficult to determine a Sixth Tribulation Eminence’s age.
Seventh Tribulation Eminences typically pursued the Eighth Tribulation realm. Hence, they focused on studying the temporal laws to an extremely profound level. For example, Realm Ancestor, Ancestral Master Archean Eon, and Hall Lord White Avian could determine a Sixth Tribulation Eminence’s age with a single glance.
As for half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences, they were focused on perfecting their physical body formulation and transcending the tribulation. Most of them didn’t have high attainments in the time lineage.
“Hall Lord White Avian?” Meng Chuan was alarmed.
was
Hall Lord White Avian was one of the two peak existences in the River of Spacetime. In fact, many cultivators believed that he was the strongest.
After all, Hall Lord White Avian cultivated faster and was younger than Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
Secondly, excluding Hall Lord White Avian, White Avian Hall had three Seventh Tribulation Eminences and seven half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
Six Directions Heaven had two Seventh Tribulation Eminences-excluding Celestial Thearch Myriad STar—and three half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
In terms of peak experts, White Avian Hall was clearly stronger than Six Directions Heaven.
Hall Lord White Avian-who is probably the current era’s strongest expert-pays attention to me? Meng Chuan was indeed somewhat shocked.
Blazing Sun smiled at Meng Chuan. “Aren’t you going to invite me in?”
“Hall Lord, please.” Meng Chuan had indeed lost his composure. He immediately led the other party into the cave abode. To catch Hall Lord White Avian’s attention and have Hall Lord Blazing Sun personally visit me… Meng Chuan’s emotions were in turmoil.
“Realm Ancestor was the one who informed Hall Lord White Avian about you.” After he sat down, Blazing Sun said frankly, “That’s how we know about you. I personally came to invite you to join White Avian Hall. As for your request to visit the Valley of Spacetime… We can agree to it.”
“I’ve long heard of White Avian Hall’s fame. I’m naturally willing to join,” Meng Chuan immediately agreed.
Upon hearing this, Hall Lord Blazing Sun smiled brightly.
He personally extended the invitation because he was worried that an accident would happen. After all, an Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence—who had cultivated for less than 3,000 years-naturally had pride. It was also possible for such talents to encounter some setbacks.
For example, the leader of the River of Spacetime’s Origin Realm was the one with the most dazzling talent after Celestial Thearch Myriad Star and Hall Lord White Avian. He had only cultivated for slightly more than 20,000 years.
When he was at the Sixth Tribulation realm, he disdained joining any faction. He had even cultivated to the Seventh Tribulation realm and formed his own faction. He then led his faction to compete with White Avian Hall and Six Directions Heaven for various resources. His methods were extremely ruthless and vicious.
Since Origin Realm’s leader was an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, he had many Essence Soul avatars. Hence, he could lead his subordinates into battle everywhere. It was as though eight or nine Seventh Tribulation Eminences were fighting everywhere. This left White Avian Hall and Six Directions Heaven rather vexed. Even if they spent a great deal of effort to destroy one of the Essence Soul avatars, the other party would instantly condense another one.
He alone could fight two major factions! This showed how powerful Origin Realm’s leader
was.
In terms of heritage, Origin Realm’s forces couldn’t be ranked in the River of Spacetime’s top five. However, they had an extremely domineering way of handling matters. Origin Realm completely looked down on the ancient Ancestral Magus Realm. Meng Chuan had reached the Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation realm at about the same age as Origin Realm’s leader. Thus, White Avian Hall had to rope in such a talented and promising person as soon as possible to prevent another person similar to Origin Realm’s leader from appearing. “I also need to make things about the Valley of Spacetime clear to you in advance,” said Blazing Sun solemnly. “Our White Avian Hall has over 10,000 Sixth Tribulation Eminences. Many want to go to the Valley of Spacetime. Therefore, we have to prove your strength to the rest.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
“I will say that I owe your homeworld’s senior karma. Outsiders will then think this is why I’m helping you in your trip to the Valley of Spacetime,” said Blazing Sun with a smile. “I’m now a half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Nobody will say a thing about me resolving karma. When the time comes, we can even deduct some of my credit on the surface.”
“Thank you, Hall Lord,” said Meng Chuan.
“There’s no need to thank me. If your talent is publicized, it will cause a great commotion,” said Blazing Sun. “Since you want to keep it a secret, it’s best not to meet Seventh Tribulation Eminences. Most Seventh Tribulation Eminences can determine how long you’ve cultivated at a glance. Most half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences can’t.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
“Also, our White Avian Hall now has eight cultivators in the Valley of Spacetime. One of them is a half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence. He is Mountain Lord Moxie, a Patroller in charge of guarding our territory in the Valley of Spacetime. The other seven are all waiting for the Void Trileaf Flower. If you go over now, you will be eighth in line,” said Blazing Sun.
“I can make the decision to let you enter, but you will only be eighth in the queue at most. In fact, many White Avian Hall members wish to head to the Valley of Spacetime. You have already cut the queue in a sense.”
“How long will it take to go through eight spots?” asked Meng Chuan.
“Our White Avian Hall occupies a large area in the Valley of Spacetime. Typically, we can obtain a Void Trileaf Flower every 100 years. Sometimes it might be faster, but it also might be slower. Sometimes, a few will appear in our territory. Occasionally, we even have to wait for a long time. According to my estimates, it might take 200 to 300 years. It will be your turn in 2,000 years at the latest,” explained Blazing Sun.
Meng Chuan nodded. “Understood.”
He wasn’t in a hurry. According to his cultivation plan, he wanted to finish comprehending the Void Catalog before consuming the Void Trileaf Flower. He would then take a second go at studying the Void Catalog
Understanding the Void Catalog’s two volumes comprehensively and constantly experimenting with the insights he gained would probably take Meng Chuan more than 1,000 years. If the Void Trileaf Flower was produced too early, Meng Chuan might end up in a panic. After all, he had to consume the Void Trileaf Flower within a day of obtaining it.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan’s Nebula Token suddenly received lots of information.
“This is White Avian Hall’s basic intelligence,” said Blazing Sun. “It also lists White Avian Hall’s members. You can communicate with them through the Nebula Token since all of them have Nebula Tokens.”
Meng Chuan nodded and checked the information.
White Avian Hall’s members numbered 13,289 in total. The leader was White Avian Hall, a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
The deputy hall lords were Hall Lord Blazing Sun and Hall Lord Azure Dragon. Hall Lord Azure Dragon was also the strongest dragon in the River of Spacetime. These two diligently followed Hall Lord White Avian and were in charge of specific matters. Blazing Sun was in charge of the trivial matters, while Azure Dragon was in charge of combat.
The three Librarians were Seventh Tribulation Eminences. Seventh Tribulation Eminences had extremely high statuses; they also had their own goals. Their relationship with White Avian Hall was more of a cooperative one. Therefore, they weren’t in charge of specific matters. As Librarians, they had the right to read all the precious books in White Avian Hall, including the original copy of Immeasurable Universe.
The five Patrollers were half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences. They each had their own pursuits. They even had their own factions. Therefore, they only managed some simple matters. For example, they would send a true body to guard a certain place for a long period of time. They typically cultivated on their own.
The rest were Sixth Tribulation Eminences.
In terms of Tribulation Eminences, White Avian Hall could be said to be the strongest in the River of Spacetime. It had about 2,000 more members than Six Directions Heaven, which was ranked second.
This was what cultivation was like. The higher one’s realm was, the more time they spent on themselves. No Seventh Tribulation Eminence would diligently work for another Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
Blazing Sun continued, “In White Avian Hall, you will be a little special. Your direct superior will be me. Therefore, in the entire White Avian Hall, you will only need to listen to Hall Lord White Avian and me. You can ignore everybody else’s orders.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
Logically speaking, Meng Chuan had to bear a lot of responsibilities after obtaining a large faction’s benefits. However, things were made simple for him-only the two hall lords could instruct him.
“However, you have to listen to the guardian’s arrangements when you are at the Valley of Spacetime,” instructed Blazing Sun. “The guardian is Mountain Lord Mo Xie. However, you will probably only see him a few times when you’re there.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “I’ll naturally follow his instructions.”
In the Valley of Spacetime, conflicts could break out between other factions. He naturally had to obey orders in such a situation.
“You can set off now,” said Blazing Sun with a smile. “The responsibilities that you will bear and the benefits you will receive from White Avian Hall are all provided in the intelligence I gave you. You can take your time to read it.”
With that said, Blazing Sun stood up.
Meng Chuan immediately stood up to send him off.
Outside the cave abode, Meng Chuan watched as Blazing Sun left. Since I’ve already joined White Avian Hall, it’s time to leave. However, I should choose some mystic techniques before I leave.
Ever since he grasped the lightning law, Meng Chuan hadn’t deliberately cultivated mystic techniques.
Mystic techniques were utility techniques. The Magic Awl Forbidden Spell was one example! The Magic Awl Forbidden Spell was collected by Ancestral Master Archean Eon only.
Eternal Tower had countless-fold more mystic techniques than the number of mystic techniques Ancestral Master Archean Eon had gathered.
Meng Chuan had previously focused on transcending the tribulation. He had relied on his World Treasure and willpower to transcend the tribulation. Mystic techniques were useless, so he didn’t waste any time on them.
Since he would be embroiled in battles in the near future, he had to learn some mystic techniques. In the River of Spacetime, many mystic techniques were far more powerful than the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell.
Many of them were also suitable for him.
Back in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, Meng Chuan had to use an Eighth Tribulation treasure to kill his opponent’s true body.
In the future, Meng Chuan wouldn’t easily bring an Eighth Tribulation treasure with him when he fought outside.
Mystic technique formulations. Meng Chuan returned to his cave abode and began reading.
Will-type mystic techniques, domain-type mystic techniques, mystic techniques that suited the lightning law…
Meng Chuan read through them one by one.

chapters.title: Chapter 644 - Mountain Lord Moxie
chapters.content:
Chapter 644 Mountain Lord Moxie
Although he had a long lifespan after reaching the Sixth Tribulation realm, Meng Chuan still cherished his time.
I’ll forget about domain-type mystic techniques. Meng Chuan gave up after scanning the ones available. A mystic technique was a functional use of the laws. However, the techniques he could use were typically inferior to treasures refined by Seventh Tribulation Eminences, much less Eighth Tribulation treasures.
Therefore, buying a Seventh Tribulation treasure array formation was much better than arduously cultivating a mystic technique himself.
The only difference was that the treasures would be lost if their Essence Soul avatar died in battle. However, if one used mystic techniques against an enemy, the losses would be negligible.
Even if I choose a mystic technique, I have to choose one that is of great use to me. The lightning lineage is good at attacking, so I’ll choose an offensive mystic technique. Meng Chuan scanned the manuals available. For a mystic technique that can help me comprehend Chaos Hole laws... This shall be it.
Meng Chuan found a mystic technique.
The illusory projection in front of him was a gray book. On the book’s surface were wordsChaos Hole Lightning Spear. With lightning as the catalyst and Chaos Hole laws as the foundation, Meng Chuan could condense a lightning spear and use it to attack.
An expert that had grasped a lightning law had the greatest offensive power when they instantly controlled all lightning within a five billion-kilometer radius! Chaos Hole Lightning Spear was a mysterious mystic technique that allowed one to condense the lightning.
Learning this mystic technique will also be beneficial to my future mastery of Chaos Hole laws. It won’t be a waste of time. I only need 300 cubes to learn it once. Meng Chuan instantly decided on this mystic technique.
Seventh Tribulation mystic techniques weren’t expensive. This was because the original copy of mystic techniques created by Seventh Tribulation Eminences typically cost thousands of cubes at most. The price to learn such a mystic technique once was naturally lower.
In comparison, the value of an Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s legacy soared rapidly. An Eternal legacy was ridiculously expensive. The Void Catalog was one example; it mainly described spatial laws. One required nearly one million Outer Realm Essence Crystals to obtain the Void Catalog’s three complete volumes.
I have to learn a willpower-based mystic technique. Meng Chuan placed great importance on it. After all, his mind and willpower had helped him traverse 5,000 kilometers on Fiend Mountain’s path of the mind. After his wife and parents woke up, his Essence Soul had transformed after he painted Perfection.
After obtaining the Eighth Tribulation Essence Soul legacy-Eternal Road—from Realm Ancestor, he created a new Essence Soul Dharmic formulation on the two Eighth Tribulation Essence Soul legacies’ foundation.
Although this formulation was still in its nascent form, it was most suitable for him. One’s Essence Soul structure had a huge impact on their life. The Essence Soul structure matched Meng Chuan’s temperament, causing his Essence Soul to feel much more ethereal. His perception and willpower had also become stronger.
Meng Chuan didn’t know how strong his willpower was, but he felt that his willpower was at the peak of the Sixth Tribulation realm before transcending the tribulation. It might even be able to match an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s willpower...
Since Meng Chuan was so strong in this aspect, he naturally had to choose a good willpower-based mystic technique.
He learned the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell from the original copy found by Ancestral Master Archean Eon. However, there were many other techniques in the River of Spacetime that were stronger.
This shall be it. Meng Chuan quickly chose a technique in Eternal Tower’s treasure vault.
Pupil of Darkness was one of the top ten Essence Soul mystic techniques in the River of Spacetime. It used the Chaos Hole law as its foundation; it also contained the Immeasurable law and the Karma law. It was an Eighth Tribulation Essence mystic technique that contained three Origins laws.
It’s really expensive. Meng Chuan looked at the price. It costs 150,000 cubes to learn it once.
This technique could only be used against enemies.
For techniques like Essence Soul Star and Eternal Road—which were related to one’s Essence Soul structure-it typically cost more than one million cubes to learn them once. Furthermore, it was very difficult to buy them. This was because recording these legacies was very difficult. They were also limited by the spacetime laws. Every such legacy could only be learned a limited number of times. On the other hand, pure mystic techniques were relatively less restricted by the spacetime laws, making them cheaper.
Moments later...
Meng Chuan bought two mystic techniques and learned them separately.
It’s indeed worth it. Meng Chuan sighed in amazement. As expected of one of the top ten Essence Soul mystic techniques in the River of Spacetime. The Pupil of Darkness’s strength is extremely astonishing. With just one glance, my enemies might sink into oblivion and lose the ability to resist. If one’s realm is too low, their Essence Soul might collapse and be destroyed.
Of course, the stronger the opponent was, the stronger their resistance.
Since he had just reached the Sixth Tribulation Realm, Meng Chuan’s willpower was his strongest aspect. This Pupil of Darkness is enough to be my trump card. Meng Chuan already had a plan.
In the future, he would send his Essence Soul avatars out. His main attacking methods would be the Pupil of Darkness and Chaos Hole Lightning Spear. He would use his Essence Soul World to suppress the enemy. It would be sufficiently intimidating. Even if he died in battle, he wouldn’t incur any losses as long as his avatars didn’t carry any treasures. It’s time to head to the Valley of Spacetime.
At the same time, Meng Chuan split out an Essence Soul avatar on Fiend Mountain before rushing to the Valley of Spacetime. This was because this body was the closest to the Valley of Spacetime.
In a mystic realm.
Ice spread out. On a towering iceberg’s peak was an ice palace.
Inside the palace sat a silver-haired elder, who was about 1,000 feet tall. His skin was covered in silver patterns. It’s clearly my turn to be in the Valley of Spacetime queue. I should be the next to head to the Valley of Spacetime.
The silver-haired elder was furious. Someone actually cut the line? I’ve fought hard for White Avian Hall for more than 30,000 years. I’ve contributed so much, and my turn has finally arrived. Yet, you now want me to wait a little longer?
The silver-haired elder was very old. Although he had only been pushed back one spot, and he might only be delayed for a century or so, he only had 10,000 years left to live. His chances of breaking through became slimmer for every moment he delayed.
I’ve cultivated to this day and have a deep understanding of the spatial law. As long as I obtain the Void Trileaf Flower, I will have a chance of fully grasping the spatial law. Once I grasp the spatial law, I can extend my lifespan by 20,000 to 30,000 years as long as I improve my body slightly, even if I can’t reach the Seventh Tribulation realm.
The silver-haired elder was very anxious. The closer the elderly cultivators were to the end of their lifespans, the more precious their time became.
City Lord Eastcalm? The silver-haired elder took note of the name.
White Avian Hall had publicly announced the name of the new Sixth Tribulation Eminence entering the Valley of Spacetime.
A newly-advanced Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence crushes me? I hear that he has Deputy Hall Lord Blazing Sun backing him? Hmph, Deputy Hall Lord Blazing Sun is becoming more and more unfair. Hall Lord White Avian has given him too much power. The silver-haired elder felt very indignant, but he could only grumble inside his cave abode.
Fiend Mountain’s exits were scattered across nine river zones—which were relatively far from each other. With Fiend Mountain as a transit point, one was relatively close to any place in the River of Spacetime. I’m here. The black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan looked into the distance.
In front of him was a dark void. It looked ordinary, but it was a special place in the River of Spacetime. The various factions had sent Eminences to guard it.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan flew towards White Avian Hall’s territory, which was indicated in the information given to him.
As he flew closer, the space around him began to turn strange. The vast spacetime around him seemed to turn into a spinning bottle.
Meng Chuan flew into the depths of the bottle.
