In the bottle’s deepest depths was a long, narrow tunnel—the Valley of Spacetime.
Although the Valley of Spacetime was long and narrow, it had been folded into 15 layers.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan flew carefully. If he didn’t know the correct location and randomly flew, he might have flown into another faction’s territory since the Valley of Spacetime had several layers.
As Meng Chuan flew, he entered a new layer of space. Even if Supremacies and Imperial Lords came here, they would find it difficult to understand the changes in spacetime. However, Meng Chuan and other Sixth Tribulation Eminences could naturally understand these changes.
“Eastcalm, you’re here?” A voice sounded in Meng Chuan’s ear. “Come over.”
An invisible force guided Meng Chuan.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan instantly traversed five billion kilometers and saw an ordinary cave abode in the dark void.
A gray-robed man stood in front of the cave abode. The man had no hair, and his skin was somewhat crystalline. There were strange flame runes at his glabella.
“Greetings, Lord Moxie.” Meng Chuan bowed.
Moxie-an Eminence at the half-step Seventh Tribulation realm-had established a faction, Land Without Karma. As a person who grasped the Karma law-an Origins law-Moxie’s means were unpredictable. His faction, Land of Zero Karma, had great influence. He only joined White Avian Hall so that he had a stronger backer.
“White Avian Hall occupies 30% of the Valley of Spacetime,” said Moxie as he looked at Meng Chuan calmly. “Apart from me, there are seven other Sixth Tribulation Eminences. These seven are all at the peak Sixth Tribulation realm. You are the weakest.”
Meng Chuan listened calmly.
It wasn’t strange at all. Since White Avian Hall had more than 10,000 Sixth Tribulation Eminences, those who could come to the Valley of Spacetime were naturally outstanding.
Typically, one could be considered a top Sixth Tribulation Eminence if they grasped two Sixth Tribulation laws. Only by grasping a spatial law could one be considered a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
“Therefore, you have to be careful in the Valley of Spacetime. This is because you are probably no match for most Sixth Tribulation Eminences here,” said Mountain Lord Moxie. “I’ve also arranged a simple mission for you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 645 - Archean Eon Realm’s Growth
chapters.content:
Chapter 645 Archean Eon Realm’s Growth
Mountain Lord Moxie waved his hand, and the Valley of Spacetime’s illusory 15-layered structure appeared in front of him.
“The Valley of Spacetime is divided into 15 levels,” said Moxie. “Our White Avian Hall occupies four of the larger levels. I control the first level directly. The other three levels are controlled by other Tribulation Eminences. You can head to the outermost level and help keep an eye on the border with Six Directions Heaven.”
“Yes,” replied Meng Chuan immediately. The mission was indeed very simple.
Moxie nodded. “You may leave. Contact me through the Nebula Token if there’s anything important.” Meng Chuan bowed respectfully and flew away.
Moxie watched Meng Chuan leave. He didn’t care about the Sixth Tribulation Eminences waiting for Void Trileaf Flowers. As one of the top 100 Eminences in the River of Spacetime, why would he care about a newly-advanced Sixth Tribulation Eminence? To him, this was just a normal thing.
Moxie only accepted the mission of guarding the Valley of Spacetime for White Avian Hall. He couldn’t be bothered with other matters.
The Origin Realm’s forces are becoming stronger and stronger. As for me, I’m still at the half-step Seventh Tribulation realm. The gap between him and me is becoming wider and wider. Moxie sighed inwardly. He had a grudge against Origin Realm’s leader. Back when the other party established Origin Realm, Moxie had established the Land of Zero Karma. They were on par with each other.
Now, Origin Realm’s forces could compete with Six Directions Heaven and White Avian Hall. As an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, the other party’s fame was widespread. He was also one of the top ten strongest in the entire River of Spacetime.
In comparison, Moxie was much inferior.
I have to perfect my physical formulation as soon as possible. I feel that I can succeed within 10,000 years. Moxie returned to his cave abode to continue cultivating.
Moxie spent 99% of his time cultivating while guarding the Valley of Spacetime. He only appeared when ushering newcomers, Void Trileaf Flowers were born, and when external factions invaded. He didn’t care about anything else.
Meng Chuan arrived at the Valley of Spacetime level where White Avian Hall and Six Directions Heaven bordered each other—the fifth level.
“Brother Eastcalm.”
Two figures flew over from afar to welcome Meng Chuan. One was a black-haired man with two soft feelers, while the other was a cyan-clothed woman-whose body was covered in flames.
“Brother Cang Li, Lady Feng Yu,” greeted Meng Chuan politely.
The cyan-clothed woman was one of the eight Sixth Tribulation Eminences of the phoenix race-Lady Feng Yu. The phoenixes were weaker than the dragons in this era. Although neither race had a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, the dragons had at least one half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
However, Meng Chuan didn’t dare underestimate them.
Lady Feng Yu was also one of the top Sixth Tribulation Eminences. The phoenixes’ heritage far exceeded that of Ancestral Master Archean Eon, so who would dare to bully them? Furthermore, Phoenix Ancestor-an Eighth Tribulation Eminence-might still be alive.
Even if an Eighth Tribulation Eminence had disappeared for a billion years, they might still be very young considering the possibility of them time-traveling a billion years.
“This array formation is mainly controlled by me,” said the black-haired man, Cang Li, with a smile. “There’s no need for you and Sister Feng Yu to manage it. Set up a cave abode at Six Directions Heaven’s border and focus on your cultivation.”
“Thank you, Brother Cang Li,” said Meng Chuan.
Cang Li was an extremely famous Sixth Tribulation Eminence. He came from a low-level inhabited world, and he had forged his standing in the River of Spacetime one step at a time. He had even grasped three Sixth Tribulation laws.
He had even obtained an Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s treasure trove and moved it back to his homeworld. Most importantly, he had only cultivated for 30,000 years. Having grasped three Sixth Tribulation laws at such a young age made his chances of becoming a Seventh Tribulation Eminence very high. Meng Chuan was a Seventh Tribulation seedling
It was the same for Cang Li. Furthermore, Cang Li had no backing. He had attained his present accomplishments alone.
Hence, Meng Chuan was rather impressed.
“Set up a cave abode first. In a while, I’ll invite the Sixth Tribulation Eminences in the Valley of Spacetime for a gathering at Nebula Palace,” said Cang Li with a smile. The Sixth Tribulation Eminences in the Valley of Spacetime couldn’t leave on their own due to their missions. Thus, they could only hold gatherings at Nebula Palace.
Meng Chuan bade farewell and headed to the periphery to set up his cave abode.
“Cang Li, you took the initiative to welcome a newly-advanced Sixth Tribulation Eminence? You should have waited for him to go to your cave abode,” said the cyan-robed Lady Feng Yu.
“Feng Yu,” said Cang Li, “Don’t underestimate any Sixth Tribulation Eminence. They must be extraordinary if they can reach the Sixth Tribulation realm.”
nr
“You are just too cautious about everything.” Lady Feng Yu shook her head. Phoenixes were mainly female; there were very few males. Many of them lived alone their entire lives. Once they chose a target, they wouldn’t give up easily.
Lady Feng Yu was extremely proud and aloof, but she was certain that Cang Li was the one after interacting with him. Cang Li had come to the Valley of Spacetime for the Void Trileaf Flower, while Lady Feng Yu had also come to the Valley of Spacetime thanks to her identity as a phoenix.
Cang Li looked at Lady Feng Yu.
The two of them were indeed too different. Lady Feng Yu was born of the phoenix race. She was accustomed to not thinking much of other experts. However, Cang Li had struggled to survive in the outer realm’s void since he was a weak Supremacy. He had suffered too much, so he instinctively didn’t underestimate any Tribulation Eminence at the same level.
“Treating friends with respect might result in a future opportunity,” said Cang Li.
“A newly-advanced Sixth Tribulation Eminence though?” Lady Feng Yu didn’t say anything else. She felt that Cang Li’s cultivation style was too tiring. She felt that one should be happy and carefree, doing the things they wanted. Only then would her cultivation be smoother.
To be so careful and scheming? It was exhausting.
Cang Li glanced at her without saying anything
He had a nagging feeling that the conditions given to these phoenixes by Phoenix Ancestor were too good. They were shielded from the darkness in the outer realm, preventing them from seeing much of the truth. This was probably the reason why the dragons and phoenixes didn’t have any Seventh Tribulation Eminences in this era.
This Eastcalm isn’t ordinary. Cang Li looked into the distance. Cang Li was very good at observing things. Among the Sixth Tribulation laws he had grasped, one was the Fate law.
The Fate law involved the future timelines of the Laws of Time. When the future had yet to happen, there were many possibilities.
Cang Li looked at Meng Chuan. He could see fate threads intertwining with Meng Chuan’s body. It was difficult to pry into too many things since he felt a faint pressure coming from the fate threads.
In the void, Meng Chuan flew to the periphery. He could sense White Avian Hall’s and Six Directions Heaven’s arrays.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan waved his hand, and a cave abode flew out. The five-kilometer-wide cave abode floated in the air.
In the future, an avatar will cultivate here. Meng Chuan smiled. He had a good impression of Cang Li after coming to the Valley of Spacetime. At the very least, Cang Li’s cultivation accomplishments impressed him.
“Brother Eastcalm, come over quickly.” Cang Li summoned him through the Nebula Token. “I’m coming.”
With a thought, Meng Chuan sent his will through the Nebula Token to the mysterious Nebula Palace.
Meng Chuan left only an Essence Soul avatar in spacetime.
Archean Eon Realm.
“Master has long prepared the array formation and treasures that will help Archean Eon Realm grow. However, he has always lacked a Sixth Tribulation Eminence presiding over the array formation,” said the white-robed elder at Heaven and Earth Great Hall’s entrance.
Meng Chuan nodded. “It’s time to let Archean Eon Realm grow.”
“The size limit of a middle-level world is 150,000 kilometers across,” said the white-robed elder. “Meng Chuan, you only need to carefully preside over it for 1,000 years. It will be easy after that.”
Meng Chuan had also read up on the details.
It was like planting a tree. In the beginning, one had to be very careful-plowing the land, fertilizing the soil, and watering the sapling. The sapling would slowly grow. However, once it passed the early stages, there was no need to care too much about it. It would grow naturally, and over decades and centuries, it would grow bigger and bigger.
Elevating a world of life was much more complicated than planting trees, but the process was similar.
In the beginning, Meng Chuan had to guide it carefully and invest all sorts of treasures. After plenty of care was provided for 1,000 years, and once everything was on track, there was no need to take care of it anymore. He just needed to let it grow naturally. “To advance from a low-level world to a middle-level world, one needs to take care of it carefully for 500 years. After that, it will grow normally for 300,000 years... Only then can it be considered a stable middle-level world,” said the white-robed elder. “After it stabilizes, it can be upgraded. Meng Chuan, take care of Archean Eon Realm meticulously for 1,000 years. After that, let it grow for about 500,000 years. It will then become a peak middle-level world.”
“The time a world takes to grow is truly long.” Meng Chuan sighed.
A tree would take a decade to a century to finish growing
It was normal for a world to take hundreds of thousands of years to grow.
“I heard that the way a high-level world grows is different,” said the white-robed elder. “However, only an Eighth Tribulation Eminence can do that.”
Meng Chuan nodded as well.
If an Eighth Tribulation Eminence was willing, they could change their species. For example, the phoenixes and the dragons were born because of Eighth Tribulation Eminences. The mystic realms they created could nurture many experts. The number of experts in a mystic realm could even be comparable to the number of experts in ten river systems. It also allowed cultivators to remain undying and transcend Samsara. These were the means of an Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
The current Seventh Tribulation Eminences were also pursuing their footsteps.
“Let’s begin.” Meng Chuan headed to Heaven and Earth Great Hall and presided over the array formation. He began Archean Eon Realm’s growth once again.

chapters.title: Chapter 646 - Species Impact
chapters.content:
Chapter 646 Species Impact
Meng Chuan’s true body sat cross-legged in the middle of the array formation. The Power of the Sixth Tribulation Essence Soul fused with the array formation, activating it.
The array formation placed a huge burden on Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul. It was as though he was carrying the entire Archean Eon Realm alone.
Boom!
Meng Chuan could clearly sense the entire Archean Eon Realm tremble slightly. Archean Eon Realm—which had been in the doldrums for a long time—was awakened. It was being guided into absorbing the Outer Realm Essence Energy at a thousand-fold greater rate than usual.
At the same time, the treasures around Meng Chuan were gradually absorbed by the array formation and fused with Archean Eon Realm’s Origins.
Archean Eon Realm is transforming. Meng Chuan was delighted.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon had upgraded his homeworld to a middle-level world, leaving behind a rich heritage.
Meng Chuan would allow his homeworld to expand to a middle-sized world’s limits gradually. However, the subsequent expansion would last for 500,000 years. This was a relay between two generations of experts, pushing for the upgrading of the world.
10
What’s going on? Inside Black Sand Grotto-Heaven, Bai Yaoyue was dressed in white, cold as the moon. She left Black Sand Grotto-Heaven and arrived at Black Sand Mountain Range. She stood on the mountain peak and carefully sensed the changes in the world. The entire world is trembling. An unknown change is happening.
What happened? Yan Jin was strolling with his wife when he suddenly looked up in puzzlement.
Archean Eon Realm seems to have undergone a special change. Luo Tang carefully sensed the changes.
As long as one reached the Grotto-Heaven realm, they would be able to sense the drastic changes in Archean Eon Realm. However, they were unable to determine where the changes happened.
This was because Archean Eon Realm mainly focused on strengthening its Origins first. As for the underground becoming deeper and the land expanding; thus. increasing the world’s scale? These changes were very inconspicuous in the early stages.
Three days later.
Meng Chuan summoned all the Regis Godfiends to Archean Mountain.
Meng Chuan looked at the nearly 300 Regis Godfiends below. Although they were still split into three major sects, all the sects’ Regis Godfiends respected Meng Chuan greatly. Even the Supremacies came to listen to Meng Chuan’s lectures.
“I’m not going to lecture this time.” Meng Chuan looked at them and smiled. “I’m going to talk about another important matter.”
“Something important?” The Regis Godfiends below were somewhat puzzled. Yan Jin and Yan Chitong were among them. However, they were the oldest. Furthermore, they had reached the Grotto-Heaven realm in terms of technique. They were one of the few with top strength. Meng Chuan continued, “From today onwards, Regis Godfiends can obtain a rare treasure from the outer realm as long as they reach the Grotto-Heaven realm and have a fifth-level Essence Soul, even if their bodies have aged. These treasures will allow one’s body to return to peak vitality.”
“Return to peak vitality?” The Regis Godfiends present were shocked.
It was very difficult to become a Supremacy. This was because one’s body would slowly decline from its peak after reaching 150 years of age. It was fine in the beginning, but the more one aged, the slimmer their chances of breaking through.
Those around 300 to 400 years—who had physically aged—had nearly negligible chances of becoming Supremacies. Therefore, people like King True Martial—who were late bloomers— typically stopped at the Regis Godfiend realm.
Even in the Demon Realm, many talented demon monarchs stopped at the fifth Firmament realm.
“Imperial Lord, can one obtain rare treasures from the outer realm as long as one has reached the Grotto-Heaven realm and has a fifth-level Essence Soul if they are old?” asked a white-haired elder excitedly.
Meng Chuan nodded.
“Imperial Lord, this is unprecedented,” said an old woman as she stood up. “According to the sect’s records, treasures that can restore one’s peak vitality are extremely precious. If we do this on a large scale, the price will be extremely astonishing.”
“There’s no need to use the sect’s resources. I’ll bear the cost alone,” said Meng Chuan. There was no precedent. This was because birth, aging, sickness, and death were part of the spacetime laws. It cost 100 cubes of rare treasures to restore an average person’s aging body to its peak state. As for Heaven Earth realm Supremacies, they only needed a few hundred cubes to transform their lives into Imperial Lord-level special lifeforms.
A hundred cubes was the equivalent of an Imperial Lord’s entire fortune. “It’s very difficult to become a Supremacy before 200 years of age. However, I believe that 20% to 30% of those who reach the Grotto-Heaven realm and have a fifth-level Essence Soul within 500 years are capable of doing so.”
A young Regis Godfiend stood up and said, “I estimate that there will be 30 to 40 new Regis Godfiends every 100 years. Imperial Lord, can we really afford to restore Regis Godfiends to their peak vitality?”
Under Meng Chuan’s leadership, Archean Eon Realm had given birth to plenty of Regis Godfiends. Furthermore, most of them were born in the past 200 years.
In a few centuries, when Archean Eon Realm was at its peak, it would probably be able to maintain nearly 800 Regis Godfiends at the same time. There would probably be 200 Regis Godfiends that would reach the Grotto-Heaven realm and attain fifth-level Essence Souls before the end of their lifespans.
In 500 years, 20,000 cubes would be needed for 200 Regis Godfiends to recover their peak vitality!
Five thousand years meant 200,000 cubes.
Fifty thousand years meant 2,000,000 cubes.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon allowed the sect to use a very limited number of treasures each year. After all, he had to consider his homeworld’s future. There was a limit to the number of treasures he could give an Imperial Lord or Tribulation Eminence.
Therefore, in Archean Eon Realm’s entire history, they had only been extravagant when Ancestral Master Archean Eon was alive and when Meng Chuan was alive.
When it came to treasures, the Demon Realm was inferior to Archean Eon Realm. Hence, they couldn’t be so extravagant.
“Don’t worry. As long as I’m alive, I’ll bear all the responsibility,” said Meng Chuan calmly. If he had failed to transcend the tribulation previously, Meng Chuan wouldn’t have mentioned it. Now that he had transcended the tribulation, Meng Chuan still had some confidence.
“Thank you, Imperial Lord.”
“Thank you, Imperial Lord.”
Excited and grateful voices immediately resounded.
Although these Regis Godfiends had to consider the species as a whole and felt that Imperial Lord Eastcalm-Meng Chuan-had paid an astonishing price, they were still very excited when Meng Chuan expressed that he wouldn’t use the sect’s treasures and that he would bear the burden alone.
This would change the fate of many Regis Godfiends.
Under normal circumstances, it was extremely difficult for Regis Godfiends to become Supremacies. The ratio was extremely low. It was rare for one in ten to become a Supremacy.
With Meng Chuan’s promise, the ratio increased greatly. Many Regis Godfiends saw hope.
It will cost me a million cubes for 20,000 to 30,000 years. I can still afford this price. Only with enough Supremacies and Imperial Lords can the Godfiend cultivation system be perfected faster.
The Godfiend cultivation system still had many flaws. Only Ancestral Master Archean Eon, Meng Chuan, and Meng An had perfected their bodies.
Meng Chuan naturally created the Chaos Hole realm and Primordial realm because he had created a paramount technique. However, the requirements for this cultivation system were too high. It couldn’t become widespread.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon and Meng An were of the same lineage. They had the Samsara Divine Body as their foundation. After the two of them mastered the Samsara Divine Body, the Samsara Divine Body system became more complete. However, not all humans could cultivate the Samsara Divine Body.
During Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s era, he forged the Samsara Divine Body path. I hope I can open up a few more paths for Archean Eon Realm’s Godfiend cultivation system in my era, thought Meng Chuan. Unfortunately, lifeforms in different worlds have very different body structures. Otherwise, I would be able to find a cultivation system that’s very suitable for humans in Archean Eon Realm.
Some world’s lifeforms weren’t even made of flesh and blood.
Some species had six arms, while others had three eyes... Although they looked similar on the surface, the differences in their body structures were still major.
In the outer realm, cultivation systems common to most species were very rare. Typically, only Eighth Tribulation Eminences could create them.
For example, the Cosmos Body cultivation system’s formulation could be cultivated by any blood and flesh-based lifeforms.
However, the cultivation requirements for powerful formulations were extremely harsh. The Cosmos Body cultivation system had extremely high requirements on one’s Essence Soul. Furthermore, it required external objects like Cosmos Crystals.
Back then, the Cosmos Realm’s ancestor had excavated most of the Cosmos Crystals in the River of Spacetime and moved all of it to the Cosmos Realm. His descendants had been constantly searching for them, so Cosmos Crystals had long been monopolized.
Archean Eon Realm’s history is still short. Since the Demon Realm has a long history, its cultivation system was naturally perfected. I can only expedite the Godfiend cultivation system’s completion. If I want it to be truly perfect, I have to reach the Eighth Tribulation realm, but that’s still too far away for me.
Meng Chuan didn’t have extravagant hopes. He would help his species to the best of his ability. If he were to focus on reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm only, he would only realize that he hadn’t done enough for his species when he was nearing the end of his life. It would be too late for him to help then; it would be too late for regrets.
The rules set by Meng Chuan had far-reaching implications for Archean Eon Realm.
The ancient Regis Godfiends—who were sleeping-were awakened. They had contributed greatly to Archean Eon Realm. As long as they had a fifth-level Essence Soul and had reached the Grotto-Heaven realm, they could consume rare treasures from the outer realm to recover their peak vitality. They could then directly break through to the Supremacy realm.
Yan Chitong only had a fourth-level Essence Soul, so he was naturally lacking.
Yan Jin’s technique realm was high enough. With the help of rare treasures from the outer realm, he broke through to the Supremacy realm.
The number of Supremacies in Archean Eon Realm greatly increased.

chapters.title: Chapter 647 - Letter
chapters.content:
Chapter 647 Letter
Jiang State Capital, Meng Manor. “Eh?” Liu Qiyue—who came out of the chamber-looked at the distant study in surprise. The white-haired Meng Chuan was sitting there, writing something.
He seems to be writing letters? Ah Chuan rarely writes letters. Liu Qiyue was somewhat puzzled. Meng Chuan’s mind covered the entire Archean Eon Realm. If there was anything, he could just send a voice transmission. With his status, it was very rare for him to write letters personally.
Liu Qiyue walked over.
Meng Chuan finished writing a letter with a brush in hand. With a wave of his hand, 62 letters appeared beside him. The same words appeared on every letter.
“Ah Chuan, 63 letters?” Liu Qiyue walked into the study. “Are you sending them to all the Supremacies in Archean Eon Realm?”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Yes.”
After the ancient Regis Godfiends woke up and broke through, Archean Eon Realm had more than 60 Supremacies—an astonishing number. Apart from Liu Qiyue, Meng An, and Meng Dajiang, there were 63 Supremacies.
“This matter is very important, so I have to write to every one of them personally,” said Meng Chuan.
Two World Island.
The black-haired Supremacy Thousand Wood stood in the courtyard.
Fate really makes fools of people. After sleeping for centuries, I actually obtained a rare treasure from the outer realm that restored me to peak vitality and allowed me to break through to the Supremacy realm. I also have a 1,500-year lifespan now. Supremacy Thousand Wood sighed. He had fought in the World Gap with Meng Chuan, King True Martial, King Molten, and King Northcleanse the last time he woke up.
In that battle, the core figure was King True Martial. He and Meng Chuan were equally important. With a sixth-level Essence Soul and the Magic Awl Forbidden Spell, he was extremely powerful among Regis Godfiends.
After the battle, he entered the slumber again. After all, Two World Island placed great importance on such a powerful expert. This time, he was awakened because Imperial Lord Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, had given them rare treasures that allowed them to recover their peak vitality. This allowed them to break through to the Supremacy realm.
When I was young, the war hadn’t even begun. When I reigned supreme in the world, the threat from the demon war wasn’t that threatening. After I woke up after sleeping for centuries, the world was already in chaos. It was the most critical moment.” Supremacy Thousand Wood sighed. “Back then, Meng Chuan was the youngest in our team, and he was already a core figure. Who knew that he would end the war completely and cultivate to an unimaginable realm... According to the records, he’s the strongest expert in Three Bay River System, perhaps the strongest expert in Goddess River Zone.
In the era of war, an impressive hero managed to appear. Supremacy Thousand Wood felt emotional.
Swoosh.
A shadow flew over from afar. It landed to reveal a demon servant.
The demon servant respectfully handed over a letter. “Supremacy Thousand Wood, this is a letter from Imperial Lord Eastcalm.”
“Imperial Lord’s letter?” Supremacy Thousand Wood was astonished. With Meng Chuan’s current status, he could just send a voice transmission if there was anything. Yet, he wrote a letter?
He immediately received it solemnly.
The Power of Essence Soul aura contained within the letter couldn’t be replicated.
“In the outer realm, there’s a mystic realm called Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. Spending ten years there will only be one year in Archean Eon Realm. The cultivation environment there far exceeds Archean Eon Realm. There are many experts there, ones far exceeding Archean Eon Realm.”
Supremacy Thousand Wood read the contents, and his heart stirred.
It was very difficult for Supremacies to become Imperial Lords. In the past, Archean Eon Realm only produced one Imperial Lord every 100,000 years. In total, only one Imperial Lord appeared out of hundreds of Supremacies. They didn’t have any opportunities to cultivate in their homeworld, nor did they have any seniors to guide them. Without any backers, roaming the outer realm meant high mortality rates. For example, the demons were protected by demon Imperial Lords when they roamed the outer realm. In their homeworld, demon Imperial Lords would give lectures. There were even demon Tribulation Eminences guiding them.
The cultivation conditions for both parties were highly disparate.
“We have plenty of resources now. With Imperial Lord Eastcalm’s guidance and Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, I’m afraid one Imperial Lord will appear out of every 20 Supremacies. Ten Supremacies will produce a Heaven Earth Supremacy.” Supremacy Thousand Wood read the letter.
The breakthrough ratio was Meng Chuan’s guess. Combined with Earth Cloud Mystic Realm cultivators’ breakthrough ratio and considering how Archean Eon Realm cultivators had become Supremacies despite the harsh conditions, Meng Chuan believed that they should be able to achieve such a breakthrough ratio. After they had talent generally higher than of Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s Supremacies, and they would receive his nurturing
Even if I want to become a Heaven Earth realm Supremacy, nine out of ten will fail. Should I leave my homeworld and cultivate in a foreign land... Supremacy Thousand Wood pondered. There aren’t many people in the world that I’m concerned about. I’ll head to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm and try my luck.
Supremacy Thousand Wood made his decision.
“Madam, what do you think?”
Yan Jin looked at his wife, Mu Fengxue—who was reading the letter. She looked at his husband. “Do you want to go?”
“It says that time in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm flows ten times faster than Archean Eon Realm’s. In 150 Archean Eon Realm years, 1,500 years will have passed in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm... What’s left of my lifespan will be gone very quickly.” Yan Jin smiled. “Furthermore, I know my limits. Only one in ten can become a Heaven Earth realm Supremacy. There are even fewer who can become an Imperial Lord. I originally relied on outer realm treasures to become a Supremacy. My chances of becoming a Heaven Earth realm Supremacy are very low.”
“To abandon my family for that little hope.” Yan Jin shook his head. “I won’t choose to do so.”
Mu Fengxue looked at Yan Jin. “I’ll cultivate well and become a Supremacy.”
“Yes, you have hope.” Yan Jin looked at his wife.
Mu Fengxue was also a genius disciple of Archean Mountain. She was once Yan Jin’s disciple and had always been with Yan Jin. She was now a Regis Godfiend. Having cultivated for 300 years, she believed that her cultivation had reached its peak, but the rules Meng Chuan had set allowed these Regis Godfiends to see hope. As long as they reached the Grotto-Heaven realm and attained a fifth-level Essence Soul before their demise, they could become Supremacies.
“The letter also mentions that,” said Mu Fengxue, “although it’s very difficult for Supremacies to become Imperial Lords, even Supremacies have a chance of creating a transcendent-grade Godfiend body formulation. For example, the Eon Sea Fiend Body and the Lightning Devastator Fiend Body... Nearly half of transcendent-grade Godfiend bodies were created by Supremacies. “Instead, many Imperial Lords in human history have never created a transcendent-grade Godfiend body formulation. As long as you can create one, you will be given treasures according to your contributions.”
“Yes.” Yan Jin nodded. “I knew Meng Chuan when we were young. I know his temperament very well. He has sacrificed his entire life for humanity. He probably wants to create enough Godfiend body systems to perfect the Godfiend cultivation system.”
Out of the 12 transcendent-grade Godfiend bodies, two required the dragon and phoenix bloodlines. Therefore, strictly speaking, there were only ten transcendent-grade Godfiend bodies.
Meng Chuan naturally had hope for every human Supremacy. Similarly, he wouldn’t be stingy with his bestowments.
“I won’t go to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, but I’ll give creating a transcendent-grade Godfiend body a try. After becoming a Supremacy, I also feel that the Azure Lotus Divine Body doesn’t have a high compatibility with me,” said Yan Jin. Back then, he could only choose one Godfiend body that was relatively more compatible out of the ten transcendent-grade Godfiend bodies. He had failed to cultivate the Azure Lotus Divine Body to perfection. Only he could create a perfect compatibility with it.
Earth Cloud Mystic Realm? This is a good opportunity. Bai Yaoyue read the letter’s description. She was extremely talented, and she clearly felt that she was extremely close to attaining a Heaven Earth realm ultimate technique. She knew that she was just short of breaking through to create a Heaven Earth realm ultimate technique. Earth Cloud Mystic Realm—which had a better cultivation environment—had clearly given her hope.
I never expected that the child Nianyun gave birth to would completely change Archean Eon Realm and my fate. Bai Yaoyue sighed. Who would have thought that Bai Nianyun would marry a mortal like Meng Dajiang and give birth to such a dazzling figure in Archean Eon Realm’s history?
These Supremacies made their own decisions. Some wanted to stay in their homeworld to nurture their sect’s future talents and lead peaceful lives. This was because the war had gone on for too long.
Some wanted to challenge themselves and improve.
On a snowy day, 34 Supremacies gathered at Archean Mountain’s Grotto-Heaven Pavilion.
“Everyone.” Meng Chuan looked at the people in front of him.
Qin Wu, Luo Tang, Bai Yaoyue, Jing Fei, and the other older Supremacies were present. There were also Supremacies like King Thousand Wood, King Transcendence, King Northcleanse, and some other sleeping Regis Godfiends who had broken through. There were also some young Supremacies who were in high spirits.
“I hope that you can become a Heaven Earth realm Supremacy or an Imperial Lord,” said Meng Chuan. “I also hope that you can perfect the Godfiend cultivation system for humans. We need pioneers to forge and open up a path. In the future, your descendants will be able to cultivate a perfected Godfiend cultivation system.”
The Supremacies present were excited. They had their own goals. Earth Cloud Mystic Realm was a bigger world.
“After every century in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, I will send people back to Archean Eon Realm.” Meng Chuan looked at everyone. “Whoever wants to return can take this opportunity.”
The Supremacies nodded slightly.
“Let’s go.” Meng Chuan stored everyone into his mobile grotto-heaven. Following that, his Essence Soul avatar left Archean Eon Realm and headed for Earth Cloud Mystic Realm.
...
Fiend Mountain.
Fiend Mountain was desolate. Meng Chuan was the only living creature with intelligence.
In the entire River of Spacetime, only about 100 people could enter and exit Fiend Mountain normally. All of them had rather high statuses. Ordinary Sixth Tribulation Eminences had never heard of Fiend Mountain.
Those existences had high statuses, so they didn’t pay much attention to the weapons and items left behind on Fiend Mountain. However, Meng Chuan’s outer realm true body came to search for treasures.
In order to nurture the Regis Godfiends and Supremacies, I have to do my best to pick up what’s left behind. Meng Chuan spent a month foraging each time before leaving Fiend Mountain. He would enter again after his Essence Soul recovered to its peak.
Although Fiend Mountain was harmful to one’s Essence Soul, the mountain range’s periphery had a very low impact on one’s Essence Soul. In the early days, Black Wind and company had stayed in the periphery for quite some time. Furthermore, Meng Chuan was at the Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation realm.
His willpower was high enough, and he could quickly recover from staying in the periphery for a month after leaving Fiend Mountain. Of course, he didn’t dare enter the path of epiphany. If he reached the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm, he could enter the entire Fiend Mountain as he pleased.
After three months of hard work, I’ve only picked up treasures worth 150,000 cubes in total. I reckon there aren’t many treasures left in the periphery of Fiend Mountain. Meng Chuan sighed. The good days of picking up treasures were almost gone. It wasn’t easy for a Sixth Tribulation Eminence to accumulate treasures either.

chapters.title: Chapter 648 - 25,000 Kilometers on Fiend Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 648 25,000 Kilometers on Fiend Mountain
The reason why Meng Chuan’s outer realm true body didn’t cultivate on Fiend Mountain’s path of the mind was that he didn’t want to affect his homeworld’s true body, which was studying the Void Catalog.
On the path of the mind, the mountaintop’s voice constantly attacked his Essence Soul. The interference was too great. Meng Chuan undoubtedly gave the comprehension of the Void Catalog top priority.
The Void Catalog is the most precious manual I’ve obtained to date. Meng Chuan was enamored by it. Although he had memorized all three volumes with a single glance at his cultivation realm, he had taken a long time studying every word and every painting. He even went to a Chaos Hole’s depths, Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, and the Great Seal Eternal treasure to verify his ideas.
Concrete verification was actually more important. If one were to enter seclusion and meditate, they would only deviate further and become closer to fantasy. The ideas one came up with would be different from the real laws.
Only by putting his deductions into practice could Meng Chuan understand which were right and which were wrong. He would also understand which direction he should take. If he meditated for a year, he might spend ten to twenty years doing experiments. This was followed by meditation and verifications again... This cycle continued without end.
This was how cultivation was. One relied on a slow accumulation over a long period of time. As one’s accumulations deepened, success would naturally follow. Meng Chuan was afraid that his accumulation process would stagnate, preventing him from advancing any further. However, he constantly improved while studying the Void Catalog! It was as though an Eternal existence was carefully teaching him... He had to be fully focused during his meditation, unwilling to be disturbed by anything. However, he only needed to split a portion of his mental strength to verify his insights when carrying out experiments. He could cultivate the path of the mind at the same time. He could even study the Great Seal Eternal treasure, cultivate the Pupil of Darkness mystic technique, cultivate in the Chaos Hole’s depths, and verify his insights in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm simultaneously.
It was very easy for an Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence to do thousands of tasks simultaneously.
Time passed. In the blink of an eye, Meng Chuan spent 600 years cultivating; fifty years had passed in the outside world.
This was mainly because the time flow was very fast in the Chaos Hole’s depths. Meng Chuan experienced a thousand-fold faster time flow in the Chaos Hole’s depths. Even if he occasionally went there, he still consumed his lifespan extremely quickly. However, the deeper he went into the Chaos Hole, the more spacetime distorted. As someone who wanted to comprehend a Chaos Hole law, he often went to the Chaos Hole’s depths.
Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, Realm Palace.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in front of the lake. However, his consciousness descended upon a dangerous area in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s Heaven realm—the Dark Maze. He practiced void techniques in the Dark Maze.
Condense.
In the Dark Maze, spacetime was chaotic and unpredictable. It was the perfect place for studying time and space.
As the mystic realm’s owner, Meng Chuan could easily control the entire Dark Maze. At that moment, he condensed a void blade with a thought. The void blade—which was difficult to see with the naked eye-seemed to condense the void billions of times, completely turning it into a weapon.
The ordinary void was very weak. Even Supremacies could tear through it. It was like water in the River of Spacetime. When the void condensed into a weapon, it was like water forming a water blade. Mortals could easily splash water, but when a water blade had condensed, it could easily slice through things that were hundreds or thousands of times tougher than mortals.
It was the same for the void blade. It was terrifyingly sharp.
Split. Meng Chuan sent another thought. The void no longer remained condensed and compressed. Instead, it split apart. It was completely separated. From the outermost layer to the bottommost layer, the void was separated. When the void was separated, a new void would naturally appear. It was like a patch.
When the void was split apart, the living beings and matter that lived in space would be split into two. This was an even more terrifying method of splitting.
As the mystic realm’s owner, my control over the laws is much stronger. However, I can’t do it in the outside world. Meng Chuan carefully experienced it. In the mystic realm, his strength soared to the level of a Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
Anyone below the Seventh Tribulation realm would be sending themselves to their deaths if they entered. Therefore, this was the most suitable place for long-term experimentation.
Huh?
Meng Chuan suddenly turned his head and looked at a spot in the distance. In the depths of his eyes were extremely complicated runes. There were billions of runes, and they were formed layer by layer. These runes were formed by Meng Chuan’s cultivation of the Pupil of Darkness. As his understanding of spatial laws deepened, he also became more proficient with the mystic technique.
Meng Chuan had reached the 63rd level of the Pupil of Darkness—which had a total of 90 levels. This represented his realm. However, as a willpower-type mystic technique, its strength was mainly determined by one’s willpower.
The mystic technique was like a weapon. Meng Chuan’s willpower was like a weapon-wielding hand. By cultivating the Pupil of Darkness to this level, obtaining it was a natural result during his experimentations.
Master summoned me? Meng Chuan looked into the distance and took a step forward, arriving at Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. In the Earth realm, Qin Wu lived in seclusion at a beautiful valley.
“Master, you were looking for me?” Meng Chuan smiled as he walked over.
Qin Wu looked at Meng Chuan and nodded slightly. “I have something to trouble you with.”
“What’s the matter?” Meng Chuan was astonished. His master, Qin Wu, wasn’t one who was willing to request help. Just like how he had long prepared longevity extension treasures for his master, his master wasn’t willing to use them either.
After coming to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, Qin Wu cultivated in a far more crazy manner. There were many cultivation treasures in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. Under Meng Chuan’s arrangements, Qin Wu could choose any one of them. He entered all the areas that could aid his Essence Soul cultivation.
Land of Nightmare, Secular World Painting...
Qin Wu didn’t hesitate at all in visiting all these places—even if death was a possibility.
Meng Chuan could do nothing about it. Fortune and disaster were two sides of the same coin. Many cultivation lands were accompanied by danger, yet Qin Wu managed to survive. Furthermore, he had attained a seventh-level Essence Soul before the end of his lifespan. He managed to reach the Imperial Lord realm through his efforts alone. “It’s Luo Tang.” Qin Wu looked at Meng Chuan. “I once told her that I gained a lot from the Secular World Painting. She also entered, but she ended up with mental demons.”
Mental demons? Meng Chuan was taken aback.
“She’s currently traveling alone.” Qin Wu sighed. “Her personality has changed drastically because of this.”
Meng Chuan nodded. With a thought, he locked onto Supremacy Luo Tang.
Luo Tang—who was dressed in a yellow robestood on a mountain as she blankly stared at the cultivators fighting in the distance.
Whoosh.
With a thought, Luo Tang was teleported, and she appeared in the valley. Luo Tang also saw Meng Chuan and Qin Wu.
“Meng Chuan, Qin Wu.” Luo Tang nodded slightly.
“Can I see your Essence Soul?” asked Meng Chuan. “Perhaps I need to see your memories after you came to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm.”
Luo Tang nodded and said calmly, “Alright, but I don’t think you can help me.”
Meng Chuan looked at her.
His Power of Essence Soul instantly seeped into Luo Tang’s body. Luo Tang’s Essence Soul looked like a bright flower, but it was somewhat dispirited.
Her Essence Soul isn’t injured, and it isn’t affected by external forces. In that case, it’s because of her memories? With a thought, Meng Chuan finished reading all her memories in the blink of an eye.
“Luo Tang.” Meng Chuan said, “Your experiences in the Secular World Painting caused your personality to change. As long as you remove all memories related to the Secular World Painting, you will naturally recover slowly.” “There’s no need. That memory is very beautiful.” Luo Tang smiled. “I don’t want to remove this precious memory. Meng Chuan, I know my limits. My talent is far inferior to Qin Wu’s. When placed in human history, I’m only an ordinary Supremacy. Ever since I came to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm to cultivate, I’ve found myself very far from the Heaven Earth realm. My Essence Soul has stagnated at the fifth-level Essence Soul realm. In the future, I want to return to Archean Eon Realm and spend the rest of my life back home.”
After cultivating in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm for 500 years, Luo Tang had completely recognized her potential.
Meng Chuan nodded. “Alright.”
He also knew that only one in ten Supremacies that came to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm would reach the Heaven Earth realm. Luo Tang was indeed inferior.
Even the Demon Annihilation Guild Master, Jing Fei—who was more talented than Luo Tang—failed to reach the Heaven Earth realm a few years ago. When he only had about 30 years left to live, he returned to Archean Eon Realm.
“Do you still want to stay in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm? I can send you back at any time,” said Meng Chuan. Although he had stipulated a return every 100 years, Supremacy Luo Tang was an exception.
“I’ll go back now.” Luo Tang smiled slightly at Qin Wu.
Meng Chuan sent another Essence Soul avatar to leave Earth Cloud Mystic Realm with Luo Tang.
“It’s truly very difficult to cultivate to the Imperial Lord realm,” said Qin Wu with a sigh. “Most of them stop at the Supremacy realm. Even I’m considered quite talented. If it weren’t for the supplementary treasures you gave me and the special lands in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, I wouldn’t have been able to become an Imperial Lord.”
Qin Wu knew very well that his limit was becoming a Heaven Earth realm Supremacy before his end.
“Master, it’s relatively easier to cultivate as an Imperial Lord,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “In the outer realm, one out of ten Imperial Lords can reach the Tribulation realm.”
Supremacies needed to break through from the perfected Grotto-Heaven realm to the Heaven Earth realm.
Their Essence Souls needed to reach the seventh level. The two thresholds were a qualitative transformation, making it very difficult.
An Imperial Lord needed to reach the perfected Heaven Earth realm from the Heaven Earth realm’s early stage. After all, one only needed to reach the perfected Heaven Earth realm on a single path. If one’s body was perfected, they could naturally transcend the tribulation. “Let’s hope so. If I can reach the Tribulation realm, we’ll have another Godfiend body that can reach the Tribulation realm.” Qin Wu was also looking forward to it.
The path of the mind in Fiend Mountain.
Meng Chuan walked.
The Supremacies in my homeworld-Luo Tang, Jing Fei, and the others—have all aged. Meng Chuan also knew that many of his old friends would die. In the future, Archean Eon Realm would be filled with the younger generation.
This is time.
Meng Chuan continued walking on the path of the mind. Suddenly, he was stunned. At a glance, he saw that the path of the mind and the path of epiphany had merged into a single path further up on Fiend Mountain, just below the lingering clouds.
After 25,000 kilometers, the path of the mind and the path of epiphany actually merge into one? Meng Chuan was somewhat shocked. He wasn’t aware of this previously.
Due to Meng Chuan painting Perfection and creating his own Essence Soul formulation, his willpower had improved greatly. In addition, his understanding of spacetime had improved after studying the Void Catalog over the past few years. This improved Meng Chuan’s willpower slightly. Therefore, it was very easy for Meng Chuan to walk the path of the mind. The path of the mind didn’t provide much help to his Essence Soul. Therefore, he walked very quickly early on. He only slowed down when he reached 21,500 kilometers.
Meng Chuan had already walked nearly 25,000 kilometers. With his vision, he could vaguely see that the path of the mind and the path of epiphany merged as one around the spot at the 25,000-kilometer-mark in the clouds.
Realm Ancestor said that one’s willpower is at the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm’s threshold once they can travel 25,000 kilometers on the path of the mind. Could he be referring to this merging point? Meng Chuan looked into the distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 649 - Fiend Mountain Core Member
chapters.content:
Chapter 649 Fiend Mountain Core Member
I’m only about 1,000 to 1,500 kilometers away from the intersection. Meng Chuan calmed down and continued walking slowly.
The voice coming from the mountaintop rumbled in his sea of consciousness as each intonation struck Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul. Due to the change in his Essence Soul structure and willpower, his perception of the intonations became clearer.
Meng Chuan spent a long time carefully studying after every step of the path before taking the next step. This continued for more than six years. Although he had some gains, his mind and willpower didn’t transform. At his current realm, it was increasingly difficult for Meng Chuan’s willpower to transform.
I’m here.
Meng Chuan looked at the three paths on Fiend Mountain. Two of the paths—the path of the mind and the path of epiphany-had completely merged into one.
The path of epiphany brings endless trouble. However, Realm Ancestor has also said that the path of the mind is the only path on Fiend Mountain that doesn’t have any future troubles. Many Seventh Tribulation Eminences will take a walk to see if they can reach the mountaintop to test their willpower. Clearly, one can take the path of the mind all the way to the mountaintop.
The higher one’s realm was, the greater their resistance to harm.
For example, Fu Sui and many other Fifth Tribulation Eminences were still very weak in terms of body, Essence Soul, and willpower. If they took the path of epiphany, they would naturally be plagued by endless troubles. As for those who could withstand 25,000 kilometers on the path of the mind, their resistance was naturally different.
I’ll give it a try. Meng Chuan took a step forward.
With one step, he walked from the path of the mind to the two paths that converged. The moment Meng Chuan stepped onto the path, he felt something different.
The sound he heard wasn’t much different. After all, he had only taken one more step. Meng Chuan could still resist the influence on his Essence Soul fairly easily, but he could sense an invisible force affecting his Essence Soul. It made his Essence Soul somewhat ethereal. The speed at which his thoughts circulated increased. His perception of the intonations increased by more than ten-fold.
It affects my Essence Soul somewhat. I’ve gained a lot more insights, but I’m still far from experiencing an epiphany. Meng Chuan was somewhat surprised. It’s even worse than the first step I took on the path of epiphany back then.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul and willpower were much stronger than when he was at the Fifth Tribulation realm.
The path of epiphany’s effects at the intersection is already unable to achieve the effect of epiphany. If another Seventh Tribulation Eminence came, the path of epiphany’s effects would be even lower. Just as Meng Chuan was feeling the intersection’s effects, a mysterious and ancient voice suddenly sounded in his mind.
“Having walked half the path of Fiend Mountain, you may become a core member of my Fiend Mountain.”
At the same time, a mystic technique entered Meng Chuan’s mind. With this mystic technique, he could bring outsiders into Fiend Mountain.
Boom!
Following that, a large amount of information surged into Meng Chuan’s mind. It took Meng Chuan a few seconds to memorize the plethora of information. Our universe has a Chaos Turbid River? Meng Chuan was shocked.
According to the information, core members of Fiend Mountain could head to the Chaos Turbid River if they obtained the mystic technique. The Chaos Turbid River was a mysterious place in the universe. It was connected to areas beyond the universe, and forbidden creatures could enter the universe through the Chaos Turbid River. So forbidden creatures are actually called Chaos creatures. Meng Chuan was somewhat shocked. This is a huge secret. It’s a secret that most Sixth Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime likely don’t know about. Chaos creatures are lifeforms that live outside the universe. The Chaos Turbid River is set up by Eighth Tribulation Eminences. Therefore, those Chaos creatures are unable to charge out of the Chaos Turbid River. Even us cultivators can only enter the Chaos Turbid River with the mystic technique left behind by an Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
He could enter the Chaos Turbid River and kill Chaos creatures.
A Sixth Tribulation Chaos creature-a forbidden creature—had a Life Core hidden within. One had to shatter the Life Core in order to kill it completely.
A Seventh Tribulation Chaos creature (forbidden creature) had an even stranger Life Core. It began to transform into a conceptualized law. Even a Seventh Tribulation Eminence couldn’t completely shatter it. They could only seal it before destroying the will contained within the Life Core. Fiend Mountain’s owner had imparted the sealing technique and the trick to destroying the Life Core’s will, but Meng Chuan’s realm was clearly still far from being able to use this technique.
Fiend Mountain’s owner bought all Life Core fragments.
Sixth Tribulation Chaos Life Core fragments, Seventh Tribulation Chaos Life Cores, and so on could be exchanged for many treasures from Fiend Mountain’s owner.
For example, Eighth Tribulation treasures could be obtained by directly entering the depths of Fiend Mountain. If one had ten complete Seventh Tribulation Chaos creature Life Cores or 1,000 Sixth Tribulation Chaos creature Life Cores, they could summon Fiend Mountain’s owner from the depths of Fiend Mountain. Fiend Mountain’s owner would directly come to this timeline and meet the summoner.
Ten Seventh Tribulation Chaos creature Life Cores allows one to make a direct request to meet the owner of Fiend Mountain? Meng Chuan sighed inwardly. Ordinary treasure exchanges can be done in the depths of Fiend Mountain? From the looks of it, there are many treasures hidden in the depths of Fiend Mountain.
Thinking of Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures, one could imagine how astonishing the treasures left behind by the owner of Fiend Mountain were.
As long as he was still alive, no one dared to barge into Fiend Mountain. After all, it could result in Fiend Mountain’s owner descending to this point in time if one attempted to barge in forcefully.
It’s no wonder that no top cultivator dares to destroy Fiend Mountain, despite it being such a great calamity. Meng Chuan sighed inwardly. The reduction of if its influence probably was a result of other Eighth Tribulation Eminences’ decisions. A Seventh Tribulation Eminence probably didn’t have the guts to do so.
There had been endless disasters in the history of Fiend Mountain. Perhaps it had caused the other Eighth Tribulation Eminences in this universe to be unhappy. In the end, they decided to try their best to hide the existence of Fiend Mountain and prevent cultivators from entering on a large scale.
Chaos Turbid River? Forbidden creatures are very rare in our universe. It turns out that almost all of them are in the Chaos Turbid River. Furthermore, they are blocked by an array formation. I wonder how the forbidden creatures scattered across the universe broke out of the array formation.
Also, what’s up with these crazy forbidden creatures on Fiend Mountain? Why does Fiend Mountain’s owner collect a large number of forbidden creature Life Cores? Are these Life Core fragments of great use to an Eighth Tribulation Eminence like him? Meng Chuan had many guesses.
With a flip of his hand, an extremely small fragment appeared in Meng Chuan’s hand.
This was what Meng Chuan had obtained when he swept through Three Bay River System’s plundering factions. Back then, a wine cup shard had allowed Demon Slayer to absorb a large amount of baneful aura, greatly increasing Demon Slayer’s strength.
However, Meng Chuan didn’t spend too much effort on studying physical body formulations. Therefore, he didn’t spend much effort nurturing a melee weapon like Demon Slayer either. But after reaching the Sixth Tribulation realm, Demon Slayer also received normal nurturing, allowing it to become a Sixth Tribulation treasure.
Back then, Meng Chuan had kept a few shards. According to Eternal Tower, they were a Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature’s Life Core fragments.
Different Sixth Tribulation forbidden creatures had very different fragments.
Some of the baneful auras were terrifying, while others emanated a cold aura. Some were even scorching hot. It wasn’t easy to find a single type of baneful aura. Hence, Meng Chuan didn’t deliberately bulk-purchase them.
A forbidden creature’s Life Core seems very special. Meng Chuan flipped his hand and put away the small fragment. He hesitated.
Every core member will receive an opportunity from Fiend Mountain’s owner.
Among the large amounts of information Meng Chuan had obtained, he had an opportunity to head to the Land of Foulbone.
According to the opportunity’s description, there were many dangers hidden in the Land of Foulbone. Similarly, there were fortuitous encounters. Whether one died in the Land of Foulbone or made great harvests depended on one’s strength and luck.
“I’ve never heard of the Land of Foulbone,” said Meng Chuan after some thought. “Free benefits from becoming a core member of Fiend Mountain? This doesn’t match the style of Fiend Mountain’s owner.”
After all this, Meng Chuan could sense that Fiend Mountain’s owner didn’t care about the lives of cultivators. He didn’t care even if billions of cultivators died from madness.
The so-called core members of Fiend Mountain were also further enticed by Fiend Mountain’s owner to help him kill forbidden creatures and collect Life Cores.
Even the weakest creature in a place like the Chaos Turbid River is a Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature. There are also Seventh Tribulation forbidden creatures. As a newly-advanced Sixth Tribulation Eminence, I should stay far away for the time being. At the very least, I must have the confidence to kill a Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature in a short period of time before I can give it a try.
If I were to attempt killing an ordinary Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature now, I might have to engage in a nasty battle, resulting in me attracting over 100 forbidden creatures. I might even attract Seventh Tribulation forbidden creatures. Isn’t that courting death?
I can send an Essence Soul avatar to the Land of Foulbone to give it a try.
Just as Meng Chuan was digesting a large amount of informationAt an altitude of about 45,000 kilometers on Fiend Mountain, the three paths had long merged together. A man-who looked like a meatball-stood there. He had a pair of short legs and six arms, but he only had one large eye. This large eye was currently looking at Meng Chuan.
“City Lord Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, a newly-advanced Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence. He actually reached the midway point of Fiend Mountain?” His mouth widened as he laughed. “The owner of Fiend Mountain should have given him an opportunity? What a coincidence that I happened to encounter him.”

chapters.title: Chapter 650 - Survival of the Strong
chapters.content:
Chapter 650 Survival of the Strong
Meng Chuan continued walking and took in the louder voice from the mountaintop. Suddenly, he was slightly stunned as he looked up.
Whoosh.
A meatball – like figure flew down from above. A smile appeared on the figure’s face. However, the pressure produced by the figure made Meng Chuan’s heart tremble uncontrollably. It was like an ant encountering a terrifying monster charging at him. The wind carried by the figure could crush him.
What a terrifying aura. Meng Chuan was alarmed.
He had seen Realm Ancestor, Hall Lord Blazing Sun, and Mountain Lord Moxie, but he had never seen anyone with such a strong aura. Perhaps Sixth Tribulation Eminences with weaker wills would be dazed for some time when they encountered him.
“Greetings, Guild Master, I’m Eastcalm.” Meng Chuan immediately bowed when he saw the other party. There were only over 20 Seventh Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime. All of them were legends. The meatball-like existence in front of him had once stood at the peak of the River of Spacetime for a short period of time! He was Guild Master Fiend Eye.
Over 80,000 years ago, Guild Master Fiend Eye
—who had only cultivated for 30,000 yearswas unspokenly the strongest in the River of Spacetime. He was the strongest expert at the Physical Body Seventh Tribulation realm. Only Realm Ancestor could match him!
For a period of time, many Sixth Tribulation Eminences had submitted to Guild Master Fiend Eye. Even some Seventh Tribulation Eminences had followed Guild Master Fiend Eye when they were still weak.
Later on, Guild Master Fiend Eye vanished!
He vanished for nearly 30,000 years. Although one of his true bodies was in his homeworld, he never showed himself. The outside world couldn’t see him at all. Therefore, the largest faction-Fiend Eye Guild-collapsed.
During his disappearance, Ancestral Magus King had obtained an Eternal existence’s legacy, the Magus lineage. His strength improved further, and he wasn’t inferior to the Guild Master Fiend Eye before he disappeared. He became the strongest expert at the Physical Body Seventh Tribulation realm back then. He had also enjoyed tens of thousands of years of glory... Back then, Realm Ancestor was still the strongest expert at the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm.
Later on, it was the rise of Celestial Thearch Myriad Star and Hall Lord White Avian. The birth of two half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences completely suppressed the present world.
During the nearly 30,000 years of Guild Master Fiend Eye’s disappearance, there were all sorts of legends circulating in the outside world. Some guessed that he had suffered very serious injuries. Later, he left his homeworld and rebuilt the Fiend Eye Guild. He publicly admitted that he had once left the universe due to an opportunity. He encountered a powerful enemy somewhere beyond the universe and suffered very serious injuries. Even though he had stabilized his injuries, his strength had declined. He was much more low-key and reserved as a result. His power once enveloped the River of Spacetime. Now, he had restrained himself a lot more. He always claimed to have the strength of an ordinary Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
However, no one dared to underestimate him. After all, he had the strength of Ancestral Magus King 80,000 years ago. Even if he was heavily injured, who knew what other hidden means he had after cultivating for 80,000 years?
In the River of Spacetime, apart from the two publicly recognized strongest experts, there were seven peak Seventh Tribulation Eminences. Some were Ancestral Magus King, Realm Ancestor, Palace Lady Blood Phoenix, and Origins Realm’s leader. Guild Master Fiend Eye wasn’t included because he had never revealed peak Seventh Tribulation strength after he recovered from his injuries. However, all the factions were afraid of him.
“City Lord Eastcalm, Meng Chuan.” Fiend Eye’s mouth widened as he smiled happily. “The younger generation is truly impressive. After cultivating for about 3,000 years, you can already traverse half of Fiend Mountain. Seeing you just makes me feel like we are getting older.”
“Guild Master, you reached the Seventh Tribulation realm after cultivating for a little more than 10,000 years. You’re much better than me,” said Meng Chuan humbly. Guild Master Fiend Eye had given himself the name ‘Fiend Eye’ because he didn’t hide his fiendish nature in everything he did. He thought nothing of it. Facing such an existence, Meng Chuan was naturally more cautious with his words.
“Haha...” Guild Master Fiend Eye smiled and said, “You might become a Seventh Tribulation Eminence in the future as well.”
“Guild Master, you flatter me,” said Meng Chuan.
“Since you were able to cross half of Fiend Mountain, you should have obtained an opportunity bestowed by Fiend Mountain’s owner, right?” Fiend Eye looked at Meng Chuan. “Back then, we obtained an opportunity after traversing half of Fiend Mountain.”
Meng Chuan knew that he couldn’t hide it from Fiend Eye. Thus, he nodded and said, “Yes.”
“Hand this opportunity to me,” said Guild Master Fiend Eye with a smile. “Hand it over to you?” Meng Chuan was slightly taken aback.
To be honest, Meng Chuan was wary of Fiend Mountain’s owner.
The so-called opportunities set up by Fiend Mountain’s owner caused the deaths of countless Tribulation Eminences. So to say that he was kind enough to give out opportunities? Furthermore, Fiend Mountain’s owner had already said that blessings and disasters were two sides of the same coin in the Land of Foulbone. What one obtained depended on their abilities and luck.
Meng Chuan was still willing to sell a fortuitous encounter-one that contained blessings and disasters on two sides of the same coin-for real benefits. After all, many benefits in the River of Spacetime were monopolized by the current Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
“May I know what conditions you have to offer?” asked Meng Chuan.
“Conditions?” Guild Master Fiend Eye looked at Meng Chuan and smiled. “Young fellow, are you negotiating with me? Does not killing you count as a condition?” Meng Chuan was stunned. Does not killing you count as a condition?
Guild Master Fiend Eye smiled at Meng Chuan. “The entire universe, and even beyond the universe is like a huge jungle. The strong plunder the weak. It’s already benevolent of me to spare your life. You are only a newly-advanced Sixth Tribulation Eminence. You are still weak. Isn’t it only right for you to obediently hand over your opportunities in front of me? The top resources in the River of Spacetime are all monopolized by Seventh Tribulation Eminences. Even if they accidentally land in the hands of a Sixth Tribulation Eminence, they will be snatched away by a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Without strength... you have no right to possess treasures. Otherwise, you will be seeking death.”
Meng Chuan looked at him.
“You haven’t cultivated for long, so you haven’t experienced many hardships,” said Fiend Eye. “Hand over the opportunity obediently.”
“Isn’t this too much?” asked Meng Chuan. “Too much? That’s very normal. If you are stronger than me in the future, such as becoming an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, I’ll be very happy to have you kill me,” said Guild Master Fiend Eye with a smile. “I’ll have no qualms about dying at the hands of an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. Clearly, you are weaker than me. You only have two choices now.
“One is to reject me. I will wipe out all your avatars in the outer realm and send out a kill order. Your homeworld’s faction will also be hunted down. Don’t even think of letting a single member of your species enter the outer realm. As long as I’m alive, you can only stay in your homeworld forever. Likewise for your homeworld’s members; they will be unable to take a step out into the outer realm.” Meng Chuan didn’t say a word and just listened. He had heard of such cases. Once someone angered a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, the latter would issue a kill order and personally deal with the Sixth Tribulation Eminence. A Sixth Tribulation Eminence could forget about having an avatar cultivating outside peacefully.
Once they left their homeworld, they would be wiped out. Seventh Tribulation Eminences disdained dealing with Supremacies and Imperial Lords, but Seventh Tribulation Eminences had a large group of Sixth Tribulation Eminences and Fifth Tribulation Eminences under their command. These subordinates could quickly wipe out all the target’s homeworld factions.
If he were trapped in his homeworld and unable to roam the outer realm to experience all kinds of scenarios, he would only be able to unleash a tenth of his potential. Meng Chuan’s chances of reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm would greatly decrease.
“The other is to agree to my request and obediently hand over the opportunity,” said Fiend Eye with a smile. “Consider this as me teaching you to adapt to the River of Spacetime’s rules.”
Meng Chuan looked at him and calmly said, “I refuse!”

chapters.title: Chapter 651 - Peering into the Future
chapters.content:
Chapter 651 Peering into the Future
“Refuse?” Guild Master Fiend Eye’s single eye examined Meng Chuan, and he smiled. “You seem to be very confident? Tell me what’s backing you. Perhaps I’ll change my mind.”
Meng Chuan looked at the other party. The intelligence had long recorded that the Guild Master Fiend Eye had a fiendish and capricious personality. This was also one of the reasons why the Fiend Eye Guild collapsed after he hid for nearly 30,000 years. None of the Eminences who followed Guild Master Fiend Eye had any loyalty to him. This was because Fiend Eye never cared about relationships. He only cared about tangible benefits.
“You want to destroy all my avatars?” said Meng Chuan. “I’m an Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence. I can produce Essence Soul avatars with a thought. How many can you destroy?”
“If any one of you comes out, I’ll capture one alive and seal it.” Fiend Eye smiled at Meng Chuan. “If I capture nine of you alive, won’t you only have one true body left in your homeworld? I only need to attack nine times. It’s not troublesome.”
Meng Chuan said indifferently, “One of my Essence Soul avatars will be left in Eternal Tower’s River of Spacetime headquarters. Can you kill it?”
“There are only a limited number of cultivation opportunities in Eternal Tower’s River of Spacetime headquarters,” said Fiend Eye casually. “You can only cultivate in your homeworld and the River of Spacetime headquarters. You can’t go to the many magical places in the outer realm. How far can you cultivate with such limitations? You probably have no hope of reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm.”
Yes.
If Meng Chuan’s range of activity was limited to his homeworld-Archean Eon Realm-and Eternal Tower’s headquarters in the River of Spacetime, Meng Chuan’s cultivation conditions would be much more inferior. For example, he couldn’t go to the Valley of Spacetime or many mystical places, nor could he go to a Chaos Hole’s depths... To Meng Chuan, who wanted to comprehend the Chaos Hole law, his chances of reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm would indeed decrease greatly.
“Guild Master, what do you think of this move of mine?” Meng Chuan stood where he was as the surrounding void distorted. If one was weak, they wouldn’t be able to tell, but Fiend Eye could tell at a glance that the surrounding void fluctuations were completely restrained. Furthermore, the void had been sliced into tens of thousands of layers. Meng Chuan’s figure could be seen in every layer of space.
Fiend Eye’s single eye was colored in astonishment. He nodded and gave his evaluation. “Domain of the void, control over the void, and void traversal. You have comprehended the spatial law’s three tenets sufficiently well.” Meng Chuan had long grasped the spatial law’s three tenets. After obtaining the Void Catalog’s remaining two volumes, he had cultivated for more than 600 years. Meng Chuan had accumulated enough insights into the other two aspects as well. This was the use of the Void Catalog. Without such a brilliant legacy, it would probably take him several times longer to reach the same realm.
“I’ve only cultivated for 3,000 years,” said Meng Chuan indifferently. “I’ve long obtained the complete Void Catalog. With my insights into the Dao of Space and the fact that I can cultivate in Eternal Tower’s River of Spacetime headquarters, do you think I have a chance of grasping a spatial law in 10,000 years?”
Since he couldn’t enter a Chaos Hole’s depths to cultivate, his chances of grasping a Chaos Hole law would greatly decrease. However, space was everywhere.
With his current insights and talent, together with the Void Catalog’s guidance, Meng Chuan was confident that he could buy a large number of resources from the River of Spacetime’s headquarters even if he couldn’t go to many places.
“In 10,000 years?” Fiend Eye looked at Meng Chuan.
“As long as I grasp the spatial law, will you be able to capture my Essence Soul avatars alive?” Meng Chuan looked at him.
A spatial law implied complete control over space. With a spatial law, one could exchange blows with a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. If the situation wasn’t good, one could instantly destroy an Essence Soul avatar. Fiend Eye had no way of capturing an existence who grasped the spatial law alive before they could react.
no
“After grasping the spatial law, I can constantly send my avatars to various places in the outer realm,” said Meng Chuan. “When the time comes, will you be pursuing my avatars all the time and not do anything else?”
Fiend Eye was a Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence. His homeworld had one true body, leaving only one true body available in the outer realm. He had no time to do anything else if he kept pursuing Meng Chuan.
Therefore, even Seventh Tribulation Eminences found it difficult to threaten Sixth Tribulation Eminences who grasped a spatial law.
“Grasp a spatial law?” Fiend Eye carefully looked at Meng Chuan. In his eyes, he saw the timeline.
Meng Chuan had many temporal lines on him. The past lines were unique and constant, but the future lines connected to Meng Chuan were endless. They extended into the endless future, representing Meng Chuan’s possible futures.
As an existence that once stood at the peak of the River of Spacetime 80,000 years ago, his strength was comparable to that of Ancestral Magus King. Although he was now heavily injured, he had been focused on comprehending the temporal law all this while. His insights into the temporal law were extremely profound. Fiend Eye naturally had his ambitions. He also wanted to grasp the temporal law completely before his death. When that happened, he could also become a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence. With his current insights, he could at least see a portion of Meng Chuan’s future. The future hadn’t happened, so it was uncertain. However, with the various elements present to date, he could see many possible futures. Fiend Eye’s single eye traced one of the timelines and saw a future scene.
It was in the vast and surging Chaos River Zone.
A white-haired, white-robed man sat cross-legged. In the sky was a huge painting. The painting covered the vast river zone, and Chaos Holes were in the middle of the painting. An invisible force enveloped the area below. A stocky existence stood in the river and roared. It was massive in size, with 16 curved horns on its head and sharp spikes on its back. Countless mystic runes surfaced on its skin. Just seeing it made one feel endless horror and fear.
“Eastcalm, I’ve already admitted defeat and am willing to leave this universe. Why aren’t you letting me leave?” roared the stocky existence angrily. “Leave?” Countless runes appeared in the white-haired man’s eyes. His eyes turned dark and terrifying
The stocky existence trembled in pain. Heads appeared on his skin due to the pain, but some of the heads shattered with a bang, causing the stocky existence to howl in pain. His body split apart, and billions of figures charged towards the white-robed, white-haired man.
The future of a Seventh Tribulation Eminence? Furthermore, he can hunt down a Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature? Fiend Eye was somewhat surprised. A Sixth Tribulation Eminence with high talent indeed has a chance of reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm. A single future timeline doesn’t mean anything.
He traced another timeline.
A man with countless stars floating behind him had an extremely terrifying aura as it produced invisible waves that affected countless river zones. He coldly glared at the white-robed, white-haired man.
“Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.” The white-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan stared at the man. The painting was vast and continuous. It also affected the endless spacetime.
Humph. Fiend Eye felt his eye ache as it turned bloodshot. Clearly, looking at the scene with the two existences was a huge burden on him.
What? He will fight Celestial Thearch Myriad Star? He also doesn’t seem to be at a disadvantage? Fiend Eye was shocked. He could easily view the futures of ordinary Supremacies and Imperial Lords, but it was very burdensome for him to view a Sixth Tribulation Eminence’s future.
As Meng Chuan was very young, Fiend Eye wanted to take a cursory probe. However, he was shocked when he saw two futures.
Third future timeline, fourth future timeline, fifth future timeline...
Fiend Eye couldn’t help but look at the next one after he was done with one. Although he felt the burden increase, he continued bearing with it.
The eighth future timeline.
It was a barren void. Fiend Eye was fleeing in panic when a vast painting suddenly enveloped the spacetime around him. Spacetime became completely sealed, making it look like a painting. Fiend Eye turned his head with great difficulty while inside the painting. When he saw a white-robed, white-haired man appear behind him, he immediately bowed respectfully. Just as he wanted to say something...
Whoosh.
Bam!
Fiend Eye-who was prying into the eighth future timeline-suddenly had his single eye explode. Blood splattered. Fiend Eye clutched his eye. His eye rapidly recovered, but it would take him several years to expel the spacetime backlash from within. He stared at the young man in front of him, who was calmly staring at him. If the timeline Fiend Eye pried into involved himself, the backlash would be even worse. He was unable to hold back his temptation and finally reached his limits.
I’ve seen eight future timelines in a row. Eight futures... He reaches the Seventh Tribulation realm in all of them, thought Fiend Eye. An Eighth Tribulation Eminence can completely jump out of the timeline, making it impossible for others to pry into their future. Although I didn’t pry into the other future timelines, it means that it’s very likely Meng Chuan will ultimately reach the Seventh Tribulation realm, no matter what decision I make now.
By prying into the future, one could determine a cultivator’s potential based on probability.
