Currently, only a handful of people in the River of Spacetime could pry into Sixth Tribulation Eminences’ futures. Fiend Eye was one of them.
Fiend Eye was certain that it would be difficult for him to prevent the young man from rising to prominence, no matter what decision he made. At the very least, there was a high chance that the other party would still become a Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
Oh? Meng Chuan looked at Fiend Eye in puzzlement. He had said everything he needed to say, but Fiend Eye ended up falling silent for a long time.
Meng Chuan didn’t see the scene of Fiend Eye’s eye rupturing. All he knew was Fiend Eye that kept staring at him.
“What you say makes sense,” said Fiend Eye with a smile. “With your current insights into the Dao of Space, you will still have a chance of grasping a spatial law in 10,000 years even if I exert pressure on you. When that happens, my efforts would be meaningless.”
Meng Chuan was confident.
There was another reason that remained unspoken. His homeworld had an Eternal treasure seal left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon. It was also a huge opportunity.
“You convinced me, so I’ve changed my mind,” said Fiend Eye with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 652 - Calamity?
chapters.content:
Chapter 652 Calamity?
Meng Chuan was somewhat astonished when he heard that.
The reason why he had forcefully rejected the demand was that he was prepared to fall out with Fiend Eye. Once he did so, his Essence Soul avatar in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm would teleport everyone from Archean Eon Realm back to their homeworld. Meng Chuan had made arrangements for his grandson, Meng Yu
—who had long reached the Imperial Lord realm. Furthermore, it wouldn’t be easy for Fiend Eye to find Earth Cloud Mystic Realm without the karmic connection as long as he left Earth Cloud Mystic Realm.
Every mystic realm was created by an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. Seventh Tribulation Eminences needed luck to find a mystic realm. Many mystic realms in the River of Spacetime still remained ownerless. Even if people knew that they were in a certain region, they couldn’t find them.
Furthermore, Earth Cloud Mystic Realm was hidden by Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s array.
As for himself? Once they fell out, Meng Chuan would naturally use all his resources to grasp the spatial law as soon as possible.
My words... ended up changing the other party’s mind?
“You have quite a deep understanding of the spatial law. I do think highly of you,” said Fiend Eye with a smile. “Therefore, name a price. I’m willing to buy the opportunity that Fiend Mountain’s owner gave you. I’m not taking advantage of you. Fiend Mountain’s owner’s personality is much more fiendish than mine. The opportunities he gives you for free are a combination of fortune and disaster.”
Meng Chuan looked at him. Name a price? There are many resources that I want, but they are all monopolized by Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
“I want to cultivate on Clear Spring Island,” said Meng Chuan. “I want to exchange this opportunity for cultivation time on Clear Spring Island. I won’t be excessive. A hundred years will do.”
“Clear Spring Island?” Fiend Eye looked at Meng Chuan carefully. “You sure are bold.” “A hundred years is enough.” Meng Chuan didn’t dare ask for too much.
Of course, he wanted to cultivate there. Clear Spring Island was the most mysterious cultivation ground in the River of Spacetime. It was originally a mysterious spring that had been born in the void. The spring spanned only 50 kilometers. An Eighth Tribulation Eminence later discovered this place and set up an island. There were only 18 cave abodes on the island.
Only 18 living beings were allowed to cultivate on Clear Spring Island at a time because the other cultivators would be affected once there were more than 18 living beings there.
There were more than 20 Seventh Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime, so the competition was naturally intense. As for Fiend Eye, he had undoubtedly taken one of the cave abodes for himself long ago. According to legend, cultivating on Clear Spring Island was extremely beneficial to newly-advanced Seventh Tribulation Eminences. It was much less helpful to peak Seventh Tribulation Eminences. It was of even lesser help to Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star. Therefore, some cave abode possessors were willing to give the opportunity to other Seventh Tribulation Eminences. Of course, the other Seventh Tribulation Eminences had to pay a sufficient price.
Some were used by half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences. If people used it for 100 years or 200 years...
Very few ordinary Seventh Tribulation Eminences gave up their cave abodes. The ones willing to give up their cave abodes were the few top Seventh Tribulation Eminences. For example, Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star left these resources to their own factions. People could use credits to exchange for cultivation time. The cave abodes were almost monopolized by the half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences—who contributed greatly to White Avian Hall. Ordinary members had no hope of heading there.
“Alright.” Fiend Eye nodded. “However, you have to wait another 80 years. One of my clansmen is cultivating there. In 80 years, I’ll give you a Clear Spring Token, and you’ll be able to head there.” Fiend Eye suddenly smiled strangely. “The time you will spend cultivating there won’t be 100 years, but 300 years...”
“Three hundred years?” Meng Chuan was originally quite satisfied with this transaction. He wanted to exchange a fortuitous encounter that could spell both fortune and disaster for a tangible benefit. However, the other party suddenly took the initiative to give him 300 years of cultivation time on Clear Spring Island. This left Meng Chuan somewhat puzzled, but he didn’t even dare agree to it personally. “I’ve already said that I think highly of you. Since I think highly of you, I naturally wish to form a good relationship with you,” said Fiend Eye casually. “Do you agree to this transaction? If you do, quickly hand me the method to enter the Land of Foulbone.”
“I agree.” Meng Chuan didn’t hesitate at all. Meng Chuan naturally accepted the deal that didn’t have any harsh requirements.
On the path of cultivation, Meng Chuan had long set a rule: he had to cultivate with all his might. He couldn’t slack off at all. Therefore, he had to seize any huge opportunities that came his way.
If he slacked off a little once or twice, he would probably have no hope of reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm if it continued. No matter how talented he was, he would probably have no hope of reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm.
None of the peak experts in the River of Spacetime dared to relax their requirements unless they felt that their cultivation was hopeless and began to give up.
Whoosh.
With a flip of his hand, Meng Chuan condensed his Quintessential Essence into a crystal. The crystal contained the method to enter the Land of Foulbone.
“The entry method for the Land of Foulbone is in here.” Meng Chuan threw the crystal over.
Fiend Eye received it and probed it. To him, the cultivation resources that were useful to him in the River of Spacetime were dwindling. Fiend Mountain’s owner was ultimately an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. The opportunities he left behind might be of some help.
“Alright. In 80 years, the Clear Spring Token will be sent to Three Bay River System’s Eastcalm City.” After Fiend Eye said that, he vanished into thin air.
Form a good relationship with me? That’s why I got the benefit of cultivating on Clear Spring Island for 300 years? Meng Chuan stood rooted to the ground, still somewhat surprised. This Guild Master Fiend Eye sure has fiendish tendencies.
He originally thought it was a tribulation, but it turned into an opportunity.
In the gray fog-filled void.
As Fiend Eye walked through the void, he pondered. When observing a true Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s future when they are still at the Sixth Tribulation realm... only a portion of the future will show them reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm.
Previously, I wanted to kill all of Meng Chuan’s avatars in the outside world and suppress him greatly. Yet, he reached the Seventh Tribulation Realm in all the future timelines that I saw. He also isn’t just an ordinary Seventh Tribulation Eminence in those timelines. I suspect that almost half of those timelines have him at the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm.
Such potential is truly astonishing. Perhaps only the young Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star can compare.
Fiend Eye had to admit this. Although the current Seventh Tribulation Eminences were very impressive, Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star far exceeded the other Seventh Tribulation Eminences in terms of growth trajectories. Now, he felt that Meng Chuan had the potential to match the two of them.
He might even become a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence or even reach the Eighth Tribulation realm. Fiend Eye pondered. On this path of cultivation, it’s also very important to form good karma other than cultivating on your own.
Fiend Eye had once stood at the peak of the River of Spacetime. He had once traveled beyond the universe and had vast knowledge. He knew that there was a cultivator in another universe named Xi Gu. He had good judgment. When he was still at the Fifth Tribulation realm, he was dedicated to serving a mysterious person from a young age until he was an old man.
He kept serving the mysterious person without any regrets. Later, he learned that the mysterious person was an Eternal existence. Before the Eternal existence left, he extended Xi Gu’s lifespan and gave him a legacy and a personal lecture. After many years of cultivation, Xi Gu finally became an Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
There were several similar legends.
I don’t dare hope for an Eternal existence. As long as I can form a good relationship with an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, it will be infinitely beneficial. This is my first time meeting him. I have plenty of time in the future.
Fiend Eye was too old. His confidence in becoming a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence was dropping. Therefore, he placed great importance on anyone with potential. As for Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star, they were in their prime. They only had one goal—to reach the Eighth Tribulation realm.
After experiencing the mild conflict with Fiend Eye, Meng Chuan continued walking slowly on Fiend Mountain. After the path of epiphany and the path of the mind merged, there were indeed some changes.
The clarity of the voice on the mountaintop increased a little, but Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul had become much more ethereal. His understanding of the intonations greatly improved. It helped him comprehend the intonations.
As my willpower becomes stronger, it becomes even harder for it to metamorphose. Meng Chuan also discovered this point. Ever since he returned to Fiend Mountain, he had traversed more than 25,000 kilometers on the path of the mind. Yet, his mind and will hadn’t transformed at all.
Perhaps it’s because the pressure on my willpower is still too low, guessed Meng Chuan.
Time passed.
Meng Chuan walked step by step as he carefully experienced the sound’s effects on his Essence Soul. Gradually, the sound placed sufficient pressure on his Essence Soul.
28,000 kilometers, 28,500 kilometers, 29,000 kilometers, 29,500 kilometers...
The pressure increased. Meng Chuan became even more thrilled. Every intonation struck his Essence Soul fiercely, causing it to tremble and rumble. This allowed Meng Chuan to discover the weaknesses in his Essence Soul structure clearly. He also knew which parts of his willpower were lacking.
Very good. This is the way; the greater the pressure, the greater the impact. Meng Chuan could clearly see his flaws. He carefully pondered over them.
Unknowingly, the immense pressure caused Meng Chuan’s sea of consciousness to rumble. He was about to reach his limits.
Myriad Tribulations Star.
The outer layer of Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul was a liquid layer, while the inner layer was a star.
The inner star was derived from the Essence Soul Star legacy’s profundities. Meng Chuan gained a brand new understanding of the Essence Soul Star. The intonations were like a calamity. Sometimes, a calamity wasn’t an obstacle but a tremendous opportunity.
With some changes to his Essence Soul structure, Meng Chuan’s willpower became more condensed and powerful.
This was the first transformation Meng Chuan had undergone on his journey on Fiend Mountain. At this moment, he had traveled a distance of 31,000 kilometers.

chapters.title: Chapter 653 - Archean Eon Realm’s Supremacies
chapters.content:
Chapter 653 Archean Eon Realm’s Supremacies
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul began to contain the will that couldn’t be ground away by difficulties.
Creating one’s Essence Soul formulation was the most orthodox way to strengthen one’s willpower. In the early stages, one relied on tribulations, tempering, and insights. However, in the later stages, one had to create their own Essence Soul formulation. What was truly terrifying about one’s willpower wasn’t how strong one’s resistance to difficulties was. Instead, it was one’s wisdom that could see through everything without any doubts.
The torment of suffering was also a temptation. Without any doubts, Meng Chuan would completely deconstruct everything.
The birth and destruction of the Universe, the operation of all things, the growth and reincarnation of living beings, joy, anger, and grief. How was a will born? What was the difference between the Essence Souls and bodies of the countless species and powerful existences? Why were there these differences?
As his intelligence increased, his willpower would naturally increase.
After gaining a complete understanding of the Essence Soul and changing the Essence Soul structure, one’s natural order in life would slowly transform. This would naturally result in a stronger willpower. My Essence Soul formulation is still very crude. I’m mainly using the two major frameworks of Eternal Road and Essence Soul Star to create an embryonic form of my formulation. If I want to become truly powerful, I need to create a formulation with my own insights. In other words, I have to grasp the laws of time and space. Only by using this as a foundation to establish an Essence Soul formulation can I compare to the two seniors. Meng Chuan knew very well that he was still early on in his journey, but he was already figuring things out.
The transformation of his willpower weakened the influence of the sounds from the mountaintop. Meng Chuan looked up, but he still couldn’t see past the clouds. He lowered his head and continued walking slowly on Fiend Mountain.
Time passed. As he heard more and more words, Meng Chuan vaguely felt that this voice might be a formulation. However, he couldn’t hear it completely.
I’ve reached my limit. Meng Chuan stopped. The voice on the mountaintop became much clearer. The strong impact on his Essence Soul also made it impossible for him to advance. Although he had some insights, it was difficult for his mind and will to transform.
He had a feeling that he would have to perfect his Essence Soul formulation if he wanted to undergo another transformation from now on.
36,500 kilometers. This is my current limit. Meng Chuan looked up.
The path beneath his feet continued upward with the path of possession extending parallel to it.
I’ll definitely reach the mountain peak and see what’s at the top.
It was very difficult to reach the peak. From what Realm Ancestor knew, if one could reach the peak, it meant that their willpower had reached the standards of the Physical Body Eighth Tribulation realm. It was very difficult for Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminences to reach the peak as well. Most Seventh Tribulation Eminences couldn’t reach the peak.
Perhaps Guild Master Fiend Eye came to Fiend Mountain to make an attempt. Perhaps he hasn’t reached the mountaintop? Meng Chuan guessed.
Meng Chuan looked around. Fiend Mountain was silent. The crazy forbidden creatures had left the mountain. At the very least, he couldn’t see a single one on the main peak.
It was time to leave!
There’s still about 20 years before the agreed upon time with Guild Master Fiend Eye. Meng Chuan was still looking forward to heading to Clear Spring Island. Following that, Meng Chuan vanished into thin air and left Fiend Mountain with a mystic technique.
...
In a valley in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm.
The appearance of the white-haired Meng Chuan attracted the attention of the six cultivators in the valley.
“Imperial Lords.”
“Meng Chuan.” The cultivators in the valley bowed. At a glance, Meng Chuan saw six people. Every century, he would send cultivators back from Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. It had been 1,100 years since he brought 34 Supremacies with him. It had also been 110 years in Archean Eon Realm.
He had sent many batches of cultivators previously. Six people in this batch was considered a lot.
“Supremacy Yaoyue, are you returning this time?” Meng Chuan walked towards Bai Yaoyue.
Bai Yaoyue’s sideburns had turned white. Bai Yaoyue—who was Archean Eon Realm’s youngest and most talented Supremacy when Meng Chuan was young-was already very old. “I’ve already tried all the special lands in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm that are suitable for me.” Bai Yaoyue’s temper was much milder now. She smiled and sighed. “I’ve less than 200 years left to live. My Essence Soul is still at the sixth level. I can’t force my Essence Soul to break through. Perhaps I’ll have some hope of breaking through when I return to my hometown. If that doesn’t work... I’ll have to rely on you, Meng Chuan, to transform me into an Imperial Lord-level special lifeform.”
Meng Chuan comforted her. “After you return, you might be able to break through before the end of your lifespan. My master also broke through before the end of his lifespan.”
“Let’s hope so.” Bai Yaoyue knew very well that Qin Wu had only broken through after being stimulated by special cultivation grounds like Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s Land of Nightmare and Secular World Painting. However, she had already tried all of these.
Meng Chuan nodded. He had promised Archean Eon Realm’s Heaven Earth Supremacies that they could be transformed into Imperial Lord-level special lifeforms. Meng Chuan didn’t care about this expenditure. This was because it was too difficult for Archean Eon Realm to produce a Heaven Earth Supremacy. “Yang Cheng, you are returning too?” Meng Chuan looked at another Supremacy. “Yes, Father-in-law.” Yang Cheng nodded. “I promised Meng You that I will return before I’m 1,500 years old.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
His daughter and son-in-law originally came to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm together. In the early stages, they roamed the mystic realm together to cultivate. However, Meng You’s improvement in strength was much slower. Furthermore, some of Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s treasured lands took a century or two per entry. Some places allowed the strong to remain longer while the weaker ones were expelled early... Therefore, it was very difficult for Meng You to follow her husband, Yang Cheng. After cultivating in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm for 300 years, she returned first. This was because they had been separated for too long in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. After Meng You returned to Archean Eon Realm, Yang Cheng focused on his cultivation even more.
From the 34 Supremacies who originally came, only Imperial Lord Northcleanse became an Imperial Lord other than Qin Wu.
Imperial Lord Northcleanse was King Northcleanse—who had once fought alongside Meng Chuan in the World Gap. King Northcleanse had first recovered his peak vitality and became a Supremacy. After coming to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, he cultivated the entire time. He became an Imperial Lord at 1,200 years of age. It was so smooth that Meng Chuan was surprised. Meng Chuan had once imagined that King True Martial might’ve become an Imperial Lord if he had lived to this day.
Apart from the two Imperial Lords, the older generation’s Bai Yaoyue and the younger generation’s Yang Cheng were all Heaven Earth Supremacies.
Apart from them, there were no other major breakthroughs.
Among those he sent to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, the two Imperial Lords-Qin Wu and Imperial Lord Northcleanse—as well as the two Heaven Earth Supremacies, Bai Yaoyue and Yang Cheng, had benefited greatly. Even the youngest, Yang Cheng, was nearly 1,500 years old. It was very difficult for him to achieve an Essence Soul breakthrough before his death.
“Let’s go back to Archean Eon Realm.” Meng Chuan led the six of them and immediately left for Archean Eon Realm.
With Fiend Mountain as a relay point, Meng Chuan could travel much faster.
Of course, when doing the transfer at Fiend Mountain, the other six were in Meng Chuan’s grotto-heaven treasure. They couldn’t survive in Fiend Mountain’s environment.
After returning to Archean Eon Realm, Meng Chuan released the six Supremacies.
The six Supremacies were rather excited. After all, they had left their homeworld for more than 1,000 years. After bidding farewell to Meng Chuan, they quickly left.
As he watched Bai Yaoyue and company leave, Meng Chuan sighed. The path of cultivation was too difficult. For example, his wife, Liu Qiyue, had used a drop of Fire Origins Liquid—which was comparable to an Eighth Tribulation treasure-to make her bloodline pure enough to be close to that of a pure-blooded phoenix. He believed that it would be very easy for her to reach the perfected Imperial Lord realm, but that was all. To become a Tribulation Eminence? It was still difficult. Her chances of becoming a powerful Tribulation Eminence were ever slimmer.
His son, Meng An, had followed the path Ancestral Master Archean Eon had set for him since a young age. He had undergone strict cultivation and reached the Tribulation realm. However, it was becoming harder and harder for him to improve. Meng Chuan could sense that it was very difficult to find someone from his hometown with similar strength on the path of cultivation. He could only advance alone.
Just like how Ancestral Master Archean Eon had traveled alone a long time ago.
Regardless of the changes in the outside world, Meng Chuan spent the next 20 years peacefully. He also obtained the Clear Spring Token from Fiend Eye.

chapters.title: Chapter 654 - Clear Spring Island
chapters.content:
Chapter 654 Clear Spring Island
Legends regarding Clear Spring Island had spread among Sixth Tribulation Eminences. However, there were only 18 cave abodes. There weren’t enough cave abodes for Seventh Tribulation Eminences, so all Sixth Tribulation Eminences could do was hope. Today, Meng Chuan arrived at Clear Spring Island.
Clear Spring Island is in this spacetime zone. One of Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars rushed here. Clear Spring Island wasn’t a huge secret. Sixth Tribulation Eminences could still discover its general location, but they couldn’t see Clear Spring Island even if they rushed here.
This place had an array set up by an Eighth Tribulation Eminence; only 18 living beings were allowed inside.
Time to go. With a flip of his hand, Meng Chuan took out the Clear Spring Token that Guild Master Fiend Eye had given him. The Clear Spring Token was a very simple cyan token. He infused his strength into it and activated it slightly.
Buzz.
The token led to a spot closer to him. Meng Chuan immediately followed the guidance and stepped through the layers of space.
Oh? The moment Meng Chuan landed, he appeared in front of a cave abode. The cave abode spanned about 1.5 kilometers. A wall isolated the surrounding area from prying eyes. There were shrines, halls, and rooms inside. Although the cave abode was small, it was sufficient.
Meng Chuan appeared out of thin air within the cave abode’s walls. He turned his head and looked past the walls. He could see the other cave abodes around him, but each cave abode had yard walls. With an array formation concealing them, it was difficult to see their interior.
Just this small island has 18 cave abodes on it, but it’s the best place to cultivate in the River of Spacetime. I’m lucky enough to cultivate here for 300 years. After standing in the cave abode, Meng Chuan understood why Clear Spring Island was called the best place to cultivate.
This was because it was the place closest to the operations regarding the laws of spacetime. Due to the connection to the mysterious spring, the cultivators on Clear Spring Island could see it at the closest distance possible.
Meng Chuan carefully sensed the River of Spacetime’s operations. Colorful lines intertwined as they exuded beauty.
If one had a high understanding of space, they would be able to tell that the different threads interweaved on different levels.
If one’s perception of time was high enough, they could see that these lines were connected to the past, present, and future.
His Essence Soul had a strong perception, but he could tell that every line contained countless runes after being magnified billions of times. Every line was a law. The laws at the periphery affected everything in the River of Spacetime.
The combination of countless laws determined the lifeforms’ lifespans. They determined the birth and destruction of minerals and plants.
They determined the birth and decline of a world of life. They determined the spatial tides and the cycles of countless stars...
The entire universe’s sequence—from growth to prosperity, reaching its peak to declining and being destroyed—were hidden within the laws.
I can vaguely sense that the vast laws involve Origins. Meng Chuan could find the Chaos Hole law from the seemingly vast laws. It could devour stars. Even super-large Chaos Holes could devour inhabited worlds...
There’s still time and space.
Meng Chuan could barely sense them.
The interweaving of space and time ultimately formed countless laws. The two combined was the source of everything. Although a pure spatial law was recognized as a hallmark of the Sixth Tribulation realm in terms of strength, they were the foundation of everything. Once they clashed with time, countless possibilities appeared.
I better make haste. Meng Chuan stood in the courtyard in a daze for a long time before coming to a realization. With a thought, he sensed his cave abode. He immediately chose a chamber and began cultivating on Clear Spring Island.
His Essence Soul avatar carefully meditated on Clear Spring Island. Some of his Essence Soul avatars cultivated in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm at ten-fold the speed of time. His homeworld’s true body used the Eternal treasure-Great Seal—to verify his cultivation and ensure that all his cultivation was in sync. With the guidance of the Void Catalog, Meng Chuan improved rapidly.
Talent in cultivation was one aspect. External conditions were also very important. Be it Celestial Thearch Myriad Star or Hall Lord White Avian, they had soared thanks to huge fortuitous encounters.
Although Meng Chuan’s opportunities were not bad, there were many opportunities that surpassed his in this era. For example, Ancestral Magus King had obtained an Eternal existence’s legacy. Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had gone beyond the universe. The opportunities they obtained were above that of Ancestral Magus King. Guild Master Fiend Eye’s main opportunities were similarly extraordinary.
Meng Chuan had only obtained the benefits left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon. In comparison, they were way inferior.
The cultivator in Fiend Eye’s cave abode has changed? In another cave abode on Clear Spring Island, a middle-aged man sat cross-legged. He had many trees and flowers growing on his body. His body was like a vast land with countless flowers and plants on its surface... However, the trees and plants were tiny. It was as though his clothes were embellished. His hair consisted of black vines, his eyes were like a vast lake, and his hands were like wood.
Who is it?
Although the middle-aged man couldn’t pry into the other party’s cave abode-after all, these cave abodes were created by an Eighth Tribulation Eminence-with a thought, karma could be connected across distances.
Sixth Tribulation Eminence, Archean Eon Realm’s Eastcalm-Meng Chuan? The middle-aged man came to a realization. Senior Archean Eon’s achievements back then were rather high. Now, this junior has to be blessed by him.
He didn’t care too much about it because in terms of achievements, he wasn’t inferior to Ancestral Master Archean Eon. Furthermore, he still had a very long lifespan.
In the entire River of Spacetime, among the seven peak Seventh Tribulation Eminencessecond only to Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star—the middle-aged man and Realm Ancestor were the only ones who were low-key and detached from worldly affairs.
Realm Ancestor was the oldest and was close to the end of his lifespan, so he couldn’t be bothered to vie for anything. When he was young, Realm Ancestor had once reigned supreme over the River of Spacetime and engaged in battles everywhere.
As for the middle-aged man, he didn’t like fighting. He had never crazily fought with anyone in his entire cultivation life. Firstly, it was because he didn’t like conflict. Secondly, all parties would give in to him if he was determined to have something.
This was because the middle-aged man had cultivated medicine and poison to an unimaginable level. He could be said to be the strongest in the River of Spacetime. Just revealing the tip of the iceberg was enough to leave everyone alarmed.
A Sixth Tribulation kid has arrived at Clear Spring Island? In another cave abode on Clear Spring Island, a black stone golem sat cross-legged. He glanced in the direction of Guild Master Fiend Eye’s cave abode. Hall Lord Blazing Sun is willing to help him, and so is Guild Master Fiend Eye? It looks like he has something to rely on.
The black stone golem’s eyes were filled with a strange color. He was a Seventh Tribulation Eminence-Guild Master Darkstar.
The Darkstar Guild was one of the most notorious factions in the River of Spacetime.
In a special Darkstar Space, core members of the Darkstar Guild could descend with a thought.
“Guild Master has sent an order to list Goddess River Zone’s City Lord Eastcalm as a second-tier hunting target.” In a hall in the Darkstar Space, members were handling intelligence.
“City Lord Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, went to the Valley of Spacetime first after reaching the Sixth Tribulation realm. Now, he’s on Clear Spring Island? Ancestral Master Archean Eon left him a lot of resources. Perhaps he will open the next treasure trove of resources. We should lock onto him through karma at all times.”
These members also believed that Meng Chuan was very valuable. In the River of Spacetime, some factions specialized in plundering and slaughtering. Black Fiend Hall was the most famous. Black Fiend Hall had the worst reputation because they slaughtered everything they came across. Even weak Supremacies were slaughtered.
As for the Darkstar Guild, Shadow Lands, and several other factions, they were better than Black Fiend Hall. They wouldn’t attack the weak because they were worthless. They didn’t even think much of ordinary Fifth Tribulation Eminences.
They targeted those with great treasures. Every time they attacked, they had to make a huge profit. In fact, many Sixth Tribulation Eminences had limited treasures. Most of them hid their treasures in their homeworlds, so these factions couldn’t snatch anything from them. Therefore, choosing a target was very important.
Meng Chuan was clearly listed as a target. They believed that Meng Chuan was a Sixth Tribulation Eminence with great resources. They only needed to seize his opportunities. After all, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars and outer realm true bodies wouldn’t carry any treasures most of the time.

chapters.title: Chapter 655 - First Gathering at Nebula Palace
chapters.content:
Chapter 655 First Gathering at Nebula Palace
Meng Chuan focused on his cultivation. As he only needed to obey Deputy Hall Lord Blazing Sun at White Avian Hall, there was nothing to disturb him. However, he received an invitation after cultivating on Clear Spring Island for more than 20 years. Lord of Avian Mountain from White Avian Hall’s third hall has grasped a spatial law and is about to hold a celebration ceremony at Nebula Palace? Meng Chuan was astonished. Ever since he joined White Avian Hall, he hadn’t participated in any activities. As he wasn’t familiar with the other Sixth Tribulation Eminences, he hadn’t attended any gatherings at Nebula Palace. However, this was a large-scale celebration.
The next day, Meng Chuan naturally sent a thought through the Nebula Token and headed to Nebula Palace.
Boom!
Nebula Palace’s laws were mysterious. After descending, one could gather their strength and form a body and Essence Soul. Meng Chuan landed on the vast square at the periphery of Nebula Palace and was somewhat astonished.
Tribulation Eminences had a limited number of physical body avatars. For example, Physical Body Tribulation Eminences only had two true bodies. This was limited by the laws of spacetime. However, one could form a body in Nebula Palace with a thought. This showed how special Nebula Palace was.
The Cang Alliance Space only allowed one to condense an ordinary embodiment without any combat strength. Yet, Nebula Palace allowed one to condense a body here.
Furthermore, the cost of cultivating an avatar at the Physical Body Tribulation realm was very high. A Fifth Tribulation Eminence’s body required thousands of cubes. A Sixth Tribulation Eminence’s body required tens of thousands of cubes. However, creating such a body at Nebula Palace didn’t require any effort. It could be condensed with a thought. Of course, the prerequisite was that one had already figured out such a physical body formulation.
I’ll head to the third branch hall first. Meng Chuan walked across the square. There were many palaces in Nebula Palace. They were vast, and the various factions had demarcated their territories.
White Avian Hall occupied nearly 20% of the area. Meng Chuan naturally knew about this. I’m here. Meng Chuan arrived at White Avian Hall’s third branch hall. The hall was bustling with noise and excitement. At a glance, hundreds of Eminences were already seated.
These seats also have their differences. Although Meng Chuan wasn’t familiar with most Sixth Tribulation Eminences, he had long gathered the intelligence on White Avian Hall’s members. He could discern the Sixth Tribulation Eminences’ identities at a glance.
The seats in the hall were arranged in a semicircle around the hall. The first hundred-plus seats were reserved for peak Sixth Tribulation Eminences. Ordinary Sixth Tribulation Eminences sat behind, in the second and third rows.
Meng Chuan naturally walked to the back and casually sat down in the fifth row.
“Brother Eastcalm?” A Sixth Tribulation Eminence greeted him warmly.
Meng Chuan smiled and replied, “Palace Lord Star Sand.”
This Sixth Tribulation Eminence’s name was Palace Lord Star Sand. He was the strongest expert of the Star Sand lifeforms in the River of Spacetime. His body was condensed from starlight sand, and the sand slowly flowed around him. He smiled brightly. “I heard of your name some time ago, but I’ve only gotten to meet you today.”
“Brother Eastcalm, I heard that you are acquainted with Deputy Hall Lord Blazing Sun, allowing you to head to the Valley of Spacetime directly. We are extremely envious.”
“We can only be envious.”
“Brother Eastcalm, are you from Goddess River Zone? I’m from Bone Chasing River Zone. It’s very close to Goddess River Zone.”
The surrounding Sixth Tribulation Eminences chatted with Meng Chuan. They were rather enthusiastic. They were also ordinary Sixth Tribulation Eminences. They were willing to befriend an Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence with strong background and backing.
Furthermore, according to White Avian Hall’s rules, they had to help each other as members of White Avian Hall’s third branch. There were too many members in White Avian Hall. According to the regional division, neighboring river zones were grouped together. There were a total of eight branches.
Hall Lord White Avian personally led the first branch. It had the most members, and it was in the River of Spacetime’s central region. The other seven branch halls were led by seven half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences. They had over 1,000 members. They were the other seven areas in the River of Spacetime.
As a member of Goddess River Zone, Meng Chuan was assigned to the third branch. “A few days ago, our battle with Six Directions Heaven in the East Abyss River region was really tragic. The battle was chaotic. Even a Seventh Tribulation Eminences and several half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences appeared. My outer realm true body died in battle during the process. After the battle, the Patroller returned my weapons and treasures to me. They even compensated me with 30,000 cubes of Outer Realm Essence Crystals. Unfortunately, I require more than 30,000 cubes to recultivate my outer realm true body. I suffered a terrible loss.”
“All of us suffered a loss during the battle at East Abyss River. Six Directions Heaven launched a sneak attack, fully prepared. After the Seventh Tribulation Eminence-Lord of the East Abyss-was heavily injured, he requested for help. White Avian Hall sent a large number of experts to reinforce us, but they failed to clinch victory in the end. There’s no way to replenish the losses they suffered from the battle. It’s not bad that they compensated you with 30,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals.
“Lord of the East Abyss is still a little weak. If he had the strength of a peak Seventh Tribulation Eminence, I believe Six Directions Heaven wouldn’t dare to take over the entire East Abyss River.”
“Lord of the East Abyss... It’s a long story.”
“He’s quite petty.”
“For example, our Sect Master Mental Demon and Hall Master Azure Dragon are much more generous. We have never suffered any losses following the Sect Master and Hall Master Azure Dragon.” As the Sixth Tribulation Eminences chatted, Meng Chuan mainly listened. After all, he didn’t accept any missions from White Avian Hall, so he knew very little about such matters.
“He’s here.”
“Sect Master is here.” The lively hall gradually fell silent as three figures walked over.
Meng Chuan took a closer look.
Walking in the middle was a smiling boy. In fact, he was the leader of the third branchSect Master Mental Demon. He was also a half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence. He grasped the Immeasurable law. The difficulty of dealing with a half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence depended on the laws they grasped.
Once one grasped the Immeasurable law, they could be said to be immortal. In terms of head-on combat, Sect Master Mental Demon was ranked in the River of Spacetime’s top 100. However, in terms of life-preservation means, he was ranked in the top 20.
Sect Master Mental Demon. Flanking his sides are King Hunch Ridge and Lord of Avian Mountain. Meng Chuan examined them. King Hunch Ridge was a single-horned elder with an octagonal outer shell on his back. Lord of Avian Mountain was a white and fat man. His skin was very fair and supple. These two had grasped a spatial law. They were peak Sixth Tribulation Eminences, and they were strong enough to exchange blows with Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
As for ordinary Sixth Tribulation Eminences and peak Sixth Tribulation Eminences, they were unable to fight back against Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
“Everyone.” Sect Master Mental Demon-who looked like a child-sat at the main seat of honor. His voice reached every corner of the hall, and his voice naturally carried joy. “Apart from King Hunch Ridge, our White Avian Hall’s third branch has produced another Deputy Patroller. It’s none other than Brother Avian Mountain.”
Only peak Sixth Tribulation Eminences had the right to take on the responsibility of Deputy Patroller.
Meng Chuan sat in a corner and raised his cup with the crowd.
During the entire celebration, Meng Chuan only focused when Lord of Avian Mountain began explaining the spatial law he had comprehended.
The lecture continued for half a day, and all the Sixth Tribulation Eminences listened carefully.
Only then did the pudgy Lord of Avian Mountain smile. “After saying so much, I will need to showcase it a little to make it more comprehensible. Whoever wishes to spar with me, please come to the hall.”
“Brother Avian Mountain, I’m looking forward to receiving some pointers.” A thin figure in the front row stood up and walked to the center of the hall.
Anyone who dared to challenge a Deputy Patroller had to be a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence. It would be meaningless if the strength difference was too great.
The thin figure’s blood-red eyes were filled with anticipation. He also wanted to comprehend a spatial law. He could gain a deeper understanding of spatial laws by engaging in direct combat.
“Don’t hold back. Attack with all your might.” The thin figure stared at Lord of Avian Mountain. In the past, they had been on par, but the gap between them had now widened.
“You won’t be able to last more than a few blows if I attack with all my might.” The white and fat Lord of Avian Mountain walked to the center of the hall. “Come at me.”
The thin figure vanished into thin air.
A huge illusory head appeared and attempted to devour Lord of Avian Mountain. The surrounding scenery began to distort.
Lord of Avian Mountain extended his right hand, and his fair palm pressed down slightly.
Silently
The surrounding area was suddenly crushed into a piece of paper. There was a thin figure pattern on the piece of paper. The paper eventually dissipated, and the thin figure pattern also vanished. Meng Chuan’s pupils constricted when he saw this. He had studied the Void Catalog for so long, so he could naturally tell that Lord of Avian Mountain had used the simple Void Pressure. It crushed all the layers of space into a single layer. Furthermore, it erased the ‘height’ of this layer of space, changing it from a three-dimensional space to a flat surface.
After becoming a flat surface, all living beings that relied on space would die.
One had to grasp a spatial law completely in order to control space so wantonly.

chapters.title: Chapter 656 - Spatial Law
chapters.content:
Chapter 656 Spatial Law
Despite killing a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence with a single strike, Lord of Avian Mountain thought nothing of it. At that moment, the thin figure walked in from outside the hall. He had clearly condensed his will once again.
“Brother Avian Mountain, you won against me fair and square.” The thin figure walked in and shook his head. “I’ve cultivated to such a stage, but I’m still unable to withstand a single blow in front of a spatial law.”
“Space is the foundation of all existences. It can naturally suppress all other Sixth Tribulation laws,” said Lord of Avian Mountain. “Although I don’t know why one is still considered a Sixth Tribulation lifeform despite grasping a spatial law... it’s no less important than an Origins law to me.”
All the Sixth Tribulation Eminences from the various river zones present nodded.
At their realm, the next step was the Origins laws. Therefore, they could sense that the spatial laws had a greater influence on everything, even more than a number of Origins laws. However, the body and Essence Soul cultivated with a spatial law remained at the Sixth Tribulation realm.
“Time and space are the two core foundations of everything we know.” Sect Master Mental Demon-who was seated in the main seatspoke from afar. “It’s just like two legs. Without any of the legs, one will be a cripple. The spatial law is indeed very important, but if there’s no time, pure space will be much weaker. However, it will transform once time is added.”
“As for Origins laws, they are compatible with time and space, resulting in their great might. With this, one can reach the Seventh Tribulation realm. Just relying on space is extremely weak. But with a complete spatial law as a foundation, one can leap out of the River of Spacetime and become an Eighth Tribulation Eminence once a complete temporal law is combined with it.
“They can roam the past, future, and other universes,” said Sect Master Mental Demon with a smile. “To an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, grasping a spatial law is just one step in building their foundation.”
The Sixth Tribulation Eminences present nodded slightly. They yearned for the Eighth Tribulation realm, but they found it extremely distant.
They were all hegemons of their own jurisdictions. Some were geniuses from high-level worlds, the strongest of a special lifeform race, and the most dazzling person of weak worlds...
In the vast River of Spacetime, there were only tens of thousands of Sixth Tribulation Eminences among the countless species.
For example, the Eight-Headed Star Swallowing Snake species—which Meng Chuan had interacted with before-didn’t have a Sixth Tribulation Eminence. The strongest expert in that species didn’t even have the right to enter Nebula Palace. Clearly, being in the ranks of Nebula Palace meant that one stood among the universe’s strongest experts. “Avian Mountain, show us more. People won’t even have the time to comprehend what’s happening if you keep finishing your opponent in one or two moves,” said Sect Master Mental Demon with a smile.
Lord of Avian Mountain nodded slightly. He swept his gaze across the top Sixth Tribulation Eminences sitting at the front of the hall.
At that moment, a silver-haired, green-eyed man stood up. His ears were sharp, and his robe was gorgeous. He smiled and said, “I’ll spar with Brother Avian Mountain. Brother Avian Mountain, please show mercy.”
“It won’t be easy to destroy this avatar of yours.” When Lord of Avian Mountain saw the other party, he felt somewhat helpless.
It’s him? Shadowfiend Walker? Meng Chuan raised his eyebrows.
Hall Lord White Avian had a good friend who had built White Avian Hall with him. His name was Lord of Shadowfiend. He was a half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence, and he was like Hall Lord White Avian’s shadow. He didn’t like to appear in public, nor did he handle any management issues. However, his secret contributions to White Avian Hall were above that of Deputy Hall Lord Blazing Sun and Deputy Hall Lord Azure Dragon. Traces of his contribution could be found in many of White Avian Hall’s major events.
Lord of Shadowfiend was publicly recognized as the strongest half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence! In the days when he fought alongside Hall Lord White Avian, Lord of Shadowfiend had once killed two Seventh Tribulation Eminences’ outer realm true bodies. This shocked all the factions in the River of Spacetime. Of course, he seldom appeared in the past 10,000 years.
As for Shadowfiend Walker, he was Lord of Shadowfiend’s only Sixth Tribulation disciple.
Inside the main hall of Nebula Palace, Lord of Avian Mountain and Shadowfiend Walker began fighting Shadowfiend Walker transformed into windan omnipresent wind!
The wind howled alongside a gentle breeze. The latter silently seeped deep into the enemy’s body.
Whoosh.
Wind sliced toward Lord of Avian Mountain like a blade.
Lord of Avian Mountain stood there.
The wind blade sliced through the air as though Lord of Avian Mountain was an illusion. The wind blade failed to touch him at
all.
As long as Lord of Avian Mountain is willing to stand in front of him, the other party won’t be able to touch him. Meng Chuan could tell that Lord of Avian Mountain had casually created a layer of space and stayed inside it. Other Sixth Tribulation Eminences were unable to enter this layer of space, so they naturally couldn’t injure him at all.
Lord of Avian Mountain suddenly took a step forward. Strangely, all the wind around him receded.
He was walking The surrounding wind was avoiding him, maintaining a distance of about one feet from him.
So close yet so far. Meng Chuan sighed in amazement.
It wasn’t that the wind was retreating, but rather that Lord of Avian Mountain was controlling space, allowing the two parties to maintain such a distance forever. No matter how fast the other party was, he would always be slightly short of hitting Lord of Avian Mountain.
“Impressive.”
“A spatial law indeed crushes all other Sixth Tribulation laws.”
“Every time I see it with my own eyes, I find the difference between us too great.”
The Sixth Tribulation Eminences present discussed silently. Sixth Tribulation Eminences who grasped a spatial law were ranked as peak Sixth Tribulation Eminences. They were on a whole different level. They weren’t even afraid of falling out with Seventh Tribulation Eminences. This was because they would still have time to self-destruct an avatar if a Seventh Tribulation Eminence wanted to kill them.
“It’s my turn.” Lord of Avian Mountain—who had been hiding-finally attacked.
He pointed his finger forward.
Boom.
The raging winds that had spread everywhere were suddenly restrained! To be precise, the surrounding space was abruptly compressed into a single point. It was slightly smaller than a grain of sand, so the boundless wind was naturally contained within that point.
The fair, slender finger touched the spot, and the spot was completely destroyed with a boom.
At the moment of annihilation, Shadowfiend Walker appeared out of nowhere, still in peak condition.
Law of the past. Meng Chuan looked at this scene and knew that this was another one of Shadowfiend Walker’s techniques.
Shadowfiend Walker was a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence. He had grasped two Sixth Tribulation laws. One was the law of wind, and the other was the law of the past.
The law of the past was actually the ingenious usage of an Undying Talisman’s profundity. Shadowfiend Walker could create Undying Talismans himself.
The moment he seemed to be killed, he could project a still perfect body from the past to reality.
To kill an expert that had comprehended the law of the past, not only did one have to kill the expert’s present, but one also had to kill the expert’s past.
If the law of wind was considered relatively good for staying alive, then the law of the past could be said to give one an undying body at the Sixth Tribulation realm.
“No matter how powerful time is, it still depends on space.” Lord of Avian Mountain finally became serious. With him at the center, his surroundings began to distort and boil. Shadowfiend Walker’s body began to distort as well. Every distortion resulted in destruction and rebirth.
Shadowfiend’s body was constantly being destroyed and projected from the past to the present. However, it was clearly becoming more and more difficult for him to project his past body into the present. “Absolute Space?”
mo
ore
Everyone present watched as Meng Chuan held his breath.
In the past, only one move could break a Sixth Tribulation law-Absolute Space.
Absolute Space meant complete control. For example, the 50,000-kilometer-wide Lightning Realm that Meng Chuan had previously read about was an absolute space.
Absolute Space had a terrifying suppression on everything. Teleportation through time became extremely difficult. “In my Absolute Space, you can only project the most recent moment to the present. How many times can you project yourself? Ten times? A hundred times?” Lord of Avian Mountain looked at his opponent.
Shadowfiend Walker’s body trembled dozens of times before he immediately shouted, “Alright, alright. Stop immediately.”
Absolute Space greatly affected Shadowfiend Walker’s control over time. After the recent time nodes were destroyed, he could only use an older time node. However, the older the time node was, the harder it was for him to successfully project it into the present amidst Absolute Space.
For example, an Eighth Tribulation Eminence could directly head to the past with their body. It was something Shadowfiend Walker didn’t even dare imagine. Whoosh.
The surrounding space returned to normal. Lord of Avian Mountain smiled as he looked at Shadowfiend Walker.
“A complete spatial law is indeed invincible at the Sixth Tribulation realm.” Shadowfiend Walker shook his head. “Without Origins laws, there’s no way to suppress it.”
Meng Chuan watched all of this from a corner at the back of the hall, and he sighed.
Be it Shadowfiend Walker or Lord of Avian Mountain, they both far exceeded him. He had no way of dealing with Shadowfiend Walker’s Undying Body of the Past at all. The other party’s two laws combined could trample him.
As for Lord of Avian Mountain? In Absolute Space, he could destroy Meng Chuan however he wanted.
Spatial law, Meng Chuan thought to himself. This was also his current cultivation goal.

chapters.title: Chapter 657 - Endless Belts of Wind
chapters.content:
Chapter 657 Endless Belts of Wind
The celebration ceremony finally came to an end.
As a member of White Avian Hall’s third branch hall, Meng Chuan sat in the back and waited until the celebration ended. Of course, he also made some Sixth Tribulation friends. Although most of the Sixth Tribulation Eminences present had never spoken to Meng Chuan, they could deeply remember every cultivator present with just a glance.
They memorized their auras and locked onto each other’s karma, so the other members naturally got to know Meng Chuan.
This was Meng Chuan’s first official appearance at the third branch. Meng Chuan was also happy to get to know people. This was because these Sixth Tribulation Eminences were his companions!
To be precise, White Avian Hall’s more than 10,000 members were his companions. They were forbidden from killing each other. In the River of Spacetime, they had to help each other and join forces to fight other factions.
The result of joining a faction was that one had many companions, but there were also many enemy factions. For example, there were more than 10,000 members in Six Directions Heaven. Not to mention the other factions...
From the day Meng Chuan joined White Avian Hall, he had taken sides and was embroiled in a faction conflict. He had no choice. If he didn’t take sides, he wouldn’t even have the right to obtain many resources.
Everything depends on strength. What’s most important to me now is to comprehend the spatial law. Meng Chuan focused on his cultivation.
He had been cultivating on Clear Spring Island for 50 years. Strictly speaking, with time in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm and the Chaos Hole flowing at different speeds, another 600 years of cultivation had passed for Meng Chuan. Nearly 2,000 years had passed since he transcended the tribulation and reached the Sixth Tribulation realm.
I’ve almost grasped the spatial law’s foundation. I’ve completely comprehended Void Domain and Void Control. I’m only left with Void Walk, but I’ve reached a bottleneck. Meng Chuan arrived on the ninth floor of Thousand Mountain Star’s Eternal Tower. I can’t waste time at a bottleneck.
He had to comprehend all three aspects of the spatial law. After comprehending them, perfectly combining all three aspects would result in the spatial law.
Meng Chuan still reached a bottleneck on the spatial law’s three aspects even though he had independently created an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique, had the complete Void Catalog as his guide, was studying an Eternal treasure-Great Seal—and had very good cultivation conditions on Clear Spring Island.
This was because every cultivator had their own strengths.
The more skilled one was in a certain aspect, the faster one’s cultivation would be. If one wasn’t good at it, they would naturally cultivate slower, making it easier for them to encounter bottlenecks.
The lightning law shared similarities with Void Walk, but Meng Chuan still encountered a bottleneck.
The universe is vast. There are many strange environments. Meng Chuan flipped through Eternal Tower’s intelligence records. There are many places that are suitable for studying spatial laws.
I also have some places I’ve long wanted to visit. Yes, I’ll choose these nine places for now.
Meng Chuan chose nine special locations. The first was the Endless Belts of Wind. The second was Holy Mountain of Painting. The third was Ice River Nebula...
AS
Of these nine chosen places, seven were conducive for studying the spatial law. The other two places were places Meng Chuan had long wanted to visit. For example, Holy Mountain of Painting was the only painting ruin left behind by an Eighth Tribulation Eminence in the River of Spacetime, Daolord Evodia.
As a cultivator who liked painting, Meng Chuan naturally wanted to visit the place long ago. However, due to his cultivation on Fiend Mountain and his Tribulation Transcendence, Meng Chuan had never had the chance.
There was also Nine Tribulations Planet. There were nine huge paintings on the surface of the massive planet. It was unknown who had painted them, but it was certain that the painter was at the Eighth Tribulation realm.
After confirming that there were only two paintings left behind by Eighth Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime, Meng Chuan naturally wanted to visit them.
In comparison, Holy Mountain of Painting was ranked higher because Daolord Evodia was famous for his painting skills. He used brushes and paintings against enemies.
I’ll head to the Endless Belts of Wind first before going to Holy Mountain of Painting.
Meng Chuan set his sights on this place because it was a very suitable place for cultivating Void Walk. He had to master the three major foundations of space as soon as possible. Only by mastering all three foundations could he attempt to merge them into a complete spatial law.
The Endless Belts of Wind was in the Orchid Transformation River Zone. The spacetime structure here was very special, forming boundless gales.
The winds howled, forming a wind belt.
If one advanced past various belts, they would discover that their final destination was the same as their starting point.
Therefore, the wind advanced forever, but it would always return to its starting point.
A white-haired man arrived.
What a chaotic spacetime. Meng Chuan watched as the wind in the outer realm’s void destroyed everything. The wind would probably pulverize ordinary Imperial Lords instantly.
The endless winds caused the void to become unstable. Cracks constantly appeared and constantly recovered. Countless void rifts appeared in the Endless Belts of Wind. Furthermore, the time flow constantly changed.
As the wind howled, time would occasionally experience a three-fold, five-fold, ten-fold, or even a hundred-fold speedup.
Time to begin. Meng Chuan took a step forward and entered the Endless Belts of Wind.
The Endless Belts of Wind spanned a large area, covering half of the river system. It was a famous sight in the Universe. Chi! Chi! Chi!
Boundless wind, endless spatial rifts, and a variable spacetime-caused by the windmade the area strange and unpredictable. In such an environment, if one could walk through the Endless Belts of Wind without touching any rifts and avoid every gust of wind, it meant that one had succeeded in comprehending Void Walk. Avoid every gust of wind and all the void rifts? Meng Chuan looked at the omnipresent wind and immediately took action.
The wind might’ve been everywhere, but at Meng Chuan’s current realm, he discovered that the wind only penetrated different layers of space. He only needed to take advantage of the situation and stay in the spatial layers where the wind didn’t penetrate.
But it was very difficult to do so because the wind was immeasurable. It constantly seeped and dissipated into the different layers. Furthermore, the time flow constantly changed, and spatial rifts kept appearing.
As Meng Chuan walked, the howling wind hit his body, but it was as though the wind was blowing into nothingness. It didn’t touch him at all because Meng Chuan had already changed the spatial layer he was in over 100 times in an instant, preventing the wind from touching him.
Pfft.
But spacetime changed as the wind howled, causing Meng Chuan to make a mistake. Immediately, the wind hit Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan came here to cultivate his outer realm true body. He didn’t use his domain to block the wind, allowing it to slice through his body like a blade.
The time flow can change seven times in the blink of an eye? When walking, I have to change my pace every time the time flow changes? Meng Chuan tried to walk step by step.
If he was lucky, he could last for more than 30 seconds without touching the Endless Belts of Wind.
If he was unlucky, he would probably be hit instantly.
This won’t do. Spacetime changes with the wind, and the spatial rifts are also caused by the wind. Therefore, the source of the trajectory change is the wind. I have to grasp the source. Meng Chuan flipped his hand and took out Demon Slayer.
He immediately cleaved the wind with his saber.
There’s no rush to dodge. I’ll first sense the wind’s influence on spacetime.
Meng Chuan walked through the Endless Belts of Wind and slashed out with every step he took. Meng Chuan struck the wind with his saber again and again. He sensed the changes in the wind and the void as he cultivated.

chapters.title: Chapter 658 - One Step, One River System
chapters.content:
Chapter 658 One Step, One River System
Archean Eon Realm, Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, Clear Spring Island, Thousand Mountain Star, Endless Belts of Wind... All of Meng Chuan’s true bodies and Essence Soul avatars focused on comprehending Void Walk.
Time passed very quickly during cultivation. Meng Chuan didn’t find it boring at all. He immersed himself in studying and gaining insights. It left him intoxicated. He felt like he was an apprentice sincerely learning the most fundamental truth in the River of Spacetime. With everything in the vast universe in front of him, it was easier for him to understand their core.
Why was a plant born? Its origins could be traced to the sun’s distant light and the nutrients in the planet’s soil...
Why were Supreme Yang Stars, Supreme Yin Stars, and ordinary planets born? Why did they form an ecosystem?
The spatial law was one of the two cornerstones of the River of Spacetime. All living things relied on space. As his insights into space deepened, Meng Chuan stood at a higher vantage point when he looked at the universe.
He could clearly sense matter on a Supreme Yang Star transforming into energy. It scattered light and heat wantonly. All the changes were carried out in space. Meng Chuan could sense a massive Chaos Hole in the distance. It was devouring everything, even distorting spacetime. A nearby Supreme Yang Star was slowly approaching due to spacetime influence. He believed that tens of thousands of years later, this Supreme Yang Star would be completely devoured by the Chaos Hole.
As Meng Chuan walked through the Endless Belts of Wind, he traversed distances ranging from ten feet to trillions of kilometers with each step. He constantly struck the wind with his saber as he sensed the effects the Endless Belts of Wind had on spacetime and everything in the surrounding spacetime...
Wind was one point that could stir spacetime and affect everything.
One begets two, and two begets everything.
Bits and pieces of the Void Catalog’s description surfaced in Meng Chuan’s mind. Many of the contents he had comprehended at the beginning were the truth. He now realized that there were even more things he had yet to understand. This legacy was a guide. It allowed Meng Chuan to comprehend everything in the River of Spacetime from the height akin to that of an Eternal. Whoosh.
Meng Chuan silently stood where he was when the saber struck the wind. He allowed the Endless Belts of Wind to howl, but he was like a phantom. The wind didn’t touch him at all.
The change in time flow and the countless spatial rifts similarly couldn’t touch him at all. Even the spatial rifts on his body seemed illusory and didn’t damage him. Void Walk? Meng Chuan smiled.
Immersed in his epiphany, Meng Chuan didn’t realize that more than 200 years had passed. He silently broke through his bottleneck while undergoing Void Walk. He had completely grasped it.
Sometimes, bottlenecks were only a result of insufficient accumulation. When one’s insights were deep and vast enough, they would naturally break through the bottleneck in a single step.
There’s no need to hide deliberately for a true Void Walk. I just need to take advantage of the situation. All the spatial fluctuations caused by external forces can’t touch me as long as I take advantage of the situation. Just like leaves fluttering in the wind, one just needs to follow the void fluctuations. It’s very simple in essence, but it allows one to gain an extremely deep understanding of the void once it can be done. Meng Chuan took a step and disappeared along the fluctuations. He arrived at a river system near Wind Belts River System and appeared above a barren planet. He crossed a solar system with one step.
After grasping the three basic tenets of space, Meng Chuan’s understanding of space reached an extremely profound level. It wasn’t difficult for him to cross a river system in a single step.
This is the limit of a single step of mine. After comprehending a complete spatial law, I will be able to cross from one end of a river zone to the other. I can reach another river zone with another step.
A spatial law allowed for an extremely astonishing traversal of distance.
Even a few Seventh Tribulation Eminences might not be able to catch up to Sixth Tribulation Eminences who had comprehended a spatial law.
Of course, Seventh Tribulation Eminences had different means depending on the Origins laws they grasped. For example, the controller of a Matter law was extremely powerful, but they were the slowest amongst the numerous Origins laws. As for the controller of the Immeasurable laws, they could appear anywhere in the River of Spacetime with a thought.
If a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence had extremely deep insights into time and space, their means would be even more unpredictable. For example, when Fiend Eye saw Meng Chuan, he saw future timelines without Meng Chuan realizing at all.
Realm Ancestor could easily fish Meng Chuan up.
Whoosh.
With another step, Meng Chuan returned to Wind Belts River System. I’ve already grasped the three foundations of the spatial law. Next is the most difficult step-grasping a complete spatial law. With a solid foundation, the next step was just a step away. This step could trap him for thousands of years. It was also possible for him to make a breakthrough with an immediate epiphany.
Even the Void Catalog was only a guide. The critical steps’ completion depended on one perception. The Endless Belts of Wind affects spacetime. It also has a huge impact on the entire Wind Belts River System. It’s very suitable for me to study. Meng Chuan put away Demon Slayer and walked through the Endless Belts of Wind, sensing the wind’s influence and the river system’s ecology.
He planned on meditating to his heart’s content before heading to his next targetHoly Mountain of Painting.
In a dark void in Orchid Transformation River Zone, a massive ship-over 50,000 kilometers long-floated.
Swoosh.
A majestic figure appeared from the void and flew towards the massive ship. Eight burning, fist-sized stars floated behind him. They were eight refined Supreme Yang Star treasures.
Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!
The eight Supreme Yang Star treasures constantly infused endless flames into the stocky figure’s body.
Boom.
When he landed on the ship, the entire ship trembled slightly. His golden eyes scanned the area, and five figures appeared.
“Preparations are complete. It’s time to take action,” said the muscular figure coldly. “Everything will be done according to our prior agreement. Apart from Palace Lady Ingenious Dharma, all the other lives and treasures on Ingenious Dharma Planet will be yours.”
“Ingenious Dharma Planet is the largest trading ground in South Brahma River System. There’s also an Eternal Tower branch stationed there,” said one of the five figures. “Palace Lady Ingenious Dharma has been guarding it for a long time. She has also set up an array formation. Brother Burning Sea, are you sure you can crack Ingenious Dharma Planet’s array formation?”
“You don’t trust me?” The muscular figure’s eyes turned cold.
“Brother Burning Sea, you have broken through and grasped three Fifth Tribulation laws. We naturally believe what you say,” said another skeletal lifeform. “However, Ingenious Dharma Planet is Palace Lady Ingenious Dharma’s lair after all. With the array formation’s help, it won’t be easy to breach it. If things drag on, we might encounter some difficulties.”
“As I said, leave the cracking of the array formation to me,” said the stocky figure coldly. “What I need you to do is annihilate all living beings on Ingenious Dharma Planet. When the time comes, I won’t be able to take care of the large number of cultivators when dealing with Ingenious Dharma.”
“Hehehe, slaughtering and plundering is what our Black Fiend Hall is best at.” The five figures laughed.
The skeletal lifeform continued, “It’s fine if we don’t slaughter them, but we have to be confident in our attacks. Once we attack, Palace Lady Ingenious Dharma will definitely seek help! Will Eternal Tower send reinforcements? Will Palace Lady Ingenious Dharma have powerful friends to save her?”
“How many times has your Black Fiend Hall encountered reinforcements from Eternal Tower when committing your slaughters?” The stocky figure sneered. “Eternal Tower is a very loose organization to begin with. Furthermore, the Eminences that can provide reinforcements are typically at the Sixth Tribulation realm! In the entire Orchid Transformation River Zone, only one Sixth Tribulation Eminence has joined Eternal Tower. They seldom participate in disputes, so they won’t interfere with Black Fiend Hall’s matters.”
Very few Sixth Tribulation Eminences interfered in Black Fiend Hall’s matters. Only if there was karma involved would it be alright to interfere once or twice. But if one were to interfere repeatedly, Black Fiend Hall would believe that this Sixth Tribulation Eminence was targeting all of Black Fiend Hall. They would then suffer Black Fiend Hall’s revenge.
Black Fiend Hall was a notorious top faction in the River of Spacetime. There were many Sixth Tribulation Eminences, half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences, and even Seventh Tribulation Eminences. Furthermore, they were extremely united and crazy. All of them were fiends.
“I’ve roamed Orchid Transformation River Zone for many years. I know all of Palace Lady Ingenious Dharma’s good friends. Don’t worry; she doesn’t have any powerful friends.” The stocky figure sneered. “At the very least, they are nothing in my eyes.”
“Brother Burning Sea knows Palace Lady Ingenious Dharma the best. Since you are certain that she doesn’t have any Sixth Tribulation friends, we feel assured,” said the skeletal lifeform with a smile.
The other four figures nodded slightly.
The stocky figure’s eyes burned as he said, “She’s very attached to her homeworld. She’s dedicated to protecting South Brahma River System. Hehe, I’m going to destroy everything she protects.”
The five Black Fiend Hall Tribulation Eminences beside him didn’t care about the grudge between Starlord Burning Sea and Palace Lady Ingenious Dharma. They only cared about the opportunity to slaughter and plunder. They could already foresee a large number of the river system’s cultivators being slaughtered and countless treasures appearing in their hands as their hearts burned with anticipation.
–

chapters.title: Chapter 659 - White Avian Hall, City Lord Eastcalm
chapters.content:
Chapter 659 White Avian Hall, City Lord Eastcalm
Orchid Transformation River Zone, South Brahma River System’s Ingenious Dharma Planet.
This was the most prosperous trading ground in South Brahma River System. There was also an Eternal Tower branch that attracted a large number of cultivators to gather here. To cultivators, the fair transactions possible here allowed them to exchange for the cultivation resources they needed.
“We only arrived here after traveling for more than 100 years. We have to tour Ingenious Dharma Planet properly.” A man with three swords on his back looked at the bustling city and said with a smile, “Free and easy time. It’s very safe on Ingenious Dharma Planet. No one will dare to force a sale.”
“Alright.”
“After risking our lives exploring ruins, we finally have the opportunity to visit Ingenious Dharma Planet to exchange for benefits.” The man’s surrounding companions were rather excited. They had long heard of South Brahma River System’s holy land, Ingenious Dharma Planet, and they were finally here.
“Let’s meet at the city gates before nightfall,” said the sword-bearing man in high spirits. Just as he finished speaking
Boom!
Outer realm essence energy in Ingenious Dharma Planet surged violently. The sound of essence energy surging made all the cultivators tremble in fear. They looked up and saw layers of array formations appear above Ingenious Dharma Planet. The layers of array formations complemented each other, perfectly enveloping the massive planet that spanned four million kilometers. It also affected an area of nearly half a billion kilometers. No living beings were allowed to enter this area.
“Something major has happened.” The sword-bearing man was stunned.
His companions also realized that something was amiss.
“What?”
“What happened?”
“Something big must have happened!” The tens of thousands of cultivators on Ingenious Dharma Planet were panic-stricken. They looked up at all the array formations on Ingenious Dharma Planet and realized that something was amiss.
Palace Lady Ingenious Dharma was a Fifth Tribulation Eminence. If she had to unleash all the array formations on Ingenious Dharma Planet, it definitely meant that she was facing a huge threat.
“No one can escape from Ingenious Dharma Planet today.” Accompanied by a wanton voice that resounded throughout the entire planet, array formations appeared around the planet. Although the temporary array formations’ range was relatively small, the numbers made up for the shortcomings. Dozens of array formations completely enveloped the planet’s array formation like ugly patches, preventing any cultivators from escaping.
Figures with powerful auras appeared outside Ingenious Dharma Planet without any concealment. Five Fifth Tribulation Eminences led more than 70 Tribulation Eminences and more than 300 Imperial Lords. “Black Fiend Hall.”
“It’s Black Fiend Hall.” Many cultivators on Ingenious Dharma Planet were knowledgeable. They recognized a number of Black Fiend Hall members.
“What? Black Fiend Hall?”
“Black Fiend Hall will kill all Supremacies.” The countless cultivators on Ingenious Dharma Planet became even more flustered. They were like ants facing an apocalypse. They were in despair, but there was nothing they could do to resist.
Black Fiend Hall was infamous. It was a top faction in the River of Spacetime that was comparable to Eternal Tower. Their rules were very simple. They would promise some conditions to deal with captured Tribulation Eminences and attract Tribulation Eminences to follow them.
They were more ruthless towards Imperial Lords. If they handed over 200 Outer Realm Essence Crystals and pledged their loyalty to them for 1,000 years, they would be spared from death. However, Black Fiend Hall slaughtered the weakest cultivators – Supremacies—and seized their treasures. Over the years, countless living beings had been slaughtered by Black Fiend Hall.
“We are doomed to encounter Black Fiend Hall.” Despair filled the hearts of the people on Ingenious Dharma Planet.
Boom!
Boom!
A terrifying collision erupted in the sky above Ingenious Dharma Planet.
A towering figure-standing at half a million kilometers tall, with massive Supreme Yang Stars surrounding him-stood there. Countless flames rose from his body as he tore through the outer array formation with a single swipe of his claw.
“Burning Sea.” A purple-robed woman stood high in the sky. Her face was pale, filled with despair and anger.
“Haha, Ingenious Dharma.” The towering figure’s two eyes were like two stars as he looked down at the puny purple-robed woman. “I already have a way to crack your array formation. In 30 seconds, Ingenious Dharma Planet—which you have guarded for so many years—will be destroyed by me. Tens of thousands of cultivators will die with you.”
“Your cultivation journey started with you being weak. Why must you treat weak cultivators like this?” The purple-robed woman knew that nothing could stop him. She could only watch in despair as her heart ached.
She had experienced despair before. Thus, she understood how pitiful the weak cultivators in the outer realm were all the more. They died in large batches in dangerous environments. They were plundered, killed, and bullied. The law of the jungle was prevalent. Only when a river system had sufficiently powerful existences to protect it and set rules to prevent plundering factions from existing could everything be stable.
She was willing to do so. She wanted the cultivators to stop reliving her past despair.
She silently protected Ingenious Dharma Planet and maintained South Brahma River System’s order. However, today... everything was about to be destroyed.
She was a Fifth Tribulation Eminence. Even if she lost, she would only lose this outer realm true body. She could recultivate it.
“But they...” Palace Lady Ingenious Dharma swept her gaze across the countless cultivators on Ingenious Dharma Planet and the disciples she had recruited over the years.
These Supremacies only had one true body. Death meant the end for them.
“More than 53,000 Supremacies.” Palace Lady Ingenious Dharma and the Supremacies on Ingenious Dharma Planet probably occupied half of South Brahma River System. Imperial Lords and Tribulation Eminences still had a choice, but these Supremacies were out of options.
“Eternal Tower, please send a Sixth Tribulation Eminence.” Palace Lady Ingenious Dharma requested help the moment she discovered the danger, but she knew that the probability of a miracle happening was very low.
This was because an Eternal Tower branch’s predicament required a Sixth Tribulation Eminence’s aid. As for Eternal Tower, it was very lax. Very few Sixth Tribulation Eminences were willing to cross the vast distances to help. Furthermore, Eternal Tower typically only sent news to the Sixth Tribulation Eminences in the surrounding river zones. They came if they could, but they would skip doing so if they couldn’t. Eternal Tower was very indifferent to such matters because such things had been happening for a long time.
What was happening on Ingenious Dharma Planet was just an inconspicuous wave in the long river of history.
...
Orchid Transformation River Zone, Endless Belts of Wind.
Meng Chuan—who was immersed in his cultivation-received a piece of news.
Oh? Meng Chuan was surprised. News from Eternal Tower?
In Orchid Transformation River Zone’s South Brahma River System, Ingenious Dharma Planet has encountered a Black Fiend Hall attack. The leaders are six Fifth Tribulation Eminences? Meng Chuan was astonished when he received the news. I never expected that the first mission I received from Eternal Tower is related to Black Fiend Hall.
As a core member of Eternal Tower, Meng Chuan had responsibilities. After all, he hadn’t established an Eternal Tower River Zone branch. If he didn’t accept missions, he would be forced to carry out missions every 10,000 years.
