I’ll accept this mission. Meng Chuan took a step and disappeared from Wind Belts River System.
On Ingenious Dharma Planet, the towering, half-a-million-kilometer-tall Starlord Burning Sea was tearing apart the array formation with his claw. Previously, he had said that he would crack the array formation in 30 seconds, but in reality, he had made ample preparations. He had long hired an array formation Eminence to investigate Ingenious Dharma Planet in advance and jot down the method to crack the array formations. With his current strength, he was confident of completely cracking the array formation in 30 seconds.
“Brother Burning Sea is really fast at cracking array formations. From the looks of it, he will soon be able to crack them completely.” The five Black Fiend Hall Eminences watched from afar.
“Prepare yourselves. Don’t let any cultivator escape.” The skeletal lifeform cackled. “This is what we promised Brother Burning Sea.” Apart from the five of them, more than 70 Tribulation Eminences were also watching in anticipation. On the other hand, the 300-plus Imperial Lords in Black Fiend Hall felt somewhat numb. Imperial Lords were at the bottom of Black Fiend Hall’s auxiliary members. They would be squeezed dry for 1,000 years before they could regain their freedom. They would not receive any benefits during this process. I’ve roamed the outer realm for thousands of years, but I haven’t exchanged for manuals or treasures to bring back to my hometown. How aggravating
I’m encountering such a dire situation on my first visit to Ingenious Dharma Planet?
I’ve already cultivated to become a Heaven Earth Supremacy. I have a chance of becoming an Imperial Lord. I can’t accept this! I can’t!
No, no...
I’ve just exchanged for resources. I was just one step away from leaving.
Countless cultivators on Ingenious Dharma Planet looked up in despair as the towering Starlord Burning Sea tore through the array formation.
“This Eternal Tower branch is under Lord of Demented Aristocrats’s command. Please allow us passage,” said a gray-robed elder loudly from above the Eternal Tower branch.
“We will give in on account of Lord of Demented Aristocrats, but this Eternal Tower branch needs to be inspected. Only those who are internal members and are not cultivators from South Brahma River System can live. The rest have to die. We won’t touch the treasures in the Eternal Tower branch either.” A voice sounded in the gray-robed elder’s ears.
The gray-robed elder’s expression changed slightly, but he could only hold it in. In fact, there was no way for Black Fiend Hall to snatch Eternal Tower’s treasures because treasures could be teleported away.
In order to prevent Sixth Tribulation Eminences from interfering, Black Fiend Hall would be lenient with an Eternal Tower branch that was nothing but an empty shell. Due to the deal with Starlord Burning Sea, the conditions were even harsher. They had to examine every member of Eternal Tower carefully.
High in the sky, the purple-robed Palace Lady Ingenious Dharma looked at Black Fiend Hall’s fiends. She then looked down at the countless cultivators in despair and panic. She recalled what she had experienced back then and thought to herself, The world is just like this. The weak are just so powerless. They can’t even control their own fates. I want to protect Ingenious Dharma Planet, but... I’ve already done my best.
Eternal Tower will only send my request for reinforcements to the few Sixth Tribulation Eminences in the surrounding river zones. When those people receive the news, they will probably throw it to the side and ignore it. Palace Lady Ingenious Dharma looked up and waited for the moment the array formation cracked.
Suddenly, she was stunned.
A white-robed, white-haired man abruptly appeared outside Ingenious Dharma Planet. He appeared out of thin air without any warning.
The moment he appeared, his aura didn’t converge at all. It naturally enveloped a five-billion-kilometer area. Be it the array formation on Ingenious Dharma Planet or the array formations set up by Black Fiend Hall’s members, none of them could stop him. His aura spread out.
The people around him were like ants looking up at a giant dragon. They trembled instinctively.
All living beings...
The Tribulation Eminences, Imperial Lords, and the tens of thousands of Supremacies standing on Ingenious Dharma Planet looked up at the outer realm void. When they saw the white-robed, white-haired man, their minds went blank. They stopped thinking.
Outside Ingenious Dharma Planet, Black Fiend Hall’s members and Starlord Burning Seawho was tearing apart the array formationstopped what they were doing and turned to look at the white-robed, white-haired man in horror.
The weaker Tribulation Eminences and Imperial Lords’ minds went blank. They couldn’t think. However, the five Fifth Tribulation Eminences and Starlord Burning Sea could still think since Meng Chuan wasn’t deliberately using his moves.
“White Avian Hall, City Lord Eastcalm!” The skeletal lifeform let out a sharp cry. “Retreat!”
The Tribulation Eminences—who could still think clearly-instinctively wanted to flee. There were many of them, and all of them had their own means of escaping. If they split up and fled, a few might have a chance of escaping.
The white-robed, white-haired man stood in the void. His eyes were dark as though a vast world existed in his pupils’ depths.
He scanned the area.
Starlord Burning Sea, five Fifth Tribulation Eminences, 17 Fourth Tribulation Eminences, and more than 50 weak Tribulation Eminences from Black Fiend Hall had their Essence Souls destroyed. Furthermore, this terrifying attack pursued the Tribulation Eminences through karma.
Eighth Tribulation mystic technique-Pupil of Darkness!

chapters.title: Chapter 660 - Exterminating Evil
chapters.content:
Chapter 660 - Exterminating Evil
Meng Chuan was filled with killing intent towards these Black Fiend Hall fiends. The moment he attacked, he used one of his trump cards—Pupil of Darkness.
"That's—"
When the six Fifth Tribulation Eminences saw Meng Chuan's eyes, they felt a strong attraction to his eyes. They couldn't help but sink into them. Their consciousness sank into darkness, and their Essence Souls were destroyed.
Chi!
They carried Undying Talismans with them, which they had left marks on. The moment their Essence Souls were destroyed, the Undying Talismans naturally activated. Their past self projected onto the present, and their Essence Souls completely recovered.
But the moment Starlord Burning Sea and the others regained consciousness, they saw the pair of dark eyes once more and sank into oblivion once again.
Undying Talismans were a usage of the law of the past. It was considered the strongest life-preservation means at the Sixth Tribulation realm. The Undying Talismans sold in the outside world were typically casually refined by Seventh Tribulation Eminences. They could refine them in large quantities, so weak Tribulation Eminences typically had a few prepared.
An Undying Talisman had limited power. It could only resurrect a Fifth Tribulation Eminence once!
This Black Fiend Hall Fourth Tribulation Eminence actually has 20 Undying Talismans on him? Is he selling Undying Talismans? With a thought, Meng Chuan shattered the Undying Talismans that the Tribulation Eminence had yet to activate. The Undying Talismans that had marks on them could only be destroyed. They couldn't be used by other living beings.
An Undying Talisman could revive a Fifth Tribulation Eminence once. It could revive a Fourth Tribulation Eminence about ten times and revive a newly-advanced Tribulation Eminence over 100 times.
However, an Imperial Lord could maintain an undying state for two hours. This was because Imperial Lords and Tribulation Eminences were on completely different levels of existence. It was much easier for an Imperial Lord to maintain an undying state with an Undying Talisman.
Powerful Tribulation Eminences like Starlord Burning Sea died as their corpses floated in the void.
The weak Tribulation Eminences held on for a while longer, but their bodies convulsed. Clearly, they died the moment they revived. Soon, they lost their vitality completely.
…
"No—" Among the Fifth Tribulation Eminences that attacked Ingenious Dharma Planet, only one was a special lifeform—Starlord Mist Cliff. His true body was in a Sixth Tribulation Eminence's cave abode. He was also protected by this Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
He was dressed in a gray robe, and an illusory fog surrounded him. The head in the fog revealed a look of horror and despair.
Logically speaking, it was unlikely for a Sixth Tribulation Eminence to kill a Fifth Tribulation Eminence through karma remotely. However, Meng Chuan's Pupil of Darkness was clearly extraordinary.
Whoosh.
The gray-robed special lifeform saw the pair of dark eyes again. He couldn't help but sink into eternal darkness.
Swoosh.
A red-haired elder appeared out of thin air. When he saw the gray fog corpse left behind by the gray-robed special lifeform, his expression couldn't help but change slightly. Mist Cliff is dead? Killing a Fifth Tribulation Eminence through karma? Could the murderer be a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence?
In a face-off, a Sixth Tribulation Eminence could naturally kill a Fifth Tribulation Eminence with a flip of their hand. But it was impossible for an ordinary Sixth Tribulation Eminence to kill a Fifth Tribulation Eminence through karma remotely. They were either skilled in the karmic lineage or extremely powerful in certain aspects.
"Investigate who it is." As a Sixth Tribulation Eminence, the red-haired elder immediately investigated the matter through Black Fiend Hall.
…
In a middle-level world, the strongest expert in this world lived on White Bone Mountain.
"This City Lord Eastcalm is so ruthless." The skeletal lifeform was alarmed and furious. "He wasn't satisfied with killing a single avatar. He wants to kill us completely? Mist Cliff is dead. Eight Fourth Tribulation Eminences are dead. Almost all the weaker Tribulation Eminences are dead."
Even if weak Tribulation Eminences hid in their homeworld, they couldn't withstand Meng Chuan's Pupil of Darkness's karmic descent. Hence, almost all of them died. Only two Third Tribulation Eminences survived in their homeworld.
The eight Fourth Tribulation Eminences and the Fifth Tribulation Eminence who had died were all special lifeforms.
Special lifeforms didn't have a homeworld's protection, so their life-preservation means were much weaker. Of course, they could head the Black Fiend Hall's River of Spacetime headquarters if they could become a Sixth Tribulation Eminence. The protection of Black Fiend Hall's headquarters wasn't much weaker than that of an inhabited world. The headquarters also had a Seventh Tribulation Eminence permanently presiding over it.
These Black Fiend Hall members ultimately lined the bottom ranks. They had yet to become core members of Black Fiend Hall.
…
Outside Ingenious Dharma Planet.
Meng Chuan looked at the Black Fiend Hall Imperial Lords.
These Imperial Lords are just forced servants. However, as Black Fiend Hall's henchmen, I'll destroy their true bodies as punishment. Meng Chuan understood that these Imperial Lords couldn't bear to part with their treasures. After all, some treasures might have been acc.u.mulated by their species over generations. They had to protect them at all costs. Therefore, they would rather be lackeys. Some Imperial Lords didn't care about other cultivators' lives. They just wanted to protect their treasures.
No matter what, they had to pay the price for being Black Fiend Hall's lackeys.
Weren't they most concerned about treasures?
Whoosh.
With a thought, all the treasures on the 300-plus Imperial Lords—including life-preservation items—flashed to Meng Chuan's side. With a wave of his hand, Meng Chuan stored away the Imperial Lords' treasures and the treasures left behind by Tribulation Eminences.
Following that, more than 300 Imperial Lords' bodies were reduced to dust. Meng Chuan stored the Tribulation Eminences' bodies as they had many uses.
Meng Chuan turned his head and saw Palace Lady Ingenious Dharma flying over.
"Greetings, City Lord Eastcalm." Palace Lady Ingenious Dharma's eyes were filled with gratitude. "Thank you, City Lord Eastcalm, for saving tens of thousands of cultivators on Ingenious Dharma Planet."
"I happened to be in Orchid Transformation River Zone." Meng Chuan looked at Ingenious Dharma Planet.
Joy filled the entire planet. The cultivators on the planet were very astute. They could tell that the white-robed, white-haired man was here to help the planet. He easily killed all the members of Black Fiend Hall.
The half-a-million-kilometer-tall Starlord Burning Sea—who was tearing apart Ingenious Dharma Planet's array formation—was reduced to a floating corpse with just a single glance from the white-robed, white-haired man.
Amidst the cheers and excitement, the sword-bearing man and company—who had just arrived on Ingenious Dharma Planet—were also very excited.
"This Eminence is too powerful. Brother Wang, you are the most knowledgeable. Do you know which Eminence he is?"
"How would I know? Even Palace Lady Ingenious Dharma is so respectful towards him. Perhaps he's a peak Eminence in the River of Spacetime." The sword-bearing man's eyes were filled with yearning. "We were able to escape today thanks to this Eminence. We can be considered lucky. To be able to witness such a scene in our lives… So many Tribulation Eminences and Imperial Lords were killed in the blink of an eye."
"Yes. Where are all those Tribulation Eminences and Imperial Lords? They disappeared just like that."
When I return to my homeworld, I'll definitely write it on the sect's dossiers and let my juniors learn about this. This is the grandest scene I've experienced in the past 500 years.
"Qian Mushen, you have to ask around more. I believe that there will be information on this Eminence senior in the city very soon."
His companions smiled as they chatted. They were all Supremacies, and they were far inferior to Meng Chuan in strength. Furthermore, they had survived because of Meng Chuan. They naturally felt grateful, impressed, and even more reverent.
"Yes, I'll definitely ask around." The eyes of the young Supremacy named Qian Mushen lit up. The Eminence he now admired the most was the white-robed, white-haired man.
…
In the void outside Ingenious Dharma Planet.
Meng Chuan looked at the tens of thousands of excited cultivators with a look of reminiscence. By the side, Palace Lady Ingenious Dharma and said, "More than 50,000 cultivators were in despair previously. They had no way of resisting Black Fiend Hall. They are now alive because of you, Senior City Lord Eastcalm. This is the case in the outer realm. Whether they live or die doesn't depend on themselves. It depends on the strong."
"Cultivators have differences in strength to begin with," said Meng Chuan. "After stepping into the outer realm, one has to be prepared to face all sorts of dangers."
"The strong can establish order and protect the weak," said Palace Lady Ingenious Dharma.
"The environment might be good or bad," said Meng Chuan. "As a cultivator, the only thing they can grasp is to make themselves become stronger."
Palace Lady Ingenious Dharma was slightly taken aback.
"The cultivation world is a place where the strong survive," said Meng Chuan with a smile. "Cultivators who step into the outer realm have lived for centuries or even millennia. How can they hope to be protected forever?"
Palace Lady Ingenious Dharma pondered for a moment before saying, "City Lord Eastcalm, you saved the entire Ingenious Dharma Planet. Please be my guest."
"There's no need." Meng Chuan shook his head. "I still have something to do."
Meng Chuan looked into the distance. He had been cultivating in the Endless Belts of Wind for so long. Now that Eternal Tower's mission had interrupted him, it was about time for him to stop cultivating in the Endless Belts of Wind. He had already achieved his original goal—Void Walk. It was about time.
He had made a series of preparations to comprehend a complete spatial law.
It's time to head to Holy Mountain of Painting.
"I'm leaving." After saying that, Meng Chuan took a step and disappeared.
Palace Lady Ingenious Dharma stood in the void and pondered for a moment before flying back to Ingenious Dharma Planet.

chapters.title: Chapter 661 - Cultivation at Holy Mountain of Painting
chapters.content:
Chapter 661 Cultivation at Holy Mountain of Painting
Three Bay River System’s Thousand Mountain Star, Eternal Tower’s ninth floor.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar arrived and flipped through the countless items sold by Eternal Tower.
“One Evodia Mystic Realm, Holy Mountain of Painting token. Meng Chuan selected what he wanted.
“Ten thousand cubes.” A cold, mighty voice rang out from above. Meng Chuan was already prepared.
Holy Mountain of Painting was a painting relic left behind by Daolord Evodia. It was also a treasure land in the River of Spacetime. It was now occupied by a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, Manor Lord Centaurea. Manor Lord Centaurea had also permanently stationed Master Poison Eye to guard it.
Any cultivator could visit Holy Mountain of Painting! However, the entry fee was 10,000 cubes. There was no time limit.
It costs each cultivator 10,000 cubes to visit Holy Mountain of Painting. A thousand cultivators is worth ten million cubes. It’s really easy for Seventh Tribulation Eminences to earn treasures. Meng Chuan sighed inwardly. There were tens of thousands of Sixth Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime. There were even more Fifth Tribulation Eminences. Although there were many opportunities in the River of Spacetime, and the painting ruins weren’t a specific formulation, there were still many who were willing to spend 10,000 cubes.
After all, it was a ruin left behind by an Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
Resources in the River of Spacetime were occupied by the strongest experts.
Evodia Mystic Realm was a mystic realm created by Daolord Evodia. Holy Mountain of Painting was located within it.
Whoosh.
Evodia Mystic Realm didn’t bar outsiders from visiting, so Meng Chuan easily arrived at Evodia Mystic Realm. This was a beautiful scenic world. The moment Meng Chuan arrived, a thin elder appeared out of thin air. He was dressed in a black robe, had silver eyes, and emitted a cold aura. He was clearly not someone that was easy to get along with. However, the silver-eyed elder smiled when he saw Meng Chuan. “So it’s City Lord Eastcalm.”
“Greetings, Senior Poison Eye.” Meng Chuan was very humble.
This was a peak Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence that he admired very much. Meng Chuan didn’t admire his strength, but what he had done.
Very few people in the River of Spacetime dared to fall out with top factions like Black Fiend Hall, Shadow Lands, and Darkstar Guild. However, Master Poison Eye was one of them.
Poison Eye was actually a very benevolent Tribulation Eminence. As Black Fiend Hall was excessively crazy, Poison Eye couldn’t tolerate it. He repeatedly thwarted Black Fiend Hall’s schemes and suffered from Black Fiend Hall’s relentless revenge. Anyone who was close to Poison Eye could be implicated. Therefore, Poison Eye changed his name and became even more reclusive.
Manor Lord Centaurea thought highly of Master Poison Eye and stood forward to protect him.
Manor Lord Centaurea was the one with the most connections among the Seventh Tribulation Eminences. The ones who owed him favors were Celestial Thearch Myriad Star, Hall Lord White Avian, and nearly ten other Seventh Tribulation Eminences. By stepping forward to protect Poison Eye, he made his life easier.
“This is Holy Mountain of Painting’s token. Meng Chuan immediately took out the token and handed it to the other party.
“City Lord Eastcalm, you can come to Holy Mountain of Painting any time in the future with no time restrictions.” Master Poison Eye’s stiff face revealed a smile. “Daolord Evodia’s paintings are truly impressive. Although I’ve been guarding Evodia Mystic Realm for more than 30,000 years, I still find these paintings to be filled with endless profundities. City Lord Eastcalm, you are also an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence. You can leave an Essence Soul avatar here permanently to study it.
“By the way, there are some things that need to be mentioned in advance. There are countless living beings in Evodia Mystic Realm. Therefore, you are limited to moving in the half-million-kilometer radius around Holy Mountain of Painting. You can’t enter other places.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “I understand.”
“Follow me.” Master Poison Eye personally led Meng Chuan as they flew. With their flying speed, they arrived in less than five seconds even at a leisurely speed.
“That’s Holy Mountain of Painting.” Poison Eye pointed at a towering mountain in the distance. One side of the mountain had been sliced cleanly.
The flat mountain wall was 45,000 kilometers tall and tens of thousands of kilometers wide.
There were massive paintings on the mountain wall. When Meng Chuan swept his gaze across them, he felt like an ant being pressed down by a world. His head felt dizzy.
“You can’t view it as a whole,” said Master Poison Eye immediately. “There are a total of 33 paintings on the mountain wall. Every painting contains Origins laws at the very least. If you view them as a whole, the 33 paintings can form a whole due to the connection between their auras. Even a Seventh Tribulation Eminence will feel dizzy and find it unbearable when they see them. You have to study them separately.”
“Even a painting left behind has such might.” Meng Chuan sighed in amazement.
“That’s right. Every single painting was left behind by Daolord Evodia based on his different insights. They are even from different periods in his life,” said Poison Eye. “Some paintings were drawn hundreds of millions of years apart, but the 33 paintings are now one.” Hundreds of millions of years apart? Meng Chuan was astonished. Although he knew about Holy Mountain of Painting, he didn’t know the details.
Master Poison Eye nodded. “I’m very impressed with Daolord Evodia. That’s why I’ve carefully delved into his history. These paintings were created by Daolord Evodia at different times. The last painting was created more than 700 million years ago. Daolord Evodia is still alive. More than 3 million years ago, he appeared in our universe once. Perhaps one day, he will appear again and leave behind the 34th painting on the mountain.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
Although an Eighth Tribulation Eminence couldn’t truly be eternal, they could completely jump out of the River of Time. This allowed them to live in different time periods or even different universes with ease.
Meng Chuan felt rather envious when he thought about it.
Daolord Evodia had appeared three million years ago. Perhaps the next time he appeared would be hundreds of millions of years later.
“There are still 11 other cultivators looking at Holy Mountain of Painting,” said Poison Eye with a smile. “Cultivate here. Don’t disturb the other cultivators. Don’t go beyond half a million kilometers. Other than that, there are no other restrictions.”
“I’ll remember the rules,” said Meng Chuan.
Poison Eye nodded and smiled before flying into the distance. He landed in a cave abode that spanned a kilometer. He also spent all his time studying the painting.
Meng Chuan wasn’t in a hurry to set up his cave abode. Instead, he first looked at Holy Mountain of Painting.
I’ll take a cursory look first.
Although Meng Chuan felt suffocated when he scanned the entire painting, he was still attracted by one of the paintings.
A painting with the Chaos Hole as core. Meng Chuan looked at the painting. He had comprehended the Chaos Hole lineage the most.
This Chaos Hole Art spanned more than 4,000 kilometers. The painting was extremely complicated. The traces of each stroke used to draw the painting could be clearly seen. It was clearly painted on the mountain wall, but Meng Chuan could see different spatial layers
– he could now sense all spatial layers. This painting affected all spatial layers, an amazing painting that combined many layers of structure.
From his spatial perception, Meng Chuan seemed to see a real black Chaos Hole. The black Chaos Hole constantly spun and devoured everything around it.
If one were to look at it from a flat surface, they would see countless dark and cold traces of paintings. It was as though countless tadpoles had gathered at the center of the painting.
I’ll take a look at the other paintings. Although Meng Chuan had a strong urge, he wasn’t in a hurry to study them. Instead, he looked at the next painting.
The next painting was a pair of enormous eyes. From the countless marks on the painting, one could tell that Daolord Evodia had probably spent a long time painting it.
Every painting strongly stimulated Meng Chuan.
Painting was to view the world from a different angle. It was completely different from studying the laws of spacetime. As someone who also liked painting, Meng Chuan could view the world from a different angle, so he could understand Daolord Evodia’s thoughts when painting
Huh? This painting? Meng Chuan only took a cursory look at each painting. When he saw the 20th painting, he couldn’t help but be stunned.
This was because all of Daolord Evodia’s previous paintings were extremely vast and complicated. It was like looking up at the endless starry sky. The number of strokes was in the hundreds of millions. Meng Chuan could understand this. After all, these paintings contained Origins laws. There were even many Origins laws and spatial laws. They were naturally complicated and mysterious.
As for the 20th painting, it was a very simple painting. In just six strokes, the painting was naturally formed. The painting looked very simple at first, but every stroke was extremely profound. The six strokes produced countless mysteries. I find this painting even harder to comprehend. As a painter, Meng Chuan understood that complicated paintings were easier to understand. However, the painting in front of him was much harder to understand.
However, this painting should have a more profound essence. Meng Chuan took a closer look before turning his head to continue looking at the other paintings. Thirty-three paintings. Thirty-two were extremely complicated paintings. There was only one simple painting. These paintings drew upon each other’s auras, forming a perfect whole.
I’ll take my time. Meng Chuan wasn’t in a hurry. He landed at the foot of the mountain cliff and waved his hand, setting up an ordinary cave abode that spanned a kilometer. This was where he would cultivate.

chapters.title: Chapter 662 - Painting
chapters.content:
Chapter 662 Painting
Inside the cave abode, there was a chamber with wide-open windows.
Meng Chuan-who was sitting cross-leggedcould clearly see Holy Mountain of Painting through the window. I’ll focus on the Chaos Hole lineage first. Meng Chuan was very clear-headed. He had the most insights in this aspect, so he naturally had to spend more effort on it.
A total of six of the 33 paintings contained a Chaos Hole law. Only one of them solely contained a Chaos Hole law.
Meng Chuan looked at the Chaos Hole Art.
From multiple angles...
From a flat angle...
From the lightning lineage’s perspective... He viewed the painting from different angles. Meng Chuan’s talent in painting was extremely high. He could vaguely understand why Daolord Evodia would paint like this. At the very least, Meng Chuan and Daolord Evodia shared some similarities in painting.
These insights were corroborated with the Great Seal Eternal treasure and his cultivation at Clear Spring Mountain. The Essence Soul avatar in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s Realm Palace—which took up more than half of his Essence Soul’s Origins-deduced these insights with a 10x speedup. The collision of different insights naturally gave rise to several more insights.
This painting is a flat surface painting after all. I can try painting too.
With a thought, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World condensed energy into matter, forming a white piece of paper that took up most of the chamber.
Meng Chuan reached out and grabbed a brush. The tip of the brush naturally condensed ink. After some thought, he placed the brush down and began painting.
He first tried to copy the painting, but Meng Chuan felt aggrieved and uncomfortable. After painting for ten minutes, Meng Chuan frowned and put away his brush and canvas. The huge piece of paper in front of him silently disintegrated
My cultivation realm is too lacking. It’s not suitable for me to copy. I’ll just paint my own insights. Meng Chuan began painting again. This time, he painted his insights from the Chaos Hole Art.
Free imagination was very different from painting By personally painting, Meng Chuan deepened his understanding of the Chaos Hole Art.
That’s right. That’s how it should be. It’s because Daolord Evodia drew out his insights into the Chaos Hole law that it became a Chaos Hole Art. By drawing out my insights, I can use the painting as a comparison. It is more beneficial for gathering new insights. Meng Chuan became more and more excited as he painted.
I’ll paint them separately. The insights obtained from different angles shall be divided into different paintings. I’ll first draw from the Void Domain’s angle. Meng Chuan immersed himself in painting.
Meng Chuan freely painted from Void Domain’s angle. His painting was like a dark abyss.
From Void Walk’s angle, he drew lines. The countless lines made his heart palpitate, as though they led him toward Nirvana.
From Void Control’s angle, it was a segmented picture. The further one went, the more chaotic and darker it became.
The particle-state perspective-Meng Chuan could enter the particle state after grasping the lightning law-was another way to view the world. From this angle, the painting consisted of countless black dots.
From the lightning law’s angle, what Meng Chuan drew was a vortex formed by countless lightning bolts-a vortex that appeared to devour everything.
Meng Chuan spent three years painting the five paintings. It made him feel like he had been reborn. His understanding of the Chaos Hole law deepened, and his understanding of the spatial law became much more thorough.
Following these five angles, I can paint at a deeper level. Meng Chuan immersed himself in the joy of painting.
In a hall in the Darkstar Space, a group of members was handling intelligence.
“Find out where City Lord Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, is,” instructed a tall, thin-robed figure.
“Alright.”
A Sixth Tribulation Eminence—who was good at karma-investigated the area.
With Meng Chuan being one of the second-tier hunting targets on the Darkstar Guild’s list, they would check the locations of all his avatars once a year. From his location, one could guess what Meng Chuan was doing. Was he cultivating in seclusion, exploring ruins, or did he enter a mysterious treasure land?
Once they determined that there was value in plundering, the Darkstar Guild would immediately take action.
“Many of his true body avatars are in Three Bay River System, Clear Spring Island, Valley of Spacetime, and Evodia Mystic Realm. One of his avatars has always been in a mysterious place in the Taidong River Zone. It hasn’t moved at all. We’ve investigated the Taidong River Zone previously. Earth Cloud Mystic Realm is suspected to be there,” said a chubby Eminence. His figure was considered normal in the Darkstar Space. In the outside world, his true body was more than ten million times larger and much more evil. “He’s been cultivating all this time and hasn’t gone to any ruin or treasure trove?” The lanky figure frowned slightly.
Meng Chuan’s true body and avatars—which cultivated in various places- definitely wouldn’t carry any treasures. It wasn’t worth it for them to take action.
“Investigate Cang Li again,” instructed the lanky figure.
Cang Li was also one of the Darkstar Guild’s hunting targets. He was also ranked second-tier. The Darkstar Guild was extremely certain that Cang Li had a valuable treasure. However, Cang Li was too slippery. The Darkstar Guild had never successfully encircled him. The Darkstar Guild suspected that Cang Li had grasped a law that could predict the future. The chubby Eminence sensed for a moment and said, “Cang Li’s outer realm true body has already left the Valley of Spacetime. Now... he should be in Phoenix Nest Ancestral Land.”
“The phoenix’s ancestral land?” The other members in the hall were alarmed when they heard that.
“He went to the Phoenix Nest as an outsider?”
“The phoenixes think so highly of him?”
These members were envious and jealous. The dragons and phoenixes were the two special lifeforms with the richest heritage in the River of Spacetime. For an outsider to enter the phoenixes’ ancestral land, it was definite that they had taken the initiative to provide him opportunities.
“My karmic perception has been affected, but I can still confirm that he is in the vicinity of Phoenix Nest. Outsiders are forbidden from approaching Phoenix Nest Ancestral Land, so there’s a high chance that he’s inside.” The fat Eminence was extremely certain.
The tall, thin-robed figure nodded. “The phoenixes’ Lady Phoenix Treasure has an extraordinary relationship with Cang Li. Your guess should be correct.”
Time passed. It had been 125 years since Meng Chuan arrived at Holy Mountain of Painting.
Meng Chuan had been immersed in his cultivation. He comprehended the laws of spacetime at Clear Spring Island and studied the Eternal treasure’s laws in Archean Eon Realm. Meng Chuan verified his insights against each other, allowing him to comprehend the Chaos Hole Art from all angles.
He painted the emotions obtained from every angle.
Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s environment made his Essence Soul ethereal. Meng Chuan had ten-fold more time to study.
Meng Chuan enjoyed painting all the paintings.
From the perspective of a particle state, the world is similarly unpredictable. In Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar transformed into a bolt of lightning. It existed in a particle state, and it treated itself as a tiny particle as it observed the world. From this angle, a house became 1,000 times larger than a Supreme Yang Star. It was composed of countless particles. A speck of dust was like a star, and the latter was formed from countless particles.
Therefore, my brushstrokes should change again. In the cave abode at the foot of Holy Mountain of Painting, Meng Chuanwho was in a chamber-placed his brush down again.
Every stroke seemed like a point, but every point felt like they were swimming. They also had a tail.
A point with a tail made it appear like a tadpole.
cr
It was very similar to the countless tadpoles on Holy Mountain of Painting’s Chaos Hole Art. However, Meng Chuan’s work wasn’t as complicated as the countless tadpoles on the Chaos Hole Art. His painting had fewer variations. It was a simplified tadpole with only one point and a tail. The points varied in size, and the distance between them varied. The tails were also either thin or thick, long or short. The directions also changed.
The countless simplified tadpoles began to affect spacetime, forming a dark vortex. Meng Chuan seemed oblivious as he immersed himself in painting.
As the painting was created, the impact on spacetime became greater and greater. Countless simplified tadpoles seemed to swim as the formed black vortex began to devour the surroundings.
Bam!
The painting exploded. An ordinary canvas could no longer hold such a painting. Meng Chuan sat there in a daze, but countless tadpoles swam in his eyes.
This is... another Sixth Tribulation law? Meng Chuan’s mind rumbled as a Sixth Tribulation law formed completely.

chapters.title: Chapter 663 - Another Sixth Tribulation Law
chapters.content:
Chapter 663 Another Sixth Tribulation Law
The corners of Meng Chuan’s mouth curled into a smile. His eyes contained countless tadpoles that were swimming about. Some of the tadpoles were in groups, some were scattered, and some were colliding with each other as a game...
So I’ve already grasped it.
Meng Chuan raised his head and looked past the window. He saw a wild flower growing inside the cave abode’s walls. A light-purple petal rapidly expanded in Meng Chuan’s eyes; it expanded by billions of times. He saw a particle space, a particle core, and objects of varying sizes inside the particle core. He then continued zooming in by a billions of times.
Whoosh.
Everything became countless tiny spheres.
These sphere-like objects were extremely tiny. They were the smallest objects in the entire River of Spacetime.
When he was at the Fifth Tribulation realm, Meng Chuan could vaguely sense them. He could sense their existence even more clearly at the Sixth Tribulation realm.
It’s the smallest matter in the universe. Everything is formed by it. It’s the cornerstone of the universe’s mass-energy. Meng Chuan had long understood this point.
Be it common water, rocks, metals, flames, sunlight, rare universe treasures, Eighth Tribulation treasures...
Be it weak mortals, wild beasts, powerful Tribulation Eminences, or forbidden creatures...
A tiny grain of sand, a massive star, a mysterious Chaos Hole, the legendary Primordial Star...
All known objects, even unknown objects, were acknowledged to be made up of the smallest matter of this kind.
This extremely tiny matter would ultimately form different things through different combinations. It was the smallest and called a lepton.
The lepton law was a law that entangled leptons together. How could a group of leptons coexist? Attraction, collision, combination, repulsion... The entanglement between leptons was very complicated. It was very difficult to observe them; only a small number of Fifth Tribulation Eminences good at ‘observation’ were capable of doing so. It was even more difficult to completely comprehend the leptons’ entanglement law for countless interacting leptons.
The six lepton circulation laws I figured out have fused together and become a lepton law. Meng Chuan sighed.
A dark Chaos Hole devoured everything. All matter and energy would be reduced to tiny leptons before being devoured by the Chaos Hole.
The tadpoles that Meng Chuan painted were the leptons devoured by the Chaos Hole. Although the leptons were absolute spheres, the tails were the microscopic entanglement law that Meng Chuan had drawn. Some attracted each other, some repelled each other, and some collided...
I just wanted to paint a more realistic Chaos Hole, but I ended up completely drawing the lepton law. Meng Chuan was rather delighted. Sixth Tribulation laws also had differences in strength.
The publicly acknowledged strongest Sixth Tribulation law was the spatial law. As for the lepton law, it was also an extremely powerful Sixth Tribulation law. In terms of threat, it was above the lightning law.
In terms of an undying body... At the Sixth Tribulation realm, cultivators that had grasped the law of the past had undying bodies. Those who grasped the lepton law also had undying bodies.
The lepton law Undying Body allowed one to transform their body and Essence Soul into leptons completely. Furthermore, they could maintain absolute control over their body and mind, giving them complete lucidity.
Ordinarily, the so-called annihilation of an enemy and reducing them into nothingness is actually the ultimate form of annihilation. This is because everything is composed of leptons. Meng Chuan understood this point. No matter how powerful his attacks were, they could only reduce an enemy to leptons.
Crushing something into leptons...
His Essence Soul thought would completely shatter something into leptons. Ordinary Sixth Tribulation Eminences would also have their consciousness annihilated.
However, a lepton law controller could control countless leptons to form a lepton cluster. They could maintain consciousness in the clustered state, maintaining peak strength in the form of a lepton.
Undying and Indestructible, the lepton law.
Thousand Mountain Star. The black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan took a step forward and arrived in a vast, dark void.
Lepton law? Meng Chuan was overjoyed.
Whoosh.
His body was completely pulverized. His Essence Soul was also pulverized, disappearing into nothingness.
In a Sixth Tribulation Eminence’s eyes, Meng Chuan had been reduced to countless leptons
– to nothingness. But in reality... Whoosh! Whoosh!
Countless leptons affected each other. Although they were the smallest particles, they didn’t separate completely. Instead, they gathered together and formed a lepton cluster. They had a unified consciousness—Meng Chuan’s consciousness.
Whoosh.
Sextillions of leptons were moving as a lepton cluster, similarly reaching the speed of light. This caused the entire cluster to change.
Occasionally, they would form a stone the size of a finger.
Occasionally, it would expand to the size of a nebula.
The lepton cluster moved at high speeds, disregarding everything.
Whoosh.
The lepton cluster passed through a barren planet, completely destroying the planet and reducing it to leptons.
Whoosh.
The wantonly flying lepton cluster finally condensed again, forming a black-robed, white-haired man.
I can gather and disperse as usual. I can transform into leptons after dispersing. At the Sixth Tribulation realm, only someone who has grasped a spatial law can destroy my undying body. Meng Chuan understood this.
The lepton law Undying Body was extremely terrifying
An ordinary Sixth Tribulation Eminence was like a mortal slashing at a speck of dust in the sky when faced with a lepton law controller. The latter couldn’t be injured at all.
Previously, the law of the past Undying Body and the lepton law Undying Body represented two extremes of a Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
One was related to time, while the other was related to matter.
However, if Meng Chuan encountered spatial laws, a lepton law wouldn’t be able to withstand it.
Under the control of Absolute Space, one can control the movement of every lepton. It can cause my lepton cluster to disperse without any pattern. My consciousness will also be destroyed due to the lacking medium. Meng Chuan understood this point. He had to control the leptons in order to make himself complete and for his consciousness to exist as well. If the leptons couldn’t be controlled and spread out without any pattern, his consciousness wouldn’t exist. This avatar would naturally die.
It would take some time for a spatial law controller to kill the Undying Body of someone who had grasped the law of the past. However, killing lepton law Undying Body was easy. Meng Chuan would be completely subdued.
After all, leptons were absolutely dependent on space.
Apart from someone using Absolute Space, nobody can injure me at the Sixth Tribulation realm. Meng Chuan knew this very well. The lepton law was undoubtedly an extremely powerful law.
The lightning law and the lepton law are compatible?
Meng Chuan flicked his sleeve.
A bolt of lightning struck the void and the leptons in the void.
After comprehending the lepton law and understanding the profundities of lepton entanglement, Meng Chuan could easily destroy an enemy’s lepton cluster. His destructive power had also increased significantly.
I’m considered difficult to deal with among peak Sixth Tribulation Eminences. Meng Chuan smiled.
With his powerful offensive strength, his lepton law Undying Body, and his numerous Sixth Tribulation Essence Soul avatars, he was much harder to deal with than Shadowfiend Walker.
After comprehending the lepton law, I have a chance of comprehending two Origins lawsImmeasurable law and Matter law. Meng Chuan understood this point.
The Immeasurable law was one step further than the lepton law Undying Body. It fused with the profundities of spacetime, allowing the lepton cluster to be completely scattered across the River of Spacetime. No matter how the enemy attacked, it was difficult for them to destroy an Undying Body that was scattered across the entire universe.
At the same time, Immeasurable law controllers could condense an avatar with combat strength anywhere in the universe.
The Matter law was completely different. It studied the fusion of leptons. Different leptons could form different substances. The weaker ones were like water droplets and soil. The stronger ones were like Eighth Tribulation treasures. Legendary Eternal treasures were also deemed to be formed by leptons.
A Matter law controller used leptons as the foundation to comprehend the profundities of matter fusion. Finally, one’s body became a terrifying body that was nearly Eternal and Indestructible.
Experts who had grasped the Matter law were publicly acknowledged to have the strongest bodies among those who had grasped Origins laws.
However, the lightning law isn’t of much use to these two Origins laws. Therefore, my goal is still a Chaos Hole law.
Meng Chuan had now comprehended the lightning law and lepton law. Along with his gained insights into the spatial law, the Chaos Hole law was gradually taking form.
In a cave abode at the foot of Holy Mountain of Painting.
Meng Chuan was excited and thrilled after comprehending a powerful Sixth Tribulation law.
I’ll continue painting. Meng Chuan looked at Holy Mountain of Painting and waved his hand to take out a huge canvas. This was also a war spoil he gained when he swept through the dozens of Tribulation Eminences and hundreds of Imperial Lords from Black Fiend Hall. A precious ore worth more than 300 cubes had been sliced and flattened by Meng Chuan and used as a canvas. As the painting approached a true Chaos Hole, paper condensed by his Essence Soul World could no longer withstand the profundity.

chapters.title: Chapter 664 - The Ice River in the Nebula
chapters.content:
Chapter 664 The Ice River in the Nebula
It had been 280 years since Meng Chuan came to Holy Mountain of Painting.
Meng Chuan looked at the painting on the huge canvas and shook his head slightly. He waved his hand and wiped the painting away before sighing.
He stood up and waved his hand to put away the drawing board, brush, and other items. Meng Chuan walked out of the chamber, took a step forward, flew toward Holy Mountain of Painting, and approached the mountain wall.
As he flew, Meng Chuan looked at the huge paintings up close. I feel like I’ve accumulated enough insights, but I still can’t figure out the spatial law. Meng Chuan was rather vexed. He had long grasped the spatial law’s three tenets. He had studied the six paintings of the Chaos Hole law on Holy Mountain of Painting countless times. He had even tried painting the other paintings. He often felt that he had gained new insights, but the many insights he had gained couldn’t result in qualitative changes. He was unable to figure out a complete spatial law.
It felt very close, but also extremely distant. This feeling of being stuck at a bottleneck was very uncomfortable.
“It’s like seeing the moon’s reflection in the water. I can see it but not touch it,” muttered Meng Chuan softly. “It’s time to go to the next cultivation ground.”
Among the nine cultivation grounds in his plan, Holy Mountain of Painting was second. Perhaps a new cultivation ground could help
him.
Whoosh.
After landing, he waved his hand and put away his cave abode. Following that, Meng Chuan flew toward Evodia mystic realm’s exit. “City Lord Eastcalm, are you leaving already?” Master Poison Eye-who had refined Evodia mystic realm and was in charge of guarding it -appeared beside him.
“My cultivation has reached a bottleneck. It’s time to leave,” said Meng Chuan.
“As an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence, you have many Essence Soul avatars. It might be better to leave an Essence Soul avatar here to observe and study,” said Poison Eye with a smile.
“There’s no need.” Meng Chuan shook his head. “I’ll come again.”
He decided to stop looking at the paintings temporarily. He would study them when his insights deepened. After all, according to his plan, he had to focus on cultivation in every corner of the nine cultivation grounds.
“Senior Poison Eye, farewell.” Meng Chuan glanced at the master. Poison Eye could be considered the most ruthless person to fight Black Fiend Hall among the current Sixth Tribulation Eminences. With his peak Sixth Tribulation strength and Essence Soul avatars’ means, he made Black Fiend Hall suffer a huge loss.
Ine
Black Fiend Hall also attempted to exact revenge numerous times, causing Poison Eye to suffer many injuries that were not easily treatable. It was said that his lifespan had been greatly reduced because of this. After grasping the lepton law, Meng Chuan’s senses became a lot sharper. He vaguely felt that Poison Eye wasn’t too far from the end of his lifespan. Although Sixth Tribulation Eminences had their homeworld’s protection-making it very difficult for them to die few in the outer realm dared to oppose Black Fiend Hall. Meng Chuan was filled with admiration for Master Poison Eye’s deeds.
Poison Eye smiled and nodded as he watched Meng Chuan leave.
Holy Mountain of Painting.
Master Poison Eye turned to look at the distant mountain. Typically, one could be considered a top Sixth Tribulation Eminence if they grasped two Sixth Tribulation laws. Master Poison Eye had long grasped three Sixth Tribulation laws. I don’t have much time left. I have to grasp an Origin law and transform my Essence Soul World before I can expel the forces in me. However, grasping an Origin law is too difficult. Poison Eye sighed gently and took a step back to his tiny cave abode to continue cultivating. He had already been to the cultivation grounds he could go to. He had also tried the opportunities available to him. It was even harder for him to improve after cultivating for so long.
Ice River Nebula was third in the nine cultivation grounds that Meng Chuan had chosen. Meng Chuan crossed one river system after another, traveling faster than he usually did in the River of Spacetime. Meng Chuan appeared in a dark void and looked at the resplendent nebula in the distance.
Ice River Nebula. Meng Chuan looked over.
This was a rather vast nebula. The nebula was gorgeous and beautiful. With Meng Chuan’s means, he could vaguely see a river in the nebula’s depths, but he couldn’t see it clearly.
I heard that Ice River Nebula is where a mysterious Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s cave abode is. Meng Chuan knew that this place was very special.
Some special places in the River of Spacetime were occupied by various factions. For example, studying Holy Mountain of Painting required 10,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals as the entry fee.
However, some places weren’t occupied. For example, no one dared to monopolize Fiend Mountain. But the various factions limited the spread of information because the danger was too great. For example, no one wanted to monopolize Ice River Nebula because it was unnecessary. Ice River Nebula is very special. Once one enters the nebula, they will be lost. They won’t be able to walk out of it, nor will they be able to reach the Ice River. Only by grasping a spatial law will they be unaffected by the nebula. They can step into the Ice River, but they still won’t be able to step into the palace located in the Ice River. It’s said that one has to grasp the laws of time and space before they can step into the palace.
I’ll give it a try. With a thought, Meng Chuan immediately produced an Essence Soul avatar.
He didn’t plan on coming out alive upon entry. Hence, he naturally sent an Essence Soul avatar that didn’t carry any treasures.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan’s outer realm true body watched from afar. The black-robed, white-haired Essence Soul avatar flew into the vast nebula.
Without any obstruction, Meng Chuan easily flew into the nebula.
How beautiful. Meng Chuan flew in the nebula.
Swoosh!
Without any warning, Meng Chuan was teleported from the nebula’s periphery to the nebula’s depths.
This nebula has teleported me here? Meng Chuan was somewhat astonished as he attempted to continue flying. After flying for a while, the transformed nebula void allowed Meng Chuan to appear hundreds of billions of kilometers away.
Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish! Swish...
Meng Chuan kept flying towards the core, but he appeared in different locations at random. He couldn’t control himself at all. After flying for more than an hour, his position in the nebula was still changing constantly.
I’ll try to approach the ice river.
The closer one was to the ice river, the greater the void’s influence. Therefore, the closer one was to the ice river, the higher one’s attainments in the void would be. This was especially so for the area 5,000 kilometers around the ice river. The void’s influence was especially terrifying.
I’ll give it a try. Disperse.
Meng Chuan split into a lepton cluster.
The lepton cluster spread out. With his strength, he could easily maintain his consciousness even when the lepton cluster spread to a range of half a trillion kilometers.
But this time, a portion of the lepton cluster was teleported away the moment it spread out, causing the lepton cluster’s original structure to be destroyed.
Pfft.
The lepton cluster portion that had been teleported far away dissipated immediately due to what little they had.
The lepton cluster that remained immediately fused together and condensed into the black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan.
A small piece of my Essence Soul avatar was sliced off? Meng Chuan blinked. With his Essence Soul’s recovery speed, he naturally recovered instantly. The lepton law is useless here. I still have to rely on the spatial law to gain insights. Meng Chuan released his Essence Soul World and spread it out to envelop his surroundings. He could clearly sense the changes in the void. Meng Chuan had long grasped the three tenets of the spatial law. After painting for so many years, he had a clearer understanding of the spatial law, so Meng Chuan vaguely discovered some patterns from the nebula void’s changes.
Whoosh.
With a single step, Meng Chuan advanced greatly. Another step...
Although there were occasional mistakes, Meng Chuan arrived within 1,500 kilometers from the ice river in ten minutes.
Being able to come within 1,500 kilometers means that my insights into the spatial law isn’t bad. Meng Chuan smiled and carefully observed the ice river. He could clearly see the ice river from 1,500 kilometers away. This was a river that stretched for hundreds of thousands of kilometers with no end in sight.
The river water was light green.
Above the water were floating icebergs. The smaller icebergs were about dozens of kilometers tall, while the taller ones were over 500 kilometers tall. Icebergs slowly floated in the river, never stopping.
Meng Chuan could see corpses inside the thin floating icebergs.
According to Eternal Tower’s intelligence, there’s an ice river in the nebula’s depths. There are ice mountains on the ice river, and there’s a corpse in every ice mountain. Meng Chuan calmly observed and carefully stared into the distance. Legend has it that there is a palace deep in the ice river.

chapters.title: Chapter 665 - A Deal
chapters.content:
Chapter 665 A Deal
Nothing in the ice river could be destroyed.
Even Seventh Tribulation Eminences couldn’t chip off a corner of the iceberg even when using all their strength. They couldn’t scoop away any of its water either.
One can’t obtain any treasures here, nor are there any cultivation opportunities. One can’t leave once they enter. Therefore, no factions occupy this place. Meng Chuan smiled. Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences could casually send an Essence Soul avatar to probe this place, but Physical Body Tribulation Eminences couldn’t do so.
I’ve broadened my horizons. Time to focus on cultivation.
Meng Chuan focused on walking through the nebula and carefully sensed the changes in the nebula’s void. His Essence Soul World spread out, and he used the spatial law’s profundities to resist the influence of the nebula’s void. He tried his best to walk toward the ice river.
1,500 kilometers, 1,400 kilometers, 1,350 kilometers...
He was getting closer and closer. Occasionally, he would fail and be teleported hundreds of billions of kilometers away, but Meng Chuan persisted.
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. This place suits me quite well.
The Ice River Nebula didn’t have a spatial law guiding it. It was just an array formation set up by a mysterious Eighth Tribulation Eminence to prevent outsiders from approaching. The array formation’s might was stronger in the vicinity of the ice river’s palace.
However, Meng Chuan had already accumulated a lot of insights. To him, he didn’t need guidance. He had enough guidance from the Void Catalog. Instead, he needed to crack the Nebula Array Formation so that he could familiarize himself with the use of the spatial law’s profundities. Meng Chuan’s understanding of the spatial law became
Meng Chuan focused on his cultivation. Meanwhile, on a Supreme Yin Star in the distant Square Razor-Clam River Zone.
There was a somewhat hidden cave abode here. The cave abode spanned half a million kilometers, and it was also protected by large array formations. Even a Fifth Tribulation Eminence would die if they entered by mistake.
In a corner of the cave abode was a large cluster of circular buildings. Each circular building spanned over 100 feet. These circular buildings were where the Imperial Lords lived.
An Imperial Lord lived in every building.
These Imperial Lords had different appearances. They came from different worlds and were of different species, but they now had a common identity-servants of Black Fiend Hall.
“There’s still 188 years left.” In one of the circular buildings, a red-robed cultivator with a large head and a small body sat cross-legged. On his huge head, three eyes narrowed slightly. “I’ll be able to regain my freedom after serving Black Fiend Hall for 1,000 years. I only have 188 years left before I regain my freedom.”
“Black Fiend Hall sure is greedy. I’m required to pay 200 Outer Realm Essence Crystals and still have to serve them for 1,000 years without any compensation. They won’t give us any benefits during these 1,000 years. However, they keep their promises. As long as we serve them loyally, they won’t take away my remaining treasures.”
The red-robed cultivator was rather glad.
Black Fiend Hall was willing to give the Imperial Lords a way out during the massacres because they needed some minions to carry out their large-scale operations. Otherwise, many cultivators would flee from the bustling trading planets. Without enough subordinates, it would be difficult for them to set up enough array formations. Most cultivators would be able to escape.
By not taking away the Imperial Lord’s remaining treasures, this would give them hope. All of Black Fiend Hall’s members had to stick to this rule. Otherwise, the captured Imperial Lords wouldn’t be loyal to them. They would rather self-destruct and destroy their outer realm true bodies.
Some of Black Fiend Hall members also broke the rules and plundered all the treasures that the Imperial Lords had after they served for 1,000 years. It was fine if such matters could be kept completely confidential, but Black Fiend Hall would severely punish them once it was exposed. It would be difficult for them to do anything in the River of Spacetime. Therefore, Black Fiend Hall members would not break the rules without sufficient temptation and special reasons.
If it weren’t for the sake of protecting this treasure, why would I be willing to be a servant for 1,000 years? The red-robed cultivator sensed the treasure in his storage space.
It was a picture. It was also the greatest opportunity he received while roaming the outer realm. After obtaining the map, his strength improved greatly. He planned on returning to his homeworld with the map and placing the treasure there. However, he was too slow. With his strength, it would take him more than 300 years to cross several river systems and return to his homeworld. Halfway through his journey, he encountered Black Fiend Hall’s array formation. Black Fiend Hall had set up an inescapable net in the outer realm in the corresponding area in the River of Spacetime. He happened to barge in and became a captive.
All these years, I’ve never dared to use this treasure. Bear with it a little longer. The red-robed cultivator’s three eyes were extremely cold.
In the past, he had killed and plundered as he pleased. In his homeworld, he was the only Imperial Lord. Who knew that he would become a captive? He had had enough of these stifling days.
These Imperial Lord servants were putting up with it because Black Fiend Hall had given them hope.
Three figures sat in the garden in the middle of the cave abode.
“The owner of Changpo Planet traded with us and is willing to offer Changpo Planet.”
“I never expected this old fellow to sell out the tens of thousands of cultivators on Changpo Planet when he’s nearing the end of his lifespan. I think he’s more suitable to join our Black Fiend Hall.”
“He has zero worries when nearing the end of his lifespan. It’s normal for him to take the opportunity to earn a big sum of money. However, the tens of thousands of cultivators he’s selling out come from an Eternal Tower branch.
“However, the Eternal Tower branch can contact its headquarters. Once we attack or the old fellow on Changpo Planet hands things over, Eternal Tower’s headquarters will immediately receive news. We have to be certain that no Sixth Tribulation Eminence will rush over to stop us.” “The owner of Changpo Planet offered it to us with both hands. Who’s going to be a busybody?” “Slaughtering tens of thousands of cultivators. This matter has to be reported. Only if the higher-ups agree can we do it.”
“Black Fiend Hall has too many rules.”
“Fool, the rules protect your life.”
After a brief discussion, they quickly reported the matter.
Almost all Sixth and Seventh Tribulation Eminences were members of Nebula Palace. Be it good or evil, Nebula Palace didn’t reject anyone.
Black Fiend Hall members also occupied an area in Nebula Palace.
In one of the halls.
“There’s news from Square Razor-Clam River Zone. Cave Lord Changpo wants to sell the entire Changpo Planet to us, including the tens of thousands of cultivators on it. Check if it’s possible.”
“There are eight Sixth Tribulation Eminences in the area around Square Razor-Clam River Zone. According to Eternal Tower’s standard operating procedures, they will inform these eight... The other seven are nothing. They are all Sixth Tribulation Eminences that have cultivated for many years. There’s no reason for them to not take action easily.
“We should be worried about a newly-advanced Sixth Tribulation Eminence, City Lord Eastcalm, instead. He has an Essence Soul avatar in Taidong River Zone. Taidong River Zone is close to Square Razor-Clam River Zone. Eternal Tower will likely issue him the mission. Not long ago, he attacked and killed one of our Black Fiend Hall teams.”
“How many times has he stopped our Black Fiend Hall?”
“Just once.”
The five Sixth Tribulation Eminences guarding the hall flipped through the intelligence. The purple-robed man found the relevant piece of intelligence and nodded. “Pass down the orders. We can accept this transaction.”
“What if City Lord Eastcalm attacks again?” A gray-robed woman frowned.
“He has nothing to do with Ingenious Dharma Planet and Changpo Planet. For him to stop us twice in such a short period of time means that he has deep enmity towards our Black Fiend Hall. Furthermore, it would mean extreme boldness,” said the purple-robed man indifferently. “We should take action and teach this City Lord Eastcalm the rules.”
The other members nodded.
Although Black Fiend Hall was infamous, they followed the rules. They typically wouldn’t attack a Sixth Tribulation Eminence’s faction directly.
Black Fiend Hall could tolerate Sixth Tribulation Eminences occasionally attacking to save a friendly faction. After all, they didn’t care if a few Fifth Tribulation Eminences died. However, if they had nothing to do with each other, Black Fiend Hall would bare its fangs when a Sixth Tribulation Eminence took the initiative to accept missions and repeatedly wrecked their plans.
“In my opinion, City Lord Eastcalm is very low-key in his intelligence records. He doesn’t
Eternal Tower’s and White Avian Hall’s missions. He probably won’t clash with our Black Fiend Hall twice in a short period of time,” said a withered grass lifeform with a smile. “Of course, it will be even more interesting if he takes action.”

chapters.title: Chapter 666 - Rejection and Acceptance
chapters.content:
Chapter 666 Rejection and Acceptance
A large black ship silently floated in the dark void outside Changpo Planet. Three leaders were standing in a hall on the ship, staring at the tiny Changpo Planet in the distance.
“Every Eternal Tower branch has connections with the headquarters in the River of Spacetime. They also have the Eye of Supervision to monitor the surroundings,” said a gray-robed leader. “Once we approach Eternal Tower, we will be discovered by the Eternal Tower branch. Although it’s unlikely for a meddlesome Sixth Tribulation Eminence to appear, an accident might happen if we are slow. We have to be fast. The faster we wipe out Changpo Planet, the better.”
“The owner of Changpo Planet has taken the initiative to deactivate the array formation and let us in. Our operation will be very easy,” said the black stone giant in a low voice.
“We are going to slaughter tens of thousands of cultivators. Many of them are Imperial Lords, and some also have some life-preservation items. They will definitely struggle and resist. If we aren’t prepared, accidents will happen,” instructed the gray-robed leader indifferently. “Before we take action, do one last round of checks to see if we are ready.”
The two companions nodded slightly. This was the last preparation before the attack. The order was immediately given.
Teams were residing in the black ship. Each team had at least one Tribulation Eminence.
We’re going to plunder and slaughter? I wonder where it is this time. In one of the teams, a red-robed, three-eyed cultivator listened to the leader’s orders and muttered silently to himself, I hope I don’t encounter any meddlesome Eminences. As long as I survive my days of slavery, I can bring the treasure map back.
Imperial Lords needed to offer their service for 1,000 years, but they rarely encountered such large-scale operations in 1,000 years.
“Once we exit the warship, immediately form the formation with me as the leader. Listen to my orders.” A snake-scaled elder scanned the Imperial Lords.
“Yes.” The Imperial Lords and servants were all very respectful. The red-robed, three-eyed cultivator was extremely respectful as well.
An hour later.
The black ship silently arrived half a billion kilometers away from Changpo Planet. This place was outside the Eternal Tower branch’s monitoring range. Following that, the ship suddenly traversed half a billion kilometers and teleported to the sky above Eternal Tower.
“What is that?”
“This ship!”
As a bustling trading ground, there were many cultivators on the streets and in the numerous shops. There were even some Tribulation Eminences and Imperial Lords inside. Now, all of them looked up at the black ship in shock.
“There’s a defensive array formation on Changpo Planet that isolates the void. It’s impossible to teleport in.”
“Unless Cave Lord Changpo deliberately permitted them.”
Not good.
Some knowledgeable cultivators immediately realized that something was amiss.
At the same moment the black ship appeared in the sky above Changpo Planet, an illusory, huge eye condensed above Eternal Tower’s tallest building. This was the Eye of Supervision. It could appraise everything, and it could also ensure that the person in charge of Eternal Tower was unable to carry out corrupt practices and damage Eternal Tower’s interests.
For example, the construction of a river zone headquarters was very special. The Eye of Eternal could descend a portion of its power. Therefore, anyone below the Seventh Tribulation realm would be courting death if they attacked a river zone headquarters.
However, an Eternal Tower branch was too weak. The Eye of Supervision was good at appraisal, but its strength was inferior to a Fifth Tribulation Eminence.
“Members of Black Fiend Hall.” The giant illusory eye stared at the ship. At such a close distance, it instantly locked onto life auras and confirmed the identities of the Fifth Tribulation Eminences, Fourth Tribulation Eminences, and the other Black Fiend Hall members. “Cave Lord Changpo has already betrayed Eternal Tower by allowing so many members of Black Fiend Hall to enter.”
A piece of news immediately reached Eternal Tower’s River of Spacetime headquarters. Following that, Eternal Tower immediately issued a mission to the Sixth Tribulation Eminences in the surrounding river zones. Although it took some time to describe, Eternal Tower’s reaction happened in an instant.
After the headquarters issued the order, a group of Tribulation Eminences and Imperial Lords charged out from the black ship.
“It’s beginning.” The wrinkled-faced Cave Lord Changpo stood on a distant mountain peak and watched everything coldly. He controlled the array formations on Changpo Planet. These array formations were meant to protect the cultivators on Changpo Planet, but they were now used to work in concert with Black Fiend Hall to slaughter cultivators.
A white-browed elder sat in front of a cauldron. The flames in the cauldron reflected on his face.
Boom!
The interior of the cauldron changed. The cauldron’s walls increased from nine holes to ten holes. There was also a dark-red star in the new hole, where black flames rose from it. These dark-red stars were refined from Darkstars. With an additional hole, the cauldron’s flames were stronger.
Huh? The white-browed elder sensed something
“Cave Lord Changpo committed betrayal. Black Fiend Hall forces appeared on Changpo Planet. Tens of thousands of cultivators are in danger?” The white-browed elder shook his head slightly. “A world rises and falls. A planet like Changpo Planet has also ushered in a calamity.”
He had seen too much in his long lifespan.
His homeworld gradually gave birth to civilization from a barbaric era. From the tribal era to the dynasty era, he had personally experienced it all. Tribes had once been destroyed, and he led his tribe to prominence and established a dynasty... He was close to the end of his lifespan.
In order to cultivate in seclusion, he successfully created the Imperial Lord path in his homeworld. He was the first Imperial Lord in the history of his homeworld. However, when he came out of seclusion, his dynasty was destroyed after more than 100 years. He found his remaining bloodline descendants and completely unified the world, establishing a true empire.
He was the first Imperial Lord and first Tribulation Eminence in his homeworld’s cultivation system.
In the outer realm, he was very ordinary. This was because he had cultivated for 1,800 years before becoming an Imperial Lord. He only reached the Tribulation realm after cultivating for 8,000 years. He only reached the Sixth Tribulation realm after cultivating for more than 50,000 years.
However, he allowed his homeworld to become a middle-level world.
He was an existence that countless juniors in his homeworld idolized.
The white-browed elder sighed at the impending deaths of tens of thousands of cultivators, but he only felt pity for them. He had never thought of saving them. Countless lives have their own destinies. I’m only a fish in the River of Destiny. I should follow its rules if I want to live in this river.
...
Many Sixth Tribulation Eminences refused to help. The owner of Changpo Planet had taken the initiative to betray Eternal Tower, and the tens of thousands of cultivators on Changpo Planet couldn’t find a Sixth Tribulation Eminence to back them up.
But in Archean Eon Realm.
The sun was shining brightly. Meng Chuan and his wife, Liu Qiyue, were walking through the greenery. In the distance, a white rabbit was sniffing the grass. The couple smiled at the little rabbit.
“An’er’s cultivation has been stuck at the Third Tribulation realm all this while. He plans on challenging himself in the outer realm, but you objected to it?” questioned Liu Qiyue.
“Earth Cloud Mystic Realm is large enough and has a good environment. It’s enough for one to reach the Fifth Tribulation realm,” said Meng Chuan. “What can a Third Tribulation Eminence do even if he goes to the outer realm? If he can’t reach the Fourth Tribulation realm in Archean Eon Realm and Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s environment, I think he shouldn’t go out and bring trouble to himself.”
Liu Qiyue looked at Meng Chuan. “You mean to let him out after he reaches the Fourth Tribulation realm?”
Meng Chuan wanted to say something in detail, but his expression suddenly changed slightly. He had obtained an Eternal Tower mission.
Changpo Planet? With a thought, Meng Chuan gained knowledge about the entire mission’s intricacies. The bounty for this mission was much higher than the one offered for Ingenious Dharma Planet. This was because the nature of Cave Lord Changpo’s betrayal made things even worse. Hence, the mission bounty had also increased.
100,000 contribution points? Two Spacetime Teleportation Talismans for the return trip are thrown in as well? Meng Chuan understood the urgency of the situation.
For example, if Palace Lady Ingenious Dharma took the initiative to resist on Ingenious Dharma Planet, she could stall for time. However, countless cultivators would be massacred due to the betrayal of Changpo Planet’s owner.
I’ll take it.
Meng Chuan was at the cusp of grasping a spatial law. Thus, he hoped that the pressure from the outside world would be greater. He wasn’t afraid of threats. Furthermore, it was almost his turn to obtain the Void Trileaf Flower in the Valley of Spacetime.
What powerful karma.
The moment he accepted the mission, karma formed.
Meng Chuan could also sense the distant location of Changpo Planet. The tens of thousands of cultivators were connected to Meng Chuan by karma. This was because the lives of tens of thousands of Supremacies depended on Meng Chuan’s will. The karmic connection shocked Meng Chuan. He could clearly lock onto Changpo Planet’s location.
Time to go!
An Essence Soul avatar instantly left Archean Eon Realm. Following that, he used a Spacetime Teleportation Talisman and headed straight for Changpo Planet.

chapters.title: Chapter 667 - Cave Lord Changpo
chapters.content:
Chapter 667 Cave Lord Changpo
The originally flourishing planet had now fallen into darkness and despair. The tens of thousands of cultivators gathered on the planet were mostly the strongest experts in their respective worlds. They had an acute sense for danger. From the appearance of Black Fiend Hall’s massive ship, Black Fiend Hall’s large number of Tribulation Eminences and Imperial Lords, they realized that a huge crisis had descended.
“Not good.”
“Time to go!”
“Cave Lord Changpo betrayed us.”
“Run!”
The entire planet was in chaos. Tens of thousands of cultivators used various means. Some wanted to escape from the planet, while others fled to the Eternal Tower branch.
However, Cave Lord Changpo controlled the entire planet’s array formation, preventing the cultivators from escaping.
“Form the array.” On Black Fiend Hall’s side, small teams led by Tribulation Eminences quickly formed the array formation. They wanted to carry out a large-scale massacre with the array formation. Three of the strongest Fifth Tribulation Eminences took the initiative to pursue the Tribulation Eminences and Imperial Lords on Changpo Planet.
Whoosh
Black Fiend Hall’s gray-robed leader instantly trapped a Third Tribulation Eminence, sealed him alive, and restrained him in a grotto-heaven. The poisonous gas that spread out from his attacks naturally affected a large area. Although cultivators fled very quickly, hundreds of cultivators were still affected by the poisonous gas and were instantly reduced to nothing but toxic waste. However, some cultivators’ bodies glowed as they blocked the poisonous gas. Some cultivators were revived after turning into poisonous water... But less than 10% of the hundreds of cultivators survived the poisonous gas. Those who survived fled immediately and frantically.
“Can you escape?” A towering, black stone giant in the distance slapped at a Fourth Tribulation Eminence, who was trying his best to escape. Before grabbing him, the Fourth Tribulation Eminence self-destructed his outer realm true body. He let out an extremely furious roar. “Cave Lord Changpo!” The black stone giant couldn’t help but be somewhat furious when its strike missed.
“Cave Lord Changpo.”
“You betrayed us.” “Despicable.”
“Traitor.”
ars
SO
Angry roars sounded from many places in the city. At that moment, on a mountain peak outside the city, Cave Lord Changpo listened from afar. His wrinkled face remained very calm as he said softly, “Futile struggles.”
Back then, Black Dragon Planet had been targeted by Black Fiend Hall. Although no Sixth Tribulation Eminence came to stop them, Patriarch Black Dragon was strong enough. He protected the weak with all his might and tried his best to let them escape. Back then, many cultivators had escaped with their lives. Meng Chuan was one of them.
But this time, Cave Lord Changpo and Black Fiend Hall had worked in cahoots, causing the survival probability of the tens of thousands of cultivators on Changpo Planet to be slim.
Huh? Cave Lord Changpo’s expression changed slightly. He immediately saw a black-robed, white-haired man surrounded by purple light appear not far from the ship.
At this moment, all the cultivators on Changpo Planet noticed the black-robed, white-haired man!
Meng Chuan’s aura was simply too terrifying. It was like a sun had appeared out of thin air in the middle of the night. All cultivators couldn’t help but look at Meng Chuan. They were like mortals looking at the sun-their eyes would be greatly affected. When these cultivators saw Meng Chuan, the impact of Meng Chuan’s Sixth Tribulation body was even more terrifying. Almost all cultivators’ minds went blank.
Only the Fifth Tribulation Eminences and a small number of Tribulation Eminences maintained their clarity of thought.
White Avian Hall, City Lord Eastcalm? The gray-robed leader’s heart chilled. It’s over. “A Sixth Tribulation Eminence has appeared?” The other two Fifth Tribulation Eminences felt their hearts turn cold. As members of Black Fiend Hall, they naturally knew City Lord Eastcalm. After all, City Lord Eastcalm had just killed a Black Fiend Hall branch not long ago. Now, it was their turn. Following that, their consciousness sank into darkness.
In a middle-level world.
A gray-robed leader stood on the peak of Great Snow Mountain and sensed the karmic attack.
“The losses this time are truly immense,” muttered the gray-robed leader. “An outer realm true body, special treasures, weapons, and the warship I carry... These are worth 13,000 cubes.” In order to unleash enough strength in the outside world, one naturally had to carry treasures.
Losing 13,000 cubes was nothing to a Black Fiend Hall member like him. They earned a lot from slaughtering and plundering.
“The greatest loss is the large number of Tribulation realm followers and Imperial Lord servants.” The gray-robed leader’s heart ached. “Almost all of my team has died.”
