The three leaders were naturally still alive because of their homeworld’s protection.
But other than the nine Fourth Tribulation Eminences and three Third Tribulation Eminences, the other Tribulation Eminence followers had their true bodies and avatars destroyed. They were completely dead.
As for Imperial Lords? They were Imperial Lord servants that had been captured. All of them had their outer realm true bodies destroyed, so they naturally wouldn’t work for Black Fiend Hall any longer. The gray-robed leader’s team had lost his middle and low-level members.
For a long time to come, the threat his team posed to others would be greatly reduced.
The Black Fiend Hall members were powerless in front of Meng Chuan.
They formed teams that could be recognized at a glance. Furthermore, Meng Chuan could easily distinguish Black Fiend Hall members through their karma.
Having had experience, Meng Chuan showed no mercy to Tribulation Eminences, just like on Ingenious Dharma Planet. He only wiped out the outer realm true bodies of Black Fiend Hall’s Imperial Lord servants. It was considered as leaving them some leeway. Although these Imperial Lord servants were forced, they could’ve chosen to destroy their outer realm true bodies and not be Black Fiend Hall’s lackeys. Since they couldn’t bear to part with the treasures and chose to be their lackeys, they had to pay the price.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan waved his hand and stored away all the treasures left behind by Black Fiend Hall members, including the Tribulation Eminence’s bodies. He wanted to accumulate more for his homeworld.
Boom!
Meng Chuan casually grabbed at the air, and a wrinkled elder was pulled in front of him.
The elder looked up at Meng Chuan and bowed slightly. “City Lord Eastcalm, you are concerned about the weak and are willing to offend Black Fiend Hall for them. I’m impressed.”
Meng Chuan looked at the elder in front of him.
This elder was Cave Lord Changpo. He was the owner of Changpo Planet. He had guarded this place for tens of thousands of years. He had also brought blessings to the river system for tens of thousands of years, allowing generations of cultivators to have a safe trading ground for tens of thousands of years. However, it was also him who betrayed all the cultivators on Changpo Planet.
Although Meng Chuan had rushed over as quickly as possible, thousands of cultivators had died.
“After guarding this place for tens of thousands of years, you betrayed this place?” Meng Chuan looked at him.
“Supremacies only have 2,000-year lifespans, while Imperial Lords only have 10,000-year lifespans,” said Cave Lord Changpo. “I established Changpo Planet, and it benefited many generations of cultivators. Now that I’m old, it’s not too much to take back some treasures, right?”
“You aren’t asking for treasures; you want to take away their lives. If you had massacred them... Eternal Tower’s Sixth Tribulation Eminences would have long taken action. Therefore, you got Black Fiend Hall to step in,” said Meng Chuan. “You clearly don’t want any accidents to happen.”
“However, accidents still happen. Things often develop unexpectedly,” said Cave Lord Changpo. “Thankfully, I was prepared. The treasures I obtained through normal means have long been sent back to my homeworld.”
Cave Lord Changpo looked down. “But the true wealth of Changpo Planet lies in the tens of thousands of cultivators. One has to kill them to plunder it all. I did it when I was weak, but I haven’t done it since I became a Supremacy. However, my homeworld will decline after my death. I also need enough treasures to build a foundation. For the sake of my homeworld’s survival, I can only be ruthless.”
Cave Lord Changpo looked at Meng Chuan. “The reason why I stayed behind to meet you is that I admire you, City Lord Eastcalm. In the entire River of Spacetime, there are very few Eminences like you.”
As he spoke, his skin began to turn black. “I’m despicable. I was afraid that you would capture me alive and make me suffer. Therefore, I took poison the moment you descended,” said Cave Lord Changpo with a smile.
Meng Chuan had long seen through it. From the lepton level, he realized that the other party had been deeply poisoned. Furthermore, the other party’s body was beginning to disintegrate. It was difficult for Meng Chuan to reverse the situation.
“Before this operation, all my treasures were sent back to my homeworld.” Cave Lord Changpo stared at Meng Chuan as his body disintegrated. “I still have 300 years left to live. I won’t take another step out of my homeworld. It’s my honor to see City Lord Eastcalm on my final day in the outer realm.”
With that said, Cave Lord Changpo’s body was annihilated into nothingness.

chapters.title: Chapter 668 - Lord of Scarlet
chapters.content:
Chapter 668 Lord of Scarlet
The strong prey on the weak. They plunder other cultivators to benefit themselves. Meng Chuan watched this scene. Why do they keep thinking of slaughtering and plundering? There are clearly other good paths to take.
Becoming stronger through cultivation was the most orthodox path.
If one focuses all their thoughts of slaughtering and plundering on cultivation, they will definitely become stronger. An ordinary Fifth Tribulation Eminence has a chance of becoming a top Fifth Tribulation Eminence or even a peak Fifth Tribulation Eminence. If they are strong, the number of treasures they obtain will naturally increase greatly. In Meng Chuan’s eyes, those who slaughtered and plundered were the River of Spacetime’s parasites. Meng Chuan understood Cave Lord Changpo’s final choice, but he looked down on him. If one’s mind wasn’t strong, they could only unleash 50% of their full potential.
With a powerful mind, one could even produce miracles, exceeding even their full potential.
When one became stronger, they naturally would gain more treasures.
Relying on plundering? Those were acts of parasites!
Meng Chuan looked down. Although he had tried his best to rush over, thousands of cultivators had still died. He sighed softly and took a step forward and appeared outside of the city. He silently waited for the Eternal Tower members to arrive and clean up the mess.
Meng Chuan didn’t notice that one of the hundreds of Black Fiend Hall Imperial Lord servants he had casually killed was a red-robed cultivator.
In a distant world of life, deep in a mountain range.
An angry roar sounded from a dark-red cave abode.
“Ahhh! Damn it!” A terrifying might erupted from the depths of the cave abode. It spread in all directions, causing the surrounding mountains to melt instantly, turning into magma. The surrounding 400 kilometers were completely destroyed.
His cave abode, his disciples, servants, and even some mortals in the surrounding villages had all transformed into surging magma. Magma surged for 400 kilometers. The red-robed cultivator stood in midair, unable to vent his anger.
“My treasure map. My treasure map. It’s mine.” The red-robed cultivator was extremely furious. Although he had yet to figure out the treasure map’s origins, the effects he had discovered were already unimaginable. It exceeded all the treasures he had seen in the outer realm, including all the ones in the Eternal Tower branch. For this treasure, he was willing to be a servant.
asu
Just as his 1,000 years of servitude was nearly up, an accident happened while slaughtering Changpo Planet.
“That black-robed, white-haired Eminence...” The red-robed cultivator knew that he had died at the other party’s hands, but he only felt pain. He didn’t dare feel any resentment. He knew very well that even the massive team from Black Fiend Hall had been easily slaughtered. He was definitely one of the peak Eminences in the outer realm. That white-haired man was a terrifying existence that he couldn’t offend. The treasure has fallen into his hands. I’ll never be able to retrieve it. The red-robed cultivator stood there in a daze.
Some of the other cultivators in this inhabited world could see what was happening here, but nobody dared to come over. After all, this invincible Fiend Lord had the terrifying strength to destroy worlds. All cultivators submitted to his demonic might.
Nebula Palace, in Black Fiend Hall’s territory.
In one of the halls.
“I never expected that City Lord Eastcalm would really take on the Eternal Tower mission and save the tens of thousands of cultivators on Changpo Planet.” The withered grass lifeform grinned. “This is going to be interesting.”
Although a branch under them had suffered heavy losses, they didn’t care about it as Black Fiend Hall’s core members.
This was because the three Fifth Tribulation Eminences in that team were still alive. That team’s core members were still alive. As for the losses at the bottom? How could the core members who could come to Nebula Palace care about that? They were more concerned about a Sixth Tribulation Eminence daring to oppose Black Fiend Hall.
“City Lord Eastcalm doesn’t have any connection with Changpo Planet and Ingenious Dharma Planet. He hasn’t been to either of those worlds in the past,” said the gray-robed woman. “Who gave him-a newly advanced Sixth Tribulation Eminence—the confidence to dare oppose us twice in a row?”
“Perhaps he thinks that he has many avatars at the Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation realm and isn’t afraid of us pursuing him.”
“With the protection of their homeworld, some Sixth Tribulation Eminences occasionally think that they can provoke our Black Fiend Hall.”
The core members scoffed.
Since Black Fiend Hall could do as they pleased in the River of Spacetime, they had rules that prevented them from actively offending a Sixth Tribulation Eminence. However, they also had ruthless means to deal with a Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
“City Lord Eastcalm attacked twice in a short period of time,” said the purple-robed man. “It’s time for us to teach him the rules. Let him pay the price and know the outcome of antagonizing us.”
Black Fiend Hall had different levels of retaliation when dealing with Sixth Tribulation Eminences.
This was because Sixth Tribulation Eminences with true bodies in their homeworld couldn’t die. Therefore, the most ruthless punishment was a kill order. It prevented Sixth Tribulation Eminences from leaving their homeworld. If they left, they would die.
However, only Seventh Tribulation Eminences and half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences had a chance of carrying out the kill order. There were only a few such existences in Black Fiend Hall.
Therefore, unless the person in question was too crazy and caused Black Fiend Hall to suffer huge losses, they wouldn’t deploy a Seventh Tribulation Eminence or a half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
After all, Meng Chuan hadn’t even killed a Sixth Tribulation Eminence’s avatar. There were virtually zero losses for Black Fiend Hall.
“Teach him a lesson? Who will do it?”
“We ordinary Sixth Tribulation Eminences really don’t have the confidence to deal with City Lord Eastcalm.”
The members in the hall discussed who they would send. Most of the core members in the hall were at the Sixth Tribulation realm; only three had reached the peak Sixth Tribulation realm.
“Leave it to me,” said a stocky man in scarlet armor. He had blood-red eyes and a terrifying baneful aura.
“I’m at ease now that Lord of Scarlet has taken action.” The purple-robed man smiled. “How do you plan on dealing with him?”
“He has many Essence Soul avatars. He won’t care even if I destroy his Essence Soul avatar,” said Lord of Scarlet indifferently. “I can’t find a way to enter Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. The only thing that can make him feel the pinch is Thousand Mountain Star. I’ll naturally make him pay the price by making a trip to Thousand Mountain Star.”
Thousand Mountain Star.
Meng Chuan was cultivating in a chamber with his eyes closed when he suddenly sensed something
I sense a bloody, evil Sixth Tribulation Eminence appearing. I’ve never seen him before. Meng Chuan frowned slightly.
Whoosh.
He immediately split out an Essence Soul avatar.
The black-robed, white-haired Essence Soul avatar didn’t carry any treasures. With a single step, he traversed the void and arrived more than half a billion kilometers away.
The void—more than half a billion kilometers away-was originally pitch-black.
It had now become a sea of blood.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
In the sea of blood, a man in scarlet armor stood there. His blood-colored eyes calmly looked at Meng Chuan. His skin was covered in layers of green scales, and there was a dark-red color beneath the scales.
Lord of Scarlet. Meng Chuan immediately recognized him.
Lord of Scarlet was a top Sixth Tribulation Eminence in Black Fiend Hall.
Lord of Scarlet stood in the blood-colored sea and calmly looked at Meng Chuan. Just his gaze caused an invisible wail to echo in Meng Chuan’s mind. Of course, with Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul and willpower, it didn’t affect him significantly.
Lord of Scarlet had a saber by his waist. He stared at Meng Chuan and said, “City Lord Eastcalm, this is the first time we’ve met.” “It’s indeed the first time.” Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
Lord of Scarlet indifferently stated, “You should know why I’m here.”
“Just because of that trivial matter?” Meng Chuan smiled indifferently. “In the eyes of Black Fiend Hall, weak Tribulation Eminences and Imperial Lord servants shouldn’t be worth mentioning, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 669 - Lord of Scarlet and Meng Chuan
chapters.content:
Chapter 669 Lord of Scarlet and Meng Chuan
Lord of Scarlet stared at City Lord Eastcalm in surprise. He originally believed that City Lord Eastcalm would be nervous, afraid, and wary when he came knocking on his door! However, City Lord Eastcalm was very casual and thought nothing of it.
“Our Black Fiend Hall still takes Sixth Tribulation Eminences’ reputations into account.” Lord of Scarlet’s voice echoed everywhere. “If it’s to help good friends and clansmen, we wouldn’t mind if you wiped out a few Black Fiend Hall branches. If it’s to occasionally complete Eternal Tower’s mission and stop Black Fiend Hall’s operations, we can tolerate it as long as you don’t kill the members of Black Fiend Hall.
“We have enough tolerance for Sixth Tribulation Eminences. “As for you? You took action twice in a row for people who aren’t related to you. You even killed all the Tribulation Eminences’ true bodies and avatars across space.” Lord of Scarlet’s baneful aura became denser. “We’d taken your reputation into account, but you haven’t done so for Black Fiend Hall in any
way.”
Meng Chuan looked at Lord of Scarlet and smiled. “Reputation? So in Lord of Scarlet’s eyes, killing cultivators isn’t worth mentioning. Instead, reputation is more important?”
Lord of Scarlet narrowed his eyes at Meng Chuan, his eyes turning colder. “You seem to be very unhappy with Black Fiend Hall?”
“Since you’ve become a fiend, don’t expect me to take your reputation into consideration, or what’s left of it.” Meng Chuan looked at him. “In the entire River of Spacetime, Black Fiend Hall’s reputation is already notorious. Although very few people dare to attack you, there are still many Eminences who have dealt with you. Even Seventh Tribulation Eminences have targeted Black Fiend Hall. Isn’t it because many Eminences are targeting you and are hostile to you that you have these so-called ‘rules?’ You are simply trying your best to make fewer enemies.”
Lord of Scarlet’s expression darkened.
Black Fiend Hall’s methods were too ruthless, so it naturally attracted the hostility of some Eminences. Therefore, they had to follow the rules and reduce any possible hostility.
“Fiends? You’re right. We are fiends.” Lord of Scarlet stared at Meng Chuan. “As a fiend, I want to see how capable you are.”
As soon as he finished speaking
Lord of Scarlet’s location became a core of the surrounding spacetime. It caused the spacetime within half a billion kilometers to distort, affecting Thousand Mountain Star as well.
The distant Thousand Mountain Star array formation isolated all external forces. With a thought, Meng Chuan sent two Supremacieswho happened to be passing by-into Thousand Mountain Star.
What a powerful domain. Meng Chuan sighed in amazement as he looked around. He saw Lord of Scarlet standing in the middle of the spatial vortex. “Lord of Scarlet, draw your saber.”
“You aren’t worthy of me drawing my saber.” As Lord of Scarlet spoke, a blood wave flew out from beneath his feet. It instantly passed through the void and arrived in front of Meng Chuan, sweeping across him.
Every drop of blood in the blood wave was as heavy as a star. When countless drops of blood gathered together, a qualitative change occurred. This blood wave would turn an ordinary Physical Body Sixth Tribulation Eminence into a sieve if swept up by the blood wave. They would probably be corroded and annihilated in a few seconds. Furthermore, this blood wave had some of a Dark Chaos Hole’s might. It could devour everything and distort spacetime. It was difficult to escape.
Impressive. Meng Chuan sighed softly when he sensed this move. At the same time, he had already phased away and vanished. Meng Chuan clearly had much deeper insights into the Chaos Hole laws.
He clearly dissected the distortion in spacetime. With a single step, he traversed 50 million kilometers and easily avoided the blood wave. After all, the Meng Chuan here was an Essence Soul avatar. He didn’t want to be tainted by the blood wave.
“Can you hide?” Lord of Scarlet—who was standing in the middle of the spacetime vortex
-sent out all the waves of blood beneath his feet with a thought. Eight waves formed, and together with the previous wave, nine blood waves attacked Meng Chuan from all directions.
Faced with the blood wave attack, Meng Chuan stared at Lord of Scarlet instead.
Oh? Lord of Scarlet felt that the black-robed, white-haired City Lord Eastcalm’s eyes were as dark as the abyss. He couldn’t help but be drawn in.
Not good. Lord of Scarlet realized that something was amiss, but he couldn’t escape. His mind and consciousness were completely attracted as he constantly fell toward the bottomless abyss...
Eighth Tribulation mystic technique-Pupil of Darkness!
As Meng Chuan’s cultivation improved, the Pupil of Darkness mystic technique had already reached the 65th level. The most important aspect of this mystic technique was Meng Chuan’s willpower.
Lord of Scarlet’s willpower wasn’t as powerful as his combat strength. He was considered a normal Physical Body Sixth Tribulation Eminence. With his powerful body, most Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminences’ Essence Soul mystic techniques couldn’t threaten him. However, Meng Chuan had used an Eighth Tribulation mystic technique. Furthermore, Meng Chuan’s willpower was terrifying The moment Lord of Scarlet’s consciousness sank, the nine blood waves—which were attacking Meng Chuan-completely dissipated.
Go. Meng Chuan waved his hand again.
Large amounts of lightning gathered in the surrounding area, instantly condensing into a lightning spear. Under the condensation of countless lightning bolts, the spear itself was dark-black. Arcs of lightning snaked across the surface of the spear.
Mystic technique-Chaos Hole Lightning Spear!
After grasping a lepton law, it was obvious that this mystic technique—which used the Chaos Hole law as its core—had become even more powerful. The lightning gathered at the lepton level was even more exquisite. Its density was much higher, making it even darker and heavier.
Boom!
The moment the Chaos Hole Lightning Spear condensed, it struck Lord of Scarlet, whose consciousness had sunk into oblivion.
Go, go, go. Meng Chuan used the Power of Essence Soul to stir the lightning around him and condensed several Chaos Hole Lightning Spears as quickly as possible.
In nearly a second, nine Chaos Hole Lightning Spears condensed one after another. They struck out one after another with only one identical target-Lord of Scarlet.
Lord of Scarlet—who had lost consciousnesshad a very weak perception of the outside world. He felt like he was looking at the outside world from deep inside a dark abyss. He saw that the outside world was distorted. Chaos Hole spears distorted as they attacked him. He knew that he had been attacked, but it was difficult for him to put up any defenses. He couldn’t even dodge them.
Boom! Boom!
He could only allow the Chaos Hole Lightning Spears to strike his body.
Wake up, wake up, wake up! Lord of Scarlet struggled with all his might.
But he felt that the endless darkness was too deep. It constantly dragged his consciousness into oblivion. He looked at the outside world and frantically resisted time and time again. Finally, his consciousness rushed out of the deep darkness with a poof. He could finally clearly sense his body and the outside world. The outside world no longer appeared distorted and became normal.
Boom!
Only then did Lord of Scarlet realize that another lightning spear had pierced his body. Large amounts of lightning were wreaking havoc in his body.
Lord of Scarlet had grasped two Sixth Tribulation laws. One was the law of blood, and the other was the law of gravity. With the two laws combined, he cultivated an extremely powerful body. This outer realm true body took more than 100,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals to cultivate, making it formidable. Even if he stood there, it was very difficult for other peak Sixth Tribulation Eminences to injure him heavily. Thirty percent of my body was destroyed after my consciousness sank for only a few seconds? Lord of Scarlet was secretly alarmed. Even though he didn’t use any defensive moves and allowed the attacks to hit him without any resistance, it was still terrifying to have 30% of his body destroyed.
This lightning spear caused my body to collapse at the leptonic level? Lord of Scarlet realized this. “Die!”
Lord of Scarlet didn’t have time to think as he instantly drew his saber.
Boom.
The saber beam traversed hundreds of millions of kilometers and struck Meng Chuan. Meng Chuan dissipated like a bubble, appearing hundreds of millions of kilometers away.
Meng Chuan shook his head slightly. “Too slow.”
In terms of movement techniques, Meng Chuan-who had grasped the lightning law and lepton law—was indeed much stronger. He easily dodged his opponent’s attacks. In fact, even if his opponent struck him, he wouldn’t be able to threaten his leptonic Undying Body. However, Meng Chuan didn’t want to be hit.
With his strike missing its target, Lord of Scarlet was just about to unleash greater might when he felt a pair of dark eyes appear in his mind.
It’s here again!
The dark eyes stared at Lord of Scarlet as he sank into oblivion once again. The scene outside became distorted and illusory.
Break! Break! Break! I need to break through this! Lord of Scarlet struggled with all his might.
Finally, his struggles paid off. At that moment, his body had already transformed into surging waves of blood. His injuries were even worse than before.
Although Lord of Scarlet’s perception of the outside world was blurry, he knew very well that City Lord Eastcalm had once again bombarded him with his lightning spears. Furthermore, Meng Chuan wanted to capture him and throw him into a prison. Therefore, Lord of Scarlet completely dissipated into a sea of blood with his vague control over his body.
Lord of Scarlet’s body was powerful when condensed. When completely separated, his life-preservation means as a sea of blood were even stronger.
Another 30% was destroyed? Won’t I be doomed if this happens one more time? Lord of Scarlet felt extremely weak. Clearly, even the sea of blood would still be destroyed at the leptonic level.
His Essence Soul mystic technique is too terrifying. I need to leave immediately. Lord of Scarlet didn’t dare hesitate. This true body had cost more than 100,000 cubes to cultivate; it would be a waste if it was completely destroyed.
He immediately activated a Spacetime Teleportation Talisman.
Buzz.
He immediately fled with his body. As he fled, he discovered a pair of dark eyes appearing in his mind again.
Whoosh.
Following that, the black eye vanished from his mind. Thankfully, I fled quickly. At this moment, Lord of Scarlet was actually glad that he had been decisive. If he had been any slower, he probably would have died.

chapters.title: Chapter 670 - Avoid Him
chapters.content:
Chapter 670 Avoid Him
The black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan stood in the void and frowned slightly. Spacetime teleportation? Lord of Scarlet sure fled quickly.
Meng Chuan knew Black Fiend Hall’s style very well.
To Supremacies, Imperial Lords, and the weaker cultivators in the outer realm, Black Fiend Hall represented destruction. The latter made the former feel despair and fear. It was a behemoth that they couldn’t resist.
But in the eyes of Sixth Tribulation Eminences like Meng Chuan, Black Fiend Hall was like a cunning wolf! They were ferocious and ruthless, but they took the initiative to avoid the factions directly under Sixth and Seventh Tribulation Eminences. They didn’t hesitate to pounce on the weak and devour them completely, but they were extremely cautious when facing powerful enemies.
If they were truly angered, they would spare no expense to take action and crack the tough nut! For example, Master Poison Eye—who abhorred evil-had specially targeted them. Dealt pain, Black Fiend Hall didn’t hesitate to attack him at all costs. Even a Seventh Tribulation Eminence attacked him. However, when Manor Lord Centaurea stepped forward to protect him, they gave up.
Meng Chuan had only killed two small teams from Black Fiend Hall; he hadn’t even killed a Sixth Tribulation Eminence. He didn’t make Black Fiend Hall feel the ‘pain’ yet. It just embarrassed the Sixth Tribulation Eminence. I gave Black Fiend Hall a setback. I thought they would set up an array formation when attacking, sending a few Sixth Tribulation Eminences to attack me together. Meng Chuan sensed his surroundings. Who knew that only Lord of Scarlet came.
Meng Chuan was very cautious. He only sent an Essence Soul avatar out of Thousand Mountain Star to meet the enemy. He didn’t bring any treasures with him.
Even if the other party had set up an ambush, the loss of an Essence Soul avatar wasn’t even considered a loss of ‘a single cube.’
Swoosh.
After confirming that there were no enemies, Meng Chuan returned to Thousand Mountain Star.
Black Fiend Hall’s territory in Nebula Palace. In the same hall as before.
“Eastcalm appeared the moment I arrived outside Thousand Mountain Star,” said Lord of Scarlet as he sat there. He scoffed. “He only sent an Essence Soul avatar. From the looks of it, he’s afraid of being beaten to death by me.”
“An Essence Soul avatar is nothing to an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence.”
“He probably came out to probe the situation.”
The other Sixth Tribulation Eminences also looked forward to hearing about the development of the situation. They were very confident in Lord of Scarlet. He was powerful in head-on battles. Furthermore, his Blood Corrosion ability was extremely powerful. He could silently corrode a weak cultivator’s body from within, and the victim wouldn’t know that their blood would quickly spread to other cultivators after they entered Thousand Mountain Star.
In less than a day, all the tens of thousands of cultivators on Thousand Mountain Star would be corrupted. When that happened, their lives would be completely under Lord of Scarlet’s control.
Even a Sixth Tribulation Eminence would find it difficult to detect the Blood Corrosion. Therefore, when Lord of Scarlet took the initiative to attack, the other members felt that he was a suitable candidate. Slaughtering thousands of thousand Mountain Star cultivators under City Lord Eastcalm’s nose was Lord of Scarlet’s original plan. “This Eastcalm sure is arrogant.” Lord of Scarlet snorted coldly. “I... Oh?” Lord of Scarlet’s expression changed slightly.
“What’s wrong?” asked the purple-robed man.
Lord of Scarlet frowned and sat there silently.
The other Sixth Tribulation Eminences exchanged looks. They guessed that Lord of Scarlet had likely engaged City Lord Eastcalm in battle.
“A bunch of fools!” Lord of Scarlet suddenly flew into a rage, his blood-colored eyes filled with killing intent.
The other Sixth Tribulation Eminences in the hall were alarmed.
“What happened? City Lord Eastcalm knows that we were coming and laid an ambush?” asked the purple-robed man.
“It would’ve been fine if there was an ambush.” Lord of Scarlet gritted his teeth. “Black Fiend Hall’s intelligence officers are all fools. They missed out on so much intelligence on City Lord Eastcalm that it screwed me badly.” “Screwed you badly?” The purple-robed man was solemn. The other Sixth Tribulation Eminences felt their hearts tighten. Lord of Scarlet was a top Sixth Tribulation Eminence, yet he was screwed badly? “In just two or three moves, more than half of my body was destroyed,” said Lord of Scarlet through gritted teeth. “If I were a step slower, I would have died there.”
“How can this be?”
“What happened?” The Sixth Tribulation Eminences were alarmed. Even with Lord of Scarlet’s life-preservation means, he had nearly died there. Most of them would be sending themselves to their deaths if they had gone.
Lord of Scarlet shook his head. “City Lord Eastcalm didn’t use any tricks. He only used an Essence Soul avatar. He didn’t even use any treasures, yet he nearly killed me in two or three moves.”
“An Essence Soul avatar is this powerful without using any treasures?” The purple-robed man was astonished. “At the Sixth Tribulation realm, I’m afraid only peak Sixth Tribulation Eminences can threaten him. It’s useless for other Sixth Tribulation Eminences to go.” Lord of Scarlet was very certain of this. “He’s very terrifying in a head-on battle. I can be certain that he has mastered the lightning law and the lepton law at least. The lightning law is more powerful when it comes to destruction. The lepton law is even more terrifying. How many Sixth Tribulation Eminences can withstand the destructive power from the combination of two laws at the leptonic level?”
“Lepton law?”
“Lepton Undying Body?”
Everyone present was alarmed.
Among Sixth Tribulation Eminences, the Undying Body of the Past and the Lepton Undying Body were terrifyingly famous. Only those who had grasped a spatial law could deal with them.
If one couldn’t kill their opponent, they could only allow their opponent to attack them freely.
An expert who had grasped the lepton law could attack from the leptonic level with terrifying destructive power.
“With just these two laws, he can only suppress you at best,” said the purple-robed man. “It’s impossible for him to nearly kill you in two or three moves.”
The other Sixth Tribulation Eminences agreed with this point.
The combination of the lightning law and the lepton law was indeed rather terrifying. However, Meng Chuan was ultimately just a top Sixth Tribulation Eminence. He could only suppress Lord of Scarlet. Without exchanging hundreds or thousands of blows, it would be difficult for him to injure Lord of Scarlet heavily.
“Yes, that’s not what’s most terrifying about him.” Lord of Scarlet gritted his teeth. “It’s his Essence Soul mystic technique! Once his Essence Soul mystic technique is used, my consciousness was dragged into a bottomless abyss. At that moment, I had no strength to resist.
“Unable to resist, I could only take a beating. Therefore, I was nearly killed in two or three moves,” said Lord of Scarlet. The other Sixth Tribulation Eminences were alarmed.
“With your powerful body, you can greatly weaken an Essence Soul mystic technique’s impact.” The purple-robed man was solemn. “Even so, you didn’t have the strength to resist?”
The difference between resisting and not resisting was stark.
If Lord of Scarlet had used a defensive move, he could’ve withstood 70-80% of Meng Chuan’s Chaos Hole Lightning Spear’s might The remaining power would’ve been greatly weakened by his body, but the damage to his body would be negligible. He would probably recover in the blink of an eye. No matter how long the two sides fought, it would be impressive if Meng Chuan could heavily injure Lord of Scarlet.
Without any resistance, the attack struck his body at full force. In less than ten seconds, Meng Chuan nearly killed Lord of Scarlet.
“Black Fiend Hall’s intelligence was so wrong.” Lord of Scarlet gritted his teeth in anger. “He must be targeting me now.”
For the sake of two branch teams, he had formed a grudge with City Lord Eastcalm. Lord of Scarlet was fuming.
I usually would hide from such a terrifying expert, yet I formed a grudge with him? Furthermore, I have a feeling that this City Lord Eastcalm still has some tricks up his sleeve. Lord of Scarlet recalled how Meng Chuan had easily seen through the spacetime profundities when he used his Scarlet domain. Meng Chuan had easily avoided his saber strike from beginning to end. “With such strength, it’s no wonder he dared to spoil our plans.” The purple-robed man frowned slightly. He was slightly stronger than Lord of Scarlet, but he was barely stronger. He didn’t have the confidence to deal with City Lord Eastcalm either.
“Let’s report this matter,” said a gray-robed woman. “We won’t be able to deal with it.”
“Report it.”
“Let the higher-ups decide,” said the other Sixth Tribulation Eminences. Facing an existence that nearly killed Lord of Scarlet in two or three moves, especially when the other party only sent an Essence Soul avatar without carrying a Tribulation treasure... Just the thought of it left them shuddering in fear.
A seated illusory fog existence flipped through the dossiers.
The dossier recorded the battle between Lord of Scarlet and Meng Chuan. It even recorded the battle scenes.
“City Lord Eastcalm, Meng Chuan?” The illusory fog existence looked at the dossier and muttered softly, “I originally thought that he was only a newly-advanced Sixth Tribulation Eminence. Who knew that he had hidden his strength so well? At the very least, he has grasped two laws—the lightning law and the lepton law-and cultivates an Essence Soul mystic technique that Lord of Scarlet couldn’t resist at all?
“From the Essence Soul mystic technique’s effects, it should be the Pupil of Darkness.
“Meng Chuan is also a Fiend Mountain member. His willpower should be extremely high. That’s why his Pupil of Darkness is this powerful.
“A newly-advanced Sixth Tribulation Eminence. How long has he cultivated? Yet, he has already grasped two Sixth Tribulation laws.
“He headed to the Valley of Spacetime and once headed to the Endless Belts of Wind, Holy Mountain of Painting, and Ice River Nebula... After he reached the Sixth Tribulation realm, he should be focusing on cultivating the spatial law. However, he has secretly grasped two other Sixth Tribulation laws. His talent is truly astonishing.
“He was recommended by Hall Lord Blazing Sun before he gained entry into the Valley of Spacetime.
“He was sent into Clear Spring Island by Fiend Eye.
“He’s a newly-advanced Sixth Tribulation Eminence, yet he’s so powerful. His willpower is also very strong, and he has obtained White Avian Hall and Fiend Eye’s favor.” The illusory fog existence’s lips curled up slightly. “Fiend Eye, you don’t do things without benefits in store. You are much more cunning than our Black Fiend Hall.”
“Furthermore, he comes from Archean Eon Realm, so he doesn’t lack resources. It’s difficult to prevent him from rising to prominence.” The illusory fog made a judgment.
It was already very difficult to suppress Meng Chuan at the present stage. Based on Meng Chuan’s cultivation speed, it was possible that a Seventh Tribulation Eminence would soon find it difficult to kill him.
The illusory fog existence relied on the current intelligence to make a judgment. Back then, before Meng Chuan comprehended the lepton law, Fiend Eye had probed Meng Chuan’s future one after another. He had realized that Meng Chuan’s rise could not be prevented.
As he flipped through the dossier, the illusory fog existence nodded slightly. From the intelligence, Meng Chuan doesn’t participate in any of Eternal Tower or White Avian Hall’s large-scale operations. He focuses on cultivation and seldom stirs trouble.
He immediately flipped his hand and took out a brush. He wrote two words on the dossier: “Avoid him.”
For someone who didn’t cause trouble and had terrifying talent, all they needed to do was avoid him.

chapters.title: Chapter 671 - Spoils
chapters.content:
Chapter 671 Spoils
In a chamber inside of Earth Cloud Mystic Realm’s Realm Palace, Meng Chuan sat cross-legged. With a wave of his hand, a large number of items flew out. There were shrunken ships, chains, sabers, blood wheels, and various treasures. There were also various storage treasures, mobile grotto-heavens, protective robes, and life-preservation talismans.
Changpo Planet was relatively close to Taidong River Zone. After killing the Black Fiend Hall team, Meng Chuan sent the war spoils to Taidong River Zone.
A large number of treasures piled up into a hill, occupying half of the chamber. Meng Chuan looked up. I have to filter them carefully. I have to make more preparations for my homeworld’s juniors.
For example, Ancestral Master Archean Eon was considered rich among Seventh Tribulation Eminences. The Eternal treasure, Great Seal, couldn’t be exposed to the public. The other treasures were worth between 60 to 90 million cubes.
Was that a lot?
If his expenditure didn’t increase, at a rate of one Outer Realm Essence Crystal per year, all of that would be completely consumed in about 100 million years.
Thus, Ancestral Master Archean Eon had set up multiple restrictions. Most of the time, he required the sect to form a self-sufficient cycle. He only allowed them to use the sect’s treasures for special reasons. The higher one’s talent was, the more worthy they were to be nurtured. If they were mediocre... he would rather wait thousands of years for a genius to appear.
Thankfully, Meng Chuan appeared over one million years after Ancestral Master Archean Eon died. Many of Ancestral Master’s precious treasures remained.
These can be sold through Eternal Tower.
These are useful for Archean Eon Realm. I’ll bring them back and put them in the treasure vault.
Meng Chuan quickly dealt with the war spoils. He had to identify many treasures quickly. Soon, he categorized the hill-like treasures in front of him. He only left behind the storage treasures and mobile grotto-heavens.
Whoosh.
Many items were stored in the storage treasures and mobile grotto-heavens. Meng Chuan’s Power of Essence Soul seeped into each item and quickly scanned them.
Wow. This large piece of Magnetic Essence Crystal is probably worth 50,000 cubes. I wonder if it’s a Tribulation Eminence’s or an Imperial Lord’s treasure. Meng Chuan waved his hand, and a gray sphere—that was 180 feet in diameter—floated before him.
Although the Magnetic Essence Crystal was gray, it had gorgeous flowing colors, and it had extraordinary charm. Black Fiend Hall’s Tribulation Eminences shouldn’t have brought such a precious treasure with them when out slaughtering. It’s very likely that an Imperial Lord obtained this treasure.
In fact, the main contribution to Meng Chuan’s war spoils was from the Imperial Lord servants.
When they encountered Black Fiend Hall, some Imperial Lords would rather give up their treasures and self-destruct their avatars in order to maintain their dignity or not slaughter other cultivators.
However, there were still many Imperial Lords who couldn’t bear to part with their gains in the outer realm. They were willing to be servants. The treasures of the hundreds of Imperial Lord servants ended up falling into Meng Chuan’s hands.
Last time on Ingenious Dharma Planet, the war spoils were worth about 180,000 cubes. This time, my gains are even greater. Including this piece of Magnetic Essence Crystal, I have already gained more than 200,000 cubes, and I’m not even done. Meng Chuan put away the Magnetic Essence Crystal and checked the other storage treasures and mobile grotto-heavens.
The destruction of every Black Fiend Hall branch benefited him greatly. However, most Sixth Tribulation Eminences were very cautious. Without any special reason, they wouldn’t deal with Black Fiend Hall’s branch teams. For example, Meng Chuan had only crossed them twice before Lord of Scarlet was sent.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
The storage treasures and mobile grotto-heavens were inspected and sorted out. Given Meng Chuan’s realm, he handled them quite quickly. Suddenly, Meng Chuan stopped and looked at a floating storage ring. What’s this? Meng Chuan’s Power of Essence Soul seeped into the storage ring and discovered one of the many treasures-an ancient scroll.
What a brilliant spacetime profundity it contains. It has a complete spatial law. In terms of the time law, it far exceeds my accumulated insights. It’s at least a Seventh Tribulation treasure. No... it doesn’t look like a treasure. It’s more like a treasure with a special purpose.
With a thought
Whoosh.
The painting was taken out. The painting looked like it was made of leather. It was three feet long and wide, and it looked ordinary. However, Meng Chuan was only one step away from grasping a complete spatial law. Therefore, he could confirm that the painting contained a complete spatial law. The usage of the time law was also very brilliant. There were even other laws. For example, the paintings on Holy Mountain of Painting revealed the different laws’ profundities.
This painting was a rare treasure. It converged its mysteries within. There are so many war spoils, but I actually encountered something I can’t see through. Meng Chuan was somewhat curious as a wisp of his Essence Soul seeped into the painting.
Boom!
Meng Chuan’s consciousness entered the painting’s space.
In the illusory space was a dark-cyan altar in the middle. Above it were ten doors that led off into ten different directions.
I can deduce a physical body Dharmic formulation that’s suitable for me by sacrificing treasures? Meng Chuan looked at the dark-cyan altar in front of him and was somewhat shocked. It’s very difficult to create a physical body formulation at the Physical Body Tribulation realm. As for this altar... it can help me perfect it to at least 90%. The rest requires the cultivator to take the final step? Meng Chuan’s body was still stuck at the Fifth Tribulation realm. This was because it wasn’t easy to create a body formulation for himself. He also didn’t want to waste too much time on this aspect.
An altar that can help one deduce a nearly complete formulation to 90% at least? Furthermore, it is extremely compatible with cultivators.
Fascinating! The entire painting has two uses. One: sacrifice treasures and deduce a physical body formulation. Two: by sacrificing treasures, one can possess a Physical Body Tribulation Eminence. The strongest person one can possess is a Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence? There are ten choices to choose from? Meng Chuan looked up at the ten doors above the altar.
The ten doors represent the ultimate direction of deduction? The direction of ten Origins laws? Meng Chuan was secretly alarmed. Does it mean that it can help perfect the embryonic form of a Seventh Tribulation body?
Is it true, or is it just hot air?
Meng Chuan pondered for a moment and immediately executed a simple move in the illusory space.
Boom!
The Power of Essence Soul formed a wisp of lightning that swam around the illusory space before transforming into a lepton cluster.
Words appeared on the altar: “Deducing a Sixth Tribulation Physical Body formulation that is compatible with the lightning law and the lepton law requires 500,000 Outer Realm Essence Crystals or equivalent treasures.”
A 90% completed physical body formulation for 500,000 cubes? Meng Chuan sighed inwardly. How ruthless.
But it was worth it. After all, the difficulty of creating a physical body formulation was greatly reduced. However, 500,000 cubes? It was a large expenditure, even for top Sixth Tribulation Eminences.
If a deduction is to be made, body tissue needs to be sent into the painting’s space. A drop of blood or a strand of hair will suffice. Meng Chuan sensed the information from the altar.
It still requires my outer realm true body to rush over. Meng Chuan could confirm that the painting was extraordinary. He wasn’t worried that the other party had any ill intentions. This was because, with his Lepton Undying Body and the protection of his homeworld, even an Eighth Tribulation Eminence might not be able to kill him if they personally did the deed. Meng Chuan had the confidence to deal with any variable developments in this painting. As for an existence beyond the Eighth Tribulation realm plotting against him?
Meng Chuan welcomed that very much. Meng Chuan felt that he would be lucky to meet an Eternal.
When his outer realm true body arrived at Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, he sent a drop of blood into the scroll.
Hum.
The entire illusory space locked onto the drop of blood and probed it. After all, it had to rely on his original body’s foundation to deduce a subsequent formulation.
“Time lineage. Imperial Lord-level paramount technique, perfected body.” The altar emitted a glow as a dark vortex appeared on the altar.
“Cultivator who created an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique, you are invited to the Nine Trials Pagoda to undergo nine trials.” Words appeared on the altar.
Nine Trials Pagoda? Meng Chuan’s heart palpitated. So this painting scroll was originally created by the Dragon Ancestor. It’s no wonder sacrifices are needed at every step of the way.
At the mention of Nine Trials Pagoda, Meng Chuan guessed the origins of the painting.
This was because Ancestral Master Archean Eon had personally recorded information about the Nine Trials Pagoda in his dossier. Ancestral Master Archean Eon had once been to the Nine Trials Pagoda.
According to Ancestral Master’s records, the Nine Trials Pagoda was created by the Dragon Ancestor.Only by obtaining the Dragon Ancestor’s invitation can one head there. As for the Dragon Ancestor, he’s said to be the richest among Eighth Tribulation Eminences.
The Dragon Ancestor’s wealth allowed him to stand above all other Eighth Tribulation Eminences.
He had all sorts of ways to earn treasures. He could even obtain treasures from other universes.

chapters.title: Chapter 672 - Dragon Ancestor’s Nine Trials Pagoda
chapters.content:
Chapter 672 Dragon Ancestor’s Nine Trials Pagoda
Meng Chuan didn’t care about using the sacrificial picture scroll to deduce a physical body formulation because he mainly focused on the Essence Soul lineage. He didn’t want to spend a large amount of time on the physical body lineage. The improvement brought by the physical body lineage didn’t qualitatively change his strength at all. If he had the time, he might as well spend more time studying and cultivating. A Seventh Tribulation Eminence only had slightly more than 100,000 years to live. Time was very precious. If he spent the time he saved on cultivating his body in the Essence Soul lineage, his chances of reaching the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm would increase.
As for possessing a Physical Body Tribulation Eminence, Meng Chuan was rather interested. He could use this opportunity to experience the means of a Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
Nine Trials Pagoda. Meng Chuan was immediately filled with excitement when the sacrificial picture scroll invited him to Nine Trials Pagoda.
That’s the Nine Trials Pagoda! Legend has it that one can become an Eternal after completely clearing Nine Trials Pagoda. Meng Chuan still remembered Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s detailed records in the dossier.
The Dragon Ancestor refined the Nine Trials Pagoda at a high price.
The Dragon Ancestor had even invited more than one Eighth Tribulation Eminence to clear it. He himself had attempted it a few times, but he had failed to clear it.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon tried thrice in his life. His best result was clearing the fourth trial.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon had only cleared four of the nine trials. It was obvious how difficult it was.
Time to go!
One of Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars carried the sacrificial scroll. With a thought, he sensed the dark vortex inside the altar. A spacetime fluctuation immediately enveloped Meng Chuan.
Swoosh.
The Essence Soul avatar had already left Earth Cloud Mystic Realm.
Spacetime changed. When spacetime stabilized, Meng Chuan arrived in a dark space.
The dark space only spanned billions of kilometers. It was completely isolated from the outside world.
There was only one thing in this dark space-a towering, massive tower. The tower had three floors. The tower itself was built from a massive mysterious bone. The gray bone suffused starlight as if it was shaped into the tower.
This is the Nine Trials Pagoda! Meng Chuan could sense the pressure coming from the Nine Trials Pagoda. The long bone on the pagoda was over 50,000 kilometers long. The pressure was comparable to the Eighth Tribulation Eminence arm that Ancestral Master Archean Eon had collected.
According to Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s records, this was built with the bones of an Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s massive corpse. With this as a foundation, the Dragon Ancestor spent a large number of precious materials to refine them. Only then did the Nine Trials Pagoda possess such strength. Meng Chuan knew very well that the value of the materials used to construct the Nine Trials Pagoda probably exceeded 100 million cubes.
A figure slowly flew out from the Nine Trials Pagoda’s entrance. It was an elder with a turtle shell on his back.
“A living person has finally come to the Nine Trials Pagoda again.” The turtle-shelled elder smiled. His eyebrows twitched as he carefully scrutinized Meng Chuan. “You were invited here after creating an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique. You’ve only been cultivating for slightly more than 5,000 years? You’re very young. Kid, my name is Bei.”
“Senior Bei,” greeted Meng Chuan humbly. According to Ancestral Master’s records, Senior Bei was the Nine Trials Pagoda’s host, arranged by Dragon Ancestor. At the very least, he was extremely terrifying in the Nine Trials Pagoda. If a Seventh Tribulation Eminence dared to act rashly, Senior Bei would easily kill them when he stirred the Nine Trials Pagoda’s might.
“I’m just a special array spirit; how can I be considered a senior?” The turtle-shelled elder chuckled. “I find you quite pleasing to the eye. If there’s anything you don’t understand, feel free to ask.”
Meng Chuan knew that he had to get into Senior Bei’s good books. If Senior Bei was happy, he would tell him everything. Otherwise, Senior Bei wouldn’t be bothered to say anything “Senior Bei, can I come again in the future?” asked Meng Chuan.
“There’s no limit to the number of times you can come, but each visit needs to be 10,000 years apart at least,” said the turtle-shelled elder. “This is also a rule set by the Dragon Ancestor. After all, each trial’s expenditure is massive when activated. With the Dragon Ancestor’s petty personality, he’s the one who should profit. The Nine Trials Pagoda... is a rare initiative by the Dragon Ancestor to give benefits to the cultivators in his home universe.”
Meng Chuan sighed. Home universe? Eighth Tribulation Eminences—who can jump out of the River of Spacetime and roam other universes— do have a concept of home universes.
“Senior Bei, I can sense that the bones used in this Nine Trials Pagoda should be an Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s bones. Do they originate from the same Eminence? Are they Eighth Tribulation Eminences from our universe?” Meng Chuan chatted casually. He knew that Senior Bei liked to chat when he was in a good mood because he had been lonely for too long. “It’s not an Eighth Tribulation Eminence from our universe,” said the turtle-shelled elder. “It’s an Eighth Tribulation Eminence corpse that Dragon Ancestor picked up when he was roaming beyond this universe. That corpse was rather special and was very suitable for refining into the Nine Trials Pagoda.”
“Picked up?” Meng Chuan was surprised. Such things can be picked up?
“Eighth Tribulation Eminences can jump out of the River of Spacetime and go to the past to see everything that has happened. They can also head to the future. They can even head to other universes.” The turtle-shelled elder sighed. “However, they ultimately aren’t Eternal. Their lifespans are still limited. No matter how they jump through the timeline and cross the universe, their lifespans will still decrease... “If they don’t wish to die, it will be very difficult for them to die before they reach the end of their lifespans. But when their time is almost up, an Eighth Tribulation Eminence will think of a way to break through to the Eternal realm. Many of these breakthrough methods are very dangerous, so it’s normal to leave corpses behind,” said the turtle-shelled elder.
Meng Chuan nodded.
That kid, Meng Chuan, has gone to Nine Trials River Zone? Realm Ancestor-who was fishing
-sensed something. He used karma to lock onto Meng Chuan’s location. Although the Nine Trials Pagoda had blurred his perception, he could roughly determine the area. It should be the Nine Trials Pagoda. The Nine Trials Pagoda is a test Senior Dragon Ancestor left for us juniors. It’s also an opportunity.
Realm Ancestor still respected Dragon Ancestor greatly. This was because, according to what he knew, Dragon Ancestor was probably the strongest Eighth Tribulation Eminence in the universe’s entire history. He was also rather benevolent toward his descendants.
Most of the strongest cultivators in every generation can enter the Nine Trials Pagoda. The Nine Trials Pagoda might even bestow them gifts, thought Realm Ancestor. There was no limit to the number of times one could be invited to the Nine Trials Pagoda. If one didn’t improve too much after the second and third time, they wouldn’t be given another chance. However, one would more or less receive some gifts during their first challenge of the Nine Trials Pagoda.
He’s gone to the Nine Trials Pagoda just like that? Fiend Eye sat in his chamber and looked in the direction of Nine Trials River Zone from afar. The corners of his mouth curled into a smile. Meng Chuan’s potential is too astonishing. There’s no keeping him down. He’s blessed by the light from providence, and he will ultimately soar. The light from providence was a mysterious thing.
In fact, only when a cultivator was strong could they accumulate the light shone down from providence.
With strength and talent, one would naturally be respected by others. They would be valued by the various factions. Some factions were willing to invest their resources on such existences. This was what being blessed by the light from providence meant. At the end of the day, it depended on how outstanding the cultivator was. For example, Meng Chuan’s son-Meng Anhad some light from providence shine on him, but it was also because Meng Chuan was strong and talented.
The stronger one was, the greater the impact they had on the world around them.
If one reached the Eighth Tribulation realm, they could easily change an era completely. Their favoritism was equivalent to the light from providence. Their enmity was a nightmare. If one became an Eternal existence, they could even destroy the universe. This had already exceeded the concept of the light from providence.
Meng Chuan went to the Nine Trials Pagoda? In a cave abode on Clear Spring Island, Guild Master Darkstar had also noticed the development.
Ever since he paid attention to Meng Chuan, the two were connected by karma. Thus, he could easily lock onto any of Meng Chuan’s avatars.
In the first challenge of the Nine Trials Pagoda, he will more or less receive a gift as long as he can clear the first trial. Guild Master Darkstar’s eyes were deep. A gift from Dragon Ancestor.
Dragon Ancestor was the wealthiest Eighth Tribulation Eminence born in this universe. He might also be the strongest. Even a casual gift from him was something that left Guild Master Darkstar envious.
It looks like he has quite the potential to be invited to the Nine Trials Pagoda at the Sixth Tribulation realm.
Even if you can reach the Seventh Tribulation realm in the future, it’s a pity that you’re currently still weak. Guild Master Darkstar was famous for his greed. He even dared to plot against Seventh Tribulation Eminences. After all, he feared very few people at his cultivation realm.
“Yuchang, keep an eye on City Lord Eastcalm -Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar in Nine Trials River Zone. Once you discover his location, inform me immediately,” ordered Guild Master Darkstar from afar.
“Yes.” After Yuchang received the order, he immediately sent an Essence Soul avatar to Nine Trials River Zone to lock onto Meng Chuan’s location more precisely.

chapters.title: Chapter 673 - In front of the Pill Furnace
chapters.content:
Chapter 673 In front of the Pill Furnace
The entrance to the towering Nine Trials Pagoda was 50 kilometers wide.
Meng Chuan and the turtle-shelled elder walked through the entrance like two tiny dots. “Meng Chuan, you will reach the Nine Trials Pagoda’s interior if you continue moving forward.” The turtle-shelled elder stood in the entranceway and pointed into the pagoda. The pagoda was empty chaos. In the middle was a pill furnace that resembled a hill. “After entering the pagoda, keep moving forward. Reaching the front of that pill furnace means you have survived the first trial.” Meng Chuan nodded slightly. “Walk to the pill furnace?”
“Don’t underestimate the first trial,” said the turtle-shelled elder with a smile. “In your era, the most powerful people-Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star—are both half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences; yet, they have only cleared the fifth trial. As a Sixth Tribulation Eminence... it’s very difficult for you to clear the first trial.”
Meng Chuan was shocked.
His homeworld’s Ancestral Master Archean Eon had cleared the fourth trial. As for Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star, they had only barely cleared the fifth trial.
“Senior Bei, how many people in our era have managed to reach the fourth trial?” asked Meng Chuan.
“In this era, most Seventh Tribulation Eminences have been here. Only three reached the fourth trial,” said the turtle-shelled elder. “They are Realm Ancestor, Windthunder Walker, and Palace Lord Medicine.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. There were seven publicly recognized top Seventh Tribulation Eminences. Fiend Eye hadn’t revealed his peak Seventh Tribulation strength after recovering from his serious injuries, so he wasn’t included.
These seven were Ancestral Magus King, Palace Lady Blood Phoenix, Lord of Shadows, Origin Realm Chieftain, Realm Ancestor, Windthunder Walker, and Palace Lord Medicine.
“Has Ancestral Magus King never been here?” asked Meng Chuan.
Back then, there was a period of time when Ancestral Magus King was the strongest Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Realm Ancestor was the strongest Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
Even now, Ancestral Magus King’s faction remained powerful. “He ultimately has something lacking in his cultivation. He only has such strength because he received the opportunity to obtain the legacy left behind by an Eternal existence,” said the turtle-shelled elder casually.
“What about Guild Master Fiend Eye?” asked Meng Chuan. He had come into close contact with Fiend Eye. Fiend Eye had once stood at the peak of the River of Spacetime a long time ago.
“He’s also somewhat lacking,” said the turtle-shelled elder. “He’s inferior to Realm Ancestor and the other two’s deep foundations.”
Meng Chuan sighed.
The outside world spoke of seven peak Seventh Tribulation Eminences. It was said that Fiend Eye was unfathomable. But in the eyes of the Nine Trials Pagoda’s array spirit... there was clearly a difference in strength. Presently, Realm Ancestor was the oldest Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
Palace Lord Medicine was the Seventh Tribulation Eminence who kept the lowest profile in the present era. He was the most aloof from worldly affairs. However, he had reached an unimaginable level in terms of medicine and poison. No faction was willing to be enemies with Palace Lord Medicine. Even Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star were unwilling to anger him.
Windthunder Walker was a lonely Seventh Tribulation Eminence. He explored ruin after ruin for extended periods and focused on cultivation. This was because he had discovered treasures that other Seventh Tribulation Eminences would fight over when discovered. But as long as he fought, Windthunder Walker had never suffered any losses!
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star-who was a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence-had once clashed with Windthunder Walker because of a legacy treasure. Windthunder Walker ended up walking away as the victor. He successfully fled with the treasures, while Celestial Thearch Myriad Star returned empty-handed.
In the conflict between Windthunder Walker and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star, it’s said that Windthunder Walker was lucky. After all, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star is an existence that has grasped the laws of time and space... He must have been careless. But from the looks of it, Windthunder Walker is sufficiently powerful to escape from Celestial Thearch Myriad Star along with a treasure. Meng Chuan sighed inwardly. In fact, Ancestral Master Archean Eon had cleared the fourth trial. He was on par with Realm Ancestor, Palace Lord Medicine, and Starlord Windthunder.
“I’ll remind you again that you are not allowed to use any treasures when challenging the Nine Trials Pagoda. You can only rely on your strength. Otherwise, I have no choice but to expel you and ban you from ever entering again,” said the turtle-shelled elder as he stood by the entrance.
“Understood.” Meng Chuan cherished the opportunity to enter the Nine Trials Pagoda. According to Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s records, one could search for flaws in their cultivation when they entered the Nine Trials Pagoda. Furthermore, treasures would be given to them if they were outstanding enough.
ures
Meng Chuan stepped into the pagoda.
The pagoda’s interior was empty chaos. The pill furnace in the middle was most eye-catching. As Meng Chuan took his first step into the pagoda, he felt an extremely heavy pressure envelop him.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Invisible wind blew across Meng Chuan’s body in the empty chaos. Every gust of wind was much heavier than a Supreme Yang Star. Furthermore, it tried its best to penetrate in a bid to strike at every lepton.
What a heavy pressure. It’s enough to crush an ordinary Sixth Tribulation Eminence to death. Although Meng Chuan was using an Essence Soul avatar, he was ultimately focused on cultivating his Essence Soul. The Essence Soul formulation he created had already taken an embryonic form. In particular, the formulation had undergone a transformation when he traveled 36,500 kilometers on Fiend Mountain.
His Essence Soul avatar endured the pressure from the impact, but it remained unmoved with an iron will.
Meng Chuan walked toward the pill furnace one step at a time.
The wind in the pagoda became heavier, and the impact intensified.
Wu
An evil whimper sounded in Meng Chuan’s mind. Illusory, eight-clawed creatures appeared in his sea of consciousness and attacked his mind. Meng Chuan’s consciousness condensed into a human figure, and a saber appeared at his waist. It was a Saber of Will.
Meng Chuan swung his saber and shattered the illusory, eight-clawed creatures.
In terms of willpower, Meng Chuan wasn’t inferior to an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence. He was naturally not someone that would waver before these external objects.
Meng Chuan advanced step by step.
The pressure became greater. The illusory, eight-clawed creatures that entered his sea of consciousness became more corporeal and stronger.
It’s too difficult to clear the first trial at the Sixth Tribulation realm. The turtle-shelled elder sat at the entrance of the tunnel and watched with interest. It’s probably difficult to find one in a hundred. This Meng Chuan is still too young Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The wind’s pressure became even more terrifying. Meng Chuan felt the world tremble as his Essence Soul quaked.
Even with his Essence Soul and his formulation’s embryonic form, he couldn’t withstand the impact.
Don’t tell me I can’t even pass the first trial? Meng Chuan was secretly alarmed.
Clang!
As long as he advanced, the wind pressure would only increase. Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul finally collapsed.
He failed. The turtle shell elder was about to stand up when his eyes suddenly lit up. Eh? Interesting Meng Chuan’s collapsed Essence Soul existed in the form of a lepton cluster. It was invisible to the naked eye. After all, they were leptons, the smallest particles possible.
Countless leptons formed a cluster as Meng Chuan’s consciousness controlled it.
His powerful willpower controlled the entire lepton cluster. The lepton cluster changed according to his will, flowing and changing like water as it constantly dissipated the impact. It was clearly easier to resist the wind when In the form of a lepton cluster.
The flowing liquid layer that I previously comprehended for my Essence Soul might be more suitable as a lepton cluster. Meng Chuan continued advancing in the form of a lepton cluster. Only 20% to 30% of the wind’s pressure acted on the lepton cluster, so the burden on Meng Chuan naturally decreased.
However, as he advanced
Whoosh
The evil sound finally materialized into a black, eight-clawed creature—which could be seen with the naked eye-when Meng Chuan was close to the pill furnace.
The black, eight-clawed creature pounced at Meng Chuan’s lepton cluster form, clashing with Meng Chuan’s consciousness.
“Kill! Kill! Kill!” Every single one of the black, eight-clawed creature’s tentacles was oily. They emitted an evil aura, stirring up many distracting thoughts. They wrapped around Meng Chuan’s will.
“Slash!” Meng Chuan’s willpower had hints of virtual indestructibility. He drew his saber and slashed at the black tentacles with his Saber of Will. After slashing 17 times, he completely destroyed the black, eight-clawed creature.
When it was destroyed, Meng Chuan finally arrived in front of the furnace as a lepton cluster.
The wind stopped, and the evil whimpering disappeared. Everything returned to normal.
Whoosh.
The lepton cluster condensed and restored the black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan’s form.
This is only the first trial? Meng Chuan looked at the hill-like furnace in front of him. He felt like he had almost been forced to use all means available to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 674 - Birth of the Void Trileaf Flower
chapters.content:
Chapter 674 Birth of the Void Trileaf Flower
“Not bad.” The turtle-shelled elder smiled as he walked over from the distant entrance. With a single step, he arrived beside Meng Chuan. “The Nine Trials Pagoda’s first trial is very difficult for Sixth Tribulation Eminences. For you to clear it... it means that your cultivation foundation is considered one of the best at the Sixth Tribulation realm.’
Meng Chuan turned his head and said, “That pressure tests one’s defensive abilities. Most top Sixth Tribulation Eminences probably can’t withstand it.”
The turtle-shelled elder nodded. “When cultivating in the outside world, defensive means are more important than offensive means.”
“There’s also the attack that affects one’s willpower...” Meng Chuan sighed. “Only when one’s willpower reaches the Physical Body Seventh Tribulation realm’s threshold can one withstand it,” said the turtle-shelled elder. “The first trial doesn’t require you to have a high cultivation realm. If your mind can’t reach the Seventh Tribulation realm’s threshold, how can you possibly have a chance of reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm?”
Meng Chuan nodded. One’s mind was fundamental. Only with a powerful mind would one’s realm, body, and Essence Soul matter.
“You have cleared the first trial. The second trial is next.” The turtle-shelled elder smiled as he pointed at the hill-like furnace in front of him. He pointed at the huge rotary disk on the furnace’s main body. “That rotary disk is the entire furnace’s valve. Clearing the second trial entails spinning open the rotary disk valve.”
“As long as I spin open the valve?” Meng Chuan looked up. The rotary disk valve on the pill furnace was octagonal. Each side had the same length-160 feet.
Although Ancestral Master Archean Eon had general records regarding the Nine Trials Pagoda, he didn’t mention the details of each trial. Those who could be invited to the Nine Trials Pagoda didn’t need to know the details of each trial. Those who weren’t qualified didn’t need to know the details.
“That’s right. As long as you open the valve, the entire pill furnace will ignite with raging flames,” said the turtle-shelled elder wistfully. “When the time comes, you will follow the wind tunnel and directly fly into the furnace’s interior. You will then be tested by the furnace’s flames. If you survive it... you will have survived the third trial. It’s fine if you can’t.”
la
The third trial is inside the pill furnace. I’ll be refined by the furnace? Meng Chuan secretly muttered to himself.
At his current realm, Meng Chuan could still discern the truth behind this furnace. Meng Chuan could vaguely sense the profundities of the runes on the furnace’s surface. In fact, he was vaguely certain that the furnace’s might would far exceed his imagination if it was completely unleashed. He had a feeling that his Lepton Undying Body was like dust in front of the furnace’s might. It would dissipate with a single blow.
Even a hundred of him would be annihilated.
Just slightly sensing it makes me instinctively feel terrified. I definitely can’t survive the third trial. Meng Chuan knew his limits.
It was normal.
For example, top Seventh Tribulation Eminences like Guild Master Fiend Eye and Ancestral Magus King could instantly kill him. However, they could only clear up to the third trial.
“Don’t even think about the third trial. Becoming a Seventh Tribulation Eminence is the most basic requirement to clear the third trial,” said the turtle-shelled elder with a smile. “Furthermore, there are other tests. Half of the Seventh Tribulation Eminences typically can’t withstand the third trial.”
Meng Chuan smiled when he heard that. His senses were right. Once the furnace was ignited, its might was far beyond what he could withstand.
The second trial.
Meng Chuan’s Power of Essence Soul spread out and enveloped the pill furnace’s rotary disk valve.
It’s complicated as expected. Meng Chuan sensed the rotary valve and discovered a vast number of runes inside. There were a total of nine layers of countless runes from the bottom.
The nine-layered runes connected the entire furnace.
The nine-layered runes on the rotary valve were a catalyst, a key. It was the key to activating the entire pill furnace’s core array formation.
I can’t understand the entire pill furnace array formation. However, the rotary valve is only a catalyst. The nine layers of runes are much easier to understand than the entire pill furnace array formation. At the very least, I can figure out some clues. Meng Chuan sensed and pondered carefully.
He immersed himself in his thoughts and combed through the vast nine layers of runes. Only when he vaguely understood their overall composition did Meng Chuan snap out of his adrift thoughts.
Meng Chuan realized that the turtle-shelled elder had already fallen asleep and was snoring.
“You’ve been looking at it for more than a year. How’s it going?” The turtle-shelled elder was still snoring a moment ago, but the next moment, he opened his eyes and looked at Meng Chuan. He yawned and asked, “Figured it out?”
I’ve been looking at it for more than a year?
Over the past year, many of Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars had spent all their effort on figuring things out, especially the one in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm-which had more than half of his Essence Soul Origins present. In reality, due to the ten-fold faster time flow, it took him more than ten years to comb through everything. “Senior Bei, there’s no time limit in the Nine Trials Pagoda, right?” asked Meng Chuan.
“As long as your avatar is alive, there’s no time limit,” said the turtle-shelled elder with a smile. “If your avatar dies, it means that you have failed. The next time you come, it will be at least 10,000 years later.” Meng Chuan nodded. “The array formation contained in this rotary valve is complicated. I need more time to activate it.”
“It’s good that you are confident. Take your time; I have plenty of time.” The turtle-shelled elder chuckled and closed his eyes again. He continued sleeping soundly. Meng Chuan smiled and continued studying the nine-layered runes on the rotary valve. Comprehending the nine-layered runes broadened my horizons greatly. The moment I figure it out is also the moment I grasp the spatial law. Meng Chuan already understood that the key to the second trial was the spatial law.
Everything depended on the existence of space.
The spatial law was one of the two major foundations in the River of Spacetime. Its importance wasn’t only reflected by it being the strongest Sixth Tribulation law.
Grasping a spatial law was one of the thresholds to spinning open the valve. It was only natural.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in front of the pill furnace and studied the nine-layered runes on the rotary valve while the turtle-shelled elder slept beside the pill furnace. In the blink of an eye, 15 years had passed. The actual time Meng Chuan spent cultivating was a lot longer.
The Valley of Spacetime had 15 layers. White Avian Hall occupied the larger four layers. In one layer of spacetime, an array formation enveloped the area. In one region, spacetime trembled slightly and distorted. A flower vaguely took form.
Huh?
Two figures arrived almost instantly. They were White Avian Hall’s Sixth Tribulation Eminences—who were in charge of guarding this layer of spacetime.
The pudgy figure’s eyes were very small, but his entire body was like a moving world. The pressure he released was immense. He stared at the vaguely discernible flower. He could distinguish the three leaves and the flower’s appearance. “It’s the Void Trileaf Flower.” The pudgy figure’s eyes burned.
“The Void Trileaf Flower will completely bloom an hour after it appears. It has to be consumed within a day. Otherwise, it will wither and return to spacetime.” Another cyan-clothed female Eminence stared at it with burning desire as well. She had come to the Valley of Spacetime for the Void Trileaf Flower. “By the way, according to the order, who does this Void Trileaf Flower belong to?”
The pudgy figure thought for a moment. “It’s Eastcalm’s turn.”
“Him?” The cyan-clothed woman raised her eyebrows. “Back then, City Lord Eastcalm managed to enter the Valley of Spacetime because of his relationship with Hall Lord Blazing Sun. This caused many to be displeased.”
“That’s right. Even I was pushed back a spot,” said the pudgy figure with a smile. “Despite being a newly-advanced Sixth Tribulation Eminence who hasn’t done anything for White Avian Hall, he was able to enter the Valley of Spacetime early. Many Sixth Tribulation Eminences were envious and somewhat indignant. However, I never expected that a newly-advanced Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence could defeat Black Fiend Hall’s Lord of Scarlet.”
“That’s right. That battle really gave me a fright. This Eastcalm actually silently reached the top echelons of the Sixth Tribulation realm. Furthermore, he defeated Lord of Scarlet,” said the cyan-clothed woman.
Many Eminences in Black Fiend Hall knew about Meng Chuan. This information naturally spread among the various factions in the River of Spacetime. Ordinary intelligence revealed that Meng Chuan had become a top Sixth Tribulation Eminence and defeated Lord of Scarlet. Detailed intelligence included detailed information on Meng Chuan’s strength. It would even include Meng Chuan’s means, such as his Essence Soul mystic technique-Pupil of Darkness—and many other aspects. “The Void Trileaf Flower will bloom in an hour. Report to Mountain Lord Moxie first,” said the pudgy figure.

chapters.title: Chapter 675 - Grasping Space
chapters.content:
Chapter 675: Grasping Space
On another layer of the Valley of Spacetime, there was a cave abode that spanned several kilometers in the dark void. Meng Chuan lived here in seclusion.
As Mountain Lord Moxie believed Meng Chuan to be a newly-advanced Sixth Tribulation Eminence only, he wasn’t assigned to guard the area. Hence, it was naturally relaxing for Meng Chuan. More than ten years ago, Meng Chuan shocked everyone after defeating Black Fiend Hall’s Lord of Scarlet. He became much more famous among the experts in the River of Spacetime. But since no newcomers had come recently, the mission assignments didn’t change. Meng Chuan remained very relaxed in the Valley of Spacetime.
“Eastcalm, a new Void Trileaf Flower has been born. It’s your turn. Come over quickly.” A voice sounded in Meng Chuan’s ears.
“Yes, Mountain Lord.” Meng Chuan was overjoyed. He put away the cave abode and immediately rushed to Mountain Lord Moxie’s layer.
I never expected to obtain a Void Trileaf Flower in just over 200 years after coming to the Valley of Spacetime. It’s faster than I expected.
Meng Chuan was rather excited. The growth time of Void Trileaf Flowers was irregular.
White Avian Hall occupied this area. It could produce three to five Void Trileaf Flowers in a century or as slow as having only one appear every two centuries. Previously, Cang Li and Feng Yu had obtained Void Trileaf Flowers one after another. This made Meng Chuan understand that this period was a time when the Void Trileaf Flowers were being born at a relatively fast pace.
Therefore, in order to accumulate more insights, Meng Chuan arranged for his avatars to cultivate in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, where time flowed ten times faster. Most of his Essence Soul’s Origins were gathered there to increase his cultivation efficiency.
If he didn’t make use of the ten-fold faster time flow, it would be too wasteful to use the Void Trileaf Flower if his insights into the spatial law were too shallow.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan arrived at Moxie’s cave abode. Lord Moxie stood there with six members of White Avian Hall standing beside him. They were only embodiments. All ordinary Supremacies could easily produce one embodiment. These Sixth Tribulation Eminences could also send their avatars here with the array formation set up by White Avian Hall. However, the embodiments were very weak.
“Mountain Lord.” Meng Chuan walked over and bowed.
“This is the Void Trileaf Flower. Quickly consume it,” said Moxie. “There’s no difference between consuming it with your body and consuming it with your Essence Soul avatar.”
With that said, a wooden box appeared in his hand. It flew toward Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan reached out and received it. He gently opened the wooden box and saw a Void Trileaf Flower inside. The three leaves were slightly transparent, but the flower was extremely gorgeous. It was breathtakingly beautiful. The flower petals were filled with a beauty that made Meng Chuan’s heart tremble. They contained the beauty of the extreme void.
“Congratulations, Eastcalm.”
“Congratulations, Brother Eastcalm.”
“Congratulations, Brother Eastcalm.”
