The six embodiments smiled and congratulated him. Although they were somewhat envious, they remained calm. After all, they had only arrived at the Valley of Spacetime slightly later than Meng Chuan. If the Trileaf Void Flower grew quickly, they might have their turn in a few decades. Otherwise, it would take 1,000 years at most.
“Use it immediately,” urged Moxie. He was here to ensure that nothing unexpected would happen.
“Alright.”
With a thought, the Power of Essence Soul enveloped the Void Trileaf Flower.
The moment he did so, Meng Chuan sensed his Essence Soul’s instinctive desire. Following this desire, he sucked in a little. The Void Trileaf Flower quickly transformed into a resplendent beam of light that was absorbed by Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar.
“This...” Meng Chuan felt that his Essence Soul avatar immediately changed after absorbing the Void Trileaf Flower’s power. The lepton structure changed naturally.
Just like a seedling that had experienced a drought for a long time, it began to grow after obtaining sweet dew—the power contained within the Void Trileaf Flower was the sweet dew. The changes in Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar’s lepton structure couldn’t be hidden from Meng Chuan—who had grasped the lepton law.
The changes in the Essence Soul structure can increase one’s control over space by so much?
Meng Chuan knew very well how magical the changes in the lepton structure were.
Everything—be they flowing water, soil, or Eighth Tribulation treasures—were built from leptons. Different structures naturally had different wonders.
For example, one of the Origins laws—the Matter law—was the study of the matter leptons’ composition. If he could comprehend the changes brought about by the Void Trileaf Flower, he wouldn’t be far from comprehending a complete spatial law.
Meng Chuan clearly didn’t want to waste time studying the lepton structures. He wanted to make the best use of his time to study the spatial law!
“Every bit of Void Trileaf Flower energy expended is one bit less,” said Moxie. “Treasure these few years well. You can cultivate on this layer of spacetime that I’m guarding. The Valley of Spacetime is also more suitable for studying the spatial law.” With that said, he turned and walked into the cave abode.
“Thank you, Mountain Lord.” Meng Chuan bowed slightly. At the same time, he looked at the six figures around him and said, “Everyone, I’ll be entering seclusion for now.”
“Brother Eastcalm, don’t worry about us.”
“Brother Eastcalm’s cultivation is more important.”
The six said.
Meng Chuan nodded. With a single step, he traveled hundreds of millions of kilometers. He brought out a cave abode and flew into the cave abode before sitting cross-legged in the courtyard.
My control over space?
Meng Chuan felt that everything in the vast void around him could be controlled by him. At that moment, the vast spatial law became much clearer. Before he headed to Holy Mountain of Painting, Meng Chuan had already grasped the spatial law’s three tenets. Furthermore, he had the Void Catalog’s guidance. He had been studying at Holy Mountain of Painting, Ice River Nebula, and the Nine Trials Pagoda’s rotary valve...
Together with his cultivation at Clear Spring Island and the Great Seal Eternal treasure, it could be said that his insights into the spatial law had reached an astonishing level. He felt that he was very close to breaking through, but he was always just a tiny step away.
At this moment, his control over space rapidly increased, allowing Meng Chuan to grasp the spatial law’s true essence vaguely.
It’s that essence.
Meng Chuan suppressed his joy and immediately used this essence to fuse his insights into the spatial law.
...
Six figures stood there and looked in the direction of Meng Chuan’s cave abode.
Boom!
In the sky above Meng Chuan’s cave abode, the void distorted and formed a huge bubble. It was a bubble that was half a million kilometers in size, but its interior space spanned five billion kilometers.
The void bubble was born and destroyed.
Right on the heels of that, the cave abode Meng Chuan was in became dark and unfathomable. He entered a hidden layer of space, and it became darker and darker until he completely disappeared. After a long time, it slowly appeared and became clearer.
“This City Lord Eastcalm is really recklessly using the Void Trileaf Flower’s strength,” said the cyan-clothed woman with a chuckle. “Mountain Lord already reminded him that the Void Trileaf Flower’s energy would deplete with every use. If he uses it sparingly, it can last for several years. For him to use it so wantonly, it will be used up in less than a year.”
“Brother Eastcalm’s talent is rather high. As a newly-advanced Sixth Tribulation Eminence, he has grasped two Sixth Tribulation laws,” said a sword-bearing man with a smile. “However, he’s still too eager. The best way to use the Void Trileaf Flower should be to study the spatial law and completely grasp the spatial law’s three tenets. He should only use it when his foundation is solid enough.”
How can it be easy to comprehend the spatial law’s three tenets? I’ve studied them for tens of thousands of years, but I’ve only grasped Void Domain and Void Control. Therefore, I need to use the Void Trileaf Flower to break through and build the final foundation.
“Brother Yu, you have been studying the spatial law for tens of thousands of years. Brother Eastcalm has only reached the Sixth Tribulation realm recently, so he’s a little rash to use the Void Trileaf Flower now. It’s best if one’s cultivation enters a bottleneck before they seek the use of the Trileaf Flower.”
“That’s right. The Void Trileaf Flower should be used at critical moments.”
The six chatted. The six of them were all top Sixth Tribulation Eminences. They thought highly of themselves and felt that City Lord Eastcalm’s actions were unwise.
After chatting for a while, the six embodiments dispersed.
...
Many spatial phenomena appeared around Meng Chuan’s cave abode.
Three days after consuming the Void Trileaf Flower.
“Hahaha.” Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in the cave abode’s courtyard. He looked up at the dark void and laughed softly. “Wonderful, truly wonderful.”
Cultivation was truly mesmerizing when one completely grasped the law.
He had completely understood the profundities of the vast spatial law.
</di

chapters.title: Chapter 676 - Chaos Hole Strong Force
chapters.content:
Chapter 676: Chaos Hole Strong Force
The spatial law was one of the two cornerstones to the way the universe operated. All life and everything depended on it.
After grasping the power of this cornerstone, Meng Chuan’s perception of the entire universe became completely different.
The spatial law might be inferior to Seventh Tribulation Origins laws, but it gives one a deeper understanding of everything in the universe.
At that moment, Meng Chuan’s understanding of the various Origins laws had reached an extremely high level. This was because these Origins laws were inextricably linked to the spatial law. It was only now that Meng Chuan had the strength to resist a Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
If Realm Ancestor wanted to fish him up again, Meng Chuan could use his absolute control over space to resist him.
Grasping space only establishes my foundation. I still need to grasp the Origins law further before I can be ranked at the peak of my current era.
Meng Chuan was now completely confident. With the spatial law, the lepton law, and the lightning law as a foundation, Meng Chuan was very close to grasping the Chaos Hole law—an Origins law.
Considering his willpower, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World would be able to withstand the Seventh Tribulation law once he grasped it. He would then quickly possess the strength of an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
After grasping the Chaos Hole law, I’ll have to transcend the tribulation soon. Although my willpower isn’t bad, I still need to spend more effort. From today onwards, I should prepare for the seventh Heavenly Tribulation.
The earlier he prepared, the greater his chances of transcending the tribulation. It wasn’t too much to be careful when it came to transcending tribulations.
I’m leaving.
Meng Chuan suddenly stood up and put away his cave abode. With a step, he left this layer of spacetime.
When Mountain Lord Moxie sensed Meng Chuan’s departure, he imagined that Meng Chuan wanted to go elsewhere to cultivate.
Even when he’s traveling, he’s freely using the Void Trileaf Flower’s power. This junior is really wasting treasures.
Mountain Lord Moxie sighed slightly.
Back when he was young and spirited, he had also been this reckless. He had grasped the Origins law—Karma law. His means were unpredictable. Even Seventh Tribulation Eminences were on good terms with him. Few were willing to offend a half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence who had grasped the Karma law.
The spirited him had established the Land Without Karma. He was extremely dazzling in the entire River of Spacetime. However, his old opponent, Origin Realm’s leader, quickly surpassed him. He rose step by step and now had the strength of a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
All of this depressed Mountain Lord Moxie.
“Eastcalm left without a word?” In the Valley of Spacetime, the other members of White Avian Hall sensed Meng Chuan’s departure.
He’s really a loner.
He’s casually using the Void Trileaf Flower’s strength even while traveling? He will regret it when the Void Trileaf Flower’s strength is exhausted.
The six members muttered to themselves. In the past few years in the Valley of Spacetime, they often gathered together. However, Meng Chuan was focused on his cultivation. He only appeared for the first gathering and didn’t appear again.
...
Inside the Nine Trials Pagoda.
In the vast chaos, Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in front of the towering pill furnace. The Power of Essence Soul seeped into the rotary valve.
This is now simple.
After grasping the spatial law, Meng Chuan could clearly understand the vast sea of nine-layered runes. These nine-layered runes were a form of spatial law utilization. After understanding the law, one would naturally be able to see through them from just a brief glance.
I just need to do this to spin open the rotary valve.
Meng Chuan willed it.
Boom! Boom!
The Power of Essence Soul formed two large hands that grabbed both sides of the rotary valve.
“Oh?” The turtle-shelled elder suddenly sat up. He blinked his eyes and looked at the two illusory hands holding the valve.
Humph.
As Meng Chuan activated the nine-layered runes, he exerted strength with his two void hands.
The octagonal rotary valve began to spin very slowly, and the resistance became greater as it spun.
It takes so much effort?
Meng Chuan was astonished. The resistance was so great from just spinning it a little.
Just as he relaxed—
Boom!
The rotary valve turned backward slightly and returned to its original position.
“I never expected you to grasp the spatial law so quickly.” The turtle-shelled elder had already stood up. He smiled and said, “However, cracking the rotary valve’s runic array formation is only one of the requirements. You still need sufficient strength to rotate it fully.”
“The entire rotary valve needs to complete one revolution. The power of your Essence Soul is a little weaker,” said the turtle-shelled elder.
“Sufficient strength?” Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
“If you don’t have sufficient strength, how are you going to kill the enemy?” said the turtle-shelled elder. “The requirement for strength to spin open the rotary valve completely isn’t high. It’s only equivalent to the strength of a normal half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence. If you were at the Physical Body Tribulation realm, you might be able to spin it open. As an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence... you are still lacking in strength.”
Meng Chuan sighed inwardly. Just the second trial’s requirements were exaggerated enough—one had to grasp the spatial law and unleash sufficient strength.
The Dragon Ancestor’s Nine Trials Pagoda had a total of nine trials. Of course, even the Dragon Ancestor himself couldn’t clear the nine trials.
My Essence Soul’s strength is a little weak, much less my physical strength.
Meng Chuan pondered. He had focused on his Essence Soul cultivation system, leaving his body at the Fifth Tribulation realm. It wasn’t of any help to spin open the rotary valve.
I have to learn a mystic technique now,
thought Meng Chuan immediately.
A mystic technique was a special method of using the laws.
Directly using a law was typically very crude. Meng Chuan had just grasped a spatial law, and with his previous accumulation of insights... It wasn’t easy for him to figure out a mystic technique that provided immense strength independently.
Learning the mystic techniques created by predecessors was the fastest.
Archean Eon Realm’s Star Cluster Building had a mystic technique, Chaos Hole Strong Force Art. The Eighth Tribulation-level legacies and mystic techniques left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon were very rare. However, there were still many original copies at the Seventh Tribulation realm.
Many Origins laws had their own strengths.
The Chaos Hole law was very famous for its strength.
For example, the Karma law was rather good for plotting against enemies. Its explosive strength in a head-on clash was naturally far inferior to the Chaos Hole law. The Immeasurable law was another example. It had its own strengths, but it was inferior to the Chaos Hole law and the Matter law when facing enemies head-on.
But in terms of other means, the Chaos Hole law was much inferior to the Karma law and the Immeasurable law.
For example, traveling for a controller of the Chaos Hole law was arduous. Even with a Spacetime Teleportation Talisman, teleportation took some time.
However, the Immeasurable law and the Karma law allowed one to descend to a remote spot in the universe with a mere thought.
Chaos Hole Strong Force Art.
Meng Chuan had read it before, but he had never cultivated it seriously.
Meng Chuan began to cultivate.
It’s still very simple.
Meng Chuan stood in front of the pill furnace. Many of his true bodies and avatars—which were scattered across the universe—worked together to comprehend the Chaos Hole Strong Force Art.
A mystic technique could allow those at lower cultivation realms to learn a portion of a law. Meng Chuan had grasped three laws, so he wasn’t far from completely comprehending the Chaos Hole law. Hence, Meng Chuan naturally found the mystic technique much easier to learn.
Meng Chuan’s attainments in the Chaos Hole Strong Force Art improved by leaps and bounds.
In just an hour, he had reached the Chaos Hole Strong Force Art’s 20th level. His progress significantly slowed down after he cultivated it to the 15th level.
I’ll give it a try.
Meng Chuan realized that his explosive strength had improved greatly.
Condense.
With a thought—
A large amount of Power of Essence Soul formed two large, dark hands with the profundities of the Chaos Hole Strong Force Art. Each hand contained countless runes, like a mysterious Tribulation treasure. Every palm was like a black hole that stirred the surrounding spacetime.
The two dark hands grabbed both sides of the rotary valve simultaneously.
Turn.
With a thought, Meng Chuan suddenly exerted strength.
The octagonal rotary valve was clearly spun with greater force this time. Although the resistance increased as it rotated, Meng Chuan spun it one round in seconds before the rotary valve lodged to a stop.
The turtle-shelled elder smiled when he saw this.
Meng Chuan was delighted.
I succeeded.
Boom!
Through the ventilation hole, one could clearly see dark-red flames rising from the towering furnace.
</di

chapters.title: Chapter 677 - Dragon Ancestors Gift
chapters.content:
Chapter 677: Dragon Ancestor’s Gift
The flames in the towering furnace reflected a glow on Meng Chuan’s face. Meng Chuan stood in front of the furnace, admiring it happily.
Meng Chuan knew himself very well. He was already very satisfied with clearing the second trial.
The third trial?
About half of the Seventh Tribulation Eminences in history couldn’t clear it. There was still a huge gap between him and a true Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
“It’s very rare for a Sixth Tribulation Eminence to clear the second trial,” said the turtle-shelled elder with a nod. “Your foundation is deep enough. You are very close to the Seventh Tribulation realm.”
Only experts who were close to the Seventh Tribulation realm had a chance of transcending the first two trials. It was impossible for them to transcend the first two trials if they lacked in cultivation realm, willpower, and other aspects.
“Do you want to try the third trial?” asked the turtle-shelled elder.
“Although I know I can’t clear it, I have to give it a try,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
The turtle-shelled elder nodded. “The third trial requires you to fly into the furnace through the ventilation hole and experience the burning of the flames for five minutes. As long as you can withstand the flames for five minutes without being destroyed... it will be considered a success. If you die or can’t take it and choose to escape through the ventilation hole, it will be considered a failure.
“If you can’t hold on any longer, quickly escape because I’ll give you a treasure later,” said the turtle-shelled elder with a smile.
“Treasure?” Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up.
A treasure bestowed by the Dragon Ancestor!
Although Ancestral Master Archean Eon was rich, apart from the Eternal treasure he had, he was far inferior to an Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s wealth in every other aspect.
In the River of Spacetime’s history, the Dragon Ancestor was publicly recognized as the wealthiest Eighth Tribulation Eminence! Just the cost of building the Nine Trials Pagoda was enough to belittle all Seventh Tribulation Eminences! The basic materials used to build the Nine Trials Pagoda were only a small portion of its value. The most expensive thing about it was the setting up of the Nine Trials. For example, clearing the so-called ninth trial... supposedly allowed one to attain Eternity. To have such a rumor, it had to be, at least, recognized by many Eighth Tribulation Eminences.
How could such a wealthy Eighth Tribulation Eminence give him a small gift?
“Those who are invited to the Nine Trials Pagoda are all guests of the Dragon Ancestor. The Dragon Ancestor will give them a treasure on their first visit,” said the turtle-shelled elder.
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
Although they were all invited guests, the treasures given by the Dragon Ancestor were of different grades.
Guests who had a chance of reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm, guests who had no hope of reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm, the elderly or the young...
Meng Chuan knew there was a difference.
Back when Ancestral Master Archean Eon entered the Nine Trials Pagoda for the first time, he cleared the third trial. The treasures bestowed by the Nine Trials Pagoda were worth a million cubes. According to Ancestral Master Archean Eon, it’s neither high nor low.
Meng Chuan thought to himself that the Eminences who had been to the Nine Trials Pagoda would also exchange information. He heard that the worst treasures were worth hundreds of thousands of cubes and the ordinary ones were worth a million cubes.
I wonder what treasure the Nine Trials Pagoda will give me.
Meng Chuan was also wondering.
The Dragon Ancestor didn’t appear in this era. The Dragon Ancestor had set the rules for the gifting in advance. The Nine Trials Pagoda’s array spirit only needed to follow the rules.
I’ll first attempt the third trial.
Meng Chuan didn’t think too much about it as he instantly formed another Essence Soul avatar.
The new Essence Soul avatar flew into the furnace through the ventilation hole.
...
Boom!
The furnace’s flames burned terrifyingly. When Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar flew in, he could sense the flames’ terrifying might.
Thankfully, he had already grasped the spatial law. With a thought, he formed an Absolute Space around him.
The Absolute Space suppressed the flames on a spatial level. Furthermore, countless layers of space formed around Meng Chuan. Although it looked like it only spanned ten feet, there were indeed innumerable spatial layers. One moment, it might be trillions of layers, but the next moment, it would split into tens of trillions of layers. These spatial layers would vary with the flames.
Meng Chuan took advantage of the situation. The changes in the spatial layers were to suppress, block, and weaken the flames.
Just Absolute Space alone could easily kill a top Sixth Tribulation Eminence. If he wasn’t willing, those Sixth Tribulation Eminences would never be able to touch Meng Chuan.
This was the difference between the two parties.
A peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence had a status close to that of a half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence. For example, they held a Deputy Patroller Token in White Avian Hall.
I can barely hold on?
Inside the furnace, Meng Chuan could suppress the furnace flames. The flames could only reach three feet away from Meng Chuan.
As expected of the spatial law. With this move, I can fight Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
Meng Chuan sighed inwardly.
When Meng Chuan entered the furnace, the furnace flames were suppressed by Absolute Space at the beginning. However, the flames slowly became stronger as time passed.
Boom!
The dark-red furnace flames intensified as they constantly encroached Meng Chuan.
Although the trillions of spatial layers around Meng Chuan changed accordingly, they were still burned through layer by layer. Even though Meng Chuan used various methods to deal with the flames—flattening them to two dimensions, or compressing the space into a tiny flame of annihilation... the flames’ might became stronger and stronger. Even space was burned to smithereens, becoming the most primitive spatial lepton.
Space was also composed of leptons as well.
Normally, slicing through space was like slicing through a piece of tofu, but the essence of the tofu remained the same.
However, the flames burned space into its lepton cluster state.
How do I block it? I need stronger laws.
Meng Chuan condensed a black protective layer around his body. He tried to use the spatial law, lepton law, and lightning law to form the Chaos Hole’s profundities.
Comprehending an Origins law isn’t possible in a short period of time.
Meng Chuan sensed how lacking he was.
These three laws already covered about 90% of the Chaos Hole law’s profundities. Meng Chuan still needed to accumulate more insights and grasp the remaining profundities. It was relatively easy to accumulate more insights with time.
After that, he would consolidate all his insights!
Combining everything together to form the Chaos Hole law was difficult.
It took him quite some time to gain spatial insights until he reached a threshold and comprehended the spatial law.
Furthermore, I will still be affected by karma at the combination stage.
Meng Chuan still remembered that he had made a karmic promise that he would kill three Sixth Tribulation forbidden creatures when he was at the Sixth Tribulation realm. If he didn’t break through to the Seventh Tribulation realm, he naturally wouldn’t be affected.
But since he was close to the boundary, this karma would begin to obstruct him. It would prevent him from comprehending a Seventh Tribulation law. His future cultivation would be affected. Thus, Meng Chuan had to resolve the karma.
Three Sixth Tribulation forbidden creatures.
Meng Chuan was very confident. After all, a Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature had strength similar to an ordinary Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
Boom!
As he thought of the forbidden creatures, the flames continued to encroach deeper. Meng Chuan was helpless as he watched the resistance put up by Absolute Space weaken.
I can’t hold on any longer.
The flames finally touched the black protective layer on Meng Chuan’s body. The black protective layer was useless as it was still burned through.
The moment it burned through—
Chi—
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar was completely annihilated. Even the lepton cluster dissipated completely.
Clearly, a Lepton Undying Body was nothing compared to the furnace’s fire.
I have to last for five minutes?
Outside the furnace, Meng Chuan’s other Essence Soul avatar watched and sighed.
I only lasted for a minute.
“To clear the third trial, grasping an Origins law is the most basic requirement. Otherwise, it’s impossible for you to withstand it,” said the turtle-shelled elder with a smile. “It’s already very rare for a Sixth Tribulation Eminence like you to last a minute inside.”
Meng Chuan had to admit this.
If one hadn’t comprehended a spatial law, even a Sixth Tribulation Eminence—who had powerful life-preservation means—would be instantly annihilated in the furnace.
“You failed the third trial.” The turtle-shelled elder looked at Meng Chuan. “Do you want to try again, or do you want to give up? If you give up, I can give you treasures according to Dragon Ancestor’s rules.”
“Of course, I’ll give up,” said Meng Chuan.
The earlier he obtained the treasures, the better. After tens of thousands of years, when he was strong enough, the treasures would only be icing on the cake.
The turtle-shelled elder looked at the furnace. With a boom, the rotary valve automatically turned in the opposite direction and returned to its original position. At the same time, the flames in the furnace were completely extinguished.
“Meng Chuan, you’ve cultivated for a total of 5,393 years.” The turtle-shelled elder looked at Meng Chuan. “It’s considered very rare for you to pass the Nine Trials Pagoda’s second trial. According to the rules set by Dragon Ancestor, I can offer you three treasures—from which you shall choose one.”
With that said, the turtle-shelled elder waved his hand.
Three illusory figures appeared in front of him.
The first illusory figure was a crystalline, irregular fragment. Meng Chuan felt an inexplicable fondness for it just by looking at it. He liked it from the bottom of his heart. He felt that this fragment was more beautiful than anything he had ever seen.
“An Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence took the initiative to offend an Eternal existence’s home universe before his death. Perhaps he wanted to personally experience the means left behind by an Eternal existence,” said the turtle-shelled elder. “In the end... that Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s Essence Soul shattered into many fragments, and he died instantly. This fragment... is an Essence Soul fragment left behind by that Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence after he died.”
Meng Chuan found it unbelievable.
He died despite his Essence Soul fragments still being present?
Even Meng Chuan could survive as long as a sliver of his Essence Soul remained.
“You still don’t know much about the life and death of Eighth Tribulation Eminences since they are beyond the River of Spacetime,” said the turtle-shelled elder. “Even if their bodies and Essence Souls are intact, Eternal existences can still kill them.”
Meng Chuan fell into deep thought.
Eternal?
The Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence probably knew how terrifying an Eternal was. However, he was close to the end of his lifespan. If he didn’t give it a try, he wouldn’t have a chance. To personally experience the means left behind by an Eternal existence was a calamity, but it was also an opportunity to break through to become Eternal.
“The second treasure.” The turtle-shelled elder pointed at the second illusory figure.
The second illusory figure had three rings: black, white, and gray.
“You should be following the Chaos Hole lineage. This is an Eighth Tribulation treasure array formation that uses the Chaos Hole law as its core—the Tri-Ring Chaos Hole Array,” said the turtle-shelled elder. “Each Tri-Ring treasure is an Eighth Tribulation treasure worth a million cubes. It’s even rarer when combined. Most of the weapons and treasures used by Seventh Tribulation Eminences aren’t as powerful as this.”
Meng Chuan’s eyes burned. This was the strongest treasure he had ever seen in the Chaos Hole lineage. Eternal Tower wouldn’t sell such an item to outsiders.
“The third and final treasure.” The turtle-shelled elder pointed at the final illusory figure. It was a token. “A rare treasure—Spacetime Token. It can only be used when one has grasped a spatial law,” said the turtle-shelled elder.
</di

chapters.title: Chapter 678 - Spacetime Token
chapters.content:
Chapter 678: Spacetime Token
A rare treasure?
Meng Chuan carefully looked at the token phantom. The token was like amber that had an inner luster to it.
“When Dragon Ancestor left our universe and was out roaming, he experienced countless fortuitous encounters. He once discovered a pocket universe about the size of a river system,” said the turtle-shelled elder with a smile. “A miniature River of Spacetime has already formed in this pocket universe. As it’s too small, the laws in the small universe were incomplete. It didn’t give birth to any living beings. Dragon Ancestor refined this pocket universe and refined it into this Spacetime Token. Dragon Ancestor’s refinement method was extremely profound. Just controlling the power of the pocket universe requires one to have grasped the spatial law.”
Meng Chuan’s heart stirred.
A pocket universe?
Among the treasures left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon, there was also a rare treasure—a pocket universe. However, this pocket universe was only suitable for storage and cultivating inside. At the same time, it was much smaller than Dragon Ancestor’s. It was priced at 500,000 cubes in his homeworld’s treasure vault.
The Dragon Ancestor’s one had been refined into a rare treasure, a Spacetime Token. It had some special uses.
“With the Spacetime Token, you can use the pocket universe’s power to release a spacetime domain,” said the turtle-shelled elder. “A spacetime domain is much stronger than your Absolute Space. This is also the only move that it can use against enemies.
“The Spacetime Token’s other use is to travel through spacetime. One can head to any place in a River of Spacetime in a single step. In regards to escaping, it’s better than most Eighth Tribulation treasures,” said the turtle-shelled elder. “To prevent the Spacetime Token from traveling through spacetime, one either has to grasp the laws of time and space, or they have to rely on an Eternal treasure.”
Meng Chuan got a clear understanding of the token.
Among the current Seventh Tribulation Eminences, only Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had grasped the laws of time and space. These two had extremely high statuses. They wouldn’t easily take action.
As for Eternal treasures? Seventh Tribulation Eminences would be trying their best to hide it, so who would dare to reveal them publicly?
It’s indeed better than many Eighth Tribulation treasures for escaping.
Meng Chuan was impressed.
For example, a Spacetime Teleportation Talisman cost 3,000 cubes. There were also Eighth Tribulation treasures specially used for spacetime teleportation. By using them, one could teleport through spacetime repeatedly.
However, spacetime teleportation took time—albeit an extremely short period of time. To a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, this amount of time was enough for them to attack multiple times.
On the contrary, a Spacetime Token could travel through spacetime with a pocket universe’s power. It could travel to any place in the River of Spacetime in a single step. This made it much better. Therefore, it was much more valuable than an Eighth Tribulation treasure for spacetime teleportation.
“Choose any one of the three treasures.” The turtle-shelled elder smiled at Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan fell into a dilemma.
It was too difficult to choose. All of them were very attractive, but Meng Chuan knew that such treasures were just a casual gift from Dragon Ancestor.
“Senior Bei, can you give me some advice? Which one suits me the best?” Although Meng Chuan had vaguely made a decision, he still asked. After all, his knowledge was probably inferior to this ancient array spirit.
The turtle-shelled elder pondered for a moment and said, “The first item—the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation fragment—can’t directly increase your strength, but you can study it carefully. Perhaps you won’t gain much, but it might help you reach the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm.
“The second treasure is the most practical. When you reach the Seventh Tribulation realm, this will be the most suitable weapon for you. It’s extremely powerful in a head-on battle. Furthermore, it includes the method of combining the Chaos Hole law with other Origins laws... This Tri-Ring Chaos Hole Array provides the clearest guidance.
“The third treasure will increase your strength the most when you are at the Sixth Tribulation realm. This is because it can immediately allow you to possess a spacetime domain, greatly boosting your strength. But once you reach the Seventh Tribulation realm, the spacetime domain won’t be of much help. However, the Spacetime Token’s escape technique is extremely precious. It’s enough to make Seventh Tribulation Eminences covet it,” said the turtle-shelled elder.
“It’s also beneficial to your cultivation. You can carefully study the profundities of the fusion of time and space from it. It’s very rare to find something that can match the Spacetime Token in terms of the profundities of time and space,” said the turtle-shelled elder. “Dragon Ancestor only succeeded in refining it because he used a miniature River of Spacetime as the source. If you study it, it will benefit and help you figure out a temporal law in the future.”
“What needs to be said has been said. It’s up to you,” said the turtle-shelled elder.
Meng Chuan looked at one of the illusory figures and pointed at it. “I’ll take this.”
“Spacetime Token.” The turtle-shelled elder nodded. “Wait a moment. I’ll get it for you.”
Meng Chuan had thought about it carefully.
Tri-Ring Chaos Hole Array? A combat treasure wasn’t that important to his cultivation. He could choose a weaker Eighth Tribulation treasure.
Furthermore, he had many Essence Soul avatars. There was no need for him to fight others head-on. Even if an Essence Soul avatar was shattered, he could recover it with a thought. The ability to engage in endless combat was the greatest deterrence that Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminences had. Origin Realm’s leader relied on this to fight Six Directions Heaven and White Avian Hall repeatedly.
An Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation fragment needed to be carefully studied. Who knew how much he would gain from it?
Compared to this, the aid provided by the rare treasure—Spacetime Token—was very direct.
For a long time, traversing spacetime was one of Meng Chuan’s greatest weaknesses. This was because the Chaos Hole law wasn’t good at this aspect. Even if he comprehended a second Origins law in the future, it might not be good for traveling either. For example, Ancestral Master Archean Eon wasn’t good at traveling through spacetime. This was because most of the Origins laws didn’t excel at traversing spacetime.
The Spacetime Token could make up for Meng Chuan’s weakness and help him comprehend the laws of time.
When he reached the Seventh Tribulation realm, the temporal law would be his greatest goal.
Boom!
The void in front of him distorted as an item appeared out of thin air.
It was a token. The token was amber in color. Upon closer inspection, one could see a vast galaxy hidden within.
“Meng Chuan, keep it well. Most Seventh Tribulation Eminences will be envious of this treasure,” said the turtle-shelled elder with a smile.
Meng Chuan reached out to receive it. The moment he held it, he infused his Power of Essence Soul.
His consciousness entered a vast universe. The river of stars was resplendent. It was slightly smaller than his homeworld, Three Bay River System, but still the size of an average river system. It already had a miniature River of Spacetime that belonged to this pocket universe.
Chains were everywhere in the River of Spacetime, and each chain contained countless runes.
A total of 9,999 chains controlled the miniature River of Spacetime completely. Using it, he could utilize the entire pocket universe’s powers.
Meng Chuan activated the runes on the chains.
Dragon Ancestor’s means are indeed unfathomable. He can actually control a miniature River of Spacetime completely.
Meng Chuan tried to activate it.
Buzz—
The release of the pocket universe’s power was spacetime in nature.
Spacetime domain!
As he was in the Nine Trials Pagoda, Meng Chuan could only have its range extend to 1,000 feet. He couldn’t see the spacetime domain with the naked eye.
It’s even bigger than Absolute Space.
Meng Chuan was instantly immersed in the spacetime domain. It was too shocking.
When will I be capable of producing such a domain with my own means?
He knew that the present era’s two most dazzling figures could do so. Furthermore, it was even more powerful than the pocket universe’s power that came with incomplete laws.
“How does it feel?” asked the turtle-shelled elder with a smile.
Meng Chuan put away the Spacetime Token and nodded. “I’d like to thank Dragon Ancestor for the gift. I will definitely remember this favor.”
“Dragon Ancestor doesn’t require anything in return,” said the turtle-shelled elder with a smile. “It’s mostly to help his home universe’s descendants. If you can reach the Eighth Tribulation realm in the future, you might be able to help Dragon Ancestor.”
He was just making a casual remark.
Dragon Ancestor had given away many treasures over the generations, but how many Eighth Tribulation Eminences had been born in the River of Spacetime’s history?
With the turtle-shelled elder’s experience, it was unlikely for a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence like Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star to reach the Eighth Tribulation realm even if there were hundreds of them.
The difference between a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence and an Eighth Tribulation Eminence might seem like a single step, but making that step was extremely difficult.
“By the way, the Nine Trials Pagoda has eight exits. They are located in eight different river zones.” The turtle-shelled elder waved his hand, and eight river zones appeared. “Choose an exit. I’ll send you out.”
Meng Chuan glanced at the exits and pointed at a spot. “Taidong River Zone.”
...
Nine Trials River Zone.
A gray-robed man sat cross-legged on a barren planet.
Yuchang was Guild Master Darkstar’s trusted aide. He was good at the karmic lineage. He wasn’t participating in the battle and was only here to help lock onto the target through karma.
Huh?
Yuchang’s eyebrows twitched as he looked up.
He clearly sensed the disappearance of City Lord Eastcalm’s avatar in Nine Trials River Zone. Following that, one of City Lord Eastcalm’s avatars appeared out of thin air in Taidong River Zone.
“City Lord Eastcalm has left the Nine Trials Pagoda and appeared at one of the Nine Trials Pagoda’s eight exits—Taidong River Zone.” Yuchang immediately reported to Guild Master Darkstar.
Yuchang sighed inwardly.
A very talented Sixth Tribulation Eminence was about to be plundered.
With Darkstar’s arrangements, it was almost impossible for a Sixth Tribulation Eminence to escape.
</di

chapters.title: Chapter 679 - Darkstar Guilds Attack
chapters.content:
Chapter 679: Darkstar Guild’s Attack
A black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan appeared in a dark void of Taidong River Zone.
I’m out.
Meng Chuan looked around him as his consciousness quickly spread out through the spatial fluctuations.
It dripped like a drop of water, and a ripple spread out in all directions. The area affected was relatively small. However, the countless droplets formed countless ripples. The neighboring circles interfered with each other, and the range of the ripples increased exponentially.
The spatial influence was much more complicated.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan carefully sensed the area around him as the range expanded rapidly. It spread across a river system, and the further it went, the more blurry it became. He could only sense its general outline.
The limit of what I can vaguely sense is a river zone.
Meng Chuan vaguely sensed the 3,257 river systems in Taidong River Zone.
Spacetime Token.
With the help of the rare treasure, the Spacetime Token, Meng Chuan sent a wisp of his Power of Essence Soul into the Spacetime Token’s profound array formation. Only by grasping the spatial law could he barely use it. With a thought, the 9,999 chains in the array formation immediately triggered the miniature River of Spacetime. The spacetime power in the pocket universe rippled out from the Spacetime Token.
Whoosh.
The spacetime powers in the pocket universe resonated with the River of Spacetime in the outside world.
The vast River of Spacetime had countless tributaries. Everything was reflected in his heart.
Is this the entire universe?
Meng Chuan was somewhat shocked.
Although he had seen the Spacetime Dominion Map recorded by Ancestral Master Archean Eon, the feeling of seeing the entire universe with his own eyes was thousands of times more shocking.
All river systems in the river zone were reflected in his heart. Meng Chuan could vaguely sense the places that emitted powerful energies in a river system: Supreme Yang Star, Supreme Yin Star, Dark Chaos Hole, inhabited worlds, cave abodes with powerful array formations, perilous lands in the universe, ancient ruins...
Powerful lifeforms like Fifth Tribulation Eminences could also sense them, but it was difficult to sense the weaker energies.
More than 100 river systems have been completely sealed off. Even I can’t enter?
Meng Chuan realized that there were more than 100 of such river systems in the universe. They were protected by spacetime barriers, making them impregnable. He couldn’t penetrate them even with the Spacetime Token. He could only observe them from afar.
They seem to be related to Eighth Tribulation Eminences.
Meng Chuan quickly discovered something.
Nine of these sealed and protected river systems are related to Dragon Ancestor. One is related to Daolord Evodia, and three are related to Phoenix Ancestor. As expected of Eighth Tribulation Eminences. They make an entire river system their own territory. Even Seventh Tribulation Eminences can’t approach them.
Senior Fei Yu had said that anyone below the Eighth Tribulation realm wouldn’t be able to find his homeworld, Fei Yu World.
Meng Chuan now had a clearer understanding of what he meant.
Oh?
Meng Chuan looked ahead.
An elder with a walking stick appeared out of thin air. Following that, four figures appeared beside him.
An elder with a walking stick, a handsome man, a treant, a winged woman, and a water lifeform.
“Darkstar Guild?” Meng Chuan recognized them at a glance.
The five people in front of him were all famous top Sixth Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime. Furthermore, they belonged to the Darkstar Guild.
The Darkstar Guild was very different from Black Fiend Hall. Black Fiend Hall was a massive faction with a long history. They had many members and wreaked havoc wantonly. They plundered everywhere, but they tried their best to avoid Sixth and Seventh Tribulation Eminences. They were like a pack of vicious wolves that hunted everywhere, only to avoid powerful enemies. Only by angering them would they surround and attack powerful enemies. However, the Darkstar Guild was different. The Darkstar Guild was more like a venomous snake. They didn’t attack easily.
Once they attacked, it was all for the sake of a great harvest. A venomous snake would flick out its tongue and deliver a single killing strike.
Their targets were mainly Sixth Tribulation Eminences. For the sake of treasures, the Darkstar Guild would even attack Seventh Tribulation Eminences at times. Of course, that was when Guild Master Darkstar personally took action.
I’
ve been targeted by the Darkstar Guild? They arrived just five seconds after I left the Nine Trials Pagoda. From the looks of it, they have been monitoring me through karma.
Meng Chuan immediately came to a realization. He could sense the universe through the Spacetime Token. It took a long time to describe, but it was actually just a moment, enough for the Darkstar Guild to arrive.
“Die!” The moment the five Darkstar Eminences appeared, they unleashed their killer moves.
A massive illusory array formation spanned five billion kilometers. The five Eminences attacked.
The handsome man had already transformed into a dazzling golden beam of light. This beam of light was billions of times more dazzling than the sun. Even an ordinary Tribulation Eminence could see it with their naked eyes.
The moment the golden light shone into their eyes, ordinary Tribulation Eminences would be reduced to dust. This was the power that came from fusing the Law of Light and the Law of Metal. The dazzling golden light had already spread through the array formation, illuminating countless runes on the array formation.
There was no emotion in the treant’s eyes. As he stood there, dazzling lightning erupted. The treant’s body—filled with vitality—was surrounded by lightning. Green lightning fused with the array formation.
The winged woman spread her fiery-red wings. The flames on her wings wantonly erupted as a violent wind howled. The might of wind and fire gathered as the power of wind and fire spread into the array.
Around the water lifeform was boundless black water. Copious amounts of black water fused with the array formation and spread out along the runes.
The elder with the walking stick gently tapped the walking stick in his hand. Thick, turbid gas appeared in every corner of the array formation that spanned five billion kilometers. After the other four Eminences’ powers fused with the array formation, they perfectly fused with the turbid gas. Thus, the Land of Samsara descended.
Rumble~
Impressive.
Meng Chuan sighed in amazement as he looked at his surroundings. A 50-billion-kilometer area had already transformed into a Land of Samsara. The turbulent Samsara Array Formation surrounded him, suppressing him as it attempted to crush him.
The pressure in the Land of Samsara was extremely terrifying. At the Sixth Tribulation realm, only peak Sixth Tribulation Eminences could withstand it.
Meng Chuan was clearly at the peak of the Sixth Tribulation realm.
Hum.
With Meng Chuan at the center, the surrounding 50,000 kilometers resisted the Land of Samsara’s pressure.
Absolute Space!
A spatial law controller had a limited range if they wanted to maintain maximum control over space. A 50,000-kilometer radius was the limit. If the range was greater, their control over space would constantly decrease.
“What?”
“He blocked it?”
The walking stick elder, the handsome man, the treant, the winged woman, and the churning black water felt their hearts palpitate.
Only when the five of them joined forces could they unleash Land of Samsara! This allowed the five of them to fight a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence together. Their team was also one of the Darkstar Guild’s core teams. They originally believed that, even if City Lord Eastcalm didn’t die in the Land of Samsara with his Undying Body, he would be crushed into a lepton cluster and lose the ability to resist. Who knew that he could stand still and block the Land of Samsara’s suppression?
They had even planned for a scenario where City Lord Eastcalm had made preparations. He might strike first and use the Pupil of Darkness to ambush one of them. The other four could barely form a Land of Samsara. Even though their strength would be halved, it was enough to deal with City Lord Eastcalm.
Boom!
The Land of Samsara and Absolute Space collided. Booms constantly rang out, and Absolute Space was at a slight disadvantage.
But the controller of the spatial law had unpredictable movement techniques. He could fight them head-on.
“It’s Absolute Space!”
“Oh no, retreat!” The five of them knew that something was amiss. Their sneak attack was aimed at a top Sixth Tribulation Eminence, not a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
Although they didn’t understand why a newly-advanced Sixth Tribulation Eminence like City Lord Eastcalm had grasped the spatial law, they knew that retreating was the wisest choice. This was because the five of them only had such strength when working together. A single flaw would result in them being defeated one by one.
As for peak Sixth Tribulation Eminences, they could perfectly grasp the situation. If they continued fighting, the five of them would only be at a disadvantage.
Furthermore, they had long known that City Lord Eastcalm had an Essence Soul mystic technique—Pupil of Darkness.
However, they realized that something was amiss. Meng Chuan had already used the Pupil of Darkness. For utmost confidence, he didn’t attack the entire group. Instead, he targeted the handsome man—who had transformed into a golden beam of light.
It’s the Pupil of Darkness.
Just as the handsome man was about to retreat, a pair of dark eyes appeared in his mind.
In the past, the weak couldn’t look straight at him when he was in his golden light form. If they did, they would be reduced to ashes.
This time, he didn’t want to see the pair of eyes. However, he couldn’t hide from them. The pair of dark eyes drilled into his heart like a bottomless abyss. His consciousness couldn’t resist sinking into it.
“No—” The handsome man struggled with all his might, but he was no longer able to continue powering the array formation as he sank into oblivion.
The Land of Samsara’s array formation lost one person.
</di

chapters.title: Chapter 680 - Going Too Far!
chapters.content:
Chapter 680: Going Too Far!
One wrong step led to many mistakes.
If they knew that their target was a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence, even a Seventh Tribulation Eminence would have to consider the assault carefully.
According to their understanding, City Lord Eastcalm had been a Fifth Tribulation Eminence not long ago. He had joined the Cang Alliance and established an Eternal Tower branch in Three Bay River System. It hadn’t been long since he became a newly-advanced Sixth Tribulation Eminence. He relied on his relationship with Hall Lord Blazing Sun to cut the queue and head to the Valley of Spacetime.
Although it was later revealed that this newly-advanced Sixth Tribulation Eminence had the strength of a top Sixth Tribulation Eminence and had an extremely powerful Essence Soul mystic technique, they never expected that he could grasp the spatial law and reach the peak of the Sixth Tribulation realm in just 200 years!
That was the spatial law! How could one easily grasp one of the two cornerstones of the universe’s operations?
Although there were ways to accelerate time, one’s cultivation focused on opportunities. For example, Holy Mountain of Painting, Clear Spring Island, Fiend Mountain... Many treasured lands couldn’t accelerate time. Places with time acceleration were limited to special places. For example, in a mystic realm or a Chaos Hole’s depths. If one used this time on many rare lands in the universe, their cultivation efficiency would be higher.
In order not to waste the Void Trileaf Flower and accumulate his insights, Meng Chuan took advantage of time acceleration. Even so, he had only reached the Sixth Tribulation realm after about 2,000 years.
In this era, only a handful of people could grasp the spatial law in such a short period of time.
It’s over.
As the handsome man’s consciousness sank, he understood that he had failed. Without his help, the Land of Samsara array formation’s strength decreased drastically. It couldn’t suppress a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
Meng Chuan took a step and arrived beside the handsome man.
How can a newly-advanced Sixth Tribulation Eminence grasp the spatial law?
The handsome man could sense an unstoppable force seeping into his body from every corner of the void. Even the space in his body was shattering. The space that his body relied on to survive was destroying him.
He didn’t have an Undying Body technique. Under Absolute Space, his body was instantly destroyed.
...
Spatial law?
A gray-robed man was hidden in the dark void. He was none other than Guild Master Darkstar.
He was the one who had ordered this operation.
Darkstar eyed the treasures that Dragon Ancestor had given Meng Chuan. He was worried that City Lord Eastcalm would flee quickly and escape with a Spacetime Teleportation Talisman. Therefore, he secretly followed the team. When the team set up the array formation, he had also set up an array formation that isolated spacetime. Meng Chuan couldn’t escape even if he activated a Spacetime Teleportation Talisman.
Spacetime Teleportation Talismans were very brilliant at escaping. They could utilize time and space to an extremely high degree. Most Seventh Tribulation Eminences found it difficult to intercept them. Of course, when Sixth Tribulation Eminences encountered Seventh Tribulation Eminences, they were usually instantly captured alive. They didn’t have time to use any treasures.
Guild Master Darkstar—who had been carrying out sneak attacks for a long time—had an array formation that isolated spacetime. Furthermore, he had sufficient attainments in spacetime. Even Seventh Tribulation Eminences found it difficult to escape the array formation he set up. They could only fight him in the array formation.
This Meng Chuan has only cultivated for about 5,000 years, yet he has actually grasped the spatial law?
Darkstar found it unbelievable.
He could tell at a glance that City Lord Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, was over 5,000 years old.
Top Sixth Tribulation Eminences at such an age were very rare. However, it wasn’t surprising to Darkstar. After all, Meng Chuan had been invited by the Nine Trials Pagoda. It meant that Meng Chuan was naturally somewhat special.
However, a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence at 5,000 years of age was very terrifying! Such talent had already exceeded many Seventh Tribulation Eminences. It was comparable to Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star when they were young.
For him to be such a young peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence, the treasures bestowed by the Nine Trials Pagoda must be very precious.
A strange color suffused Darkstar’s eyes, and his greed intensified.
Huh?
Darkstar’s expression changed.
This was because Meng Chuan had instantly dealt a fatal blow. With a single step, he arrived beside the handsome man. Following that, the handsome man was reduced to dust. As a spatial law controller, Meng Chuan attacked too quickly. Even Darkstar didn’t have time to stop him.
You’ve lost your chance to escape.
Darkstar didn’t care too much about it. After all, he was only a Sixth Tribulation subordinate’s avatar. He silently punched out.
...
By the time Meng Chuan took a step and arrived in front of the handsome man, the handsome man was already annihilated.
This was how a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence could completely crush a top Sixth Tribulation Eminence. The other four top Sixth Tribulation Eminences were alarmed and furious. The elder with a walking stick began to activate a Spacetime Teleportation Talisman.
Huh?
Meng Chuan’s expression changed as he turned his head.
A gray-robed man suddenly appeared 50,000 kilometers away from Meng Chuan. This was the closest spot outside Absolute Space. Under the gray robe, he could see a black stone head and a pair of cold eyes.
The gray-robed man punched out. His fist was also made of black rock, and it looked ordinary. When the black rock fist came crashing down, Absolute Space shattered layer by layer.
Guild Master Darkstar.
Meng Chuan jolted.
Guild Master Darkstar had established a top faction in the River of Spacetime single-handedly. His Darkstar Guild had attracted many Sixth Tribulation Eminences. He had even attacked half-step Seventh Tribulation and Seventh Tribulation Eminences repeatedly.
He had offended many experts, but he remained fine! This was because... Darkstar was truly very powerful.
Darkstar had grasped the Matter law—which was known as the strongest law of the body! His body was the strongest weapon! After grasping the Matter law, he could combine leptons into many forms. In a head-on battle, he would become extremely terrifying.
Even Realm Ancestor could only rely on his high cultivation realm to toy with Guild Master Darkstar. It was difficult for him to defeat him head-on.
The Immeasurable law and the Matter law represented two extremes.
One had an immeasurable body that was scattered across the universe. The other remained difficult to destroy despite being condensed in front of the opponent.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan immediately retreated.
Darkstar took a step forward almost at the same time. He remained close to Meng Chuan’s Absolute Space.
“It’s Guild Master.”
“Guild Master is here.” The other four Sixth Tribulation Eminences heaved sighs of relief. The elder with a walking stick—who fled the fastest—had already activated the Spacetime Teleportation Talisman. His heart immediately ached.
My talisman!
The Spacetime Teleportation Talisman turned to dust, but the teleportation failed.
“Oh?” The walking stick elder was taken aback.
Spacetime teleportation failed?
Meng Chuan—who had been dodging time and time again—also noticed this scene.
He really is good at dodging.
Darkstar sneered. He was indeed not good at domains. Although he had grasped the spatial law and both sides had Absolute Space, he still couldn’t stop Meng Chuan from dodging.
Boom!
Guild Master Darkstar’s body suddenly dissipated and vanished.
Meng Chuan’s expression changed as he looked up.
An exceedingly towering black stone giant appeared in the void. He was extremely massive, and his eyes were much larger than a Supreme Yang Star.
“If you have what it takes, continue fleeing. Try escaping from my grasp.” The towering black stone giant’s gigantic black stone palm covered the area.
This palm spanned more than 5 billion kilometers, completely enveloping the spacetime array formation that Darkstar had secretly set up.
No matter how Meng Chuan fled, he was within the spacetime array formation’s range!
Darkstar struck out with his palm! Everything within the array formation was within his palm.
Other Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminences needed to spend a large number of precious treasures to cultivate their bodies. However, Seventh Tribulation Eminences who grasped the Matter law could use leptons to construct their bodies with a thought. They didn’t need any treasures.
It could be big or small, extremely firm or extremely soft.
He’s finished.
When the elder with the walking stick and the other Sixth Tribulation Eminences saw this, they couldn’t see any possibility of the peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence resisting.
A peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence might be able to exchange ten strikes with a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, but they were still unable to resist.
“Guild Master Darkstar, you are going too far!”
A terrifying fluctuation erupted from Meng Chuan.
Boom—
In an instant, the shockwaves spread out in all directions. The confident four in the distance were reduced to dust.
</di

chapters.title: Chapter 681 - Taking Action at the Critical Moment!
chapters.content:
Chapter 681: Taking Action at the Critical Moment!
This was the only offensive move Meng Chuan had obtained from the Nine Trials Pagoda—the Spacetime Token. It was called Spacetime Domain.
One had to grasp the spatial law before they could use the Spacetime Token to cast it. The Spacetime Domain they formed was much stronger than Absolute Space. It was comparable to a Seventh Tribulation domain. Even if it expanded to 5 billion kilometers or 50 billion kilometers, it could still maintain extremely terrifying might.
It was just like how Guild Master Darkstar could instantly transform into a towering giant. A slap covered tens of billions of kilometers wide. Seventh Tribulation Eminences could have terrifying might with every move they made, but their range of influence was also vast.
“No—”
“The Samsara Array Formation!”
The moment the elder with the walking stick and the other three were destroyed by the impact, they didn’t care about their avatars’ destruction or the lost weapons and treasures. However, their hearts ached for the array formation.
The Samsara Array Formation’s full name was Ten Directions Samsara Array Formation. It was an Eighth Tribulation array formation treasure. It was specially bestowed to the core team under the Darkstar Guild. Guild Master Darkstar had nurtured a total of three core teams. They were either bestowed Eighth Tribulation treasures or special treasures. They were teams that could unleash strength comparable to a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
As for sending a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence to take action? If a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence wanted to pledge allegiance to anyone, they would do so with Hall Lord White Avian, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star, and company. It would be very difficult for Guild Master Darkstar to command them. Although he had some peak Sixth Tribulation Eminences and half-step Seventh Tribulation allies, he would have to split the benefits if he deployed them.
Darkstar was clearly unwilling to do so.
The stronger one was in the entire River of Spacetime, the more arrogant they could be. They wouldn’t easily pledge their allegiance to people.
For example, below Hall Lord White Avian were three Seventh Tribulation Eminences and seven half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences. But there were only two who were truly willing to follow Hall Lord White Avian—Deputy Hall Lord Blazing Sun and Deputy Hall Lord Azure Dragon.
Of course, if an Eighth Tribulation Eminence were to appear in this era one day, Seventh Tribulation Eminences would definitely take the initiative to pledge their allegiance to him.
However, Eighth Tribulation Eminences—who were beyond the River of Spacetime—pursued different things from these Seventh Tribulation Eminences. There was no need for them to recruit a Seventh Tribulation follower.
My array formation!
Upon seeing this scene, Darkstar immediately wanted to snatch the array formation. He had given it to his team, and the team only had the right to use it.
Even though he had been launching sneak attacks for a long time and had accumulated some Eighth Tribulation treasures, causing him to be considered rich among Seventh Tribulation Eminences, the loss of an Eighth Tribulation array formation treasure still made his heart ache!
After all, apart from the ones he gave to his subordinates, he only had five Eighth Tribulation treasures. Each one of them represented the crystallization of an Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s insights. They were greatly beneficial to his cultivation.
Whoosh.
Darkstar wanted to snatch the Samsara Formation.
But with just a thought, Meng Chuan used his Spacetime Domain to store the treasures left behind by the elder with a walking stick and company.
He snatched the array formation? His domain isn’t Absolute Space.
Darkstar stared at Meng Chuan with his massive eyes. He was reeling in anxiety, but he had some guesses.
It’s impossible for an Essence Soul avatar to leave his homeworld with a precious treasure. It should be a treasure bestowed by the Nine Trials Pagoda. It’s probably a treasure worth a million cubes. It has greatly improved his domain. However, these are all mine.
Guild Master Darkstar suppressed his anxiety as his gigantic palm pressed down on the area where the array formation was.
...
Although it took some time to describe, Meng Chuan had instantly killed the remaining four Sixth Tribulation Eminences with his Spacetime Domain. After snatching the treasure, he faced a dire situation.
He looked up into the sky and saw the towering palm descend.
Buzz—
The Spacetime Domain blasted out in all directions, but the Spacetime Domain—which spanned five billion kilometers—was isolated. The Spacetime Domain couldn’t go any further.
I can’t destroy this array formation with just my Spacetime Domain. I have to use the Spacetime Token’s other feature to escape through spacetime.
Meng Chuan understood this point.
However, Guild Master Darkstar has set up an isolation array formation. If I were to escape through spacetime, all the Seventh Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime will know that I have a rare treasure that allows me to escape through the void.
Of the Spacetime Token’s two features, although the Spacetime Domain was powerful, a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence could unleash similar might when using a domain-type Eighth Tribulation treasure.
The other feature—Escape—was much more powerful. In this era, only Hall Lord White Avian, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star, or a Seventh Tribulation Eminence could intercept him using an Eternal treasure! This was the most precious aspect of the Spacetime Token.
If Meng Chuan exposed this... he was bound to attract many Seventh Tribulation Eminences’ attention.
Boom!
A huge, black stone palm came enveloping downward. It entered the array formation’s range and collided with the Spacetime Domain, meeting a powerful spatial resistance.
Originally, Darkstar could have crushed Meng Chuan in seconds. However, the Spacetime Domain caused the black stone palm to slow down significantly. The spacetime around it became more stable, and its speed became even slower.
Bam! Bam! Bam!
The gigantic palm pressed down as the Spacetime Domain resisted. Every inch of spacetime was shattering.
A domain is ultimately a domain.
Darkstar’s eyes were filled with disdain.
In a head-on clash, he was considered extremely powerful among Seventh Tribulation Eminences. To resist him using a mere domain? It was ultimately lacking.
Boom!
Wherever the palm passed, spacetime exploded and shattered.
Meng Chuan—who would’ve been killed in a few seconds—managed to slow down the palm’s speed with his Spacetime Domain. It would take the fatal blow nearly 30 seconds to be dealt.
However, Meng Chuan had nowhere to escape within the array formation.
Block!
Meng Chuan’s Power of Essence Soul formed two dark hands with the Chaos Hole Strong Force Art in an attempt to block.
Pa~
It was as though an ant had raised its two limbs to block an ancient giant’s stomp. Under the black stone palm’s pressure, Meng Chuan’s two dark hands—formed by his mystic technique—were instantly destroyed. The difference was too great.
Buzz.
Meng Chuan also tried using the Pupil of Darkness, but even with the Power of Essence Soul, he couldn’t penetrate the other party’s body. A body formed from the Matter law was too powerful!
I can’t block it at all. I can’t injure him at all either.
Meng Chuan was powerless. Despite using all his available means, Meng Chuan was unable to make a difference against his opponent’s massive, crushing palm at all. Against a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, he couldn’t injure his opponent at all. Even the Spacetime Token was only able to stall for time.
The difference is too great.
Meng Chuan felt powerless.
Ordinary Sixth Tribulation Eminences and even top Sixth Tribulation Eminences were unable to resist Seventh Tribulation Eminences. They were captured alive before they could even react!
Meng Chuan could resist and even stall for time, but so what? If not for the rare treasure—Spacetime Token—he could only choose to self-destruct his avatar.
Guild Master Darkstar is really sinister and shameless. It’s one thing for a Seventh Tribulation Eminence to scheme against a Sixth Tribulation Eminence like me and send his subordinates. However, he actually ambushed me as a Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
Meng Chuan had long heard of Guild Master Darkstar’s reputation. Guild Master Darkstar cared about his reputation, but he was sinister and shameless when facing his ambush target.
Very few people in the River of Spacetime had the right to make Darkstar personally take action. Therefore, many Eminences had never seen his true appearance.
For example, Guild Master Darkstar had originally planned on having his subordinates attack Meng Chuan.
Very few Sixth Tribulation Eminences had been personally ambushed by Guild Master Darkstar. Hence, he could still maintain his reputation as a Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
Shameless.
Meng Chuan cursed inwardly.
Sneak attacks and plundering were shameless enough. It was even more shameless for a Seventh Tribulation Eminence to ambush a Sixth Tribulation Eminence. It was an act of bullying.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Although the Spacetime Domain tried its best to stabilize spacetime, spacetime continued to shatter. The black stone palm was getting closer to Meng Chuan.
The distant Guild Master Darkstar’s stone face had a hint of confidence.
The treasure Meng Chuan obtained from the Nine Trials Pagoda is mine.
Forget it. Even if I expose the Spacetime Token’s escaping means, I have to leave.
Meng Chuan sighed. He could imagine all sorts of troubles coming to him when he placed the Spacetime Token in his homeworld. They would get him to hand over the Spacetime Token by pressuring him or using force.
...
Guild Master Fiend Eye was in his chamber, observing the battle in Taidong River Zone.
Meng Chuan’s potential is indeed terrifying. He reached the peak of the Sixth Tribulation realm in the blink of an eye.
Fiend Eye watched with relish.
That despicable Darkstar is short-sighted. All he knows is to rob and plunder. He doesn’t know who he’s snatching from today! Tsk, tsk. I knew it. That idiot Darkstar couldn’t hold back. Hmm, Meng Chuan’s Spacetime Domain is quite powerful. It feels like it’s 50% stronger than mine.
This idiot Darkstar didn’t manage to snatch a treasure and ended up having an Eighth Tribulation array formation fall into Meng Chuan’s hands.
Sigh. Although Meng Chuan’s potential is terrifying, and he will at least be an existence at the level of Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star in the future—to the point of being insuppressible—he’s still a little weak now.
I’ll wait a little longer. When he’s in his greatest despair, I’ll take action. He will definitely be grateful.
Fiend Eye watched happily. Ever since they parted on Fiend Mountain, he had been secretly watching Meng Chuan, searching for an opportunity to form good relations with him.
Alright, it’s time to take action. I can’t let any accidents happen.
Fiend Eye immediately took a step forward and traversed spacetime to head to Taidong River Zone.
...
The massive, black stone palm enveloped spacetime and crushed down, attempting to crush Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan looked up and felt a little helpless.
“Darkstar, you are ambushing a Sixth Tribulation Eminence again?” A scoff suddenly echoed in spacetime.
A meatball-like figure strode forward with its short legs. With a twist of its body, it passed through the array formation that isolated spacetime. The giant eye on its head stared at the towering, black stone giant.
The black stone giant—which was nearly half a trillion kilometers tall—suddenly stopped his crushing palm’s descent.
In terms of aura, this meatball-like figure was even more terrifying than the black stone giant.
“You really embarrass us Seventh Tribulation Eminences.” Fiend Eye shook his head and sighed.
Guild Master Fiend Eye?
Meng Chuan—who had planned on fleeing—was somewhat shocked by this scene.
I didn’t seek help from Fiend Eye. Why is Fiend Eye here?
</di

chapters.title: Chapter 682 - Attention from Everywhere in the River of Spacetime
chapters.content:
Chapter 682: Attention from Everywhere in the River of Spacetime
The nearly trillion-kilometer-tall, black stone giant looked down at the tiny Fiend Eye, but he was extremely furious.
Meng Chuan was his prey!
Meng Chuan now had an Eighth Tribulation array formation treasure—Ten Directions Samsara Array Formation. This was originally something that belonged to Guild Master Darkstar. At the same time, Meng Chuan had treasures bestowed by the Nine Trials Pagoda that were even more precious!
Guild Master Darkstar originally thought that he would make a killing from obtaining the treasure. Now that Fiend Eye had suddenly interfered, his plan had been for naught.
How could Darkstar be willing to accept the loss of so many treasures?
“Fiend Eye!” The black stone giant’s voice rumbled, echoing in the surrounding spacetime.
Everything trembled. Even some of the nearby barren planets were shattered to dust.
The towering, black stone giant’s eyes were filled with anger. He stared at Fiend Eye and gritted his teeth. “Fiend Eye! Are you really going to stop me?”
“Isn’t it obvious?” Fiend Eye grinned. “I’m naturally here to help Eastcalm.”
“Fiend Eye, I’ve been avoiding you the entire time, but you came to ruin my plans!” The black stone giant roared angrily. He knew his limits. Although his body—which had the Matter law as its foundation—allowed him to be reckless, he still tried his best to avoid the top Seventh Tribulation Eminences. This was because top Seventh Tribulation Eminences were on a higher level than him. Even if they couldn’t destroy his body, they could still toy with him.
Being toyed with like a fool was very embarrassing. Darkstar would naturally try his best to avoid conflict.
In terms of cultivation realm, Fiend Eye was already the strongest Physical Body Tribulation Eminence over 80,000 years ago. Back then, he was already a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Although he had completely vanished and abandoned all his factions, he remained very low-key after returning to the human world. However, his understanding of laws would only increase, not decrease! Fiend Eye’s mastery of laws would only be much higher than it was 80,000 years ago.
Even though he had never revealed his combat strength as a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence after his return, every faction still feared him.
For example, this time...
An array formation that isolated spacetime was enough to stop most Seventh Tribulation Eminences. However, Guild Master Fiend Eye took a step forward and entered! His accomplishments in spacetime made Darkstar’s heart tremble. Fiend Eye could clearly come and go as he pleased.
“Ruin your plans?” Fiend Eye shook his head. “You are the one bullying the weak. You clearly know that Eastcalm and I have a friendship, but you still ambushed him like a bully. How can I tolerate that?”
Guild Master Darkstar was furious. He was momentarily speechless, not knowing what to say!
Friendship? What nonsense!
Everyone in the River of Spacetime knew that Guild Master Fiend Eye didn’t care about relationships. He only cared about interests. If one were to say that Guild Master Darkstar was sinister and shameless, Guild Master Fiend Eye could be considered a fiend. He could do whatever he wanted, and his means were much more terrifying.
How could such a fiend consider friendship?
...
Seventh Tribulation Eminences could naturally lock onto other cultivators through karma. This was purely an instinctive reaction.
Normally, they would completely ignore it. Only special situations would attract their attention.
For example, the meeting of two Seventh Tribulation Eminences?
For example, a Seventh Tribulation Eminence entering the universe through a special spot?
They would only pay attention to such special situations warily! As for other Seventh Tribulation Eminences summoning Sixth Tribulation Eminences, there were countless such matters. They instinctively ignored them. Therefore, when Darkstar and Meng Chuan met, even if they could sense it, the Seventh Tribulation Eminences would ignore it. Such trivial matters weren’t worth their attention.
However... Fiend Eye and Darkstar had met?
One of them was an existence that ranked in the top five in the River of Spacetime and didn’t appear unless there were benefits. The other one was a sinister and shameless person, who loved to deal sneak attacks. Why were they gathering?
Huh?
Origin Realm Chieftain observed a silver cube floating in front of him. He sensed something and turned to look into the distance.
His gaze followed the karma and instantly arrived at Taidong River Zone. He could see everything that was happening there.
“Fiend Eye and Darkstar?” Origin Realm Chieftain sneered. “Fiend Eye is extremely ruthless. Why would he care about that idiot Darkstar?”
When the Realm Ancestor died of age, Origin Realm Chieftain would be one of the only top Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime. Relying on the uniqueness of the Essence Soul Tribulation realm, he could act on his ambitions.
He had always been fighting White Avian Hall and Six Directions Heaven. There weren’t many in the River of Spacetime that he thought highly of... Fiend Eye was undoubtedly one of them. After all, Fiend Eye was already a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence 80,000 years ago. Who dared to underestimate him?
Guild Master Darkstar only knew how to do sinister and despicable things. Origin Realm’s leader didn’t think much of him.
If Darkstar had the ability, he could directly rob White Avian Hall and Six Directions Heaven just like him! What was the point of scheming against Sixth Tribulation Eminences?
“Fiend Eye is helping that Sixth Tribulation Eminence? His name is...” Origin Realm Chieftain quickly obtained information. “City Lord Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, is a descendant of Senior Archean Eon’s hometown.”
...
“Meng Chuan? Fiend Eye stood up for Meng Chuan?” A coiled azure dragon looked at the scene in front of him.
Although Hall Lord Azure Dragon was a half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence, he couldn’t see what was happening in Taidong River Zone from afar with his strength. However, he had many treasures.
As the dragons’ current leader, Hall Lord Azure Dragon had many treasures! Half of White Avian Hall’s heritage was supported by the dragons! It also made Celestial Thearch Myriad Star very envious, but it was useless. Hall Lord Azure Dragon was extremely loyal to Hall Lord White Avian.
Guild Master Darkstar failed to kill Meng Chuan instantly. Could Meng Chuan be a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence?
Hall Lord Azure Dragon thought to himself,
I have to investigate carefully.
...
Fiend Eye and Darkstar are fighting?
Many powerful existences in the River of Spacetime noticed this scene. They either relied on their strength or treasures.
There were more than 20 Seventh Tribulation Eminences. In terms of connections, Manor Lord Centaurea—who had the strongest backer—Peach River Lord, Lord of Shadows, Lord of the East Abyss, Palace Lord Snow Rainbow... More than half of the Seventh Tribulation Eminences noticed Meng Chuan.
Many of them learned of Meng Chuan for the first time.
Hahaha, Darkstar. Oh, Darkstar. He made a mistake again.
In a mystic realm, an old farmer covered in wrinkles was diligently planting trees. At that moment, he raised his head and glanced over. He couldn’t help but smile.
I’ve advised him so many times, but he’s still greedy for the benefits he earns from sneak attacks.
However, to make Fiend Eye take action.
The old farmer looked at Meng Chuan.
This young junior is definitely extraordinary.
As he watched, he easily saw everything that had happened.
Peak Sixth Tribulation realm? He has only cultivated for 5,393 years?
The old farmer pricked up his brows.
His potential is extraordinary.
As for Meng Chuan’s Spacetime Domain, it proved that he had a spacetime treasure. The old farmer didn’t care about it at all. What slipped through the cracks of his wealth far exceeded that.
Fiend Eye is meticulous when it comes to planning and is extremely cunning. There must be a reason why he took action.
The old farmer looked at Meng Chuan and saw his past. He saw Archean Eon Realm’s history.
Archean Eon’s homeworld? Archean Eon Realm sure has produced talent.
Following that, the old farmer casually looked at Meng Chuan’s future.
