With his cultivation speed, he’ll probably reach the Seventh Tribulation realm at the very least.
The old farmer watched casually.
However, his expression gradually changed.
What?
The old farmer’s expression turned solemn.
Almost everything in the River of Spacetime was under his control. The only ones that could threaten him were Hall Lord White Avian and the Eighth Tribulation Eminences that didn’t appear in this era.
This junior’s potential is even more terrifying than the two from Shadow and Origin Realm?
The old farmer’s heart tightened. Lord of Shadows and Origin Realm Chieftain had only cultivated for a short period of time, yet they were both top Seventh Tribulation Eminences. The two of them were enemies of the old farmer. Lord of Shadows was completely on Hall Lord White Avian’s side, but Origin Realm Chieftain refused to look up to anyone! He dared to fight anyone!
If Fiend Eye was one who made meticulous plans, the old farmer’s schemes were much more terrifying. The entire River of Spacetime’s general trends were under his control. If not for Hall Lord White Avian, everything would have been his chess piece.
...
Hall Lord White Avian cultivated in a chamber and resisted the torture of his Essence Soul injuries. His pale face looked up slightly and revealed a smile.
Senior Realm Ancestor’s eyes are truly sharp. In the blink of an eye, Meng Chuan has already reached the peak of the Sixth Tribulation realm. Given his age... he’s not far from reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm.
</di

chapters.title: Chapter 683 - The Dust Settles
chapters.content:
Chapter 683: The Dust Settles
Taidong River Zone.
“Good, very good.” The black stone giant looked down at the tiny Fiend Eye as his anger rose.
Due to Guild Master Fiend Eye’s interference, he had lost an Eighth Tribulation array formation treasure and a domain-type treasure that was worth at least one million cubes. This made Guild Master Darkstar’s heart ache, enraging him further.
“Fiend Eye, since you interfered, do you have the guts to take a punch from me?” Guild Master Darkstar’s voice resounded in every corner of the void. His huge eyes stared at Fiend Eye. “If you don’t dare to take it and flee with your tail between your legs, I won’t laugh at you. After all, everyone knows that you’ve been heavily injured for over 80,000 years.”
His words were filled with mockery.
If he couldn’t obtain the treasures, he wouldn’t let Fiend Eye have an easy time either. Fiend Eye either had to be embarrassed or receive a punch! Fiend Eye definitely had his reasons for being unwilling to reveal his strength for so many years.
Thus, Guild Master Darkstar wanted to take the opportunity to force Fiend Eye.
Fiend Eye’s expression sank when he heard that. He said coldly, “Receive your punch? I want to see how powerful a punch from you is.”
“Good, as expected of Fiend Eye!” Guild Master Darkstar grinned as he punched out.
His fist was like a massive celestial body. It tore through the void and instantly traversed billions of kilometers, arriving in front of Fiend Eye.
If the palm that previously pressed down on Meng Chuan had a wide range and completely enveloped the array formation, making it impossible for Meng Chuan to escape, then this punch was focused on maximum strength. This was because, at Guild Master Darkstar’s realm, Fiend Eye couldn’t stop him from leaving.
Fiend Eye stood in his spot. Dodging was beneath him. He had to take the punch head-on.
Boom!
Meng Chuan also saw the black stone fist that was tens of billions of kilometers wide. The might of the fist alarmed him. Be it the palm strike or the punch, he would be annihilated if it touched him.
This is the difference between me and a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Meng Chuan understood this point. At the same time, he carefully observed Fiend Eye.
Fiend Eye raised one of his six arms and pointed a finger forward. He then tapped his fingertip!
Boom!
With a tap of his fingertip, a point of light appeared.
This point of light... seemed to be the origin of the entire universe. All the powers in the universe seemed to originate from it.
It collided with the black stone fist. Guild Master Darkstar’s fist was extremely powerful, and it could easily destroy a Dark Chaos Hole. But when it collided with the point of light, the huge fist suddenly exploded.
The terrifying impact traveled from the fist to Guild Master Darkstar’s body.
This... Meng Chuan felt that the point of light was too dazzling and hot. He couldn’t see it with his naked eye, nor could he sense it spatially. Only his Spacetime Domain could vaguely see the process.
With the fingertip’s tap, Guild Master Darkstar’s entire arm was obliterated as cracks appeared all over his body. However, countless leptons fused together almost instantly. The cracks on Guild Master Darkstar’s body disappeared, and his arm grew out again. He was whole and undamaged again.
This was how terrifying Guild Master Darkstar was! His body was unimaginably powerful. Unless he was completely annihilated in one strike, he could instantly recover with the help of the Matter law.
“As expected of Guild Master Fiend Eye. Back then, you were the strongest expert in the physical body cultivation system. You actually injured my body.” The towering Guild Master Darkstar’s voice boomed as he glanced at Meng Chuan. “Lucky junior. Let’s see who can protect you next time.”
Following that, Guild Master Darkstar turned around and took a step forward before disappearing.
Meng Chuan stood rooted to the ground.
Next time? Meng Chuan hoped that he could fight Guild Master Darkstar head-on next time.
...
Fiend Eye’s finger can destroy a portion of Guild Master Darkstar’s body? In an ancient palace, a towering figure sat on a throne. His gaze penetrated spacetime as he looked at Taidong River Zone.
His body was very wide. Even in his cave abode, he was 5,000 kilometers tall and 4,000 kilometers wide. But he didn’t look fat at all; he looked more like a mountain.
He was Ancestral Magus King! Under Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star, he was the strongest expert in the physical body cultivation system. He also had the Magus legacy left behind by an Eternal existence.
Has Fiend Eye’s strength recovered? Back then, he was known for the Annihilation Fiend Eye and Six Hand mystic technique... Now, he only used a single finger. Ancestral Magus King felt a faint pressure. His brows furrowed like hills. But after more than 80,000 years of hibernation, he only used a single finger today. His injuries must have yet to recover. Otherwise, no matter how much he holds it in, he wouldn’t have endured for over 80,000 years.
How long was a Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s lifespan? Typically, they only had 100,000 years to live. Nobody would hold things in for more than 80,000 years.
Even the lone Windthunder Walker and the reclusive Palace Lord Medicine would reveal their fangs.
...
Although Fiend Eye only seemed to tap his finger calmly, he was actually somewhat vexed.
I only used 50% of my strength, and my injuries are acting up again. Fiend Eye could sense the Darkness powers within his body corroding his body. The universe couldn’t isolate the Darkness powers, nor could an inhabited world.
His true body and avatars were tainted by the Darkness powers. Back then, he had nearly died. He had abandoned everything in the outside world and focused on suppressing his injuries in his homeworld. It took him nearly 30,000 years to suppress his injuries.
Up to this point in his cultivation, Fiend Eye had spent most of his energy on dealing with injuries. As he became more familiar with them and his realm gradually increased, he could use more of his strength head-on.
He tried using 50% of his strength this time, and it showed that his injuries were still a little unstable.
Back then, I was too confident. Fiend Eye sighed inwardly. He had only taken one wrong step.
“Thank you for your help, Guild Master,” said Meng Chuan gratefully as he walked forward.
Regardless of Guild Master Fiend Eye’s reputation, he had indeed helped Meng Chuan this time. Firstly, Meng Chuan didn’t want to expose the Spacetime Token’s escaping means.
Secondly, he wanted the outside world to think that Guild Master Fiend Eye had an extraordinary relationship with Meng Chuan. In the future, others would have to consider Guild Master Fiend Eye if they wanted to deal with Meng Chuan.
“Haha...” Fiend Eye chuckled. “What a coincidence. After I finished my seclusion, I sensed your meeting with Guild Master Darkstar. Out of curiosity, I took a look and learned of this matter. I took action only in passing.”
Coincidence? Taking action in passing?
Regardless of whether it was a coincidence or not, Meng Chuan naturally appreciated this favor since the other party was willing to help after discovering the situation.
“Furthermore, I’ve said it before.” Fiend Eye smiled at Meng Chuan. “I think very highly of you, so I’m naturally willing to form a good relationship with you. I have helped you today, and one day, you might be the one helping me.”
“Guild Master, you think too highly of me,” said Meng Chuan immediately.
“Don’t be humble.” Fiend Eye smiled and said, “Time is very magical. Who knows what will happen tens of thousands of years later? By the way, from today onwards, all the Seventh Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime will pay attention to you. You have to be more careful in the future.”
“All Seventh Tribulation Eminences will pay attention to me?” Meng Chuan’s heart stirred.
“The entire universe is only this big. The resources are limited. As you become stronger, you will be forced into conflicts. You have to be careful,” said Fiend Eye. He turned around and took a step with his short legs before vanishing.
The stronger one is, the more they will be forced into conflicts? Meng Chuan thought for a moment and smiled. As an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence, what is there to be afraid of?
He immediately took a step and left Taidong River Zone.
...
It’s safe. The Spacetime Token is Archean Eon Realm’s treasure now. Outside Jiang State Capital, Meng Chuan was fishing with his wife, Liu Qiyue. When his other Essence Soul avatar returned, he was completely relieved. The rare treasure—Spacetime Token—and the Eighth Tribulation array formation treasure had already been stored in Archean Eon Realm. This was a huge harvest.
When he was alive, he could study and use it. If his lifespan was up, he could leave it for his homeworld’s juniors.
“Ah Chuan, what’s wrong?” asked Liu Qiyue. “What happened?”
“My Essence Soul avatar has returned to Archean Eon Realm after coming out of the Nine Trials Pagoda,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “When I came out of the Nine Trials Pagoda, I encountered a sneak attack. A Seventh Tribulation Eminence even ambushed me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 684 - First Meeting with Hall Lord White Avian
chapters.content:
Chapter 684: First Meeting with Hall Lord White Avian
“Ah Chuan, are you alright?” Liu Qiyue asked worriedly.
“My Essence Soul avatar has already returned. It’s naturally fine,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “At my cultivation realm, as long as I don’t provoke an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, my homeworld’s true body won’t be threatened.”
Meng Chuan didn’t know much about how terrifying an Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s means were.
Liu Qiyue nodded slightly and asked curiously, “Ah Chuan, you told me that Seventh Tribulation Eminences are the peak existences in the entire River of Spacetime. They care about their reputation very much. That Seventh Tribulation Eminence actually did an act of bullying by even ambushing you? Doesn’t he care about his reputation?”
Meng Chuan thought for a moment and nodded. “In terms of evil and sin, he can’t be ranked in the top five among Seventh Tribulation Eminences. But in terms of shamelessness, he’s one of the best.”
In terms of sin and ruthlessness, the two Seventh Tribulation Eminences from Black Fiend Hall were undoubtedly in the top two. They didn’t hide their evilness at all.
On the surface, Guild Master Darkstar cared a lot about his reputation. His sneak attacks were also to snatch treasures. He targeted peak Sixth Tribulation Eminences and experts. Therefore, he couldn’t be ranked in the top five in terms of sin.
“His name is Guild Master Darkstar,” said Meng Chuan. “He established the Darkstar Guild single-handedly. He always has his eyes on Sixth Tribulation Eminences and even stronger existences. Once he discovers an opportunity to rob them of their treasures, he will use any means to ambush them.”
“Ah Chuan, how did you escape?” asked Liu Qiyue. “With the spatial law?”
Meng Chuan was delighted to have grasped the spatial law. He had long shared his accomplishment with his wife.
“It wasn’t easy to escape from Guild Master Darkstar’s sneak attack.” Meng Chuan shook his head. “It’s Guild Master Fiend Eye. I’m also very surprised that he appeared...”
Liu Qiyue listened as Meng Chuan spoke. Liu Qiyue had learned many secrets about the River of Spacetime from her husband over the years.
Liu Qiyue nodded. “These Seventh Tribulation Eminences have their own ways of doing things.”
“For them to reach the Seventh Tribulation realm, none of them are ordinary—even Guild Master Darkstar... I have a nagging feeling that the information I know is only superficial,” said Meng Chuan thoughtfully. In the previous skirmish, he vaguely felt that shamelessness was only the surface of Guild Master Darkstar’s behavior.
Huh?
Meng Chuan’s heart suddenly stirred. He said to his wife, “Qiyue, Hall Lord has summoned me.”
“Hall Lord White Avian?” asked Liu Qiyue.
Meng Chuan nodded. “He summoned me personally.”
As long as one knew more about White Avian Hall, they would understand that many of White Avian Hall’s matters were mainly managed by Hall Lord Blazing Sun. It was very rare for Hall Lord White Avian to summon someone personally.
...
White Avian Hall headquarters.
Whoosh.
The black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan traversed the distant spacetime and finally arrived.
White Avian Hall is grand indeed.
At a glance, Meng Chuan saw a hall that spanned about five billion kilometers. The walls were plain, and there were buildings inside. He could even see many Sixth Tribulation Eminences chatting in groups.
White Avian Hall’s official members had their own cave abodes. There were usually thousands of Sixth Tribulation Eminences gathered here. Many were special lifeforms.
“City Lord Eastcalm actually instantly killed five top Sixth Tribulation Eminences when attacked by the Darkstar Guild. It’s said that he obtained an Eighth Tribulation treasure—the Samsara Array Formation.”
“Guild Master Darkstar personally took action but failed to kill him immediately. Right on the heels of that, Guild Master Fiend Eye appeared and helped him fend off Guild Master Darkstar. Guild Master Fiend Eye clearly has an extraordinary relationship with City Lord Eastcalm.”
“Who doesn’t know Guild Master Fiend Eye’s personality? He doesn’t care about any friendships. He must have eyed City Lord Eastcalm’s astonishing potential. According to the latest intelligence, City Lord Eastcalm has only cultivated for slightly over 5,000 years, but he has already grasped three Sixth Tribulation laws. One of them includes the spatial law. With such talent and potential... there’s no doubt that he will reach the Seventh Tribulation realm. He might be an existence like Origin Realm Chieftain.”
“That’s right. City Lord Eastcalm is an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence! Our White Avian Hall will soon produce an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence!”
Many Sixth Tribulation Eminences were gathered at White Avian Hall. They were discussing the major event that had just happened—Darkstar Guild’s attack on City Lord Eastcalm!
This information was too explosive.
The attention of many Seventh Tribulation Eminences caused Meng Chuan’s cultivation time to be completely exposed.
He had cultivated for slightly over 5,000 years and grasped three Sixth Tribulation laws... This was enough to shock the entire River of Spacetime!
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan walked into White Avian Hall.
“City Lord Eastcalm.” The Sixth Tribulation Eminences chatting in the distance saw Meng Chuan from afar. Their expressions immediately became much more respectful.
Just Meng Chuan’s strength as a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence made these Sixth Tribulation Eminences revere him. When they thought of how short his cultivation period was, who dared to slight him? Even Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star thought highly of him, much less these Sixth Tribulation Eminences.
These Sixth Tribulation Eminences were all hegemons of their own territories. Some special lifeforms produced only one Sixth Tribulation Eminence across the entirety of the River of Spacetime. Most special lifeforms didn’t even have a Sixth Tribulation Eminence!
All Sixth Tribulation Eminences were extraordinary.
They were now full of respect for City Lord Eastcalm. This was because City Lord Eastcalm had the greatest potential in the River of Spacetime. They had to look up to him.
“City Lord Eastcalm.”
“Greetings, City Lord Eastcalm.” The Sixth Tribulation Eminences bowed.
Meng Chuan smiled and nodded without saying anything. With just a few steps, he passed through the many doors and walls and soon arrived at the core region of White Avian Hall’s headquarters. Only the upper echelons could come here.
“Eastcalm is here.” Blazing Sun’s tall figure stood there and waited. When he saw Meng Chuan arrive, his single vertical eye lit up. He then said, “Follow me. Hall Lord has long arrived.”
“Hall Lord Blazing Sun.” Meng Chuan bowed humbly.
“You really shocked everyone this time. You’ve alarmed the entire River of Spacetime.” Blazing Sun walked alongside Meng Chuan and smiled. “All the Seventh Tribulation Eminences are paying attention to you.”
Meng Chuan could also sense the change in Blazing Sun’s attitude. When he recruited him last time, Blazing Sun’s attitude was mostly toward a genius with potential. Now, he treated Meng Chuan as his equal.
The two walked side by side into a small building.
Meng Chuan followed Blazing Sun to the second floor of the building. He immediately saw two figures sitting cross-legged and chatting.
One figure was covered in azure dragon scales. He had a small number of azure dragon scales on his face, and his eyes were deep and unfathomable. Meng Chuan naturally understood that this was Deputy Hall Lord Azure Dragon, the current leader of the dragons! He controlled an Origins law—the Samsara law. He had many treasures and battled everywhere. He had never suffered a loss. Many of White Avian Hall’s large faction wars were managed by him.
It was magical.
In the River of Spacetime, there were over 50 half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences. Those ranked in the top five could suppress Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
Three of the five most dazzling half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences were in White Avian Hall. They were Lord of Shadowfiend—who was publicly acknowledged to be the strongest half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence—the dragons’ leader, Deputy Hall Lord Azure Dragon, who had many treasures and means, and Apprentice, who was the River of Spacetime’s strongest refiner.
Among the three, Lord of Shadowfiend was Hall Lord White Avian’s lifelong friend. They established White Avian Hall together. Before Hall Lord White Avian reached the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm, Lord of Shadowfiend often took action. Later, as Hall Lord White Avian shook the River of Spacetime with his might, Lord of Shadowfiend seldom appeared.
Deputy Hall Lord Azure Dragon was now the one presiding over the battles.
Apprentice was a very independent half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence. He focused on refining artifacts and didn’t even pay much attention to his body. The outside world believed that he would’ve long reached the Physical Body Seventh Tribulation realm if he had focused on cultivating his body.
Even so, the array formations and treasures he refined were what White Avian Hall relied on to win large-scale battles.
The treasures he refined were Seventh Tribulation treasures in the hands of others, but they could unleash the might of an Eighth Tribulation treasure in his hands. When he fought, he could control dozens of treasures perfectly. It was as though he was unleashing the combined might of dozens of Eighth Tribulation treasures, making him virtually invincible.
Apart from these three, Sect Master Mental Demon and Mountain Lord Moxie—who were half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences—were also very terrifying. They weren’t inferior to true Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
On the contrary, Deputy Hall Lord Blazing Sun and Monarch Ape Fiend were considered normal half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences. With the help of treasures, Deputy Hall Lord Blazing Sun could match a Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
Monarch Ape Fiend was much inferior. After all, he wasn’t as diligent as Hall Lord Blazing Sun when it came to serving White Avian Hall.
What charm does Hall Lord White Avian have to recruit the few most dazzling half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences?
Meng Chuan looked at the figure sitting in the main seat.
His figure was thin, and his eyes were restrained and gentle. He was dressed in a simple robe. He looked ordinary and extremely restrained. There was no sense of pressure or threat.
When Meng Chuan saw him, it was as though he saw silent mountain rocks, flowing streams, and swaying grass...
He was the most ordinary part of the River of Spacetime.
At that moment, Hall Lord White Avian raised his head and smiled at Meng Chuan.
“Greetings, Hall Lord, Deputy Hall Lord.” Meng Chuan bowed slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 685 - Looking at the Past and Future
chapters.content:
Chapter 685: Looking at the Past and Future
“Sit,” said Hall Lord White Avian with a smile.
Meng Chuan and Blazing Sun took their seats. There were tables in front of them, ladened with drinks and food.
“To be able to reach such a realm in slightly over 5,000 years, you aren’t much different from me back then,” said Hall Lord White Avian with a smile. “Senior Realm Ancestor’s judgment is indeed extraordinary. He long identified your potential.”
“Hall Lord, you flatter me. I’m very grateful to Realm Ancestor,” said Meng Chuan. Before he transcended the sixth Heavenly Tribulation, Realm Ancestor had given him an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation legacy.
“Cultivation is very difficult,” said Azure Dragon with a sigh. “It’s already very impressive for one to reach the Sixth Tribulation realm. As for the Seventh Tribulation realm, there are only 20-odd such people in the River of Spacetime. I have many opportunities and treasures, but I still have my flaws. It’s unknown if I can reach the Seventh Tribulation realm in my life. As for some cultivators, they can leap past the threshold of the Seventh Tribulation realm easily.
“For example, the Lord of Shadows and Origin Realm Chieftain easily cleared the Seventh Tribulation realm threshold at a young age. They have even become top Seventh Tribulation Eminences.”
Azure Dragon looked at Meng Chuan. “Brother Eastcalm, you have only cultivated for slightly over 5,000 years. I estimate that you will easily reach the Seventh Tribulation realm and become White Avian Hall’s first Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence.”
The Seventh Tribulation realm’s threshold was like a chasm. But this threshold was a relaxing and pleasant milestone for some. This made the Eminences struggling at the threshold feel mixed emotions.
“Once Eastcalm takes that step, he will be an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Our White Avian Hall will also have an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence.” Hall Lord White Avian was rather expectant. The threat of an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence was much greater than a Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
A Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence only had one true body in the outer realm. One needed to cultivate, defend, and fight. There were many things they couldn’t do. However, how many people could withstand an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s numerous Essence Soul avatars—an immense threat, even when they were unarmed? Just the Essence Soul mystic techniques they had were formidable enough.
Why did Origin Realm dare to fight Six Directions Heaven and White Avian Hall at the same time?
Why was Black Fiend Hall so ferocious?
Why was Realm Ancestor’s status extraordinary?
It was all because of the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm!
As for the young Meng Chuan, he had a deep foundation in his cultivation. His willpower was long sufficient. He had a smooth path ahead of him! Nothing could stop him from becoming an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
“When you reach the Seventh Tribulation realm, White Avian Hall will arrange a Clear Spring Island cave abode for you,” said White Avian with a smile. “As an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, you naturally have to occupy one.”
“Thank you, Hall Lord,” said Meng Chuan.
An Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence was practically entitled to a cave abode on Clear Spring Island. However, those cave abodes had owners! If he wanted to occupy one, he had to force a Seventh Tribulation Eminence to give it up.
According to normal rules, it was normal for a war to break out. However, Hall Lord White Avian had personally promised him that he would handle this matter.
“Due to your cultivation potential,” said Hall Lord White Avian with a smile, “you now have the authority equivalent to a Librarian. You can read all the books and legacies in White Avian Hall freely.”
“Thank you, Hall Lord.” Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up.
Many legacies in the River of Spacetime could be perused a limited number of times. For example, an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation legacy would be destroyed after reading it nine times. Therefore, having the right to read the books was very precious.
The three Librarians were Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
Meng Chuan now had similar authority.
“The most precious legacy of White Avian Hall is the original copy of the Immeasurable Universe,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “The other legacy manuals are only at the Eighth Tribulation realm at best. There’s no need for me to remind you. However, the Immeasurable Universe is suspected to be created by an Eternal existence. It starts from the viewpoint of the Immeasurable lineage and describes all the laws in the universe.”
Created by an Eternal existence?
Meng Chuan’s heart skipped a beat.
“According to what I know, only Void Catalog and Immeasurable Universe are suspected to be created by Eternal existences. It can be confirmed that the other techniques weren’t created by Eternals,” explained Hall Lord White Avian. “Void Catalog mainly talks about spatial laws. It’s rather easy to understand. However, the Immeasurable Universe is much more complicated. It contains all the laws.”
All the laws?
Meng Chuan was secretly alarmed.
“There are records of time, space, all Origins laws, and even a large number of Sixth and Fifth Tribulation laws,” said Hall Lord White Avian with a sigh. “Countless laws form a single entity in this manual, but because it’s too profound, I have to remind you that reading the Immeasurable Universe will either require you to comprehend the Immeasurable law or to have acquired extremely profound insights in time and space. Otherwise, reading it will only bring harm and no benefits.”
Meng Chuan fell into deep thought and asked, “Hall Lord, you said, ‘when one’s insights in time and space reach an extremely profound level.’ What’s considered extremely profound?”
“When there’s only one step left before you grasp the complete time and space laws,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “In more detail, it’s to grasp the spatial law and the past, present, and future for time. Upon reaching this step, you will be able to read Immeasurable Universe.”
Meng Chuan was speechless. Grasping
the past, present, future, and the complete spatial law are just the requirements to read the original copy? Compared to that, grasping the Immeasurable law is much easier.
Hall Master Azure Dragon added, “This is because this book originally uses the Immeasurable lineage as a guide. Therefore, cultivators who grasp the Immeasurable law can comprehend it. They have the advantage. Sect Master Mental Demon had that advantage. After reading the Immeasurable Universe, he benefited greatly. With a half-step Seventh Tribulation body, he can match a Seventh Tribulation Eminence.”
Meng Chuan came to a realization.
“This is the best manual in the Immeasurable lineage. It’s also the best manual in the River of Spacetime,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “It’s not suitable to study it before one’s realm reaches a certain level. This is my suggestion. If you want to read it now, I won’t stop you.”
“Thank you for your advice.” Meng Chuan trusted the other party very much.
This was because there were definitely some Seventh Tribulation Eminences that had studied such manuals in history. There were definitely detailed records about it, so Hall Lord White Avian had no need to lie about it.
Unfortunately, Meng Chuan’s current goal was the Chaos Hole law. He was destined not to study the Immeasurable Universe for a long time. However, Meng Chuan was still looking forward to all the other books in White Avian Hall.
Apart from personal cultivation, it was also very important to absorb the seniors’ wisdom.
“I think very highly of you.” Hall Lord White Avian smiled at Meng Chuan. With a wave of his hand, three items flew toward Meng Chuan. “These are the three gifts I prepared for you.”
“Gifts?” Meng Chuan was stunned.
As a faction, White Avian Hall had many internal rules.
The benefits he obtained corresponded with his responsibilities.
Meng Chuan had to make enough contributions to White Avian Hall in order to exchange for the corresponding benefits. Reading all the books and legacies was the Librarian’s authority. It was already very rare for it to be given to him in advance. Yet, he was even given treasures? White Avian Hall didn’t have such rules.
“It’s a personal gift from me,” said Hall Lord White Avian.
Meng Chuan looked ahead.
Three items landed on the table in front of him. On the left was a black book. In the middle was a fist-sized cyan fruit that emitted a fragrance. On the right was a silver cube.
These items?
Meng Chuan couldn’t tell how precious any of them were. He didn’t recognize any of them, and he was somewhat hesitant. This was because receiving treasures from others implied the formation of karma.
Seeing Meng Chuan hesitate, Hall Lord White Avian continued, “These three treasures are worth about 20 million cubes. You can’t buy them even if you wanted to.”
Meng Chuan looked at Hall Lord White Avian.
Twenty million cubes? The three treasures are already so valuable. On average, each of them might exceed my Spacetime Token. I’ve never seen or heard of them before. How much has Ancestral Master Archean Eon accumulated in his life? Hall Master White Avian is personally giving me such a huge gift?
This was probably comparable to a Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s lifetime wealth. Even if he had enough Outer Realm Essence Crystals, he probably wouldn’t be able to buy these three treasures.
“Do you have the guts to accept it?” Hall Lord White Avian looked at Meng Chuan.
“What do you need me to do?” asked Meng Chuan.
“I’ll tell you when I need you to do it. Don’t worry. I won’t make things difficult for you,” said Hall Lord White Avian with a smile.
“You won’t make things difficult for me? I’ll accept it!” Meng Chuan knew very well that the better the treasures, the greater the karma. However, since Hall Lord White Avian dared to say that he wouldn’t make things difficult for him, Meng Chuan didn’t hesitate any further.
He immediately waved his hand and put away the three treasures. At the same time, he asked, “Hall Lord, may I know how to use these three treasures?”
“That fruit can be preserved for a long time. At the very least, it has a much longer lifespan than ours. Just eat it directly. It’s best you consume it before you transcend the seventh Heavenly Tribulation. You can study the other two items carefully. You will naturally learn of their usage,” said Hall Lord White Avian with a smile. “These three treasures are treasures from the Essence Soul lineage. They won’t be of much help to us Physical Body Tribulation Eminences.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
Rare treasures of the Essence Soul lineage?
An hour later, the meeting ended. Meng Chuan bade farewell and left.
“Hall Lord, these are the three treasures you obtained from roaming outside the universe. Are you just giving them to him?” asked Blazing Sun.
Hall Lord White Avian stood high up in the building and watched Meng Chuan leave White Avian Hall. He whispered, “Treasures of the Essence Soul lineage are useless to me.”
“I believe that with this, it will be enough for Origin Realm Chieftain to join White Avian Hall completely,” said Blazing Sun with a frown. The three treasures were worth 20 million cubes. Origin Realm Chieftain probably only had accumulated tens of millions of cubes his entire life. These three treasures were extremely tempting to Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
“In my eyes, Meng Chuan is more important.” Hall Lord White Avian looked into the distance. His eyes could see the future, so he long knew what kind of choice to make.

chapters.title: Chapter 686 - Getting Acquainted
chapters.content:
Chapter 686: Getting Acquainted
Blazing Sun was somewhat puzzled when he heard that, while Azure Dragon was somewhat surprised.
The two of them knew that, as existences that grasped time and space, Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star could see through the fog of the future. There was no need to question their decisions. This was because others would discover that they were ultimately right as time passed. In front of such existences, the other Seventh Tribulation Eminences would be doomed if they were to oppose them.
The best way to prevent the future from being seen was to make themselves unresolvable.
For example, Origin Realm Chieftain’s many Essence Soul avatars could act separately. He could send his will anywhere in the universe, and he could self-destruct them at any time. This was an unresolvable problem!
For example, no matter how Meng Chuan was suppressed, he would ultimately reach that step!
In this era, only me, Myriad Star, and this Meng Chuan have a chance of reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm. Although only one in over 100 half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences in history have a chance of reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm, there’s at least hope for Meng Chuan.
If Meng Chuan succeeds, he will be an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
Hall Lord White Avian felt constant pain and torture from his Essence Soul. Even though he had the strength to suppress it at present, he felt powerless.
He tried so hard his entire life, but it was extremely difficult for him to reach the Eighth Tribulation realm. Now, his chances of reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm were even slimmer. He could only hope for external help to escape the pain and torture. He had ways to seek an audience with a few Eighth Tribulation Eminences of the Physical Body lineage, but he couldn’t meet any Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminences!
Even though Meng Chuan’s chances of reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm were very low, as long as there was hope, it was worth it for Hall Lord White Avian to place a bet. Giving Meng Chuan three treasures was equivalent to placing a bet for his future.
...
Three days later, Nebula Palace.
White Avian Hall’s third branch held a celebration to celebrate the addition of City Lord Eastcalm as a Patroller.
The scale of this celebration was grand. The core members of White Avian Hall gathered. The Hall Lord, two Deputy Hall Lords, three Librarians, five Patrollers, and the Deputy Patroller were all present. The White Avian Hall members who participated in the celebration felt that it was only right.
“Lord of the East Abyss.”
“Lord of Shadows.”
“Palace Lord Food God.” Meng Chuan was the busiest. He did not dare slight any of White Avian Hall’s top brass. Since the other party had specially come to attend the celebration, he couldn’t not entertain them. It would be an inhospitable act.
Apart from the three Seventh Tribulation Eminences, there were also people Meng Chuan naturally knew like the Patrollers, Mountain Lord Moxie, and Monarch Ape Fiend. It was rare for Lord of Shadowfiend and Apprentice to appear. They had come to participate in the celebrations out of goodwill. For example, when Lord of Avian Mountain became a Deputy Patroller, the main members of White Avian Hall’s third branch participated in the celebrations.
“Lord of Shadowfiend.” Meng Chuan chatted with Lord of Shadowfiend alone.
Lord of Shadowfiend was a shadow lifeform. It was difficult to see his appearance clearly. He didn’t even seem to exist as he sat there, keeping a low profile. He had once fought alongside Hall Lord White Avian. Now, his realm wasn’t inferior to a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s. But his body had yet to break through, so he had yet to transcend the seventh Heavenly Tribulation.
Many Physical Body Tribulation Eminences deliberately delayed their tribulation transcendence. This was because the longer they waited, the more insights they accumulated. This boosted their chances of transcending the tribulation.
“Seeing you makes me feel like I’m looking at Hall Lord back when he was young.” Lord Shadowfiend raised his cup and toasted Meng Chuan. Soon, Meng Chuan went to receive other Eminences.
“Second Brother, when are you transcending the tribulation to reach the Seventh Tribulation realm?” Hall Lord White Avian sat in the seat of honor. Lord of Shadowfiend sat beside him. “You always mention that fighting a Seventh Tribulation Eminence as a half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence would bring greater pressure. However, you haven’t taken action in the past 10,000 years. Why haven’t you transcended the tribulation?”
“I’m not in a hurry, but you are.” Lord of Shadowfiend chuckled softly. “I’m still far from the end of my lifespan. It’s fine breaking through 10,000 years before that point.”
“Do it as soon as possible. I’m afraid that I won’t be able to withstand Myriad Star,” said Hall Lord White Avian softly. His voice only entered Lord of Shadowfiend’s ears.
Lord of Shadowfiend’s expression changed slightly as he looked at his friend. “You...”
“I’m no longer suited to fight prolonged battles.” Hall Lord White Avian nodded slightly. “Of course, Myriad Star can’t tell. Only Realm Ancestor and you know of my injuries in this River of Spacetime. I need help now.”
“Alright. I’ll break through in ten years. The heavenly tribulation will probably descend in a century or so.” Lord of Shadowfiend nodded solemnly. His good friend needed him again.
“Ten years?” Hall Lord White Avian looked at Lord of Shadowfiend. “Will it be too much of a rush? You mustn’t be careless when we are talking about a tribulation.”
“I’ve already figured out three Seventh Tribulation body formulations. I’m only trying to create stronger ones,” said Lord of Shadowfiend. “In the future, leave White Avian Hall’s troublesome matters to me. Don’t take action unless necessary.”
Hall Lord White Avian heaved a sigh of relief.
The three Librarians were only in a partnership with him. It was fine if they occasionally took action, but it was somewhat troublesome to deploy them frequently.
Apart from Deputy Hall Lord Blazing Sun and Deputy Hall Lord Azure Dragon, the only other person he could deploy at any time was his good friend, Lord of Shadowfiend. The relationship between the two of them had been established since they were weak.
Although thousands of members were gathered at the celebration, none of the other members could sense the conversation between Hall Lord White Avian and Lord of Shadowfiend.
As the star of this celebration, Meng Chuan’s surroundings were very lively.
Seventh Tribulation Eminences, half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences, peak Sixth Tribulation Eminences, and even some top Sixth Tribulation Eminences came to chat with him privately.
“Brother Eastcalm, congratulations.” Cang Li and Lady Feng Yu walked over side by side. Although they weren’t members of the third branch and hadn’t been invited to the celebration, as White Avian Hall members, they wouldn’t be stopped at the door if they took the initiative to come.
“Brother Cang Li, Lady Feng Yu.” Meng Chuan welcomed them. These two had spent some time with him in the Valley of Spacetime. Although he didn’t like Lady Feng Yu, Meng Chuan still thought highly of Cang Li.
“Speaking of which, Feng Yu and I used the Void Trileaf Flower earlier than you. However, we didn’t comprehend the spatial law, yet you did,” said Cang Li with a smile. “It made Feng Yu and I realize the difference.”
“As you accumulate more insights, both of you will definitely have a chance of comprehending the spatial law,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“City Lord Eastcalm.” The other Sixth Tribulation Eminences came to congratulate Meng Chuan.
“We won’t disturb you any further. Farewell.” Cang Li and Lady Feng Yu bade farewell when they saw this.
“Let’s meet again in the future.” Meng Chuan had no choice but to continue chatting with the other Sixth Tribulation Eminences.
...
Cang Li and Lady Feng Yu silently left amidst the commotion.
“Cang Li, although you didn’t comprehend the spatial law after consuming the Void Trileaf Flower, you have grasped a fourth Sixth Tribulation law. With such a deep foundation, you can figure out a Seventh Tribulation law at any time,” said Lady Feng Yu. “Furthermore, you obtained the Fire Origins legacy left behind by Ancestral Phoenix. In the future, you will definitely be much stronger than Eastcalm.”
The Fire Origins legacy was the phoenixes’ strongest legacy. It was a legacy created after Phoenix Ancestor reached the Eighth Tribulation realm.
In the phoenixes’ history, only a handful of people had learned this legacy. The learning threshold was extremely high. Even some of the phoenixes’ Seventh Tribulation Eminences couldn’t learn it.
Cang Li went to the Phoenix Ancestral Land. With just a glance, he had comprehended a portion of the profundities. In less than ten years, he had completely learned this legacy. It was obvious that he was extremely compatible with this legacy.
His deep accumulation, acquisition of the Fire Origins legacy, and his youth made the phoenixes place great importance on Cang Li. They began to pour resources on him.
Cang Li shook his head gently. “Feng Yu, don’t you understand why all the upper echelons of White Avian Hall appeared during the celebration of a Deputy Patroller? He has such strength after cultivating for just over 5,000 years. Furthermore, he’s at the Essence Soul Tribulation realm,” said Cang Li with a sigh. “Eastcalm is destined to be an influential figure in the River of Spacetime.”
Lady Feng Yu nodded slightly before saying, “You will also be an influential figure.”
Cang Li smiled with confidence.
...
Archean Eon Realm, inside a Seventh Tribulation World Treasure.
The wind howled and blew at Meng Chuan’s white hair. He stood on the vast land and looked up. In the dark sky, a huge eye had already appeared. It was the Eighth Tribulation treasure—Heavenly Punishment Chart.
Now that I’ve reached the peak of the Sixth Tribulation realm, I can try dealing with Emperor Roc again.
Meng Chuan waved his hand, and a blob of blood appeared in front of him. It was the blood extracted from Emperor Roc’s imprisoned outer realm true body.

chapters.title: Chapter 687 - Emperor Rocs Death (Final Chapter of Volume)
chapters.content:
Chapter 687: Emperor Roc’s Death (Final Chapter of Volume)
Meng Chuan had never forgotten Emperor Roc—one of the main culprits behind Archean Eon Realm’s calamity.
The calamity lasted for more than 900 years. During the worst and most tragic period, humans were forced to guard the important cities only. The demons wreaked havoc outside the cities, and countless people died.
Meng Chuan had experienced that tragic period. He had seen demons slaughtering countless cities and villages. The ones who caused this calamity were the Demon Realm’s three Imperial Lords! Two of the Imperial Lords—Imperial Lord Starquix and Lady Blackmoon—had died at Meng Chuan’s hands! The strongest, Emperor Roc, had reached the Third Tribulation realm and lived an abject life to this day.
Golden Roc, third of the demons’ Imperial Lords, it’s your turn today.
Meng Chuan vaguely felt that he would succeed this time. His current strength was much greater than when he had just reached the Sixth Tribulation realm.
Back then, he had only grasped a single Sixth Tribulation law—the lightning law. Now, he was already a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence. With a flip of his hand, he could destroy his former self. By using the Eighth Tribulation treasure, Heavenly Punishment Chart, he probably had the strength of a half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
With such strength, it was very likely for him to kill a Fourth Tribulation Eminence across worlds. It was impossible for a Third Tribulation Eminence to survive by relying on themselves.
Die.
The Heavenly Punishment Chart’s manifestation—which appeared as a huge eye—was as dark as a Chaos Hole. In order to have complete confidence, Meng Chuan naturally used an Eighth Tribulation treasure.
Boom!
A deep rumble echoed in the Seventh Tribulation World Treasure, causing the world to tremble. At the same time, a dark-gold lightning bolt—as thick as a finger—struck the floating blob of blood.
Meng Chuan watched everything coldly. The terrifying lightning traveled through the karmic threads that intertwined with each other and instantly spread to the Demon Realm—the neighboring inhabited world. It transmitted to Emperor Roc, who had been hiding in the Demon Ancestral Cave.
Demon Realm, Demon Ancestral Cave.
Oh?
Emperor Roc—who was sitting cross-legged—suddenly revealed a look of horror. The attack that followed the karmic threads made him instinctively feel that he couldn’t block it.
Meng Chuan has invited an Eminence to take action again so quickly?
This thought surfaced in Emperor Roc’s mind. A wisp of dark-gold lightning had already seeped into his body, and his body was like snow melting in flames. He was instantly annihilated.
His true body—which was hiding in the Demon Ancestral Cave—was completely destroyed. Only some artifacts remained.
Although the Demon Ancestral Cave had many protective means left behind by the demons’ ancestors, the strongest demon ancestor only reached the Sixth Tribulation realm. The cave’s blocking effects on karmic attacks were ultimately limited.
...
Thousand Mountain Star, Fiend Prison.
Emperor Roc’s outer realm true body had been imprisoned here and tortured.
My homeworld’s true body.
Emperor Roc was somewhat dazed as his mind went blank. With his homeworld’s true body dead, what hope did his outer realm true body have?
Emperor Roc looked up in a daze. A black-robed, white-haired man walked over from afar.
“Meng Chuan.” Emperor Roc looked at Meng Chuan. He sensed Meng Chuan’s mightier aura and muttered, “You’ve reached the Sixth Tribulation realm? I never expected you to reach the Sixth Tribulation realm. Did you beg a Seventh Tribulation Eminence to kill me? You really hate me to the core. You spared no expense to hire a Seventh Tribulation Eminence to kill me.”
Emperor Roc had determined that it was a Sixth Tribulation Eminence who had attacked him the previous time. In just over 200 years, another attack had descended upon him. It was much more terrifying, so he estimated it to be at the Seventh Tribulation realm.
It was really rare for a mere Third Tribulation Eminence like him to provoke a Seventh Tribulation Eminence to attack across worlds.
“I’m honored that you paid such a huge price.” Emperor Roc looked at Meng Chuan. He didn’t have any extravagant hopes of surviving.
“Price?” Meng Chuan looked at him. “I attacked personally! Asking for help isn’t as satisfying killing you personally.”
“Personally?” Emperor Roc was taken aback. “You’ve reached the Seventh Tribulation realm?”
After all, he was only at the Third Tribulation realm. Even though he had grasped a Fourth Tribulation law and had mostly perfected his physical body, his horizons weren’t broad. He couldn’t determine Meng Chuan’s strength.
Meng Chuan didn’t say anything else. He pointed his finger, and an illusion descended.
It made Emperor Roc fall into despair before he died.
Humph.
Emperor Roc fell into layers of illusions as he roared, “If I die, what does the destruction of the Demon Realm have to do with me? Hahaha, come if you have the guts. I’m the Demon Realm’s emperor.
“No, no, spare me.
“I don’t dare. I don’t dare.
“Hehehe...”
Emperor Roc’s willpower gradually collapsed under the layers of illusions, revealing his ugliness.
Meng Chuan watched all of this from the side. Countless scenes of the demon invasion surfaced in his mind.
Finally, Emperor Roc’s tortured Essence Soul completely dissipated as he died in Fiend Prison.
The three main culprits are dead,
thought Meng Chuan. With a wave of his hand, he reduced Emperor Roc’s corpse to dust before turning to leave.
...
Archean Eon Realm, on a mountain peak in Archean Mountain.
Meng Chuan and Qin Wu stood side by side. Their gazes penetrated the endless sea of clouds as they looked at all life in Archean Eon Realm.
“Emperor Roc is also dead,” said Qin Wu. “Having hidden in the Demon Realm, he is finally killed by you. This war has finally come to an end.”
“It’s still early,” Meng Chuan said.
“Early?” Qin Wu looked at him.
“The flames of war spread throughout Archean Eon Realm. Master, you were almost forced to use the Heaven and Earth Great Hall to destroy the world,” said Meng Chuan. “As for the Demon Realm, it’s completely unharmed. Is this considered the end?”
“The Demon Realm is indeed a calamity. This inhabited world is too close to our Archean Eon Realm. The war lasted for nearly 1,000 years after the World Entrances formed. In the future, it’s possible for it to approach again after hundreds of thousands of years or even millions of years. If we can seriously damage it, it will indeed benefit Archean Eon Realm’s descendants,” said Qin Wu. “But what can we do? We can’t enter the Demon Realm. All we can do is make the demons afraid to enter the outer realm.”
Meng Chuan didn’t say a word. He only looked down at Archean Eon Realm.
...
The legends regarding Meng Chuan spread among Sixth Tribulation Eminences. Gradually, some Fifth Tribulation Eminences learned of him.
Eastcalm? Back when he killed my true body and took away Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, he had just reached the Sixth Tribulation realm?
Three Stones panicked when he received the news.
It’s only been 200 years, yet he has already reached the peak of the Sixth Tribulation realm? According to intelligence, he has only cultivated for slightly over 5,000 years.
Three Stones’s heart palpitated.
How did I provoke such an enemy? From today onwards, my true body will hide in Yellow-Robed Academy’s headquarters. I won’t take a single step out.
Three Stones was afraid that Meng Chuan would bear a grudge, so he naturally had to be careful.
...
In the Cang Alliance Space.
The Cang Alliance members were scattered across the River of Spacetime, but news spread quickly.
“City Lord Eastcalm has reached the peak of the Sixth Tribulation realm.”
“In our Cang Alliance, the strongest is Realm Ancestor. City Lord Eastcalm is ranked second, right?”
“I never expected City Lord Eastcalm to be at the peak of the Sixth Tribulation realm after being at the Sixth Tribulation realm for less than 300 years.”
In the Cang Alliance space, members gathered in twos and threes. Almost all of them were discussing City Lord Eastcalm. After all, they were also members of the Cang Alliance, so they felt honored.
At that moment, Fu Sui was sitting alone in a corner of the Cang Alliance space.
Eastcalm is already a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence?
Fu Sui’s thoughts churned. Back then, he had discovered the Fiend Mountain ruin. He had brought Meng Chuan, Old Fiend Black Wind, and Meng Hu with him. He had taken the path of epiphany and was the first to grasp a Sixth Tribulation law. Back then, he was the most dazzling and glorious one.
Fu Sui’s Essence Soul was in excruciating pain, causing his embodiment in the Cang Alliance space to tremble slightly.
We had the same encounter, but different outcomes.
Fu Sui’s eyes were deep as he thought to himself,
All cultivators have their own destinies. As for true experts, they need to be able to withstand fate and change it.
Fu Sui had never given up. He felt that he had a chance of recovering from his Essence Soul injuries.
...
Eastcalm has reached the peak of the Sixth Tribulation realm?
Old Fiend Black Wind sat in the palace and looked at the endless void outside thoughtfully. He had gained a lot from the path of possession.
Although he vaguely felt that the path of possession was wrong when he was close to comprehending a Sixth Tribulation law, he had still seen many Sixth Tribulation laws. After leaving Fiend Mountain, he naturally comprehended a Sixth Tribulation law as he accumulated insights.
He didn’t deliberately pursue it. All he did was accumulate insights. However, he vaguely felt that the law he had comprehended might have flaws. Therefore, he didn’t create a physical body formulation.
We went on the same expedition, but Eastcalm has already reached the peak of the Sixth Tribulation realm. There’s no need for me to be too afraid. It’s time to create a Sixth Tribulation body formulation
, thought Black Wind.
I can first create a body and raise it until it’s one step away from perfection. There’s no need to rush the tribulation transcendence.
Black Wind was a cautious person. This was a habit he had cultivated over tens of thousands of years.
...
Heavenly Dream Realm.
Meng Hu was still immersed in the Hundred Lives Dream Realm as he struggled in his training. If he could wake up, he would reap great benefits. But if he didn’t wake up... he would sleep until the day he died.
The four who had entered Fiend Mountain together all took different paths.
Final Chapter of Volume—White Avian Hall

chapters.title: Chapter 688 - Eighth Tribulation Eminence Opens His Eyes
chapters.content:
Chapter 688: Eighth Tribulation Eminence Opens His Eyes
Archean Eon Realm, in a chamber inside of Heaven and Earth Great Hall.
The white-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan sat cross-legged and looked at the three items on the wooden tray in front of him: a black book, a fragrant cyan fruit, and a silver cube.
There are very few secrets in the River of Spacetime that I’m not aware of.
Meng Chuan looked at the three items in front of him in puzzlement.
After reaching the peak of the Sixth Tribulation realm, he could read White Avian Hall’s books and legacies freely. White Avian Hall had also divulged many of the River of Spacetime’s secrets to him.
The intelligence detailed many secrets in the River of Spacetime. There were many secrets regarding the current Seventh Tribulation Eminences, the half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences, and the peak Sixth Tribulation Eminences. There was also a detailed description of Fiend Mountain, Chaos Turbid River, and the Land of Foulbone, as well as the many high-level inhabited worlds and secrets related to Eighth Tribulation Eminences.
However, there are no records of the three items in front of me.
Meng Chuan looked at the items.
The black book’s faint aura alarmed Meng Chuan. It felt like the Eternal treasure—the Great Seal. As the owner of an Eternal treasure, Meng Chuan knew very well that the black book was still quite far from an Eternal treasure. However, it had a particularly similar trait.
The silver cube looked ordinary.
I’ll eat it first.
Without any hesitation, Meng Chuan opened his mouth and sucked, causing the cyan fruit on the wooden tray to fly into his mouth immediately.
It felt a little dry and sapid. Meng Chuan crushed it with a single bite and swallowed it.
This fruit?
Meng Chuan frowned in puzzlement. He took a whiff of the fragrance and ate it. However, it felt like countless grains of sand were stirring in his stomach. The countless leptons in his body stirred. His Essence Soul was also composed of leptons.
He felt very uncomfortable from the stirring.
Could it be poisonous?
Meng Chuan couldn’t help but have this thought.
It’s impossible for it to be poisonous. Hall Lord White Avian gave me treasures that are worth 20 million cubes to build a karmic relationship with me. If he deliberately wants to harm me, it would have huge karmic implications. He wants to reach the Eighth Tribulation realm, so he definitely won’t do such a thing.
Meng Chuan endured the pain. His body and Essence Soul felt uncomfortable everywhere. The feeling of every lepton being stirred wasn’t an excruciating pain, but he felt nausea, convulsions, and panic...
Meng Chuan couldn’t suppress this feeling. He was affected by every stirring lepton, and it was worse than being punished.
If it were a Fourth or Fifth Tribulation Eminence with weaker willpower, the leptons might’ve scattered uncontrollably and caused their deaths. However, Meng Chuan’s willpower had already reached the level required for the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm thanks to his progress on Fiend Mountain. Furthermore, he had a Lepton Undying Body. It was naturally impossible for him to be in any danger of dying, but he still suffered.
This torment lasted for nearly ten minutes.
Meng Chuan raised his eyebrows. He felt like the countless grains of ‘sand’ in his body and Essence Soul had completely shattered. They turned into water that nourished his Essence Soul.
Happiness came after suffering!
The feeling of having his Essence Soul nourished was wonderful. Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul trembled.
Boom!
The fruit’s power fused with Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul and instantly brought a wisp of his Essence Soul thought out of the River of Spacetime.
This Essence Soul thought of mine has left the universe?
After all, Meng Chuan had comprehended a complete spatial law. He was very certain that this Essence Soul thought had instantly left the universe. It was like a fish leaving a river. This Essence Soul thought could no longer sense the spatial law.
The moment he left the universe, he instantly rushed into a place. This was a place with concentrated turbulence.
Countless streams of water surged.
There was no way for him to ‘observe’ this place. Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul thought could only vaguely sense the area. In the turbulent flow, he could only identify ten streams.
These ten streams of water were the ten Origins laws Meng Chuan had sensed when he cultivated! Although he took the direction of the Chaos Hole law, he could sense the other nine Origins laws.
Whoosh.
The fruit’s power wrapped around Meng Chuan as it moved forward. It seemed to follow the stream.
Go there.
Under Meng Chuan’s control, the fruit’s power carried Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul thought into one of the ten water streams.
This stream of water wasn’t the Chaos Hole law stream that Meng Chuan was most familiar with. This was because Meng Chuan was very close to comprehending the Chaos Hole law after he grasped the spatial law, lepton law, and lightning law. There was no need to use the fruit’s opportunity on a nomological path that he was confident of grasping in a short period of time.
Meng Chuan chose the Heaven Splitting law!
The Heaven Splitting law was a law that created the universe. It was very mysterious, and it was very difficult to grasp out of the ten Origins laws.
As it was difficult to see the creation of the universe with one’s own eyes, one could only deduce and comprehend it with their imagination. Therefore, many Seventh Tribulation Eminences grasped laws like the Immeasurable law, Karma law, and Samsara law. However, very few could comprehend the Heaven Splitting law.
The Chaos Hole law devoured everything and returned everything to nirvana. As for the Heaven Splitting law, it created a universe. These were two opposing Origins laws.
Only by cultivating opposing paths could one become truly powerful. It benefited one’s grasp of time and space.
For example, the Immeasurable law and the Matter law were completely opposite laws that could fuse as one. This was because an Eighth Tribulation Eminence could grasp time, space, and all Origins laws. They could naturally grasp completely different laws.
Boom!
The fruit wrapped around Meng Chuan and entered the stream of water.
Meng Chuan only found the stream as vast as the sea after entering. Meng Chuan was completely immersed in it.
The fruit’s power carried Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul thought as it roamed the area.
Heaven Splitting.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul thought swam in the water, and the water seeped into his Essence Soul. Meng Chuan then vaguely saw scenes.
A towering figure brandished his axe and cleaved out an infinite world.
A black divine dragon tore open a vast world with a swipe of its claw. The black divine dragon glanced at Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul thought from afar as its whiskers fluttered.
Dragon Ancestor?
Although Meng Chuan had never seen Dragon Ancestor before, he could sense that the dark divine dragon had recognized him and was paying attention to him. They even exchanged looks.
Meng Chuan had a strong feeling that it was Dragon Ancestor.
...
It was unknown what the winding, black divine dragon was good at. It seemed to be sleeping, but the timeline was rapidly moving.
Ten thousand years, twenty thousand years, thirty thousand years...
Perhaps he had only taken a short nap, but hundreds of millions of years had passed in the outside world.
Oh?
The black divine dragon suddenly opened its eyes, and the timeline completely stopped.
The mark that reflects endless spacetime when I created a universe is actually discovered by a little fellow in my homeworld.
The black divine dragon revealed a smile. Very few things could touch him. The dragons didn’t dare awaken the Dragon Ancestor unless something major happened.
For example, the Nine Trials Pagoda gave out treasures according to his rules. The Dragon Ancestor had never observed Meng Chuan before. At his realm, it was very difficult to see his true appearance after he had completely jumped out of the River of Spacetime.
Dragon Ancestor noticed Meng Chuan when he saw the mark.
Meng Chuan? He’s a kid with great potential. It’s not difficult for him to reach the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm.
The black divine dragon glanced at him.
This era in my home universe is a very powerful era. There might be three half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences appearing at the same time.
He only took a glance and didn’t pay much attention to Meng Chuan. This was because only one in a hundred people could break through to the Eighth Tribulation realm from the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm.
Only an Eighth Tribulation Eminence could be considered his peer.
The black divine dragon closed its eyes again as the timeline continued moving.
...
Scenes appeared.
Meng Chuan saw 19 scenes. They seemed to be scenes of different universes opening up. Every existence that opened up a universe was extremely terrifying. Only the black divine dragon looked at Meng Chuan. The other existences ignored him.
As his Essence Soul thought roamed the area, the fruit’s strength was constantly consumed.
There doesn’t seem to be an end to this place.
Meng Chuan swam through the Heaven Splitting law sea with great difficulty. His Essence Soul thought was constantly affected as the fruit’s strength decreased.
Finally, after holding on for a while, the fruit’s power was completely exhausted.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul thought was instantly destroyed.
...
Huh?
In a chamber in Archean Eon Realm’s Heaven and Earth Great Hall, the white-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan suddenly jolted awake.

chapters.title: Chapter 689 - Heaven Splitting
chapters.content:
Chapter 689: Heaven Splitting
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in the chamber, unable to calm his emotions for a long time.
Who would’ve imagined that a wisp of my Essence Soul would leave the River of Spacetime just now?
Those below the Eighth Tribulation realm couldn’t rely on themselves to leave the River of Spacetime. They had to rely on external forces. For example, having an Eighth Tribulation Eminence bring them along. As for the fruit, it was inferior to a true Eighth Tribulation Eminence, so it could only carry one wisp of a person’s Essence Soul and head to that mysterious land.
I also saw Dragon Ancestor. I can confirm that he saw me too.
Dragon Ancestor created a universe?
Meng Chuan clearly remembered the 19 scenes of the universe creation. He didn’t feel like he knew the other 18. They probably didn’t have any karmic relations in the past.
According to the intelligence given to me by White Avian Hall, Dragon Ancestor is the wealthiest Eighth Tribulation Eminence born in my home universe. He’s also the strongest. However, I never expected Dragon Ancestor to be capable of creating a universe. He can create a universe, but he hasn’t reached the Eternal realm?
The current me is far inferior to Dragon Ancestor.
Meng Chuan carefully sensed his changes.
To an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence, an Essence Soul thought was like an Essence Soul avatar. The Essence Soul thought had roamed the Heaven Splitting law sea and experienced the special powers from the influence. Meng Chuan’s true body and other Essence Soul avatars had also grasped them.
Condense.
With a thought, a terrifying sharp beam condensed in his illusory Essence Soul World.
This sharp beam naturally contained the Heaven Splitting law. It was like a blade that could split open the heavens. It was extremely sharp and could destroy anything.
Heaven Splitting Blade?
Meng Chuan sensed the Heaven Splitting Blade condensed in his Essence Soul.
I haven’t even figured out the Heaven Splitting law, but I can already use a sharp blade that contains the Heaven Splitting law?
He had grasped three Sixth Tribulation laws. The spatial law was related to the Heaven Splitting law. To comprehend the Heaven Splitting law, he had to comprehend the spatial law first.
As for the lightning law and the lepton law, they were only partially related to the Heaven Splitting law.
Meng Chuan flipped his hand and took out the Spacetime Token. Immediately, an Essence Soul avatar entered the pocket universe within.
Boom!
The black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan struck out in a dark void in the pocket universe.
A black beam appeared out of thin air. Instantly, the vast land in front of him was split into two! It was completely sliced apart. It was 50 trillion kilometers wide, and this was a result of Meng Chuan not deliberately crossing spacetime.
When a Seventh Tribulation Eminence attacked, their every move affected an extremely vast area.
Is this a move at the Seventh Tribulation realm? It feels very similar to Guild Master Darkstar’s punch and palm.
Meng Chuan was somewhat shocked.
...
In Heaven and Earth Great Hall, Meng Chuan sat cross-legged. He was still immersed in the might of the Heaven Splitting Blade.
I haven’t grasped the Heaven Splitting law, but I can already use it.
Meng Chuan suddenly thought of a creature—a forbidden creature!
This is how forbidden creatures are. They don’t comprehend laws, but they can use them. Therefore, in terms of profundity and strength, the moves they use are weaker than Tribulation Eminences at the same level.
Meng Chuan knew this very well.
It’s the same for me. I only know this one move.
Compared to a Seventh Tribulation Eminence who had grasped the Heaven Splitting law, Meng Chuan only knew this one move. As for the other party, they could use moves as they pleased. In a head-on clash, the other party could easily trample him.
Without a doubt, this move of his was already at the Seventh Tribulation realm.
The Heaven Splitting law is the law with the greatest offensive strength among the ten Origins laws. All its might will be condensed into one point, allowing it to erupt completely.
Meng Chuan knew this very well.
For example, the Chaos Hole law had many characteristics—strength, a strong domain, and a strong body. Although it was inferior to the Matter law in a head-on clash, it had the advantage in domains.
There was only one thing about the Heaven Splitting law—Heaven Splitting!
Even though Guild Master Darkstar had a Seventh Tribulation body and was extremely powerful, making him good at head-on clashes, the Matter law was inferior to the Heaven Splitting law in terms of a law’s explosive strength.
Even if Meng Chuan used his Essence Soul World to condense the Heaven Splitting Blade, it was nearly as powerful as Guild Master Darkstar’s attack. However, since Guild Master Darkstar had completely grasped an Origins law, his combat prowess was much more exquisite. In a head-on clash, he would probably be able to defeat Meng Chuan quickly.
Regardless, this is the only Seventh Tribulation move I can use now.
Meng Chuan was somewhat excited. Although he could greatly increase his strength with the help of Spacetime Token and a powerful Eighth Tribulation treasure, treasures could be snatched away.
Any Essence Soul avatar could use the moves he grasped.
I’m a little like a Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature. I haven’t grasped any laws, but I can use Seventh Tribulation moves. Furthermore, I’m weaker than them. A Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature has reached the Seventh Tribulation realm in life’s natural order.
Meng Chuan mocked himself, but he was very happy.
On the one hand, he had grasped a killer move. Most importantly, it would be much easier for him to grasp the Heaven Splitting law if he used it frequently.
I’ve gained a lot from the first of the three treasures that Hall Lord gave me.
Meng Chuan looked at the remaining two treasures on the wooden tray—a black book and a silver cube.
This book.
Meng Chuan reached out to pick up the black book and flipped open the page.
On the first page, his Essence Soul thought sensed a message—”An Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence can become my disciple by breaking the 3,000 illusory arrays in the book.”
The message was very simple. It was ordinary, without any pressure or extraordinary aspects. However, its claim was ridiculous.
An Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence can only become his disciple after breaking through 3,000 illusory arrays? Who is he? An Eternal existence?
Meng Chuan muttered to himself.
Considering that this book had some similarities to the Great Seal Eternal treasure, Meng Chuan believed that it was really a book left behind by an Eternal. Furthermore, Hall Lord White Avian had personally given it to him. Its value was astonishing. Thus, the authenticity of these words should be very high.
An Eternal existence has such a high threshold for accepting disciples?
Meng Chuan thought to himself. Only three of the Seventh Tribulation Eminences in this era were at the Essence Soul Tribulation realm.
The Essence Soul lineage had a small ratio amongst the total number of Seventh Tribulation Eminences. It was the same for an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence. The creation of a physical body formulation was something visible and substantial. One knew the goal to work towards, but the willpower one required to reach the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm was unimaginably high.
There was a fundamental difference between reaching the peak of Fiend Mountain and the willpower required to reach the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm.
According to what I know, due to Dragon Ancestor’s influence, our River of Spacetime mainly focuses on the physical body cultivation system.
Dragon Ancestor had indeed left behind many legacies. For example, the sacrificial scroll and other similar means made it easier for one to cultivate the physical body cultivation system.
Dragon Ancestor’s attainments in the physical body cultivation system were too high. This made this universe’s physical body cultivation system very robust.
According to White Avian Hall’s intelligence, there are much fewer Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminences outside the universe than there are Physical Body Eighth Tribulation Eminences.
According to this book, even an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence might not be able to become a disciple?
Meng Chuan looked at the book.
I’ll take a look at the 3,000 illusory array first.
Meng Chuan flipped to another page, and his Essence Soul seeped into the book world.
This was an illusory world that was about 50 kilometers wide. In the illusory world, there was only soil, water, and a blade of grass.
I have to crack this illusory array?
Meng Chuan looked at the simple illusory world, but he didn’t know what to do.
Mud, water, grass? That’s it?
Meng Chuan stared blankly.
He could see through the profundities behind the soil, water, and grass, but this simple illusory world was perfect. He couldn’t find any flaws.
Boom!
Meng Chuan casually waved his hand.
The grass was destroyed, but it condensed and recovered.
Three laws work cyclically. Perfect.
Meng Chuan meditated for six hours before coming to a realization. He extended his hand and gently tapped the void.
A fluctuation spread out. The entire illusory world seemed to be operating perfectly, but it completely collapsed the moment the key point was pried open.
Interesting.
However, Meng Chuan gained something. He gained a new understanding of an Essence Soul World’s structure.
When Meng Chuan cracked the simplest illusion array, the black book naturally flipped to the second page. Meng Chuan immersed himself in it again.
...
It took him six hours to crack the first page of the illusory array and 6.5 months to crack the second page. Meng Chuan then read the third page, but he couldn’t understand it at all.
At his current realm, he could only crack two of the 3,000 illusory arrays.

chapters.title: Chapter 690 - Heading for the Chaos Turbid River
chapters.content:
Chapter 690: Heading for the Chaos Turbid River
Meng Chuan looked at the black book in front of him.
On the surface, this book is an opportunity to become the disciple of an Eternal existence. However, what’s precious is the 3,000 illusory arrays.
It was probably very difficult for an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence to crack all 3,000 illusory arrays.
But after each array formation was broken, one would gain a deeper understanding of illusory arrays. Perhaps after breaking 1,000 illusory arrays, one would have a chance of grasping the laws of time and space.
Although the effects on one’s strength were negligible now, and it was far inferior to the strength increase brought about by the fruit, the benefits brought by the black book would probably be much greater over a long period of time. However, if one’s cultivation realm wasn’t high enough, they wouldn’t be able to understand the illusory arrays much. Therefore, how much they gained depended on their potential.
The third treasure.
Meng Chuan looked at the silver cube.
What is this treasure?
Meng Chuan’s Power of Essence Soul seeped into the silver cube.
Boom—
A mystic treasure?
Meng Chuan was extremely shocked. He completely immersed his consciousness into the silver cube. Although it looked perfect, it was actually formed from six parts.
This silver cube is a composite mystic treasure?
After all, Meng Chuan had grasped the spatial law, so he could tell what the treasure was.
Each of the six parts looks like an ordinary Eighth Tribulation treasure. It’s probably not even comparable to the Heavenly Punishment Chart. Its value is probably only 200,000 to 300,000 cubes. But when combined, it undergoes a qualitative change. It’s probably very difficult to buy it, even with millions of cubes.
Meng Chuan was knowledgeable. It was common for Eighth Tribulation treasures to collectively form an array formation.
Meng Chuan had seen the Tri-Ring Chaos Hole Array in the Nine Trials Pagoda. However, this silver cube was even better.
It had completely combined six Eighth Tribulation mystic treasures into a new mystic treasure!
Controlling a composite mystic treasure is much harder than controlling six separate Eighth Tribulation mystic treasures.
Meng Chuan also understood this point. As long as he used them separately, he only needed to divert his attention. He just needed a strong enough Essence Soul!
However, it was much harder to use a composite mystic treasure. His entire being was required. The burden on his Essence Soul was also terrifying.
A composite mystic treasure formed by six Eighth Tribulation mystic treasures is slightly weaker than a Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s Essence Soul. It can only be used by Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
Meng Chuan’s eyes burned as he looked at the floating silver cube in front of him.
More importantly, the six parts of this silver cube are actually Eighth Tribulation spacetime mystic treasures.
Although ordinary Eighth Tribulation mystic treasures contained laws of time and space, to gather more strength, they contained more than one Origins law.
Examples of such treasures included: the Tri-Ring Chaos Hole Array, the Heart of Immeasurable, and the Heavenly Punishment Chart.
It doesn’t contain any Origins laws. It’s purely the profundities of time and space.
Meng Chuan looked at it.
It forms a composite Eighth Tribulation mystic treasure.
This was an ostentatious piece of work.
Meng Chuan felt that this was a mighty existence flaunting his accomplishments in spacetime. However, this was also the best target for study.
Comprehending a mystic treasure is one of my means for cultivation. This silver cube is very suitable for studying time and space.
Meng Chuan was very satisfied. In terms of value, the third item was slightly higher than the first two items.
The silver cube was a very powerful weapon, and it was also beneficial for cultivation! Meng Chuan was extremely impressed by the treasure refiner.
Creating such a composite treasure is probably much harder than creating an Eighth Tribulation mystic technique. If I were the refiner, I would probably refine about ten of such treasures and sell them in different Rivers of Spacetime.
Meng Chuan knew this very well.
An Eighth Tribulation treasure refined by other Eighth Tribulation Eminences was worth hundreds of thousands of cubes.
This refiner had refined a pure spacetime lineage treasure that was worth nearly ten million cubes. This was a brand!
Hall Lord White Avian was already very humble to say that these three treasures are worth 20 million cubes.
Meng Chuan felt how great the debt of gratitude was.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon had accumulated a lot in his life. But other than the Great Seal Eternal treasure, none of his other treasures could compare to these three treasures. It was very difficult for him to exchange for such rare treasures through bartering.
These three treasures are very beneficial to me. Perhaps they can double my cultivation speed.
Meng Chuan pondered.
I wonder what Hall Lord White Avian wants me to do for him.
He was prepared to listen to the other party’s summons at any moment.
...
In an area in the outer realm, the black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan was flying at high speed toward the Chaos Turbid River. He wanted to kill a forbidden creature.
He had to end the karma. Otherwise, if he didn’t do what he had promised, his future cultivation path would be ten times more difficult due to karmic interference.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan used a mystic technique, and the void didn’t repel him.
