After flying for another half a month, I should reach the Chaos Turbid River.
Ever since Meng Chuan grasped the spatial law, he had never flown like this before.
The Chaos Turbid River is surrounded by layers of array formations. In history, many Eighth Tribulation Eminences have reinforced the array formations. Unless one can jump out of the River of Spacetime, no other means can be used to cross it. Only by flying slowly can one reach the Chaos Turbid River.
After becoming a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence, he obtained a large amount of information from White Avian Hall. Meng Chuan now knew many secrets, including the detailed information about the Chaos Turbid River.
According to White Avian Hall’s records, the Chaos Turbid River was created by Fiend Mountain’s owner!
Fiend Mountain’s owner was one of the top Eighth Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime’s history. He placed himself above all living beings. He didn’t deliberately slaughter living beings, but due to his cultivation experiments, he had killed countless Tribulation Eminences. The harm brought about by the Fiend Mountain ruin was relatively small in comparison. Forbidden creatures were much more dangerous. Forbidden creatures were Chaos creatures. They were lifeforms outside the universe that couldn’t enter the universe.
Fiend Mountain’s owner had deliberately opened up a Chaos Turbid River and connected it to areas beyond the universe, luring Chaos creatures into the universe.
The Chaos Turbid River was a trap; it deliberately lured Chaos creatures in.
In the early days, Fiend Mountain’s owner had even placed forbidden creatures in the outer realm. He had caused quite a lot of trouble, causing other Eighth Tribulation Eminences to appear in that era. They forced Fiend Mountain’s owner to stop and finally reinforced the Chaos Turbid River.
From then on... forbidden creatures entered the Chaos Turbid River from outer space. Once they entered, they couldn’t leave. They were fish waiting to be slaughtered.
However, Fiend Mountain’s owner’s experiments on forbidden creatures occasionally caused forbidden creatures to appear everywhere in the universe. However, the threat wasn’t worth mentioning.
Fiend Mountain’s owner really does whatever he wants. He can do whatever he wants. Furthermore, he’s very powerful. Only when all the Eighth Tribulation Eminences in history appear together did they force him to bow his head.
Meng Chuan could tell from the intelligence that some Eighth Tribulation Eminences in history were very unhappy with Fiend Mountain’s owner, but they still tolerated him.
On the one hand, they came from the same universe. On the other hand, it was very difficult to kill an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. It was very difficult for an Eighth Tribulation Eminence to be found once they jumped out of the timeline.
Furthermore, according to the intelligence, Fiend Mountain’s owner didn’t deliberately engage in a massacre. Instead, he was conducting experiments.
Fiend Mountain ruin was an experiment, so were the forbidden creatures. There were also other experiments... Some of these experiments had disastrous results, but some were successful.
From White Avian Hall’s intelligence, only the owner of Fiend Mountain purchases the Life Cores of forbidden creatures.
Meng Chuan originally thought that the Life Cores were very important to Eighth Tribulation Eminences. He never expected that the other Eighth Tribulation Eminences didn’t need them at all.
Meng Chuan flew leisurely.
Although there were layers of array formations, Meng Chuan knew the mystic technique to enter and exit the array formations. After flying for a long time, he finally arrived at the Chaos Turbid River.
I’m here.
After reaching the end, Meng Chuan used a mystic technique and charged forward. He suddenly vanished into thin air and entered a hidden spacetime—Chaos Turbid River!

chapters.title: Chapter 691 - Above the Turbid River
chapters.content:
Chapter 691: Above the Turbid River
Meng Chuan felt his surroundings change, and he found himself standing on the vast water surface.
The water was turbid. He couldn’t even see one foot underwater.
The water surface was infinitely long and wide! From Meng Chuan’s point of view, the Chaos Turbid River was more suitable to be called ‘Chaos Turbid Sea.’
I’m only at the peak of the Sixth Tribulation realm now, so I can’t see its full appearance. If I reach the Eighth Tribulation realm, I might understand why it’s called a river.
Just like how Tribulation Eminences felt that the River of Spacetime was boundless, Meng Chuan could sense the entire River of Spacetime with the help of a rare treasure—the Spacetime Token. He also understood that it was indeed in the shape of a river.
This Chaos Turbid River connected the interior and exterior of the universe. Chaos creatures outside the universe were drawn in, never to leave. The Chaos Turbid River itself was naturally mysterious.
The sky above is illusory.
Meng Chuan looked up and found the sky gloomy and depressing.
According to the intelligence, I’ll be in the Chaos Turbid River if I fly half a billion kilometers up. If I fly downwards, pass through the entire Chaos Turbid River, and continue down... I’ll still be in the Chaos Turbid River if I fly half a billion kilometers.
Meng Chuan knew.
No matter where he went, he would forever be in the Chaos Turbid River’s range. He would never find its end.
Therefore, weaker Sixth Tribulation and the stronger Seventh Tribulation forbidden creatures were forever trapped here.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan tried to fly up. After leaving the water surface, he felt an invisible force pulling at him, hoisting him up.
With a thought, he teleported 50 million kilometers upwards.
Boom!
The drag force on the vast lake below was terrifying. Meng Chuan’s body was sheared by the forces and collapsed. He quickly plummeted at high speeds.
Only when his body collapsed did he stabilize.
Only by touching the water surface can flying be the easiest.
Meng Chuan landed on the water and walked on it.
Using the spatial law, I can sense a range of 50 million kilometers. The maximum distance I can teleport is also 50 million kilometers.
Meng Chuan had long expected this. The intelligence reports were very accurate.
Usually, he could travel from one end of a river zone to the other in a single step. However, he could only teleport 50 million kilometers in the Chaos Turbid River that trapped forbidden creatures. If an ordinary Sixth Tribulation Eminence entered, it would be difficult for them to sense a range of 5,000 kilometers!
I’ll search for prey.
Meng Chuan instantly split into three Essence Soul avatars.
The three black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuans flew in different directions.
...
Searching for forbidden creatures in the Chaos Turbid River required some luck. This was because the area was too vast. Be it cultivators or forbidden creatures, their perception range was limited. Therefore, Meng Chuan arranged for his three Essence Soul avatars to search separately.
The second day after Meng Chuan arrived at the Chaos Turbid River.
Boom!
One of Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars approached the water surface and transformed into a bolt of lightning that flew at high speeds.
Below, in the depths of Chaos Turbid River, a distance about 500,000 kilometers away from Meng Chuan.
A faint black shadow slowly floated up. This black shadow spanned more than 500 kilometers. A huge eye in the black shadow stared at Meng Chuan, who was flying above the water.
It slowly floated up, but when it floated up, it would occasionally cross a segment of space and constantly shrink the distance between it and Meng Chuan.
My luck isn’t bad. I encountered a forbidden creature the second day I arrived.
Meng Chuan—who appeared unaware of this—was rather expectant. Having grasped the spatial law, his perception range spanned 50 million kilometers. Thus, he had long discovered the forbidden creature.
After discovering it, he deliberately flew toward the forbidden creature’s territory to let it discover him.
When it was over four million kilometers away, the forbidden creature sensed Meng Chuan and silently approached.
Only after traveling millions of kilometers did it discover me. It should be a top Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature,
Meng Chuan guessed.
Just like in the Fiend Mountain ruin, there were Fifth Tribulation and peak Fifth Tribulation forbidden creatures.
Forbidden creatures from the Chaos Turbid River came from beyond the universe. Their means were strange and unpredictable; they were extremely powerful to begin with. In the Chaos Turbid River, forbidden creatures would devour each other and continue to become stronger. It was very normal for them to have top Sixth Tribulation realm strength. It was also possible for them to be stronger.
There were even Seventh Tribulation forbidden creatures.
It’s here. It’s getting closer and closer.
Meng Chuan only used the lightning law to fly, acting as though he didn’t notice anything. Secretly, two Essence Soul avatars were separately hundreds of millions of kilometers away. They entered deep into the Chaos Turbid River and carefully sensed their surroundings in search of the forbidden creature’s Life Core.
The gigantic black shadow was getting closer and closer to the bottom of the pool.
The distance between them shrank. 500,000 kilometers, 400,000 kilometers, 300,000 kilometers, 250,000 kilometers... 150,000 kilometers.
When it was 150,000 kilometers away, the black shadow stopped approaching.
Why did it stop?
Meng Chuan was secretly puzzled as he continued flying normally.
A pink fog suddenly entered Meng Chuan’s sea of consciousness and attacked his Essence Soul.
The moment the fog corroded his Essence Soul, Meng Chuan felt intense pain.
In his Essence Soul World, a white-robed, beautiful woman appeared. With her charm, she wanted to bewitch the entire Essence Soul World.
The woman’s appearance is very similar to that of a human. Is she transformed according to my will?
Boom!
The forbidden creature’s attack on Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul came without any warning. It launched a heavy assault on his Essence Soul and also bewitched Meng Chuan’s consciousness. Even an Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence’s Essence Soul would be greatly affected by such an attack that attacked both internally and externally, even if their Essence Soul didn’t dissipate.
Meng Chuan stepped on the water surface, and an illusory white face appeared below him. It opened its mouth wide and swallowed Meng Chuan.
If Meng Chuan’s consciousness were blank, he would be devoured.
Forbidden creature!
Meng Chuan wore a look of shock and anger. With a wave of his hand, bolts of lightning struck the white face beneath his feet. Every bolt of lightning contained two laws—lightning and lepton. Just three bolts of lightning completely destroyed the white face.
At the moment of destruction, a huge black shadow approached from the bottom of the water. At the same time, white faces flew out from the massive black shadow.
Instantly, thousands of white faces surfaced.
Deep in the water, white faces grinned, roared ferociously, were enthusiastic, or were cold. In the blink of an eye, a large number of white faces surfaced and surrounded Meng Chuan.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Meng Chuan looked alarmed as he frantically used lightning. Large amounts of lightning struck in all directions. But after destroying hundreds of white faces, even more faces completely drowned Meng Chuan.
On the huge black shadow, the single eye watched everything excitedly.
An Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence? Not bad for food.
Huh?
The black shadow suddenly ‘saw’ a pair of dark eyes.
The dark eyes stared at it. The black shadow felt that its consciousness could not resist. The eyes were like bottomless abysses that devoured its consciousness.
What a powerful Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence.
The black shadow could barely sense the outside world, and it couldn’t use any offensive means. The few thousand white faces—which had been released—silently dissipated.
The black shadow was very shocked. This was because it was very good at using mind and consciousness techniques. However, it was unable to resist the Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence’s attack.
It didn’t know that Meng Chuan’s willpower was extremely high to begin with. After grasping the spatial law, he had cultivated the Pupil of Darkness mystic technique to a higher realm, allowing him to unleash much greater strength.
The tens of thousands of white faces around him dissipated. Meng Chuan was extremely furious. With a wave of his hand, he condensed Chaos Hole Lightning Spears and smote the black shadow.
I know. You’re good at Essence Soul mystic techniques.
The black shadow stared at Meng Chuan without panicking at all. It allowed the Chaos Hole Lightning Spears to strike its body as they furiously struck down. In a few seconds, the black shadow was completely annihilated.
At the same time, millions of kilometers beneath the water surface...
The black shadow condensed again.
A Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature was immortal as long as their Life Core didn’t shatter.

chapters.title: Chapter 692 - Attention
chapters.content:
Chapter 692: Attention
I found it.
Meng Chuan—who was standing atop the water surface—was delighted.
The most important thing when killing a Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature was to find its Life Core!
A Life Core could be anything. For example, a ship, a flag, a wine cup, a drop of blood, a grain of sand, a blade of grass, a corpse, a mountain, a star, a mystic treasure... Everything could be a forbidden creature’s Life Core. Furthermore, it could be disguised. There was nothing special about it when disguised.
This made defeating forbidden creatures easy, but completely killing them difficult.
Meng Chuan deliberately pretended to be weak because he was afraid of scaring the forbidden creature. If he revealed his peak Sixth Tribulation realm strength and killed the other party’s true body, his opponent would be so scared that they wouldn’t dare condense their true bodies outside of their Life Core. How could Meng Chuan find a Life Core in the vast Chaos Turbid River?
A Life Core is ordinary. Only by condensing a new true body will there be energy fluctuations. Furthermore, the true body condensed won’t be too far from the Life Core.
Meng Chuan’s three Essence Soul avatars secretly circled the area as they used the spatial law to sense the area carefully.
The moment the black figure used its Life Core to condense its true body, the Life Core’s fluctuations exposed the Life Core’s location.
There.
Meng Chuan discovered that a stream of water was hidden in the Chaos Turbid River—which was 6 million kilometers away from him. It was like a part of the river, but it was exposed when the black figure condensed.
Die!
Meng Chuan’s figure vanished into thin air. When he reappeared, he was already close to the invisible stream. Absolute Space repelled all the other water currents around the stream in question, imprisoning the fist-sized stream of water only.
A face immediately appeared on the fist-sized stream of water. It opened its mouth in a bid to beg for mercy. “No...”
Pa!
As Meng Chuan watched, Absolute Space instantly diced the fist-sized stream of water into eight pieces. The face was completely destroyed as it wailed in despair.
After it was sliced apart, the Life Core completely revealed itself. It was a crystal ball that had shattered into eight pieces.
Crystal ball?
Meng Chuan stretched out his hand, and the Life Core fragments flew into his hand. They were like translucent crystal ball fragments.
I don’t know what use these Life Core fragments have. Only Fiend Mountain’s owner is buying them wantonly.
Meng Chuan shook his head slightly.
Demon Slayer can only devour Life Core fragments with baneful aura, but there are many types of Life Core fragments. Baneful aura is only one of them.
Meng Chuan vaguely felt that forbidden creatures likely represented another powerful path. They were more powerful than Tribulation Eminences in certain aspects. For example, a Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature’s Life Core was on the brink of being conceptualized. Its life-preservation abilities were superior to most Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
They could devour everything, including inhabited worlds. They could live for a very, very long time until their consciousness completely decayed and collapsed. Then, a new consciousness would be born in their Life Core. The length of their lifespan—the point when their consciousness dissipated—didn’t need elaboration.
Their survivability, devouring ability, and lifespan all exceeded that of cultivators. However, this system was clearly not easy to study. Otherwise, the other Eighth Tribulation Eminences would’ve long purchased Life Cores.
After pondering for a moment and failing to discover anything special about the crystal ball fragment, Meng Chuan put it away and flew toward the black corpse in the distance.
A true corpse.
Meng Chuan observed.
As long as the Life Core remained intact, one could never obtain a Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature’s true corpse. It would completely disappear and condense when resurrected.
This corpse?
Meng Chuan frowned as he looked at it. This was a large stretch of black algae that spanned more than 500 kilometers. There was a soft body under the algae, and the large eye was already closed.
What a strange lifeform.
Meng Chuan put it away.
The first Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature target is eliminated.
...
Meng Chuan had two solutions to completing the karmic debt of killing Sixth Tribulation forbidden creatures.
The first was to use Eternal Tower, White Avian Hall, and other intelligence channels to investigate which river zone’s river system had a Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature. With the River of Spacetime’s vastness, there were still a few Sixth Tribulation forbidden creatures. These forbidden creatures were naturally born in the outer realm’s void, and they were generally weaker than those in the Chaos Turbid River. Hence, it was easier to kill them.
However, the disadvantage was that it was very difficult to find a Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature, even if he knew that a river system had one.
Therefore, Meng Chuan chose the second method—to come to the Chaos Turbid River!
Meng Chuan was strong enough, and he was an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence. He wasn’t afraid of his Essence Soul avatars dying in battle, so he naturally dared to come to this dangerous place.
...
The Chaos Turbid River was just too large. Although Meng Chuan could sense everything within 50 million kilometers, and his three Essence Soul avatars acted independently, it wasn’t easy to encounter a forbidden creature.
More than a month later, Meng Chuan encountered a second Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature.
Boom!
After a difficult battle, Meng Chuan finally killed the forbidden creature’s true body—which resembled a blood-colored flower.
Why isn’t it reviving? Where’s its Life Core?
Meng Chuan felt a little helpless while above the Chaos Turbid River. He could determine that the other party was still alive through karma, but he couldn’t sense its location.
I only revealed 20% of my strength. It was very strenuous for me to kill one of its true bodies. Yet, it’s so scared that it doesn’t dare show its face?
As long as it resurrected and condensed a new true body, Meng Chuan could lock onto the other party’s true body through karma. However, the other party had completely hidden in its Life Core, preventing any karma locking.
I probably won’t be able to kill this Tribulation Eminence even if I use all my strength. I have to be careful; I’ll hide for 1,000 years before condensing my true body.
Over 4.5 million kilometers away from Meng Chuan, a Life Core—disguised as a stream of water—flowed through the Chaos Turbid River. It didn’t condense a new true body, and there were no fluctuations. Thus, Meng Chuan couldn’t sense it.
I’ve already shown weakness to the enemy, but I still gave it a scare.
Meng Chuan was helpless.
No matter how weak I am, I have to get rid of the other party’s true body. If I don’t force the other party to revive, how can I find a Life Core?
...
Eight months later, Meng Chuan encountered the fifth forbidden creature.
Crack! Crack! Crack!
An old wooden ship—snapped into three pieces—was in front of Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan smilingly watched the crumbling wooden ship and then looked at the eight-armed monster corpse—which was 5,000 kilometers tall—in the distance.
I’ve finally killed a second Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature.
Meng Chuan sighed with emotion and was in a good mood.
I like the Sixth Tribulation forbidden creatures that are bold and confident. They are the ones with guts!
Only those with guts would dare condense their true bodies again to continue the pursuit. Only then would Meng Chuan have a chance to reap the rewards.
The Life Core is actually a wooden ship.
Meng Chuan looked at the ancient, broken wooden ship and waved his hand to put it away. He also put away the true corpse.
I’m done once I kill another one.
Meng Chuan’s mood improved significantly. Even if he left the Chaos Turbid River and hunted a Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature in the outer realm’s void, it wouldn’t be too difficult.
...
Two and a half years later.
The forbidden creatures in the surrounding area were even more careful. Meng Chuan suspected that some of these Sixth Tribulation forbidden creatures might know each other. He had killed two of them, causing some forbidden creatures to raise their vigilance. Therefore, the effectiveness of his ‘feigning weakness’ became worse.
Boom!
As the Life Core shattered, the Life Core’s true appearance appeared—it was a broken weapon.
Its Life Core is a weapon?
Meng Chuan looked at the corpse in the distance. This forbidden creature had 13 sharp blades on its head, which resembled a crown. From its neck to its tailbone, there was a row of more than 300 blades.
This forbidden creature is the strongest one I’ve encountered. It has nearly half the strength of a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
Meng Chuan had previously tried his best to put on an act. He disguised himself as an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence that was good at the Pupil of Darkness and had an Eighth Tribulation array formation.
After a bitter battle, he killed the other party’s true body. This weapon creature failed to attack from a distance, and it wanted to engage in close combat after reviving! It clearly had many tricks up its sleeve and was still confident.
However, its revival allowed Meng Chuan to discover the hidden Life Core. Meng Chuan couldn’t be bothered to waste any more time, so he revealed all his strength, teleported close to the Life Core, and slashed it open.
I’ve finished off all three forbidden creatures.
Meng Chuan was in a good mood.
Next, I can leisurely travel the Chaos Turbid River and experience the means that are available to forbidden creatures.
Meng Chuan felt much more relaxed.
At the same time, he created an Essence Soul avatar to carry the Sixth Tribulation forbidden creatures’ Life Cores and corpses. He used the mystic technique passed down by Fiend Mountain’s owner and was silently expelled from the Chaos Turbid River. He then returned with his war spoils.
...
In an extremely remote area of the Chaos Turbid River—it was difficult to find this place without sufficient attainments in spacetime.
Whoosh.
An incomparably large, blurry face condensed in the river.
This face opened its eyes to look at the river water, but it also seemed to be prying into space.
What’s going on? Three Chaos creatures were killed in a row in such a short period of time?
Its eyes showed a little bit of perplexment. Although forbidden creatures would kill each other in the Chaos Turbid River, forbidden creatures had very powerful life-preservation means. Due to Chaos Turbid River’s vastness, only one forbidden creature would typically die every 100 to 1,000 years.
It was very abnormal for three forbidden creatures to die in just three years.
Let me see who killed the three Chaos creatures.
Its large eyes reflected one scene after another, and a large number of images appeared on the timeline.
The images quickly locked onto the scenes of the black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan killing three forbidden creatures.

chapters.title: Chapter 693 - White Avian Halls Library
chapters.content:
Chapter 693: White Avian Hall’s Library
An Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence?
A look of disappointment flashed in his huge eyes.
It’s useless to devour a weak Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
This was Bark, a general under Overlord Ashen in the Chaos’s depths. It had engaged in wars everywhere and had devoured more than ten Seventh Tribulation realm Chaos creatures. It was basically a tyrant in the Chaos.
Of course, an Eighth Tribulation Eminence that had jumped out of the River of Spacetime was far from someone he could match. Even if an Eighth Tribulation Eminence was a loner, it was enough to make an overlord in the Chaos fear and revere them. This was because, although a Chaos overlord had the strength of an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, they had yet to comprehend spacetime completely. Their true strength was slightly inferior.
That despicable Eighth Tribulation Eminence actually set up a trap. I originally thought that the place gathering Chaos Force was a treasure land... Who knew that I would enter this universe through the Chaos Turbid River and never be able to escape again.
Bark was furious and powerless. He was considered extremely powerful at the Seventh Tribulation realm, but the trap set up by Fiend Mountain’s owner had been reinforced by many Eighth Tribulation Eminences in this universe’s history! As forbidden creatures, they couldn’t escape once they entered.
Bark had been fighting since the moment his consciousness was born. He naturally wouldn’t give up easily.
There’s only one way to leave this universe—become an overlord and jump out of this River of Spacetime
, Bark thought to himself.
If I want to become an overlord, I have to devour Seventh Tribulation Eminences. The more I devour, the better.
It’s best if it’s the Seventh Tribulation Eminences in this universe. They are existences that have grasped laws. Swallowing one of them is comparable to devouring ten Chaos creatures.
Bark was filled with anticipation. This was because there was a legend in the Chaos that Tribulation Eminences—who had comprehended laws—would be of great help to their lives if they devoured them. Their evolution speed would also increase greatly.
Even if he devoured a Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s avatar, it was comparable to devouring two or three Chaos creatures of the same level.
Bark had been in this universe for many years. He had once devoured two Seventh Tribulation Eminences’ avatars, which greatly improved his strength. He originally thought that the person who killed the three Sixth Tribulation forbidden creatures in two to three years perhaps heralded a Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s arrival, leaving him somewhat excited.
Who knew that the killer was only at the Sixth Tribulation realm?
Even peak Sixth Tribulation Eminences are too weak. Only Seventh Tribulation Eminences who have grasped Origins laws will have a better Essence Soul.
Bark sighed softly as the blurry face dissipated. This face was only an embodiment of invisible forces.
...
White Avian Hall’s headquarters in the River of Spacetime.
“City Lord Eastcalm.”
“Greetings, City Lord Eastcalm.”
When Meng Chuan arrived, the Sixth Tribulation Eminences in White Avian Hall bowed from afar.
Meng Chuan walked in and soon arrived at the core of White Avian Hall. He arrived in front of a large building.
“Library?” Meng Chuan looked up.
This building was ordinary, but it was White Avian Hall’s most important place. It had a massive collection of manuals.
White Avian Hall’s ‘library’ had long been famous in the River of Spacetime. It even had an original copy of Immeasurable Universe in its collection, much less Eighth Tribulation-level manuals. As for Seventh Tribulation-level manuals, they were astonishingly plentiful. After all, there were Seventh Tribulation Eminences in every era. In all of history, the manuals left behind by Seventh Tribulation Eminences were plentiful. Even if White Avian Hall only had 1% of the original copies, it was still a massive number.
White Avian Hall’s library.
Meng Chuan walked in.
An invisible fluctuation enveloped the building, something that would make even Celestial Thearch Myriad Star find it difficult to barge in. Meng Chuan was one of the few Tribulation Eminences who didn’t suffer any restrictions and could read White Avian Hall’s books freely.
This is the benefit of joining White Avian Hall.
Meng Chuan was very satisfied with his choice from back then. The various factions’ books couldn’t compare to those of White Avian Hall. After all, White Avian Hall had received the dragons’ full help.
Meng Chuan walked into the building and looked at the bookshelves. They were filled with countless manuals.
There were all kinds of manuals. There were paperback books, leather scrolls, metal books, crystals, leaves, wooden boards, and jade plates.
Hum.
When Meng Chuan touched a manual beside him with his will, information immediately surged into his mind.
This information simply introduced the distribution of manuals in the entire building. The manuals were placed according to their levels and categories.
Chaos Hole manuals.
After understanding the distribution, Meng Chuan took two steps and traversed several kilometers to arrive at a certain section. Every bookshelf here was like a Dark Chaos Hole that affected the surroundings.
Every original copy was personally written by an existence that had grasped the Chaos Hole law. They naturally had their magical aspects.
Their gathering made the effects even more pronounced.
Chaos Hole Fist? It’s so casually named.
Meng Chuan picked up a thin book that was placed in the most eye-catching spot on the bookshelf.
The bookshelf had a total of three levels. The highest level only had this one book. Furthermore, this bookshelf was the first one to be categorized as a Chaos Hole. Meng Chuan vaguely felt that this manual had to be special.
The book was gray in color, and it was only about ten-plus pages thick. The moment Meng Chuan received it, information was transmitted into his mind. This information introduced the Chaos Hole Fist in detail.
Chaos Hole Fist was created by a Seventh Tribulation Eminence—Palace Lord Skylight—3.5 billion years ago. It was a fist art formed with the Chaos Hole law as its core.
In history, this was the strongest mystic technique that had evolved purely from the Chaos Hole law! Using just one Origins law, Palace Lord Skylight had created a fist art that matched a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s strength.
Palace Lord Skylight was one of the most dazzling Seventh Tribulation Eminences in history. He was even more impressive when it came to fist arts. His greatest achievement was grasping two Origins laws—Chaos Hole and Origin—and creating the even more terrifying Skylight Fist. With the Skylight Fist, Palace Lord Skylight was invincible for an era. He could defeat other top Seventh Tribulation Eminences with a single punch. Historically, his strength was close to that of a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
Just by grasping the Chaos Hole law, his Chaos Hole Fist can match a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence? After grasping the Chaos Hole law and the Origin law, he can defeat a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence with a single punch?
Meng Chuan was somewhat astonished.
It’s no wonder his manual is placed at the forefront.
Meng Chuan began reading the Chaos Hole Fist manual. As he read, the legacy surged into his mind. There was a large amount of information regarding the fist art.
He also fully embraced the mental illusion contained in the manual.
In the mental illusion, a muscular, robed man stood in the void. He looked ordinary, but as an inheritor, Meng Chuan could sense that his body was like a massive Chaos Hole.
Boom!
The stocky man casually punched out, and blinding light erupted from his fist.
It was difficult for Meng Chuan to see it clearly. Meng Chuan felt like the man’s punch had blasted out a universe! It had intent that was similar to Dragon Ancestor’s opening of a universe.
...
After receiving the legacy, Meng Chuan flipped through the book in his hand and understood why his opponent’s fist art was so ridiculously powerful.
Chaos Hole Fist. As a Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence, Palace Lord Skylight hides a massive Chaos Hole in his body. Thus, he has the power of a Chaos Hole. When he punches out, he uses the Chaos Hole law in reverse! The Chaos Hole law originally devours everything and converges everything. However, this punch... uses the Chaos Hole law in reverse and unleashes all its strength.
Therefore, this punch is unimaginably powerful. But using an Origins law in reverse?
Meng Chuan was puzzled.
This works?
How vast were the Origins laws? To reverse the usage completely? Just the thought of it gave Meng Chuan a headache.
This manual described the key to using the Chaos Hole law in reverse. First, one had to master the Chaos Hole Fist the correct way before mastering the Chaos Hole Fist’s reverse usage. The reverse usage was split into seven steps. Reaching the seventh step meant that one had completely grasped it.
After grasping the Chaos Hole Fist and comprehending the Origin law, one had a chance of learning the stronger Skylight Fist.
There were detailed records, but other than Palace Lord Skylight, only a handful of Seventh Tribulation Eminences in history had mastered the Chaos Hole Fist. None mastered the Skylight Fist—there were none (other than half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences).
I feel that using the Chaos Hole law in reverse has the Heaven Splitting law’s charm, but it’s not the same. The Heaven Splitting law is incomparably sharp, but reversing the Chaos Hole law will result in a big bang.
Meng Chuan looked at the manual and pondered before beginning to learn it.
This was the first legacy he was learning in White Avian Hall.

chapters.title: Chapter 694 - 1,000 Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 694: 1,000 Years
Meng Chuan seemed to be leisurely reading in White Avian Hall, but at the same moment, his outer realm true body in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm began practicing his fist art in front of Realm Palace’s lake.
The Essence Soul avatar cultivating on Clear Spring Island was also practicing the fist art.
There was also an Essence Soul avatar that headed to a Chaos Hole’s depths to practice the fist art.
In front of the Great Seal within Archean Eon Realm’s Heaven and Earth Great Hall, Meng Chuan’s true body punched out with the fist art.
Meng Chuan hadn’t even grasped the Chaos Hole law, so he naturally learned the fist art in the ‘proper’ manner. This fist art’s description was very simple. It was a thin book, and there were even fewer parts regarding the ‘proper’ manner. Hence, It was extremely difficult to learn. However, the Chaos Hole Fist was extremely powerful. The more Meng Chuan studied it, the more engrossed he became. He also admired Palace Lord Skylight’s wisdom.
Back when he made the deal with Fiend Eye, Meng Chan could only stay on Clear Spring Island for 300 years! Therefore, Meng Chuan cherished those 300 years. Most of the time, his outer realm true body would stay in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm for the ten-fold speed up to increase his cultivation efficiency on Clear Spring Island.
In the blink of an eye...
Meng Chuan had been in White Avian Hall for 12 years. In the past 12 years, he had only read one book—Chaos Hole Fist. More than 100 years had passed for his actual cultivation time.
Deep in a Chaos Hole, the black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan would occasionally come here to practice his Chaos Hole Fist.
Boom!
As usual, Meng Chuan punched out once again. Meng Chuan punched out according to the Chaos Hole Fist’s description.
Spacetime distorted as it gathered power from all directions. This punch caused spacetime to collapse in an even more exaggerated manner than usual. It sucked in the surrounding energy, affecting the massive Chaos Hole that Meng Chuan was in. A small portion of the area distorted and trembled.
This punch is much more powerful.
Meng Chuan was pleasantly surprised by his punch.
I just used the gravitational law?
He didn’t deliberately study the gravitational law. This was because the electromagnetic domain, spatial law, and lepton law combined contained the gravitational law to begin with.
With his accumulated insights, he was able to attempt comprehending the Chaos Hole law, so there was no need to waste time on it. However, he had naturally grasped the gravitational law after cultivating the Chaos Hole Fist. To a certain extent, it meant that Meng Chuan had accumulated too much insight.
I’ve already accumulated enough insights. To comprehend the Chaos Hole law, I need a moment of epiphany.
Meng Chuan understood this—he had accumulated enough insights.
What he needed to do now was to integrate everything he had accumulated into one Origins law. It was also the most difficult step. He had killed three Sixth Tribulation forbidden creatures to end the karma, so there wouldn’t be any karmic interference. All he needed to do now was focus on studying.
I’ve cultivated the Chaos Hole Fist for more than 100 years. It’s time to switch to another legacy.
Meng Chuan reached out and picked up the manual on the first bookshelf’s second level. The manual was called Chaos Hole Territory.
Meng Chuan flipped open the manual and probed it with his mind.
Boom!
The legacy surged into his consciousness.
This ultimate technique was a domain formulation evolved from the Chaos Hole law. It was created by a half-step Eighth Tribulation senior—Palace Lord Zhou Fang—9.6 billion years ago. According to Palace Lord Zhou Fang, he had obtained inspiration from an Eighth Tribulation forbidden creature’s corpse and created this domain formulation.
This was also the Chaos Hole lineage’s strongest domain formulation.
Palace Lord Zhou Fang eventually reached the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm. This formulation was created when he had newly advanced to the Seventh Tribulation realm.
Domain?
Meng Chuan was very interested since domains and the Essence Soul World were connected.
He immediately studied it carefully.
Comprehending one legacy after another was also to absorb his seniors’ wisdom.
These seniors were all Eminences from different eras. At the very least, they had grasped the Chaos Hole law. They each had their own growth experiences, and even their combat styles were different. Some were Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences that liked to set up array formations, some liked to engage in close combat, and some were good at domains. They followed their respective paths and eventually grasped the Chaos Hole law.
Meng Chuan wanted to comprehend every path. This was like talking to seniors and absorbing what was useful to him.
...
Time passed. The 18 cave abodes on Clear Spring Island remained peaceful.
As the number one cultivation ground in the River of Spacetime, many experts’ avatars had been here for a long time.
Meng Chuan walked out of one of the chambers and looked at the scenery in the courtyard.
It’s been 300 years. It’s time to leave.
Meng Chuan immediately contacted Fiend Eye through the Nebula Token.
Moments later, Meng Chuan sensed something and turned his head.
A meatball-like figure traversed the void and landed in the cave abode’s courtyard. It was Guild Master Fiend Eye.
Fiend Eye’s single eye narrowed as he smiled at Meng Chuan. “Meng Chuan, I didn’t even come looking for you. Why are you in a hurry to leave? This cave abode isn’t of much use to me, and I’m not in a hurry either.”
“Since the agreed time is up, it’s time to leave,” said Meng Chuan. Of course, he had to keep his promise. Going back on his promise would result in karmic entanglement.
“Although the deadline is up, you can extend it again. If you are willing, I’ll allow you to continue cultivating here,” said Fiend Eye with a smile. “After you reach the Seventh Tribulation realm, return the cave abode to me. I believe White Avian Hall will help you obtain a cave abode when the time comes.”
“Thank you for your kind intentions, Guild Master,” said Meng Chuan gratefully. “But there’s no need. I want to travel around more.”
“Are you about to break through?” Fiend Eye’s eyes lit up.
He doesn’t care about Clear Spring Island? Typically, when people are stuck at the final bottleneck, what they need is a moment of epiphany.
“This step can sometimes be an obstacle that lasts for a very long time.” Meng Chuan wasn’t arrogant. He had been reading books in White Avian Hall for more than 170 years, and his true cultivation time was more than 1,000 years. He had studied the formulations for varying periods, ranging from a few years to more than 100 years. He had already studied 39 Chaos Hole law legacies.
This represented the paths of 39 seniors that had grasped the Chaos Hole law.
After comprehending more, Meng Chuan’s heart became calmer. This was because he felt that he was very close to the Chaos Hole law—he could break through at any moment.
...
White Avian Hall.
Meng Chuan continued reading the 39th legacy leisurely. He could sense the help the manual provided him. The more he studied, the clearer his understanding of the Chaos Hole law.
I have a feeling that I will naturally break through soon.
Meng Chuan was confident, so he naturally had patience.
His true bodies and avatars in Archean Eon Realm, Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, Thousand Mountain Star, and other places were also immersed in studying.
In the past few years, apart from dealing with sect and family matters and accompanying his wife and children, Meng Chuan didn’t participate in anything in the River of Spacetime.
In fact, many major events had happened in the River of Spacetime in the past century. It was the most lively period.
For example, Cang Li had broken through and grasped a Seventh Tribulation law. He had become a half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Cang Li had also obtained the phoenixes’ full support. He was in the limelight for quite some time.
For example, Lord of Shadowfiend had successfully transcended the tribulation and become a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Of course, Lord of Shadowfiend remained low-key. His success in transcending the tribulation was within everyone’s expectations.
Another example was Lord of Shadows fighting Six Directions Heaven. They fought a pandemonic battle. Lord of Shadows had White Avian Hall backing him, and he was also strong enough. Before Celestial Thearch Myriad Star personally took action... Lord of Shadows didn’t cower at all.
Another example was the conflict between Black Fiend Hall’s Hall Master Snowplume and the old Realm Ancestor. It also caused many Seventh Tribulation Eminences to participate.
Of course... no matter how lively the River of Spacetime was, Meng Chuan continued reading leisurely.
Huh?
Meng Chuan put down the book in his hand as joy surfaced in his eyes.
A complete Origins law formed in his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 695 - Chaos Hole Law
chapters.content:
Chapter 695: Chaos Hole Law
It’s done.
Meng Chuan was delighted and somewhat wistful.
After reaching a bottleneck, many cultivators would be stuck at the bottleneck for a long time. It was normal for them to be stuck at a bottleneck for tens of thousands of years, unable to break through even when at the end of their lifespans.
After reaching a bottleneck, Meng Chuan had cultivated for more than 1,000 years! He had opportunities like Clear Spring Island’s cave abode, the Great Seal, and White Avian Hall’s manuals. Even with his perception, it took him a long time to break through. This was a testament to how difficult it was to break through a bottleneck.
Many cultivators are stuck at a bottleneck for too long, causing their mental state to be unbalanced. They begin to feel anxious and think of all sorts of solutions. The more anxious they are, the harder it is to break through.
This couldn’t be blamed on Sixth Tribulation Eminences. To grasp three Sixth Tribulation laws and accumulate insights to the limit, one might have already cultivated for 50,000 to 60,000 years. As for Sixth Tribulation Eminences, their lifespans were typically close to 100,000 years.
How could one not be anxious when they were stuck at a bottleneck for so long and was approaching the end of their lifespans?
Therefore, young people like Meng Chuan had a better mentality and patience.
Being young was an advantage.
Meng Chuan looked back at his cultivation path.
He had cultivated in Archean Eon Realm, a middle-level world, ever since he was young. All the way until he grasped an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique, he constantly faced the demon threat. Only after he grasped an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique did he end the demon threat.
As a genius who had created an Imperial Lord-level paramount technique, he successfully reached the Sixth Tribulation realm.
I’ve cultivated for 7,000 years and have grasped the Chaos Hole law.
Meng Chuan sighed.
In the current era, only Hall Lord White Avian was slightly better. Hall Lord White Avian had cultivated for 6,000 years before becoming a Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was also very amazing. He cultivated for 11,000 years before becoming a Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
As for himself? Meng Chuan still needed to transcend the tribulation before he could be considered a Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
I’m considered comparable to Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
Meng Chuan smiled. His cultivation speed had completely exceeded Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s.
The first obstacle in front of me now is transcending the tribulation.
Meng Chuan also felt a sense of urgency. His willpower was enough to bear Origins laws. Therefore, the seventh Essence Soul Tribulation would probably descend in about 100 years.
Chaos Hole law.
Meng Chuan began to sense the Chaos Hole law carefully.
As an Origins law, it was too vast. Meng Chuan had studied 39 Chaos Hole legacies in White Avian Hall, so he was very familiar with the Chaos Hole law from different angles.
His previous familiarity was a blurry veil. Now, he could see everything clearly.
My Essence Soul World is beginning to evolve.
Meng Chuan could sense his Essence Soul World transforming into a world with the Chaos Hole law as its core.
A natural evolution was the simplest form of evolution.
In the middle of the illusory Essence Soul World was a Dark Chaos Hole. It had a complete Chaos Hole law and mighty Power of Essence Soul... This gradually caused the Dark Chaos Hole in the Essence Soul World to become corporeal.
In about an hour, it produced a foot-wide Dark Chaos Hole core. This foot-wide Chaos Hole core was real, just like the true Chaos Hole cores in the outside world, but it was much smaller. After all, it was formed from Meng Chuan’s strength.
His Essence Soul World had transformed, and his Power of Essence Soul had reached a new level.
With such Power of Essence Soul, Heaven Splitting Blade’s might would be even more terrifying.
Is this the strength of an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence? Guild Master Darkstar should also have this level of strength, right?
Meng Chuan sensed the vast power contained within the Chaos Hole in his Essence Soul World. With his current strength, Meng Chuan could easily trample on himself back when he was a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence!
Though he had grasped the spatial law then, he only had slightly stronger life-preservation means. He could withstand a few blows from a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, giving him time to destroy his avatars and prevent himself from being captured alive.
Previously, I was lucky to have Guild Master Fiend Eye take action; otherwise, I wouldn’t have been able to resist the attack head-on. I would’ve needed to rely on the Spacetime Token to escape.
After becoming a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, Meng Chuan had a deeper understanding of the disparity in strength.
In fact, Meng Chuan also knew that his strength had already surpassed that of most half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
Whoosh.
A thin, gray-robed man appeared beside a bookshelf out of thin air. His aura was converged and ordinary as he smiled at Meng Chuan. “Eastcalm, congratulations.”
Hall Lord White Avian naturally sensed it when Meng Chuan broke through. He knew very well that Meng Chuan was now equivalent to a true Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
A half-step Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence was one who grasped a Seventh Tribulation law but had yet to break through with their bodies.
A half-step Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence grasped a Seventh Tribulation law, but their willpower was somewhat weak. Their Essence Soul World couldn’t withstand the evolution of the Chaos Hole law.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World had already transformed, and his Power of Essence Soul had also reached the Seventh Tribulation realm. Apart from not transcending the tribulation, he was no different from an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
“It’s all thanks to the library’s books,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “If I hadn’t read so many of the seniors’ ultimate techniques and manuals, I probably would’ve taken longer to break through.”
“The foundation of cultivation ultimately depends on oneself,” said Hall Lord White Avian with a smile. “For example, in high-level worlds, or for species like the dragons and phoenixes, the factions with a rich heritage have plenty of manuals and opportunities. However, they haven’t produced a Seventh Tribulation Eminence in many eras. From this, it can be seen that the birth of a Seventh Tribulation Eminence... has very high requirements on oneself.”
Meng Chuan agreed. Even in Archean Eon Realm, there were differences in one’s achievements despite having the same resources.
His son—Meng An—and his grandson, Meng Yu, had fortuitous treasures that surpassed what Meng Chuan had when he was at the same stage as them. However, their accomplishments were far inferior.
In the entire River of Spacetime, the dragons and some high-level worlds had a terrifying amount of resources. It was very common for them to have Eternal treasures. But how many could reach the Seventh Tribulation realm?
“Seven thousand years.” Hall Lord White Avian looked at Meng Chuan, his heart filled with anticipation.
Meng Chuan took 7,000 years to reach the Seventh Tribulation realm. In 30,000 years, he will reach the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm. Before his death, he can reach the Eighth Tribulation realm
, thought Hall Lord White Avian.
I also need to control the flow of time now.
As long as one lived in a place where time flowed slowly, Hall Lord White Avian would’ve only spent 20,000 years, while Meng Chuan spent 200,000 years! He could naturally wait until Meng Chuan reached the Eighth Tribulation realm.
But the higher one’s level of existence was, the higher the price to alter the time flow in the region they were in. As a Seventh Tribulation lifeform, Hall Lord White Avian placed a huge burden on the time flow in where he was—even if it was a Chaos Hole. The changed time flow could barely be maintained for a moment.
If he expended too much Chaos Hole energy, it would collapse on its own.
Only mystic realms created by Eighth Tribulation Eminences could maintain temporal acceleration for a long time.
A mystic realm could absorb external powers and accelerate time for prolonged periods. However, maintaining a ten-fold speedup or slowdown for a Seventh Tribulation Eminence was almost the limit.
...
Hall Lord White Avian and Meng Chuan arrived at a chamber in the library. They sat opposite each other and chatted while drinking.
“Eastcalm, your Essence Soul has also broken through during your breakthrough. You are already in the state of the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “Hence, your seventh Essence Soul Heavenly Tribulation will come soon.”
“In about 100 years.” Meng Chuan understood this point.
“You have to prepare for the upcoming Heavenly Tribulation,” said Hall Lord White Avian.
One was either a half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence or a Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
Meng Chuan could only maintain his present state for a short period of time before he faced the Heavenly Tribulation!
“Although your willpower isn’t bad, the Essence Soul Tribulation targets the mind,” reminded Hall Lord White Avian. “Don’t be careless.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
“In the Essence Soul cultivation system, one needs to create an Essence Soul formulation in the future,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “Now that you have grasped an Origins law, you can begin attempting to create one.”
“See through the Essence Soul and create an Essence Soul formulation that is most suitable for me. It can strengthen my Essence Soul and willpower.” Meng Chuan smiled and nodded. He naturally understood this point. After grasping an Origins law, he pursued wisdom that could see through everything.
Externally, it was to comprehend all matter—everything.
Internally, he studied his body and Essence Soul.
Meng Chuan had even figured out an Essence Soul formulation at the Sixth Tribulation realm.
“White Avian Hall has quite a number of Essence Soul formulations,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “Most of them are Seventh Tribulation-level Essence Soul formulations, but they aren’t perfected. There are also five Eighth Tribulation-level Essence Soul formulations. Some are from our universe, while others are from beyond the universe. Two of them have karmic implications. It’s your choice.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
Some Essence Soul formulations were directly sold without any karmic implications. Eternal Road was one such example.
For example, Meng Chuan had received a karmic burden from Senior Fei Yu when he cultivated the Essence Soul Star. If he reached the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm, he would have to repay the karma.
Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminences were too rare. Only a handful of them had been born in the River of Spacetime’s history. Therefore, they were much more precious than Physical Body Eighth Tribulation Eminences.
Essence Soul Star and Eternal Road—which Meng Chuan had obtained—were actually legacies from outside the universe.

chapters.title: Chapter 696 - Refining a Chaos Hole
chapters.content:
Chapter 696: Refining a Chaos Hole
“Hall Lord, there’s no need to announce the news of my breakthrough,” said Meng Chuan. “After all, I’m only about 100 years away from the tribulation. I don’t want to be disturbed and wish to focus on preparing for the tribulation.”
“Alright.” Hall Lord White Avian nodded. “By the way, according to my understanding, the 3,000 illusory arrays I gave you previously are useful for building an Essence Soul World. The stronger your Essence Soul World is, the greater your chances of transcending the tribulation.”
Meng Chuan came to a realization. “Thank you, Hall Lord.”
Hall Lord White Avian smiled and nodded. Meng Chuan’s transcending of the tribulation was of paramount importance right now. If he failed to transcend the tribulation, all his efforts would be for naught. If he succeeded in transcending the tribulation, White Avian Hall would have an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
The threat of an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence was something that even a handful of Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminences couldn’t compare to. An Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence could send a few Essence Soul avatars to attack various places without care for death.
The reason why Black Fiend Hall dared to act so fearlessly was that they had an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Origin Realm Chieftain and Realm Ancestor also enjoyed high statuses precisely because they were Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
Most importantly, Meng Chuan was Hall Lord White Avian’s hope for recovery.
...
Three Bay River System.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar arrived near a Dark Chaos Hole.
I haven’t been to a Chaos Hole’s core.
Meng Chuan smiled as he stepped across the Chaos Hole accretion disc and continued walking deeper into the darkness.
With another step, he arrived at a region where time flowed 100 times faster.
But the arrival of Meng Chuan—a Seventh Tribulation Eminence—exerted too much pressure on spacetime. The time flow rapidly decelerated, and the time acceleration failed to be even twice as fast.
This place was already dark; there was no light at all. However, Meng Chuan could easily move through the distorted spacetime and sense the entire Chaos Hole.
Meng Chuan looked into the Chaos Hole’s deepest depths.
In the past, he couldn’t see it clearly, but he could now see the Chaos Hole’s core clearly. It was a perfect, smooth sphere with a diameter of 921 feet and 2 inches. Even when magnified by one trillion-fold, no bumps could be seen. It was extremely smooth and round.
Such a large sphere distorted spacetime to a terrifying extent.
Meng Chuan could determine the time flow everywhere with his perception of spacetime.
A day in the Chaos Hole’s core is roughly 300 years in the outside world.
Meng Chuan deduced the time flow difference. With a step, he landed on the Chaos Hole’s core.
The Chaos Hole core was like a small wooden boat.
Meng Chuan took a step forward, causing the wooden boat to sway; it was extremely weak.
The Chaos Hole’s influence on spacetime greatly decreased. After Meng Chuan stood in this region, a day in the Chaos Hole’s core was roughly equivalent to 100 days in the outside world.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
The surface of the 921-foot-2-inches-wide Chaos Hole sphere silently disintegrated as it rapidly shrank.
910 feet, 900 feet, 890 feet...
I’m afraid that this Chaos Hole will collapse in less than ten minutes. My existence puts so much pressure on it?
Meng Chuan sighed.
When he was at the Sixth Tribulation realm, the Chaos Hole—which used an Origins law as its core—wasn’t affected by him. When he used an Origins law as the core to raise his lifeforce, the burden on the Chaos Hole was thousands of times greater.
How powerful is an Eighth Tribulation Eminence?
Meng Chuan sighed inwardly. Eighth Tribulation Eminences would undergo another qualitative change; they could even transcend and leave the River of Spacetime.
Meng Chuan took a step and left the Chaos Hole’s core.
The energy within the Chaos Hole’s core stopped depleting, and it resumed its normal operations. It continued to devour the outside world’s powers slowly. As time passed, it gradually grew larger.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan took a step and crossed several river systems, arriving in front of a large, Dark Chaos Hole.
This Chaos Hole’s core has a diameter of 6,000 feet. It’s about the limit that my Essence Soul World can withstand.
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. He had done a lot of research in White Avian Hall, so he knew how big a Chaos Hole a newly-advanced Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence could refine.
A Chaos Hole with a diameter of 6,000 feet was considered a super-large Chaos Hole. It was close to his limit.
Even if he could barely devour something slightly larger, it wouldn’t make much of a difference to his strength.
Refine.
With a thought, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World reflected reality. A vast, dark painting enveloped his surroundings.
Seventh Tribulation Eminences cultivated in somewhat special ways because of the laws they grasped.
For example, a Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence that had grasped the Matter law didn’t need any Outer Realm Essence Crystals or any rare treasures. They could condense countless particles with a thought to build a massive body. This saved them the huge investment needed to cultivate their bodies.
An Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence that had grasped the Chaos Hole law also had one benefit. Their Essence Soul World needed to cultivate a World Treasure. The World Treasure that was most suitable for them was a true Chaos Hole from the outside world.
If they refined a massive Chaos Hole into their Essence Soul World, their Essence Soul World’s stability and strength would increase tremendously. There was no need to buy rare treasures since no rare treasures could compare to a true, massive Chaos Hole.
In fact, a portion of an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s Essence Soul World would also be ‘corporealized.’ They would also condense a Chaos Hole core.
But the Chaos Hole core condensed with his strength alone was too small. The Chaos Hole core that Meng Chuan had formed was only one foot in diameter! Even if he consumed enough Outer Realm Essence Crystals, it would be impressive if he could enlarge it to 100 feet in diameter. It couldn’t compare to a true Chaos Hole that had been born for hundreds of millions of years.
Boom!
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World was illusory. The massive dark painting completely covered the area.
The true Chaos Hole’s core was dragged toward the center of Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World and fused with the darkness.
Boom!
In the past, the Chaos Hole devoured the outside world.
Now, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World devoured the entire Chaos Hole.
The Chaos Hole core—which was 6,000 feet in diameter—slowly fused with Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World, becoming the Essence Soul World’s core.
After half a month, the Chaos Hole was finally in place and became a part of the Essence Soul World.
Very good.
Meng Chuan could sense that his Essence Soul World seemed to have a world pillar now that it had a Chaos Hole core with a diameter of 6,000 feet! The world’s stability increased drastically, and the might of his Essence Soul World was much more terrifying.
Even if he didn’t use any moves, just the pressure from him was no less than a super-large Dark Chaos Hole.
...
There were many Dark Chaos Holes in the River of Spacetime, but Meng Chuan was the only Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence in the Chaos Hole lineage in the present era.
Meng Chuan’s numerous Essence Soul avatars headed out to refine Chaos Holes into his Essence Soul World.
The sublimation of one’s order in life is indeed astonishing.
Meng Chuan stood on the grass outside Jiang State Capital. Strictly speaking, the energy within him was much greater than the entire Archean Eon Realm.
Most importantly, I’ve grasped an Origins law.
His immense strength could be magnified through laws.
Whoosh~
Just by standing on the grass, his domain—affected by the laws—had long spread across Archean Eon Realm and past the Demon Realm. It spread to an extremely vast area.
With Archean Eon Realm as the center, my Origins domain envelops an 80 trillion-kilometer area.
Meng Chuan could clearly sense it.
Even if one didn’t deliberately use it, a lifeform’s Origins domain would naturally cover such a range even in their sleep.
Nothing could hide from Meng Chuan within this range.
I can block all karmic attacks within this range.
Meng Chuan also understood this now.
The Karma law was only an Origins law as well—on the same level as the Chaos Hole law.
In his Origins domain, all karma was exposed.
When external powers seeped in through karma, his Origins domain could easily sense and block them. Even at Celestial Thearch Myriad Star and Hall Lord White Avian’s level, the might of any karmic attack would weaken to the level of an ordinary Seventh Tribulation Eminence. If it seeped into an inhabited world, its might would weaken even more...
Meng Chuan’s Origins domain could easily block it.
As long as one obtains a Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s protection, karmic attacks will be useless.
Meng Chuan came to a realization.
My protection range is 80 trillion kilometers around myself.
“Ah Chuan, is your idea of having a stroll with me to just stand there in a daze?” Liu Qiyue—who was taking in the flowers’ fragrance—turned to smile at her husband.

chapters.title: Chapter 697 - Child and Grandchild
chapters.content:
Chapter 697: Child and Grandchild
“I’m coming.” Meng Chuan smiled as he walked over.
The grass was covered with a rug. On the rug were plates of food and wine—it was rather sumptuous.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged on the rug.
Liu Qiyue picked some wild flowers and placed them beside the delicacies. Only then did she sit down happily. She smiled and said, “Ah Chuan, I’m celebrating my breakthrough to the Imperial Lord realm today. Why are you so distracted on our trip out?”
“Yes, yes, yes. We are celebrating your breakthrough to the Imperial Lord realm. Come, let’s have a drink.” Meng Chuan immediately poured wine for his wife and himself.
Liu Qiyue smiled and took the cup. The couple then clinked glasses and downed their cup of wine.
“After cultivating in seclusion for half a year, I’ve finally broken through and become an Imperial Lord,” said Liu Qiyue wistfully, and her eyes were filled with excitement. “When dealing with the demons’ invasion, I didn’t even dare to imagine becoming an Imperial Lord in my life.”
“Your realm was already sufficient; you could’ve forcefully become an Imperial Lord with your bloodline,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “However, you waited until you had a seventh-level Essence Soul before breaking through.”
Ever since Liu Qiyue consumed the Fire Origins Liquid and her bloodline transformed, her bloodline was close to that of a pure-blooded phoenix. Even if she didn’t cultivate, she could become stronger with time! Furthermore, Liu Qiyue had been diligently cultivating since she was young.
Her diligence and perception were much higher than those lazy pure-blooded dragons and pure-blooded phoenixes. In terms of technique, although she had only cultivated for over 500 years, she had already reached the middle-stage Heaven Earth realm.
Since Liu Qiyue didn’t go to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm and had slept for more than 200 years, she had only cultivated for over 500 years.
Under the nurturing of her bloodline, her Essence Soul grew rather quickly. She had attained a seventh-level Essence Soul not long ago.
“Although I could forcefully break through to the Imperial Lord realm by relying on my bloodline after I reached the Heaven Earth realm, I still hoped to use Archean Eon Realm’s Godfiend cultivation system to break through. My cultivation conditions are already too extravagant. It would be a joke if I lowered my standards.”
Liu Qiyue was the only person in Archean Eon Realm that had used a Universe Wonder, Fire Origins Liquid—which was comparable to an Eighth Tribulation treasure—to change her bloodline and nearly reach the level of a pure-blooded phoenix.
In human history, only Ancestral Master Archean Eon and Meng Chuan could afford such a thing.
When Ancestral Master Archean Eon had enough treasures, he no longer had anyone around him worth paying such a price for.
“Furthermore, Ah Chuan, you often give me pointers.” Liu Qiyue smiled as she looked at her husband. Her husband lived in Jiang State Capital with her, and they usually talked about cultivation problems. Her husband’s pointers always hit the mark, allowing Liu Qiyue’s cultivation to be much smoother.
“The earlier one reaches the Tribulation realm, the further they can go,” said Meng Chuan. “In the Imperial Lord realm, one has to have a solid foundation before they can reach the Tribulation realm.”
Liu Qiyue nodded. Although many dragons and phoenixes had strength comparable to Fifth Tribulation Eminences when they were Imperial Lords, they had yet to comprehend their powers completely. Thus, they had no hope of reaching the Tribulation realm.
“Ah Chuan, you haven’t told me why you keep getting distracted today,” said Liu Qiyue. “You are a Sixth Tribulation Eminence and have many avatars. It’s impossible for you to be distracted if there’s nothing important, right?”
At Meng Chuan’s level, it was trivial for him to multitask. It was inconceivable for him to be distracted.
“Qiyue, I have something to tell you,” said Meng Chuan. “I’ve also broken through.”
“Broken through?” Liu Qiyue was slightly taken aback. “You mean...”
“I’ve already comprehended a Seventh Tribulation law, and my Essence Soul World has evolved. As long as I transcend the tribulation, I’ll be at the Seventh Tribulation realm,” said Meng Chuan.
“When did this happen?” Liu Qiyue asked in surprise.
“Less than a month ago, when you were still in seclusion,” said Meng Chuan. “I just broke through, so I’ve recently been familiarizing myself with the new powers I gained. That’s why I often get distracted.”
“You got distracted while familiarizing yourself with your powers?” Liu Qiyue looked at Meng Chuan. “You weren’t like this when you reached the Sixth Tribulation realm.”
“That’s right.” Meng Chuan sighed. “A Seventh Tribulation Eminence is much stronger than a Sixth Tribulation Eminence. I need to familiarize myself with my new powers slowly.”
The more Tribulation Eminences cultivated, the greater the strength boost each Tribulation realm gave them.
“If a Seventh Tribulation Eminence were to attack, they could instantly kill or capture a Sixth Tribulation Eminence even if they are separated by many river systems. Only peak Sixth Tribulation Eminences that have grasped the spatial law can destroy their avatars in front of a Seventh Tribulation Eminence,” said Meng Chuan.
The difference between them was too great. If a Seventh Tribulation Eminence was a towering mountain, then a Sixth Tribulation Eminence would be a speck of dust.
Thankfully, Sixth Tribulation Eminences could hide in places such as their homeworld or Eternal Tower’s headquarters. Therefore, Sixth Tribulation Eminences had some authority. However, they still had to rely on Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
A faction established by a Seventh Tribulation Eminence in the River of Spacetime was a top faction.
Black Fiend Hall was arrogant because they had two Seventh Tribulation Eminences. One of them was an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
Meng Chuan was now an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence! In terms of deterrence, he could almost match the entirety of Black Fiend Hall.
“Kill and capture an enemy alive across many river systems?” Liu Qiyue muttered.
“I have grasped the Chaos Hole law, so I can only attack across river systems. For example, those that have grasped the Karma law, the Immeasurable law, and so on can attack across many river zones,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “Previously, I obtained the Spacetime Token from Dragon Ancestor in the Nine Trials Pagoda. With the Spacetime Token, my strength can be transmitted to anywhere in the River of Spacetime.”
Liu Qiyue only felt that such means were too terrifying. She couldn’t help but say, “With such strength, weak Tribulation Eminences can’t resist at all. It’s useless no matter how many there are.”
“That’s right; that’s why Black Fiend Hall can slaughter people wantonly. Therefore, Sixth Tribulation Eminences have to rely on Seventh Tribulation Eminences,” said Meng Chuan.
Liu Qiyue looked at her husband.
My husband has already cultivated to such an unfathomable realm?
“By the way, you mentioned the tribulation transcendence?” asked Liu Qiyue immediately.
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded. “In about 100 years, the seventh Essence Soul Tribulation will descend. Therefore, I need to focus on preparing for the tribulation.”
Liu Qiyue was also very nervous and worried. Her husband’s strength increased rapidly, but the faster he improved, the more heavenly tribulations he would suffer.
“There’s one more thing,” said Meng Chuan. “After I broke through, Archean Eon Realm is now under the protection of my Origins domain at all times. Living beings in Archean Eon Realm don’t have to worry about any external karmic attacks. Therefore, we can let An’er and many other cultivators head out.”
Previously, Archean Eon Realm’s talents were only allowed to enter the mystic realm. They weren’t allowed to enter the outer realm. This was because Earth Cloud Mystic Realm alone had enough opportunities and experts.
“As long as they reach the Imperial Lord realm, they can be released,” said Meng Chuan. “For example, our grandson can leave Earth Cloud Mystic Realm.”
“Meng Yu?” Liu Qiyue knew that her husband thought highly of their grandson.
Meng Yu had never known his grandfather’s true origins. Meng Yu thought that he was threatened by a powerful enemy and had been arduously cultivating in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm.
“I didn’t give him too many resources. I kept letting him work on his own and only guided him in secret,” said Meng Chuan. “Meng Yu’s cultivation is almost approaching his father’s.”
Meng An had comprehended a Fourth Tribulation law, but his physical body formulation hadn’t been perfected.
According to this cultivation speed, Meng Chuan estimated that Meng An’s limit was probably the Fifth Tribulation realm.
Ever since he was young, Meng An’s cultivation speed was top-notch in Archean Eon Realm’s history. His foundation was one of the top three in human history, and he was also Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s legacy disciple... However, it was already not bad for him to reach the Fifth Tribulation realm in his life.
This was what cultivation was like; it was too difficult for a world to produce a Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
A peerless talent like Meng Chuan was rare in the entire River of Spacetime.
Meng Yu.
The path that Meng Chuan had arranged for his grandson was completely different from his son’s. It greatly increased the grinding process and allowed him to grow—Meng Yu could walk the cultivation path he liked.
For a long time, his son—Meng An—had to grow according to Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s arrangements.
Meng Chuan somewhat disagreed with this, but when he had the ability to object, his son did whatever it took to go to Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. At that time, he could no longer change the trajectory.

chapters.title: Chapter 698 - Food
chapters.content:
Chapter 698: Food
On the Chaos Turbid River’s surface was a pavilion.
The black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan was meditating in the building. He didn’t deliberately search for forbidden creatures. Instead, he focused on cultivating and preparing for his Tribulation Transcendence. Of course, his Origins domain was large enough in the Chaos Turbid River. If a forbidden creature happened to enter his domain, he could ‘conveniently’ hunt them.
He treated it as a form of relaxation.
Sixth Tribulation forbidden creatures’ Life Cores and corpses were still relatively valuable; they could be considered resources. Ancestral Master Archean Eon had relied on years of accumulation to amass all his treasures.
Meng Chuan’s current wealth was mainly given to him by Hall Lord White Avian. What he had accumulated himself was still little; he was still poor.
Huh?
Meng Chuan suddenly opened his eyes.
The Chaos Hole law was a law that was good at domains, so his Origins domain was rather large. Although Meng Chuan was heavily suppressed in the Chaos Turbid River, he could still sense his surroundings for more than five billion kilometers.
This is the first forbidden creature that I’ve encountered since I grasped the Chaos Hole law.
Meng Chuan looked into the distance. Through the Chaos Turbid River, he saw a massive creature slowly advancing in the river’s depths. It was an alien beast with eight long necks and heads. Each of the alien beast’s neck and head was like a long snake. The alien beast also had four hooves and three sharp, long, and thin tails. Its three tails danced around each other like scissors.
Its aura is quite strong; it’s considered powerful among Sixth Tribulation forbidden creatures.
Meng Chuan stood up and took a step forward to approach the forbidden creature.
The eight-headed alien beast swam underwater. Its eight long heads carefully observed its surroundings as it searched for prey.
Only by evolving to the Seventh Tribulation realm will I truly be safe in the Chaos Turbid River.
In the Chaos Turbid River, Sixth Tribulation forbidden creatures fought and devoured each other. Occasionally, cultivators would hunt them down; their living conditions were extremely harsh.
Only by reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm would one stand at the pinnacle of the Chaos Turbid River.
Devouring Chaos creatures is too slow. If I can devour a Sixth Tribulation cultivator, it will be much more helpful.
This eight-headed forbidden creature yearned to become stronger. Beyond the universe, forbidden creatures had been fighting and devouring each other since they were born. The weak were devoured, and the strong became stronger. This forbidden creature had experienced countless battles to become a Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature. Although the Chaos Turbid River was even more dangerous, it was fearless.
“This is—” The eight-headed beast suddenly saw a pair of dark eyes.
The dark eyes stared at it like an endless abyss. The forbidden creature’s consciousness rapidly sank without any resistance, and its consciousness was annihilated!
The body lost its vitality; it remained motionless as the water swirled around it.
My true body was instantly killed?
32.5 million kilometers away from the corpse, a Life Core was hidden in the river. The consciousness in this Life Core was rather alarmed.
Who attacked? Is it a Seventh Tribulation Chaos creature or a cultivator?
I can’t condense a true body. Once I do, the fluctuations in my Life Core will definitely be discovered.
The Chaos creature carefully hid itself. At the same time, its Life Core hid in the water as it followed the water flow and fled into the distance.
Meng Chuan was currently staring at the eight-headed alien beast’s corpse.
It’s so afraid that it doesn’t dare to condense its true body?
Meng Chuan also understood that he hadn’t disguised himself this time and had ruthlessly attacked instead. Thus, he had scared off the other party.
After grasping the Chaos Hole law, Meng Chuan cultivated the Pupil of Darkness to the 72nd level. He had also cast it using his Power of Essence Soul, which was at the Seventh Tribulation realm.
Meng Chuan’s strength was much greater than before.
“Can you escape?” Meng Chuan stood beside the corpse. His Chaos Hole domain affected a 150 million-kilometer area.
Boom!
With Meng Chuan at the center, an invisible force swept across the 150 million-kilometer area. Although Meng Chuan could affect an area of more than five billion kilometers, it was unnecessary to do so when dealing with a Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature.
About 35 million kilometers away from Meng Chuan, a bang sounded.
A painting then appeared.
The Life Core was clearly a painting.
Thirty-five million kilometers?
Meng Chuan glanced over. His Essence Soul mystic technique attacked the Life Core and completely destroyed the consciousness within it.
Swoosh.
With a beckon of his hand, the painting appeared in Meng Chuan’s hand. He couldn’t tell what it was made of, but it was a warm white. The painting depicted the eight-headed alien beast; every long head looked rather sinister.
I only destroyed the consciousness without destroying the Life Core. The Life Core painting is still intact.
Meng Chuan looked at the painting.
As time passes, a new consciousness will be born in this Life Core, and a new forbidden creature will appear. When the time comes, it will still be an eight-headed alien beast, but it will have a new consciousness and new memories. It will be considered another forbidden creature.
It was relatively easy to destroy a Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature’s Life Core.
A Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature’s Life Core was much stranger. It couldn’t be truly destroyed.
