According to the method passed down by Fiend Mountain’s owner, one had to seal it first before destroying its consciousness. When lacking a consciousness and in a sealed state, a Life Core couldn’t nurture a new forbidden creature.
Seal.
Meng Chuan casually sealed the painting and put it away with the corpse beside him.
In the past, Meng Chuan had disguised his strength because forbidden creatures’ Life Cores would produce fluctuations when their condensed new true bodies. This made it easier to find their Life Cores.
Typically, forbidden creatures’ true bodies were relatively far from their Life Cores. Even in the Chaos Turbid River, it was possible for the two to be tens of millions of kilometers—or even hundreds of millions of kilometers—apart. If one didn’t lock onto their Life Cores, their Life Cores would escape, making it even harder to find them.
Now that he was at the Seventh Tribulation realm, Meng Chuan could easily attack and cover over five billion kilometers. According to Meng Chuan’s understanding, a Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature’s true body was, at most, hundreds of millions of kilometers away from its Life Core in the Chaos Turbid River. Therefore, he could definitely find a Life Core if he swept through the area on a large scale.
Therefore, Meng Chuan naturally had no need to disguise himself.
This Life Core is actually a painting.
Meng Chuan looked at the painting.
Who painted it, and why did their painting become a Life Core?
Meng Chuan had always been puzzled about a Life Core’s origins.
A Life Core could be anything. It looked like an ordinary item, but it could nurture an extremely powerful forbidden creature.
The painting is really average; I painted better than this when I was ten.
Meng Chuan flipped his hand and put away the painting.
He was in a rather good mood. After all, he had made another killing.
Following that, Meng Chuan returned to the building and continued cultivating.
...
In a remote area of the Chaos Turbid River, a blurry face condensed.
Another Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature died?
This face kept staring at the Chaos Turbid River.
Any powerful cultivator or powerful Chaos creature could be its food.
On its blurry face, its huge eyes reflected the scenes from the timeline. It soon locked onto the black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan—who held the Life Core painting.
Huh?
Bark was shocked.
This Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence was still an Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence when I saw him the last few times. He’s now an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence?
Bark had devoured more than ten Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures. After coming to this universe, it had also devoured two Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s avatars. It had many strange means, so it could determine Meng Chuan’s current level of existence at a glance.
Seventh Tribulation lifeform... The last time I saw him, he was still at the Sixth Tribulation realm. He clearly broke through recently.
Bark was somewhat excited.
A newly-advanced Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence? That’s great. After devouring his Essence Soul, my strength will definitely increase.
Bark thought nothing of a Sixth Tribulation Eminence. However, Seventh Tribulation Eminences were extremely delicious food. Furthermore, Meng Chuan was a newly-advanced Seventh Tribulation Eminence, meaning that he had weaker resistance.
Devouring a Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence was very beneficial to Bark’s body. Devouring an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence was very beneficial to its Essence Soul. As a result, it was extremely excited.
“He’s my food.” The blurry face silently dissipated.
Deep in the Turbid River, a dark behemoth speedily rushed toward Meng Chuan.
As for Meng Chuan, he was focused on cultivating in the pavilion, so he didn’t notice it at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 699 - Battling Bark
chapters.content:
Chapter 699: Battling Bark
The Chaos Turbid River was like a maze. Even if one locked onto a target through karma, a distance of half a trillion kilometers could increase by tenfold when traveling in a straight line.
The spacetime here was chaotic; it was a terrifying labyrinth. Therefore, it was almost impossible to traverse the entirety of the Chaos Turbid River. One would be restrained by the Chaos Turbid River unless they could escape the River of Spacetime.
However, the Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature—Bark—had lived in the Chaos Turbid River for too long. It was very familiar with the easy-to-explore areas. Furthermore, Meng Chuan had yet to move while cultivating.
Thus, Bark had arrived in Meng Chuan’s vicinity in just a day.
I’m 40 billion kilometers away from this newly-advanced Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
The behemoth stared at the building from afar.
Most newly-advanced Seventh Tribulation Eminences can’t discover me from such a distance in the Chaos Turbid River.
The reason why Bark stayed 40 billion kilometers away was that it could only teleport up to 40 billion kilometers in the Chaos Turbid River! Any further, and it wouldn’t be able to teleport near Meng Chuan.
It’s been so many years; it’s rare to encounter such good food.
Bark was filled with eagerness.
Bark would only gain great benefits when it devoured an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s avatar for the first time. The subsequent boost from consuming that Eminence’s Essence Soul avatars would be negligible.
This was unless one could devour all of the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s avatars and completely rob them of their lives. But considering an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s life-preservation means, it was almost impossible to do so completely.
Whoosh.
Bark’s massive body suddenly lunged forward; it crossed spacetime and attacked Meng Chuan—who was 40 billion kilometers away.
...
Meng Chuan was cultivating in a building above the Turbid River. However, his Origins domain covered more than five billion kilometers around him. When the forbidden creature—Bark—charged into his Origins domain, Meng Chuan suddenly opened his eyes.
A Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature!
Meng Chuan instantly sensed the other party.
This forbidden creature resembled an octopus, but it had over 100 tentacles. Every tentacle was over 50 million kilometers long, and its massive body caused spacetime to distort. This forbidden creature’s aura alarmed Meng Chuan as it instantly charged into Meng Chuan’s Chaos Hole domain.
Meng Chuan instinctively blocked and repelled the other party.
The Chaos Hole law was good at domains, and Meng Chuan had once studied the strongest domain-type Chaos Hole lineage manual in White Avian Hall—Chaos Hole Territory. After grasping the law, he could unleash 70% of the domain mystic technique’s might.
Boom!
The spacetime in Meng Chuan’s domain was in chaos as the powerful spacetime repulsive force pulled at the behemoth.
The domain’s resistance was too great. If Guild Master Darkstar were to charge over, his speed would be reduced to just 10 to 20 percent.
However, the forbidden creature that rushed in was Bark. It had devoured more than ten forbidden creatures of the same level, causing it to evolve many times after reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm.
Whoosh.
Bark’s body seemed illusory as the Chaos Hole domain’s spacetime repulsive force only affected it slightly. It then let out a deep roar.
Buzz—
An illusory domain descended, and it instantly destroyed the Chaos Hole domain! In terms of domain, Bark was clearly stronger.
Pupil of Darkness.
The moment Meng Chuan used his domain to block the attack, he immediately used Pupil of Darkness—a mystic technique. However, Meng Chuan’s invading willpower felt like it had hit a wall.
Meng Chuan couldn’t penetrate Bark’s mental defenses at all.
Bark’s golden eye glanced at Meng Chuan mockingly because it also had high willpower. But because its target was an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, it didn’t use similar means.
However, Meng Chuan’s Pupil of Darkness couldn’t threaten it, even if it was several times stronger.
Boom!
The Chaos Hole Territory collapsed.
Without any obstructions, Bark arrived in front of Meng Chuan. Multiple tentacles—over 50 million kilometers long—then grabbed at Meng Chuan.
But Meng Chuan had already split into three. As the three Essence Soul avatars fled, a vast array formation descended.
This array formation was vast and had 60 undulating Dark Chaos Holes.
Array Formation—Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array.
This was the ultimate technique that Meng Chuan had spent the most time reading in White Avian Hall’s library. Reading this ultimate technique took him 20 years longer than Chaos Hole Fist.
This array formation was created by an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence—Myriad Tribulation Traveler. The only information Meng Chuan could obtain regarding Myriad Tribulation Traveler was this array formation. The value of the array formation was lower than an Essence Soul legacy, but Meng Chuan placed great importance on it.
This was because Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences were good at setting up array formations. This was the only Eighth Tribulation array formation Meng Chuan found that used the Chaos Hole lineage as a catalyst.
The Myriad Tribulation Chaos Hole Array was an Eighth Tribulation array formation, and it was divided into three volumes. The first volume was the Hundred Tribulation Realm—it was a pure Chaos Hole law array formation. Meng Chuan had studied the first volume and also learned the last two volumes. However, he temporarily couldn’t comprehend the last two volumes fully.
The more he studied this array formation, the more Chaos Holes he could condense.
If he could condense over 10,000 Dark Chaos Holes at the same time and perfectly form an array formation, it meant that he had reached the Myriad Tribulation Realm. Of course, he had to comprehend the complete laws of time and space before he had a chance of reaching the Myriad Tribulation Realm.
Meng Chuan was still very far from reaching that realm. But there was no doubt that this was the strongest Chaos Hole array formation that Meng Chuan had ever seen. He had studied it carefully, and he was using it now.
The 60 Dark Chaos Holes rose and fell as though they were one, suppressing the surrounding spacetime.
“Break!” Bark stared at Meng Chuan and coldly yelled.
Meng Chuan had never heard this language before, but he could naturally understand its meaning through its will.
With this angry roar, the illusory domain surged in all directions.
Boom!
Although the Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array was struck by the illusory domain, one of its major advantages was stabilization.
Every Chaos Hole core was extremely stable, and they were like 60 reefs. The reefs remained motionless despite the tides’ inundations.
Bark was somewhat shocked as well. Although it had the upper hand in domains, and it dealt a suppressive assault, it couldn’t destroy the 60 Chaos Holes.
The array formation formed by these Chaos Holes affected this spacetime greatly, preventing Bark from teleporting.
Whoosh.
Bark’s massive body suddenly disintegrated. Its massive true body split into 12 smaller avatars.
Every avatar had ten tentacles, which were over 50 million kilometers long. Their auras were much weaker.
The 12 forbidden creatures surrounded Meng Chuan’s three escaping Essence Soul avatars.
Swoosh.
Although the Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array blocked them, Bark’s avatars were terrifyingly fast. Spacetime distorted wherever they passed, and they instantly traversed hundreds of millions of kilometers.
Under the impact of the other party’s domain, Meng Chuan couldn’t teleport—he could only fly. His speed was far inferior to the other party. Even with the array formation’s help, the gap between them constantly narrowed.
This Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature is too powerful.
Meng Chuan felt suppressed in all aspects.
Whoosh~
A tentacle—over 50 million kilometers long—traversed spacetime and instantly attacked Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar. Furthermore, a huge suction cup was at the tip of the tentacle. It enveloped Meng Chuan and was about to devour the Essence Soul avatar.
Break!
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar had an Essence Soul World covering its surroundings. The huge palm in his Essence Soul World clenched into a fist and punched the tentacle suction cup.
It was known as the strongest fist technique derived from the Chaos Hole law—Chaos Hole Fist!
Boom!
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World punched out as light appeared!
The Chaos Hole Fist was simply too difficult to cultivate; it was very easy to cultivate the normal fist technique, but the reverse Chaos Hole Fist was split into seven steps.
Meng Chuan had cultivated to the fifth step because he had seen scenes of a universe being created. But the difference in strength was still very obvious when compared to the perfected seventh-step Chaos Hole Fist.
This punch caused the tentacle to ripple slightly. The soft vibrations dissipated the force, and the tentacle’s surface cracked open as purple blood flowed out.
If I had mastered the Chaos Hole Fist completely, I wouldn’t just be tearing its tentacle skin. I’d probably be able to shatter its avatar.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Meng Chuan punched out consecutively to block the attacks from the tentacles. The Essence Soul avatar wanted to pull away.
Oh? Not good.
Purple blood appeared on the surface of Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar.
Meng Chuan felt that the blood was frantically seizing control of him, and his control over his Power of Essence Soul was rapidly weakening.
I can’t touch its blood.
Meng Chuan immediately understood that the forbidden creature’s blood had a terrifying corrosive property. Once the blood touched the Chaos Hole fist, it would corrode the Essence Soul avatar.
Boom!
Meng Chuan didn’t attempt to expel the blood. Instead, he exploded his Essence Soul avatar—it was like a Chaos Hole explosion—without hesitation.
Why didn’t he attempt to resist? Why did he self-destruct instead?
When Bark saw this, he sighed inwardly.
If this Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence was very confident and tried to resist the blood contamination, the other party wouldn’t have been able to self-destruct in just one or two seconds once the contamination increased.

chapters.title: Chapter 700 - Heaven Splitting Chaos Hole
chapters.content:
Chapter 700: Heaven Splitting Chaos Hole
This Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature is much stronger than ordinary Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
Meng Chuan frowned slightly. He was now an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence. He could recover from the loss of one or two Essence Soul avatars with a thought—this was also why Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences were terrifying.
However, Meng Chuan wasn’t willing to have his Essence Soul avatar swallowed.
According to the intelligence he had, forbidden creatures didn’t gain much help in their evolution from devouring pure energy. Supreme Yang Stars and Supreme Yin Stars contained immense power that spread across the outer realm’s void.
However, forbidden creatures would only devour them occasionally to replenish their energy reserves.
If they wanted to evolve? Then, they still had to devour powerful lifeforms! The strongest lifeform in the River of Spacetime was a Seventh Tribulation Eminence!
Devouring cultivators is said to devour the cultivator’s cultivation memories. It’s also said that they are devouring the lepton composition of the cultivator’s life. It’s precisely because of these harvests that forbidden creatures can evolve.
Regardless of which one it was, Meng Chuan didn’t want his Essence Soul avatar to be devoured. Therefore, he immediately self-destructed his Essence Soul avatar when he saw that the situation was going south. He refused to give the other party a chance to devour his avatar.
Whoosh.
The other two Meng Chuans—who were fleeing—split again, returning to three Meng Chuans.
The three Meng Chuans continued fleeing in different directions. At the same time, they used the Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array to resist the forbidden creature. To Meng Chuan, this was a rare battle after he grasped the Chaos Hole law. He could use this opportunity to test out the ultimate techniques that he had learned in White Avian Hall.
A high-level battle could verify his insights.
Clang!
Bark’s 12 sub-bodies frantically pursued Meng Chuan’s three Essence Soul avatars. But every time one of the Essence Soul avatars was forced into a corner, Meng Chuan would destroy it without any hesitation.
Star Shattering.
Meng Chuan used a mystic technique.
In his Essence Soul World, a tiny, gigantic finger descended and tapped on one of the forbidden creature’s sub-bodies.
At the moment of contact, a Chaos Hole exploded at the fingertip. The forbidden creature’s sub-body was sent retreating by the impact, but it only tore the skin and caused blood to flow out.
Chaos Hole Charge.
Chaos Hole Prison.
...
Meng Chuan had studied 39 Chaos Hole legacies in White Avian Hall. He was currently trying out the various techniques.
This newly-advanced Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence is using me to test his moves?
Bark also realized that Meng Chuan’s moves were varied, but their might was only at the newly-advanced Seventh Tribulation realm.
Furthermore, he immediately self-destructs his Essence Soul avatar when he sees that the situation isn’t good, not giving me any chances. He’s too cautious. Only that move stands a chance.
Bark’s 12 massive sub-bodies suddenly dissipated into a gray fog that spread out.
Meng Chuan’s three Essence Soul avatars—which had been fleeing in panic—were somewhat astonished.
The forbidden creature has actually dissipated on its own accord?
When Meng Chuan carefully scanned his surroundings, he saw gray fog everywhere. Furthermore, it isolated spacetime. The area that his Origins domain could sense was enveloped by gray fog.
Hu! Hu! Hu!
Meng Chuan’s three Essence Souls flew for 5 billion kilometers, 15 billion kilometers, and up to 50 billion kilometers. No matter how he flew, he would always be within the gray fog.
Spacetime prison?
Meng Chuan realized that the gray fog had formed a spacetime prison.
The spacetime here was closed and periodic! It looked like he had flown billions of kilometers, but in reality, he was constantly circling a closed, periodic spacetime.
If a Seventh Tribulation Eminence had high attainments in spacetime, they could create a spacetime prison! This would prevent their target from escaping the spacetime prison’s range forever.
This Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature, Bark, was clearly very powerful when it came to spacetime. Meng Chuan was unable to crack its prison since he was still too young. Although he had grasped the spatial law, his attainments in the time lineage were too low. He was far from being comparable to Guild Master Fiend Eye and Realm Ancestor.
If Fiend Eye were here, he would probably be able to leave the spacetime prison with a single step.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
Meng Chuan looked down. The gray fog spread out and slowly seeped into his Essence Soul avatar. There was no way to block the gray fog.
This strange force is still infiltrating and corroding my Essence Soul avatar? The easiest way to leave this place is to self-destruct my avatar.
Meng Chuan also knew the surest way to escape for an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, but he didn’t want to give up easily.
Bark—whose true body had transformed into the spacetime prison—felt rather smug.
You find the corrosion slow, so you aren’t panicking. You want to use your own means to crack my move? When the corrosion is deep enough, it will be too late for you to self-destruct.
Huh? What’s he doing?
Bark—who had transformed into a spacetime prison—immediately sensed that something was amiss.
A power that made Bark’s heart palpitate was brewing.
Inside the gray fog, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World spread out. In the middle of his Essence Soul World was a massive Chaos Hole.
Now that the Chaos Hole’s powers had gathered, a terrifying blade began to condense in the Chaos Hole’s depths—Heaven Splitting Blade.
Heaven Splitting Chaos Hole!
At that moment, Meng Chuan didn’t hesitate to use his strongest move.
Heaven Splitting Blade was obtained using the fruit that Hall Lord White Avian had given him. After consuming it, a wisp of his Essence Soul had left the universe and entered a mysterious place. Then, Meng Chuan had naturally learned this one move after roaming the Heaven Splitting law’s sea.
This was a move that belonged to the Heaven Splitting law.
The Chaos Hole law and the Heaven Splitting law were opposing laws.
For example, the Chaos Hole Fist—which Meng Chuan had learned—was a perfected usage of the Chaos Hole law. It gathered a Chaos Hole’s strength into a single punch before unleashing it in the opposite direction. The might of the punch converged at one point and exploded. It was like a universe’s Big Bang. It indeed had some traces of universe creation.
The Heaven Splitting law was, without a doubt, the law of universe creation!
Meng Chuan first used the Chaos Hole law to gather infinite power, converging all of it at one point. He then used the Heaven Splitting law to unleash this power. This was a more perfect explosion than the Chaos Hole Fist.
The two opposing laws perfectly fused, causing their might to rise to an extremely terrifying level.
For other Seventh Tribulation Eminences, even if they grasped two Origins laws, their strength usage might only be more ingenious when combined. But in terms of strength, they were inferior to the combination of two opposing laws.
Whoosh.
An extremely dazzling saber beam appeared.
The saber beam erupted from the Essence Soul World’s Chaos Hole and cleaved through everything.
This is?
After transforming into the spacetime prison, Bark felt an extremely terrifying force tear through the entire spacetime prison instantly. Furthermore, the force seeped into everywhere and struck every lepton in its body.
The entire spacetime prison was instantly reduced to dust.
Heaven Splitting Chaos Hole*—*this was Meng Chuan’s strongest killer move that resulted from the combination of opposing Origins laws.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
After splitting everything apart, Meng Chuan looked at the vast Chaos Turbid River. The forbidden creature had completely vanished.
If I can comprehend the Heaven Splitting law and combine the opposing Origins law, I can unleash more moves.
At the moment, Meng Chuan only knew how to combine Heaven Splitting Blade and the Chaos Hole law. Compared to a true peak Seventh Tribulation Eminence, his weaknesses were very obvious.
This Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature was the same. Although it had many means, those means weren’t as profound as the moves used by top Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
I destroyed its true body, so I should have a chance of discovering its Life Core if it revives.
A Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature wasn’t that easy to kill. Their Life Cores couldn’t be destroyed, so they could constantly revive.
Whoosh!
The massive forbidden creature—Bark—appeared hundreds of millions of kilometers in front of Meng Chuan. Its tentacles extended for over 50 million kilometers as its huge golden eye stared at Meng Chuan.
Oh?
Meng Chuan’s expression changed slightly.
Undying Body of the Past?
This forbidden creature’s usage of time had already exceeded the law of the past; it was even more profound. It could easily project the past into the present for its resurrection.
Bark didn’t rely on its Life Core to revive. Instead, it relied on its own resurrection method. Therefore, its Life Core didn’t show any fluctuations.
Due to this, Meng Chuan naturally couldn’t find his opponent’s Life Core.
“Unless you far exceed me in the law of time, you will never be able to destroy my true body.” Bark’s golden eye stared at Meng Chuan.
“Really?”
Two additional figures suddenly split out from the three Meng Chuans.
Five Meng Chuans now stood over the Turbid River. Vast Essence Soul Worlds appeared above their heads, and every Essence Soul World had a huge Chaos Hole.
A terrifying saber beam was born within each Chaos Hole.
Heaven Splitting Chaos Hole!
The five Meng Chuans unleashed five exceptionally dazzling saber beams simultaneously, shattering everything in front of them.
“Five?” Bark had returned to his current physical form from the spacetime prison state. His defense was much stronger, but he couldn’t help but feel terrified when facing the five Heaven Splitting Chaos Hole blades.
Almost instantly, the region he was in was completely torn apart. Bark’s true body shattered once again.
A terrifying force gathered, affecting spacetime at a deeper level.

chapters.title: Chapter 701 - The Oriole Behind
chapters.content:
Chapter 701: The Oriole Behind
With enough energy, one could also affect the timeline.
Meng Chuan’s five Essence Soul avatars used Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting at the same time, and the attack’s might was terrifying. Even the relatively close timeline was affected, preventing Bark from reviving.
However, Bark was indeed very adept at the time lineage. It could revive by projecting from the distant past—a time which Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting didn’t affect. A massive, hundred-odd tentacle true body formed in the Chaos Turbid River.
Bark’s golden eyes stared at Meng Chuan. It was covetous, but it also felt that this newly-advanced Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence was too difficult to deal with.
With my spacetime strength, I can hide far away if I want to. His Essence Soul World killer move won’t even touch me.
Bark was still very confident.
However, my goal is to devour his Essence Soul avatar. If I escape, how can I devour him?
He has multiple Essence Soul avatars. Once he detects danger, he will immediately self-destruct them. He’s too cautious.
Bark found it too difficult.
The Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence in front of him had terrifying might when attacking. Meng Chuan’s attack could suppress him, but only this move was powerful.
In other aspects—including defensive means—Meng Chuan was much weaker. Bark could easily destroy the domain and corrode his opponent, but his opponent didn’t care. If he felt something was amiss, he would immediately destroy his Essence Soul avatar.
I’ll try another move.
After Bark’s true body revived, it tried again. After all, it was too difficult to encounter a newly-advanced Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
Seventh Tribulation Eminences—who had broken through for a long time—typically had high attainments in the time lineage. The effects of its many moves would be much weaker against them.
Meng Chuan’s time lineage techniques were clearly weaker, so Bark held a huge advantage over him.
Whoosh.
When Meng Chuan saw the forbidden creature—which had resurrected in front of him—its body became blurry. Almost instantly, thousands of tentacles enveloped Meng Chuan.
Although he couldn’t see through the move, Meng Chuan could vaguely tell that it was a time lineage attack. In a split second, the other party had attacked with blistering speed, causing a massive number of tentacles to appear.
I never expected that I wouldn’t be able to crack its Undying Body of the Past despite using all my strength.
Meng Chuan shook his head.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!
Without any hesitation, the five Essence Soul avatars produced five Chaos Holes Heaven Splitting blades.
These five dazzling saber beams illuminated spacetime, and the spacetime within a five-billion-kilometer radius was completely annihilated. All the tentacles were naturally annihilated, as well as the blurry forbidden creature.
Everything fell silent, but Meng Chuan knew that the other party would soon revive by projecting from the past.
I’m leaving.
Meng Chuan couldn’t be bothered to continue fighting. If he couldn’t force his opponent to revive with its Life Core, he wouldn’t be able to find its Life Core. His opponent would forever be invincible.
Fighting a forbidden creature that couldn’t be killed was a complete waste of time.
Whoosh!
After using the mystic technique bestowed by Fiend Mountain’s owner, Meng Chuan immediately felt the entire Chaos Turbid River repel him. Following the repulsive force, he completely disappeared from the Chaos Turbid River’s spacetime.
Whoosh!
Bark revived by projecting from the past again, and its massive body took form. However, Meng Chuan was no longer around.
He left? He left the Chaos Turbid River?
Bark was indignant, but it was helpless. It knew that its chances of devouring Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars were slim, even if they continued fighting.
At that moment, the flowing Chaos Turbid River froze.
Bark sensed the powerful shackles of spacetime about to seal it completely. Bark slowly turned its head with great difficulty and looked into the distance.
An old farmer covered in wrinkles walked over on the turbid river water.
Myriad Star.
Bark’s heart turned cold.
Bark naturally knew about Celestial Thearch Myriad Star!
There were only two cultivators in the River of Spacetime that could truly threaten it—Celestial Thearch Myriad Star and Hall Lord White Avian. Ever since he learned that there were half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences, Bark had been very careful. It seldom revealed its true body.
Even when dealing with prey, Bark only revealed its true body briefly before dispersing.
How is this possible? I only fought that newly-advanced Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence for a short period of time, so how did he know? Even if he knew, it should’ve taken him a long time to rush over.
Bark couldn’t understand.
The Chaos Turbid River was a spacetime maze. It was very troublesome to travel through it. Only by becoming an Eighth Tribulation Eminence could one not be affected.
As for Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star, they were still affected by the array formation—which was augmented by Fiend Mountain’s owner and generations of Eighth Tribulation Eminences. Even if they sensed the battle between Meng Chuan and Bark, it would take them some time to rush over.
It’s very difficult to pry into battles happening in the Chaos Turbid River. It’s even more impossible to rush over in a short period of time.
Bark flailed its tentacles in despair, but at that moment, the hundreds of tentacles moved very slowly.
How did he arrive so quickly?
Seal!
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star—who had come close—slapped his palm on Bark’s head.
Countless runes appeared and completely sealed Bark’s true body. Its eyes couldn’t move, and its tentacles couldn’t move an inch. Its massive body was like a statue, unable to exert any strength.
I’ve been sealed; I can’t move at all.
Bark’s consciousness remained intact, but a terrifying force sealed every inch of its true body.
“It’s all thanks to Meng Chuan that I could capture your true body alive.” A smile appeared on Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s simple and honest face.
It was indeed very difficult to pry into the Chaos Turbid River’s battles. However, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star placed great importance on Meng Chuan. Ever since he saw Meng Chuan’s future timelines, he had elevated Meng Chuan’s status—second to Hall Lord White Avian only.
He would view Meng Chuan’s future timelines almost every few decades. Ever since Meng Chuan came to the Chaos Turbid River, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had taken notice...
Meng Chuan’s future was almost certain to clash with Bark’s.
Due to Bark’s extremely high attainments in spacetime, he would discover a prey like Meng Chuan. Once Meng Chuan reached the newly-advanced Seventh Tribulation realm, this battle was bound to happen.
“After confirming that the two of you would definitely fight, I came to the Chaos Turbid River.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star looked at Bark’s massive but immobile body. “I’ve waited for more than 100 years for you to take action.”
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was very patient. To him, it didn’t matter where he cultivated.
As he cultivated in the Chaos Turbid River, he waited patiently, and he hid close to Meng Chuan.
“With your true body captured alive, you won’t be able to produce another true body with your Life Core.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star knew the way to capture a Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature.
Only when the true body died completely—or if the body or consciousness was destroyed—could the Life Core condense a new true body.
If its true body was only immobile while still alive, its Life Core wouldn’t be able to condense another true body.
The distance between a Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature’s Life Core and its true body is no more than 150 billion kilometers in the Chaos Turbid River.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star looked around and began to probe through spacetime.
With the other party’s true body in hand, even if the other party’s Life Core moved, it would definitely be within 150 billion kilometers.
Invisible fluctuations carefully swept through a 150-billion-kilometer area.
At that moment, Bark’s true body became a restriction! It prevented its Life Core from escaping.
The Life Core of a Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature has already been conceptualized. But as long as it’s within 150 billion kilometers, I will eventually find it.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star searched area after area.
With his realm, he finally found the Life Core—which was constantly fleeing within the 150-billion-kilometer area.
Nomological threads were pulled.
These nomological threads had fused with the Chaos Turbid River. One had to be at a high enough realm to discover these nomological threads.
Whoosh.
Countless gray threads appeared, and every thread had countless runes. Celestial Thearch Myriad Star forced these gray threads to condense into a tiny wooden sculpture.
This was a strange wooden sculpture with over 100 tentacles—it was Bark’s true body when miniaturized.
“Spare me, spare me,” said the wooden sculpture.
Hum.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star extended his hand and grabbed the wooden sculpture. He looked at the wooden sculpture that was begging for mercy. First, he completely sealed the energy fluctuations within the wooden sculpture. Then, he completely destroyed its consciousness.
Bark’s consciousness in its massive true body was instantly annihilated, turning into a corpse.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star smiled as he held the wooden sculpture in his hand. Even with his capabilities, he couldn’t destroy the wooden sculpture.
Even if he destroyed it physically, the wooden sculpture would only disintegrate into countless gray threads that would form again.
“Eternal and indestructible. Just releasing the seal will nurture a new consciousness,” muttered Celestial Thearch Myriad Star. “No wonder Fiend Mountain’s owner has been studying these Chaos creatures.”
Outside the universe, Chaos creatures were an extremely large group. A Chaos Overlord could match an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. But in comparison, Eighth Tribulation Eminences had more profound means.
Below Eternal existences, Eighth Tribulation Eminences were the strongest group in the endless spacetime. There was no doubt about this.
However, Eighth Tribulation Eminences also had limited lifespans.
After obtaining the Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature’s Life Core, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was in a good mood.
He looked into the distance.
This Meng Chuan sure grows fast.

chapters.title: Chapter 702 - Creating an Essence Soul Formulation
chapters.content:
Chapter 702: Creating an Essence Soul Formulation
When he thought of Meng Chuan, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s good mood significantly faded. After all, Meng Chuan was a member of White Avian Hall.
I never expected him to have such strength shortly after reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star pondered.
Many of Meng Chuan’s techniques were undoubtedly still immature, but his Heaven Splitting Chaos Hole was ridiculously powerful. It was definitely at the top of the Seventh Tribulation realm.
Weak defense? Weak domain? An Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence could abandon every Essence Soul avatar at any time.
All of these factors made Meng Chuan a huge threat.
Meng Chuan, I really don’t wish to become enemies with you. Otherwise, I’ll have a headache, and you will suffer.
As an existence that controlled time and space, a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence wouldn’t be afraid of any enemies. At most, there would be another half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence in the River of Spacetime. He had fought Hall Lord White Avian for many years, so he could handle another half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
He didn’t believe that any of his enemies could become an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. After all, according to history, only one Eighth Tribulation Eminence could appear out of 100 half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star felt that Meng Chuan and Hall Lord White Avian were far from reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm.
...
In White Avian Hall’s headquarters, Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in front of a bookshelf within the vast library. He flipped through Essence Soul formulation manuals.
There are 809 types of Essence Soul formulation manuals at the Seventh Tribulation realm in White Avian Hall.
Meng Chuan placed the book back on the bookshelf.
There are 12 Chaos Hole lineage manuals, and five are of the Heaven Splitting lineage.
There were too many Seventh Tribulation Essence Soul formulation manuals. This was because there were a few Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminences in every era. After a long period of history, there were naturally many more Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
Even though White Avian Hall only had a small portion of the many cultivation techniques in history, it was already a very astonishing number. Meng Chuan didn’t have time to comprehend all of them, so he only read cultivation techniques of the Chaos Hole lineage and the Heaven Splitting lineage.
There are a total of 17 Essence Soul formulations for the Chaos Hole lineage and the Heaven Splitting lineage.
Meng Chuan fell into deep thought. He had some gains after reading these formulations, but they were far inferior to the Eighth Tribulation Essence Soul legacies—Essence Soul Star and Eternal Road—that he had learned.
An Eighth Tribulation Essence Soul formulation is still most useful. White Avian Hall has five Eighth Tribulation Essence Soul formulations.
Meng Chuan stood up and walked more than ten steps before arriving in front of a bookshelf. There was only one crystal on the entire bookshelf. It was an Eighth Tribulation Essence Soul legacy—Heavenly River.
Meng Chuan sent a wisp of his Power of Essence Soul into the crystal, and a vast amount of information surged into his mind immediately.
Wonderful.
Meng Chuan was overjoyed the moment he figured it out.
Even though he had previously obtained two Eighth Tribulation legacies, he still benefited greatly from gaining a superficial comprehension of a third Eighth Tribulation legacy.
The Heavenly River legacy was about change. The myriad rivers constantly changed, and the myriad rivers contained Origins laws, Sixth Tribulation laws, and countless weaker laws. They collided with each other and constantly transformed into new tiny laws. However, the countless streams of water gathered into a Heavenly River, which was eternal.
Change and Eternity were the core of Heavenly River.
Meng Chuan carefully studied the legacy for half a year before learning the next legacy.
Heavenly River, Sand of Time, and Book of Truth—these three Essence Soul legacies didn’t have any karmic restraints, so they could be directly studied.
There were also two other Eighth Tribulation legacies—Universe Evolution and Immeasurable Uniqueness—but reading them had karmic implications.
Once I learn Universe Evolution, I’ll need to protect a high-level world—Aeon World—for 10,000 years if I become an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. I’ll also need to do my best to fulfill three promises of Aeon World’s strongest expert at the time.
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
This requirement is lower than Senior Fei Yu’s. If I can reach the Eighth Tribulation realm, this requirement isn’t too much. I’ll only need to do my best three times.
The Eighth Tribulation Eminence senior—who had inherited this legacy—had already died. It was already not bad for the strongest expert in Aeon World to reach the Seventh Tribulation realm.
Furthermore, he could reject requests. All he needed to do was help thrice.
Once I master Immeasurable Uniqueness, I have to unconditionally agree to Lord Sakuraba’s request thrice—other than not implicating my home universe or life—when I reach the Eighth Tribulation Realm.
Meng Chuan was alarmed when he saw this requirement.
This legacy had detailed records that Lord Sakuraba was a Chaos Lord. Furthermore, he had completely comprehended the laws of time and space. Lord Sakuraba had reached the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm, and he was one of the few Eighth Tribulation Eminences among Chaos Lords.
Because of his Life Core, Lord Sakuraba had an extremely long lifespan. His lifespan was much longer than that of ordinary Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminences. He was a famous existence outside the universe.
I have to unconditionally agree to a request three times?
Meng Chuan shook his head slightly. This requirement was simply too much. If he really had a chance of reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm, the karma brought by learning this legacy might cause him great trouble in the future.
With so many manuals, it wasn’t like he had to learn Immeasurable Uniqueness.
...
Therefore, Meng Chuan focused on studying the other four manuals—Heavenly River, Sand of Time, Book of Truth, and Universe Evolution. He also referenced Essence Soul Star and Eternal Road.
These six Eighth Tribulation legacies became Meng Chuan’s cultivation resource.
The reason why it was easier for future generations to surpass their predecessors was that they stood on their predecessors’ shoulders. With the six Eighth Tribulation legacy manuals as a foundation, Meng Chuan naturally had a much deeper understanding regarding the formation of his Essence Soul formulation.
Heavenly River—Change and Eternal.
Sand of Time—time fritters away things, but it remains eternal.
Book of Truth—12 Truths.
Universe Evolution—the source of the universe; the creation, operation, decay, and destruction.
Essence Soul Star—indestructible in the face of infinite calamity.
Eternal Road—Sea of Spacetime forged into an Eternal Road.
In White Avian Hall, Thousand Mountain Star, Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, and Archean Eon Realm, Meng Chuan’s true bodies and avatars were immersed in cultivating the Essence Soul formulations.
After grasping an Origins law, one would’ve grasped the truth of the universe. They were qualified to create an Essence Soul formulation. Although the formulation they created would be slightly deviant because they had only grasped one Origins law, the Essence Soul formulation still had extremely long-lasting effects on the Essence Soul.
If one couldn’t create an Essence Soul formulation, their willpower would ultimately be limited.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
In Meng Chuan’s sea of consciousness, his Essence Soul was the Chaos Hole Core. It had condensed into a sphere that could withstand infinite tribulations.
Water flowed externally while dark water swirled around the Chaos Hole’s core like a Chaos Hole domain.
This was a change in Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul structure with the Chaos Hole law as the core. It was an improvement on his original, embryonic Essence Soul formulation.
Such an Essence Soul could be called a Chaos Hole Essence Soul.
My Essence Soul formulation might be called Boulder and Water. Inside, it’s a Boulder—the Chaos Hole’s core is a Boulder. In the future, it might be a universe that is the Boulder. On the outside is Water. The changes in Water are endless, and it can deal with changes in the outside world. Even though the universe is vast, there are endless mysteries beyond the universe.
In the 25th year of researching an Essence Soul formulation, Meng Chuan had completely figured out an Essence Soul formulation built atop his original foundation. It was called Boulder and Water.
But Meng Chuan vaguely felt that something was amiss with it.
This formulation could indeed summarize his cultivation thoughts. He could also easily fuse the Chaos Hole law into it and form a Chaos Hole Essence Soul. He could even plan his path to the Eighth Tribulation realm.
But deep in his heart... he felt that this formulation wasn’t the most compatible with him.
This isn’t what’s most compatible with me? Then, what is most compatible with me?
Meng Chuan looked inwardly at the Essence Soul, which had already become much stronger. His willpower had also improved greatly. The Boulder and Water formulation was definitely in no way inferior to Seventh Tribulation Essence Soul formulations. However, he vaguely felt that something was amiss.
Meng Chuan pondered hard and carefully pondered over the six Eighth Tribulation legacies. He hoped that it would trigger something.
In the 34th year of his research into the Essence Soul formulation, Meng Chuan finally understood the problem.
Yes, Boulder and Water is more compatible with me, but what’s truly compatible with me... is another path.
In Meng Chuan’s mind, his Chaos Hole Essence Soul had already begun to transform into a painting that slowly unfolded.

chapters.title: Chapter 703 - Painting World
chapters.content:
Chapter 703: Painting World
His Essence Soul transformed into a painting. Above the scroll, water swirled around the Chaos Hole’s core.
In the early stages of painting, one aimed for form, mind, and heart.
Painting wasn’t a complete replication of reality. Instead, it was a fusion of the features and charms extracted from reality with the painter’s internal understanding.
Paintings originated from reality, but they also transcended reality.
It was the same for cultivation. As a cultivator, Meng Chuan observed the operations of the world and comprehended everything in the universe. He used his heart as a painting and extracted his own understanding from everything before condensing his understanding into laws.
My cultivation path is also the path of painting. In the early days, I painted the world. Now, I paint everything in the universe.
Meng Chuan came to a realization.
To this day, I only paint space and Chaos Holes.
His true path wasn’t Boulder and Water, nor was it internal indestructibility in the face of infinite calamity and changes according to the situation externally.
Instead, it was painting—painting of the world.
Boulder and Water was only the result of his 7,000 years of painting the world. What if it was 70,000 years or even longer? The paintings he produced would be much more vast and beautiful.
I shall call my Essence Soul formulation ‘Painting World.’
Meng Chuan smiled.
Painting World was to paint everything he saw. When Meng Chuan was young, he painted People Resonance. After winning the war in Archean Eon Realm, he painted Backbone. During his growth, he had painted numerous paintings.
After his Essence Soul transformed, Meng Chuan felt that his Essence Soul was especially bright.
Perhaps he still had many doubts about everything in the universe, but he no longer had any doubts about his cultivation path. His mind and will had also transformed.
Compared to the Chaos Hole Essence Soul that he had previously comprehended, the current painting Essence Soul didn’t seem to have offensive traits, but it was more inclusive and vast.
The size of one’s heart determined their Essence Soul World’s size.
After condensing an Essence Soul from the painting, Meng Chuan’s mind became much more vast.
...
After creating an Essence Soul formulation, his most important goal before transcending the tribulation had been completed. In Archean Eon Realm, Meng Chuan leisurely flipped through the manual filled with 3,000 illusory arrays.
One required a long period of time to comprehend the 3,000 illusory arrays; it was very difficult for even an Eighth Tribulation Eminence to crack them all. Thus, Meng Chuan wasn’t in a hurry.
Time passed quickly. On the 79th year since Meng Chuan grasped the Chaos Hole law—
In a courtyard pavilion on Archean Mountain.
Meng Chuan leisurely sat in the pavilion with a black book in his hand. He suddenly looked up, and his gaze traversed spacetime and landed on an ancient planet in a distant river zone.
This grandson of mine really has quite some luck with opportunities.
Meng Chuan smiled. His homeworld’s true body had the Spacetime Token, the silver cube combination treasure, and the many treasures left behind by Ancestral Master Archean Eon. Be it monitoring spacetime or sending an Essence Soul avatar across spacetime, it was very easy for him.
...
Heavenly Cycle River Zone, Seven Star River System.
On a nameless ancient planet, the void distorted as five figures appeared. They had different auras, and the weakest among them was a black-robed youth. This black-robed youth—Meng Yu—was only at the Third Tribulation realm. The other four were at the Fourth Tribulation realm.
“Everyone, let’s part ways here,” said Meng Yu with a smile. His brows were filled with delight; he had gained too much this time.
“Brother Meng, I owe you a favor this time. In the future, you have to visit me often,” said a fat elder.
“Definitely, definitely,” replied Meng Yu warmly.
“Let’s leave quickly. Something might happen if we delay,” said a purple-robed, middle-aged man. He was about to leave with Lesser Void Transference. He was rather good at spatial manipulation, but he had failed this time. The purple-robed man’s expression changed. “Not good.”
The other Tribulation Eminences, including Meng Yu, realized that something was amiss. However, the strongest amongst them was only at the Fourth Tribulation realm. Some of their homeworlds only had one or two Void Transference Talismans, so their outer realm true bodies didn’t carry any Void Transference Talismans with them.
They were prepared to abandon their outer realm true bodies when carrying out operations outside the safety of their homeworlds. After all, it was a trivial matter to reconstruct a body, while obtaining Void Transference Talismans was far harder.
But this time, the five of them were willing to pay a Void Transference Talisman in exchange for a chance to escape.
“Haha...” A deep laugh sounded.
A figure dressed in armor appeared, and his aura enveloped the entire ancient planet. The terrifying aura caused Meng Yu and company’s hearts to turn cold.
Fifth Tribulation Eminence?
Meng Yu and company knew that things were going south.
With his excellent sword technique, Meng Yu could fight a Fourth Tribulation Eminence despite them being a realm higher than him. However, the gap grew with each increment in cultivation realm. The difference between a Fourth Tribulation Eminence and a Fifth Tribulation Eminence was huge!
A Fifth Tribulation Eminence could easily crush the five of them. There wouldn’t be any accidents.
“I heard that you discovered a Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s cave abode?” The armored figure’s voice spread throughout the planet. “Your luck sure is good.”
There’s a traitor.
Meng Yu and company were alarmed as they immediately realized that a traitor had appeared amongst them.
Before their team explored the ruin, they didn’t know about the ruin’s true situation. After exploring, they were pleasantly surprised to discover that the ruin was actually where a Seventh Tribulation Eminence lived in seclusion. Although there weren’t many treasures left behind by the Seventh Tribulation Eminence, and there wasn’t a single Eighth Tribulation treasure, the ordinary treasures used in daily life made ordinary Tribulation Eminences like them envious.
For example, the most precious item was nine Heart Calming Beads embedded in the roof of a chamber. Each bead was worth about 10,000 cubes. Back then, they had been fanatical. There were dozens of treasures in the cave abode, worth about 200,000 cubes.
The five of them had become wealthy during their reconnaissance. However, they were ambushed the moment they came out of the cave abode. The other party even claimed that it was a Seventh Tribulation cave abode. Nobody had known that it was a Seventh Tribulation cave abode before they explored it.
“There’s no need to try escaping; I’ve already set up an array formation,” said the armored figure leisurely. “As long as you hand over all your treasures obediently, I promise to let you leave safely.”
“Separate and flee.”
“There’s only one of him. Let’s split up and flee; there’s a chance of escaping!”
“Flee!”
Everyone, including Meng Yu, fled without any hesitation.
Gathering together? Ignoring the fact that there was a traitor among them, even if the five of them joined forces, they would be wiped clean by the Fifth Tribulation Eminence. Only by fleeing separately did they have a chance of escaping. After all, there was only one Fifth Tribulation Eminence.
It was impossible for them to allow themselves to be captured. For the sake of the treasures in their hands, they would do their best to seize any chance of escaping.
Most of the treasures I obtained in the cave abode are cultivation artifacts. The alchemy furnace should be rather precious, but there’s no way to use it to escape.
Meng Yu determined a direction and fled quickly. At the same time, he felt rather vexed.
That divine sword is quite valuable, but I have no hope of fighting a Fifth Tribulation Eminence with it.
If I had earned the treasures earlier, I would’ve long exchanged for a Void Transference Talisman.
Meng Yu was anxious.
Void Transference Talismans were life-preservation treasures for ordinary Tribulation Eminences, but he was too poor. Ever since he came out of his homeworld—Earth Cloud Mystic Realm—he had never had the chance to obtain a Void Transference Talisman. He had relied on his sword techniques to roam the world.
The reason why he was so accomplished in sword techniques was that he had spent almost all his energy on the Meng family’s ultimate technique—Immeasurable Sword Heart. As he cultivated, he realized how brilliant Immeasurable Sword Heart—which his grandfather had given him—was. At the very least, he had never encountered an ultimate technique more powerful than the Immeasurable Sword Heart in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm.
“No—” As a gray-robed man fled, he was the first to be intercepted by the armored figure. The gray-robed man raised his head in despair and stared at the armored figure. He had obtained the equivalent of 30,000 cubes this time. It was several times more than what he had accumulated over the years. How could he be willing to be robbed?
Boom!
The armored figure enveloped him with a palm strike, freezing the gray-robed man completely. The treasures were easily plundered.
“Next.” The armored figure phased away and chased after Meng Yu.
Meng Yu transformed into a sword beam. Even though he had to resist the array formation’s obstruction, his escaping speed was still extremely fast. However, the armored figure was already chasing after him speedily.
The armored figure wasn’t affected by the array formation, and his realm was extremely high. Every step he took allowed him to traverse over five million kilometers as he constantly approached Meng Yu.
What should I do? What should I do?
Meng Yu was extremely anxious.
The rare treasure I obtained in the outer realm is about to be snatched away?
Meng Yu watched as the armored figure approached him. However, he felt powerless. The difference in strength was too great; there was no way to put up a fight.
“Grandson, don’t panic.”
A familiar voice suddenly sounded in Meng Yu’s mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 704 - Grandfather and Grandsons Reunion
chapters.content:
Chapter 704: Grandfather and Grandson’s Reunion
Meng Yu was stunned.
Grandson?
This familiar voice reminded Meng Yu of his grandfather, whom he had only met a few times.
“You still want to escape?” The armored figure’s lips curled into a sneer.
How could a mere Third Tribulation Eminence possibly resist?
He immediately struck out with his palm, hoping to freeze Meng Yu completely. But halfway through the strike, the armored figure’s eyes widened. He had already lost consciousness, and the might of the strike dissipated.
Meng Yu fled in fright as he used his sword technique to defend himself. Sword beams shielded his surroundings.
“Eh?” Meng Yu realized that, although the palm strike’s might seemed terrifying, it had completely dissipated. Only a tiny portion of it affected him, allowing him to withstand it easily. Following that, he saw the armored figure fall to the ground with a thud.
The armored figure remained motionless, no longer breathing.
He’s dead?
Meng Yu was somewhat alarmed.
A Fifth Tribulation Eminence silently died just like that?
A Fifth Tribulation Eminence could preside over an entire river system. Even in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, they would occupy the top of the pyramid. Yet, he had died just like that?
“Grandson.” A voice sounded from ahead.
Meng Yu looked up and saw a white-robed, white-haired, and middle-aged man smiling at him.
“Grandfather.” Meng Yu revealed a look of delight as he ran over. Following that, he thought of something and immediately said, “Grandfather, shouldn’t we take back the treasures we obtained? Apart from that fatty, the others don’t have any relationship with me.”
“Snatch treasures?” Meng Chuan was slightly taken aback.
“Yes, 200,000 cubes’ worth,” said Meng Yu immediately. “A huge treasure trove!”
Such a treasure trove was enough to make Fifth Tribulation Eminences risk their lives. It even made Sixth Tribulation Eminences envious. It was no wonder Meng Yu was concerned. He knew that his grandfather was fighting a great enemy in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, so a huge treasure trove should be able to help his grandfather.
Furthermore, Meng Yu was used to all kinds of schemes being pitted against one another while roaming the outer realm. His companions had only discovered the ruin with him; they didn’t have any relationship with him. Apart from the fat elder, the others in the cave abode even had a falling out with him for the treasures.
If it weren’t for the agreement they made beforehand and their unwillingness to shoulder the karma, they probably would’ve fought each other in the cave abode.
“I’ll destroy that traitor then,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
A snake-scaled man—who was fleeing—silently turned to dust. At the same time, Meng Chuan waved his hand and put away all the treasures. He also put away the Fifth Tribulation Eminence’s corpse since it was still worth something.
The fat elder and the purple-robed man fled in panic. When they felt that no array formation was suppressing them, they used Lesser Void Transference to escape.
Whoosh. Whoosh.
After the two successfully teleported and fled far away, they heaved sighs of relief.
We actually managed to escape?
The fat elder and the purple-robed man were in an unfamiliar void. They were both glad and somewhat puzzled. A Fifth Tribulation Eminence had prepared an ambush ahead of time, yet they actually managed to escape? They were really lucky.
...
On the ancient planet, Meng Yu was somewhat surprised to see his grandfather let the two Fourth Tribulation Eminences go. “Grandfather, releasing one more person means losing tens of thousands of cubes of treasures. Grandfather, don’t you have a powerful enemy?”
“What I lack isn’t treasures but cultivation,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“Grandfather, what realm are you at now?” Meng Yu couldn’t help but ask this.
He made a Fifth Tribulation Eminence die silently? How powerful is my grandfather?
Meng Chuan was stunned, but his expression didn’t change as he sighed. “I’m only a half-step Sixth Tribulation Eminence now. My enemy is a true Sixth Tribulation Eminence; he has been invincible in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm for many years. However, I’m an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence. With me obstructing him, he can forget about controlling Earth Cloud Mystic Realm.”
Meng Yu understood; he knew how special Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences were. His grandfather relied on the Essence Soul Tribulation realm’s uniqueness to fight a Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
“What’s the name of the enemy?” asked Meng Yu.
“I can’t tell you. Karma will form if you know, and this enemy might discover your existence,” said Meng Chuan.
“I understand.” Meng Yu understood that he was still too weak!
“Grandfather, I obtained quite a number of treasures this time. They should be worth nearly 50,000 cubes.” With a flip of his hand, Meng Yu took out a storage treasure. “Grandfather, I’m still weak. Having 5,000 cubes for myself is enough; I’ll give the rest to you.”
Meng Chuan blinked when he saw this.
What a good child. He is just too filial.
“That’s true; you won’t be able to use most of these treasures. I’ll help you exchange them for something suitable for you in Eternal Tower.” Meng Chuan reached out and received the treasures. He thought that he had to prepare a gift for his grandson. With a thought, Meng Chuan knew that there were 150,000 cubes in total from the Fifth Tribulation Eminence, the traitor, and Meng Yu.
I’ll double it! I’ll prepare a treasure worth 300,000 cubes for my grandson.
This was enough for a Third Tribulation Eminence.
His grandson probably couldn’t tell the true origins of such a treasure.
I can only buy some ordinary treasures at Eternal Tower. Some precious treasures can only be bought by Fifth Tribulation Eminences or even stronger experts.
Meng Yu also knew this.
...
Heavenly Cycle River Zone, Fire Cloud Fiend Palace.
Fiend Lord Fire Cloud was the strongest expert in the entire Heavenly Cycle River Zone. He was a top existence among Sixth Tribulation Eminences, and he was also a core member of Black Fiend Hall.
His Fire Cloud Fiend Palace was also the largest fiend cave in the entire Heavenly Cycle River Zone. Many Tribulation Eminences cultivated here, as well as a large number of Imperial Lord servants.
In an underground chamber of the Fiend Palace, Fiend Lord Fire Cloud sat cross-legged amidst rising purple flames. He had two horns on his head and thick scales all over his body. He was as heavy as a mountain.
Huh?
Fiend Lord Fire Cloud received news from his subordinates.
Fuming was just about to succeed in obtaining the treasures from a Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s cave abode ruin worth nearly 200,000 cubes when he was attacked by a suspected Sixth Tribulation Eminence?
Fiend Lord Fire Cloud was furious when he received the news.
Everyone in the entire Heavenly Cycle River Zone knows that Fuming is a member of Black Fiend Hall and that he’s my subordinate. To dare attack him directly, this person is an enemy of Black Fiend Hall, as well as me!
Black Fiend Hall was domineering in its dealings. They would take Sixth Tribulation Eminences into account and avoid Sixth Tribulation Eminence factions when they attacked. However, Sixth Tribulation Eminences couldn’t provoke Black Fiend Hall. If they took the initiative to provoke Black Fiend Hall, Black Fiend Hall would crazily counterattack and kill them to serve as a warning to others.
It was rare for Black Fiend Hall to endure the two times Meng Chuan had crossed them.
I want to see who it is.
Fiend Lord Fire Cloud looked at the location of the cave abode according to the intelligence. Afraid that he would be late, he immediately used a Void Transference Talisman to head there.
To a River Zone-level expert like him, a Void Transference Talisman was nothing. Only a Spacetime Teleportation Talisman was considered precious.
...
Not good. Let’s go.
Meng Chuan sensed something and immediately left with Meng Yu.
Meng Yu was somewhat dazed.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan and his grandson left this ancient planet, but another Meng Chuan remained.
I can get away with killing a Fifth Tribulation Eminence from Black Fiend Hall, but killing a Sixth Tribulation Eminence won’t be that easy to get away with.
When Meng Chuan left with his grandson, he naturally left an Essence Soul avatar behind.
Meng Chuan looked up at the void outside the planet. A stocky figure—which emitted a monstrous flaming aura—appeared in the void. It was none other than Fiend Lord Fire Cloud.
Fiend Lord Fire Cloud had a vast aura. As a top Sixth Tribulation Eminence, he was virtually invincible in the River of Spacetime.
Huh?
Fiend Lord Fire Cloud saw the white-robed, white-haired man on the planet. Although Meng Chuan had restrained his aura and looked ordinary, Fiend Lord Fire Cloud still recognized him at a glance.
City Lord Eastcalm, Meng Chuan—White Avian Hall’s Deputy Patroller! A peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence!
How could he offend a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence who grasped a spatial law?
“So it’s City Lord Eastcalm.” Fiend Lord Fire Cloud immediately wore a humble, honest smile. “City Lord Eastcalm, it’s truly a blessing for our Heavenly Cycle River Zone to have you grace us with your presence.”
“Why are you here?” Meng Chuan looked at him.
“I was just passing by.” Fire Cloud smiled obsequiously. “I’ll leave now.”

chapters.title: Chapter 705 - Black Fiend Hall Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 705: Black Fiend Hall Master
“You said you were passing by despite using a Void Transference Talisman to come here?” said Meng Chuan coldly. “Since you’ve come, don’t leave.”
Boom.
Fiend Lord Fire Cloud felt the surrounding space collapse rapidly; he couldn’t escape at all.
The space instantly collapsed into a point, and Fiend Lord Fire Cloud was completely annihilated. All that was left were sufficiently tough weapons and artifacts.
Since I encountered him, I’ll just crush him in passing.
Meng Chuan instinctively felt killing intent toward Black Fiend Hall’s members.
This was because he could see the heinous sins on Black Fiend Hall’s members. Every Black Fiend Hall member had an immense grudge and endless wailing over them since they had slaughtered countless living beings. As a core member of Black Fiend Hall, Fiend Lord Fire Cloud’s sins were even more terrifying. Unfortunately... The other party had a true body in his homeworld.
Meng Chuan had only destroyed the other party’s outer realm true body.
...
“I took the initiative to curry favor with him and bowed my head in submission, but he actually killed my true body.” In his homeworld, Fiend Lord Fire Cloud was furious. He had been extremely humble and had put on an obsequious stance, but he had still met with such an end. “He’s gone too far. He thinks nothing of Black Fiend Hall. I want to report this to Hall Master!”
Fiend Lord Fire Cloud had never suffered such humiliation. He immediately reported to Black Fiend Hall Master through Nebula Palace.
...
In one of Nebula Palace’s halls.
A handsome man with fair skin sat on the main seat and flipped through Black Fiend Hall’s dossiers.
Black Fiend Hall had two hall masters—one main and one deputy. The main hall master was Lord of Li Rainbow, who had cultivated for an extremely long time—more than 120,000 years. When his might shook the River of Spacetime, Ancestral Magus King was only at the Sixth Tribulation realm.
Although he hadn’t reached the echelons of the top Seventh Tribulation Eminences after cultivating for so long, the passage of time had made his attainments in the temporal law extremely high.
Lord of Li Rainbow’s rise was slightly earlier than Guild Master Fiend Eye’s. It was said that he had committed heinous sins as Black Fiend Hall’s supreme leader, but he seldom took action. This was especially so when the deputy hall master was also an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence. His Essence Soul avatars fought everywhere, so it was even rarer for Lord of Li Rainbow to take action.
A bunch of fools.
Lord of Li Rainbow flipped through the dossiers. He could see the provocations from some factions in the River of Spacetime.
Lord of Li Rainbow enjoyed too many resources as Black Fiend Hall Master, causing other Seventh Tribulation Eminences to spy on him. This was especially so since he was still not a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
Top Seventh Tribulation Eminences waste their time comprehending a second Origins law,
thought Lord of Li Rainbow.
Isn’t it better to spend time studying the temporal law? This way, one’s chances of grasping the temporal law will be greater.
Lord of Li Rainbow was ambitious. He had also reached the Seventh Tribulation realm after cultivating for slightly over 10,000 years, and he had become famous earlier than Fiend Eye.
He focused on studying the temporal law and didn’t want to be distracted. But before he completely grasped the temporal law, his combat strength was inferior to those who combined two Origins laws.
“Hall Lord.” Fiend Lord Fire Cloud walked in from outside the hall.
“What’s the matter?” Lord of Li Rainbow glanced at him and continued reading the dossiers.
“City Lord Eastcalm—Meng Chuan—has gone overboard with bullying our Black Fiend Hall!” Fiend Lord Fire Cloud was furious.
“Tell me in detail,” said Lord of Li Rainbow calmly.
Fiend Lord Fire Cloud said respectfully, “This was what happened. A Fifth Tribulation Eminence from our Black Fiend Hall went to snatch the treasures obtained from a cave abode, but he was surprisingly ambushed by City Lord Eastcalm. I learned of the news and knew that it happened in my Heavenly Cycle River Zone! He took the initiative to attack a member of our Black Fiend Hall in my Heavenly Cycle River Zone, so I naturally had to investigate the culprit who was bold enough to provoke our Black Fiend Hall.”
Lord of Li Rainbow listened.
“I immediately rushed over and discovered that it was actually City Lord Eastcalm,” said Fire Cloud. “He’s a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence after all, and I wasn’t stupid enough to provoke him. Thus, I naturally submitted to him and didn’t dare cross him at all. But to my surprise, he still killed my outer realm true body.”
“He still killed your outer realm true body?” Lord of Li Rainbow was somewhat alarmed.
“Yes,” said Fire Cloud immediately. “I naturally don’t dare to lie in front of you. I really didn’t dare to cross him, but he still attacked without any hesitation.”
“Alright, I understand.” Lord of Li Rainbow nodded. “You may leave.”
“Yes.” Fire Cloud didn’t dare say anything else. He knew his hall master’s personality very well.
Black Fiend Hall’s rules didn’t allow Sixth Tribulation Eminences to provoke them. If anyone dared to provoke them, Black Fiend Hall would kill one to warn the rest. These rules were naturally decided by Lord of Li Rainbow, who had been in power for more than 100,000 years.
Given his status, I can let the matter of killing a Fifth Tribulation Eminence in a sneak attack pass. However, Fiend Lord Fire Cloud is a top Sixth Tribulation Eminence of Black Fiend Hall. He deliberately tried to curry favor with Meng Chuan, but Meng Chuan still killed him with a flip of his hand. That’s equivalent to insulting my Black Fiend Hall.
Lord of Li Rainbow’s eyes turned colder.
This isn’t an ordinary provocation; he is going too far! This is equivalent to trampling over Black Fiend Hall and shitting and pissing all over it! He’s only a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence, yet he’s so arrogant?
Lord of Li Rainbow was secretly vexed.
He could tolerate the provocations of Seventh Tribulation Eminences. However, he couldn’t tolerate a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence stepping on his toes. If news of this spread, how would the various factions view Black Fiend Hall?
My studies of the temporal law have also reached a bottleneck. It’s no longer suitable for me to focus on cultivating arduously. Perhaps it’s time to have some action.
Lord of Li Rainbow’s anger surged.
I’ll destroy this Meng Chuan’s Thousand Mountain Star—which he’s guarding—as punishment.
...
“Grandfather, what’s the matter? Why are you in such a hurry to escape?” Meng Yu asked Meng Chuan in an outer realm void.
“The Fifth Tribulation Eminence that I just killed is a member of Black Fiend Hall. Black Fiend Hall is a bunch of lunatics, and they will take revenge for killing their members. When you roam the outer realm in the future, be careful of Black Fiend Hall,” reminded Meng Chuan.
Meng Yu nodded. “I understand. I’ve long heard of Black Fiend Hall’s reputation in the outer realm. Grandfather, will they find you for your actions?”
Meng Chuan comforted him. “Don’t worry; I’m very cautious. We slipped away when I sensed something amiss. The dead Fifth Tribulation Eminence didn’t see me with his own eyes, so Black Fiend Hall doesn’t know who the murderer is.”
Meng Yu understood.
“I’ll be leaving first. I’ll look for you after exchanging for treasures from Eternal Tower,” said Meng Chuan.
“Grandfather, do you know where to find me?” asked Meng Yu.
“Don’t worry. I’ll be able to find you by following the karma.” Meng Chuan then left by tearing through the sky.
Meng Yu stood rooted to the ground. He had a nagging feeling that his grandfather was mysterious in his doings. He spent very little time with him, his grandson.
Perhaps he’s careful because he has a powerful enemy
, thought Meng Yu.
...
Three Bay River System, Thousand Mountain Star.
This was the planet Meng Chuan was presiding over. It was naturally extremely prosperous; it was now one of the top ten bustling planets in Goddess River Zone. Many river system cultivators in the vicinity rushed here to conduct transactions.
Whoosh.
A figure traversed the distant spacetime and arrived outside Thousand Mountain Star.
This figure was dressed in a pale-gold robe. His skin was fair, and he had a handsome appearance. Wherever his gaze landed, the vast spacetime around him was like a box that appeared in his eyes.
Oh? A Seventh Tribulation array formation—which even prevents me from seeing through Thousand Mountain Star—is set up?
Lord of Li Rainbow was somewhat surprised.
The vast spacetime was like a box, and Thousand Mountain Star was a tiny black dot in the box. It was so dark that it was impossible to see through it.
With his realm, only a Seventh Tribulation array formation could stop him from spying on its interior.
Meng Chuan was already a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence, so it was very normal for him to set up a Seventh Tribulation array formation.
“Meng Chuan!” Lord of Li Rainbow spoke calmly. His voice echoed in the vast spacetime around him, echoing throughout Thousand Mountain Star.
“Meng Chuan!” “Meng Chuan!” “Meng Chuan!” “Meng Chuan!” “Meng Chuan!” “Meng Chuan!” ...
All the cultivators on Thousand Mountain Star clearly heard the voice.
“Come out!” “Come out!” “Come out!”
Lord of Li Rainbow’s voice was very calm, without any hint of anger. But when this calm voice sounded in the ears of every cultivator, it was extraordinary.
“Not good. Something big has happened.”
“Thousand Mountain Star is probably in danger.”
Thousand Mountain Star instantly broke into pandemonium. Cultivators were very sharp. Some chose to rush toward the Eternal Tower branch, while others immediately fled outside Thousand Mountain Star. A few cultivators also calmly stayed on Thousand Mountain Star.
In short, the entire Thousand Mountain Star was in chaos.
In the void outside Thousand Mountain Star.
Lord of Li Rainbow stood there calmly. Given his status as Black Fiend Hall’s supreme leader and one of the top existences in the River of Spacetime, he disdained sneak attacks.
He would simply warn Meng Chuan and destroy Thousand Mountain Star in front of him as punishment.
Punishment had to be done publicly! Meng Chuan would have to endure it obediently.
Whoosh.
A figure appeared outside of Thousand Mountain Star and stood outside it, facing Lord of Li Rainbow.
“Black Fiend Hall Master, you were looking for me?” Meng Chuan looked at Lord of Li Rainbow.
Lord of Li Rainbow—who had been as calm as water—couldn’t help but narrow his eyes when he saw the black-robed, white-haired man. He then softly said, “Meng Chuan?”
Meng Chuan nodded. “That’s me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 706 - City Lord Eastcalm and Black Fiend Hall Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 706: City Lord Eastcalm and Black Fiend Hall Master
Meng Chuan observed the handsome man in front of him. He was the most handsome of the current Seventh Tribulation Eminences in existence, and his life aura had a natural charm to it. Anyone who saw him couldn’t help but have a good impression of him.
Having reached the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm, Meng Chuan could even see the tremendous blood-colored sin on his body at a glance, but he was still affected. He instinctively had a good impression of this man.
Even though the blood-colored sin enveloped him, Lord of Li Rainbow seemed to be immaculate amidst his sin.
Why is it so strange? He has clearly committed the most heinous sins in the River of Spacetime, but even I’m affected and have a good impression of him?
Meng Chuan could clearly sense that he had been affected. He became even warier.
As expected of the most terrifying devil that has ruled Black Fiend Hall for over 100,000 years.
Meng Chuan was very surprised to see Black Fiend Hall Master.
However, Lord of Li Rainbow’s emotions were even more complicated. He originally wanted to attack, but all his plans were nullified when he saw that Meng Chuan was an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
“Eastcalm, you were still at the peak of the Sixth Tribulation realm a few years ago. In the blink of an eye, you are already at the Seventh Tribulation realm.” Lord of Li Rainbow didn’t appear flustered at all. The charm in his smile went up a few notches. “As the fourth Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence of this era, you are truly impressive!”
“Did the mighty Black Fiend Hall Master just come here to praise me?” questioned Meng Chuan coldly.
“I have no ill intentions,” said Lord of Li Rainbow with a friendly smile.
“You don’t have any ill intentions?” Meng Chuan looked at him. “Black Fiend Hall Master, you called me out from hundreds of millions of kilometers away just moments ago. Your voice resounded throughout Thousand Mountain Star. All life on Thousand Mountain Star heard your voice, and it instilled panic. Yet, you are now telling me that you don’t have any ill intentions?”
Lord of Li Rainbow shook his head gently. “I won’t lie. I came here on behalf of my Black Fiend Hall’s Fiend Lord Fire Cloud. He didn’t offend you, and he even tried to curry favor with you. Yet, you killed his outer realm true body. Isn’t this an act of bullying against my Black Fiend Hall? Therefore, I came to see who had this audacity.
“This gave me the opportunity to realize that you have already become an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Since it was an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence that took action, killing a Sixth Tribulation Eminence is naturally nothing.”
...
A wrinkled old farmer sat under a fruit tree and chewed on a fruit. He looked toward Thousand Mountain Star and watched Meng Chuan and Black Fiend Hall Master.
To him, among the cultivators he needed to guard against in the entirety of the River of Spacetime, Meng Chuan was qualified to be ranked second. Black Fiend Hall Master had a special status in the old farmer’s heart. Now that the two of them had met, the old farmer naturally watched from afar.
Lord of Li Rainbow is very good at enduring.
The old farmer gnawed on a fruit and smiled.
Back then, he endured all the pressure I exerted on him, and he even apologized to me with gifts.
Black Fiend Hall Master had risen to power early. He had been at the Seventh Tribulation realm for more than 100,000 years, and he had long stood at the top of the River of Spacetime. When he reached the Seventh Tribulation realm, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star and Hall Lord White Avian had yet to be born.
