When Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was at the Sixth Tribulation realm, he was rather talented. He had also received the nurturing of his seniors like Realm Ancestor and Manor Lord Centaurea. He also came across a huge opportunity.
Black Fiend Hall Master treated Seventh Tribulation Eminences at the same level gently and patiently, but he was ruthless towards the weak. Back then, he had sent a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence to plunder Celestial Thearch Myriad Star and snatched a huge opportunity from him.
From then on, the two sides became enemies.
After Celestial Thearch Myriad Star became a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, the relationship between the two parties remained very strained. After Celestial Thearch Myriad Star became a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence, he exerted pressure on Black Fiend Hall Master in every aspect...
Yet, Lord of Li Rainbow didn’t counterattack at all. Logically speaking, as a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, he could hide his true body in his homeworld. His outer realm true body could also hide in Black Fiend Hall’s headquarters. If he was really forced into a corner, so what if he turned hostile? Didn’t Origin Realm Chieftain have White Avian Hall and Six Directions Heaven as enemies? Even so, Lord of Li Rainbow endured it and even came forward to make reparations...
Facing a Seventh Tribulation Eminence who didn’t fight back no matter how much he was bullied and who made reparations, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star stopped after squeezing out most of Lord of Li Rainbow’s wealth.
...
Meng Chuan has reached the Seventh Tribulation realm?
Fiend Eye had been paying close attention to Meng Chuan; he was prepared to form good karma with Meng Chuan at any moment.
Therefore, when he sensed Meng Chuan and Black Fiend Hall Master together, he immediately looked through spacetime and prepared to help. Only then did he discover that Meng Chuan had reached the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm.
In recent years, Meng Chuan has been staying in White Avian Hall and cultivating in the Chaos Turbid River, so I couldn’t even spy on him. Who knew that he would reach the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm already?
Guild Master Fiend Eye was astonished.
The Chaos Turbid River’s environment was so special that he couldn’t spy on it. As for White Avian Hall’s headquarters, he only knew that Meng Chuan was there. Likewise, he couldn’t pry inside.
He hadn’t paid attention for decades, but now that he did, he realized that Meng Chuan had reached the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm.
Tsk, tsk. With Meng Chuan’s personality, he definitely hates Black Fiend Hall. Black Fiend Hall Master will probably suffer this time.
Fiend Eye watched in delight.
Guild Master Fiend Eye was ruthless and fiendish; he only cared about interests, and even his subordinates were afraid of him. The other Seventh Tribulation Eminences were also afraid of him. However, he thought nothing of the countless weak cultivators in the River of Spacetime.
Black Fiend Hall Master was the complete opposite. He had an astonishing affinity with people. His subordinates respected and trusted him. He befriended Seventh Tribulation Eminences and wouldn’t easily make them his enemies. However, he was cruel and heartless towards the weak.
Through Black Fiend Hall, he wantonly slaughtered countless weaklings. The members of Black Fiend Hall had to hand over the benefits at every level, so this resulted in a large number of resources reaching his hands.
Weak cultivators might have very few treasures, but when accumulated across the River of Spacetime, the amount that reached him was astonishing.
...
Black Fiend Hall Master went to Thousand Mountain Star?
White Avian Hall was Meng Chuan’s faction, so Hall Lord Azure Dragon immediately paid attention to this matter.
“Lord of Li Rainbow and City Lord Eastcalm? After Lord of Shadowfiend became a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, he became White Avian Hall’s main combat strength. He naturally paid attention from afar so that he could help one of his own.
An Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence?
Hall Lord Azure Dragon and Lord of Shadowfiend discovered this point. They were both surprised and delighted. They were pleasantly surprised that White Avian Hall’s strength had increased greatly—they now had an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation general.
“Hall Lord, Eastcalm has reached the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm.”
Lord of Shadowfiend immediately sent a voice transmission to Hall Lord White Avian.
“I knew about it long ago. However, Eastcalm hasn’t transcended the tribulation, so I didn’t announce it,”
replied Hall Lord White Avian.
“He hasn’t transcended the tribulation yet?”
Lord of Shadowfiend came to a realization—it was still too early for them to be happy.
“Should we interfere in this matter that involves Lord of Li Rainbow?”
“Eastcalm is capable of dealing with anything. We will interfere when our interference is required,”
said Hall Lord White Avian.
“But with my understanding of Lord of Li Rainbow, he’s highly tolerant! Eastcalm is also an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, so Lord of Li Rainbow will definitely try his best to soothe things over and endure.”
Lord of Shadowfiend smiled as well.
“I’m afraid that Eastcalm will suffer.”
Lord of Li Rainbow was sinister and tolerant. He also controlled Black Fiend Hall—Black Fiend Hall was on the same level as Eternal Tower. Being tolerant didn’t mean that the means available to Lord of Li Rainbow were weak. His means were so ruthless that many Seventh Tribulation Eminences feared him. None of them wanted to fight him.
“It’s not that easy to suffer losses at the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm,”
said Hall Lord White Avian.
“If he really suffers, there’s still us.”
“Okay.”
Lord of Shadowfiend watched from afar as a smile appeared on his face. Since White Avian Hall now had an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, he felt much more relaxed when dealing with Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s threat.
...
He has reached the Seventh Tribulation realm?
Guild Master Darkstar—who had a grudge with Meng Chuan—also paid attention to Black Fiend Hall Master and Meng Chuan’s encounter. He was shocked by what he saw.
He has reached the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm so quickly?
My luck hasn’t been good recently
, thought Guild Master Darkstar.
I have to be careful.
Guild Master Darkstar wasn’t afraid. What could an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence do to him? The only people he was afraid of were the two half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences.
...
In the beginning, only Celestial Thearch Myriad Star, Guild Master Fiend Eye, Hall Master Azure Dragon, Lord of Shadowfiend, Guild Master Darkstar, and a few others paid attention to Meng Chuan’s encounter with Black Fiend Hall Master. But as the explosive news of Meng Chuan reaching the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm spread, more Seventh Tribulation Eminences began to pay close attention.
Even Realm Ancestor learned of the news.
The birth of an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence was shocking. An Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence had a huge impact on the River of Spacetime.
All Seventh Tribulation Eminences are paying attention to us?
Through his Origins domain, Meng Chuan could sense some people distantly spying through spacetime. Meng Chuan couldn’t sense Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star—both had completely grasped time and space. However, the other Seventh Tribulation Eminences’ spying would still leave traces within his Origins domain.
From all over the River of Spacetime, Meng Chuan could sense 35 pairs of prying eyes! Among them were likely Seventh Tribulation Eminences and half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
Lord of Li Rainbow could also sense the prying eyes in the distant spacetime.
“As an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, killing a Sixth Tribulation Eminence from Black Fiend Hall isn’t worth mentioning?” Meng Chuan looked at him. “What if I hadn’t broken through and was still a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence?”
“Life in the River of Spacetime is divided into different levels,” explained Lord of Li Rainbow with a smile. “A Sixth Tribulation Eminence who dares to kill a member of my Black Fiend Hall will naturally have to pay the price. Things are naturally different for a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Fiend Lord Fire Cloud deserved death for offending you.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “I understand. If I were still at the peak of the Sixth Tribulation realm today, I would have to pay a sufficient price.”
Lord of Li Rainbow frowned slightly.
I’m trying to ease the tension, but Meng Chuan is deliberately being provocative.
“Sixth Tribulation Eminences have to pay the price. This is a rule,” said Lord of Li Rainbow with a frown.
“As an Essence Soul avatar, I won’t feel the pinch even if it’s destroyed. It’s not much of a price.” Meng Chuan looked at Lord of Li Rainbow. “So what price did you want me to pay, considering how you, Black Fiend Hall Master, came here with great fanfare?”
“There’s no need to elaborate on what wasn’t done, right?” Lord of Li Rainbow smiled slightly. His smile could charm one’s willpower. If one didn’t have any enmity with him, their relationship with him would usually ease.
“Of course, it needs to be elaborated on.” Meng Chuan stared at him. “You came here with great fanfare to provoke me. You wanted to punish me and make me pay the price. Now that you realize I’m strong, you want to pretend that nothing happened? How can there be such a good deal?”
Lord of Li Rainbow looked at Meng Chuan, and his expression sank. “Meng Chuan, I’ve already given you face.”
“Face? You are Black Fiend Hall’s leader, a great devil with the greatest sins in the River of Spacetime. You want to talk about face with me?” said Meng Chuan. “A devil like you has never had any face in my books.”
Lord of Li Rainbow’s expression was extremely grim.
He could tolerate it, but only the two half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences could make him tolerate such a snub.
Furthermore, Lord of Li Rainbow hadn’t forgotten the humiliation Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had exacted on him back then. He had been aggrieved for too long. He didn’t want to tolerate it any longer after he grasped the spacetime law of the past, present, and future and reached the final bottleneck. He felt that some stimulation would give him a greater chance of breaking through the bottleneck and grasping the temporal law.
When that happened, he would be a new half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence in the entire River of Spacetime!
“You are provoking me.” Lord of Li Rainbow looked at Meng Chuan. “I advise you to get a hold of yourself. You are only a newly-advanced Seventh Tribulation Eminence.”
“You finally can’t tolerate it?” Meng Chuan scoffed. “Then, try my means as a new Seventh Tribulation Eminence.”
With that said, Meng Chuan extended his hand. A dark, huge palm appeared and struck Lord of Li Rainbow.
When Lord of Li Rainbow saw this, a bloody glow flashed in his eyes. He showed his killing intent for the first time. “It looks like I’ve been keeping a low profile for too long.”

chapters.title: Chapter 707 - A Short Fight
chapters.content:
Chapter 707: A Short Fight
“You are only a newly-advanced Seventh Tribulation Eminence.” Lord of Li Rainbow coldly stared at the distant Meng Chuan. He couldn’t be bothered to look at the huge palm that was attacking him.
With Lord of Li Rainbow in the middle, two huge illusory millstones—one black and one white—appeared in this spacetime. The black-and-white millstones slowly spun in opposite directions. The moment the two huge millstones appeared, they crushed the dark palm that Meng Chuan had produced. Furthermore, they attempted to crush Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar.
Meng Chuan looked at Lord of Li Rainbow and cast an Essence Soul mystic technique.
Buzz—
A huge pair of dark eyes appeared in Lord of Li Rainbow’s mind. This pair of dark eyes were like bottomless abysses that dragged at his consciousness.
Lord of Li Rainbow had to divert nearly half of his attention to resist.
How can the Pupil of Darkness be so powerful?
Lord of Li Rainbow was somewhat shocked.
Lord of Li Rainbow—who had cultivated for a long time—naturally placed great importance on his willpower cultivation. He could walk 46,000 kilometers on Fiend Mountain—this was considered a very high standard among Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminences! For example, Guild Master Fiend Eye and the others were still walking the path of Fiend Mountain... They had yet to reach the peak.
After reaching 46,000 kilometers, his willpower was extremely strong. Furthermore, he had a Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s body to block any attack. Logically speaking, an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s Essence Soul mystic technique should be like a breeze to him. However, Meng Chuan’s mystic technique required him to divert nearly half of his attention. This made his heart tighten.
He didn’t know that Meng Chuan’s willpower had also transformed after he created his Essence Soul formulation. After comprehending a few of the 3,000 illusory arrays, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World structure became even more exquisite; it had also elevated his willpower.
Although he hadn’t continued treading the path of Fiend Mountain, he had clearly improved significantly.
His Essence Soul mystic technique is second only to Realm Ancestor’s. It’s on par with the one from Origin Realm.
Lord of Li Rainbow came to a conclusion as the huge black-and-white millstones crushed the spacetime.
Whoosh!
The Pupil of Darkness failed to sink Lord of Li Rainbow’s consciousness into oblivion. However, a vast array formation soon enveloped the vast spacetime.
192 Dark Chaos Holes slowly moved, and these Chaos Holes condensed their powers into one. As soon as they descended, Lord of Li Rainbow felt his body sink. If he had just reached the Seventh Tribulation realm, he would probably only have 20 to 30 percent of his strength left.
His Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array has reached such a high realm?
Lord of Li Rainbow frowned slightly, somewhat shocked by Meng Chuan’s strength.
He naturally knew about the Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array. Logically speaking, it was already very impressive for a newly-advanced Seventh Tribulation Eminence to condense 100 Chaos Holes. However, the number of Dark Chaos Holes Meng Chuan cast was somewhat astonishing.
Little did he know that Meng Chuan had studied the manual of 3,000 illusory arrays over the years and had already cracked 136 of them. Meng Chuan’s understanding of array formations had reached an astonishing level. He had grasped the Chaos Hole law, so he had a high understanding of the Heaven Splitting law—which was completely different from the Chaos Hole law. This—combined with his gains from cracking the 3,000 illusory arrays—allowed him to cultivate the Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array to such a level.
Boom!
The black-and-white millstones crushed the void as the Myriad Tribulation Chaos Hole Array resisted with all its might.
Meng Chuan looked up at the huge millstones.
What a powerful domain-type move. If my array formation hadn’t improved by leaps and bounds, I’m afraid it would’ve been crushed.
Lord of Li Rainbow was different from the Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature, Bark.
Bark’s strikes were thanks to its talent.
On the other hand, Lord of Li Rainbow had an extremely profound understanding of time and space. After fusing them with his Origins law, his domain became terrifyingly powerful. Meng Chuan’s Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array was at a disadvantage, but he could still withstand it without collapsing.
I originally wanted to crush him with my domain, but it looks like I’ll have to engage in close combat
, Lord of Li Rainbow thought to himself.
As a Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence, he was always strongest at close combat.
Annihilate.
Lord of Li Rainbow pointed his fair finger at Meng Chuan.
Whoosh.
Spacetime warped as the distance between them rapidly decreased! Furthermore, the flow of time changed.
Meng Chuan could clearly see the finger in front of him, but he didn’t have time to dodge.
It’s too fast.
A finger tapped Meng Chuan’s glabella.
Whoosh!
The moment before Lord of Li Rainbow tapped Meng Chuan, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar dissipated like a bubble.
At the same time, five Essence Soul avatars appeared in the vast surrounding area. The Essence Soul avatar in Thousand Mountain Star had clearly split into five new Essence Soul avatars immediately.
Thousand Mountain Star was a cave abode in the outer realm’s void. As a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, Men gChuan had long bought a fixed Eighth Tribulation-level array formation through Eternal Tower. A fixed array formation was worth less than an Eighth Tribulation array formation that he could carry with him.
Fixed array formations required time to set up and couldn’t be moved, but they were typically stronger because they could be made more complicated during the setup process.
Perhaps only the two half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences had a chance of breaking into a Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s cave abode.
As a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence, Palace Lady Blood Phoenix had set up 13 Eighth Tribulation-level array formations in her outer realm lair. Even a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence couldn’t crack them.
Meng Chuan wasn’t that strong, but his Thousand Mountain Star could withstand any Eminence below the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm.
“Splitting your Essence Soul avatars? Then, I’ll seal this spacetime so that you won’t be able to get reinforcements,” said Lord of Li Rainbow coldly. At the same time, a massive illusory array formation appeared, isolating the surrounding spacetime from the outside world for five billion kilometers.
Thousand Mountain Star was also within the five-billion-kilometer range.
Oh? I can’t see anything.
Black Fiend Hall Master has sealed that area of spacetime.
Black Fiend Hall Master is getting impatient.
Seventh Tribulation Eminences and half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences discovered that it was difficult for them to pry any further with their secret treasures.
In terms of attainments in spacetime, Black Fiend Hall Master was only one step away from reaching the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm. With the Eighth Tribulation array formation sealing off that area spacetime, it was indeed difficult to pry into it.
I can’t see it.
Fiend Eye frowned slightly.
If Lord of Li Rainbow is bent on sealing off spacetime, I won’t be able to crack it either.
In this era, only Celestial Thearch Myriad Star and Hall Lord White Avian could crack it.
Interesting.
Hall Lord White Avian watched leisurely.
Lord of Li Rainbow has endured in silence for so many years. It’s rare for him to reveal his strength, but he encountered a tough opponent.
The old farmer—who had eaten a fruit—casually threw away the fruit core.
Lord of Li Rainbow is much stronger than he was back then. He should be one step away from breaking through with the temporal law. However, this step is also the most difficult one. He probably doesn’t have any hope of doing so in this lifetime.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had seen Lord of Li Rainbow’s future. He had seen many futures, but none of them had Lord of Li Rainbow reaching the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm. Celestial Thearch Myriad Star also knew that the future had yet to happen and that all variables existed.
However, he didn’t see the future of Lord of Li Rainbow reaching the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm. This meant that Lord of Li Rainbow’s chances of breaking through were extremely low. After all, he hadn’t broken through after cultivating for more than 100,000 years. If he wanted to break through before his death? It was obvious that the probability was very low.
However, he’s quite strong in close combat. With the augmentation of spacetime, Meng Chuan can only suffer a beating.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star watched.
Meng Chuan won’t be able to hit him even if he tries.
Oh?
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star suddenly watched in shock.
This Meng Chuan only used a simple killer move last time. Now, he has fused the killer move with the Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array? His attainments in array formations are really high.
...
Spacetime within five billion kilometers of Thousand Mountain Star had been sealed. The Seventh Tribulation Eminences and half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences couldn’t see anything, and this only served to make them more curious.
However, the seal only lasted for about 30 seconds.
Boom!
An extremely terrifying and violent force erupted, completely tearing apart the seal. It caused spacetime within a five-billion-kilometer radius to be completely pulverized. Only Thousand Mountain Star—protected by the array formation—remained intact.
Even spacetime within five billion kilometers was reduced to leptons! Lord of Li Rainbow naturally couldn’t dodge.
Humph.
Blood-colored cracks appeared on Lord of Li Rainbow’s fair skin. His face was filled with cracks, making him look like a cracked porcelain doll—he looked ferocious and ugly. The blood-colored cracks quickly healed and vanished.
In just an instant, Lord of Li Rainbow returned to his handsome appearance.
“I’ve really underestimated you.” Lord of Li Rainbow glanced at Meng Chuan before disappearing with a step. He had already traversed spacetime and returned to the distant Black Fiend Hall headquarters.
Two of Meng Chuan’s Essence Souls stood there as the other three dissipated.
At that moment, Meng Chuan’s expression was solemn.
The difference is indeed huge. Apart from the last move, none of my other moves could touch him.
Meng Chuan also became aware of his flaws.

chapters.title: Chapter 708 - Choosing the Wrong Opponent
chapters.content:
Chapter 708: Choosing the Wrong Opponent
One of them was a new Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence in the River of Spacetime, while the other was Black Fiend Hall’s leader—who had been at the Seventh Tribulation realm for over 100,000 years. The other Seventh Tribulation Eminences and half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime naturally paid close attention to their battle.
However, this battle was too short!
Furthermore, other than the beginning of the battle, the most critical exchange lasted for about 30 seconds! Due to the spatial seal, these Seventh Tribulation Eminences and half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences couldn’t see anything at all. They only saw the spatial seal finally shatter. Lord of Li Rainbow’s body was covered in cracks before he tore through the void without any hesitation and returned to Black Fiend Hall.
“From the looks of it, Black Fiend Hall Master suffered.”
“That spacetime was sealed before it was forcefully blasted apart? Although I didn’t see City Lord Eastcalm’s moves clearly, they were very powerful.”
“In this battle, City Lord Eastcalm only sent a few Essence Soul avatars. In the end, he had the upper hand, and Lord of Li Rainbow suffered losses?”
Although the top factions didn’t see it clearly, they had some judgment.
...
Black Fiend Hall headquarters.
Whoosh.
Lord of Li Rainbow returned to his throne and sat down alone with a sullen expression. After all, he had reached the Seventh Tribulation realm before Guild Master Fiend Eye. As a member of the older generation, he placed great importance on his reputation.
Considering that he had reached the final bottleneck in the laws of space and time and that he only had tens of thousands of years left to live, he wanted to show his prowess in his remaining years. He wanted to stir up waves in the River of Spacetime and obtain a chance to break through in battle.
To his surprise, he suffered greatly when facing a newly-advanced Seventh Tribulation Eminence!
Have I really grown old?
Lord of Li Rainbow even began to doubt himself.
His body nearly collapsed from the attack when facing a junior, who had only cultivated for 7,000 years. Not to mention that it was his outer realm true body! This body carried an Eighth Tribulation treasure.
As for Meng Chuan, he only had Essence Soul avatars and didn’t carry any treasures. Even so, the attack had severely injured Lord of Li Rainbow’s body.
“Hall Master.” A voice sounded, and an illusory fog appeared in the hall. The fog condensed and vaguely formed a human figure.
This figure’s Essence Soul avatar typically looked like an illusory fog; it was a characteristic of his Essence Soul formulation.
“Nightmare.” Lord of Li Rainbow looked at his companion.
The person was another leader of Black Fiend Hall—Deputy Hall Master Nightmare.
Hall Master Nightmare was an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence. The fame of Black Fiend Hall was mostly thanks to him. He was also very loyal to Black Fiend Hall. This was because Black Fiend Hall was the same as Eternal Tower... They were ancient factions that had a long history. They were established by Eighth Tribulation Eminences and had a rich heritage.
The reason why Hall Master Nightmare could reach the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm was related to a special heritage treasure of Black Fiend Hall. He had inherited that treasure, so he naturally didn’t dare to betray Black Fiend Hall.
The karma from betraying Black Fiend Hall was too great; it might even cause the Eighth Tribulation Eminence who founded Black Fiend Hall to descend upon this time node to eliminate the traitor.
Lord of Li Rainbow glanced at his companion and asked, “Nightmare, did I look to be in a sorry state?”
The two of them were infamous. After all, they were the leaders of Black Fiend Hall, which had plundered the weak in the River of Spacetime.
“A little.” Nightmare’s misty face twisted slightly as though he was smiling.
“I chose the wrong opponent,” Lord of Li Rainbow said softly. “This City Lord Eastcalm is really terrifying. Unfortunately, I haven’t seen his future... Now that he has reached the Seventh Tribulation realm, I can no longer see his future.”
Lord of Li Rainbow ultimately hadn’t grasped the complete temporal law. He could pry into a Sixth Tribulation Eminence’s future, but he couldn’t pry into the future of a Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
“Very terrifying?” Nightmare asked, “What happened after you set up the spacetime seal during your fight with City Lord Eastcalm? With your strength, how could you be forced to such a state by a newly-advanced Seventh Tribulation Eminence?”
“What happened?” Lord of Li Rainbow recalled the battle and said softly, “After I set up the spacetime seal, I could attack at will given my attainments in spacetime, but he couldn’t touch me. Therefore... I tried to attack Thousand Mountain Star first. Thousand Mountain Star had a fixed Eighth Tribulation-level array formation set up. With his Essence Soul avatar presiding over it, I couldn’t blast it open. Therefore, I also attacked and split space.
“Thousand Mountain Star was separated from the spacetime around it. It prevented more Essence Soul avatars from being sent from Thousand Mountain Star as reinforcements,” said Lord of Li Rainbow indifferently. “I planned on casually destroying a few of his Essence Soul avatars before sealing and trapping Thousand Mountain Star to serve as a lesson for him.”
“To my surprise, just as I split spacetime and attacked to destroy his Essence Soul avatars... He unleashed his full strength. His previous moves couldn’t even touch me, but he used a terrifying move at that moment. Ten Chaos Holes in his Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array produced a Heaven Splitting Blade.
“With the combination of the array formation, the ten Heaven Splitting Blades’ might gathered and erupted. Their might was unimaginable. Five billion kilometers of spacetime was reduced to leptons. Even with the Eighth Tribulation treasure protecting me, I was still sliced through. Although I could still fight, I would only be embarrassed if I continued fighting in such a pathetic manner.”
“Ten Heaven Splitting Blades completely blasted through five billion kilometers of spacetime?” Hall Master Nightmare was alarmed when he heard that. “To severely injure you, this move must have the might of a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Did he really not bring a treasure with him?”
“His Essence Soul avatars could gather and disperse as he pleased. He wasn’t carrying any treasures,” said Lord of Li Rainbow. “He relied on his own capabilities to unleash the might of a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence.”
“He’s this strong without relying on external objects?” Nightmare’s misty body trembled.
“He became an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence after cultivating for only 7,000 years. He’s already so powerful after breaking through, and that’s why I said that I chose the wrong opponent.” Lord of Li Rainbow shook his head slightly, feeling regret.
He originally believed that bullying a newly-advanced Seventh Tribulation Eminence was easy, but the difference was huge.
“From now on, City Lord Eastcalm will definitely be an influential figure in this River of Spacetime,” said Lord of Li Rainbow.
“What do we do next?” Nightmare asked. “It looks like he has great enmity toward our Black Fiend Hall.”
“Let’s wait and see. Let’s see what he does.” Lord of Li Rainbow said indifferently, “At most, he will kill some Fifth and Sixth Tribulation Eminences’ outer realm true bodies. He won’t be able to shake our Black Fiend Hall’s foundation.”
Nightmare nodded.
Black Fiend Hall was established by an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. This was their greatest source of confidence. In addition, countless cultivators liked plundering in the River of Spacetime. This was because plundering was the fastest way to earn treasures. Based on these two points, Black Fiend Hall was filled with endless vitality, which allowed it to last until now.
...
Archean Eon Realm.
In a study in Jiang State Capital’s Meng Manor, a white-robed Meng Chuan was reading the book containing the 3,000 illusory arrays.
The previous battle had alarmed many top factions in the River of Spacetime. After all, it was a clash between two Seventh Tribulation Eminences. In this short battle, Meng Chuan seemed to have the upper hand, but he could sense the disparity in strength.
I’m still too weak when it comes to attainments in spacetime. I couldn’t even touch him with normal attacks; he could do anything to me as he pleased.
Meng Chuan understood this. Even if he had used Heaven Splitting Chaos Hole alone, Lord of Li Rainbow could easily dodge it.
Furthermore, it was an ultimate move unleashed by the Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array. It completely obliterated spacetime up to five billion kilometers. This was a large-scale attack that enveloped Lord of Li Rainbow, preventing him from having anywhere to hide.
The law of time is split into the past, present, and future. I haven’t grasped any of these three aspects.
Meng Chuan understood the weakness of his accumulated insights.
I’m very close to transcending the tribulation. At this moment, I should focus on studying array formations. If my attainments in array formations are high enough, my strength will also increase.
Meng Chuan read the book.
He could now simultaneously condense 192 Chaos Holes with the Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array. He had once wondered if he could make every Chaos Hole produce a Heaven Splitting Blade to produce Heaven Splitting Chaos Holes. If he succeeded, the might of this move would be terrifying.
In reality, there were many problems.
Firstly, the balance of many Chaos Holes placed a huge burden on the array formation. If too many Heaven Splitting Blades were produced, it would easily cause the array formation to collapse, preventing the Chaos Holes from coexisting. With his current attainments in array formations, Meng Chuan could only produce Heaven Splitting Chaos Holes at ten array formation nodes.
Secondly, every move—Heaven Splitting Chaos Hole—placed a huge burden on his mental strength. With Meng Chuan’s current mental strength, more than half of his mental strength was expended after producing ten Heaven Splitting Chaos Holes.
With higher attainments in array formations and higher willpower, I have a chance of making this move stronger.
Meng Chuan carefully studied the array formations in the book.
...
In the blink of an eye, 11 years had passed since the battle between Meng Chuan and Lord of Li Rainbow. Meng Chuan had grasped the Chaos Hole law for 90 years.
I’m getting closer and closer to my tribulation.
On a snowy day in his study, Meng Chuan put down the black book.
It’s time to make another trip to Fiend Mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 709 - Returning to the Fiend Mountain Path
chapters.content:
Chapter 709: Returning to the Fiend Mountain Path
Meng Chuan appeared out of thin air in the ancient Fiend Mountain world. He looked up at the towering mountain as three paths extended toward the mountaintop.
The more I cultivate, the more I find an Eighth Tribulation Eminence unfathomable.
Meng Chuan sighed inwardly.
The difference between a Seventh Tribulation Eminence and an Eighth Tribulation Eminence is clearly only one tribulation... However, one’s order in life and strength are intrinsically transformed in this one tribulation. It’s extremely difficult for Seventh Tribulation Eminences like us to reach the peak of Fiend Mountain, which was left behind by its owner.
The factions created by Eighth Tribulation Eminences—such as Eternal Tower, Nebula Palace, Black Fiend Hall, and so on—could last for endless years. Eternal Tower’s Eye of Eternity could maintain the strength of a Seventh Tribulation Eminence and live for billions of years. The Eye of Eternity... was only left behind by the owner of Eternal Tower.
Dragon Ancestor and Phoenix Ancestor had transformed their bloodlines, allowing generations of pure-blooded dragons and pure-blooded phoenixes to have the strength to match a Fifth Tribulation Eminence at adulthood.
Meng Chuan had even ‘seen’ the scene of Dragon Ancestor opening up a universe. There was also the well-known Transcendence of Samsara, which allowed them to jump out of the timeline and head to other universes and high-level worlds... All sorts of means were unimaginable to Seventh Tribulation Eminences like Meng Chuan and company.
When I was weak, I knew that a Fifth Tribulation Eminence could be said to have an undying body in their homeworlds. As long as an Eighth Tribulation Eminence doesn’t appear, no Eminence in this era can kill a Fifth Tribulation Eminence across worlds. But after becoming a Seventh Tribulation Eminence and learning a lot of information, I realized that an Eighth Tribulation Eminence could kill a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, even if they hide in their homeworld.
This is because a homeworld’s protection stems from the laws of space and time.
As for Eighth Tribulation Eminences, they have transcended the River of Spacetime. They fully understand the laws of spacetime’s restrictions.
After Meng Chuan broke through, Hall Lord White Avian gave him more detailed information. Only then did he learn about this. The information mostly involved Eighth Tribulation Eminences.
This was because the ones they revered the most at their level were Eighth Tribulation Eminences.
The operation involving the laws of spacetime seemed supreme. However, in the eyes of Eighth Tribulation Eminences, it was also a sieve. For example, the universe was originally meant to stop all Chaos creatures, but the owner of Fiend Mountain had opened up the Chaos Turbid River. It connected the universe to the outside, permanently guiding Chaos creatures (forbidden creatures) along the Chaos Turbid River to the universe.
For example, the strongest Eighth Tribulation Eminence, Dragon Ancestor, had opened up a universe. His understanding of the laws of spacetime operations would only be more ludicrous.
The path of cultivation is long. I need to be patient and resolute.
From this point, Meng Chuan felt that Lord of Li Rainbow was worthy of admiration. To be able to cultivate the temporal law to such a profound level without being distracted by comprehending a second Origins law... He would’ve long reached the top of the Seventh Tribulation realm.
Although he felt that Lord of Li Rainbow was worthy of admiration for giving up on improving his strength and focusing on the laws of time, Meng Chuan clearly wouldn’t learn from him.
He had mastered the talent move, Heaven Splitting Blade. After transcending the tribulation, mastering the Heaven Splitting law naturally took top priority.
When he combined the Chaos Hole law and the Heaven Splitting law, his various means would truly become diverse. Only then would he be a true top-notch Seventh Tribulation Eminence. With the two opposing Origins laws as his foundation, he could then study time... This was the path Meng Chuan had set his mind on.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan stepped onto the path of the mind and flew along it. He soon arrived at the spot where he had previously stopped—36,500 kilometers.
The altitude of 36,500 kilometers is now much easier for me.
Meng Chuan listened to the mountaintop’s voice without feeling any pressure.
After mastering an Origins law and creating the Painting World formulation to condense a painting Essence Soul, his mind and will had clearly improved greatly. However, the mountaintop’s voice no longer had a tempering effect on his Essence Soul.
Meng Chuan walked step by step, covering a distance of about one kilometer with each step. He soon arrived at a distance of 40,000 kilometers.
Forty thousand kilometers; here, the three paths combine?
Meng Chuan saw that the path he took and the path of possession had ultimately combined into one. The three paths of Fiend Mountain completely merged into one at a distance of 40,000 kilometers.
After reaching 40,000 kilometers, Meng Chuan pondered for a moment before taking a step and walking into the combined path.
Boom!
Meng Chuan sensed a Sixth Tribulation creature. It was an alien creature bathed in flames. The alien creature was using flames to refine a black sledgehammer; Meng Chuan felt as though he had become this alien creature.
On the path of possession, the Sixth Tribulation Eminences that people possess have all broken through via the path of epiphany.
Meng Chuan knew this.
In history, none of those who reached the Sixth Tribulation realm through the path of epiphany ended up well. Their paths were flawed, and this alien lifeform also had flaws in his cultivation. His Dao of Fire was too ferocious; it is fine if he used it for combat, but if he used it to cultivate his body, it would only make him even more ferocious and crazy. He would slowly succumb to madness.
After reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm, Meng Chuan understood why Fiend Mountain’s path of epiphany was so flawed.
Everything happened too easily and quickly! In an epiphany, a large number of insights constantly gathered and rapidly accumulated to form a Sixth Tribulation law. Without experiencing the elements or experiencing a large number of setbacks, one didn’t even have the time to verify their newfound insights repeatedly.
Yet, they figured something out? If that was the case, it would be a miracle if they could comprehend a flawless Sixth Tribulation law. And reality proved this point—all the Sixth Tribulation Eminences that had walked the path of epiphany in history had flaws.
Meng Chuan shook his head slightly and continued taking a step forward to possess another Sixth Tribulation Eminence.
Meng Chuan walked very slowly as he carefully experienced the Sixth Tribulation Eminences’ paths.
Although all these paths were flawed, they were all Sixth Tribulation laws. They were part of the circulation of time and space, other than not matching cultivation fundamentals. With Meng Chuan’s realm, he could still gain something by analyzing them from a higher vantage point.
Three years later.
When Meng Chuan reached 45,000 kilometers, the possession ended. Meng Chuan felt that he had gained something and broadened his horizons.
I had the slight effect of being tempered.
Meng Chuan continued walking. The sound coming from the mountaintop became louder. He could hear a complete sentence, but he couldn’t understand the meaning.
The complete sentence dealt an even greater blow to his Essence Soul.
Most Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminences found it difficult to reach 45,000 kilometers. As an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, Meng Chuan also felt the impact despite having created an Essence Soul formulation for himself.
Boom!
The painting Essence Soul felt the sound strike again and again, but the painting Essence Soul was accommodative. No matter how strong the impacts were, it still accommodated them.
46,000 kilometers, 46,500 kilometers, 47,000 kilometers, 47,500 kilometers... Meng Chuan walked slower and slower. As more and more complete sentences sounded, the impact became more terrifying. Each sentence constantly reverberated in Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul.
At 45,000 kilometers, I still found it relatively easy. But the closer I get to the mountaintop, the stronger the impact.
At that moment, Meng Chuan could vaguely see the mountaintop.
Amidst the fog, the mountaintop was vaguely visible. However, the sound on the mountaintop was already as loud as rumbling thunder. It resounded in his Essence Soul, causing it to rumble. Meng Chuan felt his Essence Soul blur from the impact.
This is the limit of my lucidity.
Meng Chuan stopped.
49,500 kilometers.
Although he could vaguely see the mountaintop, he was clearly still lacking by that tiny bit.
Reaching the peak meant that his willpower had reached the threshold of the Physical Body Eighth Tribulation realm.
As for the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm, the willpower and mind requirement was much higher!
The main part of walking Fiend Mountain’s path this time was about possessing more than 10,000 Sixth Tribulation Eminences. My understanding of all things in space and time has been enriched. It’s helpful for my study of the 3,000 illusory arrays. My willpower hasn’t improved at all.
Meng Chuan was already prepared.
At his level of mind and willpower, improving his willpower mainly depended on him perfecting his Essence Soul formulation.
...
After leaving Fiend Mountain, Meng Chuan continued to focus on studying the 3,000 illusory arrays. Every improvement in his array formation attainments was reflected in the structure of his Essence Soul world.
Finally, 103 years after mastering the Chaos Hole law, the Heavenly Tribulation descended again—just as Meng Chuan had expected.

chapters.title: Chapter 710 - Tribulation Transcendence (Final Chapter of Volume)
chapters.content:
Chapter 710: Tribulation Transcendence (Final Chapter of Volume)
Archean Eon Realm, in a chamber inside of Heaven and Earth Great Hall.
Sensing that the Heavenly Tribulation was about to arrive, Meng Chuan informed his wife before coming here. At that moment, he took the initiative to dissipate many Essence Soul avatars, leaving only his homeworld true body and outer realm true body to transcend the tribulation.
The seventh Essence Soul Heavenly Tribulation.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in the chamber and patiently waited for the Heavenly Tribulation to descend.
Many seniors have successfully transcended the seventh Essence Soul Heavenly Tribulation. After all, there are several in every generation. Thus, the information regarding the Heavenly Tribulation is very detailed. The seventh Heavenly Tribulation targets the Essence Soul and willpower. I’m still very confident of succeeding.
Instead, there aren’t any intelligence records regarding the eighth Essence Soul Heavenly Tribulation.
As Meng Chuan silently waited for the Heavenly Tribulation to arrive, he thought of many things. There were only a handful of Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminences in history.
Even Celestial Thearch Myriad Star and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star found it difficult to meet an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence. Therefore, it was naturally difficult to gather information on the eighth Essence Soul Tribulation.
Meng Chuan didn’t find any information regarding the eighth Essence Soul Tribulation in White Avian Hall and Eternal Tower.
I’ll advance to the Seventh Tribulation realm first. I’ll then try my best to grasp the laws of time and space after that. I’m still very far from the eighth Heavenly Tribulation.
Meng Chuan knew very well that his willpower was far from being able to withstand the spacetime law’s evolution since he hadn’t even reached Fiend Mountain’s summit.
Here it comes.
Meng Chuan calmed his mind and stopped thinking about unnecessary things. This was because a mysterious force had descended.
Whoosh.
An unprecedented cold fog descended upon Meng Chuan’s sea of consciousness. In an instant, it froze his Essence Soul.
This is?
Meng Chuan looked around; he was in a world blanketed by ice and snow.
An illusion?
My Essence Soul has been frozen, and my consciousness has been dragged into an illusion?
Meng Chuan had gathered a large amount of information regarding the tribulation. He also understood the situation he was in.
If my willpower also ends up frozen, that will translate into me failing the tribulation and dying. I have to last long enough.
I have to last until the tribulation ends. However, this illusion is really cold.
Meng Chuan couldn’t help but tremble before walking forward.
In the illusion, he was like a mortal without any divine powers.
Meng Chuan knew very well that this was a battle between his willpower and the Heavenly Tribulation. The weaker his willpower was, the colder he felt, making it easier for him to freeze to death.
Meng Chuan’s willpower was considered strong, so all he did was tremble.
...
Meng Chuan was the only one walking slowly in the snow-covered land. His eyebrows and face were covered in snow. He looked into the distance and saw a snowstorm sweeping over.
Another blizzard
, Meng Chuan muttered to himself. The wind howled as it swept up countless snowflakes and struck his body.
Meng Chuan lowered his head and endured the pain. The snowstorm grew stronger and stronger, and he was drowned by more and more snowflakes.
After a long time, the snowstorm stopped.
Amidst the thick snow, a hand stretched out. Meng Chuan crawled out from below and shook the snow away.
Snowstorms, avalanches, ice lakes... I welcome any further danger since I have a body of willpower. If my willpower can withstand it, I won’t die and will be indestructible.
Meng Chuan’s expression didn’t change.
If his willpower had only allowed him to reach an altitude of 25,000 kilometers at Fiend Mountain, the snowstorm would’ve been much more violent. He would also feel much colder. The difficulty of transcending the tribulation would increase rapidly, but he was someone who could reach a height of 49,000 kilometers.
...
The illusory realm was filled with trials and tribulations. Meng Chuan calmly dealt with them without a stir. What truly gave Meng Chuan a headache was time.
In the illusory world, one would never reach the end. It was unknown how much time had passed. Time in the illusory world was meaningless. A million years might pass in the illusory world, only to be an instant in the outside world.
Here, Meng Chuan’s consciousness and thoughts were as slow as a mortal’s. Under the freezing cold, his thoughts became slower and slower, but he couldn’t sense any laws.
How long have I been walking? 30,000 years, or 300,000 years?
Meng Chuan didn’t know either. His extremely slow mind prevented him from determining the flow of time.
Meng Chuan had experienced the torment of time during his fifth Essence Soul Tribulation. That time, he didn’t freeze or suffer repeated torment. He only spent an unknown amount of time in the void.
This time, things were even more ruthless.
Not only did it seem perpetual with no end in sight, but there was also endless torment and torture. If an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence was mentally exhausted because of the long period of time or was unable to withstand the torment, ultimately freezing... they would die.
Come on. No matter how many calamities there are and no matter how long it takes, it will eventually end. When that happens, I will succeed.
Meng Chuan firmly believed that he could succeed. His hope of transcending the tribulation was like a lamp, illuminating him as he walked through the illusions.
Time passed.
Three million years? Thirty million years?
Meng Chuan didn’t know how much time had passed. Even when he felt like it was almost time for the tribulation to end, not even a tenth of the time had passed. In fact, the illusion’s duration left Meng Chuan alarmed. He began to feel exhausted.
The illusion’s long duration made Meng Chuan—an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence—become accustomed to the illusion. He even felt that the illusion would last longer.
Whoosh.
The illusion silently collapsed.
The power that froze Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul silently vanished.
I succeeded?
Meng Chuan was momentarily dazed.
After a long period of perseverance, he finally succeeded.
Long was easy to describe, but in fact, no matter how powerful an expert was, they would become more exhausted and collapse in the face of long periods of time.
Thankfully, I created an Essence Soul formulation before I transcended the tribulation.
Meng Chuan recalled the tribulation and felt somewhat lucky.
Otherwise, if I were to transcend the tribulation when only able to traverse 30,000 to 35,000 kilometers on Fiend Mountain, I would really be walking on the tightrope of death.
Although Meng Chuan had reached the willpower threshold of the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm, that was only the minimum requirement. It only meant that his Essence Soul World could withstand the Origins law’s evolution. One’s chances of transcending the tribulation would also be very low. The higher one’s willpower was, the greater their chances of transcending the tribulation.
...
Archean Eon Realm, Jiang State Capital, Meng Manor.
Liu Qiyue sat in front of her desk and blankly stared at the half-finished painting in front of her.
Previously, Meng Chuan had worked on this piece with her. Meng Chuan painted while she wrote the captions. But halfway through, Meng Chuan said, “The Heavenly Tribulation is here. Qiyue, I’m going into seclusion.” After that, he left.
Liu Qiyue long knew that her husband was about to face his seventh Heavenly Tribulation, but she was still extremely worried when the moment arrived.
Tribulation realm. Every step forward is a tribulation. Only by transcending the tribulation can one become stronger.
Liu Qiyue was worried about her husband. She sat there in a daze as countless thoughts churned in her mind.
Two days, three days...
The more time passed, the more worried she became. She had no choice but to sit there alone and wait for her husband to return.
Seven months later, a white-robed, white-haired figure appeared outside the study. He smiled at her through the study window. Only then did Liu Qiyue smile.
Her eyes lit up as she immediately stood up and walked out. “Ah Chuan, did you succeed?” Liu Qiyue looked at Meng Chuan. She was worried that her husband had failed his tribulation transcendence and was only here to bid her farewell.
“I succeeded,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
On this day, Archean Eon Realm produced the second Seventh Tribulation Eminence in its history.
Final Chapter of Volume—Seventh Tribulation Realm

chapters.title: Chapter 711 - Dispute
chapters.content:
Chapter 711: Dispute
In a hall in Nebula Palace, White Avian Hall’s territory.
“Eastcalm, take a seat.” The gray-robed, skinny Hall Lord White Avian sat in the main seat of honor.
Meng Chuan sat down as well.
There were a total of five Eminences in the hall. Apart from Meng Chuan, there were Hall Lord White Avian, Lord of Shadowfiend, Deputy Hall Lord Blazing Sun, and Deputy Hall Lord Azure Dragon. Although White Avian Hall still had other Seventh Tribulation Eminences and half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences, these four formed White Avian Hall’s core.
They were planning to include Meng Chuan. This was because Meng Chuan hadn’t established any factions. He was also an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, so he could be of great use.
Lord of the East Abyss, Palace Lord Food God, Lord of Shadows, Sect Master Mental Demon, and Mountain Lord Moxie each had their own factions! Their relationship with White Avian Hall was more of a cooperative one.
“Congratulations, Eastcalm, on transcending the Heavenly Tribulation,” said Hall Lord White Avian with a smile. “From now on, what lays ahead remains vast. There’s no need to worry about the Heavenly Tribulation for a long time.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan smiled as well. “Ever since I became a Tribulation Eminence, the repeated Heavenly Tribulations have made me rather nervous. I can relax now; I probably won’t be able to see my eighth Essence Soul Tribulation before I die.”
“Don’t underestimate yourself,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “Eighth Tribulation Eminences also cultivate from the Seventh Tribulation realm. If seniors can succeed, why can’t we? Cultivation requires great determination. If one doesn’t even have determination, there’s no hope of them reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm.”
“Hall Lord is right,” said Meng Chuan immediately, but he muttered inwardly.
I’m just being humble. I can’t just claim that I will reach the Eighth Tribulation realm, right?
Furthermore, according to what he knew, it was indeed extremely difficult to reach the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm. The first obstacle was grasping the laws of space and time to reach the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm. There were no half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences in many eras.
It was actually very rare for two half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences to exist in this era. It wasn’t easy to clear the first obstacle.
The second trial was one’s willpower! If one’s willpower was strong enough, their Essence Soul World could withstand the laws of spacetime’s evolution. This was extremely difficult. According to the intelligence, it was much harder than cultivating a Physical Body Eighth Tribulation realm body.
The third trial was to transcend the tribulation. There was no intelligence on the eighth Essence Soul Tribulation.
When Meng Chuan said that it would probably be very difficult for him to see the eighth Essence Soul Tribulation before his death, he was, on the one hand, being humble. On the other hand, he wanted to see the eighth Heavenly Tribulation. This meant that he had passed the first two stages—his Essence Soul World could withstand the evolution of the spacetime laws.
After passing the first two trials, apart from not transcending the final tribulation, one’s true strength was already at the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm!
Why do I feel like Hall Lord values my cultivation more than me?
“Eastcalm,” said Lord of Shadowfiend. “You are still young; you have only cultivated for 7,000 years. You can completely become a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence in 20,000 to 30,000 years like Hall Lord. After that, you can attempt to reach the Eighth Tribulation realm.”
Meng Chuan smiled.
Hall Lord’s cultivation speed is very terrifying. Strictly speaking, can I reach the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm before 30,000 years?
“Let’s talk business,” said Hall Lord White Avian as he looked at Blazing Sun.
Blazing Sun nodded slightly and said, “Now that Eastcalm has reached the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm, he can take up more resources.”
Take up resources?
Meng Chuan’s heart stirred. He knew that almost all the precious resources in the River of Spacetime had been monopolized by Seventh Tribulation Eminences! The reason why Sixth Tribulation Eminences submitted to Seventh Tribulation Eminences was that they hoped to gain some of the leftover benefits from Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
I have to take up some resources! These could become Archean Eon Realm’s heritage in the future.
Whoosh.
Blazing Sun waved his hand, and a Spacetime Dominion Map appeared in front of him. Many areas in the Spacetime Dominion Map shimmered.
“All the resources that are relatively easy to obtain in the River of Spacetime have now been taken.” Deputy Hall Lord Blazing Sun pointed at a branch of the River of Spacetime. “For example, the most famous Star Sand River.
“Star Sand is the best material for refining Tribulation Charms. Occupying Star Sand River and trading Star Sand is an easy business. Now, more than 80% of Star Sand River is occupied by Palace Lord Snow Rainbow and Court Lord Yellow Shirt. The two of them fight perennially.”
“Do the other Seventh Tribulation Eminences not vie for it?” asked Meng Chuan.
“In terms of background and backing, Peach Mountain’s owner is the strongest in the entire River of Spacetime,” said Blazing Sun. “After that, it’s Palace Lord Snow Rainbow and Court Lord Yellow Shirt. Peach Mountain’s owner occupies Peach Mountain, so no one dares to spy on him. Palace Lord Snow Rainbow and Court Lord Yellow Shirt mainly occupy Star Sand River... Since Star Sand River is too large, they only occupy 80% of it.”
“What background and backer does he have?” The information that Meng Chuan had previously obtained was vague.
“The intelligence I previously gave you was very detailed,” said Hall Lord White Avian, “but I didn’t elaborate on it; it’s regarding an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. I didn’t want to distract you before you transcended the tribulation.”
Eighth Tribulation realm?
Meng Chuan’s heart stirred.
“Ever since the universe was born, dozens of Eighth Tribulation Eminences have been born in the River of Spacetime,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “Although some of them are already difficult to investigate, and even their intelligence is completely hidden, some Eighth Tribulation Eminences have proactively left behind their factions. For example, Eternal Tower, Nebula Palace, Black Fiend Hall, and so on. Many of the traces left behind by these Eighth Tribulation Eminences leave a profound impact on our River of Spacetime.”
Azure Dragon said, “The reason why Peach Mountain’s owner is said to have a strong backer is because he has cracked a difficult problem that Dragon Ancestor was troubled with. The Ancestor was rather delighted and permitted him three requests of his aid.”
“Even if our dragons’ Sixth Tribulation Eminences and half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences die in battle, the Ancestor won’t care. Only Seventh Tribulation dragons can obtain some favoritism.” Azure Dragon sighed. “Instead, it’s an outsider that managed to get the Ancestor to take action three times.”
Meng Chuan understood.
Why was no one willing to offend Peach Mountain’s owner? If Peach Mountain’s owner invited Dragon Ancestor to appear in this era, who could stop him?
“The owner of Peach Mountain only occupies Peach Mountain, a treasure land in the universe. He calls himself Peach Mountain Owner. He cultivates in seclusion and doesn’t interfere in any matters. He has never asked my Ancestor for help.” Azure Dragon thought somewhat highly of him. “He could’ve obtained more, but he was satisfied after occupying Peach Mountain.”
“Peach Mountain Owner, Palace Lord Snow Rainbow, and Court Lord Yellow Shirt all have Eighth Tribulation Eminences backing them. The Eighth Tribulation Eminence behind Court Lord Yellow Shirt is from another universe,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “Perhaps very few Seventh Tribulation Eminences have seen an Eighth Tribulation Eminence before, but it’s very difficult for them to get an Eighth Tribulation Eminence to help. Most Seventh Tribulation Eminences... have never seen an Eighth Tribulation Eminence before.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
Ancestral Master Archean Eon had only seen an Eighth Tribulation Eminence once in his life.
“There are many treasure lands in the River of Spacetime. Apart from Star Sand River and Peach Mountain having no disputes, most of the other places are in dispute.” Deputy Hall Lord Blazing Sun pointed at the spots where the Spacetime Dominion Map shimmered. “Seventh Tribulation Eminences and half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences are involved. Some have at least two or three fighting for it, up to as many as ten parties.”
Meng Chuan looked at the map carefully.
Light flashed on the Spacetime Dominion Map. Upon closer inspection, he could sense a large amount of information.
In the past, he only knew about how often Seventh Tribulation Eminences fought for resources. Only today did he truly understand the details.
Meng Chuan could vaguely tell that White Avian Hall and Six Directions Heaven were the two largest factions. They infiltrated everywhere, and both sides collectively occupied more than half of the resources. The other Seventh Tribulation Eminences and half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences each occupied many areas.
“Take a closer look,” said Blazing Sun. “Eastcalm, you are an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence. You should occupy a treasure land that matches your strength. By the way, Realm Ancestor said that he would give you a treasure land once you reached the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm.”
“Realm Ancestor’s gift?” Meng Chuan was astonished.
“Instead of calling it a gift, the occupation will still depend on you,” said Blazing Sun. “Realm Ancestor is old. Over the past few years, he has been trying to transfer the treasures he occupied to his good friends. However, Hall Master Nightmare from Black Fiend Hall isn’t convinced. He took action and forcefully snatched it, causing Realm Ancestor to fight him. Many Seventh Tribulation Eminences were involved in this. Realm Ancestor’s Essence Soul avatars occupy too many resources, so many people covet them.”

chapters.title: Chapter 712 - Universes Nest
chapters.content:
Chapter 712: Universe’s Nest
Meng Chuan came to a realization. Before he became an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, there were only three Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminences in existence. Among them, Realm Ancestor was close to the end of his lifespan. Therefore, they stopped competing.
Only Hall Master Nightmare and Origin Realm Chieftain showed off their prowess.
Origin Realm Chieftain was extremely domineering as he attempted to snatch White Avian Hall and Six Directions Heaven’s resources.
Hall Master Nightmare was slightly weaker, but he had many Essence Soul avatars. Furthermore, he wasn’t afraid of death. He could attack and occupy resources at will, making him much stronger than a Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
When Realm Ancestor grew old and passed away, he would eventually leave many resources vacant. Origin Realm Chieftain’s sphere of influence was too great. Each of his nine Essence Soul avatars had their own missions, so it was very difficult for him to arrange for Essence Soul avatars to occupy these vacant resources. Thus, Hall Master Nightmare had set his sights on them. He felt that he could occupy many of the resources once Realm Ancestor died.
If you are powerful, it’s fine if you occupy many resources in the River of Spacetime while alive. But if you are dead, what right do you have to determine who occupies these resources?
Hall Master Nightmare’s thoughts were very normal.
Realm Ancestor’s thoughts were very simple. He didn’t want others to benefit from the work he put in. He didn’t like Black Fiend Hall, so he naturally didn’t want Black Fiend Hall to take advantage. If he simply handed it to his good friend, it would be very difficult for a good friend to snatch it with their abilities. However, he was confident that the good friend could protect it.
“Realm Ancestor is very happy that you have reached the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm,” said Hall Lord White Avian with a smile. “I also told him that you still needed to transcend the tribulation. He told me to inform you that you should seek him out after transcending the tribulation.”
Meng Chuan nodded. “Alright.”
He was indebted to Realm Ancestor. It was only right to pay Realm Ancestor a visit.
“There are many treasure lands in the River of Spacetime. Some are naturally formed, while some are formed by Eighth Tribulation Eminences.” Hall Lord White Avian asked with a smile, “Have you decided which ones you want?”
Meng Chuan looked at the many glowing treasure lands in the Spacetime Dominion Map in front of him. After some thought, he pointed at a spot in the middle. “Here.”
“Universe’s Nest?” Hall Lord White Avian, Lord of Shadowfiend, Deputy Hall Lord Blazing Sun, and Deputy Hall Lord Azure Dragon were somewhat surprised.
Deputy Hall Lord Blazing Sun said in puzzlement, “Eastcalm, with your Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm strength, you can choose a better place. There’s no need to occupy Universe’s Nest, right?”
“I plan on occupying the three largest layers of Universe’s Nest,” said Meng Chuan.
Hall Lord White Avian and company laughed. Deputy Hall Lord Azure Dragon said, “There are only nine levels in the Universe’s Nest. If you occupy the largest three layers, it’s equivalent to occupying more than half of its resources.”
“To occupy three layers, you need to arrange for three Essence Soul avatars to be there,” reminded Hall Lord White Avian.
Meng Chuan nodded. “Understood.”
Universe’s Nest was the place that attracted him the most. This was because this place produced the most Universe treasures. Some Universe treasures could only be nurtured once or twice in an era. It was impossible to buy them. Therefore, if he occupied the three largest layers of the Universe’s Nest, more than half of the Universe treasures would fall into his hands. He could also choose those that were suitable for his family and Archean Eon Realm.
“From the looks of it, I have to accompany you since you want to occupy the three largest layers,” said Lord of Shadowfiend.
“Thank you, Brother Shadowfiend.” Meng Chuan also knew how powerful the other party was. When Lord of Shadowfiend was at the half-step Seventh Tribulation realm, he was publicly recognized as the strongest half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Now that he had reached the Seventh Tribulation realm, he was ranked among the top Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
...
Universe’s Nest contained nine layers of spacetime.
The nine spacetime layers were like a beehive. They fused together, but they were all different spacetimes. Therefore, one had to arrange an Essence Soul avatar to occupy each layer.
Whoosh.
A black-robed, white-haired man and a shadow existence traversed spacetime and arrived here.
“Universe’s Nest is also one of the top treasure lands in the River of Spacetime. It’s divided into nine layers. One Seventh Tribulation Eminence and eight half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences occupy each layer,” said Lord of Shadowfiend indifferently.
“Physical Body Tribulation Eminences only have one outer realm true body. If they choose to let their outer realm true bodies guard this place, they have to give up on other places. Every layer has at least one half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence... This shows how attractive Universe’s Nest is.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
Any Universe treasure could cost tens of thousands of cubes or even hundreds of thousands of cubes. Occupying a layer of Universe’s Nest was very profitable over a long period of time. Furthermore, he didn’t need to spend any effort to mine it. He just needed to guard it.
“The three largest layers are occupied by a Seventh Tribulation Eminence—Qilin Ancestor—our White Avian Hall’s Apprentice, and Six Directions Heaven’s Celestial Thearch Chi,” said Lord of Shadowfiend.
Qilin Ancestor was an ancient Seventh Tribulation Eminence from the same generation as Black Fiend Hall Master. He had cultivated for a long time and had a rich heritage. His only outer realm true body didn’t participate in many matters. He had guarded the largest layer of Universe’s Nest for a long time.
Apprentice was a half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence from White Avian Hall. He was known as the strongest artifact refiner in the River of Spacetime. He was ranked in the top five among the fifty-plus half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences. His strength suppressed a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, so he was naturally extraordinary.
Celestial Thearch Chi was one of Six Directions Heaven’s six Celestial Thearchs. He had a rather powerful background.
The three of them occupied the three largest layers.
A figure tore through the sky from Universe’s Nest in front of them. His skin was gray like a puppet. His face was expressionless, and his three eyes were dark and unfathomable. He was the strongest Tribulation Eminence at artifact refining in the present era—Apprentice.
“Shadowfiend, Eastcalm,” said Apprentice calmly.
“Thank you, Brother Apprentice, for passing me a layer of Universe’s Nest,” said Meng Chuan gratefully. According to the intelligence given by White Avian Hall, Apprentice had wished to ‘hand it over.’ Otherwise, Meng Chuan wouldn’t have received it directly.
Apprentice was also very reclusive. He focused on refining artifacts and wasn’t in a hurry to cultivate his body. After grasping an Origins law, he even gave himself the title of Apprentice.
The Eminences of this era had all sorts of origins for their names.
For example, Lord of Li Rainbow—who was in charge of Black Fiend Hall—was also known as Black Fiend Hall Master. Hall Lord Snowplume was in charge of Nightmare Hall and was also known as Hall Master Nightmare.
For example, Peach Mountain Owner occupied Peach Mountain after reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm and called himself Peach Mountain Owner.
Eminences had different ideas at different stages. Changing names was common.
For example, Myriad Star, White Avian, and Eastcalm were names that they decided upon when they were weak. They hadn’t changed their names after reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm.
“I’ve been cultivating here for more than 30,000 years. I’m thinking of changing locations, getting some activity after a prolonged sedentary lifestyle,” said Apprentice indifferently. As a Physical Body Tribulation Eminence, he only had one outer realm true body. He had to give the treasure land up if he wanted to leave. “However, Qilin Ancestor occupies the largest layer of Universe’s Nest. He won’t give in easily.”
“Let’s take a look first,” said Meng Chuan.
The three of them walked side by side.
Rumble!
Spacetime distorted as they approached the largest layer of spacetime in Universe’s Nest.
“What’s the matter?” A beast appeared. It had a single horn and looked somewhat ferocious. It was covered in scales, and its blood-colored eyes looked at the three people present. Qilin Ancestor couldn’t help but be alarmed. Although Apprentice was ranked in the top five half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences, he had a rich heritage and was confident of suppressing Apprentice. But the other two...
One was City Lord Eastcalm—Meng Chuan—who had made Black Fiend Hall Master suffer. He was also an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence. The other was Hall Lord White Avian’s sworn brother and a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence—Lord of Shadowfiend. Each of them was stronger than the other!
“Qilin Ancestor,” said Meng Chuan with a smile, “I want the largest layer in Universe’s Nest.”
Lord Ghostink—who he had some conflicts with—had followed Qilin Ancestor.
Qilin Ancestor rarely participated in disputes, but he had always guarded the largest layer of Universe’s Nest.
“You want it?” Qilin Ancestor’s eyes were cold. “What arrogance. If you have the ability, feel free to attack.”
“Qilin Ancestor, I advise you to leave obediently,” said Lord of Shadowfiend indifferently. “With the defensive array formation, you can withstand our attacks. However, we are only here to persuade you. If you aren’t open to advice, our White Avian Hall can only request Hall Lord to show up personally. If Hall Lord appears, your outer realm true body will probably be lost.”
Qilin Ancestor’s expression changed when he heard that. “There are so many layers in the Universe’s Nest, yet you insist on snatching mine? Furthermore, the River of Spacetime has many other treasure lands.”
“Hurry up and hand it over,” Lord of Shadowfiend said calmly.
White Avian Hall previously had limited manpower because they didn’t have an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence! The other Eminences only had one outer realm true body, so there was naturally no need to compete for excessive resources.
But since Meng Chuan had appeared, they naturally had to occupy more resources.
Many treasure lands in the River of Spacetime were occupied by experts!
Qilin Ancestor looked at the three people in front of him before staring at Meng Chuan. He knew that he would be at a disadvantage if he fought an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Furthermore, Meng Chuan was a terrifyingly young Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
“City Lord Eastcalm, as an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, you can occupy a better place, right?” asked Qilin Ancestor.
“I plan on occupying three layers of Universe’s Nest,” said Meng Chuan indifferently.
Qilin Ancestor was slightly stunned.
Three layers? Without a doubt, he is referring to the three largest layers. An Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence is indeed different!
“Forget it; I’ll give it to City Lord Eastcalm,” said Qilin Ancestor in a low voice. He knew better—knowing when to give up. If he gave up on this place, he could occupy other treasured lands.
City Lord Eastcalm wasn’t easy to deal with.

chapters.title: Chapter 713 - Meeting Realm Ancestor Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 713: Meeting Realm Ancestor Again
Qilin Ancestor was also very straightforward. He speedily cleaned up the Universe’s Nest layer that he occupied and dismantled the fixed array formation he had set up before silently leaving.
Perhaps this is an opportunity for me to change.
As Qilin Ancestor walked through the River of Spacetime, he pondered silently. He had guarded Universe’s Nest for too long and had been focused on cultivation for many years.
I’m left with the final bottleneck in the law of karma, but it has constantly troubled me. I’ve grasped the past and present with regards to the spacetime law, but it’s difficult to grasp the future, much less the complete temporal law.
Qilin Ancestor pondered. He had been at the Seventh Tribulation realm for more than 100,000 years; he had lived for a long time.
He had also completely given up on grasping the complete temporal law. All he wanted now was to grasp the karmic law completely. Once he succeeded, he would become a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence that had grasped two Origins laws.
If I were a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence, would White Avian Hall dare to bully me?
Qilin Ancestor thought to himself. His status in the River of Spacetime was very clear. The deterrence an ordinary Seventh Tribulation Eminences could muster was just average. Apart from not having cultivated a Seventh Tribulation body, A small number of half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences could match them in many aspects.
This was because Physical Body Tribulation Eminences deliberately left a flaw in their physical cultivation to delay the Heavenly Tribulation.
I only have 30,000 years left to live. It’s time for me to risk my life in some dangerous places.
Over the years, Qilin Ancestor had accumulated some opportunities. But he always believed that, the more profound his insights were, the easier it would be for him to break through. Therefore, he had been holding back.
If it weren’t for Meng Chuan’s appearance, Qilin Ancestor probably would’ve endured for another few thousand years, or even 10,000-plus years, before he started taking risks.
...
Of the Universe’s Nest’s three largest layers, only the layer of Six Directions Heaven’s Celestial Thearch Chi remained.
“Brother Eastcalm, you have become an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Are you only going to occupy three layers of the Universe’s Nest? That’s too little.” Celestial Thearch Chi was a very majestic man. His laughter was hearty and very enthusiastic. “If I were an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, I would’ve long exploited the fact that my many Essence Soul avatars aren’t afraid of death to fight with Ancestral Magus Realm, Origin Realm, and even Celestial Thearch Myriad Star. I would tear off a few chunks of their flesh.”
“Celestial Thearch Chi, you are a Celestial Thearch of Six Directions Heaven.” Although Meng Chuan guessed that the other party would give in, Celestial Thearch Chi was too enthusiastic.
“Haha, Myriad Star isn’t that petty,” said Celestial Thearch Chi warmly. “It’s rare for us to meet today. Brother Shadowfiend and Brother Apprentice are also here. Why don’t you come to my cave abode and have a chat?”
“There’s no need,” said the expressionless, puppet-like Apprentice coldly.
“We’ve been neighbors for so many years, but I haven’t been to your place to drink once. You aren’t willing to drink at my place either.” Celestial Thearch Chi shook his head.
“Since Celestial Thearch Chi has the intention to do so, let’s make it quick,” said Lord of Shadowfiend indifferently.
Six Directions Heaven and White Avian Hall were two opposing factions. Although the two factions’ upper echelons could sit down to have drinks, be it Lord of Shadowfiend or Apprentice, they were rather arrogant and couldn’t be bothered to deal with such matters. Even if Celestial Thearch Myriad Star were in front of them, they couldn’t be bothered to give him face. They accompanied Meng Chuan because he was part of White Avian Hall.
“Alright, I’ll dismantle the array formation now,” replied Celestial Thearch Chi. In just a moment, he dismantled everything and bade farewell.
“Celestial Thearch Chi is very low-key among Six Directions Heaven’s six Celestial Thearchs. He has been staying in the Universe’s Nest for a long time, unlike Celestial Thearch Xu—who often travels the world,” said Lord of Shadowfiend indifferently. “However, he’s good at scheming. Many operations in the Six Directions Heaven were designed by him.”
“What about Celestial Thearch Myriad Star?” asked Meng Chuan in puzzlement. “Celestial Thearch Myriad Star controls the laws of time and space... He knows the past and future. He’s even more ruthless when it comes to plotting, right?”
The expressionless Apprentice beside him said, “Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s status in the Six Directions Heaven is extraordinary. He’s far superior to the other five. Celestial Thearch Myriad Star hardly participates in many of Six Directions Heaven’s battles.”
“Once he interferes, it will be a major event,” Lord of Shadowfiend said.
Meng Chuan nodded.
That’s right. With Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s strength, he can crack array formations with his overwhelming strength. There is no need for him to scheme. If he really wanted to scheme, many Seventh Tribulation Eminences would probably feel alarmed and uneasy.
Meng Chuan’s three Essence Soul avatars entered the three largest spacetime layers in Universe’s Nest.
Universe’s Nest didn’t have any stars or other lifeforms; it only had surging energy.
Meng Chuan decided to set up a fixed Eighth Tribulation array formation on the largest layer of Universe Nest. There was no need to set up an array formation on the other two layers. This was because there weren’t any precious treasures before each spacetime layer produced a Universe treasure. Thus, very few people would dare to fight him for an empty Universe’s Nest layer.
Seventh Tribulation Eminences didn’t commit themselves unless success was certain. As an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, Meng Chuan was already considered low-key by only occupying three layers in Universe’s Nest instead of fighting for resources with Ancestral Magus Realm, Six Directions Heaven, and Origin Realm.
