The Eminences in Universe’s Nest were all people who kept low profiles.
...
What’s Myriad Star up to? He wants us to befriend Meng Chuan and not be enemies when we encounter him?
Celestial Thearch Chi walked the River of Spacetime as he pondered.
Six Directions Heaven’s Celestial Thearchs had long been exhorted by Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
“White Avian Hall is our opponent, but Meng Chuan isn’t. He can become our good friend.” Celestial Thearch Chi remembered Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s words clearly.
In Six Directions Heaven, everyone only needed to obey Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s orders obediently.
...
In front of a bamboo forest lake.
The white-haired Realm Ancestor continued fishing. The lake reflected countless figures in spacetime.
Whoosh.
A white-robed, white-haired man flew over from afar and landed nearby. He then bowed and said, “Senior Realm Ancestor.”
Realm Ancestor looked up at Meng Chuan and couldn’t help but smile. “I really am a senior when seeing a young cultivator like you.”
Realm Ancestor’s white hair made him look really old. He was close to the end of his lifespan.
Although Meng Chuan had white hair, his eyes contained endless vitality. His lifeforce was clearly still at its prime—he was still very far from the end of his lifespan.
“Come, sit.” Realm Ancestor pointed to the side. A bamboo chair materialized beside him as alcohol appeared.
Meng Chuan sat down.
“I’m also somewhat surprised that you can cultivate to the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm in 7,000 years. It’s truly impressive. Although Hall Lord White Avian is faster than you when it comes to reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm, he’s ultimately a Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence,” said Realm Ancestor. “The path of an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence is ultimately more difficult. You are much better than me back then. Perhaps you really have a chance of reaching the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm.”
“Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm...” Meng Chuan sighed. “I’ve read many records. The number of Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminences that have appeared in the River of Spacetime’s history can be counted on one hand. There’s no information about the Essence Soul Eighth Heavenly Tribulation at all.”
“Eighth Tribulation Eminences have jumped out of the River of Spacetime. If they have the intention of hiding their existence, we won’t be able to find out anything about them at all,” said Realm Ancestor. “All we know is that our universe only has dozens of Eighth Tribulation Eminences in history! At the Seventh Tribulation realm, Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences only occupy slightly more than ten percent of the population. I can guess that there are very few Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminences among the few dozen.”
“When I was young, I was ambitious. I wanted to break through to the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm, so I also gathered a lot of information. This information can be given to you,” said Realm Ancestor.
“Thank you, Senior Realm Ancestor.” Meng Chuan was rather grateful.
Realm Ancestor had occupied the position of the strongest Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence in the present era for too long. The intelligence he gathered was definitely much more than what Meng Chuan had now. In terms of historical rankings, Realm Ancestor was slightly higher than Ancestral Master Archean Eon.
Apart from the Eternal treasure he hid, Ancestral Master Archean Eon was only a normal top Seventh Tribulation Eminence in other aspects. Realm Ancestor, on the other hand, was a top Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
“The help provided by the information is limited. Cultivation still depends on yourself. Just grasping time and space is very difficult. In many eras, there are no half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences,” said Realm Ancestor wistfully. “Our era is already dazzling enough. Two half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences actually exist at the same time.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
For example, Archean Eon Realm typically only had a few Supremacies in the same era. But once in a while, stunning geniuses would appear. In fact, more than one would appear. For example, Imperial Lord Black Sand and Grandsire Yin Yang were in the same era.
Another example would be Ancestral Master Archean and Ancestral Master Eon Sea—who were from the same era.
It was the same for the entire River of Spacetime. Most of the time, there were no half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences. However, this era was relatively strong.
“Everything I know about the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm is here. I recorded it personally.” Realm Ancestor flipped his hand and handed a gray book to Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan received it solemnly and couldn’t help but probe it with his mind. With his strength, he could naturally read the entire book with a thought.
He couldn’t help but be alarmed. He now understood much more about the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 714 - Planet Blackjade
chapters.content:
Chapter 714: Planet Blackjade
“The requirements for one’s mind and willpower are that high?” Meng Chuan was a little shocked when he read the information regarding mind and willpower.
Realm Ancestor leisurely said, “Historically, the owner of Bright Cliff Realm was a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence from the Essence Soul lineage. After he comprehended time and space, he used the laws of space and time as a foundation to perfect his Essence Soul formulation. His mind and willpower also reached a terrifying level. Without needing to use any mystic techniques, all he needed was a glance and the willpower contained in his eyes... It was enough to make any Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s consciousness in that era blurry and defenseless.
“The owner of Bright Cliff Realm was the only half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence in that era. However, there were several top Seventh Tribulation Eminences. There were also top Seventh Tribulation Eminences from the Essence Soul lineage... But it was without exception; they couldn’t unleash any of their strength after a mere glance from the owner of Bright Cliff Realm.”
Realm Ancestor sighed. “Top Seventh Tribulation Eminences can still battle Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star. But in the era of Bright Cliff Realm’s owner... nobody could deliver an attack in front of him. However, his Essence Soul World still couldn’t withstand the evolution of time and space. He ended stuck at the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm his entire life.
“From this, it can be seen how great the burden on one’s Essence Soul World is when bearing the evolution of the complete laws of time and space,” said Realm Ancestor. “The requirements on one’s willpower are extremely high. For example, I have long been able to reach the peak of Fiend Mountain. However, I can only make ordinary Seventh Tribulation Eminences defenseless when using an Essence Soul mystic technique. The effects I have on top Seventh Tribulation Eminences are much weaker.”
Realm Ancestor sighed. “The outside world believes that I’m definitely very close to the Eighth Tribulation realm since ordinary Seventh Tribulation Eminences are no match against me. However, I know that I’m still far from it. Even if I break through the temporal law’s bottleneck, my willpower is still far inferior.”
“Senior Realm Ancestor, if you grasp the temporal law and use the laws of time and space as your foundation to perfect your Essence Soul formulation, I believe your willpower will transform and reach the threshold required for the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm,” said Meng Chuan.
“A perfected Essence Soul formulation?” Realm Ancestor’s eyes were filled with yearning. “Perhaps... But even if I grasp the time law now, I won’t have time to perfect my Essence Soul formulation with my remaining lifespan. You have read the intelligence on Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminences in history.
“You should know that my cultivation speed is only considered above average in history.” Realm Ancestor shook his head gently. “Among the many Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminences, I’m not considered the best. How can I hope to reach the Eighth Tribulation realm?”
Meng Chuan didn’t say a word. The intelligence given by Realm Ancestor was gathered after many years of hard work.
He had intelligence about generations of Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminences, including five half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences from the Essence Soul lineage. With all the information combined, one could tell which level they were at compared to the predecessors in history.
“You are different.” Realm Ancestor looked at Meng Chuan with bright eyes. “You are much stronger than me. In this life, you have a chance of reaching the level of Bright Cliff Realm’s owner. You even have a chance of reaching the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm.”
“I’ll naturally do my best.” Meng Chuan also felt that this path was very difficult.
“Follow me.” Realm Ancestor suddenly split out an Essence Soul avatar and led the way.
Meng Chuan had some guesses.
Hall Lord White Avian previously said that Realm Ancestor wanted to give me a treasure land.
Meng Chuan immediately followed Realm Ancestor.
...
Meng Chuan and Realm Ancestor appeared in a dark void.
Whoosh.
Ripples appeared in the void as a massive black planet appeared. On the planet, one could vaguely see cave abode buildings and array formations.
“Planet Blackjade.” Realm Ancestor looked at the planet and smiled. “It’s the most important treasure land that I’ve occupied during my conquests. Its value is much greater than the other treasure lands combined.”
Planet Blackjade?
Meng Chuan had naturally heard of it.
The value of Blackjade was definitely ranked in the top five treasures that many Seventh Tribulation Eminences fought for. The first treasure was Palace Lady Blood Phoenix’s Outer Realm Essence Crystal Star.
“As you know, Blackjade’s core can produce Blackjade Crystal Sand. Every year, only ten-plus grains are produced. Every Blackjade Crystal Sand grain is worth nearly a Primordial Stone. Every year, that translates to a production of hundreds of cubes, or even more than 1,000 cubes,” said Realm Ancestor with a smile. “As long as you guard this place and collect Blackjade Crystal Sand every few years... After 100,000 years, you can earn 100 million Outer Realm Essence Crystals with Blackjade Crystal Sand. Us Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences have multiple avatars. You just need one Essence Soul avatar to guard this place.”
Meng Chuan was alarmed.
Other than the Eternal treasure, Ancestral Master Archean Eon had accumulated less than 100 million cubes of wealth his entire life! From this, one could tell the value of Planet Blackjade.
As half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences, Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star couldn’t permanently guard the area with their only outer realm true body. They had to set their sights even higher.
In history, most of the people who occupied Planet Blackjade were at the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm.
Top Seventh Tribulation Eminences had the strength to do so, but what was most important was their cultivation! They needed to travel the world and head to various places of opportunity... If their only outer realm true body was forever tied to Planet Blackjade, it wouldn’t be worth it even if they accumulated 100 million Outer Realm Essence Crystals before they died. This was because a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence could accumulate quite a bit of wealth over time through their travels.
Of course, if it were an Outer Realm Essence Crystal Star that was several times more valuable, top Seventh Tribulation Eminences would be willing to guard it! For example, Palace Lady Blood Phoenix had paid a huge price to set up a large number of Eighth Tribulation array formations. With them, she could withstand the attacks of a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence. At this point, her true body in her homeworld could often travel outside.
“There aren’t many people in the River of Spacetime who have the right to guard this place,” said Realm Ancestor with a smile. “You are an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, and you have only cultivated for 7,000 years. No one will dare snatch this place if you occupy it.”
“This is too valuable.” Meng Chuan felt that this gift was too precious. It was difficult to guard such a treasure land! However, it was also very difficult to snatch it.
If Origin Realm Chieftain and Hall Master Nightmare had occupied the area before him, Meng Chuan wouldn’t be able to conquer the planet due to a defensive array formation.
Realm Ancestor easily gave Meng Chuan the occupation rights, so all he needed to do was guard it.
“I still have to give it up once I die,” said Realm Ancestor with a smile. “I’ve always wanted to give it to someone, but my few good friends at the top Seventh Tribulation realm only have one outer realm true body. They can’t stay here forever; they have to roam the universe and cultivate. Hall Master Nightmare wants it, but why would I give it to him? I originally wanted to wait a little longer. It wouldn’t be too late to make a decision in the final year or two before I die of old age. But since you have broken through, you are the best candidate.”
“Senior Realm Ancestor, I’ll remember this favor. I’ll accept Planet Blackjade.” Meng Chuan didn’t hesitate any further.
“Once I die, this place will still be contested by all parties. It’s not considered a favor,” said Realm Ancestor with a smile. “Planet Blackjade’s Blackjade Crystal Sand requires time to build up wealth. It also requires you to arrange an Essence Soul avatar to stay here permanently.”
“Senior Realm Ancestor, do you need me to do anything in the future?” asked Meng Chuan.
“I told you before—help my two juniors and my homeworld if you have the chance,” said Realm Ancestor with a sigh. “As for me, I won’t be able to see the day you stand at the peak of the River of Spacetime.”
An Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence was too far away, but he believed that Meng Chuan could reach the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm and stand at the peak of the River of Spacetime.

chapters.title: Chapter 715 - Swallowing a Middle-Level World
chapters.content:
Chapter 715: Swallowing a Middle-Level World
Black Fiend Hall headquarters.
In a hall, an image appeared in a mirror. Realm Ancestor accompanied Meng Chuan into Planet Blackjade, and Meng Chuan began refining its array formation.
Hall Master Nightmare watched silently.
“Stop looking. No one can do anything if Realm Ancestor takes the initiative to give it to Meng Chuan,” said Lord of Li Rainbow as he read a dossier.
“In the past, I’ve always respected Realm Ancestor quite a bit. I wasn’t willing to offend him. But in his old age, he has given the treasured lands he occupies to his many friends, but he’s unwilling to give one to me.” Hall Master Nightmare’s voice was cold. “Before Meng Chuan broke through, there were only three Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminences in existence. Origin Realm Chieftain has greater ambitions, so I was the only one who was suited to take over his treasured lands. However, he didn’t give a single one to me.”
“We’ve already fallen out with each other. What’s the point of saying all this?” Lord of Li Rainbow said indifferently.
Hall Master Nightmare fell silent. As an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, he wielded the legacy treasure, Nightmare Hall. His influence in the River of Spacetime was immense. He used force whenever soft tactics didn’t work. He had previously threatened Realm Ancestor. “Realm Ancestor, you are powerful, but you have to consider your homeworld and clansmen after you die.”
This infuriated Realm Ancestor, who sparked off a huge battle.
Hall Master Nightmare didn’t flinch at all as he battled Realm Ancestor. Many Seventh Tribulation Eminences interfered; both sides had their fair share of friends.
Hall Master Nightmare was young after all. He usually kept a low profile, but his social network was much stronger than Lord of Li Rainbow’s. Even a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence supported Hall Master Nightmare.
However, Realm Ancestor clearly had more good friends! Realm Ancestor was also stronger. In that battle... Realm Ancestor’s side had the absolute advantage. However, Hall Master Nightmare was an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence. His Essence Soul avatar condensed again after its death, so he didn’t suffer much.
Many branches of Black Fiend Hall were destroyed by the furious Realm Ancestor. Even so, Hall Master Nightmare didn’t care.
“Planet Blackjade has become Meng Chuan’s just like that.” Hall Master Nightmare had mixed feelings. He had tried to curry favor with Realm Ancestor, but all his methods—both soft and hard—were useless.
Instead, Realm Ancestor took the initiative to give Meng Chuan a gift.
Does he look down on me that much?
“We are plagued with sins after we joined Black Fiend Hall.” Lord of Li Rainbow was very calm. “It’s very normal for some Seventh Tribulation Eminences to view us as enemies. However, there are gains and losses. I control Black Fiend Hall, and you control Nightmare Hall. This is a much greater opportunity than Planet Blackjade.”
Hall Master Nightmare admitted this.
A top faction like Eternal Tower had existed for countless years because it was guarded by the Eye of Eternal.
Black Fiend Hall had two legacy treasures—Black Fiend Hall and Nightmare Hall. To Seventh Tribulation Eminences, they were no less useful than Eternal treasures. Unfortunately, they only had the right to use them! These two legacy treasures ultimately belonged to Black Fiend Hall’s owner. This was also one of the reasons why no faction wanted to vie for Black Fiend Hall and Nightmare Hall.
...
Shroud River Zone, Anbo River System, Zhan Cloud Realm.
Zhan Cloud Realm was an ancient, medium-sized world. It had existed for 9.3 billion years. Even for a medium-sized world, it had existed for too long. It had become extremely old, and it wasn’t far from being destroyed.
An inhabited world couldn’t be eternal. There were births, barbaric periods, and prosperous periods... However, they would ultimately decline and be destroyed.
“What a ridiculous inhabited world.” A black-robed figure looked at the middle-level world. Their gaze penetrated the world membrane and peeped at the living beings inside.
To mortals who lived in Zhan Cloud Realm, the world’s aging was too distant for them. Even if the world only had a few hundred thousand years left to live, it was very long for mortals. Zhan Cloud Realm was still extremely prosperous; countless family clans and factions lived a life of debauchery.
Their cultivation system was also very advanced and perfected. In history, Zhan Cloud Realm had produced one Seventh Tribulation Eminence and 15 Sixth Tribulation Eminences. Their heritage was naturally extremely deep.
Even though the world had declined, there was still one Tribulation Eminence, five Imperial Lords, and over 100 Supremacies.
Whoosh.
The black-robed figure suddenly dissipated as a dark, massive creature appeared. Its gaping mouth was even more terrifying than a Dark Chaos Hole. It devoured the entirety of Zhan Cloud Realm with a single bite. The spacetime law’s protection of an inhabited world was useless against a Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature.
Countless living beings in Zhan Cloud Realm were horrified to discover that space had been torn apart, revealing endless darkness. Following that, the darkness completely drowned them.
There was a Third Tribulation Eminence just outside Zhan Cloud Realm, as well as a number of Imperial Lord and Supremacy true bodies.
However, this devouring strike destroyed all living beings. It also destroyed the outer realm true bodies of the Tribulation Eminence and Imperial Lords through karma.
All living beings in Zhan Cloud Realm were completely wiped out.
Zhan Cloud Realm itself vanished.
Whoosh.
Having devoured the entirety of Zhan Cloud Realm, the massive figure was extremely comfortable.
Unfortunately, this inhabited world is too old and weak. It doesn’t taste good enough,
thought the behemoth.
Weak lifeforms of this inhabited world, don’t blame me. The one who really killed you is the Eminence of your universe. It’s fratricide!
The massive figure silently vanished.
Other than the disappearance of an inhabited world, nothing else changed in the void.
The disappearance of Zhan Cloud Realm didn’t cause any commotion.
In the vast River of Spacetime, hatred and killings were everywhere. Tribulation Eminences and Imperial Lords often died. No one cared about the deaths of a Third Tribulation Eminence and a few Imperial Lords.
As for the disappearance of Zhan Cloud Realm? Wasn’t it normal for an aging world to be destroyed?
...
In a dark hall.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star sat cross-legged as he lit an incense stick.
Whoosh.
A black-robed figure arrived in the dark hall and bowed respectfully to Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
“Celestial Thearch, these are the treasures in Zhan Cloud Realm. All the precious treasures are here.” The black-robed figure respectfully handed a pagoda to Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star reached out to take the pagoda and carefully inspected it. He couldn’t help but frown. “Most of the treasures left behind by Zhan Cloud Realm’s ancestors have been used up. What’s left is only ten million cubes. How poor.”
This harvest dissatisfied Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
“You didn’t devour the treasures, did you?” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star looked up at the black-robed figure, his eyes cold. Although he had been watching the entire process of the Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature devouring Zhan Cloud Realm—even to the point of helping conceal spacetime—it would be very difficult for him to find out if a Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature had secretly devoured a precious treasure that might be too attractive.
“I wouldn’t dare,” the black-robed figure said immediately. It was extremely afraid of Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star looked at it and finally flipped his hand to produce an ancient, damaged cup. “You can rest now.”
“Yes.” The black-robed figure didn’t dare to disobey. Celestial Thearch Myriad Star controlled its Life Core, so its life and death were in its hands. With a thought, he could destroy its consciousness.
The black-robed figure immediately transformed into a stream of light and flew into the cup.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star casually put away the wine cup and looked into the distance. He saw Meng Chuan refining Planet Blackjade’s array formation. Realm Ancestor was accompanying him.
Realm Ancestor gave Planet Blackjade to Meng Chuan?
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star watched from afar expressionlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 716 - Rejection
chapters.content:
Chapter 716: Rejection
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had quite a long lifespan left at his level. He naturally wanted to take that one last step to become a true Eighth Tribulation Eminence! By jumping out of the River of Spacetime and taking in the changes in spacetime, he could make the time flow in his body almost stop. A moment in his body would be a billion years or even longer in the outside world... Just the thought of it made Celestial Thearch Myriad Star yearn for it.
Although he was a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence, he was ultimately a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. He could only live for hundreds of thousands of years, and he couldn’t jump out of the River of Spacetime’s restraints; he was ultimately a big fish in the river.
If I carry out the second plan in the future, Meng Chuan and White Avian will probably be my greatest threats
, thought Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
He was very careful when devouring middle-level worlds.
In history, there were more than one million middle-level inhabited worlds that had historically produced Seventh Tribulation Eminences! Many of the countless treasures in the universe’s history were in these middle-level inhabited worlds’ treasuries.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star chose to attack the aging middle-level inhabited worlds. This was because aging was... closer to a form of natural annihilation. However, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had long destroyed over 100 middle-level inhabited worlds. Three of them were homeworlds of half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences. The wealth he obtained was still astonishing.
Over 100 medium-sized worlds had been destroyed. All of them were homeworlds that had given birth to Seventh Tribulation Eminences. Regardless of how old they were, it was still very abnormal for them to be consecutively destroyed over tens of thousands of years.
Hall Lord White Avian, Realm Ancestor, and the other powerful factions had long realized that something was amiss. They were wary of Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
I’m very careful. They don’t have any evidence to prove that my subordinate did it. However, devouring a middle-level world is ultimately a huge taboo. If I go too far... they’ll report it to an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. It’s very likely that an Eighth Tribulation Eminence with a strong sense of justice will take action.
In fact, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star wasn’t afraid of any present-day existence. Even Hall Lord White Avian was only on par with him. He was only afraid of the Eighth Tribulation Eminences that hadn’t appeared in this period.
Eighth Tribulation Eminences had different personalities. However, there was no doubt that they had one thing in common—their time was precious, and they couldn’t be disturbed.
For example, Dragon Ancestor. Even if one was a member of the Dragon race, they had to be a Seventh Tribulation dragon before he would pay attention to them. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have the time to pay attention to them. As long as it wasn’t something that shook the dragons’ foundation, the entire River of Spacetime’s foundation, or something that involved his cultivation, Dragon Ancestor wouldn’t appear.
Even if the entire universe was in excessive skirmishes and 99% of the cultivators died, it was only an era. What was it to Dragon Ancestor?
For example, Black Fiend Hall’s owner, Fiend Mountain’s owner, and so on were more self-centered. They didn’t have any sense of justice.
Thankfully, it’s very difficult to contact an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. Even the dragon clan leader can’t easily disturb their Ancestor,
thought Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
As long as I’m careful and don’t make them feel the pain, an Eighth Tribulation Eminence shouldn’t appear in this era.
Even though he knew that it was a taboo to devour middle-level inhabited worlds, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star still wasn’t willing to give up. This was because it was too easy to obtain treasures through such means.
Having sufficient treasures was also a resource for his cultivation!
There’s also that Fiend Mountain owner. It’s no wonder he wants to collect Life Cores so badly. Life Cores are too helpful for cultivation.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s eyes were filled with desire.
Unfortunately, there are too few Seventh Tribulation forbidden creatures. Almost all the Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature Life Cores in history have fallen into the hands of Fiend Mountain’s owner.
In this era, I’ve only managed to obtain eight Life Cores after trying everything I can. The few Seventh Tribulation forbidden creatures that are still alive in the Chaos Turbid River are even more cunning and cautious.
Eight Life Cores. I reserved three to have them devour a middle-level world under my control. I can only use five of them. That’s too few.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star didn’t dare to buy the Life Cores publicly. This was because there was only one existence in the entire River of Spacetime that publicly bought Seventh Tribulation Life Cores—Fiend Mountain’s owner!
If he dared to buy them publicly and caused Fiend Mountain’s owner to descend in this period, what should he do? The strength of Fiend Mountain’s owner was ranked in the top few among the dozens of Eighth Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime’s history. He was definitely not someone a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence could provoke.
I have to be careful and take it slow.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was very patient.
...
Planet Blackjade.
After Meng Chuan completely refined Blackjade’s array formation, Realm Ancestor left.
Planet Blackjade.
Meng Chuan stood in front of his cave abode and looked at the planet beneath his feet. He was in a good mood.
The endless production of Blackjade Crystal Sand here shall be Archean Eon Realm’s heritage.
Meng Chuan only needed time to accumulate treasures that weren’t inferior to Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s. Of course, they couldn’t be comparable to the single Eternal treasure.
Whoosh.
Suddenly, a blurry figure descended.
An old, gray-robed farmer appeared on Planet Blackjade as he smiled at Meng Chuan.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
Meng Chuan naturally recognized the other party. The other party had only sent an embodiment. He didn’t have a true body, so he posed no threat. If his true body wanted to enter, Meng Chuan probably would’ve immediately activated Blackjade’s array formation to stop him.
“In this era, you are indeed the most suitable person to manage Planet Blackjade,” said Celestial Thearch Myriad Star with a smile. “If I were Realm Ancestor, I also would’ve given it to you.”
“You flatter me, Celestial Thearch. What brings you here today?” asked Meng Chuan politely.
“As you know, the two greatest factions in the River of Spacetime are Six Directions Heaven and White Avian Hall,” said Celestial Thearch Myriad Star with a smile. “Although Origin Realm is also rather active, it doesn’t affect Six Directions Heaven and White Avian Hall much.”
Meng Chuan also knew that.
Origin Realm couldn’t snatch the core places.
“Six Directions Heaven and White Avian Hall have been fighting for a long time. Furthermore, I’m afraid this fight will continue far into the future,” said Celestial Thearch Myriad Star. “White Avian Hall’s resources and treasures mainly fall into Hall Lord’s hands. You other Seventh Tribulation Eminences can only share a portion of the credit. Since that’s the case... why do you have to risk your lives? For example, Lord of the East Abyss, Lord of Shadows, Palace Lord Food God, and Sect Master Mental Demon... Although they are also members of White Avian Hall, they are only in an alliance with White Avian Hall. They won’t be the vanguard at the front line.”
“What do you mean, Celestial Thearch?” Meng Chuan looked at him.
“I hope that you just help White Avian Hall a little, just like how Palace Lord Food God, Sect Master Mental Demon, and Lord of Shadows do. There’s no need to risk your life for it,” said Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
Meng Chuan understood what the other party was getting at. There was indeed a huge difference between an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence that was fighting with all their might and an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence who was slacking.
“Six Directions Heaven and White Avian Hall are opponents, but there’s no conflict between us. We can even be good friends; don’t you think so?” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star smiled. “I’ve always been generous to good friends.”
Whoosh.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star waved his hand, and a treasure appeared across spacetime. It was a palm-sized golden ring.
“This is a World Loop,” said Celestial Thearch Myriad Star with a smile. “It’s a rare treasure suitable for an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence. It was refined with materials left behind by a Chaos Lord. Furthermore, it uses the Chaos Hole law as a catalyst. With this, it can absorb enemies and store them in the World Loop. It can also be used to cast illusions...
“When a World Loop descends, it will trap enemies in an illusion. This rare treasure is worth about ten million cubes. It’s very useful for you to study an Essence Soul World’s structure and the spacetime laws.”
Materials left behind by a Chaos Lord?
With Meng Chuan’s status, he knew the difference between a Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature and a Chaos Lord! A Chaos Lord was an Eighth Tribulation forbidden creature. Any of the materials they left behind were extremely valuable. Furthermore, they contained all sorts of magical powers.
“Celestial Thearch, you sure are generous,” said Meng Chuan.
“There’s no need for you to do anything. All you need to do is agree to be an ordinary member of White Avian Hall like Palace Lord Food God. Hall Lord White Avian can’t force you to do your best for him, right?” said Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
“I’m indebted to Hall Lord, so I can only let you down,” said Meng Chuan directly.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star Star smiled and shook his head gently. “I didn’t stop you from being good friends with Hall Lord White Avian. You are good friends with him, just like me.”
Meng Chuan didn’t say a word. When he was at the Sixth Tribulation realm, Hall Lord White Avian had given him precious treasures. Having accepted the gifts, he couldn’t let Hall Lord White Avian down.
Now that he was at the Seventh Tribulation realm, he wasn’t lacking what Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had to offer.
“How about this? I don’t care what you do in White Avian Hall. Even if you fight the Six Directions Heaven for it... I don’t care.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star smiled at Meng Chuan. “I’m giving you a gift just to make you my friend.”
“A gift accepted spells the formation of karma.” Meng Chuan shook his head and said, “I’m indebted to Hall Lord. If I receive such a great gift from you today, I’m afraid I’ll let Hall Lord down in the future.”
Treasures moved people’s hearts, but it also implied karma. The more valuable the treasure, the greater the karma.
Since he had chosen to accept Hall Lord White Avian’s gifts, he definitely couldn’t accept the gifts from the enemy’s leader.
“Eastcalm.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star glanced at Meng Chuan. “You are truly a loyal person.”

chapters.title: Chapter 717 - Arriving at Holy Mountain of Painting Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 717: Arriving at Holy Mountain of Painting Again
“Celestial Thearch, you flatter me,” said Meng Chuan calmly.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star looked at Meng Chuan and shook his head. “Eastcalm, don’t reject me so quickly. Time is very magical. A decision you make today might be very different after 10,000 years or 30,000 years.”
Meng Chuan was slightly stunned.
Yes, as time changed, cultivators also changed.
“In the future, feel free to ask if you need my help on your cultivation path.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star remained friendly. “No Seventh Tribulation Eminence lives for another Eminence; they all have their own cultivation path. Even if you are indebted to Hall Lord White Avian, there will ultimately be a limit to the favors he has granted you. You can’t delay your cultivation for small favors.
“Just consider my words carefully,” said Celestial Thearch Myriad Star with a smile. “My cave abode welcomes you at any time.”
“Thank you, Celestial Thearch,” said Meng Chuan politely. Since the other party had taken the initiative to express goodwill, he had to cut him some slack.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star nodded slightly as the embodiment left.
Meng Chuan stood there thoughtfully. He could sense Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s intention to befriend him. His goodwill was very obvious.
Meng Chuan’s expression was solemn.
I’m afraid he’s up to no good by giving such a valuable gift.
There was a mortal saying: One who is unaccountably solicitous is hiding evil intentions.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star took the initiative to send a gift just to make friends? Celestial Thearch Myriad Star can see the future; he can see the future timelines of Seventh Tribulation Eminences. His sights definitely far exceed the gifts worth more than ten million cubes.
Hall Lord White Avian was the leader of his faction. Back then, he had said very clearly that he wouldn’t make things difficult for Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan had accepted the treasures under that premise. Back then, he was only at the Sixth Tribulation realm. The treasures Hall Lord White Avian gave him were treasures of the Essence Soul lineage. They were much more valuable than the ones Celestial Thearch Myriad Star gave him.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s words were vague. Without a clear request, how could Meng Chuan dare to accept the gifts?
It was the hardest to repay favors.
Hall Lord White Avian is open and aboveboard. Celestial Thearch Myriad Star looks enthusiastic, but in reality, he wants to use karma to restrain me.
Meng Chuan didn’t like Celestial Thearch Myriad Star because of this.
Forget it; there’s no need to think too much. The stronger I am, the stronger the storm I can withstand. It’s time to cultivate on Holy Mountain of Painting.
...
Evodia Mystic Realm, Holy Mountain of Painting.
“Greetings, City Lord Eastcalm.” A thin, black-robed elder bowed respectfully. He was the Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence—Poison Eye—in charge of guarding Evodia Mystic Realm.
Master Poison Eye. Meng Chuan observed the other party.
“City Lord, you can just call me Poison Eye,” said the elder humbly. “The last time City Lord came to Evodia Mystic Realm, you were still at the Sixth Tribulation realm. In the blink of an eye, you are already a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. I’m impressed.”
Master Poison Eye had long grasped three Sixth Tribulation laws and was stuck at the final bottleneck. However, City Lord Eastcalm had only cultivated for a short period of time. Meng Chuan had first comprehended the spatial law and then grasped the Chaos Hole law. Him becoming a Seventh Tribulation Eminence made Master Poison Eye rather envious.
Poison Eye had suffered Black Fiend Hall’s crazy revenge. Even though his many Essence Soul avatars could be gathered and dispersed at will, the alien powers still seeped into every Essence Soul avatar. Unless his Essence Soul transformed to the Seventh Tribulation realm and his Essence Soul became powerful, nobody could save him other than Black Fiend Hall.
Meng Chuan’s strength had increased greatly. Wherever he was, his Origins domain naturally spread out. At first glance, he could sense the strange power entangling the black-robed elder’s Essence Soul.
“Your injuries?” Meng Chuan looked at him.
“A personal blow from Hall Master Nightmare,” said the elder. “He used a strange power contained in the legendary Nightmare Hall. Manor Lord Centaurea had helped me request Realm Ancestor’s help... but he wasn’t able to expel the strange power from Nightmare Hall.”
“Oh? Mind if I take a look?” asked Meng Chuan. He knew that Nightmare Hall was a legacy treasure; it was terrifying and extraordinary.
“Thank you, City Lord.” The elder was also somewhat expectant. Realm Ancestor was an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, and so was City Lord Eastcalm. Perhaps there was a way to save him? If the alien power was expelled, he would completely recover. It meant that he could still live for tens of thousands of years.
A wisp of Meng Chuan’s Power of Essence Soul seeped into the elder’s Essence Soul avatar.
Oh?
Meng Chuan clearly discovered the problem the moment his powers seeped in.
There was a strange law that affected Master Poison Eye’s Essence Soul. This strange power was a nomological manifestation. It was very mysterious, and it had already infected the entirety of Master Poison Eye’s Essence Soul. It could even affect all his other true body avatars.
This is the Power of Nightmare?
Meng Chuan knew much more than Master Poison Eye. The intelligence given by White Avian Hall had long recorded how terrifying the Power of Nightmare was. Thankfully, Hall Master Nightmare’s realm wasn’t high. Thus, he could only unleash a small portion of the legacy treasure’s strength.
If Hall Master Nightmare had reached the pinnacle of the Seventh Tribulation realm and used the legacy treasure, Master Poison Eye’s injuries would probably be much worse. He probably would’ve died long ago.
Black Fiend Hall’s two legacy treasures were no less useful to Seventh Tribulation Eminences than Eternal treasures.
Although only a sliver of the Power of Nightmare was used, it’s too profound. I’m afraid I can only attempt to crack it after grasping the spacetime law and reaching the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm.
Meng Chuan could sense how strange and terrifying the Power of Nightmare was. From this, he understood how powerful an Eighth Tribulation Eminence was.
The elder couldn’t help but ask, “City Lord, do you have a solution?”
“I’m at my wits’ end.” Meng Chuan shook his head while in thought. “If there’s a way to crack it in the future, I’ll come to you.”
“City Lord...” The elder was somewhat grateful.
Meng Chuan appreciated Poison Eye—who abhorred evil and had a huge grudge with Black Fiend Hall. Unfortunately, he couldn’t help him now.
“You don’t have to entertain me. I’ll only cultivate in front of Holy Mountain of Painting in Evodia Mystic Realm,” said Meng Chuan as he took a step and arrived at the foot of the mountain.
With a wave of his hand, a cave abode that spanned several kilometers descended.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar lived in seclusion in the cave abode. He looked up at the 45,000-kilometer-tall mountain wall and the stunning paintings.
All 33 paintings were extraordinary.
Time for me to begin painting.
As he sat in the study, there was a blank canvas in front of Meng Chuan.
This blank canvas was personally refined by Meng Chuan. He used 800 cubes’ worth of materials to refine it. The canvas was half a million kilometers long and wide. Its uniqueness was that it was large and made of extraordinary materials. It could hold some powerful paintings.
Meng Chuan first began painting the Chaos Hole lineage. Using the Chaos Hole law, he could understand the essence of these paintings better.
...
Time passed. In the blink of an eye, 30 years passed.
Over the past 30 years, the River of Spacetime had been in turmoil. Many top factions had conflicts. Half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences had fought several times.
White Avian Hall had also participated in many battles, but they didn’t let Meng Chuan take action! This was because many battles were disputes between Sixth Tribulation Eminences. It was very rare for a half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence to take action.
Seventh Tribulation Eminences had to study and cultivate. Unless it was truly important, Seventh Tribulation Eminences wouldn’t appear to participate in the battles. But once they appeared, they would attract the attention of the top factions in the River of Spacetime.
Meng Chuan spent the past 30 years painting.
When he was at the Sixth Tribulation realm, his horizons were still shallow. After reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm and grasping the spatial law and Chaos Hole law, he could understand these paintings at a deeper level. His insights were naturally different.
Thirty years. 32 paintings.
Meng Chuan felt that he had gained too much in the past 30 years.
He painted each of the 32 paintings very seriously. For those he experienced great gains, he even drew them a second or third time...
During those 30 years, Meng Chuan gained a deeper understanding of time, space, and the ten Origins laws. How did the ten Origins laws work together? How did time and space produce so many laws? At the very least, he had a vague understanding of them.
There’s also the 33rd painting.
Meng Chuan looked up. His gaze passed through the study’s window, past the cave abode’s walls, and looked at the 45,000-kilometer-tall mountain wall. He looked at the only painting among the 33 paintings—a simple painting.
The other 32 paintings were extremely complicated. They contained at least one Origins law.
Only the painting in the middle consisted of six strokes!
Each of the six extremely casual strokes was different. Each stroke seemed to tear through the Chaos and open up a universe. The six strokes interweaved with each other, producing countless mysteries.
Meng Chuan instinctively felt that this painting was much more brilliant and difficult to comprehend. Therefore, he left it for the last.
I’ll give it a try—this six-stroke painting.
Meng Chuan looked up at the towering mountain wall and carefully examined each stroke of the six-stroke painting.

chapters.title: Chapter 718 - Six-Stroke Painting
chapters.content:
Chapter 718: Six-Stroke Painting
In the past, he couldn’t understand the six-stroke painting due to his low cultivation realm. He only instinctively felt that it was most profound.
Now that he had grasped the Chaos Hole law and had reached the Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation realm, Meng Chuan was somewhat puzzled when he looked at it carefully.
“At first glance, this stroke looks like it tore through the Chaos and opened up a universe,” muttered Meng Chuan.
But upon closer inspection, it’s as though everything has condensed into one—everything is in one stroke. When I look at it again, this stroke seems to represent all the space I’ve seen.
However, upon careful thought, the Chaos Hole law, the spatial law, and the Heaven Splitting Blade... are all grasped by me.
I see what I know?
Meng Chuan was somewhat shocked.
He saw whatever was on his mind.
This six-stroke painting was truly strange.
I’ll carefully view the six-stroke painting from the Chaos Hole law’s perspective.
Meng Chuan temporarily abandoned his other thoughts because the Chaos Hole law was the strongest among the laws he had grasped. Perhaps he could pry into the six-stroke painting’s profundities by doing so.
Time slowly passed.
Meng Chuan constantly stared at the six-stroke painting. His true body and many avatars were also studying the six-stroke painting.
He looked at the first stroke and then the second...
Each of the six strokes was different! It was like observing an object. From the front, back, left, right, top, and bottom, one could see different things.
Meng Chuan studied this six-stroke painting’s Chaos Hole law from different levels. Even as a master of the Chaos Hole law, Meng Chuan had never understood the Chaos Hole law on so many different levels.
What a wonderful six-stroke painting.
Meng Chuan looked at it for ten years before he picked up the brush.
Meng Chuan shook his head after he slowly drew the first stroke. The difference was too great.
Although he had clearly understood it, he realized that his understanding of the painting was still shallow when he actually tried to replicate it.
...
After ten years of observation and 23 years of painting, Meng Chuan had finally completed the first six-stroke painting he was satisfied with.
This painting was dark and terrifying.
Six strokes crossed... It was like a real Chaos Hole in front of him.
Meng Chuan looked at the painting in front of him and nodded slightly.
It’s done. I’ve finally drawn the entire Chaos Hole law with just six strokes.
All of the Chaos Hole law’s profundities were contained in these six strokes.
Thankfully, I’ve been viewing the world with the eyes of a painter since I began cultivating. I’m used to such cultivation, which is why I can draw one Origins law with just six strokes.
Before coming to Holy Mountain of Painting, Meng Chuan didn’t believe that he could do it. Every one of the 32 paintings left behind by Daolord Evodia was extremely complicated.
This was because an Origins law was vast to begin with. The more strokes one used, the more confidence one had in fusing the complete law.
Six strokes? It was only after Meng Chuan saw the six-stroke painting—which gave him the impetus—coupled with his talent in painting, that he finally drew the Chaos Hole law using six strokes.
This is only a six-stroke painting of the Chaos Hole law.
Meng Chuan’s gaze passed the cave abode wall and looked at the six strokes on the towering 45,000-kilometer-tall mountain wall.
As for the original piece of art, it can infuse any law.
I’ll test the spatial law.
Meng Chuan observed again.
With his prior experience, it was much faster this time. After observing for three months and painting for a year, he successfully drew a six-stroke painting of the spatial law.
It’s done.
In the past year of drawing, he had failed many times. This time, Meng Chuan finally succeeded. He looked at the six-stroke painting of the spatial law in front of him as though he could see the complete spatial law.
Two six-stroke paintings. One is of the spatial law, and the other is of the Chaos Hole law.
Meng Chuan placed both paintings in front of him. The two paintings had different styles. One was dark and terrifying, while the other was vast and calm. However, both had six strokes.
Six strokes is all it takes?
Meng Chuan compared the two paintings.
I can also try to paint the Heaven Splitting law in the same way. However, I’ve only comprehended parts of the Heaven Splitting law. I’ll try to paint the Heaven Splitting Blade first!
Meng Chuan raised his head and continued looking at the six-stroke painting on the towering mountain wall. He tried to understand the Heaven Splitting Blade from the perspective of the six-stroke painting.
This time, time passed even faster.
Practice made perfection. It became easier for Meng Chuan to understand the laws from the perspective of the six-stroke painting. This time, he gained some insights after just one day of observation. He then began to paint the Heaven Splitting Blade.
As Meng Chuan drew, his understanding of the six-stroke painting became clearer. He understood that the six strokes were a way to deconstruct everything. After deconstructing the Chaos Hole law, the spatial law, and the Heaven Splitting Blade, Meng Chuan became more familiar with the six-stroke painting.
This time, he only spent an hour painting the Heaven Splitting Blade—
Boom!
A six-stroke painting appeared in Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World. They intertwined with each other and formed a mysterious runic seal. It contained endless might. The runic seal became a part of Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World and fused with the painting Essence Soul.
This—
Meng Chuan stopped painting. There were six-stroke runic seals in the depths of his eyes.
Meng Chuan looked up.
Whoosh!
The entire Holy Mountain of Painting, the entire Evodia Mystic Realm, and even the vast void beyond the mystic realm became a vast painting in Meng Chuan’s eyes. This massive painting had six layers stacked on top of each other. Each layer was different.
In this painting, there were countless living beings, Sixth Tribulation Poison Eye, Supreme Yang Star, Supreme Yin Star, countless barren planets, inhabited worlds, and naturally, the Holy Mountain of Painting. Everything existed in the painting. It was a part of the painting.
The creatures in the painting had different appearances in the six layers. Some were sinister and evil, some were peaceful and calm, and others were just skeletons...
The Supreme Yang Star, Supreme Yin Star, inhabited worlds, and other celestial bodies in the painting were different on different levels. Some were flames, some were light, and some were a drop of ink...
...
A black-haired, long-bearded elder was sleeping soundly on a boulder. Beside the boulder was a small lit stove and a flask of alcohol. The flask leaned against the boulder, and a drop of alcohol dripped down.
The area within ten feet was very calm and ordinary. The flask of alcohol was still warm. However, the area ten feet away from the boulder rapidly changed.
The vast land quickly turned into an ocean. The ocean dried up, revealing mountains. The mountains were reduced to soil, and countless people lived here to reproduce and form civilizations... This place then transformed into a vast uninhabited swamp...
The surroundings constantly changed.
The timeline was advancing at a terrifying speed. Ten thousand years, twenty thousand years, thirty thousand years...
However, time seemed to have come to a standstill within a ten-foot radius around the boulder where the elder lay. He slept soundly for a moment, but the alcohol flask remained warm. Countless years had passed in the outside world.
The moment Meng Chuan condensed the six-stroke runic seal in his Essence Soul World, the long-bearded elder slowly opened his eyes, and the timeline stopped!
The long-bearded elder opened his eyes and saw the shocked Meng Chuan—who had condensed a six-stroke runic seal in front of Holy Mountain of Painting. He looked at Meng Chuan and smiled. “I’m going to have another junior brother.”

chapters.title: Chapter 719 - Daolord Evodia
chapters.content:
Chapter 719: Daolord Evodia
The six-stroke painting is actually a mystic technique legacy?
At that moment, Meng Chuan understood everything.
The other 32 paintings on Holy Mountain of Painting contained Daolord Evodia’s cultivation insights. Only the six-stroke painting was a mystic technique.
I’ve never heard of such an inconceivable mystic technique.
Meng Chuan looked around, and six-stroke runic seals appeared in the depths of his eyes.
This mystic technique surpasses all the mystic techniques I’ve heard of.
At its largest extent, he could see the universe, the void, and all things. At its smallest extent, everything was within a grain of sand, formed by leptons.
As Meng Chuan observed, everything became a painting! Even a drop of water formed by leptons turned into a six-layered painting.
Everything in the River of Spacetime can become a six-layered painting in my eyes.
Meng Chuan was shocked.
The originally profound and incomprehensible laws are now much easier to understand.
Heaven Splitting law.
Meng Chuan’s eyes looked at the Heaven Splitting law in the universe.
White Avian Hall had long prepared a cave abode for Meng Chuan on Clear Spring Island. The Essence Soul avatar in Clear Spring Island’s cave abode observed the Heaven Splitting law that operated under the spacetime laws.
It turned the Heaven Splitting law into a six-layered painting. The first layer depicted countless swimming tadpoles. The second layer depicted a bolt of lightning that tore through the darkness. The third layer depicted a dragon claw that ripped through everything. The fourth layer depicted countless intertwining threads. The fifth layer...
Meng Chuan only needed to study the six-layered painting separately to comprehend the Heaven Splitting law.
Comprehending the Heaven Splitting law instantly became ten times easier. Just by looking at the six-layered painting of the Heaven Splitting law, Meng Chuan felt a huge harvest surge into his heart. His insights improved by leaps and bounds.
Temporal law.
Meng Chuan wasn’t in a hurry to study it; he tried to view the most important temporal law.
This time, he managed to extract the vast temporal law from the laws of spacetime with great difficulty. He formed a six-layered painting that was much more difficult to interpret.
The first layer was of a maggot advancing through a tunnel. The second layer consisted of three voids; there were countless tadpoles in each of the three voids. Even if one looked carefully, they would find the three voids identical. The third layer was of a surging river with countless tributaries; there were illusory images in the river as living beings floated in it. The fourth layer was a blob of light! This blob of light shot out billions of light beams. Every light beam contained everything in the universe. The fifth layer...
Oh? A six-layered spacetime law diagram?
In the past, Meng Chuan felt that the temporal law was very esoteric. Therefore, he planned on comprehending the Heaven Splitting law first. He would use the two opposing laws as his foundation before slowly studying the temporal law.
But this time, each layer of the six-layered painting seemed very difficult to comprehend. However, Meng Chuan gained quite a lot from the six-layered painting when he cross-referenced them.
With the help of this mystic technique, it was clearly much easier to comprehend the temporal law than before.
Any Seventh Tribulation Eminence would probably go crazy over such a mystic technique, but I’ve never heard of it before.
Meng Chuan also realized how terrifying this mystic technique was.
This mystic technique couldn’t increase one’s strength immediately. However, it made cultivation much easier. The previously difficult parts became easy to understand. The bottleneck that one couldn’t break through in the past would also be reduced to one that simply required diligent meditation.
Such a mystic technique can definitely be considered the number one mystic technique in the River of Spacetime. It doesn’t hide anything, and it openly remains on Holy Mountain of Painting! Countless Seventh Tribulation Eminences have observed Holy Mountain of Painting, but they seem to have learned very little. If they had learned a little more, it would be impossible for them not to have any information.
In fact, such a formulation had always been open to the public on Holy Mountain of Painting. Yet, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star and Hall Lord White Avian ignored it.
Oh?
Meng Chuan’s expression changed slightly. The leptons that had been flowing in the world froze.
The leptons were completely still, so everything was naturally still. The timeline had stopped moving, but Meng Chuan could still move and cultivate. However, he could only live at this point in time; he couldn’t reach the next temporal node.
I’m an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence. I actually caused the timeline in my area to stop?
Meng Chuan knew very well how powerful he was.
When a Seventh Tribulation Eminence descended into a Chaos Hole’s core, the Chaos Hole’s core wouldn’t be able to maintain a large influence on time. They would even cause the Chaos Hole’s core to collapse gradually.
Meng Chuan saw it.
A black-haired, long-bearded elder appeared in the courtyard outside. He looked up at Holy Mountain of Painting.
I can’t sense any aura from him. It’s as though he doesn’t exist in this spacetime. Even Celestial Thearch Myriad Star and Hall Lord White Avian can’t transcend spacetime.
Meng Chuan had his speculations as he immediately walked out of his study.
The long-bearded elder still looked up at the towering 45,000-kilometer-tall mountain wall and smiled. “What do you think of these paintings?”
“Daolord Evodia’s paintings are the most profound paintings I’ve ever seen,” said Meng Chuan from the bottom of his heart. The 32 complicated paintings were very impressive, and the six-stroke painting could be said to be the best mystic technique in the River of Spacetime.
The long-bearded elder turned to look at Meng Chuan. His eyes were very bright as he smiled and said, “I’m Evodia.”
“Greetings, Senior, I’m Meng Chuan.” Even though Meng Chuan had guessed that the other party was an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, he was still extremely shocked. He immediately bowed respectfully.
This elder was an Eighth Tribulation Eminence! How could Meng Chuan not be shocked?
Many Seventh Tribulation Eminences pursued the opportunity to meet an Eighth Tribulation Eminence their entire lives! Ancestral Master Archean Eon had only seen one Eighth Tribulation Eminence in his life.
Meng Chuan had cultivated for slightly over 7,000 years, and he was lucky enough to meet Daolord Evodia. Furthermore, he had loved painting since he was young. His love for painting was even greater than his love for sabers and swords. When he encountered the Eighth Tribulation Eminence—Daolord Evodia—who had the highest painting accomplishments in the River of Spacetime, Meng Chuan naturally felt immense respect for him.
“These paintings of mine can only be considered ordinary,” Daolord Evodia said.
“But I find them mysterious and unfathomable, especially the one in the middle. It’s even more impressive.” Meng Chuan pointed at the six-stroke painting in the middle of the towering 45,000-kilometer-tall mountain wall.
A single painting that allowed him to master a mystic technique made Meng Chuan admire Daolord Evodia even more.
He is truly impressive!
“Of the 33 paintings on the mountain wall, only this one wasn’t painted by me.” Daolord Evodia smiled at Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan blinked.
It wasn’t painted by him? How is that possible?
“These 33 paintings clearly have auras that are connected as one,” said Meng Chuan. Even though the timeline had stopped and Meng Chuan and Daolord Evodia existed at this temporal node, causing everything else to become ordinary, the 33 paintings still gave Meng Chuan endless pressure.
“This is how powerful Master is,” said Daolord Evodia with a sigh. “After I reached the Eighth Tribulation realm, I placed my insights into the painting on the mountain wall. This is also a hobby of mine. When I drew 19 paintings, Master passed by this universe and saw my paintings. He was intrigued and used the aura of my 19 paintings as a catalyst to draw this six-stroke painting.
“I sensed it when a cultivator drew on my Holy Mountain of Painting, so I descended upon that temporal node and was lucky enough to meet Master. The six-stroke painting used my previous 19 paintings as the source. I immediately comprehended them after seeing the six-stroke painting and immediately kowtowed to thank Master.” A look of reminiscence appeared in Daolord Evodia’s eyes. “Thus, I was lucky enough to become Master’s disciple—his in-name disciple.”
“In-name disciple?” Meng Chuan was shocked.
Daolord Evodia was an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, yet he was only an in-name disciple?
“There’s no need to be surprised; this is already a great opportunity for me. Many Eighth Tribulation Eminences have searched their entire lives, but they haven’t been able to see Master.” Daolord Evodia looked at Meng Chuan. “Back then, I asked Master if he wanted to conceal this six-stroke painting. Master said that this was a mystic technique he created for the Painting Dao. It can be viewed by all living beings. If anyone learns this mystic technique, they can head to Dry Origin Mountain. Passing the test there allows them to become Master’s in-name disciple.
“But ever since Master left behind the six-stroke painting, nobody has been able to comprehend it other than me. Until today!” Daolord Evodia looked at Meng Chuan. “Finally, someone has learned this mystic art.”
Meng Chuan was secretly alarmed. After all these years, he was the only one to learn this mystic technique after Daolord Evodia.
“Let’s go. Follow me to Dry Origin Mountain,” Daolord Evodia said.
“Where’s Dry Origin Mountain?” asked Meng Chuan.
“It’s naturally outside the universe.” Daolord Evodia grabbed Meng Chuan’s arm.
Whoosh!
Spacetime distorted and transformed into a blur. The River of Spacetime could no longer restrain them.
The two of them had already left this universe.

chapters.title: Chapter 720 - Beyond the Universe
chapters.content:
Chapter 720: Beyond the Universe
Meng Chuan sighed in amazement as he looked around. The surrounding spacetime distorted into a tunnel as he followed Daolord Evodia and advanced through it at high speeds.
I’ve left the River of Spacetime and my home universe.
At Meng Chuan’s realm, he could clearly sense that he had left the River of Spacetime and arrived in an unfamiliar, vast land.
The spacetime here was strange. In other words, the composition of spacetime outside the universe had already exceeded Meng Chuan’s understanding. If he were to act alone, he wouldn’t dare to teleport randomly. He was afraid of accidentally entering a dangerous place.
“There’s no end beyond the universe,” Daolord Evodia said.
“This is Chaos?” Meng Chuan looked outside the tunnel. He had heard that there were Chaos creatures in the Chaos beyond the universe.
Outside the colorful time tunnel was darkness. Light occasionally flashed, and the spacetime layer was beyond bizarre.
“That’s right. One needs to have the strength of an Eighth Tribulation Eminence to travel long distances in the Chaos,” said Daolord Evodia. “For example, those Chaos creatures only move around the region they were born in. If they go too far, they will be lost and unable to return. Even if they have avatars and can sense the direction, spacetime is chaotic in the Chaos. It’s useless to advance in a direction.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
“Only by mastering the complete spacetime law can one travel through spacetime and head to many mysterious places. They can also head to other universes,” Daolord Evodia said.
“How many universes are there in the endless spacetime?” asked Meng Chuan curiously.
“That’s unknown.” Daolord Evodia shook his head. “This is a mystery! Even an Eighth Tribulation Eminence can only travel a very small portion of the endless spacetime. It’s very rare for them to pass by 100-plus universes. I’ve only explored 15 universes in my life, but I’ve heard of over 10,000 universes.”
“Over 10,000?” Meng Chuan was astonished.
“The endless spacetime will naturally give birth to universes. Eternal existences can casually create universes. Even Eighth Tribulation Eminences and the strongest powerhouses can open up universes. Furthermore, a universe also has moments of destruction. Therefore, the number of universes is uncertain. In fact, they are constantly changing,” said Daolord Evodia. “The number of known universes is more than 10,000. However, endless spacetime is too large. How many Eighth Tribulation Eminences can we see in our lives? Only Eternal existences can know all the secrets of endless spacetime.”
“Eternal existences?” Meng Chuan asked the question in his mind. “Daolord, is the master you mentioned an Eternal existence?”
Daolord Evodia turned to look at Meng Chuan. He smiled and nodded slightly. “That’s right. An Eternal existence stands at the highest point in the endless spacetime. They look down on all living beings and all the universes. They are truly omnipotent.”
“Omnipotent?” asked Meng Chuan.
To make an Eighth Tribulation Eminence say that one was omnipotent?
“An Eternal existence is much stronger than an Eighth Tribulation Eminence.” Daolord Evodia sighed. “You should know that Tribulation Eminences experience tribulations one after another, each harder than the one before. The Eighth Tribulation realm to the Eternal realm is like a chasm. Many Eighth Tribulation Eminences have long given up.”
Meng Chuan fell into deep thought.
“Imperial Lords can reach the Tribulation realm after attaining a perfected body or experiencing an Essence Soul breakthrough. Newly-advanced Tribulation Eminences can typically reach the Second Tribulation realm easily. It’s slightly difficult to reach the Third Tribulation realm, but it’s even harder to reach the Fourth Tribulation realm,” said Daolord Evodia. “Typically, only one in ten can reach the Fifth Tribulation realm from the Fourth Tribulation realm! There are typically only one in 200 Fifth Tribulation Eminences that can advance to the Sixth Tribulation realm! Only one in thousands can reach the Sixth Tribulation realm from the Fifth Tribulation realm.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. It was very difficult to reach the Seventh Tribulation realm. Seventh Tribulation Eminences generally had much longer lifespans than Sixth Tribulation Eminences, but there were only less than 30 Seventh Tribulation Eminences in this era.
“As for the Seventh Tribulation realm to the Eighth Tribulation realm? Even if our home universe has a very rich heritage, only one Eighth Tribulation Eminence appears out of tens of thousands of Seventh Tribulation Eminences,” said Daolord Evodia with a sigh. “As for the Eighth Tribulation realm to the Eternal realm? I’m afraid not even one Eternal will appear out of millions of Eighth Tribulation Eminences. I don’t know how many living beings there are in the endless spacetime... Even after so many years, only a few Eternal Eminences have been born.”
“Not even one in millions of Eighth Tribulation Eminences produces one?” Meng Chuan was somewhat dazed.
It’s that exaggerated?
“Eighth Tribulation Eminences are very rare as well,” said Daolord Evodia. “It takes us a long time to encounter one while roaming the Chaos. We are actually quite lonely; most of the time, we sleep for millions or even hundreds of millions of years.”
Meng Chuan thought about it and agreed.
The distance between universes was too great. Daolord Evodia had only explored 15 universes to date. Exploring a universe didn’t mean that one could see all the Eighth Tribulation Eminences that had been born in that particular universe’s history.
Some of those Eighth Tribulation Eminences roamed beyond their universes, some died, and some crossed this period of time and chose to appear in a temporal node a billion years in the future. Therefore, it wasn’t easy for an Eighth Tribulation Eminence to encounter another Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
It was indeed lonely.
“It’s very rare to meet an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, but it’s even harder to meet an Eternal existence,” said Daolord Evodia wistfully. “Therefore, I’m very lucky to be Master’s in-name disciple. It’s also a great opportunity for you; you have to grasp it.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
“Master has cultivated to the Eternal realm. The Dao of Painting, the Dao of the Sword... He is omniscient in many paths.” Daolord Evodia sighed. “Just by looking at my 19 paintings, he was inspired and created that six-stroke painting. To comprehend this painting mystic technique, the threshold is actually extremely high. Firstly, one has to be at the Seventh Tribulation realm and grasp an Origins law to comprehend it. Secondly, one has to have extraordinary perception. Thirdly—and most importantly—one has to have a pair of eyes that can paint worlds.”
A pair of eyes that can paint worlds?
Meng Chuan fell into deep thought.
“Master created this mystic technique by using the Dao of Painting to deconstruct all things.” Daolord Evodia continued, “If you want to gain insights into it, you first need to spend a long period of time using the art of painting to deconstruct all things. Only with this pair of eyes can you have a chance of learning this technique.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. He understood.
In fact, his past cultivation involved painting worlds. In fact, the Essence Soul formulation he created was the Painting World. He condensed a painting Essence Soul that reflected everything in the world.
He had already embarked on this path. As for the six-stroke runic seal, it was an extremely high achievement on this path. Only by accumulating enough insights on this path and having high perceptivity could he learn this formulation.
“Cultivators travel through the endless spacetime on rugged paths. There’s no such thing as undue favoritism,” said Daolord Evodia. “Eternal existences have extremely high requirements when choosing disciples. For example, you have to comprehend the Painting Dao mystic technique first before passing the test at Dry Origin Mountain. Only then will you be an in-name disciple.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
“In fact, it’s not bad to reach the Eighth Tribulation realm.” Daolord Evodia looked at the outside world. His speed in the spacetime tunnel was terrifying. Every moment, he traversed seemingly countless universes. “Although Eighth Tribulation Eminences have differences in strength, once one reaches the Eighth Tribulation realm, they will grasp the spacetime law. They will have all sorts of means. It’s very difficult to kill them at the same level.”
“It’s very difficult to kill?” Meng Chuan couldn’t help but say, “Our home universe has many Eighth Tribulation Eminences’ corpses.”
“Eighth Tribulation Eminences control spacetime. Even a drop of blood, a strand of hair, or even a book they personally wrote can be used as a mark to be reborn,” said Daolord Evodia. “Therefore, unless the strength difference between Eighth Tribulation Eminences is ridiculously great, they are unkillable.”
“What do you mean by ridiculously great?” asked Meng Chuan.
“Eighth Tribulation Eminences are also divided into the strong and weak. They can barely be divided into ordinary Eighth Tribulation Eminences, top Eighth Tribulation Eminences, and peak Eighth Tribulation Eminences,” said Daolord Evodia. “A peak Eighth Tribulation Eminence has truly reached their limits. Many of their means are already close to the Eternal realm. For example, they can open up or destroy a universe. It’s the case that if a living being below the Eternal realm hears their names, they can use this to revive. Any book that records their names can also be used for revival.”
“They can live just by remembering them?” Meng Chuan found it unbelievable.
“Therefore, only when Eternals make a move and destroy all traces of their existence in the endless spacetime such that the Eight Tribulation Eminence no longer exists in the memories of all living beings will they truly die,” said Daolord Evodia. “This is the limit of the Eighth Tribulation realm. Our home universe’s Dragon Ancestor is at this level. This is also why our home universe is famous everywhere.”
Meng Chuan was shocked.
It was no wonder that generations of Seventh Tribulation Eminences in his home universe knew very little about Eighth Tribulation Eminences. They didn’t know which Eighth Tribulation Eminences existed in history, but they vaguely believed that Dragon Ancestor was the strongest. No faction had ever refuted this claim.
“Only a peak Eighth Tribulation Eminence can kill an ordinary Eighth Tribulation Eminence,” said Daolord Evodia. “As long as one becomes a top Eighth Tribulation Eminence, their means will be even more brilliant. A peak Eighth Tribulation Eminence won’t be able to do anything to them. In our home universe, the famous Fiend Mountain owner and Eternal Tower owner are all top Eighth Tribulation Eminences. As for me...”
Meng Chuan looked at him curiously.
“I’ve only cultivated for a short period of time, and my perception is lacking. I’m still only an ordinary Eighth Tribulation Eminence.” Daolord Evodia sighed. “I’m really ashamed.”
Daolord Evodia is only an ordinary Eighth Tribulation Eminence? From the looks of it, it’s very difficult for an Eighth Tribulation Eminence to improve.
“Of course, I’m lucky to be Master’s disciple. I’ll only die of old age; it’s impossible for me to be killed.” Daolord Evodia smiled as he glanced at Meng Chuan. “Even if I die completely and all traces of me in the endless spacetime are wiped away, Master will be able to retrieve me from the spacetime.”
Meng Chuan was shocked when he heard that.
He can live despite that?
“It’s impossible to be killed once you are a disciple of an Eternal existence. This is also why many Eighth Tribulation Eminences are envious of us,” said Daolord Evodia as he looked into the distance. “Therefore, you have to pass the Dry Origin Mountain test.”

chapters.title: Chapter 721 - Eighth Tribulation Realms Lifespan
chapters.content:
Chapter 721: Eighth Tribulation Realm’s Lifespan
Whoosh!
Meng Chuan and Daolord Evodia continued advancing through the distorted spacetime tunnel.
I’m getting further and further away from my home universe.
Through his connection with his homeworld’s true body, Meng Chuan could sense that they were going further and further away. It was so far that it was difficult for him to estimate the distance. He only knew that it would be impossible for him to travel so far with his Seventh Tribulation strength, even if he traveled for ten billion years or even a trillion years.
“Daolord,” said Meng Chuan. “How much longer until we reach Dry Origin Mountain?”
“About an hour,” Daolord Evodia said. “Only by becoming Master’s disciple can I activate a spacetime tunnel that leads to Dry Origin Mountain, allowing me to arrive in slightly over an hour. If I weren’t Master’s disciple, I would need at least 300,000 years to reach Dry Origin Mountain from our home universe.”
“At least 300,000 years?” Meng Chuan was shocked.
An Eighth Tribulation Eminence needs 300,000 years just to travel there?
How many years was a Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s lifespan?
“Therefore, the Chaos is just too vast. It’s not easy to travel,” said Daolord Evodia. “We can only explore the nearby universes. It’s already impressive if we can explore dozens of universes. As for distant universes? There’s no way to explore them at all. This is because the journey will take too long. Time for Eighth Tribulation Eminences is very precious. After all, our lifespans are limited.”
Meng Chuan asked curiously, “How long can an Eighth Tribulation Eminence live?”
“An Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s lifespan doesn’t have a clear fixed number; it depends on one’s willpower,” explained Daolord Evodia. “Time is terrifying. Over time, one’s willpower will wear down and weaken.”
Meng Chuan fell into deep thought. The mind was like a mirror, one that needed to be wiped often.
“If it were just 200,000 to 300,000 years, one would have a goal in their cultivation. If they worked hard and advanced, their willpower would naturally improve. But even so, the closer they are to the Eighth Tribulation realm’s threshold, the harder it is for their willpower to improve,” said Daolord Evodia. “After reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm, it’s extremely difficult for one’s willpower to improve by even a tiny bit. Furthermore, one will discover that there’s no hope of ever reaching the Eternal realm. The difference is too great! Lastly, the lonely and comfortable days will gradually corrode one’s willpower.”
“It’s fine for a short period of time. But over long periods, one’s willpower will decline instead of advancing,” said Daolord Evodia. “When that happens, an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s willpower will regress, and their Essence Soul World will become weak. Once they are unable to withstand the laws of spacetime, their Essence Soul World will collapse... and they will die.”
“It’s the same for Physical Body Tribulation Eminences. As they cultivate, their bodies become stronger, making them powerful in all sorts of aspects. But once their willpower regresses, they won’t be able to control an Eighth Tribulation body. Instead, their consciousness will be completely crushed by their powerful bodies, turning them into corpses. Power that exceeds one’s willpower brings about destruction,” Daolord Evodia said.
Meng Chuan fell silent.
One’s willpower was like a blade. It needed constant tempering to be sharp. After a long period of peace, the blade would rust.
“For example, those Chaos creatures,” Daolord Evodia said. “They are rather special lifeforms. Their Life Cores are eternal, but their power comes from their innate talents. Their minds are too weak. After a long period of time, their consciousness will eventually decay and collapse. In the end, their Life Cores will give birth to new consciousness.
“An Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s consciousness won’t decay and collapse. But as long as it falls to the point of being unable to withstand their Essence Soul and body, they will die,” said Daolord Evodia. “Therefore, the lifespan of an Eighth Tribulation Eminence is uncertain. It depends purely on one’s willpower. In the face of endless time, no Eighth Tribulation Eminence can ensure that their willpower never regresses.
“That’s why Eternal existences are very mighty,” Daolord Evodia said. “Not only have they reached the apex of power, but their willpower has also reached the Eternal level.”
Meng Chuan nodded in understanding.
“Therefore, most Eighth Tribulation Eminences are in a deep slumber most of the time,” said Daolord Evodia with a smile. “This is because sleeping is the slowest when it comes to corroding one’s mind and will.”
Sleeping was another way to extend one’s lifespan.
Meng Chuan listened. He learned many secrets about Eighth Tribulation Eminences from Daolord Evodia. Eighth Tribulation Eminences typically couldn’t be bothered to tell Seventh Tribulation Eminences too much about these secrets.
