It was only because Meng Chuan had grasped the six-stroke runic seal mystic technique and obtained the opportunity to become an Eternal existence’s in-name disciple that Daolord Evodia thought so highly of him.
“Daolord,” asked Meng Chuan, “I know that there are three thresholds for the Eighth Tribulation realm in the Essence Soul lineage. The first threshold is the spacetime law, the second one is willpower, and the third threshold is the Tribulation Transcendence. Information regarding the Tribulation Transcendence can’t be found in my home universe. Do you know about it, Daolord?”
“Don’t ask, and don’t search,” Daolord Evodia said.
Meng Chuan was slightly stunned.
“Regarding the Essence Soul Eighth Heavenly Tribulation... I can only tell you that knowing about it in advance doesn’t give you any help. Instead, it will mess up your mental state. Therefore, the best way is not to investigate. When you are strong enough and have enough willpower, you can transcend the tribulation easily.”
“Thank you for your guidance, Daolord.” Meng Chuan fell into deep thought.
Since he knew that it was harmful and useless, there was no need to investigate. He had to grasp the laws of spacetime and have his willpower reach the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm’s threshold.
Whoosh~
As he advanced, they got closer and closer to Dry Origin Mountain.
“Dry Origin Mountain was created by Master to test cultivators,” Daolord Evodia said. “Normally, there are no cultivators there. Only Senior Brother Thousand-Hands is in charge of guarding it.”
“Senior Brother Thousand-Hands?” Meng Chuan looked at Daolord Evodia.
“Senior Brother Thousand-Hands is one of Master’s three servants. All the in-name disciples and even his eight personal disciples have to respectfully address him as Senior Brother Thousand-Hands,” explained Daolord Evodia. “Master’s three servants aren’t ordinary cultivators. They are special existences that Master paid a huge price to create. They have remained alive ever since they were created. All of them are comparable to peak Eighth Tribulation Eminences.”
Meng Chuan understood. They were similar to the Eye of Eternal—puppets.
“In-name disciples like us, and even personal disciples, will eventually die over time, but Senior Brother Thousand-Hands and the others will continue to live. Master is especially biased toward Senior Brother Thousand-Hands and the others,” Daolord Evodia said.
Meng Chuan nodded and asked, “Did you just say personal disciples?”
“The Eighth Tribulation Eminences that have entered Master’s tutelage are in-name disciples at the beginning. Only by cultivating to the limits of the Eighth Tribulation realm can they become personal disciples and receive Master’s careful guidance,” said Daolord Evodia. “Once they become personal disciples, Master will personally refine an entire set of Eternal treasures for them. In the endless spacetime, the personal disciples of Eternal existences have extremely high statuses. Even someone like Dragon Ancestor isn’t willing to provoke them.”
“Dragon Ancestor didn’t acknowledge an Eternal as his master?” asked Meng Chuan.
“No,” Daolord Evodia said. “Eternal existences take in disciples more based on luck than strength. They don’t necessarily accept disciples just because they are strong. Master only has a hundred or so in-name disciples.”
Meng Chuan understood that an Eternal’s acceptance of disciples depended on their preferences.
For example, an Eternal existence had left behind 3,000 illusory arrays in the black book. It required an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence to crack all 3,000 illusory arrays to become his disciple. Meng Chuan didn’t know how difficult these 3,000 illusory arrays were.
For example, the one that Daolord Evodia became a disciple to had taken him in purely on a whim. He left behind the six-stroke painting, and only those who could learn it was considered fated.
“We’re here.”
As they chatted, they finally arrived at Dry Origin Mountain.
Meng Chuan looked into the distance. A beautiful mountain appeared in front of him. It existed in the Chaos, but it made Meng Chuan instinctively desire it.
Whoosh.
Daolord Evodia led Meng Chuan through the invisible spacetime barrier and landed on the mountain.
At a glance, Meng Chuan saw a black-and-white beast sleeping soundly. It had eight claws, and six of them were hugging itself while two of its claws occasionally scratched its head.
“Senior Brother Thousand-Hands,” Daolord Evodia called out softly.
The black-and-white beast opened its eyes wide. Its round eyes were dazed as it looked around blankly. Only when it saw Daolord Evodia and Meng Chuan did it snap out of its reverie.
“Evodia, do you have anything to eat and drink?” asked the black-and-white beast lazily.
“Yes, yes, yes. I prepared it long ago.” Daolord Evodia waved his hand in a very practiced manner, having prepared many fragrant delicacies. Clearly, time stopped the moment he stored them.
When he took them out, they still tasted the best.
The black-and-white beast grinned happily and glanced at Meng Chuan. “You’re new. Didn’t you bring anything to eat or drink?”

chapters.title: Chapter 722 - Only Person on Dry Origin Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 722: Only Person on Dry Origin Mountain
Meng Chuan walked forward and waved his hand, releasing delicacies and fine wine. Meng Chuan had originally been cultivating on Holy Mountain of Painting for a long time, so he naturally prepared the delicacies and fine wine he liked. Some of them were even Archean Eon Realm specialties.
As for whether they suited Senior Thousand-Hands’s palate, Meng Chuan could do nothing about it. After all, Daolord Evodia hadn’t mentioned it in advance.
Daolord Evodia smiled as he watched this scene.
“Senior Thousand-Hands, I brought this from my homeworld. Try it,” said Meng Chuan humbly.
The black-and-white beast extended its eight claws. Some grabbed at the wine, while others grabbed at the plates of delicacies.
Gulp! Gulp! Gulp!
He took the food and wine that Meng Chuan had prepared. He first drank a mouthful of it before blinking his eyes and grinning. “This wine is really good.”
Meng Chuan heaved a sigh of relief.
This was fruit wine produced by Archean Eon Realm. It was slightly sour and sweet, and he felt a little tipsy after drinking it. Meng Chuan liked it quite a lot. Furthermore, he had added some rare treasures that aided his cultivation in the wine. The concoction suited his palate, and he would occasionally drink a few mouthfuls when painting.
The interior of the flask of wine was rather large. It was equivalent to a large wine jar that was as tall as a person. One flask lasted Meng Chuan for a few days. One flask was worth about 100 cubes, and he had prepared over 1,000 flasks for himself.
“Ten more flasks of this wine.” The black-and-white beast was quite satisfied with the wine; he clearly liked it. He could sense that Meng Chuan still had 1,000 flasks stashed away. To him, even if it was delicious, ten flasks were enough. He only wanted to try something new.
Meng Chuan naturally took out ten flasks.
Crunch! Crunch!
As he drank, he ate all sorts of delicacies. The black-and-white beast ate very quickly. At the same time, he glanced at Daolord Evodia and waved his hand. “Evodia, you can’t stay on Dry Origin Mountain for too long. Leave quickly.”
“Yes, I’ll leave now. Senior Brother Thousand-Hands, Meng Chuan is a young Seventh Tribulation Eminence from my home universe. Please take care of him,” said Daolord Evodia.
He had a natural affinity with Meng Chuan since they came from the same home universe and could become fellow disciples because of a painting. Daolord Evodia naturally wanted to help his prospective junior brother as much as possible.
The black-and-white beast nodded and continued eating.
“It’s up to you.” Daolord Evodia glanced at Meng Chuan. “I’ll be leaving first.”
“Thank you, Daolord.” Meng Chuan nodded to express his understanding.
Whoosh.
After Daolord Evodia left, only Meng Chuan remained by the side, watching Thousand-Hands eat and drink.
Thousand-Hands was completely immersed in eating and drinking; he enjoyed it very much. In ten minutes, he finished eating and drinking, leaving behind only ten flasks of alcohol—which he put away.
“Meng Chuan.” Thousand-Hands stood up.
“Senior Thousand-Hands.” Meng Chuan listened carefully.
Thousand-Hands said leisurely, “The mystic technique you learned means that you are fated with Master. The test at Dry Origin Mountain is very simple. There are 31 Chaos overlords imprisoned on Dry Origin Mountain! As long as you can kill one Chaos overlord without any treasures before the end of your lifespan, you will pass the test. When that happens, you will become Master’s disciple.”
Kill a Chaos overlord?
Meng Chuan’s expression changed slightly. He had experienced too much today, so his ability to accept new facts was considered very high. However, the test still placed immense pressure on him.
Chaos overlords were Eighth Tribulation forbidden creatures! He was forbidden from using any treasures to kill an Eighth Tribulation forbidden creature?
“Although these Chaos overlords can use many Eighth Tribulation moves, they are ultimately inferior to true Eighth Tribulation cultivators when it comes to controlling laws,” said Thousand-Hands. “As long as you reach the Eighth Tribulation realm, it won’t be difficult to kill one.”
“I understand,” replied Meng Chuan with a nod. However, he knew that it was very difficult. The number of Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminences born in his home universe’s River of Spacetime could be counted on one hand.
Meng Chuan wasn’t belittling himself, but he knew how difficult this path was.
“Oh, you are an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence. It’s somewhat difficult for you to reach the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm.” Thousand-Hands nodded slightly.
Meng Chuan didn’t say a word. No matter how difficult it was, he had to endure it.
“Don’t fret.” Thousand-Hands laughed, somewhat smug. “If it’s just for you to kill a Chaos overlord, there’s no need for you to come to Dry Origin Mountain. In the endless spacetime, there are plenty of Chaos overlords. You were made to come to Dry Origin Mountain because Master is benevolent. He wants to give fated people like you a boost in cultivation.”
“A boost in cultivation?” Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up.
A boost from an Eternal existence? It definitely won’t be trivial. What kind of boost will it be?
Meng Chuan didn’t feel any benefits when he arrived at Dry Origin Mountain. He only felt the time flow differently.
Dry Origin Mountain’s time flow was 33 times faster than his home universe.
33 years on Dry Origin Mountain was a year in his homeworld. However, it also depleted his lifespan; it wasn’t of much help.
“Dry Origin Mountain imprisons 31 Chaos overlords and 56,800 Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures,” said Thousand-Hands. “These Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures will be of help to your cultivation.”
Meng Chuan was shocked by the number of Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures. In order to gather Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature Life Cores, Fiend Mountain’s owner had spent a lot of effort to set up Chaos Turbid River. However, he still needed a long time to gather them slowly.
Dry Origin Mountain had over 50,000 Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures?
“Chaos creatures can devour matter. They can also devour life and make themselves become stronger. They can even commit fratricide by devouring other Chaos creatures,” said Thousand-Hands. “After devouring their kind, they can absorb the talents of the devoured Chaos creature, making them stronger.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
Forbidden creatures grew stronger by constantly eating. This was the envy of many cultivators.
“All existences’ laws are based on time and space. They can be comprehended and grasped,” said Thousand-Hands. “The devouring and strengthening of Chaos creatures is also a type of law. Master has already set the law on Dry Origin Mountain... Here, as long as one kills a Chaos creature, they can completely absorb the Chaos creature’s powers into themselves.
“Chaos creatures can only absorb a small portion of the devoured powers. The rules set by Master allow you to absorb the Chaos creatures fully as long as you kill them. Furthermore, what’s absorbed will be most suitable for yourself,” said Thousand-Hands. “This can allow you to have many talents, allowing your cultivation path to be much smoother. With your perception, the Paint Dao mystic technique, and the Chaos talents that Dry Origin Mountain gives you... you can only blame yourself for not being capable enough if you can’t reach the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm.”
Meng Chuan was pleasantly surprised.
With the Heaven Splitting Blade, his path toward the Heaven Splitting law became much smoother. If he killed Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures and obtained all sorts of talents, such as the time lineage talent, it would be much easier for him to comprehend the temporal law.
He was truly lucky to obtain an opportunity bestowed by an Eternal existence.
“Can I kill Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures at will?” asked Meng Chuan.
“Dream on.” Thousand-Hands shot a glance at Meng Chuan. “They are all Chaos creatures that were captured because they violated Master’s orders. There are only so many of them! They still have to be used as a ‘test’ for future fated juniors. You can only kill one Chaos creature every 5,000 years. You can only kill a maximum of ten Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures. You are not allowed to kill any more than that. You are only allowed to kill one Chaos overlord. If you kill one, you will pass the test. You will then have to leave Dry Origin Mountain to meet Master.”
Meng Chuan understood. Although there were some restrictions, it was still very good. This was indeed a great help to cultivation. Eternal existences were extraordinary in what they did.
“On account of the fine wine you served, I’ll give you another piece of intelligence. This is information on all the Chaos creatures that are imprisoned in Dry Origin Mountain.” Thousand-Hands waved his hand and threw out a golden plate. “Quickly read it; return it to me after reading it.”
Meng Chuan received it in delight. Sensing it with a thought, a vast amount of information surged into his mind.
“Thank you, Senior Thousand-Hands.” Meng Chuan memorized it and returned the golden plate.
“Those that irk me don’t get this intelligence. I get them to figure things out slowly.” Thousand-Hands smiled smugly, and his eyes turned round. “Alright, I’ll continue sleeping. Don’t wake me up before you pass the test.” He walked to his original position and lay down. His eight paws adjusted his posture as he hugged himself comfortably and continued sleeping.
Meng Chuan was somewhat glad.
Whether or not he gave him the intelligence depended on Thousand-Hand’s whims. Without intelligence, it was almost impossible to figure out the attributes of more than 50,000 forbidden creatures. Even if he fought them, it was very difficult to figure out everything about the forbidden creatures.
Furthermore, many forbidden creatures were too strange and difficult to deal with.
Dry Origin Mountain has 31 Chaos overlords. There are 569 peak Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures and 9,803 top Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures. There are also more than 40,000 ordinary Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures. Each creature has their own strengths.
Meng Chuan stood there and pondered over the intelligence for a long time, considering which Chaos creatures were suitable as targets. Wind blew from the mountain, causing Meng Chuan to wake up suddenly.
He looked at the silent Dry Origin Mountain.
Thousand-Hands was sleeping soundly. All the Chaos creatures had been sealed; they were in a state of Time Stillness.
In the entirety of Dry Origin Mountain... only he was lucid. For a very long foreseeable future, he would live here alone.

chapters.title: Chapter 723 - Black Fiend Halls Enemy
chapters.content:
Chapter 723: Black Fiend Hall’s Enemy
At a cave entrance on Dry Origin Mountain was a faint glow in the cave, which had its depths hardly perceptible. Meng Chuan flew to the cave entrance.
This is the entrance to the prison that imprisons the Chaos creatures?
Meng Chuan learned a lot of information from Thousand-Hands. He carefully read through the information before walking into the cave. Mountain Dry Origin was very friendly to cultivators like him. Apart from fighting Chaos creatures, there were no other dangers.
Meng Chuan entered the cave and entered a vast space; he had appeared in a dark-red void.
This is the prison?
Meng Chuan stood in midair and looked around.
The dark-red void was split into tens of thousands of spatial cells. Only one Chaos creature was imprisoned in each spatial cell.
The spatial cells also had their own rules. The highest level had 31 spatial cells, and each prison cell was extremely large. One could vaguely see the imprisoned creatures inside. All of them were Chaos overlords.
Chaos overlords?
Meng Chuan looked into the distance. Even though they had been sealed and time had stopped, these Chaos overlords were still alive. Meng Chuan instinctively felt panic and fear when he saw these lifeforms.
Among these Chaos overlords, the largest one was comparable to a river zone. Its body was like a miniature universe, and there were worlds on its surface. These worlds were currently in a state of nirvana.
The strangest Chaos overlord was a vast law. This was a law that had its own will; one couldn’t see its appearance with the naked eye. Meng Chuan learned from Thousand-Hands’s intelligence that this seemingly empty cell imprisoned a Chaos overlord formed from laws.
There was also a Chaos overlord that looked like a human. He sat cross-legged with his eight arms relaxed. He was only 1,000 feet tall...
Most Chaos overlords had terrifying bodies. They could even devour high-level worlds...
These Chaos overlords represented the most terrifying lifeforms beneath Eternals in endless spacetime.
They were no different from Eighth Tribulation Eminences in terms of vital characteristics. However, Eighth Tribulation Eminences completely controlled spacetime laws!
There are even more Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures.
Meng Chuan looked at the layers of spatial cells beneath the 31 spatial cells.
The further down one went, the smaller the spatial cells became. The Chaos creatures imprisoned there were also weaker.
For example, the Chaos overlords imprisoned at the highest levels were imprisoned despite having bodies the size of a river zone. This showed how large the spatial cell was.
I can fight some weaker Seventh Tribulation forbidden creatures.
Meng Chuan was filled with zeal. He could kill at most one in 5,000 years. He believed that his strength would definitely improve in 5,000 years. When the time came, he could obtain greater Chaos creature talents by killing a powerful one. He wasn’t in a hurry to kill one now.
During his normal cultivation, he could verify his insights through combat with the forbidden creatures.
Swoosh.
Meng Chuan transformed into a stream of light and flew toward one of the spatial cells at the bottom. Even in the lowest cells, there were Chaos creatures that had reached the Seventh Tribulation realm inside. They also possessed talent skills powered by Origins laws.
...
Dry Origin Mountain’s time flow was 33 times faster than his home universe’s. More than 90% of Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul Origins was on Dry Origin Mountain. He focused on cultivation and combat.
Black Fiend Hall headquarters.
“Li Rainbow, isn’t this City Lord Eastcalm too much? After becoming a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, he didn’t focus on cultivating. Instead, he targeted our Black Fiend Hall time and time again.” Hall Master Nightmare was also somewhat vexed. “As long as our Black Fiend Hall takes action on a large scale and wants to slaughter and plunder some prosperous places, City Lord Eastcalm will appear and take action. How can an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence have the cheek to attack Sixth and Fifth Tribulation Eminences?”
“He doesn’t have any of those qualms you mentioned during his repeated attacks.” Lord of Li Rainbow sat there with a handsome face as he calmly looked at a painting in front of him. The painting depicted the battle from before. Meng Chuan descended and appeared high in the sky above a planet. With a glance, a massive Black Fiend Hall cultivator team—from the Sixth Tribulation realm to Imperial Lords—died.
The further one cultivated, the greater the difference. In front of a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, Sixth Tribulation Eminences had no way of resisting.
Meng Chuan stopped Black Fiend Hall’s large-scale operations time and time again and wiped out many of Black Fiend Hall’s teams. Many Sixth Tribulation Eminences’ outer realm true bodies were killed, causing the entire Black Fiend Hall to be filled with complaints. However, the Sixth Tribulation Eminences from Black Fiend Hall could only grumble to Black Fiend Hall Master and Hall Master Nightmare in private.
“What should we do?” Hall Master Nightmare looked at his companion.
“What can we do?” Lord of Li Rainbow looked at the scroll indifferently. “I’m only a Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence. I can’t stop him. Are you going to stop him?”
“The moment he appears, the Black Fiend Hall team will be completely wiped out. It’ll be too late by the time I rush over.” Hall Master Nightmare shook his head. “Furthermore, I can’t stop him from slaughtering them.”
Lord of Li Rainbow nodded. He had fought Meng Chuan before, so he knew that Hall Master Nightmare couldn’t stop him.
The two fell silent.
What could they do? Eastcalm’s attitude was very clear. Although cultivation time was precious, Meng Chuan would immediately take action once he discovered Black Fiend Hall’s large-scale massacre.
“It’s really difficult to deal with an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence when they go crazy. Furthermore, he’s still so young.” Lord of Li Rainbow shook his head. “Let the people below scatter. From today onwards, stop the large-scale massacres and carry out scattered plundering operations en masse. In the entire River of Spacetime, there are countless scattered plundering operations. I’d like to know how a Seventh Tribulation Eminence can stop that.”
Every river system had plenty of plundering cases. It was uncountable when placed across the entire River of Spacetime.
Many people who had been plundered couldn’t seek help from Eternal Tower, so Meng Chuan naturally wouldn’t know about it. Even if he knew, he couldn’t stop countless plunders. After all, the universe was just too large.
“Split up and plunder?” Hall Master Nightmare frowned. “Eastcalm can’t stop us, but the gains will be too little.”
They earned a lot more by carrying out a massacre at a prosperous trading planet in a river system or one of the most prosperous places in a river zone.
They earned too little by plundering in scattered numbers.
“Do you have any way to deal with Eastcalm?” Lord of Li Rainbow looked at him. “He’s so young, and he can win any battle of attrition. Furthermore, it won’t be long before he becomes even more terrifying! Bear with it. Black Fiend Hall has been forced into hiding many times in history.”
Hall Master Nightmare was indeed helpless.
An Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence was very difficult to deal with. An Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence—who had only cultivated for 7,000 years—made everyone fear him. This was because they could predict that he would constantly become stronger, and his influence in the River of Spacetime would only increase.
Being in the same era as him, one had to learn how to coexist with him.
Black Fiend Hall’s means were ruthless. In the present era, there was Lord of Li Rainbow, an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence—Hall Master Nightmare—and legacy treasures... There were very few people that could make them feel fear. In fact, Black Fiend Hall had been unbridled in many eras in history. However, Black Fiend Hall had to endure when they encountered terrifying enemies that were at odds with them. In this era, they had encountered a powerful enemy, Meng Chuan!
...
Black Fiend Hall’s methods changed. They became much more low-key.
They split up into Black Fiend Hall teams and plundered the various river systems in the River of Spacetime. Although they still posed a huge threat, their destructive power had decreased by a whole order of magnitude! This was because the outer realm was too vast. If cultivators were careful, it wouldn’t be easy to plunder them. Even if they successfully plundered, many avatars didn’t carry any important treasures. Only the Supremacies suffered; they would die if they encountered them.
After all, Meng Chuan was but one person. This was all he could do.
The various factions in the River of Spacetime were also watching. Apart from finding trouble with Black Fiend Hall, Meng Chuan—an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence—didn’t participate in any other disputes. This made the top factions heave a sigh of relief.

chapters.title: Chapter 724 - Insatiable Desire
chapters.content:
Chapter 724: Insatiable Desire
In a dark hall.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star sat cross-legged, his eyes deep and unfathomable.
It’s becoming harder to choose a suitable middle-level world
, thought Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
Over the past few years, he had gotten used to sending Seventh Tribulation forbidden creatures to devour middle-level worlds and obtain the treasures accumulated in them. He could no longer stand the other ways of obtaining treasures in the River of Spacetime. That would be too slow. An entire life’s worth of harvests couldn’t even compare to the hundred-plus middle-level worlds he had devoured.
What he devoured weren’t ordinary middle-level inhabited worlds. He chose middle-level inhabited worlds that had produced Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
There are only a few old middle-level inhabited worlds that have produced Seventh Tribulation Eminences. After devouring over 100 of them, the various top factions have probably realized that something is amiss.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star also knew that nobody was a fool. Seventh Tribulation Eminences were even more so! Although he tried his best to conceal the matter, there were too many places that raised the alarm.
For example, there were only over one million medium-sized worlds that had produced Seventh Tribulation Eminences in the entire universe. They had extremely rich heritages. but it was very normal for one or two of them to decline after tens of thousands of years.
Over a hundred had declined over tens of thousands of years ago? This number was clearly abnormal.
Secondly, all living beings in the middle-level worlds that had declined had been wiped out! Logically speaking, Supremacies, Imperial Lords, and Tribulation Eminences could survive in the outer realm. It was very abnormal for all of them to be wiped out. Top factions would discover that something was amiss from a simple investigation.
Although the various factions don’t have sufficient evidence to prove that I did it, they will have their guesses.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was very calm.
Since everyone has their guesses, I’ll do a big one!
His desires grew.
At his cultivation realm, he needed astonishing amounts of treasures if he wanted to rely on external help.
Too many treasures would’ve been expended in a declining world. There’s too little left. Furthermore, I’ve already chosen the ones that are declining. I’ll choose the younger ones amongst those that haven’t declined.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star finally couldn’t help but attack the young inhabited worlds after devouring 100-plus declining middle-level worlds.
This is it—Deer Celestial Realm. It has only been ten million years since a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence died. Most of the treasures are probably still intact.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s eyes were cold.
This inhabited world is comparable to dozens of the other worlds.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had yet to create an Eighth Tribulation body formulation. He had seen an Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s corpse and knew how terrifying an Eighth Tribulation body was—it was like a miniature universe! Creating a physical body formulation was much harder than creating a miniature universe.
A Physical Body Eighth Tribulation Eminence had a lower willpower requirement than an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence. They only needed to withstand the tribulation with their bodies, but creating a physical body formulation was too difficult. Among the many half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences, only one in dozens could create an Eighth Tribulation body.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star knew very well that... In history, he wasn’t very dazzling when it came to half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences. His current progress in the physical body formulation made him understand that he probably wouldn’t be able to create a complete formulation by the end of his life!
Since he didn’t want to die in such an abject state, he would risk it! He would use countless treasures and resources to pave his path to the Eighth Tribulation realm.
How good would it be if Hall Lord White Avian didn’t exist in this era?
If not for Hall Lord White Avian, the other Seventh Tribulation Eminences would have unknowingly fallen for my schemes.
...
Half a month later.
The dark hall silently arrived at North Celestial River Zone, where Deer Celestial Realm was located. Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was in the dark hall, watching Deer Celestial Realm from afar.
A massive creature opened its mouth and devoured Deer Celestial Realm completely.
The strongest expert in Deer Celestial Realm was at the Fifth Tribulation realm! His true body in his homeworld died instantly. His true body in the outer realm was also personally attacked by Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
My homeworld.
The Fifth Tribulation Eminence’s eyes widened in anger. But when Celestial Thearch Myriad Star attacked, spacetime in the region where the Fifth Tribulation Eminence’s true body was located was isolated. He was annihilated before he could send out any news.
Whoosh~
“Celestial Thearch.”
The black-robed figure followed his perception of the Life Core and easily arrived at the dark hall to meet Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
“There are all the treasures in Deer Celestial Realm.” The black-robed figure respectfully handed over a pagoda, his eyes burning. “Celestial Thearch, when will you take action next?”
The middle-level world he devoured was very young and delicious; it made him feel stronger.
“There’s no rush.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star flipped his hand and took out an ancient, damaged cup. “Have a rest.”
The black-robed figure didn’t dare disobey as he transformed into a stream of light and flew into the incomplete wine cup.
This harvest...
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star looked at the treasures in the pagoda. After checking them, his eyes couldn’t help but light up.
They are comparable to 30% of what I’ve accumulated over the years! The worlds that have a recently dead half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence have plenty of treasures.
I’ve accumulated enough. I can offer another sacrifice.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was excited about his harvest, but he knew that devouring a declining world and a young world would cause a different reaction in the other factions.
I’ll wait and see what the various factions’ reactions are.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s eyes were cold. He was confident that the various factions were only making guesses at most. They didn’t have complete evidence that he had taken action.
...
In front of a bamboo forest lake.
Realm Ancestor sat in front of the lake and fished. He looked at the countless spacetime scenes in the lake. Inhabited worlds appeared in various spacetime regions.
All the inhabited worlds that had produced half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences were under surveillance.
Whoosh.
Realm Ancestor was fishing when he looked at one spot. His expression changed slightly.
Deer Celestial Realm?
The spacetime around Deer Celestial Realm was suddenly isolated. He could no longer observe or head over.
Even I can’t see it? It’s him again?
Realm Ancestor’s expression was solemn. With his attainments in spacetime and the lake treasure, only the two half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences could hide the spacetime around Deer Celestial Realm from him.
Soon, the area of spacetime returned to normal. However, Deer Celestial Realm had vanished! The void it had been in was empty.
Nothing was left.
Deer Celestial Realm is gone. This is a very young inhabited world that was born only a billion years ago.
His desires are getting greater and greater. As he gets closer to the end of his lifespan, his desires will become more and more terrifying.
Realm Ancestor’s expression was cold. At the same time, his Essence Soul avatars investigated through many channels. The three current Tribulation Eminences in Deer Celestial Realm, including the Fifth Tribulation Eminence, were all dead.
...
As a newly-advanced Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, Meng Chuan led a very peaceful life.
He had previously been targeting Black Fiend Hall. However, after Black Fiend Hall silently abandoned all large-scale massacres, Meng Chuan became even more free. He focused all his attention on cultivation.
Heaven Splitting!
Meng Chuan had an Essence Soul avatar in front of Holy Mountain of Painting. He continued painting the Heaven Splitting Painting.
He used the six-stroke runic seal mystic technique to observe spacetime. He could see Clear Spring Island extremely clearly.
When he cultivated elsewhere, he felt like a mortal looking at a lake from afar. He felt that the lake was as flat as a mirror. But cultivating on Clear Spring Island was like a mortal standing by a lake and looking at it nearby. He could see faint ripples on the surface of the lake.
Clear Spring Island allowed Meng Chuan to use the six-stroke Seal Art to clearly observe the spacetime circulation and the Heaven Splitting law.
Therefore, he painted!
He could pry into the profundities of the Heaven Splitting law from the Eternal treasure seal. He could also paint it!
The paintings on Holy Mountain of Painting also had a Heaven Splitting law painting. He had also copied it!
With the six-stroke runic seal—a mystic technique that allowed him to view everything—his cultivation speed was much faster. His Heaven Splitting law improved rapidly, allowing him to advance by leaps and bounds... Meng Chuan felt that if this continued, he might be able to grasp the Heaven Splitting law in one go.
“Meng Chuan.” A message came.
Realm Ancestor.
Meng Chuan stopped cultivating. He still respected Realm Ancestor very much.
“Tomorrow, I will invite all my friends to a gathering at Nebula Palace. Please come,” said Realm Ancestor.
Meng Chuan was shocked.
Realm Ancestor is inviting friends from all over?
“Definitely,” replied Meng Chuan without any hesitation.

chapters.title: Chapter 725 - Gathering of this Era
chapters.content:
Chapter 725: Gathering of this Era
In a garden in Nebula Palace, Seventh Tribulation Eminences and half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences arrived one after another. Everyone was somewhat shocked by the scale of this gathering.
“How many Seventh Tribulation Eminences and half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences did Realm Ancestor invite this time?”
“Could Realm Ancestor have invited everyone?”
“Mysteries Lord has a grudge with Realm Ancestor, yet he’s here?”
The seats in the garden seemed to be randomly arranged. There were seats here and there, a total of 108 seats. In reality, they were filled with profundities. After the Seventh Tribulation Eminences and half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences arrived, they took their seats one by one.
The half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences very consciously chose seats at the periphery. Everyone chatted casually, and the atmosphere was rather harmonious. They were all true peak existences in the River of Spacetime. It was rare for them to have such a huge gathering.
Everyone was in a good mood.
“Eastcalm.”
“Brother Eastcalm.”
“City Lord Eastcalm.” When Meng Chuan arrived, many half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences and Seventh Tribulation Eminences took the initiative to chat with him. After all, they believed that Meng Chuan would be an influential figure in the River of Spacetime in the future. At the very least, he would be comparable to Origin Realm Chieftain.
Meng Chuan saw Hall Lord White Avian, Lord of Shadowfiend, and Hall Lord Azure Dragon. Their gazes met, and Meng Chuan immediately walked over and sat close to them.
“Have a seat.” Hall Lord White Avian gestured for Meng Chuan to sit. He instructed via voice transmission,
“Watch and listen more later.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
Something could be read from the distribution of the factions in the seating arrangement.
On White Avian Hall’s side, Hall Lord White Avian, Lord of Shadowfiend, Meng Chuan, Lord of Shadows, Palace Lord Food God, and Lord of the East Abyss were present.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had arrived early this time. The old farmer-like Celestial Thearch Myriad Star sat there like an old farmer in his orchard. Five other Celestial Thearchs gathered around him, as well as some good friends who were closer to him.
Ancestral Magus King, Palace Lord Medicine, Windthunder Walker, Palace Lady Blood Phoenix, and other top Seventh Tribulation Eminences had also arrived. Ordinary Seventh Tribulation Eminences arrived one after another. Almost everyone was here.
Instead, half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences arrived a little late. They were still gradually arriving.
“That many?”
“From the looks of it, this gathering isn’t ordinary.” The half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences that arrived later felt their hearts tighten when they saw this. It was already impressive to invite a dozen or two of these people to an ordinary gathering. After all, time was very precious at such a realm!
Even if Realm Ancestor’s prestige was high, he wouldn’t casually disturb the cultivation of Seventh Tribulation Eminences. There had to be something important for him to invite so many people.
As Meng Chuan sat there, he realized how special this gathering was.
What does Realm Ancestor want?
Meng Chuan was puzzled.
“Hahaha... I’m actually the last to arrive among the Seventh Tribulation Eminences.” Origin Realm Chieftain walked in with a chuckle. He glanced at Celestial Thearch Myriad Star and Hall Lord White Avian before calmly walking to a spot and sitting down. His seat vaguely formed a triangle with Myriad Star Heaven and Hall Lord White Avian.
All the Seventh Tribulation Eminences are here.
Meng Chuan, Origin Realm Chieftain, and many other Eminences were shocked.
Seventh Tribulation Eminences had different personalities.
For example, Palace Lord Medicine, Peach Mountain Owner, Guild Master Fiend Eye, and company couldn’t be bothered with what happened in the world. Therefore, it wasn’t easy to invite all Seventh Tribulation Eminences here.
Realm Ancestor was sitting in a corner, chatting with Manor Lord Centaurea. He looked around and wasn’t anxious at all.
After a while, as the Eminences chatted, nearly 90% of the half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences had arrived. Meng Chuan could sense that a storm was brewing.
Huh?
Meng Chuan sensed something and watched the white-haired Realm Ancestor stand up.
At that moment, all Seventh Tribulation Eminences and half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences looked over. They looked at the person who had convened them—Realm Ancestor!
In the entire River of Spacetime, all the Seventh Tribulation Eminences in this era had gathered. Nearly 90% of them were half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences... With so many of them, they could already decide all the matters in the River of Spacetime.
Just based on Realm Ancestor’s reputation, it’s impossible for all Seventh Tribulation Eminences to arrive. After all, some of them are his enemies. There must be some inside information that I don’t know,
thought Meng Chuan.
“Everyone.” After Realm Ancestor stood up, his gaze swept across the Eminences. “I got my friends to help me gather everyone here today because of an extremely important matter.”
Everyone present listened.
“The River of Spacetime is vast; there are countless middle-level worlds,” said Realm Ancestor. “However, there are very few middle-level worlds that have produced Seventh Tribulation Eminences. Since the universe was born, there have only been a million of them.”
Some Seventh Tribulation Eminences present—such as Manor Lord Centaurea, Lord of Li Rainbow, Guild Master Fiend Eye, and company—had solemn expressions.
For example, Origin Realm Chieftain, Lord of Shadows, Meng Chuan, and company—who had cultivated for a shorter period of time—were still somewhat puzzled.
Hall Lord White Avian glanced at the distant Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star continued wearing a smile as he listened to Realm Ancestor.
“A Seventh Tribulation Eminence can increase the heritage of their homeworld and slow down the decline of their world,” said Realm Ancestor. “Therefore, in the entire River of Spacetime, only one or two Seventh Tribulation Eminences’ homeworlds will decline and collapse after tens of thousands of years. But in the past 35,000 years, 132 Seventh Tribulation Eminences’ homeworlds have been destroyed, completely vanishing from the universe.”
“132?”
How is that possible?
“132 in tens of thousands of years? It’s impossible for that to be a normal decline!”
There was an uproar.
Meng Chuan was shocked when he heard that.
“There’s Lanxi Realm, Dark Cauldron Realm, Zhan Cloud Realm...” As Realm Ancestor spoke, he waved his hand. The names of 132 medium-sized worlds appeared in front of him. Given the Eminences present, they were able to verify Realm Ancestor’s words with a simple investigation.
“Furthermore, when these inhabited worlds were destroyed, all the living beings in their worlds—including Supremacies, Imperial Lords, and even Tribulation Eminences—died. No one was found alive,” said Realm Ancestor.
Everyone was silenced!
Everyone present was certain of this.
When a normal world declined, Supremacies, Imperial Lords, and Supremacies were likely capable of surviving.
All living beings in the 132 worlds were wiped out, with no survivors. It was clearly very strange.
“Deer Celestial Realm was destroyed as well?” Fiend Eye’s expression changed slightly when he saw the names of the destroyed worlds. “The first 131 worlds were all declining worlds. They weren’t too far from destruction, but Deer Celestial Realm is a very young inhabited world. It’s the homeworld of a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence, Palace Lord Deer Celestial. It was born a little over a billion years ago.”
“That’s right; it’s a very young world.” Realm Ancestor nodded. “It was still destroyed. None of the living beings, including a Fifth Tribulation Eminence, survived.”
“A Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature that can destroy a middle-level world?”
“What kind of forbidden creature managed to destroy more than 100 medium-sized worlds?”
The people present were all the upper echelons and leaders of the various factions. However, their lifespans were ultimately limited. They were far from comparable to Seventh Tribulation forbidden creatures! Once they died of old age, their homeworld could become a meal for Seventh Tribulation forbidden creatures. They naturally couldn’t allow such matters to continue.
“We have to get rid of this forbidden creature. It being alive spells a calamity for countless worlds.”
“Senior Realm Ancestor, have you found out which Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature it is?”
The half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences couldn’t help but say this. Some Seventh Tribulation Eminences spoke up as well. Instead, Manor Lord Centaurea, Lord of Li Rainbow, and company fell silent.
“I’ve already found the true culprit who destroyed more than 100 middle-level worlds.” Realm Ancestor pointed at Celestial Thearch Myriad Star. “It’s him—Celestial Thearch Myriad Star!”
Everyone fell silent.
All the existences present had different expressions. They either expected it or found it unbelievable. All of them had their own thoughts as they looked at Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
“Myriad Star, I didn’t wrong you, right?” Realm Ancestor looked at Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.

chapters.title: Chapter 726 - Sacrifice
chapters.content:
Chapter 726: Sacrifice
When Meng Chuan saw this scene, he could sense that many Seventh Tribulation Eminences were very calm. It was as though they had long known about it.
He’s even more ruthless than the two hall masters of Black Fiend Hall.
Origin Realm Chieftain stared at Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
I’ve underestimated him.
“Realm Ancestor.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star sat there calmly and smiled calmly. “I’ve always respected you all these years, but you have truly disappointed me this time. You maligned me without any evidence.”
“You know very well if I’m slandering you.” Realm Ancestor looked at Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
“I’ve also noticed that over 100 middle-level worlds have been destroyed in the past tens of thousands of years. It’s indeed very abnormal,” said Celestial Thearch Myriad Star. “Those that can devour middle-level worlds are naturally Seventh Tribulation forbidden creatures. Perhaps a ferocious Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature was born in our River of Spacetime. Perhaps its talents make it difficult for us to probe it, thereby allowing it to devour over 100 middle-level worlds.
“As all of you know, there are strong and weak Seventh Tribulation forbidden creatures. The strongest can use Eighth Tribulation attacks. Hence, it’s very normal for them to hide from Hall Lord White Avian and me,” said Celestial Thearch Myriad Star solemnly. “Now, the most important thing is to find this forbidden creature. It’s not for us Tribulation Eminences to doubt each other.”
“Doubt?” Realm Ancestor shook his head and said, “Those destroyed worlds had spacetime concealed, so even I couldn’t pry into them. Among the current Tribulation Eminences, only you and Hall Lord White Avian can do this.”
“It’s not me. I believe it’s not Hall Lord White Avian either,” said Celestial Thearch Myriad Star. “It should be that forbidden creature. Its means are too brilliant; its spacetime abilities are in no way inferior to an Eighth Tribulation Eminence.”
“How rare is a Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature? Furthermore, it happens to have an Eighth Tribulation move that can conceal spacetime. Such a forbidden creature hasn’t been recorded in the history of our River of Spacetime,” said Realm Ancestor coldly.
“Perhaps it is a coincidence,” said Celestial Thearch Myriad Star with a faint smile. “Realm Ancestor, you can’t judge what you haven’t seen.”
“I’ve tried, but I couldn’t see the past or the scenes of those worlds being devoured,” said Hall Lord White Avian.
“I’ve also investigated it, but I was unable to see into the past. That forbidden creature’s ability to conceal spacetime is clearly in no way inferior to ours,” said Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
Hall Lord White Avian looked at Celestial Thearch Myriad Star. “However, Realm Ancestor and I discovered that when the hundred-plus middle-level worlds were destroyed... Myriad Star, your outer realm true body was always missing.”
“Missing?” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s brows pricked up.
“When those inhabited worlds were destroyed, we couldn’t find your outer realm true body,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “It’s impossible for you to be hiding your tracks all the time, but there happens to be such a coincidence. Whenever the 100-plus middle-level inhabited worlds were devoured, your outer realm true body would disappear.”
“Perhaps you disappeared during those periods as well?” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star looked at Hall Lord White Avian.
“I dare to swear to all Seventh Tribulation Eminences and half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences that I didn’t hide my location when the 100-plus inhabited worlds were devoured. Furthermore, all of this has nothing to do with me. Do you dare to make the oath?” The thin Hall Lord White Avian looked at Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star fell silent.
It wasn’t a big deal to lie when speaking normally. Sometimes, a lie could be a white lie. However, important promises or oaths involved karma! The greater the karma involved, the more one didn’t dare to make promises and swear oaths easily.
A promise had to be fulfilled, and an oath couldn’t be violated. Violation would result in karmic repercussions. To Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star—who both had ambitions of reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm—it was equivalent to destroying their future in cultivation.
“White Avian, I’m not like you,” said Celestial Thearch Myriad Star coldly. “I won’t easily swear an oath.”
“This matter has huge ramifications on the entire River of Spacetime. If you have a clear conscience, why don’t you swear an oath to make everyone believe you?” asked Hall Lord White Avian.
“Ridiculous.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star sneered.
“Myriad Star,” said Realm Ancestor. “Over 100 middle-level worlds have been destroyed, and they have had spacetime concealed. Among the current Tribulation Eminences, only you and Hall Lord White Avian can do it. Hall Lord White Avian has sworn an oath, but you don’t dare to do so. Furthermore, your outer realm true body also disappeared every time a middle-level world was destroyed. Such a coincidence happened over 100 times in a row? Do you really think we are fools?”
“These are all your single-sided claims.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star shook his head.
“There’s me too.” Hall Lord White Avian looked at him. “I can also confirm the veracity of Realm Ancestor’s words.”
“It’s only the two of you.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star stood up and said indifferently, “One is close to the end of his lifespan and doesn’t care about karma. The other is my only opponent in the entire River of Spacetime. White Avian Hall and Six Directions Heaven have indeed fought for many years, but to use such means to slander me. Even roping in Realm Ancestor—who is nearing the end of his lifespan—to slander me... White Avian, I hate your guts.”
“No matter what you say, you don’t dare to swear an oath.” Hall Lord White Avian looked at him.
“After reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm, nobody has the right to make me swear an oath.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star snorted coldly before dissipating and leaving Nebula Palace.
After Celestial Thearch Myriad Star left, the embodiments of Six Directions Heaven’s other five Celestial Thearchs, Guild Master Darkstar, and several Seventh Tribulation Eminences—who were on good terms with Celestial Thearch Myriad Star—dissipated.
“As expected, he refused to admit it.”
The white-haired Realm Ancestor’s eyes were cold.
“At the very least, we’ve revealed his true colors to everyone in the River of Spacetime,”
said Hall Lord White Avian via voice transmission.
“If he doesn’t admit it, all Seventh Tribulation Eminences and half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences can naturally make their judgment.”
Realm Ancestor and Hall Lord White Avian hadn’t planned on making it public. However, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s attack on Deer Celestial Realm had agitated them.
If he dared to attack a young world that had once produced a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence, what world wouldn’t he dare to attack?
Realm Ancestor’s homeworld after his death?
What about Hall Lord White Avian’s homeworld if he were to die from serious injuries?
The greater his desires were, the crazier Celestial Thearch Myriad Star became as he approached the end of his life. They naturally had to mobilize the entire River of Spacetime to deter him; they even hoped that a faction would inform the Eighth Tribulation Eminence behind them and have an Eighth Tribulation Eminence descend to kill Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
“Do you think an Eighth Tribulation Eminence will descend?”
asked Realm Ancestor via voice transmission.
“There are only a few people in this era who have the right to contact an Eighth Tribulation Eminence,”
said Hall Lord White Avian via voice transmission.
“Let’s wait and see.”
There were disputes in every era. It was impossible to awaken an Eight Tribulation Eminence whenever a monster appeared every era.
For example, although there were Eighth Tribulation Eminences in high-level worlds, Eighth Tribulation Eminences left behind rules for their awakening. Otherwise, ordinary matters—such as the death of a Sixth Tribulation Eminence in a high-level world—weren’t sufficient to awaken an Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
To an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, crossing over hundreds of millions of years in one go... Among the countless events that had happened in the past hundreds of millions of years... a scourge like Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was probably not in the top ten.
It would only be terrifying in a certain era when there was only one half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence, who was completely invincible when wreaking havoc.
...
In a dark hall.
Realm Ancestor and White Avian revealed the truth to the entire River of Spacetime.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s eyes were cold.
But so what if those Seventh Tribulation Eminences guessed it? What can they do to me?
Those that are truly threatening are the ones who can contact an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. However, Eighth Tribulation Eminences... won’t descend easily. What’s a matter like mine in history?
Although Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was somewhat nervous, he still had to take a gamble for his cultivation.
He believed that his luck wasn’t that bad. Furthermore, he had made many preparations in advance.
I’ll sacrifice once more to stabilize the situation.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star stood up immediately and silently cast a mystic technique.
Whoosh.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s power spread out and condensed into countless mystic runes in front of him.
These countless mystic runes formed a blurry figure, and this blurry figure had an evil aura that shocked even Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
He’s here.
The blurry figure began to materialize as a tall, thin figure with two curved horns in the dark hall. Endless sins and evil began to spread in the dark hall, causing Celestial Thearch Myriad Star to bow immediately. Although he had met several Eighth Tribulation Eminences over the years, this person... was the most terrifying person he had come into contact with.
This existence was also the most sinful existence in the River of Spacetime’s history.
“Black Fiend Progenitor.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star bowed respectfully.

chapters.title: Chapter 727 - Temptation and Breakthrough
chapters.content:
Chapter 727: Temptation and Breakthrough
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star didn’t dare show any disrespect to Black Fiend Progenitor.
Black Fiend Progenitor was a famous Eighth Tribulation Eminence in the River of Spacetime. He had refined two legacy treasures—Black Fiend Hall and Nightmare Hall. To a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, these two treasures were comparable to Eternal treasures. Just by looking at the treasures he refined, one could tell how unfathomable Black Fiend Progenitor was.
The Black Fiend Hall faction had wreaked havoc in the River of Spacetime for many years; the other Eighth Tribulation Eminences could only endure it.
On the one hand, Dragon Ancestor felt that an appropriate threat was beneficial to the growth of Tribulation Eminences. He only restrained them and didn’t completely destroy Black Fiend Hall. On the other hand, Black Fiend Progenitor was too powerful. He, Eternal Tower’s owner, Fiend Mountain’s owner, Phoenix Ancestor, and a few others had already progressed greatly in the Eighth Tribulation realm. They could be considered top Eighth Tribulation Eminences.
At this point, it was impossible for Dragon Ancestor to destroy Black Fiend Progenitor in a one-on-one battle. To destroy a top Eighth Tribulation Eminence... Dragon Ancestor needed to call on his friends and pay a huge price. Even so, he might not succeed.
Therefore, people like Black Fiend Progenitor and Fiend Mountain’s owner had the right to be willful. As long as it wasn’t something akin to flipping a table, the other Eighth Tribulation Eminences would try their best to tolerate it.
“You woke me up again?” Black Fiend Progenitor’s eyes seemed to contain billions of worlds.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star didn’t dare to meet his gaze as he said respectfully, “Black Fiend Progenitor, I’ve prepared enough treasures.”
Black Fiend Progenitor looked at him.
“Progenitor, please take a look.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star respectfully offered a pagoda that contained the countless treasures he had prepared.
Black Fiend Progenitor waved his hand, and the pagoda landed in his hand. He revealed a smile, one that affected the surrounding spacetime.
Even though Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had his head lowered, he couldn’t help but feel delighted. However, he felt even more afraid.
The last time I looked him in the eye, my body distorted and transformed into a nightmare creature. This time, I don’t even dare to look at him, yet he can still affect my mind?
It wasn’t that he had never seen an Eighth Tribulation Eminence before. He had interacted with several Eighth Tribulation Eminences, and he could talk and laugh freely with the other Eighth Tribulation Eminences. He wasn’t affected when looking at them directly. After all, he was a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence who had grasped the temporal law and the spatial law.
Only Black Fiend Progenitor was an exception! The pressure he exerted on him was too great! However, the benefits that Black Fiend Progenitor could give him were also the greatest.
“Very good.” Black Fiend Progenitor inspected the treasures in the pagoda and nodded in satisfaction. “It’s worth about three billion cubes.”
It was just like how Fiend Mountain’s owner had left behind a method to summon him: Gather 1,000 Sixth Tribulation forbidden creature Life Cores or 10 Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature Life Cores and one could seek an audience with Fiend Mountain’s owner.
Black Fiend Progenitor had left behind a similar method, but he had higher requirements. Three billion cubes was the sacrificial threshold if one wanted to meet him. If one disturbed him without gathering enough treasures, they would be courting death.
Black Fiend Hall had been plundering the entire River of Spacetime for a long time. The lower-ranking members could split the benefits. The current Black Fiend Hall Master and Hall Master Nightmare could also split the benefits. They split the benefits layer by layer, but every time, a portion of them would ultimately be paid to Black Fiend Hall’s treasure vault. Black Fiend Progenitor would wake up after a long interval to harvest Black Fiend Hall’s treasures.
“Tell me, what do you want in exchange?” Black Fiend Progenitor stood there as an illusory book appeared.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had read this book last time.
Most of the recordings in the book were formulations, mystic techniques, and other knowledge. This was because knowledge didn’t cost much to Black Fiend Progenitor. Very few of them were rare treasures, and the true value of these treasures was far lower than three billion cubes.
They might only be worth a few hundred million cubes, but they were things Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had no way of coming into contact with.
“I want the second volume of the Eternal formulation, Bloodline.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star didn’t hesitate at all. He had long wanted this volume.
Black Fiend Progenitor tapped gently, and a black beam flew into Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s glabella.
The knowledge was transmitted.
Black Fiend Progenitor was most willing to peddle knowledge. These were things that he had already grasped, which was why he could impart them personally. There was no price to pay, and it could be said to be a zero capital sale. Ordinary Eighth Tribulation Eminences might not be able to learn a complete Eternal legacy. Even if they learned it, they wouldn’t be able to impart it unless they completely grasped it.
“You still have one billion cubes available for exchange. What else do you want?” asked Black Fiend Progenitor.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star sensed the vast contents of the Bloodline Art’s second volume. Some of the questions he had regarding the first volume were answered in the second volume.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star suppressed his desire to study the newfound knowledge and immediately said, “Black Fiend Progenitor, the situation is unfavorable for me in this era. An Eighth Tribulation Eminence might want to deal with me. Progenitor, can you teach me how to stay alive?”
“I won’t participate in your conflict,” said Black Fiend Progenitor indifferently. “As for preserving your life, I’ll help you if necessary.”
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was somewhat disappointed. During the first sacrifice, Black Fiend Progenitor hoped that this ‘tool’ that collected treasures for him would live longer. Thus, he had already imparted many means to him.
However, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star still felt somewhat uneasy after Realm Ancestor exposed him. After all, no matter how invincible he was in the current era... he would still be flustered if an Eighth Tribulation Eminence were to take action.
“Do you want to exchange for that using the remaining one billion cubes?” Black Fiend Progenitor asked again.
“I’ll save it for now; I’ll exchange again next time.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had the willpower to do so. His goal was to exchange for the nine volumes of the Eternal formulation, Bloodline. It was said that these nine volumes explained all the secrets of a bloodline.
For example, he had learned a portion of the secrets behind how forbidden creatures became powerful from devouring in the first volume. As a result, his strength had increased significantly.
Black Fiend Progenitor rather liked Celestial Thearch Myriad Star, who only exchanged for formulations—he was a good ‘tool.’ Hence, he immediately said, “You have made two sacrifices. I have a treasure up for exchange, which I can make an exception for you. I once killed a Chaos overlord who controlled blood and obtained a drop of Origins Blood. As long as you consume this drop of Origins Blood, it can transform your body and nearly raise it to the Eighth Tribulation realm. You have already grasped the laws of time and space. Your consciousness won’t be warped, so you will be able to control such a body.”
“A body close to the Eighth Tribulation realm?” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s eyes lit up.
“With this, your strength will increase greatly, and you will be able to deal with danger,” said Black Fiend Progenitor. “Furthermore, you can use it as your foundation to create a body formulation that perfectly suits you. Your chances of reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm will also increase.”
It sounded nice.
In fact, this was a shortcut. He was allowing the overlord’s Origins Blood to distort himself and make himself become closer to a Chaos overlord. His body could indeed reach the Eighth Tribulation realm, but to create a physical body formulation with this? The probability was still very low.
If he only had a one percent chance of success prior to using the Chaos overlord’s drop of Origins Blood, then he only had a two to three percent chance of creating a physical body formulation after.
Black Fiend Progenitor did this mainly because he hoped that this ‘tool’ could live longer. Many things weren’t suitable for Eighth Tribulation Eminences to do, but cultivators of these eras were suitable to do them.
“How much will I need to exchange for it?” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s heart burned with fervor as he asked immediately. He wasn’t willing to give up the chance to experience a body that was close to the Eighth Tribulation realm.
“Five billion cubes,” said Black Fiend Progenitor.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star secretly felt his head ache—this was a number that made his heart palpitate. He had cultivated for so many years, but other than his own expenditure, he had only sacrificed twice after devouring so many middle-level worlds. Including the one billion cubes he had saved this time... he still needed four billion cubes.
A total of ten billion cubes for all three times!
“After obtaining this Origins Blood, you will be much stronger than you are now. Your chances of reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm will also be higher,” said Black Fiend Progenitor leisurely. He could tell that Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was feeling uneasy. After all, this was the first time he had attacked a young middle-level world, and he had been exposed.
Black Fiend Progenitor didn’t wish for Celestial Thearch Myriad Star to restrain himself. He hoped that Celestial Thearch Myriad Star would be even greedier and crazier... As for Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s outcome, he didn’t care.
What he cared about was whether the treasures would ultimately be sacrificed to him.
It couldn’t be helped! Even as an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, he was very concerned about treasures.
Even someone as powerful as Dragon Ancestor had to think of ways to collect treasures in his home universe and the endless spacetime. He was publicly acknowledged to be the richest person in this universe. Even when viewed from other universes, his wealth made other Eighth Tribulation Eminences extremely envious.
It was very difficult for other Eighth Tribulation Eminences to extend their influences to other universes. They would be boycotted by the other native Eighth Tribulation Eminences in that particular universe. Only someone as powerful as Dragon Ancestor could forcefully infiltrate other universes despite their resistance.
For example, Fiend Mountain’s owner had worked hard to set up the Chaos Turbid River to constantly lure Seventh Tribulation forbidden creatures in. He would wake up periodically to harvest them.
Eternal Tower and Black Fiend Hall had transactions all over the River of Spacetime. One earned a transaction fee with every transaction, while the other plundered the River of Spacetime. They had different ways of earning treasures.
Only with enough treasures could one go further on the path of cultivation.
Everyone knew that the treasures of middle-level and high-level worlds were the greatest. They were also the greatest treasure troves in the entire universe! However, the inhabited worlds were a soft spot for many in the universe.
Countless lives were born in the inhabited worlds, and the universe did its best to protect every inhabited world. Eighth Tribulation Eminences were born in this universe; everything that promoted their growth originated from this universe, so they owed their universe great karma.
Their actions might be righteous or evil, but they couldn’t shake this universe’s foundation. If they hit a soft spot of their universe, they would be abandoned by their home universe while staying indebted to it. Karma would plague them, and they would be in big trouble.
However, it was different for those below the Eighth Tribulation realm.
Those below the Eighth Tribulation realm didn’t jump out of the River of Spacetime, so they were a part of the River of Spacetime. No matter how they fought and plundered, they were still a part of the River of Spacetime.
Black Fiend Progenitor was currently baiting Celestial Thearch Myriad Star. Of course, he was just a casual chess piece of Black Fiend Progenitor. Although traveling through endless spacetime was difficult and earning treasures wasn’t easy, what Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had sacrificed... was nothing significant to Black Fiend Progenitor. He only offered a drop of Origins Blood to attract Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
After the transaction ended, Black Fiend Progenitor’s figure dissipated.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star stood there and pondered for a long time.
...
In the following days, the River of Spacetime remained peaceful and calm. Celestial Thearch Myriad Star didn’t immediately destroy inhabited worlds, nor did an Eighth Tribulation Eminence descend to deal with him. However, all the factions could sense the turbulent undercurrents beneath the calm.
In a wooden hut on the distant Dry Origin Mountain.
Meng Chuan was painting. He was usually the only one awake on Dry Origin Mountain, and he was also very lonely. He could only focus on cultivation and combat.
After grasping the six-stroke mystic technique, painting was a form of cultivation for him.
The painting in front of him was painted with black light. The ink gathered into terrifying black light.
Rumble~
This black beam of light seemed to slice through everything. The terrifying fluctuations could affect the outside world, but it was completely restrained in the wooden hut.
Meng Chuan revealed a smile.
I’ve been here for more than 2,000 years. Today, I’ve finally comprehended the Heaven Splitting law.
He had cultivated for 2,000 years at Dry Origin Mountain, but only 68 years had passed in his home universe. After all, the time flow difference between the two places was very great.

chapters.title: Chapter 728 - Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Array
chapters.content:
Chapter 728: Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Array
Meng Chuan walked out of the wooden hut and looked at the scenery of Dry Origin Mountain.
On this Dry Origin Mountain that contained many mysteries, he was the only living being that was awake. Nobody noticed that he had comprehended the Heaven Splitting law.
In the distance, Thousand-Hands’s eight paws were hugging himself as he slept. His breathing was rhythmic.
That’s right. I’ve only comprehended a new Origins law. I haven’t even comprehended the spacetime law, so what’s there to be excited about?
Meng Chuan thought to himself. Only by becoming an Eighth Tribulation Eminence and killing a Chaos overlord could he pass the test and become an Eternal existence’s disciple. His accomplishments were still far from anything stunning.
Meng Chuan walked through Dry Origin Mountain and pondered.
Since I’ve comprehended the Chaos Hole law and the Heaven Splitting law, I need to improve many mystic techniques so that I can kill a more powerful Seventh Tribulation Chaos creature.
Meng Chuan knew very well that killing a Chaos creature was his greatest opportunity here at Dry Origin Mountain. He could completely devour and absorb a Chaos creature, forming a talent that was most compatible with him.
A powerful talent was too beneficial to his cultivation. The Heaven Splitting law was an example.
Meng Chuan had never really seen Heaven Splitting before! Despite eating the fruit and seeing Dragon Ancestor and others opening up universes, those scenes were still very different from personally witnessing a universe’s creation.
However, Meng Chuan had grasped the Heaven Splitting law in 2,000 years thanks to his talent in Heaven Splitting Blade and the six-stroke runic seal.
This speed was astonishing. After all, the Heaven Splitting law was famous for being difficult to comprehend.
With the two opposing Origins laws as a foundation, I can directly comprehend the temporal law
, thought Meng Chuan.
Therefore, the Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures I should kill have to be very good at the spacetime lineage. I’ll ignore Chaos overlords for the time being. Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures are divided into three levels.
A peak Seventh Tribulation Chaos creature has grown to the peak of the Seventh Tribulation realm. It already has some Eighth Tribulation moves, but it hasn’t transformed into an Eighth Tribulation lifeform. At this level, one has to grasp the complete spacetime law to deal with such a Chaos creature! I’ll have to be a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence at least.
Meng Chuan had long received intelligence from Thousand-Hands, so he knew that he didn’t need to consider peak Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures before reaching the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm.
A top Seventh Tribulation Eminence is needed to kill a top Seventh Tribulation Chaos creature. Even so, success isn’t guaranteed.
Ordinary Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures can be killed if ordinary Seventh Tribulation Eminences are lucky.
Meng Chuan also understood that there was a prerequisite behind this intelligence. All Chaos creatures were imprisoned; there was no way for their Life Cores to escape.
If they were in the outside world, the difficulty of killing Chaos creatures would increase by more than ten-fold if they could use all their fleeing techniques. After all, the Life Cores of Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures had already been conceptualized. Defeating them and killing them were two completely different things.
In other words, every single spatial cell on Dry Origin Mountain imprisoned a Chaos creature. The Chaos creatures were unable to escape and could only be slaughtered.
There are 9,803 top Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures, and there are 63 of them that dominate the spacetime lineage. The one most suitable for me is a snake-shaped Chaos creature that is good at the Spacetime Loop.
Meng Chuan eyed this target.
Top Chaos creatures at the Seventh Tribulation realm grew step by step from being weak. Typically, they had many talent moves. For example, Bark, which had fought Meng Chuan, had many talent moves—poison, blood, world, spacetime, and so on. However, it couldn’t reach the strength of a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence by relying on spacetime alone.
Meng Chuan chose Chaos creatures that were purely of the spacetime lineage.
These Chaos creatures were typically born in special environments that gave rise to such talent. Coupled with their years of growth and various fortuitous encounters, they focused on this path.
Very few creatures on Dry Origin Mountain met Meng Chuan’s requirements.
I’ve just broken through. I have to consolidate my foundation before dealing with it.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged on a boulder near a cliff. In front of him was the endless fog that surrounded Dry Origin Mountain.
Facing the fog, Meng Chuan sat cross-legged on a boulder and began studying the array formation.
...
Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminences had powerful bodies. They could unleash terrifying strength in close combat.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul attacks were relatively weaker. However, an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s advantage was their powerful Essence Soul. They suited the setting up of array formations.
Meng Chuan had read many ultimate techniques in White Avian Hall. The array formation ultimate technique he had spent the most effort on was the Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array. This was an ultimate technique created by an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
With the Chaos Hole lineage as the catalyst, he could fuse more laws into it. He could even fuse the laws of spacetime into it, allowing him to power a terrifying Eighth Tribulation array formation.
With the Chaos Hole law as his foundation and the opposing Heaven Splitting law, Meng Chuan could naturally study the array formation more deeply.
He studied it, but it wasn’t just regurgitation! At Meng Chuan’s level, he would draw upon the experiences of his predecessors and ultimately walk his own path.
When Meng Chuan previously used the Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array, he had fused it with the Heaven Splitting Blade. Back then, he didn’t know much about the Heaven Splitting law, so it was very difficult for the Heaven Splitting Blade to fuse with the array formation. Now, it was much easier for him to do so.
With the Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array as a foundation, he spent most of his time studying the book left behind by the Eternal existence, Three Thousand Illusory Arrays. He drew on his array formation experience and used the mystic technique—six-stroke runic seal—to construct the array formation he wanted, Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Array.
The Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Array was a variant built upon the Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array’s foundation. This variant was most suitable for Meng Chuan.
He cultivated for more than 100 years.
My Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Array can be considered as having some initial success.
Meng Chuan stood in front of the wooden hut’s drawing table and looked at the Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Array he had drawn.
He nodded in satisfaction.
I can deal with that snake now.
Meng Chuan continued holding his brush as he sent an Essence Soul avatar toward the prison that imprisoned the Chaos creatures.
He was also prepared to fail. If he failed, he could send his Essence Soul avatar to challenge it again.
Meng Chuan lowered his head and continued painting and cultivating.
...
In the dark-red void.
Meng Chuan arrived. This place was split into many spatial cells on many different levels.
The cells at the top were filled with imprisoned Chaos overlords. Meng Chuan flew to the third level and arrived in front of one of the 9,000-plus spatial cells.
What a large snake.
Meng Chuan looked at his target through the spatial cell.
In the spatial cell, the snake was unimaginably large. Its winding body spread across more than half of the spatial cell.
With Meng Chuan’s perception, he guessed that the snake was half the size of his homeworld’s Three Bay River System! Although it was far inferior to the Chaos overlords—who were comparable to a river zone in size—it still shocked Meng Chuan greatly.
Every snake scale was much larger than a Supreme Yang Star or Supreme Yin Star.
As it was imprisoned, this was its true size. If it was a life-and-death battle, it would naturally change its size depending on the enemy.
It’s considered big even among Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures.
Meng Chuan sensed that the snake scales contained the profundities of spacetime. When he looked at it with the naked eye, he felt spacetime distort, gradually forming a closed loop.
After looking at it for a long time, Meng Chuan shook his head gently.
My attainments in spacetime are far inferior to it. Its body naturally reveals the profundities of endless spacetime.
Meng Chuan began to feel excited. The greater his opponent’s spacetime talent was, the better!
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan took a step forward and flew into the spatial cell without any obstruction.
Meng Chuan could sense that time returned to normal the moment he entered the cell.
The snake—which had spread across more than half of the spatial cell—opened its eyes and looked at Meng Chuan.
Just by opening its eyes, Meng Chuan realized that spacetime had distorted—he could no longer see the snake.

chapters.title: Chapter 729 - Ouroboros, Spacetime Loop
chapters.content:
Chapter 729: Ouroboros, Spacetime Loop
As an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World enveloped his surroundings.
After grasping the opposing Origins law and drawing upon the Three Thousand Illusory Arrays’ experience to reconstruct his Essence Soul World, his Essence Soul World’s strength had also increased drastically, allowing it to suppress the surrounding spacetime. Although the snake had grasped attacks that controlled spacetime and had a wide range, the five billion-kilometer area around Meng Chuan remained peaceful.
Cultivator.
With a thought, the snake hiding in the spacetime maze stared at Meng Chuan and created a spacetime maze, its killing intent extremely intense.
After violating the Eternal existence’s ban and getting captured and brought to Dry Origin Mountain, the Eternal existence’s word was law. The rules set by the Eternal existence made all imprisoned Chaos creatures only know one thing—kill the cultivators at all costs.
