Therefore, the moment the snake saw Meng Chuan, it didn’t hesitate to attack. It was surprised to discover that a large array formation had already appeared around Meng Chuan.
The array formation was vast; the Dark Chaos Holes devoured even light. A thousand Chaos Holes floated around Meng Chuan and suppressed the spacetime maze, causing the entire spacetime maze to turn much darker.
After grasping the Chaos Hole law and the opposing Heaven Splitting law and cultivating for more than a century, Meng Chuan’s Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array’s realm had increased greatly.
He could now maintain 1,000 Dark Chaos Holes at the same time. Although they were all small Chaos Holes, their combined strength was still extremely terrifying.
If he encountered Lord of Li Rainbow again, he could easily crush him with the array formation.
Huh?
Meng Chuan stood in the void as more than 1,000 Dark Chaos Holes floated around him. Suddenly, a huge celestial body appeared!
The massive celestial body crashed down, and its size far exceeded the range of Meng Chuan’s Origins domain—19 trillion kilometers. If it appeared in the outer realm, it would probably crush countless stars.
In the depths of Meng Chuan’s eyes was the six-stroke runic seal. Only then did he realize that this celestial body was actually the end of the large snake’s tail.
The six-stroke runic seal was a mystic technique created by an Eternal existence; it allowed him to see the essence of everything.
The tail tip was too large, and it traversed spacetime too quickly. It instantly struck Meng Chuan’s Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array.
Boom!
The 1,000 Dark Chaos Holes acted upon each other as they got pulled, crushed, scattered, and devoured by the external impact.
The impact was easily absorbed. Although many Dark Chaos Holes were fluctuating due to the impact, the array formation was extremely stable.
Bam! Bam! Bam!
The tip of the tail transformed into a phantom. The time flow around it was different from the time flow Meng Chuan experienced. In the blink of an eye, the massive tail had struck 37,800 times. Every strike was extremely terrifying.
Over 30,000 strikes was enough to threaten a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
Although Meng Chuan’s time flow was a hundred-fold slower than his opponent’s, the Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array was adaptive. The Chaos Holes pulled, twisted, scattered, and devoured... Everything happened naturally. The Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array was known for its stability. The snake couldn’t break the array formation with its powerful body.
Growl—
In the next moment, the tip of the tail vanished as an even larger snake head appeared. The snake head and open mouth could probably devour half of Three Bay River System in one mouthful.
One mouthful!
Meng Chuan and the Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array were devoured by the snake.
Interesting.
Meng Chuan didn’t panic at all after being devoured and swallowed into the snake’s belly—he had the Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array. At most, he would have an Essence Soul avatar destroyed. The more powerful the snake was, the more excited Meng Chuan became.
Looking at the dark snake’s body, Meng Chuan had a thought:
Heaven Splitting Saber Array of the Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Array.
With a thought, the array formation changed!
The 1,000 Dark Chaos Holes floating in all directions already had very condensed cores. But as Meng Chuan guided and transformed them, each Dark Chaos Hole condensed again, forming a dazzling blade.
The blade was unimaginably blinding. The Dark Chaos Hole’s power completely gathered as one, forming a Heaven Splitting Blade.
A thousand Dark Chaos Holes transformed into 1,000 dazzling blades that floated in all directions.
Every blade was condensed from a Chaos Hole, and they were terrifyingly powerful. It wasn’t like how Meng Chuan only knew how to unleash brute force with his talent! Now, his strength had perfectly fused with the 1,000 blades. They didn’t suffer any leakage and were like real blades.
Whoosh!
In the Heaven Splitting Saber Array, 1,000 Heaven Splitting Sabers circled Meng Chuan. They easily sliced through the layers of spacetime around the snake’s throat and flesh.
Under the protection of the 1,000 Heaven Splitting Blades, Meng Chuan flew out of the gaping hole in the snake’s flesh. The snake’s flesh couldn’t stop him at all.
When using 1,000 Chaos Holes, one could withstand heavy attacks with their stability.
A thousand Heaven Splitting Sabers gathered the saber forces under the array formation, but they were all indestructible. Wherever the array formation passed, everything was reduced to dust.
This was also the first of the Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Array’s three transformations that Meng Chuan had comprehended using the Three Thousand Illusory Arrays and the Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array through the Eternal Painting Dao mystic technique—six-stroke runic seal—with the opposing Origins laws as his foundation!
Each transformation had its own strengths.
His strength was ultimately limited after comprehending a law. Thus, Meng Chuan had to infuse a suitable mystic technique to unleash sufficient strength.
For example, Palace Lord Skylight had created the Chaos Hole Fist with the Chaos Hole law. It had the might of a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence. With the Chaos Hole law and other Origin laws, he had created an improved mystic technique—Skylight Fist. It was invincible for an era. One punch could defeat a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
This was the importance of mystic techniques. A powerful mystic technique could drastically increase one’s combat strength.
Later generations also comprehended the Chaos Hole law and other Origin laws, but none of them mastered the Skylight Fist.
Meng Chuan didn’t learn from others. Instead, he used the six-stroke runic seal mystic technique to observe all sorts of things. He drew upon the wisdom of his seniors and created an array formation that was most suitable for him.
Meng Chuan admitted that the Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Array he had just created might not be comparable to the Skylight Fist, but it was considered among the most powerful mystic techniques among top Seventh Tribulation mystic techniques.
This cultivator’s array formation.
The snake felt intense pain in its body. It immediately took the initiative to split its body in two, allowing Meng Chuan to come out.
The two halves then merged once again.
Whoosh.
The snake’s body rapidly shrank until it was only 50 billion kilometers long. When it shrank, it had already wrapped itself around the Heaven Splitting Saber Array that Meng Chuan had set up.
The Heaven Splitting Saber Array was extremely sharp, but the snake’s body became much tougher after it shrank to such a size. The Heaven Splitting Saber Array only managed to slice through the scales and slice off a lot of flesh. However, the spacetime changes around the snake’s body instantly restored it to its peak state.
On one side, scales and flesh flew as the Heaven Splitting Saber Array sliced down. On the other side, the snake’s body remained in peak condition.
The massive snake coiled around the array formation as it tried its best to restrain it.
The coiled snake’s might became terrifying. It had already affected the array formation’s stability, causing Meng Chuan to frown slightly.
Split!
The 1,000 Heaven Splitting Sabers immediately split into three saber streams. Each saber stream sliced through a portion of the huge snake’s body.
After all, Meng Chuan was only fighting with an Essence Soul avatar. His own safety wasn’t that important. Therefore, the three Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Array variations that he created in a short period of time were all offensive moves. This move was also the most thorough attack of the Heaven Splitting Saber Array. He completely abandoned his defense and transformed into three saber streams to kill his enemies.
Whoosh.
Under the three saber streams, the three parts of the snake’s body—which had been coiled together with all its might—were sliced apart. The moment the saber streams sliced down, they constantly destroyed the snake’s body. They wanted to take advantage of the snake’s weak resistance to destroy its body completely.
Bam!
The snake’s remnant body immediately exploded as it fled into the spacetime maze.
This cultivator is indeed powerful. I can only use the Spacetime Loop.
The snake used spacetime to recover to its peak. It couldn’t afford to die in the spatial cell because its Life Core was sealed. Once this true body died, the cultivator could instantly obtain its Life Core. Therefore, it was indeed much easier to kill Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures in the spatial cell.
...
Meng Chuan didn’t necessarily have to kill the snake successfully the first time he fought it. The first battle was more important for him to figure out the opponent’s background. He could attack the snake in a more targeted manner the next time.
Although he had obtained intelligence about the snake, the intelligence was only written. Furthermore, it only recorded a so-called Spacetime Loop. In the intelligence records of Dry Origin Mountain, this was clearly the only move that was valued.
Huh?
A thousand Heaven Splitting Blades floated in all directions as Meng Chuan looked up.
From afar, a towering serpent appeared. In the distance, the snake’s massive body formed a ring as the snake head bit the snake tail.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
After forming a ring, a blood fog rose. Countless snake scale patterns lit up as the huge snake ring transformed into a dark hole. It produced a terrifying suction force, causing all energy and objects in the spatial cell to fall into it.
Meng Chuan immediately turned the Heaven Splitting Sabers into Chaos Holes. The Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array protected his surroundings, but he still couldn’t resist it. In an instant, he fell into the endless darkness formed by the snake ring.
At that moment, information regarding the snake surfaced in Meng Chuan’s mind. It was from the information he had obtained from Dry Origin Mountain—Ouroborus, Spacetime Loop, Heaven Earth Devouring, the Restart of the Universe!

chapters.title: Chapter 730 - Slaughter
chapters.content:
Chapter 730: Slaughter
There were 63 top Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures of the spacetime lineage imprisoned at Dry Origin Mountain. Meng Chuan had targeted the snake because he had seen its information regarding the Spacetime Loop.
Spacetime Loop: Ability to devour the heavens and the earth. After devouring everything into the Spacetime Loop... a large explosion will follow! The Big Bang that occurs in the Spacetime Loop is akin to the restart of the universe!
The snake’s enemies might still be able to survive if they were swallowed into the Spacetime Loop, but very few could withstand a Big Bang that was akin to the restart of a universe.
Meng Chuan was immediately tempted when he saw the Spacetime Loop’s introduction.
The Spacetime Loop’s devouring was very similar to the Chaos Hole law, while the Big Bang that restarted the universe was very similar to the Heaven Splitting law.
The snake did all of this not because of the Chaos Hole law’s or the Heaven Splitting law’s profundity, but because of the Spacetime Loop.
Everything in endless spacetime was built upon the laws of time and space! The combination of the laws of time and space could form everything, including the many profound means of Eternal existences. However, this path was also very arduous. Many Eighth Tribulation Eminences were studying it with great difficulty and constantly scaling the cliff with spacetime as their foundation.
The Spacetime Loop had the effects of Chaos Hole and Heaven Splitting. Meng Chuan felt that it would definitely be of great help to his cultivation once he grasped this talent.
Boom!
Ouroboros, Spacetime Loop—the complete devouring of everything.
All the energy in the spatial cell, including Meng Chuan—who was protected by more than 1,000 Chaos Holes—couldn’t resist falling into it.
I’ve been devoured. Meng Chuan felt his surroundings twist and turn chaotic. Countless energy streams were sucked in, which crazily spun and condensed. He couldn’t control his body and could only flow along with the vortex.
The first transformation—Heaven-Opening Saber Array—of the Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Array is useless. The second transformation, Saber Prison Abyss, is not suitable for the current situation. My only option is the third transformation. Meng Chuan was in no rush to attack. The Spacetime Loop—which was in the devouring state—was the most stable. He needed to wait until it was most suitable for him to attack.
Deep in the Spacetime Loop, Meng Chuan sank deeper and deeper into the vortex.
The vortex suddenly condensed to a certain limit and began to erupt in reverse!
Big Bang—the restarting of a universe!
Boom!
Meng Chuan—who had been sucked into the middle of the vortex—felt an endless, terrifying explosion!
This explosion wanted to destroy all life in the Spacetime Loop.
This is the moment! Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up.
The Spacetime Loop in its Big Bang state was most terrifying, but it was also the most unstable. This was because the Spacetime Loop needed to withstand the explosive impact within.
The 1,000 Dark Chaos Holes around Meng Chuan instantly gathered. Every ten Chaos Holes instantly condensed into a new large Chaos Hole, and ten of the new Chaos Holes fused into one... In an instant, more than 1,000 Chaos Holes had completely fused into one!
Chaos Holes could indeed devour each other, but a person required extremely high attainments in array formations to instantly fuse more than 1,000 Chaos Holes into one.
Boom!
The final super-large Dark Chaos Hole had reached the limit of Meng Chuan’s control. At this moment, Meng Chuan controlled it with all his might and transformed it into an incomparably large, dazzling saber beam.
Previously, when the 1,000 Chaos Holes was simultaneously transformed into 1,000 Heaven Splitting Blades, Meng Chuan could still maintain the might of each Heaven Splitting Blade and control it with all his heart. However, it was difficult to control this super-large Chaos Hole. The saber beam that took form was difficult to control... It only transformed into a dazzling saber beam.
Light!
An extremely dazzling light!
Let the universe restart! In parallel to the Spacetime Loop’s Big Bang, Meng Chuan delivered his strongest attack.
The third transformation of the Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Array—Single Slash Heaven Splitting Chaos Split!
Rumble!
The Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Array—which was created with the opposing Origins laws as its foundation—might not be as good as Palace Lord Skylight’s Skylight Fist, but it was definitely extremely powerful among top Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
In terms of strength, the Single Slash Heaven Splitting Chaos Split was comparable to the snake’s Spacetime Loop. The Big Bang inside the Spacetime Loop exploded in all directions, causing the entire Spacetime Loop to withstand the explosive force in every corner. Even so, it could still withstand it.
Meng Chuan’s terrifying strike slashed in one direction.
The pressure on the Spacetime Loop was already considerably immense when it suffered a terrifying strike that wasn’t inferior to the Big Bang. Furthermore, it was directed in a single direction.
Although the Spacetime Loop was extremely flexible and warped as it resisted the attack with all its might, it eventually exploded.
Boom!
An incomparably dazzling saber beam and the Big Bang exploded in the Spacetime Loop. The two equally powerful moves clashed and spread in all directions.
The shockwave was so powerful that Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar—who didn’t have an array formation protecting him—couldn’t resist it. It couldn’t be helped; Meng Chuan had used all his strength to unleash the Chaos Hole Array’s third transformation. He didn’t even divert his attention to protect himself. In the face of the shockwave, Meng Chuan even took the initiative to dissipate the Essence Soul avatar.
“No!” When Ouroboros used the Spacetime Loop, it also sensed that the explosion in the Spacetime Loop had exceeded its limits. Its eyes were filled with anger and indignation.
Boom!
In the explosion, the Spacetime Loop collapsed, and its entire body was naturally destroyed.
Swoosh.
As the snake exploded and was destroyed, another black-robed, white-haired man instantly flew in from outside the spatial cell.
Life Core. The moment the snake’s true body was destroyed, another of Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars discovered the Life Core imprisoned in the spatial cell. He took a step and arrived in front of the Life Core.
The Life Core was a black snake-shaped bracelet.
The black snake-shaped bracelet floated there, imprisoned by the spatial cell.
This was the relatively easy part about killing Chaos creatures on Dry Origin Mountain. Their Life Cores had already been sealed, making it impossible for them to escape. As long as one successfully killed a Chaos creature’s true body once, they could immediately seize the opportunity to capture the Life Core.
Under Dry Origin Mountain’s suppression, the Chaos creature’s true body was destroyed once. It would take time for it to revive using its Life Core.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan reached out and grabbed the black snake-shaped bracelet.
The bracelet was a little cold. The moment it was gripped, it was affected by the invisible laws. The black snake-shaped bracelet disintegrated like sand and dissipated into the void.
Huh? The moment the black snake-shaped bracelet disintegrated, Meng Chuan felt a mysterious force surge into his body from his palm and then seeped into his Essence Soul.
At this moment, Meng Chuan felt his Essence Soul become intoxicated.
Perfect devouring? Meng Chuan guessed.
Chaos creatures could eat worlds and other lifeforms to become stronger! However, they could only devour and absorb a portion. But on Dry Origin Mountain, there were laws set by an Eternal existence! Killing Chaos creatures here allowed one to perfectly devour them and form a talent that was most suitable for them. This devouring and conversion efficiency had already exceeded Chaos creatures’ instincts.
Although Meng Chuan felt inebriated, he still flew out of the spatial cell. After he flew out, the empty spatial cell quietly disappeared.
One prisoner corresponded to a cell.
Since the prisoner had been killed, the cell naturally vanished.
...
As Meng Chuan walked on Dry Origin Mountain, he felt his Essence Soul becoming increasingly tipsy. He sat down before laying himself down.
Laying in the forest, Meng Chuan looked at the trees. He closed his eyes and carefully experienced his Essence Soul’s transformation.

chapters.title: Chapter 731 - Devoured Talent
chapters.content:
Chapter 731: Devoured Talent
Meng Chuan could sense that his Essence Soul composition gradually changed after the mysterious power seeped into it.
Everything in the universe—be it a drop of water, a blade of grass, a powerful cultivator, or a mysterious Eternal treasure—was composed of countless leptons. By following a particular direction laid out by the study of leptons, one could form the Matter law. By taking another direction, one could form the Immeasurable law...
If one reached the Eternal realm of omniscience, they could use leptons to create any treasure or living being. For example, they could create an Eternal treasure with countless leptons. they could also create an existence similar to Senior Brother Thousand-Hands.
Of course, the difficulty of creating different things was completely different.
Just like how mortals knew how to build houses, the difficulty of building a thatched hut was naturally different from building a hundred-story building. It was the same for Eternal existences. They could construct countless items with lepton, but creating an Eternal treasure required astonishing effort. Eternal existences would rather obtain precious materials from distant spacetime to refine an Eternal treasure. After all, it was very difficult to create an Eternal treasure from nothing.
The composition of leptons was filled with endless confusion for Eighth Tribulation Eminences. Meng Chuan naturally didn’t understand it. However, the slight changes in his Essence Soul affected Meng Chuan.
This is?
Meng Chuan opened his eyes and looked around in shock.
The originally beautiful mountain forest distorted and changed, becoming unreal.
Why did the world I sensed change?
Although Meng Chuan was shocked, he remained calm. He knew that everything was possible when his Essence Soul changed.
The opportunities on Dry Origin Mountain are determined by an Eternal existence. A perfect devouring shouldn’t result in any latent problems.
Whoosh!
Whether Meng Chuan had his eyes opened or closed, his perception of his surroundings became increasingly distorted.
The vegetation in front of him distorted as the space around them warped. Everything looked extremely bizarre.
Meng Chuan waited patiently. Two hours, four hours, six hours...
What he sensed became more and more exaggerated.
Everything was completely blurry.
Meng Chuan couldn’t see anything clearly. He only felt that everything was distorted Chaos.
Boom!
Twelve hours later, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul rumbled. His consciousness completely jumped out of the distorted Chaos and into a wider dimension.
Meng Chuan could see Dry Origin Mountain clearly again. But this time, he stood at a higher level and saw the time flow of Dry Origin Mountain. He saw the next moment, the next, next moment, etc. He also saw the previous scene, the previous, previous scene of Dry Origin Mountain, etc.
Different lifeforms viewed worlds differently. Some lifeforms saw the world as black and white in their eyes, while others saw them as colorful worlds.
Some lifeforms could see normal spaces, but some lifeforms could see layers of different spatial levels. They were born with the ability to travel through the void.
As for some lifeforms, they could clearly see time through their eyes—it was no different from mortals being able to see sunlight and rain. These lifeforms could also clearly see time.
Time was no longer a concept, but a corporeal existence.
That snake is a Chaos creature that’s purely skilled in the spacetime lineage. Perhaps in its eyes, the flow of time is corporeal—something clearly visible. Only after I grasped the six-stroke runic seal mystic technique did I have the right to come to Dry Origin Mountain and obtain this opportunity. With this opportunity, my chances of comprehending the temporal law are much greater.
Meng Chuan was rather excited, but he still knew that there was a long way to reach the Eighth Tribulation realm.
Among Chaos creatures, many had spacetime talents, but how many could become a Chaos overlord? How many could cross the threshold of talent and completely grasp the laws of spacetime?
Even if he could grasp the laws of spacetime, he was still far from reaching the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm... Out of the hundreds of half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences, only one could reach the Eighth Tribulation realm.
Perhaps it’s because an Eternal existence knows how difficult it is to reach the Eighth Tribulation realm that he bestowed such an opportunity.
Eternal existences could help disciples, but the disciples had to rely on themselves for cultivation.
For instance, Daolord Evodia was an Eighth Tribulation Eminence before he became a disciple. He still remained an ordinary Eighth Tribulation Eminence despite becoming a disciple.
The transformation is complete.
Meng Chuan viewed his Essence Soul World.
In the depths of his Essence Soul World was a huge, floating black ring. It devoured everything but remained extremely stable. It had already become an important node in his Essence Soul World, causing it to become even vaster and stabler.
It’s very similar to the Spacetime Loop.
Meng Chuan stood up in the mountain forest. With a thought, a ten-foot-wide black ring appeared behind him.
After the black ring appeared, it devoured all the surrounding powers.
The ring itself was formed by countless mystic runes. In the middle of the ring was a distorted vortex that devoured everything wantonly. This devouring power was much more terrifying than the Chaos Hole law. When Meng Chuan previously used the Myriad Tribulations Chaos Hole Array, he was sucked in without being able to put up any resistance.
The devouring power released by the black ring only affected the surrounding 1,000 feet. After all, he was on Dry Origin Mountain. Meng Chuan had to restrain himself.
Whoosh.
The surrounding 1,000 feet of rock remained intact, but all the vegetation was sucked into the black ring behind Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan pondered for a moment before dispelling his talent with a thought.
The time on Dry Origin Mountain changed slightly, and the vegetation in the 1,000-foot radius returned to their original state just like before they were devoured.
My talent is very similar to that giant snake’s. It can devour everything in the outside world and unleash tremendous power internally. But in terms of strength, it’s inferior to the snake. I feel like it only has 30 to 40 percent of its strength. Perhaps it’s because it had cast it using its body, while I’m only casting it with my Essence Soul World.
With such similar talent, I’ll also call it ‘Spacetime Loop,’
thought Meng Chuan.
Although it was much weaker, Meng Chuan didn’t mind. If he wanted to, he could use multiple Essence Soul avatars to cast it at the same time.
Furthermore, using a talent attack foolishly was the stupidest. He was a Tribulation Eminence, so he naturally tried his best to comprehend the moves and fuse them into his combat system.
I have to study this talent—Spacetime Loop—well. I have to figure out how it can form a stronger devouring effect than a Chaos Hole. The internal Big Bang is also similar to the Heaven Splitting law.
Meng Chuan wanted to use this to study the temporal law.
...
In a dark hall in his home universe.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star sat cross-legged.
It’s been more than 80 years since I obtained the second volume of Bloodline.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star frowned as he pondered. After his sacrifice to obtain the second volume of the Eternal formulation, Bloodline, he had been studying it with all his might. He had even used a mystic realm to accelerate time by ten-fold.
This was because he realized that the situation was tense.
The faction—consisting of Hall Lord White Avian and Realm Ancestor—and many top factions were watching him.
Cultivating an Eternal formulation is indeed very difficult.
Although Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had long expected this, he was still somewhat disappointed by his gains after studying the Eternal formulation for more than 800 years, given he had sped up time ten-fold.
Such cultivation progress was very normal.
Eternal existences were lofty existences. There were only a few in the endless universe and spacetime.
They didn’t need to hide such items at all. They even took the initiative to pass down many formulations. Even the opportunities to take in disciples were known publicly. For example, the Three Thousand Illusion Arrays had long spread throughout the endless spacetime. The six-stroke painting was also publicly placed there.
However, it was very difficult to master them!
If I had the lifespan of an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, I might be able to grasp the complete nine volumes, much less the first and second volume. However, I have much less time.
According to what he knew, Eighth Tribulation Eminences typically had lifespans of over ten million years. Existences like Dragon Ancestor—who had extremely strong willpower—had even longer lifespans.
It was much longer than him, a Seventh Tribulation Eminence who hadn’t even lived for 200,000 years.
Many Eighth Tribulation Eminences obtained the nine volumes of the Eternal formulation, Bloodline. However, there were very few who could completely learn it and impart it to the rest of the world... As a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star naturally understood even less.
The difficulty in his cultivation made him feel like his attainment of the Eighth Tribulation realm was becoming more and more uncertain.
I need more resources. The earlier I obtain that Chaos overlord’s drop of Origins Blood, the better. The earlier I comprehend it, the greater my chances of reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s eyes were dark.

chapters.title: Chapter 732 - Attack!
chapters.content:
Chapter 732: Attack!
When night fell, Jiang State Capital remained bustling and beautiful.
A thousand years had passed since the war with the demons. As the city where the Meng family resided, Jiang State Capital was now the largest city in Archean Eon Realm.
Swoosh! Swoosh!
Two figures flew above Jiang State Capital. They were the couple—Yang Cheng and Meng You.
“After so many years, we’ve finally gathered enough credits.” Meng You was excited and nervous. “As long as we exchange for a longevity extension treasure, we can awaken Yuan’er and extend his lifespan.”
“Yes.” Yang Cheng smiled and nodded.
He also doted on his son, but he felt that his son, Yang Yuan, had lived a perfect life. Although he had stopped at the Marquis Godfiend realm, his 300-year lifespan was considered not bad compared to many Godfiends.
However, his wife had always missed her son. Thus, Yang Cheng naturally did his best. After he transformed into an Imperial Lord-level special lifeform, he had been diligently accumulating credits. The couple worked hard, and Meng You often made her father, Meng Chuan, happy. The treasures her father gave her were all used to exchange for credits with the sect. Tonight, they finally accumulated 1,000,000 credits.
One million credits could be exchanged for longevity extension treasures. It could allow mortals to become Supremacies immediately, giving them 2,000 years of lifespan.
The couple spent most of their lives accumulating one million credits.
After being in Archean Mountain for so many years, the couple was the first to exchange their credits for longevity extension treasures. They needed to do the exchange with Meng Chuan.
Swoosh! Swoosh!
The couple landed in Meng Manor and saw a white-haired, middle-aged man drinking alone under the moon.
“Dad.”
“Father-in-law.”
Meng You and Yang Cheng couldn’t hide the excitement in their eyes.
Meng Chuan—who was drinking alone—put down his cup, looked up at the two of them, and smiled. He naturally knew that his daughter and son-in-law’s contributions to Archean Mountain had just accumulated to one million credits. With him as the center, nothing within the 190 trillion-kilometer-wide domain could hide from him.
“The two of you have indeed worked hard over the years.” Meng Chuan nodded. “You’ve sacrificed a lot for the sect.”
“Dad,” said Meng You immediately. “What about the longevity extension treasure?”
“Are you sure you want to exchange this one million credits for a longevity extension treasure?” Meng Chuan looked at his daughter.
Meng You and Yang Cheng nodded.
In fact, ever since he became an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence and was lucky enough to head to Dry Origin Mountain—which stood beyond the universe—Meng Chuan’s ability to obtain treasures far exceeded that of when he was at the Sixth Tribulation realm! Therefore, he had long decided that he would use more precious treasures to greatly improve his family’s bloodline in the future.
With this powerful bloodline, his family could easily become Imperial Lords over time.
To an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, one million Outer Realm Essence Crystals was enough to turn his family members into Imperial Lords. The greater his strength, the more he could help his family.
For example, he treated his grandson, Yang Yuan, colder back when he was only at the Sixth Tribulation realm.
Now that he was stronger, he naturally wasn’t that strict. Even if his daughter and son-in-law didn’t accumulate the credits, Meng Chuan would extend his grandson’s lifespan in the future. As for the couple’s diligent contributions to the sect, Meng Chuan was very satisfied.
If I reach the Eighth Tribulation realm
, Meng Chuan’s thoughts drifted.
If he reached the Eighth Tribulation realm, Archean Eon Realm could become a high-level world. The entire Archean Eon Realm’s River of Spacetime could independently form an independent one in the universe. He could allow some lifeforms to transcend Samsara or undergo reincarnation in Archean Eon Realm.
For example, Dragon Ancestor and Phoenix Ancestor could easily make generations of their species reach the Imperial Lord realm, much less their loved ones. All of them had 100,000 years of lifespan.
One’s achievements could uplift the entire species, like Dragon Ancestor—he even contributed greatly to the entire universe.
Meng Chuan took out a jade bottle and handed it to his daughter, Meng You. “Just let Yang Yuan take it.”
“Thank you, Dad.” Meng You and Yang Cheng excitedly received the longevity extension treasure that they had worked hard for many years for. They quickly bade farewell and left excitedly.
As a father, am I too harsh on my daughter?
Meng Chuan thought carefully and shook his head gently.
They are already standing at the top of Archean Eon Realm. If I indulge them too much, it won’t be easy to control them.
If I reach the Eighth Tribulation realm, and Archean Eon Realm advances as a whole, the entire race will enjoy great benefits. Qiyue, Meng An, and Meng You will all benefit greatly.
Meng Chuan looked at the lake beside the peach blossom tree. There were faint scenes in the lake.
What’s most important for me now is to grasp the spacetime law. Ever since I obtained the snake’s talent, I’ve cultivated for more than 2,000 years. I haven’t completely grasped the three major branches of the temporal law. I’m still lacking...
The temporal law was divided into the past, present, and future laws.
These three laws were Sixth Tribulation laws. There were also other names, such as the Fate law, Years law, and so on.
Meng Chuan had grasped the paramount speed law a long time ago—it was a part of the present law.
When he comprehended the Heaven Splitting law—an Origins law—he also comprehended some of the profundities of the past, present, and future.
With his original accumulations and his increased talent in the time lineage—as well as his insights into the painting Dao mystic technique—Meng Chuan had comprehended the present law 100 years after slaying the snake! In the 1,000-plus years after he killed the snake, he had comprehended the past law.
Only his cultivation in the future law was slower.
After slaying the snake for more than 2,000 years, I’ve already grasped the past and the present. What’s left is the future law. I’ve accumulated quite a bit of insights. I should be able to break through in the near future. However, comprehending the three branches is only the foundation!
Meng Chuan knew very well that several Seventh Tribulation Eminences had completely grasped the three branches.
Lord of Li Rainbow, Realm Ancestor, and Fiend Eye had grasped the three branches, but they were still far from grasping the spacetime law.
I’ve cultivated for 12,000 years. Hall Lord White Avian grasped the spacetime law in less than 30,000 years. I obtained an Eternal opportunity, and I am cultivating on Dry Origin Mountain. I should be faster than him; otherwise, how can I be an in-name disciple?
Meng Chuan naturally had high expectations of himself. He felt that he had to grasp the spacetime law within 20,000 years.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan looked at the lake.
With the rare treasure—Spacetime Token—refined by Dragon Ancestor, Meng Chuan could spy on countless areas in the River of Spacetime with his current talent and attainments in the spacetime lineage, just like Realm Ancestor.
However, there were fewer places he could spy on at the same time! Ten thousand areas was his limit. Furthermore, he had to use the Spacetime Token to help him.
All the inhabited worlds that have produced half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences.
Meng Chuan was also monitoring them. There were only 3,000-plus medium-sized inhabited worlds that had produced half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences.
Hence, it wasn’t difficult for him to monitor all of them at the same time.
Monitoring... It was also a form of tempering his attainments in spacetime.
...
At that moment, a dark hall silently arrived at a river zone. Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was in the hall as a black-robed figure stood by the side.
“Go,” said Celestial Thearch Myriad Star indifferently.
“Yes, Celestial Thearch.” The black-robed figure silently left.
Forbidden creatures couldn’t be too far from their Life Cores. They had to stay in the same river zone in the outer realm.
Therefore, every time a forbidden creature took action, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star—who had its Life Core—would come to the same river zone! This was also why he hid his location.
Meng Sha Realm.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s eyes burned.
After repeated selections, you are the one I chose among the many half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence homeworlds! Ancestor Meng Sha cultivated his body to the Eighth Tribulation realm, but he failed to transcend the tribulation. He definitely obtained plenty of treasures.
For example, Myriad Star and White Avian hadn’t even created a physical formulation.
During Ancestor Meng Sha’s illustrious era, several Eighth Tribulation Eminences had descended to befriend him. His strength was unfathomable, but when he transcended the tribulation, it proved that his body still had flaws.
Only high-level worlds were better than the Meng Sha Realm.
A high-level world had all sorts of protective means. The independent River of Spacetime transcended Samsara and even formed a divine court internally. Eighth Tribulation Eminences would do their best to protect it.
They were far from something a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence like him could spy on!
This time, I hope I can obtain four billion Outer Realm Essence Crystals from Meng Sha Realm. If it’s not enough, I’ll have to make another attack
. Celestial Thearch Myriad Star watched silently.
Time to begin.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star silently took action and concealed the spacetime where Meng Sha Realm was.
After the concealment, the black-robed figure appeared in the spacetime and transformed into a behemoth.
...
Huh?
Meng Chuan—who was in Archean Eon Realm—looked at the layers of spacetime shadows in the lake. He was monitoring all half-step Eighth Tribulation homeworlds, so he naturally instantly discovered that the spacetime at Meng Sha Realm had been concealed.
He couldn’t pry into it anymore.
Meng Sha Realm—he attacked?
Meng Chuan’s eyes emitted a cold glint.
An Essence Soul avatar flew out from Meng Chuan’s body as he sat there. He instantly traversed spacetime and headed for the region where Meng Sha Realm was.
In front of the bamboo forest, Realm Ancestor—who was fishing—also noticed Meng Sha Realm. His white eyebrows pricked up as his eyes were filled with anger. Similarly, his Essence Soul avatar flew into the lake.
“Hall Lord, Meng Sha Realm has been concealed by spacetime. There’s no way to spy on it.” Azure Dragon—who had been in charge of surveillance all these years—immediately sent a message to Hall Lord White Avian.
When Hall Lord White Avian received the message, he didn’t hesitate to take a step across distant spacetime and head toward Meng Sha Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 733 - Scrambling for Possession
chapters.content:
Chapter 733: Scrambling for Possession
Meng Sha Realm was once extremely close to becoming a high-level world. As long as Ancestor Meng Sha successfully transcended the tribulation, Meng Sha Realm could be raised to a higher level.
Although it was still a middle-level world, the cultivation system and vast number of treasures left behind by Ancestor Meng Sha still allowed Meng Sha Realm to produce many experts. In this era, Meng Sha Realm was relatively mediocre. There were 19 Tribulation Eminences, of which two were Fifth Tribulation Eminences! For a middle-level world to produce so many Tribulation Eminences, it was already very terrifying.
This was the heritage afforded to an almost Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s homeworld; it was much deeper than Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s homeworld. There was no need to mention Archean Eon Realm. Archean Eon Realm hadn’t even perfected its cultivation system.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
A group of cultivators flew toward Meng Sha Realm.
There were too many Supremacies in Meng Sha Realm, and it was very common for them to roam the world. In the surrounding river systems, Meng Sha Realm was the absolute overlord.
“What’s that?”
“No—”
The ten-plus figures flying outside Meng Sha Realm saw the massive creature.
This Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature was too massive. Just seeing it caused the ten-plus cultivators in Meng Sha Realm to feel their minds go blank. Their consciousness turned to emptiness. The Imperial Lord in the lead barely managed to stay lucid as he used his domain to carry his companions away.
But the moment the massive creature appeared, its gaping mouth enveloped the area. The Imperial Lord felt the entire outer realm plunge into darkness!
The surrounding void was completely devoured!
This void naturally included Meng Sha Realm. All living beings in Meng Sha Realm were instantly wiped out. While Celestial Thearch Myriad Star concealed spacetime, he also used karma to kill all living beings outside Meng Sha Realm and removed all traces. Perhaps the various factions in the River of Spacetime had guessed it, but Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was still unwilling to leave behind any concrete evidence.
The once prosperous Meng Sha Realm was removed from the River of Spacetime!
A middle-level world without any experts protecting it was a delicacy in front of a Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature.
If a sufficiently powerful Sixth Tribulation Eminence used an array formation, they could stall for time.
If a Seventh Tribulation Eminence were to guard it, the forbidden creature would’ve been discovered the moment it entered their Origins domain. Even if it attacked forcefully, it would be very difficult for a peak Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature to break through the World Array set up by a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Furthermore, once a forbidden creature was discovered, it would become a public enemy!
It would immediately be attacked by the Eminences in the River of Spacetime.
Unfortunately... Meng Sha Realm was chosen because the strongest person in the present era was only at the Fifth Tribulation realm. He was unable to put up any resistance.
Everything operated according to a pattern: a rise, a decline, as well as birth and destruction.
If one wanted to be strong all the time, they couldn’t rely on external forces. They could only rely on themselves.
Meng Sha Realm was weak in this era, and its treasures attracted Celestial Thearch Myriad Star. Thus, a calamity descended.
The reason why a high-level world always remained in prosperity and power was that they had an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. An Eighth Tribulation Eminence might only have a lifespan of ten million years, but they could easily cross a billion years or even longer.
...
Spacetime in the region where Meng Sha Realm was located was isolated. Meng Chuan couldn’t reach Meng Sha Realm directly; he could only teleport to the area closest to the spacetime isolation barrier.
Boom!
Meng Chuan appeared closest to the spacetime barrier, and his Essence Soul World ruthlessly broke through the spacetime barrier! Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had isolated spacetime from afar to avoid suspicion, so he naturally couldn’t stop Meng Chuan. If Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s true body arrived and personally set up the array formation, Meng Chuan wouldn’t be able to break through.
Boom! Boom!
Meng Chuan broke through the spacetime barrier and flew into the concealed spacetime. In another direction, Realm Ancestor also broke through the spacetime barrier.
The hidden spacetime region didn’t completely seal the spacetime fluctuations. One could still travel through spacetime from within; this was also to allow the Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature to teleport to Meng Sha Realm instantly. After devouring it, it could immediately escape.
But at this moment...
A forbidden creature!
Meng Chuan and Realm Ancestor used their Origins domains to see the Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature at the same time. The moment the behemoth swallowed Meng Sha Realm, they felt the surrounding spacetime fluctuate.
Meng Chuan and Realm Ancestor arrived in front of it.
Not good.
The behemoth was alarmed. As Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s subordinate, it naturally knew about the Seventh Tribulation Eminences in this universe.
City Lord Eastcalm was one thing—he was nothing but a newly-advanced Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence that didn’t pose much of a threat to it. Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had arranged for it to devour worlds because it had the strength of a top Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature.
It was easier for it to deal with unexpected situations, and it devoured worlds faster. With its strength, it naturally wasn’t afraid of an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence that had just broken through.
However, the other person was Realm Ancestor. He had occupied the title of strongest Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence for too long. Realm Ancestor had been a top Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence for a long time. Although he had never reached the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm, he was publicly recognized as powerful!
Hum.
It felt its consciousness sink into a lake, and the deep lake grabbed its consciousness.
It’s the Essence Soul mystic technique created by Realm Ancestor—Heart Lake’s Shadow.
The forbidden creature struggled violently, but it barely managed to stay lucid. Its strength was greatly reduced. Following that, it looked in Meng Chuan’s direction in horror.
...
Meng Chuan and Realm Ancestor were the first to attack; they were also the fastest to arrive.
The moment he arrived, Realm Ancestor used an Essence Soul mystic technique to affect the forbidden creature. Meng Chuan immediately used the move he was most confident in to capture the forbidden creature.
The two top Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminences didn’t have time to discuss prior to the battle, but they naturally cooperated perfectly.
Whoosh!
Meng Chuan stood in the void. The 3,000 massive Dark Chaos Holes formed a huge snake ring behind him. If one looked at it from half a trillion kilometers away, it was indeed like an Ouroboros.
In the middle of the snake ring was endless darkness that devoured everything in the surrounding space.
Omni-Convergence of the Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Array.
In the past few years, Meng Chuan had used his talent—the Spacetime Loop—the Chaos Hole, law, and the Heaven Splitting law to verify each other. After studying and cultivating, his understanding of the Spacetime Loop naturally deepened. This was especially so since he had long grasped the spatial law.
His understanding of the temporal law also deepened. He finally figured out the Spacetime Loop’s essence, and he fused it with the Chaos Hole law and the Heaven Splitting law, creating the Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Array’s fifth transformation—Omni-Convergence!
This transformation could seal the surrounding spacetime and completely devour everything within it! In terms of strength, it was much stronger than when the snake used the Spacetime Loop.
With this move, the massive creature—which was already affected by the Essence Soul mystic technique—flew toward the center of the snake ring formed by the 3,000 Chaos Holes.
Isn’t he a newly-advanced Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence? Why can’t I escape?
The behemoth’s strength had been greatly reduced due to the Essence Soul mystic technique. However, its body was powerful. Logically speaking, it was very difficult for it to be devoured, but the truth was right before its eyes... It couldn’t escape at all as it rapidly plummeted toward the snake ring.
“How bold! A forbidden creature actually dares to devour an inhabited world.” A cold voice sounded.
An old farmer-like man had already arrived in this spacetime, and he extended his hand. Meng Chuan’s Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Array had clearly sealed spacetime, but his hand still tore through the void and grabbed at the behemoth.
“Bold indeed.” Another voice sounded, and the gray-robed Hall Lord White Avian had also arrived. The moment he appeared, the surrounding spacetime was completely sealed—he could no longer teleport.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star immediately rushed over when he realized that Meng Chuan and Realm Ancestor had arrived.
Hall Lord White Avian had only rushed over after receiving Deputy Hall Lord Azure Dragon’s message. In comparison, the two of them were slightly slower than Meng Chuan and Realm Ancestor.
Huh?
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s expression changed.
White Avian has sealed spacetime.
Hall Lord White Avian—who had completely grasped the spacetime law—had taken action. Under the spacetime seal, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star couldn’t travel through the void. Although he wasn’t far from the Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature in regards to distance, it would still take him quite some time to fly through the spacetime seal.
This time was enough for Meng Chuan and Realm Ancestor to capture the Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star didn’t care about the survival of this Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature. Even if it died, its Life Core could condense its true body in the future again.
What he cared about was... the treasures in the Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature’s stomach!
The Life Core of this Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature was far less important than the treasures. Now, he couldn’t teleport through the void and could only watch as the Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature fell into the depths of Meng Chuan’s snake ring array.

chapters.title: Chapter 734 - Ownership of the Treasures
chapters.content:
Chapter 734: Ownership of the Treasures
The treasures!
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was anxious, but there was nothing he could do.
The situation was dire. Hall Lord White Avian had sealed spacetime, preventing him from stopping Meng Chuan and Realm Ancestor. He could only watch how things played out.
On the other hand, Meng Chuan’s strength far exceeded his expectations.
I carefully selected this Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature. Its strength is close to that of a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence. How can it be devoured by Meng Chuan to the point of being unable to resist?
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star felt that destiny had played a cruel joke on him. Logically speaking, even a top Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature could fight someone like Realm Ancestor. However, he never expected that it would be unable to withstand Meng Chuan’s suction.
Meng Chuan reached the Seventh Tribulation realm not too long ago, but this move’s might is probably only inferior to White Avian’s and mine.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had a keen eye. He instantly determined the might of the fifth transformation of Meng Chuan’s Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Array.
In fact, no matter how shallow his accumulation of Origins laws was, Meng Chuan could reach the average standards of top Seventh Tribulation Eminences.
He also had the talent, Spacetime Loop, to which he completely dismantled and integrated it into his assortment of attacks while improving on it.
In terms of strength... Unknowingly, Meng Chuan was already stronger than Origin Realm Chieftain. He wasn’t inferior to Realm Ancestor, Ancestral Magus King, and Palace Lord Medicine.
Although Meng Chuan’s strength made Celestial Thearch Myriad Star feel like destiny had played a joke on him, the latter immediately made a decision. Through the Life Core he controlled, he secretly sent an order via voice transmission.
“Scatter the treasures of Meng Sha Realm in all directions. Throw the most important portions to me. Furthermore, self-destruct your true body and crack Meng Chuan’s array formation.”
“Yes,”
replied the consciousness in the Life Core.
Although it was Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s first time seeing Meng Chuan use the devouring array formation, he had sharp eyes. He could determine that the devouring array formation had a limit. As long as a force exceeded the limit, the array formation might collapse.
Hall Lord White Avian kept an eye on Celestial Thearch Myriad Star. He even flew over at his greatest speed and tried his best to approach Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
I just need to keep an eye on him.
Although it took a long time to describe, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had instantly made a decision and sent a voice transmission in reality.
Roar!
The forbidden creature suddenly opened its gaping mouth, and a large number of treasures shot out from its mouth in a fan-shaped manner. Only the Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Array that was pulling at it didn’t receive any treasures.
The moment it spewed out the treasures with all its might, the forbidden creature stopped resisting. Instead, it followed Meng Chuan’s array formation and charged forward.
“Be careful.” Realm Ancestor’s expression changed.
Not good.
Meng Chuan also realized that the forbidden creature had charged over. The terrifying power contained in its body instantly exploded; it didn’t bother about its body’s endurance.
The explosion definitely represented the forbidden creature’s strongest energy.
The self-destruction of this massive forbidden creature caused the Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Array to instantly become bloated. Even its operations became difficult.
From afar, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star looked at Meng Chuan’s array formation in anticipation.
Rumble~
Behind Meng Chuan, the 3,00 Chaos Holes—which had formed an Ouroboros—trembled slightly, but they spun with great difficulty as they endured the impact. Although the array formation’s strength significantly weakened upon impact, the array formation returned to its peak in just a few seconds.
It continued to devour everything around it.
Many treasures that shot into the distance were drawn toward the array formation.
In fact, Hall Lord White Avian’s complete sealing of spacetime greatly reduced the range of Meng Chuan’s array formation’s absorption. The closer the treasures were to the array formation, the faster they were pulled toward it. The further away they were, the slower the suction speed.
The array formation wasn’t destroyed?
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had long taken the initiative to charge in the direction of the forbidden creature. He transformed into a blurry afterimage of starlight and flew much faster than the treasures.
As he flew over, he used his domain to grab the treasures.
“Myriad Star, the forbidden creature has already self-destructed. Why are you still charging over?” Hall Lord White Avian chased after Celestial Thearch Myriad Star and slowed him down. His domain collided with Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s domain, interfering with him.
“Meng Sha Realm has been destroyed, leaving all these treasures ownerless. Finders keepers.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s expression was cold. “White Avian, are you trying to stall me so that Meng Chuan and Realm Ancestor can take all the treasure?”
“Didn’t you say finders keepers?” Hall Lord White Avian sneered.
Although Celestial Thearch Myriad Star didn’t admit it, they knew in their hearts that the true culprit was Celestial Thearch Myriad Star. This time, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had disappeared again when Meng Sha Realm was devoured! If he was honest, why did he have to hide his location?
Boom!
Hall Lord White Avian’s and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s domains clashed. From afar, Hall Lord White Avian only had one thought—hold him back!
Some treasures were nearby, but Hall Lord White Avian had also snatched them from Celestial Thearch Myriad Star!
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Although some of the treasures landed in his hands, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was heartbroken and furious.
This was because Hall Lord White Avian had also seized the nearby treasures. He would even take the initiative to attack from afar. He would blast away the treasures that were closer to Celestial Thearch Myriad Star, causing them to be even closer to Meng Chuan... They then naturally flew toward the Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Array faster.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Meng Chuan was ultimately the closest to the forbidden creature. Although he was affected by the self-destruction, 95% of the treasures fell into the array formation like starlight.
A few treasures were also snatched by Celestial Thearch Myriad Star and Hall Lord White Avian.
The void finally calmed down.
Meng Chuan dispelled the array formation, and Realm Ancestor flew close to him.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star also stopped in the distance.
Hall Lord White Avian stopped as well and looked at him with a faint smile. “Myriad Star, what a coincidence. You disappeared again after the forbidden creature devoured Meng Sha Realm.”
“I just don’t want others to keep tabs on my location,” said Celestial Thearch Myriad Star indifferently. “Why, can’t I?”
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star shot a glance at Meng Chuan. “Meng Chuan, you devoured more than 90% of Meng Sha Realm’s treasures. Don’t gorge yourself; don’t forget that Meng Sha Realm has just been devoured.”
“Are you threatening me with the intent of ordering a forbidden creature to deal with Archean Eon Realm?” Meng Chuan stared at him. “Unfortunately, you’ll have to get a Chaos overlord.”
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was secretly vexed. “You should know that you have seized too many treasures this time. A scourge will befall those with plenty of treasures.”
“You are the scourge for ordering a forbidden creature to devour an inhabited world,” said Meng Chuan coldly.
He wasn’t afraid of Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
Back when he learned that Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had secretly controlled forbidden creatures to devour more than 100 inhabited worlds, Meng Chuan was shocked. He immediately set up a heavy array formation for his homeworld, Archean Eon Realm.
With his current attainments in array formations, even Celestial Thearch Myriad Star couldn’t crack the array formation! Furthermore, Archean Eon Realm had the protection of the spacetime law. Tribulation Eminences were unable to break through it.
As an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, he had nothing to fear with his current strength. Notwithstanding his rapid growth, how could he be afraid of Celestial Thearch Myriad Star?
“Quite bold of you.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star long knew that Meng Chuan might be a great threat not inferior to Hall Lord White Avian in the future. But by the time he noticed Meng Chuan, Meng Chuan was already a peak Sixth Tribulation Eminence. He couldn’t stop his growth any longer.
“Although the forbidden creature has self-destructed, its Life Core will easily condense a true body. It will be able to devour inhabited worlds again.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star glanced at Hall Lord White Avian. “If you hadn’t stopped me, I could’ve captured the forbidden creature alive and controlled its true body. Its Life Core wouldn’t have been able to escape this river zone, and I would’ve been able to find it.”
“Don’t worry.” Hall Lord White Avian said, “My spacetime perception has completely enveloped the entire river zone. That Life Core can’t escape.”
“Take your time finding it then.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star sneered.
“If the Life Core is in your hands and you leave with it, I naturally won’t be able to find it.” Hall Lord White Avian looked at him. “Do you dare swear that the Life Core isn’t in your hands?”
“Humph.”
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star sneered and couldn’t be bothered to say anything else. He took a step and left.
“He once again doesn’t dare to swear.” Hall Lord White Avian scoffed. He was certain that the Life Core was in Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s hands. Only by controlling the Life Core could he control the forbidden creature. Otherwise, how could a forbidden creature be so obedient?
The surrounding spacetime seal was dispelled. Meng Chuan, Realm Ancestor, and Hall Lord White Avian gathered together.
“Despite publicly exposing him previously,” said Realm Ancestor, “he still disappeared when Meng Sha Realm was devoured. He concealed his location.”
“Everyone knows what’s happening. He just refuses to admit it,” said Hall Lord White Avian.
“What are we to do with Meng Sha Realm’s treasures?” asked Meng Chuan.
Sigh.
Realm Ancestor sighed. “What kind of expert was Ancestor Meng Sha? Yet, his homeworld, Meng Sha Realm, ended up in such a state. He once befriended an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, but no Eighth Tribulation Eminence protected his homeworld.”
“Back then, Eighth Tribulation Eminences befriended Ancestor Meng Sha because of the physical body formulation he created, giving him a chance to reach the Eighth Tribulation realm. However, he ultimately failed to transcend the tribulation... An Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s time is precious. They have befriended so many lifeforms, so it’s impossible for them to protect every lifeform’s homeworld, right?” said Hall Lord White Avian. “Outsiders can help for a while, but it’s impossible for them to help you all your life.”
“Now that I’m close to the end of my lifespan, I’m a little worried about my homeworld’s future.” Realm Ancestor looked at Meng Chuan. “Meng Chuan, I won’t touch the treasures in Meng Sha Realm. I’m old, so there’s no benefit in taking them.”
The treasures of Meng Sha Realm were a hot potato.
“Meng Chuan, take them if you think you can bear the consequences,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “If you’re afraid, give them to me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 735
chapters.content:
Chapter 735: Response
Although Meng Sha Realm’s treasures were astonishing, they might not necessarily match the amount of treasures Hall Lord White Avian had accumulated. This was because Meng Sha Ancestor had to invest a large number of treasures into his cultivation. In order to cultivate an Eighth Tribulation body and transcend the tribulation, the price he paid was undoubtedly astonishing. Only the remaining treasures were left for his homeworld.
Hall Lord White Avian had plenty of treasures to begin with. It didn’t matter if he had an additional portion of the treasures from Meng Sha Realm.
“I’m not afraid,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. He was still young, and he was still cultivating on Dry Origin Mountain. He believed that the treasures he obtained in this life would far exceed the treasures in Meng Sha Realm. He naturally had the guts to accept them.
“Such guts are needed.” Hall Lord White Avian nodded in satisfaction. “By the way, from the battle just now, I can tell that your strength... isn’t inferior to Senior Realm Ancestor’s.”
“He’s probably stronger than me.” Realm Ancestor looked at Meng Chuan and was shocked. The rate of his growth was too terrifying.
Hall Lord White Avian looked at Meng Chuan expectantly. He could tell that Meng Chuan had cultivated for more than 12,000 years.
After reaching the Seventh Tribulation realm, he should’ve gone to a place where time flows extremely quickly.
Even so, Meng Chuan became an existence second only to Hall Lord White Avian and Celestial Thearch Myriad Star in 12,000 years. This speed allowed Hall Lord White Avian to see hope of Meng Chuan reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm.
“I was lucky to obtain an opportunity,” said Meng Chuan.
“There’s no such thing as an opportunity without reason,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “Seniors leave behind opportunities, and they will select their targets. The requirements are extremely harsh.”
Realm Ancestor nodded as well before saying, “Celestial Thearch Myriad Star directly attacked Meng Sha Realm. Perhaps he will attack again soon. What should we do?”
“He attacked Deer Celestial Realm not long ago. After we exposed him, he should’ve kept a low profile in order to avoid suspicion.” Hall Lord White Avian was also somewhat puzzled. “Instead, he became even crazier and attacked Meng Sha Realm. Although Myriad Star is greedy, his modus operandi has been about guile in the past. This doesn’t match his personality.”
“Perhaps his personality has changed drastically,” said Realm Ancestor coldly.
They didn’t know that Black Fiend Progenitor was behind this.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star knew very well that it was a temptation, but he was willing to bite the fruit of temptation.
“If he attacks again...” Meng Chuan was vexed.
Although he was much stronger, he was slightly inferior to Palace Lord Skylight in history. After all, the other party could defeat a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence with a single punch. Meng Chuan still needed to utilize several more moves.
He was slightly inferior to Palace Lord Skylight and much weaker than a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
In the present era, only Hall Lord White Avian could hold back Celestial Thearch Myriad Star. However, he could only hold him back a little; he couldn’t stop him.
I should become a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence as soon as possible. Furthermore, it won’t be long before my next window of killing a Seventh Tribulation Chaos creature.
He could only kill one imprisoned Chaos creature every 5,000 years on Dry Origin Mountain. He had cultivated on Dry Origin Mountain for more than 4,000 years; the next 5,000 years was almost up.
...
Meng Chuan, Realm Ancestor, and Hall Lord White Avian returned to their respective residences. Meng Chuan naturally returned to Archean Eon Realm with the treasures.
In Archean Eon Realm, Meng Chuan was the only one in front of Heaven and Earth Great Hall.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Treasures appeared out of thin air and flew to the huge square in front of Heaven and Earth Great Hall. These countless treasures quickly piled up into a mountain.
As he looked at the mountain of treasures, Meng Chuan’s domain had long enveloped every treasure. At his current level, there were very few treasures he didn’t recognize in the River of Spacetime.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star controlled that forbidden creature. Before the forbidden creature self-destructed, it definitely threw the most precious treasures in Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s direction. Although Hall Lord blocked it... 95% of it is with me. I estimate that its actual value is only half.
At the same time, Meng Chuan had completely appraised the treasure mountain.
This treasure mountain in front of me should be worth about 600 million cubes.
Meng Chuan sighed inwardly.
As expected of an existence that had cultivated an Eighth Tribulation body and had begun transcending the tribulation... The treasures left behind are indeed astonishing. Next batch.
After putting away the treasure mountain, Meng Chuan released another large batch of treasures.
There were too many treasures that he had to appraise them in batches.
There were a total of five batches of treasures; each were of varying value.
They’re worth about 3.2 billion cubes in total.
Although Meng Chuan didn’t recognize some treasures, he could roughly determine their level and value with his insight.
Meng Chuan stood there dazedly. He was considered normal among Seventh Tribulation Eminences. Ignoring Ancestral Master Archean Eon’s treasures, his treasures added up to tens of millions of cubes.
But this time... 3.2 billion!
It’s no wonder Celestial Thearch Myriad Star is so greedy.
Meng Chuan was also shocked by the treasures.
Hall Lord sure is generous.
Logically speaking, Hall Lord White Avian had been the main force in the battle against Celestial Thearch Myriad Star. Therefore, Meng Chuan had taken the initiative to ask him how the distribution of the treasures would work. However, Hall Lord didn’t care at all. Meng Chuan was shocked when he came back to do the stock keeping. After all, he had never been so ‘rich.’
Steady yourself. Meng Sha Ancestor must’ve expended a lot of resources to reach the Physical Body Tribulation realm. Yet, there’s still so many treasures left. I will definitely be able to obtain more treasures in the future.
Meng Chuan calmed himself down.
Such a huge amount of wealth could allow him to consume natural treasures for a long period of time, allowing his cultivation to advance by leaps and bounds. In terms of his homeworld, Archean Eon Realm’s clansmen could advance by leaps and bounds thanks to the nurturing from the large number of resources. The number of people becoming Supremacies, Imperial Lords, or Tribulation Eminences each generation could increase by dozens of times.
Meng Chuan left the Heaven and Earth Great Hall and flew above Archean Eon Realm. He looked down at the vast world.
Archean Eon Realm was extremely prosperous. The boundary of the world was constantly expanding.
3.2 billion cubes. I have to think of a plan. First, I have to be strong. If I’m not strong, Archean Eon Realm will be a delicious piece of meat.
A billion cubes are enough. If I use a billion cubes on myself, my cultivation path will be smoother. My chances of reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm will be higher. If I reach the Eighth Tribulation realm, this universe will have another high-level world. Only then will Archean Eon Realm truly prosper for countless years.
Meng Chuan was filled with anticipation.
“Meng Chuan, quickly come to Nebula Palace.”
Hall Lord White Avian sent a message through Nebula Palace.
Meng Chuan was somewhat surprised. He immediately sensed Nebula Palace from afar and condensed an embodiment to meet Hall Lord White Avian.
...
Hall Lord White Avian, Realm Ancestor, Meng Chuan, Deputy Hall Lord Azure Dragon, Deputy Hall Lord Blazing Sun, and Lord of Shadowfiend were gathered here.
“Just a moment ago,” said Hall Lord White Avian solemnly, “Celestial Thearch Myriad Star informed the various factions that a Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature had devoured Meng Sha Realm. When Myriad Star went to capture the forbidden creature, he was stopped by me. Meng Chuan and Realm Ancestor killed the forbidden creature. More than 90% of Meng Sha Realm’s treasures fell into Meng Chuan’s hands.”
“How shameless,” said Realm Ancestor.
Meng Chuan frowned slightly. He wasn’t afraid since he was a top Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence. In terms of strength, he was stronger than Origin Realm Chieftain. No one in the River of Spacetime could threaten him while he remained alive.
“I have an idea,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “We will leave behind the memories of the battle and pass them to all Seventh Tribulation Eminences and half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences other than those in Six Directions Heaven.”
“Memories of the battle?” Meng Chuan and Realm Ancestor’s hearts stirred.
A battle scene at their level couldn’t be faked. This was because memories could reproduce the entire battle process. The Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Array Meng Chuan cast was profound.
The forbidden creature tried its best to spew out all the profundities contained in the treasures.
There was also the scene of Celestial Thearch Myriad Star and Hall Lord White Avian exchanging blows... The scenes of the battle were profound at the spacetime law level. No one could comprehend the means of others in a short period of time.
For example, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star couldn’t comprehend the Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Array in a short period of time. Therefore, he couldn’t forge it, much less Hall Lord White Avian’s ultimate technique.
“The memories of the three of us showcases the battle from our respective angles,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “We will publicize the battle scene so that everyone can see it clearly.”
“Meng Chuan and Realm Ancestor were the first to arrive close to Meng Sha Realm. Those Seventh Tribulation Eminences also sensed you approaching Meng Sha Realm. Back then, I was still far away in another river zone, but Myriad Star had been hiding his location. He’s the only suspect,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “Furthermore, he was unwilling to swear an oath. In addition, Meng Chuan’s strength in the battle scene was enough to shock all parties.”
By the side, Deputy Hall Lord Azure Dragon added, “We can also remind everyone that he just devoured Deer Celestial Realm not long ago. Now, he has devoured Meng Sha Realm. Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s appetite is getting bigger. I’m afraid there will be another attempt soon.”
Lord of Shadowfiend said coldly, “If we don’t stop him, any current Seventh Tribulation Eminence who dies of old age might have their homeworld devoured.”
“At this point, let’s try our best to spread the news. Inform all the factions in high-level worlds,” said Blazing Sun. “We shall cast our net and see if an Eighth Tribulation Eminence will awaken in this era and destroy that Myriad Star in passing.”
Everyone discussed and quickly perfected the plan. On the same day, they sent intelligence that included battle scenes to the various factions in the River of Spacetime.
Some of the relatively weaker factions in the present era—high-level worlds—were surprised to receive information from Hall Lord White Avian.
One had to know that in these high-level worlds, if there were no Seventh Tribulation Eminences, they would typically keep a low profile and not participate in the River of Spacetime’s disputes.
“City Lord Eastcalm, Meng Chuan?”
This intelligence also attracted the attention of various factions. When Meng Chuan used the array formation, the 3,000 Dark Chaos Holes were enough to shock everyone. The Ouroboros formed by the Chaos Holes shocked many high-level factions.

chapters.title: Chapter 736 - Decision
chapters.content:
Chapter 736: Decision
A high-level world—Cosmos Realm.
Above the clouds was a vast divine hall. Many gods in Cosmos Realm lived here.
At that moment, in a towering hall, the gods were enjoying delicious food and alcohol.
“Your Majesty, how should we deal with the intelligence sent by White Avian Hall, the number one faction in the outer realm?” asked a Sixth Tribulation Eminence as he sat there.
“How should we deal with it?” The Imperial Lord—who was sitting on his throne—smiled indifferently and said, “There’s only one monster in this era. Haven’t we seen many such instances? There’s no need to care about it.”
“We’ve seen monsters that are many times more terrifying than Celestial Thearch Myriad Star,” said a smiling, fat man seated there. “I still remember that 500 million years ago, a foreign Eighth Tribulation Eminence sneaked in and secretly incited the Seventh Tribulation Eminences back then. After figuring out our universe’s ins and outs, he caused a huge calamity.
“That Eighth Tribulation Eminence destroyed three high-level worlds that didn’t have an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. He then plundered everything. Dragon Ancestor personally descended and attacked, but the other party still managed to flee.”
“That Eighth Tribulation Eminence leaped beyond the timeline and attacked at some still time node. The three high-level worlds’ living beings didn’t suffer any pain, dying without feeling anything. The Seventh Tribulation Eminences of that era knew nothing. It was only when he attacked the fourth high-level world—which was protected by an old friend of an Eighth Tribulation Eminence—that he was stopped, having alarmed Dragon Ancestor and company...”
The deities sighed.
It was too terrifying to attack from beyond the timeline; they couldn’t even seek help!
Therefore, if a high-level world’s Eighth Tribulation Eminence died, they could hire other Eighth Tribulation Eminences to arrange for a true body to guard it for a long period of time! For example, they could guard a high-level world for 10,000 years... The time flow for an Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s 10,000 years was nearly stagnant. It might last a billion years or even longer in the outside world.
Or they could use some powerful treasures that could reinforce a high-level world, increasing the difficulty of destruction.
The Imperial Lord sitting on the throne said, “Currently, there are turbulent undercurrents in the outer realm. On the surface, it looks like Celestial Thearch Myriad Star is arrogant and has plundered many inhabited worlds. However, he has plundered so many treasures. In the end, he still has to transact with an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. There must be an Eighth Tribulation Eminence backing him.”
The gods below nodded solemnly.
They didn’t think much of the current Seventh Tribulation Eminences. This was because once these gods fell asleep, it could be for hundreds of thousands of years. When they woke up, the current Seventh Tribulation Eminences would’ve died of old age.
However, they were extremely reverent toward Eighth Tribulation Eminences!
Eighth Tribulation Eminences used spacetime as their foundation. They comprehended and grasped various means. They could even gradually crack the spacetime laws in the universe, making their means even more unpredictable. The true fate of the entire universe was decided by Eighth Tribulation Eminences who occasionally appeared.
“That’s right! Celestial Thearch Myriad Star would find it difficult to use all the treasures he plundered! He has to transact with an Eighth Tribulation Eminence in order to exchange for what he needs.” A female deity nodded. “Since it involves an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, we can’t disturb the Progenitor or disturb him.”
The Progenitor of Cosmos Realm was an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. He was also the true backer of the entire Cosmos Realm!
With the Progenitor alive, Cosmos Realm could continue to thrive.
If the Progenitor died, Cosmos Realm would face all kinds of calamities.
These deities were unwilling to cause trouble for their Progenitor! Furthermore, the Progenitor had strict orders—only a few important matters were deserving of waking him.
“However, it’s really rare in this era. Apart from Myriad Star and White Avian, Eastcalm’s cultivation speed is even more astonishing now,” commented the Imperial Lord with a sigh. “It hasn’t been long since he reached the Seventh Tribulation realm, but his strength has actually exceeded that of ordinary top Seventh Tribulation Eminences. In this era, there might be three half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences coexisting.”
“Three half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences coexisting for an era?”
“It’s indeed very rare.”
“After hundreds of thousands of years, they will probably disappear from the River of Spacetime. They won’t be as carefree as us; we have transcended Samsara and can live as long as the heavens.”
The deities in the hall laughed. Just based on their lifespans, they could look down on the Seventh Tribulation Eminences in the outer realm.
They were originally only Sixth Tribulation Eminences, Fifth Tribulation Eminences, and even weaker lifeforms. But once their homeworld was upgraded to a high-level world and their history made independent from the River of Spacetime, they could create their own Samsara.
As the master of a high-level world, an Eighth Tribulation Eminence could scoop out any lifeform that had been born in their homeworld’s history! They could fuse with a high-level world and become a part of it.
If a high-level world wasn’t destroyed, they would live forever. Therefore, it wasn’t hyperbole that one could live as long as the heavens.
There were also flaws. After becoming a part of the high-level world, they would never be able to take a step out of their homeworld!
