Furthermore, their willpower was unable to withstand their long lifespans. They would gradually distort and collapse, so it was normal for their personalities to change drastically. Therefore, the deities often fell into a deep slumber so as to reduce the burden on their willpower. Some even had no choice but to reincarnate. They hoped for a new and fresh life to reforge their powerful willpower.
Regardless, the number of deities was limited. Every deity’s position in the high-level world was pursued by its cultivators.
This was something that low-level and middle-level cultivators couldn’t even imagine. Even Celestial Thearch Myriad Star and Hall Lord White Avian had to die when their lifespans were up.
...
The meatball-like Fiend Eye sat on his throne. He watched the intelligence from White Avian Hall and the scene of Meng Chuan’s array formation.
Fiend Eye was in a good mood.
It’s really as I expected. Back then, I felt that something was amiss when I saw that nearly half of his future timelines showed him to be at the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm at least. When he was at the Sixth Tribulation realm, there should’ve been many future possibilities. Back then, half of those possibilities placed him to be a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence at least. Clearly, there were very strong reasons why he couldn’t be stopped.
I can’t see his future now, but judging from his cultivation speed, he’s truly terrifying.
Fiend Eye was happy to see this.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star is acting even more unscrupulous in order to reach the Eighth Tribulation realm
, thought Fiend Eye.
He has to exchange with an Eighth Tribulation Eminence for his cultivation needs, so he has an Eighth Tribulation Eminence backing him... White Avian still hopes that an Eighth Tribulation Eminence will appear in this River of Spacetime out of public spiritedness? The possibility is very low. It’s forbidden for most Eighth Tribulation Eminences to be disturbed unless something major happens. Those disciples and grand-disciples won’t easily disturb their Progenitors.
...
How is this Eastcalm so powerful?
Guild Master Darkstar looked at the intelligence and felt apprehensive.
City Lord Eastcalm grew too quickly.
He had chosen the wrong target back then.
...
In an ice palace, Palace Lord Snow Rainbow read the intelligence calmly.
He had once obtained a huge opportunity of befriending an Eighth Tribulation Eminence and obtained his promise.
Palace Lord Snow Rainbow placed great importance on this promise! It was the most critical opportunity for his cultivation. He wouldn’t use it against Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star will become even more fearless. At the peak of his madness, he will touch the bottom line of an Eighth Tribulation Eminence and that will mark his death.
...
In front of Holy Mountain of Painting.
Meng Chuan stood there and shouted, “Daolord!”
After shouting twice, Meng Chuan looked around.
Daolord Evodia didn’t appear.
Daolord Evodia didn’t give me a way to summon him. I guess he doesn’t want me to disturb him
, Meng Chuan thought to himself. He knew that Daolord Evodia had previously sent him to Dry Origin Mountain because it was a mission given by an Eternal existence! As long as he mastered the six-stroke runic seal mystic technique, he would obtain this opportunity. However, Daolord Evodia didn’t have any obligation to help him in the future.
After all, although he had obtained an opportunity, he still needed to transcend the tribulation and reach the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm before he could become an Eternal existence’s disciple.
...
When the news spread, all the factions knew that it was Celestial Thearch Myriad Star who had ordered the forbidden creature to devour the inhabited world.
But as time passed, no Eighth Tribulation Eminence descended to deal with Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
I held too much hope.
Hall Lord White Avian looked into the endless spacetime and muttered softly, “I hoped for an Eighth Tribulation Eminence to descend, but clearly, no one has reported the news to an Eighth Tribulation Eminence.”
Hall Lord White Avian knew very well that he couldn’t hold a match to Celestial Therach Myriad Star in terms of delaying the end of his lifespan since he was heavily injured. Once he died, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star would definitely attack his homeworld on account of their years of conflict.
I should’ve long understood that on this path, it’s better to rely on yourself than others.
A silver token appeared in Hall Lord White Avian’s hand. He looked down at the ordinary token.
My Essence Soul was heavily injured in exchange for a promise from an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. Today, I’ll use this promise to... kill Myriad Star.
Following that, he no longer hesitated and activated the token.

chapters.title: Chapter 737 - Eighth Tribulation Eminence, Perfected Lord Crimson Peace
chapters.content:
Chapter 737: Eighth Tribulation Eminence, Perfected Lord Crimson Peace
The moment Hall Lord White Avian activated his token, in the high-level world, Fool Mountain Realm—
In a temple in Fool Mountain Realm’s mortal world, a tall man leaned against a wooden chair. He held his chin with one hand as though he was taking a nap. His eyes were long and narrow, and there was a vertical eye between his eyebrows. Even though he was taking a nap, he was much more dignified than the statue in the temple.
The entire temple was isolated from Fool Mountain Realm.
All living beings in Fool Mountain Realm, including the Imperial Lords and deities, couldn’t see this place.
Oh?
The tall man suddenly opened his eyes. The vertical eye at his glabella also opened.
At that moment—
He saw Hall Lord White Avian holding a token in the distance, outside of Fool Mountain Realm. Under the tall man’s gaze, Hall Lord White Avian’s timeline connected the past and the future. He saw everything Hall Lord White Avian had experienced recently.
This little White Avian’s personality is too benevolent.
The tall man stood up and took a step out of Fool Mountain Realm. An embodiment remained on the wooden chair in the temple.
...
After Hall Lord White Avian activated his token, he waited silently. Suddenly, he saw a tall man appear. He stood in the endless spacetime, bringing immense pressure with him.
“Perfected Lord.” Hall Lord White Avian bowed slightly.
Fool Mountain Realm’s Progenitor, Perfected Lord Crimson Peace, was also a famous existence in the River of Spacetime. But as time passed, there were fewer records about him.
“Your Essence Soul was heavily injured because of Brother Yi.” Perfected Lord Crimson Peace looked at Hall Lord White Avian. “Brother Yi is ultimately not from our River of Spacetime. Before he left, he requested me to help you once. What do you need me to do this time?”
Although Perfected Lord Crimson Peace had a true body in his home universe, he also had a true body outside. He had made close friends outside the universe, relationships forged through life and death.
“Perfected Lord, I hope you can kill Celestial Thearch Myriad Star,” said Hall Lord White Avian.
“Actually, even if you ignore him, he won’t be able to threaten you,” said Perfected Lord Crimson Peace. “If he doesn’t restrain himself, he will ultimately bring about his own death. Yet, you used up the only chance you had to request my assistance.”
“Thank you, Perfected Lord,” said Hall Lord White Avian.
Perfected Lord Crimson Peace nodded slightly. “Alright, as you wish.”
...
In a dark hall.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was studying the second volume of the Eternal formulation, Bloodline. Suddenly, he sensed something and looked up.
Whoosh.
A huge crystalline palm tore through spacetime and passed through all obstructions in Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s cave abode. Wherever it passed, everything shattered.
It had already reached the hall’s entrance.
Eighth Tribulation Eminence!
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was horrified. He was extremely certain that the person who could instantly destroy all the array formations in his cave abode was definitely an Eighth Tribulation Eminence!
“Senior,” shouted Celestial Thearch Myriad Star as tiny stars appeared on his body. Tens of thousands of stars surrounded him, forming a miniature universe and completely isolating him from the outside world.
Bam!
Without any hesitation, the palm struck the stellar array formation. With a single collision, the array formation that formed a miniature universe shattered.
Following that, the palm extended again, causing spacetime to completely fall into his palm. Celestial Thearch Myriad Star also landed in his palm.
He captured me in two moves?
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star landed in his palm and looked up. He saw five fingers that resembled heavenly pillars and the towering man’s face.
He immediately recognized that this man was Perfected Lord Crimson Peace.
With Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s status, he only knew a little about the Eighth Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime’s history. Perfected Lord Crimson Peace was one of them.
“Perfected Lord, spare me. Please spare me,” pleaded Celestial Thearch Myriad Star immediately. He was very humble.
In front of the Eighth Tribulation Eminence, the mighty and invincible Celestial Thearch Myriad Star of the current era... didn’t care about his reputation at all.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star knew very well what it meant to be captured in two moves. He was also a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence who had grasped the laws of spacetime. It was very normal for him to be captured alive after blocking a handful of moves from an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. However, Perfected Lord Crimson Peace had only extended one hand and caught him in two moves.
If Perfected Lord Crimson Peace had used a powerful treasure... he probably wouldn’t have been able to withstand a single attack. The difference was too great.
“Little White Avian, look. Myriad Star is here.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star saw the towering Perfected Lord Crimson Peace speaking to another figure beside him. He saw that the other figure was Hall Lord White Avian.
Hall Lord White Avian also looked down at the tiny figure in his palm.
It’s Hall Lord White Avian. How did he manage to invite Perfected Lord Crimson Peace?
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was dazed.
“Brother White Avian, Brother White Avian,” shouted Celestial Thearch Myriad Star loudly.
...
Hall Lord White Avian and Perfected Lord Crimson Peace stood together and looked at the tiny figure in Perfected Lord Crimson Peace’s palm.
The tiny figure shouted with all its might, “Brother White Avian! Brother White Avian, I know my mistakes. Brother White Avian, I will never order forbidden creatures to devour inhabited worlds again! Brother White Avian, give me another chance.”
At this moment, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star didn’t hesitate to beg for mercy, begging Hall Lord White Avian to spare him.
“Now that we have captured his outer realm true body, only his homeworld’s true body is left,” said Perfected Lord Crimson Peace. “Let’s go to his homeworld.”
Whoosh.
Perfected Lord Crimson Peace appeared outside a middle-level world with Hall Lord White Avian.
The reason why he captured Myriad Star alive was to prevent any accidents from happening. After all, killing an outer realm true body would allow his homeworld true body to split out another true body.
“Perfected Lord, spare me. Brother White Avian, spare me. Just this once.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star—who was in the palm—tried his best to shout, “Tell me what you need me to do.”
“Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s homeworld.” Hall Lord White Avian watched.
“All inhabited worlds are protected by spacetime laws,” said Perfected Lord Crimson Peace. “Forbidden creatures are born to devour; they devour inhabited worlds by relying on their talent. As for Eighth Tribulation Eminences, they need to comprehend the profundities of this protection and crack it if they want to break through the spacetime laws’ protection.” Perfected Lord Crimson Peace calmly explained to Hall Lord White Avian.
Hall Lord White Avian nodded slightly. “I heard that all phenomena in the endless spacetime can be resolved through meditation, no matter how inconceivable it is.”
“That’s right. If one cultivates the Eighth Tribulation realm to the limit, they can even create a universe.” Perfected Lord Crimson Peace looked at the middle-level world.
In Perfected Lord Crimson Peace’s eyes, countless nomological threads protected this middle-level world.
He had never thought of destroying a inhabited world; it signified great karma. After all, this River of Spacetime had nurtured Perfected Lord Crimson Peace. He owed it to this part of the River of Spacetime.
He planned on penetrating the world membrane and reaching in to grab Celestial Thearch Myriad Star. This middle-level world could still be restored to its original state.
It was very easy to break through the world membrane, but he had to crack the nomological protection first.
“The protection of a middle-level world is a little complicated.” Perfected Lord Crimson Peace watched.
Even Chaos creatures had to be at the Seventh Tribulation realm before they could devour a middle-level world. They knew how to eat, but they didn’t know how they ate them.
In his years of cultivation, Perfected Lord Crimson Peace had long observed the protection of an inhabited world’s laws. Now, after a brief look, he extended his hand.
The crystalline palm landed on the world membrane with a whoosh.

chapters.title: Chapter 738 - Life-preservation Method
chapters.content:
Chapter 738: Life-preservation Method
The gigantic palm seemed to be touching the world membrane, but in reality, it was cracking the nomological protection.
Countless nomological threads intertwined with one another. Although it looked complicated, Perfected Lord Crimson Peace was confident. However, just as he was about to crack it—
Black fog surfaced on the world membrane. Furthermore, wisps of nomological threads fused with the spacetime’s nomological protection.
Oh?
Perfected Lord Crimson Peace was astonished. This hidden black fog array formation was only an Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s array formation.
With Celestial Thearch Myriad Star presiding over it, it shouldn’t be able to stop him. However, this array formation... wasn’t directly used to fend off the enemy. Instead, the array formation had fused with the nomological protection of spacetime, greatly increasing the protective laws’ complexity.
What a powerful technique.
Perfected Lord Crimson Peace was secretly alarmed.
The array formation’s profundities can perfectly fuse with the nomological protection. This means that the array formation’s creator... has completely comprehended the protective laws.
Even he—who had the confidence to crack the protective law—had only comprehended 60 to 70% of it. He had only found a flaw in the protective law; he was still far from completely comprehending it.
This black fog...
As Perfected Lord Crimson Peace watched, he sensed a familiar aura. The evil and sinful aura instantly determined the array formation’s creator.
“Black Fiend Ancestor?” Perfected Lord Crimson Peace frowned slightly. He hated Black Fiend Ancestor, but he had to admit that Black Fiend Ancestor was powerful.
In the River of Spacetime’s history, only five people were ranked at the top of the Eighth Tribulation realm after Dragon Ancestor! Black Fiend Ancestor was one of them. He wreaked havoc everywhere and stirred up plenty of storms beyond the universe, but he continued living a perfectly fine life.
Although Perfected Lord Crimson Peace had been at the Eighth Tribulation realm for many years and was confident that he could reach the top Eighth Tribulation realm in his lifetime, he was still far from reaching Black Fiend Ancestor’s level.
...
In his homeworld, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s true body nervously looked at the outside world through the world membrane.
It has to hold. It has to hold.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was nervous and afraid. As a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence, he vividly knew the difference between him and a true Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
The life-preservation means that Black Fiend Ancestor gave me must work.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star could only hope so.
When he first sacrificed to Black Fiend Ancestor, Black Fiend Ancestor hoped that such a good ‘tool’ could live longer. Thus, he imparted some life-preservation means to Myriad Star. Among them was this Eighth Tribulation array formation.
An Eighth Tribulation array formation was worth hundreds of thousands of cubes—nothing worth mentioning.
But this one was created by Black Fiend Ancestor. It was to allow the array formation’s profundities to fuse with the protective law, increasing the protective law’s complexity. Perhaps it was useless against existences at the level of Dragon Ancestor and Black Fiend Ancestor, but it was enough to fend off most Eighth Tribulation Eminences.
Black Fiend Ancestor couldn’t be bothered to waste time helping Celestial Thearch Myriad Star, but he was willing to bestow him some life-preservation means.
It didn’t crack?
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was delighted when he saw the hand retract.
Whoosh.
The gigantic palm reached out again and touched the world membrane, making Celestial Thearch Myriad Star tense up again.
After a long time, the hand failed to tear through the world membrane, allowing Celestial Thearch Myriad Star to heave a sigh of relief.
...
Outside the world membrane, Hall Lord White Avian stood beside Perfected Lord Crimson Peace and watched him make contact with the world membrane with his large hand.
Perfected Lord Crimson Peace frowned in thought.
“White Avian.” Perfected Lord Crimson Peace looked at Hall Lord White Avian. “Backing Celestial Thearch Myriad Star is Black Fiend Ancestor.”
“Black Fiend Ancestor?” Hall Lord White Avian was alarmed.
The one who created Black Fiend Hall?
“I’m not afraid of him.” Perfected Lord Crimson Peace looked at the world membrane. “However, I have to admit that his realm is above mine. All he did was make an Eighth Tribulation array formation fuse with the protective law, causing it to be much more complicated. I can’t crack it.”
“There’s no way to kill Celestial Thearch Myriad Star then?” asked Hall Lord White Avian.
“I can’t kill his true body that’s hiding in his homeworld.” Perfected Lord Crimson Peace nodded and admitted it. Although he could use a karmic attack across worlds, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was still a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence after all... His attacks would be greatly weakened by karma. He wouldn’t be able to kill a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
Some Eighth Tribulation Eminences—such as Black Fiend Ancestor or an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence—could use a person’s true body to ‘corrupt’ their other true bodies. However, Perfected Lord Crimson Peace was better at head-on combat.
He wasn’t good at corrupting and permeation.
Although corruptive attacks were impossible to guard against, they were much weaker. For example, Hall Lord White Avian could still live for a long time despite being heavily injured. For example, Master Poison Eye—who was an Essence Soul Sixth Tribulation Eminence—had the protection of his homeworld. He was attacked by Hall Master Nightmare’s Nightmare Hall legacy treasure. The Power of Nightmare permeated into Master Poison Eye’s Essence Soul, but he remained alive.
With the protection of his homeworld, it was indeed rather difficult to kill a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
“It’s easiest to tear open the world membrane and kill him. If we can’t crack the protective law, it will be very difficult,” said Perfected Lord Crimson Peace. “Now that we have captured his true body and sealed it, his true body in his homeworld doesn’t dare to come out. This way, he won’t be able to threaten the outside world.”
Although Hall Lord White Avian was indignant, he nodded and said, “This is the only way.”
“It’s best to make him swear an oath,” said Perfected Lord Crimson Peace. After all, if his true body in his homeworld actually took the risk to come out, it could still stir up trouble.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star naturally didn’t know about their conversation.
Perfected Lord Crimson Peace looked at his other palm and at the tiny Celestial Thearch Myriad Star in his palm. He then said indifferently, “Myriad Star, I’ll give you one last chance. If you swear that you won’t order forbidden creatures to devour worlds in the future, I’ll spare you this time.”
“Swear an oath?” The tiny Celestial Thearch Myriad Star looked up at the towering figure, but he had already calmed his mind.
After such a long time, Perfected Lord Crimson Peace had failed to break through the world membrane. He even took the initiative to negotiate with him, letting Celestial Thearch Myriad Star understand that Perfected Lord Crimson Peace had no way of cracking the world membrane.
Since he couldn’t crack through the world membrane, why would he make an oath?
Just now, he was willing to swear an oath when faced with the threat of death, but times had changed. Now that he was alive and had no worries, his thoughts naturally changed.
“Perfected Lord, I’m just working for Black Fiend Ancestor. Please forgive me.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star bowed slightly, but his body had already collapsed—decimated.
Huh?
Hall Lord White Avian looked at Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s true body in shock.
“He can actually destroy his body in my palm?” Perfected Lord Crimson Peace said softly, “Black Fiend Ancestor imparted the Bloodline mystic technique to him? It looks like he imparted him many life-preservation means.”
Perfected Lord Crimson Peace’s eyes turned cold.
“White Avian,” said Perfected Lord Crimson Peace. “I can’t kill Myriad Star if I can’t break the protective law. However, there’s another method... which requires you to pay a lot more.”
“Pray, do tell.” Hall Lord White Avian’s eyes lit up.
There’s still a way?
“I will personally set up an array formation around this inhabited world,” said Perfected Lord Crimson Peace indifferently. “I will completely trap this inhabited world, isolating it from the universe. Celestial Thearch Myriad Star can forget about coming out. If he can’t come out, he naturally won’t be able to cause trouble. However, the only flaw is that such an array formation requires a cultivator who has grasped spacetime laws to preside over it. You are the only suitable person in this era.”
“Trap him forever and seal his inhabited world, preventing him from taking a step out.” Perfected Lord Crimson Peace looked at him. “The price of sealing him is for you to stay here for an extended period. Are you willing?”
Hall Lord White Avian was a Physical Body Tribulation Eminence after all. Arranging a true body to stay here for extended periods had a huge impact on him.
“If I am the one presiding over the array formation, will an Eighth Tribulation Eminence be able to crack the array formation and save him?” asked Hall Lord White Avian.
“The array formation contains my will,” said Perfected Lord Crimson Peace calmly. “If an Eighth Tribulation Eminence descends, they will understand everything once they see the array formation. Unless they are my enemy, they won’t save him. The only problem now... are you willing to guard the array formation?”
Hall Lord White Avian looked at Perfected Lord Crimson Peace and said with a smile, “I’m heavily injured. I’ll call it a win if I can suppress Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.”
Perfected Lord Crimson Peace nodded in satisfaction.

chapters.title: Chapter 739 - Injuries
chapters.content:
Chapter 739: Injuries
In his homeworld, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star stood on a tall mountain as he observed the outside world through the world membrane.
Perfected Lord Crimson Peace can’t crack the protective law, nor can he kill me as long as I hide in my homeworld.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star pondered.
The time of an Eighth Tribulation Eminence is much more precious than my time. It’s impossible for him to keep watching me. When Perfected Lord Crimson Peace leaves, I can send an outer realm true body out to attack again. Unfortunately... this time, the Life Core fell into Perfected Lord Crimson Peace’s hands with the death of my outer realm true body.
The treasures he obtained from ordering the Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature to devour an inhabited world were naturally moved to his homeworld as soon as possible. Apart from some treasures and weapons, his outer realm true body only carried one Seventh Tribulation Life Core.
Although his heart ached for the Life Core, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star could bear such losses.
Oh?
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s expression changed slightly.
What is Perfected Lord Crimson Peace doing?
Through the world membrane, he could see Perfected Lord Crimson Peace scattering streams of light around this world. Celestial Thearch Myriad Star could tell that Perfected Lord Crimson Peace was setting up a fixed array!
He could only watch helplessly, not daring to leave.
Moments later...
The massive array formation circulated and naturally condensed chains that appeared over the world membrane as though they were part of it. Nearly 10,000 chains completely sealed the entire inhabited world, isolating it from the outside world.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star could no longer see through the world membrane, nor could he sense the outside world. He was even isolated from Nebula Palace.
I can’t sense the outside world.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was somewhat flustered. He took a step and appeared at the highest point in the world. He looked up at the membrane wall above him and stared at the huge chain that appeared. He observed the profundities contained in the chain.
I can’t sense the outside world even though I have grasped the spacetime law?
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was somewhat anxious. He knew that high-level worlds had similar array formations that completely isolated them from the outside world. Unless one was at the Eighth Tribulation realm, they wouldn’t be able to find such high-level worlds.
However, he also knew that such array formations cost a lot! Therefore, Eighth Tribulation Eminences typically only set up one for their homeworld.
How was it possible for such a large array to be set up just to imprison him?
Buzz—
The vast array formation activated, and the aura of power that spread out was very familiar to Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
“White Avian, are you presiding over the array?” shouted Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
The sealing array was in operation, but Hall Lord White Avian ignored him.
“I can guess it even if you don’t say it.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s voice transmitted into the array formation. “An array formation that completely isolates spacetime is very rare. However, the strongest among the deities in high-level worlds are only at the Sixth Tribulation realm, and at best, the Seventh Tribulation realm. They are unable to power such an array formation perfectly. It’s because the array formation absorbs external powers that it can naturally operate for extended periods.
“This array isn’t operating naturally. It’s controlled by a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence like you. That’s how Perfected Lord Crimson Peace could set up the array formation in a short period of time. However, you are a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence. Are you going to continue wasting your time with me?
“You are also at the Physical Body Tribulation realm. You only have one outer realm true body. If you waste your time here with me, you will be destroying more than half of your cultivation future,” said Celestial Thearch Myriad Star immediately. “Is it worth it?”
“It’s worth it!” A calm voice sounded.
When Celestial Thearch Myriad Star heard Hall Lord White Avian’s response, he immediately said, “I know that you paid a huge price to invite Perfected Lord Crimson Peace this time. Tell me, what are your conditions before you are willing to let me out!? We can have a good discussion and come up with a condition that will satisfy you. This way, you won’t delay your cultivation.”
“Perfected Lord said that he had given you one last chance, but you gave it up. Now, stay in your homeworld and never come out,” said Hall Lord White Avian coldly.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was taken aback as he immediately said, “White Avian, are you crazy?”
Hall Lord White Avian ignored him.
“You are destroying your future in cultivation. I can swear that I won’t attack your homeworld. I can even swear that I will only devour three more inhabited worlds. When the time comes, I can give you three billion cubes...” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star constantly lowered his requests.
...
Hall Lord White Avian shook his head slightly when he heard Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s conditions. “At this point, you still haven’t given up on devouring inhabited worlds. You live up to your reputation as Myriad Star.”
After fighting for so many years, he had long known Myriad Star’s personality. Therefore, he was willing to pay the price to suppress him. If he gave him free rein, for example, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s madness would only exponentially worsen after tens of thousands of years—when he was nearing the end of his life.
Now, devouring these inhabited worlds was the result of Myriad Star restraining himself.
Standing in the void, Hall Lord White Avian looked around. Perfected Lord Crimson Peace had already left, leaving him alone.
I have to guard this place forever.
Hall Lord White Avian waved his hand, and a cultivation cave abode appeared in the void. Furthermore, the surrounding void was completely concealed.
...
An hour later, Meng Chuan, Realm Ancestor, Lord of Shadowfiend, Deputy Hall Lord Blazing Sun, and Deputy Hall Lord Azure Dragon came to Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s homeworld.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s homeworld has disappeared?
Meng Chuan and Realm Ancestor gathered together and looked around in surprise. The void rippled in the distance, and a cave abode appeared. Hall Lord White Avian—dressed in a gray robe—was waiting for them in front of the cave abode.
“Hall Lord.” Meng Chuan, Realm Ancestor, Lord of Shadowfiend, and company came close.
“What happened? Where’s Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s homeworld?” asked Lord of Shadowfiend.
“I can’t sense Celestial Thearch Myriad Star either. Is he dead?” Realm Ancestor’s eyes were filled with anticipation. It would be great if he was dead.
“No.”
Hall Lord White Avian led Meng Chuan and company into the cave abode and sat down in the courtyard. Although there were delicacies and wine in front of them, Meng Chuan and company weren’t in the mood to drink. They wanted to know why Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had disappeared.
“I invited an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, Perfected Lord Crimson Peace, to kill Myriad Star.” Hall Lord White Avian sat there. Knowing their puzzlement, he leisurely said, “However, behind Celestial Thearch Myriad Star is actually Black Fiend Ancestor. Black Fiend Ancestor gave him a life-preservation method... Even Perfected Lord Crimson Peace was affected by Black Fiend Ancestor’s array formation. He couldn’t crack the world membrane and kill Myriad Star’s true body inside his homeworld.”
“Perfected Lord Crimson Peace? Black Fiend Ancestor?” Meng Chuan and company were somewhat shocked. Two Eighth Tribulation Eminences were involved.
Hall Lord White Avian waved his hand. Meng Chuan and company looked past the courtyard and saw a massive inhabited world appear in the outside world. Nearly 10,000 chains wrapped around the inhabited world.
“Myriad Star’s homeworld is here,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “Perfected Lord Crimson Peace set up an array formation and completely sealed off this inhabited world. Celestial Thearch Myriad Star will forever be trapped in his homeworld, unable to take a step out.”
“Unable to step out forever?” Realm Ancestor revealed a look of delight when he heard that. “He won’t be able to wreak havoc in the outside world. If he can’t come out, his future in cultivation will mostly be destroyed.”
Realm Ancestor was rather satisfied that things had developed to this stage. After all, how could a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence be easy to kill?
“This array formation can trap a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence?” Azure Dragon was alarmed. As the dragons’ current leader, he knew how difficult such an array formation was.
“This array formation can only be presided over by cultivators who have grasped the spacetime law,” explained Hall Lord White Avian. “Otherwise, it won’t be able to trap Myriad Star.”
Meng Chuan, Lord of Shadowfiend, Realm Ancestor, Azure Dragon, and Blazing Sun looked at Hall Lord White Avian in shock.
They understood.
Apart from Myriad Star, only Hall Lord White Avian grasped the spacetime law. In other words, Hall Lord White Avian needed to maintain the array formation and couldn’t take half a step away.
It affected his cultivation greatly.
“You will never be able to leave this place in the future?” Lord of Shadowfiend asked softly.
“How can there be no price for trapping Myriad Star?” said Hall Lord White Avian worriedly. “However, I’m already injured. I only have 50,000 to 60,000 years left. I can’t trap Myriad Star forever.”
“You’re injured?” Meng Chuan was alarmed. He had never known about this before.

chapters.title: Chapter 740 - Bottleneck
chapters.content:
Chapter 740: Bottleneck
“I’ve also checked through my dragon race’s records,” said Deputy Hall Lord Azure Dragon. “Hall Lord’s injuries were caused by an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence. It’s very difficult to treat them.”
“There are only two ways to treat it by relying on external forces,” explained Hall Lord White Avian with a smile. “The first way is to get the help of a legendary Eternal existence. Eternal existences are omnipotent, so it’s naturally easy for them to treat me. The second way is to get the help of an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence. They will be able to expel the alien power left behind by another Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence in my Essence Soul.”
“Can’t you find an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence?” asked Meng Chuan.
Since Hall Lord could invite Perfected Lord Crimson Peace to take action, perhaps he could think of a way to contact an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
“Eastcalm,” said Deputy Hall Lord Azure Dragon, “the universe is vast and endless. The distance between universes is extremely great. Even an Eighth Tribulation Eminence will take a long time to travel. Furthermore, Eighth Tribulation Eminences have their own cultivation plans. Occasionally, they will sleep for billions of years or even longer.
“It’s very difficult for an Eighth Tribulation Eminence to encounter another Eighth Tribulation Eminence. It’s even harder to find an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence. Even if we do find one, an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence won’t be willing to spend a long time rushing to our universe just to treat Hall Lord.”
“The most pragmatic method is to find an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence in our universe.” Azure Dragon shook his head. “However, it’s already difficult to seek an audience with an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. We can’t do anything to seek an audience with an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence from our universe.”
“There are very few Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminences born in our universe,” said Hall Lord White Avian with a sigh. “The difficulty of seeking an audience with an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence is more than a hundred-fold harder than seeking an audience with a Physical Body Eighth Tribulation Eminence.”
It was too difficult.
There were ultimately dozens of Physical Body Eighth Tribulation Eminences. Although most of them had gone into hibernation, some were still relatively active.
For example, Dragon Ancestor, Black Fiend Ancestor, and Fiend Mountain’s owner—who were concerned about their home universe—often appeared.
None of the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminences often appeared!
It wasn’t that Hall Lord White Avian hadn’t tried coming up with solutions, but many of them didn’t work. It was too difficult to meet an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
“Although Myriad Star has cultivated for slightly longer than me, he isn’t affected by injuries. After 50,000 to 60,000 years, I will die because of my injuries. If I don’t have a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence presiding over the array formation, Myriad Star will escape when the time comes,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “Once he comes out, Myriad Star—who only has tens of thousands of years left—will definitely be even crazier. The harm he will cause will probably be much more terrifying than now.”
Everyone present nodded.
“Meng Chuan.” Hall Lord White Avian looked at Meng Chuan and said solemnly, “It’s up to you. Before I die, become a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence and help me take over this array formation.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
He respected Hall Lord very much. Furthermore, Hall Lord had sacrificed too much to resolve the scourge that was Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
One could imagine the price of hiring Perfected Lord Crimson Peace, an Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
White Avian also assigned his only outer realm true body to constantly guard this place. The price for destroying most of his future in cultivation was even greater.
He believed that Celestial Thearch Myriad Star would definitely give Hall Lord White Avian a large number of benefits if the latter showed any mercy. Furthermore, the former could promise not to attack any of Hall Lord White Avian’s factions.
In this River of Spacetime, many high-level worlds—including Peach Mountain’s owner—were just sitting on the fence! However, Hall Lord White Avian paid a huge price to suppress Celestial Thearch Myriad Star. This saved the lives of countless living beings in the inhabited worlds.
“I will definitely cultivate with all my might and replace you as soon as possible, Hall Lord,” said Meng Chuan.
Hall Lord White Avian nodded.
“It’s such a shame. Dragon Ancestor promised Peach Mountain’s owner that he would help him three times,” said Blazing Sun indignantly. “But no matter how we persuade him, Peach Mountain’s owner refuses to help.”
“You can’t blame him.” Hall Lord White Avian shook his head. “Everyone knows of Dragon Ancestor’s promise. No one is willing to be enemies with Peach Mountain’s owner. Celestial Thearch Myriad Star naturally has long tried to befriend Peach Mountain’s owner. Since they have intertwined karmic ties, Peach Mountain’s owner naturally won’t attack Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.”
“A long game,” Lord of Shadowfiend said.
Meng Chuan nodded.
Myriad Star had tried to rope him in as well. Even he would probably have karmic ties with Myriad Star if he hadn’t joined White Avian Hall and stood on the opposing side.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star would definitely spend more effort on befriending Peach Mountain’s owner. After all, Dragon Ancestor’s promise to Peach Mountain’s owner threatened Myriad Star’s plans.
...
In a dark chamber, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star sat cross-legged, his eyes cold.
White Avian is really crazy. He would rather have an outer realm true body spend time with me and destroy more than half of his cultivation future.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was rather aggrieved and indignant. He had also offered Hall Lord White Avian many conditions, but they were all useless.
White Avian clearly wanted to suppress and trap him to his death. Although he could see the future and knew that Hall Lord White Avian would be at odds with him, he couldn’t divine certain matters since an Eighth Tribulation Eminence was beyond the River of Spacetime.
He never expected Hall Lord White Avian to hire Perfected Lord Crimson Peace to deal with him.
I’ll be trapped like this forever?
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star pondered.
Forget it. I’ll just treat it as a form of seclusive cultivation. I have two volumes of the Eternal formulation, Bloodline, on hand. I still have more than 100,000 years of lifespan left. If I focus on cultivation, I will definitely become stronger. Furthermore, I still have two Seventh Tribulation Life Cores.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star waved his hand, and two Life Cores appeared in front of him: a short saber and a wooden hut.
I gathered a total of eight Seventh Tribulation Life Cores. I originally devoured five,and left three behind. One is in the hands of Perfected Lord Crimson Peace. There are only two left.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s eyes were cold as he made a decision.
Now, I just need to try my best and devour the last two Life Cores. It can increase my talent.
If it was just to control forbidden creatures to devour inhabited worlds, one or two would be enough. However, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had collected eight Seventh Tribulation Life Cores. This was because he was curious as to why Fiend Mountain’s owner was collecting Life Cores.
He had gathered a Seventh Tribulation Life Core and carefully studied it. In the endless spacetime, all phenomena had their intrinsic profundities. After all, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had grasped the two cornerstones—time and space. After careful consideration, he had truly figured out something profound. Later, he obtained insights from the first volume of Bloodline that he had obtained from his sacrifices, allowing him to perfect the devouring formulation completely.
His devouring formulation might not be as good as Fiend Mountain’s owner’s devouring means, but he could already absorb a portion of a Seventh Tribulation forbidden creature’s talent and fuse it with his body. Therefore, he had been eyeing the Seventh Tribulation forbidden creatures in the Chaos Turbid River all this time. However, he had captured all of the easy targets. The few left were much harder to capture.
He had long devoured five Life Cores, leaving behind only three to do his bidding.
This time... he devoured the remaining two. He wanted to go further on the path of cultivation!
As long as I become stronger, I don’t even need to transcend the tribulation. As long as I cultivate an Eighth Tribulation realm body, I should be able to destroy this sealing array formation completely.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star abandoned all his fantasies and focused on his cultivation.
...
Time passed. In the distant Dry Origin Mountain, Meng Chuan cultivated.
It’s been 6,000 years since I came to Dry Origin Mountain.
Meng Chuan sat in front of his desk and frowned slightly as he looked at the painting. He wasn’t too satisfied as the painting returned to a blank state.
I’m still stuck at the final bottleneck with regards to the temporal law.
Meng Chuan frowned.
He had naturally grasped the three parts of the temporal law—the past, present, and future. After all, Meng Sha Realm’s treasures could be exchanged for a large number of supplementary cultivation items. He had obtained the opportunity to kill Chaos creatures on Dry Origin Mountain, greatly increasing his talent in the temporal lineage.
With the Painting Dao mystic technique that an Eternal had imparted to him, it was very easy for him to grasp the three basic parts.
However, combining these three parts to form a complete temporal law stumped Meng Chuan.
This bottleneck lasted for 1,000 years. Meng Chuan remained confused.
The temporal law is indeed not that easy to comprehend.
It’s time to kill the next Chaos creature.
Meng Chuan stood up and walked out of the wooden hut, heading toward the prison cell on Dry Origin Mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 741 - Confusion
chapters.content:
Chapter 741: Confusion
There were many Chaos creatures imprisoned on Dry Origin Mountain. Meng Chuan also wanted to kill a peak Seventh Tribulation Chaos creature, but he had made many attempts. His Essence Soul avatar was forced to dissipate every time. If it didn’t dissipate on its own accord, it would be devoured by the Chaos creature.
It wasn’t that he didn’t want to defeat them—he just wasn’t strong enough!
According to the intelligence provided by Senior Brother Thousand-Hands, one had to reach the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm before they had a chance of killing a peak Seventh Tribulation Chaos creature.
Meng Chuan didn’t give up on his attempts. He understood the accuracy of the intelligence. Although he was only one step away from grasping a complete spacetime law, it was extremely difficult to take that final step. For example, Guild Master Fiend Eye, Lord of Li Rainbow, Realm Ancestor, and the others had long grasped the three basic parts of the temporal law, but they were unable to fuse them into a complete temporal law.
There were many Seventh Tribulation Eminences in every generation. There were also many who grasped the three basic parts of the temporal law. However, the number of half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences was much lower.
The difficulty was this tiny sliver.
This sliver is the greatest obstacle to becoming a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
Meng Chuan stood in the spatial cell as 3,000 Heaven Splitting Blades floated around him, their might affecting the surroundings.
He was surrounded by a distorted spacetime maze.
An ugly, massive Chaos creature was hiding in horror. Its eight short legs were thick and powerful. With a blink of its four eyes, it could easily construct an illusion. In terms of strength, it was on the same level as the Ouroboros from before. However, Meng Chuan was clearly much stronger than when he killed the serpent.
Meng Chuan cast the array formation as he pleased, cracking the Chaos creature’s numerous attacks.
An illusion cast by a Chaos creature?
As an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, Meng Chuan was good at illusions. He had studied the 3,000 illusory arrays, making his attainments in this aspect stronger than this Chaos creature that relied on talent.
In a head-on battle? He could easily crush his opponent.
“Apart from the Samsara of Time, you don’t seem to have any other powerful moves.” Meng Chuan shook his head slightly when he saw the Chaos creature fleeing in fright.
Go.
With a thought—
The 3,000 Heaven Splitting Sabers formed a chain of saber beams that swept in all directions.
The Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Array’s fourth transformation—As Desired Saber Chain.
With this sweep, the spacetime maze was sliced apart like tofu, revealing the hiding Chaos creature. It tried to dodge in panic, but it couldn’t dodge the Heaven Splitting Saber Chain.
Meng Chuan’s Chaos Hole Heaven Splitting Saber Array had a total of six changes. The fourth change was relatively more controllable, so Meng Chuan could use it easily.
Pfft.
Wherever the saber chain passed, the flow of time changed. Everything happened in an instant. The massive Chaos creature that looked like a lizard had been sliced apart and destroyed, its existence obliterated.
Meng Chuan took a step and arrived in front of the Life Core.
The Life Core was a gray cloth bag.
It’s easy to deal with a top Seventh Tribulation Chaos creature, but I was at an absolute disadvantage when facing a peak Seventh Tribulation Chaos creature, even when using my strongest transformation—the sixth one. I was easily trounced.
Meng Chuan sighed.
It was indeed true that even a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence only had a chance of killing a peak Seventh Tribulation Chaos creature.
Meng Chuan ultimately hadn’t crossed that line. There was still a gap between him and a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
No matter how dazzling a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence was in history, they would at most be praised as someone who was close to the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm.
Whoosh.
The gray cloth bag had a hint of turbid aura. The moment Meng Chuan reached out and touched the gray cloth bag, the cloth bag completely disintegrated like sand and dissipated into the void.
The mysterious power contained in the Life Core—a cloth bag—completely fused with Meng Chuan’s body. Meng Chuan very familiarly left the spatial cell and silently waited for the fusion to end.
The devouring process to obtain mysterious powers ended in just an hour.
The benefits this time aren’t that obvious.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged on a withered, yellow grassland on Dry Origin Mountain and carefully took in the experience.
Due to his previous transformation, he had some talent as a Chaos creature of the temporal lineage. This time, there were very few changes.
I didn’t even form any talent moves.
Meng Chuan sighed.
His gains made it easier for him to control time at a more micro level.
Just like how birds could fly and how fish could swim, Meng Chuan could now control time more precisely. With the fusion of time and space, Meng Chuan didn’t need any talent moves. He could create an illusion with his own insights—Samsara of Time.
Compared to the illusory world—Samsara of Time—my improved control over time is somewhat beneficial to my cultivation.
Meng Chuan naturally had all sorts of plans for controlling time and space.
As for the temporal law, I still have no idea how to combine the past, present, and future.
Meng Chuan frowned.
He kept feeling like he had improved, but he couldn’t break through the bottleneck. He couldn’t even infer the process clearly.
In fact, he had already grasped the temporal law’s three foundational aspects during his first 5,000 years on Dry Origin Mountain. He had cultivated for another 1,000 years before killing the second Chaos creature, hoping to accumulate more insights.
Meng Chuan hoped that he would have an obvious breakthrough if he accumulated enough insights and gained a new talent.
How do I fuse them? The continuation of the past is the present. The present is also the future of the past.
Meng Chuan shook his head slightly.
As part of the temporal law, the trifecta affected each other.
The past and the present.
The present and the future.
The past and the future.
The connections were too strong, and there were too many directions. However, Meng Chuan was left at a loss no matter which direction he attempted. None of them gave him any confidence.
There’s no clear idea or direction. I’ve just obtained some new talent, but I don’t have any new ideas either.
Meng Chuan fell into deep thought.
Grasping the laws of time and space was equally difficult for Chaos creatures. The spacetime law wasn’t something that could be grasped with just a little talent.
At this moment, it’s not very helpful to immerse myself in cultivation. I need a flash of inspiration and some stimulus.
Meng Chuan came to a decision.
Forget it. I’ll travel around; I’ll take a closer look at my home universe. After cultivating for so many years, there are many places in my home universe that I haven’t been to. For example, I’ve always wanted to go to Nine Tribulations Planet, but I’ve never been there.
...
Eighth Tribulation Eminences had gone far in terms of time and space.
Time and space were only two major tools they used to study the endless spacetime. The ruins they left behind contained the direction of their cultivation path. Meng Chuan decided not to cultivate arduously. Instead, he traveled and cultivated as he looked around.
The places he saw were naturally the ruins left behind by an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. Although Dry Origin Mountain was left behind by an Eternal existence—and perhaps because it was created by an Eternal existence, Meng Chuan couldn’t comprehend anything.
The mountains were mountains, the trees were trees, and the vegetation was vegetation—everything was ordinary.
If it was destroyed, everything could be restored. The profundities were opaque, making it difficult for Meng Chuan to comprehend them.
On the contrary, Meng Chuan could comprehend a lot of the marks left behind by Eighth Tribulation Eminences.
Nine Tribulations Planet.
The white-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan arrived above a massive planet. The entire planet emitted an endless baneful aura. The baneful aura was so thick that Fifth Tribulation Eminences could only watch from afar. Sixth Tribulation Eminences might be able to approach the planet, but they couldn’t descend to the planet’s surface.
Nine Tribulations Planet is impressive.
Meng Chuan looked down and sighed in amazement.
From high up in the sky, mountain ranges undulated across the planet’s surface as rivers flowed everywhere.
They naturally formed paintings, and the nine paintings covered the entire planet’s surface.
Using the planet as a canvas and the mountains and rivers as brushstrokes, this is a freely drawn painting.
Meng Chuan nodded.
However, the beauty can’t hide the baneful aura.
Meng Chuan slowly descended.

chapters.title: Chapter 742 - Three Thousand Years of Traveling
chapters.content:
Chapter 742: Three Thousand Years of Traveling
Translator:
CKtalon
Nine Tribulations Planet was very famous, but no one knew who its creator was. Was it an Eighth Tribulation Eminence from their universe? Or was it a foreign Eighth Tribulation Eminence who had traveled here and had been inspired to produce the painting?
Everything was possible.
With Meng Chuan’s realm, he could determine the nine paintings’ order just by looking at them. By using the Eternal mystic technique—the six-stroke runic seal—he could see the changes in the nine paintings from afar.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan landed on the first painting. It was also the first painting drawn by the mysterious Eighth Tribulation Eminence on Nine Tribulations Planet.
This painting was composed of five large lakes, four swamps, a large plain, and rivers that connected between them. This painting was the most ordinary of the nine paintings. When Meng Chuan landed on the plain, baneful aura immediately surged toward him.
Whoosh!
Three thousand tiny Dark Chaos Holes floated around Meng Chuan; they only protected him for 500 kilometers. They only defended and didn’t attack, allowing the baneful aura to strike at them.
If one falls into the Nine Tribulations Painting, they will be attacked. However, this is ultimately a baneful aura that’s triggered by the painting. It’s not deliberately set up by the Eighth Tribulation Eminence; it’s not very powerful. Even a newly-advanced ordinary Seventh Tribulation Eminence can withstand the first five paintings. A top Seventh Tribulation Eminence can also walk through all nine paintings.
This is the crux of the first painting.
Meng Chuan studied it for an hour. His Essence Soul avatar—which was far away on Dry Origin Mountain—had instead been studying it for more than a day.
After comprehending the first painting completely, he took a step and walked to the crux of the painting. This seemed like an ordinary region, but the baneful aura’s influence had weakened to a negligible level for up to a kilometer.
The second painting.
Meng Chuan flew toward the second painting.
...
Meng Chuan stayed in the first painting for an hour. He stayed in the second painting for six hours.
Meng Chuan stayed in the sixth painting for a month and a half.
Meng Chuan stayed in the seventh painting for three years.
Meng Chuan had stayed in the eighth painting for ten years. Considering the 33-fold faster time flow on Dry Origin Mountain, Meng Chuan had truly spent an astonishing amount of time.
Boom!
Dark waves surged in the vast ocean as the baneful aura shook the world.
The ocean and over 3,000 islands formed the terrifying eighth painting. Just the baneful aura contained in the eighth painting required a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence to resist it with all their might.
What a powerful spear art.
In Meng Chuan’s eyes, the ocean and islands were in the form of a spear.
The spear danced as the universe trembled.
Time for the ninth painting.
Meng Chuan had stayed here for ten years. After gaining some insights, he couldn’t help but walk toward the ninth painting.
The ninth painting was the highest mountain range on Nine Tribulations Planet.
The towering mountain controlled everything in the river and land. When Meng Chuan walked in, he felt the pressure the ninth painting exerted on him. However, the baneful aura was scattered and unsystematic. The threat it posed was greatly reduced; it was far inferior to the eighth painting’s might.
A pity.
Meng Chuan was very disappointed. He shook his head gently.
That Eighth Tribulation Eminence wanted to create a spear art of a higher realm. He wanted to attempt creating a spear art at the ninth Heavenly Tribulation realm, but he clearly has flaws. It’s inferior to the eighth painting. The first eight paintings are a complete set of spear arts, while the ninth painting is flawed.
Although Meng Chuan could use Painting Dao mystic techniques to supplement his cultivation with regards to textual legacies, it would still be very difficult for him to cultivate them. But if the creator fused their insights into a painting, it would be easier for Meng Chuan to understand it.
He was more sensitive to paintings.
Meng Chuan had only roughly comprehended the spear art contained in Nine Tribulations Planet’s first eight paintings after staying there for more than ten years. He settled down in Nine Tribulations Planet for 30 years before he truly comprehended a complete ultimate technique.
What an amazing spear art. It’s the most domineering and strongest ultimate technique I’ve ever seen.
Meng Chuan already had a complete set of spear arts in his mind. He had completely extracted the spear art from the painting, but he still couldn’t completely comprehend some of the moves. After all, he was only a top Seventh Tribulation Eminence.
It’s no wonder he dared to attempt to create a spear art at the Ninth Tribulation realm. This Eighth Tribulation Eminence... might not be far from Dragon Ancestor.
Meng Chuan had seen Dragon Ancestor and other existences create universes. He had also comprehended the complete spear art from the nine paintings. Therefore, he could roughly determine the level of this mysterious Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s strength. At the same time, he guessed that the creator of Nine Tribulations Planet’s paintings wasn’t from his universe.
This was because the strongest person in his universe was Dragon Ancestor. Next were Fiend Mountain’s owner and the others. None of them were famous for their spear arts.
Although I’m an Essence Soul Seventh Tribulation Eminence, I can fuse the spear arts into my Essence Soul World and the array formation.
Meng Chuan was rather delighted. He never expected to learn the strongest mystic technique he knew to date from Nine Tribulations Planet. Although the Eternal mystic technique—six-stroke runic seal—was the most valuable, it was a supplementary formulation and not used for combat.
Meng Chuan determined that this spear art was nearly comparable to Dragon Ancestor’s universe creation. After all, he had learned many Eighth Tribulation mystic techniques over the years, but none of them could match this spear art.
...
After staying on Nine Tribulations Planet for 43 years, Meng Chuan headed to the ruins left behind by other Eighth Tribulation Eminences.
Sword Refinement Cave—which contained thousands of swords—Nightmare Planet, which could trap Seventh Tribulation Eminences, and the strange Black Mountain Cave Abode on a black mountain that floated in the void... Most of the ruins left behind by Eighth Tribulation Eminences weren’t dangerous to the current Meng Chuan.
He roamed around and studied the traces left behind by Eighth Tribulation Eminences. Although he didn’t comprehend a powerful ultimate technique like the Nine Tribulations Spear Art, he gained many scattered insights.
Meng Chuan traveled across his home universe for over 100 years, covering all the Eighth Tribulation Eminences’ ruins.
After all, there were too few ruins; there were only a few dozen of them. Meng Chuan spent the most time at the painting ruin—Nine Tribulations Planet. He spent much less time elsewhere.
As Dry Origin Mountain’s time flow was 33 times faster than his home universe, Meng Chuan’s century of traveling actually resulted in him cultivating for more than 3,000 years. A significant portion of the time was spent at Nine Tribulations Planet.
I’ve gone to all the Eighth Tribulation ruins that I can find in my home universe.
Meng Chuan stood above a huge handprint and recalled his travels over the years. He had been following the Eighth Tribulation Eminences’ footprints, and these different footprints... ultimately had something in common—the spacetime law.
Meng Chuan’s understanding of the temporal law became clearer.
Without focusing on how to fuse them, just the large number of scattered insights made his overall understanding gradually become clearer.
Meng Chuan understood that he would probably be able to completely grasp the temporal law in 10,000 to 20,000 years if he continued accumulating insights, even if he didn’t experience any additional stimulus.
Although Hall Lord White Avian had reached the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm in less than 30,000 years, he should perform better after obtaining an Eternal opportunity.
But Meng Chuan also understood a principle—cultivation was not a competition.
He couldn’t rush it! More haste, less speed!
Oh right.
Meng Chuan recalled another Eighth Tribulation ruin—Fiend Mountain!
I’ve been studying the temporal law all these years. I haven’t been to Fiend Mountain in a long time. I wonder if I can reach the peak. I wonder what’s on Fiend Mountain’s peak?
With this in mind, Meng Chuan took a step toward Fiend Mountain.

Chapter 743: Epiphany
Translator:
CKtalon
Fiend Mountain World.
Meng Chuan walked on the path of the mind and looked up at the tallest mountain peak. Over the years, generations of cultivators had replaced one another on this path. However, Fiend Mountain remained unchanged. The loud voice on the mountain peak remained eternal and indestructible.
Swoosh.
He advanced step by step along the path of the mind. With each step, he traversed 50 kilometers. Meng Chuan quickly arrived at the limit of his previous journey—49,000 kilometers.
Oh?
Meng Chuan stopped. The mountaintop’s voice echoed in his Essence Soul like rolling thunder; the pressure was immense.
It looks like my willpower hasn’t improved much since the last time I was here.
The last time he came, he had grasped the Chaos Hole law and created his Essence Soul formulation, Painting World.
Compared to his previous visit, he had only grasped an additional Origins law—the Heaven Splitting law. Although he had studied the temporal law for many years, he ultimately hadn’t broken through. It was within his expectations that his willpower hadn’t improved much.
So many years have passed after all. After transcending the tribulation and grasping an additional Origins law, my Essence Soul World is even more stable... Perhaps I have a chance of reaching the mountaintop. With this in mind, Meng Chuan advanced step by step.
The voice on the mountaintop became louder.
49,500 kilometers, 50,000 kilometers, 50,500 kilometers...
As Meng Chuan walked slowly, his view of the mountaintop became clearer. He could even see a faint golden glow on the mountaintop.
The moment he saw the golden light, Meng Chuan felt an endless attraction. His instincts told him to rush over!
It’s getting harder and harder.
Meng Chuan persisted.
The mountaintop’s sound now had an increasing impact on his Essence Soul, but he didn’t gain anything. At his current realm, it was very difficult for his mind and willpower to improve at all.
51,000 kilometers, 51,500 kilometers, 51,750 kilometers...
I can’t go any further.
Meng Chuan stopped. At the moment, he was around the 51,950 kilometer mark.
This is my current limit. It looks like there’s still a gap between my willpower and Senior Realm Ancestor’s. Senior Realm Ancestor has long reached the top.
Meng Chuan was confident. This was because he had been focused on cultivation in recent years; he didn’t spend much effort on the Essence Soul formulation. As long as he fused the Heaven Splitting law and the temporal law’s three foundational aspects into his Essence Soul formulation and continued perfecting it, he believed that his mind and willpower would improve. That way, he would definitely be able to reach the mountaintop. He was only a short stretch away from the mountaintop.
Looking up, Meng Chuan could confirm that he was 550 kilometers away from the mountaintop.
With his current realm, even though he was suppressed by Fiend Mountain, the distance of 550 kilometers was already very close. Meng Chuan could clearly see the mountaintop.
A faint light barrier covered the entire mountain peak. A large number of golden runes flowed across the barrier’s surface as they emitted a faint golden glow.
The golden glow—which Meng Chuan had vaguely seen—originated from these textual runes.
These textual runes are the words I heard from the mountaintop.
Meng Chuan looked at the words. The dozens of words connected into one sentence. The words flowed and appeared one after another. They were in a mess, and Meng Chuan couldn’t distinguish the order of each sentence. However, he could at least see a complete sentence.
Meng Chuan didn’t recognize the words, but every sentence was like a vast world blasting into his mind. He gained many insights.
These golden textual runes had the same sentence. Different cultivators gained different insights from seeing them. They could understand them in diverse ways... It was like the source of all truths.
This sentence was very profound.
The profundity of the sentences formed by the flowing textual runes on the mountaintop shocked Meng Chuan. He vaguely felt that if these textual runes could be combined into a complete volume, it would probably surpass any ultimate technique he had seen before.
One sentence, two sentences, three sentences...
Meng Chuan raised his head and looked at the mountaintop. He looked at the words and sentences. When he saw the fifth sentence, many insights surfaced in his mind. One of his newfound insights was like a burst of light in the darkness, completely illuminating Meng Chuan’s puzzled mind. It allowed Meng Chuan to gain a new direction for his already great accumulation of temporal law insights. He quickly consolidated them.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar dissipated like a bubble. Here, he would constantly be affected by the mountaintop’s sound. At that moment, he had to eliminate all interference and grasp this inspiration.
...
In a mountain forest on Dry Origin Mountain.
The black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan sat cross-legged on a thick, soft, and withered leaf. Making use of his inspiration, he quickly consolidated his insights.
The three basic elements of the temporal law: the past, present, and future laws. These three laws were very naturally integrated. Each had the other as a part of itself, and they gradually fused together.
It was just like how the three primary colors could form a large number of colors when combined.
These three laws—the past, present, and future—could similarly fuse into a large number of outcomes. Only one was perfect; that was the true temporal law.
Finally, I’ve grasped its essence.
Meng Chuan opened his eyes. His eyes were filled with endless colors as he extended his hand and gently clenched it.
A small, complete spacetime naturally appeared in his palm. The space was stable, and the time flow was only 1% of the outside world. It operated steadily.
Meng Chuan looked around greedily. His hierarchy in life clearly hadn’t changed, but the way he looked at things became different. Everything in the world became ten times more dazzling in his eyes.
Take a distant wild flower for example. In the past, Meng Chuan could see the smallest leptons in the wild flowers. The plant lifeform with countless fluctuations, the various effects it had on space, and the billions of naturally existing particles passing through the wild flowers—nothing could hide from Meng Chuan. He could even easily see the wild flowers’ entire timeline—growth from the past to their future withered days. The wild flowers in his eyes were a complete life cycle.
However, the scene Meng Chuan saw had now changed.
Billions of particle threads? Countless fluctuations? Impact on space? A single time period? These were too superficial.
Meng Chuan saw the laws represented by these superficial appearances, and the countless complicated laws originated from time and space.
Time and space were the two cornerstones of all laws.
Meng Chuan could see that the temporal law and spatial law’s influence formed countless microscopic laws. Only by combining these countless laws did the beautiful world appear.
Laws.
Meng Chuan looked at the mountain, the trees, the flowers, the flowing water...
He was looking at mountains, rivers, and trees, but in reality, he was looking at countless laws. He also saw countless laws formed by time and space. This feeling was wonderful.
There was no more confusion!
Omniscience!
He seemed to know the essence of everything.
No
. Meng Chuan woke up when he saw the endless fog around Dry Origin Mountain. The fog contained endless profundities and was terrifying. Even Eighth Tribulation Eminences would be courting death if they dared to barge in. The profundities contained in the fog were countless times more complicated than flowers and trees.
Meng Chuan clearly knew that the endless profundities contained in the fog definitely stemmed from time and space. However, it was too complicated; he couldn’t understand it.
Only then did Meng Chuan wake up. He was still far from being omniscient.
Although everything in the endless spacetime originates from the two cornerstones—time and space—the more profound something is, the harder it is to comprehend. For example, I can’t comprehend Physical Body Eighth Tribulation Eminences and Eternal treasures.
Meng Chuan understood this point.
Even if an Eternal existence was known for being omniscient, it was very difficult to create an existence like Senior Brother Thousand-Hands—who was comparable to an Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
At the very least, I’ve taken the most important step today. I’ve truly grasped the two cornerstones of all laws—time and space.
Meng Chuan smiled.

chapters.title: Chapter 744 - Half-step Eighth Eminence Meng Chuan
chapters.content:
Chapter 744: Half-step Eighth Eminence Meng Chuan
Translator:
CKtalon
Archean Eon Realm, in a concealed space in Heaven and Earth Great Hall.
Sitting cross-legged beside the Eternal treasure seal, Meng Chuan opened his eyes. He looked at the lake of dark-red blood in front of him before looking up at the floating Eternal treasure seal.
The blood of an Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
Meng Chuan immediately saw the endless profundities formed by the blood lepton. Although it wasn’t as terrifying as the fog around Dry Origin Mountain, it was still difficult for him to comprehend it in a short period of time.
I need at least 10,000 years to comprehend it completely.
Even if he comprehended it, it didn’t mean that he could create an Eighth Tribulation body formulation. After all, a perfected body was definitely perfectly compatible with him. He had to create it himself!
Eternal treasure.
Meng Chuan waved his hand, and the gray seal landed in his hand.
Under Meng Chuan’s control, the gray seal’s might was completely restrained. It didn’t dissipate at all.
If the Origins law could barely unleash a sliver of the seal’s might, then the spacetime law was enough to reveal its true horror.
What a terrifying Eternal treasure.
Meng Chuan could clearly sense the Eternal treasure’s laws. This law represented destruction. From the different phases of time and space, this law destroyed everything.
Meng Chuan felt that by using the spacetime law, he could unleash ten-fold or even dozens-fold his strength.
With this, I might be able to fight an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. But if I’m exposed, I’m afraid all Eighth Tribulation Eminences will descend at this time node and awaken. All of them will come to snatch the Eternal treasure. Archean Eon Realm can’t stop a group of Eighth Tribulation Eminences. Just as Ancestral Master Archean Eon said, I have to reach the Eighth Tribulation realm before I can reveal it. Otherwise, it will be a disaster,
Meng Chuan thought to himself.
For people like Dragon Ancestor—who had cultivated to the Eighth Tribulation realm’s limits—they could create a universe. Even if they had three to five Eternal treasures, nobody dared to eye them.
If they cultivated to the top Eighth Tribulation realm like Fiend Mountain’s owner and Black Fiend Ancestor, it would be very difficult for them to be killed if Eternal existences didn’t take action. It was also normal for them to have Eternal treasures.
An ordinary Eighth Tribulation Eminence holding an Eternal treasure would probably spell disaster. For example, the pool of blood in front of him represented a Physical Body Eighth Tribulation Eminence that had died.
Perhaps I have to become an Eternal existence’s disciple before I can publicly reveal the Eternal treasure.
An Eternal existence’s disciple had a very special status in the endless spacetime. As Daolord Evodia had said, although Dragon Ancestor and the others were powerful, they could be killed by an Eternal existence. However, an Eternal existence’s disciple... could be pulled back from the spacetime of the past by his master if they died.
Of course, if they died of old age, there was nothing that could reverse the outcome. It was a death caused by the decline of one’s willpower. Even if they were pulled back from the spacetime of the past, the weakened mind would still be unable to bear the strength of their body. There was no way for them to live; even an Eternal existence couldn’t save them.
After cultivating for over 16,000 years, I’ve finally reached the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm.
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
Apart from his talent, resources also played a very important factor. For example, others could only comprehend the laws of spacetime operation, but he could comprehend the laws of spacetime operation and the Great Seal Eternal treasure. These two laws—which were of the same level—didn’t provide much immediate help, but the effects were very lasting and profound after extended periods of cultivation.
On the other hand, he also had an opportunity from Dry Origin Mountain.
Every person with great accomplishments had opportunities. Celestial Thearch Myriad Star and Hall Lord White Avian had great opportunities! However, opportunities only favored talented people! Otherwise, those without talent would be wasting those opportunities.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan’s gaze swept across the grotto-heaven and Goddess River Zone. He saw a couple on a bustling planet in a distant river zone—Planet Azure.
Planet Azure was a bustling planet with Eternal Tower’s river zone headquarters. It also had a Sixth Tribulation Eminence presiding over it. There were more than ten Fifth Tribulation Eminences as well. The couple who ran the Treasure Repository here was Meng An and his wife.
Meng An had already cultivated to the Fourth Tribulation realm! He was considered an expert on Planet Azure, but he didn’t stand out. After all, there was a Sixth Tribulation Eminence presiding over it.
An’er and his wife’s outer realm true bodies have settled on Planet Azure?
Meng Chuan thought to himself. His son and daughter-in-law had been wandering the outer realm. After settling on Planet Azure, they didn’t leave. They seemed to have fallen in love with life there.
Planet Azure was indeed very prosperous and beautiful.
Such days are very comfortable.
Meng Chuan smiled.
His son—Meng An—had once been ‘whipped’ by Ancestral Master Archean Eon, preventing him from daring to slack off on his cultivation. In the early days, he had been subjected to many cruel tests. Now, he had completely relaxed and enjoyed a comfortable life.
That’s quite good too.
Meng Chuan’s gaze turned, and he saw another area dozens of river zones away.
Seven Tribulation Eminences gathered on a ship. Meng Yu was inside.
“Since everyone has accepted this mission through the academy, we need to work together,” said the leader of the crimson rock creatures. “If anyone breaks the agreement, they will be pursued by the other six of us. Furthermore, it will be reported to the academy.”
“Everyone understands the consequences of breaking the agreement. Chisuo, it’s the first time the other six of us have met. We aren’t familiar with each other, so do the introductions please,” said an elder with a huge calabash on his back.
“Alright.” The scarlet rock creature nodded. He first pointed at the thin Meng Yu, who was dressed in a loose robe. “This is Brother Meng Yu. He’s the only one in our team who hasn’t joined the academy. I personally invited him. He seems to be the weakest at the Fourth Tribulation realm, but I can guarantee that his strength isn’t inferior to mine! We have a life-and-death relationship.”
“Oh?” The other five companions were all Fifth Tribulation Eminences. They looked at Meng Yu in surprise.
A Fourth Tribulation Eminence can match a Fifth Tribulation Eminence?
“Brother Chisuo is just being polite. Only my sword technique is passable,” said Meng Yu with a smile. “My means aren’t as comprehensive as a true Fifth Tribulation Eminence’s. When the time comes, I hope you can watch over me.”
...
In Archean Eon Realm, Meng Chuan looked at his grandson, Meng Yu, from afar.
Of the descendants in my Meng family, Meng Yu is the strongest. He will probably reach the Fifth Tribulation realm after cultivating for another few millennia.
Meng Chuan’s heart ached for his grandson.
This was because Meng Yu had long been roaming Earth Cloud Mystic Realm alone. He had suffered all sorts of hardships. Now, he was tempering himself while roaming the outer realm. He wanted to share his grandfather’s burden.
He had no idea that his grandfather was already a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
I’ve now reached the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm. If I successfully transcend the tribulation and become an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, many people in my homeworld will be able to transcend Samsara. However, Yu’er was born in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm. Archean Eon Realm’s River of Spacetime doesn’t recognize Yu’er, so I can’t make him transcend Samsara.
Meng Chuan understood this point.
Meng Yu could only rely on his cultivation to create a new world.
Although Meng Chuan felt that he was ruthless to his grandson, he felt that he had to temper him and watch him from the shadows since his grandson had talent.
Compared to other cultivators, he already has a lot of resources.
Although Meng Chuan allowed his grandson to be tempered, he secretly gave him opportunities.
Once he becomes a Fifth Tribulation Eminence, I believe he will know more about the River of Spacetime. He will also know about City Lord Eastcalm, Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan frowned slightly.
When that happens, I won’t be able to hide it anymore.
Forget it. When he becomes a Fifth Tribulation Eminence, I won’t be able to hide the situation in Earth Cloud Mystic Realm from him. When the time comes, I’ll have to tell him. As a Fifth Tribulation Eminence... he definitely can take some blows.
Meng Chuan turned his gaze and looked into the distance.
It was Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s homeworld.
It’s time to meet Hall Lord.
Meng Chuan was very impressed by Hall Lord. He had always wanted to reach the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm as soon as possible so that he could take over.
For an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence like him, sending an Essence Soul avatar to preside over the situation was nothing. However, to Hall Lord... he was relegating his only true outer realm body to guard it.
...
Huh?
