Outside Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s homeworld, Hall Lord White Avian—who was presiding over the array formation—was somewhat puzzled.
Why is Meng Chuan here?
He could sense Meng Chuan’s location through karma.
He looked up. The black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan had already traversed the distant spacetime and arrived in the void.
Boom!
Hall Lord White Avian’s spacetime domain collided with Meng Chuan’s spacetime domain. Although they weren’t enemies, the clash of domains still caused Hall Lord White Avian’s expression to change.
The other Seventh Tribulation Eminences’ domains were ordinary Origins domains. They were domains formed by various Seventh Tribulation laws.
As for the spacetime domain, it was at the Eighth Tribulation realm.
Previously... in this era, only Celestial Thearch Myriad Star could fight him head-on.
“Meng Chuan, you?” Hall Lord White Avian was surprised and delighted.
“I just broke through today, so I immediately came to see you, Hall Lord,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 745 - Fate
chapters.content:
Chapter 745: Fate
Translator:
CKtalon
Although Hall Lord White Avian had high hopes for Meng Chuan, Meng Chuan’s speed of growth exceeded his expectations.
How long has it been since he reached the Seventh Tribulation realm? He has already reached the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm?
“Ever since I suppressed Celestial Thearch Myriad Star, I’ve only been presiding over the array formation for slightly more than a hundred years.” No matter how strong White Avian’s mental state was, he couldn’t help but chuckle. “I’d already made preparations. Even if I delay my cultivation, I’ll just waste it out with Celestial Thearch Myriad Star. Yet, you came to replace me today. I was caught off guard by your cultivation speed.”
Although Hall Lord White Avian claimed that he was caught off guard, he was actually grinning from ear to ear.
“I was lucky to make a breakthrough in my cultivation,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “After comprehending the three fundamental laws of time, I fell into a bottleneck. I was stuck at the bottleneck for nearly 5,000 years; I only broke through when I saw the peak of Fiend Mountain.”
“I can only make a vague judgment about your cultivation time now... It isn’t more than 20,000 years,” said Hall Lord White Avian with a sigh. “You reached the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm after cultivating for more than 10,000 years. You even said that you spent nearly 5,000 years stuck at a bottleneck. If other Seventh Tribulation Eminences hear you, they would probably secretly curse you for showing off.”
“Actually... I’m just showing off,” said Meng Chuan with a smile. “After cultivating for so many years, I’ve finally reached the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm. It’s only right for me to show off.”
“I’ll hold a celebration for you at Nebula Palace in a few days so that you can show off as much as you want,” said Hall Lord White Avian with a smile.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had been suppressed. The two of them were the only two half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences in the present era, and the two of them could decide the order of the entire River of Spacetime.
He felt a lot more relaxed now.
“There’s no need for a celebration.” Meng Chuan shook his head. “It’s gratuitous.”
“Alright, up to you.” Hall Lord White Avian nodded.
If it were a half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminence or an ordinary Seventh Tribulation Eminence, they would need to celebrate. However, there was no need for any superficial ceremonies after becoming a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence. Who in the entire spacetime dared to be disrespectful to a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence?
“Come, I’ll teach you how to manage this array formation,” said Hall Lord White Avian.
“Alright.” Meng Chuan followed and learned how to control the array formation.
...
In the suppressed inhabited world, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star appeared out of thin air at the peak of a tall mountain. He looked up at the world membrane and the chains that appeared. The aura emitted by the sealing array changed.
This array formation’s aura has changed?
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s face was somewhat pale.
This is... Meng Chuan’s aura?
At that moment, he was somewhat dazed; he even felt despair.
The one presiding over the array formation was clearly White Avian. Why has it become Meng Chuan? Meng Chuan has also grasped the spacetime law?
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was somewhat flustered.
Meng Chuan was an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence. It was very easy for him to send an Essence Soul avatar to preside over the array formation; it didn’t affect his cultivation at all. Furthermore, Meng Chuan was too young. He could continue this battle of attrition.
He became a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence so quickly. With his growth speed, how can I escape his obstruction?
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was truly indignant.
I deduced the future and predicted that Meng Chuan’s future would be very terrifying. It’s very easy for him to reach the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm. Therefore, I didn’t dare delay. I started my machinations ahead of time to prevent myself from being obstructed by Meng Chuan!
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had long deduced the future. If he delayed for too long, his plan of devouring inhabited worlds would be heavily obstructed when Meng Chuan reached the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm.
This was because Meng Chuan had many Essence Soul avatars. After becoming a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence, the threat he posed was much greater than Hall Lord White Avian. For example, he could send an Essence Soul avatar to follow Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s outer realm true body for a long period of time and use an array formation to intercept him.
Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences were good at array formations.
I launched the plan ahead of time, but White Avian hired an Eighth Tribulation Eminence to set up an array formation to suppress me.
I’ve only suppressed him for slightly over 100 years, and Meng Chuan has already reached the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm. I still have to face their encirclement?
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star only felt grief and indignation.
This was fate. No matter how he dodged, Meng Chuan and Hall Lord White Avian were still two obstructing mountains in front of him.
“Meng Chuan!” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star shouted; his voice transmitted through the world membrane.
“Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.” A calm voice sounded.
“I never expected you to reach the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm so quickly. Impressive,” said Celestial Thearch Myriad Star. “Meng Chuan, I—Myriad Star—have never been your enemy all these years, have I? I’ve always wanted to befriend you, but you are cornering me to this state?”
“I did not corner you; you did it to yourself.” Meng Chuan’s voice traveled down. “You are insatiable. You ordered the forbidden creature to devour inhabited worlds wantonly. Even Perfected Lord Crimson Peace couldn’t stop you when he appeared, forcing him to set up an array formation to trap you. Who can you blame? As long as you don’t devour inhabited worlds, Hall Lord White Avian, me, or Realm Ancestor—who will deal with you? If you had stopped midway, you wouldn’t have ended up like this.”
“Understood.” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star said indifferently, “However, don’t you think that you are being too nosy? If it doesn’t threaten your homeworld, why do you care so much?”
“Myriad Star, the laws of spacetime have the principle of protecting inhabited worlds. This is the bottom line. An inhabited world is a cradle of countless lives.” Meng Chuan’s voice boomed. “You crossed the bottom line, so you are a scourge if you live. You deserve death.”
“Haha, deserve death!” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star laughed hideously. “If you have the ability to kill me, do it. You can only waste your time outside. When I break through the array formation and rush out, I will make all of you nosy ones pay the price! Even if you die, your homeworlds will be destroyed one by one.”
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s eyes were filled with madness. He only had one goal now: create an Eighth Tribulation body formulation and storm his way out!
“Don’t worry; I’ll kill you.” Meng Chuan’s cold voice sounded. No matter what Celestial Thearch Myriad Star said, he couldn’t be bothered.
...
Everyone knew that Hall Lord White Avian presided over the array formation to suppress Celestial Thearch Myriad Star, saving the entire River of Spacetime from a calamity.
However, the various factions could sense that Meng Chuan’s avatar appeared after Hall Lord White Avian left the array formation.
I heard that one has to grasp the spacetime law to control that array formation. Once Hall Lord White Avian left, Eastcalm presided over it?
City Lord Eastcalm has reached the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm?
All parties naturally had their speculations.
Soon, White Avian Hall announced—
City Lord Eastcalm had already become a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence of the Essence Soul lineage! He had sent an Essence Soul avatar to suppress Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
Boom!
This news shocked everyone in the River of Spacetime.
Half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence? In this era, there were three half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences. This was extremely rare in the River of Spacetime’s history.
Most importantly, he was of the Essence Soul lineage! Furthermore, Meng Chuan had cultivated for a much shorter period than White Avian and Myriad Star. His talent was even more terrifying.
He became a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence after cultivating for over 10,000 years?
Origin Realm Chieftain, who thought highly of himself, originally believed that he would be the strongest Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence in the present era after Realm Ancestor died. However, while Realm Ancestor was still alive, an Essence Soul half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence had already appeared.
“What a monster,” muttered Origin Realm Chieftain.
...
“He’s already at the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm?” In front of the bamboo forest lake, Realm Ancestor felt that the world was unpredictable.
He wasn’t dead yet.
It’s only been 900 years since I first met him.
Realm Ancestor also felt that everything had happened too quickly. Back then, Meng Chuan had yet to transcend the sixth Heavenly Tribulation.
It was only because it was rare for the Cang Alliance to produce someone with talent that I suddenly suggested meeting him. He’s already a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence after 900 years?
Realm Ancestor also knew that Meng Chuan’s actual cultivation time was much longer because of opportunities like Earth Cloud Mystic Realm.
However, Realm Ancestor was already nearing the end of his lifespan. He only had a few thousand years left.
After 900 years, he was still close to the end of his lifespan. However, Meng Chuan had already reached the strongest level of the present generation. He was comparable to Hall Lord White Avian and Myriad Star.
...
Back then, I plundered Meng Chuan.
The gray-robed, black stone golem—Guild Master Darkstar—sat cross-legged in his chamber as he pondered in frustration.
In the blink of an eye, he has already reached the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm. As long as he’s willing, he can easily crush my outer realm true body. What should I do?
Reverberations were sent throughout the entire River of Spacetime due to the news of Meng Chuan becoming a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
All parties needed to consider how they should face a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence from the Essence Soul lineage.

chapters.title: Chapter 746 - The Sound on the Mountaintop
chapters.content:
Chapter 746: The Sound on the Mountaintop
Translator:
CKtalon
Outside Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s homeworld, Meng Chuan’s cave abode had become very lively recently. Eminences came to visit, but Guild Master Darkstar was the last to arrive.
“I was foolish and ignorant.” The black stone golem, Guild Master Darkstar, was extremely respectful and sincere at the cave abode entrance. “It’s you, City Lord Eastcalm, who completely enlightened me. Cultivation still depends on oneself. Unorthodox means will not last long. No matter how much you accumulate... you will have to spit it all out after a single failure.”
“It’s good that you understand.” Meng Chuan didn’t even let the other party enter the cave abode. “I hope you will behave yourself in the future.”
“I understand, I understand. I will definitely remember what City Lord Eastcalm said and abide by it forever,” said Guild Master Darkstar respectfully. He couldn’t help but glance at the golden ring placed at the cave abode entrance.
His heart ached. Ninety percent of the treasures he had accumulated over the years were in the golden ring; he had given them all to City Lord Eastcalm.
For this visit... he had made many preparations. He first befriended Meng An and his wife—who were living in seclusion on Planet Azure. He then requested Meng An to help pass a message, hoping that City Lord Eastcalm would be lenient. He was willing to accept any conditions.
Meng Chuan had indeed raised a condition: Disband the Darkstar Guild! From now on, they weren’t allowed to plunder any longer. Furthermore, he had to hand over 90% of the treasures he had accumulated over the years. By requesting only 90%, it was considered as leaving the other party with something.
Guild Master Darkstar felt bitter. However, this chance of being forgiven was very rare. If he missed it, it would be gone.
Ninety percent of the treasures? His treasures were sourced from many different places—exploring some ruins, occupying some treasure lands, obtaining fortuitous encounters, and so on. The treasures he truly plundered were only a portion of them. How could he not feel the pinch when he had to hand over 90% of all his treasures?
But if Meng Chuan didn’t forgive him, he wouldn’t be able to roam the outside world.
Take Black Fiend Hall’s Lord of Li Rainbow for example. As the current leader of Black Fiend Hall, he had to follow Black Fiend Hall’s operating rules. Countless Black Fiend Hall members were still scattered across the River of Spacetime. They continued plundering... Therefore, the grudge between him and Meng Chuan couldn’t be resolved. Black Fiend Hall Master’s outer realm true body didn’t dare to take a step out of Black Fiend Hall!
Meng Chuan couldn’t enter Black Fiend Hall either.
However, Lord of Li Rainbow was naturally aggrieved about being trapped in his homeworld and Black Fiend Hall forever.
Thus, Guild Master Darkstar was willing to disband the Darkstar Guild and offer 90% of its treasures in exchange for freedom! He could slowly accumulate treasures in the future.
Humph, although I have befriended various factions, I’d also keep my distance from them.
Guild Master Darkstar was rather smug.
Myriad Star always said that I was short-sighted! No matter what he says, I refused to join Six Directions Heaven.
Black Fiend Hall Master also called me a small fry. He wanted me to join Black Fiend Hall, where I could earn a cut from the plundering done by countless Black Fiend Hall members. However, I still chose not to get involved. There’s no way out if I’d completely tied myself to Black Fiend Hall. Though I’m short-sighted and timid, I have a way out at the very least.
After receiving City Lord Eastcalm’s forgiveness, Guild Master Darkstar felt much more relaxed. This was under the premise that he didn’t think of the treasures he had offered.
...
The various factions in the River of Spacetime had different attitudes when facing Meng Chuan.
For those who had a good relationship with him—such as Guild Master Fiend Eye, who had always helped Meng Chuan—he didn’t make any requests, nor did he ask for any promises from Meng Chuan. However, Meng Chuan took all of this to heart.
In the future, if Guild Master Fiend Eye made a request and didn’t cross his bottom line, he would naturally do his best to help him as a way to resolve any karmic debt between them.
The various factions that he had ordinary relationships with tried to get closer to Meng Chuan. Even high-level factions sent their members to pay a visit. Many factions even took the initiative to give up some of their treasure lands in the River of Spacetime.
As a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence of the Essence Soul lineage, Meng Chuan could probably occupy more than half of the treasure lands in the River of Spacetime if he wanted to!
This was because he had many Essence Soul avatars! Each avatar had terrifying combat strength, making them much stronger than Hall Lord White Avian.
Black Fiend Hall had the greatest conflict with him!
Black Fiend Hall had Black Fiend Ancestor backing it, so Meng Chuan couldn’t destroy its organization system. Even if he could, he wouldn’t dare.
Meng Chuan suppressed Black Fiend Hall within a certain range! If he really were to destroy Black Fiend Hall’s foundation and cause Black Fiend Ancestor to descend into this era, there would be endless trouble.
The greater the strength, the greater the burden. If the burden is too heavy, it will crush me.
Meng Chuan knew very well that only by becoming an Eighth Tribulation Eminence and becoming a disciple of an Eternal existence could he stand on par with Black Fiend Ancestor.
...
At the height of 51,500 kilometers on Fiend Mountain, the black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan walked step by step.
Although my Essence Soul formulation hasn’t been completely perfected, I have grasped the spacetime law. The law nourishes my mind and will. My willpower should be enough to reach the peak.
Meng Chuan could sense that his willpower had indeed improved after comprehending the spacetime law. However, his Essence Soul World still couldn’t withstand the evolution of the spacetime law.
An Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence required extremely high willpower. He was still far from it.
Whoosh. Whoosh.
As Meng Chuan walked step by step, the phenomenon on the mountaintop became clearer. The golden textual runes emitted light that attracted Meng Chuan’s attention.
52,500 kilometers!
I’ve arrived.
Meng Chuan took the final step and officially reached the end of Fiend Mountain’s paths. He arrived at the mountaintop.
In front of him was a huge barrier with golden textual runes flowing around it. He was at arm’s length when a voice suddenly sounded in his mind.
“Upon reaching the peak of Fiend Mountain, one can attend an Eternal’s lecture.”
At the same time, a large amount of information was sent over.
Meng Chuan was alarmed.
On Fiend Mountain’s peak, the mighty voice recorded the scene of an Eternal existence’s lecture.
An Eternal existence’s lecture placed immense pressure on one’s willpower! Without reaching a certain level, one wouldn’t be able to listen to the complete lecture. Only by reaching the mountaintop did one have the right to withstand the complete lecture. However, Fiend Mountain’s owner had enveloped it with an array formation; he wouldn’t easily give it to cultivators for free.
Listening to the Eternal existence’s lecture was a huge opportunity bestowed by Fiend Mountain’s owner to cultivators who came to Fiend Mountain. However, one had to pay the price before they gained anything.
Different cultivators received different benefits from listening to the lecture.
Once they comprehended a mystic technique, they had to send it deep into Fiend Mountain and give it to Fiend Mountain’s owner to sever the karma.
If the mystic technique was Colorless, it was the lowest grade. It could be sent deep into Fiend Mountain.
If the mystic technique was Purple, one could awaken Fiend Mountain’s owner in the depths of Fiend Mountain. Fiend Mountain’s owner could then bestow them with something worth up to a billion cubes.
If the mystic technique was Gold, one could awaken Fiend Mountain’s owner. Fiend Mountain’s owner could bestow them with something worth up to 100 billion cubes.
Mystic techniques are graded by colors?
Meng Chuan was puzzled. He had learned many formulations, including an Eternal formulation—six-stroke runic seal. He had never heard of mystic techniques that were graded by color.
Perhaps the lecture this time is special?
Meng Chuan looked at the barrier in front of him.
According to Fiend Mountain’s owner, one can just leave if they aren’t willing to listen.
As long as he walked through the light barrier and listened to the complete Eternal lecture, he would be bound to Fiend Mountain’s owner by karma. To resolve the karma, Fiend Mountain’s owner had to be given a set of the mystic techniques that Meng Chuan comprehended.
I naturally have to listen to an Eternal’s lecture.
Although Meng Chuan had an opportunity at Dry Origin Mountain and might be able to acknowledge an Eternal as his master in the future, he had yet to become a disciple. He had yet to transcend the tribulation.
Secondly, according to what he knew, the Eternal existences that stood at the peak of endless spacetime were omnipotent. They even took the initiative to pass down many formulations.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan stepped through the barrier and saw a blurry figure in the middle of the mountain.
The blurry figure’s face couldn’t be seen clearly. Meng Chuan could only determine that it was a bald, towering figure.
The bald, towering figure sat cross-legged. Voices spread out in all directions, echoing in the mountaintop.
Meng Chuan thought of the Eternal treasure, Great Seal. When he came into contact with the Great Seal, he had seen a bald, towering figure that was identical to the one in front of him.
The same Eternal existence?
Meng Chuan didn’t think further. He immediately sat cross-legged and listened carefully.
Voices seeped into his mind and echoed in his Essence Soul World. Golden textual runes floated down from his Essence Soul World.

chapters.title: Chapter 747 - First Meeting with Fiend Mountains Owner
chapters.content:
Chapter 747: First Meeting with Fiend Mountain’s Owner
Translator:
CKtalon
In Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World, golden textual runes floated down and condensed into sentences. The sentences formed paragraphs, and the paragraphs gradually condensed into a chapter.
As he listened, a large number of insights surged into his mind. Meng Chuan listened like he was intoxicated. Now that he had grasped the two cornerstone laws of time and space, he could use them to comprehend all profundities. However, he needed an endless amount of time to comprehend them.
As for the Eternal lecture, it explained everything.
Eternal and without doubts—they had truly comprehended everything. Just a few simple sentences were enough to enlighten benighted people.
Meng Chuan was shocked and impressed.
Comprehending the Dao in the morning leaves one content even if one dies in the evening. An Eternal existence represented the pinnacle of the Dao.
Unknowingly, he had been listening to the lecture for more than two hours. After finishing the lecture, Meng Chuan snapped out of his daze. Although the mighty voice on Fiend Mountain’s peak continued to repeat itself, having the lecture repeat didn’t help much. Meng Chuan had completely memorized it.
He already had the complete lecture in his mind.
This opportunity bestowed by Fiend Mountain’s owner is truly a huge opportunity.
Meng Chuan also felt that Fiend Mountain’s owner was indeed ‘generous’ to leave such an opportunity here for any capable person. However, there were too few people who could reach Fiend Mountain’s peak with their willpower. If one’s willpower wasn’t strong enough, they wouldn’t be able to withstand the lecture. Even a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence might not be able to reach the peak.
Instead, those from the Essence Soul lineage had a higher chance of reaching the mountaintop.
According to what Meng Chuan knew, only a handful of people reached Fiend Mountain’s peak in every era.
If I obtain such a huge opportunity, I naturally have to give part of it to Fiend Mountain’s owner.
Meng Chuan felt that Fiend Mountain’s owner’s request was reasonable.
Fiend Mountain’s owner had even taken the initiative to bestow benefits if one offered Purple and Gold mystic techniques. This showed his personality—Fiend Mountain’s owner could choose not to give anything. It was only right for Meng Chuan to pay him back with a mystic technique after obtaining the opportunity he offered.
If the mystic technique was brilliant enough, he even took the initiative to bestow more gifts. This filled Meng Chuan with curiosity toward Fiend Mountain’s owner.
...
In Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, Meng Chuan lived in seclusion in a valley as he pondered over the Eternal lecture.
No medium can contain this lecture?
Meng Chuan sat in the study and attempted to write on an ancient stone slab. However, the words vanished as soon as he finished writing. It was as though an invisible law had prevented him from doing so. Meng Chuan pondered,
For example, Eighth Tribulation Eminences can pass down legacies through special mediums, which typically have limited impartation chances. The Eternal lecture seems to have higher requirements.
I can’t even record the textual runes, yet Fiend Mountain’s owner could record the complete lecture?
Meng Chuan sighed in amazement.
He listened to the lecture on the mountaintop, so he naturally had memories of it. However, it was extremely difficult to project the scene in his memories in the outside world. It was like an ant trying to carry a mountain—it was impossible to replicate it.
I can’t record it or reproduce it. Fiend Mountain’s owner also didn’t restrict me from spreading it.
Meng Chuan gave up trying and began to study the lecture carefully.
The entire lecture consisted of 16,059 characters.
Every sentence had endless meanings. When the sentences were combined, they were even more profound.
Meng Chuan was completely immersed in it. His Essence Soul avatar—which was far away on Dry Origin Mountain—was also focused on studying it. After grasping the Painting Dao mystic technique—six-stroke runic seal—Meng Chuan was used to dissecting his target into six layers to comprehend any ultimate technique.
Meng Chuan only stopped studying the lecture after 320 years under Dry Origin Mountain’s time acceleration.
I’ve finally finished comprehending it.
In Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World, six layers of paintings were formed. Each layer was an understanding of the lecture, and the six layers of paintings were completely different.
It’s only 16,059 characters. With my Essence Soul’s speed of comprehension and perception, I took 320 years to finish comprehending them.
Meng Chuan sighed in amazement.
Given my current realm, I’ve comprehended everything I can. Next, I need to fuse the six-layered insights into one.
Meng Chuan familiarly combined them.
After grasping the six-stroke runic seal mystic technique, he had done the dissection and comprehension of matters before fusing them into one too many times.
In less than a year, a complete mystic technique appeared in Meng Chuan’s mind.
Hum.
The complete mystic technique had over 60,000 words. When Meng Chuan condensed a chapter in his Essence Soul World, the entire mystic technique chapter emitted a purple glow.
I’ve figured it out.
Meng Chuan smiled.
The Eternal lecture focused on one’s willpower. The mystic technique one created based on it would also emit light from one’s mind.
The purple light was the level of the mystic technique Meng Chuan had comprehended.
After creating the mystic technique he had been studying all these years, Meng Chuan’s willpower had transformed. However, he still couldn’t withstand the evolution of the spacetime law. Clearly, an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence required terrifying willpower.
I really have to thank Fiend Mountain’s owner for greatly strengthening my willpower. I have to give him a copy of this mystic technique now.
Meng Chuan searched for paper and other items and tried to record it down.
He realized that it was similarly difficult to record it down. In the end, he used a piece of Ice Wonder Jade—worth more than 10,000 cubes—as a medium to record the entire mystic technique. Furthermore, he felt that this piece of jade would collapse after learning it once.
I’ve never heard of such a willpower mystic technique before. I don’t know its exact value either, but after Fiend Mountain’s owner obtains it, he’s willing to give up to a billion cubes... The value of this mystic technique should exceed one billion cubes.
Meng Chuan knew that it was precious, but due to his limited horizons, he didn’t know its true value.
He was a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence of the Essence Soul lineage. At his realm, it was extremely difficult for his willpower to improve by even a tiny bit. However, this mystic technique allowed him to transform!
To an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, the improvement of their willpower meant an extended lifespan!
...
Deep in Fiend Mountain was an ancient cave abode.
As long as one accumulated 1,000 Sixth Tribulation Life Core fragments, 10 Seventh Tribulation Life Cores, or at least a Purple-grade mystic technique, they could come here to awaken Fiend Mountain’s owner. If one didn’t have enough treasures, they would be courting death if they dared to awaken Fiend Mountain’s owner.
“Senior Fiend Mountain,” shouted Meng Chuan as he stood in front of the ancient cave abode. He had taken the initiative to awaken Fiend Mountain’s owner.
As soon as he finished speaking—
The dark-red cave abode door slowly opened as Meng Chuan stepped in.
After walking for a moment, Meng Chuan saw a figure sitting cross-legged in front of him. His posture was identical to the Eternal existence on the mountaintop; it also had a similar charm.
His hair was curled as though there was an endless space hidden within it. His body—which was sitting cross-legged—seemed to be filled with endless pressure, making Meng Chuan feel pressured.
He was like a statue, motionless. However, the pressure he exerted on Meng Chuan was too great. Facing him, Meng Chuan was like an ant facing a celestial body! It was as though a single wave of energy could annihilate him.
Fiend Mountain’s owner gives me a terrifying feeling. In front of him, a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence can be annihilated with a thought.
Meng Chuan understood this point.
Whoosh.
The seated figure slowly opened his eyes. The time flow within a ten-foot radius returned to normal.
Two pocket universes were hidden in his eyes. Meng Chuan was extremely certain of this when he saw Fiend Mountain’s owner. This was because at his realm, Fiend Mountain’s owner’s eyes had become even larger than Supreme Yang Stars.
Meng Chuan could clearly see stars in his eyes, and cultivators were flying in the cosmos.
His two eyes contain two pocket universes? And his hair—every strand of hair is an independent spacetime?
Meng Chuan sensed the other party’s aura, but Fiend Mountain’s owner didn’t hide it.
“You’ve cultivated for 17,000 years, and you’re a half-step Eighth Tribulation realm of the Essence Soul lineage?” Fiend Mountain’s owner had a smile on his lips. His eyes were vast and unfathomable as he observed Meng Chuan; his voice was even gentler. “Furthermore, I can see one of your Essence Soul avatars in a distant spacetime. It emits a boundless Eternal aura.”

chapters.title: Chapter 748 - The Fate of Celestial ThearChapter Myriad Star (Final Chapter of Volume)
chapters.content:
Chapter 748: The Fate of Celestial Thearch Myriad Star (Final Chapter of Volume)
Translator:
CKtalon
“To catch the eye of an Eternal existence before you reach the Eighth Tribulation realm is very rare,” said Fiend Mountain’s owner with a smile as he sat cross-legged. “But if you want to become a disciple of an Eternal existence in the endless spacetime, you have to be at the Eighth Tribulation realm at the very least. Therefore, the most important thing for you now is to transcend the eighth Heavenly Tribulation and become an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence.”
“Senior Fiend Mountain, I totally agree.” Meng Chuan nodded.
“The physical body is real, and the Physical Body Tribulation also targets the body. The Essence Soul Tribulation is much more troublesome. There are much fewer Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminences in the endless spacetime. Perhaps this is the rule set by the endless spacetime... Physical Body Tribulation Eminences can only have one avatar, while Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences can have nine avatars.” Fiend Mountain’s owner sighed and smiled at Meng Chuan. “I’m looking forward to our universe producing an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence.”
“I also want to transcend the tribulation successfully, but my willpower is clearly far inferior. I don’t even have the right to transcend the tribulation,” said Meng Chuan.
“You still have plenty of time.” Fiend Mountain’s owner said leisurely, “Even if you become an Eternal existence’s disciple in the future, you can’t slack off. Many Eternal disciples are only at the ordinary Eighth Tribulation realm. For example, Daolord Evodia of our universe doesn’t seek to improve. He is obsessed with painting... Instead, many people who haven’t become disciples of Eternal existences have reached extremely profound realms. Of course, it’s different for an Eternal’s personal disciple. Their treasures far exceed those of us without any backers. They are slightly stronger than even Dragon Ancestor.”
Meng Chuan naturally knew this based on what Daolord Evodia had said. Personal disciples were also at the limit of the Eighth Tribulation realm. Furthermore, they could obtain an entire set of Eternal treasures tailored for them. Their strength was naturally terrifying.
“I don’t have to think too much about it for the time being. I’ll think about it after I reach the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm,” said Meng Chuan.
“The Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm requires extremely high willpower.” Fiend Mountain’s owner nodded. “By the way, why did you wake me up?”
“I walked to Fiend Mountain’s peak and listened to the Eternal lecture,” said Meng Chuan. “After studying it for years and figuring out a mystic technique, I specially came to give Senior Fiend Mountain a copy.”
“Oh?” Fiend Mountain’s owner smiled and said, “Show it to me.”
Meng Chuan handed it over with both hands.
The Ice Wonder Jade in his hand flew toward Fiend Mountain’s owner. It contained dense words that emitted a purple glow.
“A Purple-grade mind mystic technique.” Fiend Mountain’s owner smiled and nodded.
He had taken many paths in cultivation. One of them was to use the wisdom of all living beings to nourish his body. The Eternal lecture left behind on the mountaintop allowed several people to listen to it in every era. Typically, they had some insights.
Most of them were at the Colorless grade. Occasionally, there were people with high perceptivity when it came to willpower that could create a Purple-grade mystic technique. In history, he had even managed to come across two Gold-grade mystic techniques in his home universe.
The mystic techniques created by other cultivators could only be referenced; they couldn’t perfectly match one’s mind. However, it was ultimately useful to learn more. Fiend Mountain’s owner wasn’t talented when it came to willpower. Over the years, he had only figured out a Purple-grade mystic technique. However, he had learned many mystic techniques, including the two Gold-grade mystic techniques.
He had absorbed a lot of wisdom and finally created a Gold-grade mystic technique that suited him. After all, Fiend Mountain’s owner couldn’t bring himself to purchase a Gold-grade mystic technique just for reference.
Although his method took a long time, the cost was low.
To this day, he was still slowly gathering them. He wanted to gather enough mystic techniques to transform his mystic techniques completely and reach the legendary Rainbow grade. With this, he could become an Eternal existence’s disciple.
“You created a Purple-grade mystic technique with just over 10,000 years of cultivation. Not bad.” Fiend Mountain’s owner had seen his fair share of mystic techniques. With a thought, he had learned this mystic technique.
The Ice Wonder Jade turned to dust.
Although he had only learned the basics, Fiend Mountain’s owner felt that he had gained something.
“What do you want?” Fiend Mountain’s owner flipped his hand, and a thick book floated in his palm. “You can choose anything that doesn’t exceed one billion cubes from this book.”
A Purple-grade mystic technique bestowed a gift worth not more than one billion cubes.
A Gold-grade mystic technique bestowed not more than 100 billion cubes.
Fiend Mountain’s owner respected the crystallization of wisdom. The most important thing about using the wisdom of all living beings to nourish oneself was fairness. Otherwise, it would shake his cultivation foundation.
“Senior Fiend Mountain.” Meng Chuan didn’t take the book. Instead, he bowed. “I hope to exchange this gift for a request.”
“Request? Tell me about it,” said Fiend Mountain’s owner.
There were also differences in requests. If it was too big a request—one far exceeding a billion cubes—Fiend Mountain’s owner naturally wouldn’t care.
“I hope that Senior can kill Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.” Meng Chuan respectfully stated his request. “He is a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence in our era.”
“Celestial Thearch Myriad Star?” Fiend Mountain’s owner muttered softly.
At this moment, Fiend Mountain’s owner’s perception crossed spacetime and passed through the obstruction of Meng Chuan’s array formation. It landed on Celestial Thearch Myriad Star—who was cultivating in his homeworld.
In an instant, Fiend Mountain’s owner saw Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s life experience clearly.
“Although I prefer bestowing treasures and not bullying the weak,” said Fiend Mountain’s owner with a smile as he looked at Meng Chuan, “I’m willing to cut you some slack and kill Celestial Thearch Myriad Star at your request.”
Meng Chuan was overjoyed. “Thank you, Senior Fiend Mountain.”
“Let’s go outside his homeworld.” The moment Fiend Mountain’s owner said that—
Meng Chuan felt spacetime change.
He and Fiend Mountain’s owner had already arrived outside the homeworld.
The two stood side by side in the void.
“Do you need me to stop the array formation?” asked Meng Chuan.
Fiend Mountain’s owner stood by the side and smiled. “There’s no need.”
He stretched out his hand!
Whoosh!
His palm was vast, but it seemed illusory as it easily passed through the array formation. The operating isolation array formation didn’t sense the palm at all. Furthermore, even the world membrane in Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s homeworld remained intact, yet the massive palm had already reached in.
The palm was nearly as large as the world.
...
The path of cultivation is difficult.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star sat on his throne and coldly looked down at the world. His other true body was cultivating in seclusion.
Ever since Meng Chuan presided over the array formation, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star knew that he had an additional opponent other than Hall Lord White Avian—Meng Chuan.
He focused on cultivation, hoping to create his own body formulation. When the time came, he could storm out.
However...
The more he cultivated, the harder it was for him to advance. He didn’t gain anything for a long time, and it was indeed tormenting.
Previously, he had chosen to rely on a large number of treasures to forge his Eighth Tribulation path, but it was done out of no choice. This was because he felt that his chances of succeeding by relying on his own cultivation were too slim if he didn’t rely on external forces. Now, he was suppressed and forced to cultivate arduously.
Huh?
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was astonished to see a vast hand sweep across the entire land and the hidden grotto-heaven.
Another Eighth Tribulation Eminence?
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s scalp crawled as he was horrified. He wanted to resist, but the hand grabbed him this time!
Apart from Celestial Thearch Myriad Star, none of the living beings on the entire continent saw him. It didn’t affect them at all as they continued living their normal lives.
However, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s two bodies were pulled out at the same time.
...
Meng Chuan watched in shock as the hand reached into the inhabited world and scooped Myriad Star up.
Following that, Fiend Mountain’s owner stopped. The array formation and the inhabited world didn’t seem to be affected at all; it was as though they hadn’t been infiltrated at all.
“Take a look.” Fiend Mountain’s owner extended his palm. In his palm were two figures; they were Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s two true bodies. “He’s Celestial Thearch Myriad Star, right?”
The two tiny Celestial Thearch Myriad Stars looked up and saw two massive faces. One was Fiend Mountain’s owner, and the other was Meng Chuan.
“Meng Chuan...” Celestial Thearch Myriad Star immediately said.
“It’s him.” Meng Chuan nodded. They were indeed Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s two true bodies.
“As you wish.” Fiend Mountain’s owner extended his palm, and spacetime in his palm trembled. The two tiny Celestial Thearch Myriad Stars were completely annihilated with a poof, disappearing from this world.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star, a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence, had died just like that.
Meng Chuan watched this scene. It was clearly his request, but he was still somewhat dazed when it actually happened.
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star—who had wreaked havoc in this era—died just like that?
“I look forward to our next meeting.” Fiend Mountain’s owner nodded slightly before disappearing.
Only Meng Chuan was left standing in the void.
Whoosh. Whoosh.
Two figures arrived in the void. They were the thin Hall Lord White Avian and the elderly Realm Ancestor. The moment they arrived, they saw Meng Chuan standing dazedly in the void.
“I sensed Myriad Star’s two true bodies just now, but I quickly lost my connection with them,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “Meng Chuan, he was suppressed by the array formation and isolated from spacetime. I shouldn’t be able to sense him. What happened?”
“I also sensed him,” said Realm Ancestor.
Failure was not an option when suppressing Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
Meng Chuan looked at the two of them. “Celestial Thearch Myriad Star is dead.”
“Dead?” Hall Lord White Avian and Realm Ancestor found it unbelievable. Who could kill a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence hiding in an inhabited world?
“I requested Fiend Mountain’s owner to kill Celestial Thearch Myriad Star just now,” said Meng Chuan directly.
“Fiend Mountain’s owner?” Hall Lord White Avian and Realm Ancestor were momentarily at a loss for words.
Meng Chuan stopped the array formation and revealed Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s homeworld.
Hall Lord White Avian and Realm Ancestor looked at the massive inhabited world.
This inhabited world was no longer isolated, but Celestial Thearch Myriad Star had completely vanished.
They couldn’t determine his location previously, but they could confirm that he was alive. Now, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was no longer present in the River of Spacetime.
He died just like that.
Hall Lord White Avian, Realm Ancestor, and Meng Chuan had many thoughts.
...
Chaos Turbid River.
Fiend Mountain’s owner appeared and extended his hand. Five Seventh Tribulation forbidden creatures and many Sixth Tribulation forbidden creatures hiding in the Chaos Turbid River were all caught in his palm. In the spacetime above his palm, all the forbidden creatures died, leaving only their Life Cores.
This Chaos Turbid River was built by him. It attracted Chaos creatures from the outside world into it. Every time he awoke from his slumber, he would ‘harvest’ it.
These Chaos creatures are all my prey. It’s fine if you kill them, but you actually devoured their Life Cores. Myriad Star, you really deserved death.
Fiend Mountain’s owner’s eyes were cold.
Many Eighth Tribulation Eminences had figured out how to devour Life Cores. However, the Eighth Tribulation Eminences in this universe knew that the Chaos Turbid River was built by Fiend Mountain’s owner and that these Chaos creatures were all prey for Fiend Mountain’s owner.
There was no need to offend Fiend Mountain’s owner for these reasons. Furthermore, Life Cores had very limited uses for Eighth Tribulation Eminences. Only Fiend Mountain’s owner valued them because of the special cultivation method he figured out.
In fact, in a certain era, there would occasionally be half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences who figured out the devouring method and devoured a few. It was fine if Fiend Mountain’s owner didn’t see them in his slumber.
Since he had awakened and Meng Chuan had requested for it, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s fate was sealed!
Final Chapter of Volume—Six-Stroke Painting

chapters.title: Chapter 749 - Tenacity of Life
chapters.content:
Chapter 749: Tenacity of Life
Translator:
CKtalon
Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was dead. Once the news spread, it shocked all the Eminences in the River of Spacetime. After all, he was a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence that had left the River of Spacetime in shock and awe for tens of thousands of years. He had been killed while hiding in his homeworld—this left many Eminences alarmed.
Furthermore, the information they had obtained... was that City Lord Eastcalm had invited an Eighth Tribulation Eminence to infiltrate the inhabited world and kill Celestial Thearch Myriad Star.
How ruthless!
This also made everyone understand City Lord Eastcalm’s personality all the more! In fact, everyone had already guessed it from Meng Chuan’s fight against Black Fiend Hall. This caused some Seventh Tribulation Eminences and half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences to restrain themselves, afraid of angering City Lord Eastcalm.
After all, given that City Lord Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, was at the strongest realm—the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm—in the present era and an Essence Soul Tribulation Eminence at that, he was much more terrifying than Hall Lord White Avian.
One of Hall Lord White Avian’s true bodies was in his homeworld, while the other was busy cultivating. There were many things he couldn’t do.
Meng Chuan had too many Essence Soul avatars... Who wouldn’t be afraid of him if he casually sent a few to roam the River of Spacetime?
...
Archean Eon Realm, Jiang State Capital, Meng Manor.
When night fell, one of the strongest experts in the River of Spacetime—Meng Chuan—accompanied his wife, Liu Qiyue.
Under the night sky, the couple sat beside a peach blossom tree. Beside them was a flask of alcohol.
The couple looked at the massive illusory scene in front of them as scenes played out.
“There are too many people and matters in Archean Eon Realm that have been drowned in the passage of time. Even the history books don’t have records of them.” Liu Qiyue sighed as she looked at him. “If it weren’t for you grasping the laws of spacetime and being able to see the past, I’m afraid these would’ve never been known by the future generations.”
“Originally, I just wanted to see some famous people, such as Ancestral Master Archean Eon, Supremacy Thundergod, and so on. Who knew that I would see so many unrecorded people?” said Meng Chuan with a nod.
“Let’s watch it from the beginning,” said Liu Qiyue. “From the moment Archean Eon Realm was born, I think it’s worth it to see all the important phases that Archean Eon Realm has experienced over 100 million years.”
“Let’s take our time; we have plenty of time,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
Even Ancestral Master Archean Eon didn’t know much about Archean Eon Realm. After all, the earlier it was, the fewer records there were.
In the beginning, there was no system for text. Later on, there were written records, but they would rot in the face of time. The Godfiend system gradually formed, and they used many powerful artifacts to record history.
The earlier the era, the fewer records there were.
They only knew that Archean Eon Realm had been born for over 100 million years. The most prosperous era was in the past one million years!
“Let’s begin.” Meng Chuan and his wife began watching Archean Eon Realm’s history.
Whoosh!
Under the night sky, a huge scene appeared in front of Meng Chuan and his wife. It depicted the past.
Matter-energy gathered in the void, gradually forming an inhabited world. This tender inhabited world in its nascent stages absorbed external powers and slowly grew.
Desolate!
This inhabited world didn’t have any life for the time being. It only had basic rocks, soil, and water. The plants gradually flourished. Following that, all sorts of weak lifeforms appeared, and worms gradually appeared...
“How ancient,” said Liu Qiyue softly.
Meng Chuan was playing the broadcast on speedup. After all, the early inhabited world’s evolution was too slow.
“Humans have appeared.” Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue saw humans appear in Archean Eon Realm for the first time 120 million years ago.
Among the many animals, the most primitive human appeared. The primitive human looked very similar to the current human. However, their fur was lusher, and they were more muscular and barbaric.
Humans didn’t have an advantage when competing with many animals. As a weak race, they were rather miserable. Among the countless animals, there were ferocious beasts. This was because some strange treasures in the inhabited world had transformed into these powerful creatures by chance.
At that moment, there was no complete cultivation system. Powerful ferocious beasts were formed by fortuitous encounters and treasures.
“Humans have gone extinct.” With a flood, the earliest primitive humans were destroyed amidst their struggles.
“Humans are born again.” After millions of years, humans evolved and formed again by chance.
“Humans have gone extinct again.”
Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue watched.
Humans were born and destroyed time and time again.
In the early days, human civilizations were too weak. If they couldn’t withstand the passage of time, they would be destroyed. The so-called destruction would result in countless deaths. Only a small number would survive and evolve into the next human civilization. In worst cases, humans would be wiped out completely. Only after a long period of time would humans evolve again. The inhabited world’s environment would clearly evolve into many species, including humans.
“Survival is truly difficult.” Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue watched everything.
In these eras, humans weren’t any nobler than other beasts. Even Archean Eon Realm had other beasts dominating it. They gradually gained intelligence, but they were ultimately destroyed in the face of time.
The scene Meng Chuan played soon arrived at a point in time 30 million years ago in Archean Eon Realm.
Huh?
Meng Chuan’s expression changed slightly.
“What’s wrong?” Liu Qiyue looked at the scene in front of her and noticed the change in Meng Chuan’s expression.
At Meng Chuan’s realm, he rarely paled in comparison.
“These 15 fleeing humans.” Meng Chuan pointed at the 15 fleeing humans that appeared in the illusory scene. “They are the source of humanity! All humans in this era originate from these 15 humans.”
Meng Chuan watched the scenes first before broadcasting them, so he knew about it ahead of time.
“All humans in this era originate from them?” Liu Qiyue was alarmed. “From these 15 people?”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. As he looked at the past, he revealed it to his wife. His view was different from his wife’s! His consciousness had seeped into Archean Eon Realm’s River of Spacetime’s past. It was as though he had experienced it personally, and the feeling was even stronger.
This generation of primitive humans was still weak across the land. Among them were two inconspicuous human races that fought each other. One race had 86 people, while the other had 135 people.
Due to ploys and other reasons, the larger race—consisting of 135 people—was actually defeated. Fifteen people fled and headed out to sea on wooden boats.
These 15 people were the source of humanity in Archean Eon Realm.
...
After accompanying his wife in watching the development of the human race’s origins, Meng Chuan couldn’t help but return to the study and begin painting.
It had been a long time since he had such passionate desires.
In front of the desk, he unfolded the painting and put down his brush.
With this painting, Meng Chuan forgot about time—he forgot about day and night. When Liu Qiyue discovered this scene, she naturally forbade anyone from disturbing Meng Chuan.
A long painting gradually formed.
On the rightmost side of the huge painting was a wooden boat with 15 primitive humans fleeing from the land.
After that, the wooden boat arrived at a lone island on a flaming mountain.
They lived and procreated on an isolated island.
After that, the land experienced a terrifying Ice Age. Countless lifeforms were wiped out, and the relatively ordinary humans among many species were similarly wiped out. Correspondingly, the isolated island with the volcano allowed humans to survive the cold.
The lone island had a limited area. As they continued to reproduce, the food on the land became insufficient. Therefore, humans found new habitats and headed to other islands or even land.
The path of migration allowed this race to form a ‘spirit of conquest.’ They would conquer new places and build new homes.
They would be heroes.
Generations of people inherited the spirit of conquest and risked their lives to find new homes.
The continental land was countless times larger than isolated islands. This branch of humanity relied on their two legs to cross mountains and rivers.
When they encountered a suitable place, they stayed behind. Some people continued advancing; they also encountered harsh environments and ferocious beasts. Some died while the living continued walking and searching for new homes.
Now that the species was large in number, there were branches that spread out in all directions.
Generation after generation...
Miraculously, this branch of humanity relied on humans’ reproduction capability to pass down the torch generation after generation. In 3,000 years, their species spread across the entire continent!
This was 3,000 years after the Ice Age. Countless large species were wiped out during the Ice Age. Many animals on the land were in a weak state, allowing this branch of humanity to have a chance of conquering some of the remnant ferocious beasts and completely infiltrate the continent. With the number advantage, humans occupied the mainstream position on the entire continent for the first time.
Humans were intelligent. With a large number of them, their ability to resist disasters increased. They also began to form a cultivation system, and humans eventually became the masters of this world.
Thus, the tribal era began.
Meng Chuan’s paintings focused on how humanity passed on the torch generation after generation. They transcended death and danger and ultimately conquered the entire land.

chapters.title: Chapter 750 - More Than Ten Thousand Years Later
chapters.content:
Chapter 750: More Than Ten Thousand Years Later
Translator:
CKtalon
These people actually managed to conquer the land.
What Meng Chuan really wanted to paint was this story of land conquest.
In the early days, the human race was nothing to speak of when it came to conflicts between species.
When it came to this generation of humans, they formed a spirit of conquest due to the environment and other factors. With just 15 people, they relied on their two legs and passed on the torch for generations! They actually traveled across the land and became the ruler of the entire continent.
In that primitive era, this was an unimaginable miracle.
After all, there were many ferocious beasts with special bloodlines during that barbaric period. The natural environment was much worse than it was now. The primitive mountain ranges, forests, poisonous bugs, miasma, and ferocious beasts... Leaving a safe home and heading to an unfamiliar place meant danger at every turn. Many people would die, and very few people could find a new home.
However, the spirit of conquest in their bones made this generation constantly move forward. When their parents died, they had children to continue the quest. When their children died, they had grandchildren.
It was a generational relay.
After 3,000 years, they traveled across the continent and conquered it.
Meng Chuan could sense his ancestors’ spirit of conquest. He was shocked and proud of his ancestors.
120 million years ago, primitive humans began to appear. The various species fought for supremacy... As these 15 people drifted out to sea 30 million years ago, humanity became the true owner of this inhabited world.
Meng Chuan looked at the long painting in front of him.
Even though danger was everywhere during that period, humans only had 20 to 30 years of lifespan on average.
Even though they didn’t have a complete cultivation system back then, with only incomplete cultivation formulas—
Even though they were few and weak back then—
But just by relying on this—20 to 30 years of lifespan on average and weak strength—to complete an unbelievable miracle, conquering the entire continent.
Meng Chuan had viewed history and knew very well how difficult it was to conquer the continent during that period.
They fought with the environment and other species. Many people died on this path, and the living continued advancing.
Meng Chuan could sense the tenacity of life rushing toward him.
After becoming a Godfiend and a Tribulation Eminence, Meng Chuan took care of the weak. But he also felt that mortals were ultimately very weak even though they were the foundation. A species relied on the strong to stand strong.
However, Meng Chuan saw the tenacity of life through this generational relay—even if they were mortals!
If one generation wasn’t enough, they would take ten generations or even a hundred generations. They could still accomplish things that even Godfiends couldn’t—even if they were mortals!
With the torch passed on for generations, a cultivation system was gradually formed!
As long as one persisted in one direction, they could create unimaginable achievements. This was the source of humanity’s rise.
For him to have his current accomplishments, he was similarly standing on the foundation established by his predecessors. He was only a part of the ‘generational relay.’
“A species,” muttered Meng Chuan. “What’s needed is such tenacity. Only with such tenacity can we overcome all difficulties; only then will we become stronger. Cultivators also need such tenacity. Only with such tenacity can one’s mind become even more tenacious and resist the tempering of time.”
Meng Chuan wrote five words on the rightmost end of the long painting—Tenacity of Life.
Meng Chuan personally painted the human ancestors of that era. Everything was vivid and lifelike. This also caused Meng Chuan’s mind to experience catharsis.
Even my willpower has been affected. It has improved greatly.
Meng Chuan sighed.
His willpower had been tempered too many times. He had even created a Purple mystic technique after listening to an Eternal’s lecture. After reaching this realm, it became harder and harder for him to improve.
Although the painting—Tenacity of Life—had only given him a limited boost, the help a new Purple mystic technique gave to Meng Chuan might not be comparable to the painting.
The higher one’s cultivation went, the harder it would be to improve. This painting had already provided a lot of help.
...
In the following days, Meng Chuan accompanied his wife and continued watching Archean Eon Realm’s history.
During this process, Meng Chuan drew nine epic paintings of Archean Eon Realm’s humans. They included Tenacity of Life, Continuation of Bloodlines, Nation, Home, Culture... He also drew 109 historical figures of Archean Eon Realm.
Meng Chuan had been influenced by Archean Eon Realm’s culture since he was young. When he watched Archean Eon Realm’s history—especially the source of the culture he had been exposed to—he naturally resonated with it. These historical sources greatly touched Meng Chuan.
The nine epic paintings of the human species and the 109 paintings of the historical figures included almost all the core and most dazzling figures in Archean Eon Realm’s history. They also completely reconstructed Meng Chuan’s knowledge of culture. With his understanding perfected, his wisdom naturally improved. His willpower was naturally boosted as well.
During this process, Meng Chuan completely fused the spacetime law with his Essence Soul formulation. He raised the Essence Soul formulation, Painting World, to the Eighth Tribulation realm.
However...
Meng Chuan’s willpower was still unable to withstand the spacetime law.
As the saying goes—the larger one’s heart is, the larger the world is. Meng Chuan’s willpower was clearly unable to contain all of spacetime.
...
Time passed.
Another 500 years passed in Archean Eon Realm. Since his main Essence Soul Origins was cultivating on Dry Origin Mountain, more than 16,000 years had passed since Meng Chuan began cultivating.
Over the past 16,000 years, Meng Chuan had focused on cultivation.
In the later stages of cultivation, wisdom determined one’s willpower.
If one reached omniscience, their willpower would be eternal. This was the case for Eternal existences.
With the spacetime law as the foundation, Meng Chuan deduced and comprehended one Origins law after another.
Laws were the secrets of the world’s operations. The more laws one grasped, the closer one was to omniscience. Fiend Mountain’s owner, Dragon Ancestor, and company continued to advance on this path. What Meng Chuan was doing now was what every half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence would do—to comprehend the ten Origins laws of his home universe.
Apart from the Chaos Hole law and the Heaven Splitting law, Meng Chuan had also comprehended eight other Origins laws—Karma law, Matter law, Immeasurable law, World law, Nirvana law, Origin law, Chaos law, and Samsara law.
He had completely grasped the ten Origins laws. In front of Meng Chuan, the secrets that everything in his homeworld had to offer decreased. His confusion decreased, and his Essence Soul formulation became more perfect.
His willpower naturally improved.
In the past 16,000 years, Meng Chuan had killed three more peak Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures on Dry Origin Mountain.
After many cultivation accumulations, he had also created knowledge that strengthened him.
He accumulated more and more insights, but his willpower failed to reach the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm’s threshold.
Meng Chuan wasn’t in a hurry.
In the entire River of Spacetime, how many people in history had willpower that could withstand spacetime? This path was destined to be extremely difficult.
A Seventh Tribulation Eminence had nearly 200,000 years of lifespan. Only 33,000 years had passed. What was there to be anxious about? Compared to his ancestors—who had used their lives to conquer new homes for themselves—what was this tiny obstacle he encountered?

chapters.title: Chapter 751 - Natural Accomplishment
chapters.content:
Chapter 751: Natural Accomplishment
Translator:
CKtalon
In Heavenly Dream Realm, the Heaven Connection Tree connected the sky and the ground. An ordinary leaf was dozens of kilometers wide. The Heaven Connection Tree’s crown spanned more than 50,000 kilometers, and there were stretches of buildings across it. It was where the entire Heavenly Dream Realm’s divine court was located.
In a hidden hall in Heavenly Dream Realm’s divine court.
A white-haired elder sat cross-legged. Beside him was an old woman, who was waiting for him silently.
The white-haired elder’s power surged into an ancient array formation hidden in the hall. Through the array formation, invisible waves spread across the River of Spacetime.
Let the world enter my dream.
The white-haired elder’s consciousness entered a dream world, and the dream world reflected the entire River of Spacetime.
The white-haired elder looked at the various places. Apart from Eternal Tower, Black Fiend Hall, Dragon Ancestral Land, high-level inhabited worlds, and a few areas where Eighth Tribulation Eminences had set up array formations, he could see everything else. Even White Avian Hall and other places couldn’t stop him.
City Lord Eastcalm, Hall Lord White Avian.
The white-haired elder naturally probed the two strongest existences in the River of Spacetime. In the illusory dream world, no other living beings could sense his spying. Meng Chuan and Hall Lord White Avian could sense it, but it was difficult for them to know where the spying came from.
How can two half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences withstand the Progenitor’s means?
His progenitor was an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. He was skilled in dreams and was extremely good at spying.
With a dream, he could dream of everything in the River of Spacetime. It was impossible to guard against.
The white-haired elder was a Seventh Tribulation deity. He used the array formation left behind by his progenitor to reflect the entire River of Spacetime into his dream.
Whoosh.
The white-haired elder opened his eyes after stopping the array formation.
“Your Majesty,” said the old woman.
“I used the Progenitor’s array formation to observe the various areas in the River of Spacetime. Compared to 300 years ago, there aren’t many changes,” said the white-haired elder. “The strongest Hall Lord White Avian and City Lord Eastcalm are still at the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm only.”
Although high-level worlds had little contact with the outside world, they often observed changes in the outside world.
The old woman nodded slightly. She wasn’t a deity; she was the strongest expert in Heavenly Dream Realm’s current era, a Sixth Tribulation Eminence. After cultivating to such a realm... the next time the Progenitor woke up, she would be bestowed a seat of divinity when she died. From then on, she would live as long as the heavens.
The white-haired elder was a Seventh Tribulation Godfiend. He was the strongest in Heavenly Dream Realm’s history apart from the Progenitor. Only with the strength of a Seventh Tribulation Eminence could he better cast the many array formations left behind by the Progenitor.
Eighth Tribulation Eminences had to cross one time period after another so that they could maintain their youth. These deities had been alive for a long time. Even though they relied on sleeping and reincarnation methods, their consciousness remained distorted.
Over time, they would become different. They would gradually be assimilated by their divinity; this was something that couldn’t be helped. Without sufficient willpower, they wouldn’t be able to maintain themselves even if they had a long lifespan.
“By the way, look at the traces of time on City Lord Eastcalm,” said the white-haired elder with a smile. “He has cultivated for more than 33,000 years. Compared to last time... City Lord Eastcalm definitely has an Essence Soul avatar that’s located in a place where time flows 33-fold faster.”
“He’s a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence. A place that can maintain a time flow 33-fold faster than normal? How terrifying is the energy expenditure?” The old woman was alarmed. “I’ve never heard of such a place.”
“Therefore, he must’ve encountered a special opportunity. He might’ve gone beyond the universe,” said the white-haired elder.
It was very normal to go outside the universe.
Hall Lord White Avian, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star, and Guild Master Fiend Eye had similar opportunities in the past. They had obtained the favor of an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. If they were willing to bring them out, they could naturally roam beyond the universe.
“Your Majesty, when do you plan on entering your slumber?” asked the old woman.
“In this era, two half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences are still alive. I won’t sleep for the time being; I’ll sleep after they die of old age,” said the white-haired elder.
“According to the 33-fold faster time flow, City Lord Eastcalm will reach the end of his lifespan in 5,000 years. We will see his cultivation outcome,” said the old woman with a smile.
“He won’t succeed.” The white-haired elder shook his head. “Progenitor said that reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm is extremely difficult. The Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm... is even harder to reach than the Physical Body Eighth Tribulation realm.”
The old woman nodded slightly and said, “By the way, Your Majesty, my disciple—Meng Hu—was once good friends with City Lord Eastcalm. They cleared Fiend Mountain together.”
“How’s his experience in Hundred Lives Dream Realm?” asked the white-haired elder. As a Fifth Tribulation Eminence in Heavenly Dream Realm, Meng Hu was similarly given close attention. After all, it was already not bad for a Sixth Tribulation Eminence to appear in a high-level world. Many times, there were no Sixth Tribulation Eminences.
“He has experienced more than half of it, but he still hasn’t sunk into it,” said the old woman worriedly. “However, the deeper one goes into Hundred Lives Dream Realm, the more dangerous it becomes.”
“If he survives, he will benefit from a disaster. He will also reach the Sixth Tribulation realm in his life,” said the white-haired elder. “If he fails, it means that he doesn’t have the required bearing.”
...
In the outer realm, White Avian Hall, Library.
Meng Chuan was reading a book.
Huh?
Meng Chuan slightly frowned when he vaguely sensed someone spying on him.
Which high-level faction is spying on me?
After Meng Chuan became a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence, he learned that factions from high-level worlds would occasionally spy on various places in the River of Spacetime. Before he grasped the laws of spacetime, he didn’t notice them. Now that he had discovered them... he didn’t know which faction was spying on him. After all, there were dozens of factions in the River of Spacetime.
Every such faction had an Eighth Tribulation Eminence backing them.
Soon, the spying sensation disappeared.
“Meng Chuan.” Hall Lord White Avian came to the library.
“Hall Lord, you sensed it too?” Meng Chuan looked at Hall Lord White Avian.
“Yes.” Hall Lord White Avian nodded. “However, don’t worry about it. They can only hide in their lair and secretly spy on us. How many dare to jump in front of us?”
These high-level worlds didn’t dare to cause trouble.
If they caused trouble, no Eighth Tribulation Eminence would take action! Eighth Tribulation Eminences had precious time. They didn’t have the time to busy themselves with their descendants. If they dared to go out and cause trouble, their death was deserving.
From an Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s point of view, they would look down at the timeline and see countless juniors in their homeworld across billions of years. Very few people could attract their attention.
Of course, Meng Chuan and Hall Lord White Avian knew that they could only endure being spied on.
“By the way, the phoenixes will likely visit us in the near future,” said Hall Lord White Avian. “I guess they agreed to your request.”
Meng Chuan smiled. “I requested to visit the phoenixes’ library more than 100 years ago and said the price was negotiable. They only decided now? I thought there was no hope.”
Hall Lord White Avian said, “The phoenixes are similar to the dragons. The upper echelons need to discuss it; it’s not something the clan leader can decide on her own. Some of the upper echelons are in seclusion, while others might object. It’s already considered fast to gather the upper echelons and spend about a century to make a decision.”
Meng Chuan felt anticipation when he heard that.
After Hall Lord White Avian informed him of the good news, he left. Meng Chuan continued reading.
After cultivating to Meng Chuan’s level, he naturally had to study more if he wanted to improve his willpower. Therefore, he read books! He read Eighth Tribulation manuals and Seventh Tribulation manuals. Since his targets were at least Seventh Tribulation manuals, White Avian Hall’s library wasn’t enough. Hence, he also requested help from various factions. He was willing to spend a large number of treasures to exchange for them.
He wouldn’t take advantage of others; he would exchange for it at a fair price and read it once. But the more precious the manuals were, the harder it was to find them. Many of them were in the collections of the dragons, phoenixes, and many other high-level worlds. The phoenixes seemed to agree on this matter, so Meng Chuan was rather expectant.
Considering my realm, I can easily learn a Seventh Tribulation ultimate technique. I can also understand many Eighth Tribulation manuals.
As Meng Chuan read and cultivated, his understanding of the countless phenomena in the universe deepened, and his willpower slowly improved. He believed that if this continued, he would definitely have a chance of bearing the evolution of the spacetime law in his life.
Mandala Finger is a psyche finger art? It’s really interesting how it affects one’s mind. It’s a unique method.
Meng Chuan looked at the ultimate technique in his hand. It was created by a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence, and he felt that he had gained quite a lot.
Just as he was in a good mood and was deep in studying this finger art—
Boom!
There was a loud boom!
Meng Chuan put down the book in his hand. He felt as though his Essence Soul World had split apart. With a loud bang, it began to evolve spacetime..........

chapters.title: Chapter 752 - Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Lifeform
chapters.content:
Chapter 752: Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Lifeform
Translator:
CKtalon
When the world was created, Chaos would transform into spacetime.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul World gradually transformed into a complete universe spacetime. It was no longer illusory but completely real.
A true universe’s void formed in his Essence Soul World. Of course, this universe’s void was far inferior to Meng Chuan’s home universe. It could only be considered a miniature universe, but the energy required for a miniature universe was extremely terrifying. The Dark Chaos Hole that devoured the outside world when he was at the Seventh Tribulation realm had long shattered. It became nutrients for this gradually forming miniature universe. Furthermore, it devoured the outer realm essence energy.
Rumble~
Archean Eon Realm, White Avian Hall, and Earth Cloud Mystic Realm—there were a total of five regions in the River of Spacetime. They formed an energy tide that gradually affected the entire River of Spacetime.
The effects of this whale devouring were very far-reaching.
On the contrary, weak Tribulation Eminences couldn’t sense it. Only those at the Sixth Tribulation realm or higher could sense it.
Those who could sense the changes in the River of Spacetime’s energy flow and the changes in the tide gradually surged toward Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars.
Huh?
Hall Lord White Avian could sense the changes in the River of Spacetime’s energy flow. He also vaguely discovered several sources.
Archean Eon Realm, Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, White Avian Hall, and five other regions are slowly absorbing the entire River of Spacetime’s energy?
Also, I can’t sense Meng Chuan!
Hall Lord White Avian was alarmed. This was because he had previously met Meng Chuan.
Just a moment ago, he was very certain that Meng Chuan was reading manuals in the library. But now, Meng Chuan had disappeared.
He could no longer sense him. He couldn’t sense Meng Chuan at all in the River of Spacetime.
He should be in the library, but I can’t sense him. Could he have...
Hall Lord White Avian had his guesses.
I can’t sense Eighth Tribulation Eminences either. Could Meng Chuan have become a lifeform of that level?
...
What’s going on? The River of Spacetime is undergoing changes!
Realm Ancestor, Guild Master Fiend Eye, Lord of Li Rainbow, Manor Lord Centaurea, Guild Master Darkstar, Origin Realm Chieftain, Ancestral Magus King, and company all sensed it. However, it was difficult for them to determine the source of the energy tide. This was because several sources had appeared at the same time and interfered with each other.
It was difficult for them to figure it out completely.
Only Hall Lord White Avian could determine what was happening in this era.
I can’t sense Meng Chuan anymore.
City Lord Eastcalm has disappeared?
I can’t sense all of City Lord Eastcalm’s Essence Soul avatars.
The various factions stirred.
Even though Celestial Thearch Myriad Star hid his true body in the outer realm back then, preventing others from finding him, they could at least determine that he was still alive. Furthermore, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star didn’t hide his true body in his homeworld.
Now, all of Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars had vanished. They couldn’t even determine if he was dead or alive.
In Dragon Ancestral Land, Phoenix Ancestral Land, Eternal Tower, and many other high-level worlds—as long as there were Seventh Tribulation Eminences guarding them—none of them could sense Meng Chuan. They investigated the matter.
I can’t find City Lord Eastcalm even when I let the River of Spacetime and headed into my dream?
Karma Trace, where is he?
The Immeasurable Net envelops the universe, but I can’t find him?
No matter how many people tried to pry into Meng Chuan’s location, they couldn’t find him.
...
Whoosh.
Outside the library, Hall Lord White Avian instantly appeared. His gaze passed through the library’s main entrance and past the many bookshelves. He saw the black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan sitting cross-legged.
He could see him with his naked eye, but he couldn’t sense him. Hall Lord White Avian was pleasantly surprised.
“He really did it,” muttered Hall Lord White Avian. At that moment, he controlled the array formation to prevent anyone from entering the library and disturbing Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged and sensed the natural evolution of his Essence Soul World. He guided everything and fused his insights over the years into it. Spacetime was the foundation, and the ten Origins laws were auxiliary. They guided the formation of this miniature universe.
The so-called ten Origins laws were only the Origins laws of his home universe. The laws in different universes weren’t necessarily the same; they might even be very different.
Compared to other Eighth Tribulation Eminences, Meng Chuan’s accumulated insights were paltry. However, his willpower had reached the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm’s threshold! It was much stronger than that of ordinary Physical Body Eighth Tribulation Eminences. Of course, Physical Body Eighth Tribulation Eminences had terrifyingly powerful bodies.
Is this the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm?
Meng Chuan felt his body transform.
The Power of Essence Soul’s transformation was the fundamental power of the entire Essence Soul World. Now, it was a unique mental strength.
I’m at the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm. I can escape my body and become a spiritual existence?
Meng Chuan felt his body transform.
The Physical Body cultivation system and the Essence Soul cultivation system were very different.
After reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm, one would walk in different directions.
The Physical Body cultivation system pursued a body that was as vast as the universe. It was unshakable, and its attacks were even more terrifying and unimaginably powerful.
In the Essence Soul lineage, the larger the heart, the larger the world. In the early days, he was good at illusions. Now, he could transform into a spiritual existence.
