As long as someone has heard of me and knows of my existence while my influence reaches a certain level, my mark can be formed? I can then use that to form an Essence Soul avatar?
Meng Chuan understood one of the means of the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm. There was no need for blood, hair, or personal writing of legacies. As long as his influence reached a certain level, he could condense a spiritual imprint.
Of course, he was still inferior to peak Eighth Tribulation Eminences. For example, as long as one of them was remembered by an Eternal and any books recorded them, they could use this to live on.
An Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence was slightly inferior, but in terms of terrifying vitality, they were comparable to top Eighth Tribulation Eminences in the Physical Body cultivation system. Their means were even more unfathomable.
Their means of infiltration, corrosion, and corruption were even more powerful. It was difficult for an inhabited world to isolate the effects.
I can completely transform into a spiritual existence. I can live in other people’s dreams and in legends?
Meng Chuan felt that his Power of Essence Soul had completely transformed. Originally, he could still see the composition of leptons with the Power of Essence Soul. However, the Power of Essence Soul at the Eighth Tribulation realm had already become conceptualized.
Meng Chuan vaguely understood that this was a special lepton composition, making it impossible for outsiders to pry into it.
Heavenly Tribulation.
Meng Chuan looked up.
All his avatars, including his Essence Soul avatar on Dry Origin Mountain, sensed a terrifying Heavenly Tribulation brewing.
As an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, one had to withstand the Heavenly Tribulation before they had the right to live for extended periods.
When he was weak, Meng Chuan thought that the Heavenly Tribulation was the descent of the universe’s laws of operation. Later, he understood that Hall Lord White Avian and company had been outside the universe. No matter where they went, they couldn’t escape the Heavenly Tribulation. Therefore, the Heavenly Tribulation wasn’t caused by the laws in their home universe. Instead, it was the law of endless spacetime; it was even more terrifying.
If I don’t try to jump out of the River of Spacetime, the Heavenly Tribulation will descend in 100 years. If I attempt to jump out of the River of Spacetime, the Heavenly Tribulation will descend immediately.
The time flow on Dry Origin Mountain is too fast. It’s 33 times faster than normal.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in his wooden hut on Dry Origin Mountain. He took the initiative to influence the time flow in his body.
As time slowed down, the consumption of energy became terrifying. In the end, the time flow in the wooden hut became one-tenth of that of Dry Origin Mountain. Such a huge expenditure of energy strained the Essence Soul avatar, which had just broken through. The energy it absorbed and expended reached a balance.
Even if I decelerate the time flow to one-tenth of Dry Origin Mountain’s, it will still be three times faster than my home universe.
Meng Chuan understood this, but he had no choice.
The River of Spacetime was like a river.
After transforming into an Eighth Tribulation lifeform, he was like an extremely big fish.
If big fish were to swim at the same speed as the river downstream, it would be the easiest. If one accelerated or slowed down, they would be met with resistance from the water! The larger a lifeform was, the greater the resistance and the greater the energy expenditure.
Of course, there was the simplest solution—jumping out of the river and standing by the bank.
On the bank, one wouldn’t be affected by the river. They could stop completely and watch the river flow.
Daolord Evodia, Fiend Mountain’s owner, and the others had all relied on such means to jump out of the River of Spacetime. Perhaps hundreds of millions of years had passed in the outside world while they did the mere act of drinking a cup of tea.
My current life essence can already jump out of the River of Spacetime. However, the moment I jump out, the Heavenly Tribulation will descend.
Meng Chuan understood this point.
Although he had become an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation lifeform, he had yet to transcend the tribulation. There were still many restrictions.

chapters.title: Chapter 753 - Treatment
chapters.content:
Chapter 753: Treatment
Translator:
CKtalon
Meng Chuan looked up and sensed the Heavenly Tribulation. It was targeting him—there was no escaping it.
I’ll have to prepare for the Tribulation Transcendence next.
Meng Chuan knew that he had to seize every moment.
Whoosh.
In the library, Meng Chuan placed the books on the bookshelf in front of him. He then stood up and walked out of the library.
A group of Eminences had already gathered outside the library. They were all from White Avian Hall—Hall Lord White Avian, Lord of Shadowfiend, Deputy Hall Lord Azure Dragon, Deputy Hall Lord Blazing Sun, Palace Lord Food God, Lord of Shadows, Lord of the East Abyss, Cang Li, and Mountain Lord Moxie.
When Meng Chuan walked out, all of them looked at Meng Chuan with complicated expressions. They were filled with disbelief, amazement, and puzzlement...
“Meng Chuan, you broke through?” asked Hall Lord White Avian. The other Eminences listened carefully.
Meng Chuan smiled and nodded. “I have, but I still need to transcend the eighth Essence Soul Tribulation.”
The moment that was said, the Eminences present fell silent.
He has really broken through! He has reached the legendary Eighth Tribulation realm!
Although Meng Chuan still needed to transcend the tribulation before he could become an extended existence, Meng Chuan had already become an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence from this moment onward. He now had unimaginable strength at that level.
Eighth Tribulation realm—this was a realm every Seventh Tribulation Eminence yearned for! Upon reaching this realm, one would gain many unimaginable means. They could make their homeworld a high-level world, and they could allow a portion of their clansmen to transcend Samsara and share lifespans with their homeworld. They could also explore endless spacetime and see scenery thousands of times more exciting.
Typically, the probability of a Seventh Tribulation Eminence reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm was extremely low. But in this era—where three half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences had once stood shoulder to shoulder—Meng Chuan had taken the critical step and truly reached the Eighth Tribulation realm. Only the final tribulation trial remained.
“Congratulations, Eastcalm.” Lord of Shadowfiend congratulated him.
“Congratulations, City Lord Eastcalm.” All the Eminences present congratulated him. At that moment, their attitudes were much more humbler.
Seventh Tribulation Eminences could only affect an era after all. The River of Spacetime’s fundamental situation was decided by Eighth Tribulation Eminences. If an Eighth Tribulation Eminence wanted to build a faction, they could exist for billions of years. If they offended an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, even someone as powerful as Celestial Thearch Myriad Star would end up in a tragic state.
“Do you need to keep your breakthrough a secret?” asked Hall Lord White Avian.
“There’s no need to keep it a secret.” Meng Chuan shook his head. He believed that many Eighth Tribulation Eminences in the River of Spacetime had sensed his elevation in life’s natural order.
He could vaguely sense that there were Eighth Tribulation Eminences sleeping and hiding in this universe. However, they were isolated by array formations. Meng Chuan could determine that they were still alive, but he didn’t know their exact locations.
He had just broken through, but without an array formation isolating him, the Eighth Tribulation Eminences would’ve known about his breakthrough. There was no need to hide it.
“Understood.” Hall Lord White Avian nodded before he couldn’t help saying, “Meng Chuan, I have something to discuss with you.”
“Hall Lord, let’s talk in detail when we reach your residence.” Meng Chuan smiled. He naturally guessed what Hall Lord wanted to say.
Soon, the two went to a courtyard in the hall. The other Eminences didn’t dare to disturb them.
“Look at my injuries. Can they be treated?” asked Hall Lord White Avian immediately as he sat down.
Meng Chuan looked at Hall Lord White Avian, but he could already see the other party’s Essence Soul clearly. He saw the alien powers that permeated everywhere.
It was a Power of Essence Soul at the same level as him.
“In terms of bodies, a Physical Body Eighth Tribulation Eminence has the advantage,” said Meng Chuan. “But in terms of unpredictable strength, an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s Power of Essence Soul is stronger. The one who attacked you was an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence. The Power of Essence Soul seeped into one of your avatars, passed through karma and your thoughts, and naturally transmitted to your homeworld’s true body.”
“Thought transmission?” Hall Lord White Avian was alarmed.
“By knowing him, remembering him, and understanding him, his strength is naturally able to seep into you,” explained Meng Chuan. “If he’s willing, he can even use your outer realm true body’s mark to condense an Essence Soul true body and descend into our universe. Of course, he didn’t kill you because your homeworld’s true body has always been in your homeworld, and he’s unable to enter your homeworld.”
“Yes, our universe is Dragon Ancestor’s home universe. I heard that he’s quite famous beyond the universe, so he won’t easily storm his way here,” said Hall Lord White Avian self-deprecatingly. “In his eyes, I’m probably a tiny ant that’s not worth mentioning. Just a nap, and I’ll die of old age. It’s not worth paying a huge price for me.”
As Meng Chuan listened, his Power of Essence Soul seeped into Hall Lord White Avian.
Hall Lord White Avian suddenly felt like Meng Chuan’s eyes were like an endless universe. He couldn’t help but be dazed.
Meng Chuan’s Power of Essence Soul affected Hall Lord White Avian’s mind. Through karma and mental transmission, it also seeped into his other true body in his homeworld.
His two true bodies were affected at the same time.
Hall Lord White Avian’s mind was slightly distorted and changed. The evil power began to be expelled.
Meng Chuan could sense that the other party was about the same level as him. As a sourceless water, the other party’s infiltration powers naturally couldn’t withstand his; this was like fighting for territory. A Physical Body Seventh Tribulation Eminence like Hall Lord White Avian was unable to stop Meng Chuan and a peer equal to him from corroding him with their Power of Essence Soul.
Moments later, Meng Chuan’s Power of Essence Soul completely expelled the other party’s before retracting his strength.
Huh?
Hall Lord White Avian fell into a daze.
“My injuries?” Hall Lord White Avian was pleasantly surprised to discover that he had completely recovered.
“Why can’t I remember what the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence that injured me looks like?” Hall Lord White Avian immediately discovered the changes in his body. At his realm, he would immediately discover the changes in his body.
“Only by doing so will it be a complete cure,” explained Meng Chuan. “If you still remember him clearly, he will be able to infiltrate and corrode you again.”
Hall Lord White Avian was secretly alarmed.
The Eighth Tribulation Eminences he came into contact with were all Physical Body Eighth Tribulation Eminences.
The only Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence he had met was an enemy. At that moment, he felt that an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s means were much more sinister than those of a Physical Body Eighth Tribulation Eminence. It was impossible to guard against them.
“I know that Black Fiend Hall’s Power of Nightmare is strange, but I feel that an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s power is much more terrifying. I can’t even know his name or have intelligence on him.” Hall Lord White Avian sighed.
“When I was at the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm, I once treated Poison Eye and witnessed the Power of Nightmare. That was a formulation comprehended by Black Fiend Progenitor,” said Meng Chuan. “An Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s power is unique to those who have cultivated the Essence Soul lineage to the Eighth Tribulation realm. It’s not easy for Physical Body Eighth Tribulation Eminences to possess such means.”
Now that Hall Lord White Avian had recovered from his injuries, he was in a much better mood. “Back then, I thought that if an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence were to appear in this era, only you would stand a chance. However, I was just clinging onto any hope of survival in my despair. I knew how difficult it was to give birth to an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence. Who knew that you would really succeed?”
Meng Chuan shook his head and said, “I haven’t transcended the tribulation yet.”
“You will definitely succeed.” Hall Lord White Avian was more confident than Meng Chuan after seeing his journey.
“If I fail to transcend the tribulation, please take care of my homeworld,” said Meng Chuan.
Hall Lord White Avian was slightly taken aback before he said solemnly, “I promise with my life that I will watch over your homeworld with all my might. However, I still believe that it’s not my place to watch over a high-level world when you transcend the tribulation successfully.”
“I’ll be counting on your blessings.” Meng Chuan wasn’t confident because he knew too little about the eighth Essence Soul Tribulation.
Huh?
Meng Chuan suddenly sensed something and looked up.
A tall man with long, narrow eyes had already arrived outside the door. He looked at Meng Chuan with kindness in his eyes.
Meng Chuan looked at him.
“Greetings, Eastcalm; I’m Crimson Peace.”
The tall man walked into the courtyard. Hall Lord White Avian didn’t notice him at all. He was in a completely different spacetime.
The person was none other than Perfected Lord Crimson Peace, an Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
“Greetings, Perfected Lord Crimson Peace.”
As Meng Chuan spoke to Hall Lord White Avian, he sent his Essence Soul avatar into this layer of spacetime and stood up to welcome Perfected Lord Crimson Peace.

chapters.title: Chapter 754 - Three Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminences in History
chapters.content:
Chapter 754: Three Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminences in History
Translator:
CKtalon
In a special layer of spacetime, Meng Chuan looked at Perfected Lord Crimson Peace.
Perfected Lord Crimson Peace had a domineering look on his face. The vertical eye between his eyebrows made Meng Chuan feel a faint threat.
I feel threatened even after becoming an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence... The vertical eye between his eyebrows is his strongest move?
“Our universe has finally produced another Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence,” said Perfected Lord Crimson Peace with a smile. “I wonder if I’m lucky enough to invite you to my cave abode?”
“Gladly,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“Let’s go.” With a wave of his hand, Perfected Lord Crimson Peace brought Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar across distant spacetime and arrived at a hidden cave abode near Fool Mountain Realm.
This cave abode was beside Fool Mountain Realm. A vast array formation protected Fool Mountain Realm and also concealed the cave abode.
“The other Eighth Tribulation Eminences won’t be able to spy on us here,” said Perfected Lord Crimson Peace with a smile.
The two of them came to a garden in the cave abode.
Perfected Lord Crimson Peace flicked his sleeve, and rare fruits and wine appeared on the tables. “Have a seat.”
“Perfected Lord, you just said ‘another Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence has been born in our universe.’ Not counting me who has just crossed the threshold, I wonder how many have been born in the past?” Meng Chuan poured himself a cup of alcohol and inquired.
He was rather curious. In fact, he could roughly guess the number of Eighth Tribulation Eminences of the Essence Soul lineage from the Physical Body lineage ratio to the Essence Soul lineage at the Seventh Tribulation realm.
“Three.” Perfected Lord Crimson Peace said, “One is a unique special lifeform named Palace Lady Peacock. She has no attachments and has long left our universe to roam the endless spacetime.”
Upon hearing Palace Lady Peacock’s name, Meng Chuan vaguely sensed an existence.
A woman with gorgeous feathers was sitting on a palatial throne. She was giving a lecture, and many living beings were listening to her.
The peacock woman’s eyes were purple as she looked up at Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan looked at her, and she likewise looked at Meng Chuan.
“I look forward to meeting you, Fellow Daoist.”
An invisible thought came with good intentions.
Following that, the connection between the two parties was severed.
“Palace Lady Peacock has the most benevolent personality,” said Perfected Lord Crimson Peace. “However, she’s also very curious about the endless spacetime. Perhaps she thinks that our home universe isn’t attractive to her. Her true body and many Essence Soul avatars will head to different spacetimes and travel everywhere.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
“There’s also the Lord of Truth,” said Perfected Lord Crimson Peace.
Meng Chuan immediately sensed the existence.
Outside his home universe, in a distant spacetime, countless living beings were shouting Lord of Truth’s name fervently. Countless living beings lived in Lord of Truth’s Essence Soul universe.
At that moment, Lord of Truth was dressed in a black robe as he looked at Meng Chuan. Lord of Truth’s eyes contained terrifying magical power as he exchanged looks with Meng Chuan.
If he were a Seventh Tribulation Eminence, his consciousness would probably be distorted. But when Lord of Truth saw Meng Chuan, he didn’t attack because he could sense that Meng Chuan was an existence at the same level.
“Another peer from my home universe. Unfortunately, with Dragon Ancestor around, you have to abide by his rules.”
Lord of Truth sent a thought, but Meng Chuan didn’t reply.
Perfected Lord Crimson Peace sat there and continued, “Lord of Truth once wanted to control the hearts and minds of all living beings in the universe. He wanted to make his home universe his own. This made Dragon Ancestor personally kill many of Lord of Truth’s avatars in a rage. This happened across multiple layers of spacetime, but he had long befriended an Eternal existence’s disciple and prepared a retreat route. That was why he dared to act recklessly in our home universe. Therefore, Dragon Ancestor couldn’t kill him completely.”
Control all living beings in the universe?
Meng Chuan was secretly astonished.
In terms of ability to cause trouble, Celestial Thearch Myriad Star was indeed far inferior to Lord of Truth, who was at the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm. Furthermore, Lord of Truth clearly had a backup plan.
“The only remaining one in our universe now, excluding you, is Mountain Lord of Plum Blossom,” said Perfected Lord Crimson Peace.
Meng Chuan also ‘saw’ him.
In a plum blossom mountain forest, an elder was sleeping soundly.
Just sensing this scene made him lose his senses.
“There are only three Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminences, but only one has chosen to live in our home universe permanently.” Meng Chuan sighed before asking, “Perfected Lord, do you know what the eighth Essence Soul Tribulation is?”
He was most concerned about intelligence regarding the Tribulation Transcendence.
“I’m not sure,” said Perfected Lord Crimson Peace. “I’ve only heard that the Heavenly Tribulation transcended by an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence is different. If you want to obtain detailed information, I estimate that in our universe, Daolord Evodia and Dragon Ancestor know the most.
“Daolord Evodia is an Eternal’s disciple; he has a special status in our universe. His horizons are broad, and he has extremely rich intelligence. Dragon Ancestor has cultivated to the limits of the Eighth Tribulation realm, and he has a wide network of friends, so he definitely has some understanding of the eighth Essence Soul Heavenly Tribulation.
“Daolord Evodia does whatever he wants; it’s really quite difficult to meet him. However, Dragon Ancestor takes very good care of the Eighth Tribulation Eminences in our universe. Before you transcend the tribulation, Dragon Ancestor should descend once and meet you personally.”
“Dragon Ancestor will personally meet me?” Meng Chuan was astonished.
“Every Eighth Tribulation Eminence typically sees Dragon Ancestor before transcending the tribulation,” said Perfected Lord Crimson Peace. “Dragon Ancestor will give us opportunities to increase our chances of transcending the tribulation. When the time comes, you can ask Dragon Ancestor about the tribulation.”
“Understood.” Meng Chuan was somewhat impressed.
Dragon Ancestor’s Nine Trials Pagoda was a gift to talented people in his home universe. He would also personally descend and give every person that was about to transcend the eighth Heavenly Tribulation opportunities to increase their chances of transcending the tribulation.
In fact, there was no need for Dragon Ancestor to do so since he had reached the limits of the Eighth Tribulation realm. However, Meng Chuan was very impressed by how he took care of his home universe’s cultivators.
“Eastcalm.” Perfected Lord Crimson Peace put down his cup and said, “I invited you here for a special spacetime.”
“A special spacetime?” Meng Chuan was puzzled.
“Yes.” Perfected Lord Crimson Peace nodded. “It’s a massive, chaotic universe. Due to the laws, it’s much larger than our home universe. It’s chaotic and doesn’t resist outsiders. I obtained an opportunity, and my outer realm true body has been fighting in that universe for many years. It has already become one of the 12 Chaos Gods.
“I’d like to invite you to send an Essence Soul avatar over to that universe to help me after you transcend the tribulation. As long as you are willing, I’m confident that an Essence Soul avatar of yours will become a Chaos God there.
“The benefits of becoming a Chaos God are much greater than having an Eternal treasure,” said Perfected Lord Crimson Peace. “When you transcend the tribulation successfully, I believe many people will invite you to travel the endless spacetime together. However, the conditions I can offer are definitely in the top three.”
Perfected Lord Crimson Peace was somewhat confident in his opportunities before he came to invite an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
He had operated that universe for a long time. It was where he had the confidence to become a top Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
“Another larger universe, a Chaos God?” Meng Chuan pondered for a moment and smiled. “Perfected Lord, I can send an Essence Soul avatar to take a trip after I transcend the tribulation and consolidate my strength. However, I can’t be sure whether it will also become a Chaos God.”
He had nine Essence Soul avatars, so it wasn’t difficult for him to send one over. Furthermore, he could disperse his Essence Soul avatars with a thought.
“Then, it’s a deal.” Perfected Lord Crimson Peace was somewhat excited and expectant. There were too few Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminences. It was also very difficult to get an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence to help.
“Definitely,” promised Meng Chuan. “However, I have to transcend the tribulation first and arrange everything.”
“No rush, no rush. Even if it’s a million years, I’m not in a hurry.” Perfected Lord Crimson Peace was patient.
Meng Chuan nodded.
His plan was that he would definitely become an Eternal existence’s disciple first if he succeeded in transcending the tribulation. After that, he would naturally have time to roam the outside world.....

chapters.title: Chapter 755 - Dragon Ancestors Obstruction
chapters.content:
Chapter 755: Dragon Ancestor’s Obstruction
Translator:
CKtalon
It was rare for Seventh Tribulation Eminences and half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences to rush over to Three Bay River System’s Thousand Mountain Star.
“I never expected a mighty existence like City Lord Eastcalm to appear in our era.” The black stone golem, Guild Master Darkstar, had a proud look on his face as he sighed. “He’s already an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. As long as he transcends the tribulation successfully, he will be affecting the entire River of Spacetime for countless generations to come.”
“Darkstar, I really admire you,” said Manor Lord Centaurea with a smile. “You are flexible. You offended City Lord Eastcalm back then, yet you obtained his forgiveness.”
“That’s because City Lord Eastcalm is benevolent.” Darkstar thought nothing of it. What was there to be ashamed of by humbly begging City Lord Eastcalm for forgiveness?
That was an Eighth Tribulation Eminence! It wouldn’t be easy for Seventh Tribulation Eminences to meet him in the future.
“City Lord Eastcalm is extremely talented. It’s our era’s blessing to have him appear in this era,” said Yellow-Robed Academy Lord with a smile.
Dozens of Seventh Tribulation Eminences and half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences had gathered in this void.
Outsiders couldn’t go to White Avian Hall without permission. Therefore, all the Eminences came to Thousand Mountain Star directly!
Thousand Mountain Star was City Lord Eastcalm’s publicly known cave abode. Even if City Lord Eastcalm wasn’t around for the time being, City Lord Eastcalm could naturally sense their arrival at his realm.
If he wanted to meet them, he would naturally summon them. If he didn’t want to meet them, they could only leave.
“Fiend Eye is here.”
The Eminences saw Fiend Eye—who was like a meatball—walk through the void with his short legs; he couldn’t hide his smile.
Everyone knew that Fiend Eye and City Lord Eastcalm had an extraordinary relationship. At that moment, they were filled with envy and jealousy.
“Look at how smug Fiend Eye is.”
“He was lucky to meet City Lord Eastcalm when he was weak.”
“Realm Ancestor is the same. I heard that he managed to fish City Lord Eastcalm before City Lord Eastcalm reached the Sixth Tribulation realm and formed an affinity with him.”
The Eminences discussed.
“Our luck isn’t bad either. City Lord Eastcalm is from the same generation as us, and we can be considered as having some ties with him. In the future, it will be countless times harder for those juniors to meet an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence.” These Eminences knew very well that it was fate to have someone from the same generation reach the Eighth Tribulation realm.
They naturally had to grasp the opportunity. Although City Lord Eastcalm had yet to transcend the tribulation, it was precisely because he hadn’t transcended the tribulation that the probability of meeting him was higher.
Sucking up to Meng Chuan would be too late if they waited until Meng Chuan transcended the tribulation.
Hum!
Spacetime distorted.
Dozens of Eminences saw a spacetime tunnel appear in front of them—it led deep into Thousand Mountain Star.
“Let’s go.”
“Let’s rush over to pay our respects.” The Eminences flew over together, but they naturally separated after flying through the spacetime tunnel.
Manor Lord Centaurea could no longer see his companions. He flew through the spacetime tunnel and arrived at a garden.
A black-robed, white-haired man was sitting there and reading a book.
“Greetings, City Lord Eastcalm,” said Manor Lord Centaurea while bowing. He was extremely humble because he felt his mind sway when he saw Meng Chuan. It was difficult for him to control himself, and this was under the circumstances of Meng Chuan not deliberately using any moves. If he had used any moves, a Seventh Tribulation Eminence’s mind would’ve been warped. They would’ve obediently allowed him to control them.
“Manor Lord Centaurea.” Meng Chuan smiled at him.
“I heard that City Lord Eastcalm has become an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence and is about to face the Heavenly Tribulation. I am lucky to be in the same era as City Lord Eastcalm; it’s also my good fortune. I once obtained an Essence Soul lineage treasure and specially came to offer it to City Lord. I wish you success in transcending the tribulation.” With a flip of his hand, an illusory book appeared in front of him.
This was Manor Lord Centaurea’s greatest treasure he chanced upon. But now, he offered it without any hesitation!
If Meng Chuan succeeded in transcending the tribulation, he probably wouldn’t think much of this treasure. If he were to offer it before transcending the tribulation, the karma generated would be immense. Even if it didn’t help much, Meng Chuan probably wouldn’t reject a treasure before transcending the tribulation.
“Oh?” When Meng Chuan saw the illusory book, he vaguely felt that it was extraordinary.
The book flew to Meng Chuan, and he reached out to take it.
After a slight scan—
This is?
Meng Chuan was rather surprised. He didn’t think much of the book, but he never expected to encounter a huge surprise.
Although Manor Lord Centaurea’s treasure wasn’t comparable to an Eternal treasure, it wasn’t inferior to legacy treasures like Black Fiend Hall and Nightmare Hall. To Meng Chuan, this treasure was even more important.
Book of the World.
Meng Chuan looked at the book.
This book was called ‘Book of the World.’ As long as one’s realm was high enough and could set the rules, the treasure would transform into an illusory world according to the rules.
The more detailed and perfect the laws were, the more powerful the illusory world would be.
Although it’s only a simulated illusory world and unlike a real universe, creating a real universe requires one to be at the limits of the Eighth Tribulation realm. The evolution of the universe takes a long time. As for this illusory world... since it’s illusory, one can easily adjust the time flow within it. This treasure isn’t as valuable as an Eternal treasure, but it surpasses Meng Sha Realm’s treasures.
Meng Chuan never expected to receive such a huge gift when meeting the Eminences of his generation.
“This gift of yours is really nice.” Meng Chuan looked at Centaurea Manor Lord.
Manor Lord Centaurea smiled and said, “It’s impossible to use such a treasure with my low strength. Only when one is at a higher realm can a superior illusory world be produced. This treasure can only be of use in your hands, City Lord Eastcalm.”
“What do you want?” asked Meng Chuan.
“A chance to transcend and become an Eighth Tribulation Eminence.” Manor Lord Centaurea looked at Meng Chuan.
He had offered his most precious treasure in exchange for an opportunity.
This was because he was destined to inch toward death if he didn’t receive any special opportunities after cultivating to his level.
He knew... that there were all sorts of possibilities in the endless spacetime. An Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence could still find a chance to help him.
Meng Chuan looked at the book in his hand and said, “I can’t promise you that, but I’ll do my best to help you if I transcend the tribulation successfully.”
“City Lord, this promise is enough.” Manor Lord Centaurea knew very well that he couldn’t seek the help of a true Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence with this treasure. He couldn’t even meet them.
Meng Chuan only gave such a promise before transcending the tribulation.
Even if it was just a chance to reach the Eighth Tribulation realm, it wasn’t something easily obtainable.
...
With a thought, Meng Chuan formed an illusory world. At the same time, he met many Seventh Tribulation Eminences and half-step Seventh Tribulation Eminences. Of course, he only met them as embodiments.
Book of the World.
Meng Chuan sighed in amazement.
When Eminences from the same era visited, all of them offered gifts.
The only thing that truly amazed Meng Chuan was the book. With his current insights, he didn’t think much of the other treasures. All he could do was store them in Archean Eon Realm and enrichen its heritage.
Since he was willing to accept them, it meant that they had a connection.
After all, they were Eminences from the same era. Meng Chuan still had to cut them some slack.
...
While Meng Chuan received the various Eminences of the same era on Thousand Mountain Star, in an area in his home universe—
Whoosh.
A tall, thin figure with two curved horns appeared in this area. He looked at Meng Chuan—who was receiving all the Eminences on Thousand Mountain Star.
“Black Fiend.” A voice sounded.
The lanky figure frowned slightly. He looked up and saw a dragon-headed elder dressed in a gorgeous black robe appear.
The dragon-headed elder’s eyes were vast, and his aura affected the surrounding laws. The laws in his home universe had been forced to retreat. The place he was in had become his territory in the absolute sense.
“Dragon Ancestor.” Black Fiend Progenitor was extremely arrogant, but he respected Dragon Ancestor greatly.
“Don’t meet Meng Chuan before he transcends the tribulation,” said Dragon Ancestor calmly.
“Even I can’t meet him?” Black Fiend Progenitor said in surprise.
“No.” Dragon Ancestor nodded. “You are too bold.”
“Dragon Ancestor, you’ve overestimated me. He has an Eternal backing him. How would I dare to play any tricks?” said Black Fiend Progenitor with a smile. “I can’t deal with Meng Chuan even if I wanted to.”
“Although you can’t kill him, you will threaten his tribulation as long as you affect his mental state slightly,” said Dragon Ancestor coldly. “Furthermore, he won’t take an Eternal as his master before reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm. Without establishing the master-disciple relationship... I know that you will dare to do anything with your guts.”
“He’s an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence. His willpower is extraordinary; that’s what he’s best at. Even if I use all my means, I can only affect him slightly. Perhaps he can benefit from a disaster and have his willpower improve,” said Black Fiend Progenitor with a smile.
Dragon Ancestor only looked at him.
“Alright, alright, alright. I’ll listen to you; I won’t meet him.” Black Fiend Progenitor knew Dragon Ancestor’s personality very well. He asked, “Do you think so highly of him?”
“He reached the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm in just over 30,000 years. In the endless spacetime, he’s considered above average among Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminences,” said Dragon Ancestor indifferently. “He is also an Eternal’s disciple. You should understand how important he is to an Eighth Tribulation faction in our home universe.”
Black Fiend Progenitor fell silent.
Of course, he knew. However, City Lord Eastcalm hated his Black Fiend Hall very much. Meng Chuan’s abhorrence of evil made him stand at odds with Black Fiend Progenitor.
To have him turn over a new leaf? Turning over a new leaf was a denial of his cultivation path.
“Alright.” Black Fiend Progenitor smiled and said, “If he transcends the tribulation successfully, I’ll break up Black Fiend Hall. But Dragon Ancestor, you should know how difficult the eighth Essence Soul Tribulation is. Do you think he can transcend it?”
Dragon Ancestor looked at him without saying a word.
In fact, Dragon Ancestor wasn’t confident—the Essence Soul Tribulation was difficult. But at this critical moment, he didn’t allow any Eighth Tribulation Eminences to cause trouble. He wanted to ensure that Meng Chuan didn’t suffer any interference as he transcended the tribulation.
“After he transcends the tribulation, I’ll leave this universe completely. To be honest... the chances of our universe producing an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence and an Eternal’s disciple at that are too low.” Black Fiend Progenitor smiled as his figure dissipated.

chapters.title: Chapter 756 - Information on the Essence Soul Tribulation
chapters.content:
Chapter 756: Information on the Essence Soul Tribulation
Translator:
CKtalon
On Thousand Mountain Star, the visiting Eminences left one after another. Only Fiend Eye remained.
Meng Chuan and Fiend Eye sat opposite each other.
Chi!
Fiend Eye closed his eyes as wisps of blood-colored fog flew out from his massive head. He couldn’t help but tremble slightly.
“There are indeed endless possibilities outside the universe, but it’s not suitable for Seventh Tribulation Eminences to venture out,” said Meng Chuan as he healed Fiend Eye. “The exception is when you can follow an Eighth Tribulation Eminence at all times and have the protection of an Eighth Tribulation Eminence.”
“It’s already very rare for an Eighth Tribulation Eminence to bring me out of the universe. To bring me along and protect me all the way?” Fiend Eye made a self-deprecating comment. “I’m just an ordinary Seventh Tribulation Eminence. Eighth Tribulation Eminences don’t think much of me.”
Meng Chuan nodded.
It took a lot of effort to bring him alongside them for prolonged periods. Unless one thought highly of him or had a strong karmic connection with him... few Eighth Tribulation Eminences were willing to do so.
“Back when I was exploring what lay beyond the universe, I encountered many dangers. In the end, I was stained by this terrifying power. My outer realm true body quickly died, and my homeworld’s true body was corrupted,” said Fiend Eye. “I cultivated in my homeworld for tens of thousands of years before suppressing my injuries.”
Meng Chuan removed the evil forces bit by bit.
The blood-colored fog wasn’t as brilliant as an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s Power of Essence Soul. However, Meng Chuan wasn’t familiar with it. Thus, he was even more careful when expelling it.
It took him ten minutes to treat Fiend Eye’s outer realm true body and homeworld true body.
“This blood fog corrupts living beings and transforms them into a blood fog.” Meng Chuan extended his hand, and the blood fog condensed into a blob that flowed in his palm. “The moment of your death is when you transform into a blood fog. It’s indeed very difficult for Seventh Tribulation Eminences to resist it.”
Fiend Eye felt relaxed and excited.
“If you are interested in what lays beyond the universe,” said Meng Chuan, “I can send you to an alternate universe if I transcend the tribulation successfully.”
“Of course, I’m interested.” Fiend Eye nodded immediately.
Of course, he was interested. He had comprehended everything he could comprehend in his home universe.
An alternate universe? It had completely different laws of operation. A completely different world environment might allow him to break through in cultivation. Just seeing something different filled him with anticipation.
“Compared to the Chaos and danger that lurks beyond the universe, the universe’s interior is much more stable,” said Meng Chuan. “It’s more suitable for you to adventure in it.”
“I heard that distances between universes are great.” Fiend Eye smiled honestly. “I don’t want to trouble you, Meng Chuan.”
He naturally wanted to go to an alternate universe, but back when he met an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, the other party had thrown him out of the universe. This was considered a severance of karma.
To specially send him to another universe? The journey was very troublesome.
Would the other universe resist outsiders? This was also very troublesome.
“If I transcend the tribulation successfully, it will be a trivial matter,” said Meng Chuan. He had many Essence Soul avatars, so he would definitely explore more than one universe.
Just the universe that he had agreed on with Perfected Lord Crimson Peace wouldn’t resist outsiders.
If Meng Chuan transcended the tribulation successfully, it wouldn’t be difficult for him to find similar universes. When exploring, he could bring one of Fiend Eye’s outer realm true bodies over.
It could be said as fulfilling the destiny between them.
After the treatment, Fiend Eye quickly bade farewell and left.
...
On Thousand Mountain Star, Meng Chuan sat in his cave abode and pondered.
The eighth Essence Soul Tribulation only gives me 100 years to prepare. I can’t do much with just 100 years.
Only after cultivating for more than 33,000 years did he have such accomplishments. How much could he improve in a hundred years?
In the next 100 years, I’ll consolidate the insights I’ve gained over the years and perfect the ultimate techniques I’ve comprehended. I can also try killing Chaos overlords with my opportunities on Dry Origin Mountain. Every Chaos overlord is an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. Their talent is extremely terrifying. As long as I kill one and devour their talent... it will be of great help.
On Dry Origin Mountain, there were only 31 Chaos overlords imprisoned. These Chaos overlords had their individual backgrounds and were skilled in their own ways.
Can I, a newly-advanced Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence, kill a Chaos overlord?
Meng Chuan wasn’t confident.
I can fight every Chaos overlord first before deciding on a target.
He had stayed on Dry Origin Mountain for more than 26,000 years, and he had only killed five Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures. The sixth one he planned on killing would be a Chaos overlord.
Suddenly—
Meng Chuan sensed something and looked up.
In the cave abode’s garden, a black-robed, dragon-headed elder appeared. He was admiring the flowers.
Dragon Ancestor!
The moment Meng Chuan saw the other party, he sensed his aura.
It was a vast aura that could match his entire home universe. This aura far exceeded that of Fiend Mountain’s owner—whom Meng Chuan had met before. Dragon Ancestor’s body was comparable to his home universe. Just the thought of it shocked Meng Chuan.
Only with such strength could he create universes and remain unharmed.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan took a step and arrived in the garden. He immediately bowed and said, “Greetings, Dragon Ancestor.”
Dragon Ancestor looked at Meng Chuan. His eyes were calm as he smiled. “Meng Chuan, do you know how many Eighth Tribulation Eminences are paying attention to you?”
Meng Chuan raised his eyebrows.
Paying attention to me?
“Especially the five top Eighth Tribulation Eminences. They can sense that one of your Essence Soul avatars is in a land belonging to an Eternal,” said Dragon Ancestor with a smile. “They are naturally very concerned about you.”
“Some have good intentions, and there are ones with evil intentions. I’ve already given strict orders to forbid them from disturbing you.” Dragon Ancestor looked at Meng Chuan. “Just now, I stopped Black Fiend.”
Meng Chuan immediately said, “Thank you, Dragon Ancestor.”
Black Fiend Progenitor probably came with ill intentions.
“It’s imperative you transcend the tribulation. If you fail to transcend the tribulation, everything will be for naught,” said Dragon Ancestor. “If you succeed in transcending the tribulation and become an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence, becoming an Eternal disciple will be of extraordinary significance to our home universe. I might even need your help in the future.”
Dragon Ancestor knew very well.
Eternal existences were the most dazzling existences in the endless spacetime and countless universes. Eternal disciples were relatively united, and it was very difficult to join an Eternal faction.
Meng Chuan was naturally one of them by taking an Eternal as a master.
An Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence had relatively strong social connections. After all, they had many Essence Soul avatars. They could have their Essence Soul avatars descend afar with a single thought and handle many matters.
If Meng Chuan cultivated for a long time and his strength improved, his future influence would probably exceed Dragon Ancestor’s.
“Yes, the most pressing thing for me now is to transcend the tribulation,” said Meng Chuan. “I once asked Daolord Evodia. Back then, he told me not to gather intelligence. It wouldn’t help if I learned about it in advance; instead, it would mess up my mental state. I’m somewhat puzzled. Why is it harmful and useless to know about it in advance? Shouldn’t I still be facing the tribulation the same way?”
“It’s indeed not suitable for you to know before you cultivate to the Eighth Tribulation realm,” said Dragon Ancestor with a nod. “However, you are already an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. There are only 100 years left before you transcend the tribulation. You can know.”
Meng Chuan’s eyes lit up.
“The Physical Body Tribulation is completely different from the Essence Soul Tribulation. The further one goes, the greater the difference,” said Dragon Ancestor. “My Nine Trials Pagoda is also set up for Physical Body Tribulation Eminences, so it won’t be of much help to you for your transcendence of the eighth Essence Soul Tribulation.”
“What’s the eighth Essence Soul Tribulation?” asked Meng Chuan.
“The eighth Essence Soul Tribulation can be said to be the mental tribulation. Different Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminences encounter different situations.” Dragon Ancestor pondered for a moment and continued, “I can only be certain of one thing... The eighth Essence Soul Tribulation is a test you have never experienced. It has nothing to do with any cultivation system you have learned.”
“It has nothing to do with any of the cultivation systems I’ve studied?” Meng Chuan was astonished.
“The ten Origins laws you have grasped—the temporal law, the spatial law, and others—even the many ultimate techniques you have comprehended, and the ultimate techniques passed down by Eternals. As long as you grasp them, they will definitely be avoided in the eighth Essence Soul Tribulation,” said Dragon Ancestor. “It’s a mental tribulation that targets your weakness.”
Meng Chuan fell into deep thought.
Everything I have cultivated and accumulated is useless?
“Let me give you an example,” said Dragon Ancestor. “Peacock told me that when she transcended the eighth Essence Soul Tribulation, she had a wisp of her consciousness descend into a mortal world, and she became an ordinary mortal girl in her teens. That mortal world didn’t have any cultivation system, and mortals lived to a hundred years of age at most. Many died in their fifties or sixties, and they couldn’t cultivate. As a commoner girl, she had to become the highest authority in that mortal world. Only then could her consciousness tear open the world and return to her true body to transcend the tribulation.
“A commoner girl without any backing or cultivation system,” said Dragon Ancestor. “With the strength of a mortal, she had to become the ruler of a mortal world. Even Peacock only managed to stand at the mortal world’s peak in her eighties and successfully transcend that tribulation when she was all grizzled.”
Meng Chuan was alarmed when he heard that.
So you are a special lifeform? Then, I’ll let you become a mortal and experience the strength of species!
You are good at cultivation? The mental tribulation doesn’t test cultivation at all.
A commoner girl becoming the highest authority in the mortal world?
“Your body, Essence Soul, and cultivation system can’t help you,” said Dragon Ancestor. “All that can help you is your intelligence.”
“Use your intelligence to transcend the eighth Heavenly Tribulation,” said Dragon Ancestor. “This is the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation. You weren’t informed in advance because we were afraid that it would mess up your mental state and make you strive to build up your intelligence. It would only delay your cultivation. Now that you have become an Eighth Tribulation lifeform... you can think about it carefully,” said Dragon Ancestor.
Meng Chuan nodded.
There were three thresholds for reaching the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm. The first one was to grasp the laws of spacetime.
Secondly, one had to have a strong will.
Third, it was to transcend the tribulation.
None of them were easy!
What will my eighth Heavenly Tribulation be?
Meng Chuan’s heart stirred.

chapters.title: Chapter 757 - Book Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 757: Book Mountain
Translator:
CKtalon
The intelligence regarding the eighth Essence Soul Tribulation had affected Meng Chuan greatly. His imagination ran wild for a moment, and he even wondered whether he could succeed if he experienced the same eighth tribulation as Palace Lady Peacock.
It was very difficult, but who knew if he would succeed or fail if he didn’t experience it?
Meng Chuan was also confident in himself since he could become an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
“You have nearly 100 years to prepare.” Dragon Ancestor looked at Meng Chuan and waved his hand. A Spacetime Dominion Map appeared in front of him, and a spot was marked out. “This is Book Mountain. Anyone who is about to transcend the eighth Heavenly Tribulation can enter once.”
“Book Mountain?” Meng Chuan looked at the location indicated on the Spacetime Dominion Map in puzzlement.
Dragon Ancestor nodded. “I created Book Mountain, and countless manuals are stored in it. There are countless manuals from our universe and other universes... I transacted with other Eighth Tribulation Eminences and conquered many universes at the same time. More than 90% of the manuals I collected are placed on Book Mountain.”
Meng Chuan was alarmed when he heard that, given Dragon Ancestor’s strength.
More than 90% of the manuals he collected are placed there?
“Those who are about to transcend the eighth Heavenly Tribulation can enter once, and all manuals can be read freely. If they fail to transcend the tribulation, that’s fine. But if they succeed in transcending the tribulation, they will need to gather at least one billion cubes’ worth of manuals and place them on Book Mountain,” said Dragon Ancestor. “There will be both replenishment and expenditure. Such a setup will allow there to be more manuals on Book Mountain. This is also the heritage of our universe.”
“Thank you, Dragon Ancestor.” Meng Chuan bowed solemnly.
The more precious the manuals were, the fewer times one could read them. One copy could be reduced to dust after reading them a handful of times.
Dragon Ancestor had contributed the most. He was also planning for the entire universe’s future.
“If you have the will, you can send more manuals there in the future,” said Dragon Ancestor with a smile. “After becoming an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, you can read the manuals on Book Mountain freely. Now, there are 96 Eternal-level legacies, 1,506 Eighth Tribulation manuals, over a million Seventh Tribulation manuals, and hundreds of millions of manuals below the Seventh Tribulation realm. As many of them are directly taken from other universes, manuals below the Eighth Tribulation realm are mostly about the laws of other universes. They aren’t suitable for our universe.”
Meng Chuan understood.
Eighth Tribulation manuals were created by an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. They were formed by the foundational laws of time and space. Therefore, all universes could study them.
Seventh Tribulation manuals were at the Origins law level. The Origins laws in different universes were different. They could be cultivated in a particular universe but not in other universes, much less books below the Seventh Tribulation realm.
There seemed to be hundreds of millions of copies. Dragon Ancestor and company had probably taken all the manuals in other universes and thrown them into Book Mountain.
“Ninety-six Eternal legacies?” Meng Chuan paid attention to this point.
He wasn’t surprised that there were more than 1,000 Eighth Tribulation Eminences manuals. After all, Seventh Tribulation Eminences could collect them.
Eighth Tribulation Eminences had long lifespans, so he found it normal for Dragon Ancestor to collect 1,000 copies. It wasn’t difficult for an ordinary Eighth Tribulation Eminence to collect dozens of copies and send them in. However, there were 96 Eternal legacies?
“Eternal existences are the peak existences in the endless spacetime. The few of them are also happy to teach their juniors,” said Dragon Ancestor. “However, their legacies might not be profound. For example, the Void Catalog was left behind by an Eternal, but it only talks about the spatial law. There are also manuals that only talk about the temporal law. There are also manuals that talk about array formations. Many of them only talk about a small branch. As the endless spacetime is too vast, it’s difficult for an Eternal existence to explain everything.”
Meng Chuan understood.
“Eternal legacies are precious because they are simple yet profound and easy to understand,” said Dragon Ancestor. “The 96 Eternal legacies in Book Mountain can be cultivated to the top Eighth Tribulation realm.
“Knowledge is the path that leads to eternity,” said Dragon Ancestor with a smile. “In the hundred years before the tribulation, you should spend more time at Book Mountain. It might be useful for your tribulation.”
With that said, Dragon Ancestor turned and left.
“Thank you for your guidance, Dragon Ancestor.” Meng Chuan bowed immediately. He stood in the garden and pondered for a moment before immediately sending an Essence Soul avatar to Book Mountain.
...
Dragon Ancestor stood in the dark void and watched Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar head to Book Mountain.
I’m about to start creating a new universe
, thought Dragon Ancestor.
A new universe requires an Eighth Tribulation Eminence to create it. This Creation God... is most suitable for Meng Chuan.
The creation of a universe was the birth of a universe. There were endless possibilities.
If Dragon Ancestor was willing to give Meng Chuan the Creation authority, Meng Chuan could control the laws of that universe. Under the highest circulation law, he could carry out creation! The entire universe could be created according to his will. If there were any mistakes, he could destroy it and start anew.
Creation... was very difficult. One had to grasp the laws of time and space completely before they were qualified to attempt it.
To an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, it was also a rare tempering.
Creating a universe wasn’t easy, and one had to pay a huge price. Over the years, Dragon Ancestor had only created two universes. He became the Creation God the first time. He gave it to Phoenix Ancestor the second time. He planned on letting Meng Chuan take responsibility for the third.
Don’t disappoint me.
Dragon Ancestor was filled with anticipation. Meng Chuan’s foundation was too good, and his potential was limitless. He could become a powerful companion for Dragon Ancestor.
...
Book Mountain was in a hidden spacetime.
It was thousands of feet tall, and no living beings had disturbed it for a long time. The black-robed, white-haired Meng Chuan only sensed its location after Dragon Ancestor’s guidance.
Without any obstruction, he successfully arrived.
Meng Chuan looked up.
There were no flowers or trees on the floating mountain, only a large number of manuals.
There were all kinds of manuals—crystals, metals, leaves, paper, fur... All sorts of mediums were used to contain the legacies, and they also used all sorts of languages. Just by looking at them with the naked eye, Meng Chuan could vaguely sense the infinite wisdom contained in the manuals.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul seemed to sense the appearances of the existences writing manuals.
The manuals are wisdom. The manuals of different universes contain the wisdom of different universes.
Meng Chuan reached out and picked up a jade stone beside him. After sensing it for a moment, Meng Chuan could sense all the mental imprints contained in the words and understand their intentions.
Mortal realm, Strange realm, Fiend realm, Origin realm...
Meng Chuan looked at the otherverse’s cultivation system.
It was a very strange cultivation system. First, one would transform themselves into monsters. After becoming monsters, it would be difficult for mortals to harm them at all. After that, one would reach the even more terrifying Fiend realm. One step further, one would fuse with the Origins of a planet. If one’s Origins wasn’t destroyed, they wouldn’t die. After that, one would completely refine the planet’s Origins and become a planetary lifeform. This cultivation system would allow one’s true body to become larger and larger—from stars to galaxies, and eventually, miniature universes.
It feels like a Chaos creature. Their bodies will become larger.
Meng Chuan put down the manual in his hand. This manual allowed one’s body to be the size of a galaxy. It was only comparable to a Seventh Tribulation Eminence. It had yet to comprehend time and space completely.
I only have 100 years to prepare. I have to make the best use of my time.
Eternal-level legacies are strategically situated; they point to different domains. I have to read them all. I can read the Eighth Tribulation manuals roughly. Although most Seventh Tribulation manuals are from other universes, they are also Origins manuals. They represent a large number of cultivation paths.
This Heavenly Tribulation will avoid what I’m good at. Then, I’ll try my best to read about the different pathways and draw upon their wisdom. By reading more, I can draw references from each other... It’ll be easier to find a breakthrough point when I encounter unfamiliar matters.
Meng Chuan knew this very well.
With a plan in mind, he began cultivating on Book Mountain.
There were different levels to the 96 Eternal legacies. Some were even incomplete.
Meng Chuan roughly read through them. He spent more time studying those that were easy to comprehend. He didn’t waste time on those that were too difficult.
He spent more than three years reading the 96 legacies. After that, he limited his Essence Soul avatar on Dry Origin Mountain to spend one day for each of the 1,506 Eighth Tribulation manuals. It took more than four years.
There was no other choice.
The time he had left to transcend the tribulation didn’t allow him to study an ultimate technique carefully. Furthermore, the deeper he studied an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation, the more it would be avoided. Therefore, in order to prepare for the tribulation, Meng Chuan pursued to be as well-read as he could. At the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm, even if he only studied it for a day, he could cultivate the otherverse system to the Fifth or Sixth Tribulation realm.
After that was a massive number of Seventh Tribulation-level manuals; almost all of them were from other universes. Meng Chuan experienced the wisdom of different paths in various universes.
His Essence Soul avatar read on Book Mountain, while his Essence Soul avatar on Dry Origin Mountain focused on distilling the information.
This was because the time flow on Dry Origin Mountain was three-fold faster than in his home universe despite reducing it to one-tenth of the original time acceleration.
In the blink of an eye, he spent 60 years reading on Book Mountain.
It’s about time.
Although he still hadn’t read a portion of Seventh Tribulation manuals and a massive number of manuals below the Seventh Tribulation realm, Meng Chuan stopped.
To spend 60 out of the 100 years before transcending the tribulation on Book Mountain was sufficient.
Although I haven’t been to other universes, I’ve seen many different universes.
Meng Chuan sighed. He had absorbed the wisdom of different universes from many books, and he felt fulfilled. At the very least, his horizons were much wider than before he came to Book Mountain.
Next up is to kill a Chaos overlord.
Meng Chuan had a plan. He wanted to kill a Chaos overlord before transcending the tribulation and snatch its talent.

chapters.title: Chapter 758 - Meng Chuans Goal
chapters.content:
Chapter 758: Meng Chuan’s Goal
Translator:
CKtalon
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in a wooden hut on Dry Origin Mountain.
The time flow in this wooden hut was one-tenth of the normal time flow on Dry Origin Mountain.
It’s time to take action.
Meng Chuan opened his eyes, and the time flow in the wooden hut returned to normal.
I can only choose one out of the 31 Chaos overlords.
Meng Chuan had already tried every one of them over the years. With the intelligence given by Thousand-Hands, Meng Chuan naturally had a deep understanding of the 31 Chaos overlords.
Although these 31 were all Chaos overlords, there were still differences in strength. For example, the strongest one was called Abyss. It was an indescribably distorted existence; it was a complete abyss. There was no way to destroy it. Once one entered its body, they would be trapped in the abyss. According to the intelligence, only someone with the strength of an Eighth Tribulation Eminence could escape from its body.
Meng Chuan had once entered the prison cell that imprisoned Abyss. Once he entered and Abyss awakened, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar had already entered the abyss and was forced to self-destruct.
Abyss was one of the strongest Chaos overlords. Meng Chuan didn’t have any hope at defeating it at all—the strength difference was too great.
There were a total of nine Chaos overlords that completely surpassed him.
There were 20 who were on par with him; they had the strength of ordinary Chaos overlords. After all, he had just reached the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm. His accumulation wasn’t deep enough.
There were only two who were weaker than him. These two Chaos overlords... Meng Chuan guessed that they had just broken through recently. A newly-advanced Eighth Tribulation Eminence was still superior to a newly-advanced Chaos overlord.
The test left behind by the Eternal is indeed not difficult. As long as I reach the Eighth Tribulation realm and cultivate for a few more years, I’ll be able to kill most of these imprisoned Chaos overlords.
Meng Chuan understood this point.
Even the newly-advanced can kill the two weakest ones.
Of these two, one was called Lord of Dreams. Its talent was to create a dream world. The dream world it created was as vast and real as a universe, causing enemies to sink into it. According to the intelligence, Lord of Dreams could also cultivate in a dream.
Another was Realm Devouring Overlord. Its talent move was to open its mouth and swallow! As long as it wanted to, it could devour anything—no matter how large it was. It could even swallow an entire universe by taking several mouthfuls during a slow meal. The premise was that no native Eighth Tribulation Eminence could stop it. According to Thousand-Hands’s intelligence, Realm Devouring Overlord had an infinite stomach in its body. An infinite stomach meant true infinite space.
It was vast and boundless.
The structure of space was very special. It was an infinitely folded spacetime. As long as one was willing, they could fold as many spacetime spaces as they wanted.
Only with an infinite stomach could one eat a universe.
These two weakest Chaos overlords have pretty good talent. One is a dream technique that allows one to cultivate in a dream. The other has an infinite stomach that can devour worlds.
Although Meng Chuan felt that they weren’t bad, he could only kill one Chaos overlord on Dry Origin Mountain as stipulated by the opportunities the Eternal existence had bestowed. Thus, the stronger the talent was, the better.
There were many more talented Chaos overlords. For example, a Chaos overlord had the talent of having 3,000 avatars! Although some Chaos overlords could divide into many sub-bodies due to their body structure—such as a Chaos overlord that had hundreds or even tens of thousands of sub-bodies—their sub-bodies were generally much weaker. But all 3,000 of this Chaos overlord’s avatars had the strength of its original body! To a certain extent, they had broken through the laws of endless spacetime.
The endless spacetime had restrictions on the avatars of Physical Body Tribulation Eminences and Essence Soul Tribulation Eminences.
Although this Chaos overlord’s 3,000 avatars couldn’t be too distant from each other, each of them had the strength of a true body. It was somewhat terrifying. Even though one of its true bodies only had the strength of an ordinary Chaos overlord, its talent made it one of the top three most terrifying existences imprisoned on Dry Origin Mountain.
Meng Chuan believed that only a peak Eighth Tribulation Eminence could defeat it.
The 3,000-avatar talent, each comparable to the true body, will greatly increase the efficiency of cultivation if so used.
Meng Chuan coveted this talent. Furthermore, this was a talent that had broken through the endless spacetime laws.
According to Senior Brother Thousand-Hands’s records, such a talent had extraordinary significance. If one could comprehend its profundities, they could cultivate this path to the limits of the Eighth Tribulation realm.
The talents of Chaos overlords were all extremely amazing.
Chaos overlords had experienced countless tribulations in the endless spacetime before reaching the pinnacle of Chaos creatures and becoming overlords. As Eighth Tribulation-level lifeforms, the talent they produced was naturally unimaginable. Ordinary means weren’t considered talent for lifeforms at their level.
I can only choose one that suits me the best.
Meng Chuan came to Dry Origin Mountain’s imprisoned space and arrived in front of a prison cell. He looked at the Chaos overlord inside.
This is it!
Meng Chuan levitated in front of one of the 31 spatial prisons.
Through the spatial prison’s membrane, time was still. A hundred-headed monster was entrenched in the prison. The hundred heads had very calm expressions. Each head had white eyebrows that fluttered. Its single eye was closed, and it had no ears or nose. Its body was somewhat similar to a tentacled octopus. Its massive body coiled there, and the hundred heads looked calm and peaceful.
“Wise.” Meng Chuan looked at it.
This monster was called Wise.
It was originally one of the countless living beings living inside Abyss. After years of nurturing, it became the most valued subordinate of Abyss. It lived at the bottom of Abyss and helped Abyss perfect its structure and devour the outside world. Abyss also gave it a portion of its devouring power, allowing it to advance to become a Chaos overlord.
Abyss relied on the wisdom of Wise to become stronger.
Abyss devoured countless living beings and countless worlds. Ordinary Eighth Tribulation Eminences could only protect themselves in front of it and escape its capture. Only Eternal personal disciples could match it.
As it was too fearless and unrestrained, it captured and devoured many spacetime continuums. Finally, an Eternal existence took action and captured Abyss. The Hundred-Headed Wise in Abyss was naturally brought over. As they were both Chaos overlords, they were imprisoned in two different areas.
The intelligence on it is very vague. It’s only said that it’s Wise. There are no detailed records of its powerful talent.
Even so, Meng Chuan wanted to kill it very much.
It was very strange for Chaos overlords to be famous for their intelligence.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan stood outside the spatial prison and sent an Essence Soul avatar in.
The moment he entered, time in the massive spatial prison returned to normal. The hundred-headed monster, Wise—which had been motionless from the imprisonment—opened its eyes.
Its eyes were calm, without any hint of ruthlessness. The corners of its mouth were slightly curved as though it was smiling. Its white eyebrows fluttered as hundreds of heads stared at Meng Chuan. “You’re here again.”
“I’m here to kill you again.” Meng Chuan nodded.
“When the Eternal captured me, I knew that I had to repay karma,” said the hundred-headed monster. “However, you still can’t kill me with your strength.”
“Is that so?” Meng Chuan smiled.
At their level, it was very difficult to see their respective futures. However, the hundred-headed monster seemed to be able to see through everything. Its prophecies were extremely accurate.
Whoosh.
The hundred-headed monster entrenched itself, but an illusory abyss appeared around it.
This was a spherical abyss. From the outermost layer to the inner layer, the hundred-headed monster was at the core.
The innermost layer of the abyss was the smallest, slightly larger than a river system. The outermost layer of the abyss was even larger than a river zone. A total of 399 layers of the abyss formed a sphere that occupied more than half of the spatial prison. This was a spatial prison that imprisoned Chaos overlords. The space inside varied in size, so it was naturally easy to withstand it.
Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!
The 399 layers of the illusory abyss protected it. Yet, Meng Chuan’s invisible will still seeped into the hundred-headed monster’s consciousness.
An attack that targeted the mind.
As an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence, Meng Chuan was the strongest in this aspect. He wanted to destroy the other party’s consciousness.
“I’ve already said that it’s useless.” Many invisible thoughts seeped through the layers of the abyss. Every layer Meng Chuan passed through made it harder for him to penetrate further. When they completely seeped into the hundred-headed monster’s body, only 30% of its strength remained. The hundred-headed monster resisted as it spoke.
“Seal of World Annihilation.”
With a thought, another array formation appeared. A large seal condensed and crushed down.
The hundred-headed monster sighed inwardly. Eighth Tribulation Eminences who had completely grasped time and space had terrifying means.
Moments later...
I still can’t kill it.
Meng Chuan stopped and looked at the hundred-headed monster protected by the illusory abyss.
I’ll give it a try after my formulation is perfected. If it still doesn’t work, I can only give up and choose a weaker Chaos overlord.
After reading on Book Mountain for 60 years and reading a large number of Eternal legacies, his horizons had broadened.
Meng Chuan had plans to perfect his ultimate techniques.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatar retreated.
The moment he retreated, the time flow in the spatial prison gradually came to a halt. An invisible sealing force suppressed the hundred-headed monster.
How glorious was it back then?
The hundred-headed creature couldn’t help but recall the scene when Abyss traversed endless spacetime and devoured worlds.
Abyss was too powerful. Many Chaos creatures submitted to Abyss after being sucked into it, becoming its subordinates.
And it was the one with the highest status below Abyss.
Unfortunately, these were all memories.
The hundred-headed monster closed its eyes and was completely imprisoned. Time also came to a complete standstill.

chapters.title: Chapter 759 - Painting Dao
chapters.content:
Chapter 759: Painting Dao
Translator:
CKtalon
Archean Eon Realm, Jiang State Capital, Meng Manor.
Ah Chuan has been completely immersed in his cultivation recently. Everything has been thrown to the side.
Liu Qiyue was reading on a bamboo chair when she looked up at the study where Meng Chuan was painting.
Liu Qiyue knew very well that her husband had many Essence Soul avatars. None of his avatars were willing to be distracted, clearly indicating that this was a critical moment.
Eighth Tribulation realm...
Liu Qiyue felt mixed emotions. From the bottom of her heart, she even hoped that her husband would stay at the half-step Eighth Tribulation realm for a long time and transcend the tribulation only when he was close to the end of his lifespan.
However, the path of cultivation was about courage and perseverance. Without courage and perseverance, one’s willpower would be unable to withstand the evolution of spacetime.
Meng Chuan couldn’t control his cultivation progress. His Essence Soul World had evolved spacetime, which meant that he only had 100 years left.
According to Ah Chuan, there are only 100 years left until the Tribulation Transcendence. It’s been 80 years; there’s less and less time left.
Liu Qiyue knew that her husband’s becoming of an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation lifeform was a celebrated matter in the entire River of Spacetime’s cultivation world. It was also an opportunity for Archean Eon Realm’s fate to transform.
Once Meng Chuan succeeded, Archean Eon Realm would leap to become a high-level world.
Many living beings in Archean Eon Realm would benefit from it. Even if she reached the end of her lifespan, she could transcend Samsara and become an Archean Eon Realm deity. She could then live as long as the heavens.
To his homeworld and his species, it was an opportunity for them to transform.
But to Meng Chuan... it was a life-and-death calamity!
Ever since you were young, you have been like this. You bravely forged forward and ignored your own life. You hunted demon monarchs every day and killed a million demon monarchs alone. You also broke through in the outer realm and eventually won the demon invasion war. After reaching the Tribulation realm, you never stopped...
Liu Qiyue had once tried to persuade her husband that he could stop and take a break if he won the war. He could then enjoy the scenery of the world. The beauty of the world wasn’t just about cultivation.
Although her husband agreed verbally, he still cultivated into an unimaginable Eighth Tribulation lifeform.
According to her son—Meng An—a Seventh Tribulation Eminence had visited him and his wife. From this, one could tell how important her husband was in the River of Spacetime.
“It’s done!” A joyous voice sounded from the study.
Liu Qiyue immediately put down the book in her hand and walked over. She saw Meng Chuan happily looking at the painting in front of him.
“You succeeded?” Liu Qiyue walked over and looked at the painting.
The long painting was only partially unfolded. Meng Chuan was painting the last part of the painting.
The final part was a black dragon claw, and the scales on the dragon claw made Liu Qiyue’s heart tremble. Just looking at it made her turn pale as if she could see the universe shattering.
Meng Chuan immediately rolled up the painting and held his wife’s hand. His Power of Essence Soul immediately calmed the trembling of his wife’s Essence Soul.
“The painting’s aura is completely restrained, so it doesn’t leak out at all. It’s fine for mortals to see it, but the higher one’s realm is, the more insights they gain from looking at the painting. In turn, the impact will be greater,” said Meng Chuan. “If you want to view it, you can try the first painting.”
Liu Qiyue nodded slightly.
Meng Chuan sighed. “The Painting Dao can contain the universe’s spacetime. This time, I used 19 paintings to fully paint the insights I’ve accumulated over the years.”
He had to thank Dragon Ancestor.
In Book Mountain as proposed and created by Dragon Ancestor, the 96 Eternal legacies and the vast number of manuals from the various universes had greatly broadened Meng Chuan’s horizons. He even felt that his Painting Dao had already exceeded the scope of the six-stroke runic seal mystic technique and extended to a stronger level.
In fact, the six-stroke runic seal was only the Eternal existence’s threshold for accepting a disciple. It was far from the limits of the Painting Dao.
The six-stroke runic seal was a threshold; it represented one’s cultivation direction.
Only today did Meng Chuan realize that he had exceeded the limits of the six-stroke runic seal. He was venturing toward a deeper level.
“If you perfect what you’ve learned, will your chances of transcending the tribulation increase?” asked Liu Qiyue.
“I don’t even know what I’ll encounter during the Tribulation Transcendence.” Meng Chuan looked at his wife and understood her worries. He smiled and said, “However, I’m guessing that I’ll have a better chance.”
He wasn’t lying. The 19 paintings he created this time represented his greatest achievement, but what he was truly happy about was the improvement in his Painting Dao. The Painting Dao was core to the way he viewed the world and his cultivation beliefs.
As one cultivated the Sword Dao, everything could be transformed into a sword art in the eyes of sword cultivators!
A Painting Dao cultivator would have everything transform into a painting. In Meng Chuan’s eyes, this was the most fundamental wisdom! No matter what kind of situation he encountered, he was confident that he could use the Painting Dao to comprehend it. If he could comprehend everything one day, he would be ‘doubtless’ and ‘omniscient.’ That would mean being an Eternal.
...
Dry Origin Mountain, dark-red space.
Meng Chuan arrived in front of the spatial prison that imprisoned the Chaos overlord, Wise. He looked at the hundred-headed monster—which was in stopped time—and thought to himself,
This is the last time I’m attacking you. If failure persists, I can only change targets.
He had spent 80 years before the tribulation integrating all his knowledge completely.
If he still couldn’t kill Wise, he couldn’t think of any other solution. He could only switch to a weaker Chaos overlord.
Lord of Dreams and Realm Devouring Overlord weren’t bad either.
He had to kill one before transcending the tribulation. At the very least, it would increase his chances of transcending the tribulation. He had to fight for it.
Hum.
The moment Meng Chuan stepped into the spatial prison, time began to flow. It returned to normal, and the hundred-headed monster opened its eyes.
“You’re here again.” From the hundred-headed monster’s point of view, time remained still every time it was imprisoned. Therefore, it felt like Meng Chuan was repeatedly challenging it without stopping.
“This is the last time,” said Meng Chuan indifferently as he stood in midair.
“Oh?” The hundred-headed monster turned solemn. The last time?
With a thought from the hundred-headed monster, a vast illusory abyss appeared. The massive sphere protected the hundred-headed monster layer by layer—this was the strongest defensive technique it had comprehended. In fact, due to Abyss’s protection, it didn’t encounter any intense battles after becoming a Chaos overlord.
Thus, it wasn’t very skilled in combat. It had only comprehended layers of defensive techniques that combined 399 layers.
“I especially drew a painting for you. It’s Painting 17—Snake Bind!” said Meng Chuan, and his Essence Soul World enveloped the entire spatial prison. With a thought, a winding snake appeared, and the snake coiled around the 399-layer spherical abyss.
The snake’s scales wriggled as terrifying energy accumulated. The snake coiled and distorted, causing the spherical abyss to tremble.
Oh?
The hundred-headed monster was shocked.
Clang!
In less than three seconds, the outermost layer of the abyss had shattered.
The outermost layer of the abyss was the most resilient. Although the subsequent layers of the illusory abyss had all sorts of defensive means, they were inferior to the outermost layer in terms of direct resistance.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Meng Chuan smiled as he watched the layers shatter.
In the previous battles, the various bizarre means he had at the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm were weakened by the 399 layers of the protective abyss. He knew that the other party was Wise, so it had definitely spent a lot of effort to protect itself.
Therefore, the best way was to use strength to crack it! To pummel it with absolute strength, he created the strongest technique—Snake Bind!
In fact, just as he had expected, the outermost layer only bought it a short period of time before collapsing.
Change.
As the protective abyss collapsed, the hundred-headed monster’s body suddenly etherealized.
“Humph.” Meng Chuan snorted coldly.
The Power of Essence Soul was like a sharp blade as it attacked the hundred-headed monster’s mind! Although the hundred-headed monster was a Chaos overlord, its willpower was inferior to an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence’s. After all its defensive means were destroyed, it suffered the full brunt of Meng Chuan’s Power of Essence Soul.
The hundred-headed monster’s illusory body distorted in pain until it became corporeal again.
