The moment it became corporeal, the coiled snake suddenly squeezed.
Pfft!
The bound hundred-headed monster was completely destroyed.
Snake Bind didn’t just restrain the target; it also bound spacetime. The bound spacetime was destroyed everywhere, so it was naturally impossible for the enemy to have any sliver of energy escape.
The moment it was destroyed, Meng Chuan saw the sealed Life Core—a silver-gray book.
Book?
Meng Chuan took a step forward and arrived in front of the book. He saw two words on the book’s surface.
He had never seen them before, but he understood the meaning—Miscellaneous Records.
In the endless Chaos, there are countless Chaos creatures. There are also all sorts of Life Cores. I wonder where they came from.
Meng Chuan even wanted to read the book’s contents, but the book disintegrated and completely dissipated the moment his Power of Essence Soul touched the book. At the same time, a mysterious force seeped into every part of Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul.
Boom!
Meng Chuan felt his Essence Soul tremble. It was even more intense than the first time he devoured one at the Seventh Tribulation realm.
He resisted the urge and immediately flew out of the spatial prison. After he left, the spatial prison silently disappeared.
Now, there were only 30 Chaos overlord cells at the highest level.

chapters.title: Chapter 760 - Passing the Test
chapters.content:
Chapter 760: Passing the Test
Translator:
CKtalon
Meng Chuan exited the dark-red space and sat cross-legged in the mountain forest on Dry Origin Mountain.
Meng Chuan trembled and felt dizzy and light-headed. All sorts of feelings attacked him.
Due to them violating taboos, these Chaos overlords were imprisoned by an Eternal existence. There was a limit to the number of them. In-name disciples of the Eternal existence could kill only one. Biy due to the rules set by the Eternal existence—which were enforced to the letter upon its promulgation—killing them on Dry Origin Mountain could allow them to devour their powers perfectly, forming a talent that was most suitable for them.
Such an opportunity was extremely precious.
Meng Chuan used this opportunity on Chaos overlord, Wise.
After the mysterious power fused with Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul for a moment, a vast number of memories surged into Meng Chuan’s mind.
Boom!
After cultivating to the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul had immense endurance. However, the surging memories made Meng Chuan momentarily unable to think.
The memory surge lasted for more than 30 seconds before Meng Chuan finished absorbing them.
I perfectly devoured this Chaos overlord and obtained its memories?
Meng Chuan was astonished. He originally thought that it was a talent, but who knew that it was a vast memory base?
Meng Chuan tried to understand these memories.
It took Meng Chuan more than 12 hours to understand the memories that took about 30 seconds to inject. After all, Meng Chuan could read vast amounts of information with a thought, but he spent so much time reading the memories.
So this is why this Chaos overlord is called Wise?
Meng Chuan came to a realization.
After reading the memories, he understood everything. When Wise, a Chaos overlord, was still a Fifth Tribulation Chaos creature, it had encountered Abyss. Back then, Abyss was already at the top of the Eighth Tribulation realm. It devoured countless spacetime creatures and stored them in its body. Back then, Wise had been sucked in just like that. It became one of the countless living beings in Abyss and experienced cruel competition.
Growing amidst the competition, Wise became a Seventh Tribulation Chaos creature. It had the right to occupy a layer of the abyss alone, and its modifications to the abyss layer made it the strongest. This delighted Abyss itself, who then began nurturing it.
Under Wise’s suggestion, the entire abyss’s structure gradually became perfected. Abyss finally broke through to the limits of the Eighth Tribulation realm, so it naturally favored Wise more. A large number of Seventh Tribulation Chaos creatures and even Chaos overlords were given to Wise for devouring. Just like that, Wise transformed into a Chaos overlord.
With its help, Abyss became stronger. It even became more terrifying at the Eighth Tribulation realm’s limits.
The Eternal’s personal disciples could only fight it to a draw in battle. It was then that the Eternal personally imprisoned Abyss and Wise.
It was also today that Meng Chuan killed Wise, obtaining its memories.
Wise is a hundred-headed monster. It’s born with a hundred heads, and each head has a different personality, thoughts, and hobbies. It’s like a hundred completely different living beings, but their memories are interconnected, forming a complete consciousness. These hundred heads deliberately seek different cultivation paths. It’s important to note that it devoured many Chaos creatures in Abyss, and it’s born to devour the memories of other creatures.
The more memories it devoured, the more knowledgeable it became.
The hundred heads took a hundred cultivation paths?
Meng Chuan sighed in amazement. He had only taken one path—the Painting Dao!
Wise actually took a hundred paths simultaneously—one for each head. The Painting Dao was also one of them, but Wise’s attainments in the Painting Dao were only at Meng Chuan’s level when he was at the Sixth Tribulation realm.
However, that didn’t undermine Wise’s multiple paths.
Painting Dao, Soul Dao, Heart Dao, Dream Dao, World Dao, Talisman Dao, Array Formation Dao... These paths weren’t figured out by Wise. Instead, they were gradually consolidated by the memories of the countless living beings it devoured in Abyss. Therefore, each path’s realm wasn’t high.
The higher ones were around the Seventh Tribulation realm, while the lower ones were around the Sixth Tribulation realm.
Although it had relied on devouring memories to take a hundred paths, it still astonished Meng Chuan.
This was because he knew very well that one had to be dedicated to one path when taking it. Just like the Painting Dao, one needed a pair of eyes that could paint the world. It was the same for other paths.
Wise was indeed extremely talented. It walked a hundred paths with a ‘hundred dedication.’ Every path was sincerely liked by its heart, and it had the necessary talent. Only by doing so could it ultimately walk a hundred paths.
The reason why it’s called Wise is that it can comprehend anything from the vantage of a hundred paths simultaneously. By verifying and cross-referencing using the 100 paths, the intersection that Wise figures out will be something it finds absolutely correct. It’s also because of this method that it constantly deduced the structure of Abyss, allowing Abyss to become more perfect and powerful.
Meng Chuan sighed in amazement.
The intersection of 100 insights? It can be done?
As an opportunity offered to him as an Eternal disciple, Meng Chuan could perfectly devour a Chaos creature once, but all he received were memories.
However, the memories regarding the 100 Dao were too precious. Meng Chuan was very satisfied.
He felt that he could use his Painting Dao to draw on the strengths of these hundred Dao.
This was how cultivation should be. Every Great Dao led to the final goal—Eternal! His Painting Dao could use the 100 Dao as sustenance.
He couldn’t cultivate a hundred Dao like Wise. This was because he had to be dedicated to a path before he could go far!
Ordinary creatures could only walk one path.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan was in a good mood. He was naturally happy that his foundation in painting had a chance of improving.
When Meng Chuan opened his eyes with a smile, he saw a black-and-white beast staring at him with its eyes wide open.
Meng Chuan was shocked; he didn’t sense it.
“Senior Thousand-Hands.” Meng Chuan immediately stood up and bowed.
“Now, you can call me Senior Brother,” said the black-and-white beast with a smile.
Meng Chuan was delighted.
Killing a Chaos overlord meant passing the test. He could be considered a disciple of an Eternal existence, so Thousand-Hands could now be addressed as senior brother.
“Greetings, Senior Brother Thousand-Hands.” Meng Chuan bowed respectfully.
The black-and-white beast threw out a jade talisman. “Refine it.”
Meng Chuan caught the jade talisman and infused his Power of Essence Soul into it.
The jade talisman immediately fused with Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul, causing a flame mark to appear at his glabella.
“From now on, you can barely be considered Master’s disciple,” said the black-and-white beast.
When Meng Chuan refined the jade talisman, he understood many things. For example, his master’s name. For example, his master’s cave abode and his 99 residences.
“Barely count?” Meng Chuan was puzzled.
“You will naturally be considered Master’s disciple after passing the test,” said the black-and-white beast. “But strictly speaking, you still have to head to Master’s cave abode, Azure Volcano, and obtain Master’s personal approval.”
Meng Chuan nodded slightly. As a disciple, he could use a mystic technique to form a spacetime teleportation tunnel that linked Dry Origin Mountain to Azure Volcano. Even an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence would take ten years.
“Once you arrive at Azure Volcano, you have to wait for an audience. Master might sleep for hundreds of millions of years. When he summons you will naturally depend on his will,” said the black-and-white beast.
“Understood.” Meng Chuan nodded. Eighth Tribulation Eminences were beyond the River of Spacetime. They had the patience, no matter how long they had to wait.
However, he didn’t have much time left before his tribulation. He couldn’t afford to wait.
“The most important thing for you right now is to transcend the tribulation,” said the black-and-white beast. “Master is very lenient with his disciples. He allows them to cultivate and grow. Even if they encounter danger and die to a powerful enemy, Master will pull his disciples out from spacetime. But there’s one thing... Master can’t save you when your lifespan is up.
“Who determines your lifespan? In fact, it’s the endless spacetime law which deems when you die,” said the black-and-white beast. “Do those Sixth and Seventh Tribulation Eminences really die because of age? It’s the endless spacetime law determining that it’s time for them to die of old age. The endless laws of spacetime cannot be violated. Only by transcending the ninth Heavenly Tribulation can one truly transcend and become Eternal.
“You are now facing the eighth Heavenly Tribulation. If you fail to transcend it, you will die. If the endless spacetime believes that you deserve death, even if Master scoops you out, you will be obliterated once more,” said the black-and-white beast.
Meng Chuan understood.
If the endless spacetime wants me dead, even Master can’t save me.

chapters.title: Chapter 761 - Meng Chuan and Meng Yu
chapters.content:
Chapter 761: Meng Chuan and Meng Yu
Translator:
CKtalon
“Transcend the tribulation well. After transcending the eighth Heavenly Tribulation, your lifespan will greatly increase. You will also be able to see scenes that are thousands of times more exciting,” said Thousand-Hands with a grin. “Otherwise, you will only be able to live for a couple hundred thousand years and experience a single universe. Your horizons will be too limited.”
Meng Chuan didn’t agree. A Seventh Tribulation Eminence stood at the peak of a universe; he had obtained enough.
But in comparison, an Eighth Tribulation Eminence that was beyond the River of Spacetime could experience unimaginable things.
“Your test is over; you can’t stay here for too long. It’s time to leave,” said Thousand-Hands. “If you wish to meet Master in the future, just head to Azure Volcano.”
“Senior Brother Thousand-Hands, I’ll take my leave,” said Meng Chuan.
Thousand-Hands nodded.
Meng Chuan’s body dissipated.
Wu~
Only then did Thousand-Hands beam with delight.
I’m the only one left on Dry Origin Mountain. All the troublesome ones have left.
Thousand-Hands lay on the ground happily. He hugged himself with his six claws, and two of his claws were caressing his face. He began sleeping again, and he naturally created the world he wanted to experience in his dream. As Senior Brother Thousand-Hands—who had the strength of a peak Eighth Tribulation Eminence—the world created by the dream was comparable to a real world.
Over the years, he had long gotten used to doing whatever he wanted in the dream worlds. He only woke up when he had to receive his master and the disciples.
...
In Archean Eon Realm’s Heaven and Earth Great Hall, Meng Chuan had a flame mark between his eyebrows. With a thought, the mark was hidden.
The Essence Soul avatar far away on Dry Origin Mountain dissipated at will. After all, the Essence Soul avatar didn’t have any treasures.
The true body in his home universe inherited all the talent and memories the Essence Soul avatar had received on Dry Origin Mountain, so there was no need for him to make the arduous journey.
There are still 20 years left before the Tribulation Transcendence.
Meng Chuan walked out of Heaven and Earth Great Hall.
All my avatars have returned to my home universe. I can control the time flow in my body and protect my homeworld for another 200 years.
Although he looked no different from others, Meng Chuan’s time flow was one-tenth that of the outside world. This way, the Heavenly Tribulation would descend 200 years later in his home universe.
Meng Chuan only wanted to protect his homeworld and spend more time with his family.
Whoosh.
High in Archean Mountain, Meng Chuan looked down at the entire sect.
After so many years of construction, especially after he became a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence, he had completely comprehended the universe’s ten Origins laws. He had created a large number of formulations for Archean Eon Realm’s Godfiend cultivation system, completely making up for Archean Eon Realm’s shortcomings.
Once a middle-level world produced a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence, the cultivation system would be perfected rapidly. This was because half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminences grasped the most fundamental time and space. Furthermore, they would comprehend the ten Origins laws.
After grasping all of these fundamental laws, they could deduce a cultivation system. It was the cultivation system that was most suitable for this universe, and it was much stronger than the cultivation system created by Seventh Tribulation Eminences. For example, Meng Chuan could create one cultivation system in three to five days. He had even created 30 Tribulation-level formulations.
If I succeed in transcending the tribulation, I will also create a perfected cultivation system for Archean Eon Realm’s Godfiend cultivation system that isn’t inferior to the Cosmos Body and the Shura cultivation systems.
His current realm was sufficient. After reading at Book Mountain and absorbing the memories of the Chaos overlord, Wise, he had accumulated enough. However, he didn’t have enough time.
Time was too tight to create a powerful formulation like the Cosmos Body cultivation system in just 20 years.
...
Archean Eon Realm.
Meng Chuan flew around Archean Eon Realm.
More than 1,600 years had passed since the war with the demons officially ended. To the commoners of Archean Eon Realm, the demons? They were only recorded in history books; it was distant history.
Archean Eon Realm was in its most prosperous period in history. As this era’s strongest expert in this River of Spacetime, Meng Chuan brought many benefits to Archean Eon Realm. A large number of rare treasures and manuals were sent to Archean Eon Realm.
Ordinary people in Archean Eon Realm could come into contact with cultivation. Cultivation became something every Archean Eon Realm member had to do, but the ratio of Godfiends was still extremely low.
However, the number of Godfiends born was much greater than 1,000 years ago. After all, this was a world that had produced an Eighth Tribulation lifeform. Such worlds were extremely prosperous in the River of Spacetime, second only to high-level worlds.
Meng Sha Realm.
Meng Chuan thought of Meng Sha Realm.
Ancestor Meng Sha had also become an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, but he had failed to transcend the tribulation.
The treasures he left for Meng Sha Realm attracted Celestial Thearch Myriad Star’s attention.
Fortune and disaster are two sides of the same coin.
Meng Chuan looked down at the prosperous Archean Eon Realm, but he knew that there was a limit to what he could do.
Without becoming a high-level world, generations of cultivators would naturally covet them.
Even after becoming a high-level world, it would only live on without worries if the Eighth Tribulation Eminence remained alive.
Even if one doesn’t experience any danger, there will come a day when an inhabited world will decline. Even a universe will have a day of destruction.
Meng Chuan was very calm.
There was only one way to resolve these problems—to reach the Eighth Tribulation realm. After reaching the Eighth Tribulation realm, one could lead their clansmen into escaping the calamity of a universe destruction.
Eighth Tribulation realm. Jumping out of the River of Spacetime?
Meng Chuan’s eyes were filled with anticipation. He was now only one obstacle away from the true Eighth Tribulation realm—Tribulation Transcendence!
...
Meng Chuan seemed carefree. He often accompanied his wife and parents, and he would even gather with his old friends, Yan Jin and Yan Chitong.
Yan Jin and company were over 1,800 years old, and they were living quite well. However, Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul avatars focused on thinking about the 100 different sets of memories he had obtained from the Chaos overlord, Wise. He drew on the 100 Dao as sustenance to enrich his Painting Dao.
Just like that, years passed. He was getting closer and closer to transcending the tribulation.
On Planet Great Isle in the outer realm.
Planet Great Isle was a branch of Yellow-Robed Academy.
“Brother Meng Yu, from today onward, you are also a member of our Yellow-Robed Academy,” said the scarlet rock creature with a laugh. “Don’t worry; my master is a Sixth Tribulation Eminence in the academy. With me taking care of you, you won’t be bullied in the academy.”
“Thank you, Brother Chisuo.” Meng Yu was rather excited. After so many years, he had finally transcended the tribulation and reached the Physical Body Fifth Tribulation realm.
In order to have sufficient confidence in transcending the tribulation, he had deliberately stalled for time. His realm was high enough, and he only perfected his body to usher in the Heavenly Tribulation when he was almost completely confident. He succeeded in one fell swoop.
Although my grandfather and father’s enemy is a Sixth Tribulation Eminence, I should be able to help a little after becoming a Fifth Tribulation Eminence,
thought Meng Yu.
“I’ll send you an intelligence report that all Yellow-Robed Academy members should know,” said Chisuo.
Meng Yu sensed it. This intelligence contained detailed information on the academy’s rules, rewards, and punishments. It also contained information on the various factions in the River of Spacetime.
There were records of the strongest existences as well. Most importantly, it mentioned the strongest Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence—City Lord Eastcalm—and his good friend, Hall Lord White Avian, who was a half-step Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
Huh?
Meng Yu was stunned. He carefully read the intelligence regarding City Lord Eastcalm, Meng Chuan.
City Lord Eastcalm, Meng Chuan. His homeworld is Three Bay River System’s Archean Eon Realm. He has a son, Meng An...
The intelligence highlighted points as a way to inform the subordinates to be careful. They didn’t want to offend an existence they couldn’t afford to offend. Intelligence on Meng An and his wife was no longer a secret to the top factions in spacetime.
Meng Yu read and verified it in a daze.
Meng Chuan? Meng An? Three Bay River System’s Archean Eon Realm? The names are the same. It can’t be that coincidental, right?
Meng Yu’s heart stirred.
An Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence? My grandfather is an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence? Is that possible?
He knew very little about Eighth Tribulation Eminences. With the intelligence he had, he only knew that Eighth Tribulation Eminences were omnipotent existences. They were high and mighty! Seventh Tribulation Eminences yearned to follow an Eighth Tribulation Eminence but to no avail. With a glance from an Eighth Tribulation Eminence, even a Seventh Tribulation Eminence would be annihilated...
City Lord Eastcalm, Meng Chuan, controls Earth Cloud Mystic Realm.
Meng Yu read the information.
Earth Cloud Mystic Realm? Isn’t that my homeworld?
“Yu’er.” A familiar voice sounded.
Meng Yu looked up and saw a black-robed, white-haired man appear beside him.
“Grandfather.” Meng Yu looked at his grandfather.
The moment his grandson learned the truth, Meng Chuan sensed it. After all, as long as someone remembered his name after he became an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence, he could sense it even while in distant universes.
“Senior, you are?” Chisuo was puzzled. Yellow-Robed Academy’s intelligence had records of Meng An, but there were no records of Meng Chuan’s imagery.
“I’m Meng Yu’s grandfather.” Meng Chuan smiled. “Yu’er, follow me.”
“Yes,” replied Meng Yu.
The grandfather-grandson duo vanished.
...
Meng Chuan and Meng Yu had already arrived at Earth Cloud Mystic Realm.
I’m back.
Meng Yu looked at the vast sky.
The sunset was gorgeous.
Meng Yu had always wanted to return to help his grandfather. Now that he was back, the outcome...
“You should’ve read the intelligence regarding me,” said Meng Chuan. “Back when I first met you, I hadn’t transcended the tribulation to the Sixth Tribulation realm.”
Meng Yu nodded. He believed that it couldn’t be fake because many of his mother’s clansmen had died. Furthermore, according to the intelligence, City Lord Eastcalm—Meng Chuan—cultivated extremely quickly. He went from a weakling to a Seventh Tribulation Eminence in a short period of time before becoming an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence.
“After gaining control of Earth Cloud Mystic Realm, I discussed it with your parents. I decided to hide it from you temporarily,” said Meng Chuan. “It was also for you to go further on your cultivation path. Your talent is more outstanding than your father’s.”
Meng Yu nodded and smiled. “I always thought that I had a powerful enemy. I’ve been cultivating carefully until now, but who knew that my grandfather was an Eighth Tribulation Eminence? Then, can I do whatever I want in the future?”
“I prepared this for you.” Meng Chuan handed him a silver bangle.
Meng Yu took it and checked it. The many treasures and cultivation manuals in the silver bangle were things he couldn’t obtain even in his wildest dreams.
“Thank you, Grandfather,” said Meng Yu immediately. The treatment was indeed different.
“That’s all I can help you with,” said Meng Chuan. He had to consider his species and other clansmen. His grandson had become a Fifth Tribulation Eminence and had a chance of reaching the Sixth Tribulation realm, but he had only given him treasures worth ten million cubes. Although these treasures were nothing to him, they were enough for his grandson.
“Grandfather, I understand. You have to be impartial,” said Meng Yu with a smile. “But Grandfather, you are an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. It’s fine... if you slightly tip the scale toward me.”
Meng Chuan looked at his grinning grandson. In fact, he could sense that Meng Yu was somewhat unhappy after being lied to for so many years. Even so, Meng Yu quickly let it go.
“Yu’er, everyone says that I’m an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence,” said Meng Chuan. “Actually, I still need to transcend the tribulation.”
“Tribulation Transcendence?” Meng Yu was taken aback.
“Yes, I will transcend the tribulation soon. My Essence Soul will undergo the eighth Heavenly Tribulation,” said Meng Chuan. “If I succeed, I’ll live. If I fail, I’ll die. You won’t have anything to rely on; you will still have to rely on yourself.”
Meng Yu looked at his grandfather dazedly.
According to the intelligence, Meng Chuan was an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence. However, transcending the tribulation was a huge secret; it wasn’t announced to the ordinary members.
Even the Seventh Tribulation Eminences didn’t know if Meng Chuan had transcended the Heavenly Tribulation, and they didn’t dare ask.
Meng Yu indeed suffered a heavy blow. He had been shocked and excited when he learned that his grandfather was an Eighth Tribulation Eminence. Now, his grandfather said that he needed to transcend the tribulation? Perhaps he would die? He still had to cultivate carefully?
“Grandfather, you will definitely transcend the tribulation successfully,” said Meng Yu seriously. “I’ve cultivated for so many years. What I want the most is not to act or pretend in front of any powerhouse. For my dream, Grandfather, you have to transcend the tribulation successfully.”
“Punk.” Meng Chuan could sense his grandson’s concern. “I’ll work hard.”
Meng Yu smiled.
Meng Yu roamed the world alone. He cared about his few family members the most.
...
In this era, Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminences was superior to all living beings. The various factions in the River of Spacetime were very careful; there were fewer chaotic battles in recent years.
As time slowly passed, the eighth Heavenly Tribulation finally descended.

chapters.title: Chapter 762 - Tribulation Begins, Exorcist
chapters.content:
Chapter 762: Tribulation Begins, Exorcist
Translator:
CKtalon
Archean Eon Realm.
Snow fell as Meng Chuan and his wife, Liu Qiyue, watched the history of Archean Eon Realm together.
Oh?
Meng Chuan suddenly sensed something.
The Heavenly Tribulation was about to descend; the vast power left Meng Chuan alarmed.
“Qiyue,” said Meng Chuan.
Liu Qiyue looked at her husband and immediately realized what was happening when she saw his expression. She asked, “Is it time for the tribulation?”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded. “I’m going to transcend the tribulation. There’s no need to tell Dad, Mom, and An’er.”
Everyone knew that Meng Chuan had to transcend the tribulation after becoming an Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation Eminence, but Meng Chuan didn’t tell them the exact time.
“Alright,” replied Liu Qiyue solemnly.
Meng Chuan stood up.
Liu Qiyue immediately stood up, hugged her husband, and said softly, “I’ll wait for you.”
“Alright.” Meng Chuan smiled and let go of his wife. He turned around and walked to the chamber.
Liu Qiyue watched silently before sitting down again. She watched the snow flutter.
The eighth Essence Soul Tribulation.
Liu Qiyue knew very well that this might be the most terrifying Heavenly Tribulation her husband would encounter.
Ah Chuan, you will succeed. I know it.
Liu Qiyue prayed silently.
...
In the chamber.
Meng Chuan dispersed all his Essence Soul avatars, leaving only his true body sitting cross-legged.
It’s here.
Meng Chuan sensed it.
As though warranted by fate, the Heavenly Tribulation descended. The invisible, terrifying force struck Meng Chuan’s Essence Soul, and his Essence Soul instantly trembled with no way to resist it.
Meng Chuan felt his consciousness rumble as he lost his perception of himself.
With a blurry consciousness, he felt a terrifying force wrap around him and throw him out! He traversed endless spacetime and headed to an extremely distant place. It was a place even further than Dry Origin Mountain.
It was another world...
...
“Senior Brother, don’t die! Don’t die; it’s all my fault. It’s all my fault...”
“Senior Brother, I’ll definitely bring you back to the Exorcism Division!”
“Senior Brother, we’re back. We’ve arrived at the Exorcism Division!”
“It will depend on fate whether Fang Qi wakes up. His injuries are too severe, and he lost too much blood...”
Meng Chuan vaguely heard some voices. Although he didn’t understand the language, he instinctively understood. However, the vessel for his consciousness was extremely weak, causing his consciousness to be adrift.
Occasionally, he would hear words from the outside world.
Gradually, Meng Chuan’s consciousness stabilized.
Finally, one day.
Boom!
Meng Chuan completely received the memories of a lifeform.
An Exorcist from the Great Yu Dynasty’s Exorcism Division? The world is already in chaos. Many warlords have risen together? The most terrifying existence in the world... Fiends?
Meng Chuan came to a complete understanding.
This was a mortal world. The Great Yu Dynasty was the largest dynasty in the entire world, and it had unified the world. But after 1300 years of rule, it had turned completely decadent. With the rise of firearms, many warlords used firearms to equip their armies.
The Great Yu Dynasty was already on the verge of collapse. Although the Imperial Court’s upper echelons knew that they had to use firearms, it was difficult to carry out the various orders once they reached the lower echelons. The military was bloated, and many factions occupied the land. This caused the Imperial Court’s army to be decimated. They were no match for the new armies of the warlords.
Fang Qi was the original owner of Meng Chuan’s body. He was the son of a local tycoon, Fang Dalong. When he was young, he entered the Exorcism Academy for his studies. Now, he was a Silver-badged Exorcist of the Imperial Court’s Exorcism Division—a seventh-grade official.
No matter how corrupt the Imperial Court was, Exorcists were viewed with great importance. This was because fiends were the most terrifying existence in the entire world. Even an army couldn’t deal with them. Therefore, during any era of the dynasty, all factions placed great importance on Exorcists.
Only an Exorcist could deal with fiends!
Huh?
Meng Chuan woke up and opened his eyes. He saw the bright sunlight shining in from the window.
What a weak body.
Meng Chuan sensed his body, and even breathing felt strenuous.
In my memories, this body was still very strong. I must’ve been lying in bed for too long.
Meng Chuan barely managed to sit up.
He looked at his right arm. It was empty, with only his sleeve fluttering.
I lost my right arm?
Meng Chuan wasn’t surprised. In his memories, he had lost an arm in order to save his junior brother, Li Feng. Back then, he had already lost an arm and was fleeing in panic with his junior brother. After that, he completely lost consciousness.
The original owner of this body had probably died at that time, and then he occupied this body.
This room was very familiar—it was where Fang Qi usually lived. As an Exorcist, the residence arranged by the Imperial Court was quite good.
Meng Chuan immediately saw a huge mirror, and it clearly reflected the outside world. Just this huge mirror alone was worth 100 taels of silver. It was definitely a luxury item.
Meng Chuan walked over and looked at himself in the mirror—a pale-faced, one-armed youth.
“Fang Qi, 19 years old. A Silver-badged Exorcist,” muttered Meng Chuan softly. “He lost an arm and 90% of his strength.”
Exorcists needed to form seals. Forming hand seals with both hands was naturally very different from forming hand seals with one hand. A single-handed hand seal could only unleash 10% of one’s strength.
Are Exorcists all mortals in this world?
Meng Chuan had a headache. As a Silver-badged Exorcist of the Imperial Court, he naturally knew many secrets.
Exorcists were also mortals. Even if they didn’t suffer from illnesses or disasters, their lifespans were the same as a normal person’s. It was a blessing for a normal person to be 100 years old.
One would be satisfied if they could live to 50 or 60 years of age.
Meng Chuan picked up a long pole and supported himself with one hand. Then, he slowly walked out of the house and out of the courtyard.
This small courtyard was also a part of the Exorcism Division.
“Fang Qi, you’re awake.”
“Silver-badged Fang!”
On the road ahead, two Exorcism Division officials walked side by side. They revealed looks of delight when they saw Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
“Fang Qi, you’re awake.”
“Fang Qi has been unconscious for more than half a month, but he has actually awoken.” The entirety of the Exorcism Division now knew that Fang Qi had awoken.
...
“Fang Qi,” said a white-browed elder in an official robe. “It’s a joyous occasion that you can wake up. Now that you have lost an arm, your strength has decreased greatly. It’s not suitable for you to continue being an Exorcist. You have two choices: One, you will still be a seventh-grade official when you return to the countryside. You will be given a leisurely job.”
The Exorcism Division had branches across the dynasty. It wasn’t difficult for them to arrange a retirement job for their staff back in their hometowns.
This was because many Exorcists died during exorcisms. Some survived but became crippled. The Exorcism Division had always guaranteed that every Exorcist could live a peaceful life even if they were crippled. After all, no matter how powerful an Exorcist was, they could become crippled because they had to deal with powerful fiends. Protecting these crippled people was to protect their future selves.
“The second choice is Exorcism Academy,” said the white-browed elder. “In Exorcism Academy, you will be a lecturer and teach the young children.”
“I’ll choose the second one,” said Meng Chuan.
The white-browed elder nodded slightly. “With your status as a Silver-badged Exorcist, you can directly become an official lecturer at the Exorcism Academy, which is a lower sixth-grade official. You can still be promoted by half a grade. By the way, remember to hand over the Exorcism Division’s Dharma artifacts.”
“Yes.” Meng Chuan nodded. Apart from personally purchased Dharma artifacts, he still had to return the Dharma artifacts the Exorcism Division had given him.
...
Fang Qi—an Exorcist with a severed arm—became a lecturer in the capital’s Exorcism Academy. This piece of news spread among the Exorcists.
Great Yu Dynasty’s capital, Exorcism Academy.
“Senior Brother, you can find a good-paying job and enjoy life. You can even get a few concubines to carry on your Fang family’s lineage. Why do you have to stay in the capital?” Li Feng was a very thin youth. He was 17 years old this year and had rather high talent. He had just been promoted to a Silver-badged Exorcist this year.
He was a good friend who shared the same room with Fang Qi back at the Exorcism Academy. But compared to Fang Qi, he was still lacking in experience and strength. Previously, he had caused Fang Qi to be crippled because of his mistake when dealing with the fiend.
“I don’t want to return for the time being,” said Meng Chuan with a smile.
“You don’t want to return?” said Li Feng. “I heard that your father got his sixth concubine. Are you unwilling to meet him?” He knew his senior brother’s situation.
“Don’t ask so much; go back and practice well. You have to be more familiar with the sealing technique. I saved you last time, but I won’t be able to save you the next time,” said Meng Chuan.
“Yes.” Li Feng nodded. Seeing his senior brother’s ruddy complexion, he felt relieved. Then, he walked away in the snow.
Meng Chuan watched Li Feng leave and then walked toward the Sutra Repository in Exorcism Academy.
I came to Exorcism Academy for this Sutra Repository.
The students of Exorcism Academy could freely borrow the books here. As lecturers, they could naturally read them as they pleased.
When he was a student, Fang Qi only learned from a few key books and read some of the other topics.
Now that Meng Chuan was here, he read even more voraciously. The Sutra Repository of the Great Yu Dynasty’s Capital Exorcism Academy was ranked in the top three in the world. There were more than 100,000 books on Exorcism. Although the students could read them freely, the birth of a powerful Exorcist was still very difficult.
With over 100,000 Exorcism books, many of them could be thrown to the side after a simple scan. However, there were still over 1,000 books worth reading seriously. Meng Chuan was now a mortal, so he read very slowly.
Fiends are divided into three levels: Bizarro Fiend, Great Fiend, and Origins Fiend.
Exorcists are divided into ordinary Exorcists, Master Exorcists, and Heaven Master Exorcists.
When ordinary Exorcists use Dharma artifacts, they have to work together to deal with one Bizarro Fiend. Fang Qi... was formerly an ordinary Exorcist. When he was dealing with a Bizarro Fiend, he lost an arm while saving his junior brother.
Fang Qi was already a true Exorcist. Even so, he also had to be careful. He couldn’t slack off at all when cooperating with his companions since a single mistake could result in his companions dying.
For a Master Exorcist to use a Dharma artifact to deal with a Bizarro Fiend alone is rare. They will at least be a fifth-grade official in the Imperial Court’s Exorcism Division, but only by combining forces with a group of Master Exorcists can they have a chance of dealing with a Great Fiend!
Heaven Master Exorcists represent the highest realm of Exorcists. The Imperial Court only has one. In the entire world... there are only a handful of Heaven Master Exorcists. They can deal with one Great Fiend in a one-on-one battle with external objects like Dharma artifacts.
As for Origins Fiends? The nine Origins Fiends in the world have been sealed. They have lived for at least thousands of years. In history, every Origins Fiend that breaks through the seal will cause pandemonium to the world. Life will plunge into misery and suffering. All the Exorcism factions in the world will join forces to seal it. No matter how many Exorcists there are, they have never killed an Origins Fiend. Origins Fiends are indestructible.
Meng Chuan frowned.
In this world, Exorcists used their psyche to communicate with Dharma Seals, talismans, Dharma artifacts, and other external objects. They used the Heaven and Earth powers to deal with fiends, but their bodies were ultimately mortal.
My tribulation this time... The unknown force threw my consciousness here and only sent a message—Become the strongest expert in this world!
Meng Chuan looked at the book in front of him.
However, I can confirm that this world can’t absorb external powers at all.
Meng Chuan’s willpower was at the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm. How powerful was it? However, his willpower relied on this body. His body was his soul’s vessel! If his soul was too powerful, it would crush his body.
Meng Chuan could sense that his soul was very weak. Although his willpower had transformed his soul, he couldn’t absorb any external power.
Power of Heaven and Earth, Power of the Stars, Power of Supreme Yin, Power of Supreme Yang...
All powers were sealed.
This body’s soul was clearly extremely thirsty and could rapidly grow, but there wasn’t enough energy to supply it. It couldn’t seek external help; the only way to absorb energy was by eating!
Eating allowed him to absorb nutrients to supply his body and soul. Furthermore, this world was only filled with mortal food. There was no way to transcend the mortal world by eating these.
I can’t absorb external powers just by eating. Even my willpower can’t control my soul. It should be a law restriction.
Meng Chuan understood this point.
Become the strongest in this world as a mortal?
Meng Chuan pondered and continued reading.
...
Meng Chuan taught at Exorcism Academy. He spent his free time reading and exercising.
Mortals could naturally temper their bodies.
Meng Chuan knew too many ways to temper his body. As he tried, he gradually figured out a set of mortal exercises. This was the most suitable training method based on his severed arm.
He also bought a large amount of meat, and he ate large amounts of meat every day. With enough meat, not only could his body become stronger rapidly, but his soul could also absorb nutrients and grow.
He ate meat every day for an hour. Every day, he trained with his mortal body exercises for eight hours. On average, he only needed to teach for an hour a day... Besides working out every day, he had to make the best use of his time to read.
As a mortal, he had limited time. Even if he tried his best, it would be very difficult for him to transcend the tribulation successfully. If he slacked off? He would probably fail.
Apart from sleeping, he didn’t waste any time. Just this mental fortitude and perseverance were something very few mortals could attain.
In two years, his body had reached the limits of mortals.
Sigh, the soul a mortal body at its limits can carry is too weak.
Meng Chuan picked up a 50-kilogram stone lock with his left hand and casually threw it. After throwing it five to six meters high, he reached out to catch it.
It seemed pretty good, but any random Bizarro Fiend was ten-fold stronger than him in pure strength, much less a Great Fiend that could destroy cities.
Such a body is the limit of this world’s mortals?
Meng Chuan sighed.
Mortals had their limits. Strength, speed, and everything else had their limits, and it was difficult to break past the limits.
Meng Chuan estimated that 1,500 kilograms of strength was the limit for mortals. Of course, he had to consider his severed arm.
After my body reaches its limits, the soul I can carry will also reach its limits. I won’t be able to become stronger; this is the foundation I can rely on.
Meng Chuan knew this very well.
Exorcists use their psyche to communicate with Dharma Seals, talismans, Dharma artifacts, and other items... The psyche originates from the soul. My soul’s limit is only this high. Furthermore, a mortal’s body will gradually decline from its peak at the age of 30. They will be old by the age of 50. It’s already not bad if they can live to the age of 80 or 90.
Therefore, it’s best if I succeed in transcending the tribulation at the age of 30. The longer I delay, the older my body will become, and the weaker my soul will be... In turn, it will be harder to become the world’s strongest.
Meng Chuan also understood this.
The strongest in this world was naturally not in comparison to humans but to all living beings in this world.
...
The third year of Meng Chuan’s teaching.
“The rebels have entered the capital!” The capital was in chaos, and the flames of war burned through the entire city.
The imperial palace was in chaos; the imperial family had fled in advance.
A one-armed, linen-clothed youth walked out of the imperial palace with a bag on his back. Some soldiers encountered him, but they didn’t seem to see him.
Meng Chuan’s soul had reached this mortal body’s limit. Although he had yet to reach the Essence Soul realm, Meng Chuan could still cast simple illusions. At the very least, he could bewitch dozens of ordinary people. Of course, if he encountered someone with strong willpower, the illusions his soul cast could be seen through. That or in front of a large number of people... He couldn’t bewitch too many people at the same time.
The imperial family actually ignored these three precious Exorcism manuals. They only fled with the treasures.
Meng Chuan sighed inwardly.
He had long set his sights on these three precious Exorcism manuals. They were manuals that the Great Yu Dynasty forced the three top Exorcism factions to hand over when it was at its peak.
The Imperial Palace had a copy, and so did the Exorcism Division headquarters.
However, Meng Chuan didn’t go to the Exorcism Division. This was because he felt that it was easier to obtain the manuals from the Imperial Palace.
The capital has been breached. The Great Yu Dynasty is completely finished.
On this day, Meng Chuan left the capital and embarked on his journey home.
...
The south’s largest city, Binhai City.
Fang Qi’s father sold all his farmland and moved to this large city?
The single-armed Meng Chuan carried his luggage and walked through Binhai City.
Binhai City was close to the sea, and trade flourished here. Although the world was in chaos and several factions controlled Binhai City, it maintained a rare peace. It also caused wealthy merchants and nobles to flee here with their families. Under the chaos of war, Binhai City became the most prosperous city in the world.
When Meng Chuan was teaching at Exorcism Academy, he received a letter from Fang Qi’s father, Fang Dalong. He said that he had moved to Binhai City and gave him an address.
This is it.
Meng Chuan finally found the address.
“What? You lost the bag of silver I gave you last night?” A roar sounded from the manor in front of him. The roar was extremely familiar to Meng Chuan. The voice in his memories belonged to his father—Fang Dalong!
Meng Chuan walked forward and knocked on the door.
The door opened.
An honest old man looked out and asked, “Who is it?”
Then, the honest old man immediately revealed a look of delight. “Eldest Young Master!”
“Master, Eldest Young Master is back. Eldest Young Master is back,” shouted the honest old man immediately.
“Uncle Sanmao,” greeted Meng Chuan with a smile.
One of Fang Dalong’s two lackeys was Wang Sanmao. Uncle Sanmao was strong, bold, and loyal. When Fang Dalong was young, Wang Sanmao followed him.
Even his wife was snatched by Fang Dalong and his men for his old pal. Toward the end of the dynasty, the government didn’t have much power. The chaos in the countryside meant that whoever had the biggest fist had the last word. It had become a tradition to snatch brides. Being able to snatch and hold onto her meant that one was strong enough. People would even consider it a good marriage.
“Qi’er is back?” A loud voice resounded throughout the manor, and a burly man with two guns at his waist ran out. He had a square face and was a hairy man. His eyes were like a tiger’s, and he had a rash aura.
Fang Dalong relied on his guns and his subordinates to become a wealthy local. He even sent his son to the capital’s Exorcism Academy.
Meng Chuan looked at the man. Fang Dalong was 41 years old, but he didn’t look old.
Fang Dalong saw the youth dressed in plain clothes standing in front of him. When he left, Fang Qi was still a youth with clean facial features, but now, he had lost an arm.
“Qi’er.” Fang Dalong hugged his son as tears rolled down his cheeks. “It’s all Dad’s fault; it’s Dad’s fault. I shouldn’t have sent you to the Exorcism Academy.”
“I was rash,” said Meng Chuan.
He remembered Fang Dalong’s repeated exhortations when he sent his son to the Exorcism Academy. “Qi’er, go to the Exorcism Academy and learn how to exorcise fiends. Come back after you’re done; don’t join the Exorcism Division.”
However, the young and impetuous Fang Qi clearly ignored his father’s exhortations and joined the Exorcism Division in high spirits.
As the father and son hugged, women and children came to the front yard.
“This is Eldest Young Master?”
“Why is he crippled?”
“Don’t spout nonsense. Eldest Young Master is an official of the Imperial Court.”
“The imperial government is gone. What official? Now that there’s war and chaos, our family is already tight on money. Now, we have another eldest young master.”
The women muttered, and some of them had unfriendly gazes. Back when Fang Qi went to the capital, he had reasons for not interacting with these aunts.
Fang Dalong hugged his son tightly for a while before letting go.
Meng Chuan looked at the women in the courtyard. There were even some children.
Fang Dalong felt a little embarrassed when he saw this. He smiled obsequiously and said, “You know your Second Aunt and the others, but there are a few that you don’t know. Let me introduce them to you. This is your Sixth Aunt, and this is your Eighth Aunt. This is your Eleventh Aunt...”
“How many did you marry?” asked Meng Chuan.
“I didn’t want to bother you when you were in the capital, so I didn’t tell you.” Fang Dalong smiled honestly. “When I was in the countryside, I married my seventh wife. Later, when I moved to the city... Now that it’s all war and chaos, I’m even more popular. I married another six. However, your Twelfth Aunt just married me half a month ago, and she left with someone else! She’s really blind; she’ll regret it!”
Meng Chuan didn’t say a word as he listened.
Fang Dalong smiled obsequiously when he saw his son’s expression. “Let’s not talk about such depressing matters. Qi’er, your return is something worth celebrating. Are you staying?”
“I won’t be leaving for now,” said Meng Chuan.
Fang Dalong heaved a sigh of relief.
Many of the aunts’ expressions turned ugly.

chapters.title: Chapter 763 - Binhais Exorcism World
chapters.content:
Chapter 763: Binhai’s Exorcism World
Translator:
CKtalon
“You brats, hurry up and practice your boxing,” Fang Dalong shouted at the children around the aunts.
“Yes, Dad.” Immediately, six children answered loudly. They couldn’t help but look curiously at their eldest brother. They had heard that their eldest brother was a high-ranking official in the imperial government and an Exorcist. However, their father held great authority over them.
The six children went to practice as usual.
“Qi’er, I’ll bring you to your room,” said Fang Dalong to his eldest son amiably.
Meng Chuan knew about Fang Dalong’s rise to wealthiness. The reason why Fang Dalong could rise to prominence from being a normal villager was that he could fight. This world also had fist arts, and there were also so-called fist art grandmasters... However, fist art grandmasters only had 500 kilograms of strength. They relied on their exquisite fist arts to fight 100 enemies alone.
With the advent of firearms, the status of fist arts declined. After all, if more than ten firearms were fired at the same time, even fist art grandmasters would have to flee in a sorry state. After all, they were also made of flesh and blood.
If they were slightly slower, they would have a few more holes on their bodies.
“This courtyard is yours.” Fang Dalong brought Meng Chuan to a small courtyard. “The layout is the same as our old home.”
As he spoke, he pushed open the door and entered.
Meng Chuan could tell at a glance that the house was often cleaned. It was very clean, and the layout was similar to what he remembered. There was also a photo of a couple hugging their children.
The man was the young Fang Dalong, while the woman was a gentle woman.
“All your belongings have been moved here from our hometown. None of them have been lost.” As Fang Dalong spoke, he walked over and gently wiped the photos. When he was young, taking photos was an extravagance. Back then, he had happily brought his wife and children to the city to take photos.
When he was 16, Fang Dalong got married. His wife was 17 years old—a year older.
He had built his business from scratch and established a large family business in the chaotic world. He had connections with the rebel forces and had a good relationship with the local government officials. His might sent reverberations across the surrounding 50 kilometers.
There was once a local official who wanted to take him down, but that official was assassinated by the rebel army. The local villains submitted to him and followed him. He even brought many of his fellow villagers to Binhai.
“What I regret the most is agreeing to let you go to the capital and the Exorcism Academy.” Fang Dalong put down the photo and sat on the bed with a sigh. At that moment, Meng Chuan’s father looked like he had aged considerably.
“I wanted to be an Exorcist back then; it’s not your fault,” said Meng Chuan. When Fang Qi was young, he had heard of scenes of Exorcists performing Exorcisms. He yearned for it.
“If I didn’t agree, could a brat like you go to the capital?” Fang Dalong glanced at his son and sighed. “Back then, I was too ambitious. I thought that firearms were too powerful. Our Fang family wasn’t reliable enough with our fist arts, so we had to learn more powerful skills. That’s why I got you to go to the capital’s Exorcism Academy... In this chaotic world, even money and food are useless. Only by relying on people can you gain a foothold. No matter who it is, they have to respect the means of Exorcists.”
Meng Chuan could tell that Fang Dalong was indeed a formidable figure. In his hometown, he intimidated a 50-kilometer area. Now, he was in the most prosperous Binhai City. To be able to buy such a large manor and have more than ten family guards, one could tell that he still had quite a high status.
“I’ve let your mother down. I swore in front of your mother’s grave that I would take good care of you and your sister, but I went back on my word.” Fang Dalong’s voice sounded a little weak. He might still be ferocious in the outside world, but he was over 40 years old now. He could sense that his body was no longer anything like before.
“But it’s good that you’re back.” Fang Dalong looked at his son. “Now that you’re back, find a few women and have a few babies. Live a good life.”
“Where’s my sister?” Meng Chuan changed the topic.
Fang Dalong shook his head and said, “Your sister is out camping in the wilderness. I’ve pampered her too much; she’s getting more and more out of hand.” Although he later married some aunts and had children, he only doted on Fang Qi and Fang Qian. They were also the ones he couldn’t control the most.
Meng Chuan nodded. In his memories, his younger sister—Fang Qian—was Fang Qi’s biological sister.
After inheriting this body, he owed Fang Qi karma. Meng Chuan naturally placed great importance on the person he cared about the most.
...
In just an hour, his sister—Fang Qian—rushed back.
“Brother, Brother.” The wavy-haired Fang Qian ran to Meng Chuan’s courtyard.
When Meng Chuan heard the voice, he walked out of the house. At a glance, he saw a young, energetic, and beautiful woman.
His younger sister, Fang Qian, looked a little like his mother in the picture, but she was even younger. Her eyes were very bright. After all, she had been practicing boxing since she was young. She was very energetic.
Fang Qian also looked at the linen-clothed youth in front of her. His sleeve was empty; clearly, he had lost an arm. His aura was restrained and calm. He didn’t look like he was in his early twenties at all. Instead, he looked like an elder in his forties or fifties who had experienced hardships.
Fang Qian looked at her brother. He was already a teenager when he left home. She could recognize him; it was just that he looked more mature now.
However, this bearing...
Fang Qian knew that losing an arm would definitely be a huge blow to her brother.
“Brother.” Fang Qian ran over and hugged her brother tightly. Her tears soaked Meng Chuan’s clothes.
...
“Third Sister, now that this Eldest Young Master is back, Master won’t let him manage the family, right?”
“Master dotes on that pair of siblings very much.”
Five women gathered and ate snacks as they discussed.
“Don’t worry. If Eldest Young Master Fang Qi wasn’t crippled and had the ability to exorcise fiends, there’s a high chance he’d be the family head. However, he’s crippled. Our Fang family is also a wealthy family, so a crippled family head will become a joke in Binhai City. I heard that after being crippled, one’s exorcism abilities are crippled as well. He can’t even use firearms. In this world, he doesn’t have the right to be a family head,” said Third Aunt confidently.
Third Aunt now had the highest status in the Fang family household. After all, she was one of the dozens of ferocious people who followed the master. She had great marksmanship and had taken many lives. After marrying the master, the other aunts naturally feared her.
Her knowledge was also much greater.
Her deduction was very reasonable. Fang Qi—who was originally an ordinary Exorcist—needed several companions working together to deal with a single Bizarro Fiend. After losing his arm, he probably only had 10% of his strength left... He didn’t even have the right to join forces with his companions to deal with a Bizarro Fiend. It wasn’t too far off to say that his exorcism abilities were neutered.
However, Meng Chuan’s arrival naturally made things different.
...
What made these aunts relieved was that this Eldest Young Master, Fang Qi, didn’t participate in any family matters after returning. The Eldest Young Master rejected the money his father gave him. Instead, he casually took out a pearl and arranged for people in the manor to buy exorcism materials.
This made Fang Dalong solemn.
It looks like my eldest son’s efforts all these years weren’t for nothing.
The aunts were dumbfounded since most of them were short-sighted. They had married the master for money and survival.
That fist-sized pearl was worth tens of thousands of taels! This young master had been in the capital for so many years and was very ‘rich.’ Immediately, some young aunts’ attitudes changed, and they tried to curry favor.
Meng Chuan naturally didn’t think much of the Fang family’s wealth. With his hallucination capabilities, he had casually picked up some treasures from the royal family when the imperial palace was in chaos. Just half a bag of treasures he picked up made him a hundred-fold richer than the Fang family. He was definitely considered one of the richest in Binhai City.
It couldn’t be helped. Meng Chuan needed to refine Dharma artifacts. The more precious the materials were, the higher the price was. He might not even be able to buy them.
The pearl he publicly produced was the cheapest treasure in his bag.
Now that I’ve cultivated the Lightning Dharma and the Five Elements Dharma to the Heaven Master realm, I still need to study array formations and weapon refinement techniques.
Meng Chuan sat cross-legged in the room with a calm expression.
Lightning Dharma was divided into many combat mystic techniques and escape arts.
There were also many mystic techniques and escape arts for the Five Elements Dharma.
If he couldn’t win, he had to escape! After all, he was now a mortal. If he failed and lost his life, he would fail the tribulation.
Therefore, Meng Chuan placed great importance on escape arts. He had learned the fastest lightning escape art and the Five Elements escape art that could deal with all kinds of dangerous environments.
When he was at the Exorcism Academy, his lightning arts had reached the Heaven Master realm! The Five Elements escape arts were much more complicated. After obtaining the three precious Exorcism manuals from the Imperial Palace, he returned to Binhai City and cultivated for half a year before reaching the Heaven Master realm.
The first step of my cultivation is to reach the Heaven Master realm in the art of Exorcism, weapon refinement, and array formations. My first step is still lacking.
According to Meng Chuan’s plan, if he wanted to become the strongest in this world, he would follow the world’s system and cultivate it to the strongest state, including artifact refining and array formations.
After gaining sufficient experience, he would begin the second step: creation and development. He would attempt to create stronger methods.
The third step was to refine Dharma artifacts and Dharma Arrays that were most suitable for him.
The reason why humans were humans was that they were good at using tools! Many of the original Dharmic artifacts and array formations in this world had been damaged due to time. Secondly, Meng Chuan didn’t think much of the ones that had been preserved. After all, there was a limit to the realm Artifact Refinement Master Exorcists could reach.
Only by refining the strongest Dharmic artifacts and array formations and combining them with his many Exorcism mystic techniques could he reach an unprecedented level.
Even so, can I kill an Origins Fiend?
Meng Chuan didn’t know. This was because no Origins Fiends had ever died.
I’ll find a few Fiends to practice with.
Every time Meng Chuan cultivated to a certain level, he would experiment with fiends. With a flip of his hand, he took out a Dharma treasure compass: Fiend Aura Tracker.
This compass was a Dharma artifact. It could sense the fiendish aura within a 15-kilometer radius.
Oh?
Meng Chuan was astonished when he saw the black light on the compass.
Such a powerful fiendish aura. It’s a Great Fiend? A Great Fiend appeared in Binhai City?
I haven’t encountered any Great Fiends after descending to this world.
Meng Chuan was tempted.
Over the years, there were only nine Origins Fiends, and all of them had been sealed. Once one broke out of the seal, it would be a calamity.
Although there were more Great Fiends, they were still extremely rare. Perhaps there were dozens of them in this era, but they were scattered across the world. It was rather difficult for Meng Chuan to encounter one unless he deliberately searched for it.
To encounter a Great Fiend in Binhai City?
That night, Meng Chuan silently left Fang Manor. With the compass in hand, he tracked down the fiendish aura.
After walking for more than five kilometers, he arrived at a bustling area.
Meng Chuan looked up and saw a large number of military guards in front of a luxurious manor. There were also many esteemed guests arriving in cars.
Cars were novel items that appeared almost at the same time as firearms. A car cost more than 1,000 taels of silver, and they were a symbol of status in Binhai City.
“President Wan, please.”
“Chief Ma, the Marshal didn’t invite you. You can’t enter.”
“Mr. Wu, please.”
“Young Master Liu, please.”
One famous figure after another entered the manor.
“F**k, our Blood Axe Gang has over a hundred people. I’m the chief, but I’m not allowed to enter? Isn’t that an insult?” A man dressed in decent clothes was rather indignant as he looked at the mansion that had many nobles entering.
It was the Marshal’s residence. The Marshal was currently the most important figure in Binhai City.
Outside the manor, Meng Chuan watched from afar.
Oh?
Meng Chuan saw this.
Three cars arrived in a row. Out of the three cars, six people walked toward the mansion; Fang Dalong was one of the six.
Father is also here?
Meng Chuan fell into deep thought. Back then, Fang Dalong had brought his fellow men from his hometown to Binhai City and joined his good friend’s gang, the Gold Silver Gang. The Gold Silver Gang was one of the three biggest gangs in Binhai City, and Fang Dalong was ranked fifth in the Gold Silver Gang.
Meng Chuan walked over.
When the one-armed youth walked over, he didn’t attract any attention. It was as though people had instinctively ignored him.
“Please.” The usher at the door didn’t stop him. Instead, he smiled and let Meng Chuan in.
Meng Chuan walked into the manor and walked past the front yard. He arrived at a brightly lit hall, where many guests were already seated.
At the front of the hall was a tall platform. On the platform was a female singer singing. A group of dancers dressed in thin clothes was also dancing erotically. The singer was also a famous singer in Binhai City, but not many guests paid attention to her.
“Marshal has occupied more than half of Binhai City. Today, he has summoned all the famous people in Binhai City. I’m afraid he has ill intentions.”
“Humph, he hasn’t completely occupied Binhai City. If he angers the entire Binhai City, he would probably have to flee back to where he came from when everyone unites.”
“Everyone unite? It’s not that easy.”
The guests discussed secretly.
Fang Dalong sat there with a frown.
“Brothers, the Marshal hasn’t summoned us from the Gold Silver Gang since he came to Binhai City. The first time he’s summoning us is in public. Something doesn’t feel right,” said the skinny old man in the lead coldly.
“Let’s see how it goes,” said a muscular man beside him.
“Previously, he refused to meet us when we visited. He must want great things,” said a fair-skinned man gently.
“Let’s see how big his appetite is,” said Fang Dalong.
...
Meng Chuan sat at a corner table. There were two guests at the same table; they smiled and nodded at Meng Chuan, but they were somewhat puzzled. It was as though they didn’t know this person.
A warlord actually has 16 Bizarro Fiends and one Great Fiend in the residence.
Meng Chuan was somewhat surprised. At such a close distance, he could already sense the deep and vast Great Fiend aura.
It far exceeded Meng Chuan’s, but an Exorcist relied on the Heaven and Earth powers to fight an enemy. One couldn’t determine their strength from the surface.
Moments later, the singing and dancing ended.
Finally, escorted by two deputy generals, a middle-aged man with sharp eyes and dressed in a military uniform walked to the center of the stage. Immediately, all the guests below the stage fell silent. The person in front of them was the most powerful person in Binhai City.
“Everyone, I’ve led the army for more than ten years. Now that the Great Yu Dynasty has finally been overthrown, many of my brothers in the military have fallen on the road. When we fight, we fight with money. I can’t even take out the money to repay my fallen brethren; I’ve let them down,” said the middle-aged man with a sigh. “I know that Binhai City is a city of heroes. Everyone here is one of the best. I’ll naturally be grateful if all of you can support me with a few taels. With your wealth, you will be my enemy if you remain stingy.”
The middle-aged man looked at a fatty sitting in the front row.
The fatty immediately shouted, “Marshal led the army into battle. We naturally have to contribute. I’m willing to give 100,000 taels of silver.”
“Thank you, President Wan.” The Marshal smiled and nodded.
The expressions of many guests changed.
President Wan wasn’t considered an important figure in Binhai City’s upper echelons, but even he had to fork out 100,000 taels of silver. Wouldn’t the faction with the highest status need to produce 1,000,000 taels of silver? This wasn’t sucking blood but cutting off one’s thigh!
“Lord Li, what about you?” The Marshal’s gaze landed on an old man next to President Wan.
“I-I’m willing to pay...” The elder gritted his teeth. “I’m willing to pay 30,000 taels of silver! Marshal, this is all the liquidated money I have.”
“That’s too stingy.” The Marshal shook his head.
Bang!
A bloody hole appeared in the elder’s glabella, and blood gushed out. It was one of the soldiers standing in the hall who had fired.
This made the entire hall jittery.
“As I said, stinginess makes you my enemy.” The Marshal’s sharp eyes were filled with killing intent. “I naturally have to kill my enemy.”
“How much money we pay depends on our own wishes. Even if you aren’t satisfied, we can discuss it. Why didn’t you give him a chance to negotiate? How could you just shoot?” An old man—who had a wart between his eyebrows—sitting in the front row spoke calmly with a gloomy expression.
“To gather money in such a way, aren’t you afraid of losing your teeth by robbing the entire Binhai City?” Another young man, who had brought his wife, scoffed.
Meng Chuan knew these two people; these two were rather famous Master Exorcists.
There were two large Exorcism sects—Soul Bell Sect and Sea Fiend Sect—in Binhai. Exorcism sects had a long heritage. With Master Exorcists and Exorcists as the core, they had guns and people in these chaotic times. They also used various Heaven and Earth powers. These were the true top factions in Binhai City.
The Marshal looked at the two and knew that they represented the sect behind them. He couldn’t help but smile. “I admire the contributions the Exorcism sects have made to countless people. I’m very satisfied with just one million taels of silver from the Soul Bell Sect and the Sea Fiend Sect.”
“And you think those tens of thousands of soldiers give you the right?” The young man gently stroked his wife’s hand and questioned the Marshal indifferently.
The Sea Fiend Sect had thousands of well-equipped troops., and they controlled Sea Fiends. In a head-on battle, the Sea Fiend Sect wasn’t afraid of the so-called 30,000-strong army. However, sects that had long legacies rarely fought.
Master Exorcists never feared any political intrigue or a handful of battles! Master Exorcists were the only existence in this world that could deal with fiends. They could even deal with fiends, much less mortals.
“The Marshal has waged war everywhere. Fellow brothers of the Sea Fiend Sect and Soul Bell Sect should empathize with the Marshal’s hard work.” A gray-robed elder appeared from an illusion and stood beside the Marshal.
“Sect Master Feng?”
“Sect Master Feng?”
The young man and the wart-faced elder’s expressions changed.
The gray-robed elder in front of them was the current sect master of one of the top ten large sects in the world, the Fiend Refinement Sect. The Fiend Refinement Sect focused on controlling fiends! In the Fiend Refinement Sect’s history, it had refined a total of three Great Fiends. Two of these three Great Fiends were still alive.
Although it was difficult to control them... controlling one Great Fiend was comparable to the strength of a Heavenly Master Exorcist. Sect Master Feng was the one who could control the Great Fiends in the sect. He was a true figure in the Exorcism world.
“I believe my fellow brethren from the Soul Bell Sect and Sea Fiend Sect are willing to pay a million taels of silver each,” said the gray-robed elder with a smile.
The young man and the wart-faced elder exchanged looks.
“Since Sect Master Feng has spoken, we are willing to give in to the Marshal.” The young man and the wart-faced elder could only endure it. After all, the two sects in Binhai City combined were inferior to the Fiend Refinement Sect.
Since the Fiend Refinement Sect’s Sect Master had appeared, the Fiend Refinement Sect definitely had other Master Exorcists following them.
From the looks of it, the Fiend Refinement Sect is supporting Marshal Shi in this era of chaos.
Everyone in the hall understood this point.
Now that all the warlords in the world had risen, Marshal Shi’s strength wasn’t too eye-catching. He couldn’t be considered a first-tier warlord, but the first-tier warlords also had the support of powerful Exorcism factions.
Since Marshal Shi was able to gain the Fiend Refinement Sect’s support, everyone’s thoughts changed.
“My Li family is willing to support the Marshal with 200,000 taels.”
“My Fu family is willing to offer 200,000 taels.”
All parties made bids according to their strength, with the first person—President Wan—as a reference.
They weren’t afraid of the Marshal’s army, but if one added a top Exorcism faction in the world—the Fiend Refinement Sect—it was somewhat terrifying.
“My Gold Silver Gang is willing to pay one million taels,” said the Gold Silver Gang’s leader.
“The Gold Silver Gang is one of the three biggest gangs in Binhai City, and they are famous for their wealth. One million taels seem too little,” said Marshal Shi with a smile. “I think five million taels is more in line with your Gold Silver Gang’s status.”
The expressions of the Gold Silver Gang’s upper echelons changed drastically.
The Gold Silver Gang was indeed powerful, but the daily expenditure of its many members was astonishing. The gang appeared to be glamorous on the surface, but in reality, its foundation was inferior to some large merchants. Taking out one million taels was already draining the gang’s cash flow, and the gang would have to mortgage their assets in the future.
As for five million taels? It was no longer cutting off their thighs but their lives.
Marshal Shi smiled as he looked over, but his eyes were very cold. He could be lenient toward Exorcism factions and large family clans with deep backgrounds.
As for the so-called three big gangs? He didn’t plan on letting go of any of the gangs formed by a bunch of mudlarks.
“The three big gangs have equal status. I think it’s quite good for each one to offer five million taels,” said Marshal Shi.
“This...”
“Marshal!”
The other two gangs’ upper echelons also reeled with anxiety.
Gangs appeared to have many members, but they were far inferior to factions with tens of thousands of soldiers. Therefore, with a single order, the three gangs’ upper echelons had to come over. However, they didn’t expect Marshal Shi to be so ruthless.
“Don’t be in a hurry. I’ll talk to the Gold Silver Gang first. I believe they love the military and the people.” Marshal Shi looked at the Gold Silver Gang’s upper echelons, and the other two gangs’ upper echelons turned pale.
“Marshal, your actions imply that you want to devour the three gangs,” said the skinny old man.
“Isn’t the law of the jungle only natural?” Marshal Shi looked at the old man.
“We can’t produce five million taels.” The thin elder shook his head.
The muscular man beside him also said, “Even if the entire Gold Silver Gang is handed over to you, we won’t be able to gather five million taels.”
“Of course, the gang can’t produce it. After all, a lot of the gang’s money is in your families. Your families should be able to scrounge up some if you search your households,” said Marshal Shi with a smile. “Either you become my enemy, in which I kill you and send troops to search your households, or you become my friends and take the initiative to offer five million taels.”
If he really killed these upper echelons, the gang would be in chaos, and the gang members would flee with the money. It would be very difficult for him to gather the money.
If he forced these upper echelons to gather it themselves, he would be able to gain more.
“These mudlarks.” The other people in the hall watched this scene coldly.
Gangs were very different from large family clans, large merchant associations, and Exorcism sects. Gangs rose from the bottom, becoming massive forces in an era of chaos.
It was obvious that although Marshal Shi was ruthless toward the other factions, he was simply lethal toward the three big gangs.
“Does the Gold Silver Gang want to be my enemy?” Marshal Shi looked at the six upper echelons of the Gold Silver Gang.
Immediately, soldiers raised their guns and pointed them at those six people.
Fang Dalong felt extremely aggrieved.
When the rebel army was weak, they had to befriend local factions. This was the case back in his hometown.
But after the Imperial Court was completely destroyed, the rebel army became much more ferocious. When Fang Dalong saw that the situation wasn’t looking good, he sold all his fields, uprooted his family, and brought them to Binhai City. He sought refuge with his old friend and joined the Gold Silver Gang.
Unexpectedly, the Gold Silver Gang was also being coerced.
In this era of chaos, big fish eat small fish. The Gold Silver Gang is also a small fish.
Fang Dalong understood this point.
Oh?
Fang Dalong suddenly sensed something. He turned around and saw a one-armed youth walk to his side.
“Qi’er?” Fang Dalong was alarmed.
Why is my son here?
Although Meng Chuan’s Exorcism techniques were brilliant, he was ultimately a mortal. If he was far away, he wouldn’t be able to intercept a bullet. Therefore, he stood by Fang Dalong’s side! No matter how many soldiers there were, it would be difficult for them to threaten Fang Dalong.
“Leave quickly,” urged Fang Dalong in a low voice. The soldiers were targeting the Gold Silver Gang’s upper echelons. They hadn’t targeted his son, but now that his son had appeared, wasn’t he throwing himself into a dire situation?
“It’s nothing.” Meng Chuan comforted him and looked up at Marshal Shi. “Marshal Shi, I’m very puzzled. The capital is in the north, and most of the Imperial Court’s armies are gathered in the north. If you want to overthrow the Imperial Court, why did the army keep heading south and end up in Binhai City?”
The hall fell silent.
Everyone was astonished by how bold the one-armed youth was. Even the Gold Silver Gang’s upper echelons were alarmed.
“Who are you?” asked Marshal Shi coldly.
The gray-robed elder, Sect Master Feng, formed a seal with one hand in his sleeve, and his eyes glowed with purple light as he looked at Meng Chuan.
Then, his expression couldn’t help but change slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 764 - Heaven Master Fang
chapters.content:
Chapter 764: Heaven Master Fang
Translator:
CKtalon
It was very difficult to determine an Exorcist’s strength. It was impossible to tell how deep their understanding of talisman arts and mudras was or whether they had powerful Dharma artifacts on the surface.
At that moment, Sect Master Feng was using a mystic technique to probe the psyche strength of the person in front of him. Most Exorcists didn’t care about their bodies but focused on cultivating their souls and minds! This was because most of them had never cultivated their souls to their bodies’ limits, so they naturally didn’t need to waste time on their bodies.
What powerful psyche strength.
Although Sect Master Feng was secretly alarmed, he wasn’t afraid.
The study of talisman techniques and mudra techniques required time. The older one was, the higher their realm was. The current generation’s Heaven Master Exorcists were all over 50 years old. One’s psyche grew with age.
Meng Chuan was an exception—his willpower was at the Essence Soul Eighth Tribulation realm the moment he descended! The strength of his soul depended on his body, so his soul would be as strong as his body could bear! Therefore, Meng Chuan’s peak psyche strength was before he was 30 years old.
But in this world, the older an Exorcist was, the stronger their psyche was, and the more terrifying their strength was.
“My friend,” said Sect Master Feng with a smile. “Which sect are you from?”
The moment he spoke, almost everyone in the hall looked at Meng Chuan. Even Marshal Shi didn’t say anything. After all, Marshal Shi was just a warlord. He only dared to act so arrogantly because of the Fiend Refinement Sect’s backing.
With the Fiend Refinement Sect’s sect master personally speaking, everyone realized that this one-armed youth was also an Exorcist and that he might have a powerful background.
“Do you know this young man?” the wart-faced elder asked his companion softly.
“I don’t know him. I don’t think I’ve heard of him among the experts of the Exorcism world,” whispered the young man.
“Both of us don’t know him, so he shouldn’t be from our Binhai’s Exorcism world,” said the wart-faced elder. “Let’s wait and see.”
...
Meng Chuan looked at the gray-robed elder on the stage. “My own.”
Sect Master Feng felt relieved when he heard that.
In the world, the Fiend Refinement Sect was only ranked in the top ten when it came to Exorcism. There were still others stronger than it, and there were also a few Heaven Master Exorcists in the current generation. He was afraid that this young man came from a powerful sect.
Your own? From the looks of it, he’s just a lucky kid who obtained an Exorcism technique, or perhaps it’s someone from the Great Yu Dynasty’s Exorcism Division. He doesn’t have any backing.
Sect Master Feng looked at Meng Chuan with a cold glint in his eyes.
There are too many young people nowadays who don’t know the immensity of the world.
Even though he was the Fiend Refinement Sect’s sect master, he remained very cautious. He chose to probe this young man’s background first.
Instead, the one-armed youth was so arrogant.
“Ignore him.” Sect Master Feng looked at Marshal Shi beside him and said the words he would eventually regret the most in his life.
When Marshal Shi heard this, he nodded slightly. He couldn’t be bothered to say another word to the one-armed youth.
He only glanced at his subordinate, and his eyelids drooped.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Three gunshots rang out simultaneously as the bullets shot toward Meng Chuan.
“Qi’er!” Fang Dalong was also a marksman. He instantly determined the direction of the muzzles and instinctively put himself between Meng Chuan and the bullets.
Meng Chuan stood where he was extremely calmly. Only his left hand stopped his father.
Chi!
An explosion sounded.
